having destroyed his deeds and renown in the world, O best of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstyakīrtisamo mṛtyurmāsti krodhasamo ripuḥ /
nāsti nindāsamaṃ pāpaṃ nāsti mohasamāsavaḥ //
meaning:
नास्त्यकीर्तिसमो मृत्युर्मास्ति क्रोधसमो रिपुः /
नास्ति निन्दासमं पापं नास्ति मोहसमासवः //
text_mt:
There is no death equal to infamy; there is no enemy equal to anger;
there is no sin equal to censure; there is no intoxicating liquor equal to delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstyasūyāsamā kīrtirnāsti kāmasamo 'nalaḥ /
nāsti rāgasamaḥ pāśo nāsti saṅgasamaṃ viṣam //
meaning:
नास्त्यसूयासमा कीर्तिर्नास्ति कामसमो ऽनलः /
नास्ति रागसमः पाशो नास्ति सङ्गसमं विषम् //
text_mt:
There is no ill-fame equal to envy; there is no fire equal to desire;
there is no snare equal to attachment; there is no poison equal to clinging.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vilapyabahudhā bāhuratyantaduḥkhitaḥ /
jīrṇāṅgomanasastāpād vṛddhabhāvādabhūdasau //
meaning:
एवं विलप्यबहुधा बाहुरत्यन्तदुःखितः /
जीर्णाङ्गोमनसस्तापाद् वृद्धभावादभूदसौ //
text_mt:
Lamenting thus in many ways, Bāhu, exceedingly distressed,
his body withered from mental anguish and old age, declined.

sanskrit_iast:
gate bahutithe kāle aurvāśramasamīpataḥ /
sa bāhurvyādhinā graste mamāra munisattama //
meaning:
गते बहुतिथे काले और्वाश्रमसमीपतः /
स बाहुर्व्याधिना ग्रस्ते ममार मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt:
After much time had passed near the hermitage of Aurva,
that Bāhu, seized by disease, died, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryā ca duḥkhārtā kaniṣṭhā garbhiṇī tadā /
ciraṃ vilapya bahudhā sahagantuṃ mano dadhe //
meaning:
तस्य भार्या च दुःखार्ता कनिष्ठा गर्भिणी तदा /
चिरं विलप्य बहुधा सहगन्तुं मनो दधे //
text_mt:
Then his younger wife, afflicted with grief and pregnant,
lamenting long in many ways, set her mind on going with him [in death].

sanskrit_iast:
samānīya casaidhāṃsi citāṃ kṛtvātiduḥkhitā /
samāropya tanpūruḍhaṃ svayaṃ samupacakrame //
meaning:
समानीय चसैधांसि चितां कृत्वातिदुःखिता /
समारोप्य तन्पूरुढं स्वयं समुपचक्रमे //
text_mt:
Having gathered firewood and prepared a pyre, exceedingly grieving,
having placed the dead body [upon it], she herself began to mount it.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare dhīmanaurvastejonidhirmuniḥ /
etadvijñātavānsarvaṃ parameṇa samādhinā //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे धीमनौर्वस्तेजोनिधिर्मुनिः /
एतद्विज्ञातवान्सर्वं परमेण समाधिना //
text_mt:
In the meantime, O wise one, the sage Aurva, a treasure of fiery energy,
perceived all this through supreme absorption.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ varttamānaṃ trikālajñāmunīśvarāḥ /
gatāsūyā mahātnānaḥ paśyantijñāna cakṣuṣā //
meaning:
भूतं भव्यं वर्त्तमानं त्रिकालज्ञामुनीश्वराः /
गतासूया महात्नानः पश्यन्तिज्ञान चक्षुषा //
text_mt:
Past, future, and present, knowing the three times, the lords of sages,
freed from envy, great-souled ones, see through the eye of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
tapobhistejasāṃ rāśiraurvapuṇyasamo muniḥ /
saṃprātpastatra sādhvī ca yatra bāhupriyā sthitā //
meaning:
तपोभिस्तेजसां राशिरौर्वपुण्यसमो मुनिः /
संप्रात्पस्तत्र साध्वी च यत्र बाहुप्रिया स्थिता //
text_mt:
A mass of splendor through austerities, the sage Aurva, equal to accumulated merit,
arrived there, virtuous, where the beloved wife of Bāhu stood.

sanskrit_iast:
citāmāroḍhumudyuktāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munisattamaḥ /
provāca dharmamūlāni vākyāni munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
चितामारोढुमुद्युक्तां तां दृष्ट्वा मुनिसत्तमः /
प्रोवाच धर्ममूलानि वाक्यानि मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt:
Seeing her about to ascend the pyre, that best of sages
spoke words rooted in righteousness, O best of sages:

sanskrit_iast:
aurva uvāca
rājavaryapriye sādhvi mā kuruṣvātisāhasam /
tavodare cakravartī śanuhantā hi tiṣṭati //
bālāpatyāśca garbhiṇyo hyadṛṣṭaṛtavastathā /
meaning:
और्व उवाच
राजवर्यप्रिये साध्वि मा कुरुष्वातिसाहसम् /
तवोदरे चक्रवर्ती शनुहन्ता हि तिष्टति //
बालापत्याश्च गर्भिण्यो ह्यदृष्टऋतवस्तथा /
text_mt:
Aurva said:
“O virtuous lady, beloved of the best of kings, do not commit such rashness!
For within your womb abides a universal monarch, a slayer of foes.

Women with young children, pregnant women, and those whose courses have not appeared,

sanskrit_iast: rajasvalā rājasutenārohati cintāśubho //
meaning: रजस्वला राजसुतेनारोहति चिन्ताशुभो //
text_mt: Or menstruating women, O princess, do not mount the inauspicious pyre.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ proktā niṣkṛtiruttamaiḥ /
dāmbhinonindakasyāpi bhrūṇaghrasya na niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां प्रोक्ता निष्कृतिरुत्तमैः /
दाम्भिनोनिन्दकस्यापि भ्रूणघ्रस्य न निष्कृतिः //
text_mt:
Expiation for sins like the slaughter of a Brahmin has been declared by the noble,
[but] for the deceitful, the censurer, and the slayer of an embryo, there is no expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikasya kṛtanghasya dharmopekṣākarasya ca /
viśvāsaghātakasyāpi niṣkṛtirnāsti suvrate //
meaning:
नास्तिकस्य कृतन्घस्य धर्मोपेक्षाकरस्य च /
विश्वासघातकस्यापि निष्कृतिर्नास्ति सुव्रते //
text_mt:
For an atheist, an ungrateful person, one who neglects righteousness,
and a betrayer of trust, there is no expiation, O lady of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādetanmahatpāpaṃ karttuṃ nārhasi śobhane /
yadetadduḥkhamutpannaṃ tatsarvaṃ śāntimeṣyati //
meaning:
तस्मादेतन्महत्पापं कर्त्तुं नार्हसि शोभने /
यदेतद्दुःखमुत्पन्नं तत्सर्वं शान्तिमेष्यति //
text_mt:
Therefore, O fair one, you ought not to commit this great sin;
all this sorrow that has arisen will come to an end.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā muninā sādhvī viśvasya tadanugraham /
vilalāpātiduḥkhārtā samuhyadhavapatkujau //
meaning:
इत्युक्ता मुनिना साध्वी विश्वस्य तदनुग्रहम् /
विललापातिदुःखार्ता समुह्यधवपत्कुजौ //
text_mt:
Addressed thus by the sage, the virtuous woman, trusting his grace,
lamented, tormented by extreme sorrow, and fainting, fell to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
aurvo 'pi tāṃ punaḥ prāha sarvaśāstrārthakoviduḥ /
mārodīrāja nanaye śriyamagrye gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
और्वो ऽपि तां पुनः प्राह सर्वशास्त्रार्थकोविदुः /
मारोदीराज ननये श्रियमग्र्ये गमिष्यसि //
text_mt:
Aurva also, skilled in the meaning of all scriptures, said to her again:
“Do not weep, O king's daughter; you will attain foremost splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
mā bhuṃ cāstramāhābhāgepreto dāhyo 'dya sajjanaiḥ /
tasmācchokaṃ parityajya kuru kālocitā kri pām //
meaning:
मा भुं चास्त्रमाहाभागेप्रेतो दाह्यो ऽद्य सज्जनैः /
तस्माच्छोकं परित्यज्य कुरु कालोचिता क्रि पाम् //
text_mt:
Do not shed tears, O noble lady; the departed must be cremated today by good people.
Therefore, abandoning grief, perform the rite appropriate to the time.

sanskrit_iast:
paṇḍite vāpimūrkhe vā daridre vāśriyānvite /
durvṛtte vā suvṛtte vā mṛtyoḥsarvatratulyatā //
meaning:
पण्डिते वापिमूर्खे वा दरिद्रे वाश्रियान्विते /
दुर्वृत्ते वा सुवृत्ते वा मृत्योःसर्वत्रतुल्यता //
text_mt:
Toward the learned or the fool, toward the poor or the rich,
toward the ill-behaved or the well-behaved, death is equal everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: nagare vā tathāmanye dainyamatrātiricyate //
meaning: नगरे वा तथामन्ये दैन्यमत्रातिरिच्यते //
text_mt: Whether in a city or likewise elsewhere, I deem that misery is surpassed here.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyatpurātanaṃ karmatattaderviha yujyate /
kāraṇaṃ daivamevātra manye sopādhikā janāḥ //
meaning:
यद्यत्पुरातनं कर्मतत्तदेर्विह युज्यते /
कारणं दैवमेवात्र मन्ये सोपाधिका जनाः //
text_mt:
Whatever ancient deed was done, that alone is joined [to one] here;
I deem fate alone to be the cause in this, while people are mere conditions.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhe vā bālyabhāve vā yauvane vāpi vārddhake /
mṛtyorvaśaṃ prayātavyaṃ jantubhiḥ kamalānane //
meaning:
गर्भे वा बाल्यभावे वा यौवने वापि वार्द्धके /
मृत्योर्वशं प्रयातव्यं जन्तुभिः कमलानने //
text_mt:
In the womb, or in childhood, or in youth, or in old age,
creatures must pass under the power of death, O lotus-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
hanti pāti ca govindro jantūnkarmavaśe sthitān /
pravādaṃ ropayantyajñā hetumātreṣu jantuṣu //
meaning:
हन्ति पाति च गोविन्द्रो जन्तून्कर्मवशे स्थितान् /
प्रवादं रोपयन्त्यज्ञा हेतुमात्रेषु जन्तुषु //
text_mt:
Govinda slays and protects living beings who abide under the power of karma;
the ignorant attribute causation to living beings who are mere instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduḥkhaṃ parityajya sukhitī bhava suvrate /
kuru patyuśca karmāṇi vivekena sthirā bhava //
meaning:
तस्मादुःखं परित्यज्य सुखिती भव सुव्रते /
कुरु पत्युश्च कर्माणि विवेकेन स्थिरा भव //
text_mt:
Therefore, abandon sorrow and be happy, O lady of good vows;
perform the funeral rites for your husband, and be firm through discernment.

sanskrit_iast:
etaccharīraṃ duḥkhānāṃ vyādhīnāmathutairgṛtam /
sukhābhāsaṃ bahukleśaṃ karmapāśena yantritam //
meaning:
एतच्छरीरं दुःखानां व्याधीनामथुतैर्गृतम् /
सुखाभासं बहुक्लेशं कर्मपाशेन यन्त्रितम् //
text_mt:
This body is surrounded by sorrows and diseases,
an illusion of happiness, full of afflictions, bound by the fetter of karma.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityāścāsya mahābuddhistayā kāryāṇyakārayat /
tyaktaśokā ca sā tanvī natā prāha munīśvaram //
meaning:
इत्याश्चास्य महाबुद्धिस्तया कार्याण्यकारयत् /
त्यक्तशोका च सा तन्वी नता प्राह मुनीश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Having thus comforted her, the great-minded one had the rites performed by her;
and having abandoned her grief, that slender woman bowed and said to the lord of sages:

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra citraṃ yatsantaḥ parārthaphalakāṅkṣiṇaḥ /
nahi drumāśca bhogārthaṃ phalanti jagatītale //
meaning:
किमत्र चित्रं यत्सन्तः परार्थफलकाङ्क्षिणः /
नहि द्रुमाश्च भोगार्थं फलन्ति जगतीतले //
text_mt:
“What wonder is there here that good people desire the fruit of others’ welfare?
Trees on the surface of the earth do not bear fruit for their own enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nyaduḥkhāni vijñāya sādhuvākyaiḥ prabodhayet /
sa eva viṣṇuḥsattvastho yataḥ parihite sthitaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽन्यदुःखानि विज्ञाय साधुवाक्यैः प्रबोधयेत् /
स एव विष्णुःसत्त्वस्थो यतः परिहिते स्थितः //
text_mt:
He who, having recognized another's sorrows, comforts them with good words,
he alone is Viṣṇu abiding in goodness, because he is established in the welfare of others.

sanskrit_iast:
anya duḥkhena yo duḥkhī yo 'nyaharṣeṇa harṣitaḥ /
sa eva jagatāmīśo nararupadharo hariḥ //
meaning:
अन्य दुःखेन यो दुःखी यो ऽन्यहर्षेण हर्षितः /
स एव जगतामीशो नररुपधरो हरिः //
text_mt:
He who is sorrowful at another's sorrow, and who rejoices at another's joy,
he alone is the Lord of the worlds, Hari bearing a human form.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhiḥ śrutāni śāstrāṇi paraduḥkhavimuktaye /
sarveṣāṃ duḥkhanāśāya iti santo vadanti hi //
meaning:
सद्भिः श्रुतानि शास्त्राणि परदुःखविमुक्तये /
सर्वेषां दुःखनाशाय इति सन्तो वदन्ति हि //
text_mt:
The sacred texts were studied by the virtuous for the release from others' sorrow,
for the destruction of the sorrow of all—thus the good indeed say.”

sanskrit_iast:
yatra santaḥ pravarttate tatra duḥkhaṃ na bādhate /
vartate yatra mārtāṇḍaḥ kathaṃ tatratamo bhavet //
meaning:
यत्र सन्तः प्रवर्त्तते तत्र दुःखं न बाधते /
वर्तते यत्र मार्ताण्डः कथं तत्रतमो भवेत् //
text_mt: Where good people move, sorrow does not oppress there; / where the sun is present, how could there be darkness?

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ vādinī sā tu svapatyuścāparāḥ kriyāḥ /
cakāra tatsarastīre muniproktavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं वादिनी सा तु स्वपत्युश्चापराः क्रियाः /
चकार तत्सरस्तीरे मुनिप्रोक्तविधानतः //
text_mt: Speaking thus, she performed the funeral rites of her husband / on the shore of that lake, according to the procedure taught by the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sthite tatra munau rājā devarāḍiva saṃjvalan /
citāmadhyādviniṣkramya vimānavaramāsthitaḥ /
prapede paramaṃ dhāma natvā caurvaṃ munīśvaram //
meaning:
स्थिते तत्र मुनौ राजा देवराडिव संज्वलन् /
चितामध्याद्विनिष्क्रम्य विमानवरमास्थितः /
प्रपेदे परमं धाम नत्वा चौर्वं मुनीश्वरम् //
text_mt: While the sage stood there, the king, blazing like the king of the gods, / stepped forth from the midst of the funeral pyre, mounted an excellent celestial chariot, / and reached the supreme abode after bowing to Aurva, the lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayuktā vā yuktā vā copapātakaiḥ /
paraṃ padaṃ prayāntyeva mahadbhiravalokitāḥ //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्ता वा युक्ता वा चोपपातकैः /
परं पदं प्रयान्त्येव महद्भिरवलोकिताः //
text_mt: Whether accompanied by great sins or accompanied by minor sins, / people certainly go to the supreme abode when looked upon by great souls.

sanskrit_iast:
kalevaraṃ vā tadbhasma taddhūmaṃ vāpi sattama /
yadi paśyati puṇyātmā sa prayāti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
कलेवरं वा तद्भस्म तद्धूमं वापि सत्तम /
यदि पश्यति पुण्यात्मा स प्रयाति परां गतिम् //
text_mt: Whether [it be] his body, or his ashes, or his smoke, O best of good men, / if a righteous-souled person looks upon it, he goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
patyuḥ kṛtakriyā sā tu gatvāśramapadaṃmuneḥ /
cakāra tasya śuśrūṣāṃ sapatnyā saha nārad //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāma satpamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पत्युः कृतक्रिया सा तु गत्वाश्रमपदंमुनेः /
चकार तस्य शुश्रूषां सपत्न्या सह नारद् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नाम सत्पमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having performed the rites for her husband, she went to the abode of the sage's hermitage / and served him together with her co-wife, O Nārada.

Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Eulogy of Greatness of the Gaṅgā', in the first quarter of the first part in the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
evamaurvāśrame te dve bāhubhārye munīśvara /
cakrāte bhaktibhāvena śuśrūṣaāṃ prativāsararam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
एवमौर्वाश्रमे ते द्वे बाहुभार्ये मुनीश्वर /
चक्राते भक्तिभावेन शुश्रूषआं प्रतिवासररम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / In this way, in the hermitage of Aurva, those two wives of Bāhu, O lord of sages, / performed service with a spirit of devotion every day.

sanskrit_iast:
gate varṣārdhdake kāle jyeṣṭhā rājñī tu yā dvija /
tasyāḥ pāpamatirjātā sapatnyāḥ saṃpadaṃ prati //
meaning:
गते वर्षार्ध्दके काले ज्येष्ठा राज्ञी तु या द्विज /
तस्याः पापमतिर्जाता सपत्न्याः संपदं प्रति //
text_mt: When a half-year had passed, the elder queen, O twice-born one, / developed an evil intention regarding the fortune of her co-wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastayā garo dattaḥ kaniṣṭhāyai tu pāpayā /
na svaprabhāvaṃ cakre vai garo muniniṣevayā //
meaning:
ततस्तया गरो दत्तः कनिष्ठायै तु पापया /
न स्वप्रभावं चक्रे वै गरो मुनिनिषेवया //
text_mt: Then poison was given by that evil woman to the younger one; / but the poison did not produce its effect on account of [her] serving the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūlepanādibhiḥ samyagyataḥ sāmudinaṃ muneḥ /
cakāra sevāṃ tenāsau jīrṇapuṇyena karmaṇā //
meaning:
भूलेपनादिभिः सम्यग्यतः सामुदिनं मुनेः /
चकार सेवां तेनासौ जीर्णपुण्येन कर्मणा //
text_mt: Because she properly performed service to the sage every day / by smearing the ground and so forth, through that act of merit it was digested.

sanskrit_iast:
tato māsa traye 'tīte gareṇa sahitaṃsutam /
suṣāva suśubhe kāle śuśrūṣānaṣṭakilbiṣā //
meaning:
ततो मास त्रये ऽतीते गरेण सहितंसुतम् /
सुषाव सुशुभे काले शुश्रूषानष्टकिल्बिषा //
text_mt: Then, when three months had elapsed, she brought forth a son / together with the poison at a very auspicious time, her sins destroyed by [her] service.

sanskrit_iast:
aho satsaṃgatirloke kiṃ pāpaṃ na vināśayet /
na tadātisukhaṃ kiṃ vā narāṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām //
meaning:
अहो सत्संगतिर्लोके किं पापं न विनाशयेत् /
न तदातिसुखं किं वा नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: Ah, what sin would good association not destroy in the world? / Or what extreme happiness would it not [bring] to men of meritorious deeds?

sanskrit_iast:
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yaccānyatkārītaṃ paraiḥ /
tatsarvaṃ nāśayatyāśu paricaryā mahātmanām //
meaning:
ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं पापं यच्चान्यत्कारीतं परैः /
तत्सर्वं नाशयत्याशु परिचर्या महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Sin committed through knowledge or ignorance, and whatever other [sin] was caused by others— / the service of great souls quickly destroys all of that.

sanskrit_iast:
jaḍo 'pi yāti pūjyatvaṃ satsaṃgājjagatītalaṃ /
kalāmātro 'pi śītāśuḥ śaṃbhunā svīkṛto yathā //
meaning:
जडो ऽपि याति पूज्यत्वं सत्संगाज्जगतीतलं /
कलामात्रो ऽपि शीताशुः शंभुना स्वीकृतो यथा //
text_mt: Even a dull person attains venerability on earth through association with the good, / just as the moon, even consisting of only a single digit, was accepted by Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
satsaṃgatiḥ parāmṛddhiṃ dadāti hi nṛṇāṃ sadā /
ihāmutra ca vignendra santaḥ pūjyatamāstataḥ //
meaning:
सत्संगतिः परामृद्धिं ददाति हि नृणां सदा /
इहामुत्र च विग्नेन्द्र सन्तः पूज्यतमास्ततः //
text_mt: Association with the good always grants supreme prosperity to men / both here and in the hereafter, O lord of obstacles; therefore, the good are the most worthy of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
aho mahagduṇānvaktuṃ kaḥ samartho munīśvarā /
garbhaṃ prātpo garo jīrṇo māsatrayamaho 'dbhutam //
meaning:
अहो महग्दुणान्वक्तुं कः समर्थो मुनीश्वरा /
गर्भं प्रात्पो गरो जीर्णो मासत्रयमहो ऽद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Ah, who is capable of recounting the virtues of the great, O lord of sages? / The poison reached the womb, was digested for three months—ah, wonderful!

sanskrit_iast:
gareṇa sahitaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā tejonidhirmuniḥ /
jātakarma cacakārāsau tannāma sagareti ca //
meaning:
गरेण सहितं पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा तेजोनिधिर्मुनिः /
जातकर्म चचकारासौ तन्नाम सगरेति च //
text_mt: Seeing the son accompanied by the poison (gara), the sage, a treasury of splendor, / performed the birth-rite and gave him the name Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
pupoṣa sagaraṃ bālaṃ tanmātā prītipūrvakam /
caulopavītakarmāṇi tathā cakre munīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
पुपोष सगरं बालं तन्माता प्रीतिपूर्वकम् /
चौलोपवीतकर्माणि तथा चक्रे मुनीश्वरः //
text_mt: His mother nurtured the child Sagara with affection; / likewise, the lord of sages performed the rites of tonsure and investiture with the sacred thread.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrāṇyadhyāpayāmāsa rājayogyāni mantravit /
samarthaṃ sagaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kiñcidudbhinnaśaiśavam //
meaning:
शास्त्राण्यध्यापयामास राजयोग्यानि मन्त्रवित् /
समर्थं सगरं दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिदुद्भिन्नशैशवम् //
text_mt: Knowing the mantras, he instructed him in the treatises suitable for kings; / seeing Sagara capable, with his childhood somewhat passed,

sanskrit_iast:
mantravatsarva śāstrāstraṃ dattavānsa munīśvaraḥ /
sagaraḥ śikṣitastena samyagaurvarṣiṇā mune //
meaning:
मन्त्रवत्सर्व शास्त्रास्त्रं दत्तवान्स मुनीश्वरः /
सगरः शिक्षितस्तेन सम्यगौर्वर्षिणा मुने //
text_mt: that lord of sages gave him all the treatises and weapons along with their mantras; / Sagara was thoroughly trained by him, the sage Aurva, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva balavāndharmi kṛtajño guṇavānsudhīḥ /
dharmajñaḥ so 'pi sagaro muneramitatejasaḥ /
sabhitkuśāṃvupuṣpādi pratyahaṃ samupānayat //
meaning:
बभूव बलवान्धर्मि कृतज्ञो गुणवान्सुधीः /
धर्मज्ञः सो ऽपि सगरो मुनेरमिततेजसः /
सभित्कुशांवुपुष्पादि प्रत्यहं समुपानयत् //
text_mt: He became strong, righteous, grateful, virtuous, wise, / and knower of dharma; and that Sagara brought / firewood, kuśa grass, water, flowers, and the like every day for the sage of boundless splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācidguṇinidhiḥ praṇipatya svamātaram /
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā sagaro vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
स कदाचिद्गुणिनिधिः प्रणिपत्य स्वमातरम् /
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा सगरो विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: Once, Sagara, that treasury of virtues, bowing down to his mother / with folded hands, addressed [her] with humility:

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
mātargataḥ pitā kutra kiṃnāmā kasya vaṃśajaḥ /
tatsarvaṃ mesamācakṣva śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
मातर्गतः पिता कुत्र किंनामा कस्य वंशजः /
तत्सर्वं मेसमाचक्ष्व श्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम //
text_mt: Sagara said: / Mother, where has my father gone? What was his name, and in whose lineage was he born? / Tell all of that to me; my curiosity to hear is great.

sanskrit_iast: pitrā vihīnā ye loke jīvanto 'pi mṛtopamāḥ //
meaning: पित्रा विहीना ये लोके जीवन्तो ऽपि मृतोपमाः //
text_mt: Those who are deprived of a father in the world, though alive, are like the dead.

sanskrit_iast:
darīdro 'pi pitā yasya hyāste sa dhanadopamaḥ /
yasya mātā pitā nāsti sukhaṃ tasya na vidyate //
meaning:
दरीद्रो ऽपि पिता यस्य ह्यास्ते स धनदोपमः /
यस्य माता पिता नास्ति सुखं तस्य न विद्यते //
text_mt: He whose father is [living], even if poor, is like Kubera; / he who has neither mother nor father has no happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmahīno yathā mūrkhaḥ paratreha ca ninditaḥ /
mātāpitṛvihīnasya ajñasyāpyavivekinaḥ /
aputrasya vṛthāṃ janma ṛṇagrastasya caiva hi //
meaning:
धर्महीनो यथा मूर्खः परत्रेह च निन्दितः /
मातापितृविहीनस्य अज्ञस्याप्यविवेकिनः /
अपुत्रस्य वृथां जन्म ऋणग्रस्तस्य चैव हि //
text_mt: Just as a fool bereft of righteousness is reviled in this world and the next, / the birth of one bereft of mother and father, of one ignorant and undiscerning, / of one without a son, and of one overwhelmed by debt is indeed in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
candrahīnā yathā rātriḥ pahmahīnaṃ yathā saraḥ /
patihīnā yathā nārī pitṛhīnastathā śiśuḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रहीना यथा रात्रिः पह्महीनं यथा सरः /
पतिहीना यथा नारी पितृहीनस्तथा शिशुः //
text_mt: Just as a night is without the moon, just as a lake is without lotuses, / just as a woman is without a husband, so is a child without a father.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmahīno yathā jantuḥ karmahīno yathā gṛhī /
paśuhīno yathā vaiśyastayā pitrā vinārbhaktaḥ //
meaning:
धर्महीनो यथा जन्तुः कर्महीनो यथा गृही /
पशुहीनो यथा वैश्यस्तया पित्रा विनार्भक्तः //
text_mt: Just as a living being is bereft of dharma, just as a householder is bereft of duty, / just as a vaiśya is bereft of cattle, so is a child without a father.

sanskrit_iast:
satyahīnaṃ yathā vākyaṃ sādhuhīnā yathā sabhā /
tapo yathā dayāhīnaṃ sathā pitrā vivārbhakaḥ //
meaning:
सत्यहीनं यथा वाक्यं साधुहीना यथा सभा /
तपो यथा दयाहीनं सथा पित्रा विवार्भकः //
text_mt: Just as speech is bereft of truth, just as an assembly is bereft of virtuous men, / just as asceticism is bereft of compassion, so is a child without a father.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣahīnaṃ yathāraṇyaṃ jalahīnā yathā nadī /
bedahīno yathā vājī tathā pitrā vinārbhaktaḥ //
meaning:
वृक्षहीनं यथारण्यं जलहीना यथा नदी /
बेदहीनो यथा वाजी तथा पित्रा विनार्भक्तः //
text_mt: Just as a forest is bereft of trees, just as a river is bereft of water, / just as a horse is bereft of speed, so is a child without a father.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā lagutaro loke mātaryāvñāparo naraḥ /
tathā pitrā vihīnastu bahuduḥkhānvitaḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
यथा लगुतरो लोके मातर्याव्ञापरो नरः /
तथा पित्रा विहीनस्तु बहुदुःखान्वितः सुतः //
text_mt: Just as a man intent on begging is very insignificant in the world, O mother, / so a son deprived of a father is filled with much sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
itītitaṃ sutenaiṣā śrutvā niḥśvāsya duḥkhitā /
saṃpṛṣṭaṃ tadyathāvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat //
meaning:
इतीतितं सुतेनैषा श्रुत्वा निःश्वास्य दुःखिता /
संपृष्टं तद्यथावृत्तं सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: Having heard this uttered by her son, she, sighing in sorrow, / related everything to him as it had happened, as questioned.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchutvā sagaraḥ kruddhaḥ kopasaṃrakta locanaḥ /
haniṣyāmītyarātīnsa pratijñāmakarottadā //
meaning:
तच्छुत्वा सगरः क्रुद्धः कोपसंरक्त लोचनः /
हनिष्यामीत्यरातीन्स प्रतिज्ञामकरोत्तदा //
text_mt: Hearing that, Sagara was enraged, his eyes blood-red with anger, / and he then made a vow: 'I will destroy my enemies!'

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya muniṃ jananīṃ ca praṇamya saḥ /
prasthāpitaḥ pratasthe ca tenaiva muninā vadā //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य मुनिं जननीं च प्रणम्य सः /
प्रस्थापितः प्रतस्थे च तेनैव मुनिना वदा //
text_mt: Having circumambulated the sage and bowed to his mother, / dismissed by that very sage, he then departed.

sanskrit_iast:
aurvāśramādriniṣkrāntaḥ sagaraḥ satyavāk śuciḥ /
vaśiṣṭaṃ svakulācāryaṃ prātpaḥ prītisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
और्वाश्रमाद्रिनिष्क्रान्तः सगरः सत्यवाक् शुचिः /
वशिष्टं स्वकुलाचार्यं प्रात्पः प्रीतिसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Sagara, truthful of speech and pure, set forth from Aurva's hermitage / and reached Vasiṣṭha, his family preceptor, filled with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya gurave tasmai viśiṣṭāya mahātmane /
sarvaṃ vijñāpatrāmāsa jñānadṛṣṭyā vijānate //
meaning:
प्रणम्य गुरवे तस्मै विशिष्टाय महात्मने /
सर्वं विज्ञापत्रामास ज्ञानदृष्ट्या विजानते //
text_mt: Having bowed to that preceptor, the eminent great soul / who knew [all] through the eye of wisdom, he reported everything.

sanskrit_iast:
aindrāstraṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmamāgreyaṃ sagaro nṛpaḥ /
tenaiva munināvāpa khaḍgaṃ vajropamaṃ dhanuḥ //
meaning:
ऐन्द्रास्त्रं वारुणं ब्राह्ममाग्रेयं सगरो नृपः /
तेनैव मुनिनावाप खड्गं वज्रोपमं धनुः //
text_mt: King Sagara received the weapons of Indra, Varuṇa, Brahmā, and Agni / from that very sage, as well as a sword and a bow like a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenābhyanujñātaḥ sagaraḥ saumanasyavān /
āśīrbhirarcitaḥ sadyaḥ pratasthe praṇipatya tam //
meaning:
ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातः सगरः सौमनस्यवान् /
आशीर्भिरर्चितः सद्यः प्रतस्थे प्रणिपत्य तम् //
text_mt: Then, permitted by him, Sagara, joyful of mind / and honored with blessings, bowed to him and departed at once.

sanskrit_iast:
ekenaiva tu cāpena sa śūraḥ paripanthinaḥ /
saputrapautrānsagaṇānakarotsvargāsinaḥ //
meaning:
एकेनैव तु चापेन स शूरः परिपन्थिनः /
सपुत्रपौत्रान्सगणानकरोत्स्वर्गासिनः //
text_mt: With just a single bow, that hero made his adversaries, / along with their sons, grandsons, and retinues, dwellers of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
taccāpamuktabāṇāgnisaṃtatāstadarātavaḥ /
kecidvinaṣṭā saṃtrastāstathā cānye pradudruvuḥ //
meaning:
तच्चापमुक्तबाणाग्निसंततास्तदरातवः /
केचिद्विनष्टा संत्रस्तास्तथा चान्ये प्रदुद्रुवुः //
text_mt: Tormented by the fire of arrows released from his bow, those enemies— / some were destroyed, some were terrified, and others fled away.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidviśīrṇa keśāścavalmīkopari saṃsthitāḥ /
tṛṇānyabhakṣayankecinnagrāśca viviśurjanalam //
meaning:
केचिद्विशीर्ण केशाश्चवल्मीकोपरि संस्थिताः /
तृणान्यभक्षयन्केचिन्नग्राश्च विविशुर्जनलम् //
text_mt: Some with disheveled hair stood on anthills, / some ate grass, and [some], naked, entered water.

sanskrit_iast:
śakāśca yavanāśvevatathā cānye mahībhṛtaḥ /
satvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurvaśiṣṭaṃ prāṇalolupāḥ //
meaning:
शकाश्च यवनाश्वेवतथा चान्ये महीभृतः /
सत्वरं शरणं जग्मुर्वशिष्टं प्राणलोलुपाः //
text_mt: The Śakas, the Yavanas, and other kings, / eager to save their lives, went swiftly for refuge to Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
jitakṣitirbāhuputro ripūngurusamīpagān /
cārairvijñātavānsadyaḥ prātpa ścācāryasannidhim //
meaning:
जितक्षितिर्बाहुपुत्रो रिपून्गुरुसमीपगान् /
चारैर्विज्ञातवान्सद्यः प्रात्प श्चाचार्यसन्निधिम् //
text_mt: Having conquered the earth, the son of Bāhu, informed by spies / that the enemies had approached his guru, immediately arrived in the preceptor's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ bāhusutaṃ niśamya munirvaśiṣṭaḥ śaraṇāgatāṃstān /
trātuṃ ca śiṣyābhihitaṃ ca kartuṃ vivārayāmāsa tadā kṣaṇena //
meaning:
तमागतं बाहुसुतं निशम्य मुनिर्वशिष्टः शरणागतांस्तान् /
त्रातुं च शिष्याभिहितं च कर्तुं विवारयामास तदा क्षणेन //
text_mt: Hearing that Bāhu's son had arrived, the sage Vasiṣṭha, in order to protect / those who had sought refuge and to fulfill what his disciple had stated, restrained him then in a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra muṇḍāñśabarānyavanāṃllambamūrddhajān /
andhāṃśca śmaśrulānsarvānmuṇḍānvedavahiṣkṛtān //
meaning:
चकार मुण्डाञ्शबरान्यवनांल्लम्बमूर्द्धजान् /
अन्धांश्च श्मश्रुलान्सर्वान्मुण्डान्वेदवहिष्कृतान् //
text_mt: He made the Śabaras shaven-headed, the Yavanas with long hair, / the Andhras with beards, and all of them shaven and excluded from the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭamuninā tena hataprāyānnirīkṣya saḥ /
prahasanprāha sagaraḥ svaguruṃ tapaso nidhim //
meaning:
वसिष्टमुनिना तेन हतप्रायान्निरीक्ष्य सः /
प्रहसन्प्राह सगरः स्वगुरुं तपसो निधिम् //
text_mt:
Beholding those who were nearly slain by that sage Vasiṣṭha,
Sagara, laughing, said to his guru, that treasure of austerity:

Sagara said:
O teacher, O teacher, in vain do you protect these evildoers!
By all means I shall slay these robbers of my father's realm.

sanskrit_iast:
upekṣeta samarthaḥ sandharmasya paripanthinaḥ /
sa eva sarvanāśāya hetubhūto na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
उपेक्षेत समर्थः सन्धर्मस्य परिपन्थिनः /
स एव सर्वनाशाय हेतुभूतो न संशयः //
text_mt:
If a capable person neglects opponents of dharma,
he himself becomes the cause of total destruction, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bāndhavaṃ prathamaṃ matvā durjatāḥ sakalaṃ jagat /
ta eva balahīnāścedbhajante 'tyantasādhutām //
meaning:
बान्धवं प्रथमं मत्वा दुर्जताः सकलं जगत् /
त एव बलहीनाश्चेद्भजन्ते ऽत्यन्तसाधुताम् //
text_mt:
Deeming all the world their kin at first, the wicked,
if they become devoid of power, resort to utter piety.

sanskrit_iast:
aho māyākṛtaṃ karma khalāḥ kaśmalacetasaḥ /
tāvatkurvanti kāryāṇi yāvatsyātprabalaṃ balam //
meaning:
अहो मायाकृतं कर्म खलाः कश्मलचेतसः /
तावत्कुर्वन्ति कार्याणि यावत्स्यात्प्रबलं बलम् //
text_mt:
Ah, how deceitful is the conduct of villains with filthy minds!
They carry out their deeds only as long as their power remains mighty.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsabhāvaṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ vārastrīṇāṃ ca sauhṛdam /
sādhubhāvaṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śreyaskāmo na viśvaset //
meaning:
दासभावं च शत्रूणां वारस्त्रीणां च सौहृदम् /
साधुभावं च सर्पाणां श्रेयस्कामो न विश्वसेत् //
text_mt:
One who desires welfare should not trust the servitude of enemies,
nor the affection of courtesans, nor the benign nature of serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
prahāsaṃ kurvate nityaṃ yāndantāndarśayankhalāḥ /
tāneva darśayantyāśu svasāmarthya viparyaye //
meaning:
प्रहासं कुर्वते नित्यं यान्दन्तान्दर्शयन्खलाः /
तानेव दर्शयन्त्याशु स्वसामर्थ्य विपर्यये //
text_mt:
Those very teeth which villains display when always mocking others,
they instantly show [in surrender] when their own power is overthrown.

sanskrit_iast:
piśunā jihvayā pūrvaṃ paruṣaṃ pravadanti ca /
atīva karuṇaṃ vākyaṃ vadantyeva tathābalāḥ //
meaning:
पिशुना जिह्वया पूर्वं परुषं प्रवदन्ति च /
अतीव करुणं वाक्यं वदन्त्येव तथाबलाः //
text_mt:
First they speak harshly with a malicious tongue;
then, powerless, they utter words of utter misery.

sanskrit_iast:
śreyaskāmo bhavedyastu nītiśāstrārthakovidaḥ /
sādhutvaṃ samabhāvaṃ ca khalānāṃ naiva viśvaset //
meaning:
श्रेयस्कामो भवेद्यस्तु नीतिशास्त्रार्थकोविदः /
साधुत्वं समभावं च खलानां नैव विश्वसेत् //
text_mt:
Whoever desires welfare and is skilled in the meaning of political treatises
should never trust the piety and impartial attitude of villains.

sanskrit_iast:
durjanaṃ praṇatiṃ yānte mitraṃ kaitavaśīlitam /
duṣṭāṃ bhāryāṃ ca viśvasto mṛta eva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्जनं प्रणतिं यान्ते मित्रं कैतवशीलितम् /
दुष्टां भार्यां च विश्वस्तो मृत एव न संशयः //
text_mt:
One who trusts a wicked person bowing down, a friend accustomed to deceit,
and an unchaste wife, is as good as dead, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mā rakṣa tasmādetānvai gorupavyāghrakarmiṇaḥ /
hatvaitānakhilān duṣṭāṃstvatprasādānmahīṃ bhaje //
meaning:
मा रक्ष तस्मादेतान्वै गोरुपव्याघ्रकर्मिणः /
हत्वैतानखिलान् दुष्टांस्त्वत्प्रसादान्महीं भजे //
text_mt:
Therefore, do not protect these who have the form of cows but act like tigers!
Having slain all these villains, by your grace I shall enjoy the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭastadvacaḥ śrutvā suprīto munisattamaḥ /
karābhyāṃ sagasyayāṅgaṃ spṛśannidamuvāca ha //
meaning:
वशिष्टस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा सुप्रीतो मुनिसत्तमः /
कराभ्यां सगस्ययाङ्गं स्पृशन्निदमुवाच ह //
text_mt:
Hearing his words, Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages, was very pleased,
and touching Sagara's body with both hands, he spoke as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭa uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga satyaṃ vadasi suvrata /
tathāpi madvacaṛ śrutvā parāṃ śāntiṃ labhiṣyasi //
meaning:
वसिष्ट उवाच
साधु साधु महाभाग सत्यं वदसि सुव्रत /
तथापि मद्वचऋ श्रुत्वा परां शान्तिं लभिष्यसि //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Well said, well said, fortunate one! You speak the truth, O you of noble vows!
Even so, having heard my words, you shall attain supreme peace.

sanskrit_iast:
mayaite nihitāḥ pūrvaṃ tvatpratijñāvirodhinaḥ /
hātānāṃ hanave kīrtiḥ kā samutpadyate vada //
meaning:
मयैते निहिताः पूर्वं त्वत्प्रतिज्ञाविरोधिनः /
हातानां हनवे कीर्तिः का समुत्पद्यते वद //
text_mt:
They who opposed your vow were already slain by me before.
What fame arises from slaying those already slain? Speak!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmīśa jantavaḥ sarve karmapāśena yantritāḥ /
tathāpi pāpairnihatāḥ kimarthaṃ haṃsi tānpunaḥ //
meaning:
भूमीश जन्तवः सर्वे कर्मपाशेन यन्त्रिताः /
तथापि पापैर्निहताः किमर्थं हंसि तान्पुनः //
text_mt:
O lord of the earth, all living beings are bound by the snare of their own karma;
nevertheless, they have already been struck down by sins. Why would you kill them again?

sanskrit_iast:
dehastu pāpajanitaḥ pūrvapamevainasā hataḥ /
ātmā hyabhedyaḥ pūrṇatvācchāstrāṇāmeṣa niścayaḥ //
meaning:
देहस्तु पापजनितः पूर्वपमेवैनसा हतः /
आत्मा ह्यभेद्यः पूर्णत्वाच्छास्त्राणामेष निश्चयः //
text_mt:
The body is born of sin and is already struck down by former fault;
for the self is indivisible due to its fullness—such is the conclusion of the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaphalabhogānāṃ hetumātrā hi jantavaḥ /
karmāṇi daivamūlāni devādhīnamidaṃ jagat //
meaning:
स्वकर्मफलभोगानां हेतुमात्रा हि जन्तवः /
कर्माणि दैवमूलानि देवाधीनमिदं जगत् //
text_mt:
Creatures are merely instrumental in the experience of the fruits of their own actions;
actions are rooted in destiny, and this world is subordinate to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā hyabhedyaḥ rakṣitā duṣṭaśikṣitā /
tato narairasvatantraiḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ sādhyate vada //
meaning:
आत्मा ह्यभेद्यः रक्षिता दुष्टशिक्षिता /
ततो नरैरस्वतन्त्रैः किं कार्यं साध्यते वद //
text_mt:
The self is indivisible, [the lord is] the protector and the punisher of the wicked;
therefore, what duty is accomplished by men who lack free will? Speak!

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ pāpasaṃbhūtaṃ pāpenaiva pravartate /
pāpamūlamidaṃ jñātvā kathaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ //
meaning:
शरीरं पापसंभूतं पापेनैव प्रवर्तते /
पापमूलमिदं ज्ञात्वा कथं हन्तुं समुद्यतः //
text_mt:
The body is born from sin and proceeds only through sin;
knowing this [body] to be rooted in sin, why are you eager to kill it?

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā śuddho 'pi dehastho dehīti procyate budhaiḥ /
tasmādidaṃ vapurbhūpa pāpamūlaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मा शुद्धो ऽपि देहस्थो देहीति प्रोच्यते बुधैः /
तस्मादिदं वपुर्भूप पापमूलं न संशयः //
text_mt:
Though pure, the self abiding in the body is called 'embodied' by the wise;
therefore, O king, this body is rooted in sin, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpamūlavapurhantuḥ kā kīrtistava bāhuja /
bhaviṣyatīti niścitya naitānhiṃsīstataḥ suta //
meaning:
पापमूलवपुर्हन्तुः का कीर्तिस्तव बाहुज /
भविष्यतीति निश्चित्य नैतान्हिंसीस्ततः सुत //
text_mt:
What fame will there be for you, O kṣatriya, by slaying a body rooted in sin?
Reflecting thus, do not harm them, O son.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ virarāma sa kopataḥ /
spṛśankareṇa sagaraṃ nandanaṃ munayastadā //
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं विरराम स कोपतः /
स्पृशन्करेण सगरं नन्दनं मुनयस्तदा //
text_mt:
Hearing this speech of his guru, he ceased from his anger.
Then the sages touched Sagara, the son [of Bāhu], with their hands.

sanskrit_iast:
athātharvanidhistasya sagarasya mahātmanaḥ /
rājyābhiṣekaṃ kṛtavānmunibhiḥ saha suvrataiḥ //
meaning:
अथाथर्वनिधिस्तस्य सगरस्य महात्मनः /
राज्याभिषेकं कृतवान्मुनिभिः सह सुव्रतैः //
text_mt:
Then that treasury of the Atharva[veda], together with the sages of noble vows,
performed the royal consecration of that high-souled Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryādvayaṃ ca tasyāsītkeśinī sumati stathā /
kāśyapasya vidarbhasya tanaye munasattama //
meaning:
भार्याद्वयं च तस्यासीत्केशिनी सुमति स्तथा /
काश्यपस्य विदर्भस्य तनये मुनसत्तम //
text_mt:
He had two wives, Keśinī and Sumati,
daughters of Vidarbha and Kāśyapa, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
rājye pratiṣṭite dṛṣṭvā muniraurvastaponidhiḥ /
vanādāgatya rājānaṃ saṃbhāṣya svāśramaṃ yayau //
meaning:
राज्ये प्रतिष्टिते दृष्ट्वा मुनिरौर्वस्तपोनिधिः /
वनादागत्य राजानं संभाष्य स्वाश्रमं ययौ //
text_mt:
Seeing him established in the kingdom, the sage Aurva, a storehouse of asceticism,
came from the forest, conversed with the king, and returned to his hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācittasya bhūpasya bhāryābhyāṃ prārthitomuniḥ /
varaṃ dadāvapatyārthamaurvo bhārgavamantravit //
meaning:
कदाचित्तस्य भूपस्य भार्याभ्यां प्रार्थितोमुनिः /
वरं ददावपत्यार्थमौर्वो भार्गवमन्त्रवित् //
text_mt:
Once, requested by the two wives of that king for offspring,
the sage Aurva, knower of Bhārgava mantras, granted a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ dhyānasthito bhūtvā trikālajño munīśvaraḥ /
keśitīṃ sumatiṃ caiva idamāha praharṣayam //
meaning:
क्षणं ध्यानस्थितो भूत्वा त्रिकालज्ञो मुनीश्वरः /
केशितीं सुमतिं चैव इदमाह प्रहर्षयम् //
text_mt:
Having entered into meditation for a moment, that lord of sages, knower of the three times,
spoke this to Keśinī and Sumati, causing great joy:

sanskrit_iast:
aurva uvāca
ekā vaṃśadharaṃ caikamanyā ṣaḍyutāni ca /
apatyārthaṃ mahābhāge vṛṇutāṃ ca yathepsitam //
meaning:
और्व उवाच
एका वंशधरं चैकमन्या षड्युतानि च /
अपत्यार्थं महाभागे वृणुतां च यथेप्सितम् //

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrutvā vacastasya muneraurvasya nārada /
keśinyekaṃ sutaṃ vavre vaṃśasantānakāraṇam //
meaning:
अथ श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मुनेरौर्वस्य नारद /
केशिन्येकं सुतं वव्रे वंशसन्तानकारणम् //
text_mt:
Then, hearing that statement of the sage Aurva, O Nārada,
Keśinī chose one son, the cause of the continuation of the lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi sumatyā hyabhavansutāḥ /
nāmnāsamañjāḥ keśinyāstanayo munisattama //
meaning:
षष्टिसहस्राणि सुमत्या ह्यभवन्सुताः /
नाम्नासमञ्जाः केशिन्यास्तनयो मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt:
Sixty thousand sons were born to Sumati;
the son of Keśinī was named Asamañja, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
asamañjāstu karmāṇi cakāronmattaceṣṭitaḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sāgarāḥ sarve hyāsandurvṛttacetasaḥ //
meaning:
असमञ्जास्तु कर्माणि चकारोन्मत्तचेष्टितः /
तं दृष्ट्वा सागराः सर्वे ह्यासन्दुर्वृत्तचेतसः //
text_mt:
Asamañja, however, acted like a madman in his deeds;
seeing him, all the sons of Sagara became evil-minded in nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvālabhāvaṃ saṃduṣṭaṃ jñātvā bāhusuto nṛpaḥ /
cintayāmāsa vidhivatputrakarma vigarhinam //
meaning:
तद्वालभावं संदुष्टं ज्ञात्वा बाहुसुतो नृपः /
चिन्तयामास विधिवत्पुत्रकर्म विगर्हिनम् //
text_mt:
Knowing his child's nature to be deeply corrupt, the king, the son of Bāhu,
pondered duly over the reprehensible deeds of his son:

sanskrit_iast:
aho kaṣṭatarā loke durjanānāṃ hi saṃgatiḥ /
kārukaistāḍyate vahṇirayaḥsaṃyogamātrataḥ //
meaning:
अहो कष्टतरा लोके दुर्जनानां हि संगतिः /
कारुकैस्ताड्यते वह्णिरयःसंयोगमात्रतः //
text_mt:
‘Ah, association with wicked persons is indeed most painful in this world!
Fire is struck by blacksmiths merely on account of its contact with iron.’

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumānnāma tanayo babhūva hyasamañjasaḥ /
śāstrajño guṇavāndharmī pitāmahahite rataḥ //
meaning:
अंशुमान्नाम तनयो बभूव ह्यसमञ्जसः /
शास्त्रज्ञो गुणवान्धर्मी पितामहहिते रतः //
text_mt:
Asamañja had a son named Aṃśumat,
a knower of scriptures, virtuous, righteous, devoted to his grandfather's welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
durvṛttāḥ sāgarāḥ sarve lokopadrava kāriṇaḥ /
anuṣṭānavatāṃ nityamantarāyā bhavanti te //
meaning:
दुर्वृत्ताः सागराः सर्वे लोकोपद्रव कारिणः /
अनुष्टानवतां नित्यमन्तराया भवन्ति ते //
text_mt:
All the sons of Sagara were evil-behaved, causers of affliction to the world;
they constantly became obstacles to those engaged in religious observances.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāni yāni yajñeṣu havīṃṣi vidhitraddijaiḥ /
bubhuje tāni sarvāṇi nirākṛtya divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
हुतानि यानि यज्ञेषु हवींषि विधित्रद्दिजैः /
बुभुजे तानि सर्वाणि निराकृत्य दिवौकसः //
text_mt:
Whatever oblations were offered in sacrifices according to rule by the twice-born,
they consumed them all, setting aside the dwellers of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
svargādāhṛtya savataṃ rambhādyā devayoṣitaḥ /
bhajanti sāgarāstā vai kacagrahabalātkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्गादाहृत्य सवतं रम्भाद्या देवयोषितः /
भजन्ति सागरास्ता वै कचग्रहबलात्कृताः //
text_mt:
Forcibly abducting celestial women such as Rambhā from heaven,
the sons of Sagara enjoyed them, seizing them by the hair.

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātādivṛkṣāṇāṃ puṣpāṇyāhṛtya te khalāḥ /
bhūṣayanti svadehāni madyapānaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
पारिजातादिवृक्षाणां पुष्पाण्याहृत्य ते खलाः /
भूषयन्ति स्वदेहानि मद्यपानपरायणाः //
text_mt:
Bringing flowers from trees such as the Pārijāta, those villains,
devoted to drinking liquor, decorated their own bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhuvṛttīḥ samājahnuḥ sadācārānanāśayan /
mitraiśca yodrumārabdhā balino 'tyantapāpinaḥ //
meaning:
साधुवृत्तीः समाजह्नुः सदाचाराननाशयन् /
मित्रैश्च योद्रुमारब्धा बलिनो ऽत्यन्तपापिनः //
text_mt:
They destroyed virtuous livelihoods and ruined right conduct;
those powerful, extremely sinful beings began to fight even with friends.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddṛṣṭvātiduḥkhārtā devā indrapurogamāḥ /
vicāraṃ paramaṃ cakrureteṣuṃ nāśahetave //
meaning:
एतद्दृष्ट्वातिदुःखार्ता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः /
विचारं परमं चक्रुरेतेषुं नाशहेतवे //
text_mt:
Seeing this, the gods led by Indra, tormented with excessive grief,
deliberated deeply for the sake of their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
niścitya vivudhāḥ sarve pātālāntaragocaram /
kapilaṃ devadeveśaṃ yayuḥ pracchannarupiṇaḥ //
meaning:
निश्चित्य विवुधाः सर्वे पातालान्तरगोचरम् /
कपिलं देवदेवेशं ययुः प्रच्छन्नरुपिणः //
text_mt:
Having made their resolve, all the gods went in disguised forms
to Kapila, the lord of the god of gods, who dwelt in the underworld.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyantamātmanātmānaṃ parānaidaikavigraham /
prāṇamya daṇḍavadrūmau tuṣṭuvuvridaśāstataḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायन्तमात्मनात्मानं परानैदैकविग्रहम् /
प्राणम्य दण्डवद्रूमौ तुष्टुवुव्रिदशास्ततः //
text_mt:
To him who was meditating on the self by the self, whose form is supreme bliss alone,
the gods bowed like a rod on the ground and then praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
namaste yogine tubhyāṃ sāṅkhyayogaratāya ca /
nararupapraticchinnaviṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नमस्ते योगिने तुभ्यां साङ्ख्ययोगरताय च /
नररुपप्रतिच्छिन्नविष्णवे जिष्णवे नमः //
text_mt:
The gods said:
Salutations to you, the yogin, and to you who are devoted to Sāṅkhya-yoga!
Salutations to Viṣṇu, the victorious one, concealed in human form!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ pareśabhaktāya lokānugrahahetave /
saṃsārāraṇyadāvāgre dharmapālanasetave //
meaning:
नमः परेशभक्ताय लोकानुग्रहहेतवे /
संसारारण्यदावाग्रे धर्मपालनसेतवे //
text_mt:
Salutations to the devotee of the Supreme Lord, the cause of grace to the worlds,
the forest fire to the wilderness of saṃsāra, the bridge for protecting dharma!

sanskrit_iast:
mahate vītarāgāya tubhyaṃ bhūyo namo namaḥ /
sāgaraiḥ pīḍitānasmāṃstrāyasva śaraṇāgatān //
meaning:
महते वीतरागाय तुभ्यं भूयो नमो नमः /
सागरैः पीडितानस्मांस्त्रायस्व शरणागतान् //
text_mt:
To the great one, free from passion, salutations again and again to you!
Protect us who have approached for refuge, afflicted by the sons of Sagara!

sanskrit_iast:
kapila uvāca
ye tu nāśamihecchanti yaśobaladhanāyuṣām /
ta eva lokānbādhante nātrāśvāryaṃ sugetamāḥ //
meaning:
कपिल उवाच
ये तु नाशमिहेच्छन्ति यशोबलधनायुषाम् /
त एव लोकान्बाधन्ते नात्राश्वार्यं सुगेतमाः //
text_mt:
Kapila said:
Those who desire in this world the destruction of [others'] fame, power, wealth, and life,
they alone torment the worlds; there is no wonder in this, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu bādhitumiccheta janānniraparādhinaḥ /
taṃ vidyātsarvalokeṣu pāpabhogarataṃ surāḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु बाधितुमिच्छेत जनान्निरपराधिनः /
तं विद्यात्सर्वलोकेषु पापभोगरतं सुराः //
text_mt:
He who wishes to oppress innocent people,
know him, O gods, among all worlds to be devoted to enjoying sin.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā yastvanyānbādhate sadā /
taṃ hanti daivamevāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यस्त्वन्यान्बाधते सदा /
तं हन्ति दैवमेवाशु नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
He who always oppresses others in deed, thought, or word,
destiny itself slays him swiftly; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
alpairahobhire vaite nāśameṣyanti sāgarāḥ /
ityuktaṃ muninā tena kapilena mahātmanā /
praṇamya taṃ yathānyāyaṃ gatā nākaṃ divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
अल्पैरहोभिरे वैते नाशमेष्यन्ति सागराः /
इत्युक्तं मुनिना तेन कपिलेन महात्मना /
प्रणम्य तं यथान्यायं गता नाकं दिवौकसः //
text_mt:
"In just a few days, these sons of Sagara will meet their destruction."
Having been addressed thus by that great-souled sage Kapila,
the denizens of heaven, bowing respectfully according to rule, went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāntare tu sagarovasiṣṭādyairmaharṣibhiḥ /
ārebhe hayamedhākhyaṃ yajñaṃ karttumanuttamam //
meaning:
अत्रान्तरे तु सगरोवसिष्टाद्यैर्महर्षिभिः /
आरेभे हयमेधाख्यं यज्ञं कर्त्तुमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Sagara, together with great ṛṣis headed by Vasiṣṭha,
undertook to perform the unsurpassed sacrifice known as the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tadyajñe yojitaṃ satpimapahṛtya sureśvaraḥ /
pātāle sthāpayāmāsa kapilo yatra tiṣṭati //
meaning:
तद्यज्ञे योजितं सत्पिमपहृत्य सुरेश्वरः /
पाताले स्थापयामास कपिलो यत्र तिष्टति //
text_mt:
Stealing the sacrificial horse employed in that sacrifice, the lord of the gods
placed it in the underworld where Kapila was staying.

sanskrit_iast:
gūḍhavigrahaśakreṇa hṛtamaśvaṃ tu sāgarāḥ /
anveṣṭuṃ babhrabhurlokān bhūrādīṃśca suvismitāḥ //
meaning:
गूढविग्रहशक्रेण हृतमश्वं तु सागराः /
अन्वेष्टुं बभ्रभुर्लोकान् भूरादींश्च सुविस्मिताः //
text_mt:
When the horse was carried off by Śakra disguised in form, the sons of Sagara,
greatly astonished, wandered through the worlds, beginning with the earth, to search for it.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṣṭasatpayaste ca pātālaṃ gantu mudyatāḥ /
cakhnurmahītalaṃ sarvamekaiko yojanaṃ pṛthak //
meaning:
अहष्टसत्पयस्ते च पातालं गन्तु मुद्यताः /
चख्नुर्महीतलं सर्वमेकैको योजनं पृथक् //
text_mt:
Not seeing the sacrificial horse, and preparing to go to the underworld,
each one separately dug out a yojana of the earth's surface.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛttikāṃ khanitāṃ te caudadhitīre samākiran /
tadvāreṇa gatāḥ sarve pātālaṃ sagarātmajāḥ //
meaning:
मृत्तिकां खनितां ते चौदधितीरे समाकिरन् /
तद्वारेण गताः सर्वे पातालं सगरात्मजाः //
text_mt:
They scattered the dug-up earth on the seashore;
through that opening, all the sons of Sagara entered the underworld.

sanskrit_iast: vicinvanti hayaṃ tatra madonmattā vicetasaḥ //
meaning: विचिन्वन्ति हयं तत्र मदोन्मत्ता विचेतसः //
text_mt: Maddened with arrogance and senseless, they searched for the horse there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyanmahātmānaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham /
kapilaṃ dhyānanirataṃ vājinaṃ ca tadantike //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यन्महात्मानं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् /
कपिलं ध्याननिरतं वाजिनं च तदन्तिके //
text_mt:
There they saw the great-souled Kapila, radiant as ten million suns,
absorbed in meditation, and near him, the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarve tu saṃrabdhā muniṃ dṛṣṭvātivegataḥ /
hantumudyuktamanaso vidravantaḥ samāsadan //
meaning:
ततः सर्वे तु संरब्धा मुनिं दृष्ट्वातिवेगतः /
हन्तुमुद्युक्तमनसो विद्रवन्तः समासदन् //
text_mt:
Then, seeing the sage, they all became enraged, and with great fury,
their minds bent on killing him, they rushed forward and attacked him.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyatāṃ hanyatāmeṣa vadhyatāṃ vadhyatāmayam /
guhyatāṃ gṛhyatāmāśu ityūcuste parasparam //
meaning:
हन्यतां हन्यतामेष वध्यतां वध्यतामयम् /
गुह्यतां गृह्यतामाशु इत्यूचुस्ते परस्परम् //
text_mt:
"Let him be struck! Let him be struck! Let him be slain! Let him be slain!
Seize him! Seize him at once!" they said to one another.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtāśvaṃ sādhubhāvena bakavaddhyānatatparam /
santi cāro khalā loke kurvantyāḍambaraṃ mahat //
meaning:
हृताश्वं साधुभावेन बकवद्ध्यानतत्परम् /
सन्ति चारो खला लोके कुर्वन्त्याडम्बरं महत् //
text_mt:
"Having stolen the horse, he poses like a virtuous man, intent on meditation like a heron!
Wicked men in this world are indeed deceivers who make a great show!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccaranto jahasuḥ kapilaṃ te munīśvaram /
samastendriyasaṃdohaṃ niyamyātmānamātmani //
meaning:
इत्युच्चरन्तो जहसुः कपिलं ते मुनीश्वरम् /
समस्तेन्द्रियसंदोहं नियम्यात्मानमात्मनि //
text_mt:
Uttering this, they laughed at Kapila, the lord of sages.
Restraining the entire mass of his senses, his self [settled] in the Self,

sanskrit_iast: āsthitaḥ kapilasteṣāṃ tatkarma jñātavānnahi //
meaning: आस्थितः कपिलस्तेषां तत्कर्म ज्ञातवान्नहि //
text_mt: Kapila remained steadfast and did not at all notice that action of theirs.

sanskrit_iast:
āsannamṛtyavaste tu vinaṣṭamatayo munim /
padbhiḥ saṃtāḍayāmāsurbuhūṃ ca jagṛhuḥ pare //
meaning:
आसन्नमृत्यवस्ते तु विनष्टमतयो मुनिम् /
पद्भिः संताडयामासुर्बुहूं च जगृहुः परे //
text_mt:
Those whose deaths were near, their intellects ruined, struck the sage
with their feet, while others seized his arms.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastyaktasamādhistu sa munirvismitastadā /
uvāca bhāvagambhīraṃ lokopadravakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्त्यक्तसमाधिस्तु स मुनिर्विस्मितस्तदा /
उवाच भावगम्भीरं लोकोपद्रवकारिणः //
text_mt:
Then, leaving his samādhi, that sage, astonished at that time,
spoke with deep emotion to those who caused distress to the world:

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryamadamattānāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ ca kāminām /
ahṝṅkāravimūḍhānāṃ viveko naiva jāyate //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तानां क्षुधितानां च कामिनाम् /
अहॄङ्कारविमूढानां विवेको नैव जायते //
text_mt:
"For those intoxicated with the pride of power, for the hungry, for the lustful,
and for those deluded by egotism, discernment never arises.

sanskrit_iast:
nidherādhāramātreṇa mahī jvalati sarvadā /
tadeva mānavā bhuktvā jvalantīti kimadbhutam //
meaning:
निधेराधारमात्रेण मही ज्वलति सर्वदा /
तदेव मानवा भुक्त्वा ज्वलन्तीति किमद्भुतम् //
text_mt:
Merely through the presence of a buried treasure, the earth always burns;
having enjoyed that very thing, is it any wonder that human beings burn?

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra citraṃ sujanaṃ bādhante yadi durjanāḥ /
mahīruhāṃ ścānutaṭe pātayanti nadīrayāḥ //
meaning:
किमत्र चित्रं सुजनं बाधन्ते यदि दुर्जनाः /
महीरुहां श्चानुतटे पातयन्ति नदीरयाः //
text_mt:
What wonder is there if wicked people torment a virtuous man?
The currents of rivers overturn trees standing along their banks.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra śrīryauṃvanaṃ vāpi śāradā vāpi tiṣṭati /
tatrāśrīrvṛddhatā nityaṃ murkhatvaṃ cāpi jāyate //
meaning:
यत्र श्रीर्यौंवनं वापि शारदा वापि तिष्टति /
तत्राश्रीर्वृद्धता नित्यं मुर्खत्वं चापि जायते //
text_mt:
Where wealth, youth, or Sarasvatī abides,
there misfortune, old age, and foolishness also continually arise.

sanskrit_iast:
aho kanakamāhātmyamākhyātuṃ kena śakyate /
nāmasāmyādaho citraṃ dhattūro 'pimadapradaḥ //
meaning:
अहो कनकमाहात्म्यमाख्यातुं केन शक्यते /
नामसाम्यादहो चित्रं धत्तूरो ऽपिमदप्रदः //
text_mt:
Ah, who is able to describe the greatness of gold?
How strange that even the thorn-apple causes intoxication merely through identity of name!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedyadi khalasya śrīḥ saiva lokavināśinī /
yathā sakhāgneḥ pavanaḥ pannagasya yathā viṣam //
meaning:
भवेद्यदि खलस्य श्रीः सैव लोकविनाशिनी /
यथा सखाग्नेः पवनः पन्नगस्य यथा विषम् //
text_mt:
If a wicked man obtains wealth, it only ruins the world,
just as wind is to fire's friend, or poison is to a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
aho dhanamadāndastu paśyannapi na paśyati /
yadi paśyatyāmahitaṃ sa paśyati na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अहो धनमदान्दस्तु पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति /
यदि पश्यत्यामहितं स पश्यति न संशयः //
text_mt:
Ah, blinded by the pride of wealth, a man does not see even while looking;
if he does see, he sees harm to himself, without a doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā kapilaḥ kruddho netrābhyāṃ sasṛje 'nalam /
sa vahniḥ sāgarānsarvānbhasmasādakarotkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा कपिलः क्रुद्धो नेत्राभ्यां ससृजे ऽनलम् /
स वह्निः सागरान्सर्वान्भस्मसादकरोत्क्षणात् //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, Kapila became enraged and emitted fire from his eyes;
that fire reduced all the sons of Sagara to ashes in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
yannetrajānalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pātālatalavāsinaḥ /
akālapralayaṃ matvā cukruśuḥ śokalālasāḥ //
meaning:
यन्नेत्रजानलं दृष्ट्वा पातालतलवासिनः /
अकालप्रलयं मत्वा चुक्रुशुः शोकलालसाः //
text_mt:
Seeing the fire born from his eyes, the dwellers of the underworld,
thinking it to be an untimely cosmic dissolution, cried out, overcome with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
tadagnitāpitāḥ sarve dandaśūkāśca rākṣasāḥ /
sāgaraṃ viviśuḥ śīghraṃ satāṃ kopo hi duḥsahaḥ //
meaning:
तदग्नितापिताः सर्वे दन्दशूकाश्च राक्षसाः /
सागरं विविशुः शीघ्रं सतां कोपो हि दुःसहः //
text_mt:
Tormented by that fire, all the serpents and rākṣasas
quickly entered the ocean, for the anger of the virtuous is unbearable.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tasya mahīpasya samāgamyādhvaraṃ tadā /
devadūta uvācedaṃ sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ hi yakṣate //
meaning:
अथ तस्य महीपस्य समागम्याध्वरं तदा /
देवदूत उवाचेदं सर्वं वृत्तं हि यक्षते //
text_mt:
Then, approaching that king's sacrifice,
a messenger of the gods told everything that had happened to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsamākarṇya vacaḥ sagaraḥ sarvavitprabhuḥ /
daivena śikṣitā duṣṭā ityuvācāti harṣitaḥ //
meaning:
एतत्समाकर्ण्य वचः सगरः सर्ववित्प्रभुः /
दैवेन शिक्षिता दुष्टा इत्युवाचाति हर्षितः //
text_mt:
Hearing this report, King Sagara, who was omniscient,
became overjoyed and said: "The wicked have been chastised by destiny!

sanskrit_iast:
mātā vā janako vāpi bhrātā vā tanayo 'pi vā /
adharmaṃ kurute yastu sa eva ripuriṣyate //
meaning:
माता वा जनको वापि भ्राता वा तनयो ऽपि वा /
अधर्मं कुरुते यस्तु स एव रिपुरिष्यते //
text_mt:
Whether mother or father, brother or son,
he who commits unrighteousness is considered an enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvadharmeṣu nirataḥ sarvalokavirodhakṛt /
taṃ ripuṃ paramaṃ vidyācchāstrāṇāmeṣa nirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
यस्त्वधर्मेषु निरतः सर्वलोकविरोधकृत् /
तं रिपुं परमं विद्याच्छास्त्राणामेष निर्णयः //
text_mt:
He who is devoted to unrighteousness and causes opposition to all the world—
one should know him as the ultimate enemy; this is the verdict of the scriptures."

sanskrit_iast:
sagaraḥ putranāśe 'pi na śuśoca munīśvaraḥ /
durvṛttanidhanaṃ yasmātsatāmutsāha kāraṇam //
meaning:
सगरः पुत्रनाशे ऽपि न शुशोच मुनीश्वरः /
दुर्वृत्तनिधनं यस्मात्सतामुत्साह कारणम् //
text_mt:
Even at the death of his sons, Sagara, that foremost of sages, did not grieve,
for the death of the wicked is a cause of joy for the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeṣvanadhikāratvādaputrāṇāmiti smṛteḥ /
pautraṃ tamaṃśumantaṃ hi putratve katavānprabhuḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञेष्वनधिकारत्वादपुत्राणामिति स्मृतेः /
पौत्रं तमंशुमन्तं हि पुत्रत्वे कतवान्प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Because of the traditional rule that childless men have no eligibility for sacrifices,
the king indeed accepted his grandson Aṃśumat as his son.

sanskrit_iast:
asamañjaḥsutaṃ tu sudhīyaṃ vāgvidāṃvaram /
yuyoja sāravidbhūyo hyaścānayanakarmaṇi //
meaning:
असमञ्जःसुतं तु सुधीयं वाग्विदांवरम् /
युयोज सारविद्भूयो ह्यश्चानयनकर्मणि //
text_mt:
The discerning king appointed the intelligent son of Asamañjas,
the foremost of the eloquent, to the task of bringing back the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatastadviladvāre dṛṣṭvā taṃ munipuṅgavam /
kapilaṃ tejasāṃrāśiṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃpraṇanāmahā //
meaning:
स गतस्तद्विलद्वारे दृष्ट्वा तं मुनिपुङ्गवम् /
कपिलं तेजसांराशिं साष्टाङ्गंप्रणनामहा //
text_mt:
Having gone to the entrance of that cavern and seen that foremost of sages,
Kapila, an embodiment of radiance, he bowed down with eight limbs prostrated.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vinaye nāgrataḥ sthitaḥ /
uvāca śāntamanasaṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा विनये नाग्रतः स्थितः /
उवाच शान्तमनसं देवदेवं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
Folding his hands in reverence, he stood before him with humility
and spoke to the calm-minded, eternal god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumānuvāca
dauḥśīlyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ brahmanmatpitṛvyaiḥ kṣamasvatat /
paropakāraniratāḥ kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ //
meaning:
अंशुमानुवाच
दौःशील्यं यत्कृतं ब्रह्मन्मत्पितृव्यैः क्षमस्वतत् /
परोपकारनिरताः क्षमासारा हि साधवः //

sanskrit_iast:
durjaneṣvapi sattveṣu dayāṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ /
nahi saṃharatejyotsnāṃ candraścāṇḍālaveśmanaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्जनेष्वपि सत्त्वेषु दयां कुर्वन्ति साधवः /
नहि संहरतेज्योत्स्नां चन्द्रश्चाण्डालवेश्मनः //
text_mt:
The virtuous show compassion even to wicked beings;
the moon does not withhold its moonlight from the house of an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
bādhyamāno 'pi sujanaḥ sarveṣāṃ sukhakṛdbhavet /
dadāti paramāṃ tuṣṭiṃ bhakṣyamāṇo 'maraiḥ śaśī //
meaning:
बाध्यमानो ऽपि सुजनः सर्वेषां सुखकृद्भवेत् /
ददाति परमां तुष्टिं भक्ष्यमाणो ऽमरैः शशी //
text_mt:
Even when tormented, a virtuous person brings happiness to all;
being consumed by the immortals, the moon gives supreme satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
dāritaśchinna evāpi hyāmodenaiva candanaḥ /
saurabhaṃ kurute sarvaṃ tathaiva sujanojanaḥ //
meaning:
दारितश्छिन्न एवापि ह्यामोदेनैव चन्दनः /
सौरभं कुरुते सर्वं तथैव सुजनोजनः //
text_mt:
Even when split and cut down, sandalwood diffuses all its fragrance
merely through its perfume; exactly so does a virtuous person.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣāntyā ca tapasā cāraistadguṇajñā munīśvarāḥ /
saṃjātaṃ śāsituṃ lokāṃstvāṃ viduḥ puruṣottama //
meaning:
क्षान्त्या च तपसा चारैस्तद्गुणज्ञा मुनीश्वराः /
संजातं शासितुं लोकांस्त्वां विदुः पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt:
Through patience, penance, and conduct, the lords of sages who know your virtues
know you, O Supreme Person, to have been born to rule over the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
namo brahmanmune tubhyaṃ namaste brahmamūrttaye /
namo brahmaṇyaśīlāya brahmadhyānaparāya ca //
meaning:
नमो ब्रह्मन्मुने तुभ्यं नमस्ते ब्रह्ममूर्त्तये /
नमो ब्रह्मण्यशीलाय ब्रह्मध्यानपराय च //
text_mt:
Obeisance to you, O brāhmaṇa sage! Obeisance to you who are the embodiment of Brahman!
Obeisance to you whose character is devoted to the brāhmaṇas, and who are intent on meditation upon Brahman!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuto munistena prasannavadanastadā /
varaṃ varaya cetyāha prasanno 'smi tavānagha //
meaning:
इति स्तुतो मुनिस्तेन प्रसन्नवदनस्तदा /
वरं वरय चेत्याह प्रसन्नो ऽस्मि तवानघ //
text_mt:
Praised in this way by him, the sage, with a delighted face, then
said: "Choose a boon, for I am pleased with you, O sinless one!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte tu muninā hyaṃśumānpraṇipatyatam /
prāpayāsmatpitṝnbrāhmaṃ lokamityabhyabhāṣata //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते तु मुनिना ह्यंशुमान्प्रणिपत्यतम् /
प्रापयास्मत्पितॄन्ब्राह्मं लोकमित्यभ्यभाषत //
text_mt:
When addressed thus by the sage, Aṃśumat bowed down to him
and said: "Cause our ancestors to reach the world of Brahmā."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasyādisaṃtuṣṭo muniḥ provāca sādaram /
gaṅgāmānīya pautraste nayiṣyati pitṝndivam //
meaning:
ततस्तस्यादिसंतुष्टो मुनिः प्रोवाच सादरम् /
गङ्गामानीय पौत्रस्ते नयिष्यति पितॄन्दिवम् //
text_mt:
Then, thoroughly pleased with him, the sage said respectfully:
"Having brought down the Gaṅgā, your grandson will lead your ancestors to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpautreṇa samānītā gaṅgā puṇyajalā nadī /
kṛtvaitāndhūtapāpānvai nayiṣyati paraṃ padam //
meaning:
त्वत्पौत्रेण समानीता गङ्गा पुण्यजला नदी /
कृत्वैतान्धूतपापान्वै नयिष्यति परं पदम् //
text_mt:
Brought down by your grandson, the river Gaṅgā of holy waters,
having made them cleansed of sin, will surely lead them to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpayainaṃ hayaṃ vatsa yataḥ syātpūrṇamadhvaram /
pitāmahāntikaṃ prāpya sāśvaṃ vṛttaṃ nyavedayat //
meaning:
प्रापयैनं हयं वत्स यतः स्यात्पूर्णमध्वरम् /
पितामहान्तिकं प्राप्य साश्वं वृत्तं न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt:
Take this horse, my child, so that the sacrifice may be complete."
Reaching his grandfather's side, he reported the events along with the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
sagarastena paśunā taṃ yajñaṃ brahmaṇaiḥ saha /
vidhāya tapasā viṣṇumārādhyāpapadaṃhareḥ //
meaning:
सगरस्तेन पशुना तं यज्ञं ब्रह्मणैः सह /
विधाय तपसा विष्णुमाराध्यापपदंहरेः //
text_mt:
With that victim, Sagara performed that sacrifice together with the brāhmaṇas;
having worshipped Viṣṇu through penance, he attained the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
jajñe hyaṃśumataḥ putro dilīpa iti viśrutaḥ /
tasmādbhagīratho jāto yo gaṅgāmānayaddivaḥ //
meaning:
जज्ञे ह्यंशुमतः पुत्रो दिलीप इति विश्रुतः /
तस्माद्भगीरथो जातो यो गङ्गामानयद्दिवः //
text_mt:
To Aṃśumat was born a son renowned as Dilīpa;
from him was born Bhagīratha, who brought down the Gaṅgā from heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathasya tapasā tuṣṭo brahmā dadau mune /
gaṅgāṃ bhagīrathāyāḥ cintayāmā sa dhāraṇe //
meaning:
भगीरथस्य तपसा तुष्टो ब्रह्मा ददौ मुने /
गङ्गां भगीरथायाः चिन्तयामा स धारणे //
text_mt:
Pleased by the penance of Bhagīratha, Brahmā granted, O sage,
the Gaṅgā to Bhagīratha, who then pondered on holding her.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca śivamārādhya taddvārā svarṇadīṃ bhuvam /
ānīya tajjalaiḥ spṛṣṭvā pūtānninye divaṃ pitṝn //
meaning:
ततश्च शिवमाराध्य तद्द्वारा स्वर्णदीं भुवम् /
आनीय तज्जलैः स्पृष्ट्वा पूतान्निन्ये दिवं पितॄन् //
text_mt:
Then, having worshipped Śiva, and through him brought down the heavenly river to the earth,
he touched his ancestors with her waters, and, being purified, led them to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathānvaye jātaḥ sudaso nāma bhūpatiḥ /
yasya putro mitrasahaḥ sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
भगीरथान्वये जातः सुदसो नाम भूपतिः /
यस्य पुत्रो मित्रसहः सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः //
text_mt: In the lineage of Bhagīratha was born a king named Sudāsa, / whose son, renowned throughout all the worlds, was Mitrasaha.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭaśāpātprātpaḥ sa saudāso rākṣasīṃ tanum /
gaṅgābinduniṣeveṇaṃpunarmukto nṛpo 'bhavat //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāma aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
वशिष्टशापात्प्रात्पः स सौदासो राक्षसीं तनुम् /
गङ्गाबिन्दुनिषेवेणंपुनर्मुक्तो नृपो ऽभवत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नाम अष्टमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Through the curse of Vasiṣṭha, that Saudāsa obtained the body of a rākṣasa; / through being touched by a drop of the Gaṅgā, the king became free once again.

Thus ends the eighth chapter, named “Eulogy of the Greatness of the Gaṅgā,” in the first quarter of the first part in the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
śatpaḥ kathaṃ vasiṣṭena saundāso nṛpasattamaḥ /
gaṅgābindūbhiṣekeṇa punaḥ śuddho 'bayatkatham //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
शत्पः कथं वसिष्टेन सौन्दासो नृपसत्तमः /
गङ्गाबिन्दूभिषेकेण पुनः शुद्धो ऽबयत्कथम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / How was Saudāsa, best of kings, cursed by Vasiṣṭha? / How did he become pure once more through the sprinkling of a drop of the Gaṅgā?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvametadaśeṣeṇa bhrātarme vaktumahrasi /
śṛṇvatāṃ vadatāṃ caiva gaṅgākhyānaṃ śubhāvaham //
meaning:
सर्वमेतदशेषेण भ्रातर्मे वक्तुमह्रसि /
शृण्वतां वदतां चैव गङ्गाख्यानं शुभावहम् //
text_mt: You ought to tell me all this in full, my brother; / the narrative of the Gaṅgā brings auspiciousness both to those who hear it and to those who recite it.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
saudāsaḥ sarvadharmajñaḥ sarvajño guṇavāñchuciḥ /
bubhuje pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pitṛvadrañjayanprajāḥ //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
सौदासः सर्वधर्मज्ञः सर्वज्ञो गुणवाञ्छुचिः /
बुभुजे पृथिवीं सर्वां पितृवद्रञ्जयन्प्रजाः //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Saudāsa, knowing all righteousness, omniscient, virtuous, and pure, / enjoyed the entire earth, gladdening his subjects like a father.

sanskrit_iast:
sageraṇa yathā pūrvaṃ mahīyaṃ satpasāgarā /
rakṣitā tadvadamunā sarvadharmāvirodhinā //
meaning:
सगेरण यथा पूर्वं महीयं सत्पसागरा /
रक्षिता तद्वदमुना सर्वधर्माविरोधिना //
text_mt: Just as formerly this earth with its seven oceans was protected by Sagara, / so it was by him, who did not act contrary to any righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ /
triṃśadaṣṭasahasrāṇi bubhuje pṛthivīṃ yuvā //
meaning:
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तः सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः /
त्रिंशदष्टसहस्राणि बुभुजे पृथिवीं युवा //
text_mt: Endowed with sons and grandsons, accompanied by all sovereign power, / as a youth he enjoyed the earth for thirty-eight thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
saudāsastvekadā rājā mṛgayābhiratirvanam /
viveśva sabalaḥ samyak śodhitaṃ hyāsamantribhiḥ //
meaning:
सौदासस्त्वेकदा राजा मृगयाभिरतिर्वनम् /
विवेश्व सबलः सम्यक् शोधितं ह्यासमन्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: Once King Saudāsa, fond of hunting, / entered the forest with his army, after it had been thoroughly scouted by his ministers.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādaiḥ saditastatra vinighranmūgalañcayam /
āsasāda nadīṃ revāṃ dharmajñaḥ sa pipāsitaḥ //
meaning:
निषादैः सदितस्तत्र विनिघ्रन्मूगलञ्चयम् /
आससाद नदीं रेवां धर्मज्ञः स पिपासितः //
text_mt: Accompanied there by hunters, slaying herds of deer, / he, knower of righteousness, became thirsty and reached the river Revā.

sanskrit_iast:
sudāsatanayastatra snātvā kṛtvāhnikaṃ mune /
bhuktvā ca mantribhiḥ sārdhdaṃ tāṃ niśāṃ tatra cāvasat //
meaning:
सुदासतनयस्तत्र स्नात्वा कृत्वाह्निकं मुने /
भुक्त्वा च मन्त्रिभिः सार्ध्दं तां निशां तत्र चावसत् //
text_mt: There, having bathed and performed his daily rites, O sage, / the son of Sudāsa ate together with his ministers and stayed there for that night.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samuthāya kṛtvā paurvāhnikīṃ kriyām /
babhrāma mantrisahito narmadātīraje vane //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुथाय कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकीं क्रियाम् /
बभ्राम मन्त्रिसहितो नर्मदातीरजे वने //
text_mt: Then, having risen in the morning and performed his morning rites, / accompanied by his ministers, he roamed in the forest bordering the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
vanādvanāntaraṃ gacchanneka eva mahīpattiḥ /
ākarṇakṛṣṭabāṇaḥ sat kṛṣṇasāraṃ samanvagāt //
meaning:
वनाद्वनान्तरं गच्छन्नेक एव महीपत्तिः /
आकर्णकृष्टबाणः सत् कृष्णसारं समन्वगात् //
text_mt: Going from one forest to another, the king, entirely alone / with his arrow drawn back to his ear, pursued a blackbuck.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrasainyo 'śvamārūḍhaḥ sa rājānuvrajanmṛgam /
vyāghradvayaṃ guhāsaṃsthamapaśthamapaśyatsurate ratam //
meaning:
दूरसैन्यो ऽश्वमारूढः स राजानुव्रजन्मृगम् /
व्याघ्रद्वयं गुहासंस्थमपश्थमपश्यत्सुरते रतम् //
text_mt: Far from his troops, mounted on his horse, the king pursuing the deer / saw a pair of tigers in a cave engaged in sexual union.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgapṛṣṭaṃ parityajya vyāghrayoḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau /
dhanuḥsaṃhitabāṇena tenāsau śaraśāstravit //
meaning:
मृगपृष्टं परित्यज्य व्याघ्रयोः संमुखं ययौ /
धनुःसंहितबाणेन तेनासौ शरशास्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Abandoning the trail of the deer, he approached the two tigers; / with an arrow fixed to his bow, he, skilled in archery,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ vyāghrīṃ pātayāmāsa tīkṣṇāgranataparvaṇā /
patamānā tu sāvyāghrī ṣaṭratriṃśadyojanāyatā //
meaning:
तां व्याघ्रीं पातयामास तीक्ष्णाग्रनतपर्वणा /
पतमाना तु साव्याघ्री षट्रत्रिंशद्योजनायता //
text_mt: brought down that tigress with a sharp-pointed, straight-jointed shaft. / Falling down, however, that tigress, thirty-six yojanas in length,

sanskrit_iast:
taḍitvaddhoranirghoṣā rākṣasī vikṛtābhavat /
patitāṃ svapriyāṃ vīkṣya dviṣansa vyāghrarākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
तडित्वद्धोरनिर्घोषा राक्षसी विकृताभवत् /
पतितां स्वप्रियां वीक्ष्य द्विषन्स व्याघ्रराक्षसः //
text_mt: making a terrible roar like thunder, became a deformed rākṣasī. / Seeing his beloved fallen, that tiger-rākṣasa, hating [the king],

sanskrit_iast:
pratikriyāṃ kariṣyāmītyuktavā cāntardadhe tadā /
rājā tu bhayasaṃvigno vanesainyaṃ sametya ca //
meaning:
प्रतिक्रियां करिष्यामीत्युक्तवा चान्तर्दधे तदा /
राजा तु भयसंविग्नो वनेसैन्यं समेत्य च //
text_mt: said, “I will retaliate,” and then vanished. / The king, agitated by fear, rejoined his army in the forest

sanskrit_iast:
tadrṛttaṃ kathayansarvānsvāṃ purīṃ sa nyavarttata /
śaṅkamānastu tadrakṣaḥkṛtyā drājā sudāsajaḥ //
meaning:
तद्रृत्तं कथयन्सर्वान्स्वां पुरीं स न्यवर्त्तत /
शङ्कमानस्तु तद्रक्षःकृत्या द्राजा सुदासजः //
text_mt: and, recounting that event to everyone, returned to his own city. / Apprehensive of an act of that rākṣasa, the king, the son of Sudāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
paritatyāja mṛgayāṃ tataḥ prabhṛti nārada /
gate bahutithe kāle hayamedhamakhaṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
परितत्याज मृगयां ततः प्रभृति नारद /
गते बहुतिथे काले हयमेधमखं नृपः //
text_mt: gave up hunting from then on, O Nārada. / After a long time had passed, the king, serene in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
samārebhe prasannātmā vaśiṣṭādyamunīśvaraiḥ /
tatra brahmādidevebhyo havirdattvā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
समारेभे प्रसन्नात्मा वशिष्टाद्यमुनीश्वरैः /
तत्र ब्रह्मादिदेवेभ्यो हविर्दत्त्वा यथाविधि //
text_mt: undertook a horse-sacrifice sacrifice with Vasiṣṭha and other lordly sages. / Having offered oblations there according to rule to the gods headed by Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya yajñaniṣkrānto vaśiṣṭaḥ strātako 'pi ca /
atrāntare rākṣaso 'sau nṛpahisitabhāryakaḥ /
kartuṃ pratikriyāṃ rājñe samāyātoruṣānvitaḥ //
meaning:
समाप्य यज्ञनिष्क्रान्तो वशिष्टः स्त्रातको ऽपि च /
अत्रान्तरे राक्षसो ऽसौ नृपहिसितभार्यकः /
कर्तुं प्रतिक्रियां राज्ञे समायातोरुषान्वितः //
text_mt: the sacrifice having concluded, Vasiṣṭha departed, as did the initiated priests. / In the meantime, that rākṣasa whose wife had been killed by the king / arrived, filled with great wrath, to take revenge upon the king.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rākṣasastasya gurau prayāte vaśiṣṭaveṣaṃ tu tadaiva dhṛtvā /
rājānamabhyetya jagāda bhokṣye māṃsaṃ samicchāmyahamityuvāca //
meaning:
स राक्षसस्तस्य गुरौ प्रयाते वशिष्टवेषं तु तदैव धृत्वा /
राजानमभ्येत्य जगाद भोक्ष्ये मांसं समिच्छाम्यहमित्युवाच //
text_mt: When the king's guru had departed, that rākṣasa assumed the very guise of Vasiṣṭha, / approached the king, and said, “I will eat; I desire meat!”

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaḥ samāsthāya sa sūdavaṣaṃ paktvāmiṣaṃ mānupamasya vādāt /
sthitaśca rājāpi hari yapātre dhṛtvā gurorāgamanaṃ pratīkṣan //
meaning:
भूयः समास्थाय स सूदवषं पक्त्वामिषं मानुपमस्य वादात् /
स्थितश्च राजापि हरि यपात्रे धृत्वा गुरोरागमनं प्रतीक्षन् //
text_mt: Assuming then the guise of a cook, he cooked human flesh at his word; / the king also stood ready, having placed it in a golden dish, awaiting the guru's arrival.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmāṃsaṃ hemapātrasthaṃ saudāso vinayānvitaḥ /
samāgatāya guruve dadau tasmau sasādaram //
meaning:
तन्मांसं हेमपात्रस्थं सौदासो विनयान्वितः /
समागताय गुरुवे ददौ तस्मौ ससादरम् //
text_mt: That meat, placed in a golden dish, Saudāsa, full of humility, / respectfully presented to the guru who had arrived.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa guruḥ kimiti vismitaḥ //
meaning: तं दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास गुरुः किमिति विस्मितः //
text_mt: Seeing it, the guru was astonished and wondered: “What is this?”

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyanmānuṣaṃ māsaṃ parameṇa samādhinā /
aho 'sya rājño dauḥśīlyamabhakṣyaṃ dattavānmama //
meaning:
अपश्यन्मानुषं मासं परमेण समाधिना /
अहो ऽस्य राज्ञो दौःशील्यमभक्ष्यं दत्तवान्मम //
text_mt: Through supreme meditative absorption he saw human flesh: / “Ah, the wickedness of this king! He has offered me what is uneatable!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti viramayamāpannaḥ pramanyurabhavanmuniḥ /
abho 'jyaṃ madvighātāya datta hi pṛthivīpate //
meaning:
इति विरमयमापन्नः प्रमन्युरभवन्मुनिः /
अभो ऽज्यं मद्विघाताय दत्त हि पृथिवीपते //
text_mt: Thus becoming astonished, the sage grew furious: / “O king, you have given what is uneatable to destroy me!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttavāpi bhavatu hyetadeva hi bhojanam /
nṛmāṃsaṃ rakṣasāmeva bhojyaṃ dattaṃ mama tvayā //
meaning:
तस्मात्तवापि भवतु ह्येतदेव हि भोजनम् /
नृमांसं रक्षसामेव भोज्यं दत्तं मम त्वया //
text_mt: Therefore let this very thing be your food as well! / Human flesh is the food of rākṣasas alone, yet it was given by you to me.

sanskrit_iast:
tadyāhi rākṣasatvaṃ tvaṃ tadāhārocitaṃ nṛpā /
iti śāpaṃ dadatyasminsaudāso bhayavihvūlaḥ //
meaning:
तद्याहि राक्षसत्वं त्वं तदाहारोचितं नृपा /
इति शापं ददत्यस्मिन्सौदासो भयविह्वूलः //
text_mt: Therefore, O king, become a rākṣasa, fit for such food!” / As he was uttering this curse, Saudāsa, overwhelmed with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñatpo bhavataiveti sakaṃpo 'sma vyajijñapat /
bhūrāśṛ cintayāmāsa vaśiṣṭastena noditaḥ //
meaning:
आज्ञत्पो भवतैवेति सकंपो ऽस्म व्यजिज्ञपत् /
भूराशृ चिन्तयामास वशिष्टस्तेन नोदितः //
text_mt: trembling, made known: “It was ordered by yourself!” / Prompted by him, Vasiṣṭha reflected deeply;

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣasā vañcitaṃ bhūpaṃ jñātavān divyacakṣuṣā /
rājāpi jalamādāya vaśiṣṭaṃ śaptumudyataḥ //
meaning:
रक्षसा वञ्चितं भूपं ज्ञातवान् दिव्यचक्षुषा /
राजापि जलमादाय वशिष्टं शप्तुमुद्यतः //
text_mt: with his divine eye he recognized that the king had been deceived by the rākṣasa. / The king too, taking up water, prepared to curse Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
samudyataṃ guruṃ śaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūyo ruṣānvitam /
madayantī priyātasya pratyuvācātha suvratā //
meaning:
समुद्यतं गुरुं शप्तं दृष्ट्वा भूयो रुषान्वितम् /
मदयन्ती प्रियातस्य प्रत्युवाचाथ सुव्रता //
text_mt: Seeing him prepared to curse his guru, filled once again with fury, / his beloved Madayantī of holy vows then said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
madayantyuvāca
bho bho kṣatriyadāyāda kopa saṃhartumarhasi /
tvayā yatkarma bhoktavyaṃ tatprātpaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मदयन्त्युवाच
भो भो क्षत्रियदायाद कोप संहर्तुमर्हसि /
त्वया यत्कर्म भोक्तव्यं तत्प्रात्पं नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Madayantī said: / “O scion of kṣatriyas, you must hold back your anger! / The karma that was to be experienced by you has arrived; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
guru tukṛtya huṅkṛtya yo vadenmṛḍhadhīrnaraḥ /
araṇye nirjale deśa sa bhaveddhahyarākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
गुरु तुकृत्य हुङ्कृत्य यो वदेन्मृढधीर्नरः /
अरण्ये निर्जले देश स भवेद्धह्यराक्षसः //
text_mt: The foolish man who addresses his guru contemptuously with harsh shouts / becomes a brahma-rākṣasa in a waterless wilderness.

sanskrit_iast:
jitendriyā jitakrodhā guru śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ /
prayānti brahmasadanamiti śāstreṣu niścayaḥ //
meaning:
जितेन्द्रिया जितक्रोधा गुरु शुश्रूषणे रताः /
प्रयान्ति ब्रह्मसदनमिति शास्त्रेषु निश्चयः //
text_mt: Those who have conquered their senses, conquered anger, and are devoted to serving the guru / go to the abode of Brahman; this is the conclusion in the scriptures.”

sanskrit_iast:
tayokto bhūpatiḥ kopaṃ tyaktvā bhāryāṃ nananda ca /
jalaṃ kutra kṣipāmīti cintayāmāsa cātmanā //
meaning:
तयोक्तो भूपतिः कोपं त्यक्त्वा भार्यां ननन्द च /
जलं कुत्र क्षिपामीति चिन्तयामास चात्मना //
text_mt: Addressed by her, the king cast off his anger and was pleased with his wife, / and he pondered to himself: “Where shall I throw this water?”

sanskrit_iast:
tajjalaṃ yatra saṃsiktaṃ tadbhavedbhasma niścitam /
iti matvā jalaṃ tattu pādayornyakṣipatsvayam //
meaning:
तज्जलं यत्र संसिक्तं तद्भवेद्भस्म निश्चितम् /
इति मत्वा जलं तत्तु पादयोर्न्यक्षिपत्स्वयम् //
text_mt: “Wherever that water is sprinkled, that will surely become ashes”; / considering thus, he poured that water upon his own two feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjalaspaśimātreṇa pādau kalmāṣatāṃ gatau /
kalmāṣapāda ityevaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti vistṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तज्जलस्पशिमात्रेण पादौ कल्माषतां गतौ /
कल्माषपाद इत्येवं ततः प्रभृति विस्तृतः //
text_mt: By the mere touch of that water, his two feet became spotted; / from that time on he was widely known as Kalmāṣapāda [“Spotted-Foot”].

sanskrit_iast:
kalmāṣapādo matimān priyayāścāsitastadā /
manasā so 'tibhītastu vavande caraṇaṃ guroḥ //
meaning:
कल्माषपादो मतिमान् प्रिययाश्चासितस्तदा /
मनसा सो ऽतिभीतस्तु ववन्दे चरणं गुरोः //
text_mt: Then the wise Kalmāṣapāda, comforted by his beloved, / though terrified in mind, bowed at the feet of his guru.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca prapannastaṃ prāñjalirnayakovidaḥ /
kṣamasva bhagavansarvaṃ nāparādhaḥ kṛto mayā //
meaning:
उवाच च प्रपन्नस्तं प्राञ्जलिर्नयकोविदः /
क्षमस्व भगवन्सर्वं नापराधः कृतो मया //
text_mt: Having surrendered, skilled in conduct, with joined palms he said: / “Forgive everything, O lord; no offense was committed by me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchutvovāca bhūpālaṃ munirniḥśvasya duḥkhitaḥ /
ātmānaṃ garhayāmāsa hyavivekaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
तच्छुत्वोवाच भूपालं मुनिर्निःश्वस्य दुःखितः /
आत्मानं गर्हयामास ह्यविवेकपरायणम् //
text_mt: Hearing that, the sage sighed in sorrow and spoke to the protector of the earth, / reproaching himself as one governed by lack of discernment:

sanskrit_iast:
avivero hi sarveṣāmāpadāṃ paramaṃ padam /
vivekarahito loke paśureva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अविवेरो हि सर्वेषामापदां परमं पदम् /
विवेकरहितो लोके पशुरेव न संशयः //
text_mt: “Lack of discernment is indeed the supreme source of all calamities; / devoid of discernment, one is nothing but a beast in this world, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñā tvajānatā nūnametatkarmocitaṃ kṛtam /
vivekarahito 'jño 'haṃ yataḥ pāpaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
राज्ञा त्वजानता नूनमेतत्कर्मोचितं कृतम् /
विवेकरहितो ऽज्ञो ऽहं यतः पापं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: By the king, not knowing, this fitting act was surely done, / whereas I, devoid of discernment and ignorant, committed a sin.

sanskrit_iast:
vivekaniyato yāti yo vā ko vāpi nirvṛttim /
vivekahīnamānpoti ko vā yo vāpyanirvṛtim //
meaning:
विवेकनियतो याति यो वा को वापि निर्वृत्तिम् /
विवेकहीनमान्पोति को वा यो वाप्यनिर्वृतिम् //
text_mt: Whoever is governed by discernment attains peace; / whoever is devoid of discernment attains unrest.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavā cātmanātmānaṃ pratyuvāca munirnṛpam /
nātyantiṅkaṃ bhavedetaddādaśābdaṃ bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
इत्युक्तवा चात्मनात्मानं प्रत्युवाच मुनिर्नृपम् /
नात्यन्तिङ्कं भवेदेतद्दादशाब्दं भविष्यति //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to himself, the sage answered the king: / “This [curse] will not be permanent; it will last for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgābindūbhiṣiktastu tyakttvā vai rākṣasīṃ tanum /
pūrvarupaṃ tvamāpanno bhokṣyase medinīmimām //
tadvindusekasaṃbhūtajñānena gatakalmaṣaḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गाबिन्दूभिषिक्तस्तु त्यक्त्त्वा वै राक्षसीं तनुम् /
पूर्वरुपं त्वमापन्नो भोक्ष्यसे मेदिनीमिमाम् //
तद्विन्दुसेकसंभूतज्ञानेन गतकल्मषः //
text_mt:
Sprinkled with a drop of the Gaṅgā, casting off the body of a rākṣasa, / you will regain your former form and enjoy this earth.”

With the knowledge born of sprinkling that droplet [of Gaṅgā water], freed from taint,

sanskrit_iast: harisevāparo bhūtvā parāṃ śāntiṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning: हरिसेवापरो भूत्वा परां शान्तिं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Devoted to the service of Hari, you shall attain the supreme peace.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāvaham
ityuktvātharvavidbhūpaṃ vaśiṣṭaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau /
rājāpi duḥkhasaṃpanno rākṣasīṃ tānumāśritaḥ //
meaning:
शुभावहम्
इत्युक्त्वाथर्वविद्भूपं वशिष्टः स्वाश्रमं ययौ /
राजापि दुःखसंपन्नो राक्षसीं तानुमाश्रितः //
text_mt:
which brings good fortune.
Having spoken thus to the king, Vasiṣṭha, who knew the Atharvaveda, went to his own hermitage; / and the king too, filled with sorrow, entered into the body of a rākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpapāsāviśeṣārto nityaṃ krodhaparāyaṇaḥ /
kṛṣṇakṣapādyutirbhīmo babhrāma vijane vane //
meaning:
क्षुत्पपासाविशेषार्तो नित्यं क्रोधपरायणः /
कृष्णक्षपाद्युतिर्भीमो बभ्राम विजने वने //
text_mt:
Extremely afflicted with hunger and thirst, constantly given over to wrath,
Terrifying, with the splendour of a black night, he wandered in the deserted forest.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgāṃśca vividhāṃstatra mānuṣāṃśca sarīsṛpān /
vihaṅgamānplavaṅgāṃśca praśastāṃstānabhakṣayat //
meaning:
मृगांश्च विविधांस्तत्र मानुषांश्च सरीसृपान् /
विहङ्गमान्प्लवङ्गांश्च प्रशस्तांस्तानभक्षयत् //
text_mt:
Various beasts there, and men, and reptiles,
Birds and monkeys—he devoured whatever were suitable [as prey].

sanskrit_iast:
asthibhirbahubhirbhūyaḥ pītaraktakalevaraiḥ /
raktāntapretakeśaiśaaca citrāsīdbhūrbhayaṅkarī //
meaning:
अस्थिभिर्बहुभिर्भूयः पीतरक्तकलेवरैः /
रक्तान्तप्रेतकेशैशअच चित्रासीद्भूर्भयङ्करी //
text_mt:
With many bones scattered about, with bodies from which blood was drunk,
And with the blood-stained hair of corpses, the terrifying ground appeared variegated.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtutraye sa pṛthivīṃ śatayo janavistṛtām /
kṛtvātiduḥkhitāṃ paścādvanāntaramupāgamat //
meaning:
ऋतुत्रये स पृथिवीं शतयो जनविस्तृताम् /
कृत्वातिदुःखितां पश्चाद्वनान्तरमुपागमत् //
text_mt:
In three seasons he made the earth desolate over an expanse of a hundred yojanas;
Afterwards, he went to another forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi kṛtavānnityaṃ naramāṃsāśanaṃ sadā /
jagāma narmadātīraṃ munisiddhaniṣevitam //
meaning:
तत्रापि कृतवान्नित्यं नरमांसाशनं सदा /
जगाम नर्मदातीरं मुनिसिद्धनिषेवितम् //
text_mt:
There too he constantly took to eating human flesh;
[Then] he went to the bank of the Narmadā, frequented by sages and siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
vicarannarmadātīre sarvalokabhayaṅkaraḥ /
apaśyatkañcana muniṃ ramantaṃ priyayā saha //
meaning:
विचरन्नर्मदातीरे सर्वलोकभयङ्करः /
अपश्यत्कञ्चन मुनिं रमन्तं प्रियया सह //
text_mt:
Wandering along the bank of the Narmadā, terrifying to all people,
He saw a certain sage sporting with his beloved wife.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhānalena saṃtatpastaṃ muniṃ samupādravat /
jāgrāha cātivegena vyādho mṛgaśiśaṃ yathā //
meaning:
क्षुधानलेन संतत्पस्तं मुनिं समुपाद्रवत् /
