जाग्राह चातिवेगेन व्याधो मृगशिशं यथा //
text_mt:
Tormented by the fire of hunger, he rushed at that sage
And seized him with great speed, as a hunter [seizes] a fawn.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇī svapatiṃ vīkṣya niśācarakarasthitam /
śirasyañjalimādhāya provāca bhayavihvālā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणी स्वपतिं वीक्ष्य निशाचरकरस्थितम् /
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय प्रोवाच भयविह्वाला //
text_mt:
The brāhmaṇa woman, seeing her husband held in the hands of the night-roamer,
Placing her folded hands upon her head, agitated with fear, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyuvāca
bho bho nṛpatiśārdūla trāhi māṃ bhayavihvalām /
prāṇapriya pradānena kuru pūrṇaṃ manoratham //
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्युवाच
भो भो नृपतिशार्दूल त्राहि मां भयविह्वलाम् /
प्राणप्रिय प्रदानेन कुरु पूर्णं मनोरथम् //
text_mt:
The brāhmaṇa woman said:
'O tiger among kings, protect me who am agitated with fear!
By giving me back the beloved of my life, fulfil my desire!

sanskrit_iast:
nānmā mitrasahastvaṃ hi sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ /
na rākṣasastato 'nāthāṃ pāhi māṃ vijane vane //
meaning:
नान्मा मित्रसहस्त्वं हि सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः /
न राक्षसस्ततो ऽनाथां पाहि मां विजने वने //
text_mt:
By name you are indeed Mitrasaha, born in the solar dynasty;
You are not a rākṣasa! Therefore protect me, a helpless woman in the deserted forest.

sanskrit_iast:
yā nārī bharttṛrahitā jīvatyapi mṛtopamā /
tathāpi bālavaidhavyaṃ kiṃ vakṣyāmyarimardana //
meaning:
या नारी भर्त्तृरहिता जीवत्यपि मृतोपमा /
तथापि बालवैधव्यं किं वक्ष्याम्यरिमर्दन //
text_mt:
A woman who is deprived of her husband, even if she lives, is like one dead.
Still more, how shall I describe child-widowhood, O crusher of foes?

sanskrit_iast:
na mātāpitarau jāne nāpi bandhuṃ ca kañcana /
patireva paro bandhuḥ paramaṃ jīvanaṃ mama //
meaning:
न मातापितरौ जाने नापि बन्धुं च कञ्चन /
पतिरेव परो बन्धुः परमं जीवनं मम //
text_mt:
I know neither mother nor father, nor any kinsman.
The husband alone is my supreme kinsman, my highest life.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānyettyakhilāndharmānyoṣitāṃ varttanaṃ yathā /
trāyasva bandhurahitāṃ bālāpatyāṃ janeśvara //
meaning:
भवान्येत्त्यखिलान्धर्मान्योषितां वर्त्तनं यथा /
त्रायस्व बन्धुरहितां बालापत्यां जनेश्वर //
text_mt:
You know all the duties and how women conduct their lives.
Protect me, devoid of relatives, with an infant child, O lord of men!

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ jīvāmi patyāsminhīnā hi vijane vane /
duhitāhaṃ bhagavatastrāhi māṃ patidānataḥ //
meaning:
कथं जीवामि पत्यास्मिन्हीना हि विजने वने /
दुहिताहं भगवतस्त्राहि मां पतिदानतः //
text_mt:
How can I live in this deserted forest, bereft of my husband?
I am the daughter of a venerable man; save me by the gift of my husband!

sanskrit_iast:
praṇadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
vadantīti mahāprājñāḥ prāṇadānaṃ kuruṣva me //
meaning:
प्रणदानात्परं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
वदन्तीति महाप्राज्ञाः प्राणदानं कुरुष्व मे //
text_mt:
There has never been nor will there be a gift higher than the gift of life.
So the very wise declare; grant me the gift of life!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāvā sā papātāsya rākṣasasya padāgrataḥ /
evaṃ saṃprārthyamāno 'pi brāhmaṇyā rākṣaso dvijam //
abhakṣayakṛṣṇasāraśiśuṃ vyāghro yathā balāt //
meaning:
इत्युक्तावा सा पपातास्य राक्षसस्य पदाग्रतः /
एवं संप्रार्थ्यमानो ऽपि ब्राह्मण्या राक्षसो द्विजम् //
अभक्षयकृष्णसारशिशुं व्याघ्रो यथा बलात् //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, she fell before the feet of the rākṣasa.
Even though thus implored by the brāhmaṇa woman, the rākṣasa devoured the twice-born
By force, as a tiger [devours] a young blackbuck fawn.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vilapya bahudhā tasya patnī pativratā /
pūrvaśāpahataṃ bhūpamaśapatkrodhitā punaḥ //
meaning:
ततो विलप्य बहुधा तस्य पत्नी पतिव्रता /
पूर्वशापहतं भूपमशपत्क्रोधिता पुनः //
text_mt:
Then, having lamented in many ways, his devoted wife,
Enraged, again cursed the king who had already been struck by an earlier curse:

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ me suratāsaktaṃ yasmāddhiṃsitavānbalāt /
tasmātstrīsaṅgamaṃ prātpastvamapi prāpsyase mṛtim //
meaning:
पतिं मे सुरतासक्तं यस्माद्धिंसितवान्बलात् /
तस्मात्स्त्रीसङ्गमं प्रात्पस्त्वमपि प्राप्स्यसे मृतिम् //
text_mt:
'Since you have forcibly slaughtered my husband while he was intent on lovemaking,
Therefore, having engaged in intercourse with a woman, you too shall meet your death.'

sanskrit_iast:
śatvaivaṃ brāhmaṇī kruddhā punaḥ śāpāntaraṃ dadau /
rākṣasatvaṃ dhruvaṃ te 'stu matpatirbhakṣito yataḥ //
meaning:
शत्वैवं ब्राह्मणी क्रुद्धा पुनः शापान्तरं ददौ /
राक्षसत्वं ध्रुवं ते ऽस्तु मत्पतिर्भक्षितो यतः //
text_mt:
Having thus cursed him, the angry brāhmaṇa woman uttered another curse again:
'Let demonhood be yours permanently, since my husband was devoured [by you]!'

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi śāpadvayaṃ śrutvā tayā dattaṃ niśācaraḥ /
pramanyuḥ prāhi visṛjankopādaṅgārasaṃcayam //
meaning:
सो ऽपि शापद्वयं श्रुत्वा तया दत्तं निशाचरः /
प्रमन्युः प्राहि विसृजन्कोपादङ्गारसंचयम् //
text_mt:
Hearing the two curses uttered by her, the night-roamer,
Enraged, spoke, emitting a shower of hot coals in his fury:

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭe kasmātpradattaṃ mevṛthā śāpadvayaṃ tvayā /
ekasyaivāparādhasya śāpastveko mamocitaḥ //
meaning:
दुष्टे कस्मात्प्रदत्तं मेवृथा शापद्वयं त्वया /
एकस्यैवापराधस्य शापस्त्वेको ममोचितः //
text_mt:
'Vile woman, why have you needlessly laid two curses upon me?
For a single offence, only one curse was proper for me.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātkṣipasi duṣṭāgyemayi śāpantaraṃ tataḥ /
piśācayonimadyaiva yāhi putrasamanvitā //
meaning:
यस्मात्क्षिपसि दुष्टाग्येमयि शापन्तरं ततः /
पिशाचयोनिमद्यैव याहि पुत्रसमन्विता //
text_mt:
Since, O vile woman, you cast another curse upon me,
Go this very day into the womb of a piśāca along with your son!'

sanskrit_iast:
tenaivaṃ brahmaṇī śatpā piśācatvaṃ tadā gatā /
kṣudhārtā susvaraṃ bhīmārurodāpatyasaṃyutā //
meaning:
तेनैवं ब्रह्मणी शत्पा पिशाचत्वं तदा गता /
क्षुधार्ता सुस्वरं भीमारुरोदापत्यसंयुता //
text_mt:
Having thus been cursed by him, the brāhmaṇa woman attained the state of a piśāca.
Afflicted with hunger, terrifying, she wailed in a loud voice along with her child.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasaśca piśācī ca krośantau nirjane vane /
jagmaturnarmadātīre vanaṃ rākṣasasevitam //
meaning:
राक्षसश्च पिशाची च क्रोशन्तौ निर्जने वने /
जग्मतुर्नर्मदातीरे वनं राक्षससेवितम् //
text_mt:
The rākṣasa and the female piśāca, crying out in the deserted forest,
Went to a forest on the bank of the Narmadā frequented by rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
audāsīnyaṃ gurau kṛtvā rākṣasīṃ tanumā śritaḥ /
tatrāste duḥkhasaṃtatpaḥ kaścillokavirodhakṛt //
meaning:
औदासीन्यं गुरौ कृत्वा राक्षसीं तनुमा श्रितः /
तत्रास्ते दुःखसंतत्पः कश्चिल्लोकविरोधकृत् //
text_mt:
Having shown indifference toward his guru, he had assumed a demon's body;
There lived a certain [spirit] who tormented beings, burned with sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasaṃ ca piśācīṃ ca dṛṣṭvā ravavaṭamāgatau /
uvāca krodhabahulo vaṭastho brahmarākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
राक्षसं च पिशाचीं च दृष्ट्वा रववटमागतौ /
उवाच क्रोधबहुलो वटस्थो ब्रह्मराक्षसः //
text_mt:
Seeing the rākṣasa and the female piśāca come to the noisy banyan tree,
The brahmarākṣasa dwelling in the banyan tree, full of wrath, said:

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamāgatau bhīmau yuvāṃ matsthānamīpsitam /
īdṛśau kena pāpena jātau me bruvatāṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
किमर्थमागतौ भीमौ युवां मत्स्थानमीप्सितम् /
ईदृशौ केन पापेन जातौ मे ब्रुवतां ध्रुवम् //
text_mt:
'Why have you two terrifying ones come to my desired dwelling?
By what sin have you become such? Tell me truly!'

sanskrit_iast:
saudāsastadvacaḥ śrutvātayā yaccātmanā kṛtam /
sarvaṃ nivedayitvāsmai paścādetaduvāca ha //
meaning:
सौदासस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वातया यच्चात्मना कृतम् /
सर्वं निवेदयित्वास्मै पश्चादेतदुवाच ह //
text_mt:
Hearing his words, Saudāsa, having related to him everything
That had been done by her and by himself, then spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
saudāsa uvāca
kastvaṃ vada mahābhāga tvayā vai kiṃ kṛtaṃ purā /
sakhyurmamāti snehena tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
सौदास उवाच
कस्त्वं वद महाभाग त्वया वै किं कृतं पुरा /
सख्युर्ममाति स्नेहेन तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Saudāsa said:
'Who are you, illustrious one? Tell me what was done by you in the past.
Out of great affection for me, your friend, you ought to tell all of that.

sanskrit_iast:
karoti vañcanaṃ mitre yo vā ko vāpi duṣṭadhīḥ /
sa hi pāpapālaṃ bhuṅkte yātanāstu yugāyutam //
meaning:
करोति वञ्चनं मित्रे यो वा को वापि दुष्टधीः /
स हि पापपालं भुङ्क्ते यातनास्तु युगायुतम् //
text_mt:
Whoever, having an evil mind, commits deception against a friend,
He experiences the fruit of sin, namely torments for ten thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
jantūnāṃ sarvaduḥkhāni kṣīyante mitradarśanāt /
tasmānmitreṣu matimānna kuryādvaṃyanaṃ kadā //
meaning:
जन्तूनां सर्वदुःखानि क्षीयन्ते मित्रदर्शनात् /
तस्मान्मित्रेषु मतिमान्न कुर्याद्वंयनं कदा //
text_mt:
All the sorrows of living beings diminish upon seeing a friend;
Therefore a wise man should never practice deception towards friends.'

sanskrit_iast:
kalmāṣapādenetyukto vaṭastho brahmarākṣasaḥ /
uvāca prītimāpanno dharmavākyāni nārada //
meaning:
कल्माषपादेनेत्युक्तो वटस्थो ब्रह्मराक्षसः /
उवाच प्रीतिमापन्नो धर्मवाक्यानि नारद //
text_mt:
Addressed thus by Kalmāṣapāda, the brahmarākṣasa dwelling in the banyan tree,
Becoming pleased, spoke righteous words, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarākṣasa uvāca
ahamāsaṃ purā vipro māgadho vedapāragaḥ /
somadatta iti khyāto nānmā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मराक्षस उवाच
अहमासं पुरा विप्रो मागधो वेदपारगः /
सोमदत्त इति ख्यातो नान्मा धर्मपरायणः //
text_mt:
The brahmarākṣasa said:
'Formerly I was a brāhmaṇa of Magadha, well-versed in the Vedas,
Known by the name of Somadatta, devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
pramatto 'haṃ mahābhāga vidyayā vayasā dhanaiḥ /
audāsīnyaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā prātpavānīdṛśīṃ gatim //
meaning:
प्रमत्तो ऽहं महाभाग विद्यया वयसा धनैः /
औदासीन्यं गुरोः कृत्वा प्रात्पवानीदृशीं गतिम् //
text_mt:
Intoxicated by learning, youth, and wealth, O highly fortunate one,
I showed indifference to my guru and attained such a state.

sanskrit_iast:
nalabhe 'haṃ sukhaṃ kiṃ cijjitāhāro 'tiduḥkhitaḥ /
mayā tu bhakṣitā viprāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
नलभे ऽहं सुखं किं चिज्जिताहारो ऽतिदुःखितः /
मया तु भक्षिता विप्राः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः //
text_mt:
I obtain no happiness whatsoever; with my food restricted, I am exceedingly wretched.
Indeed, brāhmaṇas have been devoured by me by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpipāsāparo nityamantastāpena pīḍitaḥ /
jagatrāsakaro nityaṃ māṃsāśanaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
क्षुत्पिपासापरो नित्यमन्तस्तापेन पीडितः /
जगत्रासकरो नित्यं मांसाशनपरायणः //
text_mt:
Constantly given over to hunger and thirst, tormented by internal burning,
Ever causing terror to the world, devoted to eating flesh.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvavajñā manuṣyāṇāṃ rākṣasatvapradāyinī /
mayānubhūtametaddhi tataḥ śrīmānna cācaret //
meaning:
गुर्ववज्ञा मनुष्याणां राक्षसत्वप्रदायिनी /
मयानुभूतमेतद्धि ततः श्रीमान्न चाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Disrespect towards the guru is what brings demonhood to human beings;
This has indeed been experienced by me. Therefore a prosperous man should not practice it.'

sanskrit_iast:
kalmāṣapāda uvāca
gurustu kīdṛśaḥ proktaḥ kastvayāślāghitaḥ purā /
tadvadasva sarave sarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me //
meaning:
कल्माषपाद उवाच
गुरुस्तु कीदृशः प्रोक्तः कस्त्वयाश्लाघितः पुरा /
तद्वदस्व सरवे सर्वं परं कौतूहलं हि मे //
text_mt:
Kalmāṣapāda said:
'What kind of guru is spoken of, and who was disrespected by you in the past?
Tell all that, O friend; great indeed is my curiosity.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarākṣasa uvāca
guravaḥ santi bahavaḥ pūjyā vandyāśca sādaram /
yātānahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sarave //
meaning:
ब्रह्मराक्षस उवाच
गुरवः सन्ति बहवः पूज्या वन्द्याश्च सादरम् /
यातानहं कथयिष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः सरवे //
text_mt:
The brahmarākṣasa said:
'There are many gurus who are to be worshipped and saluted with reverence.
I shall tell you about them; listen with one-pointed mind, O friend:

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpakaśca vedānāṃ vedārthayutibaidhakaḥ /
śāstravaktā dharmavaktā nītiśāstropadeśakaḥ //
meaning:
अध्यापकश्च वेदानां वेदार्थयुतिबैधकः /
शास्त्रवक्ता धर्मवक्ता नीतिशास्त्रोपदेशकः //
text_mt:
The teacher of the Vedas; the explainer of the reasoning and meaning of the Vedas;
The speaker of sacred treatises; the speaker of dharma; the teacher of statecraft;

sanskrit_iast:
mantropadeśavyākhyākhyākṛdvedasadaṃhṛttathā /
vratopadeśakaścaiva bhayatrātānnado hi ca //
meaning:
मन्त्रोपदेशव्याख्याख्याकृद्वेदसदंहृत्तथा /
व्रतोपदेशकश्चैव भयत्रातान्नदो हि च //
text_mt:
He who gives instruction in mantras and explains them; the collector of the Vedic texts;
The instructor of vows; the protector from fear; and the giver of food;

sanskrit_iast:
śvaśuro mātulaścaiva jyeṣṭhabhrātā pitā tathā /
upanetā niṣektā ca saṃskarttā mitrasattama //
meaning:
श्वशुरो मातुलश्चैव ज्येष्ठभ्राता पिता तथा /
उपनेता निषेक्ता च संस्कर्त्ता मित्रसत्तम //
text_mt:
The father-in-law, maternal uncle, eldest brother, and father;
The one who performs the upanayana, the biological father, and the one who performs the rites of passage, O best of friends;

sanskrit_iast: ete hi guravaḥ proktāḥ pūjyā vandyaśca sādaram //
meaning: एते हि गुरवः प्रोक्ताः पूज्या वन्द्यश्च सादरम् //
text_mt: These indeed are declared to be gurus, to be worshipped and saluted with reverence.'

sanskrit_iast:
kalmāṣapāda uvāca
guravo bahavaḥ proktā eteṣāṃ katamo varaḥ /
tulyāḥ sarve 'pyuta sarave tadyathāvaddhi brūhi me //
meaning:
कल्माषपाद उवाच
गुरवो बहवः प्रोक्ता एतेषां कतमो वरः /
तुल्याः सर्वे ऽप्युत सरवे तद्यथावद्धि ब्रूहि मे //
text_mt:
Kalmāṣapāda said:
'Many gurus have been declared. Among these, which one is superior?
Or are all of them equal, O friend? Tell me that accurately.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarākṣasa uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña yatpṛṣṭaṃ tadvadāmi te /
gurumāhātmyakathanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cānumodanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मराक्षस उवाच
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ यत्पृष्टं तद्वदामि ते /
गुरुमाहात्म्यकथनं श्रवणं चानुमोदनम् //
text_mt:
The Brahmarākṣasa said:
“Well said, well said, O very wise one! What you have asked, that I shall tell you. / The recitation of the eulogy of the greatness of the guru, the hearing [of it], and approval [of it]

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ śreya ādhatte tasmādvakṣyāmi sāṃpratam /
ete samānapūjārhāḥ sarvadā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां श्रेय आधत्ते तस्माद्वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम् /
एते समानपूजार्हाः सर्वदा नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: bestow the highest good upon all. Therefore I shall speak now. / These are always worthy of equal worship; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi śruṇu vakṣyāmi śāstrāṇāṃ sāraniścayam /
adhyāpakāśca vedānāṃ mantravyākhyākṛtastathā //
meaning:
तथापि श्रुणु वक्ष्यामि शास्त्राणां सारनिश्चयम् /
अध्यापकाश्च वेदानां मन्त्रव्याख्याकृतस्तथा //
text_mt: Even so, listen, I shall state the ascertained essence of the scriptures. / The teachers of the Vedas, and likewise those who explain the mantras,

sanskrit_iast: pitā ca dharmavaktā ca viśeṣaguravaḥ smṛtāḥ eteṣāmapi bhūpāla śṛṇuṣva pravaraṃ gurum //
meaning: पिता च धर्मवक्ता च विशेषगुरवः स्मृताः एतेषामपि भूपाल शृणुष्व प्रवरं गुरुम् //
text_mt: the father, and the speaker of dharma are considered special gurus. / Among these also, O protector of the earth, hear of the pre-eminent guru.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrārthatatvajñairbhāṣitaṃ pravadāmi te /
yaḥ purāṇāni vadati dharmayuktāni paṇaḍitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्वज्ञैर्भाषितं प्रवदामि ते /
यः पुराणानि वदति धर्मयुक्तानि पणडितः //
text_mt: I tell you what was spoken by those who know the truth of the meaning of all scriptures: / That learned man who recites the Purāṇas endowed with dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārapāśavicchedakaraṇāni sa uttamaḥ /
devapūjārhakarmāṇi devatāpūjane phalam //
meaning:
संसारपाशविच्छेदकरणानि स उत्तमः /
देवपूजार्हकर्माणि देवतापूजने फलम् //
text_mt: which effect the severing of the bonds of worldly existence, is the highest. / The acts worthy of deity worship [and] the fruit of worshipping deities

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate ca purāṇebhyastasmāttānīha devatāḥ /
sarvavedārthasārāṇi purāṇānīti bhūpate //
meaning:
जायते च पुराणेभ्यस्तस्मात्तानीह देवताः /
सर्ववेदार्थसाराणि पुराणानीति भूपते //
text_mt: arise from the Purāṇas; therefore they are the deities in this world. / The Purāṇas are the essence of the meaning of all the Vedas, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
vadanti munayaścaiva tadūktā paramo guruḥ /
yaḥ saṃsārārṇatvaṃ tarttumudyogaṃ kurute naraḥ //
meaning:
वदन्ति मुनयश्चैव तदूक्ता परमो गुरुः /
यः संसारार्णत्वं तर्त्तुमुद्योगं कुरुते नरः //
text_mt: so say the sages, and the one who recites them is the supreme guru. / That man who makes an effort to cross over the ocean of worldly existence

sanskrit_iast:
śruṇuyātsa purāṇāni iti śāstravibhāgakṛt /
proktavānsarvadharmāśca purāṇeṣu mahīpate //
meaning:
श्रुणुयात्स पुराणानि इति शास्त्रविभागकृत् /
प्रोक्तवान्सर्वधर्माश्च पुराणेषु महीपते //
text_mt: should hear the Purāṇas—thus declared the author of the classification of scriptures. / And all dharmas, O king, are proclaimed in the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tarkastu vādahetuḥ syānnītistvaihikasādhanam /
purāṇāni mahābuddhe ihāmutra sukhāya hi //
meaning:
तर्कस्तु वादहेतुः स्यान्नीतिस्त्वैहिकसाधनम् /
पुराणानि महाबुद्धे इहामुत्र सुखाय हि //
text_mt: Logic is a cause for debate, and political ethics is a means for this world; / but the Purāṇas, O one of great intellect, are indeed for happiness in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śṛṇoti purāṇāni satataṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ /
tasya syānnirmalā buddhirbhūyo dharmaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
यः शृणोति पुराणानि सततं भक्तिसंयुतः /
तस्य स्यान्निर्मला बुद्धिर्भूयो धर्मपरायणः //
text_mt: He who constantly listens to the Purāṇas endowed with devotion / attains an immaculate intellect and becomes devoted to dharma continuously.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaśravaṇādbhaktirjāyate śrīpatau śubhā /
viṣṇubhaktanṛṇāṃ bhūpa dharme buddhiḥ pravarttate //
meaning:
पुराणश्रवणाद्भक्तिर्जायते श्रीपतौ शुभा /
विष्णुभक्तनृणां भूप धर्मे बुद्धिः प्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: From hearing the Purāṇas, auspicious devotion arises toward the Lord of Śrī. / For people who are devotees of Viṣṇu, O king, their intellect turns to dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmātpāpāni naśyanti jñānaṃ śuddhaṃ ca jāyate /
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ ye phalānyabhilipsavaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मात्पापानि नश्यन्ति ज्ञानं शुद्धं च जायते /
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां ये फलान्यभिलिप्सवः //
text_mt: From dharma sins are destroyed, and pure knowledge is born. / Those who desire to obtain the fruits of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation

sanskrit_iast:
śruṇuyuste purāṇāni prāhuritthaṃ purāvidaḥ /
ahaṃ tu gautamamuneḥ sarvajñādrūhyavādinaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुणुयुस्ते पुराणानि प्राहुरित्थं पुराविदः /
अहं तु गौतममुनेः सर्वज्ञाद्रूह्यवादिनः //
text_mt: should hear the Purāṇas—so have said the knowers of the ancient lore. / But I, from the sage Gautama, who was omniscient and spoke the truth,

sanskrit_iast:
śrutavānsarvadharmārtha gaṅgātīre manorame /
kadācitparameśasya pūjāṃ karttumahaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
श्रुतवान्सर्वधर्मार्थ गङ्गातीरे मनोरमे /
कदाचित्परमेशस्य पूजां कर्त्तुमहं गतः //
text_mt: heard the meaning of all dharmas on the delightful bank of the Gaṅgā. / Once I went to perform the worship of the Supreme Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
upasthitāyāpi tasmai praṇāmaṃ na hyakāriṣam /
sa tu śānto mahābuddhirgauntamastejasāṃ nidhiḥ //
meaning:
उपस्थितायापि तस्मै प्रणामं न ह्यकारिषम् /
स तु शान्तो महाबुद्धिर्गौन्तमस्तेजसां निधिः //
text_mt: even when he arrived, I did not make obeisance to him. / But he, calm and of great intellect, Gautama, a treasure of splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
mantroditāni karmaṇi karotītimudaṃ ya yau /
yastvarcito mayā devaḥ śivaḥ sarvajagadguruḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रोदितानि कर्मणि करोतीतिमुदं य यौ /
यस्त्वर्चितो मया देवः शिवः सर्वजगद्गुरुः //
text_mt: became pleased, [thinking,] ‘He is performing rites prescribed by mantra.’ / But the deity who was worshipped by me was Śiva, the guru of the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvavajñā kṛtāyena rākṣasaṃtve niyuktavān /
jñānato 'jñānato vāpi yo 'vajñāṃ kurute guroḥ //
meaning:
गुर्ववज्ञा कृतायेन राक्षसंत्वे नियुक्तवान् /
ज्ञानतो ऽज्ञानतो वापि यो ऽवज्ञां कुरुते गुरोः //
text_mt: ‘Disrespect has been shown to the guru’—by him I was consigned to the state of a rākṣasa. / Whether knowingly or unknowingly, whoever shows disrespect to a guru,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivāśu praṇaśyanti dhīvidyārthātmajakriyāḥ /
śuśrūṣāṃ kurute yastu guruṇāṃ sādaraṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैवाशु प्रणश्यन्ति धीविद्यार्थात्मजक्रियाः /
शुश्रूषां कुरुते यस्तु गुरुणां सादरं नरः //
text_mt: his intellect, learning, wealth, sons, and ritual acts perish swiftly. / But that person who reverently serves the gurus,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya saṃpadbhavedbhūpa iti prāhurvipaścitaḥ /
tena śāpena dagdho 'hamantaścaiva kṣadhāgninā //
meaning:
तस्य संपद्भवेद्भूप इति प्राहुर्विपश्चितः /
तेन शापेन दग्धो ऽहमन्तश्चैव क्षधाग्निना //
text_mt: prosperity belongs to him, O king; so the wise declare. / Burned by that curse, and within [burned] by the fire of hunger,

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaṃ kadā prayāsyāmi na jāne nṛpasattama /
evaṃ vadati viprendra vaṭasthe 'sminniśācare //
meaning:
मोक्षं कदा प्रयास्यामि न जाने नृपसत्तम /
एवं वदति विप्रेन्द्र वटस्थे ऽस्मिन्निशाचरे //
text_mt: I do not know when I shall attain liberation, O best of kings!” / While this night-wanderer, staying upon the banyan tree, was speaking thus, O best of brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaśāstraprasaṃgena tayoḥ pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam /
etasminnantare prātpaḥ kaścidvipro 'tidhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मशास्त्रप्रसंगेन तयोः पापं क्षयं गतम् /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्रात्पः कश्चिद्विप्रो ऽतिधार्मिकः //
text_mt: the sin of both of them was destroyed through the discourse on the scriptures of dharma. / In the meantime, an exceedingly righteous brahmin arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṅgadeśasaṃbhūto nānmrā garga iti smṛtaḥ /
vahangaṅgājalaṃ skandhe stuvan viśveśvaraṃ prabhum //
meaning:
कलिङ्गदेशसंभूतो नान्म्रा गर्ग इति स्मृतः /
वहन्गङ्गाजलं स्कन्धे स्तुवन् विश्वेश्वरं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: born in the country of Kaliṅga, known by the name of Garga, / carrying Gaṅgā-water on his shoulder, praising the Lord Viśveśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyannāmāni tasyaiva mudā hṛṣṭatan ruhaḥ /
tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā piśācīrākṣasau ca tau //
meaning:
गायन्नामानि तस्यैव मुदा हृष्टतन् रुहः /
तमागतं मुनिं दृष्ट्वा पिशाचीराक्षसौ च तौ //
text_mt: singing His very names, his bodily hairs bristling with joy. / Seeing that sage arrive, both the female piśāca and the rākṣasa,

sanskrit_iast:
prātpā naḥ pāraṇetyuktvā prādvavannūrdhvabāhavaḥ /
tena kīrtitanāmāni śrutvā dūre vyavasthitāḥ /
aśaktāstaṃ dharṣayitumidamūcuśca rākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
प्रात्पा नः पारणेत्युक्त्वा प्राद्ववन्नूर्ध्वबाहवः /
तेन कीर्तितनामानि श्रुत्वा दूरे व्यवस्थिताः /
अशक्तास्तं धर्षयितुमिदमूचुश्च राक्षसाः //
text_mt: saying, “Our fast-breaking meal has arrived!”, ran forth with raised arms. / Hearing the names recited by him, standing at a distance, / unable to overpower him, the rākṣasas spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
aho vipra mahābhāga namastubhya mahātmane /
nāmakīrtanamāhātmyādrākṣasā dūragāvayam //
meaning:
अहो विप्र महाभाग नमस्तुभ्य महात्मने /
नामकीर्तनमाहात्म्याद्राक्षसा दूरगावयम् //
text_mt: “O greatly fortunate brahmin, homage to you, great-souled one! / By the power of the eulogy of the [Lord’s] name, we rākṣasas are kept far away.

sanskrit_iast:
asmābhirbhakṣitāḥ pūrvaṃ viprāḥ koṭisahasraḥ /
nāmaprāvaraṇaṃ vipra rakṣati tvāṃ mahābhayayāt //
meaning:
अस्माभिर्भक्षिताः पूर्वं विप्राः कोटिसहस्रः /
नामप्रावरणं विप्र रक्षति त्वां महाभययात् //
text_mt: Previously, thousands of crores of brahmins were eaten by us. / The armour of the [Lord's] name, O brahmin, protects you from great fear.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa rākṣasā api bho vayam /
parāṃ śāntiṃ samāpannā mahimnā hyacyutasya vai //
meaning:
नामश्रवणमात्रेण राक्षसा अपि भो वयम् /
परां शान्तिं समापन्ना महिम्ना ह्यच्युतस्य वै //
text_mt: Merely by hearing the name, O sir, even we rākṣasas / have attained supreme peace, indeed by the greatness of Acyuta!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvathā tvaṃ mahābhāga rāgādiruhitohyasi /
gaṅgājalābhiṣekeṇa pāhyasmātpātakoccayāt //
meaning:
सर्वथा त्वं महाभाग रागादिरुहितोह्यसि /
गङ्गाजलाभिषेकेण पाह्यस्मात्पातकोच्चयात् //
text_mt: In every way, O fortunate one, you are free from passion and the like. / By sprinkling with Gaṅgā-water, protect us from the mass of sins!

sanskrit_iast:
harise vāparo bhūtvā yaścātmānaṃ tu tārayet /
sa tārayenagatsarvamiti śaṃsanti sūrayaḥ //
meaning:
हरिसे वापरो भूत्वा यश्चात्मानं तु तारयेत् /
स तारयेनगत्सर्वमिति शंसन्ति सूरयः //
text_mt: Having become dedicated to the service of Hari, he who delivers himself / delivers the whole world; thus proclaim the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
avahāya harernāma ghorasaṃsārabheṣajam /
kenopāyena labhyeta muktiḥ sarvatra durlabhā //
meaning:
अवहाय हरेर्नाम घोरसंसारभेषजम् /
केनोपायेन लभ्येत मुक्तिः सर्वत्र दुर्लभा //
text_mt: Abandoning Hari’s name, the remedy for the terrible worldly existence, / by what means could liberation, difficult to obtain everywhere, be attained?

sanskrit_iast:
lohoḍupena pratarannimajatyudake yathā /
tayaivākṛtapuṇyāstu tārayanti kathaṃ parān //
meaning:
लोहोडुपेन प्रतरन्निमजत्युदके यथा /
तयैवाकृतपुण्यास्तु तारयन्ति कथं परान् //
text_mt: Just as one crossing with an iron raft sinks in the water, / even so how could those devoid of merit deliver others?

sanskrit_iast:
aho caritraṃ mahatāṃ sarvalokasukhā vaham /
yathā hi sarvalokānāmānandāya kalānidhiḥ //
meaning:
अहो चरित्रं महतां सर्वलोकसुखा वहम् /
यथा हि सर्वलोकानामानन्दाय कलानिधिः //
text_mt: Ah, the conduct of the great brings happiness to all the world, / just as the moon brings delight to all the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pavitrāṇi dvijottam /
tāni sarvāṇi gaṅgāyāḥ kaṇasyāpi samānina //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पवित्राणि द्विजोत्तम् /
तानि सर्वाणि गङ्गायाः कणस्यापि समानिन //
text_mt: Whatever holy sacred fords there are on earth, O best of brahmins, / all of them are not equal even to a drop of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīdalapradalasaṃmiśramapi sarṣapamātrakam /
gaṅgājalaṃ punātyeva kulānāmekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
तुलसीदलप्रदलसंमिश्रमपि सर्षपमात्रकम् /
गङ्गाजलं पुनात्येव कुलानामेकविंशतिम् //
text_mt: Mixed with a tulasī leaf, Gaṅgā-water even the size of a mustard seed / purifies twenty-one generations.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvipra mahābhāga sarvaśāstrārthakovida /
gaṅgājalapradānena pāhmasmānpāpakarmiṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्विप्र महाभाग सर्वशास्त्रार्थकोविद /
गङ्गाजलप्रदानेन पाह्मस्मान्पापकर्मिणः //
text_mt: Therefore, O greatly fortunate brahmin, skilled in the meaning of all scriptures, / protect us evil-doers by granting Gaṅgā-water!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityākhyātaṃ rākṣasaistairgaṅgāmāhātmyamuttamam /
niśamya vismayā viṣṭo babhūva dvijasatamaḥ //
meaning:
इत्याख्यातं राक्षसैस्तैर्गङ्गामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् /
निशम्य विस्मया विष्टो बभूव द्विजसतमः //
text_mt: Having heard this excellent eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā recited by those rākṣasas, / the best of brahmins was filled with wonder:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmapīddaśī bhaktirgaṅgāyāṃ lokamātari /
kimu jñānaprabhāvāṇāṃ mahatāṃ puṇyaśālinām //
meaning:
एषामपीद्दशी भक्तिर्गङ्गायां लोकमातरि /
किमु ज्ञानप्रभावाणां महतां पुण्यशालिनाम् //
text_mt: “Even in these [creatures] there is such devotion to the Gaṅgā, the mother of the worlds! / What then of the great ones endowed with merit and the power of knowledge?”

sanskrit_iast:
athāsau manasā dharmaṃ viniścitya drijottamaḥ /
sarvapūtahito bhaktaḥ prāprotīti paraṃ padam //
meaning:
अथासौ मनसा धर्मं विनिश्चित्य द्रिजोत्तमः /
सर्वपूतहितो भक्तः प्राप्रोतीति परं पदम् //
text_mt: Then that best of the twice-born, having resolved dharma in his mind, [thought,] / “A devotee who seeks the welfare of all beings reaches the supreme abode.”

sanskrit_iast:
tato vipraḥ kṛpāviṣṭo gaṅgājalapranuttamamam /
tulasīdalasaṃmiśraṃ teṣu rakṣaḥsvasecayat //
meaning:
ततो विप्रः कृपाविष्टो गङ्गाजलप्रनुत्तममम् /
तुलसीदलसंमिश्रं तेषु रक्षःस्वसेचयत् //
text_mt: Then the brahmin, filled with compassion, sprinkled that excellent Gaṅgā-water / mixed with tulasī leaves upon those rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasāstena siktāstu sarṣapopamabindunā /
vimṛjya rākṣasaṃ bhāvamabhavandevatopamāḥ //
meaning:
राक्षसास्तेन सिक्तास्तु सर्षपोपमबिन्दुना /
विमृज्य राक्षसं भावमभवन्देवतोपमाः //
text_mt: Sprinkled by him with a drop resembling a mustard seed, the rākṣasas, / casting off their rākṣasa nature, became equal to deities.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ samyakte jagmurhastathaiva ca /
koṭisūryapratīkāśā babhūvurvivudharṣabhāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं सम्यक्ते जग्मुर्हस्तथैव च /
कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशा बभूवुर्विवुधर्षभाः //
text_mt: Resembling ten million suns, those best among the gods / [praised] the brahmin and properly departed [therefrom].

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadācihnā harisārupyamāgatāḥ /
stuvanto brāhmaṇaṃ samyakte jagmurha rimāndiram //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदाचिह्ना हरिसारुप्यमागताः /
स्तुवन्तो ब्राह्मणं सम्यक्ते जग्मुर्ह रिमान्दिरम् //
text_mt: Bearing the marks of the conch, discus, and mace, having attained the same form as Hari, / suitably praising the brahmin, they went to Hari's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā kalmāṣapādastu nijarupaṃ samāsthitaḥ /
jagāma mahatīṃ cintāṃ dṛṣṭvā tānmuktigānadhān //
meaning:
राजा कल्माषपादस्तु निजरुपं समास्थितः /
जगाम महतीं चिन्तां दृष्ट्वा तान्मुक्तिगानधान् //
text_mt: King Kalmāṣapāda, however, restored to his own form, / fell into great anxiety upon seeing those departed ones reach liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin rājñi suduḥkhārte gūḍharupā sarasvatī /
dharmamūlaṃ mahāvākyaṃ babhāṣe 'gādhayā girā //
meaning:
तस्मिन् राज्ञि सुदुःखार्ते गूढरुपा सरस्वती /
धर्ममूलं महावाक्यं बभाषे ऽगाधया गिरा //
text_mt: While that king was stricken with deep sorrow, Sarasvatī, in hidden form, / spoke a great utterance rooted in dharma with a profound voice:

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho rājanmahābhāga na duḥkhaṃ gantumarhasi /
rājastavāpi bhāgānte mahacchreyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
भो भो राजन्महाभाग न दुःखं गन्तुमर्हसि /
राजस्तवापि भागान्ते महच्छ्रेयो भविष्यति //
text_mt: “O King, O fortunate one, you should not give way to sorrow. / O King, at the end of your allotment too, great welfare shall come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
satkarmadhūtapāpā ye haribhaktiparāyaṇāḥ /
prayānti nātra saṃdehastadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
सत्कर्मधूतपापा ये हरिभक्तिपरायणाः /
प्रयान्ति नात्र संदेहस्तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Those whose sins are washed away by good deeds, who are devoted to Hari’s devotion, / go to that supreme abode of Viṣṇu; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtadayāyuktā dharmamārgapravartinaḥ /
prayānti paramaṃ sthānaṃ gurupūjāparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभूतदयायुक्ता धर्ममार्गप्रवर्तिनः /
प्रयान्ति परमं स्थानं गुरुपूजापरायणाः //
text_mt: Endowed with compassion for all beings, advancing on the path of dharma, / dedicated to the worship of the guru, they go to the supreme state.”

sanskrit_iast:
itīritaṃ samākarṇya bhāratyā nṛpasatamaḥ /
manasā nirvṛttiṃ prāpyasasmāra ca gurorvacaḥ //
meaning:
इतीरितं समाकर्ण्य भारत्या नृपसतमः /
मनसा निर्वृत्तिं प्राप्यसस्मार च गुरोर्वचः //
text_mt: Hearing what was thus spoken by Sarasvatī, that best of kings / achieved peace of mind and remembered the word of his guru.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanguruṃ ca taṃ vignaṃ hariṃ caivātiharṣitaḥ /
pīrvavṛttaṃ ca viprāya sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat //
meaning:
स्तुवन्गुरुं च तं विग्नं हरिं चैवातिहर्षितः /
पीर्ववृत्तं च विप्राय सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: Praising the guru, who was freed from anxiety, and Hari, greatly delighted, / he related all the previous events to that brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nṛpastu kāliṅgaṃ praṇamya vidhirvamune /
nāmāni vyāharanviṣṇoḥ sadyo vārāṇasīṃ yayau //
meaning:
ततो नृपस्तु कालिङ्गं प्रणम्य विधिर्वमुने /
नामानि व्याहरन्विष्णोः सद्यो वाराणसीं ययौ //
text_mt: Then, bowing down properly to the Kāliṅga, O sage, / the king, chanting the names of Viṣṇu, went at once to Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsaṃ tatra gaṅgāyāṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvā sadānivam /
brāhmaṇīdattaśa pāttu mukto mitrasaho 'bhavat //
meaning:
षण्मासं तत्र गङ्गायां स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा सदानिवम् /
ब्राह्मणीदत्तश पात्तु मुक्तो मित्रसहो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Bathing there in the Gaṅgā for six months and beholding Śiva, / Mitrasaha became freed from the curse given by the brāhmaṇa's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu svapurīṃ prātpo vasiṣṭena mahātmanā /
abhiṣikto munuśreṣṭha svakaṃ rājyamapālayat //
meaning:
ततस्तु स्वपुरीं प्रात्पो वसिष्टेन महात्मना /
अभिषिक्तो मुनुश्रेष्ठ स्वकं राज्यमपालयत् //
text_mt: Then, having reached his own city, consecrated by the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, / O best of sages, he ruled his kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
pālayitvā mahīṃ kṛtstrāṃ bhuktvā bhogānstriyaṃ vinā /
vaśiṣṭātprāpya santānaṃ gato mokṣaṃ nṛpottamaḥ //
meaning:
पालयित्वा महीं कृत्स्त्रां भुक्त्वा भोगान्स्त्रियं विना /
वशिष्टात्प्राप्य सन्तानं गतो मोक्षं नृपोत्तमः //
text_mt: Having ruled the whole earth, enjoying pleasures without a woman, / and having obtained offspring through Vasiṣṭha, that best of kings attained liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
naitaccitraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha viṣṇorvārāṇasīguṇān /
gṛṇañchṛṇvansmarangaṅgāṃ pītvā mukto bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
नैतच्चित्रं द्विजश्रेष्ठ विष्णोर्वाराणसीगुणान् /
गृणञ्छृण्वन्स्मरन्गङ्गां पीत्वा मुक्तो भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: This is not surprising, O best of the twice-born: singing, hearing, and remembering / the virtues of Vārāṇasī and of Viṣṇu, and drinking [the water of] the Gaṅgā, a man becomes liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmāhimne viprendra gaṅgāyāḥ śakyate nahi /
pāraṃ gantuṃ surādhīśairbrahmaviṣṇuśivarapi //
meaning:
तस्मान्माहिम्ने विप्रेन्द्र गङ्गायाः शक्यते नहि /
पारं गन्तुं सुराधीशैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवरपि //
text_mt: Therefore, O chief of brāhmaṇas, the end of the greatness of the Gaṅgā / cannot be reached even by the lords of gods—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yannāmasmaraṇādeva mahāpātakakoṭibhiḥ /
vimukto brahmasadanaṃ naro yāti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यन्नामस्मरणादेव महापातककोटिभिः /
विमुक्तो ब्रह्मसदनं नरो याति न संशयः //
text_mt: From the mere remembrance of her name, a man is freed / from tens of millions of great sins and goes to the abode of Brahmā—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgā gaṅgeti yannāma sakṛdapyucyate yadā /
tadaiva pāpanimukto brahmaloke mahīyate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgā māhātmye navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
गङ्गा गङ्गेति यन्नाम सकृदप्युच्यते यदा /
तदैव पापनिमुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गा माहात्म्ये नवमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
When the name ‘Gaṅgā, Gaṅgā’ is uttered even once, / at that very moment one is freed from sin and honoured in the world of Brahmā.

Thus ends the ninth chapter, on the eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā, in the first quarter of the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
viṣṇupādāgrasaṃbhūtā yā gaṅgetyabhidhīyate /
tadutpattiṃ vada bhrātaranugrāhyo 'smi te yadi //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
विष्णुपादाग्रसंभूता या गङ्गेत्यभिधीयते /
तदुत्पत्तिं वद भ्रातरनुग्राह्यो ऽस्मि ते यदि //
text_mt: Nārada said: / That which is called the Gaṅgā, born from the tip of Viṣṇu's foot— / tell of her origin, O brother, if I am worthy of your favour.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi gaṅgotpattiṃ tavānagha /
vadṛtāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiṃva puṇyadāṃ pāpanāśinīm //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि गङ्गोत्पत्तिं तवानघ /
वदृतां शृण्वतां चैंव पुण्यदां पापनाशिनीम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Listen, O sinless Nārada; I shall tell you of the origin of the Gaṅgā, / which grants merit and destroys sin for those who recite and hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīdindrādidevānāṃ janakaḥ kaśyapo muniḥ /
dakṣātmaje tasya bhārye ditiścāditireva ca //
meaning:
आसीदिन्द्रादिदेवानां जनकः कश्यपो मुनिः /
दक्षात्मजे तस्य भार्ये दितिश्चादितिरेव च //
text_mt: The father of Indra and the other gods was the sage Kaśyapa; / Dakṣa's two daughters, Diti and Aditi, were his wives.

sanskrit_iast:
agaditirdevamātāsti daityānāṃ jananī ditiḥ /
te tayorātmajā vipra parasparajayaiṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
अगदितिर्देवमातास्ति दैत्यानां जननी दितिः /
ते तयोरात्मजा विप्र परस्परजयैषिणः //
text_mt: Aditi is the mother of the gods, and Diti is the mother of the Daityas. / Their sons, O brāhmaṇa, each sought victory over the other.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sapūrvadevāstu yato daityāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
ādir daityo diteḥ putro hiraṇyakaśipurbalī //
meaning:
सदा सपूर्वदेवास्तु यतो दैत्याः प्रकीर्तिताः /
आदिर् दैत्यो दितेः पुत्रो हिरण्यकशिपुर्बली //
text_mt: For the Daityas are indeed called the elder gods; / the first Daitya was Diti's son, the mighty Hiraṇyakaśipu.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādastasya putro 'bhūtsumahāndaityasattamaḥ /
virocana stasya suto babhūva dvijabhaktimān //
meaning:
प्रह्लादस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत्सुमहान्दैत्यसत्तमः /
विरोचन स्तस्य सुतो बभूव द्विजभक्तिमान् //
text_mt: His son was Prahlāda, very great, the best of the Daityas; / his son was Virocana, who was devoted to the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro 'titejasvī balirāsītpratāpavān /
sa eva vāhinīpālo daityānāmabhavanmuneḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो ऽतितेजस्वी बलिरासीत्प्रतापवान् /
स एव वाहिनीपालो दैत्यानामभवन्मुनेः //
text_mt: His son was Bali, exceedingly splendid and majestic; / he became the commander of the army of the Daityas, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
balena mahatā yukto bubhuje medinīmimām /
vijitya vasudhāṃ sarvāṃ svargaṃ jetuṃ mano dadhe //
meaning:
बलेन महता युक्तो बुभुजे मेदिनीमिमाम् /
विजित्य वसुधां सर्वां स्वर्गं जेतुं मनो दधे //
text_mt: Endowed with great strength, he enjoyed this earth; / having conquered the entire earth, he set his mind on conquering heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśca yasyāyutakoṭilakṣāstāvanta evāścarathā munīndra /
gajegaje pañcaśatī padāteḥ kiṃ varṇyate tasya camūrvariṣṭā //
meaning:
गजाश्च यस्यायुतकोटिलक्षास्तावन्त एवाश्चरथा मुनीन्द्र /
गजेगजे पञ्चशती पदातेः किं वर्ण्यते तस्य चमूर्वरिष्टा //
text_mt: For him there were a hundred thousand tens of millions of elephants, and just as many horses and chariots, O chief of sages; / five hundred foot-soldiers to each elephant—how could his superior army be described?

sanskrit_iast:
amātyakoṭyagrasarāvamātyau kumbhāṇḍanāmāpyatha kūpakarṇaḥ /
pitrā samaṃ śauryaparākramābhyāṃ bāṇo baleḥ putraśatagrajo 'bhūt //
meaning:
अमात्यकोट्यग्रसरावमात्यौ कुम्भाण्डनामाप्यथ कूपकर्णः /
पित्रा समं शौर्यपराक्रमाभ्यां बाणो बलेः पुत्रशतग्रजो ऽभूत् //
text_mt: The two ministers who were foremost among tens of millions of ministers were named Kumbhāṇḍa and Kūpakarṇa; / equal to his father in heroism and prowess was Bāṇa, the eldest of Bali's hundred sons.

sanskrit_iast:
baliḥ surāñjetumanāḥ pravṛttaḥ sainyena yukto mahatā pratasthe /
dhvajātapartrairgaganāburāśestaraṅgavidyutsmaraṇaṃ prakurvan //
meaning:
बलिः सुराञ्जेतुमनाः प्रवृत्तः सैन्येन युक्तो महता प्रतस्थे /
ध्वजातपर्त्रैर्गगनाबुराशेस्तरङ्गविद्युत्स्मरणं प्रकुर्वन् //
text_mt: Bali, having resolved to conquer the gods, set forth accompanied by a huge army, / evoking the waves and lightning of the ocean of the sky with banners and parasols.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya vṛtrāripuraṃ surārī rurogha daityairmṛgarājagāḍhaiḥ /
suraśca yuddhāya purāttathaiva viniryayurvajrakarādayaśca //
meaning:
अवाप्य वृत्रारिपुरं सुरारी रुरोघ दैत्यैर्मृगराजगाढैः /
सुरश्च युद्धाय पुरात्तथैव विनिर्ययुर्वज्रकरादयश्च //
text_mt: Having reached the city of Indra, the enemy of the gods besieged it with Daityas mounted on lions; / and the gods, led by the wielder of the thunderbolt, marched out from the city to battle in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ gīrvāṇadaityayo /
kalpāntameghānirdhoṣaṃ ḍiṇḍiṃmadhvanisaṃbhramam //
meaning:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोरं गीर्वाणदैत्ययो /
कल्पान्तमेघानिर्धोषं डिण्डिंमध्वनिसंभ्रमम् //
text_mt: Then a terrible battle commenced between the gods and the Daityas, / with a roar like the clouds at the end of a cosmic cycle and the tumult of drumbeats.

sanskrit_iast:
mumucuḥ śarajālāni daḥtyāḥ sumanasāṃ bale /
devāśca daityasenāsu saṃgrāme 'tyantadāruṇe //
meaning:
मुमुचुः शरजालानि दःत्याः सुमनसां बले /
देवाश्च दैत्यसेनासु संग्रामे ऽत्यन्तदारुणे //
text_mt: The Daityas loosed volleys of arrows upon the army of the gods, / and the gods upon the armies of the Daityas in that exceedingly fierce conflict.

sanskrit_iast:
jahi dāraya bhindhīte chindhi māraya tāḍaya /
ityevaṃ sumahānghoṣo vadatāṃ senayorabhūt //
meaning:
जहि दारय भिन्धीते छिन्धि मारय ताडय /
इत्येवं सुमहान्घोषो वदतां सेनयोरभूत् //
text_mt: ‘Strike! Tear! Pierce! Cut! Kill! Beat!’— / thus there was a great shouting of those speaking in both armies.

sanskrit_iast:
śaradundubhinidhvānaiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ suradviṣām /
bhāṅkāraiḥ syandanānāṃ ca bāṇakreṅgāraniḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
शरदुन्दुभिनिध्वानैः सिंहनादैः सिंहनादैः सुरद्विषाम् /
भाङ्कारैः स्यन्दनानां च बाणक्रेङ्गारनिःस्वनैः //
text_mt: With the sounds of arrows and kettle-drums, the lion-roars of the enemies of the gods, / the rattling of chariots, and the twanging whistle of arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvānāṃ heṣitaiścaiva gajānāṃ bṛṃhitaistathā /
ṭaṅgārairdhanuṣāṃ caiva lokaḥ śabdatmayo 'bhavat //
meaning:
अश्वानां हेषितैश्चैव गजानां बृंहितैस्तथा /
टङ्गारैर्धनुषां चैव लोकः शब्दत्मयो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: and with the neighing of horses, the trumpeting of elephants, / and the twanging of bows, the world was filled entirely with sound.

sanskrit_iast:
surāsuravinirmuktabāṇaniṣpeṣajānale /
akālapralayaṃ mene nirīkṣya sakalaṃ jagat //
meaning:
सुरासुरविनिर्मुक्तबाणनिष्पेषजानले /
अकालप्रलयं मेने निरीक्ष्य सकलं जगत् //
text_mt: At the fire born from the friction of arrows loosed by gods and Asuras, / the entire world, beholding it, thought the untimely dissolution had arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
babhau devadviṣāṃ senā sphuracchastraughadhāriṇī /
caladvidyunnibhā rātriśchāditā jaladairiva //
meaning:
बभौ देवद्विषां सेना स्फुरच्छस्त्रौघधारिणी /
चलद्विद्युन्निभा रात्रिश्छादिता जलदैरिव //
text_mt: The army of the enemies of the gods, bearing a multitude of flashing weapons, / shone like a night filled with flashing lightning, covered by rain-clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminyuddhe mahādhorairgirīn kṣitpān surāribhiḥ /
nārācaiścūrṇayāmāsurvevāste laghuvikramāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्युद्धे महाधोरैर्गिरीन् क्षित्पान् सुरारिभिः /
नाराचैश्चूर्णयामासुर्वेवास्ते लघुविक्रमाः //
text_mt: In that battle, the mountains hurled with great ferocity by the enemies of the gods / were shattered into dust with iron arrows by the swift-moving gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kecitsatāḍayāmāsurnāgairnāgānrathānrathaiḥ /
aśvairaśvāṃśca kecittu gadādaṇḍairathārddayan //
meaning:
केचित्सताडयामासुर्नागैर्नागान्रथान्रथैः /
अश्वैरश्वांश्च केचित्तु गदादण्डैरथार्द्दयन् //
text_mt: Some struck elephants with elephants, chariots with chariots, / and horses with horses; others afflicted [their foes] with maces and clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
paridhaistāḍitāḥ kecitpetuḥ śoṇitakarddame /
samuktrāntāsavaḥ kecidvimānāni samāśritāḥ //
meaning:
परिधैस्ताडिताः केचित्पेतुः शोणितकर्द्दमे /
समुक्त्रान्तासवः केचिद्विमानानि समाश्रिताः //
text_mt: Some, struck by iron bludgeons, fell into the mire of blood; / some, having breathed their last, mounted celestial chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
ye daityā nihatā devaiḥ prasahya saṅgare tadā /
te devabhāvamāpannā daiteyānsamupādravan //
meaning:
ये दैत्या निहता देवैः प्रसह्य सङ्गरे तदा /
ते देवभावमापन्ना दैतेयान्समुपाद्रवन् //
text_mt: The Daityas who were violently slain then by the gods in battle, / attaining godhood, rushed against the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha daityagaṇāḥ krudvāstaḍyamānāḥ survairbhṛśam /
śastrairbahuvidhairddevānnijadhnuratidāruṇāḥ //
meaning:
अथ दैत्यगणाः क्रुद्वास्तड्यमानाः सुर्वैर्भृशम् /
शस्त्रैर्बहुविधैर्द्देवान्निजध्नुरतिदारुणाः //
text_mt: Then the hosts of Daityas, enraged and severely struck by the gods, / exceedingly fierce, slew the gods with many kinds of weapons:

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣadbhirbhidipālaiśca khaḍgaiḥ paraśutomaraiḥ /
paridhaiśchurikābhiśca kuntaiścakraiśca śaṅkubhiḥ //
meaning:
दृषद्भिर्भिदिपालैश्च खड्गैः परशुतोमरैः /
परिधैश्छुरिकाभिश्च कुन्तैश्चक्रैश्च शङ्कुभिः //
text_mt: with rocks, bhindipālas, swords, axes, javelins, / iron bludgeons, knives, spears, discs, iron spikes,

sanskrit_iast:
musalairaṅkuśeśvaiva lāṅgalaiḥ paṭṭiśaistathā /
śaktyopalaiḥ śataghrībhiḥ pāśaiśca talamuṣṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
मुसलैरङ्कुशेश्वैव लाङ्गलैः पट्टिशैस्तथा /
शक्त्योपलैः शतघ्रीभिः पाशैश्च तलमुष्टिभिः //
text_mt: pestles, elephant-goads, ploughshares, paṭṭiśas, / darts, stones, śataghnīs, nooses, slaps and fists,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlairnālīkanārācaiḥ kṣepaṇīyaiḥsamudraraiḥ /
rathāśvanāgapadagaiḥ saṅkulo vavṛdhe raṇaḥ //
meaning:
शूलैर्नालीकनाराचैः क्षेपणीयैःसमुद्ररैः /
रथाश्वनागपदगैः सङ्कुलो ववृधे रणः //
text_mt: tridents, arrows, iron shafts, missiles and mallets. / Crowded with chariots, horses, elephants, and infantry, the battle intensified.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca vividhāstrāṇi daiteyebhyaḥ samākṣipan /
evamaṣṭasahasrāṇi yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam //
meaning:
देवाश्च विविधास्त्राणि दैतेयेभ्यः समाक्षिपन् /
एवमष्टसहस्राणि युद्धमासीत्सुदारुणम् //
text_mt: And the gods hurled diverse divine missiles at the Daiteyas; / thus the battle continued, exceedingly fierce, for eight thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
atha daityabale vṛddhe parābhūtā divaukasaḥ /
suralokaṃ parityatajya sarve bhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ //
meaning:
अथ दैत्यबले वृद्धे पराभूता दिवौकसः /
सुरलोकं परित्यतज्य सर्वे भीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः //
text_mt: Then, as the Daitya army grew stronger, the sky-dwellers were defeated; / abandoning the realm of the gods, all fled in fear.

sanskrit_iast:
nararupaparicchannā viceru ravanītale /
vairocanistribhuvanaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
नररुपपरिच्छन्ना विचेरु रवनीतले /
वैरोचनिस्त्रिभुवनं नारायणपरायणः //
text_mt: Disguised in human form, they roamed the surface of the earth; / and the son of Virocana, devoted to Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
bubhuje 'vyāhataiścaryapravṛddhaśrīrmahābalaḥ /
ityāja cāśvameghaiḥ sa viṣṇuprīṇanatatparaḥ //
meaning:
बुभुजे ऽव्याहतैश्चर्यप्रवृद्धश्रीर्महाबलः /
इत्याज चाश्वमेघैः स विष्णुप्रीणनतत्परः //
text_mt: enjoyed the three worlds, his prosperity enhanced through unimpeded dominion, endowed with great strength; / intent on pleasing Viṣṇu, he sacrificed with horse-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
indratvaṃ cākarotsvarge dikpālatvaṃ tathaiva ca /
devānāṃ prīṇanārthāya yaiḥ kriyante dvijairmakhāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रत्वं चाकरोत्स्वर्गे दिक्पालत्वं तथैव च /
देवानां प्रीणनार्थाय यैः क्रियन्ते द्विजैर्मखाः //
text_mt: He exercised the role of Indra in heaven, and likewise the role of guardian of the directions. / In all those sacrifices which were performed by the twice-born to please the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu yajñeṣu sarveṣu havirbhuṅkte sa daityarāṭ /
aditiḥ svātmajānvīkṣya devamātātiduḥkhitā //
vṛthātra nivasāmīti matvāgāddhimavadgiram /
śakrasyaiśvaryamicchantī daityānāṃ ca parājayam //
meaning:
तेषु यज्ञेषु सर्वेषु हविर्भुङ्क्ते स दैत्यराट् /
अदितिः स्वात्मजान्वीक्ष्य देवमातातिदुःखिता //
वृथात्र निवसामीति मत्वागाद्धिमवद्गिरम् /
शक्रस्यैश्वर्यमिच्छन्ती दैत्यानां च पराजयम् //
text_mt:
the king of the Daityas consumed the sacrificial offering. / Aditi, the mother of the gods, seeing her sons, was deeply grieved;

thinking, ‘I live here in vain,’ she went to the Himālaya mountain, / desiring dominion for Indra and defeat for the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
haridhyānaparā bhūtvā tapastepe 'tiduṣkaram /
kiñcitkālaṃ samāsīnā tiṣṭantī ca tataḥ param //
meaning:
हरिध्यानपरा भूत्वा तपस्तेपे ऽतिदुष्करम् /
किञ्चित्कालं समासीना तिष्टन्ती च ततः परम् //
text_mt: Devoting herself to meditation on Hari, she performed extremely difficult austerity, / sitting for a certain period, and remaining standing after that.

sanskrit_iast:
pādenaikena suciraṃ tataḥ pādāgramātrataḥ /
kañcitkālaṃ phalāhārā tataḥ śīrṇadalāśanā //
meaning:
पादेनैकेन सुचिरं ततः पादाग्रमात्रतः /
कञ्चित्कालं फलाहारा ततः शीर्णदलाशना //
text_mt: for a very long time on one foot, then merely on the tips of her toes; / for some time living on fruits, then eating [only] withered leaves;

sanskrit_iast:
tato jalāśamā vāyubhojanāhāravarjitā /
sañcidānandasandohaṃ dhyāyatyātmānamatmanā //
meaning:
ततो जलाशमा वायुभोजनाहारवर्जिता /
सञ्चिदानन्दसन्दोहं ध्यायत्यात्मानमत्मना //
text_mt: then living on water, and [finally] abstaining from food and living on air, / she meditated through herself on the Self, the mass of pure consciousness and bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ sā tapo 'tapyata nārada /
durantaṃ tattapaḥ śrutvā daiteyā māyino 'ditim //
meaning:
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रं सा तपो ऽतप्यत नारद /
दुरन्तं तत्तपः श्रुत्वा दैतेया मायिनो ऽदितिम् //
text_mt: She performed austerities for a thousand divine years, O Nārada. / Hearing of those severe austerities, the deceitful sons of Diti,

sanskrit_iast:
devatārupamāsthāya saṃprocurbalinoditāḥ /
kimarthaṃ tapyate mātaḥ śarīrapariśoṣaṇam //
meaning:
देवतारुपमास्थाय संप्रोचुर्बलिनोदिताः /
किमर्थं तप्यते मातः शरीरपरिशोषणम् //
text_mt: prompted by Bali, assumed the forms of gods and said to Aditi: / 'Why is this emaciation of the body being undertaken, O mother?

sanskrit_iast:
yadi jananti daiteyā mahahukhaṃ tato bhavet /
tyajedaṃ duḥkhabahulaṃ kāyaśoṣaṇakāraṇam //
meaning:
यदि जनन्ति दैतेया महहुखं ततो भवेत् /
त्यजेदं दुःखबहुलं कायशोषणकारणम् //
text_mt: If the sons of Diti come to know, great sorrow will ensue from it. / Abandon this cause of the emaciation of the body, which is full of misery.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāsasādhyaṃ sukṛtaṃ na praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ /
śarīraṃ yantato rakṣyaṃ dharmasādhanatatparaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रयाससाध्यं सुकृतं न प्रशंसन्ति पण्डिताः /
शरीरं यन्ततो रक्ष्यं धर्मसाधनतत्परैः //
text_mt: Wise men do not praise religious merit achieved through [such] hardship. / The body must be preserved with effort by those devoted to religious practice.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śarīramupekṣante te syurātmavighātinaḥ /
sukhaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭa subhage putrānasmānna khedaya //
meaning:
ये शरीरमुपेक्षन्ते ते स्युरात्मविघातिनः /
सुखं त्वं तिष्ट सुभगे पुत्रानस्मान्न खेदय //
text_mt: Those who neglect the body become destroyers of the self. / Remain at ease, O fortunate lady; do not cause grief to us, your sons.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā hīnā janā mātarmṛtaprāyā na saṃśayaḥ /
gāvo vā paśavo vāpiyatra gāvo mahīruhāḥ //
meaning:
मात्रा हीना जना मातर्मृतप्राया न संशयः /
गावो वा पशवो वापियत्र गावो महीरुहाः //
text_mt: People deprived of a mother, O mother, are almost dead, without doubt. / Whether cattle or beasts, or where cows and trees [are found],

sanskrit_iast:
na labhante sukhaṃ kiñcinmātrā hīnā mṛtopamāḥ /
daridro vāpi rogī vā deśāntaragato 'pi vā //
meaning:
न लभन्ते सुखं किञ्चिन्मात्रा हीना मृतोपमाः /
दरिद्रो वापि रोगी वा देशान्तरगतो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: those deprived of a mother find no happiness at all and are like the dead. / Whether poor, or diseased, or gone to a foreign land,

sanskrit_iast:
māturdarśanamātreṇa labhate paramāṃ mudam /
anne vā salile vāpi dhanādau vā priyāsu ca //
meaning:
मातुर्दर्शनमात्रेण लभते परमां मुदम् /
अन्ने वा सलिले वापि धनादौ वा प्रियासु च //
text_mt: merely by seeing the mother one attains the highest joy. / In food, or in water, or in wealth and the like, or in beloved women,

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidvimukho yāti jano mātari ko 'pi na /
yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti yatra dharmaparāyaṇā /
sādhvī ca strī patiprāṇā gantavyaṃ tena vai vanam //
meaning:
कदाचिद्विमुखो याति जनो मातरि को ऽपि न /
यस्य माता गृहे नास्ति यत्र धर्मपरायणा /
साध्वी च स्त्री पतिप्राणा गन्तव्यं तेन वै वनम् //
text_mt: a person may at times turn away, but no one ever does from a mother. / A man in whose house there is no mother, [and no] virtuous wife / who is devoted to righteousness and holds her husband as her life, should indeed go to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaśca nārāyaṇabhaktihīnāṃ dhanaṃ ca sadbhogavivarjitaṃ hi /
gṛhaṃ ca māryātanayervihīnaṃ yathā tathā mātṛvihīnamartyaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मश्च नारायणभक्तिहीनां धनं च सद्भोगविवर्जितं हि /
गृहं च मार्यातनयेर्विहीनं यथा तथा मातृविहीनमर्त्यः //
text_mt: Just as religious duty is devoid of devotion to Nārāyaṇa, wealth is devoid of noble enjoyment, / and a house is devoid of a wife and sons, so is a mortal devoid of a mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddevi paritrāhi duḥkhārtānātmajāṃstavā /
ityuktāpyaditirdaipyairna cacāla samādhitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्देवि परित्राहि दुःखार्तानात्मजांस्तवा /
इत्युक्ताप्यदितिर्दैप्यैर्न चचाल समाधितः //
text_mt: Therefore, O goddess, protect your sons who are afflicted with sorrow!' / Although addressed in this way by the Daityas, Aditi did not stir from her deep meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvāsurāḥ sarve haridhyānaparāyaṇām /
nirīkṣya krodhasaṃyuktā hantuṃ cakrurmanoratham //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वासुराः सर्वे हरिध्यानपरायणाम् /
निरीक्ष्य क्रोधसंयुक्ता हन्तुं चक्रुर्मनोरथम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, all the asuras, seeing her devoted to meditation on Hari, / became filled with anger and resolved to slay her.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpāntameghanirghoṣāḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ /
daṃṣṭragrairasṛjanvahniṃ so 'dahatkānanaṃ kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
कल्पान्तमेघनिर्घोषाः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः /
दंष्ट्रग्रैरसृजन्वह्निं सो ऽदहत्काननं क्षणात् //
text_mt: Roaring like the clouds at the end of an eon, their eyes red with wrath, / they emitted fire from the tips of their fangs; in an instant, it set the forest ablaze.

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ nānājīvasamākulam /
tenaiva dagdhā daiteyā ye pradharṣayituṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं नानाजीवसमाकुलम् /
तेनैव दग्धा दैतेया ये प्रधर्षयितुं गताः //
text_mt: It was a hundred yojanas in extent and crowded with various living beings. / By that very [fire] the sons of Diti who had gone to violate [her] were consumed.

sanskrit_iast:
saivāvaśiṣṭā jananī surāṇāmabdācchatādacyutasaktacitā /
saṃrakṣitā viṣṇusudarśanena daityāntakena svajanānukampinā //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgātpattau balikṛtadevaparājayavarṇanannāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सैवावशिष्टा जननी सुराणामब्दाच्छतादच्युतसक्तचिता /
संरक्षिता विष्णुसुदर्शनेन दैत्यान्तकेन स्वजनानुकम्पिना //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गात्पत्तौ बलिकृतदेवपराजयवर्णनन्नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
She alone, the mother of the gods, remained after a hundred years, her mind fixed on Acyuta, / protected by Viṣṇu's Sudarśana, the destroyer of Daityas, who is compassionate toward his own people.

Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Defeat of the Gods by Bali, in the Account of the Origin of the Gaṅgā', in the first quarter of the first part in the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
aho hyatyadbhutaṃ proktaṃ tvayā bhrātaridaṃ mama /
sa vahniraditiṃ muktvā kathaṃ tānadahatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अहो ह्यत्यद्भुतं प्रोक्तं त्वया भ्रातरिदं मम /
स वह्निरदितिं मुक्त्वा कथं तानदहत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'Ah, indeed a great wonder has been related by you to me, O brother! / How did that fire, sparing Aditi, consume them in an instant?

sanskrit_iast:
vadāditermahāsattvaṃ viśeṣāścaryakāraṇam /
paropadeśaniratāḥ sajjanā hi munīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
वदादितेर्महासत्त्वं विशेषाश्चर्यकारणम् /
परोपदेशनिरताः सज्जना हि मुनीश्वराः //
text_mt: Relate Aditi's great fortitude, the cause of extraordinary wonder; / for noble sages, best among ascetics, are indeed devoted to instructing others.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
śṛṇu nārada māhātmyaṃ haribhaktiratātmanām /
haridhyānaparānsādhūnkaḥ samarthaḥ prabādhitum //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
शृणु नारद माहात्म्यं हरिभक्तिरतात्मनाम् /
हरिध्यानपरान्साधून्कः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / 'Listen, O Nārada, to the eulogy of greatness of those souls devoted to Hari's devotion. / Who is able to oppress the virtuous who are intent on meditating on Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
haribhaktiparo yatra tatra brahmā hariḥ śivaḥ /
devāḥ siddhā munīśvāśca nityaṃ tiṣṭanti sattamāḥ //
meaning:
हरिभक्तिपरो यत्र तत्र ब्रह्मा हरिः शिवः /
देवाः सिद्धा मुनीश्वाश्च नित्यं तिष्टन्ति सत्तमाः //
text_mt: Where a person devoted to devotion to Hari is present, there Brahmā, Hari, and Śiva, / gods, siddhas, and great sages always remain, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
harirāste mahābhāga hṛdaye śāntacetasām /
harināmaparāṇāṃ ca kimu dhyānaratātmanām //
meaning:
हरिरास्ते महाभाग हृदये शान्तचेतसाम् /
हरिनामपराणां च किमु ध्यानरतात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Hari abides, O fortunate one, in the hearts of those whose minds are tranquil / and who are devoted to Hari's name; what to say of those whose souls are absorbed in meditation?

sanskrit_iast:
śivapūjārato vāpi viṣṇupūjāparo 'pi vā /
yatra tiṣṭati tatraiva lakṣmīḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ //
meaning:
शिवपूजारतो वापि विष्णुपूजापरो ऽपि वा /
यत्र तिष्टति तत्रैव लक्ष्मीः सर्वाश्च देवताः //
text_mt: Wherever one devoted to the worship of Śiva, or devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu, / abides, right there dwell Lakṣmī and all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra pūjāparo viṣṇorvahnistatra na bādhate /
rājā vā taskaro vāpi vyādhayaśca na santi hi //
meaning:
यत्र पूजापरो विष्णोर्वह्निस्तत्र न बाधते /
राजा वा तस्करो वापि व्याधयश्च न सन्ति हि //
text_mt: Where one is devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu, fire does not harm; / neither king nor thief, nor indeed diseases, exist there.

sanskrit_iast:
pretāḥ piśācāḥ kūṣmāṇḍagrahā bālagrahāstathā /
ḍākinyo rākṣasāścaiva na bādhante 'cyutārcakam //
meaning:
प्रेताः पिशाचाः कूष्माण्डग्रहा बालग्रहास्तथा /
डाकिन्यो राक्षसाश्चैव न बाधन्ते ऽच्युतार्चकम् //
text_mt: Pretas, piśācas, kūṣmāṇḍa spirits, infant-seizing spirits, / ḍākinīs, and rākṣasas do not afflict a worshipper of Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
parapīḍāratā ye tu bhūtavetālakādayaḥ /
naśyanti yatra sadbhakto harilakṣmyarcane rataḥ //
meaning:
परपीडारता ये तु भूतवेतालकादयः /
नश्यन्ति यत्र सद्भक्तो हरिलक्ष्म्यर्चने रतः //
text_mt: Those bhūtas, vetālas, and others who take pleasure in tormenting others / perish where a true devotee is absorbed in worshipping Hari and Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
ṭa
jitendriyaḥ sarvahito dharmakarmaparāyaṇaḥ /
yatra tiṣṭati tatraiva sarvatīrthāni devatāḥ //
meaning:
ट
जितेन्द्रियः सर्वहितो धर्मकर्मपरायणः /
यत्र तिष्टति तत्रैव सर्वतीर्थानि देवताः //
text_mt:
[...]
Wherever one who has conquered his senses, seeks the welfare of all, and is devoted to righteous action stays, / right there are all the sacred fords and deities.

sanskrit_iast:
nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārddhaṃ vā yatra tiṣṭanti yoginaḥ /
tatraiva sarvaśreyāṃsi tattīrthaṃ tattapovanam //
meaning:
निमिषं निमिषार्द्धं वा यत्र तिष्टन्ति योगिनः /
तत्रैव सर्वश्रेयांसि तत्तीर्थं तत्तपोवनम् //
text_mt: Where yogins stay for a twinkling of an eye or for half a twinkling, / right there are all blessings; that is a sacred ford, that is a forest of penance.

sanskrit_iast:
yannāmoccāraṇādeva sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ /
stotrairvāpyarhaṇābhirvā kimu dhyānena kathyate //
meaning:
यन्नामोच्चारणादेव सर्वे नश्यन्त्युपद्रवाः /
स्तोत्रैर्वाप्यर्हणाभिर्वा किमु ध्यानेन कथ्यते //
text_mt: When merely by uttering his name all afflictions are destroyed, / what can be said [of the power] through hymns, through offerings, or through meditation?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tenāgninā vipra dagdhaṃ sāsurakānanam /
sāditirnaiva dagdhābhūdviṣṇucakrābhira kṣitā //
meaning:
एवं तेनाग्निना विप्र दग्धं सासुरकाननम् /
सादितिर्नैव दग्धाभूद्विष्णुचक्राभिर क्षिता //
text_mt: Thus by that fire, O brahmin, the forest together with the asuras was burned; / but that Aditi was not burned at all, being protected by Viṣṇu's discus.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasannavadanaḥ pahmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ /
prādurāsītsamīpe 'syāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नवदनः पह्मपत्रायतेक्षणः /
प्रादुरासीत्समीपे ऽस्याः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः //
text_mt: Then, with a gracious countenance and eyes long as lotus petals, / bearing the conch, discus, and mace, he manifested near her.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣadvāsyasphuraddantaprabhābhāṣitadiṅmukhaḥ /
spṛśankareṇa puṇyena prāha kaśyapavallabhām //
meaning:
ईषद्वास्यस्फुरद्दन्तप्रभाभाषितदिङ्मुखः /
स्पृशन्करेण पुण्येन प्राह कश्यपवल्लभाम् //
text_mt: Illuminating the directions with the brilliance of teeth flashing in a gentle smile, / touching the beloved of Kaśyapa with his auspicious hand, he spoke:'

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānanuvāca
devamātaḥ prasanno 'smi tapasārādhitastvayā /
ciraṃ śrāntāsi bhadraṃ te bhaviśaṣyati na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीभगवाननुवाच
देवमातः प्रसन्नो ऽस्मि तपसाराधितस्त्वया /
चिरं श्रान्तासि भद्रं ते भविशष्यति न संशयः //
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / 'O mother of the gods, I am pleased; I have been propitiated by you through austerity. / You have been fatigued for a long time; good fortune will come to you, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya dāsyāmi yatte manasi rocate /
mā bhairbhadre mahābhāge dhruvaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
वरं वरय दास्यामि यत्ते मनसि रोचते /
मा भैर्भद्रे महाभागे ध्रुवं श्रेयो भविष्यति //
text_mt: Choose a boon; I shall give whatever pleases your mind. / Do not fear, O auspicious, highly fortunate lady; welfare will surely be yours.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktādevamātā sā devadevena cakriṇā /
tuṣṭāva praṇipatyainaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham //
meaning:
इत्युक्तादेवमाता सा देवदेवेन चक्रिणा /
तुष्टाव प्रणिपत्यैनं सर्वलोकसुखावहम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the discus-bearing God of gods, that mother of the gods / bowed down and praised him who brings happiness to all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
aditiruvāca
namaste devadeveśa sarvavyāpiñjanārdanā /
sattvādiguṇabhedena lokavyāpārakāraṇa //
meaning:
अदितिरुवाच
नमस्ते देवदेवेश सर्वव्यापिञ्जनार्दना /
सत्त्वादिगुणभेदेन लोकव्यापारकारण //
text_mt: Aditi said: / 'Salutations to you, O Lord of the gods of gods, O Janārdana who pervades all, / O cause of the activity of the worlds through the distinctions of qualities like sattva!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste bahuparupāyārupāya ca mahātmane /
sarvaikaruparupāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane //
meaning:
नमस्ते बहुपरुपायारुपाय च महात्मने /
सर्वैकरुपरुपाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने //
text_mt: Salutations to you, the great-souled one who has many forms and no form, / whose form is the single form of all, who is devoid of qualities and the self of all qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste lokanāthāya paramajñānarupiṇe /
sadbhaktajanavātsalyaśāline maṅgalātmane //
meaning:
नमस्ते लोकनाथाय परमज्ञानरुपिणे /
सद्भक्तजनवात्सल्यशालिने मङ्गलात्मने //
text_mt: Salutations to you, the lord of the worlds, whose form is supreme knowledge, / who possesses tender affection for sincere devotees, whose nature is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāvatārarupāṇi hyarcayanti munīśvarāḥ /
tamādipuruṣaṃ devaṃ namāmi hyarthasiddhaye //
meaning:
यस्यावताररुपाणि ह्यर्चयन्ति मुनीश्वराः /
तमादिपुरुषं देवं नमामि ह्यर्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: To that primordial person, the god whose forms of descent the best of sages worship, / I indeed bow down for the attainment of my aim.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutayo yaṃ na jānanti na jānanti ca sūrayaḥ /
taṃ namāmi jagaddhetuṃ samāyaṃ cāpyamāyinam //
meaning:
श्रुतयो यं न जानन्ति न जानन्ति च सूरयः /
तं नमामि जगद्धेतुं समायं चाप्यमायिनम् //
text_mt: Him whom the scriptures do not know, and whom the wise do not know, / that cause of the universe, who possesses māyā and is yet free from māyā, I revere.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāvalokanaṃ citraṃ māyopadravakāraṇam /
jagadrūpaṃ jagaddhetuṃ taṃ vandeṃ sarvavanditam //
meaning:
यस्यावलोकनं चित्रं मायोपद्रवकारणम् /
जगद्रूपं जगद्धेतुं तं वन्दें सर्ववन्दितम् //
text_mt: Him whose wondrous vision removes the afflictions of māyā, / whose form is the universe, who is the cause of the universe, worshipped by all, I praise.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpādāmbujakiñjalkasevārakṣitamastakāḥ /
avāpuḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ taṃ vande kamalādhavam //
meaning:
यत्पादाम्बुजकिञ्जल्कसेवारक्षितमस्तकाः /
अवापुः परमां सिद्धिं तं वन्दे कमलाधवम् //
text_mt: I praise the husband of Kamalā, whose lotus-like filaments of his feet, when protected on their heads through service, / enabled men to attain supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya brahmādayo devā mahimānaṃ na vai viduḥ /
atyāsannaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ taṃ vande bhaktasaṃginam //
meaning:
यस्य ब्रह्मादयो देवा महिमानं न वै विदुः /
अत्यासन्नं च भक्तानां तं वन्दे भक्तसंगिनम् //
text_mt: Whose greatness Brahmā and the other gods do not truly know, / yet who is very near to his devotees—him who unites with his devotees I praise.

sanskrit_iast:
yo devastyaktasaṅgānāṃ śāntānaṃ karuṇārṇavaḥ /
karoti hyātmanaḥ saṅgaṃ taṃ devaṃ saṅgavarjitam //
meaning:
यो देवस्त्यक्तसङ्गानां शान्तानं करुणार्णवः /
करोति ह्यात्मनः सङ्गं तं देवं सङ्गवर्जितम् //
text_mt: That God who is an ocean of compassion, who makes fellowship with the tranquil / who have renounced attachment, although he himself is devoid of attachment;

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeśvaraṃ yajñakarmasu niṣṭitam /
namāmi yajñaphaladaṃ yajñakarmaprabodhakam //
meaning:
यज्ञेश्वरं यज्ञकर्मसु निष्टितम् /
नमामि यज्ञफलदं यज्ञकर्मप्रबोधकम् //
text_mt: I bow down to the Lord of sacrifice, firmly situated in sacrificial rites, / the giver of the fruit of sacrifice, the revealer of sacrificial acts.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāmilo 'pi pāpātmā yannāmoccāraṇādanu /
prātpavānparamaṃ dhāma taṃ vande lokasākṣiṇam //
meaning:
अजामिलो ऽपि पापात्मा यन्नामोच्चारणादनु /
प्रात्पवान्परमं धाम तं वन्दे लोकसाक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Even the sinful Ajāmila attained the supreme abode / immediately upon uttering whose name—to him, the witness of the universe, I offer praise.'

sanskrit_iast:
harirupī mahādevaḥ śivarupī janārdanaḥ /
iti lokasya netā yastaṃ namāmi jagadgurum //
meaning:
हरिरुपी महादेवः शिवरुपी जनार्दनः /
इति लोकस्य नेता यस्तं नमामि जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: Mahādeva has the form of Hari, and Janārdana has the form of Śiva. / To him who thus leads the world, to the teacher of the world, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyā api deveśā yanmāyāpāśayantritāḥ /
na jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ taṃ vande sarvanāyakam //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्या अपि देवेशा यन्मायापाशयन्त्रिताः /
न जानन्ति परं भावं तं वन्दे सर्वनायकम् //
text_mt: Bound by the snare of whose māyā even the lords of gods headed by Brahmā / do not know his supreme nature, to that leader of all I offer praise.

sanskrit_iast:
hyatpahmastho 'piñyogyānāṃ dūrastha iva bhāsate /
pramāṇātītasadbhāvastaṃ vande jñānasākṣiṇam //
meaning:
ह्यत्पह्मस्थो ऽपिञ्योग्यानां दूरस्थ इव भासते /
प्रमाणातीतसद्भावस्तं वन्दे ज्ञानसाक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Though residing in the heart-lotus of yogins, he appears as if far away; / his true nature transcends all means of knowledge. To that witness of knowledge I offer praise.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmukhaḥ drvāhyaṇo jāto bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyo 'jani /
ūrvorvaiśyaḥ samutpannaḥ padyāṃ śūdro 'bhyajāyata //
meaning:
यन्मुखः द्र्वाह्यणो जातो बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियो ऽजनि /
ऊर्वोर्वैश्यः समुत्पन्नः पद्यां शूद्रो ऽभ्यजायत //
text_mt: From whose mouth the brāhmaṇa was born, and from whose arms the kṣatriya was born, / from whose thighs the vaiśya arose, and from whose feet the śūdra was born;

sanskrit_iast:
manasaścandramā jāto jātaḥ sūryaśca cakṣuṣaḥ /
mukhādagnistarthendraśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata //
meaning:
मनसश्चन्द्रमा जातो जातः सूर्यश्च चक्षुषः /
मुखादग्निस्तर्थेन्द्रश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत //
text_mt: from whose mind the moon was born, and from whose eye the sun was born, / from whose mouth fire and Indra arose, and from whose breath the wind was born;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgyajuḥsāmarupāya satyasvaragatātmane /
ṣaḍaṅgarupiṇe tubhyaṃ bhūyobhūyo namo namaḥ //
meaning:
ऋग्यजुःसामरुपाय सत्यस्वरगतात्मने /
षडङ्गरुपिणे तुभ्यं भूयोभूयो नमो नमः //
text_mt: to you whose form is the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, whose self is the truth of notes and musical tones, / whose form consists of the six limbs [of the Veda], repeatedly reverence, reverence!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamindraḥ pavanaḥ somastvamīśānastvamantakaḥ /
tvamagnirnirṛtiścaiva varuṇastvaṃ divākaraḥ //
meaning:
त्वमिन्द्रः पवनः सोमस्त्वमीशानस्त्वमन्तकः /
त्वमग्निर्निरृतिश्चैव वरुणस्त्वं दिवाकरः //
text_mt: You are Indra, the wind, the moon; you are Īśāna, you are the Ender; / you are fire, and Nirṛti, and Varuṇa; you are the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca sthāvarāścaiva piśācāścaiva rākṣasāḥ /
girayaḥ siddhagandharvānadyo bhūmiśca sāgarāḥ //
meaning:
देवाश्च स्थावराश्चैव पिशाचाश्चैव राक्षसाः /
गिरयः सिद्धगन्धर्वानद्यो भूमिश्च सागराः //
text_mt: The gods and immobile beings, the piśācas and rākṣasas, / the mountains, siddhas, gandharvas, rivers, the earth, and the oceans—

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva jagatāmīśo yatrāsi tvaṃ parātparaḥ /
tvadrūpamakhilaṃ deva tasmānnityaṃ namo 'stu te //
meaning:
त्वमेव जगतामीशो यत्रासि त्वं परात्परः /
त्वद्रूपमखिलं देव तस्मान्नित्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: you alone are the Lord of the worlds, for you are higher than the highest. / Everything is your form, O God! Therefore, reverence be to you always!

sanskrit_iast:
anāthānātha sarvajña bhūtadevendravigraha /
daiteyairbādhitānputrānmama pāhi janārdana //
meaning:
अनाथानाथ सर्वज्ञ भूतदेवेन्द्रविग्रह /
दैतेयैर्बाधितान्पुत्रान्मम पाहि जनार्दन //
text_mt: O protector of the helpless, O omniscient one, whose body is the gods and lord of beings, / protect my sons, who are afflicted by the sons of Diti, O Janārdana!

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutvā devamātā devaṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ /
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā harṣāśrukṣālitastanī //
meaning:
इति स्तुत्वा देवमाता देवं नत्वा पुनः पुनः /
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा हर्षाश्रुक्षालितस्तनी //
text_mt: Having thus praised the God and bowed to him again and again, / the mother of the gods, her breasts washed with tears of joy, folded her hands and spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
anugrāhyāsmi deveṃśa tvayā sarvādikāraṇa /
akaṇṭakāṃ śriyāṃ dehi matsutānāṃ divaukasām //
meaning:
अनुग्राह्यास्मि देवेंश त्वया सर्वादिकारण /
अकण्टकां श्रियां देहि मत्सुतानां दिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: "I ought to be favored by you, O Lord of the gods, O original cause of all! / Grant thornless sovereignty to my sons, the gods residing in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
antaryyāmiñjagadrūpa sarvajñā parameśvara /
ajñātaṃ kiṃ tava śrīśa kiṃ māmīhayasi prabho //
meaning:
अन्तर्य्यामिञ्जगद्रूप सर्वज्ञा परमेश्वर /
अज्ञातं किं तव श्रीश किं मामीहयसि प्रभो //
text_mt: O inner ruler, O you whose form is the universe, O omniscient one, O Supreme Lord! / What is unknown to you, O Lord of Śrī? Why do you test me, O Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi tava vakṣyāmi yanme manasi rocate /
vṛthāputrāsmi deveśa daiteyaiḥ paripīḍitā //
meaning:
तथापि तव वक्ष्यामि यन्मे मनसि रोचते /
वृथापुत्रास्मि देवेश दैतेयैः परिपीडिता //
text_mt: Nevertheless, I will tell you what pleases my heart: / I am [as if] childless in vain, O Lord of gods, being thoroughly tormented by the daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
tānna hiṃsitumicchāmi yataste 'pi sutā mama /
tānahatvā śriyaṃ dehi matsutebhyaḥ sureśvara //
meaning:
तान्न हिंसितुमिच्छामि यतस्ते ऽपि सुता मम /
तानहत्वा श्रियं देहि मत्सुतेभ्यः सुरेश्वर //
text_mt: I do not wish to harm them, because they too are my sons. / Without killing them, grant prosperity to my sons, O Lord of gods!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto devedeveśaḥ punaḥ prītimupāgataḥ /
uvāca harṣayanvipra devamātaramādarāt //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो देवेदेवेशः पुनः प्रीतिमुपागतः /
उवाच हर्षयन्विप्र देवमातरमादरात् //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the Lord of the gods of gods was once more pleased. / Delighting her, O brāhmaṇa, he respectfully spoke to the mother of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
prīto 'smi devi bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyāmi suto hyaham /
yataḥ sapantiputreṣu vātsalyaṃ devi durlabham //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
प्रीतो ऽस्मि देवि भद्रं ते भविष्यामि सुतो ह्यहम् /
यतः सपन्तिपुत्रेषु वात्सल्यं देवि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / "I am pleased, O goddess; may all be well with you! Indeed, I will become your son, / for maternal love toward the sons of a co-wife is rare, O goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā tu yatkṛtaṃ stotraṃ tatpaṭhānti narāstu ye /
teṣāṃ saṃpadvarā putrā na hīyante kadācana //
meaning:
त्वया तु यत्कृतं स्तोत्रं तत्पठान्ति नरास्तु ये /
तेषां संपद्वरा पुत्रा न हीयन्ते कदाचन //
text_mt: And whatever hymn was recited by you, those men who read it— / their excellent sons and prosperity will never decline.

sanskrit_iast:
tvātmaje vānyaputre vā yaḥ samatvena vartate /
na tasya putraśokaḥ syādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
त्वात्मजे वान्यपुत्रे वा यः समत्वेन वर्तते /
न तस्य पुत्रशोकः स्यादेष धर्मः सनातनः //
text_mt: Whoever conducts himself with impartiality toward his own son or another’s son, / for him there is no grief on account of sons; this is the eternal dharma."

sanskrit_iast:
aditiruvāca
tāha voḍhuṃ kṣamā deva tvāmādyapuruṣaṃ param /
asaṃkhyātāṇḍaromāṇaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāraṇam //
meaning:
अदितिरुवाच
ताह वोढुं क्षमा देव त्वामाद्यपुरुषं परम् /
असंख्याताण्डरोमाणं सर्वेशं सर्वकारणम् //
text_mt: Aditi said: / "How am I able to bear you, O God, the supreme primordial person, / whose body-hairs contain countless cosmic eggs, the Lord of all, the cause of all?

sanskrit_iast:
yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti śrutayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ /
tamahaṃ devadeveśaṃ dhārayāma kithaṃ prabho //
meaning:
यत्प्रभावं न जानन्ति श्रुतयः सर्वदेवताः /
तमहं देवदेवेशं धारयाम किथं प्रभो //
text_mt: Whose majesty the Vedas and all the deities do not know— / how, O Lord, can I bear that God of the gods of gods?

sanskrit_iast:
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamajaṃ parātparataraṃ prabhum /
dhārayāmi kathaṃ deva tvāmahaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
अणोरणीयांसमजं परात्परतरं प्रभुम् /
धारयामि कथं देव त्वामहं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Smaller than the smallest, unborn, the Lord higher than the highest— / how, O God, can I bear you, the Supreme Person?

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyātakayukto 'pi yannāmasmṛtimātrataḥ /
mucyate sa kathaṃ devogrāmyeṣu janimarhati //
meaning:
महायातकयुक्तो ऽपि यन्नामस्मृतिमात्रतः /
मुच्यते स कथं देवोग्राम्येषु जनिमर्हति //
text_mt: Even one bound by great sins is liberated / by mere remembrance of your name; how could that God deserve birth among mortals?

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śūkaramatsyādyā avatārāstava prabho /
tathāyamapi ko veda tava viśveśa ceṣṭitam //
meaning:
यथा शूकरमत्स्याद्या अवतारास्तव प्रभो /
तथायमपि को वेद तव विश्वेश चेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Just as the boar, the fish, and others were your incarnations, O Lord, / so too is this one; who can know your deeds, O Lord of the universe?

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādapahmapraṇatātvannāmasmṛtitatparā /
tvāmeva cintaye deva yathecchāsi tathā kuru //
meaning:
त्वत्पादपह्मप्रणतात्वन्नामस्मृतितत्परा /
त्वामेव चिन्तये देव यथेच्छासि तथा कुरु //
text_mt: Bowed at your lotus feet, devoted to remembering your name, / I meditate on you alone, O God. Do as you wish!"

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
tayoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo janārdanaḥ /
dattvābhayaṃ devamāturidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
तयोक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो जनार्दनः /
दत्त्वाभयं देवमातुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Hearing the words spoken by her, the God of gods, Janārdana, / having granted fearlessness to the mother of the gods, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
satyamuktaṃ mahābhāge tvayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ /
tathāpi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ śubhe //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सत्यमुक्तं महाभागे त्वया नास्त्यत्र संशयः /
तथापि शृणु वक्ष्यामि गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं शुभे //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / "You have spoken the truth, O highly fortunate one; there is no doubt about this. / Nevertheless, hear; I shall tell you that which is more secret than the secret, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgadveṣavihīnā ye madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ /
vaṃhati satataṃ teṃ māṃ gatāsūyā adāmbhikāḥ //
meaning:
रागद्वेषविहीना ये मद्भक्ता मत्परायणाः /
वंहति सततं तें मां गतासूया अदाम्भिकाः //
text_mt: Those who are free from passion and hatred, devoted to me, intent upon me, / devoid of malice, and unpretentious—they continually bear me.

sanskrit_iast:
paropatāpavimukhāḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ /
matkathāśravaṇāsaktā vahanti satataṃ hi mām //
meaning:
परोपतापविमुखाः शिवभक्तिपरायणः /
मत्कथाश्रवणासक्ता वहन्ति सततं हि माम् //
text_mt: Those who turn away from afflicting others, devoted to the worship of Śiva, / attached to listening to stories of me—they indeed continually bear me.

sanskrit_iast:
pativratāḥ pariprāṇāḥ patibhaktiparāyaṇāḥ /
vahanti satataṃ devi striyo 'pi tyaktapratsarāḥ //
meaning:
पतिव्रताः परिप्राणाः पतिभक्तिपरायणाः /
वहन्ति सततं देवि स्त्रियो ऽपि त्यक्तप्रत्सराः //
text_mt: Chaste wives who hold their husbands as their life-breath, devoted to serving their husbands, / free from jealousy—even those women continually bear me, O goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣurgurubhakto 'tithipriyaḥ /
hitakṛdvāhyaṇānāṃ yaḥ sa māṃ vahati sarvadā //
meaning:
मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रूषुर्गुरुभक्तो ऽतिथिप्रियः /
हितकृद्वाह्यणानां यः स मां वहति सर्वदा //
text_mt: One who attends to his mother and father, is devoted to his guru, fond of guests, / and acts for the welfare of brāhmaṇas—he carries me at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyatīrtharatā nityaṃ satsaṅganiratāstathā /
lokānugrahaśīlāśca satataṃ te vahanti mām //
meaning:
पुण्यतीर्थरता नित्यं सत्सङ्गनिरतास्तथा /
लोकानुग्रहशीलाश्च सततं ते वहन्ति माम् //
text_mt: Those who are always delighted in sacred fords, devoted to the company of the good, / and inclined to show grace to the world—they continually bear me.

sanskrit_iast:
paropakāraviratāḥ paradravyaparāṅmukhāḥ /
naṣuṃsakāḥ parastrīṣu te vahanti ca māṃ sadā //
meaning:
परोपकारविरताः परद्रव्यपराङ्मुखाः /
नषुंसकाः परस्त्रीषु ते वहन्ति च मां सदा //
text_mt: Those who are engaged in helping others, turn away from other people's wealth, / and are eunuchs toward other men's wives—they bear me always.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasyupāsanaratāḥ sadā nāmaparāyaṇāḥ /
gorakṣaṇaparā ye ca satataṃ māṃ vahanti te //
meaning:
तुलस्युपासनरताः सदा नामपरायणाः /
गोरक्षणपरा ये च सततं मां वहन्ति ते //
text_mt: Those who are devoted to the worship of tulasī, always intent on [repeating my] name, / and devoted to the protection of cattle—they continually bear me.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahanivṛttā ye parānnavimukhāstathā /
annodakapradātāro vahṝnti satataṃ hi mām //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहनिवृत्ता ये परान्नविमुखास्तथा /
अन्नोदकप्रदातारो वहॄन्ति सततं हि माम् //
text_mt: Those who abstain from accepting gifts, are averse to eating another’s food, / and are givers of food and water—they indeed continually bear me.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ tu devi patiprāṇā sādhvī bhūtahite ratā /
saṃprāpya putrabhāvaṃ te sādhayiṣye manoratham //
meaning:
त्वं तु देवि पतिप्राणा साध्वी भूतहिते रता /
संप्राप्य पुत्रभावं ते साधयिष्ये मनोरथम् //
text_mt: And you, O goddess, are devoted to your husband as life, virtuous, and dedicated to the welfare of beings. / Attaining the state of being your son, I will fulfill your desire."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā devedevaśo hyaditiṃ devamātaram /
dattvā kaṇṭhagatāṃ mālāmabhayaṃ ca tirodadhe //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा देवेदेवशो ह्यदितिं देवमातरम् /
दत्त्वा कण्ठगतां मालामभयं च तिरोदधे //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Aditi, the mother of the gods, / and having given her the garland from his neck and freedom from fear, the Lord of gods disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu saṃhṛṣṭamanasā devasīrdakṣanandinī /
praṇamya kamalākāntaṃ punaḥ svasthaānamāvrajat //
meaning:
सा तु संहृष्टमनसा देवसीर्दक्षनन्दिनी /
प्रणम्य कमलाकान्तं पुनः स्वस्थआनमाव्रजत् //
text_mt: With a delighted mind, that divine woman, the daughter of Dakṣa, / bowed down to the beloved of Kamalā and returned to her own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ditirmahābhāgā suprītā lokavanditā /
asūta samaye putraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam //
meaning:
ततो ऽदितिर्महाभागा सुप्रीता लोकवन्दिता /
असूत समये पुत्रं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: Then the highly fortunate Aditi, greatly pleased and praised by the worlds, / gave birth in due course to a son who was revered by all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅgacakradharaṃ śāntaṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagam /
sudhākalaśadadhyannakaraṃ vāmanasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
शङ्गचक्रधरं शान्तं चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगम् /
सुधाकलशदध्यन्नकरं वामनसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: bearing a conch and discus, peaceful, seated in the center of the lunar orb, / holding a pot of nectar and curd-rice in his hands, known by the name of Vāmana,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ vyākośakamalekṣaṇam /
sarvābharaṇaṃsaṃyuktaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ harim //
meaning:
सहस्रादित्यसंकाशं व्याकोशकमलेक्षणम् /
सर्वाभरणंसंयुक्तं पीताम्बरधरं हरिम् //
text_mt: resembling a thousand suns, with eyes like blooming lotuses, / adorned with all ornaments, wearing yellow garments—Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
stutyaṃ munigaṇairyuktaṃ sarvalokaikanāyakam /
āvirbhūtaṃ hariṃ jñātvā kaśyapo harṣavihvalaḥ /
praṇamya prañjalirbhūtva stotuṃ samupacakrame //
meaning:
स्तुत्यं मुनिगणैर्युक्तं सर्वलोकैकनायकम् /
आविर्भूतं हरिं ज्ञात्वा कश्यपो हर्षविह्वलः /
प्रणम्य प्रञ्जलिर्भूत्व स्तोतुं समुपचक्रमे //
