text_mt: Deserving of praise, attended by hosts of sages, the sole leader of all worlds— / knowing that Hari had appeared, Kaśyapa, overwhelmed with joy, / bowed down, and with folded hands began to praise him:

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapa uvāca
namonamaste 'khilakāraṇāya namonamaste 'khailapālakāya /
namonamaste 'maranāyakāya namonamo daiteyavināśanāya //
meaning:
कश्यप उवाच
नमोनमस्ते ऽखिलकारणाय नमोनमस्ते ऽखैलपालकाय /
नमोनमस्ते ऽमरनायकाय नमोनमो दैतेयविनाशनाय //
text_mt: Kaśyapa said: / "Reverence, reverence to you, the cause of all! Reverence, reverence to you, the protector of all! / Reverence, reverence to you, the leader of the immortals! Reverence, reverence to you, the destroyer of the daityas!

sanskrit_iast:
namonamo bhaktajanapriyāya namonamaḥ sajjanarañjitāya /
namonamo durjananāśanāya namo 'stu tasmai jagadīśvarāya //
meaning:
नमोनमो भक्तजनप्रियाय नमोनमः सज्जनरञ्जिताय /
नमोनमो दुर्जननाशनाय नमो ऽस्तु तस्मै जगदीश्वराय //
text_mt: Reverence, reverence to you who are dear to your devotees! Reverence, reverence to you who delight good people! / Reverence, reverence to the destroyer of the wicked! Reverence be to that Lord of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
namonamaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya nārāyaṇāyāmitavikramāya /
saśārṅgacakrāsigadādhārāya namo 'stu tasmai puruṣottamāya //
meaning:
नमोनमः कारणवामनाय नारायणायामितविक्रमाय /
सशार्ङ्गचक्रासिगदाधाराय नमो ऽस्तु तस्मै पुरुषोत्तमाय //
text_mt: Reverence, reverence to the primal Vāmana, to Nārāyaṇa of immeasurable prowess, / holding the Śārṅga bow, the discus, the sword, and the mace! Reverence be to that Supreme Person!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ payorāśinivāsanāya namo 'stu saddhṛtkamalasthitāya /
namo 'stu sūryādyamitaprabhāya namonamaḥ puṇyakathāgatāya //
meaning:
नमः पयोराशिनिवासनाय नमो ऽस्तु सद्धृत्कमलस्थिताय /
नमो ऽस्तु सूर्याद्यमितप्रभाय नमोनमः पुण्यकथागताय //
text_mt: Reverence to him who dwells in the ocean of milk! Reverence be to him who resides in the lotus heart of the virtuous! / Reverence be to him whose limitless splendor begins with the sun! Reverence, reverence to him who is attained through sacred narratives!"

sanskrit_iast:
namonamor'kenduvilocanāya namo 'stu te yajñaphalapradāya /
namo 'stu yajñāṅgavirājitāya namo 'stu te sajjanavallabhāya //
meaning:
नमोनमोर्ऽकेन्दुविलोचनाय नमो ऽस्तु ते यज्ञफलप्रदाय /
नमो ऽस्तु यज्ञाङ्गविराजिताय नमो ऽस्तु ते सज्जनवल्लभाय //
text_mt: Obeisance, obeisance to you whose eyes are the sun and the moon! Obeisance to you who bestow the fruits of sacrifice! / Obeisance to you who are adorned with the limbs of sacrifice! Obeisance to you who are dear to good people!

sanskrit_iast:
namo jagatkāraṇakāraṇāya namo 'stu śabdādivivarjitāya /
namo 'stu te divyasukhapradāya namo namo bhaktamanogatāya //
meaning:
नमो जगत्कारणकारणाय नमो ऽस्तु शब्दादिविवर्जिताय /
नमो ऽस्तु ते दिव्यसुखप्रदाय नमो नमो भक्तमनोगताय //
text_mt: Obeisance to the cause of the cause of the universe! Obeisance to you who are devoid of sound and [the other sense objects]! / Obeisance to you who bestow divine bliss! Obeisance, obeisance to you who abide in the minds of your devotees!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te dhvāntavināśakāya namo 'stu śabdādivivarjitāya /
namo 'stu te dhvāntavināśakāya mandaradhārakāya /
namo 'stu te yajñavarāhanāmne namo hiraṇyākṣavidārakāya //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते ध्वान्तविनाशकाय नमो ऽस्तु शब्दादिविवर्जिताय /
नमो ऽस्तु ते ध्वान्तविनाशकाय मन्दरधारकाय /
नमो ऽस्तु ते यज्ञवराहनाम्ने नमो हिरण्याक्षविदारकाय //
text_mt: Obeisance to you, destroyer of darkness! Obeisance to you who are devoid of sound and [the other sense objects]! / Obeisance to you, destroyer of darkness, bearer of Mandara! / Obeisance to you named the Sacrificial Boar! Obeisance to the tearer of Hiraṇyākṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te vāmanarupabhāje namo 'stu te kṣatrakulāntakāya /
namo 'stu te rāvaṇamardanāya namo 'stu te nandasutāgrajāya //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते वामनरुपभाजे नमो ऽस्तु ते क्षत्रकुलान्तकाय /
नमो ऽस्तु ते रावणमर्दनाय नमो ऽस्तु ते नन्दसुताग्रजाय //
text_mt: Obeisance to you who assume the form of Vāmana! Obeisance to you who put an end to the kṣatriya race! / Obeisance to you, crusher of Rāvaṇa! Obeisance to you, elder brother of Nanda's son!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste kamalākānta namaste sukhadāyine /
smṛtārtināśine tubhyaṃ bhūyo bhūyo namonamaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते कमलाकान्त नमस्ते सुखदायिने /
स्मृतार्तिनाशिने तुभ्यं भूयो भूयो नमोनमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to you, beloved of Kamalā! Obeisance to you who give happiness! / To you who destroy distress when remembered, again and again obeisance, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñeśa yajñavinyāsa yajñavinghavināśana /
yajñarupa yajadrūpa yajñāṅgaṃ tvāṃ yajāmyaham //
iti stutaḥ sa deveśo vāmano lokapāvanaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञेश यज्ञविन्यास यज्ञविन्घविनाशन /
यज्ञरुप यजद्रूप यज्ञाङ्गं त्वां यजाम्यहम् //
इति स्तुतः स देवेशो वामनो लोकपावनः //
text_mt:
O Lord of sacrifice, O arrangement of sacrifice, O destroyer of obstacles to sacrifice, / O embodiment of sacrifice, O form of the sacrificer, you who are the limb of sacrifice, I sacrifice to you!

Thus praised, the Lord of gods, Vāmana, purifier of the world,

sanskrit_iast: uvāca prahasanharṣaṃ vardhdayankaśyapasya saḥ //
meaning: उवाच प्रहसन्हर्षं वर्ध्दयन्कश्यपस्य सः //
text_mt: smiled and spoke, increasing the joy of Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
tāta tuṣṭo 'smi bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati surārcitā /
acirātsādhayiṣyāmi nikhilaṃ tvanmanoratham //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
तात तुष्टो ऽस्मि भद्रं ते भविष्यति सुरार्चिता /
अचिरात्साधयिष्यामि निखिलं त्वन्मनोरथम् //
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
“Father, I am pleased; auspiciousness shall be yours, who are venerated by the gods. / Before long I will fulfill your entire desire.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ janmadvaye tvevaṃ yuvayoḥ putraghatāṃ gataḥ /
asmiñjanmanyapi tathā sādayāmyuttamaṃ sukham //
meaning:
अहं जन्मद्वये त्वेवं युवयोः पुत्रघतां गतः /
अस्मिञ्जन्मन्यपि तथा सादयाम्युत्तमं सुखम् //
text_mt: In two births, indeed, I thus attained the state of being a son to you both; / in this birth as well, I shall likewise bring about supreme happiness.”

sanskrit_iast:
atrāntare balirdaityo dīrghasatraṃ mahāmakham /
ārebhe guruṇā yuktaḥ kāvyena ca munīśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
अत्रान्तरे बलिर्दैत्यो दीर्घसत्रं महामखम् /
आरेभे गुरुणा युक्तः काव्येन च मुनीश्वरैः //
text_mt: Meanwhile, the Daitya Bali, accompanied by his preceptor Kāvya and the lords of sages, / commenced a great sacrifice, a long sattra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminmakhe samāhūto viṣṇurlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ /
haviḥ svīkaraṇārthāya ṛṣibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्मखे समाहूतो विष्णुर्लक्ष्मीसमन्वितः /
हविः स्वीकरणार्थाय ऋषिभिर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: To that sacrifice, Viṣṇu, accompanied by Lakṣmī, / was invited by the ṛṣis, the expounders of Brahman, to receive the oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛddhaiśvaryardaityasya varttamāne mahākratau /
āmantrya mātāpitarau sa baṭurvāmano yayau //
meaning:
प्रवृद्धैश्वर्यर्दैत्यस्य वर्त्तमाने महाक्रतौ /
आमन्त्र्य मातापितरौ स बटुर्वामनो ययौ //
text_mt: While the Daitya's great sacrifice was underway with enhanced majesty, / that boy Vāmana, taking leave of his parents, went forth.

sanskrit_iast:
smitena mohayaṃllokaṃ vāmano bhaktavatsalaḥ /
havirbhoktumivāyāto baleḥ pratyakṣato hariḥ //
meaning:
स्मितेन मोहयंल्लोकं वामनो भक्तवत्सलः /
हविर्भोक्तुमिवायातो बलेः प्रत्यक्षतो हरिः //
text_mt: Charming the world with a smile, Vāmana, who is affectionate to devotees, / Hari came visibly before Bali, as if to enjoy the oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
durvṛtto vā suvṛtto vā jaḍo vāyaṃ hito 'pi vā /
yo bhaktiyuktastasyāntaḥ sadā saṃnihito hariḥ //
meaning:
दुर्वृत्तो वा सुवृत्तो वा जडो वायं हितो ऽपि वा /
यो भक्तियुक्तस्तस्यान्तः सदा संनिहितो हरिः //
text_mt: Whether ill-behaved or well-behaved, whether stupid or beneficial, / Hari is always present within whoever is endowed with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāntaṃ vāmanaṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayo jñānacakṣauṣaḥ /
jñātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamudyayuḥ sabhyasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
आयान्तं वामनं दृष्ट्वा ऋषयो ज्ञानचक्षौषः /
ज्ञात्वा नारायणं देवमुद्ययुः सभ्यसंयुताः //
text_mt: Seeing Vāmana coming, the sages, possessing the eye of wisdom, / recognized Lord Nārāyaṇa and rose together with the members of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
etajjñātvā daityagururekānte balimabravīt /
svasāramavicāryaiva khalāḥ kāryāṇi kurvate //
meaning:
एतज्ज्ञात्वा दैत्यगुरुरेकान्ते बलिमब्रवीत् /
स्वसारमविचार्यैव खलाः कार्याणि कुर्वते //
text_mt: Understanding this, the preceptor of the Daityas said to Bali in private: / “Without examining their own capacity, wicked men carry out actions.”

sanskrit_iast:
śukra uvāca
bho bho daityapate saumya hyapahartā tava śriyam /
viṣṇurvāmanarupeṇa hyaditeḥ putrātāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
शुक्र उवाच
भो भो दैत्यपते सौम्य ह्यपहर्ता तव श्रियम् /
विष्णुर्वामनरुपेण ह्यदितेः पुत्रातां गतः //
text_mt:
Śukra said:
“O lord of the Daityas, gentle one! Indeed, the stealer of your fortune, / Viṣṇu, has become the son of Aditi in the form of Vāmana.

sanskrit_iast:
tavādhvaraṃ sa āyāti tvayā tasyāsureśvara /
na kiñcidapi dātavyaṃ manmataṃ śṛṇu paṇḍita //
meaning:
तवाध्वरं स आयाति त्वया तस्यासुरेश्वर /
न किञ्चिदपि दातव्यं मन्मतं शृणु पण्डित //
text_mt: He is coming to your sacrifice; by you, O lord of Asuras, / nothing at all should be given to him. Listen to my advice, O wise one!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmabuddhiḥ sukhakarī gurubuddhirviśeṣataḥ /
parabuddhirvināśāya strībudhdiḥ pralayaṅkarī //
meaning:
आत्मबुद्धिः सुखकरी गुरुबुद्धिर्विशेषतः /
परबुद्धिर्विनाशाय स्त्रीबुध्दिः प्रलयङ्करी //
text_mt: One's own intellect brings happiness; the preceptor's intellect especially so; / another's intellect leads to destruction; a woman's intellect brings total ruin.

sanskrit_iast: śatrūṇāṃ hitakṛtadyastu sa hantavyo viśeṣataḥ //
meaning: शत्रूणां हितकृतद्यस्तु स हन्तव्यो विशेषतः //
text_mt: Whoever brings about the welfare of one's enemies is especially to be slain.”

sanskrit_iast:
baliruvāca
evaṃ guro na vaktavyaṃ dharmamārgavirodhataḥ /
yadādatte svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ kimasmādadhikaṃ varam //
meaning:
बलिरुवाच
एवं गुरो न वक्तव्यं धर्ममार्गविरोधतः /
यदादत्ते स्वयं विष्णुः किमस्मादधिकं वरम् //
text_mt:
Bali said:
“O preceptor, you should not speak thus, since it is contrary to the path of dharma. / When Viṣṇu himself accepts, what boon could be greater than this?

sanskrit_iast:
kurvanti viduṣo yajñānviṣṇuprīṇanakāraṇāt /
sa cetsākṣāddhavirbhogī mattaḥ ko 'bhyadhiko bhuvī //
meaning:
कुर्वन्ति विदुषो यज्ञान्विष्णुप्रीणनकारणात् /
स चेत्साक्षाद्धविर्भोगी मत्तः को ऽभ्यधिको भुवी //
text_mt: The wise perform sacrifices for the purpose of pleasing Viṣṇu; / if he himself enjoys the oblation directly, who on earth is more fortunate than I?

sanskrit_iast:
daridreṇāpi yatkiñciddīyate viṣṇave guro /
tadeva paramaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam //
meaning:
दरिद्रेणापि यत्किञ्चिद्दीयते विष्णवे गुरो /
तदेव परमं दानं दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: Even by a poor man, whatever little is given to Viṣṇu, O preceptor, / that very thing becomes the supreme gift, and what is given becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛto 'pi parayā bhaktyā punāti puruṣottamaḥ /
yena kenāpyarcitaśveddadāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
स्मृतो ऽपि परया भक्त्या पुनाति पुरुषोत्तमः /
येन केनाप्यर्चितश्वेद्ददाति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Even when remembered with supreme devotion, the Supreme Person purifies; / if worshipped in any manner whatsoever, he grants the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
harirharati pāpāniduṣṭacittairapi smṛtaḥ /
anicchayāpi saṃspṛṣṭo dahatyeva hi pāvakaḥ //
meaning:
हरिर्हरति पापानिदुष्टचित्तैरपि स्मृतः /
अनिच्छयापि संस्पृष्टो दहत्येव हि पावकः //
text_mt: Hari takes away sins even when remembered by those of corrupt mind; / fire indeed burns even when touched unwillingly.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvāgre vasate yasya hari rityakṣaradvayam /
sa viṣṇulokamānpoti punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
जिह्वाग्रे वसते यस्य हरि रित्यक्षरद्वयम् /
स विष्णुलोकमान्पोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Upon the tip of whose tongue rests the two syllables ‘Ha-ri’, / he attains the world of Viṣṇu, from which return is hard to obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
govindeti sadā dhyāyedyastu rāgādivarjitaḥ /
sa yāti viṣṇubhavanamiti prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
गोविन्देति सदा ध्यायेद्यस्तु रागादिवर्जितः /
स याति विष्णुभवनमिति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः //
text_mt: Whoever, free from passion and [other vices], constantly meditates, saying ‘Govinda’, / goes to the abode of Viṣṇu: thus have the wise declared.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau vā brahmaṇe vāpihūyate yadvavirguro /
haribhaktyā mahābhāga tena viṣṇuḥ prasīdati //
meaning:
अग्नौ वा ब्रह्मणे वापिहूयते यद्वविर्गुरो /
हरिभक्त्या महाभाग तेन विष्णुः प्रसीदति //
text_mt: Whatever oblation is offered into the fire or to a brāhmaṇa, O preceptor, / with devotion to Hari, O fortunate one, by that Viṣṇu is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu harituṣyyarthaṃ karomyadhvaramuttamam /
svayamāyāti cedviṣṇuḥ kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अहं तु हरितुष्य्यर्थं करोम्यध्वरमुत्तमम् /
स्वयमायाति चेद्विष्णुः कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः //
text_mt: I, for my part, am performing an excellent sacrifice for the pleasure of Hari; / if Viṣṇu himself comes, I have accomplished my purpose, there is no doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vadati daityandre viṣṇurvāmanarupadhṛk /
praviveśādhvarasthānaṃ hutavahnimanoramam //
meaning:
एवं वदति दैत्यन्द्रे विष्णुर्वामनरुपधृक् /
प्रविवेशाध्वरस्थानं हुतवह्निमनोरमम् //
text_mt: While the lord of Daityas was speaking thus, Viṣṇu, bearing the form of Vāmana, / entered the sacrificial precinct, delightful with the offered fire.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā koṭisūryābhaṃ yogyāvayavasundaram /
vāmanaṃ sahasotthāya pratyagṛhṇātkṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा कोटिसूर्याभं योग्यावयवसुन्दरम् /
वामनं सहसोत्थाय प्रत्यगृह्णात्कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Seeing him, radiant as ten million suns, handsome in every suitable limb, / [Bali] immediately stood up and welcomed Vāmana with joined palms.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvāsanaṃ ca prakṣālya pādau vāmanarupiṇam /
sakuṭuṃbo vahanmūrdhnā paramāṃ mudamātpavān //
meaning:
दत्त्वासनं च प्रक्षाल्य पादौ वामनरुपिणम् /
सकुटुंबो वहन्मूर्ध्ना परमां मुदमात्पवान् //
text_mt: Having offered him a seat and washed the feet of him in the form of Vāmana, / carrying [the water] on his head along with his family, he experienced supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇave 'smai jagaddhānme dattvārghyaṃ vidhivadūliḥ /
romāñcitatanurbhūtvā harṣāśrunayano 'bravīt //
meaning:
विष्णवे ऽस्मै जगद्धान्मे दत्त्वार्घ्यं विधिवदूलिः /
रोमाञ्चिततनुर्भूत्वा हर्षाश्रुनयनो ऽब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having offered water for hospitality according to rule to this Viṣṇu, the abode of the universe, / Bali, his body bristling with horripilation and his eyes filled with tears of joy, spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
baliruvāca
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalo maravaḥ /
jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ me 'dya kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
बलिरुवाच
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलो मरवः /
जीवितं सफलं मे ऽद्य कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः //
text_mt:
Bali said:
“Today my birth has borne fruit; today my sacrifice has borne fruit; / today my life has borne fruit; I have accomplished my goal, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāmṛtavṛṣṭirme samāyātātidurlabhā /
tvadāgamanamātreṇa hyanāyāso mahotsavaḥ //
meaning:
अमोघामृतवृष्टिर्मे समायातातिदुर्लभा /
त्वदागमनमात्रेण ह्यनायासो महोत्सवः //
text_mt: An infallible rain of nectar, exceedingly difficult to obtain, has arrived for me; / by your mere arrival, a great festival has arisen effortlessly.

sanskrit_iast:
ete ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṛtārthāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ /
yaiḥ pūrvaṃ hi tapastaptaṃ tadadya saphalaṃ prabho //
meaning:
एते च ऋषयः सर्वे कृतार्थां नात्र संशयः /
यैः पूर्वं हि तपस्तप्तं तदद्य सफलं प्रभो //
text_mt: All these sages too have accomplished their purpose, of this there is no doubt; / whatever austerity was performed by them previously has borne fruit today, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtārtho 'smi kṛtārtho 'smi kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ /
tasmāttubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namonamaḥ //
meaning:
कृतार्थो ऽस्मि कृतार्थो ऽस्मि कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः /
तस्मात्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं नमोनमः //
text_mt: I have accomplished my goal, I have accomplished my goal, I have accomplished my goal, there is no doubt! / Therefore, obeisance to you, obeisance to you, obeisance to you, obeisance, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tvadājñayā tvanniyogaṃ sādhayāmīti manmanaḥ /
atyutsāhasamāyuktaṃ samājñāpaya māṃ prabho //
meaning:
त्वदाज्ञया त्वन्नियोगं साधयामीति मन्मनः /
अत्युत्साहसमायुक्तं समाज्ञापय मां प्रभो //
text_mt: At your command I shall fulfill your commission: my mind / is filled with extraordinary enthusiasm. Command me, O Lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamurke dīkṣitena prahasanvāmano 'bravīt /
dehi me tapasi sthātuṃ bhūmiṃ tripadasaṃmitām //
meaning:
एवमुर्के दीक्षितेन प्रहसन्वामनो ऽब्रवीत् /
देहि मे तपसि स्थातुं भूमिं त्रिपदसंमिताम् //
text_mt: When this was spoken by the consecrated one, Vāmana smilingly said: / “Give me land measuring three strides so that I may abide in austerity.”

sanskrit_iast:
etacchṛātvā baliḥ prāha rājyaṃ yācitavānnahi /
grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ cāpi dhanaṃ vā kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā //
meaning:
एतच्छृआत्वा बलिः प्राह राज्यं याचितवान्नहि /
ग्रामं वा नगरं चापि धनं वा किं कृतं त्वया //
text_mt: Hearing this, Bali said: “You have not asked for a kingdom, / or a village, or even a city, or wealth. What have you done?

sanskrit_iast:
tanniśamya baliṃ prāha viṣṇuḥ sarvaśarīrabhṛt /
āsannabhraṣṭarājyasya vairāgyaṃ janamannivā //
meaning:
तन्निशम्य बलिं प्राह विष्णुः सर्वशरीरभृत् /
आसन्नभ्रष्टराज्यस्य वैराग्यं जनमन्निवा //
text_mt: Hearing that, Viṣṇu, the bearer of all bodies, spoke to Bali / as if instilling dispassion in him whose kingdom was soon to fall.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
śṛṇu daityandra vakṣyāmi guhyādguhyatamaṃ param /
sarvasaṃgavihīnānāṃ kimarthaiḥ sādhyatevada //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
शृणु दैत्यन्द्र वक्ष्यामि गुह्याद्गुह्यतमं परम् /
सर्वसंगविहीनानां किमर्थैः साध्यतेवद //
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
“Listen, O lord of Daityas, I shall tell you the supreme secret of secrets: / for those who are devoid of all attachment, what is accomplished by worldly wealth? Speak!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmīti bhāvaya /
mayi sarvamidaṃ daitya kimanyaiḥ sādhyate vada //
meaning:
अहं तु सर्वभूतानामन्तर्यामीति भावय /
मयि सर्वमिदं दैत्य किमन्यैः साध्यते वद //
text_mt: Contemplate that I am indeed the inner controller of all beings. / All this rests in me, O Daitya; what else can be accomplished [by wealth]? Speak!

sanskrit_iast:
rāgadveṣavihīnānāṃ śāntānāṃ tyaktamāyinām /
nityānandasvarupāṇāṃ kimanyaiḥ sādhyate dhanaiḥ //
meaning:
रागद्वेषविहीनानां शान्तानां त्यक्तमायिनाम् /
नित्यानन्दस्वरुपाणां किमन्यैः साध्यते धनैः //
text_mt: For those devoid of passion and hatred, tranquil, free from deceit, / whose essential nature is eternal bliss, what can be accomplished by other riches?

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavatsarvabhūtāni paśyatāṃ śāntacetasām /
abhinnamātmanaḥ sarvaṃ ko dātā dīyate ca kim //
meaning:
आत्मवत्सर्वभूतानि पश्यतां शान्तचेतसाम् /
अभिन्नमात्मनः सर्वं को दाता दीयते च किम् //
text_mt: For those of tranquil mind who see all beings as themselves, / all is non-different from the Self; who is the giver, and what is given?

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvīyaṃ kṣatriyavaśā iti śāstreṣu niścitam /
tadājñāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve labhante paramaṃ sukham //
meaning:
पृथ्वीयं क्षत्रियवशा इति शास्त्रेषु निश्चितम् /
तदाज्ञायां स्थिताः सर्वे लभन्ते परमं सुखम् //
text_mt: This earth is under the dominion of kṣatriyas—this is established in the scriptures; / abiding under their command, all attain supreme happiness.”

sanskrit_iast:
dātavyo munibhiścāpi ṣaṣṭāṃśo bhūbhuje bale /
mahīyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dātavyā sarva yatnataḥ //
meaning:
दातव्यो मुनिभिश्चापि षष्टांशो भूभुजे बले /
महीयं ब्राह्मणानां तु दातव्या सर्व यत्नतः //
text_mt: A sixth share must be given even by sages to the king, O Bali; / but this earth must be given to brāhmaṇas with every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
paraṃ nirvāṇamānpoti bhūmido nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
भूमिदानस्य माहात्म्यं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
परं निर्वाणमान्पोति भूमिदो नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: The eulogy of greatness of the gift of land has never been equalled, nor will it ever be; / the giver of land attains supreme nirvāṇa, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
svalpāmapi mahīṃ dattvā śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye /
brahmalokamavāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
स्वल्पामपि महीं दत्त्वा श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये /
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Giving even a tiny piece of land to a Vedic scholar who maintains the sacred fire, / one attains the world of Brahmā, from which return is hard to find.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidaḥ sarvadaḥ prokto bhūmido mokṣabhāgbhavet /
atidānaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ sarvapāpaprāṇāśanam //
meaning:
भूमिदः सर्वदः प्रोक्तो भूमिदो मोक्षभाग्भवेत् /
अतिदानं तु तज्ज्ञेयं सर्वपापप्राणाशनम् //
text_mt: A giver of land is declared a giver of all; a giver of land attains liberation. / It should be known as an extraordinary gift that destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ /
daśahastāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः /
दशहस्तां महीं दत्त्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Whether burdened with great sins or loaded with all sins, / by giving land ten cubits [wide], one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
satpātre bhūmidātā yaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet /
bhūmidānasamaṃ nānyatriṣu lokeṣu vidyate //
meaning:
सत्पात्रे भूमिदाता यः सर्वदानफलं लभेत् /
भूमिदानसमं नान्यत्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते //
text_mt: He who gives land to a worthy recipient attains the fruit of all gifts; / nothing equal to the gift of land exists in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijāya vṛttihīnāya yaḥ pradadyānmahīṃ bale /
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na kṣamo 'bdaśatairaham //
meaning:
द्विजाय वृत्तिहीनाय यः प्रदद्यान्महीं बले /
तस्य पुण्यफलं वक्तुं न क्षमो ऽब्दशतैरहम् //
text_mt: He who gives land to a twice-born lacking livelihood, O Bali, / I am not able to tell the fruit of his merit even in hundreds of years.

sanskrit_iast:
saktāya devapūjāsu vṛttihīnāya daityapa /
svalpāmapi mahīṃ dadyādyaḥ sa viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सक्ताय देवपूजासु वृत्तिहीनाय दैत्यप /
स्वल्पामपि महीं दद्याद्यः स विष्णुर्न संशयः //
text_mt: He who gives even a tiny piece of land to one devoted to worship of the gods / and lacking livelihood, O ruler of Daityas, is Viṣṇu himself, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣugodhūma tuvarīpūgavṛkṣādisaṃyutā /
pṛthvī pradīyate yena sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
इक्षुगोधूम तुवरीपूगवृक्षादिसंयुता /
पृथ्वी प्रदीयते येन स विष्णुर्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: He by whom land endowed with sugarcane, wheat, pigeon-pea, areca trees, and the like / is given away, is Viṣṇu himself; there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttihīnāya viprāya daridrāya kuṭumbine /
svalpāmapi mahīndattvā viṣṇusāyujyamānpuyāt //
meaning:
वृत्तिहीनाय विप्राय दरिद्राय कुटुम्बिने /
स्वल्पामपि महीन्दत्त्वा विष्णुसायुज्यमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: By giving even a tiny piece of land to a poor brāhmaṇa / who has a family and lacks a livelihood, one attains union with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
saktāya devapūjāsu viprāyāḍhakikāṃ mahīm /
dattvā labheta gaṅgāyāṃ trirātrasnānajaṃ phalam //
meaning:
सक्ताय देवपूजासु विप्रायाढकिकां महीम् /
दत्त्वा लभेत गङ्गायां त्रिरात्रस्नानजं फलम् //
text_mt: By giving an āḍhaka of land to a brāhmaṇa devoted to the worship of the gods, / one attains the fruit born of bathing in the Gaṅgā for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya vṛttihīnāya sadācāraratāya ca /
droṇikāṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu //
meaning:
विप्राय वृत्तिहीनाय सदाचाररताय च /
द्रोणिकां पृथिवीं दत्त्वा यत्फलं लभते शृणु //
text_mt: Hear the fruit that one attains by giving a droṇa of land / to a brāhmaṇa who lacks a livelihood and is devoted to good conduct:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātīrthāśvamedhānāṃ śatāni vidhivannaraḥ /
kṛtvā yatphalamānpoti tadāpnoti sa puṣkalam //
meaning:
गङ्गातीर्थाश्वमेधानां शतानि विधिवन्नरः /
कृत्वा यत्फलमान्पोति तदाप्नोति स पुष्कलम् //
text_mt: The fruit a man attains by performing according to rule / hundreds of horse sacrifices at the Gaṅgā sacred ford, that abundant [fruit] he attains.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti khārikāṃ bhūmiṃ daridrāya dvijāya yaḥ /
tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vadato me niśāmaya //
meaning:
ददाति खारिकां भूमिं दरिद्राय द्विजाय यः /
तस्य पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि वदतो मे निशामय //
text_mt: He who gives a khārī of land to an impoverished twice-born— / I will declare his merit; listen as I speak:

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca /
vidhāya jāhnavītīre patphalaṃ tallabheddhuvam //
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्राणि वाजपेयशतानि च /
विधाय जाह्नवीतीरे पत्फलं तल्लभेद्धुवम् //
text_mt: The fruit one would obtain by performing thousands of horse sacrifices / and hundreds of Vājapeya sacrifices on the bank of the Jāhnavī, that he surely attains.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidānaṃ mahādānamatidānaṃ prakīrttitam /
sarvapāpapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam //
meaning:
भूमिदानं महादानमतिदानं प्रकीर्त्तितम् /
सर्वपापप्रशमनमपवर्गफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: The gift of land is proclaimed a great gift, an extraordinary gift, / quelling all sins and bestowing the fruit of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
atrotihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu daityakuleśvara /
yacchutvā śraddhayā yukto bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
अत्रोतिहासं वक्ष्यामि शृणु दैत्यकुलेश्वर /
यच्छुत्वा श्रद्धया युक्तो भूमिदानफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: In this connection I will relate an ancient story; listen, O lord of the Daitya clan! / Having heard it with faith, one attains the fruit of the gift of land.

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpurā dvijavaro brāhmakalpe mahāmatiḥ /
daridro vṛttihīnaśca nāmnā bhadramatirbale //
meaning:
आसीत्पुरा द्विजवरो ब्राह्मकल्पे महामतिः /
दरिद्रो वृत्तिहीनश्च नाम्ना भद्रमतिर्बले //
text_mt: Formerly, in the Brāhma kalpa, there was an eminent, highly intelligent twice-born, / poor and lacking livelihood, named Bhadramati, O Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutāni sarvaśāstrāṇi tena vedadivāniśam /
śrutāni ca purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुतानि सर्वशास्त्राणि तेन वेददिवानिशम् /
श्रुतानि च पुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वशः //
text_mt: All the scriptures had been heard by him, day and night the Vedas, / and Purāṇas and treatises on dharma in their entirety were heard.

sanskrit_iast:
abhavaṃstasya ṣaṭpatnyaḥ śrutiḥ sindhuryaśovatī /
kāminī mālinī caiva śobhā ceti prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अभवंस्तस्य षट्पत्न्यः श्रुतिः सिन्धुर्यशोवती /
कामिनी मालिनी चैव शोभा चेति प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: He had six wives: Śruti, Sindhu, Yaśovatī, / Kāminī, Mālinī, and Śobhā, as they are renowned.

sanskrit_iast:
āsu pantīṣu tasyāsañcatvariṃśacchatadvayam /
putrāṇāmasuraśreṣṭha sarve nityaṃ bubhukṣitāḥ //
meaning:
आसु पन्तीषु तस्यासञ्चत्वरिंशच्छतद्वयम् /
पुत्राणामसुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वे नित्यं बुभुक्षिताः //
text_mt: Through these wives he had two hundred and forty / sons, O best of asuras, and all of them were constantly hungry.

sanskrit_iast:
akiñcano bhadramatiḥ kṣudhārttānātmajānpriyāḥ /
paśyansvayaṃ kṣudhārttaśca vilalāpākulendriyaḥ //
meaning:
अकिञ्चनो भद्रमतिः क्षुधार्त्तानात्मजान्प्रियाः /
पश्यन्स्वयं क्षुधार्त्तश्च विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Destitute Bhadramati, seeing his dear sons afflicted by hunger / while he himself was stricken with hunger, lamented with distressed senses:

sanskrit_iast:
dhigjanma bhāgyarahitaṃ dhigjanma dhanavarjitam /
dhigjanma dharmarahitaṃ dhigjanma khyātivarjitam //
meaning:
धिग्जन्म भाग्यरहितं धिग्जन्म धनवर्जितम् /
धिग्जन्म धर्मरहितं धिग्जन्म ख्यातिवर्जितम् //
text_mt: ‘Fie upon a birth devoid of good fortune! Fie upon a birth devoid of wealth! / Fie upon a birth devoid of dharma! Fie upon a birth devoid of fame!

sanskrit_iast:
narasya bahvapatyasya dhigjanmaiśvaryavārjitam /
aho guṇāḥ saumyatā ca vidvattā janma satkule //
meaning:
नरस्य बह्वपत्यस्य धिग्जन्मैश्वर्यवार्जितम् /
अहो गुणाः सौम्यता च विद्वत्ता जन्म सत्कुले //
text_mt: Fie upon the birth of a man with many children when devoid of power and riches! / Ah, virtues, gentleness, erudition, birth in a good family—

sanskrit_iast:
dāridyāmbudhimagnasya sarvametanna śobhate /
priyāḥ putrāścapautrāśca bāndhavā bhrātarastathā //
meaning:
दारिद्याम्बुधिमग्नस्य सर्वमेतन्न शोभते /
प्रियाः पुत्राश्चपौत्राश्च बान्धवा भ्रातरस्तथा //
text_mt: none of this shines in one sunk in the ocean of poverty! / Beloved sons, grandsons, kinsmen, and brothers,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyāśca sarvamanujāstyajantyaiśvaryavārjitam /
cāṇḍālo vā dvijo vāpi bhāgyavāneva pūjyate //
meaning:
शिष्याश्च सर्वमनुजास्त्यजन्त्यैश्वर्यवार्जितम् /
चाण्डालो वा द्विजो वापि भाग्यवानेव पूज्यते //
text_mt: as well as disciples and all people, abandon one devoid of power and riches. / Be he an outcaste or a twice-born, only the fortunate man is honoured.

sanskrit_iast:
daridraḥ puruṣo loke śavavallokaninditaḥ /
aho saṃpatsaṃmāyukto niṣṭuro vāpyaniṣṭhuraḥ //
meaning:
दरिद्रः पुरुषो लोके शववल्लोकनिन्दितः /
अहो संपत्संमायुक्तो निष्टुरो वाप्यनिष्ठुरः //
text_mt: A poor man in this world is reviled by people like a corpse. / Ah, one endowed with wealth, whether cruel or not cruel,

sanskrit_iast:
guṇahīno 'pi guṇavānmūrkho vāpyatha paṇḍitaḥ /
aiśvaryaguṇayuktaścetpūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
गुणहीनो ऽपि गुणवान्मूर्खो वाप्यथ पण्डितः /
ऐश्वर्यगुणयुक्तश्चेत्पूज्य एव न संशयः //
text_mt: devoid of virtues or endowed with virtues, a fool or a learned scholar, / if he is endowed with power and riches, is alone worthy of worship, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
aho daridratā duḥkhaṃ tatrāpyāśātiduḥkhadā /
āśābhibhūtāḥ puruṣā duḥkhamaśnuvate 'kṣayam //
meaning:
अहो दरिद्रता दुःखं तत्राप्याशातिदुःखदा /
आशाभिभूताः पुरुषा दुःखमश्नुवते ऽक्षयम् //
text_mt: Ah, poverty is suffering, and desire there is even more agonizing; / overcome by desire, men undergo imperishable suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
āśayādāsā ye dāsāste sarvalokasya /
āśā dāsī yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāsāyate lokaḥ //
meaning:
आशयादासा ये दासास्ते सर्वलोकस्य /
आशा दासी येषां तेषां दासायते लोकः //
text_mt: Those who are slaves to desire are slaves to the whole world; / but for those to whom desire is a servant, the world acts as a servant.

sanskrit_iast:
māno hi mahatāṃ loke dhanamakṣayamucyate /
tasminnāśākhyaripuṇā māne naṣṭe daridratā //
meaning:
मानो हि महतां लोके धनमक्षयमुच्यते /
तस्मिन्नाशाख्यरिपुणा माने नष्टे दरिद्रता //
text_mt: Self-respect in this world is indeed called the inexhaustible wealth of the great; / when that self-respect is destroyed by the enemy named desire, poverty [arrives].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrārthavettāpi daridro bhāti mūrkhavat /
naiṣkiñcanyamahāgrāhagrastānāṃ ko vimocacakaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थवेत्तापि दरिद्रो भाति मूर्खवत् /
नैष्किञ्चन्यमहाग्राहग्रस्तानां को विमोचचकः //
text_mt: Even a knower of the meaning of all scriptures appears like a fool when impoverished. / Who can deliver those seized by the great crocodile of destitution?

sanskrit_iast:
aho duḥkhamaho duḥkhamaho duḥkhaṃ daridratā /
tatrāpi putrabhāryāṇāṃ bāhulyamatiduḥkhadam //
meaning:
अहो दुःखमहो दुःखमहो दुःखं दरिद्रता /
तत्रापि पुत्रभार्याणां बाहुल्यमतिदुःखदम् //
text_mt: Ah, misery! Ah, misery! Ah, poverty is sheer misery! / And worse still, having an abundance of sons and wives brings supreme misery!’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā bhadramatiḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ /
anyamaiśvaryadaṃ dharmaṃ manasācintayattadā //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा भद्रमतिः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः /
अन्यमैश्वर्यदं धर्मं मनसाचिन्तयत्तदा //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Bhadramati, who had mastered the meaning of all scriptures, / then thought in his mind of another duty that bestows sovereignty and riches.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidānaṃ viniścitya sarvadānottamottamam /
dānena yo 'numantāti sa eva kṛtavānpurā //
meaning:
भूमिदानं विनिश्चित्य सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम् /
दानेन यो ऽनुमन्ताति स एव कृतवान्पुरा //
text_mt: Having determined that the gift of land is the highest of all gifts, / [he reflected:] ‘He who approves a gift is the same as the one who previously performed it.’

sanskrit_iast:
prāpakaṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam /
dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ bhūdānaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
प्रापकं परमं धर्मं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् /
दानानामुत्तमं दानं भूदानं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The supreme practice that leads [to liberation] and grants the fruits of all desires, / the highest gift among gifts is declared to be the gift of land,

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattvā samavānpoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ naraḥ /
iti niścatya matimāndhīro bhadramatirbale //
meaning:
यद्दत्त्वा समवान्पोति यद्यदिष्टतमं नरः /
इति निश्चत्य मतिमान्धीरो भद्रमतिर्बले //
text_mt: giving which a man attains whatever he most desires. / Deciding thus, the wise and steady Bhadramati, O Bali,

sanskrit_iast:
kauśāmbīṃnāma nagarīṃ kalatrāpatyayugyayau /
sughoṣanāmaviprendraṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvalitam //
meaning:
कौशाम्बींनाम नगरीं कलत्रापत्ययुग्ययौ /
सुघोषनामविप्रेन्द्रं सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वलितम् //
text_mt: went to the city named Kauśāmbī together with his wives and children, / to a lordly brāhmaṇa named Sughoṣa, who was endowed with all prosperity and power.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā yācitavānbhūmiṃ pañcahastāyatāṃ bale /
sughoṣo dharmaniratastaṃ nirīkṣya kuṭumbikram //
meaning:
गत्वा याचितवान्भूमिं पञ्चहस्तायतां बले /
सुघोषो धर्मनिरतस्तं निरीक्ष्य कुटुम्बिक्रम् //
text_mt: Having arrived, he begged for a piece of land five cubits in extent, O Bali. / Sughoṣa, devoted to dharma, seeing that householder with a large family,

sanskrit_iast:
manasā prīyamāṇena samabhyarcyedamabravīt /
kṛtārtho 'haṃ bhadramate saphalaṃ mama janma ca //
meaning:
मनसा प्रीयमाणेन समभ्यर्च्येदमब्रवीत् /
कृतार्थो ऽहं भद्रमते सफलं मम जन्म च //
text_mt: with a delighted heart worshipped him and spoke this: / ‘I have fulfilled my purpose, O Bhadramati, and my birth is fruitful;

sanskrit_iast:
matkula pāvanaṃ jātaṃ tvadanugrahato dvija /
ityuktvā taṃ samabhyarcya sughoṣo dharmatatparaḥ //
meaning:
मत्कुल पावनं जातं त्वदनुग्रहतो द्विज /
इत्युक्त्वा तं समभ्यर्च्य सुघोषो धर्मतत्परः //
text_mt: my family has become purified by your grace, O twice-born!’ / Having spoken thus and worshipped him, Sughoṣa, intent on dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcahastamitāṃ bhūmiṃ dadau tasmai mahāmatiḥ /
pṛthivī vaiṣṇavī puṇyā pṛthivīṃ viṣṇupālitā //
meaning:
पञ्चहस्तमितां भूमिं ददौ तस्मै महामतिः /
पृथिवी वैष्णवी पुण्या पृथिवीं विष्णुपालिता //
text_mt: the noble-minded one gave him a piece of land measuring five cubits: / ‘The holy earth belongs to Viṣṇu; the earth is protected by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāstu pradānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ /
mantreṇānena daityendra sughoṣastaṃ dvijottamam //
meaning:
पृथिव्यास्तु प्रदानेन प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः /
मन्त्रेणानेन दैत्येन्द्र सुघोषस्तं द्विजोत्तमम् //
text_mt: May Janārdana be pleased with me through this gift of earth!’ / With this mantra, O ruler of Daityas, Sughoṣa worshipped that best of twice-born

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubuddhyā samabhyarcya tāvatīṃ pṛthivīṃ dadau /
so 'pi bhadramatirvipro dhīmatā yācitāṃ bhuvam //
meaning:
विष्णुबुद्ध्या समभ्यर्च्य तावतीं पृथिवीं ददौ /
सो ऽपि भद्रमतिर्विप्रो धीमता याचितां भुवम् //
text_mt: regarding him as Viṣṇu, and gave him that much land. / Then the brāhmaṇa Bhadramati, receiving the land asked for from the wise man,

sanskrit_iast:
dattavānharibhaktāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine /
sughoṣo bhūmidānena koṭivaṃśasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
दत्तवान्हरिभक्ताय श्रोत्रियाय कुटुम्बिने /
सुघोषो भूमिदानेन कोटिवंशसमन्वितः //
text_mt: gave it to a devotee of Hari, a Vedic scholar with a family. / Sughoṣa, by the gift of land, accompanied by ten million ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
prapede viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati /
bale bhadramatiścāpi yataḥ prārthitavāñchriyam //
meaning:
प्रपेदे विष्णुभवनं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति /
बले भद्रमतिश्चापि यतः प्रार्थितवाञ्छ्रियम् //
text_mt: attained the abode of Viṣṇu, going where one does not grieve. / O Bali, Bhadramati also, because he had prayed for prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
sthitavānviṣṇubhavane sakuṭumbo yugāyutam /
tathaiva brahmasadane sthitvā koṭiyugāyutam //
meaning:
स्थितवान्विष्णुभवने सकुटुम्बो युगायुतम् /
तथैव ब्रह्मसदने स्थित्वा कोटियुगायुतम् //
text_mt: dwelt in the abode of Viṣṇu with his family for ten thousand yugas. / Likewise, having remained in the abode of Brahmā for ten million yugas,

sanskrit_iast:
aindraṃ padaṃ samāsādya sthitavānkalpapañcakam /
tato bhuvaṃ samāsādya sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
ऐन्द्रं पदं समासाद्य स्थितवान्कल्पपञ्चकम् /
ततो भुवं समासाद्य सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः //
text_mt: and having attained Indra's station, he remained for five kalpas. / Then, having arrived on earth endowed with all prosperity and power,

sanskrit_iast:
jātismaro mahābhāgo bubhuje bhogamuttamam /
tato bhadramatirdaitya niṣkāmo viṣṇutatparaḥ //
meaning:
जातिस्मरो महाभागो बुभुजे भोगमुत्तमम् /
ततो भद्रमतिर्दैत्य निष्कामो विष्णुतत्परः //
text_mt: Remembering his past births, highly fortunate, he enjoyed supreme pleasures. / Then, O Daitya, noble-minded, free of desire, intent on Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ vṛttihīnebhyo brahmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān /
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā tattvaiśaavaryamanuttamam //
meaning:
पृथिवीं वृत्तिहीनेभ्यो ब्रह्मणेभ्यः प्रदत्तवान् /
तस्य विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा तत्त्वैशअवर्यमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: he granted the earth to brāhmaṇas who lacked a livelihood. / Pleased in spirit with him, Viṣṇu [granted] unequalled true sovereignty,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭivaṃśasametasya dadau mokṣamanuttamam /
tasmāddaityapate mahyaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇa //
meaning:
कोटिवंशसमेतस्य ददौ मोक्षमनुत्तमम् /
तस्माद्दैत्यपते मह्यं सर्वधर्मपरायण //
text_mt: and gave unsurpassed liberation to him together with ten million [ancestors of his] lineage. / Therefore, O lord of Daityas, devoted to all duties, to me,

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścariṣyemokṣāya dehi me tripadāṃ mahīm /
vairocanistato dṛṣṭaḥ kalaśaṃ jalapūritam //
meaning:
तपश्चरिष्येमोक्षाय देहि मे त्रिपदां महीम् /
वैरोचनिस्ततो दृष्टः कलशं जलपूरितम् //
text_mt: who will perform austerities for liberation, grant earth measuring three paces.' / Then Bali, son of Virocana, was seen, and a pitcher filled with water

sanskrit_iast:
ādade pṛthivīṃ dātuṃ varṇine vāmanāya /
viṣṇuḥ sarvagatojñātvā jaladhārāvarodhinam //
meaning:
आददे पृथिवीं दातुं वर्णिने वामनाय /
विष्णुः सर्वगतोज्ञात्वा जलधारावरोधिनम् //
text_mt: he took up to give the earth to the religious student Vāmana. / Knowing him to be the obstructor of the water-stream, the all-pervading Viṣṇu

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyaṃ hastasthadarbhāgraṃ tacchare saṃnyaveśayat /
darbhāgre 'bhūnmahāśāstraṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham //
meaning:
काव्यं हस्तस्थदर्भाग्रं तच्छरे संन्यवेशयत् /
दर्भाग्रे ऽभून्महाशास्त्रं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: thrust the tip of the darbha grass held in his hand into Śukra's eye. / On the tip of the darbha arose a great weapon blazing like ten million suns,

sanskrit_iast:
amodhaṃ brahmamatyugraṃ kāvyākṣigrāsalolupam /
āyāya bhārgavasurānasurānekacakṣuṣā //
meaning:
अमोधं ब्रह्ममत्युग्रं काव्याक्षिग्रासलोलुपम् /
आयाय भार्गवसुरानसुरानेकचक्षुषा //
text_mt: unfailing, belonging to Brahmā, exceedingly fierce, eager to devour the eye of Śukra. / Approaching the gods and the asuras with one eye, the descendant of Bhṛgu

sanskrit_iast:
paśyeti vāndideśe ca darbhāgraṃ śastrasannibham /
balirdadau mahāviṣṇormahīṃ tripadasaṃmitām //
meaning:
पश्येति वान्दिदेशे च दर्भाग्रं शस्त्रसन्निभम् /
बलिर्ददौ महाविष्णोर्महीं त्रिपदसंमिताम् //
text_mt: commanded, 'Look!' at the darbha tip resembling a weapon. / Bali then gave Mahāviṣṇu the earth measuring three paces.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhe so 'pi viśvātmā ābrahmabhuvanaṃ tadā /
amimīta mahīṃ dvābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ viśvatanurhariḥ //
meaning:
ववृधे सो ऽपि विश्वात्मा आब्रह्मभुवनं तदा /
अमिमीत महीं द्वाभ्यां पद्भ्यां विश्वतनुर्हरिः //
text_mt: He, the soul of all, expanded up to the world of Brahmā then. / Hari, whose body is the universe, measured the earth with two feet.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ābrahmakaṭāhāntapadānyetāni saprabhaḥ /
pādāṅkuṣṭāgranirbhinnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ vibhide dvidhā //
meaning:
स आब्रह्मकटाहान्तपदान्येतानि सप्रभः /
पादाङ्कुष्टाग्रनिर्भिन्नं ब्रह्माण्डं विभिदे द्विधा //
text_mt: He, full of splendour, [stretched] these steps up to the edge of Brahmā's cosmic shell. / Pierced by the tip of his big toe, the cosmic egg split into two.

sanskrit_iast:
taddārā bāhyasalilaṃ bahudhāraṃ samāgatam /
dhautaviṣṇupadaṃ toyaṃ nirmalaṃ lokapāvanam //
meaning:
तद्दारा बाह्यसलिलं बहुधारं समागतम् /
धौतविष्णुपदं तोयं निर्मलं लोकपावनम् //
text_mt: Through that opening, the outer water entered in many streams. / Having washed Viṣṇu's feet, the pure water became the purifier of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāṇḍabāhyanilayaṃ dhārārupamavarttata /
tajjalaṃ pāvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmādīnpāvayatsurān //
meaning:
अजाण्डबाह्यनिलयं धारारुपमवर्त्तत /
तज्जलं पावनं श्रेष्ठं ब्रह्मादीन्पावयत्सुरान् //
text_mt: Dwelling outside the cosmic egg, it flowed in the form of a stream. / That sacred, foremost water, purifying the gods beginning with Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast: satparṣisevitaṃ caiva nyapatanmerumūrddhani //
meaning: सत्पर्षिसेवितं चैव न्यपतन्मेरुमूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: and served by the true sages, descended onto the peak of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddaṣṭvādbhutaṃ karma brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ /
ṛṣayo manavaścaiva hyastuvanharṣavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
एतद्दष्ट्वाद्भुतं कर्म ब्रह्माद्या देवतागणाः /
ऋषयो मनवश्चैव ह्यस्तुवन्हर्षविह्वलाः //
text_mt: Seeing this wondrous deed, the hosts of gods headed by Brahmā, / as well as the sages and Manus, overwhelmed with joy, praised [him].

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
namaḥ pareśāya parātmarupiṇe parātparāyāpararupadhāriṇe /
brahmātmane brahmaratātmabuddhaye namo 'stu te 'vyāhatakarmaśīline //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नमः परेशाय परात्मरुपिणे परात्परायापररुपधारिणे /
ब्रह्मात्मने ब्रह्मरतात्मबुद्धये नमो ऽस्तु ते ऽव्याहतकर्मशीलिने //
text_mt:
The gods said:
'Salutations to the Supreme Lord, whose form is the Supreme Self, who is higher than the highest, yet assumes other forms! / Salutations to you whose self is Brahman, whose intellect is devoted to Brahman, whose nature is of unhindered action!

sanskrit_iast:
pareśa paramānanda paramātmanparātpara /
sarvātmane jaganmūrtte pramāṇātīta te namaḥ //
meaning:
परेश परमानन्द परमात्मन्परात्पर /
सर्वात्मने जगन्मूर्त्ते प्रमाणातीत ते नमः //
text_mt: O Supreme Lord, O supreme bliss, O Supreme Self, higher than the highest! / Salutations to you, the soul of all, whose form is the world, who transcend all standards of knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
viśvataśvakṣuṣe tubhyaṃ viśvato bāhave namaḥ /
viśvataḥ śirase caiva viśvato gataye namaḥ //
meaning:
विश्वतश्वक्षुषे तुभ्यं विश्वतो बाहवे नमः /
विश्वतः शिरसे चैव विश्वतो गतये नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to you whose eyes are everywhere, whose arms are everywhere! / Salutations to you whose heads are everywhere, whose movement is everywhere!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃra stuto mahāviṣṇurbrahmādyaiḥ svarddavaukasām /
dattvābhayaṃ ca mumude devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
एवंर स्तुतो महाविष्णुर्ब्रह्माद्यैः स्वर्द्दवौकसाम् /
दत्त्वाभयं च मुमुदे देवदेवः सनातनः //
text_mt: Thus praised by the denizens of heaven headed by Brahmā, / Mahāviṣṇu, the eternal god of gods, gave them freedom from fear and rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
virocanātmajaṃ daityaṃ padaikārthaṃ babandha ha /
tataḥ prapannaṃ tu baliṃ jñātvā cāsmai rasātalam /
dadau tadvārapālaśca bhaktavaśyo babhūva ha //
meaning:
विरोचनात्मजं दैत्यं पदैकार्थं बबन्ध ह /
ततः प्रपन्नं तु बलिं ज्ञात्वा चास्मै रसातलम् /
ददौ तद्वारपालश्च भक्तवश्यो बभूव ह //
text_mt: For the sake of a single step, he bound the Daitya, the son of Virocana. / Then, knowing Bali had surrendered, he gave him Rasātala, / and, conquered by devotion, he became his doorkeeper.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
rasātale mahāviṣṇurvirocanasutasya vai /
kiṃ bhojyaṃ kalpayāmāsa ghore sarpabhayākule //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
रसातले महाविष्णुर्विरोचनसुतस्य वै /
किं भोज्यं कल्पयामास घोरे सर्पभयाकुले //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
'In Rasātala, dreadful and filled with fear of serpents, / what food did Mahāviṣṇu assign for the son of Virocana?'

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
amantritaṃ haviryattu hūyate jātavedasi /
apātre dīyate yacca taddhoraṃ bhogasādhanam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अमन्त्रितं हविर्यत्तु हूयते जातवेदसि /
अपात्रे दीयते यच्च तद्धोरं भोगसाधनम् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
'The sacrificial offering which is offered into the fire without mantras, / and whatever is given to an unworthy recipient—that is the dreadful means of his sustenance.

sanskrit_iast:
hutaṃ haviraśucinā dṛttaṃ satkarma yatkṛtam /
tatsarvaṃ tatra bhogārhamadhaḥ pātaphalapradam //
meaning:
हुतं हविरशुचिना दृत्तं सत्कर्म यत्कृतम् /
तत्सर्वं तत्र भोगार्हमधः पातफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: The offering poured by an impure person, a good deed done with arrogance— / all that is fit to be consumed there, yielding the fruit of falling low.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rasātalaṃ viṣṇurbalaye sāsurāya tu /
dattvābhayaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ surāṇāṃ tridivaṃ dadau //
meaning:
एवं रसातलं विष्णुर्बलये सासुराय तु /
दत्त्वाभयं च सर्वेषां सुराणां त्रिदिवं ददौ //
text_mt: Having thus given Rasātala to Bali along with the asuras, / and granting fearlessness to all, Viṣṇu gave heaven to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyamāno 'maragaṇaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ /
gandharvairgīyamānaśca punarvāmanatāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
पूज्यमानो ऽमरगणैः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः /
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानश्च पुनर्वामनतां गतः //
text_mt: Worshipped by the hosts of immortals, praised by the great sages, / and sung of by the gandharvas, he assumed the form of Vāmana once again.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddṛṣṭvā mahatkarmamuno brahmavādinaḥ /
paraspare smitamukhāḥ praṇebhuḥ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
एतद्दृष्ट्वा महत्कर्ममुनो ब्रह्मवादिनः /
परस्परे स्मितमुखाः प्रणेभुः पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Seeing this great deed, the sages, expounders of Brahman, / with smiling faces towards one another, bowed to Puruṣottama.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtatmako viṣṇurvāmanatvamupāgataḥ /
mohayannikhilaṃ lokaṃ prapede tapase vanam //
meaning:
सर्वभूतत्मको विष्णुर्वामनत्वमुपागतः /
मोहयन्निखिलं लोकं प्रपेदे तपसे वनम् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, the soul of all beings, having assumed the state of Vāmana, / deluding the entire world, retired to the forest for austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhāvā sā devī gaṅgā viṣṇupadodbhavā /
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रभावा सा देवी गङ्गा विष्णुपदोद्भवा /
यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: Such is the power of that goddess Gaṅgā who arose from Viṣṇu's feet, / by merely remembering whom one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhe cchṛṇuyādapi /
devālaye nadītīre so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgotpattirgaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इदं तु गङ्गामाहात्म्यं यः पठे च्छृणुयादपि /
देवालये नदीतीरे सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गोत्पत्तिर्गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever reads or hears this eulogy of Gaṅgā's greatness / in a temple of the gods or on a riverbank, attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.'

Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled 'The Origin and Eulogy of Greatness of Gaṅgā', in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nātada uvāca
śrutaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vāñchitaṃ pāpanāśanam /
adhunā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhrātarme dānapātraghayoḥ //
meaning:
नातद उवाच
श्रुतं तु गङ्गामाहात्म्यं वाञ्छितं पापनाशनम् /
अधुना लक्षणं ब्रूहि भ्रातर्मे दानपात्रघयोः //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
'The eulogy of Gaṅgā's greatness, which was desired and destroys sin, has been heard. / Now tell me, my brother, the characteristics of a gift and a worthy recipient.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramo guruḥ /
tasmai tānāni deyāni dattasyānantyamicchatā //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां ब्रह्मणः परमो गुरुः /
तस्मै तानानि देयानि दत्तस्यानन्त्यमिच्छता //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
'A brāhmaṇa is the supreme teacher of all the classes; / gifts should be given to him by one who desires endless reward for what is given.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhṇīyātsarvato bhayavarjitaḥ /
na kadāpi kṣatraviśo gṛhṇīyātāṃ pratigraham //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः प्रतिगृह्णीयात्सर्वतो भयवर्जितः /
न कदापि क्षत्रविशो गृह्णीयातां प्रतिग्रहम् //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa may accept gifts everywhere, free from fear; / never should a kṣatriya or a vaiśya accept gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍasya putrahīnasya dambhācāraratasya ca /
svakarmatyāginaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
चण्डस्य पुत्रहीनस्य दम्भाचाररतस्य च /
स्वकर्मत्यागिनश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to a wrathful person, to one without sons, to one engaged in hypocritical conduct, / or to one who has abandoned his proper duties, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
paradāraratasyāpi paradravyābhiliṣiṇaḥ /
nakṣatrasūcakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
परदाररतस्यापि परद्रव्याभिलिषिणः /
नक्षत्रसूचकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who covets another's wife, to one longing for another's wealth, / or to an astrologer, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyāviṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtanghasya ca māyinaḥ /
ayājyayājakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
असूयाविष्टमनसः कृतन्घस्य च मायिनः /
अयाज्ययाजकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one whose mind is overcome by malice, to an ungrateful person, to a deceitful one, / or to a priest who sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ yācñāparasyāpi hiṃsakasya khalasya ca /
rasavikrayiṇaśvaiva dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
नित्यं याच्ञापरस्यापि हिंसकस्य खलस्य च /
रसविक्रयिणश्वैव दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who is constantly begging, to a violent person, to a rogue, / or to a seller of liquids, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmaikā da
vedavikrayiṇaścāpi smṛtivikrayiṇastathā /
dharmavikrayiṇo vipra dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
नामैका द
वेदविक्रयिणश्चापि स्मृतिविक्रयिणस्तथा /
धर्मविक्रयिणो विप्र दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt:
[...]
And for sellers of the Vedas, sellers of the Smṛtis, / and sellers of dharma, O brāhmaṇa, what is given becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
gānena jīvikā yasya yasya bhāryā ca puścalī /
paropatāpinaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
गानेन जीविका यस्य यस्य भार्या च पुश्चली /
परोपतापिनश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one whose livelihood is singing, to one whose wife is unchaste, / or to one who torments others, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
asijīvī maṣījīvī devalo grāmayājakaḥ /
dhāvako vā bhavetteṣāṃ dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
असिजीवी मषीजीवी देवलो ग्रामयाजकः /
धावको वा भवेत्तेषां दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who lives by the sword, one who lives by the pen, a temple priest, a village priest, / or a washerman—to these a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
pākakartuḥ parasyārthe kavaye gadahāriṇe /
abhakṣya bhakṣakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
पाककर्तुः परस्यार्थे कवये गदहारिणे /
अभक्ष्य भक्षकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who cooks for another's sake, to a poet who steals words, / or to one who eats what is forbidden to be eaten, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrānnabhojinaścaiva śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ /
paiṃśvalānnabhujaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
शूद्रान्नभोजिनश्चैव शूद्राणां शवदाहिनः /
पैंश्वलान्नभुजश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who eats the food of a śūdra, to one who cremates the corpses of śūdras, / or to one who eats food from an unchaste woman, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmavikrayiṇo viṣṇoḥ saṃdhyākarṃmorjjhitasya ca /
duṣpratigrahadagdhasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
नामविक्रयिणो विष्णोः संध्याकर्ंमोर्ज्झितस्य च /
दुष्प्रतिग्रहदग्धस्य दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one who sells the name of Viṣṇu, to one who has abandoned twilight prayers, / or to one consumed by improper acceptance of gifts, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
divāśayanaśīlasya tathā maithunakāriṇaḥ /
sadhyābhojina evāpidattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
दिवाशयनशीलस्य तथा मैथुनकारिणः /
सध्याभोजिन एवापिदत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one habitually sleeping during the day, likewise to one having intercourse [then], / or even to one eating during the twilights, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayuktasya tyaktasya jñātibāndhavaiḥ /
kuṇḍasya cāpi golasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तस्य त्यक्तस्य ज्ञातिबान्धवैः /
कुण्डस्य चापि गोलस्य दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to one involved in a major sin, to an outcast forsaken by kinsmen and relatives, / to a child born of adultery in wedlock, or to a child born of adultery after widowhood, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
parivatteḥ śaṭhasyāpi parivattuḥ pramādinaḥ /
strījitasyātiduṣṭasya dattaṃ bhavita niṣphalam //
meaning:
परिवत्तेः शठस्यापि परिवत्तुः प्रमादिनः /
स्त्रीजितस्यातिदुष्टस्य दत्तं भवित निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to a younger brother married before the elder, to a rogue, to an elder brother unmarried while the younger marries, to a negligent person, / to one dominated by a woman, or to an exceedingly wicked person, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
madyamāṃsāśinaścāpi strīviṭasyātilobhinaḥ /
caurasya piśunasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam //
meaning:
मद्यमांसाशिनश्चापि स्त्रीविटस्यातिलोभिनः /
चौरस्य पिशुनस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम् //
text_mt: Given to an eater of liquor and meat, to a paramour of women, to an excessively greedy person, / to a thief, or to a slanderer, a gift becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
ye kecitpāpaniratā ninditāḥ sujanaiḥ sadā /
na tebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna ca vadyāddijottama /
satkarmaniratāyāpi deyaṃ yatnena nārada //
meaning:
ये केचित्पापनिरता निन्दिताः सुजनैः सदा /
न तेभ्यः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न च वद्याद्दिजोत्तम /
सत्कर्मनिरतायापि देयं यत्नेन नारद //
text_mt: Those who are ever engaged in sin and condemned by good people— / from them one should not accept gifts, nor should one give [to them], O best of the twice-born. / But even with effort one should give to one engaged in good deeds, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddānaṃ śraddhayā dattaṃ tathā viṣṇusamarpaṇam /
yācitaṃ vāpi pātreṇa bhavettaddānamuttamam //
meaning:
यद्दानं श्रद्धया दत्तं तथा विष्णुसमर्पणम् /
याचितं वापि पात्रेण भवेत्तद्दानमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Whatever gift is given with faith, dedicated to Viṣṇu, / or requested by a worthy recipient—that gift is the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
paralokaṃ samuddaśya hyaihikaṃ vāpi nārada /
yaddānaṃ dīyate pātre tatkāmyaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
परलोकं समुद्दश्य ह्यैहिकं वापि नारद /
यद्दानं दीयते पात्रे तत्काम्यं मध्यमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: With an eye to the next world, or even for this world, O Nārada, / whatever gift is given to a worthy recipient, that is remembered as middling, motivated by desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dagbhena cāpi hiṃsārthaṃ parasyāvidhināpi ca /
kruddhenāśraddhayāpātre taddānaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
दग्भेन चापि हिंसार्थं परस्याविधिनापि च /
क्रुद्धेनाश्रद्धयापात्रे तद्दानं मध्यमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Given out of arrogance, for the injury of another, or improperly, / or in anger, without faith, to an unworthy recipient—that gift is remembered as lowest.

sanskrit_iast:
adhamaṃ balitoṣāyamadhyamaṃ svārthasiddhaye /
uttamaṃ hariprītyarthaṃ prāhurvedavidāṃ varāḥ //
meaning:
अधमं बलितोषायमध्यमं स्वार्थसिद्धये /
उत्तमं हरिप्रीत्यर्थं प्राहुर्वेदविदां वराः //
text_mt: The lowest is for the appeasement of strong spirits, the middling is for the accomplishment of one's own ends, / and the highest is for the pleasure of Hari—so say the best among knowers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: dānabhogavināśāśca rāyaḥ syurgatayastridhā //
meaning: दानभोगविनाशाश्च रायः स्युर्गतयस्त्रिधा //
text_mt: Giving, enjoyment, and loss—these are the three courses of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadāti ca nobhukte taddhanaṃ nāśakāraṇam /
dhanaṃ dharmaphalaṃ vipra dharmo mādhavatuṣṭikṛt //
meaning:
यो ददाति च नोभुक्ते तद्धनं नाशकारणम् /
धनं धर्मफलं विप्र धर्मो माधवतुष्टिकृत् //
text_mt: He who neither gives nor enjoys—his wealth is a cause of destruction. / Wealth is the fruit of dharma, O brahmin; dharma is what pleases Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
taravaḥ kiṃ na jīvanti te 'pi loke parārthakāḥ /
yatra mūlaphalairvṛkṣāḥ parakāryaṃ prakurvate //
meaning:
तरवः किं न जीवन्ति ते ऽपि लोके परार्थकाः /
यत्र मूलफलैर्वृक्षाः परकार्यं प्रकुर्वते //
text_mt: Do trees not live? They too, in this world, exist for the sake of others, / where trees accomplish the purpose of others with their roots and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyā yadi viprāgthra na parārthāstadā mṛtāḥ /
parakāryaṃ na ye martyāḥ kāyenāpi dhanena vā //
meaning:
मनुष्या यदि विप्राग्थ्र न परार्थास्तदा मृताः /
परकार्यं न ये मर्त्याः कायेनापि धनेन वा //
text_mt: If human beings do not exist for the sake of others, O best of brahmins, then they are as dead. / Those mortals who do not accomplish the purpose of others by body, wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
manasā vacasā vāpi te jñeyāḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ /
atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ //
meaning:
मनसा वचसा वापि ते ज्ञेयाः पापकृत्तमाः /
अत्रेतिहासं वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: mind, or speech—they should be known as the worst evildoers. / In this regard I shall relate a historical account; listen to it accurately, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra dānādikānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam /
gaṅgāmāhātmyasahitaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
यत्र दानादिकानां तु लक्षणं परिकीर्तितम् /
गङ्गामाहात्म्यसहितं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: in which the characteristics of giving and the like are declared, / along with the eulogy of the greatness of Gaṅgā, destroying all sins:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathasya dharmasya saṃvādaṃ puṇyakāraṇam /
āsīdbhagīratho rājā sagarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
भगीरथस्य धर्मस्य संवादं पुण्यकारणम् /
आसीद्भगीरथो राजा सगरान्वयसंभवः //
text_mt: the dialogue between Bhagīratha and Dharma, which is a cause of merit. / There was a king named Bhagīratha, born in the lineage of Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ metāṃ satpadvīpāṃ sasāgarām /
sarvadharmarato nityaṃ satyasaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
शशास पृथिवीं मेतां सत्पद्वीपां ससागराम् /
सर्वधर्मरतो नित्यं सत्यसंधः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: He ruled this earth with its seven continents and oceans, / ever devoted to all dharmas, true to his word, majestic,

sanskrit_iast:
kandarpasaddaśo rupe yāyajṛko vicakṣaṇaḥ /
prāleyādrisamo dhairye dharme dharmasamo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
कन्दर्पसद्दशो रुपे यायजृको विचक्षणः /
प्रालेयाद्रिसमो धैर्ये धर्मे धर्मसमो नृपः //
text_mt: equal to the god of love in beauty, frequent performer of sacrifices, discerning, / equal to the snowy mountain in fortitude, and equal to Dharma in dharma was that king.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ /
sarvasaṃpatsamāyuktaḥ sarvānandakaro mune //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः /
सर्वसंपत्समायुक्तः सर्वानन्दकरो मुने //
text_mt: Endowed with all auspicious marks, gone to the end of the meaning of all scriptures, / accompanied by all prosperity, bringing joy to all, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
ātithyaprayato nityaṃ vāsudevārcanerataḥ /
parākramī guṇanidhirmaitraḥ kāruṇikaḥ sadhīḥ //
meaning:
आतिथ्यप्रयतो नित्यं वासुदेवार्चनेरतः /
पराक्रमी गुणनिधिर्मैत्रः कारुणिकः सधीः //
text_mt: always devoted to hospitality, intent upon worshipping Vāsudeva, / valorous, a treasure of virtues, friendly, compassionate, and wise.

sanskrit_iast:
etādṛśaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ jñātvā dṛṣṭo bhagīratham /
dharmarājo dvijaśreṣṭha kadāciddraṣṭumāgataḥ //
meaning:
एतादृशं तं राजानं ज्ञात्वा दृष्टो भगीरथम् /
धर्मराजो द्विजश्रेष्ठ कदाचिद्द्रष्टुमागतः //
text_mt: Knowing that king Bhagīratha to be such, and pleased, / the King of Dharma came at one time to see him, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgataṃ dharmarājamarhayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ /
śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā dharmaḥ prī uvāca tam //
meaning:
समागतं धर्मराजमर्हयामास भूपतिः /
शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना धर्मः प्री उवाच तम् //
text_mt: The king honoured the King of Dharma who had arrived, / according to the injunction seen in the scriptures. Pleased, Dharma said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca
rājandharmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaprasiddho 'si jagattraye /
dharmarājo 'tha kīrtiṃ te śrutvā tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ //
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच
राजन्धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठप्रसिद्धो ऽसि जगत्त्रये /
धर्मराजो ऽथ कीर्तिं ते श्रुत्वा त्वां द्रष्टुमागतः //
text_mt: The King of Dharma said: / O king, best among knowers of dharma, you are renowned in the three worlds. / Having heard of your fame, I, the King of Dharma, have come to see you.

sanskrit_iast:
sanmārganirataṃ satyaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam /
draṣṭumicchanti vibudhāratavo tkuṣṭaguṇapriyāḥ //
meaning:
सन्मार्गनिरतं सत्यं सर्वभूतहिते रतम् /
द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति विबुधारतवो त्कुष्टगुणप्रियाः //
text_mt: Devoted to the right path, truthful, delighting in the welfare of all beings— / the wise, who love superior virtues, wish to see such a one.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtirnītiśca saṃpattirvartate yatra bhūpate /
vasanti tatra niyataṃ guṇāḥsantaśca devatāḥ //
meaning:
कीर्तिर्नीतिश्च संपत्तिर्वर्तते यत्र भूपते /
वसन्ति तत्र नियतं गुणाःसन्तश्च देवताः //
text_mt: Where fame, policy, and prosperity exist, O king, / there the virtues, the good, and the deities certainly dwell.

sanskrit_iast:
aho rājanmahābhāga śobhanīcaritaṃ tava /
sarvabhūtahitatvādi mādṛśāmapi durlabham //
meaning:
अहो राजन्महाभाग शोभनीचरितं तव /
सर्वभूतहितत्वादि मादृशामपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Ah, O fortunate king, beautiful is your conduct! / Your devotion to the welfare of all beings and the like is difficult even for the likes of me to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ praṇipatya bhagīrathaḥ /
provāca vinayāviṣṭaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ ślakṣṇayā gitaṃ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तवन्तं तं धर्मं प्रणिपत्य भगीरथः /
प्रोवाच विनयाविष्टः संहृष्टः श्लक्ष्णया गितं //
text_mt: Bowing to Dharma who had spoken thus, / Bhagīratha, filled with humility and delighted, spoke in sweet words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīratha uvāca
bhagavansarvadharmajña samadarśit sureśvara /
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo yatpṛcchāmi vadasva tat //
meaning:
भगीरथ उवाच
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ समदर्शित् सुरेश्वर /
कृपया परयाविष्टो यत्पृच्छामि वदस्व तत् //
text_mt: Bhagīratha said: / O Blessed One, knower of all dharmas, impartial one, lord of the gods! / Impelled by supreme compassion, tell me that which I ask:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmā kīdṛgvidhāḥ proktāḥ ke lokā dharmaśālinām /
kiyatyo yātanāḥ proktāḥ keṣāṃ tāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मा कीदृग्विधाः प्रोक्ताः के लोका धर्मशालिनाम् /
कियत्यो यातनाः प्रोक्ताः केषां ताः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Of what kind are dharmas declared to be? Which worlds are for those possessed of dharma? / How many torments are declared, and for whom are they described?

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā saṃmānanīyā ye śāsanīyāśca ye yathā /
tatsarvaṃ me mahābhāga vistarādvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
त्वया संमाननीया ये शासनीयाश्च ये यथा /
तत्सर्वं मे महाभाग विस्तराद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Who should be honoured by you, and who punished, and how? / You ought to tell me all that in detail, O fortunate one.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahāvuddhe matiste vimalorjitā /
dharmādharmānpravakṣyāmitattvataḥ śṛṇu bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच
साधु साधु महावुद्धे मतिस्ते विमलोर्जिता /
धर्माधर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यामितत्त्वतः शृणु भक्तितः //
text_mt: The King of Dharma said: / Excellent, excellent, O great intellect! Your mind is spotless and vigorous. / I shall declare dharma and adharma accurately; listen with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmā bahuvidhāḥ proktāḥ puṇyalokapradāyakāḥ /
tathaiva yātanāḥ proktā asaṃkhyā ghoradarśatāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मा बहुविधाः प्रोक्ताः पुण्यलोकप्रदायकाः /
तथैव यातनाः प्रोक्ता असंख्या घोरदर्शताः //
text_mt: Many kinds of dharmas are declared, bestowing meritorious worlds; / likewise innumerable torments are declared, terrible to behold.

sanskrit_iast:
vistarādgadituṃ nālamapi varṣaśatāyutaiḥ /
tasmātaṃsamāsato vakṣye dharmādharmamidarśanam //
meaning:
विस्तराद्गदितुं नालमपि वर्षशतायुतैः /
तस्मातंसमासतो वक्ष्ये धर्माधर्ममिदर्शनम् //
text_mt: It is not possible to describe them in detail even in myriads of hundreds of years; / therefore I shall declare this teaching on dharma and adharma in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva yātanāṃ vai mahāpuṇyaṃ prakīrtatam /
tathaivādhyātmaviduṣo dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam //
meaning:
तथैव यातनां वै महापुण्यं प्रकीर्ततम् /
तथैवाध्यात्मविदुषो दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: Likewise, great merit is proclaimed concerning [deliverance from] torment; / likewise what is given to one who knows spiritual truth becomes inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭumbinaṃ yā śāstrajñaṃ śrotriyaṃ vā guṇānvitam /
yo dattvā syāpayedṛtiṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
कुटुम्बिनं या शास्त्रज्ञं श्रोत्रियं वा गुणान्वितम् /
यो दत्त्वा स्यापयेदृतिं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt: One who provides a livelihood, having given to a householder, / to one who knows scripture, or to a learned Vedic scholar endowed with virtues—hear the meritorious fruit of that:

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛtāḥ pitṛtaścaiva dvijaḥ koṭikulanvitaḥ /
nirviśya viṣṇubhavanaṃ kalpaṃ tatraiva mādate //
meaning:
मातृताः पितृतश्चैव द्विजः कोटिकुलन्वितः /
निर्विश्य विष्णुभवनं कल्पं तत्रैव मादते //
text_mt: along with a crore of families on the mother's side and on the father's side, / having entered the realm of Viṣṇu, he rejoices there for an eon.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇyante pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyante vṛṣṭivindavaḥ /
na gaṇyante vidhātrāpi brahahmavṛttiphalāni vai //
meaning:
गण्यन्ते पांसवो भूमेर्गण्यन्ते वृष्टिविन्दवः /
न गण्यन्ते विधात्रापि ब्रहह्मवृत्तिफलानि वै //
text_mt: The particles of dust on the earth can be counted, raindrops can be counted, / but the fruits of supporting brahmins cannot be counted even by the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
samastadevatārupo brāhmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
jīvanaṃ dadatastasya kaḥ puṇyaṃ gadituṃ kṣamaḥ //
meaning:
समस्तदेवतारुपो ब्राह्मणः परिकीर्तितः /
जीवनं ददतस्तस्य कः पुण्यं गदितुं क्षमः //
text_mt: A brahmin is proclaimed to be the form of all deities; / who is capable of describing the merit of one who gives a livelihood to him?

sanskrit_iast:
yo viprahitakṛnnityaṃ sa sarvānkṛtavānmakhān /
sa strātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu tatpaṃ tenākhilaṃ tapaḥ //
meaning:
यो विप्रहितकृन्नित्यं स सर्वान्कृतवान्मखान् /
स स्त्रातः सर्वतीर्थेषु तत्पं तेनाखिलं तपः //
text_mt: He who always acts for the welfare of brahmins has performed all sacrifices; / he has bathed at all sacred fords, and all austerity has been practised by him.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadasveti viprāṇāṃ jīvanaṃ prerayetparam /
so 'pi tatphalamāpnoti kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
यो ददस्वेति विप्राणां जीवनं प्रेरयेत्परम् /
सो ऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति किमन्यैर्बहुभाषितैः //
text_mt: He who incites another, saying, 'Give a livelihood to brahmins!'— / he too obtains that fruit. What need of speaking much further?

sanskrit_iast:
taḍāgaṃ kārayedyastu svayamevāpareṇa vā /
vaktuṃ tatpuṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ nālaṃ varṣaśatāyuṣā //
meaning:
तडागं कारयेद्यस्तु स्वयमेवापरेण वा /
वक्तुं तत्पुण्यसंख्यानं नालं वर्षशतायुषा //
text_mt: He who has a pond constructed, either by himself or through another— / a lifespan of a hundred years is not enough to recount the measure of that merit.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaścedadhvago rājaṃstaḍāgasya jalaṃ pibet /
katkartuḥ sarvapāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एकश्चेदध्वगो राजंस्तडागस्य जलं पिबेत् /
कत्कर्तुः सर्वपापानि नश्यन्त्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: If a single traveller should drink the water of that pond, O king, / all the sins of its builder are destroyed indeed, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhamaṣi yatkuryādbhūmisthamudakaṃ naraḥ /
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śatavarṣaṃ vaseddivi //
meaning:
एकाहमषि यत्कुर्याद्भूमिस्थमुदकं नरः /
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः शतवर्षं वसेद्दिवि //
text_mt: Even if a man should make water stand on the ground for a single day, / he, freed from all sins, dwells in heaven for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
kartuṃ taḍāgaṃ yo martyaḥ sāhyakaḥ śaktito bhavet /
so 'pi tatphalanāpnoti tuṣṭaḥ preraka eva ca //
meaning:
कर्तुं तडागं यो मर्त्यः साह्यकः शक्तितो भवेत् /
सो ऽपि तत्फलनाप्नोति तुष्टः प्रेरक एव च //
text_mt: Whatever mortal provides assistance according to his ability in making a pond— / he too, being pleased, and the one who incited it, obtains that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaṃ siddhārthamātrāṃ vā taḍāgādyo vahiḥ kṣipet /
tiṣṭatyabdaśataṃ svarge vimuktaḥ pāpakoṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
मृदं सिद्धार्थमात्रां वा तडागाद्यो वहिः क्षिपेत् /
तिष्टत्यब्दशतं स्वर्गे विमुक्तः पापकोटिभिः //
text_mt: He who casts out of a pond even clay measuring only a mustard seed / resides in heaven for a hundred years, freed from crores of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
devatā yasya tuṣyanti guravo vā nṛpottama /
taḍāgapuṇyabhāksa syādityeṣā śāśvatī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
देवता यस्य तुष्यन्ति गुरवो वा नृपोत्तम /
तडागपुण्यभाक्स स्यादित्येषा शाश्वती श्रुतिः //
text_mt: He with whom deities or teachers are pleased, O best of kings, / becomes a sharer in the merit of a pond: such is the eternal revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
iti hāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi tavātra nṛpasattama /
yaṃ śṛtvā sarvapāyebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
इति हासं प्रवक्ष्यामि तवात्र नृपसत्तम /
यं शृत्वा सर्वपायेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: In this regard I shall recount to you a historical account, O best of kings, / hearing which one is freed from all sins, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
gauḍadeśe 'tivikhyāto rājāsīdvīrabhadrakaḥ /
mahāpratīpī vidyāvānsadā vipraprapūjakaḥ //
meaning:
गौडदेशे ऽतिविख्यातो राजासीद्वीरभद्रकः /
महाप्रतीपी विद्यावान्सदा विप्रप्रपूजकः //
text_mt: In the Gauḍa country there was a very renowned king named Vīrabhadraka, / very valiant, learned, and always a worshipper of brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstrakulācārayukto mitrakvirdhanaḥ /
tasya rājñī mahābhāgā nānmā campakamañjarī //
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रकुलाचारयुक्तो मित्रक्विर्धनः /
तस्य राज्ञी महाभागा नान्मा चम्पकमञ्जरी //
text_mt: endowed with the conduct of the families of the Veda and scriptures, who increased [the joy of] friends. / His fortunate queen was named Campakamañjarī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya rājño mahāmātyāḥ kṛtmākṛsyavicāraṇāḥ /
dharmāṇāṃ dharmaśāstrestu sadā kurvanti niścayam //
meaning:
तस्य राज्ञो महामात्याः कृत्माकृस्यविचारणाः /
धर्माणां धर्मशास्त्रेस्तु सदा कुर्वन्ति निश्चयम् //
text_mt: The prime ministers of that king, discerning between what should and should not be done, / always made determination of dharmas in the treatises on dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ cikittsāṃ ca jyotiṣe dharmanirṇayam /
vināśāstreṇa yo brūyāttamāhurbrahmaghātakam //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं चिकित्त्सां च ज्योतिषे धर्मनिर्णयम् /
विनाशास्त्रेण यो ब्रूयात्तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम् //
text_mt: A penance, medical treatment, and a determination of duty in astrology— / one who states these without the scripture, him they call a slayer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
iti niścitya manasā manvādīritadharmkān /
ācāryebhyaḥ sadā bhūpaḥ śṛṇoti vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
इति निश्चित्य मनसा मन्वादीरितधर्म्कान् /
आचार्येभ्यः सदा भूपः शृणोति विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having resolved this in his mind, the king constantly heard according to rule / the duties proclaimed by Manu and others from his preceptors.

sanskrit_iast:
na ko 'pyanyāyavartī tasya rājye 'varo 'pi ca /
dharmeṇa pālyamānasya tasya deśasya bhūpateḥ //
meaning:
न को ऽप्यन्यायवर्ती तस्य राज्ये ऽवरो ऽपि च /
धर्मेण पाल्यमानस्य तस्य देशस्य भूपतेः //
text_mt: No one in his kingdom, even the lowliest, acted unjustly, / of that king whose land was protected in accordance with righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
jātaṃ samatvaṃ svargasya saurājyasya śubhāvaham /
sa caikadā tu nṛpatirmṛgayāyāṃ mahāvane //
meaning:
जातं समत्वं स्वर्गस्य सौराज्यस्य शुभावहम् /
स चैकदा तु नृपतिर्मृगयायां महावने //
text_mt: His good governance, which brought about auspiciousness, became equal to heaven. / And once that ruler of men, [engaged] in hunting in a great forest,

sanskrit_iast:
mantryādibhiḥ parivṛto babhrāma madhyabhāskaram /
daivādākheṭaśūnyasya hyatiśrāntasya tatra vai //
meaning:
मन्त्र्यादिभिः परिवृतो बभ्राम मध्यभास्करम् /
दैवादाखेटशून्यस्य ह्यतिश्रान्तस्य तत्र वै //
text_mt: surrounded by ministers and others, wandered about until the midday sun. / By chance, finding no game and being thoroughly exhausted there,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛparītasya saṃjātaṃ saraso darśanaṃ nṛpa /
tataḥ śuṣkāṃ tu sarasīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra vyacintayat //
meaning:
नृपरीतस्य संजातं सरसो दर्शनं नृप /
ततः शुष्कां तु सरसीं दृष्ट्वा तत्र व्यचिन्तयत् //
text_mt: the king, O king, caught sight of a lake. / Then, seeing the lake dried up, he reflected there:

sanskrit_iast:
kimayaṃ sarasīśṛṅgebhuvaḥ kena vinirmitā /
kathaṃ jalaṃ bhavedatra yena jīvedayaṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
किमयं सरसीशृङ्गेभुवः केन विनिर्मिता /
कथं जलं भवेदत्र येन जीवेदयं नृपः //
text_mt: "Why was this lake made on the ridges of the earth, and by whom? / How might there be water here, by which this king might live?"

sanskrit_iast:
tato buddhiḥ samabhavatkhāte tasyā nṛpottama /
hastamātraṃ tato garttaṃ khātvā toyamavātpavān //
meaning:
ततो बुद्धिः समभवत्खाते तस्या नृपोत्तम /
हस्तमात्रं ततो गर्त्तं खात्वा तोयमवात्पवान् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, the thought arose to dig in it. / Having dug a pit of just a cubit, he obtained water.

sanskrit_iast:
tena toyena pītena rājñastṛtpirajāyata /
mantriṇaścāpi bhūmiśa buddhisāgarasaṃjñinaḥ //
meaning:
तेन तोयेन पीतेन राज्ञस्तृत्पिरजायत /
मन्त्रिणश्चापि भूमिश बुद्धिसागरसंज्ञिनः //
text_mt: By drinking that water, satisfaction arose for the king / and also for the minister named Buddhisāgara, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa buddhisāgaro bhūpaṃ prāha dharmārthakovidaḥ /
rājanniyaṃ puṣkariṇī varṣājalavatī purā //
meaning:
स बुद्धिसागरो भूपं प्राह धर्मार्थकोविदः /
राजन्नियं पुष्करिणी वर्षाजलवती पुरा //
text_mt: That Buddhisāgara, skilled in righteousness and worldly welfare, said to the king: / "O king, in the past this pond possessed rainwater.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaināṃ baddhavaprāṃ ca karttuṃ jātā matirmama /
tadbhavānmodatāṃ deva dattādājñāṃ ca me 'nagha //
meaning:
अद्यैनां बद्धवप्रां च कर्त्तुं जाता मतिर्मम /
तद्भवान्मोदतां देव दत्तादाज्ञां च मे ऽनघ //
text_mt: Today my intention has arisen to make it enclosed with embankments. / Therefore, O lord, rejoice and give me your command, O sinless one."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvā vacastasya mantriṇo nṛpasattamaḥ /
mumude 'titarāṃ bhūpaḥ svayaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ //
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य मन्त्रिणो नृपसत्तमः /
मुमुदे ऽतितरां भूपः स्वयं कर्तुं समुद्यतः //
text_mt: Hearing these words of that minister, the best of kings, / the monarch rejoiced exceedingly, prepared to do it himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tameva mantriṇāṃ tatra yuyoja śubhakarmaṇi /
tato rājājñayā so 'pi buddhisāgarako mudā //
meaning:
तमेव मन्त्रिणां तत्र युयोज शुभकर्मणि /
ततो राजाज्ञया सो ऽपि बुद्धिसागरको मुदा //
text_mt: He appointed that very minister to that auspicious task. / Then, by the king's command, that Buddhisāgara also, with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
sarasīṃ sāgaraṃ karttumudyataḥ puṇyakṛttamaḥ /
dhanuṣāṃ caiva pañcāśatsarvato vistṛtāyatām //
meaning:
सरसीं सागरं कर्त्तुमुद्यतः पुण्यकृत्तमः /
धनुषां चैव पञ्चाशत्सर्वतो विस्तृतायताम् //
text_mt: best of doers of merit, undertook to make the lake into an ocean— / fifty bows in extent and length on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasīṃ baddhasu śilāṃ cakārāgādhaśambarām /
tāṃ vinirmāya sarasīṃ rājñe sarvaṃ nyavedayat //
meaning:
सरसीं बद्धसु शिलां चकारागाधशम्बराम् /
तां विनिर्माय सरसीं राज्ञे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: He made the lake bound with fine stones and filled with unfathomable water. / Having constructed that lake, he reported everything to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tataḥ prabhṛti vai sarve 'pi vanacāriṇaḥ /
pānthāḥ pipāsitā bhūpa labhante sma jalaṃ śubham //
meaning:
तस्यां ततः प्रभृति वै सर्वे ऽपि वनचारिणः /
पान्थाः पिपासिता भूप लभन्ते स्म जलं शुभम् //
text_mt: From then on, O king, all the forest-dwellers / and thirsty travelers obtained auspicious water in it.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitsvāyuṣaścānte sa mantrī buddhisāgaraḥ /
pramṛto gatavāṃllokaṃ lokaśāsturmama prabho //
meaning:
कदाचित्स्वायुषश्चान्ते स मन्त्री बुद्धिसागरः /
प्रमृतो गतवांल्लोकं लोकशास्तुर्मम प्रभो //
text_mt: Then, at the end of his lifespan, that minister Buddhisāgara / died and went to the world of me, the ruler of the world, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarthaṃ tu mayā pṛṣṭo dharmo dharmalipiṅkaraḥ /
citragutpastu tatkarma mahyaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat //
meaning:
तदर्थं तु मया पृष्टो धर्मो धर्मलिपिङ्करः /
चित्रगुत्पस्तु तत्कर्म मह्यं सर्वं न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: For his sake, I questioned the righteous scribe of deeds, / and Citragupta reported all his deeds to me:

sanskrit_iast:
upadeṣṭā svayaṃ cāsau dharmakāryasya bhūpateḥ /
tasmāddharmavimānaṃ tu samāroḍhumihārhati //
meaning:
उपदेष्टा स्वयं चासौ धर्मकार्यस्य भूपतेः /
तस्माद्धर्मविमानं तु समारोढुमिहार्हति //
text_mt: "He himself was the adviser for the king’s righteous work; / therefore he is worthy to mount the celestial chariot of righteousness here."

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte citragutpena samājñatpo mayā nṛpa /
vimānaṃ dharmasaṃjñaṃ tu āroḍhuṃ buddhisāgaraḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्ते चित्रगुत्पेन समाज्ञत्पो मया नृप /
विमानं धर्मसंज्ञं तु आरोढुं बुद्धिसागरः //
text_mt: When this was spoken by Citragupta, O king, Buddhisāgara / was ordered by me to mount the celestial chariot named Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kālāntare rājansarājā vīrabhadrakaḥ /
mṛto gato mama sthānaṃ namaścakre mudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अथ कालान्तरे राजन्सराजा वीरभद्रकः /
मृतो गतो मम स्थानं नमश्चक्रे मुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Then, after a period of time, O king, that king Vīrabhadraka / died and went to my abode, and full of joy, bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā tu tatra tasyāpi pṛṣṭaṃ karmākhilaṃ nṛpa /
kathitaṃ citragutpena dharmaṃ sarasisaṃbhavam //
meaning:
मया तु तत्र तस्यापि पृष्टं कर्माखिलं नृप /
कथितं चित्रगुत्पेन धर्मं सरसिसंभवम् //
text_mt: There I asked about all his deeds too, O king; / the righteousness arising from the lake was recounted by Citragupta.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā samyaṅmayā rājā bodhito 'bhūdyathāśṛṇu /
adhityakāyāṃ bhūpāla saikatasya gireḥ parā //
meaning:
तदा सम्यङ्मया राजा बोधितो ऽभूद्यथाशृणु /
अधित्यकायां भूपाल सैकतस्य गिरेः परा //
text_mt: Then the king was properly informed by me as follows; listen: / 'O protector of the earth, upon the plateau of the sandy mountain, long ago,

sanskrit_iast:
lāvakenāmunācañcvā khātaṃ dvyaṃṅguprambuni /
tataḥ kālāntare tena vārāheṇa nṛpottama //
meaning:
लावकेनामुनाचञ्च्वा खातं द्व्यंङ्गुप्रम्बुनि /
ततः कालान्तरे तेन वाराहेण नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: two finger-breadths of earth were dug with its beak by this quail. / Then, after a period of time, O best of kings, by that boar,

sanskrit_iast:
khanitaṃ hastamātraṃ tu jalaṃ tuṇḍena cātmanaḥ /
tato 'nyadāmuyā kālyāhasta yugmamitaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
खनितं हस्तमात्रं तु जलं तुण्डेन चात्मनः /
ततो ऽन्यदामुया काल्याहस्त युग्ममितः कृतः //
text_mt: a single cubit of earth was excavated with its own snout. / Then, at another time, a pit measuring two cubits was made

sanskrit_iast:
khāto jale mahārāja toyaṃ māsadvayaṃ sthitam /
pītaṃ kṣudrairvanacaraiḥ sattvaistṛṣṇāsamākulaiḥ //
meaning:
खातो जले महाराज तोयं मासद्वयं स्थितम् /
पीतं क्षुद्रैर्वनचरैः सत्त्वैस्तृष्णासमाकुलैः //
text_mt: in the water, O great king, and the water remained for two months; / it was drunk by small forest-dwelling creatures overcome with thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
tato varṣatrāyānte tu gajatānena suvrata /
hastatrayamitaḥ khātaḥ kṛtastatrādhikaṃ jalam //
meaning:
ततो वर्षत्रायान्ते तु गजतानेन सुव्रत /
हस्तत्रयमितः खातः कृतस्तत्राधिकं जलम् //
text_mt: Then, at the end of three years, O you of good vows, by a herd of elephants / a pit measuring three cubits was made, and there was more water there.

sanskrit_iast:
māsatraye sthitaṃ tacca payo jīvairvanecaraiḥ /
bhavāṃstatra samāyāto jalaśoṣāda nantaram //
meaning:
मासत्रये स्थितं तच्च पयो जीवैर्वनेचरैः /
भवांस्तत्र समायातो जलशोषाद नन्तरम् //
text_mt: That water remained for three months, [used] by forest-dwelling creatures. / You arrived there after the drying up of the water.

sanskrit_iast:
māse tatra tu saṃprātpaṃ hastaṃ khātvā jalaṃ nṛpa /
tatastasyopadeśena mantriṇo nṛpate tvayā //
meaning:
मासे तत्र तु संप्रात्पं हस्तं खात्वा जलं नृप /
ततस्तस्योपदेशेन मन्त्रिणो नृपते त्वया //
text_mt: In that month, O king, having dug a cubit, water was obtained there. / Then, by the advice of that minister, O king, by you

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśaddhanurutkhātaṃ jātaṃ tatatra mahājalam /
punaḥ śilābhiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ baddhaṃ jātaṃ mahatsaraḥ /
vṛkṣāśca ropitāstatra sarvalokopakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाशद्धनुरुत्खातं जातं ततत्र महाजलम् /
