पुनः शिलाभिः सुदृढं बद्धं जातं महत्सरः /
वृक्षाश्च रोपितास्तत्र सर्वलोकोपकारिणः //
text_mt: an excavation of fifty bows was made, and a great body of water came to be there; / furthermore, firmly built with stones, it became a great lake, / and trees were planted there, benefiting all people.

sanskrit_iast:
tena svasvena puṇyena pañcaite jagatīpate /
vimānaṃ dharmyamāruḍhāstvamāṇyenaṃ samāruha //
meaning:
तेन स्वस्वेन पुण्येन पञ्चैते जगतीपते /
विमानं धर्म्यमारुढास्त्वमाण्येनं समारुह //
text_mt: By that merit of each, O lord of the earth, these five / have mounted the righteous celestial chariot; you too, mount this one.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya mama rājā sa bhūmipa /
āruroha vimānaṃ tatṣaṣṭho rājā samāṃśabhāk //
meaning:
इति वाक्यं समाकर्ण्य मम राजा स भूमिप /
आरुरोह विमानं तत्षष्ठो राजा समांशभाक् //
text_mt: Hearing these words of mine, O king, that ruler of the earth / mounted that celestial chariot, being the sixth and sharing an equal portion.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ taḍāgajanitaṃ phalam /
śrutvaitanmucyate pāpādājanmamaraṇāntikāt //
meaning:
इति ते सर्वमाख्यातं तडागजनितं फलम् /
श्रुत्वैतन्मुच्यते पापादाजन्ममरणान्तिकात् //
text_mt: Thus has the entire fruit born of [making] a reservoir been told to you. / Hearing this, one is freed from sin from birth until the end of death.

sanskrit_iast:
yo naraḥ śraddhayo yukto vyākhyātaṃ śruṇuyātpaṭhet /
so 'pyāpnotyakhilaṃ puṇyaṃ saronirmāṇasaṃbhavam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmākhyāne dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यो नरः श्रद्धयो युक्तो व्याख्यातं श्रुणुयात्पठेत् /
सो ऽप्याप्नोत्यखिलं पुण्यं सरोनिर्माणसंभवम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे धर्माख्याने द्वादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
A person endowed with faith who hears or recites this explanation / also obtains all the merit born of the construction of a lake.

Thus ends the twelfth chapter in the discourse on righteousness in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca
devatāyatanaṃ yastu kurute kārayatyapi /
śivasyāpi harervāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच
देवतायतनं यस्तु कुरुते कारयत्यपि /
शिवस्यापि हरेर्वापि तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt: Dharmarāja said: / Whoever builds or causes to be built an abode for a deity, / whether of Śiva or of Hari, hear the meritorious fruit of that.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaścaiva lakṣakoṭikulānvitaḥ /
kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade tiṣṭatyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मातृतः पितृतश्चैव लक्षकोटिकुलान्वितः /
कल्पत्रयं विष्णुपदे तिष्टत्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: Accompanied by a hundred thousand crores of families on his mother's and father's sides, / he remains in the realm of Viṣṇu for three kalpas; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ niraḥ /
mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ naraḥ /
yāvatpuṇyaṃ bhavettasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
मृदैव कुरुते यस्तु देवतायतनं निरः /
मृदैव कुरुते यस्तु देवतायतनं नरः /
यावत्पुण्यं भवेत्तस्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु //
text_mt: A man who makes an abode for a deity out of mere clay— / a man who makes an abode for a deity out of mere clay, / hear from me as I tell what merit belongs to him:

sanskrit_iast:
divyadehadharo bhūtvā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ /
kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade tiṣṭatyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यदेहधरो भूत्वा विमानवरमास्थितः /
कल्पत्रयं विष्णुपदे तिष्टत्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: Assuming a divine body and seated on an excellent celestial chariot, / he remains in the realm of Viṣṇu for three kalpas; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaiva kurute yastu devatāyatanaṃ naraḥ /
yāvatpuṇyaṃ bhavettasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
मृदैव कुरुते यस्तु देवतायतनं नरः /
यावत्पुण्यं भवेत्तस्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु //
text_mt: A man who makes an abode for a deity out of mere clay, / hear from me as I tell what merit belongs to him:

sanskrit_iast:
divyadehadharo bhūtvā vimānavaramāsthitaḥ /
kalpatrayaṃ viṣṇupade sthitvā brahmapuraṃ vrajet //
meaning:
दिव्यदेहधरो भूत्वा विमानवरमास्थितः /
कल्पत्रयं विष्णुपदे स्थित्वा ब्रह्मपुरं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Assuming a divine body and seated on an excellent celestial chariot, / having stayed in the realm of Viṣṇu for three kalpas, he goes to the city of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpavadvayaṃ sthitastatra punaḥ kalpaṃ vaseddivi /
tatastu yogināmeva kule jāto dayonvitāḥ //
meaning:
कल्पवद्वयं स्थितस्तत्र पुनः कल्पं वसेद्दिवि /
ततस्तु योगिनामेव कुले जातो दयोन्विताः //
text_mt: Having stayed there for two kalpas, he dwells again in heaven for a kalpa; / then, born in the family of yogins, endowed with compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya muktiṃ vrajati śāśvatīm /
dārubhiḥ kurute yastu tasya syāddiguṇaṃ phalam //
meaning:
वैष्णवं योगमास्थाय मुक्तिं व्रजति शाश्वतीम् /
दारुभिः कुरुते यस्तु तस्य स्याद्दिगुणं फलम् //
text_mt: resorting to Vaiṣṇava yoga, he attains eternal liberation. / For one who makes [it] with wood, there is double the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇaṃ ceṣṭakābhistu śilābhistaccaturgaṇam /
sphuṭikābhiḥ śilābhistu jñeyaṃ daśaguṇottaram //
meaning:
त्रिगुणं चेष्टकाभिस्तु शिलाभिस्तच्चतुर्गणम् /
स्फुटिकाभिः शिलाभिस्तु ज्ञेयं दशगुणोत्तरम् //
text_mt: It is threefold with bricks, and fourfold with stones; / with crystal stones it is to be known as tenfold higher.

sanskrit_iast:
tānmībhistacchataguṇaṃ hemnā koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet /
devālayaṃ taḍāgaṃ vā grāmaṃ vā pālayettu yaḥ //
meaning:
तान्मीभिस्तच्छतगुणं हेम्ना कोटिगुणं भवेत् /
देवालयं तडागं वा ग्रामं वा पालयेत्तु यः //
text_mt: With copper it is a hundredfold, and with gold it becomes a crore of times. / One who protects a temple, a reservoir, or a village,

sanskrit_iast:
kartuḥ śataguṇaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ bhavati bhūpate /
devālayasya śuśrūṣāṃ lepasecanamaṇḍanaiḥ //
meaning:
कर्तुः शतगुणं तस्य पुण्यं भवति भूपते /
देवालयस्य शुश्रूषां लेपसेचनमण्डनैः //
text_mt: his merit becomes a hundred times that of the builder, O lord of the earth. / One who constantly performs service to a temple with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādyatsatataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyamanantakam /
vetanādviṣṭito vāpi puṇyakarmapravarttitāḥ //
meaning:
कुर्याद्यत्सततं भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यमनन्तकम् /
वेतनाद्विष्टितो वापि पुण्यकर्मप्रवर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: by plastering, sprinkling, and adorning, his merit is endless. / Those who engage in meritorious deeds, whether for wages or unpaid labor,

sanskrit_iast:
te gacchanti dharādhārāḥ śāścataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
tāḍāgārddhaphalaṃ rājankāsāre parikīrtitam //
meaning:
ते गच्छन्ति धराधाराः शाश्चतं वैष्णवं पदम् /
ताडागार्द्धफलं राजन्कासारे परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: those upholders of the earth go to the eternal abode of Viṣṇu. / Half the fruit of a reservoir, O king, is proclaimed for a small pond.

sanskrit_iast:
kūpe pādaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ vāpyāṃ padmākaronmitam /
vāpīśataguṇaṃ proktaṃ kulyāyāṃ bhūpateḥ phalam //
meaning:
कूपे पादफलं ज्ञेयं वाप्यां पद्माकरोन्मितम् /
वापीशतगुणं प्रोक्तं कुल्यायां भूपतेः फलम् //
text_mt: A fourth of the fruit is known to come from a well, and the fruit equal to a lotus pond comes from a step-well; / for a canal, O king, a hundredfold the fruit of a step-well is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣadbhistudhanīḥkuryānmṛdā niṣkiñcano janaḥ /
tayoḥ phalaṃ samānaṃ syādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
दृषद्भिस्तुधनीःकुर्यान्मृदा निष्किञ्चनो जनः /
तयोः फलं समानं स्यादित्याह कमलोद्भवः //
text_mt: A wealthy man might make [one] with stones, whereas an indigent man [does so] with earth; / the fruit of both is equal: thus said the lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādāḍhyāstu nagaraṃ hastamātramakiñcanaḥ /
bhuvaṃ tayoḥ samaphalaṃ prāhurvedavido janāḥ //
meaning:
दद्यादाढ्यास्तु नगरं हस्तमात्रमकिञ्चनः /
भुवं तयोः समफलं प्राहुर्वेदविदो जनाः //
text_mt: A wealthy man might give a city, while a penniless man [gives] merely a cubit of land; / people who know the Vedas say the fruit of both is equal.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanāḍhyaḥ kurute yastu taḍāgaṃ phalasādhanam /
daridraḥ kurute kūpaṃ samaṃ puṇyaṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
धनाढ्यः कुरुते यस्तु तडागं फलसाधनम् /
दरिद्रः कुरुते कूपं समं पुण्यं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: When a man rich in wealth makes a reservoir that yields results, / and a poor man makes a well, the religious merit is proclaimed to be equal.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramaṃ kārayedyastu bahujantūpakārakam /
sa yāti brahmabhuvanaṃ kulatrayasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
आश्रमं कारयेद्यस्तु बहुजन्तूपकारकम् /
स याति ब्रह्मभुवनं कुलत्रयसमन्वितः //
text_mt: He who causes an hermitage to be built, which benefits many living beings, / goes to the realm of Brahmā together with three generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenurvā brahmaṇo vāpi yo vā ko vāpi bhūpate /
kṣaṇārddhaṃ tasya chāyāyāṃ tiṣṭansvargaṃ nayatyamum //
meaning:
धेनुर्वा ब्रह्मणो वापि यो वा को वापि भूपते /
क्षणार्द्धं तस्य छायायां तिष्टन्स्वर्गं नयत्यमुम् //
text_mt: Whether a cow, or a brāhmaṇa, or whoever it may be, O king, / standing in its shade for half an instant leads him to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmakārakā rājandevatāgṛhakāriṇaḥ /
taḍāgagrāmakarttāraḥ pūjyante hariṇā saha //
meaning:
आरामकारका राजन्देवतागृहकारिणः /
तडागग्रामकर्त्तारः पूज्यन्ते हरिणा सह //
text_mt: Those who plant groves, O king, who build houses for deities, / and who construct reservoirs and villages, are honoured alongside Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokopakārārthaṃ puṣpārāmaṃ janeśvarā /
kurvate devatārthaṃ vā teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
सर्वलोकोपकारार्थं पुष्पारामं जनेश्वरा /
कुर्वते देवतार्थं वा तेषां पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit of those who, for the benefit of all the world / or for the sake of a deity, create a flower garden, O lord of men:

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yāvanti parṇāni kusumāni bhavanti ca /
tāvadvarṣāṇi nākastho modate kulakoṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
तत्र यावन्ति पर्णानि कुसुमानि भवन्ति च /
तावद्वर्षाणि नाकस्थो मोदते कुलकोटिभिः //
text_mt: As many leaves and flowers as there are in that place, / for that many years he rejoices in heaven with ten million generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
prākārakāriṇastasya kaṇṭakāvaraṇapradāḥ /
prayānti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yugānāmekasatpatim //
meaning:
प्राकारकारिणस्तस्य कण्टकावरणप्रदाः /
प्रयान्ति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं युगानामेकसत्पतिम् //
text_mt: Those who build an enclosure wall around it, who provide a fence of thorns, / go to the abode of Brahmā for seventy-one yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīropaṇaṃ ye tu kurtate manuje śvara /
teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ rājanvadato me niśāmaya //
meaning:
तुलसीरोपणं ये तु कुर्तते मनुजे श्वर /
तेषां पुण्यफलं राजन्वदतो मे निशामय //
text_mt: Those who plant tulasī, O lord of men— / hear from me as I proclaim the fruit of their religious merit, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
satpakoṭikulairyukto mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā /
vasetkalpaśataṃ sāgraṃ nārāyaṇapadaṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
सत्पकोटिकुलैर्युक्तो मातृतः पितृतस्तथा /
वसेत्कल्पशतं साग्रं नारायणपदं नृप //
text_mt: Accompanied by seventy million family members, both on his mother’s and his father’s side, / he shall dwell for more than a hundred kalpas in the abode of Nārāyaṇa, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhapuṇḍradharo yastu tulasīmūlamṛtstrayā /
gopikācandanenāpi citrakūṭamṛdāpi vā /
gaṅgāmṛtikayā caiva tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
ऊर्द्धपुण्ड्रधरो यस्तु तुलसीमूलमृत्स्त्रया /
गोपिकाचन्दनेनापि चित्रकूटमृदापि वा /
गङ्गामृतिकया चैव तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt: Hear the meritorious fruit of him who wears the ūrdhvapuṇḍra with clay from the root of a tulasī, / or with gopīcandana, or with clay from Citrakūṭa, / or with earth from the Gaṅgā:

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāruḍho gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ /
saṃgīyamānacarito modate viṣṇuṃmadire //
meaning:
विमानवरमारुढो गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः /
संगीयमानचरितो मोदते विष्णुंमदिरे //
text_mt: Mounted on an excellent celestial chariot, his deeds sung / by hosts of gandharvas and apsarases, he rejoices in the temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
patrāṇi tulasīmūlādyāvanti patitāni vai /
tāvanti brahmahatyādipātakāni hatāni ca //
meaning:
पत्राणि तुलसीमूलाद्यावन्ति पतितानि वै /
तावन्ति ब्रह्महत्यादिपातकानि हतानि च //
text_mt: As many leaves as fall from the base of the tulasī, / so many sins, such as the murder of a brāhmaṇa, are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasyāṃ secayedyastu jalaṃ culukamātrakam /
kṣīrodavāsinā sārddhaṃ vasedācandratārakam //
meaning:
तुलस्यां सेचयेद्यस्तु जलं चुलुकमात्रकम् /
क्षीरोदवासिना सार्द्धं वसेदाचन्द्रतारकम् //
text_mt: He who pours even a mere handful of water upon a tulasī / shall dwell together with the dweller of the Milk Ocean as long as the moon and stars endure.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti brāhmaṇānāṃ yaḥ komalaṃ tulasīdalam /
sa yāti brahmasadane kulatritayatasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
ददाति ब्राह्मणानां यः कोमलं तुलसीदलम् /
स याति ब्रह्मसदने कुलत्रितयतसंयुतः //
text_mt: He who gives a tender tulasī leaf to brāhmaṇas / goes to the abode of Brahmā accompanied by three generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
śālaprāmer'payedyastu tulasyāstu dalāni ca /
sa vasedviṣṇubhavane yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
शालप्रामेर्ऽपयेद्यस्तु तुलस्यास्तु दलानि च /
स वसेद्विष्णुभवने यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: He who offers tulasī leaves upon a śālagrāma stone / shall dwell in the abode of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭakāvaraṇaṃ yastu prākāraṃ vāpi kārayet /
so 'pyekaviṃśatikulairmodate viṣṇumandire //
meaning:
कण्टकावरणं यस्तु प्राकारं वापि कारयेत् /
सो ऽप्येकविंशतिकुलैर्मोदते विष्णुमन्दिरे //
text_mt: He who provides a thorny fence or an enclosure wall [for it], / he too rejoices in the temple of Viṣṇu with twenty-one generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'rccayeddharipādābjaṃ tulasyāḥ komalairdalaiḥ /
na tasya punarāvṛttirviṣṇulokānnareśvara //
meaning:
यो ऽर्च्चयेद्धरिपादाब्जं तुलस्याः कोमलैर्दलैः /
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्विष्णुलोकान्नरेश्वर //
text_mt: He who worships the lotus feet of Hari with tender leaves of tulasī / has no return from the world of Viṣṇu, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yaḥ kṣīreṇa snāpayeddharim /
kulāyutayutaḥ so 'pi modate vaiṣṇave pade //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां पौर्णमास्यां यः क्षीरेण स्नापयेद्धरिम् /
कुलायुतयुतः सो ऽपि मोदते वैष्णवे पदे //
text_mt: He who bathes Hari with milk on the twelfth lunar day or the full moon day / also rejoices in the abode of Viṣṇu, joined by ten thousand generations.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthamātreṇa payasā yaḥ snāpayati keśavam /
kulāyutāyutayutaḥ so 'pi viṣṇupure vaset //
meaning:
प्रस्थमात्रेण पयसा यः स्नापयति केशवम् /
कुलायुतायुतयुतः सो ऽपि विष्णुपुरे वसेत् //
text_mt: He who bathes Keśava with a prastha measure of milk / shall dwell in the city of Viṣṇu, joined by ten thousand myriads of generations.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtaprasthena yo viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ snāpayennaraḥ /
kulakoṭiyuto rājansāyujyaṃ labhate hareḥ //
meaning:
घृतप्रस्थेन यो विष्णुं द्वादश्यां स्नापयेन्नरः /
कुलकोटियुतो राजन्सायुज्यं लभते हरेः //
text_mt: The man who bathes Viṣṇu with a prastha of ghee on the twelfth lunar day, / joined by ten million generations, attains union with Hari, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtena yaḥ snānamekādaśyāṃ tu kārayet /
viṣṇoḥ sāyujyakaṃ tasya bhavetyulaśatāyutaiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चामृतेन यः स्नानमेकादश्यां तु कारयेत् /
विष्णोः सायुज्यकं तस्य भवेत्युलशतायुतैः //
text_mt: He who performs the bath [of Viṣṇu] with the five nectars on the eleventh lunar day / attains union with Viṣṇu along with a million generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā nṛpottama /
nālikerodakairviṣṇuṃ snāpayettatphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
एकादश्यां पौर्णमास्यां द्वादश्यां वा नृपोत्तम /
नालिकेरोदकैर्विष्णुं स्नापयेत्तत्फलं शृणु //
text_mt: If one bathes Viṣṇu with coconut water on the eleventh, the full moon, / or the twelfth lunar day, O best of kings, hear that fruit:

sanskrit_iast:
daśajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairvimukto nṛpasattama /
śatadvayakulairyukto modate viṣṇunā saha //
meaning:
दशजन्मार्जितैः पापैर्विमुक्तो नृपसत्तम /
शतद्वयकुलैर्युक्तो मोदते विष्णुना सह //
text_mt: Liberated from the sins accumulated across ten births, O best of kings, / accompanied by two hundred generations of his family, he rejoices with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣutoyena deveśaṃ yaḥ snāpayati bhūpate /
keśavaṃ lakṣapitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
इक्षुतोयेन देवेशं यः स्नापयति भूपते /
केशवं लक्षपितृभिः सार्द्धं विष्णुपदं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He who bathes Keśava, the lord of the gods, with sugarcane juice, O king, / goes to the abode of Viṣṇu together with a hundred thousand ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpodakena govindaṃ tathā gandhodakena ca /
snāpayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā vaiṣṇavaṃ padamānpuyāt //
meaning:
पुष्पोदकेन गोविन्दं तथा गन्धोदकेन च /
स्नापयित्वा हरिं भक्त्या वैष्णवं पदमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: Having bathed Govinda with flower-water and likewise with fragrant water, / having bathed Hari with devotion, one attains the abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
jalena vastrapūtena yaḥ snāpayati mādhavam /
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇunā saha modate //
meaning:
जलेन वस्त्रपूतेन यः स्नापयति माधवम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुना सह मोदते //
text_mt: He who bathes Mādhava with water purified through a cloth, / freed from all sins, rejoices with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrādyaiḥ snāpayedyastu ravisaṃkramaṇe harim /
sa vasedviṣṇusadane trisatpapuruṣaiḥ saha //
meaning:
क्षीराद्यैः स्नापयेद्यस्तु रविसंक्रमणे हरिम् /
स वसेद्विष्णुसदने त्रिसत्पपुरुषैः सह //
text_mt: He who bathes Hari with milk and other substances at a solar transit / shall dwell in the abode of Viṣṇu along with twenty-one generations.

sanskrit_iast: śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇimādine //
meaning: शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यामष्टम्यां पूर्णिमादिने //
text_mt: On the fourteenth, the eighth, or the full moon day in the bright fortnight;

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ bhānuvāre dvādaśyāṃ pañcamītithau /
somasūryoparāge ca manvādiṣuyugādiṣu //
meaning:
एकादश्यां भानुवारे द्वादश्यां पञ्चमीतिथौ /
सोमसूर्योपरागे च मन्वादिषुयुगादिषु //
text_mt: on an eleventh day, on a Sunday, on a twelfth, on a fifth lunar day, / during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, on the beginnings of Manvantaras and of Yugas;

sanskrit_iast:
arddhodaye ca sūryasya puṣyārke rohiṇībudhe /
tathaiva śaniro hiṇyāṃ bhaumāśvinyāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अर्द्धोदये च सूर्यस्य पुष्यार्के रोहिणीबुधे /
तथैव शनिरो हिण्यां भौमाश्विन्यां तथैव च //
text_mt: at the Ardhodaya of the sun, on Puṣyārka, on Rohiṇī-Budha, / and likewise on Śani-Rohiṇī, and likewise on Bhaumāśvinī;

sanskrit_iast:
śanyāṃ bhṛvabhṛge caivabhṛgurevurevatisaṅgame /
tathā budhānurādhāyāṃ śravaṇārke tathaiva ca //
meaning:
शन्यां भृवभृगे चैवभृगुरेवुरेवतिसङ्गमे /
तथा बुधानुराधायां श्रवणार्के तथैव च //
text_mt: on Śani joined with Ārdrā, on Bhṛgu joined with Revatī, / likewise on Budhānurādhā, and likewise on Śravaṇārka;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca somaśravaṇe hastayukte bṛhaspatau /
budhāṣṭamyāṃ budhāṣāḍhe puṇye vine tathā //
meaning:
तथा च सोमश्रवणे हस्तयुक्ते बृहस्पतौ /
बुधाष्टम्यां बुधाषाढे पुण्ये विने तथा //
text_mt: and likewise on Soma-Śravaṇa, on Bṛhaspati joined with Hasta, / on Budhāṣṭamī, on Budhāṣāḍha, and on a sacred day:

sanskrit_iast:
strāpaye tpayasā viṣṇuṃ śāntimān vāgyataḥ śuciḥ /
ghṛtena madhunā vāpi dadhnā vā tatphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
स्त्रापये त्पयसा विष्णुं शान्तिमान् वाग्यतः शुचिः /
घृतेन मधुना वापि दध्ना वा तत्फलं शृणु //
text_mt: peaceful, restrained in speech, and pure, if one bathes Viṣṇu with milk, / or with ghee, or with honey, or with curds, hear the fruit thereof:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpye sarvapāpavivaparjitaḥ /
vaseṣṭiṣṇupure sārdaṃ trisatpapuruṣairmṛpa //
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्ये सर्वपापविवपर्जितः /
वसेष्टिष्णुपुरे सार्दं त्रिसत्पपुरुषैर्मृप //
text_mt: Having attained the fruit of all sacrifices, freed from all sins, / he shall dwell in the city of Viṣṇu together with twenty-one generations, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva jñānamāsādya yogināmapi durlabham /
mokṣamāproti nṛpate punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
तत्रैव ज्ञानमासाद्य योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् /
मोक्षमाप्रोति नृपते पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Attaining right there the knowledge that is difficult even for yogins to obtain, / he attains liberation, O king, from which return is rare.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśaayāṃ somavāre ca bhūpate /
śivaṃ saṃstrāpya dugdhena śivasāyujyamānpuyāt //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशअयां सोमवारे च भूपते /
शिवं संस्त्राप्य दुग्धेन शिवसायुज्यमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day in the dark fortnight and on a Monday, O king, / having bathed Śiva with milk, one attains union with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
nālikerodakenāpi śivaṃ saṃstrāpya bhaktitaḥ /
aṣṭamyāminduvāre vā śivasāyujyamaśnute //
meaning:
नालिकेरोदकेनापि शिवं संस्त्राप्य भक्तितः /
अष्टम्यामिन्दुवारे वा शिवसायुज्यमश्नुते //
text_mt: Having bathed Śiva with coconut water with devotion / on the eighth or on a Monday, one attains union with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāmaṣyamyāṃ vāpi bhūpate /
ghṛtena madhunā strāpya śivāṃ tatsāmyatāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यामष्यम्यां वापि भूपते /
घृतेन मधुना स्त्राप्य शिवां तत्साम्यतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: On the fourteenth or on the eighth day in the bright fortnight, O king, / having bathed Śiva with ghee and honey, one attains equality with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tilatailena saṃstrāpya viṣṇuṃ vā śivamevaṃ ca /
sa yāti tattatsārupyaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha satpabhiḥ //
meaning:
तिलतैलेन संस्त्राप्य विष्णुं वा शिवमेवं च /
स याति तत्तत्सारुप्यं पितृभिः सह सत्पभिः //
text_mt: Having bathed Viṣṇu or Śiva with sesame oil, / he attains resemblance in form to each of them together with seven ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
śivamiśrurasenāpi yaḥ snāpayati bhaghaktitaḥ /
śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ sasatpapuruṣaiḥ saha //
meaning:
शिवमिश्रुरसेनापि यः स्नापयति भघक्तितः /
शिवलोके वसेत्कल्पं ससत्पपुरुषैः सह //
text_mt: He who bathes Śiva with sugarcane juice with devotion / shall dwell in the world of Śiva for a kalpa together with seven generations.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena snāpayelliṅgamutthāne dvādaśīdine /
kṣīreṇa vā mahābhāga tatphalaṃ śṛṇu madgirā //
meaning:
घृतेन स्नापयेल्लिङ्गमुत्थाने द्वादशीदिने /
क्षीरेण वा महाभाग तत्फलं शृणु मद्गिरा //
text_mt: One who bathes the liṅga with ghee on the Utthāna twelfth lunar day, / or with milk, O fortunate one, hear that fruit from my words:

sanskrit_iast:
janmāyutakṛtakaiḥ pāpairdarmukto manujo nṛpa /
koṭi saṃkhyaṃ samuddhṛkatya svakulaṃ śivatāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
जन्मायुतकृतकैः पापैर्दर्मुक्तो मनुजो नृप /
कोटि संख्यं समुद्धृकत्य स्वकुलं शिवतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Freed from the sins committed in ten thousand births, O man, O king, / having delivered his own family to the number of ten million, he attains Śivahood.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya gandhakusumairviṣṇuṃ viṣṇutithau nṛpa /
janmāyutārjitaiḥ pāpairmukto vrajati tatpadam //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य गन्धकुसुमैर्विष्णुं विष्णुतिथौ नृप /
जन्मायुतार्जितैः पापैर्मुक्तो व्रजति तत्पदम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Viṣṇu with fragrant scents and flowers on a lunar day sacred to Viṣṇu, O king, / freed from sins accumulated in ten thousand births, he goes to His abode.

sanskrit_iast:
padmapuṣpeṇa yo viṣṇuṃ śivāṃ vā pūjayennaraḥ /
sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ kulakoṭisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
पद्मपुष्पेण यो विष्णुं शिवां वा पूजयेन्नरः /
स याति विष्णुभवनं कुलकोटिसमन्वितः //
text_mt: A man who worships Viṣṇu or Śiva with a lotus flower / goes to the abode of Viṣṇu accompanied by ten million generations of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ ca ketakīpuṣpaiḥ śivaṃ dhattūrajairniśi /
saṃpūjya pāpanirmukto vasedbhiṣṇupure yugam //
meaning:
हरिं च केतकीपुष्पैः शिवं धत्तूरजैर्निशि /
संपूज्य पापनिर्मुक्तो वसेद्भिष्णुपुरे युगम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Hari with ketakī flowers, and Śiva with those born of the dhattūra at night, / freed from sin, he shall dwell in the city of Viṣṇu for a yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ tu cāmpakaiḥ purṣperarkaṣpaiśca śaṅkaram /
samabhyarcya mahārāja tattatsālokyamānpuyāt //
meaning:
हरिं तु चाम्पकैः पुर्ष्पेरर्कष्पैश्च शङ्करम् /
समभ्यर्च्य महाराज तत्तत्सालोक्यमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Hari with campaka flowers and Śaṅkara with arka flowers, / O great king, he attains co-residence in each of their realms.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkara syāthavā viṣṇorghṛtayuktaṃ ca gugagulum /
dattvā dhūpe naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
शङ्कर स्याथवा विष्णोर्घृतयुक्तं च गुगगुलुम् /
दत्त्वा धूपे नरो भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Offering guggulu combined with ghee in incense / to Śaṅkara or Viṣṇu with devotion, a man is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tilatailānvitaṃ dīpaṃ viṣṇorvā śaṅkarasya vā /
dattvā naraḥ sarvakāmānmaṃprāpnoti nṛpottama //
meaning:
तिलतैलान्वितं दीपं विष्णोर्वा शङ्करस्य वा /
दत्त्वा नरः सर्वकामान्मंप्राप्नोति नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: Offering a lamp supplied with sesame oil to Viṣṇu or Śaṅkara, / a man attains all desires, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena dīpaṃ yo dadyācchaṅkarāyātha viṣṇave /
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
घृतेन दीपं यो दद्याच्छङ्करायाथ विष्णवे /
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो गङ्गास्नानफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Whoever gives a lamp with ghee to Śaṅkara or to Viṣṇu, / freed from all sins, obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmayena vāpi tailena rājannanyena vā punaḥ /
dīpaṃ tattvā mahāviṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi phalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
ग्रामयेन वापि तैलेन राजन्नन्येन वा पुनः /
दीपं तत्त्वा महाविष्णोः शिवस्यापि फलं शृणु //
text_mt: Or with common oil, O king, or indeed with another oil, / offering a lamp to Mahāviṣṇu or to Śiva, hear the fruit:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ /
tattatsālokyamāpnoti triḥbhatpapuruṣānvitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः /
तत्तत्सालोक्यमाप्नोति त्रिःभत्पपुरुषान्वितः //
text_mt: Completely freed from all sins, endowed with all sovereignty, / he attains the same world as each of them, accompanied by twenty-one generations.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhojyaṃ tattadīśāya viṣṇave /
dattvā tattatpadaṃ yāti catvāriśatkulānvitaḥ //
meaning:
यद्यदिष्टतमं भोज्यं तत्तदीशाय विष्णवे /
दत्त्वा तत्तत्पदं याति चत्वारिशत्कुलान्वितः //
text_mt: Offering whatever food is dearest to the Lord, to Viṣṇu, / he goes to that deity's abode, accompanied by forty generations.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ vastu natadviprāya dāpayet /
sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
यद्यदिष्टतमं वस्तु नतद्विप्राय दापयेत् /
स याति विष्णुभवनं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Whatever thing is dearest, if he gives it to a brāhmaṇa, / he goes to the abode of Viṣṇu, from which return is hard to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūṇahāsvarṇadānena śuddho bhavati bhūpate /
annatoyasamandānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
भ्रूणहास्वर्णदानेन शुद्धो भवति भूपते /
अन्नतोयसमन्दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति //
text_mt: By giving gold, the killer of an embryo becomes pure, O king; / a gift equal to food and water has never been, nor will ever be.

sanskrit_iast:
annadaḥ prāṇadaḥ proktaḥ prāṇadaścāpi sarvadaḥ /
sarvadānaphalaṃ yasmādannadasya nṛpottama //
meaning:
अन्नदः प्राणदः प्रोक्तः प्राणदश्चापि सर्वदः /
सर्वदानफलं यस्मादन्नदस्य नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: The giver of food is said to be the giver of life, and the giver of life gives all, / since the fruit of all gifts belongs to the giver of food, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
annado brahmasadanaṃ yātivaṃśāyutānvitaḥ /
na tasya punarāvṛttiriti śāstreṣu niścitam //
meaning:
अन्नदो ब्रह्मसदनं यातिवंशायुतान्वितः /
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिरिति शास्त्रेषु निश्चितम् //
text_mt: The giver of food goes to Brahmā's abode accompanied by ten thousand of his lineage; / he has no return, so it is determined in the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ jñeyaṃ jaladānaṃ yato 'dhikam /
annadānānnṛpaśreṣṭha nirdiṣṭaṃ śrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
सद्यस्तुष्टिकरं ज्ञेयं जलदानं यतो ऽधिकम् /
अन्नदानान्नृपश्रेष्ठ निर्दिष्टं श्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: The giving of water should be known as instantly satisfying, and because it is superior / to the gift of food, O best of kings, it is proclaimed by the expounders of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ /
jalado mucyate tebhya ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वाप्युपपातकैः /
जलदो मुच्यते तेभ्य इत्याह कमलोद्भवः //
text_mt: Whether joined with mortal sins or joined with secondary sins, / the giver of water is freed from them—so said the lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
śarīramannājaṃ prāhuḥ prāṇāmapyannajānviduḥ /
tasmādannaprado jñeyaḥ prāṇadaḥ pṛthivīpate //
meaning:
शरीरमन्नाजं प्राहुः प्राणामप्यन्नजान्विदुः /
तस्मादन्नप्रदो ज्ञेयः प्राणदः पृथिवीपते //
text_mt: They say the body is born of food; they know the vital breaths also to be born of food; / therefore the bestower of food is known as the giver of life, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyatuṣṭikaraṃ dānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam /
tasmādannasamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti bhūpāla bhūpale //
meaning:
यद्यतुष्टिकरं दानं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् /
तस्मादन्नसमं दानं नास्ति भूपाल भूपले //
text_mt: Whatever gift brings satisfaction bestows the fruit of all desires; / therefore, O king, there is no gift equal to food on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
annadasya kule jātā āsahaṃstra nṛpotma /
napakaṃ te na paśaayanti tasmādannaprado varaḥ //
meaning:
अन्नदस्य कुले जाता आसहंस्त्र नृपोत्म /
नपकं ते न पशअयन्ति तस्मादन्नप्रदो वरः //
text_mt: Those born in the family of a giver of food, even up to a thousand, O best of kings, / do not see hell; therefore the giver of food is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
pādābhyaṅgaṃbhaktiyukto yo 'titheḥ kurute naraḥ /
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu gaṅgāsnānapuraḥsaram //
meaning:
पादाभ्यङ्गंभक्तियुक्तो यो ऽतिथेः कुरुते नरः /
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु गङ्गास्नानपुरःसरम् //
text_mt: The man who, filled with devotion, massages the feet of a guest, / has bathed in all the sacred fords, beginning with bathing in the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tailābhyaṅgaṃ mahārāja brāhmaṇānāṃ karoti yaḥ /
sa strāto 'ṣṭaśataṃ sāgraṃ gaṅgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
तैलाभ्यङ्गं महाराज ब्राह्मणानां करोति यः /
स स्त्रातो ऽष्टशतं साग्रं गङ्गायां नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Whoever anoints brāhmaṇas with oil, O great king, / has bathed fully a hundred and eight times in the Gaṅgā; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
rogitānbrahmāṇānyastu premṇā rakṣati rakṣakaḥ /
sa koṭikulasaṃyukto vasedvūhyapure yugam //
meaning:
रोगितान्ब्रह्माणान्यस्तु प्रेम्णा रक्षति रक्षकः /
स कोटिकुलसंयुक्तो वसेद्वूह्यपुरे युगम् //
text_mt: The protector who protects sick brāhmaṇas with love / dwells in the city of Brahmā for an aeon, joined by a crore of ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
yo rakṣetpṛthivīpāla raṅgaṃ vā rogiṇaṃ naram /
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā sarvānkāmānprayacchati //
meaning:
यो रक्षेत्पृथिवीपाल रङ्गं वा रोगिणं नरम् /
तस्य विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever protects a destitute or sick man, O lord of the earth, / Viṣṇu, pleased at heart, grants him all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā karmaṇā vācā yo rakṣedāmayānvitam /
sarvānkāmānavānpoti sarvepāpavivārjitaḥ //
meaning:
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यो रक्षेदामयान्वितम् /
सर्वान्कामानवान्पोति सर्वेपापविवार्जितः //
text_mt: Whoever protects one afflicted by illness with mind, deed, and speech, / obtains all desires, freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadāti mahīpāla nivāsaṃ brāhmaṇāya vai /
tasya prasanno deveśaḥ svalokaṃ saṃprayacchati //
meaning:
यो ददाति महीपाल निवासं ब्राह्मणाय वै /
तस्य प्रसन्नो देवेशः स्वलोकं संप्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever gives a dwelling to a brāhmaṇa, O protector of the earth, / the lord of gods, being pleased, bestows his own world upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāyaṃ brahmavide yo dadyādgāṃ payasvinīm /
sa yātibrahmasadanamanyeṣāmatidurlabham //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणायं ब्रह्मविदे यो दद्याद्गां पयस्विनीम् /
स यातिब्रह्मसदनमन्येषामतिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Whoever gives a milch-cow to a brāhmaṇa who knows Brahman / goes to Brahmā's abode, which is very hard for others to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
anyebhyaḥ pratigṛhyāpi yo ddyādgāṃ payasvinīm /
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śakto 'smi paṇḍita //
meaning:
अन्येभ्यः प्रतिगृह्यापि यो द्द्याद्गां पयस्विनीम् /
तस्य पुण्यफलं वक्तुं नाहं शक्तो ऽस्मि पण्डित //
text_mt: Even having received it from others, whoever gives a milch-cow, / I am not able to tell his meritorious fruit, O wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāṃ vedaviduṣe yo dadāti payasvinīm /
sa eva rudro bhūpāla sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
कपिलां वेदविदुषे यो ददाति पयस्विनीम् /
स एव रुद्रो भूपाल सर्वपापविवर्जितः //
text_mt: Whoever gives a brown milch-cow to one who knows the Veda, / he indeed is Rudra, O king, freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya vedaviduṣe dadyādubhayatomukhīm /
yastasya puṇyaṃ saṃkhyātu na śakto 'bdaśatairapi //
meaning:
विप्राय वेदविदुषे दद्यादुभयतोमुखीम् /
यस्तस्य पुण्यं संख्यातु न शक्तो ऽब्दशतैरपि //
text_mt: Whoever gives a cow in the act of calving to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Veda, / one is not able to count his merit even in hundreds of years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañśṛṇu vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ /
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुण्यफलं राजञ्शृणु वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः /
एकतः क्रतवः सर्वे समग्रवरदक्षिणाः //
text_mt: Hear truly, O king, I will declare the meritorious fruit of that: / On one side are all the sacrifices with full and excellent sacrificial fees;

sanskrit_iast:
ekato bhayabhītasyata prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam /
saṃrakṣati mahīpāla yo vipraṃ bhayavihvalam //
meaning:
एकतो भयभीतस्यत प्राणिनः प्राणरक्षणम् /
संरक्षति महीपाल यो विप्रं भयविह्वलम् //
text_mt: on the other side is the saving of the life of a living being terrified by fear. / Whoever protects a brāhmaṇa distraught with fear, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ /
vastrado rudrabhavanaṃ kanyādo brahmaṇaḥ padam //
meaning:
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षितः /
वस्त्रदो रुद्रभवनं कन्यादो ब्रह्मणः पदम् //
text_mt: has bathed in all the sacred fords, and is consecrated in all sacrifices. / The giver of cloth goes to Rudra's abode; the giver of a maiden to the abode of Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
hemado viṣṇu bhavanaṃ prayāti svakulānvitaḥ /
yastu kanyāmalaṅkṛtya dadātyadhyātmavedine //
meaning:
हेमदो विष्णु भवनं प्रयाति स्वकुलान्वितः /
यस्तु कन्यामलङ्कृत्य ददात्यध्यात्मवेदिने //
text_mt: the giver of gold goes to Viṣṇu's abode, accompanied by his family. / But whoever gives an adorned maiden to one who knows the supreme Self,

sanskrit_iast:
śatavaṃśasamāyuktaḥ sa vrajedrūhyaṇaḥ padam /
kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā āṣāḍhyāṃ vāpi bhūpate //
meaning:
शतवंशसमायुक्तः स व्रजेद्रूह्यणः पदम् /
कार्तिक्यां पौर्णमास्यां वा आषाढ्यां वापि भूपते //
text_mt: accompanied by a hundred generations, goes to the abode of Brahmā. / On the full moon of Kārttika or of Āṣāḍha, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhaṃ śivatuṣṭyarthamutsṛjettatphalaṃ śṛṇu /
satpajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairvimukto rudrarupabhāk //
meaning:
वृषभं शिवतुष्ट्यर्थमुत्सृजेत्तत्फलं शृणु /
सत्पजन्मार्जितैः पापैर्विमुक्तो रुद्ररुपभाक् //
text_mt: one should release a bull to please Śiva; hear the fruit of that: / Freed from the sins accumulated in seven births, taking the form of Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
kulasatpatisaṃyukto rudreṇa saha modate /
śivaliṅgāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā mahiṣaṃ yaḥ samutsṛjet //
meaning:
कुलसत्पतिसंयुक्तो रुद्रेण सह मोदते /
शिवलिङ्गाङ्कितं कृत्वा महिषं यः समुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt: united with seventy generations of his family, he rejoices with Rudra. / Whoever releases a buffalo marked with a liṅga of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya yātanāloko bhavennṛpatisattam /
tāmbūladānaṃ yaḥ kuryācchaktito nṛpasattama //
meaning:
न तस्य यातनालोको भवेन्नृपतिसत्तम् /
ताम्बूलदानं यः कुर्याच्छक्तितो नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: to him there will be no realm of torment, O best of kings. / Whoever gives betel according to his ability, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā dadātyāyuryaśaḥ śriyam /
kṣīrodo ghṛtadaścaiva madhudo dadhidastathā //
meaning:
तस्य विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा ददात्यायुर्यशः श्रियम् /
क्षीरोदो घृतदश्चैव मधुदो दधिदस्तथा //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, pleased at heart, gives him longevity, fame, and fortune. / The giver of milk and the giver of ghee, the giver of honey and the giver of curd,

sanskrit_iast:
/.
divyābdāyutaparyantaṃsvargaloke mahīyate /
prayāti brahmasadanamikṣudātā nṛpottama //
meaning:
/.
दिव्याब्दायुतपर्यन्तंस्वर्गलोके महीयते /
प्रयाति ब्रह्मसदनमिक्षुदाता नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: are honoured in the heavenly world for ten thousand divine years. / The giver of sugarcane goes to the abode of Brahmā, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhadaḥ puṇyaphaladaḥ prayāti brahmaṇaḥ padam /
guḍekṣurasadaścaiva prayāti kṣīrasāgaram //
meaning:
गन्धदः पुण्यफलदः प्रयाति ब्रह्मणः पदम् /
गुडेक्षुरसदश्चैव प्रयाति क्षीरसागरम् //
text_mt: The giver of fragrant substances, bestowing the fruit of merit, goes to the abode of Brahmā. / And the giver of jaggery and sugarcane juice goes to the ocean of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṭānāṃ jalado yāti sūryalokamanuttamam /
vidyādānena sāyujyaṃ mādhavasya vrajennaraḥ //
meaning:
भटानां जलदो याति सूर्यलोकमनुत्तमम् /
विद्यादानेन सायुज्यं माधवस्य व्रजेन्नरः //
text_mt: The giver of water to warriors goes to the unsurpassed world of Sūrya. / By the gift of knowledge a man attains union with Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādānaṃ mahīdānaṃ godānaṃ cottamottamam /
narakāduddharantyeva japavāhanadohanāt //
meaning:
विद्यादानं महीदानं गोदानं चोत्तमोत्तमम् /
नरकादुद्धरन्त्येव जपवाहनदोहनात् //
text_mt: The gift of knowledge, the gift of land, and the gift of cows are the highest of the high; / they rescue indeed from hell through recitation, transport, and milking.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi dānānāṃ vidyādānaṃ viśiṣyate /
vidyādānena sāyujyaṃ viṣṇoryāti nṛpottama //
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि दानानां विद्यादानं विशिष्यते /
विद्यादानेन सायुज्यं विष्णोर्याति नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: Even among all gifts, the gift of knowledge is superior; / by the gift of knowledge, O best of kings, one goes to union with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
narastviṃndhanadānena mucyate hyupapātakaiḥ /
śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ mahādānaṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
नरस्त्विंन्धनदानेन मुच्यते ह्युपपातकैः /
शालग्रामशिलादानं महादानं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: By giving firewood, a man is freed from secondary sins. / The gift of a Śālagrāma stone is proclaimed as a great gift;

sanskrit_iast:
yaddattvā mokṣamānpoti liṅgadānaṃ tathā smṛtam /
brahmāṇḍa koṭidānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ //
meaning:
यद्दत्त्वा मोक्षमान्पोति लिङ्गदानं तथा स्मृतम् /
ब्रह्माण्ड कोटिदानेन यत्फलं लभते नरः //
text_mt: giving it, he attains liberation; the gift of a liṅga is likewise traditionally remembered. / What fruit a man obtains by giving ten million cosmic eggs,

sanskrit_iast:
tatphalaṃ samavānpoti liṅgadānānna saṃśayaḥ /
śālagrāmaśilādāne tato 'pi dviguṇaṃ phalam //
meaning:
तत्फलं समवान्पोति लिङ्गदानान्न संशयः /
शालग्रामशिलादाने ततो ऽपि द्विगुणं फलम् //
text_mt: that fruit he attains without doubt from the gift of a liṅga. / In the gift of a Śālagrāma stone, the fruit is twice as much as that.

sanskrit_iast:
śāla grāmaśilārūpī viṣṇureveti viśrutaḥ /
yo dadāti naro dānaṃ gṛhatāṃ prabho //
meaning:
शाल ग्रामशिलारूपी विष्णुरेवेति विश्रुतः /
यो ददाति नरो दानं गृहतां प्रभो //
text_mt: Viṣṇu is indeed renowned as embodied in the Śālagrāma stone. / Whichever man gives a gift, saying, ‘May the Lord receive it’,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāstrānaphalaṃ tasya niścitaṃ nṛpa jāyate /
ratnānvitasavarṇasya pradānena nṛpottama //
meaning:
गङ्गास्त्रानफलं तस्य निश्चितं नृप जायते /
रत्नान्वितसवर्णस्य प्रदानेन नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: his fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā is assured, O king. / By the gift of gold endowed with gems, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktimavānpoti mahādānaṃ yataḥ smṛtam /
naro māṇikyadānena paraṃ mokṣamavānpuyāt //
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिमवान्पोति महादानं यतः स्मृतम् /
नरो माणिक्यदानेन परं मोक्षमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt: he attains enjoyment and liberation, since it is remembered as a great gift. / By the gift of a ruby, a man attains supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ghruvalokamavānpoti vajradānena mānavaḥ /
svargaṃ vidrumadānena rudralokamavānpuyāt //
meaning:
घ्रुवलोकमवान्पोति वज्रदानेन मानवः /
स्वर्गं विद्रुमदानेन रुद्रलोकमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt: A man attains the world of Dhruva by the gift of a diamond. / He attains heaven by the gift of coral, and the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāti yānadānena muktādānena caindavam /
vaiḍūryado rudralokaṃ puṣparāgapradastathā //
meaning:
प्रयाति यानदानेन मुक्तादानेन चैन्दवम् /
वैडूर्यदो रुद्रलोकं पुष्परागप्रदस्तथा //
text_mt: He goes [to heaven] by the gift of a conveyance, and to the realm of the moon by the gift of pearls. / The giver of cat's-eye goes to Rudra's world, as does the bestower of topaz.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāgapradānena sarvatra sukhamaśnute /
aśvasāṃnidhyaṃ ciraṃ vrajati bhūmipa //
meaning:
पुष्परागप्रदानेन सर्वत्र सुखमश्नुते /
अश्वसांनिध्यं चिरं व्रजति भूमिप //
text_mt: By the gift of topaz he enjoys happiness everywhere; / he goes for a long time to the proximity of the horse, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
gajadānena mahatā sarvānkāmānavānpuyāt /
prayāti yānadānena svargaṃ svaryānamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
गजदानेन महता सर्वान्कामानवान्पुयात् /
प्रयाति यानदानेन स्वर्गं स्वर्यानमास्थितः //
text_mt: By the great gift of an elephant, he attains all desires; / by the gift of a conveyance he goes to heaven, mounted upon a celestial vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣīdo jayatyeva hyapamṛkatyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
gavāṃ tṛṇapradānena rudralokamavānpuyāt //
meaning:
महिषीदो जयत्येव ह्यपमृकत्युं न संशयः /
गवां तृणप्रदानेन रुद्रलोकमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt:
The giver of a she-buffalo indeed conquers premature death; of this there is no doubt.
By giving grass to cows, one attains the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇaṃ lokamānpoti mahīśa lavaṇapradaḥ /
svaśramācāraniratāḥ sarvabhūtahiteratāḥ //
meaning:
वारुणं लोकमान्पोति महीश लवणप्रदः /
स्वश्रमाचारनिरताः सर्वभूतहितेरताः //
text_mt:
The giver of salt attains the world of Varuṇa, O lord of the earth.
Those who are devoted to the conduct of their own stage of life, devoted to the welfare of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
adāmbhikā gatāsūyāḥ prayānti bagrahmaṇaḥ padam /
paropadeśa niratā vītarāgā vimatsārāḥ //
meaning:
अदाम्भिका गतासूयाः प्रयान्ति बग्रह्मणः पदम् /
परोपदेश निरता वीतरागा विमत्साराः //
text_mt:
Free from hypocrisy and free from envy, go to the abode of Brahmā.
Devoted to instructing others, free from passion and free from malice,

sanskrit_iast:
haripādārcanaratāḥ prayānti sadanaṃ hareḥ /
satsaṅgāhlādaniratāḥ satkarmasu sadodyatāḥ //
meaning:
हरिपादार्चनरताः प्रयान्ति सदनं हरेः /
सत्सङ्गाह्लादनिरताः सत्कर्मसु सदोद्यताः //
text_mt:
Devoted to worshipping the feet of Hari, they go to the abode of Hari.
Delighting in the company of the virtuous, ever engaged in good deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
parāpavādavimukhāḥ prāyānti harimandiram /
nityaṃ hitakarā ye tu brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca //
meaning:
परापवादविमुखाः प्रायान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् /
नित्यं हितकरा ये तु ब्राह्मणेषु च गोषु च //
text_mt:
Averse to slandering others, they go to the temple of Hari.
Those who ever do good to brāhmaṇas and cows,

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīsaṅgavimukhā na paśyanti yamālayam /
jitendriyā jitāhārā goṣu kṣāntāḥ suśīlinaḥ //
meaning:
परस्त्रीसङ्गविमुखा न पश्यन्ति यमालयम् /
जितेन्द्रिया जिताहारा गोषु क्षान्ताः सुशीलिनः //
text_mt:
Averse to intercourse with others' wives, do not see the abode of Yama.
Having conquered the senses and controlled food, patient toward cows, well-behaved,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamāśīlāḥ prayānti bhavanaṃ hareḥ /
agniśuśrūṣavaścaiva guruśuśrūṣakāstathā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणेषु क्षमाशीलाः प्रयान्ति भवनं हरेः /
अग्निशुश्रूषवश्चैव गुरुशुश्रूषकास्तथा //
text_mt: Those who are patient towards brāhmaṇas go to Hari's abode, / as do those devoted to serving the fire and those devoted to serving their guru.

sanskrit_iast:
patiśuśrūṣaṇaratā na vai saṃsṛtibhāginaḥ /
sadā devārcanaratā harinamaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
पतिशुश्रूषणरता न वै संसृतिभागिनः /
सदा देवार्चनरता हरिनमपरायणाः //
text_mt:
Devoted to the service of their husbands, truly do not partake of worldly transmigration.
Ever devoted to worshipping the gods, devoted to the name of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahanivṛttāśca prayānti paramaṃ padam /
anāthaṃ viprakuṇapaṃ ye daheyurnṛpottama //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहनिवृत्ताश्च प्रयान्ति परमं पदम् /
अनाथं विप्रकुणपं ये दहेयुर्नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: And those who refrain from acceptance of gifts go to the supreme abode. / O best of kings, those who cremate the corpse of a friendless vipra,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalamaśnuvate sadā /
patraiḥ purṣpeḥ phalairvāpi jalairvā manujeśvara //
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्राणां फलमश्नुवते सदा /
पत्रैः पुर्ष्पेः फलैर्वापि जलैर्वा मनुजेश्वर //
text_mt:
Always enjoy the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.
With leaves, flowers, fruits, or even water, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayā rahitaṃ liṅgamacaryattetphalaṃ śṛṇu /
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ stūyamāno vimānagaḥ //
meaning:
पूजया रहितं लिङ्गमचर्यत्तेत्फलं शृणु /
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानो विमानगः //
text_mt:
If one should worship a liṅga destitute of worship, hear the fruit thereof:
Praised by hosts of apsarases and gandharvas, seated on a celestial chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāti śivasānnidhyamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ /
culukodakamātreṇa liṅgaṃ saṃsnāpya bhūmipa //
meaning:
प्रयाति शिवसान्निध्यमित्याह कमलोद्भवः /
चुलुकोदकमात्रेण लिङ्गं संस्नाप्य भूमिप //
text_mt:
He goes to the presence of Śiva—thus spoke the lotus-born [Brahmā].
Bathing a liṅga with merely a palmful of water, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃprānpoti na saṃśayaḥ /
pūjayā rahitaṃ liṅgaṃ kusumairyor'cayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
लक्षाश्वमेधजं पुण्यं संप्रान्पोति न संशयः /
पूजया रहितं लिङ्गं कुसुमैर्योर्ऽचयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt:
One obtains the merit born of a hundred thousand horse sacrifices, no doubt.
The wise man who worships with flowers a liṅga destitute of worship,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhāyutaphalaṃ bhavettasya janeśvara /
bhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ phalairvāpi śūnyaṃ liṅgaṃ prapūjya ca //
meaning:
अश्वमेधायुतफलं भवेत्तस्य जनेश्वर /
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैः फलैर्वापि शून्यं लिङ्गं प्रपूज्य च //
text_mt:
His [merit] shall be the fruit of ten thousand horse sacrifices, O ruler of men.
And having worshipped an abandoned liṅga with snacks, meals, or fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
śivasāyujyamānpoti punarāvṛttivarjitam /
pūjayā rahitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yor'cayedakarvaṃśaja //
meaning:
शिवसायुज्यमान्पोति पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् /
पूजया रहितं विष्णुं योर्ऽचयेदकर्वंशज //
text_mt:
He attains union with Śiva, free from return [to rebirth].
O descendant of the sun, he who worships Viṣṇu [when] destitute of worship,

sanskrit_iast:
jalenāpi sa sālokyaṃ viṣṇoryāti narottama /
devatāyatane yastu kuryātsaṃmārjanaṃ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
जलेनापि स सालोक्यं विष्णोर्याति नरोत्तम /
देवतायतने यस्तु कुर्यात्संमार्जनं सुधीः //
text_mt:
Even with water, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu, O best of men.
Moreover, the wise man who cleans the temple of a deity

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpāṃsu yugāvāsaṃ vaiṣṇave mandirelabhet /
śīrṇaṃ sphaṭikaliṅgantu yaḥ saṃdadhyānnṛpottama //
meaning:
यावत्पांसु युगावासं वैष्णवे मन्दिरेलभेत् /
शीर्णं स्फटिकलिङ्गन्तु यः संदध्यान्नृपोत्तम //
text_mt:
Shall obtain residence in the temple of Viṣṇu for as many yugas as there are dust particles.
He who repairs a broken crystal liṅga, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
śatajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairmucyate sa tu mānavaḥ /
yastu devālaye rājannapi gocarmamātrakam //
meaning:
शतजन्मार्जितैः पापैर्मुच्यते स तु मानवः /
यस्तु देवालये राजन्नपि गोचर्ममात्रकम् //
text_mt:
That man is freed from the sins accumulated across a hundred births.
O king, a man who, in the temple of a deity, sprinkles even a cow-hide's measure

sanskrit_iast:
jalena siñcidbhūbhāgaṃ so 'pi svargaṃ labhennaraḥ /
gandhodakena yaḥ siñceddevatāyatane bhuvam //
meaning:
जलेन सिञ्चिद्भूभागं सो ऽपि स्वर्गं लभेन्नरः /
गन्धोदकेन यः सिञ्चेद्देवतायतने भुवम् //
text_mt:
Of ground with water, that man also attains heaven.
He who sprinkles the ground in the temple of a deity with scented water

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatkaṇānukalpaṃ tu tiṣṭheta devasannidhau /
mṛdā dhātuvikārairvā yo limpeddevatāgṛham //
meaning:
यावत्कणानुकल्पं तु तिष्ठेत देवसन्निधौ /
मृदा धातुविकारैर्वा यो लिम्पेद्देवतागृहम् //
text_mt:
Shall remain in the presence of the deity for as many kalpas as there are droplets.
He who plasters the temple of a deity with clay or mineral pigments

sanskrit_iast:
sa koṭikulamuddhṛtya yāti sāmyaṃ madhudviṣaḥ /
śilācūrṇena yo martyo devāgāraṃ tu lopayet //
meaning:
स कोटिकुलमुद्धृत्य याति साम्यं मधुद्विषः /
शिलाचूर्णेन यो मर्त्यो देवागारं तु लोपयेत् //
text_mt:
Delivers ten million family members and attains equality with the enemy of Madhu [Viṣṇu].
That mortal who covers the temple of a deity with stone-powder

sanskrit_iast:
svastikādīni vā kuryāttasya puṇyamanantakam /
yaḥ kuryāddīparacanāṃ devatāyatane nṛpa //
meaning:
स्वस्तिकादीनि वा कुर्यात्तस्य पुण्यमनन्तकम् /
यः कुर्याद्दीपरचनां देवतायतने नृप //
text_mt:
Or makes svastikas and other designs—his merit is endless.
He who makes an arrangement of lamps in the temple of a deity, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya puṇyaṃ prasaṃkhyātuṃ notsahe 'bdaśatairapi /
akhaṇḍadīpaṃ yaḥ kuryādviṣṇorvā śaṅkarasya ca //
meaning:
तस्य पुण्यं प्रसंख्यातुं नोत्सहे ऽब्दशतैरपि /
अखण्डदीपं यः कुर्याद्विष्णोर्वा शङ्करस्य च //
text_mt:
I am unable to enumerate his merit even in hundreds of years.
He who provides a perpetual lamp for Viṣṇu or Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ tasya na durlabham /
arcitaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ vāpi namettu yaḥ //
meaning:
क्षणे क्षणे ऽश्वमेधस्य फलं तस्य न दुर्लभम् /
अर्चितं शङ्करं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुं वापि नमेत्तु यः //
text_mt:
For him the fruit of a horse sacrifice at every moment is not hard to obtain.
He who, seeing an unhonoured Śaṅkara or Viṣṇu, bows down [to him],

sanskrit_iast:
sa viṣṇubhavanaṃ prāpya modate ca yugāyutam /
devyāḥ pradakṣiṇāmekāṃ satpa sūryasya bhūmipa //
meaning:
स विष्णुभवनं प्राप्य मोदते च युगायुतम् /
देव्याः प्रदक्षिणामेकां सत्प सूर्यस्य भूमिप //
text_mt:
He, reaching the abode of Viṣṇu, rejoices for ten thousand yugas.
Making one circumambulation of the Goddess, seven of Sūrya, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
tistro vināyakasyāpi catastro viṣṇumandire /
kṛtvā tattadgṛhaṃ prāpya modate yugalakṣakam //
meaning:
तिस्त्रो विनायकस्यापि चतस्त्रो विष्णुमन्दिरे /
कृत्वा तत्तद्गृहं प्राप्य मोदते युगलक्षकम् //
text_mt:
Three of Vināyaka, and four in the temple of Viṣṇu,
Reaching their respective abodes, he rejoices for a hundred thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
yo viṣṇorbhaktibhāvena tathaiva godvijasya ca /
pradakṣiṇāṃ cararettasya hyaśvamedhaḥ pade pade //
meaning:
यो विष्णोर्भक्तिभावेन तथैव गोद्विजस्य च /
प्रदक्षिणां चररेत्तस्य ह्यश्वमेधः पदे पदे //
text_mt:
He who, with an attitude of devotion, performs a circumambulation of Viṣṇu,
And likewise of a cow and a twice-born, gains a horse sacrifice at every step.

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyāṃ maheśvaraṃ māheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya praṇamettu yaḥ /
na tasya vidyate kṛtyaṃ saṃsṛtirnaiva jāyate //
meaning:
काश्यां महेश्वरं माहेश्वरं लिङ्गं संपूज्य प्रणमेत्तु यः /
न तस्य विद्यते कृत्यं संसृतिर्नैव जायते //
text_mt:
He who, having worshipped the great liṅga of the Great Lord in Kāśī, bows down,
Has nothing left to do, and transmigration does not occur for him at all.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā savyenaiva vidhānataḥ /
naro na cyavate svargācchaṅkarasya prasādataḥ //
meaning:
शिवं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा सव्येनैव विधानतः /
नरो न च्यवते स्वर्गाच्छङ्करस्य प्रसादतः //
text_mt:
Having circumambulated Śiva clockwise according to the injunction,
A man does not fall from heaven, by the grace of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
stutvā stotrairjagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam /
sarvānkāmānavānpoti manasā yadyadicchati //
meaning:
स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैर्जगन्नाथं नारायणमनामयम् /
सर्वान्कामानवान्पोति मनसा यद्यदिच्छति //
text_mt:
Having praised with hymns the flawless Nārāyaṇa, the lord of the universe,
He attains all desires, whatever he wishes in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatane yastu bhaktiyuktaḥ pranṛtyati /
gāyate vā sa bhūpāla rudraloke ca muktibhāk //
meaning:
देवतायतने यस्तु भक्तियुक्तः प्रनृत्यति /
गायते वा स भूपाल रुद्रलोके च मुक्तिभाक् //
text_mt:
He who, filled with devotion, dances in the temple of a deity,
Or sings, O protector of the earth, partakes of liberation in the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu vādyaṃ prakurvanti devatāyatane narāḥ /
te haṃsayānamāruḍhā vrajanti brahmaṇaḥ padam //
meaning:
ये तु वाद्यं प्रकुर्वन्ति देवतायतने नराः /
ते हंसयानमारुढा व्रजन्ति ब्रह्मणः पदम् //
text_mt:
Those men who play musical instruments in the temple of a deity,
Mounted on a swan chariot, go to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
karatālaṃ prakurvanti devatāyatane tu yete /
sarvapāpanirmuktā vimānasthā yugāyutam //
meaning:
करतालं प्रकुर्वन्ति देवतायतने तु येते /
सर्वपापनिर्मुक्ता विमानस्था युगायुतम् //
text_mt:
Those who clap their hands in rhythm in the temple of a deity,
Freed from all sins, seated on a celestial chariot for ten thousand yugas,

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatane ye tu ghaṇṭānādaṃ prakurvate /
teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ nigadituṃ na samarthaḥ śivaḥ svayam //
meaning:
देवतायतने ये तु घण्टानादं प्रकुर्वते /
तेषां पुण्यं निगदितुं न समर्थः शिवः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Those who sound a bell in the temple of a deity—
Śiva himself is not able to describe their merit.

sanskrit_iast:
bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahamurajaiśva saḍiṇḍimaiḥ /
saṃprīṇayanti deveśaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
भेरीमृदङ्गपटहमुरजैश्व सडिण्डिमैः /
संप्रीणयन्ति देवेशं तेषां पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt:
Those who please the lord of the gods with kettle-drums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, murajas, and ḍiṇḍimas—
Hear the meritorious fruit of them:

sanskrit_iast:
devastrīgaṇasaṃyuktāḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samarcitāḥ /
svargalokamanuprāpya modante kalpapañcakam //
meaning:
देवस्त्रीगणसंयुक्ताः सर्वकामैः समर्चिताः /
स्वर्गलोकमनुप्राप्य मोदन्ते कल्पपञ्चकम् //
text_mt:
Accompanied by groups of celestial women, worshipped with all objects of desire,
Reaching the heavenly world, they rejoice for five kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāmandire kurvannaraḥ śaṅkharavaṃ nṛpa /
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇunā saha modate //
meaning:
देवतामन्दिरे कुर्वन्नरः शङ्खरवं नृप /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुना सह मोदते //
text_mt:
A man making the sound of a conch in the temple of a deity, O king,
Freed from all sins, rejoices together with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tālakāṃsyādininadaṃ kurvan viṣṇugṛhe naraḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokamavānpuyāt //
meaning:
तालकांस्यादिनिनदं कुर्वन् विष्णुगृहे नरः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt:
A man producing the sound of cymbals, gongs, and the like in the house of Viṣṇu,
Freed from all sins, attains the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yo devaḥ sarvadṛgviṣṇurjñānarupī nirañjanaḥ /
sarvadharmaphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ pradadāti ca //
meaning:
यो देवः सर्वदृग्विष्णुर्ज्ञानरुपी निरञ्जनः /
सर्वधर्मफलं पूर्णं संतुष्टः प्रददाति च //
text_mt:
The god Viṣṇu, the all-seeing, whose form is knowledge, the untainted,
Being pleased, grants the full fruit of all dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ /
saphalāni bhavantyeva sarvakarmāṇi bhūpate //
paramātmā jagannāthaḥ sarvakarṃmaphalapradaḥ /
satkarmakartṛbhirnityaṃ smṛtaḥ sarvārtināśanaḥ /
meaning:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः /
सफलानि भवन्त्येव सर्वकर्माणि भूपते //
परमात्मा जगन्नाथः सर्वकर्ंमफलप्रदः /
सत्कर्मकर्तृभिर्नित्यं स्मृतः सर्वार्तिनाशनः /
text_mt:
By the mere remembrance of that god of gods who bears the discus,
All rites become fruitful indeed, O lord of the earth.

The supreme self, the lord of the universe, the giver of the fruit of all actions,
Ever remembered by the performers of good deeds, the destroyer of all distress:
Whatever is done dedicated to him leads to endlessness.

sanskrit_iast: tamuddiśya kṛtaṃ yacca tadānantyāya kalpate //
meaning: तमुद्दिश्य कृतं यच्च तदानन्त्याय कल्पते //
text_mt: whatever is done for him leads to endless [merit].

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṇi viṣṇuśca phalāni viṣṇuḥ karmāṇi viṣṇuśca phalāni bhoktā /
kāryaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ karaṇāni viṣṇurasmānna kiñcivdyatiriktamasti //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmānukathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
धर्माणि विष्णुश्च फलानि विष्णुः कर्माणि विष्णुश्च फलानि भोक्ता /
कार्यं च विष्णुः करणानि विष्णुरस्मान्न किञ्चिव्द्यतिरिक्तमस्ति //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे धर्मानुकथनं नाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ /
prabravīmi nṛpaśreṣṭha taṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच
श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः /
प्रब्रवीमि नृपश्रेष्ठ तं शृणुष्व समाहितः //
text_mt:
Dharmarāja said:
I declare the dharma spoken in the Śruti and Smṛti for the varṇas in succession,
O best of kings; listen to it with a focused mind.

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhuñjāno 'śuciṃ vāpi cāṇḍālaṃ patitaṃ spṛśet /
krodhādajñānato vāpiṃ tasya vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim //
meaning:
यो भुञ्जानो ऽशुचिं वापि चाण्डालं पतितं स्पृशेत् /
क्रोधादज्ञानतो वापिं तस्य वक्ष्यामि निष्कृतिम् //
text_mt:
If someone, while eating, touches an impure person, a cāṇḍāla, or an outcaste,
Either through anger or ignorance, I will declare his expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ samācaret /
snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ viprapañcagavyena śudhyati //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं वाथ षड्रात्रं यथासंख्यं समाचरेत् /
स्नानं त्रिषवणं विप्रपञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति //
text_mt:
He should observe [a fast] for three nights or six nights respectively;
Bathing at the three junctures of the day, a vipra is purified by the five products of the cow.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācajitstravate gudam /
ucchiṣṭatve 'śucitve ca tasya śuddhiṃ vadāmi te //
meaning:
भुञ्जानस्य तु विप्रस्य कदाचजित्स्त्रवते गुदम् /
उच्छिष्टत्वे ऽशुचित्वे च तस्य शुद्धिं वदामि ते //
text_mt:
If, while a vipra is eating, his anus should discharge,
I will declare to you his purification regarding left-over food status and impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ kṛtvā dvijaḥ śaucaṃ paścādapa upaspṛśet /
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati //
meaning:
पूर्वं कृत्वा द्विजः शौचं पश्चादप उपस्पृशेत् /
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति //
text_mt: Having first performed purification, a twice-born should then touch water. / Fasting for a day and a night, he is purified by the five products of the cow (pañcagavya).

sanskrit_iast:
nigiranyadi meheta bhuktvā vā mehane kṛte /
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā juhuyātsarpiṣānalam //
meaning:
निगिरन्यदि मेहेत भुक्त्वा वा मेहने कृते /
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा जुहुयात्सर्पिषानलम् //
text_mt: If one urinates while swallowing [food], or urinates after eating, / one should fast for a day and a night and offer an oblation of clarified butter into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā bhojanakāle syādaśucirbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit /
bhūmau nidhāya taṃ grāsaṃ strātvā śuddhimavānpuyāt //
meaning:
यदा भोजनकाले स्यादशुचिर्ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् /
भूमौ निधाय तं ग्रासं स्त्रात्वा शुद्धिमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt: Whenever a brāhmaṇa becomes impure during the time of eating, / he should place that morsel on the ground, bathe, and obtain purity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayitvā tu tad āsamupavālena śuddhyati /
aśitvā caiva tatsarvaṃ trirātramaśucirbhavet //
meaning:
भक्षयित्वा तु तद् आसमुपवालेन शुद्ध्यति /
अशित्वा चैव तत्सर्वं त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: If he eats that morsel, he is purified by a fast; / and if he eats all of it, he remains impure for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
aśrataścedvamiḥ syādvai hyasvasthastriśrataṃ japet /
svasthastrīṇi sahasrāṇi gāyatryāḥ śodhanaṃ param //
meaning:
अश्रतश्चेद्वमिः स्याद्वै ह्यस्वस्थस्त्रिश्रतं जपेत् /
स्वस्थस्त्रीणि सहस्राणि गायत्र्याः शोधनं परम् //
text_mt: If vomiting should occur while eating, one who is unwell should recite [the gāyatrī] three hundred times; / one who is healthy [should recite] three thousand [times] of the gāyatrī, which is the supreme purifier.

sanskrit_iast: cāṇḍālaiḥ śvaparcaiḥ spṛṣṭo viṇmūtre ca kṛte dvijaḥ //
meaning: चाण्डालैः श्वपर्चैः स्पृष्टो विण्मूत्रे च कृते द्विजः //
text_mt: If a twice-born is touched by Cāṇḍālas or Śvapacas while passing feces or urine,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ tu prakurvīta bhuktocchiṣṭaḥ ṣahācaret /
udakyāṃ sūtikāṃvāpi saṃspṛśedantyajo yadi //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं तु प्रकुर्वीत भुक्तोच्छिष्टः षहाचरेत् /
उदक्यां सूतिकांवापि संस्पृशेदन्त्यजो यदि //
text_mt: he should observe [a fast of] three nights; [if touched] while having unwashed leftovers of food, he should observe [the same]. / If an outcaste touches a menstruating woman or a woman in childbed,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātreṇa viśuddhiḥ syāditi śātātapo 'bravīt /
rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śvabhirmātaṅgavāyasaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्धिः स्यादिति शातातपो ऽब्रवीत् /
रजस्वला तु संस्पृष्टा श्वभिर्मातङ्गवायसैः //
text_mt: purification occurs after three nights; so said Śātātapa. / If a menstruating woman is touched by dogs, Cāṇḍālas, or crows,

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhārā śucistiṣṭetkāle snānena śuddhyati /
rajasvale yadā nāryāvanyonyaṃ spṛśataḥ kvacit //
meaning:
निराहारा शुचिस्तिष्टेत्काले स्नानेन शुद्ध्यति /
रजस्वले यदा नार्यावन्योन्यं स्पृशतः क्वचित् //
text_mt: she should remain without food and pure; she is purified by bathing at the proper time. / Whenever two menstruating women touch each other,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhete brahmakūrcena brahmakūrcena copari /
ucchiṣṭena ca saṃspṛṣṭo yo na snānaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
शुद्धेते ब्रह्मकूर्चेन ब्रह्मकूर्चेन चोपरि /
उच्छिष्टेन च संस्पृष्टो यो न स्नानं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: they are purified by the brahmakūrca penance, and further by the brahmakūrca. / And he who, touched by food leftovers, does not take a bath,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtau tu garbhaṃ śaṅkitvā snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam /
anṝtau tu striyaṃ gatvā śaucaṃ mūtrapurūṣavat //
meaning:
ऋतौ तु गर्भं शङ्कित्वा स्नानं मैथुनिनः स्मृतम् /
अनॄतौ तु स्त्रियं गत्वा शौचं मूत्रपुरूषवत् //
text_mt: bathing is prescribed for one engaged in sexual intercourse during the fertile period, suspecting conception; / but having gone to a woman outside the fertile period, purification is like that for urine and feces.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhāvapyaśucī syātāṃ dampatī yābhasaṃgatau /
śayanādutthitā nārī śuciḥ syādaśuciḥ pumān //
meaning:
उभावप्यशुची स्यातां दम्पती याभसंगतौ /
शयनादुत्थिता नारी शुचिः स्यादशुचिः पुमान् //
text_mt: Both husband and wife become impure when engaged in sexual union; / rising from bed, the woman becomes pure, but the man remains impure.

sanskrit_iast:
bharttuḥ śarīraśuśrūṣāṃ daurātmyādaprakurvatī /
daṇḍyā dvādaśakaṃ nārī varṣaṃ tyājyā dhanaṃ vinā //
meaning:
भर्त्तुः शरीरशुश्रूषां दौरात्म्यादप्रकुर्वती /
दण्ड्या द्वादशकं नारी वर्षं त्याज्या धनं विना //
text_mt: A woman who, out of malice, does not attend to the personal care of her husband / should be fined twelve [paṇas], and abandoned for a year without property.

sanskrit_iast:
tyajanto patitānbagandhūndaṇḍyānuttamasāhasam /
pitā hi patitaḥ kāmaṃ na tu mātā kadācana //
meaning:
त्यजन्तो पतितान्बगन्धून्दण्ड्यानुत्तमसाहसम् /
पिता हि पतितः कामं न तु माता कदाचन //
text_mt: Those abandoning fallen relatives should be fined the highest penalty. / A father, indeed, may become fallen, but never a mother.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ ghātayedyastu rajjvādibhirupakramaiḥ /
mṛte medhyena letpavyo jīvato dviśataṃ damaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानं घातयेद्यस्तु रज्ज्वादिभिरुपक्रमैः /
मृते मेध्येन लेत्पव्यो जीवतो द्विशतं दमः //
text_mt: Whoever attempts to kill himself by means of a rope or other methods, / if dead, he should be smeared with impure substances; if living, the fine is two hundred [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍyāstatputramitrāṇi pratyekaṃ pāṇikaṃ damam /
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryuryathāśāstrapracoditam //
meaning:
दण्ड्यास्तत्पुत्रमित्राणि प्रत्येकं पाणिकं दमम् /
प्रायश्चित्तं ततः कुर्युर्यथाशास्त्रप्रचोदितम् //
text_mt: His sons and friends should each be fined a fine of one paṇa. / Then they should perform the expiation prescribed in accordance with the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
jalāgnyudvandhanabhraṣṭāḥ pravrajyānāśakacyutāḥ /
viṣaprapatanadhvastāḥ śastraghātahatāśca ye //
meaning:
जलाग्न्युद्वन्धनभ्रष्टाः प्रव्रज्यानाशकच्युताः /
विषप्रपतनध्वस्ताः शस्त्रघातहताश्च ये //
text_mt: Those who have fallen into [attempted suicide by] water, fire, or hanging; those apostate from renunciation or fallen from fasting to death; / those destroyed by poison or jumping [from a precipice]; and those struck down by weapon blows—

sanskrit_iast:
na caite pravratyavasitāḥ sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ /
cāndrāyaṇena śuddhyaṃnti tatpakṛcchradvayena vā //
meaning:
न चैते प्रव्रत्यवसिताः सर्वलोकबहिष्कृताः /
चान्द्रायणेन शुद्ध्यंन्ति तत्पकृच्छ्रद्वयेन वा //
text_mt: these are not outcasts from asceticism who are excluded from all worlds; / they are purified by a cāndrāyaṇa penance or by two taptakṛcchras.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayāvasitaḥ pāpaśyāmacchabalakāccyutaḥ /
cāndrāyaṇābhyāṃ śuddhyeta dattvā dhenuṃ tathā vṛṣam //
meaning:
उभयावसितः पापश्यामच्छबलकाच्च्युतः /
चान्द्रायणाभ्यां शुद्ध्येत दत्त्वा धेनुं तथा वृषम् //
text_mt: One who has abandoned both, an evil one fallen from the dark and dappled [paths], / is purified by two cāndrāyaṇas after giving a milch cow and a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
svaśṛgālaplavaṅgādyairmānuṣaiśca ratiṃ vinā /
spṛṣṭaḥ strātvā śuciḥ sadyo divā saṃdhyāsu rātriṣu //
meaning:
स्वशृगालप्लवङ्गाद्यैर्मानुषैश्च रतिं विना /
स्पृष्टः स्त्रात्वा शुचिः सद्यो दिवा संध्यासु रात्रिषु //
text_mt: One touched by dogs, jackals, monkeys, and the like, or by human beings without sexual pleasure, / becomes pure immediately by bathing, whether by day, at the twilights, or by night.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānādvā tu yo bhuktvā cāṇḍālānnaṃ kathañcana /
gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsārddhena viśuddhyati //
meaning:
अज्ञानाद्वा तु यो भुक्त्वा चाण्डालान्नं कथञ्चन /
गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासार्द्धेन विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Whoever eats food from a Cāṇḍāla out of ignorance in any way, / subsisting on cow's urine and barley gruel, is purified in half a month.

sanskrit_iast:
gobrāhmaṇagṛhaṃ dagdhvā mṛtaṃ codvandhanādinā /
pāśaṃ chitvā tathā tasya kṛcchramekaṃ careddijaḥ //
meaning:
गोब्राह्मणगृहं दग्ध्वा मृतं चोद्वन्धनादिना /
पाशं छित्वा तथा तस्य कृच्छ्रमेकं चरेद्दिजः //
text_mt: A twice-born who burns a cow's shed or a brāhmaṇa's house, or cuts the noose / of one who has died by hanging or the like, should perform one kṛcchra penance.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālapulpasānāṃ ca bhuktvā hatvā ca yoṣitam /
kṛcchrārdhdamācarejjñānādajñānādaindavadvayam //
meaning:
चाण्डालपुल्पसानां च भुक्त्वा हत्वा च योषितम् /
कृच्छ्रार्ध्दमाचरेज्ज्ञानादज्ञानादैन्दवद्वयम् //
text_mt: Having eaten [the food] of Cāṇḍālas and Pulkasas, or having killed their woman, / one should perform half a kṛcchra intentionally, or two aindava (cāndrāyaṇa) penances unintentionally.

sanskrit_iast:
kopālikānnabhoktṛāṇāṃ tannārīgāmināṃ tathā /
agamyāgamane vipro madyago māṃsabhakṣaṇe //
meaning:
कोपालिकान्नभोक्तृआणां तन्नारीगामिनां तथा /
अगम्यागमने विप्रो मद्यगो मांसभक्षणे //
text_mt: For those who eat the food of Kāpālikas, and likewise for those who consort with their women, / or for a vipra who approaches an unapproachable woman, drinks liquor, or eats meat,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpakṛcchraparikṣitpo maurvīhomena śuddhyati /
mahāpātakakarttāraścatvāro 'tha viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
तत्पकृच्छ्रपरिक्षित्पो मौर्वीहोमेन शुद्ध्यति /
महापातककर्त्तारश्चत्वारो ऽथ विशेषतः //
text_mt: subjected to the taptakṛcchra penance, he is purified by a maurvī homa. / Now, the four perpetrators of the major sins (mahāpātaka), especially,

sanskrit_iast:
agniṃ praviśya śuddhyantisthitvāvā mahati kratau /
rahasyakaraṇo 'pyevaṃ māsamabhyasya puruṣaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निं प्रविश्य शुद्ध्यन्तिस्थित्वावा महति क्रतौ /
रहस्यकरणो ऽप्येवं मासमभ्यस्य पुरुषः //
text_mt: are purified by entering the fire or by standing in a great sacrifice. / A man who has committed secret sins, likewise, practicing for a month

sanskrit_iast:
aghamarṣaṇasūktaṃ vā śuddhyedantarjale japan /
rajakaścarmakāraśca naṭo buruḍa eva ca //
meaning:
अघमर्षणसूक्तं वा शुद्ध्येदन्तर्जले जपन् /
रजकश्चर्मकारश्च नटो बुरुड एव च //
text_mt: reciting the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn while immersed in water, is purified. / A washerman, a leatherworker, an actor, and a Buruḍa (bamboo-worker),

sanskrit_iast:
kaivarttamedabhillāśva satpaite hyantyajāḥ smṛtāḥ /
bhuktvā caiṣāṃ striyo gatvā pītvā yaḥpratigṛhyate //
meaning:
कैवर्त्तमेदभिल्लाश्व सत्पैते ह्यन्त्यजाः स्मृताः /
भुक्त्वा चैषां स्त्रियो गत्वा पीत्वा यःप्रतिगृह्यते //
text_mt: a fisherman, a Meda, and a Bhilla—these seven are known as the outcastes (antyaja). / He who eats [their food], approaches their women, drinks [with them], or accepts [gifts from them],

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrārddhamācarejjñānādaindavadvayam /
mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca duhitṛbhaginīsnuṣāḥ //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रार्द्धमाचरेज्ज्ञानादैन्दवद्वयम् /
मातरं गुरुपत्नीं च दुहितृभगिनीस्नुषाः //
text_mt: should perform half a kṛcchra knowingly, or two aindavas. / Having approached one's mother, guru's wife, daughter, sister, or daughter-in-law,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgamya praviśedagniṃ nānyāśuddhirvidhīyate /
rājñīṃ pravrajitāṃ dhātrīṃ tathāvarṇottamāmapi //
meaning:
संगम्य प्रविशेदग्निं नान्याशुद्धिर्विधीयते /
राज्ञीं प्रव्रजितां धात्रीं तथावर्णोत्तमामपि //
text_mt: he should enter the fire; no other purification is prescribed. / Having gone to a queen, a female ascetic, a wet-nurse, or a woman of a higher caste,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvākṛcchradvayaṃ kuryātsagotrāmabhigamya ca /
amūṣu pitṛgotrāsu mātṛgotragatāsu ca //
meaning:
गत्वाकृच्छ्रद्वयं कुर्यात्सगोत्रामभिगम्य च /
अमूषु पितृगोत्रासु मातृगोत्रगतासु च //
text_mt: and having approached a woman of the same gotra, he should perform two kṛcchras. / Among these, for [consorting with] women of the father's gotra or the mother's gotra,

sanskrit_iast:
padadāreṣu sarveṣu kṛcchrārddhaṃ tapanaṃ caret /
veśyābhigamane pāpaṃ vyapohanti dvijā stathā //
meaning:
पददारेषु सर्वेषु कृच्छ्रार्द्धं तपनं चरेत् /
वेश्याभिगमने पापं व्यपोहन्ति द्विजा स्तथा //
text_mt: and for all wives of others, he should perform half a kṛcchra and a tapana penance. / Likewise, twice-borns remove the sin of approaching a courtesan

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā sakṛtsutatpaṃ ca pañcarātraṃ kuśodakam /
gurutalpagato kuryārdbāhmaṇo vidhivadrūtam //
meaning:
पीत्वा सकृत्सुतत्पं च पञ्चरात्रं कुशोदकम् /
गुरुतल्पगतो कुर्यार्द्बाह्मणो विधिवद्रूतम् //
text_mt: by drinking hot water once and kuśa grass water for five nights. / A brāhmaṇa who has defiled his guru's bed should observe the vow according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
gonghasya kecidicchanti keciccaivāvakīrṇinaḥ /
daṇḍādūrdhvaṃ prahāreṇa yastu gāṃ vinipātayet //
meaning:
गोन्घस्य केचिदिच्छन्ति केचिच्चैवावकीर्णिनः /
दण्डादूर्ध्वं प्रहारेण यस्तु गां विनिपातयेत् //
text_mt: Some prescribe [the vow] of a cow-slayer, and some [the vow] of a vow-breaker (avakīrṇin). / But he who brings down a cow with a blow exceeding the staff,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇaṃ govrataṃ tasya prāyaścitaṃ viśodhayet /
aṅguṣṭhamātrasthūlastu bāhumātraghapramāṇakaḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणं गोव्रतं तस्य प्रायश्चितं विशोधयेत् /
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रस्थूलस्तु बाहुमात्रघप्रमाणकः //
text_mt: double the cow-vow purifies him as expiation. / Thick as a thumb and measuring only an arm's length,

sanskrit_iast:
sārdrakaḥsapālāśca godaṇḍaḥ parikīrttitaḥ /
gavāṃ nipātane caiva garbho 'pi saṃbhavedyadi //
meaning:
सार्द्रकःसपालाश्च गोदण्डः परिकीर्त्तितः /
गवां निपातने चैव गर्भो ऽपि संभवेद्यदि //
text_mt: moist and possessing leaves—such is declared to be the cow-staff. / If an embryo also results from the striking down of cows,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaśaśvaretkṛcchraṃ eṣā gonghasya niṣkṛtiḥ /
bandhane rodhane caiva poṣaṇe vā gavāṃ rujām //
meaning:
एकैकशश्वरेत्कृच्छ्रं एषा गोन्घस्य निष्कृतिः /
बन्धने रोधने चैव पोषणे वा गवां रुजाम् //
text_mt: he should perform a kṛcchra for each one; this is the atonement for a cow-slayer. / If in binding, confining, or rearing, illness of the cows

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpadyate cenmaraṇaṃ nimittenaiva lipyate /
mūrcchitaḥ patito vāpi daṇḍenābhihatastataḥ //
meaning:
संपद्यते चेन्मरणं निमित्तेनैव लिप्यते /
मूर्च्छितः पतितो वापि दण्डेनाभिहतस्ततः //
text_mt: occurs and death results, he is tainted only by the indirect cause. / If, struck by a staff, [the cow] faints or falls down,

sanskrit_iast:
utthāya ṣaṭpadaṃ gacchetsatpa pañcadaśāpi vā /
grāsaṃ vā yadi gṛhṇīyāttoyaṃ vāpi pibedyadi //
meaning:
उत्थाय षट्पदं गच्छेत्सत्प पञ्चदशापि वा /
ग्रासं वा यदि गृह्णीयात्तोयं वापि पिबेद्यदि //
text_mt: and then rising, walks six, seven, or fifteen paces, / or takes a morsel of food, or drinks water,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavyādhipranaṣṭānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate /
kaṣṭaloṣṭāśmabhirgāvaḥ śastrairvā nihatā yadi //
meaning:
सर्वव्याधिप्रनष्टानां प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते /
कष्टलोष्टाश्मभिर्गावः शस्त्रैर्वा निहता यदि //
text_mt: no expiation is prescribed for [cows] perished from all [such] diseases. / If cows are killed with wood, clods of earth, stones, or weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ smṛtaṃ tatra śastre nigadyate /
kāṣṭe sāntapanaṃ proktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu loṣṭake //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं स्मृतं तत्र शस्त्रे निगद्यते /
काष्टे सान्तपनं प्रोक्तं प्राजापत्यं तु लोष्टके //
text_mt: an expiation is remembered in that case; [the penalty] for weapons is declared: / a sāntapana is prescribed for wood, and a prājāpatya for a clod of earth;

sanskrit_iast:
tatpakṛcchraṃ tu pāṣāṇe śastre cāpyatikṛcchrakam /
auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ dadyādgobrāhmaṇeṣu ca //
meaning:
तत्पकृच्छ्रं तु पाषाणे शस्त्रे चाप्यतिकृच्छ्रकम् /
औषधं स्नेहमाहारं दद्याद्गोब्राह्मणेषु च //
text_mt: a taptakṛcchra for a stone, and an atikṛcchra for a weapon. / One should give medicine, unctuous substance, and food to cows and brāhmaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
dīyamāne vipattiḥ syātprāyaścittaṃ tadā nahi /
tailabheṣajapāne ca bheṣajānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe //
meaning:
दीयमाने विपत्तिः स्यात्प्रायश्चित्तं तदा नहि /
तैलभेषजपाने च भेषजानां च भक्षणे //
text_mt: if death should occur while it is being given, there is no expiation at that time. / In the drinking of medicinal oil, in the eating of medicines,

sanskrit_iast:
niśalyakaraṇe caiva prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate /
vatsānāṃ kaṇṭhabandhena kriyayābheṣajena tu //
meaning:
निशल्यकरणे चैव प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते /
वत्सानां कण्ठबन्धेन क्रिययाभेषजेन तु //
text_mt: and in extracting splinters or darts, no expiation is prescribed. / In tying the necks of calves, in medical treatment, or by medicine,

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ saṃgopanārthaṃ ca tvadoṣo roṣabandhayoḥ /
pāde caivāsya romāṇi dvipāde śmaśru kevalam //
meaning:
सायं संगोपनार्थं च त्वदोषो रोषबन्धयोः /
पादे चैवास्य रोमाणि द्विपादे श्मश्रु केवलम् //
text_mt: and for the sake of enclosing them in the evening, there is no fault in restraint or binding. / For one quarter [of the sin], the body-hair [is shaved]; for two quarters, only the beard.

sanskrit_iast:
tripāde tu śikhāvartaṃ mūle sarvaṃ samācaret /
sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya chedayedaṅguladvayam //
meaning:
त्रिपादे तु शिखावर्तं मूले सर्वं समाचरेत् /
सर्वान्केशान्समुद्धृत्य छेदयेदङ्गुलद्वयम् //
text_mt: For three quarters, [shaving] around the crest [is prescribed]; for the root, he should do everything. / Gathering up all the hair, he should cut off two finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva tu nārīṇāṃ muṇḍanaṃ śirasaḥ smṛtam /
na stiyā vapanaṃ kāryaṃ na ca vīrāsanaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
एवमेव तु नारीणां मुण्डनं शिरसः स्मृतम् /
न स्तिया वपनं कार्यं न च वीरासनं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Just so is the shaving of the head ordained for women: / for a woman, [full] tonsure must not be done, nor is the vīrāsana posture prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca goṣṭe nivāso 'sti na gacchantīmanuvrajet /
rājā vā rājaputragho vā brāhmaṇo vā bahuśrutaḥ //
meaning:
न च गोष्टे निवासो ऽस्ति न गच्छन्तीमनुव्रजेत् /
राजा वा राजपुत्रघो वा ब्राह्मणो वा बहुश्रुतः //
text_mt: Nor is there dwelling in a cowpen, nor should [she] follow a roaming cow. / A king, or a royal prince, or a learned brāhmaṇa—

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā vapanaṃ teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirddiśet /
keśānāṃ rakṣaghaṇārthaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ vratamādiśet //
meaning:
अकृत्वा वपनं तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्द्दिशेत् /
केशानां रक्षघणार्थं च द्विगुणं व्रतमादिशेत् //
text_mt: for them, one should assign an expiation without shaving [their heads]; / and for the sake of preserving their hair, one should prescribe a double observance.

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇe gatu vrate cīrṇe dviguṇā vratadakṣiṇā //
meaning: द्विगुणे गतु व्रते चीर्णे द्विगुणा व्रतदक्षिणा //
text_mt: When a double observance has been performed, the sacrificial fee for the observance is doubled.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ na kṣīyate hanturdātā ca narakaṃ vrajet /
aśrautasmārtavihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadanti ye //
meaning:
पापं न क्षीयते हन्तुर्दाता च नरकं व्रजेत् /
अश्रौतस्मार्तविहितं प्रायश्चित्तं वदन्ति ये //
text_mt: The sin of the killer is not destroyed, and the giver goes to hell, / [when] they state an expiation not ordained by Vedic and traditional authority.

sanskrit_iast:
tāndharmavinghakartṝṃśca rājā daṇḍena pīḍayet /
na caitānpīḍayedrājā kathañcitkāmamohitaḥ //
meaning:
तान्धर्मविन्घकर्तॄंश्च राजा दण्डेन पीडयेत् /
न चैतान्पीडयेद्राजा कथञ्चित्काममोहितः //
text_mt: The king should punish with a fine those who create obstacles to dharma; / and if the king, somehow deluded by desire, does not punish them,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāpaṃ śatadhābhūtvā tameva parisarpati /
prāyaścitte tataścīrṇe kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam //
meaning:
तत्पापं शतधाभूत्वा तमेव परिसर्पति /
प्रायश्चित्ते ततश्चीर्णे कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणभोजनम् //
text_mt: that sin, becoming a hundredfold, recoils upon him alone. / Then, when the expiation has been performed, he should feed brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatirgā vṛṣaṃ caikaṃ dadyātteṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām /
krimibhistṛṇa saṃbhūtairmakṣikādinipātitaiḥ //
meaning:
विंशतिर्गा वृषं चैकं दद्यात्तेषां च दक्षिणाम् /
क्रिमिभिस्तृण संभूतैर्मक्षिकादिनिपातितैः //
text_mt: He should give twenty cows and one bull as their sacrificial fee. / By worms born of grass, cast down by flies and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrārddhaṃ sa prakurvīta śaktyā dadyāñca dakṣiṇām /
prāyaścittaṃ ca kṛtvā vai bhojayitvā dvijottamān //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रार्द्धं स प्रकुर्वीत शक्त्या दद्याञ्च दक्षिणाम् /
प्रायश्चित्तं च कृत्वा वै भोजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् //
text_mt: he should perform a half-kṛcchra and give a sacrificial fee according to his ability. / Having indeed performed the expiation and fed the best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇamānikaṃ dadyāttataḥ śuddhirvidhīyate /
cāṇḍālaśvapacaiḥ spṛṣṭe niśi snānaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
सुवर्णमानिकं दद्यात्ततः शुद्धिर्विधीयते /
चाण्डालश्वपचैः स्पृष्टे निशि स्नानं विधीयते //
text_mt: he should give a māsaka of gold; then purification is prescribed. / When touched by cāṇḍālas and dog-cookers, bathing at night is ordained.

sanskrit_iast:
na vasettatra rātrau tu sadyaḥ snānena śuddhyati /
vasedatha yadā rātrāvajñānādavicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
न वसेत्तत्र रात्रौ तु सद्यः स्नानेन शुद्ध्यति /
वसेदथ यदा रात्रावज्ञानादविचक्षणः //
text_mt: He must not stay there at night; he is purified by an immediate bath. / But when an unwise person, through ignorance, stays at night,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tasya tu tatpāpaṃ śatadhā parivartate /
udgacchanti ca nakṣatrāṇyupariṣṭācca ye grahāḥ //
meaning:
तदा तस्य तु तत्पापं शतधा परिवर्तते /
उद्गच्छन्ति च नक्षत्राण्युपरिष्टाच्च ये ग्रहाः //
text_mt: then that sin of his multiplies a hundredfold. / When constellations rise, and whatever planets are above,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃspṛṣṭe raśmibhisteṣāmudakasnānamācaret /
yāścāntarjalavalmīkamūṣikoṣaravartmasu //
meaning:
संस्पृष्टे रश्मिभिस्तेषामुदकस्नानमाचरेत् /
याश्चान्तर्जलवल्मीकमूषिकोषरवर्त्मसु //
text_mt: touched by their rays, he should perform a bath in water. / Clay found underwater, on ant-hills, mouse-holes, saline soils, roads,

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśāne śaucaśeṣe ca na grāhyāḥ satpa mṛttikāḥ /
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ tu karttavyaṃ brāhmaṇena prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
श्मशाने शौचशेषे च न ग्राह्याः सत्प मृत्तिकाः /
इष्टापूर्तं तु कर्त्तव्यं ब्राह्मणेन प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: cremation grounds, and leftover cleansing clay—these seven clays must not be taken. / An offering and pious works must be performed with effort by a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭena labhate svargaṃ mokṣaṃ pūrttena cānpuyāt /
vittakṣepo bhavediṣṭaṃ taḍāgaṃ pūrttamucyate //
meaning:
इष्टेन लभते स्वर्गं मोक्षं पूर्त्तेन चान्पुयात् /
वित्तक्षेपो भवेदिष्टं तडागं पूर्त्तमुच्यते //
text_mt: Through the offering he attains heaven, and through pious works he attains liberation. / Spending wealth [in sacrifice] is an offering; a reservoir is called a pious work,

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmaśca viśeṣeṇa devadroṇyastathaiva ca /
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca //
meaning:
आरामश्च विशेषेण देवद्रोण्यस्तथैव च /
वापीकूपतडागानि देवतायतनानि च //
