text_mt: and especially a pleasure grove, as well as procession-cars for deities, / step-wells, deep wells, reservoirs, and shrines of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
patitānyuddharedyastu sa pūrvaphalamaśnute /
śuklāyā āharenmūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā goḥ śakṛttathā //
meaning:
पतितान्युद्धरेद्यस्तु स पूर्वफलमश्नुते /
शुक्लाया आहरेन्मूत्रं कृष्णाया गोः शकृत्तथा //
text_mt: He who restores these when fallen obtains the fruit of their original [maker]. / One should take the urine of a white cow, and the dung of a black cow;

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrāyāśca payo grāhyaṃ śvetāyāśca dadhi smṛtam /
kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
ताम्रायाश्च पयो ग्राह्यं श्वेतायाश्च दधि स्मृतम् /
कपिलाया घृतं ग्राह्यं महापातकनाशनम् //
text_mt: the milk of a copper-colored cow should be taken, and curd of a white one is remembered; / ghee should be taken from a tawny cow—it destroys the great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśaistīrthanadītauyaiḥ sarvadravyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak /
āhṛtya praṇavenaiva utthāpya praṇavena ca //
meaning:
कुशैस्तीर्थनदीतौयैः सर्वद्रव्यं पृथक् पृथक् /
आहृत्य प्रणवेनैव उत्थाप्य प्रणवेन च //
text_mt: Having fetched each ingredient separately with kuśa grass and water from sacred river fords, / and lifting them with the praṇava, and with the praṇava [mixing them],

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavena samāloḍya praṇavenaiva saṃpibet /
pālāśe madhyame parṇe bhāṇḍe tāmramaye śubhe //
pibetpuṣkaraparṇe vā mṛnmaye vā kuśodakam /
meaning:
प्रणवेन समालोड्य प्रणवेनैव संपिबेत् /
पालाशे मध्यमे पर्णे भाण्डे ताम्रमये शुभे //
पिबेत्पुष्करपर्णे वा मृन्मये वा कुशोदकम् /
text_mt:
having stirred it with the praṇava, he should drink it with the praṇava alone, / in the middle leaf of a palāśa tree, or in an auspicious copper vessel,

or in a lotus leaf, or in an earthen vessel he should drink the kuśa water.

sanskrit_iast: sūtake tu samutpanne dvitīye samupasthite //
meaning: सूतके तु समुत्पन्ने द्वितीये समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: When a birth-impurity has arisen and a second one occurs,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye nāsti doṣastu prathamenaiva śudhyati /
jātena śudhyate jātaṃ mṛtena mṛtakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
द्वितीये नास्ति दोषस्तु प्रथमेनैव शुध्यति /
जातेन शुध्यते जातं मृतेन मृतकं तथा //
text_mt: there is no taint from the second; he is purified through the first alone. / By a birth [impurity] a birth is purified, and so by a death [impurity] a death.

sanskrit_iast: garbhasaṃstravaṇe māse trīṇyahāni vinirdiśet //
meaning: गर्भसंस्त्रवणे मासे त्रीण्यहानि विनिर्दिशेत् //
text_mt: In the case of a miscarriage, one should assign three days [for each] month.

sanskrit_iast:
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhastrāve viśuddhyati /
rajasyuparate sādhvī snanena strī rajasvalā //
meaning:
रात्रिभिर्मासतुल्याभिर्गर्भस्त्रावे विशुद्ध्यति /
रजस्युपरते साध्वी स्ननेन स्त्री रजस्वला //
text_mt: In a miscarriage, purification comes through nights equal [in number] to the months. / When the menses have ceased, a chaste, menstruating woman is purified by a bath.

sanskrit_iast:
svagotrādbhṛśyate nārī vivāhātsatpame pade /
svāmigotreṇa karttavyāstasyāḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ //
meaning:
स्वगोत्राद्भृश्यते नारी विवाहात्सत्पमे पदे /
स्वामिगोत्रेण कर्त्तव्यास्तस्याः पिण्डोदकक्रियाः //
text_mt: A woman falls away from her own gotra at the seventh step of marriage; / the rites of ancestral rice-balls and water for her must be performed using the husband's gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
uddeśyaṃ piṇḍadāne syātpiṇḍe piṇḍe dvināmataḥ /
ṣaṇṇāṃ deyāstrayaḥ piṇḍā evaṃ dātā na muhyati //
meaning:
उद्देश्यं पिण्डदाने स्यात्पिण्डे पिण्डे द्विनामतः /
षण्णां देयास्त्रयः पिण्डा एवं दाता न मुह्यति //
text_mt: The dedication in the offering of ancestral rice-balls should be made with two names for each rice-ball; / three ancestral rice-balls are to be given for six [ancestors]—thus the giver does not err.

sanskrit_iast:
svena bhartrā sahasrābdaṃ mātābhuktā sudaivatam /
pitāmahyapi svenaiva svenaiva prapitāmahī //
meaning:
स्वेन भर्त्रा सहस्राब्दं माताभुक्ता सुदैवतम् /
पितामह्यपि स्वेनैव स्वेनैव प्रपितामही //
text_mt: With her own husband, the mother enjoys [offerings] for a thousand years as a good deity; / the grandmother too with her own, and the great-grandmother with her own.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣe tu kurvīta mātāpitrostu satkṛtim /
adaivaṃ bhojayecchrāddhaṃ piṇḍamekaṃ tu nirvapet //
meaning:
वर्षे तु कुर्वीत मातापित्रोस्तु सत्कृतिम् /
अदैवं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धं पिण्डमेकं तु निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: On the [anniversary] year, one should perform the rite of honour for one's mother and father; / one should feed the śrāddha without deities and offer only one ancestral rice-ball.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhamathāparam /
pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pañcavidhaṃ budhaiḥ //
meaning:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं वृद्धिश्राद्धमथापरम् /
पार्वणं चेति विज्ञेयं श्राद्धं पञ्चविधं बुधैः //
text_mt: Daily, occasional, wish-fulfilling, and further the prosperity-śrāddha, / and the pārvaṇa: śrāddha should be known by the wise as fivefold.

sanskrit_iast:
grahoparāge saṃkrāntau parvotsa vamalālaye /
nirvapertrīnnaraḥ piṇḍānekameva mṛte 'hani //
meaning:
ग्रहोपरागे संक्रान्तौ पर्वोत्स वमलालये /
निर्वपेर्त्रीन्नरः पिण्डानेकमेव मृते ऽहनि //
text_mt: At an eclipse of a planet, a solstice, a festival day, or in the month of Mala, / a man should offer three ancestral rice-balls, but only one on the day of death.

sanskrit_iast:
anūḍha na pṛthakkanyā piṇḍe gotre ca sūtake /
pāṇigrahaṇamantrābhyāṃ svagotrādbhraśyate tataḥ //
meaning:
अनूढ न पृथक्कन्या पिण्डे गोत्रे च सूतके /
पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राभ्यां स्वगोत्राद्भ्रश्यते ततः //
text_mt: An unmarried maiden is not separate with regard to ancestral rice-ball, gotra, and birth-impurity; / through the mantras of marriage she then falls away from her own gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
yena yena tu varṇena yā kānyā pariṇīyate /
tatsamaṃ sūtakaṃ yāti tathāpiṇḍodake 'pi ca //
meaning:
येन येन तु वर्णेन या कान्या परिणीयते /
तत्समं सूतकं याति तथापिण्डोदके ऽपि च //
text_mt: By whichever caste a maiden is married, / she attains the birth-impurity equal to that, as well as in ancestral rice-balls and water.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhe caiva saṃvṛtte caturthe 'hanirātriṣu /
ekatvaṃ sā vrajedbhartuḥ piṇḍe gotre ca sūtake //
prathame 'ṅni dvitīye vā tṛtīye vā caturthake /
meaning:
विवाहे चैव संवृत्ते चतुर्थे ऽहनिरात्रिषु /
एकत्वं सा व्रजेद्भर्तुः पिण्डे गोत्रे च सूतके //
प्रथमे ऽङ्नि द्वितीये वा तृतीये वा चतुर्थके /
text_mt:
And when the marriage has taken place, on the fourth day and night, / she enters oneness with her husband with regard to ancestral rice-balls, gotra, and birth-impurity.

On the first day, or the second, or the third, or the fourth,

sanskrit_iast: asthisaṃcayanaṃ kāryaṃ bandhubhirhitabuddhibhiḥ //
meaning: अस्थिसंचयनं कार्यं बन्धुभिर्हितबुद्धिभिः //
text_mt: the gathering of the bones must be performed by kinsmen with well-wishing minds.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe pañcame caiva satpame navame tathā /
asthisaṃcayanaṃ proktaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थे पञ्चमे चैव सत्पमे नवमे तथा /
अस्थिसंचयनं प्रोक्तं वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः //
text_mt: On the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the ninth [day], / the gathering of the bones is proclaimed for the castes in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśāhe pretasya yasya cotsṛjyate vṛṣaḥ /
mucyate pretalokātsa svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
एकादशाहे प्रेतस्य यस्य चोत्सृज्यते वृषः /
मुच्यते प्रेतलोकात्स स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt: For whatever deceased person a bull is released on the eleventh day, / he is released from the realm of ghosts and is exalted in the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhimātre jale sthitvā hṛdayena tu cintayet /
āgacchantu me pitaro gṛhṇantvetāājāñjalīn //
meaning:
नाभिमात्रे जले स्थित्वा हृदयेन तु चिन्तयेत् /
आगच्छन्तु मे पितरो गृह्णन्त्वेताआजाञ्जलीन् //
text_mt: Standing in navel-deep water, he should think in his heart: / 'May my ancestors come; may they receive these handfuls of water!'

sanskrit_iast:
hastau kṛtvā tu saṃyuktau pūracitvā jalena ca /
gośṛṅgamātramuddhṛtya jalamadhye viniḥ kṣipet //
meaning:
हस्तौ कृत्वा तु संयुक्तौ पूरचित्वा जलेन च /
गोशृङ्गमात्रमुद्धृत्य जलमध्ये विनिः क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: Joining both hands and filling them with water, / raising them to the height of a cow’s horn, he should pour it out into the water.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśe ca kṣipedvāri vāristho dakṣaghiṇāmukhaḥ /
pitṝṇāṃ sthānamākāśaṃ dakṣiṇādik tathaiva ca //
meaning:
आकाशे च क्षिपेद्वारि वारिस्थो दक्षघिणामुखः /
पितॄणां स्थानमाकाशं दक्षिणादिक् तथैव च //
text_mt: And standing in water, facing the south, he should cast the water toward the sky; / for the sky is the abode of the ancestors, and so is the southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo devagaṇāḥ proktā āpaḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā /
tasmādasya jalaṃ deyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ hitamicchatā //
meaning:
आपो देवगणाः प्रोक्ता आपः पितृगणास्तथा /
तस्मादस्य जलं देयं पितॄणां हितमिच्छता //
text_mt: Waters are said to be the hosts of gods; waters are also the hosts of ancestors. / Therefore, water should be given by one wishing what is beneficial for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
divāsūryāṃśusaṃtatpaṃ rātrau nakṣatramārutaiḥ /
madhyayorapyubhābhyāṃ ca pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam //
meaning:
दिवासूर्यांशुसंतत्पं रात्रौ नक्षत्रमारुतैः /
मध्ययोरप्युभाभ्यां च पवित्रं सर्वदा जलम् //
text_mt: Warmed by the rays of the sun by day, and by the stars and the wind by night, / and by both during the twilight intervals, water is always pure.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvayuktamavyaktamamedhyena sadā śuciḥ /
bhāṇḍasthaṃ dharaṇīsthaṃ vā pavitraṃ sarvadā jalam //
meaning:
स्वभावयुक्तमव्यक्तममेध्येन सदा शुचिः /
भाण्डस्थं धरणीस्थं वा पवित्रं सर्वदा जलम् //
text_mt: Endowed with its natural state, invisible, [untouched] by impurities, it is ever pure; / whether kept in a vessel or situated on the earth, water is always pure.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca jalaṃ dadyājjalāñjalīn /
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ sthale dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
देवतानां पितॄणां च जलं दद्याज्जलाञ्जलीन् /
असंस्कृतप्रमीतानां स्थले दद्याद्विचक्षणः //
text_mt: He should offer handfuls of water to the deities and the ancestors; / the discerning man should offer it on dry ground for those who died without rites of passage.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhe havanakāle ca dadyādekena pāṇinā /
ubhābhyāṃ tarpaṇe dadyādeṣa dharmo vyavasthitaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmaśāntinirdeśo nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
श्रद्धे हवनकाले च दद्यादेकेन पाणिना /
उभाभ्यां तर्पणे दद्यादेष धर्मो व्यवस्थितः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे धर्मशान्तिनिर्देशो नाम चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
At a śrāddha and at the time of fire offerings, one should give with one hand; / at an offering of water, one should give with both hands: this is the established rule.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Instruction on the Appeasement of Sins through Dharma', in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarāja uvāca
pāpa bhedānpravakṣyāmi yathā sthūlāśca yātanāḥ /
śṛṇuṣva dhairyamāsthāya raudrā ye narakā yataḥ //
meaning:
धर्मराज उवाच
पाप भेदान्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा स्थूलाश्च यातनाः /
शृणुष्व धैर्यमास्थाय रौद्रा ये नरका यतः //
text_mt: Dharmarāja said: / I shall explain the divisions of sins as well as the gross tortures; / listen with steadfastness to the terrible hells wherein [they suffer],

sanskrit_iast:
pāpino ye durātmāno narakāgniṣu santatam /
pacyante yeṣu tānvakṣye bhayaṅkaraphalapradān //
meaning:
पापिनो ये दुरात्मानो नरकाग्निषु सन्ततम् /
पच्यन्ते येषु तान्वक्ष्ये भयङ्करफलप्रदान् //
text_mt: wherein the evil-minded sinners are constantly roasted in hellfire— / I shall describe those hells which bring terrifying results.

sanskrit_iast:
tapanovālukākumbhaumahārauravarauravau /
kumbhaghīpāko nirucchvāsaḥ kālasūtraḥ pramardanaḥ //
meaning:
तपनोवालुकाकुम्भौमहारौरवरौरवौ /
कुम्भघीपाको निरुच्छ्वासः कालसूत्रः प्रमर्दनः //
text_mt: Tapana, Vālukākumbha, Mahāraurava, Raurava, / Kumbhīpāka, Nirucchvāsa, Kālasūtra, Pramardana,

sanskrit_iast:
asipatravanaṃ ghoraṃ lālābhakṣohimotkaṭaḥ /
mūṣāvasthā vasākūpastathā vaitaraṇī nadī //
meaning:
असिपत्रवनं घोरं लालाभक्षोहिमोत्कटः /
मूषावस्था वसाकूपस्तथा वैतरणी नदी //
text_mt: the terrible Asipatravana, Lālābhakṣa, Himotkaṭa, / Mūṣāvasthā, Vasākūpa, and likewise the Vaitaraṇī river,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyante mūtrapānaṃ ca purīṣahlada eva ca /
tatpaśūlaṃ tatpaśilā śālmalīdruma eva ca //
meaning:
भक्ष्यन्ते मूत्रपानं च पुरीषह्लद एव च /
तत्पशूलं तत्पशिला शाल्मलीद्रुम एव च //
text_mt: Bhakṣyante, Mūtrapāna, and Purīṣahrada, / the heated pike, the heated rock, and the Śālmalī tree,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śoṇitakūpaśca ghoraḥ śoṇitabhojanaḥ /
svamāṃsabhojanaṃ caiva vahnijvālāniveśanam //
meaning:
तथा शोणितकूपश्च घोरः शोणितभोजनः /
स्वमांसभोजनं चैव वह्निज्वालानिवेशनम् //
text_mt: and also Śoṇitakūpa, the dreadful Śoṇitabhojana, / the eating of one's own flesh, and consignment to burning flames,

sanskrit_iast:
śilāvṛṣṭiḥ śastravṛṣṭirvahnivṛṣṭistathaiva ca /
kṣārodakaṃ coṣṇatoyaṃ tatpāyaḥ piṇḍabhabhaṇam //
meaning:
शिलावृष्टिः शस्त्रवृष्टिर्वह्निवृष्टिस्तथैव च /
क्षारोदकं चोष्णतोयं तत्पायः पिण्डभभणम् //
text_mt: a rain of stones, a rain of weapons, and likewise a rain of fire, / caustic water, boiling water, and the eating of red-hot iron balls,

sanskrit_iast:
atha śiraḥśoṣaṇaṃ ca marutprapatanaṃ tathā /
tathā pāśāṇavarṇaṃ ca kṛmibhojanameva ca //
meaning:
अथ शिरःशोषणं च मरुत्प्रपतनं तथा /
तथा पाशाणवर्णं च कृमिभोजनमेव च //
text_mt: then drying of the head, falling from the air, / stone-crushing, and feeding upon worms,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣāro dapānaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tathā krakacadāraṇam /
purīṣalepanaṃ caiva purīṣasya ca bhojanam //
meaning:
क्षारो दपानं भ्रमणं तथा क्रकचदारणम् /
पुरीषलेपनं चैव पुरीषस्य च भोजनम् //
text_mt: drinking of caustic fluid, whirling about, sawing with a saw, / anointing with feces, and eating feces,

sanskrit_iast:
retaḥ pānaṃ mahāghoraṃ sarvasandhiṣudāhanam /
dhūmapānaṃ pāśabandhaṃ nānāśūlānulepanam //
meaning:
रेतः पानं महाघोरं सर्वसन्धिषुदाहनम् /
धूमपानं पाशबन्धं नानाशूलानुलेपनम् //
text_mt: drinking semen, extremely dreadful burning at all joints, / drinking smoke, bondage in snares, smeared upon diverse spikes,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāraśayanaṃ caiva tathā musalamarddanam /
bahūni kāṣṭhayantrāṇi kaṣaṇaṃ chedanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अङ्गारशयनं चैव तथा मुसलमर्द्दनम् /
बहूनि काष्ठयन्त्राणि कषणं छेदनं तथा //
text_mt: lying on charcoal, pounding with a pestle, / numerous wooden contraptions, scraping, and cutting,

sanskrit_iast:
patanotpatanaṃ caiva gadādaṇḍādipīhanam /
gajadantapraharaṇaṃ nānāsarpaiśca daṃśanam //
meaning:
पतनोत्पतनं चैव गदादण्डादिपीहनम् /
गजदन्तप्रहरणं नानासर्पैश्च दंशनम् //
text_mt: falling and rising, striking with maces and clubs, / gore with elephants' tusks, and biting by various snakes,

sanskrit_iast:
śītāmbusecanaṃ caiva nāsāyāṃ ca mukhe tathā /
ghorakṣārāmbupānaṃ ca tathā lavaṇabhakṣaṇam //
meaning:
शीताम्बुसेचनं चैव नासायां च मुखे तथा /
घोरक्षाराम्बुपानं च तथा लवणभक्षणम् //
text_mt: sprinkling with icy water in the nose and mouth, / drinking terrible alkaline water, and eating salt,

sanskrit_iast:
strāyucchedaṃ snāyubandhamasthicchedaṃ tathaiva ca /
kṣārāmbupūrṇarandhrāṇāṃ praveśaṃ māṃsabhojanam //
meaning:
स्त्रायुच्छेदं स्नायुबन्धमस्थिच्छेदं तथैव च /
क्षाराम्बुपूर्णरन्ध्राणां प्रवेशं मांसभोजनम् //
text_mt: severing of sinews, binding of sinews, and likewise breaking of bones, / entering orifices filled with alkaline water, feeding upon raw meat,

sanskrit_iast:
pittapānaṃ mahāghoraṃ tathaivaḥśleṣmabhojanam /
vṛkṣāgrātpātanañcaiva jalāntarmajjanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
पित्तपानं महाघोरं तथैवःश्लेष्मभोजनम् /
वृक्षाग्रात्पातनञ्चैव जलान्तर्मज्जनं तथा //
text_mt: drinking of bile, extremely terrible, and eating of phlegm, / being cast down from the tops of trees, and immersion under water,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṣāṇadhāraṇaṃ caiva śayanaṃ kaṇṭakopari /
pipīlikādaṃśanaṃ ca vṛścikaiścāpi pīḍanam //
meaning:
पाषाणधारणं चैव शयनं कण्टकोपरि /
पिपीलिकादंशनं च वृश्चिकैश्चापि पीडनम् //
text_mt: bearing heavy stones, sleeping upon thorns, / the biting of ants, and torment by scorpions,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrapīḍā śivāpīḍā tathā mahiṣamīḍanam /
karddame śayanaṃ caiva durgandhaparipūraṇam //
meaning:
व्याघ्रपीडा शिवापीडा तथा महिषमीडनम् /
कर्द्दमे शयनं चैव दुर्गन्धपरिपूरणम् //
text_mt: torment by tigers, torment by jackals, and harassment by buffaloes, / lying in mire, and being filled with foul odors,

sanskrit_iast:
bahuśaścārdhaśayanaṃ mahātiktaniṣevaṇam /
atyuṣṇatailapānaṃ ca mahākaṭuniṣevaṇam //
meaning:
बहुशश्चार्धशयनं महातिक्तनिषेवणम् /
अत्युष्णतैलपानं च महाकटुनिषेवणम् //
text_mt: repeatedly lying half-suspended, partaking of intense bitterness, / drinking scalding oil, and consuming extremely pungent things,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṣāyodakapānaṃ ca tatpapāṣāṇatakṣaṇam /
atyuṣṇaśītasnānaṃ ca tathā daśanaśīrṇanam //
meaning:
कषायोदकपानं च तत्पपाषाणतक्षणम् /
अत्युष्णशीतस्नानं च तथा दशनशीर्णनम् //
text_mt: drinking astringent water, being carved upon heated stones, / bathing in scorching and freezing [waters], and shattering of teeth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāyaḥ śayanaṃ caiva hyayobhārasya bandhanam /
evamādyāmahābhāga yātanāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥ //
meaning:
तत्पायः शयनं चैव ह्ययोभारस्य बन्धनम् /
एवमाद्यामहाभाग यातनाः कोटिकोटिशः //
text_mt: lying on red-hot iron, and being bound with a load of iron— / such are the torments, O fortunate one, in their hundreds of millions.

sanskrit_iast:
api varṣasahasreṇa nāhaṃ nigadituṃ kṣamaḥ /
eteṣu yasya yatprātpaṃ pāpinaḥ kṣitirakṣaka //
meaning:
अपि वर्षसहस्रेण नाहं निगदितुं क्षमः /
एतेषु यस्य यत्प्रात्पं पापिनः क्षितिरक्षक //
text_mt: Even in a thousand years, I would not be able to declare them all. / Among these, whatever is attained by a sinner, O protector of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ saṃprapakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu /
brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं संप्रपक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु /
ब्रह्महा च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः //
text_mt: all that I shall declare. Listen as I recount it to you: / The killer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the violator of the guru's bed—

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakinastvete tatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ /
pantibhedīvṛthāpākī nityaṃ brahmaṇadūṣakaḥ //
meaning:
महापातकिनस्त्वेते तत्संसर्गी च पञ्चमः /
पन्तिभेदीवृथापाकी नित्यं ब्रह्मणदूषकः //
text_mt: these are the great sinners, and one who associates with them is the fifth. / One who breaks a line of diners, one who cooks for oneself alone, one who constantly slanders brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
ādeśī vedavikretā pañcaite brahmadhātakāḥ /
brahmaṇaṃ yaḥ samāhūya dāsyāmīti dhanādikam /
eścānnāstīti yo bruyāttamāhurbrahmaghātinam //
meaning:
आदेशी वेदविक्रेता पञ्चैते ब्रह्मधातकाः /
ब्रह्मणं यः समाहूय दास्यामीति धनादिकम् /
एश्चान्नास्तीति यो ब्रुयात्तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातिनम् //
text_mt: one who commands them, and one who sells the Veda: these five are killers of brahmins. / Whoever summons a brahmin saying, 'I will give wealth and other things,' / and then says, 'There is nothing,' him they call a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
snānārthaṃ pūjanārthaṃ vā gacchato brāhmaṇasya yaḥ /
samāyātyantarāyatvaṃ tamāhurbrahmadhātinam //
meaning:
स्नानार्थं पूजनार्थं वा गच्छतो ब्राह्मणस्य यः /
समायात्यन्तरायत्वं तमाहुर्ब्रह्मधातिनम् //
text_mt: Whoever causes an obstacle to a brahmin who is going / to bathe or to perform worship, him they call a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
pasnindāsu nirataścātmotkarṣarataśva yaḥ /
asatyanirataśvacaiva brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
पस्निन्दासु निरतश्चात्मोत्कर्षरतश्व यः /
असत्यनिरतश्वचैव ब्रह्महा परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: He who is devoted to censuring others, devoted to self-aggrandizement, / and devoted to falsehood is proclaimed a killer of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmasyānumantā ca brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ /
anyodvegarataścaiva anyeṣāṃ doṣasūvakaḥ //
meaning:
अधर्मस्यानुमन्ता च ब्रह्महा परिकीर्तितः /
अन्योद्वेगरतश्चैव अन्येषां दोषसूवकः //
text_mt: An instigator of unrighteousness is proclaimed a killer of a brahmin. / One devoted to causing distress to others, one who exposes the faults of others,

sanskrit_iast:
dambhācārarataśvaiva brahmahetyabhidhīyate /
nityaṃ pratigraharatastathā prāṇivadhe rataḥ //
meaning:
दम्भाचाररतश्वैव ब्रह्महेत्यभिधीयते /
नित्यं प्रतिग्रहरतस्तथा प्राणिवधे रतः //
text_mt: and one devoted to deceitful conduct is declared a killer of a brahmin. / One constantly devoted to accepting gifts, likewise one devoted to killing living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
adharmasyānumamantā ca brahmahā parikīrtitaḥ /
brahmahatyā samaṃ pāpameva bahuvidhaṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
अधर्मस्यानुममन्ता च ब्रह्महा परिकीर्तितः /
ब्रह्महत्या समं पापमेव बहुविधं नृप //
text_mt: and an instigator of unrighteousness is proclaimed a killer of a brahmin. / Such sins equal to brahmin-murder are of many kinds, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
surāpānasamaṃ pāpaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ /
gaṇānnabhojanaṃ caiva gaṇikānāṃ niṣevaṇam //
meaning:
सुरापानसमं पापं प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः /
गणान्नभोजनं चैव गणिकानां निषेवणम् //
text_mt: I shall declare in brief the sin equal to the drinking of liquor: / Eating the food of a multitude, and consorting with courtesans,

sanskrit_iast:
patitānnādanaṃ caiva surāpānasamaṃ smṛtam /
upāsamāparityāgo devalānāṃ ca bhojanam //
meaning:
पतितान्नादनं चैव सुरापानसमं स्मृतम् /
उपासमापरित्यागो देवलानां च भोजनम् //
text_mt: and eating the food of an outcaste is considered equal to the drinking of liquor. / Abandoning religious observances, eating [the food] of temple attendants,

sanskrit_iast:
surāpayoṣitsaṃyogaḥ surāpānasamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
yaḥ śūdreṇa samāhato bhojanaṃ kurute dvijaḥ //
meaning:
सुरापयोषित्संयोगः सुरापानसमः स्मृतः /
यः शूद्रेण समाहतो भोजनं कुरुते द्विजः //
text_mt: and union with a woman who drinks liquor is remembered as equal to the drinking of liquor. / That twice-born who eats food when invited by a śūdra,

sanskrit_iast:
surāpī sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ /
yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñātaḥ preṣyakarma kariti ca //
meaning:
सुरापी स हि विज्ञेयः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः /
यः शूद्रेणाभ्यनुज्ञातः प्रेष्यकर्म करिति च //
text_mt: he is to be known as a liquor-drinker, excluded from all duties. / He who, being commanded by a śūdra, performs the work of a servant,

sanskrit_iast:
surāpāna samaṃ pāpaṃ labhate sa narādhamaḥ /
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ pāpaṃ surāpānasamaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
सुरापान समं पापं लभते स नराधमः /
एवं बहुविधं पापं सुरापानसमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: that lowest of men incurs a sin equal to drinking liquor. / Sins equal to the drinking of liquor are remembered to be of many kinds in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
hemasteyasamaṃ pāpaṃ pravakṣyāmi niśāmaya /
kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca kastūrī paṭavāsasām //
meaning:
हेमस्तेयसमं पापं प्रवक्ष्यामि निशामय /
कन्दमूलफलानां च कस्तूरी पटवाससाम् //
text_mt: Hear now the sin equal to the theft of gold, which I shall declare: / [The theft] of roots, tubers, and fruits, of musk, and scented garments,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā steyaṃ ca ratnānāṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam /
tāmrāyastrapukāṃsyānāmājyasya madhunastathā //
meaning:
सदा स्तेयं च रत्नानां स्वर्णस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् /
ताम्रायस्त्रपुकांस्यानामाज्यस्य मधुनस्तथा //
text_mt: and the constant theft of gems is considered equal to the theft of gold. / [The theft] of copper, iron, tin, bronze, clarified butter, and honey,

sanskrit_iast:
steyaṃ sugandhadravyāṇṇāṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam /
kramukasyāpiharaṇamambhasāṃ candanasya ca //
parṇarasāpaharaṇaṃ svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam /
meaning:
स्तेयं सुगन्धद्रव्याण्णां स्वर्णस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् /
क्रमुकस्यापिहरणमम्भसां चन्दनस्य च //
पर्णरसापहरणं स्वर्णस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् /
text_mt:
the theft of fragrant substances is considered equal to the theft of gold. / The stealing of betel nut, of waters, and of sandalwood,

and the theft of the juice of betel leaves is considered equal to the theft of gold.

sanskrit_iast: pitṛyajñaparityāgo dharmakāryavilopanam //
meaning: पितृयज्ञपरित्यागो धर्मकार्यविलोपनम् //
text_mt: Abandoning ancestral rites, causing the destruction of righteous acts,

sanskrit_iast:
yatīrnāṃ nindataṃ caiva svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam /
bhakṣyāṇāṃ cāpaharaṇaṃ dhānyānāṃ haraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
यतीर्नां निन्दतं चैव स्वर्णस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् /
भक्ष्याणां चापहरणं धान्यानां हरणं तथा //
text_mt: and censuring ascetics is considered equal to the theft of gold. / The stealing of edible delicacies and the stealing of grains,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrākṣaharaṇaṃ caiva svarṇasteyasamaṃ smṛtam /
bhāgīnīgamanaṃ caiva putrastrīgamanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
रुद्राक्षहरणं चैव स्वर्णस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् /
भागीनीगमनं चैव पुत्रस्त्रीगमनं तथा //
text_mt: and the stealing of rudrākṣa beads is considered equal to the theft of gold. / Having intercourse with a sister, and intercourse with a son's wife,

sanskrit_iast:
rajasvalādigamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam /
hīnajātyābhigamanaṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam //
meaning:
रजस्वलादिगमनं गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् /
हीनजात्याभिगमनं मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् //
text_mt: intercourse with a menstruating woman, etc., is considered equal to violating the guru's bed. / Intercourse with a woman of low caste, consorting with a woman who drinks wine,

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīgamanaṃ caiva gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam /
bhrātṛstrīgamanaṃ caiva vayasyastrīniṣevaṇam //
viśvastāgamanaṃ caiva gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam /
meaning:
परस्त्रीगमनं चैव गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् /
भ्रातृस्त्रीगमनं चैव वयस्यस्त्रीनिषेवणम् //
विश्वस्तागमनं चैव गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् /
text_mt:
and intercourse with another's wife is considered equal to violating the guru's bed. / Intercourse with a brother's wife, consorting with a friend's wife,

and intercourse with a trusting woman is considered equal to violating the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast: akāle karmakaraṇaṃ putrīgamana meva ca //
meaning: अकाले कर्मकरणं पुत्रीगमन मेव च //
text_mt: Performing rites at the improper time, and having intercourse with one's own daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmalopaḥ śāstranindā gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam /
ityevamādayo rājanmahāpātakasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मलोपः शास्त्रनिन्दा गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् /
इत्येवमादयो राजन्महापातकसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: neglect of religious duty, and censuring the scriptures are remembered as equal to violating the guru's bed. / Sins of this kind, O king, are designated as major sins.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvekatamenāpi saṅgakṛttatsamo bhavet /
yathākathañcitpāpānāmeteṣāṃ paramarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
एतेष्वेकतमेनापि सङ्गकृत्तत्समो भवेत् /
यथाकथञ्चित्पापानामेतेषां परमर्षिभिः //
text_mt: One who forms an association with any one of these becomes equal to them. / For these sins, some kind of expiation has been observed by supreme sages

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaistu niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā prāyaścitādikalpanaiḥ /
prāyaścittavihīnāni pāpāni śṛṇu bhūpate //
meaning:
शान्तैस्तु निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा प्रायश्चितादिकल्पनैः /
प्रायश्चित्तविहीनानि पापानि शृणु भूपते //
text_mt: who were calm, through the prescriptions of penance and other means. / Hear now, O lord of the earth, of the sins devoid of expiation,

sanskrit_iast:
samastapāpatulyāni mahānarakadāni ca /
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kathañcinniṣkṛtirbhavet //
meaning:
समस्तपापतुल्यानि महानरकदानि च /
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां कथञ्चिन्निष्कृतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: equal to all sins, which consign one to great hells. / For sins like brahmin-murder, there may somehow be expiation;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi yastasya niṣkṛtirnāsti kutracit /
viśvastaghātinaṃ caiva kṛtanghānāṃ nareśvara //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणं द्वेष्टि यस्तस्य निष्कृतिर्नास्ति कुत्रचित् /
विश्वस्तघातिनं चैव कृतन्घानां नरेश्वर //
text_mt: for one who hates a brahmin, there is no expiation anywhere. / For the slayer of one who trusts, and for the ungrateful, O lord of men,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrastrīsaṅgināṃ caiva niṣkṛtirnāsti kutracit /
śūdrānnapuṣṭadehānāṃ vedanindāratātmanām //
meaning:
शूद्रस्त्रीसङ्गिनां चैव निष्कृतिर्नास्ति कुत्रचित् /
शूद्रान्नपुष्टदेहानां वेदनिन्दारतात्मनाम् //
text_mt: and for those who consort with śūdra women, there is no expiation anywhere. / For those whose bodies are nourished on the food of śūdras, whose souls take delight in reviling the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
satkathānindakānāñca nehāmutracaniṣkṛtiḥ //
bauddhālayaṃ viśedyastu mahāpadyapi vaidvijaḥ /
meaning:
सत्कथानिन्दकानाञ्च नेहामुत्रचनिष्कृतिः //
बौद्धालयं विशेद्यस्तु महापद्यपि वैद्विजः /
text_mt:
and for those who slander sacred discourses, there is no expiation either here or in the hereafter.

Whatever twice-born person enters a Buddhist temple, even in a time of extreme calamity,

sanskrit_iast: natasyaniṣkṛtirdṛṣṭāprāyaścitaśatairapi //
meaning: नतस्यनिष्कृतिर्दृष्टाप्रायश्चितशतैरपि //
text_mt: no expiation is seen for him, even by hundreds of penances.

sanskrit_iast:
bauddhāḥ pāṣaṃṇḍinaḥ proktā yato vedavinindakāḥ /
tasmādvijastānnekṣeta yato dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
बौद्धाः पाषंण्डिनः प्रोक्ता यतो वेदविनिन्दकाः /
तस्माद्विजस्तान्नेक्षेत यतो धर्मबहिष्कृताः //
text_mt: Buddhists are declared to be heretics, because they revile the Vedas; / therefore, a twice-born should not look upon them, since they are excluded from dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānato 'jñānato vāpi dvijo boddhālayaṃ viśet /
jñātvā cenniṣkṛtirnāsti śāstrāṇāmiti niśvayaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानतो ऽज्ञानतो वापि द्विजो बोद्धालयं विशेत् /
ज्ञात्वा चेन्निष्कृतिर्नास्ति शास्त्राणामिति निश्वयः //
text_mt: Whether knowingly or unknowingly, if a twice-born enters a Buddhist temple, / if [he does so] knowingly, there is no expiation; such is the ascertainment of the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ pāpabāhulyānnarakaṃ koṭikalpakam /
prāyaścittavihīnāni proktānyanyāni ca prabho //
meaning:
एतेषां पापबाहुल्यान्नरकं कोटिकल्पकम् /
प्रायश्चित्तविहीनानि प्रोक्तान्यन्यानि च प्रभो //
text_mt: Because of the abundance of their sins, [their] hell lasts for ten million kalpas. / Other [sins] also, deprived of expiation, have been declared, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast: pāpāni teṣāṃ narakāngadato me niśāmaya //
meaning: पापानि तेषां नरकान्गदतो मे निशामय //
text_mt: Listen to me as I describe their sins and hells:

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakinasteṣu pratyekaṃ yugavāsinaḥ /
tadante pṛthivīmetya satpajanmasu gardabhāḥ //
meaning:
महापातकिनस्तेषु प्रत्येकं युगवासिनः /
तदन्ते पृथिवीमेत्य सत्पजन्मसु गर्दभाः //
text_mt: Those who commit major sins dwell in each of them for an age; / at the end of that, coming to the earth, they are donkeys for seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śvāno viddhadehā bhaveyurdaśajanmasu /
āśatābdaṃ viṭkṛmayaḥ sarpā dvādaśajanmasu //
meaning:
ततः श्वानो विद्धदेहा भवेयुर्दशजन्मसु /
आशताब्दं विट्कृमयः सर्पा द्वादशजन्मसु //
text_mt: Then they become dogs with wounded bodies for ten births, / worms in feces for up to a hundred years, and snakes for twelve births.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sahasrajanmāni mṛgādyāḥ paśavo nṛpa /
śatābdaṃ sthāvarāścaiva tato godhāśarīriṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततः सहस्रजन्मानि मृगाद्याः पशवो नृप /
शताब्दं स्थावराश्चैव ततो गोधाशरीरिणः //
text_mt: Then beasts such as deer for a thousand births, O king, / stationary beings for a hundred years, and then endowed with the bodies of monitor lizards.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu satpajanmāni caṇḍālāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ /
tataḥ ṣoḍaśa janmāni śūdrādyā hīnajātayaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु सत्पजन्मानि चण्डालाः पापकारिणः /
ततः षोडश जन्मानि शूद्राद्या हीनजातयः //
text_mt: Then, for seven births, sin-committing Cāṇḍālas; / then, for sixteen births, degraded castes such as Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu janmadvitaye daridrāvyādhipīḍitāḥ /
pratigrahaparā nityaṃ tato nirayagāḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु जन्मद्वितये दरिद्राव्याधिपीडिताः /
प्रतिग्रहपरा नित्यं ततो निरयगाः पुनः //
text_mt: Then, in a pair of births, poor and afflicted by diseases, / always intent on acceptance of gifts; then going to hell once more.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyāviṣṭamanaso raurave narake smṛtam /
tatra kalpadvayaṃ sthitvā cāṇḍālāḥ śatajanmasu //
meaning:
असूयाविष्टमनसो रौरवे नरके स्मृतम् /
तत्र कल्पद्वयं स्थित्वा चाण्डालाः शतजन्मसु //
text_mt: Those whose minds are possessed by spite are traditionally said [to fall] into Raurava hell; / having remained there for two kalpas, they become Cāṇḍālas for a hundred births.

sanskrit_iast:
mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāngibrāhmaṇeṣu ca /
śunāṃ yoniśataṃ gatvā cāṇḍāleṣūpajāyate //
meaning:
मा ददस्वेति यो ब्रूयाद्गवान्गिब्राह्मणेषु च /
शुनां योनिशतं गत्वा चाण्डालेषूपजायते //
text_mt: He who says “Do not give” regarding cows, fires, and brāhmaṇas, / passing through a hundred wombs of dogs, is born among Cāṇḍālas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣṭhākṛtimiścaiva tato vyāghrastrijanmasu /
tadante narakaṃ yāti yugānāmekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
ततो विष्ठाकृतिमिश्चैव ततो व्याघ्रस्त्रिजन्मसु /
तदन्ते नरकं याति युगानामेकविंशतिम् //
text_mt: Then a worm in feces, and then a tiger for three births; / at the end of that, he goes to hell for twenty-one ages.

sanskrit_iast:
paranindāparā ye ca ye ca niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇaḥ /
dānānāṃ vinghakarttārasteṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
परनिन्दापरा ये च ये च निष्ठुरभाषिणः /
दानानां विन्घकर्त्तारस्तेषां पापफलं शृणु //
text_mt: Those who are intent on reviling others, and those who speak harsh words, / and those who cause obstruction to gifts—hear the fruit of their sin:

sanskrit_iast:
muśalolū khalābhyāṃ tu cūrṇyante taskarā bhṛśam /
tadante tatpapāṣāṇagrahaṇaṃ vatsaratraghayam //
meaning:
मुशलोलू खलाभ्यां तु चूर्ण्यन्ते तस्करा भृशम् /
तदन्ते तत्पपाषाणग्रहणं वत्सरत्रघयम् //
text_mt: Thieves are crushed severely with pestles and mortars; / at the end of that, there is the holding of heated stones for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca kālasūtreṇa bhidyante satpa vatsarān /
śocantaḥ svṛnikarmāṇi paradravyāpahārakāḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च कालसूत्रेण भिद्यन्ते सत्प वत्सरान् /
शोचन्तः स्वृनिकर्माणि परद्रव्यापहारकाः //
text_mt: And then, by Kālasūtra, they are torn asunder for seven years; / grieving for their own actions, the stealers of others' wealth,

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇā tatra pacyante narakāngiṣu santatam //
meaning: कर्मणा तत्र पच्यन्ते नरकान्गिषु सन्ततम् //
text_mt: are constantly cooked there in hells according to their karma.

sanskrit_iast:
parasvasūcakānāṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇu dāruṇam /
yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu tatpāyaḥ piṇḍabhakṣaṇam //
meaning:
परस्वसूचकानां च नरकं शृणु दारुणम् /
यावद्युगसहस्रं तु तत्पायः पिण्डभक्षणम् //
text_mt: And hear of the terrible hell of those who inform against others' property: / for as long as a thousand ages, there is the eating of heated iron balls,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpīḍyate ca rasanā saṃdaṃśairbhṛśadāruṇaiḥ /
nirucchvāsaṃ mahāghore kalpārddhaṃ nivasanti te //
meaning:
संपीड्यते च रसना संदंशैर्भृशदारुणैः /
निरुच्छ्वासं महाघोरे कल्पार्द्धं निवसन्ति ते //
text_mt: and the tongue is severely squeezed with exceedingly dreadful tongs; / deprived of breath, they dwell in the exceedingly terrible [hell] for half a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
parastrīlolupānāṃ ca narakaṃ kathayāmi te /
tatpatāmrastriyastena surupābharaṇairyutāḥ //
meaning:
परस्त्रीलोलुपानां च नरकं कथयामि ते /
तत्पताम्रस्त्रियस्तेन सुरुपाभरणैर्युताः //
text_mt: And I shall tell you of the hell of those who lust after others' wives: / red-hot copper women, endowed with beautiful forms and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśīstādṛśīstāśca ramante prasabhaṃ bahu /
vidvavantaṃ bhayenāsāṃ gṛhṇanti prasabhaṃ ca tam //
meaning:
यादृशीस्तादृशीस्ताश्च रमन्ते प्रसभं बहु /
विद्ववन्तं भयेनासां गृह्णन्ति प्रसभं च तम् //
text_mt: they repeatedly and forcibly embrace, whatever kind they may be; / and when he runs away out of fear of them, they seize him forcibly,

sanskrit_iast:
kathayantaśca tatkarma nayante narakānkramāt /
anyaṃ bhajante bhūpāla patiṃ tyaktvā ca yāḥ striyaḥ //
meaning:
कथयन्तश्च तत्कर्म नयन्ते नरकान्क्रमात् /
अन्यं भजन्ते भूपाल पतिं त्यक्त्वा च याः स्त्रियः //
text_mt: and recounting his deeds, they lead him successively into hells. / And those women who, abandoning their husband, resort to another, O protector of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāyaḥpuruśāstāstu tatpāyaḥśayanebalāt /
pātayitvā ramante ca bahukālaṃ balānvitāḥ //
meaning:
तत्पायःपुरुशास्तास्तु तत्पायःशयनेबलात् /
पातयित्वा रमन्ते च बहुकालं बलान्विताः //
text_mt: red-hot iron men throw them forcibly upon a heated iron bed, / and, endowed with strength, sport with them for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastairyoṣito muktā hutāśanasamojjvalam /
a yaḥ stambhaṃ samāśsiṣya tiṣṭhantyabdasahasrakam //
meaning:
ततस्तैर्योषितो मुक्ता हुताशनसमोज्ज्वलम् /
अ यः स्तम्भं समाश्सिष्य तिष्ठन्त्यब्दसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: Then, released by them, the women stand for a thousand years / clasping an iron pillar blazing like fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣārodakasnānaṃ kṣārodakaniṣevaṇam /
tadante narakān sarvān bhuñjate 'bdaśataṃ śatam //
meaning:
ततः क्षारोदकस्नानं क्षारोदकनिषेवणम् /
तदन्ते नरकान् सर्वान् भुञ्जते ऽब्दशतं शतम् //
text_mt: Then there is bathing in caustic water and consuming caustic water; / at the end of that, they experience all the hells for a hundred years each.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hanti brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca kṣatriyaṃ ca nṛpottamam /
sa cāpi yātanāḥ sarvā bhuṅkte kalpeṣu pañcasu //
meaning:
यो हन्ति ब्राह्मणं गां च क्षत्रियं च नृपोत्तमम् /
स चापि यातनाः सर्वा भुङ्क्ते कल्पेषु पञ्चसु //
text_mt: He who slays a brāhmaṇa, a cow, a kṣatriya, or an excellent king, / he too experiences all tortures throughout five kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śṛṇoti mahannindāṃ sādaraṃ tatphalaṃ śṛṇu /
teṣāṃ karṇeṣu dāpyante tatpāyaḥ kīlasaṃcayāḥ //
meaning:
यः शृणोति महन्निन्दां सादरं तत्फलं शृणु /
तेषां कर्णेषु दाप्यन्ते तत्पायः कीलसंचयाः //
text_mt: He who listens with respect to censure of the great, hear the fruit of that: / into their ears are driven heaps of red-hot iron pegs,

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca teṣu chidreṣu tailamatyuṣṇamulbaṇam /
pūryate ca tataścāpiṃ kumbhīpākaṃ prapadyate //
meaning:
ततश्च तेषु छिद्रेषु तैलमत्युष्णमुल्बणम् /
पूर्यते च ततश्चापिं कुम्भीपाकं प्रपद्यते //
text_mt: and then into those apertures, boiling, intense oil / is poured, and then he also falls into Kumbhīpāka.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikānāṃ pravakṣyāmi vimukhānāṃ hare harau /
abdānāṃ koṭiparyantaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhuñjate hi te //
meaning:
नास्तिकानां प्रवक्ष्यामि विमुखानां हरे हरौ /
अब्दानां कोटिपर्यन्तं लवणं भुञ्जते हि ते //
text_mt: I shall speak of the atheists who are averse to Hari: / they indeed consume salt for up to ten million years;

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca kalpaparyantaṃ raurave tatpasaikate /
bhajyante pāpakarmaṇo 'nyepyevaṃ narādhipa //
meaning:
ततश्च कल्पपर्यन्तं रौरवे तत्पसैकते /
भज्यन्ते पापकर्मणो ऽन्येप्येवं नराधिप //
text_mt: and then for up to a kalpa, in Raurava on red-hot sand, / those of sinful deeds are roasted; and others likewise, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇanye nirīkṣante kopadṛṣṭyā narādhamāḥ /
tatpasūcīsahasreṇa cakṣusteṣāṃ prasūryate //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणन्ये निरीक्षन्ते कोपदृष्ट्या नराधमाः /
तत्पसूचीसहस्रेण चक्षुस्तेषां प्रसूर्यते //
text_mt: Those lowest of men who look upon brāhmaṇas with an angry gaze, / their eyes are pierced with a thousand red-hot needles;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣārāmbudhārābhiḥ secyante nṛpasattama /
tataśca krakarcerghorairbhidyante pāpakarṃmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततः क्षाराम्बुधाराभिः सेच्यन्ते नृपसत्तम /
ततश्च क्रकर्चेर्घोरैर्भिद्यन्ते पापकर्ंमणः //
text_mt: then they are sprinkled with streams of caustic water, O best of kings, / and then, those of sinful deeds are torn by terrible saws.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāsaghātināṃ caiva maryādābhedināṃ tathā /
parānnalollupānāṃ ca narakaṃ śṛṇu dāruṇam //
meaning:
विश्वासघातिनां चैव मर्यादाभेदिनां तथा /
परान्नलोल्लुपानां च नरकं शृणु दारुणम् //
text_mt: Of betrayers of trust, and likewise of violators of propriety, / and of those greedy for others' food, hear the terrible hell:

sanskrit_iast:
svamāṃsabhojino nityaṃ bhakṣamāṇāḥ śvabhistu te /
narakeṣu samasteṣu pratyekaṃ hyabdavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
स्वमांसभोजिनो नित्यं भक्षमाणाः श्वभिस्तु ते /
नरकेषु समस्तेषु प्रत्येकं ह्यब्दवासिनः //
text_mt: Constantly eating their own flesh while being devoured by dogs, / they dwell in all the hells, a year in each.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigraharatā ye ca ye vai nakṣatrapāṭhakāḥ /
ye ca devalakānnānāṃ bhojinastāñśṛṇuṣva me //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहरता ये च ये वै नक्षत्रपाठकाः /
ये च देवलकान्नानां भोजिनस्ताञ्शृणुष्व मे //
text_mt: Those who delight in acceptance of gifts, and those who are astrologers, / and those who eat the food of temple priests—hear of them from me:

sanskrit_iast:
rājannākalpaparyantaṃ yātanāsvāsu duḥkhitāḥ /
pacyante satataṃ pāpāviṣṭā bhogaratāḥ sadā //
meaning:
राजन्नाकल्पपर्यन्तं यातनास्वासु दुःखिताः /
पच्यन्ते सततं पापाविष्टा भोगरताः सदा //
text_mt: Afflicted in those tortures until the end of a kalpa, O king, / filled with sin, they are continually cooked, always attached to sensory enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastailena pūryante kālasūtraprapīḍitāḥ /
tataḥ kṣārodakasnānaṃ mūtraviṣṭāniṣevaṇam //
meaning:
ततस्तैलेन पूर्यन्ते कालसूत्रप्रपीडिताः /
ततः क्षारोदकस्नानं मूत्रविष्टानिषेवणम् //
text_mt: Then, tormented by Kālasūtra, they are filled with oil; / then there is bathing in caustic water and consuming urine and feces.

sanskrit_iast:
tadante bhuvamāsādya bhavanti mlecchajātayaḥ /
anyodvegaratā ye tu yānti vaitaraṇīṃ nadīm //
meaning:
तदन्ते भुवमासाद्य भवन्ति म्लेच्छजातयः /
अन्योद्वेगरता ये तु यान्ति वैतरणीं नदीम् //
text_mt: At the end of that, coming to the earth, they become Mleccha castes. / But those who delight in distressing others go to the Vaitaraṇī river.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktapañcamahāyajñā lālābhakṣaṃ vrajanti hi /
upāsanāparityāgī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
त्यक्तपञ्चमहायज्ञा लालाभक्षं व्रजन्ति हि /
उपासनापरित्यागी रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Those who have abandoned the five great sacrifices go indeed to Lālābhakṣa; / he who abandons worship would go to the Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
vipragrāmakarādānaṃ kurvatāṃ śṛṇu bhūpate /
yātanāsvāsu pacyante vāvadācandratārakam //
meaning:
विप्रग्रामकरादानं कुर्वतां शृणु भूपते /
यातनास्वासु पच्यन्ते वावदाचन्द्रतारकम् //
text_mt: Hear of those who impose taxes on brāhmaṇa villages, O lord of the earth: / they are cooked in those tortures as long as the moon and stars endure.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmeṣu bhūpālavaro yaḥ kuryādadhikaṃ karam /
sa sahasrakulo bhuṅktenarakaṃ kalpapañcasu //
meaning:
ग्रामेषु भूपालवरो यः कुर्यादधिकं करम् /
स सहस्रकुलो भुङ्क्तेनरकं कल्पपञ्चसु //
text_mt: Whatever best of kings should levy an excess tax on villages, / along with a thousand families he suffers hell throughout five kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
vipragrāmakarādāne yo 'numantātu pāpakṛt /
sa eva kṛtavān rājanbrahmahatyāsahasrakam //
meaning:
विप्रग्रामकरादाने यो ऽनुमन्तातु पापकृत् /
स एव कृतवान् राजन्ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रकम् //
text_mt: The evildoer who assents to the taxation of a brāhmaṇa village, / he has indeed committed a thousand murders of brāhmaṇas, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kālasūtre mahāghore sa vaseddicaturyugam /
ayonau ca viyonau ca paśuyonau ca yo naraḥ //
meaning:
कालसूत्रे महाघोरे स वसेद्दिचतुर्युगम् /
अयोनौ च वियोनौ च पशुयोनौ च यो नरः //
text_mt: He would dwell in the exceedingly dreadful Kālasūtra for four ages. / And whatever man, into an improper womb, an unnatural womb, or an animal womb,

sanskrit_iast:
tyajedreto mahāpāpī saretobhojanaṃ labhet /
vasākūpaṃ tataḥ prāpya sthitvā divyābdasatpakam //
meaning:
त्यजेद्रेतो महापापी सरेतोभोजनं लभेत् /
वसाकूपं ततः प्राप्य स्थित्वा दिव्याब्दसत्पकम् //
text_mt: emits semen, that great sinner would receive the eating of semen; / then, having reached the pit of fat and remained there for seven divine years,

sanskrit_iast:
retobhojī bhavenmartyaḥ sarvalokeṣu ninditaḥ /
upavāsadine rājandantadhāvanakṛnnaraḥ //
meaning:
रेतोभोजी भवेन्मर्त्यः सर्वलोकेषु निन्दितः /
उपवासदिने राजन्दन्तधावनकृन्नरः //
text_mt: that mortal becomes an eater of semen, despised in all worlds. / The man who cleans his teeth on a day of fasting, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
sa ghoraṃ narakaṃ yātivyāghrapakṣaṃ caturyugam /
yaḥ svakarmaparityāgī pāṣaṇḍītyucyate budhaiḥ //
meaning:
स घोरं नरकं यातिव्याघ्रपक्षं चतुर्युगम् /
यः स्वकर्मपरित्यागी पाषण्डीत्युच्यते बुधैः //
text_mt: goes to a terrible hell for four ages, torn by tigers. / He who abandons his own duties is called a heretic by the wise;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃgakṛtamoghaḥ syāttāvubhāvatipāpinau /
kalpakoṭisahasreṣu prānputo narakānkramāt //
meaning:
तत्संगकृतमोघः स्यात्तावुभावतिपापिनौ /
कल्पकोटिसहस्रेषु प्रान्पुतो नरकान्क्रमात् //
text_mt: contact with him becomes ruined; both of them are exceedingly sinful, / and throughout a thousand ten million kalpas they obtain hells in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
devadravyāpaharttāro gurudravyāpahārakāḥ /
brahmahatyāvratasamaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ bhuñjate nṛpa //
meaning:
देवद्रव्यापहर्त्तारो गुरुद्रव्यापहारकाः /
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतसमं दुष्कृतं भुञ्जते नृप //
text_mt: Stealers of deity-property and stealers of the guru's property / suffer bad karma equal to the vow of brāhmaṇa-murder, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthadhanaharttāro hyanāthaṃ ye dviṣanti ca /
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi narake te vasanti ca //
meaning:
अनाथधनहर्त्तारो ह्यनाथं ये द्विषन्ति च /
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि नरके ते वसन्ति च //
text_mt: Stealers of the wealth of the helpless, and those who hate the helpless, / dwell in hell for a thousand ten million kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdrāṇāṃ samīpe tu ye vedādhyayane ratāḥ /
teṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्राणां समीपे तु ये वेदाध्ययने रताः /
तेषां पापफलं वक्ष्ये शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: Those who engage in the study of the Veda in the proximity of women and Śūdras, / I shall state the fruit of their sin; listen with a well-composed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśīrṣordhvapādāśca kīlitāḥ stambhaghakadvaye /
dhrūmrapānaratā nityaṃ tiṣṭhantyābrahmavatsaram //
meaning:
अधःशीर्षोर्ध्वपादाश्च कीलिताः स्तम्भघकद्वये /
ध्रूम्रपानरता नित्यं तिष्ठन्त्याब्रह्मवत्सरम् //
text_mt: With their heads down and feet up, pinned between two pillars, / constantly made to drink smoke, they remain for a year of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
jale devālaye vāpi yastyajeddehajaṃ malam /
bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ saṃprānpotyatidāruṇam //
meaning:
जले देवालये वापि यस्त्यजेद्देहजं मलम् /
भ्रूणहत्यासमं पापं संप्रान्पोत्यतिदारुणम् //
text_mt: Whoever discharges bodily waste in water or in a temple / incurs a most terrible sin equal to the killing of an embryo.

sanskrit_iast:
dantāsthikeśanakharānye tyajyantyamarālaye /
jale vā bhuktaśeṣaṃ ca teṣāṃ pāpaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
दन्तास्थिकेशनखरान्ये त्यज्यन्त्यमरालये /
जले वा भुक्तशेषं च तेषां पापफलं शृणु //
text_mt: Whoever throws teeth, bones, hair, or nails in a temple of the gods, / or leftover food in water, hear the fruit of their sins:

sanskrit_iast:
prāsaprotā halairbhinnā ārttarāvavirāviṇaḥ /
atyuṣṇatailapāke 'titapyante bhṛśadāruṇe //
meaning:
प्रासप्रोता हलैर्भिन्ना आर्त्तरावविराविणः /
अत्युष्णतैलपाके ऽतितप्यन्ते भृशदारुणे //
text_mt: Impaled on spears, torn apart by plows, screaming out cries of agony, / they are severely tortured in a cooking pot of boiling oil that is intensely terrible.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvanti duḥkhasaṃtatpāstato 'nyeṣu vrajanti ca /
brahmasaṃharate yastu gandhakāṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
कुर्वन्ति दुःखसंतत्पास्ततो ऽन्येषु व्रजन्ति च /
ब्रह्मसंहरते यस्तु गन्धकाष्टं तथैव च //
text_mt: Tormented by misery, they scream and then pass on to other [hells]. / And whoever takes away the property of a Brahmin, as well as fragrant wood—

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadācandratārakam /
brahmasvaharaṇaṃ rājannihāmātra ca duḥkhadam //
ihasaṃpadvināśāyaparatranarakāya ca /
meaning:
स याति नरकं घोरं यावदाचन्द्रतारकम् /
ब्रह्मस्वहरणं राजन्निहामात्र च दुःखदम् //
इहसंपद्विनाशायपरत्रनरकाय च /
text_mt:
He goes to a dreadful hell as long as the moon and stars endure. / Seizing a brāhmaṇa's property, O king, brings misery both here and beyond;

it leads to the destruction of wealth in this world, and to hell in the next.

sanskrit_iast: kūṭasākṣyaṃvadedyastu tasya pāpaphalaṃśṛṇu //
meaning: कूटसाक्ष्यंवदेद्यस्तु तस्य पापफलंशृणु //
text_mt: Now hear the fruit of the sin of one who gives false testimony:

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti yātanāḥ sarvā yāvadindrāścaturdaśa /
ihaputrāśca vinaśyanti paraghatra ca //
meaning:
स याति यातनाः सर्वा यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश /
इहपुत्राश्च विनश्यन्ति परघत्र च //
text_mt: he undergoes all torments for as long as the fourteen Indras reign; / in this world his sons perish, and in the next he likewise falls.

sanskrit_iast:
rauravaṃ narakaṃ bhuṅkte tato 'nyānapi ca kramāt /
ye cātikāmino martyā ye ca mithyāpravādinaḥ //
meaning:
रौरवं नरकं भुङ्क्ते ततो ऽन्यानपि च क्रमात् /
ये चातिकामिनो मर्त्या ये च मिथ्याप्रवादिनः //
text_mt: He suffers in the Raurava hell, and after that in the others in succession. / And those mortals who are excessively lustful, and those who speak falsely,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sukhe jalaukā stu pūryyante pannagopamāḥ /
evaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrābde tataḥ kṣārāmbagusecanam //
meaning:
तेषां सुखे जलौका स्तु पूर्य्यन्ते पन्नगोपमाः /
एवं षष्टिसहस्राब्दे ततः क्षाराम्बगुसेचनम् //
text_mt: their mouths are filled with leeches resembling serpents. / In this way sixty thousand years pass, and then follows sprinkling with caustic brine.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vṛthāmāṃsaniratatāste yānti kṣārakardamam /
tato gajairnipātatyante marutprapatanaṃ yathā //
meaning:
ये वृथामांसनिरततास्ते यान्ति क्षारकर्दमम् /
ततो गजैर्निपातत्यन्ते मरुत्प्रपतनं यथा //
text_mt: Those addicted to meat not offered in sacrifice go to the mire of caustic brine; / then they are hurled down by elephants, like being cast down by the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
tadante bhavamāsādya hīnāṅgāḥ prabhavanti ca /
yastvṛtau nābhigaccheta svastriṃya manujeśvara //
meaning:
तदन्ते भवमासाद्य हीनाङ्गाः प्रभवन्ति च /
यस्त्वृतौ नाभिगच्छेत स्वस्त्रिंय मनुजेश्वर //
text_mt: At the end of that, having obtained worldly birth, they are born with defective limbs. / But one who does not approach his own wife in her fertile period, O ruler of men,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti rauravaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahakatyāṃ ca vindati /
anyācārarataṃ dṛṣṭvā yaḥ śakto na nivārayet //
meaning:
स याति रौरवं घोरं ब्रह्महकत्यां च विन्दति /
अन्याचाररतं दृष्ट्वा यः शक्तो न निवारयेत् //
text_mt: goes to the dreadful Raurava and incurs the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa. / He who, though capable, does not prevent one whom he sees engaged in improper conduct

sanskrit_iast:
tatpāpaṃ samavānpoti narakaṃ tāvubhāvapi /
pāpināṃ pāpagaṇanāṃ kṛtvānyebhyo diśanti vindati //
meaning:
तत्पापं समवान्पोति नरकं तावुभावपि /
पापिनां पापगणनां कृत्वान्येभ्यो दिशन्ति विन्दति //
text_mt: incurs that sin, and both of them go to hell. / Those who enumerate the sins of sinners and report them to others

sanskrit_iast:
astitve tulyapāpāste mithyātve dviguṇā nṛpa /
apāpe pātakaṃ yastu samaropya vinindati //
meaning:
अस्तित्वे तुल्यपापास्ते मिथ्यात्वे द्विगुणा नृप /
अपापे पातकं यस्तु समरोप्य विनिन्दति //
text_mt: share equal sin if it is true, and double the sin if it is false, O king. / But he who attributes a sin to an innocent person and reviles him,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvañcardrārkatārakam /
pāpināṃ nindyamānānāṃ pāpārddhaṃ kṣayameti ca //
meaning:
स याति नरकं घोरं यावञ्चर्द्रार्कतारकम् /
पापिनां निन्द्यमानानां पापार्द्धं क्षयमेति च //
text_mt: goes to a dreadful hell as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure; / and half the sin of the sinners who are reviled is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vratāni saṃgṛhya asamāpya parityajyet /
so 'sipatre 'nubhūyārtiṃ hīnāṅgojāyate bhuvi //
meaning:
यस्तु व्रतानि संगृह्य असमाप्य परित्यज्येत् /
सो ऽसिपत्रे ऽनुभूयार्तिं हीनाङ्गोजायते भुवि //
text_mt: He who undertakes vows and abandons them without completing them, / having experienced agony in Asipatra, is born on earth with defective limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
anyaiḥ saṃgṛhyamāṇānāṃvratānāṃ vinghakṛnnaraḥ /
atīva duḥkhadaṃraudraṃ sa yāti śloṣmabhojanam //
meaning:
अन्यैः संगृह्यमाणानांव्रतानां विन्घकृन्नरः /
अतीव दुःखदंरौद्रं स याति श्लोष्मभोजनम् //
text_mt: A man who causes obstacles to vows being undertaken by others / goes to the exceedingly painful and terrible phlegm-eating hell.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāye ca dharmaśikṣāyāṃ pakṣapātaṃ karoti yaḥ /
na tasya niṣkṛtirbhūyaḥ prāyaścittāyutairapi //
meaning:
न्याये च धर्मशिक्षायां पक्षपातं करोति यः /
न तस्य निष्कृतिर्भूयः प्रायश्चित्तायुतैरपि //
text_mt: He who shows partiality in justice or in instruction on dharma / has no expiation, even through tens of thousands of penances.

sanskrit_iast:
abhojyabhojī saṃprāpyaṃ viṅbhojyaṃ tu samāyutam /
tataścaṇḍālayonau tu gomāṃsāśī sadā bhavet //
meaning:
अभोज्यभोजी संप्राप्यं विङ्भोज्यं तु समायुतम् /
ततश्चण्डालयोनौ तु गोमांसाशी सदा भवेत् //
text_mt: One who eats what should not be eaten reaches the eating of feces for ten thousand years; / then in the womb of a Caṇḍāla he constantly eats beef.

sanskrit_iast:
avamānya dvijānvāgbhirbrahmahatyāṃ ca vindati /
sarvāścayātanā bhuktvā cāṇḍālo daśajanmasu //
meaning:
अवमान्य द्विजान्वाग्भिर्ब्रह्महत्यां च विन्दति /
सर्वाश्चयातना भुक्त्वा चाण्डालो दशजन्मसु //
text_mt: Having insulted brāhmaṇas with words, one incurs the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa; / after suffering all the torments, he becomes a Caṇḍāla for ten births.

sanskrit_iast:
vigrāya dīyamāne tu yastu vinghaṃ samācaret /
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tena karttavyaṃ vratameva ca //
meaning:
विग्राय दीयमाने तु यस्तु विन्घं समाचरेत् /
ब्रह्महत्यासमं तेन कर्त्तव्यं व्रतमेव च //
text_mt: When something is being given to a brāhmaṇa, he who causes an obstacle / must perform a vow equal to that for the killing of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
apahṛtya paḥsyārthaṃ yaḥ parebhyaḥ prayacchati /
apaharttā tu nirayī yasyārthastasya tatphalam //
meaning:
अपहृत्य पःस्यार्थं यः परेभ्यः प्रयच्छति /
अपहर्त्ता तु निरयी यस्यार्थस्तस्य तत्फलम् //
text_mt: He who steals another's wealth and gives it to others / becomes a denizen of hell, while he whose wealth it was receives that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiśrutyāpradānena lālābhakṣaṃ vrajennaraḥ /
yatinindāparo rājan śilānamātre prayāti hi //
meaning:
प्रतिश्रुत्याप्रदानेन लालाभक्षं व्रजेन्नरः /
यतिनिन्दापरो राजन् शिलानमात्रे प्रयाति हि //
text_mt: By not giving what was promised, a man goes to the saliva-eating hell; / intent on reviling an ascetic, O king, he falls into hell just by a nod of the head.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmacchedino yānti yugānāmekaviṃśatim /
śvabhojanaṃ tataḥ sarvā bhuñjate yātanāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
आरामच्छेदिनो यान्ति युगानामेकविंशतिम् /
श्वभोजनं ततः सर्वा भुञ्जते यातनाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Those who cut down pleasure groves go for twenty-one yugas / to the dog-eating hell, and then in succession they suffer all the torments.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāgṛhabhettārastaḍāgānāṃ ca bhūpate /
puṣpārāmabhidaścaiva yāṃ gatiṃ yānti tacchṛṇu //
meaning:
देवतागृहभेत्तारस्तडागानां च भूपते /
पुष्पारामभिदश्चैव यां गतिं यान्ति तच्छृणु //
text_mt: Those who break shrines of the gods, reservoirs, O king, / and flower gardens—hear the destiny to which they go:

sanskrit_iast:
yātanāsvāsu sarvāsu pacyante vai pṛthak pṛthak /
tataśca viṣṭākṛmayaḥ kalpānāmekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
यातनास्वासु सर्वासु पच्यन्ते वै पृथक् पृथक् /
ततश्च विष्टाकृमयः कल्पानामेकविंशतिम् //
text_mt: they are cooked individually in all these torments; / and after that they become worms in feces for twenty-one kalpas;

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāṇḍālayonau tu śatajanmāni bhūpate /
grāmavidhvaṃ sakānāṃ tu dāhakānāṃ ca lumpatām //
meaning:
ततश्चाण्डालयोनौ तु शतजन्मानि भूपते /
ग्रामविध्वं सकानां तु दाहकानां च लुम्पताम् //
text_mt: then they take birth in the womb of a Caṇḍāla for a hundred births, O ruler of the earth. / For those who destroy villages, burn them down, and plunder them,

sanskrit_iast:
mahatpāpaṃ tadādeṣṭuṃ na kṣamo 'haṃ nijāyuṣā /
ucchiṣṭabhojino ye ca mitradrohaparāśva ye //
meaning:
महत्पापं तदादेष्टुं न क्षमो ऽहं निजायुषा /
उच्छिष्टभोजिनो ये च मित्रद्रोहपराश्व ये //
text_mt: the sin is great; I am not able to recount it within my own lifespan. / And those who eat food remnants, and those intent on betraying friends—

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ yātanāstīvrā bhavantyācandratārakam /
ucchinnapitṝdevejyā vendamārgabahiḥsthitāḥ //
meaning:
एतेषां यातनास्तीव्रा भवन्त्याचन्द्रतारकम् /
उच्छिन्नपितॄदेवेज्या वेन्दमार्गबहिःस्थिताः //
text_mt: for them there are sharp torments as long as the moon and stars endure. / Those who have abandoned offerings to the ancestors and gods, and stand outside the Vedic path,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpānāṃ yātānānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ cāpi bhūpate /
evaṃ bahuvidhā bhūpa yātanāḥ pāpakāriṇaṇām //
meaning:
पापानां यातानानां च धर्माणां चापि भूपते /
एवं बहुविधा भूप यातनाः पापकारिणणाम् //
text_mt: incur sins and torments, as well as loss of their religious merits, O king. / In this way, O king, varied are the torments of evil-doers.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ ca saṃkhyānaṃ karttuṃ nāsamahaṃ prabho /
pāpānāṃ yātanānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ cāpi bhūpate //
meaning:
तेषां तासां च संख्यानं कर्त्तुं नासमहं प्रभो /
पापानां यातनानां च धर्माणां चापि भूपते //
text_mt: I am not capable, O lord, of calculating them and their number, / nor of the sins, torments, and righteous acts, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyāṃ nigadituṃ loke kaḥ kṣamo viṣṇunā vinā /
eteṣāṃ sarvapāpānāṃ dharmaśāstravidhānataḥ //
meaning:
संख्यां निगदितुं लोके कः क्षमो विष्णुना विना /
एतेषां सर्वपापानां धर्मशास्त्रविधानतः //
text_mt: Who in the world, except Viṣṇu, is able to state their number? / When expiations for all these sins have been performed

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścitteṣu cīrṇeṣu pāparāśiḥ praṇaśyati /
prāyaścittāni kāryāṇi samīpe kamalāpateḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तेषु चीर्णेषु पापराशिः प्रणश्यति /
प्रायश्चित्तानि कार्याणि समीपे कमलापतेः //
text_mt: according to the ordinances of the legal treatises, the heap of sin is destroyed. / Expiations must be performed in the presence of the consort of Kamalā,

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnātiriktakṛtyānāṃ saṃpūrtikaraṇāya ca /
gaṅgā catulasī caiva satsaṅgo harikīrttanam //
meaning:
न्यूनातिरिक्तकृत्यानां संपूर्तिकरणाय च /
गङ्गा चतुलसी चैव सत्सङ्गो हरिकीर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: in order to complete what has been done deficiently or excessively. / The Gaṅgā, tulasī, fellowship with the virtuous, chanting Hari's praise,

sanskrit_iast:
anasūyā hyahiṃsā ca sarvepyete hi pāpahāḥ /
viṣṇvarpitāni karmāṇi saphalāni bhavanti hi //
meaning:
अनसूया ह्यहिंसा च सर्वेप्येते हि पापहाः /
विष्ण्वर्पितानि कर्माणि सफलानि भवन्ति हि //
text_mt: freedom from envy, and non-violence—all these indeed destroy sin. / For actions dedicated to Viṣṇu become fruitful;

sanskrit_iast:
anarppitāni karmāṇi bhasmavinyastadravyavat /
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yaccānyanmokṣamādhanam //
meaning:
अनर्प्पितानि कर्माणि भस्मविन्यस्तद्रव्यवत् /
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं यच्चान्यन्मोक्षमाधनम् //
text_mt: actions not dedicated are like an offering placed in ashes. / Regular, occasional, and desire-prompted rites, and whatever else is a means of liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇau samārpitaṃ sarvaṃ sāttvikaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet /
haribhaktiḥ parā nṛṇāṃ sarvaṃ pāpaprāṇāśinī //
meaning:
विष्णौ समार्पितं सर्वं सात्त्विकं सफलं भवेत् /
हरिभक्तिः परा नृणां सर्वं पापप्राणाशिनी //
text_mt: when fully offered to Viṣṇu, becomes sattva-dominated and fruitful. / Supreme devotion to Hari destroys all sins of men;

sanskrit_iast:
sā bhaktidraśadhā jñeyā pāpāraṇyadavopamā /
tāmasai rājasaiśvaiva sāttvikaiśca nṛpottama //
meaning:
सा भक्तिद्रशधा ज्ञेया पापारण्यदवोपमा /
तामसै राजसैश्वैव सात्त्विकैश्च नृपोत्तम //
text_mt: that devotion should be understood as tenfold, like a forest fire to the forest of sins, / according to tamas, rajas, and sattva, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccānyasya vināśārthaṃ bhajanaṃ śrīpaternṛpa /
sā tāmasyadhamā bhaktiḥ khalabhāvadharā yataḥ //
meaning:
यच्चान्यस्य विनाशार्थं भजनं श्रीपतेर्नृप /
सा तामस्यधमा भक्तिः खलभावधरा यतः //
text_mt: Worship of the consort of Śrī for the destruction of another, O king— / that is tamas-dominated low devotion, because it bears the state of a villain.

sanskrit_iast:
yor'cayetkaitavadhiyā svairiṇī svapatiṃ yathā /
nārāyaṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ tāmasī madhyamā tu sā //
meaning:
योर्ऽचयेत्कैतवधिया स्वैरिणी स्वपतिं यथा /
नारायणं जगन्नाथं तामसी मध्यमा तु सा //
text_mt: He who worships Nārāyaṇa, the lord of the universe, with deceitful intent, / like an unchaste woman her husband—that is tamas-dominated intermediate devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
devāpūjāparāndṛṣṭvā mātsaryādyor'cayeddhīram /
sā bhaktiḥ pṛthivīpāla tāmasī cottamā smṛtā //
meaning:
देवापूजापरान्दृष्ट्वा मात्सर्याद्योर्ऽचयेद्धीरम् /
सा भक्तिः पृथिवीपाल तामसी चोत्तमा स्मृता //
text_mt: Seeing others devoted to worshiping God, he who worships Hari out of jealousy— / that devotion, O protector of the earth, is considered tamas-dominated high devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadhānyādikaṃ yastu prārthayannarcayedvarim /
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ sā rājasyadhamā smṛtā //
meaning:
धनधान्यादिकं यस्तु प्रार्थयन्नर्चयेद्वरिम् /
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः सा राजस्यधमा स्मृता //
text_mt: He who, endowed with supreme faith, worships Hari / while praying for wealth, grain, and the like—that is considered rajas-dominated low devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvalokavikhyātakīrtimuddiśya mādhavam /
arcayetparayā bhaktyā sā madhyā rājasī matā //
meaning:
यः सर्वलोकविख्यातकीर्तिमुद्दिश्य माधवम् /
अर्चयेत्परया भक्त्या सा मध्या राजसी मता //
text_mt: He who worships Mādhava with supreme devotion / aiming at renown celebrated in all the worlds—that is considered rajas-dominated intermediate devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
sālokyādi padaṃ yastu samuddiśyārcayeddharim /
sā rājasyuttamā bhaktiḥ kīrtitā pṛthivīpate //
meaning:
सालोक्यादि पदं यस्तु समुद्दिश्यार्चयेद्धरिम् /
सा राजस्युत्तमा भक्तिः कीर्तिता पृथिवीपते //
text_mt: He who worships Hari aiming at residence in the same realm and other abodes— / that is proclaimed rajas-dominated high devotion, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu svakṛtapāpānāṃ kṣayārthaṃ prārcayedvarim /
śraddhayā parayopetaḥ sā sāttvikyadhamā smṛtā //
meaning:
यस्तु स्वकृतपापानां क्षयार्थं प्रार्चयेद्वरिम् /
श्रद्धया परयोपेतः सा सात्त्विक्यधमा स्मृता //
text_mt: He who, endowed with supreme faith, worships Hari / for the destruction of sins committed by himself—that is considered sattva-dominated low devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
hareridaṃ priyamiti śuśrūṣāṃ kurute tu yaḥ /
śraddhayā saṃyuto bhūyaḥ sāttvikī madhyamā tu sā //
meaning:
हरेरिदं प्रियमिति शुश्रूषां कुरुते तु यः /
श्रद्धया संयुतो भूयः सात्त्विकी मध्यमा तु सा //
text_mt: He who, endowed with faith, repeatedly performs service / thinking, 'This is pleasing to Hari'—that is sattva-dominated intermediate devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhibuddhyārcayedyastu dāsavacchrīpatiṃ nṛpa /
bhaktīnāṃ pravarā sā tu uttamā sāttvikī smṛtā //
meaning:
विधिबुद्ध्यार्चयेद्यस्तु दासवच्छ्रीपतिं नृप /
भक्तीनां प्रवरा सा तु उत्तमा सात्त्विकी स्मृता //
text_mt: He who worships the consort of Śrī like a servant, with the mind fixed on duty, O king— / that, the best among devotions, is considered sattva-dominated high devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
mahīmānaṃ hareryastu kiñcitkṛtvā priyo naraḥ /
tanmayatvena saṃtuṣṭaḥ sā bhaktiruttamottamā //
meaning:
महीमानं हरेर्यस्तु किञ्चित्कृत्वा प्रियो नरः /
तन्मयत्वेन संतुष्टः सा भक्तिरुत्तमोत्तमा //
text_mt: A dear man who, having realized something of the greatness of Hari, / is content through absorption in him—that is the highest of high devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
ahameva paro viṣṇurmayisarvamidaṃ jagat /
iti yaḥ satataṃ paśyettaṃ vidyāduttamottamam //
meaning:
अहमेव परो विष्णुर्मयिसर्वमिदं जगत् /
इति यः सततं पश्येत्तं विद्यादुत्तमोत्तमम् //
text_mt: 'I alone am the supreme Viṣṇu; all this world is in me'— / he who constantly sees thus, him one should know as the highest of the high.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ daśavidhā bhaktiḥ saṃsāracchedakāriṇī /
tatrāpi sāttvikī bhaktiḥ sarvakāmaphala pradā //
meaning:
एवं दशविधा भक्तिः संसारच्छेदकारिणी /
तत्रापि सात्त्विकी भक्तिः सर्वकामफल प्रदा //
text_mt: Thus devotion is tenfold, severing the cycle of worldly existence. / Even among them, sattva-dominated devotion bestows the fruits of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchṛṇuṣva bhūpāla saṃsāravijigīṣathuṇā /
svakarmaṇo virodhena bhaktiḥ kāryā janārdane //
meaning:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व भूपाल संसारविजिगीषथुणा /
स्वकर्मणो विरोधेन भक्तिः कार्या जनार्दने //
text_mt: Therefore listen, O ruler of the earth: by one wishing to conquer worldly existence, / devotion must be practiced toward Janārdana without contradiction to one's own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svadharmaṃ parityajya bhaktimātreṇa jīvati /
na tasya tuṣyate viṣṇurācāreṇaiva tuṣyate //
meaning:
यः स्वधर्मं परित्यज्य भक्तिमात्रेण जीवति /
न तस्य तुष्यते विष्णुराचारेणैव तुष्यते //
text_mt: He who, abandoning his own duty, lives only by devotion— / Viṣṇu is not pleased with him; he is pleased only by proper conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāgamānāmācāraḥ prathamaṃ parikalpate /
ācāraprabhavo dharmo dharmasya prabhuracyutaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वागमानामाचारः प्रथमं परिकल्पते /
आचारप्रभवो धर्मो धर्मस्य प्रभुरच्युतः //
text_mt: Conduct is conceived as the primary basis of all sacred scriptures. / Dharma arises from conduct, and Acyuta is the lord of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkāryā harerbhaktiḥ svardhamasyāvirodhinī /
sadācāravihīnānāṃ dharmā apyasukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्कार्या हरेर्भक्तिः स्वर्धमस्याविरोधिनी /
सदाचारविहीनानां धर्मा अप्यसुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: Therefore, one should practice devotion to Hari that does not conflict with one's own duty; / even religious acts bring no happiness to those devoid of proper conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmahīnā bhaktiśvāpyakṛtaiva prakīrtitā /
yattu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhūyastatsarvaṃ gaditaṃ mayā //
meaning:
स्वधर्महीना भक्तिश्वाप्यकृतैव प्रकीर्तिता /
यत्तु पृष्टं त्वया भूयस्तत्सर्वं गदितं मया //
text_mt: Devotion that lacks [adherence to] one's own duty is proclaimed as not performed at all. / What you have repeatedly asked, all that has been spoken by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddharmaparo bhūtvā pūjayasva janārdanam /
nārāyaṇamaṇīyāṃsaṃ sukhameṣyasi śāśvakatam //
meaning:
तस्माद्धर्मपरो भूत्वा पूजयस्व जनार्दनम् /
नारायणमणीयांसं सुखमेष्यसि शाश्वकतम् //
text_mt: Therefore, become dedicated to dharma and worship Janārdana, / the most subtle Nārāyaṇa; you will attain eternal happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva eva hariḥ sākṣāddharireva śivaḥ svayam /
dvayorantaradṛgyāti narakārankoṭiśaḥ khalaḥ //
meaning:
शिव एव हरिः साक्षाद्धरिरेव शिवः स्वयम् /
द्वयोरन्तरदृग्याति नरकारन्कोटिशः खलः //
text_mt: Śiva is truly Hari visibly, and Hari is directly Śiva himself. / The wicked person who sees a difference between the two goes to millions of hells.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ vāpi samaṃ buddhā samarcaya /
bhedakṛdduḥkhamāpnoti iha loke paratragha ca //
yadarthamahamāyātastvatsamīpaṃ janādhipa /
tatte vakṣyāmi sumate sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya //
meaning:
तस्माद्विष्णुं शिवं वापि समं बुद्धा समर्चय /
भेदकृद्दुःखमाप्नोति इह लोके परत्रघ च //
यदर्थमहमायातस्त्वत्समीपं जनाधिप /
तत्ते वक्ष्यामि सुमते सावधानं निशामय //
text_mt:
Therefore, worship Viṣṇu or Śiva, knowing them to be equal. / One who makes a distinction attains suffering in this world and in the next.

The purpose for which I have come to your presence, O ruler of men, / that I shall tell you, O wise one; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaghātakapāpmāno dagdhāḥ kapilakopataḥ /
vasanti narake te tu rājaṃstava pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
आत्मघातकपाप्मानो दग्धाः कपिलकोपतः /
वसन्ति नरके ते तु राजंस्तव पितामहाः //
text_mt: Bearing the sin of self-destruction, burnt by the wrath of Kapila, / your ancestors, O king, dwell in hell.

sanskrit_iast:
tānuddhara mahābhāga gaṅgānayanakarmaṇā /
gaṅgā sarvāṇi pāpāni nāśayatyeva bhūpate //
meaning:
तानुद्धर महाभाग गङ्गानयनकर्मणा /
गङ्गा सर्वाणि पापानि नाशयत्येव भूपते //
text_mt: Deliver them, O fortunate one, by the deed of bringing the Gaṅgā. / The Gaṅgā destroys all sins, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
keśāsthinakhadandāśca bhasmāpira nṛpasattama /
nayati viṣṇusadanaṃ spṛṣṭā gāṅgenara vāriṇā //
meaning:
केशास्थिनखदन्दाश्च भस्मापिर नृपसत्तम /
नयति विष्णुसदनं स्पृष्टा गाङ्गेनर वारिणा //
text_mt: Hair, bones, nails, teeth, and even ashes, O best of kings, / touched by the water of the Gaṅgā, she leads to the abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāsthi bhasma vā rājan gaṅgāyāṃ kṣipyate naraiḥ /
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ prayāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
यस्यास्थि भस्म वा राजन् गङ्गायां क्षिप्यते नरैः /
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः प्रयाति भवनं हरेः //
text_mt: A person whose bone or ash, O king, is cast into the Gaṅgā / is liberated from all sins and goes to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni proktāni tava bhūpate /
tāni karmāṇira naśyanti gaṅgābindvabhiṣecanāt //
meaning:
यानि कानि च पापानि प्रोक्तानि तव भूपते /
तानि कर्माणिर नश्यन्ति गङ्गाबिन्द्वभिषेचनात् //
text_mt: Whatever sins were spoken of to you, O king, / all those deeds are destroyed by being sprinkled with a drop of the Gaṅgā.”

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
ityuktvā muniśārdūla mahārājaṃ bhagīratham /
dharmātmānaṃ dharmarājaḥ sadyaśvāntardadhetadā //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूल महाराजं भगीरथम् /
धर्मात्मानं धर्मराजः सद्यश्वान्तर्दधेतदा //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Having spoken thus to the great king Bhagīratha, O tiger among sages, / the righteous Dharmarāja then vanished at once.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu rājā mahāprājñaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragāḥ /
nikṣipya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saciveṣu yayau vanam //
meaning:
स तु राजा महाप्राज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगाः /
निक्षिप्य पृथिवीं सर्वां सचिवेषु ययौ वनम् //
text_mt: And that king of great wisdom, having mastered the meaning of all scriptures, / entrusted the whole earth to his ministers and departed for the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tuhinādrau tato gatvā naranārāyaṇāśramāt /
paścime tuhinākrānte śṛṅgeṣoḍaśayojane //
meaning:
तुहिनाद्रौ ततो गत्वा नरनारायणाश्रमात् /
पश्चिमे तुहिनाक्रान्ते शृङ्गेषोडशयोजने //
text_mt: Then, having gone to the Snowy Mountain, to the west of the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa, / on a snow-covered peak sixteen yojanas away,

sanskrit_iast:
tapastaptvānayāmāsa gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde dharmākhyāne dharmarājopadeśena bhagīrathasya gaṅgānayanodyamavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तपस्तप्त्वानयामास गङ्गां त्रैलोक्यपावनीम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे धर्माख्याने धर्मराजोपदेशेन भगीरथस्य गङ्गानयनोद्यमवर्णनं नाम पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
he performed austerities and brought down the Gaṅgā, the purifier of the three worlds.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, in the discourse on Dharma, entitled 'The Description of Bhagīratha's Endeavor to Bring the Gaṅgā by the Instruction of Dharmarāja'.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
himavadgirimāsādya kiṃ cakāra mahīpatiḥ /
kathamānītavāngaṅgāmetanme vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
हिमवद्गिरिमासाद्य किं चकार महीपतिः /
कथमानीतवान्गङ्गामेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Having reached the Himavat mountain, what did the lord of the earth do? / How did he bring the Gaṅgā? You ought to tell me this.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
bhagīratho mahārājo jaṭācīradharo mune /
gacchanhimādriṃ tapase prāpto godāvarī taṭam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
भगीरथो महाराजो जटाचीरधरो मुने /
गच्छन्हिमाद्रिं तपसे प्राप्तो गोदावरी तटम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Great king Bhagīratha, wearing matted hair and bark garments, O sage, / on his way to the Himādri for austerities, reached the bank of the Godāvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyanmahāraṇye bhṛgorāśramamuttamam /
kṛṣṇasārasamākīrṇaṃ mātaṅgagaṇasevitam //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यन्महारण्ये भृगोराश्रममुत्तमम् /
कृष्णसारसमाकीर्णं मातङ्गगणसेवितम् //
text_mt: There in the great forest he saw the excellent hermitage of Bhṛgu, / crowded with blackbuck antelopes and frequented by herds of elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
bhramadbhūmarasaṃghuṣṭaṃ kūjadvihagasaṃkulam /
vrajadvarāhanikaraṃ camarīpucchavīcitam //
meaning:
भ्रमद्भूमरसंघुष्टं कूजद्विहगसंकुलम् /
व्रजद्वराहनिकरं चमरीपुच्छवीचितम् //
text_mt: filled with the humming of wandering bees, teeming with chirping birds, / with herds of wild boars roaming about, fanned by the tails of yaks,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyanmayūranikaraṃ sāraṅgādiniṣevitam /
pravarddhitamahāvṛkṣaṃ munikanyābhirādarāt //
meaning:
नृत्यन्मयूरनिकरं सारङ्गादिनिषेवितम् /
प्रवर्द्धितमहावृक्षं मुनिकन्याभिरादरात् //
text_mt: with flocks of dancing peacocks, frequented by deer and other beasts, / its great trees nurtured with affection by the daughters of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
śālatālatamālāḍhyaṃ nūnahintālamaṇḍitam /
mālatīyūthikākundacampakāśaavatthabhūṣitam //
meaning:
शालतालतमालाढ्यं नूनहिन्तालमण्डितम् /
मालतीयूथिकाकुन्दचम्पकाशअवत्थभूषितम् //
text_mt: rich in śāla, tāla, and tamāla trees, adorned with fresh hintāla palms, / embellished with mālatī, yūthikā, kunda, campaka, and aśvattha trees,

sanskrit_iast:
utpullakusumopeta mṛṣisaṅghaniṣevitam /
vedaśāstramahāghoṣamāśramaṃ prāviśadbhugoḥ //
meaning:
उत्पुल्लकुसुमोपेत मृषिसङ्घनिषेवितम् /
वेदशास्त्रमहाघोषमाश्रमं प्राविशद्भुगोः //
text_mt: filled with fully blossomed flowers, frequented by assemblies of ṛṣis, / echoing with the great sound of the Vedas and scriptures—he entered that hermitage of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛṇantaṃ parama brahma vṛttaṃ śiṣyagaṇairmunim /
tejasā sūryasadṛśaṃ bhṛguṃ tatra dadarśa saḥ //
meaning:
गृणन्तं परम ब्रह्म वृत्तं शिष्यगणैर्मुनिम् /
तेजसा सूर्यसदृशं भृगुं तत्र ददर्श सः //
text_mt: There he beheld Bhṛgu, the sage expounding the supreme Brahman, / surrounded by hosts of disciples, equal to the sun in splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇanāmātha viprendraṃ pādasaṃgrahaṇādinā /
ātithyaṃ bhṛgurapyasya cakre sanmānapūrvakam //
meaning:
प्रणनामाथ विप्रेन्द्रं पादसंग्रहणादिना /
आतिथ्यं भृगुरप्यस्य चक्रे सन्मानपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Then he bowed to the foremost of Brahmins by grasping his feet and other marks of respect; / Bhṛgu also extended hospitality to him with honor.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtātithyakriyo rājā bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā /
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā vinayānmunipuṅgavam //
meaning:
कृतातिथ्यक्रियो राजा भृगुणा परमर्षिणा /
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा विनयान्मुनिपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt: Having received the rites of hospitality from the great ṛṣi Bhṛgu, / the king, folding his hands, spoke with humility to the eminent sage:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīratha uvāca
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada /
pṛcchāmi bhavabhīto 'haṃ nṛṇāmuddhārakāraṇam //
meaning:
भगीरथ उवाच
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद /
पृच्छामि भवभीतो ऽहं नृणामुद्धारकारणम् //
text_mt: Bhagīratha said: / “O venerable one, knower of all dharma, skilled in all scriptures, / terrified of worldly existence, I ask for the means of deliverance for men.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavāṃstuṣyate yena karmaṇā munisattama /
tanmamākhyāhi sarvajña anugrāhyo 'smi te yati //
meaning:
भगवांस्तुष्यते येन कर्मणा मुनिसत्तम /
तन्ममाख्याहि सर्वज्ञ अनुग्राह्यो ऽस्मि ते यति //
text_mt: By which action the Lord is pleased, O best of sages, / that tell me, O omniscient one, if I am worthy of your favor.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguruvāca
rājaṃstavepsitaṃ jñātaṃ tvaṃ hi puṇyavatāṃ varaḥ /
anyathā svakulaṃ sarvaṃ kathamuddharttumarhasi //
meaning:
भृगुरुवाच
राजंस्तवेप्सितं ज्ञातं त्वं हि पुण्यवतां वरः /
अन्यथा स्वकुलं सर्वं कथमुद्धर्त्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Bhṛgu said: / “O king, your desire is known; you are indeed the foremost among the meritorious, / for how else could you be fit to deliver your entire lineage?

sanskrit_iast:
yo vā ko vāpi bhūpāla svakulaṃ śubhakarmaṇā /
uddharttakāmastaṃ vidyānnararupadharaṃ harim //
meaning:
यो वा को वापि भूपाल स्वकुलं शुभकर्मणा /
उद्धर्त्तकामस्तं विद्यान्नररुपधरं हरिम् //
text_mt: Whoever, O protector of the earth, desires to deliver his own lineage by auspicious action, / one should know him to be Hari bearing a human form.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā yena deveśo nṛṇāmiṣṭaphalapradaḥ /
tatpravakṣyāmi rājendra śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा येन देवेशो नृणामिष्टफलप्रदः /
तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: The action by which the Lord of gods grants the desired fruit to men, / that I shall declare, O ruler of kings; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
bhava satyaparo rājanna hiṃsāniratastathā /
sarvabhūtahito nityaṃ mānṛtaṃ vada vai kvacit //
meaning:
भव सत्यपरो राजन्न हिंसानिरतस्तथा /
सर्वभूतहितो नित्यं मानृतं वद वै क्वचित् //
text_mt: Be dedicated to truth, O king, and likewise not intent on violence; / always intent on the welfare of all beings, never speak falsehood anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaja durjanasaṃsargaṃ bhaja sādhusamāgamam /
kuru puṇyamahorātraṃ smara viṣṇuṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
त्यज दुर्जनसंसर्गं भज साधुसमागमम् /
कुरु पुण्यमहोरात्रं स्मर विष्णुं सनातनम् //
text_mt: Abandon the company of wicked people, cultivate association with the virtuous; / perform merit day and night, remember eternal Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kuru pūjāṃ mahāviṣṇoryāhi śānti manuttamām /
dvādaśāṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ jaya śreyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
कुरु पूजां महाविष्णोर्याहि शान्ति मनुत्तमाम् /
द्वादशाष्टाक्षरं मन्त्रं जय श्रेयो भविष्यति //
text_mt: Perform worship of Mahāviṣṇu, attain unexcelled peace, / recite the twelve-syllable and eight-syllable mantras; your welfare will ensue.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathā uvāca
satyaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ proktaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ mune /
anṛtaṃ kīdṛśaṃ proktaṃ durjanāścāpi kīdṛśāḥ //
meaning:
भगीरथा उवाच
सत्यं तु कीदृशं प्रोक्तं सर्वभूतहितं मुने /
अनृतं कीदृशं प्रोक्तं दुर्जनाश्चापि कीदृशाः //
text_mt: Bhagīratha said: / “What is that which is called truth that brings welfare to all beings, O sage? / What is called falsehood, and what kind are wicked people?

sanskrit_iast:
sādhavaḥ kīdṛśāḥ proktāstathā puṇyaṃ ca kīdṛśam /
smartavyaśca kathaṃ viṣṇustasya pūjā ca kīdṛśī //
meaning:
साधवः कीदृशाः प्रोक्तास्तथा पुण्यं च कीदृशम् /
स्मर्तव्यश्च कथं विष्णुस्तस्य पूजा च कीदृशी //
text_mt: What kind are virtuous people said to be, and what is merit like? / And how is Viṣṇu to be remembered, and what is his worship like?

sanskrit_iast:
śāntiśca kīdṛśī proktā ko mantro 'ṣṭākṣaro mune /
ko vā dvādaśavarṇaśca mune tattvārthakovida //
meaning:
शान्तिश्च कीदृशी प्रोक्ता को मन्त्रो ऽष्टाक्षरो मुने /
को वा द्वादशवर्णश्च मुने तत्त्वार्थकोविद //
text_mt: And what is peace declared to be? What is the eight-syllable mantra, O sage? / Or what is the twelve-syllabled one, O sage skilled in the true meaning of reality?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mayi parāṃ sarvaṃ vyākhyātamarhasi /
bhṛguruvāca
sādhu sādhumahāprājña tava buddhiranuttamā //
meaning:
कृपां कृत्वा मयि परां सर्वं व्याख्यातमर्हसि /
भृगुरुवाच
साधु साधुमहाप्राज्ञ तव बुद्धिरनुत्तमा //
text_mt: Extending supreme compassion to me, you ought to explain everything.” / Bhṛgu said: / “Well said, well said, O very wise one! Your intellect is unsurpassed!

sanskrit_iast:
yatpṛṣṭo 'haṃ tvayā bhūpa tatsarvaṃ pravadāmi te /
yathārthakathanaṃ yattatsatyamāhurvipaścitaḥ //
meaning:
यत्पृष्टो ऽहं त्वया भूप तत्सर्वं प्रवदामि ते /
यथार्थकथनं यत्तत्सत्यमाहुर्विपश्चितः //
text_mt: What has been asked of me by you, O king, all that I shall tell you. / That which is speaking things as they are, the wise call truth.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāvirodhato vācyaṃ taddhi dharmaparāyaṇaiḥ /
deśakālādi vijñāya svayamasyāvirodhataḥ //
meaning:
धर्माविरोधतो वाच्यं तद्धि धर्मपरायणैः /
देशकालादि विज्ञाय स्वयमस्याविरोधतः //
text_mt: It should be spoken without conflict with dharma by those devoted to dharma, / having understood place, time, and circumstances, without contradicting it oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvacaḥ procyate sadbhistastatyamabhidhīyate /
sarveṣāmeva jantūnāmakleṣajananaṃ hi tat //
meaning:
यद्वचः प्रोच्यते सद्भिस्तस्तत्यमभिधीयते /
सर्वेषामेव जन्तूनामक्लेषजननं हि तत् //
text_mt: Whatever word is spoken by the virtuous, that is declared to be truth; / it indeed causes no distress to any living beings at all.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā sā nṛpa proktā sarvakāmapradāyinī /
karmakāryasahāyatvamakāryaparipanthitā //
meaning:
अहिंसा सा नृप प्रोक्ता सर्वकामप्रदायिनी /
कर्मकार्यसहायत्वमकार्यपरिपन्थिता //
text_mt: That is declared to be non-violence, O king, which bestows all desires: / assisting in right action, opposing wrong action,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokahitatvaṃ vai procyate dharmakovidaiḥ /
icchānuvṛttakathanaṃ dharmādharmavivekinaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वलोकहितत्वं वै प्रोच्यते धर्मकोविदैः /
इच्छानुवृत्तकथनं धर्माधर्मविवेकिनः //
text_mt: and indeed promoting the welfare of all the world, as stated by those skilled in dharma. / For one who discerns between dharma and non-dharma, speaking merely to follow someone's desires

sanskrit_iast:
anṛtaṃ taddhi vijñeya sarvaśreyovirodhi tat /
ye loke dveṣiṇo mūrkhāḥ kumārgaratabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
अनृतं तद्धि विज्ञेय सर्वश्रेयोविरोधि तत् /
ये लोके द्वेषिणो मूर्खाः कुमार्गरतबुद्धयः //
text_mt: must be known as falsehood; it opposes all that is good. / Those who are spiteful fools in the world, whose minds delight in evil ways—
