sanskrit_iast:
te rājandurjjanā jñeyāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ /
dharmādharmavivekena vedamārgānusāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
ते राजन्दुर्ज्जना ज्ञेयाः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृताः /
धर्माधर्मविवेकेन वेदमार्गानुसारिणः //
text_mt: they, O king, are to be known as wicked men, excluded from all dharma. / Those who, through discrimination between dharma and non-dharma, follow the path of the Vedas

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokahitāsaktāḥ sādhavaḥ parikīrttitāḥ /
hari bhaktikaraṃ yattatsadbhiśca parirañcitam //
meaning:
सर्वलोकहितासक्ताः साधवः परिकीर्त्तिताः /
हरि भक्तिकरं यत्तत्सद्भिश्च परिरञ्चितम् //
text_mt: and are devoted to the welfare of all the world, are celebrated as virtuous. / That which brings about devotion to Hari, which is cherished by the virtuous,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaḥ prītijanakaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ parikīrttitam /
sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ viṣṇurvaṣṇuḥ sarvasya kāraṇam //
meaning:
आत्मनः प्रीतिजनकं तत्पुण्यं परिकीर्त्तितम् /
सर्वं जगदिदं विष्णुर्वष्णुः सर्वस्य कारणम् //
text_mt: and which generates delight for the self, is celebrated as merit. / 'This entire universe is Viṣṇu; Viṣṇu is the cause of all;

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca viṣṇuryajjñānaṃ tadviṣṇusma raṇaṃ viduḥ /
sarvadevamayo viṣṇurvidhinā pūjayāmi tam //
meaning:
अहं च विष्णुर्यज्ज्ञानं तद्विष्णुस्म रणं विदुः /
सर्वदेवमयो विष्णुर्विधिना पूजयामि तम् //
text_mt: and I am Viṣṇu'—this knowledge is known as remembrance of Viṣṇu. / 'Viṣṇu consists of all gods; I worship him according to rule'—

sanskrit_iast:
iti yā bhavati śraddhā sā tadbhaktiḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
sarvabhūtamayo viṣṇuḥ paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
इति या भवति श्रद्धा सा तद्भक्तिः प्रकीर्तिताः /
सर्वभूतमयो विष्णुः परिपूर्णः सनातनः //
text_mt: the faith that arises in this way is proclaimed as devotion to him. / 'Viṣṇu consists of all beings, all-pervading and eternal'—

sanskrit_iast:
ityabhedena yā buddhiḥ samatā sā prakīrttitā /
samatā śatrumitreṣu vaśitvaṃ ca tathā nṛpa //
meaning:
इत्यभेदेन या बुद्धिः समता सा प्रकीर्त्तिता /
समता शत्रुमित्रेषु वशित्वं च तथा नृप //
text_mt: the intellect that views [all] without distinction in this way is proclaimed as equanimity. / Equanimity towards enemies and friends, and likewise self-control, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭiḥ sā śāntiḥ parikīrtitā /
ete sarve samākhyātāstapaḥ siddhipradā nṛṇām //
meaning:
यदृच्छालाभसंतुष्टिः सा शान्तिः परिकीर्तिता /
एते सर्वे समाख्यातास्तपः सिद्धिप्रदा नृणाम् //
text_mt: and contentment with whatever is obtained by chance—that is celebrated as tranquility. / All these that have been explained bestow the success of austerities upon men;

sanskrit_iast:
samastapāparāśīnāṃ tarasā nāśahetavaḥ /
aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
समस्तपापराशीनां तरसा नाशहेतवः /
अष्टाक्षरं महामन्त्रं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: they are the cause of the swift destruction of all heaps of sin. / The great eight-syllable mantra destroys all sins;

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmi tava rājendra puruṣārthaikasādhanam /
viṣṇoḥ priyakaraṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradāyakam //
meaning:
वक्ष्यामि तव राजेन्द्र पुरुषार्थैकसाधनम् /
विष्णोः प्रियकरं चैव सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: I shall declare [it] to you, O best of kings, as the sole means to the goals of life, / pleasing to Viṣṇu and granting all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japetpraṇakpūrvakam /
namo bhagavate procya vāsudevāya tatparam //
meaning:
नमो नारायणायेति जपेत्प्रणक्पूर्वकम् /
नमो भगवते प्रोच्य वासुदेवाय तत्परम् //
text_mt: One should recite 'namo nārāyaṇāya' preceded by the praṇava [oṃ]. / Then, having spoken 'namo bhagavate' followed by 'vāsudevāya',

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādyaṃ mahārāja dvādaśārṇamudāhṛtam /
dvayoḥ samaṃ phalaṃ rājannaṣṭadvādaśavarṇayoḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवाद्यं महाराज द्वादशार्णमुदाहृतम् /
द्वयोः समं फलं राजन्नष्टद्वादशवर्णयोः //
text_mt: preceded by the praṇava, O great king, is declared to be the twelve-syllable [mantra]. / The fruit of both the eight- and twelve-syllable [mantras] is equal, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca sāmyamuddiṣṭametayoḥ /
śaṅkhacacakradharaṃ śāntaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तौ च निवृत्तौ च साम्यमुद्दिष्टमेतयोः /
शङ्खचचक्रधरं शान्तं नारायणमनामयम् //
text_mt: their equality is taught both in active engagement and in renunciation. / Bearing the conch and discus, tranquil, healthy Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīsaṃśritavāmāṅkaṃ tathābhayakaraṃ prabhum /
kirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ nānāmaṇḍanaśobhitam //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीसंश्रितवामाङ्कं तथाभयकरं प्रभुम् /
किरीटकुण्डलधरं नानामण्डनशोभितम् //
text_mt: the Lord whose left lap is occupied by Lakṣmī, granting fearlessness, / wearing a diadem and ear-ornaments, adorned with diverse ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrājatkaustubhamālāḍhyaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam /
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam //
meaning:
भ्राजत्कौस्तुभमालाढ्यं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् /
पीताम्बरधरं देवं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: rich with the shining Kaustubha garland, his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa, / wearing yellow garments, the god bowed to by gods and asuras—

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedanādinidhanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam /
antaryāmī jñānarupī paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायेदनादिनिधनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् /
अन्तर्यामी ज्ञानरुपी परिपूर्णः सनातनः //
text_mt: one should meditate upon him, without beginning or end, granting the fruit of all desires, / the inner controller, whose form is knowledge, complete, eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yattu puṣṭaṃ tvayā nṛpa /
svasti te 'stu tapaḥ siddhiṃ gaccha labdhuṃ yathāsukham //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्तु पुष्टं त्वया नृप /
स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु तपः सिद्धिं गच्छ लब्धुं यथासुखम् //
text_mt: All this has been explained, which was asked by you, O king. / May welfare be yours; go to attain the success of your austerities at your pleasure."

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahīpālo bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā /
paramāṃ prītimāpannaḥ prapedetapase vanam //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महीपालो भृगुणा परमर्षिणा /
परमां प्रीतिमापन्नः प्रपेदेतपसे वनम् //
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus by Bhṛgu, the supreme sage, / the ruler of the earth, experiencing supreme joy, departed to the forest for austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
himavadgirimāsādya puṇyadeśe manohare /
nādeśvare mahākṣetre tapastepe 'tiduścaram //
meaning:
हिमवद्गिरिमासाद्य पुण्यदेशे मनोहरे /
नादेश्वरे महाक्षेत्रे तपस्तेपे ऽतिदुश्चरम् //
text_mt: Having reached the Himavat mountain in a holy and charming region, / in the great sacred field of Nādeśvara, he performed austerities most difficult to endure.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā triṣavaṇasnāyī kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
kṛtātithyarhaṇaścāpi nityaṃ homaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
राजा त्रिषवणस्नायी कन्दमूलफलाशनः /
कृतातिथ्यर्हणश्चापि नित्यं होमपरायणः //
text_mt: The king bathed at the three junctures of the day, fed on roots and fruits, / performed hospitality to guests, and was constantly devoted to fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtahitaḥ śānto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ /
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistoyaistrikālaṃ haripūjakaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभूतहितः शान्तो नारायणपरायणः /
पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैस्तोयैस्त्रिकालं हरिपूजकः //
text_mt: Devoted to the welfare of all beings, tranquil, wholly devoted to Nārāyaṇa, / he worshipped Hari at the three times [of day] with leaves, flowers, fruits, and water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahutithaṃ kālaṃ nītvā cātyantadhairyavān /
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śīrṇaparṇāśano 'bhavat //
meaning:
एवं बहुतिथं कालं नीत्वा चात्यन्तधैर्यवान् /
ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं शीर्णपर्णाशनो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Having thus spent a long time, having extreme steadfastness, / meditating on the divine Nārāyaṇa, he came to feed on fallen leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaparo bhūtvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ /
nirucchvāsa stapastaptuṃ tataḥ samupacakrame //
meaning:
प्राणायामपरो भूत्वा राजा परमधार्मिकः /
निरुच्छ्वास स्तपस्तप्तुं ततः समुपचक्रमे //
text_mt: Devoted to breath-control, the supremely righteous king / then undertook to perform austerities without exhaling.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devamanaṃ tamaparājitam /
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahastāṇi nirucchvāsaparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
ध्यायन्नारायणं देवमनं तमपराजितम् /
षष्टिवर्षसहस्ताणि निरुच्छ्वासपरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Meditating on the divine Nārāyaṇa, infinite and unconquered, / he remained devoted to holding his breath for sixty thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya nānmāpuṭādrājño vahnirjajñaṃ bhayaṅkaraḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarve vitrastā vahnitā pitāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य नान्मापुटाद्राज्ञो वह्निर्जज्ञं भयङ्करः /
तं दृष्ट्वा देवताः सर्वे वित्रस्ता वह्निता पिताः //
text_mt: From the king's nostrils a terrifying fire arose; / seeing it, all the gods were terrified, tormented by the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
abhijagmurmahāviṣṇuṃ yatrāste jagatāṃ patiḥ /
kṣīrodasyottaraṃ tīra saṃprāpya tridaśeśvarāḥ /
astuvandevadeveśaṃ śaraṇāgatapālakam //
meaning:
अभिजग्मुर्महाविष्णुं यत्रास्ते जगतां पतिः /
क्षीरोदस्योत्तरं तीर संप्राप्य त्रिदशेश्वराः /
अस्तुवन्देवदेवेशं शरणागतपालकम् //
text_mt: They went to Mahāviṣṇu, where the Lord of the worlds resides. / Having reached the northern shore of the milk ocean, the lords of the thirty gods / praised the Lord of the gods of gods, who protects those who take refuge in him.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
natāḥ sma viṣṇuṃ jagadekanāthaṃ smaratsamastārtiharaṃ pareśam /
svabhāvaśuddhaṃ paripūrṇabhāvaṃ vadanti yajjñānatanuṃ ca tajjñāḥ //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नताः स्म विष्णुं जगदेकनाथं स्मरत्समस्तार्तिहरं परेशम् /
स्वभावशुद्धं परिपूर्णभावं वदन्ति यज्ज्ञानतनुं च तज्ज्ञाः //
text_mt: The gods said: / "We bow to Viṣṇu, the sole Lord of the universe, who removes the distress of all who remember him, the supreme Lord, / pure by nature, complete in being, whom knowers of reality declare to have knowledge as his body.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyeyaḥ sadā yogivarairmahātmā svecchāśarīraiḥ kutadevakāryaḥ /
jagatsvarupo jagadādināthastasmai natāḥ smaḥ puruṣottamāya //
meaning:
ध्येयः सदा योगिवरैर्महात्मा स्वेच्छाशरीरैः कुतदेवकार्यः /
जगत्स्वरुपो जगदादिनाथस्तस्मै नताः स्मः पुरुषोत्तमाय //
text_mt: He is ever to be meditated upon by the best of yogins, the great self who accomplishes the work of the gods through bodies chosen at will; / his form is the universe, the primal Lord of the world: to that Puruṣottama we bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yanannāmasaṃkīrttanato khalānāṃ samasta pāpāni layaṃ prayānti /
tamīśamīḍyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ natāḥ sma viṣṇuṃ puruṣāthasiddhyai //
meaning:
यनन्नामसंकीर्त्तनतो खलानां समस्त पापानि लयं प्रयान्ति /
तमीशमीड्यं पुरुषं पुराणं नताः स्म विष्णुं पुरुषाथसिद्ध्यै //
text_mt: By chanting whose name all the sins even of the wicked dissolve away, / to that Lord, the ancient person worthy of praise, to Viṣṇu we bow for the attainment of the goals of life.

sanskrit_iast:
yattejasā bhānti divākarādyā nātikramaṃ tyasya kadāpi śikṣāḥ /
kālātmakaṃ taṃ tridaśādhināthaṃ namāmahe vai puruṣārtharupam //
meaning:
यत्तेजसा भान्ति दिवाकराद्या नातिक्रमं त्यस्य कदापि शिक्षाः /
कालात्मकं तं त्रिदशाधिनाथं नमामहे वै पुरुषार्थरुपम् //
text_mt: By whose splendor the sun and other [luminaries] shine, whose commands they never transgress, / to that Lord of the thirty gods, the embodiment of time, whose form is the goals of life, we bow.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatkaro 'tyabjabhavo 'tti rudraḥ punāti lokāñśrutibhiśca viprāḥ /
tamādidevaṃ guṇasannidhānaṃ sarvopadeṣṭāramitāḥ śaraṇyam //
meaning:
जगत्करो ऽत्यब्जभवो ऽत्ति रुद्रः पुनाति लोकाञ्श्रुतिभिश्च विप्राः /
तमादिदेवं गुणसन्निधानं सर्वोपदेष्टारमिताः शरण्यम् //
text_mt: The lotus-born [Brahmā] creates the universe, Rudra consumes it, and the twice-born purify the worlds through the Vedas [by his command]; / we have approached for refuge that primal deity, the repository of qualities, the instructor of all.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ madhukaiṭabhāriṃ surāsurābhyarcitapādapīṭham /
// sadbhaktisaṃkalpitāsiddhihetuṃ jñānaikavedyaṃ praṇatāḥ sma devam //
meaning:
वरं वरेण्यं मधुकैटभारिं सुरासुराभ्यर्चितपादपीठम् /
// सद्भक्तिसंकल्पितासिद्धिहेतुं ज्ञानैकवेद्यं प्रणताः स्म देवम् //
text_mt: The boon, the most choice, enemy of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, whose footstool is worshipped by gods and asuras, / the cause of fulfilling what is intended through true devotion, knowable solely by knowledge: we bow to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
anādimadhyāntamajaṃ pareśamanādyavidyākhyatamovināśam /
saccitparānandaghanasvarupaṃ rupādihīnaṃ praṇatāḥ sma devam //
meaning:
अनादिमध्यान्तमजं परेशमनाद्यविद्याख्यतमोविनाशम् /
सच्चित्परानन्दघनस्वरुपं रुपादिहीनं प्रणताः स्म देवम् //
text_mt: Without beginning, middle, or end, unborn, the supreme Lord, the destroyer of the darkness called beginningless ignorance, / whose nature is a mass of being, consciousness, and supreme bliss, devoid of form and the like: we bow to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇumanantamīśaṃ pītāmbaraṃ padmabhavādisevyam /
yajñāpriyaṃ yajñakaraṃ viśuddhaṃ natāḥ sma sarvottamamavyayaṃ tam //
meaning:
नारायणं विष्णुमनन्तमीशं पीताम्बरं पद्मभवादिसेव्यम् /
यज्ञाप्रियं यज्ञकरं विशुद्धं नताः स्म सर्वोत्तममव्ययं तम् //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, Viṣṇu, the infinite Lord, wearing yellow garments, attended by the lotus-born [Brahmā] and others, / lover of sacrifice, maker of sacrifice, the completely pure: we bow to that immutable one, highest of all."

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuto mahāviṣṇurdevairindrādibhistadā /
caritaṃ tasya rājarṣerdevānāṃ saṃnyavedayat //
meaning:
इति स्तुतो महाविष्णुर्देवैरिन्द्रादिभिस्तदा /
चरितं तस्य राजर्षेर्देवानां संन्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: Having been praised thus by the gods headed by Indra at that time, / Mahāviṣṇu related the conduct of that royal sage to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devānsamāśvāsya dattvābhayamanañjanaḥ /
jagāma yatra rājarṣistapastapati nārada //
meaning:
ततो देवान्समाश्वास्य दत्त्वाभयमनञ्जनः /
जगाम यत्र राजर्षिस्तपस्तपति नारद //
text_mt: Then, having reassured the gods and given them fearlessness, the stainless one / went, O Nārada, to where the royal sage was performing austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakradharo devaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ /
pratyakṣatāmagāttasya rājñaḥ sarvajagadguruḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रधरो देवः सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः /
प्रत्यक्षतामगात्तस्य राज्ञः सर्वजगद्गुरुः //
text_mt: Bearing conch and discus, his body being-consciousness-bliss, / the god, teacher of the entire universe, appeared visibly to that king.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ duṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ bhābhāsitadigantaram /
atisīpuṣpaṃsaṃkāśaṃ sphuratkuṇḍalamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
तं दुष्ट्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षं भाभासितदिगन्तरम् /
अतिसीपुष्पंसंकाशं स्फुरत्कुण्डलमण्डितम् //
text_mt: Beholding the lotus-eyed one who illumined the quarters with his radiance, / resembling an atasī flower, adorned with glistening ear-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
snigdha kuntalavakrābjaṃ vibhrājanmukuṭojjvalam /
śrīvatsakaustumadharaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam //
meaning:
स्निग्ध कुन्तलवक्राब्जं विभ्राजन्मुकुटोज्ज्वलम् /
श्रीवत्सकौस्तुमधरं वनमालाविभूषितम् //
text_mt: with glossy hair and a lotus-like face, radiant and splendid with a diadem, / bearing the Śrīvatsa and the Kaustubha, adorned with a forest garland,

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghabāhumudārāṅgaṃ lokeśārcitapantkajam /
nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau bhūpatirnamrakandharaḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घबाहुमुदाराङ्गं लोकेशार्चितपन्त्कजम् /
ननाम दण्डवद्भूमौ भूपतिर्नम्रकन्धरः //
text_mt: with long arms and noble limbs, his lotus [feet] worshipped by the lords of the world, / the ruler of the earth prostrated like a stick upon the ground, bowing his neck.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantaharṣasaṃpūrṇaḥ saromāñcaḥ sagadgadaḥ /
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti śrīkṛṣṇeti samuccaran //
meaning:
अत्यन्तहर्षसंपूर्णः सरोमाञ्चः सगद्गदः /
कृष्ण कृष्णेति श्रीकृष्णेति समुच्चरन् //
text_mt: Filled with extreme joy, with hair standing on end, his voice choked with emotion, / repeating, 'Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Kṛṣṇa!',

sanskrit_iast:
tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā hyantaryāmī jagadguruḥ /
uvāca kṛpayāviṣṭo bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा ह्यन्तर्यामी जगद्गुरुः /
उवाच कृपयाविष्टो भगवान्भूतभावनः //
text_mt: to him Viṣṇu, pleased in heart, the inner controller, teacher of the universe, / the Blessed Lord, creator of beings, spoke filled with compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhagīratha mahābhāga tavābhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati /
āgamiṣyanti mallokaṃ tava pūrvapitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भगीरथ महाभाग तवाभीष्टं भविष्यति /
आगमिष्यन्ति मल्लोकं तव पूर्वपितामहाः //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'O fortunate Bhagīratha, your desire shall be fulfilled; / your forebears shall come to my world.'

sanskrit_iast:
mama mūrtyantaraṃ śambhuṃ rājanstotraiḥ svaśaktivaḥ /
stuhi te sakalaṃ kāmaṃ savai sadyaḥ kariṣyanti //
meaning:
मम मूर्त्यन्तरं शम्भुं राजन्स्तोत्रैः स्वशक्तिवः /
स्तुहि ते सकलं कामं सवै सद्यः करिष्यन्ति //
text_mt: Praise Śambhu, who is another form of mine, O king, with hymns according to your capacity; / he indeed will instantly fulfill your whole desire.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu jagrāha śaśinaṃ śūraṇaṃ samupāgatam /
tasmādārādhayeśānaṃ stotraiḥ stutyaṃ sukhapradam //
meaning:
यस्तु जग्राह शशिनं शूरणं समुपागतम् /
तस्मादाराधयेशानं स्तोत्रैः स्तुत्यं सुखप्रदम् //
text_mt: He who received the moon who came to him for refuge, / therefore worship Īśāna, who is praiseworthy through hymns and gives happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhano devaḥ sarvakāma phalapradaḥ /
tvayā saṃpujito rājansadyaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati //
meaning:
अनादिनिधनो देवः सर्वकाम फलप्रदः /
त्वया संपुजितो राजन्सद्यः श्रेयो विधास्यति //
text_mt: The god who has no beginning or end, who grants the fruit of all desires, / when worshipped by you, O king, will immediately bring about your welfare."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā devadeveśo jagatāṃ patiracyutaḥ /
antardadhe muniśreṣṭha uttasthauso 'pi bhūpatiḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा देवदेवेशो जगतां पतिरच्युतः /
अन्तर्दधे मुनिश्रेष्ठ उत्तस्थौसो ऽपि भूपतिः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Acyuta, the lord of the gods and master of the worlds, / vanished, O best of sages, and the king also stood up.

sanskrit_iast:
kimidaṃ smama āhosvitsatyaṃ sākṣādvijottam /
bhūpatirvismayaṃ prātpaḥ kiṃ karomīti vismitaḥ //
meaning:
किमिदं स्मम आहोस्वित्सत्यं साक्षाद्विजोत्तम् /
भूपतिर्विस्मयं प्रात्पः किं करोमीति विस्मितः //
text_mt: "Was this a dream, or was it directly real, O best of the twice-born?" / Filled with astonishment, the king wondered, "What should I do?"

sanskrit_iast:
athāntarikṣe vāgujcaiḥ prāha taṃ bhrāntacetasam /
satyametaditi vyaktaṃ na cintāṃ kartumarhasi //
meaning:
अथान्तरिक्षे वागुज्चैः प्राह तं भ्रान्तचेतसम् /
सत्यमेतदिति व्यक्तं न चिन्तां कर्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Then a voice loudly addressed him in the sky, as his mind was bewildered: / "This is clearly true; you should not worry."

sanskrit_iast:
tanniśamyāvanīpāla īśānaṃ sarvakāraṇam /
samastadevatārājamastauṣīdbhaktitatparaḥ //
meaning:
तन्निशम्यावनीपाल ईशानं सर्वकारणम् /
समस्तदेवताराजमस्तौषीद्भक्तितत्परः //
text_mt: Hearing that, the king, intent on devotion, / praised Īśāna, the cause of everything, the sovereign of all the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīratha uvāca
praṇamāmi jagannāthaṃ praṇatārtipraṇāśanam /
pramāṇāgocaraṃ devamīśānaṃ praṇavātmakam //
meaning:
भगीरथ उवाच
प्रणमामि जगन्नाथं प्रणतार्तिप्रणाशनम् /
प्रमाणागोचरं देवमीशानं प्रणवात्मकम् //
text_mt: Bhagīratha said: / "I bow to the Lord of the Universe, the destroyer of the distress of those who surrender, / the god beyond the scope of proof, Īśāna, whose self is the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
jagadrūpamajaṃ nityaṃ sargasthityantakāraṇam /
viśvarupaṃ virupākṣa praṇato 'smyugraretasam //
meaning:
जगद्रूपमजं नित्यं सर्गस्थित्यन्तकारणम् /
विश्वरुपं विरुपाक्ष प्रणतो ऽस्म्युग्ररेतसम् //
text_mt: Whose form is the world, unborn, eternal, the cause of creation, maintenance, and dissolution, / whose form is the universe, the odd-eyed one, the one of potent seed, I bow to him.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimadhyāntarahitamanantamajamavyayam /
samāmananti yogīndrā staṃ vande puṣṭivardhanam //
meaning:
आदिमध्यान्तरहितमनन्तमजमव्ययम् /
समामनन्ति योगीन्द्रा स्तं वन्दे पुष्टिवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Devoid of beginning, middle, and end, infinite, unborn, imperishable, / whom the lords of yogins contemplate; I praise him, the increaser of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
namo lokādhināthāpa vañcate parivañcate /
namo 'stu nīlagrīvāya pasūnāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो लोकाधिनाथाप वञ्चते परिवञ्चते /
नमो ऽस्तु नीलग्रीवाय पसूनां पतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the master of the world, to the deceiver, to the great deceiver; / homage be to the blue-necked one; homage to the lord of beasts.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kapālahastāya pāśapataye namaḥ /
namo 'kalpaprakalpāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः कपालहस्ताय पाशपतये नमः /
नमो ऽकल्पप्रकल्पाय भूतानां पतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the skull-handed one; homage to the lord of the snare; / homage to the one who produces the eons; homage to the lord of spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ pinākahastāya śūlahastāya te namaḥ /
namaḥ kapālahastāya pāśamudgaradhāriṇe //
meaning:
नमः पिनाकहस्ताय शूलहस्ताय ते नमः /
नमः कपालहस्ताय पाशमुद्गरधारिणे //
text_mt: Homage to the one whose hand holds the Pināka; homage to you whose hand holds the trident; / homage to the skull-handed one, the bearer of the noose and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sarvabhūtāya ghaṇṭāhastāya te namaḥ /
namaḥ pañcāsyadevāya kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते सर्वभूताय घण्टाहस्ताय ते नमः /
नमः पञ्चास्यदेवाय क्षेत्राणां पतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to you who are all beings; homage to you whose hand holds a bell; / homage to the five-faced god; homage to the lord of sacred fields.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ samastabhūtānāmādibhṛtāya bhūbhṛte /
anekaruparupāya nirguṇāya parātmane //
meaning:
नमः समस्तभूतानामादिभृताय भूभृते /
अनेकरुपरुपाय निर्गुणाय परात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to the upholder of the earth, the first sustainer of all beings; / whose forms are manifold, devoid of qualities, the supreme self.

sanskrit_iast:
namo daṇādhidevāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ /
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो दणाधिदेवाय गणानां पतये नमः /
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय हिरण्यपतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the supreme god of the gaṇas; homage to the lord of the gaṇas; / homage to the golden-wombed one; homage to the lord of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyaretase tubhyaṃnamo hiraṇyabāhave /
namo dhyānasvarupāya namaste dhyānasākṣiṇe //
meaning:
हिरण्यरेतसे तुभ्यंनमो हिरण्यबाहवे /
नमो ध्यानस्वरुपाय नमस्ते ध्यानसाक्षिणे //
text_mt: Homage to you of golden seed; homage to the golden-armed one; / homage to the one whose nature is meditation; homage to you, the witness of meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste dhyānasaṃsthāya dhyānagamyāya te namaḥ /
yenedaṃ viśvamakhilaṃ carācaravirājitam //
meaning:
नमस्ते ध्यानसंस्थाय ध्यानगम्याय ते नमः /
येनेदं विश्वमखिलं चराचरविराजितम् //
text_mt: Homage to you seated in meditation; homage to you who are reachable through meditation; / by whom this entire universe, adorned with the moving and unmoving,

sanskrit_iast: varṣevābhreṇa janitaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmanā //
meaning: वर्षेवाभ्रेण जनितं प्रधानपुरुषात्मना //
text_mt: was brought forth as rain by a cloud, through his nature as Pradhāna and Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
svaprakāśaṃ mahātmānaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam /
yamāmananti tattvajñāḥ savitāraṃ nṛcakṣuṣām //
meaning:
स्वप्रकाशं महात्मानं परं ज्योतिः सनातनम् /
यमामनन्ति तत्त्वज्ञाः सवितारं नृचक्षुषाम् //
text_mt: The self-luminous, great-souled, eternal supreme light, / whom knowers of reality call the sun of human eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
umākāntanandikeśantaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadāśivam /
mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahādevaṃ parātparataraṃ vibhum //
meaning:
उमाकान्तनन्दिकेशन्तं नीलकण्ठं सदाशिवम् /
मृत्युञ्जयं महादेवं परात्परतरं विभुम् //
text_mt: The beloved of Umā, the lord of Nandikeśa, the blue-throated, Sadāśiva, / the conqueror of death, the great god, the all-pervading one higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ śabdabrahmarupaṃ taṃ vande 'khilakāraṇam /
kaparddine namastubhyaṃ sadyo jātāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
परं शब्दब्रह्मरुपं तं वन्दे ऽखिलकारणम् /
कपर्द्दिने नमस्तुभ्यं सद्यो जाताय वै नमः //
text_mt: I praise him whose form is the supreme Śabda-Brahman, the cause of all; / homage to you with matted hair; homage indeed to Sadyojāta.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavodbhavāya śuddhāya jyeṣṭhāya ca kanīyase /
manyave ta iṣe traghayyāḥ pataye yajñatantave //
meaning:
भवोद्भवाय शुद्धाय ज्येष्ठाय च कनीयसे /
मन्यवे त इषे त्रघय्याः पतये यज्ञतन्तवे //
text_mt: To the origin of existence, the pure one, the eldest and the youngest, / to your wrath, to the arrow, to the lord of the sacred cow, to the thread of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrje diśāṃ ca pataye kālāyāghorarupiṇe /
kṛśānuretase tubhyaṃ namo 'stu sumāhātmane //
meaning:
ऊर्जे दिशां च पतये कालायाघोररुपिणे /
कृशानुरेतसे तुभ्यं नमो ऽस्तु सुमाहात्मने //
text_mt: To strength and the lord of the directions, to Time, whose form is non-terrific; / homage be to you of fire-seed, to the supreme great soul.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ samudrāḥ sarito 'drayaśca gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṅghāḥ /
sthāṇu ścariṣṇurmahadalpakaṃ ca asañca sajjīvamajīmāsa //
meaning:
यतः समुद्राः सरितो ऽद्रयश्च गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घाः /
स्थाणु श्चरिष्णुर्महदल्पकं च असञ्च सज्जीवमजीमास //
text_mt: From whom are the oceans, rivers, and mountains, the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Asuras, and Siddhas, / the stationary and moving, the great and small, the non-existent and the existent, the living and the non-living.

sanskrit_iast:
nato 'smi taṃ yoginatāṅghripadmaṃ sarvāntarātmānamarupamīśam /
svatantramekaṃ guṇunāṃ guṇaṃ ca namāmi bhūyaḥ praṇamāmi bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
नतो ऽस्मि तं योगिनताङ्घ्रिपद्मं सर्वान्तरात्मानमरुपमीशम् /
स्वतन्त्रमेकं गुणुनां गुणं च नमामि भूयः प्रणमामि भूयः //
text_mt: I bow to him whose lotus feet are revered by yogins, the inner self of all, the formless lord, / independent, the one, and the quality of qualities; I bow again and again, I prostrate again and again."

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ /
āvirbabhūva bhṛpasya saṃtatpatapasogrataḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं स्तुतो महादेवः शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः /
आविर्बभूव भृपस्य संतत्पतपसोग्रतः //
text_mt: Thus praised, the great god Śaṅkara, the cause of welfare for the world, / appeared before the king who was burned by his severe austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavakraṃ daśabhujaṃ candrārdhdakṛtaśaekharam /
trilocanamudārāṅgaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam //
meaning:
पञ्चवक्रं दशभुजं चन्द्रार्ध्दकृतशएखरम् /
त्रिलोचनमुदाराङ्गं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् //
text_mt: having five faces, ten arms, crested with the crescent moon, / three-eyed, of noble limbs, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
viśālavakṣasaṃ devaṃ tuhinādrisamaprabham /
gajacarmāmbaradharaṃ surārcitapadāmbujam //
meaning:
विशालवक्षसं देवं तुहिनाद्रिसमप्रभम् /
गजचर्माम्बरधरं सुरार्चितपदाम्बुजम् //
text_mt: the god of broad chest, with splendor equal to the snow-mountain, / wearing an elephant-hide garment, whose lotus feet are worshipped by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā papāta pādāgre daṇḍavadbhuvi nārada /
tata utthāya sahasā śivāgre vihitāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा पपात पादाग्रे दण्डवद्भुवि नारद /
तत उत्थाय सहसा शिवाग्रे विहिताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Seeing him, he fell like a staff on the ground at his feet, O Nārada; / then, rising quickly, with folded hands before Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇanāma mahādevaṃ kīrtayañśaṅkarāhvayam /
vijñāya bhaktiṃ bhūpasya śaṅkaraḥ śaśiśekharaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणनाम महादेवं कीर्तयञ्शङ्कराह्वयम् /
विज्ञाय भक्तिं भूपस्य शङ्करः शशिशेखरः //
text_mt: he bowed to the great god, chanting the name Śaṅkara. / Recognizing the king's devotion, Śaṅkara, whose crest is the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca rājñe tuṣṭo 'smi varaṃ varaya vāñchitam /
toṣito 'smi tvayā samyak stotreṇa tapasā tathā //
meaning:
उवाच राज्ञे तुष्टो ऽस्मि वरं वरय वाञ्छितम् /
तोषितो ऽस्मि त्वया सम्यक् स्तोत्रेण तपसा तथा //
text_mt: spoke to the king: "I am pleased; choose a desired boon. / I am completely satisfied by you through your hymn and also through your austerity."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa devena rājā saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ /
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā jagatāmīśvareśvareśvaram //
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स देवेन राजा संतुष्टमानसः /
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा जगतामीश्वरेश्वरेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the god, the king, his mind delighted, / said with joined palms to the supreme Lord of lords of the worlds:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīratha uvāca
anugrāhyo 'smi yadi te varadānānmaheśvara /
tadā gaṅgāṃ prayacchāsmatpitṝṇāṃ muktihetave //
meaning:
भगीरथ उवाच
अनुग्राह्यो ऽस्मि यदि ते वरदानान्महेश्वर /
तदा गङ्गां प्रयच्छास्मत्पितॄणां मुक्तिहेतवे //
text_mt: Bhagīratha said: / "If I am to be favored by you with the grant of a boon, O Maheśvara, / then grant the Gaṅgā for the sake of the liberation of our ancestors."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśiva uvāca
dattā gaṅgā mayā tubhyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ te gatiḥ parā /
tubhyaṃ mokṣaṃ paraśceti tamuktvāntardadhe śivaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीशिव उवाच
दत्ता गङ्गा मया तुभ्यं पितॄणां ते गतिः परा /
तुभ्यं मोक्षं परश्चेति तमुक्त्वान्तर्दधे शिवः //
text_mt: Śrī Śiva said: / "The Gaṅgā is granted to you by me; your ancestors will attain the supreme state, / and you shall have supreme liberation." Having spoken to him, Śiva vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
parardino jaṭāstrastā gaṅgā lokaikapāvirnī /
pāvayantī jagatsarvamanvagacchadbhagīratham //
meaning:
परर्दिनो जटास्त्रस्ता गङ्गा लोकैकपाविर्नी /
पावयन्ती जगत्सर्वमन्वगच्छद्भगीरथम् //
text_mt: Flowing down from the matted hair of Kapardin, the Gaṅgā, the sole purifier of the world, / purifying the entire universe, followed Bhagīratha.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti sā devī nirmalā malahāriṇī /
bhāgīrathīti vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣvabhūnmune //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति सा देवी निर्मला मलहारिणी /
भागीरथीति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेष्वभून्मुने //
text_mt: From that time forward, that spotless goddess who removes impurities / became renowned in the three worlds as Bhāgīrathī, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sagarasyātmajāḥ pūrvaṃ yatra dagdhāḥ svapāpmanā /
taṃ deśaṃ plāvayāmāsa gaṅgā sarvasaridvarā //
meaning:
सगरस्यात्मजाः पूर्वं यत्र दग्धाः स्वपाप्मना /
तं देशं प्लावयामास गङ्गा सर्वसरिद्वरा //
text_mt: Where the sons of Sagara had formerly been burned by their own sin, / the Gaṅgā, the best of all rivers, inundated that place.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā saṃplāvitaṃ bhasma sāgarāṇāṃ tu gaṅgāyā /
tadaiva narake magnā uddhṛtāśca gatainasaḥ //
meaning:
यदा संप्लावितं भस्म सागराणां तु गङ्गाया /
तदैव नरके मग्ना उद्धृताश्च गतैनसः //
text_mt: When the ashes of the sons of Sagara were flooded by the Gaṅgā, / at that very moment, submerged in hell, they were lifted up, freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
purā saṃkruśyamānena ye yamenātipūḍitāḥ /
ta eva pūcitāstena gaṅgājalapariplutāḥ //
meaning:
पुरा संक्रुश्यमानेन ये यमेनातिपूडिताः /
त एव पूचितास्तेन गङ्गाजलपरिप्लुताः //
text_mt: Those who formerly, being shouted at, were tormented severely by Yama, / were now worshipped by him when bathed in the waters of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
gatapāpānya vijñāya yamaḥ sagarasaṃbhavān /
praṇamyābhyarcya vidhivatprāha tānprītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
गतपापान्य विज्ञाय यमः सगरसंभवान् /
प्रणम्याभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्प्राह तान्प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: Recognizing the descendants of Sagara as having their sins removed, / Yama, bowing down and worshipping them according to rule, spoke to them with a pleased mind:

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho rājasutā yūyaṃ narakād bhṛśadāruṇāt /
muktā vimānamāruhya gacchadhvaṃ viṣṇumandiram //
meaning:
भो भो राजसुता यूयं नरकाद् भृशदारुणात् /
मुक्ता विमानमारुह्य गच्छध्वं विष्णुमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: "O sons of the king, you are released from the terribly dreadful hell! / Mount a celestial chariot and go to the abode of Viṣṇu."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāste mahātmāno yamena gatakalmaṣāḥ /
divyadehadharā bhūtvā viṣṇulokaṃ prapedire //
meaning:
इत्युक्तास्ते महात्मानो यमेन गतकल्मषाः /
दिव्यदेहधरा भूत्वा विष्णुलोकं प्रपेदिरे //
text_mt: Thus addressed by Yama, those great-souled ones, freed from blemish, / assumed divine bodies and reached the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃprabhāvā sā gaṅgā viṣṇupādāgrasaṃbhavā /
sarvalokeṣu vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī //
meaning:
एवंप्रभावा सा गङ्गा विष्णुपादाग्रसंभवा /
सर्वलोकेषु विख्याता महापातकनाशिनी //
text_mt: Such is the power of the Gaṅgā, born from the tip of Viṣṇu's foot, / renowned in all the worlds, destroyer of great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam /
paṭhecca śṛṇuyādvāpi gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
य इदं पुण्यमाख्यानं महापातकनाशनम् /
पठेच्च शृणुयाद्वापि गङ्गास्नानफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Whoever reads or even hears this holy narrative which destroys great sins, / would obtain the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
yastve tatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ kathayedrvāhyaṇāgrataḥ /
sa yāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam //
iti śrūbṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgāmāhātmye bhagīrathagaṅgānayanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaṣo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यस्त्वे तत्पुण्यमाख्यानं कथयेद्र्वाह्यणाग्रतः /
स याति विष्णुभवनं पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् //
इति श्रूबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गामाहात्म्ये भगीरथगङ्गानयनं नाम षोडषो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He who narrates this sacred account before brāhmaṇas / goes to the abode of Viṣṇu, free from returning again.

Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'The Bringing Down of the Gaṅgā by Bhagīratha', in the eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā, in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
sādhu sūta mahābhāga tvayātikaruṇātmanā /
śrāvitaṃ sarvapāpanghaṃ gaṅgāmāhātmya muttamam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
साधु सूत महाभाग त्वयातिकरुणात्मना /
श्रावितं सर्वपापन्घं गङ्गामाहात्म्य मुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / "Well done, O Sūta of great fortune! By you, whose nature is exceedingly compassionate, / this excellent eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā, which destroys all sins, has been recited."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nārado devadarśanaḥ /
kiṃ papraccha punaḥ sūta sanakaṃ munisattamam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नारदो देवदर्शनः /
किं पप्रच्छ पुनः सूत सनकं मुनिसत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having heard the eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā, what did Nārada, who sees the gods, / ask again, O Sūta, to Sanaka, the best of sages?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve nāradena surarṣiṇā /
pṛṣṭaṃ punaryathā prāha pravakṣyāmi tathaiva tat //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे नारदेन सुरर्षिणा /
पृष्टं पुनर्यथा प्राह प्रवक्ष्यामि तथैव तत् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Listen, all you sages; just as it was asked again by Nārada, the divine sage, / and as he answered, so indeed I shall relate it.

sanskrit_iast:
nānākhyānetihāsāḍyaṃ gaṅgāmāhātmyamuttamam /
śrutvā brahmasuto bhūyaḥ pṛṣṭavānidamādarāt //
meaning:
नानाख्यानेतिहासाड्यं गङ्गामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् /
श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मसुतो भूयः पृष्टवानिदमादरात् //
text_mt: Having heard the supreme eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā, rich in various legends and histories, / the son of Brahmā questioned again with respect this:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
aho 'tidhanyaṃ sukṛtaikasāraṃ śrutaṃ mayā puṇyamasaṃvṛtārtham /
gāṅgeyamāhātmyamaghapraṇāśi tvatto mune kāruṇikādabhīṣṭam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अहो ऽतिधन्यं सुकृतैकसारं श्रुतं मया पुण्यमसंवृतार्थम् /
गाङ्गेयमाहात्म्यमघप्रणाशि त्वत्तो मुने कारुणिकादभीष्टम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Ah, most blessed, the sole essence of good deeds, holy, its meaning revealed, / destroying sin, and most desired is this eulogy of the greatness of the Gaṅgā heard from you, O compassionate sage!

sanskrit_iast:
ye sādhavaḥ sādhu bhajanti viṣṇuṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca yatanta eva /
nānopadeśaiḥ suvimugdhacittaṃ prabodhayanti prasabhaṃ prasannam //
meaning:
ये साधवः साधु भजन्ति विष्णुं स्वार्थं परार्थं च यतन्त एव /
नानोपदेशैः सुविमुग्धचित्तं प्रबोधयन्ति प्रसभं प्रसन्नम् //
text_mt: Those good people who properly worship Viṣṇu, striving for their own sake and for the sake of others, / forcibly awaken through various teachings the mind that was utterly bewildered, making it serene.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samākhyāhi harervratāni kṛtaiśca yaiḥ prītimupaiti viṣṇuḥ /
dadāti bhaktiṃ bhajatāṃ dayālurmuktistu tasyā viditā hi dāsī //
meaning:
ततः समाख्याहि हरेर्व्रतानि कृतैश्च यैः प्रीतिमुपैति विष्णुः /
ददाति भक्तिं भजतां दयालुर्मुक्तिस्तु तस्या विदिता हि दासी //
text_mt: Therefore, recount the observances of Hari, performed by which Viṣṇu is pleased. / Compassionate, he grants devotion to those who worship him, and liberation is well known to be its handmaiden.

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti muktiṃ bhajatāṃ mukundo vratārcanadhyānaparāyaṇānām /
bhaktānusevāsu mahāprayāsaṃ vimṛśya kasyāpi na bhaktiyogam //
meaning:
ददाति मुक्तिं भजतां मुकुन्दो व्रतार्चनध्यानपरायणानाम् /
भक्तानुसेवासु महाप्रयासं विमृश्य कस्यापि न भक्तियोगम् //
text_mt: Mukunda grants liberation to those who worship, intent on observances, worship, and meditation; / considering the great exertion involved in attending upon devotees, [he grants] devotional practice to hardly anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca yatkarma harito ṣaṇam /
tadā khyāhi muniśreṣṭha viṣṇubhakto 'si mānada //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तं च निवृत्तं च यत्कर्म हरितो षणम् /
तदा ख्याहि मुनिश्रेष्ठ विष्णुभक्तो ऽसि मानद //
text_mt: Whether based on action or cessation of action, that deed which satisfies Hari, / relate that, O best of sages! You are a devotee of Viṣṇu, O respectful one.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha bhaktastvaṃ puruṣottameḥ /
bhūyo bhūyo yataḥ puccheścaritraṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
साधु साधु मुनिश्रेष्ठ भक्तस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तमेः /
भूयो भूयो यतः पुच्छेश्चरित्रं शार्ङ्गधन्वनः //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Well done, well done, O best of sages! You are a devotee of the Supreme Being, / since again and again you inquire into the deeds of the wielder of the bow Śārṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāni te pravakṣyāmi lokopakṛtimanti ca /
prasīdati hariryaistu prayacchatyabhayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
व्रतानि ते प्रवक्ष्यामि लोकोपकृतिमन्ति च /
प्रसीदति हरिर्यैस्तु प्रयच्छत्यभयं तथा //
text_mt: I shall relate to you the observances that bring benefit to the worlds, / by which Hari is pleased and grants fearlessness as well.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya prasanno bhagavānyajñaliṅgo janārdanaḥ /
ihāmutra sukhaṃ tasya tapovṛddhiśca jāyate //
meaning:
यस्य प्रसन्नो भगवान्यज्ञलिङ्गो जनार्दनः /
इहामुत्र सुखं तस्य तपोवृद्धिश्च जायते //
text_mt: To whom the Blessed Janārdana, whose emblem is sacrifice, is gracious, / for him happiness in this world and the next, and increase of asceticism, are born.

sanskrit_iast:
yena kenāpyupāyena haripūjāparāyaṇāḥ /
prayānti paramaṃ sthānamiti prāhurmaharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
येन केनाप्युपायेन हरिपूजापरायणाः /
प्रयान्ति परमं स्थानमिति प्राहुर्महर्षयः //
text_mt: Those who are devoted to the worship of Hari by whatever means / attain the supreme abode; thus have the great sages declared.

sanskrit_iast:
mārga śīrṣe site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ jalaśāyinam /
upoṣito 'ḍarcayetsamyaṅ naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
मार्ग शीर्षे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां जलशायिनम् /
उपोषितो ऽडर्चयेत्सम्यङ् नरः श्रद्धासमन्वितः //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the twelfth day, fasting, / a man endowed with faith should properly worship him who reclines upon the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā śuklāmbaradharo dantadhāvanapūrvakam /
gandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpair dīpairnaivedyapūrvakaiḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरधरो दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् /
गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैर्धूपैर् दीपैर्नैवेद्यपूर्वकैः //
text_mt: Having bathed, wearing white garments, preceded by the cleansing of teeth, / with fragrant pastes, flowers, unbroken grains, incenses, lamps, preceded by food offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
vāgyato bhaktibhāvena muniśreṣṭhārcayeddharim /
keśavāya namastubhyamiti viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayet //
meaning:
वाग्यतो भक्तिभावेन मुनिश्रेष्ठार्चयेद्धरिम् /
केशवाय नमस्तुभ्यमिति विष्णुं च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: restraining his speech, with an attitude of devotion, O best of sages, he should worship Hari; / and he should worship Viṣṇu [saying]: 'Homage to you, O Keśava!'

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā vanhau ghṛtatilāhutīḥ /
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryācchālagrāmasamīpataḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं हुत्वा वन्हौ घृततिलाहुतीः /
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याच्छालग्रामसमीपतः //
text_mt: Having offered one hundred and eight oblations of ghee and sesame seeds into the fire, / he should keep a vigil at night near a śālagrāma stone.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayetprasthapayasā nārāyaṇamanāmayam /
gītairvādyaiśca naivedyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca keśavam //
meaning:
स्नापयेत्प्रस्थपयसा नारायणमनामयम् /
गीतैर्वाद्यैश्च नैवेद्यैर्भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैश्च केशवम् //
text_mt: He should bathe Nārāyaṇa, the faultless one, with a prastha measure of milk; / [and honor] Keśava with songs, instruments, food offerings, edibles, and delicacies.

sanskrit_iast:
trikālaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā mahālakṣmyā samanvitam /
punaḥ kalye samutthāya kṛtvā karma yathocitam //
meaning:
त्रिकालं पूजयेद्भक्त्या महालक्ष्म्या समन्वितम् /
पुनः कल्ये समुत्थाय कृत्वा कर्म यथोचितम् //
text_mt: He should worship him with devotion at the three times of the day, together with Mahālakṣmī. / Rising again at dawn, performing his duties as appropriate,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavatpūjayedvevaṃ vāgyato niyataḥ śuciḥ /
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ nālikeraphalānvitam //
meaning:
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्वेवं वाग्यतो नियतः शुचिः /
पायसं घृतसंमिश्रं नालिकेरफलान्वितम् //
text_mt: silent, restrained, and pure, he should worship in this manner as before. / Milk-rice mixed with ghee, along with a coconut fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena viprāya dadyādbhaktyā sadakṣiṇam /
keśavaḥ keśihā devaḥ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्राय दद्याद्भक्त्या सदक्षिणम् /
केशवः केशिहा देवः सर्वसंपत्प्रदायकः //
text_mt: he should give to a brāhmaṇa with devotion, along with a priestly gift, with this mantra: / 'Keśava, the slayer of Keśin, the god who bestows all prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
paramānnapradānena mama syādiṣṭadāyakaḥ /
brahmaṇānbhojayetpaścācchaktito bandhubhiḥ saha //
meaning:
परमान्नप्रदानेन मम स्यादिष्टदायकः /
ब्रह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाच्छक्तितो बन्धुभिः सह //
text_mt: by this offering of sweet rice, may he grant my desire!' / Then he should feed brāhmaṇas according to his means, along with his relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa paro bhūtvā svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ /
iti yaḥ kurute bhaktyā keśavārcanamuttamam //
meaning:
नारायण परो भूत्वा स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः /
इति यः कुरुते भक्त्या केशवार्चनमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Devoted to Nārāyaṇa, he should himself eat, restraining his speech. / He who thus performs with devotion the supreme worship of Keśava

sanskrit_iast:
sa paiṇḍarīkayajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet /
pauṣamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
स पैण्डरीकयज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं लभेत् /
पौषमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः //
text_mt: obtains eightfold the fruit of the Paiṇḍarīka sacrifice. / Fasting in the month of Pauṣa, on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti pūjayetprayato harim /
payasā snāpya naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ ca samarpayet //
meaning:
नमो नारायणायेति पूजयेत्प्रयतो हरिम् /
पयसा स्नाप्य नैवेद्यं पायसं च समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: intent and pure, he should worship Hari, saying: 'Homage to Nārāyaṇa!' / Having bathed him with milk, he should offer food and milk-rice as an offering.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātrrikālārcanatatparaḥ /
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairgandhaiḥ puṣpairmanoramaiḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्र्रिकालार्चनतत्परः /
धूपैर्दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैर्गन्धैः पुष्पैर्मनोरमैः //
text_mt: He should keep a vigil at night, intent on worship at the three times of the day, / with incenses, lamps, food offerings, perfumes, and charming flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇaiśca gītavādyādyaiḥ stotraiścāpyaryayeddharim /
kṛśarānnaṃ ca viprāya dadyātsaghṛtadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
तृणैश्च गीतवाद्याद्यैः स्तोत्रैश्चाप्यर्ययेद्धरिम् /
कृशरान्नं च विप्राय दद्यात्सघृतदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: and with grasses, songs, musical instruments, and hymns, he should worship Hari. / And he should give kṛśara rice to a brāhmaṇa, with ghee and a priestly fee:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmā sarvalokeśaḥ sarvavyāpī sanātanaḥ /
nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ syātkṛśarānnapradānataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशः सर्वव्यापी सनातनः /
नारायणः प्रसन्नः स्यात्कृशरान्नप्रदानतः //
text_mt: 'The Soul of all, Lord of all the worlds, all-pervading, eternal— / may Nārāyaṇa be pleased by the offering of kṛśara rice!'

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena viprāya dattvā vai dānamuttamam /
dvijāṃśca bhojeyacchaktyā svayamadyātsabāndhavaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्राय दत्त्वा वै दानमुत्तमम् /
द्विजांश्च भोजेयच्छक्त्या स्वयमद्यात्सबान्धवः //
text_mt: Having given this supreme gift to a brāhmaṇa with this mantra, / he should feed twice-borns according to his means, and eat himself with his kin.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum /
agniṣṭomāṣṭakaphalaṃ sa saṃpūrṇamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या देवं नारायणं प्रभुम् /
अग्निष्टोमाष्टकफलं स संपूर्णमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: He who worships the Lord, the god Nārāyaṇa, in this manner with devotion, / completely attains the fruit of eight Agniṣṭoma sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
māghasya śukladvādaśyāṃ pūrvavatsamupoṣitaḥ /
namaste mādhavāyeti hutvāṣṭau ca ghṛtāhutīḥ //
meaning:
माघस्य शुक्लद्वादश्यां पूर्ववत्समुपोषितः /
नमस्ते माधवायेति हुत्वाष्टौ च घृताहुतीः //
text_mt: On the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, fasting as before, / saying, 'Homage to you, O Mādhava!' and offering eight oblations of ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamānena payasā snāpayenmādhavaṃ tadā /
puṣpagandhākṣatairarcetsāvadhānena cetasā //
meaning:
पूर्वमानेन पयसा स्नापयेन्माधवं तदा /
पुष्पगन्धाक्षतैरर्चेत्सावधानेन चेतसा //
text_mt: he should then bathe Mādhava with milk according to the previous measure; / he should worship him with flowers, perfumes, and unbroken grains, with an attentive mind.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpūrvavadbhaghaktisaṃyutaḥ /
kalyakarma ca nirvartya mādhavaṃ punararcayet //
meaning:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्पूर्ववद्भघक्तिसंयुतः /
कल्यकर्म च निर्वर्त्य माधवं पुनरर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion, he should keep a vigil at night as before; / and having completed his morning duties, he should worship Mādhava again.

sanskrit_iast:
prasthaṃ tilānāṃ viprāya dadyādvai mantrapūrvakam /
sadakṣiṇaṃ savāstrañca sarvapāpavimuktaye //
meaning:
प्रस्थं तिलानां विप्राय दद्याद्वै मन्त्रपूर्वकम् /
सदक्षिणं सवास्त्रञ्च सर्वपापविमुक्तये //
text_mt: He should give a prastha of sesame seeds to a brāhmaṇa, preceded by the mantra, / with a priestly fee and with a cloth, for release from all sins:

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavaḥ sarvabhūtātmā sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ /
tiladānena mahatā sarvānkāmānprayacchatu //
meaning:
माधवः सर्वभूतात्मा सर्वकर्मफलप्रदः /
तिलदानेन महता सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छतु //
text_mt: 'Mādhava, the soul of all beings, the bestower of the fruits of all actions— / may he grant all desires through this great gift of sesame seeds!'

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇānena viprāya dattvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ /
brahmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā saṃsmaranmādhavaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्राय दत्त्वा भक्तिसमन्वितः /
ब्रह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या संस्मरन्माधवं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion, having given to a brāhmaṇa with this mantra, / he should feed brāhmaṇas according to his means, remembering the Lord Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tiladāne vrataṃ mune /
vājapeya śatasyāsau saṃpūrṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या तिलदाने व्रतं मुने /
वाजपेय शतस्यासौ संपूर्णं फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: He who performs this observance of the gift of sesame seeds with devotion in this way, O sage, / attains the complete fruit of a hundred Vājapeya sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
phaālgunasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ /
govindāya namastubhyamiti saṃpūjayedvratī //
meaning:
फआल्गुनस्य सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः /
गोविन्दाय नमस्तुभ्यमिति संपूजयेद्व्रती //
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, / the observer of the vow should worship, saying: 'Homage to you, O Govinda!'

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottagaraśataṃ dṛtvā ghṛtamiśratilāhutīḥ /
pūrvamānena payasā govindaṃ snāpayecchuciḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तगरशतं दृत्वा घृतमिश्रतिलाहुतीः /
पूर्वमानेन पयसा गोविन्दं स्नापयेच्छुचिः //
text_mt: Having offered one hundred and eight oblations of sesame mixed with ghee, / pure, he should bathe Govinda with milk according to the previous measure.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātrrikālaṃ pūjayaittathā /
prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpyātha govindaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्र्रिकालं पूजयैत्तथा /
प्रातः कृत्यं समाप्याथ गोविन्दं पूजयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: He should keep a vigil at night and worship at the three times; / then, having completed the morning duties, he should worship Govinda again.

sanskrit_iast:
vrīhyāḍhakaṃ ca viprāya dadyādvastraṃ sadakṣiṇam /
namo govinda sarveśa gopikājanavallabha //
meaning:
व्रीह्याढकं च विप्राय दद्याद्वस्त्रं सदक्षिणम् /
नमो गोविन्द सर्वेश गोपिकाजनवल्लभ //
text_mt: He should give an āḍhaka measure of rice to a brāhmaṇa, along with a garment and a priestly fee: / 'Homage to Govinda, Lord of all, beloved of the cowherd women!

sanskrit_iast:
anena dhānya dānena prīto bhava jagadguro /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ samyak sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
अनेन धान्य दानेन प्रीतो भव जगद्गुरो /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं सम्यक् सर्वपापविवर्जितः //
text_mt: Be pleased by this gift of grain, O Teacher of the universe!' / Having properly performed this observance, freed from all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
gomedhamakhajaṃ puṇyaṃ sampūrṇaṃ labhate naraḥ /
caitramāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
गोमेधमखजं पुण्यं सम्पूर्णं लभते नरः /
चैत्रमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः //
text_mt: a man obtains the complete merit born of a Gomedha sacrifice. / Fasting on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of the month of Caitra,

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu viṣṇave tubhyamiti pūrvavadarcayet /
kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ pūrvamānena śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु विष्णवे तुभ्यमिति पूर्ववदर्चयेत् /
क्षीरेण स्नापयेद्विष्णुं पूर्वमानेन शक्तितः //
text_mt: he should worship as before, saying: 'Homage be to you, O Viṣṇu!' / He should bathe Viṣṇu with milk according to the previous measure, according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva snāpayedvipra ghṛtaprasthena sādanam /
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau pūjayetpūrvavadrūtī //
meaning:
तथैव स्नापयेद्विप्र घृतप्रस्थेन सादनम् /
कृत्वा जागरणं रात्रौ पूजयेत्पूर्ववद्रूती //
text_mt: Likewise, O brāhmaṇa, he should bathe the deity with a prastha of ghee; / keeping a vigil at night, the observer of the vow should worship as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tatakaḥ kalye samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā madhaavājyatilamiśritam //
meaning:
ततकः कल्ये समुत्थाय प्रातः कृत्यं समाप्य च /
अष्टोत्तरशतं हुत्वा मधअवाज्यतिलमिश्रितम् //
text_mt: Then, having risen at dawn and completed the morning rites, / having offered one hundred and eight oblations mixed with honey, ghee, and sesame,

sanskrit_iast:
sadakṣiṇaṃ ca viprāya dadyādvai taṇḍulāḍhakam /
prāṇarupī mahāviṣṇuḥ prāṇadaḥ sarvavallabhaḥ //
meaning:
सदक्षिणं च विप्राय दद्याद्वै तण्डुलाढकम् /
प्राणरुपी महाविष्णुः प्राणदः सर्ववल्लभः //
text_mt: he should give an āḍhaka of husked rice along with a priestly gift to a brāhmaṇa: / 'Mahāviṣṇu, whose form is the life-breath, the giver of breath, beloved of all—'

sanskrit_iast:
taṇḍulāḍhakadānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ /
evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
तण्डुलाढकदानेन प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः /
एवं कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या सर्वपापविवर्जितः //
text_mt: ‘By the gift of an āḍhaka of rice, may Janārdana be pleased with me!’ / Having done this with devotion, a man is freed from all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
atyangiṣṭomayajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet /
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāmupoṣya madhusūdanam //
meaning:
अत्यन्गिष्टोमयज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं लभेत् /
वैशाखशुक्लद्वादश्यामुपोष्य मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: And obtains eight times the fruit of an Ati-Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / Having fasted on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, for Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
droṇakṣīreṇa deveśaṃ snāpayedbhaktiṃsaṃyutaḥ /
jāgaraṃ tatragha karttavyaṃ trikālārcanasaṃyutam //
meaning:
द्रोणक्षीरेण देवेशं स्नापयेद्भक्तिंसंयुतः /
जागरं तत्रघ कर्त्तव्यं त्रिकालार्चनसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Filled with devotion, he should bathe the Lord of Gods with a droṇa of milk. / A night-vigil is to be kept there, accompanied by worship at the three junctures of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste madhuhantre ca juhuyācchaktito ghṛtam /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ prorcya vidhivanmadhusūdanam //
meaning:
नमस्ते मधुहन्त्रे च जुहुयाच्छक्तितो घृतम् /
अष्टोत्तरशतं प्रोर्च्य विधिवन्मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: With [the mantra]: ‘Obeisance to you, slayer of Madhu’, he should offer oblations of ghee according to his capacity, / And having properly worshipped Madhusūdana one hundred and eight times,

sanskrit_iast:
vipāpo hyaśvamedhānāmaṣṭānāṃ phalamānpuyāt /
jyeṣṭamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāmupavāsakṛt //
meaning:
विपापो ह्यश्वमेधानामष्टानां फलमान्पुयात् /
ज्येष्टमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यामुपवासकृत् //
text_mt: Free of sin, he attains the fruit of eight horse sacrifices. / One who fasts on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīreṇāḍhakamānena snāpayedyastriviktamam /
namastriviktamāyeti pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरेणाढकमानेन स्नापयेद्यस्त्रिविक्तमम् /
नमस्त्रिविक्तमायेति पूजयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: And bathes Trivikrama with a measure of an āḍhaka of milk, / Should worship him, filled with devotion, with: ‘Obeisance to Trivikrama’.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyātpāyasenaiva hyaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ /
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet //
meaning:
जुहुयात्पायसेनैव ह्यष्टोत्तरशताहुतीः /
कृत्वा जागरणं रात्रौ पुनः पूजां प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: He should offer one hundred and eight oblations with sweet milk-rice; / Having kept a night-vigil, he should perform worship again.

sanskrit_iast:
apūpaviṃśatiṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya sadakṣiṇam /
devadeva jagannāta prasīda parameśvara //
meaning:
अपूपविंशतिं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय सदक्षिणम् /
देवदेव जगन्नात प्रसीद परमेश्वर //
text_mt: Having given twenty apūpa cakes along with a sacrificial fee to a brāhmaṇa, [saying]: / ‘O God of gods, Lord of the world, be gracious, O Supreme Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
upāyanaṃ ca saṃgṛhya mamābhīṣṭaprado bhava /
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
उपायनं च संगृह्य ममाभीष्टप्रदो भव /
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Accepting this present, be the grantor of my desire!’ / He should feed brāhmaṇas according to his capacity and eat himself, keeping silence.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra vrataṃ traivikramaṃ param /
so 'ṣṭānāṃ naramedhānāṃ vipāpaḥ phalamānpuyāt //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र व्रतं त्रैविक्रमं परम् /
सो ऽष्टानां नरमेधानां विपापः फलमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: The twice-born who thus observes this supreme Traivikrama observance, / Becomes free of sin and attains the fruit of eight human sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāmupavāsī jitendriyaḥ /
vāmanaṃ pūrvamānena snāpayetpayasā vratī //
meaning:
आषाढशुक्लद्वादश्यामुपवासी जितेन्द्रियः /
वामनं पूर्वमानेन स्नापयेत्पयसा व्रती //
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha with senses restrained, / The observer of the vow should bathe Vāmana with milk of the previously stated measure.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vāmanāyeti dūrvājyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
hutvā ca jāgaraṃ kuryādvāmanaṃ cārcayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते वामनायेति दूर्वाज्याष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
हुत्वा च जागरं कुर्याद्वामनं चार्चयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: With: ‘Obeisance to you, O Vāmana’, he should offer one hundred and eight oblations / Of dūrvā grass and ghee, keep a night-vigil, and worship Vāmana again.

sanskrit_iast:
sadākṣiṇaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ nālikeraphalānvitam /
bhaktyā pradadyādviprāya vāmanārcanaśīline //
meaning:
सदाक्षिणं च दध्यन्नं नालिकेरफलान्वितम् /
भक्त्या प्रदद्याद्विप्राय वामनार्चनशीलिने //
text_mt: Along with a sacrificial fee, he should devoutly give curd-rice accompanied by a coconut fruit / To a brāhmaṇa devoted to the worship of Vāmana, [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
vāmano vuddhido hotā dravyastho vāmanaḥ sadā /
vāmanastārako 'smācca vāmanāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
वामनो वुद्धिदो होता द्रव्यस्थो वामनः सदा /
वामनस्तारको ऽस्माच्च वामनाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: ‘Vāmana is the giver of intellect, the sacrificer; Vāmana always abides in the offerings; / Vāmana is the deliverer from this [world]; obeisance, obeisance to Vāmana!’

sanskrit_iast:
anena dattvā dadhyannaṃ śaktito bhojayeddijān /
kṛtvai vamagriṣṭomānāṃ śatasya phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अनेन दत्त्वा दध्यन्नं शक्तितो भोजयेद्दिजान् /
कृत्वै वमग्रिष्टोमानां शतस्य फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having given curd-rice with this [mantra], he should feed twice-borns according to his capacity. / Having done this, he attains the fruit of a hundred Agniṣṭoma sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāmupavāsakṛt /
kṣīreṇa madhumiśreṇa snāpayecchrīdharaṃ vratī //
meaning:
श्रावणस्य सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यामुपवासकृत् /
क्षीरेण मधुमिश्रेण स्नापयेच्छ्रीधरं व्रती //
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, / The observer of the vow should bathe Śrīdhara with milk mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu śrīdharāyeti gandhādyaiḥ pūjayetkramāt /
juhuyātpṛṣadājyena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mune //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु श्रीधरायेति गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेत्क्रमात् /
जुहुयात्पृषदाज्येन शतमष्टोत्तरं मुने //
text_mt: With: ‘Obeisance be to Śrīdhara’, he should worship him in order with scents and other offerings, / And offer one hundred and eight oblations with ghee mixed with curds, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā ca jāgaraṃ rātrau punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet /
dātavyaṃ caiva viprāya kṣīrāḍhakamanuttamam //
meaning:
कृत्वा च जागरं रात्रौ पुनः पूजां प्रकल्पयेत् /
दातव्यं चैव विप्राय क्षीराढकमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having kept a night-vigil, he should perform worship again, / And an excellent āḍhaka of milk should be given to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca savastrāṃ vai pradadyāddhemakuṇḍale /
mantreṇānena viprendru sarvakāmāśrasiddhaye //
meaning:
दक्षिणां च सवस्त्रां वै प्रदद्याद्धेमकुण्डले /
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्रेन्द्रु सर्वकामाश्रसिद्धये //
text_mt: And he should give a sacrificial fee along with garments and golden earrings / With this mantra, O best of twice-borns, for the attainment of all desires:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhiśāyindeveśa ramākānta jagatpate /
kṣīradānena suprīto bhava sarvasukhapradaḥ //
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिशायिन्देवेश रमाकान्त जगत्पते /
क्षीरदानेन सुप्रीतो भव सर्वसुखप्रदः //
text_mt: ‘O Lord of gods sleeping on the ocean of milk, O lover of Ramā, O Lord of the world, / Be exceedingly pleased by this gift of milk, and grant all happiness!’

sanskrit_iast:
sukhapradattvādviprāṃśca bhojayecchaktito vratī /
eva kṛtvā śvamedhānāṃ sahasrasya phalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
सुखप्रदत्त्वाद्विप्रांश्च भोजयेच्छक्तितो व्रती /
एव कृत्वा श्वमेधानां सहस्रस्य फलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Having given this, the observer of the vow should feed brāhmaṇas according to his capacity; / Having done this, he obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi bhādrapade śukle dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ /
snāpayeddroṇapayasā hṛṣīkeśaṃ jagadgurum //
meaning:
मासि भाद्रपदे शुक्ले द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः /
स्नापयेद्द्रोणपयसा हृषीकेशं जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth day in the bright fortnight in the month of Bhādrapada, / He should bathe Hṛṣīkeśa, the teacher of the world, with a droṇa of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyamiti saṃpūjayennaraḥ /
caruṇā madhuyuktena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunet //
meaning:
हृषीकेश नमस्तुभ्यमिति संपूजयेन्नरः /
चरुणा मधुयुक्तेन शतमष्टोत्तरं हुनेत् //
text_mt: A man should worship him saying: ‘O Hṛṣīkeśa, obeisance to you!’, / And offer one hundred and eight oblations with sacrificial rice mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast:
jāgarādīnini nirvartya dadyādātmavide tataḥ /
sārdhāḍhakaṃ ca godhūmāndakṣiṇāṃ hema śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
जागरादीनिनि निर्वर्त्य दद्यादात्मविदे ततः /
सार्धाढकं च गोधूमान्दक्षिणां हेम शक्तितः //
text_mt: Having completed the night-vigil and other rites, he should then give to a knower of the self / One and a half āḍhakas of wheat, a sacrificial fee, and gold according to his capacity, [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṃ sarvalokaikahetave /
mahyaṃ sarvasukhaṃ dehi godhūmasya pradānataḥ //
meaning:
हृषीकेश नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वलोकैकहेतवे /
मह्यं सर्वसुखं देहि गोधूमस्य प्रदानतः //
text_mt: ‘O Hṛṣīkeśa, obeisance to you, the sole cause of all the worlds! / Grant me all happiness through this gift of wheat!’

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayedvrāhmāñśaktyā svayaṃ cāśrītavāgyataḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
भोजयेद्व्राह्माञ्शक्त्या स्वयं चाश्रीतवाग्यतः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्ममेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: He should feed brāhmaṇas according to his capacity, and eat himself, keeping silence. / Freed from all sins, he obtains the fruit of a Brahmamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine māsiśuklāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃsamupoṣitaḥ /
padmanābhaṃ capayasā snāpayedbhaktitaḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
आश्विने मासिशुक्लायां द्वादश्यांसमुपोषितः /
पद्मनाभं चपयसा स्नापयेद्भक्तितः शुचिः //
text_mt: Fasting on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Āśvina, / Pure, he should devoutly bathe Padmanābha with milk.

sanskrit_iast:
namaste padmanābhāya homaṃ kuyārtsvaśaktitaḥ /
tilabrīhiyavājyaiśca pūjayecca vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते पद्मनाभाय होमं कुयार्त्स्वशक्तितः /
तिलब्रीहियवाज्यैश्च पूजयेच्च विधानतः //
text_mt: With: ‘Obeisance to you, O Padmanābha’, he should perform fire oblation according to his capacity / With sesamum, paddy, barley, and ghee, and worship him according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmaraṃ niśi nirvartya punaḥ pūjāṃ samācaret /
dadyādviprāya kuḍavaṃ madhunastu sadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
जामरं निशि निर्वर्त्य पुनः पूजां समाचरेत् /
दद्याद्विप्राय कुडवं मधुनस्तु सदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Having kept a night-vigil, he should perform worship again, / And give to a brāhmaṇa a kuḍava of honey along with a sacrificial fee, [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābhagha namastubhyaṃ sarvalokapitāmaha /
madhudānena suprīto bhavasarvasukhapradaḥ //
meaning:
पद्मनाभघ नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वलोकपितामह /
मधुदानेन सुप्रीतो भवसर्वसुखप्रदः //
text_mt: ‘O Padmanābha, obeisance to you, grandfather of all the worlds! / Be exceedingly pleased by this gift of honey, and grant all happiness!’

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā padmanābhavrataṃ sudhīḥ /
brahmamedhasahasrasya phalamānpoti niścitam //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या पद्मनाभव्रतं सुधीः /
ब्रह्ममेधसहस्रस्य फलमान्पोति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: The wise person who thus performs the Padmanābha vow with devotion, / Certainly obtains the fruit of a thousand Brahmamedha sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ kārtike śukle upavāsī jitendriyaḥ /
kṣīreṇākaḍhakamānena dandhā vājyena tāvatā //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां कार्तिके शुक्ले उपवासी जितेन्द्रियः /
क्षीरेणाकढकमानेन दन्धा वाज्येन तावता //
text_mt: On the twelfth day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, fasting with senses restrained, / [He should bathe him] with a measure of an āḍhaka of milk, or with that much curds or ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
namo dāmodarāyeti snāpayedbhaktibhāvataḥ /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā maghvājyāktatilāhutīḥ //
meaning:
नमो दामोदरायेति स्नापयेद्भक्तिभावतः /
अष्टोत्तरशतं हुत्वा मघ्वाज्याक्ततिलाहुतीः //
text_mt: Devoutly bathing him with: ‘Obeisance to Dāmodara’. / Having offered one hundred and eight oblations of sesamum anointed with honey and ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgaraṃ niyataḥ kuryāttrikālārcanatatparaḥ /
prātaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ padmapuṣpairmanoramaiḥ //
meaning:
जागरं नियतः कुर्यात्त्रिकालार्चनतत्परः /
प्रातः संपूजयेद्देवं पद्मपुष्पैर्मनोरमैः //
text_mt: He should keep a vigil with self-restraint, intent on worship at the three junctures of the day. / In the morning, he should worship the god with charming lotus flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
punaraṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyātsaghṛtai stilaiḥ /
pañcabhakṣyayutaṃ cānnaṃ dadyādviprāya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
पुनरष्टोत्तरशतं जुहुयात्सघृतै स्तिलैः /
पञ्चभक्ष्ययुतं चान्नं दद्याद्विप्राय भक्तितः //
text_mt: He should again offer one hundred and eight oblations with sesamum accompanied by ghee, / And devoutly give food accompanied by the five kinds of delicacies to a brāhmaṇa, [saying]:

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodara jagannātha sarvakāraṇakāraṇa /
trāhimāṃ kṛpayā deva śāraṇāgatapālakaḥ //
meaning:
दामोदर जगन्नाथ सर्वकारणकारण /
त्राहिमां कृपया देव शारणागतपालकः //
text_mt: ‘O Dāmodara, Lord of the world, cause of all causes, / Protect me through your compassion, O God who protects those who take refuge!’

sanskrit_iast:
anena dattvā dānaṃ ca śrotriyāya kuṭumbine /
dakṣiṇāñca yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇāṃśvāpi bhojayet //
meaning:
अनेन दत्त्वा दानं च श्रोत्रियाय कुटुम्बिने /
दक्षिणाञ्च यथाशक्त्या ब्राह्मणांश्वापि भोजयेत् //
text_mt: Having made this gift to a Vedic scholar who has a family, / And given a sacrificial fee according to his capacity, he should also feed brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṅkṛtvā vrataṃ samyagaśrīyādvūndhubhiḥ saha /
aśvamegha sahasrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute //
meaning:
एवङ्कृत्वा व्रतं सम्यगश्रीयाद्वून्धुभिः सह /
अश्वमेघ सहस्राणां द्विगुणं फलमश्नुते //
text_mt: Having properly performed this vow, he should eat together with his kinsmen; / He attains twice the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kuryādvratī yastu dvādaśīvratamuttamam /
saṃvatsaraṃ muniśreṣṭha sa yāti parama padam //
meaning:
एवं कुर्याद्व्रती यस्तु द्वादशीव्रतमुत्तमम् /
संवत्सरं मुनिश्रेष्ठ स याति परम पदम् //
text_mt: The observer of the vow who thus performs this excellent Dvādaśī vow / For a full year, O best of sages, goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamāse dvimāse vāyaḥ kuryādbhaktitatparaḥ /
tattatphalamavānpoti prānpoti ca hareḥ padam //
meaning:
एकमासे द्विमासे वायः कुर्याद्भक्तितत्परः /
तत्तत्फलमवान्पोति प्रान्पोति च हरेः पदम् //
text_mt: He who, intent on devotion, performs it for one month or two months / Obtains their respective fruits and attains the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī /
mārgaśīrṣāsite pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ ca munīśvara //
meaning:
पूर्णं संवत्सरं कृत्वा कुर्यादुद्यापनं व्रती /
मार्गशीर्षासिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां च मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: Having completed a full year, the observer of the vow should perform the concluding rite / On the twelfth day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā prātaryathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam /
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा प्रातर्यथाचारं दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् /
शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः //
text_mt: Having bathed in the morning according to custom, preceded by brushing his teeth, / Wearing white garlands and garments, and anointed with white fragrant paste,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ suśībhanam /
ghaṇṭācāmarasaṃyuktaṃ kiṅkiṇīravaśobhitam //
meaning:
मण्डपं कारयेद्दिव्यं चतुरस्त्रं सुशीभनम् /
घण्टाचामरसंयुक्तं किङ्किणीरवशोभितम् //
text_mt: He should cause a splendid, four-cornered, very beautiful pavilion to be made, / Provided with bells and chowries, and adorned with the sound of small bells,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkṛtaṃ puṣpamālyairvitānaghvajarājitān /
chāditaṃ śuklavastreṇa dīpamālāvibhūṣitam //
meaning:
अलङ्कृतं पुष्पमाल्यैर्वितानघ्वजराजितान् /
छादितं शुक्लवस्त्रेण दीपमालाविभूषितम् //
text_mt: Decorated with flower garlands, resplendent with canopies and banners, / Covered with a white cloth, and adorned with rows of lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kuryātsamyagalaṅkṛtam /
tasyoparinyasetkumbhāndvādaśāmbuprapūritān //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये सर्वतोभद्रं कुर्यात्सम्यगलङ्कृतम् /
तस्योपरिन्यसेत्कुम्भान्द्वादशाम्बुप्रपूरितान् //
text_mt: In the middle of it, he should make a well-adorned sarvatobhadra diagram; / Upon it he should place twelve water-jars completely filled with water.

sanskrit_iast:
ekena śulkavanastreṇa samyaksaṃśodhitena ca /
sarvānācchādayetkumbhānpañcaratnasamanvitān //
meaning:
एकेन शुल्कवनस्त्रेण सम्यक्संशोधितेन च /
सर्वानाच्छादयेत्कुम्भान्पञ्चरत्नसमन्वितान् //
text_mt: With a single, thoroughly cleansed white cloth, / He should cover all the jars containing the five gems.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kārayedbhaktimānvratī /
henmā vā rājatenāpi tathā tāmreṇa vā dvijā //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीनारायणं देवं कारयेद्भक्तिमान्व्रती /
हेन्मा वा राजतेनापि तथा ताम्रेण वा द्विजा //
text_mt: The devoted vow-keeper should have an image of God Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa made, / Either of gold, or of silver, or also of copper, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetpratimāṃ tāṃ ca kumbhopari susaṃyamī /
tanmūlyaṃ vā dvijaśreṣṭha kāñcanaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ //
meaning:
स्थापयेत्प्रतिमां तां च कुम्भोपरि सुसंयमी /
तन्मूल्यं वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ काञ्चनं च स्वशक्तितः //
text_mt: And being well-restrained, he should install that image upon the jars; / Or, O best of twice-borns, he should place gold of its value, according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavrateṣu matimānvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarja yet /
yadi kuryātkṣayaṃ yānti tasyāyurddhanasaṃpadaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वव्रतेषु मतिमान्वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्ज येत् /
यदि कुर्यात्क्षयं यान्ति तस्यायुर्द्धनसंपदः //
text_mt: In all observances, the wise person should avoid stinginess regarding wealth. / If he should commit it, his lifespan, wealth, and prosperity go to ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaśāyinaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayaṭam /
pañcāmṛtena prathamaṃ snāpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तशायिनं देवं नारायणमनामयटम् /
पञ्चामृतेन प्रथमं स्नापयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion, one should first bathe the imperishable God Nārāyaṇa, / who reclines on Ananta, with the five nectars.

sanskrit_iast:
nāṃmabhiḥ keśavādyaiśca hyupacārānmakalpayet /
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhaghiḥ //
meaning:
नांमभिः केशवाद्यैश्च ह्युपचारान्मकल्पयेत् /
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्पुराणश्रवणादिभघिः //
text_mt: And one should arrange the offerings with the names beginning with Keśava. / At night one should keep vigil by listening to the Purāṇas and other such means.

sanskrit_iast:
jitanidro bhavetsamyaksopavāso jitendriyaḥ /
trikālamarcayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
जितनिद्रो भवेत्सम्यक्सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः /
त्रिकालमर्चयेद्देवं यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Having conquered sleep, fasting, and with senses restrained, / one should worship the God at the three junctions of the day according to the extent of one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ samāpya ca /
tilahomānvyāhṛtibhiḥ sahasraṃra kāvyeddvijaiḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय प्रातः कृत्यं समाप्य च /
तिलहोमान्व्याहृतिभिः सहस्रंर काव्येद्द्विजैः //
text_mt: Then, having risen at dawn and finished one's morning duties, / one should have Brahmins perform a thousand fire oblations of sesame seeds with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt /
devasya purataḥ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
ततः संपूजयेद्देवं गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् /
देवस्य पुरतः कुर्यात्पुराणश्रवणं ततः //
text_mt: Then one should worship the God in due order with scents, flowers, and the like; / then one should listen to the Purāṇas before the God.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyāddvādaśaviprebhyo dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā /
apūpairdaśa bhiryuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca sadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
दद्याद्द्वादशविप्रेभ्यो दध्यन्नं पायसं पायसं तथा /
अपूपैर्दश भिर्युक्तं सघृतं च सदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: One should give to twelve Brahmins curd-rice and sweet milk-rice, / along with ten sweet cakes, accompanied with clarified butter and priestly gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
devadevajagannātha bhaktānugrahavigraha /
gṛhāṇopāyanaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvābhīṣṭaprado bhava //
meaning:
देवदेवजगन्नाथ भक्तानुग्रहविग्रह /
गृहाणोपायनं कृष्ण सर्वाभीष्टप्रदो भव //
text_mt: “O God of gods, Lord of the world, whose form is compassion to devotees! / Accept this offering, O Kṛṣṇa, and be the bestower of all desired wishes.”

sanskrit_iast:
anenopāyanaṃ dattvā prārthaye māñjaliḥ sthitaḥ /
ādhāya jānunī bhūmau vinayāvananato vratī //
meaning:
अनेनोपायनं दत्त्वा प्रार्थये माञ्जलिः स्थितः /
आधाय जानुनी भूमौ विनयावननतो व्रती //
text_mt: Having presented the offering with this [mantra], the practitioner of the vow, / placing both knees upon the earth and bowing down in humility, should pray with cupped hands:

sanskrit_iast:
namo namaste surarājarāja namo 'stute devaṃ jagannivāsa /
kuruṣva saṃpṛrṇaphalaṃ mamādya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ puruṣottamāya //
meaning:
नमो नमस्ते सुरराजराज नमो ऽस्तुते देवं जगन्निवास /
कुरुष्व संपृर्णफलं ममाद्य नमो ऽस्तु तुभ्यं पुरुषोत्तमाय //
text_mt: “Salutations, salutations to you, O King of the kings of gods! Salutations to you, O God, abode of the world! / Make my fruit complete today! Salutations to you, the Supreme Person!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃprārthayedviprāndevaṃ ca puruṣottamam /
dadyādarghyaṃ ca devāya mahālakṣmīyutāya vai //
meaning:
इति संप्रार्थयेद्विप्रान्देवं च पुरुषोत्तमम् /
दद्यादर्घ्यं च देवाय महालक्ष्मीयुताय वै //
text_mt: Thus he should pray to the Brahmins and to the God, the Supreme Person; / and he should present an offering of water to the God accompanied by Mahālakṣmī:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīpate namastubhyaṃ kṣīrārṇavanivāsine /
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa lakṣmyā ca sahitaḥ prakṣo //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीपते नमस्तुभ्यं क्षीरार्णवनिवासिने /
अर्घ्यं गृहाण देवेश लक्ष्म्या च सहितः प्रक्षो //
text_mt: “Salutations to you, O Lord of Lakṣmī, dweller in the Milk Ocean! / Accept this offering of water, O Lord of gods, together with Lakṣmī, O Lord!”

sanskrit_iast:
yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā tapoyajñakriyādiṣu /
nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti sadyo vande tamacyutam //
meaning:
यस्य स्मृत्या च नामोक्त्या तपोयज्ञक्रियादिषु /
न्यूनं संपूर्णतां याति सद्यो वन्दे तमच्युतम् //
text_mt: “Through the remembrance and recitation of whose name whatever is deficient / in austerities, sacrifices, rituals, and the like instantly reaches completeness—to that Acyuta I bow.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ tatsarvaṃ saṃyamī vrate /
pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāmācāryāya nivedayet //
meaning:
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं तत्सर्वं संयमी व्रते /
प्रतिमां दक्षिणायुक्तामाचार्याय निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Having thus addressed the Lord of gods, the self-restrained observer of the vow / should offer all of that, [including] the idol accompanied with a priestly gift, to the teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścīcchaktyā dadyāja dakṣiṇām /
bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bevṛjanairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चीच्छक्त्या दद्याज दक्षिणाम् /
भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः पश्चात्स्वयं बेवृजनैर्वृतः //
text_mt: Afterwards he should feed Brahmins and give priestly gifts according to his means. / Afterwards, keeping silent, he should eat himself, surrounded by his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
āsāyaṃ śṛduyādviṣṇoḥ kathāṃ vidvajjanaiḥ saha /
ityevaṃ kurute yastu manujo dvādaśīvratam //
meaning:
आसायं शृदुयाद्विष्णोः कथां विद्वज्जनैः सह /
इत्येवं कुरुते यस्तु मनुजो द्वादशीव्रतम् //
text_mt: Until evening he should listen to the stories of Viṣṇu along with learned people. / That mortal who thus performs the observance of the twelfth day

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānkāmānsa ānpoti paraghatreha ca nārada /
trisatakulasaṃyuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ /
tapāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra yattvā na śocati //
meaning:
सर्वान्कामान्स आन्पोति परघत्रेह च नारद /
त्रिसतकुलसंयुक्तः सर्वपापविवर्जितः /
तपाति विष्णुभवनं यत्र यत्त्वा न शोचति //
text_mt: attains all desires in this world and the next, O Nārada; / accompanied by three hundred generations of his family and freed from all sins, / he goes to the abode of Viṣṇu, having reached which he grieves no more.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādvipra dvādaśīvratamuttamam /
vācayedvāpi sa naro vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne mārgaśīrṣaśukladvādaśīvratakathanaṃ nāma satpadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयाद्विप्र द्वादशीव्रतमुत्तमम् /
वाचयेद्वापि स नरो वाजपेयफलं लभेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे व्रताख्याने मार्गशीर्षशुक्लद्वादशीव्रतकथनं नाम सत्पदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever hears this supreme observance of the twelfth day, O Brahmin, / or recites it, that man obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, titled 'The Account of the Observance of the Bright Twelfth Day of Mārgaśīrṣa', in the narration of vows in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
anyadvratavaraṃ vakṣya śṛṇuṣva munisattama /
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhanibarhaṇam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अन्यद्व्रतवरं वक्ष्य शृणुष्व मुनिसत्तम /
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखनिबर्हणम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / I shall declare another excellent observance; listen, O best of sages, / which destroys all sins, is holy, and removes all sorrow,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā /
samastakāmaphaladaṃ sarvavratamyaphalapradam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां योषितां तथा /
समस्तकामफलदं सर्वव्रतम्यफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: for Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, Śūdras, and women, / granting the fruit of all desires, yielding the fruit of all vows,

sanskrit_iast:
duḥsvanpanāśane dharmyaṃ duṣṭagrahanivāraṇam /
sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūrṇimāvratamam /
yena cīrṇena pāpānāṃ rāśikoṭiḥra praśāmyati //
meaning:
दुःस्वन्पनाशने धर्म्यं दुष्टग्रहनिवारणम् /
सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातं पूर्णिमाव्रतमम् /
येन चीर्णेन पापानां राशिकोटिःर प्रशाम्यति //
text_mt: righteous, destroying bad dreams, averting malignant planets, / renowned in all the worlds: the observance of the full moon, / through the performance of which ten million masses of sins are pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe sitepakṣe pūrṇāyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ /
snānaṃ kuryādyathācāraṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे सितेपक्षे पूर्णायां नियतः शुचिः /
स्नानं कुर्याद्यथाचारं दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: In the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the bright full-moon day, self-controlled and pure, / one should bathe according to custom after cleaning one's teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuddho gṛhamāgagatya vāgyataḥ /
prakṣālya pādāvācamya smaratrārāyaṇaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुद्धो गृहमागगत्य वाग्यतः /
प्रक्षाल्य पादावाचम्य स्मरत्रारायणं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Wearing white garments, pure, having returned home, restrained in speech, / having washed one's feet and sipped water, remembering the Lord Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā paśvātsaṃkalpapūrvakam /
lakṣmī nārāyaṇaṃ devamarcayedbhaktibhāvataḥ //
meaning:
नित्यं देवार्चनं कृत्वा पश्वात्संकल्पपूर्वकम् /
लक्ष्मी नारायणं देवमर्चयेद्भक्तिभावतः //
text_mt: having performed the daily worship of the deity, and then having made the ritual intention, / one should worship the God Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa with devoted feeling.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanāsanādyaiśca gandhapuṣpādibhirvratī /
namo nārāyaṇāyeti pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ //
meaning:
आवाहनासनाद्यैश्च गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्व्रती /
नमो नारायणायेति पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परः //
text_mt: With invocations, seats, and the like, and with scents, flowers, and other offerings, / intent on devotion, the practitioner of the vow should worship him, saying, “Salutations to Nārāyaṇa.”

sanskrit_iast:
gītairvādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca purāṇapaṭhanādibhiḥ /
stotrairvārādhayeddevaṃ vratakṛtsusamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
गीतैर्वाद्यैश्च नृत्यैश्च पुराणपठनादिभिः /
स्तोत्रैर्वाराधयेद्देवं व्रतकृत्सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: With songs, musical instruments, dances, readings from the Purāṇas, and other acts, / and with hymns of praise, the practitioner of the vow, deeply concentrated, should propitiate the God.

sanskrit_iast:
devasya purataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ caturastrakam /
aratnimātraṃ tatrāngiṃ sthāpayedgṛhyamārgataḥ /
ājyabhāgāntarpayantaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasūktataḥ /
caraṇā ca tilaiśvāpi ghṛtena juhuyāttathā //
meaning:
देवस्य पुरतः कृत्वा स्थण्डिलं चतुरस्त्रकम् /
अरत्निमात्रं तत्रान्गिं स्थापयेद्गृह्यमार्गतः /
आज्यभागान्तर्पयन्तं कृत्वा पुरुषसूक्ततः /
चरणा च तिलैश्वापि घृतेन जुहुयात्तथा //
text_mt: Having made a four-cornered altar of one cubit in size before the God, / one should establish the fire there according to the domestic ritual rule; / having performed [the rites] up to the portions of clarified butter, according to the Puruṣasūkta / and with the sacrificial caru, sesame seeds, and clarified butter, one should offer fire oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
ekavāraṃ dvivāraṃ vātrivāraṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ /
homaṃ kuryātprayatnena sarvapāpanivṛttaye //
meaning:
एकवारं द्विवारं वात्रिवारं वापि शक्तितः /
होमं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन सर्वपापनिवृत्तये //
text_mt: Once, twice, or thrice, according to one's capacity, / one should diligently perform the fire oblation for the cessation of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittā dikaṃ sarvaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ /
samāpya homaṃ vidhivacchāntisūktaṃ japedrudhaḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्ता दिकं सर्वं स्वगृह्योक्तविधानतः /
समाप्य होमं विधिवच्छान्तिसूक्तं जपेद्रुधः //
