text_mt: Having concluded all the rites such as expiations in accordance with the rule of one's own domestic manual / and finished the fire oblation properly, the wise man should recite the Śāntisūkta.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāddevaṃ samāgatya punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet /
tathopavāsaṃ devāya hyarpayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
पश्चाद्देवं समागत्य पुनः पूजां प्रकल्पयेत् /
तथोपवासं देवाय ह्यर्पयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: Afterwards, approaching the God, he should arrange worship again; / and endowed with devotion, he should dedicate his fasting to the God:

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvā deva tavājñayā /
bhokṣyāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa pare 'hli śaraṇaṃ bhava //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां निराहारः स्थित्वा देव तवाज्ञया /
भोक्ष्यामि पुण्डरीकाक्ष परे ऽह्लि शरणं भव //
text_mt: “Remaining without food on the full-moon day, O God, by your command, / I shall eat on the following day, O Lotus-eyed One; be my refuge!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñāpya devāyahyarghyaṃ dadyāttathaindave /
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gagatvā śuklapuṣpākṣatānvitaḥ //
meaning:
इति विज्ञाप्य देवायह्यर्घ्यं दद्यात्तथैन्दवे /
जानुभ्यामवनीं गगत्वा शुक्लपुष्पाक्षतान्वितः //
text_mt: Having addressed the God thus, he should also offer water to the Moon; / going down on his knees to the ground, accompanied with white flowers and unbroken rice grains:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta aghatrigotrasamudbhaghava /
grahāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rohiṇīnāyaka prabho /
evamarghyaṃ pradāyendoḥ prārthayetprāñjalistataḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूत अघत्रिगोत्रसमुद्भघव /
ग्रहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं रोहिणीनायक प्रभो /
एवमर्घ्यं प्रदायेन्दोः प्रार्थयेत्प्राञ्जलिस्ततः //
text_mt: “O born from the Ocean of Milk! O born in the lineage of Atri! / Accept the offering of water given by me, O Lord, husband of Rohiṇī!” / Having thus given the offering of water to the Moon, he should then pray with cupped hands,

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭanpūrvamukho bhūtvā paśyanninduṃ ca nārada //
meaning: तिष्टन्पूर्वमुखो भूत्वा पश्यन्निन्दुं च नारद //
text_mt: standing facing the east and looking at the Moon, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śuklāṃśave tubhyaṃ dvijarājāya te namaḥ /
rohiṇīpataye tubhyaṃ lakṣmībhrātre namo 'stu te //
meaning:
नमः शुक्लांशवे तुभ्यं द्विजराजाय ते नमः /
रोहिणीपतये तुभ्यं लक्ष्मीभ्रात्रे नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: “Salutations to you of white rays! Salutations to you, king of the stars! / Salutations to you, husband of Rohiṇī! Salutations be to you, brother of Lakṣmī!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca jāgaraṃ kuryātpurāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ /
jitendriyaśca saṃśuddhaḥ pāṣaṇḍālokavarjitaḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च जागरं कुर्यात्पुराणश्रवणादिभिः /
जितेन्द्रियश्च संशुद्धः पाषण्डालोकवर्जितः //
text_mt: And then he should keep vigil by listening to the Purāṇas and similar means, / with senses conquered, completely purified, and avoiding the sight of heretics.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ prakurvīta svācāraṃ ca yathāvidhi /
punaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ yathāvibhavavistaram //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः प्रकुर्वीत स्वाचारं च यथाविधि /
पुनः संपूजयेद्देवं यथाविभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Then at dawn he should perform his customary duties according to the rule, / and worship the God again according to the extent of his wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā tataśca prayato naraḥ /
bandhubhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या ततश्च प्रयतो नरः /
बन्धुभृत्यादिभिः सार्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Then, according to his capacity, the self-controlled man should feed Brahmins; / together with his relatives, servants, and others, he should himself eat, keeping silent.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pauṣādimāseṣu pūrṇamāsyāmupoṣitaḥ /
arcayedbhaktisaṃyukto nārāyaṇamanāyamam //
meaning:
एवं पौषादिमासेषु पूर्णमास्यामुपोषितः /
अर्चयेद्भक्तिसंयुक्तो नारायणमनायमम् //
text_mt: Having fasted thus on the full-moon day in the months beginning with Pauṣa, / endowed with devotion he should worship the imperishable Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimādine /
udyāpanaṃ prakurvīta tadvidhānaṃ vadāmi te //
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा कार्तिक्यां पूर्णिमादिने /
उद्यापनं प्रकुर्वीत तद्विधानं वदामि ते //
text_mt: Having done so for a year, on the full-moon day of Kārttika / he should perform the concluding rite. I will tell you the rule for it:

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ caturastraṃ sumaṅgalam /
śobhitaṃ puṣpamālābhirvitānadhvajarājitam //
meaning:
मण्डपं कारयेद्दिव्यं चतुरस्त्रं सुमङ्गलम् /
शोभितं पुष्पमालाभिर्वितानध्वजराजितम् //
text_mt: He should have a celestial pavilion constructed, four-cornered and highly auspicious, / adorned with garlands of flowers, splendid with canopies and banners,

sanskrit_iast:
bahudāpasamākīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam /
darpaṃṇaiścāmaraiścaiva kalaśaiśca samāvṛtam //
meaning:
बहुदापसमाकीर्णं किङ्किणीजालशोभितम् /
दर्पंणैश्चामरैश्चैव कलशैश्च समावृतम् //
text_mt: filled with many lamps, decorated with clusters of tiny bells, / and surrounded with mirrors, fly-whisks, and water jars.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ pañcavarṇavirājitam /
jalapūrṇaṃ tataḥ kumbhaṃ nyasettasyopari dvija //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये सर्वतोभद्रं पञ्चवर्णविराजितम् /
जलपूर्णं ततः कुम्भं न्यसेत्तस्योपरि द्विज //
text_mt: In the middle of it, a sarvatobhadra diagram shining with five colors; / then, O Brahmin, upon it he should place a water jar filled with water.

sanskrit_iast:
pidhāya kumbhaṃ vastreṇa susūkṣmeṇāti śobhitam /
henmā vā rajatenāpi tathā tānmeṇa vā dvija /
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṛtvā tasyopari nyaset //
meaning:
पिधाय कुम्भं वस्त्रेण सुसूक्ष्मेणाति शोभितम् /
हेन्मा वा रजतेनापि तथा तान्मेण वा द्विज /
लक्ष्मीनारायणं देवं कृत्वा तस्योपरि न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Having covered the jar with a very fine and exceedingly beautiful cloth, / having fashioned the god Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa out of gold or silver or copper, O twice-born one, / one should place it upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpyābhyarcyagandhādibhiḥ kramāt /
bhakṣmairbhojyādinaivedyairbhaktitaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चामृतेन संस्नाप्याभ्यर्च्यगन्धादिभिः क्रमात् /
भक्ष्मैर्भोज्यादिनैवेद्यैर्भक्तितः संयतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Having bathed [the deity] with the five nectars and worshipped him in proper sequence with fragrant perfumes and other offerings, / with edible pastries, cooked dishes, and other food-offerings, with devotion and senses restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgaraṃ ca tathā kuryārtsamyakchraraddhāsamanvitaḥ /
pare 'hni prātarvidhiva tpūrvavadviṣṇumarcayet //
meaning:
जागरं च तथा कुर्यार्त्सम्यक्छ्ररद्धासमन्वितः /
परे ऽह्नि प्रातर्विधिव त्पूर्ववद्विष्णुमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: one should also hold a night-vigil endowed with complete faith. / The next day, in the morning, one should worship Viṣṇu according to rule as before.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryāya pradātavyā pratimā dakṣaghiṇānvitā /
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā vibhave satyavāritam //
meaning:
आचार्याय प्रदातव्या प्रतिमा दक्षघिणान्विता /
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या विभवे सत्यवारितम् //
text_mt: The image, accompanied by a priestly gift, must be given to the preceptor. / One should feed brāhmaṇas according to one's capacity, unstintingly if wealth permits.

sanskrit_iast:
tiladānaṃ prakurvīta yathāśaktyā samāhitaḥ /
kuryādrangau ca vidhivatilahomaṃ vicakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
तिलदानं प्रकुर्वीत यथाशक्त्या समाहितः /
कुर्याद्रन्गौ च विधिवतिलहोमं विचक्षिणः //
text_mt: Composed in mind, one should give a gift of sesame seeds according to one's ability. / In the sacrificial arena, the wise man should perform a fire oblation with sesame seeds according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyak lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam /
iha bhuktvā mahābhogānputraghapautraghasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा नरः सम्यक् लक्ष्मीनारायणव्रतम् /
इह भुक्त्वा महाभोगान्पुत्रघपौत्रघसमन्वितः //
text_mt: A person having thus properly performed the observance of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, / enjoying great pleasures here [in this world] accompanied by sons and grandsons,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kulāyutasamanvitaḥ /
prayāti viṣṇubhavanaṃ yogināmapi durlabham //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne māgaśīrṣapaurṇimāyāṃ lakṣaghmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः कुलायुतसमन्वितः /
प्रयाति विष्णुभवनं योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे व्रताख्याने मागशीर्षपौर्णिमायां लक्षघ्मीनारायणव्रतं नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
freed from all sins and accompanied by ten thousand of his lineage, / goes to the abode of Viṣṇu, difficult to attain even for yogins.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named The Observance of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa on the Full Moon of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the narration of observances in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhvajāropaṇasaṃjñitam /
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇuprīṇanakāraṇam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अन्यद्वूतं प्रवक्ष्यामि ध्वजारोपणसंज्ञितम् /
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं विष्णुप्रीणनकारणम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / I shall declare another observance, called the Erection of the Flag, / which removes all sins, yields merit, and causes the delight of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kuryādviṣṇubhavane dhvajāropaṇamuttamam /
saṃpūjyate vigniñcyādyaiḥ kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
यः कुर्याद्विष्णुभवने ध्वजारोपणमुत्तमम् /
संपूज्यते विग्निञ्च्याद्यैः किमन्यैर्बहुभाषितैः //
text_mt: Whoever performs the excellent erection of the flag in Viṣṇu's temple / is worshipped by Brahmā and the other gods; what need is there of saying much else?

sanskrit_iast:
hemabhārasahasraṃ tu yo dadāti kuṭumbine /
tatphalaṃ tulyamātraṃ syāddhūjāropaṇakarmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
हेमभारसहस्रं तु यो ददाति कुटुम्बिने /
तत्फलं तुल्यमात्रं स्याद्धूजारोपणकर्मणः //
text_mt: He who gives a thousand measures of gold to a householder— / that fruit is merely equal to the rite of erecting the flag.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajāropaṇatulyaṃ syādgaṅgāsnānamanuttamam /
athavā tulasūsevā śivaliṅgaprapūjanam //
meaning:
ध्वजारोपणतुल्यं स्याद्गङ्गास्नानमनुत्तमम् /
अथवा तुलसूसेवा शिवलिङ्गप्रपूजनम् //
text_mt: Bathing in the Gaṅgā, than which nothing is higher, / or attendance upon tulasī, or the worship of the liṅga of Śiva, would equal the erection of the flag.

sanskrit_iast:
aho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamaho 'pūrvamidaṃ dvija /
sarvapāpa haraṃ karma dhvajāgopaṇasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
अहो ऽपूर्वमहो ऽपूर्वमहो ऽपूर्वमिदं द्विज /
सर्वपाप हरं कर्म ध्वजागोपणसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: Ah, wonderful! Ah, wonderful! Ah, wonderful is this rite, O twice-born one, / called the erection of the flag, which removes all sins!

sanskrit_iast:
santi vai yāni kāryāṇi dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi /
tāni sarvāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama //
meaning:
सन्ति वै यानि कार्याणि ध्वजारोपणकर्मणि /
तानि सर्वाणि वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व गदतो मम //
text_mt: Whatever duties there are in the rite of erecting the flag, / all of them I shall declare; listen to me speaking.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikasya site pakṣaghe daśamyāṃ prayato naraḥ /
snānaṃ kuryātprayatnena dantadhāvanapūrvakam //
meaning:
कार्तिकस्य सिते पक्षघे दशम्यां प्रयतो नरः /
स्नानं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: On the tenth day in the bright half of Kārtika, a restrained man / should diligently take a bath after first cleaning his teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāśī brahmacārī ca svapennārāyaṇaṃ smaran /
dhautāmbaradharaḥ śuddho vipro nārāyaṇāgrataḥ //
meaning:
एकाशी ब्रह्मचारी च स्वपेन्नारायणं स्मरन् /
धौताम्बरधरः शुद्धो विप्रो नारायणाग्रतः //
text_mt: Eating once a day and celibate, wearing washed clothes, / pure, the brāhmaṇa should sleep before Nārāyaṇa, remembering Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvācamya yathāvidhi /
nityakarmāṇi nirvartya paścādviṣṇuṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय स्नात्वाचम्य यथाविधि /
नित्यकर्माणि निर्वर्त्य पश्चाद्विष्णुं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Then, having risen in the morning, bathed, and sipped water according to rule, / and having performed the daily duties, he should thereafter worship Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhdaṃ kṛtvā ca svastivācanam /
nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dhvajāropaṇakarmaṇi //
meaning:
चतुर्भिर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्ध्दं कृत्वा च स्वस्तिवाचनम् /
नान्दीश्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत ध्वजारोपणकर्मणि //
text_mt: Having performed the recitation of auspicious blessings together with four brāhmaṇas, / he should perform the nāndīśrāddha in the rite of erecting the flag.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajastambho ca gāyatryā prokṣaghayedvastrasaṃyutau /
sūryaṃ ca vainateyaṃ ca himāṃśuṃ tatparor'cayet //
meaning:
ध्वजस्तम्भो च गायत्र्या प्रोक्षघयेद्वस्त्रसंयुतौ /
सूर्यं च वैनतेयं च हिमांशुं तत्परोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: He should sprinkle the two flagstaffs, draped with cloth, with the gāyatrī, / and thereafter worship the Sun, Garuḍa, and the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātāraṃ ca vidhātāraṃ pūjayeddhajadaṇḍake /
haridrākṣaghatagandhādyaiḥ śuklapuṣpairviśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
धातारं च विधातारं पूजयेद्धजदण्डके /
हरिद्राक्षघतगन्धाद्यैः शुक्लपुष्पैर्विशेषतः //
text_mt: And on the flagstaff he should worship Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ / with turmeric, unbroken rice, fragrant perfumes, and other offerings, especially with white flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gocarmamātraghaṃ tu sthaṇḍilaṃ copalipya vai /
ādhāyāngiṃ svagṛhyottyā hyājyabhāgādikaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
ततो गोचर्ममात्रघं तु स्थण्डिलं चोपलिप्य वै /
आधायान्गिं स्वगृह्योत्त्या ह्याज्यभागादिकं क्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, having smeared a sacrificial ground measuring a cow-hide, / having established the fire according to the precepts of his own domestic ritual manual, [and offered] the portions of clarified butter and so forth in order,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyātpāyasaṃ caiva sājyamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
prathamaṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ viṣṇornukamirāvatīm //
meaning:
जुहुयात्पायसं चैव साज्यमष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
प्रथमं पौरुषं सूक्तं विष्णोर्नुकमिरावतीम् //
text_mt: he should offer one hundred and eight oblations of milk-rice mixed with clarified butter, / first reciting the Puruṣasūkta, then 'viṣṇor nu kam', and the Irāvatī [hymn].

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca vainateyāya svāhe tyaṣṭāhutīstathā /
somo dhenumudutyaṃ ca juhuyācca tato dvija //
meaning:
ततश्च वैनतेयाय स्वाहे त्यष्टाहुतीस्तथा /
सोमो धेनुमुदुत्यं च जुहुयाच्च ततो द्विज //
text_mt: Then, uttering 'svāhā to the son of Vinatā', he should likewise offer eight oblations, / and then, O twice-born one, offer with 'somo dhenum' and 'ud u tyam'.

sanskrit_iast:
sauramantrāñjapettaghatra śāntisūtkāni śaktitaḥ /
rātraghau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādupakaṇṭhaṃ hareḥ śucuḥ //
meaning:
सौरमन्त्राञ्जपेत्तघत्र शान्तिसूत्कानि शक्तितः /
रात्रघौ जागरणं कुर्यादुपकण्ठं हरेः शुचुः //
text_mt: He should recite the solar mantras there and the hymns of pacification according to his capacity; / pure, he should keep a night-vigil near Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca /
gandhapuṣpādibhirdevamarcayetpūrvavatkramāt //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय नित्यकर्म समाप्य च /
गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्देवमर्चयेत्पूर्ववत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, having risen in the morning and completed his daily duties, / he should worship the god in order with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and other offerings as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tato maṅgalavādyaiśca sūktapāṭhaiśca śaubhanam /
nṛtyaiśca ratotraghapaṭhanairnayedviṣṇavālaye dhvajam //
meaning:
ततो मङ्गलवाद्यैश्च सूक्तपाठैश्च शौभनम् /
नृत्यैश्च रतोत्रघपठनैर्नयेद्विष्णवालये ध्वजम् //
text_mt: Then, with auspicious musical instruments, recitations of Vedic hymns, / dances, and recitations of hymns of praise, he should carry the splendid flag to Viṣṇu's temple.

sanskrit_iast:
devasya dvāradeśe vā śikhare vā mudānvitaḥ /
susthuraḥ sthāpayedvipra dhvajaṃ sastambhasaṃyutam //
meaning:
देवस्य द्वारदेशे वा शिखरे वा मुदान्वितः /
सुस्थुरः स्थापयेद्विप्र ध्वजं सस्तम्भसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Filled with joy, O brāhmaṇa, he should firmly erect / the flag together with its staff, either at the temple's gateway or on its pinnacle.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpāghakṣatairddevaṃ dhūpadīparmanoharaiḥ /
bhakṣaghyabhojyādisaṃyuktairnaivedyaiśca hariṃ yajet //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाघक्षतैर्द्देवं धूपदीपर्मनोहरैः /
भक्षघ्यभोज्यादिसंयुक्तैर्नैवेद्यैश्च हरिं यजेत् //
text_mt: He should worship the god Hari with fragrant perfumes, flowers, unbroken rice, captivating incense and lamps, / and with food-offerings consisting of edible pastries, cooked dishes, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ devālaye sthāpya śobhanaṃ dhvajamuttamam /
pradakṣaghiṇamanuvrajya stotraghametadudūrayet //
meaning:
एवं देवालये स्थाप्य शोभनं ध्वजमुत्तमम् /
प्रदक्षघिणमनुव्रज्य स्तोत्रघमेतदुदूरयेत् //
text_mt: Having thus erected the auspicious and excellent flag in the god's abode, / and having walked circumambulating it, he should utter this hymn of praise:

sanskrit_iast:
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana /
namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja //
meaning:
नमस्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन /
नमस्ते ऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुष पूर्वज //
text_mt: "Homage to you, lotus-eyed one! Homage to you, creator of the universe! / Homage be to you, Hṛṣīkeśa, supreme Puruṣa, the first-born!

sanskrit_iast:
yenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭitam /
layameṣyati yatraivaṃ taṃ prapanno 'smi keśavam //
meaning:
येनेदमखिलं जातं यत्र सर्वं प्रतिष्टितम् /
लयमेष्यति यत्रैवं तं प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि केशवम् //
text_mt: To him by whom this whole [universe] was born, in whom everything is established, / and into whom it shall dissolve—to that Keśava I have surrendered.

sanskrit_iast:
na jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ yasya brahmādayaḥ surāḥ /
yoginoyaṃ na paśyanti taṃ vandaṃ jñānarupuṇam //
meaning:
न जानन्ति परं भावं यस्य ब्रह्मादयः सुराः /
योगिनोयं न पश्यन्ति तं वन्दं ज्ञानरुपुणम् //
text_mt: Whose highest nature Brahmā and the other gods do not know, / whom yogins do not behold—to him whose form is knowledge, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣantu yannābhirdyairmūrddhā yasya caiva hi /
pādo 'bhūdyasya pṛthivī taṃ vande viśvarupiṇam //
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षन्तु यन्नाभिर्द्यैर्मूर्द्धा यस्य चैव हि /
पादो ऽभूद्यस्य पृथिवी तं वन्दे विश्वरुपिणम् //
text_mt: Whose navel is the intermediate space, whose head is heaven itself, / whose feet became the earth—to him whose form is the universe, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śrotre diśaḥ sarvā yaccakṣurdinakṛcajchaśī /
ṛksāmayajupī yena taṃ vande brahrarupiṇam //
meaning:
यस्य श्रोत्रे दिशः सर्वा यच्चक्षुर्दिनकृचज्छशी /
ऋक्सामयजुपी येन तं वन्दे ब्रह्ररुपिणम् //
text_mt: Whose ears are all the directions, whose eyes are the sun and the moon, / by whom exist the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajur [Vedas]—to him whose form is Brahman, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmukhādvāhmaṇā jātā yadvāhorabhavannṛpāḥ /
vaiśyā yasyo ruto jātāḥ padbhaghyāṃ śūdro vyajāyata //
meaning:
यन्मुखाद्वाह्मणा जाता यद्वाहोरभवन्नृपाः /
वैश्या यस्यो रुतो जाताः पद्भघ्यां शूद्रो व्यजायत //
text_mt: From whose mouth brāhmaṇas were born, from whose arms were kings, / the vaiśyas were born from his thighs, and from his feet the śūdra was born.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāsaṅgamamātragheṇa vadanti puruṣaṃ tvajam /
svabhāvavimalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam //
meaning:
मायासङ्गममात्रघेण वदन्ति पुरुषं त्वजम् /
स्वभावविमलं शुद्धं निर्विकारं निरञ्जनम् //
text_mt: They speak of the unborn Puruṣa merely through his contact with māyā, / who is by nature stainless, pure, changeless, and immaculate.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrabdhi śāyinaṃ devamanantamaparājitam /
sadbhaktavatsalaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhaktigamyaṃ namāmyaham //
meaning:
क्षीरब्धि शायिनं देवमनन्तमपराजितम् /
सद्भक्तवत्सलं विष्णुं भक्तिगम्यं नमाम्यहम् //
text_mt: The god who reclines on the milk ocean, the infinite, unconquered, / affectionate toward true devotees, attainable through devotion—to Viṣṇu I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tanmātrāṇīṃndriyāṇi ca /
sūkṣmāsūkṣyāṇi yenāsaṃstaṃ vande sarvatomukham //
meaning:
पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि तन्मात्राणींन्द्रियाणि च /
सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्याणि येनासंस्तं वन्दे सर्वतोमुखम् //
text_mt: By whom the elements beginning with earth, the subtle elements, and the sense-organs, / both subtle and gross, came into being—to that all-facing one I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvahya paramaṃ dhāma sarvalokottamottamam /
nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmaṃ praṇato 'sti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
यद्वह्य परमं धाम सर्वलोकोत्तमोत्तमम् /
निर्गुणं परमं सूक्ष्मं प्रणतो ऽस्ति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: To that supreme abode of his, highest of all worlds, / devoid of qualities, transcendent, and subtle, I bow down again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvatobāhumīśvaram /.
yamāmananti yogāndrāḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam //
meaning:
अविकारमजं शुद्धं सर्वतोबाहुमीश्वरम् /.
यमामनन्ति योगान्द्राः सर्वकारणकारणम् //
text_mt: The changeless, unborn, pure, lord with arms on all sides, / whom the lords of yoga declare to be the cause of all causes.

sanskrit_iast:
yo devaḥ sarvabhūtānāmantarātmā jaganmayaḥ /
nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu //
meaning:
यो देवः सर्वभूतानामन्तरात्मा जगन्मयः /
निर्गुणः परमात्मा च स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु //
text_mt: The god who is the inner self of all beings, composed of the universe, / devoid of qualities and the supreme self—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me!

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayastho 'pi dūrastho māyayā mohitātmanām /
jñānināṃ sarvago yastu sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu //
meaning:
हृदयस्थो ऽपि दूरस्थो मायया मोहितात्मनाम् /
ज्ञानिनां सर्वगो यस्तु स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु //
text_mt: Though residing in the heart, he is far away to those whose minds are deluded by māyā, / but omnipresent to the wise—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me!

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhireva ca /
hūyate ca punardvātārthaṃbhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ pratīdatu //
meaning:
चतुर्भिश्च चतुर्भिश्च द्वाभ्यां पञ्चभिरेव च /
हूयते च पुनर्द्वातार्थंभ्यां स मे विष्णुः प्रतीदतु //
text_mt: He to whom offerings are made with four, with four, with two, with five, / and again with two [syllables]—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me!

sanskrit_iast:
jñānināṃ karmiṇāṃ caiva tathā bhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām /
gatidātā viśvamṛgyaḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasūdatu //
meaning:
ज्ञानिनां कर्मिणां चैव तथा भक्तिमतां नृणाम् /
गतिदाता विश्वमृग्यः स मे विष्णुः प्रसूदतु //
text_mt: The giver of the goal to men of knowledge, men of action, / and those endowed with devotion, sought by the whole universe—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me!

sanskrit_iast:
jagaddhitārthaṃ ye dehā dhriyante līlayā hareḥ /
tānarcayanti vibudhāḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu //
meaning:
जगद्धितार्थं ये देहा ध्रियन्ते लीलया हरेः /
तानर्चयन्ति विबुधाः स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु //
text_mt: The bodies assumed in sport by Hari for the welfare of the world, / which the wise revere—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me!"

sanskrit_iast:
yamāmanantive santaḥ saccidānandavigraham /
nirguṇaṃ ca guṇādhāraṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu //
meaning:
यमामनन्तिवे सन्तः सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहम् /
निर्गुणं च गुणाधारं स मे विष्णुः प्रसीदतु //
text_mt: Whom the virtuous declare to be the embodiment of existence, consciousness, and bliss, / devoid of qualities yet the support of all qualities—may that Viṣṇu be pleased with me.

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutvā namedviṣṇuṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca prapūjayet /
ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścāddakṣiṇācchādanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
इति स्तुत्वा नमेद्विष्णुं ब्राह्मणांश्च प्रपूजयेत् /
आचार्यं पूजयेत्पश्चाद्दक्षिणाच्छादनादिभिः //
text_mt: Having thus praised him, he should bow to Viṣṇu and worship the brahmins; / then he should worship the teacher with gifts of honorarium, garments, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā bhakti bhāvasamanvitaḥ /
putramatrikalatrādyaiḥ svayaṃ ca saha bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या भक्ति भावसमन्वितः /
पुत्रमत्रिकलत्राद्यैः स्वयं च सह बन्धुभिः //
text_mt: Endowed with a disposition of devotion, he should feed the brahmins according to his means, / and himself, along with his sons, friends, wife, and kinsmen,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvīta pāraṇaṃ vipra nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ /
yastvetatkarma kurvīta dhvajāropaṇamuttamam /
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कुर्वीत पारणं विप्र नारायणपरायणः /
यस्त्वेतत्कर्म कुर्वीत ध्वजारोपणमुत्तमम् /
तस्य पुण्यफलं वक्ष्ये शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: devoted to Nārāyaṇa, should break his fast, O brahmin. / Whoever performs this supreme act of hoisting a flag, / I shall proclaim the fruit of his merit; listen with an attentive mind.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭo dhvajasya viprendra yāvaccalati vāyunā /
tāvanti pāpajālāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पटो ध्वजस्य विप्रेन्द्र यावच्चलति वायुना /
तावन्ति पापजालानि नश्यन्त्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: As long as the cloth of the flag flutters in the wind, O foremost of brahmins, / so long do whole webs of sins perish; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ /
dhvajaṃ viṣṇugṛhe kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः /
ध्वजं विष्णुगृहे कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: Whether burdened with mortal sins or laden with all manner of sins, / by setting up a flag in Viṣṇu’s temple, one is liberated from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvaddināni tiṣṭeta dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dvija /
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi harisārupyamaśnute //
meaning:
यावद्दिनानि तिष्टेत ध्वजो विष्णुगृहे द्विज /
तावद्युगसहस्राणि हरिसारुप्यमश्नुते //
text_mt: For as many days as the flag remains in Viṣṇu’s temple, O twice-born one, / for that many thousands of yugas he attains conformity of form with Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
āropitaṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye 'bhinandanti dhārmikāḥ /
te 'pi sarve pramucyante mahāpātakakoṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
आरोपितं ध्वजं दृष्ट्वा ये ऽभिनन्दन्ति धार्मिकाः /
ते ऽपि सर्वे प्रमुच्यन्ते महापातककोटिभिः //
text_mt: Those righteous people who, seeing a hoisted flag, rejoice in it, / they too are all delivered from crores of mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast:
āropito dhvajo viṣṇugṛhe dhunvanpaṭaṃ svakam /
kartuḥ sarvāṇi pāpāni dhunoti nimiṣārddhataḥ //
meaning:
आरोपितो ध्वजो विष्णुगृहे धुन्वन्पटं स्वकम् /
कर्तुः सर्वाणि पापानि धुनोति निमिषार्द्धतः //
text_mt: A flag hoisted in Viṣṇu’s temple, as it waves its cloth, / dispels all the performer's sins within half a twinkling of an eye.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvā ropya gṛhe viṣṇordhvajaṃ nityamupācaret /
sa devayānena divaṃ yātīva sumatirnṛpaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne dhvajāropaṇannāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यस्त्वा रोप्य गृहे विष्णोर्ध्वजं नित्यमुपाचरेत् /
स देवयानेन दिवं यातीव सुमतिर्नृपः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे व्रताख्याने ध्वजारोपणन्नामैकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever, having hoisted a flag in Viṣṇu’s house, tends to it constantly, / goes to heaven by the path of the gods, like the wise King Sumati.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, named 'The Hoisting of the Flag', in the discourse on observances in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga /
sarvakarmavariṣṭaṃ ca tvayoktaṃ dhvajadhāraṇam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारग /
सर्वकर्मवरिष्टं च त्वयोक्तं ध्वजधारणम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / O Lord, knower of all righteousness, conversant with the meaning of all scriptures, / the raising of a flag has been declared by you to be the foremost among all religious acts.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vai sumatirnāma dhvajāropaparo mune /
tvayoktastasya caritaṃ vistareṇa mamādiśa //
meaning:
यस्तु वै सुमतिर्नाम ध्वजारोपपरो मुने /
त्वयोक्तस्तस्य चरितं विस्तरेण ममादिश //
text_mt: He who was named Sumati, devoted to hoisting the flag, O sage, / and was mentioned by you—explain his story to me in full.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ puṇyamitihāsaṃ purātanamam /
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ mahyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
शृणुष्वैकमनाः पुण्यमितिहासं पुरातनमम् /
ब्रह्मणा कथितं मह्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Listen with single-minded focus to this ancient, sacred history / told to me by Brahmā, which destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpurā kṛtayuge sumatirnāma bhūpatiḥ /
somavaṃśodbhavaḥ śrīmānsatpadvīpaikanāyakaḥ //
meaning:
आसीत्पुरा कृतयुगे सुमतिर्नाम भूपतिः /
सोमवंशोद्भवः श्रीमान्सत्पद्वीपैकनायकः //
text_mt: In ancient times, in the Kṛta Yuga, there was a king named Sumati, / born of the Lunar dynasty, illustrious, the sole ruler of the seven continents,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmātmā satyasaṃpannaḥ śucivaṃśyo 'tithipriyaḥ /
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvasaṃpadvibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मात्मा सत्यसंपन्नः शुचिवंश्यो ऽतिथिप्रियः /
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नः सर्वसंपद्विभूषितः //
text_mt: righteous-souled, endowed with truth, of pure lineage, fond of guests, / endowed with all auspicious marks, and adorned with all forms of prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā harikathāsevī haripūjāparāyaṇaḥ /
haribhaktiparāṇāṃ ca śuśrūṣurnirahṝṅkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सदा हरिकथासेवी हरिपूजापरायणः /
हरिभक्तिपराणां च शुश्रूषुर्निरहॄङ्कृतिः //
text_mt: always devoted to hearing stories of Hari, intent on worshipping Hari, / wishing to serve those devoted to Hari, free from egoism,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyapūjārato nityaṃ samadarśī guṇānvitaḥ /
sarvabhūtahitaḥ śāntaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kīrtimāṃstathā //
meaning:
पूज्यपूजारतो नित्यं समदर्शी गुणान्वितः /
सर्वभूतहितः शान्तः कृतज्ञः कीर्तिमांस्तथा //
text_mt: constantly engaged in worshipping the venerable, seeing all with an equal eye, endowed with virtues, / benevolent to all beings, tranquil, grateful, and renowned.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryā mahābhāgā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā /
pativratā patiprāṇā nāmrā satyamatirmune //
meaning:
तस्य भार्या महाभागा सर्वलक्षणसंयुता /
पतिव्रता पतिप्राणा नाम्रा सत्यमतिर्मुने //
text_mt: His wife, O sage, was highly fortunate, endowed with all auspicious marks, / devoted to her husband, holding her husband as her very breath, named Satyamatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tādubhau dampatū nityaṃ haripūjāparāyaṇau /
jātismarau mahābhāgau satyajñau satparāyaṇau //
meaning:
तादुभौ दम्पतू नित्यं हरिपूजापरायणौ /
जातिस्मरौ महाभागौ सत्यज्ञौ सत्परायणौ //
text_mt: Both husband and wife were constantly intent on the worship of Hari; / highly fortunate, possessing memory of previous births, knowers of truth, dedicated to the good.

sanskrit_iast:
annadānaratau nityaṃ jaladānaparāyaṇau /
taḍāgārāmavaprādau nasaṃkhyātānvitenatuḥ //
meaning:
अन्नदानरतौ नित्यं जलदानपरायणौ /
तडागारामवप्रादौ नसंख्यातान्वितेनतुः //
text_mt: Always devoted to giving food, intent on providing water, / they laid out countless tanks, gardens, ramparts, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu satyamatirnityaṃ śucirviṣṇugṛhe satī /
nṛtyatyatyantasantuṣṭā manojñā sañjuvādinī //
meaning:
सा तु सत्यमतिर्नित्यं शुचिर्विष्णुगृहे सती /
नृत्यत्यत्यन्तसन्तुष्टा मनोज्ञा सञ्जुवादिनी //
text_mt: And that virtuous Satyamatī, pure, highly delighted, charming, / and truthful in speech, danced continually in Viṣṇu’s temple.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi rājā mahābhāgo dvādaśīddhādaśīdine /
dhvajamāropayatyeva manojñaṃ bahuvistaram //
meaning:
सो ऽपि राजा महाभागो द्वादशीद्धादशीदिने /
ध्वजमारोपयत्येव मनोज्ञं बहुविस्तरम् //
text_mt: That highly fortunate king, too, on every twelfth lunar day, / would hoist a beautiful, vast flag.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hariparaṃ nityaṃ rājānaṃ dharmakovidam /
primāṃ matyamatiṃ cāmya devā api sadāstuvan //
meaning:
एवं हरिपरं नित्यं राजानं धर्मकोविदम् /
प्रिमां मत्यमतिं चाम्य देवा अपि सदास्तुवन् //
text_mt: Thus, even the gods always praised that king who was ever devoted to Hari and skilled in righteousness, / as well as his beloved Satyamatī.

sanskrit_iast:
triloke viśrutau jñātvā dampatī dharmako vidau /
āyayau bahubhiḥ śipyairdraṣṭukāmo vibhāṇḍakaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिलोके विश्रुतौ ज्ञात्वा दम्पती धर्मको विदौ /
आययौ बहुभिः शिप्यैर्द्रष्टुकामो विभाण्डकः //
text_mt: Knowing the couple to be renowned throughout the three worlds and skilled in righteousness, / Vibhāṇḍaka arrived, accompanied by many disciples, desiring to see them.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāyāntaṃ muniṃ śrutvā sa tu rājā vibhāṇḍakam /
pratyudyayau sapatnīkaḥ prajā bhirbahuvistaram //
meaning:
तमायान्तं मुनिं श्रुत्वा स तु राजा विभाण्डकम् /
प्रत्युद्ययौ सपत्नीकः प्रजा भिर्बहुविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Hearing that the sage Vibhāṇḍaka was arriving, the king, / accompanied by his wife and a vast multitude of subjects, went out to meet him.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtātithyakriyaṃ śāntaṃ kṛtāsanaparigraham /
nīcāsanasthito bhūyaḥ prāñjalirmunimabravīt //
meaning:
कृतातिथ्यक्रियं शान्तं कृतासनपरिग्रहम् /
नीचासनस्थितो भूयः प्राञ्जलिर्मुनिमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: When [the sage], serene, had received hospitality and had taken his seat, / [the king], seated on a lower seat, spoke to the sage with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
bhagavankṛtakṛtyo 'smiṃ tvadabhyāgamanena veṃ /
satāmāyamanaṃ santaṃ praśaṃsanti suravāvaham //
meaning:
राजोवाच
भगवन्कृतकृत्यो ऽस्मिं त्वदभ्यागमनेन वें /
सतामायमनं सन्तं प्रशंसन्ति सुरवावहम् //
text_mt: The king said: / O venerable one, I have fulfilled my life's purpose by your arrival; / the wise praise the coming of virtuous men as bringing welfare to all.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra syānmahatāṃ prema tatra syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ /
tejaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ putrā iti prahurvipaścitaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र स्यान्महतां प्रेम तत्र स्युः सर्वसम्पदः /
तेजः कीर्तिर्धनं पुत्रा इति प्रहुर्विपश्चितः //
text_mt: Where there is love from the great, there all prosperity resides— / splendour, fame, wealth, and sons—so the wise have declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vṛddhimupāyānti theyāṃsyanudinaṃ mune /
yatra santaḥ prakurvanti mahatīṃ karuṇāṃ prabho //
meaning:
तत्र वृद्धिमुपायान्ति थेयांस्यनुदिनं मुने /
यत्र सन्तः प्रकुर्वन्ति महतीं करुणां प्रभो //
text_mt: Auspicious blessings increase day by day, O sage, / wherever the virtuous bestow their great compassion, O master.

sanskrit_iast:
yo mṛrdhni dhāgyedūhyanmahatpādajalaṃ rajaḥ /
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu puṇyātmā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यो मृर्ध्नि धाग्येदूह्यन्महत्पादजलं रजः /
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु पुण्यात्मा नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: He who bears upon his head the water and dust from the feet of the great / has bathed in all the sacred fords; he is a meritorious soul, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mama putrāśca dārāśca saṃpattvayi samarpitāḥ /
māmājñāpaya viprendra kiṃ priyaṃ karavāṇi te //
meaning:
मम पुत्राश्च दाराश्च संपत्त्वयि समर्पिताः /
मामाज्ञापय विप्रेन्द्र किं प्रियं करवाणि ते //
text_mt: My sons, my wife, and my wealth are surrendered to you; / command me, O foremost of brahmins, what pleasing deed I may perform for you.

sanskrit_iast:
vinañcavanataṃ bhūpaṃ sa nirīkṣya munīśaavaraḥ /
spṛśaṣankareṇa taṃ prītyuvācātiharṣitaḥ //
meaning:
विनञ्चवनतं भूपं स निरीक्ष्य मुनीशअवरः /
स्पृशषन्करेण तं प्रीत्युवाचातिहर्षितः //
text_mt: Beholding the king bowed in humility, that lord among sages, / touching him with his hand, spoke with affectionate delight:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca
gajanyaduktaṃ bhavatā tatsarvaṃ tvatkulocitam /
vinayāvanataḥ sarvo bahuśreyo labhediha //
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच
गजन्यदुक्तं भवता तत्सर्वं त्वत्कुलोचितम् /
विनयावनतः सर्वो बहुश्रेयो लभेदिह //
text_mt: The sage said: / O king, all that has been said by you is worthy of your lineage; / anyone humble with modesty attains great welfare in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca nṛpasattama /
vinayāllabhate martyo durlabhaṃ kiṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मोक्षश्च नृपसत्तम /
विनयाल्लभते मर्त्यो दुर्लभं किं महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, O best of kings— / a mortal attains these through humility; what is hard to attain for noble souls?

sanskrit_iast:
prīto 'smi tava bhāpāla sanmārgaparivarttinaḥ /
svasti te satataṃ bhūyādyatpṛcchāmi taducyatām //
meaning:
प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव भापाल सन्मार्गपरिवर्त्तिनः /
स्वस्ति ते सततं भूयाद्यत्पृच्छामि तदुच्यताम् //
text_mt: I am pleased with you, O protector of the earth, walking in the right path. / May well-being always attend you; tell me what I ask.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā bahuvidhāḥ santi hastuṣṭividhāyikāḥ /
tāsu nityaṃ dhvajārope varttse tvaṃ sadodyataḥ //
meaning:
पूजा बहुविधाः सन्ति हस्तुष्टिविधायिकाः /
तासु नित्यं ध्वजारोपे वर्त्त्से त्वं सदोद्यतः //
text_mt: There are many kinds of worship that bring delight to Hari; / among them, you are ever intent and constantly engaged in hoisting a flag.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāpi tava sādhvīyaṃ nityaṃ nṛtyaparāyaṇā /
kimarthametadvṛttāntaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
भार्यापि तव साध्वीयं नित्यं नृत्यपरायणा /
किमर्थमेतद्वृत्तान्तं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: This virtuous wife of yours, too, is constantly devoted to dancing. / You should relate to me this matter as it truly happened, and why.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
śṛṇuṣva bhagavansarvaṃ yatpṛcchasi vadāmi tat /
āścaryabhūtaṃ lokānāmāvayoścaritaṃ tviha //
meaning:
राजोवाच
शृणुष्व भगवन्सर्वं यत्पृच्छसि वदामि तत् /
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकानामावयोश्चरितं त्विह //
text_mt: The king said: / Listen, O lord; I shall tell you all that you ask, / which is a wondrous account of both of us in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro mālinirnāma sattama /
kumārgaganirato nityaṃ sarvalokāhike rataḥ //
meaning:
अहमासं पुरा शूद्रो मालिनिर्नाम सत्तम /
कुमार्गगनिरतो नित्यं सर्वलोकाहिके रतः //
text_mt: In a former birth I was a Śūdra named Mālin, O best of men, / always walking evil paths, intent on harming all people,

sanskrit_iast:
piśuno dharmavidveṣī devadravyāpahārakaḥ /
godhnaśca brahmahā cauraḥ sarvaprāṇivadhe rataḥ //
meaning:
पिशुनो धर्मविद्वेषी देवद्रव्यापहारकः /
गोध्नश्च ब्रह्महा चौरः सर्वप्राणिवधे रतः //
text_mt: slanderous, hating righteousness, a plunderer of deities' property, / a cow-killer, a brahmin-slayer, a thief, bent on killing all living creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ niṣṭhuravaktā ca pāpī veśyāparāyaṇaḥ /
evaṃ sthitaḥ kiyatkālamanāhatyaṃ mahadṛcaḥ //
meaning:
नित्यं निष्ठुरवक्ता च पापी वेश्यापरायणः /
एवं स्थितः कियत्कालमनाहत्यं महदृचः //
text_mt: habitually speaking harsh words, sinful, devoted to prostitutes. / Remaining thus for some time, disregarding the words of the great,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabandhuparityakto duḥkhī vanamupāgataḥ /
mṛgamāṃsāśano nityaṃ tathā pānthāvillampakaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वबन्धुपरित्यक्तो दुःखी वनमुपागतः /
मृगमांसाशनो नित्यं तथा पान्थाविल्लम्पकः //
text_mt: abandoned by all relatives and miserable, I went to the forest, / constantly eating the meat of deer and plundering wayfarers.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākī duḥkhabahulo nyavasannirjane vane /
ekadā kṣutpariśrānto nidāghārttaḥ pipāsitaḥ //
meaning:
एकाकी दुःखबहुलो न्यवसन्निर्जने वने /
एकदा क्षुत्परिश्रान्तो निदाघार्त्तः पिपासितः //
text_mt: Solitary and laden with sorrow, I lived in an uninhabited forest. / Once, exhausted by hunger, afflicted by the heat of summer, and thirsty,

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇaṃ devālayaṃ viṣṇorapaśyaṃ vijane vane /
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ tatsamīpe mahatsaraḥ //
meaning:
जीर्णं देवालयं विष्णोरपश्यं विजने वने /
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं तत्समीपे महत्सरः //
text_mt: I saw a ruined temple of Viṣṇu in the desolate forest, / and nearby a large lake teeming with swans and wild ducks,

sanskrit_iast:
paryantavanapuṣpaughacchāditaṃ tanmunīśvara /
apibaṃ tatra pānīyaṃ tattīre vigataśramaḥ //
meaning:
पर्यन्तवनपुष्पौघच्छादितं तन्मुनीश्वर /
अपिबं तत्र पानीयं तत्तीरे विगतश्रमः //
text_mt: covered with a mass of wild forest flowers, O lord of sages. / I drank water there, and on its bank, my fatigue was dispelled.

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni jagdhvā śīrṇāni svayaṃ kṣucca nivāritā /
tasmiñjīrṇīlaye viṣṇonarnivāsaṃ kṛtakavānaham //
meaning:
फलानि जग्ध्वा शीर्णानि स्वयं क्षुच्च निवारिता /
तस्मिञ्जीर्णीलये विष्णोनर्निवासं कृतकवानहम् //
text_mt: Eating fallen fruits, my hunger too was appeased; / and in that ruined abode of Viṣṇu, I took up my residence.

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇasphuṭitasaṃdhānaṃ tasya nityamakāriṣam /
parṇaistṛṇaiśca kāṣṭhaighair gṛhaṃ samyak prakalpitam //
meaning:
जीर्णस्फुटितसंधानं तस्य नित्यमकारिषम् /
पर्णैस्तृणैश्च काष्ठैघैर् गृहं सम्यक् प्रकल्पितम् //
text_mt: I constantly repaired whatever was broken and dilapidated in it; / with leaves, grasses, and piles of timber, I fashioned a dwelling properly.

sanskrit_iast:
svasurārāthaṃ tu tadbhamirmayā litpā munīśvara /
tatrāhaṃ vyādhavṛttistho hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān //
meaning:
स्वसुराराथं तु तद्भमिर्मया लित्पा मुनीश्वर /
तत्राहं व्याधवृत्तिस्थो हत्वा बहुविधान्मृगान् //
text_mt: For my own ease, O lord of sages, its floor was plastered by me. / There, pursuing the profession of a hunter, killing various kinds of deer,

sanskrit_iast:
ājīvaṃ vartaya nnityaṃ varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiḥ sthitaḥ /
atheyamāgatā sādhvī vindhyadeśasamudbhavā //
meaning:
आजीवं वर्तय न्नित्यं वर्षाणां विंशतिः स्थितः /
अथेयमागता साध्वी विन्ध्यदेशसमुद्भवा //
text_mt: I stayed for twenty years, continually maintaining my livelihood. / Then this virtuous woman arrived, born in the Vindhya region,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādakulajā viprā nānmā khyātā/ñavakokilā /
bandhuvargaparityaktā duḥkhitā jīrṇavigrahā //
meaning:
निषादकुलजा विप्रा नान्मा ख्याता/ञवकोकिला /
बन्धुवर्गपरित्यक्ता दुःखिता जीर्णविग्रहा //
text_mt: born of a Niṣāda family, O brāhmaṇa, known by the name Vakakokilā, / abandoned by her relatives, miserable, with an emaciated body,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣuttṛḍgharmapariśrāntā śocantī svakṛtaṃ hyagham /
daivayogākatsamāyātābhramantī vijane vane //
meaning:
क्षुत्तृड्घर्मपरिश्रान्ता शोचन्ती स्वकृतं ह्यघम् /
दैवयोगाकत्समायाताभ्रमन्ती विजने वने //
text_mt: exhausted by hunger, thirst, and heat, grieving indeed for the evil deeds she had done, / having arrived by the turn of fate, wandering in the solitary forest,

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣmatāpārdditā bāhye svānte cādhinipūḍitā /
imāṃ duḥkhārditāṃ dṛṣṭvā jātā me vipulā dayā //
meaning:
ग्रीष्मतापार्द्दिता बाह्ये स्वान्ते चाधिनिपूडिता /
इमां दुःखार्दितां दृष्ट्वा जाता मे विपुला दया //
text_mt: afflicted externally by the heat of summer and tormented internally by mental anguish. / Seeing her tormented by sorrow, immense compassion arose in me.

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ mayā jalaṃ cāsyai māṃsaṃ vanyaphalāni ca /
gataśramātviyaṃ brahmanmayā pṛṣṭā yathā tayam //
meaning:
दत्तं मया जलं चास्यै मांसं वन्यफलानि च /
गतश्रमात्वियं ब्रह्मन्मया पृष्टा यथा तयम् //
text_mt: Water, meat, and wild fruits were given to her by me. / When her exhaustion was gone, O brāhmaṇa, she was asked by me as to the truth of the matter.

sanskrit_iast:
avedayatsvavṛttāntaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmune /
nānmāvakokilā cāhaṃ niṣādakulasabhbhavā //
meaning:
अवेदयत्स्ववृत्तान्तं तच्छृणुष्व महामुने /
नान्मावकोकिला चाहं निषादकुलसभ्भवा //
text_mt: She related her own story; listen to that, O great sage: / 'I am Vakakokilā by name, born of a Niṣāda family,

sanskrit_iast:
dārukasya sutā cāhaṃ vindhyaparvatavāsinī /
parasvahāriṇī nityaṃ sadā paiśunyavādinī //
meaning:
दारुकस्य सुता चाहं विन्ध्यपर्वतवासिनी /
परस्वहारिणी नित्यं सदा पैशुन्यवादिनी //
text_mt: and the daughter of Dāruka, residing on the Vindhya mountain, / constantly taking the property of others, always speaking slander.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃścalūtyevamuktvā tu bandhuvargaiḥ samujjhitā /
kiyatkālaṃ tataḥ patyā bhṛtāhaṃ lokaninditā //
meaning:
पुंश्चलूत्येवमुक्त्वा तु बन्धुवर्गैः समुज्झिता /
कियत्कालं ततः पत्या भृताहं लोकनिन्दिता //
text_mt: Saying: "She is a wanton woman," I was cast out by my relatives. / Then for some time, condemned by people, I was maintained by my husband.

sanskrit_iast:
daivātso 'pi gato lokaṃ yamasyātra vihāya mām /
kāntāre vijane caikā bhramantī duḥkhapīḍitā //
meaning:
दैवात्सो ऽपि गतो लोकं यमस्यात्र विहाय माम् /
कान्तारे विजने चैका भ्रमन्ती दुःखपीडिता //
text_mt: By fate, he too departed to the world of Yama, leaving me behind here. / Wandering alone in the solitary wild forest, afflicted with grief,

sanskrit_iast:
daivāttvatsavidhaṃ prātpā jīvitāhaṃ tvayādhunā /
ityevaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma mahyaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat //
meaning:
दैवात्त्वत्सविधं प्रात्पा जीविताहं त्वयाधुना /
इत्येवं स्वकृतं कर्म मह्यं सर्वं न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: by fate I arrived near you, and I have now been revived by you.' / In this way, she related to me all the deeds she had done.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devālaye tasmindamapatībhāvamāśritau /
sthitau varṣāṇi daśa ca āvāṃ māṃsaphalāśinau //
meaning:
ततो देवालये तस्मिन्दमपतीभावमाश्रितौ /
स्थितौ वर्षाणि दश च आवां मांसफलाशिनौ //
text_mt: Then, having assumed the status of husband and wife in that temple of the god, / eating meat and fruits, the two of us lived there for ten years.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā madyapānena pramattau nirbharaimune /
tatra devālaye rāghatrau muditau māṃsabhojanāt //
meaning:
एकदा मद्यपानेन प्रमत्तौ निर्भरैमुने /
तत्र देवालये राघत्रौ मुदितौ मांसभोजनात् //
text_mt: Once, O sage, deeply intoxicated by drinking wine, / joyful from eating meat, at night in that temple of the god,

sanskrit_iast:
tanuvastrāparijñānau nṛtyaṃ cakṛva mohitau /
prārabdhakarma bhogāntamāvāṃ yugapadāgatau //
meaning:
तनुवस्त्रापरिज्ञानौ नृत्यं चकृव मोहितौ /
प्रारब्धकर्म भोगान्तमावां युगपदागतौ //
text_mt: unconscious of our clothes, bewitched, we both danced. / We both reached the end of the experiencing of our commenced karma simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast:
yamadūtāstadāyātāḥ pāśahastā bhayaṅkarāḥ /
netumāvāṃ nṛtyaratau sudhorāṃ yamayātanām //
meaning:
यमदूतास्तदायाताः पाशहस्ता भयङ्कराः /
नेतुमावां नृत्यरतौ सुधोरां यमयातनाम् //
text_mt: Then the messengers of Yama arrived, fearful, with nooses in hand, / to take us both, delighting in dance, to the exceedingly terrible torment of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānkarmaṇā mama mānada /
devāvasathasaṃskārasaṃjñitena kṛtena naḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्कर्मणा मम मानद /
देवावसथसंस्कारसंज्ञितेन कृतेन नः //
text_mt: Then, O respect-giver, the Blessed Lord was pleased with my deed, / which was performed by us under the name of renovating the temple of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
svadūtānprepayāmāsa svabhaktāvanatatparaḥ /
te dūtā devadevasya śaṅkhacakra gadādharāḥ //
meaning:
स्वदूतान्प्रेपयामास स्वभक्तावनतत्परः /
ते दूता देवदेवस्य शङ्खचक्र गदाधराः //
text_mt: Intent on protecting His own devotees, He sent His messengers. / Those messengers of the God of gods, holding the conch, discus, and mace,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasūryāsaṃkāśāḥ sarve cārucaturbhujāḥ /
kirīṭakuṇḍaladharā hāriṇo vanamālinaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रसूर्यासंकाशाः सर्वे चारुचतुर्भुजाः /
किरीटकुण्डलधरा हारिणो वनमालिनः //
text_mt: resembling a thousand suns, all having handsome four arms, / wearing diadems and earrings, charming, wearing forest garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
diśo vitimirā vipra kurvantaḥ svena tejasā /
bhayaṅkarānyāśahastāndaṃṣṭriṇo yamakiṅkarān //
meaning:
दिशो वितिमिरा विप्र कुर्वन्तः स्वेन तेजसा /
भयङ्करान्याशहस्तान्दंष्ट्रिणो यमकिङ्करान् //
text_mt: dispelling the darkness from the directions, O brāhmaṇa, with their own splendor, / to the terrifying, fanged servants of Yama with nooses in hand,

sanskrit_iast: āvayogrāhaṇe yattānṛcuḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning: आवयोग्राहणे यत्तानृचुः कृष्णपरायणाः //
text_mt: who were intent on seizing the two of us, those devoted to Kṛṣṇa spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇudūtā ūcuḥ
bho bho krūrā dūrācārā vivekaparivarjitāḥ /
muñcadhvametau niṣpāpau dampatī harivallabhau //
meaning:
विष्णुदूता ऊचुः
भो भो क्रूरा दूराचारा विवेकपरिवर्जिताः /
मुञ्चध्वमेतौ निष्पापौ दम्पती हरिवल्लभौ //
text_mt: The messengers of Viṣṇu said: / 'Ho, ho! Cruel ones, of wicked conduct, devoid of discernment, / release these two sinless ones, a husband and wife dear to Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
vivekastriṣu lokeṣu saṃpadāmādikāraṇam /
apāpe pāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyātpuruṣādhamam //
meaning:
विवेकस्त्रिषु लोकेषु संपदामादिकारणम् /
अपापे पापधीर्यस्तु तं विद्यात्पुरुषाधमम् //
text_mt: Discernment is the prime cause of prosperity in the three worlds. / But he who views the sinless as sinful, one should know him as the lowest of men.

sanskrit_iast: pāpe tvapāpadhīryastu taṃ vidyādadhamādhamam //
meaning: पापे त्वपापधीर्यस्तु तं विद्यादधमाधमम् //
text_mt: And he who views the sinful as sinless, one should know him as the lowest of the low!'

sanskrit_iast:
yamadūtā ūcuḥ
yuṣmābhiḥ satyamevoktaṃ kiṃ tvetau pāpisattamau /
yamena pāpino daṇḍyāstanneṣyāmo vayaṃ tvimau //
meaning:
यमदूता ऊचुः
युष्माभिः सत्यमेवोक्तं किं त्वेतौ पापिसत्तमौ /
यमेन पापिनो दण्ड्यास्तन्नेष्यामो वयं त्विमौ //
text_mt: The messengers of Yama said: / 'What you have said is indeed true, but these two are the greatest of sinners. / Sinners must be punished by Yama; therefore, we will take these two.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutipraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ /
dharmādharmaviveko 'yaṃ tanneṣyāmo yamāntikam //
meaning:
श्रुतिप्रणिहितो धर्मो ह्यधर्मस्तद्विपर्ययः /
धर्माधर्मविवेको ऽयं तन्नेष्यामो यमान्तिकम् //
text_mt: Dharma is what is enjoined by the scriptures, and adharma is its opposite. / This is the discernment of dharma and adharma; therefore, we will lead them to the presence of Yama.'

sanskrit_iast:
etactchuvātikupitā viṣṇudūtā mahaujasaḥ /
pratyūcūstānyamabhaṭānadharme dharmamāninaḥ //
meaning:
एतच्त्छुवातिकुपिता विष्णुदूता महौजसः /
प्रत्यूचूस्तान्यमभटानधर्मे धर्ममानिनः //
text_mt: Hearing this, the exceedingly mighty messengers of Viṣṇu became very angry, / and replied to those soldiers of Yama who considered adharma as dharma:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇadūtā ūcuḥ
aho kaṣṭaṃ dharmadṛśāmadharmaḥ spṛśate sabhām /
samyagvivekaśūnyānāṃ nidānaṃ hyāpadāṃ mahat //
meaning:
विष्णदूता ऊचुः
अहो कष्टं धर्मदृशामधर्मः स्पृशते सभाम् /
सम्यग्विवेकशून्यानां निदानं ह्यापदां महत् //
text_mt: The messengers of Viṣṇu said: / 'Alas, the tragedy! Adharma touches the assembly of those who perceive dharma. / For those utterly devoid of discernment, it is indeed the great source of disasters.

sanskrit_iast:
tarkāṇādyaviśeṣeṇa narakādhyakṣatāṃ gatāḥ /
yūyaṃ kimarthamadyāpi karttuṃ pāpāni sodyamāḥ //
meaning:
तर्काणाद्यविशेषेण नरकाध्यक्षतां गताः /
यूयं किमर्थमद्यापि कर्त्तुं पापानि सोद्यमाः //
text_mt: Having attained the directorship of hell through the lack of discrimination in reasoning and the like, / why are you, even today, eager to commit sins?

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmakṣayaparyantaṃ mahāpātakino 'pi ca /
tiṣṭanti narake ghore yāvaccandrārkatārakam //
meaning:
स्वकर्मक्षयपर्यन्तं महापातकिनो ऽपि च /
तिष्टन्ति नरके घोरे यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् //
text_mt: Even great sinners, until the exhaustion of their own karma, / stay in the terrible hell as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasaṃcitapāpānāmadṛṣṭvā niṣkṛtiṃ vṛthā /
kimarthaṃ pāpakarmāṇi kariṣye 'tha punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वसंचितपापानामदृष्ट्वा निष्कृतिं वृथा /
किमर्थं पापकर्माणि करिष्ये ऽथ पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Not seeing expiation for sins accumulated in the past, / why would one vainly commit sinful acts again and again?

sanskrit_iast:
śrutipraṇihito dharmaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
kintvābhyāṃ caritāndharmānpravakṣyāmo yathātatham //
meaning:
श्रुतिप्रणिहितो धर्मः सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः /
किन्त्वाभ्यां चरितान्धर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यामो यथातथम् //
text_mt: Dharma is enjoined by the scriptures—true, true, there is no doubt. / But we shall explain as it is the dharmas practiced by these two.

sanskrit_iast:
etau pāpavinirmuktau hariśuśrūṣaṇe ratau /
hariṇā trāyamāṇau ca muñcadhvamavilambitam //
meaning:
एतौ पापविनिर्मुक्तौ हरिशुश्रूषणे रतौ /
हरिणा त्रायमाणौ च मुञ्चध्वमविलम्बितम् //
text_mt: These two are free from sin, devoted to the service of Hari, / and are being protected by Hari. Release them without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā ca nartanaṃ cakre tathaiva dhvajaroṣaṇam /
antakāle viṣṇugṛhe tena niṣpāpatāṃ gatau //
meaning:
एषा च नर्तनं चक्रे तथैव ध्वजरोषणम् /
अन्तकाले विष्णुगृहे तेन निष्पापतां गतौ //
text_mt: She danced, and likewise raised a flag / at the time of death in the house of Viṣṇu; through that, they both attained sinlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
antakāle tu yannāma śrutvoktvāpi ca vai sakṛt /
labhate paramaṃ sthānaṃ kimu śūśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ //
meaning:
अन्तकाले तु यन्नाम श्रुत्वोक्त्वापि च वै सकृत् /
लभते परमं स्थानं किमु शूश्रूषणे रताः //
text_mt: Even at the time of death, having heard or spoken His name even once, / one attains the supreme place; how much more so those devoted to His service?

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ /./
kṛṣṇasevī naro 'nte 'pi labhate paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वाप्युपपातकैः /./
कृष्णसेवी नरो ऽन्ते ऽपि लभते परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Whether endowed with mortal sins or endowed with minor sins, / a man who serves Kṛṣṇa, even at the end, attains the supreme destination.

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ paricaryā parāyaṇāḥ /
te dūtāḥ sahasā yānti pāpino 'pi parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
यतीनां विष्णुभक्तानां परिचर्या परायणाः /
ते दूताः सहसा यान्ति पापिनो ऽपि परां गतिम् //
text_mt: Those devoted to the service of ascetics who are devotees of Viṣṇu, / O messengers, even if sinful, go quickly to the supreme destination.

sanskrit_iast:
muhurtaṃ vā muhurtārddhaṃ yastiṣṭoddharimandire /
so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ kimudvātraghiṃśavatsarān //
meaning:
मुहुर्तं वा मुहुर्तार्द्धं यस्तिष्टोद्धरिमन्दिरे /
सो ऽपि याति परं स्थानं किमुद्वात्रघिंशवत्सरान् //
text_mt: He who stays in the temple of Hari for a muhūrta or half a muhūrta, / he too goes to the supreme place; how much more so for thirty-two years?

sanskrit_iast:
upalepanakarttārau saṃmārjanaparāyaṇau /
etau harigṛhe nityaṃ jīrṇaśīrṇādhiropakau //
meaning:
उपलेपनकर्त्तारौ संमार्जनपरायणौ /
एतौ हरिगृहे नित्यं जीर्णशीर्णाधिरोपकौ //
text_mt: They were performers of plastering, devoted to sweeping, / constantly repairing whatever was dilapidated and broken in the house of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
jalasecanakarttārau dīpadau harimandire /
kathametau mahābhāgau yātanābhogamarhatha //
meaning:
जलसेचनकर्त्तारौ दीपदौ हरिमन्दिरे /
कथमेतौ महाभागौ यातनाभोगमर्हथ //
text_mt: They were sprinklers of water, givers of lamps in the temple of Hari. / How do these two highly fortunate ones deserve the experience of torture?'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā viṣṇudūtāste cchitvā pāśāṃstadaiva hi /
āropyāvāṃ vimānāgrayaṃ yayurviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
इत्युक्ता विष्णुदूतास्ते च्छित्वा पाशांस्तदैव हि /
आरोप्यावां विमानाग्रयं ययुर्विष्णोः परं पदम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed, those messengers of Viṣṇu cut the nooses at that very moment, / placed the two of us on a splendid aerial chariot, and went to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sāmīpyamāpannau devadevasya cakriṇaḥ /
divyānbhogānbhuktavantau tāvatkālaṃ munīśvara //
meaning:
तत्र सामीप्यमापन्नौ देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः /
दिव्यान्भोगान्भुक्तवन्तौ तावत्कालं मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: There, having attained proximity to the God of gods who bears the discus, / we enjoyed divine pleasures for that long period of time, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
divyānbhogāṃstu tatrāpi bhuktvā yātau mahīmimām /
atrāpi saṃpadatulā harisevāprasādataḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यान्भोगांस्तु तत्रापि भुक्त्वा यातौ महीमिमाम् /
अत्रापि संपदतुला हरिसेवाप्रसादतः //
text_mt: Having enjoyed divine pleasures even there, we came to this earth; / here too is unequaled prosperity, by the grace of the service of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
anicchayā kṛtenāpi sevanena harermune /
prātpamīdṛk phalaṃ vipra devānāmapi durlabham //
meaning:
अनिच्छया कृतेनापि सेवनेन हरेर्मुने /
प्रात्पमीदृक् फलं विप्र देवानामपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Even by service done to Hari without intention, O sage, / such a fruit has been attained, O brāhmaṇa, which is difficult even for the gods to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
icchayārādhya viśveśaṃ bhaktibhāvena mādhavam /
prāpsyāvaḥ paramaṃ śreya iti heturnirupitaḥ //
meaning:
इच्छयाराध्य विश्वेशं भक्तिभावेन माधवम् /
प्राप्स्यावः परमं श्रेय इति हेतुर्निरुपितः //
text_mt: Having worshiped the Lord of the universe, Mādhava, with intention and a spirit of devotion, / we shall attain the supreme good—thus was the purpose determined.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśenāpi yatkarma kṛtaṃ syātsumahatphalam /
jāyate bhūmidevendra kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā kṛtam //
meaning:
अवशेनापि यत्कर्म कृतं स्यात्सुमहत्फलम् /
जायते भूमिदेवेन्द्र किं पुनः श्रद्धया कृतम् //
text_mt: Even what act is done involuntarily yields a very great fruit, / O best of earthly gods; how much more so that which is done with faith!

sanskrit_iast:
etaduktaṃ niśamyāsau sa munīndro vibhaṇḍakaḥ /
praśasya dampatī tau tu prayayau svatapevanam //
meaning:
एतदुक्तं निशम्यासौ स मुनीन्द्रो विभण्डकः /
प्रशस्य दम्पती तौ तु प्रययौ स्वतपेवनम् //
text_mt: Hearing this speech, that Vibhaṇḍaka, the best of sages, / praised that couple and set out for his own penance-grove.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjānīhi devarṣe devadevasya cakriṇaḥ /
paricaryā tu sarveṣāṃ kāmadhenūpamā smṛtā //
meaning:
तस्माज्जानीहि देवर्षे देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः /
परिचर्या तु सर्वेषां कामधेनूपमा स्मृता //
text_mt: Therefore know, O divine sage, that service to the God of gods who bears the discus / is remembered as being like the wish-fulfilling cow for all.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāparāṇāṃ tu harireva sanātanaḥ /
dadāti paramaṃ śreyaḥ sarvakāmaphalamapradaḥ //
meaning:
हरिपूजापराणां तु हरिरेव सनातनः /
ददाति परमं श्रेयः सर्वकामफलमप्रदः //
text_mt: To those devoted to the worship of Hari, eternal Hari alone, / the bestower of the fruits of all desires, gives the supreme good.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam /
paṭhecca śṛṇuyādvāpi so 'pi yāti parāṃ rātim //
iti śrabṛhannāradīyaparāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde sumatibhūpakathāvarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśa'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इदं पुण्यमाख्यानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् /
पठेच्च शृणुयाद्वापि सो ऽपि याति परां रातिम् //
इति श्रबृहन्नारदीयपराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे सुमतिभूपकथावर्णनं नाम विंशऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever reads or hears this meritorious narrative, which destroys all sins, / he too attains supreme delight.

Thus ends the twentieth chapter, titled “Description of the Story of King Sumati,” in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
anyadvūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ /
durlabhaṃ sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ haripañcakam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अन्यद्वूतं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद तत्त्वतः /
दुर्लभं सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातं हरिपञ्चकम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / I shall declare another vow, hear it in truth, O Nārada, / rare in all the worlds, renowned as the Haripañcaka.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ ca sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇam /
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ nidānaṃ munisattama //
meaning:
नारीणां च नराणां च सर्वदुःखनिवारणम् /
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणां निदानं मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: It dispels all suffering for women and men; / it is the root cause of righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ caiva sarvavrataphalapradam /
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाभीष्टप्रदं चैव सर्वव्रतफलप्रदम् /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे दशम्यां नियतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: It grants all desires and gives the fruit of all vows. / In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the tenth day, with senses restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātsnānādikaṃ karma dantadhāvanapūrvakama /
kṛtvā devārcanaṃ samyaktathā pañca mahādhvarān //
meaning:
कुर्यात्स्नानादिकं कर्म दन्तधावनपूर्वकम /
कृत्वा देवार्चनं सम्यक्तथा पञ्च महाध्वरान् //
text_mt: one should perform bath and other rites, preceded by cleaning the teeth, / having properly performed the worship of the deity, as well as the five great sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāśī ca bhavettasmin dine niyamamāsthitāḥ /
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya hyekādaśyāṃ munīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एकाशी च भवेत्तस्मिन् दिने नियममास्थिताः /
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय ह्येकादश्यां मुनीश्वरः //
text_mt: One should eat only once on that day, remaining firm in the observance. / Then rising early in the morning on the eleventh day, O lord of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ kṛtvā yathācāraṃ hariṃ caivāryadṛhe /
snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
स्नानं कृत्वा यथाचारं हरिं चैवार्यदृहे /
स्नापयेद्देवदेवेशं पञ्चामृतविधानतः //
text_mt: having bathed according to custom and [worshipped] Hari in one's home, / one should bathe the god of gods according to the rite of the fivefold nectar (pañcāmṛta).

sanskrit_iast:
arcayetparayā bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ ṛmāt /
dhūpairdīpeśca naivaidyaistāmbūlaiśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ //
meaning:
अर्चयेत्परया भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पादिभिः ऋमात् /
धूपैर्दीपेश्च नैवैद्यैस्ताम्बूलैश्च प्रदक्षिणैः //
text_mt: One should worship [him] with supreme devotion in sequence with perfume, flowers, and the like, / with incense, lamps, food offerings, betel leaves, and circumambulations.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya devadeveśamimaṃ mantramudīrayet /.
namaste ghajñānarupāya jñānadāya namo 'stute //
meaning:
संपूज्य देवदेवेशमिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् /.
नमस्ते घज्ञानरुपाय ज्ञानदाय नमो ऽस्तुते //
text_mt: Having worshipped the god of gods, one should utter this mantra: / “Salutations to you whose form is knowledge! Salutations to you who grant knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sravaparupāya sarvasiddhipradāyine /
evaṃ praṇamya deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārjanam //
meaning:
नमस्ते स्रवपरुपाय सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिने /
एवं प्रणम्य देवेशं वासुदेवं जनार्जनम् //
text_mt: Salutations to you whose form is the universe! Salutations to the granter of all perfections!” / Having thus bowed down to the lord of gods, Vāsudeva, Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa hyupavāsaṃ samarpayet /
pañcarātraṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava //
meaning:
वक्ष्यमाणेन मन्त्रेण ह्युपवासं समर्पयेत् /
पञ्चरात्रं निराहारो ह्यद्यप्रभृति केशव //
text_mt: one should dedicate the fast with the mantra that is to be stated: / “Remaining without food for five nights from today onward, O Keśava,

sanskrit_iast:
tvadajñayā jagatsvāminmamābhīṣṭaprado bhava /
evaṃ samapya devasya upavāsaṃ jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
त्वदज्ञया जगत्स्वामिन्ममाभीष्टप्रदो भव /
एवं समप्य देवस्य उपवासं जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: by your command, O Master of the universe, become the granter of my desire!” / Having thus dedicated the fast of the deity, with senses conquered,

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādekādaśyāmatho dvija /
dvādaśyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यादेकादश्यामथो द्विज /
द्वादश्यां च त्रयोदश्यां चतुर्दश्यां जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: one should keep a vigil at night on the eleventh day, then, O twice-born; / and on the twelfth, on the thirteenth, on the fourteenth, with senses controlled,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇanamāsyāṃ ca karttavyamevaṃ viṣṇvarcanaṃ mune /
ekādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ karttavyaṃ jāgaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
पौर्णनमास्यां च कर्त्तव्यमेवं विष्ण्वर्चनं मुने /
एकादश्यां पौर्णमास्यां कर्त्तव्यं जागरं तथा //
text_mt: and on the full-moon day, such worship of Viṣṇu is to be performed, O sage. / On the eleventh and on the full-moon day, a vigil is likewise to be kept.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtādipūjā tu sāmānyā dinapañcasu /
kṣīreṇa snāpayedviṣṇuṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ /
tilahomaśca karttavyastiladānaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
पञ्चामृतादिपूजा तु सामान्या दिनपञ्चसु /
क्षीरेण स्नापयेद्विष्णुं पौर्णमास्यां तु शक्तितः /
तिलहोमश्च कर्त्तव्यस्तिलदानं तथैव च //
text_mt: The worship with the fivefold nectar and the like is common to all five days. / On the full-moon day, however, according to one's ability, one should bathe Viṣṇu with milk; / a sesame fire-oblation is to be performed, and likewise a gift of sesame.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ ṣaṣṭe dine prātpe nirvatyaṃ svāśramakriyām /
saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ ca pūjayedvidhibaddharim //
meaning:
ततः षष्टे दिने प्रात्पे निर्वत्यं स्वाश्रमक्रियाम् /
संप्राश्य पञ्चगव्यं च पूजयेद्विधिबद्धरिम् //
text_mt: Then on the sixth day, in the morning, having performed the rites of one's stage of life, / and having consumed the five products of the cow (pañcagavya), one should worship Hari according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvibhave satyavāritam /
tataḥ svabandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाद्विभवे सत्यवारितम् /
ततः स्वबन्धुभिः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Afterward, if means allow, one should feed brāhmaṇas without restriction; / then, restrained in speech, one should eat oneself along with one's kin.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paupādimāseṣu kārttikānteṣu nārada /
śuklapakṣe vrataṃ kuryātpūrvamivavidhinā naraḥ //
meaning:
एवं पौपादिमासेषु कार्त्तिकान्तेषु नारद /
शुक्लपक्षे व्रतं कुर्यात्पूर्वमिवविधिना नरः //
text_mt: In this way, in the months beginning with Pauṣa and ending with Kārttika, O Nārada, / in the bright fortnight, a man should observe the vow according to the previous rule.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam /
punaḥ prātpe mārgaśīrṣe kuryādudyapanaṃ vratī //
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरं कार्यं व्रतं पापप्रणाशनम् /
पुनः प्रात्पे मार्गशीर्षे कुर्यादुद्यपनं व्रती //
text_mt: In this manner the sin-destroying vow is to be performed for a year. / When Mārgaśīrṣa has arrived again, the observer of the vow should perform the concluding ceremony (udyāpana).

sanskrit_iast:
dvija /
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro bhavetpūrvamiva dvija /
dvādaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca prāśayetsusamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
द्विज /
एकादश्यां निराहारो भवेत्पूर्वमिव द्विज /
द्वादश्यां पञ्चगव्यं च प्राशयेत्सुसमाहितः //
text_mt:
O twice-born,
On the eleventh day, one should fast just as before, O twice-born; / and on the twelfth day, with a well-concentrated mind, one should consume the five products of the cow.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpā dibhiḥ samyagdevadevaṃ janārdanam /
abhyarcyopāyanaṃ dadyādrūhyaṇāya jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पा दिभिः सम्यग्देवदेवं जनार्दनम् /
अभ्यर्च्योपायनं दद्याद्रूह्यणाय जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Having properly worshipped the god of gods, Janārdana, with perfume, flowers, and the like, / with restrained senses one should give a gift to a brāhmaṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ phalānvitam /
sugandhaja lasaṃyuktaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
पायसं मधुसंमिश्रं घृतयुक्तं फलान्वितम् /
सुगन्धज लसंयुक्तं पूर्णकुम्भं सदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: milk-rice mixed with honey, endowed with clarified butter, accompanied by fruits, / and a full jar filled with fragrant water along with a sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
vastreṇācchāditaṃ kumbhaṃ pañcarantasamanvitam /
dadyādadhyātmaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya munīśvara //
meaning:
वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं कुम्भं पञ्चरन्तसमन्वितम् /
दद्यादध्यात्मविदुषे ब्राह्मणाय मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: a jar covered with a cloth, accompanied by the five jewels, / one should give to a brāhmaṇa who knows the supreme Self, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātman sarvabhūteśa sarvavyāpinsanātana /
paramānnapradānena suprīto bhava mādhava //
meaning:
सर्वात्मन् सर्वभूतेश सर्वव्यापिन्सनातन /
परमान्नप्रदानेन सुप्रीतो भव माधव //
text_mt: “O Self of all, O Lord of all beings, O all-pervading, eternal one! / Through this gift of supreme food, be well pleased, O Mādhava!”

sanskrit_iast:
anena pāyasaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ /
śaktito bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
अनेन पायसं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः /
शक्तितो बन्धुभिः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Having given the milk-rice with this [mantra], one should then feed brāhmaṇas; / according to one's ability, one should eat oneself along with kin, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
vratametattu yaḥ kuryāddharipañcakasaṃjñitam /
na tasya punarāvṛttirbrahmalokātkadācana //
meaning:
व्रतमेतत्तु यः कुर्याद्धरिपञ्चकसंज्ञितम् /
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिर्ब्रह्मलोकात्कदाचन //
text_mt: Whoever performs this vow named Haripañcaka, / for him there is never any return from the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vratametatprakarttavya micchadbhirmokṣamuttam /
samastapāpakāntāradāvānalasamaṃ dvija //
meaning:
व्रतमेतत्प्रकर्त्तव्य मिच्छद्भिर्मोक्षमुत्तम् /
समस्तपापकान्तारदावानलसमं द्विज //
text_mt: This vow is to be undertaken by those desiring supreme liberation; / it is equal to a forest fire for the wilderness of all sins, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi dattvā yatphalamāpnuyāt /
tatphalaṃ labhyate pumbhiretasmā dupavāsataḥ //
meaning:
गवां कोटिसहस्राणि दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नुयात् /
तत्फलं लभ्यते पुम्भिरेतस्मा दुपवासतः //
text_mt: Whatever fruit one obtains by giving thousands of crores of cows, / that fruit is obtained by men from this fast.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvetacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ /
sa mucyate mahāghoraiḥ tāpakānāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāṃradīyapurāṇaṃ pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne mārgaśīrṣaśulkaikādaśīmāsabhya paurṇimāparyantaṃ pañcarātrivrataṃ nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यस्त्वेतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या नारायणपरायणः /
स मुच्यते महाघोरैः तापकानां च कोटिभिः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नांरदीयपुराणं पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे व्रताख्याने मार्गशीर्षशुल्कैकादशीमासभ्य पौर्णिमापर्यन्तं पञ्चरात्रिव्रतं नामैकविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever listens to this with devotion, dedicated to Nārāyaṇa, / is freed from tens of millions of exceedingly terrible torments.

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, titled “The Five-Night Vow from the Bright Eleventh to the Full Moon of Mārgaśīrṣa in the Narrative of Vows,” in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
anyad vratavaraṃ vakṣye tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ /
sarvāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokopakārakam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अन्यद् व्रतवरं वक्ष्ये तच्छृणुष्व समाहितः /
सर्वापापहरं पुण्यं सर्वलोकोपकारकम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / I shall declare another excellent vow; listen to it attentively, / pure, destroying all sins, beneficial to all the world.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhre śrāvaṇe vāpi tathā bhādrapade 'pi ca /
tathaivāśvinake māse kuryādetadvataṃ dvija //
meaning:
आषाढ्रे श्रावणे वापि तथा भाद्रपदे ऽपि च /
तथैवाश्विनके मासे कुर्यादेतद्वतं द्विज //
text_mt: In Āṣāḍha or in Śrāvaṇa, and also in Bhādrapada, / or likewise in the month of Āśvina, one should perform this vow, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvanyatame māse śulkapakṣe jitendriyaḥ /
prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ ca svapedviṣṇusamīpataḥ //
meaning:
एतेष्वन्यतमे मासे शुल्कपक्षे जितेन्द्रियः /
प्राशयेत्पञ्चगव्यं च स्वपेद्विष्णुसमीपतः //
text_mt: In any of these months, in the bright fortnight, with senses conquered, / one should consume the five products of the cow (pañcagavya) and sleep near Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityakarma samāpya ca /
śraddhayā pūjayedviṣṇuṃ vaśī krodhavivārjitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय नित्यकर्म समाप्य च /
श्रद्धया पूजयेद्विष्णुं वशी क्रोधविवार्जितः //
text_mt: Then, having risen in the morning and completed the daily rites, / self-controlled and free from anger, one should worship Viṣṇu with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
vidvadbhiḥ sahito viṣṇumarcayitvā yathocitam /
saṃkalpaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāstvasti vācanapūrvakam //
meaning:
विद्वद्भिः सहितो विष्णुमर्चयित्वा यथोचितम् /
संकल्पं तु ततः कुर्यास्त्वस्ति वाचनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Viṣṇu properly in the company of learned men, / one should then make a solemn resolve (saṃkalpa) preceded by the recitation of blessings:

sanskrit_iast:
māsamekaṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti keśava /
māsāntaṃ pāraṇaṃ kurve devadeva tavājñayā //
meaning:
मासमेकं निराहारो ह्यद्यप्रभृति केशव /
मासान्तं पारणं कुर्वे देवदेव तवाज्ञया //
text_mt: “Remaining without food for one month from today onward, O Keśava, / at the end of the month I shall break my fast by your command, O god of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
taporupa namastubhyaṃ tapasāṃ phala dāyaka /
mamābhūṣṭapradaṃ dehi sarvavinghānnivāraya //
meaning:
तपोरुप नमस्तुभ्यं तपसां फल दायक /
ममाभूष्टप्रदं देहि सर्वविन्घान्निवारय //
text_mt: Salutations to you whose form is austerity, O giver of the fruit of austerities! / Grant what is desired by me, and remove all obstacles!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ samarpya devasya viṣṇormāsavrataṃ śubham /
tataḥ prabhṛti māsāntaṃ nivaseddharimandire //
meaning:
एवं समर्प्य देवस्य विष्णोर्मासव्रतं शुभम् /
ततः प्रभृति मासान्तं निवसेद्धरिमन्दिरे //
text_mt: Having thus dedicated to the god Viṣṇu this auspicious month-long vow, / from that time until the end of the month one should reside in a temple of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ snāpayeddevaṃ pañcāmṛtavidhānataḥ /
dīpaṃ nirantaraṃ kuryāttasminmāse harergṛhe //
meaning:
प्रत्यहं स्नापयेद्देवं पञ्चामृतविधानतः /
दीपं निरन्तरं कुर्यात्तस्मिन्मासे हरेर्गृहे //
text_mt: Every day one should bathe the deity according to the rite of the fivefold nectar (pañcāmṛta); / one should keep a perpetual lamp burning in Hari's temple during that month.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ khādayetkāṣṭhaṃ hyapāmārga samudbhavam /
tataḥ snāyīta vidhinnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यहं खादयेत्काष्ठं ह्यपामार्ग समुद्भवम् /
ततः स्नायीत विधिन्नारायणपरायणः //
text_mt: Every day one should chew a tooth-stick derived from the apāmārga plant; / then one should bathe according to rule, dedicated to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃsnāpayedviṣṇuṃ pūrvavatprayator'cayet /
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā bhaktiyuktaḥ sada kṣiṇam //
meaning:
ततः संस्नापयेद्विष्णुं पूर्ववत्प्रयतोर्ऽचयेत् /
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्छक्त्या भक्तियुक्तः सद क्षिणम् //
text_mt: Then, having bathed Viṣṇu, pure, one should worship him as before; / endowed with devotion, one should feed brāhmaṇas according to one's capacity, with a sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ ca bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ bhuñjīta prayatendriyaḥ /
evaṃ māsopavāsāṃśca vratī kuryāt trayodaśa //
meaning:
स्वयं च बन्धुभिः सार्द्धं भुञ्जीत प्रयतेन्द्रियः /
एवं मासोपवासांश्च व्रती कुर्यात् त्रयोदश //
text_mt: and, with restrained senses, eat oneself along with one's kin. / In this way the observer of the vow should perform thirteen monthly fasts.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣānte vedaviduṣe gāṃ pradadyātsa dakṣiṇām /
bhojayedvrāhmāṇāṃstatra dvādaśaiva vidhānataḥ /
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādrūhyaṇyābharaṇāni ca //
meaning:
वर्षान्ते वेदविदुषे गां प्रदद्यात्स दक्षिणाम् /
भोजयेद्व्राह्माणांस्तत्र द्वादशैव विधानतः /
शक्त्या च दक्षिणां दद्याद्रूह्यण्याभरणानि च //
text_mt: At the end of the year, one should give a cow accompanied by a sacrificial fee to one learned in the Veda; / one should feed twelve brāhmaṇas there according to rule, / and according to ability one should give a sacrificial fee and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
māsopavāsatritayaṃ yaḥ kuryātsaṃyate ndriyaḥ /
ātporyāmasya yajñatya dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute //
meaning:
मासोपवासत्रितयं यः कुर्यात्संयते न्द्रियः /
आत्पोर्यामस्य यज्ञत्य द्विगुणं फलमश्नुते //
text_mt: Whoever, with restrained senses, observes a triad of month-long fasts, / obtains twice the fruit of the āptoryāma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥ kṛtvaḥ kṛtaṃ yena pārākaṃ munisattama /
sa labhetparamaṃ puṇyamaṣṭāngiṣṭomasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
चतुः कृत्वः कृतं येन पाराकं मुनिसत्तम /
स लभेत्परमं पुण्यमष्टान्गिष्टोमसंभवम् //
text_mt: He by whom this supreme fast (pārāka) is performed four times, O best of sages, / obtains the supreme merit arising from eight agniṣṭoma sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakṛtvo vratamidaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mahātmanā /
atyangiṣṭomajaṃ puṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चकृत्वो व्रतमिदं कृतं येन महात्मना /
अत्यन्गिष्टोमजं पुण्यं द्विगुणं प्राप्नुयान्नरः //
text_mt:
A great-souled person by whom this vow has been performed five times
obtains double the merit born of the Atyagniṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māsopavāṣaṭkaṃ yaḥ karoti susamāhitaḥ /
jyotiṣṭo syanga yajñasya phalaṃ so 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet //
meaning:
मासोपवाषट्कं यः करोति सुसमाहितः /
ज्योतिष्टो स्यन्ग यज्ञस्य फलं सो ऽष्टगुणं लभेत् //
text_mt:
He who, deeply concentrated, performs six month-long fasts,
shall obtain eightfold the fruit of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhāraḥ satpakṛtvo naro māsopavāsakān /
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet //
meaning:
निराहारः सत्पकृत्वो नरो मासोपवासकान् /
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं लभेत् //
text_mt:
A man without food through seven month-long fasts
shall obtain eightfold the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
māso pāvāsānyaḥ kuryādaṣṭakṛtvo munīśvara /
naramedhākhyayajñasya phalaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ labhet //
meaning:
मासो पावासान्यः कुर्यादष्टकृत्वो मुनीश्वर /
नरमेधाख्ययज्ञस्य फलं पञ्चगुणं लभेत् //
text_mt:
He who should perform month-long fasts eight times, O lord of sages,
shall obtain fivefold the fruit of the sacrifice named the human sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu māsopavāsāṃśca navakṛtvaḥ samācaret /
gomedhamakhajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate triguṇaṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु मासोपवासांश्च नवकृत्वः समाचरेत् /
गोमेधमखजं पुण्यं लभते त्रिगुणं नरः //
text_mt:
And the man who should perform month-long fasts nine times
obtains threefold the merit born of the cow sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
daśakṛtvastu yaḥ kuryātparākaṃ munisattama /
sa brahmamedhayajñasya triguṇaṃ phalamaśnute //
meaning:
दशकृत्वस्तु यः कुर्यात्पराकं मुनिसत्तम /
स ब्रह्ममेधयज्ञस्य त्रिगुणं फलमश्नुते //
text_mt:
He who should perform the Parāka ten times, O best of sages,
enjoys threefold the fruit of the Brahmamedha sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśa parākāṃśca yaḥ kuryātsaṃyatendriyaḥ /
sa yāti harisārupyaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam //
meaning:
एकादश पराकांश्च यः कुर्यात्संयतेन्द्रियः /
स याति हरिसारुप्यं सर्वभोगसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
And he who, with senses restrained, should perform eleven Parākas
attains sameness of form with Hari, endowed with all enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśa parākāṃśca yaḥ kuryātprayato naraḥ /
sa yāti paramānandaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati //
meaning:
त्रयोदश पराकांश्च यः कुर्यात्प्रयतो नरः /
स याति परमानन्दं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति //
text_mt:
And the self-controlled man who should perform thirteen Parākas
attains supreme bliss, having reached which he does not grieve.

sanskrit_iast:
māsopavāsaniratā gaṅgāsnānaparāyaṇāḥ /
dhamamāgapravaktāro muktā eva na saśaṃyaḥ //
meaning:
मासोपवासनिरता गङ्गास्नानपरायणाः /
धममागप्रवक्तारो मुक्ता एव न सशंयः //
text_mt:
Those devoted to month-long fasts, dedicated to bathing in the Gaṅgā,
and proclaimers of the path of righteousness are liberated indeed, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
avīrābhiryatibhirbrahyacāribhiḥ /
māsopavāsaḥ karttavyo vanasthaiśca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अवीराभिर्यतिभिर्ब्रह्यचारिभिः /
मासोपवासः कर्त्तव्यो वनस्थैश्च विशेषतः //
text_mt:
By childless women, ascetics, celibate students,
and especially by forest-dwellers, a month-long fast should be undertaken.

sanskrit_iast:
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi vratametatsudurlabham /
kṛtvā mokṣamavānpoti yogināmapi durlabham //
meaning:
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि व्रतमेतत्सुदुर्लभम् /
कृत्वा मोक्षमवान्पोति योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt:
A woman or a man, having performed this very difficult-to-obtain vow,
attains liberation, which is hard to obtain even for yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhastho vānaprastho vā vratī vā bhikṣureva vā /
mūrkho vā paṇḍito vāpi śrutvaitanmokṣabhāgbhavet //
meaning:
गृहस्थो वानप्रस्थो वा व्रती वा भिक्षुरेव वा /
मूर्खो वा पण्डितो वापि श्रुत्वैतन्मोक्षभाग्भवेत् //
text_mt:
A householder, a forest-dweller, an observer of vows, or a mendicant,
a fool or a learned person, upon hearing this, becomes an enjoyer of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ puṇyaṃ vratākhyānaṃ nārāyaṇa parāyaṇaḥ /
śṛṇuyādvācayedvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde vratākhyāne māsopavāsavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इदं पुण्यं व्रताख्यानं नारायण परायणः /
शृणुयाद्वाचयेद्वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे व्रताख्याने मासोपवासवर्णनं नाम द्वादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Dedicated to Nārāyaṇa, whoever hears or causes this sacred narrative of the vow to be read
is freed from all sins.

Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Month-Long Fast in the Narrative of Vows', in the first quarter of the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि व्रतं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
I shall declare this other vow, renowned in the three worlds,
which allays all sins and grants the fruit of all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ caiva yopitām /
mokṣadaṃ kurvatāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ priyataraṃ dvija //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां चैव योपिताम् /
मोक्षदं कुर्वतां भक्त्या विष्णोः प्रियतरं द्विज //
text_mt:
bestowing liberation on Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, Śūdras, and women
who perform it with devotion, exceedingly dear to Viṣṇu, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīvrataṃ nāma sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām /.
karttavyaṃ sarvathā vipraviṣṇuprītikaraṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
एकादशीव्रतं नाम सर्वाभीष्टप्रदं नृणाम् /.
कर्त्तव्यं सर्वथा विप्रविष्णुप्रीतिकरं यतः //
text_mt:
The vow named Ekādaśī grants all desired things to men;
it should be performed by all means, O Brahmin, since it causes delight to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayopari /
yo bhuṅkte so 'tra pāpīyānparatra narakaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
एकादश्यां न भुञ्जीत पक्षयोरुभयोपरि /
यो भुङ्क्ते सो ऽत्र पापीयान्परत्र नरकं व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
One should not eat on the eleventh lunar day in either of the two fortnights;
he who eats is a sinner in this world and goes to hell in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaphalaṃ lipsurjahyādbhukticatuṣṭayam /
pūrvāparadine gatrāvahorātraṃ tu madhyame //
meaning:
उपवासफलं लिप्सुर्जह्याद्भुक्तिचतुष्टयम् /
