He should perform the svastivācana and give the imperishable water,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā samāhitaḥ kuryāttathā viprābhivādanam /
acālayitvā pātraṃ tu svasti kurvanti ye dvijāḥ //
meaning:
दत्त्वा समाहितः कुर्यात्तथा विप्राभिवादनम् /
अचालयित्वा पात्रं तु स्वस्ति कुर्वन्ति ये द्विजाः //
text_mt:
and having given it, composed in mind, he should salute the twice-borns.
Those twice-borns who utter svasti without moving the plate,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaraṃ pitarasteṣāṃ bhavantyucchiṣṭabhojinaḥ /
dātāro no 'bhivarddhantāmityādyaiḥ smṛtibhāṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
वत्सरं पितरस्तेषां भवन्त्युच्छिष्टभोजिनः /
दातारो नो ऽभिवर्द्धन्तामित्याद्यैः स्मृतिभाषितैः //
text_mt:
their ancestors become eaters of leftovers for a year.
With "May our donors prosper!" and other words stated in the Smṛtis,

sanskrit_iast:
āśīrvaco labhettebhyo namaskāraṃ carettataḥ /
dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā tāṃbūlaṃ gandhasaṃyutam //
meaning:
आशीर्वचो लभेत्तेभ्यो नमस्कारं चरेत्ततः /
दद्याच्च दक्षिणां शक्त्या तांबूलं गन्धसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
he should obtain words of blessing from them, and then perform obeisance.
And he should give a sacrificial fee according to his capacity, along with betel and fragrant perfume.

sanskrit_iast:
nyubjapātramathānīya svadhākāramudīrayet /
vājevāje iti ṛcā pitṝndevānvisarjayet //
meaning:
न्युब्जपात्रमथानीय स्वधाकारमुदीरयेत् /
वाजेवाजे इति ऋचा पितॄन्देवान्विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
Then, bringing the plate turned downward, he should utter the word "svadhā".
With the verse "Vāje vāje", he should dismiss the ancestors and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktā ca śrāddhakṛttasyāṃ rajanyāṃ maithunaṃ tyajet /
tathā svādhyāyamadhvānaṃ prayatnena parityajet //
meaning:
भोक्ता च श्राद्धकृत्तस्यां रजन्यां मैथुनं त्यजेत् /
तथा स्वाध्यायमध्वानं प्रयत्नेन परित्यजेत् //
text_mt:
The eater and the performer of the śrāddha should avoid sexual intercourse on that night;
likewise, he should zealously avoid study of the Veda and travel.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvagaścāturaścaiva vihīnaśca dhanaistathā /
āmaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta hemnā vāstṛśyabhāryakaḥ //
meaning:
अध्वगश्चातुरश्चैव विहीनश्च धनैस्तथा /
आमश्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत हेम्ना वास्तृश्यभार्यकः //
text_mt:
A traveler, one who is sick, one devoid of wealth,
or one whose wife is in her monthly course should perform an Āmaśrāddha or [a śrāddha] with gold.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyābhāve dvijābhāve hyannamātraṃ ca pācayet /
paitṛkena tu sūktena homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
द्रव्याभावे द्विजाभावे ह्यन्नमात्रं च पाचयेत् /
पैतृकेन तु सूक्तेन होमं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः //
text_mt:
In the absence of material goods or twice-borns, one should cook only grain.
The discerning man should make the fire oblation with the hymn to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
atyanta havyaśūnyaścaitsvaśaktyā tu tṛṇaṃ gavām /
snātvā ca vidhivadvipra kuryādvā tilataparṇam //
meaning:
अत्यन्त हव्यशून्यश्चैत्स्वशक्त्या तु तृणं गवाम् /
स्नात्वा च विधिवद्विप्र कुर्याद्वा तिलतपर्णम् //
text_mt:
If he is entirely destitute of sacrificial offerings, [he should give] grass to cows according to his ability;
or, having bathed according to rule, O twice-born, he should make a libation of water with sesame.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā rodanaṃ kuryādatyuccairvijane vane /
daridro 'haṃ mahāpāpī vadanniti vicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अथवा रोदनं कुर्यादत्युच्चैर्विजने वने /
दरिद्रो ऽहं महापापी वदन्निति विचक्षणः //
text_mt:
Or the discerning man should weep very loudly in a lonely forest,
saying, "I am poor, a great sinner!"

sanskrit_iast:
paredyuḥ śrāddhakṛnmartyo yo na tarpayate pitṝn /
tatkulaṃ nāśamāyāti brahmahatyāṃ ca vindati //
meaning:
परेद्युः श्राद्धकृन्मर्त्यो यो न तर्पयते पितॄन् /
तत्कुलं नाशमायाति ब्रह्महत्यां च विन्दति //
text_mt:
The mortal who has performed a śrāddha and does not satisfy the ancestors on the following day,
his family goes to destruction, and he incurs the murder of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ kurvanti ye martyāḥ śraddhāvanto munīśvara /
na teṣāṃ saṃtaticchedaḥ saṃpannāste bhavanti ca //
meaning:
श्राद्धं कुर्वन्ति ये मर्त्याः श्रद्धावन्तो मुनीश्वर /
न तेषां संततिच्छेदः संपन्नास्ते भवन्ति च //
text_mt:
Those faithful mortals who perform the śrāddha, O lord of sages,
there is no severance of their lineage, and they become prosperous.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnyañjati yeṃ śrāddhe taistu viṣṇuḥ prapūjitaḥ /
tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagannāthe sarvāstuṣyanti devatāḥ //
meaning:
पितॄन्यञ्जति यें श्राद्धे तैस्तु विष्णुः प्रपूजितः /
तस्मिंस्तुष्टे जगन्नाथे सर्वास्तुष्यन्ति देवताः //
text_mt:
Those who worship the ancestors in a śrāddha, by them Viṣṇu is worshipped.
When that Lord of the Universe is pleased, all the deities are pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaro devatāścaiva gandharvāpsarasastathā /
yakṣāśca siddhā manujā harireva sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
पितरो देवताश्चैव गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा /
यक्षाश्च सिद्धा मनुजा हरिरेव सनातनः //
text_mt:
Ancestors, deities, Gandharvas, and Apsarases,
Yakṣas, Siddhas, and human beings are only the eternal Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam /
tasmāddātā ca bhoktā ca sarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
येनेदमखिलं जातं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
तस्माद्दाता च भोक्ता च सर्वं विष्णुः सनातनः //
text_mt:
By whom this entire universe, moving and unmoving, was brought forth,
therefore the giver, the eater, and everything is eternal Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yadasti vipra yannāsti dṛśyaṃ cādṛśyameva ca /
sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jñeyaṃ tasmādanyanna vidyate //
meaning:
यदस्ति विप्र यन्नास्ति दृश्यं चादृश्यमेव च /
सर्वं विष्णुमयं ज्ञेयं तस्मादन्यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt:
Whatever exists, O twice-born, and whatever does not exist, visible and invisible,
everything should be known as consisting of Viṣṇu; other than him, nothing exists.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārabhūto viśvasya sarvabhūtātmako 'vyayaḥ /
anaupamyasvabhāvaśca bhagavānhavyakavyabhuk //
meaning:
आधारभूतो विश्वस्य सर्वभूतात्मको ऽव्ययः /
अनौपम्यस्वभावश्च भगवान्हव्यकव्यभुक् //
text_mt:
The foundation of the universe, the self of all beings, imperishable,
incomparable by nature, the Lord who eats both sacrificial and ancestral offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
parabrahmābhidheyo ya eka eva janārdanaḥ /
karttā kārayitā caiva sarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
परब्रह्माभिधेयो य एक एव जनार्दनः /
कर्त्ता कारयिता चैव सर्वं विष्णुः सनातनः //
text_mt:
he who is designated as the Supreme Brahman, the one and only Janārdana,
the agent, the cause of action, and everything is the eternal Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ te muniśreṣṭha śrāddhāsya vidhiruttamaḥ /
kathitaḥ kurvatāmevaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo vilīyate //
meaning:
इत्येवं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ श्राद्धास्य विधिरुत्तमः /
कथितः कुर्वतामेवं पापं सद्यो विलीयते //
text_mt:
Thus has been told to you, O best of sages, the highest procedure of the śrāddha.
For those performing it in this way, sin is immediately dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā śrāddhakāle dvijottamaḥ /
pitarastasya tuṣyanti saṃtatiścaiva varddhate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde śrāddhakriyāvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इदं पठते भक्त्या श्राद्धकाले द्विजोत्तमः /
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यन्ति संततिश्चैव वर्द्धते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे श्राद्धक्रियावर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The best of twice-borns who reads this with devotion at the time of a śrāddha,
his ancestors are pleased, and his lineage increases.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Śrāddha Rites', in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
tithīnāṃ nirṇayaṃ vakṣye prācaścittavidhiṃ tathā /
śṛṇuṣva tanmuniśreṣṭha karmasiddhiryato bhavet //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
तिथीनां निर्णयं वक्ष्ये प्राचश्चित्तविधिं तथा /
शृणुष्व तन्मुनिश्रेष्ठ कर्मसिद्धिर्यतो भवेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
śrautaṃ smārttaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ yaccānyatkarma vaidikam /
anirṇītāsu tithiṣu na kiñcitphalati dvija //
meaning:
श्रौतं स्मार्त्तं व्रतं दानं यच्चान्यत्कर्म वैदिकम् /
अनिर्णीतासु तिथिषु न किञ्चित्फलति द्विज //
text_mt:
Vedic ritual, Smārta ritual, vows, gifts, and whatever other Vedic rite [there is],
when lunar days are undetermined, none of it bears fruit, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyaṣṭamī ṣaṣṭī paurṇamāsī caturddaśī /
amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca hyupavāsavratādiṣu //
meaning:
एकादश्यष्टमी षष्टी पौर्णमासी चतुर्द्दशी /
अमावास्या तृतीया च ह्युपवासव्रतादिषु //
text_mt:
The eleventh, eighth, sixth, full-moon day, fourteenth,
new-moon day, and third, in fasts, vows, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
paraviddhāḥ praśastāḥ syurna grāhyāḥ pūrvasaṃyutāḥ /
nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭī śivaviddhā tu satpamī //
meaning:
परविद्धाः प्रशस्ताः स्युर्न ग्राह्याः पूर्वसंयुताः /
नागविद्धा तु या षष्टी शिवविद्धा तु सत्पमी //
text_mt:
are praiseworthy when joined with the subsequent [day]; they should not be taken when joined with the previous [day].
A sixth day joined with the fifth, and a seventh day joined with the sixth,

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyekādaśīviddhā nopoṣyāḥ syuḥ kadācana /
darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsīṃ ca satpamīṃ pitṛvāsaram //
meaning:
दशम्येकादशीविद्धा नोपोष्याः स्युः कदाचन /
दर्शं च पौर्णमासीं च सत्पमीं पितृवासरम् //
text_mt:
and an eleventh day joined with the tenth should never be fasted on.
On the new-moon day, the full-moon day, the seventh day, and the day of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakāyopadyate /
kṛṣṇapakṣe pūrvaviddhāṃ satpamīṃ ca caturdaśīm //
meaning:
पूर्वविद्धं प्रकुर्वाणो नरकायोपद्यते /
कृष्णपक्षे पूर्वविद्धां सत्पमीं च चतुर्दशीम् //
text_mt:
one who performs [the rite on a day] joined with the previous [day] is destined for hell.
In the dark fortnight, a seventh day and a fourteenth day joined with the previous [day]

sanskrit_iast:
praśastāṃ kecidāhuśca tṛtīyāṃ navamīṃ tathā /
vratādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śuklapakṣo viśiṣyate //
meaning:
प्रशस्तां केचिदाहुश्च तृतीयां नवमीं तथा /
व्रतादीनां तु सर्वेषां शुक्लपक्षो विशिष्यते //
text_mt: And some declare the third [lunar day] as well as the ninth to be praiseworthy; / for all observances and the like, however, the bright fortnight is superior.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhnācca pūrvohṇaṃ grāhyaṃ śreṣṭhattaraṃ yataḥ /
asaṃbhave vratādīnāṃ yadi paurvāhnikī tithiḥ //
meaning:
अपराह्नाच्च पूर्वोह्णं ग्राह्यं श्रेष्ठत्तरं यतः /
असंभवे व्रतादीनां यदि पौर्वाह्निकी तिथिः //
text_mt: The forenoon is to be taken rather than the afternoon, since it is superior; / in the case of observances and the like, if the lunar day pertains to the forenoon, in case of impossibility [otherwise],

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtadvitayaṃ grāhyaṃ bhagavatyudite ravau /
pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tithirnaktavrate sadā //
meaning:
मुहूर्तद्वितयं ग्राह्यं भगवत्युदिते रवौ /
प्रदोषव्यापिनी ग्राह्या तिथिर्नक्तव्रते सदा //
text_mt: two muhūrtas are to be taken after the blessed sun has risen; / for a night-observance, the lunar day extending over dusk is always to be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ /
tithinakṣatrasaṃyogavihitavratakarmaṇi //
meaning:
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं येनास्तं याति भास्करः /
तिथिनक्षत्रसंयोगविहितव्रतकर्मणि //
text_mt: The asterism with which the sun sets is to be observed with fasting / in the ritual of an observance prescribed for the conjunction of a lunar day and an asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tvanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet /
arddharātrādadho yā tu nakṣatravyāpinī tithiḥ //
meaning:
प्रदोषव्यापिनी ग्राह्या त्वन्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् /
अर्द्धरात्रादधो या तु नक्षत्रव्यापिनी तिथिः //
text_mt: That extending over dusk is to be taken, for otherwise it would be fruitless; / but the lunar day extending over the asterism below midnight,

sanskrit_iast:
saiva grāhyā muniśreṣṭha nakṣatravihitavrate /
yadyarddharātraghagayorvyātpaṃ nakṣatraṃ tu dinadvaye //
meaning:
सैव ग्राह्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ नक्षत्रविहितव्रते /
यद्यर्द्धरात्रघगयोर्व्यात्पं नक्षत्रं तु दिनद्वये //
text_mt: that very one is to be taken, O best of sages, in an observance prescribed for an asterism; / if the asterism extends to midnight on both days,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuṇyaṃ tithisaṃyuktaṃ nakṣatraṃ grāhyamucyate /
arddharātradvaye syātāṃ nakṣatraṃ ca tithiryadi //
meaning:
तत्पुण्यं तिथिसंयुक्तं नक्षत्रं ग्राह्यमुच्यते /
अर्द्धरात्रद्वये स्यातां नक्षत्रं च तिथिर्यदि //
text_mt: that meritorious asterism joined with the lunar day is said to be acceptable; / if the asterism and the lunar day should occur at both midnights,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaye pūrvā praśastā syādrṛddhau kāryā tathottarā /
ardhdarātradvayavyātpā tithirnakṣatraghasaṃyutā //
meaning:
क्षये पूर्वा प्रशस्ता स्याद्रृद्धौ कार्या तथोत्तरा /
अर्ध्दरात्रद्वयव्यात्पा तिथिर्नक्षत्रघसंयुता //
text_mt: in case of decrease the prior would be praiseworthy, and in case of increase the subsequent should be observed; / if the lunar day joined with the asterism extends over both midnights,

sanskrit_iast:
hnāsavṛddhiviśūnyā cet grāhyāpūrvā tathā parā /
jyeṣṭhāsaṃmiśritaṃ mūlaṃ rohiṇī vahniṃsaṃyutā //
meaning:
ह्नासवृद्धिविशून्या चेत् ग्राह्यापूर्वा तथा परा /
ज्येष्ठासंमिश्रितं मूलं रोहिणी वह्निंसंयुता //
text_mt: if it is devoid of decrease or increase, the prior or the subsequent is to be taken; / Jyeṣṭhā mixed with Mūla, Rohiṇī joined with Kṛttikā,

sanskrit_iast:
maitreṇa saṃyutā jyeṣṭā saṃtānādivināśainī /
tataḥ syustithayaḥ puṇyāḥ karmānuṣṭānato divā //
meaning:
मैत्रेण संयुता ज्येष्टा संतानादिविनाशैनी /
ततः स्युस्तिथयः पुण्याः कर्मानुष्टानतो दिवा //
text_mt: and Jyeṣṭhā joined with Anurādhā destroy offspring and the like; / therefore lunar days are meritorious according to the performance of rites by day.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrivrateṣu sarveṣu rātriyogo viśiṣyate /
tithirnakṣaghatrayogena yā puṇyā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
रात्रिव्रतेषु सर्वेषु रात्रियोगो विशिष्यते /
तिथिर्नक्षघत्रयोगेन या पुण्या परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: In all night-observances, conjunction with the night is superior; / that which is proclaimed meritorious through the conjunction of lunar day and asterism,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu tadvataṃ kāryaṃ saiva kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
udayavyāpinī grāhyā śravaṇadvādaśī vrate //
meaning:
तस्यां तु तद्वतं कार्यं सैव कार्या विचक्षणैः /
उदयव्यापिनी ग्राह्या श्रवणद्वादशी व्रते //
text_mt: on that [day] alone that observance should be performed; that very one should be observed by the wise; / extending over sunrise is to be taken in the observance of Śravaṇadvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryendugrahaṇe yāvattāvad grāhyā japādiṣu /
saṃkrāntiṣu tu sarvāsu puṇyakālonigadyate //
meaning:
सूर्येन्दुग्रहणे यावत्तावद् ग्राह्या जपादिषु /
संक्रान्तिषु तु सर्वासु पुण्यकालोनिगद्यते //
text_mt: During an eclipse of the sun or moon, as long as [it lasts], it is to be taken for recitation and the like; / at all transitions of the sun, the auspicious time is declared [thus]:

sanskrit_iast:
snānadānajapādīnāṃ kurvatāmakṣaya phalam /
tatra karkaṭako jñeyo dakṣiṇāyanasaṃkramaḥ //
meaning:
स्नानदानजपादीनां कुर्वतामक्षय फलम् /
तत्र कर्कटको ज्ञेयो दक्षिणायनसंक्रमः //
text_mt: For those performing bathing, gifting, recitation, and the like, the fruit is imperishable; / there, Cancer is to be known as the dakṣiṇāyana-saṃkrānti.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvato ghaṭikāstriṃśatpuṇyakālaṃ vidurbudhāḥ /
vṛṣabhe vṛścike caiva siṃhe kumbhe tathaiva ca //
meaning:
पूर्वतो घटिकास्त्रिंशत्पुण्यकालं विदुर्बुधाः /
वृषभे वृश्चिके चैव सिंहे कुम्भे तथैव च //
text_mt: The wise know the thirty ghaṭikās before [it] as the auspicious time; / and in Taurus, Scorpio, Leo, and Aquarius,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamaṣṭamuhūrtāstu grāhyāḥ snānajapādiṣu /
tulāyāṃ caiva meṣe ca pūrvataḥ paratastathā //
meaning:
पूर्वमष्टमुहूर्तास्तु ग्राह्याः स्नानजपादिषु /
तुलायां चैव मेषे च पूर्वतः परतस्तथा //
text_mt: the eight muhūrtas prior are to be taken for bathing, recitation, and the like; / and in Libra and Aries, before and likewise after,

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyā daśaiva ghaṭikā dattasyākṣayatāvahāḥ /
kanyāyāṃ mithune caiva mīne dhanuṣi ca dvija //
meaning:
ज्ञेया दशैव घटिका दत्तस्याक्षयतावहाः /
कन्यायां मिथुने चैव मीने धनुषि च द्विज //
text_mt: ten ghaṭikās are to be known as bringing imperishability to what is given; / in Virgo, Gemini, Pisces, and Sagittarius, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭikāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyā parataḥ puṇyadāyikāḥ /
mākaraṃ saṃkramaṃ prāhuruttarāyaṇasaṃjñakam //
meaning:
घटिकाः षोडश ज्ञेया परतः पुण्यदायिकाः /
माकरं संक्रमं प्राहुरुत्तरायणसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt: sixteen ghaṭikās after are to be known as bestowing merit; / they declare the transit into Capricorn to be named uttarāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
parāstriṃśaśca ghaṭikāścatvāriṃśacca pūrvavat /
ādityaśītakiraṇau grāhyāvastaṅgatau yadi //
meaning:
परास्त्रिंशश्च घटिकाश्चत्वारिंशच्च पूर्ववत् /
आदित्यशीतकिरणौ ग्राह्यावस्तङ्गतौ यदि //
text_mt: Thirty ghaṭikās after, or forty as before [are auspicious]; / if the sun and the moon have set while eclipsed,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā bhuñjīta viprendra paredyuḥ śuddhamaṇḍalam /
dṛṣṭacandrā sinīvālī naṣṭacandrā kuhūḥ smṛtā //
meaning:
स्नात्वा भुञ्जीत विप्रेन्द्र परेद्युः शुद्धमण्डलम् /
दृष्टचन्द्रा सिनीवाली नष्टचन्द्रा कुहूः स्मृता //
text_mt: having bathed on the next day when the orb is purified, O best of brāhmaṇas, one should eat; / Sinīvālī is remembered as the new-moon day when the moon is seen, and Kuhū when the moon is not seen.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyā dvidhā proktā vidvadbhirdharmālipsubhiḥ /
sinīvālīṃ dvijairgrāhyā sāgnikaiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
अमावास्या द्विधा प्रोक्ता विद्वद्भिर्धर्मालिप्सुभिः /
सिनीवालीं द्विजैर्ग्राह्या साग्निकैः श्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: The new-moon day is stated to be of two kinds by the learned who seek virtue; / Sinīvālī is to be taken by twice-born men who maintain fires for the ancestral rite,

sanskrit_iast:
kahūḥ strībhistathā śūdraipari vānagrikaistathā /
aparāhnadvayavyāpinyamāvāsyātithiryadi //
meaning:
कहूः स्त्रीभिस्तथा शूद्रैपरि वानग्रिकैस्तथा /
अपराह्नद्वयव्यापिन्यमावास्यातिथिर्यदि //
text_mt: and Kuhū by women, śūdras, and fireless householders; / if the new-moon day extends over both afternoons,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaye pūrvā tu karttavyā vṛddhau kāryā tathottarā /
amāvāsyā pratītā cenmadhyāhnātparato yadi //
meaning:
क्षये पूर्वा तु कर्त्तव्या वृद्धौ कार्या तथोत्तरा /
अमावास्या प्रतीता चेन्मध्याह्नात्परतो यदि //
text_mt: in case of decrease the prior is to be performed, and in case of increase the subsequent should be observed; / if the new-moon day is recognized as extending beyond midday,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaviddheti vikhyātāsradbhiḥ śāstraviśāradaiḥ /
atyantakṣayapakṣe tu paredyurnāparāhnagā //
meaning:
भूतविद्धेति विख्यातास्रद्भिः शास्त्रविशारदैः /
अत्यन्तक्षयपक्षे तु परेद्युर्नापराह्नगा //
text_mt: it is celebrated by the wise learned in the scriptures as 'overlapped by the fourteenth'; / but in the case of extreme decrease, on the next day it does not extend to the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra grāhyā sinīvālī sāyāhnavyāpinī tithiḥ /
arvācīnakṣaye cacaiva sāyāhnavyāpinī tathā //
meaning:
तत्र ग्राह्या सिनीवाली सायाह्नव्यापिनी तिथिः /
अर्वाचीनक्षये चचैव सायाह्नव्यापिनी तथा //
text_mt: There Sinīvālī, the lunar day extending over evening, is to be taken; / and likewise in a recent decrease, extending over evening,

sanskrit_iast:
sinīvālī parā grāhyā sarvathā śrāddhakarmaṇi /
atyantatithivṛddhau tu bhūtaviddhāṃ parityajet //
meaning:
सिनीवाली परा ग्राह्या सर्वथा श्राद्धकर्मणि /
अत्यन्ततिथिवृद्धौ तु भूतविद्धां परित्यजेत् //
text_mt: the later Sinīvālī is by all means to be taken for the ancestral rite; / but in the case of extreme increase of the lunar day, one should abandon the one overlapped by the fourteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
grāhyā syādaparāhnasthā kuhūḥ paitṛkakarmaṇi /
yathārvācīnavṛddhau tu saṃtyājyā bhūtasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
ग्राह्या स्यादपराह्नस्था कुहूः पैतृककर्मणि /
यथार्वाचीनवृद्धौ तु संत्याज्या भूतसंयुताः //
text_mt: Kuhū occurring in the afternoon should be taken for ancestral rites; / just as in a recent increase, the one joined with the fourteenth is to be abandoned,

sanskrit_iast:
paredyurvibudhaśreṣṭhaiḥ kuhūrgrāhyā parāhnagā /
madhyāhnadvitaye vyātpā hyamāvāsyā tithiryadi //
meaning:
परेद्युर्विबुधश्रेष्ठैः कुहूर्ग्राह्या पराह्नगा /
मध्याह्नद्वितये व्यात्पा ह्यमावास्या तिथिर्यदि //
text_mt: on the next day Kuhū occurring in the afternoon is to be taken by the best of the wise; / if indeed the new-moon day extends over two middays,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrecchayā ca saṃgrāhyā pūrvā vātha parāthavā /
anvādhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃtaḥ saṃpūrṇavarvaṇi //
meaning:
तत्रेच्छया च संग्राह्या पूर्वा वाथ पराथवा /
अन्वाधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि संतः संपूर्णवर्वणि //
text_mt: then according to desire the prior or the subsequent is to be taken; / I shall declare the placing of fire on the altar, O virtuous ones, on the full new- or full-moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipaddivase kuryādyāgaṃ ca munisattama /
parvaṇo yaścaturthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadastrayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिपद्दिवसे कुर्याद्यागं च मुनिसत्तम /
पर्वणो यश्चतुर्थांश आद्याः प्रतिपदस्त्रयः //
text_mt: And on the day of the first lunar day one should perform the sacrifice, O best of sages; / the fourth part of the parvan and the first three [parts] of the first lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prātarukto manīṣibhiḥ /
madhyāhnadvitaye syātāmamāvāsyā ca pūrṇimā //
meaning:
यागकालः स विज्ञेयः प्रातरुक्तो मनीषिभिः /
मध्याह्नद्वितये स्याताममावास्या च पूर्णिमा //
text_mt: that is to be known as the time for sacrifice, declared by the wise as in the morning; / if the new-moon day and the full-moon day occur at two middays,

sanskrit_iast: paredyureva viprendra sadyaḥ kālo vidhīyate //
meaning: परेद्युरेव विप्रेन्द्र सद्यः कालो विधीयते //
text_mt: then on the next day alone, O best of brāhmaṇas, the immediate time is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadvaye paredyuḥ syātsaṃgavātparato manīṣibhiḥ /
sadyaḥ kālaḥ paredyuḥ syājjñeyamevaṃ tithikṣaye //
meaning:
पूर्वद्वये परेद्युः स्यात्संगवात्परतो मनीषिभिः /
सद्यः कालः परेद्युः स्याज्ज्ञेयमेवं तिथिक्षये //
text_mt: In the prior two, on the next day it should be after the forenoon according to the wise; / the immediate time should be on the next day; thus it should be known in the case of decrease of the lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairekādaśī grāhyā daśamīparivarjitā /
daśamīsaṃyutā hṝntipuṇyaṃ janmatrayārjitam //
meaning:
सर्वैरेकादशी ग्राह्या दशमीपरिवर्जिता /
दशमीसंयुता हॄन्तिपुण्यं जन्मत्रयार्जितम् //
text_mt: The eleventh day devoid of the tenth is to be taken by all; / joined with the tenth, it destroys the merit earned in three births.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī kalāmātrā dvādaśyāṃ tu pratīyate /
dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāmasti cetsā parā smṛtā //
meaning:
एकादशी कलामात्रा द्वादश्यां तु प्रतीयते /
द्वादशी च त्रयोदश्यामस्ति चेत्सा परा स्मृता //
text_mt: If the eleventh day is perceived on the twelfth for only a kalā, / and the twelfth exists on the thirteenth, that subsequent one is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyāṃ ca pratīyate /
traghayodaśī ca rātryante tatra vakṣyāmi nirṇayam //
meaning:
संपूर्णैकादशी शुद्धा द्वादश्यां च प्रतीयते /
त्रघयोदशी च रात्र्यन्ते तत्र वक्ष्यामि निर्णयम् //
text_mt: When a complete, pure eleventh day is also perceived on the twelfth, / and the thirteenth is at the end of the night, there I shall declare the decision:

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvā gṛhasthaiḥ sā kāryyā hyuttarā yatibhistathā /
gṛhasthāḥ siddhimicchanti yato mokṣaṃ yatīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वा गृहस्थैः सा कार्य्या ह्युत्तरा यतिभिस्तथा /
गृहस्थाः सिद्धिमिच्छन्ति यतो मोक्षं यतीश्वराः //
text_mt: The prior is to be observed by householders, and the subsequent by ascetics; / for householders desire accomplishment, whereas the lords of ascetics desire liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ tu kalāyāṃ vā yadi labhyeta pāraṇā /
tadānīṃ daśamīviddhāpyupoṣyaikādaśī tithiḥ //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां तु कलायां वा यदि लभ्येत पारणा /
तदानीं दशमीविद्धाप्युपोष्यैकादशी तिथिः //
text_mt: If breaking the fast is obtained on the twelfth or during a kalā, / then even if overlapped by the tenth, the eleventh lunar day is to be observed with fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
śulke vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe bhavedekādaśīdvayam /
gṛhasthānāṃ tu pūrvoktā yatīnāmuttarā smṛtā //
meaning:
शुल्के वा यदि वा कृष्णे भवेदेकादशीद्वयम् /
गृहस्थानां तु पूर्वोक्ता यतीनामुत्तरा स्मृता //
text_mt: Whether in the bright or in the dark fortnight there should be two eleventh days, / the prior is declared for householders, and the subsequent is remembered for ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ vidyate kiñciddaśamīsaṃyutā yadi /
dinakṣaye dvitīyaiva sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitāṃ //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां विद्यते किञ्चिद्दशमीसंयुता यदि /
दिनक्षये द्वितीयैव सर्वेषां परिकीर्तितां //
text_mt: If a little exists on the twelfth and it is joined with the tenth, / in the case of decrease of days, the second alone is proclaimed for all.

sanskrit_iast:
viddhāpyekādaśī grāhyā parato dvādaśī na cet /
aviddhāpi niṣiddhaiva parato dvādaśī yadi //
meaning:
विद्धाप्येकादशी ग्राह्या परतो द्वादशी न चेत् /
अविद्धापि निषिद्धैव परतो द्वादशी यदि //
text_mt: Even an overlapped eleventh day is to be taken if the twelfth is not beyond; / even an unoverlapped one is prohibited if the twelfth is beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātraghiśeṣe trayodaśī /
dvādaśadvādaśīpuṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe //
meaning:
एकादशी द्वादशी च रात्रघिशेषे त्रयोदशी /
द्वादशद्वादशीपुण्यं त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणे //
text_mt: There being the eleventh, the twelfth, and at the end of the night the thirteenth, / the merit of twelve twelfth-days is gained when breaking the fast on the thirteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī kalāmātrā vidyate dvādaśīdine /
dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāṃ nāsti vā vidyate 'thavā //
meaning:
एकादशी कलामात्रा विद्यते द्वादशीदिने /
द्वादशी च त्रयोदश्यां नास्ति वा विद्यते ऽथवा //
text_mt: If the eleventh exists for only a kalā on the day of the twelfth, / and the twelfth does not exist on the thirteenth, or if it does exist,

sanskrit_iast:
vidvāpyekādaśī tatra pūrvā syādgṛhaṇāṃ tadā /
yadibhiścottarā grāhyā hyavīrābhistathaiva ca //
meaning:
विद्वाप्येकादशी तत्र पूर्वा स्याद्गृहणां तदा /
यदिभिश्चोत्तरा ग्राह्या ह्यवीराभिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: even if overlapped, the prior eleventh day belongs to householders then, / and the subsequent should be taken by ascetics and likewise by widows.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyāṃ nāsti kiñcana /
dvādaśī ca trayodaśayāmasti tatra kathaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
संपूर्णैकादशी शुद्धा द्वादश्यां नास्ति किञ्चन /
द्वादशी च त्रयोदशयामस्ति तत्र कथं भवेत् //
text_mt: When the eleventh lunar day is complete and pure, and nothing of it remains on the twelfth, / and the twelfth extends into the thirteenth, what should be done in that case?

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvā gṛhasthaiḥ kāryātra yatibhiścottarā tithiḥ /
upoṣyaiva dvitīyeti kecidāhuśca bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वा गृहस्थैः कार्यात्र यतिभिश्चोत्तरा तिथिः /
उपोष्यैव द्वितीयेति केचिदाहुश्च भक्तितः //
text_mt: Here, householders should observe the former lunar day, and ascetics the latter. / Some say out of devotion that one should fast on the second [day].

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī yadāviddhā dvādaśyāṃ na pratīyate /
dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāmasti tatraiva cāpare //
meaning:
एकादशी यदाविद्धा द्वादश्यां न प्रतीयते /
द्वादशी च त्रयोदश्यामस्ति तत्रैव चापरे //
text_mt: When the eleventh lunar day is overlapped [at dawn] and does not appear on the twelfth, / but the twelfth extends into the thirteenth, then on that matter others [state]:

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā sarvaireva na saṃśayaḥ /
kecidāhuśca pūrvāṃ tu tanmataṃ na samañjasam //
meaning:
उपोष्या द्वादशी शुद्धा सर्वैरेव न संशयः /
केचिदाहुश्च पूर्वां तु तन्मतं न समञ्जसम् //
text_mt: All persons, without doubt, should fast on the pure twelfth day. / Some recommend the former day, but their opinion is not proper.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrātau ravivāre ca pātagrahaṇayostathā /
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryātputravāngṛhī //
meaning:
संक्रातौ रविवारे च पातग्रहणयोस्तथा /
पारणं चोपवासं च न कुर्यात्पुत्रवान्गृही //
text_mt: At a solstice, on a Sunday, during an inauspicious planetary conjunction, and during an eclipse, / a householder with a son should neither break a fast nor observe a fast.

sanskrit_iast:
arke 'hni parvarātraghau ca caturdaśyaṣṭamī divā /
ekādaśyāmahorātraṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret //
meaning:
अर्के ऽह्नि पर्वरात्रघौ च चतुर्दश्यष्टमी दिवा /
एकादश्यामहोरात्रं भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् //
text_mt: On a Sunday, at night on a festival day, during the day on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days, / [or] on the eleventh day and night, if one eats, one should perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityagrahaṇe prātpe pūrvayāmatraye tathā /
nādyādvai yadi bhuñjīta surāpena samo bhavet //
meaning:
आदित्यग्रहणे प्रात्पे पूर्वयामत्रये तथा /
नाद्याद्वै यदि भुञ्जीत सुरापेन समो भवेत् //
text_mt: When a solar eclipse has occurred, during the preceding three watches / one should not eat; if one should eat, one becomes equal to a drinker of liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
anvādhāneṣṭimadhye tu grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ muniśreṣṭha karttavyaṃ tatra yājñikaiḥ //
meaning:
अन्वाधानेष्टिमध्ये तु ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः /
प्रायश्चित्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कर्त्तव्यं तत्र याज्ञिकैः //
text_mt: If an eclipse of the moon or the sun occurs during the anvādhāna and iṣṭi sacrifices, / O best of sages, the sacrificial priests must perform an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
cadroparāge juhuyāddaśame soma ityṛcā /
āpyāyasva ṛcā caiva somapāsta iti dvija //
meaning:
चद्रोपरागे जुहुयाद्दशमे सोम इत्यृचा /
आप्यायस्व ऋचा चैव सोमपास्त इति द्विज //
text_mt: During a lunar eclipse, one should offer an oblation with the tenth verse, 'soma...', / and with the verse 'āpyāyasva...', and 'somapāsta...', O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryoparāge juhuyādudutyaṃ jātavedasam /
āsatyeṃnodvayaṃ caiva trayomantrā udāhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्योपरागे जुहुयादुदुत्यं जातवेदसम् /
आसत्येंनोद्वयं चैव त्रयोमन्त्रा उदाहृताः //
text_mt: During a solar eclipse, one should offer an oblation with 'udutyaṃ jātavedasam...', / and with two verses beginning with 'āsatyena...': these three mantras are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tithiṃ viniścitya smṛtimārgeṇa paṇḍitaḥ /
yaḥ karoti vratādīni tasya syādakṣayaṃ phalam //
meaning:
एवं तिथिं विनिश्चित्य स्मृतिमार्गेण पण्डितः /
यः करोति व्रतादीनि तस्य स्यादक्षयं फलम् //
text_mt: Having thus determined the lunar day according to the path of traditional law, a learned person / who performs vows and the like obtains inexhaustible fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
vedapraṇihito dharmo dharmaistuṣyati keśavaḥ /
tasmāddharmaparā yānti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
वेदप्रणिहितो धर्मो धर्मैस्तुष्यति केशवः /
तस्माद्धर्मपरा यान्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Righteousness is ordained by the Veda; through righteousness Keśava is pleased. / Therefore those devoted to righteousness go to that supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmānye karttumicchanti te vai kṛṣṇasvarupiṇaḥ /
tasmāttāṃstu bhavavyādhiḥ kadācinnaiva bādhate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde tithyādinirṇayo nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
धर्मान्ये कर्त्तुमिच्छन्ति ते वै कृष्णस्वरुपिणः /
तस्मात्तांस्तु भवव्याधिः कदाचिन्नैव बाधते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे तिथ्यादिनिर्णयो नाम एकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those who desire to perform duties are indeed of the nature of Kṛṣṇa. / Therefore the disease of worldly existence never afflicts them.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Determination of Lunar Days and the Like', in the first quarter of the first part in the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
prāyaścittavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada sāṃpratam /
prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā sarvakarmaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
प्रायश्चित्तविधिं वक्ष्ये शृणु नारद सांप्रतम् /
प्रायश्चित्तविशुद्धात्मा सर्वकर्मफलं लभेत् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
Now I will declare the rule of expiation; listen, Nārada. / One whose self is purified by expiation attains the fruit of all rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittavihīnaistu yatkarma kriyate mune /
tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ proktaṃ rākṣasaiḥ parisevitam //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तविहीनैस्तु यत्कर्म क्रियते मुने /
तत्सर्वं निष्फलं प्रोक्तं राक्षसैः परिसेवितम् //
text_mt: Whatever ritual is performed by those devoid of expiation, O sage, / all that is declared fruitless and enjoyed by demons.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhavihīnaiśca dharmaśāstraviśāradaiḥ /
praṣṭavyā brāhmaṇā dharmaṃ sarvadharmaphalecchubhiḥ //
meaning:
कामक्रोधविहीनैश्च धर्मशास्त्रविशारदैः /
प्रष्टव्या ब्राह्मणा धर्मं सर्वधर्मफलेच्छुभिः //
text_mt: By those who desire the fruits of all duties, Brahmins who are free from lust and anger / and skilled in the treatises on dharma should be questioned about righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni nārāyaṇaparāṅmukhaiḥ /
na niṣpunanti viprendra surābhāṇḍamivāpagāḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तानि चीर्णानि नारायणपराङ्मुखैः /
न निष्पुनन्ति विप्रेन्द्र सुराभाण्डमिवापगाः //
text_mt: Expiations performed by those who have turned their faces away from Nārāyaṇa / do not purify, O best of Brahmins, just as rivers [do not purify] a wine jar.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ /
mahāpātakinanastvete tatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महा च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः /
महापातकिननस्त्वेते तत्संसर्गी च पञ्चमः //
text_mt: The killer of a Brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and a violator of the guru's bed— / these are great sinners, and one who associates with them is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ hyataiḥ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ /
saṃvasetsaha taṃ vidyātpatitaṃ sarvakarmasu //
meaning:
यस्तु संवत्सरं ह्यतैः शयनासनभोजनैः /
संवसेत्सह तं विद्यात्पतितं सर्वकर्मसु //
text_mt: Whoever dwells with them for a year, sharing a bed, a seat, or food, / one should know that person to have fallen from all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānādvāhmaṇaṃ hatvā cīravāsā jaṭī bhavet /
svenaiva hataviprasya kapālamapi dhārayet //
meaning:
अज्ञानाद्वाह्मणं हत्वा चीरवासा जटी भवेत् /
स्वेनैव हतविप्रस्य कपालमपि धारयेत् //
text_mt: Having killed a Brahmin unintentionally, one should wear bark garments and matted hair; / he should also carry the skull of the Brahmin killed by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāve muniśraṣṭa kapālaṃ vānyameva vā /
taddravyaṃ dhvajadaṇḍe tu dhṛtvā vanacaro bhavet //
meaning:
तदभावे मुनिश्रष्ट कपालं वान्यमेव वा /
तद्द्रव्यं ध्वजदण्डे तु धृत्वा वनचरो भवेत् //
text_mt: In the absence of that, O best of sages, [he should carry] another skull, / and fastening that item to a staff, he should become a wanderer in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
vanyāhāro vasetatra vāramekaṃ mitāśanaḥ /
samyaksaṃdhyāmupāsīta trikālaṃ snānamācaret //
meaning:
वन्याहारो वसेतत्र वारमेकं मिताशनः /
सम्यक्संध्यामुपासीत त्रिकालं स्नानमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Living on forest food, he should dwell there eating a moderate amount once [a day]; / he should properly attend to the twilight worship and bathe at the three divisions of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyayanādhyāpanādūnvarjayetsaṃsmareddharim /
brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ gandhamālyādi varjayet //
meaning:
अध्ययनाध्यापनादून्वर्जयेत्संस्मरेद्धरिम् /
ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्नित्यं गन्धमाल्यादि वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: He should abstain from reciting and teaching the Veda, and remember Hari; / he should remain continually chaste, and avoid perfumes, garlands, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānyanuvaseccaiva puṇyāścāvāśramāṃstathā /
yadi vanyairna jīveta grāme bhikṣāṃ samācaret //
meaning:
तीर्थान्यनुवसेच्चैव पुण्याश्चावाश्रमांस्तथा /
यदि वन्यैर्न जीवेत ग्रामे भिक्षां समाचरेत् //
text_mt: He should dwell near sacred fords and holy hermitages; / if he cannot live on wild food, he may beg for alms in a village.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśābdaṃ vrataṃ kuryādevaṃ hariparāyaṇaḥ /
brahmahā śuddhimānpoti karmārhaścaiva jāyate //
meaning:
द्वादशाब्दं व्रतं कुर्यादेवं हरिपरायणः /
ब्रह्महा शुद्धिमान्पोति कर्मार्हश्चैव जायते //
text_mt: Devoted to Hari, he should perform this vow for twelve years; / the killer of a Brahmin then attains purification and becomes fit for rites.

sanskrit_iast:
vratamadhye mṛgairvāpi rogairvāpi niṣūditaḥ /
gonimittaṃ dvijārthaṃ vā prāṇānvāpi parityajet //
meaning:
व्रतमध्ये मृगैर्वापि रोगैर्वापि निषूदितः /
गोनिमित्तं द्विजार्थं वा प्राणान्वापि परित्यजेत् //
text_mt: In the course of the vow, whether slain by wild animals or by diseases, / or giving up his life for the sake of a cow or for a Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā dadyāddvijendrāṇāṃ gavāmayutamuttasam /
eteṣvanyatamaṃ kṛtvā brahmahā śuddhimānpuyāt //
meaning:
यद्वा दद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राणां गवामयुतमुत्तसम् /
एतेष्वन्यतमं कृत्वा ब्रह्महा शुद्धिमान्पुयात् //
text_mt: or if he gives ten thousand excellent cows to the best of Brahmins, / having performed any one of these, the killer of a Brahmin obtains purification.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitaṃ kṣatriyaṃ hatvā careddhi brahmahavratam /
agnipraveśanaṃ vāpi marutprapatanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
दीक्षितं क्षत्रियं हत्वा चरेद्धि ब्रह्महव्रतम् /
अग्निप्रवेशनं वापि मरुत्प्रपतनं तथा //
text_mt: Having slain an initiated Kṣatriya, one should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin, / or enter into fire, or cast oneself from a precipice.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣītaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā dviguṇaṃ vratamācaret /
ācāryādivadhe caiva vratamuktaṃ caturguṇam //
meaning:
दीक्षीतं ब्राह्मणं हत्वा द्विगुणं व्रतमाचरेत् /
आचार्यादिवधे चैव व्रतमुक्तं चतुर्गुणम् //
text_mt: Having slain an initiated Brahmin, one should observe twice that vow; / and for slaying an ācārya or the like, the vow is declared to be fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tu vipramātraṃ ca caretsaṃvatsaraṃ vratam /
evaṃ viprasya gaditaḥ prāyaścittavidhirdvija //
meaning:
हत्वा तु विप्रमात्रं च चरेत्संवत्सरं व्रतम् /
एवं विप्रस्य गदितः प्रायश्चित्तविधिर्द्विज //
text_mt: For slaying an ordinary Brahmin, one should observe the vow for a year. / Thus has the rule of expiation been declared for a Brahmin, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
/
dviguṇaṃ kṣatriyasyoktaṃ triguṇaṃ tu viśaḥ smṛtam /
brāhmaṇaṃ hṝnti yaḥ śūdrastaṃ muśalyaṃ virdurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
/
द्विगुणं क्षत्रियस्योक्तं त्रिगुणं तु विशः स्मृतम् /
ब्राह्मणं हॄन्ति यः शूद्रस्तं मुशल्यं विर्दुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: Twice as much is prescribed for a kṣatriya, and three times as much for a vaiśya; / the wise know that a śūdra who kills a brāhmaṇa is to be executed with an iron pestle.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaiva śikṣā kartavyā iti śāsteṣu niścayaḥ /
brāhmaṇīnāṃ vadhe tvarddhaṃ pādaḥ syātkanyakāvadhe //
meaning:
राज्ञैव शिक्षा कर्तव्या इति शास्तेषु निश्चयः /
ब्राह्मणीनां वधे त्वर्द्धं पादः स्यात्कन्यकावधे //
text_mt: Punishment must be inflicted by the king alone: such is the determination in the treatises. / In the case of slaying Brahmin women, [the penance is] one half; in slaying a maiden, one quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tvanupanītāṃśca tathā pādavrataṃ caret /
hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vipraḥ ṣaḍabdaṃ kucchramācaret //
meaning:
हत्वा त्वनुपनीतांश्च तथा पादव्रतं चरेत् /
हत्वा तु क्षत्रियं विप्रः षडब्दं कुच्छ्रमाचरेत् //
text_mt: For killing uninitiated boys, one should likewise observe a quarter of the vow. / Having killed a Kṣatriya, a Brahmin should perform the kṛcchra penance for six years.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ trayaṃ veśyaṃ śūrdraṃ hatvā tu vatsaram /
dīkṣitasya striyaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇī cāṣṭavatsarān //
meaning:
संवत्सरं त्रयं वेश्यं शूर्द्रं हत्वा तु वत्सरम् /
दीक्षितस्य स्त्रियं हत्वा ब्राह्मणी चाष्टवत्सरान् //
text_mt: For killing a Vaiśya, [he should perform it for] three years, and for killing a Śūdra, for one year. / For killing the wife of an initiated man or a Brahmin woman, [he should perform it for] eight years.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kṛtvā śuddho bhavati niścitam /
prāvaścittaṃ vidhānaṃ tu sarvatra munisattama //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कृत्वा शुद्धो भवति निश्चितम् /
प्रावश्चित्तं विधानं तु सर्वत्र मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: Having performed the vow for slaying a Brahmin, he certainly becomes purified. / Such is the procedure for expiation everywhere, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhāturastrībālānāmarddhamuktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ /
gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyā trividhā surā //
meaning:
वृद्धातुरस्त्रीबालानामर्द्धमुक्तं मनीषिभिः /
गौडी पैष्टी च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा //
text_mt: Half is declared by the wise for the aged, the sick, women, and children. / Liquor is to be known as threefold: made from molasses, made from flour, and made from honey.

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvarṇyārapeyā syāttathā strībhiśca nārada /
kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vā gomūtrameteṣvanyatamaṃ mune //
meaning:
चातुर्वर्ण्यारपेया स्यात्तथा स्त्रीभिश्च नारद /
क्षीरं घृतं वा गोमूत्रमेतेष्वन्यतमं मुने //
text_mt: It should not be drunk by the four castes, nor by women, O Nārada. / [Heating] milk, clarified butter, or cow urine—any one of these, O sage—

sanskrit_iast:
snātvardravāsā niyato nārāyaṇamanusmaran /
pakvāyasanibhaṃ kṛtvā pibejcaivodakaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वर्द्रवासा नियतो नारायणमनुस्मरन् /
पक्वायसनिभं कृत्वा पिबेज्चैवोदकं ततः //
text_mt: having bathed, wearing wet clothes, restrained, contemplating Nārāyaṇa, / making it red-hot like boiling iron, he should then drink that liquid.

sanskrit_iast:
tattu lauhena pātreṇa hyāyasenāthavā pibet /
tāmreṇa vāthaṃ pātreṇa tatpītvā maraṇaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
तत्तु लौहेन पात्रेण ह्यायसेनाथवा पिबेत् /
ताम्रेण वाथं पात्रेण तत्पीत्वा मरणं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He should drink it with an iron vessel, or else of steel, / or with a copper vessel; having drunk that, he goes to death.

sanskrit_iast:
surāpī śuddhimānpoti nānyathā śuddhiriṣyate /
ajñānādātmabuddyā tu surāṃ pītvā dvijaścaret //
meaning:
सुरापी शुद्धिमान्पोति नान्यथा शुद्धिरिष्यते /
अज्ञानादात्मबुद्द्या तु सुरां पीत्वा द्विजश्चरेत् //
text_mt: The drinker of liquor thus attains purification; in no other way is purification approved. / If a twice-born drinks liquor unintentionally, thinking it to be something else, he should perform

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāvrataṃ samyaktaccihnaparivarjitaḥ /
yadi rogānivṛttyarthamauṣadhārthaṃ surāṃ pibet //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं सम्यक्तच्चिह्नपरिवर्जितः /
यदि रोगानिवृत्त्यर्थमौषधार्थं सुरां पिबेत् //
text_mt: the full vow for killing a Brahmin, without carrying its insignia. / If he drinks liquor to cure a disease, for the purpose of medicine,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopanayanaṃ bhūyastathā cāndrāyaṇadvayam /
surāsaṃspṛṣṭapātraṃ tu surābhāṇḍodakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तस्योपनयनं भूयस्तथा चान्द्रायणद्वयम् /
सुरासंस्पृष्टपात्रं तु सुराभाण्डोदकं तथा //
text_mt: he must undergo the investiture with the sacred thread again, and two cāndrāyaṇa penances. / A vessel touched by liquor and water from a liquor jar

sanskrit_iast:
surāpānasamaṃ prāhustathā candrasya bhakṣaṇam /
tālaṃ ca pānasaṃ caiva drākṣaṃ khārjūrasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
सुरापानसमं प्राहुस्तथा चन्द्रस्य भक्षणम् /
तालं च पानसं चैव द्राक्षं खार्जूरसंभवम् //
text_mt: they declare to be equal to drinking liquor; and likewise the eating of moon-wort. / Liquor made from palmyra, jackfruit, grape, date-palm,

sanskrit_iast:
mādhuka śailamāriṣṭaṃ maireyaṃ nālikerajam /
gauḍī mādhvī surā madyamevamekādaśa smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
माधुक शैलमारिष्टं मैरेयं नालिकेरजम् /
गौडी माध्वी सुरा मद्यमेवमेकादश स्मृताः //
text_mt: madhūka flowers, śaila, ariṣṭa berries, maireya, and coconut, / molasses-liquor, honey-liquor, surā, and madya—thus eleven are remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvanyatamaṃ vipro na pibedvai kadācana /
eteṣvanyatamaṃ yastu pivedajñānato dvijaḥ //
meaning:
एतेष्वन्यतमं विप्रो न पिबेद्वै कदाचन /
एतेष्वन्यतमं यस्तु पिवेदज्ञानतो द्विजः //
text_mt: A Brahmin should never drink any one of these. / The twice-born person who unknowingly drinks any one of these,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopanayanaṃ bhūyastatpakṛcchraṃ carettathā /
samakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā balāccauyaṇa vā tathā //
meaning:
तस्योपनयनं भूयस्तत्पकृच्छ्रं चरेत्तथा /
समक्षं वा परोक्षं वा बलाच्चौयण वा तथा //
text_mt: must undergo investiture with the sacred thread again, and perform the kṛcchra penance. / Whether openly or secretly, or by force or by stealth,

sanskrit_iast:
parasvānāmupādānaṃ steyamityucyate budhaiḥ /
suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ tu manvādyaiḥ paribhāṣitam //
meaning:
परस्वानामुपादानं स्तेयमित्युच्यते बुधैः /
सुवर्णस्य प्रमाणं तु मन्वाद्यैः परिभाषितम् //
text_mt:
The taking of another's property is called theft by the wise.
The measure of gold, however, has been defined by Manu and others.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye śṛṇuṣva viprendra prāyaścajitoktisādhanam /
gavākṣāgatamārtaṇḍaraśmimadhye pradṛśyate //
meaning:
वक्ष्ये शृणुष्व विप्रेन्द्र प्रायश्चजितोक्तिसाधनम् /
गवाक्षागतमार्तण्डरश्मिमध्ये प्रदृश्यते //
text_mt:
I shall state it; listen, O foremost of Brahmins, to the standard prescribed for expiation.
That which is seen in the midst of a sunbeam entered through a lattice window,

sanskrit_iast:
trasareṇupramāṇaṃ tu raja ityucyate budhaiḥ /
trasareṇvaṣṭakaṃ niṣkastatrayaṃ rājasarṣapaḥ //
meaning:
त्रसरेणुप्रमाणं तु रज इत्युच्यते बुधैः /
त्रसरेण्वष्टकं निष्कस्तत्रयं राजसर्षपः //
text_mt:
the measure of a mote (trasareṇu), is called a dust particle (rajas) by the wise.
Eight motes are a niṣka; three of those are a black mustard seed (rājasarṣapa).

sanskrit_iast:
maurasarṣapastartrayaṃ syāttatṣaṭkaṃ yava ucyate /
yavatrayaṃ kṛṣṇalaḥ syānmāṣastatpañcakaṃ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मौरसर्षपस्तर्त्रयं स्यात्तत्षट्कं यव उच्यते /
यवत्रयं कृष्णलः स्यान्माषस्तत्पञ्चकं स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Three of those are a white mustard seed (gaurasarṣapa); six of those are said to be a barleycorn (yava).
Three barleycorns are a guñjā berry (kṛṣṇala); five of those are considered a māṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
māṣaṣoḍaṣamānaṃ syātsuvarṇamiti nārada /
hatvā brahmasvamajñānāddvādaśāṃbdaṃ tu pūrvavat //
meaning:
माषषोडषमानं स्यात्सुवर्णमिति नारद /
हत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमज्ञानाद्द्वादशांब्दं तु पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: The measure of sixteen māṣas is a suvarṇa, O Nārada. / Having taken a Brahmin's property unwittingly, [he should perform penance] for twelve years as before,

sanskrit_iast:
kapāladhvajahīnaṃ tu brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret /
guruṇāṃ yajñakatṝṇāṃ dhārmiṣṭānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
कपालध्वजहीनं तु ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
गुरुणां यज्ञकतॄणां धार्मिष्टानां तथैव च //
text_mt: and observe the vow for killing a Brahmin, but without the skull and staff. / Likewise, [if one takes] the gold of gurus, of sacrifice-performers, of the righteous,

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāṇāṃ dvijānāṃ tu hṛtvā hemaivamācaret /
kṛtānutāpo dehe ca saṃpūrṇe lepayed dhṛtam //
meaning:
श्रोत्रियाणां द्विजानां तु हृत्वा हेमैवमाचरेत् /
कृतानुतापो देहे च संपूर्णे लेपयेद् धृतम् //
text_mt: or of Vedic-scholar twice-born men, one should act in this way. / Full of remorse, he should smear his whole body with ghee;

sanskrit_iast:
karīṣacchādito dagdhaḥ steyapāpādvimucyate /
brahmasvaṃ kṣatriyo hṛtvā paścāttāpamavāpya ca //
meaning:
करीषच्छादितो दग्धः स्तेयपापाद्विमुच्यते /
ब्रह्मस्वं क्षत्रियो हृत्वा पश्चात्तापमवाप्य च //
text_mt: covered with dried cow dung and burnt, he is freed from the sin of theft. / If a Kṣatriya steals a Brahmin's property and then feels remorse,

sanskrit_iast:
punardadāti tatraiva tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me /
tatra sāṃtapanaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśāhopavāsataḥ //
meaning:
पुनर्ददाति तत्रैव तद्विधानं शृणुष्व मे /
तत्र सांतपनं कृत्वा द्वादशाहोपवासतः //
text_mt: and returns it right there, listen to my rule for that: / having performed the sāṃtapana [penance] there with a fast of twelve days,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhimāpnoti devarṣe hyanyathā patito bhavet /
rantāsanamanuṣyastrīdhenubhūmyādikeṣu ca //
meaning:
शुद्धिमाप्नोति देवर्षे ह्यन्यथा पतितो भवेत् /
रन्तासनमनुष्यस्त्रीधेनुभूम्यादिकेषु च //
text_mt: he attains purification, O divine sage; otherwise he becomes fallen. / In the case of jewels, seats, male or female slaves, cows, land, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇasahṛśeṣveṣu prāyaścitārddhamucyate /
trasareṇusamaṃ hema hṛtvā kuryātsamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
सुवर्णसहृशेष्वेषु प्रायश्चितार्द्धमुच्यते /
त्रसरेणुसमं हेम हृत्वा कुर्यात्समाहितः //
text_mt: which are equal to gold, half the penance is prescribed. / Having stolen gold equal [in weight] to a trasareṇu, one should attentively perform

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmadvayaṃ samyak tena śuddhaccati mānavaḥ /
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāddhṛtvā niṣkapramāṇakam //
meaning:
प्राणायामद्वयं सम्यक् तेन शुद्धच्चति मानवः /
प्राणायामत्रयं कुर्याद्धृत्वा निष्कप्रमाणकम् //
text_mt: two breath-controls properly; through that a person is purified. / Having stolen [gold] the measure of a niṣka, he should perform three breath-controls.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmāśca catvāro rājasarṣa pamātrake /
gaurasarṣapamānaṃ tu hṛtvā hema vicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्राणायामाश्च चत्वारो राजसर्ष पमात्रके /
गौरसर्षपमानं तु हृत्वा हेम विचक्षणः //
text_mt: Four breath-controls [are prescribed] for the measure of a black mustard seed. / Having stolen gold to the measure of a white mustard seed, a wise man,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā ca vidhivajjapyādgāyatryaṣṭasahasrakam /
yavamātrasuvarṇasya steyācchuddho bhaveddijaḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा च विधिवज्जप्याद्गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रकम् /
यवमात्रसुवर्णस्य स्तेयाच्छुद्धो भवेद्दिजः //
text_mt: having bathed according to rule, should recite eight thousand [times] the gāyatrī. / From stealing gold merely the size of a barleycorn, a twice-born becomes purified

sanskrit_iast:
āsāyaṃ prātarārabhya japtvā vai vedamātaram /
hema kṛṣṇalamātraṃ tu hṛtvā sāṃtapanaṃ caret //
meaning:
आसायं प्रातरारभ्य जप्त्वा वै वेदमातरम् /
हेम कृष्णलमात्रं तु हृत्वा सांतपनं चरेत् //
text_mt: by reciting the mother of the Vedas from morning until evening. / Having stolen gold merely the size of a kṛṣṇala, he should observe the sāṃtapana.

sanskrit_iast:
māṣapramāṇe hemnastu prāyaścittaṃ nigadyate /
gomūtrapakvayavabhugvarṣeṇaikena śuddhyati //
meaning:
माषप्रमाणे हेम्नस्तु प्रायश्चित्तं निगद्यते /
गोमूत्रपक्वयवभुग्वर्षेणैकेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: The penance is declared for gold to the measure of a māṣa: / eating barley cooked in cow's urine, he is purified in one year.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇasya suvarṇasya steyaṃ kṛtvā munīśvara /
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryāddvādaśābdaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
संपूर्णस्य सुवर्णस्य स्तेयं कृत्वा मुनीश्वर /
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्याद्द्वादशाब्दं समाहितः //
text_mt: Having committed the theft of a whole suvarṇa, O lord of sages, / he should attentively observe the vow for killing a Brahmin for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇamānānnyūne tu rajatasteyakarmaṇi /
kuryātsāṃtapanaṃ samyaganyathā patito bhavet //
meaning:
सुवर्णमानान्न्यूने तु रजतस्तेयकर्मणि /
कुर्यात्सांतपनं सम्यगन्यथा पतितो भवेत् //
text_mt: In the act of stealing silver that is less than the measure of a suvarṇa, / he should properly observe the sāṃtapana; otherwise he becomes fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaniṣkāntaparyantamūrddhūṃ niṣkacatuṣṭayāt /
hatvā ca rajataṃ vidvānkuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ mune //
meaning:
दशनिष्कान्तपर्यन्तमूर्द्धूं निष्कचतुष्टयात् /
हत्वा च रजतं विद्वान्कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणं मुने //
text_mt: Above four niṣkas up to the limit of ten niṣkas, / having taken silver, O sage, the wise man should perform a cāndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
daśādiśatiṣkāntaṃ yaḥ steyī rajatasya tu /
cāndrāyaṇadvayaṃ tasya proktaṃ pāpaviśodhakam //
meaning:
दशादिशतिष्कान्तं यः स्तेयी रजतस्य तु /
चान्द्रायणद्वयं तस्य प्रोक्तं पापविशोधकम् //
text_mt: He who is a thief of silver from ten [niṣkas] up to a hundred niṣkas, / two cāndrāyaṇas are prescribed as the purifier of his sin.

sanskrit_iast:
śatādūrddhūṃ sahasrāntaṃ proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇatrayam /
sahasrādadhikasteye brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret //
meaning:
शतादूर्द्धूं सहस्रान्तं प्रोक्तं चान्द्रायणत्रयम् /
सहस्रादधिकस्तेये ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt: Above a hundred up to a thousand, three cāndrāyaṇas are prescribed; / for a theft of more than a thousand, he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyapittalamukhyeṣu hyayaskānte tathaiva ca /
sahasraniṣkamāne tu parākaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
कांस्यपित्तलमुख्येषु ह्ययस्कान्ते तथैव च /
सहस्रनिष्कमाने तु पराकं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: In the case of [thefts of] bronze, brass, and the like, as well as magnetic iron / to the amount of a thousand niṣkas, a parāka is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ tu rantānāṃ steye rājatavatsmṛtam /
gurutalpagatānāṃ ca prāyaścittamudīryate //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं तु रन्तानां स्तेये राजतवत्स्मृतम् /
गुरुतल्पगतानां च प्रायश्चित्तमुदीर्यते //
text_mt: The penance for the theft of jewels is considered like that for silver. / Now the penance is declared for those who have violated the guru's bed:

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānānmātaraṃ gatvā tatsapatnīmathāpi vā /
svayameva svamuṣkaṃ tu cchindyātpāpamudīrayan //
meaning:
अज्ञानान्मातरं गत्वा तत्सपत्नीमथापि वा /
स्वयमेव स्वमुष्कं तु च्छिन्द्यात्पापमुदीरयन् //
text_mt: Having unwittingly gone to his mother, or to his father's other wife, / he should cut off his own testicles himself while proclaiming his sin.

sanskrit_iast:
haste gṛhītvā muṣkaṃ tu gacchandvai naiṛtīṃ diśam /
gacchanmārgai sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ na kadācidvicārayet //
meaning:
हस्ते गृहीत्वा मुष्कं तु गच्छन्द्वै नैऋतीं दिशम् /
गच्छन्मार्गै सुखं दुःखं न कदाचिद्विचारयेत् //
text_mt: Taking the testicles in hand and walking towards the southwest direction, / while walking on the road he should never consider pleasure or pain.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyangacchato gacchetpāṇāntaṃ yaḥ sa śuddhyati /
marutprapatanaṃ vāpi kuryātpāpamudāharan //
meaning:
अपश्यन्गच्छतो गच्छेत्पाणान्तं यः स शुद्ध्यति /
मरुत्प्रपतनं वापि कुर्यात्पापमुदाहरन् //
text_mt: Walking blindly until his life ends, he who [does this] is purified; / or he may leap from a precipice while proclaiming his sin.

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇottamavarṇastrīgamane tvavicārataḥ /
brāhmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādvādaśābdaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
स्ववर्णोत्तमवर्णस्त्रीगमने त्वविचारतः /
ब्राह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्याद्वादशाब्दं समाहितः //
text_mt: In having intercourse thoughtlessly with a woman of one's own class or a higher class, / he should attentively observe the vow for killing a Brahmin for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
amatyābhyāsato gacchetsavarṇāṃ cottamāṃ tathā /
kārīṣavahninā dagdhaḥ śuddhiṃ yāti dvijottama //
meaning:
अमत्याभ्यासतो गच्छेत्सवर्णां चोत्तमां तथा /
कारीषवह्निना दग्धः शुद्धिं याति द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: If he approaches a woman of his own class or of a higher class unintentionally out of habit, / burnt by a fire of dry cow dung, he attains purification, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
retaḥsekātpūrvameva nivṛtto yadi mātari /
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādretaḥ seke 'gnidāhanam //
meaning:
रेतःसेकात्पूर्वमेव निवृत्तो यदि मातरि /
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्याद्रेतः सेके ऽग्निदाहनम् //
text_mt: If he desists from his mother before the emission of semen, / he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin; if semen was emitted, burning in fire [is prescribed].

sanskrit_iast:
savarṇottamavarṇāsu nivṛtto vīryasecanāt /
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryānnavābdānviṣṇutatparaḥ //
meaning:
सवर्णोत्तमवर्णासु निवृत्तो वीर्यसेचनात् /
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्यान्नवाब्दान्विष्णुतत्परः //
text_mt: Having desisted before emitting semen with women of his own class or higher classes, / he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin for nine years, devoted to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyāyāṃ pitṛpatnyāṃ tu ṣaḍabdaṃ vratamācaret /
gatvā śūdvāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ trivarṣaṃ vratamācaret //
meaning:
वैश्यायां पितृपत्न्यां तु षडब्दं व्रतमाचरेत् /
गत्वा शूद्वां गुरोर्भार्यां त्रिवर्षं व्रतमाचरेत् //
text_mt: With a Vaiśya wife of his father, he should observe the vow for six years; / having approached a Śūdra wife of the guru, he should observe the vow for three years.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛṣvasāraṃ ca pitṛṣvasāramācāryabhāryāṃ śvaśurasya patnīm /
pitṛvyabhāryāmatha mātulānīṃ putrīṃ ca gacchedyadi kāmamugdhaḥ //
meaning:
मातृष्वसारं च पितृष्वसारमाचार्यभार्यां श्वशुरस्य पत्नीम् /
पितृव्यभार्यामथ मातुलानीं पुत्रीं च गच्छेद्यदि काममुग्धः //
text_mt: If infatuated by lust he approaches his mother's sister, his father's sister, / the teacher's wife, the wife of his father-in-law, / the wife of his paternal uncle, his maternal uncle's wife, or his daughter:

sanskrit_iast:
dinadvaye brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryādyathāvidhi /
ekasminneva divase bahuvāraṃ trivārṣikam //
meaning:
दिनद्वये ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्याद्यथाविधि /
एकस्मिन्नेव दिवसे बहुवारं त्रिवार्षिकम् //
text_mt: [if on] two days, he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin according to rule; / if many times on a single day, [a vow] of three years;

sanskrit_iast:
ekavāraṃ gate hyabdaṃvrataṃ kṛtvā viśuddhyati /
dinatraye gate vahnidagdhaḥ śudhyeta nānyathā //
meaning:
एकवारं गते ह्यब्दंव्रतं कृत्वा विशुद्ध्यति /
दिनत्रये गते वह्निदग्धः शुध्येत नान्यथा //
text_mt: if he went once, he is purified after performing a vow for a year; / if he went on three days, he is purified burnt by fire, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
cāñjālīṃ puṣkasīṃ caiva snuṣāṃ ca bhaginīṃ tathā /
mitrastriyaṃ śiṣyapatnīṃ yastu vai kāmato vrajet //
meaning:
चाञ्जालीं पुष्कसीं चैव स्नुषां च भगिनीं तथा /
मित्रस्त्रियं शिष्यपत्नीं यस्तु वै कामतो व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He who willfully approaches an outcaste woman, a Puṣkasa woman, / a daughter-in-law, a sister, / a friend's wife, or a disciple's wife:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryātsa ṣaḍabdaṃ munīśvara /
akāmato vrajedyastu so 'bdakṛcchraṃ samācaret //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं कुर्यात्स षडब्दं मुनीश्वर /
अकामतो व्रजेद्यस्तु सो ऽब्दकृच्छ्रं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: he should observe the vow for killing a Brahmin for six years, O lord of sages; / but he who approaches unintentionally should perform a kṛcchra for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakisaṃsarge prāyaścittaṃ nigadyate /
prāyaścittaviśuddhātmā sarvakarmaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
महापातकिसंसर्गे प्रायश्चित्तं निगद्यते /
प्रायश्चित्तविशुद्धात्मा सर्वकर्मफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: The penance is declared for association with a perpetrator of a great sin; / purified in soul by the penance, he attains the fruit of all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yena bhavetsaṃgo brahmahāndicaturṣvapi /
tattadvrataṃ sa nivrartya śuddhimānpotyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
यस्य येन भवेत्संगो ब्रह्महान्दिचतुर्ष्वपि /
तत्तद्व्रतं स निव्रर्त्य शुद्धिमान्पोत्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: Whoever has association with any of the four [types of sinners], beginning with the Brahmin-killer, / having performed that particular vow, he undoubtedly attains purification.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānātpañcarātraṃ tu saṃgamebhiḥ karotiyaḥ /
kāyakṛcchraṃ caretsamyaganyathā patito bhavet //
meaning:
अज्ञानात्पञ्चरात्रं तु संगमेभिः करोतियः /
कायकृच्छ्रं चरेत्सम्यगन्यथा पतितो भवेत् //
text_mt: He who unwittingly associates with these for five nights / should properly perform a kāyakṛcchra; otherwise he becomes fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāhetu saṃsarge mahāsāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam /
saṃgaṅkṛtvārddhamāsaṃ tu dvādaśāhamupāvaset //
meaning:
द्वादशाहेतु संसर्गे महासांतपनं स्मृतम् /
संगङ्कृत्वार्द्धमासं तु द्वादशाहमुपावसेत् //
text_mt: In the case of association for twelve days, a mahāsāṃtapana is prescribed; / having associated for half a month, he should fast for twelve days.

sanskrit_iast:
parāko māsasaṃsarge cāndramāsatrayesmṛtam /
kṛtvā saṃgaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ careccāndrāyaṇadvayam //
meaning:
पराको माससंसर्गे चान्द्रमासत्रयेस्मृतम् /
कृत्वा संगं तु षण्मासं चरेच्चान्द्रायणद्वयम् //
text_mt: A parāka is prescribed for association for a month; a cāndrāyaṇa for three months; / having associated for six months, he should perform two cāndrāyaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcinnyūnābdasaṃge tu ṣaṇmāsavratamācaret /
etacca triguṇaṃ proktaṃ jñānātsaṃge yathākramam //
meaning:
किञ्चिन्न्यूनाब्दसंगे तु षण्मासव्रतमाचरेत् /
एतच्च त्रिगुणं प्रोक्तं ज्ञानात्संगे यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: For association for slightly less than a year, he should observe a six-month vow; / and this is declared to be threefold in order for association done knowingly.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍūkaṃ nakulaṃ kākaṃ varāhaṃ mūṣakaṃ tathā /
mārjārājāvikaṃ śvānaṃ hatvā kukkuṭakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मण्डूकं नकुलं काकं वराहं मूषकं तथा /
मार्जाराजाविकं श्वानं हत्वा कुक्कुटकं तथा //
text_mt: Having killed a frog, a mongoose, a crow, a boar, a mouse, / a cat, a goat, a sheep, a dog, or a cock:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrārddhamācaredvipro 'tikṛcchraṃ cāśvaha caret /
jatpakṛcchraṃ karivadhe parākaṃ govadhe smṛtam //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रार्द्धमाचरेद्विप्रो ऽतिकृच्छ्रं चाश्वह चरेत् /
जत्पकृच्छ्रं करिवधे पराकं गोवधे स्मृतम् //
text_mt: a Brahmin should observe half a kṛcchra; the killer of a horse should observe an atikṛcchra; / a japtakṛcchra is prescribed for killing an elephant; a parāka for killing a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmato govadhe naiva śuddhirddaṣṭā manīṣibhiḥ /
pānaśayyāsanādyeṣu puṣpamūlaphaleṣu ca //
meaning:
कामतो गोवधे नैव शुद्धिर्द्दष्टा मनीषिभिः /
पानशय्यासनाद्येषु पुष्पमूलफलेषु च //
text_mt: For intentional cow-killing, no purification has been seen by the wise. / For theft of drinks, beds, seats, and the like, or flowers, roots, and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhojyāpahāreṣu pañcagavyaviśodhanam /
śuṣkakāṣṭatṛṇānāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca guḍasya ca //
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोज्यापहारेषु पञ्चगव्यविशोधनम् /
शुष्ककाष्टतृणानां च द्रुमाणां च गुडस्य च //
text_mt: and of foods that can be eaten or chewed, the purification is pañcagavya. / For [the theft] of dry wood, grass, trees, jaggery,

sanskrit_iast:
carmavastrāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam /
ṭiṭṭibhaṃ cakravākaṃ ca haṃsaṃ kāraṇḍavaṃ tathā //
meaning:
चर्मवस्त्रामिषाणां च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम् /
टिट्टिभं चक्रवाकं च हंसं कारण्डवं तथा //
text_mt: leather, cloth, and meat, there should be fasting for three nights. / Having killed a lapwing, a cakravāka, a goose, a kāraṇḍava duck,

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkaṃ sārasaṃ caiva pakotaṃ jalapādakam /
śukaṃ cāṣaṃ balākaṃ ca śiśumāraṃ ca kacchapam //
meaning:
उलूकं सारसं चैव पकोतं जलपादकम् /
शुकं चाषं बलाकं च शिशुमारं च कच्छपम् //
text_mt: an owl, a crane, a heron, a water-fowl, / a parrot, a blue jay, a egret, a dolphin, or a turtle—

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvanyatamaṃ hatvā dvādaśāhamabhojanam /
prājāpatyavrataṃ kuryādretoviṇmūtrabhojane //
meaning:
एतेष्वन्यतमं हत्वा द्वादशाहमभोजनम् /
प्राजापत्यव्रतं कुर्याद्रेतोविण्मूत्रभोजने //
text_mt: having killed any one of these, fasting for twelve days [is prescribed]. / He should perform the prājāpatya vow if he consumes semen, feces, or urine.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇatrayaṃ proktaṃ śūdrocchiṣṭasya bhojane /
rajasvalāṃ ca cāṇḍālaṃ mahāpātakinaṃ tathā //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणत्रयं प्रोक्तं शूद्रोच्छिष्टस्य भोजने /
रजस्वलां च चाण्डालं महापातकिनं तथा //
text_mt: Three cāndrāyaṇas are prescribed for eating the leftover food of a Śūdra. / Having touched a menstruating woman, a Cāṇḍāla, a perpetrator of a great sin,

sanskrit_iast:
sūtikāṃ patitaṃ caiva ucchiṣṭaṃ rajakādikam /
spṛṣṭvā sacailaṃ snāyīta ghṛtaṃ saṃprāśeyattathā //
meaning:
सूतिकां पतितं चैव उच्छिष्टं रजकादिकम् /
स्पृष्ट्वा सचैलं स्नायीत घृतं संप्राशेयत्तथा //
text_mt: a woman in childbed, a fallen man, or an impure washerman or the like, / he should bathe with his clothes on and consume ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ ca viśuddhātmā japedaṣṭaśataṃ dvija /
eteṣvanyatamaṃ spṛṣṭvā ajñānādhadyadi bhojane //
meaning:
गायत्रीं च विशुद्धात्मा जपेदष्टशतं द्विज /
एतेष्वन्यतमं स्पृष्ट्वा अज्ञानाधद्यदि भोजने //
text_mt: And, purified in soul, a twice-born should recite the gāyatrī one hundred and eight times. / If he unwittingly touches any of these while eating,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātro poṣaṇācchuddhye tpañcagavyāśanādvija /
snānadānajapādau ca bhojanādau ca nārada //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रो पोषणाच्छुद्ध्ये त्पञ्चगव्याशनाद्विज /
स्नानदानजपादौ च भोजनादौ च नारद //
text_mt: he is purified by fasting for three nights and consuming pañcagavya, O twice-born. / In bathing, giving gifts, reciting mantras, and eating, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmanyatamasyāpi śabdaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyādvadet /
udvameddhuktamaṃnnatatstrātvā copavasettathā //
meaning:
एषामन्यतमस्यापि शब्दं यः शृणुयाद्वदेत् /
उद्वमेद्धुक्तमंन्नतत्स्त्रात्वा चोपवसेत्तथा //
text_mt: whoever should hear the voice of any one of these or speak [to them] / must vomit up the food eaten, bathe, and likewise fast.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye 'hni ghṛtaṃ prāśya śuddhimānpoti nārada /
vratādimadhye yadyeṣā śṛṇuyāddhūnimapyuta //
meaning:
द्वितीये ऽह्नि घृतं प्राश्य शुद्धिमान्पोति नारद /
व्रतादिमध्ये यद्येषा शृणुयाद्धूनिमप्युत //
text_mt: On the second day, having consumed clarified butter, he attains purity, O Nārada. / Moreover, if in the midst of a vow or the like he should even hear their voice,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japedrai vedamātaram /
pāpānāmadhikaṃ pāpaṃ dvijadaivatanindanam //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु जपेद्रै वेदमातरम् /
पापानामधिकं पापं द्विजदैवतनिन्दनम् //
text_mt: he should recite the mother of the Vedas one thousand and eight times. / The greatest sin among sins is reviling twice-borns and deities;

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭvā niṣkṛtistasya sarvaśāstreṣu nārada /
mahāpātakatulyāni yāni proktāni sūribhiḥ //
meaning:
न दृष्ट्वा निष्कृतिस्तस्य सर्वशास्त्रेषु नारद /
महापातकतुल्यानि यानि प्रोक्तानि सूरिभिः //
text_mt: no expiation is seen for that in any of the scriptures, O Nārada. / For those that are declared by wise men to be equal to major sins,

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ tu teṣāṃ ca kuryādevaṃ yathāvidhi /
prāyaścittāni yaḥ kuryānnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं तु तेषां च कुर्यादेवं यथाविधि /
प्रायश्चित्तानि यः कुर्यान्नारायणपरायणः //
text_mt: he should perform an expiation for them according to the rules in this way. / Whoever performs expiations devoted to Nārāyaṇa—

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pāpāni naśyantihyanyathā patito bhavet /
yastu rāgādinirmukto hyanutāpasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पापानि नश्यन्तिह्यन्यथा पतितो भवेत् /
यस्तु रागादिनिर्मुक्तो ह्यनुतापसमन्वितः //
text_mt: his sins are destroyed; otherwise he would become fallen. / But one who is freed from attachment and the like, endowed with repentance,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtayayāyukto viṣṇusmaraṇatatparaḥ /
mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभूतययायुक्तो विष्णुस्मरणतत्परः /
महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: possessed of compassion for all beings, intent on remembering Viṣṇu— / whether tainted by a major sin or tainted by all sins—

sanskrit_iast:
vimukta eva pāpebhyo jñeyo viṣṇuparo yataḥ /
nārāyaṇamanāndyantaṃ viśvākāramanāmayam //
meaning:
विमुक्त एव पापेभ्यो ज्ञेयो विष्णुपरो यतः /
नारायणमनान्द्यन्तं विश्वाकारमनामयम् //
text_mt: is to be known as completely freed from sins, because he is devoted to Viṣṇu. / Whoever, being mortal, remembers Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
yastu saṃsmarate martyaḥ sa muktaḥ pāpakoṭibhiḥ /
smṛto vā pūjito vāpi dhyātaḥ praṇamito 'pi vā //
meaning:
यस्तु संस्मरते मर्त्यः स मुक्तः पापकोटिभिः /
स्मृतो वा पूजितो वापि ध्यातः प्रणमितो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: who has no beginning or end, whose form is the universe, who is free from affliction— / he is released from millions of sins. / Whether remembered, worshipped, meditated upon, or bowed down to,

sanskrit_iast:
nāśayatyeva pāpāni viṣṇurhṛdgamanaḥ satām /
saṃparkādyadi vā mohādyastu pūjayate harim //
meaning:
नाशयत्येव पापानि विष्णुर्हृद्गमनः सताम् /
संपर्काद्यदि वा मोहाद्यस्तु पूजयते हरिम् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, who dwells in the hearts of the virtuous, surely destroys sins. / If, even through contact or through delusion, one worships Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa prayāti hareḥ padam /
sakṛtsaṃsmaraṇādviṣṇornaśyanti kleśasaṃcayāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स प्रयाति हरेः पदम् /
सकृत्संस्मरणाद्विष्णोर्नश्यन्ति क्लेशसंचयाः //
text_mt: freed from all sins he goes to the abode of Hari. / From remembering Viṣṇu even once, the accumulations of distress are destroyed;

sanskrit_iast:
svargādibhogaprātpistu tasya viprānumīyate /
mānuṣaṃ durlabhaṃ janma prāpyate yairmunīśvara //
meaning:
स्वर्गादिभोगप्रात्पिस्तु तस्य विप्रानुमीयते /
मानुषं दुर्लभं जन्म प्राप्यते यैर्मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: the attainment of the pleasures of heaven and beyond is readily inferred for him, O learned one. / Those by whom human birth, so difficult to attain, is attained, O lord of sages—

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi haribhaktistu durlabhā parikīrttitā /
tasmāttaḍillatālolaṃ mānuṣyaṃ prāpya durlabham //
meaning:
तत्रापि हरिभक्तिस्तु दुर्लभा परिकीर्त्तिता /
तस्मात्तडिल्लतालोलं मानुष्यं प्राप्य दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: even in that, devotion to Hari is proclaimed to be difficult to attain. / Therefore, having attained human birth, rare [and] fleeting as a streak of lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
hariṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā paśupāśavimocanam /
sarve 'ntarāyā naśyanti manaḥśuddhiśca jāyate //
meaning:
हरिं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या पशुपाशविमोचनम् /
सर्वे ऽन्तराया नश्यन्ति मनःशुद्धिश्च जायते //
text_mt: one should worship Hari with devotion, the liberator from the bonds of living beings. / All obstacles perish, and purification of mind arises;

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ mokṣaṃ labheścaiva pūjite tu janārdane /
dharmārthakāmokṣākhyāḥ puruṣārthāḥ sanātanāḥ //
meaning:
परं मोक्षं लभेश्चैव पूजिते तु जनार्दने /
धर्मार्थकामोक्षाख्याः पुरुषार्थाः सनातनाः //
text_mt: and one obtains supreme liberation when Janārdana is worshipped. / The eternal aims of human life called virtue, wealth, pleasure, and liberation

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāparāṇāṃ tu sidhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ /
putradāragṛhakṣetradhanadhānyābhidhāvatīm //
meaning:
हरिपूजापराणां तु सिध्यन्ति नात्र संशयः /
पुत्रदारगृहक्षेत्रधनधान्याभिधावतीम् //
text_mt: are achieved by those intent on the worship of Hari; of this there is no doubt. / Having obtained this human station that runs toward

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvemāṃ mānuṣīṃ vṛttiṃ rere darpaṃ tu mā kṛthāḥ /
saṃtyajya kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ mohaṃ madaṃ tathā //
meaning:
लब्ध्वेमां मानुषीं वृत्तिं रेरे दर्पं तु मा कृथाः /
संत्यज्य कामं क्रोधं च लोभं मोहं मदं तथा //
text_mt: sons, wives, homes, fields, wealth, and grains, do not, O friend, be arrogant! / Abandoning desire and anger, greed, delusion, and pride,

sanskrit_iast:
parāpavādaṃ nindāṃ ca bhajadhvaṃ bhaktito harim /
vyāpārānsakalāṃstktvā pūjayadhvaṃ janārdanam //
meaning:
परापवादं निन्दां च भजध्वं भक्तितो हरिम् /
व्यापारान्सकलांस्त्क्त्वा पूजयध्वं जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: censure of others and reviling, serve Hari with devotion. / Abandoning all worldly business, worship Janārdana!

sanskrit_iast:
nikaṭā eva dṛśyante kṛtāntanagaradrumāḥ /
yāvannāyāti maraṇaṃ yāvannāyāti vai jarā //
meaning:
निकटा एव दृश्यन्ते कृतान्तनगरद्रुमाः /
यावन्नायाति मरणं यावन्नायाति वै जरा //
text_mt: The trees of the city of Death are already seen near at hand. / So long as death has not arrived, so long as old age has not come,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ tāvadevācaryeddharim /
dhīmānnakuryādviśvāsaṃ śarīre 'sminvinaśvare //
meaning:
यावन्नेन्द्रियवैकल्यं तावदेवाचर्येद्धरिम् /
धीमान्नकुर्याद्विश्वासं शरीरे ऽस्मिन्विनश्वरे //
text_mt: so long as the senses are not impaired, just so long should one worship Hari. / A wise man should not place trust in this perishable body;

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ sannihito mṛtyuḥ saṃpadatyantacañcalā /
āsannamaraṇo dehastasmāddarppaṃ vimucata //
meaning:
नित्यं सन्निहितो मृत्युः संपदत्यन्तचञ्चला /
आसन्नमरणो देहस्तस्माद्दर्प्पं विमुचत //
text_mt: death is always near, prosperity is exceedingly fickle, / [and] the body is close to dying; therefore, cast off pride!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogā viprayogāntāḥ sarvaṃ ca ghakṣaṇabhaṅguram /
etajjñātvā mahābhāga pūjayasva janārdanam //
meaning:
संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ताः सर्वं च घक्षणभङ्गुरम् /
एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाभाग पूजयस्व जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: Unions end in separation, and everything is fragile in an instant. / Knowing this, O fortunate one, worship Janārdana!

sanskrit_iast:
āśayā vyathate caiva mokṣastvatyantadurlabhaḥ /
bhaktyā yajati yo viṣṇuṃ mahāpātakavānapi //
meaning:
आशया व्यथते चैव मोक्षस्त्वत्यन्तदुर्लभः /
भक्त्या यजति यो विष्णुं महापातकवानपि //
text_mt: One suffers through expectation, and liberation is exceedingly rare; / [yet] whoever worships Viṣṇu with devotion, even if possessing major sins,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatragha gatvā na śocati /
sarvatīrthāni yajñāśca sāṃgā vedāśca sattama //
meaning:
सो ऽपि याति परं स्थानं यत्रघ गत्वा न शोचति /
सर्वतीर्थानि यज्ञाश्च सांगा वेदाश्च सत्तम //
text_mt: he too goes to the supreme place, having gone to which he grieves no more. / All the sacred fords and sacrifices, and the Vedas along with their auxiliary limbs, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇārcanasyaite kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm /
kiṃ vai vedairmakhaiḥ śāstraiḥ kiṃvā tīrthaniṣevaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
नारायणार्चनस्यैते कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् /
किं वै वेदैर्मखैः शास्त्रैः किंवा तीर्थनिषेवणैः //
text_mt: do not equal a sixteenth part of the worship of Nārāyaṇa. / What is the use of the Vedas, of sacrifices, of scriptures, or of visiting sacred fords?

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇubhaktivihīnānāṃ kiṃ tapobhirvratairapi //
meaning: विष्णुभक्तिविहीनानां किं तपोभिर्व्रतैरपि //
text_mt: For those devoid of devotion to Viṣṇu, what is the use of austerities or vows?

sanskrit_iast:
yajanti ye viṣṇumanantamṛrtiṃ nirīkṣya cākāragataṃ vareṇyam /
vedāntavedyaṃ bhavarogavaidyaṃ te yānti martyāḥ padamacyutasya //
meaning:
यजन्ति ये विष्णुमनन्तमृर्तिं निरीक्ष्य चाकारगतं वरेण्यम् /
वेदान्तवेद्यं भवरोगवैद्यं ते यान्ति मर्त्याः पदमच्युतस्य //
text_mt: Those mortals who worship Viṣṇu, whose form is endless, perceiving that supreme one who has entered bodily form, / who is knowable through the Upaniṣads, the physician for the disease of mundane existence—they go to the abode of Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
anādimātmānamanantaśaktimādhārabhūtaṃ jagataḥ sureḍyam /
jyotiḥ svarupaṃ paramacyutākhyaṃ smṛtvā samabhyeti naraḥ sakhāyam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde prāyaścittavidhirnāma ghatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अनादिमात्मानमनन्तशक्तिमाधारभूतं जगतः सुरेड्यम् /
ज्योतिः स्वरुपं परमच्युताख्यं स्मृत्वा समभ्येति नरः सखायम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे प्रायश्चित्तविधिर्नाम घत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Remembering that beginningless, all-powerful Self, the support of the universe, praised by the gods, / whose nature is light, who is supreme and named Acyuta, a man approaches his friend.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, entitled 'Rules for Expiation', in the first quarter of the first part in the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kathito bhavatā samyagvarṇāśramavidhirmune /
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कथितो भवता सम्यग्वर्णाश्रमविधिर्मुने /
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यममार्गं सुदुर्गमम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / The rule of the classes and stages of life has been described fully by you, O sage. / Now I wish to hear about the path of Yama, which is exceedingly difficult to traverse.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam /
sukhadaṃ puṇyaśīlānāṃ pāpināṃ bhayadāyakam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यममार्गं सुदुर्गमम् /
सुखदं पुण्यशीलानां पापिनां भयदायकम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Listen, O twice-born; I shall describe the path of Yama, exceedingly difficult to traverse, / which bestows happiness upon the virtuous and strikes fear into sinners.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanārnini munīśvara /
yamamārgasya vistāraḥ kathaitaḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ //
meaning:
षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनार्निनि मुनीश्वर /
यममार्गस्य विस्तारः कथैतः पूर्वसूरिभिः //
text_mt: Eighty-six thousand leagues, O lord of sages, / has the extent of the path of Yama been described by the ancient sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ye narā dānaśīlāstu te yānti sukhino dvija /
dharmaśūnyā narā yānti duḥkhena bhṛśamarditāḥ //
meaning:
ये नरा दानशीलास्तु ते यान्ति सुखिनो द्विज /
धर्मशून्या नरा यान्ति दुःखेन भृशमर्दिताः //
text_mt: Men who are generous go happily, O twice-born; / men devoid of righteousness go severely afflicted with pain.

sanskrit_iast:
atibhītā vivaśtrāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ /
kradanto vistaraṃ dīnāḥ pāpino yānti tatpathi //
meaning:
अतिभीता विवश्त्राश्च शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकाः /
क्रदन्तो विस्तरं दीनाः पापिनो यान्ति तत्पथि //
text_mt: Utterly terrified and naked, their throats, lips, and palates parched, / weeping aloud, the miserable sinners go along that road,

sanskrit_iast: hanyamānā yamabhaṭaiḥ pratodādyaistathāyudhaiḥ //
meaning: हन्यमाना यमभटैः प्रतोदाद्यैस्तथायुधैः //
text_mt: beaten by the attendants of Yama with goads and other weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
itastataḥ pradhāvanto yānti duḥkhena tatpathi /
kvacitpaṅkaḥ kvacidūhniḥ kvacitsetatpasaikatam /
kvacidvai dāvarupeṇaḥ tīkṣṇadhārāḥ śilāḥ kvacit //
meaning:
इतस्ततः प्रधावन्तो यान्ति दुःखेन तत्पथि /
क्वचित्पङ्कः क्वचिदूह्निः क्वचित्सेतत्पसैकतम् /
क्वचिद्वै दावरुपेणः तीक्ष्णधाराः शिलाः क्वचित् //
text_mt: Running here and there, they go in pain along that road. / In some places there is mud, in some fire, in some burning hot sand; / in some places wild forest fires, in some sharp-edged stones;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitkaṇṭakavṛkṣāśca duḥkhārohaśilā nagāḥ /
gāḍhāndhakārāśaaca guhāḥ kaṇṭakāvaraṇaṃ mahat //
meaning:
क्वचित्कण्टकवृक्षाश्च दुःखारोहशिला नगाः /
गाढान्धकाराशअच गुहाः कण्टकावरणं महत् //
text_mt: in some places thorny trees and rocky mountains difficult to climb, / caverns of dense darkness, and vast coverings of thorns;

sanskrit_iast:
vaprāgrārohaṇaṃ caiva kandarasya praveśanam /
śarkarāśca tathā loṣṭāḥ sūcītulyāśca kaṇṭakāḥ //
meaning:
वप्राग्रारोहणं चैव कन्दरस्य प्रवेशनम् /
शर्कराश्च तथा लोष्टाः सूचीतुल्याश्च कण्टकाः //
text_mt: climbing high embankments and entering mountain chasms, / gravel, stones, and thorns resembling needles;

sanskrit_iast:
śaivālaṃ ca kvacinmārge kvacitkīcakapaṅktayaḥ /
kvacivdyāvrāśca garjante vardhante ca kvacijjvarāḥ //
meaning:
शैवालं च क्वचिन्मार्गे क्वचित्कीचकपङ्क्तयः /
क्वचिव्द्याव्राश्च गर्जन्ते वर्धन्ते च क्वचिज्ज्वराः //
text_mt: and in some places on the road there are mosses, in some rows of whistling bamboo, / in some places tigers roar, and in some fevers surge.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuvidhakleśāḥ pāpino yānti nārada /
krośantaśca rudantaśca mlāyantaścaiva pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
एवं बहुविधक्लेशाः पापिनो यान्ति नारद /
क्रोशन्तश्च रुदन्तश्च म्लायन्तश्चैव पापिनः //
text_mt: Afflicted with many such distresses the sinners go, O Nārada, / screaming, weeping, and withering away.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśena yantritāḥ kecitkṛṣyamāṇāstathāṅkuśaiḥ /
śāstrāstraistāḍyamānāśca pṛṣṭato yānti pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
पाशेन यन्त्रिताः केचित्कृष्यमाणास्तथाङ्कुशैः /
शास्त्रास्त्रैस्ताड्यमानाश्च पृष्टतो यान्ति पापिनः //
text_mt: Some bound with ropes, dragged along with hooks, / and beaten from behind with blades and weapons, the sinners go.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsāgrapāśakṛṣṭāśca kecidantraiśca badhitāḥ /
vahṝntaścāyasāṃ bhāraṃ śiśrāgreṇa prayānti vai //
meaning:
नासाग्रपाशकृष्टाश्च केचिदन्त्रैश्च बधिताः /
वहॄन्तश्चायसां भारं शिश्राग्रेण प्रयान्ति वै //
text_mt: Some pulled by a rope through the tip of the nose, and some bound by their entrails, / carrying a burden of iron, they proceed on their heads.

sanskrit_iast:
ayobhāradvayaṃ kecinnāsāgreṇa tathāpare /
karṇābhyāṃ ca tathā kecidvahṝnto yānti pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
अयोभारद्वयं केचिन्नासाग्रेण तथापरे /
कर्णाभ्यां च तथा केचिद्वहॄन्तो यान्ति पापिनः //
text_mt: Some carry a double burden of iron with the tip of their nose, and others / carry it with their ears as they go, the sinners.

sanskrit_iast:
kecicca skhalitā yānti tāḍyamānāstathāpare /
atyarthocṅvasitāḥ kecitkecidācchatralocanāḥ //
meaning:
केचिच्च स्खलिता यान्ति ताड्यमानास्तथापरे /
अत्यर्थोच्ङ्वसिताः केचित्केचिदाच्छत्रलोचनाः //
text_mt: Some go stumbling, and others [go] being beaten; / some are gasping excessively, and some have their eyes covered.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyājalavihīne tu pathi yāntyatiduḥkhitāḥ /
śocantaḥ svāni karmaṇi jñānājñānakṛtāni ca //
meaning:
छायाजलविहीने तु पथि यान्त्यतिदुःखिताः /
शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्मणि ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतानि च //
text_mt: Deprived of shade and water, they go along the path in extreme agony, / bewailing their own deeds done with knowledge or without knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu nārada dharmiṣṭhā dānaśīlā subuddhayaḥ /
atīva sukhasaṃpannāste yānti dharmamandiram //
meaning:
ये तु नारद धर्मिष्ठा दानशीला सुबुद्धयः /
अतीव सुखसंपन्नास्ते यान्ति धर्ममन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
Those, O Nārada, who are most righteous, generous in giving, and endowed with good intellect,
abundantly endowed with happiness, go to the abode of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
annadāstu munuśreṣṭha bhuñjantaḥ svādu yānti vai /
nīradā yānti sukhinaḥ pibantaḥ kṣīramuttamamam /
takradā dadhidāścaiva tattadbhogaṃ labhanti vai /
ghṛtadā madhudāścaiva kṣīradāśca dvijottama //
meaning:
अन्नदास्तु मुनुश्रेष्ठ भुञ्जन्तः स्वादु यान्ति वै /
नीरदा यान्ति सुखिनः पिबन्तः क्षीरमुत्तममम् /
तक्रदा दधिदाश्चैव तत्तद्भोगं लभन्ति वै /
घृतदा मधुदाश्चैव क्षीरदाश्च द्विजोत्तम //

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāpānaṃ prakurvanto yānti vai dharmamandiram /
śākadāḥ pāyasaṃ bhuñjaṃndīpado jvalayandiśaḥ //
meaning:
सुधापानं प्रकुर्वन्तो यान्ति वै धर्ममन्दिरम् /
शाकदाः पायसं भुञ्जंन्दीपदो ज्वलयन्दिशः //
text_mt:
go indeed to the abode of Dharma, drinking nectar;
