givers of vegetables eat milk-rice; the giver of a lamp illuminates the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrado munuśārdūla yāti divyāmbarāvṛtaḥ /
purākaraprado yāti stūyamāno 'maraiḥ pathi //
meaning:
वस्त्रदो मुनुशार्दूल याति दिव्याम्बरावृतः /
पुराकरप्रदो याति स्तूयमानो ऽमरैः पथि //
text_mt:
The giver of clothing, O tiger among sages, goes clothed in divine garments;
the giver of a city or a tax-free settlement goes being praised on the path by the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
godānena naro yāti sarvasaukhyasamanvitaḥ /
bhūmido gṛhadaścaiva vimāne sarvasaṃpadi //
meaning:
गोदानेन नरो याति सर्वसौख्यसमन्वितः /
भूमिदो गृहदश्चैव विमाने सर्वसंपदि //
text_mt:
By the gift of a cow, a man goes endowed with all happiness;
the giver of land and the giver of a house [go] in an aerial chariot amidst all prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe krīḍanyāti vṛṣālayam /
hayado yānadaścāpi gajadaśca dvijottama //
meaning:
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे क्रीडन्याति वृषालयम् /
हयदो यानदश्चापि गजदश्च द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
sporting amidst a host of Apsarases, he goes to the abode of righteousness.
The giver of a horse, the giver of a vehicle, and the giver of an elephant, O foremost of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmālayaṃ vimānena yāti bhogānvitena vai /
anaḍuddo muniśreṣṭha yānāruḍhaḥ prayāti vai //
meaning:
धर्मालयं विमानेन याति भोगान्वितेन वै /
अनडुद्दो मुनिश्रेष्ठ यानारुढः प्रयाति वै //
text_mt:
goes indeed to the abode of Dharma in an aerial chariot endowed with enjoyments;
the giver of an ox, O best of sages, proceeds mounted upon a vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
phaladaḥ puṣpadaścāpi yāti saṃtoṣasaṃyutaḥ /
tāṃbūlado naro yāti prahṛṣṭor dhamamandiram //
meaning:
फलदः पुष्पदश्चापि याति संतोषसंयुतः /
तांबूलदो नरो याति प्रहृष्टोर् धममन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
The giver of fruits and the giver of flowers goes filled with contentment;
the man who gives betel goes delighted to the abode of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtavānyo narottamaḥ /
sa yāti parituṣṭātmā pūjyamāno divisthitaiḥ //
meaning:
मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रूषां कृतवान्यो नरोत्तमः /
स याति परितुष्टात्मा पूज्यमानो दिविस्थितैः //
text_mt:
That best of men who has rendered service to his mother and father
goes with a contented soul, being worshipped by the dwellers of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣāṃ kurute yastu yatīnāṃ vratacāriṇām /
dvijagryabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca sa yātvatisukhānvitaḥ //
meaning:
शुश्रूषां कुरुते यस्तु यतीनां व्रतचारिणाम् /
द्विजग्र्यब्राह्मणानां च स यात्वतिसुखान्वितः //
text_mt:
He who renders service to ascetics observing vows
and to eminent Brahmins, goes endowed with utmost happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtadayāyuktaḥ pūjyamāno 'marairdvijaḥ /
sarvabhogānvitenāsau vimānena prayāti ca //
meaning:
सर्वभूतदयायुक्तः पूज्यमानो ऽमरैर्द्विजः /
सर्वभोगान्वितेनासौ विमानेन प्रयाति च //
text_mt:
Endowed with compassion toward all living beings, the twice-born, worshipped by the immortals,
goes in an aerial chariot endowed with all enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādānarato yāti pūjyamāno 'bjasūnubhiḥ /
purāṇapaṭhako yāti stūyamāno munīśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
विद्यादानरतो याति पूज्यमानो ऽब्जसूनुभिः /
पुराणपठको याति स्तूयमानो मुनीश्वरैः //
text_mt:
He who is devoted to the gift of knowledge goes worshipped by the sons of Brahmā;
the reciter of the Purāṇas goes being praised by the lords of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dharmaparā yānti sukhaṃ dharmasya mandiram /
yamaścaturmukho bhūtvā śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt //
meaning:
एवं धर्मपरा यान्ति सुखं धर्मस्य मन्दिरम् /
यमश्चतुर्मुखो भूत्वा शङ्खचक्रगदासिभृत् //
text_mt:
Thus the righteous go happily to the abode of Dharma.
Yama, having assumed four faces, bearing a conch, discus, mace, and sword,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakarmarataṃ samyaksnehānmitramivārcati /
bho bho buddhimatāṃ śreṣṭhānarakakleṣabhīravaḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यकर्मरतं सम्यक्स्नेहान्मित्रमिवार्चति /
भो भो बुद्धिमतां श्रेष्ठानरकक्लेषभीरवः //
text_mt:
duly honors one devoted to virtuous deeds like a friend out of affection:
'O foremost among the wise, who fear the afflictions of hell!

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmābhiḥ sādhitaṃ puṇyamatrāmutrasukhāvaham /
manuṣathya janma yaḥ prāpya sukṛtaṃ na karoti ca //
meaning:
युष्माभिः साधितं पुण्यमत्रामुत्रसुखावहम् /
मनुषथ्य जन्म यः प्राप्य सुकृतं न करोति च //
text_mt:
Virtue bringing happiness here and hereafter has been accomplished by you.
He who, having attained human birth, does not perform good deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva pāpināṃ śreṣṭha ātmaghātaṃ karoti ca /
anityaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ nityaṃ yastu na sādhayet //
meaning:
स एव पापिनां श्रेष्ठ आत्मघातं करोति च /
अनित्यं प्राप्य मानुष्यं नित्यं यस्तु न साधयेत् //
text_mt:
is the foremost among sinners and commits suicide.
He who, having attained transient human existence, does not accomplish the eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ ko 'nyastasmādacetanaḥ /
śarīraṃ yātanārupaṃ malādyaiḥ paridūṣitam //
meaning:
स याति नरकं घोरं को ऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः /
शरीरं यातनारुपं मलाद्यैः परिदूषितम् //
text_mt:
goes to a terrible hell; who is more mindless than him?
The body is of the nature of torment, defiled by filth and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
tasminyo yāti viśvāsaṃ taṃ vidyādātmaghātakam /
sarveṣu prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣu vai buddhijīvinaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्यो याति विश्वासं तं विद्यादात्मघातकम् /
सर्वेषु प्राणिनः श्रेष्ठास्तेषु वै बुद्धिजीविनः //
text_mt:
he who places trust in it should be known as a slayer of the self.
Living beings are superior among all things; among them, those who live by intellect;

sanskrit_iast:
buddhimastu narāḥ śreṣṭhā nareṣu brāhmaṇāstathā /
brāhmaṇeṣu ca vidvāṃso vidvatsu kṛtabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
बुद्धिमस्तु नराः श्रेष्ठा नरेषु ब्राह्मणास्तथा /
ब्राह्मणेषु च विद्वांसो विद्वत्सु कृतबुद्धयः //
text_mt:
men are superior among the intelligent; among men, Brahmins;
among Brahmins, the learned; among the learned, those of resolved intellect;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtabuddhiṣu karttāraḥ kartṛṣu brahmavādinaḥ /
brahmavādiṣvapi tathā śreṣṭho nirmama ucyate //
meaning:
कृतबुद्धिषु कर्त्तारः कर्तृषु ब्रह्मवादिनः /
ब्रह्मवादिष्वपि तथा श्रेष्ठो निर्मम उच्यते //
text_mt:
among those of resolved intellect, the doers [of duty]; among doers, expounders of Brahman;
among expounders of Brahman also, he who is free from possessiveness is said to be superior.

sanskrit_iast:
etebhyo 'pi paro jñeyo nityaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ /
tasmātsarvaprayatnena karttavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ //
meaning:
एतेभ्यो ऽपि परो ज्ञेयो नित्यं ध्यानपरायणः /
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कर्त्तव्यो धर्मसंग्रहः //
text_mt:
Higher even than these is to be known he who is ever devoted to meditation.
Therefore, with every effort, a store of virtue must be accumulated.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra pūjyate janturdharmavānnātra saṃśayaḥ /
gaccha svapuṇyairmatsthānaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam //
meaning:
सर्वत्र पूज्यते जन्तुर्धर्मवान्नात्र संशयः /
गच्छ स्वपुण्यैर्मत्स्थानं सर्वभोगसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
Everywhere a righteous living being is worshipped; there is no doubt in this.
Go, by your own merits, to my abode endowed with all enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
asti cedduṣkṛtaṃ kiñcitpaścādatraiva bhokṣyase /
evaṃ yamastamabhyarcya prāpayitvā ca sadgatim //
meaning:
अस्ति चेद्दुष्कृतं किञ्चित्पश्चादत्रैव भोक्ष्यसे /
एवं यमस्तमभ्यर्च्य प्रापयित्वा च सद्गतिम् //
text_mt:
If there is any misdeed, you will experience it right here afterward.'
Having thus honored him and caused him to attain the good path,

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya pāpinaścaiva kāladaṇḍena tarjayet /
pralayāṃbudanirghoṣo hyañjanādrisamaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
आहूय पापिनश्चैव कालदण्डेन तर्जयेत् /
प्रलयांबुदनिर्घोषो ह्यञ्जनाद्रिसमप्रभः //
text_mt:
and having summoned the sinners, Yama threatens them with the rod of death.
Having a roar like the clouds of dissolution, having the luster like a mountain of collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyutpra bhāyurghorbhīmo dvātriṃśadbhujasaṃyutaḥ /
yojanatrayavistāro raktākṣo dīrghanāsikaḥ //
meaning:
विद्युत्प्र भायुर्घोर्भीमो द्वात्रिंशद्भुजसंयुतः /
योजनत्रयविस्तारो रक्ताक्षो दीर्घनासिकः //
text_mt:
having terrible weapons with the radiance of lightning, thirty-two-armed,
three yojanas in width, red-eyed, long-nosed,

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālavadano vāpītulyogralocanaḥ /
mṛtyujvarādibhiryuktaścitragutpo 'pi bhīṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनो वापीतुल्योग्रलोचनः /
मृत्युज्वरादिभिर्युक्तश्चित्रगुत्पो ऽपि भीषणः //
text_mt:
with a face dreadful with fangs, with fierce eyes resembling water-reservoirs,
accompanied by death, fever, and others, terrifying Citragupta also [is present].

sanskrit_iast:
sarve dūtāśca garjanti yamatulyavibhīṣaṇāḥ /
tato bravīti tānsarvānkaṃpamānāṃśca pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे दूताश्च गर्जन्ति यमतुल्यविभीषणाः /
ततो ब्रवीति तान्सर्वान्कंपमानांश्च पापिनः //
text_mt:
And all the messengers roar, terrifying like Yama.
Then Citragupta, by Yama's command, addresses all those trembling sinners

sanskrit_iast:
śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi citragutpo yamājñayā /
bho bho pāpā durācārā ahṝṅkārapradūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्माणि चित्रगुत्पो यमाज्ञया /
भो भो पापा दुराचारा अहॄङ्कारप्रदूषिताः //
text_mt:
who are lamenting their own deeds:
'O sinners, of evil conduct, corrupted by egoism!

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamarjitaṃ pāpaṃ yuṣmābhiravivekibhiḥ /
kāmaktodhādidṛṣṭena sagarveṇa tu cetasā //
meaning:
किमर्थमर्जितं पापं युष्माभिरविवेकिभिः /
कामक्तोधादिदृष्टेन सगर्वेण तु चेतसा //
text_mt:
Why was sin accumulated by you, destitute of discernment,
with a mind clouded by desire, anger, and the like, and full of pride?

sanskrit_iast:
yadyatpāpataraṃ tattatkimarthaṃ caritaṃ janāḥ /
kṛtavantaḥ purā pāpānyatyantaharṣitāḥ //
meaning:
यद्यत्पापतरं तत्तत्किमर्थं चरितं जनाः /
कृतवन्तः पुरा पापान्यत्यन्तहर्षिताः //
text_mt:
Why were various most sinful deeds performed by you, O people?
Formerly you committed sins being exceedingly delighted;

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva yātanā bhojyāḥ kiṃ vṛthā hyatidurivatāḥ /
bhṛtyamitrakalatrārthaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ caritaṃ yathā //
meaning:
तथैव यातना भोज्याः किं वृथा ह्यतिदुरिवताः /
भृत्यमित्रकलत्रार्थं दुष्कृतं चरितं यथा //
text_mt:
in the very same way torments must be endured; why lament in vain, O sinners?
Just as evil deeds were performed for the sake of servants, friends, and wives,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā karmavaśātprātpā yūyamatrātiduḥkhitāḥ /
yuṣmābhiḥ poṣitā ye tu putrādyā anyatogatāḥ //
meaning:
तथा कर्मवशात्प्रात्पा यूयमत्रातिदुःखिताः /
युष्माभिः पोषिता ये तु पुत्राद्या अन्यतोगताः //
text_mt:
so by the force of karma you have arrived here exceedingly miserable.
Those sons and others who were nourished by you have gone elsewhere;

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmākameva tatpāpaṃ prātpaṃ kiṃ duḥkhakāraṇam /
yathā kṛtāni pāpāni yuṣmābhiḥ subahūni vai //
meaning:
युष्माकमेव तत्पापं प्रात्पं किं दुःखकारणम् /
यथा कृतानि पापानि युष्माभिः सुबहूनि वै //
text_mt:
that sin has fallen upon you alone; why [seek] a cause for sorrow?
Just as very numerous sins were committed by you,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā prātpāni duḥkhāni kimarthamiha duḥkhitāḥ /
vicārayadhvaṃ yūyaṃ tu yuṣmābhiścāritaṃ purā //
meaning:
तथा प्रात्पानि दुःखानि किमर्थमिह दुःखिताः /
विचारयध्वं यूयं तु युष्माभिश्चारितं पुरा //
text_mt:
so miseries have been obtained; why be grieved here?
Reflect upon what was previously performed by you!

sanskrit_iast:
yamaḥ kariṣyate daṇḍamiti kiṃ na vicāritam /
daridre 'pi ca mūrkhe ca paṇḍite vā śriyānvite //
meaning:
यमः करिष्यते दण्डमिति किं न विचारितम् /
दरिद्रे ऽपि च मूर्खे च पण्डिते वा श्रियान्विते //
text_mt:
Why did you not consider that Yama will inflict punishment?
Toward the poor and the fool, or the learned and the one endowed with fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
kāndiśīke ca vīre ca samavartīḥ yamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
citragutperitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā te pāpinastadā //
meaning:
कान्दिशीके च वीरे च समवर्तीः यमः स्मृतः /
चित्रगुत्पेरितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ते पापिनस्तदा //
text_mt:
toward the fugitive and the hero, Yama is known to be impartial.'
Having heard the words uttered by Citragupta, those sinners then,

sanskrit_iast:
śaucantaḥ svāni karmaṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭanti bhīṣitāḥ /
yamājñākāriṇaḥ krūraścaṇḍā dūtā bhayānakāḥ //
meaning:
शौचन्तः स्वानि कर्मणि तूष्णीं तिष्टन्ति भीषिताः /
यमाज्ञाकारिणः क्रूरश्चण्डा दूता भयानकाः //
text_mt:
lamenting their own deeds, remain silent, terrified.
The cruel, fierce, dreadful messengers who execute Yama's command,

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍalādyāḥ prasahyaitānnarakeṣu kṣipanti ca /
svaduṣkarmaphalaṃ te tu bhuktvānte pāpaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
चण्डलाद्याः प्रसह्यैतान्नरकेषु क्षिपन्ति च /
स्वदुष्कर्मफलं ते तु भुक्त्वान्ते पापशेषतः //
text_mt:
outcastes and the like, violently cast them into the hells.
Having experienced the fruit of their own evil deeds, at the end, from the remnant of sin,

sanskrit_iast:
mahītalaṃ ca saṃprāpya bhavanti sthaāvarādayaḥ /
nārada uvāca
bhagavansaṃśayo jāto maccetasi dayānidhe //
meaning:
महीतलं च संप्राप्य भवन्ति स्थआवरादयः /
नारद उवाच
भगवन्संशयो जातो मच्चेतसि दयानिधे //

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ samartho 'si tacchettuṃ yato no hyagrajo bhavān /
dharmāśca vividhāḥ proktāḥ pāpānyapi bahūni ca //
meaning:
त्वं समर्थो ऽसि तच्छेत्तुं यतो नो ह्यग्रजो भवान् /
धर्माश्च विविधाः प्रोक्ताः पापान्यपि बहूनि च //
text_mt:
you are able to sever it, since you are indeed our elder brother.
Diverse virtues have been spoken of, and also many sins;

sanskrit_iast:
cirabhojyaṃ phalaṃ teṣāmuktaṃ bahuvidā tvayā /
dinānte brahmaṇaḥ prokto nāśo lokatrayasya vai //
meaning:
चिरभोज्यं फलं तेषामुक्तं बहुविदा त्वया /
दिनान्ते ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तो नाशो लोकत्रयस्य वै //
text_mt:
their fruit to be enjoyed for a long time has been stated by you who know many things.
At the end of Brahmā's day, the destruction of the three worlds is declared;

sanskrit_iast:
parārddhadvitayānte tu brahmāṇḍasyāpi saṃkṣayaḥ /
grāmadānādipuṇyānāṃ tvayaiva vidhinandana //
meaning:
परार्द्धद्वितयान्ते तु ब्रह्माण्डस्यापि संक्षयः /
ग्रामदानादिपुण्यानां त्वयैव विधिनन्दन //
text_mt:
and at the end of two parārdhas, the complete destruction of the cosmic egg [takes place].
Of the merits such as the gift of a village [spoken of] by you, O son of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭisahasreṣu mahānbhoga udāhṛtaḥ /
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ vināśaḥ prākṛte laye //
meaning:
कल्पकोटिसहस्रेषु महान्भोग उदाहृतः /
सर्वेषामेव लोकानां विनाशः प्राकृते लये //
text_mt: A great enjoyment is described throughout thousands of crores of aeons; / yet in the elemental dissolution, all the worlds are indeed destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaḥ śiṣyata eveti tvayā proktaṃ janārdanaḥ /
eṣa me saṃśayo jātastaṃ bhavāñchettumarhati //
meaning:
एकः शिष्यत एवेति त्वया प्रोक्तं जनार्दनः /
एष मे संशयो जातस्तं भवाञ्छेत्तुमर्हति //
text_mt: You have stated that Janārdana alone remains. / This doubt has arisen in me; you ought to resolve it,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyapāpopabhogānāṃ samātpirnāsya saṃplave /
sanaka uvāca
sādhu sādhau mahāprājña guhyādguhyatamaṃ tvidam //
meaning:
पुण्यपापोपभोगानां समात्पिर्नास्य संप्लवे /
सनक उवाच
साधु साधौ महाप्राज्ञ गुह्याद्गुह्यतमं त्विदम् //
text_mt:
since the experience of merit and demerit has not reached an end at the cosmic dissolution.
Sanaka said:
Well said, well said, O greatly wise one! This is the most secret of secrets.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭaṃ tatte 'bhidhāsyāmi śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ /
nārāyaṇo 'kṣaro 'nantaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
पृष्टं तत्ते ऽभिधास्यामि शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः /
नारायणो ऽक्षरो ऽनन्तः परं ज्योतिः सनातनः //
text_mt: Since it has been asked, I shall explain it to you; listen with a well-concentrated mind. / Nārāyaṇa is the imperishable, the endless, the supreme light, the eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddho nirguṇo nityo māyāmohavivarjitaḥ /
nirguṇo 'pi parānando guṇavāniva bhāti yaḥ //
meaning:
विशुद्धो निर्गुणो नित्यो मायामोहविवर्जितः /
निर्गुणो ऽपि परानन्दो गुणवानिव भाति यः //
text_mt:
He who is pure, devoid of attributes, eternal, free from the delusion of māyā,
who, though devoid of attributes and supreme bliss, appears as if possessed of attributes;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaistu bhedavāniva lakṣyate /
guṇopādhikabhedeṣu triṣveteṣu sanātana //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाद्यैस्तु भेदवानिव लक्ष्यते /
गुणोपाधिकभेदेषु त्रिष्वेतेषु सनातन //
text_mt:
who is perceived as if differentiated through Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others,
O Sanātana, in these three distinctions conditioned by the attributes;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyojya māyāmakhilaṃ jagatkāryaṃ karoti ca /
brahmarupeṇa sṛjati viṣṇurupeṇa pāti ca //
meaning:
संयोज्य मायामखिलं जगत्कार्यं करोति च /
ब्रह्मरुपेण सृजति विष्णुरुपेण पाति च //
text_mt:
and having united with māyā, performs all the cosmic work:
in the form of Brahmā he creates, and in the form of Viṣṇu he protects;

sanskrit_iast:
ante ca rudrarupeṇa sarvamattīti niścitam /
prasayānte samutthāya brahmarupī janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
अन्ते च रुद्ररुपेण सर्वमत्तीति निश्चितम् /
प्रसयान्ते समुत्थाय ब्रह्मरुपी जनार्दनः //
text_mt:
and at the end, in the form of Rudra, he devours everything—this is certain.
Having arisen at the end of the dissolution, Janārdana in the form of Brahmā

sanskrit_iast:
carācarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ yathāpūrvamakalpayat /
sthāvarādyāśaaca viprendra yatra yatra vyavasthitāḥ //
meaning:
चराचरात्मकं विश्वं यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् /
स्थावराद्याशअच विप्रेन्द्र यत्र यत्र व्यवस्थिताः //
text_mt:
fashioned the universe consisting of the moving and unmoving just as before.
And wherever the stationary objects and others were situated, O best of Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā tattajjagatsarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ karoti vai /
tasmātkṛtānāṃ pāpānāṃ puṇyānāṃ caiva sattama //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा तत्तज्जगत्सर्वं यथापूर्वं करोति वै /
तस्मात्कृतानां पापानां पुण्यानां चैव सत्तम //
text_mt:
Brahmā verily makes all that universe just as before.
Therefore, of sins and merits committed, O best of virtuous men,

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ karmaṇāṃ hyakṣayaṃ phalam /
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi //
meaning:
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कर्मणां ह्यक्षयं फलम् /
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि //
text_mt:
the imperishable fruit of actions must inevitably be experienced;
for unexperienced karma does not diminish even after hundreds of crores of kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham /
yo devaḥ sarvalokānāmantarātmā jaganmayaḥ /
sarvakarmaphalaṃ bhukte paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् /
यो देवः सर्वलोकानामन्तरात्मा जगन्मयः /
सर्वकर्मफलं भुक्ते परिपूर्णः सनातनः //
text_mt:
Action performed, whether auspicious or inauspicious, must inevitably be experienced.
The God who is the inner Self of all worlds, composed of the universe,
enjoys the fruit of all karma, [being] complete and eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sau viśvaṃbharo devo guṇamedavyavasthitaḥ /
sūjatyavati cāttyetatsarvaṃ sarvabhugavyayaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde yamadūtakṛtyanirupaṇaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यो ऽसौ विश्वंभरो देवो गुणमेदव्यवस्थितः /
सूजत्यवति चात्त्येतत्सर्वं सर्वभुगव्ययः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे यमदूतकृत्यनिरुपणं नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He who is the all-supporting God, established in the distinctions of the attributes,
creates, protects, and devours all this, the all-consuming, imperishable one.

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Duties of the Messengers of Yama', in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
evaṃ karmapāśaniyantritajantatavaḥ svargādipuṇyasthāneṣu puṇyabhogamanubhūya yātīva duḥkhataraṃ pāpaphalamanubhūya prakṣīṇakarmā vaśeṣeṇāmuṃ lokamāgatya sarvabhayavihvaleṣu mṛtyubādhāsaṃyuteṣusthāvarādiṣu jāyate /
vṛkṣagulmalatāvallīgirayaśca tṛṇāni ca /
sthāvarā iti vikhyātā mahāmohasamāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
एवं कर्मपाशनियन्त्रितजन्ततवः स्वर्गादिपुण्यस्थानेषु पुण्यभोगमनुभूय यातीव दुःखतरं पापफलमनुभूय प्रक्षीणकर्मा वशेषेणामुं लोकमागत्य सर्वभयविह्वलेषु मृत्युबाधासंयुतेषुस्थावरादिषु जायते /
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्लीगिरयश्च तृणानि च /
स्थावरा इति विख्याता महामोहसमावृताः //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
Thus, living beings bound by the noose of karma, having experienced the enjoyment of merit in meritorious places such as heaven, having experienced the exceedingly grievous fruit of sin, with their karma diminished, come to this world with a remnant [of karma] and are born among stationary things and the like, which are terrified of all danger and afflicted by death:
Trees, shrubs, creeping plants, vines, mountains, and grasses—
these are known as stationary beings, enveloped in great delusion.

sanskrit_iast: sthāvaratve pṛthivyāmutpabījāni jalasekānupadaṃ susaṃskārasāmagrīvaśādantaruṣmaprapācitānyucchūnatvamāpadya tato mūlabhāvaṃ tanmūlādaṅkurotpattistasmādapi parṇakāṇḍanālādikaṃ kāṇḍeṣu ca prasavamāpadyante teṣu ca puṣpasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning: स्थावरत्वे पृथिव्यामुत्पबीजानि जलसेकानुपदं सुसंस्कारसामग्रीवशादन्तरुष्मप्रपाचितान्युच्छूनत्वमापद्य ततो मूलभावं तन्मूलादङ्कुरोत्पत्तिस्तस्मादपि पर्णकाण्डनालादिकं काण्डेषु च प्रसवमापद्यन्ते तेषु च पुष्पसंभवः //
text_mt: In the stationary state, seeds sown in the earth, immediately upon the sprinkling of water, through the force of the collection of favourable causes, ripened by internal heat, attain swollenness; thence arises the state of root; from that root arises the sprout; and from that too the leaf, stalk, stem, and the like; and in the stems blossoms are produced, and in them flowers arise.

sanskrit_iast: tāni puṣpāṇi kānicidaphalāni kānicitphalahetubhūtāni teṣu puṣpeṣu vṛddhabhāveṣu satsu tatpuṣpamūlatastuṣotpattirjāyate teṣu tuṣu bhoktṝṇāṃ prāṇināṃ saṃskārasāmagrīvaśāddhimaraśmikiraṇāsannatayā tadoṣadhirasastuṣāntaḥ praviśya kṣīrabhāvaṃ sametya svakāle taṇḍulākāratāmupagamya prāṇināṃ bhogasaṃskāravaśātsaṃvatsare phalinaḥ syuḥ //
meaning: तानि पुष्पाणि कानिचिदफलानि कानिचित्फलहेतुभूतानि तेषु पुष्पेषु वृद्धभावेषु सत्सु तत्पुष्पमूलतस्तुषोत्पत्तिर्जायते तेषु तुषु भोक्तॄणां प्राणिनां संस्कारसामग्रीवशाद्धिमरश्मिकिरणासन्नतया तदोषधिरसस्तुषान्तः प्रविश्य क्षीरभावं समेत्य स्वकाले तण्डुलाकारतामुपगम्य प्राणिनां भोगसंस्कारवशात्संवत्सरे फलिनः स्युः //
text_mt: Some of those flowers are fruitless, and some become the cause of fruit; when those flowers mature, from the base of those flowers the appearance of the husk takes place; in those husks, through the force of the collection of impressions of the living beings who are the consumers, by proximity to the rays of the cool-rayed moon, the sap of that herb enters within the husk, attains the state of milky fluid, in its proper time attains the form of grain, and, through the force of the impressions of enjoyment of living beings, in a year they become fruit-bearing.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaratve 'pi bahukālaṃ vānarādibhirbhujyamānā hi cchedanadavāgnidahanaśītātapādiduḥkhamanubhūya mriyate /
tataśca krimayo bhūtvā sadāduḥkhabahulāḥ kṣaṇārdhdaṃ jīvantaḥ kṣaṇārdhdaṃ mriyamāṇā balavatprāṇipīḍāyāṃ nivārayitumakṣamāḥ śītavātādikleśabhūyiṣṭhā nityaṃ kṣudhākṣudhitā malamūtrādiṣu sacaranto duḥkhamanubhavanti //
meaning:
स्थावरत्वे ऽपि बहुकालं वानरादिभिर्भुज्यमाना हि च्छेदनदवाग्निदहनशीतातपादिदुःखमनुभूय म्रियते /
ततश्च क्रिमयो भूत्वा सदादुःखबहुलाः क्षणार्ध्दं जीवन्तः क्षणार्ध्दं म्रियमाणा बलवत्प्राणिपीडायां निवारयितुमक्षमाः शीतवातादिक्लेशभूयिष्ठा नित्यं क्षुधाक्षुधिता मलमूत्रादिषु सचरन्तो दुःखमनुभवन्ति //
text_mt:
Even in the stationary state, being eaten for a long time by monkeys and other animals, experiencing suffering through cutting, burning by forest-fires, cold, heat, and the like, it dies.
And then, having become worms, continuously full of sorrow, living for half a moment, dying for half a moment, unable to ward off the affliction caused by stronger creatures, mostly beset by hardships such as cold and wind, ever tormented by hunger, moving about in faeces, urine, and the like, they experience suffering.

sanskrit_iast: tata eva padmayonimāgatya balavadvādhodvejitā vṛthodvegabhūyiṣṭhāḥ kṣutkṣāntā nityaṃ vanacāriṇo mātṛṣvapi viṣayāturā vātādikleṣabahulāḥ kaśmiṃścijjanmani tṛṇāśanāḥ kasmiṃścijjanmani māṃsāmedhyādyadanāḥ kasmiṃścijjanmani kandamūlaphalāśanā durbalaprāṇipīḍāniratā duḥkhamanubhavanti //
meaning: तत एव पद्मयोनिमागत्य बलवद्वाधोद्वेजिता वृथोद्वेगभूयिष्ठाः क्षुत्क्षान्ता नित्यं वनचारिणो मातृष्वपि विषयातुरा वातादिक्लेषबहुलाः कश्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि तृणाशनाः कस्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि मांसामेध्याद्यदनाः कस्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि कन्दमूलफलाशना दुर्बलप्राणिपीडानिरता दुःखमनुभवन्ति //
text_mt: Thereafter, having entered the womb of four-footed beasts, agitated by powerful obstacles, mostly filled with vain distress, overcome with hunger, ever roaming in the forest, impassioned for sensual pleasures even towards their mothers, filled with hardships such as the wind, eating grass in one birth, eating meat, impure matter, and the like in another birth, eating bulbs, roots, and fruits in another birth, engaged in tormenting weaker creatures, they experience suffering.

sanskrit_iast: aṇḍajatve 'pi vātāśanāmāṃsāmedhyādyaśanāśca parapīḍāparāyaṇā nityaṃ duḥkhabahulā grāmyapaśuyonimāgatā api svajātiviyogabhārodvahanapāśādibandhanatāḍanahalādidhāraṇādisarvaduḥkhānyanubhavanti //
meaning: अण्डजत्वे ऽपि वाताशनामांसामेध्याद्यशनाश्च परपीडापरायणा नित्यं दुःखबहुला ग्राम्यपशुयोनिमागता अपि स्वजातिवियोगभारोद्वहनपाशादिबन्धनताडनहलादिधारणादिसर्वदुःखान्यनुभवन्ति //
text_mt: Even in the oviparous state, feeding on air, eating meat, impure matter, and the like, intent on injuring others, ever full of sorrow, and having entered the womb of domestic animals, they experience all sorrows such as separation from their own kind, carrying burdens, being bound with ropes and the like, beating, and bearing ploughs and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuyoniṣu saṃbhrāntāḥ krameṇa mānuṣaṃ janma prāpnuvanti /
kecicca puṇyaviśeṣādyutkrameṇāpi manuṣyajanmāśnuvate //
meaning:
एवं बहुयोनिषु संभ्रान्ताः क्रमेण मानुषं जन्म प्राप्नुवन्ति /
केचिच्च पुण्यविशेषाद्युत्क्रमेणापि मनुष्यजन्माश्नुवते //
text_mt:
Having thus wandered in many wombs, they gradually attain human birth.
And some, due to special merit, attain human birth even out of order.

sanskrit_iast: manuṣyajanma nāpi ca carmakāracaṇḍālavyādhānāpitarajakakuṃbhakāralohakārasvarṇakāratantuvācasaucikajaṭilasiddhadhāvakalekhakabhṛtakaśāsanahārinīcabhṛtyadraridahīnāṅgādhikāṅgatvādi duḥkhabahulajvaratāpaśītaśleṣmagulmapādākṣiśirogarbhapārśvavedanādiduḥkhamanubhavanti //
meaning: मनुष्यजन्म नापि च चर्मकारचण्डालव्याधानापितरजककुंभकारलोहकारस्वर्णकारतन्तुवाचसौचिकजटिलसिद्धधावकलेखकभृतकशासनहारिनीचभृत्यद्ररिदहीनाङ्गाधिकाङ्गत्वादि दुःखबहुलज्वरतापशीतश्लेष्मगुल्मपादाक्षिशिरोगर्भपार्श्ववेदनादिदुःखमनुभवन्ति //
text_mt: And even in human birth, as leather-workers, caṇḍālas, hunters, barbers, washermen, potters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, weavers, tailors, ascetics with matted hair, accomplished runners, scribes, hired servants, message-bearers, base servants, the poor, those with missing limbs, those with extra limbs, and the like, they experience suffering abundant in sorrow: fever, heat, cold, phlegm, abdominal swelling, pain in feet, eyes, head, belly, sides, and the like.

sanskrit_iast: manuṣyatve 'pi yadā strīpuruṣayorvyavāyastatsamayereto yadā jarāyuṃ praviśati tadaiva karmavaśājjantuḥ śukreṇa saha jarāyuṃ praviśya śukraśoṇitakalale pravarttate //
meaning: मनुष्यत्वे ऽपि यदा स्त्रीपुरुषयोर्व्यवायस्तत्समयेरेतो यदा जरायुं प्रविशति तदैव कर्मवशाज्जन्तुः शुक्रेण सह जरायुं प्रविश्य शुक्रशोणितकलले प्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Even in the human state, when there is copulation of a woman and a man, at that time when the semen enters the womb, then indeed, by the force of karma, the creature, entering the womb along with the semen, is formed into the embryonic fluid of semen and ovum.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvīryaṃ jīvapraveśātpañcāhātkalalaṃ bhavati arddhamāse /
palavalabhāvamupetya māse prādeśamātratvamāpadyate //
meaning:
तद्वीर्यं जीवप्रवेशात्पञ्चाहात्कललं भवति अर्द्धमासे /
पलवलभावमुपेत्य मासे प्रादेशमात्रत्वमापद्यते //
text_mt:
That semen, from the entrance of the soul, after five days becomes the embryo; in half a month
it attains the condition of a lump of flesh; in a month it attains the measure of a span.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ prabhṛti vāyuvaśāccaitanyābhāve 'pi māturuhye duḥsahatāpalkeśatayaikatra sthātumaśakyatvād bhramati //
meaning: ततः प्रभृति वायुवशाच्चैतन्याभावे ऽपि मातुरुह्ये दुःसहतापल्केशतयैकत्र स्थातुमशक्यत्वाद् भ्रमति //
text_mt: From that time forward, driven by the wind, even in the absence of [manifest] consciousness, on account of the unbearable affliction of heat in the mother's abdomen, being unable to stay in one place, it tosses about.

sanskrit_iast: māse dvitīye pūrṇe puruṣākāramātratāmupagamaya māsatritaye pūrṇe karacaraṇādyavayavabhāvamupagamya caturṣu māseṣu gateṣu sarvāvayavānāṃ saṃdhibhedaparijñānaṃ pañcasvatīteṣu nakhānāmabhivyañjakakatā ṣaṭsvatīteṣu nakhasaṃdhiparisphuṭatāmupagamya nābhisūtreṇa puṣyamāṇamamedhyamūtrasiktāṅgaṃ jarāyuṇā bandhitaraktāsthikrimivasāmajjāsnāyukeśādidūṣite kutsite śarīre nivāsinaṃ svayamapyevaṃ paridūṣitadehaṃ mātuśca kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇabhuktadahyamātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā dehī pūrvajanmasmaraṇānubhāvātpūrvānubhūtanarakaduḥthāni ca smṛtvāntarduḥkhena ca paridahyamāno māturdehātimūtrādirukṣeṇa dahyamāna evaṃ manasi pralayati //
meaning: मासे द्वितीये पूर्णे पुरुषाकारमात्रतामुपगमय मासत्रितये पूर्णे करचरणाद्यवयवभावमुपगम्य चतुर्षु मासेषु गतेषु सर्वावयवानां संधिभेदपरिज्ञानं पञ्चस्वतीतेषु नखानामभिव्यञ्जककता षट्स्वतीतेषु नखसंधिपरिस्फुटतामुपगम्य नाभिसूत्रेण पुष्यमाणममेध्यमूत्रसिक्ताङ्गं जरायुणा बन्धितरक्तास्थिक्रिमिवसामज्जास्नायुकेशादिदूषिते कुत्सिते शरीरे निवासिनं स्वयमप्येवं परिदूषितदेहं मातुश्च कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णभुक्तदह्यमात्मानं दृष्ट्वा देही पूर्वजन्मस्मरणानुभावात्पूर्वानुभूतनरकदुःथानि च स्मृत्वान्तर्दुःखेन च परिदह्यमानो मातुर्देहातिमूत्रादिरुक्षेण दह्यमान एवं मनसि प्रलयति //
text_mt: When the second month is completed, it attains merely the human form; when three months are completed, it attains the state of limbs such as hands and feet; when four months have passed, there is distinct perception of the joints of all the limbs; when five have elapsed, the manifestation of nails takes place; when six have elapsed, the joints of the nails attain clear visibility. Nourished by the umbilical cord, its limbs soaked in impure matter and urine, bound by the amnion, dwelling in a contemptible body defiled by blood, bone, worms, fat, marrow, sinew, hair, and the like, seeing itself likewise having a defiled body and burning from the bitter, sour, salty, and exceedingly hot food eaten by the mother, the embodied soul, through the power of remembering previous births and recalling the sufferings of hell experienced before, burning with internal sorrow and burning from the harshness of the mother's bodily urine and the like, thus laments in its mind:

sanskrit_iast: aho 'tyantapāpo 'haṃpūrvajanmanibhṛtyāpatyamitrayoṣidgṛhakṣetradhanadhānyādiṣvatyantarāgeṇa kalatrapoṣaṇārthaṃ paradhanakṣetrādikaṃ paśyato haraṇādyupāyairapahyatya kāmāndhatayā parastrīharaṇādikamanubhūya mahāpāpānyācaraṃstaiḥ pāpairahameka evaṃvidhanarakānanubhūya punaḥ sthāvarādiṣu mahāduḥkhamanubhūya saṃprati jarāyuṇā pariveṣṭito 'ntardukhena bahistāpena ca dahyāmi //
meaning: अहो ऽत्यन्तपापो ऽहंपूर्वजन्मनिभृत्यापत्यमित्रयोषिद्गृहक्षेत्रधनधान्यादिष्वत्यन्तरागेण कलत्रपोषणार्थं परधनक्षेत्रादिकं पश्यतो हरणाद्युपायैरपह्यत्य कामान्धतया परस्त्रीहरणादिकमनुभूय महापापान्याचरंस्तैः पापैरहमेक एवंविधनरकाननुभूय पुनः स्थावरादिषु महादुःखमनुभूय संप्रति जरायुणा परिवेष्टितो ऽन्तर्दुखेन बहिस्तापेन च दह्यामि //
text_mt: 'Alas! I was exceedingly sinful in my previous birth! Out of excessive passion for servants, children, friends, women, house, field, wealth, grain, and the like, for the sake of nourishing my wife, having seized another's wealth, field, and the like right before their eyes by means of theft and the like, having experienced the abduction of other men's wives and the like out of blindness of lust, committing great sins—by those sins, I alone, having experienced hells of such kinds, and having experienced great suffering among stationary beings and the like, am now enveloped by the amnion, burning with internal sorrow and external heat!

sanskrit_iast: mayā poṣitā dārāśca svakarmavaśādanyato gatāḥ //
meaning: मया पोषिता दाराश्च स्वकर्मवशादन्यतो गताः //
text_mt: And the wife nourished by me has gone elsewhere under the influence of her own karma!

sanskrit_iast: aho dukhaṃ hi dehinām //
meaning: अहो दुखं हि देहिनाम् //

sanskrit_iast:
dehastu pāpātsaṃjātastasmātpāpaṃ na kārayet /
bhṛtyabhitrakalatrārthamanyaddravyaṃ hṛtaṃ mayā //
meaning:
देहस्तु पापात्संजातस्तस्मात्पापं न कारयेत् /
भृत्यभित्रकलत्रार्थमन्यद्द्रव्यं हृतं मया //
text_mt: [The creature in the womb thinks:] The body has arisen from sin; therefore one should not commit sin. / For the sake of servants, friends, and wife, another's property was stolen by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tena pāpena dahyāmi jarāyupariveṣṭitaḥ /
dṛṣṭvānyasya śriyaṃ pūrvaṃ satatpo 'hamasūyayā khitaḥ //
meaning:
तेन पापेन दह्यामि जरायुपरिवेष्टितः /
दृष्ट्वान्यस्य श्रियं पूर्वं सतत्पो ऽहमसूयया खितः //
text_mt: Through that sin I burn, enveloped by the amnion. / Formerly, upon seeing another's prosperity, I was afflicted with jealousy and burnt with anguish.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhāgninānudahyeyamidānīmapi pāpakṛt /
kāyena manasā vācā parapīḍāmakāriṣamtena pāpena dahyāmi tvahameko 'tiduḥkhitaḥ //
meaning:
गर्भाग्निनानुदह्येयमिदानीमपि पापकृत् /
कायेन मनसा वाचा परपीडामकारिषम्तेन पापेन दह्यामि त्वहमेको ऽतिदुःखितः //
text_mt: Now too, an evil-doer, I am burned by the fire of the womb. / By body, mind, and speech I inflicted suffering on others; / through that sin I burn, alone and deeply tormented.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ garbhastho janturvilapya svayameva vā //
meaning: एवं बहुविधं गर्भस्थो जन्तुर्विलप्य स्वयमेव वा //
text_mt: Having thus lamented in diverse ways, the creature dwelling in the womb, or by itself

sanskrit_iast: ātmānamāśvāsya utpatteranantaraṃ satsaṃgena viṣṇoścaritaśravaṇena ca viśuddhamanā bhūtvā satkarmāṇi nirvartya akhilajagadantarātmanaḥ satyajñānānandamayasya śaktiprabhāvānuṣṭitaviṣṭapavargasya lakṣmīpaternārāyaṇasya sakalasurāsurayakṣagandharvarākṣasapanna gamunikinnarasamūhārcitacaraṇakamalayugaṃ bhaktitaḥ samabhyarcya duḥsahaḥ saṃsāracchedasyakāraṇabhūtaṃ vedarahasyopaniṣadbhiḥ parisphuṭaṃ sakalalokaparāyaṇaṃ hṛdinidhāya duḥkhataramimaṃ saṃskārāgāramatikramiṣyāmīti manasi bhavayati //
meaning: आत्मानमाश्वास्य उत्पत्तेरनन्तरं सत्संगेन विष्णोश्चरितश्रवणेन च विशुद्धमना भूत्वा सत्कर्माणि निर्वर्त्य अखिलजगदन्तरात्मनः सत्यज्ञानानन्दमयस्य शक्तिप्रभावानुष्टितविष्टपवर्गस्य लक्ष्मीपतेर्नारायणस्य सकलसुरासुरयक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसपन्न गमुनिकिन्नरसमूहार्चितचरणकमलयुगं भक्तितः समभ्यर्च्य दुःसहः संसारच्छेदस्यकारणभूतं वेदरहस्योपनिषद्भिः परिस्फुटं सकललोकपरायणं हृदिनिधाय दुःखतरमिमं संस्कारागारमतिक्रमिष्यामीति मनसि भवयति //
text_mt: comforting itself, contemplates in mind: 'After birth, through the company of the virtuous and through hearing the deeds of Viṣṇu, becoming purified in mind and performing good deeds, having worshipped with devotion the pair of lotus feet—adored by the hosts of all gods, asuras, yakṣas, gandharvas, rākṣasas, serpents, sages, and kinnaras—of Nārāyaṇa, the inner Self of the entire universe, who consists of truth, knowledge, and bliss, by whose power the realms are sustained, the lord of Lakṣmī; keeping in heart the ultimate refuge of all the worlds, clearly revealed by the Upaniṣads that are the secret of the Vedas, who is the cause of cutting off this unbearable worldly existence, I will transcend this most painful abode of latent impressions.'

sanskrit_iast: yatastanmātuḥ prasūtisamaye sati garbhasthodehī nāradamune vāyunāparipīḍito mātuścāpi duḥkhaṃ kurvankarmapāśena balādyonimārgānniṣkrāmansakalayātanābhogamekakālabhavamanubhavati //
meaning: यतस्तन्मातुः प्रसूतिसमये सति गर्भस्थोदेही नारदमुने वायुनापरिपीडितो मातुश्चापि दुःखं कुर्वन्कर्मपाशेन बलाद्योनिमार्गान्निष्क्रामन्सकलयातनाभोगमेककालभवमनुभवति //
text_mt: For at the time of the mother's delivery, O sage Nārada, the embodied soul in the womb, tormented by the wind [of labour], causing pain to the mother as well, emerging forcibly from the vaginal canal due to the bondage of karma, experiences in a single moment the full torment of all sufferings.

sanskrit_iast: tenātikleśena yoniyantrapūḍito garbhānniṣkānto niḥsaṃjñatāṃ yāti //
meaning: तेनातिक्लेशेन योनियन्त्रपूडितो गर्भान्निष्कान्तो निःसंज्ञतां याति //
text_mt: Through that extreme agony, crushed by the vaginal machine, having emerged from the womb, it falls into unconsciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tu bāhyavāyuḥ samujjīvayati /
bāhyavāyusparśasamanantarameva naṣṭasmṛtipūrvānubhūtākhiladuḥkhāni varttamānānyapi jñānābhāvadavijñāyātyantaduḥkhamanubhavati //
meaning:
तं तु बाह्यवायुः समुज्जीवयति /
बाह्यवायुस्पर्शसमनन्तरमेव नष्टस्मृतिपूर्वानुभूताखिलदुःखानि वर्त्तमानान्यपि ज्ञानाभावदविज्ञायात्यन्तदुःखमनुभवति //
text_mt: The external air, however, revives it. / Immediately upon contact with the external air, its memory is lost; and failing to recognise, through lack of knowledge, all the sufferings experienced previously as well as those present now, it experiences utter misery.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ bālatvamāpanno jantustatrāpi svamalamūtralitpadeha ādhyātmikādipīḍyamāno 'pi vaktumaśaktakṣuttṛṣāpīḍito rudite sati stanādikaṃ deyamiti manvānāḥ prayatante //
meaning: एवं बालत्वमापन्नो जन्तुस्तत्रापि स्वमलमूत्रलित्पदेह आध्यात्मिकादिपीड्यमानो ऽपि वक्तुमशक्तक्षुत्तृषापीडितो रुदिते सति स्तनादिकं देयमिति मन्वानाः प्रयतन्ते //
text_mt: Thus, having reached infancy, the creature even there has its body smeared with its own excrement and urine; afflicted by internal and other sufferings, it is unable to speak; when, afflicted by hunger and thirst, it cries, [its caretakers], thinking that breastmilk or the like should be given, make an effort.

sanskrit_iast: evamanekaṃ dehabhogamanyādhīnatayānubhūyamāno daṃśādiṣvapi nivārayitumaśaktaḥ //
meaning: एवमनेकं देहभोगमन्याधीनतयानुभूयमानो दंशादिष्वपि निवारयितुमशक्तः //
text_mt: Thus experiencing many bodily afflictions through dependence on others, it is unable to ward off even gnats and [biting insects].

sanskrit_iast: bālyabhāvamāsādya mātāpitrorupādhyāyasya tāḍanaṃ sadā paryaṭanaśīlatvaṃ pāṃśubhasmapaṅkādiṣukrīḍanaṃ sadā kalahaniyatatvāma śucitvaṃ bahuvyāpārābhāsakāryaniyatatvaṃ tadasaṃbhava ādhyātmikaduḥkhamevaṃvidhamanubhavati //
meaning: बाल्यभावमासाद्य मातापित्रोरुपाध्यायस्य ताडनं सदा पर्यटनशीलत्वं पांशुभस्मपङ्कादिषुक्रीडनं सदा कलहनियतत्वाम शुचित्वं बहुव्यापाराभासकार्यनियतत्वं तदसंभव आध्यात्मिकदुःखमेवंविधमनुभवति //
text_mt: Reaching childhood, it experiences such sufferings caused by internal factors: beatings by parents and the teacher, constantly roaming about, playing in dust, ashes, and mud, constant involvement in quarrels, impurity, engagement in various seemingly meaningful activities, and the failure of those [endeavours].

sanskrit_iast: tatastu taruṇabhāvena dhanārjanamarjitasya rakṣaṇaṃ tasya nāśavyayādiṣu cātyantaduḥkhitā māyayā mohitāḥ kāmakrodhādiduṣṭamanasāḥ sadāsūyāparāyaṇāḥ parasvaparastrīharaṇopāyaparāyaṇāḥ putramitrakalatrādibharaṇopāyacintāparāyaṇā vṛthāhaṅkāradūṣitāḥ putrādiṣu vyādhyādi pīḍiteṣu satsu sarvavyātpiṃ parityajya rogādibhiḥ kleśitānāṃ samīpe svayamādhyātmikaduḥkhena pariplutā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa citāmaśnuvate //
meaning: ततस्तु तरुणभावेन धनार्जनमर्जितस्य रक्षणं तस्य नाशव्ययादिषु चात्यन्तदुःखिता मायया मोहिताः कामक्रोधादिदुष्टमनसाः सदासूयापरायणाः परस्वपरस्त्रीहरणोपायपरायणाः पुत्रमित्रकलत्रादिभरणोपायचिन्तापरायणा वृथाहङ्कारदूषिताः पुत्रादिषु व्याध्यादि पीडितेषु सत्सु सर्वव्यात्पिं परित्यज्य रोगादिभिः क्लेशितानां समीपे स्वयमाध्यात्मिकदुःखेन परिप्लुता वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारेण चितामश्नुवते //
text_mt: Then, arriving at youth, they become extremely distressed over the acquisition of wealth, the preservation of what has been acquired, and its loss and expenditure; deluded by māyā, with minds corrupted by lust, anger, and the like, always intent on envy, intent on means to seize another's property and another's wife, intent on the worry of means to support sons, friends, and wives, tainted by futile egoism; and when their sons and others are afflicted with disease and the like, abandoning all their activities, in the presence of those tormented by sickness and the like, themselves overwhelmed by internal suffering, they experience anxiety in the manner to be described:

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ kama kiñcinnāpi vicāritam /
samṛddhasya kuṭumbasya kathaṃ bhavati varttanam //
meaning:
गृहक्षेत्रादिकं कम किञ्चिन्नापि विचारितम् /
समृद्धस्य कुटुम्बस्य कथं भवति वर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: 'House, field, and the like have not been considered at all. / How will the maintenance of a large family be secured?

sanskrit_iast:
mama mūladhanaṃ nāsti vṛṣṭiścāpi na varṣati /
aśvaḥ palāyitaḥ kutra gāvaḥ kiṃ nāgatā mama //
meaning:
मम मूलधनं नास्ति वृष्टिश्चापि न वर्षति /
अश्वः पलायितः कुत्र गावः किं नागता मम //
text_mt: I have no capital, and the rain does not fall either. / Where has the horse fled? Why have my cows not returned?

sanskrit_iast:
bālāpatyā ca me bhāryā vyādhito 'haṃ ca nirdhanaḥ /
avicārātkṛṣirnaṣṭā putrā nityaṃ rudanti ca //
meaning:
बालापत्या च मे भार्या व्याधितो ऽहं च निर्धनः /
अविचारात्कृषिर्नष्टा पुत्रा नित्यं रुदन्ति च //
text_mt: My wife has young children, and I am diseased and penniless. / Through lack of planning, farming has failed, and my sons constantly weep.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnaṃ chinnaṃ tu me sadma bāndhavā api dūragāḥ /
na labhyate varttanaṃ ca rāja bādhātiduḥsahā //
meaning:
भग्नं छिन्नं तु मे सद्म बान्धवा अपि दूरगाः /
न लभ्यते वर्त्तनं च राज बाधातिदुःसहा //
text_mt: My dwelling is broken and torn down, and my kinsmen too have gone far away. / Maintenance is not to be found, and the oppression of the king is unbearable.

sanskrit_iast:
ripavo māṃ pradhāvante kathaṃ jeṣṭāmyahaṃ ripūn /
vyavasāyākṣamaścāhaṃ prātpāḥ prāghūrṇakā amī //
meaning:
रिपवो मां प्रधावन्ते कथं जेष्टाम्यहं रिपून् /
व्यवसायाक्षमश्चाहं प्रात्पाः प्राघूर्णका अमी //
text_mt: Enemies are running against me; how shall I conquer the enemies? / I am incapable of work, and these guests have arrived.'

sanskrit_iast: evamatyantacintākulaḥ svaduḥkhāni nivārayitumakṣamo dhigvidhiṃ bhāgyahīnaṃ māṃ kimarthaṃ vidadhe iti daivamākṣipati //
meaning: एवमत्यन्तचिन्ताकुलः स्वदुःखानि निवारयितुमक्षमो धिग्विधिं भाग्यहीनं मां किमर्थं विदधे इति दैवमाक्षिपति //
text_mt: Thus bewildered by intense worry, incapable of warding off his own miseries, he censures fate: 'Fie upon destiny! For what purpose did it make me so destitute of good fortune?'

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vṛddhatvamāpanno hīyamānasāro jarāpalitādivyātpadeho vyādhibādhyatvādikamāpannaḥ /
prakaṃpamānāvayavaśvāsakāsādipīḍito lolāvilalocanaḥ śleṣmaṇyātpakaṇṭhaḥ putradārādibhirbhartsyamānaḥ kadā maraṇamupayāmīti cintākulo mayi mṛte sati madarjitaṃ gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ vastu putrādayaḥ kathaṃ rakṣanti kasya vā bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तथा वृद्धत्वमापन्नो हीयमानसारो जरापलितादिव्यात्पदेहो व्याधिबाध्यत्वादिकमापन्नः /
प्रकंपमानावयवश्वासकासादिपीडितो लोलाविललोचनः श्लेष्मण्यात्पकण्ठः पुत्रदारादिभिर्भर्त्स्यमानः कदा मरणमुपयामीति चिन्ताकुलो मयि मृते सति मदर्जितं गृहक्षेत्रादिकं वस्तु पुत्रादयः कथं रक्षन्ति कस्य वा भविष्यति //
text_mt: Likewise, having reached old age, his strength failing, his body pervaded by decrepitude, grey hair, and the like, afflicted by disease and other torments, / his limbs trembling, afflicted by asthma, cough, and the like, his eyes unsteady and dimmed, his throat filled with phlegm, reviled by his sons, wife, and others, anxious as to when he will meet death: 'When I have died, how will my sons and others protect the house, field, and possessions acquired by me? Or to whom will they belong?

sanskrit_iast: maddhane parairapahṛte putrādīnāṃ kathaṃ varttanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti mamatāduḥkhaparipluto gāḍhaṃ niḥśvasya svena vayasā kṛtāni karmāṇi punaḥ punaḥ smaran kṣaṇe vismarati ca saṃtatastvāsannamaraṇo //
meaning: मद्धने परैरपहृते पुत्रादीनां कथं वर्त्तनं भविष्यतीति ममतादुःखपरिप्लुतो गाढं निःश्वस्य स्वेन वयसा कृतानि कर्माणि पुनः पुनः स्मरन् क्षणे विस्मरति च संततस्त्वासन्नमरणो //
text_mt: If my wealth is carried off by others, how will the maintenance of my sons and others come about?' Overwhelmed by the pain of possessiveness, sighing deeply, repeatedly remembering the deeds done in his youth and in a moment forgetting them, constantly approaching death,

sanskrit_iast: vyādhipīḍito 'ntastāpārtaḥ kṣaṇaṃ śayyāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ mañce ca tatastataḥ paryaṭan kṣuttṛṭūparipūḍitaḥ kiñcinmātramudakaṃ dehītyatikārpaṇyena yācamānastatrāpi jvarāviṣṭānāmudakaṃ na śreyaskaramiti bruvato manasātidveṣaṃ kurvanmanda caitanyo bhavati //
meaning: व्याधिपीडितो ऽन्तस्तापार्तः क्षणं शय्यायां क्षणं मञ्चे च ततस्ततः पर्यटन् क्षुत्तृटूपरिपूडितः किञ्चिन्मात्रमुदकं देहीत्यतिकार्पण्येन याचमानस्तत्रापि ज्वराविष्टानामुदकं न श्रेयस्करमिति ब्रुवतो मनसातिद्वेषं कुर्वन्मन्द चैतन्यो भवति //
text_mt: afflicted by disease, tormented by inner burning, for a moment on the bed, for a moment on a couch, wandering here and there, afflicted by hunger and thirst, begging with extreme helplessness, 'Give me just a little water!', and when they say, 'Water is not good for those gripped with fever,' feeling intense hatred in his mind, his consciousness fades.

sanskrit_iast: tataśca hastapādākarṣaṇe na tu kṣamo rudradbhibandhujanairveṣṭito vaktumakṣamaḥ svārjitadhanādikaṃ kasya bhaviṣyatīti cintāparo bāṣpāvilavilocanaḥ kaṇṭhe vuraghurāyamāṇe sati śarīrānniṣkrāntaprāṇo yamadūtairbhartsyamānaḥ pāśayantrito narakādīnpūrvavadaśnute //
meaning: ततश्च हस्तपादाकर्षणे न तु क्षमो रुद्रद्भिबन्धुजनैर्वेष्टितो वक्तुमक्षमः स्वार्जितधनादिकं कस्य भविष्यतीति चिन्तापरो बाष्पाविलविलोचनः कण्ठे वुरघुरायमाणे सति शरीरान्निष्क्रान्तप्राणो यमदूतैर्भर्त्स्यमानः पाशयन्त्रितो नरकादीन्पूर्ववदश्नुते //
text_mt: And then, no longer able to draw back his hands and feet, surrounded by weeping relatives, unable to speak, intent on worrying, 'To whom will the wealth and property acquired by me belong?', his eyes clouded with tears, with a rattling sound in his throat, his breath departing from the body, reviled by the messengers of Yama, bound with cords, he suffers hells and other [torments] as before.

sanskrit_iast:
āmalaprakṣayādyadvadagnau dhāmyanti dhātavaḥ /
tathaiva jīvinaḥ sarva ākarmaprakṣayād bhṛśam //
meaning:
आमलप्रक्षयाद्यद्वदग्नौ धाम्यन्ति धातवः /
तथैव जीविनः सर्व आकर्मप्रक्षयाद् भृशम् //
text_mt: Just as base metals are smelted in fire until their impurities are destroyed, / so all living beings are intensely [smelted] until their karma is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃsāradāvāgnitāpārto dvijasattama /
abhyasetparamaṃ jñānaṃ jñānānmokṣamavānpuyāt //
meaning:
तस्मात्संसारदावाग्नितापार्तो द्विजसत्तम /
अभ्यसेत्परमं ज्ञानं ज्ञानान्मोक्षमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt: Therefore, O best of the twice-born, afflicted by the scorching heat of the forest fire of saṃsāra, / one should cultivate supreme knowledge; through knowledge one attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaśūnyā narā ye tu paśavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
tasmātsaṃsāramokṣāya paraṃ jñānaṃ samabhyaset //
meaning:
ज्ञानशून्या नरा ये तु पशवः परिकीर्तिताः /
तस्मात्संसारमोक्षाय परं ज्ञानं समभ्यसेत् //
text_mt: Those men who are devoid of knowledge are declared to be beasts; / therefore, for liberation from saṃsāra, one should thoroughly cultivate supreme knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyaṃ caiva saṃprāpya sarvakarmaprasādhakam /
hariṃ na sevate yastu ko 'nyastasmādacetanaḥ //
meaning:
मानुष्यं चैव संप्राप्य सर्वकर्मप्रसाधकम् /
हरिं न सेवते यस्तु को ऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः //
text_mt: And having obtained human birth, which accomplishes all deeds, / who could be more senseless than one who does not serve Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
aho citramaho citramaho citraṃ munīśvarāḥ /
āsthite kāmade viṣṇo narā yānti hi yātanām //
meaning:
अहो चित्रमहो चित्रमहो चित्रं मुनीश्वराः /
आस्थिते कामदे विष्णो नरा यान्ति हि यातनाम् //
text_mt: Ah, wonder of wonders! Ah, wonder of wonders! Ah, what a wonder, O lords of sages! / Even while Viṣṇu, the grantor of desires, is present, men go to torment!

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇe jagannāthe sarvakāmaphalaprade /
sthite 'pi jñānarahitāḥ pacyante narakeṣvaho //
meaning:
नारायणे जगन्नाथे सर्वकामफलप्रदे /
स्थिते ऽपि ज्ञानरहिताः पच्यन्ते नरकेष्वहो //
text_mt: Even while Nārāyaṇa, Lord of the Universe, grantor of the fruit of all desires, / is present, the ignorant, alas, are roasted in hells!

sanskrit_iast:
stravanmūtrapurīṣe tu śarīre 'sminnṛśāśvate /
śāśvataṃ bhāvayantyajñā mahāmohasamāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रवन्मूत्रपुरीषे तु शरीरे ऽस्मिन्नृशाश्वते /
शाश्वतं भावयन्त्यज्ञा महामोहसमावृताः //
text_mt: Indeed, in this impermanent body oozing urine and feces, / fools enveloped in great delusion imagine permanence.

sanskrit_iast:
kutsitaṃ māṃsaraktādyairdehaṃ saṃprāpya yo naraḥ /
saṃsāracchedakaṃ viṣṇuṃ na bhajetso 'tipātakī //
meaning:
कुत्सितं मांसरक्ताद्यैर्देहं संप्राप्य यो नरः /
संसारच्छेदकं विष्णुं न भजेत्सो ऽतिपातकी //
text_mt: Having obtained a despicable body composed of flesh, blood, and the like, / that man who does not worship Viṣṇu, who severs transmigration, is a supreme sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
aho kaṣṭamaho kaṣṭamaho kaṣṭaṃ hi mūrkhatā /
haridhyānaparo vipra caṇḍālo 'pi mahāsukhī //
meaning:
अहो कष्टमहो कष्टमहो कष्टं हि मूर्खता /
हरिध्यानपरो विप्र चण्डालो ऽपि महासुखी //
text_mt: Ah, what sorrow! Ah, what sorrow! For foolishness is indeed great sorrow! / O brahmin, even an outcaste devoted to meditation on Hari is supremely happy.

sanskrit_iast:
svadehānniḥsṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā malamūtrādikilbiṣam /
udvega mānavā mūrkhāḥ kiṃ na yānti hi pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
स्वदेहान्निःसृतं दृष्ट्वा मलमूत्रादिकिल्बिषम् /
उद्वेग मानवा मूर्खाः किं न यान्ति हि पापिनः //
text_mt: Seeing the foul filth of feces, urine, and the like discharged from their own bodies, / why do foolish, sinful men not feel revulsion?

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma prārthyate tridaśairapi /
tallabdhvā paralokārthaṃ yatnaṃ kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्लभं मानुषं जन्म प्रार्थ्यते त्रिदशैरपि /
तल्लब्ध्वा परलोकार्थं यत्नं कुर्य्याद्विचक्षणः //
text_mt: Human birth is hard to attain, desired even by the gods; / having attained it, a wise person should strive for the sake of the next world.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyātmajñānasaṃpannā haripūjāparāyaṇāḥ /
labhante paramaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
अध्यात्मज्ञानसंपन्ना हरिपूजापरायणाः /
लभन्ते परमं स्थानं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Endowed with knowledge of the Self, devoted to the worship of Hari, / they attain the supreme state, from which return is hard to obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
yato jātamidaṃ viśvaṃ yataścaitanyamaśnute /
yasmiṃśca vilayaṃ yāti sa saṃsārasya mocakaḥ //
meaning:
यतो जातमिदं विश्वं यतश्चैतन्यमश्नुते /
यस्मिंश्च विलयं याति स संसारस्य मोचकः //
text_mt: He from whom this universe has arisen, through whom it attains consciousness, / and in whom it dissolves—He is the deliverer from transmigration.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇo 'pi paro 'nanto guṇavāniva bhāti yaḥ /
taṃ samabhyarcya deveśaṃ saṃsārātparimucyate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde bhavāṭavīnirupaṇaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
निर्गुणो ऽपि परो ऽनन्तो गुणवानिव भाति यः /
तं समभ्यर्च्य देवेशं संसारात्परिमुच्यते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे भवाटवीनिरुपणं नाम द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Though devoid of qualities, the supreme, infinite Lord appears as if possessing qualities; / having worshipped that Lord of gods, one is liberated from transmigration.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, titled “Description of the Forest of Transmigration,” in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
bhagavansarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ viduṣā tvayā /
saṃsārapāśabaddhānāṃ duḥkhāni subahūni ca //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
भगवन्सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टं विदुषा त्वया /
संसारपाशबद्धानां दुःखानि सुबहूनि च //
text_mt: Nārada said: / O Lord, all has been recounted by you, the wise one, as was asked, / concerning the exceedingly numerous sorrows of those bound by the snares of transmigration.

sanskrit_iast:
asya saṃsārapāśasya cchedakaḥ katamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
yenopāyena mokṣaḥ syāttanme brūhi tapodhana //
meaning:
अस्य संसारपाशस्य च्छेदकः कतमः स्मृतः /
येनोपायेन मोक्षः स्यात्तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन //
text_mt: Which one is recalled as the severer of this snare of transmigration? / Tell me, O rich in asceticism, by what means liberation might be attained.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇibhiḥ karmajālāni kriyante pratyahaṃ bhṛśam /
bhujyante ca muniśreṣṭha teṣāṃ nāśaḥ kathaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
प्राणिभिः कर्मजालानि क्रियन्ते प्रत्यहं भृशम् /
भुज्यन्ते च मुनिश्रेष्ठ तेषां नाशः कथं भवेत् //
text_mt: Tangles of actions are constantly wrought by living beings, / and they are experienced; O best of sages, how can their destruction come about?

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā dehamānpoti dehī kāmena badhyate /
kāmāllobhābhibhūtaḥ syāllobhātkrodhaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा देहमान्पोति देही कामेन बध्यते /
कामाल्लोभाभिभूतः स्याल्लोभात्क्रोधपरायणाः //
text_mt: Through action, the embodied soul obtains a body; [then] it is bound by desire. / From desire it becomes overcome by greed; from greed it becomes prone to anger.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāñca dharmanāśaḥ syāddharmanāśānmatibhramaḥ /
pranaṣṭabuddhirmanujaḥ punaḥ pāpaṃ karoti ca //
meaning:
क्रोधाञ्च धर्मनाशः स्याद्धर्मनाशान्मतिभ्रमः /
प्रनष्टबुद्धिर्मनुजः पुनः पापं करोति च //
text_mt: And from anger comes destruction of virtue; from destruction of virtue comes confusion of the intellect. / A human being whose intellect is destroyed commits sin again.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddehaṃ pāpamūlaṃ pāpakarmarataṃ tathā /
yathā dehabhramatyaktvā mokṣabhāksyāttathā vada //
meaning:
तस्माद्देहं पापमूलं पापकर्मरतं तथा /
यथा देहभ्रमत्यक्त्वा मोक्षभाक्स्यात्तथा वद //
text_mt: Therefore, the body is the root of sin, and devoted to sinful deeds; / tell me how one may abandon bodily delusion and partake of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña matiste vimalorjitā /
yasmātsaṃsāraduḥkhānno mokṣopāyamabhīpsasi //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ मतिस्ते विमलोर्जिता /
यस्मात्संसारदुःखान्नो मोक्षोपायमभीप्ससि //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Well done, well done, O highly wise one! Your intellect is spotless and powerful, / since you desire the means of liberation from the sorrow of transmigration.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyājñayā jagatsarvaṃ brahmnā sṛjati suvrata /
hariśca pālako rudro nāśakaḥ sa hi mokṣadaḥ //
meaning:
यस्याज्ञया जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्म्ना सृजति सुव्रत /
हरिश्च पालको रुद्रो नाशकः स हि मोक्षदः //
text_mt: By whose command Brahmā creates the entire universe, O virtuous one, / and Hari is the preserver, and Rudra is the destroyer—He indeed is the giver of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamādiviśeṣāntā jātāyasya prabhāvatagaḥ /
taṃ vidyānmokṣadaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam //
meaning:
अहमादिविशेषान्ता जातायस्य प्रभावतगः /
तं विद्यान्मोक्षदं विष्णुं नारायणमनामयम् //
text_mt: By whose power the principles beginning with egoity and ending with the gross elements have arisen, / one should know Him, free from affliction, as Viṣṇu, Nārāyaṇa, the giver of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyābhinnamidaṃ sarvaṃ yacceṅgadyañca neṅgati /
tamugramajaraṃ devaṃ dhyātvā duḥkhātpramucyate //
meaning:
यस्याभिन्नमिदं सर्वं यच्चेङ्गद्यञ्च नेङ्गति /
तमुग्रमजरं देवं ध्यात्वा दुःखात्प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: From whom this whole [universe], moving and unmoving, is non-different— / meditating upon that fierce, ageless God, one is freed from sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ svaprakāśaṃ nirañjanam /
jñānarupaṃ sadānandaṃ prāhurvaimokṣasādhanam //
meaning:
अविकारमजं शुद्धं स्वप्रकाशं निरञ्जनम् /
ज्ञानरुपं सदानन्दं प्राहुर्वैमोक्षसाधनम् //
text_mt: Immutable, unborn, pure, self-luminous, stainless, / the embodiment of knowledge, eternal bliss—they call Him the means of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāvatārarupāṇi brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ /
samarcayanti taṃ vidyācchāśvatasthānadaṃ harim //
meaning:
यस्यावताररुपाणि ब्रह्माद्या देवतागणाः /
समर्चयन्ति तं विद्याच्छाश्वतस्थानदं हरिम् //
text_mt: Whose descent-forms the hosts of deities headed by Brahmā / properly worship—one should know Him, Hari, as the giver of the eternal state.

sanskrit_iast:
jitaprāṇā jitāhārāḥ sadā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ /
hṛdi paśyanti yaṃ satyaṃ taṃ jāmīhi sukhāvaham //
meaning:
जितप्राणा जिताहाराः सदा ध्यानपरायणाः /
हृदि पश्यन्ति यं सत्यं तं जामीहि सुखावहम् //
text_mt: Those who have conquered their breaths, conquered their food, and are ever devoted to meditation, / perceive Him, the Truth, in their heart; know Him to be the bringer of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇo 'pi guṇādhāro lokānugraharupadhṛk /
ākāśamadhyagaḥ pūrṇastaṃ prāhurmokṣadaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
निर्गुणो ऽपि गुणाधारो लोकानुग्रहरुपधृक् /
आकाशमध्यगः पूर्णस्तं प्राहुर्मोक्षदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: Though devoid of qualities, the substratum of qualities, assuming forms for the grace of the worlds, / dwelling in the middle of space, all-pervading—Him they proclaim the giver of liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyakṣaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ dehino hṛdaye sthitaḥ /
anūpamo 'khilādhārastāṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
अध्यक्षः सर्वकार्याणां देहिनो हृदये स्थितः /
अनूपमो ऽखिलाधारस्तां देवं शरणं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: The witness of all actions, seated in the heart of the embodied soul, / peerless, the support of all—one should take refuge in that God.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ saṃgṛhya kalpānte śete yastu jale svayam /
taṃ prāhurmokṣadaṃ viṣṇuṃ munayastattvadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वं संगृह्य कल्पान्ते शेते यस्तु जले स्वयम् /
तं प्राहुर्मोक्षदं विष्णुं मुनयस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः //
text_mt: Gathering up all things at the end of the aeon, He sleeps on the water by Himself; / the sages who see the truth proclaim Him, Viṣṇu, the giver of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
vedārthavidbhiḥ karmajñairijyate vividhairmakhaiḥ /
sa eva karmaphalado mokṣado 'kāmakarmaṇām //
meaning:
वेदार्थविद्भिः कर्मज्ञैरिज्यते विविधैर्मखैः /
स एव कर्मफलदो मोक्षदो ऽकामकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: He is worshipped with diverse sacrifices by those who know the meaning of the Vedas and know ritual; / He alone gives the fruit of action, and gives liberation to those whose actions are free from desire.

sanskrit_iast:
havyakavyādidāneṣu devatāpitṛrūpadhṛk /
bhuṅkte ya īśvaro 'vyaktastaṃ prāhurmokṣadaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
हव्यकव्यादिदानेषु देवतापितृरूपधृक् /
भुङ्क्ते य ईश्वरो ऽव्यक्तस्तं प्राहुर्मोक्षदं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Taking the forms of the deities and ancestors in offerings of havis, kavya, and the like, / the unmanifest Lord enjoys them; Him they proclaim the Master who gives liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātaḥ praṇamito vāpi pūjito vāpi bhaktitaḥ /
dadāti śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ taṃ dayāluṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
ध्यातः प्रणमितो वापि पूजितो वापि भक्तितः /
ददाति शाश्वतं स्थानं तं दयालुं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Whether meditated upon, bowed to, or worshipped with devotion, / He grants the eternal abode; one should worship that compassionate Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃmeko yaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ /
jarāmaraṇanirmukto mokṣadaḥ so 'vyayo hariḥ //
meaning:
आधारः सर्वभूतानांमेको यः पुरुषः परः /
जरामरणनिर्मुक्तो मोक्षदः सो ऽव्ययो हरिः //
text_mt: The support of all beings, the one supreme Person, / freed from old age and death, the imperishable Hari is the giver of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya yasya pādābjaṃ dehino 'pi munīśvara /
amṛtatvaṃ bhajantyāśu taṃ viduḥ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
संपूज्य यस्य पादाब्जं देहिनो ऽपि मुनीश्वर /
अमृतत्वं भजन्त्याशु तं विदुः पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped whose lotus feet even embodied beings, O lord of sages, / swiftly partake of immortality—Him they know as the Supreme Person.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandamajaraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam /
parātparataraṃ yañca tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
आनन्दमजरं ब्रह्म परं ज्योतिः सनातनम् /
परात्परतरं यञ्च तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Bliss, ageless Brahman, supreme light, eternal, / and that which is higher than the highest—that is the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
advayaṃ niguṇaṃ nityamadvitīyamanaupamam /
paripūrṇaṃ jñānamayaṃ vidurmokṣapratādhakam //
meaning:
अद्वयं निगुणं नित्यमद्वितीयमनौपमम् /
परिपूर्णं ज्ञानमयं विदुर्मोक्षप्रताधकम् //
text_mt: Non-dual, devoid of qualities, eternal, without a second, incomparable, / full, consisting of knowledge—they know Him to be the producer of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃbhūtaṃ paraṃ vastu yogamārgavidhānataḥ /
ya upāste sadā yogī sa yāti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
एवंभूतं परं वस्तु योगमार्गविधानतः /
य उपास्ते सदा योगी स याति परमं पदम् //
text_mt: The yogi who ever worships the supreme Reality thus constituted, / according to the rules of the path of yoga, attains the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
parisarvasaṃgaparityāgī śamādiguṇasaṃyutaḥ /
kāmardyaivarjitoyogī labhate paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
परिसर्वसंगपरित्यागी शमादिगुणसंयुतः /
कामर्द्यैवर्जितोयोगी लभते परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Renouncing all attachments, endowed with qualities such as tranquility, / the yogi, freed from desire and the like, attains the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
karmaṇā kena yogasya siddhirbhavati yoginām /
tadupāyaṃ yathātattvaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कर्मणा केन योगस्य सिद्धिर्भवति योगिनाम् /
तदुपायं यथातत्त्वं ब्रूहि मे वदतां वर //
text_mt: Nārada said: / By what action does the accomplishment of yoga occur for yogis? / Tell me the means to it according to reality, O best among the eloquent!

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
jñānalabhyaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāhustattvārthacintakāḥ /
yajjñānaṃ bhaktimūlaṃ ca bhaktiḥ karmavatāṃ tathā //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
ज्ञानलभ्यं परं मोक्षं प्राहुस्तत्त्वार्थचिन्तकाः /
यज्ज्ञानं भक्तिमूलं च भक्तिः कर्मवतां तथा //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Those who contemplate the true meaning declare that supreme liberation is attained through knowledge; / and that knowledge is rooted in devotion, and devotion belongs to those who perform action.

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni yajñā vividhāstīrthayātrādayaḥ kṛtāḥ /
yena janmasahasreṣu tasya bhaktirbhaveddharau //
meaning:
दानानि यज्ञा विविधास्तीर्थयात्रादयः कृताः /
येन जन्मसहस्रेषु तस्य भक्तिर्भवेद्धरौ //
text_mt: He by whom gifts, various sacrifices, pilgrimages to sacred fords, and the like have been performed / throughout thousands of births—devotion to Hari arises in him.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayaḥ paramo dharmo bhaktileśena jāyate /
śraddhayā parayā caiva sarvaṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyati //
meaning:
अक्षयः परमो धर्मो भक्तिलेशेन जायते /
श्रद्धया परया चैव सर्वं पापं प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: Imperishable, supreme righteousness is born from even a fraction of devotion; / and through supreme faith, all sin is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpeṣu naṣṭeṣu buddhirbhavati nirmalā /
saiva buddhiḥ samākhyātā jñānaśabdena sūribhiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापेषु नष्टेषु बुद्धिर्भवति निर्मला /
सैव बुद्धिः समाख्याता ज्ञानशब्देन सूरिभिः //
text_mt: When all sins are destroyed, the intellect becomes spotless; / that very intellect is designated by the wise with the word “knowledge.”

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ prāhustajjñānaṃ yogināṃ bhavet /
yogastu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ karmajñānaprabhedataḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानं च मोक्षदं प्राहुस्तज्ज्ञानं योगिनां भवेत् /
योगस्तु द्विविधः प्रोक्तः कर्मज्ञानप्रभेदतः //
text_mt: And knowledge is said to give liberation; that knowledge arises for yogis. / Yoga is declared to be of two kinds, through the distinction between action and knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāyogaṃ vinā nṝṇāṃ jñānayogo na sidhyati /
kriyāyogaratastasmācchraddhayā harimarcayet //
meaning:
क्रियायोगं विना नॄणां ज्ञानयोगो न सिध्यति /
क्रियायोगरतस्तस्माच्छ्रद्धया हरिमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Without the yoga of action, the yoga of knowledge does not succeed for men; / therefore, devoted to the yoga of action, one should worship Hari with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijabhūmyagnisūryāmbudhātuhṛñcitrasaṃjñitāḥ /
pratimāḥ keśavasyaitā pūjya etāsu bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
द्विजभूम्यग्निसूर्याम्बुधातुहृञ्चित्रसंज्ञिताः /
प्रतिमाः केशवस्यैता पूज्य एतासु भक्तितः //
text_mt: These are the images of Keśava, designated as: a twice-born, the earth, fire, the sun, water, metal, the heart, and a painting; / He is to be worshipped in these with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā paripīḍāparāṅmukhaḥ /
tasmātsarvagataṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा परिपीडापराङ्मुखः /
तस्मात्सर्वगतं विष्णुं पूजयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: Averting oneself from causing injury to others through deed, mind, or speech, / one should worship the all-pervading Viṣṇu endowed with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodho brahmacaryāparigrahau /
anīrṣyā ca dayā caiva yogayorūbhayoḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधो ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ /
अनीर्ष्या च दया चैव योगयोरूभयोः समाः //
text_mt: Non-violence, truth, freedom from anger, celibacy, non-possession, / absence of envy, and compassion are common to both yogas.

sanskrit_iast:
carācarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ /
iti niścitya manasā yogadvitayamabhyaset //
meaning:
चराचरात्मकं विश्वं विष्णुरेव सनातनः /
इति निश्चित्य मनसा योगद्वितयमभ्यसेत् //
text_mt: "The universe composed of the moving and unmoving is verily the eternal Viṣṇu"— / having determined thus in mind, one should practice the twofold yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavatsarvabhūtāni ye manyante manīṣiṇaḥ /
te jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मवत्सर्वभूतानि ये मन्यन्ते मनीषिणः /
ते जानन्ति परं भावं देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः //
text_mt: Those wise ones who regard all beings as oneself, / they know the supreme state of the discus-bearer, the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi krodhādiduṣṭātmā pūjādhyānaparo bhavet /
na tasya tuṣyate viṣṇuryato dharmapatiḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
यदि क्रोधादिदुष्टात्मा पूजाध्यानपरो भवेत् /
न तस्य तुष्यते विष्णुर्यतो धर्मपतिः स्मृतः //
text_mt: If a man of depraved soul, filled with anger and the like, is intent on worship and meditation, / Viṣṇu is not pleased with him, since He is remembered as the Lord of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi kāmādiduṣṭātmā deva pūjāparo bhavet /
daṃbhācāraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvapātakibhiḥ samaḥ //
meaning:
यदि कामादिदुष्टात्मा देव पूजापरो भवेत् /
दंभाचारः स विज्ञेयः सर्वपातकिभिः समः //
text_mt: If one of depraved soul, filled with desire and the like, is intent on the worship of the deity, / his practice should be known as hypocrisy, equal to that of all sinners.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥ pūjādhyānaparoyastvasūyārato bhavet /
tattapaḥ sā ca pūjā ca taddhyānaṃ hi nirarthakam //
meaning:
तपः पूजाध्यानपरोयस्त्वसूयारतो भवेत् /
तत्तपः सा च पूजा च तद्ध्यानं हि निरर्थकम् //
text_mt: Whoever is intent on austerity, worship, and meditation, but delights in malice, / his austerity, that worship, and that meditation are indeed futile.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvātmakaṃ viṣṇuṃ śamādiguṇatatparaḥ /
muktayarthamarcayetsamyak kriyāyogaparo naraḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वात्मकं विष्णुं शमादिगुणतत्परः /
मुक्तयर्थमर्चयेत्सम्यक् क्रियायोगपरो नरः //
text_mt: Therefore, devoted to qualities such as tranquility, intent on the yoga of action, / a man should properly worship the all-pervading Viṣṇu for the sake of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvalokahite rataḥ /
samarcayati deveśaṃ kriyāyogaḥ sa ucyate //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वलोकहिते रतः /
समर्चयति देवेशं क्रियायोगः स उच्यते //
text_mt: Engaged in the welfare of all beings through deed, thought, and speech, / he who thoroughly worships the Lord of the gods—that is called the yoga of action.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvāntayaryāmiṇaṃ harim /
stotrādyaiḥ stauti yo viṣṇuṃ karmayogī sa ucyate //
meaning:
नारायणं जगद्योनिं सर्वान्तयर्यामिणं हरिम् /
स्तोत्राद्यैः स्तौति यो विष्णुं कर्मयोगी स उच्यते //
text_mt: He who praises Viṣṇu with hymns and the like—Nārāyaṇa, the womb of the universe, Hari, the inner controller of all— / he is called a karma-yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsādibhiścaiva purāṇaśravaṇādibhiḥ /
puṣpādyaiścārcanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kriyāyoga udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपवासादिभिश्चैव पुराणश्रवणादिभिः /
पुष्पाद्यैश्चार्चनं विष्णोः क्रियायोग उदाहृतः //
text_mt: And the worship of Viṣṇu through fasts and the like, through hearing Purāṇas and the like, / and with flowers and the like, is declared to be the yoga of action.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhaktimatāṃ viṣṇau kriyāyogaratātmanām /
sarvapāpāni naśyanti pūrvajanmārjitāni vai //
meaning:
एवं भक्तिमतां विष्णौ क्रियायोगरतात्मनाम् /
सर्वपापानि नश्यन्ति पूर्वजन्मार्जितानि वै //
text_mt: Thus, of those endowed with devotion to Viṣṇu whose minds are dedicated to the yoga of action, / all sins accumulated in previous births are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpakṣayācchudvamatirvāñchati jñānamuttamam /
jñānaṃ hi mokṣadaṃ jñeyaṃ tadupāyaṃ vadāmi te //
meaning:
पापक्षयाच्छुद्वमतिर्वाञ्छति ज्ञानमुत्तमम् /
ज्ञानं हि मोक्षदं ज्ञेयं तदुपायं वदामि ते //
text_mt: From the destruction of sins, one of purified intellect desires supreme knowledge; / for knowledge is to be understood as granting liberation. I shall tell you the means to it:

sanskrit_iast:
carācarātmake loke nityaṃ cānityameva ca /
samyag vicārayeddhīmānsadbhiḥ śāstrārthakovidaiḥ //
meaning:
चराचरात्मके लोके नित्यं चानित्यमेव च /
सम्यग् विचारयेद्धीमान्सद्भिः शास्त्रार्थकोविदैः //
text_mt: In this world composed of the moving and unmoving, what is eternal and what is transient— / the wise man should properly deliberate upon this in the company of the virtuous who are skilled in the meaning of the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
anityāstu padārthā vai nityameko hariḥ smṛtaḥ /
anityāni parityajya nityameva samāśrayet //
meaning:
अनित्यास्तु पदार्था वै नित्यमेको हरिः स्मृतः /
अनित्यानि परित्यज्य नित्यमेव समाश्रयेत् //
text_mt: Transient indeed are worldly objects; Hari alone is remembered as eternal. / Abandoning the transient, one should take refuge in the eternal alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāmutra ca bhogeṣu viraktaśca tathā bhavet /
avirakto bhavedyastu sa saṃsāre pravartate //
meaning:
इहामुत्र च भोगेषु विरक्तश्च तथा भवेत् /
अविरक्तो भवेद्यस्तु स संसारे प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: And likewise one must become detached from enjoyments here and in the hereafter; / but he who is not detached continues in the cycle of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
anityeṣu padārtheṣu yastu rāgī bhavennaraḥ /
tasya saṃsāravicchittiḥ kadācinnaiva jāyate //
meaning:
अनित्येषु पदार्थेषु यस्तु रागी भवेन्नरः /
तस्य संसारविच्छित्तिः कदाचिन्नैव जायते //
text_mt: A man who is attached to transient objects— / the cessation of his worldly existence never occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
śamādiguṇasaṃpanno mumukṣurjñānamabhyaset /
śamādiguṇahīnasya jñānaṃ naiva ca sidhyati //
meaning:
शमादिगुणसंपन्नो मुमुक्षुर्ज्ञानमभ्यसेत् /
शमादिगुणहीनस्य ज्ञानं नैव च सिध्यति //
text_mt: Endowed with qualities such as tranquility, a seeker of liberation should practice knowledge; / for one lacking qualities such as tranquility, knowledge is never accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgadveṣavihīno yaḥ śamādiguṇasaṃyutaḥ /
haridhyānaparo nityaṃ mumukṣurabhidhīyate //
meaning:
रागद्वेषविहीनो यः शमादिगुणसंयुतः /
हरिध्यानपरो नित्यं मुमुक्षुरभिधीयते //
text_mt: He who is free from attachment and aversion, endowed with qualities such as tranquility, / and ever devoted to meditation on Hari, is called a seeker of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ sādhanairebhirviśuddhamatirucyate /
sarvagaṃ bhāvayedviṣṇuṃ sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भिः साधनैरेभिर्विशुद्धमतिरुच्यते /
सर्वगं भावयेद्विष्णुं सर्वभूतदयापरः //
text_mt: Endowed with these four means, his intellect is said to be completely purified; / intent on compassion for all beings, he should contemplate Viṣṇu as omnipresent.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣarākṣarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ /
iti jānāti yo vipratajjñānaṃ yogajaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
क्षराक्षरात्मकं विश्वं व्याप्य नारायणः स्थितः /
इति जानाति यो विप्रतज्ज्ञानं योगजं विदुः //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa stands pervading the universe consisting of the perishable and the imperishable; / he who knows thus, O twice-born one, they consider that knowledge to be born of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
yogopāyamato vakṣye saṃsāravinivarttakam /
yogo jñānaṃ viśuddhaṃ syāttajjñānaṃ mokṣadaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
योगोपायमतो वक्ष्ये संसारविनिवर्त्तकम् /
योगो ज्ञानं विशुद्धं स्यात्तज्ज्ञानं मोक्षदं विदुः //
text_mt: Henceforth I shall declare the means of yoga that puts an end to worldly existence; / yoga is pure knowledge, and they know that knowledge as granting liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ dvividhaṃ prāhuḥ parāparavibhedataḥ /
dve brahmaṇī veditavye iti cātharvarṇī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानं द्विविधं प्राहुः परापरविभेदतः /
द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये इति चाथर्वर्णी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: They declare the Self to be twofold through the distinction of higher and lower; / 'Two Brahmans are to be known,' so states the Atharvan scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
parastu nirguṇaḥ prokto hyahṝṅkārayuto 'paraḥ /
tayorabhedavijñānaṃ yoga ityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
परस्तु निर्गुणः प्रोक्तो ह्यहॄङ्कारयुतो ऽपरः /
तयोरभेदविज्ञानं योग इत्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: The higher is proclaimed to be devoid of qualities, while the lower is endowed with egoism; / the discerning knowledge of their non-difference is called yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhūtātmake dehe yaḥ sākṣī hṛdaye sthitaḥ /
aparaḥ procyate sadbhiḥ paramātmā paraḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चभूतात्मके देहे यः साक्षी हृदये स्थितः /
अपरः प्रोच्यते सद्भिः परमात्मा परः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The witness who abides in the heart within the body composed of the five elements / is declared by the virtuous to be the lower; the Supreme Self is remembered as the higher.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ kṣevramityāhustatsthaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate /
avyaktaḥ paramaḥ śuddhaḥ paripūrṇa udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शरीरं क्षेव्रमित्याहुस्तत्स्थः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते /
अव्यक्तः परमः शुद्धः परिपूर्ण उदाहृतः //
text_mt: They call the body the field; that which resides in it is called the knower of the field. / It is declared to be unmanifest, supreme, pure, and all-pervading.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tvabhedavijñānaṃ jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ /
bhavettadā muniśreṣṭha pāśacchedo 'parātmanaḥ //
meaning:
यदा त्वभेदविज्ञानं जीवात्मपरमात्मनोः /
भवेत्तदा मुनिश्रेष्ठ पाशच्छेदो ऽपरात्मनः //
text_mt: When, however, the discerning knowledge of the non-difference of the individual self and the Supreme Self / arises, then, O best of sages, the fetter of the lower self is severed.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaḥ śuddho 'kṣaro nityaḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ /
nṛṇāṃ vijñānabhedena bhedavāniva lakṣyate //
meaning:
एकः शुद्धो ऽक्षरो नित्यः परमात्मा जगन्मयः /
नृणां विज्ञानभेदेन भेदवानिव लक्ष्यते //
text_mt: One, pure, imperishable, eternal is the Supreme Self, identical with the universe; / owing to the difference in knowledge among men, it appears as though differentiated.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamevādvitīyaṃ yatparaṃ brahma sanātanam /
gīyamānaṃ ca vedāntaistasmānnāsti paraṃ dvija //
meaning:
एकमेवाद्वितीयं यत्परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
गीयमानं च वेदान्तैस्तस्मान्नास्ति परं द्विज //
text_mt: That which is the one without a second, the supreme, eternal Brahman, / sung by the Vedāntas—higher than that there is nothing, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya karma kāryaṃ vā rupaṃ varṇamathāpi vā /
karttṛtvaṃ vāpi bhoktṛtvaṃ nirguṇasya parātmanaḥ //
meaning:
न तस्य कर्म कार्यं वा रुपं वर्णमथापि वा /
कर्त्तृत्वं वापि भोक्तृत्वं निर्गुणस्य परात्मनः //
text_mt: Neither action nor duty, neither form nor color, / nor agency, nor enjoyership belongs to that Supreme Self devoid of qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
nidānaṃ sarvahetūnāṃ tejo yattejasāṃ param /
kimapyanyadyato nāsti tajjñeyaṃ muktihetave //
meaning:
निदानं सर्वहेतूनां तेजो यत्तेजसां परम् /
किमप्यन्यद्यतो नास्ति तज्ज्ञेयं मुक्तिहेतवे //
text_mt: The primal cause of all causes, the splendor that is the supreme among splendors, / since nothing else whatsoever exists, that is to be known for the sake of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdabrahmamayaṃ yattanmahāvākyādikaṃ dvija /
tadvicārodbhavaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ mokṣasya sādhanam //
meaning:
शब्दब्रह्ममयं यत्तन्महावाक्यादिकं द्विज /
तद्विचारोद्भवं ज्ञानं परं मोक्षस्य साधनम् //
text_mt: That which consists of the sound-Brahman, namely the great sayings and the like, O twice-born one— / the knowledge arising from inquiry into that is the supreme means to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
samyagjñānavihīnānāṃ dṛśyate vividhaṃ jagatag /
paramajñānināmetatparabrahmātmakaṃ dvija //
meaning:
सम्यग्ज्ञानविहीनानां दृश्यते विविधं जगतग् /
परमज्ञानिनामेतत्परब्रह्मात्मकं द्विज //
text_mt: To those devoid of correct knowledge, the world appears manifold; / to those possessing supreme knowledge, O twice-born one, this consists of the Supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
eka eva parānando nirguṇaḥ parataḥ paraḥ /
bhāti vijñānabhedena bahurupadharo 'vyayaḥ //
meaning:
एक एव परानन्दो निर्गुणः परतः परः /
भाति विज्ञानभेदेन बहुरुपधरो ऽव्ययः //
text_mt: The one supreme bliss, devoid of qualities, higher than the highest, / the imperishable one, appears as bearing manifold forms through the difference in knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
māyino māyayā bhedaṃ paśyanti paramātmani /
tasmānmāyāṃ tyajedyogānmumukṣurdvijasattam //
meaning:
मायिनो मायया भेदं पश्यन्ति परमात्मनि /
तस्मान्मायां त्यजेद्योगान्मुमुक्षुर्द्विजसत्तम् //
text_mt: The deluded, by virtue of illusion, perceive difference in the Supreme Self; / therefore, through yoga, a seeker of liberation should renounce illusion, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsadrūpāna sadrūpā māyā naivobhayātmikā /
anirvācyā tato jñeyā bhedabuddhipradāryinī //
meaning:
नासद्रूपान सद्रूपा माया नैवोभयात्मिका /
अनिर्वाच्या ततो ज्ञेया भेदबुद्धिप्रदार्यिनी //
text_mt: Illusion is neither of the nature of non-being, nor of the nature of being, nor consisting of both; / therefore it is to be understood as ineffable, conferring the notion of difference.

sanskrit_iast:
māyaiva jñānaśabdena buddhyate munisattama /
tasmādajñānavicchedo bhavedraujitamāyinām //
meaning:
मायैव ज्ञानशब्देन बुद्ध्यते मुनिसत्तम /
तस्मादज्ञानविच्छेदो भवेद्रौजितमायिनाम् //
text_mt: Illusion alone is apprehended through the word 'ignorance', O best of sages; / therefore, the severing of ignorance belongs to those who have abandoned illusion.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātanaṃ paraṃ brahma jñānaśabdena kathyate /
jñānināṃ paramātmā vai hṛdi bhāti nirantaram //
meaning:
सनातनं परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानशब्देन कथ्यते /
ज्ञानिनां परमात्मा वै हृदि भाति निरन्तरम् //
text_mt: The eternal Supreme Brahman is designated by the word 'knowledge'; / the Supreme Self indeed shines incessantly in the heart of the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānaṃ nāśayedyogī yogena munisattama /
aṣṭāṅgaiḥ siddhyate yogastāni vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञानं नाशयेद्योगी योगेन मुनिसत्तम /
अष्टाङ्गैः सिद्ध्यते योगस्तानि वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: A yogin should destroy ignorance through yoga, O best of sages; / yoga is attained by means of its eight limbs; I shall declare them in truth:

sanskrit_iast:
yamāśca niyamāścaiva āsanāni ca sattama /
prāṇāyāmaḥ pratyāhāro dhāraṇā dhyānameva ca //
meaning:
यमाश्च नियमाश्चैव आसनानि च सत्तम /
प्राणायामः प्रत्याहारो धारणा ध्यानमेव च //
text_mt: Restraints, observances, postures, O best of men, / breath control, withdrawal of the senses, concentration, and meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
samādhiśca muniśreṣṭha yogāṅgāni yathākramam /
eṣāṃ saṃkṣepato vakṣye lakṣaṇāni munīśvara //
meaning:
समाधिश्च मुनिश्रेष्ठ योगाङ्गानि यथाक्रमम् /
एषां संक्षेपतो वक्ष्ये लक्षणानि मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: and absorption, O best of sages—these are the limbs of yoga in due order; / of these, I shall succinctly declare the characteristics, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau /
akrodhaścānasūyā ca proktāḥ saṃkṣepato yamāḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ /
अक्रोधश्चानसूया च प्रोक्ताः संक्षेपतो यमाः //
text_mt: Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, non-possession, / freedom from anger, and freedom from malice are stated concisely as the restraints.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāmakleśajananaṃ hi yat /
ahiṃsā kathitā sadbhiryogasiddhipradāyinī //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव भूतानामक्लेशजननं हि यत् /
अहिंसा कथिता सद्भिर्योगसिद्धिप्रदायिनी //
text_mt: That which causes no distress whatsoever to all beings / is declared by the virtuous to be non-violence, which grants attainment in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
yathārthakathanaṃ yañca dharmādharmavivekataḥ /
satyaṃ prāhurmuniśreṣṭha asteyaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam //
meaning:
यथार्थकथनं यञ्च धर्माधर्मविवेकतः /
सत्यं प्राहुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ अस्तेयं शृणु साम्प्रतम् //
text_mt: Speaking what is factually true, through discernment between righteousness and unrighteousness, / they declare to be truthfulness, O best of sages; now listen to non-stealing.

sanskrit_iast:
cauryeṇa vā balenāpi parasvaharaṇaṃ hi yat /
steyamityucyate sadbhirasteyaṃ tadviparyayam //
meaning:
चौर्येण वा बलेनापि परस्वहरणं हि यत् /
