स्तेयमित्युच्यते सद्भिरस्तेयं तद्विपर्ययम् //
text_mt: Taking another's property by theft or even by force / is called stealing by the virtuous; non-stealing is the opposite of that.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra maithunatyāgo brahmacaryaṃ prakīrttitam /
brahmacaryaparityāgājjñānavānapi pātakī //
meaning:
सर्वत्र मैथुनत्यागो ब्रह्मचर्यं प्रकीर्त्तितम् /
ब्रह्मचर्यपरित्यागाज्ज्ञानवानपि पातकी //
text_mt: The renunciation of sexual union under all circumstances is celebrated as celibacy; / through abandonment of celibacy, even a knowledgeable person becomes a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃgaparityāgī maithuneyastu varttate /
sa caṇḍālasamo jñeyaḥ sarvavarṇabahiṣkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वसंगपरित्यागी मैथुनेयस्तु वर्त्तते /
स चण्डालसमो ज्ञेयः सर्ववर्णबहिष्कृतः //
text_mt: One who has abandoned all attachments, but engages in sexual union, / should be known as equal to an outcaste, expelled from all castes.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu yogarato vipra viṣayeṣu spṛhānvitaḥ /
tatsaṃbhāṣaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā bhavennṛṇām //
meaning:
यस्तु योगरतो विप्र विषयेषु स्पृहान्वितः /
तत्संभाषणमात्रेण ब्रह्महत्या भवेन्नृणाम् //
text_mt: A twice-born who, though engaged in yoga, is endowed with longing for sensory objects— / by merely conversing with him, men incur the sin of killing a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃgaparityāgī punaḥ saṃgī bhavedyadi /
tatsaṃgasaṃgināṃ saṃgānmahāpātakadoṣabhāk //
meaning:
सर्वसंगपरित्यागी पुनः संगी भवेद्यदि /
तत्संगसंगिनां संगान्महापातकदोषभाक् //
text_mt: If one who has abandoned all attachments should again become attached, / through association with those who associate with him, one shares in the guilt of a mortal sin.

sanskrit_iast:
anādānaṃ hi dravyāṇāmāpadyapi munīśvara /
aparigraha ityukto yogasaṃsiddhikārakaḥ //
meaning:
अनादानं हि द्रव्याणामापद्यपि मुनीश्वर /
अपरिग्रह इत्युक्तो योगसंसिद्धिकारकः //
text_mt: Not accepting material things even in distress, O lord of sages, / is stated to be non-possession, which brings about success in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanastu samutkarṣādatiniṣṭhurabhāṣaṇam /
krodhamāhurdharmavido hyakrodhastadviparyayaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनस्तु समुत्कर्षादतिनिष्ठुरभाषणम् /
क्रोधमाहुर्धर्मविदो ह्यक्रोधस्तद्विपर्ययः //
text_mt: Speaking harshly out of one's own pride, / those who know righteousness declare to be anger; freedom from anger is the opposite of that.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanādyairadhikaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛśaṃ manasi tāpanam /
asūyā kīrtitā sadbhistattyāgo hyanasūyatā //
meaning:
धनाद्यैरधिकं दृष्ट्वा भृशं मनसि तापनम् /
असूया कीर्तिता सद्भिस्तत्त्यागो ह्यनसूयता //
text_mt:
Intense mental distress upon seeing another surpass oneself in wealth and other things
is proclaimed malice by the virtuous, and its abandonment is non-malice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktā yamā vibudhasattama /
niyamānapi vakṣyāmitubhyaṃ tāñchṛṇu nārada //
meaning:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ता यमा विबुधसत्तम /
नियमानपि वक्ष्यामितुभ्यं ताञ्छृणु नारद //
text_mt:
Thus the restraints have been briefly declared, O best of sages;
I shall now tell you the observances as well; listen to them, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥsvādhyāyasaṃtoṣāḥ śaucaṃ ca haripūjanam /
saṃdhyopāsanamukhyāśca niyamāḥ parikīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
तपःस्वाध्यायसंतोषाः शौचं च हरिपूजनम् /
संध्योपासनमुख्याश्च नियमाः परिकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt:
Austerity, study of sacred texts, contentment, purity, worship of Hari,
and the twilight devotion are proclaimed the foremost observances.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇādibhiryatra śarīrasya viśoṣaṇam /
tapo nigaditaṃ sadbhiryogasādhanamuttamam //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणादिभिर्यत्र शरीरस्य विशोषणम् /
तपो निगदितं सद्भिर्योगसाधनमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Where the body is emaciated through the cāndrāyaṇa fast and other vows,
that is declared austerity by the virtuous, an excellent means of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavasyopaniṣadāṃ dvādaśārṇasya ca dvija /
aṣṭākṣarasya mantrasya mahāvākyacayasya ca //
meaning:
प्रणवस्योपनिषदां द्वादशार्णस्य च द्विज /
अष्टाक्षरस्य मन्त्रस्य महावाक्यचयस्य च //
text_mt:
The recitation of the syllable Oṃ, the Upaniṣads, the twelve-syllable mantra, O twice-born,
the eight-syllable mantra, and the collection of great sentences,

sanskrit_iast:
japaḥ svādhyāya udito yogasādhanamuttamam /
svādhyāyaṃ yastyajenmūḍhastasya yogo na sidhyati //
meaning:
जपः स्वाध्याय उदितो योगसाधनमुत्तमम् /
स्वाध्यायं यस्त्यजेन्मूढस्तस्य योगो न सिध्यति //
text_mt:
is called study of sacred texts, an excellent means of yoga.
The fool who abandons the study of sacred texts never attains success in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaṃ vināpi svādhyāyātpāpanāśo bhavennṛṇām /
svādhyāyaistoṣyamāṇāśca prasīdanti hi devatāḥ //
meaning:
योगं विनापि स्वाध्यायात्पापनाशो भवेन्नृणाम् /
स्वाध्यायैस्तोष्यमाणाश्च प्रसीदन्ति हि देवताः //
text_mt:
Even without yoga, the destruction of human sins comes about through the study of sacred texts;
and the deities, being pleased by the study of sacred texts, are propitiated.

sanskrit_iast:
japastu trividhaḥ prokto vācikopāṃśumānasaḥ /
trividhe 'pi ca viprendra pūrvātpūrvātparo varaḥ //
meaning:
जपस्तु त्रिविधः प्रोक्तो वाचिकोपांशुमानसः /
त्रिविधे ऽपि च विप्रेन्द्र पूर्वात्पूर्वात्परो वरः //
text_mt:
Recitation is declared to be threefold: voiced, whispered, and mental;
and among the three types, O prince of brahmins, each succeeding one is superior to the preceding.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasyoccāraṇaṃ samyaksphuṭākṣarapadaṃ yathā /
japastu vācikaḥ proktaḥ sarvayajñaphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्योच्चारणं सम्यक्स्फुटाक्षरपदं यथा /
जपस्तु वाचिकः प्रोक्तः सर्वयज्ञफलप्रदः //
text_mt:
The correct articulation of a mantra with distinctly pronounced syllables and words
is declared voiced recitation; it bestows the fruit of all sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasyoccāraṇe kiñcitpadātpadavivecanam /
sa tūpāṃśurjapaḥ proktaḥ pūrvasmāddviguṇo 'dhikaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्योच्चारणे किञ्चित्पदात्पदविवेचनम् /
स तूपांशुर्जपः प्रोक्तः पूर्वस्माद्द्विगुणो ऽधिकः //
text_mt:
When, in uttering the mantra, the syllables are somewhat distinguished from word to word,
that is declared whispered recitation, twice as superior to the previous.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya hyakṣaraśreṇyāṃ tattadarthavicāraṇam /
sa japomānasaḥ prokto yogasiddhipradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
विधाय ह्यक्षरश्रेण्यां तत्तदर्थविचारणम् /
स जपोमानसः प्रोक्तो योगसिद्धिप्रदायकः //
text_mt:
Reflecting upon the respective meaning across the series of syllables
is declared mental recitation, which bestows success in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
japena devatā nityaṃ stuvataḥ saṃprasīdati /
tasmātsvādhyāyasaṃpanno labhetsarvānmanorathān //
meaning:
जपेन देवता नित्यं स्तुवतः संप्रसीदति /
तस्मात्स्वाध्यायसंपन्नो लभेत्सर्वान्मनोरथान् //
text_mt:
The deity is ever pleased with one who praises through recitation;
therefore, one endowed with the study of sacred texts will obtain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭiḥ saṃtoṣa iti gīyate /
saṃtoṣahīnaḥ puruṣo na labheccharma kutracit //
meaning:
यदृच्छालाभसंतुष्टिः संतोष इति गीयते /
संतोषहीनः पुरुषो न लभेच्छर्म कुत्रचित् //
text_mt:
Satisfaction with whatever is obtained by chance is celebrated as contentment.
A person devoid of contentment does not obtain happiness anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
na jātukāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati /
ito 'dhikaṃ kadā lapsya iti kāmastu varddhate //
meaning:
न जातुकामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति /
इतो ऽधिकं कदा लप्स्य इति कामस्तु वर्द्धते //
text_mt:
Desire is never quenched by the enjoyment of desired things;
desire only increases, thinking, 'When will I obtain more than this?'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkāmaṃ parityajya dehasaṃśoṣakāraṇam /
yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭo bhaveddharmaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्कामं परित्यज्य देहसंशोषकारणम् /
यदृच्छालाभसंतुष्टो भवेद्धर्मपरायणः //
text_mt:
Therefore, abandoning desire, which is the cause of emaciating the body,
one should be satisfied with what is obtained by chance and devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyābhyantarabhedena śaucaṃ tu dvividhaṃ smṛtam /
mṛjjalābhyāṃ bahiḥ śuddhirbhāvaśuddhistathāntaram //
meaning:
बाह्याभ्यन्तरभेदेन शौचं तु द्विविधं स्मृतम् /
मृज्जलाभ्यां बहिः शुद्धिर्भावशुद्धिस्तथान्तरम् //
text_mt:
Purity is held to be twofold, distinguished into external and internal:
outer purification is by earth and water, while inner is the purity of disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥśuddhivihīnaistu ye 'dhvarā vividhāḥ kṛtāḥ /
na phalanti munīśreṣṭha bhasmani nyastahavyavat //
meaning:
अन्तःशुद्धिविहीनैस्तु ये ऽध्वरा विविधाः कृताः /
न फलन्ति मुनीश्रेष्ठ भस्मनि न्यस्तहव्यवत् //
text_mt:
Whatever diverse sacrifices are performed by those devoid of inner purity,
they bear no fruit, O best of sages, like an offering placed in cold ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaśuddhivihīnānāṃ samastaṃ karmaniṣphalam /
tasmādrāgādikaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya sukhī bhavet //
meaning:
भावशुद्धिविहीनानां समस्तं कर्मनिष्फलम् /
तस्माद्रागादिकं सर्वं परित्यज्य सुखी भवेत् //
text_mt:
Every action of those devoid of purity of disposition is fruitless;
therefore, abandoning all passion and the like, one should be happy.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdābhārasahasraistu kumbhakoṭijalaistathā /
kṛtaśauco 'pi duṣṭātmā caṇḍālasadṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मृदाभारसहस्रैस्तु कुम्भकोटिजलैस्तथा /
कृतशौचो ऽपि दुष्टात्मा चण्डालसदृशः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Even if purified with a thousand loads of earth and crores of pots of water,
the corrupt-minded person is still regarded as equal to an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥśuddhivihīnastu devapūjāparo yadi /
tameva daivataṃ hṝnti narakaṃ ca prapadyate //
meaning:
अन्तःशुद्धिविहीनस्तु देवपूजापरो यदि /
तमेव दैवतं हॄन्ति नरकं च प्रपद्यते //
text_mt:
If one devoid of inner purity engages in the worship of deities,
he offends that very deity and falls into hell.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥśuddhivihīnaśca bahiḥśuddhiṃ karoti yaḥ /
alaṅkṛtaḥ surābhāṇḍa iva śāntiṃ na gacchati //
meaning:
अन्तःशुद्धिविहीनश्च बहिःशुद्धिं करोति यः /
अलङ्कृतः सुराभाण्ड इव शान्तिं न गच्छति //
text_mt:
One who is devoid of inner purity and yet performs outer purification,
like an adorned vessel of liquor, does not attain tranquility.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥśuddhivihīnā ye tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvate /
na tānpuṃnati tīrthāni surābhāṇḍamivāpagā //
meaning:
मनःशुद्धिविहीना ये तीर्थयात्रां प्रकुर्वते /
न तान्पुंनति तीर्थानि सुराभाण्डमिवापगा //
text_mt:
Those who undertake pilgrimages to sacred fords without purity of mind
are not cleansed by the sacred fords, any more than a vessel of liquor by a river.

sanskrit_iast:
vācā dharmānpravaladati manasā pāpamicchati /
jānīyāttaṃ muniśreṣṭha mahāpātakināṃ varam //
meaning:
वाचा धर्मान्प्रवलदति मनसा पापमिच्छति /
जानीयात्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ महापातकिनां वरम् //
text_mt:
One who proclaims righteous duties with words, yet intends sin in his mind—
know him, O best of sages, to be the foremost among great sinners.

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhamānasā ye tu dharmamātramanuttamam /
kurvanti tatphalaṃ vidyādakṣayaṃ sukhadāyakam //
meaning:
विशुद्धमानसा ये तु धर्ममात्रमनुत्तमम् /
कुर्वन्ति तत्फलं विद्यादक्षयं सुखदायकम् //
text_mt:
Those with purified minds, however, who perform even modest unmatched righteousness,
know that its fruit is imperishable and bestows happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā stutiśravaṇa pūjanaiḥ /
haribhaktirdṛḍhā yasya haripūjeti gīyate //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा स्तुतिश्रवण पूजनैः /
हरिभक्तिर्दृढा यस्य हरिपूजेति गीयते //
text_mt:
Firm devotion to Hari through action, mind, speech,
praise, listening, and worship, is sung as the worship of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāśca niyamāścaiva saṃkṣepeṇa prabodhitāḥ /
ebhirviśuddhamanasāṃ mokṣaṃ hastagataṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
यमाश्च नियमाश्चैव संक्षेपेण प्रबोधिताः /
एभिर्विशुद्धमनसां मोक्षं हस्तगतं विदुः //
text_mt:
The restraints and the observances have thus been taught in brief;
for those whose minds are purified by these, liberation is known to be in the palm of their hand.

sanskrit_iast:
yamaiśca niyamaiścaiva sthirabuddhirjitendriyaḥ /
abhyasedāsanaṃsamyagyogasādhanamuttamam //
meaning:
यमैश्च नियमैश्चैव स्थिरबुद्धिर्जितेन्द्रियः /
अभ्यसेदासनंसम्यग्योगसाधनमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
With mind made firm by the restraints and the observances, senses conquered,
one should properly practice posture, the excellent means of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
padmakaṃ svastikaṃ pīṭhaṃ saiṃhaṃ kaukkuṭakaiñjare /
kaurmaṃvajrāsanaṃ caiva vārāhaṃ mṛgacailikam //
meaning:
पद्मकं स्वस्तिकं पीठं सैंहं कौक्कुटकैञ्जरे /
कौर्मंवज्रासनं चैव वाराहं मृगचैलिकम् //
text_mt:
The lotus, svastika, ritual seat, lion, cock, and cage postures,
the tortoise, thunderbolt, boar, and deer postures,

sanskrit_iast:
krauñcaṃ ca nālikaṃ caiva sarvatobhadrameva ca /
vārṣabhaṃ nāgamātsye ca vaiyānghaṃ cārddhacandrakam //
meaning:
क्रौञ्चं च नालिकं चैव सर्वतोभद्रमेव च /
वार्षभं नागमात्स्ये च वैयान्घं चार्द्धचन्द्रकम् //
text_mt:
the krauñca-bird, reed, sarvatobhadra,
bull, serpent, fish, tiger, and half-moon postures,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍavātāsanaṃ śailaṃ svabhraṃ maudgarameva ca /
mākaraṃ traipathaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ sthāṇuṃ vaikarṇikaṃ tathā //
meaning:
दण्डवातासनं शैलं स्वभ्रं मौद्गरमेव च /
माकरं त्रैपथं काष्ठं स्थाणुं वैकर्णिकं तथा //
text_mt:
the staff-wind, rock, chasm, mace postures,
the crocodile, three-path, wood, post, and ear-shaped postures,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumaṃ vīrāsanaṃ caiva yogasādhanakāraṇam /
triṃśatsaṃkhyānyāsanāni munīndraiḥ kathitāni vai //
meaning:
भौमं वीरासनं चैव योगसाधनकारणम् /
त्रिंशत्संख्यान्यासनानि मुनीन्द्रैः कथितानि वै //
text_mt:
and the earth and hero postures, as the means of yoga—
these thirty postures in number have indeed been spoken of by the chiefs of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmekatamaṃ baddhā gurubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ /
upāsako jayetprāṇāndvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ //
meaning:
एषामेकतमं बद्धा गुरुभक्तिपरायणः /
उपासको जयेत्प्राणान्द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः //
text_mt:
Assuming any one of these, devoted to devotion to the guru,
beyond dualities and free from envy, the practitioner should conquer the vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi tathā pratyaṅmukho 'pi vā /
abhyāsena jayetprāṇānniḥśabde janavarjite //
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि तथा प्रत्यङ्मुखो ऽपि वा /
अभ्यासेन जयेत्प्राणान्निःशब्दे जनवर्जिते //
text_mt:
Facing east, or facing north, or even facing west,
one should conquer the vital breaths through practice in a silent place devoid of people.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo vāyuḥ śarīrastha āyāmastasya nigrahaḥ /
prāṇāyāma iti prokto dvividhaḥ sa prakīrttitaḥ //
meaning:
प्राणो वायुः शरीरस्थ आयामस्तस्य निग्रहः /
प्राणायाम इति प्रोक्तो द्विविधः स प्रकीर्त्तितः //
text_mt:
Prāṇa is the wind abiding in the body; āyāma is its restraint;
this is declared breath-control, and it is proclaimed to be twofold:

sanskrit_iast:
agarbhaśca sagarbhaśca dvitīyastu tayorvaraḥ /
jayadhyānaṃ vināgarbhaḥ sagarbhastatsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
अगर्भश्च सगर्भश्च द्वितीयस्तु तयोर्वरः /
जयध्यानं विनागर्भः सगर्भस्तत्समन्वितः //
text_mt:
seedless and with seed; of the two, the second is superior.
Seedless is without recitation and meditation; with seed is endowed with them.

sanskrit_iast:
recakaḥ pūrakaścaiva kuṃbhakaḥ śūnyakastathā /
evaṃ caturvidhaḥ proktaḥ prāṇāyāmo manīṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
रेचकः पूरकश्चैव कुंभकः शून्यकस्तथा /
एवं चतुर्विधः प्रोक्तः प्राणायामो मनीषिभिः //
text_mt:
Exhalation, inhalation, retention, and the void:
thus breath-control is declared to be fourfold by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
jantūnāṃ dakṣiṇā nāḍī piṅgalā parikīrtitā /
sūryadaivatakā caiva pitṛyoniriti śrutā //
meaning:
जन्तूनां दक्षिणा नाडी पिङ्गला परिकीर्तिता /
सूर्यदैवतका चैव पितृयोनिरिति श्रुता //
text_mt:
The right channel of living beings is proclaimed to be the piṅgalā;
it has the sun as its deity and is traditionally known as the origin of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
devayoniriti khyātā iḍā nāḍī tvadakṣiṇā /
tatrādhidaivata candraṃ jānīhi munisattamaṃ //
meaning:
देवयोनिरिति ख्याता इडा नाडी त्वदक्षिणा /
तत्राधिदैवत चन्द्रं जानीहि मुनिसत्तमं //
text_mt:
The iḍā channel, however, is the left, known as the origin of the gods;
know its presiding deity to be the moon, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
etayorubhayormadhye suṣumṇā nāḍikā smṛtā /
atisūkṣmā guhyatamā jñeyā sā brahmadaivatā //
meaning:
एतयोरुभयोर्मध्ये सुषुम्णा नाडिका स्मृता /
अतिसूक्ष्मा गुह्यतमा ज्ञेया सा ब्रह्मदैवता //
text_mt:
Between these two, the suṣumṇā channel is remembered;
extremely subtle, most secret, it is to be known as having Brahman as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmena recayedvāyuṃ recanādrecakaḥ smṛtaḥ /
pūrayeddakṣiṇenaiva pūraṇātpūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
वामेन रेचयेद्वायुं रेचनाद्रेचकः स्मृतः /
पूरयेद्दक्षिणेनैव पूरणात्पूरकः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
One should exhale the wind through the left; because of discharging, it is called exhalation.
One should fill with the right; because of filling, it is called inhalation.

sanskrit_iast:
svadehapūritaṃ vāyaṃ nigṛhya na vimṛñcati /
saṃpūrṇakuṃbhavattiṣṭetkumbhakaḥ sa hi viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
स्वदेहपूरितं वायं निगृह्य न विमृञ्चति /
संपूर्णकुंभवत्तिष्टेत्कुम्भकः स हि विश्रुतः //
text_mt:
Restraining the wind filled in one's body, one does not release it,
remaining like a full jar; that indeed is famous as retention.

sanskrit_iast:
na gṛhṇāti na tyajati vāyumantarbahiḥ sthitam /
viddhi tacchūnyakaṃ nāma prāṇāyāmaṃ yathāsthitam //
meaning:
न गृह्णाति न त्यजति वायुमन्तर्बहिः स्थितम् /
विद्धि तच्छून्यकं नाम प्राणायामं यथास्थितम् //
text_mt:
Neither taking in nor expelling the wind situated inside and outside,
know that to be the breath-control named void, just as it is.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiḥśanairvijetavyaḥ prāṇo mattagajendravat /
anyathā khalu jāyante mahārogā bhayaṅkarāḥ //
meaning:
शनैःशनैर्विजेतव्यः प्राणो मत्तगजेन्द्रवत् /
अन्यथा खलु जायन्ते महारोगा भयङ्कराः //
text_mt:
Little by little the breath should be conquered, like an intoxicated bull-elephant;
otherwise, dreadful, terrible diseases are indeed produced.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa yojayedvāyuṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ /
sa sarvapāpanirmukto brahmaṇaḥ padamānpuyāt //
meaning:
क्रमेण योजयेद्वायुं योगी विगतकल्मषः /
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणः पदमान्पुयात् //
text_mt:
The yogin whose impurities are gone should regulate the wind gradually;
freed from all sins, he will attain the state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayeṣu prasaktāni cendriyāṇi munīśvaraḥ /
samāmāhṛtya nigṛhṇāti pratyāhārastu sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विषयेषु प्रसक्तानि चेन्द्रियाणि मुनीश्वरः /
समामाहृत्य निगृह्णाति प्रत्याहारस्तु स स्मृतः //
text_mt:
When the chief of sages restrains the senses attached to sensory objects,
having withdrawn them completely, that is remembered as sensory withdrawal.

sanskrit_iast:
jitendriyā mahātmāno dhyānaśūnyā api dvija /
prayānti paramaṃ brahma punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
जितेन्द्रिया महात्मानो ध्यानशून्या अपि द्विज /
प्रयान्ति परमं ब्रह्म पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt:
Great-souled ones who have mastered their senses, even if devoid of meditation, O twice-born,
attain the supreme Brahman, from which return is hard to find.

sanskrit_iast:
anirjitendriyagrāmaṃ yastu dhyānaparo bhavet /
mūḍhātmānaṃ ca taṃ vidyāddhyānaṃ cāsya na sidhyati //
meaning:
अनिर्जितेन्द्रियग्रामं यस्तु ध्यानपरो भवेत् /
मूढात्मानं च तं विद्याद्ध्यानं चास्य न सिध्यति //
text_mt:
He, however, who engages in meditation without conquering the host of senses,
know him to be foolish-minded, and his meditation does not succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyatpaśyati tatsarvaṃ paśyedātmavadātmani /
pratyāhṛtānīndriyāṇi dhārayetsā tu dhāraṇā //
meaning:
यद्यत्पश्यति तत्सर्वं पश्येदात्मवदात्मनि /
प्रत्याहृतानीन्द्रियाणि धारयेत्सा तु धारणा //
text_mt:
Whatever one sees, one should see all that in the Self as the Self;
one should hold the withdrawn senses [there]—that indeed is concentration.

sanskrit_iast:
yogājjitendriyagrāmastāni hṛtvā dṛḍhaṃ hṛdi /
ātmānaṃ paramaṃ dhyāyetsarvadhātāramacyutam //
meaning:
योगाज्जितेन्द्रियग्रामस्तानि हृत्वा दृढं हृदि /
आत्मानं परमं ध्यायेत्सर्वधातारमच्युतम् //
text_mt: Having conquered the senses through yoga and held them firmly in the heart, / one should meditate on the supreme Self, the supporter of all, Acyuta,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaviśvātmakaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvasokaikakāraṇam /
vikasatpadyapatrākṣaṃ cārukuṇḍalabhūṣitam //
meaning:
सर्वविश्वात्मकं विष्णुं सर्वसोकैककारणम् /
विकसत्पद्यपत्राक्षं चारुकुण्डलभूषितम् //
text_mt: on Viṣṇu, who constitutes the whole universe, the sole cause of the entire world, / whose eyes are like blooming lotus petals, adorned with charming earrings,

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghabāhumudārāṅgaṃ sarvālaṅkārabhṛṣitam /
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ hemayajñopavītinam //
meaning:
दीर्घबाहुमुदाराङ्गं सर्वालङ्कारभृषितम् /
पीताम्बरधरं देवं हेमयज्ञोपवीतिनम् //
text_mt: with long arms and noble limbs, adorned with all ornaments, / the god wearing yellow garments and a golden sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhrataṃ tulasīmālāṃ kaustubhena virājitam /
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam //
meaning:
बिभ्रतं तुलसीमालां कौस्तुभेन विराजितम् /
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: wearing a tulasī garland, radiant with the Kaustubha gem, / the god with the śrīvatsa on his chest, bowed to by gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāre hṛtsaroje tu dvādaśāṅgulavistṛte /
dhyāyedātmānamavyaktaṃ parātparataraṃ vibhumaṭ //
meaning:
अष्टारे हृत्सरोजे तु द्वादशाङ्गुलविस्तृते /
ध्यायेदात्मानमव्यक्तं परात्परतरं विभुमट् //
text_mt: In the eight-spoked lotus of the heart, twelve finger-breadths wide, / one should meditate on the unmanifest Self, higher than the highest, the omnipresent Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ sadbhinirgaditaṃ pratyayasyaikatānatā /
dhyānaṃ kṛtvā muhurttaṃ vā paraṃ mokṣaṃ labhennaraḥ //
meaning:
ध्यानं सद्भिनिर्गदितं प्रत्ययस्यैकतानता /
ध्यानं कृत्वा मुहुर्त्तं वा परं मोक्षं लभेन्नरः //
text_mt: Through meditation sins are destroyed; through meditation one obtains liberation; / through meditation Hari is pleased; through meditation all aims are achieved.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānātpāpāni naśyanti dhyānānmokṣaṃ ca vindati /
dhyānātprasīdati hariddharyānātsarvārthasādhanam //
meaning:
ध्यानात्पापानि नश्यन्ति ध्यानान्मोक्षं च विन्दति /
ध्यानात्प्रसीदति हरिद्धर्यानात्सर्वार्थसाधनम् //
text_mt: Whatever form of Mahāviṣṇu [one chooses], upon that one should meditate with concentrated mind; / pleased in spirit by that meditation, Hari indeed grants liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadrūpaṃ mahāviṣṇostattaddhyāyetsamāhitam /
tena dhyānena tuṣṭātmā harirmokṣaṃ dadāti vai //
meaning:
यद्यद्रूपं महाविष्णोस्तत्तद्ध्यायेत्समाहितम् /
तेन ध्यानेन तुष्टात्मा हरिर्मोक्षं ददाति वै //
text_mt: One should make the mind unwavering upon the object of meditation, O best of the virtuous, / so that meditation, the object of meditation, and the state of the meditator completely vanish.

sanskrit_iast:
acañcalaṃ manaḥ kuryāddhyeye vastuni sattama /
dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyātṛbhāvaṃ yathā naśyati nirbharam //
meaning:
अचञ्चलं मनः कुर्याद्ध्येये वस्तुनि सत्तम /
ध्यानं ध्येयं ध्यातृभावं यथा नश्यति निर्भरम् //
text_mt: Then immortality arises from the enjoyment of the nectar of knowledge; / from unbroken meditation comes the realization of non-difference.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'mṛtatvaṃ bhavati jñānāmṛtaniṣevaṇāt /
bhavennirantaraṃ dhyānādabhedapratipādanam //
meaning:
ततो ऽमृतत्वं भवति ज्ञानामृतनिषेवणात् /
भवेन्निरन्तरं ध्यानादभेदप्रतिपादनम् //
text_mt: Joined with supreme bliss as if in deep sleep, with the senses ceased, / standing steady like a lamp in a windless place—this is called samādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣutpivatparānandayuktaścoparatendriyaḥ /
nirvātadīpavatsaṃsthaḥ samādhirabhidhīyate //
meaning:
सुषुत्पिवत्परानन्दयुक्तश्चोपरतेन्द्रियः /
निर्वातदीपवत्संस्थः समाधिरभिधीयते //
text_mt: In the state of samādhi the yogin does not hear, does not see, / does not smell, does not touch, and speaks nothing at all, O best of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
yogī samādhyavasthāyāṃ na śṛṇoti na paśyati /
na jighrati na spṛśati na kiñcadvakti sattama //
meaning:
योगी समाध्यवस्थायां न शृणोति न पश्यति /
न जिघ्रति न स्पृशति न किञ्चद्वक्ति सत्तम //
text_mt: The Self, however, is spotless, pure, the embodiment of being, consciousness, and bliss, / released from all adjuncts; to yogins it shines unwavering.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā tu nirmalaḥ śuddhaḥ sañcidānandavigrahaḥ /
sarvopādhivinirmukto yogināṃ bhātyacañcalaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मा तु निर्मलः शुद्धः सञ्चिदानन्दविग्रहः /
सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तो योगिनां भात्यचञ्चलः //
text_mt: Though devoid of qualities, the supreme God seems possessed of qualities through ignorance; / but upon the destruction of ignorance, [the Self] remains established as it was before.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇo 'pi paro devo hyajñānādguṇavāniva /
vibhātyajñānanāśe tu yathāpūrvaṃ vyavasthitam //
meaning:
निर्गुणो ऽपि परो देवो ह्यज्ञानाद्गुणवानिव /
विभात्यज्ञाननाशे तु यथापूर्वं व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt: The supreme light, immeasurable in essence, seems possessed of māyā to the illusory; / upon its destruction, the spotless Brahman reveals itself to the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ jyotirameyātmā māyāvāniva māyinām /
tannāśe nirmalaṃ brahma prakāśayati paṇḍitaṃ //
meaning:
परं ज्योतिरमेयात्मा मायावानिव मायिनाम् /
तन्नाशे निर्मलं ब्रह्म प्रकाशयति पण्डितं //
text_mt: One alone and without a second, supreme light, taintless, / existing as the inner ruler within all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamevādvitīyaṃ ca paraṃ jyotirnirañjanam /
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāmantaryāmitayā sthitam //
meaning:
एकमेवाद्वितीयं च परं ज्योतिर्निरञ्जनम् /
सर्वेषामेव भूतानामन्तर्यामितया स्थितम् //
text_mt: Smaller than the small, greater than the great, the eternal Self is the cause of the entire universe; / the foremost among knowers of knowledge behold it, higher than the highest, supremely pure.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyānsanātanātmākhilaviśvahetuḥ /
paśyanti yajjñānavidāṃ variṣṭāḥ parātparasmātparamaṃ pavitram //
meaning:
अणोरणीयान्महतो महीयान्सनातनात्माखिलविश्वहेतुः /
पश्यन्ति यज्ज्ञानविदां वरिष्टाः परात्परस्मात्परमं पवित्रम् //
text_mt: Arranged in the division of letters from "a" to "kṣa", / the ancient, beginningless Person is sung of as Śabdabrahman.

sanskrit_iast:
akārādikṣakārāntavarṇabhedavyavasthitaḥ /
purāṇapuruṣo 'nādiḥ śabdabrahmeti gīyate //
meaning:
अकारादिक्षकारान्तवर्णभेदव्यवस्थितः /
पुराणपुरुषो ऽनादिः शब्दब्रह्मेति गीयते //
text_mt: Completely pure, imperishable, eternal, full, dwelling in the midst of ether, / bliss, spotless and tranquil, it is sung of as the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddamakṣaraṃ nityaṃ pūrṇamākāśamadhyagam /
ānandaṃ nirmalaśāntaṃ paraṃ brahmeti gīyate //
meaning:
विशुद्दमक्षरं नित्यं पूर्णमाकाशमध्यगम् /
आनन्दं निर्मलशान्तं परं ब्रह्मेति गीयते //
text_mt: Yogins behold within the heart the eternal supreme Self; / changeless, unborn, pure, it is sung of as the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yogino hṛdi paśyanti parātmānaṃ sanātanam /
avikāramajaṃ śuddhaṃ paraṃ brahmeti gīyate //
meaning:
योगिनो हृदि पश्यन्ति परात्मानं सनातनम् /
अविकारमजं शुद्धं परं ब्रह्मेति गीयते //
text_mt: I shall describe another meditation, listen, O best of sages, / which is like a shower of nectar for men scorched by the heat of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamanyatpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva muni sattama /
saṃsāratāpatatpānāṃ sudhāvṛṣṭisamaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
ध्यानमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व मुनि सत्तम /
संसारतापतत्पानां सुधावृष्टिसमं नृणाम् //
text_mt: One should remember Nārāyaṇa, supreme bliss, residing in the praṇava, / whose form is sound, incomparable, standing above the half-mora.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ parānandaṃ smaretpraṇavasaṃsthitam /
nādarupamanaupamyamarddhamātroparisthitam //
meaning:
नारायणं परानन्दं स्मरेत्प्रणवसंस्थितम् /
नादरुपमनौपम्यमर्द्धमात्रोपरिस्थितम् //
text_mt: The letter "a" has the form of Brahmā; the letter "u" possesses the form of Viṣṇu; / the letter "m" is the form of Rudra; the half-mora consists of the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
akāraṃ brahmaṇo rupamukāraṃ viṣṇurupavat /
makāraṃ rudrarupaṃ syādardhdamātraṃ parātmakam //
meaning:
अकारं ब्रह्मणो रुपमुकारं विष्णुरुपवत् /
मकारं रुद्ररुपं स्यादर्ध्दमात्रं परात्मकम् //
text_mt: Three morae are declared, presided over by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; / their combination, O brāhmaṇa, awakens [knowledge of] the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrāstistraḥ samākhyātā brahmaviṣṇu śivādhipāḥ /
teṣāṃ samuccayaṃ vipra parabrahmaprabodhakam //
meaning:
मात्रास्तिस्त्रः समाख्याता ब्रह्मविष्णु शिवाधिपाः /
तेषां समुच्चयं विप्र परब्रह्मप्रबोधकम् //
text_mt: The signified is the supreme Brahman; the signifier is said to be the praṇava; / the connection between signified and signifier between the two, O twice-born, is figurative.

sanskrit_iast:
vācyaṃ tu paramaṃ brahma vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ /
vācyavācakasaṃbandho hyupacārāttayordvijā //
meaning:
वाच्यं तु परमं ब्रह्म वाचकः प्रणवः स्मृतः /
वाच्यवाचकसंबन्धो ह्युपचारात्तयोर्द्विजा //
text_mt: Reciting the praṇava daily, they are freed from all sins; / united with its practice, they attain supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
japantaḥ praṇavaṃ nityaṃ mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ /
tadabhyāsena saṃyuktāḥ paraṃ mokṣaṃ labhanti ca //
meaning:
जपन्तः प्रणवं नित्यं मुच्यन्ते सर्वपातकैः /
तदभ्यासेन संयुक्ताः परं मोक्षं लभन्ति च //
text_mt: Reciting the praṇava mantra, which consists of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / one should meditate within oneself on the spotless radiance equal to ten million suns.

sanskrit_iast:
japaṃśca praṇavaṃ mantraṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam /
koṭisūryasamaṃ tejo dhyāyedātmani nirmalam //
meaning:
जपंश्च प्रणवं मन्त्रं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकम् /
कोटिसूर्यसमं तेजो ध्यायेदात्मनि निर्मलम् //
text_mt: Either in the form of a śālagrāma stone or in the form of an image, / or whatever object removes sin, upon that one should meditate in the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilārupaṃ pratimārupameva vā /
yadyatpāpaharaṃ vastu tattadvā cintayeddhṛdi //
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलारुपं प्रतिमारुपमेव वा /
यद्यत्पापहरं वस्तु तत्तद्वा चिन्तयेद्धृदि //
text_mt: This Vaiṣṇava knowledge which has been told to you, O lord of sages— / having known this, the foremost yogin attains supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yadetaddaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ kathitaṃ te munīśvara /
etadviditvā yogīndro labhate mokṣamuttamam //
meaning:
यदेतद्दैष्णवं ज्ञानं कथितं ते मुनीश्वर /
एतद्विदित्वा योगीन्द्रो लभते मोक्षमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Whoever either hears this or recites it with a concentrated mind, / freed from all sins, attains the world of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvetacchṛāṇuyādvāpi paṭhedvāpi samāhitaḥ /
sa sarvapāpanirmukto harisālokyamānpuyāt //
iti śrībṛnnāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde yoganirupaṇaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यस्त्वेतच्छृआणुयाद्वापि पठेद्वापि समाहितः /
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तो हरिसालोक्यमान्पुयात् //
इति श्रीबृन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे योगनिरुपणं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, named the Exposition of Yoga, in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

Nārada said: / All the limbs of yoga have been fully explained, O great sage; / now too, O omniscient one, tell me what I ask.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
samākhyātāni sarvāṇi yogāṅgāni mahāmune /
idānīmapi sarvajña yatpṛcchāmi taducyatām //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
समाख्यातानि सर्वाणि योगाङ्गानि महामुने /
इदानीमपि सर्वज्ञ यत्पृच्छामि तदुच्यताम् //
text_mt: It was spoken by you that yoga succeeds only for those with devotion; / and he with whom the Lord of all is pleased has eternal devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
yogobhaktimatāmeva sidhyatīti tvayoditam /
yasya tuṣyati sarveśastasya bhaktiśca śāśvatam //
meaning:
योगोभक्तिमतामेव सिध्यतीति त्वयोदितम् /
यस्य तुष्यति सर्वेशस्तस्य भक्तिश्च शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: In what manner the Lord of all, the God of gods, Janārdana, is pleased, / tell me that, O omniscient sage, ocean of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tuṣyati sarveśo devadevo janārdanaḥ /
tanmamākhyāhi sarvajña mune kāruṇyavāridhe //
meaning:
यथा तुष्यति सर्वेशो देवदेवो जनार्दनः /
तन्ममाख्याहि सर्वज्ञ मुने कारुण्यवारिधे //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Worship Nārāyaṇa, the supreme God, the embodiment of being, consciousness, and bliss, / with your whole being, O brāhmaṇa, if you desire liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ devaṃ saccidānandavigraham /
bhaja sarvātmanā vipra yadi muktimabhīpsasi //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
नारायणं परं देवं सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहम् /
भज सर्वात्मना विप्र यदि मुक्तिमभीप्ससि //
text_mt: Enemies do not harm him, the planetary forces do not afflict him, / and demons do not cast their gaze upon a man devoted to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ripavastaṃ na hiṃsanti na bādhante grahāścatam /
rākṣasāśca na cekṣante naraṃ viṣṇuparāyaṇam //
meaning:
रिपवस्तं न हिंसन्ति न बाधन्ते ग्रहाश्चतम् /
राक्षसाश्च न चेक्षन्ते नरं विष्णुपरायणम् //
text_mt: He whose devotion to the God of gods, Janārdana, is firm / has blessings come to fruition; those endowed with devotion are superior to others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktardṛḍhā bhavedyasya devadeve janārdane /
śreyāṃsi tasya sidhyanti bhaktimanto 'dhikāstataḥ //
meaning:
भक्तर्दृढा भवेद्यस्य देवदेवे जनार्दने /
श्रेयांसि तस्य सिध्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तो ऽधिकास्ततः //
text_mt: Those feet of men are fruitful which walk to the house of Viṣṇu; / those hands should be known as fruitful which are devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pādau tau saphalau puṃsāṃ yau viṣṇugṛhagāminau /
tau karau laphalau jñeyau viṣṇupūjāparau tu yau //
meaning:
पादौ तौ सफलौ पुंसां यौ विष्णुगृहगामिनौ /
तौ करौ लफलौ ज्ञेयौ विष्णुपूजापरौ तु यौ //
text_mt: Those eyes of men are very fruitful which behold Janārdana; / that tongue is praised by the virtuous which is dedicated to the name of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
te netre suphale puṃsāṃ paśyato ye danārdanam /
sā jihvā procyate sadbhirharināmaparā tu yā //
meaning:
ते नेत्रे सुफले पुंसां पश्यतो ये दनार्दनम् /
सा जिह्वा प्रोच्यते सद्भिर्हरिनामपरा तु या //
text_mt: Truth, truth, again truth, raising my arm it is proclaimed: / there is no truth equal to the guru, and there is no deity higher than Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamuddhṛtya bhujamutyate /
tattvaṃ gurusamaṃ nārita nata devaḥ keśavātparaḥ //
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यमुद्धृत्य भुजमुत्यते /
तत्त्वं गुरुसमं नारित नत देवः केशवात्परः //
text_mt: I speak the truth, I speak what is beneficial, I speak the essence again and again: / in this worthless worldly existence, worship of Hari is the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ vacmihitaṃ vācmi sāraṃ vacmi punaḥ punaḥ /
asāre 'smiṃsta saṃsāre satyaṃ harisamarcanam //
meaning:
सत्यं वच्मिहितं वाच्मि सारं वच्मि पुनः पुनः /
असारे ऽस्मिंस्त संसारे सत्यं हरिसमर्चनम् //
text_mt: Having severed the exceedingly firm snare of worldly existence, which produces great delusion, / with the axe of devotion to Hari, become exceedingly happy.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārapāśaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ mahāmohapradāyakam /
haribhaktikuṭāreṇa cchittvātyantasukhī bhava //
meaning:
संसारपाशं सुदृढं महामोहप्रदायकम् /
हरिभक्तिकुटारेण च्छित्त्वात्यन्तसुखी भव //
text_mt: That mind is [truly a mind] which is joined to Viṣṇu; that speech which is devoted to him; / those ears, praised by the world, which are filled with the essence of stories about him.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmanaḥ saṃyutaṃ viṣṇau sā vāṇī yatparāyaṇā /
te śrotre tatkathāsārapūrite lokavandite //
meaning:
तन्मनः संयुतं विष्णौ सा वाणी यत्परायणा /
ते श्रोत्रे तत्कथासारपूरिते लोकवन्दिते //
text_mt: Bliss, imperishable, devoid of the three states as well, / constantly worship the God dwelling in the midst of ether, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandamakṣaraṃ śūnyamavasthātritayairapi /
ākāśamadhyagaṃ devaṃ bhaja nārada saṃtatam //
meaning:
आनन्दमक्षरं शून्यमवस्थात्रितयैरपि /
आकाशमध्यगं देवं भज नारद संततम् //
text_mt: Whose place or essential nature can never / be indicated, O tiger among sages, or seen by those with unrefined minds.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaṃ na śakyate yasya svarupaṃ vā kadācana /
nirdeṣṭuṃ muniśārdūla draṣṭuṃ vāpyakṛtātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
स्थानं न शक्यते यस्य स्वरुपं वा कदाचन /
निर्देष्टुं मुनिशार्दूल द्रष्टुं वाप्यकृतात्मभिः //
text_mt: When it is endowed with all the sense-organs, / then that eternal inner ruler is called waking by the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
samastaiḥ karaṇairyukto vartte 'sau yadā tadā /
jāgradityucyate sadbhirantaryāmī sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
समस्तैः करणैर्युक्तो वर्त्ते ऽसौ यदा तदा /
जाग्रदित्युच्यते सद्भिरन्तर्यामी सनातनः //
text_mt: When, joined with the inner organs, it roams at will, / that Self, when free from slumber, is called dreaming.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāntaḥ karaṇairṃyuktaḥ svecchayā vicaratyasau /
svapannicyucyate hyātmā yadā svāpavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
यदान्तः करणैर्ंयुक्तः स्वेच्छया विचरत्यसौ /
स्वपन्निच्युच्यते ह्यात्मा यदा स्वापविवर्जितः //
text_mt: When that Self is not endowed with external sense-organs, nor with inner organs, / formless, and free from merit and demerit,

sanskrit_iast:
na bāhyakaraṇairyukto na cāntaḥ karaṇaistathā /
asvarupo yadātmāsau puṇyāpuṇyavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
न बाह्यकरणैर्युक्तो न चान्तः करणैस्तथा /
अस्वरुपो यदात्मासौ पुण्यापुण्यविवर्जितः //
text_mt: released from all adjuncts, bliss, devoid of qualities, all-pervading, / the God consisting of supreme Brahman is sung of as asleep [in deep sleep].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvopādhivinirmukto hyānando nirguṇo vibhuḥ /
parabrahmamayo devaḥ suṣutpa iti gīyate //
meaning:
सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तो ह्यानन्दो निर्गुणो विभुः /
परब्रह्ममयो देवः सुषुत्प इति गीयते //
text_mt: This universe of the moving and unmoving consists of thought alone; / it is as fickle as lightning, O best of brāhmaṇas; therefore worship Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvanāmayametadvai jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam /
vidyudvilolaṃ viprendra bhaghaja tasmājjanārdanam //
meaning:
भावनामयमेतद्वै जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
विद्युद्विलोलं विप्रेन्द्र भघज तस्माज्जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: Non-violence, truth, non-stealing, celibacy, and non-possession— / he in whom these abide, with him alone the Lord of the worlds is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau /
vartate yasya tasyaiva tuṣyate jagatāṃ patiḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ /
वर्तते यस्य तस्यैव तुष्यते जगतां पतिः //
text_mt: With one who is endowed with compassion for all beings and devoted to honoring brāhmaṇas, / the Lord of the universe, the crusher of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhaghūtadayāyukto viprapūjāparāyaṇaḥ /
tasya tuṣṭo jagannātho madhukaiṭabhamarddanaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभघूतदयायुक्तो विप्रपूजापरायणः /
तस्य तुष्टो जगन्नाथो मधुकैटभमर्द्दनः //
text_mt: Jagannātha, the slayer of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, is pleased with him / who is full of compassion for all beings and devoted to honouring brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
satkathāyāṃ ca ramate satkathāṃ ca karoti yaḥ /
satsaṅgo nirahaṃ kārastasya prīto ramāpatiḥ //
meaning:
सत्कथायां च रमते सत्कथां च करोति यः /
सत्सङ्गो निरहं कारस्तस्य प्रीतो रमापतिः //
text_mt: The husband of Ramā is delighted with him / who takes delight in noble tales and tells noble tales, who keeps good company, and is free from egoism.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmasaṃkīrttanaṃ viṣṇo kṣuttṛṭpraskhalitādiṣu /
karoti satataṃ yastu tasya prīto hyadhokṣajaḥ //
meaning:
नामसंकीर्त्तनं विष्णो क्षुत्तृट्प्रस्खलितादिषु /
करोति सततं यस्तु तस्य प्रीतो ह्यधोक्षजः //
text_mt: Adhokṣaja is pleased indeed with him / who constantly chants Viṣṇu's names when hungry, thirsty, slipping, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yātu nārīpatiprāṇā patipūjāparāyaṇā /
tasyāstuṣṭo jagannātho dadāti svapadaṃ mune //
meaning:
यातु नारीपतिप्राणा पतिपूजापरायणा /
तस्यास्तुष्टो जगन्नाथो ददाति स्वपदं मुने //
text_mt: With the woman whose husband is her life and who is devoted to serving her husband, / Jagannātha is pleased, O sage, and gives his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyārahitā ye tu hyahaṅkāravivarjitāḥ /
devapūjāparāścaiva teṣāṃ tuṣyati keśavaḥ //
meaning:
असूयारहिता ये तु ह्यहङ्कारविवर्जिताः /
देवपूजापराश्चैव तेषां तुष्यति केशवः //
text_mt: Keśava is pleased with those / who are free from malice, rid of egoism, and devoted to worshipping the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchṛṇuṣva devarśe bhajasvaṃ satataṃ harim /
mā kuruṣva hyahaṅkāraṃ vidyullolaśriyā vṛthā //
meaning:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व देवर्शे भजस्वं सततं हरिम् /
मा कुरुष्व ह्यहङ्कारं विद्युल्लोलश्रिया वृथा //
text_mt: Therefore listen, O divine sage! Constantly worship Hari; / do not become arrogant in vain over fortune as unsteady as lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ mṛtyusaṃyuktaṃ jīvitaṃ cāti cañcalam /
rājādibhirdhanaṃ bādhyaṃ sampadaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgurāḥ //
meaning:
शरीरं मृत्युसंयुक्तं जीवितं चाति चञ्चलम् /
राजादिभिर्धनं बाध्यं सम्पदः क्षणभङ्गुराः //
text_mt: The body is bound to death, and life is exceedingly fickle; / wealth can be seized by kings and others, and fortunes crumble in a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na paśyasi devarṣe hyāyuṣārddhaṃ tu nidrayā /
hataṃ ca bhojanādyaiśca kiyadāyuḥ samāhṛtam //
meaning:
किं न पश्यसि देवर्षे ह्यायुषार्द्धं तु निद्रया /
हतं च भोजनाद्यैश्च कियदायुः समाहृतम् //
text_mt: Do you not see, O divine sage, that half of one's life is destroyed by sleep, / and how much of life is consumed by eating and the like?

sanskrit_iast:
kiyadāyurbālabhāvātkiyadvṛthā /
kiyadviṣayabhogaiśca kadā dharmānkariṣyati //
meaning:
कियदायुर्बालभावात्कियद्वृथा /
कियद्विषयभोगैश्च कदा धर्मान्करिष्यति //
text_mt: How much of life is spent in childhood, how much in vain, / and how much in the enjoyment of sense objects! When will one practice righteousness?

sanskrit_iast:
bālabhāve ca vārddhakyena ghaṭetācyutārcanam /
vayasyeva tato dharmānkuru tvamanahaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
बालभावे च वार्द्धक्येन घटेताच्युतार्चनम् /
वयस्येव ततो धर्मान्कुरु त्वमनहङ्कृतः //
text_mt: Worship of Acyuta cannot be accomplished in childhood or in old age; / therefore, while still in your youth, practice righteousness, free from egoism.

sanskrit_iast:
mā vināśaṃ vraja mune magnaḥ saṃsāragahvare /
varurvināśanilayamāpadāṃ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
मा विनाशं व्रज मुने मग्नः संसारगह्वरे /
वरुर्विनाशनिलयमापदां परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Do not perish, O sage, sinking into the pit of worldly existence; / the body is an abode of ruin, the supreme seat of misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ bhoganilayaṃ malādyaiḥ paridūṣitam /
kimarthaṃ śāśvatadhiyā kuryātpāpaṃ naro vṛthā //
meaning:
शरीरं भोगनिलयं मलाद्यैः परिदूषितम् /
किमर्थं शाश्वतधिया कुर्यात्पापं नरो वृथा //
text_mt: The body is an abode of pleasures, tainted by impurities and the like; / why should a person commit sin in vain thinking it to be eternal?

sanskrit_iast:
āsārabhūte saṃsāre nānāduḥ khasamanvite /
viśvāso nātra karttavyo niścitaṃ mṛtyusaṃkule //
meaning:
आसारभूते संसारे नानादुः खसमन्विते /
विश्वासो नात्र कर्त्तव्यो निश्चितं मृत्युसंकुले //
text_mt: In this worthless worldly existence, filled with manifold sufferings / and crowded with death, no trust should be placed at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchṛṇuṣva viprendra satyametadvravīmyaham /
dehayoganivṛttyarthaṃ sadya eva janārdanam //
meaning:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व विप्रेन्द्र सत्यमेतद्व्रवीम्यहम् /
देहयोगनिवृत्त्यर्थं सद्य एव जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: Therefore listen, O best of brāhmaṇas, I speak this truth to you: / for the cessation of union with the body, [worship] Janārdana at once.

sanskrit_iast:
mānaṃ tyaktvā tathā lobhaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ /
bhajasva satataṃ viṣṇuṃ mānuṣyamatidurlabham //
meaning:
मानं त्यक्त्वा तथा लोभं कामक्रोधविवर्जितः /
भजस्व सततं विष्णुं मानुष्यमतिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Casting aside pride and greed, rid of lust and anger, / constantly worship Viṣṇu; human birth is exceedingly difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭijanmasahasreṣu sthāvarādiṣu sattama /
saṃbhrāntasya tu mānuṣyaṃ kathañcitparilabhyate //
meaning:
कोटिजन्मसहस्रेषु स्थावरादिषु सत्तम /
संभ्रान्तस्य तु मानुष्यं कथञ्चित्परिलभ्यते //
text_mt: O best of men, wandering through tens of millions of births among stationary beings and the rest, / a human birth is somehow attained.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi devatābuddhirdānabuddhiśca sattama /
bhogabuddhistathā nṝṇāṃ janmāntaratapaḥ phalam //
meaning:
तत्रापि देवताबुद्धिर्दानबुद्धिश्च सत्तम /
भोगबुद्धिस्तथा नॄणां जन्मान्तरतपः फलम् //
text_mt: Even there, a mind inclined to the divine, a mind inclined to charity, O best of men, / and an attitude towards enjoyments [free from attachment] is the fruit of austerities performed in previous lives.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya yo hariṃ nārcayetsakṛt /
mūrkhaḥ ko 'sti parastasmājjaḍabuddhiracetanaḥ //
meaning:
मानुष्यं दुर्लभं प्राप्य यो हरिं नार्चयेत्सकृत् /
मूर्खः को ऽस्ति परस्तस्माज्जडबुद्धिरचेतनः //
text_mt: Having obtained a rare human birth, who does not worship Hari even once? / Who is a greater fool than he, dull-witted and devoid of consciousness?

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ nārcayanti ca ye harim /
teṣāmatīva mūrkhāṇāṃ vivekaḥ kutra tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
दुर्लभं प्राप्य मानुष्यं नार्चयन्ति च ये हरिम् /
तेषामतीव मूर्खाणां विवेकः कुत्र तिष्ठति //
text_mt: Those who, having attained a rare human birth, do not worship Hari— / where does the discernment of those utter fools abide?

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhito jagannātho dadātyabhimataṃ phalam /
kastaṃ na pūjayedviprasaṃsārāpripradīpitaḥ //
meaning:
आराधितो जगन्नाथो ददात्यभिमतं फलम् /
कस्तं न पूजयेद्विप्रसंसाराप्रिप्रदीपितः //
text_mt: Propitiated, Jagannātha grants one's desired reward; / who, scorched by the fire of worldly existence, would not worship him, O brāhmaṇa?

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālo 'pi muniśreṣṭa viṣṇubhakto dvijādhikaḥ /
viṣṇubhaktivihīnaśca dvijo 'pi śvapacādhamaḥ //
meaning:
चण्डालो ऽपि मुनिश्रेष्ट विष्णुभक्तो द्विजाधिकः /
विष्णुभक्तिविहीनश्च द्विजो ऽपि श्वपचाधमः //
text_mt: Even an outcaste who is devoted to Viṣṇu is superior to a twice-born, O best of sages; / and even a twice-born lacking devotion to Viṣṇu is lower than a dog-cooker.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkāmādikaṃ tyaktvā bhajeta harimavyayam /
yasmiṃstuṣṭe 'khilaṃ tuṣyedyataḥ sarvagato hariḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्कामादिकं त्यक्त्वा भजेत हरिमव्ययम् /
यस्मिंस्तुष्टे ऽखिलं तुष्येद्यतः सर्वगतो हरिः //
text_mt: Therefore, casting aside lust and the like, one should worship imperishable Hari; / when he is pleased, all is pleased, because Hari is omnipresent.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hastipade sarvaṃ padamātraṃ pralīyate /
tathaḥā carācaraṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇāviva pralīyate //
meaning:
यथा हस्तिपदे सर्वं पदमात्रं प्रलीयते /
तथःआ चराचरं विश्वं विष्णाविव प्रलीयते //
text_mt: Just as every footprint dissolves into an elephant's footprint, / so the entire universe, moving and stationary, dissolves into Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśena yathā vyātpaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam /
tathaiva hariṇā vyātpaṃ viśvametaccarācaram //
meaning:
आकाशेन यथा व्यात्पं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
तथैव हरिणा व्यात्पं विश्वमेतच्चराचरम् //
text_mt: Just as the universe of the moving and unmoving is pervaded by space, / so this entire universe, moving and stationary, is pervaded by Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
janmano maraṇaṃ nṝṇāṃ janma vai mṛtyusādhanam /
ubhe te nikaṭe viddhi tannāśo harisevayā //
meaning:
जन्मनो मरणं नॄणां जन्म वै मृत्युसाधनम् /
उभे ते निकटे विद्धि तन्नाशो हरिसेवया //
text_mt: Death comes from birth for men; birth indeed is the means to death; / know that both are near; their destruction comes through the service of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātaḥ smṛtaḥ pūjito vā praṇato vā janārdanaḥ /
saṃsārapāśavicchedīkastaṃ na pratipūjayet //
meaning:
ध्यातः स्मृतः पूजितो वा प्रणतो वा जनार्दनः /
संसारपाशविच्छेदीकस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Whether meditated upon, remembered, worshipped, or bowed to, Janārdana / cuts the bonds of worldly existence; who would not revere him?

sanskrit_iast:
yannāmoccāṃraṇādeva mahāpātakanāśanam /
yaṃ samabhyarcya viprarṣe mokṣabhāgī bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
यन्नामोच्चांरणादेव महापातकनाशनम् /
यं समभ्यर्च्य विप्रर्षे मोक्षभागी भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: Just by uttering his name, great sins are destroyed; / by thoroughly worshipping him, O brāhmaṇa sage, a man becomes an heir to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
aho citramaho citramaho citramidaṃ dvija /
harināmni sthite lokaḥ saṃsāre parivarttate //
meaning:
अहो चित्रमहो चित्रमहो चित्रमिदं द्विज /
हरिनाम्नि स्थिते लोकः संसारे परिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Ah, what a wonder! Ah, what a wonder! Ah, what a wonder this is, O twice-born! / Though the name of Hari exists, the world still wanders in worldly existence!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyobhūyo 'pi vakṣyāmi satyametattapodhana /
nīyamāno yamabhaṭairaśakto dharmasādhanaiḥ //
meaning:
भूयोभूयो ऽपि वक्ष्यामि सत्यमेतत्तपोधन /
नीयमानो यमभटैरशक्तो धर्मसाधनैः //
text_mt: Again and again I tell you this truth, O rich in austerity: / when being dragged away by the soldiers of Yama, one is unable [to practice] the means of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ yāvadvyādhirna bādhate /
tāvadevārcayedviṣṇuṃ yadi muktimabhīpsati //
māturgarbhādviniḥ
meaning:
यावन्नेन्द्रियवैकल्यं यावद्व्याधिर्न बाधते /
तावदेवार्चयेद्विष्णुं यदि मुक्तिमभीप्सति //
मातुर्गर्भाद्विनिः
text_mt:
As long as the senses are not impaired, as long as disease does not afflict one, / so long should one worship Viṣṇu, if one desires liberation.

The very moment a living being has emerged from the mother's womb, / death draws near; therefore, one should be devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
māturgarbhādviniṣkrānto yadā jantustadaiva hi /
mṛtyuḥ saṃnihito bhūyāttasmāddharmaparo bhavet //
meaning:
मातुर्गर्भाद्विनिष्क्रान्तो यदा जन्तुस्तदैव हि /
मृत्युः संनिहितो भूयात्तस्माद्धर्मपरो भवेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
aho kaṣṭamaho kaṣṭamahokaṣṭamidaṃ vapuḥ /
vinaśvaraṃ samājñāya dharmaṃ naivācaratyayam //
meaning:
अहो कष्टमहो कष्टमहोकष्टमिदं वपुः /
विनश्वरं समाज्ञाय धर्मं नैवाचरत्ययम् //
text_mt: Ah, what misery! Ah, what misery! Ah, what misery! Though knowing this body / to be perishable, a person does not practice righteousness at all!

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate /
dambhācāraṃ parityajyaṃ vāsudevaṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यमुद्धृत्य भुजमुच्यते /
दम्भाचारं परित्यज्यं वासुदेवं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: It is true, true, and true again, proclaimed with arm raised high: / abandoning hypocritical conduct, one should worship Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo bhūyo hitaṃ vacmi bhujamuddhṛtya nārada /
viṣṇuḥ sarvātmanā pūjyastyājyāsūyā tathānṛtam //
meaning:
भूयो भूयो हितं वच्मि भुजमुद्धृत्य नारद /
विष्णुः सर्वात्मना पूज्यस्त्याज्यासूया तथानृतम् //
text_mt: Again and again I declare what is beneficial, raising my arm, O Nārada: / Viṣṇu is to be worshipped with all one's being; malice and falsehood must be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhamūlo manastāpaḥ krodhaḥ saṃsārabandhanam /
dharmakṣayakaraḥ krodhastasmāttaṃ parivarjayet //
meaning:
क्रोधमूलो मनस्तापः क्रोधः संसारबन्धनम् /
धर्मक्षयकरः क्रोधस्तस्मात्तं परिवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Anger is the root of mental distress; anger is the bond of worldly existence; / anger causes the destruction of righteousness; therefore, one should avoid it.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmamūlamidaṃ janma kāmaḥ pāpasya kāraṇam /
yaśaḥ kṣayakaraḥ kāmastasmāttaṃ parivarjayet //
meaning:
काममूलमिदं जन्म कामः पापस्य कारणम् /
यशः क्षयकरः कामस्तस्मात्तं परिवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: This birth has desire as its root; desire is the cause of sin; / desire causes the destruction of renown; therefore, one should avoid it.

sanskrit_iast:
samastaduḥkhajālānāṃ mātsaryaṃ kāraṇaṃ smṛtam /
narakāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ ca tasmāttadapi saṃtyajet //
meaning:
समस्तदुःखजालानां मात्सर्यं कारणं स्मृतम् /
नरकाणां साधनं च तस्मात्तदपि संत्यजेत् //
text_mt: Envy is known to be the cause of all networks of suffering / and the means to hells; therefore, one should abandon that as well.

sanskrit_iast:
mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥ /
tasmāttadabhisaṃyojya parātmani sukhī bhavet //
meaning:
मन एव मनुष्याणां कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः /
तस्मात्तदभिसंयोज्य परात्मनि सुखी भवेत् //
text_mt: The mind alone is the cause of bondage and liberation for human beings; / therefore, having joined it to the supreme Self, one may become happy.

sanskrit_iast:
aho dhairyamaho dhairyamaho dhairyamaho nṛṇām /
viṣṇau sthite jagannāthe na bhajanti madoddhatāḥ //
meaning:
अहो धैर्यमहो धैर्यमहो धैर्यमहो नृणाम् /
विष्णौ स्थिते जगन्नाथे न भजन्ति मदोद्धताः //
text_mt: Ah, what persistence! Ah, what persistence! Ah, what persistence of men, / that while Viṣṇu, the Lord of the world, exists, haughty with pride they do not worship him!

sanskrit_iast:
anārādhya jagannāthaṃ sarvadhātāramacyutam /
saṃsārasāgare magnāḥ kathaṃ pāraṃ prayānti hi //
meaning:
अनाराध्य जगन्नाथं सर्वधातारमच्युतम् /
संसारसागरे मग्नाः कथं पारं प्रयान्ति हि //
text_mt: Without propitiating Jagannātha, the supporter of all, Acyuta, / how can those sunk in the ocean of worldly existence reach the further shore?

sanskrit_iast:
acyutānantagovindanāmoccāraṇabheṣajāt /
naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham //
meaning:
अच्युतानन्तगोविन्दनामोच्चारणभेषजात् /
नश्यन्ति सकला रोगाः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् //
text_mt: By the medicine of uttering the names 'Acyuta, Ananta, Govinda,' / all diseases are destroyed; I speak the truth, the truth!

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇa jagannātha vāsudeva janārddana /
itīrayanti ye nityaṃ te vai sarvatra vanditāḥ //
meaning:
नारायण जगन्नाथ वासुदेव जनार्द्दन /
इतीरयन्ति ये नित्यं ते वै सर्वत्र वन्दिताः //
text_mt: Those who constantly utter: 'Nārāyaṇa, Jagannātha, Vāsudeva, Janārdana,' / are indeed revered everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi ca muniśreṣṭa brahmādyā api devatāḥ /
yatprābhāvaṃ na jānanti taṃ yāhi śaraṇaṃ mune //
meaning:
अद्यापि च मुनिश्रेष्ट ब्रह्माद्या अपि देवताः /
यत्प्राभावं न जानन्ति तं याहि शरणं मुने //
text_mt: Even today, O best of sages, the deities headed by Brahmā / do not know his majesty; take refuge in him, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
aho maurkhyamaho maurkhyamaho maurkhyaṃ durātmanām /
hṛtpadmasaṃsthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ na vijānanti nārada //
meaning:
अहो मौर्ख्यमहो मौर्ख्यमहो मौर्ख्यं दुरात्मनाम् /
हृत्पद्मसंस्थितं विष्णुं न विजानन्ति नारद //
text_mt: Ah, the foolishness, ah, the foolishness, ah, the foolishness of the wicked, / who do not recognize Viṣṇu seated in the lotus of the heart, O Nārada!

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇuṣva muniśārdūla bhūyobhūyo vadāmyaham /
hariḥ śraddhāvatāṃ tuṣyenna dhanairna ca bāndhavaiḥ //
meaning:
शृणुष्व मुनिशार्दूल भूयोभूयो वदाम्यहम् /
हरिः श्रद्धावतां तुष्येन्न धनैर्न च बान्धवैः //
text_mt: Listen, O tiger among sages, I say again and again: / Hari is pleased with those who have faith, not by wealth nor by kin.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhumattvaṃ dhanāḍhyatvaṃ putravattvaṃ ca sattama /
viṣṇubhaghaktimatāṃ nṝṇāṃ bhavejjanmani janmani //
meaning:
बन्धुमत्त्वं धनाढ्यत्वं पुत्रवत्त्वं च सत्तम /
विष्णुभघक्तिमतां नॄणां भवेज्जन्मनि जन्मनि //
text_mt: Possession of kin, richness in wealth, and possession of sons, O best of beings, / shall belong in birth after birth to people endowed with devotion to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpamūlamayaṃ dehaḥ pāpakarmaratastathā /
etadviditvā satataṃ pūjanīyo janārddanaḥ //
meaning:
पापमूलमयं देहः पापकर्मरतस्तथा /
एतद्विदित्वा सततं पूजनीयो जनार्द्दनः //
text_mt: This body is rooted in sin, and likewise intent on sinful deeds; / knowing this, Janārdana must be worshipped constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
putramitrakalatrādyā bahavaḥ syuśca saṃpadaḥ /
haripūjāratānāṃ tu bhavatyena na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्राद्या बहवः स्युश्च संपदः /
हरिपूजारतानां तु भवत्येन न संशयः //
text_mt: Sons, friends, wives, and so forth, and many riches / come indeed to those devoted to the worship of Hari; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāmutra sukhaprepsuḥ pūjayetsatataṃ harim /
ihāmutrāsukhaprepsuḥ paranindāparo bhavet //
meaning:
इहामुत्र सुखप्रेप्सुः पूजयेत्सततं हरिम् /
इहामुत्रासुखप्रेप्सुः परनिन्दापरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Desiring happiness here and in the hereafter, one should constantly worship Hari; / desiring unhappiness here and in the hereafter, one would be intent on censuring others.

sanskrit_iast:
dhigjanma bhaktihīnānāṃ devadeve janārddane /
satpātradānaśūnyaṃ yattaddhanaṃ dhikpunaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
धिग्जन्म भक्तिहीनानां देवदेवे जनार्द्दने /
सत्पात्रदानशून्यं यत्तद्धनं धिक्पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Fie on the birth of those devoid of devotion to the god of gods, Janārdana! / Fie, fie again on that wealth which is destitute of gift to a worthy recipient!

sanskrit_iast:
na namedviṣṇave yasya śarīraṃ karmabhedine /
pāpānāmākaraṃ tadvai vijñeyaṃ munisattama //
meaning:
न नमेद्विष्णवे यस्य शरीरं कर्मभेदिने /
पापानामाकरं तद्वै विज्ञेयं मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: The body of one that does not bow to Viṣṇu, who destroys karma, / is surely to be known, O best of sages, as a mine of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
satpātradānarahitaṃ yaddravyaṃ yena rakṣitam /
cauryeṇa rakṣitamiva viddhi lokeṣu niścitam //
meaning:
सत्पात्रदानरहितं यद्द्रव्यं येन रक्षितम् /
चौर्येण रक्षितमिव विद्धि लोकेषु निश्चितम् //
text_mt: Whatever wealth is guarded without giving to a worthy recipient, / know that in the worlds it is certainly as if guarded by theft.

sanskrit_iast:
taḍillolaśriyā mattāḥ kṣaṇaṃbhayuraśālinaḥ /
nārādhayanti viśveśaṃ paśupāśavimocakam //
meaning:
तडिल्लोलश्रिया मत्ताः क्षणंभयुरशालिनः /
नाराधयन्ति विश्वेशं पशुपाशविमोचकम् //
text_mt: Intoxicated by fortune flickering as lightning, possessing only momentary radiance, / they do not worship the Lord of the Universe, who liberates beasts from their bonds.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭistu dvividhā proktā daivāsuravibhedataḥ /
hari bhakti yutā daivī taddhīnā hyāsurī mahā //
meaning:
सृष्टिस्तु द्विविधा प्रोक्ता दैवासुरविभेदतः /
हरि भक्ति युता दैवी तद्धीना ह्यासुरी महा //
text_mt: Creation is declared to be twofold, distinguished as divine and demonic: / the divine is endowed with devotion to Hari; that devoid of it is indeed greatly demonic.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchṛṇaṣva viprendra haribhaktiparāyaṇāḥ /
śreṣṭhāḥ sarvatra vikhyātā yato bhaktiḥ sudurlabhā //
meaning:
तस्माच्छृणष्व विप्रेन्द्र हरिभक्तिपरायणाः /
श्रेष्ठाः सर्वत्र विख्याता यतो भक्तिः सुदुर्लभा //
text_mt: Therefore listen, O leader of brahmins: those devoted to devotion to Hari / are celebrated everywhere as the best, because devotion is exceedingly difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyārahitā ye ca vipratrāṇaparāyaṇāḥ /
kāmādirahitā ye ca teṣāṃ tuṣyati keśavaḥ //
meaning:
असूयारहिता ये च विप्रत्राणपरायणाः /
कामादिरहिता ये च तेषां तुष्यति केशवः //
text_mt: Those who are free from malice, intent on protecting brahmins, / and devoid of desire and the like—with them Keśava is pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmārjanādinā ye tu viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ /
satpātradānaniratāḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde haribhaktilakṣaṇaṃ nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
संमार्जनादिना ये तु विष्णुशुश्रूषणे रताः /
सत्पात्रदाननिरताः प्रयान्ति परमं पदम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे हरिभक्तिलक्षणं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those, however, who are intent on serving Viṣṇu by sweeping and the like, / and devoted to giving to worthy recipients, go to the supreme abode.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, named 'The Characteristics of Devotion to Hari', in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
punarvakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ /
paṭhatāṃ śuṇvatāṃ sadyaḥ pāparāśiḥ praṇaśyati //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
पुनर्वक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः /
पठतां शुण्वतां सद्यः पापराशिः प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / I shall again speak of the eulogy of greatness of the god of gods, the Wielder of the Discus, / by reciting and hearing which the mass of sins is instantly destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntā jitāriṣaḍvargā yogenāpyanahṝṅkṛtāḥ /
yajanti jñānayogena jñānarūpiṇamavyayam //
meaning:
शान्ता जितारिषड्वर्गा योगेनाप्यनहॄङ्कृताः /
यजन्ति ज्ञानयोगेन ज्ञानरूपिणमव्ययम् //
text_mt: The peaceful, who have conquered the six enemies and become free of egoism through yoga, / worship through the yoga of knowledge the imperishable One whose nature is knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthasnānairviśuddhā ye vratadānatapomakhaiḥ /
yajanti karmayogena sarvadhātāramacyutam //
meaning:
तीर्थस्नानैर्विशुद्धा ये व्रतदानतपोमखैः /
यजन्ति कर्मयोगेन सर्वधातारमच्युतम् //
text_mt: Those purified by bathing at sacred fords, by vows, gifts, austerities, and sacrifices, / worship through the yoga of action the supporter of all, Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
lubdhā vyasanito 'jñāśca na yajanti jagatpatim /
ajarāmaravanmūḍhāstiṣṭanti narakīṭakāḥ //
meaning:
लुब्धा व्यसनितो ऽज्ञाश्च न यजन्ति जगत्पतिम् /
अजरामरवन्मूढास्तिष्टन्ति नरकीटकाः //
text_mt: The greedy, the addicted, and the ignorant do not worship the Lord of the World; / foolish, like worms of hell, they behave as though unaging and immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
taḍillekhāśriyā mattā vṛthāhṝṅkāradviṣitāḥ /
na yajanti jagannāthaṃ sarvaśraiyovidhāyakam //
meaning:
तडिल्लेखाश्रिया मत्ता वृथाहॄङ्कारद्विषिताः /
न यजन्ति जगन्नाथं सर्वश्रैयोविधायकम् //
text_mt: Intoxicated by fortune like a flash of lightning, hateful with vain egoism, / they do not worship Jagannātha, the bestower of all welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
haridharmaratāḥ śāntā haripādābjasevakāḥ /
daivātke 'pīha jāyante lokānugrahatatparāḥ //
meaning:
हरिधर्मरताः शान्ता हरिपादाब्जसेवकाः /
दैवात्के ऽपीह जायन्ते लोकानुग्रहतत्पराः //
text_mt: Devoted to the dharma of Hari, peaceful, servants of Hari's lotus feet, / by fate some are born here intent on showing favor to the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā yo yajedbhaktito harim /
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ sarvalokottamottamam //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यो यजेद्भक्तितो हरिम् /
स याति परमं स्थानं सर्वलोकोत्तमोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Whoever worships Hari with devotion through action, mind, and speech, / he goes to the supreme station, the highest among all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् /
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: Right here they cite this ancient account, / which destroys all sins for those who recite and hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpravakṣyāmi caritaṃ yajñamālisumālinoḥ /
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vācimedha phalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चरितं यज्ञमालिसुमालिनोः /
यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण वाचिमेध फलं लभेत् //
text_mt: I shall relate that story of Yajñamālin and Sumālin, / by merely hearing which one obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha.

sanskrit_iast:
kaścidāsītpurā vipra brahmaṇo raivateṃ'tare /
vedamāliriti khyāto vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
कश्चिदासीत्पुरा विप्र ब्रह्मणो रैवतेंऽतरे /
वेदमालिरिति ख्यातो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt: Long ago, O brahmin, during the Raivata Manvantara, there was a certain brahmin / known as Vedamālin, who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtadayāyukto haripūjāparāyaṇaḥ /
putramitrakalatrārthaṃ dhanārjanaparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
सर्वभूतदयायुक्तो हरिपूजापरायणः /
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रार्थं धनार्जनपरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Endowed with compassion for all beings, intent on the worship of Hari, / he became bent on acquiring wealth for the sake of his sons, friends, and wife.

sanskrit_iast:
apaṇyaṃvikrayaṃ cakre tathā ca rasivikrayam /
caṇḍālādyairapi tathā saṃbhaṣī tatpratigrahī //
meaning:
अपण्यंविक्रयं चक्रे तथा च रसिविक्रयम् /
चण्डालाद्यैरपि तथा संभषी तत्प्रतिग्रही //
text_mt: He engaged in the sale of illicit goods, and likewise in the sale of fluids; / he also conversed with outcasts and others, and received gifts from them.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasāṃ vikrayaṃ cakre vratānāṃ vikrayaṃ tathā /
parārthaṃ tīrthagamanaṃ kalatrārthamakārayat //
meaning:
तपसां विक्रयं चक्रे व्रतानां विक्रयं तथा /
परार्थं तीर्थगमनं कलत्रार्थमकारयत् //
text_mt: He sold austerities, and likewise he sold religious vows; / he undertook pilgrimages to sacred fords for others, for the sake of his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
kālena gacchatā vipra jātau tasya sutāvubho /
yajñamālī sumālī ca yamalāvatiśobhanau //
meaning:
कालेन गच्छता विप्र जातौ तस्य सुतावुभो /
यज्ञमाली सुमाली च यमलावतिशोभनौ //
text_mt: As time passed, O brahmin, two sons were born to him, / Yajñamālin and Sumālin, exceedingly handsome twins.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pitā kumārau tāvatisnehasamanvitaḥ /
poṣayāmāsa vātsalyādbahubhiḥ sādhanaistadā //
meaning:
ततः पिता कुमारौ तावतिस्नेहसमन्वितः /
पोषयामास वात्सल्याद्बहुभिः साधनैस्तदा //
text_mt: Then the father, endowed with great affection, / nurtured the two boys out of fondness through many means at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamālirbahūpāyairdhanaṃ saṃpādya yatnataḥ /
svadhanaṃ gaṇayāmāsa kiyatsyāditi veditum //
meaning:
वेदमालिर्बहूपायैर्धनं संपाद्य यत्नतः /
स्वधनं गणयामास कियत्स्यादिति वेदितुम् //
text_mt: Vedamālin, having acquired wealth diligently by many expedients, / counted his wealth in order to know how much it might be.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhikoṭisahasrāṇāṃ koṭikoṭiguṇānvitam /
vigaṇayya svayaṃ dṛṣṭo vismitaścārthacintayā //
meaning:
निधिकोटिसहस्राणां कोटिकोटिगुणान्वितम् /
विगणय्य स्वयं दृष्टो विस्मितश्चार्थचिन्तया //
text_mt: Having counted and seen for himself that it was multiplied by crores of crores of thousands of crores of treasures, / he was astonished, pondering over his riches:

sanskrit_iast:
asatpratigrahaiścaiva apaṇyānāṃ ca vikrayaiḥ /
meyā tapo vikrayādyairetaddhanamupārjitam //
meaning:
असत्प्रतिग्रहैश्चैव अपण्यानां च विक्रयैः /
मेया तपो विक्रयाद्यैरेतद्धनमुपार्जितम् //
text_mt: "By accepting illicit gifts and by sales of illicit goods, / by the sale of austerities and such, this wealth has been amassed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
nādyāpi śāntimāpannā mama tṛṣṇātiduḥsahā /
merutulyasuvarṇāni hyasaṃkhyātāni vāñchati //
meaning:
नाद्यापि शान्तिमापन्ना मम तृष्णातिदुःसहा /
मेरुतुल्यसुवर्णानि ह्यसंख्यातानि वाञ्छति //
text_mt: Even today my exceedingly unbearable craving has not attained peace; / it desires countless [masses of] gold equal to Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
aho manye mahākaṣṭaṃ samastakleśasādhanam /
sarvānkāmānavāṃpnoti punaranyañca kāṅkṣati //
meaning:
अहो मन्ये महाकष्टं समस्तक्लेशसाधनम् /
सर्वान्कामानवांप्नोति पुनरन्यञ्च काङ्क्षति //
text_mt: Ah, I consider it a great distress, the instrument of all afflictions: / one attains all desires, and yet longs for another!

sanskrit_iast:
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśāḥ dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ /
cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇekā taruṇāyate //
meaning:
जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः केशाः दन्ता जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः /
चक्षुःश्रोत्रे च जीर्येते तृष्णेका तरुणायते //
text_mt: The hair decays as one ages, the teeth decay as one ages, / the eyes and ears decay; craving alone remains youthful.

sanskrit_iast:
mamedriyāṇi sarvāṇi mandabhāvaṃ vrajanti ca /
balaṃ hataṃ ca jarasā tṛṣṇā taruṇatāṃ gatā //
meaning:
ममेद्रियाणि सर्वाणि मन्दभावं व्रजन्ति च /
बलं हतं च जरसा तृष्णा तरुणतां गता //
text_mt: All my senses are becoming dull, / my strength is destroyed by old age, [yet] craving has attained youthfulness.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṣṭāśā varttate yasya sa vidrānatha paṇḍitaḥ /
suśānto 'pi pramanyuḥ syāddhīmānapyatimūḍhadhīḥ //
meaning:
कष्टाशा वर्त्तते यस्य स विद्रानथ पण्डितः /
सुशान्तो ऽपि प्रमन्युः स्याद्धीमानप्यतिमूढधीः //
text_mt: He in whom painful desire dwells, even if learned or a scholar, / even if very peaceful, becomes angry, and though wise, becomes extremely foolish-minded.

sanskrit_iast:
āśā bhaṅgakarī puṃsāmajeyārātisannibhā /
tasmādāśāṃ tyajetprājño yadīcchecchāśvataṃ sukham //
meaning:
आशा भङ्गकरी पुंसामजेयारातिसन्निभा /
तस्मादाशां त्यजेत्प्राज्ञो यदीच्छेच्छाश्वतं सुखम् //
text_mt: Desire ruins men; it is like an unconquerable enemy; / therefore, a wise man should abandon desire if he wishes for eternal happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
balaṃ tejoḥ yaśaśvaiva vidyāṃ mānaṃ ca vṛddhatām /
tathaiva satkule janma āśā hatyativegataḥ //
meaning:
बलं तेजोः यशश्वैव विद्यां मानं च वृद्धताम् /
तथैव सत्कुले जन्म आशा हत्यतिवेगतः //
text_mt: Strength, splendor, fame, learning, honor, senior status, / and likewise birth in a noble family—desire destroys them with great swiftness.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāmāśābhibhūtānāmāścaryamidasucyate /
kiñciddātāpi cāṇḍālastasmādadhikatāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
नृणामाशाभिभूतानामाश्चर्यमिदसुच्यते /
किञ्चिद्दातापि चाण्डालस्तस्मादधिकतां गतः //
text_mt: This wonder is spoken of concerning men overcome by desire: / even an outcast who gives a little becomes superior to them.

sanskrit_iast:
āśābhibhūtā ye martyā mahāmohā mahoddhatāḥ /
avamānādikaṃ duḥkhaṃ na jānanti kadāpyaho //
meaning:
आशाभिभूता ये मर्त्या महामोहा महोद्धताः /
अवमानादिकं दुःखं न जानन्ति कदाप्यहो //
text_mt: Mortals overcome by desire, deeply deluded and exceedingly arrogant, / ah, never recognize the suffering of dishonor and the like!

sanskrit_iast:
mayāpyevaṃ bahukliśairetaddhanamupārjitam /
śarīramapi jīrṇaṃ ca jarasāpahataṃ balam //
meaning:
मयाप्येवं बहुक्लिशैरेतद्धनमुपार्जितम् /
शरीरमपि जीर्णं च जरसापहतं बलम् //
text_mt: Even so has this wealth been amassed by me through many hardships; / the body is worn out, and strength has been carried away by old age.

sanskrit_iast:
itaḥ paraṃ yatiṣyāmi paralokārthamādarāt /
evaṃ niścitya viprendra dharmamārga rato 'bhavat //
meaning:
इतः परं यतिष्यामि परलोकार्थमादरात् /
एवं निश्चित्य विप्रेन्द्र धर्ममार्ग रतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Henceforth I shall strive with care for the sake of the next world." / Having thus resolved, O best of brahmins, he became intent upon the path of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva taddhanaṃ sarvaṃ caturddhā vyabhajattathā /
svayaṃ tu bhāga dvitaya svārjitārthādapāharat //
meaning:
तदैव तद्धनं सर्वं चतुर्द्धा व्यभजत्तथा /
स्वयं तु भाग द्वितय स्वार्जितार्थादपाहरत् //
text_mt: Right then he divided all that wealth into four parts; / and he took for himself two parts from the wealth he had amassed,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ ca bhāgadvitayaṃ putrayorubhayordadau /
svenārjitānāṃ pāpānāṃ nāśaṃ kartumanāstadā //
meaning:
शेषं च भागद्वितयं पुत्रयोरुभयोर्ददौ /
स्वेनार्जितानां पापानां नाशं कर्तुमनास्तदा //
text_mt: and gave the remaining two parts to his two sons. / Intending at that time to bring about the destruction of the sins he had amassed,

sanskrit_iast:
prapātaḍāgārāmāṃśca tathā devagṛhānbahūn /
annādīnāṃ ca dānāni gaṅgātīre cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
प्रपातडागारामांश्च तथा देवगृहान्बहून् /
अन्नादीनां च दानानि गङ्गातीरे चकार सः //
text_mt: he constructed water-sheds, ponds, and groves, and likewise many temples of the gods, / and made gifts of food and the like on the bank of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhanamaśeṣaṃ ca viśrāṇya haribhaktimān /
nāranārāyaṇa sthānaṃ jagāma tapase vanam //
meaning:
एवं धनमशेषं च विश्राण्य हरिभक्तिमान् /
नारनारायण स्थानं जगाम तपसे वनम् //
text_mt: Having thus distributed all the wealth, full of devotion to Hari, / he went to the forest, the dwelling of Nara and Nārāyaṇa, for the purpose of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyanmahāramyamāśramaṃ munisevitam /
phalitaiḥ puṣaapitaiścaiva śobhitaṃ vṛkṣasaṃcayaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यन्महारम्यमाश्रमं मुनिसेवितम् /
फलितैः पुषअपितैश्चैव शोभितं वृक्षसंचयैः //
text_mt: There he saw a very delightful hermitage frequented by sages, / adorned with masses of trees bearing fruit and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛṇadbhiḥ paramaṃ brahma śāstracintāparaistathā /
paricaryāparairvṛddhairmunibhiḥ pariśobhitam //
meaning:
गृणद्भिः परमं ब्रह्म शास्त्रचिन्तापरैस्तथा /
परिचर्यापरैर्वृद्धैर्मुनिभिः परिशोभितम् //
text_mt: [An ashram] adorned by elderly sages who recited the supreme Brahman, / who were devoted to reflecting on the sacred scriptures, and intent on pious service;

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ tatra muniṃ jānanti saṃjñakam /
gṛṇantaṃ paramaṃ brahma tejorāśiṃ dadarśa ha //
meaning:
शिष्यैः परिवृतं तत्र मुनिं जानन्ति संज्ञकम् /
गृणन्तं परमं ब्रह्म तेजोराशिं ददर्श ह //
text_mt: There he beheld a sage named Jānanti, surrounded by disciples, / reciting the supreme Brahman—a mass of fiery splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
śamādiguṇasaṃyuktaṃ rāgādirahitaṃ munim /
śīrṇaparṇāśanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vedamālirnanāma tam //
meaning:
शमादिगुणसंयुक्तं रागादिरहितं मुनिम् /
शीर्णपर्णाशनं दृष्ट्वा वेदमालिर्ननाम तम् //
text_mt: Seeing that sage endowed with tranquillity and other virtues, free from passion and [its companion vices], / who fed on fallen leaves, Vedamālin bowed down to him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya jānantirāgantoḥ kalpayāmāsa cārhaṇam /
kandamūlaphalādyaistu nārāyaṇadhiyā mune //
meaning:
तस्य जानन्तिरागन्तोः कल्पयामास चार्हणम् /
कन्दमूलफलाद्यैस्तु नारायणधिया मुने //
text_mt: Jānanti prepared hospitality for the guest / with roots, fruits, and the like, O sage, regarding him with the thought of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtātithyakriyastena vedamālī kṛtāñjaliḥ /
vinayāvanato bhūtvā provāca vadatāṃ varam //
meaning:
कृतातिथ्यक्रियस्तेन वेदमाली कृताञ्जलिः /
विनयावनतो भूत्वा प्रोवाच वदतां वरम् //
text_mt: Having received hospitable rites from him, Vedamālin, with joined palms / and bowed down in humility, spoke to that foremost of eloquent men:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavankṛtakṛtyo 'smi vigataṃ kalmaṣaṃ mama /
māmuddhara mahābhāga jñānadānena paṇḍita //
meaning:
भगवन्कृतकृत्यो ऽस्मि विगतं कल्मषं मम /
मामुद्धर महाभाग ज्ञानदानेन पण्डित //
text_mt: “O venerable one, I have accomplished my purpose! My stain is gone. / Deliver me, O highly fortunate one, wise one, by the bestowal of knowledge!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastatastena jānantirmunisattamaḥ /
provāca prahasanvāgmī vedamāliṃ guṇānvitam //
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन जानन्तिर्मुनिसत्तमः /
प्रोवाच प्रहसन्वाग्मी वेदमालिं गुणान्वितम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed by him, Jānanti, the best of sages, / an eloquent speaker, smiled gently and said to the virtuous Vedamālin:

sanskrit_iast:
jānantiruvāca
śṛṇaṣva vipraśārdūla saṃsāracchedakāraṇam /
pravakṣyāmi samāsena durlabhaṃ tvakṛtātmanām //
meaning:
जानन्तिरुवाच
शृणष्व विप्रशार्दूल संसारच्छेदकारणम् /
प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन दुर्लभं त्वकृतात्मनाम् //
text_mt:
Jānanti said:
“Listen, O tiger among Brahmins, to the cause of severing worldly existence, / which I shall declare in brief, difficult to attain for those whose minds are undisciplined.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaja viṣṇuṃ paraṃ nityaṃ smara nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum /
parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ kadācidapi mā kṛthāḥ //
meaning:
भज विष्णुं परं नित्यं स्मर नारायणं प्रभुम् /
परापवादं पैशुन्यं कदाचिदपि मा कृथाः //
text_mt: Constantly worship the supreme Viṣṇu; remember the lord Nārāyaṇa. / Never engage in slandering others or in calumny.

sanskrit_iast:
paropakāranirataḥ sa dā bhava mahāmate /
haripūjāparaścaiva tyaja mūrkhasamāgamam //
meaning:
परोपकारनिरतः स दा भव महामते /
हरिपूजापरश्चैव त्यज मूर्खसमागमम् //
text_mt: Always be devoted to the welfare of others, O highly intelligent one; / be dedicated to the worship of Hari, and abandon the company of fools.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ ca madamatsarau /
parityajyātmavallokaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
कामं क्रोधं च लोभं च मोहं च मदमत्सरौ /
परित्यज्यात्मवल्लोकं दृष्ट्वा शान्तिं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Abandoning desire, anger, greed, delusion, arrogance, and envy, / and viewing the world as yourself, you will attain peace.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyāṃ paranindāṃ ca kadācidapi mā kuru /
draṃbhācāramahṝṅkāraṃ naiṣṭhuryaṃ ca parityaja //
meaning:
असूयां परनिन्दां च कदाचिदपि मा कुरु /
द्रंभाचारमहॄङ्कारं नैष्ठुर्यं च परित्यज //
text_mt: Never indulge in malice or censuring others; / renounce hypocritical conduct, egotism, and cruelty.

sanskrit_iast:
dayāṃ kuruṣva bhuteṣu śuśrūṣāṃ ca tathā satām /
tvayā kṛtāṃśca dharmānvai mā prakāśaya pucchatām //
meaning:
दयां कुरुष्व भुतेषु शुश्रूषां च तथा सताम् /
त्वया कृतांश्च धर्मान्वै मा प्रकाशय पुच्छताम् //
text_mt: Show compassion to living beings and attendance upon the virtuous; / and do not disclose to those who inquire the righteous deeds you have done.

sanskrit_iast:
anācāraparāndṛṣṭvā nopekṣāṃ kuru śaktitaḥ /
pūjayasvātiyiṃ nityaṃ svakuṭuṃbāvirodhataḥ //
meaning:
अनाचारपरान्दृष्ट्वा नोपेक्षां कुरु शक्तितः /
पूजयस्वातियिं नित्यं स्वकुटुंबाविरोधतः //
text_mt: Seeing those intent on improper conduct, do not be indifferent according to your ability. / Constantly honour a guest without causing hardship to your family.

sanskrit_iast:
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairvāpi dūrvābhiḥ pallavairatha /
pūjayasva jagannāthaṃ nārāyaṇamakāṃ mataḥ //
meaning:
पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैर्वापि दूर्वाभिः पल्लवैरथ /
पूजयस्व जगन्नाथं नारायणमकां मतः //
text_mt: With leaves, flowers, or fruits, or with dūrvā grass and shoots, / worship Nārāyaṇa, the lord of the world, free from selfish desires.

sanskrit_iast:
devānṛpīnpitṝścāpi tarpayasva yathāvidhi /
agreśca vidhivadvapra paricaryāparo bhava //
meaning:
देवानृपीन्पितॄश्चापि तर्पयस्व यथाविधि /
अग्रेश्च विधिवद्वप्र परिचर्यापरो भव //
text_mt: Offer water libations duly to gods, sages, and ancestors; / and, O Brahmin, be devoted to attending upon the fire in accordance with the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatane nityaṃ saṃmārjanaparo bhava /
tathopalepanaṃ caiva kuruṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
देवतायतने नित्यं संमार्जनपरो भव /
तथोपलेपनं चैव कुरुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: Always be intent on sweeping the temple of the deity, / and well-concentrated, perform plastering [its floor].

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṇasphaṭitasaṃdhānaṃ kuru devagṛhe sadā /
mārgaśobhāṃ ca dīpaṃ ca viṣṇorāyatane kuru //
meaning:
शीर्णस्फटितसंधानं कुरु देवगृहे सदा /
मार्गशोभां च दीपं च विष्णोरायतने कुरु //
text_mt: Always repair what is broken and cracked in the house of God; / make the approach path beautiful, and offer lamps in the temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kandamūlaphalairvāpi sadā pūjaya mādhavam /
pradakṣiṇanamaskāraiḥ stotrāṇāṃ paṭhanaistathā //
meaning:
कन्दमूलफलैर्वापि सदा पूजय माधवम् /
प्रदक्षिणनमस्कारैः स्तोत्राणां पठनैस्तथा //
text_mt: Constantly worship Mādhava with bulbs, roots, or fruits, / with circumambulations, prostrations, and the recitation of hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
yurāṇaśravaṇaṃ caiva purāṇapaṭhanaṃ tathā /
vedāntapaṭhanaṃ caiva pratyahaṃ kuru śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
युराणश्रवणं चैव पुराणपठनं तथा /
वेदान्तपठनं चैव प्रत्यहं कुरु शक्तितः //
text_mt: Hear the Purāṇas, recite the Purāṇas, / and recite the Vedānta every day according to your ability.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sthiti tava jñānaṃ bhaghaviṣyatyuttamottamam /
jñānātsamastapāpānāṃ mokṣo bhavati niścitam //
meaning:
एवं स्थिति तव ज्ञानं भघविष्यत्युत्तमोत्तमम् /
ज्ञानात्समस्तपापानां मोक्षो भवति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: In this condition, the most excellent knowledge will arise in you; / from knowledge, release from all sins is assuredly achieved.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabodhitastena vedamālirmahāmatiḥ /
tathā jñānarato nityaṃ jñānaleśamavāptavān //
meaning:
एवं प्रबोधितस्तेन वेदमालिर्महामतिः /
तथा ज्ञानरतो नित्यं ज्ञानलेशमवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Thus awakened by him, the highly intelligent Vedamālin, / ever intent on knowledge in that manner, attained a fraction of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamāliḥ kadācittu jñānaleśapracoditaḥ /
ko 'haṃ mama kriyā keti svayameva vyaktintayat //
meaning:
वेदमालिः कदाचित्तु ज्ञानलेशप्रचोदितः /
को ऽहं मम क्रिया केति स्वयमेव व्यक्तिन्तयत् //
text_mt: One day Vedamālin, impelled by that fraction of knowledge, / reflected within himself: “Who am I? What is my action?”

sanskrit_iast:
mama janma kathaṃ jātaṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛgvidhaṃ mama /
evaṃ vicāraṇaparoḥ divāniśamatandritaḥ //
meaning:
मम जन्म कथं जातं रूपं कीदृग्विधं मम /
एवं विचारणपरोः दिवानिशमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: “How did my birth come about? What kind of form is mine?” / Ever engaged in such inquiry, unwearied day and night,

sanskrit_iast:
aniścitamatirbhūtvā vedamālirddhijottamaḥ /
punarjānantimāgamya praṇamyedamuvāca ha //
meaning:
अनिश्चितमतिर्भूत्वा वेदमालिर्द्धिजोत्तमः /
पुनर्जानन्तिमागम्य प्रणम्येदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: with an unsettled mind, Vedamālin, the best of Brahmins, / approached Jānanti once again, bowed down, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
vedamāliruvāca
mama cittamatibhrātaṃ guro brahmavidāṃ vara /
ko 'haṃ mama kriyā kā ca mama janma kathaṃ vada //
meaning:
वेदमालिरुवाच
मम चित्तमतिभ्रातं गुरो ब्रह्मविदां वर /
को ऽहं मम क्रिया का च मम जन्म कथं वद //
text_mt:
Vedamālin said:
“My mind is deeply bewildered, O guru, best among knowers of Brahman! / Who am I? What is my action? And how did my birth occur? Tell me!”

sanskrit_iast:
jānantiruvāca
satyaṃ satyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ cittaṃ bhrātaṃ suniścitam /
avidyānilarya cittaṃ kathaṃ sadbhāvagagameṣyati //
meaning:
जानन्तिरुवाच
सत्यं सत्यं महाभागं चित्तं भ्रातं सुनिश्चितम् /
अविद्यानिलर्य चित्तं कथं सद्भावगगमेष्यति //
text_mt:
Jānanti said:
“Truly, truly, O highly fortunate one, the mind is thoroughly confused! / For how can a mind that is the abode of ignorance attain the true reality?

sanskrit_iast:
mameti gaditaṃ yattu tadapi bhrāntiriṣyate /
ahṝṅkāro manodharma ātmano nahi paṇḍita //
meaning:
ममेति गदितं यत्तु तदपि भ्रान्तिरिष्यते /
अहॄङ्कारो मनोधर्म आत्मनो नहि पण्डित //
text_mt: Even that which is called ‘mine’ is regarded as delusion; / egotism is a property of the mind, not of the Self, O wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca ko 'hamityuktaṃ vedamāle tvayā tu yat /
mama jātyādi śūnyasya kathaṃ nāma karomyaham //
meaning:
पुनश्च को ऽहमित्युक्तं वेदमाले त्वया तु यत् /
