मम जात्यादि शून्यस्य कथं नाम करोम्यहम् //
text_mt: Furthermore, as to what you asked, ‘Who am I?’, O Vedamālin: / how can I give a name to [the Self] that is devoid of caste, [birth], and the like?

sanskrit_iast:
anaupamyasvabhāvasya nirguṇasya parātmanaḥ /
nīrūpasyāprameyasya kathaṃ nāma karomyaham //
meaning:
अनौपम्यस्वभावस्य निर्गुणस्य परात्मनः /
नीरूपस्याप्रमेयस्य कथं नाम करोम्यहम् //
text_mt: To the supreme Self whose nature is incomparable, devoid of attributes, / formless, and immeasurable—how can I give a name?

sanskrit_iast:
parajyotiḥ svarūpasya paripūrṇāvyayātmanaḥ /
avicchinnasvabhāvasya kathyate ca kathaṃ kriyā //
meaning:
परज्योतिः स्वरूपस्य परिपूर्णाव्ययात्मनः /
अविच्छिन्नस्वभावस्य कथ्यते च कथं क्रिया //
text_mt: To that whose essential form is supreme light, the complete, immutable Self, / whose nature is unbroken—how can action be predicated?

sanskrit_iast:
svaprakāśātmano vipra nityasya paramātmanaḥ /
anantasya kriyā caiva kathaṃ janma ca kathyate //
meaning:
स्वप्रकाशात्मनो विप्र नित्यस्य परमात्मनः /
अनन्तस्य क्रिया चैव कथं जन्म च कथ्यते //
text_mt: Of the supreme Self, self-luminous, eternal, / and infinite, O Brahmin, how can action or birth be spoken of?

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaikavedyamajaraṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam /
paripūrṇaṃ parānandaṃ tasmānnānyadiha dvija //
meaning:
ज्ञानैकवेद्यमजरं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
परिपूर्णं परानन्दं तस्मान्नान्यदिह द्विज //
text_mt: The ageless, supreme Brahman is known by knowledge alone; it is eternal, / complete, and supreme bliss; other than that there is nothing here, O Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvamasyādivākyebhyo jñānaṃ mokṣasya sādhanam /
jñāne tvanāhate siddhe sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्येभ्यो ज्ञानं मोक्षस्य साधनम् /
ज्ञाने त्वनाहते सिद्धे सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं भवेत् //
text_mt: From statements such as ‘Thou art that’ arises knowledge, the means to liberation; / when that pure knowledge is accomplished, everything becomes Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabodhitastena vedamālirmunīśvara /
mumoda paśyannātmānamātmanyevācyutaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
एवं प्रबोधितस्तेन वेदमालिर्मुनीश्वर /
मुमोद पश्यन्नात्मानमात्मन्येवाच्युतं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Thus awakened by him, O lord of sages, Vedamālin / rejoiced, seeing the Self, the lord Acyuta, within the Self alone.

sanskrit_iast:
upādhirahitaṃ brahma svaprakāśaṃ nirañjanam /
ahameveti niścitya parāṃ śāntimavāptavān //
meaning:
उपाधिरहितं ब्रह्म स्वप्रकाशं निरञ्जनम् /
अहमेवेति निश्चित्य परां शान्तिमवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Ascertaining ‘I alone am Brahman, free from conditioning adjuncts, self-luminous, and taintless,’ / he attained supreme peace.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca vyavahārārthaṃ vedamālirmunīśvaram /
guruṃ praṇamya jānanti sadā dhyānaparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
ततश्च व्यवहारार्थं वेदमालिर्मुनीश्वरम् /
गुरुं प्रणम्य जानन्ति सदा ध्यानपरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Then, for the sake of practical conduct, Vedamālin, / having bowed down to his guru Jānanti, best among sages, remained ever devoted to meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
gate bahutithe kāle vedamālirmunīśva /
vārāṇasīpuraṃ prāpya paraṃ mokṣamavāptavān //
meaning:
गते बहुतिथे काले वेदमालिर्मुनीश्व /
वाराणसीपुरं प्राप्य परं मोक्षमवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: When a long period of time had elapsed, Vedamālin, O lord of sages, / reached the city of Vārāṇasī and attained supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ /
sa karmapāśavicchedaṃ prāpya saukhyamavānpuyāt //
iti śrībṛhannārādīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde jñānanirūpaṇa nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इमं पठते ऽध्यायं शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः /
स कर्मपाशविच्छेदं प्राप्य सौख्यमवान्पुयात् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारादीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे ज्ञाननिरूपण नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever recites this chapter or hears it with concentrated mind / shall sever the bondage of karma and attain happiness.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, named ‘Exposition of Knowledge’, in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
vedamāleḥ sutau proktau yāvubhau munisattama /
yajñamālī sumālī ca tayoḥ karmādhunocyata //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
वेदमालेः सुतौ प्रोक्तौ यावुभौ मुनिसत्तम /
यज्ञमाली सुमाली च तयोः कर्माधुनोच्यत //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
“The two sons of Vedamālin who were mentioned, O best of sages— / Yajñamālin and Sumālin—their conduct is now described.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorādyo yajñamālī vibheda pitṛsaṃcitam /
dhanaṃ dvidhā kaniṣṭasya bhāgamekaṃ dadau tadā //
meaning:
तयोराद्यो यज्ञमाली विभेद पितृसंचितम् /
धनं द्विधा कनिष्टस्य भागमेकं ददौ तदा //
text_mt: The elder of them, Yajñamālin, divided the wealth accumulated by their father / into two parts and gave one share to his younger brother.

sanskrit_iast:
sumālī ca dhanaṃ sarvaṃ vyasanābhirakataḥ sadā /
apādānā dibhiścaiva nāśayāmāsa bho dvija //
meaning:
सुमाली च धनं सर्वं व्यसनाभिरकतः सदा /
अपादाना दिभिश्चैव नाशयामास भो द्विज //
text_mt: And Sumālin, constantly addicted to vices, O Brahmin, / squandered all that wealth through inappropriate gifts and other means.

sanskrit_iast:
gītavādyarato nityaṃ madyapānarato 'bhavat /
veśyāvibhramalubdho 'sau paradārato 'bhavat //
meaning:
गीतवाद्यरतो नित्यं मद्यपानरतो ऽभवत् /
वेश्याविभ्रमलुब्धो ऽसौ परदारतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Always devoted to singing and instrumental music, he indulged in drinking wine; / infatuated by the charms of prostitutes, he committed adultery with others' wives.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasminnāśamāyāte hiraṇye pitṛsaṃcite /
apahṛtya paraṃ dravyaṃ vārastrīnirato 'bhavat //
meaning:
सर्वस्मिन्नाशमायाते हिरण्ये पितृसंचिते /
अपहृत्य परं द्रव्यं वारस्त्रीनिरतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: When all the gold accumulated by his father had been completely exhausted, / he stole other people's property and remained devoted to courtesans.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sumālinaḥ śūlaṃ yajñamālī mahāmatiḥ /
babhūva duḥkhito 'tyarthaṃ bhrātaraṃ cedamabravīt //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सुमालिनः शूलं यज्ञमाली महामतिः /
बभूव दुःखितो ऽत्यर्थं भ्रातरं चेदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Seeing the wicked nature of Sumālin, the highly intelligent Yajñamālin / became exceedingly grieved and said to his brother:

sanskrit_iast:
alamamatyantakaṣṭena vṛttenāsmatkule 'nuja /
tvameka eva duṣṭātmā mahāpāparato 'bhavaḥ //
meaning:
अलममत्यन्तकष्टेन वृत्तेनास्मत्कुले ऽनुज /
त्वमेक एव दुष्टात्मा महापापरतो ऽभवः //
text_mt: ‘Enough of such deeply shameful conduct in our family, younger brother! / You alone are wicked-minded, devoted to terrible sin!’

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nivārayantaṃ taṃ bahuśo jyeṣṭasodaram /
haniṣyāmīti niścitya khaḍgahastaḥ kace 'grahīt //
meaning:
एवं निवारयन्तं तं बहुशो ज्येष्टसोदरम् /
हनिष्यामीति निश्चित्य खड्गहस्तः कचे ऽग्रहीत् //
text_mt: As he repeatedly restrained him thus, [Sumālin], sword in hand, / seized his elder brother by the hair, resolved: ‘I will kill him!’”

sanskrit_iast:
tato mahāravo jajñe nagare bhṛśadāruṇaḥ /
babandhurnāgarāścainaṃ kupitāste sumālinam //
meaning:
ततो महारवो जज्ञे नगरे भृशदारुणः /
बबन्धुर्नागराश्चैनं कुपितास्ते सुमालिनम् //
text_mt: Then a very dreadful, great outcry arose in the city; / and those citizens, enraged, bound Sumālī.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālī hyameyātmā paurānsaṃprārthya duḥkhitaḥ /
bandhanānmocayāmāsa bhrātṛsnehavimohitaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञमाली ह्यमेयात्मा पौरान्संप्रार्थ्य दुःखितः /
बन्धनान्मोचयामास भ्रातृस्नेहविमोहितः //
text_mt: Yajñamālī of boundless soul, grieved, entreated the citizens, / and, infatuated by love for his brother, released him from captivity.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālī punaścāpi bibhide svadhanaṃ dvidhā /
ādade svayamarddhaṃ ca dadāvarddhaṃ yavīyase //
meaning:
यज्ञमाली पुनश्चापि बिभिदे स्वधनं द्विधा /
आददे स्वयमर्द्धं च ददावर्द्धं यवीयसे //
text_mt: And Yajñamālī further divided his wealth into two parts: / he himself took one half, and gave the other half to his younger brother.

sanskrit_iast:
sumālī tvatimūḍhātmā taddhanaṃ cāpi nārada /
mūrkhaiḥ pāraṃvaḍacaṇḍālairbubhuje ca sahoddhataḥ //
meaning:
सुमाली त्वतिमूढात्मा तद्धनं चापि नारद /
मूर्खैः पारंवडचण्डालैर्बुभुजे च सहोद्धतः //
text_mt: Sumālī, however, utterly foolish, O Nārada, / arrogantly squandered that wealth with fools, outcasts, and cāṇḍālas.

sanskrit_iast:
asatāmupabho gāya durjanānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ /
picumandaḥ phalāḍhyo 'pi kākairevopabhujyate //
meaning:
असतामुपभो गाय दुर्जनानां विभूतयः /
पिचुमन्दः फलाढ्यो ऽपि काकैरेवोपभुज्यते //
text_mt: The riches of wicked people are for the enjoyment of the unrighteous; / the neem tree, though full of fruit, is eaten only by crows.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātrā dattaṃ dhanaṃ tañca sumālī nāśayanmune /
madyapānapramattaśca gomāṃsā dīnyabhakṣayat //
meaning:
भ्रात्रा दत्तं धनं तञ्च सुमाली नाशयन्मुने /
मद्यपानप्रमत्तश्च गोमांसा दीन्यभक्षयत् //
text_mt: Wasting the wealth given by his brother, O sage, / Sumālī, drunk from drinking wine, ate beef and other [forbidden foods].

sanskrit_iast:
tyakto bandhujanaiḥ sarvaiścāṇḍālastrīsamanvitaḥ /
rājñāpi bādhito vipraprapede nirjanaṃ vanam //
meaning:
त्यक्तो बन्धुजनैः सर्वैश्चाण्डालस्त्रीसमन्वितः /
राज्ञापि बाधितो विप्रप्रपेदे निर्जनं वनम् //
text_mt: Forsaken by all his kinsmen, accompanied by an outcast cāṇḍāla woman, / and expelled by the king, O brāhmaṇa, he took refuge in a deserted forest.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālī sudhīrvipra sadā dharmarato 'bhavet /
avāritaṃ dadāvannaṃ satsaṅgagatakalmaṣaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञमाली सुधीर्विप्र सदा धर्मरतो ऽभवेत् /
अवारितं ददावन्नं सत्सङ्गगतकल्मषः //
text_mt: Wise Yajñamālī, O brāhmaṇa, was always devoted to dharma; / with his sins removed by good association, he gave food without restriction.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā kṛtāni sarvāṇi taḍāgādīni sattama /
apālayatprayatnena sadā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
पित्रा कृतानि सर्वाणि तडागादीनि सत्तम /
अपालयत्प्रयत्नेन सदा धर्मपरायणः //
text_mt: All the reservoirs and other works made by his father, O best of men, / he carefully maintained, ever dedicated to dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāṇitaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yajñamālermahātmanaḥ /
satpātradānaniṣṭasya dharmamārgapravartinaḥ //
meaning:
विश्राणितं धनं सर्वं यज्ञमालेर्महात्मनः /
सत्पात्रदाननिष्टस्य धर्ममार्गप्रवर्तिनः //
text_mt: All the wealth of high-souled Yajñamālī was given away, / steadfast as he was in gifts to worthy recipients, proceeding along the path of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
aho sadupabhogāya sajjanānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ /
kalpavṛkṣaphalaṃ sarvamamaraireva bhujyate //
meaning:
अहो सदुपभोगाय सज्जनानां विभूतयः /
कल्पवृक्षफलं सर्वममरैरेव भुज्यते //
text_mt: Ah! The wealth of good people is for good enjoyment; / the entire fruit of the wish-fulfilling tree is consumed only by the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ viśrāṇya dharmārthaṃ yajñamālī mahāmatiḥ /
nityaṃ viṣṇugṛhe samyakparicaryyāparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
धनं विश्राण्य धर्मार्थं यज्ञमाली महामतिः /
नित्यं विष्णुगृहे सम्यक्परिचर्य्यापरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Having bestowed his wealth for the sake of dharma, the highly intelligent Yajñamālī / was constantly and properly devoted to service in the temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kālena gacchatā tau tu vṛddhabhāvamupāgatau /
yajñamālī sumālī ca hyekakāle mṛtāvubhau //
meaning:
कालेन गच्छता तौ तु वृद्धभावमुपागतौ /
यज्ञमाली सुमाली च ह्येककाले मृतावुभौ //
text_mt: With the passage of time, the two of them reached old age; / and both Yajñamālī and Sumālī died at the very same time.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāratasyāsya yajñamālimahātmanaḥ /
hariḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa vimānaṃ pārṣadā vṛtam //
meaning:
हरिपूजारतस्यास्य यज्ञमालिमहात्मनः /
हरिः संप्रेषयामास विमानं पार्षदा वृतम् //
text_mt: For this high-souled Yajñamālī, who was devoted to the worship of Hari, / Hari sent an aerial chariot surrounded by his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya yajñamālī mahāmatiḥ /
pūjyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ stūyamāno munīśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य यज्ञमाली महामतिः /
पूज्यमानः सुरगणैः स्तूयमानो मुनीश्वरैः //
text_mt: Ascending the celestial chariot, the highly intelligent Yajñamālī, / worshipped by hosts of gods and praised by sovereign sages,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvairgīyamānaśca sevitaścāpsarogaṇaiḥ /
kāmadhenvā puṣyamāṇaścitrābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानश्च सेवितश्चाप्सरोगणैः /
कामधेन्वा पुष्यमाणश्चित्राभरणभूषितः //
text_mt: sung to by gandharvas and attended by hosts of apsarases, / nourished by Kāmadhenu and adorned with varied ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
komalaistulasīmālyairbhūṣitastejasāṃ nidhiḥ /
gacchanviṣṇupadaṃ divyaṃmanujaṃ pathi dṛṣṭavān //
meaning:
कोमलैस्तुलसीमाल्यैर्भूषितस्तेजसां निधिः /
गच्छन्विष्णुपदं दिव्यंमनुजं पथि दृष्टवान् //
text_mt: adorned with delicate tulasī garlands, a repository of splendours, / going to the celestial realm of Viṣṇu, saw a man upon the road:

sanskrit_iast:
tāhyamānaṃ yamabhaṭaiḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ paripīḍitam /
pretabhūtaṃ vivastraṃ ca duḥkhitaṃ pāśaveṣṭitam /
itastataḥ prādhāvantaṃ vilapantamanāthavat //
meaning:
ताह्यमानं यमभटैः क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां परिपीडितम् /
प्रेतभूतं विवस्त्रं च दुःखितं पाशवेष्टितम् /
इतस्ततः प्राधावन्तं विलपन्तमनाथवत् //
text_mt: beaten by Yama's soldiers, afflicted by hunger and thirst, / turned into a ghost, naked, wretched, bound with cords, / running hither and thither, lamenting like a helpless orphan.

sanskrit_iast: krośantaṃ ca sudantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā manasi vivyathe //
meaning: क्रोशन्तं च सुदन्तं च दृष्ट्वा मनसि विव्यथे //
text_mt: Seeing him weeping loudly and crying bitterly, his heart was pained.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālīdayāyukto viṣṇudūtānsamīpagān /
ko 'yaṃ bhaṭairbādhyamānaṃ ityapṛcchatkṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञमालीदयायुक्तो विष्णुदूतान्समीपगान् /
को ऽयं भटैर्बाध्यमानं इत्यपृच्छत्कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Yajñamālī, moved with compassion, with joined palms / asked Viṣṇu's messengers who were near: "Who is this man being tormented by the soldiers?"

sanskrit_iast:
atha te haridūtāstaṃ yajñamālimahaujasam /
asau sumālī bhrātā te pāpātmeti samabruvan //
meaning:
अथ ते हरिदूतास्तं यज्ञमालिमहौजसम् /
असौ सुमाली भ्राता ते पापात्मेति समब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Then those messengers of Hari said to the immensely powerful Yajñamālī: / "This is your sinful brother Sumālī."

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālī samākarṇya vyākhyātaṃ viṣṇukiṅkaraiḥ /
manasā duḥkhamāpannaḥ punaḥ papraccha nārada //
meaning:
यज्ञमाली समाकर्ण्य व्याख्यातं विष्णुकिङ्करैः /
मनसा दुःखमापन्नः पुनः पप्रच्छ नारद //
text_mt: Hearing the explanation given by Viṣṇu's servants, / Yajñamālī became sorrowful at heart, and asked again, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
kathamasya bhavenmokṣaḥ sāṃcitaiḥ pāpasaṃcayaiḥ /
tadupāyaṃbadadhvaṃ me yūyaṃ hi mamabāndhavāḥ //
meaning:
कथमस्य भवेन्मोक्षः सांचितैः पापसंचयैः /
तदुपायंबदध्वं मे यूयं हि ममबान्धवाः //
text_mt: "How can there be liberation for him from his accumulated heaps of sins? / Tell me the means for that, for you are indeed my kin.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhyaṃ sāptapadīnaṃ syādityāhurdharmakovidāḥ /
satāṃ sāptapadī maitrī satsatāṃ tripadī tathā //
meaning:
सख्यं साप्तपदीनं स्यादित्याहुर्धर्मकोविदाः /
सतां साप्तपदी मैत्री सत्सतां त्रिपदी तथा //
text_mt: Those who know dharma say that friendship takes place upon seven paces; / the friendship of the virtuous is formed in seven paces, and that of the very virtuous in three paces;

sanskrit_iast: satsatāmapi ye saṃtasteṣāṃ maitraghī pade pade //
meaning: सत्सतामपि ये संतस्तेषां मैत्रघी पदे पदे //
text_mt: and of those who are the virtuous among the virtuous, friendship forms at every single step.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānme bāndhavā yūyaṃ māṃ netuṃ samupāgatāḥ /
yato 'yaṃ mama bhrātāpi mucyate tadihocyatām //
meaning:
तस्मान्मे बान्धवा यूयं मां नेतुं समुपागताः /
यतो ऽयं मम भ्रातापि मुच्यते तदिहोच्यताम् //
text_mt: Therefore, you who have come to lead me away are my kin. / Tell me here how this brother of mine too may be liberated."

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālivacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇudūtā dayālavaḥ /
punaḥ smitāmukhāḥ procuryajñamāliharipriyam //
meaning:
यज्ञमालिवचः श्रुत्वा विष्णुदूता दयालवः /
पुनः स्मितामुखाः प्रोचुर्यज्ञमालिहरिप्रियम् //
text_mt: Hearing the words of Yajñamālī, the compassionate messengers of Viṣṇu, / their faces smiling, spoke once again to Yajñamālī, beloved of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇudūtā ūcuḥ
yajñamālinmahābhāga nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa /
upāyaṃ tava vakṣyāmaḥ sumālipremamuktidam //
meaning:
विष्णुदूता ऊचुः
यज्ञमालिन्महाभाग नारायणपरायण /
उपायं तव वक्ष्यामः सुमालिप्रेममुक्तिदम् //
text_mt: The messengers of Viṣṇu said: / "O highly fortunate Yajñamālī, dedicated to Nārāyaṇa, / we shall tell you the means that will lovingly bestow liberation upon Sumālī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ yatsumahatkarma tvayā prāktanajanmani /
pravakṣyāmaḥ samāsena tacchraṇuṣva samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कृतं यत्सुमहत्कर्म त्वया प्राक्तनजन्मनि /
प्रवक्ष्यामः समासेन तच्छ्रणुष्व समाहितः //
text_mt: We shall explain briefly the great deed done by you / in your previous birth; listen to it attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
purā tvaṃ vaiśyajātīyo nāmnā viśvaṅghabharaḥ smṛtaḥ /
tvayā kṛtāni pāpāni ahantyagaṇitāni vai //
meaning:
पुरा त्वं वैश्यजातीयो नाम्ना विश्वङ्घभरः स्मृतः /
त्वया कृतानि पापानि अहन्त्यगणितानि वै //
text_mt: Formerly you belonged to the vaiśya caste, known by the name of Viśvaṅghabhara; / by you were committed sins, day and night, without count.

sanskrit_iast:
sukarmavāsanāhīno mātāpitrorvirodhakṛt /
ekadā bandhubhistyaktaḥ śokasaṃtāpapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
सुकर्मवासनाहीनो मातापित्रोर्विरोधकृत् /
एकदा बन्धुभिस्त्यक्तः शोकसंतापपीडितः //
text_mt: Lacking any inclination for virtuous action, causing conflict with your parents, / you were once abandoned by your kinsmen, afflicted by grief and torment.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣudhāgnināpi saṃtaptaḥ prāptavānharimandiram /
tadā vṛṣṭirabhūttatra tatsthānaṃ paṅkilaṃ hyabhūta //
meaning:
क्षुधाग्निनापि संतप्तः प्राप्तवान्हरिमन्दिरम् /
तदा वृष्टिरभूत्तत्र तत्स्थानं पङ्किलं ह्यभूत //
text_mt: Tormented also by the fire of hunger, you reached a temple of Hari; / then rain fell there, and that place became muddy.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrīkṛtastvayā paṅkastatsthāne sthātumicchayā /
upalepanatāṃ prāptaṃ tatsthānaṃ viṣṇumandire //
tvayoṣitaṃ tu tadgātrau tasmindevālaye dvija /
daṃśitaścaiva sarpeṇa prāptaṃ pañcatvameva ca //
tena puṇyaprabhāvena upalepakṛtena ca /
viprajanma tvayā prāptaṃ hari bhaktistathācalā //
meaning:
दीरीकृतस्त्वया पङ्कस्तत्स्थाने स्थातुमिच्छया /
उपलेपनतां प्राप्तं तत्स्थानं विष्णुमन्दिरे //
त्वयोषितं तु तद्गात्रौ तस्मिन्देवालये द्विज /
दंशितश्चैव सर्पेण प्राप्तं पञ्चत्वमेव च //
तेन पुण्यप्रभावेन उपलेपकृतेन च /
विप्रजन्म त्वया प्राप्तं हरि भक्तिस्तथाचला //
text_mt:
The mud was cleared away by you with the wish to rest in that spot; / in that temple of Viṣṇu, that spot was thus smeared clean.

You remained in that divine temple that night, O twice-born; / bitten by a serpent, you met your demise.

Through the power of that merit produced by the smearing, / you attained birth as a brāhmaṇa, as well as unshakeable devotion to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ saṃprāpya harisannidhim /
vasādya jñānamāsādya paraṃ mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं संप्राप्य हरिसन्निधिम् /
वसाद्य ज्ञानमासाद्य परं मोक्षं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Reaching the presence of Hari for a full hundred crore kalpas, / dwell there, and obtaining knowledge, you will attain supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
anujaṃ pātakiśreṣṭhaṃ tvaṃ samuddharttamicchasi /
upāyaṃ tava vakṣyāmastaṃ nibodha mahāmate //
meaning:
अनुजं पातकिश्रेष्ठं त्वं समुद्धर्त्तमिच्छसि /
उपायं तव वक्ष्यामस्तं निबोध महामते //
text_mt: You wish to deliver your younger brother, the foremost among sinners; / we shall tell you the means for it: understand it, O highly intelligent one!

sanskrit_iast:
gocarmamātrabhūmestu upalepanajaṃ phalam /
dattvoddhara mahābhāga bhrātaraṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
गोचर्ममात्रभूमेस्तु उपलेपनजं फलम् /
दत्त्वोद्धर महाभाग भ्रातरं कृपयान्वितः //
text_mt: Bestow the fruit born of smearing a piece of ground merely the size of a cowhide, / and full of compassion, deliver your brother, O highly fortunate one!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto viṣṇudūtairyajñamālī mahāpatiḥ /
tatphalaṃ pradadau tasmai bhrātre pāpavimuktaye //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो विष्णुदूतैर्यज्ञमाली महापतिः /
तत्फलं प्रददौ तस्मै भ्रात्रे पापविमुक्तये //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the messengers of Viṣṇu, the high-minded Yajñamālī / gave that fruit to his brother for his liberation from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sumālī bhrātṛdattena puṇyena gatakalmaṣaḥ /
babhūva yamadūtāstu taṃ tyaktvā prapalāyitāḥ //
meaning:
सुमाली भ्रातृदत्तेन पुण्येन गतकल्मषः /
बभूव यमदूतास्तु तं त्यक्त्वा प्रपलायिताः //
text_mt: Sumālī, freed from sin through the merit given by his brother, / was delivered, and the messengers of Yama, abandoning him, fled.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānaṃ cāgataṃ sadyaḥ sarvabhogasamanvitam /
tadā sumālī svaryānamāruhya mumude mune //
meaning:
विमानं चागतं सद्यः सर्वभोगसमन्वितम् /
तदा सुमाली स्वर्यानमारुह्य मुमुदे मुने //
text_mt: And instantly an aerial chariot arrived, endowed with all luxuries; / then Sumālī, mounting the celestial chariot, rejoiced, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvubhau bhrātarau vipra suravṛndanamaskṛtau /
avāpaturbhṛśaṃ prītiṃ samāliṅgya parasparam //
meaning:
तावुभौ भ्रातरौ विप्र सुरवृन्दनमस्कृतौ /
अवापतुर्भृशं प्रीतिं समालिङ्ग्य परस्परम् //
text_mt: Both brothers, O brāhmaṇa, saluted by the assembly of gods, / experienced great joy, having embraced one another.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñamālī sumālī ca stūyamānau maharṣibhiḥ /
gīyamānau ca gandharvairviṣṇulokaṃ prajagmatuḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञमाली सुमाली च स्तूयमानौ महर्षिभिः /
गीयमानौ च गन्धर्वैर्विष्णुलोकं प्रजग्मतुः //
text_mt: Yajñamālī and Sumālī, praised by great ṛṣis / and sung to by gandharvas, proceeded to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya harisālokyaṃ sumālī munisattama /
yajñamālī coṣatustau kalpamekaṃ mudānvitau //
meaning:
अवाप्य हरिसालोक्यं सुमाली मुनिसत्तम /
यज्ञमाली चोषतुस्तौ कल्पमेकं मुदान्वितौ //
text_mt: Attaining residence in the same realm as Hari, O best of sages, / both Sumālī and Yajñamālī lived for an entire kalpa, full of joy.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā bhogānbahūṃstatra yajñamālī mahāmatiḥ /
tatraiva jñānasaṃpannaḥ paraṃ mokṣamupāgataḥ //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा भोगान्बहूंस्तत्र यज्ञमाली महामतिः /
तत्रैव ज्ञानसंपन्नः परं मोक्षमुपागतः //
text_mt: Having enjoyed many pleasures there, the highly intelligent Yajñamālī, / endowed with knowledge right there, reached supreme liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sumālī tu mahābhāgo viṣṇuloke mudānvitaḥ /
sthitvā bhūmiṃ punaḥ prāpya vipratvaṃ samupāgataḥ //
meaning:
सुमाली तु महाभागो विष्णुलोके मुदान्वितः /
स्थित्वा भूमिं पुनः प्राप्य विप्रत्वं समुपागतः //
text_mt: Sumālī, the highly fortunate, dwelling with joy in the world of Viṣṇu, / returned to the earth and attained the status of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
atiśuddhe kule jāto guṇavānvedapāragaḥ /
sarvasaṃpatsamopeto haribhaktiparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अतिशुद्धे कुले जातो गुणवान्वेदपारगः /
सर्वसंपत्समोपेतो हरिभक्तिपरायणः //
text_mt: Born into an exceedingly pure family, virtuous, master of the Vedas, / endowed with all fortunes, he was devoted to devotion to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāharanharināmāni prapede jāhnavītaṭam /
tatra snātaśca gaṅgāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ prabhum //
meaning:
व्याहरन्हरिनामानि प्रपेदे जाह्नवीतटम् /
तत्र स्नातश्च गङ्गायां दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Chanting the names of Hari, he reached the bank of the Jāhnavī; / having bathed there in the Gaṅgā and beheld Lord Viśveśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ yogināmapi durlabham /
upalepanamāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ te munīśvara //
meaning:
अवाप परमं स्थानं योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् /
उपलेपनमाहात्म्यं कथितं ते मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: he attained the supreme state, difficult to reach even for yogins. / The eulogy of the greatness of smearing [a temple] has thus been told to you, O sovereign sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃpūjyo jagatāṃpatiḥ /
akāmādapi ye viṣṇoḥ sakṛtpūjāṃ prakurvate //
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संपूज्यो जगतांपतिः /
अकामादपि ये विष्णोः सकृत्पूजां प्रकुर्वते //
text_mt: Therefore, the Lord of the worlds should be worshipped with every effort. / Even without desire, those who worship Viṣṇu even once,

sanskrit_iast:
na teṣāṃ bhavabandhastu kadācidapi jāyate /
haribhaktiratānyastu haribuddhyā samarcayet //
meaning:
न तेषां भवबन्धस्तु कदाचिदपि जायते /
हरिभक्तिरतान्यस्तु हरिबुद्ध्या समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: never again experience the bondage of worldly existence. / Moreover, one who worships those devoted to devotion to Hari, viewing them as Hari himself,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tuṣyanti viprendra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
haribhaktiparāṇāṃ tu saṃgināṃ saṃgamātrataḥ //
meaning:
तस्य तुष्यन्ति विप्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः /
हरिभक्तिपराणां तु संगिनां संगमात्रतः //
text_mt: pleases Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, O best of brahmins. / Merely through contact with those who associate with people devoted to Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mahāpātakavānapi /
haripūjāparāṇāṃ ca harināmaratātmanām //
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो महापातकवानपि /
हरिपूजापराणां च हरिनामरतात्मनाम् //
text_mt: even one guilty of a mortal sin is freed from all sins. / And for those devoted to serving those intent on Viṣṇu's worship

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣāniratā yānti pāpino 'pi parāṃ gatim //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde viṣṇusevāprabhāvo nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
शुश्रूषानिरता यान्ति पापिनो ऽपि परां गतिम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे विष्णुसेवाप्रभावो नाम षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
and devoted in mind to Hari's name, even sinners attain the supreme destination.

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Power of Service to Viṣṇu', in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
bhūyaḥ śṛṇuṣva viprendra māhātmyaṃ kamalāpateḥ /
kasya no jāyate prītiḥ śrotuṃ harikathāmṛtam //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
भूयः शृणुष्व विप्रेन्द्र माहात्म्यं कमलापतेः /
कस्य नो जायते प्रीतिः श्रोतुं हरिकथामृतम् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Listen again, O best of brahmins, to the eulogy of greatness of the consort of Kamalā. / In whom does love not arise to hear the nectar of Hari’s tales?

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāṃ viṣayāndhānāṃ mamatākulacetasām /
ekameva harernāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
नराणां विषयान्धानां ममताकुलचेतसाम् /
एकमेव हरेर्नाम सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: For men who are blind to sense objects and whose minds are troubled by possessiveness, / the single name of Hari alone destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdvā na namedyastu viṣṇuṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇām /
śvapacaṃ taṃ vijānīyātkadācinnālapeñca tam //
meaning:
सकृद्वा न नमेद्यस्तु विष्णुं पापहरं नृणाम् /
श्वपचं तं विजानीयात्कदाचिन्नालपेञ्च तम् //
text_mt: He who does not bow even once to Viṣṇu, the destroyer of men’s sins, / one should know him as a dog-cooker; one should never even converse with him.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāvihīnaṃ tu yasya veśma dvijottama /
śmaśānasadṛśaṃ taddhi kadācidapi no viśet //
meaning:
हरिपूजाविहीनं तु यस्य वेश्म द्विजोत्तम /
श्मशानसदृशं तद्धि कदाचिदपि नो विशेत् //
text_mt: The house of a man that is devoid of the worship of Hari, O best of the twice-born, / is indeed like a cremation ground; one should never enter it.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāvihīnāśca vedavidveṣiṇastathā /
godvijadveṣaniratā rākṣasāḥ parikīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
हरिपूजाविहीनाश्च वेदविद्वेषिणस्तथा /
गोद्विजद्वेषनिरता राक्षसाः परिकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: Those devoid of the worship of Hari, and likewise those who despise the Vedas, / intent on hostility toward cows and brahmins, are declared to be rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vā ko vāpi viprendra vipradveṣaparāyaṇaḥ /
samarcayati govindaṃ tatpūjā viphalā bhavet //
meaning:
यो वा को वापि विप्रेन्द्र विप्रद्वेषपरायणः /
समर्चयति गोविन्दं तत्पूजा विफला भवेत् //
text_mt: Whoever he may be, O best of brahmins, if devoted to hostility toward brahmins, / he worships Govinda, that worship of his becomes fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
anyaśreyovināśārthaṃ yer'cayanti janārdanam /
sā pūjaiva mahābhāga pūjakānāśu hṝnti vai //
meaning:
अन्यश्रेयोविनाशार्थं येर्ऽचयन्ति जनार्दनम् /
सा पूजैव महाभाग पूजकानाशु हॄन्ति वै //
text_mt: Those who worship Janārdana for the sake of destroying another’s welfare, / that very worship, O fortunate one, swiftly slays the worshippers.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjākaro yastu yadi pāpaṃ samācaret /
tameva viṣmudveṣṭāraṃ prāhustattvārtthakovidāḥ //
meaning:
हरिपूजाकरो यस्तु यदि पापं समाचरेत् /
तमेव विष्मुद्वेष्टारं प्राहुस्तत्त्वार्त्थकोविदाः //
text_mt: If someone who performs the worship of Hari should commit sin, / the knowers of the truth proclaim him to be an actual hater of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ye viṣṇuniratāḥ saṃti lokānugrahatatparāḥ /
dharmakāryaratāḥ śaśvadviṣṇurupāstu te matāḥ //
meaning:
ये विष्णुनिरताः संति लोकानुग्रहतत्पराः /
धर्मकार्यरताः शश्वद्विष्णुरुपास्तु ते मताः //
text_mt: Those who are devoted to Viṣṇu, intent upon doing grace to the world, / constantly engaged in virtuous deeds—they are considered forms of Viṣṇu Himself.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭijanmārdajitaiḥ puṇyairviṣṇubhaktiḥ prajāyate /
dṛḍhabhaktimatāṃ viṣṇau pāpabuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
कोटिजन्मार्दजितैः पुण्यैर्विष्णुभक्तिः प्रजायते /
दृढभक्तिमतां विष्णौ पापबुद्धिः कथं भवेत् //
text_mt: Devotion to Viṣṇu arises from merit accumulated over ten million births; / how could a sinful intention arise in those who have firm devotion to Viṣṇu?

sanskrit_iast:
janmakoṭyarjitaṃ pāpaṃ viṣṇupūjāratātmanām /
kṣayaṃ yāti kṣaṇādeva teṣāṃ syātpāpadhīḥ katham //
meaning:
जन्मकोट्यर्जितं पापं विष्णुपूजारतात्मनाम् /
क्षयं याति क्षणादेव तेषां स्यात्पापधीः कथम् //
text_mt: Sin accumulated over ten million births of those whose souls are devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu / reaches destruction in an instant; how could there be a sinful intellect in them?

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktivihīnā ye caṇḍālāḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
caṇḍālā api vai śreṣṭhā haribhaktiparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तिविहीना ये चण्डालाः परिकीर्तिताः /
चण्डाला अपि वै श्रेष्ठा हरिभक्तिपरायणाः //
text_mt: Those who are devoid of devotion to Viṣṇu are declared to be outcasts; / even outcasts are the best if they are dedicated to devotion to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāṃ viṣayāndhānāṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśinī /
hariseveti vikhyātā bhuktimuktipradāyinī //
meaning:
नराणां विषयान्धानां सर्वदुःखविनाशिनी /
हरिसेवेति विख्याता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायिनी //
text_mt: For men who are blind to sense objects, the renowned service to Hari / destroys all sorrow and bestows enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgātsnehādbhayāllobhādajñānādvāpi yo naraḥ /
viṣṇorupāsanaṃ kuryātso 'kṣayaṃ sukhamaśnute //
meaning:
संगात्स्नेहाद्भयाल्लोभादज्ञानाद्वापि यो नरः /
विष्णोरुपासनं कुर्यात्सो ऽक्षयं सुखमश्नुते //
text_mt: Whatever person worships Viṣṇu out of company, affection, fear, greed, / or even ignorance, he attains imperishable happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
haripādodakaṃ yastu kaṇamātraṃ pibedapi /
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu viṣṇoḥ priyataro bhavet //
meaning:
हरिपादोदकं यस्तु कणमात्रं पिबेदपि /
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु विष्णोः प्रियतरो भवेत् //
text_mt: He who drinks even a single drop of Hari’s foot-water, / has bathed in all the sacred fords and becomes most dear to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
akālamṛtyuśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam /
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ haripododaka smṛtam //
meaning:
अकालमृत्युशमनं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् /
सर्वदुःखोपशमनं हरिपोदोदक स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The water of Hari's feet is recorded as / pacifying untimely death, destroying all diseases, and quelling all sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ dhāma jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamam /
ye prapannā mahātmānasteṣāṃ muktirhi śāśvatī //
meaning:
नारायणं परं धाम ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमम् /
ये प्रपन्ना महात्मानस्तेषां मुक्तिर्हि शाश्वती //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa is the supreme abode, the ultimate light of lights; / the great souls who take refuge in Him indeed attain eternal liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् /
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: Here, indeed, they recount this ancient historical narrative / that destroys all sins for those who recite and hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpurā kṛtayuge guliko nāma lubdhakaḥ /
paradāraparadravyaharaṇe satatodyataḥ //
meaning:
आसीत्पुरा कृतयुगे गुलिको नाम लुब्धकः /
परदारपरद्रव्यहरणे सततोद्यतः //
text_mt: Formerly, in the Kṛta age, there was a hunter named Gulika, / constantly intent on stealing others' wives and others' wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
paranindāparo nityaṃ jantūpadravakṛttathā /
hatavānbrāhmaṇān gāśca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
परनिन्दापरो नित्यं जन्तूपद्रवकृत्तथा /
हतवान्ब्राह्मणान् गाश्च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Constantly bent on slandering others, and afflicting living beings, / he killed hundreds and thousands of brahmins and cows.

sanskrit_iast:
devasvaharaṇe nityaṃ parasvaharaṇe tathā /
udyuktaḥ sarvadā vipra kīnāśānāmadhīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
देवस्वहरणे नित्यं परस्वहरणे तथा /
उद्युक्तः सर्वदा विप्र कीनाशानामधीश्वरः //
text_mt: Always engaged in taking the property of deities and likewise taking the property of others, / O brahmin, he was always a master of villains.

sanskrit_iast:
tena pāpānyanekāni kṛtāni sumahānti ca /
na teṣāṃ śakyate vaktuṃ saṃkhyā vatsarakoṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
तेन पापान्यनेकानि कृतानि सुमहान्ति च /
न तेषां शक्यते वक्तुं संख्या वत्सरकोटिभिः //
text_mt: Countless and very great sins were committed by him; / their number cannot be told even in tens of millions of years.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadā cinmahāpāpo jatṛnāmantakopamaḥ /
sauvīrarājño nagaraṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitam //
meaning:
स कदा चिन्महापापो जतृनामन्तकोपमः /
सौवीरराज्ञो नगरं सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Once, that great sinner, who was like the god of death to living beings, / [went to] the city of the king of Sauvīra, endowed with all opulence,

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣiddhirbhūṣitārbhiśca sarobhinirmalodakaiḥ /
alaṅkṛtaṃ vipaṇibhiryayo devapuropamam //
meaning:
योषिद्धिर्भूषितार्भिश्च सरोभिनिर्मलोदकैः /
अलङ्कृतं विपणिभिर्ययो देवपुरोपमम् //
text_mt: adorned with women and lakes of clear water, / and decorated with market-streets, resembling the city of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopavanamadhyasthaṃ ramyaṃ keśavamandiram /
chaditaṃ hemakalaśairdṛṣṭvā vyādho mudaṃ yayau //
meaning:
तस्योपवनमध्यस्थं रम्यं केशवमन्दिरम् /
छदितं हेमकलशैर्दृष्ट्वा व्याधो मुदं ययौ //
text_mt: Seeing a delightful temple of Keśava situated in the midst of its park, / covered with golden water-pitchers, the hunter felt great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
harāmyatra suvarṇāni bahūnīti viniścitam /
jagāmābhyantaraṃ tasya kīnāśaścauryalolupaḥ //
meaning:
हराम्यत्र सुवर्णानि बहूनीति विनिश्चितम् /
जगामाभ्यन्तरं तस्य कीनाशश्चौर्यलोलुपः //
text_mt: Firmly resolving, “I will steal many gold pieces here,” / the thief, greedy for theft, went inside it.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyaddvijavaraṃ śāntaṃ tattvārthakovidam /
paricaryāparaṃ viṣṇoruttaṅkaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यद्द्विजवरं शान्तं तत्त्वार्थकोविदम् /
परिचर्यापरं विष्णोरुत्तङ्कं तपसां निधिम् //
text_mt: There he saw the best of brahmins, peaceful, knowing the truth of reality, / devoted to the service of Viṣṇu—Uttaṅka, a treasure of austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
ekākinaṃ dayāsuṃ ca nispṛhaṃ dhyānalolupam /
cauryāntarāyakartāraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā lubdhako mune //
meaning:
एकाकिनं दयासुं च निस्पृहं ध्यानलोलुपम् /
चौर्यान्तरायकर्तारं तं दृष्ट्वा लुब्धको मुने //
text_mt: solitary, compassionate, devoid of desires, eager for meditation. / Seeing him, who was an obstacle to his theft, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
dravyajātaṃ tu devasya hartukāmo 'tisāhasī /
uttaṅkaṃ hṝntumārebhe vidhṛtāsirmadoddhataḥ //
meaning:
द्रव्यजातं तु देवस्य हर्तुकामो ऽतिसाहसी /
उत्तङ्कं हॄन्तुमारेभे विधृतासिर्मदोद्धतः //
text_mt: desiring to steal the collection of wealth of the deity, the extremely reckless one / began to slay Uttaṅka, raising his sword, arrogant with pride.

sanskrit_iast:
pādenākramya tadvakṣo jaṭāḥ saṃgṛhya pāṇinā /
hṝntuṃ kṛtamatiṃ vyādhamuttaṅkaḥ prekṣya cābravīt //
meaning:
पादेनाक्रम्य तद्वक्षो जटाः संगृह्य पाणिना /
हॄन्तुं कृतमतिं व्याधमुत्तङ्कः प्रेक्ष्य चाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Pressing his chest with his foot and seizing his matted locks with his hand, / seeing the hunter resolved to kill him, Uttaṅka spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
uttaṅka uvāca
bho bho sādho vṛthā māṃ tvaṃ haniṣyasi nirāgasam /
mayā kimaparāddhaṃ te tadvadasva mahāmatte //
meaning:
उत्तङ्क उवाच
भो भो साधो वृथा मां त्वं हनिष्यसि निरागसम् /
मया किमपराद्धं ते तद्वदस्व महामत्ते //
text_mt: Uttaṅka said: / “O good sir, in vain will you slay me, innocent as I am. / What wrong have I done to you? Tell me that, O very intelligent one!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāparādhināṃ loke śaktāḥ śikṣāṃ prakurvate /
nahi saumya vṛthā ghnanti sajjanā api pāpinaḥ //
meaning:
कृतापराधिनां लोके शक्ताः शिक्षां प्रकुर्वते /
नहि सौम्य वृथा घ्नन्ति सज्जना अपि पापिनः //
text_mt: In this world, capable men mete out punishment to wrongdoers; / virtuous men do not kill even sinners in vain, O gentle one.

sanskrit_iast:
virodhiṣvapi mūrkheṣu nirīkṣyāvasthitān guṇān /
virodhaṃ nahi kurvanti sajjanāḥ śāntacetasaḥ //
meaning:
विरोधिष्वपि मूर्खेषु निरीक्ष्यावस्थितान् गुणान् /
विरोधं नहि कुर्वन्ति सज्जनाः शान्तचेतसः //
text_mt: Even among foolish adversaries, having perceived their existing virtues, / peaceful-minded virtuous men do not practice hostility.

sanskrit_iast:
bahudhā bodhyamāno 'pi yo naraḥ kṣamayānvitaḥ /
tamuttamaṃ naraṃ prāhurviṣṇoḥ priyataraṃ sadā //
meaning:
बहुधा बोध्यमानो ऽपि यो नरः क्षमयान्वितः /
तमुत्तमं नरं प्राहुर्विष्णोः प्रियतरं सदा //
text_mt: The man who is endowed with patience, even though provoked in many ways, / him they declare the best of men, always most dear to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sujano na yāti vairaṃ parahitabuddhirvanāśakāle 'pi /
chede 'pi candanataruḥ surabhayati mukhaṃ kuṭhārasya //
meaning:
सुजनो न याति वैरं परहितबुद्धिर्वनाशकाले ऽपि /
छेदे ऽपि चन्दनतरुः सुरभयति मुखं कुठारस्य //
text_mt: A virtuous person whose mind is intent on the welfare of others does not foster enmity even at the time of death; / even when being cut, the sandalwood tree perfumes the edge of the axe.

sanskrit_iast:
aho vidhiḥ subalavānbā dhate bahudhā janān /
sarvasaṃgavihīno 'pi bādhyate hi durātmanā //
meaning:
अहो विधिः सुबलवान्बा धते बहुधा जनान् /
सर्वसंगविहीनो ऽपि बाध्यते हि दुरात्मना //
text_mt: Alas, destiny is very powerful and afflicts people in many ways; / even one devoid of all attachment is indeed tormented by an evil-minded person.

sanskrit_iast:
aho niṣkāraṇaṃ loke bādhante bahudhā janān /
sarvasaṃgavihīno 'pi bādhyate piśunairjanaiḥ /
tatrāpi sādhūnbādhante na samānānkadācana //
meaning:
अहो निष्कारणं लोके बाधन्ते बहुधा जनान् /
सर्वसंगविहीनो ऽपि बाध्यते पिशुनैर्जनैः /
तत्रापि साधून्बाधन्ते न समानान्कदाचन //
text_mt: Alas, in this world they afflict people in many ways without cause; / even one devoid of all attachment is afflicted by slanderous men; / even there, they torment the virtuous, never their equals.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgamīnasajjanānāṃ tṛṇajalasaṃtoṣavihitavṛttānām /
lubdhakadhīvarapiśunā niṣkāraṇavairiṇo jagati //
meaning:
मृगमीनसज्जनानां तृणजलसंतोषविहितवृत्तानाम् /
लुब्धकधीवरपिशुना निष्कारणवैरिणो जगति //
text_mt: For the deer, the fish, and the virtuous, who subsist contentedly on grass, water, and contentment, / the hunter, the fisherman, and the slanderer are unprovoked enemies in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
aho balavatī māyā mohayatyakhilaṃ jagat /
putramitrakalatrārthaṃ sarvaṃ duḥkhena yojayet //
meaning:
अहो बलवती माया मोहयत्यखिलं जगत् /
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रार्थं सर्वं दुःखेन योजयेत् //
text_mt: Alas, powerful illusion bewitches the entire universe; / for the sake of son, friend, and wife, it yokes everything to sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
paradravyāpahāreṇa kalatraṃ poṣitaṃ tvayā /
ante tatsarvamutsṛjya eka eva prayati vai //
meaning:
परद्रव्यापहारेण कलत्रं पोषितं त्वया /
अन्ते तत्सर्वमुत्सृज्य एक एव प्रयति वै //
text_mt: By stealing others' wealth, a wife was nourished by you; / in the end, having abandoned all that, one goes forth truly alone.

sanskrit_iast:
mama mātā mama pitā mama bhāryā mamātmajāḥ /
mamedamiti jantūnāṃ mamatā bādhate vṛthā //
meaning:
मम माता मम पिता मम भार्या ममात्मजाः /
ममेदमिति जन्तूनां ममता बाधते वृथा //
text_mt: ‘My mother, my father, my wife, my sons, / this is mine’—thus possessiveness torments creatures in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadarjayati dravyaṃ bāndhavāstāvadeva hi /
dharmādharmauṃ sahaivāstāmihāmutra na cāparaḥ //
meaning:
यावदर्जयति द्रव्यं बान्धवास्तावदेव हि /
धर्माधर्मौं सहैवास्तामिहामुत्र न चापरः //
text_mt: Only as long as one earns wealth do kinsmen exist; / righteousness and unrighteousness alone stay together here and in the hereafter, and nothing else.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmārjitairdravyaiḥ poṣitā yena ye narāḥ /
mṛtamagnimukhe hutvā ghṛtānnaṃ bhuñjate hi te //
meaning:
धर्माधर्मार्जितैर्द्रव्यैः पोषिता येन ये नराः /
मृतमग्निमुखे हुत्वा घृतान्नं भुञ्जते हि ते //
text_mt: The people who were nourished by someone with wealth acquired by righteousness or unrighteousness / offer him into the mouth of the fire when dead, and feast on food cooked with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchantaṃ paralokaṃ ca naraṃ tu hyanutiṣṭataḥ /
dharmādharmauṃ na ca dhanaṃ na putrā na ca bāndhavāḥ //
meaning:
गच्छन्तं परलोकं च नरं तु ह्यनुतिष्टतः /
धर्माधर्मौं न च धनं न पुत्रा न च बान्धवाः //
text_mt: And as a man departs for the other world, / only righteousness and unrighteousness follow him—neither wealth, nor sons, nor kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaḥ samṛddhimāyāti narāṇāṃ pāpakarmiṇām /
kāmaḥ saṃkṣayamāyāti narāṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām //
meaning:
कामः समृद्धिमायाति नराणां पापकर्मिणाम् /
कामः संक्षयमायाति नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: Desire increases in men of sinful actions; / desire dwindles away in men of meritorious actions.

sanskrit_iast: vṛthaiva vyākulā lokā dhanādānāṃ sadārjane //
meaning: वृथैव व्याकुला लोका धनादानां सदार्जने //
text_mt: In vain indeed are people distressed constantly in the acquisition of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhāvi tadbhavatyeva yadabhāvyaṃ na tadbhavet /
iti niścitabuddhīnāṃ na cintā bādhate kvacit //
meaning:
यद्भावि तद्भवत्येव यदभाव्यं न तद्भवेत् /
इति निश्चितबुद्धीनां न चिन्ता बाधते क्वचित् //
text_mt: What is to be, certainly happens; what is not to be, does not happen; / for those of such resolved intellect, anxiety never causes distress anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
rdavādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam /
tasmājjanma ca mṛtyuṃ ca daivaṃ jānāti nāparaḥ //
meaning:
र्दवाधीनमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
तस्माज्जन्म च मृत्युं च दैवं जानाति नापरः //
text_mt: All this world, mobile and immobile, is under the control of fate; / therefore, fate alone knows birth and death, and no one else.”

sanskrit_iast:
yatra kutra sthitasyāpi yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhaved dhruvam /
lokastu tatra vijñāya vṛthāyāsaṃ karoti hi //
meaning:
यत्र कुत्र स्थितस्यापि यद्भाव्यं तद्भवेद् ध्रुवम् /
लोकस्तु तत्र विज्ञाय वृथायासं करोति हि //
text_mt: "Wherever one is situated, that which is destined to happen will surely happen. / Yet worldly people, understanding that, indeed make effort in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
aho duḥkhaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ mamatākulacetasām /
mahāpāpāni kṛtvāpi parānpuṣyānti yatnataḥ //
meaning:
अहो दुःखं मनुष्याणां ममताकुलचेतसाम् /
महापापानि कृत्वापि परान्पुष्यान्ति यत्नतः //
text_mt: Alas, the misery of humans whose minds are confounded by possessiveness! / Even having committed great sins, they diligently nourish others.

sanskrit_iast:
arjitaṃ ca dhanaṃ sarvaṃ bhuñjate bāndhavāḥ sadā /
svayamekatamo mūḍhastatpāpaphalamaśnute //
meaning:
अर्जितं च धनं सर्वं भुञ्जते बान्धवाः सदा /
स्वयमेकतमो मूढस्तत्पापफलमश्नुते //
text_mt: Relatives always enjoy all the accumulated wealth, / while that solitary fool alone experiences the fruit of that sin."

sanskrit_iast:
iti bravāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ vimucya bhayavihvalaḥ /
gulikaḥ prāñjaliḥ prāha kṣamasveti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
इति ब्रवाणं तमृषिं विमुच्य भयविह्वलः /
गुलिकः प्राञ्जलिः प्राह क्षमस्वेति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: As the sage was speaking thus, Gulika, agitated by fear, released him, / and with folded hands said repeatedly, "Forgive me!"

sanskrit_iast:
satsaṃgasya prabhāveṇa harisannidhimātrataḥ /
gatapāpo lubagdakaśca hyanutāpīdamabravīt //
meaning:
सत्संगस्य प्रभावेण हरिसन्निधिमात्रतः /
गतपापो लुबग्दकश्च ह्यनुतापीदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: By the power of the company of the virtuous, merely through the presence of Hari's [devotee], / the hunter, his sins gone and feeling remorse, spoke thus:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā kṛtā ni pāpāni mahānti subahūni ca /
tāni sarvāṇi naṣṭāni viprendra tava darśanāt //
meaning:
मया कृता नि पापानि महान्ति सुबहूनि च /
तानि सर्वाणि नष्टानि विप्रेन्द्र तव दर्शनात् //
text_mt: "Great and very numerous sins have been committed by me; / they have all been destroyed, O best of brahmins, by the sight of you.

sanskrit_iast:
aho 'haṃ pāpadhīrnityaṃ mahāpāpamupācaram /
kathaṃ me niṣkṛtir bhūyo yāmi kaṃ śaraṇaṃ vibhoḥ //
meaning:
अहो ऽहं पापधीर्नित्यं महापापमुपाचरम् /
कथं मे निष्कृतिर् भूयो यामि कं शरणं विभोः //
text_mt: Alas, I of sinful intellect have constantly committed great sin! / How will my atonement be accomplished again? To whose refuge among the lord's [servants] do I go?

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmārjitaiḥ pāpairlubdhakatvamavāptavān /
atrāpi pāpajālāni kṛtvā kāṃ gatimāpnuyām //
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मार्जितैः पापैर्लुब्धकत्वमवाप्तवान् /
अत्रापि पापजालानि कृत्वा कां गतिमाप्नुयाम् //
text_mt: By the sins accumulated in previous lives, I attained the state of a hunter. / Having made a web of sins here too, what destination will I attain?

sanskrit_iast:
aho mamāyuḥ kṣayameti śīghraṃ pāpānyanekāni samarjjitāni /
prātikriyā naiva kṛtā mayaiṣāṃ gatiśca kā syānmamajanma kiṃ vā //
meaning:
अहो ममायुः क्षयमेति शीघ्रं पापान्यनेकानि समर्ज्जितानि /
प्रातिक्रिया नैव कृता मयैषां गतिश्च का स्यान्ममजन्म किं वा //
text_mt: Alas, my life quickly comes to an end; many sins have been accumulated, / and no counter-action has been taken by me for these! What will my destination be, or what my rebirth?

sanskrit_iast:
aho vidhiḥ pāpaśatā kulaṃ māṃ kiṃ sṛṣṭavānpāpataraṃ ca śaśvat /
kathaṃ ca yatpāpaphalaṃ hi bhokṣye kiyatsu janmasvahamugrakarmā //
meaning:
अहो विधिः पापशता कुलं मां किं सृष्टवान्पापतरं च शश्वत् /
कथं च यत्पापफलं हि भोक्ष्ये कियत्सु जन्मस्वहमुग्रकर्मा //
text_mt: Alas, why did the Creator make me afflicted with hundreds of sins and ever more sinful? / And how, in how many births, will I, of terrible deeds, indeed experience the fruit of that sin?"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vinindannātmānamātmanā lubdhakastadā /
antastāpāgnisaṃtaptaḥ sadyaḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ //
meaning:
एवं विनिन्दन्नात्मानमात्मना लुब्धकस्तदा /
अन्तस्तापाग्निसंतप्तः सद्यः पञ्चत्वमागतः //
text_mt: Thus reproaching himself by himself at that time, / scorched by the fire of inner torment, the hunter instantly met his death.

sanskrit_iast:
uttaṅkaḥ patitaṃ prekṣya lubagdhakaṃ taṃ dayāparaḥ /
viṣṇupādodakenaivamabhyaṣiñcanmahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
उत्तङ्कः पतितं प्रेक्ष्य लुबग्धकं तं दयापरः /
विष्णुपादोदकेनैवमभ्यषिञ्चन्महामतिः //
text_mt: Seeing that hunter fallen, compassionate Uttaṅka, / highly intelligent, sprinkled him with the water from Viṣṇu's feet.

sanskrit_iast:
haripādodakasparśāllubdhako gatakalmaṣaḥ /
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya munimetadathābravīt //
meaning:
हरिपादोदकस्पर्शाल्लुब्धको गतकल्मषः /
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य मुनिमेतदथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: From the touch of the water from Hari's feet, the hunter, freed from taint, / ascended a celestial chariot and then said this to the sage:

sanskrit_iast:
gulika uvāca
uttaṅka muniśārdūla gurustvaṃ mama suvrata /
vimuktastvatprasādena mahāpātakakañcukāt //
meaning:
गुलिक उवाच
उत्तङ्क मुनिशार्दूल गुरुस्त्वं मम सुव्रत /
विमुक्तस्त्वत्प्रसादेन महापातककञ्चुकात् //
text_mt: Gulika said: / "Uttaṅka, tiger among sages, you are my guru, O one of good vows! / By your grace, I am released from the slough of mortal sin.

sanskrit_iast:
gatastvadupadeśānme saṃtāpo munipuṅgava /
tathaiva sarvapāpāni vinaṣṭānyativegataḥ //
meaning:
गतस्त्वदुपदेशान्मे संतापो मुनिपुङ्गव /
तथैव सर्वपापानि विनष्टान्यतिवेगतः //
text_mt: From your instruction, O bull among sages, my torment has vanished; / likewise, all my sins have perished with great speed.

sanskrit_iast:
haripādodakaṃ yasmānmayi tvaṃ siktavānmune /
prāpito 'smi tvayā tasmāttadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
हरिपादोदकं यस्मान्मयि त्वं सिक्तवान्मुने /
प्रापितो ऽस्मि त्वया तस्मात्तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Because you sprinkled the water from Hari's feet upon me, O sage, / I have therefore been brought by you to that supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayāhaṃ tārito vipra pāpādasmāccharīrataḥ /
tasmānnato 'smi te vidvanmatkṛtaṃ tatkṣamasva ca //
meaning:
त्वयाहं तारितो विप्र पापादस्माच्छरीरतः /
तस्मान्नतो ऽस्मि ते विद्वन्मत्कृतं तत्क्षमस्व च //
text_mt: By you I have been delivered, O brahmin, from this sinful body; / therefore, I bow to you, O wise one, and forgive what was done by me!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā devakusumairmuniśreṣṭhaṃ samākiram /
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskāraṃ cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा देवकुसुमैर्मुनिश्रेष्ठं समाकिरम् /
प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कृत्वा नमस्कारं चकार सः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he strewed the best of sages with divine flowers, / performed three circumambulations, and bowed down.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vimānamāruhya sarvakāmasamanvitam /
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaḥ prapede harimandiram //
meaning:
ततो विमानमारुह्य सर्वकामसमन्वितम् /
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णः प्रपेदे हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Then, having ascended the chariot endowed with all desires / and crowded with hosts of Apsarases, he went to the temple of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddṛṣṭvā vismito 'sau hyuttaṅkastapasāṃnidhiḥ /
śirasyañjalimādhāya tuṣṭāva kamalāpatim //
meaning:
एतद्दृष्ट्वा विस्मितो ऽसौ ह्युत्तङ्कस्तपसांनिधिः /
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय तुष्टाव कमलापतिम् //
text_mt: Having seen this, that Uttaṅka, a treasure-house of austerities, was astonished; / placing his folded hands upon his head, he praised the Lord of Kamalā.

sanskrit_iast:
tena stuto mahāviṣṇurdattavānvaramattamam /
vareṇa tenoktaṅko 'pi prapede paramaṃ padam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge viṣṇumāhātmye saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तेन स्तुतो महाविष्णुर्दत्तवान्वरमत्तमम् /
वरेण तेनोक्तङ्को ऽपि प्रपेदे परमं पदम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे विष्णुमाहात्म्ये सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Praised by him, Mahāviṣṇu granted an excellent boon; / and by that boon, Uttaṅka also attained the supreme abode.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, on the eulogy of the greatness of Viṣṇu, in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kintatstotraṃ mahābhāga kathaṃ tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ /
uktaṅkaḥ puṇyapuruṣaḥ kīdṛśaṃ labdhavānvaram //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
किन्तत्स्तोत्रं महाभाग कथं तुष्टो जनार्दनः /
उक्तङ्कः पुण्यपुरुषः कीदृशं लब्धवान्वरम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / "What was that praise, O blessed one? How was Janārdana pleased? / What kind of boon did the meritorious person Uttaṅka obtain?"

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
uttaṅkastu tadā vipro haridhyānaparāyaṇaḥ /
pādodakasya māhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
उत्तङ्कस्तु तदा विप्रो हरिध्यानपरायणः /
पादोदकस्य माहात्म्यं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टाव भक्तितः //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / "Then the brahmin Uttaṅka, devoted to meditation on Hari, / having seen the greatness of the foot-water, praised [him] with devotion."

sanskrit_iast:
uttaṅka uvāca
nato 'smi nārāyaṇamādidevaṃ jagannivāsaṃ jagadekabandhum /
cakrābjaśārṅgīsidharaṃ mahāntaṃ smṛtārtinighnaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
उत्तङ्क उवाच
नतो ऽस्मि नारायणमादिदेवं जगन्निवासं जगदेकबन्धुम् /
चक्राब्जशार्ङ्गीसिधरं महान्तं स्मृतार्तिनिघ्नं शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt: Uttaṅka said: / "I bow to Nārāyaṇa, the primal deity, the abode of the universe, the sole friend of the universe; / holding the discus, lotus, Śārṅga bow, and sword, the great one who destroys the suffering of those who remember him, I go to him for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yannibhijābja prabhavo vidhātā sṛjatyamuṃ lokasamuñcayaṃ ca /
yatkrodhajo hṝnti jagañca rudrastamādidevaṃ praṇato 'smi viṣṇum //
meaning:
यन्निभिजाब्ज प्रभवो विधाता सृजत्यमुं लोकसमुञ्चयं च /
यत्क्रोधजो हॄन्ति जगञ्च रुद्रस्तमादिदेवं प्रणतो ऽस्मि विष्णुम् //
text_mt: From whose navel-lotus the Creator arose and creates this collection of worlds, / and born from whose anger Rudra destroys the universe—to that primal deity Viṣṇu I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
padmāpatiṃ padmadalāyatākṣaṃ vicitravīryaṃ nikhilaikahetum /
vedāntavedyaṃ pukuṣaṃ purāṇaṃ taijonidhiṃ viṣṇumahaṃ prapannaḥ //
meaning:
पद्मापतिं पद्मदलायताक्षं विचित्रवीर्यं निखिलैकहेतुम् /
वेदान्तवेद्यं पुकुषं पुराणं तैजोनिधिं विष्णुमहं प्रपन्नः //
text_mt: To the Lord of Padmā, whose eyes are long like lotus petals, of wondrous valour, the single cause of all, / knowable through the Vedānta, the ancient Puruṣa, the treasure of splendour, to Viṣṇu I have surrendered.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmākṣaraḥ sarvagato 'cyutākhyo jñānātmako jñānavidāṃ śaraṇyaḥ /
jñānaikavedyo bhagavānanādiḥ prasīdatāṃ vyaṣṭisa praṣṭirupaḥ //
meaning:
आत्माक्षरः सर्वगतो ऽच्युताख्यो ज्ञानात्मको ज्ञानविदां शरण्यः /
ज्ञानैकवेद्यो भगवाननादिः प्रसीदतां व्यष्टिस प्रष्टिरुपः //
text_mt: The imperishable Self, omnipresent, named Acyuta, consisting of knowledge, the refuge of those who know knowledge, / knowable by knowledge alone, the beginningless Lord in the form of individual and cosmic manifestation, may he be pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
anantavīyo guṇajātihīnāṃ guṇātmako jñānavidāṃ varaṣṭaḥ /
nityaḥ prapannārti haraḥ parātmā dayāṃbudhirme varadastu bhaghūyāt //
meaning:
अनन्तवीयो गुणजातिहीनां गुणात्मको ज्ञानविदां वरष्टः /
नित्यः प्रपन्नार्ति हरः परात्मा दयांबुधिर्मे वरदस्तु भघूयात् //
text_mt: Of endless valour, devoid of qualities and genus, consisting of qualities, the highest among those who know knowledge, / eternal, removing the distress of the surrendered, the supreme Self, the ocean of compassion—may he become the granter of boons to me!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sthūlasūkṣmādiviśeṣabhedaurjagadyathāvatsvakṛtaṃ praviṣṭaḥ /
tvameva tatsarvamanantasāraṃ tvattaḥ paraṃ nāsti yataḥ parātman //
meaning:
यः स्थूलसूक्ष्मादिविशेषभेदौर्जगद्यथावत्स्वकृतं प्रविष्टः /
त्वमेव तत्सर्वमनन्तसारं त्वत्तः परं नास्ति यतः परात्मन् //
text_mt: He who, by distinct variations such as gross and subtle, entered the world properly as his own creation—/ you alone are all that, the endless essence, since there is nothing beyond you, O supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
agocaraṃ yattava śuddharūraṃ māyāvihīnaṃ guṇajātihīnam /
nirañjanaṃ nirmalamaprameyaṃ paśyanti santaḥ paramārthasaṃjñam //
meaning:
अगोचरं यत्तव शुद्धरूरं मायाविहीनं गुणजातिहीनम् /
निरञ्जनं निर्मलमप्रमेयं पश्यन्ति सन्तः परमार्थसंज्ञम् //
text_mt: Your pure form, beyond the senses, free from māyā, devoid of qualities and genus, / untainted, spotless, immeasurable, designated as the supreme truth, the good perceive.

sanskrit_iast:
ekena hemraiva vibhūṣaṇāni yātāni bhedatvamupādhibhedāt /
tathaiva sarveṣvara eka eva pradṛśyate bhinna ivārivalātmā //
meaning:
एकेन हेम्रैव विभूषणानि यातानि भेदत्वमुपाधिभेदात् /
तथैव सर्वेष्वर एक एव प्रदृश्यते भिन्न इवारिवलात्मा //
text_mt: Just as ornaments made from gold alone attain diversity through difference of conditions, / even so the one Lord of all, the Self of all, appears as if divided.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmāyayā mohitacetasastaṃ paśyanti nātmānamapi prasiddham /
ta eva māyārahitāstadeva pasaayanti sarvātmakamātmarupam //
meaning:
यन्मायया मोहितचेतसस्तं पश्यन्ति नात्मानमपि प्रसिद्धम् /
त एव मायारहितास्तदेव पसअयन्ति सर्वात्मकमात्मरुपम् //
text_mt: Those whose minds are deluded by his māyā do not see him, nor even the well-known Self; / but those very ones, freed from māyā, see that Self whose form is the Self of all.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhuṃ jyotiranaupamyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ namāmyaham /
samastametadudbhūtaṃ yato yatra pratiṣṭitam //
meaning:
विभुं ज्योतिरनौपम्यं विष्णुसंज्ञं नमाम्यहम् /
समस्तमेतदुद्भूतं यतो यत्र प्रतिष्टितम् //
text_mt: I bow to the all-pervading light, peerless, bearing the name Viṣṇu, / from whom all this has arisen and in whom it is established.

sanskrit_iast:
yataścaitanyamāyātaṃ yadrūpaṃ tasya vai namaḥ /
aprameyamanādāramādhārādheyarūpakam //
meaning:
यतश्चैतन्यमायातं यद्रूपं तस्य वै नमः /
अप्रमेयमनादारमाधाराधेयरूपकम् //
text_mt: From whom consciousness has come, whose form is that—to him indeed be homage! / The immeasurable, without support, who has the form of both support and supported,

sanskrit_iast:
paramānandacinmātraṃ vāsudevaṃ nato 'smyaham /
hṛdguhānilayaṃ devaṃ yogibhiḥ parisevitam //
meaning:
परमानन्दचिन्मात्रं वासुदेवं नतो ऽस्म्यहम् /
हृद्गुहानिलयं देवं योगिभिः परिसेवितम् //
text_mt: supreme bliss, pure consciousness—to Vāsudeva I bow; / the god who dwells in the cave of the heart, attended upon by yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
yogānāmādibhūtaṃ taṃ namāmi praṇavasthitam /
nādātmakaṃ nādabījaṃ praṇavātmakamavyayam //
meaning:
योगानामादिभूतं तं नमामि प्रणवस्थितम् /
नादात्मकं नादबीजं प्रणवात्मकमव्ययम् //
text_mt: To him who is the beginning of yogas, dwelling in the praṇava, I bow; / consisting of sound, the seed of sound, consisting of the praṇava, imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhaghāvaṃ sañcidānandaṃ taṃ vande tigmacakriṇam /
ajaraṃ sākṣiṇaṃ tvasya hyavāṅmanasagocaram //
meaning:
सद्भघावं सञ्चिदानन्दं तं वन्दे तिग्मचक्रिणम् /
अजरं साक्षिणं त्वस्य ह्यवाङ्मनसगोचरम् //
text_mt: I praise him whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss, bearer of the sharp discus, / unaging, the witness of this [world], beyond the reach of speech and mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nirañjanamanantākhyaṃ viṣṇurupaṃ nato 'smyaham /
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ //
meaning:
निरञ्जनमनन्ताख्यं विष्णुरुपं नतो ऽस्म्यहम् /
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः सत्त्वं तेजो बलं धृतिः //
text_mt: To the untainted one named Ananta, who is Viṣṇu's form, I bow: / the senses, mind, intellect, sattva, splendour, strength, and resolve."

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevātmakānyāhuḥ kṣetraṃ kṣetra jñameva ca /
vidyāvidyātmakaṃ prāhuḥ parātparataraṃ tathā //
meaning:
वासुदेवात्मकान्याहुः क्षेत्रं क्षेत्र ज्ञमेव च /
विद्याविद्यात्मकं प्राहुः परात्परतरं तथा //
text_mt: They declare that [all these] consist of Vāsudeva, as do the field and the knower of the field; / and they declare that he consists of knowledge and ignorance, higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhanaṃ śāntaṃ sarvadhātāramacyutam /
ye prapannā mahātmānasteṣāṃ muktirhi śāśvatī //
meaning:
अनादिनिधनं शान्तं सर्वधातारमच्युतम् /
ये प्रपन्ना महात्मानस्तेषां मुक्तिर्हि शाश्वती //
text_mt: Those great-souled ones who have taken refuge in Acyuta, the beginningless and endless, tranquil supporter of all, / attain indeed eternal liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ purāṇaṃ sanātanaṃ sarvagataṃ samastam /
nato 'smi bhūyo 'pi nato 'smi bhūyo 'pi nato 'smi bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
वरं वरेण्यं वरदं पुराणं सनातनं सर्वगतं समस्तम् /
नतो ऽस्मि भूयो ऽपि नतो ऽस्मि भूयो ऽपि नतो ऽस्मि भूयः //
text_mt: To the excellent, the worthy of choice, the giver of boons, the ancient, eternal, all-pervading, and all-comprising, / I bow again and again; I bow again and again; I bow once more.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpāda toyaṃ bhaghavarogavaidyo yatpādapāṃśurvimalatvasiddhyai /
yannāma duṣkarmanivāraṇāyacaya tamaprameyaṃ puruṣaṃ bhajāmi //
meaning:
यत्पाद तोयं भघवरोगवैद्यो यत्पादपांशुर्विमलत्वसिद्ध्यै /
यन्नाम दुष्कर्मनिवारणायचय तमप्रमेयं पुरुषं भजामि //
text_mt: The water from whose feet is a physician for the disease of worldly existence, the dust from whose feet brings about purity, / whose name dispels evil actions—that immeasurable Puruṣa I worship.

sanskrit_iast:
sadrūpaṃ tamasadrūpaṃ sadasadrūpamavyayam /
tattadvilakṣaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhācchraṣṭhataraṃ bhaje //
meaning:
सद्रूपं तमसद्रूपं सदसद्रूपमव्ययम् /
तत्तद्विलक्षणं श्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठाच्छ्रष्ठतरं भजे //
text_mt: His form is being, non-being, and both being and non-being; immutable, / distinct from both, supreme: I worship him who is greater than the greatest.

sanskrit_iast:
nirañjanaṃ nirākāraṃ pūrṇamākāśamadhyagam /
paraṃ ca vidyāvidyābhyāṃ hṛdaṃbujanivāsinam //
meaning:
निरञ्जनं निराकारं पूर्णमाकाशमध्यगम् /
परं च विद्याविद्याभ्यां हृदंबुजनिवासिनम् //
text_mt: Free from stain, formless, complete, abiding in the midst of space, / beyond knowledge and ignorance, dwelling in the lotus of the heart;

sanskrit_iast:
svaprakāśamanirdeṣyaṃ mahatāṃ ca mahattaram /
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamajaṃ sarvopādhivivarjitam //
meaning:
स्वप्रकाशमनिर्देष्यं महतां च महत्तरम् /
अणोरणीयांसमजं सर्वोपाधिविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: Self-luminous, indefinable, greater than the great, / subtler than the subtle, unborn, devoid of all adjuncts;

sanskrit_iast:
yannityaṃ paramānandaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam /
viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ jagaddhāma tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
यन्नित्यं परमानन्दं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
विष्णुसंज्ञं जगद्धाम तमस्मि शरणं गतः //
text_mt: That eternal supreme bliss, the eternal Supreme Brahman, / designated as Viṣṇu, the abode of the universe—in him I have taken refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ bhajanti kriyāniṣṭāyaṃ paśyanti ca yoginaḥ /
pūjyātpūjyataraṃ śāntaṃ gato 'smi śaraṇaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
यं भजन्ति क्रियानिष्टायं पश्यन्ति च योगिनः /
पूज्यात्पूज्यतरं शान्तं गतो ऽस्मि शरणं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Whom those devoted to action worship, and whom yogins behold; / to that Lord, more worthy of worship than the venerable, tranquil, I have gone for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ na paśyanti vidvāṃso ya etadvyāvya tiṣṭati /
sarvasmādadhikaṃ nityaṃ nato 'smi vibhumavyayam //
meaning:
यं न पश्यन्ति विद्वांसो य एतद्व्याव्य तिष्टति /
सर्वस्मादधिकं नित्यं नतो ऽस्मि विभुमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Whom the learned do not see, who remains pervading this [entire universe], / higher than all, eternal: I bow to the all-pervading, imperishable Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ karaṇasaṃyogājjīva ityucyate ca yaḥ /
avidyākārya rahitaḥ paramātmeti gīyate //
meaning:
अन्तः करणसंयोगाज्जीव इत्युच्यते च यः /
अविद्याकार्य रहितः परमात्मेति गीयते //
text_mt: He who is called the individual self through connection with the inner organ, / free from the effects of ignorance, is sung of as the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmakaṃ sarvahetuṃ sravakarmaphalappadam /
varaṃ vareṇyamajanaṃ praṇato 'smi parātparam //
meaning:
सर्वात्मकं सर्वहेतुं स्रवकर्मफलप्पदम् /
वरं वरेण्यमजनं प्रणतो ऽस्मि परात्परम् //
text_mt: Consisting of all, the cause of all, granter of the fruit of all deeds, / excellent, worthy of choice, unborn: I bow to the higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntaṃ sarvāntayā miṇaṃ harim /
jñānātmakaṃ jñānanidhiṃ jñānasaṃsthaṃ vibhuṃ bhaje //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं शान्तं सर्वान्तया मिणं हरिम् /
ज्ञानात्मकं ज्ञाननिधिं ज्ञानसंस्थं विभुं भजे //
text_mt: Omniscient, all-pervading, tranquil, the inner ruler of all, Hari, / consisting of knowledge, a treasure of knowledge, abiding in knowledge: I worship the all-pervading Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
namāmyahaṃ vedanidhiṃ murāriṃ vedānta vijñānasuniścitārtham /
sūryeduvatprojjvalane tramindraṃ ravagasvarupaṃ vapatisvarūpam //
meaning:
नमाम्यहं वेदनिधिं मुरारिं वेदान्त विज्ञानसुनिश्चितार्थम् /
सूर्येदुवत्प्रोज्ज्वलने त्रमिन्द्रं रवगस्वरुपं वपतिस्वरूपम् //
text_mt: I bow to Murāri, the treasure of the Vedas, whose meaning is firmly established by the wisdom of the Vedānta, / whose eyes are ablaze like the sun and moon, Indra, having the nature of the sun, embodied as the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvaraṃ sarvagataṃ mahāntaṃ vedātmakaṃ vedavidāṃvariṣṭam /
taṃvāṅmano 'cintyamanantaśaktiṃ jñānaikavedyaṃ puruṣaṃ bhajāmi //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरं सर्वगतं महान्तं वेदात्मकं वेदविदांवरिष्टम् /
तंवाङ्मनो ऽचिन्त्यमनन्तशक्तिं ज्ञानैकवेद्यं पुरुषं भजामि //
text_mt: Lord of all, all-pervading, the Great One, consisting of the Vedas, foremost among knowers of the Vedas, / unthinkable by speech or mind, of infinite power, knowable through knowledge alone: I worship the Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāgnikālāsurapāśivāyusomeṣamārttaṇḍapurandarādyaiḥ /
yaḥ pāti lokānparipūrṇabhāvastamaprameyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
इन्द्राग्निकालासुरपाशिवायुसोमेषमार्त्तण्डपुरन्दराद्यैः /
यः पाति लोकान्परिपूर्णभावस्तमप्रमेयं शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt: He who, having a complete nature, protects the worlds through Indra, Agni, Kāla, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Soma, Īśa, Sūrya, Purandara, and others— / in that immeasurable one I take refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣaṃ ca sahasrapādaṃ sahasrabāhuḥ ca sahasranetram /
samastayajñaiḥ parijuṣṭamādyaṃ nato 'smi tuṣṭipradamugravīryam //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षं च सहस्रपादं सहस्रबाहुः च सहस्रनेत्रम् /
समस्तयज्ञैः परिजुष्टमाद्यं नतो ऽस्मि तुष्टिप्रदमुग्रवीर्यम् //
text_mt: Having a thousand heads, a thousand feet, a thousand arms, and a thousand eyes, / worshipped through all sacrifices, the primeval one, granter of satisfaction, of fierce valour: to him I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
kālātmakaṃ kālavibhāgahetuṃ guṇatrayātītamahaṃ guṇajñam /
guṇapriyaṃ kāmadamastasaṃgamatīndriyaṃ viśvabhaghujaṃ vitṛṣṇam //
meaning:
कालात्मकं कालविभागहेतुं गुणत्रयातीतमहं गुणज्ञम् /
गुणप्रियं कामदमस्तसंगमतीन्द्रियं विश्वभघुजं वितृष्णम् //
text_mt: Consisting of time, the cause of the divisions of time, transcending the three guṇas, knower of qualities, / lover of virtues, granter of desires, free of attachment, beyond the senses, enjoyer of the universe, free of thirst;

sanskrit_iast:
nirīhamagryaṃ manasāpyagamyaṃ manomayaṃ cānnamayaṃ nirūḍham /
vijñānabhedaṃ pratipannakalpaṃ na vāṅmayaṃ prāṇamayaṃ bhajāmi //
meaning:
निरीहमग्र्यं मनसाप्यगम्यं मनोमयं चान्नमयं निरूढम् /
विज्ञानभेदं प्रतिपन्नकल्पं न वाङ्मयं प्राणमयं भजामि //
text_mt: Free of desire, the foremost, ungraspable even by the mind, made of mind and firmly rooted as made of food, / possessing distinctions of consciousness, assuming all forms, not made of speech, made of breath: [him] I worship.

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya rūpaṃ na balaprabhāvo na yasya karmāṇi na yatpramāṇam /
jānanti devā kamalodbhavādyastoṣyāmyahaṃ taṃ kathamātmarūpam //
meaning:
न यस्य रूपं न बलप्रभावो न यस्य कर्माणि न यत्प्रमाणम् /
जानन्ति देवा कमलोद्भवाद्यस्तोष्याम्यहं तं कथमात्मरूपम् //
text_mt: Whose form, strength, majesty, deeds, and measure / the gods beginning with the lotus-born [Brahmā] do not know—how shall I praise him whose nature is the Self?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasidhau patitaṃ kadaryaṃ mohākulaṃ kāmaśatena baddham /
akīrtibhājaṃ piśunaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ sadāśuciṃ pāparataṃ pramanyum /
dayāṃbudhe pāhi bhayākulaṃ māṃ punaḥ punastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
संसारसिधौ पतितं कदर्यं मोहाकुलं कामशतेन बद्धम् /
अकीर्तिभाजं पिशुनं कृतघ्नं सदाशुचिं पापरतं प्रमन्युम् /
दयांबुधे पाहि भयाकुलं मां पुनः पुनस्त्वां शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt: Fallen into the ocean of saṃsāra, wretched, bewildered by delusion, bound by hundreds of desires, / bearing ill fame, malicious, ungrateful, ever impure, devoted to sin, enraged— / O ocean of compassion, protect me, bewildered by fear; again and again I take refuge in you!

sanskrit_iast:
iti prasāditastena dayālasuḥ kamalāpatiḥ /
pratyakṣatāmagāttasya bhagavāṃstejasāṃ nidhiḥ //
meaning:
इति प्रसादितस्तेन दयालसुः कमलापतिः /
प्रत्यक्षतामगात्तस्य भगवांस्तेजसां निधिः //
text_mt: Thus propitiated by him, the compassionate Lord of Kamalā, / the Blessed Lord, a treasure of splendours, became visible to him.

sanskrit_iast:
atasī puṣpasaṃkāśaṃ phullapaṅkajalocanan /
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ hārakeyūrabhūṣitam //
meaning:
अतसी पुष्पसंकाशं फुल्लपङ्कजलोचनन् /
किरीटिनं कुण्डलिनं हारकेयूरभूषितम् //
text_mt: [Resembling] the flax flower, with eyes like blooming lotuses, / wearing a diadem, adorned with earrings, necklaces, and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsakaustubhadharaṃ hemayajñopavītinanam /
nāsāvinyastamuktā bhavardhamānatanucchavim //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभधरं हेमयज्ञोपवीतिननम् /
नासाविन्यस्तमुक्ता भवर्धमानतनुच्छविम् //
text_mt: Bearing the Śrīvatsa and the Kaustubha, wearing a golden sacred thread, / the radiance of his body enhanced by a pearl placed on his nose,

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣimat /
tulasīkomaladalairarcitāṅghniṃ mahādyutim //
meaning:
पीतांबरधरं देवं वनमालाविभूषिमत् /
तुलसीकोमलदलैरर्चिताङ्घ्निं महाद्युतिम् //
text_mt: Wearing yellow garments, the god adorned with a garland of forest flowers, / his feet worshipped with tender tulasī leaves, possessed of great splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇīnūpurā dyaiśca śobhitaṃ garuḍadhvajam /
dṛṣṭvā nānāma viprendro daṇḍavatkṣitimaṇḍale //
meaning:
किङ्किणीनूपुरा द्यैश्च शोभितं गरुडध्वजम् /
दृष्ट्वा नानाम विप्रेन्द्रो दण्डवत्क्षितिमण्डले //
text_mt: Adorned with bells, anklets, and the like, with the emblem of Garuḍa— / seeing him, the foremost of brāhmaṇas fell prostrate like a stick upon the circle of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaṣiñcaddhareḥ pādāvuttaṅko harṣavāribhiḥ /
murāre rakṣa rakṣeti vyāharannānyadhīstadā //
meaning:
अभ्यषिञ्चद्धरेः पादावुत्तङ्को हर्षवारिभिः /
मुरारे रक्ष रक्षेति व्याहरन्नान्यधीस्तदा //
text_mt: Uttaṅka bathed Hari's feet with tears of joy, / crying, 'O Murāri, protect me, protect me!' with a single-pointed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tamutthāpya mahāviṣṇurāliliṅga dayāparaḥ /
varaṃ vṛṇuṣva vatseti provāca munipuṅgavam //
meaning:
तमुत्थाप्य महाविष्णुरालिलिङ्ग दयापरः /
वरं वृणुष्व वत्सेति प्रोवाच मुनिपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt: Lifting him up, Mahāviṣṇu, filled with compassion, embraced him, / and said to that best of sages: 'Choose a boon, my child!'

sanskrit_iast:
asādhyaṃ nāsti kiñcitte prasanne mayi sattama /
itīritaṃ samākarṇya hyuttaṅkaścakrapāṇinā /
punaḥ praṇamya taṃ prāha devadevaṃ janārddanam //
meaning:
असाध्यं नास्ति किञ्चित्ते प्रसन्ने मयि सत्तम /
इतीरितं समाकर्ण्य ह्युत्तङ्कश्चक्रपाणिना /
पुनः प्रणम्य तं प्राह देवदेवं जनार्द्दनम् //
text_mt: Hearing this spoken by the Discus-Bearer: 'There is nothing unachievable for you when I am pleased, O best of men,' / Uttaṅka bowed once more to that God of gods, Janārdana, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ māṃ mohayasīśa tvaṃ kimanyairdeva me varaiḥ /
tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā me 'stu janmajanmāntareṣvapi //
meaning:
किं मां मोहयसीश त्वं किमन्यैर्देव मे वरैः /
त्वयि भक्तिर्दृढा मे ऽस्तु जन्मजन्मान्तरेष्वपि //
text_mt: 'Why do you bewilder me, O Lord? What use have I for other boons, O God? / May I have steadfast devotion to you, even in birth after birth!

sanskrit_iast: kīṭeṣu pakṣiṣu mṛgeṣu sarīsṛpeṣu rakṣaḥ piśācamanujeṣvapi yatra tatrajajātasya me bhavatu keśava te prasāddāttvayyeva bhaktiracalāvyabhicāraṇī ca //
meaning: कीटेषु पक्षिषु मृगेषु सरीसृपेषु रक्षः पिशाचमनुजेष्वपि यत्र तत्रजजातस्य मे भवतु केशव ते प्रसाद्दात्त्वय्येव भक्तिरचलाव्यभिचारणी च //
text_mt: Among insects, birds, beasts, reptiles, rākṣasas, piśācas, or men—wherever I may be born, / O Keśava, by your grace, may I have unswerving and unwavering devotion to you alone!'

sanskrit_iast: evamastviti lokeśaḥ śaṅkhaprāntena saṃspṛśan divyajñānaṃ dadau tasmai yogināmapidurlamabhagham //
meaning: एवमस्त्विति लोकेशः शङ्खप्रान्तेन संस्पृशन् दिव्यज्ञानं ददौ तस्मै योगिनामपिदुर्लमभघम् //
text_mt: Saying 'So be it,' the Lord of the world, touching him with the tip of his conch, / gave him divine knowledge, difficult of attainment even for yogins.

sanskrit_iast: puḥ stuvantaṃ viprendraṃ devadevo janārddanaḥ idamāha smitamukho hastaṃ tacchirasi nyasan //
meaning: पुः स्तुवन्तं विप्रेन्द्रं देवदेवो जनार्द्दनः इदमाह स्मितमुखो हस्तं तच्छिरसि न्यसन् //
text_mt: To that foremost of brāhmaṇas who praised him again, the God of gods, Janārdana, / with a smiling face, placing his hand upon his head, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca ārādhaya kriyāyogairmāṃ sadā dvijasattam /
naranārāyaṇasthānaṃ vraja mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच आराधय क्रियायोगैर्मां सदा द्विजसत्तम् /
नरनारायणस्थानं व्रज मोक्षं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Worship me constantly through kriyāyoga, O best of the twice-born; / go to the abode of Nara and Nārāyaṇa, and you shall attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā kṛtamidaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhetsatataṃ naraḥ /
sarvānkāmānavāpyānte mokṣabhāgī bhavettataḥ //
meaning:
त्वया कृतमिदं स्तोत्रं यः पठेत्सततं नरः /
सर्वान्कामानवाप्यान्ते मोक्षभागी भवेत्ततः //
text_mt: The person who continually recites this hymn composed by you / will obtain all desires and thereafter become an enjoyer of liberation.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhādhavo vipraṃ tatraivāntardadhe mune /
naranarāyaṇasthānamuttaṅko 'pi tato yayau //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भाधवो विप्रं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे मुने /
नरनरायणस्थानमुत्तङ्को ऽपि ततो ययौ //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to the brāhmaṇa, O sage, Mādhava disappeared right there; / and Uttaṅka also then departed for the abode of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kasmādbhaktiḥ sadā kāryā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ /
haribhaktiḥ parā proktā sarvakāmapalapradā //
meaning:
कस्माद्भक्तिः सदा कार्या देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः /
हरिभक्तिः परा प्रोक्ता सर्वकामपलप्रदा //
text_mt: Therefore, devotion should ever be offered to the Discus-Bearer, the God of gods; / devotion to Hari is declared to be supreme, granting the fruits of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
utaṅko bhāktibhāvena kriyāyogaparo mune /
pūjayanmādhayavaṃ nityaṃ naranārāyaṇāśrame //
meaning:
उतङ्को भाक्तिभावेन क्रियायोगपरो मुने /
पूजयन्माधयवं नित्यं नरनारायणाश्रमे //
text_mt: Uttaṅka, with a spirit of devotion, intent on kriyāyoga, O sage, / constantly worshipped Mādhava in the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānavijñānasaṃpannaḥ saṃcchinnadvaitasaṃśayaḥ /
āvāpa duravāpaṃ vai tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसंपन्नः संच्छिन्नद्वैतसंशयः /
आवाप दुरवापं वै तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Endowed with knowledge and realization, his doubts regarding duality severed, / he truly attained that difficult-to-attain supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjito namito vāpi saṃsmṛto vāpi mokṣadaḥ /
nārāyaṇo jagannātho bhaktānāṃ mānavarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
पूजितो नमितो वापि संस्मृतो वापि मोक्षदः /
नारायणो जगन्नाथो भक्तानां मानवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: Worshipped, bowed to, or remembered, he grants liberation: / Nārāyaṇa, the Lord of the universe, who increases the honour of his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ devamanantamaparājitam /
ihāmutra sukhaprepsuḥ pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्नारायणं देवमनन्तमपराजितम् /
इहामुत्र सुखप्रेप्सुः पूजयेद्भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: Therefore, desiring happiness in this world and the next, one should, endowed with devotion, / worship the god Nārāyaṇa, the infinite, the unconquered.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhedidamākhyānaṃ śṛṇuyādvāsamāhitaḥ /
so 'pi sarvāghanirmuktaḥ prayāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यः पठेदिदमाख्यानं शृणुयाद्वासमाहितः /
सो ऽपि सर्वाघनिर्मुक्तः प्रयाति भवनं हरेः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे विष्णुमाहात्म्यं नामाष्टत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever reads or hears this narrative with a concentrated mind / is also freed from all sins and goes to the abode of Hari.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, named 'The Eulogy of Viṣṇu's Greatness', in the first quarter of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
bhūyaḥ śṛṇuṣva viprendra māhātmyaṃ parameṣṭinaḥ /
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
भूयः शृणुष्व विप्रेन्द्र माहात्म्यं परमेष्टिनः /
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
Listen again, O best of Brahmins, to the eulogy of greatness of the supreme lord,
which removes all sins, is holy, and grants enjoyment and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
aho harikathā loke pāpaghnī puṇyadāyinī /
śṛṇvatāṃ vadatāṃ caiva tadbhaktānāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अहो हरिकथा लोके पापघ्नी पुण्यदायिनी /
शृण्वतां वदतां चैव तद्भक्तानां विशेषतः //
text_mt:
Ah, the discourse about Hari in the world destroys sins and bestows merit,
especially for those who hear it and speak it, and for his devotees!

sanskrit_iast:
haribhaktirasāsvādamuditā ye narottamāḥ /
namaskaromyahaṃ tebhyo yatsaṃgānmukti bhāgnaraḥ //
meaning:
हरिभक्तिरसास्वादमुदिता ये नरोत्तमाः /
नमस्करोम्यहं तेभ्यो यत्संगान्मुक्ति भाग्नरः //
text_mt:
To those best among men who rejoice in savoring the nectar of devotion to Hari,
I bow down to them, by contact with whom a man attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
haribhaktiparā ye tu harināmaparāyaṇāḥ /
durvṛttā vā suvṛttā vā tebhyo nityaṃ namonamaḥ //
meaning:
हरिभक्तिपरा ये तु हरिनामपरायणाः /
दुर्वृत्ता वा सुवृत्ता वा तेभ्यो नित्यं नमोनमः //
text_mt:
Those devoted to devotion to Hari and dedicated to the name of Hari,
whether ill-conducted or well-conducted, to them be homage again and again forever!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ ya icchenmu nipuṅgava /
sa bhajeddharibhaktānāṃ bhaktānvai pāpahāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
संसारसागरं तर्तुं य इच्छेन्मु निपुङ्गव /
स भजेद्धरिभक्तानां भक्तान्वै पापहारिणः //
text_mt:
Whoever desires to cross the ocean of mundane existence, O foremost sage,
should revere the devotees of Hari's devotees, who remove sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭaḥ smṛtaḥ pūjito vā dhyātaḥ praṇamito 'pi vā /
samuddharati govindo dustarādbhava sāgarāt //
meaning:
दृष्टः स्मृतः पूजितो वा ध्यातः प्रणमितो ऽपि वा /
समुद्धरति गोविन्दो दुस्तराद्भव सागरात् //
text_mt:
Seen, remembered, worshiped, meditated upon, or bowed to,
Govinda delivers [one] from the difficult-to-cross ocean of existence.

sanskrit_iast:
svapanbhuñjan vrajaṃstiṣṭannatiṣṭaśca vadaṃstathā /
cintayedyo harernāma tasmai nityaṃ namo namaḥ //
meaning:
स्वपन्भुञ्जन् व्रजंस्तिष्टन्नतिष्टश्च वदंस्तथा /
चिन्तयेद्यो हरेर्नाम तस्मै नित्यं नमो नमः //
text_mt:
Sleeping, eating, walking, standing, sitting, or speaking,
whoever contemplates the name of Hari—to him be homage, homage forever!

sanskrit_iast:
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ viṣṇu bhaktiratātmanām /
yeṣāṃ muktiḥ karasthaiva yogināmapi durlabhā //
meaning:
अहो भाग्यमहो भाग्यं विष्णु भक्तिरतात्मनाम् /
येषां मुक्तिः करस्थैव योगिनामपि दुर्लभा //
text_mt:
Oh, what good fortune! Oh, what good fortune of those souls devoted to devotion to Viṣṇu,
for whom liberation, difficult to attain even for yogins, is right in hand!

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam /
vadatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpa praṇāśanam //
meaning:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् /
वदतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपाप प्रणाशनम् //
text_mt:
In this regard also they relate this ancient narrative,
which destroys all sins for both the tellers and the listeners:

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpurā mahīpālaḥ somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ /
jayadhvaja iti khyāto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
आसीत्पुरा महीपालः सोमवंशसमुद्भवः /
जयध्वज इति ख्यातो नारायणपरायणः //
text_mt:
Formerly there was an earth-protector born of the Lunar lineage,
known as Jayadhvaja, devoted to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇordevālaye nityaṃ saṃmār janaparāyaṇaḥ /
dīpadānarataścaiva sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णोर्देवालये नित्यं संमार् जनपरायणः /
दीपदानरतश्चैव सर्वभूतदयापरः //
text_mt:
He was constantly engaged in sweeping the temple of Viṣṇu,
devoted to offering lamps, and intent on compassion toward all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmahīpālo revātīre manorame /
vicitrakusumopetaṃ kṛtavānviṣṇumandiram //
meaning:
स कदाचिन्महीपालो रेवातीरे मनोरमे /
विचित्रकुसुमोपेतं कृतवान्विष्णुमन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
Once that earth-protector built on the delightful bank of the Revā
a temple of Viṣṇu furnished with various flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra nṛpaśārdūlaḥ sadā saṃmārjane rataḥ /
dīpadānaparaścaiva viśeṣeṇa haripriyaḥ //
meaning:
स तत्र नृपशार्दूलः सदा संमार्जने रतः /
दीपदानपरश्चैव विशेषेण हरिप्रियः //
text_mt:
There that tiger among kings was always engaged in sweeping
and dedicated to offering lamps, especially dear to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
harināmaparo nityaṃ harisaṃsaktamānasaḥ /
paripraṇāmanirato haribhaktajanapriyaḥ //
meaning:
हरिनामपरो नित्यं हरिसंसक्तमानसः /
परिप्रणामनिरतो हरिभक्तजनप्रियः //
text_mt:
Constantly devoted to the name of Hari, his mind fixed on Hari,
intent on offering prostrations, dear to the devotees of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
vītihotra iti khyāto hyāsīttasya purohitaḥ /
jayadhvajasya caritaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ //
meaning:
वीतिहोत्र इति ख्यातो ह्यासीत्तस्य पुरोहितः /
जयध्वजस्य चरितं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागतः //
text_mt:
There was his royal priest, known as Vītihotra,
who, seeing the conduct of Jayadhvaja, was struck with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidupaviṣṭaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ viṣṇutatparam /
apṛcchadvītihotrastu vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
कदाचिदुपविष्टं तं राजानं विष्णुतत्परम् /
अपृच्छद्वीतिहोत्रस्तु वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt:
Once Vītihotra, who had mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences,
asked that king who was seated and devoted to Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
vītihotra uvāca
rājanparamadharmajña haribhaktiparāyaṇa /
viṣṇubhaktimatāṃ puṃsāṃ śreṣṭho 'si bharatarṣabha //
meaning:
वीतिहोत्र उवाच
राजन्परमधर्मज्ञ हरिभक्तिपरायण /
विष्णुभक्तिमतां पुंसां श्रेष्ठो ऽसि भरतर्षभ //
text_mt:
