Vītihotra said:
O king, knower of the highest dharma, devoted to devotion to Hari,
you are the best among men possessing devotion to Viṣṇu, O bull of the Bharatas!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmārjanaparo nityaṃ dīpadānaratastathā /
tanme vada mahābhāga kiṃ tvayā viditaṃ phalam //
meaning:
संमार्जनपरो नित्यं दीपदानरतस्तथा /
तन्मे वद महाभाग किं त्वया विदितं फलम् //
text_mt:
You are constantly intent on sweeping and devoted to offering lamps;
tell me that, O fortunate one: what fruit has been realized by you?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpādanena varttīnāṃ tailasaṃpalādanena ca /
saṃyukto 'si sadā bhadrayadviṣṇorgṛhamārjane //
meaning:
संपादनेन वर्त्तीनां तैलसंपलादनेन च /
संयुक्तो ऽसि सदा भद्रयद्विष्णोर्गृहमार्जने //
text_mt:
By preparing wicks and supplying oil,
you are always occupied, O good one, in sweeping the temple of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
karmāṇyanyāni saṃtyeva viṣṇoḥ prītikarāṇi ca /
tathāpi kiṃ mahābhāga etayoḥ satatodyataḥ //
meaning:
कर्माण्यन्यानि संत्येव विष्णोः प्रीतिकराणि च /
तथापि किं महाभाग एतयोः सततोद्यतः //
text_mt:
There are indeed other deeds that please Viṣṇu;
nevertheless, O fortunate one, why are you constantly engaged in these two?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanā mahāpuṇyaṃ nareśa vidita ca yat /
tad brūhi me guhyatamaṃ prītirmayi tavāsti cet //
meaning:
सर्वात्मना महापुण्यं नरेश विदित च यत् /
तद् ब्रूहि मे गुह्यतमं प्रीतिर्मयि तवास्ति चेत् //
text_mt:
What great merit is known [to you] wholeheartedly, O lord of men,
tell me that most secret thing, if you have affection for me.

sanskrit_iast:
purodhasaivamuktastu prahasansa jayadhvajaḥ /
vinayāvanato bhūtvā provācejaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
पुरोधसैवमुक्तस्तु प्रहसन्स जयध्वजः /
विनयावनतो भूत्वा प्रोवाचेजं कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by the royal priest, that Jayadhvaja, laughing softly
and having bent low with modesty, said this with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
jayadhvaja uvāca
śṛṇuṣva vipraśārdūla mayaivācaritaṃ purā /
jātismaratvājjānāmi śrotṝṇāṃ vismayapradam //
meaning:
जयध्वज उवाच
शृणुष्व विप्रशार्दूल मयैवाचरितं पुरा /
जातिस्मरत्वाज्जानामि श्रोतॄणां विस्मयप्रदम् //

sanskrit_iast:
āsītpurā kṛtayuge brahmansvārociṣeṃ'tare /
raivato nāma viprendro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
आसीत्पुरा कृतयुगे ब्रह्मन्स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे /
रैवतो नाम विप्रेन्द्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt:
Formerly in the Kṛta age, O Brahmin, during the Svārociṣa interval,
there was a best of Brahmins named Raivata, who had mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
ayājyayājakaścaiva sadaiva grāmayojakaḥ /
piśuno niṣṭhuraścaiva hyapaṇyānāṃ ca vikrayī //
meaning:
अयाज्ययाजकश्चैव सदैव ग्रामयोजकः /
पिशुनो निष्ठुरश्चैव ह्यपण्यानां च विक्रयी //
text_mt:
He sacrificed for those not entitled to sacrifice, always caused dissension in villages,
was malicious, harsh, and a seller of prohibited goods.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhakarmācaraṇātparityaktaḥ sa bandhubhiḥ /
daridro duḥkhitaścaiva śīrṇāṅgo vyādhito 'bhavat //
meaning:
निषिद्धकर्माचरणात्परित्यक्तः स बन्धुभिः /
दरिद्रो दुःखितश्चैव शीर्णाङ्गो व्याधितो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
Because of performing forbidden actions, he was abandoned by his kinsmen;
he became poor, wretched, emaciated, and diseased.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadāciddharthaṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ paryaṭan dvijaḥ /
mamāra narmadātīre śvāsakāsaprapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
स कदाचिद्धर्थं तु पृथिव्यां पर्यटन् द्विजः /
ममार नर्मदातीरे श्वासकासप्रपीडितः //
text_mt:
Once, wandering the earth for wealth, that twice-born man
died on the bank of the Narmadā, afflicted by asthma and cough.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminmṛte tasya bhāryā nāmnā bandhumatī mune /
kāmacāraparā sā tu parityaktā ca bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्मृते तस्य भार्या नाम्ना बन्धुमती मुने /
कामचारपरा सा तु परित्यक्ता च बन्धुभिः //
text_mt:
When he died, his wife, named Bandhumatī, O sage,
followed her wanton desires and was abandoned by her kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jāto 'smi caṇḍālo daṇḍaketuriti śrutaḥ /
mahāpāparato nityaṃ brahmadveṣaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यां जातो ऽस्मि चण्डालो दण्डकेतुरिति श्रुतः /
महापापरतो नित्यं ब्रह्मद्वेषपरायणः //
text_mt:
From her I was born as an outcaste, known as Daṇḍaketu,
constantly devoted to great sin, intent on hatred of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
paradāraparadravyalolupo jantuhiṃsakaḥ /
gāvaśca viprā bahavo nihatā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
परदारपरद्रव्यलोलुपो जन्तुहिंसकः /
गावश्च विप्रा बहवो निहता मृगपक्षिणः //
text_mt:
Covetous of other men's wives and other men's property, an injurer of living beings,
by whom many cows, Brahmins, deer, and birds were killed.

sanskrit_iast:
merutulyasuvarṇāni bahūnyapahṛtāni ca /
madyapānarato nityaṃ bahuśo mārgarodhakṛt //
meaning:
मेरुतुल्यसुवर्णानि बहून्यपहृतानि च /
मद्यपानरतो नित्यं बहुशो मार्गरोधकृत् //
text_mt:
Much gold equal to Mount Meru was stolen [by me];
constantly addicted to drinking liquor, frequently a blocker of the road.

sanskrit_iast:
paśupakṣimṛgādīnāṃ jantūnāmantakopamaḥ /
kadācitkāmasaṃtapto gantu kāmo ratiṃ striyaḥ //
meaning:
पशुपक्षिमृगादीनां जन्तूनामन्तकोपमः /
कदाचित्कामसंतप्तो गन्तु कामो रतिं स्त्रियः //
text_mt:
Like the God of Death to beasts, birds, deer, and other living creatures;
once, tormented by lust, wishing to engage in sexual union with a woman,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ viṣṇugṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvā praviṣṭaśca striyā saha /
niśi rāmopabhogārthaṃ śayitaṃ tatra kāminā //
meaning:
शून्यं विष्णुगृहं दृष्ट्वा प्रविष्टश्च स्त्रिया सह /
निशि रामोपभोगार्थं शयितं तत्र कामिना //
text_mt:
and seeing a deserted house of Viṣṇu, I entered with the woman;
at night, in order to enjoy the lovely woman, [I] lay there as a passionate lover.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmansvavastraprāntena kiyaddeśaḥ pramārjitaḥ /
yāvantyaḥ pāṃśukaṇikāstatra saṃmārjitā dvija //
meaning:
ब्रह्मन्स्ववस्त्रप्रान्तेन कियद्देशः प्रमार्जितः /
यावन्त्यः पांशुकणिकास्तत्र संमार्जिता द्विज //
text_mt:
O Brahmin, with the hem of my garment some space was wiped clean;
as many specks of dust as were swept away there, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvajjanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadaiva kṣayamāgatam /
pradīpaḥ sthāpitastatra suratārthaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
तावज्जन्मकृतं पापं तदैव क्षयमागतम् /
प्रदीपः स्थापितस्तत्र सुरतार्थं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
the sin committed over that many births was wiped out right then!
A lamp was set up there for the sake of sexual intercourse, O best of the twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
tenāpi mama duṣkarma niḥśeṣaṃ kṣayamāgatam /
evaṃ sthite viṣṇugṛhe hyāgatāḥ purapālakāḥ //
meaning:
तेनापि मम दुष्कर्म निःशेषं क्षयमागतम् /
एवं स्थिते विष्णुगृहे ह्यागताः पुरपालकाः //
text_mt:
by that too, my evil deeds were completely brought to an end.
While we were thus staying in the house of Viṣṇu, the city-guards arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
jāro 'yamiti māṃ tāṃ ca hatavantaḥ prasahya vai /
āvāṃ nihatya te sarve nivṛttāḥ purakṣakāḥ //
meaning:
जारो ऽयमिति मां तां च हतवन्तः प्रसह्य वै /
आवां निहत्य ते सर्वे निवृत्ताः पुरक्षकाः //
text_mt:
Saying, ‘This is an adulterer!’ they forcefully killed me and her;
having killed the two of us, all those city-guards turned back.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tadaiva saṃprāptā viṣṇudūtāścaturbhujāḥ /
kirīṭakuṇḍaladharā vanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
यदा तदैव संप्राप्ता विष्णुदूताश्चतुर्भुजाः /
किरीटकुण्डलधरा वनमालाविभूषिताः //
text_mt:
Just then the four-armed messengers of Viṣṇu arrived,
wearing crowns and earrings, and adorned with forest-flower garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
taistu saṃpreritāvāvāṃ viṣṇudūtairakalmaṣaiḥ /
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya sarvabhogasamanvitam //
meaning:
तैस्तु संप्रेरितावावां विष्णुदूतैरकल्मषैः /
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य सर्वभोगसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
Impelled by those spotless messengers of Viṣṇu,
having mounted a divine aerial chariot equipped with all enjoyments,

sanskrit_iast:
divyadehadharau bhūtvā viṣṇulokamupāgatau /
tatra sthitvā brahmakalpaśataṃ sāgraṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
दिव्यदेहधरौ भूत्वा विष्णुलोकमुपागतौ /
तत्र स्थित्वा ब्रह्मकल्पशतं साग्रं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
assuming divine bodies, we reached the world of Viṣṇu.
Having stayed there for fully a hundred Kalpas of Brahmā, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
divyabhogasamāyuktau tāvatkālaṃ divi sthitau /
tataśca bhūmibhāgeṣu devayogeṣu vai kramāt //
meaning:
दिव्यभोगसमायुक्तौ तावत्कालं दिवि स्थितौ /
ततश्च भूमिभागेषु देवयोगेषु वै क्रमात् //
text_mt:
accompanied by divine enjoyments, we dwelt in heaven for so long a time;
and then, gradually in various parts of the earth among connections with the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa yadūnāṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ /
tenaiva me 'cyutā saṃpattathā rājyamakaṇṭakam //
meaning:
तेन पुण्यप्रभावेण यदूनां वंशसंभवः /
तेनैव मे ऽच्युता संपत्तथा राज्यमकण्टकम् //
text_mt:
by the power of that merit, [I had] birth in the lineage of the Yadus;
by that very [merit] I gained unfailing prosperity as well as an unthreatened kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmankṛtvopabhogārthamevaṃ śreyo hyavāptavān /
bhaktyā kurvanti ye saṃtasteṣāṃ puṇyaṃ na vedyaham //
meaning:
ब्रह्मन्कृत्वोपभोगार्थमेवं श्रेयो ह्यवाप्तवान् /
भक्त्या कुर्वन्ति ये संतस्तेषां पुण्यं न वेद्यहम् //
text_mt:
O Brahmin, having done [that] merely for enjoyment, I attained such welfare!
I do not even know the merit of those good people who perform [it] with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃmārjane nityaṃ dīpadāne ca sattama /
yatiṣye parayā bhaktyā hyahaṃ jātismaro yataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्संमार्जने नित्यं दीपदाने च सत्तम /
यतिष्ये परया भक्त्या ह्यहं जातिस्मरो यतः //
text_mt:
Therefore, O best of men, I will constantly strive in sweeping
and in offering lamps with supreme devotion, since I remember my past lives.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pūjayejjagannāthamekākī vigataspṛhaḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
यः पूजयेज्जगन्नाथमेकाकी विगतस्पृहः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्रयाति परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Whoever worships the Lord of the Universe alone, free from desire,
is liberated from all sins and goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśenāpi yatkarma kṛtvemāṃ śriyamāgataḥ /
bhaktibhadbhiḥ praśāntaiśca kiṃ punaḥ samyagarcanāt //
meaning:
अवशेनापि यत्कर्म कृत्वेमां श्रियमागतः /
भक्तिभद्भिः प्रशान्तैश्च किं पुनः सम्यगर्चनात् //
text_mt:
When by an act done even involuntarily I attained this glory,
what need be said of [the result] from proper worship by peaceful people endowed with devotion?

sanskrit_iast:
iti bhūpavacaḥ śrutvā vītihotro dvijottamaḥ /
anantatuṣṭimāpanno haripūjāparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
इति भूपवचः श्रुत्वा वीतिहोत्रो द्विजोत्तमः /
अनन्ततुष्टिमापन्नो हरिपूजापरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
Having heard this speech of the king, Vītihotra, best of the twice-born,
attained boundless satisfaction and became devoted to the worship of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchṛṇuṣva viprendra devo nārāyaṇo 'vyayaḥ /
jñānato 'jñānato vāpi pūjakānāṃ vimuktidaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व विप्रेन्द्र देवो नारायणो ऽव्ययः /
ज्ञानतो ऽज्ञानतो वापि पूजकानां विमुक्तिदः //
text_mt:
Therefore listen, O best of Brahmins: the imperishable god Nārāyaṇa
grants liberation to his worshipers, whether [done] knowingly or unknowingly.

sanskrit_iast:
anityā bāndhavāḥ sarve vibhavo naiva śāśvataḥ /
nityaṃ sannihito mṛtyuḥ kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ //
meaning:
अनित्या बान्धवाः सर्वे विभवो नैव शाश्वतः /
नित्यं सन्निहितो मृत्युः कर्तव्यो धर्मसंग्रहः //
text_mt:
All kinsmen are impermanent, wealth is by no means eternal,
death is ever at hand; an accumulation of dharma must be made.

sanskrit_iast:
ajño loko vṛthā garvaṃ kariṣyati mahoddhataḥ /
kāyaḥ saṃnihitāpāyo dhānādīnāṃ kimucyate //
meaning:
अज्ञो लोको वृथा गर्वं करिष्यति महोद्धतः /
कायः संनिहितापायो धानादीनां किमुच्यते //
text_mt:
An ignorant person, exceedingly arrogant, will take pride in vain;
the body is subject to imminent ruin—what need be said of grain and other possessions?

sanskrit_iast:
janmakoṭisahasreṣu puṇyaṃ yaiḥ samupārjitam /
teṣāṃ bhaktirbhavecchuddhā devadeve janārdane //
meaning:
जन्मकोटिसहस्रेषु पुण्यं यैः समुपार्जितम् /
तेषां भक्तिर्भवेच्छुद्धा देवदेवे जनार्दने //
text_mt:
Only those who have accumulated merit through thousands of crores of births
possess pure devotion toward the god of gods, Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
sulabhaṃ jāhnavī snānaṃ tathevātithipūjanam /
sulabhāḥ sarvayajñāśca viṣṇubhaktiḥ sudurlabhā //
meaning:
सुलभं जाह्नवी स्नानं तथेवातिथिपूजनम् /
सुलभाः सर्वयज्ञाश्च विष्णुभक्तिः सुदुर्लभा //
text_mt:
Bathing in the Gaṅgā is easily attained, and likewise the honoring of guests;
all sacrifices are easily performed, but devotion to Viṣṇu is very difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhā tulasīsevā durlabhaḥ saṃgamaḥ satām /
sarvabhūtadayā vāpi sulabhā yasya kasya cit //
meaning:
दुर्लभा तुलसीसेवा दुर्लभः संगमः सताम् /
सर्वभूतदया वापि सुलभा यस्य कस्य चित् //
text_mt: Rare is service to tulasī; rare is company of the good; / or compassion for all beings is easy only for some rare person.

sanskrit_iast: satsaṃgastulasīsebā haribhaktiśca durlabhā //
meaning: सत्संगस्तुलसीसेबा हरिभक्तिश्च दुर्लभा //
text_mt: Company of the good, service to tulasī, and devotion to Hari are rare.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ prāpyaṃ mānuṣyaṃ na tathā gamayed budhaḥ /
arcayeddhi jagannāthaṃ sārametaddvijottama //
meaning:
दुर्लभं प्राप्यं मानुष्यं न तथा गमयेद् बुधः /
अर्चयेद्धि जगन्नाथं सारमेतद्द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: Having obtained human birth, which is rare, a wise person should not waste it so; / rather, he should worship the Lord of the Universe, for this is the essence, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tarttuṃ yadīcchati jano dustaraṃ bhavasāgaram /
haribhaktiparo bhūyādetadeva rasāyanam //
meaning:
तर्त्तुं यदीच्छति जनो दुस्तरं भवसागरम् /
हरिभक्तिपरो भूयादेतदेव रसायनम् //
text_mt: If a person wishes to cross the ocean of mundane existence, difficult to cross, / he should become devoted to devotion to Hari; this alone is the elixir.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātarāśraya govindaṃ mā vilaṃbaṃ kuru priya /
āsannameva nagaraṃ kṛtāntasya hi dṛśyate //
meaning:
भ्रातराश्रय गोविन्दं मा विलंबं कुरु प्रिय /
आसन्नमेव नगरं कृतान्तस्य हि दृश्यते //
text_mt: O brother, take refuge in Govinda! Do not delay, dear one! / For the city of the Ender of Life [Yama] is already seen nearby.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam /
samarcayasva viprendra yadi bhuktimabhīpsasi //
meaning:
नारायणं जगद्योनिं सर्वकारणकारणम् /
समर्चयस्व विप्रेन्द्र यदि भुक्तिमभीप्ससि //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, the origin of the world, the cause of all causes— / worship Him, O leader of Brahmins, if you desire worldly enjoyment [and liberation].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhāra sarvayoniṃ sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ vibhum /
ye prapannā mahātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाधार सर्वयोनिं सर्वान्तर्यामिणं विभुम् /
ये प्रपन्ना महात्मानस्ते कृतार्था न संशयः //
text_mt: The support of all, the source of all, the inner ruler of all, the omnipresent Lord— / those great-souled ones who have surrendered to Him have achieved their aim; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
te vandyāste prapūjyāśca namaskāryā viśeṣataḥ /
yer'cayanti mahāviṣṇuṃ praṇatārtipraṇāśanam //
meaning:
ते वन्द्यास्ते प्रपूज्याश्च नमस्कार्या विशेषतः /
येर्ऽचयन्ति महाविष्णुं प्रणतार्तिप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: They are to be praised, they are to be revered, and especially to be saluted, / who worship Mahāviṣṇu, the destroyer of the distress of those who bow to Him.

sanskrit_iast:
ye viṣṇubhaktā niṣkāmā yañjati parameśvaram /
triḥsaptakulasaṃyuktā ste yānti harimandiram //
meaning:
ये विष्णुभक्ता निष्कामा यञ्जति परमेश्वरम् /
त्रिःसप्तकुलसंयुक्ता स्ते यान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: The devotees of Viṣṇu who worship the supreme Lord without desire, / joined with twenty-one generations of their family, go to Hari's mansion.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktāya yo dadyānniṣkāmāya mahātmane /
pānīyaṃ vā phalaṃ vāpi sa eva bhagavatpriyaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्ताय यो दद्यान्निष्कामाय महात्मने /
पानीयं वा फलं वापि स एव भगवत्प्रियः //
text_mt: Whoever gives even water or fruit to a great-souled devotee of Viṣṇu / who is free from desire, that person is dear to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktiparāṇāṃ tu śuśrūṣāṃ kurvate tu ye /
te yānti viṣṇubhuvanaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तिपराणां तु शुश्रूषां कुर्वते तु ये /
ते यान्ति विष्णुभुवनं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: Those who perform service to those intent on devotion to Viṣṇu / go to the world of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
ye yañjati spṛhāśūnyā haribhaktān hariṃ tathā /
ta eva bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ puṃnati svāṅghripāṃśunā //
meaning:
ये यञ्जति स्पृहाशून्या हरिभक्तान् हरिं तथा /
त एव भुवनं सर्वं पुंनति स्वाङ्घ्रिपांशुना //
text_mt: Those who, free of desire, worship Hari's devotees as well as Hari, / purify the entire world with the dust of their feet.

sanskrit_iast:
devapūjāparo yasya gṛhe vasati sarvadā /
tatraiva sarvadevāśca tiṣṭanti śrīharistathā //
meaning:
देवपूजापरो यस्य गृहे वसति सर्वदा /
तत्रैव सर्वदेवाश्च तिष्टन्ति श्रीहरिस्तथा //
text_mt: In whose house one devoted to the worship of God always resides, / right there dwell all the gods, and so does Śrī Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyamānā ca tulasī yasya tiṣṭati veśmani /
tatra sarvāṇi śreyāṃsi varddhatyaharahardvija //
meaning:
पूज्यमाना च तुलसी यस्य तिष्टति वेश्मनि /
तत्र सर्वाणि श्रेयांसि वर्द्धत्यहरहर्द्विज //
text_mt: And in whose dwelling tulasī stays, being worshipped, / there all blessings increase day by day, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilārūpī yatra tiṣṭati keśavaḥ /
na bādhante grahāstatra bhūtavetāla kādayaḥ //
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलारूपी यत्र तिष्टति केशवः /
न बाधन्ते ग्रहास्तत्र भूतवेताल कादयः //
text_mt: Where Keśava resides in the form of a śālagrāma stone, / there planets, bhūtas, vetālas, and other [evil spirits] do not torment.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilā yatra tattīrthaṃ tattapovanam /
yataḥ saṃnihitastatra bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
शालग्रामशिला यत्र तत्तीर्थं तत्तपोवनम् /
यतः संनिहितस्तत्र भगवान्मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Where the śālagrāma stone is, that is a sacred ford, that is a penance grove, / because the blessed Madhusūdana is present there.

sanskrit_iast:
yadgṛhe nāsti devarṣe śālagrāmaśilārcanam /
śmaśānasadṛśaṃ vidyāttada gṛhaṃ śubhavārjitam //
purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsā dharmaśāstrāṇi ca dvija //
meaning:
यद्गृहे नास्ति देवर्षे शालग्रामशिलार्चनम् /
श्मशानसदृशं विद्यात्तद गृहं शुभवार्जितम् //
पुराणन्यायमीमांसा धर्मशास्त्राणि च द्विज //
text_mt: In whose house there is no worship of the śālagrāma stone, O divine sage, / one should know that house to be like a cremation ground, devoid of auspiciousness. / Purāṇas, Nyāya, Mīmāṃsā, and Dharmaśāstras, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast: sāṃgā vedāstathā sarve viṣṇorūpaṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning: सांगा वेदास्तथा सर्वे विष्णोरूपं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: as well as all the Vedas with their auxiliary limbs, are proclaimed to be the form of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā kurvanti ye viṣṇoḥ pradakṣiṇacatuṣṭayam /
te 'pi yānti paraṃ sthānaṃ sarvakarmanibarhaṇam //
iti bṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathama pāde viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ nāma ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
भक्त्या कुर्वन्ति ये विष्णोः प्रदक्षिणचतुष्टयम् /
ते ऽपि यान्ति परं स्थानं सर्वकर्मनिबर्हणम् //
इति बृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथम पादे विष्णुमाहात्म्यं नाम एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those who perform four circumambulations of Viṣṇu with devotion, / they too go to the supreme abode, the destroyer of all karmic actions.

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, named Viṣṇumāhātmya, in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vibhūtiṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ mune /
yāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kīrtayatāṃ sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavet //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि विभूतिं वैष्णवीं मुने /
यां शृण्वतां कीर्तयतां सद्यः पापक्षयो भवेत् //
text_mt: Sanaka said: / Henceforth I shall declare the Vaiṣṇava splendour, O sage, / hearing and chanting which causes the immediate destruction of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvateṃ'tare pūrvaṃ śakrasya ca bṛhaspateḥ /
saṃvādaḥ sumahānāsīttaṃ vakṣyāmi niśāmaya //
meaning:
वैवस्वतेंऽतरे पूर्वं शक्रस्य च बृहस्पतेः /
संवादः सुमहानासीत्तं वक्ष्यामि निशामय //
text_mt: Formerly, in the Vaivasvata interval, there was a great dialogue / between Śakra and Bṛhaspati; I shall relate it, listen.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā sarvabhogāḍhyo vibudhaiḥ parivāritaḥ /
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇo bṛhaspatimabhāṣata //
meaning:
एकदा सर्वभोगाढ्यो विबुधैः परिवारितः /
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णो बृहस्पतिमभाषत //
text_mt: Once, rich in all enjoyments, surrounded by the gods, / crowded by crowds of apsarases, he spoke to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
bṛhaspate mahābhāga sarvatattvārthakovida /
atītabrahmaṇaḥ kalpe sṛṣṭiḥ kīdṛgvidhā prabho //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
बृहस्पते महाभाग सर्वतत्त्वार्थकोविद /
अतीतब्रह्मणः कल्पे सृष्टिः कीदृग्विधा प्रभो //
text_mt: Indra said: / O fortunate Bṛhaspati, knower of all true principles, / what was the creation like in the kalpa of the past Brahmā, O Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
indrastu kīdṛśaḥ prokto vivudhāḥ kīdṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ /
teṣāṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ karma yathāvadvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
इन्द्रस्तु कीदृशः प्रोक्तो विवुधाः कीदृशाः स्मृताः /
तेषां च कीदृशं कर्म यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: What kind of Indra was described? What kind were the gods said to be? / And what was their action like? You ought to speak accurately.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
na jñāyate mayā śakra pūrvedyuścaritaṃ vidheḥ /
vartamānadinasyāpi durjñeyaṃ pratibhāti me //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
न ज्ञायते मया शक्र पूर्वेद्युश्चरितं विधेः /
वर्तमानदिनस्यापि दुर्ज्ञेयं प्रतिभाति मे //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / The conduct of Brahmā on former days is not known by me, O Śakra; / even that of the present day appears difficult for me to know.

sanskrit_iast:
manavaḥ samatītāśca tānvaktumapi na kṣamaḥ /
yo vijānāti taṃ te 'dya kathayāmi niśāmaya //
meaning:
मनवः समतीताश्च तान्वक्तुमपि न क्षमः /
यो विजानाति तं ते ऽद्य कथयामि निशामय //
text_mt: Nor am I capable of describing the Manus who have passed away. / Who knows it, that person I will tell you today; listen.

sanskrit_iast:
sudharma iti vikhyātaḥ kaścidāste pure tava /
bhuñjāno divyabhogāṃśca brahmalokādihāgataḥ //
meaning:
सुधर्म इति विख्यातः कश्चिदास्ते पुरे तव /
भुञ्जानो दिव्यभोगांश्च ब्रह्मलोकादिहागतः //
text_mt: Renowned as Sudharmā, a certain one lives in your city, / enjoying divine pleasures, having come here from the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vā eta dvijānāti kathayāmi niśāmaya /
evamuktastu guruṇā śakrastena samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
स वा एत द्विजानाति कथयामि निशामय /
एवमुक्तस्तु गुरुणा शक्रस्तेन समन्वितः //
text_mt: He indeed knows this; I shall speak, listen. / Having been thus addressed by the preceptor, Śakra, accompanied by him,

sanskrit_iast: devatāgaṇasaṃkīrṇaḥ sudharmanilayaṃ yayau //
meaning: देवतागणसंकीर्णः सुधर्मनिलयं ययौ //
text_mt: surrounded by the hosts of deities, went to the abode of Sudharmā.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgataṃ devapatiṃ bṛhaspatisamanvitam /
dṛṣṭvā yathārhaṃ devarṣe pūjayāmāsa sādaram //
meaning:
समागतं देवपतिं बृहस्पतिसमन्वितम् /
दृष्ट्वा यथार्हं देवर्षे पूजयामास सादरम् //
text_mt: Seeing the lord of the gods arrived, accompanied by Bṛhaspati, / he worshipped them with respect according to their worth, O divine sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sudharmeṇārcitaḥ śaṅkro dṛṣṭvā tacchriyamuttamām /
manasā vismayāviṣṭaḥ provāca vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
सुधर्मेणार्चितः शङ्क्रो दृष्ट्वा तच्छ्रियमुत्तमाम् /
मनसा विस्मयाविष्टः प्रोवाच विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: Śakra, worshipped by Sudharmā, seeing his excellent splendour, / was seized with wonder in his mind and spoke, filled with humility.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
atītabrahmakalpasya vṛttāntaṃ vetsi cedbudha /
tadākhyāhi samāyāta etatpraṣṭuṃ sayājakaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
अतीतब्रह्मकल्पस्य वृत्तान्तं वेत्सि चेद्बुध /
तदाख्याहि समायात एतत्प्रष्टुं सयाजकः //
text_mt: Indra said: / If you know the account of the past Brahmā-kalpa, O wise one, / then relate it; I have come together with my priest to ask this.

sanskrit_iast:
gatanidrāṃśca devāṃśca yena jānāsi suvrata /
tadvadasvādhikaḥ kasmādasmadbhyo 'pi divi sthitaḥ //
meaning:
गतनिद्रांश्च देवांश्च येन जानासि सुव्रत /
तद्वदस्वाधिकः कस्मादस्मद्भ्यो ऽपि दिवि स्थितः //
text_mt: And how you know the gods who are sleepless, O you of noble vows, / tell that: why do you abide in heaven superior even to us,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasāyaśasā kīrtyā jñānena ca parantapa /
dānena vā tapobhirvā kathametādṛśaḥ prabho //
meaning:
तेजसायशसा कीर्त्या ज्ञानेन च परन्तप /
दानेन वा तपोभिर्वा कथमेतादृशः प्रभो //
text_mt: in splendour, in fame, in renown, and in knowledge, O scorcher of foes, / or by gifts or by austerities? How is it such, O Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto devarājena sudharmā prahasaṃstadā /
provāca vinayāviṣṭaḥ pūrvavṛttaṃ yathāvidhi //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो देवराजेन सुधर्मा प्रहसंस्तदा /
प्रोवाच विनयाविष्टः पूर्ववृत्तं यथाविधि //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the king of the gods, Sudharmā, smiling then, / filled with humility, properly related the past event.

sanskrit_iast:
sudharma uvāca
caturyugasahasrāṇi brahmaṇo dinamucyate /
ekasmin divase śakra manavaśca caturdaśa //
meaning:
सुधर्म उवाच
चतुर्युगसहस्राणि ब्रह्मणो दिनमुच्यते /
एकस्मिन् दिवसे शक्र मनवश्च चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Sudharmā said: / A day of Brahmā is said to be four thousand yugas. / In a single day, O Śakra, there are fourteen Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāścaturdaśa proktā devāśca vividhāḥ pṛthak /
indrāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ manvādīnāṃ ca vāsava //
meaning:
इन्द्राश्चतुर्दश प्रोक्ता देवाश्च विविधाः पृथक् /
इन्द्राणां चैव सर्वेषां मन्वादीनां च वासव //
text_mt: Fourteen Indras are proclaimed, and various gods separately. / And among all the Indras and the Manus and the others, O Vāsava,

sanskrit_iast:
tulyatā tejasā lakṣmyā prabhāveṇa balena ca /
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
तुल्यता तेजसा लक्ष्म्या प्रभावेण बलेन च /
तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: there is equality in brilliance, splendour, power, and strength. / I shall tell their names; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ svārociṣastathā /
uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं ततः स्वारोचिषस्तथा /
उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा //
text_mt: First is Svāyambhuva Manu, then Svārociṣa likewise, / Uttama, Tāmasa, Raivata, and Cākṣuṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvato manuścaiva sūryasāvarṇiraṣṭamaḥ /
navamo dakṣasāvarṇiḥ sarvadevahite rataḥ //
meaning:
वैवस्वतो मनुश्चैव सूर्यसावर्णिरष्टमः /
नवमो दक्षसावर्णिः सर्वदेवहिते रतः //
text_mt: And Vaivasvata Manu, and the eighth is Sūryasāvarṇi; / the ninth is Dakṣasāvarṇi, devoted to the welfare of all the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
daśamo brahmasāvarṇirddharmasāvarṇikastataḥ /
tatastu rudrasāvarṇī rocamānastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दशमो ब्रह्मसावर्णिर्द्धर्मसावर्णिकस्ततः /
ततस्तु रुद्रसावर्णी रोचमानस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt: the tenth is Brahmasāvarṇi, then Dharmasāvarṇika; / then Rudrasāvarṇi; then Rocamāna is remembered;

sanskrit_iast:
bhautyaścaturdaśaḥ prokta ete hi manavaḥ smṛtāḥ /
devānindrāṃśca vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva vibudharṣabha //
meaning:
भौत्यश्चतुर्दशः प्रोक्त एते हि मनवः स्मृताः /
देवानिन्द्रांश्च वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व विबुधर्षभ //
text_mt: Bhautya is declared the fourteenth. These are remembered as the Manus. / I shall tell the gods and the Indras; listen, O bull among the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmā iti samākhyātā devāḥ svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare /
śacīpatiḥ samākhyātasteṣāmindro mahāpatiḥ //
meaning:
यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे /
शचीपतिः समाख्यातस्तेषामिन्द्रो महापतिः //
text_mt: Known as the Yāmas are the gods in the Svāyambhuva interval; / the husband of Śacī is declared to be their Indra, the great master.

sanskrit_iast:
pārāvatāśca tuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣeṃ'tare /
vipaścinnāma devendraṃ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
पारावताश्च तुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषेंऽतरे /
विपश्चिन्नाम देवेन्द्रं सर्वसंपत्समन्वितः //
text_mt: The Pārāvatas and Tuṣitas are the gods in the Svārociṣa interval; / the lord of the gods is named Vipaścit, endowed with all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāmānastathā satyāḥ śivāścāya prartadanāḥ /
teṣāmindraḥ suśāntiśca tṛtīye parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
सुधामानस्तथा सत्याः शिवाश्चाय प्रर्तदनाः /
तेषामिन्द्रः सुशान्तिश्च तृतीये परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: The Sudhāmāns, Satyās, Śivas, and Pratardanas [are the gods]; / and their Indra in the third [manvantara] is proclaimed as Suśānti.

sanskrit_iast:
sutāḥ pārāharāścaiva sutyāścāsudhiyastathā /
teṣāmindraḥ śivaḥ proktaḥ śakrastāmasakeṃ'tare /
vibhānāmā devapatiḥ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
सुताः पाराहराश्चैव सुत्याश्चासुधियस्तथा /
तेषामिन्द्रः शिवः प्रोक्तः शक्रस्तामसकेंऽतरे /
विभानामा देवपतिः पञ्चमः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: The Sutās, Pārāharas, Sutyās, and Asudhis [are the gods]; / their Indra is declared to be Śiva, the Śakra in the Tāmasa interval; / the lord of the gods named Vibhu is declared to be the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
amitābhādayo devāḥ ṣaṣṭhe 'pi ca tathā śṛṇu /
āryādyā vibudhāḥ proktāsteṣā mindro manojavaḥ //
meaning:
अमिताभादयो देवाः षष्ठे ऽपि च तथा शृणु /
आर्याद्या विबुधाः प्रोक्तास्तेषा मिन्द्रो मनोजवः //
text_mt: Amitābha and others are the gods in the sixth; also hear: / the Āryas and others are declared the gods, [and] their Indra is Manojava.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityavasurudrādyā devā vaivasvataṃ'tare /
indraḥ purandaraḥ proktaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
आदित्यवसुरुद्राद्या देवा वैवस्वतंऽतरे /
इन्द्रः पुरन्दरः प्रोक्तः सर्वकामसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
The gods in the Vaivasvata interval are said to be the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, and others;
the Indra is called Purandara, endowed with the fulfillment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyāśca vibudhāḥ sutapādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
viṣṇupūjāprabhāveṇa teṣāmindro baliḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अप्रमेयाश्च विबुधाः सुतपाद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः /
विष्णुपूजाप्रभावेण तेषामिन्द्रो बलिः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
The gods [in the eighth manvantara] are celebrated as the Sutapas and others of immeasurable power;
by virtue of the worship of Viṣṇu, Bali is traditionally known as their Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
pārādyā navame devā indraścādbhuta ucyate /
suvāsanādyā vibudhā daśame parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
पाराद्या नवमे देवा इन्द्रश्चाद्भुत उच्यते /
सुवासनाद्या विबुधा दशमे परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
In the ninth, the gods are the Pāras and others, and the Indra is called Adbhuta;
in the tenth, the gods are celebrated as the Suvāsanas and others.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntirnāma ca tatrendraḥ sarvabhogasamanvitaḥ /
vihṝṅgṝmādyā devāśca teṣāmindro vṛṣaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तिर्नाम च तत्रेन्द्रः सर्वभोगसमन्वितः /
विहॄङ्गॄमाद्या देवाश्च तेषामिन्द्रो वृषः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
And there the Indra is named Śānti, endowed with all enjoyments;
[in the eleventh,] the gods are the Vihangamas and others, and Vṛṣa is recorded as their Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśe dvādaśe tu nibodhakathāyāmi te /
krabhuvanāmā ca devendro harinābhāstathā surāḥ //
meaning:
एकादशे द्वादशे तु निबोधकथायामि ते /
क्रभुवनामा च देवेन्द्रो हरिनाभास्तथा सुराः //
text_mt:
Hear now, I shall tell you of the eleventh and twelfth [manvantaras]:
the lord of gods is named Krabhuva, and the deities are the Harinābhas.

sanskrit_iast:
sutrāmādyāstathā devāstrayodaśatame 'ntare /
divaspatirmahāvīryasteṣāmindraḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
सुत्रामाद्यास्तथा देवास्त्रयोदशतमे ऽन्तरे /
दिवस्पतिर्महावीर्यस्तेषामिन्द्रः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
Likewise, in the thirteenth interval, the gods are the Sutrāmāns and others;
Divaspati of great prowess is proclaimed as their Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśe cākṣupādyā devā indraḥ śuciḥ smṛtaḥ /
evaṃ te manavaḥ proktā indrā devāśca tattvataḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशे चाक्षुपाद्या देवा इन्द्रः शुचिः स्मृतः /
एवं ते मनवः प्रोक्ता इन्द्रा देवाश्च तत्त्वतः //
text_mt:
And in the fourteenth, the gods are the Cākṣupas and others, and Śuci is remembered as Indra;
thus have the Manus, Indras, and deities been described to you according to reality.

sanskrit_iast: ekasminbrahmadivase svādhikāraṃ prabhuñjate //
meaning: एकस्मिन्ब्रह्मदिवसे स्वाधिकारं प्रभुञ्जते //
text_mt: In a single day of Brahmā, they enjoy their sovereign authority.

sanskrit_iast:
lekeṣu sarvasargeṣu sṛṣṭirekavidhā smṛtā /
karttāro bahavaḥ saṃti tatsaṃkhyāṃ vetti kovidaḥ //
meaning:
लेकेषु सर्वसर्गेषु सृष्टिरेकविधा स्मृता /
कर्त्तारो बहवः संति तत्संख्यां वेत्ति कोविदः //
text_mt:
In all the worlds and in every creation, the creation is remembered as uniform;
many are the creators—a wise person knows their number.

sanskrit_iast:
mayi sthite brahmaloke brahmāṇāṃ bahavo gatāḥ /
teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na saṃkhyātu śakto 'smyadya dvijottama //
meaning:
मयि स्थिते ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्माणां बहवो गताः /
तेषां संख्या न संख्यातु शक्तो ऽस्म्यद्य द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
While I have resided in the world of Brahmā, many Brahmās have passed away;
O best of the twice-born, today I am not capable of calculating their number.

sanskrit_iast:
svargalokamapi prāpya yāvatkālaṃ śṛṇuṣva me /
catvāro manavo 'tītā mama śrīścātivistarā //
meaning:
स्वर्गलोकमपि प्राप्य यावत्कालं शृणुष्व मे /
चत्वारो मनवो ऽतीता मम श्रीश्चातिविस्तरा //
text_mt:
Listen to me regarding the length of time since I attained even heaven:
four Manus have passed away, and my fortune has been exceedingly vast.

sanskrit_iast:
sthātavyaṃ ca mayātraiva yugakoṭiśataṃ prabho /
tataḥ paraṃ gamiṣyāmi karmabhūmiṃ śṛṇuṣva me //
meaning:
स्थातव्यं च मयात्रैव युगकोटिशतं प्रभो /
ततः परं गमिष्यामि कर्मभूमिं शृणुष्व मे //
text_mt:
I must remain right here for a hundred crores of yugas, O lord;
after that, I shall go to the land of ritual action—hear [this] from me.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā kṛtaṃ purā karma vakṣyāmi tava suvrata /
vadatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
मया कृतं पुरा कर्म वक्ष्यामि तव सुव्रत /
वदतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt:
I shall tell you the deed performed by me in the past, O you of noble vows,
which destroys all sins for those who recite it and hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamāṃsa purā śakra gṛdhraḥ pāpo viśeṣataḥ /
sthitaśca bhūmibhāge vai amedhyāmiṣabhojanaḥ //
meaning:
अहमांस पुरा शक्र गृध्रः पापो विशेषतः /
स्थितश्च भूमिभागे वै अमेध्यामिषभोजनः //
text_mt:
In the past, O Śakra, I was a vulture, exceedingly sinful,
staying on a portion of the ground, feeding on impure carrion.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadāhaṃ viṣṇugṛhe prākāre saṃsthitaḥ prabho /
patito vyādhaśastreṇa sāyaṃ viṣṇorgṛhāṅgaṇe //
meaning:
एकदाहं विष्णुगृहे प्राकारे संस्थितः प्रभो /
पतितो व्याधशस्त्रेण सायं विष्णोर्गृहाङ्गणे //
text_mt:
Once, O lord, while perched on an enclosure wall of a temple of Viṣṇu,
I fell into the courtyard of Viṣṇu's house at dusk, struck by a hunter's weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
mayi kaṇṭhagataprāṇe bhaṣaṇo māṃsalolupaḥ /
jagrāha māṃ svavakreṇa śvabhiranyaiścarandrutaḥ //
meaning:
मयि कण्ठगतप्राणे भषणो मांसलोलुपः /
जग्राह मां स्ववक्रेण श्वभिरन्यैश्चरन्द्रुतः //
text_mt:
When my life-breath had reached my throat, a barking dog eager for flesh
seized me with its mouth, and was pursued by other dogs.

sanskrit_iast:
vahanmāṃ svamukhenaiva bhīto 'nyairbhaṣaṇaistathā /
gataḥ pradakṣiṇā kāraṃ viṣṇostanmandiraṃ prabho //
meaning:
वहन्मां स्वमुखेनैव भीतो ऽन्यैर्भषणैस्तथा /
गतः प्रदक्षिणा कारं विष्णोस्तन्मन्दिरं प्रभो //
text_mt:
Carrying me in its very mouth, and terrified by those other barking dogs,
it performed a circumambulation of that temple of Viṣṇu, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva tuṣṭimāpanno hyantarātmā jaganmayaḥ /
mama cāpi śunaścāpi dattāvanparamaṃ padam //
meaning:
तेनैव तुष्टिमापन्नो ह्यन्तरात्मा जगन्मयः /
मम चापि शुनश्चापि दत्तावन्परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Thereby the inner Self, who pervades the universe, attained satisfaction,
and granted the supreme abode to both me and the dog.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇā kāratayā gatasyāpīdṛṃ phalam /
saṃprāptaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭha kiṃ punaḥ samyagarcanāt //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणा कारतया गतस्यापीदृं फलम् /
संप्राप्तं विबुधश्रेष्ठ किं पुनः सम्यगर्चनात् //
text_mt:
Even when gone through the motion of a circumambulation, such a fruit
was obtained, O best among the gods; what then [to say] of proper worship?

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto devarājastu sudharmeṇa mahātmanā /
manasā prītimāpanno haripūjā rato 'bhavat //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो देवराजस्तु सुधर्मेण महात्मना /
मनसा प्रीतिमापन्नो हरिपूजा रतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
Having been addressed in this manner by the high-souled Sudharman, the king of gods,
having attained joy in his mind, became devoted to the worship of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi nirjarāḥ sarve bhārate janmalipsavaḥ /
samarcayanti deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam /
tānarcayanti satataṃ brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
तथापि निर्जराः सर्वे भारते जन्मलिप्सवः /
समर्चयन्ति देवेशं नारायणमनामयम् /
तानर्चयन्ति सततं ब्रह्माद्या देवतागणाः //

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇānusmaraṇodyatānāṃ mahātmanāṃ tyaktaparigrahaṇām /
kathaṃ bhavatyugrabhavasya bandhastatsaṅgalubdhā yadi muktibhājaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणानुस्मरणोद्यतानां महात्मनां त्यक्तपरिग्रहणाम् /
कथं भवत्युग्रभवस्य बन्धस्तत्सङ्गलुब्धा यदि मुक्तिभाजः //
text_mt:
How can the bondage of dreadful mundane existence touch high-souled beings who have renounced possessions and are intent on remembering Nārāyaṇa,
if those who merely covet association with them become partakers of liberation?

sanskrit_iast:
ye mānavāḥ pratidinaṃ parimuktasaṅgā nārāyaṇaṃ garuḍavāhanamarcayanti /
te sarvapāpanikaraiḥ parito vimuktā viṣṇoḥ padaṃ śubhataraṃ pratiyānti hṛṣṭāḥ //
meaning:
ये मानवाः प्रतिदिनं परिमुक्तसङ्गा नारायणं गरुडवाहनमर्चयन्ति /
ते सर्वपापनिकरैः परितो विमुक्ता विष्णोः पदं शुभतरं प्रतियान्ति हृष्टाः //
text_mt:
Those men who daily, completely free from attachment, worship Nārāyaṇa whose mount is Garuḍa,
entirely freed from heaps of all sins, joyfully attain the most auspicious abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāvarajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti /
dhyānena tena hatakilbiṣacetanāste mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na punaḥ pibanti //
meaning:
ये मानवा विगतरागपरावरज्ञा नारायणं सुरगुरुं सततं स्मरन्ति /
ध्यानेन तेन हतकिल्बिषचेतनास्ते मातुः पयोधररसं न पुनः पिबन्ति //
text_mt:
Those men who, free from passion and knowing higher and lower truth, constantly remember Nārāyaṇa, the preceptor of the gods—
their consciousness freed from sins by that meditation, they do not drink milk from a mother's breast again.

sanskrit_iast:
ye mānavā harikathāśravaṇāstadoṣāḥ kṛṣṇāṅghrapadmabhajane ratacetanāśca /
te vā puṃnati ca jaganti śarīrasaṃgāt saṃbhāṣaṇādapi tato harireva pūjyaḥ //
meaning:
ये मानवा हरिकथाश्रवणास्तदोषाः कृष्णाङ्घ्रपद्मभजने रतचेतनाश्च /
ते वा पुंनति च जगन्ति शरीरसंगात् संभाषणादपि ततो हरिरेव पूज्यः //
text_mt:
Those men whose faults are dispelled by hearing tales of Hari, and whose minds are devoted to the service of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet,
purify the worlds through contact with their bodies and even through conversation with them; therefore, Hari alone is to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
haripūjāparā yatra mahāntaḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ /
tatraiva sakalaṃ bhadraṃ yathā nimne jalaṃ dvija //
meaning:
हरिपूजापरा यत्र महान्तः शुद्धबुद्धयः /
तत्रैव सकलं भद्रं यथा निम्ने जलं द्विज //
text_mt:
Where high-souled beings of pure intellect are intent on the worship of Hari,
all auspiciousness gathers right there, O twice-born, just as water runs down to low ground.

sanskrit_iast:
harireva paro bandhurharireva parā gatiḥ /
harireva tataḥ pūjyo yataścetanyakāraṇam //
meaning:
हरिरेव परो बन्धुर्हरिरेव परा गतिः /
हरिरेव ततः पूज्यो यतश्चेतन्यकारणम् //
text_mt:
Hari alone is the supreme kinsman; Hari alone is the supreme destination;
therefore, Hari alone is to be worshipped, since he is the cause of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ sadānandaṃ nirāmayam /
pṛjyasya muniśreṣṭha paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं सदानन्दं निरामयम् /
पृज्यस्य मुनिश्रेष्ठ परं श्रेयो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
Worship the bestower of the fruits of heaven and liberation, the eternally blissful, the free from disease, O best of sages;
the supreme good will be yours.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayanti hariṃ ye tu niṣkāmāḥ śuddhamānasāḥ /
teṣāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā sarvānkāmān prayacchati //
meaning:
पूजयन्ति हरिं ये तु निष्कामाः शुद्धमानसाः /
तेषां विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा सर्वान्कामान् प्रयच्छति //
text_mt:
As for those who worship Hari desireless and of pure mind,
Viṣṇu, being pleased in spirit, grants them all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvetacchṛṇuyādvāpi paṭhedvā susamāhitaḥ /
sa prāpnotyaśvamedhasya phalaṃ munivarottama //
meaning:
यस्त्वेतच्छृणुयाद्वापि पठेद्वा सुसमाहितः /
स प्राप्नोत्यश्वमेधस्य फलं मुनिवरोत्तम //
text_mt:
Whoever listens to this or reads it with concentrated mind,
he attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice, O best among eminent sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatte samākhyātaṃ haripūjāphalaṃ dvija /
saṃkocavistarābhyāṃ tu kimanyatkathayāmi te //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde viṣṇumāhātmye catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतत्ते समाख्यातं हरिपूजाफलं द्विज /
संकोचविस्तराभ्यां तु किमन्यत्कथयामि ते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे विष्णुमाहात्म्ये चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus has the fruit of Hari's worship been related to you, O twice-born,
both briefly and in detail; what else shall I tell you?

Thus ends the fortieth chapter, on the eulogy of the greatness of Viṣṇu, in the first quarter of the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
ākhyātaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ mune tattvārtha kovida /
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yugānāṃ sthitilakṣaṇam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
आख्यातं भवता सर्वं मुने तत्त्वार्थ कोविद /
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि युगानां स्थितिलक्षणम् //

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña mune lokopakāraka /
yugadharmānprabakṣyāmi sarvalokopakārakān //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ मुने लोकोपकारक /
युगधर्मान्प्रबक्ष्यामि सर्वलोकोपकारकान् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
Well said, well said, O greatly wise sage, benefactor of the world!
I shall proclaim the dharmas of the yugas, which bring welfare to all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmo vivṛddhimāyāti kāle kasmiṃściduttama /
tathā vināsamāyāti dharṃma eva mahītale //
meaning:
धर्मो विवृद्धिमायाति काले कस्मिंश्चिदुत्तम /
तथा विनासमायाति धर्ंम एव महीतले //
text_mt:
At a certain time, O excellent one, dharma increases;
likewise, dharma comes to destruction on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam /
divyairdvādaśabhirjñeyaṃ vatsaraistatra sattama //
meaning:
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चेति चतुर्युगम् /
दिव्यैर्द्वादशभिर्ज्ञेयं वत्सरैस्तत्र सत्तम //
text_mt:
The cycle of four yugas consists of Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali;
know, O most virtuous one, that it is measured there by twelve divine years [multiplied by thousands].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāsandhyāṃśayuktāni yugāni sadṛśāni vai /
kālato veditavyāni ityuktaṃ tattvā darśibhiḥ //
meaning:
संध्यासन्ध्यांशयुक्तानि युगानि सदृशानि वै /
कालतो वेदितव्यानि इत्युक्तं तत्त्वा दर्शिभिः //
text_mt:
The yugas, together with their twilights and twilight portions,
are to be known according to time; so it is declared by seers of truth.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye kṛtayugaṃ prāhustatastretāvidhānakam /
tataśca dvāparaṃ prāhuḥ kalimantyaṃ viduḥ kramāt //
meaning:
आद्ये कृतयुगं प्राहुस्ततस्त्रेताविधानकम् /
ततश्च द्वापरं प्राहुः कलिमन्त्यं विदुः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
In the beginning, they speak of the Kṛta yuga; then the arrangement of Tretā;
then they speak of Dvāpara; and they recognize Kali as the last in order.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ /
nāsankṛtayuge vipra sarve devasamāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः /
नासन्कृतयुगे विप्र सर्वे देवसमाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
Gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and serpents
did not exist [as distinct] in the Kṛta yuga, O twice-born; all were considered equal to gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve hṛṣṭāśca dharmiṣṭā na tatra krayavikrayau /
vedānāṃ ca vibhāgaśca na yuge kṛtasaṃjñake //
meaning:
सर्वे हृष्टाश्च धर्मिष्टा न तत्र क्रयविक्रयौ /
वेदानां च विभागश्च न युगे कृतसंज्ञके //
text_mt:
All were joyful and righteous; there was neither buying nor selling there,
nor any division of the Vedas in the age known as Kṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ svācāratatparāḥ /
sadā nārāyaṇaparāstapodhyānaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राः स्वाचारतत्पराः /
सदा नारायणपरास्तपोध्यानपरायणाः //
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras were devoted to their own proper conduct,
always intent on Nārāyaṇa, devoted to asceticism and meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmādidoṣanirmuktāḥ śamādiguṇatatparāḥ /
dharmasādhanacittāśca gatāsūyā adāṃbhikāḥ //
meaning:
कामादिदोषनिर्मुक्ताः शमादिगुणतत्पराः /
धर्मसाधनचित्ताश्च गतासूया अदांभिकाः //
text_mt:
Free from defects such as desire, devoted to virtues such as tranquility,
their minds set on the practice of dharma, devoid of malice and free from hypocrisy.

sanskrit_iast:
satyavākyaratāḥ sarve caturāśramadharmiṇaḥ /
vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
सत्यवाक्यरताः सर्वे चतुराश्रमधर्मिणः /
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाः सर्वशास्त्रविचक्षणाः //
text_mt: All were devoted to truthful speech, abiding by the duties of the four stages of life, / endowed with study of the Vedas, and proficient in all treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
caturāśramayuktena karmaṇā kālayoninā /
akāmaphalasaṃyogāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
चतुराश्रमयुक्तेन कर्मणा कालयोनिना /
अकामफलसंयोगाः प्रयान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Through action proper to the four stages of life, born of the right season, / free from attachment to fruits, they attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaḥ kṛtayuge śuklavarṇaḥ sunirmalaḥ /
tretādharmānpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणः कृतयुगे शुक्लवर्णः सुनिर्मलः /
त्रेताधर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: In the Kṛta age, Nārāyaṇa is white-colored and purely stainless. / I shall now declare the duties of the Tretā age; listen with attentive mind:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ pāṇḍuratāṃ yāti tretāyāṃ munisattama /
haristu raktātāṃ yāti kiñcitkleśānvitā janāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मः पाण्डुरतां याति त्रेतायां मुनिसत्तम /
हरिस्तु रक्तातां याति किञ्चित्क्लेशान्विता जनाः //
text_mt: Dharma becomes pale-white in the Tretā age, O best of sages, / while Hari takes on a red hue, and people are attended by a little suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāyogaratāḥ sarve yajñakarmasu niṣṭitāḥ /
satyavratā dhyānaparāḥ sadādhyānaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
क्रियायोगरताः सर्वे यज्ञकर्मसु निष्टिताः /
सत्यव्रता ध्यानपराः सदाध्यानपरायणाः //
text_mt:
All were devoted to the yoga of action and established in sacrificial rites,
true to their vows, intent on meditation, ever dedicated to meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipādo vartate dharmo dvāpare ca munīśvara /
hariḥ pītatvamāyāti vedaścāpi vibhajyate //
meaning:
द्विपादो वर्तते धर्मो द्वापरे च मुनीश्वर /
हरिः पीतत्वमायाति वेदश्चापि विभज्यते //
text_mt:
In Dvāpara, O lord of sages, dharma stands on two feet;
Hari becomes yellow, and the Veda is divided.

sanskrit_iast:
asatyaniratāścāpi kecittatra dvijottamāḥ /
brāhmaṇādyāśca varṇāḥ syuḥ kecidrāgādidurguṇāḥ //
meaning:
असत्यनिरताश्चापि केचित्तत्र द्विजोत्तमाः /
ब्राह्मणाद्याश्च वर्णाः स्युः केचिद्रागादिदुर्गुणाः //
text_mt:
Even some foremost of twice-born men there were addicted to falsehood,
and the varṇas beginning with the brāhmaṇas had some evil qualities such as passion.

sanskrit_iast:
kecitsvargāpavargārthaṃ viprayajñānprakurvate /
keciddhanādikāmāśca kecitkalmaṣacetasaḥ //
meaning:
केचित्स्वर्गापवर्गार्थं विप्रयज्ञान्प्रकुर्वते /
केचिद्धनादिकामाश्च केचित्कल्मषचेतसः //
text_mt:
Some performed sacrifices of the twice-born for the sake of heaven and liberation,
while some desired wealth and the like, and some had contaminated minds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmauṃ samau syātāṃ dvāpare viprasattama /
adharmasya prabhāveṇa kṣīyante ca prajāstathā //
meaning:
धर्माधर्मौं समौ स्यातां द्वापरे विप्रसत्तम /
अधर्मस्य प्रभावेण क्षीयन्ते च प्रजास्तथा //
text_mt:
Dharma and adharma were equal in Dvāpara, O best of twice-born men;
and by the power of adharma, creatures diminished.

sanskrit_iast:
alpāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti keciñcāpi munīśvara /
kecitpuṇyaratān dṛṣṭvā asūyāṃ vipra kurvate //
meaning:
अल्पायुषो भविष्यन्ति केचिञ्चापि मुनीश्वर /
केचित्पुण्यरतान् दृष्ट्वा असूयां विप्र कुर्वते //
text_mt:
Some will be short-lived, O lord of sages,
and seeing those devoted to merit, O twice-born, some feel malice.

sanskrit_iast:
kalisthitiṃ pravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ /
dharmaḥ kaliyuge prāpte pādenaikena vartate //
meaning:
कलिस्थितिं प्रवक्ष्यामि तच्छृणुष्व समाहितः /
धर्मः कलियुगे प्राप्ते पादेनैकेन वर्तते //
text_mt:
I shall proclaim the condition of Kali; hear that with an attentive mind:
When the Kaliyuga arrives, dharma stands on one foot alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasaṃ yugamāsādya hariḥ kṛṣṇatvameti ca /
yaḥ kaścidapi dharmātmā yajñācārānkaroti ca //
meaning:
तामसं युगमासाद्य हरिः कृष्णत्वमेति च /
यः कश्चिदपि धर्मात्मा यज्ञाचारान्करोति च //
text_mt:
Reaching the dark yuga, Hari becomes black.
Whoever may be righteous and perform sacrificial practices,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kaścidapi puṇyātmā kriyāyogarato bhavet /
naraṃ dharmarataṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve 'sūyāṃ prakurvate //
meaning:
यः कश्चिदपि पुण्यात्मा क्रियायोगरतो भवेत् /
नरं धर्मरतं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ऽसूयां प्रकुर्वते //
text_mt:
or whoever may be meritorious and devoted to the yoga of action—
seeing a man devoted to dharma, all show malice toward him.

sanskrit_iast:
vratācārāḥ praṇaśyanti jñānayajñādayastathā /
upadravā bhaviṣyanti hyadharmasya pravatanāt //
meaning:
व्रताचाराः प्रणश्यन्ति ज्ञानयज्ञादयस्तथा /
उपद्रवा भविष्यन्ति ह्यधर्मस्य प्रवतनात् //
text_mt:
Observances of vows and traditional practices perish, as do sacrifices of knowledge and the like;
calamities will arise due to the prevalence of adharma.

sanskrit_iast:
asūyāniratāḥ sarve daṃbhācāraparāyaṇāḥ /
prajāścālpāyuṣaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge //
meaning:
असूयानिरताः सर्वे दंभाचारपरायणाः /
प्रजाश्चाल्पायुषः सर्वा भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे //
text_mt:
All will be intent on malice and dedicated to hypocritical conduct;
and all creatures will be short-lived in the Kaliyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
yugadharmāḥ samākhyātāstvayā saṃkṣepato mune /
kaliṃ vistarato brūhi tvaṃ hi dharmavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
युगधर्माः समाख्यातास्त्वया संक्षेपतो मुने /
कलिं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि त्वं हि धर्मविदां वरः //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
The dharmas of the yugas have been declared briefly by you, O sage.
Tell of Kali in detail, for you are the foremost of those who know dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścamunisattama /
kimāhārāḥ kimācārāḥ bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चमुनिसत्तम /
किमाहाराः किमाचाराः भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे //
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, O best of sages—
what will their food be, and what their conduct in the Kaliyuga?

sanskrit_iast:
sanaka uvāca
śṛṇuṣva muniśārdūla sarvalokopakāraka /
kalidharmānpravakṣyāmi vistareṇa yathātatham //
meaning:
सनक उवाच
शृणुष्व मुनिशार्दूल सर्वलोकोपकारक /
कलिधर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यामि विस्तरेण यथातथम् //
text_mt:
Sanaka said:
Hear, O tiger among sages, benefactor of all the world!
I shall describe the dharmas of Kali in detail, as they truly are.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve dharmā vinaśyanti kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇatvamāgate /
tasmātkalirmahāghoraḥ sarvapātakasaṃkaraḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे धर्मा विनश्यन्ति कृष्णे कृष्णत्वमागते /
तस्मात्कलिर्महाघोरः सर्वपातकसंकरः //
text_mt:
All dharmas perish when Kṛṣṇa has become black;
therefore Kali is extremely dreadful, a mixture of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā dharmaparāṅmukhāḥ /
ghore kaliyuge prāpte dvijā vedaparāṅmukhāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा धर्मपराङ्मुखाः /
घोरे कलियुगे प्राप्ते द्विजा वेदपराङ्मुखाः //
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras turn away from dharma;
when the dreadful Kaliyuga has arrived, the twice-born turn away from the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
vyājadharmaratāḥ sarve asūyāniratāstathā /
vṛthāhṝṅkāraduṣṭāśca satyahīnāśca paṇḍitāḥ //
meaning:
व्याजधर्मरताः सर्वे असूयानिरतास्तथा /
वृथाहॄङ्कारदुष्टाश्च सत्यहीनाश्च पण्डिताः //
text_mt:
All are devoted to deceptive dharma and intent on malice;
and scholars are corrupted by empty pride and devoid of truth.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamevādhika iti sarve 'pi vivadanti ca /
adharmalolupāḥ sarvale tathā vaitaṃhikā narāḥ //
meaning:
अहमेवाधिक इति सर्वे ऽपि विवदन्ति च /
अधर्मलोलुपाः सर्वले तथा वैतंहिका नराः //
text_mt:
They all dispute, saying, “I alone am superior!”;
men are all greedy for adharma and captious disputants.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ svalpāyuṣaḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge /
alpāyuṣṭvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ na vidyāgrahaṇaṃ dvija //
meaning:
अतः स्वल्पायुषः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे /
अल्पायुष्ट्वान्मनुष्याणां न विद्याग्रहणं द्विज //
text_mt:
Hence all will be very short-lived in the Kaliyuga;
because of the short lifespan of men, O twice-born, there is no acquisition of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāgrahaṇaśūnyatvādadharmo vartate punaḥ /
vyātkrameṇa prajāḥ sarvā mniyante pāpatatparāḥ //
meaning:
विद्याग्रहणशून्यत्वादधर्मो वर्तते पुनः /
व्यात्क्रमेण प्रजाः सर्वा म्नियन्ते पापतत्पराः //
text_mt:
Due to the absence of the acquisition of knowledge, adharma prevails again;
all creatures, devoted to sin, die out of proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādyāstathā varṇāḥ saṃkīryante parasparam /
kāmakrodhaparā mūḍhā vṛthāsaṃtāpapīḍitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाद्यास्तथा वर्णाः संकीर्यन्ते परस्परम् /
कामक्रोधपरा मूढा वृथासंतापपीडिताः //
text_mt:
The varṇas beginning with brāhmaṇas become mutually mixed;
intent on lust and anger, foolish, they are afflicted with useless remorse.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdratulyā bhaviṣyanti sarve varṇā kalau yuge /
uttamā nīcatāṃ yānti nīcāścottamatāṃ tathā //
meaning:
शूद्रतुल्या भविष्यन्ति सर्वे वर्णा कलौ युगे /
उत्तमा नीचतां यान्ति नीचाश्चोत्तमतां तथा //
text_mt:
All varṇas will become equal to śūdras in the Kaliyuga;
the high descend to lowness, and likewise the low rise to highness.

sanskrit_iast:
rājano dravyaniratāstathā hyanyāyavarttinaḥ /
pīḍayanti prajāścaiva karairatyarthayojitaiḥ //
meaning:
राजनो द्रव्यनिरतास्तथा ह्यन्यायवर्त्तिनः /
पीडयन्ति प्रजाश्चैव करैरत्यर्थयोजितैः //
text_mt:
Kings are intent on wealth and behave unjustly;
they oppress their subjects with excessively imposed taxes.

sanskrit_iast:
śavavāhābhaviṣyanti śūdrāṇāṃ ca dvijātayaḥ /
dharmastrīṣvapi gacchanti patayo jāradharmiṇaḥ //
meaning:
शववाहाभविष्यन्ति शूद्राणां च द्विजातयः /
धर्मस्त्रीष्वपि गच्छन्ति पतयो जारधर्मिणः //
text_mt:
And twice-born men will become corpse-bearers for śūdras;
husbands, behaving like paramours, go even to lawful wives [for mere lust].

sanskrit_iast:
dviṣanti pitaraṃ putrā bhartāraṃ ca striyo 'khilāḥ /
paristrīnirataḥ sarve paradravyaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
द्विषन्ति पितरं पुत्रा भर्तारं च स्त्रियो ऽखिलाः /
परिस्त्रीनिरतः सर्वे परद्रव्यपरायणाः //
text_mt:
Sons hate their father, and all women hate their husbands;
all are intent on other men's wives and dedicated to other people's property.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyāmiṣeṇa jīvanti duhṝntaścāpyajīvikām /
ghore kaliyuge vipra sarve pāparatā janāḥ //
meaning:
मत्स्यामिषेण जीवन्ति दुहॄन्तश्चाप्यजीविकाम् /
घोरे कलियुगे विप्र सर्वे पापरता जनाः //
text_mt:
They live on fish and meat, and daughters [are made] a source of livelihood;
in the dreadful Kaliyuga, O twice-born, all people are devoted to sin.

sanskrit_iast:
satāmasūyāniratāṃ upahāsaṃ prakurvate /
sarittīreṣu kuddālairvāpayiṣyanti cauṣadhīḥ //
meaning:
सतामसूयानिरतां उपहासं प्रकुर्वते /
सरित्तीरेषु कुद्दालैर्वापयिष्यन्ति चौषधीः //
text_mt:
Intent on malice toward the virtuous, they ridicule them;
they will sow herbs on riverbanks with spades.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvī niṣphalatāṃ yāti bījaṃ puṣpaṃ vinaśyati /
veśyālāvaṃyaśīleṣu spṛhā kurvanti yoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
पृथ्वी निष्फलतां याति बीजं पुष्पं विनश्यति /
वेश्यालावंयशीलेषु स्पृहा कुर्वन्ति योषितः //
text_mt:
The earth becomes barren, and seed and blossom perish;
women desire the beauty and conduct of courtesans.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmavikrayiṇo viprāḥ striyaśca bhagavikrayāḥ /
vedavikrayakāścānye śūdrācāraratā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मविक्रयिणो विप्राः स्त्रियश्च भगविक्रयाः /
वेदविक्रयकाश्चान्ये शूद्राचाररता द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Twice-born men are sellers of dharma, and women sellers of their vaginas;
others are sellers of the Veda, and twice-born men are devoted to the conduct of śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhūnāṃ vidhavānāṃ ca vittānya paharanti ca /
na vratāni cariṣyanti brāhmaṇā dravyalolupāḥ //
meaning:
साधूनां विधवानां च वित्तान्य पहरन्ति च /
न व्रतानि चरिष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणा द्रव्यलोलुपाः //
text_mt:
They seize the wealth of virtuous men and of widows;
greedy for wealth, brāhmaṇas will not observe vows.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmācāraṃ parityajya vṛthāvādairviṣajjitāḥ /
dvijāḥ kurvanti daṃbhārthaṃ pitṛśrāddhādikāḥ kriyāḥ //
meaning:
धर्माचारं परित्यज्य वृथावादैर्विषज्जिताः /
द्विजाः कुर्वन्ति दंभार्थं पितृश्राद्धादिकाः क्रियाः //
text_mt:
Abandoning righteous conduct, engrossed in idle arguments,
the twice-born perform rites such as ancestral śrāddhas merely for ostentation.

sanskrit_iast:
apātreṣveva dānāni prayacchanti narādhamāḥ /
dugdhalobhanimittena goṣu prītiṃ ca kurvate //
meaning:
अपात्रेष्वेव दानानि प्रयच्छन्ति नराधमाः /
दुग्धलोभनिमित्तेन गोषु प्रीतिं च कुर्वते //
text_mt:
Vile men bestow gifts only upon the unworthy;
and they show affection to cows solely out of greed for milk.

sanskrit_iast:
na kurvanti tathā viprāḥ snānaśaucādikāḥ kriyāḥ /
apātreṣveva dānāni prayacchanti narādhamāḥ //
meaning:
न कुर्वन्ति तथा विप्राः स्नानशौचादिकाः क्रियाः /
अपात्रेष्वेव दानानि प्रयच्छन्ति नराधमाः //
text_mt:
Twice-born men do not perform rites such as bathing and purification;
vile men bestow gifts only upon the unworthy.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhunindāparāścaiva vipranindāparāstathā /
na kasyāpi mano vipra viṣṇubhaktiparaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
साधुनिन्दापराश्चैव विप्रनिन्दापरास्तथा /
न कस्यापि मनो विप्र विष्णुभक्तिपरं भवेत् //
text_mt:
They are intent on reviling the virtuous and reviling the twice-born;
no one’s mind, O twice-born, is intent on devotion to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yajvinaśca dvijānaiva dhanārtharājakiṅkarāḥ /
tāḍayanti dvijānduṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇatvamāgate //
meaning:
यज्विनश्च द्विजानैव धनार्थराजकिङ्कराः /
ताडयन्ति द्विजान्दुष्टाः कृष्णे कृष्णत्वमागते //
text_mt:
Royal servants, for the sake of wealth, do not [spare] sacrificial twice-born men;
wicked men beat the twice-born when Kṛṣṇa has become black.

sanskrit_iast:
dānahīnā narāḥ sarve ghore kaliyuge mune /
pratigrahaṃ prakurvanti patitānāmapi dvijāḥ //
meaning:
दानहीना नराः सर्वे घोरे कलियुगे मुने /
प्रतिग्रहं प्रकुर्वन्ति पतितानामपि द्विजाः //
text_mt:
All men are devoid of charity in the dreadful Kaliyuga, O sage;
twice-born men engage in acceptance of gifts even from fallen outcasts.

sanskrit_iast:
kaleḥ prathamapāde 'pi viṃnindanti hariṃ narāḥ /
yugānte ca harernāma naivakaścidvadiṣyati //
meaning:
कलेः प्रथमपादे ऽपि विंनिन्दन्ति हरिं नराः /
युगान्ते च हरेर्नाम नैवकश्चिद्वदिष्यति //
text_mt:
Even in the first quarter of Kali, men revile Hari;
and at the end of the yuga, no one will utter Hari's name at all.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrastrīsaṃganiratā vidhavāsaṃgalolupāḥ /
śūdrānnabhoganiratā bhaviṣyanti kalau dvijāḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रस्त्रीसंगनिरता विधवासंगलोलुपाः /
शूद्रान्नभोगनिरता भविष्यन्ति कलौ द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Twice-born men in Kali will be intent on union with śūdra women, greedy for union with widows,
and intent on eating the food of śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya vedasanmārgaṃ kupathācārasaṃgatāḥ /
pāṣaṇḍāścabhaviśaṣyanticaturāśramanindakāḥ //
meaning:
विहाय वेदसन्मार्गं कुपथाचारसंगताः /
पाषण्डाश्चभविशष्यन्तिचतुराश्रमनिन्दकाः //
text_mt:
Abandoning the good path of the Vedas, adhering to the conduct of bad paths,
heretics will arise who revile the four stages of life.

sanskrit_iast:
na cadvijā tiśuśrūṣāṃ kurvanti caraṇodbhavāḥ /
dvijātidharmāngṛhṇanti pākhaṇḍaliṅgino 'dhamāḥ //
meaning:
न चद्विजा तिशुश्रूषां कुर्वन्ति चरणोद्भवाः /
द्विजातिधर्मान्गृह्णन्ति पाखण्डलिङ्गिनो ऽधमाः //
text_mt:
And those born from the feet [śūdras] do not render service to the twice-born;
vile men wearing heretical emblems adopt the duties of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣāyaparivītāśca jaṭilā bhasmadhūlitāḥ /
śūdrādharmānpravakṣyantī kūṭayuktaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
काषायपरिवीताश्च जटिला भस्मधूलिताः /
शूद्राधर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यन्ती कूटयुक्तपरायणाः //
text_mt:
Clad in ochre robes, wearing matted hair, smeared with ashes,
śūdras will expound dharmas, devoted to deceptive reasoning.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijāḥsvācāramutḥsṛjyacaparapākānnabhojinaḥ /
bhaviṣyantidurātmānaḥ śūdrāḥ pravrajitāstathā //
meaning:
द्विजाःस्वाचारमुत्ःसृज्यचपरपाकान्नभोजिनः /
भविष्यन्तिदुरात्मानः शूद्राः प्रव्रजितास्तथा //
text_mt:
Twice-born men, abandoning their own conduct, will eat food cooked by others;
they will become wicked-minded, and śūdras will become renunciants.

sanskrit_iast:
utkocajīvinastatra bhaviṣyanti kalau mune /
dharmaṭīnāstu pāṣaṇḍā kāpālā bhikṣavo 'dhamāḥ //
meaning:
उत्कोचजीविनस्तत्र भविष्यन्ति कलौ मुने /
धर्मटीनास्तु पाषण्डा कापाला भिक्षवो ऽधमाः //
text_mt:
Those living on bribes will arise there in Kali, O sage;
dharma-destroyers, heretics, Kāpālikas, and vile mendicants [will abound].

sanskrit_iast:
dharmavidhvaṃsaśīlānāṃ dvijānāṃ dvijasattama /
śūdrā dharmānpravakṣyantihyadhiruhyottamāsanam //
meaning:
धर्मविध्वंसशीलानां द्विजानां द्विजसत्तम /
शूद्रा धर्मान्प्रवक्ष्यन्तिह्यधिरुह्योत्तमासनम् //
text_mt:
To twice-born men who are prone to destroying dharma, O best of twice-born men,
śūdras will expound dharmas, mounting the highest seat.

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānyeca bahavo nagnaraktapaṭādikāḥ /
pāṣaṇḍāḥ pracāriṣyanti prāyo vedavidūṣakāḥ //
meaning:
एते चान्येच बहवो नग्नरक्तपटादिकाः /
पाषण्डाः प्रचारिष्यन्ति प्रायो वेदविदूषकाः //
text_mt:
These and many other heretics—naked ones, red-robed ones, and the like—
will generally wander about, revilers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
gītavāditrakuśalāḥ kṣudradharmasamāśrayāḥ /
bhaviṣyantikalau prāyo dharmavidhvaṃsakā narāḥ //
meaning:
गीतवादित्रकुशलाः क्षुद्रधर्मसमाश्रयाः /
भविष्यन्तिकलौ प्रायो धर्मविध्वंसका नराः //
text_mt:
Skilled in singing and playing instruments, resorting to mean religions,
men who destroy dharma will mostly arise in Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
alpadravyā vṛthāliṅgā vṛthāhṝṅkāradūṣitāḥ /
hartāraṃ paravittānāṃ bhavitāro narādhamāḥ //
meaning:
अल्पद्रव्या वृथालिङ्गा वृथाहॄङ्कारदूषिताः /
हर्तारं परवित्तानां भवितारो नराधमाः //
text_mt:
Having little wealth, bearing false sectarian marks, corrupted by empty pride,
vile men will become thieves of others' property.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahaparā nityaṃ jagadunmārgaśīlinaḥ /
ātmastutiparāḥ sarve paranindāparāstathā //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहपरा नित्यं जगदुन्मार्गशीलिनः /
आत्मस्तुतिपराः सर्वे परनिन्दापरास्तथा //
text_mt:
Constantly intent on acceptance of gifts, prone to going astray in the world,
all are intent on self-praise and intent on reviling others.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvastaghātinaḥ krūrā dayādharmavivarjitāḥ /
bhaviṣyanti narā vipra kalau cādharmabāndhavāḥ //
meaning:
विश्वस्तघातिनः क्रूरा दयाधर्मविवर्जिताः /
भविष्यन्ति नरा विप्र कलौ चाधर्मबान्धवाः //
text_mt: Betrayers of trust, cruel, destitute of compassion and righteousness, / men in the Kali age, O twice-born one, will be kin to unrighteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
paramāyuśca bhavitā tadā varṣāṇi ṣoḍaśa /
ghore kaliyuge vipra pañcavarṣā prasūyate //
meaning:
परमायुश्च भविता तदा वर्षाणि षोडश /
घोरे कलियुगे विप्र पञ्चवर्षा प्रसूयते //
text_mt: The maximum lifespan will then be sixteen years; / in the dreadful Kali age, O twice-born one, a girl gives birth at five years of age.

sanskrit_iast:
saptavarṣāṣṭavarṣāśca yuvāno 'taḥ pare jarā /
svakarmatyāginaḥ sarve kṛtaghnābhinnavṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
सप्तवर्षाष्टवर्षाश्च युवानो ऽतः परे जरा /
स्वकर्मत्यागिनः सर्वे कृतघ्नाभिन्नवृत्तयः //
text_mt: At seven or eight years they are youths, and beyond that comes old age. / All will abandon their own prescribed duties, ungrateful and fallen from conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
yācakāścadvijā nityaṃ bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge /
parāvamānaniratāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paraveśmani //
meaning:
याचकाश्चद्विजा नित्यं भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे /
परावमाननिरताः प्रहृष्टाः परवेश्मनि //
text_mt: The twice-born will constantly be beggars in the Kali age, / devoted to showing contempt for others, yet delighting in another’s house.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva nindāniratā vṛthāviśraṃbhiṇo janāḥ /
nidāṃ kurvanti satataṃ pitṛmātṛsuteṣu ca //
meaning:
तत्रैव निन्दानिरता वृथाविश्रंभिणो जनाः /
निदां कुर्वन्ति सततं पितृमातृसुतेषु च //
text_mt: Right there, people devoted to censure, falsely trusting, / continually speak slander against father, mother, and children.

sanskrit_iast:
vadanti vācā dharmāṃśca cetasā pāpalolupāḥ /
dhanavidyāvayomattāḥ sarvaduḥkhaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
वदन्ति वाचा धर्मांश्च चेतसा पापलोलुपाः /
धनविद्यावयोमत्ताः सर्वदुःखपरायणाः //
text_mt: They speak of duties with their voice, yet in their heart they covet sin; / intoxicated by wealth, learning, and youth, given over to all miseries.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhitaskaradurbhikṣaiḥ pīḍitā atimāṃyinaḥ /
prapuṣyanti vṛthaivāmī na vicārya ca duṣkṛtam //
meaning:
व्याधितस्करदुर्भिक्षैः पीडिता अतिमांयिनः /
प्रपुष्यन्ति वृथैवामी न विचार्य च दुष्कृतम् //
text_mt: Afflicted by diseases, thieves, and famines, excessively deceitful, / these people nourish themselves in vain, never reflecting upon their misdeeds.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmamārgapraṇetāraṃ tiraskurvanti pāpinaḥ /
dharmakārye rataṃ caiva vṛthāviśraṃbhiṇo janāḥ //
meaning:
धर्ममार्गप्रणेतारं तिरस्कुर्वन्ति पापिनः /
धर्मकार्ये रतं चैव वृथाविश्रंभिणो जनाः //
text_mt: Sinners revile the guide along the path of righteousness; / people falsely trusting [disparage] one devoted to righteous action.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyanti kalau prāpte rājāno mlecchajātayaḥ /
śūdrā bhaikṣyaratāścaiva teṣāṃ śuśrūṣaṇe dvijāḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यन्ति कलौ प्राप्ते राजानो म्लेच्छजातयः /
शूद्रा भैक्ष्यरताश्चैव तेषां शुश्रूषणे द्विजाः //
text_mt: When the Kali age arrives, the kings will be of barbarian origin; / Śūdras will take up mendicancy, and the twice-born will attend upon them.

sanskrit_iast:
na śiṣyo na guruḥ kaścinna putro lana pitā tathā /
na bhāryā na patiścaiva bhavitāro 'tra saṃkare //
meaning:
न शिष्यो न गुरुः कश्चिन्न पुत्रो लन पिता तथा /
न भार्या न पतिश्चैव भवितारो ऽत्र संकरे //
text_mt: No one will be a pupil, nor a guru; neither son, nor father; / neither wife, nor husband will exist in this mixture [of castes].

sanskrit_iast:
kalau gate bhaviṣyanti dhanāḍhyā api yācakāḥ /
rasa vikrayiṇaścāpi bhaviṣyanti dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
कलौ गते भविष्यन्ति धनाढ्या अपि याचकाः /
रस विक्रयिणश्चापि भविष्यन्ति द्विजातयः //
text_mt: In the course of the Kali age, even the wealthy will be beggars, / and the twice-born will become sellers of prohibited liquids.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakañcukasaṃvītā muniveṣadharā dvijāḥ /
apaṇyavikrayaratā agamyāgāminastathā //
meaning:
धर्मकञ्चुकसंवीता मुनिवेषधरा द्विजाः /
अपण्यविक्रयरता अगम्यागामिनस्तथा //
text_mt: Twice-born wearing the cloak of righteousness, adopting the garb of sages, / will be devoted to selling unsellable goods and consorting with forbidden women.

sanskrit_iast:
vedanindāparāścaiva dharmaśāstravinindukāḥ /
śūdravṛttyaiva jīvanti narakārhā dvijā mune //
meaning:
वेदनिन्दापराश्चैव धर्मशास्त्रविनिन्दुकाः /
शूद्रवृत्त्यैव जीवन्ति नरकार्हा द्विजा मुने //
text_mt: Intent on reviling the Vedas and censuring the scriptures of dharma, / the twice-born will live by the occupation of a Śūdra, deserving of hell, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛṣṭabhayaṃ prāptā gaganāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ /
bhaviṣyanti kalau martyāsarve kṣudbhayakātarāḥ //
meaning:
अनावृष्टभयं प्राप्ता गगनासक्तदृष्टयः /
भविष्यन्ति कलौ मर्त्यासर्वे क्षुद्भयकातराः //
text_mt: Terrified by drought, with eyes fixed upon the sky, / all mortals in the Kali age will be distressed by the fear of hunger.

sanskrit_iast:
kandaparṇaphalāhārāstāpaṃsā iva mānavāḥ /
ātmānaṃ tārayiṣyanti anāvṛṣṭyātidukhitāḥ //
meaning:
कन्दपर्णफलाहारास्तापंसा इव मानवाः /
आत्मानं तारयिष्यन्ति अनावृष्ट्यातिदुखिताः //
text_mt: Eating roots, leaves, and fruits like ascetics, / men will sustain themselves, sorely distressed by drought.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmārtā hrasvadehāśca lubdhā ścādharmatatparāḥ /
kalau sarve bhaviṣyanti svalpabhāgyā bahuprajāḥ //
meaning:
कामार्ता ह्रस्वदेहाश्च लुब्धा श्चाधर्मतत्पराः /
कलौ सर्वे भविष्यन्ति स्वल्पभाग्या बहुप्रजाः //
text_mt: Tormented by lust, short in body, greedy, and devoted to unrighteousness, / all in the Kali age will have little fortune and many offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaḥ svapoṣaṇaparā veśyā lāvaṇyaśīlikāḥ /
pativākyamanādṛtya sadānyagṛhatatparāḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रियः स्वपोषणपरा वेश्या लावण्यशीलिकाः /
पतिवाक्यमनादृत्य सदान्यगृहतत्पराः //
text_mt: Women will be intent only on self-nourishment, wanton, proud of their charms, / disregarding their husband's word, and constantly visiting other houses.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥśīlā duṣṭaśīleṣu kariṣyinti sadā spṛhām /
asadvṛttā bhaviṣyanti puruṣeṣu kulāṅganāḥ //
meaning:
दुःशीला दुष्टशीलेषु करिष्यिन्ति सदा स्पृहाम् /
असद्वृत्ता भविष्यन्ति पुरुषेषु कुलाङ्गनाः //
text_mt: Ill-behaved, women of good family will always lust after men of vicious conduct / and become unchaste toward men.

sanskrit_iast:
caurādibhayabhītāśca kāṣṭayantrāṇi kurvate /
durbhikṣakarapīḍābhiratīvopadrutā janāḥ //
meaning:
चौरादिभयभीताश्च काष्टयन्त्राणि कुर्वते /
दुर्भिक्षकरपीडाभिरतीवोपद्रुता जनाः //
text_mt: Terrified by fear of thieves and the like, people fashion wooden locks; / excessively harassed are they by famine and taxes.

sanskrit_iast:
godhūmānnayavānnāḍhye deśe yāsyanti duḥkhitāḥ /
nidhāya hṛdyakarmaṇi prerayanti vacaḥ śubham //
meaning:
गोधूमान्नयवान्नाढ्ये देशे यास्यन्ति दुःखिताः /
निधाय हृद्यकर्मणि प्रेरयन्ति वचः शुभम् //
text_mt: Distressed, they will migrate to a region rich in wheat and barley; / holding foul deeds in their heart, they utter pleasant words.

sanskrit_iast:
svakāryasiddhiparyantaṃ bandhutāṃ kurvate janāḥ /
bhikṣavaścāva mitrādisnehasaṃbandhayantritāḥ //
meaning:
स्वकार्यसिद्धिपर्यन्तं बन्धुतां कुर्वते जनाः /
भिक्षवश्चाव मित्रादिस्नेहसंबन्धयन्त्रिताः //
text_mt: People maintain kinship only until their own ends are achieved; / and mendicants are bound by bonds of affection toward friends and others.

sanskrit_iast: annopādhinimittena śiṣyāngṛhṇanti bhikṣavaḥ //
meaning: अन्नोपाधिनिमित्तेन शिष्यान्गृह्णन्ति भिक्षवः //
text_mt: Mendicants accept pupils merely for the sake of food.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhābhyāmatha pāṇibhyāṃ śiraḥkaṇḍūyanaṃ striyaḥ /
kurvantyo gurubhartṛāṇāmājñāmullaṅghayanti ca //
meaning:
उभाभ्यामथ पाणिभ्यां शिरःकण्डूयनं स्त्रियः /
कुर्वन्त्यो गुरुभर्तृआणामाज्ञामुल्लङ्घयन्ति च //
text_mt: Scratching their heads with both hands, / women disobey the command of elders and husbands.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṣaṇḍālāpaniratāḥ pāṣaṇḍajanasaṃginaḥ /
yadā dvijā bhaviṣyanti tadā vṛddhiṃ kalirvrajet //
meaning:
पाषण्डालापनिरताः पाषण्डजनसंगिनः /
यदा द्विजा भविष्यन्ति तदा वृद्धिं कलिर्व्रजेत् //
text_mt: When the twice-born delight in conversing with heretics and keeping company with heretical people, / then the Kali age grows strong.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā prajā na yakṣyanti na hoṣyanti dvijātayaḥ /
tadaiva tu kalervṛddhiranumeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
यदा प्रजा न यक्ष्यन्ति न होष्यन्ति द्विजातयः /
तदैव तु कलेर्वृद्धिरनुमेया विचक्षणैः //
text_mt: When the subjects offer no sacrifices, and the twice-born make no fire-oblations, / right then the advance of the Kali age is to be inferred by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmavṛddhirbhavitā bāsamṛtyurapi dvijā /
sarvadharmeṣu naṣṭeṣu yāti niḥśrīkatāṃ jagat //
meaning:
अधर्मवृद्धिर्भविता बासमृत्युरपि द्विजा /
सर्वधर्मेषु नष्टेषु याति निःश्रीकतां जगत् //
text_mt: There will be an increase of unrighteousness, and premature death as well, O twice-born; / when all duties are destroyed, the world is stripped of splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kaleḥ svarūpaṃ te kathitaṃ viprasattama /
haribhaktiparāneṣa na kalirbādhate kvacit //
meaning:
एवं कलेः स्वरूपं ते कथितं विप्रसत्तम /
हरिभक्तिपरानेष न कलिर्बाधते क्वचित् //
text_mt: Thus the true nature of the Kali age has been told to you, O best of the twice-born; / yet this Kali age never oppresses those devoted to devotion to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyuge tretāyāṃ dhyānameva ca /
dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānamekaṃ kalau yuge //
meaning:
ततः परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायुगे त्रेतायां ध्यानमेव च /
द्वापरे यज्ञमेवाहुर्दानमेकं कलौ युगे //
text_mt: Beyond that, in the Kṛta age, [it is said to be] meditation; in the Tretā age, sacrifices; / in the Dvāpara, worship; and in the Kali age, they say giving alone is [prescribed].

sanskrit_iast:
yatkṛte daśabhirvarṣaistretāyāṃ śaradā ca yat /
dvāpare yañca māsena hyahorātreṇa tatkalau //
meaning:
यत्कृते दशभिर्वर्षैस्त्रेतायां शरदा च यत् /
द्वापरे यञ्च मासेन ह्यहोरात्रेण तत्कलौ //
text_mt: What is gained in the Kṛta age in ten years, in the Tretā in an autumn, / and what in the Dvāpara in a month, that is gained in the Kali age in a single day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyankṛte jayanyajñaistretāyāṃ dvāparer'cayan /
yadāpnoti tadāpnoti kalau saṃkīrtya keśavam //
meaning:
ध्यायन्कृते जयन्यज्ञैस्त्रेतायां द्वापरेर्ऽचयन् /
यदाप्नोति तदाप्नोति कलौ संकीर्त्य केशवम् //
text_mt: What one attains by meditating in the Kṛta, by performing sacrifices in the Tretā, and by worshipping in the Dvāpara, / that one attains in the Kali age by reciting the praises of Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātraṃ harernāma kīrtayanti ca ye narāḥ /
kurvanti haripūjāṃ vā na kalirbādhate ca tān //
meaning:
अहोरात्रं हरेर्नाम कीर्तयन्ति च ये नराः /
कुर्वन्ति हरिपूजां वा न कलिर्बाधते च तान् //
text_mt: Men who praise the name of Hari day and night, / or perform worship of Hari, are not oppressed by the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti kīrtayanti ca ye narāḥ /
niṣkāmā vā sakāmā vā na kalirbādhate ca tān //
meaning:
नमो नारायणायेति कीर्तयन्ति च ये नराः /
निष्कामा वा सकामा वा न कलिर्बाधते च तान् //
text_mt: Men who chant 'Salutations to Nārāyaṇa', / whether desireless or with desire, are not oppressed by the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
harināmaparā ye tu ghore kaliyuge dvija /
ta eva kṛtakṛtyāśca na kalirbādhate hi tān //
meaning:
हरिनामपरा ये तु घोरे कलियुगे द्विज /
त एव कृतकृत्याश्च न कलिर्बाधते हि तान् //
text_mt: Those who are devoted to the name of Hari in the dreadful Kali age, O twice-born one, / have indeed accomplished their purpose; the Kali age does not torment them.

sanskrit_iast:
.
haripūjāparā ye ca harināmaparāyaṇāḥ /
ta eva śivatulyāśca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
.
हरिपूजापरा ये च हरिनामपरायणाः /
त एव शिवतुल्याश्च नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
[...]
Those who are devoted to the worship of Hari and intent upon the name of Hari / are equal to Śiva himself; no doubt should be entertained in this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
samastajagadādhāraṃ paramārthasvarupiṇam /
ghore kaliyuge prāpte viṣṇuṃ dhyāyanna sīdati //
meaning:
समस्तजगदाधारं परमार्थस्वरुपिणम् /
घोरे कलियुगे प्राप्ते विष्णुं ध्यायन्न सीदति //
text_mt: When the dreadful Kali age has arrived, one who meditates on Viṣṇu, / the support of the entire universe, whose nature is the supreme reality, does not perish.

sanskrit_iast:
aho ati subhāgyāste sakṛdvai keśavārcakāḥ /
ghore kaliyuge prāpte sarvadharmavivarjite //
meaning:
अहो अति सुभाग्यास्ते सकृद्वै केशवार्चकाः /
घोरे कलियुगे प्राप्ते सर्वधर्मविवर्जिते //
text_mt: Ah, very fortunate indeed are those worshippers of Keśava, even once, / when the dreadful Kali age arrives, bereft of all righteous duties!

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnātiriktadoṣāṇāṃ kalau vedoktakarmaṇām /
harismaraṇamevātra saṃpūrṇatvavidhāyakam //
meaning:
न्यूनातिरिक्तदोषाणां कलौ वेदोक्तकर्मणाम् /
हरिस्मरणमेवात्र संपूर्णत्वविधायकम् //
text_mt: For rites taught in the Vedas that suffer from defects of deficiency or excess in the Kali age, / remembrance of Hari alone is the cause of completeness here.

sanskrit_iast:
hare keśava govinda vāsudeva jaganmaya /
itīrayanti ye nityaṃ nahi tānbādhate kaliḥ //
meaning:
हरे केशव गोविन्द वासुदेव जगन्मय /
इतीरयन्ति ये नित्यं नहि तान्बाधते कलिः //
text_mt: Those who continually say, 'O Hari, O Keśava, O Govinda, O Vāsudeva, O pervader of the universe!', / are not oppressed by the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva śaṅkara rudreśa nīlakaṇṭha trilocana /
iti jalpanti ye vāpi kalistānnāpi bādhate //
meaning:
शिव शङ्कर रुद्रेश नीलकण्ठ त्रिलोचन /
इति जल्पन्ति ये वापि कलिस्तान्नापि बाधते //
text_mt: Or those who utter, 'O Śiva, O Śaṅkara, O Lord of Rudras, O Blue-throated One, O Three-eyed One!', / are likewise not oppressed by the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādeva virūpākṣa gaṅgādhara mṛḍāvyaya /
itthaṃ vadanti ye vipra te kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
महादेव विरूपाक्ष गङ्गाधर मृडाव्यय /
इत्थं वदन्ति ये विप्र ते कृतार्था न संशयः //
text_mt: Those who say, 'O Mahādeva, O Odd-eyed One, O bearer of the Gaṅgā, O gracious, imperishable One!', / have achieved their purpose, O twice-born one; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
janārdana jagannāta pītāṃbaradharācyuta /
iti vāpyuñcarantīha na ca teṣāṃ kalerbhayam //
meaning:
जनार्दन जगन्नात पीतांबरधराच्युत /
इति वाप्युञ्चरन्तीह न च तेषां कलेर्भयम् //
text_mt: Or those who utter here, 'O Janārdana, O Lord of the world, O yellow-robed Acyuta!', / have no fear of the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāre sulabhāḥ puṃsāṃ putradāradhanādayaḥ /
ghore kaliyuge vipra haribhaktastu durlabhā //
meaning:
संसारे सुलभाः पुंसां पुत्रदारधनादयः /
घोरे कलियुगे विप्र हरिभक्तस्तु दुर्लभा //
text_mt: Sons, wives, wealth, and the like are easily attained by men in this worldly existence; / but devotion to Hari, O twice-born one, is rare in the dreadful Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaśraddhāvihīnā ye pāṣaṇḍā vedanindakāḥ /
adharmaniratā naiva narakārhā harismṛteḥ //
meaning:
कर्मश्रद्धाविहीना ये पाषण्डा वेदनिन्दकाः /
अधर्मनिरता नैव नरकार्हा हरिस्मृतेः //
text_mt: Even those who lack faith in rituals, heretics who revile the Vedas, / and those intent upon unrighteousness, do not deserve hell because of the remembrance of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamārgabahiṣṭānāṃ janānāṃ pāpakarmaṇām /
manaḥ śuddhivihīnānāṃ harināmnaiva niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
वेदमार्गबहिष्टानां जनानां पापकर्मणाम् /
मनः शुद्धिविहीनानां हरिनाम्नैव निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: For people outside the Vedic path, of sinful deeds, / and bereft of purity of mind, deliverance comes through the name of Hari alone.

sanskrit_iast:
daivādhīnaṃ jagatsarvamidaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam /
yathāpreritametena tathaiva kuruteṃ dvija //
meaning:
दैवाधीनं जगत्सर्वमिदं स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
यथाप्रेरितमेतेन तथैव कुरुतें द्विज //
text_mt: This entire world, both immovable and moving, is subject to fate; / as prompted by it, O twice-born one, so it acts.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktitaḥ sarvakarmāṇi vedoktāni vidhāya ca /
samarpayenmahāviṣṇau nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शक्तितः सर्वकर्माणि वेदोक्तानि विधाय च /
समर्पयेन्महाविष्णौ नारायणपरायणः //
text_mt: And having performed all rites prescribed in the Vedas to the best of one's ability, / devoted to Nārāyaṇa, one should surrender them to Mahāviṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
samarpitāni karmāṇi mahaviṣṇau parātmani /
saṃpūrṇatāṃ prayāntyeva harismaraṇamātrataḥ //
meaning:
समर्पितानि कर्माणि महविष्णौ परात्मनि /
संपूर्णतां प्रयान्त्येव हरिस्मरणमात्रतः //
text_mt: Actions surrendered to Mahāviṣṇu, the supreme Self, / attain completion merely by remembering Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
haribhaktiratānāṃ ca pāpabandho na jāyate /
ato 'tidurlabhā loke haribhaktirdurātmanām //
meaning:
हरिभक्तिरतानां च पापबन्धो न जायते /
अतो ऽतिदुर्लभा लोके हरिभक्तिर्दुरात्मनाम् //
text_mt: And for those delighting in devotion to Hari, no bondage of sin arises; / therefore devotion to Hari is extremely difficult to attain in the world for wicked souls.

sanskrit_iast:
aho hariparā ye tu kalau ghore bhayaṅkare /
te subhāgyā mahātmānaḥ satsaṃgara hitā api //
meaning:
अहो हरिपरा ये तु कलौ घोरे भयङ्करे /
ते सुभाग्या महात्मानः सत्संगर हिता अपि //
text_mt: Ah, those who are devoted to Hari in the fierce, terrifying Kali [age], / they are greatly fortunate, great-souled, even if devoid of the company of the good!

sanskrit_iast:
harismaraṇaniṣṭānāṃ śivanāmaratātmanām /
satyaṃ samastakarmāṇi yānti saṃpūrṇatāṃ dvija //
meaning:
हरिस्मरणनिष्टानां शिवनामरतात्मनाम् /
सत्यं समस्तकर्माणि यान्ति संपूर्णतां द्विज //
text_mt: For those steadfast in remembering Hari, whose souls delight in the name of Śiva, / all rites truly attain completion, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ harināma ratātmanām /
tridarśerapi te pūjyāḥ kimanyairbahubhāṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
अहो भाग्यमहो भाग्यं हरिनाम रतात्मनाम् /
त्रिदर्शेरपि ते पूज्याः किमन्यैर्बहुभाषितैः //
text_mt: Ah, what fortune! Ah, what fortune for those whose souls delight in the name of Hari! / They are worthy of worship even by the gods; what need of many other words?

sanskrit_iast:
