आकाशं वायुरूष्मा च स्नेहो यश्चापि पार्थिवः //
text_mt: They stay together through condition; they disunite by their own nature. / Space, wind, heat, moisture, and that which is earthy—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa pañcasamāhāraḥ śarīramapi naikadhā /
jñānamūṣmā ca vāyuśca trividhaḥ kāyasaṃgrahaḥ //
meaning:
एष पञ्चसमाहारः शरीरमपि नैकधा /
ज्ञानमूष्मा च वायुश्च त्रिविधः कायसंग्रहः //
text_mt: this fivefold aggregation is the body, manifold as well. / Knowledge, heat, and wind: this is the threefold constitution of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanāmanaḥ /
prāṇāpānau vikāraśca dhātavaścātra niḥsṛtāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च स्वभावश्चेतनामनः /
प्राणापानौ विकारश्च धातवश्चात्र निःसृताः //
text_mt: The senses, the objects of the senses, inherent nature, consciousness, mind, / prāṇa and apāna, modification, and the elements—these have issued forth here.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ jihvā dṛṣṭirnāsā tathaiva ca /
indriyāṇīti pañcaite cittapūrvaṅgamā guṇāḥ //
meaning:
श्रवणं स्पर्शनं जिह्वा दृष्टिर्नासा तथैव च /
इन्द्रियाणीति पञ्चैते चित्तपूर्वङ्गमा गुणाः //
text_mt: Hearing, touch, tongue, sight, and nose likewise: / these are the five senses, qualities preceded by the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vijñānasaṃyuktā trividhā cetanā dhruvā /
sukhaduḥkheti yāmāhuranaduḥkhāsukheti ca //
meaning:
तत्र विज्ञानसंयुक्ता त्रिविधा चेतना ध्रुवा /
सुखदुःखेति यामाहुरनदुःखासुखेति च //
text_mt: There, united with consciousness, constant consciousness is threefold, / which they speak of as pleasant, painful, and neither painful nor pleasant.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca mūrtyarthameva te trayaḥ /
ete hyāmaraṇātpañca sadguṇā jñānasiddhaye //
meaning:
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च मूर्त्यर्थमेव ते त्रयः /
एते ह्यामरणात्पञ्च सद्गुणा ज्ञानसिद्धये //
text_mt: Sound, touch, and form: these three are for the purpose of material form. / These five true qualities exist until death for the attainment of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu karmaṇi siddhiśca sarvatattvārthaniścayaḥ /
tamāhuḥ paramaṃ śuddhiṃ buddhirityavyayaṃ mahat //
meaning:
तेषु कर्मणि सिद्धिश्च सर्वतत्त्वार्थनिश्चयः /
तमाहुः परमं शुद्धिं बुद्धिरित्यव्ययं महत् //
text_mt: In them is the accomplishment in action and the determination of all true principles; / that they call supreme purity, the great imperishable intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ guṇasamāhāramātmabhāvena paśyataḥ /
asamyagdarśanairduḥkhamanantaṃ nopaśāmyati //
meaning:
इमं गुणसमाहारमात्मभावेन पश्यतः /
असम्यग्दर्शनैर्दुःखमनन्तं नोपशाम्यति //
text_mt: For one who views this aggregate of qualities as the Self, / through incorrect perceptions endless sorrow is not pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
anātmeti ca yadṛṣṭaṃ tenāhaṃ na mametyapi /
vartate kimadhiṣṭānātprasaktā duḥkhasaṃtatiḥ //
meaning:
अनात्मेति च यदृष्टं तेनाहं न ममेत्यपि /
वर्तते किमधिष्टानात्प्रसक्ता दुःखसंततिः //
text_mt: And because it is seen as not-self, through that there is 'not I, nor mine.' / From what foundation does the continuous succession of sorrow remain attached?

sanskrit_iast:
tatra samyagjano nāma tyāgaśāstramanuttamam /
śṛṇuyāttacca mokṣāya bhāṣyamāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तत्र सम्यग्जनो नाम त्यागशास्त्रमनुत्तमम् /
शृणुयात्तच्च मोक्षाय भाष्यमाणं भविष्यति //
text_mt: There, a right-minded person should listen to the unsurpassed teaching on renunciation; / and that, being spoken, will lead to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tyāga eva hi sarveṣāmuktānāmapi karmaṇām /
nityaṃ mithyāvinītānāṃ kleśo duḥkhāvaho tamaḥ //
meaning:
त्याग एव हि सर्वेषामुक्तानामपि कर्मणाम् /
नित्यं मिथ्याविनीतानां क्लेशो दुःखावहो तमः //
text_mt: For renunciation is indeed of all actions that have been spoken of; / for those who are falsely trained, affliction always brings sorrow and darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyatyāge tu karmāṇi bhogatyāge vratāni ca /
sukhatyāgā tapo yogaṃ sarvatyāge samāpanā //
meaning:
द्रव्यत्यागे तु कर्माणि भोगत्यागे व्रतानि च /
सुखत्यागा तपो योगं सर्वत्यागे समापना //
text_mt: In the renunciation of possessions lie rituals; in the renunciation of enjoyment, vows; / in the renunciation of pleasure, asceticism and yoga; in the renunciation of all, completion.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya mārgo 'yamadvaidhaḥ sarvatyāgasya darśitaḥ /
viprahāṇāya duḥkhasya durgatirhi tathā bhavet //
meaning:
तस्य मार्गो ऽयमद्वैधः सर्वत्यागस्य दर्शितः /
विप्रहाणाय दुःखस्य दुर्गतिर्हि तथा भवेत् //
text_mt: This non-dual path of the renunciation of all has been shown / for the abandoning of sorrow, for otherwise a bad state would result.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca jñānendriyāṇyuktvā manaḥ ṣaṣṭāni cetasi /
basaṣaṣṭāni vakṣyāmi pañca karmedriyāṇi tu //
meaning:
पञ्च ज्ञानेन्द्रियाण्युक्त्वा मनः षष्टानि चेतसि /
बसषष्टानि वक्ष्यामि पञ्च कर्मेद्रियाणि तु //
text_mt: Having spoken of the five senses of knowledge, with the mind as sixth in the intellect, / I shall speak of the five organs of action, with speech as the sixth.

sanskrit_iast:
hastau karmedriyaṃ jñeyamatha pādau gatīndriyam /
prajanāna dayomeḍhro visargo pāyurindriyam //
meaning:
हस्तौ कर्मेद्रियं ज्ञेयमथ पादौ गतीन्द्रियम् /
प्रजनान दयोमेढ्रो विसर्गो पायुरिन्द्रियम् //
text_mt: The hands are to be known as an organ of action, and the feet as the organ of movement; / the penis is for reproduction and pleasure, and the anus is the organ for evacuation;

sanskrit_iast:
vākca śabdaviśeṣārthamiti pañcānvitaṃ viduḥ /
evamekādaśetāni buddhyā tvavasṛjanmanaḥ //
meaning:
वाक्च शब्दविशेषार्थमिति पञ्चान्वितं विदुः /
एवमेकादशेतानि बुद्ध्या त्ववसृजन्मनः //
text_mt: and speech is for the purpose of distinguishing words—thus they know it as endowed with five. / Having thus given up these eleven along with the mind by means of the intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇo śabdaśca cittaṃ ca trayaḥ śravaṇasaṃgrahe /
tathā sparśe tathā rūpe tathaiva rasagandhayoḥ //
meaning:
कर्णो शब्दश्च चित्तं च त्रयः श्रवणसंग्रहे /
तथा स्पर्शे तथा रूपे तथैव रसगन्धयोः //
text_mt: ear, sound, and mind are the triad in the apprehension of hearing; / likewise in touch, likewise in form, and likewise in taste and smell.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañca trikā hyete guṇastadupalabdhaye /
yenāyaṃ trividho bhāvaḥ paryāyātsamupasthitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं पञ्च त्रिका ह्येते गुणस्तदुपलब्धये /
येनायं त्रिविधो भावः पर्यायात्समुपस्थितः //
text_mt: Thus these five triads of qualities exist for their perception, / by which this threefold state arises in succession:

sanskrit_iast:
sāttviko rājasaścāpi tāmasaścāpi te trayaḥ /
trividhā vedānā yeṣu prasṛtā sarvasādhinī //
meaning:
सात्त्विको राजसश्चापि तामसश्चापि ते त्रयः /
त्रिविधा वेदाना येषु प्रसृता सर्वसाधिनी //
text_mt: sāttvika, rājasa, and tāmasa are those three, / in which the threefold feeling, accomplishing everything, has spread forth.

sanskrit_iast:
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaḥ sukhaṃ saṃśāntacittatā /
akutaścitkutaścidvā cittataḥ sāttviko guṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः सुखं संशान्तचित्तता /
अकुतश्चित्कुतश्चिद्वा चित्ततः सात्त्विको गुणः //
text_mt: Delight, affection, joy, pleasure, and peace of mind, / whether from no cause or from some cause, arising from the mind, is the sāttvika quality.

sanskrit_iast:
atuṣṭiḥ paritāpaśca śoko lobhastathākṣamā /
liṅgāni rajasastāni dṛśyante hetvahetutaḥ //
meaning:
अतुष्टिः परितापश्च शोको लोभस्तथाक्षमा /
लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि दृश्यन्ते हेत्वहेतुतः //
text_mt: Discontent, torment, grief, greed, and intolerance— / those signs of rajas are seen, whether from a cause or without a cause.

sanskrit_iast:
avivekastathā mohaḥ pramādaḥ svapnatandritā /
kathañcidapi vartante vividhāstāmasā guṇāḥ //
meaning:
अविवेकस्तथा मोहः प्रमादः स्वप्नतन्द्रिता /
कथञ्चिदपि वर्तन्ते विविधास्तामसा गुणाः //
text_mt: Lack of discrimination, delusion, carelessness, sleep, and lethargy— / the manifold tāmasa qualities somehow exist."

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ ca yo veda vimokṣabuddhimātmānamanvicchati cāpramattaḥ /
na lipyate karmapalairaniṣṭaiḥ patraṃ viṣasyeva jalena siktam //
meaning:
इमां च यो वेद विमोक्षबुद्धिमात्मानमन्विच्छति चाप्रमत्तः /
न लिप्यते कर्मपलैरनिष्टैः पत्रं विषस्येव जलेन सिक्तम् //
text_mt: And whoever knows this discernment concerning liberation and seeks the Self with vigilance, / is not stained by undesirable fruits of actions, just as the leaf of a water-lily is not stained by water.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhairhi pāśairvividhairvimuktaḥ prajānimittairapi daivataiśca /
yadā hyasau duḥkhasaukhye jahāti muktastadāgryāṃ gatimetyaliṅgaḥ //
meaning:
दृढैर्हि पाशैर्विविधैर्विमुक्तः प्रजानिमित्तैरपि दैवतैश्च /
यदा ह्यसौ दुःखसौख्ये जहाति मुक्तस्तदाग्र्यां गतिमेत्यलिङ्गः //
text_mt: Being released indeed from various firm bonds caused by progeny as well as by deities, / when he truly abandons pleasure and pain, then, liberated and markless, he attains the highest goal.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutipramāṇagamamaṅgalaiśca śeti jarāmṛtyubhayādatītaḥ /
kṣīṇe ca puṇye vigate ca pāpe tanornimitte ca phale vinaṣṭe //
meaning:
श्रुतिप्रमाणगममङ्गलैश्च शेति जरामृत्युभयादतीतः /
क्षीणे च पुण्ये विगते च पापे तनोर्निमित्ते च फले विनष्टे //
text_mt: And through the auspicious truths derived from the means of knowledge of the Vedas, he rests, gone beyond the fear of old age and death, / when merit is exhausted, evil has departed, and the fruit that caused the body has perished.

sanskrit_iast:
alepamākāśamaliṅgamevamāsthāya paśyanti mahatyaśaktā /
yathorṇanābhiḥ parivartamānastantukṣaye tiṣṭati yātyamānaḥ //
meaning:
अलेपमाकाशमलिङ्गमेवमास्थाय पश्यन्ति महत्यशक्ता /
यथोर्णनाभिः परिवर्तमानस्तन्तुक्षये तिष्टति यात्यमानः //
text_mt: Resorting thus to the unstained, unconditioned space, those unable [to act] look upon the great [reality], / just as a spider, turning around when its thread is exhausted, remains, being led forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vimuktaḥ prajahāti duḥkhaṃ vidhaavaṃsate loṣṭamivādimṛcchan /
yathā ruruḥ śṛṅgamatho purāṇaṃ hitvā tvacaṃ vāpyurago yathā ca //
meaning:
तथा विमुक्तः प्रजहाति दुःखं विधअवंसते लोष्टमिवादिमृच्छन् /
यथा रुरुः शृङ्गमथो पुराणं हित्वा त्वचं वाप्युरगो यथा च //
text_mt: In that manner, the liberated one abandons sorrow; he falls away, as if reaching a clod of earth at the beginning; / just as a deer casts off its old horn, or just as a snake casts off its slough,

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya gacchannanavekṣaghamāṇastathā vimukto vijahāti duḥkham /
matsyaṃ yathā vāpyudake patantamutsṛjya pakṣī nipatatsaśaktaḥ //
meaning:
विहाय गच्छन्ननवेक्षघमाणस्तथा विमुक्तो विजहाति दुःखम् /
मत्स्यं यथा वाप्युदके पतन्तमुत्सृज्य पक्षी निपतत्सशक्तः //
text_mt: departing without looking back, so the liberated one completely casts off sorrow; / or just as a bird capable of diving, releasing a fish that falls back into the water,

sanskrit_iast: tathā hyasau duḥkhasaukhye vihāya muktaḥ parārddhyā gatimetyaliṅgaḥ //
meaning: तथा ह्यसौ दुःखसौख्ये विहाय मुक्तः परार्द्ध्या गतिमेत्यलिङ्गः //
text_mt: even so, having abandoned pleasure and pain, the liberated one, markless, attains the highest goal.

sanskrit_iast:
idamamṛtapadaṃ niśamya rājā svayamihapañcaśikhena bhāṣyamāṇam /
nikhilamabhisamīkṣya niścitārthaḥ paramasukhī vijahāra vītaśokaḥ //
meaning:
इदममृतपदं निशम्य राजा स्वयमिहपञ्चशिखेन भाष्यमाणम् /
निखिलमभिसमीक्ष्य निश्चितार्थः परमसुखी विजहार वीतशोकः //
text_mt: Having heard this immortal word spoken here personally by Pañcaśikha, / examining all of it and having ascertained its meaning, the king, free from grief, wandered about in supreme happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
api ca bhavati maithilena gītaṃ nagaramupāhitamagninābhivīkṣya /
na khalu mama hi dahyate 'tra kiñcitsvayamidamāha kila sma bhūmipālaḥ //
meaning:
अपि च भवति मैथिलेन गीतं नगरमुपाहितमग्निनाभिवीक्ष्य /
न खलु मम हि दह्यते ऽत्र किञ्चित्स्वयमिदमाह किल स्म भूमिपालः //
text_mt: And indeed, it was sung by the ruler of Mithilā upon beholding the city engulfed by fire: / 'Truly nothing of mine burns here!'—so said the king himself.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ hi yaḥ paṭhati vimokṣaniścayaṃ mahāmune satatamavekṣate tathā /
upadravānanubhaghavate hyaduḥ khitaḥ pramucyate kapilamivaitya maithilaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde pañcacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इमं हि यः पठति विमोक्षनिश्चयं महामुने सततमवेक्षते तथा /
उपद्रवाननुभघवते ह्यदुः खितः प्रमुच्यते कपिलमिवैत्य मैथिलः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever recites this ascertained doctrine of liberation, O great sage, and constantly contemplates it thus, / experiences calamities without being grieved, and is liberated just like the ruler of Mithilā after approaching Kapila.

Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter in the second quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tacchṛtvā nārado viprā maithilādhyātmamuttamam /
punaḥ papraccha taṃ prītyā sanandanamudāradhīḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
तच्छृत्वा नारदो विप्रा मैथिलाध्यात्ममुत्तमम् /
पुनः पप्रच्छ तं प्रीत्या सनन्दनमुदारधीः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard that supreme spirituality of the ruler of Mithilā, O Brahmins, / Nārada of noble intellect asked Sanandana again with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
ādhyātmikādatrividhaṃ tāpaṃ nānubhavedyathā /
prabrūhi tanmune mahyaṃ prapannāya dayānidhe //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
आध्यात्मिकादत्रिविधं तापं नानुभवेद्यथा /
प्रब्रूहि तन्मुने मह्यं प्रपन्नाय दयानिधे //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Tell me, O sage, treasure of compassion, to me who have surrendered [to you], / how one may not experience the threefold torment beginning with the internal.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
tadasya trividhaṃ duḥkhamiha jātasya paṇḍita /
garbe janmajarādyeṣusthāneṣu prabhaviṣyataḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
तदस्य त्रिविधं दुःखमिह जातस्य पण्डित /
गर्बे जन्मजराद्येषुस्थानेषु प्रभविष्यतः //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / That threefold suffering belongs to one born here, O wise one, / who is about to arise in places such as the womb, birth, and old age.

sanskrit_iast:
nirastātiśayāhlādasukhabhāvaikalakṣaṇā /
bheṣajaṃ bhagavatprāptiraikā cātyantikī matā //
meaning:
निरस्तातिशयाह्लादसुखभावैकलक्षणा /
भेषजं भगवत्प्राप्तिरैका चात्यन्तिकी मता //
text_mt: Attainment of the Blessed Lord, whose sole characteristic is the state of bliss and joy surpassing all others, / is considered the single and ultimate remedy.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttatprāptaye yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ paṇḍitairnaraiḥ /
tatprāptihetujñānaṃ ca karma coktaṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
तस्मात्तत्प्राप्तये यत्नः कर्तव्यः पण्डितैर्नरैः /
तत्प्राप्तिहेतुज्ञानं च कर्म चोक्तं महामुने //
text_mt: Therefore, effort for attaining Him should be made by wise men; / and both knowledge and action have been declared the means of attaining Him, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamotthaṃ vivekāñca dvidhā jñānaṃ tathocyate /
śabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahmavivekajam //
meaning:
आगमोत्थं विवेकाञ्च द्विधा ज्ञानं तथोच्यते /
शब्दब्रह्मागममयं परं ब्रह्मविवेकजम् //
text_mt: Knowledge is likewise said to be of two kinds: that arising from scripture and that from discrimination; / the sonic Brahman consists of scripture, while the supreme Brahman arises from discrimination.

sanskrit_iast:
manurapyāha vedārthaṃ smṛtvāyaṃ munisattamamaḥ /
tadetacchrūyatāmatra subodhaṃ gadato mama //
meaning:
मनुरप्याह वेदार्थं स्मृत्वायं मुनिसत्तममः /
तदेतच्छ्रूयतामत्र सुबोधं गदतो मम //
text_mt: Remembering the meaning of the Veda, Manu also, the best of sages, spoke this; / let that be heard here as I speak it, easy to understand:

sanskrit_iast:
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat /
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati //
meaning:
द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये शब्दब्रह्म परं च यत् /
शब्दब्रह्मणि निष्णातः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति //
text_mt: 'Two Brahmans are to be known: the sonic Brahman and that which is supreme; / one who is well-versed in the sonic Brahman attains the supreme Brahman.'

sanskrit_iast:
dve vidye veditavye cetyāha cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ /
paramā tvakṣaraprāptirṛgvedādimayā parā //
meaning:
द्वे विद्ये वेदितव्ये चेत्याह चाथर्वणी श्रुतिः /
परमा त्वक्षरप्राप्तिरृग्वेदादिमया परा //
text_mt: And the Atharvaṇa Vedic text declares: 'Two kinds of knowledge are to be known'; / the supreme is the attainment of the imperishable, while the other consists of the Ṛgveda and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
yattadavyaktamajaramanīhamajamavyayam /
anirdeśyamarūpaṃ ca pāṇipādādisaṃyutam //
meaning:
यत्तदव्यक्तमजरमनीहमजमव्ययम् /
अनिर्देश्यमरूपं च पाणिपादादिसंयुतम् //
text_mt: That which is unmanifest, ageless, devoid of exertion, unborn, imperishable, / undefinable, formless, yet possessed of hands, feet, and other limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhuṃ sarvagataṃ nityaṃ bhūtayo nimakāraṇam /
vyāpyaṃ vyāptaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ taṃ vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ //
meaning:
विभुं सर्वगतं नित्यं भूतयो निमकारणम् /
व्याप्यं व्याप्तं यतः सर्वं तं वै पश्यन्ति सूरयः //
text_mt: all-pervading, omnipresent, eternal, the cause of the source of beings, / by whom everything pervaded is pervaded—that indeed the wise behold.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbūhya tatparaṃ dhāma taddhyeyaṃ mo7kāṅkṣibhiḥ /
śrutivākyoditaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
तद्बूह्य तत्परं धाम तद्ध्येयं मो7काङ्क्षिभिः /
श्रुतिवाक्योदितं सूक्ष्मं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: That is to be conceived, that is the supreme abode, that is to be meditated upon by seekers of liberation; / proclaimed by Vedic declarations, subtle—that is the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva bhagavadvācyaṃ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ /
vācako bhagavacchabdastasyoddiṣṭo 'kṣayātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तदेव भगवद्वाच्यं स्वरूपं परमात्मनः /
वाचको भगवच्छब्दस्तस्योद्दिष्टो ऽक्षयात्मनः //
text_mt: That alone is the essential nature of the Supreme Self signified by 'bhagavat'; / the word 'bhagavat' is designated as the designator of that imperishable Self.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nigaditārthasya yattatvaṃ tasya tattvataḥ /
jñāyate yena tajjñānaṃ paramanyatrayīmayam //
meaning:
एवं निगदितार्थस्य यत्तत्वं तस्य तत्त्वतः /
ज्ञायते येन तज्ज्ञानं परमन्यत्रयीमयम् //
text_mt: The reality of that which has been thus explained, by which it is known in truth— / that is supreme knowledge; the other consists of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
aśabdagocarasyāpi tasya vai brahmaṇo dvijā /
pūjāyāṃ bhagavacchabdaḥ kriyate hyaupacārikaḥ //
meaning:
अशब्दगोचरस्यापि तस्य वै ब्रह्मणो द्विजा /
पूजायां भगवच्छब्दः क्रियते ह्यौपचारिकः //
text_mt: Even of that Brahman which is beyond the range of words, O twice-born, / the word 'bhagavat' is used figuratively in worship.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhe mahāvibhūtyākhye pare brahmaṇi varttate /
bhagavanbhagavacchabdaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇe //
jñeyaṃ jñāteti tathā bhakāror'thadvayātmakaḥ /
tenāgamapitā sraṣṭā gakāro 'yaṃ tathā mune //
meaning:
शुद्धे महाविभूत्याख्ये परे ब्रह्मणि वर्त्तते /
भगवन्भगवच्छब्दः सर्वकारणकारणे //
ज्ञेयं ज्ञातेति तथा भकारोर्ऽथद्वयात्मकः /
तेनागमपिता स्रष्टा गकारो ऽयं तथा मुने //
text_mt: The word 'bhagavat', O venerable one, applies to the pure, supreme Brahman called 'of great majesty', / the cause of all causes. / The syllable 'bha' has two meanings: the object of knowledge and the knower; / likewise, O sage, the syllable 'ga' is the leader, father, and creator.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryasya samagrasya vīryasya yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ /
jñānavairāgyayoścaiva ṣaṇṇāṃ bhaga itīraṇā //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यस्य समग्रस्य वीर्यस्य यशसः श्रियः /
ज्ञानवैराग्ययोश्चैव षण्णां भग इतीरणा //
text_mt: Total sovereignty, virility, fame, splendour, / and knowledge and dispassion—these six are called 'bhaga'.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃti tatra bhūtāni bhūtātmanyakhilātmani /
sarvabhūteṣvaśeṣeṣu vakārārthastato 'vyayaḥ //
meaning:
वसंति तत्र भूतानि भूतात्मन्यखिलात्मनि /
सर्वभूतेष्वशेषेषु वकारार्थस्ततो ऽव्ययः //
text_mt: All beings dwell in Him, the Self of beings, the universal Self, / and He [dwells] in all beings without remainder; hence the meaning of the syllable 'va' is the imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva mahāśabdo bhagavāniti sattama /
paramabrahmabhūtasya vāsudevasya nānyagaḥ //
meaning:
एवमेव महाशब्दो भगवानिति सत्तम /
परमब्रह्मभूतस्य वासुदेवस्य नान्यगः //
text_mt: Thus this great word 'bhagavān', O best of beings, / belongs only to Vāsudeva, who is the Supreme Brahman, and to no other.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pūjyapadārthoktiḥ paribhāṣāsamanvitaḥ /
śabdo 'yaṃ nopacāreṇa cānyatra hyupacārataḥ //
meaning:
तत्र पूज्यपदार्थोक्तिः परिभाषासमन्वितः /
शब्दो ऽयं नोपचारेण चान्यत्र ह्युपचारतः //
text_mt: There, it expresses an object of worship accompanied by technical definition; / this word is not applied figuratively to Him, whereas elsewhere it is applied figuratively.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim /
vetti vidyāmavidyāṃ ca sa vācyo bhagavāniti //
meaning:
उत्पत्तिं प्रलयं चैव भूतानामागतिं गतिम् /
वेत्ति विद्यामविद्यां च स वाच्यो भगवानिति //
text_mt: He who knows the origin and dissolution, the arrival and departure of beings, / and knowledge and ignorance—he is to be called 'bhagavān'.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ /
bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyairguṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानशक्तिबलैश्वर्यवीर्यतेजांस्यशेषतः /
भगवच्छब्दवाच्यानि विना हेयैर्गुणादिभिः //
text_mt: Knowledge, power, strength, sovereignty, virility, and splendour without remainder, / are denoted by the word 'bhagavat', devoid of all undesirable qualities and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇi tatra bhūtāni vasaṃti paramātmani /
bhūteṣu vasanādeva vāsudevastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाणि तत्र भूतानि वसंति परमात्मनि /
भूतेषु वसनादेव वासुदेवस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt: All beings dwell in Him, the Supreme Self, / and because of His dwelling in beings, He is traditionally called Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikyaṃ janakaṃ prāha pṛṣṭaḥ keśidhvajaḥ purā /
nāmavyākhyāmanantasya vāsudevasya tattvataḥ //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्यं जनकं प्राह पृष्टः केशिध्वजः पुरा /
नामव्याख्यामनन्तस्य वासुदेवस्य तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: Formerly, Keśidhvaja, when asked, explained in truth to Khāṇḍikya Janaka / the meaning of the name of the infinite Vāsudeva:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūteṣu vasate soṃ'tarvasaṃtyatra ca tāni yat /
dhātā vidhātā jagatāṃ vāsudevastataḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
भूतेषु वसते सोंऽतर्वसंत्यत्र च तानि यत् /
धाता विधाता जगतां वासुदेवस्ततः प्रभुः //
text_mt: "Because he dwells within all beings, and because they dwell in him, / he is the creator and ordainer of worlds, therefore the Lord is Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvabhūtaprakṛtiṃ vikāraṃ guṇādidoṣāṃśca mune vyatītaḥ /
atītasarvāvaraṇo 'khilātmā tenāstṛtaṃ yadbhuvanāntarālam //
meaning:
स सर्वभूतप्रकृतिं विकारं गुणादिदोषांश्च मुने व्यतीतः /
अतीतसर्वावरणो ऽखिलात्मा तेनास्तृतं यद्भुवनान्तरालम् //
text_mt: O sage, he transcends the material nature of all beings, its modification, and the defects such as the guṇas; / he has transcended all coverings, the Self of all, by whom the intermediate space of the worlds is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
samastakalyāṇaguṇaṃ guṇātmako hitvātiduḥkhāvṛtabhūtasargaḥ /
icchāgṛhītābhimatorudehaḥ saṃsādhitāśeṣajagaddhito 'sau //
meaning:
समस्तकल्याणगुणं गुणात्मको हित्वातिदुःखावृतभूतसर्गः /
इच्छागृहीताभिमतोरुदेहः संसाधिताशेषजगद्धितो ऽसौ //
text_mt: Free from the creation of beings enveloped in extreme suffering, he possesses all auspicious qualities, being of the nature of virtues; / by his own will he assumes his vast beloved body, having accomplished the welfare of all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tejobalaiśvaryamahāvabodhaṃ svavīryaśaktyāduguṇaikarāśiḥ /
paraḥ parāṇāṃ sakalā na yatra kleśādayaḥ saṃti parāvareśe //
meaning:
तेजोबलैश्वर्यमहावबोधं स्ववीर्यशक्त्यादुगुणैकराशिः /
परः पराणां सकला न यत्र क्लेशादयः संति परावरेशे //
text_mt: He is a sole mass of virtues such as splendor, strength, sovereignty, supreme awareness, his own valor, and power; / higher than the highest, in whom, the ruler of high and low, no afflictions or similar taints exist.

sanskrit_iast:
sa īśvaro vyaṣṭisamaṣṭirūpo 'vyaktasvarūpaḥ prakaṭasvarūpaḥ /
sarveśvaraḥ sarvanisargavettā samaskaśaktiḥ parameśvarākhyaḥ //
meaning:
स ईश्वरो व्यष्टिसमष्टिरूपो ऽव्यक्तस्वरूपः प्रकटस्वरूपः /
सर्वेश्वरः सर्वनिसर्गवेत्ता समस्कशक्तिः परमेश्वराख्यः //
text_mt: He is the Lord whose form is both individual and aggregate, unmanifest in essence and manifest in form; / the Lord of all, knower of all natures, endowed with all power, designated as the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sa jñāyate yena tadastadoṣaṃ śuddhaṃ paraṃ nirmalameva rūpam /
saṃdṛśyate cāpyavagamyate ca tajjñānamato 'nyaduktam //
meaning:
स ज्ञायते येन तदस्तदोषं शुद्धं परं निर्मलमेव रूपम् /
संदृश्यते चाप्यवगम्यते च तज्ज्ञानमतो ऽन्यदुक्तम् //
text_mt: That by which his flawless, pure, supreme, and completely stainless form / is known, seen, and comprehended—that is knowledge; other than that is declared [ignorance].

sanskrit_iast:
/.
svādhyāyasaṃyamābagyāṃ sa dṛśyate puruṣottamaḥ /
tatprāptikāraṇaṃ brahma tavetatpratipadyate //
meaning:
/.
स्वाध्यायसंयमाबग्यां स दृश्यते पुरुषोत्तमः /
तत्प्राप्तिकारणं ब्रह्म तवेतत्प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: Through Vedic study and restraint, that Highest Person is seen; / Brahman, the cause of attaining him, is comprehended in this way by you.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyādyogamāsīta yogātsvādhyāyamāmanet /
svādhyāyayogasaṃpattyā paramātmā prakāśate //
meaning:
स्वाध्यायाद्योगमासीत योगात्स्वाध्यायमामनेत् /
स्वाध्याययोगसंपत्त्या परमात्मा प्रकाशते //
text_mt: From Vedic study one should sit in yoga; from yoga one should reflect upon Vedic study; / by the perfection of Vedic study and yoga, the Supreme Self shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadīkṣaṇāya svādhyāyaścakṣuryogastathāparam /
na māṃsacakṣuṣā draṣṭuṃ brahmabhūtaḥ sa śakyate //
meaning:
तदीक्षणाय स्वाध्यायश्चक्षुर्योगस्तथापरम् /
न मांसचक्षुषा द्रष्टुं ब्रह्मभूतः स शक्यते //
text_mt: For perceiving him, Vedic study is one eye, and yoga is the other; / one who has become Brahman cannot be seen with the eye of flesh."
Nārada said: / "O lord, I desire to know that yoga; tell it to me, / knowing which I may behold the Supreme Lord, the support of all."

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
keśidhvajo yathā prāha khāṇḍikyāya mahātmane /
janakāya purā yogaṃ tathāhaṃ kathayāmi te //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
केशिध्वजो यथा प्राह खाण्डिक्याय महात्मने /
जनकाय पुरा योगं तथाहं कथयामि ते //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / "Just as Keśidhvaja formerly spoke yoga to the great-souled Khāṇḍikya Janaka, / so I shall relate it to you."

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
khāṇḍikyaḥ ko 'bhavadbrahman ko vā keśidhvajo 'bhavat /
kathaṃ tayośca saṃvādo yogasaṃbandhavānabhūt //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
खाण्डिक्यः को ऽभवद्ब्रह्मन् को वा केशिध्वजो ऽभवत् /
कथं तयोश्च संवादो योगसंबन्धवानभूत् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / "Who was Khāṇḍikya, O Brahman, or who was Keśidhvaja? / And how did their conversation concerning yoga take place?"

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
dharmadhvajo vai janaka tasya puśe 'mitadhvajaḥ /
kṛtadhvajo 'sya bhrātābhūtsadādhyātmaratirnṛpaḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
धर्मध्वजो वै जनक तस्य पुशे ऽमितध्वजः /
कृतध्वजो ऽस्य भ्राताभूत्सदाध्यात्मरतिर्नृपः //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / "Dharmadhvaja was indeed a Janaka; his son was Amitadhvaja. / Kṛtadhvaja was his brother, a king who always delighted in the supreme self.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtadhvajasya putro 'bhūddhanyaḥ keśidhvajo dvijaḥ /
putro 'mitavvajasyāpi khāṇḍikyajanakābhidhaḥ //
karmamārge hi khāṇḍikyaḥ svarājyādavaropitaḥ /
purodhasā mantribhiśca samaveto 'lpasādhanaḥ //
meaning:
कृतध्वजस्य पुत्रो ऽभूद्धन्यः केशिध्वजो द्विजः /
पुत्रो ऽमितव्वजस्यापि खाण्डिक्यजनकाभिधः //
कर्ममार्गे हि खाण्डिक्यः स्वराज्यादवरोपितः /
पुरोधसा मन्त्रिभिश्च समवेतो ऽल्पसाधनः //
text_mt: The son of Kṛtadhvaja was the fortunate twice-born Keśidhvaja; / and the son of Amitadhvaja was named Khāṇḍikya Janaka. / For Khāṇḍikya was deposed from his own kingdom along the path of ritual action; / accompanied by his family priest and ministers, he possessed few resources.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyānnirākṛtaḥ so 'tha durgāraṇyacaro 'bhavat /
iyāḍaja so 'pi subahūna yajñāñjñānavyapāśrayaḥ //
meaning:
राज्यान्निराकृतः सो ऽथ दुर्गारण्यचरो ऽभवत् /
इयाडज सो ऽपि सुबहून यज्ञाञ्ज्ञानव्यपाश्रयः //
text_mt: Banished from his kingdom, he then wandered in the impassable forest; / having taken recourse in knowledge, he also performed very many sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭāya tartuṃ mṛtyumapi svayam /
ekadā vartamānasya yāge yogavidāṃ vara //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविद्यामधिष्टाय तर्तुं मृत्युमपि स्वयम् /
एकदा वर्तमानस्य यागे योगविदां वर //
text_mt: having taken his stand on the knowledge of Brahman in order to cross beyond death himself. / Once, while he was engaged in a sacrifice, O best of the knowers of yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dhenuṃ jaghānograḥ śārdūlo vijane vane /
tato rājā hatāṃ jñātvā dhenuṃ vyāghreṇa cartvijaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य धेनुं जघानोग्रः शार्दूलो विजने वने /
ततो राजा हतां ज्ञात्वा धेनुं व्याघ्रेण चर्त्विजः //
text_mt: a fierce tiger killed his cow in a deserted forest. / Then, learning that the cow had been killed by a tiger, the king asked his priests

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ sa papraccha kimatreti vidhīyatām /
te cocurnavayaṃvidmaḥ kaśeruḥ pṛcchyatāmiti //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं स पप्रच्छ किमत्रेति विधीयताम् /
ते चोचुर्नवयंविद्मः कशेरुः पृच्छ्यतामिति //
text_mt: for an expiation: 'What should be performed here?' / And they said, 'We do not know; let Kaśeru be asked.'

sanskrit_iast:
kaśerurapi tenoktastatheti prāha nārada /
śunakaṃ pṛccha rājendra veda sa vetsyati //
meaning:
कशेरुरपि तेनोक्तस्तथेति प्राह नारद /
शुनकं पृच्छ राजेन्द्र वेद स वेत्स्यति //
text_mt: Kaśeru also, addressed by him, said: 'So be it,' O Nārada; / 'Ask Śunaka, O best of kings; he knows, he will understand.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā tamapṛcchañca so 'pyāha nṛpatiṃ mune /
na kaśerurnacaivāhaṃ na cānyaḥ sāṃprataṃ bhuvi //
meaning:
स गत्वा तमपृच्छञ्च सो ऽप्याह नृपतिं मुने /
न कशेरुर्नचैवाहं न चान्यः सांप्रतं भुवि //
text_mt: Having gone, he questioned him, and he also said to the king, O sage: / 'Neither Kaśeru, nor I, nor anyone else on earth at present

sanskrit_iast:
vettyeka eva tvacchatruḥ khāṇḍikyo yo jitastvayā /
sa cāha taṃ vrajāmyeṣa praṣṭumātmaripuṃ mune //
meaning:
वेत्त्येक एव त्वच्छत्रुः खाण्डिक्यो यो जितस्त्वया /
स चाह तं व्रजाम्येष प्रष्टुमात्मरिपुं मुने //
text_mt: knows, except your enemy Khāṇḍikya alone, who was conquered by you.' / And he said to him: 'I will go to question my own enemy, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpta eva mayā yajñe yadi māṃ sa haniṣyati /
prāyaścittaṃ sa cetpṛṣṭo vadiṣyati ripurmama //
meaning:
प्राप्त एव मया यज्ञे यदि मां स हनिष्यति /
प्रायश्चित्तं स चेत्पृष्टो वदिष्यति रिपुर्मम //
text_mt: If he kills me, the sacrifice will indeed have been accomplished by me; / if my enemy, being questioned, declares the expiation,

sanskrit_iast:
tataścāvikalo yogo muniśreṣṭha bhaviṣyati /
ityuktvā rathamāruhya kṛṣṇājinadharo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
ततश्चाविकलो योगो मुनिश्रेष्ठ भविष्यति /
इत्युक्त्वा रथमारुह्य कृष्णाजिनधरो नृपः //
text_mt: then the sacrifice will be complete, O best of sages.' / Having spoken thus, the king mounted his chariot, wearing a black antelope skin,

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ jagāma yatrāste khāṇḍikyaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ /
tamāyāntaṃ samālokya khāñjaḍikyo ripumātmanaḥ //
meaning:
वनं जगाम यत्रास्ते खाण्डिक्यः स महीपतिः /
तमायान्तं समालोक्य खाञ्जडिक्यो रिपुमात्मनः //
text_mt: and went to the forest where that ruler of the earth, Khāṇḍikya, resided. / Seeing his enemy arriving,

sanskrit_iast:
provāca krodhatāmrākṣaḥ samāropitakārmukaḥ /
khāṇḍikya uvāca
kṛṣṇājinatvakkavacabhāvenāsmānhaniṣyasi //
meaning:
प्रोवाच क्रोधताम्राक्षः समारोपितकार्मुकः /
खाण्डिक्य उवाच
कृष्णाजिनत्वक्कवचभावेनास्मान्हनिष्यसि //
text_mt: Khāṇḍikya, his eyes red with anger, with strung bow, spoke. / Khāṇḍikya said: / 'Will you slay us under the guise of wearing a black antelope skin as armor?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinadhare vetsi na mayi prahariṣyati /
mṛgānāṃ vada pṛṣṭeṣu mūḍha kṛṣṇājinaṃ na kim //
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनधरे वेत्सि न मयि प्रहरिष्यति /
मृगानां वद पृष्टेषु मूढ कृष्णाजिनं न किम् //
text_mt: Do you think: "He will not strike me while I wear a black antelope skin"? / Tell me, fool, is there not a black antelope skin on the backs of deer,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ matvā vṛthā cogrāḥ prahitāḥ śitasāyakāḥ /
sa tvāmahaṃ haniṣyāmi na me jīvanvimokṣyase //
meaning:
येषां मत्वा वृथा चोग्राः प्रहिताः शितसायकाः /
स त्वामहं हनिष्यामि न मे जीवन्विमोक्ष्यसे //
text_mt: against whom fierce, sharp arrows are discharged without hesitation? / I shall kill you; you will not escape me alive!

sanskrit_iast:
ātatāyyasi durbuddhe mama rājyaharo ripuḥ /
keśidhvaja uvāca
khāṇḍikya saṃśayaṃ praṣṭuṃ bhavantamahamāgataḥ //
meaning:
आतताय्यसि दुर्बुद्धे मम राज्यहरो रिपुः /
केशिध्वज उवाच
खाण्डिक्य संशयं प्रष्टुं भवन्तमहमागतः //
text_mt: You are a treacherous foe, O evil-minded one, who seized my kingdom!' / Keśidhvaja said: / 'O Khāṇḍikya, I have come to ask you about a doubt,

sanskrit_iast:
na tvāṃ hṝntuṃ vicāryataitkopaṃ bāṇaṃ ca muñca vā /
tataḥ sa mantribhiḥ sārddhamekānte sapurohitaḥ //
meaning:
न त्वां हॄन्तुं विचार्यतैत्कोपं बाणं च मुञ्च वा /
ततः स मन्त्रिभिः सार्द्धमेकान्ते सपुरोहितः //
text_mt: not to kill you; consider this, and release your anger and arrow.' / Then, together with his ministers and family priest in private,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrayāmāsa khāṇḍikyaḥ sarvaireva mahāmatiḥ /
tamūrmantriṇo vadhyo ripureṣa vaśaṅgataḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रयामास खाण्डिक्यः सर्वैरेव महामतिः /
तमूर्मन्त्रिणो वध्यो रिपुरेष वशङ्गतः //
text_mt: the highly intelligent Khāṇḍikya deliberated with them all. / The ministers said to him: 'This enemy has fallen into your power; he should be killed!

sanskrit_iast:
hate 'tra pṛthivī sarvā tava vaśyā bhaviṣyati /
khāṇḍikyaścāha tānsarvāneva meva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
हते ऽत्र पृथिवी सर्वा तव वश्या भविष्यति /
खाण्डिक्यश्चाह तान्सर्वानेव मेव न संशयः //
text_mt: When he is killed, the entire earth will be under your control.' / Khāṇḍikya said to them all: 'It is so indeed, there is no doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
hate tu pṛthivī sarvā mama vaśyā bhaviṣyati /
paralokajayastasya pṛthivī sakalā mama //
meaning:
हते तु पृथिवी सर्वा मम वश्या भविष्यति /
परलोकजयस्तस्य पृथिवी सकला मम //
text_mt: if he is killed, the entire earth will be under my control. / Conquest of the next world is his, while the whole earth is mine.

sanskrit_iast:
na hanmi cellokajayo mama vayatvaḥsuṃdharā /
paralokajayo 'nantaḥ svalpakālo mahījayaḥ //
meaning:
न हन्मि चेल्लोकजयो मम वयत्वःसुंधरा /
परलोकजयो ऽनन्तः स्वल्पकालो महीजयः //
text_mt: If I do not kill him, the conquest of worlds will be mine, even though the earth belongs to him; / conquest of the other world is eternal, while conquest of the earth lasts but a short time.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnainaṃ haniṣye 'haṃ yatpṛcchati vadāmi tat /
tatastamabhyupetyāha khāṇḍikyo janako ripum //
meaning:
तस्मान्नैनं हनिष्ये ऽहं यत्पृच्छति वदामि तत् /
ततस्तमभ्युपेत्याह खाण्डिक्यो जनको रिपुम् //
text_mt: Therefore, I will not kill him; I will answer what he asks.' / Then Khāṇḍikya Janaka, having approached his enemy, said:

sanskrit_iast:
praṣṭavyaṃ yattvayā sarvaṃ tatpṛccha tvaṃ vadāmyaham /
tataḥ prāha yathāvṛttaṃ homadhenuvadhaṃ mune //
meaning:
प्रष्टव्यं यत्त्वया सर्वं तत्पृच्छ त्वं वदाम्यहम् /
ततः प्राह यथावृत्तं होमधेनुवधं मुने //
text_mt: 'Whatever is to be asked by you, ask all that; I will tell you.' / Then he related, O sage, the slaughter of the sacrificial cow just as it had occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca taṃ sa papraccha prāyaścittaṃ hi tadrūtam /
sa cācaṣṭa yathānyāyaṃ mune keśidhvajāya tat //
meaning:
ततश्च तं स पप्रच्छ प्रायश्चित्तं हि तद्रूतम् /
स चाचष्ट यथान्यायं मुने केशिध्वजाय तत् //
text_mt: And then he quickly asked him for the expiation for it, / and he explained that properly to Keśidhvaja, O sage—

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittamaśeṣaṃ hi yadvai tatra vidhīyate /
viditārthaḥ sa tenaivamanujñāto mahātmanā //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तमशेषं हि यद्वै तत्र विधीयते /
विदितार्थः स तेनैवमनुज्ञातो महात्मना //
text_mt: the entire expiation, indeed, which is prescribed in that case. / Having understood the matter, and permitted by that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
yāgabhūmimupāgatya cakre sarvāṃ kriyāṃ kramat /
krameṇa vidhivadyāgaṃ nītvā so 'vabhṛthāplutaḥ //
meaning:
यागभूमिमुपागत्य चक्रे सर्वां क्रियां क्रमत् /
क्रमेण विधिवद्यागं नीत्वा सो ऽवभृथाप्लुतः //
text_mt: he went to the sacrificial ground and performed all the rites in sequence. / Having duly brought the sacrifice to completion in order, and having bathed in the concluding bath,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyastato bhūtvā cintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ /
pūjitā ṛtvijaḥ sarve sadasyā mānitā mayā //
meaning:
कृतकृत्यस्ततो भूत्वा चिन्तयामास पार्थिवः /
पूजिता ऋत्विजः सर्वे सदस्या मानिता मया //
text_mt: and having thus achieved his purpose, the king reflected: / 'All the officiating priests have been honored, the assembly members respected by me,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivārthijano 'pyarthojito 'bhimatairmayā /
yathāhaṃ martyalokasya mayā sarvaṃ vicaṣṭitam //
meaning:
तथैवार्थिजनो ऽप्यर्थोजितो ऽभिमतैर्मया /
यथाहं मर्त्यलोकस्य मया सर्वं विचष्टितम् //
text_mt: and the supplicants have been gratified by me with their desired wealth; / I have done everything properly according to the mortal world.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣpannakriyaṃ cetastathā na mama kiṃ yathā /
itthaṃ tu cintayanneva saṃmāra sa mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
अनिष्पन्नक्रियं चेतस्तथा न मम किं यथा /
इत्थं तु चिन्तयन्नेव संमार स महीपतिः //
text_mt: Why, then, does my mind feel as though its duties are incomplete?' / While thus reflecting, the ruler of the earth remembered:

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikyāya na datteti mayā vaigurudakṣiṇā /
sa jagāma tato bhūyo rathamāruhya pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्याय न दत्तेति मया वैगुरुदक्षिणा /
स जगाम ततो भूयो रथमारुह्य पार्थिवः //
text_mt: 'The fee for the preceptor has not been given by me to Khāṇḍikya!' / Thereupon, mounting his chariot again, the king went

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvaḥ sthito yatra khāṇḍikyo 'raṇyadurgamam /
khāṇḍikyo 'pi punarddaṣṭvā tamāyāntaṃ dhṛtāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवः स्थितो यत्र खाण्डिक्यो ऽरण्यदुर्गमम् /
खाण्डिक्यो ऽपि पुनर्द्दष्ट्वा तमायान्तं धृतायुधः //
text_mt: to the impassable forest where Khāṇḍikya of Svāyambhuva's lineage was residing. / Khāṇḍikya also, seeing him arriving once more, took up his weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasthau hṝntuṃ kṛtamatismamāha sa punarnṛpaḥ /
ahaṃ tu nāpakārāya prāptaḥ khāṇḍikya mā krudhaḥ //
meaning:
तस्थौ हॄन्तुं कृतमतिस्ममाह स पुनर्नृपः /
अहं तु नापकाराय प्राप्तः खाण्डिक्य मा क्रुधः //
text_mt:
stood determined to slay him. But that king spoke again:
“I have not arrived to do harm, Khāṇḍikya; do not be angry!

sanskrit_iast:
gurorniṣkṛtidānāya māmavehi semāgatam /
niṣpādito mayā yāgaḥ samyak tvadupadeśataḥ //
meaning:
गुरोर्निष्कृतिदानाय मामवेहि सेमागतम् /
निष्पादितो मया यागः सम्यक् त्वदुपदेशतः //
text_mt:
Know that I have come to offer the teacher's fee.
The sacrifice has been duly accomplished by me according to your instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ te dātumicchāmi vṛṇīṣva gurudakṣiṇām /
ityukto mantrayāmāsa sa bhūyo mantribhiḥ saha //
meaning:
सो ऽहं ते दातुमिच्छामि वृणीष्व गुरुदक्षिणाम् /
इत्युक्तो मन्त्रयामास स भूयो मन्त्रिभिः सह //
text_mt:
As such, I desire to give it to you; choose your teacher's fee!”
Addressed thus, he took counsel once more with his ministers.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorniṣkṛtikāmo 'ya kimayaṃ prārthyatāṃ mayā /
tamūcurmantriṇo gajyamaśeṣaṃ yācyatāmayam //
meaning:
गुरोर्निष्कृतिकामो ऽय किमयं प्रार्थ्यतां मया /
तमूचुर्मन्त्रिणो गज्यमशेषं याच्यतामयम् //
text_mt:
“This man desires to give the teacher's fee; what should I ask of him?”
The ministers said to him: “Let the entire kingdom be requested of him!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtābhiḥ prārthyate rājyamanāyāsitasainikaiḥ /
prāhasya tānāha nṛpaḥ sa khāṇḍikyo mahāpatiḥ //
meaning:
कृताभिः प्रार्थ्यते राज्यमनायासितसैनिकैः /
प्राहस्य तानाह नृपः स खाण्डिक्यो महापतिः //
text_mt:
A kingdom is sought after without putting soldiers to trouble.”
Laughing, that king, Khāṇḍikya, the great lord, said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
svalpakālaṃ mahīrājyaṃ mādṛśaiḥ prārthyate katham /
etametadbhaṃvato 'tra svārtha sādhanamantriṇaḥ //
meaning:
स्वल्पकालं महीराज्यं मादृशैः प्रार्थ्यते कथम् /
एतमेतद्भंवतो ऽत्र स्वार्थ साधनमन्त्रिणः //
text_mt:
“How could an earthly kingdom of very short duration be sought by people like me?
Indeed, you are counsellors here who accomplish [only] selfish worldly ends.

sanskrit_iast:
paramārthaḥ kathaṃ ko 'tra yūyaṃ nātra vicakṣaṇāḥ /
ityuktvā samupetyaiṃnaṃ sa tu keśidhvajaṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
परमार्थः कथं को ऽत्र यूयं नात्र विचक्षणाः /
इत्युक्त्वा समुपेत्यैंनं स तु केशिध्वजं नृपम् //
text_mt:
What is the ultimate truth here, and how is it? You are not discerning in this matter.”
Having spoken thus and approached King Keśidhvaja,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca kimavaśyaṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi gurudakṣiṇām /
bāḍhamityeva tenoktaḥ khāṇḍikyastamathābravīt //
meaning:
उवाच किमवश्यं त्वं दास्यसि गुरुदक्षिणाम् /
बाढमित्येव तेनोक्तः खाण्डिक्यस्तमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
he said: “Will you certainly give the teacher's fee?”
When told, “Certainly,” by him, Khāṇḍikya then said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānadhyātmavijñānaparamārthavicakṣaṇaḥ /
yadi ceddīyate mahyaṃ bhavatā guruniṣkrayaḥ //
meaning:
भवानध्यात्मविज्ञानपरमार्थविचक्षणः /
यदि चेद्दीयते मह्यं भवता गुरुनिष्क्रयः //
text_mt:
“You are expert in the ultimate truth of the knowledge of the Self.
If a teacher's fee is indeed to be given to me by you,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkleśapraśamāyālaṃ yatkarma tadudīraya /
keśidhvaja uvāca
na prārthitaṃ tvayā kasmānmama rājyamakaṇṭakam //
meaning:
तत्क्लेशप्रशमायालं यत्कर्म तदुदीरय /
केशिध्वज उवाच
न प्रार्थितं त्वया कस्मान्मम राज्यमकण्टकम् //
text_mt:
then declare that action which is capable of quelling afflictions.”
Keśidhvaja said:
“Why was my kingdom without rivals not requested by you?

sanskrit_iast:
rājyalābhāḥ ddhi nāstyanyatkṣatriyāṇāmatipriyam /
khāṇḍikya uvāca
keśidhvaja nibodha tvaṃ mayā na prārthitaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
राज्यलाभाः द्धि नास्त्यन्यत्क्षत्रियाणामतिप्रियम् /
खाण्डिक्य उवाच
केशिध्वज निबोध त्वं मया न प्रार्थितं यतः //
text_mt:
For there is nothing else more dear to kṣatriyas than gaining a kingdom.”
Khāṇḍikya said:
“Understand, Keśidhvaja, the reason why it was not requested by me.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyametadaśeṣeṇa yanna gṛghranti paṇḍitāḥ /
kṣatriyāṇāmayaṃ dharmo yatprajāparipālanam //
meaning:
राज्यमेतदशेषेण यन्न गृघ्रन्ति पण्डिताः /
क्षत्रियाणामयं धर्मो यत्प्रजापरिपालनम् //
text_mt:
This entire kingdom is something which the wise do not covet.
This is the duty of kṣatriyas: the protection of subjects,

sanskrit_iast:
vadhaśca dharmayuddhena svarājyaparipanthinām /
yatrāśaktasya me doṣo naivāstyapakṛte tvayā //
meaning:
वधश्च धर्मयुद्धेन स्वराज्यपरिपन्थिनाम् /
यत्राशक्तस्य मे दोषो नैवास्त्यपकृते त्वया //
text_mt:
and the slaying in righteous battle of the adversaries of one's kingdom.
When I was incapable in that regard, there was no fault in me, nor was any harm done by you.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhāyaiva bhavatyeṣā hyavidyā cākramojjhitā /
janmoparbhāgalipsārthamiyaṃ gajyaspṛhā mama //
meaning:
बन्धायैव भवत्येषा ह्यविद्या चाक्रमोज्झिता /
जन्मोपर्भागलिप्सार्थमियं गज्यस्पृहा मम //
text_mt:
This ignorance, abandoned without proper stages, leads only to bondage.
Such a desire for a kingdom would be mine only for the sake of obtaining a subsequent birth.

sanskrit_iast:
anyeṣāṃ dopajāneva dharmamevānurudhyate /
na yācñā kṣatrabandhūnāṃ dharmāyaitatsatāṃ matam //
meaning:
अन्येषां दोपजानेव धर्ममेवानुरुध्यते /
न याच्ञा क्षत्रबन्धूनां धर्मायैतत्सतां मतम् //
text_mt:
Knowing the faults of others, one conforms only to duty;
begging is not for the duty of fallen kṣatriyas—this is the view of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
ato na yācita rājyamavidyāntargataṃ tava /
rājyaṃ gṛdhnanti vidvāṃso mamatvākṛṣṭacetasaḥ //
meaning:
अतो न याचित राज्यमविद्यान्तर्गतं तव /
राज्यं गृध्नन्ति विद्वांसो ममत्वाकृष्टचेतसः //
text_mt:
Therefore your kingdom, which belongs within ignorance, was not requested.
Do the wise, their minds drawn away by mine-ness, covet a kingdom?

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃmānamahya pānamadamattā na mādṛśāḥ /
keśidhvaja uvāca
ahaṃ ca vidyayā mṛtyuṃ tartukāmaḥ karomi vai //
meaning:
अहंमानमह्य पानमदमत्ता न मादृशाः /
केशिध्वज उवाच
अहं च विद्यया मृत्युं तर्तुकामः करोमि वै //
text_mt:
People like me are not intoxicated by pride, drunk on the potion of egotism.”
Keśidhvaja said:
“Desiring to cross beyond death by means of knowledge, I indeed govern

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ yajñāṃśca vividhānbhoge puṇyakṣayaṃ tathā /
tadidaṃ te mano diṣṭyā vivekaiścaryatāṃ gatam //
meaning:
राज्यं यज्ञांश्च विविधान्भोगे पुण्यक्षयं तथा /
तदिदं ते मनो दिष्ट्या विवेकैश्चर्यतां गतम् //
text_mt:
the kingdom and perform various sacrifices, and likewise exhaust merit in enjoyment.
By good fortune, this mind of yours has attained the wealth of discernment.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyatāṃ cāpyavidyāyāḥ svarūpaṃ kulanandana /
anātmanyātmabuddhiryā hyasve svaviṣayā matiḥ //
meaning:
श्रूयतां चाप्यविद्यायाः स्वरूपं कुलनन्दन /
अनात्मन्यात्मबुद्धिर्या ह्यस्वे स्वविषया मतिः //
text_mt:
And hear also the essential nature of ignorance, O delight of your family!
The notion of the Self in what is not the Self, and the thought of ‘mine’ in what is not one's own,

sanskrit_iast:
avidyātarusaṃnbhūtaṃ bījametaddvidhā sthitam /
pañcabhūtātmake dehe dehī mohatamovṛttaḥ //
meaning:
अविद्यातरुसंन्भूतं बीजमेतद्द्विधा स्थितम् /
पञ्चभूतात्मके देहे देही मोहतमोवृत्तः //
text_mt:
is the twofold seed born of the tree of ignorance.
In the body composed of the five elements, the embodied self, enveloped in the darkness of delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
ahametaditītyuñcaiḥ kurute kumatirmatim /
ākāśavāyvagrijalapṛthivībhiḥ pṛthak sthite //
meaning:
अहमेतदितीत्युञ्चैः कुरुते कुमतिर्मतिम् /
आकाशवाय्वग्रिजलपृथिवीभिः पृथक् स्थिते //
text_mt:
foolishly forms the lofty notion: ‘I am this.’
When the Self stands distinct from space, wind, fire, water, and earth,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyātmamayaṃ bhāvaṃ kaḥ karoti kalevare /
kalevaropabhogyaṃ hi gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
आत्मन्यात्ममयं भावं कः करोति कलेवरे /
कलेवरोपभोग्यं हि गृहक्षेत्रादिकं च यत् //
text_mt:
who conceives the idea of the Self in the bodily frame?
And whatever is an object of enjoyment for the bodily frame, such as house, field, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
adehe hyātmani prājño mamedamiti manyate /
itthaṃ ca putrapautreṣu taddehotpāditeṣu ca //
meaning:
अदेहे ह्यात्मनि प्राज्ञो ममेदमिति मन्यते /
इत्थं च पुत्रपौत्रेषु तद्देहोत्पादितेषु च //
text_mt:
the [supposedly] wise man thinks ‘This is mine’ with regard to the bodiless Self.
And likewise in regard to sons and grandsons produced from that body,

sanskrit_iast:
karoti paṇḍitaḥ svāmyamanātmani kalevare /
sarvadehopabhogāya kurute karma mānavaḥ //
meaning:
करोति पण्डितः स्वाम्यमनात्मनि कलेवरे /
सर्वदेहोपभोगाय कुरुते कर्म मानवः //
text_mt:
the learned man assumes ownership over the non-Self physical frame.
A man performs action for the sake of the enjoyment of the whole body;

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ cānyadyadā puṃsaḥsadā bandhāya tatparam /
mṛṇmayaṃ hi yathā gehaṃ lipyate vai mṛdaṃ bhasā //
meaning:
देहं चान्यद्यदा पुंसःसदा बन्धाय तत्परम् /
मृण्मयं हि यथा गेहं लिप्यते वै मृदं भसा //
text_mt:
and when another body comes to a man, that leads always to further bondage.
For just as a house made of clay is smeared with clay and water,

sanskrit_iast:
pārthivo 'yaṃ tathā deho mṛdaṃbholepanasthitiḥ /
pañcabhogātmakairbhogaiḥ pañcabhogātmakaṃ vapuḥ //
meaning:
पार्थिवो ऽयं तथा देहो मृदंभोलेपनस्थितिः /
पञ्चभोगात्मकैर्भोगैः पञ्चभोगात्मकं वपुः //
text_mt:
so this earthly body is maintained by plastering with clay and water.
If the body composed of five enjoyments is nourished

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyate yadi tataḥ puṃso garvo 'tra kiṅkṛtaḥ /
anekajanmasāhastraṃ sasārapadavīṃ vrajan //
meaning:
आप्यायते यदि ततः पुंसो गर्वो ऽत्र किङ्कृतः /
अनेकजन्मसाहस्त्रं ससारपदवीं व्रजन् //
text_mt:
by pleasures consisting of the five sensory objects, what cause for pride is there here for a man?
Wandering along the path of worldly existence through many thousands of births,

sanskrit_iast:
mohaśramaṃ prayāto 'sau vāsanāreṇuguṇṭhitaḥ /
prakṣālyate yadā saumya reṇurjñānoṣṇavāriṇā //
meaning:
मोहश्रमं प्रयातो ऽसौ वासनारेणुगुण्ठितः /
प्रक्षाल्यते यदा सौम्य रेणुर्ज्ञानोष्णवारिणा //
text_mt:
he has incurred the weariness of delusion, covered with the dust of latent impressions.
When that dust is washed away, gentle one, by the warm water of knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā saṃsārapānthasya yāti mohaśramaḥ śamam /
mohaśrame śamaṃ yāte svacchāntaḥkaraṇaḥ pumān //
meaning:
तदा संसारपान्थस्य याति मोहश्रमः शमम् /
मोहश्रमे शमं याते स्वच्छान्तःकरणः पुमान् //
text_mt:
then the weariness of delusion comes to an end for the traveler in worldly existence.
When the weariness of delusion has ceased, the person of pure inner sense,

sanskrit_iast:
ananyātiśayādhāraḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati /
nirvāṇamaya evāyamātmā jñānamayo 'malaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्यातिशयाधारः परं निर्वाणमृच्छति /
निर्वाणमय एवायमात्मा ज्ञानमयो ऽमलः //
text_mt:
the substrate of unsurpassable excellence, attains supreme nirvāṇa.
This Self is indeed of the nature of nirvāṇa, of the nature of knowledge, taintless.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhājñānamayā dharmāḥ prakṛteste tunātmanaḥ /
jalasya nāgninā saṃgaḥ sthālīsaṃgāttathāpi hi //
meaning:
दुःखाज्ञानमया धर्माः प्रकृतेस्ते तुनात्मनः /
जलस्य नाग्निना संगः स्थालीसंगात्तथापि हि //
text_mt:
Attributes consisting of suffering and ignorance belong to material nature, but not to the Self.
Just as water has no contact with fire, yet through contact with the pot

sanskrit_iast:
śabdodrekādikāndharmānkaroti hi yathā budhaḥ /
tathātmā prakṛteḥ saṃgādahaṃmānādidūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
शब्दोद्रेकादिकान्धर्मान्करोति हि यथा बुधः /
तथात्मा प्रकृतेः संगादहंमानादिदूषितः //
text_mt:
it manifests properties such as bubbling sounds, as the wise know,
even so the Self, defiled by egotism and the like through contact with material nature,

sanskrit_iast:
bhajate prākṛtāndharmānnyastastaṃbho hi so 'vyayaḥ /
tadetatkathitaṃ bījamavidyāyā mayā tava //
meaning:
भजते प्राकृतान्धर्मान्न्यस्तस्तंभो हि सो ऽव्ययः /
तदेतत्कथितं बीजमविद्याया मया तव //
text_mt:
experiences natural properties, yet that imperishable one is an immovable pillar.
This seed of ignorance has thus been described by me to you.

sanskrit_iast:
kleśānāṃ ca kṣayakaraṃ yogādanyanna vidyate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
क्लेशानां च क्षयकरं योगादन्यन्न विद्यते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे षट्चत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
And there is nothing other than yoga that destroys afflictions.”

Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter in the second quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
etadadhyātmamānāḍhyaṃ vacaḥ keśidhvajasya saḥ /
khāṇḍikyo 'mṛtavacchratvā punarāha tamīrayan //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
एतदध्यात्ममानाढ्यं वचः केशिध्वजस्य सः /
खाण्डिक्यो ऽमृतवच्छ्रत्वा पुनराह तमीरयन् //
text_mt:
Sanandana said:
Having heard these words of Keśidhvaja, rich in the science of the Self, like nectar,
Khāṇḍikya spoke again, addressing him:

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikya uvāca
tad brūhi tvaṃ mahābhāga yogaṃ yogaviduttama /
vijñātayo gaśāstrārthastvamasyāṃ nimisaṃtatau //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्य उवाच
तद् ब्रूहि त्वं महाभाग योगं योगविदुत्तम /
विज्ञातयो गशास्त्रार्थस्त्वमस्यां निमिसंततौ //
text_mt:
Khāṇḍikya said:
“Therefore tell me about yoga, O fortunate one, foremost among knowers of yoga!
You have understood the meaning of the treatises on yoga in this lineage of Nimi.”

sanskrit_iast:
keśidhvaja uvāca
yogasvarūpaṃ khāṇḍikya śrūyatāṃ gadato mama /
yatra sthito na cyavate prāpya brahmalayaṃ muniḥ //
meaning:
केशिध्वज उवाच
योगस्वरूपं खाण्डिक्य श्रूयतां गदतो मम /
यत्र स्थितो न च्यवते प्राप्य ब्रह्मलयं मुनिः //
text_mt:
Keśidhvaja said:
“Hear from me as I speak, Khāṇḍikya, the nature of yoga,
established in which the sage, having attained dissolution in Brahman, does not fall.

sanskrit_iast:
mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥ /
bandhasya viṣayāsaṃgi mukternirviṣayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मन एव मनुष्याणां कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः /
बन्धस्य विषयासंगि मुक्तेर्निर्विषयं तथा //
text_mt:
The mind alone is the cause of bondage and liberation for human beings:
attached to sense objects, it leads to bondage; free from sense objects, to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayebhyaḥ samāhṛtya vijñānātmā budho manaḥ /
cintayenmuktaye tena brahmabhūtaṃ pareśvaram //
meaning:
विषयेभ्यः समाहृत्य विज्ञानात्मा बुधो मनः /
चिन्तयेन्मुक्तये तेन ब्रह्मभूतं परेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Having withdrawn the mind from sense objects, the wise one, of the nature of understanding,
should meditate with it upon the Supreme Lord who is Brahman, for the sake of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmabhāvaṃ nayettena tadbrīhyadhyāpanaṃ manaḥ /
vikāryamātmanaḥ śaktyā lohamākarṣako yathā //
meaning:
आत्मभावं नयेत्तेन तद्ब्रीह्यध्यापनं मनः /
विकार्यमात्मनः शक्त्या लोहमाकर्षको यथा //
text_mt:
By that means he should bring the mind to the state of the Self, directing it to that Brahman;
as a magnet acts upon iron, it is to be transformed by its own power.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaprayatnasāpekṣā viśiṣṭā yā manogatiḥ /
tasyā brahmaṇi saṃyogo yoga ityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
आत्मप्रयत्नसापेक्षा विशिष्टा या मनोगतिः /
तस्या ब्रह्मणि संयोगो योग इत्यभिधीयते //
text_mt:
That distinct movement of the mind which depends upon self-effort,
its union with Brahman, is called yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
evamatyantavaiśiṣṭyayuktadharmopalakṣaṇam /
yasya yogaḥ sa vai yogī mumukṣuramidhīyate //
meaning:
एवमत्यन्तवैशिष्ट्ययुक्तधर्मोपलक्षणम् /
यस्य योगः स वै योगी मुमुक्षुरमिधीयते //
text_mt:
He whose yoga is characterized by attributes endowed with such extreme distinction
is indeed designated a yogin, a seeker of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yogayuk prathamaṃ yogī yuñjamāno 'bhidhīyate /
viniṣyannasamādhistu parabrahmopalabdhimān //
meaning:
योगयुक् प्रथमं योगी युञ्जमानो ऽभिधीयते /
विनिष्यन्नसमाधिस्तु परब्रह्मोपलब्धिमान् //
text_mt:
First, the yogin joined in yoga is called one who is practicing;
but the one whose absorption is accomplished is one who perceives the Supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyantarāyadoṣeṇa dūṣyate nāsya mānasam /
janmāntarairabhyasanānmuktiḥ pūrvasya jāyate //
meaning:
यद्यन्तरायदोषेण दूष्यते नास्य मानसम् /
जन्मान्तरैरभ्यसनान्मुक्तिः पूर्वस्य जायते //
text_mt:
If his mind is not corrupted by the fault of obstacles,
liberation comes to the former through practice over other births.

sanskrit_iast:
viniṣpannasamādhistu muktistatraiva janmani /
prāpnoti yogī yogāgnidagdhakarmacayo 'cirāt //
meaning:
विनिष्पन्नसमाधिस्तु मुक्तिस्तत्रैव जन्मनि /
प्राप्नोति योगी योगाग्निदग्धकर्मचयो ऽचिरात् //
text_mt:
The yogin whose absorption is accomplished, however, attains liberation in that very birth,
the heap of his past actions quickly burnt by the fire of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryamahiṃsāṃ ca satyāsteyāparigrahān /
seveta yogī niṣkāmo yigitāṃ svamano nayan //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसां च सत्यास्तेयापरिग्रहान् /
सेवेत योगी निष्कामो यिगितां स्वमनो नयन् //
text_mt:
A yogin should cultivate celibacy, non-violence,
truthfulness, non-stealing, and non-possession, desireless, bringing his mind under control.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyaśaucasaṃtoṣatapāṃsi niyamānyamān /
kurvvīta brahmaṇi tathā parisminpravaṇaṃ manaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाध्यायशौचसंतोषतपांसि नियमान्यमान् /
कुर्व्वीत ब्रह्मणि तथा परिस्मिन्प्रवणं मनः //
text_mt: [He should practice] study of the scriptures, purity, contentment, and austerities as observances, and the restraints; / likewise he should make his mind inclined toward the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
ete yamāśca niyamāḥ pañca pañcaprakīrtitāḥ /
viśiṣṭaphaladāḥ kāmyā niṣkāmānāṃ vimuktidāḥ //
meaning:
एते यमाश्च नियमाः पञ्च पञ्चप्रकीर्तिताः /
विशिष्टफलदाः काम्या निष्कामानां विमुक्तिदाः //
text_mt: These restraints and observances are taught to be five each; / when desired with motive they grant distinguished fruits, but to the motiveless they grant liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhadrāsanādīnāṃ samāsthāya guṇairyutaḥ /
yamākhyairniyamākhyaiśca yuñjīta niyato yatiḥ //
meaning:
एवं भद्रासनादीनां समास्थाय गुणैर्युतः /
यमाख्यैर्नियमाख्यैश्च युञ्जीत नियतो यतिः //
text_mt: Thus seated in bhadrāsana or other postures, endowed with the qualities / called restraints and observances, the restrained ascetic should practice yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇākhyamavalaṃbasthamabhyāsātkurute tu yat /
prāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sabījo 'bīja eva ca //
meaning:
प्राणाख्यमवलंबस्थमभ्यासात्कुरुते तु यत् /
प्राणायामः स विज्ञेयः सबीजो ऽबीज एव च //
text_mt: That which, based on an object of support, one performs through practice upon the breath, / is to be known as prāṇāyāma, both with seed and without seed.

sanskrit_iast:
paraspareṇābhibhavaṃ prāṇāpānau yadā nilau /
kurutaḥ sadvidhānena tṛtīyaḥ saṃyamāttayoḥ //
meaning:
परस्परेणाभिभवं प्राणापानौ यदा निलौ /
कुरुतः सद्विधानेन तृतीयः संयमात्तयोः //
text_mt: When the two winds, prāṇa and apāna, subdue each other / according to the true method, a third [state arises] from the restraint of both.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cāṃlabanavatsthūlaṃ rūpaṃ dviṣatpate /
ālaṃbanamanantasya yogino 'bhyasataḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
तस्य चांलबनवत्स्थूलं रूपं द्विषत्पते /
आलंबनमनन्तस्य योगिनो ऽभ्यसतः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Its support is the gross form [of the Lord], O slayer of foes; / the gross form is taught to be the support of the Infinite for the practicing yogī.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdādiṣvanuraktāni nigṛhyākṣāṇi yogavit /
kuryyāñcittānukārīṇi pratyāhāraparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शब्दादिष्वनुरक्तानि निगृह्याक्षाणि योगवित् /
कुर्य्याञ्चित्तानुकारीणि प्रत्याहारपरायणः //
text_mt: Restraining the senses that are attached to sound and the rest, / the knower of yoga, intent upon pratyāhāra, should make them conform to the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśyatā paramā tena jāyate niścalā tmanām /
indriyāṇāmavaśyaistairna yogī yogasādhakaḥ //
meaning:
वश्यता परमा तेन जायते निश्चला त्मनाम् /
इन्द्रियाणामवश्यैस्तैर्न योगी योगसाधकः //
text_mt: Thereby supreme mastery arises for those whose minds are steady; / with senses unsubdued, the yogī cannot accomplish yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmena pavanaiḥ pratyāhareṇa cendriyaiḥ /
vaśīkṛtaistataḥ kuryātsthiraṃ cetaḥ śubhāśraye //
meaning:
प्राणायामेन पवनैः प्रत्याहरेण चेन्द्रियैः /
वशीकृतैस्ततः कुर्यात्स्थिरं चेतः शुभाश्रये //
text_mt: With the winds subdued through prāṇāyāma and the senses through pratyāhāra, / he should then make his mind steady upon the auspicious support.

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikya uvāca
kathyatāṃ me mahābhāga cetaso yaḥ śubhāśrayaḥ /
yadādhāramaśeṣaṃ tu hṝnti doṣasamudbhavam //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्य उवाच
कथ्यतां मे महाभाग चेतसो यः शुभाश्रयः /
यदाधारमशेषं तु हॄन्ति दोषसमुद्भवम् //
text_mt:
Khāṇḍikya said:
Tell me, O fortunate one, what is that auspicious support of the mind, / depending upon which it completely removes faults born of [worldly] origin?

sanskrit_iast:
keśidhvaja uvāca
āśrayaścetaso jñānin dvidhā tañca svarūpataḥ /
rūpaṃ mūrtamamūrtaṃ ca paraṃ cāparameva ca //
meaning:
केशिध्वज उवाच
आश्रयश्चेतसो ज्ञानिन् द्विधा तञ्च स्वरूपतः /
रूपं मूर्तममूर्तं च परं चापरमेव च //
text_mt:
Keśidhvaja said:
O wise one, the support of the mind is two-fold according to its nature: / the form [is both] embodied and unembodied, supreme and non-supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhā bhāvanā rūpaṃ viśvametattridhocyate /
brahmākhyā karmasaṃjñā ca tathā caivobhayātmikā //
meaning:
त्रिविधा भावना रूपं विश्वमेतत्त्रिधोच्यते /
ब्रह्माख्या कर्मसंज्ञा च तथा चैवोभयात्मिका //
text_mt: The three-fold conception is its form; this universe is said to be three-fold: / that called Brahman, that termed ritual action, and likewise that which is of the nature of both.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhāvātmikā hyekā brahmabhāvātmikāparā /
ubhayātmikā tathaivānyā trividhā bhāvabhāvanā //
meaning:
कर्मभावात्मिका ह्येका ब्रह्मभावात्मिकापरा /
उभयात्मिका तथैवान्या त्रिविधा भावभावना //
text_mt: One is of the nature of the conception of action; another is of the nature of the conception of Brahman; / and another is likewise of the nature of both: thus three-fold is the conception of being.

sanskrit_iast:
sanakādyā sadā jñānin brahmabhāvanayā yutāḥ /
karmabhāvanayā cānye devādyāḥ sthāvarāścarāḥ //
meaning:
सनकाद्या सदा ज्ञानिन् ब्रह्मभावनया युताः /
कर्मभावनया चान्ये देवाद्याः स्थावराश्चराः //
text_mt: Sanaka and the others, O wise one, are ever endowed with the conception of Brahman, / while other beings, beginning with the gods down to immobile and mobile creatures, have the conception of action.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhādiṣu ca brahmakarmātmikā dvidhā /
adhikārabodhayukteṣu vidyate bhāvabhāvanā //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भादिषु च ब्रह्मकर्मात्मिका द्विधा /
अधिकारबोधयुक्तेषु विद्यते भावभावना //
text_mt: In Hiraṇyagarbha and the rest, the conception of being exists as two-fold, / consisting of Brahman and action, in those who are endowed with qualification and understanding.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣīṇeṣu samasteṣu viśeṣajñānakarmasu /
viśvametatparaṃ cānyadbhedabhinnadṛśāṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
अक्षीणेषु समस्तेषु विशेषज्ञानकर्मसु /
विश्वमेतत्परं चान्यद्भेदभिन्नदृशां नृप //
text_mt: Until all differentiation of knowledge and action is extinguished, / this universe appears supreme and other to those of divided vision, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyastamitabhedaṃ yatsattāmātramagocaram /
vacasāmātmasaṃtodyaṃ tajjñānaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
प्रत्यस्तमितभेदं यत्सत्तामात्रमगोचरम् /
वचसामात्मसंतोद्यं तज्ज्ञानं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: That in which differentiation has set, which is pure existence, beyond the range / of words, to be known within oneself—that knowledge is termed Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tacca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ rūpamarūpasyājanasya ca /
viśvasvarūpaṃ vairūpyalakṣaṇaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तच्च विष्णोः परं रूपमरूपस्याजनस्य च /
विश्वस्वरूपं वैरूप्यलक्षणं परमात्मनः //
text_mt: And that is the supreme, formless, unborn form of Viṣṇu, / whose own nature is the universe, yet whose characteristic is difference of form from the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
na tadyogayujā śakyaṃ nṛpa cintayituṃ yataḥ /
tataḥ sthūlaṃ hare rūpaṃ cintyaṃ yañcakṣugocaram //
meaning:
न तद्योगयुजा शक्यं नृप चिन्तयितुं यतः /
ततः स्थूलं हरे रूपं चिन्त्यं यञ्चक्षुगोचरम् //
text_mt: Since that cannot be meditated upon by one practicing yoga, O king, / therefore the gross form of Hari, which falls within the range of the eye, is to be meditated upon.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavānvāsavo 'tha prajāpatiḥ /
maruto vasavo rudrā bhāskārāstārakā grahāḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान्वासवो ऽथ प्रजापतिः /
मरुतो वसवो रुद्रा भास्कारास्तारका ग्रहाः //
text_mt: The lord Hiraṇyagarbha, Indra, Prajāpati, / the Maruts, the Vasus, the Rudras, the suns, the stars, the planets,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā yakṣadaityāśca sakalā devayotayaḥ /
manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ śailāsamudrāḥ sarito drumāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वा यक्षदैत्याश्च सकला देवयोतयः /
मनुष्याः पशवः शैलासमुद्राः सरितो द्रुमाः //
text_mt: the Gandharvas, the Yakṣas, the Daityas, all the divine wombs, / human beings, animals, mountains, oceans, rivers, trees,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpa bhūtānyaśeṣāṇi bhūtānāṃ ye ca hetavaḥ /
pradhānādiviśeṣāntāścetanāñcetanātmakam //
meaning:
भूप भूतान्यशेषाणि भूतानां ये च हेतवः /
प्रधानादिविशेषान्ताश्चेतनाञ्चेतनात्मकम् //
text_mt: all the beings, O king, and the causes of beings / ending with the specific evolutes beginning with the unmanifest, consisting of both conscious and unconscious,

sanskrit_iast:
ekapādaṃ dvipādaṃ ca bahupādamapādakam /
mūrttametaddhare rūpaṃ bhāvanātritayātmakam //
meaning:
एकपादं द्विपादं च बहुपादमपादकम् /
मूर्त्तमेतद्धरे रूपं भावनात्रितयात्मकम् //
text_mt: one-footed, two-footed, many-footed, and footless— / this is the embodied form of Hari, consisting of the triad of conceptions.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvamidaṃ viṃśvaṃ jagadetañcarācaram /
parabrahmasvarūpasya viṣṇoḥ śaktisamanvitam //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वमिदं विंश्वं जगदेतञ्चराचरम् /
परब्रह्मस्वरूपस्य विष्णोः शक्तिसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: All this universe, this moving and unmoving world, / is endowed with the power of Viṣṇu, whose essential nature is the Supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuśaktiḥ parā proktā kṣetrajñākhyā tathāparā /
avidyākarmasaṃjñānyā tṛtīyā śaktiriṣyate //
meaning:
विष्णुशक्तिः परा प्रोक्ता क्षेत्रज्ञाख्या तथापरा /
अविद्याकर्मसंज्ञान्या तृतीया शक्तिरिष्यते //
text_mt: The power of Viṣṇu is said to be supreme; another is termed the knower of the field; / and a third power is acknowledged, termed ignorance and action.

sanskrit_iast:
yeyaṃ kṣetrajñaśaktiḥ sā ceṣṭitā nṛpa karmajā /
asārabhūte saṃsāre proktā tatra mahāmate //
meaning:
येयं क्षेत्रज्ञशक्तिः सा चेष्टिता नृप कर्मजा /
असारभूते संसारे प्रोक्ता तत्र महामते //
text_mt: This power called the knower of the field, O king, functions as born of action; / it is declared [to abide] there in the worthless saṃsāra, O wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāratāpānakhilānavāpnotyanusaṃjñitān /
tayā tirohitatvāttu śaktiḥ kṣetrajña saṃjñitā //
meaning:
संसारतापानखिलानवाप्नोत्यनुसंज्ञितान् /
तया तिरोहितत्वात्तु शक्तिः क्षेत्रज्ञ संज्ञिता //
text_mt: Because it is veiled by that [ignorance], the power called the knower of the field / experiences all the afflictions of saṃsāra, according to its name.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūteṣu bhūpāla tāratamyena lakṣyate /
aprāṇavatsu khalvalpā sthāvareṣu tato 'dhikā //
meaning:
सर्वभूतेषु भूपाल तारतम्येन लक्ष्यते /
अप्राणवत्सु खल्वल्पा स्थावरेषु ततो ऽधिका //
text_mt: In all beings, O protector of the earth, it is perceived in gradations; / it is indeed very small in the lifeless, and greater in the immobile.

sanskrit_iast:
sarīsṛpeṣu tebhyo 'nyāpyatiśaktyā patatriśu /
patatrribhyo mṛgāstebhyaḥ svaśaktyā paśavo 'dhikāḥ //
meaning:
सरीसृपेषु तेभ्यो ऽन्याप्यतिशक्त्या पतत्रिशु /
पतत्र्रिभ्यो मृगास्तेभ्यः स्वशक्त्या पशवो ऽधिकाः //
text_mt: In reptiles it is other than those, and with still greater power in birds; / deer are greater than birds, and domestic beasts are greater than them in their own power.

sanskrit_iast:
paśubhyo manujāścātiśaktyā puṃsaḥprabhāvitāḥ /
tebhyo 'pi nāgagandharvayakṣādyā devatā nṛpa //
meaning:
पशुभ्यो मनुजाश्चातिशक्त्या पुंसःप्रभाविताः /
तेभ्यो ऽपि नागगन्धर्वयक्षाद्या देवता नृप //
text_mt: Men are manifested with exceeding power above beasts, / and above them are the deities, O king, beginning with the Nāgas, Gandharvas, and Yakṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
śakraḥ samastadevebhyastataścātiprajāpatiḥ /
hiraṇyagarbho 'pi tataḥ puṃsaḥ śaktyupalakṣitaḥ //
meaning:
शक्रः समस्तदेवेभ्यस्ततश्चातिप्रजापतिः /
हिरण्यगर्भो ऽपि ततः पुंसः शक्त्युपलक्षितः //
text_mt: Indra is above all the gods, and Prajāpati is beyond him; / and Hiraṇyagarbha beyond him is marked with the power of the Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
etānyaśeṣarūpāṇi tasya rūpāṇi pārthiva /
yatastacchaktiyogena yuktāni nabhasā yathā //
meaning:
एतान्यशेषरूपाणि तस्य रूपाणि पार्थिव /
यतस्तच्छक्तियोगेन युक्तानि नभसा यथा //
text_mt: All these limitless forms are his forms, O king, / because they are united through connection with his power, like space.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñasya yogidhyeyaṃ mahāmate /
amṛrtaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ yatsadityucyate budhaiḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयं विष्णुसंज्ञस्य योगिध्येयं महामते /
अमृर्तं ब्रह्मणो रूपं यत्सदित्युच्यते बुधैः //
text_mt: The second [form] of the one called Viṣṇu, to be meditated upon by yogīs, O wise one, / is the unembodied form of Brahman, which is called 'the Real' by the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
samastāḥ śaktayaścaitā nṛpa yatra pratiṣṭitāḥ /
nahi svarūparūpaṃ vai rūpamanyaddharermahat //
meaning:
समस्ताः शक्तयश्चैता नृप यत्र प्रतिष्टिताः /
नहि स्वरूपरूपं वै रूपमन्यद्धरेर्महत् //
text_mt: wherein all these powers are established, O king. / Indeed, there is no other great form of Hari than his essential form.

sanskrit_iast:
samastaśaktirūpāṇi tatkaroti janeśvara /
devatiryaṅmanuṣyādiceṣṭāvanti svalīlayā //
meaning:
समस्तशक्तिरूपाणि तत्करोति जनेश्वर /
देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्यादिचेष्टावन्ति स्वलीलया //
text_mt: He produces all forms of power, O ruler of people, / possessing the activities of gods, animals, humans, and the rest, by his own play.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatāmupakārāya tasya karmanimittajā /
ceṣṭā tasyāprameyasya vyāpinyavihitātmikā //
meaning:
जगतामुपकाराय तस्य कर्मनिमित्तजा /
चेष्टा तस्याप्रमेयस्य व्यापिन्यविहितात्मिका //
text_mt: For the welfare of the worlds, his activity is not caused by karma; / the activity of that immeasurable, all-pervading one is autonomous.

sanskrit_iast:
tadrūpaṃ viśvarūpāya cintyaṃ yoga yujā nṛpa /
tasya hyātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam //
meaning:
तद्रूपं विश्वरूपाय चिन्त्यं योग युजा नृप /
तस्य ह्यात्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं सर्वकिल्बिषनाशनम् //
text_mt: That form of the Universal Form is to be meditated upon by one joined in yoga, O king; / indeed, for his self-purification, it destroys all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāgnirūddhataśikhaḥ kakṣaṃ dahati sānilaḥ /
tathā cittasthito viṣṇuryogināṃ sarvakilbiṣam //
meaning:
यथाग्निरूद्धतशिखः कक्षं दहति सानिलः /
तथा चित्तस्थितो विष्णुर्योगिनां सर्वकिल्बिषम् //
text_mt: Just as a fire with leaping flames, accompanied by wind, burns up dry grass, / even so Viṣṇu, residing in the mind, burns all the sin of yogīs.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsamastaśaktīnāmāndyānte tatra cetasaḥ /
kurvīta saṃsthitaṃ sādhu vijñeyā śuddhalakṣaṇā //
meaning:
तस्मात्समस्तशक्तीनामान्द्यान्ते तत्र चेतसः /
कुर्वीत संस्थितं साधु विज्ञेया शुद्धलक्षणा //
text_mt: Therefore, upon that which is the beginning and end of all powers, / one should establish the mind well; it is to be known as pure by nature.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāṃśrayaḥ sacittasya sarvagasya tathātmanaḥ /
tribhāvabhāvanātīto muktaye yogināṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
शुभांश्रयः सचित्तस्य सर्वगस्य तथात्मनः /
त्रिभावभावनातीतो मुक्तये योगिनां नृप //
text_mt: That auspicious support of the mind, and likewise of the all-pervading Self, / is beyond the three conceptions of being, for the liberation of yogīs, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
anye tu puruṣavyāghra cetaso ye vyāpā8yāḥ /
aśuddhāste samastāstu devādyāḥ karmayonayaḥ //
meaning:
अन्ये तु पुरुषव्याघ्र चेतसो ये व्यापा8याः /
अशुद्धास्ते समस्तास्तु देवाद्याः कर्मयोनयः //
text_mt: Other supports of the mind, O tiger among men, / are all impure, beginning with the gods, having action as their origin.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttaṃ bhagavato rūpaṃ sarvāpāśrayanispṛhaḥ /
eṣā vai dhāraṇā jñeyā yañcitaṃ tatra dhāryate //
meaning:
मूर्त्तं भगवतो रूपं सर्वापाश्रयनिस्पृहः /
एषा वै धारणा ज्ञेया यञ्चितं तत्र धार्यते //
text_mt: When one is detached from all other supports, [focusing on] the embodied form of the Lord, / this is indeed to be known as dhāraṇā, wherein the mind is held fixed there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mūrttaṃ hare rūpaṃ yādṛk cintyaṃ narādhipa /
tacchrūyatā manādhāre dhāraṇā nopapadyate //
meaning:
तत्र मूर्त्तं हरे रूपं यादृक् चिन्त्यं नराधिप /
तच्छ्रूयता मनाधारे धारणा नोपपद्यते //
text_mt: Hear what kind of embodied form of Hari is to be meditated upon there, O king; / without a support, dhāraṇā is not possible.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannacāruvadanaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam /
sukapolaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ lalāṭaphalakojjvam //
meaning:
प्रसन्नचारुवदनं पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणम् /
सुकपोलं सुविस्तीर्णं ललाटफलकोज्ज्वम् //
text_mt: One should meditate upon him whose face is serene and handsome, whose eyes are long like lotus petals, / who has beautiful cheeks and a broad, radiant forehead-slab,

sanskrit_iast:
samakarṇāṃsavinya stacārukarṇopabhūṣaṇam /
kambugrīvaṃ suvistīrṇaśrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasam //
meaning:
समकर्णांसविन्य स्तचारुकर्णोपभूषणम् /
कम्बुग्रीवं सुविस्तीर्णश्रीवत्सांकितवक्षसम् //
text_mt: who has lovely ear ornaments resting on symmetrical ears and shoulders, / who has a conch-like neck and a broad chest marked with the Śrīvatsa,

sanskrit_iast:
balitriṃbhāginā bhugnanābhinā codareṇa vai /
pralaṃbāṣṭabhujaṃ viṣṇumatha vāpi caturbhujam //
meaning:
बलित्रिंभागिना भुग्ननाभिना चोदरेण वै /
प्रलंबाष्टभुजं विष्णुमथ वापि चतुर्भुजम् //
text_mt: with an abdomen graced with three folds and a deep navel, / having long, eight arms—or else four arms—namely Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
samasthitorujaghanaṃ susthirāṅghrikarāṃbujaṃm /
cintayedbūhyabhūtaṃ taṃ pītanirmalavāsasam //
meaning:
समस्थितोरुजघनं सुस्थिराङ्घ्रिकरांबुजंम् /
चिन्तयेद्बूह्यभूतं तं पीतनिर्मलवाससम् //
text_mt: with well-proportioned thighs and hips, with very steady lotus feet and lotus hands, / wearing pure yellow garments, meditated upon as a manifest entity,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭacārukeyūrakaṭakādivibhūṣitam /
śārṅgaśaṅkhagadākhaḍgaprakāśavalayāñcitam //
meaning:
किरीटचारुकेयूरकटकादिविभूषितम् /
शार्ङ्गशङ्खगदाखड्गप्रकाशवलयाञ्चितम् //
text_mt: adorned with a diadem, lovely armlets, bracelets, and other ornaments, / and embellished with a brilliant discus, the bow Śārṅga, a conch, a mace, and a sword.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayettanmayo yogī samādhāyātmamānasam /
tāvadyāvad dṛḍhībhūtā tatraiva nṛpa dhāraṇā //
meaning:
चिन्तयेत्तन्मयो योगी समाधायात्ममानसम् /
तावद्यावद् दृढीभूता तत्रैव नृप धारणा //
text_mt: Absorbed in Him, the yogin should concentrate his mind and meditate, / so long, O king, until fixation [of the mind] upon that very [form] becomes firm.

sanskrit_iast:
vadatastiṣṭato yadvā svecchayā karma kurvataḥ /
nāpayāti yadā cittātsiddhāṃ manyeta tāṃ tadā //
meaning:
वदतस्तिष्टतो यद्वा स्वेच्छया कर्म कुर्वतः /
नापयाति यदा चित्तात्सिद्धां मन्येत तां तदा //
text_mt: When it does not depart from the mind while speaking, standing, / or doing actions at will, then he may consider it attained.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śaṅkhagadācakraśārṅgādi rahitaṃ budhaḥ /
cintaye dbhagavadrūpaṃ praśāntaṃ sākṣasūtrakam //
meaning:
ततः शङ्खगदाचक्रशार्ङ्गादि रहितं बुधः /
चिन्तये द्भगवद्रूपं प्रशान्तं साक्षसूत्रकम् //
text_mt: Then the wise man should meditate on the Lord's peaceful form, / holding a rosary, devoid of the conch, mace, discus, bow, and other attributes.

sanskrit_iast:
sā yadā dhāraṇā tadvadavasthānavatī tataḥ /
kirīṭakeyūramukhairbhūṣaṇai rahitaṃ smaret //
meaning:
सा यदा धारणा तद्वदवस्थानवती ततः /
किरीटकेयूरमुखैर्भूषणै रहितं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: When that fixation is likewise firmly established, / then he should remember Him as devoid of ornaments such as diadem, armlets, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tadekāvayavaṃ caivaṃ cetasā hi punarbudhaḥ /
kuryāttato 'vayavini prāṇidhānaparo bhavet //
meaning:
तदेकावयवं चैवं चेतसा हि पुनर्बुधः /
कुर्यात्ततो ऽवयविनि प्राणिधानपरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Then the wise man should indeed place his mind upon a single limb of that [form]; / thereafter, he should become intent upon the one possessing limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tadrūpapratyaye caikasaṃnatiścānyaniḥspṛhā /
taddhyānaṃ prathamairaṅgaiḥ ṣaṅbhirniṣpādyate nṛpa //
meaning:
तद्रूपप्रत्यये चैकसंनतिश्चान्यनिःस्पृहा /
तद्ध्यानं प्रथमैरङ्गैः षङ्भिर्निष्पाद्यते नृप //
text_mt: The continuous flow [of thought] upon the idea of that form alone, without desire for anything else, / is meditation; it is accomplished through the first six limbs, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ kalpanāhīnaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ hi yat /
manasā dhyānaniṣpādyaṃ samādhiḥ so 'bhidhīyate //
meaning:
तस्यैवं कल्पनाहीनं स्वरूपग्रहणं हि यत् /
मनसा ध्याननिष्पाद्यं समाधिः सो ऽभिधीयते //
text_mt: Indeed, that apprehension of the essential nature itself, devoid of mental construction / and brought about by meditation through the mind, is called samādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānaṃ prāpakaṃ prāpye paraṃ brahmaṇi pārthiva /
prāpaṇīyastathaivātmā prakṣīṇāśeṣabhāvanaḥ //
meaning:
विज्ञानं प्रापकं प्राप्ये परं ब्रह्मणि पार्थिव /
प्रापणीयस्तथैवात्मा प्रक्षीणाशेषभावनः //
text_mt: Wisdom is the means of reaching the goal—the supreme Brahman, O king; / and the self, with all mental constructions destroyed, is that which is to be reached.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñakaraṇījñānaṃ karaṇaṃ tena tasya tat /
niṣpādya muktikāryaṃ vai kṛtakṛtyo nivartate //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञकरणीज्ञानं करणं तेन तस्य तत् /
निष्पाद्य मुक्तिकार्यं वै कृतकृत्यो निवर्तते //
text_mt: The knowledge to be performed by the knower of the field is the instrument for him; / having thereby accomplished the work of liberation, having done what was to be done, it ceases.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāvabhāvanāpannastato 'sau paramātmanaḥ /
bhavatyabhedī bhedaśca tasyājñānakṛto bhavet //
meaning:
तद्भावभावनापन्नस्ततो ऽसौ परमात्मनः /
भवत्यभेदी भेदश्च तस्याज्ञानकृतो भवेत् //
text_mt: Attaining the state of being identical with Him, he then / becomes non-different from the Supreme Self; and difference is created by ignorance.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhedajanake jñāne nāśa mātyantikaṃ gate /
ātmano brahmaṇābhedaṃ saṃmataṃ kaḥ kariṣyati //
meaning:
विभेदजनके ज्ञाने नाश मात्यन्तिकं गते /
आत्मनो ब्रह्मणाभेदं संमतं कः करिष्यति //
text_mt: When the knowledge that causes differentiation has met with absolute destruction, / who will make a differentiation between the Self and Brahman that is acknowledged [as real]?

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaste mayā yogaḥ khāṇḍikya paripṛcchataḥ /
saṃkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tu kimanyatkriyatāṃ tava //
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्ते मया योगः खाण्डिक्य परिपृच्छतः /
संक्षेपविस्तराभ्यां तु किमन्यत्क्रियतां तव //
text_mt: "Thus has yoga been explained to you by me, O Khāṇḍikya, as you asked, / in brief and in detail. What else, then, may be done for you?"

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikya uvāca
kathito yogasadbhāvaḥ sarvameva kṛtaṃ mama /
tavopadeśātsakalo naṣṭaścittamalo mama //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्य उवाच
कथितो योगसद्भावः सर्वमेव कृतं मम /
तवोपदेशात्सकलो नष्टश्चित्तमलो मम //
text_mt: Khāṇḍikya said: / "The true nature of yoga has been declared, everything has indeed been accomplished for me; / through your teaching, all the impurity of my mind has been destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
mameti yanmayā proktamasadetanna cānyathā /
naredraṃ gadituṃ śakyamapi vijñeyavedabhiḥ //
meaning:
ममेति यन्मया प्रोक्तमसदेतन्न चान्यथा /
नरेद्रं गदितुं शक्यमपि विज्ञेयवेदभिः //
text_mt: What was spoken of by me as 'mine' is unreal, not otherwise; / it cannot be expressed to a king even by those who know what is to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ mametyavidyeyaṃ vyavahārastathānayoḥ /
paramārthastva saṃlāpyo vacasāṃ gocaro na yaḥ //
meaning:
अहं ममेत्यविद्येयं व्यवहारस्तथानयोः /
परमार्थस्त्व संलाप्यो वचसां गोचरो न यः //
text_mt: 'I' and 'mine'—this is ignorance, and worldly conduct consists of these two. / The supreme truth, however, is beyond conversation, not within the range of words.

sanskrit_iast:
tadguccha śreyase sarvaṃ mamaitadbhavatā kṛtam /
yadvimuktiparo yogaḥ proktaḥ keśidvajāvyayaḥ //
meaning:
तद्गुच्छ श्रेयसे सर्वं ममैतद्भवता कृतम् /
यद्विमुक्तिपरो योगः प्रोक्तः केशिद्वजाव्ययः //
text_mt: Therefore go unto welfare; all this has been done by you for me, / since imperishable yoga oriented toward liberation has been spoken, O Keśidhvaja."

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
yathārhapūjayā tena khāṇḍikyena sa pūjitaḥ /
ājagāma puraṃ brahmaṃstataḥ keśidhvajo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
यथार्हपूजया तेन खाण्डिक्येन स पूजितः /
आजगाम पुरं ब्रह्मंस्ततः केशिध्वजो नृपः //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / Honored by that Khāṇḍikya with worship befitting him, / King Keśidhvaja then returned to his city, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
khāṇḍikyo 'pi sutaṃ kṛtvā rājānaṃ yogasiddhaye /
viśālāmagamatkṛṣṇe samāveśitamānasaḥ //
meaning:
खाण्डिक्यो ऽपि सुतं कृत्वा राजानं योगसिद्धये /
विशालामगमत्कृष्णे समावेशितमानसः //
text_mt: Khāṇḍikya too, having made his son king for the attainment of yoga, / went to Viśālā, his mind firmly fixed on Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatraikāntiko bhūtvā yamādiguṇasaṃyutaḥ /
viṣṇvākhye nirmale brahmaṇyavāpa nṛpatirlayam //
meaning:
स तत्रैकान्तिको भूत्वा यमादिगुणसंयुतः /
विष्ण्वाख्ये निर्मले ब्रह्मण्यवाप नृपतिर्लयम् //
text_mt: Becoming single-minded there, endowed with virtues such as yama, / the king attained absorption into the pure Brahman called Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
keśidhvajo 'pi muktayarthaṃ svakarmakṣapaṇonmukhaḥ /
bubhuje viṣayānkarma cakre cānabhisaṃdhitam //
meaning:
केशिध्वजो ऽपि मुक्तयर्थं स्वकर्मक्षपणोन्मुखः /
बुभुजे विषयान्कर्म चक्रे चानभिसंधितम् //
text_mt: Keśidhvaja too, eager to exhaust his karma for the sake of liberation, / enjoyed sense-objects and performed action without selfish motive.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kalyāṇopabhogaiśca kṣīṇapāpo 'malastataḥ /
avāpa siddhimatyantatritāpakṣapaṇīṃ mune //
meaning:
स कल्याणोपभोगैश्च क्षीणपापो ऽमलस्ततः /
अवाप सिद्धिमत्यन्तत्रितापक्षपणीं मुने //
text_mt: And with sins diminished through auspicious experiences, pure thereafter, / he attained the perfection that utterly destroys the threefold suffering, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛṣṭavān /
tāpatrayacikitsārthaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te //
iti śrūbṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge dvitīyapāde saptacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृष्टवान् /
