evaṃ gurugatāṃ vidyāṃ śūśrūṣuradhigacchati //
meaning:
यथा खननन्खनित्रेण भूपलं वारि विन्दति /
एवं गुरुगतां विद्यां शूश्रूषुरधिगच्छति //
text_mt:
Just as a man digging the earth with a shovel finds water,
even so the attentive disciple attains the knowledge residing in the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā /
athavā vidyayā vidyā hyanyathā nopapadyate //
meaning:
गुरुशुश्रूषया विद्या पुष्कलेन धनेन वा /
अथवा विद्यया विद्या ह्यन्यथा नोपपद्यते //
text_mt:
Knowledge is acquired through service to the guru, or by abundant wealth,
or knowledge by [exchange of] knowledge; in no other way can it be obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣārahitā vidyā yadyapi medhāguṇaiḥ samupayāti /
vandhyeva yauvanavatī na tasya sāphalyavati bhavati //
meaning:
शुश्रूषारहिता विद्या यद्यपि मेधागुणैः समुपयाति /
वन्ध्येव यौवनवती न तस्य साफल्यवति भवति //
text_mt:
Even if knowledge comes through qualities of intellect without service [to the guru],
it bears no fruit for him, like a barren woman in the bloom of youth.

sanskrit_iast:
iti diṅmātramuddiṣṭaṃ śikṣāgranthaṃ mayā tava /
jñātvā vedāṅgamādyaṃ tu brahmabhūyāya kalpate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde pañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति दिङ्मात्रमुद्दिष्टं शिक्षाग्रन्थं मया तव /
ज्ञात्वा वेदाङ्गमाद्यं तु ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast:
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kalpagranthaṃ munīśvarara /
yasya vijñānamātreṇa syātkarmakuśalo naraḥ //
meaning:
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि कल्पग्रन्थं मुनीश्वरर /
यस्य विज्ञानमात्रेण स्यात्कर्मकुशलो नरः //
text_mt:
Now, therefore, O lord of sages, I shall fully explain the treatise on Kalpa,
by the mere understanding of which a man becomes skilled in ritual actions.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrakalpo vedānāṃ saṃhitānāṃ tathaiva ca /
caturthaḥ syādāṅgirasaḥ śāntikalpaśca pañcamaḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रकल्पो वेदानां संहितानां तथैव च /
चतुर्थः स्यादाङ्गिरसः शान्तिकल्पश्च पञ्चमः //
text_mt:
There is the Nakṣatrakalpa, likewise those of the Vedas and the Saṃhitās;
the fourth is the Āṅgirasa [kalpa], and the Śāntikalpa is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrādhīśvarākhyānaṃ vistareṇa yathātatham /
nakṣatrakalpe nirdiṣṭaṃ jñātavyaṃ tadihāpi ca //
meaning:
नक्षत्राधीश्वराख्यानं विस्तरेण यथातथम् /
नक्षत्रकल्पे निर्दिष्टं ज्ञातव्यं तदिहापि च //
text_mt:
The account of the presiding deities of the asterisms is indicated in detail as it truly is
in the Nakṣatrakalpa; that is to be known here as well.

sanskrit_iast:
vedakalpe vidhānaṃ tu ṛgādī nāṃ munīśvara /
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhyai proktaṃ savistaram //
meaning:
वेदकल्पे विधानं तु ऋगादी नां मुनीश्वर /
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां सिद्ध्यै प्रोक्तं सविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
In the Vedakalpa, however, O lord of sages, the ritual rule for the Ṛgveda and others
has been stated at length for the attainment of virtue, wealth, desire, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāṇāmṛṣayaścaiva chadāṃsyatha ca devatāḥ /
nirdiṣṭāḥ saṃhitākalpe munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्राणामृषयश्चैव छदांस्यथ च देवताः /
निर्दिष्टाः संहिताकल्पे मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः //
text_mt: The seers of mantras, as well as the metres and deities, / were designated in the Saṃhitākalpa by the seers who perceive reality.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivāṅgirase kalpe ṣaṭkarmāṇi savistaram /
abhicāravidhānena nirdiṣṭāni svayaṃbhuvā //
meaning:
तथैवाङ्गिरसे कल्पे षट्कर्माणि सविस्तरम् /
अभिचारविधानेन निर्दिष्टानि स्वयंभुवा //
text_mt: Likewise, the six ritual acts were taught in detail by the Self-born [Brahmā] / in the Āṅgirasakalpa according to the procedure of sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntikalpe tu divyānāṃ bhaumānāṃ munisattama /
tathāntarikṣotpātānāṃ śāntayo hyuditāḥ pṛthak //
meaning:
शान्तिकल्पे तु दिव्यानां भौमानां मुनिसत्तम /
तथान्तरिक्षोत्पातानां शान्तयो ह्युदिताः पृथक् //
text_mt: In the Śāntikalpa, O best of sages, propitiatory rites / for celestial, terrestrial, and atmospheric portents are individually declared.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣepeṇaitaduddiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kalpalakṣaṇe /
viśeṣaḥ pṛthageteṣāṃ sthitaḥ śaṅkhāntareṣu ca //
meaning:
संक्षेपेणैतदुद्दिष्टं लक्षणं कल्पलक्षणे /
विशेषः पृथगेतेषां स्थितः शङ्खान्तरेषु च //
text_mt: This has been stated in brief as the defining characteristic of the Kalpa; / the distinct specifics among these are found in the branches of the Śaṅkha [tradition].

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhyakalpe tu sarveṣāmupayogitayādhunā /
vakṣyāmi te dvijaśreṣṭha sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu //
meaning:
गृह्यकल्पे तु सर्वेषामुपयोगितयाधुना /
वक्ष्यामि ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ सावधानतया शृणु //
text_mt: Now, because it is useful to all, I shall declare to you / the Gṛhyakalpa, O best among the twice-born; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāraścātha śabdaśca dvāvetau brahmaṇaḥ purā /
kaṇṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryātau tasmānmāṅgalyakāvimau //
meaning:
ओङ्कारश्चाथ शब्दश्च द्वावेतौ ब्रह्मणः पुरा /
कण्ठं भित्त्वा विनिर्यातौ तस्मान्माङ्गल्यकाविमौ //
text_mt: Anciently, the sound 'Om' and the word 'atha'—these two— / burst through Brahmā's throat and came forth; therefore, these two are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā proktāni karmāṇi tadvarddhvāni karoti yaḥ /
so 'tha śabdaṃ praṃyujīta tadānantyārthamiṣyate //
meaning:
कृत्वा प्रोक्तानि कर्माणि तद्वर्द्ध्वानि करोति यः /
सो ऽथ शब्दं प्रंयुजीत तदानन्त्यार्थमिष्यते //
text_mt: He who performs the prescribed rites, having done so, / should employ the word 'atha' for what follows them; it is desired for the sake of completeness.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāḥ parisamūhāya vyastaśākhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
nyūnādhikā niṣphalāya karmaṇo 'bhimatasya ca //
meaning:
कुशाः परिसमूहाय व्यस्तशाखाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
न्यूनाधिका निष्फलाय कर्मणो ऽभिमतस्य च //
text_mt: Kuśa grasses with spreading blades are declared for sweeping together; / too few or too many lead to fruitlessness of the intended rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmikīṭapataṅgādyā bhramanti vasudhātale /
teṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya proktaṃ parisamūhanam //
meaning:
कृमिकीटपतङ्गाद्या भ्रमन्ति वसुधातले /
तेषां संरक्षणार्थाय प्रोक्तं परिसमूहनम् //
text_mt: Worms, insects, moths, and the like wander upon the surface of the earth; / for their protection, the ritual sweeping together is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāḥ proktāśca yāstisraḥ kartavyāstāḥ samā dvija /
nyūnādhikā na karttavyā ityeva paribhāṣitam //
meaning:
रेखाः प्रोक्ताश्च यास्तिस्रः कर्तव्यास्ताः समा द्विज /
न्यूनाधिका न कर्त्तव्या इत्येव परिभाषितम् //
text_mt: The three lines that are prescribed must be drawn equal, O twice-born; / they must not be drawn unequal or uneven: such is the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
medinī medasā vyāptā madhukaiṭabhadaityayoḥ /
gomayenopalepyeyaṃ tadarthamiti nārada //
meaning:
मेदिनी मेदसा व्याप्ता मधुकैटभदैत्ययोः /
गोमयेनोपलेप्येयं तदर्थमिति नारद //
text_mt: The earth was smeared with the fat of the two demons Madhu and Kaiṭabha; / for that reason, O Nārada, it must be smeared with cow dung.

sanskrit_iast:
vandhyā duṣṭā ca dīnāṅgī mṛtavatsā ca yā bhavet /
yajñārthaṃ gomayaṃ tasyā nāharediti bhāṣitam //
meaning:
वन्ध्या दुष्टा च दीनाङ्गी मृतवत्सा च या भवेत् /
यज्ञार्थं गोमयं तस्या नाहरेदिति भाषितम् //
text_mt: If a cow is barren, vicious, sickly-limbed, or has lost its calf, / one should not take cow dung from her for a sacrifice; thus it is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhramanti sadā'kāśe pataṅgādyā bhayaṅkarāḥ /
taṣāṃ praharaṇārthāya mataṃ proddharaṇaṃ dvija //
meaning:
ये भ्रमन्ति सदाऽकाशे पतङ्गाद्या भयङ्कराः /
तषां प्रहरणार्थाय मतं प्रोद्धरणं द्विज //
text_mt: For repelling the dreadful winged creatures and others / that constantly wander in the sky, taking up [the dust] is approved, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sruveṇa ca kuśenāpi kuryādullekhanaṃ bhuvaḥ /
asthikaṇṭakasiddhyarthaṃ brahmaṇā paribhāṣitam //
meaning:
स्रुवेण च कुशेनापि कुर्यादुल्लेखनं भुवः /
अस्थिकण्टकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मणा परिभाषितम् //
text_mt: One should furrow the ground with the sruva-spoon and with kuśa grass; / it was prescribed by Brahmā for the removal of bones and thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo devagaṇāḥ sarve tathā pitṛgaṇā dvija /
tenādbhirukṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ munibhirvidhi kovidaiḥ //
meaning:
आपो देवगणाः सर्वे तथा पितृगणा द्विज /
तेनाद्भिरुक्षणं प्रोक्तं मुनिभिर्विधि कोविदैः //
text_mt: Waters are all the hosts of gods and likewise the hosts of ancestors, O twice-born; / therefore, sprinkling with water is prescribed by sages skilled in rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
agneṃrānayanaṃ proktaṃ saubhāgyasrībhireva ca /
śubhade mṛṇmaye pātre prokṣyādbhistaṃ nidhāyapayet //
meaning:
अग्नेंरानयनं प्रोक्तं सौभाग्यस्रीभिरेव च /
शुभदे मृण्मये पात्रे प्रोक्ष्याद्भिस्तं निधायपयेत् //
text_mt: Bringing the fire by auspicious married women is prescribed; / having sprinkled it with water, one should place it in an auspicious earthen vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtasya kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmādyaiḥ sarvadaivataiḥ /
vedyāṃ nidhāpitastasmātsamidgarbho hutāśanaḥ //
meaning:
अमृतस्य क्षयं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्माद्यैः सर्वदैवतैः /
वेद्यां निधापितस्तस्मात्समिद्गर्भो हुताशनः //
text_mt: Seeing the diminishment of nectar, the fire containing firewood within / was placed upon the altar by all the gods headed by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇasyāṃ dānavādyāḥ sthitā yajñasya nārada /
tebhyaḥ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya brahmāṇaṃ taddiśi nyaset //
meaning:
दक्षिणस्यां दानवाद्याः स्थिता यज्ञस्य नारद /
तेभ्यः संरक्षणार्थाय ब्रह्माणं तद्दिशि न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Demons and others stand in the south of the sacrifice, O Nārada; / for protection against them, one should place the Brahmā priest in that direction.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare sarvapātrāṇi praṇītādyāni paścime /
yajamānaḥ pūrvataḥ syurdvijāḥ sarve 'pi nārada //
meaning:
उत्तरे सर्वपात्राणि प्रणीताद्यानि पश्चिमे /
यजमानः पूर्वतः स्युर्द्विजाः सर्वे ऽपि नारद //
text_mt: All the vessels should be placed in the north, the Praṇītā and others in the west; / the patron of the sacrifice should be in the east, as should all the twice-born priests, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūte ca vyavahāre ca yajñakarmaṇi cedbhavet /
kartodāsīna cittastatkarma naśyediti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
द्यूते च व्यवहारे च यज्ञकर्मणि चेद्भवेत् /
कर्तोदासीन चित्तस्तत्कर्म नश्येदिति स्थितिः //
text_mt: In gambling, in legal disputes, and in the sacrificial rite, / if the agent has an indifferent mind, that rite is ruined: such is the established rule.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmācāryauṃ svaśākhau hi karttavyau yajñakarmaṇi /
ṛtvijāṃ niyamo nāsti yathālābhaṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
ब्रह्माचार्यौं स्वशाखौ हि कर्त्तव्यौ यज्ञकर्मणि /
ऋत्विजां नियमो नास्ति यथालाभं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: In a sacrificial rite, the Brahmā and the Ācārya must belong to one's own Vedic branch; / there is no restriction regarding the [other] officiating priests: one may honor them as available.

sanskrit_iast:
dve paritre tryaṅgule staḥ prokṣiṇī caturaṅgulā /
ājyasthālī tryaṅgulātha carusthālī ṣaḍaṅgulā //
meaning:
द्वे परित्रे त्र्यङ्गुले स्तः प्रोक्षिणी चतुरङ्गुला /
आज्यस्थाली त्र्यङ्गुलाथ चरुस्थाली षडङ्गुला //
text_mt: The two purifying strainers are three fingers long; the Prokṣiṇī vessel is four fingers; / the ghee pot is three fingers, and the pot for the caru-offering is six fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgulaṃ tūpayamanamekaṃ saṃmārjanāṅgulam /
sruvaṃ ṣaḍaṅgula proktaṃ srucaṃ sārddhatrayāṅgulam //
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुलं तूपयमनमेकं संमार्जनाङ्गुलम् /
स्रुवं षडङ्गुल प्रोक्तं स्रुचं सार्द्धत्रयाङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: The Upayamana kuśa is two fingers, the sweeping bundle is one finger; / the sruva-spoon is declared to be six fingers, and the sruc-ladle three and a half fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
prādaśamātrā samidhaḥ pūrṇapātraṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam /
prokṣiṇyā uttare bhāge praṇītāpātramaṣṭabhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रादशमात्रा समिधः पूर्णपात्रं षडङ्गुलम् /
प्रोक्षिण्या उत्तरे भागे प्रणीतापात्रमष्टभिः //
text_mt: The fuel sticks measure a span; the full vessel is six fingers; / to the north of the Prokṣiṇī is the Praṇītā vessel, measuring eight [fingers].

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kāni ca tīrthāni samudrāḥ saritastathā /
praṇītāyāṃ samāsannāstasmāttāṃ pūrayejjalaiḥ //
meaning:
यानि कानि च तीर्थानि समुद्राः सरितस्तथा /
प्रणीतायां समासन्नास्तस्मात्तां पूरयेज्जलैः //
text_mt: Whatever sacred fords there are, as well as oceans and rivers, / are present in the Praṇītā; therefore, one should fill it with water.

sanskrit_iast:
vedikā vasrahīnā ca nagrā saṃprocyate dvija /
paristīryya tato darbheḥ paridadhyādimāṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
वेदिका वस्रहीना च नग्रा संप्रोच्यते द्विज /
परिस्तीर्य्य ततो दर्भेः परिदध्यादिमां बुधः //
text_mt: An altar devoid of clothing is called naked, O twice-born; / having strewn it with darbha grass, the wise one should clothe it.

sanskrit_iast:
indravajraṃ viṣṇucakraṃ vāmadevatriśūlakam /
darbharūpatayā trīṇi pavitracchedanāni ca //
meaning:
इन्द्रवज्रं विष्णुचक्रं वामदेवत्रिशूलकम् /
दर्भरूपतया त्रीणि पवित्रच्छेदनानि च //
text_mt: The thunderbolt of Indra, the discus of Viṣṇu, and the trident of Vāmadeva / are the three cutting implements for the purifying strainers in the form of darbha.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇī ca prakartavyā praṇītodakasaṃyutā /
tenātipuṇyadaṃ karma pavitramiti kīrtitam //
meaning:
प्रोक्षणी च प्रकर्तव्या प्रणीतोदकसंयुता /
तेनातिपुण्यदं कर्म पवित्रमिति कीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The Prokṣaṇī vessel must be prepared, filled with the Praṇītā water; / through that, the rite is celebrated as granting great merit and purification.

sanskrit_iast:
ājyasthālī prakartavyā palamātrapramāṇikā /
kulālacakraghaṭitaṃ āsuraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
आज्यस्थाली प्रकर्तव्या पलमात्रप्रमाणिका /
कुलालचक्रघटितं आसुरं मृण्मयं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The ghee pot should be made with a capacity of one pala; / an earthen vessel made on a potter's wheel is considered demoniac.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva hastaghaṭitaṃ sthālyādi daivikaṃ bhavet /
sruve ca sarvakarmāṇi śubhānyapyaśubhāni ca //
meaning:
तदेव हस्तघटितं स्थाल्यादि दैविकं भवेत् /
स्रुवे च सर्वकर्माणि शुभान्यप्यशुभानि च //
text_mt: That very pot or vessel made by hand is divine; / in the sruva-spoon are all rites, both auspicious and inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya caiva pavitrārthaṃ vahnau tāpanamīritam /
agre dhūtena vaidhavyaṃ madhyaṃ caiva prajākṣayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य चैव पवित्रार्थं वह्नौ तापनमीरितम् /
अग्रे धूतेन वैधव्यं मध्यं चैव प्रजाक्षयः //
text_mt: Heating it in the fire is declared for the sake of its purification; / if it is held by the tip, widowhood results; if by the middle, loss of offspring;

sanskrit_iast:
mūle ca mriyate hotā tasmāddhāryaṃ vicārya tat /
agniḥ sūryaśca somaśca viriñciranilo yamaḥ //
meaning:
मूले च म्रियते होता तस्माद्धार्यं विचार्य तत् /
अग्निः सूर्यश्च सोमश्च विरिञ्चिरनिलो यमः //
text_mt: and if held by the base, the Hotṛ priest dies; therefore, having considered this, it must be held [properly]. / Agni, Sūrya, Soma, Viriñci, Anila, and Yama—

sanskrit_iast:
sruve ṣaḍete devāstu pratyaṅgulamupāśritāḥ /
agnirbhaghogārthanāśāya sūryo vyādhikaro bhavet //
meaning:
स्रुवे षडेते देवास्तु प्रत्यङ्गुलमुपाश्रिताः /
अग्निर्भघोगार्थनाशाय सूर्यो व्याधिकरो भवेत् //
text_mt: these six gods reside in the sruva-spoon, each occupying a finger's breadth. / Agni brings about the destruction of wealth and enjoyment; Sūrya causes disease;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣphalastu smṛtaḥ somo viriñciḥ sarvakāmadaḥ /
anilo vṛddhidaḥ prokto yamo mṛtyuprado mataḥ //
meaning:
निष्फलस्तु स्मृतः सोमो विरिञ्चिः सर्वकामदः /
अनिलो वृद्धिदः प्रोक्तो यमो मृत्युप्रदो मतः //
text_mt: Soma is traditionally regarded as fruitless; Viriñci grants all desires; / Anila is said to bestow prosperity; and Yama is considered to bring death.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmārjanopayamanaṃ karttavyaṃ ca kuśadvayam /
pūrvaṃ tu sarvaśākhaṃ syātpañcaśākhaṃ tathāparam //
meaning:
संमार्जनोपयमनं कर्त्तव्यं च कुशद्वयम् /
पूर्वं तु सर्वशाखं स्यात्पञ्चशाखं तथापरम् //
text_mt: The sweeping bundle and the Upayamana must be made of two kuśa blades; / the former should have all branches intact, and the latter five branches.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīparṇī ca śamī tadvatkhadiraśca vikaṅkataḥ /
palāśaścaiva vijñeyāḥ sruve caiva tathā sruci //
meaning:
श्रीपर्णी च शमी तद्वत्खदिरश्च विकङ्कतः /
पलाशश्चैव विज्ञेयाः स्रुवे चैव तथा स्रुचि //
text_mt: Śrīparṇī, śamī, as well as khadira, vikaṅkata, / and palāśa are known to be used for the sruva and for the sruc.

sanskrit_iast:
hastonmitaṃ sruvaṃ śastaṃ trindaśāṅgulikaṃ srucam /
viprāṇāṃ caitadākhyātaṃ hyanyeṣāmaṅgulonakam //
meaning:
हस्तोन्मितं स्रुवं शस्तं त्रिन्दशाङ्गुलिकं स्रुचम् /
विप्राणां चैतदाख्यातं ह्यन्येषामङ्गुलोनकम् //
text_mt: A sruva measuring a cubit is praised, and a sruc of thirty fingers' length; / this is declared for Brahmins, while for others it is one finger less.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ patitānāṃ ca kharādīnāṃ ca nārada /
dṛṣṭidoṣavināśārthaṃ pātrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
शूद्राणां पतितानां च खरादीनां च नारद /
दृष्टिदोषविनाशार्थं पात्राणां प्रोक्षणं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: For the destruction of the defect caused by the gaze / of Śūdras, outcastes, donkeys, and the like, the sprinkling of vessels is prescribed, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛte pūrṇapātre tu yajñacchidraṃ samudbhavet /
tasminpūrṇīkṛte vipra yajñasaṃpūrṇatā bhavet //
meaning:
अकृते पूर्णपात्रे तु यज्ञच्छिद्रं समुद्भवेत् /
तस्मिन्पूर्णीकृते विप्र यज्ञसंपूर्णता भवेत् //
text_mt: If the full vessel is not prepared, a flaw in the sacrifice will arise; / when it is filled, O Brahmin, completeness of the sacrifice is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamuṣṭirbhavetkiñcitpuṣkalaṃ taccatuṣṭayam /
puṣkalāni tu catvāri pūrṇapātraṃ vidurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमुष्टिर्भवेत्किञ्चित्पुष्कलं तच्चतुष्टयम् /
पुष्कलानि तु चत्वारि पूर्णपात्रं विदुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: Eight handfuls make a kiñcit; four of those make a puṣkala; / and four puṣkalas make a full vessel, so the wise know.

sanskrit_iast:
homakāle tu saṃprāpte na dadyādāsanaṃ kvacit /
datte tṛptobhavedvahniḥ śāpaṃ dadyāñca dāruṇam //
meaning:
होमकाले तु संप्राप्ते न दद्यादासनं क्वचित् /
दत्ते तृप्तोभवेद्वह्निः शापं दद्याञ्च दारुणम् //
text_mt: When the time for fire oblation has arrived, one should never offer a seat; / if it is offered, the fire becomes gratified [too early] and would pronounce a terrible curse.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārau nāsike proktau ājyabhāgau ca cakṣuṣī /
prājāpatyaṃ mukhaṃ prokta kaṭirvyāhṛtibhiḥ smṛtā //
meaning:
आधारौ नासिके प्रोक्तौ आज्यभागौ च चक्षुषी /
प्राजापत्यं मुखं प्रोक्त कटिर्व्याहृतिभिः स्मृता //
text_mt: The two base-oblations are declared to be the nostrils; the two portions of ghee are the eyes; / the offering to Prajāpati is the mouth, and the hips are known to be the vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṣahastau ca pādau ca pañcavāruṇamīritam /
tathā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ vipra śrotre pūrṇāhutistathā //
meaning:
शीर्षहस्तौ च पादौ च पञ्चवारुणमीरितम् /
तथा स्विष्टकृतं विप्र श्रोत्रे पूर्णाहुतिस्तथा //
text_mt: The head, the two hands, and the two feet are declared to be the five Vāruṇa offerings; / likewise, the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the full final oblation are the two ears, O Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
dvimukhaṃ caikahṛdayaṃ catuḥ śrotraṃ dvināsikam /
dviśīrṣakaṃ ca ṣaṇnetraṃ piṅgalaṃ saptajihvakam //
meaning:
द्विमुखं चैकहृदयं चतुः श्रोत्रं द्विनासिकम् /
द्विशीर्षकं च षण्नेत्रं पिङ्गलं सप्तजिह्वकम् //
text_mt: He has two faces, one heart, four ears, two nostrils, / two heads, six eyes, a tawny complexion, and seven tongues.

sanskrit_iast:
savyabhāge trihistaṃ ca caturhastañca dakṣiṇe /
srukstruvau cākṣamālā ca yā śaktirdakṣiṇe kare //
meaning:
सव्यभागे त्रिहिस्तं च चतुर्हस्तञ्च दक्षिणे /
स्रुक्स्त्रुवौ चाक्षमाला च या शक्तिर्दक्षिणे करे //
text_mt: He has three hands on the left side and four hands on the right; / the sruc-ladle, sruva-spoon, rosary, and spear are in the right hands.

sanskrit_iast:
trimekhalaṃ tripādaṃ ca ghṛtapātraṃ dvicāmaram /
meṣārūḍhaṃ catuḥśṛṅgaṃ bālādityasamaprabham //
meaning:
त्रिमेखलं त्रिपादं च घृतपात्रं द्विचामरम् /
मेषारूढं चतुःशृङ्गं बालादित्यसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: He has three girdles, three feet, a ghee pot, two fly-whisks, / is mounted on a ram, possesses four horns, and has the radiance of the morning sun.

sanskrit_iast:
upavītasamāyuktaṃ jaṭākuṇḍalamaṇḍimam /
jñātvaivamagnidehaṃ tu homakarmasamācaret //
meaning:
उपवीतसमायुक्तं जटाकुण्डलमण्डिमम् /
ज्ञात्वैवमग्निदेहं तु होमकर्मसमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Endowed with a sacred thread, adorned with matted locks and ear-rings— / knowing the body of Agni in this manner, one should perform the rite of fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva snehapakvaṃ tathaiva ca /
juhuyādyastu hastena sa vipro brahmahā bhavet //
meaning:
पयो दधि घृतं चैव स्नेहपक्वं तथैव च /
जुहुयाद्यस्तु हस्तेन स विप्रो ब्रह्महा भवेत् //
text_mt:
Milk, curd, clarified butter, and whatever is cooked in oil—
he who offers these with his bare hand, that brāhmaṇa becomes a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yadannaṃ puruṣo 'śrāti tadannaṃ tasya devatāḥ /
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ tilādhikyaṃ havirmatam //
meaning:
यदन्नं पुरुषो ऽश्राति तदन्नं तस्य देवताः /
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं तिलाधिक्यं हविर्मतम् //
text_mt:
Whatever food a man eats, that same food is of his deities.
For the abundance of all desires, an excess of sesamum is considered the sacrificial oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
home mudrātrayaṃ proktaṃ mṛgī haṃsī ca sūkarī /
abhicāre sūkarī syānmṛgī haṃsī śubhātmake //
meaning:
होमे मुद्रात्रयं प्रोक्तं मृगी हंसी च सूकरी /
अभिचारे सूकरी स्यान्मृगी हंसी शुभात्मके //
text_mt:
In the fire oblation, three hand gestures are prescribed: mṛgī, haṃsī, and sūkarī.
In sorcery rituals sūkarī is used; mṛgī and haṃsī are used in auspicious rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgulībhiḥ krauḍī syāddhaṃsī muktakaniṣṭikā /
madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭairmṛgī sudrā prakīrtitā //
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गुलीभिः क्रौडी स्याद्धंसी मुक्तकनिष्टिका /
मध्यमानामिकाङ्गुष्टैर्मृगी सुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt:
Formed with all the fingers, it is krauḍī; haṃsī is with the little finger released;
with the middle finger, the ring finger, and the thumb, the mṛgī gesture is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapramāṇayāhutyā pañcāṅguligṛhītayā /
dadhimadhvājyasaṃyukta ṛtvigbhirjuhuyāttilaiḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वप्रमाणयाहुत्या पञ्चाङ्गुलिगृहीतया /
दधिमध्वाज्यसंयुक्त ऋत्विग्भिर्जुहुयात्तिलैः //
text_mt:
With an oblation of the previously specified measure, seized by the five fingers,
mixed with curd, honey, and clarified butter, one should offer fire oblations with sesamum through the officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast: kuśāstvanāmikāsaktāḥ kāryāḥ syuḥ puṇyakarmaṇi //
meaning: कुशास्त्वनामिकासक्ताः कार्याः स्युः पुण्यकर्मणि //
text_mt: Kuśa blades should be attached to the ring finger in an auspicious rite.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakaḥ karmavighnasiddhyarthaṃ viniyojitaḥ /
gaṇānāmādhipatye ca rudreṇa brahmaṇā tathā //
meaning:
विनायकः कर्मविघ्नसिद्ध्यर्थं विनियोजितः /
गणानामाधिपत्ये च रुद्रेण ब्रह्मणा तथा //
text_mt:
Vināyaka was appointed by Rudra and Brahmā for the accomplishment of obstacles to actions,
and to the supreme lordship over the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tenopasṛṣṭo yastasya lakṣaṇāni nibodha me /
svameva gāhatetyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṇḍāṃśca paśyati //
meaning:
तेनोपसृष्टो यस्तस्य लक्षणानि निबोध मे /
स्वमेव गाहतेत्यर्थं जलं मुण्डांश्च पश्यति //
text_mt:
Hear from me the signs of one who is afflicted by him:
he plunges into water, as it were, and sees shaven-headed men.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmāya vāsasaścaiva kravyādāṃścādhirohati /
antyajairgarddabhairuṣṭaiḥ sahaikatrāvatiṣṭate //
meaning:
कामाय वाससश्चैव क्रव्यादांश्चाधिरोहति /
अन्त्यजैर्गर्द्दभैरुष्टैः सहैकत्रावतिष्टते //
text_mt:
Out of desire he mounts cloths and carnivorous beasts;
he stays in one place together with outcastes, donkeys, and camels.

sanskrit_iast: vrajannapi tathātmānaṃ manyate 'nugataṃ paraiḥ vimanā viphalāraṃbhaḥ saṃsīdatyanimittataḥ //
meaning: व्रजन्नपि तथात्मानं मन्यते ऽनुगतं परैः विमना विफलारंभः संसीदत्यनिमित्ततः //
text_mt:
Even while walking, he imagines himself pursued by others;
dejected in mind, his undertakings fruitlessly failing, he sinks down without cause.

sanskrit_iast:
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanandanaḥ /
kumārī na ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhamaṅganā /
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo 'dhyayanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनन्दनः /
कुमारी न च भर्तारमपत्यं गर्भमङ्गना /
आचार्यत्वं श्रोत्रियश्च न शिष्यो ऽध्ययनं तथा //

sanskrit_iast:
vaṇiglābhaṃ na cānpoti kṛṣiṃ cāpi kṛṣibalaḥ /
snapana tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye 'hri vidhipūrvakam /
gaurasarṣa pakalkena svasti vācyā dvijaiḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
वणिग्लाभं न चान्पोति कृषिं चापि कृषिबलः /
स्नपन तस्य कर्तव्यं पुण्ये ऽह्रि विधिपूर्वकम् /
गौरसर्ष पकल्केन स्वस्ति वाच्या द्विजैः शुभाः //

sanskrit_iast:
aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamāddhradāt /
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gandhān gugguluṃ cāśu nikṣipet //
meaning:
अश्वस्थानाद्गजस्थानाद्वल्मीकात्संगमाद्ध्रदात् /
मृत्तिकां रोचनां गन्धान् गुग्गुलुं चाशु निक्षिपेत् //
text_mt:
From a stable of horses, an elephant stable, an anthill, the confluence of rivers, and a pond,
one should promptly fetch clay, yellow pigment, fragrant substances, and bdellium resin.

sanskrit_iast:
pātryāhṛtā hyekavarṇaiścaturbhiḥ kalaśairhradāt /
carmaṇyānuḍuhe rakte sthāpyaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
पात्र्याहृता ह्येकवर्णैश्चतुर्भिः कलशैर्ह्रदात् /
चर्मण्यानुडुहे रक्ते स्थाप्यं भद्रासनं ततः //
text_mt:
Having brought [water] in a vessel from a lake with four jars of uniform colour,
an auspicious seat should then be placed on a red bull-hide.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāra mṛṣibhiḥ pāvanaṃ kṛtam /
tena tvāmabhiṣiñcāmi pāvamānyāḥ puṃnatu te //
meaning:
सहस्राक्षं शतधार मृषिभिः पावनं कृतम् /
तेन त्वामभिषिञ्चामि पावमान्याः पुंनतु ते //
text_mt:
“The thousand-eyed, hundred-streamed [vessel] made purifying by the sages;
with that I consecrate you; may the purifying verses cleanse you.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ /
bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ //
meaning:
भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः /
भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः //
text_mt:
“May King Varuṇa bestow good fortune upon you; may the Sun and Bṛhaspati bestow good fortune;
may Indra and Vāyu bestow good fortune; may the Seven Sages bestow good fortune upon you.”

sanskrit_iast:
yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmante yacca mūrddhani /
lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastudantu sarvadā //
meaning:
यत्ते केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमन्ते यच्च मूर्द्धनि /
ललाटे कर्णयोरक्ष्णोरापस्तुदन्तु सर्वदा //
text_mt:
“Whatever misfortune is in your hair, in your parting, and on your head,
on your forehead, in your ears, or in your eyes, may the waters always remove it.”

sanskrit_iast:
snānasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇaudumbareṇa tu /
juhuyānmūrddhani kuśānsavyana parigṛhya ca //
meaning:
स्नानस्य सार्षपं तैलं स्रुवेणौदुम्बरेण तु /
जुहुयान्मूर्द्धनि कुशान्सव्यन परिगृह्य च //
text_mt:
One should offer into the fire mustard oil for the bath with an udumbara wood ladle on his head,
holding kuśa grass with his left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
mitaśca saṃmitaścaiva tathā śālakaṭaṅkaṭau /
kūṣmāṇḍo rājaputra ścetyante svāhāsamānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
मितश्च संमितश्चैव तथा शालकटङ्कटौ /
कूष्माण्डो राजपुत्र श्चेत्यन्ते स्वाहासमान्वितैः //
text_mt:
“To Mita, to Saṃmita, and likewise to Śāla and Kaṭaṅkaṭa,
to Kūṣmāṇḍa and to Rājaputra,” followed at the end by “svāhā”;

sanskrit_iast:
nāmabhirbalimantraiśca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ /
dadyāñcatuṣpathe sūryye kuśānāstīryya sarvataḥ //
meaning:
नामभिर्बलिमन्त्रैश्च नमस्कारसमन्वितैः /
दद्याञ्चतुष्पथे सूर्य्ये कुशानास्तीर्य्य सर्वतः //
text_mt:
with these names, accompanied by offering mantras and salutations,
one should give [the offering] at a crossroads in the presence of the sun, having strewn kuśa grass all around.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtā kṛtāṃstaṇḍulīśca palalaudanameva ca /
matsyānpakvāṃstathaivāmānmāṃsametāvadevatu //
meaning:
कृता कृतांस्तण्डुलीश्च पललौदनमेव च /
मत्स्यान्पक्वांस्तथैवामान्मांसमेतावदेवतु //
text_mt:
Pounded and unpounded rice grains, rice cooked with sesamum paste,
cooked fish as well as raw fish, and meat in just this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāñca trividhāmapi /
mūlakaṃ pūrikāpūpāṃstathaivoṭasrajo 'pi ca //
meaning:
पुष्पं चित्रं सुगन्धं च सुराञ्च त्रिविधामपि /
मूलकं पूरिकापूपांस्तथैवोटस्रजो ऽपि च //
text_mt:
variegated and fragrant flowers, the three kinds of liquor,
radishes, cakes fried in oil, boiled cakes, and garlands of linen,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva gujapiṣṭa samodakam /
etānsarvānupāhṛtya bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ //
meaning:
दध्यन्नं पायसं चैव गुजपिष्ट समोदकम् /
एतान्सर्वानुपाहृत्य भूमौ कृत्वा ततः शिरः //
text_mt:
curd rice, milk-rice pudding, and sweetmeats made of raw sugar and flour—
having brought all these forward and bowed one's head to the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya jananī mupatiṣṭettato 'mbikām /
durvāsarṣapapuṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇamañjalim //
meaning:
विनायकस्य जननी मुपतिष्टेत्ततो ऽम्बिकाम् /
दुर्वासर्षपपुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घ्यं पूर्णमञ्जलिम् //
text_mt:
one should then approach Ambikā, the mother of Vināyaka,
having offered a full palmful of dūrvā grass, mustard, and flowers as an arghya water offering:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhagavati dehi me /
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvānkāmāṃśca dehi me //
meaning:
रूपं देहि यशो देहि भगं भगवति देहि मे /
पुत्रान्देहि धनं देहि सर्वान्कामांश्च देहि मे //
text_mt:
“Grant me beauty, grant me renown, grant me good fortune, O divine lady!
Grant me sons, grant me wealth, and grant me all desires!”

sanskrit_iast:
upasthāya śivāṃ durgāmumāpatimathāceryat /
dhūpaidarpiścai naivedyairgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ //
meaning:
उपस्थाय शिवां दुर्गामुमापतिमथाचेर्यत् /
धूपैदर्पिश्चै नैवेद्यैर्गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः //
text_mt:
Having approached the auspicious Durgā, one should then worship the lord of Umā
with incense, lamps, food offerings, perfumes, garlands, and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ /
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvastrayugamaṃ gurorapi //
meaning:
ततः शुक्लाम्बरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः /
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाद्वस्त्रयुगमं गुरोरपि //
text_mt:
Then, wearing white garments, adorned with white garlands and ointments,
one should subsequently feed brāhmaṇas, and also offer a pair of garments to the preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva prapūjayet /
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā puṣṭivṛddhyāyurvīryyavān //
meaning:
एवं विनायकं पूज्य ग्रहांश्चैव प्रपूजयेत् /
श्रीकामः शान्तिकामो वा पुष्टिवृद्ध्यायुर्वीर्य्यवान् //
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped Vināyaka, one desirous of prosperity, or one desirous of peace,
robust with nourishment, growth, longevity, and vigour, should also worship the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
sīryyaḥ somo mahīputro budho jīvo bhṛguḥ śaniḥ /
rāhuketū navāpyete navāpyete sthāpanīyā grahāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
सीर्य्यः सोमो महीपुत्रो बुधो जीवो भृगुः शनिः /
राहुकेतू नवाप्येते नवाप्येते स्थापनीया ग्रहाः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
The Sun, the Moon, the son of the Earth (Mars), Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn,
Rāhu, and Ketu—these nine planets should be installed in order.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrakādrajatādraktacandanātsvarṇakādapi /
hemno rajatādayasaḥ sīsātkāryā śubhāptaye //
meaning:
ताम्रकाद्रजताद्रक्तचन्दनात्स्वर्णकादपि /
हेम्नो रजतादयसः सीसात्कार्या शुभाप्तये //
text_mt:
They should be fashioned from copper, silver, red sandalwood, gold,
silver, iron, and lead, for the attainment of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇairvāpaṭe lekhyā gandhairmaṇḍalakeṣu ca /
yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca //
meaning:
स्ववर्णैर्वापटे लेख्या गन्धैर्मण्डलकेषु च /
यथावर्णं प्रदेयानि वासांसि कुसुमानि च //
text_mt:
Or they may be drawn on cloth or on diagrams with fragrant substances according to their colours;
garments and flowers should be given according to their colours,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhāśca balayaścaiva dhūpo deyaśca gugguluḥ /
kartavyā mantravantaśca caravaḥ pratidaivatam //
meaning:
गन्धाश्च बलयश्चैव धूपो देयश्च गुग्गुलुः /
कर्तव्या मन्त्रवन्तश्च चरवः प्रतिदैवतम् //
text_mt:
as well as fragrances, offerings, incense, and bdellium resin;
and cooked sacrificial rice dishes accompanied by mantras should be prepared for each deity:

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṇena imandevā agnirmūrddhādivaḥ kakut /
udbudhaayasvāti yadaryastathaivānnātparisrutaḥ //
meaning:
आकृष्णेन इमन्देवा अग्निर्मूर्द्धादिवः ककुत् /
उद्बुधअयस्वाति यदर्यस्तथैवान्नात्परिस्रुतः //
text_mt:
“Ā kṛṣṇena...”, “Imaṃ devāḥ...”, “Agnir mūrdhā divaḥ kakut...”,
“Udbudhyasva...”, “Bṛhaspate ati yad aryaḥ...”, likewise “Annāt parisrutaḥ...”,

sanskrit_iast: śannodevīstathā kāṇḍātketuṃ kṛṇvannaketavaḥ //
meaning: शन्नोदेवीस्तथा काण्डात्केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवः //
text_mt: “Śaṃ no devīḥ...”, and likewise “Kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāt...”, and “Ketuṃ kṛṇvan aketave...”.

sanskrit_iast:
arkaḥ palāśaḥ khadirastvapāmārgo 'thapippalaḥ /
uduṃbaraḥ śamī dūrvā kuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
अर्कः पलाशः खदिरस्त्वपामार्गो ऽथपिप्पलः /
उदुंबरः शमी दूर्वा कुशाश्च समिधः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Arka, palāśa, khadira, apāmārga, and pippala,
udumbara, śamī, dūrvā grass, and kuśa grass are the firewood offerings in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasmādaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva ca /
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā punaḥ //
meaning:
एकैकस्मादष्टशतमष्टाविंशतिरेव च /
होतव्या मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां दध्ना क्षीरेण वा पुनः //
text_mt:
For each [planet], one hundred and eight or twenty-eight oblations
should be made with honey and clarified butter, or with curd, or with milk.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ kṣīraṣyaṃ kṣīraṣāṣṭikam /
dadhyodanaṃ haviścūrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ citrānnameva ca //
meaning:
गुडौदनं पायसं च हविष्यं क्षीरष्यं क्षीरषाष्टिकम् /
दध्योदनं हविश्चूर्णं मांसं चित्रान्नमेव च //
text_mt:
Boiled rice with jaggery, milk-rice pudding, sacrificial food, boiled rice from sixty-day grain with milk,
curd-rice, sacrificial barley meal, meat, and variegated rice—

sanskrit_iast:
dadyā dgrahakramādetaddvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ /
śaktito 'pi yathā lābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
दद्या द्ग्रहक्रमादेतद्द्विजेभ्यो भोजनं बुधः /
शक्तितो ऽपि यथा लाभं सत्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt:
the wise man should give these as food to the twice-born in the order of the planets,
according to ability or according to what is available, having honoured them properly.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuḥ śaṅkhastathānaṅvānhimavāso hayaḥ kramāt /
kṛṣṇāgaurāyasaṃ chāga etā vai dakṣiṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
धेनुः शङ्खस्तथानङ्वान्हिमवासो हयः क्रमात् /
कृष्णागौरायसं छाग एता वै दक्षिणाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
A milch cow, a conch, a draft-ox, gold, a horse in order,
a black cow, iron, and a goat—these are remembered as the sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yasya tu yaddravyaṃ palenārcyaḥ sa tena ca /
brahmanneṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyathaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य यस्य तु यद्द्रव्यं पलेनार्च्यः स तेन च /
ब्रह्मन्नेषां वरो दत्तः पूजिताः पूजयिष्यथः //
text_mt:
Whatever is the substance of each planet, with that measure it should be worshipped.
O brāhmaṇa, a boon was granted to them: “When worshipped, you will grant worship.”

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhīnā naredrāṇāṃ dhanajātyucchrayāstathā /
bhāvābhāvau ca jagatastasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहाधीना नरेद्राणां धनजात्युच्छ्रयास्तथा /
भावाभावौ च जगतस्तस्मात्पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः //
text_mt:
Dependent on the planets are the wealth, social rank, and prominence of kings,
as well as the existence and non-existence of the world; therefore, the planets are most worthy of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
adityasya sadā pūjā tilakaṃ svāminastathā /
mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavānpuyāt //
meaning:
अदित्यस्य सदा पूजा तिलकं स्वामिनस्तथा /
महागणपतेश्चैव कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवान्पुयात् //
text_mt:
Constantly performing worship of the Sun, the tilaka mark, the lord [Kārttikeya],
and the great Gaṇapati, one attains success;

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇāṃ saphalatvaṃ ca śriyaṃ vāpnotyanuttamām //
meaning: कर्मणां सफलत्वं च श्रियं वाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: one also attains the fruition of actions and unexcelled prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā mātṛyāgaṃ tu yo grahārcāṃ samārabhet /
kupyanti mātarastasya pratyūhaṃ kurvate tathā //
meaning:
अकृत्वा मातृयागं तु यो ग्रहार्चां समारभेत् /
कुप्यन्ति मातरस्तस्य प्रत्यूहं कुर्वते तथा //
text_mt:
Whoever undertakes the worship of the planets without having performed the sacrifice to the Mothers,
against him the Mothers become angry and create obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
vasoḥ pavitramantreṇa vasorddhārāṃ prakalpya ca /
gauryādyā mātaraḥ pūjyā māṅgalyeṣu śubhārthibhiḥ //
meaning:
वसोः पवित्रमन्त्रेण वसोर्द्धारां प्रकल्प्य च /
गौर्याद्या मातरः पूज्या माङ्गल्येषु शुभार्थिभिः //
text_mt:
Having arranged the stream of ghee with the Vasor-dhārā mantra,
the Mothers, beginning with Gaurī, should be worshipped on auspicious occasions by those seeking welfare:

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī padma śacī medhā sāvitrī vijayā jayā /
devasenā svadhā svāhā mātṛkā vaidhṛtirdhṛtiḥ //
meaning:
गौरी पद्म शची मेधा सावित्री विजया जया /
देवसेना स्वधा स्वाहा मातृका वैधृतिर्धृतिः //
text_mt:
Gaurī, Padmā, Śacī, Medhā, Sāvitrī, Vijayā, Jayā,
Devasenā, Svadhā, Svāhā, Mātṛkā, Vaidhṛti, Dhṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭirhṛṣṭistathā tuṣṭirātmadevatayā saha /
gaṇeśenādhikā hyetā vṛddhau pūjyāstu ṣohaśa //
meaning:
पुष्टिर्हृष्टिस्तथा तुष्टिरात्मदेवतया सह /
गणेशेनाधिका ह्येता वृद्धौ पूज्यास्तु षोहश //
text_mt:
Puṣṭi, Hṛṣṭi, and Tuṣṭi, together with one's own tutelary deity—
these sixteen, augmented by Gaṇeśa, are to be worshipped during rites for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ tathā pādyamardhyaṃ snānaṃ ca candanam /
akṣatāṃścaiva puṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ phalāni ca //
meaning:
आवाहनं तथा पाद्यमर्ध्यं स्नानं च चन्दनम् /
अक्षतांश्चैव पुष्पाणि धूपं दीपं फलानि च //
text_mt:
Invocation, water for feet, guest-water, bath, sandalwood,
unbroken grains, flowers, incense, lamp, and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyācamanīyaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ pūgameva ca /
nīrājanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca kramāddadyāñca tuṣṭaye //
meaning:
नैवेद्याचमनीयं च तांबूलं पूगमेव च /
नीराजनं दक्षिणां च क्रमाद्दद्याञ्च तुष्टये //
text_mt:
food-offering, water for sipping, betel, and areca-nut,
waving of lights, and priestly fee: he should give these in order for satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛkalpaṃ prakṣyāmi dhanasaṃtativarddhanam /
amāvasyāṣṭakā vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣāyanadvayam //
meaning:
पितृकल्पं प्रक्ष्यामि धनसंततिवर्द्धनम् /
अमावस्याष्टका वृद्धिः कृष्णपक्षायनद्वयम् //
text_mt:
I shall proclaim the ancestral ritual that increases wealth and progeny:
the new-moon day, the Aṣṭakā, rites of prosperity, the dark fortnight, the two solstices,

sanskrit_iast:
dravyaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpattirviṣuvatsuryasaṃkramaḥ /
vyatīpāto gajacchāyā grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ //
meaning:
द्रव्यं ब्राह्मणसंपत्तिर्विषुवत्सुर्यसंक्रमः /
व्यतीपातो गजच्छाया ग्रहणं चन्द्रसूर्ययोः //
text_mt:
the availability of materials and Brahmins, the equinox, solar transit,
Vyatīpāta, the 'elephant's shadow' conjunction, an eclipse of the moon or the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ pratiruciścaiva śrāddhakālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
agryāḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu śrotriyo brahmavidyuvā //
meaning:
श्राद्धं प्रतिरुचिश्चैव श्राद्धकालाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
अग्र्याः सर्वेषु वेदेषु श्रोत्रियो ब्रह्मविद्युवा //
text_mt:
a desire for a śrāddha—these are declared the proper times for śrāddha.
Foremost in all the Vedas, a learned Vedic scholar, a youth knowing Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
vedārthavijjyeṣṭasāmā trimadhusrisuparṇakaḥ /
svasrīya ṛtvigjāmātā yājyaśvaśuramātulāḥ //
meaning:
वेदार्थविज्ज्येष्टसामा त्रिमधुस्रिसुपर्णकः /
स्वस्रीय ऋत्विग्जामाता याज्यश्वशुरमातुलाः //
text_mt:
one who knows the meaning of the Vedas, a chanter of the Jyeṣṭhasāman, one who knows the Trimadhu, one who knows the Trisuparṇa,
a sister's son, an officiating priest, a son-in-law, a patron of sacrifice, a father-in-law, a maternal uncle,

sanskrit_iast:
triṇāciketadauhitraśiṣyasaṃbandhibāndhavāḥ /
karmaniṣṭāstaponiṣṭāḥ pañcāgnibrahmacāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिणाचिकेतदौहित्रशिष्यसंबन्धिबान्धवाः /
कर्मनिष्टास्तपोनिष्टाः पञ्चाग्निब्रह्मचारिणः //
text_mt:
one who maintains the Triṇāciketa fire, a daughter's son, a disciple, affines, relatives,
those devoted to rites, those devoted to austerities, keepers of the five fires, celibate students,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛparāścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ śrāddhasaṃpadaḥ /
rogī nyūnātiriktāṅgaḥ kāṇaḥ paunarbhavastathā //
meaning:
पितृमातृपराश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः श्राद्धसंपदः /
रोगी न्यूनातिरिक्ताङ्गः काणः पौनर्भवस्तथा //
text_mt:
and those devoted to their mother and father: such Brahmins are the wealth of a śrāddha.
A diseased man, one with deficient or surplus limbs, a one-eyed man, a son of a remarried woman,

sanskrit_iast:
avakīrṇī kuṇḍagolau kunakhī śyāvadaṅkaḥ /
bhṛtakādhyāpakaḥ klībaḥ kanyādūṣyabhiśastakaḥ //
meaning:
अवकीर्णी कुण्डगोलौ कुनखी श्यावदङ्कः /
भृतकाध्यापकः क्लीबः कन्यादूष्यभिशस्तकः //
text_mt:
one who has broken his vow of chastity, a Kuṇḍa, a Gola, one with bad nails, one with black teeth,
one who teaches for hire, an impotent man, a seducer of maidens, one who is accused,

sanskrit_iast:
mitradhruk piśunaḥ somavikrayī parivindakaḥ /
mātṛpitṛgurutyāgī kuṇḍāśī vṛṣalātmajaḥ //
meaning:
मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनः सोमविक्रयी परिविन्दकः /
मातृपितृगुरुत्यागी कुण्डाशी वृषलात्मजः //
text_mt:
a betrayer of friends, a slanderous informer, a seller of soma, one married before his elder brother,
one who abandons his mother, father, or guru, an eater of food given by a Kuṇḍa, the son of a Śūdra woman,

sanskrit_iast:
parapūrvāpatiḥ stenaḥ karmabhraṣṭāśca ninditāḥ /
nimantrayīta pūrvedyurbrāhmaṇānātmavān śuciḥ //
meaning:
परपूर्वापतिः स्तेनः कर्मभ्रष्टाश्च निन्दिताः /
निमन्त्रयीत पूर्वेद्युर्ब्राह्मणानात्मवान् शुचिः //
text_mt:
a husband of a woman previously married to another, a thief, and those fallen from their duties are blamed.
Controlled and pure, he should invite the Brahmins on the previous day.

sanskrit_iast:
taiścāpi saṃyatair bhāvyaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ /
aparāhne samaghabhyarcya svāgatenāgatāṃstu tān //
meaning:
तैश्चापि संयतैर् भाव्यं मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः /
अपराह्ने समघभ्यर्च्य स्वागतेनागतांस्तु तान् //
text_mt:
They too must remain restrained in mind, speech, body, and action.
Having fully honored those who have arrived in the afternoon with words of welcome,

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrapāṇirācāntānāsane copaveśayet /
viprāndaive yathāśakti pitrye 'yugmāṃstathaiva ca //
meaning:
पवित्रपाणिराचान्तानासने चोपवेशयेत् /
विप्रान्दैवे यथाशक्ति पित्र्ये ऽयुग्मांस्तथैव च //
text_mt:
holding a purifying ring of kuśa grass, after they have sipped water, he should seat them on cushions:
Brahmins for the divine side according to his capacity, and an odd number for the ancestral rite,

sanskrit_iast:
paraśrite śucau deśe dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ tathā /
dvau dvaive prāk trayaḥ pitraghye udagekaikameva ca //
meaning:
परश्रिते शुचौ देशे दक्षिणाप्रवणं तथा /
द्वौ द्वैवे प्राक् त्रयः पित्रघ्ये उदगेकैकमेव च //
text_mt:
in an isolated, pure place sloping toward the south:
two facing east for the divine, three facing north for the ancestral rite, or one for each.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ tatra vā vaiśvadaivikam /
pāṇiprakṣālanaṃ dattvā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśānapi //
meaning:
मातामहानामप्येवं तत्र वा वैश्वदैविकम् /
पाणिप्रक्षालनं दत्त्वा विष्टरार्थं कुशानपि //
text_mt:
The same is prescribed for the maternal grandfathers; or the divine rite may be common to both.
Having given water for washing the hands, and kuśa grass for seats,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayedanujñāto viśvedevāsa ityṛcā /
yavairanvāvakīryātha bhājane sapavitrake //
meaning:
आवाहयेदनुज्ञातो विश्वेदेवास इत्यृचा /
यवैरन्वावकीर्याथ भाजने सपवित्रके //
text_mt:
he should invite the Viśvedevas, when permitted, with the verse, 'All gods...'.
Then, having scattered barley around them, in a vessel with a strainer,

sanskrit_iast:
śanno devyā apaḥ kṣiptvā yavo 'sīti yavāṃstathā /
yādivyā iti mantreṇa haste pādyaṃ viniḥkṣipet //
meaning:
शन्नो देव्या अपः क्षिप्त्वा यवो ऽसीति यवांस्तथा /
यादिव्या इति मन्त्रेण हस्ते पाद्यं विनिःक्षिपेत् //
text_mt:
pouring water with 'May the divine waters be auspicious for us...', and barley with 'You are barley...',
he should pour out water for the feet into the hand with the mantra 'O divine ones...'.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvodakaṃ gandhamālyaṃ pradāyānnaṃ sadīpakam /
apasavyaṃ tataḥ tṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ sapradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
दत्त्वोदकं गन्धमाल्यं प्रदायान्नं सदीपकम् /
अपसव्यं ततः तृत्वा पितॄणां सप्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
Having offered water, perfume, and garlands, and having presented food with a lamp,
he should then place the sacred thread over the right shoulder, circumambulating clockwise for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇāṃstu kuśāndattvā hyuśantistvityṛcā pitṝn /
āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyantu nastataḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणांस्तु कुशान्दत्त्वा ह्युशन्तिस्त्वित्यृचा पितॄन् /
आवाह्य तदनुज्ञातो जपेदायन्तु नस्ततः //
text_mt:
Offering double-folded kuśa grass, and having invoked the ancestors with the verse 'Willingly...',
permitted by them, he should then recite 'May our ancestors come...'.

sanskrit_iast:
yavārthāstu tilaiḥ kāryāḥ kuryādardhyādi pūrvavat /
dattvārdhyaṃ sayavāṃsteṣāṃ pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
यवार्थास्तु तिलैः कार्याः कुर्यादर्ध्यादि पूर्ववत् /
दत्त्वार्ध्यं सयवांस्तेषां पात्रे कृत्वा विधानतः //
text_mt:
The function of barley should be performed with sesame seeds, and guest-water, etc., offered as before.
Having offered the guest-water, and placed those [offerings] with barley in their vessels according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ kagetyadhaḥ /
agnau kariṣyannādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutam //
meaning:
पितृभ्यः स्थानमसीति न्युब्जं पात्रं कगेत्यधः /
अग्नौ करिष्यन्नादाय पृच्छत्यन्नं घृतप्लुतम् //
text_mt:
he inverts the vessel beneath with 'You are a seat for the ancestors.'
Intending to make offerings into the fire, he takes up food soaked in clarified butter and asks:

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto dattāvāgnau pitṛyajñavat /
hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāttu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कुरुष्वेत्यभ्यनुज्ञातो दत्तावाग्नौ पितृयज्ञवत् /
हुतशेषं प्रदद्यात्तु भाजनेषु समाहितः //
text_mt:
Permitted with 'Perform it!', he should make offerings into the fire as in an ancestral sacrifice.
With concentrated mind, he should place the residue of the oblation into their vessels,

sanskrit_iast:
yathālābhopapanneṣu gaipyeṣu ca viśeṣataḥ /
dattvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātramiti pātrā bhimantraṇam //
meaning:
यथालाभोपपन्नेषु गैप्येषु च विशेषतः /
दत्त्वान्नं पृथिवीपात्रमिति पात्रा भिमन्त्रणम् //
text_mt:
in vessels available, especially those of silver.
Having offered the food, he consecrates the vessels with 'Earth is the vessel...',

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭaṃ niveśayet /
savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhuvātā iti tyṛcam //
meaning:
कृत्वेदं विष्णुरित्यन्ने द्विजाङ्गुष्टं निवेशयेत् /
सव्याहृतिकां गायत्रीं मधुवाता इति त्यृचम् //
text_mt:
and, reciting 'Viṣṇu strode...', he should place the Brahmin's thumb into the food.
Reciting the gāyatrī with the sacred utterances, and the triplet 'Sweet are the winds...',

sanskrit_iast:
japtvā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃste 'pi vāgyatāḥ /
agnamiṣṭaṃ havipyaṃ ca dadyādakrodhano 'tvaraḥ //
meaning:
जप्त्वा यथासुखं वाच्यं भुञ्जीरंस्ते ऽपि वाग्यताः /
अग्नमिष्टं हविप्यं च दद्यादक्रोधनो ऽत्वरः //
text_mt:
he should say: 'Eat at your ease.' They too, restraining their speech, should eat.
Free of anger and unhurried, he should offer pleasing food suitable for oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
ātṛptestu pavitrāṇi japtvā pūrvajapaṃ tathā /
annamādāya tṛptāḥstha śeṣaṃ caivānumānya ca //
meaning:
आतृप्तेस्तु पवित्राणि जप्त्वा पूर्वजपं तथा /
अन्नमादाय तृप्ताःस्थ शेषं चैवानुमान्य च //
text_mt:
Reciting purifying texts until they are satisfied, as well as the previous recitation,
he takes the food and asks, 'Are you satisfied?', and gains their assent regarding the remainder.

sanskrit_iast:
tadannaṃ vikiredbhūmau dadyāñcāpaḥ sakṛtsakṛt /
sarvamannamupādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ //
meaning:
तदन्नं विकिरेद्भूमौ दद्याञ्चापः सकृत्सकृत् /
सर्वमन्नमुपादाय सतिलं दक्षिणामुखः //
text_mt:
He should scatter that food upon the ground and offer water once to each.
Taking all the food with sesame seeds, facing south,

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭasannidhau piṇḍāndadyādvai pitṛyajñavat /
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
उच्छिष्टसन्निधौ पिण्डान्दद्याद्वै पितृयज्ञवत् /
मातामहानामप्येवं दद्यादाचमनं ततः //
text_mt:
he should offer rice-balls near the remnants, as in an ancestral sacrifice.
The same is done for maternal grandfathers; then he should give water for sipping.

sanskrit_iast:
svasnivācaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣayyodakameva hi /
dattvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāramudāharet //
meaning:
स्वस्निवाचं ततः कुर्यादक्षय्योदकमेव हि /
दत्त्वा च दक्षिणां शक्त्या स्वधाकारमुदाहरेत् //
text_mt:
Then he should utter the benediction, and give water for imperishability;
and having given a priestly fee according to capacity, he should utter the svadhā-formula.

sanskrit_iast:
vācyatāmityanujñātaḥ prakṛtebhyaḥ svadhocyatām /
brūyurastu svadhetyukte bhūmau siṃcettato jalam //
meaning:
वाच्यतामित्यनुज्ञातः प्रकृतेभ्यः स्वधोच्यताम् /
ब्रूयुरस्तु स्वधेत्युक्ते भूमौ सिंचेत्ततो जलम् //
text_mt:
Authorized with 'Let it be uttered!', he says: 'May svadhā be uttered for the fathers.'
When they say, 'Let there be svadhā,' he should then sprinkle water on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvedevāśvaprīyantāṃ vipraiścokta idaṃ japet /
dātārono 'bhivarddhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatireva ca //
meaning:
विश्वेदेवाश्वप्रीयन्तां विप्रैश्चोक्त इदं जपेत् /
दातारोनो ऽभिवर्द्धन्तां वेदाः संततिरेव च //
text_mt:
When told by the Brahmins, 'May the Viśvedevas be pleased,' he should recite this:
'May our donors increase, and so may the Vedas and our lineage!

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā cano mā vyagamadbahu deyaṃ ca no 'stviti /
ityukto ktāḥ priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet //
meaning:
श्रद्धा चनो मा व्यगमद्बहु देयं च नो ऽस्त्विति /
इत्युक्तो क्ताः प्रिया वाचः प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
May faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!'
Addressed thus, having spoken pleasing words, he should bow down and dismiss them.

sanskrit_iast:
vājevāje iti prītaḥ pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanam /
yasmiṃste saṃśravāḥ pūrvamardhyapātre niveśitāḥ //
meaning:
वाजेवाजे इति प्रीतः पितृपूर्वं विसर्जनम् /
यस्मिंस्ते संश्रवाः पूर्वमर्ध्यपात्रे निवेशिताः //
text_mt:
Pleased, he performs the dismissal beginning with the ancestors, reciting 'In every contest...'.
That ancestral vessel in which the overflowings of guest-water were earlier deposited—

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛpātraṃ tadutthānaṃ kṛtvā viprānvisarjayet /
pradakṣiṇamanuvrajya bhuñjīta pitṛsevitam //
meaning:
पितृपात्रं तदुत्थानं कृत्वा विप्रान्विसर्जयेत् /
प्रदक्षिणमनुव्रज्य भुञ्जीत पितृसेवितम् //
text_mt:
having raised that ancestral vessel, he should dismiss the Brahmins.
Walking after them clockwise, he should eat what was enjoyed by the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī bhavettāṃ tu rajanīṃ brahmaṇaiḥ saha /
evaṃ pradakṣiṇāvṛttyā vṛddhau nāndīmukhānpitṝn //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी भवेत्तां तु रजनीं ब्रह्मणैः सह /
एवं प्रदक्षिणावृत्त्या वृद्धौ नान्दीमुखान्पितॄन् //
text_mt:
He should remain celibate for that night, together with the Brahmins.
Thus, proceeding clockwise in a prosperity rite, he should worship the Nāndīmukha ancestors

sanskrit_iast:
yajeta dadhikarkandhumiśrānpiḍānyavaiḥ kṛtān /
ekoddiṣṭaṃ devahīnamevārdhyaikapavitrakam //
meaning:
यजेत दधिकर्कन्धुमिश्रान्पिडान्यवैः कृतान् /
एकोद्दिष्टं देवहीनमेवार्ध्यैकपवित्रकम् //
text_mt:
with rice-balls made of barley mixed with curd and jujube fruit.
A rite for a single deceased is without deities, has only one guest-water and one strainer,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hyapasavyavat /
upatiṣaaṭatāmakṣayyasthāne vipravisarjane //
meaning:
आवाहनाग्नौकरणरहितं ह्यपसव्यवत् /
उपतिषअटतामक्षय्यस्थाने विप्रविसर्जने //
text_mt:
lacks invocation and offerings into fire, and is performed with sacred thread on the right shoulder.
In place of 'May it be imperishable,' he says 'May it approach [the deceased].' At the dismissal of the Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
abhiraṇyatāmiti vaded brūyuste 'bhiratāḥ sma ha /
gandhodakaṃ tilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
अभिरण्यतामिति वदेद् ब्रूयुस्ते ऽभिरताः स्म ह /
गन्धोदकं तिलैर्युक्तं कुर्यात्पात्रचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
he should say: 'May you be pleased!'; they should reply, 'We are indeed pleased.'
He should prepare four vessels with fragrant water and sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhyārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ presecayet /
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret //
meaning:
अर्ध्यार्थं पितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रेसेचयेत् /
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यां शेषं पूर्ववदाचरेत् //
text_mt:
For the sake of guest-water, he should pour the vessel of the deceased into the vessels of the ancestors
with the two verses 'They who are equal...'; the rest he should perform as before.

sanskrit_iast:
etansapiṃ ḍīkaraṇamekoṣṭiddaṃ sriyā api /
arvāksapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarādbhavet //
meaning:
एतन्सपिं डीकरणमेकोष्टिद्दं स्रिया अपि /
अर्वाक्सपिण्डीकरणं यस्य संवत्सराद्भवेत् //
text_mt:
This is the rite of sapīṇḍīkaraṇa; the single-deceased rite applies to women as well.
If one's sapīṇḍīkaraṇa is performed before a year has elapsed,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyannaṃ sodakuṃbhaṃ dadyātsaṃvatsaraṃ dvije /
bhṛte 'hani tu kartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram //
meaning:
तस्याप्यन्नं सोदकुंभं दद्यात्संवत्सरं द्विजे /
भृते ऽहनि तु कर्तव्यं प्रतिमासं तु वत्सरम् //
text_mt:
one should still give food with a water pot to a Brahmin for a year.
It must be performed on the day of death each month for a year,

sanskrit_iast:
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ caiva māsamekādaśe 'hani /
piṇḍāṃścago 'javiprebhyo dadyādagnau jale 'pi vā //
meaning:
प्रतिसंवत्सरं चैव मासमेकादशे ऽहनि /
पिण्डांश्चगो ऽजविप्रेभ्यो दद्यादग्नौ जले ऽपि वा //
text_mt:
and year after year, and on the eleventh day of the month.
He should give rice-balls to a cow, a goat, or Brahmins, or cast them into fire or water.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣipetsatsu vipreṣu dvijocchiṣṭaṃ na mārjayet /
haviṣyānnena vai māsaṃ pāyasena tu vatsaram //
meaning:
प्रक्षिपेत्सत्सु विप्रेषु द्विजोच्छिष्टं न मार्जयेत् /
हविष्यान्नेन वै मासं पायसेन तु वत्सरम् //
text_mt:
While the Brahmins are present, he should not clean up their food remnants.
[Pleased] for a month indeed with sacrificial food, but for a year with milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
mātsyahāriṇakaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ /
aiṇarauravavārāhaśāśairmāṃsairyathākramam //
meaning:
मात्स्यहारिणकौरभ्रशाकुनच्छागपार्षतैः /
ऐणरौरववाराहशाशैर्मांसैर्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
and with the meat of fish, deer, sheep, birds, goats, and spotted deer,
of black buck, Ruru deer, boar, and hare, in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
māsavṛddhyābhitṛpyanti dattairiha pitāmahāḥ /
khaḍgāmiṣaṃ mahākalpaṃ madhu munyannameva ca //
meaning:
मासवृद्ध्याभितृप्यन्ति दत्तैरिह पितामहाः /
खड्गामिषं महाकल्पं मधु मुन्यन्नमेव च //
text_mt:
the grandfathers are gratified here with an increase of months by what is offered.
Rhinoceros flesh for a great cosmic age, honey, and ascetic food,

sanskrit_iast:
lohāmiṣaṃ mahāśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhrīṇasasya ca /
yo dadāti gayāsthaśca sarvamānantyamaśnute //
meaning:
लोहामिषं महाशाकं मांसं वार्ध्रीणसस्य च /
यो ददाति गयास्थश्च सर्वमानन्त्यमश्नुते //
text_mt:
red goat flesh, the mahāśāka vegetable, and the flesh of a Vārdhrīṇasa bird—
he who offers these while staying at Gayā attains all things eternally.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca viśeṣataḥ /
kalyāṃ kanyāvedinaśca paśūnvai satsutānapi //
meaning:
तथा वर्षात्रयोदश्यां मघासु च विशेषतः /
कल्यां कन्यावेदिनश्च पशून्वै सत्सुतानपि //
text_mt:
Likewise especially on the thirteenth day of the rainy season and under the Maghā asterism,
and one who seeks a good maiden obtains cattle and good sons.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ dviśaphaikaśaphaāṃstathā /
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrānsvarṇarūpye sakupyake //
meaning:
द्यूतं कृषिं च वाणिज्यं द्विशफैकशफआंस्तथा /
ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः पुत्रान्स्वर्णरूप्ये सकुप्यके //
text_mt: Gambling, agriculture, trade, cloven-hoofed and single-hoofed beasts, / sons endowed with the splendour of sacred knowledge, gold, silver, and copper or base metal—

sanskrit_iast:
jñātiśreṣṭhyaṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā /
pratipatprabhṛtiṣvekāṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm //
meaning:
ज्ञातिश्रेष्ठ्यं सर्वकामानाप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा /
प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिष्वेकां वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीम् //
text_mt: Eminence among kin, and all desires the giver of śrāddha always attains, / [offering] on [tithis] beginning with the first, excepting only the fourteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
śastreṇa tu hatāye vai tebhyastatra pradīyate /
svargaṃ hyapatyamojaśca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā //
meaning:
शस्त्रेण तु हताये वै तेभ्यस्तत्र प्रदीयते /
स्वर्गं ह्यपत्यमोजश्च शौर्यं क्षेत्रं बलं तथा //
text_mt: For those indeed who were slain by a weapon, [śrāddha] is offered on that [fourteenth tithi]. / [The performer obtains] heaven, offspring, vigour, valour, arable land, and strength,

sanskrit_iast:
putrān śreṣṭhāṃśca saubhāgyaṃ samṛddhiṃ mukhyatāṃ śubham /
pravṛttaṃ cakratāṃ caiva vāṇijyaprabhṛtīni ca //
meaning:
पुत्रान् श्रेष्ठांश्च सौभाग्यं समृद्धिं मुख्यतां शुभम् /
प्रवृत्तं चक्रतां चैव वाणिज्यप्रभृतीनि च //
text_mt: Excellent sons, good fortune, prosperity, pre-eminence, good auspiciousness, / an unbroken circle of authority, trade and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṃ gatim /
dhanaṃ vidyāṃ bhiṣak siddhiṃ kupyaṅgā apyajāvikam //
meaning:
अरोगित्वं यशो वीतशोकतां परमां गतिम् /
धनं विद्यां भिषक् सिद्धिं कुप्यङ्गा अप्यजाविकम् //
text_mt: Freedom from disease, fame, grieflessness, the supreme state, / wealth, learning, success as a physician, base metal, cows, goats, and sheep,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvanāyuśca vidhivadyaḥ śrāddhaṃ saṃprayacchati /
kṛttikādi bharaṇyantaṃ sakāmānāpnuyādimān //
meaning:
अश्वनायुश्च विधिवद्यः श्राद्धं संप्रयच्छति /
कृत्तिकादि भरण्यन्तं सकामानाप्नुयादिमान् //
text_mt: Horses, and longevity—he who properly performs śrāddha / from Kṛttikā to Bharaṇī attains these wished-for things.

sanskrit_iast:
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca vyapetamadamatsaraḥ /
vasurudrāditisutāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ //
meaning:
आस्तिकः श्रद्दधानश्च व्यपेतमदमत्सरः /
वसुरुद्रादितिसुताः पितरः श्राद्धदेवताः //
text_mt:
Faithful, full of faith, free from pride and envy—
the Vasus, Rudras, and sons of Aditi are the ancestors, the deities of the śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝn śrāddhena tarpitāḥ /
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca //
meaning:
प्रीणयन्ति मनुष्याणां पितॄन् श्राद्धेन तर्पिताः /
आयुः प्रजां धनं विद्यां स्वर्गं मोक्षं सुखानि च //
text_mt:
Gratified through the śrāddha, they delight the ancestors of human beings;
longevity, offspring, wealth, learning, heaven, liberation, and pleasures,

sanskrit_iast:
prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ nṛṇāṃ prītāḥ pitāmahāḥ /
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiñcitkalpādhyāye viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
प्रयच्छन्ति तथा राज्यं नृणां प्रीताः पितामहाः /
इत्येवं कथितं किञ्चित्कल्पाध्याये विशेषतः //
text_mt:
as well as sovereignty, do the pleased forefathers bestow upon men.
Thus has something been related in particular in the Kalpa chapter;

sanskrit_iast:
jñātavyaṃ vaidike tantre purāṇāntarake 'pi ca /
ya imaṃ cintayedvidvānkalpādhyāyaṃ munīśvara //
meaning:
ज्ञातव्यं वैदिके तन्त्रे पुराणान्तरके ऽपि च /
य इमं चिन्तयेद्विद्वान्कल्पाध्यायं मुनीश्वर //
text_mt:
it should also be known from the Vedic system and from other Purāṇas.
The wise person who contemplates this Kalpa chapter, O lord of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhavetkarmakuśala ihānyatra gatiṃ śubhām /
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi //
meaning:
स भवेत्कर्मकुशल इहान्यत्र गतिं शुभाम् /
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि //
text_mt:
becomes skilled in ritual action, with an auspicious destination here and hereafter.
The man who listens with devotion during rites for the gods and ancestors

sanskrit_iast:
kalpādhyāyaṃ sa labhate daivapitrya kriyāphalam /
dhanaṃ vidyāṃ yaśaḥ putrānparatra ca gatiṃ parām //
meaning:
कल्पाध्यायं स लभते दैवपित्र्य क्रियाफलम् /
धनं विद्यां यशः पुत्रान्परत्र च गतिं पराम् //
text_mt:
to the Kalpa chapter, obtains the fruit of rites for gods and ancestors:
wealth, learning, fame, sons, and a supreme destination in the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ vyākaraṇaṃ tubhyaṃ vedamukhābhidham /
kathayiṣye samāsena śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde eka pañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अतः परं व्याकरणं तुभ्यं वेदमुखाभिधम् /
कथयिष्ये समासेन शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे एक पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
After this I will speak to you in brief of grammar,
which is called the mouth of the Veda; listen, fully concentrated.

Thus ends the fifty-first chapter in the second quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
atha vyākaraṇaṃ vakṣye saṃkṣepāttava nārada /
siddharūpaprabandhena mukhaṃ vedasya sāṃpratam //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
अथ व्याकरणं वक्ष्ये संक्षेपात्तव नारद /
सिद्धरूपप्रबन्धेन मुखं वेदस्य सांप्रतम् //
text_mt:
Sanandana said:
Now I will speak to you briefly of grammar, O Nārada,
as a presentation of standard forms, the mouth of the Veda today.

sanskrit_iast:
suptiṅaṃtaṃ padaṃ vipra supāṃ sapta vibhaktayaḥ /
svaujasaḥ prathamā proktā sā prātipadikātmikā //
meaning:
सुप्तिङंतं पदं विप्र सुपां सप्त विभक्तयः /
स्वौजसः प्रथमा प्रोक्ता सा प्रातिपदिकात्मिका //
text_mt:
A word ends in sup or tiṅ, O vipra; of the sup affixes there are seven case-endings.
su-au-jas is called the first; its nature is the nominal stem,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbodhane ca liṅgādāvukte karmaṇi kartari /
arthāvatprātipadikaṃ dhātupratyayavārjitam //
meaning:
संबोधने च लिङ्गादावुक्ते कर्मणि कर्तरि /
अर्थावत्प्रातिपदिकं धातुप्रत्ययवार्जितम् //
text_mt:
and it occurs in the vocative, in [denoting] gender, and so on, when the object or agent is already expressed.
A nominal stem is meaningful, excluding verbal roots and affixes.

sanskrit_iast:
amausaśo dvitīyā syāttatkarma kriyate ca yat /
dvitīyā karmaṇi proktāntarāntareṇa saṃyute //
meaning:
अमौसशो द्वितीया स्यात्तत्कर्म क्रियते च यत् /
द्वितीया कर्मणि प्रोक्तान्तरान्तरेण संयुते //
text_mt:
am-auṭ-śas is the second; that is the object, and what is done.
The second is declared to denote the object, and in connection with antarā and antareṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṭābhyāṃbhisastṛtīyā syātkaraṇe kartarīritā /
yena kriyate tatkaraṇaṃ saḥ kartā syātkaroti yaḥ //
meaning:
टाभ्यांभिसस्तृतीया स्यात्करणे कर्तरीरिता /
येन क्रियते तत्करणं सः कर्ता स्यात्करोति यः //
text_mt:
ṭā-bhyām-bhis is the third, said to denote the instrument and the agent;
that by which an act is done is the instrument, and he who does it is the agent.

sanskrit_iast:
ṅebhyāṃbhyasaścaturtho syātsaṃ pradāne ca kārake /
yasmai ditsā dhārayedvai rocate saṃpradānakam //
meaning:
ङेभ्यांभ्यसश्चतुर्थो स्यात्सं प्रदाने च कारके /
यस्मै दित्सा धारयेद्वै रोचते संप्रदानकम् //
text_mt:
ṅe-bhyām-bhyas is the fourth, in the case of the recipient kāraka:
to whom one wishes to give, [to whom one] owes, or who is pleased, is the recipient.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamī syānṅasibhyāṃbhyo hyapādāne ca kārake /
yato 'paiti samādatte apadatte ca yaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमी स्यान्ङसिभ्यांभ्यो ह्यपादाने च कारके /
यतो ऽपैति समादत्ते अपदत्ते च यं यतः //
text_mt:
The fifth is ṅasi-bhyām-bhyas, in the case of the point of departure kāraka:
from which [one] departs, or takes, and from what [one protects] whom.

sanskrit_iast:
ṅasosāmaśca ṣaṣṭhī syātsvāmisaṃbandhamukhyake /
ṅyoḥsupaḥ saptamī tu syātsā cādhikaraṇe bhavet //
meaning:
ङसोसामश्च षष्ठी स्यात्स्वामिसंबन्धमुख्यके /
ङ्योःसुपः सप्तमी तु स्यात्सा चाधिकरणे भवेत् //
text_mt:
ṅas-os-ām is the sixth, primarily denoting the master and relation.
ṅi-os-sup is the seventh, and it occurs to denote the locus,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāre cāpi viprendra rakṣārthānāṃ prayogataḥ /
īpsitaṃ cānīpsitaṃ yattadapādānakaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
आधारे चापि विप्रेन्द्र रक्षार्थानां प्रयोगतः /
ईप्सितं चानीप्सितं यत्तदपादानकं स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
as well as the substratum, O best of vipras; by the use of [verbs] meaning protection,
that which is desired or undesired is known as the point of departure.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamī paryaṇaṅyoge itararte 'nyadiṅmukhe /
etairyoge dvitīyā syātkarmapravacanīyakaiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमी पर्यणङ्योगे इतरर्ते ऽन्यदिङ्मुखे /
एतैर्योगे द्वितीया स्यात्कर्मप्रवचनीयकैः //
text_mt:
The fifth occurs in connection with pari, apa, and āṅ, and with itara, ṛte, and anya in the sense of direction.
In connection with these karmapravacanīyas the second occurs:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūto 'bhirabhāge cānupariprati /
antareṣu sahārthe ca hīne hyupaśca kathyate //
meaning:
लक्षणेत्थंभूतो ऽभिरभागे चानुपरिप्रति /
अन्तरेषु सहार्थे च हीने ह्युपश्च कथ्यते //
text_mt:
abhi in the sense of a sign or state, and anu, pari, and prati when not denoting a share;
upa is declared in the sense of between, together with, and inferior.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyā ca caturthī syāñceṣṭāyāṃ gatikarmaṇi /
aprāṇiṣu vibhaktī dve manyakarmaṇyanādare //
meaning:
द्वितीया च चतुर्थी स्याञ्चेष्टायां गतिकर्मणि /
अप्राणिषु विभक्ती द्वे मन्यकर्मण्यनादरे //
text_mt:
The second and the fourth occur to denote the object of motion involving bodily action,
and the two case-endings [occur] with inanimate objects as the object of manya in contempt.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥsvastisvadhāsvāhālaṃvaṣaḍyoga īritā /
caturthī caiva tādarthye tumarthādbhāvavācinaḥ //
meaning:
नमःस्वस्तिस्वधास्वाहालंवषड्योग ईरिता /
चतुर्थी चैव तादर्थ्ये तुमर्थाद्भाववाचिनः //
text_mt:
The fourth is declared in connection with namaḥ, svasti, svadhā, svāhā, alam, and vaṣaṭ,
and also in the sense of purpose, from a verbal noun in the sense of the infinitive.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyā sahayoge syātkutsiteṃ'ge viśeṣaṇe /
kāle bhāve saptamī syādetairyoge ca ṣaṣṭhyapi //
meaning:
तृतीया सहयोगे स्यात्कुत्सितेंऽगे विशेषणे /
काले भावे सप्तमी स्यादेतैर्योगे च षष्ठ्यपि //
text_mt:
The third occurs in connection with saha, with a deformed limb, and with a characteristic mark.
The seventh occurs in time and condition, and the sixth also in connection with these,

sanskrit_iast:
svāmīśvarodhipatibhiḥ sākṣidāyādasūtakaiḥ /
nirdhāraṇe dve vibhaktī ṣaṣṭī hetuprayogake //
meaning:
स्वामीश्वरोधिपतिभिः साक्षिदायादसूतकैः /
निर्धारणे द्वे विभक्ती षष्टी हेतुप्रयोगके //
text_mt:
with the words svāmin, īśvara, adhipati, sākṣin, dāyāda, and prasūta.
In selection there are two case-endings; the sixth is used with hetu,

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyarthakarmaṇi tathā karoteḥ pratiyatnake /
hiṃsārthānāṃ prayoge ca kṛtikarmaṇi kartari //
meaning:
स्मृत्यर्थकर्मणि तथा करोतेः प्रतियत्नके /
हिंसार्थानां प्रयोगे च कृतिकर्मणि कर्तरि //
text_mt:
likewise with the object of [verbs] meaning remembrance, with the effort of kṛ,
in the use of [verbs] meaning violence, and in the agent and object of a kṛt-affix.

sanskrit_iast:
/
na kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭī niṣṭādipratipādikā /
etā vai dvividhā jñeyāḥ subādiṣu vibhaktiṣu /
bhūvādiṣu tiṅateṣu lakārā daśa vai smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
/
न कर्तृकर्मणोः षष्टी निष्टादिप्रतिपादिका /
एता वै द्विविधा ज्ञेयाः सुबादिषु विभक्तिषु /
भूवादिषु तिङतेषु लकारा दश वै स्मृताः //
text_mt:
The sixth does not express the agent or object with niṣṭhā and other [affixes].
These are to be known as twofold among the sup and other case-endings.
Ten lakāras are recorded for tiṅ-endings after roots beginning with bhū:

sanskrit_iast:
tipta saṃtīti prathamo madhyamaḥ sipthasthottamaḥ /
mivvasmasaḥ parasmai tu pādānāṃ cā mapanedam //
meaning:
तिप्त संतीति प्रथमो मध्यमः सिप्थस्थोत्तमः /
मिव्वस्मसः परस्मै तु पादानां चा मपनेदम् //
text_mt:
tip, tas, jhi is the third person; sip, thas, tha is the second person; the first person
is mip, vas, mas, of the parasmaipada [endings]; and now of the ātmanepada:

sanskrit_iast:
ta āteṃ'te prathamo madhvaḥ se āthe dhve tathottamaḥ /
e vahe maha ādeśā jñeyā hyanye liṅādiṣu //
meaning:
त आतेंऽते प्रथमो मध्वः से आथे ध्वे तथोत्तमः /
ए वहे मह आदेशा ज्ञेया ह्यन्ये लिङादिषु //
text_mt:
ta, ātām, jha is the third person; the middle is thās, āthām, dhvam; likewise the first
is iṭ, vahi, mahiṅ; and other substitutes should be known in the liṅ, etc.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmni prayujyamāne tu prathamaḥ puruṣo bhavet /
madhyamo yuṣmadi prokta uttamaḥ puruṣo 'smadi //
meaning:
नाम्नि प्रयुज्यमाने तु प्रथमः पुरुषो भवेत् /
मध्यमो युष्मदि प्रोक्त उत्तमः पुरुषो ऽस्मदि //
text_mt:
When a noun is used, the third person occurs;
the second person is stated when yuṣmad [is used], and the first person when asmad [is used].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūvādyā dhātavaḥ proktāḥ sanādyantāstathā tataḥ /
laḍīrito vartamāne bhūte 'nadyatane tathā //
meaning:
भूवाद्या धातवः प्रोक्ताः सनाद्यन्तास्तथा ततः /
लडीरितो वर्तमाने भूते ऽनद्यतने तथा //
text_mt:
Roots are stated as beginning with bhū and ending with san, etc. Then,
laṭ is declared in the present; and likewise in the non-recent past,

sanskrit_iast:
māsmayoge ca laṅ vācyo loḍāśiṣi ca dhātutaḥ /
vidhyādau syādāśiṣi ca liṅito dvividho mune //
meaning:
मास्मयोगे च लङ् वाच्यो लोडाशिषि च धातुतः /
विध्यादौ स्यादाशिषि च लिङितो द्विविधो मुने //
text_mt:
in connection with mā and sma, laṅ is to be stated, and loṭ after a root in benediction;
liṅ is of two kinds, O sage, in injunction, etc., and in benediction.

sanskrit_iast:
liḍatīte parokṣe syāt śvastane luṅ bhaviṣyati /
syādanadyatane ḷṭū ca bhaviṣyati tu dhātutaḥ //
meaning:
लिडतीते परोक्षे स्यात् श्वस्तने लुङ् भविष्यति /
स्यादनद्यतने ऌटू च भविष्यति तु धातुतः //
text_mt:
liṭ occurs in the past beyond perception; in the tomorrow-future, luṭ occurs;
and in the non-recent future, lṛṭ occurs after a root.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūte luṅ tipasyapau ca kriyāyāṃ ḷṅ prakīrtitaḥ /
siddhodāharaṇaṃ viddhi saṃhitādipuraḥ saram //
meaning:
भूते लुङ् तिपस्यपौ च क्रियायां ऌङ् प्रकीर्तितः /
सिद्धोदाहरणं विद्धि संहितादिपुरः सरम् //
text_mt:
luṅ is in the past, and tip and syap, and lṛṅ is proclaimed in [conditional] action.
Know the illustrative examples, beginning with euphony, etc.:

sanskrit_iast:
/
daṇḍāgraṃ ca dadhīdaṃ ca madhūdakaṃ pitrarṣabhaḥ /
hotṝkārastathā seyaṃ lāṅgalīṣā manīṣayā //
meaning:
/
दण्डाग्रं च दधीदं च मधूदकं पित्रर्षभः /
होतॄकारस्तथा सेयं लाङ्गलीषा मनीषया //
text_mt:
daṇḍāgram, dadhīdam, madhūdakam, pitrarṣabhaḥ,
hotṝkāraḥ, and likewise seyam, lāṅgalīṣā, manīṣayā,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgodakaṃ tavalkāra ṛṇārṇaṃ ca munīśvara //ṭha
śītārtaśca muniśreṣṭha seṃdraḥ saukāra ityapi //
meaning:
गङ्गोदकं तवल्कार ऋणार्णं च मुनीश्वर //ठ
शीतार्तश्च मुनिश्रेष्ठ सेंद्रः सौकार इत्यपि //
text_mt:
gaṅgodakam, tavalkāraḥ, and ṛṇārṇam, O lord of sages,
and śītārtaḥ, O best of sages, sendraḥ, and saukāraḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
vadhvāsanaṃ pitrartho nāyako lavaṇastathā /
ta ādyā viṣṇave hyatra tasmā argho gurā adhaḥ //
meaning:
वध्वासनं पित्रर्थो नायको लवणस्तथा /
त आद्या विष्णवे ह्यत्र तस्मा अर्घो गुरा अधः //
text_mt:
vadhvāsanam, pitrarthaḥ, nāyakaḥ, likewise lavaṇaḥ;
ta ādyāḥ, viṣṇave here, tasmā arghaḥ, gurā adhaḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
hare 'va viṣṇo 'vetyeṣādasomādapyamī adhāḥ /
śaurī etau viṣṇu imau durge amū no arjunaḥ //
meaning:
हरे ऽव विष्णो ऽवेत्येषादसोमादप्यमी अधाः /
शौरी एतौ विष्णु इमौ दुर्गे अमू नो अर्जुनः //
text_mt:
hare 'va, viṣṇo 'va; after these, asomāt, and also amī adhāḥ,
śaurī etau, viṣṇū imau, durge amū, no arjunaḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
ā evaṃ ca prakṛtyaite tiṣṭanti munisattama /
ṣaḍatra ṣaṇmātaraśca vākchuro vāgdhasrithā //
meaning:
आ एवं च प्रकृत्यैते तिष्टन्ति मुनिसत्तम /
षडत्र षण्मातरश्च वाक्छुरो वाग्धस्रिथा //
text_mt:
These remain unchanged in original form, O best of sages:
ṣaḍ atra, ṣaṇ mātaraḥ, vākśūraḥ, vāg dhasrithā,

sanskrit_iast:
hariḥśete vibhuścintyastaccheṣo yañcarastanthā /
praśnastvatha hariḥṣaṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇaṣṭīkata ityapi //
meaning:
हरिःशेते विभुश्चिन्त्यस्तच्छेषो यञ्चरस्तन्था /
प्रश्नस्त्वथ हरिःषष्ठः कृष्णष्टीकत इत्यपि //
text_mt:
hariḥ śete, vibhuś cintyaḥ, taccheṣaḥ, yañ caraḥ, and likewise
praśnaḥ, then hariḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, kṛṣṇaṣ ṭīkate, and also

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānṣaṣṭhaśca ṣaṭ santaḥ ṣaṭte tallepa eva ca /
cakriṃśchindhi bhavāñchaurirbhavāñśaurirityapi //
meaning:
भवान्षष्ठश्च षट् सन्तः षट्ते तल्लेप एव च /
चक्रिंश्छिन्धि भवाञ्छौरिर्भवाञ्शौरिरित्यपि //
text_mt:
bhavāñ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, ṣaṭ santaḥ, ṣaṭ te, and tal-lepaḥ,
cakriñś chindhi, bhavāñ śauriḥ, bhavāñś śauriḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
samyaṅṅanantoṅgacchāyā kṛṣṇaṃ vande munīśvara /
tejāṃsi maṃsyate gaṅgā hariśchettā maraḥśivaḥ //
meaning:
सम्यङ्ङनन्तोङ्गच्छाया कृष्णं वन्दे मुनीश्वर /
तेजांसि मंस्यते गङ्गा हरिश्छेत्ता मरःशिवः //
text_mt:
samyaṅṅ anantaḥ, aṅgacchāyā, kṛṣṇaṃ vande, O lord of sages;
tejāṃsi, maṃsyate, gaṅgā, hariś chettā, maraḥ śivaḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
rāma kāmyaḥ kṛpa pūjyo hariḥ pūjyor'cya eva hi /
romo dṛṣṭo 'balā atra suptā iṣṭā imā yataḥ //
meaning:
राम काम्यः कृप पूज्यो हरिः पूज्योर्ऽच्य एव हि /
रोमो दृष्टो ऽबला अत्र सुप्ता इष्टा इमा यतः //
text_mt:
rāma kāmyaḥ, kṛpa pūjyaḥ, hariḥ pūjyaḥ, arcya eva hi,
romo dṛṣṭaḥ, abalā atra suptāḥ, iṣṭā imāḥ, yataḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurnabhyo ravirayaṃ gī )( phalaṃ prātaracyutaḥ /
bhaktairvadyo 'pyantarātmā bho bho eṣa haristathā /
eṣa śārṅgī saiṣa rāmaḥ saṃhitaivaṃ prakīrtitā //
meaning:
विष्णुर्नभ्यो रविरयं गी )( फलं प्रातरच्युतः /
भक्तैर्वद्यो ऽप्यन्तरात्मा भो भो एष हरिस्तथा /
एष शार्ङ्गी सैष रामः संहितैवं प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt:
viṣṇur nabhyaḥ, ravir ayam, gīḥ phalam, prātar acyutaḥ,
bhaktair vadyaḥ, antarātmā, bho bho eṣa hariḥ, and likewise
eṣa śārṅgī, saiṣa rāmaḥ—thus has euphony been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇābhihitaṃ karomi satataṃ rāmaṃ bhaje sāḍharam /
rāmeṇāpahṛtaṃ samastaduritaṃ rāmāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ /
rāmānmuktimabhīpsitā mama sadā rāmasya dāso 'smyaham /
rāme rañjat me manaḥ suviśadaṃ he rāma tubhyaṃ namaḥ //
meaning:
रामेणाभिहितं करोमि सततं रामं भजे साढरम् /
रामेणापहृतं समस्तदुरितं रामाय तुभ्यं नमः /
रामान्मुक्तिमभीप्सिता मम सदा रामस्य दासो ऽस्म्यहम् /
रामे रञ्जत् मे मनः सुविशदं हे राम तुभ्यं नमः //

sanskrit_iast: sarva ityādikā gopāḥ sakhā caiva patirhariḥ //
meaning: सर्व इत्यादिका गोपाः सखा चैव पतिर्हरिः //
text_mt: The [nominal stems] are: sarva and so on, gopāḥ, sakhā, and patiḥ, hariḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
suśrīrbhānuḥ svayaṃbhūśca kartā rau gaustu nauriti /
anaṅghāngodhugliṭ ca dve trayaścatvāra eva ca //
meaning:
सुश्रीर्भानुः स्वयंभूश्च कर्ता रौ गौस्तु नौरिति /
अनङ्घान्गोधुग्लिट् च द्वे त्रयश्चत्वार एव च //
text_mt:
suśrīḥ, bhānuḥ, svayambhūḥ, kartā, raiḥ, gauḥ, nauḥ;
anadvān, godhuk, liṭ, and dve, trayaḥ, catvāraḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā panthāstathā daṇḍī brahmahā pañca cāṣṭa ca /
aṣṭau ayaṃ mune samrāṭ savibhradvapuṅmanaḥ //
meaning:
राजा पन्थास्तथा दण्डी ब्रह्महा पञ्च चाष्ट च /
अष्टौ अयं मुने सम्राट् सविभ्रद्वपुङ्मनः //
text_mt:
rājā, panthās, as well as daṇḍī, brahmahā, [and the numerals] pañca and aṣṭa;
aṣṭau, ayam, O sage, samrāṭ, savibhṛt, vapuḥ, manaḥ;

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaṅ pumānmahān dhīmān vidvānṣaṭ pipaṭhīśca doḥ /
uśanāsāviṃme puṃsi syāraktalavirāmakāḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यङ् पुमान्महान् धीमान् विद्वान्षट् पिपठीश्च दोः /
उशनासाविंमे पुंसि स्यारक्तलविरामकाः //
text_mt:
pratyaṅ, pumān, mahān, dhīmān, vidvān, ṣaṭ, pipaṭhīḥ, and doḥ;
uśanā, asau—these masculine [words] end in consonants: s, r, k, t, l, and the rests [stops];

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā sarvā gatirgopī srī śrīrdhenurvadhūḥ svasā /
gaurnauṃrupān dūdyaurgoḥ kṣut kakupsaṃvittu vā kvacit //
meaning:
राधा सर्वा गतिर्गोपी स्री श्रीर्धेनुर्वधूः स्वसा /
गौर्नौंरुपान् दूद्यौर्गोः क्षुत् ककुप्संवित्तु वा क्वचित् //
text_mt:
rādhā, sarvā, gatiḥ, gopī, strī, śrīḥ, dhenuḥ, vadhūḥ, svasā,
gauḥ, nauḥ, upānat, dyauḥ, gauḥ, kṣut, kakup, saṃvit, and sometimes [vā];

sanskrit_iast:
rugviḍudbhāḥ sriyāstapaḥ kulaṃ somapamakṣi ca /
grāmaṇyaṃburavalapvevaṃ kartṛ cātiri vātinu //
meaning:
रुग्विडुद्भाः स्रियास्तपः कुलं सोमपमक्षि च /
ग्रामण्यंबुरवलप्वेवं कर्तृ चातिरि वातिनु //
text_mt:
ruk, viṭ, udbhāḥ, strī; [in neuter:] tapaḥ, kulam, somapam, and akṣi,
grāmaṇi, ambu, avalapu, thus kartṛ, and atiri or atinu;

sanskrit_iast:
svanahucca vimaladyu vāśvatvārīdameva ca /
etadbrahmāhaśca daṇḍī asṛkkiñcittyadādi ca //
meaning:
स्वनहुच्च विमलद्यु वाश्वत्वारीदमेव च /
एतद्ब्रह्माहश्च दण्डी असृक्किञ्चित्त्यदादि च //
text_mt:
svanahuḥ, vimaladyu, vāśva, trī, and idam itself,
etat, brahma, ahaḥ, and daṇḍi, asṛk, kiñcit, and tyad etc.;

sanskrit_iast:
etadve bhidgavākgavāṅ goak goṅgok goṅ /
tiryagyakṛcchakṛccaiva dadadbhavatpacattudat //
meaning:
एतद्वे भिद्गवाक्गवाङ् गोअक् गोङ्गोक् गोङ् /
तिर्यग्यकृच्छकृच्चैव ददद्भवत्पचत्तुदत् //
text_mt:
etat, vid, bhid, gavāk, gavāṅ, goak, goṅ, gok, goṅ,
tiryak, yakṛt, and śakṛt, dadat, bhavat, pacat, tudat;

sanskrit_iast:
dīvyaddhanuśca pipaṭhīḥ payo 'daḥsumumāṃsi ca /
guṇadravya kriyāyogāṃsriliṅgāṃśca kati bruve //
meaning:
दीव्यद्धनुश्च पिपठीः पयो ऽदःसुमुमांसि च /
गुणद्रव्य क्रियायोगांस्रिलिङ्गांश्च कति ब्रुवे //
text_mt:
dīvyat, dhanuḥ, and pipaṭhi, payaḥ, adaḥ, and sumumān;
and those used in the three genders by connection to quality, substance, or action—how many shall I state?

sanskrit_iast:
śuktaḥ kīlālapāścaiva śuciśca grāmaṇīḥ sudhīḥ /
paṭuḥ svayaṃbhūḥ kartā ca mātā caiva va pitā ca nā //
meaning:
शुक्तः कीलालपाश्चैव शुचिश्च ग्रामणीः सुधीः /
पटुः स्वयंभूः कर्ता च माता चैव व पिता च ना //
text_mt:
śuklaḥ, kīlālapāḥ, and śuciḥ, grāmaṇīḥ, sudhīḥ,
paṭuḥ, svayaṃbhūḥ, kartā, and mātā, or pitā, and nā;

sanskrit_iast:
satyānāgyāstathā puṃso matabhramaradīrghapāt /
dhanākṛsomau cāgarhastavirgrathāsvarṇanbahū //
meaning:
सत्यानाग्यास्तथा पुंसो मतभ्रमरदीर्घपात् /
धनाकृसोमौ चागर्हस्तविर्ग्रथास्वर्णन्बहू //
text_mt:
satya, anāgyā, as well as of the masculine mata, bhramara, dīrghapāt,
dhanākṛ, somau, agarha, staviḥ, grathāḥ, suvarṇān, bahu;

sanskrit_iast: rimapavviṣādvajātānaho tathā sarvaṃ viśvobhaye cobhau anyāntaretarāṇi ca //
meaning: रिमपव्विषाद्वजातानहो तथा सर्वं विश्वोभये चोभौ अन्यान्तरेतराणि च //
text_mt: … so also sarva, viśva, ubhaya, both ubhau, anya, antara, itara, and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
uttaraścottamo nemastvasamo 'tha samā iṣaḥ /
pūrvottarottarāścaiva dakṣiṇaścottarādharau //
meaning:
उत्तरश्चोत्तमो नेमस्त्वसमो ऽथ समा इषः /
पूर्वोत्तरोत्तराश्चैव दक्षिणश्चोत्तराधरौ //
text_mt:
uttara, uttama, nema, asama, then samāḥ, iṣaḥ,
pūrvottarottarāḥ, dakṣiṇa, uttara, and adhara;

sanskrit_iast:
aparaścaturo 'pyetadyāvattatkimasau dvayam /
yuṣmadasmañca prathamaścaramolpastathārdhakaḥ //
meaning:
अपरश्चतुरो ऽप्येतद्यावत्तत्किमसौ द्वयम् /
युष्मदस्मञ्च प्रथमश्चरमोल्पस्तथार्धकः //
text_mt:
apara, catur, this yāvat, tat, kim, asau, dvayam,
yuṣmad, asmad, prathama, carama, alpa, as well as ardhaka;

sanskrit_iast:
noraḥ katipayo dve ca trayo śuddhādayastathā /
svekābhuvirodhapari viparyayaścāvyayāstathā //
meaning:
नोरः कतिपयो द्वे च त्रयो शुद्धादयस्तथा /
स्वेकाभुविरोधपरि विपर्ययश्चाव्ययास्तथा //
text_mt:
[the affix] na, uḥ, katipaya, dve, trayaḥ, śuddha, and so forth,
sva, eka, in the sense of opposition, pari, contrariety, and likewise the indeclinables;

sanskrit_iast:
taddhitāścāpyapatyārthe pāṇḍavāḥ śraidharastathā /
gārgyo nāḍāyanātreyau gāṅgeyaḥ paitṛṣvasrīyaḥ //
meaning:
तद्धिताश्चाप्यपत्यार्थे पाण्डवाः श्रैधरस्तथा /
गार्ग्यो नाडायनात्रेयौ गाङ्गेयः पैतृष्वस्रीयः //
text_mt:
and the secondary derivative suffixes (taddhita) in the patronymic sense: pāṇḍavāḥ, śraidhara,
gārgya, nāḍāyana, ātreya, gāṅgeya, paitṛṣvasrīya;

sanskrit_iast:
devatārthe cedamarthe hyaidraṃ brāhmo havirbalī /
kriyāyujoḥ karmakartrordhairiyaḥ kauṅkumaṃ tathā //
meaning:
देवतार्थे चेदमर्थे ह्यैद्रं ब्राह्मो हविर्बली /
क्रियायुजोः कर्मकर्त्रोर्धैरियः कौङ्कुमं तथा //
text_mt:
in the sense of a deity or 'pertaining to this': aindra, brāhma, havis, balī;
of two joining in an action as agent and object: dhairya, and kauṅkuma;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavādyarthe tu kānīnaḥ kṣatriyo vaidikaḥ svakaḥ /
svārthe caurastu tulyārthe candravanmukhamīkṣate //
meaning:
भवाद्यर्थे तु कानीनः क्षत्रियो वैदिकः स्वकः /
स्वार्थे चौरस्तु तुल्यार्थे चन्द्रवन्मुखमीक्षते //
text_mt:
in the sense of 'born there' and so forth: kānīna, kṣatriya, vaidika, svaka;
in its own base meaning: caura; in the sense of comparison: 'he looks at the face like the moon' (candravat);

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇatvaṃ brāhmaṇatā bhāve brāhmaṇyameva ca /
gomāndhanī ca dhanavānastyarthe pramitau kiyān //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणत्वं ब्राह्मणता भावे ब्राह्मण्यमेव च /
गोमान्धनी च धनवानस्त्यर्थे प्रमितौ कियान् //
text_mt:
brāhmaṇatva, brāhmaṇatā, and brāhmaṇya in the abstract state;
gomān, dhanī, and dhanavān in the sense of possession; in measure: kiyān;

sanskrit_iast:
jātārthe tundilaḥ śraddhāluraunnattye tu danturaḥ /
sragvī tapasvī medhāvī māyāvyastyartha eva ca //
meaning:
जातार्थे तुन्दिलः श्रद्धालुरौन्नत्त्ये तु दन्तुरः /
स्रग्वी तपस्वी मेधावी मायाव्यस्त्यर्थ एव च //
text_mt:
tundila in the sense of born with, śraddhālu; in the sense of prominence: dantura;
sragvī, tapasvī, medhāvī, māyāvī, also in the sense of possession;

sanskrit_iast:
vācālaścaiva vācāṭo bahukutsitabhāṣiṇi /
īṣadaparisamāptau kalpavdeśīya eva ca //
meaning:
वाचालश्चैव वाचाटो बहुकुत्सितभाषिणि /
