ईषदपरिसमाप्तौ कल्पव्देशीय एव च //
text_mt:
vācāla and vācāṭa in the sense of talking much or contemptibly;
in the sense of slightly incomplete: the suffixes -kalpa and -deśīya;

sanskrit_iast:
kavikalpaḥ kavideśyaḥ prakāravacane tathā /
paṭujātīyaḥ kutsāyāṃ vaidyapāśaḥ praśaṃsane //
meaning:
कविकल्पः कविदेश्यः प्रकारवचने तथा /
पटुजातीयः कुत्सायां वैद्यपाशः प्रशंसने //
text_mt:
kavikalpa, kavideśya; so too in expressing type:
paṭujātīya; in contempt: vaidyapāśa; in praise: [vaidyarūpa];

sanskrit_iast:
vaidyarūpo bhūtapūrve mato dṛṣṭacaro mune /
prācuryādiṣvannamayo mṛṇmayaḥ srīmayastathā //
meaning:
वैद्यरूपो भूतपूर्वे मतो दृष्टचरो मुने /
प्राचुर्यादिष्वन्नमयो मृण्मयः स्रीमयस्तथा //
text_mt:
vaidyarūpa; in the sense of 'having been previously': dṛṣṭacara, O sage;
in the sense of abundance: annamaya, mṛṇmaya, and strīmaya;

sanskrit_iast:
jātārthe lajjito 'tyarthe śreyāñchreṣṭaśca nārada /
kṛṣṇataraḥ śuklatamaḥ kima ākhyānato 'vyayān //
meaning:
जातार्थे लज्जितो ऽत्यर्थे श्रेयाञ्छ्रेष्टश्च नारद /
कृष्णतरः शुक्लतमः किम आख्यानतो ऽव्ययान् //
text_mt:
lajjita in the sense of arisen; in the superlative degree: śreyān and śreṣṭha, O Nārada;
kṛṣṇatara, śuklatama; after 'kim', verbs, or indeclinables:

sanskrit_iast:
kintarāṃ caivātitarāmabhihyuccaistarāmapi /
parimāṇe jānudaghnaṃ jānudvayasamityapi //
meaning:
किन्तरां चैवातितरामभिह्युच्चैस्तरामपि /
परिमाणे जानुदघ्नं जानुद्वयसमित्यपि //
text_mt:
kintarām, and atitarām, abhihyuccaistarām;
in measure: jānudaghna, as well as jānudvayasam;

sanskrit_iast:
jānumātraṃ ca nirddhāre bahūnāṃ ca dvayoḥ kramāt /
katamaḥ kataraḥ saṃkhyeyaviśeṣāvadhāraṇe //
meaning:
जानुमात्रं च निर्द्धारे बहूनां च द्वयोः क्रमात् /
कतमः कतरः संख्येयविशेषावधारणे //
text_mt:
and jānumātra; in single selection among many or of two, respectively:
katama and katara; in specifying ordinal numbers:

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaśca tṛtīyaśca caturthaḥ ṣaṣṭapañcamau /
etādaśaḥ katipayaḥ katithaḥ kati nārada //
meaning:
द्वितीयश्च तृतीयश्च चतुर्थः षष्टपञ्चमौ /
एतादशः कतिपयः कतिथः कति नारद //
text_mt:
dvitīya, tṛtīya, caturtha, ṣaṣṭha, pañcama,
etādṛśa, katipaya, katitha, and kati, O Nārada;

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśaśca viṃśatitamastathā śatatamādayaḥ /
dvedhā dvaidhā dvidhā saṃkhyā prakāre 'tha munīśvara //
meaning:
विंशश्च विंशतितमस्तथा शततमादयः /
द्वेधा द्वैधा द्विधा संख्या प्रकारे ऽथ मुनीश्वर //
text_mt:
viṃśa and viṃśatitama, and likewise śatatamā and so forth;
dvedhā, dvaidhā, dvidhā in expressing the manner of numbers, O lord of sages;

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāvṛttau pañcakṛtvo dvisrirbahuśa ityapi /
dvitayaṃ tritapaṃ cāpi saṃkhyāyāṃ hi dvayaṃ trayam //
meaning:
क्रियावृत्तौ पञ्चकृत्वो द्विस्रिर्बहुश इत्यपि /
द्वितयं त्रितपं चापि संख्यायां हि द्वयं त्रयम् //
text_mt:
in repetition of an action: pañcakṛtvaḥ, dviḥ, triḥ, and bahuśaḥ;
dvitayam and tritayam, and of numerals, dvayam and trayam;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭīraśca śamīraśca śuṇḍāro 'lpārthake mataḥ /
traiṇaḥ pauṣṇastuṇḍibhaśca vṛndārakakṛṣīvalau //
meaning:
कुटीरश्च शमीरश्च शुण्डारो ऽल्पार्थके मतः /
त्रैणः पौष्णस्तुण्डिभश्च वृन्दारककृषीवलौ //
text_mt:
kuṭīra, śamīra, and śuṇḍāra are regarded in the diminutive sense;
traiṇa, pauṣṇa, tuṇḍibha, vṛndāraka, and kṛṣīvala;

sanskrit_iast:
malino vikaṭo gomī bhaurikīvidhamutkaṭam /
avaṭīṭovanāṭe nibiḍaṃ cekṣuśākinam //
meaning:
मलिनो विकटो गोमी भौरिकीविधमुत्कटम् /
अवटीटोवनाटे निबिडं चेक्षुशाकिनम् //
text_mt:
malina, vikaṭa, gomī, bhaurikividha, utkaṭa,
avaṭīṭa, vanāṭa, nibiḍa, and ikṣuśākina;

sanskrit_iast:
nibirīsameṣukārī vittovidyāñcaṇastathā /
vidyāthuñcurbahutithaṃ parvataḥ śṛṅgiṇastathā //
meaning:
निबिरीसमेषुकारी वित्तोविद्याञ्चणस्तथा /
विद्याथुञ्चुर्बहुतिथं पर्वतः शृङ्गिणस्तथा //
text_mt:
nibirīsa, meṣukārī, vitta, vidyācaṇa,
vidyāthuñcu, bahutitha, parvata, and śṛṅgī;

sanskrit_iast:
svāmī viṣamarūpyaṃ copatyakādhityakā tathā /
cillaśca cipiṭaṃ cikvaṃ vātūlaḥ kutapastathā //
meaning:
स्वामी विषमरूप्यं चोपत्यकाधित्यका तथा /
चिल्लश्च चिपिटं चिक्वं वातूलः कुतपस्तथा //
text_mt:
svāmī, viṣamarūpya, upatyakā, adhityakā,
cilla, cipiṭa, cikva, vātūla, kutapa;

sanskrit_iast:
vallaśva himeluśca kahoḍaścopaḍastataḥ /
ūrṇāyuśca marūtaścaikākī carmaṇvatī tathā //
meaning:
वल्लश्व हिमेलुश्च कहोडश्चोपडस्ततः /
ऊर्णायुश्च मरूतश्चैकाकी चर्मण्वती तथा //
text_mt:
valla, himelu, kahoḍa, upaḍa,
ūrṇāyu, maruta, ekākī, carmaṇvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
jyotsnā tamisrāṣṭīvacca kakṣīvardṣamaṇvatī /
āsaṃdī vañca cakrīvattūṣṇīkāṃ jalpatakyapi //
meaning:
ज्योत्स्ना तमिस्राष्टीवच्च कक्षीवर्द्षमण्वती /
आसंदी वञ्च चक्रीवत्तूष्णीकां जल्पतक्यपि //
text_mt:
jyotsnā, tamisrā, aṣṭīvat, kakṣīvat, carmaṇvatī,
āsandīvat, cakrīvat, tūṣṇīkā, jalpatakī;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃbhaśca kaṃyuḥ kaṃvaśca nāradaketiḥ kantuḥ kantakaṃpau śaṃvastathaiva ca /
śantaḥ śantiḥ śaṃyaśantau śaṃyohaṃyuḥ śubhaṃyuvat //
meaning:
कंभश्च कंयुः कंवश्च नारदकेतिः कन्तुः कन्तकंपौ शंवस्तथैव च /
शन्तः शन्तिः शंयशन्तौ शंयोहंयुः शुभंयुवत् //
text_mt:
kaṃbha, kaṃyu, kaṃva, O Nārada, keti, kantu, kantaka, kaṃpa, śaṃva,
śanta, śanti, śaṃya, śantu, śaṃyu, haṃyu, like śubhaṃyu;

sanskrit_iast: bhavati bagabhūva bhavitā bhaviṣyati bhavatvabhavadbhaghaveccāpi //
meaning: भवति बगभूव भविता भविष्यति भवत्वभवद्भघवेच्चापि //
text_mt: [The root bhū:] bhavati, babhūva, bhavitā, bhaviṣyati, bhavatu, abhavat, bhavet,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyādabhūdabhaviṣaayallādāvetāni rūpāṇi /
atti jaghāsāttātsyatyattvādadadyāddviraghasadātsyat //
meaning:
भूयादभूदभविषअयल्लादावेतानि रूपाणि /
अत्ति जघासात्तात्स्यत्यत्त्वाददद्याद्द्विरघसदात्स्यत् //
text_mt:
bhūyāt, abhūt, abhaviṣyat—these are the forms in the l-tenses [laṭ, etc.];
[The root ad:] atti, jaghāsa, attā, atsyati, attu, ādat, adyāt, aghasat, ātsyat;

sanskrit_iast:
juhito juhāva juhavāñcakāra hotā hoṣyati juhotu /
ajuhojjuhuyāddhūyādahauṣīdahoṣyaddīvyati /
dideva devitā deviṣyati ca adīvyaddīvyeddīvyādvai //
meaning:
जुहितो जुहाव जुहवाञ्चकार होता होष्यति जुहोतु /
अजुहोज्जुहुयाद्धूयादहौषीदहोष्यद्दीव्यति /
दिदेव देविता देविष्यति च अदीव्यद्दीव्येद्दीव्याद्वै //
text_mt:
[The root hu:] juhoti, juhāva, juhavāñcakāra, hotā, hoṣyati, juhotu,
ajuhot, juhuyāt, hūyāt, ahauṣīt, ahoṣyat; [The root div:] dīvyati,
dideva, devitā, deviṣyati, adīvyat, dīvyet, dīvyāt,

sanskrit_iast:
adevīdadevīṣyatsunoti suṣāva sotā soṣyati vai /
sunotvasunotsunuyātsūyādaśāvīdasoṣyuttudati ca //
meaning:
अदेवीददेवीष्यत्सुनोति सुषाव सोता सोष्यति वै /
सुनोत्वसुनोत्सुनुयात्सूयादशावीदसोष्युत्तुदति च //
text_mt:
adevīt, adevīṣyat; [The root su:] sunoti, suṣāva, sotā, soṣyati,
sunotu, asunot, sunuyāt, sūyāt, asāvīt, asoṣyat; and [the root tud:] tudati,

sanskrit_iast:
tutoda tottā totsyati tudatvatudattudettudyāddhi /
atautsīdatotsyaditi ca ruṇaddhi rūrodha roddhā rotsyati vai //
meaning:
तुतोद तोत्ता तोत्स्यति तुदत्वतुदत्तुदेत्तुद्याद्धि /
अतौत्सीदतोत्स्यदिति च रुणद्धि रूरोध रोद्धा रोत्स्यति वै //
text_mt:
tutoda, tottā, totsyati, tudatu, atudat, tudet, tudyāt,
atautsīt, atotsyat; and [the root rudh:] ruṇaddhi, rurodha, roddhā, rotsyati,

sanskrit_iast:
ruṇaddhu aruṇadrudhyādarautsīdārotsyañca /
tanoti tatāna tanitā taniṣyati tanotvatanottanuyāddhi //
meaning:
रुणद्धु अरुणद्रुध्यादरौत्सीदारोत्स्यञ्च /
तनोति ततान तनिता तनिष्यति तनोत्वतनोत्तनुयाद्धि //
text_mt:
ruṇaddhu, aruṇat, rundhyāt, arautsīt, arotsyat;
and [the root tan:] tanoti, tatāna, tanitā, taniṣyati, tanotu, atanot, tanuyāt,

sanskrit_iast:
atanīñcātānīdataniṣyatkrīṇāti cikrāya kretā kreṣyati krīṇātviti ca /
akrīṇātkrīṇātkrīṇīyātkrīyādakraiṣīdakreṣyañcorayati corayāmāsa corayitā corayiṣyati corayatu //
meaning:
अतनीञ्चातानीदतनिष्यत्क्रीणाति चिक्राय क्रेता क्रेष्यति क्रीणात्विति च /
अक्रीणात्क्रीणात्क्रीणीयात्क्रीयादक्रैषीदक्रेष्यञ्चोरयति चोरयामास चोरयिता चोरयिष्यति चोरयतु //
text_mt:
atanīt, atānīt, ataniṣyat; [The root krī:] krīṇāti, cikrāya, kretā, kreṣyati, krīṇātu,
akrīṇāt, krīṇīyāt, krīyāt, akraiṣīt, akreṣyat; [The root cur:] corayati, corayāmāsa, corayitā, corayiṣyati, corayatu,

sanskrit_iast:
acorayañcorayeccoryāt acūcuradacoriṣyadityevaṃ daśa vai gaṇāḥ /
prayojake bhāvayati sanīcchāyāṃ bubhūṣati /
kriyāsamabhihāre tu paṇḍito bobhūyate mune //
meaning:
अचोरयञ्चोरयेच्चोर्यात् अचूचुरदचोरिष्यदित्येवं दश वै गणाः /
प्रयोजके भावयति सनीच्छायां बुभूषति /
क्रियासमभिहारे तु पण्डितो बोभूयते मुने //

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yaṅluki bobhavīti ca paṭhyate /
putrīyatītyātmanīcchāyāṃ tathācāre 'pi nārada /
anudāttañito dhātoḥ kriyāvinimaye tathā //
meaning:
तथा यङ्लुकि बोभवीति च पठ्यते /
पुत्रीयतीत्यात्मनीच्छायां तथाचारे ऽपि नारद /
अनुदात्तञितो धातोः क्रियाविनिमये तथा //

sanskrit_iast:
niviśādestathā vipra vijānīhyātmanepadam /
parasmaipadamākhyātaṃ śeṣātkartāri śābdikaiḥ //
meaning:
निविशादेस्तथा विप्र विजानीह्यात्मनेपदम् /
परस्मैपदमाख्यातं शेषात्कर्तारि शाब्दिकैः //
text_mt:
and after ni, vi, etc., O brāhmaṇa, know that the Ātmanepada is used;
the Parasmaipada is stated by grammarians to occur in the active voice for the remaining roots;

sanskrit_iast:
ñitsvaritetaśca ubhe yakca syādbhāvakarmaṇoḥ /
saukaryātiśayaṃ caiva yadādyotayituṃ mune //
meaning:
ञित्स्वरितेतश्च उभे यक्च स्याद्भावकर्मणोः /
सौकर्यातिशयं चैव यदाद्योतयितुं मुने //
text_mt:
and from roots with an anudātta, ñ, or svarita indicator, both [padas occur]; and the yak-affix occurs in the passive and impersonal senses,
and when denoting exceptional ease [of accomplishment], O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
vivakṣyate na vyāpāro lakṣye kartustadāpare /
labhante kartṛte paśya pacyate hyodanaḥ svayam //
meaning:
विवक्ष्यते न व्यापारो लक्ष्ये कर्तुस्तदापरे /
लभन्ते कर्तृते पश्य पच्यते ह्योदनः स्वयम् //
text_mt: When the action of the agent is not intended to be expressed in the object, then other [factors] / obtain the nature of the agent; behold: “Indeed the rice cooks by itself.”

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu vāsiśchinattyevaṃ sthālī pacati vai mune /
dhātoḥ sakarmakādbhāve karmaṇyapi lapratyayāḥ //
meaning:
साधु वासिश्छिनत्त्येवं स्थाली पचति वै मुने /
धातोः सकर्मकाद्भावे कर्मण्यपि लप्रत्ययाः //
text_mt: “The axe cuts well”; likewise, O sage: “The pot cooks.” / From a transitive verbal root, the L-affixes are taught in the senses of verbal state and object;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai vākarmakādvipra bhāve kartari kīrtitaḥ /
phalavyāparayorekaniṣṭatāyāmakarmakaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मै वाकर्मकाद्विप्र भावे कर्तरि कीर्तितः /
फलव्यापरयोरेकनिष्टतायामकर्मकः //
text_mt: Or from an intransitive [root], O twice-born one, [an L-affix] is proclaimed in the senses of verbal state and agent. / When the fruit and the action reside in the same substrate, [the root] is intransitive;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātustayorddharmibhede sakarmaka udāhṛtaḥ /
gauṇe karmaṇi druhyādeḥ pradhāne nīhṛkṛṣvahām //
meaning:
धातुस्तयोर्द्धर्मिभेदे सकर्मक उदाहृतः /
गौणे कर्मणि द्रुह्यादेः प्रधाने नीहृकृष्वहाम् //
text_mt: When there is a distinction between the loci of those two, the root is called transitive. / In the secondary object of roots like druh- (to bear malice), and in the primary [object] of nī-, hṛ-, kṛṣ-, and vah-;

sanskrit_iast:
buddhibhakṣārthayoḥ śabdakarmakāṇāṃ nijecchayā /
prayojya karmaṇyanyeṣāṃ ṇyantānāṃ lādayo matāḥ //
meaning:
बुद्धिभक्षार्थयोः शब्दकर्मकाणां निजेच्छया /
प्रयोज्य कर्मण्यन्येषां ण्यन्तानां लादयो मताः //
text_mt: For verbs meaning to know or to eat, and for those having sound as their object, according to one's desire, / in the case of other [verbs] ending in ṇi (causatives), the L[-affixes] and others are held to occur with the prompted agent as object.

sanskrit_iast:
phalavyāpārayorddhāturāśraye tu tiṅaḥ smṛtāḥ /
phale pradhānaṃ vyāpārastirṅthastu viśeṣaṇam //
meaning:
फलव्यापारयोर्द्धातुराश्रये तु तिङः स्मृताः /
फले प्रधानं व्यापारस्तिर्ङ्थस्तु विशेषणम् //
text_mt: The verbal root denotes the fruit and the action; the tiṅ-affixes, however, denote their substrate. / With respect to the fruit, the action is primary, while the meaning of the tiṅ-affix is a qualifier.

sanskrit_iast:
edhitavyamedhanīyamiti kṛtye nidarśanam /
bhāve karmaṇi kṛtyāḥ syuḥ kṛtaḥ kartari kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
एधितव्यमेधनीयमिति कृत्ये निदर्शनम् /
भावे कर्मणि कृत्याः स्युः कृतः कर्तरि कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: “Edhitavyam” (to be increased), “edhanīyam” (to be increased) are illustrations in the case of a kṛtya-affix; / kṛtya-affixes occur in the senses of verbal state and object, while kṛt-affixes are declared in the sense of the agent.

sanskrit_iast:
kartā kāraka ityādyā bhūte bhūtādi kīrtitam /
gamyādigamye nirdiṣṭaṃ śeṣamadyatane matam //
meaning:
कर्ता कारक इत्याद्या भूते भूतादि कीर्तितम् /
गम्यादिगम्ये निर्दिष्टं शेषमद्यतने मतम् //
text_mt: “Kartā” (agent), “kāraka” (maker), and so forth [are examples]. In the past tense, bhūta- and others are taught; / gamya- and others are prescribed for the future (gamya), and the rest is taught for the proximate past (adyatana).

sanskrit_iast:
adhisrītyavyayībhāve yathāśakti ca kīrtitam /
rāmāśritastatpuruṣe dhānyārtho yūpadāru ca //
meaning:
अधिस्रीत्यव्ययीभावे यथाशक्ति च कीर्तितम् /
रामाश्रितस्तत्पुरुषे धान्यार्थो यूपदारु च //
text_mt: “Adhistri” (concerning women) and “yathāśakti” (according to ability) are cited in an avyayībhāva compound; / “rāmāśritaḥ” (resorting to Rāma), “dhānyārthaḥ” (wealth acquired by grain), and “yūpadāru” (wood for the sacrificial post) are in a tatpuruṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrabhī rājapuruṣo 'kṣaśaiṇḍo dvigurucyate /
pañcagavaṃ daśagrāmī triphaleti tu rūḍhitaḥ //
meaning:
व्याघ्रभी राजपुरुषो ऽक्षशैण्डो द्विगुरुच्यते /
पञ्चगवं दशग्रामी त्रिफलेति तु रूढितः //
text_mt: “Vyāghrabhīḥ” (fear of a tiger), “rājapuruṣaḥ” (the king's man), “akṣaśauṇḍaḥ” (skilled at dice) [are also tatpuruṣas]. A dvigu is declared / conventionally in “pañcagavam” (a collection of five cows), “daśagrāmī” (a collection of ten villages), and “triphalā” (three fruits);

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalaṃ mahāṣaṣṭī tulyārthe karmadhārayaḥ /
abrāhmaṇo na ñi proktaḥ kuṃbhakārādikaḥ kṛtā //
meaning:
नीलोत्पलं महाषष्टी तुल्यार्थे कर्मधारयः /
अब्राह्मणो न ञि प्रोक्तः कुंभकारादिकः कृता //
text_mt: “Nīlotpalam” (blue lotus) and “mahāṣaṣṭī” (great sixth day) are karmadhārayas in the sense of apposition; / “abrāhmaṇaḥ” (non-Brahmin) is stated with the negative particle nañ; “kumbhakāraḥ” (pot-maker) and the like are formed by a kṛt-affix.

sanskrit_iast:
anyārthe tu bahuvrīhau grāmaḥ prāptodako dvija /
pañcagū rūpavadbhāryo madhyāhnaḥ sasutādikaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यार्थे तु बहुव्रीहौ ग्रामः प्राप्तोदको द्विज /
पञ्चगू रूपवद्भार्यो मध्याह्नः ससुतादिकः //
text_mt: In a bahuvrīhi denoting another sense, O twice-born one: “prāptodako grāmaḥ” (a village to which water has come), / “pañcaguḥ” (one who has five cows), “rūpavadbhāryaḥ” (one whose wife is beautiful), “madhyāhnaḥ” (midday), “sasutaḥ” (accompanied by a son), and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
samuccaye guruṃ ceśaṃ bhajasvānvācaye tvaṭa // ca dvayoḥ kramāt /
bhikṣāmānaya gāṃ cāpi vākyamevānayorbhavet //
meaning:
समुच्चये गुरुं चेशं भजस्वान्वाचये त्वट // च द्वयोः क्रमात् /
भिक्षामानय गां चापि वाक्यमेवानयोर्भवेत् //
text_mt: In conjunction: “Worship the guru and God”; in secondary connection: “Worship, and wander!” [using “ca”] in the two respectively; / “Bring alms, and the cow as well”—this very sentence illustrates both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
itaretarayoge tu rāmakṛṣṇau samāhṛtau /
rāmakṛṣṇaṃ dvija dvai dvai brahma caikamupāsyate //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde vyākaraṇanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इतरेतरयोगे तु रामकृष्णौ समाहृतौ /
रामकृष्णं द्विज द्वै द्वै ब्रह्म चैकमुपास्यते //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे व्याकरणनिरूपणं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
In mutual association: “Rāmakṛṣṇau” (Rāma and Kṛṣṇa); in collective aggregation: / “Rāmakṛṣṇam”, O twice-born one. The two are distinct, yet one Brahman is worshipped.

Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, titled “Exposition of Grammar”, in the second quarter of the Bṛhadupākhyāna, in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
niruktaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vedaṃ śrotrāṅgamuttamam /
tatpañcavidhamākhyātaṃ vaidikaṃ dhāturūpakam //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
निरुक्तं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि वेदं श्रोत्राङ्गमुत्तमम् /
तत्पञ्चविधमाख्यातं वैदिकं धातुरूपकम् //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / I shall declare to you the Nirukta, the excellent ear-limb of the Veda; / that Vedic [science], consisting of verbal forms, is declared to be of five kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidūrṇāgamastatra kvacidvarṇaviparyayaḥ /
vikāraḥ kvāpi varṇānāṃ varṇanāśaḥ kvacinmataḥ //
meaning:
क्वचिदूर्णागमस्तत्र क्वचिद्वर्णविपर्ययः /
विकारः क्वापि वर्णानां वर्णनाशः क्वचिन्मतः //
text_mt: In some cases there is the addition of a letter; in some, the transposition of letters; / in some, the modification of letters; and in some, the elision of a letter is accepted;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vikāranāśābhyāṃ varṇānāṃ yatra nārada /
dhātoryogātiśayī ca saṃyogaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
तथा विकारनाशाभ्यां वर्णानां यत्र नारद /
धातोर्योगातिशयी च संयोगः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: Likewise where, through modification and loss of letters, O Nārada, / there is an intensive connection of the root, that is proclaimed as the fifth combination.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhedvarṇāgamāddhaṃsaḥ siṃho varṇaviparyayāt /
gūḍhotmā varṇavikṛtervarṇanāṃśātpṛṣodaraḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धेद्वर्णागमाद्धंसः सिंहो वर्णविपर्ययात् /
गूढोत्मा वर्णविकृतेर्वर्णनांशात्पृषोदरः //
text_mt: From the addition of a letter “haṃsaḥ” (swan) is derived; “siṃhaḥ” (lion) from the transposition of letters; / “gūḍhotmā” from the modification of letters; “pṛṣodaraḥ” from the loss of a letter.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramarāduṣu śabdeṣu jñeyo yogo hi pañcamaḥ /
bahulaṃ chandasītyuktamatra vācyaṃ punarvasū //
meaning:
भ्रमरादुषु शब्देषु ज्ञेयो योगो हि पञ्चमः /
बहुलं छन्दसीत्युक्तमत्र वाच्यं पुनर्वसू //
text_mt: In words such as “bhramara” (bee) the fifth combination is to be known. / It is stated that “diversely [it occurs] in the Veda”; here must be stated the dual form “Punarvasū”;

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasvadvṛṣaṇaścaivāparasmaipadi cāpi hi /
paraṃ vyavahitāścāpi gatisaṃjñāstathā hi ā //
meaning:
नभस्वद्वृषणश्चैवापरस्मैपदि चापि हि /
परं व्यवहिताश्चापि गतिसंज्ञास्तथा हि आ //
text_mt: “Nabhasvat” (wind) and “vṛṣaṇaḥ”, and even where an Ātmanepada is used instead of a Parasmaipada; / separated by intervening elements, and having the designation gati, as in “ā”;

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktīnāṃ viparyāso yathā dadhanā juhoti hi /
abhyutsādayāmaketurdhvanayītpramukhāstathā /
niṣṭarkyāndyāstathoktāśca gṛbhāyetyādikāstathā //
meaning:
विभक्तीनां विपर्यासो यथा दधना जुहोति हि /
अभ्युत्सादयामकेतुर्ध्वनयीत्प्रमुखास्तथा /
निष्टर्क्यान्द्यास्तथोक्ताश्च गृभायेत्यादिकास्तथा //
text_mt: The transposition of case-terminations, as in “dadhanā juhoti”; / forms beginning with “abhyutsādayāmaketuḥ”, “dhvanayīt”, / “niṣṭarkya”, and the like, as well as “gṛbhāya” and so forth;

sanskrit_iast:
suptiṅupagrahaliṅganarāṇāṃ kālahalūcūsvarakartṛyaḍāṃ ca /
vyatyayamicchati śāsrakṛdeṣāṃ so 'pi ca siddhyati bāhulakena //
meaning:
सुप्तिङुपग्रहलिङ्गनराणां कालहलूचूस्वरकर्तृयडां च /
व्यत्ययमिच्छति शास्रकृदेषां सो ऽपि च सिद्ध्यति बाहुलकेन //
text_mt: Of sup-affixes, tiṅ-affixes, voice, gender, person, tense, consonants, vowels, accents, agents, and y-augment / the author of the treatise accepts interchange; and that too is established by diversity (bāhulaka).

sanskrit_iast: rātrī vimbī ca kadrūścāviṣṭvau vājasaneyinaḥ //
meaning: रात्री विम्बी च कद्रूश्चाविष्ट्वौ वाजसनेयिनः //
text_mt: “Rātrī”, “bimbī”, “kadrūḥ”, and “aviṣṭvau” among the Vājasaneyins;

sanskrit_iast:
karṇebhiśca yaśobhāgya ityādyāścaturakṣaram /
devāso 'tho sarvadevatātitvāvata ityapi //
meaning:
कर्णेभिश्च यशोभाग्य इत्याद्याश्चतुरक्षरम् /
देवासो ऽथो सर्वदेवतातित्वावत इत्यपि //
text_mt: “Karṇebhiḥ”, “yaśobhāgya”, and four-syllabled forms of that kind; / “devāsaḥ”, and then “sarvadevatāt”, “itvāvataḥ” as well;

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayāvina mādyāśca pralayādyāśca stṛcaṃ tathā /
apaspṛdhethāṃ no avyādāyo asmānmukhāstathā //
meaning:
उभयाविन माद्याश्च प्रलयाद्याश्च स्तृचं तथा /
अपस्पृधेथां नो अव्यादायो अस्मान्मुखास्तथा //
text_mt: Forms such as “ubhayāvin”, “pralaya”, and “stṛcam”; / “apaspṛdhethām”, “no avyāt”, and those beginning with “āyo asmān”;

sanskrit_iast:
sagarbhyosthāpadī ṛtvyorajiṣṭaṃ tripañcakam /
hiraṇyayena naraṃ ca parame vyomanityapi //
meaning:
सगर्भ्योस्थापदी ऋत्व्योरजिष्टं त्रिपञ्चकम् /
हिरण्ययेन नरं च परमे व्योमनित्यपि //
text_mt: “Sagarbhyaḥ”, “sthāpadī”, “ṛtvyā”, “ajiṣṭam”, the group of fifteen; / “hiraṇyayena”, “naram”, and “parame vyoman” as well;

sanskrit_iast:
urviyā svaprayā vāravadhvādaduhavaivadhī /
yajadhvainamemasi ca snātvī gatvā pacāsthabhauḥ //
meaning:
उर्विया स्वप्रया वारवध्वाददुहवैवधी /
यजध्वैनमेमसि च स्नात्वी गत्वा पचास्थभौः //
text_mt: “Urviyā”, “svaprayā”, “vāravadhvā”, “aduhava”, “evadhī”, / “yajadhvainam”, “emasi”, “snātvī”, “gatvā”, “pacāsthabhauḥ”;

sanskrit_iast:
gonāñcāparihravṛttāścāturirgrasitādikā /
paśyedadhadbrabhūthāpi pramiṇāntityavīvṛdhat //
meaning:
गोनाञ्चापरिह्रवृत्ताश्चातुरिर्ग्रसितादिका /
पश्येदधद्ब्रभूथापि प्रमिणान्तित्यवीवृधत् //
text_mt: “Gonām”, “aparihvṛtāḥ”, “cāturiḥ”, forms beginning with “grasita”, / “paśyet”, “adhadbrap”, “bhūtha”, “pramiṇanti”, and “yavīvṛdhat”;

sanskrit_iast:
mitrayuśca durasvā vā hātvā sudhitamityapi /
dadhartyādyā svavadbhiśca sasūveti ca dhiṣva ca //
meaning:
मित्रयुश्च दुरस्वा वा हात्वा सुधितमित्यपि /
दधर्त्याद्या स्ववद्भिश्च ससूवेति च धिष्व च //
text_mt: “Mitrayuḥ”, “durasvā”, “hātvā”, and “sudhitam”; / roots beginning with “dadharti”, “svavadbhiḥ”, “sasūva”, and “dhiṣva”;

sanskrit_iast:
praprāyaṃ ca harivatekṣaṇvataḥ suparthitaraḥ /
rathītarī nasatādyā amnarbhuvaratho iti //
meaning:
प्रप्रायं च हरिवतेक्षण्वतः सुपर्थितरः /
रथीतरी नसताद्या अम्नर्भुवरथो इति //
text_mt: “Praprāyam”, “harivate”, “akṣaṇvataḥ”, “suparthitaraḥ”, / “rathītarī”, forms beginning with “nasat”, “amnar”, “bhuvar”, and “atho”;

sanskrit_iast:
brūhyādyādeḥ parasyāpyau śrāvayetyādike plutaḥ /
dāśvāṃśva svatavānyāpautribhiṣṭvaṃ ca nṛbhiṣṭutaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रूह्याद्यादेः परस्याप्यौ श्रावयेत्यादिके प्लुतः /
दाश्वांश्व स्वतवान्यापौत्रिभिष्ट्वं च नृभिष्टुतः //
text_mt: A prolated vowel after verbal forms beginning with “brūhi”, or in “śrāvaya” and the like; / “dāśvāṃsaḥ”, “svatavān”, “yāpau”, “tribhiṣṭvam”, and “nṛbhiṣṭutaḥ”;

sanskrit_iast:
abhīṣuṇa ṛtāvāhaṃ nyaṣīdannṛmaṇā api /
caturvidhādbāhulakātpravṛtterapravṛttitaḥ //
meaning:
अभीषुण ऋतावाहं न्यषीदन्नृमणा अपि /
चतुर्विधाद्बाहुलकात्प्रवृत्तेरप्रवृत्तितः //
text_mt: “Abhīṣuṇaḥ”, “ṛtāvāham”, “nyaṣīdan”, and “nṛmaṇāḥ”. / From the fourfold diversity—application, non-application,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāṣayānyathābhāvātsarvaṃ siddhyeñca vaidikam /
bhūvādyā dhātavo jñeyāḥ parasmaipadinaḥsmṛtāḥ //
meaning:
विभाषयान्यथाभावात्सर्वं सिद्ध्येञ्च वैदिकम् /
भूवाद्या धातवो ज्ञेयाः परस्मैपदिनःस्मृताः //
text_mt: optional application, and variation—everything Vedic is established. / The roots beginning with bhū are to be known as taking Parasmaipada terminations;

sanskrit_iast:
edhādyā ātmanebhāṣā udāttāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśasaṃkhyakāḥ /
atādayo 'ṣṭatriṃśañca parasmaipadino mune //
meaning:
एधाद्या आत्मनेभाषा उदात्ताः षट्त्रिंशसंख्यकाः /
अतादयो ऽष्टत्रिंशञ्च परस्मैपदिनो मुने //
text_mt: Those beginning with edh- take Ātmanepada, have an acute accent, and number thirty-six; / those beginning with at- number thirty-eight and take Parasmaipada, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
lokṛpūrvā dvicatvāriṃśaduktā ca hyātmane pade /
udāttetaratu pañcāśatphakkādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
लोकृपूर्वा द्विचत्वारिंशदुक्ता च ह्यात्मने पदे /
उदात्तेतरतु पञ्चाशत्फक्काद्याः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Those beginning with lokṛ- are stated to be forty-two in Ātmanepada; / those having an accent other than the acute, beginning with phakk-, are declared to be fifty;

sanskrit_iast:
varcādyā anudātteta ekaviṃśatirīrītāḥ /
gupādayo dvicatvāriṃśadudāttetāḥ samīritāḥ //
meaning:
वर्चाद्या अनुदात्तेत एकविंशतिरीरीताः /
गुपादयो द्विचत्वारिंशदुदात्तेताः समीरिताः //
text_mt: Those beginning with varc- have a grave accent and are stated to be twenty-one; / those beginning with gup- are stated to be forty-two with an acute accent;

sanskrit_iast:
dhiṇyādayo 'nudātteto daśa proktā hi śābdikaiḥ /
aṇādayopyudāttetaḥ saptaviṃśatidhātavaḥ //
meaning:
धिण्यादयो ऽनुदात्तेतो दश प्रोक्ता हि शाब्दिकैः /
अणादयोप्युदात्तेतः सप्तविंशतिधातवः //
text_mt: Those beginning with dhiṇy- have a grave accent and are said by grammarians to be ten; / those roots beginning with aṇ- have an acute accent and are twenty-seven;

sanskrit_iast:
amādayaḥ samuddiṣṭāścatursriṃśaddhiśābdikaiḥ /
dvisaptatimitā mavyamukhāścodāttabandhanā //
meaning:
अमादयः समुद्दिष्टाश्चतुर्स्रिंशद्धिशाब्दिकैः /
द्विसप्ततिमिता मव्यमुखाश्चोदात्तबन्धना //
text_mt: Those beginning with am- are taught by grammarians to be thirty-four; / those beginning with mavy- are seventy-two in number and bound to the acute accent;

sanskrit_iast:
svāriteddhāvudhātustu eka eva prakīrtitaḥ /
kṣudhādayo 'nudātteto dviṣapañcāśadudāhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्वारितेद्धावुधातुस्तु एक एव प्रकीर्तितः /
क्षुधादयो ऽनुदात्तेतो द्विषपञ्चाशदुदाहृताः //
text_mt: The root [dhāv-] having a circumflex accent is proclaimed to be only one; / those beginning with kṣudh- having a grave accent are mentioned as fifty-six;

sanskrit_iast:
ghuṣirādyā udāttato 'ṣṭāśītirdhātavo matāḥ /
dyutādyā anudātteto dvāviṃśatirato matāḥ //
meaning:
घुषिराद्या उदात्ततो ऽष्टाशीतिर्धातवो मताः /
द्युताद्या अनुदात्तेतो द्वाविंशतिरतो मताः //
text_mt: The roots beginning with ghuṣir- having an acute accent are held to be eighty-eight; / those beginning with dyut- having a grave accent are held thereafter to be twenty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣitasrayodaśa ghaṭādiṣvenudatteta īritaḥ /
tato jvaladudātteto dvipañcāśanmitāstathā //
meaning:
षितस्रयोदश घटादिष्वेनुदत्तेत ईरितः /
ततो ज्वलदुदात्तेतो द्विपञ्चाशन्मितास्तथा //
text_mt: Thirteen [roots] with an indicated ṣ are declared among those beginning with ghaṭ with an indicated anudātta; / then those beginning with jval with an indicated udātta are likewise measured at fifty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritedrājṛsaṃprokta stanahebhrājṛtasrayaḥ /
anudātteta akhyātā bhādyutāttā itaḥ syamāt //
meaning:
स्वरितेद्राजृसंप्रोक्त स्तनहेभ्राजृतस्रयः /
अनुदात्तेत अख्याता भाद्युतात्ता इतः स्यमात् //
text_mt: Rājṛ is said to have an indicated svarita; three [roots], beginning with staneh and bhrājṛ, / are declared to have an indicated anudātta, from bhādyut down to syam.

sanskrit_iast:
saho 'nudāttedekastu ramaiko 'pyātmanaipadī /
sadasraya udāttetaḥ kucādvedā udātta it //
meaning:
सहो ऽनुदात्तेदेकस्तु रमैको ऽप्यात्मनैपदी /
सदस्रय उदात्तेतः कुचाद्वेदा उदात्त इत् //
text_mt: Sah is the one with an indicated anudātta, and ram is the one taking the Ātmanepada endings; / three [roots] beginning with sad have an indicated udātta; four from kuc have an indicated udātta.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritetaḥ pañcatriṃśaddhikkādyāśca tataḥ param /
svaritecchiñbhṛñādyāścatvāra svaritettataḥ //
meaning:
स्वरितेतः पञ्चत्रिंशद्धिक्काद्याश्च ततः परम् /
स्वरितेच्छिञ्भृञाद्याश्चत्वार स्वरितेत्ततः //
text_mt: There are thirty-five with an indicated svarita; and after that those beginning with dhikk; / chiñ, bhṛñ and others with an indicated svarita are four; then with an indicated svarita:

sanskrit_iast:
dheṭaḥ parasmaipadinaḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadudīritāḥ /
aṣṭādaśasmiṅādyāstu āmanepadino matāḥ //
meaning:
धेटः परस्मैपदिनः षट्चत्वारिंशदुदीरिताः /
अष्टादशस्मिङाद्यास्तु आमनेपदिनो मताः //
text_mt: Forty-six taking the Parasmaipada endings are stated from dheṭ; / eighteen beginning with smiṅ are considered to take the Ātmanepada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasrayo 'nudāttetaḥ pūṅādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
hṛparasmaipadī cātmanebhāṣāstu gupātrayaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्रयो ऽनुदात्तेतः पूङाद्याः परिकीर्तिताः /
हृपरस्मैपदी चात्मनेभाषास्तु गुपात्रयः //
text_mt: Then three beginning with pūṅ are proclaimed to have an indicated anudātta; / hṛ takes the Parasmaipada endings, whereas the three roots from gup are Ātmanepada.

sanskrit_iast:
rabhadyabdayanudātteto ñikṣvidotātta inmataḥ /
parasmaipadinaḥ pañca daśa skaṃmbhvādayastathā //
meaning:
रभद्यब्दयनुदात्तेतो ञिक्ष्विदोतात्त इन्मतः /
परस्मैपदिनः पञ्च दश स्कंम्भ्वादयस्तथा //
text_mt: Rabh and labh have an indicated anudātta, and ñikṣvid is considered to have an indicated udātta; / fifteen beginning with skambh take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
kitadhāturudātteñca dānaśānobhayātmakau /
svaritetaḥ pacādyaṅkāḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ //
meaning:
कितधातुरुदात्तेञ्च दानशानोभयात्मकौ /
स्वरितेतः पचाद्यङ्काः परस्मैपदिनो मताः //
text_mt: The root kit has an indicated udātta, and dān and śān take both sets of endings; / nine roots beginning with pac have an indicated svarita, regarded as Parasmaipada.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritetastrayaścaitau vadavacī paribhāṣiṇau /
bhvādyā ete ṣaḍadhikaṃ sahasraṃ dhātavo matāḥ //
meaning:
स्वरितेतस्त्रयश्चैतौ वदवची परिभाषिणौ /
भ्वाद्या एते षडधिकं सहस्रं धातवो मताः //
text_mt: Three roots have an indicated svarita, and these two, vad and vac, speak [Parasmaipada]; / these roots of the first class beginning with bhū are reckoned as one thousand and six.

sanskrit_iast:
parasmaipadinaḥ proktā vadāścāpi haneti ca /
svariteto dviṣādyāstu catvāro dhātavo matāḥ //
meaning:
परस्मैपदिनः प्रोक्ता वदाश्चापि हनेति च /
स्वरितेतो द्विषाद्यास्तु चत्वारो धातवो मताः //
text_mt: Vad and also han are declared to take the Parasmaipada endings; / four roots beginning with dviṣ are considered to have an indicated svarita.

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣiṅekaḥ samākhyāto dhāturatrātmanepadī /
irādayo 'nudātteto dhātavastu trayodaśa //
meaning:
चक्षिङेकः समाख्यातो धातुरत्रात्मनेपदी /
इरादयो ऽनुदात्तेतो धातवस्तु त्रयोदश //
text_mt: Cakṣiṅ is declared to be the single root here taking the Ātmanepada endings; / thirteen roots beginning with i have an indicated anudātta.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanepadinau proktau ṣūṅśīṅdvau śābdikairmune /
parasmaipadinaḥ proktā ṣumukhāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनेपदिनौ प्रोक्तौ षूङ्शीङ्द्वौ शाब्दिकैर्मुने /
परस्मैपदिनः प्रोक्ता षुमुखाः सप्त धातवः //
text_mt: The two roots ṣūṅ and śīṅ are proclaimed by grammarians to take the Ātmanepada endings, O sage; / seven roots beginning with ṣu are declared to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritedurṇuñākhyāto dhātureko munīśvara /
ghumukhāstraya uddiṣṭāḥ parasmaipadinastathā //
meaning:
स्वरितेदुर्णुञाख्यातो धातुरेको मुनीश्वर /
घुमुखास्त्रय उद्दिष्टाः परस्मैपदिनस्तथा //
text_mt: Urṇuñ is declared to be a single root with an indicated svarita, O lord of sages; / three roots beginning with ghu are likewise indicated as Parasmaipada.

sanskrit_iast: ṣṭuñekastu samā khyātaḥ smṛte nārada śābdikaiḥ //
meaning: ष्टुञेकस्तु समा ख्यातः स्मृते नारद शाब्दिकैः //
text_mt: And ṣṭuñ is traditionally declared to be single, O Nārada, by grammarians.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśa rāprabhṛtayaḥ parasmaipadinaḥ smṛtāḥ /
iṅṅātmanepadī prokto dhāturnārada kevalaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टादश राप्रभृतयः परस्मैपदिनः स्मृताः /
इङ्ङात्मनेपदी प्रोक्तो धातुर्नारद केवलः //
text_mt: Eighteen roots beginning with rā are remembered as taking the Parasmaipada endings; / the root iṅ alone, O Nārada, is declared to take the Ātmanepada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
vidāda yastu catvāraḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ /
ñiṣvapśaye samuddiṣṭaḥ parasmaipadikastathā //
meaning:
विदाद यस्तु चत्वारः परस्मैपदिनो मताः /
ञिष्वप्शये समुद्दिष्टः परस्मैपदिकस्तथा //
text_mt: Four roots beginning with vid are considered to take the Parasmaipada endings; / ñiṣvap is indicated in lying down, and likewise as taking the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
parasmaipadinaścaiva te mayoktāḥ syamādayaḥ /
dīdhīṅveṅsmṛtau dhātū ātmanepadinau mune //
meaning:
परस्मैपदिनश्चैव ते मयोक्ताः स्यमादयः /
दीधीङ्वेङ्स्मृतौ धातू आत्मनेपदिनौ मुने //
text_mt: And those beginning with syam have been spoken of by me as taking the Parasmaipada endings; / dīdhīṅ and veṅ are remembered, O sage, as two roots taking the Ātmanepada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
prathādayasrayaścāpi udāttetaḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
carkarītaṃ ca hnuṅ prokto 'nudāttenmunisattama //
meaning:
प्रथादयस्रयश्चापि उदात्तेतः प्रकीर्तिताः /
चर्करीतं च ह्नुङ् प्रोक्तो ऽनुदात्तेन्मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: And three roots beginning with prath are proclaimed to have an indicated udātta; / and intensive [forms] and hnuṅ are declared to have an indicated anudātta, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
trisaptati samākhyātā dhātavo 'dādike gaṇe /
dādayo dhātavo vedāḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ //
meaning:
त्रिसप्तति समाख्याता धातवो ऽदादिके गणे /
दादयो धातवो वेदाः परस्मैपदिनो मताः //
text_mt: Seventy-three roots are enumerated in the class beginning with ad; / four roots beginning with dā are considered to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritedvai bhṛñākhyāta udātteddhāk prakīrtitaḥ /
māṅhāṅdvāvanudāttetau svariteddānadhātuṣu //
meaning:
स्वरितेद्वै भृञाख्यात उदात्तेद्धाक् प्रकीर्तितः /
माङ्हाङ्द्वावनुदात्तेतौ स्वरितेद्दानधातुषु //
text_mt: Bhṛñ indeed is declared to have an indicated svarita, and hāk is proclaimed to have an indicated udātta; / māṅ and hāṅ are two roots with an indicated anudātta, and among roots of giving, [dā] has an indicated svarita.

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇitirādyāsrayaśvāpi svariteta udāhṛtāḥ /
ghṛmukhā dvādaśa tathā parasmaipatino matāḥ //
meaning:
वाणितिराद्यास्रयश्वापि स्वरितेत उदाहृताः /
घृमुखा द्वादश तथा परस्मैपतिनो मताः //
text_mt: And three roots beginning with vāṇiti are cited as having an indicated svarita; / likewise twelve roots beginning with ghṛ are considered to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāviṃśatirihoddiṣṭā dhātavo hvādike gaṇe /
parasmaipadinaḥ proktā divādyāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ //
meaning:
द्वाविंशतिरिहोद्दिष्टा धातवो ह्वादिके गणे /
परस्मैपदिनः प्रोक्ता दिवाद्याः पञ्चविंशतिः //
text_mt: Twenty-two roots are indicated here in the class beginning with hu; / twenty-five beginning with div are declared to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanepadinau dhātū ṣūṅdūṅdvāvapi nārada /
oditaḥ pūṅmukhāḥ sapta ātmanedapino matāḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनेपदिनौ धातू षूङ्दूङ्द्वावपि नारद /
ओदितः पूङ्मुखाः सप्त आत्मनेदपिनो मताः //
text_mt: Both roots, ṣūṅ and dūṅ, take the Ātmanepada endings, O Nārada; / seven beginning with pūṅ, having an indicated o, are considered to take the Ātmanepada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanepadino vipra dīṅmukhāstviha kīrtitāḥ /
syatiprabhṛtayo vedāḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनेपदिनो विप्र दीङ्मुखास्त्विह कीर्तिताः /
स्यतिप्रभृतयो वेदाः परस्मैपदिनो मताः //
text_mt: Those beginning with dīṅ are proclaimed here as taking the Ātmanepada endings, O brāhmaṇa; / four roots beginning with syati are considered to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
janyādayaḥ pañcadaśa ātmanepadino mune /
mṛṣādyāḥ svaritetastu dhātavaḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
जन्यादयः पञ्चदश आत्मनेपदिनो मुने /
मृषाद्याः स्वरितेतस्तु धातवः पञ्च कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Fifteen roots beginning with jan take the Ātmanepada endings, O sage; / five roots beginning with mṛṣ are proclaimed to have an indicated svarita.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśa padādyāstu hyātmanepadino matāḥ /
rādhoḥ karmaka evātra vṛddhau svādicurādike //
meaning:
एकादश पदाद्यास्तु ह्यात्मनेपदिनो मताः /
राधोः कर्मक एवात्र वृद्धौ स्वादिचुरादिके //
text_mt: Eleven roots beginning with pad are considered to take the Ātmanepada endings; / here rādh is exclusively intransitive in the sense of growth in the class beginning with svā and cur.

sanskrit_iast:
udāttetastudādyāstu trayodaśa samīritāḥ /
parasmaipadino 'ṣṭātra radhādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
उदात्तेतस्तुदाद्यास्तु त्रयोदश समीरिताः /
परस्मैपदिनो ऽष्टात्र रधाद्याः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Thirteen roots beginning with tud are declared to have an indicated udātta; / eight roots beginning with radh are proclaimed here to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
samādyāścāpyudāttetaḥ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadudīritāḥ /
catvāriśacchataṃ cāpi divādau dhātavo matāḥ //
meaning:
समाद्याश्चाप्युदात्तेतः षट्चत्वारिंशदुदीरिताः /
चत्वारिशच्छतं चापि दिवादौ धातवो मताः //
text_mt: And forty-six roots beginning with śam are declared to have an indicated udātta; / and one hundred and forty roots are considered to be in the class beginning with div.

sanskrit_iast:
svādayaḥ svaritettoṅkā dhātavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
saptākhyāto dunotistu parasmaipadino mune //
meaning:
स्वादयः स्वरितेत्तोङ्का धातवः परिकीर्तिताः /
सप्ताख्यातो दुनोतिस्तु परस्मैपदिनो मुने //
text_mt: Roots beginning with su are proclaimed to have an indicated svarita, marked by an indicated o; / the root duno is declared to be of seven [verbs] taking the Parasmaipada endings, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭighāvanudāttetau dhātū dvau parikīrtitau /
parasmaipadinastvatra tikādyāstu caturdaśa //
meaning:
अष्टिघावनुदात्तेतौ धातू द्वौ परिकीर्तितौ /
परस्मैपदिनस्त्वत्र तिकाद्यास्तु चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Aṣ and tiṅ are proclaimed as two roots with an indicated anudātta; / but here fourteen roots beginning with tik take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśaddhātavaḥ proktā viprendra svādike gaṇe /
svaritetaḥ ṣaṅākhyātāstudādyā munisattama //
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशद्धातवः प्रोक्ता विप्रेन्द्र स्वादिके गणे /
स्वरितेतः षङाख्यातास्तुदाद्या मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: Thirty-two roots are declared in the class beginning with su, O lord of brāhmaṇas; / those beginning with tud are declared to have an indicated svarita, having an indicated ṣa, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyudāttejjuṣīpūrvā atmanepadinorṇavāḥ /
vraścādaya udāttetaḥ proktāḥ pañcādhikaṃ śatam //
meaning:
ऋष्युदात्तेज्जुषीपूर्वा अत्मनेपदिनोर्णवाः /
व्रश्चादय उदात्तेतः प्रोक्ताः पञ्चाधिकं शतम् //
text_mt: Ṛṣ has an indicated udātta; four beginning with juṣ take the Ātmanepada endings; / those beginning with vraśc have an indicated udātta and are declared to be one hundred and five.

sanskrit_iast:
gūryudāttedihoddiṣṭo dhātureko munīśvara /
ṇūmukhāścaiva catvāraḥ parasmaipadino matāḥ //
meaning:
गूर्युदात्तेदिहोद्दिष्टो धातुरेको मुनीश्वर /
णूमुखाश्चैव चत्वारः परस्मैपदिनो मताः //
text_mt: Gūr is indicated here as a single root with an indicated udātta, O lord of sages; / and four roots beginning with ṇū are considered to take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅākhyātonudātteñca kuṭādyāḥ pūrtimāgatāḥ /
pṛṅ mṛṅ cātmanebhāṣau ṣaṭ parasmaipade ripeḥ //
meaning:
कुङाख्यातोनुदात्तेञ्च कुटाद्याः पूर्तिमागताः /
पृङ् मृङ् चात्मनेभाषौ षट् परस्मैपदे रिपेः //
text_mt: The root named kuṅ has an indicated anudātta, and those beginning with kuṭ have reached completion; / pṛṅ and mṛṅ take the Ātmanepada endings, and six from rip take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanepadino dhātū dṛṅdhṛṅdvau cāpyudāhṛtau /
pracchādiṣoḍaśākhyātāḥ parasmaipadino mune //
meaning:
आत्मनेपदिनो धातू दृङ्धृङ्द्वौ चाप्युदाहृतौ /
प्रच्छादिषोडशाख्याताः परस्मैपदिनो मुने //
text_mt: And the two roots dṛṅ and dhṛṅ are cited as taking the Ātmanepada endings; / sixteen roots beginning with pracch are declared to take the Parasmaipada endings, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritetaḥ ṣaṭ tataśca proktā milamukhā mune /
kṛtīprabhṛtaya ścāpi parasmaipadinasrayaḥ //
meaning:
स्वरितेतः षट् ततश्च प्रोक्ता मिलमुखा मुने /
कृतीप्रभृतय श्चापि परस्मैपदिनस्रयः //
text_mt: Then six roots beginning with mil are declared to have an indicated svarita, O sage; / and three roots beginning with kṛt take the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta pañcāśadadhikāstudādau dhātavaḥ śatam /
svariteto rudhonandā parasmaibhāṣitaḥ kṛtī //
meaning:
सप्त पञ्चाशदधिकास्तुदादौ धातवः शतम् /
स्वरितेतो रुधोनन्दा परस्मैभाषितः कृती //
text_mt: There are one hundred and fifty-seven roots in the class beginning with tud; / nine roots from rudh have an indicated svarita, and kṛt takes the Parasmaipada endings.

sanskrit_iast:
ñiindhīto 'nudātetasrayo dhātava īritāḥ /
udāttetaḥ śiṣapiṣarudhādyāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ //
meaning:
ञिइन्धीतो ऽनुदातेतस्रयो धातव ईरिताः /
उदात्तेतः शिषपिषरुधाद्याः पञ्चविंशतिः //
text_mt: Three roots beginning with ñiindhī are declared to have an indicated anudātta; / twenty-five roots, śiṣ, piṣ, and those beginning with rudh, have an indicated udātta.

sanskrit_iast:
svaritetastanoḥ sapta dhātavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
manuvanvātmanebhāṣau svaritettkṛñudāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
स्वरितेतस्तनोः सप्त धातवः परिकीर्तिताः /
मनुवन्वात्मनेभाषौ स्वरितेत्त्कृञुदाहृतः //
text_mt: Seven roots of the class beginning with tan are proclaimed to have an indicated svarita; / man and van take the Ātmanepada endings, and kṛñ is cited as having an indicated svarita.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvau kīrtitau vipra dhātavo daśa śābdikaiḥ /
kyādyāḥ saptobhayebhāṣāḥ sautrāḥ staṃbhvādikāstathā //
meaning:
ततो द्वौ कीर्तितौ विप्र धातवो दश शाब्दिकैः /
क्याद्याः सप्तोभयेभाषाः सौत्राः स्तंभ्वादिकास्तथा //
text_mt: Then, O brāhmaṇa, ten roots are proclaimed [in this group] by grammarians; / seven beginning with krī take both sets of endings; similarly the Vedic roots beginning with stambh,

sanskrit_iast:
parasmaipadinaḥ proktāścatvāro 'pi munīśvara /
dvāviṃśatirudāttetaḥ kudhādyā dhātavo matāḥ //
meaning:
परस्मैपदिनः प्रोक्ताश्चत्वारो ऽपि मुनीश्वर /
द्वाविंशतिरुदात्तेतः कुधाद्या धातवो मताः //
text_mt: and four roots are declared to take the Parasmaipada endings, O lord of sages; / twenty-two roots beginning with kudh are considered to have an indicated udātta.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṅṅātmanepadī dhātuḥ śraṃthādyāścaikaviṃśatiḥ /
parasmaipadinaścātha svaritedgraha eva ca //
meaning:
वृङ्ङात्मनेपदी धातुः श्रंथाद्याश्चैकविंशतिः /
परस्मैपदिनश्चाथ स्वरितेद्ग्रह एव च //
text_mt: The root vṛṅ takes the Ātmanepada endings, and twenty-one roots beginning with śrath / take the Parasmaipada endings; and grah has an indicated svarita.

sanskrit_iast:
rkyādikeṣu dvipañcāśaddhātavaḥ kīrtitā budhaiḥ /
curādyā dhātavo ñyantā ṣaṭrtriṃśadadhikaḥ śatam //
meaning:
र्क्यादिकेषु द्विपञ्चाशद्धातवः कीर्तिता बुधैः /
चुराद्या धातवो ञ्यन्ता षट्र्त्रिंशदधिकः शतम् //
text_mt: Fifty-two roots among those beginning with krī are proclaimed by the wise; / the roots beginning with cur end in the affix ṇi and are one hundred and thirty-six.

sanskrit_iast:
cityādyaṣṭādaśākhyātā ātmanepadino mune /
carcādyā ādhṛṣīyāstu pyantā vā parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
चित्याद्यष्टादशाख्याता आत्मनेपदिनो मुने /
चर्चाद्या आधृषीयास्तु प्यन्ता वा परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Eighteen roots beginning with cit are declared to take the Ātmanepada endings, O sage; / those beginning with carc up to ādhṛṣ are proclaimed as optionally ending in pi.

sanskrit_iast:
adantā dhātavaścaiva catvāriṃśattathāṣṭaṃ ca /
padādyāstu daśa proktā dhātavo hyātmanepade //
meaning:
अदन्ता धातवश्चैव चत्वारिंशत्तथाष्टं च /
पदाद्यास्तु दश प्रोक्ता धातवो ह्यात्मनेपदे //
text_mt: And roots ending in short a are forty-eight; / ten roots beginning with pad are declared to be in the Ātmanepada.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrādyā aṣṭa cāpyatra ñyantā proktā manīṣibhiḥ /
dhātvarthe prātipadikādvahulaṃ ceṣṭavanmatam //
meaning:
सूत्राद्या अष्ट चाप्यत्र ञ्यन्ता प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः /
धात्वर्थे प्रातिपदिकाद्वहुलं चेष्टवन्मतम् //
text_mt: And eight roots beginning with sūtra here are declared by the wise to end in the affix ṇi; / [an affix is applied] diversely to a nominal stem in the sense of a verb, like an action.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe hetumatyapi ṇirmataḥ /
dhātvarthe kartṛkaraṇāñcitrādyāścāpi dhātavaḥ //
meaning:
तत्करोति तदाचष्टे हेतुमत्यपि णिर्मतः /
धात्वर्थे कर्तृकरणाञ्चित्राद्याश्चापि धातवः //
text_mt: The affix ṇi is prescribed in the sense of 'he does that', 'he tells that', and in a causal sense; / roots beginning with citra are also formed from the agent and instrument in the sense of a verb.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭa saṃgrāma ākhyāto 'nudāttecchabdikairbudhaiḥ /
stomādyāḥ ṣoḍaśa tathā andatasyaṃ nidarśanam //
meaning:
अष्ट संग्राम आख्यातो ऽनुदात्तेच्छब्दिकैर्बुधैः /
स्तोमाद्याः षोडश तथा अन्दतस्यं निदर्शनम् //
text_mt: The root saṃgrām is declared by learned grammarians to have an indicated anudātta, having eight [meanings]; / likewise sixteen beginning with stoma are an illustration of that ending in short a.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bāhulakādanye sautralaukikavaidikāḥ /
sarve sarvagaṇīyāśca tathānekārthavācinaḥ //
meaning:
तथा बाहुलकादन्ये सौत्रलौकिकवैदिकाः /
सर्वे सर्वगणीयाश्च तथानेकार्थवाचिनः //
text_mt: Likewise, other roots through diversity are from sūtras, worldly, or Vedic; / they all belong to all classes and likewise convey multiple meanings.

sanskrit_iast:
sanādyantā dhātavaśca tathā vai nāmadhātavaḥ /
evamānantyamudbhāvyaṃ dhātūnāmiha nārada /
saṃkṣepo 'yaṃ samuddiṣṭo vistarastatra tatra ca //
meaning:
सनाद्यन्ता धातवश्च तथा वै नामधातवः /
एवमानन्त्यमुद्भाव्यं धातूनामिह नारद /
संक्षेपो ऽयं समुद्दिष्टो विस्तरस्तत्र तत्र च //
text_mt: And [there are] verbal roots ending in san and the like, as well as nominal roots; / in this way, O Nārada, the infinity of roots is to be understood here. / This summary has been stated, and the elaboration [is found] here and there.

sanskrit_iast:
ūdṛdantairyaunti rukṣṇuśūṅsnunukṣuściḍīṅśribhiḥ /
vṛṅvṛñbhyāṃ ca vinaikāco 'janteṣu nihatāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ऊदृदन्तैर्यौन्ति रुक्ष्णुशूङ्स्नुनुक्षुश्चिडीङ्श्रिभिः /
वृङ्वृञ्भ्यां च विनैकाचो ऽजन्तेषु निहताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Except for roots ending in ū and ṛ, [and except for] yā, yu, ru, kṣnu, śūṅ, snu, nu, kṣu, śvī, ḍīṅ, and śri, / and without vṛṅ and vṛñ, the monosyllabic roots among vowel-ending ones are taught as unaccented [aniṭ].

sanskrit_iast:
śaklapacmucārcvacvicsicpracchityajnijir bhajaḥ /
bhañjbhujbhrasjmatjiyajyujrujrañjavijirsvañjisañjsṛjaḥ //
meaning:
शक्लपच्मुचार्च्वच्विच्सिच्प्रच्छित्यज्निजिर् भजः /
भञ्ज्भुज्भ्रस्ज्मत्जियज्युज्रुज्रञ्जविजिर्स्वञ्जिसञ्ज्सृजः //
text_mt: Śakl, pac, muc, ric, vac, vic, sic, pracch, tyaj, nij, bhaj, / bhañj, bhuj, bhrajj, majj, yaj, yuj, ruj, rañj, vij, svañj, sañj, and sṛj;

sanskrit_iast:
adkṣudkhidchidtudinudaḥ padyabhidvidyatirvinad /
śadsadī svidyatiḥskandirhadī krudhkṣudhibudhyatī //
meaning:
अद्क्षुद्खिद्छिद्तुदिनुदः पद्यभिद्विद्यतिर्विनद् /
शद्सदी स्विद्यतिःस्कन्दिर्हदी क्रुध्क्षुधिबुध्यती //
text_mt: ad, kṣud, khid, chid, tud, nud, pad, bhid, vid, vyadh, vinad, / śad, sad, svid, skand, had, krudh, kṣudh, and budh;

sanskrit_iast:
bandhiryudhirudhīrādhivyadhśudhaḥ sādhisidhyatī /
manyahannāpkṣipchupitaptipastṛpyatidṛpyatī //
meaning:
बन्धिर्युधिरुधीराधिव्यध्शुधः साधिसिध्यती /
मन्यहन्नाप्क्षिप्छुपितप्तिपस्तृप्यतिदृप्यती //
text_mt: bandh, yudh, rudh, rādh, vyadh, śudh, sādh, sidh, / man, han, āp, kṣip, chup, tap, tip, tṛp, dṛp;

sanskrit_iast:
libluvvapūśapsvapūsṛpiyabharabhagamnamyamo rabhiḥ /
kruśirdaṃśidiśī dṛśmṛśriruśliśviśspṛśaḥ kṛṣiḥ //
meaning:
लिब्लुव्वपूशप्स्वपूसृपियभरभगम्नम्यमो रभिः /
क्रुशिर्दंशिदिशी दृश्मृश्रिरुश्लिश्विश्स्पृशः कृषिः //
text_mt: lip, lup, vap, śap, svap, sṛp, yabh, rabh, gam, nam, yam, rabh, / kruś, daṃś, diś, dṛś, mṛś, ruś, liś, viś, spṛś, kṛṣ;

sanskrit_iast:
tviṣṭuṣduṣpuṣyapiṣviṣśiṣśuṣśliṣyatayo ghasiḥ /
vasatirdahadihiduho nahmihruhlihvahistathā //
meaning:
त्विष्टुष्दुष्पुष्यपिष्विष्शिष्शुष्श्लिष्यतयो घसिः /
वसतिर्दहदिहिदुहो नह्मिह्रुह्लिह्वहिस्तथा //
text_mt: tviṣ, tuṣ, duṣ, puṣ, piṣ, viṣ, śiṣ, śuṣ, śliṣ, ghas, / vas, dah, dih, duh, nah, mih, ruh, lih, and vah—

sanskrit_iast:
anudāttā halanteṣu dhātavo dvyadhikaṃ śatam /
cādyā nipātā gavayaḥ prādyā digdeśakālajāḥ //
meaning:
अनुदात्ता हलन्तेषु धातवो द्व्यधिकं शतम् /
चाद्या निपाता गवयः प्राद्या दिग्देशकालजाः //
text_mt: these consonant-ending roots are anudātta [aniṭ], one hundred and two [in number]. / The particles beginning with ca, gavaya, and those beginning with pra; words born of direction, region, and time,

sanskrit_iast:
śabdāḥ proktā hyanekārthāḥ sarvaliṅgā api dvija /
gaṇapāṭhaḥ sūtrapāṭho dhātupāṭhastathaiva ca //
meaning:
शब्दाः प्रोक्ता ह्यनेकार्थाः सर्वलिङ्गा अपि द्विज /
गणपाठः सूत्रपाठो धातुपाठस्तथैव च //
text_mt: are indeed proclaimed as polysemous, and occurring in all genders, O twice-born one. / The recitation of the word-lists, the recitation of sūtras, and likewise the recitation of roots,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭhonunāsikānāṃ ca parāyaṇamihocyate /
śabdāḥ siddhā vaidikāstu laukikāścāpi nārada //
meaning:
पाठोनुनासिकानां च परायणमिहोच्यते /
शब्दाः सिद्धा वैदिकास्तु लौकिकाश्चापि नारद //
text_mt: and the recitation of nasalised vowels is called the comprehensive study [śabdapārāyaṇa] here. / The words established [by them] are both Vedic and worldly, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdapārāyaṇaṃ tasmātkāraṇaṃ śabdasaṃgrahe /
laghumārgeṇa śabdānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃnirūpaṇam //
meaning:
शब्दपारायणं तस्मात्कारणं शब्दसंग्रहे /
लघुमार्गेण शब्दानां साधूनां संनिरूपणम् //
text_mt: Therefore, the comprehensive study of words is the cause in gathering words. / The determination of correct words by a concise method,

sanskrit_iast: prakṛtipratyayādeśalopāgamamukhaiḥ kṛtam //
meaning: प्रकृतिप्रत्ययादेशलोपागममुखैः कृतम् //
text_mt: is accomplished by means of base, suffix, substitution, elision, and augment.

sanskrit_iast:
itthametatsamākhyātaṃ niruktaṃ kiñcidevate /
kātsnyerna vaktumānantyātko 'piśakto na nārada //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇa pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde niruktalakṣaṇanirūpaṇaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्थमेतत्समाख्यातं निरुक्तं किञ्चिदेवते /
कात्स्न्येर्न वक्तुमानन्त्यात्को ऽपिशक्तो न नारद //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराण पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे निरुक्तलक्षणनिरूपणं नाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus has this Nirukta been expounded to you in brief; / due to its endlessness, no one at all is capable of declaring it completely, O Nārada.

Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Characteristics of Nirukta,' in the second quarter of the Bṛhad-upākhyāna in the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
jyotiṣāṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā purā /
yasya vijñāna mātreṇa dharmasiddhirbhavennṛṇām //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
ज्योतिषाङ्गं प्रवक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं ब्रह्मणा पुरा /
यस्य विज्ञान मात्रेण धर्मसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम् //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / I shall declare the limb [of the Veda] that is Jyotiṣa, which was spoken by Brahmā of old, / merely by the knowledge of which the attainment of dharma occurs for men.

sanskrit_iast:
triskandhaṃ jyautiṣāṃ śāstraṃ caturlakṣamudāhṛtam /
gaṇitaṃ jātakaṃ vipra saṃhitāskandhasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
त्रिस्कन्धं ज्यौतिषां शास्त्रं चतुर्लक्षमुदाहृतम् /
गणितं जातकं विप्र संहितास्कन्धसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: The treatise on astronomy-astrology having three branches is said to consist of four hundred thousand [verses]. / Mathematics [Gaṇita], Horoscopy [Jātaka], and Saṃhitā are designated as the branches, O brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇite parikarmādi khagamadhyasphuṭakriṃye /
anuyogaścandrasūryagrahaṇaṃ tacodasyākam //
meaning:
गणिते परिकर्मादि खगमध्यस्फुटक्रिंये /
अनुयोगश्चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहणं तचोदस्याकम् //
text_mt: In mathematics, the operations and so forth, the computation of the mean and true planets, / the question-and-answer, the solar and lunar eclipses, the rising and setting of planets,

sanskrit_iast:
chāyā śṛṅgonnatiyutī pātasādhānamīritam /
jātake rāśibhedāśca grahayoniśca yonijam //
meaning:
छाया शृङ्गोन्नतियुती पातसाधानमीरितम् /
जातके राशिभेदाश्च ग्रहयोनिश्च योनिजम् //
text_mt: the shadow, the elevation of the moon's cusps, conjunction, and determination of planetary nodes are spoken of. / In horoscopy, the divisions of zodiacal signs, the origin of planets, origin [of beings],

sanskrit_iast:
niṣekajanmāriṣṭāni hyāyurdāyo daśākramaḥ /
karmājīvaṃ cāṣṭavargo rājayogāśca nābhasāḥ //
meaning:
निषेकजन्मारिष्टानि ह्यायुर्दायो दशाक्रमः /
कर्माजीवं चाष्टवर्गो राजयोगाश्च नाभसाः //
text_mt: conception, birth, afflictions [ariṣṭa], the lifespan, the order of planetary periods [daśā], / professional livelihood, the aṣṭakavarga, and the royal and celestial yogas,

sanskrit_iast:
candrayogāḥ pravrajyākhyā rāśiśīlaṃ ca dṛkphalam /
grahabhāvaphalaṃ caivāśrayayogaprakīrṇake //
meaning:
चन्द्रयोगाः प्रव्रज्याख्या राशिशीलं च दृक्फलम् /
ग्रहभावफलं चैवाश्रययोगप्रकीर्णके //
text_mt: the lunar yogas, asceticism [renunciation], the disposition of signs, the result of aspects, / the results of planetary houses, the planetary shelter yogas, and miscellaneous matters,

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭayogāḥ srījanmapalaṃ niryāṇameva ca /
naṣṭajanmavidhānaṃ ca tathā dreṣkāṇalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
अनिष्टयोगाः स्रीजन्मपलं निर्याणमेव च /
नष्टजन्मविधानं च तथा द्रेष्काणलक्षणम् //
text_mt: inauspicious yogas, the results of female horoscopy, death itself, / the method for lost horoscopes, and the characteristics of decanates [dreṣkāṇa] [are treated].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitāśāstrarūpaṃ ca grahacāro 'bdalakṣaṇam /
tithivāsaranakṣatrayogatithyarddhasaṃjñakāḥ //
meaning:
संहिताशास्त्ररूपं च ग्रहचारो ऽब्दलक्षणम् /
तिथिवासरनक्षत्रयोगतिथ्यर्द्धसंज्ञकाः //
text_mt: The nature of the Saṃhitā treatise comprises the motion of planets, the characteristics of years, / the tithis, weekdays, asterisms, yogas, and half-tithis [karaṇas],

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtopagrahāḥ sūyasaṃkrāntirgocaraḥ kramāt /
candratā rābalaṃ caiva sarvalagrārtavāhvayaḥ //
meaning:
मुहूर्तोपग्रहाः सूयसंक्रान्तिर्गोचरः क्रमात् /
चन्द्रता राबलं चैव सर्वलग्रार्तवाह्वयः //
text_mt: the muhūrtas, secondary planets, solar ingress, transits in due order, / the strength of the moon and stars, the ascendant of all matters, seasonal periods,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhānapuṃsasīmantajātanāmānnabhuktayaḥ /
caulaṅkarṇyayaṇaṃ maiñjī kṣurikābandhanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
आधानपुंससीमन्तजातनामान्नभुक्तयः /
चौलङ्कर्ण्ययणं मैञ्जी क्षुरिकाबन्धनं तथा //
text_mt: impregnation, pumsavana, parting the hair, birth-rites, naming, first feeding, / tonsure, piercing the ears, the sacred girdle, and the investiture of the dagger,

sanskrit_iast:
samāvartinavaivāhapratiṣṭāsadmalakṣaṇam /
yātrāpraveśanaṃ sadyovṛṣṭiḥ karmavilakṣaṇam //
meaning:
समावर्तिनवैवाहप्रतिष्टासद्मलक्षणम् /
यात्राप्रवेशनं सद्योवृष्टिः कर्मविलक्षणम् //
text_mt: graduation from studentship, marriage, consecration, the characteristics of houses, / journeys, house-entering, immediate rainfall, different rites,

sanskrit_iast:
utpattilakṣaṇaṃ caiva sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato bruve /
ekaṃ daśa śataṃ caiva sahasrāyutalakṣakam //
meaning:
उत्पत्तिलक्षणं चैव सर्वं संक्षेपतो ब्रुवे /
एकं दश शतं चैव सहस्रायुतलक्षकम् //
text_mt: and the characteristics of portents: all this I declare in brief. / One, ten, one hundred, one thousand, ten thousand, one hundred thousand,

sanskrit_iast:
prayutaṃ koṭisaṃjñāṃ cārbudamabjaṃ ca rarvavakam /
niravarva ca mahāpadmaṃ śaṅkurjaladhireva ca //
meaning:
प्रयुतं कोटिसंज्ञां चार्बुदमब्जं च रर्ववकम् /
निरवर्व च महापद्मं शङ्कुर्जलधिरेव च //
text_mt: one million, that named ten million [koṭi], one hundred million, one billion, ten billion, / one hundred billion, one trillion, ten trillion, one hundred trillion,

sanskrit_iast:
atyaṃ madhyaṃ parārddhaṃ ca saṃjñā daśaguṇottarāḥ /
kramādutkramato vāpi yogaḥ kāryottaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
अत्यं मध्यं परार्द्धं च संज्ञा दशगुणोत्तराः /
क्रमादुत्क्रमतो वापि योगः कार्योत्तरं तथा //
text_mt: one quadrillion, ten quadrillion, and one hundred quadrillion: these denominations increase tenfold successively. / In order or in reverse order, addition and subtraction are to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyādguṇena guṇyaṃ syāttainaivopāntimādikān /
śuddheddharoyadguṇaścabhājyāntyāttatphalaṃ mune //
meaning:
हन्याद्गुणेन गुण्यं स्यात्तैनैवोपान्तिमादिकान् /
शुद्धेद्धरोयद्गुणश्चभाज्यान्त्यात्तत्फलं मुने //
text_mt: One should multiply the multiplicand by the multiplier, and by that very [multiplier] the penultimate and subsequent places. / Whatever multiplier times the divisor clears [the dividend], that is the quotient from the end of the dividend, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
samāṅkato 'tho vargasyāttamevāhuḥ kṛtiṃ budhāḥ /
antyāttu viṣamāttyaktvā kṛtiṃ mūlaṃnyasetpṛthak //
meaning:
समाङ्कतो ऽथो वर्गस्यात्तमेवाहुः कृतिं बुधाः /
अन्त्यात्तु विषमात्त्यक्त्वा कृतिं मूलंन्यसेत्पृथक् //
text_mt: From the square of equal numbers comes the square [varga]; the wise indeed call that the square. / Having subtracted the square from the last odd place, one should set down the root separately.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇenāmunā bhakte phalaṃ mūle nyasetkramāt /
tatkṛtiṃ ca tyajedvipra mūlena vibhajetpunaḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणेनामुना भक्ते फलं मूले न्यसेत्क्रमात् /
तत्कृतिं च त्यजेद्विप्र मूलेन विभजेत्पुनः //
text_mt: When divided by double that [root], one should place the quotient in the root in order; / and one should subtract its square, O brahmin, and divide again by the root.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ muhurvargamūlaṃ jāyate ca munīśvara /
samatryaṅkahatiḥ prokto ghanastatravidhiḥ pade //
meaning:
एवं मुहुर्वर्गमूलं जायते च मुनीश्वर /
समत्र्यङ्कहतिः प्रोक्तो घनस्तत्रविधिः पदे //
text_mt: In this way, the square root is produced repeatedly, O lord of sages. / The product of three equal numbers is declared to be the cube; the rule regarding the places therein [is as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
procyate viṣamaṃ tvādyaṃ same dve ca tataḥ param /
viśodhyaṃ viṣamādantyāddhanaṃ tanmūlamucyate //
meaning:
प्रोच्यते विषमं त्वाद्यं समे द्वे च ततः परम् /
विशोध्यं विषमादन्त्याद्धनं तन्मूलमुच्यते //
text_mt: The first place is called odd, and the next two places are even; / the cube is to be subtracted from the last odd place; its root is spoken of [separately].

sanskrit_iast:
trighnādbhajanmūlakṛtyā samaṃ mūle nyasetphalam /
tatkṛtitvena nihatānnighnīṃ cāpi viśodhayet //
meaning:
त्रिघ्नाद्भजन्मूलकृत्या समं मूले न्यसेत्फलम् /
तत्कृतित्वेन निहतान्निघ्नीं चापि विशोधयेत् //
text_mt: From dividing by three times the square of the root, one should place the quotient in the root for the even place; / and one should subtract the product of its square and [thrice the root],

sanskrit_iast:
ghanaṃ ca viṣamādevaṃ ghanamūlaṃ murhubhavet /
anyonyahāranihatau harāṃśau tu samucchidā //
meaning:
घनं च विषमादेवं घनमूलं मुर्हुभवेत् /
अन्योन्यहारनिहतौ हरांशौ तु समुच्छिदा //
text_mt: and the cube from the odd place; thus repeatedly the cube root arises. / When the numerator and denominator are multiplied reciprocally by the denominator, they have a common divisor.

sanskrit_iast:
lavā lavaghnāśca harā haraghnā hi savarṇanam /
bhāgaprabhāge vijñeyaṃ mune śāsrārthacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
लवा लवघ्नाश्च हरा हरघ्ना हि सवर्णनम् /
भागप्रभागे विज्ञेयं मुने शास्रार्थचिन्तकैः //
text_mt: Numerators multiplied by numerators and denominators multiplied by denominators constitute reduction to a common fraction; / this should be known in fractions and subfractions, O sage, by thinkers on the meaning of the treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
anubandhe 'pavāhe caikasya cedadhikonakaḥ /
bhāgāstalasthahāreṇa haraṃ svāṃśādhikena tān //
meaning:
अनुबन्धे ऽपवाहे चैकस्य चेदधिकोनकः /
भागास्तलस्थहारेण हरं स्वांशाधिकेन तान् //
text_mt: In addition and subtraction of fractions, if one fraction is greater or smaller than another, / [multiply] the fractions by the denominator beneath, and multiply the denominator by that [denominator] increased by its own numerator,

sanskrit_iast:
ūnena cāpi guṇayeddhanarṇaṃ cintayettathā /
kāryastulyaharāṃ śānāṃ yogaścāpyantato mune //
meaning:
ऊनेन चापि गुणयेद्धनर्णं चिन्तयेत्तथा /
कार्यस्तुल्यहरां शानां योगश्चाप्यन्ततो मुने //
text_mt: or by that decreased [by its numerator], and one should consider positive and negative likewise; / and addition of fractions with equal denominators is to be performed at the end, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ahārarāśau rūpyaṃ tu kalpayeddharamapyathā /
aṃśāhatiśchedaghātahṛdbhinnaguṇane phalam //
meaning:
अहारराशौ रूप्यं तु कल्पयेद्धरमप्यथा /
अंशाहतिश्छेदघातहृद्भिन्नगुणने फलम् //
text_mt: In an un-fractional quantity, one should suppose the denominator to be unity. / The product of numerators divided by the product of denominators is the result in multiplication of fractions.

sanskrit_iast:
chedaṃ cāpi lavaṃ vidvanparivartya harasya ca /
śeṣaḥ kāryo bhāgahāre kartavyo guṇanāvidhiḥ //
meaning:
छेदं चापि लवं विद्वन्परिवर्त्य हरस्य च /
शेषः कार्यो भागहारे कर्तव्यो गुणनाविधिः //
text_mt: Having inverted the denominator and numerator of the divisor, O wise one, / the rest of the operation is to be done in division: the procedure of multiplication is to be executed.

sanskrit_iast:
hārāṃśayoḥ kṛtī varge ghanau ghanavidhau mune /
padasiddhyai pade kuryādathoravaṃ sarvataśca ravam //
meaning:
हारांशयोः कृती वर्गे घनौ घनविधौ मुने /
पदसिद्ध्यै पदे कुर्यादथोरवं सर्वतश्च रवम् //
text_mt: The squares of the denominator and numerator [are taken] in squaring, and their cubes in the operation of cubing, O sage; / for the purpose of finding the root, one should extract the root; so too in every operation.

sanskrit_iast:
chedaṃ guṇaṃ guṇaṃ chedaṃ vargaṃ mūlaṃ padaṃ kṛtim /
ṛṇaṃ svaṃ svamṛṇaṃ kuryādṛśye rāśiprasiddhaye //
meaning:
छेदं गुणं गुणं छेदं वर्गं मूलं पदं कृतिम् /
ऋणं स्वं स्वमृणं कुर्यादृश्ये राशिप्रसिद्धये //
text_mt: Make the divisor a multiplier, the multiplier a divisor, the square a square root, the root a square, / negative positive, and positive negative, in the visible quantity, in order to determine the [unknown] quantity.

sanskrit_iast:
atha svāṃśādhikone tu lavāḍhyo no haro haraḥ /
aṃśastvavikṛtastatra vilome śeṣamuktavat //
meaning:
अथ स्वांशाधिकोने तु लवाढ्यो नो हरो हरः /
अंशस्त्वविकृतस्तत्र विलोमे शेषमुक्तवत् //
text_mt: Now, when increased or decreased by its own fraction, the denominator increased or decreased by the numerator becomes the denominator, / while the numerator remains unchanged; in the inverse method, the rest is as previously stated.

sanskrit_iast:
uddiṣṭārāśiḥ saṃkṣiptau hṛtoṃ'śai rahito yutaḥ /
iṣṭaghnadṛṣṭenaitena bhaktarāśiranīśitaḥ //
meaning:
उद्दिष्टाराशिः संक्षिप्तौ हृतोंऽशै रहितो युतः /
इष्टघ्नदृष्टेनैतेन भक्तराशिरनीशितः //
text_mt: A designated quantity, reduced, divided, diminished, or increased by its fractions: / that quantity divided by this given value multiplied by the assumed value is determined.

sanskrit_iast:
yogontareṇonayutodvitorāśītasaṃkrame /
rāśyantarahṛtaṃ vargottaraṃ yosutaśca tau //
meaning:
योगोन्तरेणोनयुतोद्वितोराशीतसंक्रमे /
राश्यन्तरहृतं वर्गोत्तरं योसुतश्च तौ //
text_mt: In the transit of two quantities, the sum is decreased or increased by the difference; / the difference of squares divided by the difference of the two quantities gives their sum.

sanskrit_iast:
gajagrīṣṭakṛtirvyaikā dalitā ceṣṭabhājitā /
eko 'sya vargo dalitaḥ saiko rāśiḥ paro mataḥ //
meaning:
गजग्रीष्टकृतिर्व्यैका दलिता चेष्टभाजिता /
एको ऽस्य वर्गो दलितः सैको राशिः परो मतः //
text_mt: The square of an assumed number minus one, halved and divided by the assumed number, [gives one quantity]; / one square of this halved, increased by one, is regarded as the other quantity.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇeṣṭahṛtaṃ rūpaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāgrūpakaṃ param /
vargayogāntare vyeke rāśyorvargosta etayoḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणेष्टहृतं रूपं श्रेष्ठं प्राग्रूपकं परम् /
वर्गयोगान्तरे व्येके राश्योर्वर्गोस्त एतयोः //
text_mt: Unity divided by twice the assumed number is the first best value; the other is the former unit; / when the sum and difference of the squares are decreased by one, the square of these two quantities [is obtained].

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭavagekṛtiśceṣṭaghanoṣṭagrau ca saukakau /
eṣīsyānāmubhe vyakte gaṇite vyaktameva ca //
meaning:
इष्टवगेकृतिश्चेष्टघनोष्टग्रौ च सौककौ /
एषीस्यानामुभे व्यक्ते गणिते व्यक्तमेव च //
text_mt: The desired square, square root, desired cube, and cube roots are thus calculated; / both these manifest quantities are indeed clearly understood in arithmetic.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇaghnamūlonayutaḥ saguṇārddhe kṛtaṃ padam /
dṛṣṭasya ca guṇārddho na yutaṃ vargīkṛtaṃ guṇaḥ //
meaning:
गुणघ्नमूलोनयुतः सगुणार्द्धे कृतं पदम् /
दृष्टस्य च गुणार्द्धो न युतं वर्गीकृतं गुणः //
text_mt: Diminished or increased by the square root multiplied by a factor, the square root of that which is combined with half the coefficient squared / of the known quantity, diminished or increased by half the coefficient and squared, yields the coefficient.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā lavonapumrāśirdṛśyaṃ bhāgonayugbhuvā /
bhaktaṃ tathā mūlaguṇaṃ tābhyāṃ sādhyotha vyaktavat //
meaning:
यदा लवोनपुम्राशिर्दृश्यं भागोनयुग्भुवा /
भक्तं तथा मूलगुणं ताभ्यां साध्योथ व्यक्तवत् //
text_mt: When a quantity is decreased by a fraction, the visible amount divided by the earth [unity] diminished or increased by the fraction, / multiplied likewise by the square root, is solved by these two just like a known quantity.

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇecche sajātīye ādyante madhaayagaṃ phalam /
icchaghnamādyahṛtseṣṭaṃ phalaṃ vyaste viparyayāt //
meaning:
प्रमाणेच्छे सजातीये आद्यन्ते मधअयगं फलम् /
इच्छघ्नमाद्यहृत्सेष्टं फलं व्यस्ते विपर्ययात् //
text_mt: The standard [measure] and the requisition are of the same kind, placed at the beginning and the end, with the fruit in the middle. / The fruit multiplied by the requisition and divided by the initial [measure] is the desired fruit; in the inverse rule, it is reversed.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarāsyādike 'nyonyapakṣaṃ kṛtvā phalacchidām /
bahurāśivadhaṃ bhakte phalaṃ svalpavadhena ca //
meaning:
पञ्चरास्यादिके ऽन्योन्यपक्षं कृत्वा फलच्छिदाम् /
बहुराशिवधं भक्ते फलं स्वल्पवधेन च //
text_mt: In the rule of five and the rest, having interchanged the sides of the denominators of the fruits, / when the product of the many quantities is divided by the product of the few, the fruit [is obtained].

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭakarmavadhemūlaṃ cyutaṃ miśrātkalāntare /
mānaghnakālaścātītakālāghnaphalasaṃhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
इष्टकर्मवधेमूलं च्युतं मिश्रात्कलान्तरे /
मानघ्नकालश्चातीतकालाघ्नफलसंहृताः //
text_mt: In the operation of interest, the square root of the product, subtracted from the mixed capital-interest at the interval of interest, / the time multiplied by the principal, and divided by the fruit multiplied by the elapsed time:

sanskrit_iast:
svayogabhaktānighnāḥ syuḥ saṃprayuktadalāni ca /
bahurāśipalātsvalparāśimāsaphalaṃ bahu //
meaning:
स्वयोगभक्तानिघ्नाः स्युः संप्रयुक्तदलानि च /
बहुराशिपलात्स्वल्पराशिमासफलं बहु //
text_mt: divided by their sum and multiplied [by the total], they are the portions of the capital lent. / If the monthly yield of a small amount from a large amount is large,

sanskrit_iast:
cedrāśivivaraṃ māsaphalāntarahṛtaṃ ca yaḥ /
kṣepā miśrahatāḥ kṣepoyogabhaktāḥ phalāni ca //
meaning:
चेद्राशिविवरं मासफलान्तरहृतं च यः /
क्षेपा मिश्रहताः क्षेपोयोगभक्ताः फलानि च //
text_mt: then the difference between the two amounts is divided by the difference between the monthly yields; / and the investments multiplied by the mixed sum, divided by the sum of the investments, are the fruits [shares].

sanskrit_iast:
bhajecchidāeṃśaistairmiśrai rūpaṃ kālaśca pūrtikṛt /
pūrṇogacchetsamedhyavyesamevargorddhitetyataḥ //
meaning:
भजेच्छिदाएंशैस्तैर्मिश्रै रूपं कालश्च पूर्तिकृत् /
पूर्णोगच्छेत्समेध्यव्येसमेवर्गोर्द्धितेत्यतः //
text_mt: One should divide unity by those mixed fractions, and that becomes the completing time. / When the total period is even, [one halves it]; when odd, [one subtracts one], and thus from squaring and halving:

sanskrit_iast:
vyastaṃ gacchataṃ phalaṃ yadguṇavargaṃ bhacahi tat /
vyekaṃ vyekaguṇāptaṃ ca prādhnaṃ mānaṃ guṇottare //
meaning:
व्यस्तं गच्छतं फलं यद्गुणवर्गं भचहि तत् /
व्येकं व्येकगुणाप्तं च प्राध्नं मानं गुणोत्तरे //
text_mt: The inverse power of the period, which is the square of the common ratio, / diminished by one and divided by the common ratio less one, and multiplied by the first term, is the measure in a geometric progression.

sanskrit_iast:
bhujakoṭikṛtiyogamūlaṃ karṇaśca dorbhavet /
śrutikṛtyantarapada koṭirdoḥ karṇavargayoḥ //
meaning:
भुजकोटिकृतियोगमूलं कर्णश्च दोर्भवेत् /
श्रुतिकृत्यन्तरपद कोटिर्दोः कर्णवर्गयोः //
text_mt: The square root of the sum of the squares of the base and the upright is the hypotenuse, and [similarly] the base is found. / The upright is the square root of the difference between the squares of the hypotenuse and the base.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃvarāttatkarṇapadaṃ kṣetre tricaturasrake /
rāśyorantaravargeṇa dvighne ghāte yute tayoḥ //
meaning:
विंवरात्तत्कर्णपदं क्षेत्रे त्रिचतुरस्रके /
राश्योरन्तरवर्गेण द्विघ्ने घाते युते तयोः //
text_mt: From the difference of the squares of the two, the square root is the hypotenuse in a triangular or quadrilateral figure. / When twice their product is added to the square of the difference between two quantities,

sanskrit_iast:
vargayogotha yogāntahṝntirvargāntaraṃ bhavet /
vyāsa ākṛtisaṃkṣaṇṇovyāsāsyātparidhirmune //
meaning:
वर्गयोगोथ योगान्तहॄन्तिर्वर्गान्तरं भवेत् /
व्यास आकृतिसंक्षण्णोव्यासास्यात्परिधिर्मुने //
text_mt: that is the sum of their squares; and the product of the sum and difference is the difference of their squares. / The diameter multiplied by the square root of ten is the circumference, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
jyāvyāsayogavivarāhatamūlonito 'rddhitaḥ /
vyāsaḥ śaraḥ śaronāñca vyāsāccharaguṇātpadam //
meaning:
ज्याव्यासयोगविवराहतमूलोनितो ऽर्द्धितः /
व्यासः शरः शरोनाञ्च व्यासाच्छरगुणात्पदम् //
text_mt: The diameter diminished by the square root of the product of the sum and difference of the chord and the diameter, and halved, / is the arrow; and the square root of the diameter diminished by the arrow, multiplied by the arrow,

sanskrit_iast:
dvighnaṃ jīvātha jīvārddhavarge śarahṛte yute /
vyāsoṣṭatebhavedevaṃ proktaṃ gaṇitakovidaiḥ //
meaning:
द्विघ्नं जीवाथ जीवार्द्धवर्गे शरहृते युते /
व्यासोष्टतेभवेदेवं प्रोक्तं गणितकोविदैः //
text_mt: doubled, is the chord; then, when the square of half the chord is divided by the arrow and added [to the arrow], / it becomes the diameter. Thus has it been declared by those learned in calculation.

sanskrit_iast:
cāponanighnaḥ paridhiḥ pragaṅlaḥ paridheḥ kṛte /
turyāṃśena śaradhnenāgheninādhaṃ caturgaṇam //
meaning:
चापोननिघ्नः परिधिः प्रगङ्लः परिधेः कृते /
तुर्यांशेन शरध्नेनाघेनिनाधं चतुर्गणम् //
text_mt: The circumference diminished by the arc, multiplied by [the arc], is the first factor. / Four times [the product of the diameter and arc] divided by one-fourth of the square of the circumference diminished by that product,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsadhnaṃ prabhajedvipra jyā kāśaṃ jāyate sphuṭā /
jyāṅghrīṣudhnovṛttavargobagdhighnavyāsāḍhyamaurvihṛt //
meaning:
व्यासध्नं प्रभजेद्विप्र ज्या काशं जायते स्फुटा /
ज्याङ्घ्रीषुध्नोवृत्तवर्गोबग्धिघ्नव्यासाढ्यमौर्विहृत् //
text_mt: and multiplied by the diameter, should be divided, O brahmin; the accurate chord is produced. / The square of the circumference multiplied by one-fourth of the chord, divided by the chord increased by four times the diameter,

sanskrit_iast:
labdhonavṛttavargādripaderdhātpatite dhanuḥ /
sthūlamadhyāpṛvannavedho vṛttāṅkāśeṣabhāgikaḥ //
meaning:
लब्धोनवृत्तवर्गाद्रिपदेर्धात्पतिते धनुः /
स्थूलमध्यापृवन्नवेधो वृत्ताङ्काशेषभागिकः //
text_mt: subtracted from the square of the circumference, its fourth part subtracted from half, gives the arc. / The depth is taken as rough, intermediate, and broad, divided into nine equal parts.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttāṅgāṃśakṛtirvedhaniprīyanakarāmitau /
vārivyāsahataṃ dairdhyaṃvedhāṅgulahataṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
वृत्ताङ्गांशकृतिर्वेधनिप्रीयनकरामितौ /
वारिव्यासहतं दैर्ध्यंवेधाङ्गुलहतं पुनः //
text_mt: The square of a fraction of the circumference measured by cubits according to depth: / the length multiplied by the diameter of the water, and further multiplied by the digits of the depth,

sanskrit_iast:
kharavendurāmavihataṃ mānaṃ droṇādivāriṇaḥ /
vistārāyāmavedhānāṃmaṅgulyonyanāḍighnāḥ //
meaning:
खरवेन्दुरामविहतं मानं द्रोणादिवारिणः /
विस्तारायामवेधानांमङ्गुल्योन्यनाडिघ्नाः //
text_mt: divided by three thousand one hundred and twenty, is the measure of the water in droṇas and the like. / The digits of the breadth, length, and depth multiplied together,

sanskrit_iast:
rasāṃkābhrābdhibhirbhaktā dhānye droṇādikāmitiḥ /
utsedhavyāsadairdhyāṇāmaṅgulyānyasya no dvija //
meaning:
रसांकाभ्राब्धिभिर्भक्ता धान्ये द्रोणादिकामितिः /
उत्सेधव्यासदैर्ध्याणामङ्गुल्यान्यस्य नो द्विज //
text_mt: and divided by four thousand and ninety-six, is the measure of grain in droṇas and the like. / The digits of height, diameter, and length of another [vessel], O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
mithoghnāti bhajetsvākṣeśairdreṇādimitirbhavet /
vistārādyaṃ gulānyevaṃ mithoghnānyapasāṃbhavet //
meaning:
मिथोघ्नाति भजेत्स्वाक्षेशैर्द्रेणादिमितिर्भवेत् /
विस्ताराद्यं गुलान्येवं मिथोघ्नान्यपसांभवेत् //
text_mt: multiplied together and divided by five hundred and twenty, yields the measure in droṇas and the like. / Likewise, the digits of breadth and the like multiplied together for liquids,

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇebhamārgaṇairlabdhaṃ droṇādyaṃ mānamādiśet /
dīpaśaṅkutalacchidraghnaḥ śaṅkurbhaivaṃbhavenmune //
meaning:
वाणेभमार्गणैर्लब्धं द्रोणाद्यं मानमादिशेत् /
दीपशङ्कुतलच्छिद्रघ्नः शङ्कुर्भैवंभवेन्मुने //
text_mt: divided by five hundred and eighty-five, gives the measure in droṇas and the rest. / The gnomon multiplied by the distance between the lamp and the base of the gnomon is the shadow, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
narona dīpakaśikhaucyabhakto hyatha bhodvane /
śaṅkaunṛdīpādhaśchidraghnairdīpauccyaṃ narānvite //
meaning:
नरोन दीपकशिखौच्यभक्तो ह्यथ भोद्वने /
शङ्कौनृदीपाधश्छिद्रघ्नैर्दीपौच्च्यं नरान्विते //
text_mt: divided by the height of the tip of the lamp diminished by the human measure [of the gnomon], the shadow is produced. / The height of the lamp multiplied by the base distance between the gnomon and the lamp, when added to the human measure,

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśakudīpauccaguṇācchāyā śaṅkūddhṛtā bhavet /
dīpaśaṅkvantaraṃ cātha cchāyāgravivaraghnabhā //
meaning:
विंशकुदीपौच्चगुणाच्छाया शङ्कूद्धृता भवेत् /
दीपशङ्क्वन्तरं चाथ च्छायाग्रविवरघ्नभा //
text_mt: the shadow multiplied by the height of the lamp and divided by the gnomon becomes the distance between the lamp and the gnomon. / And the shadow multiplied by the distance between the tips of the shadows,

sanskrit_iast:
mānāntaradrudbhūmiḥ syādathobhūnarāhatiḥ /
prabhāptā jāyate dīpaśikhauccyaṃ syāttrirāśikāt //
meaning:
मानान्तरद्रुद्भूमिः स्यादथोभूनराहतिः /
प्रभाप्ता जायते दीपशिखौच्च्यं स्यात्त्रिराशिकात् //
text_mt: divided by the difference of the measures, is the base distance. Then, the product of the base and the gnomon / divided by the shadow produces the height of the lamp's flame by the rule of three.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ gaṇite parikarmakam /
grahamadhyādikaṃ vakṣye gaṇite nātivistarān //
meaning:
एतत्संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं गणिते परिकर्मकम् /
ग्रहमध्यादिकं वक्ष्ये गणिते नातिविस्तरान् //
text_mt: Thus the preliminary arithmetic operations have been declared in brief. / I shall now declare the mean positions of the planets and the rest in astronomy, without excessive expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
yugamānaṃ smṛtaṃ vipra khacatuṣkaradārṇavāḥ /
taddaśāṃśāstu catvāraḥ kṛtākhyaṃ pādamucyate //
meaning:
युगमानं स्मृतं विप्र खचतुष्करदार्णवाः /
तद्दशांशास्तु चत्वारः कृताख्यं पादमुच्यते //
text_mt: The measure of a yuga is traditionally taught, O brahmin, as four million three hundred and twenty thousand [years]. / Four-tenths of that is declared to be the quarter known as Kṛtayuga;

sanskrit_iast:
trayasretā dvāparaḥ dvau kalirekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
manukṛtābdasahitā yugānāmekasaptatiḥ //
meaning:
त्रयस्रेता द्वापरः द्वौ कलिरेकः प्रकीर्तितः /
मनुकृताब्दसहिता युगानामेकसप्ततिः //
text_mt: three [tenths] are Tretā, two Dvāpara, and one is proclaimed to be Kali. / Seventy-one yugas together with the Kṛtayuga years of a Manu [sandhi]

sanskrit_iast:
vidherddine syurviprendra manavastu caturdaśa /
tāvatyeva niśā tasya viprendra parikīrtitā //
meaning:
विधेर्द्दिने स्युर्विप्रेन्द्र मनवस्तु चतुर्दश /
तावत्येव निशा तस्य विप्रेन्द्र परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: constitute a day of the Creator, O best of brahmins; there are fourteen Manus, / and just as long is declared to be his night, O foremost of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhuvā śaragatānabdānsaṃpiṇḍya nārada /
khacarānayanaṃ kāryamathaveṣṭayugāditaḥ //
meaning:
स्वयंभुवा शरगतानब्दान्संपिण्ड्य नारद /
खचरानयनं कार्यमथवेष्टयुगादितः //
text_mt: Having totaled the elapsed years from the birth of the Self-born Brahmā, O Nārada, / the calculation of the heavenly bodies is to be made, or else from the beginning of the desired yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
yuge sūryajñaśukrāṇāṃ khacatuṣkaradārṇavāḥ /
pūjārkiguruśukrāṇāṃ bhagaṇāpūrvapāpinām //
meaning:
युगे सूर्यज्ञशुक्राणां खचतुष्करदार्णवाः /
पूजार्किगुरुशुक्राणां भगणापूर्वपापिनाम् //
text_mt: In a yuga, the revolutions of the Sun, Mercury, and Venus are four million three hundred and twenty thousand; / the revolutions of Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and the previously mentioned evil planets [are as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
indorasāgnitriṣu sapta bhūdharamārgaṇāḥ /
dasratryāṣṭarasāṃkāśvilocanāni kujasya tu //
meaning:
इन्दोरसाग्नित्रिषु सप्त भूधरमार्गणाः /
दस्रत्र्याष्टरसांकाश्विलोचनानि कुजस्य तु //
text_mt: Of the Moon, fifty-seven million seven hundred and fifty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-six; / and of Mars, two million two hundred and ninety-six thousand eight hundred and thirty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
budhaśīghrasya śūnyartukhādritryaṅkanagendavaḥ /
bṛhaspateḥ khadasrākṣivedasraṅhūyastathā //
meaning:
बुधशीघ्रस्य शून्यर्तुखाद्रित्र्यङ्कनगेन्दवः /
बृहस्पतेः खदस्राक्षिवेदस्रङ्हूयस्तथा //
text_mt: Of the quick [conjunction] of Mercury, seventeen million nine hundred and thirty-seven thousand and sixty; / of Jupiter, three hundred and sixty-four thousand two hundred and twenty;

sanskrit_iast:
śitaśīghrasya yaṣṇasatriyamāśvisvabhūdharāḥ /
śanerbhujagaṣaṭpacarasavedaniśākarāḥ //
meaning:
शितशीघ्रस्य यष्णसत्रियमाश्विस्वभूधराः /
शनेर्भुजगषट्पचरसवेदनिशाकराः //
text_mt: of the quick [conjunction] of Venus, seven million twenty-two thousand three hundred and seventy-six; / of Saturn, one hundred and forty-six thousand five hundred and sixty-eight.

sanskrit_iast:
candroñcasyāgniśūnyākṣivasusarpārṇavā yuge /
vāmaṃ pātasya ca svagniyamāśviśikhidasrakāḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रोञ्चस्याग्निशून्याक्षिवसुसर्पार्णवा युगे /
वामं पातस्य च स्वग्नियमाश्विशिखिदस्रकाः //
text_mt: Of the lunar apogee, four hundred and eighty-eight thousand two hundred and three in a yuga; / and retrogradely of its ascending node, two hundred and thirty-two thousand two hundred and twenty-six.

sanskrit_iast:
udayādudayaṃ bhānorbhūmaiḥ sācena vāsarāḥ /
vasuvdyaṣṭādrirūpāṅkasaptādritithayo yuge //
meaning:
उदयादुदयं भानोर्भूमैः साचेन वासराः /
वसुव्द्यष्टाद्रिरूपाङ्कसप्ताद्रितिथयो युगे //
text_mt: From sunrise to sunrise, the terrestrial civil days of the Sun / are one billion five hundred and seventy-seven million nine hundred and seventeen thousand eight hundred and twenty-eight in a yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍ vahitrihutāśāṅkatithayaścādhimāsakāḥ /
tithikṣayāyamārthākṣidvyaṣṭavyomaśarāśvinaḥ //
meaning:
षड् वहित्रिहुताशाङ्कतिथयश्चाधिमासकाः /
तिथिक्षयायमार्थाक्षिद्व्यष्टव्योमशराश्विनः //
text_mt: The intercalary months are one million five hundred and ninety-three thousand three hundred and thirty-six; / and the omitted lunar days are twenty-five million eighty-two thousand two hundred and fifty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
ravacatuṣkā samudrāṣṭakurpacaravimāsakāḥ /
ṣaṭtryagnivedagnipañcaśubhrāṃśumāsakāḥ //
meaning:
रवचतुष्का समुद्राष्टकुर्पचरविमासकाः /
षट्त्र्यग्निवेदग्निपञ्चशुभ्रांशुमासकाः //
text_mt: The solar months are fifty-one million eight hundred and forty thousand; / and the lunar months are fifty-three million four hundred and thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-six.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgāteḥ sūryamandasya kalpesaptāṣṭavahnayaḥ /
kaujasya vedasvayamā baudhasyāṣṭartuvahnayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रागातेः सूर्यमन्दस्य कल्पेसप्ताष्टवह्नयः /
कौजस्य वेदस्वयमा बौधस्याष्टर्तुवह्नयः //
text_mt: In a kalpa, the revolutions of the slow apogee of the Sun in direct motion are three hundred and eighty-seven; / of Mars, two hundred and four; of Mercury, three hundred and sixty-eight;

sanskrit_iast:
ravaravarandhrāṇi jaivasya śaukrasyārdhaguṇeṣavaḥ /
gognayaḥ śanimandasya pātānāmathavā mataḥ //
meaning:
रवरवरन्ध्राणि जैवस्य शौक्रस्यार्धगुणेषवः /
गोग्नयः शनिमन्दस्य पातानामथवा मतः //
text_mt: of Jupiter, nine hundred; of Venus, five hundred and thirty-five; / of Saturn's slow apogee, thirty-nine; or else, the views regarding the nodes [are as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
manudasrāstu kaujasya baudhasyāṣṭāṣṭasāgarāḥ /
kṛtādricandrājaivasya ravaikasyāgniravanandakāḥ //
meaning:
मनुदस्रास्तु कौजस्य बौधस्याष्टाष्टसागराः /
कृताद्रिचन्द्राजैवस्य रवैकस्याग्निरवनन्दकाः //
text_mt: Of Mars, two hundred and fourteen; of Mercury, four hundred and eighty-eight; / of Jupiter, one hundred and seventy-four; of Venus, eight hundred and ninety-nine;

sanskrit_iast:
śanipātasya bhagaṇāḥ kalpe yamarasartavaḥ /
vartamānayuge pānāvatsarābhagaṇābhidhāḥ //
meaning:
शनिपातस्य भगणाः कल्पे यमरसर्तवः /
वर्तमानयुगे पानावत्सराभगणाभिधाः //
