text_mt: and the revolutions of Saturn's node in a kalpa are six hundred and sixty-two. / In the current yuga, the years called revolutions [are noted];

sanskrit_iast:
māsīkṛtāyutā māsairmadhuśuklādibhirgataiḥ /
pṛthaktthāsidhimāsagrāsūryamāsavibhājitāḥ //
meaning:
मासीकृतायुता मासैर्मधुशुक्लादिभिर्गतैः /
पृथक्त्थासिधिमासग्रासूर्यमासविभाजिताः //
text_mt: turned into months and added to the elapsed months beginning with the bright half of Madhu, / placed in a separate position, they are multiplied by the intercalary months and divided by the solar months.

sanskrit_iast:
athādhimāsakairyuktā dinīkṛtya dinānvitāḥ /
dvisthāstitikṣayābhyastāścāndravāsarabhājitāḥ //
meaning:
अथाधिमासकैर्युक्ता दिनीकृत्य दिनान्विताः /
द्विस्थास्तितिक्षयाभ्यस्ताश्चान्द्रवासरभाजिताः //
text_mt: Then, combined with the intercalary months, converted into days, and increased by the elapsed days, / placed in two positions, multiplied by the omitted lunar days, and divided by the lunar days:

sanskrit_iast:
lathonarātrirahitālaṅkāryāmarddharātrikāḥ /
sāvanodyūgasārarkādirdinamāsābdayāstataḥ //
meaning:
लथोनरात्रिरहितालङ्कार्यामर्द्धरात्रिकाः /
सावनोद्यूगसारर्कादिर्दिनमासाब्दयास्ततः //
text_mt: diminished by the resulting omitted days, they are the civil days at midnight at Laṅkā. / Thence the terrestrial civil days, the lord of the day, month, and year [are found]:

sanskrit_iast:
saptibhiḥ kṣapitaḥ śeṣaḥ mūryādyovāsareśvaraḥ /
māsābdadinasaṃkhyāsaṃdvitrighnaṃ rūpasaṃyutam //
meaning:
सप्तिभिः क्षपितः शेषः मूर्याद्योवासरेश्वरः /
मासाब्ददिनसंख्यासंद्वित्रिघ्नं रूपसंयुतम् //
text_mt: divided by seven, the remainder indicates the lord of the day, beginning with the Sun. / The number of months, years, and days multiplied by two and three, and increased by one,

sanskrit_iast:
saptorddhanāvaśeṣau tau vijñeyau māsavarṣapau /
snehasya bhagaṇābhyasto dinarāśiḥ kuvāsaraiḥ //
meaning:
सप्तोर्द्धनावशेषौ तौ विज्ञेयौ मासवर्षपौ /
स्नेहस्य भगणाभ्यस्तो दिनराशिः कुवासरैः //
text_mt: divided by seven, the remainders are to be known as the lords of the month and of the year. / The sum of days multiplied by the revolutions of a planet and divided by the terrestrial civil days [yields its position].

sanskrit_iast:
vibhājito madhyagatyā bhagaṇādirgraho bhavet /
evaṃ hyaśīghramandāñcaye proktāḥ pūrvapāpinaḥ //
meaning:
विभाजितो मध्यगत्या भगणादिर्ग्रहो भवेत् /
एवं ह्यशीघ्रमन्दाञ्चये प्रोक्ताः पूर्वपापिनः //
text_mt: Divided by the mean motion, the planet is obtained in revolutions and the rest. / Thus indeed are the slow apogees and fast apogees declared for the previous planets.

sanskrit_iast:
vilomagatayaḥ pātāstadvañcakrāṣviśodhitāḥ /
yojanāni śatānyaṣṭau bhūkarṇauṃ dviguṇāḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विलोमगतयः पातास्तद्वञ्चक्राष्विशोधिताः /
योजनानि शतान्यष्टौ भूकर्णौं द्विगुणाः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The nodes, having retrograde motion, are likewise subtracted from the circle. / The diameter of the earth is known to be eight hundred multiplied by two yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvargato daśaguṇātpada bhūparidhirbhavet /
laṃbajyāghnasvajīvāptaḥ sphuṭo bhūparidhiḥ svakaḥ //
meaning:
तद्वर्गतो दशगुणात्पद भूपरिधिर्भवेत् /
लंबज्याघ्नस्वजीवाप्तः स्फुटो भूपरिधिः स्वकः //
text_mt: The square root of ten times its square is the circumference of the earth. / Multiplied by the sine of colatitude and divided by the radius, it becomes the true circumference of one's own locality.

sanskrit_iast:
tena deśāntarābhyastā grahabhuktirvibhājitā /
kalāditatphalaṃ prārcyāḥ grahebhyaḥ pariśodhayet //
meaning:
तेन देशान्तराभ्यस्ता ग्रहभुक्तिर्विभाजिता /
कलादितत्फलं प्रार्च्याः ग्रहेभ्यः परिशोधयेत् //
text_mt: The daily motion of the planet multiplied by the terrestrial longitude and divided by that, / yields a result in minutes and the rest; one should subtract that from the planets to the east.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāpratīcisaṃsthāne prakṣipetsyuḥ svadeśataḥ /
rākṣasātapadevaukaḥ śailayormadhyasūtragāḥ //
meaning:
रेखाप्रतीचिसंस्थाने प्रक्षिपेत्स्युः स्वदेशतः /
राक्षसातपदेवौकः शैलयोर्मध्यसूत्रगाः //
text_mt: One should add it if the locality is situated west of the prime meridian. / Those on the central meridian between the abode of the demons and the mountain of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
avantikārohatikaṃ tathā sannihitaṃ saraḥ /
vārapravṛttivāgdeśe kṣayārddhebhyadhiko bhavet //
meaning:
अवन्तिकारोहतिकं तथा सन्निहितं सरः /
वारप्रवृत्तिवाग्देशे क्षयार्द्धेभ्यधिको भवेत् //
text_mt: are Avantikā, Rohitaka, and the nearby lake Kurukṣetra. / The start of the weekday in that eastern region would exceed the half-reduction;

sanskrit_iast:
taddeśāntaranāḍībhiḥ paścādūne vinirdiśet /
iṣṭanāḍīguṇā bhuktiḥ ṣaṣṭyā bhaktā kalādikam //
meaning:
तद्देशान्तरनाडीभिः पश्चादूने विनिर्दिशेत् /
इष्टनाडीगुणा भुक्तिः षष्ट्या भक्ता कलादिकम् //
text_mt: by the nāḍīs of that terrestrial longitude, one should declare it to be less in the west. / The daily motion multiplied by the desired nāḍīs and divided by sixty yields minutes and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
gate śoddhyaṃ tathā yojyaṃ gamye tātkāliko grahaḥ /
bhacakraliptāśītyaṃśaḥ paramaṃ dakṣiṇottaram //
meaning:
गते शोद्ध्यं तथा योज्यं गम्ये तात्कालिको ग्रहः /
भचक्रलिप्ताशीत्यंशः परमं दक्षिणोत्तरम् //
text_mt: It is subtracted when past, and likewise added when to come; [thus is] the planet for that immediate time. / One-eightieth part of the minutes of the zodiacal circle is the maximum north-south

sanskrit_iast:
vikṣipyate svapātena svakrāntyantādanuṣṇaguḥ /
tatra vāsaṃ dviguṇitajīvasriguṇitaṃ kujaḥ //
meaning:
विक्षिप्यते स्वपातेन स्वक्रान्त्यन्तादनुष्णगुः /
तत्र वासं द्विगुणितजीवस्रिगुणितं कुजः //
text_mt: deflection from the end of its declination by its node for the sun. / In that matter, Mars is doubled, Jupiter tripled,

sanskrit_iast:
budhaśukrārkajāḥ pātairvikṣipyante caturguṇam /
rāśiliptāṣṭamo bhāgaḥ prathamaṃ jyārddhamucyate //
meaning:
बुधशुक्रार्कजाः पातैर्विक्षिप्यन्ते चतुर्गुणम् /
राशिलिप्ताष्टमो भागः प्रथमं ज्यार्द्धमुच्यते //
text_mt: and Mercury, Venus, and Saturn are deflected fourfold by their nodes. / The eighth part of the minutes of a sign is called the first sine-segment.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvibhaktalabdhonamiśritaṃ taddvitīyakam /
ādyenaiva kramātpiṇḍānbhaktāllabdhonitairyutān //
meaning:
ततो द्विभक्तलब्धोनमिश्रितं तद्द्वितीयकम् /
आद्येनैव क्रमात्पिण्डान्भक्ताल्लब्धोनितैर्युतान् //
text_mt: That, reduced by the quotient of its division by two, combined, is the second. / By that very first, successively divided by the quotients obtained from dividing the tabular sines,

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍakāḥ syuścaturviśā jyārddhapiṇḍāḥ kramādamī /
paramā pakramajyā tu saptarandhraguṇendavaḥ //
meaning:
खण्डकाः स्युश्चतुर्विशा ज्यार्द्धपिण्डाः क्रमादमी /
परमा पक्रमज्या तु सप्तरन्ध्रगुणेन्दवः //
text_mt: the segments would be the twenty-four tabular sines in order. / The maximum sine of declination is one thousand three hundred and ninety-seven.

sanskrit_iast:
tadgumajyā trijivāptā tañcāpaṃ krāntirucyate /
grahaṃ saṃśodhya mandoñcattathā śīghnādviśodhya ca //
meaning:
तद्गुमज्या त्रिजिवाप्ता तञ्चापं क्रान्तिरुच्यते /
ग्रहं संशोध्य मन्दोञ्चत्तथा शीघ्नाद्विशोध्य च //
text_mt: Its sine multiplied and divided by the radius, the arc of that is called the declination. / Subtracting the planet from the slow apogee, and likewise subtracting it from the fast apogee,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ kandapadantasmādbhujajyā koṭireva ca /
gatādbhujajyāviṣame gamyātkoṭiḥ pade bhavet //
meaning:
शेषं कन्दपदन्तस्माद्भुजज्या कोटिरेव च /
गताद्भुजज्याविषमे गम्यात्कोटिः पदे भवेत् //
text_mt: the remainder is the anomaly and quadrant; from that arise the base-sine and perpendicular-sine. / In an odd quadrant, the base-sine is from the past [anomaly] and the perpendicular-sine from the anomaly to come.

sanskrit_iast:
sameti gamyādvāhudajyā koṭijyānugatā bhavet /
liptāstattvayamairbhaktā labdhajyāpiṇḍakaṃ gatam //
meaning:
समेति गम्याद्वाहुदज्या कोटिज्यानुगता भवेत् /
लिप्तास्तत्त्वयमैर्भक्ता लब्धज्यापिण्डकं गतम् //
text_mt: In an even quadrant, the base-sine is from the anomaly to come, and the perpendicular-sine is from the past. / The minutes divided by two hundred and twenty-five yield the elapsed tabular sine.

sanskrit_iast:
gatagamyāntarābhyastaṃ vibhajettattvalocanaiḥ /
tadavāptaphalaṃ yojyaṃ jyāpiṇḍe gatasaṃjñake //
meaning:
गतगम्यान्तराभ्यस्तं विभजेत्तत्त्वलोचनैः /
तदवाप्तफलं योज्यं ज्यापिण्डे गतसंज्ञके //
text_mt: Multiplied by the difference between the elapsed and to-come, one should divide by two hundred and twenty-five. / The result thus obtained should be added to the tabular sine called the elapsed.

sanskrit_iast:
syātkramajyāvidhiścaivamutkramajyāgatā bhavet /
liptāstattvayamairbhaktā labdhajyā piṇḍakaṃ gatam //
meaning:
स्यात्क्रमज्याविधिश्चैवमुत्क्रमज्यागता भवेत् /
लिप्तास्तत्त्वयमैर्भक्ता लब्धज्या पिण्डकं गतम् //
text_mt: Such is the rule for the right sine; and the versed sine elapsed would be: / the minutes divided by two hundred and twenty-five yield the elapsed tabular sine.

sanskrit_iast:
gatagamyāntarābhyastaṃ vibhajettattvalocanaiḥ /
tadavāptaphalaṃ yojyaṃ jyāpiṇḍe gatasaṃjñake //
meaning:
गतगम्यान्तराभ्यस्तं विभजेत्तत्त्वलोचनैः /
तदवाप्तफलं योज्यं ज्यापिण्डे गतसंज्ञके //
text_mt: Multiplied by the difference between the elapsed and to-come, one should divide by two hundred and twenty-five. / The result thus obtained should be added to the tabular sine called the elapsed.

sanskrit_iast:
syātkramajyāvidhiścaivamukramajyāsvapismṛtaḥ /
jyāṃ prohya śeṣaṃ tattvatāśvi hṝntaṃ tadvivaroddhṛm //
meaning:
स्यात्क्रमज्याविधिश्चैवमुक्रमज्यास्वपिस्मृतः /
ज्यां प्रोह्य शेषं तत्त्वताश्वि हॄन्तं तद्विवरोद्धृम् //
text_mt: Such is the rule for the right sine, and it is also remembered for the versed sines. / Subtracting the sine, dividing the remainder by two hundred and twenty-five, divided by the difference,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyātattvāśvisaṃvargyasaṃyojyaṃ dhanurucyate /
ravermandaparidhyaṃśā manavaḥ śītagoradāḥ //
meaning:
संख्यातत्त्वाश्विसंवर्ग्यसंयोज्यं धनुरुच्यते /
रवेर्मन्दपरिध्यंशा मनवः शीतगोरदाः //
text_mt: multiplied by two hundred and twenty-five and added to the count, it is called the arc. / The degrees of the sun's slow epicycle are fourteen; those of the moon are thirty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
yugmānte viṣamānte tunakhaliptonitāstayoḥ /
yugmānterthādrayaḥ khāgnisurāḥ sūryā navārṇavāḥ //
meaning:
युग्मान्ते विषमान्ते तुनखलिप्तोनितास्तयोः /
युग्मान्तेर्थाद्रयः खाग्निसुराः सूर्या नवार्णवाः //
text_mt: At the end of an even quadrant they are diminished by twenty minutes; at the end of an odd quadrant, / for them at the end of an even quadrant: seventy-five, thirty, thirty-three, twelve, and forty-nine;

sanskrit_iast:
ojedvyagā ca suyamāradārudrāgajābdhayaḥ /
kujādīnāmataḥ śaughnyāyugmānterthāgnidasrakāḥ //
meaning:
ओजेद्व्यगा च सुयमारदारुद्रागजाब्धयः /
कुजादीनामतः शौघ्न्यायुग्मान्तेर्थाग्निदस्रकाः //
text_mt: in an odd quadrant: seventy-two, twenty-eight, fourteen, and forty-eight. / Next, for Mars and the others, the fast [epicycles] at the end of an even quadrant: two hundred and thirty-five,

sanskrit_iast:
guṇāgnicandrāḥ khanagādvirasākṣīṇi go 'grayaḥ /
ojānte dvitriyamatādviviśveyamaparvatāḥ //
meaning:
गुणाग्निचन्द्राः खनगाद्विरसाक्षीणि गो ऽग्रयः /
ओजान्ते द्वित्रियमताद्विविश्वेयमपर्वताः //
text_mt: one hundred and thirty-three, seventy, two hundred and sixty-two, and ninety-nine; / at the end of an odd quadrant: two hundred and thirty-two, two hundred and sixty-two, and seventy-two,

sanskrit_iast:
khartudasnāvipadvedāḥ śīghnakarmaṇi kīrtitāḥ /
ojayugmāntaraguṇābhujajyātrijyayoddhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
खर्तुदस्नाविपद्वेदाः शीघ्नकर्मणि कीर्तिताः /
ओजयुग्मान्तरगुणाभुजज्यात्रिज्ययोद्धृताः //
text_mt: two hundred and sixty, and four hundred and twenty-four are proclaimed in the fast operation. / Multiplied by the difference between odd and even, the base-sine is divided by the radius;

sanskrit_iast:
yugmavṛttedhanarṇaśyādojādūne 'dhike sphuṭam /
tadguṇe bhujakoṭijyebhagaṇāṃśavibhājite //
meaning:
युग्मवृत्तेधनर्णश्यादोजादूने ऽधिके स्फुटम् /
तद्गुणे भुजकोटिज्येभगणांशविभाजिते //
text_mt: it should be additive or subtractive to the even epicycle according as it is less or greater than the odd, [giving] the true [epicycle]. / Multiplied by that, the base-sine and perpendicular-sine are divided by the degrees of the circle;

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhujajyāphaladhanurmāndaṃ liptādikaṃ phalam /
śai'yakoṭiphalaṃ kendre makarādau dhanaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
तद्भुजज्याफलधनुर्मान्दं लिप्तादिकं फलम् /
शैऽयकोटिफलं केन्द्रे मकरादौ धनं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: the arc of that base-sine equation is the slow equation in minutes and the like. / The fast perpendicular-equation, when the anomaly begins with Capricorn, is regarded as additive;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśodhyaṃ tu trijīvāyāṃ karkādau koṭijaṃ phalam /
tadbāhuphalavargaikyānmūlakarṇaścalābhidhaḥ //
meaning:
संशोध्यं तु त्रिजीवायां कर्कादौ कोटिजं फलम् /
तद्बाहुफलवर्गैक्यान्मूलकर्णश्चलाभिधः //
text_mt: it is to be subtracted from the radius when it begins with Cancer. / From the sum of the squares of that base-equation [and perpendicular], the square root is the hypotenuse named variable.

sanskrit_iast:
trijyābhyastaṃ bhujaphalaṃ makarādau dhanaṃ smṛtam /
saṃśodhyaṃ tu trijīvāyāṃ karkādau koṭijaṃ phalam //
meaning:
त्रिज्याभ्यस्तं भुजफलं मकरादौ धनं स्मृतम् /
संशोध्यं तु त्रिजीवायां कर्कादौ कोटिजं फलम् //
text_mt: The base-equation multiplied by the radius is regarded as additive when beginning with Capricorn; / but the equation produced from the perpendicular is to be subtracted from the radius when beginning with Cancer.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbāhuphalavargaikyānmūlaṃ karṇaścalābhidhaḥ /
trijyābhaghyastaṃ bhujaphalaṃ palakarṇavibhājitam //
meaning:
तद्बाहुफलवर्गैक्यान्मूलं कर्णश्चलाभिधः /
त्रिज्याभघ्यस्तं भुजफलं पलकर्णविभाजितम् //
text_mt: From the sum of the squares of that base-equation, the square root is the hypotenuse named variable. / The base-equation multiplied by the radius and divided by the equinoctial hypotenuse,

sanskrit_iast:
labdhasya cāpaṃ liptādi phalaṃ śaidhryamidaṃ smṛtam /
etadādau kujādīnāṃ caturthe caiva karmaṇi //
meaning:
लब्धस्य चापं लिप्तादि फलं शैध्र्यमिदं स्मृतम् /
एतदादौ कुजादीनां चतुर्थे चैव कर्मणि //
text_mt: the arc of the quotient in minutes and the like is remembered as this fast equation. / This is in the first and indeed the fourth operation for Mars and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
māndyaṃ karmaikamarkendvorbhaundvorbhauṃmādīnāmāthocyate /
śairdhyaṃ mādyaṃ punarmāndyaṃ śairghyaṃ catvāryanukramāt //
meaning:
मान्द्यं कर्मैकमर्केन्द्वोर्भौन्द्वोर्भौंमादीनामाथोच्यते /
शैर्ध्यं माद्यं पुनर्मान्द्यं शैर्घ्यं चत्वार्यनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: For the sun and the moon there is only one slow operation; now it is declared for Mars and the rest: / fast, slow, again slow, and fast—the four operations in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ajā dikendre sarveṣāṃ māndye śairghye ca karmaṇi /
dhanaṃ grahāṇāṃ liptādi tulādāvṛṇameva tat //
meaning:
अजा दिकेन्द्रे सर्वेषां मान्द्ये शैर्घ्ये च कर्मणि /
धनं ग्रहाणां लिप्तादि तुलादावृणमेव तत् //
text_mt: When the anomaly begins with Aries, in both the slow and fast operations for all planets, / the minutes and the like are additive; when beginning with Libra, that is indeed subtractive.

sanskrit_iast:
arkabāhuphalābhyastā grahabhuktivibhājitāḥ /
bhacakrakalikābhistu liptāḥ kāryā graher'kavat //
meaning:
अर्कबाहुफलाभ्यस्ता ग्रहभुक्तिविभाजिताः /
भचक्रकलिकाभिस्तु लिप्ताः कार्या ग्रहेर्ऽकवत् //
text_mt: Multiplied by the sun's base-equation and divided by the minutes of the zodiacal circle, / the daily motions of the planets are converted into minutes like the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
grahabhaktaḥ phalaṃ kāryaṃ grahavanmandakarmaṇi /
karkādau taddhanaṃ tatra makarādāvṛṇaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
ग्रहभक्तः फलं कार्यं ग्रहवन्मन्दकर्मणि /
कर्कादौ तद्धनं तत्र मकरादावृणं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The equation divided by the planet should be applied like the planet in the slow operation: / there, beginning with Cancer, it is additive, and beginning with Capricorn, it is remembered as subtractive.

sanskrit_iast:
dorjyottaraguṇābhuktistattvanetroddhṛtā punaḥ /
svamandaparidhikṣuṇṇā bhagaṇāṃśoddhṛtāḥkalāḥ //
meaning:
दोर्ज्योत्तरगुणाभुक्तिस्तत्त्वनेत्रोद्धृता पुनः /
स्वमन्दपरिधिक्षुण्णा भगणांशोद्धृताःकलाः //
text_mt: The daily motion multiplied by the base-sine and again divided by two hundred and twenty-five, / multiplied by its slow epicycle and divided by the degrees of the revolution, yields the minutes.

sanskrit_iast:
mandasphuṭakṛtā bhuktiḥ śīghnoccabhuktitaḥ /
taccheṣaṃ vivareṇātha hanyātrijyāṅkakarṇayoḥ //
meaning:
मन्दस्फुटकृता भुक्तिः शीघ्नोच्चभुक्तितः /
तच्छेषं विवरेणाथ हन्यात्रिज्याङ्ककर्णयोः //
text_mt: The daily motion corrected by the slow process [is subtracted] from the motion of the fast apogee; / one should then multiply that remainder by the difference between the radius and the hypotenuse.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrakarṇahṛtaṃ bhuktau karṇe trijyādhike dhanam /
ṛṇamūne 'dhike prohya śeṣaṃ vakragatirbhavet //
meaning:
चक्रकर्णहृतं भुक्तौ कर्णे त्रिज्याधिके धनम् /
ऋणमूने ऽधिके प्रोह्य शेषं वक्रगतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Divided by the hypotenuse of the circle, it is additive to the daily motion when the hypotenuse exceeds the radius; / subtractive when less; subtracted when greater, the remainder becomes retrograde motion.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtartucandrairvedendraiḥ śūnyatryekairguṇāṣṭabhiḥ /
śararudraiścaturyāṃśukendrāṃśerbhūsutādayaḥ //
meaning:
कृतर्तुचन्द्रैर्वेदेन्द्रैः शून्यत्र्येकैर्गुणाष्टभिः /
शररुद्रैश्चतुर्यांशुकेन्द्रांशेर्भूसुतादयः //
text_mt: At one hundred and sixty-four, one hundred and forty-four, one hundred and thirty, eighty-three, / and one hundred and fifteen degrees of the fast anomaly, Mars and the other planets

sanskrit_iast:
vakriṇaścakraśuddhaistairaṃśairujutivakratām /
kramajyā viṣuvadbhāghnī kṣitijyā dvādaśoddhṛtā //
meaning:
वक्रिणश्चक्रशुद्धैस्तैरंशैरुजुतिवक्रताम् /
क्रमज्या विषुवद्भाघ्नी क्षितिज्या द्वादशोद्धृता //
text_mt: become retrograde; and when those degrees are deducted from the circle, they attain direct motion. / The right sine multiplied by the equinoctial shadow and divided by twelve is the earth-sine.

sanskrit_iast:
trijyāguṇā dinavyāsabhaktā cāpaṃ ca śatravaḥ /
tatkārmukamudakrāntau dhanahīno pṛthakkṣate //
meaning:
त्रिज्यागुणा दिनव्यासभक्ता चापं च शत्रवः /
तत्कार्मुकमुदक्रान्तौ धनहीनो पृथक्क्षते //
text_mt: Multiplied by the radius and divided by the day-diameter, the arc [is determined]. / That arc is separately calculated as added or subtracted in northern declination;

sanskrit_iast:
svāhorātracaturbhāgedinarātridale smṛte /
yāmyakrāntau viparyaste dviguṇaite dinakṣaye //
meaning:
स्वाहोरात्रचतुर्भागेदिनरात्रिदले स्मृते /
याम्यक्रान्तौ विपर्यस्ते द्विगुणैते दिनक्षये //
text_mt: in the quarter of its day-and-night circle, the halves of day and night are known. / In southern declination, it is reversed; when doubled, in the decrease of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
bhabhogo 'ṣṭaśatīrliptāḥ svāśivaśailostathāttitheḥ /
grahaliptā bhagābhogābhāni bhuktyādinādikam //
meaning:
भभोगो ऽष्टशतीर्लिप्ताः स्वाशिवशैलोस्तथात्तिथेः /
ग्रहलिप्ता भगाभोगाभानि भुक्त्यादिनादिकम् //
text_mt: The span of an asterism is eight hundred minutes; and seven hundred and twenty is that of a lunar day. / The minutes of a planet [divided by] the span of an asterism give the asterisms, daily motion, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
ravīnduyogaliptāstu yogābhabhogabhājitāḥ /
gatagamyāśca ṣaṣṭighnā bhuktiyogāptanāḍikāḥ //
meaning:
रवीन्दुयोगलिप्तास्तु योगाभभोगभाजिताः /
गतगम्याश्च षष्टिघ्ना भुक्तियोगाप्तनाडिकाः //
text_mt: The sum of the minutes of the sun and moon divided by the span of an asterism yields the yoga. / The elapsed and to-come multiplied by sixty and divided by the sum of daily motions give the nāḍīs.

sanskrit_iast:
arkenacandraliptāstu tithayo bhogabhājitāḥ /
gatagamyāśca ṣaṣṭighnā nātobhuktataroddhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अर्केनचन्द्रलिप्तास्तु तिथयो भोगभाजिताः /
गतगम्याश्च षष्टिघ्ना नातोभुक्ततरोद्धृताः //
text_mt: The minutes of the moon [separated] from the sun, divided by the span, give the lunar days. / The elapsed and to-come, multiplied by sixty and divided by the difference in daily motion, [give the nāḍīs].

sanskrit_iast:
tithayaḥ śuklapratipado dvighnāḥ saikā na gāhatāḥ /
śeṣaṃ bavo bālavaśca kaulavastaitilo garaḥ //
meaning:
तिथयः शुक्लप्रतिपदो द्विघ्नाः सैका न गाहताः /
शेषं बवो बालवश्च कौलवस्तैतिलो गरः //
text_mt: The lunar days starting with the bright fortnight's first day, multiplied by two, increased by one, and divided by seven: / the remainders are Bava, Bālava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṇijobhre bhavedviṣṭiḥ kṛṣṇabhūtāparārddhataḥ /
śakunirnāgāśca catuṣpada kiṃstughnameva ca //
meaning:
वणिजोभ्रे भवेद्विष्टिः कृष्णभूतापरार्द्धतः /
शकुनिर्नागाश्च चतुष्पद किंस्तुघ्नमेव च //
text_mt: Vaṇij, and at zero it is Viṣṭi. From the second half of the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, / Śakuni, Catuṣpada, Nāga, and Kiṃstughna occur.

sanskrit_iast:
śilātalevasaṃśuddhe vajralepetivāsame /
tatra śakāṅgulairiṣṭaiḥ samamaṇḍalamālikhet //
meaning:
शिलातलेवसंशुद्धे वज्रलेपेतिवासमे /
तत्र शकाङ्गुलैरिष्टैः सममण्डलमालिखेत् //
text_mt: On a leveled stone surface, coated with plaster and very smooth, / one should draw a regular circle there with desired digits of the gnomon.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye sthāpayecchaṅkuṃ kalpanā ddvādaśāṅgulam /
tacchāyāgraṃ spṛśedyatra dattaṃ pūrvāparāhnayoḥ //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये स्थापयेच्छङ्कुं कल्पना द्द्वादशाङ्गुलम् /
तच्छायाग्रं स्पृशेद्यत्र दत्तं पूर्वापराह्नयोः //
text_mt: In its centre one should set up a gnomon, by convention twelve digits [in height], / where the tip of its shadow touches, marked in the forenoon and afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra binduṃ vidhāyobhau vṛtte pūrvāparābhidhau /
tanmadhye timinā rekhā kartavyā dakṣiṇottata //
meaning:
तत्र बिन्दुं विधायोभौ वृत्ते पूर्वापराभिधौ /
तन्मध्ये तिमिना रेखा कर्तव्या दक्षिणोत्तत //
text_mt: Having made two points there on the circle, called east and west, / in their middle a north-south line should be drawn by means of a fish-figure.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyottaradiśormadhye timinā pūrvapaścimā /
digmadhyamatsyaiḥ saṃsādhyā vidiśastadvadeva hi //
meaning:
याम्योत्तरदिशोर्मध्ये तिमिना पूर्वपश्चिमा /
दिग्मध्यमत्स्यैः संसाध्या विदिशस्तद्वदेव हि //
text_mt: Between the southern and northern directions, the east-west [line is drawn] by a fish-figure; / by means of fish-figures between the cardinal points, the intermediate directions are likewise determined.

sanskrit_iast:
caturastaṃ bahiḥ kuryātsūtrairmadhyādviniḥsṛtaiḥ /
bhujasūtrāṅgulaistatra dattairiṣṭaprabhā matā //
meaning:
चतुरस्तं बहिः कुर्यात्सूत्रैर्मध्याद्विनिःसृतैः /
भुजसूत्राङ्गुलैस्तत्र दत्तैरिष्टप्रभा मता //
text_mt: One should make a square outside with cords extending from the centre; / by the digits of the base-cords marked there, the desired shadow is determined.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅkpaścimāśritā rekhā procyate samamaṇḍalam /
bhamaṇḍalaṃ ca viṣuvanmaṇḍalaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
प्राङ्क्पश्चिमाश्रिता रेखा प्रोच्यते सममण्डलम् /
भमण्डलं च विषुवन्मण्डलं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The line lying east and west is called the prime vertical, / and the circle of constellations is proclaimed to be the equinoctial circle.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhā prācyaparā sādhyā viṣuvadbhāgrayā tathā /
iṣṭacchāyāviṣuvatormadhyehyagrābhidhīyate //
meaning:
रेखा प्राच्यपरा साध्या विषुवद्भाग्रया तथा /
इष्टच्छायाविषुवतोर्मध्येह्यग्राभिधीयते //
text_mt: The east-west line should likewise be determined by the tip of the equinoctial shadow; / the distance between the desired shadow and the equinoctial [shadow] is called the agrā.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkucchāyākṛtiyutermūlaṃ karṃṇo 'ya vargataḥ /
prohya śaṅkukṛte mūlaṃ chāyā śekuviparyayāt //
meaning:
शङ्कुच्छायाकृतियुतेर्मूलं कर्ंणो ऽय वर्गतः /
प्रोह्य शङ्कुकृते मूलं छाया शेकुविपर्ययात् //
text_mt: The square root of the sum of the squares of the gnomon and the shadow is the hypotenuse; / subtracting the square of the gnomon from the square [of the hypotenuse], the square root is the shadow, and conversely for the gnomon.

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśatkṛtyoyuge bhānāṃ cakraṃ prākparilaṃbate /
tadguṇādbhadinairbhaktyā dyugaṇādyadavāpyate //
meaning:
त्रिंशत्कृत्योयुगे भानां चक्रं प्राक्परिलंबते /
तद्गुणाद्भदिनैर्भक्त्या द्युगणाद्यदवाप्यते //
text_mt: Thirty times in a yuga the circle of asterisms oscillates eastward; / by the quotient of that multiplier times the elapsed days divided by the days of a stellar revolution,

sanskrit_iast:
taddosrivnādaśādhnāṃśā vijñeyā ayatānidhāḥ /
tatsaṃsvakṛtāddhahātkānticchāyāvaradalādikam //
meaning:
तद्दोस्रिव्नादशाध्नांशा विज्ञेया अयतानिधाः /
तत्संस्वकृताद्धहात्कान्तिच्छायावरदलादिकम् //
text_mt: the degrees multiplied by the sine of that and by twelve are known as the ayanāṃśas; / from the planet adjusted by that, the declination, shadow, day-radius, and so forth [are derived].

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkucchāyāhate trijye viṣuvatkarkabhājite /
laṃbākṣajye tayośchāye laṃbākṣau dakṣimau sadā //
meaning:
शङ्कुच्छायाहते त्रिज्ये विषुवत्कर्कभाजिते /
लंबाक्षज्ये तयोश्छाये लंबाक्षौ दक्षिमौ सदा //
text_mt: The trijyā multiplied by the gnomon and shadow and divided by the equinoctial hypotenuse / yields the sines of colatitude and latitude; their shadows, colatitude and latitude, are always to the south.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣārkāpakramayutirddiksāmyentaramanyathā /
śeṣahyānāṃśāḥ sūryasya tadvāhujyātha koṭijāḥ //
meaning:
साक्षार्कापक्रमयुतिर्द्दिक्साम्येन्तरमन्यथा /
शेषह्यानांशाः सूर्यस्य तद्वाहुज्याथ कोटिजाः //
text_mt: The sum of latitude and the sun's declination [is taken] when in the same direction, and their difference otherwise; / the remainder is the zenith distance of the sun; its sine is the bāhujyā, and the sine of the complement is the koṭijyā.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkumānāṅgulābhyaste bhujatrijye yathāṅkramam /
koṭījyayāvibhajyāpte chāyākarmābahirddale //
meaning:
शङ्कुमानाङ्गुलाभ्यस्ते भुजत्रिज्ये यथाङ्क्रमम् /
कोटीज्ययाविभज्याप्ते छायाकर्माबहिर्द्दले //
text_mt: The sine of the base and the trijyā, multiplied respectively by the measure of the gnomon in digits, / and divided by the sine of the complement, give the shadow and the hypotenuse.

sanskrit_iast:
svākṣārkanatabhāgānāṃ diksāmye 'taramanyathā /
digbhedopakramaḥ śeṣastasya jyā trijyayā hatā //
meaning:
स्वाक्षार्कनतभागानां दिक्साम्ये ऽतरमन्यथा /
दिग्भेदोपक्रमः शेषस्तस्य ज्या त्रिज्यया हता //
text_mt: The difference between one's latitude and the degrees of the sun's zenith distance [is taken] when in the same direction, and otherwise [the sum]; / when there is a difference of direction, the remainder is the declination, whose sine is multiplied by the trijyā.

sanskrit_iast:
paramopakramajyāpta cāpamepādigo raviḥ /
karkādau prohyacakrārddhāttulādau bhārddhasaṃyutātta //
meaning:
परमोपक्रमज्याप्त चापमेपादिगो रविः /
कर्कादौ प्रोह्यचक्रार्द्धात्तुलादौ भार्द्धसंयुतात्त //
text_mt: Divided by the sine of maximum declination, the arc is the sun beginning with Aries; / beginning with Cancer, it is subtracted from half a circle; beginning with Libra, it is added to half the circle;

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgādau prohyacakrāttu madhyāhner'kaḥ sphuṭo bhavet /
tanmandamasakṛddhāmaṃphalaṃ madhyo divākaraḥ //
meaning:
मृगादौ प्रोह्यचक्रात्तु मध्याह्नेर्ऽकः स्फुटो भवेत् /
तन्मन्दमसकृद्धामंफलं मध्यो दिवाकरः //
text_mt: and beginning with Capricorn, it is subtracted from the whole circle; thus the sun at midday becomes true. / From repeated equations of the centre, the true sun is [derived from] the mean sun.

sanskrit_iast:
grahodayāḥ prāṇahatāḥ khakhāṣṭaikoddhatā gatiḥ /
cakrāsavo labdhayutī svrahorātrāsavaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहोदयाः प्राणहताः खखाष्टैकोद्धता गतिः /
चक्रासवो लब्धयुती स्व्रहोरात्रासवः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The risings of the planets multiplied by prāṇas and divided by one thousand eight hundred is the motion; / the respirations of the revolution, joined to the quotient, are remembered as the respirations of one's own day-and-night.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhadyukarṇārddhaguṇā svāhorātrārddhabhājitāḥ /
kramādekadvitribhaghājyā taccāpāni pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
त्रिभद्युकर्णार्द्धगुणा स्वाहोरात्रार्द्धभाजिताः /
क्रमादेकद्वित्रिभघाज्या तच्चापानि पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Multiplied by half the equinoctial day-hypotenuse and divided by half one's own diurnal circle, / the sines of one, two, and three signs in succession yield their respective arcs separately.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhodhaḥ praviśodhyātha meṣāllaṅkodayāsavaḥ /
svāgāṣṭayorthagogaikāḥ śaratryekaṃ himāṃśavaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाधोधः प्रविशोध्याथ मेषाल्लङ्कोदयासवः /
स्वागाष्टयोर्थगोगैकाः शरत्र्येकं हिमांशवः //
text_mt: Then, subtracting each from the one beneath it, the rising respirations at Laṅkā from Aries [are]: / one thousand six hundred seventy, one thousand seven hundred ninety-five, and one thousand nine hundred thirty-five.

sanskrit_iast:
svadeśacarakhaṇḍonā bhavantīṣṭodayāsavaḥ /
vyastāvyastairyutāstaistaiḥ karkaṭādyāstatastu yaḥ //
meaning:
स्वदेशचरखण्डोना भवन्तीष्टोदयासवः /
व्यस्ताव्यस्तैर्युतास्तैस्तैः कर्कटाद्यास्ततस्तु यः //
text_mt: Diminished by the local ascensional difference portions, they become the desired rising respirations [for Aries, Taurus, and Gemini]; / increased by those same [portions] in inverse order, [they are the rising respirations] for Cancer and the following signs.

sanskrit_iast:
utkrameṇa ṣaḍevaite bhavantīṣṭāstulādayaḥ /
gatabhogyāsavaḥ kāryāḥ sāyanāḥsveṣṭabhāskarāḥ //
meaning:
उत्क्रमेण षडेवैते भवन्तीष्टास्तुलादयः /
गतभोग्यासवः कार्याः सायनाःस्वेष्टभास्कराः //
text_mt: These six in reverse order are the desired [rising times] for Libra and the rest. / The elapsed and remaining respirations should be calculated, with the ayanāṃśas added to one's desired sun.

sanskrit_iast:
svodayātsuhatā bhaktā bhaktabhogyāḥ svamānataḥ /
abhiṣṭadhaṭikāsubhyo bhogyāsūnpraviśodhayet //
meaning:
स्वोदयात्सुहता भक्ता भक्तभोग्याः स्वमानतः /
अभिष्टधटिकासुभ्यो भोग्यासून्प्रविशोधयेत् //
text_mt: Multiplied well by their own rising [times] and divided by their own measure, the elapsed and to-be-passed [degrees] are obtained; / from the desired respirations of the ghaṭikās, one should subtract the respirations yet to be passed.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadevaiṣyalagnāsūnevaṃ vyāptāstathā kramāt /
śeṣaṃ triṃśatkramāddhyastamaśuddhena vibhājitam //
meaning:
तद्वदेवैष्यलग्नासूनेवं व्याप्तास्तथा क्रमात् /
शेषं त्रिंशत्क्रमाद्ध्यस्तमशुद्धेन विभाजितम् //
text_mt: Likewise with the respirations of the subsequent rising signs successively traversed in this manner; / the remainder, multiplied by thirty and divided by the unexhausted [rising time],

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgayuktaṃ ca hīnaṃ ca vyayanāṃśaṃ tanuḥ kuje /
prākpaścānnatanāḍībhyastadvallaṅkodayāsubhiḥ //
meaning:
भागयुक्तं च हीनं च व्ययनांशं तनुः कुजे /
प्राक्पश्चान्नतनाडीभ्यस्तद्वल्लङ्कोदयासुभिः //
text_mt: increased or diminished by the degrees, minus the ayanāṃśas, is the ascendant on the horizon. / By the elapsed nāḍīs before and after midday, in the same way, by the rising respirations at Laṅkā,

sanskrit_iast:
bhānau kṣayadhane kṛtvā madhyalagnaṃ tadā bhavet /
bhogyāsūnūnakasyātha bhuktāsūnadhikasya ca //
meaning:
भानौ क्षयधने कृत्वा मध्यलग्नं तदा भवेत् /
भोग्यासूनूनकस्याथ भुक्तासूनधिकस्य च //
text_mt: applied as subtractive or additive to the sun, the meridian-ecliptic point is then obtained. / For the lesser, the respirations to be traversed, and for the greater, the respirations already traversed,

sanskrit_iast:
sapiṇḍyāntaralagnāsūnevaṃ syātkālasādhanam /
virāhvarkabhujāṃśāścedindrālpāḥ syād graho vidhoḥ //
meaning:
सपिण्ड्यान्तरलग्नासूनेवं स्यात्कालसाधनम् /
विराह्वर्कभुजांशाश्चेदिन्द्राल्पाः स्याद् ग्रहो विधोः //
text_mt: together with the respirations of the intervening signs, thus constitutes the computation of time. / If the base degrees of the sun diminished by Rāhu are less than twelve, an eclipse of the moon takes place.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ śivaghnāḥ śailāptā vyāvarkājaḥ śarāeṅgulaiḥ /
arkaṃ vidhurvidhuṃ bhūbhā chādayatyathā channakam //
meaning:
तेषां शिवघ्नाः शैलाप्ता व्यावर्काजः शराएङ्गुलैः /
अर्कं विधुर्विधुं भूभा छादयत्यथा छन्नकम् //
text_mt: Multiplied by eleven and divided by seven, they are the celestial latitude of the sun and moon in digits. / The moon covers the sun, and the earth's shadow covers the moon; then, the obscured portion [is calculated].

sanskrit_iast:
chādyachādakamānārdhaṃ śaronaṃ grāhyavarjitam /
tatsvacchannaṃ ca mānaikyārddhāṃśaṣaṣṭaṃ daśāhatam //
meaning:
छाद्यछादकमानार्धं शरोनं ग्राह्यवर्जितम् /
तत्स्वच्छन्नं च मानैक्यार्द्धांशषष्टं दशाहतम् //
text_mt: Half the sum of the diameters of the eclipsed and eclipsing bodies, diminished by the latitude, is the obscured part; / that is the eclipsed portion; and one-sixtieth of half the sum of diameters multiplied by ten,

sanskrit_iast:
channaghnamasmānmūlaṃ tu khāṅgonaglauvapurhṛtam /
sthityarddhaṃ ghaṭikādisyādvyaṅgabāhvaṃśasaṃmitaiḥ //
meaning:
छन्नघ्नमस्मान्मूलं तु खाङ्गोनग्लौवपुर्हृतम् /
स्थित्यर्द्धं घटिकादिस्याद्व्यङ्गबाह्वंशसंमितैः //
text_mt: multiplied by the obscured part—the square root of this, divided by the moon's diameter diminished by sixty, / yields the half-duration in ghaṭikās and so on, by degrees corresponding to the arm devoid of limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭaiḥ palaistadūnāḍhyaṃ vyagāvūner'kaṣaṅguṇaḥ /
tadanyathādhike tasminnevaṃ spaṣṭe sukhāntyage //
meaning:
इष्टैः पलैस्तदूनाढ्यं व्यगावूनेर्ऽकषङ्गुणः /
तदन्यथाधिके तस्मिन्नेवं स्पष्टे सुखान्त्यगे //
text_mt: Diminished or increased by that according to the desired minutes, if less than seventy, the sun is multiplied by six; / otherwise, when it is greater, the beginning and end [of the eclipse] are thus made clear.

sanskrit_iast:
grāsena svāhate cchādyamānāme syurviśopakāḥ /
pūrṇāntaṃ madhyamatra syāddarśānteñjaṃ tribhonakam //
meaning:
ग्रासेन स्वाहते च्छाद्यमानामे स्युर्विशोपकाः /
पूर्णान्तं मध्यमत्र स्याद्दर्शान्तेञ्जं त्रिभोनकम् //
text_mt: When the obscured part is multiplied by its own [diameter] and divided by the diameter of the eclipsed body, the viśopakas are obtained; / the end of the full moon is the middle here; at the new moon, [one takes] the ecliptic point devoid of three signs.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthak tatkrāntyakṣabhāgasaṃskṛtau syurnatāṃśakāḥ /
taddighnāṃśakṛtidvyūnārddhārkayutā hariḥ //
meaning:
पृथक् तत्क्रान्त्यक्षभागसंस्कृतौ स्युर्नतांशकाः /
तद्दिघ्नांशकृतिद्व्यूनार्द्धार्कयुता हरिः //
text_mt: Adjusted separately by the degrees of declination and latitude, they become the zenith-distance degrees; / their square multiplied by two, minus two, halved, and joined to twelve, is the divisor.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhānāṅgārkaviśleṣāṃśo ḥṃśonaghnāḥ /
purandarāḥ
harāptālaṃbanaṃ svarṇavitribherkādhikonake //
meaning:
त्रिभानाङ्गार्कविश्लेषांशो ःंशोनघ्नाः /
पुरन्दराः
हराप्तालंबनं स्वर्णवित्रिभेर्काधिकोनके //
text_mt: The degrees of the difference between the sun and the point ninety degrees from the ascendant, multiplied by fourteen / and divided by the divisor, give the parallax in longitude, additive or subtractive when the sun is less or greater than that point.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaghnalaṃbanakalāḍhyonastu tithivadyaguḥ /
śaronolaṃbanaṣaḍaghne tallavāḍhyonavitribhāt //
meaning:
विश्वघ्नलंबनकलाढ्योनस्तु तिथिवद्यगुः /
शरोनोलंबनषडघ्ने तल्लवाढ्योनवित्रिभात् //
text_mt: The parallax minutes multiplied by thirteen are added or subtracted as for a lunar day; / diminished by the latitude and multiplied by six, increased or diminished by those parts from the nonagesimal,

sanskrit_iast:
natāṃśāstajāṃsāne prādhṛtastadvivarjita /
śabdenduliptaiḥ ṣaḍbhistu bhaktānatirnatirnatāṃśadik //
meaning:
नतांशास्तजांसाने प्राधृतस्तद्विवर्जित /
शब्देन्दुलिप्तैः षड्भिस्तु भक्तानतिर्नतिर्नतांशदिक् //
text_mt: the zenith-distance degrees in the direction of the zenith distance, subtracted from that, / divided by one hundred and six minutes, yield the parallax in latitude in the direction of the zenith distance.

sanskrit_iast:
tayornāṭyohabhinnaikadik śaraḥ sphuṭatāṃ vrajet /
tataśchannasthitidale sādhye sthityarddhaṣaṭtribhiḥ //
meaning:
तयोर्नाट्योहभिन्नैकदिक् शरः स्फुटतां व्रजेत् /
ततश्छन्नस्थितिदले साध्ये स्थित्यर्द्धषट्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: When their directions are different or the same, the true celestial latitude is arrived at; / then the obscured portion and the half-duration are to be calculated by three-sixteenths of the half-duration.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśastairvintribhandvisthaṃlaṃbanetayoḥ pūrvavat /
saṃskṛtestābhyāṃ sthityarddhe bhavataḥ sphuṭe //
meaning:
अंशस्तैर्विन्त्रिभन्द्विस्थंलंबनेतयोः पूर्ववत् /
संस्कृतेस्ताभ्यां स्थित्यर्द्धे भवतः स्फुटे //
text_mt: With those degrees applied twice to the nonagesimal, parallax is calculated as before; / corrected by these two, the two half-durations become true.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ hīnayuto madhyadarśaḥ kālau mukhāntagau /
arkādyūnā viśva īśā navapañcadaśāṃśakāḥ //
meaning:
ताभ्यां हीनयुतो मध्यदर्शः कालौ मुखान्तगौ /
अर्काद्यूना विश्व ईशा नवपञ्चदशांशकाः //
text_mt: Diminished and increased by these two, the middle new-moon day yields the times of contact and separation. / Less by the sun and others, thirteen, eleven, nine, and fifteen degrees

sanskrit_iast:
kālāṃśāstairūnayukte ravau hyastodayau vidhoḥ /
dṛṣṭvā hyādau kheṭabiṃbaṃ dṛgauñcye laṃbamīkṣya ca //
meaning:
कालांशास्तैरूनयुक्ते रवौ ह्यस्तोदयौ विधोः /
दृष्ट्वा ह्यादौ खेटबिंबं दृगौञ्च्ये लंबमीक्ष्य च //
text_mt: are the time-degrees; when the sun is diminished or increased by them, the setting and rising of the moon occur. / Having first observed the disk of the planet and observed its vertical plumb-line at the altitude,

sanskrit_iast:
talluṃbapāpabiṃbāntardṛṇau vyāptaravighnabhāḥ /
aste sāvayavā jñeyā gataiṣyāstithayo budhaiḥ //
meaning:
तल्लुंबपापबिंबान्तर्दृणौ व्याप्तरविघ्नभाः /
अस्ते सावयवा ज्ञेया गतैष्यास्तिथयो बुधैः //
text_mt: the line of sight between that plumb and the disk covers the ray-shadows; / at sunset, the elapsed and future tithis with their fractional parts should be known by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaste yuktāntibhāgaiśca dvighnatithyāhṛtā sphuṭam /
saṃskāradikalaṃbanamaṅgulādyaṃ prajāyate //
meaning:
व्यस्ते युक्तान्तिभागैश्च द्विघ्नतिथ्याहृता स्फुटम् /
संस्कारदिकलंबनमङ्गुलाद्यं प्रजायते //
text_mt: Taken inversely and combined with the end-portions, clearly divided by twice the tithi, / the deflection, parallax, and so forth in digits and so on are produced from the calculation.

sanskrit_iast:
seṣvaśonāḥ sitaṃ tithyo balannāśonnataṃ vidhoḥ /
śṛṅgamanyatra udvācyaṃ balanāṅgulalekhanāt //
meaning:
सेष्वशोनाः सितं तिथ्यो बलन्नाशोन्नतं विधोः /
शृङ्गमन्यत्र उद्वाच्यं बलनाङ्गुललेखनात् //
text_mt: Diminished by the fifth part, the illuminated portion of the moon is elevated by the force of the deflection; / the cusps are to be described otherwise by drawing the deflection digits.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcatve goṅkaviśikhāḥ śeṣakarṇahatāḥ pṛthak /
vikṛjyakāṅgasiddhāgnibhaktālabdhonasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चत्वे गोङ्कविशिखाः शेषकर्णहताः पृथक् /
विकृज्यकाङ्गसिद्धाग्निभक्तालब्धोनसंयुताः //
text_mt: In the case of the five [planets], nine, nine, and five, multiplied separately by the remaining hypotenuse / and divided by three hundred sixty-six, the results are subtracted or added.

sanskrit_iast:
trijyādhikone śravaṇe vapūṃṣi syurhṛtāḥ kujāt /
ṛjvoranṛjvorvivaraṃ gatyantaravibhājitam //
meaning:
त्रिज्याधिकोने श्रवणे वपूंषि स्युर्हृताः कुजात् /
ऋज्वोरनृज्वोर्विवरं गत्यन्तरविभाजितम् //
text_mt: When the hypotenuse is greater or less than the trijyā, the sizes [of the planets] from Mars onward are derived. / The difference between two direct or two retrograde [planets], divided by the difference of their daily motions,

sanskrit_iast:
vakrartvorgatiyogāmaṃ gamyetīte dinādikam /
khanatyāsaṃskṛtauvveṣūdaksāmyenyentaraṃ yutiḥ //
meaning:
वक्रर्त्वोर्गतियोगामं गम्येतीते दिनादिकम् /
खनत्यासंस्कृतौव्वेषूदक्साम्येन्येन्तरं युतिः //
text_mt: or [divided by] the sum of the motions of a retrograde and a direct one, gives the days and so forth to come or past [at conjunction]. / Adjusted by the parallax in latitude, the difference is taken if their celestial latitudes are in the same direction, and the sum otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyodakkheṭavivaraṃ mānaukyāddholpakaṃ yadā /
yadā bhedolaṃbanādyaṃ sphuṭārthaṃ sūryaparvavat //
meaning:
याम्योदक्खेटविवरं मानौक्याद्धोल्पकं यदा /
यदा भेदोलंबनाद्यं स्फुटार्थं सूर्यपर्ववत् //
text_mt: When the north-south distance of two planets is less than half the sum of their diameters, / then there is an occultation; parallax and so forth are [computed] for true results as in a solar eclipse.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāyanagatau syātāṃ sūryācandramasau yadā /
tayute maṇḍale krāntyau tulyatve vai dhṛtābhidhaḥ //
meaning:
एकायनगतौ स्यातां सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ यदा /
तयुते मण्डले क्रान्त्यौ तुल्यत्वे वै धृताभिधः //
text_mt: When the sun and the moon move in the same solstitial half-cycle, / and their declinations in that combined circle are equal, [the aspect] is called dhṛta (vaidhṛta).

sanskrit_iast:
vipaṭītāyanagatau candrākārai krāntiliptikāḥ /
samāstadā vyatīpāto bhagaṇārddhe tapoyutau //
meaning:
विपटीतायनगतौ चन्द्राकारै क्रान्तिलिप्तिकाः /
समास्तदा व्यतीपातो भगणार्द्धे तपोयुतौ //
text_mt: When the Moon and the Sun are moving in opposite solstices, and their minutes of declination / are equal, then it is vyatīpāta, when the sum of their longitudes is half a revolution [six signs].

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskaredvor bhacakrānta cakrārddhāvadhisaṃsthayoḥ /
dṛkkalpasādhitāṃśādiyuktayoḥ svāvapakramau //
meaning:
भास्करेद्वोर् भचक्रान्त चक्रार्द्धावधिसंस्थयोः /
दृक्कल्पसाधितांशादियुक्तयोः स्वावपक्रमौ //
text_mt: When the Sun and the Moon are situated near the ends of the zodiacal circle or half-circle, / endowed with the degrees and so on calculated through observation, their respective declinations [are obtained].

sanskrit_iast:
athojapadagamyendoḥ krāntirvikṣepasaṃskṛtāḥ /
yadi syādadhikā bhānoḥ krānteḥ pāto gatastadā //
meaning:
अथोजपदगम्येन्दोः क्रान्तिर्विक्षेपसंस्कृताः /
यदि स्यादधिका भानोः क्रान्तेः पातो गतस्तदा //
text_mt: Now, if the Moon's declination, corrected by celestial latitude, in an odd quadrant, / should be greater than the Sun's declination, then the pāta is already past.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnā cetsyāttadā bhāvī vāmaṃ yugmapadasya ca /
yadānyatvaṃ vidhoḥ krāntiḥ kṣepāccedyadi śuddhyati //
meaning:
न्यूना चेत्स्यात्तदा भावी वामं युग्मपदस्य च /
यदान्यत्वं विधोः क्रान्तिः क्षेपाच्चेद्यदि शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: If it should be less, then it is yet to occur; and the reverse is true for an even quadrant. / When there is a difference, if the declination of the Moon is subtracted from the latitude,

sanskrit_iast:
krāntyorjetrijyayābhiste paramāyakramoddhate /
taccāpāntarmarddhavāyorjyabhāvinaśītagau //
meaning:
क्रान्त्योर्जेत्रिज्ययाभिस्ते परमायक्रमोद्धते /
तच्चापान्तर्मर्द्धवायोर्ज्यभाविनशीतगौ //
text_mt: multiplied by the sine of the radius, and divided by the maximum declination, / the arc between them [is obtained], and the sine is applied to the Moon that is yet to occur.

sanskrit_iast:
śodhyaṃ candrādgate pāte tatsūyagatitāḍitam /
candrabhuktyā hṛtaṃ bhānau liptādiśaśivatphalam //
meaning:
शोध्यं चन्द्राद्गते पाते तत्सूयगतिताडितम् /
चन्द्रभुक्त्या हृतं भानौ लिप्तादिशशिवत्फलम् //
text_mt: When the pāta is past, it is to be subtracted from the Moon; multiplied by the Sun's motion / and divided by the Moon's daily motion, the result in minutes and so forth is applied to the Sun just like the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tadūcchaśāṅkapātasya phalaṃ deyaṃ viparyayāt /
karmaitadasakṛttāvatkrāntī yāvatsametayoḥ //
meaning:
तदूच्छशाङ्कपातस्य फलं देयं विपर्ययात् /
कर्मैतदसकृत्तावत्क्रान्ती यावत्समेतयोः //
text_mt: The result of the Moon's node is to be applied inversely. / This operation is repeated until the declinations of both become equal.

sanskrit_iast:
krāntyoḥ samatve pāto 'tha prakṣiptāṃśonite vidhau /
hīner'dvarātraghikāghato bhāvī tātkālike 'dhikā //
meaning:
क्रान्त्योः समत्वे पातो ऽथ प्रक्षिप्तांशोनिते विधौ /
हीनेर्ऽद्वरात्रघिकाघतो भावी तात्कालिके ऽधिका //
text_mt: When their declinations are equal, the pāta occurs. Now, when the Moon is diminished by the projected degrees, / if less, the pāta occurred before midnight; if greater, it will occur at that current time.

sanskrit_iast:
sthirīkṛtārddharā trārddhau dvayorvivaraliptakāḥ /
ṣaṣṭiścācandrabhuktāptā pātakālasya nāḍikāḥ //
meaning:
स्थिरीकृतार्द्धरा त्रार्द्धौ द्वयोर्विवरलिप्तकाः /
षष्टिश्चाचन्द्रभुक्ताप्ता पातकालस्य नाडिकाः //
text_mt: Taking the fixed half of midnight, the minutes of difference between the two, / multiplied by sixty and divided by the Moon's daily motion, are the nāḍikās of the time of the pāta.

sanskrit_iast:
ravīndvormānayogārddhaṃ ṣaṣṭyā saṃguṇya bhājayet /
tayorbhuktayantareṇāptaṃ sthityamarddhāṃ nāḍikādivat //
meaning:
रवीन्द्वोर्मानयोगार्द्धं षष्ट्या संगुण्य भाजयेत् /
तयोर्भुक्तयन्तरेणाप्तं स्थित्यमर्द्धां नाडिकादिवत् //
text_mt: One should multiply half the sum of the diameters of the Sun and the Moon by sixty and divide / by the difference of their daily motions; the result gives half the duration in nāḍikās and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
pātakālaḥ sphuṭo madhyaḥ so 'pi sthityarddhavarjitaḥ /
tasya saṃbhavakālaḥ syāttatsaṃyogektasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
पातकालः स्फुटो मध्यः सो ऽपि स्थित्यर्द्धवर्जितः /
तस्य संभवकालः स्यात्तत्संयोगेक्तसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: The precise middle time of the pāta, minus half the duration, / is its beginning time, and combined with it, it is known as the end.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyantakālayormadhye kālo jñeyo 'tidāruṇaḥ /
prajvalajjvalanākāraḥ sarvakarmasu garhitaḥ //
meaning:
आद्यन्तकालयोर्मध्ये कालो ज्ञेयो ऽतिदारुणः /
प्रज्वलज्ज्वलनाकारः सर्वकर्मसु गर्हितः //
text_mt: The time between the beginning and the end is to be known as exceedingly dreadful, / having the appearance of a blazing fire, and condemned in all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetadgaṇito kiñcitproktaṃ saṃkṣepato dvija /
jātakaṃ vācmi samayādrāśisaṃjñāpuraḥsaram //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde jyotiṣavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतद्गणितो किञ्चित्प्रोक्तं संक्षेपतो द्विज /
जातकं वाच्मि समयाद्राशिसंज्ञापुरःसरम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे ज्योतिषवर्णनं नाम चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus, O twice-born one, a little of mathematical astronomy has been stated in brief. / I shall now explain horoscopy (jātaka) according to time, beginning with the designations of the zodiacal signs.

Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter, named Description of Jyotiṣa, in the second quarter of the Bṛhad-upākhyāna in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanantana uvāca
mūrddhāsyabāhuhṛtkroḍāntarbastivyañjasonakhaḥ /
jānujaṅghāṅghniyugalaṃ kālāṅgāni kriyādayaḥ //
meaning:
सनन्तन उवाच
मूर्द्धास्यबाहुहृत्क्रोडान्तर्बस्तिव्यञ्जसोनखः /
जानुजङ्घाङ्घ्नियुगलं कालाङ्गानि क्रियादयः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / The head, mouth, arms, heart, belly, groin, private parts, anus, / knees, shanks, and pair of feet are the bodily limbs of Time, [signified by] Aries (Kriya) and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumāsphujibudhenduśca ravisaumyasitāḥ kujaḥ /
gurumandārkiguravo meṣādīnāmadhīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
भौमास्फुजिबुधेन्दुश्च रविसौम्यसिताः कुजः /
गुरुमन्दार्किगुरवो मेषादीनामधीश्वराः //
text_mt: Mars, Venus, Mercury, the Moon, the Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, / Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn, and Jupiter are the lords of Aries and the other signs.

sanskrit_iast:
hore viṣamabherkedoḥ samaye śaśisūryayoḥ /
ādipañcanavādhīśādreṣkāṇeśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
होरे विषमभेर्केदोः समये शशिसूर्ययोः /
आदिपञ्चनवाधीशाद्रेष्काणेशाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: In an odd sign, the two horas belong to the Sun and the Moon; in an even sign, to the Moon and the Sun. / The lords of the first, fifth, and ninth signs are taught to be the lords of the drekkāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
pañceṣṭāṣṭādripañcāṃśā kujārkījyajñaśukragāḥ /
oje viparyayādyugme triśāṃśeśāḥ samīritāḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चेष्टाष्टाद्रिपञ्चांशा कुजार्कीज्यज्ञशुक्रगाः /
ओजे विपर्ययाद्युग्मे त्रिशांशेशाः समीरिताः //
text_mt: In an odd sign, portions of five, five, eight, seven, and five degrees / belong to Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus; in an even sign, in reverse order: these are declared the lords of the triṃśāṃśas.

sanskrit_iast:
kriyaṇataulikarkādyā meṣādiṣu navāṃśakāḥ /
svabhāddvādaśabhāgeśāḥ ṣarḍgaṃ rāśipūrvakam //
meaning:
क्रियणतौलिकर्काद्या मेषादिषु नवांशकाः /
स्वभाद्द्वादशभागेशाः षर्ड्गं राशिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Beginning with Aries, Libra, Capricorn, and Cancer are the navāṃśakas in Aries and the rest. / The lords of the dvādaśāṃśas begin with the sign itself. Thus is the sixfold division (ṣaḍvarga) beginning with the rāśi.

sanskrit_iast:
gojāśca karkayugmena rātryākhyā pṛṣṭakodayāḥ /
śeṣā dinākhyāstūbhayaṃ timiḥ krūraḥ saumyaḥ pumān //
meaning:
गोजाश्च कर्कयुग्मेन रात्र्याख्या पृष्टकोदयाः /
शेषा दिनाख्यास्तूभयं तिमिः क्रूरः सौम्यः पुमान् //
text_mt: Taurus, Aries, Cancer, and Gemini are nocturnal signs and rise by the rear. / The rest are diurnal, Pisces is both, cruel, benefic, and masculine.

sanskrit_iast:
pumān srī ca klībaścarasthiradviḥsvabhāvakāḥ /
meṣādyāḥ pūrvatodiksthāḥ svasvasthānacarāstathā //
meaning:
पुमान् स्री च क्लीबश्चरस्थिरद्विःस्वभावकाः /
मेषाद्याः पूर्वतोदिक्स्थाः स्वस्वस्थानचरास्तथा //
text_mt: Male, female, and hermaphrodite; movable, fixed, and dual in nature; / Aries and the rest are situated in the eastern and other directions, moving in their respective places.

sanskrit_iast:
ajokṣeṇāṅganākīṭajhaṣajūkā ināditaḥ /
uccāni dvitrimanuyuktithīṣubhanakhāṃśakaiḥ //
meaning:
अजोक्षेणाङ्गनाकीटझषजूका इनादितः /
उच्चानि द्वित्रिमनुयुक्तिथीषुभनखांशकैः //
text_mt: Aries, Taurus, Capricorn, Virgo, Scorpio, Pisces, and Libra, starting from the Sun, / are the exaltation signs, at the tenth, third, twenty-eighth, fifteenth, twenty-seventh, and twentieth degrees.

sanskrit_iast:
tattatsaptamanīcāni prāṅmadhyāntyāṃśakāḥ kramāt /
vargottamāścarādheṣu bhāvāddvādaśa mūrtimān //
meaning:
तत्तत्सप्तमनीचानि प्राङ्मध्यान्त्यांशकाः क्रमात् /
वर्गोत्तमाश्चराधेषु भावाद्द्वादश मूर्तिमान् //
text_mt: Their seventh signs are the debilitations. The first, middle, and last ninths, respectively, / are vargottama in movable, [fixed, and dual signs]. From the ascendant, the twelve houses have bodily form.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhokṣāvisraścatau likubhāḥ sūryātrikoṇabham /
caturasraṃ tūryamṛtyutrikoṇaṃ navapañcamam //
meaning:
सिंहोक्षाविस्रश्चतौ लिकुभाः सूर्यात्रिकोणभम् /
चतुरस्रं तूर्यमृत्युत्रिकोणं नवपञ्चमम् //
text_mt: Leo, Taurus, Aries, Virgo, Libra, and Aquarius are the mūlatrikoṇa signs of the planets beginning with the Sun. / The caturasra is the fourth and eighth houses; the trikoṇa is the ninth and fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
riḥphaāṣṭaṣaṭkaṃ trikabhaṃ kendraṃ prākturyasaptakham /
nṛpādaḥ kīṭapaśavo balāḍhyāḥ kendragāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
रिःफआष्टषट्कं त्रिकभं केन्द्रं प्राक्तुर्यसप्तखम् /
नृपादः कीटपशवो बलाढ्याः केन्द्रगाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: The twelfth, eighth, and sixth houses are the trika houses. The kendra is the first, fourth, seventh, and tenth. / Humans, quadrupeds, scorpions, and animals are strong when situated in the kendras, in order.

sanskrit_iast:
kendrātparaṃ paṇapharamāpoklimamataḥ param /
raktaḥ śvetaḥ śukanibhaḥ pāṭalo dhūmrapāṇḍurau //
meaning:
केन्द्रात्परं पणफरमापोक्लिममतः परम् /
रक्तः श्वेतः शुकनिभः पाटलो धूम्रपाण्डुरौ //
text_mt: Succeeding the kendras are the paṇapharas, and after that are the āpoklimas. / Red, white, parrot-colored, pale red, smoky, pale yellow,

sanskrit_iast:
citraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pītapiṅgau babhruḥ svacchaḥ prabhākriyāt /
sāmyāśākhyaplavatvaṃ syāddvitīye vaśirarkabhāt //
meaning:
चित्रः कृष्णः पीतपिङ्गौ बभ्रुः स्वच्छः प्रभाक्रियात् /
साम्याशाख्यप्लवत्वं स्याद्द्वितीये वशिरर्कभात् //
text_mt: variegated, black, yellow-tawny, brown, and clear are their hues, from Aries onward. / A vessel is named after its equal direction; in the second from the Sun's sign is the vaśi yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
kālātmārke manaścadraḥ kujaḥ satvaṃ vacobudhaḥ /
jīvo jñānaṃ sukhaṃ śukraḥ kāmo duḥkhaṃ dineśajaḥ //
meaning:
कालात्मार्के मनश्चद्रः कुजः सत्वं वचोबुधः /
जीवो ज्ञानं सुखं शुक्रः कामो दुःखं दिनेशजः //
text_mt: The Sun is the soul of Time, the Moon is the mind, Mars is strength, Mercury is speech, / Jupiter is knowledge, Venus is pleasure, passion [is Mars], and the son of the Sun (Saturn) is sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpau ravīndū netāsṛk kumāro jñaḥ kavījyakau /
sacivo sūryajaḥ preṣyo mato jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ //
meaning:
नृपौ रवीन्दू नेतासृक् कुमारो ज्ञः कवीज्यकौ /
सचिवो सूर्यजः प्रेष्यो मतो ज्योतिर्विदां वरैः //
text_mt: The Sun and the Moon are kings; Mars is the army chief; Mercury is the crown prince; Venus and Jupiter / are ministers; and the son of the Sun is a servant: thus it is considered by the best of astronomers.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmraśuklaraktaharitpītacitrāsitā raveḥ /
varṇā va avyahaharīdrā śacīkaudhipāraveḥ //
meaning:
ताम्रशुक्लरक्तहरित्पीतचित्रासिता रवेः /
वर्णा व अव्यहहरीद्रा शचीकौधिपारवेः //
text_mt: Copper-colored, white, blood-red, green, yellow, variegated, and dark are the Sun's [and others'] / colors; their presiding deities are Fire, Water, Skanda, Viṣṇu, Indra, Śacī, and Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
raviśukrārarāhvarkenduvidījyā digīśvarāḥ /
kṣīṇendvarkāraravijāḥ pāpā pāpayuto budhaḥ //
meaning:
रविशुक्रारराह्वर्केन्दुविदीज्या दिगीश्वराः /
क्षीणेन्द्वर्काररविजाः पापा पापयुतो बुधः //
text_mt: The Sun, Venus, Mars, Rāhu, Saturn, the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are the lords of the directions. / The waning Moon, the Sun, Mars, and Saturn are malefics; Mercury conjoined with a malefic is malefic.

sanskrit_iast:
klibau budhārkī śukrendū sriyau śeṣā narāḥ smṛtāḥ /
śikhibhūmipayovārivāsino bhūsutādayaḥ //
meaning:
क्लिबौ बुधार्की शुक्रेन्दू स्रियौ शेषा नराः स्मृताः /
शिखिभूमिपयोवारिवासिनो भूसुतादयः //
text_mt: Mercury and Saturn are hermaphrodites; Venus and the Moon are females; the rest are considered males. / The sons of the Earth and the others dwell in fire, earth, water, and wind.

sanskrit_iast:
kavījyau kujasūryauṃ ca vedo jño varṇapāḥ kramāt /
saurāeṃ'tyajādhipaḥ prokto rāhurmlecchādhipastathā //
meaning:
कवीज्यौ कुजसूर्यौं च वेदो ज्ञो वर्णपाः क्रमात् /
सौराएंऽत्यजाधिपः प्रोक्तो राहुर्म्लेच्छाधिपस्तथा //
text_mt: Venus and Jupiter, Mars and the Sun, the Moon, and Mercury are the lords of the four castes in order. / Saturn is declared the lord of the outcastes, and Rāhu the lord of the barbarians (mlecchas).

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkajīvājñasitau kujārkī sāttvikādikāḥ /
devatendvagniraivalābhūkosakhāyoparādhipāḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्कजीवाज्ञसितौ कुजार्की सात्त्विकादिकाः /
देवतेन्द्वग्निरैवलाभूकोसखायोपराधिपाः //
text_mt: The Moon, Sun, and Jupiter; Mercury and Venus; Mars and Saturn are sattvic and so forth. / Their deities are the Moon, Fire, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Earth, Indra, and Brahmā as lords of clothes and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
vasraṃ sthalaṃ navaṃ vahnikahataṃ madyadaṃ tathā /
sphuṭitaṃ ravitastāṃmraṃ tāre tāmrapunistathā //
meaning:
वस्रं स्थलं नवं वह्निकहतं मद्यदं तथा /
स्फुटितं रवितस्तांम्रं तारे ताम्रपुनिस्तथा //
text_mt: Coarse cloth, new cloth, burnt by fire, soaked in wine, / torn cloth from the Sun [and others]; copper, bell-metal, and copper again,

sanskrit_iast:
hemakāṃsyāyasī tryaṃśaiḥśiśirādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
sauraśukrāracandrajñaguruṣūdyatsu ca kramāt //
meaning:
हेमकांस्यायसी त्र्यंशैःशिशिराद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः /
सौरशुक्रारचन्द्रज्ञगुरुषूद्यत्सु च क्रमात् //
text_mt: gold, brass, and iron are declared by third-parts, with winter and the other seasons, / in order when Saturn, Venus, Mars, the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter are rising.

sanskrit_iast:
tryāśatrikoṇaturyāṣṭasaptamānyena vṛddhitaḥ /
saurejyārāpare pūrṇe kramātpaśyanti nārada //
meaning:
त्र्याशत्रिकोणतुर्याष्टसप्तमान्येन वृद्धितः /
सौरेज्यारापरे पूर्णे क्रमात्पश्यन्ति नारद //
text_mt: By one-third, trikoṇa, fourth and eighth, and the seventh, with increasing strength, / Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars cast their full aspects, in order, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
ayanakṣaṇaghasrartumāsārddhaśarado raveḥ /
kaṭutiktakṣāramiśramadhurāmlakaṣāyakāḥ //
meaning:
अयनक्षणघस्रर्तुमासार्द्धशरदो रवेः /
कटुतिक्तक्षारमिश्रमधुराम्लकषायकाः //
text_mt: Solstice, muhūrta, day, season, half-month, and year belong to the Sun and the others; / pungent, bitter, saline, mixed, sweet, sour, and astringent are their tastes.

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇātsāṃtyadhādharmāyuḥ sukhakhodyapaḥ suhṛt /
jīvo jīvajñau sitajñau vyarkā vyārāḥ kramādamī //
meaning:
त्रिकोणात्सांत्यधाधर्मायुः सुखखोद्यपः सुहृत् /
जीवो जीवज्ञौ सितज्ञौ व्यर्का व्याराः क्रमादमी //
text_mt: The lord of the ninth, eighth, fourth, and tenth houses from the mūlatrikoṇa is a friend; / Jupiter, Jupiter and Mercury, Venus and Mercury, those without the Sun, those without Mars, in order,

sanskrit_iast:
vīndvarkā vikujendvarkāḥ suhṛdo 'nyeraverdhṛtāḥ /
mithodhanavyayāyatribandhuvyāpāragaḥ suhṛt //
meaning:
वीन्द्वर्का विकुजेन्द्वर्काः सुहृदो ऽन्येरवेर्धृताः /
मिथोधनव्ययायत्रिबन्धुव्यापारगः सुहृत् //
text_mt: those without the Moon and Sun, those without Mars, the Moon, and the Sun: these are the friends of the Sun and the rest. / One situated mutually in the second, twelfth, eleventh, third, fourth, or tenth is a friend.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyekānubhaktā mayān jñātvā miśrīdītsahajānmune /
matkālodhisuhṛnmitrapūrvakānkalpayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
ध्येकानुभक्ता मयान् ज्ञात्वा मिश्रीदीत्सहजान्मुने /
मत्कालोधिसुहृन्मित्रपूर्वकान्कल्पयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: Having known them, divided by two and combined together, O sage, / one should calculate again the friends, neutrals, and enemies of the present time.

sanskrit_iast:
svoccatrikoṇagehā pranavāṃśaisthānajaṃ balam /
dikṣu saumyejyayoḥ sūryārayoḥ saure sitābjayoḥ //
meaning:
स्वोच्चत्रिकोणगेहा प्रनवांशैस्थानजं बलम् /
दिक्षु सौम्येज्ययोः सूर्यारयोः सौरे सिताब्जयोः //
text_mt: Positional strength comes from one's exaltation, trikoṇa, own house, and friendly navāṃśaka; / directional strength belongs to Mercury and Jupiter [in the east], the Sun and Mars [in the south], Saturn [in the west], Venus and the Moon [in the north].

sanskrit_iast:
ravāhṛtūdaganenye tu vakri ca samāgame /
uttarasthā dīptakarāśceṣṭā vīryayutā matāḥ //
meaning:
रवाहृतूदगनेन्ये तु वक्रि च समागमे /
उत्तरस्था दीप्तकराश्चेष्टा वीर्ययुता मताः //
text_mt: Those with northward courses, retrograde, or in planetary conjunction with the Sun, / situated in the north, possessing bright rays, are considered endowed with motional strength.

sanskrit_iast:
niśīndukujasaurāśca sarvadā kṣohni cāpare /
krūrāḥ kṛṣṇe site saumyāḥ mataṃ kālabalaṃ budhaiḥ //
meaning:
निशीन्दुकुजसौराश्च सर्वदा क्षोह्नि चापरे /
क्रूराः कृष्णे सिते सौम्याः मतं कालबलं बुधैः //
text_mt: By night the Moon, Mars, and Saturn, and by day the others; / the malefics in the dark fortnight, the benefics in the bright: this is considered temporal strength by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
saurārajñejyaśukrendusūryādhikyaṃ parasparam /
pāpāstu balinaḥ saumyā vivakṣāḥ kaṇṭakopage //
meaning:
सौरारज्ञेज्यशुक्रेन्दुसूर्याधिक्यं परस्परम् /
पापास्तु बलिनः सौम्या विवक्षाः कण्टकोपगे //
text_mt: Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, the Moon, and the Sun increase progressively in strength. / Malefics are strong, and benefics are weak when situated in the angles.

sanskrit_iast:
klībe tadūśanādvāpi candrārkāṃśasamaṃ januḥ /
svāṃśe pāpāḥ parāṃśasthāḥ saumyālagnaṃ viyonijam //
meaning:
क्लीबे तदूशनाद्वापि चन्द्रार्कांशसमं जनुः /
स्वांशे पापाः परांशस्थाः सौम्यालग्नं वियोनिजम् //
text_mt: When a hermaphrodite is aspected by Venus, or equal to the Moon and Sun's degree, birth occurs; / when malefics are in their own navāṃśas and benefics are in other navāṃśas, the ascendant is non-human.

sanskrit_iast:
nirbalaṃ ca tadādeśyaṃ viyonerjanma paṇḍitaiḥ /
śīrṣaṃ vakragale pādāvaṃsau pṛṣṭamurastathā //
meaning:
निर्बलं च तदादेश्यं वियोनेर्जन्म पण्डितैः /
शीर्षं वक्रगले पादावंसौ पृष्टमुरस्तथा //
text_mt: When it is devoid of strength, a non-human birth is to be declared by the learned. / The head, face, neck, feet, shoulders, back, and chest

sanskrit_iast:
pārśve kukṣī tvapānāṅghrī meḍhramuṣkau tathā sphijau /
pucchaṃ catuṣpadāṅgeṣu meṣādyā rāśayaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
पार्श्वे कुक्षी त्वपानाङ्घ्री मेढ्रमुष्कौ तथा स्फिजौ /
पुच्छं चतुष्पदाङ्गेषु मेषाद्या राशयः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The ribs, belly, anus and feet, penis and testicles, and likewise the buttocks / and tail—among the limbs of four-footed beasts, the signs starting with Aries are considered [to represent these].

sanskrit_iast:
lagnāṃśādgrahayugdṛṣṭvā varṇānbalayutādvadet /
dṛksamānapramāṇāṃśca iṣṭe rekhāṃ smarasthitaiḥ //
meaning:
लग्नांशाद्ग्रहयुग्दृष्ट्वा वर्णान्बलयुताद्वदेत् /
दृक्समानप्रमाणांश्च इष्टे रेखां स्मरस्थितैः //
text_mt: From the degree of the ascendant and from planets conjoined or aspecting, when endowed with strength, one should declare the colors; / and [one should declare] forms conforming to those aspects, and lines on desired [limbs] by planets standing in the seventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
khagatryaṃśe balāgnege caramāṃśe grahānvite /
vāṃśe sthalāṃbujaḥ saurerdvīkṣāyogabhavā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
खगत्र्यंशे बलाग्नेगे चरमांशे ग्रहान्विते /
वांशे स्थलांबुजः सौरेर्द्वीक्षायोगभवा द्विजाः //
text_mt: When a decanate is in an airy sign, endowed with strength, or in a movable degree conjoined with a planet, / or in its own degree, [the creature is] terrestrial or aquatic; from Saturn's aspect and conjunction, twice-born [birds or reptiles] arise.

sanskrit_iast:
vipralaistanujacandrejyārkaistarūṇāṃ janiṃ vadet /
sthalāṃbubhendośakṛtaścetareṣāmudāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विप्रलैस्तनुजचन्द्रेज्यार्कैस्तरूणां जनिं वदेत् /
स्थलांबुभेन्दोशकृतश्चेतरेषामुदाहृतः //
text_mt: Through planets devoid of strength, or through the son of the bodily [ruler], the Moon, Jupiter, and the Sun, one should declare the birth of trees; / and it is taught to be terrestrial or aquatic according to the signs and degrees of the Moon and others.

sanskrit_iast:
sthalāṃbu ca patiḥ kheṭo lagnādyāvanmite gṛhe /
tāvanta eva takhaḥ sthalajā jalajāstathā //
meaning:
स्थलांबु च पतिः खेटो लग्नाद्यावन्मिते गृहे /
तावन्त एव तखः स्थलजा जलजास्तथा //
text_mt: As far as the planetary lord of land and water is situated in a house counting from the ascendant, / just so many are the trees born on land and born in water.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥsārā ravau saure durbhagāḥ kṣīriṇo vidhau /
bhaume kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā ījye jñe saphalāphalau //
meaning:
अन्तःसारा रवौ सौरे दुर्भगाः क्षीरिणो विधौ /
भौमे कण्टकिनो वृक्षा ईज्ये ज्ञे सफलाफलौ //
text_mt: Trees are heartwood-rich under the Sun, deformed and sapless under Saturn, milky under the Moon, / thorny under Mars, fruitful under Jupiter, and fruitless under Mercury.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpitā bhārgave snigdhāścandre 'tha kaṭukāḥ kuje /
aśubharkṣe śubhaḥ kheṭaḥ śubhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ kubhūmijam //
meaning:
पुष्पिता भार्गवे स्निग्धाश्चन्द्रे ऽथ कटुकाः कुजे /
अशुभर्क्षे शुभः खेटः शुभं वृक्षं कुभूमिजम् //
text_mt: Under Venus they are flowering and glossy; then under Mars they are bitter. / A benefic planet in a malefic sign produces an auspicious tree grown in poor soil;

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādvilomago vāpi svāṃśoktaparagaiḥ samam /
kujenduhetukaṃ srīṇāṃ pratimāsamihārtavam //
meaning:
कुर्याद्विलोमगो वापि स्वांशोक्तपरगैः समम् /
कुजेन्दुहेतुकं स्रीणां प्रतिमासमिहार्तवम् //
text_mt: or when retrograde, it acts similarly to planets in another's sign with degrees of their own. / The monthly menstruation of women here is caused by Mars and the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
neṣṭasthejye 'nyathāste srīyuṅktāsannarekṣite /
pāpayuktekṣite dyūne ruṣā prītyā śubhagrahaiḥ //
meaning:
नेष्टस्थेज्ये ऽन्यथास्ते स्रीयुङ्क्तासन्नरेक्षिते /
पापयुक्तेक्षिते द्यूने रुषा प्रीत्या शुभग्रहैः //
text_mt: If Jupiter is in the seventh house, it is unfavorable; otherwise, if the Moon is in the seventh house, aspected by a man, [conception occurs]; / if the seventh house is conjoined or aspected by malefics, it occurs through anger, and through love if by benefic planets.

sanskrit_iast:
śukrārkendujaiḥ svāṃśasthairījya cāṅgatrikoṇage /
bhavedapatyaṃ viprendra puṃsāṃ sadvīryaśālinām //
meaning:
शुक्रार्केन्दुजैः स्वांशस्थैरीज्य चाङ्गत्रिकोणगे /
भवेदपत्यं विप्रेन्द्र पुंसां सद्वीर्यशालिनाम् //
text_mt: When Venus, the Sun, and Mercury occupy their own navāṃśas and Jupiter is in the ascendant or a trine, / an offspring is born, O foremost of Brahmins, to men endowed with good virility.

sanskrit_iast:
asrer'kendo kujārkī cetpuṃsriyorāmayapradau /
vyayakhago yuktau caikadṛṣṭyā nṛtyupradau tayoḥ //
meaning:
अस्रेर्ऽकेन्दो कुजार्की चेत्पुंस्रियोरामयप्रदौ /
व्ययखगो युक्तौ चैकदृष्ट्या नृत्युप्रदौ तयोः //
text_mt: If Mars and the Sun occupy the places of the Moon and the Sun, they bring disease to the man and woman; / and if they occupy the twelfth house together with a single aspect, they bring death to both.

sanskrit_iast:
śukrārkrau mātṛpitarau divā naktaṃ śaśīnajau /
mātṛṣvasṛpitṛvyākhyau vā padmeji same śubhau //
meaning:
शुक्रार्क्रौ मातृपितरौ दिवा नक्तं शशीनजौ /
मातृष्वसृपितृव्याख्यौ वा पद्मेजि समे शुभौ //
text_mt: Venus and the Sun are mother and father by day, and the Moon and Saturn by night; / or Venus and Jupiter are called maternal aunt and paternal uncle, being auspicious in even signs.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpadṛṣṭe śubhe kṣīṇe tuṅge vā lagnageyame /
kṣīṇendukujasaṃdṛṣṭe mṛtyumetya gatā dhruvam //
meaning:
पापदृष्टे शुभे क्षीणे तुङ्गे वा लग्नगेयमे /
क्षीणेन्दुकुजसंदृष्टे मृत्युमेत्य गता ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: If a benefic is aspected by a malefic and waning, or if Saturn is in exaltation in the ascendant, / aspected by the waning Moon and Mars, she surely meets with death and passes away.

sanskrit_iast:
yugapadvā pṛthaksasthau lagnendū pāpamadhyagau /
yadā tadā garbhayutā nārī mṛtyumavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
युगपद्वा पृथक्सस्थौ लग्नेन्दू पापमध्यगौ /
यदा तदा गर्भयुता नारी मृत्युमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Or when the ascendant and the Moon together or separately are hemmed between malefics, / then the pregnant woman meets her death.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnāṃñcadrācca turyasthaiḥ pāpairnidhanage kuje /
naṣṭendau kujaravyośca bandhuriṣpagayormṛtiḥ //
meaning:
लग्नांञ्चद्राच्च तुर्यस्थैः पापैर्निधनगे कुजे /
नष्टेन्दौ कुजरव्योश्च बन्धुरिष्पगयोर्मृतिः //
text_mt: When malefics are in the fourth from the ascendant and from the Moon, and Mars is in the eighth, / or when the Moon is vanished, and Mars and the Sun are in the fourth and twelfth, death ensues.

sanskrit_iast:
tanvastasaṃsthayorbhauṃmaravyoḥ śasrabhavaḥ kṣayaḥ /
yanmāsādhipatirnaṣṭastanmāsaṃ saṃsrave tyajet //
meaning:
तन्वस्तसंस्थयोर्भौंमरव्योः शस्रभवः क्षयः /
यन्मासाधिपतिर्नष्टस्तन्मासं संस्रवे त्यजेत् //
text_mt: When Mars and the Sun occupy the ascendant and the seventh, destruction occurs through weapons. / When the lord of a month is lost, one should avoid that month during miscarriage.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnendugaiḥ śubhaiḥ kheṭaisrikoṇārthāstabhūkhagaiḥ /
pāpaisriṣaṣṭalābhasthaiḥ sukhī garbho ravīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
लग्नेन्दुगैः शुभैः खेटैस्रिकोणार्थास्तभूखगैः /
पापैस्रिषष्टलाभस्थैः सुखी गर्भो रवीक्षितः //
text_mt: When benefics are in the ascendant and Moon, and planets are in the trine, second, seventh, and tenth houses, / and malefics are in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses aspected by the Sun, the fetus remains happy.

sanskrit_iast:
ojabhe puruṣāṃśer'kejyendulagnairbalānvitaiḥ /
gurvakārai viṣamasthau vā yuñjanma pravadettadā //
meaning:
ओजभे पुरुषांशेर्ऽकेज्येन्दुलग्नैर्बलान्वितैः /
गुर्वकारै विषमस्थौ वा युञ्जन्म प्रवदेत्तदा //
text_mt: In an odd sign, when the Sun, Jupiter, the Moon, and the ascendant are in masculine degrees and endowed with strength, / or when Jupiter and the Sun are in odd signs, one should then declare the birth of a boy.

sanskrit_iast:
yugmabhāṃśasthitaistaistu vakrendubhṛgubhistathā /
yāmasthānagatairvācyaṃ sriyo janma manīṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
युग्मभांशस्थितैस्तैस्तु वक्रेन्दुभृगुभिस्तथा /
यामस्थानगतैर्वाच्यं स्रियो जन्म मनीषिभिः //
text_mt: Through those situated in even signs and degrees, and likewise through Mars, the Moon, and Venus / situated in even houses, the birth of a female should be declared by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgasthā budhasaṃdṛṣṭāḥ svapakṣeya malaṅkarāḥ /
lagnaṃ vinaujabhāvasthaḥ sauraḥ puñjanmakṛttathā //
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गस्था बुधसंदृष्टाः स्वपक्षेय मलङ्कराः /
लग्नं विनौजभावस्थः सौरः पुञ्जन्मकृत्तथा //
text_mt: Situated in dual signs and aspected by Mercury, they adorn their own side; / and Saturn situated in an odd house other than the ascendant likewise causes the birth of a boy.

sanskrit_iast:
mitho ravīndūrjñārkī vā paśyataḥ samagaṃ raviḥ /
vakro vāṅgavidhū oje jajñau yugmaujasaṃsthitau //
meaning:
मिथो रवीन्दूर्ज्ञार्की वा पश्यतः समगं रविः /
वक्रो वाङ्गविधू ओजे जज्ञौ युग्मौजसंस्थितौ //
text_mt: The Sun and the Moon or Mercury and Saturn mutually aspect; or the Sun is in an even sign; / or Mars aspects the ascendant and the Moon in an odd sign—twins are born in even and odd positions.

sanskrit_iast:
kujekṣitepumāṃśeduhitā klība janmadā /
same sitendū ojasthā jñārāṅgojyā nṛvīkṣitau //
meaning:
कुजेक्षितेपुमांशेदुहिता क्लीब जन्मदा /
समे सितेन्दू ओजस्था ज्ञाराङ्गोज्या नृवीक्षितौ //
text_mt: If aspected by Mars in a masculine degree, a daughter is born; or it causes the birth of a hermaphrodite. / If Venus and the Moon are in an even sign, and Mercury, Mars, the ascendant, and Jupiter are in an odd sign aspected by a male;

sanskrit_iast:
lagnendusamagau yugmasthāne vā yamalaṅkarāḥ /
grahodayasthāndyaṅgāṃśānpaśyati jñe svabhāgage //
meaning:
लग्नेन्दुसमगौ युग्मस्थाने वा यमलङ्कराः /
ग्रहोदयस्थान्द्यङ्गांशान्पश्यति ज्ञे स्वभागगे //
text_mt: or if the ascendant and the Moon are in an even sign, or in an even place, they produce twins. / When Mercury, situated in its own degree, aspects the dual navāṃśas rising in the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
tritayaṃ jñāṃśakādyugmamamiśraiḥ samamādiśet /
lagne cāpāntyabhāgasthe tadaṃśasthabaligrahaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रितयं ज्ञांशकाद्युग्मममिश्रैः सममादिशेत् /
लग्ने चापान्त्यभागस्थे तदंशस्थबलिग्रहैः //
text_mt: one should predict triplets from Mercury's degree, twins from unmixed signs, and parity accordingly. / When the ascendant is in the last degree of Sagittarius with strong planets in that degree,

sanskrit_iast:
vīryāḍhyajñārkisadṛṣṭaiḥ kośasthāvahavoginaḥ /
sitārejyārkacandrārkijñāṅgeśorkendavo 'dhipāḥ //
meaning:
वीर्याढ्यज्ञार्किसदृष्टैः कोशस्थावहवोगिनः /
सितारेज्यार्कचन्द्रार्किज्ञाङ्गेशोर्केन्दवो ऽधिपाः //
text_mt: aspected by strong Mercury and Saturn, triplets are born within the membrane. / Venus, Mars, Jupiter, the Sun, the Moon, Saturn, Mercury, the lord of the ascendant, the Sun, and the Moon are the lords

sanskrit_iast:
māsānāṃ tatsamaṃ vācyaṃ garbagasthasya śubhāśubham /
trikome jñe parairnaṣṭairdvimukhāhnikapānvitaḥ //
meaning:
मासानां तत्समं वाच्यं गर्बगस्थस्य शुभाशुभम् /
त्रिकोमे ज्ञे परैर्नष्टैर्द्विमुखाह्निकपान्वितः //
text_mt: of the months; good or bad for the one in the womb should be declared in accordance with them. / When Mercury is in a trine while the others are lost, [the child] has two faces or holds a day-ruler's nature.

sanskrit_iast:
avāgāvāṭāvaśubhairbhasaṃdhisthaiḥ prajāyate /
vīrānsagīścadaṣṭedhvaṣṭārkātabhasaṃhitāḥ //
meaning:
अवागावाटावशुभैर्भसंधिस्थैः प्रजायते /
वीरान्सगीश्चदष्टेध्वष्टार्कातभसंहिताः //
text_mt: One is born speechless or blind through malefics situated in sign-junctions, / or deformed with teeth destroyed when conjoined with signs afflicted by the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ārārkī cejyabhāṃśasthau sadantogarbhakastadāḥ /
kharbheje bhuvimandāradṛṣṭe kubjastu garbhagaḥ /
pargurmīne yamedvārairdaṣṭethāṅgebhaghasaṃdhige //
meaning:
आरार्की चेज्यभांशस्थौ सदन्तोगर्भकस्तदाः /
खर्भेजे भुविमन्दारदृष्टे कुब्जस्तु गर्भगः /
पर्गुर्मीने यमेद्वारैर्दष्टेथाङ्गेभघसंधिगे //
text_mt: If Mars and Saturn occupy a degree of Jupiter, then the child in the womb has teeth. / If in Aries or a sign of the Earth aspected by Saturn and Mars, the fetus is a hunchback; / or if Pisces is the ascendant and Saturn occupies a door and is aspected by malefics, or the ascendant is in a sign-junction,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpairjaḍo vidhau garbhaḥ śubhadṛṣṭivivarjite /
mṛgāntyage vāmanakaḥ sauredrarkanirīkṣite /
dhīnayodapagaistryaṃśaiḥ pāpāstairasirohradāḥ //
meaning:
पापैर्जडो विधौ गर्भः शुभदृष्टिविवर्जिते /
मृगान्त्यगे वामनकः सौरेद्रर्कनिरीक्षिते /
धीनयोदपगैस्त्र्यंशैः पापास्तैरसिरोह्रदाः //
text_mt: the fetus is dull-witted through malefics when the Moon is devoid of the aspect of benefics. / If in the end of Capricorn, aspected by Saturn and the Sun, [the child is] a dwarf; / by malefics occupying decanates of the fifth or watery signs, [they are born] headless or lacking limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ravīnduyukte siṃheṅge māheyārkinirīkṣite /
netrahīnā miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe buddhudalocanāḥ /
vyayejo vāmanayanaṃ dakṣaṃ sūryo vināśayet //
meaning:
रवीन्दुयुक्ते सिंहेङ्गे माहेयार्किनिरीक्षिते /
नेत्रहीना मिश्रखेटैर्दृष्टे बुद्धुदलोचनाः /
व्ययेजो वामनयनं दक्षं सूर्यो विनाशयेत् //
text_mt: When Leo is the ascendant conjoined with the Sun and Moon and aspected by Mars and Saturn, / [the child is] blind; if aspected by mixed planets, they have bubble-like eyes. / Jupiter in the twelfth destroys the left eye, and the Sun destroys the right.

sanskrit_iast:
neṣṭā yogāḥ śubhairdṛṣṭāḥ pāpāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ /
mande 'ste mandabhāṃśeṅge niṣaikebdatraye janiḥ //
meaning:
नेष्टा योगाः शुभैर्दृष्टाः पापाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः /
मन्दे ऽस्ते मन्दभांशेङ्गे निषैकेब्दत्रये जनिः //
text_mt: Inauspicious combinations aspected by benefics become auspicious; of this there is no doubt. / When Saturn is in the seventh house and the ascendant is in Saturn's degree, birth occurs three years after conception;

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśābde śaśinyevaṃ sutāvapi vicintayet //
meaning: द्वादशाब्दे शशिन्येवं सुतावपि विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: in the twelfth year if the Moon is likewise situated: so one should consider concerning the child.

sanskrit_iast: ādhānendudvādaśāṃśā pāpāstadrāśibhiḥ puraḥ //
meaning: आधानेन्दुद्वादशांशा पापास्तद्राशिभिः पुरः //
text_mt: Malefics in the dvādaśāṃśa of the Moon at conception, preceded by those signs,

sanskrit_iast: śaśāṅke janmabhāgādidvi ghnamiṣṭakalāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning: शशाङ्के जन्मभागादिद्वि घ्नमिष्टकलाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: when the Moon is in the birth degree doubled, are known as the desired elapsed times.

sanskrit_iast: pituḥ parokṣe janmasyādindau lagnamapaśyati //
meaning: पितुः परोक्षे जन्मस्यादिन्दौ लग्नमपश्यति //
text_mt: Birth occurs in the absence of the father when the Moon does not aspect the ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyādbhraṣṭerke videśasthe janane nārijanma vai /
mandeṅgasthe kujeste ca jñosphuji madhyage vidhau //
meaning:
मध्याद्भ्रष्टेर्के विदेशस्थे जनने नारिजन्म वै /
मन्देङ्गस्थे कुजेस्ते च ज्ञोस्फुजि मध्यगे विधौ //
text_mt: When the Sun has fallen from the meridian, the father is in a foreign land; when it is in the seventh, indeed, birth occurs away from the woman. / When Saturn is in the ascendant, Mars in the seventh, and Mercury and Venus are in the meridian with the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpāṅgebje tribhāge lau svāyagaiḥ sadbhirudgataḥ /
sūryastaddṛṣṭigo vāpi jñeyo jyotirvidāṃ varaiḥ //
meaning:
पापाङ्गेब्जे त्रिभागे लौ स्वायगैः सद्भिरुद्गतः /
सूर्यस्तद्दृष्टिगो वापि ज्ञेयो ज्योतिर्विदां वरैः //
text_mt: or when malefics are in the ascendant, or the Moon is in a decanate with benefics occupying their own or eleventh houses, / the Sun has risen or is in their aspect—this should be known by the best of astrologers.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadarkṣage bhānau śerṣaibalayutaiḥ khagaiḥ /
kośādatau tu yamalau jāyete munisattama //
meaning:
चतुष्पदर्क्षगे भानौ शेर्षैबलयुतैः खगैः /
कोशादतौ तु यमलौ जायेते मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: When the Sun is in a quadruped sign and the other planets are endowed with strength, / two twins are born from the womb, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sārkyārasiṃhojñājāṃse bhāṃśatutyāṅganālayuk /
lagnaminduṃ ca sārkenduṃ na paśyati yadā guruḥ //
meaning:
सार्क्यारसिंहोज्ञाजांसे भांशतुत्याङ्गनालयुक् /
लग्नमिन्दुं च सार्केन्दुं न पश्यति यदा गुरुः //
text_mt: When the degree of the Sun, Mars, Leo, Mercury, or Aries is conjoined with an equal number of women, / and Jupiter does not aspect the ascendant, the Moon, or the Sun and Moon together,

sanskrit_iast:
sapāpagor'ke jāyo vā paravīryaprasūtikṛt /
pāpabhasthau pāpakheṭaiḥ sūryārghānatrikoṇagau //
meaning:
सपापगोर्ऽके जायो वा परवीर्यप्रसूतिकृत् /
पापभस्थौ पापखेटैः सूर्यार्घानत्रिकोणगौ //
text_mt: or the Sun is conjoined with a malefic in the seventh, the birth is generated by another's seed. / When both are in malefic signs, and by malefic planets the Sun and Moon are placed in trines,

sanskrit_iast:
videśagaḥ pitāvṛddhaḥ khevā rāśivaśātyaye /
pūrṇa iṇḍhau svabheśejñe śubhe muvyaṃvuje tanau //
meaning:
विदेशगः पितावृद्धः खेवा राशिवशात्यये /
पूर्ण इण्ढौ स्वभेशेज्ञे शुभे मुव्यंवुजे तनौ //
text_mt: the father has gone to a foreign land or is aged, or there is danger according to the nature of the sign. / When the Moon is full in its own sign, Mercury and benefics are in the ascendant or an aquatic sign,

sanskrit_iast:
dyūnasthe vā vidhau yāteṅganā nārī prasūyate /
abdhāṅgamanbhagaḥ pūrṇe jyo vā paśyati nārada //
meaning:
द्यूनस्थे वा विधौ यातेङ्गना नारी प्रसूयते /
अब्धाङ्गमन्भगः पूर्णे ज्यो वा पश्यति नारद //
text_mt: or when the Moon is in the seventh house, a woman gives birth on a boat. / When the full Moon is in a watery sign or aspected by Jupiter, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
svabaṃlagnagaḥ sūtiḥ salile nātra saṃsayaḥ /
pāpadṛṣṭe yame gudyāṃ janmāṅgājavyayasthite //
meaning:
स्वबंलग्नगः सूतिः सलिले नात्र संसयः /
पापदृष्टे यमे गुद्यां जन्माङ्गाजव्ययस्थिते //
text_mt: and situated in its own ascendant, delivery takes place in water; there is no doubt about this. / When Saturn is aspected by malefics in a ditch, birth occurs in the ascendant or twelfth from Aries.

sanskrit_iast:
karkātilagnageśaurevaṭe janmābjavīkṣite /
mande janmagate lagne budhasūryenduvīkṣite //
meaning:
कर्कातिलग्नगेशौरेवटे जन्माब्जवीक्षिते /
मन्दे जन्मगते लग्ने बुधसूर्येन्दुवीक्षिते //
text_mt: When Saturn is in Cancer or the ascendant aspected by the Moon, birth is under a banyan tree. / When Saturn is in the ascendant at birth, aspected by Mercury, the Sun, and the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāsthāne devagehe pyūṣare ca kramājjaniḥ /
śmaśāne lagnadṛgasṛgrāmyasthānebjabhārgavau //
meaning:
क्रीडास्थाने देवगेहे प्यूषरे च क्रमाज्जनिः /
श्मशाने लग्नदृगसृग्राम्यस्थानेब्जभार्गवौ //
text_mt: birth occurs respectively in a pleasure-ground, a temple, or barren soil. / If Mars aspects the ascendant, it is in a cremation ground; if the Moon and Venus, in a pleasant village place;

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotragṛhe jīvor'ke bhūṣābharaṇe gṛhe /
śilpālaye budho janma kuryādbalasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रगृहे जीवोर्ऽके भूषाभरणे गृहे /
शिल्पालये बुधो जन्म कुर्याद्बलसमन्वितः //
text_mt: under Jupiter, in a sacrificial house; under the Sun, in a decorated mansion; / and when endowed with strength, Mercury causes birth in an artisan's workshop.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsamāne sare mārge sthire svarkṣāṃśage gṛhe /
trikoṇagaja ārārkyoraste vā sṛjyate 'mbayā //
meaning:
भासमाने सरे मार्गे स्थिरे स्वर्क्षांशगे गृहे /
त्रिकोणगज आरार्क्योरस्ते वा सृज्यते ऽम्बया //
text_mt: In a movable sign it is on the road; in a fixed sign or its own sign and degree, in a house. / When Mars and Saturn are in trines or in the seventh, the child is abandoned by the mother.

sanskrit_iast:
gurudṛṣṭe tu dīrghāyuḥ paraṃ ca prāpyate punaḥ /
pāpadṛṣṭe vidhaulagne 'stekuje tu vinaśyati //
meaning:
गुरुदृष्टे तु दीर्घायुः परं च प्राप्यते पुनः /
पापदृष्टे विधौलग्ने ऽस्तेकुजे तु विनश्यति //
text_mt: When aspected by Jupiter, however, there is long life and, furthermore, supreme [well-being] is obtained. / But when aspected by a malefic, with the Moon in the ascendant and Mars in the descendant, he perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhave kujārkyoḥ saṃdṛṣṭe parahastagataḥ sukhī /
pāpedyatāyurbhavati māsaḥ sārthaiḥ parairapi //
meaning:
भवे कुजार्क्योः संदृष्टे परहस्तगतः सुखी /
पापेद्यतायुर्भवति मासः सार्थैः परैरपि //
text_mt: If it is aspected by Mars and Saturn in the eleventh house, he goes into another's hands [yet] is happy. / When malefics aspect, the lifespan becomes [a matter of] months, or with other [factors] alongside.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛgehe janma tadadhīśabalānmune /
tarugehe śubhe nīce naikasthadṛṣṭau lagnenduḥ //
meaning:
पितृमातृगेहे जन्म तदधीशबलान्मुने /
तरुगेहे शुभे नीचे नैकस्थदृष्टौ लग्नेन्दुः //
