text_mt: Birth takes place in the father's or mother's house depending on the strength of their lords, O sage; / in a wooden house if a benefic is debilitated, when the ascendant and the Moon are not aspected by multiple [planets].

sanskrit_iast:
etallakṣaṇasaṃpannā prasītirvijane tadā /
mandarkṣāṃśe vidhau turye mandadṛṣṭe 'bjage 'pi vā //
meaning:
एतल्लक्षणसंपन्ना प्रसीतिर्विजने तदा /
मन्दर्क्षांशे विधौ तुर्ये मन्ददृष्टे ऽब्जगे ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Endowed with these characteristics, birth takes place in a solitary place then, / when the Moon is in the sign or navāṃśa of Saturn, in the fourth house, aspected by Saturn, or in a watery sign.

sanskrit_iast:
mandārcane vā tamasi śayanaṃ nīcagebhuvi /
śīrṣe pṛṣṭodaye janma tadvadeva vinirdiśet //
meaning:
मन्दार्चने वा तमसि शयनं नीचगेभुवि /
शीर्षे पृष्टोदये जन्म तद्वदेव विनिर्दिशेत् //
text_mt: Or in the worship-place of Saturn, in darkness, the lying-down is on the ground if [the planet is] debilitated; / in a sign rising by head or back, the birth should be indicated in the very same way.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāstasukhagaḥ pāpairmātuḥ pīḍāṃ samādiśet /
jīrṇoddhṛtaṃ gṛhaṃ mande sṛji dagdhaṃ na vā vidhau //
meaning:
चन्द्रास्तसुखगः पापैर्मातुः पीडां समादिशेत् /
जीर्णोद्धृतं गृहं मन्दे सृजि दग्धं न वा विधौ //
text_mt: Malefics in the seventh or fourth house from the Moon indicate affliction to the mother. / The house is dilapidated and rebuilt when Saturn [is there], burnt when Mars [is there], or [so] with the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭāḍhyamadṛḍhaṃ sūya bahuśilpayutaṃ budhe /
citrayuktaṃ navaṃ śukre dṛḍhe ramye gurau gṛham //
meaning:
काष्टाढ्यमदृढं सूय बहुशिल्पयुतं बुधे /
चित्रयुक्तं नवं शुक्रे दृढे रम्ये गुरौ गृहम् //
text_mt: With the Sun, the house is rich in wood and frail; with Mercury, it has many crafts; / with Venus, it is adorned with paintings and new; with Jupiter, it is firm and delightful.

sanskrit_iast:
dhaṭājakarkyalighaṭe pūrve jñejyagṛhe hyudak /
vṛṣe paścānmṛge siṃhe dakṣiṇe vasatirbhavet //
meaning:
धटाजकर्क्यलिघटे पूर्वे ज्ञेज्यगृहे ह्युदक् /
वृषे पश्चान्मृगे सिंहे दक्षिणे वसतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: In Libra, Aries, Cancer, Scorpio, and Aquarius, [the dwelling is] in the east; in the houses of Mercury and Jupiter, in the north; / in Taurus, in the west; in Capricorn and Leo, the dwelling is in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhaprācyādigau dvau dvau vdyaṅgāḥ koṇeṣvajādayaḥ /
parthaṅke vāstuvatpādāsriṣadaṅkāntyarāśayaḥ //
meaning:
गृहप्राच्यादिगौ द्वौ द्वौ व्द्यङ्गाः कोणेष्वजादयः /
पर्थङ्के वास्तुवत्पादास्रिषदङ्कान्त्यराशयः //
text_mt: Two [signs] each belong to the east and the other directions of the house; the dual signs, Aries and the rest, are in the corners. / Separately, like the Vāstupuruṣa, the signs from the sixth to the twelfth represent the feet [and other body parts].

sanskrit_iast:
candrāgāntaragaiḥ kheṭaiḥ sūtikāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ /
cakrāddhi bahirantaśca dṛśyādṛśyopare 'nyathā //
meaning:
चन्द्रागान्तरगैः खेटैः सूतिकाः समुदाहृताः /
चक्राद्धि बहिरन्तश्च दृश्यादृश्योपरे ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: By the planets situated between the Moon and the ascendant, the women attending the childbirth are declared: / outside and inside the zodiacal wheel, visible and invisible, and otherwise for the others.

sanskrit_iast:
lagrāśayasamānāṅgobālikheṭaṃsamopi vā /
candranandāṃśavadvarṇaḥ śīrṣādyaṅgavibhāga yuk //
meaning:
लग्राशयसमानाङ्गोबालिखेटंसमोपि वा /
चन्द्रनन्दांशवद्वर्णः शीर्षाद्यङ्गविभाग युक् //
text_mt: His limbs correspond to the ascendant-sign, or are like the strongest planet; / his complexion is like the navāṃśa of the Moon, possessing divisions of limbs from the head onward.

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṣakaṃ dakśrave nāsā kapolahanavo mukham /
kaṇṭhāṃsapārśvahṛddvoṣaḥ kroḍaṃnābhiśca bāstikāḥ //
meaning:
शीर्षकं दक्श्रवे नासा कपोलहनवो मुखम् /
कण्ठांसपार्श्वहृद्द्वोषः क्रोडंनाभिश्च बास्तिकाः //
text_mt: The head, right ear, nose, cheeks, jaw, and face; / neck, shoulders, flanks, chest, belly, and pelvis;

sanskrit_iast:
śiṃśnāpāte ca vṛṣaṇau jaghane jānunī tathā /
jaṅghepādau cobhaghayatra tryaṃśaiḥ samuditairvadet //
meaning:
शिंश्नापाते च वृषणौ जघने जानुनी तथा /
जङ्घेपादौ चोभघयत्र त्र्यंशैः समुदितैर्वदेत् //
text_mt: the penis, anus, testicles, thighs, and knees, / and the shanks and feet on both sides—he should declare them by the combined decanates.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpayukte vraṇastasminnaṅge lakṣma ca tadyute /
svarkṣāṃśe sthirayukte tu naija āgantuko 'nyathā //
meaning:
पापयुक्ते व्रणस्तस्मिन्नङ्गे लक्ष्म च तद्युते /
स्वर्क्षांशे स्थिरयुक्ते तु नैज आगन्तुको ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: On the limb connected with a malefic there is a wound; connected with a [benefic], a mark. / In its own sign or navāṃśa, or joined with a fixed [sign], it is innate; otherwise, acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
mande 'nilāśmajo bhaume viṣaśasrāgnijo budhe /
bhujer'ke kāṣṭapaśujo jetuḥ śṛṅgyajayonijaḥ //
meaning:
मन्दे ऽनिलाश्मजो भौमे विषशस्राग्निजो बुधे /
भुजेर्ऽके काष्टपशुजो जेतुः शृङ्ग्यजयोनिजः //
text_mt: Under Saturn, it arises from wind or stone; under Mars, from poison, weapons, or fire; under Mercury, / from earth; under the Sun, from wood or cattle; under Jupiter, from horned animals, goats, or women.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminsaṃjñāsrayaḥ kheṭā aṅgesyustatra niścitam /
vraṇośubhakṛtaḥ pṛṣṭetanau rāśisamāśrite //
meaning:
यस्मिन्संज्ञास्रयः खेटा अङ्गेस्युस्तत्र निश्चितम् /
व्रणोशुभकृतः पृष्टेतनौ राशिसमाश्रिते //
text_mt: On whichever limb the planets bearing the appellations are, certainly there / a wound caused by an inauspicious [planet] is placed on the body according to the sign.

sanskrit_iast:
tilakṛnmasakṛdaṣṭasaumyairyuktaśca lakṣmavān /
caturasraḥ piṅgadṛk ca paittiko 'lpakaco raviḥ //
meaning:
तिलकृन्मसकृदष्टसौम्यैर्युक्तश्च लक्ष्मवान् /
चतुरस्रः पिङ्गदृक् च पैत्तिको ऽल्पकचो रविः //
text_mt: Joined with benefics in the eighth house, he produces moles and freckles, and possesses marks. / The Sun is square, has yellowish-brown eyes, is bilious, and has scanty hair.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛto vātakaphī prājño mandavāk śubhadṛk śaśī /
krṛradṛktaruṇo bhaumaḥ paittikaścapalastathā //
meaning:
वृतो वातकफी प्राज्ञो मन्दवाक् शुभदृक् शशी /
क्रृरदृक्तरुणो भौमः पैत्तिकश्चपलस्तथा //
text_mt: The Moon is round, windy and phlegmatic, wise, of slow speech, and has auspicious eyes; / Mars has fierce eyes, is youthful, bilious, and fickle.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhānupavṛtirhāsyarucijñaḥ śliṣṭavāktathā /
piṅgake ślakṣaṇo dīrghaḥ kaphīdhīmāngururmataḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधानुपवृतिर्हास्यरुचिज्ञः श्लिष्टवाक्तथा /
पिङ्गके श्लक्षणो दीर्घः कफीधीमान्गुरुर्मतः //
text_mt: Mercury has a threefold nature, delights in humor, and speaks equivocally; / Jupiter is considered to have yellowish hair, to be smooth, tall, phlegmatic, and intelligent.

sanskrit_iast:
suvapurlocanaḥ kṛṣṇavakrakeśo bhṛguḥ sukhī /
dīrghaḥ kapiladṛḍbhando nilīkharakacolasaḥ //
meaning:
सुवपुर्लोचनः कृष्णवक्रकेशो भृगुः सुखी /
दीर्घः कपिलदृड्भन्दो निलीखरकचोलसः //
text_mt: Venus has a handsome body and eyes, black and curly hair, and is happy; / Saturn is tall, has dark brown eyes, is dark, with rough hair, and lazy.

sanskrit_iast:
snāyvasthiraktatvakśukravasāmajjāstu dhātavaḥ /
mandārkacandrasomyāspujijjīvakubhuvaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
स्नाय्वस्थिरक्तत्वक्शुक्रवसामज्जास्तु धातवः /
मन्दार्कचन्द्रसोम्यास्पुजिज्जीवकुभुवः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Sinews, bone, blood, skin, semen, fat, and marrow are the bodily constituents / of Saturn, the Sun, the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, and Mars respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāṅgapāpairbhāntyasthaiḥ seṃvupāpacatuṣṭayaiḥ /
cakrapūrvāpare pāpasaumyaiḥ kīṭatanau mṛtiḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्राङ्गपापैर्भान्त्यस्थैः सेंवुपापचतुष्टयैः /
चक्रपूर्वापरे पापसौम्यैः कीटतनौ मृतिः //
text_mt: When the Moon, the ascendant, and malefics are in the last degrees of signs, or when the four malefics are in watery [signs], / or when malefics and benefics occupy the eastern and western halves of the circle, death occurs if Scorpio is the ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstagatau pāpau candraḥ krūrayutaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
na ceddṛṣṭastadā mṛtyurjātasya bhavati dhruvam //
meaning:
उदयास्तगतौ पापौ चन्द्रः क्रूरयुतैः शुभैः /
न चेद्दृष्टस्तदा मृत्युर्जातस्य भवति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: If malefics are in the ascendant and descendant, and the Moon is joined with cruel [planets] / and not aspected by benefics, then the child certainly dies.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīṇe 'bje vyayage pāpairlagnāṣṭasthaiḥ śubhā na cet /
kendreṣu vābjosaṃyuktaḥ smarāntyamṛtilagnagaḥ //
meaning:
क्षीणे ऽब्जे व्ययगे पापैर्लग्नाष्टस्थैः शुभा न चेत् /
केन्द्रेषु वाब्जोसंयुक्तः स्मरान्त्यमृतिलग्नगः //
text_mt: When the Moon is waning in the twelfth house and malefics are in the ascendant and eighth, if benefics do not [aspect], / or if the Moon is in the cardines, or combined in the seventh, twelfth, eighth, or ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
kendrādyā hasta sankheṭairadṛṣṭo mṛtyudastathā /
ṣaṣṭemebje 'sadṛṣṭesadyo mṛtyuḥ śubhekṣite //
meaning:
केन्द्राद्या हस्त सन्खेटैरदृष्टो मृत्युदस्तथा /
षष्टेमेब्जे ऽसदृष्टेसद्यो मृत्युः शुभेक्षिते //
text_mt: unseen by the planets from the cardines onward, it thus brings death. / When the Moon is in the sixth house and aspected by a malefic, there is immediate death; if aspected by a benefic,

sanskrit_iast:
samāṣṭake miśrakheṭairdṛṣṭe mṛtiḥ śiśoḥ /
kṣīṇebjeṅge randhrakende pāpe pāpāntarasthite //
meaning:
समाष्टके मिश्रखेटैर्दृष्टे मृतिः शिशोः /
क्षीणेब्जेङ्गे रन्ध्रकेन्दे पापे पापान्तरस्थिते //
text_mt: in eight years, [or] if aspected by mixed planets, there is death of the infant. / When the waning Moon is in the ascendant, a malefic in the eighth or a cardine, or placed between malefics,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūdyūnanidhane vābje lagne 'pyevaṃ śiśormṛtiḥ /
pāpaiścandrāstagairmātrā sārddhaṃ sadṛṣṭimantarā //
meaning:
भूद्यूननिधने वाब्जे लग्ने ऽप्येवं शिशोर्मृतिः /
पापैश्चन्द्रास्तगैर्मात्रा सार्द्धं सदृष्टिमन्तरा //
text_mt: or when the Moon is in the ascendant, seventh, or eighth, there is likewise death of the infant. / With malefics in the descendant from the Moon, without benefic aspect, [it dies] along with its mother.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhādṛṣṭe bhāntyagebje trikoṇoparataiḥ khalaiḥ /
sagnasthe vā vidhaupāpairastasthairmṛtimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
शुभादृष्टे भान्त्यगेब्जे त्रिकोणोपरतैः खलैः /
सग्नस्थे वा विधौपापैरस्तस्थैर्मृतिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: When the Moon is at the end of a sign and not aspected by a benefic, while malefics are in the trines; / or when the Moon is in the ascendant and malefics are in the descendant, he meets death.

sanskrit_iast:
graste 'bje 'sadbhiraṣṭasthai sṛjyavātmajayormṛtiḥ /
lagne ravau tu śasreṇa savīryāsadbhiraṣṭagaiḥ //
meaning:
ग्रस्ते ऽब्जे ऽसद्भिरष्टस्थै सृज्यवात्मजयोर्मृतिः /
लग्ने रवौ तु शस्रेण सवीर्यासद्भिरष्टगैः //
text_mt: When an eclipsed Moon is present and malefics are in the eighth, death of both the mother and the child [ensues]; / but with the Sun in the ascendant and strong malefics in the eighth, [death is] by a weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
karkendvījyayute lagne kendre saumye ca bhārgave /
śaṣaistryarīśagairāyuramitaṃ bhavati dhruvam //
meaning:
कर्केन्द्वीज्ययुते लग्ने केन्द्रे सौम्ये च भार्गवे /
शषैस्त्र्यरीशगैरायुरमितं भवति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: When the ascendant is Cancer joined with the Moon and Jupiter, Mercury and Venus in a cardine, / and the remaining [planets] in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, the lifespan is certainly immeasurable.

sanskrit_iast:
varṅgottame mīnalagne vṛṣe 'bje tattvalipsike /
svatuṅgastheṣvaśeṣeṣu paramāyuḥ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
वर्ङ्गोत्तमे मीनलग्ने वृषे ऽब्जे तत्त्वलिप्सिके /
स्वतुङ्गस्थेष्वशेषेषु परमायुः प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: With Pisces as the ascendant in a vargottama, the Moon in Taurus at twenty-five degrees, / and all the rest in their exaltations, the maximum lifespan is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhairdṛṣṭaḥ savīryoge kendrasthe cāyurarthadaḥ /
svaccobje svarkṣagaiḥ saumyaiḥ savīryeṅgādhipe tanau //
meaning:
शुभैर्दृष्टः सवीर्योगे केन्द्रस्थे चायुरर्थदः /
स्वच्चोब्जे स्वर्क्षगैः सौम्यैः सवीर्येङ्गाधिपे तनौ //
text_mt: Aspected by benefics, endowed with strength, and placed in a cardine, it bestows lifespan and wealth; / when the Moon is in its exaltation, benefics are in their own signs, and the lord of the ascendant is strong in the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyabdakendrasaumyebheṣṭaśuddhe saptatirgurau /
mūlatrikoṇagaiḥ saumyairguro svoccasamanvite //
meaning:
षष्ट्यब्दकेन्द्रसौम्येभेष्टशुद्धे सप्ततिर्गुरौ /
मूलत्रिकोणगैः सौम्यैर्गुरो स्वोच्चसमन्विते //
text_mt: [the life is] sixty years; with benefics in cardines, when affliction is removed, seventy under Jupiter; / with benefics in their mūlatrikoṇas and Jupiter joined with its exaltation,

sanskrit_iast:
lagnādhipe balayutaśītyabdaṃ tvāyurīritam /
savīrye satsu kendreṣu triṃśacchuddhiyute 'ṣṭame //
meaning:
लग्नाधिपे बलयुतशीत्यब्दं त्वायुरीरितम् /
सवीर्ये सत्सु केन्द्रेषु त्रिंशच्छुद्धियुते ऽष्टमे //
text_mt: and the lord of the ascendant endowed with strength, a lifespan of eighty years is stated. / When the cardines have strong benefics and the eighth is cleared of thirty [degrees of affliction],

sanskrit_iast:
layeśe dharmagejīveṣṭasthe krūrakṣite jitāḥ /
lagnāṣṭameśāvaṣṭasthau bhābdamāyuḥ karau matau //
meaning:
लयेशे धर्मगेजीवेष्टस्थे क्रूरक्षिते जिताः /
लग्नाष्टमेशावष्टस्थौ भाब्दमायुः करौ मतौ //
text_mt: when the lord of the twelfth is in the ninth, Jupiter in the eighth, and they are overcome by the aspect of malefics; / the lords of the ascendant and eighth placed in the eighth are considered to grant twenty-seven years of life.

sanskrit_iast:
lagne 'śubhejyau glaudṛṣṭau mṛtyau kaścana cākṛtiḥ /
dharmāṅgastheśanau śukre kendre 'bje vyayadharmage //
meaning:
लग्ने ऽशुभेज्यौ ग्लौदृष्टौ मृत्यौ कश्चन चाकृतिः /
धर्माङ्गस्थेशनौ शुक्रे केन्द्रे ऽब्जे व्ययधर्मगे //
text_mt: If a malefic and Jupiter are in the ascendant, aspected by the Moon, in the house of death some form [of early demise occurs]. / With Saturn in the ninth or ascendant, Venus in a cardine, and the Moon in the twelfth or ninth,

sanskrit_iast:
śatābdaṃ gīṣpatau karke kaṭakasthasitejyayoḥ /
layeśeṅge śubhairhīne 'ṣṭame ravābdhimitaṃ vayaḥ //
meaning:
शताब्दं गीष्पतौ कर्के कटकस्थसितेज्ययोः /
लयेशेङ्गे शुभैर्हीने ऽष्टमे रवाब्धिमितं वयः //
text_mt: [the lifespan is] one hundred years; with Jupiter in Cancer, and Venus and Jupiter in Cancer; / with the lord of the twelfth in the ascendant, and the eighth devoid of benefics, the age is measured at forty-four.

sanskrit_iast:
lagne śeṣṭamageṣṭeśe tanusthe pañcavatsaram /
kavījyayoge saumyābjau lagne mṛtyau ca sveṣavaḥ //
meaning:
लग्ने शेष्टमगेष्टेशे तनुस्थे पञ्चवत्सरम् /
कवीज्ययोगे सौम्याब्जौ लग्ने मृत्यौ च स्वेषवः //
text_mt: When the lord of the ascendant is in the eighth and the lord of the eighth is in the ascendant, [the life is] five years; / in a conjunction of Venus and Jupiter, with Mercury and the Moon in the ascendant and eighth, [the life is] fifty.

sanskrit_iast:
etadyogajamāyuḥ syādatha spaṣṭamudīyate /
sūryādhika bale paiṇḍaṃ nisargāñca vidhorbale //
meaning:
एतद्योगजमायुः स्यादथ स्पष्टमुदीयते /
सूर्याधिक बले पैण्डं निसर्गाञ्च विधोर्बले //
text_mt: This would be the lifespan produced by combinations; now it is proclaimed explicitly: / the paiṇḍa [lifespan] when the Sun has greater strength, the nisarga when the Moon is strong,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśāyuḥ sabale lagne tatsādhanamatho śṛṇu /
gobjāstattvatithī sūryāstithiḥ svargā nakhāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
अंशायुः सबले लग्ने तत्साधनमथो शृणु /
गोब्जास्तत्त्वतिथी सूर्यास्तिथिः स्वर्गा नखाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: and the aṃśāyuḥ when the ascendant is strong. Now hear the calculation thereof: / nineteen, twenty-five, fifteen, fifteen, twelve, and twenty in order,

sanskrit_iast: nakhā vidhurdvāvaṅkāśca dhṛtiḥ svākṣikhamārgaṇāḥ //
meaning: नखा विधुर्द्वावङ्काश्च धृतिः स्वाक्षिखमार्गणाः //
text_mt: [and] twenty, one, two, nine, eighteen, and fifty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍe nisarge ravocce no grahaḥ ṣaṭbhālpako yadā /
cakraśuddhastadā grāhyesyāṃśā āyuṣisaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
पिण्डे निसर्गे रवोच्चे नो ग्रहः षट्भाल्पको यदा /
चक्रशुद्धस्तदा ग्राह्येस्यांशा आयुषिसंमताः //
text_mt: In the piṇḍa and nisarga [systems], at the Sun's exaltation, when a planet is not less than six signs [away], / then the parts purified by the circle are to be taken as accepted for lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśonāḥ śantrubhe kāryā grahaṃ vakragatiṃ vinā /
mandaśuktau vinārddhonā grahasyāstaṅgatasya ca //
meaning:
अंशोनाः शन्त्रुभे कार्या ग्रहं वक्रगतिं विना /
मन्दशुक्तौ विनार्द्धोना ग्रहस्यास्तङ्गतस्य च //
text_mt: In an enemy's sign, portions are to be reduced, except for a planet in retrograde motion; / and reduced by half for a planet that is combust, except for Saturn and Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
hānidvaye 'dhikāḥ kāryā yadā krūrastanau tadā /
vihāyārīnaṃśādyairhanyādāyurlavān bhajet //
meaning:
हानिद्वये ऽधिकाः कार्या यदा क्रूरस्तनौ तदा /
विहायारीनंशाद्यैर्हन्यादायुर्लवान् भजेत् //
text_mt: When there are two reductions, the greater is to be made. When a malefic is in the ascendant, / setting aside the enemies, one should multiply by the degrees and divide the lifespan by the fractions.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagaṇāṃśairlabdhahīnāsteṣāṃ kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
pāpasyāṃśāḥ samagronā saumyasyārddhavivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
भगणांशैर्लब्धहीनास्तेषां कार्या विचक्षणैः /
पापस्यांशाः समग्रोना सौम्यस्यार्द्धविवर्जिताः //
text_mt: Those [portions] reduced by what is obtained from the degrees of the zodiac should be calculated by the wise: / the degrees of a malefic are entirely deducted, while those of a benefic are halved.

sanskrit_iast:
spaṣṭāsteṃśāḥ khaṣaṭtryāsā guṇayitvā svakairgaṇaiḥ /
varṣāṇi śeṣamarkadhnaṃ hārātsaṃmāsakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्पष्टास्तेंशाः खषट्त्र्यासा गुणयित्वा स्वकैर्गणैः /
वर्षाणि शेषमर्कध्नं हारात्संमासकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Those clarified degrees multiplied by three hundred and sixty by their respective groups / are the years; the remainder multiplied by twelve and [divided] by the divisor is known as the months.

sanskrit_iast:
taccheṣaśca triguṇitaḥ tenaivāptaṃ dināni ca /
śeṣe ṣaṣṭyā hate bhakte hāreṇa ghaṭikādikam //
meaning:
तच्छेषश्च त्रिगुणितः तेनैवाप्तं दिनानि च /
शेषे षष्ट्या हते भक्ते हारेण घटिकादिकम् //
text_mt: And that remainder multiplied by thirty and divided by the same gives the days; / when the remainder is multiplied by sixty and divided by the divisor, ghaṭikās and the rest [are obtained].

sanskrit_iast:
hitvā bhājyaṅgabhāgādīnkalīkṛtya khakhākṣibhiḥ /
bhajedvarṣāṇi śeṣe tu guṇite dvādaśādibhiḥ //
meaning:
हित्वा भाज्यङ्गभागादीन्कलीकृत्य खखाक्षिभिः /
भजेद्वर्षाणि शेषे तु गुणिते द्वादशादिभिः //
text_mt: Setting aside [the rest], converting the dividend's signs, degrees, and so forth into minutes, / one should divide by two hundred; and when the remainder is multiplied by twelve and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
dvisaptāṃśe ca māsādilagrāyurjāyate sphuṭam /
aśāyuṣī salagnānāṃ kheṭānāmaṃśakā hṛtāḥ //
meaning:
द्विसप्तांशे च मासादिलग्रायुर्जायते स्फुटम् /
अशायुषी सलग्नानां खेटानामंशका हृताः //
text_mt: in two-sevenths, months and so forth are clearly obtained as the lifespan from the ascendant. / In the aṃśāyur-method, the degrees of the planets together with the ascendant are divided;

sanskrit_iast:
khayugairāyuraṃśāḥ syustatsaṃskāraṃ vadāmi te /
grahanalagnaṃ ṣaḍrātyaṃ cetsaṃskāro 'nyathā nahi //
meaning:
खयुगैरायुरंशाः स्युस्तत्संस्कारं वदामि ते /
ग्रहनलग्नं षड्रात्यं चेत्संस्कारो ऽन्यथा नहि //
text_mt: by twenty they become the lifespan degrees. I shall tell you their rectification: / if the planetary ascendant exceeds six signs, there is rectification, otherwise not.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṃśaḥ svāgnayo bhaktā labdhonobhūrguṇo bhavet /
yadaikālyaṃ tadāstāṃśāḥ svāgryāptonā ca bhūrguṇaḥ //
meaning:
तदंशः स्वाग्नयो भक्ता लब्धोनोभूर्गुणो भवेत् /
यदैकाल्यं तदास्तांशाः स्वाग्र्याप्तोना च भूर्गुणः //
text_mt: Dividing its degrees by three, the quotient subtracted from one becomes the multiplier; / when it has set, its setting degrees are divided by three and subtracted from one, yielding the multiplier.

sanskrit_iast:
saumayasyārddhena pāpasya samagreṇeti niścayaḥ /
gumakadhnāścāyuraṃśāḥ saṃskāro 'yamudāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सौमयस्यार्द्धेन पापस्य समग्रेणेति निश्चयः /
गुमकध्नाश्चायुरंशाः संस्कारो ऽयमुदाहृतः //
text_mt: For a benefic, [the reduction is] by half; for a malefic, by the whole: this is certain. / The lifespan degrees are multiplied by the multiplier: this rectification has been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuraṃśakalābhaktādviṃśatyābdā ināhatam /
śeṣaṃ dviśatabhaktaṃ syurmāsāḥ śeṣā dinādikam //
meaning:
आयुरंशकलाभक्ताद्विंशत्याब्दा इनाहतम् /
शेषं द्विशतभक्तं स्युर्मासाः शेषा दिनादिकम् //
text_mt: Dividing the minutes of lifespan degrees by twenty, [the quotient is] years; the remainder multiplied by twelve / and divided by two hundred gives the months; the remainder gives days and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnāyuraṃśāstriguṇā digbhiktā syuḥ samāstataḥ /
śeṣer'kādiguṇe bhakte digbharmāsādikaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
लग्नायुरंशास्त्रिगुणा दिग्भिक्ता स्युः समास्ततः /
शेषेर्ऽकादिगुणे भक्ते दिग्भर्मासादिकं भवेत् //
text_mt: The span of life contributed by the ascendant, multiplied by three and divided by ten, gives the years. / The remainder multiplied by twelve and divided by ten yields the months and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
sabaleṅgebhatulyābdairyutamāyurbhavetsphuṭam /
aṃśadvidhnamakṣāṃśaṃ māsāḥ khatryādisaṃguṇāt //
meaning:
सबलेङ्गेभतुल्याब्दैर्युतमायुर्भवेत्स्फुटम् /
अंशद्विध्नमक्षांशं मासाः खत्र्यादिसंगुणात् //
text_mt: When the ascendant is strong, the lifespan becomes correct when combined with years equal to eight [or the designated figure]. / One-fifth of the navāṃśa doubled yields the months; from the remainder multiplied by thirty and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣā dinādikaṃ yojyaṃ naitatpiṇḍanisargayoḥ /
lagnārkacandramadhye tu yo balī taddaśā purā //
meaning:
शेषा दिनादिकं योज्यं नैतत्पिण्डनिसर्गयोः /
लग्नार्कचन्द्रमध्ये तु यो बली तद्दशा पुरा //
text_mt: the days and so on are to be added; this does not apply to the Piṇḍa and Nisarga methods. / Among the ascendant, the Sun, and the Moon, whichever is strongest, its daśā comes first.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kendrādigānāṃ tu dvitryādau sabalasya ca /
bahvāyuryo vīryasāmyerkādyutasya prāk yācakaḥ //
meaning:
ततः केन्द्रादिगानां तु द्वित्र्यादौ सबलस्य च /
बह्वायुर्यो वीर्यसाम्येर्काद्युतस्य प्राक् याचकः //
text_mt: Then, among those situated in the kendras and following houses, the first period belongs to the strong planet in the second, third, and subsequent houses; / when strength is equal, the one that grants the longest life [rules first], or the one conjoined with the Sun as stated before.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍvargārddhasya triṃśasya trikoṇagaśca smaragaḥ /
saptamāsasya tūryasya caturasragatasya ca //
meaning:
षड्वर्गार्द्धस्य त्रिंशस्य त्रिकोणगश्च स्मरगः /
सप्तमासस्य तूर्यस्य चतुरस्रगतस्य च //
text_mt: For a planet in the half of the ṣaḍvarga, in the triṃśāṃśa, in a trine, or in the seventh house, / as well as in the seventh sign, in the fourth, or occupying a caturasra [fourth/eighth house],

sanskrit_iast:
kramaḥ kendrādiko 'trāpi dvitryādau sabalasya ca /
pākapasyābdhināgāśca hyarṇavā sahagasya ca //
meaning:
क्रमः केन्द्रादिको ऽत्रापि द्वित्र्यादौ सबलस्य च /
पाकपस्याब्धिनागाश्च ह्यर्णवा सहगस्य च //
text_mt: the order here too begins with the kendras and so forth, among the strong planets in the second, third, and other houses. / For the ruler of the period, the multiplier is eighty-four, and four for one that accompanies it,

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇasthasya cāṣṭākṣisūryā dyūnagatasya ca /
turyāṣṭagasya tu svargā guṇakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
त्रिकोणस्थस्य चाष्टाक्षिसूर्या द्यूनगतस्य च /
तुर्याष्टगस्य तु स्वर्गा गुणकाः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: twenty-eight for one in a trine, twelve for one in the seventh house, / and twenty-one is declared as the multiplier for one in the fourth or eighth house.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāguṇairhatā bhaktyā guṇaikyena samāgatāḥ /
śeṣer'kādihate bhakte māsādyaikyena nārada //
meaning:
दशागुणैर्हता भक्त्या गुणैक्येन समागताः /
शेषेर्ऽकादिहते भक्ते मासाद्यैक्येन नारद //
text_mt: The planetary periods multiplied by their multipliers, divided by the sum of the multipliers, yield the years. / When the remainder is multiplied by twelve and divided, months and so forth are obtained in total, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
antardaśāsu vidaśāstāsu copadaśāstathā /
daśeśamitrasvoccakṣaṅgobjobdhyekādrivṛddhigaḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्दशासु विदशास्तासु चोपदशास्तथा /
दशेशमित्रस्वोच्चक्षङ्गोब्जोब्ध्येकाद्रिवृद्धिगः //
text_mt: Within the antardaśās there are vidaśās, and within them likewise upadaśās. / If a planet is in the house of a friend of the period-lord, in its own exaltation, in the ascendant, or in the eleventh, fourth, or seventh house, it brings growth.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhago yadbhagastadbhisnvādisthena taddhikṛt /
proktetarasthānagatastattadbhāvakṣayaṃ karaḥ //
meaning:
शुभगो यद्भगस्तद्भिस्न्वादिस्थेन तद्धिकृत् /
प्रोक्तेतरस्थानगतस्तत्तद्भावक्षयं करः //
text_mt: Positioned in an auspicious sign, whatever sign it occupies, situated in the second or other houses, it enhances that bhāva; / situated in other houses than those stated, it causes the destruction of that respective bhāva.

sanskrit_iast:
khagasya yadbhaveddravyaṃ bhāvabhe kṣaṇayogajam /
jīvikādiphalaṃ sarvaṃ daśāyāṃ tasya yojayet //
meaning:
खगस्य यद्भवेद्द्रव्यं भावभे क्षणयोगजम् /
जीविकादिफलं सर्वं दशायां तस्य योजयेत् //
text_mt: Whatever wealth, aspect, or conjunction arises from the bhāva and sign of a planet, / all the fruits such as livelihood should be assigned to its daśā.

sanskrit_iast:
viśanyāpadaśāyāṃ yo vairidṛṣṭo vipattikṛt /
śubhamatrekṣitaśceṣṭasadvargasthaśca yo grahaḥ //
meaning:
विशन्यापदशायां यो वैरिदृष्टो विपत्तिकृत् /
शुभमत्रेक्षितश्चेष्टसद्वर्गस्थश्च यो ग्रहः //
text_mt: In an adverse sub-period, a planet aspected by an enemy causes disaster; / but a planet that is aspected by a benefic, or desirable and situated in a benefic varga,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkāle balavānāpannāśakṛtsamudāhṛtaḥ /
yasyāṣṭavargajaṃ cāpi phalaṃ pūrṇaśubhaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
तत्काले बलवानापन्नाशकृत्समुदाहृतः /
यस्याष्टवर्गजं चापि फलं पूर्णशुभं भवेत् //
text_mt: and strong at that time, is declared to be a destroyer of misfortunes. / Also, that planet whose aṣṭakavarga yields completely auspicious fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca mūrtitanuglāvo vṛddhigaḥ svoccabhasthitaḥ /
svatrikoṇasuhṛdbhasthastasya madhyamasatphalam //
meaning:
यश्च मूर्तितनुग्लावो वृद्धिगः स्वोच्चभस्थितः /
स्वत्रिकोणसुहृद्भस्थस्तस्य मध्यमसत्फलम् //
text_mt: and which has bright bodily radiance, is waxing, placed in its exaltation sign, / in its trine, or in a friend's sign, yields moderate or good fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
śreṣṭhaṃ śubhataraṃ vācyaṃ viparītagatasya tu /
neṣṭamutkaṭamiṣṭaṃ tu svalpaṃ jñātvā balaṃ vadet //
meaning:
श्रेष्ठं शुभतरं वाच्यं विपरीतगतस्य तु /
नेष्टमुत्कटमिष्टं तु स्वल्पं ज्ञात्वा बलं वदेत् //
text_mt: Its result should be pronounced as excellent and very auspicious; but for one in the opposite state, / it is unfavorable. Discerning whether favorable strength is intense or slight, one should declare the result.

sanskrit_iast:
care sanmadhyaduṣṭābhyāmaṅgabhaṅge viparyayāt /
sthire neṣṭaṣṭamadhyā ca horāyāstryaṃ śakaiḥ phalam //
meaning:
चरे सन्मध्यदुष्टाभ्यामङ्गभङ्गे विपर्ययात् /
स्थिरे नेष्टष्टमध्या च होरायास्त्र्यं शकैः फलम् //
text_mt: In a movable sign, the fruit is determined by good, medium, and bad parts of the body respectively; in reverse for a dual sign; / in a fixed sign, the fruit of the horā is unfavorable, bad, and middling according to its decanates.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmījyajñayutā horā dṛṣṭā vā satpalāvahā /
vināśa dṛṣṭayuktā ca pāpāntaragatānyathā //
meaning:
स्वामीज्यज्ञयुता होरा दृष्टा वा सत्पलावहा /
विनाश दृष्टयुक्ता च पापान्तरगतान्यथा //
text_mt: The horā conjoined with or aspected by its lord, Jupiter, or Mercury brings good results; / otherwise, conjoined with or aspected by a malefic, or hemmed between malefics, it brings destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgdhvāṅkṣā bandhu mṛtyāya tayordyūne raviḥ svabhāt /
vakrātsvādivasāñcārke śukrādyūnāṃ tu ṣaḍrataḥ //
meaning:
प्राग्ध्वाङ्क्षा बन्धु मृत्याय तयोर्द्यूने रविः स्वभात् /
वक्रात्स्वादिवसाञ्चार्के शुक्राद्यूनां तु षड्रतः //
text_mt: The Sun from its own sign in the seventh brings death to relatives; / [similarly] from Mars, Mercury, and Venus in the designated places, auspicious points are reckoned.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmadhyāyārigo jīvādikatryārigo vidhoḥ /
pṛdhyantyadhītapāḥ sujñā tatovṛddhyantyabandhurāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मध्यायारिगो जीवादिकत्र्यारिगो विधोः /
पृध्यन्त्यधीतपाः सुज्ञा ततोवृद्ध्यन्त्यबन्धुराः //
text_mt: In the ninth, eleventh, and sixth from Jupiter; in the third, eleventh, and sixth from the Moon; / the wise consider these places auspicious for learning and austerity, bringing prosperity to those who are fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhigoṅgātsadhanaghītapaḥ svārācchaśī śubhaḥ /
svadūvṛdhyastādiṣu pṛdhātsasāṣṭau pañcayopagaḥ //
meaning:
वृद्धिगोङ्गात्सधनघीतपः स्वाराच्छशी शुभः /
स्वदूवृध्यस्तादिषु पृधात्ससाष्टौ पञ्चयोपगः //
text_mt: The Moon is auspicious in the eleventh from the ascendant, along with the second, ninth, and fifth; from Mars, / in its own houses, the eleventh, seventh, and fifth, it confers prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtryāyadhīstho mandāñca jñāddvitryāyāṣṭakendragaḥ /
kendrāṣṭāyāntya ijyādvā jñajyāyāstatra sve kaveḥ //
meaning:
षट्त्र्यायधीस्थो मन्दाञ्च ज्ञाद्द्वित्र्यायाष्टकेन्द्रगः /
केन्द्राष्टायान्त्य इज्याद्वा ज्ञज्यायास्तत्र स्वे कवेः //
text_mt: In the sixth, third, eleventh, and fifth from Saturn; in the second, third, eleventh, eighth, and kendras from Mercury; / in the kendras, eighth, eleventh, and twelfth from Jupiter, and similarly in the own houses of Venus,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhāvinātsādidhiyā maṅgā māyārigo vidhoḥ /
kendrāṣṭāpārthagaḥ svarkṣānmandādgoṣṭāyakendragaḥ //
meaning:
वृद्धाविनात्सादिधिया मङ्गा मायारिगो विधोः /
केन्द्राष्टापार्थगः स्वर्क्षान्मन्दाद्गोष्टायकेन्द्रगः //
text_mt: in the eleventh and fifth from the Sun; in the ascendant, eleventh, and sixth from the Moon; / in the kendras, eighth, and twelfth from its own sign; and in the ninth, eighth, eleventh, and kendras from Saturn,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭ tridhī bhavataḥ saumyātṣaḍvāṃśāṣṭago bhṛgoḥ /
karmāyavyayaṣaṣṭastho jīvādbhaumaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
षट् त्रिधी भवतः सौम्यात्षड्वांशाष्टगो भृगोः /
कर्मायव्ययषष्टस्थो जीवाद्भौमः शुभः स्मृतः //
text_mt: in the sixth, third, and fifth from Mercury; in the sixth and eighth from Venus; / and situated in the tenth, eleventh, twelfth, and sixth from Jupiter, Mars is considered auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kaverddhyāṣaṣṭamodhyāye sanjñomandānsadhītraye /
sākṣāste bhūmijājjīvādyayāribhavamṛtyugaḥ //
meaning:
कवेर्द्ध्याषष्टमोध्याये सन्ज्ञोमन्दान्सधीत्रये /
साक्षास्ते भूमिजाज्जीवाद्ययारिभवमृत्युगः //
text_mt: In the fifth and eighth from Venus; in the sixth, eleventh, fifth, and third from Saturn; / in the fifth and seventh from Mars; in the twelfth, sixth, eleventh, and eighth from Jupiter;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāyārisatāntyerkātsādyatrisvagatā svabhāt /
ṣaṭkhāyāṣṭābdhikhoṣvijyātsahādyeṣu vilagnataḥ //
meaning:
धर्मायारिसतान्त्येर्कात्साद्यत्रिस्वगता स्वभात् /
षट्खायाष्टाब्धिखोष्विज्यात्सहाद्येषु विलग्नतः //
text_mt: in the ninth, eleventh, sixth, fifth, and twelfth from the Sun; in the second, third, and fifth from its own sign; / in the sixth, tenth, eleventh, eighth, fourth, and twelfth from Jupiter; and in the third and ascendant from the lagna,

sanskrit_iast:
dikvāṣṭādyastabandhyāye kujātkhātsatrike guruḥ /
sātryaṅke san raveḥ śukrāddhīkhago digbhavārigaḥ //
meaning:
दिक्वाष्टाद्यस्तबन्ध्याये कुजात्खात्सत्रिके गुरुः /
सात्र्यङ्के सन् रवेः शुक्राद्धीखगो दिग्भवारिगः //
text_mt: in the tenth, eighth, first, seventh, and fourth from Mars; and in the tenth, third, ninth, and first from the Sun, Jupiter is auspicious; from Venus in the fifth, tenth, eleventh, and sixth;

sanskrit_iast:
candrādvīśārthagosteṣu mandāddhītriṣaḍantyagaḥ /
gobdhidhīṣaṭkhakhādyā ye jñātsadyūne vilagnataḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्राद्वीशार्थगोस्तेषु मन्दाद्धीत्रिषडन्त्यगः /
गोब्धिधीषट्खखाद्या ये ज्ञात्सद्यूने विलग्नतः //
text_mt: in the second, eleventh, and second from the Moon; in the fifth, third, sixth, and twelfth from Saturn; / in the ninth, fourth, fifth, sixth, tenth, and ascendant from Mercury; and in the seventh from the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
āśu teśāṣṭagoṣvaṅgaḥtsāṃteṣvabjātsitaḥ śubhaḥ /
svātsajñeṣu tridhīgobdhī dikchidrāsigatorkajāt //
meaning:
आशु तेशाष्टगोष्वङ्गःत्सांतेष्वब्जात्सितः शुभः /
स्वात्सज्ञेषु त्रिधीगोब्धी दिक्छिद्रासिगतोर्कजात् //
text_mt: Venus is auspicious in these places; in the eighth from itself, and in the designated houses from the Moon; / in the second, fifth, third, ninth, fourth, tenth, and eighth from Saturn;

sanskrit_iast:
randhrāyavyacagaḥ sūryādoṣṭadhīkhe sagorguro /
jñābdhitryāyārigorātriṣaṭdhyadhyāntyagoṣu ca //
meaning:
रन्ध्रायव्यचगः सूर्यादोष्टधीखे सगोर्गुरो /
ज्ञाब्धित्र्यायारिगोरात्रिषट्ध्यध्यान्त्यगोषु च //
text_mt: in the eighth, eleventh, and twelfth from the Sun; in the eighth, fifth, and tenth from Jupiter; / in the fourth, third, eleventh, and sixth from Mercury; and in the sixth, fifth, and twelfth from the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhīśāriṣu mandaḥ khātsākṣāntyeṣu śubho sṛjaḥ /
kendrāyāṣṭadhaneṣvarkā lagnādvṛddhyādyabandhuṣu //
meaning:
त्रिधीशारिषु मन्दः खात्साक्षान्त्येषु शुभो सृजः /
केन्द्रायाष्टधनेष्वर्का लग्नाद्वृद्ध्याद्यबन्धुषु //
text_mt: Saturn is auspicious in the third, fifth, eleventh, and sixth; from Mars in the tenth, fifth, and twelfth; / from the Sun in the kendras, eleventh, eighth, and second; and from the ascendant in the eleventh, first, and fourth;

sanskrit_iast:
godhvaṣṭāpārikhāntyejñāccandrāllābhatriṣadbhataḥ /
ṣaḍaṣṭāntyagataḥ śukrādgurīrdvīśāntyaśatruṣu //
meaning:
गोध्वष्टापारिखान्त्येज्ञाच्चन्द्राल्लाभत्रिषद्भतः /
षडष्टान्त्यगतः शुक्राद्गुरीर्द्वीशान्त्यशत्रुषु //
text_mt: in the ninth, eighth, twelfth, sixth, tenth, and twelfth from Mercury; in the eleventh, third, and sixth from the Moon; / in the sixth, eighth, and twelfth from Venus; and in the second, eleventh, twelfth, and sixth from Jupiter.

sanskrit_iast:
uktasthāneṣu rekhādo hyanukteṣu tu bindudāḥ /
janmabhādvadvimitroccasvabhedhiṣṭaṃ pareṣvasat //
meaning:
उक्तस्थानेषु रेखादो ह्यनुक्तेषु तु बिन्दुदाः /
जन्मभाद्वद्विमित्रोच्चस्वभेधिष्टं परेष्वसत् //
text_mt: In the mentioned places they give lines (rekhā), while in the unmentioned places they give dots (bindu). / In friendly, exalted, and own signs from the natal sign, results are desirable; in others, they are adverse.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṣṭamarthakṣayaḥ kleśaḥ samatārthasukhāgamaḥ /
dhanāptiḥ sukhamiṣṭāptiriti rekhāphalaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
कष्टमर्थक्षयः क्लेशः समतार्थसुखागमः /
धनाप्तिः सुखमिष्टाप्तिरिति रेखाफलं क्रमात् //
text_mt: Misfortune, loss of wealth, anguish, mediocrity, gain of wealth and happiness, / acquisition of money, comfort, and fulfillment of desires—such is the fruit of the lines in order.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛdviṣanmitrabhrātṛstrībhṛtakādraveḥ /
svāmilagrājayoḥ svasthādbhedarkasvayaśośayāt //
meaning:
पितृमातृद्विषन्मित्रभ्रातृस्त्रीभृतकाद्रवेः /
स्वामिलग्राजयोः स्वस्थाद्भेदर्कस्वयशोशयात् //
text_mt: From the Sun and other planets respectively, livelihood is discerned concerning father, mother, enemy, friend, brother, wife, and servant, / or from the lord of the tenth house, according to their place and the glory of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇasvarṇāśvadhoraṇādyairarkāṃśe vṛttimādiśet /
kṛṣyaṃbujasrībhyobjāṃśe kauje dhātvasrasāhasaiḥ //
meaning:
तृणस्वर्णाश्वधोरणाद्यैरर्कांशे वृत्तिमादिशेत् /
कृष्यंबुजस्रीभ्योब्जांशे कौजे धात्वस्रसाहसैः //
text_mt: In the Sun's navāṃśa, one should predict a livelihood by grass, gold, horses, and carriages; / in the Moon's navāṃśa, through agriculture, aquatic products, and women; in Mars's navāṃśa, through minerals, weapons, and daring deeds;

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyaśilpādibhirbodhe jave devadvijākaraiḥ /
śaukre rajatagoratnairmānde hiṃsaśramādhamaiḥ //
meaning:
काव्यशिल्पादिभिर्बोधे जवे देवद्विजाकरैः /
शौक्रे रजतगोरत्नैर्मान्दे हिंसश्रमाधमैः //
text_mt: in Mercury's navāṃśa, through poetry, arts, and crafts; in Jupiter's navāṃśa, through gods, brāhmaṇas, and mines; / in Venus's navāṃśa, through silver, cows, and gems; in Saturn's navāṃśa, through violence, heavy labor, and base trades.

sanskrit_iast:
svoñceṣvārkī tathā jyārairuktaikāṅge nṛ pādhipāḥ /
lagre vargottame 'bje vā caturādigrahekṣite //
meaning:
स्वोञ्चेष्वार्की तथा ज्यारैरुक्तैकाङ्गे नृ पाधिपाः /
लग्रे वर्गोत्तमे ऽब्जे वा चतुरादिग्रहेक्षिते //
text_mt: When Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars are in their respective exaltations in the mentioned single limb, they become lords of kings. / If the ascendant or the Moon is in vargottama and aspected by four or more planets,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāviṃśabhūpāstuṅgesṛkcāperkendūyamastanau /
bhūpakṛttuṅgagorkegestesājārkekhabhe gurau //
meaning:
द्वाविंशभूपास्तुङ्गेसृक्चापेर्केन्दूयमस्तनौ /
भूपकृत्तुङ्गगोर्केगेस्तेसाजार्केखभे गुरौ //
text_mt: kings numbering twenty-two [are produced]; when Mars is in exaltation, the Sun and Moon in Sagittarius, and Saturn in the ascendant, / it makes a king; or when the Sun is in exaltation and Jupiter is in the tenth house,

sanskrit_iast:
yamendutuṅgagau lagne ṣaṣṭer'kajñau tulājagau /
sitāsṛjo gurau karke sārāje lagnage nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
यमेन्दुतुङ्गगौ लग्ने षष्टेर्ऽकज्ञौ तुलाजगौ /
सितासृजो गुरौ कर्के साराजे लग्नगे नृपाः //
text_mt: when Saturn and the Moon are in exaltation in the ascendant, the Sun and Mercury in the sixth house in Libra and Aries, / or Venus and Mars with Jupiter in Cancer, and Mars in Aries in the ascendant, kings are born.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣegebjerkejyasauraiḥ suhṛjjāyākhagairnṛpaḥ /
mande mṛgāṅgetryaryakāṃśasthairajādibhirnṛpa //
meaning:
वृषेगेब्जेर्केज्यसौरैः सुहृज्जायाखगैर्नृपः /
मन्दे मृगाङ्गेत्र्यर्यकांशस्थैरजादिभिर्नृप //
text_mt: When the Moon is in Taurus, and the Sun, Jupiter, and Saturn are in friendly signs, in the seventh, or in the tenth, a king is born. / When Saturn is in Capricorn, and planets from Aries onward are in their navāṃśas, a king is born.

sanskrit_iast:
sejyājeśve mṛgamukhe kuje tuṅgerkṣabhāgevau /
lagne 'tha sejyakarkeṅge jñājaśukrairbhavopagaiḥ //
meaning:
सेज्याजेश्वे मृगमुखे कुजे तुङ्गेर्क्षभागेवौ /
लग्ने ऽथ सेज्यकर्केङ्गे ज्ञाजशुक्रैर्भवोपगैः //
text_mt: With Jupiter in Aries and Mars in Capricorn, if the Sun is in its exalted navāṃśa in the ascendant; / or with Jupiter in Cancer in the ascendant, and Mercury, the Sun, and Venus occupying the eleventh house,

sanskrit_iast:
meṣe 'rke bhūmipāseṃdau eṣe ṣāṅgrerkapapāsṛjaḥ /
siṃhakuṃbhamṛgasthāścedbhūpaḥ sāretanāvaje //
meaning:
मेषे ऽर्के भूमिपासेंदौ एषे षाङ्ग्रेर्कपपासृजः /
सिंहकुंभमृगस्थाश्चेद्भूपः सारेतनावजे //
text_mt: with the Sun in Aries, kings are born; or when the Moon is in Taurus, and the Sun, Saturn, and Mars / are placed in Leo, Aquarius, and Capricorn, and Mars is in the ascendant in Aries, a king is born.

sanskrit_iast:
ārkejīve tanau vāpi nṛpo 'thoḥ kujabhāskarau /
dhīsthau gurvidukavayo bhūmau ratryage budhairnṛpaḥ //
meaning:
आर्केजीवे तनौ वापि नृपो ऽथोः कुजभास्करौ /
धीस्थौ गुर्विदुकवयो भूमौ रत्र्यगे बुधैर्नृपः //
text_mt: Or when the Sun and Jupiter are in the ascendant, a king is born; likewise when Mars and the Sun / are in the fifth house, and Jupiter, the Moon, and Venus are on the earth [fourth house], or with Mercury in the ninth, a king is born.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgāsyalagnagaiḥ saurejābjarkṣaharayaḥ sayāḥ /
kavikṣau tulayuramasthau vai bhūpaḥ kīrtimānbhavent //
meaning:
मृगास्यलग्नगैः सौरेजाब्जर्क्षहरयः सयाः /
कविक्षौ तुलयुरमस्थौ वै भूपः कीर्तिमान्भवेन्त् //
text_mt: When Saturn and Jupiter are in the ascendant in Capricorn, and the Moon, the Sun, and Mars / are in Libra and other signs, a king surely becomes illustrious.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya kasyāpi tanayaḥ proktairyogairnṛpo bhavet /
vakṣyamāṇairnṛpasuto jñeyo bhūyo munīśvara //
meaning:
यस्य कस्यापि तनयः प्रोक्तैर्योगैर्नृपो भवेत् /
वक्ष्यमाणैर्नृपसुतो ज्ञेयो भूयो मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: The son of anyone at all becomes a king through the combinations described above. / Through those to be spoken hereafter, the son of a king is to be known as becoming one even more, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
svocce trikoṇabhagatestryādyairbalayutairnṛpaḥ /
siṃher'ke meṣalagne 'je mṛge bhaume ghaṭe 'ṣṭame //
meaning:
स्वोच्चे त्रिकोणभगतेस्त्र्याद्यैर्बलयुतैर्नृपः /
सिंहेर्ऽके मेषलग्ने ऽजे मृगे भौमे घटे ऽष्टमे //
text_mt: When three or more planets endowed with strength are in their exaltation or trine signs, a king is born; / or when the Sun is in Leo, the ascendant is Aries, Mars is in Capricorn, and Saturn is in Aquarius in the eighth house.

sanskrit_iast:
cāpe dharānāthaḥsyādatha svarkṣage bhṛgau /
pātālage dharmage 'bje śubhadṛṣṭe yute mune //
meaning:
चापे धरानाथःस्यादथ स्वर्क्षगे भृगौ /
पातालगे धर्मगे ऽब्जे शुभदृष्टे युते मुने //
text_mt: In Sagittarius, he becomes a lord of the earth. Moreover, when Venus is in its own sign, / the Moon in the fourth or ninth house, aspected by or conjoined with a benefic, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
trilagnabhavagaiḥśeṣairdharādhīśaḥ prajāyate /
saumye vīryayuteṃ'gasthe balāḍhyeśubhage śubhe //
meaning:
त्रिलग्नभवगैःशेषैर्धराधीशः प्रजायते /
सौम्ये वीर्ययुतेंऽगस्थे बलाढ्येशुभगे शुभे //
text_mt: and the remaining [planets] are in the third, first, and eleventh houses, a sovereign of the earth is born. / When Mercury, endowed with strength, is in the ascendant, and a benefic is in a benefic [house] endowed with strength,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthopacayasthaiścaśeṣairdharmayutonṛpaḥ /
meṣūraṇāyatanugāḥ śaśisūryajasūrayaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मार्थोपचयस्थैश्चशेषैर्धर्मयुतोनृपः /
मेषूरणायतनुगाः शशिसूर्यजसूरयः //
text_mt: and the remaining [planets] are situated in the ninth, second, and upacaya houses, a virtuous king [is born]. / When the Moon, the son of the Sun (Saturn), and Jupiter are in the tenth, eleventh, and ascendant [respectively],

sanskrit_iast:
jñārau dhaneśitaravā hibuke bhūpatistadā /
vṛṣeṃ'ge 'bjodhanāristho jīvārkī lāṃbhagāḥ pare //
meaning:
ज्ञारौ धनेशितरवा हिबुके भूपतिस्तदा /
वृषेंऽगे ऽब्जोधनारिस्थो जीवार्की लांभगाः परे //
text_mt: Mercury and Mars in the second, and the Sun in the fourth, then [one becomes] a ruler of the earth. / When the Moon is in the ascendant Taurus, Jupiter and Saturn in the second and sixth, and the others in the eleventh;

sanskrit_iast:
sukhe guruḥ kheravīndūyamo lagne bhave karai /
lagne vakrāsitau candrejyasitārkabudhāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
सुखे गुरुः खेरवीन्दूयमो लग्ने भवे करै /
लग्ने वक्रासितौ चन्द्रेज्यसितार्कबुधाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: [or] Jupiter in the fourth, the Sun and Moon in the tenth, and Saturn in the ascendant, [a king] is born with hands [bearing royal marks]. / When Mars and Saturn are in the ascendant, and the Moon, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun, and Mercury are respectively

sanskrit_iast:
sukhāstu śubhakhāptisthānareśaṃ janayantyapi /
karmalagnagaraveṭasya daśāyāṃ rājyasaṃgatiḥ //
meaning:
सुखास्तु शुभखाप्तिस्थानरेशं जनयन्त्यपि /
कर्मलग्नगरवेटस्य दशायां राज्यसंगतिः //
text_mt: in the fourth [house], benefic, tenth, and eleventh houses, they indeed generate a king. / In the planetary period of the planet occupying the tenth house or the ascendant, attainment of kingship occurs;

sanskrit_iast:
prabalasya daśāyāṃ vā śatrunīcā digārtidāḥ /
āsannakendradvayagairvargadākhyaḥ sakalagrahaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रबलस्य दशायां वा शत्रुनीचा दिगार्तिदाः /
आसन्नकेन्द्रद्वयगैर्वर्गदाख्यः सकलग्रहैः //
text_mt: or in the planetary period of a strong [planet]; [planets] in enemy or depression signs, etc., cause distress. / When all planets are situated in two adjacent angles, it is called the Vargada [yoga];

sanskrit_iast:
tanvastagaiśca sakaṭaṃ vihago rājyabandhugaiḥ /
śṛṅgāṭakaṃ dhigaugasthairlagnāyasthairhalaṃ matam //
meaning:
तन्वस्तगैश्च सकटं विहगो राज्यबन्धुगैः /
शृङ्गाटकं धिगौगस्थैर्लग्नायस्थैर्हलं मतम् //
text_mt: and when occupying the ascendant and descendant, it is Sakaṭa; Vihaga when [planets] occupy the tenth and fourth houses; / Śṛṅgāṭaka when they occupy the ninth, ascendant, and fifth; Hala is considered [to occur] when occupying the ascendant and eleventh houses;

sanskrit_iast:
varjjoṅgesthe satsvasatsu turyakhasthairyavonyathā /
vimiśraiḥ kamalaṃ prāhurvāyākaṇṭakabāhyagaiḥ //
meaning:
वर्ज्जोङ्गेस्थे सत्स्वसत्सु तुर्यखस्थैर्यवोन्यथा /
विमिश्रैः कमलं प्राहुर्वायाकण्टकबाह्यगैः //
text_mt: when benefics occupy the ascendant and malefics occupy the fourth and tenth, it is Vajra, and otherwise Yava; / when mixed, they call it Kamala; when outside the angles, [they call it Vāpī];

sanskrit_iast:
lagnāccaturbhugairyūpaḥśarastūryāccaturbhugaiḥ /
dyūnādvedakṣagaiḥ śaktirṃ da'khādicaturbhagaiḥ //
meaning:
लग्नाच्चतुर्भुगैर्यूपःशरस्तूर्याच्चतुर्भुगैः /
द्यूनाद्वेदक्षगैः शक्तिर्ं दऽखादिचतुर्भगैः //
text_mt: occupying four houses continuously from the ascendant is Yūpa; Śara is from four houses from the fourth; / Śakti is from four houses from the seventh; Daṇḍa is from four houses beginning with the tenth;

sanskrit_iast:
lagnātkramātsaptabhagairnokākūṭastu nuryataḥ /
chatramastātsvabhādyāyonyasmādarddhendunāmakaḥ //
meaning:
लग्नात्क्रमात्सप्तभगैर्नोकाकूटस्तु नुर्यतः /
छत्रमस्तात्स्वभाद्यायोन्यस्मादर्द्धेन्दुनामकः //
text_mt: occupying seven houses continuously from the ascendant is Naukā, but Kūṭa is from the fourth; / Chatra is from the seventh; from any other sign beginning with the second, it is called Ardhendu;

sanskrit_iast:
lagnādekāntaragataiścakramarthātsaritpatiḥ /
ṣahyusthāneṣu vīṇādyāḥ samasaptarkṣagaiḥ //
meaning:
लग्नादेकान्तरगतैश्चक्रमर्थात्सरित्पतिः /
षह्युस्थानेषु वीणाद्याः समसप्तर्क्षगैः //
text_mt: occupying alternate houses from the ascendant is Cakra; [from the second], Samudra; / in the houses of the signs, Vīṇā and the others [are formed] by [planets] occupying seven signs:

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇādāmapāśakedārabhūśūlayugagolakāḥ /
grahaiḥścarabhagai rājayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
वीणादामपाशकेदारभूशूलयुगगोलकाः /
ग्रहैःश्चरभगै राजयोगः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt: Vīṇā, Dāma, Pāśa, Kedāra, Śūla, Yuga, and Gola. / By planets situated in movable signs, a rājayoga is proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
sthirasthairyamusalaṃ nāma dviśarīṇatairnalaḥ /
bhālā kendrasthitaiḥ saumyaiḥ pāpaiḥsarpa udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
स्थिरस्थैर्यमुसलं नाम द्विशरीणतैर्नलः /
भाला केन्द्रस्थितैः सौम्यैः पापैःसर्प उदाहृतः //
text_mt: by those in fixed signs, Musala by name; by those in dual signs, Nala; / when benefics occupy angles, it is Mālā; when malefics [occupy them], Sarpa is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
īryyuradhvarucī rajjvāṃ musale dhanamānayuk /
vyaṅgā sthirā lonalajo monīsragjohijordditaḥ //
meaning:
ईर्य्युरध्वरुची रज्ज्वां मुसले धनमानयुक् /
व्यङ्गा स्थिरा लोनलजो मोनीस्रग्जोहिजोर्द्दितः //
text_mt: One born in Rajju is jealous and fond of travel; in Musala, endowed with wealth and honour; / in Nala, defective in limb, firm, and clever; in Sraj, honoured; in Sarpa, afflicted;

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇodbhavotinipuṇāgītanṛtyarucirbhṛśam /
dātā samṛddho dāmāsthaḥ pāśajo dhanaśīlayuk //
meaning:
वीणोद्भवोतिनिपुणागीतनृत्यरुचिर्भृशम् /
दाता समृद्धो दामास्थः पाशजो धनशीलयुक् //
text_mt: one born under Vīṇā is very skilled, extremely fond of song and dance; / born in Dāma, generous and prosperous; born in Pāśa, endowed with wealth and good conduct;

sanskrit_iast:
kedārotthaḥ kṛṣikaraḥ śūle śūrokṣato dhanaḥ /
yugaṃ pāṣaṇḍayurgole vidhano malinastathā //
meaning:
केदारोत्थः कृषिकरः शूले शूरोक्षतो धनः /
युगं पाषण्डयुर्गोले विधनो मलिनस्तथा //
text_mt: arisen in Kedāra, an agriculturist; in Śūla, a brave warrior, wounded, without wealth; / in Yuga, a heretic; likewise in Gola, destitute and filthy;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpavandyapadaścakre samudre nṛpabhogayuk /
subhagāṅgorddhacaṃpātsukhīśūraśca cāmaraḥ //
meaning:
भूपवन्द्यपदश्चक्रे समुद्रे नृपभोगयुक् /
सुभगाङ्गोर्द्धचंपात्सुखीशूरश्च चामरः //
text_mt: in Cakra, one whose feet are worshipped by kings; in Samudra, endowed with royal enjoyments; / in Ardhendu, having handsome limbs, happy, valorous, and like a fly-whisk [bearer];

sanskrit_iast:
mitro pakārakṛcchatre kūṭe cānṛtabandharāṭ /
taujaḥ sakīrtiḥ sukhabhāk mānavo bhavati dhruvam //
meaning:
मित्रो पकारकृच्छत्रे कूटे चानृतबन्धराट् /
तौजः सकीर्तिः सुखभाक् मानवो भवति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: in Chatra, a benefactor of friends; in Kūṭa, a liar and deceitful king; / in it a man certainly becomes vigorous, renowned, and endowed with happiness;

sanskrit_iast:
tyāgī yajvātmavān yūthe hiṃsro guhyādhipaḥ śaraiḥ /
śaktau nīco 'laso niḥsvo daṇḍe priyaviyogabhāk //
meaning:
त्यागी यज्वात्मवान् यूथे हिंस्रो गुह्याधिपः शरैः /
शक्तौ नीचो ऽलसो निःस्वो दण्डे प्रियवियोगभाक् //
text_mt: in Yūpa, self-controlled, a sacrificer, generous; in Śara, cruel, a lord of secrets; / in Śakti, base, lazy, penniless; in Daṇḍa, experiencing separation from loved ones.

sanskrit_iast:
vyarkaiḥ svāntyobhayagataiḥ kheṭaiḥ syātsunaphaānaphaā /
durudharā caiva vidhau jñeyaḥ kemudrumo 'nyathā //
meaning:
व्यर्कैः स्वान्त्योभयगतैः खेटैः स्यात्सुनफआनफआ /
दुरुधरा चैव विधौ ज्ञेयः केमुद्रुमो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: By planets other than the Sun occupying the second, twelfth, or both [houses] from the Moon, / Sunaphā, Anaphā, and Durudharā occur; otherwise, it is to be known as Kemadruma.

sanskrit_iast:
svopārjitārthabhugdātā sunaphaāyāṃ dhanī sukhī /
nīrogaḥ śīlavān khyātaḥ suveṣaścānaphaābhavaḥ //
meaning:
स्वोपार्जितार्थभुग्दाता सुनफआयां धनी सुखी /
नीरोगः शीलवान् ख्यातः सुवेषश्चानफआभवः //
text_mt: One born in Sunaphā enjoys self-earned wealth, is generous, wealthy, and happy; / born in Anaphā, he is free from disease, virtuous, famous, and well-dressed;

sanskrit_iast:
bhogī sukhī dhanīdānītyāgī durudhurodbhavaḥ /
kemudrume 'timalino duḥkhī nīco 'tha nirdhanaḥ //
meaning:
भोगी सुखी धनीदानीत्यागी दुरुधुरोद्भवः /
केमुद्रुमे ऽतिमलिनो दुःखी नीचो ऽथ निर्धनः //
text_mt: one born in Durudharā is an enjoyer, happy, wealthy, charitable, and generous; / in Kemadruma, exceedingly dirty, miserable, base, and destitute.

sanskrit_iast:
yantryāśmakāraṃśājoko bhaumapuṣkarurte dhvagaḥ sujñaḥ /
sukīrtirnipuṇaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhaninaṃ tathā //
meaning:
यन्त्र्याश्मकारंशाजोको भौमपुष्करुर्ते ध्वगः सुज्ञः /
सुकीर्तिर्निपुणं विद्वांसं धनिनं तथा //
text_mt: [The Moon combined with Mars makes one] a maker of machines and weapons; [with Mercury], a traveller, wise, / renowned, skilled, learned, and also wealthy;

sanskrit_iast:
senyonyakāryanirataṃ sāsphujicchasrajīvinam /
samando dhātukuśalaṃ tathā bhāḍaṃvidaṃ mune //
meaning:
सेन्योन्यकार्यनिरतं सास्फुजिच्छस्रजीविनम् /
समन्दो धातुकुशलं तथा भाडंविदं मुने //
text_mt: with Jupiter, devoted to others' affairs; with Venus, living by weapons; / with Saturn, skilled in metallurgy and an expert in vessels, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭasnyāśavapaṇyāṭhaṃ nasāsṛgindgaḥ prasūdviṣam /
kuryātsajñorthanipuṇaṃ namraṃ satkīrtisaṃyutam //
meaning:
कूटस्न्याशवपण्याठं नसासृगिन्द्गः प्रसूद्विषम् /
कुर्यात्सज्ञोर्थनिपुणं नम्रं सत्कीर्तिसंयुतम् //
text_mt: [Mars combined with the Moon makes one dealing in] forged goods and deceitful merchandise, or an enemy of one's mother; / with Mercury, it makes one skilled in wealth, humble, and endowed with good fame;

sanskrit_iast:
sajyo 'sthiravayaṃ vaṃśyaṃ vikrāntaṃ ca samarthinam /
sasitosukavettāraṃ sārkiponabhavaṃ mune //
meaning:
सज्यो ऽस्थिरवयं वंश्यं विक्रान्तं च समर्थिनम् /
ससितोसुकवेत्तारं सार्किपोनभवं मुने //
text_mt: with Jupiter, of unsteady age, of noble lineage, valorous, and desirous of wealth; / with Venus, knowing poetry; with Saturn, barren, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
āre sajñe vāhuyodhī purādhyakṣaḥ sagīṣpatau /
saśukre dyūtakrarheyo nṛtī dyūti samandake //
meaning:
आरे सज्ञे वाहुयोधी पुराध्यक्षः सगीष्पतौ /
सशुक्रे द्यूतक्रर्हेयो नृती द्यूति समन्दके //
text_mt: when Mars is with Mercury, a wrestler; with Jupiter, head of a city; / with Venus, an adroit gambler; with Saturn, a dancer and gambler;

sanskrit_iast:
sejyejñe nṛtyagītāḍhyo māyādakṣaḥ /
sabhārgavesamande lubdhakaḥ krūro naro bhavati nārada //
meaning:
सेज्येज्ञे नृत्यगीताढ्यो मायादक्षः /
सभार्गवेसमन्दे लुब्धकः क्रूरो नरो भवति नारद //
text_mt: when Mercury is with Jupiter, rich in dance and song, skilled in illusions; / with Venus and Saturn, a man becomes a hunter and cruel, O Nārada;

sanskrit_iast:
saśukre vākpatau vidvānsāsite 'nnaghaṭaṅkaraḥ /
kavau sa mandamandākṣā va vaniśrayavittavān //
meaning:
सशुक्रे वाक्पतौ विद्वान्सासिते ऽन्नघटङ्करः /
कवौ स मन्दमन्दाक्षा व वनिश्रयवित्तवान् //
text_mt: when Jupiter is with Venus, learned; with Saturn, a cook of food; / when Venus is with Saturn, one is shy and possesses wealth gained through women.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasthaiścaturādyaistu khavārthaiḥ khacaraiḥ pṛthak /
kujajñejyājaśukrārkisūryaḥ parivrajennaraḥ //
meaning:
एकस्थैश्चतुराद्यैस्तु खवार्थैः खचरैः पृथक् /
कुजज्ञेज्याजशुक्रार्किसूर्यः परिव्रजेन्नरः //
text_mt: By four or more planets situated in a single house, / a person takes renunciation under Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, or the Sun respectively,

sanskrit_iast:
śākyājīvakavṛddhārthica rakākhaphalāśanaḥ /
tatsvāmibhiḥ paridajitaiḥ pravrajyāpracyutirbhavet //
meaning:
शाक्याजीवकवृद्धार्थिच रकाखफलाशनः /
तत्स्वामिभिः परिदजितैः प्रव्रज्याप्रच्युतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: as a Buddhist, Ājīvika, elder, wandering mendicant, or eater of fruits. / If their lords are defeated [in planetary war], a fall from renunciation occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitālpastagataiḥ sabalaistatsthabhaktayaḥ /
janmaponyairyadyadṛṣṭo mandaṃ paśyati nārada //
meaning:
अदीक्षिताल्पस्तगतैः सबलैस्तत्स्थभक्तयः /
जन्मपोन्यैर्यद्यदृष्टो मन्दं पश्यति नारद //
text_mt: If uninitiated or weak planets occupy it, one has devotion to those deities. / If the lord of the birth sign, not aspected by others, aspects Saturn, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
mando vā janmapaṃ naṣṭaṃ tathā ca mandakāgaṇe /
bhaumārkāṃśe sauradṛṣṭe candre vā dīkṣito bhavet //
meaning:
मन्दो वा जन्मपं नष्टं तथा च मन्दकागणे /
भौमार्कांशे सौरदृष्टे चन्द्रे वा दीक्षितो भवेत् //
text_mt: or if Saturn aspects the birth lord when devoid of strength, and likewise in the division of Saturn, / or if the Moon is in the navāṃśa of Mars or the Sun and aspected by Saturn, one becomes an ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
surūpo bhūṣitago 'śinyāṃ dakṣaḥ satyavacā yame /
bahūbhugpadāragnau sthiradhīḥ priyavāktathā //
meaning:
सुरूपो भूषितगो ऽशिन्यां दक्षः सत्यवचा यमे /
बहूभुग्पदारग्नौ स्थिरधीः प्रियवाक्तथा //
text_mt: In Aśvinī, handsome, fond of ornaments; in Yama (Bharaṇī), clever and truthful; / in Agni (Kṛttikā), a heavy eater, steady-minded, and of pleasant speech;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmo dhanīmṛge bhogī raudre hiṃstraḥ śaṭho 'ghakṛt /
dānto rogī śubho 'dityāṃ puṣyaryajanmā kaviḥ sukhī //
meaning:
ब्राह्मो धनीमृगे भोगी रौद्रे हिंस्त्रः शठो ऽघकृत् /
दान्तो रोगी शुभो ऽदित्यां पुष्यर्यजन्मा कविः सुखी //
text_mt: in the Brāhma [constellation] (Rohiṇī), wealthy; in Mṛgaśiras, an enjoyer; in Raudra (Ārdrā), cruel, deceitful, and sinful; / in Aditi (Punarvasu), self-controlled, sickly, and auspicious; born in Puṣya, a poet and happy;

sanskrit_iast:
dhūrtaḥ śaṭhaḥ kṛtaghno 'hau pāpaḥ sarvāśano bhavet /
patre bhogī dhanī bhakto dātā priyavacā bhage //
meaning:
धूर्तः शठः कृतघ्नो ऽहौ पापः सर्वाशनो भवेत् /
पत्रे भोगी धनी भक्तो दाता प्रियवचा भगे //
text_mt: in the serpent constellation (Āśleṣā), cunning, treacherous, ungrateful, evil, and omnivorous; / in the leaf constellation (Maghā), an enjoyer, wealthy, and devoted; in Bhaga (Pūrvaphālgunī), generous and pleasant-spoken;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanī bhogīnaroryamarkṣe steno dhṛṣṭo ghṛṇī kare /
citrāṃbaraḥ sudṛktvāṣṭre na ca dharmadayāparaḥ //
meaning:
धनी भोगीनरोर्यमर्क्षे स्तेनो धृष्टो घृणी करे /
चित्रांबरः सुदृक्त्वाष्ट्रे न च धर्मदयापरः //
text_mt: in Aryaman's constellation (Uttaraphālgunī), wealthy and enjoying; in Hasta, a thief, insolent, and compassionate; / in Citrā, wearing varied garments, having good eyes, but not devoted to virtue and pity;

sanskrit_iast:
dvīśe lubdhaḥ paṭuḥ krodhī maḍhaiyo āṭhanovideśagaḥ /
śākre dharmaparastuṣṭo mūle mānī dhanī sukhī //
meaning:
द्वीशे लुब्धः पटुः क्रोधी मढैयो आठनोविदेशगः /
शाक्रे धर्मपरस्तुष्टो मूले मानी धनी सुखी //
text_mt: in Dvīśa (Viśākhā), greedy, clever, wrathful, arrogant, and travelling abroad; / in Śakra (Jyeṣṭhā), devoted to virtue and contented; in Mūla, proud, wealthy, and happy;

sanskrit_iast:
āpye mānī dṛṣṭo vaiśve namraśca dhārmikaḥ /
karṇe dhanī sukhī khyāto dātā śūro dhanī vasau //
meaning:
आप्ये मानी दृष्टो वैश्वे नम्रश्च धार्मिकः /
कर्णे धनी सुखी ख्यातो दाता शूरो धनी वसौ //
text_mt: in Āpya (Pūrvāṣāḍhā), proud and bold; in Vaiśva (Uttarāṣāḍhā), humble and righteous; / in Karṇa (Śravaṇa), wealthy, happy, and famous; in Vasu (Śraviṣṭhā/Dhaniṣṭhā), generous, heroic, and wealthy;

sanskrit_iast:
śeta'rihṝntā vyasanī srījito jāhibhedinī /
budhne vaktā sukhī kāntaḥ pauṣṇe śūro dhanī śuciḥ //
meaning:
शेतऽरिहॄन्ता व्यसनी स्रीजितो जाहिभेदिनी /
बुध्ने वक्ता सुखी कान्तः पौष्णे शूरो धनी शुचिः //
text_mt: in Śatabhiṣaj, a conqueror of enemies, fond of vices, dominated by women, and divisive; / in Budhna (Uttarabhadrapadā), an orator, happy, and charming; in Pauṣṇa (Revatī), heroic, wealthy, and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmī śūraḥ kṛtajño 'je kāntastyāgī kṣamī vṛṣe /
yugme srīdyūtaśāsrajñaḥ sraiṇo hrasvaḥ svabhe vidhau //
meaning:
कामी शूरः कृतज्ञो ऽजे कान्तस्त्यागी क्षमी वृषे /
युग्मे स्रीद्यूतशास्रज्ञः स्रैणो ह्रस्वः स्वभे विधौ //
text_mt: In Aries, lustful, heroic, and grateful; in Taurus, charming, generous, and forbearing; / in Gemini, skilled in women, gambling, and weapons; in Cancer (the Moon's sign), fond of women and short of stature;

sanskrit_iast:
srīdviṭ krodhī harau mānī vikrāntaḥ sthiradhīḥ sukhī /
dharmī ślakṣṇaḥ sudhīḥ ṣaṣṭe prājñaḥ prāṃśurdhanī ghaṭe //
meaning:
स्रीद्विट् क्रोधी हरौ मानी विक्रान्तः स्थिरधीः सुखी /
धर्मी श्लक्ष्णः सुधीः षष्टे प्राज्ञः प्रांशुर्धनी घटे //
text_mt: in Leo, hostile to women, wrathful, proud, valorous, firm-minded, and happy; / in the sixth (Virgo), righteous, gentle, and clever; in Libra, wise, tall, and wealthy;

sanskrit_iast:
rogī pūjyaḥ kṣatī kārairpye kaviḥ śilpījyabhe dhanī /
mṛge 'laso 'ṭanaḥ svakṣaḥ paradārārthahṛddhaṭe //
meaning:
रोगी पूज्यः क्षती कारैर्प्ये कविः शिल्पीज्यभे धनी /
मृगे ऽलसो ऽटनः स्वक्षः परदारार्थहृद्धटे //
text_mt: in Scorpio, sickly, venerable, and scarred; in Sagittarius, a poet, craftsman, and wealthy; / in Capricorn, lazy, wandering, with handsome eyes; in Aquarius, stealing others' wives and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
sabalebhaibhayevāpisa valejeśilaphalam /
anyathā viparītaṃ tatpalaṃmevaṃ pare 'pi na /
khyātaḥ srīdviṭ dhanī tīkṣṇojñaḥ kaviḥ śaiṇḍiko dhanī /
pūjyo lubdho 'dhanasakho meṣādau bhāskare janau //
meaning:
सबलेभैभयेवापिस वलेजेशिलफलम् /
अन्यथा विपरीतं तत्पलंमेवं परे ऽपि न /
ख्यातः स्रीद्विट् धनी तीक्ष्णोज्ञः कविः शैण्डिको धनी /
पूज्यो लुब्धो ऽधनसखो मेषादौ भास्करे जनौ //
text_mt: When the signs or their lords are strong, the full fruit is obtained; / otherwise, that fruit is opposite, and so on for others as well. / Renowned, hostile to women, wealthy, fierce, learned, poetic, a distiller, wealthy, / revered, greedy, without wealth, or a companion, when the Sun is in Aries and the other signs at birth.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsvor'kabhe bhūmiputre bhūmiputre dhanī cāndre svabhedanaḥ /
baudhe kṛtajño jaive tu khyātaḥ śaukre 'nyadārikaḥ //
meaning:
निःस्वोर्ऽकभे भूमिपुत्रे भूमिपुत्रे धनी चान्द्रे स्वभेदनः /
बौधे कृतज्ञो जैवे तु ख्यातः शौक्रे ऽन्यदारिकः //
text_mt: When Mars is in the Sun's sign, one is destitute; in the Moon's, wealthy and destructive of his own kin; / in Mercury's, grateful; in Jupiter's, renowned; in Venus's, an adulterer.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛge bahvātmajadhanaḥ kuṃbhe duḥkhyanṛtī khalaḥ /
srīdveṣyaḥ svajanadveṣīniyaratyaḥ sadhīyanaḥ //
meaning:
मृगे बह्वात्मजधनः कुंभे दुःख्यनृती खलः /
स्रीद्वेष्यः स्वजनद्वेषीनियरत्यः सधीयनः //
text_mt: In Capricorn, he has many children and wealth; in Aquarius, he is miserable, untruthful, wicked, / hated by women, hostile to relatives, intent on misdeeds, and foolish.

sanskrit_iast:
samānārthaḥ saputrasrīsarṇaḥ sūryādibhe budhe /
senānīḥ stryarthaputrāḍhyaḥ dakṣamaiśyaḥ paricchadī //
meaning:
समानार्थः सपुत्रस्रीसर्णः सूर्यादिभे बुधे /
सेनानीः स्त्र्यर्थपुत्राढ्यः दक्षमैश्यः परिच्छदी //
text_mt: When Mercury is in the signs beginning with the Sun, [one has] mediocre wealth, children and wives, and debts; / an army commander, rich in women, wealth, and sons, clever, wealthy, possessed of retinue;

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍaleśaḥ sārthasukhaḥ sarṇasvāmyarkabhādgurau /
stryāptārtho mandaśokāḍhyo bandhudveṣī dhanāghavān //
meaning:
मण्डलेशः सार्थसुखः सर्णस्वाम्यर्कभाद्गुरौ /
स्त्र्याप्तार्थो मन्दशोकाढ्यो बन्धुद्वेषी धनाघवान् //
text_mt: a ruler of a province, endowed with caravan-trade and happiness, indebted, or a lord. When Jupiter is in the signs from the Sun: / having wealth gained from women, rich in mild grief, hating relatives, wealthy and sinful;

sanskrit_iast:
sārthaḥ prājñaḥ samaḥ khyātiḥ srīji'torkādibhe mṛgau /
vyaṅgajārtho khaprasūko vidhimitro sukhatrayaḥ //
meaning:
सार्थः प्राज्ञः समः ख्यातिः स्रीजिऽतोर्कादिभे मृगौ /
व्यङ्गजार्थो खप्रसूको विधिमित्रो सुखत्रयः //
text_mt: prosperous, wise, impartial, famous, submissive to women. When [Venus] is in the signs from the Sun: / having wealth from crippled persons, childless, friendly to the wise, endowed with threefold happiness;

sanskrit_iast:
satputrastrīdhano rājā grāme śokādibherkaje /
bhūpajñaguṇipaurāsvādṛṣṭebjejesṛgādibhiḥ //
meaning:
सत्पुत्रस्त्रीधनो राजा ग्रामे शोकादिभेर्कजे /
भूपज्ञगुणिपौरास्वादृष्टेब्जेजेसृगादिभिः //
text_mt: having good sons, wives, and wealth, a king, grieved in a village. When Saturn is in the signs [from the Sun]: / seen by Mars and so forth, [one becomes] a king, scholar, virtuous, town-headman, or consumer;

sanskrit_iast:
niḥ svastena nṛpāḥ prajñapreṣyāmavinṛyugmage /
dhātvājīvī nṛpajñābhītantuvāyādhanāḥ svabhe //
meaning:
निः स्वस्तेन नृपाः प्रज्ञप्रेष्यामविनृयुग्मगे /
धात्वाजीवी नृपज्ञाभीतन्तुवायाधनाः स्वभे //
text_mt: in Gemini, destitute, a thief, kings, scholars, servants, or diseased; / in Cancer, living by metallurgy, a king, scholar, fearful, a weaver, or poor;

sanskrit_iast:
yuyutsukavisūrījyadhātujīvidṛgāmayāḥ /
jyotirjñāḍhyejyanu khalu nṛpejñādikarharau //
meaning:
युयुत्सुकविसूरीज्यधातुजीविदृगामयाः /
ज्योतिर्ज्ञाढ्येज्यनु खलु नृपेज्ञादिकर्हरौ //
text_mt: desiring to fight, a poet, wise, an astrologer, living by minerals, or eye-diseased; / in Leo, rich in astrologers and scholars, an adviser, indeed a king, scholar, and so forth;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭe śubhairnṛpacamūpanaipuṇyavatitāśayāḥ /
jūke bhūpasvarṇakāravaṇijaḥ śeṣadṛgyute //
meaning:
षष्टे शुभैर्नृपचमूपनैपुण्यवतिताशयाः /
जूके भूपस्वर्णकारवणिजः शेषदृग्युते //
text_mt: in the sixth [Virgo], seen by benefics, commanders of the king's army, skillful, or noble-minded; / in Libra, kings, goldsmiths, or merchants; when aspected by the others,

sanskrit_iast:
dvipaitṛkābdhidhvajino vyaṅgā svakṣitipā alau /
jñātikṣmājanayāścāye sadbhirdarmī śaṭhastathā //
meaning:
द्विपैतृकाब्धिध्वजिनो व्यङ्गा स्वक्षितिपा अलौ /
ज्ञातिक्ष्माजनयाश्चाये सद्भिर्दर्मी शठस्तथा //
text_mt: having two fathers, ocean-going, banner-bearing, crippled, or independent kings; in Scorpio, / having relatives, lands, and wealth; aspected by the good, righteous; likewise a rogue;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpamaṇḍitasakhejyāmṛge bhūyānyadārikau /
kuṃbhe śeṣaiśca hāsyajñanṛpajñāḥ sadbhirantyabhe //
meaning:
भूपमण्डितसखेज्यामृगे भूयान्यदारिकौ /
कुंभे शेषैश्च हास्यज्ञनृपज्ञाः सद्भिरन्त्यभे //
text_mt: in Sagittarius, kings, adorned, friendly, or revered; in Capricorn, rich or an adulterer; / in Aquarius, aspected by the rest, comics or kings' scholars; aspected by benefics in the last sign [Pisces],

sanskrit_iast:
hāreśarkṣadalasthaistu dṛṣṭo yuktaḥ śaśī śubhaḥ /
tryaṃśe tatpatimitrarkṣagateryuktekṣitastathā //
meaning:
हारेशर्क्षदलस्थैस्तु दृष्टो युक्तः शशी शुभः /
त्र्यंशे तत्पतिमित्रर्क्षगतेर्युक्तेक्षितस्तथा //
text_mt: the Moon situated in the half of the lord's sign, aspected or conjoined [by them], is auspicious; / likewise in the drekkāṇa, situated in a friendly sign of that lord, conjoined or aspected.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṃśe phalaṃ proktaṃ navāṃśe 'pyatha kīrtyate /
ārakṣeko vadharucirniyuddhakuśalor'thavān //
meaning:
द्वादशांशे फलं प्रोक्तं नवांशे ऽप्यथ कीर्त्यते /
आरक्षेको वधरुचिर्नियुद्धकुशलोर्ऽथवान् //
text_mt: The effect in the dvādaśāṃśa has been stated; now it is proclaimed for the navāṃśa as well: / one is a guard, fond of killing, skilled in wrestling, wealthy,

sanskrit_iast:
kalahaḥ kṣitijāṃsthe śaukre mūrkho 'nyadāradaḥ /
kaviḥ sukhī budhāṃśe tu naṭacaurajñaśilpinaḥ //
meaning:
कलहः क्षितिजांस्थे शौक्रे मूर्खो ऽन्यदारदः /
कविः सुखी बुधांशे तु नटचौरज्ञशिल्पिनः //
text_mt: and quarrelsome when [the Moon is] in Mars's navāṃśa; in Venus's navāṃśa, a fool, an adulterer, / a poet, and happy; in Mercury's navāṃśa, actors, thieves, scholars, and artisans;

sanskrit_iast:
svāṃśe tvalpatanuḥ sakhastapasvī lobhatatparaḥ /
krodhī nidhīśo mātyo vā nṛpo hiṃsro suto hareḥ //
meaning:
स्वांशे त्वल्पतनुः सखस्तपस्वी लोभतत्परः /
क्रोधी निधीशो मात्यो वा नृपो हिंस्रो सुतो हरेः //
text_mt: in its own navāṃśa [Cancer], slender-bodied, a friend, an ascetic, intent on greed, / wrathful, a lord of treasures, or a minister, a king, violent, a son of Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvāṃśe hāsyavidyodhā balī mantrī ca dhārmikaḥ /
alpāpatyo duḥkhito kho duṣṭastrīsauribhāgage //
meaning:
जीवांशे हास्यविद्योधा बली मन्त्री च धार्मिकः /
अल्पापत्यो दुःखितो खो दुष्टस्त्रीसौरिभागगे //
text_mt: in Jupiter's navāṃśa, humorous, learned, heroic, strong, a counselor, and righteous; / in Saturn's navāṃśa, having few children, miserable, foolish, having a wicked wife.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānārvidvādidṛṣṭe nu tadvadeva phalaṃ vadet /
vargottame khe parabhe pala muktaṃ śubhaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
भानार्विद्वादिदृष्टे नु तद्वदेव फलं वदेत् /
वर्गोत्तमे खे परभे पल मुक्तं शुभं क्रमात् //
text_mt: When aspected by the Sun, Mars, Mercury, and so forth, one should declare the effect just so. / In a vargottama, in an empty, and in another's sign, the auspicious result is declared in order:

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭaṃ madhyaṃ laghu jñeyaṃ yadi cāṃśapatirbalī /
rāśīkṣaṇaphalaṃ ruddhvā dadātyaṃśapalaṃ spuṭam //
meaning:
पुष्टं मध्यं लघु ज्ञेयं यदि चांशपतिर्बली /
राशीक्षणफलं रुद्ध्वा ददात्यंशपलं स्पुटम् //
text_mt: it is to be known as abundant, middling, and slight. And if the lord of the navāṃśa is strong, / blocking the result of the sign's aspect, it clearly gives the result of the navāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrastabdho vikaladṛgnighṛṇor'ke tanusthite /
meṣe dhanī taimirakaḥ siṃhe rātryandha eva ca //
meaning:
शूरस्तब्धो विकलदृग्निघृणोर्ऽके तनुस्थिते /
मेषे धनी तैमिरकः सिंहे रात्र्यन्ध एव च //
text_mt: When the Sun is in the ascendant, one is brave, rigid, defective in sight, and pitiless; / in Aries, wealthy and afflicted with eye disease; and in Leo, truly night-blind;

sanskrit_iast:
nīcodhosvaḥ karkager'ke udbudākṣastanusthite /
dvitīyer'ke bahudhano nṛpadaṇḍyo mukhāmayī //
meaning:
नीचोधोस्वः कर्कगेर्ऽके उद्बुदाक्षस्तनुस्थिते /
द्वितीयेर्ऽके बहुधनो नृपदण्ड्यो मुखामयी //
text_mt: in Cancer, low, degraded, and poor; when the Sun is in the ascendant, he has swollen eyes. / When the Sun is in the second, he has much wealth, is punished by the king, and has mouth diseases;

sanskrit_iast:
trige budho vikramī ca vimukhaḥ pīḍito bhuvi /
dhanāpatyoktito dhīsthe balī śatrujitorige //
meaning:
त्रिगे बुधो विक्रमी च विमुखः पीडितो भुवि /
धनापत्योक्तितो धीस्थे बली शत्रुजितोरिगे //
text_mt: in the third, intelligent, valorous, averse [to evil], and afflicted on earth; / in the fifth, through wealth, sons, and speech; in the sixth, strong and victorious over enemies;

sanskrit_iast:
strī jito dyūnasaṃsthe ca nidhanelpātmajolpadṛk /
sutārthasukhabhā bhāraye daśame śrutaśauryavāt //
meaning:
स्त्री जितो द्यूनसंस्थे च निधनेल्पात्मजोल्पदृक् /
सुतार्थसुखभा भारये दशमे श्रुतशौर्यवात् //
text_mt: in the seventh, subjugated by women; in the eighth, having few sons and poor sight; / in the ninth, endowed with sons, wealth, and happiness; in the tenth, endowed with sacred learning and valor;

sanskrit_iast:
lābhe bahudhano mānī patito kho 'vyaye ravau /.
mūkodho badhiraḥ preṣyo jege khāñcājage dhanī //
meaning:
लाभे बहुधनो मानी पतितो खो ऽव्यये रवौ /.
मूकोधो बधिरः प्रेष्यो जेगे खाञ्चाजगे धनी //
text_mt: in the eleventh, possessed of much wealth and pride; when the Sun is in the twelfth, fallen and wretched. / [For the Moon:] dumb, blind, deaf, a servant in [the first sign]; in Aries, wealthy;

sanskrit_iast:
buṭurvā dhanavānadhe hiṃsro vikramage bhavet /
sādhubhāvaḥ sukhagate dhīsthe kanyāprajolasaḥ //
meaning:
बुटुर्वा धनवानधे हिंस्रो विक्रमगे भवेत् /
साधुभावः सुखगते धीस्थे कन्याप्रजोलसः //
text_mt: or a youth, wealthy in the second; in the third, violent; / in the fourth, of virtuous disposition; in the fifth, having female offspring and lazy;

sanskrit_iast:
alpāgnikāmastīkṣṇorauīṣyustatrimadojñarave /
vyādhipūḍānvito mṛtyau bhānurddhanage mitradhanānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अल्पाग्निकामस्तीक्ष्णोरौईष्युस्तत्रिमदोज्ञरवे /
व्याधिपूडान्वितो मृत्यौ भानुर्द्धनगे मित्रधनान्वितः //
text_mt: in the sixth, having little digestive fire, lustful, harsh, and envious; in the seventh, arrogant and foolish; / in the eighth, afflicted with disease and suffering; in the ninth, endowed with friends and wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmadhīdhanayugrājye khyātadhīdhanayugbhavet /
kṣudrāeṃ'gahīno vyayage candre proktaṃ phalaṃ budhaiḥ //
meaning:
धर्मधीधनयुग्राज्ये ख्यातधीधनयुग्भवेत् /
क्षुद्राएंऽगहीनो व्ययगे चन्द्रे प्रोक्तं फलं बुधैः //
text_mt: in the tenth, endowed with righteousness, intellect, and wealth; in the kingdom, famous, wise, and wealthy; / in the twelfth, mean-spirited and defective in limbs: thus is the result proclaimed by the wise for the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
lagne kuje kṣatatanurddhanage tu kadannabhuk /
dharmapāpasamācāro 'nyatra sūryasamo mataḥ //
meaning:
लग्ने कुजे क्षततनुर्द्धनगे तु कदन्नभुक् /
धर्मपापसमाचारो ऽन्यत्र सूर्यसमो मतः //
text_mt: When Mars is in the ascendant, one has wounds on his body; in the second, he eats bad food; / he engages in righteous and sinful deeds; elsewhere he is considered equal to the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
vidvān dhanī ca pravaraḥ paṇḍitaḥ sacivoriyuk /
dharmajño vistṛtaguṇo gādhojñeyarator'kavat //
meaning:
विद्वान् धनी च प्रवरः पण्डितः सचिवोरियुक् /
धर्मज्ञो विस्तृतगुणो गाधोज्ञेयरतोर्ऽकवत् //
text_mt: Learned, wealthy, eminent, a scholar, a minister, endowed with enemies, / knowing righteousness, having extensive virtues, profound, devoted to learning, like the Sun [is Mercury].

sanskrit_iast:
vidvānsa vācyaḥ kṛpaṇī sukhākṣo ripugṛddhimān /
nīcastapasvī caṣṇavanī lobhīduṣṭastanorguro //
meaning:
विद्वान्स वाच्यः कृपणी सुखाक्षो रिपुगृद्धिमान् /
नीचस्तपस्वी चष्णवनी लोभीदुष्टस्तनोर्गुरो //
text_mt: When Jupiter is in the ascendant, one should be called learned, stingy, having pleasing eyes, coveting enemies' [wealth], / base, an ascetic, an eater, greedy, and wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
smarī mukhī vilagnasthe kalahī suratotsukaḥ /
sukhitastanapasye ca bhṛgau jīvavadanyataḥ //
meaning:
स्मरी मुखी विलग्नस्थे कलही सुरतोत्सुकः /
सुखितस्तनपस्ये च भृगौ जीववदन्यतः //
text_mt: When Venus is in the ascendant, one is passionate, prominent, quarrelsome, and eager for coitus; / happy, in the ninth; elsewhere, like Jupiter.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśvo rogī kāmavaśo malinaḥ śaiśavārtiyuk /
alaso lagnage mande dharmātsvoñcagate nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
निःश्वो रोगी कामवशो मलिनः शैशवार्तियुक् /
अलसो लग्नगे मन्दे धर्मात्स्वोञ्चगते नृपः //
text_mt: When Saturn is in the ascendant, one is destitute, diseased, subject to lust, filthy, afflicted from childhood, / and lazy; through virtue, in its own or exaltation sign, he is a king,

sanskrit_iast:
grāmādhipaḥ sa vidvāṃśca cārvaṅgo 'nyatra sūryavat /
pūrṇamuccetha pādonaphalaṃ mūlatrikoṇage //
meaning:
ग्रामाधिपः स विद्वांश्च चार्वङ्गो ऽन्यत्र सूर्यवत् /
पूर्णमुच्चेथ पादोनफलं मूलत्रिकोणगे //
text_mt: a village headman, learned, and fair-limbed; elsewhere, like the Sun. / In exaltation, the result is full; in mūlatrikoṇa, one quarter less;

sanskrit_iast:
śubhagrahedalaṃ svarkṣe mitrabheṃ'ghrimitaṃ phalam /
śatrubhe 'lpaṃ tathā nīcāstaṅgate phalaśūnyatā //
meaning:
शुभग्रहेदलं स्वर्क्षे मित्रभेंऽघ्रिमितं फलम् /
शत्रुभे ऽल्पं तथा नीचास्तङ्गते फलशून्यता //
text_mt: for a benefic planet in its own sign, half; in a friendly sign, the result is measured as one quarter; / in an inimical sign, slight; and in debilitation or setting, there is complete absence of results.

sanskrit_iast:
khabharākādike kheṭe kulatulyaḥ kulādhikaḥ /
bandhupūjyo 'thadhanavānsukhī bhogī nṛpaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
खभराकादिके खेटे कुलतुल्यः कुलाधिकः /
बन्धुपूज्यो ऽथधनवान्सुखी भोगी नृपः क्रमात् //
text_mt: When a planet occupies one, two, or more [favorable positions], one is equal to his family, superior to his family, / honored by kin, then wealthy, happy, enjoying pleasures, and a king, respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
parivittasuhṛdvandhupoṣyāgaṇabalādhipau /
nṛpaśca mitrabhāstheṣu kheṭe vrekādiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
परिवित्तसुहृद्वन्धुपोष्यागणबलाधिपौ /
नृपश्च मित्रभास्थेषु खेटे व्रेकादिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: When planets are in friendly signs, one is, respectively, / one with many relatives, friends, kin, dependents, a commander of troops, and a king.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamarkṣer'kahorāyāṃ sasthite śubhabheṣu ca /
khyāto mahodyamī cātitejā dhīmāndhanī balī //
meaning:
विषमर्क्षेर्ऽकहोरायां सस्थिते शुभभेषु च /
ख्यातो महोद्यमी चातितेजा धीमान्धनी बली //
text_mt: When benefics are situated in an odd sign and in the Sun's horā, / a man becomes renowned, highly energetic, very radiant, wise, wealthy, and strong.

sanskrit_iast:
śubheṣu candrahorāyāṃ sthiteṣu samarāśiṣu /
kāntimārddavasaubhāgyabhogadhīmānbhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
शुभेषु चन्द्रहोरायां स्थितेषु समराशिषु /
कान्तिमार्द्दवसौभाग्यभोगधीमान्भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: When benefics are situated in even signs and in the Moon's horā, / a man will be endowed with beauty, gentleness, good fortune, enjoyment, and intelligence.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryahorāgataḥ pāpaḥ samabheṣu tu madhyamāḥ /
viṣamarkṣeṣu bhāskaryā saumyā noktaphalapradāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यहोरागतः पापः समभेषु तु मध्यमाः /
विषमर्क्षेषु भास्कर्या सौम्या नोक्तफलप्रदाः //
text_mt: A malefic in the Sun's horā in even signs yields middling results; / benefics in odd signs in the Sun's [horā] do not bestow the stated result.

sanskrit_iast:
svamitratryaṃśagaścandraḥ surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ naram /
karotyannagatastadvattattulyaguṇarūpiṇam //
meaning:
स्वमित्रत्र्यंशगश्चन्द्रः सुरूपं गुणिनं नरम् /
करोत्यन्नगतस्तद्वत्तत्तुल्यगुणरूपिणम् //
text_mt: The Moon situated in its own or a friend's drekkāṇa makes a man handsome and virtuous; / situated in another's, it makes him possess virtues and form equal to that [planet].

sanskrit_iast:
vyālāyudhe catuṣpādāṃ'jeṣu ca tryaṃśake ca /
tīkṣṇe 'tihiṃsraśca bhavedgurutalpagatoṭanaḥ //
meaning:
व्यालायुधे चतुष्पादांऽजेषु च त्र्यंशके च /
तीक्ष्णे ऽतिहिंस्रश्च भवेद्गुरुतल्पगतोटनः //
text_mt: In a serpent, weapon, or quadruped drekkāṇa, / one becomes sharp, exceedingly violent, a violator of the guru's bed, and a wanderer;

sanskrit_iast:
steno bhoktā sadhanadhīrnṛpaḥ klībaśca śatruhā /
viṣṭikṛddāsavṛttiśca pāpo hiṃsno 'matirbhavet //
meaning:
स्तेनो भोक्ता सधनधीर्नृपः क्लीबश्च शत्रुहा /
विष्टिकृद्दासवृत्तिश्च पापो हिंस्नो ऽमतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: a thief, an enjoyer, endowed with wealth and intellect, a king, a eunuch, a slayer of enemies, / doing forced labor, living by slavery, sinful, violent, and devoid of intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣādikottamāṃśeṣu dvādaśāṃśeṣu rāśivat /
jāyābalavibhūṣāḍhyaḥ sattvayukto 'tisāhasī //
meaning:
मेषादिकोत्तमांशेषु द्वादशांशेषु राशिवत् /
जायाबलविभूषाढ्यः सत्त्वयुक्तो ऽतिसाहसी //
text_mt: In the navāṃśas of Aries and the others, [and] in the dvādaśāṃśas, [the results are] as for the signs. / Endowed with strength of wife and ornaments, possessing sattva, exceedingly daring,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasvī ca naraḥ khāye triṃśāṃse sṛjisaṃsthite /
āmayī vā svabhāryāyāṃ viṣamaḥ pāradārikaḥ //
meaning:
तेजस्वी च नरः खाये त्रिंशांसे सृजिसंस्थिते /
आमयी वा स्वभार्यायां विषमः पारदारिकः //
text_mt: and radiant is a man in the triṃśāṃśa of Saturn situated in Aries; / or sickly, harsh towards his own wife, and an adulterer;

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhī paricchadayuto malinaścārkaje svake /
sukhadhīdhanakīrtyālastejasvī lokapūjitaḥ //
meaning:
दुःखी परिच्छदयुतो मलिनश्चार्कजे स्वके /
सुखधीधनकीर्त्यालस्तेजस्वी लोकपूजितः //
text_mt: miserable, accompanied by retinue, and filthy in Saturn's own [triṃśāṃśa]. / Endowed with happiness, intellect, wealth, and fame, radiant, honored by the world,

sanskrit_iast:
nīraguhyabhavānbhogī jīve khatriṃśabhāgage /
medhākalākāvyaśilpavivādakapaṭāñcitaḥ //
meaning:
नीरगुह्यभवान्भोगी जीवे खत्रिंशभागगे /
मेधाकलाकाव्यशिल्पविवादकपटाञ्चितः //
text_mt: free from secret diseases, and enjoying pleasures [is he] when Jupiter is in Saturn's triṃśāṃśa. / Endowed with intelligence, arts, poetry, crafts, dispute, and deceit,

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrārthasāhasayuto budhe svatriṃśabhāgage /
bahvapatsukhāraugyarogarūpārthasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
शास्त्रार्थसाहसयुतो बुधे स्वत्रिंशभागगे /
बह्वपत्सुखारौग्यरोगरूपार्थसंयुतः //
text_mt: accompanied by daring in the meaning of the scriptures, when Mercury is in his own triṃśāṃśa. / Endowed with many children, happiness, health, disease, beauty, and wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāṅgo viprakīṇandriyaḥ syādbhārgave svake /
śūrastabdhau ca viṣamavadhakau sadguṇānvitau //
meaning:
ललिताङ्गो विप्रकीणन्द्रियः स्याद्भार्गवे स्वके /
शूरस्तब्धौ च विषमवधकौ सद्गुणान्वितौ //
text_mt: with graceful limbs, whose senses are scattered, would he be in Venus's own [triṃśāṃśa]. / Brave and stiff, harsh and murderous, endowed with good qualities,

sanskrit_iast: sukhejño cāru ceṣṭāṅgau candrārkkaucetkujādigau mūlatrikoṇasvarkṣocce kaṇṭhasthāstu ca ye grahāḥ //
meaning: सुखेज्ञो चारु चेष्टाङ्गौ चन्द्रार्क्कौचेत्कुजादिगौ मूलत्रिकोणस्वर्क्षोच्चे कण्ठस्थास्तु च ये ग्रहाः //
text_mt: happy, knowing, with beautiful gestures and limbs, if the Moon and Sun are in [the signs of] Mars and the rest. / Planets which are in their m乗latrikoṇa, own sign, or exaltation, and situated in the kendras,

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyakārakāste syuḥ karmagastu viśeṣataḥ /
śubhaṃ vargottame janma vesisthāne vasadgṛhaiḥ //
meaning:
अन्योन्यकारकास्ते स्युः कर्मगस्तु विशेषतः /
शुभं वर्गोत्तमे जन्म वेसिस्थाने वसद्गृहैः //
text_mt: they become mutual factors (kārakas), especially one in the tenth house. / Birth is auspicious in vargottama, or through planets occupying the veśi position.

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyeṣu ca kendreṣu kārakākhyagṛheṣu ca /
gurujanmeśalagneśāḥ kendrasthā madhyasaukhyādāḥ //
meaning:
अशून्येषु च केन्द्रेषु कारकाख्यगृहेषु च /
गुरुजन्मेशलग्नेशाः केन्द्रस्था मध्यसौख्यादाः //
text_mt: And when the kendras are not empty, and in the signs called kāraka. / Jupiter, the lord of the birth sign, and the lord of the ascendant situated in kendras grant moderate happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭobhavakodaparkṣasthitāstvantyāntarāduṣu /
praveśe bhāskarakujau bhṛgvījyo madhyagau tathā //
meaning:
पृष्टोभवकोदपर्क्षस्थितास्त्वन्त्यान्तरादुषु /
प्रवेशे भास्करकुजौ भृग्वीज्यो मध्यगौ तथा //
text_mt: Planets situated in signs that rise from the back, front, and both [give results] at the end, middle, and beginning respectively. / At the entrance, the Sun and Mars [give results]; Venus and Jupiter in the middle likewise;

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkī phala dāvantye sadā jñaḥ phaladāyakaḥ /
lagnātputre kalatre vābjācchubheśayutekṣite //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्की फल दावन्त्ये सदा ज्ञः फलदायकः /
लग्नात्पुत्रे कलत्रे वाब्जाच्छुभेशयुतेक्षिते //
text_mt: the Moon and Saturn give results at the end; Mercury always gives results. / In the fifth or seventh from the ascendant or the Moon, when joined or aspected by the lord of benefics,

sanskrit_iast:
syāttayoḥ saṃpadaḥ svatvamanyathāthāṅgatodayaḥ /
ravau bhīner'kajaḥ srīghnaḥ putrasthastu tathā kujaḥ //
meaning:
स्यात्तयोः संपदः स्वत्वमन्यथाथाङ्गतोदयः /
रवौ भीनेर्ऽकजः स्रीघ्नः पुत्रस्थस्तु तथा कुजः //
text_mt: there is wealth and personal property for both; otherwise, [results come] from the ascendant. / When the Sun is in the ascendant, Saturn kills the wife; Mars situated in the fifth likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
simāturyāṣṭagaiḥ krūrairyadvā krūrāntare sitaḥ /
sadgrahāyutadṛṣṭaścedagnipātānmṛtiḥ striyāḥ //
meaning:
