सिमातुर्याष्टगैः क्रूरैर्यद्वा क्रूरान्तरे सितः /
सद्ग्रहायुतदृष्टश्चेदग्निपातान्मृतिः स्त्रियाः //
text_mt: When malefic planets are in the twelfth, fourth, or eighth house, or if Venus is between malefics, / if not conjoined or aspected by benefic planets, the wife's death occurs through fire or falling.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnadya pāṇigatayoḥ śaśiravyoḥ saha striyā /
ekena yasya janmāhuratha saptamasaṃsthayoḥ //
meaning:
लग्नद्य पाणिगतयोः शशिरव्योः सह स्त्रिया /
एकेन यस्य जन्माहुरथ सप्तमसंस्थयोः //
text_mt: When the Moon and Sun are in the ascendant and the seventh, with a woman / by one [planet] they say a person's birth occurs; then, if they are in the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
navadhīgatayorvāpi vikalasrīsitārkayoḥ /
koṇodaye 'stāṃ tyasandhau bhṛgau bandhyāpaterjaniḥ //
meaning:
नवधीगतयोर्वापि विकलस्रीसितार्कयोः /
कोणोदये ऽस्तां त्यसन्धौ भृगौ बन्ध्यापतेर्जनिः //
text_mt: or if Venus and the Sun are in the ninth or fifth, the wife is impaired. / When Venus is in the ascendant of a trine, or at the junction of the seventh and twelfth, the birth is of one whose wife is barren.

sanskrit_iast:
sutabhaṃ cenna saumyāḍhyamathāntyāstodayarkṣagaiḥ /
pāpe dhīsthe vidhau kṣīṇajanmā sutakalatriṇaḥ //
meaning:
सुतभं चेन्न सौम्याढ्यमथान्त्यास्तोदयर्क्षगैः /
पापे धीस्थे विधौ क्षीणजन्मा सुतकलत्रिणः //
text_mt: If the house of children is not endowed with benefics, then with malefics in the twelfth, seventh, or the rising sign, / and the waning Moon in the fifth, birth is of one who has [illness in] children and wife.

sanskrit_iast:
śanau khage 'ste saśukre tadṛṣṭe pāradārikaḥ /
tau cetseṃdusriyā sārddhaṃ puṃścalo jāyate naraḥ //
meaning:
शनौ खगे ऽस्ते सशुक्रे तदृष्टे पारदारिकः /
तौ चेत्सेंदुस्रिया सार्द्धं पुंश्चलो जायते नरः //
text_mt: When Saturn is in the tenth, or in the seventh with Venus or aspected by him, he is an adulterer; / if those two are with the Moon, a man becomes promiscuous along with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūgvabjayorastagayornaro bhāryā suto 'pi vā /
nṛsriyo stu śubhairdṛṣṭau tau dvau pariṇatāṅgakau //
meaning:
भूग्वब्जयोरस्तगयोर्नरो भार्या सुतो ऽपि वा /
नृस्रियो स्तु शुभैर्दृष्टौ तौ द्वौ परिणताङ्गकौ //
text_mt: When Venus and the Moon are in the seventh house, a man, or his wife, or his son / have aged bodies; but if they are aspected by benefics, both of the couple [flourish].

sanskrit_iast:
ravāstāṃbugairinduśukrapāpairvaṃśavināśakaḥ /
śilpī tryeśe budhayute kendrasaṃsthārkivīkṣite //
meaning:
रवास्तांबुगैरिन्दुशुक्रपापैर्वंशविनाशकः /
शिल्पी त्र्येशे बुधयुते केन्द्रसंस्थार्किवीक्षिते //
text_mt: When the Moon, Venus, and malefics are in the Sun, seventh, and fourth, he is a destroyer of his lineage. / One is an artisan when the lord of the third is joined with Mercury and aspected by Saturn in a kendra.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsyāṃ jātaḥ sauribhāge riḥphage bhṛgunandane /
nīcer'kendorastagayordṛṣṭayoḥ sūryajena vā //
meaning:
दास्यां जातः सौरिभागे रिःफगे भृगुनन्दने /
नीचेर्ऽकेन्दोरस्तगयोर्दृष्टयोः सूर्यजेन वा //
text_mt: He is born of a female slave when Venus is in the navāṃśa of Saturn in the twelfth house, / or when the Sun and Moon are debilitated, set, or aspected by Saturn.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpadṛṣṭau śanikujāvastagau vātarukpradau /
karkālyaṃ śagate kendre pāpayukte tu guhyaruk //
meaning:
पापदृष्टौ शनिकुजावस्तगौ वातरुक्प्रदौ /
कर्काल्यं शगते केन्द्रे पापयुक्ते तु गुह्यरुक् //
text_mt: Saturn and Mars aspected by malefics and set grant diseases of wind. / When a kendra is in a navāṃśa of Cancer or Scorpio and joined by malefics, there is secret disease.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpātaragateṃ'gebje ravau dyūne tu kuṣṭayuk /
candre khe 'stāṅgate bhaume vikalo veśiger'kaje //
meaning:
पापातरगतेंऽगेब्जे रवौ द्यूने तु कुष्टयुक् /
चन्द्रे खे ऽस्ताङ्गते भौमे विकलो वेशिगेर्ऽकजे //
text_mt: When the ascendant or Moon is between malefics and the Sun is in the seventh, he is afflicted with leprosy. / When the Moon is in the tenth, Mars in the seventh or the ascendant, and Saturn in the veśi house, he is crippled.

sanskrit_iast:
mitho bhāṃśagayoḥ śūlī ravīndvoryutayoḥ kṛśaḥ /
nidhanāridhanāntyasthā ravīndvārayamā yadā //
meaning:
मिथो भांशगयोः शूली रवीन्द्वोर्युतयोः कृशः /
निधनारिधनान्त्यस्था रवीन्द्वारयमा यदा //
text_mt: When [the Sun and Moon] are in each other's signs or navāṃśas, he has colic; when the Sun and Moon are conjoined, he is emaciated. / When the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Saturn are in the eighth, sixth, second, or twelfth house,

sanskrit_iast:
caladgraheṇa doṣeṇa kurvantyanayanaṃ naram /
saumyā dṛṣṭā na vāyatridhīgatāḥ pāpakhecarāḥ //
meaning:
चलद्ग्रहेण दोषेण कुर्वन्त्यनयनं नरम् /
सौम्या दृष्टा न वायत्रिधीगताः पापखेचराः //
text_mt: they make a man blind through the affliction of a wandering planet. / Malefic planets in the eleventh, third, or fifth, not aspected by benefics,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇopaghātakā dyūne radavaikṛtyakārakāḥ /
lagne gurau dyune mande vātarogādito bhavet //
meaning:
कर्णोपघातका द्यूने रदवैकृत्यकारकाः /
लग्ने गुरौ द्युने मन्दे वातरोगादितो भवेत् //
text_mt: cause injury to the ears; in the seventh, they cause deformity of teeth. / With Jupiter in the ascendant and Saturn in the seventh, it happens through wind disease and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhe 'ste vā kuje jīve lagne vārkiyutodaye /
kujena vātmaje dyūne saṃjñeṃ'tye 'bje ca sonmadaḥ //
meaning:
सुखे ऽस्ते वा कुजे जीवे लग्ने वार्कियुतोदये /
कुजेन वात्मजे द्यूने संज्ञेंऽत्ये ऽब्जे च सोन्मदः //
text_mt: When Mars is in the fourth or seventh, or Jupiter in the ascendant, or with Saturn in the ascendant, / or with Mars in the fifth, or in the seventh, or the Moon in the twelfth, he becomes insane.

sanskrit_iast:
dhīdharmārthāntyagaiḥ pāpairbhasamasyānnibandhanam /
sarpaśṛṅkhalayā śāṭhyairdṛkkairbalyaśubhekṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
धीधर्मार्थान्त्यगैः पापैर्भसमस्यान्निबन्धनम् /
सर्पशृङ्खलया शाठ्यैर्दृक्कैर्बल्यशुभेक्षितैः //
text_mt: With malefics in the fifth, ninth, second, or twelfth, imprisonment of that sign occurs, / by snake, chain, or deceit, through decanates aspected by strong malefics.

sanskrit_iast:
samande 'bje vakradṛṣṭe pasmārī durvacāḥ kṣayī /
ravimandakujaiḥ ravasthaiḥ saumyadṛṣṭaiḥ samaṇḍalaiḥ //
meaning:
समन्दे ऽब्जे वक्रदृष्टे पस्मारी दुर्वचाः क्षयी /
रविमन्दकुजैः रवस्थैः सौम्यदृष्टैः समण्डलैः //
text_mt: When the Moon is with Saturn and aspected by Mars, one is epileptic, foul-mouthed, and consumptive. / When the Sun, Saturn, and Mars are in the Sun's position and aspected by benefics in disks,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛtakāḥ pūrvamuditairvaramadhyādhamā narāḥ /
puñjanau tu phalaṃ puṇyasrīṇāṃ yogyaṃ vadecca tat //
meaning:
भृतकाः पूर्वमुदितैर्वरमध्याधमा नराः /
पुञ्जनौ तु फलं पुण्यस्रीणां योग्यं वदेच्च तत् //
text_mt: men become servants—best, middling, or lowest—according to the earlier statements. / But in the birth of a man, one should state the result; that which is suitable for virtuous women [should be stated] for them.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsvāmiṣvakhilaṃ kāryaṃ tadbhartṛmaraṇaṃ mṛtau /
lagnendugaṃ vapuścaiva yādayūpapītadyune //
meaning:
तत्स्वामिष्वखिलं कार्यं तद्भर्तृमरणं मृतौ /
लग्नेन्दुगं वपुश्चैव यादयूपपीतद्युने //
text_mt: All that must be applied to their husbands; the husband's death is from the eighth house; / the body is from the ascendant and the Moon; the yādā is from the seventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
yugmeṣu lagnaśaśinorvanitā prakṛtisthitā /
sacchīlabhūṣaṇayutā śubhasaṃdṛṣṭayostayoḥ //
meaning:
युग्मेषु लग्नशशिनोर्वनिता प्रकृतिस्थिता /
सच्छीलभूषणयुता शुभसंदृष्टयोस्तयोः //
text_mt: When the ascendant and Moon are in even signs, a woman remains in her natural state; / endowed with good conduct and ornaments, if those two are aspected by benefics.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣākṛti śīlāḍhyā tayorojasthayormatā /
atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitathostayoḥ //
meaning:
पुरुषाकृति शीलाढ्या तयोरोजस्थयोर्मता /
अथ पापा गुणोनाश्च पापवीक्षितथोस्तयोः //
text_mt: When those two are in odd signs, she is considered endowed with male form and character; / then, she is wicked and devoid of virtues when those two are aspected by malefics.

sanskrit_iast:
kujārkījyajñaśukrāṇāṃ kujarkṣe kramaśo 'ṅganā /
bālyaduṣṭā tathā dāsī sādhvī māyāvatī tvarā //
meaning:
कुजार्कीज्यज्ञशुक्राणां कुजर्क्षे क्रमशो ऽङ्गना /
बाल्यदुष्टा तथा दासी साध्वी मायावती त्वरा //
text_mt: In a sign of Mars, in the triṃśāṃśas of Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus respectively, a woman is: / wicked in childhood, a servant, virtuous, deceitful, and rash;

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭā vākṛtiśīlā syāttayorojasthayormatā /
atha pāpā guṇonāśca pāpavīkṣitayostayoḥ //
meaning:
दृष्टा वाकृतिशीला स्यात्तयोरोजस्थयोर्मता /
अथ पापा गुणोनाश्च पापवीक्षितयोस्तयोः //
text_mt: her appearance and character are considered according to their aspects when they are in odd signs; / then, she is wicked and devoid of virtues when those two are aspected by malefics.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṇavāk punarbhūḥ saguṇā vijñā khyātā sphujidgrṛhe /
baudhe samā yā klīvā ca satī guṇavatī calā //
meaning:
दुष्णवाक् पुनर्भूः सगुणा विज्ञा ख्याता स्फुजिद्ग्रृहे /
बौधे समा या क्लीवा च सती गुणवती चला //
text_mt: evil-speaking, remarried, virtuous, wise, and famous in the house of Venus; / in Mercury's [sign]: modest, impotent, faithful, virtuous, and fickle;

sanskrit_iast:
dvandvabhe svairiṇīśadhnī guṇāḍhyā śilpikādhamā /
vācāṭā kulaṭā siṃhe rāgī pundhīragamyatā //
meaning:
द्वन्द्वभे स्वैरिणीशध्नी गुणाढ्या शिल्पिकाधमा /
वाचाटा कुलटा सिंहे रागी पुन्धीरगम्यता //
text_mt: in a dual sign: unchaste, husband-killing, endowed with virtues, artisan, and base; / in Leo: talkative, unchaste, passionate, manly in intellect, and unapproachable;

sanskrit_iast:
jaive guṇāḍhyālparatirguṇajñā jñāninī satī /
dāsī nīcaratā sādhvī mānde duṣṭā napatyakā //
meaning:
जैवे गुणाढ्याल्परतिर्गुणज्ञा ज्ञानिनी सती /
दासी नीचरता साध्वी मान्दे दुष्टा नपत्यका //
text_mt: in Jupiter's [sign]: rich in virtues, having little sexual desire, knowing virtues, wise, and chaste; / in Saturn's: a servant, taking pleasure in base men, virtuous, wicked, and barren.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnenduyuktaisriṃśāṃśaiḥ phalametadvalānugam /
dṛggaiḥ mithoṃśe śukrārkī śaukre cedvā ghaṭāṃśake //
meaning:
लग्नेन्दुयुक्तैस्रिंशांशैः फलमेतद्वलानुगम् /
दृग्गैः मिथोंशे शुक्रार्की शौक्रे चेद्वा घटांशके //
text_mt: This result follows the strength [of planets] through the triṃśāṃśas joined with the ascendant and Moon. / By aspects: when Venus and Saturn are in each other's navāṃśa, or in Venus's or Aquarius's navāṃśa,

sanskrit_iast:
strībhiḥ strī maithunaṃ yāti madanānaladīpitā /
śūnye kāpuruṣo dyūne bale klīvo na sadṛśi //
meaning:
स्त्रीभिः स्त्री मैथुनं याति मदनानलदीपिता /
शून्ये कापुरुषो द्यूने बले क्लीवो न सदृशि //
text_mt: inflamed by the fire of passion, a woman engages in sexual union with women. / When the seventh house is empty, [her husband is] a coward; when weak, impotent, not suitable;

sanskrit_iast:
budhārkyoścarabhe nityaṃ paradeśaparāyaṇaḥ /
tatsṛṣṭā madage sūrye strībālavidhavā kuje //
meaning:
बुधार्क्योश्चरभे नित्यं परदेशपरायणः /
तत्सृष्टा मदगे सूर्ये स्त्रीबालविधवा कुजे //
text_mt: in a movable sign of Mercury or Saturn, he is always devoted to foreign lands. / When the Sun is in the seventh house, she is deserted by him; when Mars [is there], she becomes a widow while a girl.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpadṛṣṭe śanau dyūne kanyaivāpadyate jarām /
āgneyairvidhavāstasthaiḥ punarbhūmiśrakairbhaghavet //
meaning:
पापदृष्टे शनौ द्यूने कन्यैवापद्यते जराम् /
आग्नेयैर्विधवास्तस्थैः पुनर्भूमिश्रकैर्भघवेत् //
text_mt: When Saturn is in the seventh aspected by a malefic, she grows old as a virgin. / When fiery planets are in the seventh, she becomes a widow; with mixed [planets], a remarried woman.

sanskrit_iast:
krūre hīnabale 'stasthe patityaktā na sadṛśi /
mithoṃśagaiḥ sitārau tu kuruto 'nyaratāṃ striyam //
meaning:
क्रूरे हीनबले ऽस्तस्थे पतित्यक्ता न सदृशि /
मिथोंशगैः सितारौ तु कुरुतो ऽन्यरतां स्त्रियम् //
text_mt: When a malefic weak in strength is in the seventh, she is abandoned by her husband, not matched. / Venus and Mars in mutual navāṃśas make a woman fond of others;

sanskrit_iast:
śītaraśmiryadā dyūne tadā bharturanusayā /
saurārarkṣe lagnagate seṃduśukre tu vandhakī //
meaning:
शीतरश्मिर्यदा द्यूने तदा भर्तुरनुसया /
सौरारर्क्षे लग्नगते सेंदुशुक्रे तु वन्धकी //
text_mt: when the Moon is in the seventh house, then [she is] obedient to her husband. / But when Saturn or Mars's sign is in the ascendant with the Moon and Venus, she is an adulteress,

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā sārddhamasaddṛṣṭe tathā kaujeṃśake 'stage /
mandadṛṣṭe vyādhiyoniḥ sadgrahāṃśe patipriyā //
meaning:
मात्रा सार्द्धमसद्दृष्टे तथा कौजेंशके ऽस्तगे /
मन्ददृष्टे व्याधियोनिः सद्ग्रहांशे पतिप्रिया //
text_mt: together with her mother, if aspected by malefics; likewise, when a navāṃśa of Mars is set / and aspected by Saturn, she has a diseased vagina; in a navāṃśa of a benefic, she is dear to her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
mandarkṣe vāṃśake dyūne vṛddhau mūrkhaḥ patiḥ striyāḥ /
strīlolaḥ krodhanaḥ kauje baudhe vidvāṃśca naipuṇaḥ //
meaning:
मन्दर्क्षे वांशके द्यूने वृद्धौ मूर्खः पतिः स्त्रियाः /
स्त्रीलोलः क्रोधनः कौजे बौधे विद्वांश्च नैपुणः //
text_mt: When Saturn's sign or navāṃśa is in the seventh, a woman's husband is old and foolish; / in Mars's, fond of women and wrathful; in Mercury's, learned and skillful;

sanskrit_iast:
jitendriyo gṛṇījaive cāndre kāmī mṛdustathā /
śaukre saubhāgyayukkāntaḥ saureti mṛdukarmakṛt //
meaning:
जितेन्द्रियो गृणीजैवे चान्द्रे कामी मृदुस्तथा /
शौक्रे सौभाग्ययुक्कान्तः सौरेति मृदुकर्मकृत् //
text_mt: in Jupiter's, with controlled senses and a householder; in the Moon's, lustful and gentle; / in Venus's, fortunate and handsome; in Saturn's, doing very gentle work.

sanskrit_iast:
śukrābjayorlagnagayoḥ sukhinīrṣyāsamanvitā /
jñedvoḥ kalāsu nipuṇā sukhitā ca guṇānvitā //
śukrajñayostu śubhagā kalājñā rucirāṅganā /
anekasaukhyārthaguṇālagne saumyatraye sthite //
meaning:
शुक्राब्जयोर्लग्नगयोः सुखिनीर्ष्यासमन्विता /
ज्ञेद्वोः कलासु निपुणा सुखिता च गुणान्विता //
शुक्रज्ञयोस्तु शुभगा कलाज्ञा रुचिराङ्गना /
अनेकसौख्यार्थगुणालग्ने सौम्यत्रये स्थिते //
text_mt:
When Venus and the Moon are in the ascendant, she is happy and full of jealousy; / when Mercury and the Moon [are there], skillful in the arts, happy, and endowed with virtues.

When Venus and Mercury [are in the ascendant, she is] fortunate, skilled in the arts, and a beautiful woman; / and when the triad of benefics is in the ascendant, she possesses manifold comforts, wealth, and good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
krūre 'ṣṭame 'ṣṭameśāṃśe yasya syāttadvayaḥ same /
vaidhavyaṃ ca mṛtistasyā svayaṃsatsvarthageṣu tu //
meaning:
क्रूरे ऽष्टमे ऽष्टमेशांशे यस्य स्यात्तद्वयः समे /
वैधव्यं च मृतिस्तस्या स्वयंसत्स्वर्थगेषु तु //
text_mt: When a malefic is in the eighth house or in the navāṃśa of the eighth lord, then at an age equal to that [lord], / widowhood and death occur for her; but when benefics occupy the second house, [she predeceases her husband].

sanskrit_iast:
alpāpatyatvamabje 'syāḥ kanyāliharigoṣu tu /
saure madhyabale candraśukrajñairbalavarjitaiḥ //
meaning:
अल्पापत्यत्वमब्जे ऽस्याः कन्यालिहरिगोषु तु /
सौरे मध्यबले चन्द्रशुक्रज्ञैर्बलवर्जितैः //
text_mt: She has few children if the Moon is in Virgo, Scorpio, Leo, or Taurus; / when Saturn has middling strength, while the Moon, Venus, and Mercury are devoid of strength,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaiḥ savīryairojarkṣe lagne kurūpiṇī bhavet /
jīvārakaviśaumyeṣu baliṣu samabhe tanau //
meaning:
शेषैः सवीर्यैरोजर्क्षे लग्ने कुरूपिणी भवेत् /
जीवारकविशौम्येषु बलिषु समभे तनौ //
text_mt: and the remaining planets are strong in an odd sign in the ascendant, she becomes ugly. / When Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Mercury are strong in an even sign in the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyātānaikaśāstrajñā vanitā brahmavādinī /
pāpe 'ste navamasthasya pravrajyāmeti bhāminī //
meaning:
विख्यातानैकशास्त्रज्ञा वनिता ब्रह्मवादिनी /
पापे ऽस्ते नवमस्थस्य प्रव्रज्यामेति भामिनी //
text_mt: the woman is famous, knowledgeable in manifold treatises, and an expounder of Brahman. / When a malefic is in the seventh house, she embraces the ascetic life of the planet in the ninth house.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhe varaṇe praśne sarvametadvicintayet /
mṛtyusthānaṃ paśyatāṃ syādvalinā dhātukopataḥ //
meaning:
उद्वाहे वरणे प्रश्ने सर्वमेतद्विचिन्तयेत् /
मृत्युस्थानं पश्यतां स्याद्वलिना धातुकोपतः //
text_mt: One should examine all of this in marriage, in choosing [a bride], and in horary queries. / Death occurs through the perturbation of the bodily humor belonging to the planet aspecting or situated in the house of death according to strength.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāṃ mṛtyuhitaṃ yuktaṃ bhagātrosthopathabhūribhiḥ /
savīryairbahujo 'gnyakṣatajvararugudbhavaḥ //
meaning:
नृणां मृत्युहितं युक्तं भगात्रोस्थोपथभूरिभिः /
सवीर्यैर्बहुजो ऽग्न्यक्षतज्वररुगुद्भवः //
text_mt: Death of men is brought about by the limb or body parts [indicated by the sign]; / when many [planets] are endowed with strength, it arises from fire, wounds, or feverish disease;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṭkṣudbhavaścāṣṭamasthaiḥ sūryādyaiśca varādiṣu /
parasvādhvapradeśeṣu mṛtyuḥ sūryamahījayoḥ //
meaning:
तृट्क्षुद्भवश्चाष्टमस्थैः सूर्याद्यैश्च वरादिषु /
परस्वाध्वप्रदेशेषु मृत्युः सूर्यमहीजयोः //
text_mt: and it arises from thirst and hunger through the Sun and others in the eighth house. In the case of the Sun and Mars, / death occurs in places belonging to others, on roads, or in regions [abroad];

sanskrit_iast:
svabandhusthitayoḥ puṃsaḥ śailāgnābhirutasya ca /
bandhvastakarmagairmandabhūjaiḥ prahau mṛtiḥ //
meaning:
स्वबन्धुस्थितयोः पुंसः शैलाग्नाभिरुतस्य च /
बन्ध्वस्तकर्मगैर्मन्दभूजैः प्रहौ मृतिः //
text_mt: for a man when they are situated in his own fourth house, [death is] caused by a mountain, fire, or falling. / When Saturn and Mars occupy the fourth, seventh, and tenth houses, death occurs in an abyss.

sanskrit_iast:
striyāṃ himoṣaaṇakarayoḥ svajanātpāpadṛktayoḥ /
toyamṛto ravīdṛtusyātāṃyā dyubhayodaye //
meaning:
स्त्रियां हिमोषअणकरयोः स्वजनात्पापदृक्तयोः /
तोयमृतो रवीदृतुस्यातांया द्युभयोदये //
text_mt: For a woman, when the Moon and the Sun are aspected by malefics, [death is caused] by her own kinsmen; / when the Sun and Moon are in dual ascendants, death is through water.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāgnijośubhāntasthe candre bhaumagṛhagasthite /
mṛtyuścātha mṛge candre karke mande jalodarāt //
meaning:
शस्त्राग्निजोशुभान्तस्थे चन्द्रे भौमगृहगस्थिते /
मृत्युश्चाथ मृगे चन्द्रे कर्के मन्दे जलोदरात् //
text_mt: When the Moon is situated between malefics in a house of Mars, death arises from weapons or fire; / and when the Moon is in Capricorn and Saturn is in Cancer, [death is] from dropsy.

sanskrit_iast:
striyāmindau raktaśauthātsaure vājvagnipātajaḥ /
putradharmasthasyorvandhātpāpayoḥ sadadṛṣṭayoḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रियामिन्दौ रक्तशौथात्सौरे वाज्वग्निपातजः /
पुत्रधर्मस्थस्योर्वन्धात्पापयोः सददृष्टयोः //
text_mt: For a woman, when the Moon [is so placed], it arises from blood disorders or swelling; when Saturn [is so placed], from fire or falling from a horse. / When malefics occupy the fifth or ninth house and are not aspected by benefics, [death is] from imprisonment;

sanskrit_iast:
sathāsaśaṃyanigaḍairdṛkairmṛtyau tu bandhanaiḥ /
striyāṃ sapāpe 'bje dyūne site meṣe ravau tanau //
meaning:
सथासशंयनिगडैर्दृकैर्मृत्यौ तु बन्धनैः /
स्त्रियां सपापे ऽब्जे द्यूने सिते मेषे रवौ तनौ //
text_mt: and when aspects indicate bonds, death occurs in captivity. / In a woman's chart, when the Moon with a malefic is in the seventh house, Venus is in Aries, and the Sun is in the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇaṃ strīkṛte gehe hyatha turye kuje ravau /
yame kheṃ'gatrikoṇarstheḥ kṣīṇacandrāṃśubhaiḥ sakṛt //
meaning:
मरणं स्त्रीकृते गेहे ह्यथ तुर्ये कुजे रवौ /
यमे खेंऽगत्रिकोणर्स्थेः क्षीणचन्द्रांशुभैः सकृत् //
text_mt: death occurs at home on account of a woman. Now, when Mars and the Sun are in the fourth house, / Saturn in the tenth, and waning Moon and benefics are in the ascendant or trines,

sanskrit_iast:
turyer'ke khe kujekṣīṇa candradṛṣṭe samiddhataḥ /
randhrakhāṅgajalaiḥ kṣīṇendvārārkiravisaṃyutaiḥ //
meaning:
तुर्येर्ऽके खे कुजेक्षीण चन्द्रदृष्टे समिद्धतः /
रन्ध्रखाङ्गजलैः क्षीणेन्द्वारार्किरविसंयुतैः //
text_mt: or when the Sun is in the fourth house and Mars in the tenth is aspected by the waning Moon, [death] is caused by a club. / When the eighth, tenth, ascendant, and fourth houses are occupied by the waning Moon, Mars, Saturn, and the Sun,

sanskrit_iast:
lakuṭenātha taireva khāṅkāṅgatanayasthitaiḥ /
dhūmānibandhanaiḥ kāryaḥ kudanairmaraṇaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
लकुटेनाथ तैरेव खाङ्काङ्गतनयस्थितैः /
धूमानिबन्धनैः कार्यः कुदनैर्मरणं भवेत् //
text_mt: death is caused by a cudgel; and by those same [planets] situated in the tenth, ninth, ascendant, and fifth houses, / death occurs through smoke, fire, binding, or bad days.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhvastakhasthairbhauṃmārkarmadaiḥ śastrāgniṃrājabhiḥ /
sauredvāraiḥ svāṃburavasthaiḥ kṣatakremyaṅgayā tataḥ //
meaning:
बन्ध्वस्तखस्थैर्भौंमार्कर्मदैः शस्त्राग्निंराजभिः /
सौरेद्वारैः स्वांबुरवस्थैः क्षतक्रेम्यङ्गया ततः //
text_mt: When Mars, the Sun, and Saturn occupy the fourth, seventh, and tenth houses, [death is] through weapons, fire, or kings; / when Saturn occupies the second, fourth, or ascendant, it occurs through wounds, worms, or limbs;

sanskrit_iast:
sver'ke turye kuje yānapātādatha kuje 'stage /
yantrosīdunataḥ kṣīṇacandrayukte mṛtirbhavet //
meaning:
स्वेर्ऽके तुर्ये कुजे यानपातादथ कुजे ऽस्तगे /
यन्त्रोसीदुनतः क्षीणचन्द्रयुक्ते मृतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: when the Sun is in the second house and Mars in the fourth, [death is] from a fall from a vehicle; and when Mars sets, / [it is] caused by machinery or stones, and when conjoined with the waning Moon, death occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumārkiśītakiraṇairjūkājaśanibhasthiteḥ /
kṣīṇendvarkakujaiḥ khāstāṃbusthairvārakare mṛtiḥ //
meaning:
भौमार्किशीतकिरणैर्जूकाजशनिभस्थितेः /
क्षीणेन्द्वर्ककुजैः खास्तांबुस्थैर्वारकरे मृतिः //
text_mt: When Mars, Saturn, and the Moon occupy Libra, Aries, and Capricorn, / or when the waning Moon, the Sun, and Mars occupy the tenth, seventh, and fourth houses, death is caused by a horse.

sanskrit_iast:
balyāradṛṣṭe kṣīṇendau mande nidhaṃnasaṃsthite /
guhyarukkṛmiśastrāgnidārujo mṛtyuraṅgirāḥ //
meaning:
बल्यारदृष्टे क्षीणेन्दौ मन्दे निधंनसंस्थिते /
गुह्यरुक्कृमिशस्त्राग्निदारुजो मृत्युरङ्गिराः //
text_mt: When the waning Moon is aspected by powerful Mars and Saturn is placed in the eighth house, / death arises from disease of the private parts, worms, weapons, fire, or wood, [so says] Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
saurer'ke 'ste mṛto mande kṣīṇendau bhuvyasaṃyute /
lagnadhyāyāsta paḥkhārkabhaumacandraniśākaraiḥ //
meaning:
सौरेर्ऽके ऽस्ते मृतो मन्दे क्षीणेन्दौ भुव्यसंयुते /
लग्नध्यायास्त पःखार्कभौमचन्द्रनिशाकरैः //
text_mt: When Saturn is in the setting house and the Sun is [there], death occurs; when Saturn, the waning Moon, and Mars are conjoined, / or when the ascendant, fourth, ninth, eighth, Mars, and the Moon [are afflicted],

sanskrit_iast:
śailaśṛṅgasvarugrapātaunurnidhanaṃ bhavet /
dṛkkonttare turddhāviṃśastatpatirmṛtyupopi vā //
meaning:
शैलशृङ्गस्वरुग्रपातौनुर्निधनं भवेत् /
दृक्कोन्त्तरे तुर्द्धाविंशस्तत्पतिर्मृत्युपोपि वा //
text_mt: death of the man occurs from a mountain peak or a terrible fall. / In the decanates, the twenty-second [decanate] or its lord, or the lord of death,

sanskrit_iast:
svaguṇairnidha na kuryādbalavānyo dvayorbhavet /
lagnāṃśeśasadṛksthāne mṛtyuryogekṣaṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
स्वगुणैर्निध न कुर्याद्बलवान्यो द्वयोर्भवेत् /
लग्नांशेशसदृक्स्थाने मृत्युर्योगेक्षणादिभिः //
text_mt: causes death according to its own qualities, whichever of the two is stronger. / Death occurs in a place similar to the lord of the ascendant's navāṃśa, through yogas and aspects.

sanskrit_iast:
modāentenuditāṃśasya tulyo dvighnaḥ svapekṣite /
śubhekṣite tu triguṇaḥ kalpyamanyatsvabuddhitaḥ //
meaning:
मोदाएन्तेनुदितांशस्य तुल्यो द्विघ्नः स्वपेक्षिते /
शुभेक्षिते तु त्रिगुणः कल्प्यमन्यत्स्वबुद्धितः //
text_mt: It is equal to the elapsed portion of the rising degree; doubled when aspected by its own [lord], / and tripled when aspected by a benefic; other [details] are to be conceived by one's own intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnyaṃpabubhasmasakledaśoṣavyālairmṛtisthitaiḥ /
bindutaścintanīyaśca yathokto matyuraṅginaḥ //
meaning:
वह्न्यंपबुभस्मसक्लेदशोषव्यालैर्मृतिस्थितैः /
बिन्दुतश्चिन्तनीयश्च यथोक्तो मत्युरङ्गिनः //
text_mt: From the planets situated in the house of death—fire, water, earth, ashes, moisture, drying, or serpents— / and from the dots [in the aṣṭakavarga], the death of the embodied soul is to be considered as stated.

sanskrit_iast:
guruḥ śaśāṅkaśukrau ca sūryabhaumau yamendujau /
devapitratiraktotha nārakānkuryuraṣṭame //
meaning:
गुरुः शशाङ्कशुक्रौ च सूर्यभौमौ यमेन्दुजौ /
देवपित्रतिरक्तोथ नारकान्कुर्युरष्टमे //
text_mt: Jupiter, the Moon and Venus, the Sun and Mars, Saturn and Mercury, / when in the eighth house, lead respectively to the gods, ancestors, wandering spirits, or the denizens of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ravīndubalavaśraṃśanāthācchreṣṭasamādhamāḥ /
tuṅgagaḥ sāṃdanūkenugatiḥ ṣaḍrandhradṛkkapaḥ //
meaning:
रवीन्दुबलवश्रंशनाथाच्छ्रेष्टसमाधमाः /
तुङ्गगः सांदनूकेनुगतिः षड्रन्ध्रदृक्कपः //
text_mt: According to the strength of the Sun and Moon, through the lord of the navāṃśa, the [states of existence] are superior, middling, or base. / One who is in exaltation [goes to heaven]; the lord of the decanate of the eighth or sixth house indicates the state.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūnasthito gururvāpi ripukendravināśagaḥ /
svoccasthoṃ'ge vyaye saumyabhāge mokṣo balānyataḥ //
meaning:
द्यूनस्थितो गुरुर्वापि रिपुकेन्द्रविनाशगः /
स्वोच्चस्थोंऽगे व्यये सौम्यभागे मोक्षो बलान्यतः //
text_mt: Or when Jupiter is situated in the seventh, sixth, kendra, or eighth house, / or in its exaltation in the ascendant, and the twelfth house is in a benefic navāṃśa, liberation [occurs]; otherwise, [rebirth occurs] through other strengths.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāne janmā jñāne tu vṛkṣatāṃ lagnato vadet /
pūrvāparārddhairlagnasya saumye vācyapanejaniḥ //
meaning:
आधाने जन्मा ज्ञाने तु वृक्षतां लग्नतो वदेत् /
पूर्वापरार्द्धैर्लग्नस्य सौम्ये वाच्यपनेजनिः //
text_mt: When conception or birth is unknown, one should declare the [rising] tree from the ascendant; / in the former or latter halves of the ascendant, birth in a benefic or malefic [sign] is to be declared.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnatrikoṇe dhījyatryaṃśairvikalpāvayavāḥ samāḥ /
grīṣmoger'ke parai ramyāpanatāṃpṛturarkabhāt //
meaning:
लग्नत्रिकोणे धीज्यत्र्यंशैर्विकल्पावयवाः समाः /
ग्रीष्मोगेर्ऽके परै रम्यापनतांपृतुरर्कभात् //
text_mt: In the ascendant and trines, the limbs are divided equally by the decanates of the fifth and ninth lords; / when the Sun is in the summer [season], the broadness [of the child] is declared through others from the Sun's sign.

sanskrit_iast:
candrajñajīvāvṛtyasyāḥ śukrārārkibhiranyathā /
dṛkkairādyaiḥ pūrvamāsastithistatrānupātataḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रज्ञजीवावृत्यस्याः शुक्रारार्किभिरन्यथा /
दृक्कैराद्यैः पूर्वमासस्तिथिस्तत्रानुपाततः //
text_mt: Through the period of the Moon, Mercury, and Jupiter, [it is known]; through Venus, Mars, and Saturn, it is otherwise. / Through the decanates, the first [half] gives the previous month, and the lunar day is [known] by proportion.

sanskrit_iast:
vilomajanma bhāgaiśca velā rātridyusaṃjñake /
trikoṇottamavārthantilagnaṃ vā labhanābhane //
meaning:
विलोमजन्म भागैश्च वेला रात्रिद्युसंज्ञके /
त्रिकोणोत्तमवार्थन्तिलग्नं वा लभनाभने //
text_mt: By the degrees of reversed birth, the time of birth is designated as night or day; / or the ascendant is in a trine, highest sign, or second house, in the acquisition of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadūno vidhurlagnāttāvaccandrācca janmabhe /
goharī yugmavasubhe kriyajuke mṛgāṅgane //
meaning:
यावदूनो विधुर्लग्नात्तावच्चन्द्राच्च जन्मभे /
गोहरी युग्मवसुभे क्रियजुके मृगाङ्गने //
text_mt: As far as the Moon is behind the ascendant, so far from the Moon is the birth-sign: / in Taurus, Leo, Gemini, Capricorn, Aries, Libra, Capricorn, or Virgo,

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṣṭasaptaviṣaye guṇyāḥ śeṣāḥ khasaṃkhyayā /
jīvabhaumakavijñāḥ syu rāghavādyāyarejñavat //
meaning:
दशाष्टसप्तविषये गुण्याः शेषाः खसंख्यया /
जीवभौमकविज्ञाः स्यु राघवाद्यायरेज्ञवत् //
text_mt: they are to be multiplied by ten, eight, seven, and five, and the remainder by zero. / Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury are like Rāma and others, according to knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānāṃ nityo vidhiḥ kheṭavaśāvaddhargaṇāstathā /
saptarghnaṃ bhahṛtaṃ śeṣamṛkṣaṃ navadhanarṇataḥ //
meaning:
भानां नित्यो विधिः खेटवशावद्धर्गणास्तथा /
सप्तर्घ्नं भहृतं शेषमृक्षं नवधनर्णतः //
text_mt: The daily rule of the asterisms is thus dependent on the planets and the accumulated days; / multiplied by seven and divided by the asterisms, the remaining asterism is from the nine, positive or negative.

sanskrit_iast:
dvighne samartumāsāḥ syuḥ pakṣatithyau gajāhate /
saptaghnaṃ honiśārkṣāṇīṣughneṅgāṃśeṣṭahorikā //
meaning:
द्विघ्ने समर्तुमासाः स्युः पक्षतिथ्यौ गजाहते /
सप्तघ्नं होनिशार्क्षाणीषुघ्नेङ्गांशेष्टहोरिका //
text_mt: When doubled, the seasons and months are equal; multiplied by eight, the fortnight and lunar day [are found]; / multiplied by seven, the day, night, and asterisms [are found]; multiplied by five, the desired horā in the parts of the body [is determined].

sanskrit_iast:
pumānparaśudhṛkkṛṣṇo raktadṛgrakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ /
dṛṣṭartikapadāśvāsyā raktavastrā ghaṭākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
पुमान्परशुधृक्कृष्णो रक्तदृग्रक्षितुं क्षमः /
दृष्टर्तिकपदाश्वास्या रक्तवस्त्रा घटाकृतिः //
text_mt: [First decanate of Aries:] A dark man holding an axe, with red eyes, capable of protecting; / [second decanate:] a horse-faced woman in red garments, with pain in the feet, shaped like a pot;

sanskrit_iast:
kapilo hyandhadṛkrūro raktavastraḥ kṣatavrataḥ /
kṣuttṛṣārtodugdhapaṭo lūnakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ //
meaning:
कपिलो ह्यन्धदृक्रूरो रक्तवस्त्रः क्षतव्रतः /
क्षुत्तृषार्तोदुग्धपटो लूनकुञ्चितमूर्धजः //
text_mt: [third decanate:] tawny, blind in vision, fierce, clad in red garments, broken in vows, / afflicted by hunger and thirst, with milk-white cloth, and severed, curled hair.

sanskrit_iast:
malinaḥ kṣutparojāsyo dakṣaḥ kṛṣyādikarmaṇi /
dvipakāyaḥ sarabhayātpiṃpagalo vyākulāntaraḥ //
meaning:
मलिनः क्षुत्परोजास्यो दक्षः कृष्यादिकर्मणि /
द्विपकायः सरभयात्पिंपगलो व्याकुलान्तरः //
text_mt: [Taurus:] Dirty, very hungry, with the face of a goat, skilled in agriculture and other work; / with the body of an elephant, tawny through sudden fear, and agitated within;

sanskrit_iast:
śaucikīrūpiṇī sādhvī hyaprajocchritapāṇikā /
udyāne kavacī dhanvī krīḍecchargaruḍānanaḥ //
meaning:
शौचिकीरूपिणी साध्वी ह्यप्रजोच्छ्रितपाणिका /
उद्याने कवची धन्वी क्रीडेच्छर्गरुडाननः //
text_mt: a chaste woman possessing beauty and purity, childless, with hands raised aloft. / [Gemini:] In a garden, an armored archer, playing with arrows, having the face of Garuḍa;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyādividvaruṇavadbahuratnodhanurdharaḥ /
dvipāsyakaṇṭhaḥ kroḍāsyaḥ kānaneśaramāhikaḥ //
meaning:
नृत्यादिविद्वरुणवद्बहुरत्नोधनुर्धरः /
द्विपास्यकण्ठः क्रोडास्यः काननेशरमाहिकः //
text_mt: skilled in dancing and other arts, resembling Varuṇa, possessing many gems, bearing a bow; / with the neck and face of an elephant, boar-faced, an archer in the forest;

sanskrit_iast:
ātavyaśākhāṃ pālāśī rauti mūrddhāhikarkaśā /
cipiṭāsyo hi saṃvīto nausthaḥ ratryarthaṃvrajañjale //
meaning:
आतव्यशाखां पालाशी रौति मूर्द्धाहिकर्कशा /
चिपिटास्यो हि संवीतो नौस्थः रत्र्यर्थंव्रजञ्जले //
text_mt: [Cancer:] Holding a branch of palāśa in the forest, shouting, rough-headed like a serpent; / flat-faced, covered, seated in a boat, traveling on water for the sake of gems;

sanskrit_iast:
śvā naro jaṃbukaṃ gṛdhraṃ gṛhītvā rauti śālmalau /
dhanvī kṛṣṇājinī siṃhavāśvonnatamāturaḥ //
meaning:
श्वा नरो जंबुकं गृध्रं गृहीत्वा रौति शाल्मलौ /
धन्वी कृष्णाजिनी सिंहवाश्वोन्नतमातुरः //
text_mt: a man who, seizing a dog, a jackal, and a vulture, shouts at the base of a silk-cotton tree; / [Leo:] an archer clad in black antelope skin, loud like a lion or horse, tall and distressed;

sanskrit_iast:
phalāmiṣaghnaḥ kūrjīnā bhallāsyaḥ kapiceṣṭitaḥ /
puṣpapūrṇacchaṭākanyāvidyellā malināṃvarā //
meaning:
फलामिषघ्नः कूर्जीना भल्लास्यः कपिचेष्टितः /
पुष्पपूर्णच्छटाकन्याविद्येल्ला मलिनांवरा //
text_mt: destroying fruits and meat, bearing a basket, bear-faced, acting like a monkey; / [Virgo:] a maiden with a basket filled with flowers, learned, clad in soiled clothes;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvī vyayāpakṛcchyāmo lipikṛdrāmaśonaraḥ /
gaurīdhautāṃśukātsuccākuṃbhadṛstāsurālaye //
meaning:
धन्वी व्ययापकृच्छ्यामो लिपिकृद्रामशोनरः /
गौरीधौतांशुकात्सुच्चाकुंभदृस्तासुरालये //
text_mt: an archer, dark from expenditure and toil, a scribe, a delightful man; / fair, with washed garments, pure, looking at a pot in a shrine of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
mānonmānpāpasotaulībhāṇḍamutpavicintakaḥ /
kṣuttṛṅyuto naraḥ kuṃbhīgṛdhnasya strīsutopagaḥ //
meaning:
मानोन्मान्पापसोतौलीभाण्डमुत्पविचिन्तकः /
क्षुत्तृङ्युतो नरः कुंभीगृध्नस्य स्त्रीसुतोपगः //
text_mt: [Libra:] A man holding a balance, considering weights and measures, intent on pots and goods; / a hungry and thirsty man, eager for a pot, approaching his wife and son;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvīkintaraceṣṭastuhaimavarmāmṛgānugaḥ /
siṃdhekūjaṃvrajantīstrīnānāsarpasita hikā //
meaning:
धन्वीकिन्तरचेष्टस्तुहैमवर्मामृगानुगः /
सिंधेकूजंव्रजन्तीस्त्रीनानासर्पसित हिका //
text_mt: an archer acting like a kinnara, with golden armor, pursuing a deer; / [Scorpio:] a woman going to the ocean with a water-pot, bitten by manifold serpents;

sanskrit_iast:
saukhyaspṛhāhyāvṛttāṅgībhatrarthakacchapākṛtiḥ /
kūrmāsyo malaye siṃhaḥ śvakroṇḍamṛgabhīṣakaḥ //
meaning:
सौख्यस्पृहाह्यावृत्ताङ्गीभत्रर्थकच्छपाकृतिः /
कूर्मास्यो मलये सिंहः श्वक्रोण्डमृगभीषकः //
text_mt: Desiring pleasure, her limbs covered, shaped like a tortoise for the sake of her husband, / with a turtle's face in the Malaya mountains, a lion, terrifying to dogs, foxes, and deer;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsyaḥ śvakāyo dhānuṣko raṅkṣastāpasayajñiye /
caṃpakābhāsane madhyā siṃdhuratravivarddhinī //
meaning:
वास्यः श्वकायो धानुष्को रङ्क्षस्तापसयज्ञिये /
चंपकाभासने मध्या सिंधुरत्रविवर्द्धिनी //
text_mt: having an axe, a dog's body, an archer, a beggar at the sacrifices of ascetics; / a middle woman on a seat resembling a campaka flower, swelling like the ocean here;

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmāsane caṃpakābho daṇḍī kauśeyakāninī /
paramo 'tho gṛdhramukhaḥ snehamadyāśanaspṛhaḥ //
meaning:
कूर्मासने चंपकाभो दण्डी कौशेयकानिनी /
परमो ऽथो गृध्रमुखः स्नेहमद्याशनस्पृहः //
text_mt: resembling a campaka flower on a tortoise seat, holding a staff, clad in silk garments; / then the supreme one with a vulture's face, desiring to consume fats and liquor;

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhānasthā lohadharā sabhūṣābhāñjakaccarā /
bhāṇḍī romaścavāḥ śyāmaḥ kirīṭī phalayantradhṛk //
meaning:
दग्धानस्था लोहधरा सभूषाभाञ्जकच्चरा /
भाण्डी रोमश्चवाः श्यामः किरीटी फलयन्त्रधृक् //
text_mt: standing in ashes, bearing iron, adorned with ornaments, destroying, wandering; / holding a vessel, hairy, dark, wearing a crown, holding a fruit-press;

sanskrit_iast:
nausthodhvosaṃvibhūṣārntha nānāratnakarāeñcitaḥ /
nausthabdheḥ kūlamāyāntī sayūthāṃ campakānanā //
meaning:
नौस्थोध्वोसंविभूषार्न्थ नानारत्नकराएञ्चितः /
नौस्थब्धेः कूलमायान्ती सयूथां चम्पकानना //
text_mt: standing in a boat, adorned for the sake of ornament, hands decorated with various gems; / standing in a boat, coming to the shore of the ocean, having a multitude, with a campaka-like face;

sanskrit_iast:
garte sarpāvṛto nagno rudaṃścaurānalārditaḥ /
etādṛśāṅkriyāṃśāḥ stu ṣatriṃśadudītāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
गर्ते सर्पावृतो नग्नो रुदंश्चौरानलार्दितः /
एतादृशाङ्क्रियांशाः स्तु षत्रिंशदुदीताः क्रमात् //
text_mt: naked in a pit, surrounded by snakes, weeping, afflicted by thieves and fire— / such decanates have been declared in order, thirty-six in number.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ jātakaṃ munisattama /
nibodha saṃhitāskandhaṃ lokakṛtyupayoginam //
iti śrīnāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge dvitīyapāde bṛhadupākhyāne jātakanirūpaṇannāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत्संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं जातकं मुनिसत्तम /
निबोध संहितास्कन्धं लोककृत्युपयोगिनम् //
इति श्रीनारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे द्वितीयपादे बृहदुपाख्याने जातकनिरूपणन्नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus the branch of horoscopy has been spoken in brief, O best of sages; / now understand the Saṃhitā section, which is useful for the activities of the world.

Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, named 'Exposition of Horoscopy', in the Bṛhad-upākhyāna of the second quarter of the first part of the glorious Nāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanandana uvāca
kramāñcaitrādimāseṣu meṣādyāḥ saṃkramā matāḥ /
caitraśuklapratipadi yo vāraḥ sa nṛpaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दन उवाच
क्रमाञ्चैत्रादिमासेषु मेषाद्याः संक्रमा मताः /
चैत्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि यो वारः स नृपः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Sanandana said: / In order, in the months beginning with Caitra, the ingresses beginning with Meṣa are considered. / The weekday on the first tithi of the waxing fortnight of Caitra is known as the king.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣapraveśe senānīḥ karkaṭe sasyayo bhavet /
samodyadhīśvaraḥ sūryo madhyamaścottamovidhuḥ //
meaning:
मेषप्रवेशे सेनानीः कर्कटे सस्ययो भवेत् /
समोद्यधीश्वरः सूर्यो मध्यमश्चोत्तमोविधुः //
text_mt: At the entrance into Meṣa, [the lord of that day] is the commander of the army; in Karkaṭa, he is the lord of crops. / The Sun is a ruler with even results, the Moon is intermediate and excellent.

sanskrit_iast:
neṣṭaḥ kujo budho jīvo bhṛgustvatiśubhaṅkaraḥ /
adhamo ravijo vācyo jñātvā caiṣāṃ balābalam //
meaning:
नेष्टः कुजो बुधो जीवो भृगुस्त्वतिशुभङ्करः /
अधमो रविजो वाच्यो ज्ञात्वा चैषां बलाबलम् //
text_mt: Mars is unfavorable; Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus are exceedingly auspicious; / Saturn is to be declared lowest, having ascertained their strength and weakness.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍākāre kabandhe vā dhvāṅkṣākāre 'tha kīlake /
dṛṣṭer'kamaṇḍale vyādhirbhrāntiścorārthanāśanam //
meaning:
दण्डाकारे कबन्धे वा ध्वाङ्क्षाकारे ऽथ कीलके /
दृष्टेर्ऽकमण्डले व्याधिर्भ्रान्तिश्चोरार्थनाशनम् //
text_mt: When a staff-shaped, headless, crow-shaped, or peg-shaped form / is seen in the Sun's orb, there is disease, delusion, and loss of wealth through thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
chatradhvajapatākādyasannibhastimitairdhvanaiḥ /
varimaṇḍalagairdhūmraiḥ sasphuliṅgairjagatkṣayaḥ //
meaning:
छत्रध्वजपताकाद्यसन्निभस्तिमितैर्ध्वनैः /
वरिमण्डलगैर्धूम्रैः सस्फुलिङ्गैर्जगत्क्षयः //
text_mt: When it resembles an umbrella, banner, flag, and the like, with deep rumbles, / smoky inside the water-orb and accompanied by sparks, there is destruction of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sitaraktaiḥ pītakṛṣṇairvaṇairviprādipīḍanam /
ghnanti dvitricaturvarṇairbhuvi rājajanānmune //
meaning:
सितरक्तैः पीतकृष्णैर्वणैर्विप्रादिपीडनम् /
घ्नन्ति द्वित्रिचतुर्वर्णैर्भुवि राजजनान्मुने //
text_mt: With white, red, yellow, and black colors, there is affliction respectively to Brahmins and the other classes; / with two, three, or four colors, O sage, they destroy kings and people on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhairbhānukaraistāmrairnāśa yāti camūpatiḥ /
pītairnṛpasutaḥ śvetaiḥ purodhāścitritairjanāḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्द्धैर्भानुकरैस्ताम्रैर्नाश याति चमूपतिः /
पीतैर्नृपसुतः श्वेतैः पुरोधाश्चित्रितैर्जनाः //
text_mt: With upward, copper-colored rays of the Sun, the commander of the army meets destruction; / with yellow, the king's son; with white, the priest; with multicolored, the people.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmrairnṛpapiśaṅgaistu jaladādhomukhairjagat /
śubhor'kaḥ śiśire tāmraḥ kuṅkumābhā vasaṃtike //
meaning:
धूम्रैर्नृपपिशङ्गैस्तु जलदाधोमुखैर्जगत् /
शुभोर्ऽकः शिशिरे ताम्रः कुङ्कुमाभा वसंतिके //
text_mt: With smoky rays, the king; with reddish-brown, the cloud; with downward rays, the world [is ruined]. / The Sun is auspicious when copper-colored in winter, and saffron-hued in spring;

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣmaścāpāṇḍuraścaiva vicitro jaladāgame /
padmodarābhaḥ śaradi hemante lohitacchaviḥ //
meaning:
ग्रीष्मश्चापाण्डुरश्चैव विचित्रो जलदागमे /
पद्मोदराभः शरदि हेमन्ते लोहितच्छविः //
text_mt: whitish in summer, variegated at the arrival of clouds, / resembling the interior of a lotus in autumn, and reddish in early winter.

sanskrit_iast:
pītaḥ śīte vṛṣṭau grīṣme lohitabhāraviḥ /
rogānāvṛṣṭibhayakṛt kramādukto munīśvara //
meaning:
पीतः शीते वृष्टौ ग्रीष्मे लोहितभारविः /
रोगानावृष्टिभयकृत् क्रमादुक्तो मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: A Sun that is yellow in cold weather, [yellow] in rain, and red-colored in summer / causes diseases and fear of drought, respectively, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
indracāpārddhamūrtistu bhānurbhūpavirodhakṛt /
śaśaraktanibhe bhānau saṃgrāmo na cirādbhuvi //
meaning:
इन्द्रचापार्द्धमूर्तिस्तु भानुर्भूपविरोधकृत् /
शशरक्तनिभे भानौ संग्रामो न चिराद्भुवि //
text_mt: A Sun having the form of a half-rainbow causes hostility among kings. / When the Sun resembles the blood of a hare, battle soon arises on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūrapatra saṃkāśo dvādaśābdaṃ na varṣati /
candramāsadṛśo bhānuḥ kuryādbhūpāntaraṃ kṣitau //
meaning:
मयूरपत्र संकाशो द्वादशाब्दं न वर्षति /
चन्द्रमासदृशो भानुः कुर्याद्भूपान्तरं क्षितौ //
text_mt: When it resembles a peacock's feather, it does not rain for twelve years. / A Sun resembling the Moon brings about another king on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
arke śyāme kīṭabhayaṃ bhasmābhe rāṣṭrajaṃ tathā /
chidrer'kamaṇḍale dṛṣṭaṃ mahārājavināśanam //
meaning:
अर्के श्यामे कीटभयं भस्माभे राष्ट्रजं तथा /
छिद्रेर्ऽकमण्डले दृष्टं महाराजविनाशनम् //
text_mt: When the Sun is dark, there is fear from insects; when ash-colored, fear arising in the kingdom; / when an aperture is seen in the Sun's orb, the destruction of a great king occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭākṛtiḥ kṣudbhayakṛtpurahā toraṇākṛtiḥ /
chatrākṛte deśahatiḥ khaṇḍabhānunṛpāntakṛt //
meaning:
घटाकृतिः क्षुद्भयकृत्पुरहा तोरणाकृतिः /
छत्राकृते देशहतिः खण्डभानुनृपान्तकृत् //
text_mt: Shaped like a jar, it causes fear of hunger; shaped like an arch, it destroys cities; / when shaped like an umbrella, ruin of the country; a broken Sun causes the end of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamaye kāle vidyudulkāśaniryadi /
tadā nṛpavadho jñeyastvathavā rājavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
उदयास्तमये काले विद्युदुल्काशनिर्यदि /
तदा नृपवधो ज्ञेयस्त्वथवा राजविग्रहः //
text_mt: If at the time of sunrise or sunset there is lightning, meteors, or thunderbolts, / then the slaughter of the king is to be understood, or a war between kings.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣaṃ pakṣārddhamarkendupariviṣṭāvaharniśam /
rājānamanyaṃ kuruto lohitāmbudayāstagau //
meaning:
पक्षं पक्षार्द्धमर्केन्दुपरिविष्टावहर्निशम् /
राजानमन्यं कुरुतो लोहिताम्बुदयास्तगौ //
text_mt: If the Sun and Moon have halos day and night for a fortnight or half a fortnight, / and rise or set amid red clouds, they make another man king.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamaye bhānurācchinnaḥ śastrasannibheḥ /
ghanairyuddhaṃ kharoṣṭrādyaiḥ pāparūpairbhayapradam //
meaning:
उदयास्तमये भानुराच्छिन्नः शस्त्रसन्निभेः /
घनैर्युद्धं खरोष्ट्राद्यैः पापरूपैर्भयप्रदम् //
text_mt: At sunrise or sunset, the Sun obscured by clouds resembling weapons / indicates war; [obscured] by ominous forms like donkeys and camels, it brings fear.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyaśṛṅgonnattaścandraḥ śubhadī mīnameṣayoḥ /
saumyaśṛṅgonnataḥ śreṣṭho nṛyuṅmakarayostathā //
meaning:
याम्यशृङ्गोन्नत्तश्चन्द्रः शुभदी मीनमेषयोः /
सौम्यशृङ्गोन्नतः श्रेष्ठो नृयुङ्मकरयोस्तथा //
text_mt: The Moon with its southern horn raised brings good fortune in Mīna and Meṣa; / with its northern horn raised, it is best in Mithuna and Makara.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭokṣṇastu samaḥ karkacāpayoḥ śarasannibhaḥ /
cāpavatkaurmahṝrṃyośca śūlabattulakarkayoḥ //
meaning:
घटोक्ष्णस्तु समः कर्कचापयोः शरसन्निभः /
चापवत्कौर्महॄर्ंयोश्च शूलबत्तुलकर्कयोः //
text_mt: In Kumbha and Vṛṣabha it is level; in Karka and Dhanus it resembles an arrow; / in Vṛścika and Siṃha it is like a bow; and in Tulā and Karka it is like a trident.

sanskrit_iast:
viparītoditaścandro durbhikṣakalahapradaḥ /
āṣāḍhadvayamūlendradhiṣṇyānāṃ yāmyagaḥ śaśī //
meaning:
विपरीतोदितश्चन्द्रो दुर्भिक्षकलहप्रदः /
आषाढद्वयमूलेन्द्रधिष्ण्यानां याम्यगः शशी //
text_mt: A Moon that rises in a contrary manner brings famine and strife. / Moving south of the asterisms of the two Āṣāḍhās, Mūla, and Jyeṣṭhā, the Moon

sanskrit_iast:
agnipradasteyacaravanasarpavināśakṛt /
viśākhā mitrayoryāmyapārśvagaḥ pāpagaḥ śaśī //
meaning:
अग्निप्रदस्तेयचरवनसर्पविनाशकृत् /
विशाखा मित्रयोर्याम्यपार्श्वगः पापगः शशी //
text_mt: brings fire, and causes destruction to rovers, forest-dwellers, and serpents. / Moving on the southern side of Viśākhā and Anurādhā, a malefic Moon

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamaḥ pitṛdaivatye dvidaive saimyagaḥ śaśī /
aprāpyapauṣṇabhādrāmadukṣāviśaśī śubhaḥ //
meaning:
मध्यमः पितृदैवत्ये द्विदैवे सैम्यगः शशी /
अप्राप्यपौष्णभाद्रामदुक्षाविशशी शुभः //
text_mt: is intermediate; moving to the north in Maghā and Viśākhā, the Moon is auspicious / before it reaches Revatī, Bhādrapadā, or Rohiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyagodvāradakṣāṇi atītya navavāsavāt /
yamendrāhīśanoyeśamarutaścārddhatārakāḥ //
meaning:
मध्यगोद्वारदक्षाणि अतीत्य नववासवात् /
यमेन्द्राहीशनोयेशमरुतश्चार्द्धतारकाः //
text_mt: Going in the middle, passing the south doors, from nine [lunar mansions] beginning with Dhaniṣṭhā, / Bharaṇī, Jyeṣṭhā, Āśleṣā, Ārdrā, and Svātī are half-star constellations;

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvāditidvidaivāḥ syuradhyarddhāṃścāparāḥ samāḥ /
yāmyaśṛṅgonnato neṣṭaḥ śubhaḥ śukle pipīlikā //
meaning:
ध्रुवादितिद्विदैवाः स्युरध्यर्द्धांश्चापराः समाः /
याम्यशृङ्गोन्नतो नेष्टः शुभः शुक्ले पिपीलिका //
text_mt: Uttaraphalgunī, Uttara-āṣāḍhā, Uttara-bhādrapadā, Rohiṇī, Punarvasu, and Viśākhā are one and a half; others are equal. / The southern horn raised is unfavorable; an ant-like line in the waxing moon is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryahāniḥ kāryavṛddhirhānirvṛddhiryathākramam /
subhikṣakṛdviśālenduraviśāloghanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
कार्यहानिः कार्यवृद्धिर्हानिर्वृद्धिर्यथाक्रमम् /
सुभिक्षकृद्विशालेन्दुरविशालोघनाशनः //
text_mt: Loss of enterprise, increase of enterprise, loss, and increase occur respectively. / A broad moon produces plenty; a narrow one brings destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
adhomukhe śastrabhayaṅkalahodaṇḍasannibhe /
kujādyairnihate śṛṅge maṇḍale vā yathākramam //
meaning:
अधोमुखे शस्त्रभयङ्कलहोदण्डसन्निभे /
कुजाद्यैर्निहते शृङ्गे मण्डले वा यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: When turned downward, there is fear of weapons; when resembling a rod, strife. / When a horn or the orb is struck by Mars and other planets, respectively,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemādyaṃ vṛṣṭibhūpālajananāśaḥ prajāyate /
satyāṣṭanavamarkṣeṣu sodayādvikrime kuje //
meaning:
क्षेमाद्यं वृष्टिभूपालजननाशः प्रजायते /
सत्याष्टनवमर्क्षेषु सोदयाद्विक्रिमे कुजे //
text_mt: there occurs security or the like, rain, and the destruction of kings and people. / When Mars retrogrades in the seventh, eighth, or ninth asterism from its rising,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvakramuṣṇaṃsaṃjñaṃ syātprajāpīḍāgnisaṃbhavaḥ /
daśamaikādaśe ṛkṣe dvādaśarvāgratīpayaḥ //
meaning:
तद्वक्रमुष्णंसंज्ञं स्यात्प्रजापीडाग्निसंभवः /
दशमैकादशे ऋक्षे द्वादशर्वाग्रतीपयः //
text_mt: that retrograde is called 'Hot', causing affliction to subjects and the occurrence of fires. / In the tenth, eleventh, or twelfth asterism, moving backward,

sanskrit_iast:
kūkraṃ vakramukhaṃ jñeyaṃ sasyavṛṣṭivināśakṛt /
kuje trayodaśe ṛkṣe vakrite vā caturdaśe //
meaning:
कूक्रं वक्रमुखं ज्ञेयं सस्यवृष्टिविनाशकृत् /
कुजे त्रयोदशे ऋक्षे वक्रिते वा चतुर्दशे //
text_mt: that retrograde is to be known as 'Curved-faced', destroying crops and rain. / When Mars retrogrades in the thirteenth or fourteenth asterism,

sanskrit_iast:
bālāsyacakraṃ tattasminsasyavṛṣṭivināśanam /
pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśarkṣe vakre syādrudhirānanam //
meaning:
बालास्यचक्रं तत्तस्मिन्सस्यवृष्टिविनाशनम् /
पञ्चदशे षोडशर्क्षे वक्रे स्याद्रुधिराननम् //
text_mt: that retrograde is 'Young-faced', bringing destruction of crops and rain. / When it retrogrades in the fifteenth or sixteenth asterism, it becomes 'Blood-faced';

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ rogānkaroti kṣitinandanaḥ /
aṣṭādaśe saptadaśe tadvakraṃ muśalāhvayam //
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षं क्षुद्भयं रोगान्करोति क्षितिनन्दनः /
अष्टादशे सप्तदशे तद्वक्रं मुशलाह्वयम् //
text_mt: the son of the Earth then causes famine, fear of hunger, and diseases. / In the seventeenth or eighteenth asterism, that retrograde is named 'Pestle';

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣaṃ dhanadhānyādināśane bhayakṛtsadā /
phaālgunyorudito bhaumo vaiśvadeve pratīpagaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षं धनधान्यादिनाशने भयकृत्सदा /
फआल्गुन्योरुदितो भौमो वैश्वदेवे प्रतीपगः //
text_mt: it constantly creates fear in the destruction of wealth, grain, and the like. / Mars having risen in the two Phalgunīs, moving retrogradely in Uttarāṣāḍhā,

sanskrit_iast:
astagaścaturāsyārkṣe lokatrayavināśakṛt /
uditaḥ śravaṇe puṣye vaktṛgośvanahānidaḥ //
meaning:
अस्तगश्चतुरास्यार्क्षे लोकत्रयविनाशकृत् /
उदितः श्रवणे पुष्ये वक्तृगोश्वनहानिदः //
text_mt: and setting in Rohiṇī, causes destruction to the three worlds. / Having risen in Śravaṇa or Puṣya, retrograde, it causes loss of horses.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddiggo 'bhyudito bhaumastaddigbhūpabhayapradaḥ /
madhāmadhyagato bhaumastatra caiva pratīpagaḥ //
meaning:
यद्दिग्गो ऽभ्युदितो भौमस्तद्दिग्भूपभयप्रदः /
मधामध्यगतो भौमस्तत्र चैव प्रतीपगः //
text_mt: In whichever direction Mars rises, it brings fear to the kings of that direction. / Mars situated in the middle of Maghā and retrograding right there

sanskrit_iast:
avṛṣṭiśastrabhayadaḥ pīḍyaṃ devā nṛpantakṛt /
pitṛdvidaivadhātṝṇāṃ bhidyante gaṇḍatārakāḥ //
meaning:
अवृष्टिशस्त्रभयदः पीड्यं देवा नृपन्तकृत् /
पितृद्विदैवधातॄणां भिद्यन्ते गण्डतारकाः //
text_mt: causes drought and fear of weapons, afflicting gods and bringing death to kings. / When the junction-stars of Maghā, Viśākhā, and Rohiṇī are pierced,

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ rogaṃ karoti kṣitijastadā /
triṣūttarāsu rohiṇyāṃ nairṛte śravaṇe mṛge //
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षं मरणं रोगं करोति क्षितिजस्तदा /
त्रिषूत्तरासु रोहिण्यां नैरृते श्रवणे मृगे //
text_mt: the son of the Earth then causes famine, death, and disease. / In the three Uttarās, in Rohiṇī, Mūla, Śravaṇa, and Mṛgaśīrṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
avṛṣaaṭidaścaranbhaumo dakṣiṇerohiṇīsthitaḥ /
bhūmijaḥ sarvadhiṣṇyānāmudagāmī śubhaghapradaḥ //
meaning:
अवृषअटिदश्चरन्भौमो दक्षिणेरोहिणीस्थितः /
भूमिजः सर्वधिष्ण्यानामुदगामी शुभघप्रदः //
text_mt: Mars moving brings drought; situated to the south of Rohiṇī, / the son of the Earth brings destruction to all asterisms; moving to the north, he gives good.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyago 'niṣṭaphalado bhavedbhedakaro nṛṇām /
vinotpātena śaśinaḥ kadācinnodayaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
याम्यगो ऽनिष्टफलदो भवेद्भेदकरो नृणाम् /
विनोत्पातेन शशिनः कदाचिन्नोदयं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Moving to the south, he produces unfavorable results and causes division among men. / He should never rise without an omen of the Moon;

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛṣṭāgnibhayakṛdanarthanṛpavigrahaṛ /
vasuvaiṣṇavaviśvendudhātṛbheṣu caranbudhaḥ //
meaning:
अनावृष्टाग्निभयकृदनर्थनृपविग्रहऋ /
वसुवैष्णवविश्वेन्दुधातृभेषु चरन्बुधः //
text_mt: he creates drought, fear of fire, misfortune, and war among kings. / Mercury moving in Dhaniṣṭhā, Śravaṇa, Uttarāṣāḍhā, Mṛgaśīrṣa, and Rohiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
bhinatti yadi tattārāṃ bādhāvṛṣṭibhayaṅkaraḥ /
ārdrādipitṛbhānteṣu dṛśyate yadi candrajaḥ //
meaning:
भिनत्ति यदि तत्तारां बाधावृष्टिभयङ्करः /
आर्द्रादिपितृभान्तेषु दृश्यते यदि चन्द्रजः //
text_mt: if he pierces that star, causes obstacle, rain, and fear. / If the son of the Moon is seen in the asterisms beginning with Ārdrā and ending with Maghā,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā durbhikṣakalaharogānāvṛṣṭibhītikṛt /
hastādiṣaṭsu tārāsu vicarannindunandanaḥ //
meaning:
तदा दुर्भिक्षकलहरोगानावृष्टिभीतिकृत् /
हस्तादिषट्सु तारासु विचरन्निन्दुनन्दनः //
text_mt: Then it causes famine, strife, disease, drought, and fear. / The son of the Moon (Mercury), moving through the six asterisms beginning with Hasta,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyaṃ kurute roganāśanam /
ahirbudhnyāryamāgneyayāmyabheṣu caranbudhaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेमं सुभिक्षमारोग्यं कुरुते रोगनाशनम् /
अहिर्बुध्न्यार्यमाग्नेययाम्यभेषु चरन्बुधः //
text_mt: brings about peace, plenty, health, and the destruction of diseases. / Mercury moving through Ahirbudhnya (Uttarabhadrapadā), Aryaman (Uttaraphālgunī), Āgneya (Kṛttikā), and Yāmya (Bharaṇī)

sanskrit_iast:
bhiṣaktaraṅgavāṇijyavṛttīnāṃ nāśakṛttādā /
pūrvātrayecaransaumyo yogatārāṃ bhinatti cet //
meaning:
भिषक्तरङ्गवाणिज्यवृत्तीनां नाशकृत्तादा /
पूर्वात्रयेचरन्सौम्यो योगतारां भिनत्ति चेत् //
text_mt: causes destruction to physicians, messengers, and mercantile livelihoods then. / If Mercury, moving in the three Pūrvās, pierces their junction-star,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣucchastrānalacaurebhyo bhayadaḥ prāṇināṃ tadā /
yāmyāgnidhātṛvāyavyadhiṣṇayeṣu prākṛtā gatiḥ //
meaning:
क्षुच्छस्त्रानलचौरेभ्यो भयदः प्राणिनां तदा /
याम्याग्निधातृवायव्यधिष्णयेषु प्राकृता गतिः //
text_mt: then it brings danger to living beings from hunger, weapons, fire, and thieves. / In the lunar mansions of Yāmya, Agni, Dhātṛ, and Vāyu, [its] course is called Prākṛtā (Natural).

sanskrit_iast:
raudrendusārpapitryeṣu jñeyā miśrāhvayā gatiḥ /
bhāgyāryamejyāditiṣu saṃkṣiptā gatirucyate //
meaning:
रौद्रेन्दुसार्पपित्र्येषु ज्ञेया मिश्राह्वया गतिः /
भाग्यार्यमेज्यादितिषु संक्षिप्ता गतिरुच्यते //
text_mt: In the mansions of Rudra, Indu, Sarpa, and Pitṛs, the course is to be known as Miśrā (Mixed). / In Bhāgya, Āryama, Ijya, and Aditi, the course is called Saṃkṣiptā (Contracted).

sanskrit_iast:
gatitīkṣṇājacaraṇāhirbudhyabhāśribheṣuyā /
yomātikātiviśvābumūlamatsyainyajasya ca //
meaning:
गतितीक्ष्णाजचरणाहिर्बुध्यभाश्रिभेषुया /
योमातिकातिविश्वाबुमूलमत्स्यैन्यजस्य च //
text_mt: The course is Tīkṣṇā (Fierce) in Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, and Āśvina; / [and it is Viśākhā] in Viśve, Āpaḥ, Mūla, and Matsya (Revatī) for the offspring of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ghorā gatirharitvāṣṭravasuvāruṇabheṣu ca /
indrāgnimitramārtaṇḍabheṣu pāpāhvayāgatiḥ //
meaning:
घोरा गतिर्हरित्वाष्ट्रवसुवारुणभेषु च /
इन्द्राग्निमित्रमार्तण्डभेषु पापाह्वयागतिः //
text_mt: The course is Ghorā (Terrible) in the asterisms of Hari, Tvaṣṭṛ, Vasu, and Varuṇa. / In the mansions of Indra-Agni, Mitra, and Mārtaṇḍa, the course is named Pāpā (Evil).

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtādyāsu gati hyudito 'stamitopivā /
yāvantyeva dinānyeṣa dṛśyastāvatyadṛśyagaḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृताद्यासु गति ह्युदितो ऽस्तमितोपिवा /
यावन्त्येव दिनान्येष दृश्यस्तावत्यदृश्यगः //
text_mt: Having risen or set in the courses beginning with Prākṛtā, / for as many days as it remains visible, for so many it remains invisible.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśatkramātriṃśadravīndra bhūsuto nava /
pañcadaśaikādaśabhirdivasaiḥ śaśinandanaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्क्रमात्रिंशद्रवीन्द्र भूसुतो नव /
पञ्चदशैकादशभिर्दिवसैः शशिनन्दनः //
text_mt: Forty, thirty, sequentially—the Sun, Indra, Mars nine, / the son of the Moon [remains invisible] for fifteen and eleven days.

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtāyāṃ gataḥ saumyaḥ kṣemārogyasubhikṣakṛt /
miśrasakṣiptayormadhye phalado 'nyāsu vṛṣṭidaḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृतायां गतः सौम्यः क्षेमारोग्यसुभिक्षकृत् /
मिश्रसक्षिप्तयोर्मध्ये फलदो ऽन्यासु वृष्टिदः //
text_mt: Mercury moving in the Prākṛtā course brings peace, health, and plenty; / in Miśrā and Saṃkṣiptā it produces middling results, and in the others it brings rain.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākha śrāvaṇe pauṣe āṣāḍhe 'bhyudito budhaḥ /
jagatāṃ pāpaphaladastvitareṣu śubhapradaḥ //
meaning:
वैशाख श्रावणे पौषे आषाढे ऽभ्युदितो बुधः /
जगतां पापफलदस्त्वितरेषु शुभप्रदः //
text_mt: Rising in Vaiśākha, Śrāvaṇa, Pauṣa, or Āṣāḍha, Mercury / produces evil fruits for the worlds, but in the other months it bestows good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣorjamāsayoḥ śastradurbhikṣāgnibhayapradaḥ /
uditaścandrajaḥ śreṣṭho rajatasphaṭikopayaḥ //
meaning:
इषोर्जमासयोः शस्त्रदुर्भिक्षाग्निभयप्रदः /
उदितश्चन्द्रजः श्रेष्ठो रजतस्फटिकोपयः //
text_mt: In the months of Iṣa (Āśvina) and Ūrja (Kārtika) it gives fear of weapons, famine, and fire. / The son of the Moon, rising with the appearance of silver or crystal, is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhāṭajodimāstasya pañcamaikādaśāstrimādhavaḥ śubhado jyeṣṭo nṛṇāṃ madhyaphalapradaḥ /
śucirmadhyo nabhaḥ śreṣṭho bhādraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kvacinnaraḥ //
meaning:
द्विभाटजोदिमास्तस्य पञ्चमैकादशास्त्रिमाधवः शुभदो ज्येष्टो नृणां मध्यफलप्रदः /
शुचिर्मध्यो नभः श्रेष्ठो भाद्रः श्रेष्ठः क्वचिन्नरः //
text_mt: [Rising in Vaiśākha] it is auspicious; in Jyeṣṭha it yields middling results for men; / in Śuci (Āṣāḍha) it is middling; in Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa) it is auspicious; in Bhādrapada it is auspicious for some men.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtiko mārgaśīrṣaśca nṛṇāṃ duṣṭaphalapradaḥ /
śubhapradau pauṣamādhau madhyamau phaālguno madhuḥ //
meaning:
कार्तिको मार्गशीर्षश्च नृणां दुष्टफलप्रदः /
शुभप्रदौ पौषमाधौ मध्यमौ फआल्गुनो मधुः //
text_mt: Kārtika and Mārgaśīrṣa yield evil fruits for men. / Pauṣa and Māgha bestow auspiciousness; Phālguna and Madhu (Caitra) are middling.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavaḥ śubhado jyeṣṭo nṛṇāṃ madhyaphalapradaḥ /
śucirmadhyo nabhaḥ śreṣṭho bhādraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kvacinnara //
meaning:
माधवः शुभदो ज्येष्टो नृणां मध्यफलप्रदः /
शुचिर्मध्यो नभः श्रेष्ठो भाद्रः श्रेष्ठः क्वचिन्नर //
text_mt: Mādhava (Vaiśākha) bestows good fortune; Jyeṣṭha yields middling results for men; / Śuci (Āṣāḍha) is middling; Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa) is auspicious; Bhādrapada is auspicious for some men.

sanskrit_iast:
atiśreṣṭha iṣaḥ prokto māsānāṃ phalamīdṛśam /
saumye bhāge caranbhānāṃ kṣemārogyasubhikṣakṛt //
meaning:
अतिश्रेष्ठ इषः प्रोक्तो मासानां फलमीदृशम् /
सौम्ये भागे चरन्भानां क्षेमारोग्यसुभिक्षकृत् //
text_mt: Iṣa (Āśvina) is declared very auspicious; such is the fruit of the months. / [Jupiter] moving in the northern portion of the asterisms brings peace, health, and plenty;

sanskrit_iast:
viparīto gururyāmye madhye carati madhyamam /
pītāgniśyāmaharitaraktavarṇogirāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
विपरीतो गुरुर्याम्ये मध्ये चरति मध्यमम् /
पीताग्निश्यामहरितरक्तवर्णोगिराः क्रमात् //
text_mt: contrariwise, Jupiter moving in the southern yields the opposite; moving in the middle, middling [results]. / In order, the planet of yellow, smoky, dark, green, or red color

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhyagnicauraśastrāstrabhayadaḥ prāṇināṃ bhavet /
anāvṛṣṭiṃ bhūmnanibhaḥ karoti surapūjitaḥ //
meaning:
व्याध्यग्निचौरशस्त्रास्त्रभयदः प्राणिनां भवेत् /
अनावृष्टिं भूम्ननिभः करोति सुरपूजितः //
text_mt: causes danger to living beings from disease, fire, thieves, swords, and missiles. / Resembling earth, the preceptor of the gods brings about drought.

sanskrit_iast:
divādṛṣṭo nṛpavadhyāmayaṃvārāṣṭranāśanam /
saṃvatsaraśarīraṃ syātkṛttikā rohiṇī tathā //
meaning:
दिवादृष्टो नृपवध्यामयंवाराष्ट्रनाशनम् /
संवत्सरशरीरं स्यात्कृत्तिका रोहिणी तथा //
text_mt: Seen by day, it brings the death of kings, disease, or destruction of the kingdom. / Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī constitute the body of the year;

sanskrit_iast:
nābhistvāpāṭhayugalamādrī hṛtkusumaṃ maghā /
durbhikṣāgnimarudbhītiḥ śarīraṃ krūrapīḍite //
meaning:
नाभिस्त्वापाठयुगलमाद्री हृत्कुसुमं मघा /
दुर्भिक्षाग्निमरुद्भीतिः शरीरं क्रूरपीडिते //
text_mt: the two Āṣāḍhās are the navel; Ārdrā the heart; Maghā the flower. / When the body is afflicted by a malefic, there is fear of famine, fire, and wind.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhyāṃ kṣuttṛṅbhayaṃ puṣye samyaṅmūlaphalakṣayaḥ /
hṛdayeśasya nidhanaṃ śubhaṃ syātsaṃyutaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
नाभ्यां क्षुत्तृङ्भयं पुष्ये सम्यङ्मूलफलक्षयः /
हृदयेशस्य निधनं शुभं स्यात्संयुतैः शुभैः //
text_mt: When the navel [is afflicted], there is fear of hunger and thirst; in Puṣya, complete loss of roots and fruits. / In the heart, death of the ruler; with benefics conjoined, there is auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
śasyavṛddhiḥ prajārogyaṃ yuddhaṃ jīvātyavarṣaṇam /
iti dvijātimadhyāṃ tu gonṛpastrīsukhaṃ mahat //
meaning:
शस्यवृद्धिः प्रजारोग्यं युद्धं जीवात्यवर्षणम् /
इति द्विजातिमध्यां तु गोनृपस्त्रीसुखं महत् //
text_mt: There is growth of crops, health of the subjects, war, and excessive rainfall by Jupiter. / Thus, in the middle of the twice-born, there is great happiness for cows, kings, and women;

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsvanāvṛṣṭiphaṇi bhirvṛṣṭiḥ svāsthyaṃ mahotsavaḥ /
mahārghamapi saṃpattirdeśanāśo 'tivarṣaṇam //
meaning:
निःस्वनावृष्टिफणि भिर्वृष्टिः स्वास्थ्यं महोत्सवः /
महार्घमपि संपत्तिर्देशनाशो ऽतिवर्षणम् //
text_mt: [or] poverty, drought, snakes, rain, well-being, great festivity, / high prices, yet prosperity, destruction of the land, excessive rain,

sanskrit_iast:
avairaṃ rogamabhayaṃ rogabhīḥ sasyavarṣaṇe /
rogo dhānyaṃ nabho 'dṛṣṭimaghādyṛkṣagate gurau //
meaning:
अवैरं रोगमभयं रोगभीः सस्यवर्षणे /
रोगो धान्यं नभो ऽदृष्टिमघाद्यृक्षगते गुरौ //
text_mt: absence of enmity, disease, freedom from fear, dread of illness when crops rain, / disease, corn, and no rain from the sky, when Jupiter is situated in the asterisms beginning with Maghā.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyamadhyamayāmyeṣu mārgeṣu vīthikātrayam /
śukrasya dastrabhājjñeyaṃ paryāyaiśca tribhistribhiḥ //
meaning:
सौम्यमध्यमयाम्येषु मार्गेषु वीथिकात्रयम् /
शुक्रस्य दस्त्रभाज्ज्ञेयं पर्यायैश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: In the northern, central, and southern paths, three lanes each, / Venus has nine lanes beginning from the asterism of the Aśvins, taken in triads.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgebhairāvatāścaiva vṛṣabhoṣṭrakharāhvayāḥ /
mṛgāñjadahanākhyāḥ syuryāmayāntā vīthayo nava //
meaning:
नागेभैरावताश्चैव वृषभोष्ट्रखराह्वयाः /
मृगाञ्जदहनाख्याः स्युर्यामयान्ता वीथयो नव //
text_mt: The nine lanes ending in the south are known as / Nāga, Gaja, Airāvata, Vṛṣabha, Uṣṭra, Khara, Mṛga, Aja, and Dahana.

sanskrit_iast:
saumya mārge ca tisṛṣu caranvīthiṣu bhārgavaḥ /
dhānyārthavṛṣṭisasyānāṃ paripūrti karoti hi //
meaning:
सौम्य मार्गे च तिसृषु चरन्वीथिषु भार्गवः /
धान्यार्थवृष्टिसस्यानां परिपूर्ति करोति हि //
text_mt: Venus moving in the three lanes of the northern path / verily causes the full abundance of grain, wealth, rain, and crops.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamārge ca tisṛṣu sarvamapyadhamaṃ phalam /
pūrvasyāṃ diśi meghastu śubhadaḥ pitṛpañcake //
meaning:
मध्यमार्गे च तिसृषु सर्वमप्यधमं फलम् /
पूर्वस्यां दिशि मेघस्तु शुभदः पितृपञ्चके //
text_mt: In the three lanes of the middle path, all results are inferior. / A cloud in the eastern direction is auspicious in the five Pitṛ constellations;

sanskrit_iast:
svātitraye paścimāyāṃ tasyāṃ śukrastathāvidhaḥ /
viparīte tvanāvṛṣṭidṛdbudhasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
स्वातित्रये पश्चिमायां तस्यां शुक्रस्तथाविधः /
विपरीते त्वनावृष्टिदृद्बुधसंयुतः //
text_mt: in the western direction in the Svāti triad, Venus acts likewise. / But if contrary, conjoined with Mercury, it brings drought.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ ca yadā sitaḥ /
undayāstamanaṃ yāti tadā jalamayī mahī //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्याममायां च यदा सितः /
उन्दयास्तमनं याति तदा जलमयी मही //
text_mt: When Venus rises or sets on the eighth or fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / or on the new moon, then the earth is filled with water.

sanskrit_iast:
mithaḥ saptamarāśisthau paścātprāgvīthisaṃsthitau /
guruśukrāvanāvṛṣṭidurbhikṣasamarapradau //
meaning:
मिथः सप्तमराशिस्थौ पश्चात्प्राग्वीथिसंस्थितौ /
गुरुशुक्रावनावृष्टिदुर्भिक्षसमरप्रदौ //
text_mt: Jupiter and Venus situated in the seventh sign from each other, / or situated in the western and eastern lanes, cause drought, famine, and battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kujajñajīvaravijāḥ śukrasyāgresarā yadi /
yuddhāntivāyurdurbhikṣajalanāśakarā matāḥ //
meaning:
कुजज्ञजीवरविजाः शुक्रस्याग्रेसरा यदि /
युद्धान्तिवायुर्दुर्भिक्षजलनाशकरा मताः //
text_mt: If Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, or Saturn precede Venus, / they are considered causes of war, violent wind, famine, and destruction of water.

sanskrit_iast:
jalamitrāryamāhīndranakṣatreṣu subhikṣakṛt /
sacchastrāvṛṣṭido mūle 'hirbudhnyabhayorbhayam //
meaning:
जलमित्रार्यमाहीन्द्रनक्षत्रेषु सुभिक्षकृत् /
सच्छस्त्रावृष्टिदो मूले ऽहिर्बुध्न्यभयोर्भयम् //
text_mt: In the asterisms of Jala, Mitra, Aryaman, Ahi, and Indra, [Saturn] causes plenty; / in Mūla it causes rain of weapons; in the two asterisms of Ahirbudhnya there is danger.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇānilahtārdrābharaṇībhāgyameṣu ca /
caratrchaiścaro nṝṇāṃ subhikṣārogyasyakṛt //
meaning:
श्रवणानिलह्तार्द्राभरणीभाग्यमेषु च /
चरत्र्छैश्चरो नॄणां सुभिक्षारोग्यस्यकृत् //
text_mt: Moving in Śravaṇa, Anila, Ārdrā, Bharaṇī, and Bhāgya, / Saturn brings plenty, health, and comfort to men.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe caikaṃ gude dve ca trīṇi ke nayane dvayam /
hṛdaye pañca ṛkṣāṇi vāmahaste catuṣṭayam //
meaning:
मुखे चैकं गुदे द्वे च त्रीणि के नयने द्वयम् /
हृदये पञ्च ऋक्षाणि वामहस्ते चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: One [star] in the mouth, two in the anus, three in the head, two in the eyes, / five stars in the heart, four in the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapāde tathā trīṇi dakṣiṇe trīṇe bhāni ca /
catvāri dakṣiṇe haste janmabhādravijasthitiḥ //
meaning:
वामपादे तथा त्रीणि दक्षिणे त्रीणे भानि च /
चत्वारि दक्षिणे हस्ते जन्मभाद्रविजस्थितिः //
text_mt: likewise three in the left foot and three stars in the right, / and four in the right hand: such is the placement of the Sun's son (Saturn) from one's birth-star.

sanskrit_iast:
rogo lābhastathā hānirlābhaḥ saukhyaṃ ca bandhanam /
āyāsaḥ śreṣṭhayātrā ca dhanalābhaḥ kramātphalam //
meaning:
रोगो लाभस्तथा हानिर्लाभः सौख्यं च बन्धनम् /
आयासः श्रेष्ठयात्रा च धनलाभः क्रमात्फलम् //
text_mt: Disease, gain, then loss, gain, comfort, and imprisonment, / fatigue, an excellent journey, and gain of wealth are the results in order.

sanskrit_iast:
bahudhāravijastvetadvakragaḥ phalamīdṛśam /
karotyeva samaḥ sāmyaṃ śīghrageṣūtkramātphalam //
meaning:
बहुधारविजस्त्वेतद्वक्रगः फलमीदृशम् /
करोत्येव समः साम्यं शीघ्रगेषूत्क्रमात्फलम् //
text_mt: Saturn retrograding produces this diverse result indeed; / stationary, it produces equality; in direct rapid motion, the result is in reverse order.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇucakrotkṛttaśirāḥ haṅguḥ pūyūṣapānataḥ /
amṛtyutāṃ gatastatra kheṭastatra kheṭatve parikalpitaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुचक्रोत्कृत्तशिराः हङ्गुः पूयूषपानतः /
अमृत्युतां गतस्तत्र खेटस्तत्र खेटत्वे परिकल्पितः //
text_mt: Rāhu, whose head was severed by Viṣṇu's discus, having drunk the nectar, / attained immortality; therefore he is reckoned among the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṇadhāturarkendū tudateḥ sarvaparvaṇi /
vikṣepāvanatervaṅgādgāhurdūragatastayoḥ //
meaning:
वरणधातुरर्केन्दू तुदतेः सर्वपर्वणि /
विक्षेपावनतेर्वङ्गाद्गाहुर्दूरगतस्तयोः //
text_mt: At every conjunction and opposition, Rāhu afflicts the Sun and the Moon by obscuration; / because of deflection in latitude, Rāhu moves away from them.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsavṛddhyā grahaṇaṃ śodhayendravicandrayoḥ /
parveśāstu tathā satyadevā khyāditaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
षण्मासवृद्ध्या ग्रहणं शोधयेन्द्रविचन्द्रयोः /
पर्वेशास्तु तथा सत्यदेवा ख्यादितः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Calculate the eclipse of the Sun and the Moon through an increase of six months. / The lords of the eclipse-cycles (parvans), in order, beginning from Satyadeva,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmendrvindradhanādhīśavaruṇāgniyamāhvayoḥ /
paśusasyadvijātīnāṃ vṛddhirbrahme tu parvaṇi //
meaning:
ब्रह्मेन्द्र्विन्द्रधनाधीशवरुणाग्नियमाह्वयोः /
पशुसस्यद्विजातीनां वृद्धिर्ब्रह्मे तु पर्वणि //
text_mt: are named Brahmā, Moon, Indra, Kubera, Varuṇa, Agni, and Yama. / In the eclipse-cycle of Brahmā, there is increase of cattle, crops, and twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadeva phalaṃ saumye śleṣmapīḍā ca parvaṇi /
virodho bhūbhujāṃ duḥkhamaindre sasyavināśanam //
meaning:
तद्वदेव फलं सौम्ये श्लेष्मपीडा च पर्वणि /
विरोधो भूभुजां दुःखमैन्द्रे सस्यविनाशनम् //
text_mt: likewise in that of the Moon, but with affliction from phlegm; / in that of Indra, hostility among kings, sorrow, and destruction of crops;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanināṃ dhanahāniḥ syātkauberaṃ dhānyavardhanam /
nṛpāṇāmaśivaṃ kṣemamitareṣāṃ ca vāruṇe //
meaning:
धनिनां धनहानिः स्यात्कौबेरं धान्यवर्धनम् /
नृपाणामशिवं क्षेममितरेषां च वारुणे //
text_mt: in that of Kubera, loss of wealth to the wealthy, but increase of grain; / in that of Varuṇa, misfortune to kings, but welfare to others;

sanskrit_iast:
pravarṣaṇaṃ sasyavṛddhiḥ kṣemaṃ hautāśaparvaṇi /
anāvṛṣṭiḥ sasyahānirdurbhikṣaṃ yāmyaparvaṇi //
meaning:
प्रवर्षणं सस्यवृद्धिः क्षेमं हौताशपर्वणि /
अनावृष्टिः सस्यहानिर्दुर्भिक्षं याम्यपर्वणि //
text_mt: in the eclipse-cycle of Agni, abundant rain, growth of crops, and welfare; / in the cycle of Yama, drought, loss of crops, and famine.

sanskrit_iast:
velāhīne syahānirnṛpāṇāṃ dāruṇaṃ raṇam /
ativele puṣpahānirbhayaṃ sasyavināśanam //
meaning:
वेलाहीने स्यहानिर्नृपाणां दारुणं रणम् /
अतिवेले पुष्पहानिर्भयं सस्यविनाशनम् //
text_mt: When [an eclipse occurs] before its calculated time, there is loss of crops and a fierce battle of kings; / when beyond its calculated time, loss of flowers, fear, and destruction of crops.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminneva māse tu candrārkagrahaṇaṃ yadā /
virodho dharaṇīśānāmarthavṛṣṭivināśanam //
meaning:
एकस्मिन्नेव मासे तु चन्द्रार्कग्रहणं यदा /
विरोधो धरणीशानामर्थवृष्टिविनाशनम् //
text_mt: When an eclipse of both the Moon and the Sun occurs in a single month, / there is hostility among the lords of the earth, and destruction of wealth and rainfall.

sanskrit_iast:
grastoditāvastamitau nṛpadhānyavināśadau /
sarvagrastāvinendūtu kṣudvyādhyagnibhayapradau //
meaning:
ग्रस्तोदितावस्तमितौ नृपधान्यविनाशदौ /
सर्वग्रस्ताविनेन्दूतु क्षुद्व्याध्यग्निभयप्रदौ //
text_mt: [Eclipses] rising or setting while eclipsed cause the destruction of kings and grain; / the sun and moon, when totally eclipsed, bring fear of hunger, disease, and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāyane kṣatraviprānitarāṃhanti dakṣiṇe /
dvijātīṃścakramāddhanti rāhudṛṣṭoragāditaḥ //
meaning:
सौम्यायने क्षत्रविप्रानितरांहन्ति दक्षिणे /
द्विजातींश्चक्रमाद्धन्ति राहुदृष्टोरगादितः //
text_mt: In the northern course [an eclipse] destroys Kṣatriyas and Brāhmaṇas; in the southern, the others; / seen by Rāhu, it destroys the twice-born classes in succession, beginning from Uraga (Āśleṣā).

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva grāmabhedāḥ syurmokṣabhe dāstathā daśa /
no śaktā lakṣituṃ devāḥ kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtā janāḥ //
meaning:
तथैव ग्रामभेदाः स्युर्मोक्षभे दास्तथा दश /
नो शक्ता लक्षितुं देवाः किं पुनः प्राकृता जनाः //
text_mt: So too, there are varieties of obscuration and ten varieties of release; / even the gods are unable to discern them, how much less ordinary people!

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya kheṭāngaṇitāṃsteṣāṃ vāraṃ vicintayet /
śubhāśubhānyaiḥ kālasya grāhayāmo hi lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
आनीय खेटान्गणितांस्तेषां वारं विचिन्तयेत् /
शुभाशुभान्यैः कालस्य ग्राहयामो हि लक्षणम् //
text_mt: Having calculated the planets mathematically, one should consider their weekday; / for through other [factors] of time, auspicious and inauspicious, we make its characteristics known.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanveṣaṇīyaṃ tatkālajñānāya dhīmatā /
utpātarūpāḥ ketūnāmudayāstamayā nṛṇām //
meaning:
तस्मादन्वेषणीयं तत्कालज्ञानाय धीमता /
उत्पातरूपाः केतूनामुदयास्तमया नृणाम् //
text_mt: Therefore that must be investigated by a wise man to know the time; / the risings and settings of comets are portents for men.

sanskrit_iast:
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāste śubhāśubhaphalapradāḥ /
yajñadhvajāstrabhavanarakṣavṛddhiṅgajopamāḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षा भौमास्ते शुभाशुभफलप्रदाः /
यज्ञध्वजास्त्रभवनरक्षवृद्धिङ्गजोपमाः //
text_mt: They are celestial, atmospheric, and terrestrial, bestowing auspicious and inauspicious results, / resembling sacrificial flags, weapons, houses, trees, or elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhaśūlāṅkuśākārā āntarikṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
nakṣatrasaṃsthitā divyā bhaumā ye bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
स्तम्भशूलाङ्कुशाकारा आन्तरिक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
नक्षत्रसंस्थिता दिव्या भौमा ये भूमिसंस्थिताः //
text_mt: Those shaped like pillars, tridents, and elephant goads are declared to be atmospheric; / celestial comets are located among the lunar mansions; terrestrial comets are those located on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
eko 'pi bhinnarūpaḥ syājjanturnāma śubhāya vai /
yāvanto divasānketurdṛśyate vividhātmakaḥ //
meaning:
एको ऽपि भिन्नरूपः स्याज्जन्तुर्नाम शुभाय वै /
यावन्तो दिवसान्केतुर्दृश्यते विविधात्मकः //
text_mt: Even a single creature possessing diverse forms indeed yields an auspicious result. / For however many days a comet of diverse forms is visible,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanmāsaiḥ phalaṃ yacchatyaṣṭau sāravyavatsaraiḥ /
ye divyāḥ ketavaste 'pi śaśvajjīvaphalapradāḥ //
meaning:
तावन्मासैः फलं यच्छत्यष्टौ सारव्यवत्सरैः /
ये दिव्याः केतवस्ते ऽपि शश्वज्जीवफलप्रदाः //
text_mt: it grants its fruit over that many months; over eight years it [bestows] lasting stability. / The celestial comets also continuously bestow long life as their fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvaḥ snigdhaḥ suprasannaḥ śvetaketuḥ suvṛṣṭikṛt /
kṣiprādastamayaṃ yāti dīrghaketu ravṛṣṭikṛt //
meaning:
ह्रस्वः स्निग्धः सुप्रसन्नः श्वेतकेतुः सुवृष्टिकृत् /
क्षिप्रादस्तमयं याति दीर्घकेतु रवृष्टिकृत् //
text_mt: Short, glossy, and very clear, Śvetaketu brings abundant rain. / It quickly sets; Dīrghaketu brings drought.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭado dhūmaketuḥ śakracāpasamaprabhaḥ /
dvitricatuḥśūlarūpaḥ sa ca rājyāntakṛnmataḥ //
meaning:
अनिष्टदो धूमकेतुः शक्रचापसमप्रभः /
द्वित्रिचतुःशूलरूपः स च राज्यान्तकृन्मतः //
text_mt: Dhūmaketu, having a brilliance like Indra's rainbow, brings misfortune; / shaped with two, three, or four prongs, it is considered to bring an end to kingdoms.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇihārastuvarṇābhā dīptimanto 'rkasūnavaḥ /
ketavaścoditāḥ pūrvāparayornṛpahānidāḥ //
meaning:
मणिहारस्तुवर्णाभा दीप्तिमन्तो ऽर्कसूनवः /
केतवश्चोदिताः पूर्वापरयोर्नृपहानिदाः //
text_mt: Having the color and lustre of a pearl necklace, radiant comets born of the sun / that arise in the east or west bestow the destruction of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃsukabiṃbakṣitijacchukatuṇḍādisannibhāḥ /
hutāśanoditāste 'pi ketavaḥ phaladāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
वंसुकबिंबक्षितिजच्छुकतुण्डादिसन्निभाः /
हुताशनोदितास्ते ऽपि केतवः फलदाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Resembling a bamboo tube, a bimba fruit, the earth, a parrot's beak, and the like, / comets born of fire are traditionally held to bear fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūsutā jalatailābhā vartulāḥ kṣudbhayapradāḥ /
subhikṣakṣemadāḥ śvetaketavaḥ somasūnavaḥ //
meaning:
भूसुता जलतैलाभा वर्तुलाः क्षुद्भयप्रदाः /
सुभिक्षक्षेमदाः श्वेतकेतवः सोमसूनवः //
text_mt: Comets born of the son of the earth (Mars) have the lustre of water or oil, are round, and cause fear of famine. / White comets born of the son of the moon (Mercury) grant abundant food and security.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahātmajaḥ ketustrivarṇastridaśānvitaḥ /
brahmadaṇḍāddhūmaketuḥ prajānāmantakṛnmataḥ //
meaning:
पितामहात्मजः केतुस्त्रिवर्णस्त्रिदशान्वितः /
ब्रह्मदण्डाद्धूमकेतुः प्रजानामन्तकृन्मतः //
text_mt: The comet born of the Grandsire (Brahmā) is three-colored and attended by the gods; / a Dhūmaketu arising from Brahmā's staff is considered to bring the destruction of subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ bhārgavasutāḥ śvetarūpāstvaniṣṭadāḥ /
aniṣṭadāḥ paṅgusutā viśikhāḥ kamakāhvayāḥ //
meaning:
ऐशान्यां भार्गवसुताः श्वेतरूपास्त्वनिष्टदाः /
अनिष्टदाः पङ्गुसुता विशिखाः कमकाह्वयाः //
text_mt: In the northeast, comets born of Venus are white in form, yet bring misfortune. / The sons of Saturn, tailless and named Kamaka, bring misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
vikacākhyā gurusutā veṣṭā yāmye sthitā api /
sūkṣmāḥ śuklā budhasutāścaurarogabhayapradāḥ //
meaning:
विकचाख्या गुरुसुता वेष्टा याम्ये स्थिता अपि /
सूक्ष्माः शुक्ला बुधसुताश्चौररोगभयप्रदाः //
text_mt: The sons of Jupiter named Vikaca, surrounded [by light], even though situated in the south, / and the sons of Mercury, subtle and white, cause fear of thieves and disease.

sanskrit_iast:
kujātmajāḥ kuṅkumākhyā raktāḥ śūlāstvaniṣṭadāḥ /
agnijā viśvarūpākhyā agnivarṇāḥ sukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
कुजात्मजाः कुङ्कुमाख्या रक्ताः शूलास्त्वनिष्टदाः /
अग्निजा विश्वरूपाख्या अग्निवर्णाः सुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: The sons of Mars named Kuṅkuma are red, trident-like, and bring misfortune. / Born of fire, named Viśvarūpa, fire-colored, they bestow happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇāḥ śyāmalākārā arkaputrāśca pāpadāḥ /
śukrajā ṛkṣasadṛśāḥ ke tavaḥ śubhadāyakāḥ //
meaning:
अरुणाः श्यामलाकारा अर्कपुत्राश्च पापदाः /
शुक्रजा ऋक्षसदृशाः के तवः शुभदायकाः //
text_mt: Reddish and darkish in form, comets born of the sun bestow sin (misfortune). / Resembling constellations, comets born of Venus are givers of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikāsu bhavo dhūmaketurnūnaṃ prajākṣayaḥ /
prāsādavṛkṣaśaileṣu jāto rājñāṃ vināśakṛt //
meaning:
कृत्तिकासु भवो धूमकेतुर्नूनं प्रजाक्षयः /
प्रासादवृक्षशैलेषु जातो राज्ञां विनाशकृत् //
text_mt: A Dhūmaketu appearing in the Kṛttikās certainly destroys subjects; / appearing upon palaces, trees, or mountains, it brings destruction to kings.

sanskrit_iast:
subhikṣakṛtkaumudākhyaḥ ketuḥ kumudasannibhaḥ /
āvartaketusaṃdhyāyāṃ śaśiro neṣṭadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
सुभिक्षकृत्कौमुदाख्यः केतुः कुमुदसन्निभः /
आवर्तकेतुसंध्यायां शशिरो नेष्टदायकः //
text_mt: The comet named Kaumuda, resembling a white water-lily, brings abundant food; / a revolving comet (Āvartaketu) at twilight is cool and does not bestow agreeable results.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadevamanormāna pitryaṃ sauraṃ ca sāvanam /
cāndramārkṣaṃ gurormānamiti mānāni vai navaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मदेवमनोर्मान पित्र्यं सौरं च सावनम् /
चान्द्रमार्क्षं गुरोर्मानमिति मानानि वै नवः //
text_mt: The measures of time are: of Brahmā, of the gods, of Manu, / of the ancestors, of the sun, civil, / of the moon, of the stars, and of Jupiter; thus indeed there are nine measures.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ navamānānāṃ vyavahāro 'tra pañcabhiḥ /
teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthakkāryaṃ vakṣyate vyavahārataḥ //
meaning:
एतेषां नवमानानां व्यवहारो ऽत्र पञ्चभिः /
तेषां पृथक्पृथक्कार्यं वक्ष्यते व्यवहारतः //
text_mt: Of these nine measures, worldly practice here uses five; / their distinct functions will be explained in accordance with practice.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāṇāṃ nikhilaścāro gṛhyate saura mānataḥ /
vṛṣṭervidhānaṃ strīgarbhaḥ sāvanenaiva gṛhyate //
meaning:
ग्रहाणां निखिलश्चारो गृह्यते सौर मानतः /
वृष्टेर्विधानं स्त्रीगर्भः सावनेनैव गृह्यते //
text_mt: The entire course of the planets is apprehended by the solar measure; / the regulation of rainfall and the gestation of women are apprehended by the civil [measure] alone.

sanskrit_iast:
pravarṣaṇāṃ same garbhauṃ nākṣatreṇa pragṛhyate /
yātrodvāhavratakṣaure tithivarṣeśanirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रवर्षणां समे गर्भौं नाक्षत्रेण प्रगृह्यते /
यात्रोद्वाहव्रतक्षौरे तिथिवर्षेशनिर्णयः //
text_mt: The gestation of clouds for rains is correctly apprehended by the sidereal measure; / in journeys, marriage, vows, tonsure, and the determination of lunar days and the lord of the year,

sanskrit_iast:
parvavāstūpavāsādi kṛtsnaṃ cāndreṇa gṛhyate /
gṛhyate gurumānena prabhavādyabdalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
पर्ववास्तूपवासादि कृत्स्नं चान्द्रेण गृह्यते /
गृह्यते गुरुमानेन प्रभवाद्यब्दलक्षणम् //
text_mt: the joints of the month, site-worship, fasting, and so forth are entirely apprehended by the lunar [measure]. / By Jupiter's measure are apprehended the characteristics of the years beginning with Prabhava.

sanskrit_iast:
tattanmāsairdvādaśabhistattadaṣṭau bhavettataḥ /
gurumadhyamacāreṇaṣaṣṭyabdāḥ prabhāvādayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्तन्मासैर्द्वादशभिस्तत्तदष्टौ भवेत्ततः /
गुरुमध्यमचारेणषष्ट्यब्दाः प्रभावादयः //
text_mt: By those respective twelve months, there are eight of those [measures] thereafter; / by the mean motion of Jupiter, the sixty years beginning with Prabhava [are determined]:

sanskrit_iast:
prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodo 'tha prajāpatiḥ /
aṅgirāḥ śrīmukho bhāvo yuvā dhātā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
प्रभवो विभवः शुक्लः प्रमोदो ऽथ प्रजापतिः /
अङ्गिराः श्रीमुखो भावो युवा धाता तथैव च //
text_mt: Prabhava, Vibhava, Śukla, Pramoda, then Prajāpati, / Aṅgiras, Śrīmukha, Bhāva, Yuvan, and likewise Dhātṛ,

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaro bahudhānyaśca pramāthī vikramo vṛṣaḥ /
citrabhānuḥsubhānuśca tāraṇaḥ pārthivo 'vyayaḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वरो बहुधान्यश्च प्रमाथी विक्रमो वृषः /
चित्रभानुःसुभानुश्च तारणः पार्थिवो ऽव्ययः //
text_mt: Īśvara, Bahudhānya, Pramāthin, Vikrama, Vṛṣa, / Citrabhānu, Subhānu, Tāraṇa, Pārthiva, Avyaya,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajitsarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtaḥ kharaḥ /
nandano vijayaścaiva jayo manmathadurmukhau //
meaning:
सर्वजित्सर्वधारी च विरोधी विकृतः खरः /
नन्दनो विजयश्चैव जयो मन्मथदुर्मुखौ //
text_mt: Sarvajit, Sarvadhārin, Virodhin, Vikṛta, Khara, / Nandana, Vijaya, Jaya, Manmatha, and Durmukha,

sanskrit_iast:
