hemalaṃbo vilaṃbaśca vikārī śārvarī lavaḥ /
śubhakṛcchobhanaḥ krodhī viśvāvasuparābhavau //
meaning:
हेमलंबो विलंबश्च विकारी शार्वरी लवः /
शुभकृच्छोभनः क्रोधी विश्वावसुपराभवौ //
text_mt: Hemalamba, Vilamba, Vikārin, Śārvarī, Lava, / Śubhakṛt, Śobhana, Krodhin, Viśvāvasu, Parābhava,

sanskrit_iast:
plavaṅgaḥ kīlakaḥ saumyaḥ sāmāptaśca virodhakṛt /
paribhāvī pramādī ca ānando rākṣaso 'nalaḥ //
meaning:
प्लवङ्गः कीलकः सौम्यः सामाप्तश्च विरोधकृत् /
परिभावी प्रमादी च आनन्दो राक्षसो ऽनलः //
text_mt: Plavaṅga, Kīlaka, Saumya, Sādhāraṇa, Virodhakṛt, / Paribhāvin, Pramādin, Ānanda, Rākṣasa, Anala,

sanskrit_iast:
piṅgalaḥ kālayuktaśca siddhārtho raudradurmatīḥ /
dundubhīrudhirodgarī raktākṣaḥ krodhanaḥ kṣayaḥ //
meaning:
पिङ्गलः कालयुक्तश्च सिद्धार्थो रौद्रदुर्मतीः /
दुन्दुभीरुधिरोद्गरी रक्ताक्षः क्रोधनः क्षयः //
text_mt: Piṅgala, Kālayukta, Siddhārtha, Raudra, Durmati, / Dundubhi, Rudhirodgārin, Raktākṣa, Krodhana, and Kṣaya.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmatulyaphalāḥ sarve vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭivatsarāḥ /
yugaṃ syātpañcabhirvarṣairyugānyevaṃ tu dvādaśa //
meaning:
नामतुल्यफलाः सर्वे विज्ञेयाः षष्टिवत्सराः /
युगं स्यात्पञ्चभिर्वर्षैर्युगान्येवं तु द्वादश //
text_mt: All the sixty years are to be understood as bearing fruits corresponding to their names. / A yuga consists of five years, and thus there are twelve yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmīśāḥ kramājjñeyā viṣṇurdevapurohitaḥ /
purandaro lohitaśca tvaṣṭāhirbudhnyasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
तेषामीशाः क्रमाज्ज्ञेया विष्णुर्देवपुरोहितः /
पुरन्दरो लोहितश्च त्वष्टाहिर्बुध्न्यसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: Their lords should be known in order: Viṣṇu, the priest of the gods (Bṛhaspati), / Purandara (Indra), Lohita (Agni), Tvaṣṭṛ, he named Ahirbudhnya,

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraśca tato viśve śaśīndrādgnayaśino bhagaḥ /
tathā yugasya varṣe śāstvagninenduvidhīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
पितरश्च ततो विश्वे शशीन्द्राद्ग्नयशिनो भगः /
तथा युगस्य वर्षे शास्त्वग्निनेन्दुविधीश्वराः //
text_mt: and then the ancestors, the Viśvedevas, the Moon, Indra, Agni, and Bhaga. / Likewise, the regents of the years of a yuga are Agni, the Sun, the Moon, Brahmā, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
athādveśacamūnāthasasyapānāṃ balābalam /
tatkālaṃ grahacāraṃ ca samyak jñātvā phalaṃ padet //
meaning:
अथाद्वेशचमूनाथसस्यपानां बलाबलम् /
तत्कालं ग्रहचारं च सम्यक् ज्ञात्वा फलं पदेत् //
text_mt: Now, having fully understood the strength and weakness of the lord of the year, commander-in-chief, and lords of crops, / and the planetary movements of that time, one should declare the results.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyā yanaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ mṛgādyaṃ bhānubhuktitaḥ /
ahaḥ surāṇāṃ tadrātriḥ karkādyaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam //
meaning:
सौम्या यनं मासषट्कं मृगाद्यं भानुभुक्तितः /
अहः सुराणां तद्रात्रिः कर्काद्यं दक्षिणायनम् //
text_mt: The six months beginning with Capricorn, through the sun's passage, is the northern course (Uttarāyaṇa), / the day of the gods; the southern course (Dakṣiṇāyana) begins with Cancer, their night.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhapraveśavaivāhapratiṣṭāmaiñjibandhanam /
madhādau maṅgalaṃ karma vidheyaṃ cottarāyaṇe //
meaning:
गृहप्रवेशवैवाहप्रतिष्टामैञ्जिबन्धनम् /
मधादौ मङ्गलं कर्म विधेयं चोत्तरायणे //
text_mt: Entering a new house, marriage, installation of deities, and tying of the munja grass girdle (Upanayana), / and auspicious rites in Madhu and the rest should be performed in the northern course.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyāyane garhitaṃ ca karma yatnātpraśasyate /
mādhādi māsau dvau dvau ca ṛtavaḥ śiśirādayaḥ //
meaning:
याम्यायने गर्हितं च कर्म यत्नात्प्रशस्यते /
माधादि मासौ द्वौ द्वौ च ऋतवः शिशिरादयः //
text_mt: Work that is [otherwise] censured in the southern course is carefully commended [then]. / The two-month pairs beginning with Māgha are the seasons, winter and the rest:

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgācchiśiravasaṃtaśca grīṣmāḥ syuścottarāyaṇe /
varṣā śaraśca hemantaḥ karkādvai dakṣiṇāyane //
meaning:
मृगाच्छिशिरवसंतश्च ग्रीष्माः स्युश्चोत्तरायणे /
वर्षा शरश्च हेमन्तः कर्काद्वै दक्षिणायने //
text_mt: From Capricorn [are] winter, spring, and summer in the northern course; / the rainy season, autumn, and dewy season are from Cancer in the southern course.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndro darśīvadhiḥ sauraḥ saṃkrātyā sāvano dineḥ /
triṃśadbhiścandrabhagaṇo māso nākṣatrasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
चान्द्रो दर्शीवधिः सौरः संक्रात्या सावनो दिनेः /
त्रिंशद्भिश्चन्द्रभगणो मासो नाक्षत्रसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: The lunar month has the new moon as its limit; the solar month is by solar transit; the civil month is thirty days; / a sidereal month is a revolution of the moon [through the lunar mansions].

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśca mādhavaḥ śukraḥ śuciścātha nabhastataḥ /
nabhasya iṣa ūrjaśca sahāścaiva sahasyakaḥ //
meaning:
मधुश्च माधवः शुक्रः शुचिश्चाथ नभस्ततः /
नभस्य इष ऊर्जश्च सहाश्चैव सहस्यकः //
text_mt: Madhu, Mādhava, Śukra, Śuci, and then Nabhas, / Nabhasya, Iṣa, Ūrja, Sahas, and Sahasya,

sanskrit_iast:
tapāstapasya kramaśaścaitrādīnāṃ samāhvayā /
yasminmāse paurṇamāsī yena dhiṣṇena saṃyutā //
meaning:
तपास्तपस्य क्रमशश्चैत्रादीनां समाह्वया /
यस्मिन्मासे पौर्णमासी येन धिष्णेन संयुता //
text_mt: Tapas, and Tapasya are, in order, the names of Caitra and the rest. / In whatever month the full moon is joined with a particular lunar mansion,

sanskrit_iast:
tannakṣatrāhvayo māsaḥ paurṇamāsī tadāhvayā /
tatpakṣau daiva pitrākhyau śuklakṛṣṇau tathāpare //
meaning:
तन्नक्षत्राह्वयो मासः पौर्णमासी तदाह्वया /
तत्पक्षौ दैव पित्राख्यौ शुक्लकृष्णौ तथापरे //
text_mt: the month is named after that lunar mansion, and the full moon bears that name. / The two fortnights are called divine and ancestral, bright and dark; likewise the other [phases],

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśubhe karmaṇi ca praśastau bhavataḥ sadā /
kramāttithīnāṃ brahmāgnī viriñciviṣṇuśailajāḥ //
meaning:
शुभाशुभे कर्मणि च प्रशस्तौ भवतः सदा /
क्रमात्तिथीनां ब्रह्माग्नी विरिञ्चिविष्णुशैलजाः //
text_mt: are always commended for auspicious and inauspicious rites. / In order, [the deities] of the lunar days are Brahmā, Agni, Viriñci, Viṣṇu, the Mountain-born goddess (Pārvatī),

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakayamau nāgacandrau skandor'kavāsavau /
mahendravāsavau nāgadurgādaṇḍadharāhvayaḥ //
meaning:
विनायकयमौ नागचन्द्रौ स्कन्दोर्ऽकवासवौ /
महेन्द्रवासवौ नागदुर्गादण्डधराह्वयः //
text_mt: Vināyaka, Yama, the Serpents, the Moon, Skanda, the Sun, the Vasus, / Mahendra, Indra, the Serpents, Durgā, and the Rod-bearer (Yama),

sanskrit_iast:
śivaviṣṇūhariravīkāmaḥ sarvaḥ kalītataḥ /
candraviśvedarśasaṃjñatithīśāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
शिवविष्णूहरिरवीकामः सर्वः कलीततः /
चन्द्रविश्वेदर्शसंज्ञतिथीशाः पितरः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Śiva, Viṣṇu, Hari, the Sun, Kāma, Śiva, then Kali; / the Moon, the Viśvedevas, and the ancestors are considered the lords of the new moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
nandābhadrājayāriktā pūrṇāḥ syutithayaḥ punaḥ /
trirāvṛttyā kramājjñeyā neṣṭamadhyeṣṭadāḥ site //
meaning:
नन्दाभद्राजयारिक्ता पूर्णाः स्युतिथयः पुनः /
त्रिरावृत्त्या क्रमाज्ज्ञेया नेष्टमध्येष्टदाः सिते //
text_mt: Again, the lunar days are Nandā, Bhadrā, Jayā, Riktā, / and Pūrṇā in succession, repeated thrice; in the bright fortnight they grant unwelcome, middling, and welcome fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe tviṣṭamadhyāniṣṭadāḥ kramaśastadā /
aṣṭamī dvādaśī ṣaṣṭī caturthī ca caturdaśī //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे त्विष्टमध्यानिष्टदाः क्रमशस्तदा /
अष्टमी द्वादशी षष्टी चतुर्थी च चतुर्दशी //
text_mt: In the dark fortnight, however, they grant welcome, middling, and unwelcome fruits in order. / The eighth, twelfth, sixth, fourth, and fourteenth

sanskrit_iast:
tithayaḥ pakṣarandhrākhyā hyatirūkṣā prakīrtitāḥ /
samudramanurandhrāṅkatattvasaṃkhyāstu nāḍikāḥ //
meaning:
तिथयः पक्षरन्ध्राख्या ह्यतिरूक्षा प्रकीर्तिताः /
समुद्रमनुरन्ध्राङ्कतत्त्वसंख्यास्तु नाडिकाः //
text_mt: lunar days are known as the vulnerable days (Pakṣarandhras) and are proclaimed to be extremely harsh. / The [last] nāḍikās numbering four, fourteen, nine, and twenty-five,

sanskrit_iast:
tyājyāḥ syustāsu tithiṣu kramātpañca ca sarvadā /
amāvāsyā ca navamī hitvā viṣamasaṃjñikā //
meaning:
त्याज्याः स्युस्तासु तिथिषु क्रमात्पञ्च च सर्वदा /
अमावास्या च नवमी हित्वा विषमसंज्ञिका //
text_mt: five in number, are always to be avoided in those lunar days in order. / Except for the new moon day and the ninth, the odd-numbered lunar days

sanskrit_iast:
tithayastupraśastāsyurmadhyamā pratipatsitā /
ṣaṣaaṭyāṃ tailaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ māsaṃ kṣauraṃ kalestithau //
meaning:
तिथयस्तुप्रशस्तास्युर्मध्यमा प्रतिपत्सिता /
षषअट्यां तैलं तथाष्टम्यां मासं क्षौरं कलेस्तिथौ //
text_mt: are highly auspicious, while the first day of the bright fortnight is middling. / On the sixth day [one should avoid] oil; likewise on the eighth, meat; and shaving on the fourteenth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇimādarśayornārīsevanaṃ parivarjayet /
derśe ṣaṣṭyāṃ pratipadi dvādaśyāṃ pratiparvasu //
meaning:
पूर्णिमादर्शयोर्नारीसेवनं परिवर्जयेत् /
देर्शे षष्ट्यां प्रतिपदि द्वादश्यां प्रतिपर्वसु //
text_mt: One should avoid union with a woman on the full moon and new moon days, / on the new moon, sixth, first, twelfth, and each parvan day.

sanskrit_iast:
navamyāṃ ca na kurvīta kadāciddantadhāvanam /
vyatīpāte ca saṃkrāntāvekādaśyāṃ ca parvasu //
meaning:
नवम्यां च न कुर्वीत कदाचिद्दन्तधावनम् /
व्यतीपाते च संक्रान्तावेकादश्यां च पर्वसु //
text_mt: And on the ninth, one should never brush one's teeth; / [likewise] at Vyatīpāta, at a Saṃkrānti, on the eleventh, and on parvan days.

sanskrit_iast:
arkabhaumadine ṣaṣṭyāṃ nābhyaṅgo vaidhṛtau tathā /
yaḥ karoti daśamyāṃ ca snānamāmalakairnaraḥ //
meaning:
अर्कभौमदिने षष्ट्यां नाभ्यङ्गो वैधृतौ तथा /
यः करोति दशम्यां च स्नानमामलकैर्नरः //
text_mt: On Sunday and Tuesday, on the sixth, and at Vaidhṛti there should be no oil massage. / A man who bathes with āmalaka on the tenth

sanskrit_iast:
putrahānirbhavettasya traṃyodaśyāṃ dhanakṣayaḥ /
arthaputrakṣayastasya dvitīyāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रहानिर्भवेत्तस्य त्रंयोदश्यां धनक्षयः /
अर्थपुत्रक्षयस्तस्य द्वितीयायां न संशयः //
text_mt: incurs the loss of his son; on the thirteenth, the loss of wealth; / on the second, he undoubtedly suffers the loss of wealth and son;

sanskrit_iast:
amāyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca saptamyāṃ ca kulakṣayaḥ /
yā paurṇimā divā candramatī sānumatī smṛtā //
meaning:
अमायां च नवम्यां च सप्तम्यां च कुलक्षयः /
या पौर्णिमा दिवा चन्द्रमती सानुमती स्मृता //
text_mt: on the new moon, on the ninth, and on the seventh, ruin of the lineage [occurs]. / That full moon day which has the moon during the day is called Anumati;

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau candravatī rākāpyamāvāsyā tathā dvidhā /
sinīvālī cendumatī kuhūrnendumatī matā //
meaning:
रात्रौ चन्द्रवती राकाप्यमावास्या तथा द्विधा /
सिनीवाली चेन्दुमती कुहूर्नेन्दुमती मता //
text_mt: that which has the moon at night is Rākā. The new moon day is likewise twofold: / Sinīvālī is considered to have the moon, and Kuhū is considered to have no moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklanavamī tvādiḥ kṛtayugasya ca /
tretādirmādhave śukle tṛtīyā puṇyasaṃjñitā //
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लनवमी त्वादिः कृतयुगस्य च /
त्रेतादिर्माधवे शुक्ले तृतीया पुण्यसंज्ञिता //
text_mt: The bright ninth of Kārtika is the beginning of the Kṛtayuga; / the beginning of Tretā is the bright third in Mādhava (Vaiśākha), called auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇā pañcadaśī māghe dvāparādimudīritā /
kalpādiḥ syātkṛṣṇapakṣe nabhastasya trayodaśī //
meaning:
कृष्णा पञ्चदशी माघे द्वापरादिमुदीरिता /
कल्पादिः स्यात्कृष्णपक्षे नभस्तस्य त्रयोदशी //
text_mt: the dark fifteenth in Māgha is said to be the beginning of Dvāpara; / the dark thirteenth of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa) is the beginning of the Kalpa;

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyūrje śuklapakṣe navamyaccheśvayujyapi /
caitre bhādrapade caiva tṛtīyā śuklasaṃjñitā //
meaning:
द्वादश्यूर्जे शुक्लपक्षे नवम्यच्छेश्वयुज्यपि /
चैत्रे भाद्रपदे चैव तृतीया शुक्लसंज्ञिता //
text_mt: the bright twelfth in Ūrja (Kārtika); the bright ninth in Āśvayuja; / the bright third in Caitra and in Bhādrapada;

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī sitā pauṣe hyāṣāḍherdeśamīsitā /
māghe ca saptamī śuklā nabhasye tvasitāṣṭamī //
meaning:
एकादशी सिता पौषे ह्याषाढेर्देशमीसिता /
माघे च सप्तमी शुक्ला नभस्ये त्वसिताष्टमी //
text_mt: the bright eleventh in Pauṣa; the bright tenth in Āṣāḍha; / the bright seventh in Māgha; and the dark eighth in Nabhasya (Bhādrapada);

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe māsyamāvāsyā phaālgune māsi paurṇimā /
āṣāḍhe kārtike māsi jyaṣṭe caitre ca paurṇimā //
meaning:
श्रावणे मास्यमावास्या फआल्गुने मासि पौर्णिमा /
आषाढे कार्तिके मासि ज्यष्टे चैत्रे च पौर्णिमा //
text_mt: the new moon day in the month of Śrāvaṇa; the full moon day in the month of Phālguna; / and the full moon days in the months of Āṣāḍha, Kārtika, Jyeṣṭha, and Caitra—

sanskrit_iast:
manvādayo mānavānāṃ śrāddheṣvatyantapuṇyadā /
bhādre kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ maghāminduḥ kare raviḥ //
meaning:
मन्वादयो मानवानां श्राद्धेष्वत्यन्तपुण्यदा /
भाद्रे कृष्णत्रयोदश्यां मघामिन्दुः करे रविः //
text_mt: these are the Manvādi days, which bestow immense merit upon men in ancestral rites (śrāddha). / When on the dark thirteenth of Bhādrapada the moon is in Maghā and the sun in Kara (Hasta),

sanskrit_iast:
gajacchāyā tadā jñeyā śrāddhe hyatyantapuṇyadā /
ekasminvāsare tisrastithayaḥ syāttithikṣayaḥ //
meaning:
गजच्छाया तदा ज्ञेया श्राद्धे ह्यत्यन्तपुण्यदा /
एकस्मिन्वासरे तिस्रस्तिथयः स्यात्तिथिक्षयः //
text_mt: that is known as Gajacchāyā, bestowing immense merit in ancestral rites. / When three lunar days occur in a single solar day, that is a day-loss (tithikṣaya);

sanskrit_iast:
tithirvāratraye tvekā hyadhikā dve ca nindite /
sūryāstamanaparyantaṃ yasminvāre tu yā tithiḥ //
meaning:
तिथिर्वारत्रये त्वेका ह्यधिका द्वे च निन्दिते /
सूर्यास्तमनपर्यन्तं यस्मिन्वारे तु या तिथिः //
text_mt: when one lunar day spans three solar days, it is intercalary (adhikā); both are condemned. / That lunar day which continues up to sunset on a given weekday

sanskrit_iast:
vidyate sā tvakhaṇḍā syānnyūnā cetkhañjasaṃjñitā /
titheḥ pañcadaśo bhāgaḥ kramātpratipadādayaḥ //
meaning:
विद्यते सा त्वखण्डा स्यान्न्यूना चेत्खञ्जसंज्ञिता /
तिथेः पञ्चदशो भागः क्रमात्प्रतिपदादयः //
text_mt: is unbroken (akhaṇḍā); if shorter, it is named lame (khañjā). / The fifteenth part of a lunar day, in order from the first, etc.,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇasaṃjñāstadarddhāni tāsāmarddhapramāṇataḥ /
raviḥ sthiraścaraścandraḥ krūro vakrokhilo budhaḥ //
meaning:
क्षणसंज्ञास्तदर्द्धानि तासामर्द्धप्रमाणतः /
रविः स्थिरश्चरश्चन्द्रः क्रूरो वक्रोखिलो बुधः //
text_mt: are called kṣaṇas; their halves are measured by half of them. / The Sun is fixed; the Moon is movable; Mars is cruel; Mercury is completely retrograde;

sanskrit_iast:
laghurījyo mṛduḥ śukrastrīkṣṇo dinakarātmajaḥ /
abhyakto bhānuvāre yaḥ sa naraḥ kleśavānbhavet //
meaning:
लघुरीज्यो मृदुः शुक्रस्त्रीक्ष्णो दिनकरात्मजः /
अभ्यक्तो भानुवारे यः स नरः क्लेशवान्भवेत् //
text_mt: Jupiter is light; Venus is gentle; the son of the Sun (Saturn) is sharp. / A man who is anointed with oil on Sunday will suffer distress;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣeśe kāntibhāgbhaume vyādhi saubhāgyaminduje /
jīve naivaṃ site hānirmande sarvasamṛddhayaḥ //
meaning:
ऋक्षेशे कान्तिभाग्भौमे व्याधि सौभाग्यमिन्दुजे /
जीवे नैवं सिते हानिर्मन्दे सर्वसमृद्धयः //
text_mt: on [the day of] the lord of stars (Monday), he attains radiance; on Tuesday, sickness; on the day of the Moon's son (Wednesday), good fortune; / on Jupiter's day, not so; on Venus's day, loss; on Saturn's day, all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
laṅkodayātsyādvārādista smādūrdhvamadho 'pivā /
deśāntarasvacarārddhanāḍībhirapare bhavet //
meaning:
लङ्कोदयात्स्याद्वारादिस्त स्मादूर्ध्वमधो ऽपिवा /
देशान्तरस्वचरार्द्धनाडीभिरपरे भवेत् //
text_mt: The beginning of the weekday is from sunrise at Laṅkā; above that or below it, / in other places it occurs by the nāḍīs of the half-difference of local time and ascensional difference.

sanskrit_iast:
balapradasya kheṭasya karma siddhyati yatkṛtam /
tatkarma balahīnasya duḥkhenāpi na siddhyāti //
meaning:
बलप्रदस्य खेटस्य कर्म सिद्ध्यति यत्कृतम् /
तत्कर्म बलहीनस्य दुःखेनापि न सिद्ध्याति //
text_mt: A deed performed for a planet that bestows strength succeeds; / that deed performed for one devoid of strength does not succeed even with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
indujñajīvaśukrāṇāṃ vāsarāḥ sarvakarmasu /
phaladāstvitare krūre karmasvabhimatapradāḥ //
meaning:
इन्दुज्ञजीवशुक्राणां वासराः सर्वकर्मसु /
फलदास्त्वितरे क्रूरे कर्मस्वभिमतप्रदाः //
text_mt: The days of the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus bear fruit in all activities; / the others bestow the desired result in cruel deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
raktavarṇauṃ raviścandrau gauro bhaumastulohitaḥ /
dūrvāvarṇo vudho jīvaḥ pītaśvetastu bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
रक्तवर्णौं रविश्चन्द्रौ गौरो भौमस्तुलोहितः /
दूर्वावर्णो वुधो जीवः पीतश्वेतस्तु भार्गवः //
text_mt: The Sun is red-colored; the Moon is white; Mars is reddish; / Mercury is of the color of dūrvā grass; Jupiter is yellow; Venus is white;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaḥ sauriḥ svavāreṣu svasvavarṇakriyā hitāḥ /
adrivāṇāśca yastarkapātālavasudhādharāḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णः सौरिः स्ववारेषु स्वस्ववर्णक्रिया हिताः /
अद्रिवाणाश्च यस्तर्कपातालवसुधाधराः //
text_mt: Saturn is black. On their respective weekdays, deeds appropriate to their respective colors are beneficial. / [The numbers] 7, 5, 6, 7, 1;

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇāgnilocanānihyavedabāhuśilīmukhāḥ /
tryekāhayo netragotrarāmāśvadrarasartavaḥ //
meaning:
बाणाग्निलोचनानिह्यवेदबाहुशिलीमुखाः /
त्र्येकाहयो नेत्रगोत्ररामाश्वद्ररसर्तवः //

sanskrit_iast:
kulikāścopakulikā vāravelā stathā kramāt /
praharārddhapramāṇāste vijñeyāḥ sūryavāsarāt //
meaning:
कुलिकाश्चोपकुलिका वारवेला स्तथा क्रमात् /
प्रहरार्द्धप्रमाणास्ते विज्ञेयाः सूर्यवासरात् //
text_mt: these are the Kulikas, Upakulikas, and Vāravelās, in order, / whose measures are half a prahara, to be known from Sunday onward.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminvāre kṣaṇo vāradṛṣṭastadvāsarādhipaḥ /
ādyaḥ ṣaṣṭo dvitīyo 'smattatṣaṣṭhastutṛtīyakaḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिन्वारे क्षणो वारदृष्टस्तद्वासराधिपः /
आद्यः षष्टो द्वितीयो ऽस्मत्तत्षष्ठस्तुतृतीयकः //
text_mt: On whichever weekday a kṣaṇa is observed, the lord of that weekday / is the first; the sixth [from it] is the second; the sixth from that is the third;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭaścetareṣāṃ kālahorādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ /
sārddhanāḍīdvayenaiva divā rātrau yathākramāt //
meaning:
षष्टः षष्टश्चेतरेषां कालहोराधिपाः स्मृताः /
सार्द्धनाडीद्वयेनैव दिवा रात्रौ यथाक्रमात् //
text_mt: the sixth and sixth of the others are remembered as the lords of the planetary hours (kālahorā), / by two and a half nāḍīs each, day and night in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
vāraprokte karmakārye tadgrahasya kṣaṇe 'pi san /
nakṣatreśāḥ kramāddasrayamavahnipitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
वारप्रोक्ते कर्मकार्ये तद्ग्रहस्य क्षणे ऽपि सन् /
नक्षत्रेशाः क्रमाद्दस्रयमवह्निपितामहाः //
text_mt: When a rite is prescribed for a weekday, it should be done in the kṣaṇa of that planet. / The presiding deities of the lunar mansions are, in order: the Dasras (Aśvins), Yama, Fire, Grandfather (Brahmā),

sanskrit_iast:
candreśāditijīvāhipitaro bhagasaṃjñakaḥ /
aryamārkatvaṣṭṛmarucchakrāgnimitravāsavaḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रेशादितिजीवाहिपितरो भगसंज्ञकः /
अर्यमार्कत्वष्टृमरुच्छक्राग्निमित्रवासवः //
text_mt: Moon, Lord (Śiva), Aditi, Jupiter, Serpents, Ancestors, Bhaga, / Aryaman, Sun, Tvaṣṭṛ, Wind, Indra-Agni, Mitra, Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyudakaviśvejagovindavasutoyapāḥ /
ajaikapādahirbudhnyā pūṣā ceti prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
नैरृत्युदकविश्वेजगोविन्दवसुतोयपाः /
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्या पूषा चेति प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Nirṛti, Waters, All-Gods, Govinda (Viṣṇu), Vasus, Lord of Waters (Varuṇa), / Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, and Pūṣan—thus they are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvātrayaṃ madhāhyagniviśākhāya mamūlabham /
adhomukhaṃ tu navakaṃ bhānau tatra vidhīyate //
meaning:
पूर्वात्रयं मधाह्यग्निविशाखाय ममूलभम् /
अधोमुखं तु नवकं भानौ तत्र विधीयते //
text_mt: The three Pūrvās, Maghā, Kṛttikā, Viśākhā, Bharaṇī, and Mūla: / this group of nine faces downward; when the sun is in them, there is prescribed:

sanskrit_iast:
bilapraveśagaṇitabhūtasādhanalekhanam /
śilpakarmakalākūpanikṣepoddharaṇādi yat //
meaning:
बिलप्रवेशगणितभूतसाधनलेखनम् /
शिल्पकर्मकलाकूपनिक्षेपोद्धरणादि यत् //
text_mt: entering a hole, calculation, practice concerning spirits, writing, / artisan craft, arts, digging wells, recovery of buried treasure, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
mitrendutvāṣṭrahastendrāditibhāntyāśvivāyubham /
tiryaṅmukhākhyaṃ navakaṃ bhānau tatra vidhīyate //
meaning:
मित्रेन्दुत्वाष्ट्रहस्तेन्द्रादितिभान्त्याश्विवायुभम् /
तिर्यङ्मुखाख्यं नवकं भानौ तत्र विधीयते //
text_mt: Anurādhā, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Citrā, Hasta, Jyeṣṭhā, Punarvasu, Revatī, Aśvinī, and Svātī: / this group of nine is called facing sideways; when the sun is in them, there is prescribed:

sanskrit_iast:
halapravāhagamanaṃ gantrīpatragajoṣṭrakam /
kharagorathanauyānalulāyahayakarma ca //
meaning:
हलप्रवाहगमनं गन्त्रीपत्रगजोष्ट्रकम् /
खरगोरथनौयानलुलायहयकर्म च //
text_mt: ploughing, journeying, carts, vehicles, elephants, camels, / donkeys, oxen, chariots, boats, buffaloes, and horses.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāryaśatatārāvasūttarāḥ /
ūrddhāsyaṃ navakaṃ bhānāṃ proktamatra vidhīyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशार्यशततारावसूत्तराः /
ऊर्द्धास्यं नवकं भानां प्रोक्तमत्र विधीयते //
text_mt: Rohiṇī, Śravaṇa, Ārdrā, Puṣya, Śatabhiṣaj, Dhaniṣṭhā, and the three Uttarās: / this group of nine lunar mansions is said to face upward; in these is prescribed:

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpābhiṣekamāṅgalyavāraṇadhvajakarmaca /
prāsādatoraṇārāmaprākārādyaṃ ca siddhyati //
meaning:
नृपाभिषेकमाङ्गल्यवारणध्वजकर्मच /
प्रासादतोरणारामप्राकाराद्यं च सिद्ध्यति //
text_mt: the consecration of a king, auspicious rites, deeds concerning elephants and banners; / [rites regarding] palaces, archways, pleasure gardens, enclosing ramparts, and so forth succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
sthiraṃ rohiṇyuttarākhyaṃ kṣipraṃ sūrayāśvipuṣyabham /
sādhāraṇaṃ dvidaivatyaṃ vahnibhaṃ ca prakīrtitam //
meaning:
स्थिरं रोहिण्युत्तराख्यं क्षिप्रं सूरयाश्विपुष्यभम् /
साधारणं द्विदैवत्यं वह्निभं च प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Rohiṇī and the three Uttarās are fixed; Puṣya, Aśvinī, and Hasta are swift; / the two-deity mansion (Viśākhā) and Kṛttikā are proclaimed to be ordinary;

sanskrit_iast:
vasvadityaṃvupuṣyāṇi viṣṇubhaṃ carasaṃjñitam /
mṛdvindumitracitrāntyamugraṃ pūrvāmaghātrikam //
meaning:
वस्वदित्यंवुपुष्याणि विष्णुभं चरसंज्ञितम् /
मृद्विन्दुमित्रचित्रान्त्यमुग्रं पूर्वामघात्रिकम् //
text_mt: Dhaniṣṭhā, Punarvasu, Śatabhiṣaj, and Śravaṇa are designated as movable; / Mṛgaśīrṣa, Anurādhā, Citrā, and Revatī are gentle; the three Pūrvās and Maghā are fierce;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlārdrāhīndrabhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ svanāmasadṛśaṃ phalam /
citrādityaṃbuviṣṇvaṃbāntyādhimitravasūḍuṣu //
meaning:
मूलार्द्राहीन्द्रभं तीक्ष्णं स्वनामसदृशं फलम् /
चित्रादित्यंबुविष्ण्वंबान्त्याधिमित्रवसूडुषु //
text_mt: Mūla, Ārdrā, Āśleṣā, and Jyeṣṭhā are sharp; their results correspond to their names. / Under the lunar mansions Citrā, Punarvasu, Śatabhiṣaj, Śravaṇa, Rohiṇī, Revatī, Jyeṣṭhā, Anurādhā, and Dhaniṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
samṛgejyeṣu bālānāṃ karṇavedhaṅkriyā hitā /
dasrendvadititiṣyeṣu karāditritaye tathā //
meaning:
समृगेज्येषु बालानां कर्णवेधङ्क्रिया हिता /
दस्रेन्द्वदितितिष्येषु करादित्रितये तथा //
text_mt: along with Mṛgaśīrṣa and Puṣya, the ear-piercing ceremony for children is beneficial. / In Aśvinī, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Punarvasu, Puṣya, and likewise in the triad beginning with Hasta,

sanskrit_iast:
gajakarmākhilaṃ yattadvidheyaṃ sthirabheṣu ca /
vājikarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ sūryavāre viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
गजकर्माखिलं यत्तद्विधेयं स्थिरभेषु च /
वाजिकर्माखिलं कार्यं सूर्यवारे विशेषतः //
text_mt: every deed concerning elephants is to be performed; and in the fixed lunar mansions, / every deed concerning horses is to be performed, especially on Sunday.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāvaruṇavairiñcatryuttarāsu gamāgamam /
darśāṣṭabhyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paśūnāṃ na kadācana //
meaning:
चित्रावरुणवैरिञ्चत्र्युत्तरासु गमागमम् /
दर्शाष्टभ्यां चतुर्दश्यां पशूनां न कदाचन //
text_mt: Under Citrā, Śatabhiṣaj, Rohiṇī, and the three Uttarās, and on the new moon, / the eighth, and the fourteenth days, travel concerning cattle should never take place.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdudhruvakṣipracaraviśākhāpitṛbheṣu ca /
halapravāhaṃ prathamaṃ vidadhyānmūlabhe vṛṣaiḥ //
meaning:
मृदुध्रुवक्षिप्रचरविशाखापितृभेषु च /
हलप्रवाहं प्रथमं विदध्यान्मूलभे वृषैः //
text_mt: Under the soft, fixed, swift, moveable asterisms, Viśākhā, Maghā, / and Mūla, one should carry out the first ploughing with bulls.

sanskrit_iast:
halādau vṛṣānāśāya bhatrayaṃ sūryamuktabhāt /
agre vṛddhyai trayaṃ lakṣmye saumyapārśve ca pañcakam //
meaning:
हलादौ वृषानाशाय भत्रयं सूर्यमुक्तभात् /
अग्रे वृद्ध्यै त्रयं लक्ष्म्ये सौम्यपार्श्वे च पञ्चकम् //
text_mt: At the start of ploughing, the three asterisms from the one left by the Sun cause the destruction of the bulls; / the three ahead are for growth, and the five on the northern side are for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlatrayepi navakaṃ maraṇāya ca pañcakam /
śriyai puṣṭyai trayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ syāccakre lāṅgalāhvaye //
meaning:
शूलत्रयेपि नवकं मरणाय च पञ्चकम् /
श्रियै पुष्ट्यै त्रयं श्रेष्ठं स्याच्चक्रे लाङ्गलाह्वये //
text_mt: The nine upon the three points of the ploughshare and the five cause death; / the three are best for prosperity and nourishment in the diagram named the plough.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdudhruvakṣiprabheṣu pitṛvāyuvasūṅṣu /
samūlabheṣu bījoptiratyuntkṛṣṭaṃ phalapradā //
meaning:
मृदुध्रुवक्षिप्रभेषु पितृवायुवसूङ्षु /
समूलभेषु बीजोप्तिरत्युन्त्कृष्टं फलप्रदा //
text_mt: Under the soft, fixed, and swift asterisms, Maghā, Svātī, and Dhaniṣṭhā, / together with Mūla, the sowing of seeds yields exceedingly excellent fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedbhatritayaṃ mūrghni dhānyanāśāya rāhubhāt /
gale trayaṃ kajjalāya vṛddhyai ca dvādaśodare //
meaning:
भवेद्भत्रितयं मूर्घ्नि धान्यनाशाय राहुभात् /
गले त्रयं कज्जलाय वृद्ध्यै च द्वादशोदरे //
text_mt: From the asterism occupied by Rāhu, the three asterisms on the head cause ruin of grain; / the three on the neck cause smut, and the twelve on the belly are for growth.

sanskrit_iast:
nistaṃhulatvaṃ lāṅgūle bhacatuṣṭayabhītidam /
nābhau vahniḥ pañcakaṃ yadvījoptāviti cintayet //
meaning:
निस्तंहुलत्वं लाङ्गूले भचतुष्टयभीतिदम् /
नाभौ वह्निः पञ्चकं यद्वीजोप्ताविति चिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: The group of four asterisms on the tail causes grainlessness and danger; / the five on the navel are fire: thus should one consider during the sowing of seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sthireṣvaditisārpāntyapitṛmārutabheṣu ca /
na kuryādrogamuktasya snānamāhīṃ duśukrayoḥ //
meaning:
स्थिरेष्वदितिसार्पान्त्यपितृमारुतभेषु च /
न कुर्याद्रोगमुक्तस्य स्नानमाहीं दुशुक्रयोः //
text_mt: Under the fixed asterisms, Punarvasu, Āśleṣā, Revatī, Maghā, and Svātī, / one should not perform the bath of one recovered from sickness on a Tuesday or a Friday.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarātrayamaitrendravasuvāruṇabheṣu ca /
puṣyārkapauṣṇadhiṣṇyeṣu nṛtyāraṃbhaḥ praśasyate //
meaning:
उत्तरात्रयमैत्रेन्द्रवसुवारुणभेषु च /
पुष्यार्कपौष्णधिष्ण्येषु नृत्यारंभः प्रशस्यते //
text_mt: Under the three Uttarās, Anurādhā, Jyeṣṭhā, Dhaniṣṭhā, and Śatabhiṣaj, / and under Puṣya, Hasta, and Revatī, the commencement of dance is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvārddhayuñji ṣaṅbhani pauṣṇabhādudabhāttataḥ /
madhyayuñji dvādaśarkṣāṇīndrabhānnavabhāni ca //
meaning:
पूर्वार्द्धयुञ्जि षङ्भनि पौष्णभादुदभात्ततः /
मध्ययुञ्जि द्वादशर्क्षाणीन्द्रभान्नवभानि च //
text_mt: Under Pūrvārdhayuñj, the six asterisms beginning from Revatī; then from Uttaraphālgunī, / under Madhyayuñj, twelve asterisms; and nine asterisms beginning from Jyeṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
parārddhayuñji kramaśaḥ saṃprītirdampatermathaḥ /
jaghanyāstoyapārdrāhipavanāntakanākapāḥ //
meaning:
परार्द्धयुञ्जि क्रमशः संप्रीतिर्दम्पतेर्मथः /
जघन्यास्तोयपार्द्राहिपवनान्तकनाकपाः //
text_mt: under Parārdhayuñj, in order, affection of husband and wife [arises]. Now, the lowest: / Śatabhiṣaj, Ārdrā, Āśleṣā, Svātī, Bharaṇī, and Jyeṣṭhā,

sanskrit_iast:
kramāditidvidaivatyā bṛhattārāḥ parāḥ samāḥ /
tāsāṃ pramāṇaghaṭikāstriṃśannavatidyaṣṭayaḥ //
meaning:
क्रमादितिद्विदैवत्या बृहत्ताराः पराः समाः /
तासां प्रमाणघटिकास्त्रिंशन्नवतिद्यष्टयः //
text_mt: and Punarvasu and Viśākhā in order, are large stars; the others are equal. / Their measure is thirty, ninety, and two eight [i.e. sixteen] ghaṭikās,

sanskrit_iast:
kramādabhyudite candre nayatyarghasamāni ca /
aśvagrīndvījyanairṛtyatvāṣṭrajattyuttarābhavāḥ //
meaning:
क्रमादभ्युदिते चन्द्रे नयत्यर्घसमानि च /
अश्वग्रीन्द्वीज्यनैरृत्यत्वाष्ट्रजत्त्युत्तराभवाः //
text_mt: in order, when the Moon has risen, bringing equality in prices. / The stars belonging to Aśvinī, Kṛttikā, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Puṣya, Mūla, Citrā, and the three Uttarās,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdvidaivavasvākhyāstārāḥ syuḥ kulasaṃjñikāḥ /
dhātṛjyeṣṭāditisvātīpauṣṇārkaharidevatāḥ //
meaning:
पितृद्विदैववस्वाख्यास्ताराः स्युः कुलसंज्ञिकाः /
धातृज्येष्टादितिस्वातीपौष्णार्कहरिदेवताः //
text_mt: along with Maghā, Viśākhā, and Dhaniṣṭhā, are designated as family [kula] stars. / The asterisms whose deities are Rohiṇī, Jyeṣṭhā, Punarvasu, Svātī, Revatī, Hasta, and Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
ajāhyantyakabhaujaṅgatārāścaivākulāhvayāḥ /
śeṣāḥ kulākulāstārāstāsāṃ madhye kuloḍuṣu //
meaning:
अजाह्यन्त्यकभौजङ्गताराश्चैवाकुलाह्वयाः /
शेषाः कुलाकुलास्तारास्तासां मध्ये कुलोडुषु //
text_mt: and Pūrvabhādrapadā, Uttarabhādrapadā, Bharaṇī, and Āśleṣā are indeed called non-family [akula]. / The remaining are family-non-family [kulākula] stars. Among them, under the kula asterisms,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāti yadi bhūpālastadāpnoti parājayam /
bheṣūpakulasaṃjñeṣu jayamāpnoti niścitam //
meaning:
प्रयाति यदि भूपालस्तदाप्नोति पराजयम् /
भेषूपकुलसंज्ञेषु जयमाप्नोति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: if a king sets out, he meets defeat; / under the asterisms named upakula, he certainly achieves victory.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhirvāpi tayoḥ sāmyaṃ kulākulagaṇoḍuṣu /
arkārkibhaumavāre cedbhadrāyā viṣamāṅghribham //
meaning:
संधिर्वापि तयोः साम्यं कुलाकुलगणोडुषु /
अर्कार्किभौमवारे चेद्भद्राया विषमाङ्घ्रिभम् //
text_mt: Under the asterisms of the kulākula group, there is a truce or equality between the two. / If on Sunday, Saturday, or Tuesday, under a Bhadrā, there is an asterism on an odd quarter,

sanskrit_iast:
tripuṣkaraṃ triguṇadaṃ dviguṇaṃ yamalāhibham /
tadyāttaddoṣanāśāya gotrayaṃ mūlyameva vā //
meaning:
त्रिपुष्करं त्रिगुणदं द्विगुणं यमलाहिभम् /
तद्यात्तद्दोषनाशाय गोत्रयं मूल्यमेव वा //
text_mt: it is Tripuṣkara, granting three-fold [results]; that on Yamala [an even quarter] and serpent-asterism [Āśleṣā] gives double. / To destroy that fault, one should donate three cows or their value.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipuṣkare dvayaṃ dadyānna doṣastvṛkṣabho 'pi vā /
krūraviddho yuto vāpipuṣyo yadi balānvitaḥ //
meaning:
द्विपुष्करे द्वयं दद्यान्न दोषस्त्वृक्षभो ऽपि वा /
क्रूरविद्धो युतो वापिपुष्यो यदि बलान्वितः //
text_mt: In Dvipuṣkara, one should give two [cows]; then there is no fault, or even an offering of grains. / If Puṣya, even when pierced by a malefic or joined [with one], is possessed of strength,

sanskrit_iast:
vinā pāṇigrahaṃ sarvamaṅgaleṣviṣṭadaḥ sadā /
rāmāgniṛtubāṇāgnibhūvedāgniśareṣu ca //
meaning:
विना पाणिग्रहं सर्वमङ्गलेष्विष्टदः सदा /
रामाग्निऋतुबाणाग्निभूवेदाग्निशरेषु च //
text_mt: except for marriage, it is always wish-granting in all auspicious undertakings. / Three, three, six, five, three, one, four, three, five, five,

sanskrit_iast:
netrabāhuśaredvindubāhuvedāgnisaṃkarāḥ /
vedanetrābdhyagniśatabāhunetraradāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
नेत्रबाहुशरेद्विन्दुबाहुवेदाग्निसंकराः /
वेदनेत्राब्ध्यग्निशतबाहुनेत्ररदाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: two, two, five, one, one, two, four, three combinations, / four, two, four, three, one hundred, two, two, and thirty-two, in order,

sanskrit_iast:
tārāsaṃkhyāśca vijñeyā dasrādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak /
yā dṛśyante dīptatārāḥ svagaṇe yogatārakāḥ //
meaning:
तारासंख्याश्च विज्ञेया दस्रादीनां पृथक् पृथक् /
या दृश्यन्ते दीप्तताराः स्वगणे योगतारकाः //
text_mt: are to be known as the numbers of stars for Aśvinī and the rest individually. / The bright stars seen within their respective groups are the junction stars.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣo vṛkṣoścabhāyāmyadhiṣṇyeyamakarastaruḥ /
uḍuṃbaraścāgnidhiṣṇye rohiṇyāṃ jaṃbukastaruḥ //
meaning:
वृषो वृक्षोश्चभायाम्यधिष्ण्येयमकरस्तरुः /
उडुंबरश्चाग्निधिष्ण्ये रोहिण्यां जंबुकस्तरुः //
text_mt: The vṛṣa tree belongs to the asterism of Aśvinī; the yamadūtaka tree to Bharaṇī; / the uḍumbara to Kṛttikā; the jambū tree to Rohiṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
indubhātkhadiro jātaḥ kṛṣṇaplakṣaśca raudrabhāt /
saṃbhūto 'ditibhādvaṃśaḥ pippalaḥ puṣyasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
इन्दुभात्खदिरो जातः कृष्णप्लक्षश्च रौद्रभात् /
संभूतो ऽदितिभाद्वंशः पिप्पलः पुष्यसंभवः //
text_mt: from the asterism of the Moon [Mṛgaśīrṣa] arose the khadira, and the black plakṣa from Ārdrā; / from Punarvasu the bamboo arose; the pippala is born of Puṣya;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadhiṣṇyānnāgavṛkṣo vaṭaḥ pitṛbhasaṃbhavaḥ /
pālāśo bhāgyabhājjātaḥ akṣaścāryamasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वधिष्ण्यान्नागवृक्षो वटः पितृभसंभवः /
पालाशो भाग्यभाज्जातः अक्षश्चार्यमसंभवः //
text_mt: from Āśleṣā, the nāga tree; the banyan is born of Maghā; / the palāśa arose from Pūrvaphālgunī; and the akṣa is born of Uttaraphālgunī;

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭavṛkṣo ravibhācchrīvṛkṣastvāṣṭrasaṃbhavaḥ /
svātyukṣajor'juno vṛkṣo dvidaivatyādvikaṅkataḥ //
meaning:
अरिष्टवृक्षो रविभाच्छ्रीवृक्षस्त्वाष्ट्रसंभवः /
स्वात्युक्षजोर्ऽजुनो वृक्षो द्विदैवत्याद्विकङ्कतः //
text_mt: the ariṣṭa tree is from Hasta; the bilva tree is born of Citrā; / the arjuna tree belongs to Svātī; from Viśākhā, the vikaṅkata;

sanskrit_iast:
mitrabhādbakulojāto viṣṭiḥ paurandararkṣajaḥ /
sarjjavṛkṣo mūlabhāñca vañjulo vāridhiṣṇyajaḥ //
meaning:
मित्रभाद्बकुलोजातो विष्टिः पौरन्दरर्क्षजः /
सर्ज्जवृक्षो मूलभाञ्च वञ्जुलो वारिधिष्ण्यजः //
text_mt: from Anurādhā, the bakula arose; the viṣṭi is born of Jyeṣṭhā; / the sarja tree belongs to Mūla; and the vañjula is born of Pūrvāṣāḍhā;

sanskrit_iast:
panaso vaiśvabhājjātaścārkavṛkṣaśca viṣṇubhāt /
vasudhiṣṇyācchamīvṛkṣaḥ kadaṃbo vāruṇarkṣajaḥ //
meaning:
पनसो वैश्वभाज्जातश्चार्कवृक्षश्च विष्णुभात् /
वसुधिष्ण्याच्छमीवृक्षः कदंबो वारुणर्क्षजः //
text_mt: the panasa arose from Uttarāṣāḍhā; and the arka tree from Śravaṇa; / from Dhaniṣṭhā, the śamī tree; the kadamba belongs to Śatabhiṣaj;

sanskrit_iast:
ajāheścūtavṛkṣobhūdbudhnyajaḥ picumandakaḥ /
madhuvṛkṣaḥ pauṣṇadhiṣṇyāddhiṣṇyavṛkṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अजाहेश्चूतवृक्षोभूद्बुध्न्यजः पिचुमन्दकः /
मधुवृक्षः पौष्णधिष्ण्याद्धिष्ण्यवृक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: from Pūrvabhādrapadā came the mango tree; from Uttarabhādrapadā the neem; / the madhūka tree is from Revatī: thus are the trees of the asterisms proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiñchaṃnaiśvaro dhiṣṇye tadrṛkṣo 'rcyaḥ prayatnataḥ /
yogeśā yamaviśvendudhātṛjīvaniśākarāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिञ्छंनैश्वरो धिष्ण्ये तद्रृक्षो ऽर्च्यः प्रयत्नतः /
योगेशा यमविश्वेन्दुधातृजीवनिशाकराः //
text_mt: The tree of whichever asterism Saturn occupies should be worshipped with diligence. / The lords of the yogas are Yama, Viśvedevas, Candra, Vidhātṛ, Jīva, Niśākara,

sanskrit_iast:
indratoyāhivahnyarkabhūmirudrakatoyapāḥ /
gaṇeśarudradhanadatvaṣṭṭamitraṣaḍānanāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रतोयाहिवह्न्यर्कभूमिरुद्रकतोयपाः /
गणेशरुद्रधनदत्वष्ट्टमित्रषडाननाः //
text_mt: Indra, Toyapa, Ahi, Vahni, Arka, Bhūmi, Rudraka, Toyapa, / Gaṇeśa, Rudra, Dhanada, Tvaṣṭṛ, Mitra, the six-faced one [Kārttikeya],

sanskrit_iast:
sāvatrī kamalā gaurī nāsatyau pitaro 'ditiḥ /
vaidhṛtiśca vyatīpāto mahāpātāvubhau sadā //
meaning:
सावत्री कमला गौरी नासत्यौ पितरो ऽदितिः /
वैधृतिश्च व्यतीपातो महापातावुभौ सदा //
text_mt: Sāvitrī, Kamalā, Gaurī, the two Nāsatyas, the Pitṛs, and Aditi. / Vaidhṛti and Vyatīpāta are both always Mahāpātas.

sanskrit_iast:
parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ sarvakāryeṣu garhitam /
viṣkaṃbhavajrayostisraḥ ṣaḍvā gaṇḍātigaṇḍayāĪḥ //
meaning:
परिघस्य च पूर्वार्द्धं सर्वकार्येषु गर्हितम् /
विष्कंभवज्रयोस्तिस्रः षड्वा गण्डातिगण्डयाईः //
text_mt: The first half of Parigha is condemned in all undertakings. / Three [nāḍīs] of Viṣkambha and Vajra, or six of Gaṇḍa and Atigaṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāgaghāte nava śūle tu pañca nāḍyo hi garhitāḥ /
aditīndumadhāhyaśvamūlamaitrejyabhāni ca //
meaning:
व्यागघाते नव शूले तु पञ्च नाड्यो हि गर्हिताः /
अदितीन्दुमधाह्यश्वमूलमैत्रेज्यभानि च //
text_mt: nine in Vyāghāta, and five nāḍīs in Śūla are indeed condemned. / The asterisms Punarvasu, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Maghā, Aśvinī, Mūla, Anurādhā, and Puṣya,

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyāni sahacitrāṇi mūrddhabhāni yathākramam /
likhedūrdhvagatāmekāṃ tiryagrekhāstrayodaśa //
meaning:
ज्ञेयानि सहचित्राणि मूर्द्धभानि यथाक्रमम् /
लिखेदूर्ध्वगतामेकां तिर्यग्रेखास्त्रयोदश //
text_mt: together with Citrā, are to be known as the head asterisms, in their order. / One should draw one upward line and thirteen horizontal lines;

sanskrit_iast:
tatra ravārjūrike cakre kathitaṃ mūrdhni bhaṃ nyaset /
bhājyaikareravāgatayoḥ sūryācandramasormithaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र रवार्जूरिके चक्रे कथितं मूर्ध्नि भं न्यसेत् /
भाज्यैकरेरवागतयोः सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्मिथः //
text_mt: there, in the ravārjūrika diagram, one should place the asterism stated on the head. / In the mutual movement of the Sun and the Moon, dividing one ray,

sanskrit_iast:
ekārgalo dṛṣṭipātaścābhijidvarjitāni vai /
vināḍībhirdvādaśabhī rahitaṃ ghaṭikādvayam //
meaning:
एकार्गलो दृष्टिपातश्चाभिजिद्वर्जितानि वै /
विनाडीभिर्द्वादशभी रहितं घटिकाद्वयम् //
text_mt: there is the Ekārgala and the cast of sight, excluding Abhijit. / Two ghaṭikās minus twelve vināḍīs [is its duration].

sanskrit_iast:
yogaṃ prakaraṇaṃ yogāḥ kramāttu saptaviṃśatiḥ /
indraḥ prajāpatirmitrastvaṣṭābhūharitipriyā //
meaning:
योगं प्रकरणं योगाः क्रमात्तु सप्तविंशतिः /
इन्द्रः प्रजापतिर्मित्रस्त्वष्टाभूहरितिप्रिया //
text_mt: The chapter on the yogas. The yogas are twenty-seven in sequence. / Indra, Prajāpati, Mitra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Bhūmi, Hari, Priya,

sanskrit_iast:
kīnāśaḥ kalirudrākhyo tithyarddheśāstvahirmarut /
bavādivaṇijāntāni śubhāni karaṇāni ṣaṭ //
meaning:
कीनाशः कलिरुद्राख्यो तिथ्यर्द्धेशास्त्वहिर्मरुत् /
बवादिवणिजान्तानि शुभानि करणानि षट् //
text_mt: Kīnāśa, Kali, Rudra, Ahi, and Marut are the rulers of the half-tithis [karaṇas]. / The six karaṇas beginning with Bava and ending with Vaṇij are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
parītā viparītā vā viṣyirneṣṭā tu maṅgale /
mukhe pañcagale caikā vakṣasyekādaśa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
परीता विपरीता वा विष्यिर्नेष्टा तु मङ्गले /
मुखे पञ्चगले चैका वक्षस्येकादश स्मृतः //
text_mt: Whether forward or reverse, Viṣṭi is not desirable in an auspicious rite. / Five [nāḍīs] are in the mouth, one in the neck, and eleven are recorded in the chest;

sanskrit_iast:
nābhau catasraḥ ṣaṭ kaṭyāṃ tisraḥ pucchākhyanājikāḥ /
kāryahānirmukhe mṛtyurgale vakṣasi niḥsvatā //
meaning:
नाभौ चतस्रः षट् कट्यां तिस्रः पुच्छाख्यनाजिकाः /
कार्यहानिर्मुखे मृत्युर्गले वक्षसि निःस्वता //
text_mt: four in the navel, six in the hips, and three nāḍīs in the tail. / In the mouth, loss of work; in the neck, death; in the chest, poverty;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭyāmunmattatā nābhau cyutiḥ pucche dhruvaṃ jayaḥ /
sthirāṇi madhyamānyeṣāṃ madhyanāgacatuṣpadau //
meaning:
कट्यामुन्मत्तता नाभौ च्युतिः पुच्छे ध्रुवं जयः /
स्थिराणि मध्यमान्येषां मध्यनागचतुष्पदौ //
text_mt: in the waist, madness; in the navel, downfall; in the tail, victory is certain. / The fixed ones among these are middling; in the middle are Nāga and Catuṣpad.

sanskrit_iast:
divāmuhūrtā rudrāhimitrapitṛvasūdakam /
viśvevidhātṛbrahmendrarudrāgnivasutoyapāḥ //
meaning:
दिवामुहूर्ता रुद्राहिमित्रपितृवसूदकम् /
विश्वेविधातृब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्राग्निवसुतोयपाः //
text_mt: The daytime muhūrtas are: Rudra, Ahi, Mitra, Pitṛ, Vasu, Udaka, / Viśvedevas, Vidhātṛ, Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, Agni, Vasu, Toyapa,

sanskrit_iast:
aryamā bhagasaṃjñaśca vijñeyā daśa pañca ca /
īśājapādāhirbudhnyapūṣāśviyamavahnayaḥ //
meaning:
अर्यमा भगसंज्ञश्च विज्ञेया दश पञ्च च /
ईशाजपादाहिर्बुध्न्यपूषाश्वियमवह्नयः //
text_mt: Aryaman, and the one named Bhaga—these fifteen are to be known. / [The night muhūrtas are:] Īśa, Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Pūṣan, the two Aśvins, Yama, Agni,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātṛ indrāditījyākhyā viṣṇvarkatvaṣṭṛvāyavaḥ /
ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgastathā rātripramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
धातृ इन्द्रादितीज्याख्या विष्ण्वर्कत्वष्टृवायवः /
अह्नः पञ्चदशो भागस्तथा रात्रिप्रमाणतः //
text_mt: Dhātṛ, Indra, Aditi, Bṛhaspati, Viṣṇu, Arka, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Vāyu. / The fifteenth part of the day, and likewise of the duration of the night,

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtamānaṃ dvarāvakṣaṇarkṣāṇi sameśvaram /
aryamā rākṣasabrāhnau pitryāgneyau tathābhijit //
meaning:
मुहूर्तमानं द्वरावक्षणर्क्षाणि समेश्वरम् /
अर्यमा राक्षसब्राह्नौ पित्र्याग्नेयौ तथाभिजित् //
text_mt: is the measure of a muhūrta, containing asterisms of two twinkling-moments with their respective lords. / Aryaman, Rākṣasa, and Brāhma; the two Pitrya and Āgneya; likewise Abhijit;

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasākhyau brāhmapitryau bhargājāṃśāvalinādiṣu /
vāreṣu varjanīyāste muhūrtāḥ śubhakarmasu //
meaning:
राक्षसाख्यौ ब्राह्मपित्र्यौ भर्गाजांशावलिनादिषु /
वारेषु वर्जनीयास्ते मुहूर्ताः शुभकर्मसु //
text_mt: the two called Rākṣasa, Brāhma, and Pitrya, on the days of Bharga, Aja, Aṃśumat, and Bali and the like— / these muhūrtas are to be avoided in auspicious actions on those days.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu ṛkṣeṣu yatkarma kathitaṃ nikhilaṃ ca tat /
taddaivatye muhūrte 'pi kāryaṃ yātrādikaṃ sadā //
meaning:
येषु ऋक्षेषु यत्कर्म कथितं निखिलं च तत् /
तद्दैवत्ये मुहूर्ते ऽपि कार्यं यात्रादिकं सदा //
text_mt: Whatever rite has been declared in any asterisms, all of that / may always be undertaken in the muhūrta presided over by that same deity, such as a journey.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūkaṃpaḥ sūryabhātsaptamarkṣe vidyuñca pañcame /
śūlo 'ṣṭame ca daśame śāniraṣṭādaśe tataḥ //
meaning:
भूकंपः सूर्यभात्सप्तमर्क्षे विद्युञ्च पञ्चमे /
शूलो ऽष्टमे च दशमे शानिरष्टादशे ततः //
text_mt: An earthquake occurs in the seventh asterism from the Sun's asterism, and lightning in the fifth; / a comet in the eighth, Saturn in the tenth, and then in the eighteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
ketuḥ pañcadaśe daṇḍa ulkā ekonaviṃśatau /
nirghātapātasaṃjñaśca jñeyaḥ sa navapañcame //
meaning:
केतुः पञ्चदशे दण्ड उल्का एकोनविंशतौ /
निर्घातपातसंज्ञश्च ज्ञेयः स नवपञ्चमे //
text_mt: Ketu is in the fifteenth; Daṇḍa and Ulkā in the nineteenth; / and the one named Nirghātapāta should be known in the ninth and fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
mohanirghātakaṃ pāśca kuliśaṃ pariveṣaṇam /
vijñeyā ekaviṃśarkṣādārabhya ca yathākramam //
meaning:
मोहनिर्घातकं पाश्च कुलिशं परिवेषणम् /
विज्ञेया एकविंशर्क्षादारभ्य च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Moha, Nirghātaka, Pāśa, Kuliśa, and Pariveṣaṇa / should be known in order, beginning from the twenty-first asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
candrayukteṣu bheṣveṣu śubhakarma na kārayet /
sūryabhātsarvapitryarkṣaṃ tvāṣṭramitraptabheṣu ca //
meaning:
चन्द्रयुक्तेषु भेष्वेषु शुभकर्म न कारयेत् /
सूर्यभात्सर्वपित्र्यर्क्षं त्वाष्ट्रमित्रप्तभेषु च //
text_mt: When the Moon is conjoined with these asterisms, one should not perform any auspicious rite. / From the Sun's asterism, all the asterisms sacred to the Pitṛs, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Mitra,

sanskrit_iast:
saviṣaaṇubheṣu kramaśo hastabhāñcandrasaṃyutaḥ /
dhiṣṇye tāvati satyatra duṣṭayogaḥ patatyasau //
meaning:
सविषअणुभेषु क्रमशो हस्तभाञ्चन्द्रसंयुतः /
धिष्ण्ये तावति सत्यत्र दुष्टयोगः पतत्यसौ //
text_mt: and the asterisms Viśākhā and Anurādhā respectively, when conjoined with the Moon from the Hasta asterism: / when the Moon is in such an asterism, this inauspicious combination occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍīśacaṇḍāyudhākhyastasminnaivācarecchubham /
trayodaśa syurmilanasaṃkhyayā tithivārayoḥ //
meaning:
चण्डीशचण्डायुधाख्यस्तस्मिन्नैवाचरेच्छुभम् /
त्रयोदश स्युर्मिलनसंख्यया तिथिवारयोः //
text_mt: It is named Caṇḍīśa and Caṇḍāyudha; during it, one must not perform any auspicious act. / There are thirteen [such yogas] by the reckoning of the conjunctions of lunar day and weekday.

sanskrit_iast:
krakaco nāma yogo 'yaṃ maṅgaleṣvatigardditaḥ /
saptamyāmarkavāraścetpratipatsaumyabāsare //
meaning:
क्रकचो नाम योगो ऽयं मङ्गलेष्वतिगर्द्दितः /
सप्तम्यामर्कवारश्चेत्प्रतिपत्सौम्यबासरे //
text_mt: This yoga called Krakaca is severely condemned in auspicious rites: / if there is Sunday on the seventh lunar day, or Wednesday on the first lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatayogo vijñeyaḥ śubhakarmavināśakṛt /
ānandaḥ kāladaṇḍākhyo dhūmradhātṛsudhākarāḥ //
meaning:
संवतयोगो विज्ञेयः शुभकर्मविनाशकृत् /
आनन्दः कालदण्डाख्यो धूम्रधातृसुधाकराः //
text_mt:
It is to be known as saṃvatayoga, which destroys auspicious undertakings.
Ānanda, the one called Kāladaṇḍa, Dhūmra, Dhātṛ, Sudhākāra,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvāṅkṣadhvajākhyaśrīvatsavajramudgarachatrakāḥ /
mitramānasapadmākhyalumbakotpātamṛtyavaḥ //
meaning:
ध्वाङ्क्षध्वजाख्यश्रीवत्सवज्रमुद्गरछत्रकाः /
मित्रमानसपद्माख्यलुम्बकोत्पातमृत्यवः //
text_mt:
Dhvāṅkṣa, the one named Dhvaja, Śrīvatsa, Vajra, Mudgara, Chatraka,
Mitra, Mānasa, the one called Padma, Lumbaka, Utpāta, Mṛtyu,

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇasiddhiśubhā mṛtyumuśalāntakarkujarāḥ /
rākṣasākhyavarasthairyavarddhamānāḥ kramādamī //
meaning:
काणसिद्धिशुभा मृत्युमुशलान्तकर्कुजराः /
राक्षसाख्यवरस्थैर्यवर्द्धमानाः क्रमादमी //
text_mt:
Kāṇa, Siddhi, Śubha, Mṛtyu, Musala, Antaka, Gaja,
the one named Rākṣasa, Vara, Sthairya, and Vardhamāna: in this order,

sanskrit_iast:
yogāḥ svasaṃjñāphaladā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ /
ravivāre kramādeva dasrabhārdidubhādvidhau //
meaning:
योगाः स्वसंज्ञाफलदा अष्टाविंशतिरीरिताः /
रविवारे क्रमादेव दस्रभार्दिदुभाद्विधौ //
text_mt:
these twenty-eight yogas are proclaimed, granting fruits corresponding to their own names.
On Sunday, [they begin] precisely in sequence from Aśvinī; on Monday, from Mṛgaśīrṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
sārpāddhaume pudhe hastānmaitrabhātsuramantriṇi /
vaiśvadevādbhagusute vāruṇādbhāskarātmaje //
meaning:
सार्पाद्धौमे पुधे हस्तान्मैत्रभात्सुरमन्त्रिणि /
वैश्वदेवाद्भगुसुते वारुणाद्भास्करात्मजे //
text_mt:
on Tuesday, from Āśleṣā; on Wednesday, from Hasta; on Thursday, from Anurādhā;
on Friday, from Uttarāṣāḍhā; and on Saturday, from Śatabhiṣaj.

sanskrit_iast:
hastarkṣaṃ ca khārvidau candrabhaṃ dasrabhaṃ kuje /
saumye mitrabhamācāryaṃ tiṣyaḥ pauṣṇaṃ bhṛgoḥ sute //
meaning:
हस्तर्क्षं च खार्विदौ चन्द्रभं दस्रभं कुजे /
सौम्ये मित्रभमाचार्यं तिष्यः पौष्णं भृगोः सुते //
text_mt:
Hasta and Puṣya on Monday; Citrā and Aśvinī on Tuesday;
Anurādhā on Wednesday; Puṣya on Thursday; Revatī on Friday;

sanskrit_iast:
/
rohiṇī mandavāre ca siddhiyogāhvayā amī /
ādityabhaumayornandā bhadrā śukraśaśāṅkayoḥ //
meaning:
/
रोहिणी मन्दवारे च सिद्धियोगाह्वया अमी /
आदित्यभौमयोर्नन्दा भद्रा शुक्रशशाङ्कयोः //
text_mt:
and Rohiṇī on Saturday—these are called siddhi-yogas.
Nandā on Sunday and Tuesday; Bhadrā on Friday and Monday;

sanskrit_iast:
jayāsaumye gurau riktā śanaupūrṇeti no śubhāḥ /
nandā tithiḥ śukravāre saumye bhadrā kuje jayā //
meaning:
जयासौम्ये गुरौ रिक्ता शनौपूर्णेति नो शुभाः /
नन्दा तिथिः शुक्रवारे सौम्ये भद्रा कुजे जया //
text_mt:
Jayā on Wednesday; Riktā on Thursday; Pūrṇā on Saturday: these are inauspicious.
The tithi Nandā on Friday, Bhadrā on Wednesday, Jayā on Tuesday,

sanskrit_iast:
riktā mande gurorvāre pūrṇā siddhāhvayā amī /
ekādaśyāminduvāro dvādaśyāmarkavāsaraḥ //
meaning:
रिक्ता मन्दे गुरोर्वारे पूर्णा सिद्धाह्वया अमी /
एकादश्यामिन्दुवारो द्वादश्यामर्कवासरः //
text_mt:
Riktā on Saturday, and Pūrṇā on Thursday: these are named siddhā.
Monday on the eleventh [tithi]; Sunday on the twelfth;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭī gurau tṛtīyā jñe 'ṣṭamī śukre śanaiścare /
navamī pañcamī bhaume dagdhayogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
षष्टी गुरौ तृतीया ज्ञे ऽष्टमी शुक्रे शनैश्चरे /
नवमी पञ्चमी भौमे दग्धयोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
the sixth on Thursday; the third on Wednesday; the eighth on Friday;
the ninth on Saturday; and the fifth on Tuesday are proclaimed as the dagdha-yogas.

sanskrit_iast:
bharaṇyarkadine candre citrābhaumetu viśvabham /
budhe śraviṣṭāryamabhe gurau jyeṣṭā bhṛgordine //
meaning:
भरण्यर्कदिने चन्द्रे चित्राभौमेतु विश्वभम् /
बुधे श्रविष्टार्यमभे गुरौ ज्येष्टा भृगोर्दिने //
text_mt:
Bharaṇī on Sunday; Citrā on Monday; Uttarāṣāḍhā on Tuesday;
Śraviṣṭhā on Wednesday; Uttaraphālgunī on Thursday; Jyeṣṭhā on Friday;

sanskrit_iast:
revatī mandavāre tu grahajanmarkṣanāśanam /
viśākhādicaturvargamarkamarkavārādiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
रेवती मन्दवारे तु ग्रहजन्मर्क्षनाशनम् /
विशाखादिचतुर्वर्गमर्कमर्कवारादिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt:
and Revatī on Saturday destroy the natal constellation of planets.
The group of four beginning with Viśākhā, in order on the days beginning with Sunday,

sanskrit_iast:
utpātamṛtyukāraṇākhyasiddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
tithivārodbhavā neṣṭā yogā vārarkṣasaṃbhavāḥ //
meaning:
उत्पातमृत्युकारणाख्यसिद्धियोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
तिथिवारोद्भवा नेष्टा योगा वारर्क्षसंभवाः //
text_mt:
are proclaimed as the yogas called Utpāta, Mṛtyu, Kāraṇa, and Siddhi.
Yogas arising from tithis and days are undesirable; yogas born of days and constellations,

sanskrit_iast:
hūṇavaṅgakhaseṣvanyadeśeṣvatiśubhapradāḥ /
ghorāṣṭākṣīmahodaryo mandā mandākinī tathā //
meaning:
हूणवङ्गखसेष्वन्यदेशेष्वतिशुभप्रदाः /
घोराष्टाक्षीमहोदर्यो मन्दा मन्दाकिनी तथा //
text_mt:
[though undesirable] in the lands of the Hūṇas, Vaṅgas, and Khasas, are exceedingly auspicious in other regions.
Ghorā, Aṣṭākṣī, Mahodarī, Mandā, Mandākinī,

sanskrit_iast:
miśrā rākṣasikā sūryavārādiṣu yathākramam /
śūdrataskaravaiśyakṣmādevabhūpagavāṃ kramāt //
meaning:
मिश्रा राक्षसिका सूर्यवारादिषु यथाक्रमम् /
शूद्रतस्करवैश्यक्ष्मादेवभूपगवां क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Miśrā, and Rākṣasikā, in respective order on the days beginning with Sunday,
are remembered as bringing happiness to Śūdras, thieves, Vaiśyas, Brāhmaṇas, kings, cows,

sanskrit_iast:
anuktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ghorādyāḥ sukhadāḥ smṛtāḥ /
pūrvāhne nṛpatīnhanti viprānmadhyandine viśaḥ //
meaning:
अनुक्तानां च सर्वेषां घोराद्याः सुखदाः स्मृताः /
पूर्वाह्ने नृपतीन्हन्ति विप्रान्मध्यन्दिने विशः //
text_mt:
and all those not explicitly mentioned, respectively.
In the forenoon, the sun's ingress destroys kings; at midday, Brāhmaṇas; in the afternoon, Vaiśyas;

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhne 'stage śūdrānpradoṣe ca piśācakān /
niśi rātricarānnāṭyakārānapararātrike //
meaning:
अपराह्ने ऽस्तगे शूद्रान्प्रदोषे च पिशाचकान् /
निशि रात्रिचरान्नाट्यकारानपररात्रिके //
text_mt:
at sunset, Śūdras; in the early evening, piśācas;
at night, night-roaming spirits; in the latter part of the night, actors;

sanskrit_iast:
gopānuṣasi saṃdhyāyāṃ liṅgino ravisaṃkramaḥ /
divā cenmeṣasaṃkrāntiranarthakalahapradā //
meaning:
गोपानुषसि संध्यायां लिङ्गिनो रविसंक्रमः /
दिवा चेन्मेषसंक्रान्तिरनर्थकलहप्रदा //
text_mt:
at dawn, cowherds; and at twilight, ascetics.
If the Aries saṃkrānti occurs during the day, it causes ruin and strife;

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau subhikṣamatulaṃ saṃdhyayorvṛṣṭināśanam /
hariśārdūlavārāhakharakuñjaramāhiṣāḥ /
aśvaśpavājavṛṣāḥ pādāyudhāḥ karaṇavāhanāḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ सुभिक्षमतुलं संध्ययोर्वृष्टिनाशनम् /
हरिशार्दूलवाराहखरकुञ्जरमाहिषाः /
अश्वश्पवाजवृषाः पादायुधाः करणवाहनाः //
text_mt:
if at night, matchless abundance of food; and at both twilights, the destruction of rainfall.
Lion, tiger, boar, donkey, elephant, buffalo,

sanskrit_iast: bhuśuḍī ca gadākhaḍgau daṇḍa iṣaavāsatomarau //
meaning: भुशुडी च गदाखड्गौ दण्ड इषअवासतोमरौ //
text_mt:
horse, dog, goat, and bull are the footed vehicles of the karaṇas.
The bhuśuṇḍī, mace, sword, staff, arrow, spear, and javelin,

sanskrit_iast:
kuntapāśāṅkuśāstreṣūnbibharti karayostvinaḥ /
annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ sayūṣaṃ ca payo dadhi //
meaning:
कुन्तपाशाङ्कुशास्त्रेषून्बिभर्ति करयोस्त्विनः /
अन्नं च पायसं भैक्ष्यं सयूषं च पयो दधि //
text_mt:
lance, noose, goad, missile, and arrows: the sun bears these in his hands.
Boiled rice, milk-rice, alms-food, broth, milk, curds,

sanskrit_iast:
miṣṭānnaṃ guḍamadhvājyaśarkarā vavato haviḥ /
vavovīvaṇijeviśvāṃ bālave gocarasthitau //
meaning:
मिष्टान्नं गुडमध्वाज्यशर्करा ववतो हविः /
ववोवीवणिजेविश्वां बालवे गोचरस्थितौ //
text_mt:
sweetmeats, molasses, honey, ghee, sugar, and sacrificial offering from Bava onwards [are the food].
Bava, Vālava, Kaulava, Taitila, Gara, Vaṇij, and Viṣṭi,

sanskrit_iast:
kaulave śakunau bhānuḥ kiṃstughne corddhasaṃsthitathaḥ /
catuḥ pāde tilenāge suptaḥ krāntiṃ karoti hi //
meaning:
कौलवे शकुनौ भानुः किंस्तुघ्ने चोर्द्धसंस्थितथः /
चतुः पादे तिलेनागे सुप्तः क्रान्तिं करोति हि //
text_mt:
Śakuni, Catuṣpada, Kintughna, and Nāga: when situated upright,
seated, or sleeping, the sun makes his transit.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāyurvṛṣṭiṣu samaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ phalaṃ kramāt /
āyudhaṃ vāhanāhārau yajjātīyaṃ janasya ca //
meaning:
धर्मायुर्वृष्टिषु समं श्रेष्ठं नष्टं फलं क्रमात् /
आयुधं वाहनाहारौ यज्जातीयं जनस्य च //
text_mt:
Regarding virtue, lifespan, and rain, the fruit is middling, excellent, or ruined in order.
Whatever class of weapon, vehicle, and food belongs to people,

sanskrit_iast:
svāpopaviṣṭāstiṣṭhantaste lokāḥ kṣemamāpnuyuḥ /
andhakaṃ mandasaṃjñaṃ ca madhyasaṃjñaṃ sulocanam //
meaning:
स्वापोपविष्टास्तिष्ठन्तस्ते लोकाः क्षेममाप्नुयुः /
अन्धकं मन्दसंज्ञं च मध्यसंज्ञं सुलोचनम् //
text_mt:
if those people are asleep, seated, or standing, they attain security.
Blind, slow-sighted, middle-sighted, and clear-sighted:

sanskrit_iast:
papīyādgaṇayodbhāni rohiṇyādicaturvidham /
sthirabheṣvarkasaṃkrāntirjñeyā viṣṇupadāhvayā //
meaning:
पपीयाद्गणयोद्भानि रोहिण्यादिचतुर्विधम् /
स्थिरभेष्वर्कसंक्रान्तिर्ज्ञेया विष्णुपदाह्वया //
text_mt:
one should count the constellations from Rohiṇī onwards into these four classes.
The transit of the sun into fixed signs is known as Viṣṇupada;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītimukhā jñeyā dvisvabhāveṣu rāśiṣu /
tulāghaṭājayorjñeyo viṣuvatsūryasaṃkramaḥ //
meaning:
षडशीतिमुखा ज्ञेया द्विस्वभावेषु राशिषु /
तुलाघटाजयोर्ज्ञेयो विषुवत्सूर्यसंक्रमः //
text_mt:
into dual signs, it is known as Ṣaḍaśītimukha.
The sun's transit into Libra and Aries is known as the equinox.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyāyane sthire tvādyāḥ parāḥ saumyendumūrtibhaiḥ /
medhyā viṣuvati proktāḥ puṇyanāḍyastu ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
याम्यायने स्थिरे त्वाद्याः पराः सौम्येन्दुमूर्तिभैः /
मेध्या विषुवति प्रोक्ताः पुण्यनाड्यस्तु षोडश //
text_mt:
In the southern solstice and fixed signs, the earlier [nāḍīs] are pure; in the northern solstice and lunar signs, the later ones.
At the equinox, sixteen nāḍīs are declared auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyā trināḍī pramitārkabiṃborddhodayāstataḥ /
prākpaścādyāmyasaumye cetpuṇyaṃ pūrvāṃpare 'hani //
meaning:
संध्या त्रिनाडी प्रमितार्कबिंबोर्द्धोदयास्ततः /
प्राक्पश्चाद्याम्यसौम्ये चेत्पुण्यं पूर्वांपरे ऽहनि //
text_mt:
Twilight is measured as three nāḍīs from the rising and setting of the solar disc.
If before and after, in the southern or northern [course], the merit belongs to the previous or the next day.

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśenendunā bhānoḥ saṃkrāntistādṛśaṃ phalam /
naraḥ prāpnoti tadrāśau śītāṃśoḥ sādhvasādhu ca //
meaning:
यादृशेनेन्दुना भानोः संक्रान्तिस्तादृशं फलम् /
नरः प्राप्नोति तद्राशौ शीतांशोः साध्वसाधु च //
text_mt:
According to the condition of the moon at the sun's transit, a person
receives that kind of good or bad fruit in that sign of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrānteḥ parato bhānurbhuktvā yāvadbhiraṃśakaiḥ /
raverayanasaṃkrāntistadā tadrāśisaṃkramāt //
meaning:
संक्रान्तेः परतो भानुर्भुक्त्वा यावद्भिरंशकैः /
रवेरयनसंक्रान्तिस्तदा तद्राशिसंक्रमात् //
text_mt:
Beyond the saṃkrānti, by however many degrees the sun has traversed,
when the solstitial ingress of the sun occurs, then it is from the ingress into that sign.

sanskrit_iast:
sakrāntigrahagarkṣaṃvā janmanyubhayapārśvayoḥ /
vratodvāhādikeṣveva dvayaṃ neṣṭaṃ tu tatkramāt //
meaning:
सक्रान्तिग्रहगर्क्षंवा जन्मन्युभयपार्श्वयोः /
व्रतोद्वाहादिकेष्वेव द्वयं नेष्टं तु तत्क्रमात् //
text_mt:
The constellation of the transit or eclipse planet on either side of the natal constellation
is undesirable in observances, marriages, and the like, in that order.

sanskrit_iast:
tiloparilikheccakraṃ tritriśūlaṃ trikoṇakam /
tatra hema vinikṣipya dadyāddoṣāpavṛttayeḥ //
meaning:
तिलोपरिलिखेच्चक्रं त्रित्रिशूलं त्रिकोणकम् /
तत्र हेम विनिक्षिप्य दद्याद्दोषापवृत्तयेः //
text_mt:
Upon sesame seeds, one should draw a triangular diagram with three tridents;
placing gold upon it, one should offer it to remove the defect.

sanskrit_iast:
tārābalena śītāṃśurbalavāṃstadvaśādraviḥ /
balī saṃkramamāṇastu tadvatkheṭā balādhikāḥ //
meaning:
ताराबलेन शीतांशुर्बलवांस्तद्वशाद्रविः /
बली संक्रममाणस्तु तद्वत्खेटा बलाधिकाः //
text_mt:
The cool-rayed moon is strong through the strength of constellations; under his sway the sun
is strong when transiting, and likewise the planets have greater strength.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhor'ke janmatastryāyadaśaṣaṭsu munīśvara /
navapañcāṃburiṣphasthairvyarkibhirvidhyate na cet //
meaning:
शुभोर्ऽके जन्मतस्त्र्यायदशषट्सु मुनीश्वर /
नवपञ्चांबुरिष्फस्थैर्व्यर्किभिर्विध्यते न चेत् //
text_mt:
The sun is auspicious in the third, eleventh, tenth, and sixth from the natal sign, O lord of sages,
if not obstructed by planets other than Saturn in the ninth, fifth, fourth, and twelfth.

sanskrit_iast:
śubho janmarkṣataścandro dyūnāṅgāyārisvatriṣu /
yatheṣṭāntyāṃbudharmasthaivibudhairvidhyate na cet //
meaning:
शुभो जन्मर्क्षतश्चन्द्रो द्यूनाङ्गायारिस्वत्रिषु /
यथेष्टान्त्यांबुधर्मस्थैविबुधैर्विध्यते न चेत् //
text_mt:
The moon is auspicious from the natal constellation in the seventh, sixth, eleventh, tenth, second, and third,
if not obstructed by planets in the fifth, twelfth, fourth, and ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
tryāyāriṣu kujaḥ śreṣṭho janmanā cenna vidhyate /
vyayeṣvaṅkasthitaiḥ saurisaumyasūryaiḥ śubhauṣadhāt //
meaning:
त्र्यायारिषु कुजः श्रेष्ठो जन्मना चेन्न विध्यते /
व्ययेष्वङ्कस्थितैः सौरिसौम्यसूर्यैः शुभौषधात् //
text_mt:
Mars is best in the third, eleventh, and sixth from the natal sign, if not obstructed
by Saturn, Mercury, and the sun located in the twelfth, fifth, and ninth.

sanskrit_iast:
jñaḥ svāyāryaṣṭaravayiṣu janmataścenna vidhaayate /
dhītryakādigajāntasthaiḥ śaśāṅkarahitaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञः स्वायार्यष्टरवयिषु जन्मतश्चेन्न विधअयते /
धीत्र्यकादिगजान्तस्थैः शशाङ्करहितैः शुभैः //
text_mt:
Mercury is auspicious from the natal sign in the second, fourth, sixth, eighth, tenth, and eleventh, if not obstructed
by benefics excluding the moon in the fifth, third, ninth, first, eighth, and twelfth.

sanskrit_iast:
janmarāśerguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svāyago 'dhyastago na cet /
vidhyatentyāṣṭaravāṃbutrigataiḥ ravaiṭairmunīśvarā //
meaning:
जन्मराशेर्गुरुः श्रेष्ठः स्वायगो ऽध्यस्तगो न चेत् /
विध्यतेन्त्याष्टरवांबुत्रिगतैः रवैटैर्मुनीश्वरा //
text_mt:
Jupiter is best in the second, eleventh, ninth, fifth, and seventh from the natal sign, if not
obstructed, O lord of sages, by planets in the twelfth, eighth, tenth, fourth, and third.

sanskrit_iast:
janmabhādāsutāṣṭāṅkāntyāyeṣviṣṭo bhṛgoḥsutaḥ /
cenna viddho 'ṣṭasaptāṅgam ravāṅkādyāyārirāmagaiḥ //
meaning:
जन्मभादासुताष्टाङ्कान्त्यायेष्विष्टो भृगोःसुतः /
चेन्न विद्धो ऽष्टसप्ताङ्गम् रवाङ्काद्यायारिरामगैः //
text_mt:
Venus is favored from the natal constellation in the first, second, third, fourth, fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, and eleventh,
if not obstructed by planets in the eighth, seventh, sixth, tenth, ninth, first, eleventh, sixth, and third.

sanskrit_iast:
na dadāti śubhaṃ kiñcidgocare vedhasaṃyute /
tasmādvedhaṃ vicāryātha kathanīyaṃ śubhāśubham //
meaning:
न ददाति शुभं किञ्चिद्गोचरे वेधसंयुते /
तस्माद्वेधं विचार्याथ कथनीयं शुभाशुभम् //
text_mt:
When transit is attended with an obstruction, it grants no auspicious fruit at all;
therefore, only after considering the obstruction should good or bad be declared.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmabhedavidhānena duṣṭo 'pi syācchubhaṅkaraḥ /
saumyekṣito 'niṣṭaphalaḥ śubhadaḥ pāpavīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
वामभेदविधानेन दुष्टो ऽपि स्याच्छुभङ्करः /
सौम्येक्षितो ऽनिष्टफलः शुभदः पापवीक्षितः //
text_mt:
By reverse variation, even a malefic can become an auspicious maker;
aspected by a benefic it may yield undesirable fruit, and aspected by a malefic it may yield good fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣphalau tau grahau svena śatruṇā ca vilokitau /
nīcarāśigataḥ svasya śatroḥ kṣetragato 'pi vā //
meaning:
निष्फलौ तौ ग्रहौ स्वेन शत्रुणा च विलोकितौ /
नीचराशिगतः स्वस्य शत्रोः क्षेत्रगतो ऽपि वा //
text_mt:
Those two planets become fruitless when aspected by their own enemy,
or when fallen into a sign of debilitation or into the field of their enemy,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ naiva dadyādastamitopi vā /
graheṣu viṣamastheṣu śāntiṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ //
meaning:
शुभाशुभफलं नैव दद्यादस्तमितोपि वा /
ग्रहेषु विषमस्थेषु शान्तिं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt:
or when combust; they would not grant good or bad fruit at all.
When planets are adversely situated, one should diligently perform pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
hānirvṛddhirgrahādhīnā tasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ /
maṇirmuktāphalaṃ vidrumākhyaṃ maraka taṃ tathā //
meaning:
हानिर्वृद्धिर्ग्रहाधीना तस्मात्पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः /
मणिर्मुक्ताफलं विद्रुमाख्यं मरक तं तथा //
text_mt:
Loss and gain depend on the planets; therefore, planets are most worthy of worship.
Ruby, pearl, coral, emerald,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāgaṃ tathā vajraṃ nīlaṃ gomedasaṃjñitam /
dūryyaṃ bhāskarādīnāṃ tuṣṭya dhāryaṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
पुष्परागं तथा वज्रं नीलं गोमेदसंज्ञितम् /
दूर्य्यं भास्करादीनां तुष्ट्य धार्यं यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
topaz, diamond, sapphire, hessonite,
and cat's-eye should be worn respectively for the gratification of the sun and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣādidivase candro yasya śubhapradaḥ /
sa pakṣastasya śubhadaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣonyathāśubhaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षादिदिवसे चन्द्रो यस्य शुभप्रदः /
स पक्षस्तस्य शुभदः कृष्णपक्षोन्यथाशुभः //
text_mt:
The person to whom the moon is auspicious on the first day of the bright fortnight,
to him that whole fortnight brings good; otherwise, the dark fortnight is inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe śubhaścandro dvitīyanavapañcame /
riḥpharandhrāṃbusaṃsthaiścainna viddho gagane caraiḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे शुभश्चन्द्रो द्वितीयनवपञ्चमे /
रिःफरन्ध्रांबुसंस्थैश्चैन्न विद्धो गगने चरैः //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, the Moon is auspicious in the second, ninth, and fifth [houses], / provided it is not afflicted by celestial bodies situated in the twelfth, eighth, or fourth houses.

sanskrit_iast:
janma saṃpadvipat kṣema pratyariḥ sādhako vadhaḥ /
mitraṃ paramamitraṃ ca janmabhāttu punaḥ puna //
meaning:
जन्म संपद्विपत् क्षेम प्रत्यरिः साधको वधः /
मित्रं परममित्रं च जन्मभात्तु पुनः पुन //
text_mt: Janma, Saṃpad, Vipat, Kṣema, Pratyari, Sādhaka, Vadha, / Mitra, and Parama-mitra [recur] again and again from the birth asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
janmatripañcasaptākhyāstārā neṣṭa phalapradāḥ /
śākaṃ guḍaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ satilaṃ kāñcanaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
जन्मत्रिपञ्चसप्ताख्यास्तारा नेष्ट फलप्रदाः /
शाकं गुडं च लवणं सतिलं काञ्चनं क्रमात् //
text_mt: The asterisms called the birth, third, fifth, and seventh do not yield desirable fruits. / Vegetables, jaggery, salt, sesame seeds, and gold [should be offered] respectively,

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭaphalanāśāya dadyādetaddvijātaye /
kṛṣṇe balavatī tārā śuklapakṣe balū śaśī /
candrasya dvādaśāvasthā rāśaurāśau yathākramam //
meaning:
अनिष्टफलनाशाय दद्यादेतद्द्विजातये /
कृष्णे बलवती तारा शुक्लपक्षे बलू शशी /
चन्द्रस्य द्वादशावस्था राशौराशौ यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: and given to a twice-born man to destroy inauspicious fruits. / In the dark fortnight the asterism is powerful; in the bright fortnight the Moon is powerful. / The Moon has twelve states in each sign in succession:

sanskrit_iast:
yātrodvāhādikāryeṣu nāmatulyaphalapradāḥ /
ṣaṣṭighnaṃ gatacandrarkṣaṃ tatkālaghaṭikānvitam /
vedaghnamiṣuvedāntyamavasthā bhānubhāgataḥ //
meaning:
यात्रोद्वाहादिकार्येषु नामतुल्यफलप्रदाः /
षष्टिघ्नं गतचन्द्रर्क्षं तत्कालघटिकान्वितम् /
वेदघ्नमिषुवेदान्त्यमवस्था भानुभागतः //
text_mt: In activities such as journeys and weddings, they grant results equal to their names. / Multiply the elapsed lunar asterism by sixty, add the current ghaṭikās, / multiply by four, and divide by forty-five: [the result is] the state from the Sun’s degree.

sanskrit_iast:
pravāsanaṣṭākhyamṛtā jayo hāsyaṃ ratimudā /
śinibhuktirjvaraḥ kaṃpaḥ susthitirnāmasannibhāḥṛ //
meaning:
प्रवासनष्टाख्यमृता जयो हास्यं रतिमुदा /
शिनिभुक्तिर्ज्वरः कंपः सुस्थितिर्नामसन्निभाःऋ //
text_mt: Pravāsa, Naṣṭa, Mṛta, Jaya, Hāsya, Rati, Mudā, / Śubhā, Bhukti, Jvara, Kampa, and Susthiti correspond to their names.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭṭabandhanayānograsaṃdhivigrahabhūṣaṇam /
dhātvākaraṃ yuddhakarma meṣalagne prasiddhyati //
meaning:
पट्टबन्धनयानोग्रसंधिविग्रहभूषणम् /
धात्वाकरं युद्धकर्म मेषलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Coronation, travel, harsh treaties and war, ornament, / metal mines, and acts of battle succeed in the Aries ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalāni sthirāṇyaṃvuveśmakarmapravartanam /
kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvādiduṣṭalagne prasiddhyati //
meaning:
मङ्गलानि स्थिराण्यंवुवेश्मकर्मप्रवर्तनम् /
कृषिवाणिज्यपश्वादिदुष्टलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Fixed auspicious rites, waterworks, commencement of house building, / agriculture, trade, and cattle succeed in the Taurus ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāvijñānaśilpāni bhūṣaṇāhavasaṃśravam /
gajodvāhābhiṣekādyaṃ karttavyaṃ mithunodaye //
meaning:
कलाविज्ञानशिल्पानि भूषणाहवसंश्रवम् /
गजोद्वाहाभिषेकाद्यं कर्त्तव्यं मिथुनोदये //
text_mt: Fine arts, sciences, crafts, ornament, battle alliances, / elephant-lore, wedding, and consecration should be performed at the rising of Gemini.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpīkūpataḍāgādi vāribandhanamokṣaṇam /
pauṣṭikaṃ lipilekhādi kartavyaṃ karkaṭodaye //
meaning:
वापीकूपतडागादि वारिबन्धनमोक्षणम् /
पौष्टिकं लिपिलेखादि कर्तव्यं कर्कटोदये //
text_mt: Stepwells, wells, ponds, damming and releasing of water, / rites for nourishment, and writing of scripts should be performed at the rising of Cancer.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣudhānyavaṇikpaṇyakṛṣisevādayaḥsthire /
sāhasāhavabhūpādyaṃ siṃhalagne prasiddhyati //
meaning:
इक्षुधान्यवणिक्पण्यकृषिसेवादयःस्थिरे /
साहसाहवभूपाद्यं सिंहलग्ने प्रसिद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Sugarcane, grain, mercantile merchandise, agriculture, service, and fixed matters, / ventures of daring, battle, and kingly matters succeed in the Leo ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāśilpauṣadhaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca carasthiram /
kanyā lagne vidheyaṃ ca pauṣṭikākhilamaṅgalam //
meaning:
विद्याशिल्पौषधं कृत्यं भूषणं च चरस्थिरम् /
कन्या लग्ने विधेयं च पौष्टिकाखिलमङ्गलम् //
text_mt: Learning, crafts, medicine, actions, movable and fixed ornaments, / and all auspicious rites for nourishment should be performed in the Virgo ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣivāṇijyayānaṃ ca paśūdvāhavratādikam /
tulāyāmakhilaṃ karma tulābhārāśrite ca yat //
meaning:
कृषिवाणिज्ययानं च पशूद्वाहव्रतादिकम् /
तुलायामखिलं कर्म तुलाभाराश्रिते च यत् //
text_mt: Agriculture, trade, journey, cattle, wedding, vows, / and every action pertaining to balances should be performed in Libra.

sanskrit_iast:
sthirakarmākhilaṃ kāryaṃ rājasevābhiṣecanam /
cauryakarmasthirāraṃbhāḥ kartavyā vṛścikodaye //
meaning:
स्थिरकर्माखिलं कार्यं राजसेवाभिषेचनम् /
चौर्यकर्मस्थिरारंभाः कर्तव्या वृश्चिकोदये //
text_mt: All fixed actions should be done, service to kings, consecration, / theft, and firm undertakings should be performed at the rising of Scorpio.

sanskrit_iast:
vratodvāhaprayāṇāśvagajaśilpakalādikam /
carasthiravimiśraṃ ca kartavyaṃ kārmukodaye //
meaning:
व्रतोद्वाहप्रयाणाश्वगजशिल्पकलादिकम् /
चरस्थिरविमिश्रं च कर्तव्यं कार्मुकोदये //
text_mt: Vows, wedding, journey, horses, elephants, crafts, and arts, / whether movable, fixed, or mixed, should be performed at the rising of Sagittarius.

sanskrit_iast:
cāpabandhanamokṣāstrakṛṣigośvādikam yat /
prasthānaṃ paśudāsādi kartavyaṃ makarodaye //
meaning:
चापबन्धनमोक्षास्त्रकृषिगोश्वादिकम् यत् /
प्रस्थानं पशुदासादि कर्तव्यं मकरोदये //
text_mt: Stringing of bows, discharging of weapons, agriculture, cattle, horses, / departure, livestock, and servants should be dealt with at the rising of Capricorn.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣivāṇijyapaśvaṃbuśilpaṅkarmakalādikam /
jalapātrāstrāśastrādi kartavyaṃ kalaśodaye //
meaning:
कृषिवाणिज्यपश्वंबुशिल्पङ्कर्मकलादिकम् /
जलपात्रास्त्राशस्त्रादि कर्तव्यं कलशोदये //
text_mt: Agriculture, trade, cattle, waterworks, crafts, and arts, / water-vessels, and weapons should be attended to at the rising of Aquarius.

sanskrit_iast:
vratodvāhābhiṣekāṃbusthāpanaṃ sanniveśanam /
bhūṣaṇaṃ jalapātrāśvakarma mīnodaye śubham //
meaning:
व्रतोद्वाहाभिषेकांबुस्थापनं सन्निवेशनम् /
भूषणं जलपात्राश्वकर्म मीनोदये शुभम् //
text_mt: Vows, wedding, consecration, installation of water reservoirs, settlement, / ornaments, water-vessels, and acts concerning horses are auspicious at the rising of Pisces.

sanskrit_iast:
meṣādiṣu kligneṣu śuddheṣvevaṃ prasiddhyati /
krūragrahekṣiteṣūgrasaṃyuteṣūgrameva hi //
meaning:
मेषादिषु क्लिग्नेषु शुद्धेष्वेवं प्रसिद्ध्यति /
क्रूरग्रहेक्षितेषूग्रसंयुतेषूग्रमेव हि //
text_mt: In ascendants beginning with Aries, thus success comes when they are pure; / but when aspected by malefic planets or conjoined with fierce ones, the result is indeed fierce.

sanskrit_iast:
goyugmakarkakanyāntyatulācāpadharāḥ śubhāḥ /
śubharkṣatvāśubhāsatya itarā pāparāśayaḥ //
meaning:
गोयुग्मकर्ककन्यान्त्यतुलाचापधराः शुभाः /
शुभर्क्षत्वाशुभासत्य इतरा पापराशयः //
text_mt: Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Virgo, Pisces, Libra, and Sagittarius are auspicious; / because they are auspicious signs, the others are indeed malefic signs.

sanskrit_iast:
grahayogāvalokābhyāṃ rāśirdhatte grahodbhavam /
phalaṃ tābhyāṃ vihīno 'sau svabhāvamupasarpati //
meaning:
ग्रहयोगावलोकाभ्यां राशिर्धत्ते ग्रहोद्भवम् /
फलं ताभ्यां विहीनो ऽसौ स्वभावमुपसर्पति //
text_mt: By planetary conjunction and aspect, a sign takes on the nature arising from that planet; / devoid of these two, it maintains its own inherent nature.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau saṃpūrṇaphaladaṃ madhye madhyaphalapradam /
ante tucchaphale lagne sarvasminnevameva hi //
meaning:
आदौ संपूर्णफलदं मध्ये मध्यफलप्रदम् /
अन्ते तुच्छफले लग्ने सर्वस्मिन्नेवमेव हि //
text_mt: It yields full fruit at the beginning, middling fruit in the middle, / and negligible fruit at the end; this is indeed so in every ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra prathamaṃ lagnaṃ kartuścandrabalaṃ tataḥ /
kalpyāmadindau balini saptame balino grahāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वत्र प्रथमं लग्नं कर्तुश्चन्द्रबलं ततः /
कल्प्यामदिन्दौ बलिनि सप्तमे बलिनो ग्रहाः //
text_mt: In all matters, the ascendant is foremost, and then the lunar strength of the performer; / when the Moon is strong, the planets in the seventh house are also judged strong.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasya valimādhāramādheya cānyakheṭakam /
ādhārabhūtenādheyaṃ dhīyate paridhiṣṭinam //
meaning:
चन्द्रस्य वलिमाधारमाधेय चान्यखेटकम् /
आधारभूतेनाधेयं धीयते परिधिष्टिनम् //
text_mt: The strength of the Moon is the substratum, and the other planets are the content; / by means of the substratum, the content placed in that abode is sustained.

sanskrit_iast:
cendinduḥ śubhadaḥ sarve grahāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ /
aśubhaścedaśubhadā varjayitvā dhanādhipam //
meaning:
चेन्दिन्दुः शुभदः सर्वे ग्रहाः शुभफलप्रदाः /
अशुभश्चेदशुभदा वर्जयित्वा धनाधिपम् //
text_mt: If the Moon is auspicious, all planets yield auspicious results; / if it is inauspicious, they yield inauspicious results, except for the lord of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnasyābhyuditā yeṃśāsteṣvaṃśeṣu sthito grahaḥ /
lagnodbhavaṃ phalaṃ dhatte dhanātīto dvitīyakam //
meaning:
लग्नस्याभ्युदिता येंशास्तेष्वंशेषु स्थितो ग्रहः /
लग्नोद्भवं फलं धत्ते धनातीतो द्वितीयकम् //
text_mt: A planet situated in the degrees of the ascendant that have already risen / brings forth the fruit arising from the ascendant; beyond the degrees of the ascendant, it brings forth that of the second house.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sthāneṣu śeṣeṣu caivamevaṃ prakalpayet /
lagnaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ labhyate 'lpairdinairno //
meaning:
एवं स्थानेषु शेषेषु चैवमेवं प्रकल्पयेत् /
लग्नं सर्वगुणोपेतं लभ्यते ऽल्पैर्दिनैर्नो //
text_mt: In the remaining houses too, one should reckon in the very same way. / An ascendant endowed with all good qualities is not easily obtained within a few days.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikyaṃ bahu saṃtatamiṣyate /
doṣādduṣṭo hi kālastamapi mārṣṭuṃ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
दोषाल्पत्वं गुणाधिक्यं बहु संततमिष्यते /
दोषाद्दुष्टो हि कालस्तमपि मार्ष्टुं पितामहः //
text_mt: Few faults and an abundance of virtues are always desired; / for when a time is corrupted by faults, even Brahmā cannot wipe them away.

sanskrit_iast:
apyaśaucatuṇādhikyaṃ doṣānyatte tato hi te /
amāriktāṣṭamīṣaṣṭīdvādaśīpratipatsvapi //
meaning:
अप्यशौचतुणाधिक्यं दोषान्यत्ते ततो हि ते /
अमारिक्ताष्टमीषष्टीद्वादशीप्रतिपत्स्वपि //
text_mt: Even ritual impurity and an abundance of straw cause other faults for you; / therefore, on the new moon, empty lunar days, the eighth, sixth, twelfth, and first lunar days,

sanskrit_iast:
parighasya ca pūrvārddhaṃ vyatīpāte savaidhṛtau /
saṃdhyāsūpaplave viṣṭyāmaśubhaṃ prathamārttavam //
meaning:
परिघस्य च पूर्वार्द्धं व्यतीपाते सवैधृतौ /
संध्यासूपप्लवे विष्ट्यामशुभं प्रथमार्त्तवम् //
text_mt: and in the first half of Parigha, in Vyatīpāta and Vaidhṛti, / at twilight, during eclipses, and in Viṣṭi, the first menstruation is inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
rugṇā patipriyā duḥkhī putriṇī bhogamī tathā /
pativratā keśayuktā sūryavārādiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
रुग्णा पतिप्रिया दुःखी पुत्रिणी भोगमी तथा /
पतिव्रता केशयुक्ता सूर्यवारादिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: [On such days, a woman becomes] diseased, beloved of her husband, sorrowful, having sons, sensual, / devoted to her husband, or filled with trouble, respectively, on Sunday and following weekdays.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmāgniraudrabhāgyayāhidvīśendrādihyupadviṣāḥ /
tārakā na hitā māsā madhūrjaśucipauṣakāḥ //
meaning:
यामाग्निरौद्रभाग्ययाहिद्वीशेन्द्रादिह्युपद्विषाः /
तारका न हिता मासा मधूर्जशुचिपौषकाः //
text_mt: The asterisms Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, Ārdrā, Pūrvaphalgunī, Āśleṣā, Viśākhā, Jyeṣṭhā, etc., are harmful; / the months Caitra, Kārttika, Āṣāḍha, and Pauṣa are not beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrā ca saṃkramonidrā rātriścandrārkayorgrahaḥ /
kulaṭā pāpabhogeṣu nindyarkṣe nindyavāsare //
meaning:
भद्रा च संक्रमोनिद्रा रात्रिश्चन्द्रार्कयोर्ग्रहः /
कुलटा पापभोगेषु निन्द्यर्क्षे निन्द्यवासरे //
text_mt: Bhadrā, solar transit, sleep, night, and eclipses of the Moon or Sun— / on inauspicious asterisms and inauspicious weekdays, [she becomes] unchaste, indulging in sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tilājyadūrvā juhuyādgāyatryāṣṭaśataṃ budhaḥ /
suvarṇagotilāndadyātsarvadoṣāpanuttaye //
meaning:
तिलाज्यदूर्वा जुहुयाद्गायत्र्याष्टशतं बुधः /
सुवर्णगोतिलान्दद्यात्सर्वदोषापनुत्तये //
text_mt: A wise man should offer one hundred and eight oblations of sesame seeds, clarified butter, and dūrvā grass with the gāyatrī, / and should give gold, a cow, and sesame seeds to remove all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyā niśaścatasrastu tyājyā hyapi samāḥ paraiḥ /
ojarāśyaṃśage candre lagne puṅgrahavīkṣite //
meaning:
आद्या निशश्चतस्रस्तु त्याज्या ह्यपि समाः परैः /
ओजराश्यंशगे चन्द्रे लग्ने पुङ्ग्रहवीक्षिते //
text_mt: The first four nights are to be avoided, and even nights are preferred by others; / when the Moon is in an odd sign or navāṃśa, and the ascendant is aspected by male planets,

sanskrit_iast:
upavītī yugmatithāvanagnaḥ kāmayetstriyam /
putrārthī puruṣaśastyaktvā pauṣṇamūlāhipitryabham //
meaning:
उपवीती युग्मतिथावनग्नः कामयेत्स्त्रियम् /
पुत्रार्थी पुरुषशस्त्यक्त्वा पौष्णमूलाहिपित्र्यभम् //
text_mt: a man wearing the sacred thread, not naked, on an even lunar day, desiring a son, / should make love to his wife, avoiding the asterisms Revatī, Mūla, Āśleṣā, and Maghā.

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhe prathame garbhe tṛtīye vā dvitīyake /
māse puṃsavanaṃ kāryaṃ sīmantaṃ ca yathā tathā //
meaning:
प्रसिद्धे प्रथमे गर्भे तृतीये वा द्वितीयके /
मासे पुंसवनं कार्यं सीमन्तं च यथा तथा //
text_mt: When the first pregnancy is known, in the second or third / month, the puṃsavana rite should be performed, and the sīmanta in due manner.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe māsi ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame vā tadīśvare /
balopapanne daṃpatyoścandratārābalānvite //
meaning:
चतुर्थे मासि षष्टे वाप्यष्टमे वा तदीश्वरे /
बलोपपन्ने दंपत्योश्चन्द्रताराबलान्विते //
text_mt: In the fourth, sixth, or eighth month, when its ruling lord / is endowed with strength, and the couple possesses the strength of the Moon and asterisms,

sanskrit_iast:
ariktāparvadivase kujajīvārkavāsare /
tīkṣṇamiśrārkavarjyeṣu puṃbhāṃśerātrināyake //
meaning:
अरिक्तापर्वदिवसे कुजजीवार्कवासरे /
तीक्ष्णमिश्रार्कवर्ज्येषु पुंभांशेरात्रिनायके //
text_mt: on a day that is not empty or a parvan, on Tuesday, Thursday, or Sunday, / avoiding sharp, mixed, and Sun asterisms, when the Moon is in a masculine sign or division,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhe 'ṣṭame janmalagnāttayorlagne na naidhane /
śubhagrahayute dṛṣṭe pāpadṛṣṭivivarjite //
meaning:
शुद्धे ऽष्टमे जन्मलग्नात्तयोर्लग्ने न नैधने /
शुभग्रहयुते दृष्टे पापदृष्टिविवर्जिते //
text_mt: when the eighth house from their birth ascendant is pure, the ascendant not being the eighth, / conjoined with or aspected by auspicious planets, and devoid of the aspect of malefic planets,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhagraheṣu dhīdharmakendreṣvaribhave triṣu /
pāpeṣu satsu candretyanidhanādyarivarjite //
meaning:
शुभग्रहेषु धीधर्मकेन्द्रेष्वरिभवे त्रिषु /
पापेषु सत्सु चन्द्रेत्यनिधनाद्यरिवर्जिते //
text_mt: when auspicious planets are in the fifth, ninth, and kendra houses, and malefic planets / are in the sixth, eleventh, and third houses, and the Moon is devoid of the eighth, first, and sixth houses.

sanskrit_iast:
krūragrahāṇāmekopi lagnādantyātmajāṣṭagaḥ /
sīmantinīṃ vā tadgarbhaṃ balī hṝnti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
क्रूरग्रहाणामेकोपि लग्नादन्त्यात्मजाष्टगः /
सीमन्तिनीं वा तद्गर्भं बली हॄन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt: Even a single cruel planet situated in the twelfth, fifth, or eighth house from the ascendant, / if strong, undoubtedly kills the woman or her fetus.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiñjanmamuhūrte 'pi sūtakāntepi vā śiśoḥ /
jātakarma prakartavyaṃ pitṛpūjanapūrvakam //
meaning:
तस्मिञ्जन्ममुहूर्ते ऽपि सूतकान्तेपि वा शिशोः /
जातकर्म प्रकर्तव्यं पितृपूजनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: At that very birth-moment, or at the end of the period of birth-impurity, / the birth-rite of the child should be performed, preceded by the worship of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtakānte nāmakarma vidheyaṃ tatkulocitam /
nāmapūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syānmaṅgalaiḥ susamīkṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
सूतकान्ते नामकर्म विधेयं तत्कुलोचितम् /
नामपूर्वं प्रशस्तं स्यान्मङ्गलैः सुसमीक्षितैः //
text_mt: At the end of the period of birth-impurity, the naming ceremony suited to one's family should be performed. / The prefix of the name should be auspicious, accompanied by well-examined auspicious signs.

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālopaghātādyaiḥ kālātikramaṇaṃ yadā /
anastage bhṛgāvījye tatkārye cottarāyaṇe //
meaning:
देशकालोपघाताद्यैः कालातिक्रमणं यदा /
अनस्तगे भृगावीज्ये तत्कार्ये चोत्तरायणे //
text_mt: When there is a lapse of time due to afflictions of place, time, and so forth, / it should be performed during the northern course of the sun, when Venus and Jupiter are uncombust,

sanskrit_iast:
carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhavāsare /
candrātārābalopete divase ca śiśoḥ pituḥ //
meaning:
चरस्थिरमृदुक्षिप्रनक्षत्रे शुभवासरे /
चन्द्राताराबलोपेते दिवसे च शिशोः पितुः //
text_mt: in a movable, fixed, gentle, or swift lunar mansion, on an auspicious weekday, / on a day possessing the strength of the moon and stars for the child and the father,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca nidhane śuddhisaṃyute /
ṣaṣṭe māsyaṣṭame vāpi puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ tu pañcame //
meaning:
शुभलग्ने शुभांशे च निधने शुद्धिसंयुते /
षष्टे मास्यष्टमे वापि पुंसां स्त्रीणां तु पञ्चमे //
text_mt: under an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, with purity in the eighth house, / in the sixth or eighth month for males, but in the fifth for females.

sanskrit_iast:
saptame māsi vā kāryaṃ navānnapraśanaṃ śubham /
riktāṃ dinakṣayaṃ nandāṃ dvādaśīmaṣṭamīmatha //
meaning:
सप्तमे मासि वा कार्यं नवान्नप्रशनं शुभम् /
रिक्तां दिनक्षयं नन्दां द्वादशीमष्टमीमथ //
text_mt: Or in the seventh month, the auspicious first feeding of new grain is to be performed. / Having avoided a riktā, a day of loss (dinakṣaya), a nandā, the twelfth, and also the eighth [lunar day],

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvānyatithiṣu proktaṃ praśanaṃ śubhavāsare /
carasthiramṛdukṣipranakṣatre śubhanaidhane //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वान्यतिथिषु प्रोक्तं प्रशनं शुभवासरे /
चरस्थिरमृदुक्षिप्रनक्षत्रे शुभनैधने //
text_mt: Feeding is prescribed on the other lunar days, on an auspicious weekday, / under a movable, fixed, gentle, or swift asterism, when the eighth house is auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
daśame śuddhisaṃyukte śubhalagne śubhāṃśake /
