pūrvārddhe saumyakheṭena saṃyukte vīkṣitepi vā //
meaning:
दशमे शुद्धिसंयुक्ते शुभलग्ने शुभांशके /
पूर्वार्द्धे सौम्यखेटेन संयुक्ते वीक्षितेपि वा //
text_mt: When the tenth house is pure, in an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, / in the first half [of the day], combined with or aspected by a benefic planet,

sanskrit_iast:
triṣaṣṭalābhagaiḥ krūraiḥ kendradhīdharmagaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
vyayārinidhanasthe ca candre 'nnaprāśanaṃ śubham //
meaning:
त्रिषष्टलाभगैः क्रूरैः केन्द्रधीधर्मगैः शुभैः /
व्ययारिनिधनस्थे च चन्द्रे ऽन्नप्राशनं शुभम् //
text_mt: With malefics in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, with benefics in quadrants, the fifth, or ninth houses, / and the Moon in the twelfth, sixth, or eighth house, the first feeding of grain is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye pañcame cābde svakulācārato 'pi vā /
bālānāṃ janmataścaulaṃ svagṛhyoktavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तृतीये पञ्चमे चाब्दे स्वकुलाचारतो ऽपि वा /
बालानां जन्मतश्चौलं स्वगृह्योक्तविधानतः //
text_mt: In the third or fifth year, or according to one’s own family custom, / the tonsure of boys from birth is to be done according to the rule prescribed in one’s own Gṛhyasūtra,

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāyane nāstagayoḥ surārisuramantriṇoḥ /
aparvariktātithiṣu śukrejyajñenduvāsare //
meaning:
सौम्यायने नास्तगयोः सुरारिसुरमन्त्रिणोः /
अपर्वरिक्तातिथिषु शुक्रेज्यज्ञेन्दुवासरे //
text_mt: During the northern course of the sun, when the counsellor of the enemies of the gods (Śukra) and the counsellor of the gods (Bṛhaspati) have not set, / on non-parvan and non-riktā lunar days, on Friday, Thursday, Wednesday, or Monday,

sanskrit_iast:
dasrāditījyacandrendrapūṣabhāni śubhāni ca /
caulakarmaṇi hastakṣārrtrīṇitrīṇi ca viṣṇubhāt //
meaning:
दस्रादितीज्यचन्द्रेन्द्रपूषभानि शुभानि च /
चौलकर्मणि हस्तक्षार्र्त्रीणित्रीणि च विष्णुभात् //
text_mt: Aśvinī, Punarvasu, Puṣya, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Jyeṣṭhā, and Revatī are auspicious; / in the rite of tonsure, the three asterisms from Hasta and the three from Śravaṇa [are auspicious].

sanskrit_iast:
paṭṭabandhanacaulānnaprāśane copanāyane /
śubhadaṃ janmanakṣatramaśubhaṃ tvanyakarmaṇi //
meaning:
पट्टबन्धनचौलान्नप्राशने चोपनायने /
शुभदं जन्मनक्षत्रमशुभं त्वन्यकर्मणि //
text_mt: In the tying of the fillet, tonsure, the first feeding of grain, and the sacred-thread investiture, / the birth asterism yields good fortune, but in other rites it is inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame śuddhisaṃyukteṃ śubhalagne śubhāṃśake /
janmāṣṭame na śītāṃśau ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite //
meaning:
अष्टमे शुद्धिसंयुक्तें शुभलग्ने शुभांशके /
जन्माष्टमे न शीतांशौ षष्टाष्टान्त्यविवर्जिते //
text_mt: When the eighth house is pure, in an auspicious ascendant and auspicious navāṃśa, / with the cold-rayed Moon not in the eighth house from the birth-Moon, avoiding the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ /
abhyakte sandhyayornāre niśi bhuktvā na vāhave //
meaning:
धनत्रिकोणकेन्द्रस्थैः शुभैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः /
अभ्यक्ते सन्ध्ययोर्नारे निशि भुक्त्वा न वाहवे //
text_mt: With benefics occupying the second, trine, and quadrant houses, and others occupying the third, eleventh, and sixth houses. / Shaving is not to be done when smeared with oil, at the two twilights, on Tuesday, at night, having eaten, nor in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
notkaṭe bhūṣite naiva yāne na navame 'hni ca /
kṣaurakarma mahīpānāṃ pañcamepañcame 'hani //
meaning:
नोत्कटे भूषिते नैव याने न नवमे ऽह्नि च /
क्षौरकर्म महीपानां पञ्चमेपञ्चमे ऽहनि //
text_mt: Nor when arrogant, nor when adorned, nor in a vehicle, nor on the ninth lunar day. / The shaving of kings is to be done on every fifth day;

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ kṣoranakṣatre 'pyatha vāsyodaye śubham /
nṛpaviprājñayā yajñe maraṇe bandhamokṣaṇeṃ //
meaning:
कर्तव्यं क्षोरनक्षत्रे ऽप्यथ वास्योदये शुभम् /
नृपविप्राज्ञया यज्ञे मरणे बन्धमोक्षणें //
text_mt: It is to be done under a shaving asterism, or auspiciously at its rising; / or by the command of a king or a brāhmaṇa, at a sacrifice, upon a death, or upon release from bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhe 'khilavārarkṣatithiṣu kṣauramiṣṭadam /
kartavyaṃ maṅgaleṣvādau maṅgalāya kṣurārpaṇam //
meaning:
उद्वाहे ऽखिलवारर्क्षतिथिषु क्षौरमिष्टदम् /
कर्तव्यं मङ्गलेष्वादौ मङ्गलाय क्षुरार्पणम् //
text_mt: In marriage, shaving is wish-granting on all weekdays, asterisms, and lunar days. / In auspicious rites, the application of the razor is to be done first for the sake of good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
navame saptame vāpi pañcame divase 'pi vā /
tṛtīye bījanakṣatre śubhavāre śubhodaye //
meaning:
नवमे सप्तमे वापि पञ्चमे दिवसे ऽपि वा /
तृतीये बीजनक्षत्रे शुभवारे शुभोदये //
text_mt: On the ninth, seventh, fifth, / or third day, under a seed-sowing asterism, on an auspicious weekday, at an auspicious rising,

sanskrit_iast:
samyaggṛhāṇyalaṅkṛtya vitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ /
āśiṣo vācanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyāṅganādibhiḥ //
meaning:
सम्यग्गृहाण्यलङ्कृत्य वितानध्वजतोरणैः /
आशिषो वाचनं कार्यं पुण्यं पुण्याङ्गनादिभिः //
text_mt: Having properly decorated the houses with canopies, flags, and arched doorways, / a recitation of auspicious blessings should be performed by virtuous women and others.

sanskrit_iast:
sahavāditranṛtyādyairgatvā prāguttarāṃ diśam /
tatra mṛdatatastīkṣṇā gṛhītvā punarāgataḥ //
meaning:
सहवादित्रनृत्याद्यैर्गत्वा प्रागुत्तरां दिशम् /
तत्र मृदततस्तीक्ष्णा गृहीत्वा पुनरागतः //
text_mt: Having gone toward the north-east with musical instruments, dance, and the like, / and having taken sharp, fresh earth from there, returning again,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṇyaye 'pyathavā vaiṇave 'pi pātre prapūrayet /
anekabījasaṃyuktaṃ toyaṃ puṣpābhiśobhitam //
meaning:
मृण्यये ऽप्यथवा वैणवे ऽपि पात्रे प्रपूरयेत् /
अनेकबीजसंयुक्तं तोयं पुष्पाभिशोभितम् //
text_mt: One should fill an earthen or bamboo vessel / with water containing many seeds and adorned with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhānādaṣṭame varṣe janmato vāgrajanmanām /
rājñā mekādaśe maiñjībandhanaṃ dvādaśe viśām //
meaning:
आधानादष्टमे वर्षे जन्मतो वाग्रजन्मनाम् /
राज्ञा मेकादशे मैञ्जीबन्धनं द्वादशे विशाम् //
text_mt: The tying of the muñja grass girdle is in the eighth year from conception or from birth for the first-born (brāhmaṇas), / in the eleventh for kings (kṣatriyas), and in the twelfth for vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
janmataḥ pañcame varṣe vedaśāstrariṃśāradaḥ /
upavītī yataḥ śrīmānkāryaṃ tatropanāyanam //
meaning:
जन्मतः पञ्चमे वर्षे वेदशास्त्ररिंशारदः /
उपवीती यतः श्रीमान्कार्यं तत्रोपनायनम् //
text_mt: Or, from birth in the fifth year, in order that the boy become learned in the Vedas and Śāstras, / endowed with the sacred thread, and prosperous, the investiture should be performed then.

sanskrit_iast:
bālasya balahīno 'pari sito jīvaḥ śubhapradaḥ /
yathoktavatsare kāryamanukte nopanāyanam //
meaning:
बालस्य बलहीनो ऽपरि सितो जीवः शुभप्रदः /
यथोक्तवत्सरे कार्यमनुक्ते नोपनायनम् //
text_mt: Even if devoid of strength for a child, Śukra and Bṛhaspati grant good fortune. / The investiture is to be performed in the year prescribed, not in an unprescribed one.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyamānagurau śukre śākheśe cottarāyaṇe /
vedānāmadhipā jīvaśukrabhaumabudhāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
दृश्यमानगुरौ शुक्रे शाखेशे चोत्तरायणे /
वेदानामधिपा जीवशुक्रभौमबुधाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: When Bṛhaspati, Śukra, and the lord of the Vedic branch are visible, and in the northern course of the sun. / The lords of the Vedas are, respectively, Bṛhaspati, Śukra, Mars, and Mercury.

sanskrit_iast:
śaradgrīṣmavasaṃteṣu vyutkramāttu dvijanmanām /
mukhyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tapomāsādipañcasu //
meaning:
शरद्ग्रीष्मवसंतेषु व्युत्क्रमात्तु द्विजन्मनाम् /
मुख्यं साधारणं तेषां तपोमासादिपञ्चसु //
text_mt: In autumn, summer, and spring, respectively, in reverse order for the twice-born. / The primary, common time for them is in the five months beginning with the month of Tapas (Māgha).

sanskrit_iast:
svakulācāradharmajño mādhamāse tu phalgune /
vidhijñaścārthavāṃścaitre vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
स्वकुलाचारधर्मज्ञो माधमासे तु फल्गुने /
विधिज्ञश्चार्थवांश्चैत्रे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt: [Invested] in the month of Māgha, he knows the family customs and duty; in Phālguna, / he knows the rules and is wealthy; in Caitra, he masters the Vedas and Vedāṅgas;

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśāṣe dhanavānvendaśāstravidyāviśāradaḥ /
upanīto balāḍhyaśca jyeṣṭhe vidhividāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
वैशाषे धनवान्वेन्दशास्त्रविद्याविशारदः /
उपनीतो बलाढ्यश्च ज्येष्ठे विधिविदां वरः //
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, he becomes wealthy and learned in the knowledge of the Vedas and Śāstras; / invested in Jyeṣṭha, he becomes full of strength and the best of knowers of ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā pañcamī tathā /
trayodaśī ca daśamī saptamī vratabandhane //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे द्वितीया च तृतीया पञ्चमी तथा /
त्रयोदशी च दशमी सप्तमी व्रतबन्धने //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, the second, third, and fifth, / as well as the thirteenth, tenth, and seventh are good for the binding of the vow (investiture);

sanskrit_iast:
śreṣṭhā tvekādaśī ṣaṣṭī dvādaśyanyāstu madhyamāḥ /
kṛthaṣṇe dvitrīṣusaṃkhyāśca tithyo 'nyā hyatininditāḥ //
meaning:
श्रेष्ठा त्वेकादशी षष्टी द्वादश्यन्यास्तु मध्यमाः /
कृथष्णे द्वित्रीषुसंख्याश्च तिथ्यो ऽन्या ह्यतिनिन्दिताः //
text_mt: The eleventh, sixth, and twelfth are best, while the others are middling. / In the dark fortnight, the lunar days numbered two, three, and five [are acceptable]; the others are highly condemned.

sanskrit_iast:
dhiṣṇānyarkatrayāntejyarudrādityuttarāṇi ca /
viṣṇutrayāṃśvimitrābjayonibhānyupanāyane //
meaning:
धिष्णान्यर्कत्रयान्तेज्यरुद्रादित्युत्तराणि च /
विष्णुत्रयांश्विमित्राब्जयोनिभान्युपनायने //
text_mt: The asterisms are the three from Hasta, Puṣya, Ārdrā, the three Uttarās, / the three from Śravaṇa, Anurādhā, and Rohiṇī for the sacred-thread investiture.

sanskrit_iast:
janmabhāddaśamaṃ karma saṃghātarkṣaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam /
aṣṭādaśaṃ samudayaṃ trayoviṃśaṃ vināśanam //
meaning:
जन्मभाद्दशमं कर्म संघातर्क्षं तु षोडशम् /
अष्टादशं समुदयं त्रयोविंशं विनाशनम् //
text_mt: The tenth asterism from the birth-star is the karma star, the sixteenth is the saṃghāta star, / the eighteenth is the samudaya, the twenty-third is the vināśana,

sanskrit_iast:
mānasaṃ mānasaṃ pañcaviṃśarkṣaṃ nācarecchubhameṣu tu /
ācāryasaumyakāvyānāṃ vārāḥ śastāḥ śaśīnayoḥ //
meaning:
मानसं मानसं पञ्चविंशर्क्षं नाचरेच्छुभमेषु तु /
आचार्यसौम्यकाव्यानां वाराः शस्ताः शशीनयोः //
text_mt: And the twenty-fifth is the mānasa star; one should not perform an auspicious rite under these. / The days of Bṛhaspati, Mercury, and Śukra are praiseworthy; those of the Moon and the Sun

sanskrit_iast:
vārau tu madhyamau caiva vrate 'nyau ninditau matau /
tridhā vibhajya divasaṃ tatrādau karma daivikam //
meaning:
वारौ तु मध्यमौ चैव व्रते ऽन्यौ निन्दितौ मतौ /
त्रिधा विभज्य दिवसं तत्रादौ कर्म दैविकम् //
text_mt: Are middling, and the other two are considered condemned for the vow. / Dividing the day into three parts: in the first, divine work;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye mānuṣaṃ kāryaṃ tṛtīye ḥṃśe ca paitṛkam /
svanīcage tadaṃśe vā svāribhe vā tadaṃśake //
meaning:
द्वितीये मानुषं कार्यं तृतीये ःंशे च पैतृकम् /
स्वनीचगे तदंशे वा स्वारिभे वा तदंशके //
text_mt: In the second, human work should be done; and in the third part, ancestral work. / When the lord of the Vedic branch or Bṛhaspati and Ketu are in their debilitation sign or its navāṃśa, or in their enemy’s sign or its navāṃśa,

sanskrit_iast:
guruśikhinośca śākheśe kalāśīlavivarjitaḥ /
svādhiśatrugṛhasthe vā tadaṃśasthe 'tha vā vratī //
meaning:
गुरुशिखिनोश्च शाखेशे कलाशीलविवर्जितः /
स्वाधिशत्रुगृहस्थे वा तदंशस्थे ऽथ वा व्रती //
text_mt: The initiate is bereft of arts and character; or if the lord of the Vedic branch is in the house of a bitter enemy, or in its navāṃśa,

sanskrit_iast:
śākheśe vā gurau śukre mahāpātakakṛdbhavet /
svoccasaṃsthe tadaṃśe vā svarāśau rāśige gaṇe //
meaning:
शाखेशे वा गुरौ शुक्रे महापातककृद्भवेत् /
स्वोच्चसंस्थे तदंशे वा स्वराशौ राशिगे गणे //
text_mt: Or if Bṛhaspati or Śukra is such, he becomes a committer of great sins. / But when placed in its exaltation sign or its navāṃśa, or in its own sign or the group of signs [favourable],

sanskrit_iast:
śākheśe vā gurau śukre kendrage vā trikoṇage /
atīva dhanavāṃścaiva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
शाखेशे वा गुरौ शुक्रे केन्द्रगे वा त्रिकोणगे /
अतीव धनवांश्चैव वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt: If the lord of the Vedic branch, or Bṛhaspati, or Śukra is in a quadrant or a trine, / he becomes exceedingly wealthy and a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
paramoccagate jīve śākheśe vātha vā sate /
vratī viśuddhe nidhane vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
परमोच्चगते जीवे शाखेशे वाथ वा सते /
व्रती विशुद्धे निधने वेदशास्त्रविशारदः //
text_mt: When Bṛhaspati, the lord of the Vedic branch, or Mercury is in deep exaltation, / the eighth house being completely pure, the initiate becomes learned in the Vedas and Śāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhimitragṛhasthe vā tasyoñcasthe tadaṃśage /
gurau bhṛgau vā śākheśe vidyādhanasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाधिमित्रगृहस्थे वा तस्योञ्चस्थे तदंशगे /
गुरौ भृगौ वा शाखेशे विद्याधनसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Or if the lord of the Vedic branch, Bṛhaspati, or Śukra is in the house of an intimate friend, or in its exaltation, or its navāṃśa, / he is endowed with learning and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śākhādhipativāraśca śākhādhipabalaṃ śiśoḥ /
śaākhādhipatilagnaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tritayaṃ vrate //
meaning:
शाखाधिपतिवारश्च शाखाधिपबलं शिशोः /
शआखाधिपतिलग्नं च दुर्लभं त्रितयं व्रते //
text_mt: The weekday of the lord of the Vedic branch, the strength of the lord of the Vedic branch for the child, / and the ascendant of the lord of the Vedic branch—this triad is difficult to obtain in the investiture.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvedvāṃśage candre vratī vidyāviśāradaḥ /
pāpāṃśage vā daridro nityaduḥkhitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्वेद्वांशगे चन्द्रे व्रती विद्याविशारदः /
पापांशगे वा दरिद्रो नित्यदुःखितः //
text_mt: Therefore, when the Moon is in an intelligent (or Vedic) navāṃśa, the initiate is skilled in learning; / but if [the Moon] is in a malefic navāṃśa, he becomes poor and constantly afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇādini nakṣatre karkāṃśasthe niśākare /
tadā vratī vedaśāstradhanadhānyasamṛddhimān //
meaning:
श्रवणादिनि नक्षत्रे कर्कांशस्थे निशाकरे /
तदा व्रती वेदशास्त्रधनधान्यसमृद्धिमान् //
text_mt: When the Moon is in asterisms beginning with Śravaṇa and situated in a Cancer navāṃśa, / then the initiate abounds in [knowledge of] the Vedas and Śāstras, wealth, and grains.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca naidhane śuddhisaṃyute /
lagne tu nidhane saumyaiḥ saṃyute vā nirīkṣite //
meaning:
शुभलग्ने शुभांशे च नैधने शुद्धिसंयुते /
लग्ने तु निधने सौम्यैः संयुते वा निरीक्षिते //
text_mt: In an auspicious ascendant and an auspicious navāṃśa, with the eighth house pure, / the ascendant or the eighth house combined with or aspected by benefics,

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭairjīvārkacandrādyaiḥ pañcabhirbalibhirgrahai /
sthānādibalasaṃpūrṇaiścaturbhirvā śubhānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
इष्टैर्जीवार्कचन्द्राद्यैः पञ्चभिर्बलिभिर्ग्रहै /
स्थानादिबलसंपूर्णैश्चतुर्भिर्वा शुभान्वितैः //
text_mt: Aspected by five strong, favourable planets such as Bṛhaspati, the Sun, the Moon, and others, / or by four endowed with positional and other strengths and combined with benefics,

sanskrit_iast:
īkṣannaivātraikaviṃśamahādoṣavivarjite /
rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ //
meaning:
ईक्षन्नैवात्रैकविंशमहादोषविवर्जिते /
राशयः सकलाः श्रेष्ठाः शुभग्रहयुतेक्षिताः //
text_mt: Free from the twenty-one great blemishes—all zodiac signs are excellent when conjoined with or aspected by benefic planets;

sanskrit_iast:
śubhanavāṃśakagatā grāhyāste śubharāśayaḥ /
na kadācitkarkaṭāṃśaśubhekṣitayuto 'pi vā //
meaning:
शुभनवांशकगता ग्राह्यास्ते शुभराशयः /
न कदाचित्कर्कटांशशुभेक्षितयुतो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Those auspicious signs situated in an auspicious navāṃśa should be chosen, / never a Cancer navāṃśa, even if aspected by or conjoined with a benefic.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādgomithunāṃśāśca tulākanyāṃśakāḥ śubhāḥ /
evaṃvidhe lagnagate navāṃśe vratamīritam //
meaning:
तस्माद्गोमिथुनांशाश्च तुलाकन्यांशकाः शुभाः /
एवंविधे लग्नगते नवांशे व्रतमीरितम् //
text_mt: Therefore, Taurus and Gemini navāṃśas, as well as Libra and Virgo navāṃśas, are auspicious. / The investiture is declared [to be performed] when such a navāṃśa has risen in the ascendant,

sanskrit_iast:
triṣaḍāyagataiḥ pāpaiḥ ṣaḍaṣṭāntyavivarjitaiḥ /
śubhaiḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭalagnāntyavarjitena himāṃśunā //
meaning:
त्रिषडायगतैः पापैः षडष्टान्त्यविवर्जितैः /
शुभैः षष्टाष्टलग्नान्त्यवर्जितेन हिमांशुना //
text_mt: With malefics in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, with benefics avoiding the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses, / and with the Moon avoiding the sixth, eighth, ascendant, and twelfth houses.

sanskrit_iast:
svoñcasaṃstho 'pi śītāṃśurvratino yadi lagnagaḥ /
na karoti śiśuṃ niḥsvaṃ sarvataḥ kṣayarogiṇam //
meaning:
स्वोञ्चसंस्थो ऽपि शीतांशुर्व्रतिनो यदि लग्नगः /
न करोति शिशुं निःस्वं सर्वतः क्षयरोगिणम् //
text_mt: Even if placed in its exaltation, if the cold-rayed Moon is in the ascendant of the initiate, / does it not make the child destitute and afflicted with consumption in every way?

sanskrit_iast:
sphūrjite kendrage bhānau vratināṃ pitṛnāśanam /
pañcadoṣonitaṃ lagnaṃ śubhadaṃ copanāyane //
meaning:
स्फूर्जिते केन्द्रगे भानौ व्रतिनां पितृनाशनम् /
पञ्चदोषोनितं लग्नं शुभदं चोपनायने //
text_mt: When the blazing Sun is in a quadrant, it causes the destruction of the initiates’ fathers. / An ascendant devoid of the five blemishes bestows good fortune in the sacred-thread investiture.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā vasaṃtaṛtunā kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe /
anadhyāye viṣṭiṣaṣṭyorna tu saskāramarhati //
meaning:
विना वसंतऋतुना कृष्णपक्षे गलग्रहे /
अनध्याये विष्टिषष्ट्योर्न तु सस्कारमर्हति //
text_mt: Except in the spring season, during a galagraha day in the dark fortnight, / on an unpromulgated study day (anadhyāya), on a viṣṭi karaṇa, or on a sixth lunar day, he does not deserve the sacrament.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyādicatvāri saptamyādidinatrayam /
caturthī vā śubhāḥ proktā aṣṭāvete galagrahāḥ //
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यादिचत्वारि सप्तम्यादिदिनत्रयम् /
चतुर्थी वा शुभाः प्रोक्ता अष्टावेते गलग्रहाः //
text_mt: The four days beginning with the thirteenth, the three days beginning with the seventh, / or the fourth tithi are declared auspicious; these eight are the throat-planets.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣurikābandhaṃ vakṣye nṛpāṇāṃ prākkaragrahāt /
vivāhokteṣu māseṣu śuklapakṣe 'pyanastage //
meaning:
क्षुरिकाबन्धं वक्ष्ये नृपाणां प्राक्करग्रहात् /
विवाहोक्तेषु मासेषु शुक्लपक्षे ऽप्यनस्तगे //
text_mt: I shall explain the girding of the knife for kings prior to taking the hand [in marriage]: / in the months prescribed for marriage, during the bright fortnight, and when they are not combust,

sanskrit_iast:
jīve śukre ca bhūputre candratārābalānvite /
maiñjībandhoktatithiṣu kujavarjitavāsare //
meaning:
जीवे शुक्रे च भूपुत्रे चन्द्रताराबलान्विते /
मैञ्जीबन्धोक्ततिथिषु कुजवर्जितवासरे //
text_mt: when Jupiter, Venus, and Mars are endowed with the strength of the moon and stars, / on the tithis prescribed for the girdle-tying, on a weekday excluding Tuesday,

sanskrit_iast:
nacennavāṃśake karturaṣṭamodayavarjite /
śuddhe 'ṣṭame vidhau lagne ṣaṣṭāṣṭāntyavivarjite //
meaning:
नचेन्नवांशके कर्तुरष्टमोदयवर्जिते /
शुद्धे ऽष्टमे विधौ लग्ने षष्टाष्टान्त्यविवर्जिते //
text_mt: not in a navāṃśa that is the eighth from the agent's rising sign, / when the eighth house is pure, the Moon is in the ascendant, and the sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses are free [of malefics].

sanskrit_iast:
dhanatrikoṇakendrasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ /
kṣurikābandhanaṃ kāryamarcayitvāmarānpitṝn //
meaning:
धनत्रिकोणकेन्द्रस्थैः शुभैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः /
क्षुरिकाबन्धनं कार्यमर्चयित्वामरान्पितॄन् //
text_mt: With benefics situated in the second, trine, and quadrant houses, and the others in the third, eleventh, and sixth, / having worshipped the gods and the ancestors, the girding of the knife should be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
arcayetkṣurikāṃ samyagdevatānāṃ ca sannidhau /
tataḥ sulagne badhnīyātkaṭyāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām //
meaning:
अर्चयेत्क्षुरिकां सम्यग्देवतानां च सन्निधौ /
ततः सुलग्ने बध्नीयात्कट्यां लक्षणसंयुताम् //
text_mt: One should properly worship the knife in the presence of the deities; / then, under an auspicious ascendant, one should bind it, endowed with auspicious marks, upon the waist.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāmārddhāgravistārapramāṇenaivacchedayat /
tacchedakhaṇḍānyāyāḥ syurdhvajāye ripunāśanam //
meaning:
आयामार्द्धाग्रविस्तारप्रमाणेनैवच्छेदयत् /
तच्छेदखण्डान्यायाः स्युर्ध्वजाये रिपुनाशनम् //
text_mt: One should measure the cut by half the length and the width of the tip; / the sections of that cut yield the āyas: in the flag-āya there is destruction of enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
ghūmrāye maraṇaṃ siṃhe jayaḥ śuni ca rogitā /
dhanalābho vṛṣe 'tyantaṃ duḥkhī bhavati gardabhe //
meaning:
घूम्राये मरणं सिंहे जयः शुनि च रोगिता /
धनलाभो वृषे ऽत्यन्तं दुःखी भवति गर्दभे //
text_mt: in the smoke-āya death, in the lion victory, and in the dog disease; / in the bull there is great gain of wealth, in the donkey one becomes miserable,

sanskrit_iast:
gajāye 'tyantasaṃprītirdhvāṅkṣe vittavināśanam /
khaḍgaputrikayormānaṃ gaṇayetsvāṅgulena tu //
meaning:
गजाये ऽत्यन्तसंप्रीतिर्ध्वाङ्क्षे वित्तविनाशनम् /
खड्गपुत्रिकयोर्मानं गणयेत्स्वाङ्गुलेन तु //
text_mt: in the elephant-āya there is extreme joy, and in the crow loss of wealth. / One should calculate the measure of the sword and dagger by one's own digits.

sanskrit_iast:
mānāṅguleṣu paryāyāmekādaśamitāṃ tyajet /
śeṣāṇāmagulīnāṃ ca phalāni syuryathākramam //
meaning:
मानाङ्गुलेषु पर्यायामेकादशमितां त्यजेत् /
शेषाणामगुलीनां च फलानि स्युर्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Among the measured digits, one should discard the cycles of eleven; / and of the remaining digits, the results are respectively:

sanskrit_iast:
putralābhaḥ śatruvadhaḥ strīlābho gamana śubham /
arthahāniścārthavṛddhiḥ prīti siddhijayaḥ stutiḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रलाभः शत्रुवधः स्त्रीलाभो गमन शुभम् /
अर्थहानिश्चार्थवृद्धिः प्रीति सिद्धिजयः स्तुतिः //
text_mt: obtaining a son, slaying of enemies, obtaining a woman, auspicious travel, / loss of wealth, increase of wealth, affection, success, victory, and praise.

sanskrit_iast:
sthito dhvaje vṛṣāye vā naṣṭācetpūrvato vraṇam /
siṃhegaje madhyabhāge tvantabhāge śvakākayoḥ //
meaning:
स्थितो ध्वजे वृषाये वा नष्टाचेत्पूर्वतो व्रणम् /
सिंहेगजे मध्यभागे त्वन्तभागे श्वकाकयोः //
text_mt: Situated in the flag or bull āya, if it is marred, the flaw is in the eastern part; / in the lion and elephant, in the middle part; but in the dog and crow, in the end part;

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛmragarddabhayornaiva vraṇaṃ śrayontyabhāgagam /
athottarāyaṇe śukrajīvayorddaśyamānayoḥ //
meaning:
धृम्रगर्द्दभयोर्नैव व्रणं श्रयोन्त्यभागगम् /
अथोत्तरायणे शुक्रजीवयोर्द्दश्यमानयोः //
text_mt: in the smoke and donkey, never. A flaw in the end part brings ruin. / Now, during the northern course of the sun, when Venus and Jupiter are visible,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātīnāṃ gurorgehānnivṛttānāṃ yatātmanām /
citrottarāditījyāntyaharimitravidhātṛṣu //
meaning:
द्विजातीनां गुरोर्गेहान्निवृत्तानां यतात्मनाम् /
चित्रोत्तरादितीज्यान्त्यहरिमित्रविधातृषु //
text_mt: for twice-born men of self-control returning from the teacher's house, / under the stars Citrā, the three Uttarās, Puṣya, Revatī, Rohiṇī, Anurādhā, and Rohiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
bheṣvarkendujñejyaśukravāralagnāṃśakeṣu ca /
pratipatparvariktā mā cāṣṭamī ca dinatrayam //
meaning:
भेष्वर्केन्दुज्ञेज्यशुक्रवारलग्नांशकेषु च /
प्रतिपत्पर्वरिक्ता मा चाष्टमी च दिनत्रयम् //
text_mt: and on the weekdays, ascendants, and navāṃśas of the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, / avoiding the first tithi, parvan days, empty tithis, the new moon, the eighth tithi, and the three days,

sanskrit_iast:
hitvānyadivase kāryaṃ samāvartanamuṇḍanam /
sarvāśramāṇāṃ viprendra hyuttamo 'yaṃ gṛhāśramaḥ //
meaning:
हित्वान्यदिवसे कार्यं समावर्तनमुण्डनम् /
सर्वाश्रमाणां विप्रेन्द्र ह्युत्तमो ऽयं गृहाश्रमः //
text_mt: on another day, the completion of studentship and tonsure should be performed. / O foremost of brahmins, among all stages of life, this householder stage is the highest;

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ tatrāpi bhāminyāṃ śīlavatyāṃ sthitaṃ tataḥ /
tasyāḥ sacchīlarlā dhastu sulagnavaśataḥ khalu //
meaning:
सुखं तत्रापि भामिन्यां शीलवत्यां स्थितं ततः /
तस्याः सच्छीलर्ला धस्तु सुलग्नवशतः खलु //
text_mt: happiness in it rests upon a virtuous wife; therefore, / the obtaining of a wife of good character indeed depends upon an auspicious ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahoktaṃ saṃvīkṣya lagnaśuddhiṃ pravacmyaham /
puṇye 'hnilakṣaṇopetaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ sucetasam //
meaning:
पितामहोक्तं संवीक्ष्य लग्नशुद्धिं प्रवच्म्यहम् /
पुण्ये ऽह्निलक्षणोपेतं सुखासीनं सुचेतसम् //
text_mt: Having examined what was stated by Brahmā, I declare the purity of the ascendant: / On an auspicious day, approaching the astrologer who is endowed with auspicious signs, comfortably seated, and pure-minded,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya devavatpṛccherddaivajñaṃ bhaktipūrvakam /
tāṃbūlaphalapuṣpādyaiḥ pūrṇāñjalirupāgataḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य देववत्पृच्छेर्द्दैवज्ञं भक्तिपूर्वकम् /
तांबूलफलपुष्पाद्यैः पूर्णाञ्जलिरुपागतः //
text_mt: having bowed to him like a deity, one should inquire with devotion, / having approached with folded hands filled with betel, fruits, flowers, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra cellagnagaḥ krūrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ /
daṃpatyormaraṇa vācya varṣāṇāmaṣṭakātpurā //
meaning:
तत्र चेल्लग्नगः क्रूरस्तस्मात्सप्तमगः कुजः /
दंपत्योर्मरण वाच्य वर्षाणामष्टकात्पुरा //
text_mt: If a malefic is in the ascendant and Mars is in the seventh from it, / the death of the couple should be declared before eight years have passed.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi lagnagataścandrastasmātsaptamagaḥ kujaḥ /
vijñeyaṃ bhartṛmaraṇamaṣṭavarṣānttare budhaiḥjha //
meaning:
यदि लग्नगतश्चन्द्रस्तस्मात्सप्तमगः कुजः /
विज्ञेयं भर्तृमरणमष्टवर्षान्त्तरे बुधैःझ //
text_mt: If the Moon is in the ascendant and Mars is in the seventh from it, / the death of the husband within eight years should be known by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnātpañcamagaḥ pāpaḥ śatrudṛṣṭaśca nīcagaḥ /
mṛtaputrātha vā kanyā kulaṭā vā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
लग्नात्पञ्चमगः पापः शत्रुदृष्टश्च नीचगः /
मृतपुत्राथ वा कन्या कुलटा वा न संशयः //
text_mt: If a malefic is in the fifth from the ascendant, aspected by an enemy, and in debilitation, / the woman will have dead sons or become an unchaste woman, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyapañcasaptāyakarmago vā niśākaraḥ /
lagnātkaroti saṃbandhaṃ daṃpatyorguruvīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयपञ्चसप्तायकर्मगो वा निशाकरः /
लग्नात्करोति संबन्धं दंपत्योर्गुरुवीक्षितः //
text_mt: Or if the Moon, situated in the third, fifth, seventh, eleventh, or tenth house / from the ascendant, is aspected by Jupiter, it brings about the union of the couple.

sanskrit_iast:
tulāgokarkaṭā lagnasaṃsthaḥ śukrendusaṃyutāḥ /
vīkṣitāḥ pṛcchatāṃ nṝṇāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā //
meaning:
तुलागोकर्कटा लग्नसंस्थः शुक्रेन्दुसंयुताः /
वीक्षिताः पृच्छतां नॄणां कन्यालाभो भवेत्तदा //
text_mt: If Libra, Taurus, or Cancer are in the ascendant, occupied by Venus and the Moon, / or aspected by them, then for men making the query, the obtaining of a maiden will take place.

sanskrit_iast:
strīdreṣkāṇaḥ strīnavāṃśe yugmalagnaṃ samāgatam /
vīkṣitaṃ candraśukrābhyāṃ kanyālābho bhavettadā //
meaning:
स्त्रीद्रेष्काणः स्त्रीनवांशे युग्मलग्नं समागतम् /
वीक्षितं चन्द्रशुक्राभ्यां कन्यालाभो भवेत्तदा //
text_mt: When a female decanate is in a female navāṃśa, and a dual ascendant has arrived, / aspected by the Moon and Venus, then the obtaining of a maiden will take place.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ strīṇāṃ bhartṛlabdhiḥ puṃlagne puṃnavāṃśake /
pṛcchakasya bhavellagnaṃ puṅgrahairavalokitam //
meaning:
एवं स्त्रीणां भर्तृलब्धिः पुंलग्ने पुंनवांशके /
पृच्छकस्य भवेल्लग्नं पुङ्ग्रहैरवलोकितम् //
text_mt: Similarly, the obtaining of a husband occurs for women when the querent's ascendant / is a male sign, in a male navāṃśa, and aspected by male planets.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe praśnalagnādyasya rāśī yadā /
pāpadṛṣṭo 'tha vā randhre na saṃbandho bhavettadā //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे प्रश्नलग्नाद्यस्य राशी यदा /
पापदृष्टो ऽथ वा रन्ध्रे न संबन्धो भवेत्तदा //
text_mt: In the dark fortnight, whatever sign the query ascendant is in, / if it is aspected by a malefic or in the eighth house, then no alliance will take place.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyairnimittaśakunaiḥ praśnakāle tu maṅgalam /
daṃpatyoraśubhairetairaśubhaṃ sarvato bhavet //
meaning:
पुण्यैर्निमित्तशकुनैः प्रश्नकाले तु मङ्गलम् /
दंपत्योरशुभैरेतैरशुभं सर्वतो भवेत् //
text_mt: Through auspicious omens and portents at the time of query, auspiciousness ensues for the couple; / through inauspicious ones, misfortune will arise on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgaśuddhidivase candratārābalānvite /
vivāhabhasyodaye vā kanyāvaraṇamanvayaiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिदिवसे चन्द्रताराबलान्विते /
विवाहभस्योदये वा कन्यावरणमन्वयैः //
text_mt: On a day pure in the five limbs of the calendar, endowed with the strength of the moon and stars, / or at the rising of the marriage-asterism, the selection of the bride should be made by relatives,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇaiḥ puṣpatāṃbūlaphalairgandhākṣatādibhiḥ /
śuklāṃbarairgītavādyaiṃrvighnāśīrvacanaiḥ saha //
meaning:
भूषणैः पुष्पतांबूलफलैर्गन्धाक्षतादिभिः /
शुक्लांबरैर्गीतवाद्यैंर्विघ्नाशीर्वचनैः सह //
text_mt: with ornaments, flowers, betel, fruits, perfumes, unbroken rice, and the like, / with white garments, songs, musical instruments, and words of obstacle-removing benediction,

sanskrit_iast:
kārayetkanyakāgehe varaḥ praṇavapūrvakam /
tadā kuryātpitā tasyāḥ pradānaṃ prītipūrvakam //
meaning:
कारयेत्कन्यकागेहे वरः प्रणवपूर्वकम् /
तदा कुर्यात्पिता तस्याः प्रदानं प्रीतिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: the groom should cause it to be done in the house of the maiden, preceded by the praṇava; / then her father should lovingly make the gift of her.

sanskrit_iast:
kulaśīlavayorūpavittavidyāyutāya ca /
varāya ca rūpavatīṃ kanyāṃ dadyādyavīyasīm //
meaning:
कुलशीलवयोरूपवित्तविद्यायुताय च /
वराय च रूपवतीं कन्यां दद्याद्यवीयसीम् //
text_mt: To a groom endowed with good family, character, age, beauty, wealth, and learning, / he should give a beautiful maiden who is younger [than the groom].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya prārthayitvā ca śacīṃ devīṃ guṇāśrayām /
trailokyasundarīṃ divyagandhamālyāṃbarāvṛtām //
meaning:
संपूज्य प्रार्थयित्वा च शचीं देवीं गुणाश्रयाम् /
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरीं दिव्यगन्धमाल्यांबरावृताम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped and prayed to Goddess Śacī, the abode of virtues, / the most beautiful in the three worlds, draped in divine perfumes, garlands, and garments,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām /
anarghamaṇimālābhirbhāsayantīṃ digantarān //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् /
अनर्घमणिमालाभिर्भासयन्तीं दिगन्तरान् //
text_mt: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / illuminating the quarters of the sky with necklaces of priceless gems,

sanskrit_iast:
vilāsinīsahasrādyaiḥ sevamānāmaharniśam /
evaṃvidhāṃ kumārīṃ tāṃ pūjānte prārthayediti //
meaning:
विलासिनीसहस्राद्यैः सेवमानामहर्निशम् /
एवंविधां कुमारीं तां पूजान्ते प्रार्थयेदिति //
text_mt: served day and night by thousands of lovely damsels and the like; / having worshipped such a maiden, one should pray at the conclusion of worship as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
devīndrāṇi namastubhyāṃ devendrapriyabhāmini /
vivāhe bhāgyamārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dehi me //
meaning:
देवीन्द्राणि नमस्तुभ्यां देवेन्द्रप्रियभामिनि /
विवाहे भाग्यमारोग्यं पुत्रलाभं च देहि मे //
text_mt: ‘O Goddess Indrāṇī, salutations to you, beloved lady of the king of gods! / In my marriage, grant me good fortune, health, and the obtaining of sons!’

sanskrit_iast:
yugme 'bde janmataḥ strīṇāṃ pītidaṃ pāṇipīḍanam /
etatpuṃsāmayugme 'bde vyatyayenāśanaṃ tayoḥ //
meaning:
युग्मे ऽब्दे जन्मतः स्त्रीणां पीतिदं पाणिपीडनम् /
एतत्पुंसामयुग्मे ऽब्दे व्यत्ययेनाशनं तयोः //
text_mt: Clasping the hand in an even year from birth brings love for women; / for men, this is in an odd year; by reversal, there is destruction of both.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaphaālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭamāsāḥ śubhapradāḥ /
madhyamā kārtiko mārgaśīrṣo vai ninditāḥ pare //
meaning:
माघफआल्गुनवैशाखज्येष्टमासाः शुभप्रदाः /
मध्यमा कार्तिको मार्गशीर्षो वै निन्दिताः परे //
text_mt: The months of Māgha, Phālguna, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha bring auspiciousness; / Kārtika and Mārgaśīrṣa are mediocre; the others are indeed condemned.

sanskrit_iast:
na kadācidvaśarkṣeṣu bhānorārdrāpraveśanāt /
vivāho devatānāṃ ca pratiṣṭāṃ copanāyanam //
meaning:
न कदाचिद्वशर्क्षेषु भानोरार्द्राप्रवेशनात् /
विवाहो देवतानां च प्रतिष्टां चोपनायनम् //
text_mt: Never during the asterisms of subjugation from the Sun's entry into Ārdrā / should marriage, the installation of deities, and the sacred thread ceremony be performed,

sanskrit_iast:
nāstaṅgate site jīve na tayorbālavṛddhayoḥ /
na gurau siṃharāśisthe siṃhāṃśakagatepi vā //
meaning:
नास्तङ्गते सिते जीवे न तयोर्बालवृद्धयोः /
न गुरौ सिंहराशिस्थे सिंहांशकगतेपि वा //
text_mt: nor when Venus and Jupiter are combust, nor when they are in infancy or old age, / nor when Jupiter is in the sign of Leo, or in the Leo navāṃśa.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātprāguditaḥ śukro daśatridivasaṃ śiśuḥ /
buddhaḥ pañcadinaṃ pakṣaṃ guruḥ pakṣaṃ ca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
पश्चात्प्रागुदितः शुक्रो दशत्रिदिवसं शिशुः /
बुद्धः पञ्चदिनं पक्षं गुरुः पक्षं च सर्वतः //
text_mt: Having risen in the west or the east, Venus is an infant for ten or three days; / when old, for five days; Jupiter is so for a fortnight on both sides.

sanskrit_iast:
aprabuddho hṛṣīkeśo yāvattāvanna maṅgalam /
utsave vāsudevasya divase nānyamaṅgalam //
meaning:
अप्रबुद्धो हृषीकेशो यावत्तावन्न मङ्गलम् /
उत्सवे वासुदेवस्य दिवसे नान्यमङ्गलम् //
text_mt: As long as Hṛṣīkeśa is unawakened, no auspicious ceremony [should be held]; / on the day of the festival of Vāsudeva, no other auspicious rite [should take place].

sanskrit_iast:
na janmamāse janmarkṣe na janmadivase 'pi ca /
ādya garbhasutasyātha duhiturvā karagrahaḥ //
meaning:
न जन्ममासे जन्मर्क्षे न जन्मदिवसे ऽपि च /
आद्य गर्भसुतस्याथ दुहितुर्वा करग्रहः //
text_mt: The taking of the hand (marriage) of the first-born son or daughter / must not take place in their birth-month, their birth-nakṣatra, or even on their birth-day.

sanskrit_iast:
naivodvāho jyeṣṭhaputrīputrayośca parasparam /
jyeṣṭamāse tayorekajyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhaśca nānyathā //
meaning:
नैवोद्वाहो ज्येष्ठपुत्रीपुत्रयोश्च परस्परम् /
ज्येष्टमासे तयोरेकज्येष्ठे श्रेष्ठश्च नान्यथा //
text_mt: Nor should there be a marriage of an eldest daughter and an eldest son to each other / in the month of Jyeṣṭha; if only one of them is the eldest, it is auspicious, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
utpātagrahaṇādūrddhaṃ saptāhamakhilagrahe /
nākhile tridinaṃ neṣṭaṃ tridyuspṛk ca kṣayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
उत्पातग्रहणादूर्द्धं सप्ताहमखिलग्रहे /
नाखिले त्रिदिनं नेष्टं त्रिद्युस्पृक् च क्षयं तथा //
text_mt: Following an unnatural portentious phenomenon (utpāta) or an eclipse, seven days [must be avoided] in the case of a total eclipse; / in the case of a non-total one, three days; a day touching three tithis and an expunged tithi are likewise not favored.

sanskrit_iast:
grastāste tridinaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādgrastodaye 'thavā /
saṃdhyāyāṃ tridinaṃ tadvanniśīthe sapta eva ca //
meaning:
ग्रस्तास्ते त्रिदिनं पूर्वं पश्चाद्ग्रस्तोदये ऽथवा /
संध्यायां त्रिदिनं तद्वन्निशीथे सप्त एव च //
text_mt: If it sets while eclipsed, three days prior, or if it rises while eclipsed, [three days] following; / likewise three days if during twilight, and precisely seven if at midnight.

sanskrit_iast:
māsānte pañca divasāṃstyajedriktāṃ tathāṣṭamīm /
vyatīpātaṃ vaidhṛtiṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ parighārddhakam //
meaning:
मासान्ते पञ्च दिवसांस्त्यजेद्रिक्तां तथाष्टमीम् /
व्यतीपातं वैधृतिं च संपूर्णं परिघार्द्धकम् //
text_mt: One should avoid the five days at the end of a solar month, the Riktā tithis, likewise the eighth tithi, / Vyatīpāta, Vaidhṛti, and the entire first half of Parigha.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣṇabhatryuttarāmaitramaruñcandrārkapitryabhaiḥ /
samūlabhairaviddhaistaiḥ strīkaragraha iṣyate //
meaning:
पौष्णभत्र्युत्तरामैत्रमरुञ्चन्द्रार्कपित्र्यभैः /
समूलभैरविद्धैस्तैः स्त्रीकरग्रह इष्यते //
text_mt: The taking of a woman's hand is approved under Revatī, the three Uttarās, Anurādhā, / Svātī, Rohiṇī, Mṛgaśiras, Maghā, and Mūla, provided they are not pierced (aviddha).

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhe balamāvaśyaṃ daṃpatyorgurusūryayoḥ /
cetpūjā yatnataḥ kāryā durbala grahayostayoḥ //
meaning:
विवाहे बलमावश्यं दंपत्योर्गुरुसूर्ययोः /
चेत्पूजा यत्नतः कार्या दुर्बल ग्रहयोस्तयोः //
text_mt: In a marriage, the planetary strength of Jupiter and the Sun for the couple is essential; / if those two planets are weak, ritual worship must be performed with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
gocaraṃ vedhajaṃ cāṣṭavargajaṃ rūpajaṃ balam /
yathottaraṃ balādhikyaṃ sthūlaṃ gocaramārgajam //
meaning:
गोचरं वेधजं चाष्टवर्गजं रूपजं बलम् /
यथोत्तरं बलाधिक्यं स्थूलं गोचरमार्गजम् //
text_mt: The strength derived from transit (gocara), from planetary piercing (vedha), from the aṣṭakavarga, and natural strength (rūpaja): / in succeeding order, there is greater strength, while that derived from transit paths is rough.

sanskrit_iast:
candratārābalaṃ vīkṣya tataḥ pañcāṅgajaṃ balam /
tithirekaguṇā vāro dviguṇastriguṇaṃ ca bham //
meaning:
चन्द्रताराबलं वीक्ष्य ततः पञ्चाङ्गजं बलम् /
तिथिरेकगुणा वारो द्विगुणस्त्रिगुणं च भम् //
text_mt: Having examined the strength of the Moon and the birth-star, then [consider] the strength born of the five limbs (pañcāṅga): / the tithi is of single measure, the weekday has double, and the asterism (nakṣatra) has triple;

sanskrit_iast:
yogaścaturguṇaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tithyarddhasaṃjñitam /
tato manahūrto balavāṃstato lagnaṃ balādhikam //
meaning:
योगश्चतुर्गुणः पञ्चगुणं तिथ्यर्द्धसंज्ञितम् /
ततो मनहूर्तो बलवांस्ततो लग्नं बलाधिकम् //
text_mt: The yoga has fourfold [measure], and that called half-tithi (karaṇa) has fivefold; / stronger than that is the muhūrta, and stronger than that is the ascendant (lagna);

sanskrit_iast:
tato balavatī horā dreṣkāṇo balavāṃstataḥ /
tato navāṃśo balavāndvādaśāṃśo balī tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो बलवती होरा द्रेष्काणो बलवांस्ततः /
ततो नवांशो बलवान्द्वादशांशो बली ततः //
text_mt: Stronger than that is the horā, stronger than that is the decan (dreṣkāṇa); / stronger than that is the ninth-division (navāṃśa), stronger than that is the twelfth-division (dvādaśāṃśa);

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśāṃśo balavāṃstasmādvīkṣyametadbalābalam /
śubhekṣitayutāḥ śastā udvāhe 'khilarāśayaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिंशांशो बलवांस्तस्माद्वीक्ष्यमेतद्बलाबलम् /
शुभेक्षितयुताः शस्ता उद्वाहे ऽखिलराशयः //
text_mt: Stronger than that is the thirtieth-division (triṃśāṃśa)—thus this strength and weakness is to be examined. / All signs aspected by or conjoined with benefic planets are auspicious in marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkejyādayaḥ paca yasya rāśestukhecarāḥ /
iṣṭāstacchubhadaṃ lagnaṃ catvāro 'pi balānvitāḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्केज्यादयः पच यस्य राशेस्तुखेचराः /
इष्टास्तच्छुभदं लग्नं चत्वारो ऽपि बलान्विताः //
text_mt: That sign for which five heavenly bodies, beginning with the Moon, the Sun, and Jupiter, / are auspicious—that lagna bestows good fortune, or even if four are endowed with strength.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmitraśuddhyaikaviṃśanmahādoṣavivarjitam /
ekaviṃśatidoṣāṇāṃ nāmarūpaphalāni ca //
meaning:
जामित्रशुद्ध्यैकविंशन्महादोषविवर्जितम् /
एकविंशतिदोषाणां नामरूपफलानि च //
text_mt: It should be free from the twenty-one great blemishes through the purity of the seventh house (jāmitra). / The names, forms, and results of the twenty-one blemishes

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyante 'tra samāsena śṛṇu nārada sāṃpratam /
pañcāṅgaśuddhirāhityaṃ doṣastvādyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
वक्ष्यन्ते ऽत्र समासेन शृणु नारद सांप्रतम् /
पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिराहित्यं दोषस्त्वाद्यः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt: Will now be spoken here in brief; listen, O Nārada: / Lack of purity of the five limbs (pañcāṅga) is declared to be the first blemish;

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstaśuddhirhānirdvitīyaḥ sūryasaṃkramaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ pāpaṣaḍvargo bhṛguḥ ṣaṣṭaḥ kujo 'ṣṭamaḥ //
meaning:
उदयास्तशुद्धिर्हानिर्द्वितीयः सूर्यसंक्रमः /
तृतीयः पापषड्वर्गो भृगुः षष्टः कुजो ऽष्टमः //
text_mt: Loss of purity of rising and setting is the second; solar transit is the third; / malefic influence in the sixfold division (ṣaḍvarga); Venus in the sixth house; Mars in the eighth;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇḍāntaṃ kartarī riṣaaphaṣaḍaṣṭendugato grahaḥ /
daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirviṣaghaṭī tathā //
meaning:
गण्डान्तं कर्तरी रिषअफषडष्टेन्दुगतो ग्रहः /
दंपत्योरष्टमं लग्नं राशिर्विषघटी तथा //
text_mt: Gaṇḍānta; scissors-formation (kartarī); a planet situated in the sixth or eighth from the Moon, or in the twelfth (riphpha); / the eighth lagna or eighth rāśi of the couple; likewise the poison-ghatī (viṣaghaṭī);

sanskrit_iast:
durmuhīrto vāradoṣaḥ khārjūrikasamāṅghribham /
grahaṇotpātabhaṃ krūraviddharkṣaṃ krūrasaṃyutam //
meaning:
दुर्मुहीर्तो वारदोषः खार्जूरिकसमाङ्घ्रिभम् /
ग्रहणोत्पातभं क्रूरविद्धर्क्षं क्रूरसंयुतम् //
text_mt: An inauspicious muhūrta (durmuhūrta); the blemish of the weekday; an asterism sharing the same quarter in the khārjūra diagram; / an asterism afflicted by an eclipse or portent, or pierced by a malefic, or conjoined with a malefic;

sanskrit_iast:
kunavāṃśo mahāpāto vaidhṛtiścaikaviṃśatiḥ /
tithivārarkṣayogānāṃ karaṇasya ca melanam //
meaning:
कुनवांशो महापातो वैधृतिश्चैकविंशतिः /
तिथिवारर्क्षयोगानां करणस्य च मेलनम् //
text_mt: An evil navāṃśa; the great fall (mahāpāta); and Vaidhṛti makes twenty-one. / The combination of tithi, weekday, asterism, yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgamasya śuddhistu pañcāṅgaśuddhirīritā /
yasminpañcāṅgadoṣo 'sti tasmiṃllagne nirarthakam //
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गमस्य शुद्धिस्तु पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिरीरिता /
यस्मिन्पञ्चाङ्गदोषो ऽस्ति तस्मिंल्लग्ने निरर्थकम् //
text_mt: And karaṇa is the five limbs (pañcāṅga); its purity is declared to be pañcāṅga-śuddhi. / The lagna in which there is a defect of the five limbs is useless;

sanskrit_iast:
tyajetpañcaiṣṭikaṃ cāpi viṣasaṃyuktadugdhavat /
lagnalagnāṃśakau svasvapatinā vīkṣitau yutau //
meaning:
त्यजेत्पञ्चैष्टिकं चापि विषसंयुक्तदुग्धवत् /
लग्नलग्नांशकौ स्वस्वपतिना वीक्षितौ युतौ //
text_mt: Even if five desires are fulfilled, one should abandon it like milk mixed with poison. / If the lagna and the navāṃśa of the lagna are not aspected by or conjoined with their respective lords,

sanskrit_iast:
na cedvānyonyapatinā śubhaghamitreṇa vā tathā /
varasya mṛtyuḥ syāttābhyāṃ saptasaptodayāṃśakau //
meaning:
न चेद्वान्योन्यपतिना शुभघमित्रेण वा तथा /
वरस्य मृत्युः स्यात्ताभ्यां सप्तसप्तोदयांशकौ //
text_mt: Or not by each other's lord, or likewise by an auspicious friend, / death of the groom will occur through both of them. If the seventh house and the navāṃśa of the seventh

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tau na yutau dṛṣṭau mutyurvadhvāḥ karagrahe /
tyājyāḥ sūryasya saṃkrānteḥ pūrvataḥ paratastathā //
meaning:
एवं तौ न युतौ दृष्टौ मुत्युर्वध्वाः करग्रहे /
त्याज्याः सूर्यस्य संक्रान्तेः पूर्वतः परतस्तथा //
text_mt: Are likewise not conjoined or aspected, death of the bride occurs in marriage. / Before and after the Sun's transit (saṃkrānti),

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhādiṣu kāryeṣu nāḍyaḥ ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśā / /
ṣaḍvargaḥ śubhadaḥ śreṣṭho vivāhasathāpanādiṣu //
meaning:
विवाहादिषु कार्येषु नाड्यः षोडशषोडशा / /
षड्वर्गः शुभदः श्रेष्ठो विवाहसथापनादिषु //
text_mt: Sixteen nāḍīs in each direction are to be avoided in activities such as marriage. / An auspicious sixfold division (ṣaḍvarga) is excellent in marriage, consecrations, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguṣaṣṭhāhvayo doṣo lagnātṣaṣṭhagate site /
uccage śubhasaṃyukte tallagnaṃ sarvadā tyajet //
meaning:
भृगुषष्ठाह्वयो दोषो लग्नात्षष्ठगते सिते /
उच्चगे शुभसंयुक्ते तल्लग्नं सर्वदा त्यजेत् //
text_mt: The fault named 'Venus in the sixth' occurs when Venus occupies the sixth house from the lagna; / even if exalted or conjoined with a benefic, one should always avoid that lagna.

sanskrit_iast:
kujo 'ṣṭamo mahādoṣo lagnādaṣṭamage kuje /
śubhatrayayutaṃ lagnaṃ na tyajettuṅgago yadi //
meaning:
कुजो ऽष्टमो महादोषो लग्नादष्टमगे कुजे /
शुभत्रययुतं लग्नं न त्यजेत्तुङ्गगो यदि //
text_mt: 'Mars in the eighth' is a great blemish when Mars occupies the eighth house from the lagna; / yet one need not abandon a lagna conjoined with three benefics if Mars is in his exaltation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇānandāṅkhyayostithyoḥ saṃdhirnāḍīdvayaṃ yadā /
gaṇḍāntaṃ mṛtyudaṃ janmayātrodvāhavratādiṣu //
meaning:
पूर्णानन्दाङ्ख्ययोस्तिथ्योः संधिर्नाडीद्वयं यदा /
गण्डान्तं मृत्युदं जन्मयात्रोद्वाहव्रतादिषु //
text_mt: When the junction of the tithis called Pūrṇā and Nandā lasts two nāḍīs, / it is gaṇḍānta, which causes death in birth, journeys, marriages, vows, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kulīrasiṃhayoḥ kīṭacāpayorminameṣayoḥ /
gaṇḍātaṃmantarālaṃ syāddhaṭikārddhaṃ mṛtipradam //
meaning:
कुलीरसिंहयोः कीटचापयोर्मिनमेषयोः /
गण्डातंमन्तरालं स्याद्धटिकार्द्धं मृतिप्रदम् //
text_mt: Between Cancer and Leo, Scorpio and Sagittarius, and Pisces and Aries, / the interval is gaṇḍānta; half a ghaṭikā there bestows death.

sanskrit_iast:
sārpaindrapauṣṇobheṣvantyaṣoḍaśeśā bhasaṃdhayaḥ /
tadagnimeṣvādyapādā bhānāṃ gaṇḍātasaṃjñakāḥ //
meaning:
सार्पैन्द्रपौष्णोभेष्वन्त्यषोडशेशा भसंधयः /
तदग्निमेष्वाद्यपादा भानां गण्डातसंज्ञकाः //
text_mt: At the junctions of the asterisms Āśleṣā, Jyeṣṭhā, and Revatī—the last sixteen nāḍīs are the nakṣatra-junctions; / the first quarters of Aśvinī, Maghā, and Mūla are also termed gaṇḍānta.

sanskrit_iast:
ugraṃ ca saṃdhitritayaṃ gaṇḍātaṃ trividhaṃ mahat /
lagnābhimukhayoḥ pāpagrahayorṛjuvakrayoḥ //
meaning:
उग्रं च संधित्रितयं गण्डातं त्रिविधं महत् /
लग्नाभिमुखयोः पापग्रहयोरृजुवक्रयोः //
text_mt: Fierce is this triad of junctions, the great threefold gaṇḍānta. / When two malefic planets face the lagna, one in direct and the other in retrograde motion,

sanskrit_iast:
sā kartarīti vijñeyā daṃpatyorgalakartarī /
kartarīyogaduṣṭaṃ yallagnaṃ tatparivarjayet //
meaning:
सा कर्तरीति विज्ञेया दंपत्योर्गलकर्तरी /
कर्तरीयोगदुष्टं यल्लग्नं तत्परिवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: That is to be known as the scissors-formation (kartarī), a throat-cutter for the couple; / a lagna corrupted by the kartarī yoga one must utterly avoid,

sanskrit_iast:
api saumyagrahairyukta guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitam /
ṣaḍaṣṭariṣphage candre lagnadoṣaḥ svasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
अपि सौम्यग्रहैर्युक्त गुणैः सर्वैः समन्वितम् /
षडष्टरिष्फगे चन्द्रे लग्नदोषः स्वसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: Even if it is conjoined with benefic planets and endowed with all good qualities. / When the Moon is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, that constitutes the lagna-fault named after them.

sanskrit_iast:
tallagnaṃ varjayedyatrājjīvaśukrasamanvitam /
uccage nīcage vāpi mitrabhe śatrurāśige //
meaning:
तल्लग्नं वर्जयेद्यत्राज्जीवशुक्रसमन्वितम् /
उच्चगे नीचगे वापि मित्रभे शत्रुराशिगे //
text_mt: One should diligently avoid that lagna even if conjoined with Jupiter and Venus, / whether [the Moon is] in exaltation or debilitation, in a friendly sign or in an enemy's sign;

sanskrit_iast:
api sarvaguṇopetaṃ daṃpatyornidhanapradam /
śaśāṅke grahasaṃyukte doṣaḥ saṃgrahasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
अपि सर्वगुणोपेतं दंपत्योर्निधनप्रदम् /
शशाङ्के ग्रहसंयुक्ते दोषः संग्रहसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: Even if endowed with all virtues, it brings death to the couple. / When the Moon is conjoined with a planet, it is the blemish called saṃgraha.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsaṃgrahadoṣe tu vivāhaṃ naiva kārayet /
sūryeṇa saṃyute candre dāridyaṃ bhavati sphuṭam //
meaning:
तस्मिन्संग्रहदोषे तु विवाहं नैव कारयेत् /
सूर्येण संयुते चन्द्रे दारिद्यं भवति स्फुटम् //
text_mt: During that saṃgraha fault, one should never perform a marriage. / When the Moon is conjoined with the Sun, poverty clearly results;

sanskrit_iast:
kujena maraṇaṃ vyādhiḥ saumyena tvanapatyatā /
daurbhāgyaṃ guruṇā yukte sāpatyaṃ bhārgaveṇa tu //
meaning:
कुजेन मरणं व्याधिः सौम्येन त्वनपत्यता /
दौर्भाग्यं गुरुणा युक्ते सापत्यं भार्गवेण तु //
text_mt: With Mars, death; with Mercury, disease and childlessness; / with Jupiter, misfortune; with Venus, children;

sanskrit_iast:
pravrajyā sūryaputreṇa rāhuṇā mūlasaṃkṣayaḥ /
ketunā saṃyute candre nityaṃ kaṣṭaṃ daridratā //
meaning:
प्रव्रज्या सूर्यपुत्रेण राहुणा मूलसंक्षयः /
केतुना संयुते चन्द्रे नित्यं कष्टं दरिद्रता //
text_mt: With Saturn, renunciation; with Rāhu, total destruction of the family; / when the Moon is conjoined with Ketu, constant distress and indigence.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpagrahayute candre daṃpatyormaraṇaṃ bhavet /
śubhagrahayute candre svoccasthe mitrarāśige //
meaning:
पापग्रहयुते चन्द्रे दंपत्योर्मरणं भवेत् /
शुभग्रहयुते चन्द्रे स्वोच्चस्थे मित्रराशिगे //
text_mt: When the Moon is conjoined with a malefic planet, death of the couple occurs; / when the Moon is conjoined with a benefic planet, exalted, or in a friend's sign,

sanskrit_iast:
doṣāyanaṃ bhavellagnaṃ daṃpatyoḥ śreyase sadā /
svoccago vā svarkṣago vā mitra kṣetragatopi vā //
meaning:
दोषायनं भवेल्लग्नं दंपत्योः श्रेयसे सदा /
स्वोच्चगो वा स्वर्क्षगो वा मित्र क्षेत्रगतोपि वा //
text_mt: The lagna becomes an abode of good qualities, always for the welfare of the couple; / but if conjoined with a malefic planet, even if exalted, in its own asterism, or in a friendly sign,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpagnahayutaścandraḥ karoti maraṇaṃ tayoḥ /
daṃpatyoraṣṭamaṃ lagnamaṣṭamo rāśireva ca //
meaning:
पापग्नहयुतश्चन्द्रः करोति मरणं तयोः /
दंपत्योरष्टमं लग्नमष्टमो राशिरेव च //
text_mt: The Moon brings about their death. / If the eighth lagna or eighth sign of the couple

sanskrit_iast:
yadi lagnagataḥ sopi daṃpatyormaraṇapradaḥ /
sa rāśiḥ śubhasaṃyukto lagnaṃ vā śubhasaṃyutam //
meaning:
यदि लग्नगतः सोपि दंपत्योर्मरणप्रदः /
स राशिः शुभसंयुक्तो लग्नं वा शुभसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Itself becomes the rising lagna, it also causes the death of the couple; / even if that sign is conjoined with a benefic, or the lagna is conjoined with a benefic,

sanskrit_iast:
lagnaṃ vivarjayedyatnāttadaṃśāṃśatadīśvarām /
daṃpatyordvādaśaṃ lagnaṃ rāśirvā yadi lagnagaḥ //
meaning:
लग्नं विवर्जयेद्यत्नात्तदंशांशतदीश्वराम् /
दंपत्योर्द्वादशं लग्नं राशिर्वा यदि लग्नगः //
text_mt: One must diligently avoid the lagna, its sub-division (aṃśa), and their lords. / If the twelfth lagna or twelfth sign of the couple becomes the rising lagna,

sanskrit_iast:
arthahānistayorasmāttadaṃśasvāminaṃ tyajet /
janmarāśyudayaścaiva janmalagnodayaḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
अर्थहानिस्तयोरस्मात्तदंशस्वामिनं त्यजेत् /
जन्मराश्युदयश्चैव जन्मलग्नोदयः शुभः //
text_mt: Loss of wealth occurs for both; therefore, one should avoid the lord of that aṃśa. / The rising of the birth-sign and the rising of the birth-lagna are auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
tayorupacayasthānaṃ lagnetyantaśubhapradam /
khamārgaṇā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmā vedamārgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
तयोरुपचयस्थानं लग्नेत्यन्तशुभप्रदम् /
खमार्गणा वेदपक्षाः खरामा वेदमार्गणाः //
text_mt: The upacaya houses of those two, as lagna, bestow supreme good fortune. / [The viṣanāḍīs are:] fifty (khamārgaṇa, 50), twenty-four (vedapakṣa, 24), thirty (kharāma, 30), fifty-four (vedamārgaṇa, 54),

sanskrit_iast:
vahnicandrā rūpadasrāḥ kharāmā vyomabāhavaḥ /
dvirāmāḥ svāgnaṃyaḥ śūnyadasrāḥ kuñjarabhūmayaḥ //
meaning:
वह्निचन्द्रा रूपदस्राः खरामा व्योमबाहवः /
द्विरामाः स्वाग्नंयः शून्यदस्राः कुञ्जरभूमयः //
text_mt: Thirteen (vahnicandra, 13), twenty-one (rūpadasra, 21), thirty (kharāma, 30), twenty (vyomabāhu, 20), / thirty-two (dvirāma, 32), thirty-three (svāgni, 33), twenty (śūnyadasra, 20), eighteen (kuñjarabhūmi, 18),

sanskrit_iast:
rūpapakṣā vyomadasrā vedacandrāścaturddaśa /
śūnyacandrā vedacandrā ṣaḍṛkṣā vedabāhavaḥ //
meaning:
रूपपक्षा व्योमदस्रा वेदचन्द्राश्चतुर्द्दश /
शून्यचन्द्रा वेदचन्द्रा षडृक्षा वेदबाहवः //
text_mt: Twenty-one (rūpapakṣa, 21), twenty (vyomadasra, 20), fourteen (vedacandra, 14), fourteen (caturdaśa, 14), / ten (śūnyacandra, 10), fourteen (vedacandra, 14), twenty-six (ṣaḍṛkṣa, 26), twenty-four (vedabāhu, 24),

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyadasrāḥ śūnyacandrāḥ pūrṇacandrā gatendravaḥ /
tarkacandrā vedapakṣāḥ kharāmāścāśvibhātkramāt //
meaning:
शून्यदस्राः शून्यचन्द्राः पूर्णचन्द्रा गतेन्द्रवः /
तर्कचन्द्रा वेदपक्षाः खरामाश्चाश्विभात्क्रमात् //
text_mt: Twenty (śūnyadasra, 20), ten (śūnyacandra, 10), ten (pūrṇacandra, 10), zero (gatendrava, 0), / sixteen (tarkacandra, 16), twenty-four (vedapakṣa, 24), and thirty (kharāma, 30), in order from the asterism Aśvinī.

sanskrit_iast:
ābhyāḥ parāstu ghaṭikāścatasro viṣasaṃjñitāḥ /
vivāhādiṣu kāryeṣu viṣanāḍīṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
आभ्याः परास्तु घटिकाश्चतस्रो विषसंज्ञिताः /
विवाहादिषु कार्येषु विषनाडीं विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: The four ghaṭikās following these are designated as poison [ghaṭikās]; / in marriage and other rituals, one should avoid the poisonous nāḍī.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarādiṣu vāreṣu ye muhūrtāśca ninditāḥ /
vivāhādiṣu te varjyā apilakṣaguṇairyutāḥ //
meaning:
भास्करादिषु वारेषु ये मुहूर्ताश्च निन्दिताः /
विवाहादिषु ते वर्ज्या अपिलक्षगुणैर्युताः //
text_mt: The muhūrtas censured on the weekdays beginning with Sunday / should be avoided in marriage and other rites, even if endowed with a hundred thousand good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
nihitāvāradoṣā ye sūryavārādiṣu kramāt /
api sarvaguṇopetāste varjyāḥ sarvamaṅgale //
meaning:
निहितावारदोषा ये सूर्यवारादिषु क्रमात् /
अपि सर्वगुणोपेतास्ते वर्ज्याः सर्वमङ्गले //
text_mt: The flaws assigned to the weekdays in succession, beginning with Sunday, / must be avoided in every auspicious rite, even if endowed with all virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
ekārgalāṅghritulyaṃ yattallagnaṃ ca vivarjayet /
apiśukrejyasaṃyuktaṃ viṣasaṃyuktadugdhavat //
meaning:
एकार्गलाङ्घ्रितुल्यं यत्तल्लग्नं च विवर्जयेत् /
अपिशुक्रेज्यसंयुक्तं विषसंयुक्तदुग्धवत् //
text_mt: One must avoid an ascendant that corresponds to a quarter of Ekārgala, / even if conjoined with Venus and Jupiter, like milk mixed with poison.

sanskrit_iast:
grahaṇotpātabhaṃ tyājyaṃ maṅgaleṣu ṛtutrayam /
yāvacca śaśinā bhuktvā muktabhaṃ dagdhakāṣṭavat //
meaning:
ग्रहणोत्पातभं त्याज्यं मङ्गलेषु ऋतुत्रयम् /
यावच्च शशिना भुक्त्वा मुक्तभं दग्धकाष्टवत् //
text_mt: The constellation of an eclipse or portent is to be avoided in auspicious rites for three seasons, / and an asterism traversed and abandoned by the Moon [is avoided] like burnt wood.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgaleṣu tyajetśeṭairviddhaṃ ca krūrasaṃyutam /
akhilarkṣaṃ pañcagavyaṃ surābinduyutaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मङ्गलेषु त्यजेत्शेटैर्विद्धं च क्रूरसंयुतम् /
अखिलर्क्षं पञ्चगव्यं सुराबिन्दुयुतं तथा //
text_mt: In auspicious rites, one should avoid an entire asterism pierced by planets or conjoined with a malefic, / like the five products of the cow mixed with a drop of liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
pāda eva śubhairviddhamaśubhaṃ naiva kṛtstrabham /
krūraviddhaṃ yutaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ nikhilaṃ naiva maṅgalam //
meaning:
पाद एव शुभैर्विद्धमशुभं नैव कृत्स्त्रभम् /
क्रूरविद्धं युतं धिष्ण्यं निखिलं नैव मङ्गलम् //
text_mt: When pierced by benefics, only that quarter is inauspicious, not the whole asterism; / an asterism pierced or joined by a malefics is entirely devoid of auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tulāmithunakanyāṃśā dhanurantyārddhasaṃyutāḥ /
ete navāṃśāḥ śubhadā vṛṣabhasyāṃśakāḥ khalu //
meaning:
तुलामिथुनकन्यांशा धनुरन्त्यार्द्धसंयुताः /
एते नवांशाः शुभदा वृषभस्यांशकाः खलु //
text_mt: The navāṃśas of Libra, Gemini, and Virgo, joined with the latter half of Sagittarius, / and indeed the navāṃśas of Taurus—these navāṃśas bestow auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
antyāṃśāstepi śubhadā yadi vargottamāhvayāḥ /
anye navāṃśā na grāhyā yataste kunavāṃśakāḥ //
meaning:
अन्त्यांशास्तेपि शुभदा यदि वर्गोत्तमाह्वयाः /
अन्ये नवांशा न ग्राह्या यतस्ते कुनवांशकाः //
text_mt: The final navāṃśas are also auspicious if they are called vargottama; / other navāṃśas are not to be accepted, because they are bad navāṃśas.

sanskrit_iast:
kunavāṃśakalagnaṃ yattyājyaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam /
yasmindine mahāpātastaddinaṃ varjayecchubhe //
meaning:
कुनवांशकलग्नं यत्त्याज्यं सर्वगुणान्वितम् /
यस्मिन्दिने महापातस्तद्दिनं वर्जयेच्छुभे //
text_mt: An ascendant in a bad navāṃśa is to be discarded, even if endowed with all virtues. / The day on which a mahāpāta occurs should be avoided in auspicious rites;

sanskrit_iast:
api sarvaguṇopetaṃ dampatyormṛtyudaṃ yataḥ /
anuktāḥ svalpadoṣāḥ syurvidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ //
meaning:
अपि सर्वगुणोपेतं दम्पत्योर्मृत्युदं यतः /
अनुक्ताः स्वल्पदोषाः स्युर्विद्युन्नीहारवृष्टयः //
text_mt: even if endowed with all virtues, it brings death to the couple. / Minor flaws, which are not mentioned [as destructive], are lightning, mist, rain,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyarkapariveṣendracāpāṃbudharagarjanāḥ /
lattopagrahapātākhyā māsadagdhāhvayā tithiḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यर्कपरिवेषेन्द्रचापांबुधरगर्जनाः /
लत्तोपग्रहपाताख्या मासदग्धाह्वया तिथिः //
text_mt: mock suns, halos, rainbows, thunder, / lattā, upagraha, pātā, and the lunar day called māsadagdha;

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhalagnāndhabadhirapaṅgusaṃjñāśca rāśayaḥ /
evamādyāstatasteṣāṃ vyavasthā kriyate 'dhunā //
meaning:
दग्धलग्नान्धबधिरपङ्गुसंज्ञाश्च राशयः /
एवमाद्यास्ततस्तेषां व्यवस्था क्रियते ऽधुना //
text_mt: and the zodiacal signs designated as burnt ascendants, blind, deaf, and lame. / Their status is now set forth regarding these and similar matters:

sanskrit_iast:
akālajā bhavantyete vidyunnīhāravṛṣṭayaḥ /
doṣāya maṅgale nūnamadoṣāyaiva kālataḥ //
meaning:
अकालजा भवन्त्येते विद्युन्नीहारवृष्टयः /
दोषाय मङ्गले नूनमदोषायैव कालतः //
text_mt: When these—lightning, mist, and rain—occur out of season, / they certainly cause defect in an auspicious rite, but in their proper season they cause no defect at all.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiḥ kendragataḥ śukro vā yadi vā budhaḥ /
eko 'pi doṣanicayaṃ haratyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिः केन्द्रगतः शुक्रो वा यदि वा बुधः /
एको ऽपि दोषनिचयं हरत्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: If Jupiter, Venus, or Mercury / is placed in an angle, even one [of them] destroys the multitude of faults; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryakpañcorddhūgāḥ pañca rekhā dve dve ca koṇayoḥ /
dvitīye śaṃbhukoṇe 'gnidhiṣṇyaṃ cakre pravinyaset //
meaning:
तिर्यक्पञ्चोर्द्धूगाः पञ्च रेखा द्वे द्वे च कोणयोः /
द्वितीये शंभुकोणे ऽग्निधिष्ण्यं चक्रे प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Draw five horizontal lines, five vertical lines, and two in each corner; / in this diagram, one should place the asterism of Agni [Kṛttikā] in the second corner, the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānyatra sābhijityekarekhākheṭena viddhabham /
purataḥ pṛṣṭator'kādyā dinarkṣaṃ lattayanti yat //
meaning:
भान्यत्र साभिजित्येकरेखाखेटेन विद्धभम् /
पुरतः पृष्टतोर्ऽकाद्या दिनर्क्षं लत्तयन्ति यत् //
text_mt: The asterisms, including Abhijit, situated on the same line are asterisms pierced by a planet. / The planets, beginning with the Sun, which pierce the asterism of the day from the front or the back,

sanskrit_iast:
arkākṛtiguṇādynaṅgabāṇāṣṭanavasaṃkhyabham /
sūryabhātsārppapitryāntyatvāṣṭramitroḍuviṣṇubham //
meaning:
अर्काकृतिगुणाद्य्नङ्गबाणाष्टनवसंख्यभम् /
सूर्यभात्सार्प्पपित्र्यान्त्यत्वाष्ट्रमित्रोडुविष्णुभम् //
text_mt: strike the asterism numbering twelve, three, nine, six, five, eight, or nine / from the Sun's asterism, [or] the asterisms of the serpents [Āśleṣā], the ancestors [Maghā], the last [Revatī], Tvaṣṭṛ [Citrā], Mitra [Anurādhā], or Viṣṇu [Śravaṇa].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyāyā dinabhetāvadaśvibhātpātaduṣṭabham /
saurāṣṭre sālvadeśe tu lattitaṃ bhaṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
संख्याया दिनभेतावदश्विभात्पातदुष्टभम् /
सौराष्ट्रे साल्वदेशे तु लत्तितं भं विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: By counting to the daily asterism from Aśvinī, the asterism corrupted by pāta is found. / In Saurāṣṭra and the Sālva country, one must avoid an asterism struck by lattā;

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṅgavaṅgadeśeṣu pātitaṃ na śubhapradam /
bāhlike kurudeśe cānyasmindeśe na dūṣaṇam //
meaning:
कलिङ्गवङ्गदेशेषु पातितं न शुभप्रदम् /
बाह्लिके कुरुदेशे चान्यस्मिन्देशे न दूषणम् //
text_mt: [an asterism] afflicted by pāta does not bestow auspiciousness in the lands of Kaliṅga and Vaṅga; / in Bāhlika and the Kuru country and elsewhere it is not a defect.

sanskrit_iast:
tithayo māsadagdhāśca dagdhalagnāni yānyapi /
madhyadeśe vivarjyāni na dṛṣṭānītareṣu ca //
meaning:
तिथयो मासदग्धाश्च दग्धलग्नानि यान्यपि /
मध्यदेशे विवर्ज्यानि न दृष्टानीतरेषु च //
text_mt: The lunar days that are māsadagdha and the ascendants that are burnt / are to be avoided in the Madhyadeśa; they are not considered [flaws] in other regions.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṅgvaṃ dhakāṇalagnāni māsaśūnyāśca rāśayaḥ /
gauḍamālavayostyājyā anyadeśe na garhitāḥ //
meaning:
षङ्ग्वं धकाणलग्नानि मासशून्याश्च राशयः /
गौडमालवयोस्त्याज्या अन्यदेशे न गर्हिताः //
text_mt: Ascendants that are lame, blind, and one-eyed, and signs that are void in a month, / are to be rejected in Gauḍa and Mālava; in other countries they are not censured.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣaduṣṭaṃ sadā kālaṃ sannimārṣṭuṃ na śakyate /
api dhāturato grāhyaṃ doṣālpatvaṃ guṇādhikam //
meaning:
दोषदुष्टं सदा कालं सन्निमार्ष्टुं न शक्यते /
अपि धातुरतो ग्राह्यं दोषाल्पत्वं गुणाधिकम् //
text_mt: Time corrupted by flaws can never be completely cleansed, / even by the Creator; therefore, a lesser degree of flaw and an abundance of virtues should be accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sulagne daṃpatyoḥ kārayetsamyagīkṣaṇam /
hastocchritāṃ caturhastaiścaturasrāṃ samantataḥ //
meaning:
एवं सुलग्ने दंपत्योः कारयेत्सम्यगीक्षणम् /
हस्तोच्छ्रितां चतुर्हस्तैश्चतुरस्रां समन्ततः //
text_mt: Thus, at an auspicious ascendant, one should perform the mutual gazing of the bride and groom / [upon an altar] one cubit high, four cubits square on every side,

sanskrit_iast:
staṃbhaścaturbhiḥ suślakṣṇairvāmabhāge tu sannatām /
samaṇḍapāṃ caturdikṣu sopānairatiśobhitām //
meaning:
स्तंभश्चतुर्भिः सुश्लक्ष्णैर्वामभागे तु सन्नताम् /
समण्डपां चतुर्दिक्षु सोपानैरतिशोभिताम् //
text_mt: with four very smooth pillars, sloping towards the left, / furnished with a pavilion, and beautifully adorned with steps on all four sides;

sanskrit_iast:
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ raṃbhāstaṃbhairhaṃsaśukādibhiḥ /
vicitritāṃ citrakuṃbhairvividhaistoraṇāṅkuraiḥ //
meaning:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां रंभास्तंभैर्हंसशुकादिभिः /
विचित्रितां चित्रकुंभैर्विविधैस्तोरणाङ्कुरैः //
text_mt: sloping towards the north-east, decorated with plantain pillars, swans, parrots, and the like, / with ornamental jars, and various arches and fresh sprouts;

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārapuṣpanicayairvarṇakaiḥ samalaṅkṛtām /
viprāśīrvacanaiḥ puṇyasrībhirdivyairmanoramām //
meaning:
शृङ्गारपुष्पनिचयैर्वर्णकैः समलङ्कृताम् /
विप्राशीर्वचनैः पुण्यस्रीभिर्दिव्यैर्मनोरमाम् //
text_mt: adorned with arrays of auspicious flowers and pigments, / made delightful by the blessings of brāhmaṇas and by holy, celestial women;

sanskrit_iast:
vāditranṛtyagītādyairhṛdayānandinīṃ śubhām /
evaṃ vidhāṃ samārohenmithunaṃ svāgnivedikām //
meaning:
वादित्रनृत्यगीताद्यैर्हृदयानन्दिनीं शुभाम् /
एवं विधां समारोहेन्मिथुनं स्वाग्निवेदिकाम् //
text_mt: gladdening the heart with musical instruments, dancing, songs, and the like, auspicious— / the couple should ascend an altar of fire of such description.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭadhā rāśikūṭaṃ ca svādūḍugaṇarāśayaḥ /
rāśīśayonirvarṇākhyaṛtavaḥ putrapautradāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टधा राशिकूटं च स्वादूडुगणराशयः /
राशीशयोनिर्वर्णाख्यऋतवः पुत्रपौत्रदाः //
text_mt: The eightfold agreement of the signs consists of the asterism, the category, the signs, / the lord of the sign, the animal class, the caste, and the seasons, which grant sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarāśau pṛthagdiṣṇye daṃpatyoḥ pāṇipījanam /
uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ bhinnaṃ rāśyaikatvaṃ yayostayoḥ //
meaning:
एकराशौ पृथग्दिष्ण्ये दंपत्योः पाणिपीजनम् /
उत्तमं मध्यमं भिन्नं राश्यैकत्वं ययोस्तयोः //
text_mt: Marriage of the couple within the same sign but in different asterisms / is best; it is mediocre when the asterism is different and the sign is the same for both.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarkṣe tvekarāśau hi vivāhaḥ prāṇahānidaḥ /
strīdhiṣṇyādādyanavake strīdūramatininditam //
meaning:
एकर्क्षे त्वेकराशौ हि विवाहः प्राणहानिदः /
स्त्रीधिष्ण्यादाद्यनवके स्त्रीदूरमतिनिन्दितम् //
text_mt: Marriage in the same asterism and in the same sign causes loss of life. / If the bridegroom's asterism is in the first ennead from the bride's asterism, it is extremely censured as 'distant from the woman';

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tṛtīye navake nṛbham /
tisraḥ pūrvottarā dhātṛyāmyamāheśatārakāḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीये मध्यमं श्रेष्ठं तृतीये नवके नृभम् /
तिस्रः पूर्वोत्तरा धातृयाम्यमाहेशतारकाः //
text_mt: in the second [ennead] it is mediocre, and in the third ennead the groom's asterism is best. / The three constellations containing Pūrvā and Uttarā, Rohiṇī, Bharaṇī, and Ārdrā—

sanskrit_iast:
iti martyagaṇe jñeyaḥ syādamartyagaṇaḥ paraḥ /
haryādityārkavāyvantyamitrāśvījyendutārakāḥ //
meaning:
इति मर्त्यगणे ज्ञेयः स्यादमर्त्यगणः परः /
हर्यादित्यार्कवाय्वन्त्यमित्राश्वीज्येन्दुतारकाः //
text_mt: these are to be known as the human class; the divine class is different: / Puṣya, Punarvasu, Hastā, Svātī, Revatī, Anurādhā, Aśvinī, Tiṣya [or Puṣya], and Mṛgaśiras.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣogaṇaḥ pitṛtvāṣṭradvidaivāgnīndratārakāḥ /
vasuvārīśamūlāhitārakābhiryutāstataḥ //
meaning:
रक्षोगणः पितृत्वाष्ट्रद्विदैवाग्नीन्द्रतारकाः /
वसुवारीशमूलाहितारकाभिर्युतास्ततः //
text_mt: The demon class consists of the stars of the ancestors [Maghā], Tvaṣṭṛ [Citrā], the two deities [Viśākhā], fire and Indra [Kṛttikā, Jyeṣṭhā], / together with the stars of the Vasus [Dhaniṣṭhā], the lord of the waters [Śatabhiṣaj], Mūla, and the serpent [Āśleṣā].

sanskrit_iast:
daṃpatyorjanmabhe caikagaṇe prītiranekadhā /
madhyamā devamartyānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ tayormṛtiḥ //
meaning:
दंपत्योर्जन्मभे चैकगणे प्रीतिरनेकधा /
मध्यमा देवमर्त्यानां राक्षसानां तयोर्मृतिः //
text_mt: When the birth-asterisms of the bride and groom belong to the same class, love is manifold; / between divine and human it is middling; [a combination] with demons brings death to both.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuḥ ṣaṣṭāṣṭake pañcanavame tvanapatyatā /
naiḥsvya dvirdvādaśe 'nyeṣu daṃpatyoḥ prītiruttamā //
meaning:
मृत्युः षष्टाष्टके पञ्चनवमे त्वनपत्यता /
नैःस्व्य द्विर्द्वादशे ऽन्येषु दंपत्योः प्रीतिरुत्तमा //
text_mt: Death occurs in a sixth-eighth [sign relationship]; childlessness in a fifth-ninth; / poverty in a second-twelfth; in other [relationships] there is excellent affection between husband and wife.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādhipe mitrabhāve śubhadaṃ pāṇipīḍanam /
dvirdādaśe trikoṇe ca na kadācitṣaḍaṣṭake //
meaning:
एकाधिपे मित्रभावे शुभदं पाणिपीडनम् /
द्विर्दादशे त्रिकोणे च न कदाचित्षडष्टके //
text_mt: When there is the same planetary lord or friendship [between the lords], marriage bestows auspiciousness / in a second-twelfth or a trine [relationship], but never in a sixth-eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvebhameṣasarpāhihyotumeṣotumūṣakāḥ /
ākhugomahiṣavyāghrakālīvyāghramṛgadvayam //
meaning:
अश्वेभमेषसर्पाहिह्योतुमेषोतुमूषकाः /
आखुगोमहिषव्याघ्रकालीव्याघ्रमृगद्वयम् //
text_mt: Horse, elephant, ram, serpent, serpent, dog, cat, ram, cat, rat, / rat, cow, buffalo, tiger, hare, tiger, deer, deer,

sanskrit_iast:
śvānaḥ kaparirbabhruyuge kapisiṃhaturaṅgamāḥ /
siṃhagodantino bhānāṃ yonayaḥ syuryathāśvibhāt //
meaning:
श्वानः कपरिर्बभ्रुयुगे कपिसिंहतुरङ्गमाः /
सिंहगोदन्तिनो भानां योनयः स्युर्यथाश्विभात् //
text_mt: dog, monkey, mongoose pair, monkey, lion, horse, / lion, cow, and elephant are the animal classes of the asterisms in order from Aśvinī.

sanskrit_iast:
śvaiṇaṃ babhraragaṃ meṣavānarau siṃhavāraṇam /
govyāghramākhumārjāraṃ mahiṣāścaṃ ca śātravam //
meaning:
श्वैणं बभ्ररगं मेषवानरौ सिंहवारणम् /
गोव्याघ्रमाखुमार्जारं महिषाश्चं च शात्रवम् //
text_mt: The dog and deer, mongoose and snake, ram and monkey, lion and elephant, / cow and tiger, rat and cat, buffalo and horse are mutual enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
jhaṣālikarkaṭā viprāsta dūrdhvāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ /
puṃvarṇarāśeḥ strīrāśau satihīne yathāśubham //
meaning:
झषालिकर्कटा विप्रास्त दूर्ध्वाः क्षत्रियादयः /
पुंवर्णराशेः स्त्रीराशौ सतिहीने यथाशुभम् //
text_mt: Pisces, Scorpio, and Cancer are brāhmaṇas; beyond them are the kṣatriyas and the rest. / If the woman's sign is of a lower caste than the man's sign, it is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
catustrivdyaṅghribhotthāyāḥ kanyāyāścāśvibhātkramāt /
vahnibhādindubhānnāḍītricatuḥpañcaparvasu //
meaning:
चतुस्त्रिव्द्यङ्घ्रिभोत्थायाः कन्यायाश्चाश्विभात्क्रमात् /
वह्निभादिन्दुभान्नाडीत्रिचतुःपञ्चपर्वसु //
text_mt: For a maiden born in asterisms having four, three, two, or one quarter, in order from Aśvinī, / counting from the asterisms of Agni [Kṛttikā] and the Moon [Rohiṇī], across the three, four, and five nodes,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇayetsaṃkhyayā caikanāḍyāṃ mṛtyurna pārśvayoḥ /
prājāpatyabrāhmadaivā vivāhāścārṣasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
गणयेत्संख्यया चैकनाड्यां मृत्युर्न पार्श्वयोः /
प्राजापत्यब्राह्मदैवा विवाहाश्चार्षसंयुताः //
text_mt: one should calculate by number: there is death in the same channel, but not at the sides. / The Prājāpatya, Brāhma, Daiva, and Ārṣa marriages—

sanskrit_iast:
uktakāle tu kartavyāścatvāraḥ phaladāyakāḥ /
gandharvāsurapaiśācarākṣasākhyāstu sarvadā //
meaning:
उक्तकाले तु कर्तव्याश्चत्वारः फलदायकाः /
गन्धर्वासुरपैशाचराक्षसाख्यास्तु सर्वदा //
text_mt: these four, which grant good fruit, must be performed at the prescribed time; / but those called Gāndharva, Āsura, Paiśāca, and Rākṣasa may be performed at any time.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthamabhijillagnamudayarkṣāñca saptamam /
godhūlikaṃ tadubhayaṃ vivāhe putrapautradam //
meaning:
चतुर्थमभिजिल्लग्नमुदयर्क्षाञ्च सप्तमम् /
गोधूलिकं तदुभयं विवाहे पुत्रपौत्रदम् //
text_mt: The fourth ascendant, Abhijit, and the seventh from the rising asterism, / is the twilight ascendant; both grant sons and grandsons in marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyā na ca kaliṅgānāṃ mukhyaṃ godhūlikaṃ smṛtam /
abhijitsarvadeśeṣu mukhyo doṣavināśakṛt //
meaning:
प्राच्या न च कलिङ्गानां मुख्यं गोधूलिकं स्मृतम् /
अभिजित्सर्वदेशेषु मुख्यो दोषविनाशकृत् //
text_mt: The twilight ascendant is not considered primary by easterners or the people of Kaliṅga; / Abhijit is primary in all countries, destroying defects.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyandinagate bhānau muhūrto 'bhijidāhvayaḥ /
nāśayatyakhilāndoṣānpinākī tripuraṃ yathā //
meaning:
मध्यन्दिनगते भानौ मुहूर्तो ऽभिजिदाह्वयः /
नाशयत्यखिलान्दोषान्पिनाकी त्रिपुरं यथा //
text_mt: When the sun has reached midday, the muhūrta named Abhijit / destroys all defects, just as the bearer of Pināka [destroyed] Tripura.

sanskrit_iast:
putrodvāhātparaṃ putrīvivāho na ṛtutraye /
na tayorvratamudvāhānmaṅgale nānyamaṅgalam //
meaning:
पुत्रोद्वाहात्परं पुत्रीविवाहो न ऋतुत्रये /
न तयोर्व्रतमुद्वाहान्मङ्गले नान्यमङ्गलम् //
text_mt: A daughter's marriage should not take place within three seasons after a son's wedding; / their tonsure or sacred-thread investiture should not occur after marriage; one auspicious rite must not follow upon another.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhaścaikajanyānāṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yadi /
asaṃśayaṃ tribhirvarṣaistatraikā vidhavā bhavet //
meaning:
विवाहश्चैकजन्यानां षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे यदि /
असंशयं त्रिभिर्वर्षैस्तत्रैका विधवा भवेत् //
text_mt: If a marriage of those born of the same parents occurs within six months, / then without doubt, within three years one [of the brides] becomes a widow.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyudvāho naiva kāryo naikasmai duhitṛdvayam /
na caikajanyayoḥ puṃsorekajanye tu kanyake //
meaning:
प्रत्युद्वाहो नैव कार्यो नैकस्मै दुहितृद्वयम् /
न चैकजन्ययोः पुंसोरेकजन्ये तु कन्यके //
text_mt: A cross-marriage should never be done, nor two daughters [given] to one man, / nor two daughters born of the same mother [given] to two men born of the same parents.

sanskrit_iast:
naivaṃ kadācidudvāho naikadā muṇḍanadvayam /
divājātastu pitaraṃ rātrau tu jananīṃ tathā //
meaning:
नैवं कदाचिदुद्वाहो नैकदा मुण्डनद्वयम् /
दिवाजातस्तु पितरं रात्रौ तु जननीं तथा //
text_mt: Never should such a marriage be held, nor two tonsures at one time. / A child born in the day slays the father, and one born at night slays the mother;

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ saṃdhyayorhanti nāsti gaṇḍe viparyayaḥ /
sutaḥ sutā vā niyataṃ śvasuraṃ hṝnti mūlajaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानं संध्ययोर्हन्ति नास्ति गण्डे विपर्ययः /
सुतः सुता वा नियतं श्वसुरं हॄन्ति मूलजः //
text_mt: at the two twilights, it slays itself; there is no alteration in the Gaṇḍa junction. / A son or daughter born under Mūla definitely destroys the father-in-law;

sanskrit_iast:
tadantyapādajo naiva tathāśleṣādyapādajaḥ /
jyeṣṭāntyapādajau jyeṣṭaṃ bālo hṝnti na bālikā //
meaning:
तदन्त्यपादजो नैव तथाश्लेषाद्यपादजः /
ज्येष्टान्त्यपादजौ ज्येष्टं बालो हॄन्ति न बालिका //
text_mt: but not if born in its last quarter; likewise, one born in the first quarter of Āśleṣā [destroys the mother-in-law]. / Born in the last quarter of Jyeṣṭhā, a boy destroys the elder brother, but not a girl.

sanskrit_iast:
na bālikāṃbumūlarkṣe mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā /
saindrī dhavāgrajaṃ hṝnti devaraṃ tu dvidaivajā //
meaning:
न बालिकांबुमूलर्क्षे मातरं पितरं तथा /
सैन्द्री धवाग्रजं हॄन्ति देवरं तु द्विदैवजा //
text_mt: a girl born under Āśleṣā or Pūrvāṣāḍhā slays the mother and likewise the father. / A girl born under Jyeṣṭhā slays the elder brother of the husband, and one born under Viśākhā slays the husband's younger brother.

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhyodvāhadivasāt ṣaṣṭe vāpyaṣṭame dine /
vadhūpraveśa saṃpattyaidaśame saptame dine //
meaning:
आरभ्योद्वाहदिवसात् षष्टे वाप्यष्टमे दिने /
वधूप्रवेश संपत्त्यैदशमे सप्तमे दिने //
text_mt: Beginning from the day of the marriage, on the sixth or on the eighth day, / on the tenth or on the seventh day, the entrance of the bride is for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
hāyanadvitayaṃ janmabhalagnadivasānapi /
saṃtyajya hyatiśukre 'pi yātrā vaivāhikī śubhā //
meaning:
हायनद्वितयं जन्मभलग्नदिवसानपि /
संत्यज्य ह्यतिशुक्रे ऽपि यात्रा वैवाहिकी शुभा //
text_mt: Even when Venus is set, having avoided two years, / and also the days of the birth-constellation and ascendant, the marital journey is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpradaṃ sarvagīrvāṇasthāpanaṃ cottarāyaṇe /
gīrvāṇapūrvagīrvāṇamatriṇordṛśyamānayoḥ //
meaning:
श्रीप्रदं सर्वगीर्वाणस्थापनं चोत्तरायणे /
गीर्वाणपूर्वगीर्वाणमत्रिणोर्दृश्यमानयोः //
text_mt: The installation of all gods during the northern course of the sun brings prosperity, / when Jupiter and Venus are visible,

sanskrit_iast:
vicaitreṣveva māseṣu māghādiṣu ca pañcasu /
śuklapakṣeṣu kṛṣṇeṣu tadādiṣvaṣṭasu śubham //
meaning:
विचैत्रेष्वेव मासेषु माघादिषु च पञ्चसु /
शुक्लपक्षेषु कृष्णेषु तदादिष्वष्टसु शुभम् //
text_mt: in the months other than Caitra, namely in the five beginning with Māgha, / in the bright fortnights, and in the dark fortnights auspiciously in the eight [lunar days] beginning with the first,

sanskrit_iast:
dineṣu yasya devasya yā titistatra tasya ca /
dvatīyādidvaye pañcamyāditastisṛṣu kramāt //
meaning:
दिनेषु यस्य देवस्य या तितिस्तत्र तस्य च /
द्वतीयादिद्वये पञ्चम्यादितस्तिसृषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: on the days and lunar day proper to whichever god [is being installed]; / in order, in the two beginning with the second, in the three beginning with the fifth,

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyādeṣcatasṛṣu paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
tryuttarāditicandrāntyahastatrayagurūḍuṣu //
meaning:
दशम्यादेष्चतसृषु पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः /
त्र्युत्तरादितिचन्द्रान्त्यहस्तत्रयगुरूडुषु //
text_mt: in the four beginning with the tenth, and especially on the full moon day; / under the asterisms of the three Uttarās, Punarvasu, Revatī, Hasta, Citrā, Svātī, and Puṣya,

sanskrit_iast:
sāśvidhātṛjalādhīśaharimitravasuṣvapi /
kujavarjitavāreṣu kartuḥ sūrye balaprade //
meaning:
साश्विधातृजलाधीशहरिमित्रवसुष्वपि /
कुजवर्जितवारेषु कर्तुः सूर्ये बलप्रदे //
text_mt: along with Aśvinī, Rohiṇī, Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Śravaṇa, Anurādhā, and Dhaniṣṭhā, / on weekdays excluding Tuesday, when the Sun grants strength to the agent,

sanskrit_iast:
candratārābalopete pūrvāhne śobhane dine /
śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca kartturna nidhanodaye //
meaning:
चन्द्रताराबलोपेते पूर्वाह्ने शोभने दिने /
शुभलग्ने शुभांशे च कर्त्तुर्न निधनोदये //
text_mt: endowed with the strength of the Moon and the stars, in the forenoon of an auspicious day, / in an auspicious ascendant and auspicious divisional degree, when the eighth sign does not rise for the agent.

sanskrit_iast:
rāśayaḥ sakalāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhagrahayutekṣitāḥ /
pañcāṣṭake śubhe lagne naidhane śuddhisaṃyute //
meaning:
राशयः सकलाः श्रेष्ठाः शुभग्रहयुतेक्षिताः /
पञ्चाष्टके शुभे लग्ने नैधने शुद्धिसंयुते //
text_mt: All signs are excellent when conjoined with or aspected by benefic planets; / in an auspicious ascendant with five and eight [benefics], and the eighth house endowed with purity.

sanskrit_iast:
lagnasthāścandrasūryārarāhuketvarkasūnavaḥ /
kartturmṛtyupradāścānye dhanadhānyasukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
लग्नस्थाश्चन्द्रसूर्यारराहुकेत्वर्कसूनवः /
कर्त्तुर्मृत्युप्रदाश्चान्ये धनधान्यसुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: The Moon, Sun, Mars, Rāhu, Ketu, and Saturn situated in the ascendant / cause death to the agent; the others grant wealth, grain, and happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye neṣṭadāḥ pāpāḥ saumyāścandraścaḥ vittadāḥ /
tṛtīye nikhilāḥ kheṭāḥ putrapautrasukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीये नेष्टदाः पापाः सौम्याश्चन्द्रश्चः वित्तदाः /
तृतीये निखिलाः खेटाः पुत्रपौत्रसुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: Malefics in the second house do not give desired results; benefics and the Moon give wealth. / In the third house, all planets give the happiness of sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe sukhadāḥ saumyāḥ krūrāḥ kheṭāśca duḥkhadāḥ /
glānidāḥ pañcame krūrāḥ saumyāḥ putrasukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थे सुखदाः सौम्याः क्रूराः खेटाश्च दुःखदाः /
ग्लानिदाः पञ्चमे क्रूराः सौम्याः पुत्रसुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: In the fourth, benefics give happiness, and cruel planets cause misery. / In the fifth, cruel planets cause debility; benefics give the happiness of sons.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭe śubhāḥ śatrudāḥ syuḥ pāpāḥ śabrukṣayaṅkarāḥ /
vyādhidāḥ saptame pāpāḥ saumyāḥ śubhaphalapradāḥ //
meaning:
षष्टे शुभाः शत्रुदाः स्युः पापाः शब्रुक्षयङ्कराः /
व्याधिदाः सप्तमे पापाः सौम्याः शुभफलप्रदाः //
text_mt: In the sixth, benefics cause enemies; malefics bring about the destruction of enemies. / In the seventh, malefics bring disease; benefics grant auspicious results.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamasthāḥ khagāḥ sarvekarturmṛtyupradāyakāḥ /
dharme pāpā ghnanti saumyāḥ śubhadā maṅgalapradāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमस्थाः खगाः सर्वेकर्तुर्मृत्युप्रदायकाः /
धर्मे पापा घ्नन्ति सौम्याः शुभदा मङ्गलप्रदाः //
text_mt: All planets situated in the eighth house bring about death for the agent. / In the ninth, malefics destroy; benefics bring auspiciousness and grant prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
karmagā duḥkhadāḥ pāpā saumyāścandraśca kīrtidāḥ /
lābhasthānagatāḥ sarve bhūrilābhapradā grahāḥ //
meaning:
कर्मगा दुःखदाः पापा सौम्याश्चन्द्रश्च कीर्तिदाः /
लाभस्थानगताः सर्वे भूरिलाभप्रदा ग्रहाः //
text_mt: In the tenth, malefics cause misery; benefics and the Moon grant fame. / All planets situated in the house of gain (the eleventh) bestow abundant gain.

sanskrit_iast:
vyayasthānagatāḥ śaśvadbahūvyayakarā grahāḥ /
hṝntyarthahīnāḥ kartāraṃ mantrahīnāstu ṛtvijam //
sriyaṃ lakṣaṇahīnāstu na pratiṣṭāsamo ripuḥ //
meaning:
व्ययस्थानगताः शश्वद्बहूव्ययकरा ग्रहाः /
हॄन्त्यर्थहीनाः कर्तारं मन्त्रहीनास्तु ऋत्विजम् //
स्रियं लक्षणहीनास्तु न प्रतिष्टासमो रिपुः //
text_mt:
Planets situated in the house of expenditure (the twelfth) constantly cause great expenditure. / [Rites] devoid of wealth destroy the patron, while those devoid of mantra destroy the officiating priest;

[rites] devoid of correct marks destroy fortune; there is no enemy like a faulty consecration.

sanskrit_iast: guṇādhikatare lagne doṣaḥ svalpataro yadi //
meaning: गुणाधिकतरे लग्ने दोषः स्वल्पतरो यदि //
text_mt: If in an ascendant possessing an excess of merits there is a very small fault,

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ tatra karturiṣṭārthasiddhidam /
nirmāṇāyatanagrāmagṛhādīnāṃ samāsataḥ //
meaning:
सुराणां स्थापनं तत्र कर्तुरिष्टार्थसिद्धिदम् /
निर्माणायतनग्रामगृहादीनां समासतः //
text_mt: the installation of the gods therein accomplishes the desired goal for the agent. / In brief, for the construction of temples, villages, houses, and the like:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetramādau parīkṣeta gandhavarṇarasāṃśakaiḥ /
madhupuṣpāmlapiśitagandhaṃ viprānupūrvakam //
meaning:
क्षेत्रमादौ परीक्षेत गन्धवर्णरसांशकैः /
मधुपुष्पाम्लपिशितगन्धं विप्रानुपूर्वकम् //
