text_mt: One should first examine the ground by smell, color, taste, and portions: / having the smell of honey, flower, sour gruel, or flesh, in the order of the brāhmaṇas and other [castes];

sanskrit_iast:
sitaṃ raktaṃ ca haritaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ yathākramam /
madhuraṃ kaṭukaṃ tiktaṃ kaṣāyakarasaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
सितं रक्तं च हरितं कृष्णवर्णं यथाक्रमम् /
मधुरं कटुकं तिक्तं कषायकरसं क्रमात् //
text_mt: white, red, yellow, and black in color in due order; / sweet, pungent, bitter, and astringent in taste respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantavṛddhidaṃ nṝṇāmīśānaprāgudagplavam /
anyadikṣu plave teṣāṃ śaśvadatyantahānidam //
meaning:
अत्यन्तवृद्धिदं नॄणामीशानप्रागुदग्प्लवम् /
अन्यदिक्षु प्लवे तेषां शश्वदत्यन्तहानिदम् //
text_mt: A ground sloping toward the northeast, east, or north brings immense prosperity to men; / a slope toward other directions constantly brings immense loss to them.

sanskrit_iast:
samagartāratnimātraṃ khanitvā tatra pūrayet /
atyantavṛddhiradhike hīne hāniḥ same samam //
meaning:
समगर्तारत्निमात्रं खनित्वा तत्र पूरयेत् /
अत्यन्तवृद्धिरधिके हीने हानिः समे समम् //
text_mt: Having dug an even pit measuring one cubit, one should refill it with that [earth]; / if there is excess, there is immense prosperity; if a deficit, loss; if equal, neutrality.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā niśādau tatkṛtvā pānīyena prapūrayet /
prātardṛṣṭe jale vṛddhiḥ samaṃ paṅke kṣayaḥ kṣaye //
meaning:
तथा निशादौ तत्कृत्वा पानीयेन प्रपूरयेत् /
प्रातर्दृष्टे जले वृद्धिः समं पङ्के क्षयः क्षये //
text_mt: Likewise, having done that at the beginning of night, one should fill it with water. / If water is seen in the morning, there is prosperity; if mud, mediocrity; if it has diminished, ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ samyak kṣetraṃ samīkṣyate /
diksādhanāya tanmadhye samaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet //
meaning:
एवं लक्षणसंयुक्तं सम्यक् क्षेत्रं समीक्ष्यते /
दिक्साधनाय तन्मध्ये समं मण्डलमालिखेत् //
text_mt: Thus the plot endowed with proper characteristics is thoroughly examined. / To ascertain the directions, one should draw a level circle in its center.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ śaṅkuṃ sthāpyekṣettatra diktramam /
caturasrīkṛte kṣetre ṣaḍvargapariśodhite //
meaning:
द्वादशाङ्गुलकं शङ्कुं स्थाप्येक्षेत्तत्र दिक्त्रमम् /
चतुरस्रीकृते क्षेत्रे षड्वर्गपरिशोधिते //
text_mt: Setting up a gnomon of twelve fingers, one should observe therein the course of the directions. / On a site made square and purified by the six astrological criteria,

sanskrit_iast:
rekhāmārge ca karttavyaṃ prākāraṃ sumanoharam /
āyāmeṣu caturdikṣu prāgādiṣu ca satsvapi //
meaning:
रेखामार्गे च कर्त्तव्यं प्राकारं सुमनोहरम् /
आयामेषु चतुर्दिक्षु प्रागादिषु च सत्स्वपि //
text_mt: an exceedingly charming boundary wall should be built along the line. / In the extensions along the four directions, beginning with the east,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau pratidiśaṃ dvārāṇi syuryathākramam /
pradakṣiṇakramātteṣāmamūni ca phalāni vai //
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ प्रतिदिशं द्वाराणि स्युर्यथाक्रमम् /
प्रदक्षिणक्रमात्तेषाममूनि च फलानि वै //
text_mt: there should be eight doors in each direction in proper sequence. / In clockwise order, their results are indeed these:

sanskrit_iast:
hānirnaiḥ khyandhanaprāptirnṛpapūjā mahadvanam /
aticauryamatikrodho bhītirdiśi śacīpateḥ //
meaning:
हानिर्नैः ख्यन्धनप्राप्तिर्नृपपूजा महद्वनम् /
अतिचौर्यमतिक्रोधो भीतिर्दिशि शचीपतेः //
text_mt: Loss, fame, acquisition of wealth, royal honor, great forest, / extreme theft, extreme anger, and fear in the direction of Indra;

sanskrit_iast:
nidhanaṃ bandhanaṃ bhītirarthāptirddhanavarddhanam /
anāntakaṃ vyādhibhayaṃ niḥsattvaṃ dakṣiṇādiśi //
meaning:
निधनं बन्धनं भीतिरर्थाप्तिर्द्धनवर्द्धनम् /
अनान्तकं व्याधिभयं निःसत्त्वं दक्षिणादिशि //
text_mt: death, imprisonment, fear, gain of purpose, increase of wealth, / immortality, fear of disease, and weakness in the southern direction;

sanskrit_iast:
putrahāniḥ śatruvṛddhirlakṣmīprāptirddhanāgamaḥ /
saubhāgyamatidaurbhāgyaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaśca paścime //
meaning:
पुत्रहानिः शत्रुवृद्धिर्लक्ष्मीप्राप्तिर्द्धनागमः /
सौभाग्यमतिदौर्भाग्यं दुःखं शोकश्च पश्चिमे //
text_mt: loss of sons, increase of enemies, attainment of fortune, arrival of wealth, / good fortune, great misfortune, misery, and grief in the west;

sanskrit_iast:
kalatrahānirniḥ sattvaṃ hānirddhānyadhanāgamaḥ /
saṃpadvṛddhirmāsabhītirāmayaṃ diśi śītagoḥ //
meaning:
कलत्रहानिर्निः सत्त्वं हानिर्द्धान्यधनागमः /
संपद्वृद्धिर्मासभीतिरामयं दिशि शीतगोः //
text_mt: loss of a wife, weakness, loss, arrival of grain and wealth, / increase of prosperity, fear of months, and sickness in the direction of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gṛhādiṣu dvāravistārāddviguṇocchritam /
paścime dakṣiṇe vāpi kapāṭaṃ sthāpayedgṛhe //
meaning:
एवं गृहादिषु द्वारविस्ताराद्द्विगुणोच्छ्रितम् /
पश्चिमे दक्षिणे वापि कपाटं स्थापयेद्गृहे //
text_mt: Thus, in houses and the like, twice as high as the width of the door, / one should place the door-panel in the house, either in the west or in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
prākārāntaḥ kṣitiṃ kuryādekāśītipadaṃ yathā /
madhye navapade brahmasthānaṃ tadatininditam //
meaning:
प्राकारान्तः क्षितिं कुर्यादेकाशीतिपदं यथा /
मध्ये नवपदे ब्रह्मस्थानं तदतिनिन्दितम् //
text_mt: Inside the enclosure, one should make the ground into eighty-one squares; / in the center, on nine squares, is the place of Brahmā, which is extremely forbidden [for building].

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśadaṃśāḥ prākārasamīyāṃśāḥ samantataḥ /
piśācāṃśe gṛhāraṃbhe duḥkhaśokabhayapradaḥ //
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशदंशाः प्राकारसमीयांशाः समन्ततः /
पिशाचांशे गृहारंभे दुःखशोकभयप्रदः //
text_mt: Thirty-two divisions are the border divisions all around; / beginning a house in the piśāca division brings misery, grief, and fear.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāśāḥ syuśca nirmāṇe putrapautradhanapradāḥ /
śirāḥ syurvāstunorekhā digvidigmadhyasaṃbhavāḥ //
meaning:
शेषाशाः स्युश्च निर्माणे पुत्रपौत्रधनप्रदाः /
शिराः स्युर्वास्तुनोरेखा दिग्विदिग्मध्यसंभवाः //
text_mt: The remaining divisions for construction give sons, grandsons, and wealth. / The channels are lines of the building-site originating from the center of the cardinal and intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmabhāgāḥ piśācāṃśāḥ śirāṇāṃ yatra saṃhatiḥ /
tatra tatra vijānīyādvāstuno marmasaṃdhayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मभागाः पिशाचांशाः शिराणां यत्र संहतिः /
तत्र तत्र विजानीयाद्वास्तुनो मर्मसंधयः //
text_mt: The portions of Brahmā and the piśāca portions, wherever there is a junction of the channels, / in each such place one should know the vital points and joints of the building-site.

sanskrit_iast:
marmāṇi saṃdhayo neṣṭāḥ svasthe 'pyevaṃ niveśane /
saumyaphaālgunavaiśākhamāghaśrāvaṇakārtikāḥ //
meaning:
मर्माणि संधयो नेष्टाः स्वस्थे ऽप्येवं निवेशने /
सौम्यफआल्गुनवैशाखमाघश्रावणकार्तिकाः //
text_mt: Vital points and joints are not desired even in a well-situated dwelling. / Mārgaśīrṣa, Phālguna, Vaiśākha, Māgha, Śrāvaṇa, and Kārttika

sanskrit_iast:
māsāḥ syurgṛhanirmāṇe putrārogyadhanapradāḥ /
akārādiṣu bhāgṣu dikṣu prāgādiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
मासाः स्युर्गृहनिर्माणे पुत्रारोग्यधनप्रदाः /
अकारादिषु भाग्षु दिक्षु प्रागादिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: are months in house-construction that grant sons, health, and wealth. / In the divisions beginning with the sound 'a', in the directions beginning with the east in order,

sanskrit_iast:
kharośvotha hariḥ śvākhyaḥ sapokhugajaśāśakāḥ /
digvargāṇāmiyaṃ yoniḥ svavargātpañcamo ripuḥ //
meaning:
खरोश्वोथ हरिः श्वाख्यः सपोखुगजशाशकाः /
दिग्वर्गाणामियं योनिः स्ववर्गात्पञ्चमो रिपुः //
text_mt: are the donkey, horse, lion, dog, snake, rat, elephant, and hare. / This is the origin of the direction-groups; the fifth from one's own group is an enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyavargaḥ puraḥ sthāpya pṛṣṭataḥ sādhakaṃ nyaset /
vyatyaye nāśanaṃ tasya ṛṇamadhyaṃ dhanācchubham //
meaning:
साध्यवर्गः पुरः स्थाप्य पृष्टतः साधकं न्यसेत् /
व्यत्यये नाशनं तस्य ऋणमध्यं धनाच्छुभम् //
text_mt: One should place the target-group in front and set the practitioner-group behind; / in the reverse, there is destruction; a middle debt is auspicious from wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhya sādhakaṃ ghiṣṇyaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvaccaturguṇam /
vibhejetsaptabhiḥ śeṣaṃ sādhakasya dhanaṃ tadā //
meaning:
आरभ्य साधकं घिष्ण्यं साध्यं यावच्चतुर्गुणम् /
विभेजेत्सप्तभिः शेषं साधकस्य धनं तदा //
text_mt: Starting from the practitioner asterism up to the target, multiplied by four, / one should divide by seven; the remainder is then the wealth of the practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
vistāra āyāmaguṇo gṛhasya padamucyate /
tasmāddhanādhanāyarkṣavārāṃśāḥ saṃkhyayā kramāt //
meaning:
विस्तार आयामगुणो गृहस्य पदमुच्यते /
तस्माद्धनाधनायर्क्षवारांशाः संख्यया क्रमात् //
text_mt: The breadth multiplied by the length is called the square area of the house. / From that, wealth, non-wealth, asterism, and portions of the day are computed by number in due sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanādhikaṃ gṛhaṃ vṛddhyai ṛṇādhikamaśobhanam /
viṣamāyaḥ śubhaghāyaiva samāyo nirdhanāya ca //
meaning:
धनाधिकं गृहं वृद्ध्यै ऋणाधिकमशोभनम् /
विषमायः शुभघायैव समायो निर्धनाय च //
text_mt: A house with an excess of wealth brings prosperity; one with an excess of debt is inauspicious. / An odd income destroys good fortune, and an equal income leads to poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
ghanakṣayastṛtīyarkṣe pañcamarkṣe paraḥ kṣayaḥ /
ātmakṣayaḥ saptamarkṣe bhavatyeva hi bhartṛbhāt //
meaning:
घनक्षयस्तृतीयर्क्षे पञ्चमर्क्षे परः क्षयः /
आत्मक्षयः सप्तमर्क्षे भवत्येव हि भर्तृभात् //
text_mt: In the third asterism there is loss of accumulated wealth; in the fifth asterism, great ruin; / and in the seventh asterism from the master's birth-star, destruction of self indeed occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
dvirdvādaśo nirdhanāya trikoṇamasutāya ca /
ṣaṭkāṣṭakaṃ mṛtyave syācchubhadārāśayaḥ pare //
meaning:
द्विर्द्वादशो निर्धनाय त्रिकोणमसुताय च /
षट्काष्टकं मृत्यवे स्याच्छुभदाराशयः परे //
text_mt: The second and twelfth [positions] cause poverty; the trine causes childlessness; / the sixth and eighth cause death; the other signs are auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāṅgārakavārāṃśā vaiśvānarabhayapradāḥ /
itare grahavārāṃśāḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhidāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्याङ्गारकवारांशा वैश्वानरभयप्रदाः /
इतरे ग्रहवारांशाः सर्वकामार्थसिद्धिदाः //
text_mt: The day-divisions of the Sun and Mars cause danger from fire; / the day-divisions of the other planets grant the attainment of all desires and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasyādiṣu māseṣu triṣu triṣu yathākramam /
pūrvādikaśirovāmapārśveśāyāpradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
नभस्यादिषु मासेषु त्रिषु त्रिषु यथाक्रमम् /
पूर्वादिकशिरोवामपार्श्वेशायाप्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
In three months each, beginning with Nabhasya in due order,
lying on the left side, [facing] the north-east, with the head towards the east and subsequent [directions] clockwise,

sanskrit_iast:
carāhvayo vāstupumān caratyevaṃ mahodaraḥ /
yaddiṅmukho vāstupumān kuryāttaddiṅmukhaṃ gṛham //
meaning:
चराह्वयो वास्तुपुमान् चरत्येवं महोदरः /
यद्दिङ्मुखो वास्तुपुमान् कुर्यात्तद्दिङ्मुखं गृहम् //
text_mt:
the large-bellied site-man called Cara thus roams.
In whichever direction the site-man has his face turned, in that direction one should make the house face.

sanskrit_iast:
pratikūlamukhaṃ gehaṃ rogaśokabhayapradam /
sabalo mukhagehānāmeṣa doṣo na vidyate //
meaning:
प्रतिकूलमुखं गेहं रोगशोकभयप्रदम् /
सबलो मुखगेहानामेष दोषो न विद्यते //
text_mt:
A house facing in the opposite direction brings disease, grief, and fear.
For a house that has a strong front, this defect is not found.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtyeṭikāṃ svarṇareṇudhānyaśaivalasaṃyutam /
gṛhamadhye hastamātre garte nyāsāya vinyaset //
meaning:
वृत्येटिकां स्वर्णरेणुधान्यशैवलसंयुतम् /
गृहमध्ये हस्तमात्रे गर्ते न्यासाय विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
Along with an enclosed brick, gold dust, grain, and algae,
one should place [them] for deposit in a pit measuring one cubit in the centre of the house.

sanskrit_iast:
vastvāyāmadalaṃ nābhistasmādadhyaṅgulatrayam /
kukṣistasminnyasecchaṅkuṃ putrapautravivardhanam //
meaning:
वस्त्वायामदलं नाभिस्तस्मादध्यङ्गुलत्रयम् /
कुक्षिस्तस्मिन्न्यसेच्छङ्कुं पुत्रपौत्रविवर्धनम् //
text_mt:
Half of the length of the site is the navel; three aṅgulas above that
is the belly; there one should drive the peg that causes sons and grandsons to flourish.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviśatrayorviṃśatṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgulaiḥ /
viprādīnāṃ kukṣimānaṃ svarṇavastrādyalaṅkṛtam //
meaning:
चतुर्विशत्रयोर्विंशत्षोडशद्वादशाङ्गुलैः /
विप्रादीनां कुक्षिमानं स्वर्णवस्त्राद्यलङ्कृतम् //
text_mt:
By twenty-four, twenty-three, sixteen, and twelve aṅgulas
is the belly measurement for Brahmins and the others, adorned with gold, cloth, and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
khadirārjunaśālotthaṃ yugayantraṃ tarūdbhaghavam /
raktacandanapālāśaraktaśānaviśālajam //
meaning:
खदिरार्जुनशालोत्थं युगयन्त्रं तरूद्भघवम् /
रक्तचन्दनपालाशरक्तशानविशालजम् //
text_mt:
Produced from Khadira, Arjuna, or Śāla, a balanced peg born of trees,
or made of red sandalwood, Palāśa, or broad Raktaśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
śakuṃ tridhā vibhajyāndyaṃ caturasraṃ tataḥ param /
aṣṭāsraṃ ca tṛtīyāsau manvasraṃ mṛdumavraṇam //
meaning:
शकुं त्रिधा विभज्यान्द्यं चतुरस्रं ततः परम् /
अष्टास्रं च तृतीयासौ मन्वस्रं मृदुमव्रणम् //
text_mt:
having divided the peg into three parts: the first four-sided, following that
eight-sided, and the third fourteen-sided, smooth and free from blemishes—

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ parikalpya śubhe dine /
ṣaḍvargaśuddhisūtreṇa sūtrite dharaṇītale //
meaning:
एवं लक्षणसंयुक्तं परिकल्प्य शुभे दिने /
षड्वर्गशुद्धिसूत्रेण सूत्रिते धरणीतले //
text_mt:
having thus fashioned it endowed with [auspicious] characteristics on an auspicious day,
when the ground has been marked out with the string purified by the six astrological divisions,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdudhruvakṣiprabheṣu riktāmāvarjite dine /
vyarkāracaralagneṣu pāpe cāṣṭamavarjite //
meaning:
मृदुध्रुवक्षिप्रभेषु रिक्तामावर्जिते दिने /
व्यर्कारचरलग्नेषु पापे चाष्टमवर्जिते //
text_mt:
under mild, fixed, or swift asterisms, on a day free from Rikta [tithis] and the new moon,
in movable ascendants devoid of the Sun and Mars, and with malefics absent from the eighth house,

sanskrit_iast:
naidhane śuddhisaṃyukte śubhaghalagne śubhāṃśake /
śubhekṣite 'tha vā yukte lagne śaṅkuṃ vinikṣipet //
meaning:
नैधने शुद्धिसंयुक्ते शुभघलग्ने शुभांशके /
शुभेक्षिते ऽथ वा युक्ते लग्ने शङ्कुं विनिक्षिपेत् //
text_mt:
when the eighth house is purified, in a benefic ascendant and a benefic navāṃśa,
aspected by or conjoined with a benefic in the ascendant, one should drive the peg.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāhaghoṣairvāditraiḥ puṇyapuṇyāṅganādibhiḥ /
svatrikendratrikoṇasthaiḥ śubhaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ //
meaning:
पुण्याहघोषैर्वादित्रैः पुण्यपुण्याङ्गनादिभिः /
स्वत्रिकेन्द्रत्रिकोणस्थैः शुभैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः //
text_mt:
Accompanied by proclamations of auspicious days, musical instruments, and blessed chaste women,
with benefics situated in their own trines, angles, and trines, and the other [malefics] situated in the third, eleventh, and sixth houses,

sanskrit_iast:
lagnāṃśāṣṭāricandreṇa daivajñārcanapūrvakam /
ekadvitricatuḥśālāḥ sapta śālā daśāhvayāḥ //
meaning:
लग्नांशाष्टारिचन्द्रेण दैवज्ञार्चनपूर्वकम् /
एकद्वित्रिचतुःशालाः सप्त शाला दशाह्वयाः //
text_mt:
with the Moon in the ascendant's navāṃśa, the eighth, or the sixth, preceded by the worship of the astrologer:
there are houses of one, two, three, and four halls, seven halls, and those called ten [halls].

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ punaḥ ṣaḍvidhāḥ śālāḥ pratyekaṃ daśaṣaḍvidhāḥ /
dhruvaṃ dhānyaṃ jayaṃ nandaṃ kharaḥ kāntaṃ manoramam //
meaning:
ताः पुनः षड्विधाः शालाः प्रत्येकं दशषड्विधाः /
ध्रुवं धान्यं जयं नन्दं खरः कान्तं मनोरमम् //
text_mt:
Those halls are again of six kinds, each being of sixteen kinds:
Dhruva, Dhānya, Jaya, Nanda, Khara, Kānta, Manorama,

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhaṃ durmukhaṃ krūraṃ śatruṃ svarṇapradaṃ kṣayam /
ākrandaṃ vipulākhya ca vijayaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ gṛham //
meaning:
सुमुखं दुर्मुखं क्रूरं शत्रुं स्वर्णप्रदं क्षयम् /
आक्रन्दं विपुलाख्य च विजयं षोडशं गृहम् //
text_mt:
Sumukha, Durmukha, Krūra, Śatru, Svarṇaprada, Kṣaya,
Ākranda, the one named Vipula, and the sixteenth house, Vijaya.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇi gaṇayedevaṃ teṣāṃ prastārabhedataḥ /
guroragho laghuḥ sthāpyaḥ purastādūrdhvavannyaset //
meaning:
गृहाणि गणयेदेवं तेषां प्रस्तारभेदतः /
गुरोरघो लघुः स्थाप्यः पुरस्तादूर्ध्ववन्न्यसेत् //
text_mt:
One should calculate the houses in this manner through the permutations of their distribution:
a light [syllable] is to be placed below a heavy [syllable]; in front, one should place it as above;

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhiḥ pūrayetpaścātsarvaladhvavadhīrvidhiḥ /
kuryāllaghupade 'lindaṃ gṛhadvārātpradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
गुरुभिः पूरयेत्पश्चात्सर्वलध्ववधीर्विधिः /
कुर्याल्लघुपदे ऽलिन्दं गृहद्वारात्प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
one should fill [the rest] behind with heavy [syllables]—this rule holds until all are light.
In the place of a light [syllable], one should make a veranda clockwise from the door of the house.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādigeṣvalindeṣu gṛhabhedāstu ṣoḍaśa /
snānāgāraṃ diśi prācyāmāgneyyāṃ pākamandiram //
meaning:
पूर्वादिगेष्वलिन्देषु गृहभेदास्तु षोडश /
स्नानागारं दिशि प्राच्यामाग्नेय्यां पाकमन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
With the verandas facing the east and other directions, there are sixteen varieties of houses:
the bathhouse in the eastern quarter; in the south-east, the kitchen;

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyāṃ ca śayanāgāraṃ nairṛtyāṃ śāsramandiram /
pratīcyāṃ bhojanagṛhaṃ vā yavyāṃ dhānyamadiram //
meaning:
याम्यां च शयनागारं नैरृत्यां शास्रमन्दिरम् /
प्रतीच्यां भोजनगृहं वा यव्यां धान्यमदिरम् //
text_mt:
in the south, the bedroom; in the south-west, the armoury;
in the west, the dining room; in the north-west, the granary;

sanskrit_iast:
kauberyāṃ devatāgāramīśānyāṃ kṣiramandiram /
śayyāmūtrāstratadvicca bhojanaṃ maṅgalāśrayam //
dhānyastrībhogavittaṃ ca śṛṅgārāyatanāni ca ///
meaning:
कौबेर्यां देवतागारमीशान्यां क्षिरमन्दिरम् /
शय्यामूत्रास्त्रतद्विच्च भोजनं मङ्गलाश्रयम् //
धान्यस्त्रीभोगवित्तं च शृङ्गारायतनानि च ///

sanskrit_iast: īśānyādikramasteṣāṃ gṛhanirmāṇakaṃ śubham //
meaning: ईशान्यादिक्रमस्तेषां गृहनिर्माणकं शुभम् //
text_mt: their construction of the house in the order beginning with the north-east is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣvetāni śastrāṇi svaṃ sthāpyāni svadikṣvapi /
dhvajo dhūmrotha siṃhaḥ śvā saurameyaḥ kharo gajāḥ //
meaning:
एतेष्वेतानि शस्त्राणि स्वं स्थाप्यानि स्वदिक्ष्वपि /
ध्वजो धूम्रोथ सिंहः श्वा सौरमेयः खरो गजाः //
text_mt:
Among these, these auspicious [arrangements] are to be established in their own directions:
Dhvaja, Dhūmra, Siṃha, Śvan, Saurameya, Khara, Gaja,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvāṅkṣaścaiva bhavantyaṣṭau pūrvādipāḥ kramādamī /
plakṣoduṃbaracūtākhyā niṃbastu hi vibhītakāḥ //
meaning:
ध्वाङ्क्षश्चैव भवन्त्यष्टौ पूर्वादिपाः क्रमादमी /
प्लक्षोदुंबरचूताख्या निंबस्तु हि विभीतकाः //
text_mt:
and Dhvāṅkṣa are the eight [ayas] that rule the directions beginning with the east, in order.
Plakṣa, Udumbara, the so-called Cūta, Nimba, and indeed Vibhītaka,

sanskrit_iast:
ya kaṭakā dugdhavṛkṣā vṛkṣāśvatthakapitthakāḥ /
agastisiṃdhuvālākhyatintiḍīkāśca ninditāḥ //
meaning:
य कटका दुग्धवृक्षा वृक्षाश्वत्थकपित्थकाः /
अगस्तिसिंधुवालाख्यतिन्तिडीकाश्च निन्दिताः //
text_mt:
thorny [trees], milky trees, Aśvattha and Kapittha trees,
and those called Agasti, Sindhuvāra, and Tintiḍīka are censured.

sanskrit_iast:
pittavāgrajadehasyātpaścime dakṣiṇe tathā /
gṛhapādāgṛhastabhāḥ samāḥ śastāśca nāsamāḥ //
meaning:
पित्तवाग्रजदेहस्यात्पश्चिमे दक्षिणे तथा /
गृहपादागृहस्तभाः समाः शस्ताश्च नासमाः //
text_mt:
They would cause bilious and windy disorders to the body in the west and in the south.
The supports and pillars of the house should be even and auspicious, not uneven.

sanskrit_iast:
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ kuḍyotsedhaṃ yathāruci /
gṛhopari gṛhādīnāmevaṃ sarvatra cintayet //
meaning:
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं कुड्योत्सेधं यथारुचि /
गृहोपरि गृहादीनामेवं सर्वत्र चिन्तयेत् //
text_mt:
Neither too high nor too low, the height of the walls should be according to desire.
One should consider in this manner everywhere regarding a house above a house and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhādīnāṃ gṛhaśrāvaṃ kramaśo 'ṣṭavidhaṃ smṛtam /
pāñcālamānaṃ vaidehaṃ kauravaṃ ca kujanyakam //
meaning:
गृहादीनां गृहश्रावं क्रमशो ऽष्टविधं स्मृतम् /
पाञ्चालमानं वैदेहं कौरवं च कुजन्यकम् //
text_mt:
The roof-slope of houses and the like is traditionally remembered to be of eight kinds in order:
the Pāñcāla measure, Vaideha, Kaurava, Kaujanyaka,

sanskrit_iast:
māgadhaṃ śūrasenaṃ ca gāndhārāvatikā smṛtam /
sacaturbhāgavistāramutsedhaṃ yattaducyate //
meaning:
मागधं शूरसेनं च गान्धारावतिका स्मृतम् /
सचतुर्भागविस्तारमुत्सेधं यत्तदुच्यते //
text_mt:
Māgadha, Śūrasena, Gāndhāra, and Avantika.
The height which is stated to be four parts of the width,

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcālamātulānāṃ ca hyuttarottaravṛddhitaḥ /
vaidehādīnyaśeṣāṇi mānāni syuryathākramam //
meaning:
पाञ्चालमातुलानां च ह्युत्तरोत्तरवृद्धितः /
वैदेहादीन्यशेषाणि मानानि स्युर्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
through the successive increase of the Pāñcāla and the cross-beams,
would yield all the measures beginning with Vaideha in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcālamānaṃ sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇamataḥ param /
avantimānaṃ viprāṇāṃ gāndhāraṃ kṣatriyasya ca //
meaning:
पाञ्चालमानं सर्वेषां साधारणमतः परम् /
अवन्तिमानं विप्राणां गान्धारं क्षत्रियस्य च //
text_mt:
The Pāñcāla measure is common to all. Beyond this:
the Avanti measure is for Brahmins, and the Gāndhāra for a Kṣatriya;

sanskrit_iast:
kaujanyamānaṃ vaiśyānāṃ viprādīnāṃ yathottaram /
yathoditaṃ jalastrāvyaṃ dvitribhūmikaveśmanām //
meaning:
कौजन्यमानं वैश्यानां विप्रादीनां यथोत्तरम् /
यथोदितं जलस्त्राव्यं द्वित्रिभूमिकवेश्मनाम् //
text_mt:
the Kaujanya measure is for Vaiśyas, and for Brahmins and the others in upward order.
As prescribed, water is to be drained from houses of two or three storeys.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṭrakuñjaraśālānāṃ dhvajāyepyathā vā gaje /
paśuśālāśca śālānāṃ dhvajāyepyatha vā gaje //
meaning:
उष्ट्रकुञ्जरशालानां ध्वजायेप्यथा वा गजे /
पशुशालाश्च शालानां ध्वजायेप्यथ वा गजे //
text_mt:
For stables of camels and elephants, [it should be] in the Dhvaja āya or else in the Gaja [āya];
and animal pens and halls, in the Dhvaja āya or else in the Gaja [āya].

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraśayyāśanāmatradhvajāḥ siṃhavṛṣadhvajāḥ /
vāstupūjāvidhiṃ vakṣye navaveśmapraveśane //
meaning:
द्वारशय्याशनामत्रध्वजाः सिंहवृषध्वजाः /
वास्तुपूजाविधिं वक्ष्ये नववेश्मप्रवेशने //
text_mt:
For doors, beds, eating, and vessels: the Dhvaja, Siṃha, and Vṛṣa āyas.
I shall declare the ritual of worshipping the site upon entering a new dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
hastamātrā likhedrekhā daśa pūrvā daśottarāḥ /
gṛhamadhye taṇḍuloparyekāśītipadaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
हस्तमात्रा लिखेद्रेखा दश पूर्वा दशोत्तराः /
गृहमध्ये तण्डुलोपर्येकाशीतिपदं भवेत् //
text_mt:
One should draw ten lines to the east and ten to the north, measuring a cubit,
in the centre of the house upon raw rice; there shall be eighty-one squares.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcottarānvakṣyamāṇāṃścatvariṃśatsurān likhet /
dvātrindvāhyataḥ pūjyāstatrāntaḥsthāsrayodaśa //
meaning:
पञ्चोत्तरान्वक्ष्यमाणांश्चत्वरिंशत्सुरान् लिखेत् /
द्वात्रिन्द्वाह्यतः पूज्यास्तत्रान्तःस्थास्रयोदश //
text_mt:
One should draw forty-five gods who will be spoken of:
thirty-two are to be worshipped on the outside, and thirteen residing within.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sthānāni nāmāni vakṣyāmi kramaśodhunā /
īśānakoṇato bāhyo dvātriṃśatrridaśā amī //
meaning:
तेषां स्थानानि नामानि वक्ष्यामि क्रमशोधुना /
ईशानकोणतो बाह्यो द्वात्रिंशत्र्रिदशा अमी //
text_mt:
I shall now declare their places and names in order:
from the north-east corner, on the outside, are these thirty-two gods:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpīṭayoniḥ parjanyo jayantaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ /
sūryaḥ śaśī mṛgākāśau vāyuḥ pūṣā ca nairṛtiḥ //
meaning:
कृपीटयोनिः पर्जन्यो जयन्तः पाकशासनः /
सूर्यः शशी मृगाकाशौ वायुः पूषा च नैरृतिः //
text_mt:
Kṛpīṭayoni, Parjanya, Jayanta, Pākaśāsana,
Sūrya, Śaśin, Mṛga, Ākāśa, Vāyu, Pūṣan, and Nairṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhākṣato daṇḍadharo gāndharvo bhṛgurājakaḥ /
mṛgaḥ pitṛgaṇādhiśastato dauvāri kāhvayaḥ //
meaning:
गृहाक्षतो दण्डधरो गान्धर्वो भृगुराजकः /
मृगः पितृगणाधिशस्ततो दौवारि काह्वयः //
text_mt:
Gṛhākṣata, Daṇḍadhara, Gāndharva, Bhṛgurājaka,
Mṛga, the lord of the ancestral hosts, then the one named Dauvārika,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmaḥ sūryo 'ditiditī dvātriṃśatrridaśā amī /
atheśānādikoṇasthāścātvārastatsamīpagāḥ //
meaning:
सामः सूर्यो ऽदितिदिती द्वात्रिंशत्र्रिदशा अमी /
अथेशानादिकोणस्थाश्चात्वारस्तत्समीपगाः //
text_mt:
Soma, Sūrya, Aditi, and Diti—these are the thirty-two gods.
Now the four situated in the corners beginning with the north-east, standing near them:

sanskrit_iast:
āpaḥ sāvitraghasaṃjñaśca jayo rudraḥ kramādamī /
ekāntarā syuḥ prāgādyāḥ parito brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
आपः सावित्रघसंज्ञश्च जयो रुद्रः क्रमादमी /
एकान्तरा स्युः प्रागाद्याः परितो ब्रह्मणः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
Āpas, the one named Sāvitra, Jaya, and Rudra in due order.
Surrounding Brahmā, beginning with the east, are remembered [those with] one intervening space:

sanskrit_iast:
aryamā savitā biṃbavivattkānvaktudhādhipaḥ /
mitrotha rājayakṣmā ca tathā pṛthvīdharāhvayaḥ //
meaning:
अर्यमा सविता बिंबविवत्त्कान्वक्तुधाधिपः /
मित्रोथ राजयक्ष्मा च तथा पृथ्वीधराह्वयः //
text_mt:
Aryaman, Savitṛ, Vivasvat, the lord of nectar [Vibhuda],
Mitra, then Rājayakṣman, and likewise the one named Pṛthvīdhara,

sanskrit_iast:
āpavatso 'ṣṭamaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśatsurā amī /
āpaścaivāpavatsaśca parjanyo 'gnirditiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
आपवत्सो ऽष्टमः पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्सुरा अमी /
आपश्चैवापवत्सश्च पर्जन्यो ऽग्निर्दितिः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
and Āpavatsa as the eighth—these are the forty-five gods.
Āpas, Āpavatsa, Parjanya, Agni, and Diti, in order,

sanskrit_iast:
yaddikkānāṃ ca vargo 'yamevaṃ koṇeṣvaśeṣataḥ /
tanmadhye viṃśatirbāhyā dvipadāste tu sarvadā //
meaning:
यद्दिक्कानां च वर्गो ऽयमेवं कोणेष्वशेषतः /
तन्मध्ये विंशतिर्बाह्या द्विपदास्ते तु सर्वदा //
text_mt:
and this group belonging to that direction—thus in all the corners.
Among them, the outer twenty always occupy two squares.

sanskrit_iast:
aryamā ca vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ pṛthvī dharāhvayaḥ /
brahmaṇaḥ pārito dikṣu catvārastripadāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अर्यमा च विवस्वांश्च मित्रः पृथ्वी धराह्वयः /
ब्रह्मणः पारितो दिक्षु चत्वारस्त्रिपदाः स्मृताः //
text_mt:
Aryaman, Vivasvat, Mitra, and the one named Pṛthvīdhara:
these four around Brahmā in the cardinal directions are remembered as occupying three squares.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathaikadvitripadānarcayetsurān /
vāstumantreṇa vāstujño dūrvādadhyakṣatādibhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं च तथैकद्वित्रिपदानर्चयेत्सुरान् /
वास्तुमन्त्रेण वास्तुज्ञो दूर्वादध्यक्षतादिभिः //
text_mt:
One who knows the site should worship Brahmā and likewise the gods occupying one, two, or three squares
with the Vāstu mantra, using dūrvā grass, curd, unbroken grains, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmamantreṇa vā śvetavastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet /
āvāhanādisarvopacārāṃśca kramaśastathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्ममन्त्रेण वा श्वेतवस्त्रयुग्मं प्रदापयेत् /
आवाहनादिसर्वोपचारांश्च क्रमशस्तथा //
text_mt:
or with the Brahmā mantra; one should present a pair of white cloths,
and likewise all the services in order, beginning with invocation.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ trividhānnena vādyaiḥ sahasamarpayet /
tāmbūlaṃ ca tataḥ kartā prārthayedvāstupūruṣam //
vāstupuruṣa namaste 'stu bhūśayyānirata prabho //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं त्रिविधान्नेन वाद्यैः सहसमर्पयेत् /
ताम्बूलं च ततः कर्ता प्रार्थयेद्वास्तुपूरुषम् //
वास्तुपुरुष नमस्ते ऽस्तु भूशय्यानिरत प्रभो //
text_mt:
He should present the food offering with three kinds of food along with musical instruments,
and betel; then the patron should pray to the site-man:

"O site-man, obeisance be to you, O Lord engaged in lying upon the earth!

sanskrit_iast: madgṛhe dhanadhānyādisamṛddhaṃ kuru sarvadā //
meaning: मद्गृहे धनधान्यादिसमृद्धं कुरु सर्वदा //
text_mt: "Make [my life] in my house always abundant with wealth, grain, and the like!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti prārthya yathāśaktyā dakṣiṇāmarcakāya ca /
dadyāttadagre viprebhyo bhojanaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ //
meaning:
इति प्रार्थ्य यथाशक्त्या दक्षिणामर्चकाय च /
दद्यात्तदग्रे विप्रेभ्यो भोजनं च स्वशक्तितः //
text_mt: Having prayed thus, one should give a sacrificial fee according to one's means to the worshipper, / and in front of him one should give food to the brāhmaṇas according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā samyagvāstupūjāṃ karoti yaḥ /
ārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ labhennaraḥ //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना सम्यग्वास्तुपूजां करोति यः /
आरोग्यं पुत्रलाभं च धनं धान्यं लभेन्नरः //
text_mt: The man who duly performs the worship of the Vāstu deity according to this rule / obtains health, the birth of sons, wealth, and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā vāstupūjāṃ yaḥ praviśennavamandiram /
rogānnānāvidhānkleśānaśnute sarvasaṃkaṭam //
meaning:
अकृत्वा वास्तुपूजां यः प्रविशेन्नवमन्दिरम् /
रोगान्नानाविधान्क्लेशानश्नुते सर्वसंकटम् //
text_mt: He who enters a new house without having performed the Vāstu worship / suffers from diseases, various kinds of afflictions, and all manner of distress.

sanskrit_iast:
akapāṭamanācchannamadattabalibhojanam /
gṛhaṃ na praviśedevaṃ vipadāmākaraṃ hi tat //
meaning:
अकपाटमनाच्छन्नमदत्तबलिभोजनम् /
गृहं न प्रविशेदेवं विपदामाकरं हि तत् //
text_mt: One must never enter a house that has no doors, is uncovered, / and in which offerings and food have not been given; for it is a mine of calamities.

sanskrit_iast:
atho yātrā nṛpādīnāmabhīṣṭaphalasiddhaye /
syāttathā tāṃ pravakṣyāmi samyagvijñātajanmanām //
meaning:
अथो यात्रा नृपादीनामभीष्टफलसिद्धये /
स्यात्तथा तां प्रवक्ष्यामि सम्यग्विज्ञातजन्मनाम् //
text_mt: Now, for kings and others whose birth[-times] are well known, / I shall explain journeying so that it leads to the attainment of the desired results.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātajanmanāṃ nṝṇāṃ phalāptirghuṇavarṇavat /
praśnodayanimittādyaisteṣāmapi phalodayaḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञातजन्मनां नॄणां फलाप्तिर्घुणवर्णवत् /
प्रश्नोदयनिमित्ताद्यैस्तेषामपि फलोदयः //
text_mt: For men whose birth[-times] are unknown, the attainment of results is like letters bored by a woodworm; / their attainment of results also arises from queries, the rising sign, omens, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyaṣṭamīdvādaśīṣu riktāmāpūrṇimāsu ca /
yātrā śuklapratipadi nirddhanāya kṣayāya ca //
meaning:
षष्ट्यष्टमीद्वादशीषु रिक्तामापूर्णिमासु च /
यात्रा शुक्लप्रतिपदि निर्द्धनाय क्षयाय च //
text_mt: On the sixth, eighth, and twelfth [lunar days], on the empty lunar days, the new moon, and the full moon, / and on the first lunar day of the bright fortnight, a journey leads to poverty and ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
maitrāditīndvārkāntyāśvihāgitiṣyavasūḍuṣu /
asaptapañcatryādyeṣu yātrābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ //
meaning:
मैत्रादितीन्द्वार्कान्त्याश्विहागितिष्यवसूडुषु /
असप्तपञ्चत्र्याद्येषु यात्राभीष्टफलप्रदाः //
text_mt: In the asterisms of Anurādhā, Punarvasu, Mṛgaśīrṣa, Hasta, Revatī, Aśvinī, Puṣya, and Dhaniṣṭhā, / when they are not the seventh, fifth, or third [from one's birth-star] or the first, journeys grant desired results.

sanskrit_iast:
na mandendudine prācīṃ na vrajeddakṣiṇaṃ gurau /
sitārkayerna pratīcīṃ nodīcīṃ jñārayorddine //
meaning:
न मन्देन्दुदिने प्राचीं न व्रजेद्दक्षिणं गुरौ /
सितार्कयेर्न प्रतीचीं नोदीचीं ज्ञारयोर्द्दिने //
text_mt: One should not travel east on the day of Saturn or the Moon, nor south on Jupiter's day; / nor west on the day of Venus or the Sun, nor north on the day of Mercury or Mars.

sanskrit_iast:
indrājapādacaturāsyāryamarkṣāṇi pūrvataḥ /
śūlāni sarvadvārāṇi mitrārkejyāśvabhāni ca //
meaning:
इन्द्राजपादचतुरास्यार्यमर्क्षाणि पूर्वतः /
शूलानि सर्वद्वाराणि मित्रार्केज्याश्वभानि च //
text_mt: The asterisms of Jyeṣṭhā, Pūrvabhādrapadā, Rohiṇī, and Uttarāphālgunī are [directional] spikes in the east; / and all gates are [reckoned with] the asterisms of Anurādhā, Hasta, Puṣya, and Aśvinī.

sanskrit_iast:
kramāddigdvārabhāni syuḥ saptasaptāgnidhiṣṇyataḥ /
parighaṃ laṅghayeddaṇḍaṃ nāgniśvasanardiggamam //
meaning:
क्रमाद्दिग्द्वारभानि स्युः सप्तसप्ताग्निधिष्ण्यतः /
परिघं लङ्घयेद्दण्डं नाग्निश्वसनर्दिग्गमम् //
text_mt: In order, seven asterisms from the asterism of Kṛttikā become the gate-stars of the quarters. / One may cross the bar and the rod, but one must not travel toward the quarters of fire and wind.

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyaṃ pūrvadigdhiṣṇyairvidiśaścaivameva hi /
digrāśayastu kramaśo meṣādyāśca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
आग्नेयं पूर्वदिग्धिष्ण्यैर्विदिशश्चैवमेव हि /
दिग्राशयस्तु क्रमशो मेषाद्याश्च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: The south-east is reckoned by the stars of the eastern direction, and likewise the intermediate directions; / and the directional zodiacal signs are repeatedly Aries and the others in order.

sanskrit_iast:
digīśvare lalāṭasthe yāturna punarāgamaḥ /
lagnastho bhāskaraḥ prācyāṃ diśi yāturlalāṭagaḥ //
meaning:
दिगीश्वरे ललाटस्थे यातुर्न पुनरागमः /
लग्नस्थो भास्करः प्राच्यां दिशि यातुर्ललाटगः //
text_mt: When the lord of a direction stands on the traveler's forehead, he does not return. / The Sun situated in the ascendant stands on the forehead of one travelling in the eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśaikādaśaḥ śukro 'pyāgneyyāntu lalāṭagaḥ /
daśamasthaḥ kujo lagnādyābhyāṃ yāturlalāṭagaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशैकादशः शुक्रो ऽप्याग्नेय्यान्तु ललाटगः /
दशमस्थः कुजो लग्नाद्याभ्यां यातुर्ललाटगः //
text_mt: Venus in the twelfth or eleventh stands on the forehead in the south-east; / Mars situated in the tenth from the ascendant stands on the forehead of a traveler heading south.

sanskrit_iast:
navamāṣṭamago rāhurnaiṛtyāṃ tu lalāṭagaḥ /
lagnātsaptamagaḥ sauriḥ pratīcyāṃ tu lalāṭagaḥ //
meaning:
नवमाष्टमगो राहुर्नैऋत्यां तु ललाटगः /
लग्नात्सप्तमगः सौरिः प्रतीच्यां तु ललाटगः //
text_mt: Rāhu in the ninth or eighth stands on the forehead in the south-west; / Saturn in the seventh from the ascendant stands on the forehead in the west.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭaḥ pañcamagaścandro vāyavyāṃ ca lalāṭagaḥ /
caturthasthānagaḥ saumyaścottarasyāṃ lalāṭagaḥ //
meaning:
षष्टः पञ्चमगश्चन्द्रो वायव्यां च ललाटगः /
चतुर्थस्थानगः सौम्यश्चोत्तरस्यां ललाटगः //
text_mt: The Moon in the sixth or fifth stands on the forehead in the north-west; / and Mercury situated in the fourth house stands on the forehead in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitristhānagato jīva īśānyāṃ vai lalāṭagaḥ /
lalāṭaṃ tu parityajya jīvitecchurvrajennaraḥ //
meaning:
द्वित्रिस्थानगतो जीव ईशान्यां वै ललाटगः /
ललाटं तु परित्यज्य जीवितेच्छुर्व्रजेन्नरः //
text_mt: Jupiter located in the second or third house stands on the forehead in the north-east. / A man wishing to live should depart avoiding [the planet on his] forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
vilomago graho yasya yātrālagropago yadi /
tasya bhaṅgaprado rājñasta dvargo 'pi vilagnagaḥ //
meaning:
विलोमगो ग्रहो यस्य यात्रालग्रोपगो यदि /
तस्य भङ्गप्रदो राज्ञस्त द्वर्गो ऽपि विलग्नगः //
text_mt: If a planet moving retrograde is in the journey's rising sign of anyone, / it brings defeat to that king; and likewise if its division is in the ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
ravīndvayanayoryātamanukūlaṃ śubhapradam /
tadabhāve divārātrau yāyādyāturvadho 'nyathā //
meaning:
रवीन्द्वयनयोर्यातमनुकूलं शुभप्रदम् /
तदभावे दिवारात्रौ यायाद्यातुर्वधो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: A departure favorable to the solstices of the Sun and the Moon brings good fortune; / in their absence, one should travel by day or night [respectively], otherwise the traveler suffers destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
mūḍhe śukre kāryahāniḥ pratiśukre parājayaḥ /
pratiśukrakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ hṝntuṃ śaktā grahā na hi //
meaning:
मूढे शुक्रे कार्यहानिः प्रतिशुक्रे पराजयः /
प्रतिशुक्रकृतं दोषं हॄन्तुं शक्ता ग्रहा न हि //
text_mt: When Venus is combust, there is loss of the undertaking; when Venus is directly opposite, there is defeat; / the planets are not capable of removing the flaw caused by an opposing Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsiṣṭakāśyapeyātribhāradvājāḥ sagautamāḥ /
eteṣāṃ pañcagotrāṇāṃ pratiśukro na vidyate //
meaning:
वासिष्टकाश्यपेयात्रिभारद्वाजाः सगौतमाः /
एतेषां पञ्चगोत्राणां प्रतिशुक्रो न विद्यते //
text_mt: For the descendants of Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, Atri, and Bharadvāja, along with those of Gautama— / for these five clans an opposing Venus does not exist.

sanskrit_iast:
ekagrāme vivāhe ca durbhikṣe rājavigrahe /
dvijakṣobhe nṛpakṣobhe pratiśukro na vidyate //
meaning:
एकग्रामे विवाहे च दुर्भिक्षे राजविग्रहे /
द्विजक्षोभे नृपक्षोभे प्रतिशुक्रो न विद्यते //
text_mt: In the same village, in marriage, during famine, during a war between kings, / during distress caused by brāhmaṇas, or distress caused by kings, an opposing Venus does not exist.

sanskrit_iast:
nīcago 'rigṛhastho vā vakrago vā parājitaḥ /
yāturbhaṅgapradaḥ śukraḥ svoñcasthaścejjayapradaḥ //
meaning:
नीचगो ऽरिगृहस्थो वा वक्रगो वा पराजितः /
यातुर्भङ्गप्रदः शुक्रः स्वोञ्चस्थश्चेज्जयप्रदः //
text_mt: When Venus is debilitated, in an enemy's house, retrograde, or defeated in planetary war, / it brings defeat to the traveler; but if situated in its exaltation, it brings victory.

sanskrit_iast:
svāṣṭalagneṣṭarāśau vā śatrubhāttvaṣṭamepi vā /
teṣāmīśastharāśau vā yāturmṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाष्टलग्नेष्टराशौ वा शत्रुभात्त्वष्टमेपि वा /
तेषामीशस्थराशौ वा यातुर्मृत्युर्न संशयः //
text_mt: If [the journey's ascendant] is in one's eighth sign from the ascendant, or the eighth sign from the enemy's star, / or in the sign occupied by their lords, the traveler's death is beyond doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
janmeṣāṣṭamalagneśau mitho mitre vyavasthitau /
janmarāśyaṣṭamarkṣotthadoṣā naśyantiṃ bhāktaḥ //
meaning:
जन्मेषाष्टमलग्नेशौ मिथो मित्रे व्यवस्थितौ /
जन्मराश्यष्टमर्क्षोत्थदोषा नश्यन्तिं भाक्तः //
text_mt: If the lord of the birth sign and the lord of the eighth or the ascendant are situated as mutual friends, / the flaws arising from the eighth star from the birth sign are eliminated in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
krūragrahekṣito yukto dviḥsvabhāvo 'pi bhaṅgadaḥ /
yāne sthirodaye neṣṭo bhavyayuktekṣitaḥ svayam //
meaning:
क्रूरग्रहेक्षितो युक्तो द्विःस्वभावो ऽपि भङ्गदः /
याने स्थिरोदये नेष्टो भव्ययुक्तेक्षितः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Even a dual sign aspected by or conjoined with a malefic planet brings failure; / on a journey, a fixed sign rising is not desired, even if it is conjoined with or aspected by a benefic.

sanskrit_iast:
vasvantyārddhādipañcarkṣe saṃgrahaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭayoḥ /
yāmyadiggamanaṃ śayyā na kuryādgehagopanam //
meaning:
वस्वन्त्यार्द्धादिपञ्चर्क्षे संग्रहं तृणकाष्टयोः /
याम्यदिग्गमनं शय्या न कुर्याद्गेहगोपनम् //
text_mt: In the five asterisms beginning with the second half of Dhaniṣṭhā, / one should not make a gathering of grass and wood, travel to the south, make a bed, or thatch a house.

sanskrit_iast:
janmodaye janmabhe vā tayorīśasyabhepi vā /
tābhyāṃ tayorikendreṣu yātuḥ śatrukṣayo bhavet //
meaning:
जन्मोदये जन्मभे वा तयोरीशस्यभेपि वा /
ताभ्यां तयोरिकेन्द्रेषु यातुः शत्रुक्षयो भवेत् //
text_mt: When the birth-ascendant, the birth-star, or the star of their lords rises, / or when in the angles from those two [benefics are placed], the traveler accomplishes the destruction of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
śīrṣodaye lagnagate diglagne lagnagopi vā /
śubhavārgotha vā lagne yātuḥ śatrukṣayastadā //
meaning:
शीर्षोदये लग्नगते दिग्लग्ने लग्नगोपि वा /
शुभवार्गोथ वा लग्ने यातुः शत्रुक्षयस्तदा //
text_mt: When a sign that rises head-first is in the ascendant, or a directional sign is in the ascendant, / or a benefic division is in the ascendant, then destruction of the enemy belongs to the traveler.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrujanmodaye janmarāśervā nidhanodaye /
tayorīśasthite rāśau yātuḥ śatrukṣayo bhavet //
meaning:
शत्रुजन्मोदये जन्मराशेर्वा निधनोदये /
तयोरीशस्थिते राशौ यातुः शत्रुक्षयो भवेत् //
text_mt: When the enemy's birth-ascendant or the eighth sign from his birth-sign rises, / or in the sign occupied by their lords, destruction of the enemy belongs to the traveler.

sanskrit_iast:
vakraḥ panthā mīnalagne yāturmīnāṃśakepi vā /
nindyo nikhilayātrāsu ghaṭalagno ghaṭāṃśakaḥ //
meaning:
वक्रः पन्था मीनलग्ने यातुर्मीनांशकेपि वा /
निन्द्यो निखिलयात्रासु घटलग्नो घटांशकः //
text_mt: The path is crooked when Pisces is the rising sign or in a navāṃśa of Pisces for the traveler; / Aquarius as the rising sign or a navāṃśa of Aquarius is condemned in all journeys.

sanskrit_iast:
jalalagno jalāṃśo vā jalayoneḥ śubhāvahaḥ /
mūrtiḥ kośo dhanvinaśca vāhanaṃ mantrasaṃjñakam //
meaning:
जललग्नो जलांशो वा जलयोनेः शुभावहः /
मूर्तिः कोशो धन्विनश्च वाहनं मन्त्रसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt: A water-sign or water-division brings good fortune to one born of water. / The body, treasury, archers, conveyance, that named counsel,

sanskrit_iast:
śatrumārgastathāyuśca manovyāpārasaṃjñikam /
prāptiraprāptirudayādbhāvāḥ syurdvādaśaiva te //
meaning:
शत्रुमार्गस्तथायुश्च मनोव्यापारसंज्ञिकम् /
प्राप्तिरप्राप्तिरुदयाद्भावाः स्युर्द्वादशैव ते //
text_mt: the enemy's path, longevity, that named mental activity, / gain, and non-gain—these are the twelve houses from the ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
ghnanti krūrāstryāptivargaṃ bhāvānsūryamahīsutau /
na nighnato hi vyāpāraṃ saumyāḥḍha puṣṇantyariṃ vinā //
meaning:
घ्नन्ति क्रूरास्त्र्याप्तिवर्गं भावान्सूर्यमहीसुतौ /
न निघ्नतो हि व्यापारं सौम्याःढ पुष्णन्त्यरिं विना //
text_mt: The malefics destroy the third and eleventh houses; the Sun and Mars / do not destroy action; benefics nurture [all houses] except the enemy house.

sanskrit_iast:
śukro 'staṃ ca na puṣṇāti mūrtiṃ mṛtyuṃ ca candramāḥ /
yāmyadiggamanaṃ tyaktvā sarvakāṣṭhāsu yāyinām //
meaning:
शुक्रो ऽस्तं च न पुष्णाति मूर्तिं मृत्युं च चन्द्रमाः /
याम्यदिग्गमनं त्यक्त्वा सर्वकाष्ठासु यायिनाम् //
text_mt: Venus does not nurture the seventh house, nor the Moon the first and eighth houses. / For those travelling in all quarters, excluding travel in the southern direction,

sanskrit_iast:
abhijitkṣaṇayogo 'yamabhīṣṭaphalasiddhidaḥ /
pañcāṅgaśuddhirahite divase 'pi phalapradaḥ //
meaning:
अभिजित्क्षणयोगो ऽयमभीष्टफलसिद्धिदः /
पञ्चाङ्गशुद्धिरहिते दिवसे ऽपि फलप्रदः //
text_mt: this planetary combination at the moment of Abhijit grants the attainment of desired results; / it bestows results even on a day devoid of purity of the five astrological limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāyogā vicitrāstānyogānvakṣye yatastataḥ /
phalasiddhiryāgalagnādrājñāṃ vipraśya dhiṣṇyataḥ //
meaning:
यात्रायोगा विचित्रास्तान्योगान्वक्ष्ये यतस्ततः /
फलसिद्धिर्यागलग्नाद्राज्ञां विप्रश्य धिष्ण्यतः //
text_mt: Diverse are the combinations for travel; I shall describe those combinations from which / attainment of results occurs: for kings from the ascendant of sacrifice, for a brāhmaṇa from the star,

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtaśaktito 'nyeṣāṃ śakunaistaskarasya ca /
kendratrikoṇe hyekena yogaḥ śukrajñasūriṇām //
meaning:
मुहूर्तशक्तितो ऽन्येषां शकुनैस्तस्करस्य च /
केन्द्रत्रिकोणे ह्येकेन योगः शुक्रज्ञसूरिणाम् //
text_mt: for others from the power of the muhūrta, and for a thief from omens. / When one of Venus, Mercury, and Jupiter is in an angle or trine, a yoga is formed;

sanskrit_iast:
adhiyego bhaveddvābhyāṃ tribhiryogādhiyogakaḥ /
yoge 'pi yāyināṃ kṣemamadhiyoge jayo bhavet //
meaning:
अधियेगो भवेद्द्वाभ्यां त्रिभिर्योगाधियोगकः /
योगे ऽपि यायिनां क्षेममधियोगे जयो भवेत् //
text_mt: with two of them it becomes an adhiyoga; with three it becomes a yogādhiyoga. / Even in a yoga there is security for travelers; in an adhiyoga there is victory;

sanskrit_iast:
yogādhiyoge kṣemaṃ ca vijayārthavibhūtayaḥ /
vyāpāraśatrumūrtisthaiścandramandadivākaraiḥ //
meaning:
योगाधियोगे क्षेमं च विजयार्थविभूतयः /
व्यापारशत्रुमूर्तिस्थैश्चन्द्रमन्ददिवाकरैः //
text_mt: and in a yogādhiyoga there is security, victory, wealth, and power. / When the Moon, Saturn, and the Sun are situated respectively in the tenth, sixth, and first houses,

sanskrit_iast:
raṇe gatasya bhūpasya jayalakṣmīḥ pramāṇikā /
śukrārkajñārkibhaumeṣu lagnādhvastatriśatruṣu //
meaning:
रणे गतस्य भूपस्य जयलक्ष्मीः प्रमाणिका /
शुक्रार्कज्ञार्किभौमेषु लग्नाध्वस्तत्रिशत्रुषु //
text_mt: the fortune of victory is certain for a king who has gone to battle. / When Venus, the Sun, Mercury, Saturn, and Mars are situated in the ascendant, seventh, third, and sixth houses,

sanskrit_iast:
gatasyāgre vairicamṛrvahnau lākṣve līyate /
lagnasthe tridaśācārye dhanāyasthaiḥ paragrahaiḥ //
meaning:
गतस्याग्रे वैरिचमृर्वह्नौ लाक्ष्वे लीयते /
लग्नस्थे त्रिदशाचार्ये धनायस्थैः परग्रहैः //
text_mt: the army of the enemy melts away like lac in fire before him who has marched forth. / When the preceptor of the thirty gods is in the ascendant, and the other planets are in the second and eleventh,

sanskrit_iast:
gatasya rājño 'risenā nīyate yamamandiram /
lagne śukre ravau lābhe candre bandhusthite yadā //
meaning:
गतस्य राज्ञो ऽरिसेना नीयते यममन्दिरम् /
लग्ने शुक्रे रवौ लाभे चन्द्रे बन्धुस्थिते यदा //
text_mt: the enemy's army of the departed king is led to the abode of Yama. / When Venus is in the ascendant, the Sun in the eleventh, and the Moon is situated in the fourth house,

sanskrit_iast:
gato nṛpo ripūnhṝnti kesarīvebhasaṃhatim /
svoccasaṃsthe site lagne svocce candre ca lābhage //
meaning:
गतो नृपो रिपून्हॄन्ति केसरीवेभसंहतिम् /
स्वोच्चसंस्थे सिते लग्ने स्वोच्चे चन्द्रे च लाभगे //
text_mt: The king who has marched slays his foes like a lion destroys a herd of elephants, / when Venus is in its exaltation in the ascendant, and the Moon is in its exaltation and situated in the eleventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
hṝnti yāto 'riṣṭatanāṃ keśavaḥpūtanāmiva /
trikoṇe kendragāḥ saumyāḥ krūrāstryāyārigā yadi //
meaning:
हॄन्ति यातो ऽरिष्टतनां केशवःपूतनामिव /
त्रिकोणे केन्द्रगाः सौम्याः क्रूरास्त्र्यायारिगा यदि //
text_mt: Departing, he slays the enemy's army just as Keśava slew Pūtanā, / if the benefic planets are in trines and angles, and the malefic planets are in the third, eleventh, and sixth houses.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yāteralakṣmīstamupaitīvābhisārikā /
jīvārkacandrā lagnārirandhragā yadi gacchataḥ //
meaning:
यस्य यातेरलक्ष्मीस्तमुपैतीवाभिसारिका /
जीवार्कचन्द्रा लग्नारिरन्ध्रगा यदि गच्छतः //
text_mt: Misfortune approaches the traveler like a courting mistress, / if Jupiter, the Sun, and the Moon occupy the ascendant, sixth, and eighth houses for one who is marching.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāgre khalamaitrīva na sthirā ripuvāhinī /
trikhaḍāyeṣu mandārau balavantaḥ śubhā yadi //
meaning:
तस्याग्रे खलमैत्रीव न स्थिरा रिपुवाहिनी /
त्रिखडायेषु मन्दारौ बलवन्तः शुभा यदि //
text_mt: Before him, the enemy army is unstable like the friendship of a rogue, / if Saturn and Mars are in the third, sixth, and eleventh houses, and the benefics are strong.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāyāṃ nṛpatastasya hastasthā śatrumedinī /
svoñcasthe lagnage jīve candre lābhagate yadi //
meaning:
यात्रायां नृपतस्तस्य हस्तस्था शत्रुमेदिनी /
स्वोञ्चस्थे लग्नगे जीवे चन्द्रे लाभगते यदि //
text_mt: Upon the expedition of that king, the enemy’s territory falls into his hand, / if Jupiter is in the ascendant in its exaltation, and the Moon is in the eleventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
gato rājā ripūnhati pinākī tripuraṃ yathā /
mastakodayageśukra lagnasthe lābhage gurau //
meaning:
गतो राजा रिपून्हति पिनाकी त्रिपुरं यथा /
मस्तकोदयगेशुक्र लग्नस्थे लाभगे गुरौ //
text_mt: The king who has marched slays his enemies just as Pinākin destroyed Tripura, / when Venus rises head-first in the ascendant, and Jupiter is in the eleventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
gato rājā ripūnhṝnti kumārastārakaṃ yathā /
jīvaṃ lagnagate śukre kendre vāpi trikoṇage //
meaning:
गतो राजा रिपून्हॄन्ति कुमारस्तारकं यथा /
जीवं लग्नगते शुक्रे केन्द्रे वापि त्रिकोणगे //
text_mt: The king who has marched slays his enemies just as Kumāra slew Tāraka, / when Jupiter is in the ascendant and Venus is in an angle or in a trine.

sanskrit_iast:
gato dahatyarīvrājā kṛṣṇavartmā yathā vanam /
lagnage jñe śubhe kendre dhiṣṇye copakule gataḥ //
meaning:
गतो दहत्यरीव्राजा कृष्णवर्त्मा यथा वनम् /
लग्नगे ज्ञे शुभे केन्द्रे धिष्ण्ये चोपकुले गतः //
text_mt: The king who has marched burns his enemies like fire burns a forest, / when Mercury is in the ascendant and a benefic is in an angle, and the departure takes place under a favorable asterism and allied constellation.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpāḥ śuṣyantyarīn grīṣme hradinīṃ vārkaraśmayaḥ /
śubhi trikoṇe kendrasthe lābhe candre 'thavā ravī //
meaning:
नृपाः शुष्यन्त्यरीन् ग्रीष्मे ह्रदिनीं वार्करश्मयः /
शुभि त्रिकोणे केन्द्रस्थे लाभे चन्द्रे ऽथवा रवी //
text_mt: Kings dry up their enemies like the rays of the sun dry up a pond in summer, / when a benefic is in a trine or angle, and the Moon or the Sun is in the eleventh house.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūnhanti gato rājā hyandhakāraṃ yathā raviḥ /
svakṣetrage śubhe kadre trikoṇoyagate gataḥ //
meaning:
शत्रून्हन्ति गतो राजा ह्यन्धकारं यथा रविः /
स्वक्षेत्रगे शुभे कद्रे त्रिकोणोयगते गतः //
text_mt: The king who has marched slays his enemies just as the sun dispels darkness, / when a benefic is in its own house and in an angle, and the departure takes place with a planet in a trine.

sanskrit_iast:
vināśayatyarītrājā tṛlarāśimivānalaḥ /
indau svasthe gurau kendre mantraḥ sapraṇavo gataḥ //
meaning:
विनाशयत्यरीत्राजा तृलराशिमिवानलः /
इन्दौ स्वस्थे गुरौ केन्द्रे मन्त्रः सप्रणवो गतः //
text_mt: The king destroys his enemies like fire destroys a heap of grass; / the departure is like a mantra with the praṇava, when the Moon is in its own house and Jupiter is in an angle.

sanskrit_iast:
nṝpo hṝnti ripūnsarvānpāpānpañcākṣaro yathā /
vargottamagate śukre 'pyevasminneva lagnage //
meaning:
नॄपो हॄन्ति रिपून्सर्वान्पापान्पञ्चाक्षरो यथा /
वर्गोत्तमगते शुक्रे ऽप्येवस्मिन्नेव लग्नगे //
text_mt: The king slays all his enemies just as the five-syllable mantra destroys sins, / when Venus is in the vargottama division and in that very ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
harismṛtiryathāghaughānhṝnti śatrūn gato nṛpaḥ /
śubhe kendre trikoṇasthe candre vargottame gataḥ //
meaning:
हरिस्मृतिर्यथाघौघान्हॄन्ति शत्रून् गतो नृपः /
शुभे केन्द्रे त्रिकोणस्थे चन्द्रे वर्गोत्तमे गतः //
text_mt: Just as the remembrance of Hari destroys floods of sins, the king who has marched slays his enemies, / when a benefic is in an angle or a trine, and the departure occurs with the Moon in vargottama.

sanskrit_iast:
sagotrārīnnṛpān hṝnti yathā gotrāṃścagotrabhit /
mitrabhe 'tha gurau kendre trikoṇasthe 'tha vā site //
meaning:
सगोत्रारीन्नृपान् हॄन्ति यथा गोत्रांश्चगोत्रभित् /
मित्रभे ऽथ गुरौ केन्द्रे त्रिकोणस्थे ऽथ वा सिते //
text_mt: He slays enemy kings of the same lineage just as the breaker of mountains [Indra] struck down the mountains, / when Jupiter is in a friendly sign and in an angle, or when Venus is in a trine.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūnhṝnti gato rājā bhujaṅgān garuḍo yathā /
śubhakadratrikoṇasthe vargottamagate gataḥ //
meaning:
शत्रून्हॄन्ति गतो राजा भुजङ्गान् गरुडो यथा /
शुभकद्रत्रिकोणस्थे वर्गोत्तमगते गतः //
text_mt: The king who has marched slays his enemies just as Garuḍa slays serpents, / when the departure occurs with a benefic in an angle or a trine and in vargottama.

sanskrit_iast:
vināśayatyarīnrājā pāpānbhāgīrathī yathā /
ye nṛpā yāntyarīñjetuṃ teṣāṃ yogairnṛpāhvayaiḥ //
meaning:
विनाशयत्यरीन्राजा पापान्भागीरथी यथा /
ये नृपा यान्त्यरीञ्जेतुं तेषां योगैर्नृपाह्वयैः //
text_mt: The king destroys his enemies just as the Bhāgīrathī washes away sins. / For kings who march to conquer enemies under these astrological combinations named after kings,

sanskrit_iast:
upaiti śāntiṃ kopāgniḥ śatruyoṣāśrubindubhiḥ /
balakṣayapakṣadaśamīmāsīṣe vijayābhidhā //
meaning:
उपैति शान्तिं कोपाग्निः शत्रुयोषाश्रुबिन्दुभिः /
बलक्षयपक्षदशमीमासीषे विजयाभिधा //
text_mt: the fire of anger is quenched by the teardrops of the enemy’s women. / On the tenth tithi of the waning fortnight in the month of Āśvina, which is named Vijayā,

sanskrit_iast:
vijayastatra yātṝṇāṃ sadhirvā na parājayaḥ /
nimittaśakunādibhyaḥ pradhānaṃ hi manodayaḥ //
meaning:
विजयस्तत्र यातॄणां सधिर्वा न पराजयः /
निमित्तशकुनादिभ्यः प्रधानं हि मनोदयः //
text_mt: victory belongs to those who march, or an honorable peace, but not defeat. / Indeed, superior to omens, birds, and portents is the rising of inner resolve;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmanasvināṃ yatnātphalaheturmanodayaḥ /
utsavopanayodvāhapratiṣṭāśaucasūtake //
meaning:
तस्मान्मनस्विनां यत्नात्फलहेतुर्मनोदयः /
उत्सवोपनयोद्वाहप्रतिष्टाशौचसूतके //
text_mt: therefore, for resolute men, the rising of resolve is deliberately the cause of success. / During a festival, an upanayana, a wedding, a consecration, or ritual impurity from death or birth,

sanskrit_iast:
asamāpte na kurvīta yātrāṃ martyo jijīviṣuḥ /
mahiṣondurayoryuddhe kalatrakalahārttave //
meaning:
असमाप्ते न कुर्वीत यात्रां मर्त्यो जिजीविषुः /
महिषोन्दुरयोर्युद्धे कलत्रकलहार्त्तवे //
text_mt: a mortal desiring to live should not set out on an expedition before these are completed; / nor during a fight between a buffalo and a rat, a marital quarrel, or [the wife's] menses;

sanskrit_iast:
vastrādeḥ skhalite krodhe durukte na vrajennṛpaḥ /
ghṛtānnaṃ tilapiṣṭānnaṃ matsyānnaṃ ghṛtapāyasam //
meaning:
वस्त्रादेः स्खलिते क्रोधे दुरुक्ते न व्रजेन्नृपः /
घृतान्नं तिलपिष्टान्नं मत्स्यान्नं घृतपायसम् //
text_mt: nor upon the slipping of a garment, during anger, or at harsh words should a king march. / Having eaten food cooked with ghee, food with sesame paste, fish with rice, or sweet rice-pudding with ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgādikramaśo bhuktvā yāti rājā jayatyarīn /
sajjikā paramānnaṃ ca kāñjika ca payo dadhi //
meaning:
प्रागादिक्रमशो भुक्त्वा याति राजा जयत्यरीन् /
सज्जिका परमान्नं च काञ्जिक च पयो दधि //
text_mt: in order starting from the east, the king marches and conquers his foes. / Having eaten barley gruel, divine rice-pudding, sour gruel, milk, curd,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraṃ tilodanaṃ bhuktvā bhānuvārādiṣu kramāt /
kulmāṣāṃśca tilānnaṃ ca dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरं तिलोदनं भुक्त्वा भानुवारादिषु क्रमात् /
कुल्माषांश्च तिलान्नं च दधि क्षौद्रं घृतं पयः //
text_mt: condensed milk, and sesame-rice in sequence on Sunday and the other days of the week; / and sour gruel, sesame-rice, curd, honey, ghee, milk,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgamāṃsaṃ ca tatsāraṃ pāyasaṃ ca khagaṃ mṛgam /
śaśamāṃsaṃ ca ṣāṣṭikyaṃ priyaguṅkamapūpakam //
meaning:
मृगमांसं च तत्सारं पायसं च खगं मृगम् /
शशमांसं च षाष्टिक्यं प्रियगुङ्कमपूपकम् //
text_mt: venison and its broth, sweet rice-pudding, fowl, deer meat, / hare meat, ṣaṣṭika-rice, priyaṅgu-grain, cakes,

sanskrit_iast:
citrāṇḍajapalaṃ kūrmaśvāvidgodhāṃśca śāsvakam /
haviṣyaṃ kṛśarānnaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ yavapiṣṭikam //
meaning:
चित्राण्डजपलं कूर्मश्वाविद्गोधांश्च शास्वकम् /
हविष्यं कृशरान्नं च मुद्गान्नं यवपिष्टिकम् //
text_mt: meat of various birds, turtle, porcupine, monitor lizard, hare, / oblation-food, kṛśarā, mung-bean rice, barley flour,

sanskrit_iast:
matsyānnaṃ ca vicitrānnaṃ dadhyannaṃ dasrabhātkramāt /
bhuktvā rājebhāśvarathanarairyāti jayatyarīn //
meaning:
मत्स्यान्नं च विचित्रान्नं दध्यन्नं दस्रभात्क्रमात् /
भुक्त्वा राजेभाश्वरथनरैर्याति जयत्यरीन् //
text_mt: fish with rice, mixed rice, and curd-rice in order from the asterism Aśvinī— / having eaten these, the king marches with elephants, horses, chariots, and infantry and conquers his foes.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśanaṃ tilairhutvā pūjayeta digīśvaram /
praṇamya devabhūdevānāśīrvādairnṛpo vrajet //
meaning:
हुताशनं तिलैर्हुत्वा पूजयेत दिगीश्वरम् /
प्रणम्य देवभूदेवानाशीर्वादैर्नृपो व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Having offered sesame into the fire, he should worship the guardian of the directions; / having bowed to the gods and the Brahmins, the king should depart with blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvarṇavasragandhādyaistanmantreṇa vidhānataḥ /
indramairāvatārūḍhaṃ śacyā saha virājitam //
meaning:
यद्वर्णवस्रगन्धाद्यैस्तन्मन्त्रेण विधानतः /
इन्द्रमैरावतारूढं शच्या सह विराजितम् //
text_mt: Using clothes, perfumes, and other items of the appropriate color, and with the respective mantra according to the ritual rule: / Indra mounted on Airāvata, resplendent alongside Śacī,

sanskrit_iast:
vajrapāṇiṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam /
saptahastaṃ saptajihvaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ meṣavāhanam //
meaning:
वज्रपाणिं स्वर्णवर्णं दिव्याभरणभूषितम् /
सप्तहस्तं सप्तजिह्वं षण्मुखं मेषवाहनम् //
text_mt: holding the thunderbolt, golden-hued, adorned with divine ornaments; / [Agni] seven-handed, seven-tongued, six-faced, riding a ram,

sanskrit_iast:
svāhāpriye raktavarṇaṃ srukūsruvāyudhadhāriṇam /
daṇḍāyudhaṃ lohitārkṣaṃ yamaṃ mahiṣavāhanam //
meaning:
स्वाहाप्रिये रक्तवर्णं स्रुकूस्रुवायुधधारिणम् /
दण्डायुधं लोहितार्क्षं यमं महिषवाहनम् //
text_mt: the beloved of Svāhā, red-hued, bearing the sruc and sruva as weapons; / Yama holding the staff weapon, red-eyed, riding a buffalo,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmalaṃ sahitaṃ raktavarṇairūrddhvamukhaṃ śubham /
khaḍgacarmadharaṃ nīlaṃ nirṛtiṃ nakhāhanam //
meaning:
श्यामलं सहितं रक्तवर्णैरूर्द्ध्वमुखं शुभम् /
खड्गचर्मधरं नीलं निरृतिं नखाहनम् //
text_mt: dark-complexioned, accompanied by red hues, facing upwards, auspicious; / Nirṛti bearing a sword and shield, dark blue, riding an animal,

sanskrit_iast:
urddhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ dīrghagrīvāyutaṃ vibhum /
nāgapāśadharaṃ pītavarṇaṃ makaravāhanam //
meaning:
उर्द्ध्वकेशं विरूपाक्षं दीर्घग्रीवायुतं विभुम् /
नागपाशधरं पीतवर्णं मकरवाहनम् //
text_mt: with hair standing upright, deformed eyes, endowed with a long neck, the all-pervading lord; / Varuṇa holding a serpent noose, yellow-colored, riding a makara,

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaṃ kālikānāthaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam /
prāṇināṃ prāṇarūpaṃ taṃ dvibāhuṃ daṇḍapāṇikam //
meaning:
वरुणं कालिकानाथं रत्नाभरणभूषितम् /
प्राणिनां प्राणरूपं तं द्विबाहुं दण्डपाणिकम् //
text_mt: the lord of Kālikā, adorned with gemstone ornaments; / Vāyu, the life-breath of living beings, two-armed, with staff in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuṃ kṛṣṇamṛgārūḍhaṃ pūjayedañjanīpatim /
aśvārūḍhaṃ kuṃbhapāṇiṃ dvibāhuṃ svarṇasannibham //
meaning:
वायुं कृष्णमृगारूढं पूजयेदञ्जनीपतिम् /
अश्वारूढं कुंभपाणिं द्विबाहुं स्वर्णसन्निभम् //
text_mt: riding a black deer, the lord of Añjanī, him he should worship; / Kubera riding a horse, holding a jar, two-armed, resembling gold,

sanskrit_iast:
kuberaṃ citralekheśaṃ yakṣagandharvanāyakam /
pinākinaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ gaurīpatimanuttam //
meaning:
कुबेरं चित्रलेखेशं यक्षगन्धर्वनायकम् /
पिनाकिनं वृषारूढं गौरीपतिमनुत्तम् //
text_mt: the lord of Citralekhā, leader of the Yakṣas and Gandharvas; / Pinākin riding a bull, the matchless lord of Gaurī,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetavarṇaṃ candramauliṃ nāgayajñopavītinam /
aprayāṇe svayaṃ kāryā prekṣayā bhūbhujastathā //
meaning:
श्वेतवर्णं चन्द्रमौलिं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् /
अप्रयाणे स्वयं कार्या प्रेक्षया भूभुजस्तथा //
text_mt: white-hued, with the moon on his crest, wearing a snake as his sacred thread. / If the king cannot march in person, it should be done by proxy through inspection;

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ nigamanaṃ chatraṃ dhvajaśastrāstravāhanaiḥ /
svasthānānnirgamasthānaṃ daḍānāṃ ca śatandvayam //
meaning:
कार्यं निगमनं छत्रं ध्वजशस्त्रास्त्रवाहनैः /
स्वस्थानान्निर्गमस्थानं दडानां च शतन्द्वयम् //
text_mt: the dispatch should be carried out using the umbrella, standard, weapons, missiles, and mounts. / The place of departure from one's own dwelling should be two hundred daṇḍas,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśaddvādaśaiva prasthitaḥ sa svayaṃ gataḥ /
dinānyekatra na vasetsaptaṣṭ vā paro janaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारिंशद्द्वादशैव प्रस्थितः स स्वयं गतः /
दिनान्येकत्र न वसेत्सप्तष्ट् वा परो जनः //
text_mt: or forty, or even twelve [daṇḍas]; then he who has set out is deemed to have gone in person. / Another person should not dwell in one single place for seven or eight days;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarātraṃ ca purataḥ punarlagnāntare vrajet /
akālajeṣu nṛpatirvidyudgarjitavṛṣṭiṣu //
meaning:
पञ्चरात्रं च पुरतः पुनर्लग्नान्तरे व्रजेत् /
अकालजेषु नृपतिर्विद्युद्गर्जितवृष्टिषु //
text_mt: furthermore, after five nights ahead, he may march again in another auspicious lagna. / In the event of unseasonal lightning, thunder, and rain,

sanskrit_iast:
utpāteṣu trividheṣu saptarātraṃ tu na vrajet /
sntākuḍyaśivākākakapotānāṃ girastathā //
meaning:
उत्पातेषु त्रिविधेषु सप्तरात्रं तु न व्रजेत् /
स्न्ताकुड्यशिवाकाककपोतानां गिरस्तथा //
text_mt: or the three kinds of portents, he should not march for seven nights. / The cries of the snake-catching bird, a lizard, a jackal, a crow, and a pigeon,

sanskrit_iast:
jhajhebhukhemavakṣīrasvarāṇāṃ vāmato gatiḥ /
pītakārabharadvājapabhiṇāṃ dakṣiṇā gatiḥ //
meaning:
झझेभुखेमवक्षीरस्वराणां वामतो गतिः /
पीतकारभरद्वाजपभिणां दक्षिणा गतिः //
text_mt: as well as the calls of the cricket, owl, mongoose, and dog are auspicious when passing to the left; / the movement of the woodpecker and the skylark is auspicious on the right.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṣaṃ tyaktvā catuṣpāttu śubhadāvāmato matāḥ /
kṛṣṇaṃ tyaktvā prayāṇe tu kṛkalāsena vīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
चाषं त्यक्त्वा चतुष्पात्तु शुभदावामतो मताः /
कृष्णं त्यक्त्वा प्रयाणे तु कृकलासेन वीक्षितः //
text_mt: Except for the blue jay, four-footed animals are considered auspicious on the left. / At departure, being seen by a chameleon, except for a black one,

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhaśaśagodhāstu sarpāṇāṃ kīrtanaṃ śubham /
hṛtekṣaṇaṃ neṣṭamevāvyapatyayaṃ kapiṛkṣayoḥ //
meaning:
वाराहशशगोधास्तु सर्पाणां कीर्तनं शुभम् /
हृतेक्षणं नेष्टमेवाव्यपत्ययं कपिऋक्षयोः //
text_mt: or the mere mention of a boar, hare, monitor lizard, and snakes is auspicious; / having one's sight obstructed is not desirable, nor is the sudden crossing of a monkey or a bear.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūracchāganakulacāṣapārāvatāḥ śubhāḥ /
dṛṣṭamātreṇa yātrāyāṃ vyastaṃ sarvaṃ praveśane //
meaning:
मयूरच्छागनकुलचाषपारावताः शुभाः /
दृष्टमात्रेण यात्रायां व्यस्तं सर्वं प्रवेशने //
text_mt: Peacocks, goats, mongooses, blue jays, and pigeons are auspicious / at the mere sight during departure; the opposite is true upon entry.

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāsiddhirbhaveddṛṣṭe śaverādanavajite /
praveśe rodanayutaḥ śavaḥ śavapradastathā //
meaning:
यात्रासिद्धिर्भवेद्दृष्टे शवेरादनवजिते /
प्रवेशे रोदनयुतः शवः शवप्रदस्तथा //
text_mt: Success in an expedition occurs upon seeing a corpse devoid of weeping; / upon entry, a corpse accompanied by weeping causes death.

sanskrit_iast:
patitaklībajaṭilamattavāntauṣadhādibhiḥ /
abhyaktavasāsthicarmāṅgāradāruṇarogibhiḥ //
meaning:
पतितक्लीबजटिलमत्तवान्तौषधादिभिः /
अभ्यक्तवसास्थिचर्माङ्गारदारुणरोगिभिः //
text_mt: A fallen man, an impotent man, one with matted hair, an intoxicated person, vomited medicine and the like, / persons anointed with fat, bones, hides, burning coals, or severe diseases,

sanskrit_iast:
guḍakārpāsalavaṇaripupraśnatṛṇoragaiḥ /
vandhyākuñjakakāṣāyamuktakeśabubhukṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
गुडकार्पासलवणरिपुप्रश्नतृणोरगैः /
वन्ध्याकुञ्जककाषायमुक्तकेशबुभुक्षितैः //
text_mt: jaggery, cotton, salt, an enemy, one asking questions, grass, serpents, / a barren woman, an eunuch, one wearing saffron robes, disheveled hair, starving persons,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāṇasamaye nagnairddṛṣṭaiḥ siddhirna jāyate /
prajvalāgnīnsuturaganṛpāsanapurāṅganāḥ //
meaning:
प्रयाणसमये नग्नैर्द्दृष्टैः सिद्धिर्न जायते /
प्रज्वलाग्नीन्सुतुरगनृपासनपुराङ्गनाः //
text_mt: and naked persons seen at the time of departure bring no success. / Blazing fires, fine horses, the royal throne, city women,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣaapākṣatacchatracāmarāndolikaṃ nṛpaḥ /
bhakṣyekṣuphalamṛtsnānnamadhvājyadadhigodayāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धपुषअपाक्षतच्छत्रचामरान्दोलिकं नृपः /
भक्ष्येक्षुफलमृत्स्नान्नमध्वाज्यदधिगोदयाः //
text_mt: Fragrance, flowers, unhusked rice, an umbrella, a cāmara, a litter, a king, / sweetmeats, sugarcane, fruit, fine clay, food, honey, ghee, curd, the rising of cattle,

sanskrit_iast:
madyamāṃsasudhādhautavastraśaṅkhavṛṣadhvajāḥ /
puṇyastrīpuṇyakalaśaratnabhṛṅgāragodvijāḥ //
meaning:
मद्यमांससुधाधौतवस्त्रशङ्खवृषध्वजाः /
पुण्यस्त्रीपुण्यकलशरत्नभृङ्गारगोद्विजाः //
text_mt: liquor, meat, nectar, washed cloth, a conch, an ox, banners, / an auspicious woman, a sacred water-pot, a jewel, a pitcher, cattle, twice-born men,

sanskrit_iast:
bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭahaghaṇṭāvīṇādiniḥsvanāḥ /
vedamaṅgalaghoṣāḥ syuḥ yā yināṃ kāryasiddhidāḥ //
meaning:
भेरीमृदङ्गपटहघण्टावीणादिनिःस्वनाः /
वेदमङ्गलघोषाः स्युः या यिनां कार्यसिद्धिदाः //
text_mt: the sounds of kettledrums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, bells, vīṇās, and the like, / [and] the auspicious chanting of the Vedas—these grant success in undertakings to travelers.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau viruddhaśakunaṃ dṛṣṭvā yāyīṣṭadevatām /
smṛtvā dvitīye viprāṇāṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ nivartayet //
meaning:
आदौ विरुद्धशकुनं दृष्ट्वा यायीष्टदेवताम् /
स्मृत्वा द्वितीये विप्राणां कृत्वा पूजां निवर्तयेत् //
text_mt: Seeing an unfavourable omen at the outset, a traveler should remember his chosen deity; / on a second [such omen], he should make an offering to the Brahmins and turn back.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadikṣukṣutaṃ neṣṭaṃ gokṣutaṃ nidhanapradam /
aphalaṃ yadbālavṛddharogipainasikaiḥ kṛtam //
meaning:
सर्वदिक्षुक्षुतं नेष्टं गोक्षुतं निधनप्रदम् /
अफलं यद्बालवृद्धरोगिपैनसिकैः कृतम् //
text_mt: Sneezing in all directions is undesirable, and the sneeze of a cow brings death; / [a sneeze] made by children, the aged, the diseased, or those with catarrh is without effect.

sanskrit_iast:
parastrī dvijadevasvaṃ tatrapṛśeddiggajāśvakān /
hanyātparapuraprāpto na strīrnityaṃ nirāyudhān //
meaning:
परस्त्री द्विजदेवस्वं तत्रपृशेद्दिग्गजाश्वकान् /
हन्यात्परपुरप्राप्तो न स्त्रीर्नित्यं निरायुधान् //
text_mt: Another’s wife, the property of twice-born men and gods, and the quarter-elephants and horses there he must not touch; / having reached an enemy city, he must never slay women or those without weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau saumyāyane kāryaṃnavavāstupraveśanam /
vidhāya pūrvadivase vāstupūjābalikriyām //
meaning:
आदौ सौम्यायने कार्यंनववास्तुप्रवेशनम् /
विधाय पूर्वदिवसे वास्तुपूजाबलिक्रियाम् //
text_mt: The entry into a new house should first be performed in the northern course of the sun, / having performed the worship of the site and the offering of oblations on the preceding day.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaphaālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭamāseṣu śobhanam /
praveśo madhyamo jñeyaḥ saumyakārtikamāsayoḥ //
meaning:
माघफआल्गुनवैशाखज्येष्टमासेषु शोभनम् /
प्रवेशो मध्यमो ज्ञेयः सौम्यकार्तिकमासयोः //
text_mt: In the months of Māgha, Phālguna, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha it is auspicious; / house-entry should be known as middling in the months of Mārgaśīrṣa and Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśījyānteṣu varuṇatvāṣṭramitrasthiroḍuṣu /
śubhaḥ prevaśo devejyaśukrayorddṛśyamānayoḥ //
meaning:
शशीज्यान्तेषु वरुणत्वाष्ट्रमित्रस्थिरोडुषु /
शुभः प्रेवशो देवेज्यशुक्रयोर्द्दृश्यमानयोः //
text_mt: In the lunar mansions ending with Jupiter's and the Moon's, in Śatabhiṣaj, Citrā, Anurādhā, and the fixed stars, / house-entry is auspicious while Jupiter and Venus are visible,

sanskrit_iast:
vyarkāravāre tithiṣu riktāmāvarjiteṣu ca /
divā vā yadi vā rātrau praveśo maṅgalapradaḥ //
meaning:
व्यर्कारवारे तिथिषु रिक्तामावर्जितेषु च /
दिवा वा यदि वा रात्रौ प्रवेशो मङ्गलप्रदः //
text_mt: on weekdays other than Sunday, and on lunar days avoiding the empty ones and the new moon; / whether by day or by night, the entry brings auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
candratārābalopete pūrvāhne śobhane dine /
sthiralagne sthirāṃśe ca naidhane śuddhisaṃyute //
meaning:
चन्द्रताराबलोपेते पूर्वाह्ने शोभने दिने /
स्थिरलग्ने स्थिरांशे च नैधने शुद्धिसंयुते //
text_mt: endowed with the strength of the Moon and lunar mansions, in the forenoon of an auspicious day, / in a fixed ascendant and fixed degree, and with purity in the eighth house,

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇakendrasaṃsthaiś saumyaistryāyārigaiḥ paraiḥ /
lagrāntyāṣṭamaṣaṣṭasthavarjitena dviyāṃśunā //
meaning:
त्रिकोणकेन्द्रसंस्थैश् सौम्यैस्त्र्यायारिगैः परैः /
लग्रान्त्याष्टमषष्टस्थवर्जितेन द्वियांशुना //
text_mt: with benefics situated in trines and angles, and others in the third, eleventh, and sixth [houses], / avoiding the Sun situated in the ascendant, twelfth, eighth, or sixth [houses].

sanskrit_iast:
karturṣā janmabhe lagne tābhyāmupacaye 'pi vā /
praveśalgne syāmṛddhiranyabheśokaniḥsvatā //
meaning:
कर्तुर्षा जन्मभे लग्ने ताभ्यामुपचये ऽपि वा /
प्रवेशल्ग्ने स्यामृद्धिरन्यभेशोकनिःस्वता //
text_mt: In the builder's asterism, birth-asterism, ascendant, or in an upacaya from both of them, / in the ascendant of entry there will be prosperity; in any other asterism, sorrow and poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanīya gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ vidhidhairmaṅgalasvanaiḥ /
kṛtvārkaṃ vāmato vidvānbhṛṅgāraṃ cāgrato viśet //
meaning:
दर्शनीय गृहं रम्यं विधिधैर्मङ्गलस्वनैः /
कृत्वार्कं वामतो विद्वान्भृङ्गारं चाग्रतो विशेत् //
text_mt: Looking upon the charming house with various auspicious sounds, / having kept the Sun on his left, the wise man should enter with a water-pot in front.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāpraveśe śaśini jalarāśigatepi vā /
kendrage vā śuklapakṣe cātivṛṣṭiḥ śubhekṣite //
meaning:
वर्षाप्रवेशे शशिनि जलराशिगतेपि वा /
केन्द्रगे वा शुक्लपक्षे चातिवृष्टिः शुभेक्षिते //
text_mt: At the onset of the rainy season, when the Moon is in a watery sign / or in an angle during the bright fortnight, and aspected by a benefic, there is excessive rain;

sanskrit_iast:
alpavṛṣṭiḥ pāpadṛṣṭe prāvṛṭkāle 'cirādbhavet /
candraśceddhārgave sarvamevaṃvidha guṇānvite //
meaning:
अल्पवृष्टिः पापदृष्टे प्रावृट्काले ऽचिराद्भवेत् /
चन्द्रश्चेद्धार्गवे सर्वमेवंविध गुणान्विते //
text_mt: if aspected by a malefic, there will soon be meager rain in the rainy season. / If the Moon is with Venus, all endowed with such qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
prāvṛṣīnduḥ sitātsaptarāśigaḥ śubhavīkṣitaḥ /
mandātrrikoṇasaptastho yadi vā vṛddhikṛdbhavet //
meaning:
प्रावृषीन्दुः सितात्सप्तराशिगः शुभवीक्षितः /
मन्दात्र्रिकोणसप्तस्थो यदि वा वृद्धिकृद्भवेत् //
text_mt: the Moon in the rainy season occupying the seventh sign from Venus, aspected by a benefic, / or situated in a trine or the seventh from Saturn, causes an increase [of rain].

sanskrit_iast:
sadyo vṛṣṭikaraḥ śukro yadā budhasamīpagaḥ /
tayorṃmadhyagate bhānau bhavedṣṭivināśanam //
meaning:
सद्यो वृष्टिकरः शुक्रो यदा बुधसमीपगः /
तयोर्ंमध्यगते भानौ भवेद्ष्टिविनाशनम् //
text_mt: Venus produces immediate rain when it goes near Mercury; / when the Sun enters between the two, there will be destruction of rain.

sanskrit_iast:
maghādipañcadhiṣṇyasthaḥ pūrve svātitraye pare /
pravarṣaṇaṃ bhṛguḥ kuryādviparīte na varṣaṇam //
meaning:
मघादिपञ्चधिष्ण्यस्थः पूर्वे स्वातित्रये परे /
प्रवर्षणं भृगुः कुर्याद्विपरीते न वर्षणम् //
text_mt: Situated in the five mansions beginning with Maghā in the east, or the three beginning with Svātī in the west, / Venus produces rainfall; in the reverse, there is no rain.

sanskrit_iast:
purataḥ pṛṣṭato bhānorgrahā yadi samīpagāḥ /
tadā vṛṣṭiṃ prakurvanti na te cetpratilomagāḥ //
meaning:
पुरतः पृष्टतो भानोर्ग्रहा यदि समीपगाः /
तदा वृष्टिं प्रकुर्वन्ति न ते चेत्प्रतिलोमगाः //
text_mt: If planets are situated close before or behind the Sun, / they produce rain then, provided they are not moving retrogradely.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmabhāgasthitaḥ śukro vṛṣṭikṛccettu yāmyagaḥ /
udayāsteṣu vṛṣṭiḥ syādbhānorārdrāpraveśane //
meaning:
वामभागस्थितः शुक्रो वृष्टिकृच्चेत्तु याम्यगः /
उदयास्तेषु वृष्टिः स्याद्भानोरार्द्राप्रवेशने //
text_mt: If Venus situated on the left side brings rain, then if it goes to the south, / there will be rain at its rising and setting, [and] at the Sun's entry into Ārdrā.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyayoḥ sasyavṛddhiḥ syātsarvasaṃpannṛṇānniśi /
stokavṛṣṭiranarghaḥ syādavṛṣṭiḥ sasyasaṃpadaḥ //
meaning:
संध्ययोः सस्यवृद्धिः स्यात्सर्वसंपन्नृणान्निशि /
स्तोकवृष्टिरनर्घः स्यादवृष्टिः सस्यसंपदः //
text_mt: At the two twilights there will be growth of crops; at night, complete prosperity for men; / with little rain there will be high prices; with no rain, prosperity of crops [is ruined].

sanskrit_iast:
ādrodayegrabhinnā cadbhavediti na saṃśayaḥ /
candrejye jñetha vā śukre kendrenbītirvinaśyati //
meaning:
आद्रोदयेग्रभिन्ना चद्भवेदिति न संशयः /
चन्द्रेज्ये ज्ञेथ वा शुक्रे केन्द्रेन्बीतिर्विनश्यति //
text_mt: If clouds are broken at the rising of Ārdrā, there is no doubt [of this]; / if the Moon, Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus is in an angle, calamity is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāṣāḍhā gato bhānurjīmūtaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ /
varṣatyārdrādimṛlāntaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratyahaṃ tathā //
meaning:
पूर्वाषाढा गतो भानुर्जीमूतैः परिवेष्टितः /
वर्षत्यार्द्रादिमृलान्तं प्रत्यक्षं प्रत्यहं तथा //
text_mt: The Sun situated in Pūrvāṣāḍhā, surrounded by clouds, / rains daily and visibly from Ārdrā to Mūla.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣṭiścetpauṣṇabheṃ tasmāddaśarkṣeṣu na varṣati /
siṃhe bhinne kujo vṛṣṭirabhinne karkaṭe tathā //
meaning:
वृष्टिश्चेत्पौष्णभें तस्माद्दशर्क्षेषु न वर्षति /
सिंहे भिन्ने कुजो वृष्टिरभिन्ने कर्कटे तथा //
text_mt: If it rains in Revatī, it does not rain for ten asterisms from that; / when Leo is pierced, Mars brings rain; likewise when Cancer is not pierced.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyodaye prabhinne cetsarvadā vṛṣṭiruttama /
ahirbudhnyaṃ pūrvaśasyaṃ paraśasyā ca revatī //
meaning:
कन्योदये प्रभिन्ने चेत्सर्वदा वृष्टिरुत्तम /
अहिर्बुध्न्यं पूर्वशस्यं परशस्या च रेवती //
text_mt: If it is pierced at the rising of Virgo, there is always excellent rain; / Uttarabhadrapadā brings early crops, and Revatī brings late crops;

sanskrit_iast:
bharaṇī sarvasasyā ca sarvanāśāya cāśvinī /
guroḥ saptamarā tisthaḥ pratyaggo bhṛgujo yadā //
meaning:
भरणी सर्वसस्या च सर्वनाशाय चाश्विनी /
गुरोः सप्तमरा तिस्थः प्रत्यग्गो भृगुजो यदा //
text_mt: Bharaṇī brings all crops, and Aśvinī brings complete destruction. / When Venus, moving westward, is situated in the seventh sign from Jupiter,

sanskrit_iast:
tadātivarṣaṇaṃ bhūri prāvṛṭkāle balojjhite /
āsaptamarkṣaṃśaśinaḥ pariveśagatottarā //
meaning:
तदातिवर्षणं भूरि प्रावृट्काले बलोज्झिते /
आसप्तमर्क्षंशशिनः परिवेशगतोत्तरा //
text_mt: then there is abundant, heavy rainfall during the rainy season, even if depleted of strength. / If a halo of the Moon extends up to the seventh asterism to the north,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyutprapūrṇamaṇḍūkāsvanāvṛṣṭirbhavettadā /
yadāpratyaṅnatā maghāḥ khasaptopari saṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
विद्युत्प्रपूर्णमण्डूकास्वनावृष्टिर्भवेत्तदा /
यदाप्रत्यङ्नता मघाः खसप्तोपरि संस्थिताः //
text_mt: with lightning and filled with the croaking of frogs, then rain occurs. / When Maghā stars bending westward are situated high above seven in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
patanti dakṣiṇasthā yebhavedvṛṣṭistadācirāt /
nakhairlikhantomārjārāścāvaniṃ lohasaṃyute //
meaning:
पतन्ति दक्षिणस्था येभवेद्वृष्टिस्तदाचिरात् /
नखैर्लिखन्तोमार्जाराश्चावनिं लोहसंयुते //
text_mt: and fall while situated in the south, rain will occur soon after. / Cats scratching the earth with their claws, [or] in contact with iron,

sanskrit_iast:
rathyāyāṃ setubandhāḥ syurbālānāṃ vṛṣṭihetavaḥ /
pipīlikāśreṇayaśchinnāḥ khadyotā bahavastadā //
meaning:
रथ्यायां सेतुबन्धाः स्युर्बालानां वृष्टिहेतवः /
पिपीलिकाश्रेणयश्छिन्नाः खद्योता बहवस्तदा //
text_mt: children building bridges in the street—these are causes of rain. / Broken lines of ants and many fireflies then,

sanskrit_iast:
drumādirohaḥ sarpāṇāṃ prītirdurvṛṣṭisūcakāḥ /
udayāstamaye kāle vivarṇor'ketha vā śaśī //
meaning:
द्रुमादिरोहः सर्पाणां प्रीतिर्दुर्वृष्टिसूचकाः /
उदयास्तमये काले विवर्णोर्ऽकेथ वा शशी //
text_mt: snakes climbing trees and the like, and their coupling, indicate bad rain. / If at sunrise or sunset the Sun or Moon is discolored

sanskrit_iast:
madhuvarṇo 'tivāyuścedativṛṣṭirbhavettadā /
prāṅmukhasya tu kūrmasya navāṅgeṣu dharāmimām //
meaning:
मधुवर्णो ऽतिवायुश्चेदतिवृष्टिर्भवेत्तदा /
प्राङ्मुखस्य तु कूर्मस्य नवाङ्गेषु धरामिमाम् //
text_mt: or honey-colored, and if there is excessive wind, then there will be heavy rain. / Dividing this earth into nine parts upon the nine limbs of the tortoise facing east,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajya navadhā khaṇḍe maṇḍalāni pradakṣiṇam /
antarvedāśca ṣāñcālastasyedaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
विभज्य नवधा खण्डे मण्डलानि प्रदक्षिणम् /
अन्तर्वेदाश्च षाञ्चालस्तस्येदं नाभिमण्डलम् //
text_mt: the regions in clockwise order: Antarvedi and the Pāñcālas are its navel region;

sanskrit_iast:
prācyā māgadhalāṭotthā deśāstanmukhamaṇḍalam /
strīkaliṅgakirātākhyā deśāstadbāhumaṇḍalam //
meaning:
प्राच्या मागधलाटोत्था देशास्तन्मुखमण्डलम् /
स्त्रीकलिङ्गकिराताख्या देशास्तद्बाहुमण्डलम् //
text_mt: the eastern countries, and those arising in Magadha and Lāṭa, are its face region; / the regions called Strīrājya, Kaliṅga, and Kirāta are its right arm region;

sanskrit_iast:
avantī draviḍā bhillā deśāstatpārśvamaṇḍalam /
gauḍakaiṅkaṇaśālvāndhrapauḍrastatpādamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
अवन्ती द्रविडा भिल्ला देशास्तत्पार्श्वमण्डलम् /
गौडकैङ्कणशाल्वान्ध्रपौड्रस्तत्पादमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Avanti, the Draviḍas, and the Bhillas are its right side region; / Gauḍa, Koṅkaṇa, Śālva, Andhra, and Pauṇḍra are its right foot region;

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhukāśimahārāṣṭrasaurāṣṭrāḥ pucchamaṇḍalam /
pulindacīnayavanagurjarāḥ pādamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
सिंधुकाशिमहाराष्ट्रसौराष्ट्राः पुच्छमण्डलम् /
पुलिन्दचीनयवनगुर्जराः पादमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Sindhu, Kāśi, Mahārāṣṭra, and Saurāṣṭra are the tail region; / the Pulindas, Cīnas, Yavanas, and Gurjaras are the left foot region;

sanskrit_iast:
kurukāśmīramādreyamatsyāstatpārśvamaṇḍalam /
khasāṃgavaṅgabāhlīkaṃ kāṃbojāḥ pāṇimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
कुरुकाश्मीरमाद्रेयमत्स्यास्तत्पार्श्वमण्डलम् /
खसांगवङ्गबाह्लीकं कांबोजाः पाणिमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Kuru, Kaśmīra, Mādreya, and Matsya are its left side region; / Khasa, Aṅga, Vaṅga, Bāhlīka, and the Kāmbojas are its left arm region.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikādīni dhiṣṇyāni trīṇi triṇi kramānnyaset /
nābhyādiṣu navāṅgeṣu pāpairduṣṭaṃ śubhaiḥ śubham //
meaning:
कृत्तिकादीनि धिष्ण्यानि त्रीणि त्रिणि क्रमान्न्यसेत् /
नाभ्यादिषु नवाङ्गेषु पापैर्दुष्टं शुभैः शुभम् //
text_mt: One should assign the lunar mansions beginning with Kṛttikā in groups of three successively / to the nine limbs beginning with the navel; affliction comes from malefics, and good from benefics.

sanskrit_iast:
devatā yatra nṛtyanti patanti prajvalanti ca /
muhū rudanti gāyanti prasvidyanti hasaṃti ca //
meaning:
देवता यत्र नृत्यन्ति पतन्ति प्रज्वलन्ति च /
मुहू रुदन्ति गायन्ति प्रस्विद्यन्ति हसंति च //
text_mt: Where deities dance, fall, flare up, / repeatedly weep, sing, sweat, and laugh,

sanskrit_iast:
vamantyagniṃ tathā dhūmaṃ snehaṃ raktaṃ payo jalam /
adhomukhādhitiṣṭanti sthānātsthānaṃ vrajanti ca //
meaning:
वमन्त्यग्निं तथा धूमं स्नेहं रक्तं पयो जलम् /
अधोमुखाधितिष्टन्ति स्थानात्स्थानं व्रजन्ति च //
text_mt: vomit fire, smoke, oil, blood, milk, or water, / hang upside down, and move from place to place—

sanskrit_iast:
evamādyā hi dṛśyante vikārāḥ pratimāsu ca /
gandharvanagaraṃ caiva divā nakṣatradarśanam //
meaning:
एवमाद्या हि दृश्यन्ते विकाराः प्रतिमासु च /
गन्धर्वनगरं चैव दिवा नक्षत्रदर्शनम् //
text_mt: when such portents are seen in idols, and a city of the Gandharvas, or the sight of stars by day,

sanskrit_iast:
mahotkāpatanaṃ kāṣṭatṛṇaraktapravarṣaṇam /
gāndharvaṃ dehadigdhūmaṃ bhūmikaṃpaṃ divā niśi //
meaning:
महोत्कापतनं काष्टतृणरक्तप्रवर्षणम् /
गान्धर्वं देहदिग्धूमं भूमिकंपं दिवा निशि //
text_mt: the falling of great meteors, a rain of wood, grass, and blood, / celestial sounds, smoke rising from bodies or the quarters, earthquakes by day and night,

sanskrit_iast:
anagnau ca sphuliṅgāśca jvalanaṃ ca vinendhanam /
niśīndracāpamaṇḍūkaṃ śikhare śvetavāyasaḥ //
meaning:
अनग्नौ च स्फुलिङ्गाश्च ज्वलनं च विनेन्धनम् /
निशीन्द्रचापमण्डूकं शिखरे श्वेतवायसः //
text_mt: sparks where there is no fire, and burning without fuel, / a rainbow at night, a frog or a white crow on a roof-peak,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante visphuliṅgāśca gogajāśvoṣṭragātrataḥ /
jantavo dvitriśiraso jāyante vāpi yoniṣu //
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते विस्फुलिङ्गाश्च गोगजाश्वोष्ट्रगात्रतः /
जन्तवो द्वित्रिशिरसो जायन्ते वापि योनिषु //
text_mt: sparks seen from the limbs of cows, elephants, horses, and camels, / or creatures born from wombs with two or three heads,

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ sūryāścatasṛṣu hyarditāyugapadraveḥ /
jambūkagrāmasaṃvāsaḥ ketūnāṃ ca pradarśanam //
meaning:
प्रातः सूर्याश्चतसृषु ह्यर्दितायुगपद्रवेः /
जम्बूकग्रामसंवासः केतूनां च प्रदर्शनम् //
text_mt: the Sun seen in the four directions in the morning afflicted simultaneously, / jackals dwelling in villages, and the appearance of comets,

sanskrit_iast:
kākānāmākulaṃ rātrau kapotānāṃ divā yadi /
akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣā dṛśyante phalitā yadi //
meaning:
काकानामाकुलं रात्रौ कपोतानां दिवा यदि /
अकाले पुष्पिता वृक्षा दृश्यन्ते फलिता यदि //
text_mt: commotion among crows at night, or among pigeons by day, / if trees are seen flowering or bearing fruit out of season—

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ tacchedanaṃ tatra tataḥ śāntirmanīṣibhiḥ /
