text_mt: who have assumed manifold bodies for the perfection of the incarnation of wisdom, / who are new, whose form is the body, whose single nature is the ultimate reality,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave ciddhanāya te /
statantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya śivātmane //
meaning:
सर्वाज्ञानतमोभेदभानवे चिद्धनाय ते /
स्ततन्त्राय दयाकॢप्तविग्रहाय शिवात्मने //
text_mt: the sun that dispels all the darkness of ignorance, a mass of consciousness, / independent, whose body is fashioned out of compassion, whose nature is Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
paratra trāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhāvarūpiṇe /
vivekināṃ vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśinām //
meaning:
परत्र त्राय भक्तानां भव्यानां भावरूपिणे /
विवेकिनां विवेकाय विमर्शाय विमर्शिनाम् //
text_mt: the protector in the beyond for devotees, the essence of being for the auspicious, / discernment for the discerning, reflective awareness for the reflective,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśānāṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇe /
purastātpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭe namastubhyamuparyadhaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकाशानां प्रकाशाय ज्ञानिनां ज्ञानरूपिणे /
पुरस्तात्पार्श्वयोः पृष्टे नमस्तुभ्यमुपर्यधः //
text_mt: the light of lights, whose nature is knowledge for the wise! / Homage to you in front, on both flanks, behind, above, and below!

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sañcitsvarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadāsanam /
tvatprasādādahaṃ deva kṛtākṛtyo 'smi sarvataḥ //
meaning:
सदा सञ्चित्स्वरूपेण विधेहि भवदासनम् /
त्वत्प्रसादादहं देव कृताकृत्यो ऽस्मि सर्वतः //
text_mt: Always establish your seat with the nature of pure existence and consciousness. / By your grace, O God, I have accomplished all that was to be done in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāmṛtyumahāpāśādvimukto 'smi śivo 'smi vaḥ /
iti stutvā tataḥ sarva gurave vinivedayet //
meaning:
मायामृत्युमहापाशाद्विमुक्तो ऽस्मि शिवो ऽस्मि वः /
इति स्तुत्वा ततः सर्व गुरवे विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: I am freed from the great snare of illusion and death; I am Śiva, indeed.' / Having praised thus, one should then dedicate everything to the guru:

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāṃyādiprātarantataḥ /
yatkaromi jagannātha tadastu tava pūjanam //
meaning:
प्रातः प्रभृति सायान्तं सांयादिप्रातरन्ततः /
यत्करोमि जगन्नाथ तदस्तु तव पूजनम् //
text_mt: 'From morning until evening, and from evening until morning, / whatever I do, O Lord of the universe, let that be your worship.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca gurupādābjagalitāmṛtadhārayā /
kṣālitaṃ nijamātmānaṃ lirmalaṃ bhāvayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च गुरुपादाब्जगलितामृतधारया /
क्षालितं निजमात्मानं लिर्मलं भावयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: Then the wise person should contemplate oneself as cleansed and spotless / by the stream of nectar trickling from the lotus feet of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ mūlavidyāṃ vibhāvayet /
mūlādhārādadho bhāge vartulaṃ vāyumaṇḍalam //
meaning:
मूलादिब्रह्मरन्ध्रान्तं मूलविद्यां विभावयेत् /
मूलाधारादधो भागे वर्तुलं वायुमण्डलम् //
text_mt: One should contemplate the root-knowledge from the mūlādhāra up to the brahmarandhra. / Below the mūlādhāra is the circular maṇḍala of wind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthavāyubījotthavāyunā ca tadrūrddhvakam /
trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vahnestatrasthavahnibījataḥ //
meaning:
तत्रस्थवायुबीजोत्थवायुना च तद्रूर्द्ध्वकम् /
त्रिकोणं मण्डलं वह्नेस्तत्रस्थवह्निबीजतः //
text_mt: Above it, through the wind arisen from the wind-seed-syllable situated there, / is the triangular maṇḍala of fire. By the fire arisen from the fire-seed-syllable situated there,

sanskrit_iast:
utpannenāgninā mūlādhārāvasthitavigrahām /
prasuptabhujagākārāṃ svayaṃbhūliṅgaveṣṭinīm //
meaning:
उत्पन्नेनाग्निना मूलाधारावस्थितविग्रहाम् /
प्रसुप्तभुजगाकारां स्वयंभूलिङ्गवेष्टिनीम् //
text_mt: having contemplated the Kulakuṇḍalinī, whose form resides in the mūlādhāra, / who has the form of a sleeping serpent, coiling around the self-existent liṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
visatantunibhāṃ koṭividyudābhāṃ tanīyasīm /
kulakuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā kūrcenotthāpayeñca tām //
meaning:
विसतन्तुनिभां कोटिविद्युदाभां तनीयसीम् /
कुलकुण्डलिनीं ध्यात्वा कूर्चेनोत्थापयेञ्च ताम् //
text_mt: resembling a lotus filament, radiant as ten million flashes of lightning, extremely subtle, / one should awaken her with the kūrca-bīja.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumṇāvartmanātāṃ ca ṣaṭcakrakramabhedinīm /
gurupadiṣṭavidhinā brahmarandhraṃ nayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
सुषुम्णावर्त्मनातां च षट्चक्रक्रमभेदिनीम् /
गुरुपदिष्टविधिना ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं नयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: And the wise person, by the method taught by the guru, / should lead her, piercing through the sequence of the six cakras, along the path of the suṣumṇā to the brahmarandhra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthāmṛtasaṃmagnīkṛtyātmānaṃ vibhāvayet /
tatprabhāpaṭalavyāptaivimalaṃ cinmayaṃ param //
meaning:
तत्रस्थामृतसंमग्नीकृत्यात्मानं विभावयेत् /
तत्प्रभापटलव्याप्तैविमलं चिन्मयं परम् //
text_mt: One should contemplate oneself submerged in the nectar situated there, / stainless, consisting of consciousness, supreme, pervaded by her mass of splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
punastāṃ svasthalaṃ nītvā hṛdidevaṃ vicintayan /
dṛṣṭvā ca mānasairdravyaiḥ prārthayenmanunāmunā //
meaning:
पुनस्तां स्वस्थलं नीत्वा हृदिदेवं विचिन्तयन् /
दृष्ट्वा च मानसैर्द्रव्यैः प्रार्थयेन्मनुनामुना //
text_mt: Having brought her back to her own place, meditating on the deity in the heart, / and having beheld [him], one should pray with mental offerings using this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyacaita nyamayādideva śrīnātha viṣṇo bhavadājñayaiva /
prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ saṃsārayātrāṃ tvanuvartayiṣye //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यचैत न्यमयादिदेव श्रीनाथ विष्णो भवदाज्ञयैव /
प्रातः समुत्थाय तव प्रियार्थं संसारयात्रां त्वनुवर्तयिष्ये //
text_mt: 'O Primordial Deity consisting of the consciousness of the three worlds, O Śrīnātha, O Viṣṇu, only by your command, / having risen in the morning, I shall pursue worldly activity for your pleasure.'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoriti sthale vipra kārya ūho 'nyadaivate /
tatataḥ kuryātsarvasiddhyai tvajapāyā nivedanam //
meaning:
विष्णोरिति स्थले विप्र कार्य ऊहो ऽन्यदैवते /
तततः कुर्यात्सर्वसिद्ध्यै त्वजपाया निवेदनम् //
text_mt: In place of 'Viṣṇu', O Brahmin, an adaptation should be made for another deity. / Then, for the attainment of all perfections, one should make the offering of the ajapā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ /
ajapākhyāṃ tu gāyatrīṃ jīvojapati sarvadā //
meaning:
षट्शतानि दिवा रात्रौ सहस्राण्येकविंशतिः /
अजपाख्यां तु गायत्रीं जीवोजपति सर्वदा //
text_mt: Six hundred and twenty-one thousand times / during day and night, the living soul constantly recites the gāyatrī named ajapā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirhaṃsastathāvyaktagātrīchanda īritam /
devatā paramohaṃsaścādyante bījaśaktikam //
meaning:
ऋषिर्हंसस्तथाव्यक्तगात्रीछन्द ईरितम् /
देवता परमोहंसश्चाद्यन्ते बीजशक्तिकम् //
text_mt: Its seer is Haṃsa, its meter is said to be the unmanifest Gāyatrī, / its deity is Paramahaṃsa, and the seed and energy are at the beginning and the end.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kurvīta sūryaḥ somonirañjanaḥ /
nirābhāsaśca dharmaśca jñānaṃ ceti tathā punaḥ //
meaning:
ततः षडङ्गं कुर्वीत सूर्यः सोमोनिरञ्जनः /
निराभासश्च धर्मश्च ज्ञानं चेति तथा पुनः //
text_mt: Then one should perform the six limbs: Sūrya, Soma, Nirañjana, / Nirābhāsa, Dharma, and again Jñāna.

sanskrit_iast:
kramādetānhaṃsapūrvānātmanepadapaścimān /
jātayuktānsādhakendra ṣaḍaṅgeṣu niyojayet //
meaning:
क्रमादेतान्हंसपूर्वानात्मनेपदपश्चिमान् /
जातयुक्तान्साधकेन्द्र षडङ्गेषु नियोजयेत् //
text_mt: Having preceded these in order with 'haṃsa' and followed them with the word 'ātmane', / endowed with the case-endings, O best of practitioners, one should assign them to the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
hakāraḥ sūryasaṃkāśatejāḥ saṃgacchate bahiḥ /
sakārastādṛśaścaiva praveśe dhyānamīritam //
meaning:
हकारः सूर्यसंकाशतेजाः संगच्छते बहिः /
सकारस्तादृशश्चैव प्रवेशे ध्यानमीरितम् //
text_mt: The syllable 'ha', having the brilliance of the sun, goes outside; / the syllable 'sa' is likewise upon inhalation: this is declared to be the meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvārpayeddhīmānvahnyarkeṣu vibhāgaśaḥ /
mūlādhāre vādisāṃtabījayukte caturdale //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार्पयेद्धीमान्वह्न्यर्केषु विभागशः /
मूलाधारे वादिसांतबीजयुक्ते चतुर्दले //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, the wise person should apportion it to the fires and suns: / In the four-petaled mūlādhāra endowed with the seed-syllables from 'va' to 'sa',

sanskrit_iast:
bandhūkābhe svaśaktyā tu sahitāpāsvagāya ca /
pāśāṅkuśasudhāpātramodakollāsapāṇaye //
meaning:
बन्धूकाभे स्वशक्त्या तु सहितापास्वगाय च /
पाशाङ्कुशसुधापात्रमोदकोल्लासपाणये //
text_mt: which has the hue of a bandhūka flower, accompanied by his Śakti, who moves in the breath, / whose hands shine with a noose, a goad, a vessel of nectar, and a sweetmeat,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭśataṃ tu gaṇeśāya vāgadhīśāya cārpayet /
svādhiṣṭāne vidrumābhe vādilāntārṇasaṃyute //
meaning:
षट्शतं तु गणेशाय वागधीशाय चार्पयेत् /
स्वाधिष्टाने विद्रुमाभे वादिलान्तार्णसंयुते //
text_mt: one should dedicate six hundred [breaths] to Gaṇeśa, the lord of speech. / In the svādhiṣṭhāna resembling coral, joined with the syllables from 'ba' to 'la',

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṅgaśaktiyuktāya vidyādhipataye tathā /
sruvākṣamālālasitabāhave padmajanmane //
meaning:
वामाङ्गशक्तियुक्ताय विद्याधिपतये तथा /
स्रुवाक्षमालालसितबाहवे पद्मजन्मने //
text_mt: to the lord of knowledge joined with the Śakti on his left side, / whose arms shine with the ladle and the rosary, to the lotus-born

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇe ṣaṭsahasraṃ tu haṃsārūḍhāya cārpayet /
vidyullasitameghābhe ḍādiphaāntārṇapatrake //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणे षट्सहस्रं तु हंसारूढाय चार्पयेत् /
विद्युल्लसितमेघाभे डादिफआन्तार्णपत्रके //
text_mt: Brahmā mounted on a swan, one should dedicate six thousand. / In the [maṇipūra] whose petals have the letters from 'ḍa' to 'pha', resembling a cloud flashed with lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇipūre śaṅkhacakragadāpaṅkadhāriṇe /
saśriye ṣaṭsahasraṃ ca viṣṇave vinivedayet //
meaning:
मणिपूरे शङ्खचक्रगदापङ्कधारिणे /
सश्रिये षट्सहस्रं च विष्णवे विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: one should dedicate six thousand to Viṣṇu in the maṇipūra, / who holds the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, together with Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
anāhater'kapatre ca kādiṭhāntārṇasaṃyute /
śukle śūlābhayavarasadhākalaśadhāriṇe //
meaning:
अनाहतेर्ऽकपत्रे च कादिठान्तार्णसंयुते /
शुक्ले शूलाभयवरसधाकलशधारिणे //
text_mt: In the white twelve-petaled anāhata endowed with the syllables from 'ka' to 'ṭha', / to him who holds a trident, the gestures of fearlessness and boon-granting, and a nectar-pot,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṅge śaktiyuktāya vidyādhipataye sudhīḥ /
vṛṣārūḍhāya rudrāya ṣaṭsahasraṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
वामाङ्गे शक्तियुक्ताय विद्याधिपतये सुधीः /
वृषारूढाय रुद्राय षट्सहस्रं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: to Rudra, the lord of knowledge, mounted on a bull, / accompanied by Śakti on his left side, the wise person should dedicate six thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
viśudde ṣoḍaśadale svarāḍhye śuknatraṇake /
mahājyotiprakāśāyendriyādhipataye tataḥ //
meaning:
विशुद्दे षोडशदले स्वराढ्ये शुक्नत्रणके /
महाज्योतिप्रकाशायेन्द्रियाधिपतये ततः //
text_mt: In the sixteen-petaled viśuddha, rich in vowels, having white filaments, / to the lord of the senses, possessing the brilliance of a great light,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasramarpayetprāṇaśaktyā yukteścarāya ca /
ājñācakre hakṣayukte dvidile 'bje sahasrakam //
meaning:
सहस्रमर्पयेत्प्राणशक्त्या युक्तेश्चराय च /
आज्ञाचक्रे हक्षयुक्ते द्विदिले ऽब्जे सहस्रकम् //
text_mt: to Īśvara united with the vital breath-energy, one should offer one thousand. / In the two-petaled lotus of the ājñā-cakra endowed with 'ha' and 'kṣa', one should offer one thousand

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivāya gurave parāśaktiyutāya vai /
sahasrāre mahāpadme nādabindudvayānvite //
meaning:
सदाशिवाय गुरवे पराशक्तियुताय वै /
सहस्रारे महापद्मे नादबिन्दुद्वयान्विते //
text_mt: to Sadāśiva, the guru, who is indeed united with the supreme energy. / In the great thousand-petaled sahasrāra, endowed with both nāda and bindu,

sanskrit_iast:
vilasanmātṛkāvarṇe varāmayakarāya ca /
praramādye ca gurave sahasraṃ vinivedayet //
meaning:
विलसन्मातृकावर्णे वरामयकराय च /
प्ररमाद्ये च गुरवे सहस्रं विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: shining with the letters of the alphabet, granting boons and fearlessness with his hands, / one should dedicate one thousand to the supreme primordial guru.

sanskrit_iast:
culukeṃ'bu punarddhṛtvā svabhāvādeva sidhyataḥ /
ekaviṃśatisāhasrapramitasya japasya ca //
meaning:
चुलुकेंऽबु पुनर्द्धृत्वा स्वभावादेव सिध्यतः /
एकविंशतिसाहस्रप्रमितस्य जपस्य च //
text_mt: Then, holding water in the cupped hand, [one offers the fruit] of the recitation / accomplished naturally, measuring twenty-one thousand

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭśatādhikasaṃkhyāsyā dajapāyā vibhāgaśaḥ /
saṃkalpena mokṣadātā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti //
meaning:
षट्शताधिकसंख्यास्या दजपाया विभागशः /
संकल्पेन मोक्षदाता विष्णुर्मे प्रीयतामिति //
text_mt: and six hundred repetitions of the ajapā according to the divisions, / with the resolve: 'May Viṣṇu, the bestower of liberation, be pleased with me.'

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate /
brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃsārī nityamukto na śokabhāk //
meaning:
अस्याः संकल्पमात्रेण महापापैः प्रमुच्यते /
ब्रह्मैवाहं न संसारी नित्यमुक्तो न शोकभाक् //
text_mt: By the mere resolve of this, one is released from great sins. / One should contemplate oneself: 'I am indeed Brahman, not a worldly transmigrant, eternally liberated, untouched by grief;

sanskrit_iast:
sañcidānandarūpo 'hamātmānamiti bhāvayet /
tataḥ samācareddehakṛtyaṃ devārcanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
सञ्चिदानन्दरूपो ऽहमात्मानमिति भावयेत् /
ततः समाचरेद्देहकृत्यं देवार्चनं तथा //
text_mt: I am of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss.' / Thereafter, one should perform the bodily duties and likewise the worship of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
taddhidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sadācārasya lakṣaṇam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde pañcaṣaṣṭimo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तद्धिधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि सदाचारस्य लक्षणम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे पञ्चषष्टिमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
I shall proclaim that rule, the characteristic of good conduct.

Thus ends the sixty-fifth chapter in the third quarter of the Bṛhad-upākhyāna in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
tataḥ śvāsānusāreṇa datvā pādaṃ mahītale /
samudramekhale devi parvatastanamaṇḍale //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
ततः श्वासानुसारेण दत्वा पादं महीतले /
समुद्रमेखले देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Then, placing a foot upon the surface of the earth in accordance with the breath: / 'O Goddess whose girdle is the ocean, whose breasts are the mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuvatni namastubhyaṃ pādasparśaṃ kṣamasva me /
iti bhūmiṃ tu saṃprārthya vihareñca yathāvidhi //
meaning:
विष्णुवत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे /
इति भूमिं तु संप्रार्थ्य विहरेञ्च यथाविधि //
text_mt: O wife of Viṣṇu, homage to you; forgive the touch of my feet.' / Having thus prayed to the earth, one should move about according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣaḥ koṇe tato grāmādgatvā mantramudīrayet /
gacchantu ṛṣayo devāḥ piśācā ye ca guhyakāḥ //
meaning:
रक्षः कोणे ततो ग्रामाद्गत्वा मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् /
गच्छन्तु ऋषयो देवाः पिशाचा ये च गुह्यकाः //
text_mt: Then, having gone from the village to the south-western quarter, one should utter the mantra: / 'May the sages, gods, piśācas, and whatever guhyakas,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhūtagaṇāḥ sarve kariṣye malamocanam /
iti tālatrayaṃ datvā śiraḥ prāvṛtya vāsasā //
meaning:
पितृभूतगणाः सर्वे करिष्ये मलमोचनम् /
इति तालत्रयं दत्वा शिरः प्रावृत्य वाससा //
text_mt: all ancestors and host of spirits go away; I shall discharge bodily waste.' / Having clapped one's hands three times thus and covered the head with a cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ rātrau divā sthitvā hyudaṅmukhaḥ /
malaṃ visṛjya saucaṃ tu mṛdādbhiḥ samupācaret //
meaning:
दक्षिणाभिमुखं रात्रौ दिवा स्थित्वा ह्युदङ्मुखः /
मलं विसृज्य सौचं तु मृदाद्भिः समुपाचरेत् //
text_mt: facing south at night and facing north by day, / having discharged the waste, one should perform purification with earth and water.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā liṅge gude tisro daśa vāmakare mṛdaḥ /
karayoḥ sapta vai dadyātritrivaraṃ ca pādayoḥ //
meaning:
एका लिङ्गे गुदे तिस्रो दश वामकरे मृदः /
करयोः सप्त वै दद्यात्रित्रिवरं च पादयोः //
text_mt: One application of clay to the penis, three to the anus, ten to the left hand, / seven to both hands, and three to each foot.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śaucaṃ vidhāyātha gaṇḍūṣāndvādaśaiva tu /
kṛtvā vanaspatiṃ cātha prārthayenmanunāmunā //
meaning:
एवं शौचं विधायाथ गण्डूषान्द्वादशैव तु /
कृत्वा वनस्पतिं चाथ प्रार्थयेन्मनुनामुना //
text_mt: Having thus performed purification and then made twelve mouthfuls [of water for rinsing], / one should then pray to the tree with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca /
śriyaṃ prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate //
meaning:
आयुर्बलं यशो वर्चः प्रजाः पशुवसूनि च /
श्रियं प्रज्ञां च मेधां च त्वं नो देहि वनस्पते //
text_mt: “O lord of the forest, give us lifespan, strength, renown, radiance, offspring, / cattle, wealth, prosperity, wisdom, and retentive intellect.”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprārthyaivaṃ dantakāṣṭaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitam /
gṛhītvā kāmamantreṇa kuryānmantrī samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
संप्रार्थ्यैवं दन्तकाष्टं द्वादशाङ्गुलसंमितम् /
गृहीत्वा काममन्त्रेण कुर्यान्मन्त्री समाहितः //
text_mt: Having thus prayed and taken a tooth-stick measuring twelve finger-breadths, / the practitioner of mantras, composed in mind, should brush with the Kāma mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadevapadaṃ ṅentaṃ tathā sarvajanapriyam /
hṛdantaḥ kāmabījāḍhyaṃ dantāṃścānena śodhayet //
meaning:
कामदेवपदं ङेन्तं तथा सर्वजनप्रियम् /
हृदन्तः कामबीजाढ्यं दन्तांश्चानेन शोधयेत् //
text_mt: With the word “Kāmadeva” in the dative, followed by “beloved of all people”, / ending in namaḥ and enriched with the Kāma seed-syllable, one should cleanse the teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
jihvollekho vāgbhavena mūlena kṣālayenmukham /
devāgāraṃ tato gatvā nirmālyamapasārya ca //
meaning:
जिह्वोल्लेखो वाग्भवेन मूलेन क्षालयेन्मुखम् /
देवागारं ततो गत्वा निर्माल्यमपसार्य च //
text_mt: Scraping of the tongue is done with the Vāgbhava seed-syllable, and one should wash the mouth with the root mantra. / Then, going to the temple and removing the faded flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
paridhāyāṃbaraṃ śuddhaṃ maṅgalārārtikaṃ caret /
asreṇa pātraṃ saṃprokṣya mūlena jvālayeñca tam //
meaning:
परिधायांबरं शुद्धं मङ्गलारार्तिकं चरेत् /
अस्रेण पात्रं संप्रोक्ष्य मूलेन ज्वालयेञ्च तम् //
text_mt: and putting on clean clothes, one should perform the auspicious waving of lights. / Having sprinkled the vessel with the Astra mantra, one should kindle it with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya pātramādāyotthāya ghaṇṭāṃ ca vādayet /
sugoghṛtapradīpena bhrāmitena samantataḥ //
meaning:
संपूज्य पात्रमादायोत्थाय घण्टां च वादयेत् /
सुगोघृतप्रदीपेन भ्रामितेन समन्ततः //
text_mt: Having worshipped the vessel, taken it up, and stood, one should ring the bell; / with a lamp of good cow's ghee waved all around,

sanskrit_iast:
vādyairgītairmanojñaiśca devasyārārtikaṃ bhavet /
iti nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā prārthayitvā nijeśvaram //
meaning:
वाद्यैर्गीतैर्मनोज्ञैश्च देवस्यारार्तिकं भवेत् /
इति नीराजनं कृत्वा प्रार्थयित्वा निजेश्वरम् //
text_mt: accompanied by charming instruments and songs, the waving of lights to the deity should take place. / Having thus performed the waving of lamps and prayed to one's own Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
snātuṃ yāyānnimragādau kīrtayandevatāguṇān /
gatvā tīrthaṃ namaskṛtya snānīyaṃ ca nidhāya vai //
meaning:
स्नातुं यायान्निम्रगादौ कीर्तयन्देवतागुणान् /
गत्वा तीर्थं नमस्कृत्य स्नानीयं च निधाय वै //
text_mt: one should go to a river or the like to bathe, praising the attributes of the deity. / Having reached the sacred ford, bowed down, and set aside the bathing attire,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlābhimantritamṛdamādāya kaṭideśataḥ /
vilipyapādaparyantaṃ kṣālayettīrthavāriṇā //
meaning:
मूलाभिमन्त्रितमृदमादाय कटिदेशतः /
विलिप्यपादपर्यन्तं क्षालयेत्तीर्थवारिणा //
text_mt: taking clay consecrated with the root mantra, smearing it from the waist down / to the feet, one should wash with the water of the sacred ford.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca pañcabhiḥ pādau prakṣālyāntarjale punaḥ /
praviśya nābhimātre tu mṛdaṃ vāmakarasya ca //
meaning:
ततश्च पञ्चभिः पादौ प्रक्षाल्यान्तर्जले पुनः /
प्रविश्य नाभिमात्रे तु मृदं वामकरस्य च //
text_mt: Then, having washed the feet with five applications, entering into the water again / up to the navel, [placing] clay on the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇibandhe hastatale tadagre ca tathā punaḥ /
kṛtvāṅgulyā gāṅgamṛgamādāyāstreṇa tatpunaḥ //
meaning:
मणिबन्धे हस्ततले तदग्रे च तथा पुनः /
कृत्वाङ्गुल्या गाङ्गमृगमादायास्त्रेण तत्पुनः //
text_mt: on the wrist, on the palm, and at its tip, / and having again taken clay from the Gaṅgā with a finger, with the Astra mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
nijopari ca mantrajño bhrāmayitvā tyajetsudhī /
talasthāṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgeṣu tanmantraiḥ pravilepayet //
meaning:
निजोपरि च मन्त्रज्ञो भ्रामयित्वा त्यजेत्सुधी /
तलस्थां च षडङ्गेषु तन्मन्त्रैः प्रविलेपयेत् //
text_mt: the wise practitioner, knowing the mantra, should wave it over himself and cast it away. / With their respective mantras, he should smear the clay in his palm onto the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
nimajya kṣālayetsamyag malasnānamitīritam /
vibhāvyeṣṭamayaṃ sarvamāntaraṃ snānamācaret //
meaning:
निमज्य क्षालयेत्सम्यग् मलस्नानमितीरितम् /
विभाव्येष्टमयं सर्वमान्तरं स्नानमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Dipping in, he should wash thoroughly; this is called the bath for physical purification. / Imagining all to be composed of the chosen deity, he should perform the internal bath.

sanskrit_iast:
anantā dityasaṃkāśaṃ nijabhūṣāyudhairyutam /
mantramūrtiṃ prabhuṃ smṛtvā tatpādodakasaṃbhavām //
meaning:
अनन्ता दित्यसंकाशं निजभूषायुधैर्युतम् /
मन्त्रमूर्तिं प्रभुं स्मृत्वा तत्पादोदकसंभवाम् //
text_mt: Remembering the Lord whose form is mantra, resplendent like endless suns, / equipped with his ornaments and weapons, and remembering the stream arising from his foot-water,

sanskrit_iast:
dhārāṃ ca brahmarandhreṇa praviśantīṃ nijāṃ tanum /
tayā saṃkṣālayetsarvamantarddehagataṃ malam //
meaning:
धारां च ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण प्रविशन्तीं निजां तनुम् /
तया संक्षालयेत्सर्वमन्तर्द्देहगतं मलम् //
text_mt: entering one's body through the aperture of Brahmā, / with that one should cleanse all the impurity located within the body.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇādvirajā mantrī jāyate sphaṭikopamaḥ /
tataḥ śrautoktavidhinā snātvā mantrī samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्क्षणाद्विरजा मन्त्री जायते स्फटिकोपमः /
ततः श्रौतोक्तविधिना स्नात्वा मन्त्री समाहितः //
text_mt: From that moment, the practitioner becomes free of dust, resembling crystal. / Then, having bathed according to the rule declared in the Vedic scripture, the focused practitioner

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāttadvidhānamathocyate /
deśakālau ca saṃkīrtya prāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅgakaiḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्नानं ततः कुर्यात्तद्विधानमथोच्यते /
देशकालौ च संकीर्त्य प्राणायामषडङ्गकैः //
text_mt: should perform the mantra-bath; the procedure for that is now stated. / Having proclaimed the place and time, performing breath-control and the six limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvārkamaṇḍalāttīrthānyāhvayenmuṣṭimudrayā /
brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te raveḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वार्कमण्डलात्तीर्थान्याह्वयेन्मुष्टिमुद्रया /
ब्रह्माण्डोदरतीर्थानि करैः स्पृष्टानि ते रवेः //
text_mt: he should invoke the sacred fords from the solar orb with the fist-gesture: / “The sacred fords within the womb of the universe have been touched by the rays of you, the Sun;

sanskrit_iast: tena satyena me deva dehi tīrthaṃ divākara //
meaning: तेन सत्येन मे देव देहि तीर्थं दिवाकर //
text_mt: by that truth, O god, O maker of day, grant me the sacred ford!”

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati /
narmade siṃdhukāveri jale 'sminsaṃnidhiṃ kuru //
meaning:
गङ्गे च यमुने चैव गोदावरि सरस्वति /
नर्मदे सिंधुकावेरि जले ऽस्मिन्संनिधिं कुरु //
text_mt: “O Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Godāvarī, Sarasvatī, / Narmadā, Sindhu, and Kāverī, make your presence in this water!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityāvāhya jale tāni sudhābījena yojayet /
gomudrayāmṛtīkṛtya kavacenāvaguṇṭhya ca //
meaning:
इत्यावाह्य जले तानि सुधाबीजेन योजयेत् /
गोमुद्रयामृतीकृत्य कवचेनावगुण्ठ्य च //
text_mt: Having thus invoked them into the water, he should unite them with the nectar seed-syllable, / turn it into nectar with the cow-gesture, veil it with the Kavaca mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrakṣyāstreṇa tatpaścāccakramudrāṃ pradarśayet /
vahnyarkendumaṇḍalāni tatra saṃcitayedrudhaḥ //
meaning:
संरक्ष्यास्त्रेण तत्पश्चाच्चक्रमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् /
वह्न्यर्केन्दुमण्डलानि तत्र संचितयेद्रुधः //
text_mt: protect it with the Astra mantra, and then display the discus-gesture. / The wise man should contemplate there the orbs of fire, the sun, and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrayedarkamantreṇa sudhābījena tajjalam /
mūlena caikādaśadhā tatra saṃmantrya bhāvayet //
meaning:
मन्त्रयेदर्कमन्त्रेण सुधाबीजेन तज्जलम् /
मूलेन चैकादशधा तत्र संमन्त्र्य भावयेत् //
text_mt: He should consecrate that water with the solar mantra and the nectar seed-syllable; / and having consecrated it there eleven times with the root mantra, he should visualize

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāyantraṃ ca tanmadhye svāntādāvāhya devatām /
snāpayitvārcayettāṃ ca mānasairupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
पूजायन्त्रं च तन्मध्ये स्वान्तादावाह्य देवताम् /
स्नापयित्वार्चयेत्तां च मानसैरुपचारकैः //
text_mt: the worship-yantra, and in its center, having invoked the deity from within himself, / he should bathe and worship the deity with mental offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsanasthāṃ tāṃ natvā tajjalaṃ praṇametsudhīḥ /
ādhāraḥ sarvabhātānāṃ viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ //
meaning:
सिंहासनस्थां तां नत्वा तज्जलं प्रणमेत्सुधीः /
आधारः सर्वभातानां विष्णोरतुलतेजसः //
text_mt: Having bowed to the deity seated on the throne, the wise one should bow to that water: / “The support of all beings, belonging to Viṣṇu of peerless brilliance,

sanskrit_iast:
tadrūpāśca tato jātā āpastāḥ praṇamāmyaham /
iti natvā samārundhya saptacchidrāṇi sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
तद्रूपाश्च ततो जाता आपस्ताः प्रणमाम्यहम् /
इति नत्वा समारुन्ध्य सप्तच्छिद्राणि साधकः //
text_mt: and embodying him, born from him—to those waters I bow.” / Having thus bowed and closed the seven orifices, the practitioner,

sanskrit_iast:
nimajya salile tasminmūlaṃ devākṛtiṃ smaret /
nimajjyonmajjya triścaivaṃ siṃcetkaṃ kuṃbhamudrayā //
meaning:
निमज्य सलिले तस्मिन्मूलं देवाकृतिं स्मरेत् /
निमज्ज्योन्मज्ज्य त्रिश्चैवं सिंचेत्कं कुंभमुद्रया //
text_mt: submerging in that water, should remember the root mantra and the deity's form. / Having submerged and surfaced three times, he should sprinkle water on his head with the pot-gesture.

sanskrit_iast:
trirmūlena caturmantrairabhiṣiñcennijāṃ tanum /
catvāro manavaste 'tra kathyante tāntrikā mune //
meaning:
त्रिर्मूलेन चतुर्मन्त्रैरभिषिञ्चेन्निजां तनुम् /
चत्वारो मनवस्ते ऽत्र कथ्यन्ते तान्त्रिका मुने //
text_mt: Three times with the root mantra, and with four mantras he should consecrate his body. / Those four Tantric mantras, O sage, are stated here:

sanskrit_iast:
sisṛkṣornikhilaṃ viśvaṃ muhuḥ śukraṃ prajāpateḥ /
mātaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmāpo devyaḥ punantu mām //
meaning:
सिसृक्षोर्निखिलं विश्वं मुहुः शुक्रं प्रजापतेः /
मातरः सर्वभूतानामापो देव्यः पुनन्तु माम् //
text_mt: “The waters, repeatedly the semen of Prajāpati who desired to create the whole universe, / the mothers of all beings, the divine waters—may they purify me.

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣmīrmalarūpā yā sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitā /
kṣālayanti ca tāṃ sparśādāpo devyaḥ punantu mām //
meaning:
अलक्ष्मीर्मलरूपा या सर्वभूतेषु संस्थिता /
क्षालयन्ति च तां स्पर्शादापो देव्यः पुनन्तु माम् //
text_mt: The misfortune, in the form of filth, which resides in all beings, / and which they wash away by their touch—may the divine waters purify me.

sanskrit_iast:
yanme keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmante yañca mūrddhani /
lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastaddhantu vo namaḥ //
meaning:
यन्मे केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमन्ते यञ्च मूर्द्धनि /
ललाटे कर्णयोरक्ष्णोरापस्तद्धन्तु वो नमः //
text_mt: Whatever ill-fortune is in my hair, in the parting of my hair, and on my head, / on the forehead, the two ears, and the two eyes—may the waters destroy that! Salutations to you.

sanskrit_iast:
āyurārogyamaiśvaryamaripakṣakṣayaṃ śubham /
santoṣaḥ kṣāntirāstikyaṃ vidyā bhavatu vo namaḥ //
meaning:
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यमरिपक्षक्षयं शुभम् /
सन्तोषः क्षान्तिरास्तिक्यं विद्या भवतु वो नमः //
text_mt: May longevity, health, sovereignty, destruction of the side of enemies, welfare, / contentment, forbearance, faith, and knowledge be mine! Salutations to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
viprapādodakaṃ pītvā śālagrāmaśilājalam /
pibeddhiruddhaṃ no kuryādeṣāṃ tu niyato vidhiḥ //
meaning:
विप्रपादोदकं पीत्वा शालग्रामशिलाजलम् /
पिबेद्धिरुद्धं नो कुर्यादेषां तु नियतो विधिः //
text_mt: Having sipped the foot-washing water of a brāhmaṇa, he should drink the water of a śālagrāma stone; / he should not act contrary to this, for this is their fixed rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni dakṣāṅghrau tāni bhūsure /
sveṣṭadevaṃ samudvāsya mantrī mārtaṇḍamaṇḍale //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि दक्षाङ्घ्रौ तानि भूसुरे /
स्वेष्टदेवं समुद्वास्य मन्त्री मार्तण्डमण्डले //
text_mt: Whatever sacred fords there are on the earth are located in the right foot of a brāhmaṇa. / Having dismissed his chosen deity into the orb of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastīraṃ samāgatyaṃ vastraṃ saṃkṣālya yatnataḥ /
vāsasī paridhāyātha kuryātsandhyādikaṃ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तीरं समागत्यं वस्त्रं संक्षाल्य यत्नतः /
वाससी परिधायाथ कुर्यात्सन्ध्यादिकं सुधीः //
text_mt: the wise one, having then come to the riverbank and carefully washed his cloth, / and put on two garments, should perform the twilight ritual and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
rogādyaśakto manujaḥ kuryāttatrāgharmaṣaṇam /
athavā bhasmanā snāto rajobhiścaiva vākṣamaḥ //
meaning:
रोगाद्यशक्तो मनुजः कुर्यात्तत्राघर्मषणम् /
अथवा भस्मना स्नातो रजोभिश्चैव वाक्षमः //
text_mt: A person incapable due to disease or other reasons should perform the sin-effacing ritual there; / or, if incapable, having bathed with ashes or with dust.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sandhyādikaṃ kuryān sthitvā caivāsane śubhe /
keśavena tathā nārāyaṇena mādhavena ca //
meaning:
अथ सन्ध्यादिकं कुर्यान् स्थित्वा चैवासने शुभे /
केशवेन तथा नारायणेन माधवेन च //
text_mt: Now he should perform the twilight ritual and other rites, seated on an auspicious seat. / With the names Keśava, Nārāyaṇa, and Mādhava,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāśya toyaṃ govindaviṣṇubhyāṃ kṣālayetkarau /
madhusūdanatrivikramābhyāmoṣṭhau ca mārjayet //
meaning:
संप्राश्य तोयं गोविन्दविष्णुभ्यां क्षालयेत्करौ /
मधुसूदनत्रिविक्रमाभ्यामोष्ठौ च मार्जयेत् //
text_mt: having sipped water, he should wash both hands with Govinda and Viṣṇu; / he should wipe both lips with Madhusūdana and Trivikrama;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanaśrīdharābhyāṃ ca mukhaṃ hastau spṛśettataḥ /
hṛṣīkeśapadmanābhābhyāṃ spṛśeñcaraṇau tataḥ //
meaning:
वामनश्रीधराभ्यां च मुखं हस्तौ स्पृशेत्ततः /
हृषीकेशपद्मनाभाभ्यां स्पृशेञ्चरणौ ततः //
text_mt: with Vāmana and Śrīdhara he should then touch the face and both hands; / with Hṛṣīkeśa and Padmanābha he should then touch both feet;

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodareṇa mūrddhānaṃ mukhaṃ saṃkarṣaṇena ca /
vāsudevena pradyumnena spṛśennāsike tataḥ //
meaning:
दामोदरेण मूर्द्धानं मुखं संकर्षणेन च /
वासुदेवेन प्रद्युम्नेन स्पृशेन्नासिके ततः //
text_mt: with Dāmodara the head, with Saṃkarṣaṇa the mouth, / and with Vāsudeva and Pradyumna he should then touch both nostrils;

sanskrit_iast:
aniruddhapuruṣottamābhyāṃ netre spṛśettataḥ /
adhokṣajanṛsiṃhābhyāṃ śravaṇe saṃspṛśettathā //
meaning:
अनिरुद्धपुरुषोत्तमाभ्यां नेत्रे स्पृशेत्ततः /
अधोक्षजनृसिंहाभ्यां श्रवणे संस्पृशेत्तथा //
text_mt: with Aniruddha and Puruṣottama he should then touch both eyes; / with Adhokṣaja and Nṛsiṃha he should touch both ears;

sanskrit_iast:
nābhiṃ spṛśedacyutena janārdanena vakṣasi /
hariṇā viṣṇunāṃsau ca vaiṣṇavācamanaṃ tvidam //
meaning:
नाभिं स्पृशेदच्युतेन जनार्दनेन वक्षसि /
हरिणा विष्णुनांसौ च वैष्णवाचमनं त्विदम् //
text_mt: he should touch the navel with Acyuta, the chest with Janārdana, / and both shoulders with Hari and Viṣṇu. This is the Vaiṣṇava sipping of water.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādyairṅentasvāhāntaiḥ keśavādikanāmabhiḥ /
mukhe nasoḥ pradeśinyānāmayā netrakarṇayoḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवाद्यैर्ङेन्तस्वाहान्तैः केशवादिकनामभिः /
मुखे नसोः प्रदेशिन्यानामया नेत्रकर्णयोः //
text_mt: Beginning with Oṃ, in the dative case and ending with svāhā, with the names beginning with Keśava: / [he touches] the mouth and nostrils with the forefinger, and both eyes and ears with the ring-finger,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhayā nābhideśaṃ sarvatrāṅguṣṭyojanam /
ātmavidyāśivaistattvaiḥ svāhāntaiḥ śaivamīritam //
meaning:
कनिष्ठया नाभिदेशं सर्वत्राङ्गुष्ट्योजनम् /
आत्मविद्याशिवैस्तत्त्वैः स्वाहान्तैः शैवमीरितम् //
text_mt: the navel-region with the little finger, joining the thumb everywhere. / The Śaiva [sipping] is stated to be with the principles of self, knowledge, and Śiva, ending with svāhā.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghatrayenduyugvyomapūrvakaiśca pibejjalam /
ātmavidyāsivaireva śaivaṃ svāhāvasānikaiḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घत्रयेन्दुयुग्व्योमपूर्वकैश्च पिबेज्जलम् /
आत्मविद्यासिवैरेव शैवं स्वाहावसानिकैः //
text_mt: Preceded by the three long [vowels], the moon, the pair, and space, one should drink water; / the Śaiva [sipping] is done with the principles of self, knowledge, and Śiva, ending in svāhā.

sanskrit_iast:
vāglajjāśrī mukhaiḥ proktaṃ śāktaṃ svāhāvasānikaiḥ /
vāglajjāśrīmukhaiḥ proktaṃ dvijācamanamarthadam //
meaning:
वाग्लज्जाश्री मुखैः प्रोक्तं शाक्तं स्वाहावसानिकैः /
वाग्लज्जाश्रीमुखैः प्रोक्तं द्विजाचमनमर्थदम् //
text_mt: The Śākta [sipping] is taught as having the seed-syllables of speech, shame, and prosperity at the beginning, ending in svāhā. / The sipping of twice-borns, beginning with speech, shame, and prosperity, is taught to bestow benefit.

sanskrit_iast:
tilakaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādbhāle suṣṭhu gadākṛti /
nandakaṃ hṛdaye śaṅkhacakre caiva bhujadvaye //
meaning:
तिलकं च ततः कुर्याद्भाले सुष्ठु गदाकृति /
नन्दकं हृदये शङ्खचक्रे चैव भुजद्वये //
text_mt: Then he should make a tilaka on his forehead, beautifully shaped like a mace, / the Nandaka [sword] on the heart, and the conch and discus on the two arms;

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgabāṇaṃ mastake ca vinyasetkramaśaḥ sudhīḥ /
karṇamūle pārśvayośca pṛṣṭe nābhau kakudyapi //
meaning:
शार्ङ्गबाणं मस्तके च विन्यसेत्क्रमशः सुधीः /
कर्णमूले पार्श्वयोश्च पृष्टे नाभौ ककुद्यपि //
text_mt: The wise man should systematically place the bow Śārṅga and arrow on the head, / at the base of the ears, on the sides, on the back, on the navel, and on the nape of the neck.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaḥ kuryānmṛdbhistīrthodbhavādibhiḥ /
agnihotrodbhavaṃ bhasma gṛhītvā tryaṃbakeṇa tu //
meaning:
एवं तु वैष्णवः कुर्यान्मृद्भिस्तीर्थोद्भवादिभिः /
अग्निहोत्रोद्भवं भस्म गृहीत्वा त्र्यंबकेण तु //
text_mt: Thus indeed the Vaiṣṇava should perform [it] with clay originating from sacred fords and the like. / But taking ash produced from the agnihotra fire, with the Tryambaka [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃvāgniriti mantreṇābhimantrya pañcamantrakaiḥ /
kramāttatpuruṣāghorasadyojātādināmabhiḥ //
meaning:
किंवाग्निरिति मन्त्रेणाभिमन्त्र्य पञ्चमन्त्रकैः /
क्रमात्तत्पुरुषाघोरसद्योजातादिनामभिः //
text_mt: Or having consecrated [it] with the mantra 'agniriti…' along with the five mantras / in order with the names of Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Sadyojāta, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
pañca kuryātripuṇḍrāṇi bhālāṃsodarahṛtsu ca /
śaivaṃ śāktastrikoṇā bhaṃ nārīvadvā samācaret //
meaning:
पञ्च कुर्यात्रिपुण्ड्राणि भालांसोदरहृत्सु च /
शैवं शाक्तस्त्रिकोणा भं नारीवद्वा समाचरेत् //
text_mt: He should make five tripuṇḍras on the forehead, shoulders, belly, and heart. / The Śaiva [does so, while] the Śākta should perform [it] resembling a triangle or like a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu vaidikīṃ saṃdhyāṃ tāntrikīṃ ca samācaret /
ācamya vidhivanmantrī tīrthānyāvāhya pūrvavat //
meaning:
कृत्वा तु वैदिकीं संध्यां तान्त्रिकीं च समाचरेत् /
आचम्य विधिवन्मन्त्री तीर्थान्यावाह्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: Having performed the Vedic twilight worship, he should perform the Tantric one. / Having sipped water according to rule, the practitioner of mantras, invoking the sacred fords as before,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastrivāraṃ darbheṇa bhūmau toyaṃ viniḥbhipet /
saptadhā tajjalenātha mūrddhānamabhiṣecayet //
meaning:
ततस्त्रिवारं दर्भेण भूमौ तोयं विनिःभिपेत् /
सप्तधा तज्जलेनाथ मूर्द्धानमभिषेचयेत् //
text_mt: Should then cast water three times onto the ground with darbha grass. / Then he should sprinkle his head seven times with that water.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca prāṇānāyamya kṛtvā nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam /
ādāya vāmahasteṃ'bu dakṣeṇācchādya pāṇinā //
meaning:
ततश्च प्राणानायम्य कृत्वा न्यासं षडङ्गकम् /
आदाय वामहस्तेंऽबु दक्षेणाच्छाद्य पाणिना //
text_mt: And then, having restrained his breath and performed the ritual placement of the six limbs, / taking water in his left hand and covering it with the right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
viyadvāyvagnitoyakṣmābījaiḥ saṃmantrya mantravit /
mūlena tasmāt ścotadbhirbindubhistattvamudrayā //
meaning:
वियद्वाय्वग्नितोयक्ष्माबीजैः संमन्त्र्य मन्त्रवित् /
मूलेन तस्मात् श्चोतद्भिर्बिन्दुभिस्तत्त्वमुद्रया //
text_mt: The knower of mantras, consecrating it with the seed-syllables of ether, wind, fire, water, and earth, / with the root-mantra, with the drops trickling from it, through the tattva-mudrā,

sanskrit_iast:
svaśiraḥ saptadhā prokṣyāvaśiṣṭaṃ tatpunarjalam /
kṛtvā tadakṣaraṃ mantrī nāsikāntikamānayet //
meaning:
स्वशिरः सप्तधा प्रोक्ष्यावशिष्टं तत्पुनर्जलम् /
कृत्वा तदक्षरं मन्त्री नासिकान्तिकमानयेत् //
text_mt: Having sprinkled his head seven times, bringing that remaining water, / having made it into that syllable, the practitioner of mantras should bring it near his nose.

sanskrit_iast:
jalaṃ tejomayaṃ tañcākṛṣyāntaśceḍayā punaḥ /
prakṣālyāntargataṃ tena kalmaṣaṃ tajjalaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
जलं तेजोमयं तञ्चाकृष्यान्तश्चेडया पुनः /
प्रक्षाल्यान्तर्गतं तेन कल्मषं तज्जलं पुनः //
text_mt: And drawing inward that water consisting of light through the iḍā [nāḍī], / washing away the inner impurity with it, that water again,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ piṅgalayā recayetsvāgratastathā /
kṣipedastreṇa tatpaścātkalpite kuliśopale //
meaning:
कृष्णवर्णं पिङ्गलया रेचयेत्स्वाग्रतस्तथा /
क्षिपेदस्त्रेण तत्पश्चात्कल्पिते कुलिशोपले //
text_mt: Turned black in color, he should expel through the piṅgalā [nāḍī] in front of himself; / then, with the astra [mantra], he should cast it onto an imagined diamond-slab.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhvi sarvapāpaghnaṃ proktaṃ caivāghamarṣaṇam /
tataśca hastau prakṣālya prāgvadācamya mantravit //
meaning:
एतद्ध्वि सर्वपापघ्नं प्रोक्तं चैवाघमर्षणम् /
ततश्च हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य प्राग्वदाचम्य मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: For this is proclaimed as the sin-effacing ritual called aghamarṣaṇa. / And then, having washed both hands and sipped water as before, the knower of mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
samutthāya ca mantrajñastāmrapātre sumādikam /
prakṣipyārghaṃ pradadyādvai mūlāntairmantramuccaran //
meaning:
समुत्थाय च मन्त्रज्ञस्ताम्रपात्रे सुमादिकम् /
प्रक्षिप्यार्घं प्रदद्याद्वै मूलान्तैर्मन्त्रमुच्चरन् //
text_mt: Standing up, the knower of mantras, having placed flowers and the like in a copper vessel, / should indeed offer the arghya, uttering the mantra ending with the root-syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
ravimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya devāyārghyaṃ prakalpayet /
dattvārghaṃ triranenātha devaṃ ravigataṃ smaret //
meaning:
रविमण्डलसंस्थाय देवायार्घ्यं प्रकल्पयेत् /
दत्त्वार्घं त्रिरनेनाथ देवं रविगतं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: He should prepare the arghya for the deity residing in the orb of the sun. / Having offered the arghya three times with this, he should then remember the deity situated in the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
svakalpoktāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
aṣṭāṃviṃśativāraṃ vā guhyetimanunārpayet //
meaning:
स्वकल्पोक्तां च गायत्रीं जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
अष्टांविंशतिवारं वा गुह्येतिमनुनार्पयेत् //
text_mt: And he should recite the gāyatrī taught in his own ritual manual one hundred and eight times, / or twenty-eight times, and dedicate it with the secret mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
udyadādityasaṃkāśāṃ pustakākṣakarāṃbujām /
kṛṣṇājināṃbarāṃ brāhmīṃ dhyāyettārāṅkite 'mbare //
meaning:
उद्यदादित्यसंकाशां पुस्तकाक्षकरांबुजाम् /
कृष्णाजिनांबरां ब्राह्मीं ध्यायेत्ताराङ्किते ऽम्बरे //
text_mt: Resembling the rising sun, with book and rosary in her lotus-hands, / clad in a black antelope skin, he should meditate on the Brāhmī in the sky marked with stars.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne varadāṃ devīṃ pārvatīṃ saṃsmaretparām /
śuklāṃbarāṃ vṛṣārūḍhāṃ trinetrāṃ ravibiṃbagām //
meaning:
मध्याह्ने वरदां देवीं पार्वतीं संस्मरेत्पराम् /
शुक्लांबरां वृषारूढां त्रिनेत्रां रविबिंबगाम् //
text_mt: At midday, he should remember the supreme goddess Pārvatī, the granter of boons, / dressed in white garments, mounted on a bull, three-eyed, situated in the orb of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca dadhānāṃ nṛkaroṭikām /
sāyāhne ratnabhūṣāḍhyāṃ pītakauśeyavāsasām //
meaning:
वरं पाशं च शूलं च दधानां नृकरोटिकाम् /
सायाह्ने रत्नभूषाढ्यां पीतकौशेयवाससाम् //
text_mt: Holding a boon, a noose, a trident, and a human skull. / In the evening, richly adorned with jewels, clad in yellow silk,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmaraṅgāṃ caturhastāṃ śaṅkhacakralasatkarām /
gadāpadmadharāṃ devīṃ sūryāsanakṛtāśrayām //
meaning:
श्यामरङ्गां चतुर्हस्तां शङ्खचक्रलसत्कराम् /
गदापद्मधरां देवीं सूर्यासनकृताश्रयाम् //
text_mt: Dark-complexioned, four-armed, with hands shining with conch and discus, / bearing a mace and a lotus, the goddess who has taken her seat upon the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devānṛṣīṃścaiva pitṝṃścāpi vidhānavit /
tarpayitvā sveṣṭadevaṃ tarpayetkalpamārgataḥ //
meaning:
ततो देवानृषींश्चैव पितॄंश्चापि विधानवित् /
तर्पयित्वा स्वेष्टदेवं तर्पयेत्कल्पमार्गतः //
text_mt: Then, having offered libations to the gods, the sages, and the ancestors, the knower of ritual / should offer libations to his chosen deity according to the path of the manual.

sanskrit_iast:
gurupaṅktiṃ ca saṃtarpyaṃ sāṃgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ tathā /
sāyudhaṃ vainateyaṃ saṃtarpayāmīti tarpayet //
meaning:
गुरुपङ्क्तिं च संतर्प्यं सांगं सावरणं तथा /
सायुधं वैनतेयं संतर्पयामीति तर्पयेत् //
text_mt: And having offered libations to the lineage of gurus, along with the limbs, attendants, / and weapons, he should offer libation, saying: 'I offer libation to the son of Vinatā [Garuḍa].'

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaṃ parvataṃ jiṣṇuṃ niśaṭhoddhavadārukān /
viṣvaksena ca śaileyaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paritarpayet //
meaning:
नारदं पर्वतं जिष्णुं निशठोद्धवदारुकान् /
विष्वक्सेन च शैलेयं वैष्णवः परितर्पयेत् //
text_mt: To Nārada, Parvata, Jiṣṇu, Niśaṭha, Uddhava, and Dāruka, / to Viṣvaksena and Śaileya, the Vaiṣṇava should offer libations.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃtarpya viprendra dattvārdhyaṃ ca vivasvate /
pūjāgāraṃ samāgatya prakṣālyāṅghrī upaspṛśet //
meaning:
एवं संतर्प्य विप्रेन्द्र दत्त्वार्ध्यं च विवस्वते /
पूजागारं समागत्य प्रक्षाल्याङ्घ्री उपस्पृशेत् //
text_mt: Having offered libations thus, O best of brahmins, and having offered arghya to the sun, / having arrived at the worship-chamber, he should wash his feet and rinse his mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotrasthitānagnīn hutvopasthāya yatnataḥ /
pūjāsthalaṃ samāgatya dvārapūjāṃ samācaret //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रस्थितानग्नीन् हुत्वोपस्थाय यत्नतः /
पूजास्थलं समागत्य द्वारपूजां समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having made oblations into the fires situated in the agnihotra and having attended to them with care, / having gone to the place of worship, he should perform the worship of the doorway:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ corddhvaśākhāyāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ ca dakṣiṇe /
sarasvatīṃ vāmabhāge dakṣe vighneśvaraṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
गणेशं चोर्द्ध्वशाखायां महालक्ष्मीं च दक्षिणे /
सरस्वतीं वामभागे दक्षे विघ्नेश्वरं पुनः //
text_mt: Gaṇeśa on the upper lintel, and Mahālakṣmī on the right, / Sarasvatī on the left side, and Vighneśvara again on the right;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrapālaṃ tathā vāme dakṣe gaṅgāṃ prapūjayet /
vāme ca yamunāṃ dakṣe dhātāraṃ vāmatastathā //
meaning:
क्षेत्रपालं तथा वामे दक्षे गङ्गां प्रपूजयेत् /
वामे च यमुनां दक्षे धातारं वामतस्तथा //
text_mt: Likewise Kṣetrapāla on the left, Gaṅgā on the right he should worship, / Yamunā on the left, Dhātṛ on the right, and likewise on the left

sanskrit_iast:
vidhātāraṃ śaṅkhapadmanidhīṃśca vāmadakṣayoḥ /
dvārapālāṃstato 'bhyarcettattatkalpoditānsudhīḥ //
meaning:
विधातारं शङ्खपद्मनिधींश्च वामदक्षयोः /
द्वारपालांस्ततो ऽभ्यर्चेत्तत्तत्कल्पोदितान्सुधीः //
text_mt: Vidhātṛ, and the treasures Śaṅkha and Padma on the left and right; / then the wise man should worship the door-keepers declared in each respective manual:

sanskrit_iast:
nandaḥ sunandaścaṇḍaśca pracaṇḍaḥ pracalobalaḥ /
bhadraḥ subhadraścetyādyā vaiṣṇavā dvārapālakāḥ //
meaning:
नन्दः सुनन्दश्चण्डश्च प्रचण्डः प्रचलोबलः /
भद्रः सुभद्रश्चेत्याद्या वैष्णवा द्वारपालकाः //
text_mt: Nanda, Sunanda, Caṇḍa, Pracaṇḍa, Pracala, Bala, / Bhadra, and Subhadra, and so forth, are the Vaiṣṇava door-keepers;

sanskrit_iast:
nandī bhṛṅgī riṭī skando gaṇeśomāmaheśvarāḥ /
vṛṣabhaśca mahākālaḥ śaivā vai dvārapālakāḥ //
meaning:
नन्दी भृङ्गी रिटी स्कन्दो गणेशोमामहेश्वराः /
वृषभश्च महाकालः शैवा वै द्वारपालकाः //
text_mt: Nandī, Bhṛṅgī, Riṭi, Skanda, Gaṇeśa, Umā, Maheśvara, / Vṛṣabha, and Mahākāla are indeed the Śaiva door-keepers;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmayādyā mātaro 'ṣṭau tu śaktyo dvāḥsthitāḥ svayam /
seṃduḥ svanāmāgharṇādyā ṅenamoṃtā ime smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मयाद्या मातरो ऽष्टौ तु शक्त्यो द्वाःस्थिताः स्वयम् /
सेंदुः स्वनामाघर्णाद्या ङेनमोंता इमे स्मृताः //
text_mt: The eight mothers beginning with Brāhmī are the śaktis standing at the door itself; / they are remembered as having a bindu, preceded by the letters of their names, and ending with 'ṅe' [dative] and 'namaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sthitvāsane dhīmānācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ /
divyāntarikṣabhaumāṃśca vighnānutsārya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
ततः स्थित्वासने धीमानाचम्य प्रयतः शुचिः /
दिव्यान्तरिक्षभौमांश्च विघ्नानुत्सार्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: Then, sitting on the seat, wise, having sipped water, restrained and pure, / having carefully driven away obstacles of the sky, the atmosphere, and the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
keśavādyāṃ mātṛkāntu nyasedvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ /
keśavaḥ kīrtisaṃyuktaḥ kāntyā nārāyaṇastathā //
meaning:
केशवाद्यां मातृकान्तु न्यसेद्वैष्णवसत्तमः /
केशवः कीर्तिसंयुक्तः कान्त्या नारायणस्तथा //
text_mt: The best among Vaiṣṇavas should perform the ritual placement of the mātṛkā beginning with Keśava: / Keśava united with Kīrti; likewise Nārāyaṇa with Kānti;

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavastuṣṭisahito govindaḥ puṣṭisaṃyutaḥ /
viṣṇustu dhṛtisaṃyuktaḥ śāntiyuṅmadhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
माधवस्तुष्टिसहितो गोविन्दः पुष्टिसंयुतः /
विष्णुस्तु धृतिसंयुक्तः शान्तियुङ्मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Mādhava accompanied by Tuṣṭi; Govinda endowed with Puṣṭi; / Viṣṇu united with Dhṛti; Madhusūdana joined with Śānti;

sanskrit_iast:
trivikramaḥ kriyāyukto vāmano dayitāyutaḥ /
śrīdharo medhayā yukto hṛṣīkiśaśca harṣayā //
meaning:
त्रिविक्रमः क्रियायुक्तो वामनो दयितायुतः /
श्रीधरो मेधया युक्तो हृषीकिशश्च हर्षया //
text_mt: Trivikrama endowed with Kriyā; Vāmana accompanied by Dayā; / Śrīdhara united with Medhā; and Hṛṣīkeśa with Harṣā;

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābhayutā śraddhā lajjā dāmodarānvitā /
vāsudevaśca lakṣmīyuk saṃkarṣaṇasarasvatī //
meaning:
पद्मनाभयुता श्रद्धा लज्जा दामोदरान्विता /
वासुदेवश्च लक्ष्मीयुक् संकर्षणसरस्वती //
text_mt: Śraddhā associated with Padmanābha; Lajjā united with Dāmodara; / Vāsudeva endowed with Lakṣmī; Saṃkarṣaṇa with Sarasvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnaḥ prītisaṃyukto 'niruddho ratisaṃyutaḥ /
cakrī jayāyutaḥ paścādgadī durgāsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नः प्रीतिसंयुक्तो ऽनिरुद्धो रतिसंयुतः /
चक्री जयायुतः पश्चाद्गदी दुर्गासमन्वितः //
text_mt: Pradyumna united with Prīti; Aniruddha endowed with Rati; / Cakrin accompanied by Jayā; next, Gadin endowed with Durgā;

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgī tu prabhayā yuktaḥ khaḍgī yuktastu satyayā /
śaṅkhī caṇḍāsamāyukto halī vāṇīsamāyutaḥ //
meaning:
शार्ङ्गी तु प्रभया युक्तः खड्गी युक्तस्तु सत्यया /
शङ्खी चण्डासमायुक्तो हली वाणीसमायुतः //
text_mt: Śārṅgin united with Prabhā; Khaḍgin joined with Satī; / Śaṅkhin associated with Caṇḍā; Halin endowed with Vāṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
musalī ca bilāsinyā śūlī vijayayānvitaḥ /
pāśī virajayā yukto kuśī viśvāsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
मुसली च बिलासिन्या शूली विजययान्वितः /
पाशी विरजया युक्तो कुशी विश्वासमन्वितः //
text_mt: Musalin with Vilāsinī; Śūlin accompanied by Vijayā; / Pāśin united with Virajā; Aṅkuśin endowed with Viśvā;

sanskrit_iast:
mukundo vinatāyukto nandajaśca sunandayā /
nindī smṛtyā samāyukto naro vṛddhyā samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
मुकुन्दो विनतायुक्तो नन्दजश्च सुनन्दया /
निन्दी स्मृत्या समायुक्तो नरो वृद्ध्या समन्वितः //
text_mt: Mukunda joined with Vinatā; Nandaja with Sunandā; / Nandin united with Smṛti; Nara endowed with Vṛddhi;

sanskrit_iast:
samṛddhiyuṅnarakajicchuddhiyukca hariḥ smṛtaḥ /
kṛṣṇo buddhyā yutaḥ satyo bhuktyā muktyātha sātvataḥ //
meaning:
समृद्धियुङ्नरकजिच्छुद्धियुक्च हरिः स्मृतः /
कृष्णो बुद्ध्या युतः सत्यो भुक्त्या मुक्त्याथ सात्वतः //
text_mt: Narakajit joined with Samṛddhi; Hari is remembered as endowed with Śuddhi; / Kṛṣṇa joined with Buddhi; Satya with Bhukti; then Sātvata with Mukti;

sanskrit_iast:
saurikṣame sūrarame umāyukto janārdanaḥ /
bhūdharaḥ kledinīyukto viśvamūrtiśca klinnayā //
meaning:
सौरिक्षमे सूररमे उमायुक्तो जनार्दनः /
भूधरः क्लेदिनीयुक्तो विश्वमूर्तिश्च क्लिन्नया //
text_mt: Śauri with Kṣamā; Śūra with Ramā; Janārdana joined with Umā; / Bhūdhara united with Kledinī; Viśvamūrti with Klinnā;

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭho vasudhāyukto vasudaḥpuruṣottamaḥ /
balī tu parayā yukto balānujaparāyaṇe //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठो वसुधायुक्तो वसुदःपुरुषोत्तमः /
बली तु परया युक्तो बलानुजपरायणे //
text_mt: Vaikuṇṭha united with Vasudhā; Puruṣottama with Vasudā; / Balin united with Parā; Balānuja with Parāyaṇā;

sanskrit_iast:
bālasūkṣme vṛṣaghnastu saṃdhyāyuk prajñayā vṛṣaḥ /
haṃsaḥ prabhāsamāyukto varāho niśayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
बालसूक्ष्मे वृषघ्नस्तु संध्यायुक् प्रज्ञया वृषः /
हंसः प्रभासमायुक्तो वराहो निशया युतः //
text_mt: Bāla with Sūkṣmā; Vṛṣaghna joined with Saṃdhyā; Vṛṣa with Prajñā; / Haṃsa united with Prabhāsā; Varāha accompanied by Niśā;

sanskrit_iast:
vimalo dhārayā yukto nṛsiṃho vidyutā yutaḥ /
keśavādimātṛkāyā munirnārāyaṇo mataḥ //
meaning:
विमलो धारया युक्तो नृसिंहो विद्युता युतः /
केशवादिमातृकाया मुनिर्नारायणो मतः //
text_mt: Vimala united with Dhārā; Nṛsiṃha endowed with Vidyut. / The sage of the mātṛkā beginning with Keśava is considered to be Nārāyaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtādyā ca gāyatrī chando viṣṇuśca devatā /
cakrādyāyudhasaṃyuktaṃ kuṃbhādarśadharaṃ harim //
meaning:
अमृताद्या च गायत्री छन्दो विष्णुश्च देवता /
चक्राद्यायुधसंयुक्तं कुंभादर्शधरं हरिम् //
text_mt: The metre is the Gāyatrī beginning with Amṛtā; and Viṣṇu is the deity. / Hari, equipped with weapons such as the discus, holding a water-jar and a mirror,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīyutaṃ vidyudābhaṃ bahubhūṣāyutaṃ bhajet /
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasecchaktiṃ śrīkāmapuṭitākṣaram //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीयुतं विद्युदाभं बहुभूषायुतं भजेत् /
एवं ध्यात्वा न्यसेच्छक्तिं श्रीकामपुटिताक्षरम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Lakṣmī, radiant as lightning, adorned with many ornaments, one should worship; / having thus meditated, he should place the śakti, whose syllables are enclosed by the seed-mantras of Śrī and Kāma.

sanskrit_iast:
vadettadviṣṇuśaktibhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ praṇavādikam /
tvagaṃsṛṅmāṃsamedo 'sthimajjāśukrāṇyasūnvadet //
meaning:
वदेत्तद्विष्णुशक्तिभ्यां हृदयं प्रणवादिकम् /
त्वगंसृङ्मांसमेदो ऽस्थिमज्जाशुक्राण्यसून्वदेत् //
text_mt: One should utter the heart [mantra] preceded by the Praṇava, ending with 'to Viṣṇu and Śakti.' / One should say the skin, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow, semen, and the vital breaths,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇaṃ krodhaṃ tathā mabhyāmantānyādidaśasvapi /
eka maulau mukhe caika dvika netre dvikaṃ śrutau //
meaning:
प्राणं क्रोधं तथा मभ्यामन्तान्यादिदशस्वपि /
एक मौलौ मुखे चैक द्विक नेत्रे द्विकं श्रुतौ //
text_mt: the breath, and anger, ending with [the syllable] 'ma', in the first ten places. / One [syllable] on the crown, one on the face, two on the eyes, two on the ears,

sanskrit_iast:
nasordvayaṃ kapole ca dvayaṃ dve dviradacchade /
ekaṃ tu rasanāmūle grīvāyāmekameva ca //
meaning:
नसोर्द्वयं कपोले च द्वयं द्वे द्विरदच्छदे /
एकं तु रसनामूले ग्रीवायामेकमेव च //
text_mt: two on the nostrils, two on the cheeks, two on the lips, / one at the root of the tongue, and one on the neck,

sanskrit_iast:
kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau cavargaṃ vāmabāhuke /
ṭatavargauṃ pādayostu paphau kuṅkṣidvaye nyaset //
meaning:
कवर्गं दक्षिणे बाहौ चवर्गं वामबाहुके /
टतवर्गौं पादयोस्तु पफौ कुङ्क्षिद्वये न्यसेत् //
text_mt: the ka-group on the right arm, the ca-group on the left arm, / the ṭa- and ta-groups on the feet, and pa and pha on the two flanks one should place.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vamityuktaṃ nābhau bhaṃ hṛdaye tu mam /
yādisaptāpi dhātusthā haṃ prāṇe laṃ tathātmani //
meaning:
पृष्ठवंशे वमित्युक्तं नाभौ भं हृदये तु मम् /
यादिसप्तापि धातुस्था हं प्राणे लं तथात्मनि //
text_mt: 'Va' is spoken on the backbone, 'bha' on the navel, and 'ma' on the heart; / the seven beginning with 'ya' situated in the bodily elements, 'ha' on the vital breath, and 'la' on the self;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṃ krodhe kramato nyasya viṣṇu pūjākṣamo bhavet /
pūrṇodaryā tu śrīkaṇṭho hyananto vijarānvitaḥ //
meaning:
क्षं क्रोधे क्रमतो न्यस्य विष्णु पूजाक्षमो भवेत् /
पूर्णोदर्या तु श्रीकण्ठो ह्यनन्तो विजरान्वितः //
text_mt: placing 'kṣa' on anger in due order, one becomes fit to worship Viṣṇu. / Śrīkaṇṭha with Pūrṇodarī, and Ananta accompanied by Vijarā;

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmeśaḥ śālmalīyukto lolākṣīyuktrimātakaḥ /
maheśvaro vartulākṣyādhīṃśo vai dīrghaghoṇayā //
meaning:
सूक्ष्मेशः शाल्मलीयुक्तो लोलाक्षीयुक्त्रिमातकः /
महेश्वरो वर्तुलाक्ष्याधींशो वै दीर्घघोणया //
text_mt: Sūkṣmeśa united with Śālmalī, Trimātaka united with Lolākṣī; / Maheśvara with Vartulākṣī, and the supreme lord with Dīrghaghoṇā;

sanskrit_iast:
dirghamukhyā bhārabhūtistithīśo gomukhīyutaḥ /
sthāvareśo dirghajihvāyugdharaḥ kuḍodarīyutaḥ //
meaning:
दिर्घमुख्या भारभूतिस्तिथीशो गोमुखीयुतः /
स्थावरेशो दिर्घजिह्वायुग्धरः कुडोदरीयुतः //
text_mt: Bhārabhūti with Dīrghamukhī, Tithīśa accompanied by Gomukhī; / Sthāvareśa endowed with Dīrghajihvā, Kuṇḍodarī with Dhara;

sanskrit_iast:
urddhakeśyā tu jhiṇṭīśo bhautiko vikṛtāsyayā /
sadyo jvālāmukhīyuktolkāmukhyānugraho yutaḥ //
meaning:
उर्द्धकेश्या तु झिण्टीशो भौतिको विकृतास्यया /
सद्यो ज्वालामुखीयुक्तोल्कामुख्यानुग्रहो युतः //
text_mt: Jhiṇṭīśa with Ūrdhvakeśī, Bhautika with Vikṛtāsyā; / Sadyojāta with Jvālāmukhī, and Anugraha endowed with Ulkāmukhī;

sanskrit_iast:
akrūra āsyayā yukto mahāseno vidyayā yutaḥ /
krodhīśaścamahākālyā caṇḍeśena sarasvatī //
meaning:
अक्रूर आस्यया युक्तो महासेनो विद्यया युतः /
क्रोधीशश्चमहाकाल्या चण्डेशेन सरस्वती //
text_mt: Akrūra accompanied by Āsyā, Mahāsena endowed with Vidyā; / Krodhīśa with Mahākālī, and Sarasvatī with Caṇḍeśa;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāntakaḥ siddhagauryā yuktaścātha śirottamaḥ /
trailokyavidyayā yukto mantraśaktyaikarudrakaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चान्तकः सिद्धगौर्या युक्तश्चाथ शिरोत्तमः /
त्रैलोक्यविद्यया युक्तो मन्त्रशक्त्यैकरुद्रकः //
text_mt: Pañcāntaka joined with Siddhagaurī, and then Śirottama / accompanied by Trailokyavidyā, and Ekarudraka with Mantraśakti;

sanskrit_iast:
krūrmeśaḥ kamaṭhīyukto bhūtamātraikanetrakaḥ /
lambodaryā caturvakro hyajeśo drāviṇīyutaḥ //
meaning:
क्रूर्मेशः कमठीयुक्तो भूतमात्रैकनेत्रकः /
लम्बोदर्या चतुर्वक्रो ह्यजेशो द्राविणीयुतः //
text_mt: Kūrmeśa joined with Kamaṭhī, and Ekanetra who is Bhūtamātra; / Caturvaktra with Lambodarī, and Ajeśa accompanied by Drāviṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśo nāgarīyuktaḥ someśaḥ khecarīyutaḥ /
maryādayā lāṅgalīśo dārukeśena rūpiṇī //
meaning:
सर्वेशो नागरीयुक्तः सोमेशः खेचरीयुतः /
मर्यादया लाङ्गलीशो दारुकेशेन रूपिणी //
text_mt:
Sarveśa united with Nāgarī, Someśa with Khecarī,
Lāṅgalīśa according to rule, [and] Rūpiṇī with Dārukeśa;

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇyā tvarddhanārīśo umākānto gunīśvaraḥ /
kākodaryā tathāṣāḍhī pūtanāsaṃyukto mataḥ //
meaning:
वारुण्या त्वर्द्धनारीशो उमाकान्तो गुनीश्वरः /
काकोदर्या तथाषाढी पूतनासंयुक्तो मतः //
text_mt:
Ardhanārīśa with Vāruṇī, Umākānta the lord of Guṇas,
likewise Āṣāḍhī with Kākodarī, [and] Pūtanā considered united;

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍīśo bhadrakālīyutrīśo yoginīyutaḥ /
mīneśaḥ śaṅkhinīyukto meṣeśastarjayanīyutaḥ //
meaning:
दण्डीशो भद्रकालीयुत्रीशो योगिनीयुतः /
मीनेशः शङ्खिनीयुक्तो मेषेशस्तर्जयनीयुतः //
text_mt:
Daṇḍīśa united with Bhadrakālī, Śrīśa united with Yoginī,
Mīneśa united with Śaṅkhinī, Meṣeśa united with Tarjanī;

sanskrit_iast:
lohitaḥ kālarātryā ca śikhīśaḥ kujanīyutaḥ /
chalagaṇḍaḥ kapardinyā dviraṇḍeśaśca vajrayā //
meaning:
लोहितः कालरात्र्या च शिखीशः कुजनीयुतः /
छलगण्डः कपर्दिन्या द्विरण्डेशश्च वज्रया //
text_mt:
Lohita with Kālarātri, Śikhīśa united with Kujanī,
Chalagaṇḍa with Kapardinī, and Dviraṇḍeśa with Vajrā;

sanskrit_iast:
mahābalo jayāyukto balīśaḥ sumukheśvarī /
bhujaṅgo revatīyuktaḥ pinākī mādhavīyutaḥ //
meaning:
महाबलो जयायुक्तो बलीशः सुमुखेश्वरी /
भुजङ्गो रेवतीयुक्तः पिनाकी माधवीयुतः //
text_mt:
Mahābala united with Jayā, Balīśa [with] Sumukheśvarī,
Bhujaṅga united with Revatī, Pinākin united with Mādhavī;

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgīśo vāruṇīyukto bakeśo vāyavīyutaḥ /
śvetorasko vidāriṇyā bhṛguḥ sahajayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
खड्गीशो वारुणीयुक्तो बकेशो वायवीयुतः /
श्वेतोरस्को विदारिण्या भृगुः सहजया युतः //
text_mt:
Khaḍgīśa united with Vāruṇī, Bakeśa united with Vāyavī,
Śvetoraskas with Vidāriṇī, [and] Bhṛgu united with Sahajā;

sanskrit_iast:
lakulīśaśca lakṣmīyuk śiveśo vyāpinīyutaḥ /
saṃvartake mahāmāyā proktā śrīkaṇṭhamātṛkā //
meaning:
लकुलीशश्च लक्ष्मीयुक् शिवेशो व्यापिनीयुतः /
संवर्तके महामाया प्रोक्ता श्रीकण्ठमातृका //
text_mt:
Lakulīśa endowed with Lakṣmī, Śiveśa united with Vyāpinī,
and Mahāmāyā in Saṃvartaka: this is declared as the Śrīkaṇṭhamātṛkā.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra svīśapadaṃ noktaṃ tatra sarvatra yojayet /
muniḥsyāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgāyatrīchanda īritam //
meaning:
यत्र स्वीशपदं नोक्तं तत्र सर्वत्र योजयेत् /
मुनिःस्याद्दक्षिणामूर्तिर्गायत्रीछन्द ईरितम् //
text_mt:
Wherever one's own lordly word is not uttered, one should supply it everywhere.
Dakṣiṇāmūrti is the sage; the meter is said to be Gāyatrī;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā cārddhanārīśo viniyogo 'khilāptaye /
halo bījāni coktāni svarāḥ śaktaya īritāḥ //
meaning:
देवता चार्द्धनारीशो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
हलो बीजानि चोक्तानि स्वराः शक्तय ईरिताः //
text_mt:
the deity is Ardhanārīśa, the application is for the attainment of all [desires],
consonants are declared the seed-syllables, and vowels are said to be the energies.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādbhṛgusthākāśena ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena cāṅgakam /
bandhūkasvarṇavarṇāgaṃ varākṣāṅkuśapāśinam //
meaning:
कुर्याद्भृगुस्थाकाशेन षड्दीर्घाढ्येन चाङ्गकम् /
बन्धूकस्वर्णवर्णागं वराक्षाङ्कुशपाशिनम् //
text_mt:
One should perform the limbs with the space-syllable [ha] resting on Bhṛgu [sa], endowed with the six long [vowels].
[Meditation:] Having limbs colored like the bandhūka and gold, holding a boon, rosary, goad, and noose,

sanskrit_iast:
arddhenduśekharaṃ tryakṣaṃ devavandyaṃ vicintayet /
dhyātvaivaṃ śivaśaktīśca caturthī hṛdayāntim //
meaning:
अर्द्धेन्दुशेखरं त्र्यक्षं देववन्द्यं विचिन्तयेत् /
ध्यात्वैवं शिवशक्तीश्च चतुर्थी हृदयान्तिम् //
text_mt:
having the crescent moon as crest-ornament, three-eyed, praised by the gods—one should meditate [on him].
Having thus meditated on Śiva and the Śaktis, [using] the dative case ending with 'hṛdaya,'

sanskrit_iast:
saubījamātṛkāpūrve vinyasenmātṛkā sthale /
vighneśaśca hriyā yukto vighnarājaḥ śriyā yutaḥ //
meaning:
सौबीजमातृकापूर्वे विन्यसेन्मातृका स्थले /
विघ्नेशश्च ह्रिया युक्तो विघ्नराजः श्रिया युतः //
text_mt:
preceded by one's seed-syllable and mātṛkā, one should place them on the sites of the mātṛkā.
Vighneśa is united with Hrī, Vighnarāja is united with Śrī;

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakastathā puṣṭyā śāntiyuktaḥ śivottamaḥ /
vighnakṛtsvastisaṃyukto vighnahartā sarasvatī //
meaning:
विनायकस्तथा पुष्ट्या शान्तियुक्तः शिवोत्तमः /
विघ्नकृत्स्वस्तिसंयुक्तो विघ्नहर्ता सरस्वती //
text_mt:
Vināyaka likewise with Puṣṭi, Śivottama united with Śānti,
Vighnakṛt united with Svasti, Vighnahartṛ [with] Sarasvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
svāhayā gaṇanāthaśca ekadantaḥ sumedhayā /
kāntyā yukto dvidantastu kāminyā gajavakrakaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाहया गणनाथश्च एकदन्तः सुमेधया /
कान्त्या युक्तो द्विदन्तस्तु कामिन्या गजवक्रकः //
text_mt:
Gaṇanātha with Svāhā, Ekadanta with Sumedhā,
Dvidanta united with Kānti, Gajavaktra with Kāminī;

sanskrit_iast:
nirañjano mohinīyukkaparddītunaṭīyutaḥ /
dīrghajihvaḥ pārvatīyugjvālinyā śaṅkukarṇakaḥ //
meaning:
निरञ्जनो मोहिनीयुक्कपर्द्दीतुनटीयुतः /
दीर्घजिह्वः पार्वतीयुग्ज्वालिन्या शङ्कुकर्णकः //
text_mt:
Nirañjana united with Mohinī, Kapardin united with Naṭī,
Dīrghajihva united with Pārvatī, Śaṅkukarṇa with Jvālinī;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣadhvajo nandayā ca sureśyā gaṇanāyakaḥ /
gajendaḥ kāmarūpiṇyā śūrpakarṇastathomayā //
meaning:
वृषध्वजो नन्दया च सुरेश्या गणनायकः /
गजेन्दः कामरूपिण्या शूर्पकर्णस्तथोमया //
text_mt:
Vṛṣadhvaja with Nandā, Gaṇanāyaka with Sureśī,
Gajendra with Kāmarūpiṇī, Śūrpakarṇa likewise with Umā;

sanskrit_iast:
virocanastejovatyā satyā lambodareṇa ca /
mahānandaśca vighneśyā caturmūrtisvarūpiṇī //
meaning:
विरोचनस्तेजोवत्या सत्या लम्बोदरेण च /
महानन्दश्च विघ्नेश्या चतुर्मूर्तिस्वरूपिणी //
text_mt:
Virocana with Tejovatī, Satyā with Lambodara,
Mahānanda with Vighneśī, [the goddess] whose form comprises the four manifestations;

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaḥ kāmadayā hyāmodo madajihvayā /
dumukho bhūtisaṃyuktaḥ sumukho bhautikīyutaḥ //
meaning:
सदाशिवः कामदया ह्यामोदो मदजिह्वया /
दुमुखो भूतिसंयुक्तः सुमुखो भौतिकीयुतः //
text_mt:
Sadāśiva with Kāmadā, Āmoda with Madajihvā,
Durmukha united with Bhūti, Sumukha united with Bhautikī;

sanskrit_iast:
pramodadhaḥ sitayā yukta ekapādo ramāyutaḥ /
dvijihvo mahiṣīyukto jabhinyā śūranāmakaḥ //
meaning:
प्रमोदधः सितया युक्त एकपादो रमायुतः /
द्विजिह्वो महिषीयुक्तो जभिन्या शूरनामकः //
text_mt:
Pramodada united with Sitā, Ekapāda united with Ramā,
Dvijihva united with Mahiṣī, the one named Śūra with Jṛmbhiṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
vīro vikarṇayā yuktaḥ ṣaṇmukho bhṛkuṭīyutaḥ /
varado lajjayā vāmadevaṃśo dīrghaghoṇayā //
meaning:
वीरो विकर्णया युक्तः षण्मुखो भृकुटीयुतः /
वरदो लज्जया वामदेवंशो दीर्घघोणया //
text_mt:
Vīra united with Vikarṇā, Ṣaṇmukha united with Bhṛkuṭī,
Varada with Lajjā, Vāmadevāṃśa with Dīrghaghoṇā;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurddharyā vakratuḍo dviṃraṇḍo yāminīyutaḥ /
senānī rātrisaṃyuktaḥ kāmāndho grāmaṇīyutaḥ //
meaning:
धनुर्द्धर्या वक्रतुडो द्विंरण्डो यामिनीयुतः /
सेनानी रात्रिसंयुक्तः कामान्धो ग्रामणीयुतः //
text_mt:
Vakratuṇḍa with Dhanurdharī, Dviraṇḍa united with Yāminī,
Senānī united with Rātri, Kāmāndha united with Grāmaṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
mattaḥ śaśiprabhāyukto vimatto lolanetrayā /
mattavāhaścañcalayā jaṭī dīptisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
मत्तः शशिप्रभायुक्तो विमत्तो लोलनेत्रया /
मत्तवाहश्चञ्चलया जटी दीप्तिसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
Matta united with Śaśiprabhā, Vimatta with Lolanetrā,
Mattavāha with Cañcalā, Jaṭin endowed with Dīpti;

sanskrit_iast:
muṃhī subhagayā yuktaḥ khaḍgī durbhagayā yutaḥ /
vareṇyaśca śivāyukto bhagayā vṛṣaketanaḥ //
meaning:
मुंही सुभगया युक्तः खड्गी दुर्भगया युतः /
वरेण्यश्च शिवायुक्तो भगया वृषकेतनः //
text_mt:
Muṇḍin united with Subhagā, Khaḍgin united with Durbhagā,
Vareṇya united with Śivā, Vṛṣaketana with Bhagā;

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyapriyo bhaginyā ca gaṇeśo bhaginīyutaḥ /
meghanādaḥ subhagayā vyāpī syātkālarātriyuk //
meaning:
भक्ष्यप्रियो भगिन्या च गणेशो भगिनीयुतः /
मेघनादः सुभगया व्यापी स्यात्कालरात्रियुक् //
text_mt:
Bhakṣyapriya with Bhaginī, Gaṇeśa united with Bhaginī,
Meghanāda with Subhagā, Vyāpin should be united with Kālarātri;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśvaraḥ kāliṅkayā proktā vighneśamātṛkāḥ /
gaṇeśamātṛkāyāstu gaṇo munibhirīritaḥ //
meaning:
गणेश्वरः कालिङ्कया प्रोक्ता विघ्नेशमातृकाः /
गणेशमातृकायास्तु गणो मुनिभिरीरितः //
text_mt:
Gaṇeśvara with Kāliṅkā: these are declared the Vighneśamātṛkās.
Of this Gaṇeśamātṛkā, the sage is declared by the wise to be Gaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
trivṛdgāyatrikāchando devaḥ śaktigaṇeśvaraḥ /
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena kṛtvāṅgāni tataḥ smaret //
meaning:
त्रिवृद्गायत्रिकाछन्दो देवः शक्तिगणेश्वरः /
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन कृत्वाङ्गानि ततः स्मरेत् //
text_mt:
the meter is Trivṛt-Gāyatrī; the deity is Śaktigaṇeśvara.
Having performed the limbs with the seed-syllable endowed with the six long [vowels], one should then remember:

sanskrit_iast:
pāṃśāṅkuśābhayavarāndadhānaṃ kañjahastayā /
patnyāśliṣṭaṃ raktatanuṃ trinetraṃ gaṇape bhavet //
meaning:
पांशाङ्कुशाभयवरान्दधानं कञ्जहस्तया /
पत्न्याश्लिष्टं रक्ततनुं त्रिनेत्रं गणपे भवेत् //
text_mt:
holding noose, goad, gesture of fearlessness, and boon, embraced by his wife holding a lotus in her hand,
red-bodied, three-eyed—[thus] should one meditate on the Lord of Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasetsvīyabījapūrvākṣarānvitam /
nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistatedhikāḥ //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा न्यसेत्स्वीयबीजपूर्वाक्षरान्वितम् /
निवृत्तिश्च प्रतिष्ठा च विद्या शान्तिस्ततेधिकाः //
text_mt:
Having meditated thus, one should place [them] preceded by one's own seed-syllable and endowed with the letters.
Nivṛtti, Pratiṣṭhā, Vidyā, Śānti, and beyond that;

sanskrit_iast:
dīpikā recikā cāpi mocikā ca parābhidhā /
sūkṣmāsūkṣmāmṛtā jñānāmṛtā cāpyāyinī tathā //
meaning:
दीपिका रेचिका चापि मोचिका च पराभिधा /
सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्मामृता ज्ञानामृता चाप्यायिनी तथा //
text_mt:
Dīpikā, Recikā, Mocikā, and named Parā;
Sūkṣmā, Sūkṣmāmṛtā, Jñānāmṛtā, and Āpyāyinī;

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpinī vyomarūpā cānantā sṛṣṭiḥ samṛddhikā /
smṛtirmedhā tataḥ kāntirlakṣmīrddhṛtiḥ sthirā sthitiḥ //
meaning:
व्यापिनी व्योमरूपा चानन्ता सृष्टिः समृद्धिका /
स्मृतिर्मेधा ततः कान्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्द्धृतिः स्थिरा स्थितिः //
text_mt:
Vyāpinī, Vyomarūpā, Anantā, Sṛṣṭi, Samṛddhikā,
Smṛti, Medhā, then Kānti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Sthirā, Sthiti;

sanskrit_iast:
siddhirjarā pālinī ca kṣāntirīśvarīkā ratiḥ /
kāmiko varadā vātha hlādinī prītisaṃyutā //
meaning:
सिद्धिर्जरा पालिनी च क्षान्तिरीश्वरीका रतिः /
कामिको वरदा वाथ ह्लादिनी प्रीतिसंयुता //
text_mt:
Siddhi, Jarā, Pālinī, Kṣānti, Īśvarī, Rati,
Kāmikā, Varadā, or Hlādinī united with Prīti;

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghā tīkṣṇā tathā raudrā proktā nidrā ca tandrikā /
kṣudhā ca krodhinī paścākriyākārī samṛtyukā //
meaning:
दीर्घा तीक्ष्णा तथा रौद्रा प्रोक्ता निद्रा च तन्द्रिका /
क्षुधा च क्रोधिनी पश्चाक्रियाकारी समृत्युका //
text_mt:
Dīrghā, Tīkṣṇā, likewise Raudrā, Nidrā is taught, and Tandrikā,
Kṣudhā, and Krodhinī, thereafter Kriyākārī along with Mṛtyukā;

sanskrit_iast:
pītā śretāruṇā paścādasitānantayā yutā /
uktā kalāmātṛkaivaṃ tattadbhaktaḥ samācaret //
meaning:
पीता श्रेतारुणा पश्चादसितानन्तया युता /
उक्ता कलामातृकैवं तत्तद्भक्तः समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Pītā, Śvetā, Aruṇā, thereafter Asitā united with Anantā:
thus is the Kalāmātṛkā declared; each devotee should perform it accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāyuṅmātṛkāyāstu muniḥ proktaḥ prajāpatiḥ /
gāyatrīchanda ākhyātaṃ devatā śāradābhidhā //
meaning:
कलायुङ्मातृकायास्तु मुनिः प्रोक्तः प्रजापतिः /
गायत्रीछन्द आख्यातं देवता शारदाभिधा //
text_mt:
Of this mātṛkā joined with Kalās, the sage is declared to be Prajāpati;
the meter is named Gāyatrī; the deity is named Śāradā.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvadīrghāntarasthaiśca tāraiḥ kuryātṣaḍaṅgakam /
padmacakraguṇaiṇāṃśca dadhatīṃ ca trilocanām //
meaning:
ह्रस्वदीर्घान्तरस्थैश्च तारैः कुर्यात्षडङ्गकम् /
पद्मचक्रगुणैणांश्च दधतीं च त्रिलोचनाम् //
text_mt:
With the Oṃkāra placed between short and long [vowels], one should perform the six limbs.
[Meditation:] Holding a lotus, discus, bowstring, and deer, three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavakrāṃ bhāratīṃ tāṃ muktābhūṣāṃ bhajetsudhīḥ /
dhyātvaivaṃ tārapūrvāṃ tāṃ nyasenṅantakalānvitām //
meaning:
पञ्चवक्रां भारतीं तां मुक्ताभूषां भजेत्सुधीः /
ध्यात्वैवं तारपूर्वां तां न्यसेन्ङन्तकलान्विताम् //
text_mt:
five-faced, ornamented with pearls: that Bhāratī the wise one should worship.
Having meditated thus, one should place that [mātṛkā] preceded by Tāra [Oṃ] and endowed with the Kalās ending in the dative.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca mūlamantrasya ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret /
hṛdayādicaturthyante jātīḥ saṃyojya vinyaset //
meaning:
ततश्च मूलमन्त्रस्य षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् /
हृदयादिचतुर्थ्यन्ते जातीः संयोज्य विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
And then one should perform the six limbs of the root-mantra;
joining the ritual utterances ending with the dative [casemarkers] beginning with hṛdaya, one should place them.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaṭ jātaya īritāḥ /
tato dhyātveṣṭadevaṃ taṃ bhūṣāyudhasamanvitam //
meaning:
नमः स्वाहा वषट् हुं वौषट् फट् जातय ईरिताः /
ततो ध्यात्वेष्टदेवं तं भूषायुधसमन्वितम् //
text_mt:
Namaḥ, svāhā, vaṣaṭ, huṃ, vauṣaṭ, and phaṭ are declared the ritual utterances.
Then, having meditated on that chosen deity endowed with ornaments and weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
nyasyāṅgaṣaṭkaṃ tanmūrtauṃ tataḥ pūjanamārabhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge buhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde saṃdhyādinirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
न्यस्याङ्गषट्कं तन्मूर्तौं ततः पूजनमारभेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बुहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे संध्यादिनिरूपणं नाम षट्षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
having placed the group of six limbs upon that form, one should then begin the worship.

Thus ends the sixty-sixth chapter, named the Description of the Twilight Devotions and Other Rites, in the third quarter of the major narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha vakṣye devapūjāṃ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidām /
trikoṇaṃ caturasraṃ vā vāmabhāge prakalpya ca //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ वक्ष्ये देवपूजां साधकाभीष्टसिद्धिदाम् /
त्रिकोणं चतुरस्रं वा वामभागे प्रकल्प्य च //
text_mt:
Sanatkumāra said:
Now I shall speak of the worship of the deity that yields the attainment of the practitioner's desired object.
Having fashioned a triangle or a quadrangle on the left side,

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjyā sreṇa saṃkṣālya hṛdādhāraṃ nidhāya ca /
tatrāgnimaṇḍalaṃ cedvā pātraṃ saṃkṣālya cāsrataḥ //
meaning:
सम्पूज्या स्रेण संक्षाल्य हृदाधारं निधाय च /
तत्राग्निमण्डलं चेद्वा पात्रं संक्षाल्य चास्रतः //
text_mt:
worshiping it, washing it with Astra, and placing the base with the Hṛdaya [mantra],
and having visualized the circle of fire there, and having washed the vessel with Astra,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāre nāmasaṃ sthāpya tatra cedravimaṇḍalam /
klimamātṛkā pūlamuñcaranpūrapejjalaiḥ //
meaning:
आधारे नामसं स्थाप्य तत्र चेद्रविमण्डलम् /
क्लिममातृका पूलमुञ्चरन्पूरपेज्जलैः //
text_mt:
having set down the vessel by name on the base, and there [visualized] the circle of the sun,
pronouncing the root-mātṛkā in regular order, one should fill it with water.

sanskrit_iast:
catreñjumaṇḍalaṃ prārcya tīrthānyāvāhya pūrvavat /
gomudrayāmṛtīkṛtya kavacenāvaguṇṭhayet //
meaning:
चत्रेञ्जुमण्डलं प्रार्च्य तीर्थान्यावाह्य पूर्ववत् /
गोमुद्रयामृतीकृत्य कवचेनावगुण्ठयेत् //
text_mt:
Having previously worshipped the circle of the moon there, having invoked the sacred waters as before,
having transformed it into nectar with the cow-gesture, one should veil it with the Kavaca [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣālyāsreṇa praṇavaṃ taduparyaṣṭadhā japet /
sāmānyārghamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
संक्षाल्यास्रेण प्रणवं तदुपर्यष्टधा जपेत् /
सामान्यार्घमिदं प्रोक्तं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् //
text_mt:
Having washed it with Astra, one should recite the Praṇava eight times over it;
this is declared the general arghya, which bestows all accomplishments on men.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjalaṃ rkicidudūdhṛtya prokṣiṇyā sādhakottamaḥ /
ātmānaṃ yāgavastūni tena saṃprokṣayetputhak //
meaning:
तज्जलं र्किचिदुदूधृत्य प्रोक्षिण्या साधकोत्तमः /
आत्मानं यागवस्तूनि तेन संप्रोक्षयेत्पुथक् //
text_mt:
Having drawn up a little of that water with the sprinkling vessel, the best of practitioners
should sprinkle himself and the sacrificial articles separately with it.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmavāmāgrataḥ kuryātṣaṭṭkoṇāntasrikoṇakam /
caturasreṇa saṃveṣṭya saṃkṣālyārghodakena ca //
meaning:
आत्मवामाग्रतः कुर्यात्षट्ट्कोणान्तस्रिकोणकम् /
चतुरस्रेण संवेष्ट्य संक्षाल्यार्घोदकेन च //
text_mt:
In front to his own left, he should make a triangle inside a hexagon;
enclosing it with a quadrangle and washing it with the arghya water,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ staṃbhayecchaṅkhamudrayā /
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu hṛdādyaṅgacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
ततस्तु साधकश्रेष्ठः स्तंभयेच्छङ्खमुद्रया /
आग्नेयादिषु कोणेषु हृदाद्यङ्गचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
the best of practitioners should then fix it with the conch-gesture.
In the corners beginning with the south-east, [he places] the four limbs beginning with Hṛdaya;

sanskrit_iast:
netraṃ madhye dikṣu cāsraṃ trikoṇe pūjayettataḥ /
mūlakhaṇḍatrayenāthādhāraśaktiṃ tu madhyagām //
meaning:
नेत्रं मध्ये दिक्षु चास्रं त्रिकोणे पूजयेत्ततः /
मूलखण्डत्रयेनाथाधारशक्तिं तु मध्यगाम् //
text_mt: Then, one should worship the eye in the middle, the weapon in the directions, in the triangle, / with the three sections of the root [mantra], and then the base power situated in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadasraṃsaṃkṣālitaṃ hṛdā /
pratiṣṭāpya tripadikāṃ pūjayenmanunāmunā //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवदस्रंसंक्षालितं हृदा /
प्रतिष्टाप्य त्रिपदिकां पूजयेन्मनुनामुना //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped in accordance with rule, having cleansed the weapon with the heart [mantra], / and having set up the tripod, one should worship it with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
maṃ vahnimaṇḍalā yeti tato deśakalātmane /
amukārdhyeti pātrānte sanāpahṛdayoṃ'time //
meaning:
मं वह्निमण्डला येति ततो देशकलात्मने /
अमुकार्ध्येति पात्रान्ते सनापहृदयोंऽतिमे //
text_mt: 'Maṃ to the circle of fire,' then 'to the self of ten digits,' / ending with the [offering] vessel named as such, having the heart [mantra] at the end, with Praṇava;

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśativarṇo 'yamādhārasyārcane manuḥ /
svamantrakṣālitaṃ śaraṃvaṃ saṃsyāpyāya samarcayet //
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिवर्णो ऽयमाधारस्यार्चने मनुः /
स्वमन्त्रक्षालितं शरंवं संस्याप्याय समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: this is the twenty-four-syllable mantra for the worship of the base. / Having set up the conch cleansed with its own mantra, one should worship it:

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ kārṃmamahāṃste tu tato jalacarāya ca /
varma phaṭ hṛdayaṃ pāñcajanyāya hṛdayaṃ maneḥ //
meaning:
तारः कार्ंममहांस्ते तु ततो जलचराय च /
वर्म फट् हृदयं पाञ्चजन्याय हृदयं मनेः //
text_mt: the tāra [mantra], 'kāṃ,' 'to the great brilliance,' then 'and to the water-dweller,' / the armor, phaṭ, the heart [mantra], and the heart [mantra] 'to Pāñcajanya,' of the jewel;

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārkamaṇḍalāyeti dvādaśānte kalāramane /
amukārdhyeti pātrānte namontastryakṣivarṇavān //
meaning:
तत्रार्कमण्डलायेति द्वादशान्ते कलारमने /
अमुकार्ध्येति पात्रान्ते नमोन्तस्त्र्यक्षिवर्णवान् //
text_mt: there [one utters], 'to the circle of the sun,' ending with twelve, 'to the self of digits,' / ending with the [offering] vessel named as such, ending with namas, possessing three syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya tena tatrārceddvādaśārkakalāḥ kramāt /
tataḥ śuddhajalairmūlaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ paṭhan //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य तेन तत्रार्चेद्द्वादशार्ककलाः क्रमात् /
ततः शुद्धजलैर्मूलं विलोममातृकां पठन् //
text_mt: having worshipped with that, one should worship the twelve digits of the sun in order there. / Then, reciting the root [mantra] and the reverse mātṛkā with pure waters,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhamāpūrayettasminpūjayenmanunāmunā /
oṃ somamaṇḍalāyeti ṣoḍaśānte kalātmane //
meaning:
शङ्खमापूरयेत्तस्मिन्पूजयेन्मनुनामुना /
ओं सोममण्डलायेति षोडशान्ते कलात्मने //
text_mt: one should fill the conch, and worship in it with this mantra: / 'Oṃ to the circle of the moon,' ending with sixteen, 'to the self of digits,'

sanskrit_iast:
amukārdhyāmṛtāyeti hṛnmanuścārdhyapūjane /
tatra ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākā yajeñcandramasaḥ kalāḥ //
meaning:
अमुकार्ध्यामृतायेति हृन्मनुश्चार्ध्यपूजने /
तत्र षोडशसंख्याका यजेञ्चन्द्रमसः कलाः //
text_mt: 'to the immortal nectar of the specified arghya,' and the heart-mantra in the worship of the arghya; / there one should worship the digits of the moon, sixteen in number.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tīrthānyāvāhya gaṅge cetyādipūrvavat /
gomudrayāmṛtīkṛtyācchādayenmatsmamudrayā //
meaning:
ततस्तु तीर्थान्यावाह्य गङ्गे चेत्यादिपूर्ववत् /
गोमुद्रयामृतीकृत्याच्छादयेन्मत्स्ममुद्रया //
text_mt: Then, having invoked the sacred waters with 'Gaṅge ca...' as before, / having turned it into nectar with the cow-gesture, one should cover it with the fish-gesture.

sanskrit_iast:
kavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha rakṣedastreṇa tatpunaḥ /
cintayitveṣṭadevaṃ ca tato mudrāḥ pradarśayet //
meaning:
कवचेनावगुण्ठ्याथ रक्षेदस्त्रेण तत्पुनः /
चिन्तयित्वेष्टदेवं च ततो मुद्राः प्रदर्शयेत् //
text_mt: Then, having veiled it with the armor [mantra], one should protect it again with the weapon [mantra]; / and having meditated on the chosen deity, one should then display the hand-gestures:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhamauśalacakākhyāḥ paramīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ /
mahāmudrāṃ yonimudrāṃ darśayetkramataḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खमौशलचकाख्याः परमीकरणं ततः /
महामुद्रां योनिमुद्रां दर्शयेत्क्रमतः सुधीः //
text_mt: the conch, club, and discus gestures; then supreme integration; / the wise person should display the great gesture and the yoni-gesture in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
gāruḍī gālinī caiva mukhye mudre prakīrtite /
gandhapuṣpādibhistatra pūjayeddevatāṃ smaranaṭ //
meaning:
गारुडी गालिनी चैव मुख्ये मुद्रे प्रकीर्तिते /
गन्धपुष्पादिभिस्तत्र पूजयेद्देवतां स्मरनट् //
text_mt: The Gāruḍī and the Gālinī are proclaimed as the two principal gestures. / Remembering the deity, one should worship there with fragrant sandal-paste, flowers, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭakṛtvo japenmūlaṃ praṇavaṃ cāṣṭadhā tathā /
śaṅkhāddakṣiṇadigbhāge prokṣaṇīpātramādiśet //
meaning:
अष्टकृत्वो जपेन्मूलं प्रणवं चाष्टधा तथा /
शङ्खाद्दक्षिणदिग्भागे प्रोक्षणीपात्रमादिशेत् //
text_mt: one should recite the root [mantra] eight times, and the Praṇava eight times as well. / To the right side of the conch, one should designate the sprinkling-vessel;

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇyāṃ tajjalaṃ kiñcitkṛtvātmānaṃ tridhā tataḥ /
ātmatattvātmane hṛñca vidyātattvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
प्रोक्षण्यां तज्जलं किञ्चित्कृत्वात्मानं त्रिधा ततः /
आत्मतत्त्वात्मने हृञ्च विद्यातत्त्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt: having placed a little of that water into the sprinkling-vessel, then oneself threefold: / the heart [mantra] 'to the self whose essence is the soul,' and 'salutation to the self whose essence is wisdom,'

sanskrit_iast:
śivatattvātmane hṛñca ityetairmanubhistribhiḥ /
prokṣetpuṣpākṣataiścāpi maṇḍalaṃ vidhivatsudhīḥ //
meaning:
शिवतत्त्वात्मने हृञ्च इत्येतैर्मनुभिस्त्रिभिः /
प्रोक्षेत्पुष्पाक्षतैश्चापि मण्डलं विधिवत्सुधीः //
text_mt: and the heart [mantra] 'to the self whose essence is Śiva'—with these three mantras, / the wise person should sprinkle the maṇḍala properly, also with flowers and unbroken grain;

sanskrit_iast:
athavā mūlagāyatryā pūjādravyāṇi prokṣayet /
pādyārdhyācamanūyārthaṃ madhuparkārthamapyuta //
meaning:
अथवा मूलगायत्र्या पूजाद्रव्याणि प्रोक्षयेत् /
पाद्यार्ध्याचमनूयार्थं मधुपर्कार्थमप्युत //
text_mt: or one should sprinkle the articles of worship with the root-gāyatrī. / For foot-water, arghya, and water for sipping, as well as for the honey-mixture,

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇyādhārayuktāni sthāpayedvidhinā puraḥ /
pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntajalaiḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
पात्राण्याधारयुक्तानि स्थापयेद्विधिना पुरः /
पाद्यं श्यामाकदूर्वाब्जविष्णुक्रान्तजलैः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: one should place the vessels furnished with bases in front according to rule. / Foot-water is traditionally prescribed with water containing śyāmāka grain, dūrvā grass, lotus, and viṣṇukrāntā;

sanskrit_iast:
ardhyaṃ puṣpākṣatayavaiḥ kuśāgratilasarṣapaiḥ /
gandhadūrvādalaiḥ proktaṃ tataścācamanīyakam //
meaning:
अर्ध्यं पुष्पाक्षतयवैः कुशाग्रतिलसर्षपैः /
गन्धदूर्वादलैः प्रोक्तं ततश्चाचमनीयकम् //
text_mt: arghya is declared to be with flowers, unbroken grain, barley, kuśa tips, sesame, and mustard, / with fragrant sandal-paste and dūrvā blades; and next the water for sipping:

sanskrit_iast:
jātīphalaṃ ca kaṅkolaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca jalānvitam /
kṣaudrājyadadhisaṃmiśraṃ madhuparkasamīritam //
meaning:
