जातीफलं च कङ्कोलं लवङ्गं च जलान्वितम् /
क्षौद्राज्यदधिसंमिश्रं मधुपर्कसमीरितम् //
text_mt: nutmeg, kakkola berries, and clove, together with water; / the honey-mixture is stated to be mixed with honey, clarified butter, and curd.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminnathavā pātre pādyādīni prakalpayet /
śaṅkarārkārcane śaṅkhamayenaiva praśasyate //
meaning:
एकस्मिन्नथवा पात्रे पाद्यादीनि प्रकल्पयेत् /
शङ्करार्कार्चने शङ्खमयेनैव प्रशस्यते //
text_mt: Or, one may arrange the foot-water and the rest in a single vessel; / in the worship of Śaṅkara and the Sun, [using a vessel] made of conch-shell alone is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetākṛṣṇāruṇāpītāśyāmāraktāsitāsitāḥ /
raktāṃbarābhayakarādhyeyāḥspuḥ pīṭhaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
श्वेताकृष्णारुणापीताश्यामारक्तासितासिताः /
रक्तांबराभयकराध्येयाःस्पुः पीठशक्तयः //
text_mt: White, black, reddish-brown, yellow, dark, red, dark, and black; / wearing red garments, making the gesture of fearlessness, these powers of the seat are to be meditated upon.

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇādilikhite yantre śālagrāme maṇau tathā /
vidhinā sthāpitāyāṃ vā pratimāyāṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
स्वर्णादिलिखिते यन्त्रे शालग्रामे मणौ तथा /
विधिना स्थापितायां वा प्रतिमायां प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: One should worship upon a yantra inscribed on gold or other material, on a śālagrāma stone, on a gem, / or on an image consecrated according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭādivitastyantamānā svarṇādidhātubhiḥ /
nirmitā śubhadā gehe pūjanāya dine dine //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्टादिवितस्त्यन्तमाना स्वर्णादिधातुभिः /
निर्मिता शुभदा गेहे पूजनाय दिने दिने //
text_mt: Measuring from a thumb's length up to a span, fashioned from gold or other metals, / [an image] brings auspiciousness in the home for daily worship.

sanskrit_iast:
vakrāṃ dagdhāṃ khaṇḍitāṃ ca bhinnamūrddhadṛśaṃ punanaḥ /
spaṣṭāṃ vāpya ntyajādyaiśca pratimāṃ naiva pūjayet //
meaning:
वक्रां दग्धां खण्डितां च भिन्नमूर्द्धदृशं पुननः /
स्पष्टां वाप्य न्त्यजाद्यैश्च प्रतिमां नैव पूजयेत् //
text_mt: One must never worship an image that is crooked, burnt, broken, / or with a fractured head or eyes, or touched by an outcaste and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇādiliṅge vābhyarcetsarvalakṣaṇalakṣite /
mūlena mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya dhyātvā devaṃ yathoditam //
meaning:
बाणादिलिङ्गे वाभ्यर्चेत्सर्वलक्षणलक्षिते /
मूलेन मूर्तिं संकल्प्य ध्यात्वा देवं यथोदितम् //
text_mt: Or one should worship upon a bāṇaliṅga or the like, characterized by all auspicious marks. / Having conceived the form with the root [mantra], and having meditated on the God as described,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhā pūjayetasyāṃ parivāragaṇaiḥ saha /
śālagrāme sthāpitāyāṃ nāvāhanavisarjane //
meaning:
आवाहा पूजयेतस्यां परिवारगणैः सह /
शालग्रामे स्थापितायां नावाहनविसर्जने //
text_mt: having invoked Him, one should worship in it along with His retinue. / In a śālagrāma stone or a permanently installed [image], there is no invocation or dismissal.

sanskrit_iast: puṣpāñjaliṃ samādāya dhyātvā mantramudīrayet //
meaning: पुष्पाञ्जलिं समादाय ध्यात्वा मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् //
text_mt: Taking a handful of flowers and meditating, one should utter the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
ātmasaṃsthamajaṃ śuddhaṃ tvāmahaṃ parameśvara /
araṇyāmiva havyāśaṃ mūrtāvāvāhayāmyaham //
meaning:
आत्मसंस्थमजं शुद्धं त्वामहं परमेश्वर /
अरण्यामिव हव्याशं मूर्तावावाहयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: 'O Supreme Lord, You who dwell in the self, unborn and pure, / I invoke You into this form, like fire into the fire-sticks.

sanskrit_iast:
taveyaṃ hi mahāmūrtistasyāṃ tvāṃ sarvagaṃ prabho /
bhaktirevahasamākṛṣṭaṃ dīpavatsthāpayāmyaham //
meaning:
तवेयं हि महामूर्तिस्तस्यां त्वां सर्वगं प्रभो /
भक्तिरेवहसमाकृष्टं दीपवत्स्थापयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: For this is Your great form; in it, O Lord, I establish You, / who are all-pervading, drawn by devotion alone, like a lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāntaryāmiṇe devaṃ sarvabījamaya śubham /
ravātmasthaāya paraṃ śuddhamāsanaṃ kalpayāvyaham //
meaning:
सर्वान्तर्यामिणे देवं सर्वबीजमय शुभम् /
रवात्मस्थआय परं शुद्धमासनं कल्पयाव्यहम् //
text_mt: For the God who is the inner ruler of all, who consists of all seed-syllables, the auspicious one, / who abides in the soul of the sun, I arrange a supreme, pure seat.

sanskrit_iast:
ananyā tava deveśa mūrtiśaktiriyaṃ prabho /
sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru tasyāṃ tvaṃ bhaktānugrāhakāraka //
meaning:
अनन्या तव देवेश मूर्तिशक्तिरियं प्रभो /
सांनिध्यं कुरु तस्यां त्वं भक्तानुग्राहकारक //
text_mt: This power of the form is non-different from You, O Lord of gods, O master; / make Your presence in it, You who bestow grace upon devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānājuca mattattvādvaikalyātsādhanasya ca /
yadyapūrṇaṃ bhavetkalpaṃ katathāpyabhimukho bhava //
meaning:
अज्ञानाजुच मत्तत्त्वाद्वैकल्यात्साधनस्य च /
यद्यपूर्णं भवेत्कल्पं कतथाप्यभिमुखो भव //
text_mt: If through ignorance, confusion of mind, or deficiency in the means of ritual, / the performance should be incomplete, nonetheless be favorably disposed toward me.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśā pūyūṣavarṣiṇyā pūrayanyajñaviṣṭare /
mūrtauṃ vā yajñasaṃpūrtyai sthito bhava maheśvara //
meaning:
दृशा पूयूषवर्षिण्या पूरयन्यज्ञविष्टरे /
मूर्तौं वा यज्ञसंपूर्त्यै स्थितो भव महेश्वर //
text_mt: Filling [all] with a glance raining nectar, on the seat of the sacrifice / or in the image, be present for the fulfillment of the sacrifice, O Great Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
abhaktavāṅmanaścakṣuḥ śrotradūrāyitadyute /
svatejaḥ pañjareṇāśu veṣṭito bhava sarvataḥ //
meaning:
अभक्तवाङ्मनश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रदूरायितद्युते /
स्वतेजः पञ्जरेणाशु वेष्टितो भव सर्वतः //
text_mt: O You whose radiance is far beyond the speech, mind, eye, and ear of the non-devotee, / be quickly encircled on all sides by the cage of Your own splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
yasya darśanāmicchanti devāḥ svābhīṣṭasiddhaye /
tasmai te parameśāya svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ca me //
meaning:
यस्य दर्शनामिच्छन्ति देवाः स्वाभीष्टसिद्धये /
तस्मै ते परमेशाय स्वागतं स्वागतं च मे //
text_mt: To You, the Supreme Lord, whose vision the gods desire for the attainment of their own wishes, / welcome, and welcome to me!'

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtārtho 'nugṛhīto 'smi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama /
āgato devadeveśaḥ sukhāgatamidaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
कृतार्थो ऽनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि सफलं जीवितं मम /
आगतो देवदेवेशः सुखागतमिदं पुनः //
text_mt: I am fulfilled, I am blessed, my life has borne fruit! / The Lord of the gods of gods has arrived: once more, welcome in comfort!

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhaktileptasaṃparkātparamānandasaṃbhavaḥ /
tasmai me paraṇābjāya pādyaṃ śuddhāya kalpyate //
meaning:
यद्भक्तिलेप्तसंपर्कात्परमानन्दसंभवः /
तस्मै मे परणाब्जाय पाद्यं शुद्धाय कल्प्यते //
text_mt: From contact with a particle of devotion to whom supreme bliss arises, / for that pure lotus foot of mine the water for washing the feet is prepared.

sanskrit_iast:
vedānāmapi vedāya devānāṃ devatātmane /
ācāmaṃ kalpayāmīśa śuddhānāṃ śuddhihetave //
meaning:
वेदानामपि वेदाय देवानां देवतात्मने /
आचामं कल्पयामीश शुद्धानां शुद्धिहेतवे //
text_mt: To the Veda of the Vedas themselves, to the Divine Self of the gods, / to the cause of purity for the pure, I prepare the water for sipping, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tāpatrayahara divyaṃ paramānandalakṣaṇam /
tāpatrayavinirmuktyai tavārghyaṃ kalpayāmyaham //
meaning:
तापत्रयहर दिव्यं परमानन्दलक्षणम् /
तापत्रयविनिर्मुक्त्यै तवार्घ्यं कल्पयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: O remover of the threefold suffering, divine one, characterized by supreme bliss! / For release from the threefold suffering I prepare your water offering.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāluṣyahīnāya paripūrṇasukhātmane /
madhuparkamidaṃ deva kalpayāmi prasīda me //
meaning:
सर्वकालुष्यहीनाय परिपूर्णसुखात्मने /
मधुपर्कमिदं देव कल्पयामि प्रसीद मे //
text_mt: To him who is free of all impurity, whose self is complete bliss, / I prepare this honey-mixture, O God; be gracious to me.

sanskrit_iast:
avacchiṣṭo 'pyaśucirvāpi yasya smaraṇamātrataḥ /
śuddhimāpnoti tasmai te punarācamanīyakam //
meaning:
अवच्छिष्टो ऽप्यशुचिर्वापि यस्य स्मरणमात्रतः /
शुद्धिमाप्नोति तस्मै ते पुनराचमनीयकम् //
text_mt: Even one with food remnants [in the mouth] or one who is impure attains purity merely by remembering him; / for you, that one, [I offer] the water for sipping a second time.

sanskrit_iast:
snehaṃ gṛhāṇa snehena lokanātha mahāśaya /
sarvalokeṣu śuddhātmandadāmi snehamuttamam //
meaning:
स्नेहं गृहाण स्नेहेन लोकनाथ महाशय /
सर्वलोकेषु शुद्धात्मन्ददामि स्नेहमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Receive the oil with affection, O Lord of the world, magnanimous one; / to the pure self throughout all the worlds I offer the best oil.

sanskrit_iast:
paramānandabodhābdhinimagnanijamūrtaye /
sāṃgopāṅgamidaṃ snānaṃ kalpayāmyahamīśa te /
sahasraṃ vā śataṃ vāpi yathāśaktyādareṇa ca //
meaning:
परमानन्दबोधाब्धिनिमग्ननिजमूर्तये /
सांगोपाङ्गमिदं स्नानं कल्पयाम्यहमीश ते /
सहस्रं वा शतं वापि यथाशक्त्यादरेण च //
text_mt: For his own form immersed in the ocean of supreme bliss and consciousness, / I prepare this bath with its ancillary limbs, O Lord, for you, / whether with a thousand [oblations] or a hundred, according to ability and with reverence.

sanskrit_iast: gandhapuṣpādikairīśa manunāṃ cābhiṣiñcet //
meaning: गन्धपुष्पादिकैरीश मनुनां चाभिषिञ्चेत् //
text_mt: With fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like, O Lord, he should sprinkle [him] with the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāci trapaṭacchannanijaguhyorutejase /
nirāvaraṇavijñāna vāsaste kalpayāmyaham //
meaning:
मायाचि त्रपटच्छन्ननिजगुह्योरुतेजसे /
निरावरणविज्ञान वासस्ते कल्पयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: To him whose secret, vast splendour is veiled by the painted cloth of Māyā, / whose consciousness is unveiled: I prepare your garment.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāśritya ma hāmāyā jagatsaṃmohinī sadā /
tasmai te parameśāya kalpayāmyuttarīyakam //
meaning:
यमाश्रित्य म हामाया जगत्संमोहिनी सदा /
तस्मै ते परमेशाय कल्पयाम्युत्तरीयकम् //
text_mt: Depending on whom Mahāmāyā constantly deludes the world, / to that Supreme Lord I prepare your upper garment.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ śaktyarkavighneṣu pītaṃviṣṇau sitaṃ śive /
tailādidūṣitaṃ jīrṇaṃ sacchidraṃ malinaṃ tyajet //
meaning:
रक्तं शक्त्यर्कविघ्नेषु पीतंविष्णौ सितं शिवे /
तैलादिदूषितं जीर्णं सच्छिद्रं मलिनं त्यजेत् //
text_mt: Red for the Goddess, the Sun, and Gaṇeśa; yellow for Viṣṇu; white for Śiva. / One should discard what is soiled with oil and the like, worn out, torn, or dirty.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śaktitrayeṇadaṃ saṃprītamakhilaṃ jagat /
yajñasūtrāya tasmai te yajñasūtraṃ prakalpaye //
meaning:
यस्य शक्तित्रयेणदं संप्रीतमखिलं जगत् /
यज्ञसूत्राय तस्मै ते यज्ञसूत्रं प्रकल्पये //
text_mt: By whose threefold power this entire world is delighted, / to you who are the sacrificial cord, I offer the sacrificial cord.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvasundarāṅgāya nānāśaktyāśrayāya te /
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi kalpayāmyamarārcita //
meaning:
स्वभावसुन्दराङ्गाय नानाशक्त्याश्रयाय ते /
भूषणानि विचित्राणि कल्पयाम्यमरार्चित //
text_mt: en:

sanskrit_iast:
paramānandasaurabhyaparipūrṇadigantaram /
gṛhāṇa parama gandha kṛpayā parameśvara //
meaning:
परमानन्दसौरभ्यपरिपूर्णदिगन्तरम् /
गृहाण परम गन्ध कृपया परमेश्वर //
text_mt: Filling the horizon with the fragrance of supreme bliss, / receive the supreme perfume with compassion, O Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
turīyavanasaṃbhūtaṃ nānāguṇamanoharam /
amandasaurabhapuṣpaṃ gṛhyatāmidamuttamam /
japākṣatārkadhattūrānviṣṇau naivārpayetkvacit //
meaning:
तुरीयवनसंभूतं नानागुणमनोहरम् /
अमन्दसौरभपुष्पं गृह्यतामिदमुत्तमम् /
जपाक्षतार्कधत्तूरान्विष्णौ नैवार्पयेत्क्वचित् //
text_mt: Arisen in the forest of the transcendent, charming with various qualities, / let this excellent flower of unfailing fragrance be accepted! / One should never offer hibiscus, unbroken rice, arka, or dhattūra to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ketakīṃ kuṭajaṃ kundaṃ bandhūkaṃ kesaraṃ japām /
mālatīpuṣpaka caiva nārpayettu maheśvare //
meaning:
केतकीं कुटजं कुन्दं बन्धूकं केसरं जपाम् /
मालतीपुष्पक चैव नार्पयेत्तु महेश्वरे //
text_mt: Ketakī, kuṭaja, kunda, bandhūka, kesara, hibiscus, / and mālatī flowers one should never offer to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
mātuliṅgaṃ ca tagaraṃ ravau naivārpayetkvacit /
śaktau dūrvārkamandārān gaṇeśe tulasīṃ tyajet //
meaning:
मातुलिङ्गं च तगरं रवौ नैवार्पयेत्क्वचित् /
शक्तौ दूर्वार्कमन्दारान् गणेशे तुलसीं त्यजेत् //
text_mt: Citron and tagara one should never offer to the Sun; / on the Goddess one should avoid dūrvā grass, arka, and mandāra; on Gaṇeśa, tulasī.

sanskrit_iast:
sarojinīdamanakau tathā marubakaḥ kuśaḥ /
viṣṇukrāntā nāgavallī dūrvāpāmārgadāḍimau //
meaning:
सरोजिनीदमनकौ तथा मरुबकः कुशः /
विष्णुक्रान्ता नागवल्ली दूर्वापामार्गदाडिमौ //
text_mt: Lotus and damanaka, as well as marubaka and kuśa grass, / viṣṇukrāntā, betel leaf, dūrvā grass, apāmārga, and pomegranate;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrī muniyutānāṃ ca patrairdevārcanaṃ caret /
kadalī badarī dhātrī tintiṇī bījapūrakam //
meaning:
धात्री मुनियुतानां च पत्रैर्देवार्चनं चरेत् /
कदली बदरी धात्री तिन्तिणी बीजपूरकम् //
text_mt: along with dhātrī and agastya: with their leaves one should perform worship of the deity. / Plantain, jujube, dhātrī, tamarind, and citron,

sanskrit_iast:
āmradāḍimajaṃbīrajaṃbūpanasabhūruhāḥ /
eteṣāṃ tu phalaiḥ kuryāddevatāpūjanaṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
आम्रदाडिमजंबीरजंबूपनसभूरुहाः /
एतेषां तु फलैः कुर्याद्देवतापूजनं बुधः //
text_mt: mango, pomegranate, lime, rose-apple, and breadfruit trees: / with the fruits of these the wise person should perform the worship of the deity.

sanskrit_iast: śuṣkaistu nārcayeddevaṃ patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairapi //
meaning: शुष्कैस्तु नार्चयेद्देवं पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैरपि //
text_mt: One should not worship the god with dry leaves, flowers, or fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrī khadirabitvānāṃ tamālasya dalāni ca /
chinnabhinnānyapi mune na dūṣyāṇi jagurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
धात्री खदिरबित्वानां तमालस्य दलानि च /
छिन्नभिन्नान्यपि मुने न दूष्याणि जगुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: The leaves of dhātrī, khadira, bilva, and tamāla, / even if torn or broken, O sage, the wise have declared not to be defective.

sanskrit_iast:
padmamāmalakaṃ tiṣṭecchuddhaṃ caiva dinatrayam /
sarvadā tulasī śuddhā bilvapatrāṇi vai tathā //
meaning:
पद्ममामलकं तिष्टेच्छुद्धं चैव दिनत्रयम् /
सर्वदा तुलसी शुद्धा बिल्वपत्राणि वै तथा //
text_mt: A lotus and an āmalaka fruit remain pure for three days; / tulasī is always pure, and likewise bilva leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśakāśakusumaistamālatulasīdalaiḥ /
chātrīdalaiśca dūrvābhirnārcayejjagadaṃbikām //
meaning:
पलाशकाशकुसुमैस्तमालतुलसीदलैः /
छात्रीदलैश्च दूर्वाभिर्नार्चयेज्जगदंबिकाम् //
text_mt: With flowers of palāśa and kāśa, with leaves of tamāla and tulasī, / with leaves of chātrī and with dūrvā grass, one should not worship the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
nārpayetkusumaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ deve hyadhomukham /
puṣpapatrādikaṃ vipra yathotpannaṃ tathārpayet //
meaning:
नार्पयेत्कुसुमं पत्रं फलं देवे ह्यधोमुखम् /
पुष्पपत्रादिकं विप्र यथोत्पन्नं तथार्पयेत् //
text_mt: One should not offer a flower, leaf, or fruit downwards to the god; / O brahmin, one should offer a flower, leaf, and the like just as it grew.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaspatirasaṃ divyaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam /
āghreyaṃ devadeveśa dhūpaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāma me //
meaning:
वनस्पतिरसं दिव्यं गन्धाढ्यं सुमनोहरम् /
आघ्रेयं देवदेवेश धूपं भक्त्या गृहाम मे //
text_mt: Divine sap of forest plants, rich in fragrance, very pleasing, / pleasant to smell: receive the incense with devotion from me, O Lord of the gods of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
suprakāśaṃ mahādīpaṃ sarvadā timirāpaham /
ghṛtavartisamāyuktaṃ gṛhāṇa mama satkṛtam //
meaning:
सुप्रकाशं महादीपं सर्वदा तिमिरापहम् /
घृतवर्तिसमायुक्तं गृहाण मम सत्कृतम् //
text_mt: A great lamp of bright radiance, constantly dispelling darkness, / furnished with ghee and a wick: receive [this] honoured [offering] of mine.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam /
bhaktyā gṛhāṇa me deva naivedyantuṣṭidaṃsadā //
meaning:
अन्नं चतुर्विधं स्वादु रसैः षड्भिः समन्वितम् /
भक्त्या गृहाण मे देव नैवेद्यन्तुष्टिदंसदा //
text_mt: Food of four kinds, tasty, endowed with the six flavours: / with devotion receive my food offering, O God, which always gives satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgavallīdalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pūgakhadiracūrṇayuk /
karpūrādisugandhāḍhyaṃ yaddattaṃ tadgṛhāṇa me //
meaning:
नागवल्लीदलं श्रेष्ठं पूगखदिरचूर्णयुक् /
कर्पूरादिसुगन्धाढ्यं यद्दत्तं तद्गृहाण मे //
text_mt: Best betel leaf, accompanied by areca nut and catechu powder, / rich in sweet fragrances like camphor: receive what has been offered by me.

sanskrit_iast: dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ paścātkuryādāvaraṇārcanam //
meaning: दद्यात्पुष्पाञ्जलिं पश्चात्कुर्यादावरणार्चनम् //
text_mt: He should give a handful of flowers; afterwards he should perform the worship of the enclosures.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāśābhimukho bhūtvā pūjanaṃ tu samācaret /
saiva prācī tu vijñeyā tato 'nyā vidiśo daśa //
meaning:
यदाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा पूजनं तु समाचरेत् /
सैव प्राची तु विज्ञेया ततो ऽन्या विदिशो दश //
text_mt: Facing whatever direction he performs the worship, / that should be known as the east, and after that the other ten intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
keśareṣvagnikoṇādi hṛdayādīni pūjayet /
netramagre dikṣu cāstraṃ aṅgamantrairyathākramam //
meaning:
केशरेष्वग्निकोणादि हृदयादीनि पूजयेत् /
नेत्रमग्रे दिक्षु चास्त्रं अङ्गमन्त्रैर्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: On the filaments [of the lotus], beginning from the fire corner (south-east), he should worship the heart and other [limbs]; / the eye in front, and the weapon in the [cardinal] directions, respectively with the limb-mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaśvetasitaśyāmakṛṣṇaraktārciṣaḥ kramāt /
varābhayakarā dhyeyāḥ svasvadikṣvaṃ gaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लश्वेतसितश्यामकृष्णरक्तार्चिषः क्रमात् /
वराभयकरा ध्येयाः स्वस्वदिक्ष्वं गशक्तयः //
text_mt: White, fair, bright, dark, black, and red in their rays in order, / showing the gestures of bestowing boons and fearlessness, the limb-powers should be meditated on in their respective directions.

sanskrit_iast:
amukāvaraṇānte tu devatā iti saṃvadet /
sālaṅkārāstataḥ paścātsāṃgāḥ saparicārikāḥ //
meaning:
अमुकावरणान्ते तु देवता इति संवदेत् /
सालङ्कारास्ततः पश्चात्सांगाः सपरिचारिकाः //
text_mt: At the end of [the name of] such-and-such an enclosure, he should say, ‘the deities’; / then adorned with ornaments, along with their limbs, along with their attendants,

sanskrit_iast:
savāhanāḥ sāyudhāśca tataḥ sarvo pacārakaiḥ /
saṃpūjitāstarpitāśca varadāḥ saṃtvidaṃ paṭhet //
meaning:
सवाहनाः सायुधाश्च ततः सर्वो पचारकैः /
संपूजितास्तर्पिताश्च वरदाः संत्विदं पठेत् //
text_mt: with mounts and with weapons; then, worshipped with all the articles of worship / and propitiated, he should recite this: ‘Be granters of boons!’

sanskrit_iast:
mūlānte ca samuñcārya divatāyai nivedayet /
abhīṣṭasiddhiṃ me dehi śaraṇāgatavatsala //
meaning:
मूलान्ते च समुञ्चार्य दिवतायै निवेदयेत् /
अभीष्टसिद्धिं मे देहि शरणागतवत्सल //
text_mt: Having pronounced [the formula] at the end of the root-mantra, he should announce to the deity: / ‘Grant me the attainment of my desired object, O you who are affectionate to those who seek refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktayā samarpaye tubhyamamukāvaraṇārcanam /
ityuñcārya kṣipetpuṣpāñjaliṃ devasya mastake //
meaning:
भक्तया समर्पये तुभ्यममुकावरणार्चनम् /
इत्युञ्चार्य क्षिपेत्पुष्पाञ्जलिं देवस्य मस्तके //
text_mt: With devotion I offer to you the worship of such-and-such an enclosure.’ / Having pronounced this, he should throw a handful of flowers onto the head of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvabhyarcyanīyāḥ syuḥ kalpoktāścāvṛtīḥ kramāt /
sāyudhāṃstata indrādyānsvasvadikṣu prapūjayet //
meaning:
ततस्त्वभ्यर्च्यनीयाः स्युः कल्पोक्ताश्चावृतीः क्रमात् /
सायुधांस्तत इन्द्राद्यान्स्वस्वदिक्षु प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Then the enclosures prescribed in the ritual injunction should be worshipped in succession; / then he should worship Indra and the others, accompanied by their weapons, in their respective directions:

sanskrit_iast:
idro vahniryamo rakṣo varuṇaḥ pavano vidhuḥ /
īśāno 'tha vidhiścaivamadhastātpanna gādhipaḥ //
meaning:
इद्रो वह्निर्यमो रक्षो वरुणः पवनो विधुः /
ईशानो ऽथ विधिश्चैवमधस्तात्पन्न गाधिपः //
text_mt: Indra, Agni, Yama, the Rākṣasa (Nirṛti), Varuṇa, Pavana, the Moon, / Īśāna, and then Vidhi (Brahmā), and below the Lord of Serpents (Ananta).

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatastathā meṣo mahiṣaḥ pretastimirmṛgaḥ /
vājī vṛṣo haṃsakūrmauṃ vāhanāni vidurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतस्तथा मेषो महिषः प्रेतस्तिमिर्मृगः /
वाजी वृषो हंसकूर्मौं वाहनानि विदुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: Airāvata, the ram, the buffalo, the corpse, the makara, the deer, / the horse, the bull, the goose, and the tortoise: the wise know [these to be] their mounts.

sanskrit_iast:
vajraṃ śaktiṃ daṇḍakhaḍgau pāśāṃ kuśagadā api /
triśūlaṃ padmacakre ca kramādindrādihetayaḥ //
meaning:
वज्रं शक्तिं दण्डखड्गौ पाशां कुशगदा अपि /
त्रिशूलं पद्मचक्रे च क्रमादिन्द्रादिहेतयः //
text_mt: The thunderbolt, lance, staff, sword, noose, goad, mace, / trident, lotus, and discus in succession are the weapons of Indra and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpyāvaraṇārcāṃ tu devatārārtikaṃ caret /
śaṅkhatoyaṃ parikṣipyodvāhurnṛtyan patetkṣitau //
meaning:
समाप्यावरणार्चां तु देवतारार्तिकं चरेत् /
शङ्खतोयं परिक्षिप्योद्वाहुर्नृत्यन् पतेत्क्षितौ //
text_mt: Having completed the worship of the enclosures, he should perform the waving of lights before the deity; / having poured around conch water, raising his arms and dancing, he should fall to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍavañcāpyathotthāya prārthayitvā nije śvaram /
dakṣiṇe sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃskāramācaret //
meaning:
दण्डवञ्चाप्यथोत्थाय प्रार्थयित्वा निजे श्वरम् /
दक्षिणे स्थण्डिलं कृत्वा तत्र संस्कारमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Falling like a rod, and then rising, having prayed to his own Lord, / having prepared an altar on the right, he should perform the consecration there:

sanskrit_iast:
mūlenekṣaṇamastreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ punaḥ /
kuśaistadvarmaṇābhyukṣya pūjya tatra nyasedvasum //
meaning:
मूलेनेक्षणमस्त्रेण प्रोक्षणं ताडनं पुनः /
कुशैस्तद्वर्मणाभ्युक्ष्य पूज्य तत्र न्यसेद्वसुम् //
text_mt: Inspection with the root-mantra, sprinkling and striking with the weapon-mantra; / having sprinkled it with kuśa grass with the armour-mantra, and worshipped, he should deposit the fire there.

sanskrit_iast:
pradāpya tatra juhuyāddhyātvā caiveṣṭadevatām /
mahāvyāhṛtibhiryastu samastābhiścatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
प्रदाप्य तत्र जुहुयाद्ध्यात्वा चैवेष्टदेवताम् /
महाव्याहृतिभिर्यस्तु समस्ताभिश्चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: Having offered and having meditated on the chosen deity right there, / one who [offers] four [oblations] with all the great utterances combined,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyātsarpiṣā bhaktaistilairvā pāyasena vā /
saghṛtaiḥ sādhakaśreṣṭhaḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
जुहुयात्सर्पिषा भक्तैस्तिलैर्वा पायसेन वा /
सघृतैः साधकश्रेष्ठः पञ्चविंशतिसंख्यया //
text_mt: should make offerings with clarified butter, or cooked food, or sesame seeds, or milk-rice / with ghee, twenty-five in number, the best of practitioners.

sanskrit_iast:
punarvyāhṛtibhaghirhutvā gandhādyaiḥ punararcayet /
devaṃ saṃyojayenmūrtauṃ tato vahniṃ visarjayet //
meaning:
पुनर्व्याहृतिभघिर्हुत्वा गन्धाद्यैः पुनरर्चयेत् /
देवं संयोजयेन्मूर्तौं ततो वह्निं विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Having offered again with the great utterances, he should worship again with perfumes and the rest; / he should unite the god in the image, and then dismiss the fire:

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho vahne mahāśakte sarvakarmaprasādhaka /
karmāntare 'pi saṃprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaram //
meaning:
भो भो वह्ने महाशक्ते सर्वकर्मप्रसाधक /
कर्मान्तरे ऽपि संप्राप्ते सान्निध्यं कुरु सादरम् //
text_mt: ‘O Fire! O you of great power, accomplisher of all rites! / Even when another rite has arrived, re-establish your presence with respect.’

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjyāgnidevatāyai dadyādācamanīyakam /
avaśiṣṭena haviṣā gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam //
meaning:
विसृज्याग्निदेवतायै दद्यादाचमनीयकम् /
अवशिष्टेन हविषा गन्धपुष्पाक्षतान्वितम् //
text_mt: Having dismissed [the fire], he should give water for sipping to the fire-deity, / along with the remaining oblation food accompanied by perfume, flowers, and unbroken rice.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāpārṣadebhyo 'pi pūrvoktebhyo baliṃ dadet /
ye raudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudrasthānanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
देवतापार्षदेभ्यो ऽपि पूर्वोक्तेभ्यो बलिं ददेत् /
ये रौद्रा रौद्रकर्माणो रौद्रस्थाननिवासिनः //
text_mt: One should offer a bali oblation to the attendants of the deity, who were mentioned earlier, / and to those who are fierce, performing fierce deeds and dwelling in fierce places,

sanskrit_iast:
yoginyo hyugrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāśca ye /
vighnabhūtāstathā cānye digvidikṣu samāśritāḥga //
meaning:
योगिन्यो ह्युग्ररूपाश्च गणानामधिपाश्च ये /
विघ्नभूतास्तथा चान्ये दिग्विदिक्षु समाश्रिताःग //
text_mt: and indeed to the yoginīs of terrible form, to the lords of the gaṇas, / and likewise to the other obstacle-spirits settled in the cardinal and intermediate directions:

sanskrit_iast:
sarve te prītamanasaḥ pratigṛhṇantvimaṃ balim /
ityaṣṭadikṣu datvā ca punarbhūtabaliṃ caret //
meaning:
सर्वे ते प्रीतमनसः प्रतिगृह्णन्त्विमं बलिम् /
इत्यष्टदिक्षु दत्वा च पुनर्भूतबलिं चरेत् //
text_mt: "May all of them, with pleased minds, accept this bali oblation." / Having thus offered it in the eight directions, one should again perform the bali for the spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
pānīyamamṛtīkṛtya mudrayā dhenusaṃjñayā /
devatāyāḥ kare dadyātpunaścācamanīyakam //
meaning:
पानीयममृतीकृत्य मुद्रया धेनुसंज्ञया /
देवतायाः करे दद्यात्पुनश्चाचमनीयकम् //
text_mt: Having transformed the water into nectar with the gesture called dhenu, / one should place it in the hand of the deity, and once again offer sipping-water.

sanskrit_iast:
devamudvāsya mūrtisthaṃ punastatraiva yojayet /
naivedyaṃ ca tato dadyāttattaducchiṣṭabhojine //
meaning:
देवमुद्वास्य मूर्तिस्थं पुनस्तत्रैव योजयेत् /
नैवेद्यं च ततो दद्यात्तत्तदुच्छिष्टभोजिने //
text_mt: Having dismissed the god residing in the image, one should again unite him there; / and then one should offer food offerings to the respective consumer of the deity's leavings:

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvarasya caṇḍeśo viṣvaksenastathā hareḥ /
caṇḍāṃśustaraṇervaktatuṇḍaścāpi gaṇeśituḥ /
śakterucchiṣṭacāṇḍālī proktā ucchiṣṭabhojinaḥ //
meaning:
महेश्वरस्य चण्डेशो विष्वक्सेनस्तथा हरेः /
चण्डांशुस्तरणेर्वक्ततुण्डश्चापि गणेशितुः /
शक्तेरुच्छिष्टचाण्डाली प्रोक्ता उच्छिष्टभोजिनः //
text_mt: Caṇḍeśa is the consumer of the leavings for Maheśvara, and Viṣvaksena likewise for Hari; / Caṇḍāṃśu for the Sun, and Vakratuṇḍa for the lord of gaṇas; / Ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālī is proclaimed for the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tato ṛṣyādikaṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā mūlaṣaḍaṅgakam /
japtvā mantraṃ yathāśakti devatāyai nivedayet //
meaning:
ततो ऋष्यादिकं स्मृत्वा कृत्वा मूलषडङ्गकम् /
जप्त्वा मन्त्रं यथाशक्ति देवतायै निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Then, remembering the seer and other particulars, and performing the six limbs with the root [mantra], / having recited the mantra according to one's ability, one should dedicate it to the deity:

sanskrit_iast:
guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam /
siddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprasādāttvayi sthitā //
meaning:
गुह्यातिगुह्यगोप्ता त्वं गृहाणास्मत्कृतं जपम् /
सिद्धिर्भवतु मे देव त्वत्प्रसादात्त्वयि स्थिता //
text_mt: "You are the protector of the most secret of secrets; accept the recitation performed by us. / May there be success for me, O God, abiding in You by Your grace."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ parāṅmukhaṃ cārghaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaiḥ prapūjayet /
dorbhyāṃ pabhdyāṃ ca jānubhyāmurasā śirasādṛśā /
manasā vacasā ceti praṇāmo 'ṣṭāṅga īritaḥ //
meaning:
ततः पराङ्मुखं चार्घं कृत्वा पुष्पैः प्रपूजयेत् /
दोर्भ्यां पभ्द्यां च जानुभ्यामुरसा शिरसादृशा /
मनसा वचसा चेति प्रणामो ऽष्टाङ्ग ईरितः //
text_mt: Then, having turned the arghya offering away, one should worship with flowers. / With the two arms, two feet, two knees, chest, head, and eyes, / with mind and speech—this is declared to be the eight-limbed prostration.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhubhyāṃ ca sajānubhyāṃ śirasā vacasāpi vā /
pañcāṅgakaḥ praṇāmaḥ syātpūjāyāṃ pravarāvubhau //
meaning:
बाहुभ्यां च सजानुभ्यां शिरसा वचसापि वा /
पञ्चाङ्गकः प्रणामः स्यात्पूजायां प्रवरावुभौ //
text_mt: With the arms together with knees, with the head, or with speech: / that would be the five-limbed prostration; both are excellent in worship.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā ca daṇḍavanmantrī tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇāḥ /
viṣmusomārkavighnānāṃ vedārdhendvadrivahnayaḥ //
meaning:
नत्वा च दण्डवन्मन्त्री ततः कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाः /
विष्मुसोमार्कविघ्नानां वेदार्धेन्द्वद्रिवह्नयः //
text_mt: Having bowed like a staff, the mantra practitioner should then circumambulate: / four times for Viṣṇu, one for the Moon, seven for the Sun, and three for Vighna.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ stotrādikaṃ mantrī prapaṭhe dbhaktipūrvakam /
itaḥ pūrṇaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārataḥ //
meaning:
ततः स्तोत्रादिकं मन्त्री प्रपठे द्भक्तिपूर्वकम् /
इतः पूर्णं प्राणबुद्धिदेहधर्माधिकारतः //
text_mt: Then the mantra practitioner should recite a hymn of praise and similar texts with devotion: / "Henceforth fully, according to the authority of the duties of life-breath, intellect, and body,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyante 'vasthāsu manasā vadet /
vācā hastābhyāṃ ca padbhyā mudareṇa tataḥ param //
meaning:
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्त्यन्ते ऽवस्थासु मनसा वदेत् /
वाचा हस्ताभ्यां च पद्भ्या मुदरेण ततः परम् //
text_mt: in the states of waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, by the mind, / by speech, with the two hands, two feet, the belly, and thereafter

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣṇānte yatsmṛtaṃ paścādyaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tataḥ /
tatsarvaṃ ca tato brahmarpaṇaṃ bhavatu ṭhadvayam //
meaning:
शिष्णान्ते यत्स्मृतं पश्चाद्यदुक्तं यत्कृतं ततः /
तत्सर्वं च ततो ब्रह्मर्पणं भवतु ठद्वयम् //
text_mt: with the genitals—whatever was remembered, and then whatever was spoken, whatever was done— / may all that be an offering to Brahman, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ madīyaṃ ca sakalaṃ viṣṇave ca samarpaye /
tāraṃ tatsadato brahmarpaṇamastu manurmataḥ //
meaning:
मां मदीयं च सकलं विष्णवे च समर्पये /
तारं तत्सदतो ब्रह्मर्पणमस्तु मनुर्मतः //
text_mt: "I dedicate myself and all that is mine unto Viṣṇu. / Om tat sat, may this be an offering unto Brahman!"—this is considered the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādyo 'ṣṭavasvarṇo hyanenātmānamarpayet /
ajñānādvā pramādādvā vaikalyātsādhanasya ca //
meaning:
प्रणवाद्यो ऽष्टवस्वर्णो ह्यनेनात्मानमर्पयेत् /
अज्ञानाद्वा प्रमादाद्वा वैकल्यात्साधनस्य च //
text_mt: Beginning with praṇava and having twenty-eight syllables: with this one should surrender oneself. / "Whether through ignorance, heedlessness, or deficiency of ritual means,

sanskrit_iast:
yannyūnamatiriktaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi /
dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ mayānyathā //
meaning:
यन्न्यूनमतिरिक्तं वा तत्सर्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि /
द्रव्यहीनं क्रियाहीनं मन्त्रहीनं मयान्यथा //
text_mt: whatever has been deficient or redundant, you ought to forgive all that. / Lacking ritual substances, lacking correct actions, lacking mantras, otherwise

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ yattatkṣamasveśa kṛpayā tvaṃ dayānidhe /
yanmayā kriyate karma jāgratsvaprasuṣuptiṣu //
meaning:
कृतं यत्तत्क्षमस्वेश कृपया त्वं दयानिधे /
यन्मया क्रियते कर्म जाग्रत्स्वप्रसुषुप्तिषु //
text_mt: whatever was done by me: forgive that, O Lord, by your compassion, O ocean of mercy! / Whatever action is done by me in waking, dreaming, and deep sleep,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ tāvakī pūjā bhūyādbhūtyai ca me prabho /
bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalaṃbanam //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं तावकी पूजा भूयाद्भूत्यै च मे प्रभो /
भूमौ स्खलितपादानां भूमिरेवावलंबनम् //
text_mt: may all that become your worship, and lead to my welfare, O Lord! / For those whose feet stumble on the ground, the ground itself is the support;

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ prabho /
anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama //
meaning:
त्वयि जातापराधानां त्वमेव शरणं प्रभो /
अन्यथा शरणं नास्ति त्वमेव शरणं मम //
text_mt: for those who have committed offenses against you, you alone are the refuge, O Lord! / There is no other refuge; you alone are my refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkāruṇyabhāvena kṣamasva parameśvara /
aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyante 'harnniśaṃ mayā //
meaning:
तस्मात्कारुण्यभावेन क्षमस्व परमेश्वर /
अपराधसहस्राणि क्रियन्ते ऽहर्न्निशं मया //
text_mt: Therefore, through the disposition of compassion, forgive me, O Supreme Lord! / Thousands of offenses are committed day and night by me;

sanskrit_iast:
dāso 'yamiti māṃ matvā kṣamasva jagatāṃ pate /
āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanam //
meaning:
दासो ऽयमिति मां मत्वा क्षमस्व जगतां पते /
आवाहनं न जानामि न जानामि विसर्जनम् //
text_mt: thinking, 'This is my servant,' forgive me, O Lord of the worlds! / I do not know invocation, nor do I know dismissal;

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvara /
saṃprārthyaivaṃ tato mantrī mūlānte ślokamuñcaret //
meaning:
पूजां चैव न जानामि त्वं गतिः परमेश्वर /
संप्रार्थ्यैवं ततो मन्त्री मूलान्ते श्लोकमुञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: and I do not know how to worship: you are my refuge, O Supreme Lord!" / Having thus prayed, the mantra practitioner should then recite the verse at the end of the root [mantra]:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ jagadīśa jaganmaya /
yanna brahmādayo devā jānanti ca sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
गच्छ गच्छ परं स्थानं जगदीश जगन्मय /
यन्न ब्रह्मादयो देवा जानन्ति च सदाशिवः //
text_mt: "Go, go to the supreme abode, O Lord of the universe, who pervade the universe, / which the gods such as Brahmā do not know, nor Sadāśiva."

sanskrit_iast:
iti puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā tataḥ saṃhāramudrayā /
nidhāya devaṃ sāṃgaṃ ca svīyadṛtsarasīruhe //
meaning:
इति पुष्पाञ्जलिं दत्वा ततः संहारमुद्रया /
निधाय देवं सांगं च स्वीयदृत्सरसीरुहे //
text_mt: Having thus offered a handful of flowers, then by means of the saṃhāramudrā, / placing the god together with his limbs in the lotus of one's own heart,

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumṇāvartmanā puṣpamāghrāyodvāsayed budhaḥ /
śaṅkhacakraśilāliṅgavighnasūryadvayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
सुषुम्णावर्त्मना पुष्पमाघ्रायोद्वासयेद् बुधः /
शङ्खचक्रशिलालिङ्गविघ्नसूर्यद्वयं तथा //
text_mt: smelling the flower via the path of the suṣumṇā, the wise person should dismiss him. / Two conches, two cakras, two śālagrāma stones, two liṅgas, two Vighnas, two suns,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktitrayaṃ na caikatra pūjayedduḥkhakāraṇam /
akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvavyādhivināśan //
meaning:
शक्तित्रयं न चैकत्र पूजयेद्दुःखकारणम् /
अकालमृत्युहरणं सर्वव्याधिविनाशन् //
text_mt: and three śaktis one should never worship together in one place; it causes sorrow. / Removing untimely death, destroying all diseases,

sanskrit_iast: sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ viṣṇupādodakaṃ śubham //
meaning: सर्वपापक्षयकरं विष्णुपादोदकं शुभम् //
text_mt: and effecting the destruction of all sins, is the auspicious water from Viṣṇu's feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tattadbhaktairgṛhī tavyaṃ tannaivedyaniveditam /
agrāhyaṃ śivanirmālyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam //
meaning:
तत्तद्भक्तैर्गृही तव्यं तन्नैवेद्यनिवेदितम् /
अग्राह्यं शिवनिर्माल्यं पत्रं पुष्पं फलं जलम् //
text_mt: That which has been dedicated as a food offering should be received by the respective devotees. / Unacceptable are the offerings to Śiva: a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāsparśātsarvaṃ yāti pavitratām /
pūjā pañcavidhā tatra kathitā nāradākhilaiḥ //
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलास्पर्शात्सर्वं याति पवित्रताम् /
पूजा पञ्चविधा तत्र कथिता नारदाखिलैः //
text_mt: From contact with a śālagrāma stone, everything attains purity. / Worship has been declared there to be of five kinds by all, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
āturī sautikī trāsī sādhanā bhāvinī tathā /
daurbodhī ca kramādāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni śṛṇuṣaava me //
meaning:
आतुरी सौतिकी त्रासी साधना भाविनी तथा /
दौर्बोधी च क्रमादासां लक्षणानि शृणुषअव मे //
text_mt: āturī (the afflicted), sautikī (of impurity), trāsī (of fear), sādhanābhāvinī (of lacking means), / and daurbodhī (of ignorance). Hear from me their characteristics in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
rogādiyukto na srāyānna japenna ca pūjayet /
vilokya pūjāṃ devasya mūrtiṃ vā sūryyamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
रोगादियुक्तो न स्रायान्न जपेन्न च पूजयेत् /
विलोक्य पूजां देवस्य मूर्तिं वा सूर्य्यमण्डलम् //
text_mt: One afflicted with illness or the like should not bathe, should not recite, and should not worship. / Having beheld the worship of the god, or the image, or the orb of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyātha smaranmantramarpayetkumāñjalim /
roge nivṛtte snātvātha natvā saṃpūñcedgurum //
meaning:
प्रणम्याथ स्मरन्मन्त्रमर्पयेत्कुमाञ्जलिम् /
रोगे निवृत्ते स्नात्वाथ नत्वा संपूञ्चेद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: having bowed and then remembering the mantra, one should offer a handful of flowers. / When the illness has ceased, having bathed, bowed, and worshipped the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
tvatprasādājjagannātha jagatpūjya dayānidhe /
pūjāvicchedadoṣo me māstviti prārthayecca tam //
meaning:
त्वत्प्रसादाज्जगन्नाथ जगत्पूज्य दयानिधे /
पूजाविच्छेददोषो मे मास्त्विति प्रार्थयेच्च तम् //
text_mt: one should pray to him: "By your grace, O Lord of the world, worthy of the world's worship, O ocean of mercy, / may there be no fault on my part for interrupting the worship."

sanskrit_iast:
dvijānapi ca saṃpūjya yathāśaktyā pratoṣya ca /
tebhyaścāśiṣamādāya devaṃ prāgvattator'cayet //
meaning:
द्विजानपि च संपूज्य यथाशक्त्या प्रतोष्य च /
तेभ्यश्चाशिषमादाय देवं प्राग्वत्ततोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the twice-born also, pleasing them according to one's ability, / and receiving blessings from them, one should then worship the god as before.

sanskrit_iast:
āturī kathitā hyeṣā sotikyatha nigadyate /
sūtakaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ jātākhyaṃ mṛtasaṃjñakam //
meaning:
आतुरी कथिता ह्येषा सोतिक्यथ निगद्यते /
सूतकं द्विविधं प्रोक्तं जाताख्यं मृतसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt: This has indeed been declared as āturī; now sautikī is described. / Impurity is said to be of two kinds: that called birth-impurity and that called death-impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā mānasīṃ tu kṛtvā saṃdhyāṃ samāhitaḥ /
manasaiva yajeddevaṃ manasaiva japenmanum //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा मानसीं तु कृत्वा संध्यां समाहितः /
मनसैव यजेद्देवं मनसैव जपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: There, having bathed and performed the twilight worship mentally, concentrated in mind, / one should worship the god solely with the mind and recite the mantra solely with the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛtte sūtake prāgvatsaṃpūjya ca guruṃ dvijān /
tebhyaścāśiṣamādāya tato nityakramaṃ caret //
meaning:
निवृत्ते सूतके प्राग्वत्संपूज्य च गुरुं द्विजान् /
तेभ्यश्चाशिषमादाय ततो नित्यक्रमं चरेत् //
text_mt: When the impurity has ended, having worshipped the guru and the twice-born as before, / and receiving blessings from them, one should then perform the daily sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā tu sautikī proktā trāsī cātha nigadyate /
duṣṭebhyastrāsamāpanno yathālabdhopacāraṅkaiḥ //
meaning:
एषा तु सौतिकी प्रोक्ता त्रासी चाथ निगद्यते /
दुष्टेभ्यस्त्रासमापन्नो यथालब्धोपचारङ्कैः //
text_mt: This is proclaimed as sautikī; now trāsī is described. / One who has incurred terror from wicked persons, using whatever offerings are available,

sanskrit_iast:
mānasairvai yajeddevaṃ trāsī sā parikīrtitā /
pūjāsādhanavastūnāma sāmarthye tu sarvataḥ //
meaning:
मानसैर्वै यजेद्देवं त्रासी सा परिकीर्तिता /
पूजासाधनवस्तूनाम सामर्थ्ये तु सर्वतः //
text_mt: or indeed through mental ones, should worship the god: that is celebrated as trāsī. / When there is total incapacity with regard to the articles for worship,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalairvāpi manasā vā yajedvibhum /
sādhanābhāvinī hyeṣā daurbodhīṃ śṛṇu nārada //
meaning:
पुष्पैः पत्रैः फलैर्वापि मनसा वा यजेद्विभुम् /
साधनाभाविनी ह्येषा दौर्बोधीं शृणु नारद //
text_mt: one should worship the all-pervading Lord with flowers, leaves, fruits, or even with the mind: / this is sādhanābhāvinī. Hear of daurbodhī, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
striyo vṛddhā stathā bālā mūrkhāstaistu yathākramam /
yathājñānakṛtā sā tu daurbodhīti prakīrtitā //
meaning:
स्त्रियो वृद्धा स्तथा बाला मूर्खास्तैस्तु यथाक्रमम् /
यथाज्ञानकृता सा तु दौर्बोधीति प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt: Worship performed by women, the elderly, children, and fools, according to their capacity, / in accordance with their limited knowledge, is celebrated as daurbodhī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yathākathañcittu pūjāṃ kuryāddhi sādhakaḥ /
devapūjāvihīno yaḥ sa gacchennarakaṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
एवं यथाकथञ्चित्तु पूजां कुर्याद्धि साधकः /
देवपूजाविहीनो यः स गच्छेन्नरकं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Thus, somehow or other, the practitioner should indeed perform worship; / one who is destitute of worship of God surely goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevādikaṃ kṛtvā bhojayeddvijasattamān /
deve niveditaṃ paścādbhuñjīta svagaṇaiḥ svayam //
meaning:
वैश्वदेवादिकं कृत्वा भोजयेद्द्विजसत्तमान् /
देवे निवेदितं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत स्वगणैः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Having performed the vaiśvadeva and other rites, one should feed the best of the twice-born; / afterwards, one should oneself eat together with one's dependents what was offered to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamyānanaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā tiṣṭet kiyatkṣaṇam /
purāṇamitihāsaṃ ca śṛṇuyātsvajanaiḥ saha //
meaning:
आचम्याननशुद्धिं च कृत्वा तिष्टेत् कियत्क्षणम् /
पुराणमितिहासं च शृणुयात्स्वजनैः सह //
text_mt: Having sipped water and cleansed the mouth, one should sit for a few moments, / and listen to a Purāṇa and Itihāsa together with one's kin.

sanskrit_iast:
samarthaḥ sarvakalpeṣu yo 'nukalpaṃ samācaret /
na sāṃgaśayikaṃ tasya durmaterjāyate phalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde devapūjānirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭittamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
समर्थः सर्वकल्पेषु यो ऽनुकल्पं समाचरेत् /
न सांगशयिकं तस्य दुर्मतेर्जायते फलम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे देवपूजानिरूपणं नाम सप्तषष्टित्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
One who, being capable of all the primary rules, resorts to a secondary rule, / is of corrupted mind; no fruit of his, accompanied by all limbs, is produced.

Thus ends the sixty-seventh chapter, named "Ascertainment of the Worship of the Deity", in the Third Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsanatkumāra uvāca /
atha vakṣye gaṇeśasya mantrānsarveṣṭadāyakān /
yānsamārādhya viprendra sādhako bhuktimuktimān //
meaning:
श्रीसनत्कुमार उवाच /
अथ वक्ष्ये गणेशस्य मन्त्रान्सर्वेष्टदायकान् /
यान्समाराध्य विप्रेन्द्र साधको भुक्तिमुक्तिमान् //
text_mt: Illustrious Sanatkumāra said: / Now I shall declare the mantras of Gaṇeśa that grant all desires, / by worshipping which, O best of vipras, the practitioner obtains enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
avyayo viṣṇuvanitā śaṃbhustrī mīnaketanaḥ /
smṛtirmāṃseṃdumanvāḍhyā sā punaścandraśekharā //
meaning:
अव्ययो विष्णुवनिता शंभुस्त्री मीनकेतनः /
स्मृतिर्मांसेंदुमन्वाढ्या सा पुनश्चन्द्रशेखरा //
text_mt: The imperishable [oṃ], the consort of Viṣṇu [śrīm], the wife of Śambhu [hrīm], the fish-bannered [klīm], / memory endowed with meat and moon [glaum], and that adorned with the crest-moon [gam],

sanskrit_iast:
ṅeṃto gaṇapatistoyaṃ bhujaṅgo varadeti ca /
sarvānte janamuñcārya tato me vaśamānaya //
meaning:
ङेंतो गणपतिस्तोयं भुजङ्गो वरदेति च /
सर्वान्ते जनमुञ्चार्य ततो मे वशमानय //
text_mt: Gaṇapati ending in ṅe [gaṇapataye], water [vara], snake [varada], and 'grant boons' [varada], / after all uttering 'people' [sarvajanam], and then 'bring into my control' [me vaśam ānaya],

sanskrit_iast:
vahniḥ priyānto mantro 'yaṣṭāviṃśativarṇavān /
gaṇako 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī viyudādikā //
meaning:
वह्निः प्रियान्तो मन्त्रो ऽयष्टाविंशतिवर्णवान् /
गणको ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री वियुदादिका //
text_mt: ending with the beloved of fire [svāhā]—this mantra consists of twenty-eight syllables. / Its sage is Gaṇaka; the meter is Gāyatrī beginning with viyad;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśo devatā bījaṃ ṣaṣṭaśaktistadādikā /
śrīmanmahāgaṇapatiprītaye viniyogakaḥ //
meaning:
गणेशो देवता बीजं षष्टशक्तिस्तदादिका /
श्रीमन्महागणपतिप्रीतये विनियोगकः //
text_mt: Gaṇeśa is the deity; the seed is the sixth [gam]; the power is that which begins it [śrīm]; / the application is for the pleasing of the glorious Mahāgaṇapati.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṃ śirasi vakre tu chandaśca hṛdi devatām /
guhye bījaṃ padoḥ śaktiṃ nyasetsādhakasattamaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिं शिरसि वक्रे तु छन्दश्च हृदि देवताम् /
गुह्ये बीजं पदोः शक्तिं न्यसेत्साधकसत्तमः //
text_mt: The sage on the head, the meter on the mouth, the deity on the heart, / the seed on the private parts, and the power on the feet: the best of practitioners should place them.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena yaṃ ca bījādinā punaḥ /
ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasedasya jātiyuktāni mantravit //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन यं च बीजादिना पुनः /
षडङ्गानि न्यसेदस्य जातियुक्तानि मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: With the seed endowed with the six long vowels, and again with the seed and the rest, / the knower of mantra should place its six limbs endowed with their endings.

sanskrit_iast:
śaivī ṣaḍaṅgamudrāya nyastavyā hi ṣaḍaṅgake /
gāmādyaṃ caiva bhūrlokaṃ nābhyantaṃ pādayornyaset //
meaning:
शैवी षडङ्गमुद्राय न्यस्तव्या हि षडङ्गके /
गामाद्यं चैव भूर्लोकं नाभ्यन्तं पादयोर्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: The Śaivite six-limb gesture must be applied to the six limbs. / One should place Bhūrloka beginning with 'gām' from the feet up to the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
gīmādyaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ kaṇṭhāntaṃ nābhito nyaset /
svarlokaṃ caiva gūmādyaṃ kaṇṭhadimastakāvadhi //
meaning:
गीमाद्यं च भुवर्लोकं कण्ठान्तं नाभितो न्यसेत् /
स्वर्लोकं चैव गूमाद्यं कण्ठदिमस्तकावधि //
text_mt: and Bhuvarloka beginning with 'gīm' from the navel up to the throat; / and Svarloka beginning with 'gūm' from the throat up to the head.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ mūlamantreṇa nyāso 'yaṃ bhuvanābhidhaḥ /
mūlamantraṃ samuñcārya mātṛkāvarṇamīrayet //
meaning:
व्यापकं मूलमन्त्रेण न्यासो ऽयं भुवनाभिधः /
मूलमन्त्रं समुञ्चार्य मातृकावर्णमीरयेत् //
text_mt: Then an all-pervading [placement] with the root mantra; this is the placement named bhuvanā. / Uttering the root mantra, one should recite the mātṛkā letter;

sanskrit_iast:
tadante 'pi ca mūlaṃ syānnamoṃ'taṃ mātṛkāsthale /
kṣāntaṃ vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ racayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
तदन्ते ऽपि च मूलं स्यान्नमोंऽतं मातृकास्थले /
क्षान्तं विन्यस्य मूलेन व्यापकं रचयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: at its end too should be the root mantra, ending with 'namaḥ', at the site of the mātṛkā. / Placing [them] up to 'kṣa', the wise one should perform an all-pervading [placement] with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇanyā so 'yamākhyātaḥ padanyāsastathocyate /
pañcatribāṇavahnīnducandrākṣinigamaiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
वर्णन्या सो ऽयमाख्यातः पदन्यासस्तथोच्यते /
पञ्चत्रिबाणवह्नीन्दुचन्द्राक्षिनिगमैः क्रमात् //
text_mt: This is described as the placement of syllables; now the placement of words is declared: / By five, three, five, three, one, one, two, and four in order,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktairmūlagāyatryā hṛdantairaṣṭabhiḥ padaiḥ /
bhāladeśe mukhe kaṇṭhe hṛdi nābhyūrujānuṣu //
meaning:
विभक्तैर्मूलगायत्र्या हृदन्तैरष्टभिः पदैः /
भालदेशे मुखे कण्ठे हृदि नाभ्यूरुजानुषु //
text_mt: divided by the eight words of the root gāyatrī ending with 'hṛd', / on the forehead, the mouth, the throat, the heart, the navel, thighs, and knees,

sanskrit_iast:
pādayoścaiva vinyasya mūlane vyāpakaṃ caret /
vadettatpuruṣāyānte vidmaheti padaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
पादयोश्चैव विन्यस्य मूलने व्यापकं चरेत् /
वदेत्तत्पुरुषायान्ते विद्महेति पदं ततः //
text_mt: and placing on the two feet, one should perform an all-pervading [placement] with the root mantra. / One should say the word 'tatpuruṣāya', and next 'vidmahe';

sanskrit_iast:
vakratuṇḍāya śabdānte dhīmahīti samīrayet /
tanno dantiḥ pracovarṇā dayāditi vadetpunaḥ //
meaning:
वक्रतुण्डाय शब्दान्ते धीमहीति समीरयेत् /
तन्नो दन्तिः प्रचोवर्णा दयादिति वदेत्पुनः //
text_mt: after the words 'vakratuṇḍāya', one should utter 'dhīmahi'; / 'tanno dantiḥ pracodayāt' one should say next.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣoktā mūlagāyatrī sarvasiddhipradāyinī /
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedevaṃ hṛdaṃbuje //
meaning:
एषोक्ता मूलगायत्री सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनी /
एवं न्यासविधिं कृत्वा ध्यायेदेवं हृदंबुजे //
text_mt: This is declared to be the root gāyatrī, the giver of all attainments. / Having performed this procedure of ritual placement, one should meditate in this manner in the lotus of the heart:

sanskrit_iast:
udyanmārtaṇḍasadṛśaṃ lokasthityantakāraṇam /
saśaktikaṃ bhūṣitāṅgaṃ danta cakrādyudāyudham //
meaning:
उद्यन्मार्तण्डसदृशं लोकस्थित्यन्तकारणम् /
सशक्तिकं भूषिताङ्गं दन्त चक्राद्युदायुधम् //
text_mt: Resembling the rising sun, the cause of the preservation and destruction of the world, / accompanied by his śakti, his limbs adorned, raising weapons beginning with the tusk and discus.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā catuścatvāriṃśatsāhasrasaṃyutam /
caturlakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ aṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्साहस्रसंयुतम् /
चतुर्लक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं अष्टद्रव्यैर्दशांशतः //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should recite the mantra four hundred and forty-four thousand times. / With eight substances, one-tenth [of the total]

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādvidhivanmantrī saṃskṛte havyavāhane /
ikṣavaḥ saktavo mocāphalāni cipiṭāstilāḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयाद्विधिवन्मन्त्री संस्कृते हव्यवाहने /
इक्षवः सक्तवो मोचाफलानि चिपिटास्तिलाः //
text_mt: the mantra-practitioner should offer in fire oblation according to rule into consecrated fire. / Sugarcanes, barley flour, plantains, flattened rice, sesame seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
modakā nārikelāni lājā dravyāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam /
pīṭhamādhāraśaktyādiparatatvāntamarcayet //
meaning:
मोदका नारिकेलानि लाजा द्रव्याष्टकं स्मृतम् /
पीठमाधारशक्त्यादिपरतत्वान्तमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: modakas, coconuts, and puffed grain: this is remembered as the group of eight substances. / One should worship the ritual seat from the base-power up to the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇāntastrikoṇaṃ ca bahiraṣṭadalaṃ likhet /
bhūpuraṃ tadbahiḥ kṛtvā gameśaṃ tatra pūjayet //
meaning:
षट्कोणान्तस्त्रिकोणं च बहिरष्टदलं लिखेत् /
भूपुरं तद्बहिः कृत्वा गमेशं तत्र पूजयेत् //
text_mt: One should draw a triangle within a six-pointed star, and outside an eight-petalled [lotus]; / having made an earth-enclosure outside that, one should worship Gaṇeśa there.

sanskrit_iast:
tīvrākhyā jvālinī nandā bhogadā kāmarūpāṇī /
agrā tejovatī satyā navamī vidhnanāśinī //
meaning:
तीव्राख्या ज्वालिनी नन्दा भोगदा कामरूपाणी /
अग्रा तेजोवती सत्या नवमी विध्ननाशिनी //
text_mt: Tīvrā, Jvālinī, Nandā, Bhogadā, Kāmarūpiṇī, / Ugrā, Tejovatī, Satyā, and ninth, Vighnanāśinī.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādiśaktikamalāsanāya hṛdayāntikaḥ /
pīṭhamantro 'yametena dadyādāsanamuttamam //
meaning:
सर्वादिशक्तिकमलासनाय हृदयान्तिकः /
पीठमन्त्रो ऽयमेतेन दद्यादासनमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: 'To the lotus-seat of all primordial powers' ending with hṛdaya ['namaḥ']— / this is the seat-mantra; with this, one should offer the excellent seat.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvāhya gaṇādhīśaṃ madhye sampūjya yatnataḥ /
vikoṇabāhye pūrvādicaturdikṣaavarcayetkramāt //
meaning:
तत्रावाह्य गणाधीशं मध्ये सम्पूज्य यत्नतः /
विकोणबाह्ये पूर्वादिचतुर्दिक्षअवर्चयेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: Invoking the Lord of the Ganas there, and carefully worshipping him in the center, / outside the triangle, in the four directions beginning with the east, one should worship in order:

sanskrit_iast:
śriyaṃ śriyaḥ patiṃ caiva gaurīṃ gaurī patiṃ tathā /
ratiṃ ratipatiṃ pāścānmahīpūrva ca potriṇam //
meaning:
श्रियं श्रियः पतिं चैव गौरीं गौरी पतिं तथा /
रतिं रतिपतिं पाश्चान्महीपूर्व च पोत्रिणम् //
text_mt: Śrī and the husband of Śrī; Gaurī and the husband of Gaurī; / Rati and the husband of Rati; and next, the Earth and the Boar.

sanskrit_iast:
kramādilvavaṭāśvatthapriyagūnāmadhor'cayet /
ramā padmadvayakarā śaṅkhacakradharo hariḥ //
meaning:
क्रमादिल्ववटाश्वत्थप्रियगूनामधोर्ऽचयेत् /
रमा पद्मद्वयकरा शङ्खचक्रधरो हरिः //
text_mt: In order, one should worship them beneath bilva, banyan, peepal, and priyaṅgu trees. / Ramā has two lotuses in her hands; Hari holds a conch and a discus.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī pāśāṅkuśadharā ṭaṅkaśūladharo haraḥ /
ratiḥ padmakarā puṣpabāṇacāpadharaḥ smaraḥ //
meaning:
गौरी पाशाङ्कुशधरा टङ्कशूलधरो हरः /
रतिः पद्मकरा पुष्पबाणचापधरः स्मरः //
text_mt: Gaurī holds a noose and a goad; Hara holds a chisel and a trident. / Rati has a lotus in her hand; Smara holds a flower-arrow and a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
śūkavrīhyagrahastā bhūḥ potrī cakragadādharaḥ /
devāgre pūjayellakṣmīsahitaṃ tu vināyakam //
meaning:
शूकव्रीह्यग्रहस्ता भूः पोत्री चक्रगदाधरः /
देवाग्रे पूजयेल्लक्ष्मीसहितं तु विनायकम् //
text_mt: The Earth holds awns and the tops of grain in her hands; the Boar holds a discus and a mace. / Before the deity, one should worship Vināyaka accompanied by Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetṣaṭsu koṇeṣu hyāmodādyānpriyāyutān /
āmodaṃ siddhisaṃyuktamagrataḥ paripījayet //
meaning:
पूजयेत्षट्सु कोणेषु ह्यामोदाद्यान्प्रियायुतान् /
आमोदं सिद्धिसंयुक्तमग्रतः परिपीजयेत् //
text_mt: In the six corners, one should worship those beginning with Āmoda together with their beloveds. / One should worship Āmoda endowed with Siddhi in front;

sanskrit_iast:
pramodaṃ cāgnikoṇe tu samṛddhisahitaṃ yajet /
īśakoṇe yajetkīrtisaṃyutaṃ sumukhaṃ tathā //
meaning:
प्रमोदं चाग्निकोणे तु समृद्धिसहितं यजेत् /
ईशकोणे यजेत्कीर्तिसंयुतं सुमुखं तथा //
text_mt: and Pramoda endowed with Samṛddhi in the fire corner [southeast]; / in the northeast corner, one should worship Sumukha accompanied by Kīrti;

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇe madanāvatyā saṃyutaṃ durmukhaṃ yajet /
yajennairṛtyakoṇe tu vighnaṃ madadravāyutam //
meaning:
वारुणे मदनावत्या संयुतं दुर्मुखं यजेत् /
यजेन्नैरृत्यकोणे तु विघ्नं मदद्रवायुतम् //
text_mt: in the western direction, one should worship Durmukha endowed with Madanāvatī; / in the southwest corner, one should worship Vighna accompanied by Madadravā;

sanskrit_iast:
drāviṇyā vighnakartāraṃ vāyukoṇe samarcayet /
pāśāṅkuśābhayakarāṃstaruṇārkasamaprabhān //
meaning:
द्राविण्या विघ्नकर्तारं वायुकोणे समर्चयेत् /
पाशाङ्कुशाभयकरांस्तरुणार्कसमप्रभान् //
text_mt: in the wind corner [northwest], one should worship Vighnakartṛ with Drāviṇī. / Holding a noose, a goad, and granting fearlessness with their hands, radiant as the morning sun,

sanskrit_iast:
kapolavigaladdānagandhalubdhā liśobhitān /
ṣaṭkoṇobhayapārśve tu śaṅkhapadmanibhau kramāt //
meaning:
कपोलविगलद्दानगन्धलुब्धा लिशोभितान् /
षट्कोणोभयपार्श्वे तु शङ्खपद्मनिभौ क्रमात् //
text_mt: adorned with bees attracted by the scent of ichor trickling from their temples; / and on both sides of the six-pointed star, those resembling Conch and Lotus in order,

sanskrit_iast:
sahitau nijaśaktibhyāṃ dhyātvā pūrvavadarcayet /
keśareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvaṣṭau tu mātaraḥ //
meaning:
सहितौ निजशक्तिभ्यां ध्यात्वा पूर्ववदर्चयेत् /
केशरेषु षडङ्गानि पत्रेष्वष्टौ तु मातरः //
text_mt: accompanied by their own śaktis, having meditated [on them], one should worship as before. / The six limbs on the filaments, and the eight Mothers on the petals,

sanskrit_iast:
indrādyānapi vajjrādīnpūjayeddharaṇīgṛhe /
evamārādhya vighneśaṃ sādhayetsvamanorathān //
meaning:
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्ज्रादीन्पूजयेद्धरणीगृहे /
एवमाराध्य विघ्नेशं साधयेत्स्वमनोरथान् //
text_mt: and Indra and the others, as well as the thunderbolt and other [weapons], one should worship in the earth-enclosure. / Having worshipped the Lord of Obstacles in this way, one achieves one's desires.

sanskrit_iast:
catuścatvāriṃśatāḍhyaṃ catuḥ śatamatandritaḥ /
tarpayedaṃbubhiḥ śuddhairgajāsyaṃ dinaśaḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
चतुश्चत्वारिंशताढ्यं चतुः शतमतन्द्रितः /
तर्पयेदंबुभिः शुद्धैर्गजास्यं दिनशः सुधीः //
text_mt: Four hundred and forty-four times, unwearied, / the wise one should daily offer water-libation to the elephant-faced god with pure waters.

sanskrit_iast:
padmaistu vaśayedbhūpāṃstatpatnīścotpalaistathā /
kumudairmantriṇo 'śvatthasamidbhirvāḍavāñśubhaiḥ //
meaning:
पद्मैस्तु वशयेद्भूपांस्तत्पत्नीश्चोत्पलैस्तथा /
कुमुदैर्मन्त्रिणो ऽश्वत्थसमिद्भिर्वाडवाञ्शुभैः //
text_mt: With lotuses he should subjugate kings, and with blue water-lilies their queens; / with white water-lilies ministers, and with auspicious peepal fuel-sticks brāhmaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
uduṃmbarotthairnṛpatīnvaiśyānplakṣasamudbhavaiḥ /
vaṭodbhavaiḥ samidbhiśca vaśayedantimānbudhaḥ //
meaning:
उदुंम्बरोत्थैर्नृपतीन्वैश्यान्प्लक्षसमुद्भवैः /
वटोद्भवैः समिद्भिश्च वशयेदन्तिमान्बुधः //
text_mt: with those from the udumbara, kings; with those from the plakṣa, vaiśyas; / and with fuel-sticks from the banyan tree, the wise one should subjugate the last [varṇa].

sanskrit_iast:
ājyena śriyamāpnoti svarṇāptirmadhunā bhavet /
godugdhena gavāṃ lābho dadhnā sarvasamṛddhimān //
meaning:
आज्येन श्रियमाप्नोति स्वर्णाप्तिर्मधुना भवेत् /
गोदुग्धेन गवां लाभो दध्ना सर्वसमृद्धिमान् //
text_mt: Through ghee one attains fortune; the acquisition of gold comes through honey; / through cow's milk the obtaining of cattle; through curd one obtains all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
annāptirannahomena samidbhirvetasāṃ jalam /
vāsāṃsi labhate hutvā kusuṃbhakusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
अन्नाप्तिरन्नहोमेन समिद्भिर्वेतसां जलम् /
वासांसि लभते हुत्वा कुसुंभकुसुमैः शुभैः //
text_mt: The obtaining of food comes through food-oblations; with fuel-sticks of the reed, water; / by offering oblations with auspicious safflower flowers, one obtains garments.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sarveṣṭadaṃ vakṣye caturāvṛttitarpaṇam /
mūlenādau caturvāraṃ pratyekaṃ ca pratarpayet //
meaning:
अथ सर्वेष्टदं वक्ष्ये चतुरावृत्तितर्पणम् /
मूलेनादौ चतुर्वारं प्रत्येकं च प्रतर्पयेत् //
text_mt: Now I shall declare the fourfold libation that bestows all desires: / At first, with the root mantra, one should offer libation four times for each,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamantrākṣarairmantraiḥ svāhāntaiśca catuścatuḥ /
mūlamantraiścaturvārapūrvakaṃ saṃpratarpya ca //
meaning:
पूर्वमन्त्राक्षरैर्मन्त्रैः स्वाहान्तैश्च चतुश्चतुः /
मूलमन्त्रैश्चतुर्वारपूर्वकं संप्रतर्प्य च //
text_mt: with mantras of the syllables of the former mantra ending with 'svāhā', four by four; / having offered libations preceded by four times with the root mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
mithunādīṃstataḥ paścātpūrvavatsaṃpratarpayet /
devena sahitāṃ śaktiṃ śaktyā ca sahitaṃ tu tam //
meaning:
मिथुनादींस्ततः पश्चात्पूर्ववत्संप्रतर्पयेत् /
देवेन सहितां शक्तिं शक्त्या च सहितं तु तम् //
text_mt: one should then offer libations as before to the couples and others: / to the śakti accompanied by the god, and to him accompanied by the śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
evañca ṣaḍviṃśatidhā mithunāni bhavanti hi /
svanāmādyarṇabījāni tāni santarpayetkramāt //
meaning:
एवञ्च षड्विंशतिधा मिथुनानि भवन्ति हि /
स्वनामाद्यर्णबीजानि तानि सन्तर्पयेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: In this manner, there are twenty-six couples; / one should offer libations to them in order, using the seed-syllables that begin their own names.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavetsaṃbhūya sacatuścatvāriṃśañcatuḥ śatam /
evaṃ saṃtapya tatpaścātpūrvavatsopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
भवेत्संभूय सचतुश्चत्वारिंशञ्चतुः शतम् /
एवं संतप्य तत्पश्चात्पूर्ववत्सोपचारकैः //
text_mt: Together, they amount to four hundred and forty-four. / Having offered libations thus, thereafter with the offerings of attendance as before,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhīṣṭaṃ ca saṃprārthya praṇamyodvāsayetsudhīḥ /
bhādrakṛṣṇacaturthyādipratimāsamatandritaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाभीष्टं च संप्रार्थ्य प्रणम्योद्वासयेत्सुधीः /
भाद्रकृष्णचतुर्थ्यादिप्रतिमासमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: having prayed for all desires and bowed down, the wise one should bid farewell [to the deity]. / Beginning on the fourth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, each month, untiring,

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhyārke dayaṃ mantrī yāvaccandrodayo bhavet /
tāvannopaviśedbhūmau jitavākkriyāmānasaḥ //
meaning:
आरभ्यार्के दयं मन्त्री यावच्चन्द्रोदयो भवेत् /
तावन्नोपविशेद्भूमौ जितवाक्क्रियामानसः //
text_mt: starting from sunrise until the rising of the moon, / the practitioner, controlling his speech, action, and mind, should not sit on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścandrodaye mantrī pūjayedgaṇanāyakam /
pūrvoktavidhinā samyaṅnānāpuṣpopahārakaiḥ //
meaning:
ततश्चन्द्रोदये मन्त्री पूजयेद्गणनायकम् /
पूर्वोक्तविधिना सम्यङ्नानापुष्पोपहारकैः //
text_mt: Then, at moonrise, the practitioner should worship the Leader of the Gaṇas / according to the previously stated rule, properly, with various flowers and offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākānmodakāṃśca nivedayet /
tadagre prajapenmantramaṣṭottarasahasrakam //
meaning:
एकविंशतिसंख्याकान्मोदकांश्च निवेदयेत् /
तदग्रे प्रजपेन्मन्त्रमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: And he should offer twenty-one sweetmeats; / in front of him, he should recite the mantra one thousand and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ karpūrakāśmīraraktapuṣpaiḥ sacandanaiḥ /
ardhyaṃ dadyāttu mūlānte ṅeṃte gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
ततः कर्पूरकाश्मीररक्तपुष्पैः सचन्दनैः /
अर्ध्यं दद्यात्तु मूलान्ते ङेंते गणपतिं ततः //
text_mt: Then, with camphor, saffron, and red flowers along with sandalwood, / he should offer water for the arghya with the root mantra followed by ‘gaṇapataye’ in the dative case.

sanskrit_iast:
idamardhyaṃ kalpayāmi hṛdantor'dhyamanurmataḥ /
stutvā natvā visṛjyātha yajeccandramasaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
इदमर्ध्यं कल्पयामि हृदन्तोर्ऽध्यमनुर्मतः /
स्तुत्वा नत्वा विसृज्याथ यजेच्चन्द्रमसं पुनः //
text_mt: ‘I prepare this water for the arghya’ ending with ‘namaḥ’ is regarded as the arghya mantra. / Having praised, bowed down, and dismissed [him], he should then worship the Moon again.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhyaṃ dadyāñcaturvāraṃ pūjayitvā guruṃ tataḥ /
nivediteṣu viprāya dadyādardhāṃśca modakān //
meaning:
अर्ध्यं दद्याञ्चतुर्वारं पूजयित्वा गुरुं ततः /
निवेदितेषु विप्राय दद्यादर्धांश्च मोदकान् //
text_mt: He should offer the arghya four times, and then, having worshipped the guru, / he should give half of the offered sweetmeats to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamarddhānprabhuñjīta brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ /
evaṃ vrataṃ yaḥ kurute samyaksaṃvatsarāvadhi //
meaning:
स्वयमर्द्धान्प्रभुञ्जीत ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः /
एवं व्रतं यः कुरुते सम्यक्संवत्सरावधि //
text_mt: He should himself eat the other half, practicing celibacy and mastering his senses. / The man who performs this observance properly for the duration of a year

sanskrit_iast:
putrānpautrānsukhaṃ vittamārogyaṃ labhate naraḥ /
sūryodayādaśaktaścedastamārabhya mantravit //
meaning:
पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सुखं वित्तमारोग्यं लभते नरः /
सूर्योदयादशक्तश्चेदस्तमारभ्य मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: obtains sons, grandsons, happiness, wealth, and good health. / If incapable of [fasting] from sunrise, the knower of mantras, beginning from sunset

sanskrit_iast:
candrodayāntaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā vratamācaret /
evaṃ kṛte 'pi pūrvoktaṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam //
meaning:
चन्द्रोदयान्तं पूर्वोक्तविधिना व्रतमाचरेत् /
एवं कृते ऽपि पूर्वोक्तं फलमाप्नोति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: until moonrise, should perform the observance according to the previously stated rule. / Even when performed in this manner, he certainly obtains the aforementioned fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇiśapratimāṃ dantidantena kapināpi vā /
gajabhagrena niṃbena sitārkeṃṇāthavā punaḥ //
meaning:
गणिशप्रतिमां दन्तिदन्तेन कपिनापि वा /
गजभग्रेन निंबेन सितार्केंणाथवा पुनः //
text_mt: Having fashioned an image of Gaṇeśa from an elephant's tusk or monkey-wood, / from a neem tree broken by an elephant, or from white arka wood,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tasyāṃ samāvāhya prāṇasthāpanapūrvakam /
abhyarcya vidhivanmantrī rāhugraste niśākare //
meaning:
कृत्वा तस्यां समावाह्य प्राणस्थापनपूर्वकम् /
अभ्यर्च्य विधिवन्मन्त्री राहुग्रस्ते निशाकरे //
text_mt: and having invoked [him] in it after first infusing it with life-breath, / the mantra practitioner, worshipping [him] according to rule during a lunar eclipse,

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭrā caiva nirahārastāṃ śikhāyāṃ samudvahan /
dyūte vivāde samare vyavahāre jayaṃ labhet //
meaning:
स्पृष्ट्रा चैव निरहारस्तां शिखायां समुद्वहन् /
द्यूते विवादे समरे व्यवहारे जयं लभेत् //
text_mt: touching it and abstaining from food, bearing it upon his topknot, / shall attain victory in gambling, in dispute, in battle, and in legal affairs.

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ varāho binddhāḍhyau manvindvānnau kalau tataḥ /
smṛtirmāṃseṃdumanvāgrā karṇocchiṣṭagaṇe vadet //
meaning:
बीजं वराहो बिन्द्धाढ्यौ मन्विन्द्वान्नौ कलौ ततः /
स्मृतिर्मांसेंदुमन्वाग्रा कर्णोच्छिष्टगणे वदेत् //
text_mt: The seed-syllable is the boar endowed with bindu; then the eleventh vowel endowed with moon and fire; / then memory endowed with flesh, moon, and fire; in [the mantra of] Ucchiṣṭa-Gaṇapati one should speak the ear;

sanskrit_iast:
bakaḥ sadīrghapavano mahāyakṣāya yaṃ baliḥ /
balimantro 'yamākhyāto na cedvarṇo 'khileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
बकः सदीर्घपवनो महायक्षाय यं बलिः /
बलिमन्त्रो ऽयमाख्यातो न चेद्वर्णो ऽखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: baka endowed with long wind, and ‘to the great yakṣa’ followed by ‘baliṃ namaḥ’— / this is declared to be the bali-mantra, granting all desires even if not [repeated] in syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo bhuvaneśānīsvabījānte navārṇakaḥ /
hastīti ca piśācīti likheñcaivāgriṃsuṃdarī //
meaning:
प्रणवो भुवनेशानीस्वबीजान्ते नवार्णकः /
हस्तीति च पिशाचीति लिखेञ्चैवाग्रिंसुंदरी //
text_mt: Beginning with the praṇava and the Bhuvaneśānī [seed] followed by its own seed-syllable, the nine-syllabled mantra consists of: / ‘hasti-piśāci-likhe svāhā’.

sanskrit_iast:
navārṇo 'yaṃ samuddiṣṭo bhajatāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ /
padaiḥ sarvaṇa mantreṇa pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet //
meaning:
नवार्णो ऽयं समुद्दिष्टो भजतां सर्वसिद्धिदः /
पदैः सर्वण मन्त्रेण पञ्चाङ्गानि प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: This nine-syllabled [mantra] is declared to bestow all accomplishments on those who worship [him]. / One should assign the five limbs with the words of the entire mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatsarvaṃ samānaṃ syātpūrvamantreṇa nārada /
athābhidhāsye vidhivadvakratuṇḍamanuttamam //
meaning:
अन्यत्सर्वं समानं स्यात्पूर्वमन्त्रेण नारद /
अथाभिधास्ये विधिवद्वक्रतुण्डमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Everything else is identical to the previous mantra, O Nārada. / Now I shall explain according to rule the unsurpassed mantra of Vakratuṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
toyaṃ vidhirvahniyuktakarṇendvāḍhyo haristathā /
sadīrgho dārako vāyurvarmānto 'yaṃ rasārṇakaḥ //
meaning:
तोयं विधिर्वह्नियुक्तकर्णेन्द्वाढ्यो हरिस्तथा /
सदीर्घो दारको वायुर्वर्मान्तो ऽयं रसार्णकः //
text_mt: Water, Vidhi accompanied by fire, and Hari endowed with ear and moon, / long dāraka, wind, ending in armor—this is the six-syllabled [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavo 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭubdevo gaṇādhipaḥ /
vakratuṇḍābhidho bījaṃ vaṃ śaktiḥ kavacaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
भार्गवो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुब्देवो गणाधिपः /
वक्रतुण्डाभिधो बीजं वं शक्तिः कवचं पुनः //
text_mt: Bhārgava is its seer; the metre is anuṣṭubh; the deity is the lord of Gaṇas / named Vakratuṇḍa; the seed-syllable is ‘vaṃ’; the energy is the armor.

sanskrit_iast:
tāradṛnmadhyagairmantravarṇaiścandravibhūṣitaiḥ /
kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgamantrārṇānbhrūmadhye ca gale hṛdi //
meaning:
तारदृन्मध्यगैर्मन्त्रवर्णैश्चन्द्रविभूषितैः /
कृत्वा षडङ्गमन्त्रार्णान्भ्रूमध्ये च गले हृदि //
text_mt: Making the six-limbed mantra syllables by means of the mantra syllables placed between tāra and dṛk and adorned with the moon, / [he should place them] between the eyebrows, at the throat, at the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmau liṅge pade nyasyākhilena vyāpakaṃ caret /
udyadarkadyutiṃ hastaiḥ pāśāṅkuśavarābhayān //
meaning:
नामौ लिङ्गे पदे न्यस्याखिलेन व्यापकं चरेत् /
उद्यदर्कद्युतिं हस्तैः पाशाङ्कुशवराभयान् //
text_mt: at the navel, at the genitals, and at the feet, and perform a pervasive placement with the whole [mantra]. / One should worship the elephant-faced one, possessing the radiance of the rising sun, bearing the noose,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhataṃ gajavaktraṃ ca raktabhūṣāṃbaraṃ bhajet /
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapettarkalakṣaṃ dravyairdaśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
दधतं गजवक्त्रं च रक्तभूषांबरं भजेत् /
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेत्तर्कलक्षं द्रव्यैर्दशांशतः //
text_mt: goad, boon, and safety gestures in his hands, wearing red ornaments and garments. / Having meditated thus, he should recite [the mantra] six hundred thousand times, and perform fire oblations with one-tenth of that amount

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabhirjuhuyātpīṭhe tīvrādisahiter'cayet /
mūrtiṃ mūrtena saṃkalpya tasyāmāvāhya pūjayet //
meaning:
अष्टभिर्जुहुयात्पीठे तीव्रादिसहितेर्ऽचयेत् /
मूर्तिं मूर्तेन संकल्प्य तस्यामावाह्य पूजयेत् //
text_mt: with the eight substances. He should worship on the ritual seat accompanied by Tīvrā and the others; / having envisioned the image through the embodied form, and having invoked [him] in it, he should worship [him].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvaṣṭau tu śaktayaḥ /
yajedvidyāṃ vidhātrīṃ ca bhogadāṃ vipraghātinīm //
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि पत्रेष्वष्टौ तु शक्तयः /
यजेद्विद्यां विधात्रीं च भोगदां विप्रघातिनीम् //
text_mt: The six limbs are in the six angles, and the eight energies are upon the petals: / he should worship Vidyā, Vidhātrī, Bhogadā, Vipraghātinī,

sanskrit_iast:
nidhipradīpāṃ pāpaghnīṃ puṇyāṃ paścācchaśiprabhām /
dalāgreṣu vakratuṇḍa ekadaṃṣṭramahodarau //
meaning:
निधिप्रदीपां पापघ्नीं पुण्यां पश्चाच्छशिप्रभाम् /
दलाग्रेषु वक्रतुण्ड एकदंष्ट्रमहोदरौ //
text_mt: Nidhipradīpā, Pāpaghnī, Puṇyā, and after that Śaśiprabhā. / On the tips of the petals are Vakratuṇḍa, Ekadaṃṣṭra, Mahodara,

sanskrit_iast:
gajāsyalaṃbodarakau vikaṭau vidhnarāṭ tathā /
dhūmravarṇastato bāhye lokeśānhetisaṃyutān //
meaning:
गजास्यलंबोदरकौ विकटौ विध्नराट् तथा /
धूम्रवर्णस्ततो बाह्ये लोकेशान्हेतिसंयुतान् //
text_mt: Gajāsya, Lambodara, Vikaṭa, and also Vighnarāj, / and Dhūmravarṇa. Outside of that, [he should worship] the lords of the worlds accompanied by their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāvaraṇairiṣṭvā pañcabhirgaṇanāyakam /
sādhaṃyedakhilānkāmānvakratuṇḍa praṃsādataḥ //
meaning:
एवमावरणैरिष्ट्वा पञ्चभिर्गणनायकम् /
साधंयेदखिलान्कामान्वक्रतुण्ड प्रंसादतः //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the lord of Gaṇas through the five enclosures, / he shall accomplish all desires through the grace of Vakratuṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā gurumukhānmantraṃ dīkṣāsaṃskārapūrvakam /
brahmacārī haviṣyāśī satyavāk ca jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
लब्ध्वा गुरुमुखान्मन्त्रं दीक्षासंस्कारपूर्वकम् /
ब्रह्मचारी हविष्याशी सत्यवाक् च जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Having received the mantra from the mouth of the guru after the initiation rite, / observing celibacy, eating sacrificial offerings, speaking truth, and with senses subdued,

sanskrit_iast:
japedarkasahasraṃ tu ṣaṇmāsaṃ homasaṃyutam /
dāridṣaṃ tu parābhūya jāyate dhanadopamaḥ //
meaning:
जपेदर्कसहस्रं तु षण्मासं होमसंयुतम् /
दारिद्षं तु पराभूय जायते धनदोपमः //
text_mt: he should recite twelve thousand times for six months accompanied by fire oblations. / Overcoming poverty, he becomes equal to the giver of wealth [Kubera].

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyādi caturthyantaṃ japedayutamādarāt /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ hutvā prāgvatphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यादि चतुर्थ्यन्तं जपेदयुतमादरात् /
अष्टोत्तरशतं नित्यं हुत्वा प्राग्वत्फलं लभेत् //
text_mt: From the fourth day [of the lunar fortnight] to the [next] fourth day, he should devoutly recite ten thousand times, / and having offered daily one hundred and eight fire oblations, he obtains the fruit as before.

sanskrit_iast:
/
pakṣayorubhayormantrī caturthyāṃ juhuyācchatam /
apūpairvatsare sa syātsamṛddheḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
/
पक्षयोरुभयोर्मन्त्री चतुर्थ्यां जुहुयाच्छतम् /
अपूपैर्वत्सरे स स्यात्समृद्धेः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: On the fourth day of both fortnights, the practitioner should offer a hundred fire oblations / with rice-cakes. In one year, he becomes the supreme abode of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgārakacaturthyāṃ tu devamiṣṭvā vidhānataḥ /
haviṣā pā yasānnena naivedyaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
अङ्गारकचतुर्थ्यां तु देवमिष्ट्वा विधानतः /
हविषा पा यसान्नेन नैवेद्यं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: On the fourth lunar day falling on a Tuesday, having worshipped the deity according to rule, / he should prepare an offering consisting of sacrificial food, milk-rice, and cooked grains.

sanskrit_iast:
tato guruṃ samabhyarntya bhojayedvidhivatsudhīḥ /
niveditena juhuyātsaharasraṃ vidhivadvasau //
meaning:
ततो गुरुं समभ्यर्न्त्य भोजयेद्विधिवत्सुधीः /
निवेदितेन जुहुयात्सहरस्रं विधिवद्वसौ //
text_mt: Then the wise man, having worshipped the guru, should feed him according to rule; / with what has been offered, he should make a thousand fire oblations into the fire according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt /
athānyatsādhanaṃ vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा महतीं श्रियमाप्नुयात् /
अथान्यत्साधनं वक्ष्ये लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Having done this for a year, he obtains great prosperity. / Now I will declare another procedure for the benefit of all people.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā gaṇeśaṃ pṛthukaiḥ pāyasāpūpamodakaḥ /
nānāphalaistatomantrī haridrāmatha saindhavam //
meaning:
इष्ट्वा गणेशं पृथुकैः पायसापूपमोदकः /
नानाफलैस्ततोमन्त्री हरिद्रामथ सैन्धवम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Gaṇeśa with flattened rice, milk-rice, cakes, and sweetmeats, / and various fruits, the practitioner should then take turmeric, rock salt,

sanskrit_iast:
vacāṃ niṣkārddhabhāgaṃ ca tadarddhaṃ vā manuṃ japet /
viśodhya cūrṇaṃ prasṛtau gavāṃ mūtre vinikṣipet //
meaning:
वचां निष्कार्द्धभागं च तदर्द्धं वा मनुं जपेत् /
विशोध्य चूर्णं प्रसृतौ गवां मूत्रे विनिक्षिपेत् //
text_mt: and sweet flag in the amount of half a niṣka, or half of that, and recite the mantra over it. / Having purified the powder, he should drop a handful of it into cow's urine.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakṛtvo manunā mantrayitvā prayatnataḥ /
snātāmṛtudine śuddhāṃ śuklāṃbaradharāṃ śubhām //
meaning:
सहस्रकृत्वो मनुना मन्त्रयित्वा प्रयत्नतः /
स्नातामृतुदिने शुद्धां शुक्लांबरधरां शुभाम् //
text_mt: Having carefully consecrated it a thousand times with the mantra, / the wise man, placing before the deity [a woman] who has bathed on her fertile day,

sanskrit_iast:
devasya purataḥ sthāpya pāyayedauṣadhaṃ sudhīḥ /
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ vandhyāpi labhate sutam //
meaning:
देवस्य पुरतः स्थाप्य पाययेदौषधं सुधीः /
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं वन्ध्यापि लभते सुतम् //
text_mt: pure, wearing white garments, and auspicious, / should make her drink the medicine; even a barren woman obtains a son endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam /
gocarmamātrāṃ dharaṇīmupalipya prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
अथान्यत्संप्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् /
गोचर्ममात्रां धरणीमुपलिप्य प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: Now I shall proclaim another supreme and wonderful secret. / Having carefully smeared a piece of ground measuring a cow-hide,

sanskrit_iast:
vikīrya dhānyaprakaraistatra saṃsthāpayeddhaṭam /
śuddhodakena saṃpūrya tasyopari nidhāpayet //
meaning:
विकीर्य धान्यप्रकरैस्तत्र संस्थापयेद्धटम् /
शुद्धोदकेन संपूर्य तस्योपरि निधापयेत् //
text_mt: and scattering various grains there, he should set up a water-pot. / Having filled it with pure water, he should place upon it

sanskrit_iast:
kapilājyena saṃpūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ nūtanaṃ śubham /
ṣaḍaṣṭākṣaramantrābhyāṃ dīpamāropayecchubham //
meaning:
कपिलाज्येन संपूर्णं शरावं नूतनं शुभम् /
षडष्टाक्षरमन्त्राभ्यां दीपमारोपयेच्छुभम् //
text_mt: an auspicious new earthen saucer filled with the ghee of a brown cow. / He should light an auspicious lamp with the six-syllabled and eight-syllabled mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpe devaṃ samāvāhya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet /
snātāṃ kumārīmathavā kumāraṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
दीपे देवं समावाह्य गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् /
स्नातां कुमारीमथवा कुमारं पूजयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: Having invoked the deity in the lamp, he should worship him with fragrant pastes, flowers, and the like. / The wise man should worship a maiden or a young boy who has bathed.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpasya purataḥ sthāpyadhyātvā devaṃ japenmanum /
pradīpe sthāpite paśyeddvijarūpaṃ gaṇeśvaram //
meaning:
दीपस्य पुरतः स्थाप्यध्यात्वा देवं जपेन्मनुम् /
प्रदीपे स्थापिते पश्येद्द्विजरूपं गणेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Placing [the child] in front of the lamp and meditating on the deity, he should recite the mantra. / When the lamp is established, [the child] sees the lord of Gaṇas in the form of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭastataḥ saṃpadi vā naṣṭaṃ caivāpyanāgatam /
sakalaṃ pravadedevaṃ kumārī vā kumārakaḥ //
meaning:
पृष्टस्ततः संपदि वा नष्टं चैवाप्यनागतम् /
सकलं प्रवदेदेवं कुमारी वा कुमारकः //
text_mt: Then, when questioned about prosperity, lost items, or the future, / the maiden or the young boy will recount everything.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍakṣaro hṛdantaścedbhavedaṣṭākṣaro manuḥ /
anye 'pi mantrā devarṣe santi tantre gaṇeśituḥ //
meaning:
षडक्षरो हृदन्तश्चेद्भवेदष्टाक्षरो मनुः /
अन्ये ऽपि मन्त्रा देवर्षे सन्ति तन्त्रे गणेशितुः //
text_mt: The six-syllabled mantra, if ending with ‘namaḥ’, becomes an eight-syllabled mantra. / There are other mantras too of the lord of Gaṇas in the Tantra, O divine sage.

sanskrit_iast:
kintvatra yanna sādhyaṃ syātrriṣu lokeṣu sādhakaiḥ /
aṣṭaviṃśarasārṇābhyāṃ tanna paśyedapi kvacit //
meaning:
किन्त्वत्र यन्न साध्यं स्यात्र्रिषु लोकेषु साधकैः /
अष्टविंशरसार्णाभ्यां तन्न पश्येदपि क्वचित् //
text_mt: However, whatever cannot be accomplished here in the three worlds by practitioners / through the twenty-eight and six-syllabled mantras, one would never see anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
etadgaṇeśamantrāṇāṃ vidhānaṃ te mayoditam /
śaṭhebhyaḥ paraśiṣyebhyo vañcakebhyo 'pi mā vada //
meaning:
एतद्गणेशमन्त्राणां विधानं ते मयोदितम् /
शठेभ्यः परशिष्येभ्यो वञ्चकेभ्यो ऽपि मा वद //
text_mt: This procedure of the mantras of Gaṇeśa has been declared to you by me. / Do not speak it to villains, to disciples of others, or to cheats.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yo bhajate devaṃ gaṇeśaṃsarvasiddhidam /
prāpyeha sakalānbhoganinte muktipadaṃ vrajet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde gaṇeśamantravidhānanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं यो भजते देवं गणेशंसर्वसिद्धिदम् /
प्राप्येह सकलान्भोगनिन्ते मुक्तिपदं व्रजेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे गणेशमन्त्रविधाननिरूपणं नामाष्टषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever worships god Gaṇeśa, the giver of all perfections, in this manner, / having attained all enjoyments in this world, shall attain the state of liberation at the end.

Thus ends the sixty-eighth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Rules for the Mantras of Gaṇeśa’, in the third quarter of the great narrative of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha vakṣye trayīmūrtervidhānaṃ tvabjinīpateḥ /
mantrāṇāṃ yatsamārādhya sarveṣṭaṃ prāmuyāhṛvi //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ वक्ष्ये त्रयीमूर्तेर्विधानं त्वब्जिनीपतेः /
मन्त्राणां यत्समाराध्य सर्वेष्टं प्रामुयाहृवि //
text_mt:
Sanatkumāra said:
Now I shall declare the ritual procedure for the Lord of lotuses, who is the embodiment of the three Vedas, / by worshipping whose mantras one attains all desired things in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro recikayā yukto medhānetrayutā ratiḥ /
sasargā bāmakarṇoḍhyo bhṛgurvaḍhyāsano marut //
meaning:
तारो रेचिकया युक्तो मेधानेत्रयुता रतिः /
ससर्गा बामकर्णोढ्यो भृगुर्वढ्यासनो मरुत् //
text_mt: The syllable Oṃ joined with [the vowel] ṛ, the letter ra with e and the bindu, / with a visarga, then the letter sa endowed with the left ear [u], then the wind-syllable ya seated on fire [ra], with the long vowel ā,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣoditya iti prokto vasvarṇo bhuktimuktidaḥ /
devabhāgo muniśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥ //
meaning:
शेषोदित्य इति प्रोक्तो वस्वर्णो भुक्तिमुक्तिदः /
देवभागो मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता रविः //
text_mt: followed by 'ādityāya'—this eight-syllabled mantra is proclaimed to grant enjoyment and liberation. / The sage is Devabhāga, the meter is gāyatrī, and the deity is the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
māyā vījaṃ ramā śaktirdṛṣṭādṛṣṭe niyogakaḥ /
satyāya hṛdayaṃ paścādbrahmaṇe śira īritam //
meaning:
माया वीजं रमा शक्तिर्दृष्टादृष्टे नियोगकः /
सत्याय हृदयं पश्चाद्ब्रह्मणे शिर ईरितम् //
text_mt: Māyā is the seed, Ramā the power, and the application is for seen and unseen fruits. / Then 'satyāya' is declared as the heart, 'brahmaṇe' as the head,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇave tu śikhāvarma rudrāya parikīrtitam /
netraṃ syādagraye paścātśarvāyāsramudāhṛtam //
meaning:
विष्णवे तु शिखावर्म रुद्राय परिकीर्तितम् /
नेत्रं स्यादग्रये पश्चात्शर्वायास्रमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: 'viṣṇave' is the crown lock, 'rudrāya' is proclaimed as the armor, / 'agnaye' is the eye, and thereafter 'śarvāya' is declared as the weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
netro jvālā mano huṃ phaṭsvāhāntā manavo gaṇāḥ /
punaḥ ṣaḍarṇairhrī lakṣmyāḥ kṛtvāntaḥ sthaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
नेत्रो ज्वाला मनो हुं फट्स्वाहान्ता मनवो गणाः /
पुनः षडर्णैर्ह्री लक्ष्म्याः कृत्वान्तः स्थैः षडङ्गकम् //
