text_mt: The groups of mantras end in namaḥ, svāhā, vaṣaṭ, huṃ, vauṣaṭ, and phaṭ. / Then, with the six syllables of Hrī Lakṣmī situated within them, one performs the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣṭāraujaṭhare pṛṣṭe tayorṅeṃtākhyayā nyaset /
ādityaṃ ca raviṃ paścādbhānuṃ bhāskarameva ca //
meaning:
शिष्टारौजठरे पृष्टे तयोर्ङेंताख्यया न्यसेत् /
आदित्यं च रविं पश्चाद्भानुं भास्करमेव च //
text_mt: On the remaining corners, the belly, and the back, one should place them in the dative case. / Then Āditya, Ravi, Bhānu, and Bhāskara,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaṃ ca mūrdhni vadane hṛdi guhye ca pādayoḥ /
sadyādipañca hrasvādyān nyasenṅeṃ hṛdayoṃ'timān //
meaning:
सूर्यं च मूर्ध्नि वदने हृदि गुह्ये च पादयोः /
सद्यादिपञ्च ह्रस्वाद्यान् न्यसेन्ङें हृदयोंऽतिमान् //
text_mt: and Sūrya—on the crown of the head, face, heart, private parts, and feet; / one should place the five beginning with Sadyojāta, prefixed with the short vowels and ending in the dative case with namaḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
hrīṃ ramāmadhyagāmaṣṭau varṇāṃstārādikānnyaset /
mūrddhāsyakaṇṭhahṛtkukṣinābhiliṅgagudeṣu ca //
meaning:
ह्रीं रमामध्यगामष्टौ वर्णांस्तारादिकान्न्यसेत् /
मूर्द्धास्यकण्ठहृत्कुक्षिनाभिलिङ्गगुदेषु च //
text_mt: One should place the eight syllables beginning with Oṃ, having Hrīṃ and Ramā in the middle, / on the crown of the head, face, throat, heart, belly, navel, genitals, and anus.

sanskrit_iast:
sacandrasvarapūrvaṃ tu ṅetaṃ śītāṃśumaṇḍalam /
mūrddhādikaṇṭhaparyantaṃ nyaseñcāndrimanuspraran //
meaning:
सचन्द्रस्वरपूर्वं तु ङेतं शीतांशुमण्डलम् /
मूर्द्धादिकण्ठपर्यन्तं न्यसेञ्चान्द्रिमनुस्प्ररन् //
text_mt: Prefixed with the moon-vowel and ending in the dative case, one should place the moon-circle / from the crown of the head down to the throat, meditating on the mantra of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
sparśānseṃdūnsamuñcārya ṅeṃtaṃ bhāskaramaṇḍalam /
nyasetkaṇṭhādinābhyantaṃ dhyāyanpradyotanaṃ hṛdi //
meaning:
स्पर्शान्सेंदून्समुञ्चार्य ङेंतं भास्करमण्डलम् /
न्यसेत्कण्ठादिनाभ्यन्तं ध्यायन्प्रद्योतनं हृदि //
text_mt: Uttering the stop-consonants endowed with the moon, ending in the dative case, one should place the sun-circle / from the throat down to the navel, meditating on the Illuminator in the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
yādīnsacandrānuñcārya ṅetaṃ ca vahnimaṇḍalam /
nābhyādipādaparyantaṃ nyasedvahnimanusmaran //
meaning:
यादीन्सचन्द्रानुञ्चार्य ङेतं च वह्निमण्डलम् /
नाभ्यादिपादपर्यन्तं न्यसेद्वह्निमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Uttering the semi-vowels beginning with ya endowed with the moon, ending in the dative case, / one should place the fire-circle from the navel down to the feet, remembering the fire mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
prokto 'yaṃ maṇḍalanyāso mahātejovidhāyakaḥ /
ādiṭhāntārṇapūrvaṃ ṅeṃnamontaṃ somamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
प्रोक्तो ऽयं मण्डलन्यासो महातेजोविधायकः /
आदिठान्तार्णपूर्वं ङेंनमोन्तं सोममण्डलम् //
text_mt: This nyāsa of circles, which confers great splendor, has been declared. / Preceded by the syllables beginning with a and ending in ṭha, ending in the dative and namaḥ, the moon-circle

sanskrit_iast:
mūrddhādihṛdayāntaṃ tu vinyasetsādhakottamaḥ /
ḍakārādikṣakārāntavarṇādyaṃ pahnimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
मूर्द्धादिहृदयान्तं तु विन्यसेत्साधकोत्तमः /
डकारादिक्षकारान्तवर्णाद्यं पह्निमण्डलम् //
text_mt: the excellent practitioner should place from the crown of the head down to the heart. / Beginning with the syllables from ḍa to kṣa, ending in the dative case, the fire-circle

sanskrit_iast:
ṅeṃtaṃ hṛdādipādāntaṃ vinyasetsusamāhitaḥ /
agrīṣomātmako nyāsaḥ kathitaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
ङेंतं हृदादिपादान्तं विन्यसेत्सुसमाहितः /
अग्रीषोमात्मको न्यासः कथितः सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: he should place, fully concentrated, from the heart down to the feet. / This nyāsa consisting of fire and moon has been declared to confer all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
nyasetseṃdūnmātṛkārṇāñjayāntapuruṣātmane /
namonte vyāpakaṃ mantrī haṃsnayāso 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
न्यसेत्सेंदून्मातृकार्णाञ्जयान्तपुरुषात्मने /
नमोन्ते व्यापकं मन्त्री हंस्नयासो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: Ending in namaḥ, one should place the mātṛkā syllables endowed with the moon onto the self of Puruṣa ending in jayā; / this pervasion is declared by the mantra practitioner as the Haṃsa-nyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau svarāñśeṣānpañcapañca mitānpunaḥ /
uktādityamukhānetānvinyaseñca navagrahān //
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ स्वराञ्शेषान्पञ्चपञ्च मितान्पुनः /
उक्तादित्यमुखानेतान्विन्यसेञ्च नवग्रहान् //
text_mt: Eight vowels, eight, the remaining ones, and then five and five measured again; / one should place these nine planets headed by the aforesaid Āditya

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraliṅgayornābhau hṛdi kaṇṭhe mukhāntare /
bhrūmadhye ca tathā bhāle brahmaraṅghre nyasetkramāt //
meaning:
आधारलिङ्गयोर्नाभौ हृदि कण्ठे मुखान्तरे /
भ्रूमध्ये च तथा भाले ब्रह्मरङ्घ्रे न्यसेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: on the basal center, genitals, navel, heart, throat, inside the mouth, / between the eyebrows, forehead, and Brahmarandhra, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsākhyamagnīṣomākhyaṃ maṇḍalatrayameva ca /
punarnyāsatrayaṃ kuryānmūlena vyāpakaṃ caret //
meaning:
हंसाख्यमग्नीषोमाख्यं मण्डलत्रयमेव च /
पुनर्न्यासत्रयं कुर्यान्मूलेन व्यापकं चरेत् //
text_mt: One should perform the three nyāsas named Haṃsa, Agniṣoma, / and the three circles, and perform a pervasive nyāsa with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyetsūryaṃ hṛdabuje /
dānābhayābjayugalaṃ dhārayantaṃ karai ravim //
meaning:
एवं न्यासविधिं कृत्वा ध्यायेत्सूर्यं हृदबुजे /
दानाभयाब्जयुगलं धारयन्तं करै रविम् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the rite of nyāsa, one should meditate on the Sun in the heart lotus: / Ravi bearing the gestures of granting boons and fearlessness, and a pair of lotuses in his hands,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍalāṃ gadakeyūrahāriṇaṃ ca trayītanum /
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapenmantrī vasulakṣaṃ daśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
कुण्डलां गदकेयूरहारिणं च त्रयीतनुम् /
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेन्मन्त्री वसुलक्षं दशांशतः //
text_mt: wearing earrings, armlets, bracelets, and necklaces, the embodiment of the three Vedas. / Having meditated thus, the mantra practitioner should recite [the mantra] eight hundred thousand times, and one-tenth of that

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃbhojaistilairvāpi juhuyādvidhivadvasau /
prathamaṃ pīṭhayajane dharmādīnāṃ sthale yajet //
meaning:
रक्तांभोजैस्तिलैर्वापि जुहुयाद्विधिवद्वसौ /
प्रथमं पीठयजने धर्मादीनां स्थले यजेत् //
text_mt: he should offer as fire oblations into the fire with red lotuses or sesamum according to the rule. / First, in the worship of the seat, he should worship in the place of Dharma and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ śāraṃ samārādhyamanantaram /
paramādimukhaṃ madhye khabiṃbāntaṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
प्रभूतं विमलं शारं समाराध्यमनन्तरम् /
परमादिमुखं मध्ये खबिंबान्तं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: having worshipped Prabhūta, Vimala, and Śāra next, / he should worship the head of the supreme beginning in the middle, ending in the sky-orb.

sanskrit_iast:
somāgnimaṇḍalaṃ pūjyaravimaṇḍalamarcayet /
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā //
meaning:
सोमाग्निमण्डलं पूज्यरविमण्डलमर्चयेत् /
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमला तथा //
text_mt: Having worshipped the circle of moon and fire, he should worship the circle of the sun: / Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, Vimalā,

sanskrit_iast:
amoghā vidyutā sarvatomukhī pīṭhaśaktayaḥ /
hrasvatrayoktijāḥ klībahī nā vahnīndusaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
अमोघा विद्युता सर्वतोमुखी पीठशक्तयः /
ह्रस्वत्रयोक्तिजाः क्लीबही ना वह्नीन्दुसंयुताः //
text_mt: Amoghā, Vidyutā, and Sarvatomukhī are the powers of the seat. / Arising from the pronunciation of the three short vowels, lacking neuter letters, joined with fire and moon,

sanskrit_iast:
svarā bījāni śaktīnāṃ tadādyāḥ pūjayettuḥ tāḥ /
brahmaviṣṇuśivātmā te sṛṣṭiḥ śeṣānvitāpyasau //
meaning:
स्वरा बीजानि शक्तीनां तदाद्याः पूजयेत्तुः ताः /
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मा ते सृष्टिः शेषान्विताप्यसौ //
text_mt: the vowels are the seed-syllables of the powers; he should worship them beginning with those. / Consisting of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, this creation is joined with the remaining letters;

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ cānte yoga pīṭhātmane hṛdayamīrayet /
tārādyo 'yaṃ pīṭhamantrastvanenāsanamādiśet //
meaning:
एवं चान्ते योग पीठात्मने हृदयमीरयेत् /
ताराद्यो ऽयं पीठमन्त्रस्त्वनेनासनमादिशेत् //
text_mt: and thus at the end he should utter the heart mantra to the embodiment of the yoga-pīṭha. / This is the seat mantra beginning with Oṃ; with this he should assign the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo viyadbinduyutaṃ khaṃ khakholkāya dṛnmanuḥ /
navārṇāya ca manave mūrtiṃ saṃkalpayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
ध्रुवो वियद्बिन्दुयुतं खं खखोल्काय दृन्मनुः /
नवार्णाय च मनवे मूर्तिं संकल्पयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: The steady syllable [Oṃ], sky [ha] endowed with the bindu, kha, followed by 'khakholkāya'—this is the nine-syllabled eye-mantra; / for this nine-syllabled mantra the wise person should conceive the divine form.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣiṇaṃ jagatāṃ tasyāmāvāhya vidhivadyajet /
tataḥ ṣaḍaṅgāmārādhya dvikṣvaṣṭāṅgaṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
साक्षिणं जगतां तस्यामावाह्य विधिवद्यजेत् /
ततः षडङ्गामाराध्य द्विक्ष्वष्टाङ्गं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having invoked the witness of the worlds into it, he should worship him according to rule. / Then, having worshipped the six limbs, he should worship the eight limbs in the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya madhye vādityaṃ raviṃ bhānuṃ ca bhāskaram /
sūryaṃ diśāsu sadyādipañca hrasvādikānimān //
meaning:
संपूज्य मध्ये वादित्यं रविं भानुं च भास्करम् /
सूर्यं दिशासु सद्यादिपञ्च ह्रस्वादिकानिमान् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Āditya in the center, and Ravi, Bhānu, Bhāskara, / and Sūrya in the cardinal directions, with these five beginning with Sadyojāta prefixed with the short vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
svasvanāmādivarṇādyāḥ śaktayor'cyā vidikṣu ca /
uṣāṃ prajñāṃ prabhāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tato brahmādikānyajet //
meaning:
स्वस्वनामादिवर्णाद्याः शक्तयोर्ऽच्या विदिक्षु च /
उषां प्रज्ञां प्रभां संध्यां ततो ब्रह्मादिकान्यजेत् //
text_mt: the powers should be worshipped in the intermediate directions, beginning with the first letters of their respective names: / Uṣā, Prajñā, Prabhā, and Saṃdhyā; then he should worship Brahmā and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
purato 'ruṇamabhyarcya somaṃ jñaṃ ca guruṃ bhṛgum /
dikṣvaryamādikāniṣṭvā bhūmijaṃ ca śanaiścaram //
meaning:
पुरतो ऽरुणमभ्यर्च्य सोमं ज्ञं च गुरुं भृगुम् /
दिक्ष्वर्यमादिकानिष्ट्वा भूमिजं च शनैश्चरम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Aruṇa in front, Soma, Jña [Budha], Guru [Bṛhaspati], and Bhṛgu [Śukra], / and having worshipped Aryaman and others in the directions, as well as the Son of Earth [Maṅgala] and Saturn,

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca koṇeṣu pūrvavatparipūjayet /
indrādyānapi vajrādyānpūjayetpūrvavatsudhīḥ //
meaning:
राहुं केतुं च कोणेषु पूर्ववत्परिपूजयेत् /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्राद्यान्पूजयेत्पूर्ववत्सुधीः //
text_mt: the wise person should worship Rāhu and Ketu in the corners as before; / he should also worship Indra and the others, as well as the thunderbolt and other [weapons], as before.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadbhāskaraṃ bhaktavatsalam /
samāhito dineśāya dadyādardhyaṃ dine dine //
meaning:
इत्थं संपूज्य विधिवद्भास्करं भक्तवत्सलम् /
समाहितो दिनेशाय दद्यादर्ध्यं दिने दिने //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped Bhāskara, who is affectionate to devotees, according to rule, / being concentrated, he should offer arghya day after day to the Lord of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānāyamya sadbhūmau nyāsānkṛtvā puroditān /
vidhāya maṇḍalaṃ bhānoḥ pīṭhaṃ pūrvavadarcayet //
meaning:
प्राणानायम्य सद्भूमौ न्यासान्कृत्वा पुरोदितान् /
विधाय मण्डलं भानोः पीठं पूर्ववदर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Having restrained the breaths upon pure ground, having performed the nyāsas spoken of earlier, / and having drawn the sun's maṇḍala, he should worship the seat as before.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvārkaṃ prayajeddvivyairmānasairupacārakaiḥ /
pātraṃ tāmramayaṃ prasthatoyagrāhi suśobhanam //
meaning:
ध्यात्वार्कं प्रयजेद्द्विव्यैर्मानसैरुपचारकैः /
पात्रं ताम्रमयं प्रस्थतोयग्राहि सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: Having meditated on the Sun, he should worship him with divine, mental offerings. / A very beautiful copper vessel holding a prastha of water,

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya maṇḍale raktacandanādivinirmite /
vilomamātṛkāmūlamuñcaranpūrayejjalaiḥ //
meaning:
निधाय मण्डले रक्तचन्दनादिविनिर्मिते /
विलोममातृकामूलमुञ्चरन्पूरयेज्जलैः //
text_mt: placed within the maṇḍala made with red sandalwood and other substances, / he should fill with water while reciting the mātṛkā in reverse order and the root mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryabiṃbavinirgacchatsudhāṃbudhivibhāvitaiḥ /
kuṅkumaṃ rojanāṃ rājīṃ candanaṃ raktacandanam //
meaning:
सूर्यबिंबविनिर्गच्छत्सुधांबुधिविभावितैः /
कुङ्कुमं रोजनां राजीं चन्दनं रक्तचन्दनम् //
text_mt: meditated upon as an ocean of nectar flowing out of the sun's orb. / Saffron, yellow orpiment, black mustard, sandalwood, red sandalwood,

sanskrit_iast:
karavīraṃ japāśālikuśaśyāmākataṇḍulān /
tilaveṇuyavāṃścaiva nikṣipetsalile śubhe //
meaning:
करवीरं जपाशालिकुशश्यामाकतण्डुलान् /
तिलवेणुयवांश्चैव निक्षिपेत्सलिले शुभे //
text_mt: oleander, hibiscus, rice paddy, kuśa grass, and grains of wild śyāmāka rice, / as well as sesame seeds, bamboo seeds, and barley he should cast into the auspicious water.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ tatrāvāhyārkaṃ pūrvavadyajet /
gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyādyai rvidhānataḥ //
meaning:
सांगं सावरणं तत्रावाह्यार्कं पूर्ववद्यजेत् /
गन्धपुष्पधूपदीपनैवेद्याद्यै र्विधानतः //
text_mt: Having invoked the Sun there along with his limbs and retinue, he should worship him as before / with scents, flowers, incense, lamps, food offerings, and the like, according to the injunctions.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni pūrvavat /
sudhābījaṃ candanena dakṣe karatale likhet //
meaning:
प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा कुर्यादङ्गानि पूर्ववत् /
सुधाबीजं चन्दनेन दक्षे करतले लिखेत् //
text_mt: Having performed three breath controls, he should form the limbs as before. / He should write the nectar-seed with sandalwood paste on his right palm.

sanskrit_iast:
tenācchādyārdhyapātraṃ ca japenmanumananyadhīḥ /
aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā punaḥ saṃpūjya bhāskaram //
meaning:
तेनाच्छाद्यार्ध्यपात्रं च जपेन्मनुमनन्यधीः /
अष्टोत्तरशतावृत्त्या पुनः संपूज्य भास्करम् //
text_mt: Covering the arghya vessel with that, he should recite the mantra with undivided mind / for a cycle of one hundred and eight times, and worship Bhāskara once again.

sanskrit_iast:
hastābhyāṃ pātramādāya jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ /
āmūrdhni pātramuddhṛtyāṃbareṇa varaṇe raveḥ //
meaning:
हस्ताभ्यां पात्रमादाय जानुभ्यामवनीं गतः /
आमूर्ध्नि पात्रमुद्धृत्यांबरेण वरणे रवेः //
text_mt: Taking the vessel with both hands, having touched the ground with his knees, / and raising the vessel up to his head, casting his gaze upon the sun in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭiṃ cādhāya manasā pūjayitvā raviṃ punaḥ /
sādhakena svakaikyena mūlamantraṃ dhiyā japan //
meaning:
दृष्टिं चाधाय मनसा पूजयित्वा रविं पुनः /
साधकेन स्वकैक्येन मूलमन्त्रं धिया जपन् //
text_mt: and worshipping Ravi once more mentally, / with the practitioner reciting the root mantra in his mind in identity with him,

sanskrit_iast:
ardhyaṃ dadyādraviṃ dhyāyavraktacandanamaṇḍale /
dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ bhūyo japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
अर्ध्यं दद्याद्रविं ध्यायव्रक्तचन्दनमण्डले /
दत्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं भूयो जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् //
text_mt: meditating on Ravi, he should offer the arghya into the red sandalwood maṇḍala. / Having offered a handful of flowers, he should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times again.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ vā tadvine 'pyevamardhyaṃ dadyādvivasvate /
tena tuṣṭo dineśo 'smai dadyādvittaṃ yaśaḥ sukham //
meaning:
नित्यं वा तद्विने ऽप्येवमर्ध्यं दद्याद्विवस्वते /
तेन तुष्टो दिनेशो ऽस्मै दद्याद्वित्तं यशः सुखम् //
text_mt: He should offer the arghya to Vivasvat daily, or even on that specific day. / Pleased thereby, the Lord of the day grants him wealth, fame, happiness,

sanskrit_iast:
putrānpautrānabhīṣṭaṃ ca yadyatsarvaṃ prayacchati /
ardhyadānamidaṃ proktamāyurārogyavarddhanam //
meaning:
पुत्रान्पौत्रानभीष्टं च यद्यत्सर्वं प्रयच्छति /
अर्ध्यदानमिदं प्रोक्तमायुरारोग्यवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: sons, grandsons, and whatever is desired—he bestows all of it. / This offering of arghya is declared to increase life and health.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadhānyapaśukṣemakṣetramitrakalatradam /
tejovīryayaśaḥkīrtividyāvibhavabhogadam //
meaning:
धनधान्यपशुक्षेमक्षेत्रमित्रकलत्रदम् /
तेजोवीर्ययशःकीर्तिविद्याविभवभोगदम् //
text_mt: It grants wealth, grain, cattle, well-being, fields, friends, and a wife; / it grants splendor, vigor, fame, renown, knowledge, prosperity, and enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryārādhanāsaktaḥ saṃdhyāvandanatatparaḥ /
evaṃ manuṃ japanvipro duḥkhaṃ naivāpnuyātkvacit //
meaning:
गायत्र्याराधनासक्तः संध्यावन्दनतत्परः /
एवं मनुं जपन्विप्रो दुःखं नैवाप्नुयात्क्वचित् //
text_mt: Devoted to the worship of the gāyatrī, intent upon the twilight prayers, / a Brahmin reciting the mantra in this way shall never encounter sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
vikartanāya nirmālyamevaṃ saṃpūjya dāpayet /
viyadvahnimarutsādyāntārvīseṃdusamanvitam //
meaning:
विकर्तनाय निर्माल्यमेवं संपूज्य दापयेत् /
वियद्वह्निमरुत्साद्यान्तार्वीसेंदुसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the Sun, he should offer the previous day's floral offerings. / Endowed with ether, fire, wind, s, ā, d, y, ā, earth, and the moon [i.e., the seed-syllables],

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍabhairavākhyaṃ hi bījaṃ trailokyamohanam /
biṃbabījena puṭitaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam //
meaning:
मार्तण्डभैरवाख्यं हि बीजं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् /
बिंबबीजेन पुटितं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: is the seed-syllable named Mārtaṇḍabhairava, which enchants the three worlds; / enclosed within the solar-disc seed-syllable, it bestows the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavatsakalaṃ cānyadatra jñeyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ /
bhṛgurjalendumanvāḍhyaḥ somāya hṛdayāntimaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्ववत्सकलं चान्यदत्र ज्ञेयं मनीषिभिः /
भृगुर्जलेन्दुमन्वाढ्यः सोमाय हृदयान्तिमः //
text_mt: Everything else here is to be understood by the wise as described before. / The letter of Bhṛgu [s], endowed with the water-letter [v], the moon [anusvāra], and the Manu [au], followed by 'somāya hṛdayāya namaḥ' [i.e. 'svauṃ somāya namaḥ']—

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍakṣaro mantrarājo munirasya bhṛgurmataḥ /
chandaḥ paṅktistu somo 'sya devatā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
षडक्षरो मन्त्रराजो मुनिरस्य भृगुर्मतः /
छन्दः पङ्क्तिस्तु सोमो ऽस्य देवता परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: this is the six-syllabled king of mantras; its seer is considered to be Bhṛgu, / its metre is Paṅkti, and Soma is declared to be its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye /
ṣaḍdīrgheṇa svabījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
आद्यं बीजं नमः शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
षड्दीर्घेण स्वबीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: The first syllable is the seed, 'namaḥ' is the power, and the ritual application is for the attainment of everything. / With its own seed-syllable lengthened through the six long vowels, one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇedvāsyaṃ sphaṭikabhaṃ nīlālakalasanmukham /
vibhrāṇamiṣṭaṃ kumudaṃ dhyāyenmuktāsrajaṃ vidhum //
meaning:
पूर्णेद्वास्यं स्फटिकभं नीलालकलसन्मुखम् /
विभ्राणमिष्टं कुमुदं ध्यायेन्मुक्तास्रजं विधुम् //
text_mt: With a face like the full moon, radiant like crystal, his face adorned with dark curls, / holding his wish and a night-lotus, wearing a pearl garland—one should meditate on the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ pāyasena sasarpiṣā /
juhuyāttaddaśāṃśena pīṭhe somāntapūjite //
meaning:
ऋतुलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं पायसेन ससर्पिषा /
जुहुयात्तद्दशांशेन पीठे सोमान्तपूजिते //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra six hundred thousand times, and with milk-rice mixed with clarified butter / offer oblations of one-tenth of that number on a ritual seat worshipped up to Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtimūlena saṃkalpya pūjayedvidhivadvidhum /
kesareṣvaṅgapūjā syātpatreṣvetāśca śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
मूर्तिमूलेन संकल्प्य पूजयेद्विधिवद्विधुम् /
केसरेष्वङ्गपूजा स्यात्पत्रेष्वेताश्च शक्तयः //
text_mt:
Having projected the form with the root [mantra], one should worship the moon according to the rules.
In the filaments there should be worship of the limbs, and on the petals, these powers:

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇī kṛttikā caiva revatī bharaṇī puraḥ /
rātrirārdrā tato jyetsnā kalā hārasamaprabhā //
meaning:
रोहिणी कृत्तिका चैव रेवती भरणी पुरः /
रात्रिरार्द्रा ततो ज्येत्स्ना कला हारसमप्रभा //
text_mt:
Rohiṇī, Kṛttikā, Revatī, and Bharaṇī in front;
then Rātri, Ārdrā, Jyotsnā, and Kalā, whose radiance equals a necklace;

sanskrit_iast:
suśuklamālyavasanāmuktāhāravibhūṣitāḥ /
sarvāḥstanabharākrāntā racitāñjalayaḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
सुशुक्लमाल्यवसनामुक्ताहारविभूषिताः /
सर्वाःस्तनभराक्रान्ता रचिताञ्जलयः शुभाः //
text_mt:
Adorned with pure white garlands and garments and pearl necklaces,
all heavy with the weight of their breasts, their folded hands raised, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
svapriyāsaktamanaso madavibhramamantharāḥ /
samabhyarcyāḥ sarojākṣyaḥ pūrṇendusadṛśānanāḥ //
meaning:
स्वप्रियासक्तमनसो मदविभ्रममन्थराः /
समभ्यर्च्याः सरोजाक्ष्यः पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननाः //
text_mt:
Their minds attached to their beloved, languid with the charm of intoxication;
these lotus-eyed maidens, whose faces resemble the full moon, should be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
dalāgreṣu samabhyarcyāstvaṣṭau sūryādikā grahāḥ /
ādityabhūsutabudhamandadevejyarāhavaḥ //
meaning:
दलाग्रेषु समभ्यर्च्यास्त्वष्टौ सूर्यादिका ग्रहाः /
आदित्यभूसुतबुधमन्ददेवेज्यराहवः //
text_mt:
On the tips of the petals, the eight planets beginning with the sun should be worshipped:
Āditya, the son of the earth (Mars), Budha (Mercury), Manda (Saturn), the preceptor of the gods (Jupiter), Rāhu,

sanskrit_iast:
śukraketuyutā hyete pūjyāḥ patragragāgrahāḥ /
raktāruṇaśvetanīlapītadhūmrasitāsitāḥ //
meaning:
शुक्रकेतुयुता ह्येते पूज्याः पत्रग्रगाग्रहाः /
रक्तारुणश्वेतनीलपीतधूम्रसितासिताः //
text_mt:
Accompanied by Śukra (Venus) and Ketu; these planets standing at the tips of the petals should be worshipped,
[having the colors] red, crimson, white, blue, yellow, smoky, white, and black.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmorunyastataddhastā dakṣiṇena dhṛtābhayāḥ /
sokapālāṃstadastrāṇi tadvāhye pūjayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
वामोरुन्यस्ततद्धस्ता दक्षिणेन धृताभयाः /
सोकपालांस्तदस्त्राणि तद्वाह्ये पूजयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt:
Their [left] hands are placed on their left thighs, and with the right they grant fearlessness.
The wise one should worship outside of that the guardians of the worlds and their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
eva saṃsādhito mantraḥ prayacchediṣṭamātmanaḥ /
paurṇamāsyāṃ jitāhāro dadyādardhyaṃ vidhūdaye //
meaning:
एव संसाधितो मन्त्रः प्रयच्छेदिष्टमात्मनः /
पौर्णमास्यां जिताहारो दद्यादर्ध्यं विधूदये //
text_mt:
The mantra mastered in this manner yields one's desire.
On the full moon day, having conquered one's food, one should offer an arghya at moonrise.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalatritaryaṃ kuryātprākpratyagāyataṃ bhuvi /
paścime maṇḍale sthitvā pūjādravyaṃ ca madhyame //
meaning:
मण्डलत्रितर्यं कुर्यात्प्राक्प्रत्यगायतं भुवि /
पश्चिमे मण्डले स्थित्वा पूजाद्रव्यं च मध्यमे //
text_mt:
One should make a triad of maṇḍalas on the ground extending from east to west;
standing in the western maṇḍala, and placing the articles of worship in the middle one,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya somamanyasminmaṇḍale 'bjasamanvite /
samabhyarcyaṃ vidhānena pīṭhapūjanapūrvakam //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य सोममन्यस्मिन्मण्डले ऽब्जसमन्विते /
समभ्यर्च्यं विधानेन पीठपूजनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt:
And having established the moon in the other maṇḍala endowed with a lotus,
and worshipped him according to rule, preceded by worship of the seat,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayedrājataṃ pātraṃ puratastatra mantravit /
surabhīpayasāpūryya taṃ spṛśanprajapenmanum //
meaning:
स्थापयेद्राजतं पात्रं पुरतस्तत्र मन्त्रवित् /
सुरभीपयसापूर्य्य तं स्पृशन्प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt:
The knower of mantras should place a silver vessel before him there.
Filling it with cow's milk and touching it, he should recite the mantra

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ paścādvidyā mantreṇa mantravit /
dadyānniśākarāyārdhyaṃ sarvābhīṣṭārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं पश्चाद्विद्या मन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् /
दद्यान्निशाकरायार्ध्यं सर्वाभीष्टार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt:
One hundred and eight times; then the knower of mantras, with the vidyā-mantra,
should offer an arghya to the moon for the attainment of all desired aims.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādanena vidhinā pratimāsamatandritaḥ /
vaṣāntareṇa savaṣṭaṃ prāpnoti bhuvimānavaḥ //
meaning:
कुर्यादनेन विधिना प्रतिमासमतन्द्रितः /
वषान्तरेण सवष्टं प्राप्नोति भुविमानवः //
text_mt:
Performing this ritual every month without sloth,
a man on earth attains everything he wishes within a year.

sanskrit_iast:
vidye vidyāmālini syādanta candriṇi katavadet /
candramukhi dviṭhānto 'yaṃ vidyāmantra udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विद्ये विद्यामालिनि स्यादन्त चन्द्रिणि कतवदेत् /
चन्द्रमुखि द्विठान्तो ऽयं विद्यामन्त्र उदाहृतः //
text_mt:
‘vidye vidyāmālini’ should be [spoken], then at the end ‘candriṇi’, then one should say
‘candramukhi’, ending with ‘dviṭhā’ (svāhā); this is declared as the vidyā-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kumudinīnāthamantraṃ yo japati dhruvam /
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutānpautrānsaubhāgyaṃ labhate 'cirāt //
meaning:
एवं कुमुदिनीनाथमन्त्रं यो जपति ध्रुवम् /
धनं धान्यं सुतान्पौत्रान्सौभाग्यं लभते ऽचिरात् //
text_mt:
Whoever thus constantly recites the mantra of the lord of water-lilies
quickly obtains wealth, grain, sons, grandsons, and good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
athāṅgārakamantraṃ tu vakṣye dhanasutapradam /
tāro dīrghenduyugvyoma tadevenduyutaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अथाङ्गारकमन्त्रं तु वक्ष्ये धनसुतप्रदम् /
तारो दीर्घेन्दुयुग्व्योम तदेवेन्दुयुतः पुनः //
text_mt:
Now I shall declare the mantra of Aṅgāraka (Mars), which grants wealth and sons.
Tāra (Om), the ether (ha) joined with a long moon (ūṃ), then again that [same letter] with the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣāntaḥ sargī ca caṇḍīśau kramārdiduvisargiṇai /
ṣaḍarṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro maṅgalasyākhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
षान्तः सर्गी च चण्डीशौ क्रमार्दिदुविसर्गिणै /
षडर्णो ऽयं महामन्त्रो मङ्गलस्याखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt:
Ending with ṣa, with visarga (saḥ), and caṇḍīśa (bha) and u, each with a visarga (bhuḥ)—
this six-syllabled great mantra of Maṅgala grants all desired objects.

sanskrit_iast:
virūpākṣo muniśchandogāyatraṃ devatā kujaḥ /
mantrārṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgāni krurvandhyāyeddharātmajam //
meaning:
विरूपाक्षो मुनिश्छन्दोगायत्रं देवता कुजः /
मन्त्रार्णैः षड्भिरङ्गानि क्रुर्वन्ध्यायेद्धरात्मजम् //
text_mt:
Virūpākṣa is the sage, the metre is gāyatrī, Kuja is the deity.
Performing the limbs with the six syllables of the mantra, one should meditate on the son of the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
meṣasthaṃ raktavasrāṅgaṃ śūlaśaktigadāvarān /
karairbibhrāṇamīśānasvedajaṃ bhūṃsutaṃ smaret //
meaning:
मेषस्थं रक्तवस्राङ्गं शूलशक्तिगदावरान् /
करैर्बिभ्राणमीशानस्वेदजं भूंसुतं स्मरेत् //
text_mt:
One should remember the son of the earth seated on a ram, his body and garments red,
bearing a spear, a lance, a mace, and granting boons with his hands, born from the sweat of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
rasalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ khadirodbhavaiḥ /
samidbhirjuhuyādagnau śaive pīṭhe yajetkujam //
meaning:
रसलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं खदिरोद्भवैः /
समिद्भिर्जुहुयादग्नौ शैवे पीठे यजेत्कुजम् //
text_mt:
One should recite the mantra six hundred thousand times, and in the fire one should offer a tenth of that
with kindling sticks from the khadira tree; one should worship Kuja on a Śaiva seat.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgaṅgāni samārādhya hyekaviṃśatikoṣṭakam /
maṅgalobhūmiputraśca ṛṇahartā dhanapradaḥ //
meaning:
प्रागङ्गानि समाराध्य ह्येकविंशतिकोष्टकम् /
मङ्गलोभूमिपुत्रश्च ऋणहर्ता धनप्रदः //
text_mt:
Having first worshipped the limbs, [one should worship] the twenty-one compartments:
Maṅgala, Bhūmiputra, the remover of debt, the giver of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
sthirāsano mahākāyaḥ sarvakarmāvarodhakaḥ /
lohito lohitākṣaśca sāmagānāṃ kṛpākaraḥ //
meaning:
स्थिरासनो महाकायः सर्वकर्मावरोधकः /
लोहितो लोहिताक्षश्च सामगानां कृपाकरः //
text_mt:
Sthirāsana, Mahākāya, Sarvakarmāvarodhaka,
Lohita, Lohitākṣa, Merciful to singers of the Sāman,

sanskrit_iast:
dharātmajaḥ kujo bhaumo bhūmido bhūminandanaḥ /
aṅgārako mahīsūnuḥ sarvarogāpahārakaḥ //
meaning:
धरात्मजः कुजो भौमो भूमिदो भूमिनन्दनः /
अङ्गारको महीसूनुः सर्वरोगापहारकः //
text_mt:
Dharātmaja, Kuja, Bhauma, Bhūmida, Bhūminandana,
Aṅgāraka, Mahīsūnu, Remover of all diseases,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣṭikartā vṛṣṭihartā sarvakāryārthasiddhidaḥ /
ityeka rviśatiḥ proktā mūrtayo bhūsutasya vai //
meaning:
वृष्टिकर्ता वृष्टिहर्ता सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धिदः /
इत्येक र्विशतिः प्रोक्ता मूर्तयो भूसुतस्य वै //
text_mt:
Maker of rain, Withholder of rain, and Bestower of success in all undertakings;
these indeed are spoken of as the twenty-one forms of the son of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalādīnyajenmantrī svasvasthānasthitānkramāt /
indrādyānapi vajrādīnevaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ //
meaning:
मङ्गलादीन्यजेन्मन्त्री स्वस्वस्थानस्थितान्क्रमात् /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्रादीनेवं सिद्धो भवेन्मनुः //
text_mt:
The practitioner of mantras should worship Maṅgala and the rest situated in their respective places in order,
and also Indra and the others, and the thunderbolt and the others; thus the mantra becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
sutakāmā kuraṅgākṣī bhaumavratamupācaret /
mārgaśīrṣe 'tha vaiśākhe vratāraṃbhaḥ praśasyate //
meaning:
सुतकामा कुरङ्गाक्षी भौमव्रतमुपाचरेत् /
मार्गशीर्षे ऽथ वैशाखे व्रतारंभः प्रशस्यते //
text_mt:
A fawn-eyed woman desirous of a son should perform the vow of Bhauma.
The commencement of the vow is praised in Mārgaśīrṣa or in Vaiśākha.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇodayavelāyāmutthāyāvaśyakaṃ punaḥ /
vinirvartya radāndhāvedapāmārgeṇa vāgyatā //
meaning:
अरुणोदयवेलायामुत्थायावश्यकं पुनः /
विनिर्वर्त्य रदान्धावेदपामार्गेण वाग्यता //
text_mt:
Rising at the time of dawn, and having performed
her necessary duties, she should clean her teeth with apāmārga, restraining her speech.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā raktāṃbaradharā raktamālyavilepanā /
naivedyādīṃśca saṃbhārānraktānsarvānprakalpayet //
meaning:
स्नात्वा रक्तांबरधरा रक्तमाल्यविलेपना /
नैवेद्यादींश्च संभारान्रक्तान्सर्वान्प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
Having bathed, wearing red garments, adorned with red garlands and unguents,
she should prepare all the provisions, including the food offerings, in red.

sanskrit_iast:
yogyaṃ vipraṃ samāhūya kujamarcettadājñayā /
raktagogomayāliptabhūmau raktāsane viśet //
meaning:
योग्यं विप्रं समाहूय कुजमर्चेत्तदाज्ञया /
रक्तगोगोमयालिप्तभूमौ रक्तासने विशेत् //
text_mt:
Summoning a worthy brahmin, she should worship Kuja at his direction.
She should sit on a red seat upon ground smeared with red cow-dung.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya deśakālau ca smṛtvā kāmya samuccaran /
maṅgalādīni nāmāni svakīyāṅgeṣu vinyaset //
meaning:
आचम्य देशकालौ च स्मृत्वा काम्य समुच्चरन् /
मङ्गलादीनि नामानि स्वकीयाङ्गेषु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
Having sipped water, recalled the place and time, and stated her desire,
she should project the names beginning with Maṅgala onto her own limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe pravinyasetsādhvī sāmagānāṃ kṛpākaram /
dharātmajaṃ nasorakṣṇoḥ kujaṃ bhaumaṃ lalāṭake //
meaning:
मुखे प्रविन्यसेत्साध्वी सामगानां कृपाकरम् /
धरात्मजं नसोरक्ष्णोः कुजं भौमं ललाटके //
text_mt:
The virtuous woman should place ‘Merciful to singers of the Sāman’ on the mouth,
‘Dharātmaja’ on the nose, ‘Kuja’ on the eyes, ‘Bhauma’ on the forehead,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidaṃ tu bhruvormadhye mastake bhūminandanam /
aṅgārakaṃ śikhāyāṃ ca sarvāṅge ca mahīsutam //
meaning:
भूमिदं तु भ्रुवोर्मध्ये मस्तके भूमिनन्दनम् /
अङ्गारकं शिखायां च सर्वाङ्गे च महीसुतम् //
text_mt:
‘Bhūmida’ between the eyebrows, ‘Bhūminandana’ on the head,
‘Aṅgāraka’ on the tuft of hair, and ‘Mahīsūta’ on the whole body;

sanskrit_iast:
bāhudvaye nyasetpaścātsarvarogāpahārakam /
mūrddhādi vṛṣṭikartāramāpādāntaṃ nyasetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
बाहुद्वये न्यसेत्पश्चात्सर्वरोगापहारकम् /
मूर्द्धादि वृष्टिकर्तारमापादान्तं न्यसेत्सुधीः //
text_mt:
Next, the wise woman should place ‘Remover of all diseases’ on both arms,
‘Maker of rain’ from the head down to the feet,

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasedrṛṣṭihartāraṃ mūrddhāntaṃ caraṇāditaḥ /
nyasedante tato dikṣu sarvakāryārthasiddhidam //
meaning:
विन्यसेद्रृष्टिहर्तारं मूर्द्धान्तं चरणादितः /
न्यसेदन्ते ततो दिक्षु सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt:
‘Withholder of rain’ from the feet up to the head;
then at the end she should place ‘Bestower of success in all undertakings’ in the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhau hṛdi śirasyāraṃ vakre bhūmijameva ca /
vinyasyaivaṃ nije dehe dhyāyetprāgvaddharātmajam //
meaning:
नाभौ हृदि शिरस्यारं वक्रे भूमिजमेव च /
विन्यस्यैवं निजे देहे ध्यायेत्प्राग्वद्धरात्मजम् //
text_mt:
Placing Āra on the navel, heart, and head, and Bhūmija on the mouth,
having thus performed the placement on her own body, she should meditate on the son of the earth as before.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasairupacāraiśca saṃpūjyārdhyaṃ nidhāpayet /
ekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāḍhye trikoṇe tāmrapatrage //
meaning:
मानसैरुपचारैश्च संपूज्यार्ध्यं निधापयेत् /
एकविंशतिकोष्ठाढ्ये त्रिकोणे ताम्रपत्रगे //
text_mt:
Having worshipped him with mental offerings, she should present the arghya.
In a copper vessel containing a triangle rich with twenty-one compartments,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhyāṅgārakaṃ tatra raktapuṣpādibhiryajet /
aṅgāni pūrvamārādhya maṅgalādīnprapūjayet //
meaning:
आवाह्याङ्गारकं तत्र रक्तपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् /
अङ्गानि पूर्वमाराध्य मङ्गलादीन्प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt:
Having invoked Aṅgāraka there, she should worship him with red flowers and other offerings.
Having first worshipped the limbs, she should worship Maṅgala and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśatikoṣṭheṣu cakramāraṃ ca bhūmijam /
trikoṇeṣu ca sampūjya bahiraṣṭau ca mātṛkāḥ //
meaning:
एकविंशतिकोष्ठेषु चक्रमारं च भूमिजम् /
त्रिकोणेषु च सम्पूज्य बहिरष्टौ च मातृकाः //
text_mt:
Having worshipped Āra, the son of the earth, in the twenty-one compartments
and in the triangles, and the eight mothers outside,

sanskrit_iast:
indrādīnatha vajrādīnbāhye saṃpūjayetpunaḥ /
dhūpadīpau samarpyātha godhūmānnaṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
इन्द्रादीनथ वज्रादीन्बाह्ये संपूजयेत्पुनः /
धूपदीपौ समर्प्याथ गोधूमान्नं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt:
She should again worship Indra and the others, and the thunderbolt and the others outside.
Then offering incense and a lamp, she should offer wheat food.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātre śuddhatoyapūrite raktacandanam /
raktapuṣpākṣataphalānyākṣipyārdhyaṃ samarpayet /
maṅgalāya tato mantrī idaṃ mantradvayaṃ paṭhet //
meaning:
ताम्रपात्रे शुद्धतोयपूरिते रक्तचन्दनम् /
रक्तपुष्पाक्षतफलान्याक्षिप्यार्ध्यं समर्पयेत् /
मङ्गलाय ततो मन्त्री इदं मन्त्रद्वयं पठेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiputra mahātejaḥ svedodbhavapinākinaḥ /
sutārthinī prapannā tvāṃ gṛhāṇārdhyaṃ namo 'stu te //
meaning:
भूमिपुत्र महातेजः स्वेदोद्भवपिनाकिनः /
सुतार्थिनी प्रपन्ना त्वां गृहाणार्ध्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
‘O son of the earth, of great splendor, born from the sweat of the Wielder of the Pināka!
Desiring a son, I have taken refuge in you; accept this arghya, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
raktapravālasaṃkāśa japākusumasannibha /
mahīsuta mahābhāga gṛhāṇārdhyaṃ namo 'stu te //
meaning:
रक्तप्रवालसंकाश जपाकुसुमसन्निभ /
महीसुत महाभाग गृहाणार्ध्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
O one resembling red coral, like the hibiscus flower,
O son of the earth, highly fortunate one, accept this arghya, homage to you!’

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśatipūrvoktairṅenamontaiṃśca nāmabhiḥ /
tārādyaiḥ praṇametpaścāttāvatyaśca pradakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning:
एकविंशतिपूर्वोक्तैर्ङेनमोन्तैंश्च नामभिः /
ताराद्यैः प्रणमेत्पश्चात्तावत्यश्च प्रदक्षिणाः //
text_mt:
With the twenty-one previously mentioned names ending in the dative case and ‘namaḥ’,
beginning with Tāra (Om), she should then bow down, and perform that many circumambulations.

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇīgarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ vidyuttejaḥ samaprabham /
kumāraṃ śaktihastaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyaham //
meaning:
धरणीगर्भसंभूतं विद्युत्तेजः समप्रभम् /
कुमारं शक्तिहस्तं च मङ्गलं प्रणमाम्यहम् //
text_mt:
‘I bow to Maṅgala, born from the womb of the earth, equal in brilliance to the flash of lightning,
a youth holding a lance in his hand.’

sanskrit_iast:
tato rekhātrayaṃ kuryātkhadirāṅgārakeṇa ca /
mārjayedvāmapādena mantrābhyāṃ ca samāhitā //
meaning:
ततो रेखात्रयं कुर्यात्खदिराङ्गारकेण च /
मार्जयेद्वामपादेन मन्त्राभ्यां च समाहिता //
text_mt:
Then, with a charcoal of khadira wood, she should draw three lines,
and wipe them away with her left foot, composed in mind, with two mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśāya putrasaṃtānahetave /
kṛtarekhātrayaṃ vāmapādenaitatpramārjmyaham //
meaning:
दुःखदौर्भाग्यनाशाय पुत्रसंतानहेतवे /
कृतरेखात्रयं वामपादेनैतत्प्रमार्ज्म्यहम् //
text_mt:
‘For the destruction of sorrow and misfortune, and for the sake of obtaining male offspring,
I wipe away these three drawn lines with my left foot.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇaduḥ khavināśāya manobhīṣṭārthasiddhiye /
mārjayāmyasitā rekhāstisro janmatrayodbhavāḥ //
meaning:
ऋणदुः खविनाशाय मनोभीष्टार्थसिद्धिये /
मार्जयाम्यसिता रेखास्तिस्रो जन्मत्रयोद्भवाः //
text_mt:
For the destruction of debt and sorrow, and for the fulfillment of the desires of my heart,
I wipe away the three black lines arising from three births.’

sanskrit_iast:
stuvīta dharaṇīputraṃ puṣpāñjalikarā tataḥ /
dhyāyantī tatpadāṃbhojaṃ pūjāsāṃgatvasiddhaye //
meaning:
स्तुवीत धरणीपुत्रं पुष्पाञ्जलिकरा ततः /
ध्यायन्ती तत्पदांभोजं पूजासांगत्वसिद्धये //
text_mt: Then, with folded hands holding a handful of flowers, she should praise the son of the Earth, / meditating on his lotus-feet for the successful completion of the worship:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇahartre namastubhyaṃ duḥkhadāridrayanāśine /
saubhāgyasukhado nityaṃ bhava me dharaṇīsuta //
meaning:
ऋणहर्त्रे नमस्तुभ्यं दुःखदारिद्रयनाशिने /
सौभाग्यसुखदो नित्यं भव मे धरणीसुत //
text_mt: 'Homage to you, remover of debt, destroyer of sorrow and poverty! / O Son of the Earth, be ever the bestower of fortune and happiness upon me!

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśa taruṇārkasamaprabha /
sukhasaubhāgyadhanada ṛṇadāridṣanāśaka //
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चनसंकाश तरुणार्कसमप्रभ /
सुखसौभाग्यधनद ऋणदारिद्षनाशक //
text_mt: O one resembling molten gold, having the radiance of the morning sun! / O bestower of happiness, good fortune, and wealth, destroyer of debt and poverty!

sanskrit_iast:
graharāja namaste 'stu sarvakalyāṇakāraka /
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa sarvakalyāṇabhājana //
meaning:
ग्रहराज नमस्ते ऽस्तु सर्वकल्याणकारक /
प्रसादं कुरु देवेश सर्वकल्याणभाजन //
text_mt: O king among planets, homage be to you, causer of all auspiciousness! / Grant your favor, O lord of deities, vessel of all auspiciousness!

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ /
āpnuvanti śivaṃ sarve sadā pūrṇamanorathāḥ //
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः /
आप्नुवन्ति शिवं सर्वे सदा पूर्णमनोरथाः //
text_mt: Deities, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and serpents / all attain auspiciousness, their desires always fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
ācirādeva loke 'sminyasyārādhanato janāḥ /
prāpnuvanti sukhaṃ tasmai namo dharaṇisūnave //
meaning:
आचिरादेव लोके ऽस्मिन्यस्याराधनतो जनाः /
प्राप्नुवन्ति सुखं तस्मै नमो धरणिसूनवे //
text_mt: Homage to that son of the Earth, through whose worship people in this world / attain happiness without delay!

sanskrit_iast:
yo vakragatimāpanno nṛṇāṃ duḥkhaṃ prayacchati /
pūjitaḥ sukhasaubhāgyaṃ tasmai kṣmāsūnave namaḥ //
meaning:
यो वक्रगतिमापन्नो नृणां दुःखं प्रयच्छति /
पूजितः सुखसौभाग्यं तस्मै क्ष्मासूनवे नमः //
text_mt: Homage to that son of the Earth who, entering retrograde motion, brings sorrow to mortals, / but when worshipped, brings happiness and good fortune!

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasi dyotamānāya sarvakalyāṇahetave /
maṅgalāya namastubhyaṃ dhanasaṃtānahetave //
meaning:
नभसि द्योतमानाय सर्वकल्याणहेतवे /
मङ्गलाय नमस्तुभ्यं धनसंतानहेतवे //
text_mt: Homage to you, Maṅgala, shining in the sky, cause of all auspiciousness, / cause of wealth and offspring!

sanskrit_iast:
prasādaṃ kuru me bhaumamaṅgalaprada maṅgala /
meṣavāhana rudrātmandehi putrāndhanaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसादं कुरु मे भौममङ्गलप्रद मङ्गल /
मेषवाहन रुद्रात्मन्देहि पुत्रान्धनं यशः //
text_mt: Grant me your favor, O Bhauma, O Maṅgala, bestower of auspiciousness! / O one who rides a ram, whose nature is Rudra, grant me sons, wealth, and renown!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutvā praṇamyātha visṛjya dharaṇīsutam /
yathāśaktyā pradāya svaṃ gṛhṇīyādbraṇāśiṣaḥ //
meaning:
एवं स्तुत्वा प्रणम्याथ विसृज्य धरणीसुतम् /
यथाशक्त्या प्रदाय स्वं गृह्णीयाद्ब्रणाशिषः //
text_mt: Having thus praised him, bowed, and dismissed the son of the Earth, / one should give away one's wealth according to capacity and receive the blessings of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā bhuñjīyāttanniveditam //
meaning: गुरवे दक्षिणां दत्त्वा भुञ्जीयात्तन्निवेदितम् //
text_mt: Having given the fee to the preceptor, one should eat what was offered to the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
evamāvatsaraṃ kuryātpratimaṅgalavāsaram /
tilairhemaṃ vidhāyātha śatārddhaṃ bhojayoddvijān //
meaning:
एवमावत्सरं कुर्यात्प्रतिमङ्गलवासरम् /
तिलैर्हेमं विधायाथ शतार्द्धं भोजयोद्द्विजान् //
text_mt: One should do this for a year on every Tuesday. / Then, having made a fire oblation with sesame seeds, one should feed fifty Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumamūrtiṃ svarṇamayīmācāryāya samarpayet /
maṇḍalasthe ghaṭe 'bhyarcyetsutasaubhāgyasiddhaye //
meaning:
भौममूर्तिं स्वर्णमयीमाचार्याय समर्पयेत् /
मण्डलस्थे घटे ऽभ्यर्च्येत्सुतसौभाग्यसिद्धये //
text_mt: One should present a golden idol of Bhauma to the preceptor; / one should worship him in a water-jar placed on a sacred diagram for the sake of attaining sons and good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vrataparā nārī prāpnuyātsubhagānsutān /
ṛṇanāśāya vittārthaṃ vrataṃ kuryātpumānapi //
meaning:
एवं व्रतपरा नारी प्राप्नुयात्सुभगान्सुतान् /
ऋणनाशाय वित्तार्थं व्रतं कुर्यात्पुमानपि //
text_mt: A woman devoted to this observance thus attains fortunate sons; / a man also should perform this observance for the eradication of debt and for wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ prajapenmantraṃmagnirmūrddheti vaidikam /
aṅgārakasya gāyatrīṃ vakṣye yajanasiddhaye //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः प्रजपेन्मन्त्रंमग्निर्मूर्द्धेति वैदिकम् /
अङ्गारकस्य गायत्रीं वक्ष्ये यजनसिद्धये //
text_mt: A Brahmin should recite the Vedic mantra 'agnirmūrdhā…'. / I shall describe the gāyatrī of Aṅgāraka for the perfection of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgārakāya śabdānte vidmahe padamīrayet /
śaktihastāya varṇānte dhīmahīti samuñcaret //
meaning:
अङ्गारकाय शब्दान्ते विद्महे पदमीरयेत् /
शक्तिहस्ताय वर्णान्ते धीमहीति समुञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: After the word 'aṅgārakāya', one should utter the word 'vidmahe'; / after the syllable ending in 'śaktihastāya', one should utter 'dhīmahi';

sanskrit_iast:
tanno bhaumaḥ pracovarṇāndayānditi ca saṃvadet /
bhaumasyaiṣā tu gāyatrī japtuḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidā //
meaning:
तन्नो भौमः प्रचोवर्णान्दयान्दिति च संवदेत् /
भौमस्यैषा तु गायत्री जप्तुः सर्वेष्टसिद्धिदा //
text_mt: and one should recite the syllables 'tanno bhaumaḥ pracodayāt'. / This is the gāyatrī of Bhauma, which bestows the attainment of all desires upon the reciter.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaumopāsanametaddhi budhamantramathocyate /
phaāntaḥ karṇendusaṃyukto budho ṅeṃte hadantimaḥ //
meaning:
भौमोपासनमेतद्धि बुधमन्त्रमथोच्यते /
फआन्तः कर्णेन्दुसंयुक्तो बुधो ङेंते हदन्तिमः //
text_mt: This is the worship of Bhauma; now the mantra of Budha is described: / The letter ending in ph [i.e., b], joined with the ear [u] and moon [anusvāra], 'budha' in the dative, followed by the heart-mantra ['namaḥ']—

sanskrit_iast:
rasāṇoṃ budhamantro 'yaṃ munibrahmāsya kīrtitaḥ /
paṅktiśchaido devatā tu budhaḥ sarveṣṭado nṛṇām //
meaning:
रसाणों बुधमन्त्रो ऽयं मुनिब्रह्मास्य कीर्तितः /
पङ्क्तिश्छैदो देवता तु बुधः सर्वेष्टदो नृणाम् //
text_mt: this is the six-syllabled mantra of Budha; Brahmā is declared as its seer, / Paṅkti is the metre, and the deity is Budha, who grants all desires to mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye /
vande budhaṃ sadā bhaktyā pītāmbaravibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
आद्यं बीजं नमः शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
वन्दे बुधं सदा भक्त्या पीताम्बरविभूषणम् //
text_mt: The first syllable is the seed, 'namaḥ' is the power, and the ritual application is for the attainment of everything. / 'I revere Budha always with devotion, adorned with yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
jānusthavāmahastāḍhyaṃ sābhayetarapāṇikam /
dhyātvevaṃ prajapesahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
जानुस्थवामहस्ताढ्यं साभयेतरपाणिकम् /
ध्यात्वेवं प्रजपेसहस्रं विजितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: with his left hand placed upon his knee, and his other hand granting fearlessness'— / meditating thus, one with subdued senses should recite it a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādājyaiḥ pīṭhe pūrvoditer'cayet /
aṅgamātṛdiśāpālahetibhirbudhamarcayet //
meaning:
दशांशं जुहुयादाज्यैः पीठे पूर्वोदितेर्ऽचयेत् /
अङ्गमातृदिशापालहेतिभिर्बुधमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: One should offer one-tenth of that as oblations of clarified butter; one should worship him on the aforementioned ritual seat. / One should worship Budha along with his limbs, mothers, guardians of the directions, and weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayetsvamanorathān /
sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ nityaṃ daśadināvadhi //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेत्स्वमनोरथान् /
सहस्रं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं नित्यं दशदिनावधि //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner achieves his desires. / If one recites the mantra a thousand times daily for a period of ten days,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāśu grahajā pīḍā naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
budhasyārādhanaṃ proktaṃ gurorārādhanaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
तस्याशु ग्रहजा पीडा नश्यत्येव न संशयः /
बुधस्याराधनं प्रोक्तं गुरोराराधनं शृणु //
text_mt: the affliction caused by the planet certainly vanishes for him, without a doubt. / The worship of Budha has been spoken; now hear the worship of Guru.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛṃhaspatipadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ seṃdvādyarṇāghamaṇḍitam /
namonto vasuvarṇo 'yaṃ munirbrahmāsya saṃmataḥ //
meaning:
बृंहस्पतिपदं ङेंतं सेंद्वाद्यर्णाघमण्डितम् /
नमोन्तो वसुवर्णो ऽयं मुनिर्ब्रह्मास्य संमतः //
text_mt: The word 'bṛhaspati' in the dative case, adorned with the first letter [a] with the moon [anusvāra], / ending with 'namaḥ' [i.e. 'oṃ bṛhaspataye namaḥ'], is an eight-syllabled mantra; Brahmā is accepted as its seer,

sanskrit_iast:
chando 'nuṣṭupsurācāryo devatā bījamādimam /
hṛcchaktirdīrghavahnīnduyugalenāṅgakalpanā //
meaning:
छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप्सुराचार्यो देवता बीजमादिमम् /
हृच्छक्तिर्दीर्घवह्नीन्दुयुगलेनाङ्गकल्पना //
text_mt: the metre is Anuṣṭubh, the teacher of the gods is the deity, the first syllable is the seed, / 'namaḥ' is the power, and the assignment of limbs is made with the long vowels accompanied by fire and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
nyastavāmakaraṃ rāśau ratnānāṃ dakṣiṇātkarāt /
kirantaṃ pītapuṣpālaṅkārālepāṃśukārcitam //
meaning:
न्यस्तवामकरं राशौ रत्नानां दक्षिणात्करात् /
किरन्तं पीतपुष्पालङ्कारालेपांशुकार्चितम् //
text_mt: Resting his left hand upon a heap of gems, scattering [wealth] from his right hand, / worshipped with yellow flowers, ornaments, ointments, and garments,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavidyānidhiṃ devaguruṃ svarṇadyutiṃ smaret /
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena ghṛtenānnena vā hunet //
meaning:
सर्वविद्यानिधिं देवगुरुं स्वर्णद्युतिं स्मरेत् /
लक्षं जपो दशांशेन घृतेनान्नेन वा हुनेत् //
text_mt: one should meditate on the teacher of the gods, the treasury of all knowledge, possessing a golden lustre. / The recitation is a hundred thousand times; one-tenth of that should be offered into the fire with clarified butter or food.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādipīṭhe prayajedaṅgadikpālahetibhiḥ /
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मादिपीठे प्रयजेदङ्गदिक्पालहेतिभिः /
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेदिष्टमात्मनः //
text_mt: One should worship on the seat of Dharma and the rest, with the limbs, guardians of the directions, and their weapons. / When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner achieves his desired object.

sanskrit_iast:
viparogādipīḍāsu kalahe svajanodbhave /
pippalotthasamidbhiśca juhuyāttannivṛttaye //
meaning:
विपरोगादिपीडासु कलहे स्वजनोद्भवे /
पिप्पलोत्थसमिद्भिश्च जुहुयात्तन्निवृत्तये //
text_mt: In afflictions such as fever, sickness, and the like, or in strife arising among one's own kinsmen, / one should offer oblations with sacred fuel sticks of the pippala tree for their cessation.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā dinatrayaṃ mantrī niśāpuṣpairghṛtaplutaiḥ /
sa viṃśatiśataṃ śīghraṃ vāsāṃsi labhate mahīm //
meaning:
हुत्वा दिनत्रयं मन्त्री निशापुष्पैर्घृतप्लुतैः /
स विंशतिशतं शीघ्रं वासांसि लभते महीम् //
text_mt: Having offered oblations for three days with night-blooming flowers drenched in clarified butter, / the practitioner quickly obtains garments, land, and one hundred and twenty [cows].

sanskrit_iast:
gurorārādhanaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu śukrasya sāṃpratam /
vasraṃ me dehi śukrāya ṭhadvayānto dhruvādikaḥ //
meaning:
गुरोराराधनं प्रोक्तं शृणु शुक्रस्य सांप्रतम् /
वस्रं मे देहि शुक्राय ठद्वयान्तो ध्रुवादिकः //
text_mt: The worship of Guru has been spoken; now hear that of Śukra: / 'vastraṃ me dehi śukrāya' ending with two ṭhas ['svāhā'] and beginning with dhruva ['oṃ']—

sanskrit_iast:
rudrārṇo 'yaṃ manurbrahmā muniśchando virāhuta /
daityejyo devatā bījaṃ dhruvaḥ śaktirvasupriyā //
meaning:
रुद्रार्णो ऽयं मनुर्ब्रह्मा मुनिश्छन्दो विराहुत /
दैत्येज्यो देवता बीजं ध्रुवः शक्तिर्वसुप्रिया //
text_mt: this eleven-syllabled mantra has Brahmā as its seer, the metre is Virāj, / the preceptor of the Daityas is the deity, dhruva ['oṃ'] is the seed, and the beloved of the Vasus ['svāhā'] is the power.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūnetra candranetrāgninetrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam /
śuklāṃbarālepabhūṣaṃ kareṇa dadataṃ dhanam //
meaning:
भूनेत्र चन्द्रनेत्राग्निनेत्रार्णैः स्यात्षडङ्गकम् /
शुक्लांबरालेपभूषं करेण ददतं धनम् //
text_mt: The six limbs are formed with the syllables with one, two, three, four, five, and six vowels. / Adorned with white garments, ointments, and ornaments, granting wealth with one hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmena śukraṃ vyākhyānamudrādoṣaṃ smaretsudhīḥ /
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyād ghṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
वामेन शुक्रं व्याख्यानमुद्रादोषं स्मरेत्सुधीः /
अयुतं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं जुहुयाद् घृतैः //
text_mt: and showing the gesture of exposition with the left, the wise man should meditate on Śukra. / One should recite the mantra ten thousand times and offer one-tenth of that as oblations with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādipīṭhe prayajedaṅgendrāditadāyudhaiḥ /
śvetapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca juhuyād bhṛguvāsare //
meaning:
धर्मादिपीठे प्रयजेदङ्गेन्द्रादितदायुधैः /
श्वेतपुष्पैः सुगन्धैश्च जुहुयाद् भृगुवासरे //
text_mt: One should worship on the seat of Dharma and the rest, along with the limbs, Indra and the other [guardians], and their weapons. / On Friday, one should offer oblations with white, fragrant flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśativāraṃ yo labhatesoṃ'śukaṃ maṇīn /
manavo 'mo sadā gopyā na deyā yasya kasyacit //
meaning:
एकविंशतिवारं यो लभतेसोंऽशुकं मणीन् /
मनवो ऽमो सदा गोप्या न देया यस्य कस्यचित् //
text_mt: One who [recites] twenty-one times obtains garments and gems. / These mantras should always be kept secret, and not given to just anyone;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiyuktāya śiṣyāya deyā vā nijasūnave //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde mantravidhānanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
भक्तियुक्ताय शिष्याय देया वा निजसूनवे //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे मन्त्रविधाननिरूपणं नामैकोनसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
they may be given to a devoted disciple, or to one's own son.

Thus ends the sixty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Rules for Mantras', in the third quarter of the Bṛhadupākhyāna in the Pūrvabhāga of the illustrious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha vakṣye mahāviṣṇormantrānlokeṣu durlabhān /
yānprāpya mānavāstūrṇaṃ prāpnuvanti nijepsitam //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ वक्ष्ये महाविष्णोर्मन्त्रान्लोकेषु दुर्लभान् /
यान्प्राप्य मानवास्तूर्णं प्राप्नुवन्ति निजेप्सितम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Now I shall declare the mantras of Mahāviṣṇu, difficult to obtain in the worlds, / having attained which, men quickly accomplish their desired end.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāmuñcāraṇeneva pāpasaṃghaḥ pralīyate /
brahmādayo 'pi yāñjñātvā samarthāḥ syurjagatkṛtau //
meaning:
येषामुञ्चारणेनेव पापसंघः प्रलीयते /
ब्रह्मादयो ऽपि याञ्ज्ञात्वा समर्थाः स्युर्जगत्कृतौ //
text_mt: By the mere utterance of which the mass of sins dissolves, / and having known which even Brahmā and the others become capable of creating the world;

sanskrit_iast:
tārahṛtpūrvakaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ nārāyaṇapadaṃ bhavet /
aṣṭākṣaro manuścāsya sādhyo nārāyaṇo muniḥ //
meaning:
तारहृत्पूर्वकं ङेंतं नारायणपदं भवेत् /
अष्टाक्षरो मनुश्चास्य साध्यो नारायणो मुनिः //
text_mt: preceded by the tāra and hṛt, let the word 'Nārāyaṇa' end in the dative: / this is the eight-syllabled mantra, whose master-seer is the sage Nārāyaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
chandaḥ proktaṃ ca gāyatrī devatā viṣṇukhyayaḥ /
oṃ bījaṃ yaṃ ca tathā śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye //
meaning:
छन्दः प्रोक्तं च गायत्री देवता विष्णुख्ययः /
ओं बीजं यं च तथा शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये //
text_mt: its meter is said to be the gāyatrī, and the deity is named Viṣṇu; / 'Oṃ' is the seed-syllable, and 'yaṃ' is the energy; its ritual application is for the attainment of all ends.

sanskrit_iast:
kruddholkāya hṛdākhyātaṃ maholkāya śiraḥ smṛtam /
vīrolkāya śikhā proktā dyulkāya kavacaṃ matam //
meaning:
क्रुद्धोल्काय हृदाख्यातं महोल्काय शिरः स्मृतम् /
वीरोल्काय शिखा प्रोक्ता द्युल्काय कवचं मतम् //
text_mt: 'To Kruddholka' is declared the heart; 'To Maholka' is recorded the head; / 'To Vīrolka' is said the topknot; 'To Dyulkay' is deemed the armour;

sanskrit_iast:
maholkāyeti cāsraṃ syāditthaṃ pañcāṅgakalpanā /
punaḥ ṣaḍaṅgamantrotthaiḥ ṣaḍvarṇaiśca samācaret //
meaning:
महोल्कायेति चास्रं स्यादित्थं पञ्चाङ्गकल्पना /
पुनः षडङ्गमन्त्रोत्थैः षड्वर्णैश्च समाचरेत् //
text_mt: and 'To Maholka' is the weapon: such is the arrangement of the five limbs. / Then one should also perform [the nyāsa] with the six syllables arising from the six-limbed mantra;

sanskrit_iast:
avaśiṣṭau nyasetkukṣipṛṣṭayormantravarṇakau /
sudarśanasya mantreṇa kuryāddigbandhanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
अवशिष्टौ न्यसेत्कुक्षिपृष्टयोर्मन्त्रवर्णकौ /
सुदर्शनस्य मन्त्रेण कुर्याद्दिग्बन्धनं ततः //
text_mt: one should place the two remaining mantra-syllables on the belly and back; / then one should perform the sealing of the directions with the mantra of Sudarśana.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro namaścaturthyantaṃ sudarśanapadaṃ vadet /
astrāyaphaḍiti prokto mantro dvādaśavarṇavān //
meaning:
तारो नमश्चतुर्थ्यन्तं सुदर्शनपदं वदेत् /
अस्त्रायफडिति प्रोक्तो मन्त्रो द्वादशवर्णवान् //
text_mt: One should utter the tāra, 'namaḥ', the word 'Sudarśana' ending in the dative, / and 'astrāya phaṭ': [thus] the twelve-syllabled mantra is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvṛttimaya nyāsaṃ vakṣye vibhūtipañcaram /
mūlārṇānsvatanau nyasyedādhāre hṛdaye mukhe //
meaning:
दशावृत्तिमय न्यासं वक्ष्ये विभूतिपञ्चरम् /
मूलार्णान्स्वतनौ न्यस्येदाधारे हृदये मुखे //
text_mt: I shall state the nyāsa consisting of ten repetitions, called the vibhūtipañjara: / one should place the root syllables upon one's own body—at the base, the heart, the mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
doḥpanmūleṣu nāsāyāṃ prathamāvṛttirīritā /
gale nābhau hṛdi kucapārśvapṛṣṭeṣu tatparāḥ //
meaning:
दोःपन्मूलेषु नासायां प्रथमावृत्तिरीरिता /
गले नाभौ हृदि कुचपार्श्वपृष्टेषु तत्पराः //
text_mt: at the base of the arms and feet, and in the nose: this is stated as the first repetition; / in the throat, navel, heart, breast, sides, and back are the next;

sanskrit_iast:
mūrddhāsyanetraśravaṇaghrāṇeṣu ca tṛtīyakāḥ /
doḥpādasaṃdhyaṅguliṣu vedāvṛttyā ca vinyaset //
meaning:
मूर्द्धास्यनेत्रश्रवणघ्राणेषु च तृतीयकाः /
दोःपादसंध्यङ्गुलिषु वेदावृत्त्या च विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: on the crown of the head, the mouth, the eyes, ears, and nose are the third; / and on the joints and fingers and toes of the arms and feet one should place them in the fourth repetition;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātuprāṇeṣu hṛdaye vinyasettadanantaram /
śironetrā syahṛtkukṣisorujaṅghāpadadvaye //
meaning:
धातुप्राणेषु हृदये विन्यसेत्तदनन्तरम् /
शिरोनेत्रा स्यहृत्कुक्षिसोरुजङ्घापदद्वये //
text_mt: thereafter one should place them on the bodily elements, the vital breaths, and the heart; / on the head, eyes, mouth, heart, belly, thighs, shanks, and both feet,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaśo nyasedvarṇānmantrasya kramataḥ sudhīḥ /
nyaseddhṛdaṃsorupadeṣvarṇānvedamitānmanoḥ //
meaning:
एकैकशो न्यसेद्वर्णान्मन्त्रस्य क्रमतः सुधीः /
न्यसेद्धृदंसोरुपदेष्वर्णान्वेदमितान्मनोः //
text_mt: the wise one should place the syllables of the mantra one by one in succession; / one should place the four syllables of the mantra on the heart, shoulders, thighs, and feet;

sanskrit_iast:
cakraśaṃ khagadāṃbhojapadeṣu svasvamudrayā /
śeṣāṃśca nyāsavaryo 'yaṃ vibhūtipañjarābhidhaḥ //
meaning:
चक्रशं खगदांभोजपदेषु स्वस्वमुद्रया /
शेषांश्च न्यासवर्यो ऽयं विभूतिपञ्जराभिधः //
text_mt: and with each one's own hand-gesture upon the positions of the discus, conch, mace, and lotus, / and the rest: this is the foremost nyāsa, named vibhūtipañjara.

sanskrit_iast:
nyasenmūlārṇamekaikaṃ sacandraṃ tārasampuṭam /
athavā vai namontena nyasedityapare jaguḥ //
meaning:
न्यसेन्मूलार्णमेकैकं सचन्द्रं तारसम्पुटम् /
अथवा वै नमोन्तेन न्यसेदित्यपरे जगुः //
text_mt: One should place each root syllable with a crescent moon, enveloped by the tāra; / or else, one should place them ending in 'namaḥ', so others have proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhiṣṇubhāvaprasiddhaye /
aṣṭārṇo 'ṣṭaprakṛtyātmā gaditaḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ //
meaning:
तत्त्वन्यासं ततः कुर्याद्धिष्णुभावप्रसिद्धये /
अष्टार्णो ऽष्टप्रकृत्यात्मा गदितः पूर्वसूरिभिः //
text_mt: Then one should perform the tattvanyāsa for the realization of the state of Viṣṇu: / the eight-syllabled [mantra] is declared by ancient sages to consist of the eight primary principles;

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tato 'hṝṅkārameva ca /
mahāṃśca prakṛtiścaivetyaṣṭau prakṛtayo matāḥ //
meaning:
पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि ततो ऽहॄङ्कारमेव च /
महांश्च प्रकृतिश्चैवेत्यष्टौ प्रकृतयो मताः //
text_mt: the elements beginning with earth, then the 'I'-maker, / the intellect, and primordial matter: these are considered the eight primary principles.

sanskrit_iast:
pāde liṅge hṛdi mukhe mūrdhni vakṣasi hṛtsthale /
sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ kuryādekena sādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
पादे लिङ्गे हृदि मुखे मूर्ध्नि वक्षसि हृत्स्थले /
सर्वाङ्गे व्यापकं कुर्यादेकेन साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: On the foot, the phallus, the heart, the mouth, the crown of the head, the chest, the region of the heart, / and over all limbs as an all-pervading [nyāsa], the foremost practitioner should perform [it] with one [syllable];

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārṇahṛtparāyādyamātmane hṛdayāntimam /
tattannāma samuñcāryya nyasettattatsthale budhaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रार्णहृत्परायाद्यमात्मने हृदयान्तिमम् /
तत्तन्नाम समुञ्चार्य्य न्यसेत्तत्तत्स्थले बुधः //
text_mt: with the mantra-syllable, 'hṛt', 'parāya', and beginning with 'ātmane' and ending with 'hṛdayāya', / having uttered the respective name, the wise one should place [them] on each respective spot.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ tattvābhidho nyāsaḥ sarvanyāsottamottamaḥ /
mūrtīnyaṃseddvādaśa vai dvādaśādityasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
अयं तत्त्वाभिधो न्यासः सर्वन्यासोत्तमोत्तमः /
मूर्तीन्यंसेद्द्वादश वै द्वादशादित्यसंयुताः //
text_mt: This is the nyāsa named tattva, the most supreme of all nyāsas; / one should indeed place the twelve forms, united with the twelve Ādityas,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākṣaravarṇādyā dvādaśādityasaṃyutāḥ /
aṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ manuścāṣṭaprakṛtyātmā samīritaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशाक्षरवर्णाद्या द्वादशादित्यसंयुताः /
अष्टार्णो ऽयं मनुश्चाष्टप्रकृत्यात्मा समीरितः //
text_mt: beginning with the letters of the twelve-syllabled mantra, united with the twelve Ādityas; / and this eight-syllabled mantra is proclaimed to consist of the eight primary principles;

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmātmacatuṣkasya yogādarkākṣaro bhavet /
lalāṭakukṣihṛtkaṇṭhadakṣapārśvāṃsakeṣu ca //
meaning:
तासामात्मचतुष्कस्य योगादर्काक्षरो भवेत् /
ललाटकुक्षिहृत्कण्ठदक्षपार्श्वांसकेषु च //
text_mt: by uniting their four selves, it becomes the twelve-syllabled [mantra]; / on the forehead, belly, heart, throat, right side, and right shoulder,

sanskrit_iast:
gale ca vāmapārśvāṃ sagalapṛṣṭeṣvanantaram /
kakudyapi nyasenmantrī mūrtīrdvādaśa vai kramāt //
meaning:
गले च वामपार्श्वां सगलपृष्टेष्वनन्तरम् /
ककुद्यपि न्यसेन्मन्त्री मूर्तीर्द्वादश वै क्रमात् //
text_mt: and on the throat, left side, left shoulder, the back of the neck, / and on the hump of the neck, the practitioner of mantras should place the twelve forms in sequence:

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrā tu keśavaṃ nyasyāryamṇa nārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ /
mitreṇa mādhavaṃ nyasya govindaṃ varuṇena ca //
meaning:
धात्रा तु केशवं न्यस्यार्यम्ण नारायणं पुनः /
मित्रेण माधवं न्यस्य गोविन्दं वरुणेन च //
text_mt: having placed Keśava with Dhātṛ, and then Nārāyaṇa with Aryaman, / having placed Mādhava with Mitra, and Govinda with Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ caivāṃśunā yuktaṃ bhagena madhusūdanam /
nyasedvivasvatā yuktaṃ trivikramamataḥ param //
meaning:
विष्णुं चैवांशुना युक्तं भगेन मधुसूदनम् /
न्यसेद्विवस्वता युक्तं त्रिविक्रममतः परम् //
text_mt: and Viṣṇu joined with Aṃśu, Madhusūdana with Bhaga, / after that one should place Trivikrama joined with Vivasvat,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanaṃ ca tathādraṇa pūṣṇā śrīdharameva ca /
hṛṣīkeśaṃ nyasetpaścātparjanyena samanvitam //
meaning:
वामनं च तथाद्रण पूष्णा श्रीधरमेव च /
हृषीकेशं न्यसेत्पश्चात्पर्जन्येन समन्वितम् //
text_mt: and likewise Vāmana with Indra, and Śrīdhara with Pūṣan, / and then one should place Hṛṣīkeśa joined with Parjanya,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭrā yutaṃ padmanābhaṃ dāmodaraṃ ca viṣṇunā /
dvādasārṇaṃ tato mantraṃ samaste śirasi nyaset //
meaning:
त्वष्ट्रा युतं पद्मनाभं दामोदरं च विष्णुना /
द्वादसार्णं ततो मन्त्रं समस्ते शिरसि न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Padmanābha accompanied by Tvaṣṭṛ, and Dāmodara with Viṣṇu; / then one should place the entire twelve-syllabled mantra upon the head.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ vinyasetpaścātkirīṭamanunā sudhīḥ /
dhruvaḥkirīṭakeyūrahārānte makaretica //
meaning:
व्यापकं विन्यसेत्पश्चात्किरीटमनुना सुधीः /
ध्रुवःकिरीटकेयूरहारान्ते मकरेतिच //
text_mt: Then the wise one should perform an all-pervading placement with the kirīṭa-mantra: / the dhruva, followed by 'kirīṭakeyūrahāra', then 'makara',

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍalānte cakraśaṅkhagadānteṃ'bhojahastataḥ /
pītāṃbarānte śrīvatsāṃ kitavakṣaḥ sthaleti ca //
meaning:
कुण्डलान्ते चक्रशङ्खगदान्तेंऽभोजहस्ततः /
पीतांबरान्ते श्रीवत्सां कितवक्षः स्थलेति च //
text_mt: after 'kuṇḍala', followed by 'cakraśaṅkhagadā', then 'ambojahastāya', / followed by 'pītāmbara', and 'śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasthalāya',

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhūmisahitasvātmajyotirdvayamataḥ param /
vadeddīptikarāyānti sahasrādityatejase //
meaning:
श्रीभूमिसहितस्वात्मज्योतिर्द्वयमतः परम् /
वदेद्दीप्तिकरायान्ति सहस्रादित्यतेजसे //
text_mt: then 'śrībhūmisahitasvātmajyotirdvayāya', / and one should utter 'dīptikarāya', and 'sahasrādityatejase',

sanskrit_iast:
namonto bāṇaṣaṅvarṇaiḥ kirīṭamanurīritaḥ /
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
नमोन्तो बाणषङ्वर्णैः किरीटमनुरीरितः /
एवं न्यासविधिं कृत्वा ध्यायेन्नारायणं विभुम् //
text_mt: ending in 'namaḥ', containing thirty-five syllables: thus is the kirīṭa-mantra proclaimed; / having performed the rite of nyāsa in this manner, one should meditate on the all-pervading Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
udyatkoṭyarkasadṛśaṃ śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃbujam /
dadhataṃ ca karairbhūmiśrībhyāṃ pārśvadvayāñcitam //
meaning:
उद्यत्कोट्यर्कसदृशं शङ्खं चक्रं गदांबुजम् /
दधतं च करैर्भूमिश्रीभ्यां पार्श्वद्वयाञ्चितम् //
text_mt: who resembles ten million rising suns, holding the conch, discus, mace, and lotus / with his hands, flanked on both sides by Bhūmi and Śrī,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhāmuktakandharam /
hārakeyūravalayāṅgadaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ smaret //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं भ्राजत्कौस्तुभामुक्तकन्धरम् /
हारकेयूरवलयाङ्गदं पीतांबरं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: having the Śrīvatsa on his chest, with the glistening Kaustubha adorning his neck; / one should remember him wearing yellow garments, adorned with necklaces, armlets, bracelets, and angadas.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ vidhivanniyatendriyaḥ /
prathamena tu lakṣeṇa svātmaśuddhirbhaved dhruvam //
meaning:
वर्णलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं विधिवन्नियतेन्द्रियः /
प्रथमेन तु लक्षेण स्वात्मशुद्धिर्भवेद् ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: With senses controlled, one should recite the mantra according to rule for a hundred thousand times; / by the first hundred thousand, purification of one's own self is certain to occur;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣadvayajapenātha mantraśuddhimavāpnuyāt /
lakṣatrayeṇa japtena svarlokamadhigacchati //
meaning:
लक्षद्वयजपेनाथ मन्त्रशुद्धिमवाप्नुयात् /
लक्षत्रयेण जप्तेन स्वर्लोकमधिगच्छति //
text_mt: then by the recitation of two hundred thousand, one would attain purity of the mantra; / by three hundred thousand recited, one reaches the heavenly realm;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoḥ samīpamāpnoti vedalakṣajapānnaraḥ /
tathā ca nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ pañcalakṣajapādbhavet //
meaning:
विष्णोः समीपमाप्नोति वेदलक्षजपान्नरः /
तथा च निर्मलं ज्ञानं पञ्चलक्षजपाद्भवेत् //
text_mt: from the recitation of four hundred thousand, a man attains proximity to Viṣṇu; / and likewise, stainless knowledge arises from the recitation of five hundred thousand;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṣaṣṭena cāpnoti mantrī viṣṇau1sthirā matim /
saptalakṣajapānmantrī viṣṇoḥ sārūpyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
लक्षषष्टेन चाप्नोति मन्त्री विष्णौ1स्थिरा मतिम् /
सप्तलक्षजपान्मन्त्री विष्णोः सारूप्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: by six hundred thousand, the practitioner of mantras attains a firm mind fixed upon Viṣṇu; / from the recitation of seven hundred thousand, the practitioner of mantras would attain conformity of form with Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantrī nirvāṇamadhigacchati /
evaṃ japtvā tataḥ prājño daśāṃśaṃ sarasīruhaiḥ //
meaning:
अष्टलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्री निर्वाणमधिगच्छति /
एवं जप्त्वा ततः प्राज्ञो दशांशं सरसीरुहैः //
text_mt: the practitioner of mantras who recites eight hundred thousand attains absolute cessation; / having thus recited, the wise one should then offer in oblations a tenth part [of that] with lotuses

sanskrit_iast:
madhurāktaiḥ prajuhuyātsaṃskṛte havyavāhane /
maṇḍūkātparatatvāntaṃ pīṭhe saṃpūjya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
मधुराक्तैः प्रजुहुयात्संस्कृते हव्यवाहने /
मण्डूकात्परतत्वान्तं पीठे संपूज्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: smeared with sweets into consecrated fire; / having worshiped with care on the ritual seat [all principles] from Maṇḍūka up to the Supreme Principle:

sanskrit_iast:
vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogā tataḥ parā /
prahvī satyā tatheśānanugrahā navamī matā //
meaning:
विमलोत्कर्षिणी ज्ञाना क्रिया योगा ततः परा /
प्रह्वी सत्या तथेशाननुग्रहा नवमी मता //
text_mt: Vimalā, Utkarṣiṇī, Jñānā, Kriyā, and thereafter Yogā, / Prahvī, Satyā, likewise Īśānā, and Anugrahā is considered the ninth;

sanskrit_iast:
tāro namano bhagavate viṣṇave sarvabhū tataḥ /
tātmane vāsudevāya sarvātmeti padaṃ vadet //
meaning:
तारो नमनो भगवते विष्णवे सर्वभू ततः /
तात्मने वासुदेवाय सर्वात्मेति पदं वदेत् //
text_mt: the tāra, 'namo bhagavate viṣṇave', then 'sarvabhū-', / '-tātmane vāsudevāya', and one should utter the phrase 'sarvātma-';

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogayogapadmānte pīṭhāya hṛdayāntimaḥ /
ṣaḍviṃśadakṣaraḥ pīṭhamantro 'nenāsanaṃ diśet //
meaning:
संयोगयोगपद्मान्ते पीठाय हृदयान्तिमः /
षड्विंशदक्षरः पीठमन्त्रो ऽनेनासनं दिशेत् //
text_mt: ending in '-saṃyogayogapadmāya', ending with 'pīṭhāya' and 'hṛt': / this is the twenty-six-syllabled pīṭha-mantra; by this one should offer the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena tasyāmāvāhya pūjayet /
ādau cāṅgāni saṃpūjya mantrāṇāṃ keśareṣu ca //
meaning:
मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलेन तस्यामावाह्य पूजयेत् /
आदौ चाङ्गानि संपूज्य मन्त्राणां केशरेषु च //
text_mt: Having mentally formed the image, having invoked him into it with the root mantra, one should worship him; / and having first worshiped the limbs and the mantras upon the filaments,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgādidigdale vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tathā /
pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca śaktīḥ koṇeṣvathārcayet //
meaning:
प्रागादिदिग्दले वासुदेवं संकर्षणं तथा /
प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धं च शक्तीः कोणेष्वथार्चयेत् //
text_mt: on the petals in the directions beginning with the east [one should worship] Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, / Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; then one should worship the energies in the corners:

sanskrit_iast:
śāntiṃ śriyaṃ sarasvatyā ratiṃ saṃpūjayetkramāt /
hemapītatamālendranīlābhāḥ pītavāsasaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तिं श्रियं सरस्वत्या रतिं संपूजयेत्क्रमात् /
हेमपीततमालेन्द्रनीलाभाः पीतवाससः //
text_mt: in sequence one should worship Śānti, Śrī, Sarasvatī, and Rati, / who have the luster of golden yellow, the tamāla tree, and the sapphire, and wear yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujāḥ śaṅkhacakragadāṃbhaghojadharā ime /
sitakāñcanagodugdhadūrvāvarṇāśca śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजाः शङ्खचक्रगदांभघोजधरा इमे /
सितकाञ्चनगोदुग्धदूर्वावर्णाश्च शक्तयः //
text_mt: possessing four arms, bearing the conch, discus, mace, and lotus; / and these energies have the colors of white, gold, cow's milk, and dūrvā grass.

sanskrit_iast:
dalāgreṣu cakraśaṅkhagadāpaṅkajakaustubhān /
pūjayenmusalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālāṃ yathākramāt //
meaning:
दलाग्रेषु चक्रशङ्खगदापङ्कजकौस्तुभान् /
पूजयेन्मुसलं खड्गं वनमालां यथाक्रमात् //
text_mt: On the tips of the petals one should worship in due order the discus, conch, mace, lotus, and Kaustubha, / the pestle, the sword, and the forest garland,

sanskrit_iast:
raktājapītakanakaśyāmakṛṣṇāsitārjunān /
kuṅkumābhaṃ samabhyarcyedvahiragre khageśvaram //
meaning:
रक्ताजपीतकनकश्यामकृष्णासितार्जुनान् /
कुङ्कुमाभं समभ्यर्च्येद्वहिरग्रे खगेश्वरम् //
text_mt: colored red, yellow, dark green, black, dark, and white; / having worshiped the saffron-hued king of birds outside in front,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvayoḥ pūjayetpaścāṅkhapadmanidhī kramāt /
muktāmāṇikyasaṃkāśau paścime dhvajamaparcayet //
meaning:
पार्श्वयोः पूजयेत्पश्चाङ्खपद्मनिधी क्रमात् /
मुक्तामाणिक्यसंकाशौ पश्चिमे ध्वजमपर्चयेत् //
text_mt: one should then worship the Conch and Lotus treasures on both sides in order, / resembling pearls and rubies, and in the west one should worship the banner.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ vighnaṃ tathāgneye śyāmamāryaṃ ca rākṣase /
durgāṃ śyāmāṃ vāyukoṇe senānyaṃ pītamaiśvare //
meaning:
रक्तं विघ्नं तथाग्नेये श्याममार्यं च राक्षसे /
दुर्गां श्यामां वायुकोणे सेनान्यं पीतमैश्वरे //
text_mt: Likewise, the wise one should worship red Vighna in the south-east, dark Ārya in the south-west, / dark Durgā in the north-west, and yellow Senānī in the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
lokeśā nāyudhairyuktānbahiḥ saṃpūjayetsudhīḥ /
evamāvaraṇairyuktaṃ yor'cajayedviṣṇumavyayam //
meaning:
लोकेशा नायुधैर्युक्तान्बहिः संपूजयेत्सुधीः /
एवमावरणैर्युक्तं योर्ऽचजयेद्विष्णुमव्ययम् //
text_mt: On the outside, the wise one should worship the lords of the worlds equipped with their weapons. / Whoever worships the imperishable Viṣṇu surrounded by enclosures in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvehasakalānbhogānante viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet /
kṣetradhānyasuvarṇānāṃ ppāptaye dhāraṇīṃ smaret //
meaning:
भुक्त्वेहसकलान्भोगानन्ते विष्णुपदं व्रजेत् /
क्षेत्रधान्यसुवर्णानां प्पाप्तये धारणीं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: having enjoyed all pleasures here, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu at the end. / To obtain lands, grains, and gold, one should remember the Earth-goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
devīṃ dūrvādalaśyāmāṃ dadhānāṃ śālimañjarīm /
cintayedbhāratīṃ devīṃ vīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm //
meaning:
देवीं दूर्वादलश्यामां दधानां शालिमञ्जरीम् /
चिन्तयेद्भारतीं देवीं वीणापुस्तकधारिणीम् //
text_mt: the goddess dark as a blade of dūrvā grass, holding a stalk of winter rice. / One should contemplate the goddess Bhāratī holding a vīṇā and a book,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe devadevasya pūrṇacandranibhānanām /
kṣīrābdhiphenapuñjābhe vasānāṃ śvetavāsasī //
meaning:
दक्षिणे देवदेवस्य पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् /
क्षीराब्धिफेनपुञ्जाभे वसानां श्वेतवाससी //
text_mt: to the right of the God of gods, her face resembling the full moon, / dressed in two white garments resembling a mass of foam from the ocean of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāratyā sahitaṃ yo vai dhyāyeddvevaṃ parātparam /
vedavedārthatattvajño jāyate sarvavittamaḥ //
meaning:
भारत्या सहितं यो वै ध्यायेद्द्वेवं परात्परम् /
वेदवेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञो जायते सर्ववित्तमः //
text_mt: Whoever meditates on the God higher than the highest together with Bhāratī / becomes one who knows the truth of the Vedas and their meaning, the foremost knower of all.

sanskrit_iast:
nārasiṃhamivātmānaṃ devaṃ dhyātvātibhairavam /
śaśtraṃ saṃmantrya mantreṇa śabrūnhatvā nivartate //
meaning:
नारसिंहमिवात्मानं देवं ध्यात्वातिभैरवम् /
शश्त्रं संमन्त्र्य मन्त्रेण शब्रून्हत्वा निवर्तते //
text_mt: Meditating on oneself as Nṛsiṃha, the exceedingly terrible deity, / having consecrated a weapon with the mantra and slain one's enemies, one returns.

sanskrit_iast:
nārasiṃhena bījena mantraṃ saṃyojya sādhakaḥ /
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ jaṇtvā vāmahastābhimantritāḥ //
meaning:
नारसिंहेन बीजेन मन्त्रं संयोज्य साधकः /
शतमष्टोत्तरं जण्त्वा वामहस्ताभिमन्त्रिताः //
text_mt: Combining the mantra with the seed-syllable of Nṛsiṃha, the practitioner, / having recited it one hundred and eight times, with [waters] consecrated with the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punarapaḥ siṃcetsarpadaṣṭo 'pi jīvati /
gāruḍena ca saṃyojya pañcārṇena japettadā //
meaning:
पुनः पुनरपः सिंचेत्सर्पदष्टो ऽपि जीवति /
गारुडेन च संयोज्य पञ्चार्णेन जपेत्तदा //
text_mt: should sprinkle waters again and again; even one bitten by a snake survives. / Combining it with the five-syllabled Garuḍa [mantra], one should then recite it.

sanskrit_iast:
nirviṣīkaraṇe dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ garuḍavāhanam /
aśokaphalake tārkṣyamālikhyāśokasaṃhatau //
meaning:
निर्विषीकरणे ध्यायेद्विष्णुं गरुडवाहनम् /
अशोकफलके तार्क्ष्यमालिख्याशोकसंहतौ //
text_mt: For neutralizing poison, one should meditate on Viṣṇu mounted upon Garuḍa. / Having drawn Garuḍa on an aśoka-wood tablet amidst a grove of aśoka trees,

sanskrit_iast:
aśokapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya bhagavantaṃ tadagrataḥ /
juhuyāttāni puṣpāṇi trisaṃdhyaṃ saptapatrakam //
meaning:
अशोकपुष्पैः संपूज्य भगवन्तं तदग्रतः /
जुहुयात्तानि पुष्पाणि त्रिसंध्यं सप्तपत्रकम् //
text_mt: having worshipped the Lord with aśoka flowers in front of it, / one should offer those flowers at the three twilights [along with] a seven-leafed [sprig].

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣo jāyate pakṣī varamiṣṭaṃ prayacchati /
gāṇapatyena saṃyojya japellakṣaṃ payovrataḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षो जायते पक्षी वरमिष्टं प्रयच्छति /
गाणपत्येन संयोज्य जपेल्लक्षं पयोव्रतः //
text_mt: The bird becomes visible before one's eyes and grants the desired boon. / Combining it with the Gāṇapatya [mantra], living on milk, one should recite one hundred thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgaṇapatiṃ devaṃ pratyakṣamiha paśyati /
vāṇibījena saṃyuktaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ yojayennaraḥ //
meaning:
महागणपतिं देवं प्रत्यक्षमिह पश्यति /
वाणिबीजेन संयुक्तं षण्मासं योजयेन्नरः //
text_mt: Here one sees the god Mahāgaṇapati visibly present before one's eyes. / A man should employ it joined with the seed-syllable of Speech for six months;

sanskrit_iast:
mahākavivaro bhūtvā mohayetsakalaṃ jagat /
hutvā guṅcīśakalānyarddhāgulamitāni ca //
meaning:
महाकविवरो भूत्वा मोहयेत्सकलं जगत् /
हुत्वा गुङ्चीशकलान्यर्द्धागुलमितानि च //
text_mt: becoming a foremost great poet, he can enchant the entire world. / Having offered pieces of guñjā measured to half an aṅgula,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhimadhvājyayuktāni mṛtyuṃ jayati sādhakaḥ /
śanaiśvara dine samyak spṛṣṭvā śvatthaṃ ca pāṇinā //
meaning:
दधिमध्वाज्ययुक्तानि मृत्युं जयति साधकः /
शनैश्वर दिने सम्यक् स्पृष्ट्वा श्वत्थं च पाणिना //
text_mt: combined with curd, honey, and clarified butter, the practitioner conquers death. / On a Saturday, properly touching an aśvattha tree with the hand,

sanskrit_iast:
japtvā cāṣṭaśataṃ yuddhe hyapamṛtyuṃ jayatyasau /
pañcaviṃśatidhā japtvā nityaṃ prātaḥ pibejjalam //
meaning:
जप्त्वा चाष्टशतं युद्धे ह्यपमृत्युं जयत्यसौ /
पञ्चविंशतिधा जप्त्वा नित्यं प्रातः पिबेज्जलम् //
text_mt: and having recited it one hundred and eight times, he conquers untimely death in battle. / Having recited it twenty-five times, he should drink water every morning;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmukto jñānavān rogavarjitaḥ /
kuṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivadāpūrya śuddhavāriṇā //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ज्ञानवान् रोगवर्जितः /
कुंभं संस्थाप्य विधिवदापूर्य शुद्धवारिणा //
text_mt: freed from all sins, he becomes wise and devoid of diseases. / Setting up a pot according to rule and filling it with pure water,

sanskrit_iast:
japtvāyutaṃ tatastenābhiṣekaḥ sarvaroganut /
candrasūryoparāge tu hyupoṣyāṣṭasahasrakam //
meaning:
जप्त्वायुतं ततस्तेनाभिषेकः सर्वरोगनुत् /
चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे तु ह्युपोष्याष्टसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: having recited it ten thousand times, a bath with that removes all illnesses. / During an eclipse of the moon or the sun, having fasted, [reciting] eight thousand times,

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭvā brāhmīdhṛtaṃ japtvā pibetsādhakasattamaḥ /
medhāṃ kavitvaṃ vāksiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
स्पृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मीधृतं जप्त्वा पिबेत्साधकसत्तमः /
मेधां कवित्वं वाक्सिद्धिं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: touching brāhmī-ghee and reciting, the best of practitioners should drink it; / he gains intelligence, poetic skill, and the power of speech; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādayutaṃ vilvairmahādhanapatirbhavet /
nārāyaṇasya mantro 'yaṃ sarvamantrottamottamaḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयादयुतं विल्वैर्महाधनपतिर्भवेत् /
नारायणस्य मन्त्रो ऽयं सर्वमन्त्रोत्तमोत्तमः //
text_mt: One should offer ten thousand [oblations] with bilva fruits; one becomes a lord of great wealth. / This mantra of Nārāyaṇa is the most supreme of all mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
ālayaḥ sarvasiddhīnāṃ kathitastava nārada /
nārāyaṇāya śabdānte vidmahe padamīrayet //
meaning:
आलयः सर्वसिद्धीनां कथितस्तव नारद /
नारायणाय शब्दान्ते विद्महे पदमीरयेत् //
text_mt: the abode of all perfections, spoken unto you, O Nārada. / After the word 'nārāyaṇāya', one should utter the word 'vidmahe';

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevapadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ dhīmahīti tato vadet /
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracovarṇānsaṃvadeñcodayāditi //
meaning:
वासुदेवपदं ङेंतं धीमहीति ततो वदेत् /
तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोवर्णान्संवदेञ्चोदयादिति //
text_mt: then one should say the word 'vāsudeva' in the dative case, and 'dhīmahi'; / then 'tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodavārṇān' and say 'pracodayāt'.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣoktā viṣṇugāyatrī sarvapāpapraṇāśinī /
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃto vāsudevāya kīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
एषोक्ता विष्णुगायत्री सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी /
तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतो वासुदेवाय कीर्तितः //
text_mt: This is declared as the Viṣṇugāyatrī, the destroyer of all sins. / Oṃ, namaḥ, bhagavate in the dative case, and vāsudevāya are stated:

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśārṇo mahāmantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ /
strīśūdrāṇāṃ vitāro 'yaṃ satārastu dvijanmanām //
meaning:
द्वादशार्णो महामन्त्रो भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकः /
स्त्रीशूद्राणां वितारो ऽयं सतारस्तु द्विजन्मनाम् //
text_mt: this twelve-syllabled great mantra bestows enjoyment and liberation. / For women and Śūdras it is without Oṃ, but for the twice-born it is with Oṃ.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatirmuniścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritaḥ /
devatā vāsudevastu bījaṃ śaktirdhruvaśca hṛt //
meaning:
प्रजापतिर्मुनिश्चास्य गायत्री छन्द ईरितः /
देवता वासुदेवस्तु बीजं शक्तिर्ध्रुवश्च हृत् //
text_mt: Prajāpati is its seer, the metre is said to be Gāyatrī, / the deity is Vāsudeva, the seed-syllable is [Oṃ], the śakti is [namaḥ].

sanskrit_iast:
candrākṣivedapañcarṇaiḥ samastenāṅgakalpanam /
mūrdhni bhāle dṛśorāsye gale dorhṛdaye punaḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्राक्षिवेदपञ्चर्णैः समस्तेनाङ्गकल्पनम् /
मूर्ध्नि भाले दृशोरास्ये गले दोर्हृदये पुनः //
text_mt: The assignment of the limbs is done with one, two, four, five syllables, and all together. / On the crown of the head, forehead, eyes, face, throat, arms, and heart,

sanskrit_iast:
kukṣau nābhau dhvaje jānudvaye pādadvaye tathā /
nyāsetkramān mantravarṇānsṛṣṭinyāso 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
कुक्षौ नाभौ ध्वजे जानुद्वये पादद्वये तथा /
न्यासेत्क्रमान् मन्त्रवर्णान्सृष्टिन्यासो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: on the belly, navel, generative organ, the two knees, and likewise the two feet, / one should place the syllables of the mantra in order; this is declared as the nyāsa of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
