hṛdādimastakāntaṃ tu sthitinyāsaṃ pracakṣate /
pādādārabhya mūrddhānaṃ nyāsaṃ saṃhārakaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
हृदादिमस्तकान्तं तु स्थितिन्यासं प्रचक्षते /
पादादारभ्य मूर्द्धानं न्यासं संहारकं विदुः //
text_mt: From the heart to the head is spoken of as the nyāsa of preservation. / Beginning from the feet up to the head, they know as the nyāsa of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryātsarvatantreṣu gopitam /
bīvaṃ prāṇaṃ tathā cittaṃ hṛtpadmaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
तत्त्वन्यासं ततः कुर्यात्सर्वतन्त्रेषु गोपितम् /
बीवं प्राणं तथा चित्तं हृत्पद्मं सूर्यमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Then one should perform the nyāsa of tattvas concealed in all tantras: / the soul, the vital breath, and the mind, the heart-lotus, the orb of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
candrāgnimaṇḍale caiva vāsudevaṃ tataḥ param /
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ tataḥ param //
meaning:
चन्द्राग्निमण्डले चैव वासुदेवं ततः परम् /
संकर्षणं च प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धं ततः परम् //
text_mt: the orb of the moon and the fire, and beyond that, Vāsudeva, / Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and beyond that, Aniruddha,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ cakramatastattvāni dvādaśaiva tu /
mūlārṇahṛtparāyādyamātmane hṛdayāntimam //
meaning:
नारायणं चक्रमतस्तत्त्वानि द्वादशैव तु /
मूलार्णहृत्परायाद्यमात्मने हृदयान्तिमम् //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, and the discus: these are indeed the twelve tattvas. / Beginning with each root syllable, followed by namaḥ, followed by ātmane, ending with namaḥ,

sanskrit_iast:
tattve nāma samuñcaryya nyasenmūrddhādiṣu kramāt /
pūrvoktaṃ dhyānamatrāpi bhānulakṣajapo manoḥ //
meaning:
तत्त्वे नाम समुञ्चर्य्य न्यसेन्मूर्द्धादिषु क्रमात् /
पूर्वोक्तं ध्यानमत्रापि भानुलक्षजपो मनोः //
text_mt: pronouncing the name of each tattva, one should place them on the head and other parts in order. / Here too the meditation is as previously stated; the recitation of the mantra is twelve hundred thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
tadṛśāṃśaṃ tilairājyalolitairhavanaṃ caret /
pīṭhe pūrvodite mantrī mūrti saṃkalpya mūlataḥ //
meaning:
तदृशांशं तिलैराज्यलोलितैर्हवनं चरेत् /
पीठे पूर्वोदिते मन्त्री मूर्ति संकल्प्य मूलतः //
text_mt: One should perform homa with a tenth part of that using sesame seeds mixed with ghee. / On the previously stated ritual seat, the mantrin, projecting the form by means of the root mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmāvāhya deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet /
aṅgāni pūrvamabhyarcya vāsudevādikāstataḥ //
meaning:
तस्यामावाह्य देवेशं वासुदेवं प्रपूजयेत् /
अङ्गानि पूर्वमभ्यर्च्य वासुदेवादिकास्ततः //
text_mt: having invoked the Lord of gods into it, should worship Vāsudeva. / Having first worshipped the limbs, then Vāsudeva and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
śāntyādiśaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ prāgvaddikṣu vidikṣu ca /
tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ proktā dvādaśa mūrtayaḥ //
meaning:
शान्त्यादिशक्तयः पूज्याः प्राग्वद्दिक्षु विदिक्षु च /
तृतीयावरणे पूज्याः प्रोक्ता द्वादश मूर्तयः //
text_mt: the powers such as Śānti are to be worshipped in the directions and intermediate directions as before; / in the third enclosure, the twelve forms that have been declared are to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādyānāyudhairyuktān pūjayeddharaṇīgṛhe /
evamāvaraṇairiṣṭvā pañcabhirviṣṇumavyayam //
meaning:
इन्द्राद्यानायुधैर्युक्तान् पूजयेद्धरणीगृहे /
एवमावरणैरिष्ट्वा पञ्चभिर्विष्णुमव्ययम् //
text_mt: One should worship Indra and the others equipped with their weapons in the earth-abode. / Thus, having worshipped the imperishable Viṣṇu with five enclosures,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnuyātsakalānarthānante viṣṇupade vrajet /
puruṣottamasaṃjñasya viṣṇorbhedacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
प्राप्नुयात्सकलानर्थानन्ते विष्णुपदे व्रजेत् /
पुरुषोत्तमसंज्ञस्य विष्णोर्भेदचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: one obtains all desires and goes to the abode of Viṣṇu at the end. / Of Viṣṇu named Puruṣottama, there is a fourfold division.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamohanasteṣāṃ prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
śrīkaraśca hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṛṣaaṇaścātra caturthakaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमोहनस्तेषां प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः /
श्रीकरश्च हृषीकेशः कृषअणश्चात्र चतुर्थकः //
text_mt: Among them, Trailokyamohana is proclaimed as the first; / Śrīkara, Hṛṣīkeśa, and Kṛṣṇa is the fourth here.

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ kāmo ramā paścān ṅeṃtaḥ syātpuruṣottamaḥ /
varmāstrāṇyagnipriyānto mantro vahnīnduvarṇavān //
meaning:
तारः कामो रमा पश्चान् ङेंतः स्यात्पुरुषोत्तमः /
वर्मास्त्राण्यग्निप्रियान्तो मन्त्रो वह्नीन्दुवर्णवान् //
text_mt: Oṃ, klīm, śrīm, and then puruṣottama in the dative case, / followed by hum phaṭ svāhā; the mantra consists of thirty-one syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chandaḥ prokto 'tha devatā /
puruṣottamasaṃjño 'tra bījaśaktīsmarandire //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा मुनिः स्याद्गायत्री छन्दः प्रोक्तो ऽथ देवता /
पुरुषोत्तमसंज्ञो ऽत्र बीजशक्तीस्मरन्दिरे //
text_mt: Brahmā is the seer, Gāyatrī is declared as the metre, and the deity / is named Puruṣottama; the seed-syllable and śakti are Kāma and Ramā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūcandraikarasākṣyakṣimantravarṇorvibhāgataḥ /
kṛtvāṅgāni tato dhyāyedvidhivatpuruṣottamam //
meaning:
भूचन्द्रैकरसाक्ष्यक्षिमन्त्रवर्णोर्विभागतः /
कृत्वाङ्गानि ततो ध्यायेद्विधिवत्पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Dividing the syllables of the mantra by one, one, one, six, two, and two, / having assigned the limbs, one should then properly meditate on Puruṣottama:

sanskrit_iast:
samudyadādityanibhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāṃbujaiḥ /
lasatkaraṃ pītavasraṃ smarecchrīpuruṣottamam //
meaning:
समुद्यदादित्यनिभं शङ्खचक्रगदांबुजैः /
लसत्करं पीतवस्रं स्मरेच्छ्रीपुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Resembling the rising sun, with hands shining with conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / dressed in yellow garments—one should remember the glorious Puruṣottama,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāratnaughakhacitasphurattoraṇamaṇḍape /
mauktikaughaśamadamavirājitavitānake //
meaning:
महारत्नौघखचितस्फुरत्तोरणमण्डपे /
मौक्तिकौघशमदमविराजितवितानके //
text_mt: in a pavilion with glittering arched doorways studded with masses of great gems, / with a canopy adorned with clusters of pearls of calm brilliance,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyaddevāṅganāvṛndakvaṇātkiṅkiṇinūpure /
lasanmāṇikyavedyāṃ tu dītpārkāyutatejasi //
meaning:
नृत्यद्देवाङ्गनावृन्दक्वणात्किङ्किणिनूपुरे /
लसन्माणिक्यवेद्यां तु दीत्पार्कायुततेजसि //
text_mt: where anklets and tiny bells tinkle on host of celestial maidens dancing, / on a platform of shining rubies possessing the radiance of ten thousand blazing suns,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndārakavrātakirīṭāgraratnābhicarcite /
navalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
वृन्दारकव्रातकिरीटाग्ररत्नाभिचर्चिते /
नवलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं जुहुयात्तद्दशांशतः //
text_mt: anointed with the luster of jewels on the crests of crowns of hosts of gods. / One should recite the mantra nine hundred thousand times and offer oblation with a tenth of that.

sanskrit_iast:
utphullaiḥ kamalaiḥ pīṭhe pūrvokte vaiṣṇaver'cayet /
evamārādhya deveśaṃ prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam //
meaning:
उत्फुल्लैः कमलैः पीठे पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवेर्ऽचयेत् /
एवमाराध्य देवेशं प्राप्नोति महतीं श्रियम् //
text_mt: One should worship with fully blossomed lotuses on the previously stated Vaiṣṇava ritual seat. / Having thus worshipped the Lord of gods, one obtains great prosperity;

sanskrit_iast:
putrānpautrānyaśaḥ kāntiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati /
uttiṣṭeti padaṃ paścācchrīkarāgnipriyāntimaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रान्पौत्रान्यशः कान्तिं भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति /
उत्तिष्टेति पदं पश्चाच्छ्रीकराग्निप्रियान्तिमः //
text_mt: he obtains sons, grandsons, fame, radiance, enjoyment, and liberation. / The word 'uttiṣṭha', followed by 'śrīkara', and ending with 'svāhā'—

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭārṇo 'sya munirvyāsaḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam /
śrīkārākhyo hariḥ prokto devatā sakaleṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टार्णो ऽस्य मुनिर्व्यासः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतम् /
श्रीकाराख्यो हरिः प्रोक्तो देवता सकलेष्टदः //
text_mt: this is eight-syllabled; its seer is Vyāsa, the metre is said to be Paṅkti, / the deity is Hari named Śrīkara, the bestower of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīṣayadvitayaṃ hṛtsyāt trāsayadvitayaṃ śiraḥ /
śikhā pramarddayadvandvaṃ varma pradhvaṃsayadvayam //
meaning:
भीषयद्वितयं हृत्स्यात् त्रासयद्वितयं शिरः /
शिखा प्रमर्द्दयद्वन्द्वं वर्म प्रध्वंसयद्वयम् //
text_mt: The two [words] *bhīṣaya bhīṣaya* are the heart; the two [words] *trāsaya trāsaya* are the head; / the pair *pramardaya pramardaya* is the crest; the two [words] *pradhvaṃsaya pradhvaṃsaya* are the armor;

sanskrit_iast:
asraṃ rakṣadvayaṃ sarve humantāḥ samudīritāḥ /
mastake netrayoḥ kaṇṭhahṛdaye nābhideśake //
meaning:
अस्रं रक्षद्वयं सर्वे हुमन्ताः समुदीरिताः /
मस्तके नेत्रयोः कण्ठहृदये नाभिदेशके //
text_mt: the two [words] *rakṣa rakṣa* are the weapon; all are declared to end in *hum*. / On the head, on the two eyes, on the throat, on the heart, in the region of the navel,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrūjaṅghāṃyugmeṣu mantravarṇānkramānnyataset /
tataḥ puruṣasūktoktamantrairnyāsaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
ऊरूजङ्घांयुग्मेषु मन्त्रवर्णान्क्रमान्न्यतसेत् /
ततः पुरुषसूक्तोक्तमन्त्रैर्न्यासं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: and on the pairs of thighs and shanks, one should perform the ritual placement of the syllables of the mantra in order. / Then one should perform the ritual placement with the mantras spoken in the Puruṣasūkta:

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe nyasedbrāhmaṇo 'sya mukhamāsīdimaṃ manum /
bāhuyugme tathā bāhūṃrājanya iti vinyaset //
meaning:
मुखे न्यसेद्ब्राह्मणो ऽस्य मुखमासीदिमं मनुम् /
बाहुयुग्मे तथा बाहूंराजन्य इति विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: On the mouth one should place the mantra *brāhmaṇo 'sya mukham āsīt*; / likewise on the pair of arms one should place *bāhū rājanyaḥ*;

sanskrit_iast:
ūrū tadasya yadvaiśya imamūrudvaye nyaset /
nyasetpādadvaye mantrī padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata //
meaning:
ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्य इममूरुद्वये न्यसेत् /
न्यसेत्पादद्वये मन्त्री पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत //
text_mt: one should place this *ūrū tad asya yad vaiśyaḥ* on the pair of thighs; / the practitioner should place on the pair of feet *padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata*.

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ karāgreṣvatha vinyaset /
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyetpūrvoktamaṇḍape //
meaning:
चक्रं शङ्खं गदां पद्मं कराग्रेष्वथ विन्यसेत् /
एवं न्यासविधिं कृत्वा ध्यायेत्पूर्वोक्तमण्डपे //
text_mt: Then one should place the discus, the conch, the mace, and the lotus on the fingertips. / Having thus performed the rite of ritual placement, one should meditate in the previously described pavilion:

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇābjāsanasthasya tārkṣyasyopari saṃsthitam /
pūrvoktarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ śrīkaraṃ lokamohanam //
meaning:
अरुणाब्जासनस्थस्य तार्क्ष्यस्योपरि संस्थितम् /
पूर्वोक्तरूपिणं देवं श्रीकरं लोकमोहनम् //
text_mt: upon Garuḍa seated on a red lotus seat, / the god who has the previously stated form, the granter of prosperity, who enchants the world.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayedaṣṭalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ /
raktāṃbujaiḥ samidbhiśca vilvakṣīridrumodbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं पूजयेदष्टलक्षं मन्त्री दशांशतः /
रक्तांबुजैः समिद्भिश्च विल्वक्षीरिद्रुमोद्भवैः //
text_mt: Having thus meditated, the practitioner should recite eight hundred thousand times, and one-tenth of that / [he should offer] in fire oblations with red lotuses, kindling sticks from bilva and milky-sapped trees,

sanskrit_iast:
payo 'nnaiḥ sarpiṣā hutvā pratyekaṃ susamāhitaḥ /
aśvatthoduṃbaraplakṣavaṭāḥ kṣīridrumāḥ smṛtā //
meaning:
पयो ऽन्नैः सर्पिषा हुत्वा प्रत्येकं सुसमाहितः /
अश्वत्थोदुंबरप्लक्षवटाः क्षीरिद्रुमाः स्मृता //
text_mt: milk-rice, and clarified butter, one by one, with concentrated mind. / The aśvattha, uḍumbara, plakṣa, and banyan are remembered as milky-sapped trees.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedvaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ /
aṅgāvaraṇadikpālahetibhiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
पूजयेद्वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः /
अङ्गावरणदिक्पालहेतिभिः सहितं विभुम् //
text_mt: One should worship the all-pervading Lord on a Vaiṣṇava ritual seat, envisioning His form by means of the root-mantra, / accompanied by the limbs, the retinue, the guardians of the directions, and the weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ siddhe manau matrī prayogānpūrvavañcaret /
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃto varāheti tataḥ param //
meaning:
इत्थं सिद्धे मनौ मत्री प्रयोगान्पूर्ववञ्चरेत् /
तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतो वराहेति ततः परम् //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner should perform the rites as before. / [The mantra begins with] the Praṇava, [followed by] *hṛt* [namaḥ], *bhagavān* ending in the dative, and then *varāha*;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpāya bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ syāllohitakāmikā ca ye /
bhūpatitvaṃ ca me dehi dadāpaya śucipriyā //
meaning:
रूपाय भूर्भुवः स्वः स्याल्लोहितकामिका च ये /
भूपतित्वं च मे देहि ददापय शुचिप्रिया //
text_mt: *rūpāya*, [then] *bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svaḥ*, *lohitakāmikāye*, / and *bhūpatitvaṃ ca me dehi dadāpaya*, ending with the beloved of Agni [*svāhā*].

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāgnivarṇo mantro 'yaṃ bhārgavo 'sya munirmataḥ /
chando 'nuṣṭubdevatādivarāhaḥ samudīritaḥ //
meaning:
रामाग्निवर्णो मन्त्रो ऽयं भार्गवो ऽस्य मुनिर्मतः /
छन्दो ऽनुष्टुब्देवतादिवराहः समुदीरितः //
text_mt: This mantra has thirty-three syllables; its sage is considered to be Bhārgava; / the meter is anuṣṭubh, and the deity is proclaimed to be Ādivarāha.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadaṃṣṭrāya hṛdayaṃ vyomolkāyaga śiraḥ smṛtam /
śikhā tejo 'dhipataye viśvarūpāya varma ca //
meaning:
एकदंष्ट्राय हृदयं व्योमोल्कायग शिरः स्मृतम् /
शिखा तेजो ऽधिपतये विश्वरूपाय वर्म च //
text_mt: To Ekadaṃṣṭra is the heart; *vyomolkāya* is remembered as the head; / the crest is to Tejodhipati; the armor is to Viśvarūpa;

sanskrit_iast:
mahādaṃṣṭrāya cāstraṃ syātpañcāṅgamiti kalpayet /
athavā giriṣaṭsaptabāṇairvasubhirakṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
महादंष्ट्राय चास्त्रं स्यात्पञ्चाङ्गमिति कल्पयेत् /
अथवा गिरिषट्सप्तबाणैर्वसुभिरक्षरैः //
text_mt: and the weapon is to Mahādaṃṣṭra; thus one should arrange the five limbs. / Or else, by means of seven, six, seven, five, and eight syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktairmantravaryasya pañcāgāṃni prakalpayet /
tatau dhyāyedanekārkanibhamādivarāhakam //
meaning:
विभक्तैर्मन्त्रवर्यस्य पञ्चागांनि प्रकल्पयेत् /
ततौ ध्यायेदनेकार्कनिभमादिवराहकम् //
text_mt: divided from the excellent mantra, one should form the five limbs. / Then one should meditate on the Primeval Varāha, radiant like many suns,

sanskrit_iast:
āṃ hrīṃ svarṇanibhaṃ jānvoradho nābheḥ sitaprabham /
iṣṭābhītigadāśaṅkhacakraśaktyasikheṭakān //
meaning:
आं ह्रीं स्वर्णनिभं जान्वोरधो नाभेः सितप्रभम् /
इष्टाभीतिगदाशङ्खचक्रशक्त्यसिखेटकान् //
text_mt: [with the seed-syllables] *āṃ hrīṃ*, resembling gold below the knees, and possessing a white radiance above the navel, / holding the boon, protection, mace, conch, discus, spear, sword, and shield

sanskrit_iast:
dadhataṃ ca karairdaṃṣṭrāgralasaddharaṇiṃ smaret /
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ sarasīruhaiḥ //
meaning:
दधतं च करैर्दंष्ट्राग्रलसद्धरणिं स्मरेत् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षं दशांशं सरसीरुहैः //
text_mt: with His hands; and one should remember the earth shining on the tip of His tusk. / Having thus meditated, one should recite one hundred thousand times, and a tenth of that with lotuses

sanskrit_iast:
madhvaktairjuhayātpīṭhe pūrvokte vaiṣṇave yajet /
mūlena mūrtiṃ saṅkalpya tasyāṃ sampūjayedvibhum //
meaning:
मध्वक्तैर्जुहयात्पीठे पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे यजेत् /
मूलेन मूर्तिं सङ्कल्प्य तस्यां सम्पूजयेद्विभुम् //
text_mt: smeared with honey one should offer in fire oblations; one should worship Him on the previously described Vaiṣṇava ritual seat. / Having conceived the form with the root-mantra, one should worship the all-pervading Lord in it,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāvaraṇadikpālahetiyantraprasiddhaye /
japādevāvarni dadyāddhanaṃ dhānyaṃ mahīṃ śriyam //
meaning:
अङ्गावरणदिक्पालहेतियन्त्रप्रसिद्धये /
जपादेवावर्नि दद्याद्धनं धान्यं महीं श्रियम् //
text_mt: for the perfection of the limbs, retinue, guardians of the directions, weapons, and yantra. / From recitation alone, the earth will bestow wealth, grain, land, and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhārke sitapakṣasyāṣṭamyāṃ gavyeṣu pañcasu /
śilāṃ śuddhāṃ vinikṣipya spṛṣṭvā tāmayutaṃ japet //
meaning:
सिंहार्के सितपक्षस्याष्टम्यां गव्येषु पञ्चसु /
शिलां शुद्धां विनिक्षिप्य स्पृष्ट्वा तामयुतं जपेत् //
text_mt: When the sun is in Leo, on the eighth day of the bright fortnight, placing a pure stone / into the five products of the cow, touching it, one should recite ten thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukhasvato mantrī tāṃ śilāṃ likhanedbhuvi /
bhūtapretāhicaurādikṛtāṃ bādhāṃ nivārayet //
meaning:
उदङ्मुखस्वतो मन्त्री तां शिलां लिखनेद्भुवि /
भूतप्रेताहिचौरादिकृतां बाधां निवारयेत् //
text_mt: The practitioner, facing north, should bury that stone in the ground; / he averts the affliction caused by spirits, ghosts, serpents, thieves, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarbhṛgudine sādhyabhūtalānmṛdamāharet /
mantritāṃ mūlamantreṇa vibhajettāṃ tridhā punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रातर्भृगुदिने साध्यभूतलान्मृदमाहरेत् /
मन्त्रितां मूलमन्त्रेण विभजेत्तां त्रिधा पुनः //
text_mt: In the morning on a Friday, one should fetch clay from the ground to be mastered; / having consecrated it with the root-mantra, one should divide it again into three parts:

sanskrit_iast:
cullyāmekaṃ samālipyāpyaparaṃ pākabhājane /
godugdhe paramāloḍya śodhitāṃstandulān kṣipet //
meaning:
चुल्ल्यामेकं समालिप्याप्यपरं पाकभाजने /
गोदुग्धे परमालोड्य शोधितांस्तन्दुलान् क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: smearing one [part] on the hearth, and the other on the cooking vessel, / having stirred [the third] in cow's milk, one should cast in cleansed grains of rice.

sanskrit_iast:
samyak śuddhe śuciḥ keśe japanmantraṃ paceñcarum /
avatārya caruṃ paścādvahnau deyaṃ yathāvidhi //
meaning:
सम्यक् शुद्धे शुचिः केशे जपन्मन्त्रं पचेञ्चरुम् /
अवतार्य चरुं पश्चाद्वह्नौ देयं यथाविधि //
text_mt: Purified, in a thoroughly clean space, reciting the mantra, one should cook the sacrificial porridge. / Having taken down the sacrificial porridge, one should then offer it into the fire according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya dhūpadīpādyaiḥ paścādājyaplutaṃ carum /
juhuyātsaṃskṛte vahnau aṣṭottaraśataṃ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य धूपदीपाद्यैः पश्चादाज्यप्लुतं चरुम् /
जुहुयात्संस्कृते वह्नौ अष्टोत्तरशतं सुधीः //
text_mt: Having worshiped with incense, lamps, and so forth, the wise practitioner should then offer into the consecrated fire / one hundred and eight times the sacrificial porridge drenched with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prajuhuyānmantrī kavivāreṣu saptasu /
virodho naśyati kṣetre śatrucaurādyupadravāḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रजुहुयान्मन्त्री कविवारेषु सप्तसु /
विरोधो नश्यति क्षेत्रे शत्रुचौराद्युपद्रवाः //
text_mt: Thus the practitioner should offer in fire oblation on seven Fridays; / opposition in the field and troubles from enemies, thieves, and the like perish.

sanskrit_iast:
bhānūdayepyāravāre sādhyakṣetrānmṛdaṃ punaḥ /
ādāya pūrvavidhinā havirāpādya pūrvavat //
meaning:
भानूदयेप्यारवारे साध्यक्षेत्रान्मृदं पुनः /
आदाय पूर्वविधिना हविरापाद्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: Also at sunrise on a Tuesday, taking clay again from the field to be mastered, / preparing the sacrificial offering according to the previous rule as before,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādedhite vahnau pūrvasaṃkhyākamādarāt /
evaṃ sa saptāravāreṣu juhuyātkṣetrasiddhaye //
meaning:
जुहुयादेधिते वह्नौ पूर्वसंख्याकमादरात् /
एवं स सप्तारवारेषु जुहुयात्क्षेत्रसिद्धये //
text_mt: he should diligently offer into the kindled fire the previously stated number of times. / In this way he should offer fire oblations on seven Tuesdays for the mastery of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyāllakṣasaṃkhyākaṃ gavyai ścaiva sapāyasaiḥ /
abhīṣṭabhūmyādhipatyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयाल्लक्षसंख्याकं गव्यै श्चैव सपायसैः /
अभीष्टभूम्याधिपत्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: One should offer one hundred thousand fire oblations with the products of the cow and with milk-rice; / he attains lordship over the desired land; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
udyaddoḥ paridhaṃ divyaṃ sitadaṃṣṭrāgrabhūdharam /
svarṇābhaṃ pārthive pīte maṇḍale susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
उद्यद्दोः परिधं दिव्यं सितदंष्ट्राग्रभूधरम् /
स्वर्णाभं पार्थिवे पीते मण्डले सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: Having raised His arms like iron bars, divine, bearing the earth on the tip of His white tusk, / golden-hued, in the yellow earthly sacred diagram, with concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvāpnoti mahīṃ ramyāṃ varāhasya prasādataḥ /
vāruṇe maṇḍale dhyāyedvārāhaṃ himasannibhagham //
meaning:
ध्यात्वाप्नोति महीं रम्यां वराहस्य प्रसादतः /
वारुणे मण्डले ध्यायेद्वाराहं हिमसन्निभघम् //
text_mt: having meditated, he obtains charming land through the grace of Varāha. / In the watery sacred diagram one should meditate on Varāha resembling snow;

sanskrit_iast:
mahopadravaśāntiḥ syātsādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ /
vaśyārthaṃ ca sadā dhyāyedvarhyābhaṃ vahnimaṇḍe //
meaning:
महोपद्रवशान्तिः स्यात्साधकस्य न संशयः /
वश्यार्थं च सदा ध्यायेद्वर्ह्याभं वह्निमण्डे //
text_mt: there will be the pacification of great calamities for the practitioner, without doubt. / And for the sake of subjugation, one should always meditate on Him resembling fire in the fire sacred diagram;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedevaṃ ripūñcāṭe kṛṣṇābhaṃ vāyumaṇḍale /
hyamaṇḍalagataṃ svacchaṃ vārāhaṃ sarvasiddhidam //
meaning:
ध्यायेदेवं रिपूञ्चाटे कृष्णाभं वायुमण्डले /
ह्यमण्डलगतं स्वच्छं वाराहं सर्वसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: one should thus meditate on Him as black-hued in the wind sacred diagram to drive away enemies. / In the ether sacred diagram, one should meditate on the pure Varāha, who bestows all perfections,

sanskrit_iast:
śatrubhūtagrahakṣveḍāmayapīḍādiśāntaye /
bhagvardhīśayutaṃ vyomabindubhūṣitamastakam //
meaning:
शत्रुभूतग्रहक्ष्वेडामयपीडादिशान्तये /
भग्वर्धीशयुतं व्योमबिन्दुभूषितमस्तकम् //
text_mt: for the pacification of afflictions from enemies, spirits, astrological seizures, poison, illness, and the like. / [The syllable *h*], united with *ra*, *ī*, and the lord of wealth [long *ī*], the ether [*ha*] with its head adorned by the bindu—

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaro varāhasya mantraḥ kalpadrumo 'paraḥ /
pūjādyārdhyādikaṃ sarvamasyāṃ pūrvoktavañcaret //
meaning:
एकाक्षरो वराहस्य मन्त्रः कल्पद्रुमो ऽपरः /
पूजाद्यार्ध्यादिकं सर्वमस्यां पूर्वोक्तवञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: this single-syllabled mantra of Varāha is another wish-granting tree. / One should perform all rites such as worship, offering of respectful water, and the like in this, as stated before.

sanskrit_iast:
savāmakarṇānidrāsyādvarāhāya hṛdantimaḥ /
tārādyo vasuvarṇo 'yaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
सवामकर्णानिद्रास्याद्वराहाय हृदन्तिमः /
ताराद्यो वसुवर्णो ऽयं सर्वैश्वर्यप्रदायकः //
text_mt: [The syllable *g*] with the left ear [*u*], *nidrā* [*bha*] with *ra*, followed by *varāhāya*, ending with *hṛt* [*namaḥ*], / beginning with the Praṇava, this eight-syllabled [mantra] bestows all sovereign power.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando vārāhasaṃjñakaḥ /
devaścandredvabdhinetraiḥ saveṇāṅgakriyā matā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा मुनिः स्याद्गायत्री छन्दो वाराहसंज्ञकः /
देवश्चन्द्रेद्वब्धिनेत्रैः सवेणाङ्गक्रिया मता //
text_mt: Brahmā is the sage, the meter is gāyatrī, and the deity is named Varāha. / The ritual of the limbs is considered to be with one, two, four, and two syllables with *sva*.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjāprayogādi prāgvadasyāpi kalpayet /
praṇavādau ca ṅentaṃ ca bhagavatīti padaṃ tataḥ /
dharaṇidvitayaṃ paścāddharerdvayamudīrayet //
meaning:
ध्यानपूजाप्रयोगादि प्राग्वदस्यापि कल्पयेत् /
प्रणवादौ च ङेन्तं च भगवतीति पदं ततः /
धरणिद्वितयं पश्चाद्धरेर्द्वयमुदीरयेत् //
text_mt: One should perform meditation, worship, practical rites, and so forth for this as before. / Beginning with the Praṇava, and the word *bhagavatī* ending in the dative, / then two [words of] *dharaṇi*, and afterwards one should utter two [words of] *dhare*,

sanskrit_iast:
ekonaviṃśatyarṇāḍhyo mantro vahnipriyāntimaḥ /
varāho 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī nivṛdādikā //
meaning:
एकोनविंशत्यर्णाढ्यो मन्त्रो वह्निप्रियान्तिमः /
वराहो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री निवृदादिका //
text_mt: and ending with the beloved of Agni [*svāhā*], is the mantra rich in nineteen syllables. / Varāha is its sage, the meter is gāyatrī, nivṛt, and so forth;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā dharaṇī bījaṃ tāraḥśaktirvasupriyā /
rāmavedāgnibāṇākṣinetrārṇairaṅgarakalpanam //
meaning:
देवता धरणी बीजं तारःशक्तिर्वसुप्रिया /
रामवेदाग्निबाणाक्षिनेत्रार्णैरङ्गरकल्पनम् //
text_mt: the deity is Dharaṇī, the seed-syllable is the Praṇava, the power is the beloved of Vasu [*svāhā*]. / The arrangement of the limbs is with three, four, three, five, two, and two syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃ citravibhūṣāḍhyāṃ padmasthāṃ tuṅgasustanīm /
nīlāṃbujadvayaṃ śālimañjarīṃ ca śukraṃ karaiḥ //
meaning:
श्यामां चित्रविभूषाढ्यां पद्मस्थां तुङ्गसुस्तनीम् /
नीलांबुजद्वयं शालिमञ्जरीं च शुक्रं करैः //
text_mt: Dark-complexioned, adorned with diverse ornaments, standing on a lotus, having high, beautiful breasts, / holding two blue lotuses, a stalk of rice, and a parrot in Her hands,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhatīṃ citravasanāṃ dharāṃ bhagavatīṃ smaret /
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ pāyasena tu //
meaning:
दधतीं चित्रवसनां धरां भगवतीं स्मरेत् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षं दशांशं पायसेन तु //
text_mt: wearing variegated garments—one should remember the divine Lady Earth. / Having thus meditated, one should recite one hundred thousand times, and offer a tenth of that with milk-rice

sanskrit_iast:
sājyena juhuyānmantrī viṣṇoḥ pīṭhṭhe samarcayet /
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena tasyāṃ vasumatīṃ yajet //
meaning:
साज्येन जुहुयान्मन्त्री विष्णोः पीठ्ठे समर्चयेत् /
मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलेन तस्यां वसुमतीं यजेत् //
text_mt: along with clarified butter; the practitioner should worship on the ritual seat of Viṣṇu. / Having conceived the form by the root-mantra, one should worship the Earth within it.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāni pūrvamārādhya bhūvahnijalamārutān /
dikpātreṣu ca sampūjya koṇapatreṣu tatkalāḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गानि पूर्वमाराध्य भूवह्निजलमारुतान् /
दिक्पात्रेषु च सम्पूज्य कोणपत्रेषु तत्कलाः //
text_mt: Having first worshiped the limbs, one should worship the earth, fire, water, and wind / on the directional petals, and Her portions on the corner petals:

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭā ca vidyānāṃ taiśca tatkalāḥ /
indrādyānapi vañcādīnpūjayettadanantaram //
meaning:
निवृत्तिश्च प्रतिष्टा च विद्यानां तैश्च तत्कलाः /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वञ्चादीन्पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Nivṛtti, Pratiṣṭhā, and Vidyā, and their kalās through them; / immediately after that, one should also worship Indra and the other [guardians of directions] and the thunderbolt and other weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ /
dharaṇī prabhajannevaṃ paśuratnāṃbarādibhiḥ //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेदिष्टमात्मनः /
धरणी प्रभजन्नेवं पशुरत्नांबरादिभिः //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner achieves his desired aim, / worshiping Earth in this manner with cattle, jewels, garments, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dharamyā vallabhaḥ sa syātsukhī jīvecchataṃ samā /
trailokyamohano mantro jagannāthasya kīrtyate //
meaning:
धरम्या वल्लभः स स्यात्सुखी जीवेच्छतं समा /
त्रैलोक्यमोहनो मन्त्रो जगन्नाथस्य कीर्त्यते //
text_mt:
He becomes dear to the earth and shall live happily for a hundred years.
Now the mantra of Jagannātha that bewilders the three worlds is proclaimed:

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ kāmo ramā bījaṃ hṛdante puruṣottamaḥ /
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ pratirūpānte lakṣmīti ca nivāsi ca //
meaning:
तारः कामो रमा बीजं हृदन्ते पुरुषोत्तमः /
श्रीकण्ठः प्रतिरूपान्ते लक्ष्मीति च निवासि च //
text_mt:
The praṇava, the Kāma-bīja, Ramā's bīja, Puruṣottama following hṛt,
Śrīkaṇṭha followed by pratirūpa, and lakṣmī and nivāsi,

sanskrit_iast:
sakalānte jagatpaścātkṣobhaṇeti padaṃ vadet /

सर्वस्त्रीहृदयान्ते तु विदारणपदं वदेत् //
text_mt:
after sakala one should utter the word jagat, then kṣobhaṇa;
after sarvastrīhṛdaya one should utter the word vidāraṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
tatastribhuvanāntaṃ tu madonmādakareti ca /
surāsurānte manujasuṃdarījanavarṇataḥ //
meaning:
ततस्त्रिभुवनान्तं तु मदोन्मादकरेति च /
सुरासुरान्ते मनुजसुंदरीजनवर्णतः //
text_mt:
then following tribhuvana, madonmādakara;
after surāsura, through the syllables manujasundarījana,

sanskrit_iast:
manāṃsi tāpayadvandvaṃ dīpayadvitayaṃ tataḥ /
śoṣayadvitayaṃ paścānmārayadvitayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
मनांसि तापयद्वन्द्वं दीपयद्वितयं ततः /

text_mt:
then manāṃsi, two tāpayas, then a pair of dīpayas,
then a pair of śoṣayas, then a pair of mārayas,

sanskrit_iast:
staṃbhayadvitayaṃ bhūyo mohayadvitaya tataḥ /
drāvayadvitayaṃ tāvadākarṣayayugaṃ tataḥ //
dhyānapūjāprayogādi prāgvadasyāpi kalpayet /
praṇavādau ca ṅentaṃ ca bhagavatīti padaṃ tataḥ /
dharaṇidvitayaṃ paścāddharerdvayamudīrayet //
ekonaviṃśatyarṇāḍhyo mantro vahnipriyāntimaḥ /
varāho 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī nivṛdādikā //
devatā dharaṇī bījaṃ tāraḥśaktirvasupriyā /
rāmavedāgnibāṇākṣinevārṇairaṅgakalpanam //
śyāmāṃ citravibhūṣāḍhyāṃ padmasthāṃ tuṅgasustanīm /
nīlāṃbujadvayaṃ śālimañjarīñca śukaṃ karaiḥ //
dadhatīṃ citravasanāṃ dharāṃ bhagavatīṃ smaret /
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ pāyasena tu //
sājyena juhuyānmantrī viṣṇoḥ pīṭhe samarcayet /
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya gūlena tasyāṃ vasumatīṃ yajet //
aṅgāni pūrvamārādhya bhūvahnijalamārutān /
dikpātreṣu ca sampūjya koṇapatreṣu tatkalāḥ //
meaning:
स्तंभयद्वितयं भूयो मोहयद्वितय ततः /
द्रावयद्वितयं तावदाकर्षययुगं ततः //
ध्यानपूजाप्रयोगादि प्राग्वदस्यापि कल्पयेत् /
प्रणवादौ च ङेन्तं च भगवतीति पदं ततः /
धरणिद्वितयं पश्चाद्धरेर्द्वयमुदीरयेत् //
एकोनविंशत्यर्णाढ्यो मन्त्रो वह्निप्रियान्तिमः /
वराहो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री निवृदादिका //
देवता धरणी बीजं तारःशक्तिर्वसुप्रिया /
रामवेदाग्निबाणाक्षिनेवार्णैरङ्गकल्पनम् //
श्यामां चित्रविभूषाढ्यां पद्मस्थां तुङ्गसुस्तनीम् /
नीलांबुजद्वयं शालिमञ्जरीञ्च शुकं करैः //
दधतीं चित्रवसनां धरां भगवतीं स्मरेत् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षं दशांशं पायसेन तु //
साज्येन जुहुयान्मन्त्री विष्णोः पीठे समर्चयेत् /
मूर्तिं संकल्प्य गूलेन तस्यां वसुमतीं यजेत् //
अङ्गानि पूर्वमाराध्य भूवह्निजलमारुतान् /
दिक्पात्रेषु च सम्पूज्य कोणपत्रेषु तत्कलाः //
text_mt:
again a pair of stambhayas, then a pair of mohayas,
then a pair of drāvayas, then a pair of ākarṣayas,

One should arrange the meditation, worship, ritual application, and the like for this also as before.
With the praṇava at the beginning, ending in the fourth case, then the word bhagavatī,
then two dharaṇīs, after that one should utter two haras;

the mantra possesses nineteen syllables, ending with the beloved of Agni.
Its sage is Varāha, the metre is Nivṛt-Gāyatrī and so forth;

the deity is Dharaṇī, the bīja is the praṇava, the śakti is the beloved of Vasu.
The arrangement of limbs is made with syllables numbering three, four, three, five, two, and nine.

One should meditate on the divine Dharaṇī as dark-complexioned, adorned with varied ornaments,
seated on a lotus, having high and firm breasts, holding in her hands two blue lotuses, a sheaf of rice, and a parrot,

and wearing garments of varied colors.
Having meditated thus, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times, and one-tenth thereof with milk-rice

mixed with clarified butter the mantra-practitioner should offer into fire, and should worship on the seat of Viṣṇu.
Having conceived a form by means of the root-mantra, he should worship Vasumatī in it.

Having first worshipped the limbs, and having worshipped earth, fire, water, and wind
upon the directional petals, and her powers upon the corner petals,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭā ca vidyānāṃ taiśca tatkalāḥ /
indrādyānapi vajrādīnpūjayettadanantaram //
pūrnaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ /
dharaṇīṃ prabhajannevaṃ paśuratnāṃbarādibhiḥ //
dharaṇyā vallabhaḥ sa syātsukhī jīvecchataṃ samā /
trailokyamohano mantro jagannāthasya kīrtyate //
tāraḥ kāmo ramā bījaṃ hṛdante puruṣottamaḥ /
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ pratirūpānte lakṣmīti ca nivāsiṃ ca //
sakalānte jagatpaścātkṣobhaṇeti padaṃ vadet /
sarvastrīhṛdayānte tu vidāraṇapadaṃ vadet //
tatastribhuvanāntaṃ tu madonmādakareti ca /
surāsurānte manujasuṃdarījanavarṇataḥ //
manāṃsi tāpayadvandvaṃ dīpayadvitayaṃ tataḥ /
śoṣayadvitayaṃ paścānmārayadvitayaṃ tataḥ //
staṃbhayadvitayaṃ bhūyo mohayadvitaya tataḥ /
drāvayadvitayaṃ tāvadākarṣayayugaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
निवृत्तिश्च प्रतिष्टा च विद्यानां तैश्च तत्कलाः /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्रादीन्पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् //
पूर्नं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेदिष्टमात्मनः /
धरणीं प्रभजन्नेवं पशुरत्नांबरादिभिः //
धरण्या वल्लभः स स्यात्सुखी जीवेच्छतं समा /
त्रैलोक्यमोहनो मन्त्रो जगन्नाथस्य कीर्त्यते //
तारः कामो रमा बीजं हृदन्ते पुरुषोत्तमः /
श्रीकण्ठः प्रतिरूपान्ते लक्ष्मीति च निवासिं च //
सकलान्ते जगत्पश्चात्क्षोभणेति पदं वदेत् /
सर्वस्त्रीहृदयान्ते तु विदारणपदं वदेत् //
ततस्त्रिभुवनान्तं तु मदोन्मादकरेति च /
सुरासुरान्ते मनुजसुंदरीजनवर्णतः //
मनांसि तापयद्वन्द्वं दीपयद्वितयं ततः /
शोषयद्वितयं पश्चान्मारयद्वितयं ततः //
स्तंभयद्वितयं भूयो मोहयद्वितय ततः /
द्रावयद्वितयं तावदाकर्षययुगं ततः //
text_mt:
namely, Nivṛtti, Pratiṣṭhā, Vidyā, and their parts,
immediately after that he should worship Indra and the others, as well as the vajra and other weapons.

When the mantra is completely mastered, the mantra-practitioner achieves his desired aim.
Thus honoring Dharaṇī with cattle, gems, garments, and other things,

he becomes dear to the earth and shall live happily for a hundred years.
Now the mantra of Jagannātha that bewilders the three worlds is proclaimed:

The praṇava, the Kāma-bīja, Ramā's bīja, Puruṣottama following hṛt,
Śrīkaṇṭha followed by pratirūpa, and lakṣmī and nivāsi,

after sakala one should utter the word jagat, then kṣobhaṇa;
after sarvastrīhṛdaya one should utter the word vidāraṇa;

then following tribhuvana, madonmādakara;
after surāsura, through the syllables manujasundarījana,

then manāṃsi, two tāpayas, then a pair of dīpayas,
then a pair of śoṣayas, then a pair of mārayas,

again a pair of stambhayas, then a pair of mohayas,
then a pair of drāvayas, then a pair of ākarṣayas,

sanskrit_iast:
samastaparamo yena subhagena ca saṃyutam /
sarvasaubhāgyaśabdānte karasarvapadaṃ vadet //
meaning:
समस्तपरमो येन सुभगेन च संयुतम् /
सर्वसौभाग्यशब्दान्ते करसर्वपदं वदेत् //
text_mt:
samastaparama, joined with subhaga,
after the word sarvasaubhāgya one should utter the words kara and sarva,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmapradādamunbrahmāseṃdurhanuyugaṃ tataḥ /
cakreṇa gadayā paścātkhaḍgena tadanantaram //
meaning:
कामप्रदादमुन्ब्रह्मासेंदुर्हनुयुगं ततः /
चक्रेण गदया पश्चात्खड्गेन तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt:
kāmaprada, adamu, the letter na with anusvāra, then a pair of hanus,
with the cakra, with the mace, after that with the sword,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabāṇairbhediyugaṃ pāśenānte kaṭadvayam /
aṅkuśeneti saṃprocya tāḍayadvitayaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वबाणैर्भेदियुगं पाशेनान्ते कटद्वयम् /
अङ्कुशेनेति संप्रोच्य ताडयद्वितयं पुनः //
text_mt:
with all arrows, a pair of bhedis, with the noose, followed by two kaṭas,
having pronounced 'with the elephant-goad', again a pair of tāḍayas,

sanskrit_iast:
kuruśabdadvayamatho kiṃ tiṣṭasi padaṃ vadet /
tāvadyāvatpadasyānte samāhitamanantaram /
tato me siddhirābhāsya bhavamante ca varma phaṭ //
meaning:
कुरुशब्दद्वयमथो किं तिष्टसि पदं वदेत् /
तावद्यावत्पदस्यान्ते समाहितमनन्तरम् /
ततो मे सिद्धिराभास्य भवमन्ते च वर्म फट् //
text_mt:
then a pair of the word kuru, one should utter the word kiṃ tiṣṭhasi,
then as far as the word yāvat, followed by samāhita,
then having revealed me siddhi, at the end of the vocative form varma and phaṭ,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdanto 'yaṃ mahāmantro dviśatārṇaḥ samīritaḥ /
jaiminirmunirasyoktaśchandaścāmitamīritam //
meaning:
हृदन्तो ऽयं महामन्त्रो द्विशतार्णः समीरितः /
जैमिनिर्मुनिरस्योक्तश्छन्दश्चामितमीरितम् //
text_mt:
this great mantra ending with hṛt is declared to contain two hundred syllables.
Its sage is said to be Jaimini, and its metre is said to be Amita;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā jagatāṃ mohe jagannāthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
kāmo bījaṃ ramā śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye //
meaning:
देवता जगतां मोहे जगन्नाथः प्रकीर्तितः /
कामो बीजं रमा शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये //
text_mt:
the deity for enchanting the worlds is proclaimed as Jagannātha;
the Kāma-bīja is the seed, Ramā is the śakti, and the application is for obtaining all things.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣottamatribhuvanonmādakānte 'gnivarma ca /
hṛdayaṃ kīrtitaṃ paścājjagatkṣobhaṇaśabdataḥ //
meaning:
पुरुषोत्तमत्रिभुवनोन्मादकान्ते ऽग्निवर्म च /
हृदयं कीर्तितं पश्चाज्जगत्क्षोभणशब्दतः //
text_mt:
After puruṣottamatribhuvanonmādaka, the fire-armour (svāhā)
is proclaimed as the heart; next, after the word jagatkṣobhaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīdayitavarmāntaḥ śiraḥ proktaṃ śikhā punaḥ /
manmatho tamaśabdānte maṅgaje padamīrayet //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीदयितवर्मान्तः शिरः प्रोक्तं शिखा पुनः /
मन्मथो तमशब्दान्ते मङ्गजे पदमीरयेत् //
text_mt:
ending in lakṣmīdayitavarma is declared the head; again, the crest-lock:
after the word manmathottama, one should utter the words maṅgaje,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadāyeti huṃ procya nyasedvama tataḥ param /
paramānte bhṛgukarṇābhyāṃ ca sarvapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
कामदायेति हुं प्रोच्य न्यसेद्वम ततः परम् /
परमान्ते भृगुकर्णाभ्यां च सर्वपदं ततः //
text_mt:
having pronounced kāmadāya hūṃ, one should assign the armour thereafter;
after parama, through the ears of Bhṛgu, and then the word sarva,

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyakaravarmānte kavacaṃ pārikīrtitam /
surāsurānte manujasuṃdarīti padaṃ vadet //
meaning:
सौभाग्यकरवर्मान्ते कवचं पारिकीर्तितम् /
सुरासुरान्ते मनुजसुंदरीति पदं वदेत् //
text_mt:
ending in saubhāgyakaravarma, the armour is proclaimed;
after surāsura, one should utter the word manujasundarī,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayānte vidā paścādraṇasarvapadaṃ vadet /
tataḥ praharaṇadharasarvakāmukatatpadam //
meaning:
हृदयान्ते विदा पश्चाद्रणसर्वपदं वदेत् /
ततः प्रहरणधरसर्वकामुकतत्पदम् //
text_mt:
after hṛdaya, then the words vidāraṇa and sarva;
then that word praharaṇadharasarvakāmuka,

sanskrit_iast:
hanayugmaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ bandhanāni tato vadet /
ākarṣayadvayaṃ paścānmahābalapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
हनयुग्मं च हृदयं बन्धनानि ततो वदेत् /
आकर्षयद्वयं पश्चान्महाबलपदं ततः //
text_mt:
a pair of hanas and the heart, then one should utter bandhanāni,
then a pair of ākarṣayas, then the word mahābala,

sanskrit_iast:
varma cāstraṃ samākhyātaṃ netraṃ syāttadanantaram /
vadetribhuvanaṃ paścāccara sarvajaneti ca //
meaning:
वर्म चास्त्रं समाख्यातं नेत्रं स्यात्तदनन्तरम् /
वदेत्रिभुवनं पश्चाच्चर सर्वजनेति च //
text_mt:
and varma and the weapon are declared; immediately after that should be the eye:
one should say tribhuvana, and next cara sarvajana,

sanskrit_iast:
manāṃsi harayugmānte dārayadvitayaṃ ca me /
vaśamānaya varmānte netramantraḥ samīritaḥ //
meaning:
मनांसि हरयुग्मान्ते दारयद्वितयं च मे /
वशमानय वर्मान्ते नेत्रमन्त्रः समीरितः //
text_mt:
manāṃsi, after a pair of haras, two dārayas, and me
vaśam ānaya ending in varma is proclaimed as the eye mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgamantrāstārādyāḥ phaṭnamontāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
tārastrailokyaśabdānte mohaneti padaṃ vadet //

षडङ्गमन्त्रास्ताराद्याः फट्नमोन्ताः प्रकीर्तिताः /
तारस्त्रैलोक्यशब्दान्ते मोहनेति पदं वदेत् //
text_mt:
The six limb-mantras are proclaimed as beginning with the praṇava and ending in phaṭ and namaḥ.
The praṇava, after the word trailokya, one should utter the word mohana,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣīkeśeti saṃprocyāpratirūpādiśabdataḥ /
mamnathānantaraṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ hṛdayamīrayet //
meaning:
हृषीकेशेति संप्रोच्याप्रतिरूपादिशब्दतः /
मम्नथानन्तरं सर्वस्त्रीणां हृदयमीरयेत् //
text_mt:
having pronounced hṛṣīkeśa, from the word apratirūpa and so on,
after manmatha, one should utter sarvastrīṇāṃ hṛdayam,

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣaṇapadā gacchadāgacchahṛdayāntimaḥ /
anena vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā jagannāthaṃ smaret sudhīḥ //
meaning:
आकर्षणपदा गच्छदागच्छहृदयान्तिमः /
अनेन व्यापकं कृत्वा जगन्नाथं स्मरेत् सुधीः //
text_mt:
followed by the word ākarṣaṇa, ending in gacchāgacchahṛdaya.
Having performed the pervasive placement with this, the wise person should remember Jagannātha:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhestu taṭe ramyaṃ suradrumalatāñcitam /
udyadarkābhujālābhaṃ svadhāmnojvāladiṅmukham //
meaning:
क्षीराब्धेस्तु तटे रम्यं सुरद्रुमलताञ्चितम् /
उद्यदर्काभुजालाभं स्वधाम्नोज्वालदिङ्मुखम् //
text_mt:
On the pleasant shore of the ocean of milk, graced with creepers of divine trees,
having the radiance of the network of the rays of the rising sun, illuminating the directions with his own splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
prasūnāvalisaurabhyamādyanmadhukarāravam /
divyavātoñcalatkañjaparāgoddhūlitāṃbaram //
meaning:
प्रसूनावलिसौरभ्यमाद्यन्मधुकरारवम् /
दिव्यवातोञ्चलत्कञ्जपरागोद्धूलितांबरम् //
text_mt:
resounding with intoxicated bees fragrant with clusters of blossoms,
with the atmosphere dusted with the pollen of lotuses stirred by divine breezes,

sanskrit_iast:
svarvadhūgītamādhuryābhirāma cintayedvanam /
tadantarmaṇisampattisphurattoraṇamaṇḍape //
meaning:
स्वर्वधूगीतमाधुर्याभिराम चिन्तयेद्वनम् /
तदन्तर्मणिसम्पत्तिस्फुरत्तोरणमण्डपे //
text_mt:
one should contemplate the delightful grove with the sweetness of the songs of celestial damsels;
within that, in a pavilion with arched doorways shining with an abundance of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
vilasanmauktikoddāmadāmarājadvitānake /
maṇivedyādi viyatkirīṭāgrasamarcite //
meaning:
विलसन्मौक्तिकोद्दामदामराजद्वितानके /
मणिवेद्यादि वियत्किरीटाग्रसमर्चिते //
text_mt:
under a canopy resplendent with rows of shining, large pearls,
honoured with jewelled altars and the like, reaching to the sky with its crown,

sanskrit_iast:
divyasiṃhāsane vipra samāsīnaṃ smaredvibhum /
śaṅkhapāśeṣu cāpāni musalaṃ nandakaṃ gadām //
meaning:
दिव्यसिंहासने विप्र समासीनं स्मरेद्विभुम् /
शङ्खपाशेषु चापानि मुसलं नन्दकं गदाम् //
text_mt:
the wise one should meditate on the Lord seated upon a divine lion-throne, O brahmin,
holding with his arms the conch, noose, bow, pestle, Nandaka sword, mace,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkuśaṃ dadhataṃ dorbhiḥ śliṣṭe kamalayorasi /
paśyatyaṅkasthayāṃbhojaśriyā rāgollasadṛśā //
meaning:
अङ्कुशं दधतं दोर्भिः श्लिष्टे कमलयोरसि /
पश्यत्यङ्कस्थयांभोजश्रिया रागोल्लसदृशा //
text_mt:
and elephant-goad, embraced by Kamalā on his chest,
looking upon Lotus-Śrī seated upon his lap with eyes sparkling with affection.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapellakṣacatuṣkaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ /
kuṇḍer'ddhacandre padmairvā jātīpuṣpaiśca homayet //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेल्लक्षचतुष्कं तद्दशांशतः /
कुण्डेर्ऽद्धचन्द्रे पद्मैर्वा जातीपुष्पैश्च होमयेत् //
text_mt:
Having thus meditated, one should recite [the mantra] four hundred thousand times; one-tenth thereof
one should offer into fire in a crescent-shaped pit with lotuses or jasmine flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgabhūmiṃ tathātmānaṃ yāgopakaraṇaṃ tathā /
pūjayiṣyan jagannāthaṃ gāyatryā prokṣayedvudhaḥ //
meaning:
यागभूमिं तथात्मानं यागोपकरणं तथा /
पूजयिष्यन् जगन्नाथं गायत्र्या प्रोक्षयेद्वुधः //
text_mt:
Intending to worship Jagannātha, the wise person should sprinkle with the gāyatrī
the sacrificial ground, himself, and the sacrificial implements.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamohanāyānte vidmahe padamīrayet /
smarāya dhīmahītyuktvā tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमोहनायान्ते विद्महे पदमीरयेत् /
स्मराय धीमहीत्युक्त्वा तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् //
text_mt:
After trailokyamohanāya, one should utter the word vidmahe;
having said smarāya dhīmahi, [then] tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryeṣā samākhyātā sarvaśuddhikarī parā /
kalpayedāsanaṃ pīṭhe pūrvokte vaiṣṇave sudhīḥ //
meaning:
गायत्र्येषा समाख्याता सर्वशुद्धिकरी परा /
कल्पयेदासनं पीठे पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे सुधीः //
text_mt:
This is proclaimed as the supreme gāyatrī that purifies everything.
The wise one should arrange the seat on the previously described Vaiṣṇava pīṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣirājāya ṭhadvandvaṃ pīṭhamantro 'yamīritaḥ /
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpamūlena tasyāmāvāhayedataḥ //
meaning:
पक्षिराजाय ठद्वन्द्वं पीठमन्त्रो ऽयमीरितः /
मूर्तिं संकल्पमूलेन तस्यामावाहयेदतः //
text_mt: "To the king of birds [Garuḍa], svāhā"—this is stated as the mantra of the ritual seat. / Then, with the root [mantra], having formed the conception, one should invoke the form [of the deity] upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakanyāsamantreṇa tataḥ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ /
śrīvatsahṛdayaṃ tena śrīvatsaṃ stanayoryajet //
meaning:
व्यापकन्यासमन्त्रेण ततः सम्पूज्य भक्तितः /
श्रीवत्सहृदयं तेन श्रीवत्सं स्तनयोर्यजेत् //
text_mt: Then, having worshipped with devotion through the mantra of pervasive ritual placement, / one should worship the Śrīvatsa on the breasts with that [mantra] having Śrīvatsa in the heart [i.e., ending with namaḥ].

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhāya hṛdantena yajedvakṣasi kaustubham /
pūjayedvanamālāyai hṛdantena gale ca tām //
meaning:
कौस्तुभाय हृदन्तेन यजेद्वक्षसि कौस्तुभम् /
पूजयेद्वनमालायै हृदन्तेन गले च ताम् //
text_mt: One should worship the Kaustubha on the chest with [the mantra ending in] the heart for Kaustubha. / And one should worship the forest garland on the neck with [the mantra ending in] the heart for the forest garland.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāyāṃ tato 'bhyarcayedvidhivañcāṅgadevatāḥ /
daleṣu pūjayetpaścāllakṣmyādyāvṛttacāmarāḥ //
meaning:
कर्णिकायां ततो ऽभ्यर्चयेद्विधिवञ्चाङ्गदेवताः /
दलेषु पूजयेत्पश्चाल्लक्ष्म्याद्यावृत्तचामराः //
text_mt: Then one should worship the deities of the limbs on the pericarp according to rule. / Afterwards, on the petals, one should worship Lakṣmī and the others who hold fly-whisks,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhūkakusumābhāsāḥmuktāhāralasatkucāḥ /
utphullāṃbhaghojanayanā madavibhramamantharāḥ //
meaning:
बन्धूककुसुमाभासाःमुक्ताहारलसत्कुचाः /
उत्फुल्लांभघोजनयना मदविभ्रममन्थराः //
text_mt: shining like bandhūka flowers, their breasts radiant with pearl necklaces, / their eyes like blossoming lotuses, languid with the amorous play of passion:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmī sarasvatī caiva dhṛtiḥ prītistataḥ param /
kāntiḥ śāntistuṣṭipuṣṭibījādyā ṅenamontikāḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मी सरस्वती चैव धृतिः प्रीतिस्ततः परम् /
कान्तिः शान्तिस्तुष्टिपुष्टिबीजाद्या ङेनमोन्तिकाः //
text_mt: Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, and Dhṛti, and after that Prīti, / Kānti, Śānti, Tuṣṭi, and Puṣṭi, beginning with their seed-syllables and ending with the dative and namaḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguḥ khaḍrāśacandrāḍhyo devyā bījamudāhṛtam /
hrasvatrayaklībasarvarahitasvarasaṃyutam //
meaning:
भृगुः खड्राशचन्द्राढ्यो देव्या बीजमुदाहृतम् /
ह्रस्वत्रयक्लीबसर्वरहितस्वरसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Bhṛgu [sa], combined with kha [ha], ra, and the moon [candrabindu, producing srāṃ etc.], is declared as the seed-syllable of the goddess, / joined with the vowels devoid of the three short vowels and all neuter vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
devyā bījaṃ kramādāsāmādau ca viniyojayet /
dalāgreṣu yajecchaṅkhaṃ śārṅgaṃ cakramasiṃ gadām //
meaning:
देव्या बीजं क्रमादासामादौ च विनियोजयेत् /
दलाग्रेषु यजेच्छङ्खं शार्ङ्गं चक्रमसिं गदाम् //
text_mt: One should employ the seed-syllable of the goddess at the beginning of these in order. / At the tips of the petals, one should worship the conch, the bow Śārṅga, the discus, the sword, the mace,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkuśaṃ musalaṃ pāśaṃ svamudrāmanubhiḥ pṛthak /
mahājalacarā yānte varmāstraṃ vahnivallabhā //
meaning:
अङ्कुशं मुसलं पाशं स्वमुद्रामनुभिः पृथक् /
महाजलचरा यान्ते वर्मास्त्रं वह्निवल्लभा //
text_mt: the goad, the pestle, and the noose, separately, with their own mudrās and mantras: / "O great aquatic creature," followed by "yā", the armor [huṃ], the weapon [phaṭ], and the beloved of fire [svāhā],

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcajanyā pratārādyo namontaḥ śaṅkhapūjane /
śārṅgāya saśayānte ca varmāstraṃ vahnivallabhā //
meaning:
पाञ्चजन्या प्रताराद्यो नमोन्तः शङ्खपूजने /
शार्ङ्गाय सशयान्ते च वर्मास्त्रं वह्निवल्लभा //
text_mt: preceded by the star [Oṃ], [followed by] "To Pāñcajanya," ending with namaḥ, in the worship of the conch; / "To the bow Śārṅga," ending with "saśa", the armor [huṃ], the weapon [phaṭ], and the beloved of fire [svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgāya hṛdayaṃ mantro mahādyaḥ śārṅgapūjane /
sudarśanamahānte tu cakrarājapadaṃ vadet //
meaning:
शार्ङ्गाय हृदयं मन्त्रो महाद्यः शार्ङ्गपूजने /
सुदर्शनमहान्ते तु चक्रराजपदं वदेत् //
text_mt: "To the bow Śārṅga, namaḥ" is the mantra beginning with mahat in the worship of the Śārṅga; / and after "O great Sudarśana," one should utter the word "king of discuses",

sanskrit_iast:
hayayugmaṃ sarvaduṣṭabhayamante kurudvayam /
chindhidvayaṃ tataḥ paścādvidārayayugaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
हययुग्मं सर्वदुष्टभयमन्ते कुरुद्वयम् /
छिन्धिद्वयं ततः पश्चाद्विदारययुगं ततः //
text_mt: the pair "haya", "fear to all wicked ones," ending with the two "kuru"s; / then the two "chindhi"s, and then the pair "vidāraya";

sanskrit_iast:
paramantrān grasadvandvaṃ bhakṣayadvitayaṃ punaḥ /
bhūkāni trāsayadvandvaṃ varmaphaḍvahnisuṃdarī //
meaning:
परमन्त्रान् ग्रसद्वन्द्वं भक्षयद्वितयं पुनः /
भूकानि त्रासयद्वन्द्वं वर्मफड्वह्निसुंदरी //
text_mt: "swallow the mantras of others" twice, again the two "bhakṣaya"s, / "terrify the beings" twice, the armor [huṃ], phaṭ, and the beauty of fire [svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanāya hṛdayaṃ proktaścakrarcane manuḥ /
mahākhaḍgatīkṣṇapadācchiviyugmaṃ samīrayet //
meaning:
सुदर्शनाय हृदयं प्रोक्तश्चक्रर्चने मनुः /
महाखड्गतीक्ष्णपदाच्छिवियुग्मं समीरयेत् //
text_mt: "To Sudarśana, namaḥ" is declared as the mantra in the worship of the discus. / After the words "O sharp great sword," one should utter the pair "chindhi",

sanskrit_iast:
huṃ phaṭ svāhā ca khaḍgāya namaḥ khaḍgārcane manuḥ /
mahākaumodakītyante vadeñcaiva mahābale //
meaning:
हुं फट् स्वाहा च खड्गाय नमः खड्गार्चने मनुः /
महाकौमोदकीत्यन्ते वदेञ्चैव महाबले //
text_mt: huṃ phaṭ svāhā, and "To the sword, namaḥ" is the mantra in the worship of the sword. / After "O great Kaumodakī," one should utter, "O immensely powerful one,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsurāntake paścātprasīdayugaleti ca /
varmāstravahnijāyāntakaumodaki hṛkṣatimaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वासुरान्तके पश्चात्प्रसीदयुगलेति च /
वर्मास्त्रवह्निजायान्तकौमोदकि हृक्षतिमः //
text_mt: destroyer of all asuras," and then the pair "be pleased"; / ending with the armor [huṃ], the weapon [phaṭ], and the wife of fire [svāhā], "To Kaumodakī, namaḥ"—

sanskrit_iast:
kaumodakyarcane prokto mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ /
mahāṅkuśapadātkuṭcayugmaṃ huṃphaṭvasupriyā //
meaning:
कौमोदक्यर्चने प्रोक्तो मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः /
महाङ्कुशपदात्कुट्चयुग्मं हुंफट्वसुप्रिया //
text_mt: this is declared as the mantra accomplishing all aims in the worship of Kaumodakī. / After the word "great goad," the pair "kuṭa", huṃ phaṭ, and the beloved of the Vasus [svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkuśāya namaḥ prokto mantragrauvākuśarcane /
saṃvartakamahānte tu musaleti padaṃ vadet //
meaning:
अङ्कुशाय नमः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रग्रौवाकुशर्चने /
संवर्तकमहान्ते तु मुसलेति पदं वदेत् //
text_mt: "To the goad, namaḥ" is declared as the mantra in the worship of the great goad. / After "the great Saṃvartaka," one should utter the word "pestle",

sanskrit_iast:
yodhayadvitayaṃ varma phaḍante vahnisuṃdarī /
musalāya namaḥ prokto mantro susalapūjane //
meaning:
योधयद्वितयं वर्म फडन्ते वह्निसुंदरी /
मुसलाय नमः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रो सुसलपूजने //
text_mt: the two "yodhaya"s, the armor [huṃ], followed by phaṭ, and the beauty of fire [svāhā]; / "To the pestle, namaḥ" is declared as the mantra in the worship of the pestle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāśa hadādaghaṭayamākarṣayadvayam /
huṃ phaṭe svāhā ca pāśāya namaḥ pāśārcane manuḥ //
meaning:
महापाश हदादघटयमाकर्षयद्वयम् /
हुं फटे स्वाहा च पाशाय नमः पाशार्चने मनुः //
text_mt: After the words "great noose," the pair "ākarṣaya" [attract], / huṃ phaṭ svāhā, and "To the noose, namaḥ" is the mantra in the worship of the noose.

sanskrit_iast: tārādyā manavo hyete tataḥ śakrādikānyajet //
meaning: ताराद्या मनवो ह्येते ततः शक्रादिकान्यजेत् //
text_mt: These mantras indeed begin with the star [Oṃ]. Then one should worship Indra and the other [guardians of the quarters].

sanskrit_iast:
vajrādyānapi saṃpūjya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet /
māsamātraṃ tu kusumaiḥ pūjayitvā hayārijaiḥ //
meaning:
वज्राद्यानपि संपूज्य सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् /
मासमात्रं तु कुसुमैः पूजयित्वा हयारिजैः //
text_mt: Having worshipped the thunderbolt and the other weapons as well, one becomes the lord of all supernatural powers. / Having worshipped for only a month with oleander flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
kumudairvā prajuhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam /
māsamātreṇa vaśyāḥsyustasya sarve nṛpottamāḥ //
meaning:
कुमुदैर्वा प्रजुहुयादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् /
मासमात्रेण वश्याःस्युस्तस्य सर्वे नृपोत्तमाः //
text_mt: or having made fire oblations of a thousand and eight white water lilies, / within only a month all the best of kings become subject to his will.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya nāma yutaṃ mantraṃ japedayutasaṃkhyayā /
sa bhaveddāsavatsadyo mantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
यस्य नाम युतं मन्त्रं जपेदयुतसंख्यया /
स भवेद्दासवत्सद्यो मन्त्रस्यास्य प्रभावतः //
text_mt: If one recites the mantra joined with a person's name for a myriad of times [ten thousand], / that person instantly becomes like a servant by the power of this mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunā kimihoktena manunānena sādhakaḥ /
sādhayetsakalānkāmānviṣṇutulyo na saṃśayaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde saptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन मनुनानेन साधकः /
साधयेत्सकलान्कामान्विष्णुतुल्यो न संशयः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
What is the use of speaking much here? By this mantra the practitioner / can accomplish all desires, equal to Viṣṇu, without doubt.

Thus ends the seventieth chapter in the third quarter of the great narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi divyānnaraharermanūn /
yānsamārādhya brahmādyāścakruḥ sṛṣṭyādi karma vai //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि दिव्यान्नरहरेर्मनून् /
यान्समाराध्य ब्रह्माद्याश्चक्रुः सृष्ट्यादि कर्म वै //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Nārada: I shall proclaim the divine mantras of the Man-Lion, / by worshipping which Brahmā and the others indeed performed actions such as creation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartakaścandramaulirmanurvahnivibhūṣitaḥ /
ekākṣaraḥ smṛto mantro bhajatāṃ surapādapaḥ //
meaning:
संवर्तकश्चन्द्रमौलिर्मनुर्वह्निविभूषितः /
एकाक्षरः स्मृतो मन्त्रो भजतां सुरपादपः //
text_mt: Saṃvartaka [kṣa], adorned with the moon [candrabindu] and decorated with fire [ra]— / this single-syllable mantra is considered a wish-fulfilling tree for those who revere it.

sanskrit_iast:
muniratriśca jagatīṃ chando buddhimatāṃ vara /
devatā nṛhariḥ prokto viniyogo 'khilāptaye //
meaning:
मुनिरत्रिश्च जगतीं छन्दो बुद्धिमतां वर /
देवता नृहरिः प्रोक्तो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये //
text_mt: The seer is Atri, and the metre is Jagatī, O best of the wise; / the deity is declared to be the Man-Lion; the application is for the attainment of all [desires].

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṃ bījaṃ śaktirī proktā ṣaḍdīrgheṇa ṣaḍaṅgakam /
arkenduvahninayanaṃ śaradindurucaṃ karaiḥ //
meaning:
क्षं बीजं शक्तिरी प्रोक्ता षड्दीर्घेण षडङ्गकम् /
अर्केन्दुवह्निनयनं शरदिन्दुरुचं करैः //
text_mt: Kṣaṃ is the seed-syllable; ī is declared to be the power; the six limbs are with the six long [vowels]. / With the sun, the moon, and fire as his eyes, possessing the radiance of the autumn moon, bearing with his hands

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuścakrābhayavalarāndadhataṃ nṛhariṃ smaret /
lakṣaṃ japastaddaśāṃśahomaśca ghṛtapāyasaiḥ //
meaning:
धनुश्चक्राभयवलरान्दधतं नृहरिं स्मरेत् /
लक्षं जपस्तद्दशांशहोमश्च घृतपायसैः //
text_mt: the bow, the discus, the gesture of fearlessness, and the boon, one should meditate on the Man-Lion. / Recitation is one hundred thousand times, and the fire oblation is one tenth of that, with ghee and milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
yajetpīṭhe vaiṣṇave tu kesareṣvaṅgapūjanam /
khageśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śeṣaṃ śatānandaṃ digāliṣu //
meaning:
यजेत्पीठे वैष्णवे तु केसरेष्वङ्गपूजनम् /
खगेशं शङ्करं शेषं शतानन्दं दिगालिषु //
text_mt: One should worship on the Vaiṣṇava ritual seat, with the worship of the limbs on the filaments; / the king of birds [Garuḍa], Śaṅkara, Śeṣa, and Śatānanda [Brahmā] in the rows of the cardinal directions;

sanskrit_iast:
śriyaṃ hriyaṃ dhṛtiṃ puṣṭiṃ koṇapatreṣu pūjayet /
dantacchadeṣu nṛharīṃstāvataḥ pūjayetkramātma //
meaning:
श्रियं ह्रियं धृतिं पुष्टिं कोणपत्रेषु पूजयेत् /
दन्तच्छदेषु नृहरींस्तावतः पूजयेत्क्रमात्म //
text_mt: Śrī, Hrī, Dhṛti, and Puṣṭi one should worship on the corner petals; / and on the petals [or tips] one should worship that many Man-Lions in order:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇo rudro mahāghoro bhīmo bhīṣaṇa ujjvalaḥṛ /
karālo vikarālaśca daityānto madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णो रुद्रो महाघोरो भीमो भीषण उज्ज्वलःऋ /
करालो विकरालश्च दैत्यान्तो मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa, Rudra, Mahāghora, Bhīma, Bhīṣaṇa, Ujjvala, / Karāla, Vikarāla, Daityānta, Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
raktākṣaḥ piṅgalākṣaścāñjano dīptarucistathā /
sughorakaśca suhanurviśvako rākṣasāṃtakaḥ //
meaning:
रक्ताक्षः पिङ्गलाक्षश्चाञ्जनो दीप्तरुचिस्तथा /
सुघोरकश्च सुहनुर्विश्वको राक्षसांतकः //
text_mt: Raktākṣa, Piṅgalākṣa, Añjana, Dīptaruci, / Sughoraka, Suhanu, Viśvaka, Rākṣasāntaka,

sanskrit_iast:
viśālako dhūmrakeśo hayagrīvo ghanasvanaḥ /
meghavarṇaḥ kubhaghakarṇaḥ kṛtāntatīvratejasau //
meaning:
विशालको धूम्रकेशो हयग्रीवो घनस्वनः /
मेघवर्णः कुभघकर्णः कृतान्ततीव्रतेजसौ //
text_mt: Viśālaka, Dhūmrakeśa, Hayagrīva, Ghanasvana, / Meghavarṇa, Kumbhakarṇa, Kṛtānta, Tīvratejas,

sanskrit_iast:
agnivarṇo mahograśca tato viśvavibhūṣaṇaḥ /
vighnakṣamo mahāsenaḥ siṃhā dvātriṃśadīritāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निवर्णो महोग्रश्च ततो विश्वविभूषणः /
विघ्नक्षमो महासेनः सिंहा द्वात्रिंशदीरिताः //
text_mt: Agnivarṇa, Mahogra, then Viśvavibhūṣaṇa, / Vighnakṣama, and Mahāsena—these thirty-two lions are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbrahiḥ prārcayedvidvāṃllokapālānsahetikān /
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādheyedakhilepsitān //
meaning:
तद्ब्रहिः प्रार्चयेद्विद्वांल्लोकपालान्सहेतिकान् /
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधेयेदखिलेप्सितान् //
text_mt: Outside of that, the wise man should worship the world-guardians along with their weapons. / When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner achieves all desired things.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇaḥ pradyumnayuk śārṅgī mahāṃstataḥ /
viṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ bhṛgvīśo jalaṃ padmāsanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
विष्णः प्रद्युम्नयुक् शार्ङ्गी महांस्ततः /
विष्णुं ज्वलन्तं भृग्वीशो जलं पद्मासनं ततः //
text_mt: "Viṣṇa", joined with Pradyumna; the wielder of Śārṅga; then "the great"; / "Viṣṇu"; "the blazing"; the lord of Bhṛgu; water; then "lotus-seated";

sanskrit_iast:
haristu vāsudevāya vaikuṇṭho viṣṇusaṃyutaḥ /
gadī seṃdunṛsiṃhaṃ ca bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadvameva ca //
meaning:
हरिस्तु वासुदेवाय वैकुण्ठो विष्णुसंयुतः /
गदी सेंदुनृसिंहं च भीषणं भद्वमेव च //
text_mt: "Hari" to Vāsudeva; Vaikuṇṭha combined with Viṣṇu; / the mace-bearer; Nṛsiṃha with the moon; Bhīṣaṇa, and "bhadva";

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyumṛtyuṃ tataḥ śaurirbhānornārāyaṇānvitaḥ /
nṛharerdvāviṃśadarṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sāmrājyadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
मृत्युमृत्युं ततः शौरिर्भानोर्नारायणान्वितः /
नृहरेर्द्वाविंशदर्णो ऽयं मन्त्रः साम्राज्यदायकः //
text_mt: "death to death"; then Śauri, accompanied by the sun and Nārāyaṇa— / this twenty-two-syllable mantra of the Man-Lion is the bestower of sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā munistu gāyatrī chando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam /
devatā nṛhariścāsya sarveṣṭuphaladāyakaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा मुनिस्तु गायत्री छन्दो ऽनुष्टुबुदाहृतम् /
देवता नृहरिश्चास्य सर्वेष्टुफलदायकः //
text_mt: Brahmā is the seer; Gāyatrī and Anuṣṭubh are stated as the metre; / the deity is the Man-Lion, the giver of the fruit of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃ bījaṃ iṃ tathā śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye /
vedaiścaturbhirvasubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhiryugākṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
हं बीजं इं तथा शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
वेदैश्चतुर्भिर्वसुभिः षड्भिः षड्भिर्युगाक्षरैः //
text_mt: Haṃ is the seed-syllable, and iṃ is the power; the application is for the attainment of all [desires]. / With four, eight, six, six, and two syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāyātha mūrdhni bhāle ca netrayoḥ /
mukhabāhvaṅghrisaṃdhyagreṣvatha kukṣau tathā hṛdi //
meaning:
षडङ्गानि विधायाथ मूर्ध्नि भाले च नेत्रयोः /
मुखबाह्वङ्घ्रिसंध्यग्रेष्वथ कुक्षौ तथा हृदि //
text_mt: having performed the six limbs, then on the crown of the head, the forehead, the two eyes, / the mouth, the joints and tips of the arms and feet, then in the belly, and likewise in the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
gale pārśvadvaye pṛṣṭe kakudyarṇānmanūdbhavān /
praṇavāntaritān kṛtvā nyasetsādhakasattamaḥ //
meaning:
गले पार्श्वद्वये पृष्टे ककुद्यर्णान्मनूद्भवान् /
प्रणवान्तरितान् कृत्वा न्यसेत्साधकसत्तमः //
text_mt: in the throat, on both flanks, on the back, and on the hump, the best of practitioners / should place the syllables born of the mantra, interspersed with the praṇava [Oṃ].

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhasāṃnidhyakaro nyāso daśavidho yathā /
karāṅghṣaṣṭādyaṅgulīṣu pṛthagādyantaparvaṇoḥ //
meaning:
नृसिंहसांनिध्यकरो न्यासो दशविधो यथा /
कराङ्घ्षष्टाद्यङ्गुलीषु पृथगाद्यन्तपर्वणोः //
text_mt: As for the ten-fold ritual placement causing the presence of Nṛsiṃha: / on the thumbs and the other fingers of the hands and toes, separately on the initial and final joints,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgulīṣu vinyasyāvaśiṣṭaṃ talayornyaset /
śirolalāṭe bhrumadhye netrayoḥ karṇayostathā //
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गुलीषु विन्यस्यावशिष्टं तलयोर्न्यसेत् /
शिरोललाटे भ्रुमध्ये नेत्रयोः कर्णयोस्तथा //
text_mt: having placed [syllables] on all fingers, one should place the remainder on the palms. / On the head, forehead, between the eyebrows, on the two eyes, and on the two ears,

sanskrit_iast:
kapolakarṇamūle ca cibukorddhādharoṣṭake /
kaṇṭhe ghoṇe ca bhujayorddattanau nābhimaṇḍale //
meaning:
कपोलकर्णमूले च चिबुकोर्द्धाधरोष्टके /
कण्ठे घोणे च भुजयोर्द्दत्तनौ नाभिमण्डले //
text_mt: on the cheeks and the roots of the ears, on the chin, the upper and lower lips, / on the throat, on the nose, on the two arms, on the two breasts, and in the circle of the navel,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣānpadostale kaṭyāṃ meḍhrorvojānujaghayacoḥ /
gulphe pādakarāṅgulyoḥ sarvasandhiṣu romasu //
meaning:
दक्षान्पदोस्तले कट्यां मेढ्रोर्वोजानुजघयचोः /
गुल्फे पादकराङ्गुल्योः सर्वसन्धिषु रोमसु //
text_mt: On the right sides, the soles of the feet, the waist, the penis, the thighs, the knees, the shanks, / the ankles, the toes and fingers, all joints, the body hair,

sanskrit_iast:
raktāsthimajjāsu tanau nyasedvarṇānvi cakṣaṇaḥ /
varṇānpade gulphajānukaṭinābhihṛdi sthale //
meaning:
रक्तास्थिमज्जासु तनौ न्यसेद्वर्णान्वि चक्षणः /
वर्णान्पदे गुल्फजानुकटिनाभिहृदि स्थले //
text_mt: the blood, bones, and marrow, the wise person should place the syllables on the body. / [Then] the syllables on the foot, ankle, knee, waist, navel, heart-region,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvoḥ kaṇṭhe ca cibuke cauṣṭau gaṇḍe pravinyaset /
karṇayorvadane nāsāpuṭe netre ca mūrddhani //
meaning:
बाह्वोः कण्ठे च चिबुके चौष्टौ गण्डे प्रविन्यसेत् /
कर्णयोर्वदने नासापुटे नेत्रे च मूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: arms, throat, chin, lips, cheeks, / ears, mouth, nostrils, eyes, and head.

sanskrit_iast:
padāni tu mukhe mūrdhri nasi cakṣuṣi karṇayoḥ /
āsye ca hṛdaya nābhau pādānsarvāṅgakenyaset //
meaning:
पदानि तु मुखे मूर्ध्रि नसि चक्षुषि कर्णयोः /
आस्ये च हृदय नाभौ पादान्सर्वाङ्गकेन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Then [he should place] the words on the mouth, head, nose, eyes, ears, / face, heart, navel, and place the feet on all limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhadvayaṃ nyasenmūrdhni āhṛtpādāttadaṅgakam /
ugrādīni padānī ha mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham //
meaning:
अर्द्धद्वयं न्यसेन्मूर्ध्नि आहृत्पादात्तदङ्गकम् /
उग्रादीनि पदानी ह मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम् //
text_mt: He should place the two halves on the head, [and] the limb from the heart to the feet. / The words beginning with ‘ugra’ here, ending with ‘mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmy aham’—

sanskrit_iast:
ityantānyāsyakaghnāṇacakṣuḥśrotreṣupakṣmasu /
hṛdi nābhau ca kaṭyādipādāntaṃ navasu nyaset //
meaning:
इत्यन्तान्यास्यकघ्नाणचक्षुःश्रोत्रेषुपक्ष्मसु /
हृदि नाभौ च कट्यादिपादान्तं नवसु न्यसेत् //
text_mt: he should place these ending words in nine places: the mouth, nose, eyes, ears, eyelashes, / heart, navel, and from the waist down to the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrādyānapi tānyeva yathāpūrvaṃ pravinyaset /
nṛsiṃhādyāni tānyeva pūrvavadvinyasetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
वीराद्यानपि तान्येव यथापूर्वं प्रविन्यसेत् /
नृसिंहाद्यानि तान्येव पूर्ववद्विन्यसेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: He should likewise place those very [words] beginning with ‘vīra’ as before; / the wise man should place those very [words] beginning with ‘nṛsiṃha’ as previously.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāgnivedaṣaḍrāmanetradigbāhubhūmitān /
vibhaktā pantravarṇāṃśca kramātsthāneṣu vinyaset //
meaning:
चन्द्राग्निवेदषड्रामनेत्रदिग्बाहुभूमितान् /
विभक्ता पन्त्रवर्णांश्च क्रमात्स्थानेषु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Numbered by one, three, four, six, three, two, ten, two, and one, / the divided mantra-syllables should be placed in order in their proper locations:

sanskrit_iast:
mūle mūlācca nābhyantaṃ nābhyādihṛdayāvadhi /
hṛdayādbhrūyugāntaṃ tu netratraye ca mastake //
meaning:
मूले मूलाच्च नाभ्यन्तं नाभ्यादिहृदयावधि /
हृदयाद्भ्रूयुगान्तं तु नेत्रत्रये च मस्तके //
text_mt: At the base, from the base to the navel, from the navel up to the heart, / from the heart to the pair of eyebrows, on the three eyes, and on the head,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvoraṅguliṣu prāṇemūrddhādi caraṇāvadhi /
vinyasennāmato dhīmānharinyāso 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
बाह्वोरङ्गुलिषु प्राणेमूर्द्धादि चरणावधि /
विन्यसेन्नामतो धीमान्हरिन्यासो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: on the arms, fingers, vital breath, [and] from the head to the feet, / the wise man should place [them] by name; this is declared the Harinyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsasyāsya tu māhātmyaṃ jānātyeko hariḥ svayam /
evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā dhyāyecca nṛhariṃ hṛdi //
meaning:
न्यासस्यास्य तु माहात्म्यं जानात्येको हरिः स्वयम् /
एवं न्यासविधिं कृत्वा ध्यायेच्च नृहरिं हृदि //
text_mt: Hari himself alone knows the eulogy of greatness of this ritual placement. / Having thus performed the rite of ritual placement, he should meditate on Nṛhari in his heart:

sanskrit_iast:
galāsaktalasadbāhuspṛṣṭakeśo 'bjacakradhṛk /
nakhāgrabhinnadaityeśo jvālāmālāsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
गलासक्तलसद्बाहुस्पृष्टकेशो ऽब्जचक्रधृक् /
नखाग्रभिन्नदैत्येशो ज्वालामालासमन्वितः //
text_mt: His gleaming arms clinging to the neck, his hair touched [there], holding a lotus and a discus, / ripping open the lord of Daityas with the tips of his claws, accompanied by garlands of flames,

sanskrit_iast:
dīptajihvastrinayano daṃṣṭrograṃ vadanaṃ vahan /
nṛsiṃho 'smānsadā pātusthalāṃbugaganopagaḥ //
meaning:
दीप्तजिह्वस्त्रिनयनो दंष्ट्रोग्रं वदनं वहन् /
नृसिंहो ऽस्मान्सदा पातुस्थलांबुगगनोपगः //
text_mt: with a flaming tongue, three-eyed, bearing a face fierce with fangs— / may Nṛsiṃha, moving through earth, water, and sky, always protect us!

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ darśayenmudrāṃ nṛsiṃhasya mahātmanaḥ /
jānumadhyagatau kṛtvā cibukoṣṭau samāvubhau //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं दर्शयेन्मुद्रां नृसिंहस्य महात्मनः /
जानुमध्यगतौ कृत्वा चिबुकोष्टौ समावुभौ //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, he should display the mudrā of the great-souled Nṛsiṃha: / Having brought [both hands] between the knees, with both chin and lips even,

sanskrit_iast:
hastau ca bhūmisaṃlagnau kaṃpamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ /
mukhaṃ vijṛṃbhitaṃ kṛtvā lelihānāṃ ca jihvikām //
meaning:
हस्तौ च भूमिसंलग्नौ कंपमानः पुनः पुनः /
मुखं विजृंभितं कृत्वा लेलिहानां च जिह्विकाम् //
text_mt: with hands placed on the ground, trembling repeatedly, / opening the mouth wide, and darting the tongue out,

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā mudrā nārasiṃhī pradhāneti prakīrtitā /
vāmasyāṅguṣṭato baddhvākaniṣṭāmaṅgalītrayam //
meaning:
एषा मुद्रा नारसिंही प्रधानेति प्रकीर्तिता /
वामस्याङ्गुष्टतो बद्ध्वाकनिष्टामङ्गलीत्रयम् //
text_mt: this is proclaimed the primary Nārasiṃhī mudrā. / Binding the little finger with the thumb of the left hand, [and raising] the three fingers

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlavat saṃmukhorddhve kuryānmudrāṃ nṛsiṃhagām /
aṅguṣṭābhyāṃ ca karayostathā'kramya kaniṣṭake //
meaning:
त्रिशूलवत् संमुखोर्द्ध्वे कुर्यान्मुद्रां नृसिंहगाम् /
अङ्गुष्टाभ्यां च करयोस्तथाऽक्रम्य कनिष्टके //
text_mt: upright facing forward like a trident, he should make the mudrā pertaining to Nṛsiṃha. / Then pressing down the little fingers with the thumbs of both hands,

sanskrit_iast:
adhomukhābhiḥ śiṣṭābhiḥ śeṣābhirnṛharau tataḥ /
hastāvadhomukhau kṛtvā nābhideśe prasārya ca //
meaning:
अधोमुखाभिः शिष्टाभिः शेषाभिर्नृहरौ ततः /
हस्तावधोमुखौ कृत्वा नाभिदेशे प्रसार्य च //
text_mt: with the remaining fingers turned downwards, in Nṛhari; then / turning the hands downwards and extending them at the region of the navel,

sanskrit_iast:
tarjaṃnībhyāṃ nayetskandhau proktā cāntraṇamudrikā /
hastāvūrddhvamukhau kṛtvā tale saṃyojya madhyame //
meaning:
तर्जंनीभ्यां नयेत्स्कन्धौ प्रोक्ता चान्त्रणमुद्रिका /
हस्तावूर्द्ध्वमुखौ कृत्वा तले संयोज्य मध्यमे //
text_mt: he should lead [them] to the shoulders with the forefingers; this is called the mudrā of the entrails. / Turning the hands face upwards and joining the middle fingers at the palms,

sanskrit_iast:
anāmāyāṃ tu vāmāyāṃ tuvāmāyāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tu vinikṣipet /
tarjanyau pṛṣṭato lagnau aṅguṣṭau tarjanīśritau //
meaning:
अनामायां तु वामायां तुवामायां दक्षिणां तु विनिक्षिपेत् /
तर्जन्यौ पृष्टतो लग्नौ अङ्गुष्टौ तर्जनीश्रितौ //
text_mt: he should cast the right [ring finger] into the left ring finger, / the two forefingers touching the back, the thumbs resting on the forefingers.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramudrābhavedeṣā nṛhareḥ saṃnidhau matā /
cakramudrā tathā kṛtvā tarjanībhyāṃ tu madhyame //
meaning:
चक्रमुद्राभवेदेषा नृहरेः संनिधौ मता /
चक्रमुद्रा तथा कृत्वा तर्जनीभ्यां तु मध्यमे //
text_mt: This is known as the cakra-mudrā in the presence of Nṛhari. / Having formed the cakra-mudrā in this way, he should press the middle fingers with the forefingers;

sanskrit_iast:
pīḍayedvaṃṣṭramudraiṣā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī /
etā mudrā nṛsiṃhasya sarvamantreṣu saṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
पीडयेद्वंष्ट्रमुद्रैषा सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी /
एता मुद्रा नृसिंहस्य सर्वमन्त्रेषु संमताः //
text_mt: this is the daṃṣṭra-mudrā, which destroys all sins. / These mudrās of Nṛsiṃha are approved in all mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ca pāyasaiḥ /
ghaṛtāktarjuhuyādvahnau pīṭhe pūrvoditer'cayet //
meaning:
वर्णलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तद्दशांशं च पायसैः /
घऋताक्तर्जुहुयाद्वह्नौ पीठे पूर्वोदितेर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: He should recite the mantra a hundred thousand times per syllable, and offer a tenth of that in the fire / with milk-rice mixed with ghee; he should worship on the previously described ritual seat.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgānyādau samārādhya dikpatreṣu yajetpunaḥṛ /
garaḍādīn śrīmukhāṃśca vidikṣu lokapānbahiḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गान्यादौ समाराध्य दिक्पत्रेषु यजेत्पुनःऋ /
गरडादीन् श्रीमुखांश्च विदिक्षु लोकपान्बहिः //
text_mt: Having first worshipped the limbs, he should then worship on the directional petals / Garuḍa and the others, and the divine faces, and on the intermediate directions the guardians of the world outside.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ sarvānkāmānprapūrayet /
saumye kārye smaretsaumyaṃ krūraṃ krūre smaredbudhaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संसाधितो मन्त्रः सर्वान्कामान्प्रपूरयेत् /
सौम्ये कार्ये स्मरेत्सौम्यं क्रूरं क्रूरे स्मरेद्बुधः //
text_mt: A mantra thus mastered fulfills all desires. / In a peaceful rite, the wise person should contemplate a peaceful [form]; in a fierce [rite], he should contemplate a fierce [form].

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamṛtyupade śatrornāma kṛtvā svayaṃ hariḥ /
niśitairnakhadaṃṣṭrāgraiḥ khādyamānaṃ ca saṃsmaret //
meaning:
पूर्वमृत्युपदे शत्रोर्नाम कृत्वा स्वयं हरिः /
निशितैर्नखदंष्ट्राग्रैः खाद्यमानं च संस्मरेत् //
text_mt: Placing the name of the enemy in the place of the earlier word 'mṛtyu', he should contemplate / the enemy being eaten by Hari himself with the sharp tips of his claws and fangs.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ japenmantramatandritaḥ /
jāyate maṇḍalādarvāk śatrurvai śamanātithiḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं नित्यं जपेन्मन्त्रमतन्द्रितः /
जायते मण्डलादर्वाक् शत्रुर्वै शमनातिथिः //
text_mt: Unwearied, he should recite the mantra one hundred and eight times daily; / within forty-eight days, the enemy indeed becomes a guest of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānabhedānatho vakṣye sarvasiddhipradāyakān /
śrīkāmaḥ satataṃ dhyāyetpūrvoktaṃ nṛhariṃ sitam //
meaning:
ध्यानभेदानथो वक्ष्ये सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकान् /
श्रीकामः सततं ध्यायेत्पूर्वोक्तं नृहरिं सितम् //
text_mt: Now I shall speak of the varieties of meditation that bestow all accomplishments. / One desiring prosperity should constantly meditate on the previously described white Nṛhari,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṅkasthitayā lakṣmyāliṅgataṃ padmahastayā /
viṣamṛtyūparogādisarvopadravanāśanam //
meaning:
वामाङ्कस्थितया लक्ष्म्यालिङ्गतं पद्महस्तया /
विषमृत्यूपरोगादिसर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् //
text_mt: embraced by Lakṣmī, who is seated on his left lap and holds a lotus in her hand, / destroying poison, untimely death, diseases, and all afflictions.

sanskrit_iast:
narasiṃhaṃ mahābhīmaṃ kālānala samaprabham /
āntramālādharaṃ raudraṃ kaṇṭhahāreṇa bhūṣitam //
meaning:
नरसिंहं महाभीमं कालानल समप्रभम् /
आन्त्रमालाधरं रौद्रं कण्ठहारेण भूषितम् //
text_mt: Narasimha, exceedingly terrible, possessing the brilliance of the fire of cosmic dissolution, / wearing a garland of entrails, fierce, adorned with a necklace around the throat,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca pañcānanasuśobhitam /
candramauliṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prativaktraṃ trinetrakam //
meaning:
नागयज्ञोपवीतं च पञ्चाननसुशोभितम् /
चन्द्रमौलिं नीलकण्ठं प्रतिवक्त्रं त्रिनेत्रकम् //
text_mt: with a serpent as his sacred thread, beautifully adorned with five faces, / with the crescent moon on his diadem, blue-throated, three-eyed on every face,

sanskrit_iast:
bhujaiḥ parighasaṃkāśairddaśabhiścopaśobhitam /
akṣasūtraṃ gadāpadmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ gokṣīrasannibham //
meaning:
भुजैः परिघसंकाशैर्द्दशभिश्चोपशोभितम् /
अक्षसूत्रं गदापद्मं शङ्खं गोक्षीरसन्निभम् //
text_mt: adorned with ten arms resembling iron bludgeons, / holding a rosary, a mace, a lotus, a conch resembling cow's milk,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuśca muśalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇaṃ cakrasuttamam /
khaḍgaṃ śūlaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca nṛhariṃ rudrarūpiṇam //
meaning:
धनुश्च मुशलं चैव बिभ्राणं चक्रसुत्तमम् /
खड्गं शूलं च बाणं च नृहरिं रुद्ररूपिणम् //
text_mt: a bow, a pestle, the excellent discus, / a sword, a trident, and an arrow—Nṛhari having the form of Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
indragopābhanīlābhaṃ candrābhaṃ svarṇasannibham /
pūrvādi cottaraṃ yāvadūddhvārsyaṃ sarvavarṇakam //
meaning:
इन्द्रगोपाभनीलाभं चन्द्राभं स्वर्णसन्निभम् /
पूर्वादि चोत्तरं यावदूद्ध्वार्स्यं सर्ववर्णकम् //
text_mt: resembling an indragopa insect, dark blue, moon-like, golden-hued, / from east to north, with the upward face containing all colors.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sarvavyādhivimuktaye /
sarvamṛtyuharaṃ divya smaraṇātsarvasiddhidam //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेन्मन्त्री सर्वव्याधिविमुक्तये /
सर्वमृत्युहरं दिव्य स्मरणात्सर्वसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, the practitioner of mantras should recite [it] for deliverance from all diseases; / it removes all death, is divine, and by remembrance bestows all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedyadā mahātkarma tadā ṣoḍaśahastavān /
nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायेद्यदा महात्कर्म तदा षोडशहस्तवान् /
नृसिंहः सर्वलोकेशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः //
text_mt: When performing a great deed, he should meditate on Nṛsiṃha with sixteen hands, / the lord of all the worlds, adorned with all ornaments:

sanskrit_iast:
dvau vidāraṇakarmāptau dvau cāntroddharaṇānvitau /
śaṅkhacacakradharau dvau tu dvau ca bāṇaghanurddharau //
meaning:
द्वौ विदारणकर्माप्तौ द्वौ चान्त्रोद्धरणान्वितौ /
शङ्खचचक्रधरौ द्वौ तु द्वौ च बाणघनुर्द्धरौ //
text_mt: Two engaged in the act of tearing open, two occupied with drawing out the entrails, / two holding a conch and a discus, and two holding an arrow and a bow,

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgakheṭadharau dvau ca dvau gadāpadmadhāriṇau /
pāśāṅkuśadharau dvau ca dvau ripormukuṭārpitau //
meaning:
खड्गखेटधरौ द्वौ च द्वौ गदापद्मधारिणौ /
पाशाङ्कुशधरौ द्वौ च द्वौ रिपोर्मुकुटार्पितौ //
text_mt: two holding a sword and a shield, two holding a mace and a lotus, / two holding a noose and a goad, and two placed upon the crown of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
iti ṣoḍaśadordaṇḍamaṇḍitaṃ nṛhariṃ vibhum /
dhyāyennārada nīlābhamugrakarmamaṇyananyadhīḥ //
meaning:
इति षोडशदोर्दण्डमण्डितं नृहरिं विभुम् /
ध्यायेन्नारद नीलाभमुग्रकर्ममण्यनन्यधीः //
text_mt: Thus, with a mind focused on nothing else, in a fierce rite, O Nārada, / one should meditate on the all-pervading Nṛhari adorned with sixteen arm-staffs, having a dark-blue hue.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyeyo mahatame kārye dvātriṃśaddhastavānbudhaiḥ /
nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvabhūteśaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
ध्येयो महतमे कार्ये द्वात्रिंशद्धस्तवान्बुधैः /
नृसिंहः सर्वभूतेशः सर्वसिद्धिकरः परः //
text_mt: In the greatest undertaking, the wise should meditate on thirty-two-armed / Nṛsiṃha, the supreme lord of all beings, who brings about all accomplishments:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe cakrapadme ca paraśuṃpāśameva ca /
halaṃ ca muśalaṃ caiva abhayaṃ cāṅkuśaṃ tathā //
meaning:
दक्षिणे चक्रपद्मे च परशुंपाशमेव च /
हलं च मुशलं चैव अभयं चाङ्कुशं तथा //
text_mt: On the right side, with hands [holding] a discus and a lotus, an axe and a noose, / a plow and a pestle, the gesture of fearlessness and a goad,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭṭiśaṃ bhindipālaṃ ca khaḍgamudgaratomarān /
vāmabhāge karaiḥ śaṃṅkhaṃ kheṭaṃ pāśaṃ ca śūlakam //
meaning:
पट्टिशं भिन्दिपालं च खड्गमुद्गरतोमरान् /
वामभागे करैः शंङ्खं खेटं पाशं च शूलकम् //
text_mt: a paṭṭiśa spear, a bhindipāla javelin, a sword, a club, and javelins; / on the left side, with hands [holding] a conch, a shield, a noose, a small spear,

sanskrit_iast:
agniṃ ca varadaṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ca tataḥ param /
kārmukaṃ tarjanīmudrāṃ gadāṃ ḍamaruśūrpakau //
meaning:
अग्निं च वरदं शक्तिं कुण्डिकां च ततः परम् /
कार्मुकं तर्जनीमुद्रां गदां डमरुशूर्पकौ //
text_mt: fire, the gesture of boon-giving, a spear, a water-pot, and thereafter / a bow, the pointing-finger mudrā, a mace, a small drum, and a winnowing basket;

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ ca riporjānumastakapīḍanam /
ūrddhvīkṛtābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ āntramālādharaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
द्वाभ्यां कराभ्यां च रिपोर्जानुमस्तकपीडनम् /
ऊर्द्ध्वीकृताभ्यां बाहुभ्यां आन्त्रमालाधरं विभुम् //
text_mt: with two hands crushing the enemy's knees and head, / with two arms raised upwards, the all-pervading lord wearing a garland of entrails,

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ sthitābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ hiraṇyakavidāraṇam /
priyaṅkaraṃ ca bhaktānāṃ daityānāṃ ca bhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
अधः स्थिताभ्यां बाहुभ्यां हिरण्यकविदारणम् /
प्रियङ्करं च भक्तानां दैत्यानां च भयङ्करम् //
text_mt: with two arms situated below tearing apart Hiraṇyakaśipu, / bringing delight to devotees and terrifying the Daityas—

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsihaṃ taṃ smareditthaṃ mahāmṛtyubhayāpaham /
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sarvakāryārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
नृसिहं तं स्मरेदित्थं महामृत्युभयापहम् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेन्मन्त्री सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: thus should he remember that Nṛsiṃha, who dispels the fear of great death. / Having meditated thus, the practitioner of mantras should recite [it] for the accomplishment of all goals and undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
athocyate dhyānamanyanmukharogaharaṃ śubham /
svarṇavarṇasuparṇasthaṃ vidyunmālāsaṭānvitam //
meaning:
अथोच्यते ध्यानमन्यन्मुखरोगहरं शुभम् /
स्वर्णवर्णसुपर्णस्थं विद्युन्मालासटान्वितम् //
text_mt: Now another auspicious meditation is described, which dispels diseases of the mouth: / [meditate on him] seated upon the golden-hued Garuda, endowed with a mane like a garland of lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭipūrṇenduvarṇaṃ ca sumukhaṃ tryakṣivīkṣaṇam /
pītavastrorubhūṣāḍhyaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ śāntavigraham /
cakraśaṅkhābhayavarāndadhataṃ karapallavaiḥ //
meaning:
कोटिपूर्णेन्दुवर्णं च सुमुखं त्र्यक्षिवीक्षणम् /
पीतवस्त्रोरुभूषाढ्यं नृसिंहं शान्तविग्रहम् /
चक्रशङ्खाभयवरान्दधतं करपल्लवैः //
text_mt: radiant like ten million full moons, handsome-faced, gazing with three eyes, / adorned with yellow garments and magnificent ornaments, Nṛsiṃha of peaceful form, / bearing the discus, conch, gesture of fearlessness, and boon-granting gesture with his shoot-like hands.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣveḍarogādiśamanaṃ svairdhyānaiḥ sukhanditam /
śatroḥ senānirodhena yatnaṃ kuryāñca sādhakam //
meaning:
क्ष्वेडरोगादिशमनं स्वैर्ध्यानैः सुखन्दितम् /
शत्रोः सेनानिरोधेन यत्नं कुर्याञ्च साधकम् //
text_mt: By one’s own meditations, the quelling of poisons, diseases, and the like is happily accomplished. / The practitioner should make an effort toward blocking the army of the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣakāṣṭairedhite 'gnau vicintya ripumardanam /
devaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃpūjya kusumādyupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
अक्षकाष्टैरेधिते ऽग्नौ विचिन्त्य रिपुमर्दनम् /
देवं नृसिंहं संपूज्य कुसुमाद्युपचारकैः //
