text_mt: In a fire kindled with akṣa wood, contemplating the crusher of foes, / having worshipped the god Nṛsiṃha with offerings of flowers and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
samūlamūlairjuṃhuyāccarairdaśaśataṃ pṛthak /
ripuṃ khādanniva japennirdahanniva taṃ kṣipet //
meaning:
समूलमूलैर्जुंहुयाच्चरैर्दशशतं पृथक् /
रिपुं खादन्निव जपेन्निर्दहन्निव तं क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: he should offer into the fire ten hundred [oblations] separately of whole roots with their sprouts. / As though devouring the enemy, he should recite; as though burning him up, he should cast [the oblations].

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā saptadinaṃ mantrī senāmiṣṭāṃ mahīpateḥ /
prasthāpayecchubhe lagne pararāṣṭrajayecchayā //
meaning:
हुत्वा सप्तदिनं मन्त्री सेनामिष्टां महीपतेः /
प्रस्थापयेच्छुभे लग्ने परराष्ट्रजयेच्छया //
text_mt: Having offered oblations for seven days, the mantra-practitioner, desiring to conquer foreign kingdoms, / should dispatch the king's favored army at an auspicious astrological moment.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ purastānnṛhariṃ nighnantaṃ ripumaṇḍalam /
smṛtvā japaṃ praklarvīta yāvadāyāti sā punaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः पुरस्तान्नृहरिं निघ्नन्तं रिपुमण्डलम् /
स्मृत्वा जपं प्रक्लर्वीत यावदायाति सा पुनः //
text_mt:
Visualizing Nṛhari in front of it slaying the enemy army,
he should perform recitation as long as that [army] returns again.

sanskrit_iast:
nirjatya nikhilāñchatrūnsaha vīraśriyāsukhāt /
prīṇayenmantriṇaṃ rājā vibhavaiḥ prītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
निर्जत्य निखिलाञ्छत्रून्सह वीरश्रियासुखात् /
प्रीणयेन्मन्त्रिणं राजा विभवैः प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: Having vanquished all enemies with ease along with heroic glory, / the king, with a delighted mind, should gratify the mantra-practitioner with riches,

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśvaratharatnaiśca grāmakṣetradhanādibhiḥ /
yadi mantrī na tuṣyeta tadānartho mahīpateḥ //
meaning:
गजाश्वरथरत्नैश्च ग्रामक्षेत्रधनादिभिः /
यदि मन्त्री न तुष्येत तदानर्थो महीपतेः //
text_mt: with elephants, horses, chariots, and jewels, and with villages, fields, wealth, and the like. / If the mantra-practitioner is not satisfied, then disaster for the king

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate tasya rāṣṭreṣu prāṇebhyo 'pi mahābhayam /
aṣṭottaraśatamūlamantramantritabhasmanā //
meaning:
जायते तस्य राष्ट्रेषु प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि महाभयम् /
अष्टोत्तरशतमूलमन्त्रमन्त्रितभस्मना //
text_mt: arises in his realms, even great danger to his life. / With ash consecrated by reciting the root mantra one hundred and eight times,

sanskrit_iast:
nāśayenmūṣikālūtāvṛścikādyutthitaṃ viṣam /
liptāṅgaḥ sarvarogaiśca mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
नाशयेन्मूषिकालूतावृश्चिकाद्युत्थितं विषम् /
लिप्ताङ्गः सर्वरोगैश्च मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: one should destroy the poison arising from rats, spiders, scorpions, and the like; / and one whose limbs are smeared [with it] is freed from all diseases, there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
sevantīkusumairhutvā mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt /
audumbarasamidbhistu bhaveddhānyasamṛddhimān //
meaning:
सेवन्तीकुसुमैर्हुत्वा महतीं श्रियमाप्नुयात् /
औदुम्बरसमिद्भिस्तु भवेद्धान्यसमृद्धिमान् //
text_mt: By offering oblations of sevantī flowers, one obtains great fortune; / but by firewood of the udumbara tree, one becomes abundant in grain.

sanskrit_iast:
apūpalakṣahome tu bhavedvaiśravaṇopamaḥ /
kruddhasya sannidhau rājño japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
अपूपलक्षहोमे तु भवेद्वैश्रवणोपमः /
क्रुद्धस्य सन्निधौ राज्ञो जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् //
text_mt: With an oblation of a hundred thousand sweet cakes, one becomes equal to Kubera. / In the presence of an angry king, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times;

sanskrit_iast:
sadyo nairmalyamāpnoti prasādaṃ cādhigacchati /
kundaprasūnairudayaṃ mocābhirvighnanāśanam //
meaning:
सद्यो नैर्मल्यमाप्नोति प्रसादं चाधिगच्छति /
कुन्दप्रसूनैरुदयं मोचाभिर्विघ्ननाशनम् //
text_mt: he immediately attains clarity and receives his favor. / With kunda flowers [one attains] prosperity; with plantains, the destruction of obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīpatrahomena mahatīṃ kīrtimāpnuyāt /
śālyutthasaktuhomena vaśayedakhilaṃ jagat //
meaning:
तुलसीपत्रहोमेन महतीं कीर्तिमाप्नुयात् /
शाल्युत्थसक्तुहोमेन वशयेदखिलं जगत् //
text_mt: By offering oblations of tulasī leaves, one obtains great fame; / by offering oblations of flour made from winter rice, one subjugates the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
madhūkapuṣpairiṣṭaṃ syātstaṃbhanaṃ dhātrikhaṇḍakaiḥ /
dadhimadhvājyamiśrāṃ tu guḍūcīṃ caturaṅgulām //
meaning:
मधूकपुष्पैरिष्टं स्यात्स्तंभनं धात्रिखण्डकैः /
दधिमध्वाज्यमिश्रां तु गुडूचीं चतुरङ्गुलाम् //
text_mt: With madhūka flowers whatever is desired is gained; immobilization is achieved with pieces of emblic myrobalan. / One who offers oblations of guḍūcī measuring four finger-widths,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyā dayutaṃ yo 'sau śataṃ jīvati rogajit /
śanaiścaradine 'śvatthaṃ spṛṣṭvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
जुहुया दयुतं यो ऽसौ शतं जीवति रोगजित् /
शनैश्चरदिने ऽश्वत्थं स्पृष्ट्वा चाष्टोत्तरं शतम् //
text_mt: mixed with yogurt, honey, and clarified butter, ten thousand times, conquers disease and lives for a hundred [years]. / Touching an aśvattha tree on a Saturday and [reciting the mantra] one hundred and eight times,

sanskrit_iast:
japejjitvāso 'pamṛtyuṃ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati /
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi yantraṃ trailokyamohanam //
meaning:
जपेज्जित्वासो ऽपमृत्युं शतवर्षाणि जीवति /
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि यन्त्रं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् //
text_mt: one should recite: having overcome untimely death, he lives for a hundred years. / Now I shall fully explain to you the yantra that enchants the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya saṃdhāraṇādeva bhaveyuḥsarvasaṃpadaḥ /
śvetabhūrjje likhetpadmaṃ dvātriṃśatsiṃhasaṃyutam //
meaning:
यस्य संधारणादेव भवेयुःसर्वसंपदः /
श्वेतभूर्ज्जे लिखेत्पद्मं द्वात्रिंशत्सिंहसंयुतम् //
text_mt: by the mere wearing of which all fortunes come to be. / On white birch-bark, one should draw a lotus furnished with thirty-two lions.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye siṃhe svabījaṃ ca likhetpūrvavadeva tu /
śrībījena tu tusaṃvedya valayatrayasaṃyutam //
meaning:
मध्ये सिंहे स्वबीजं च लिखेत्पूर्ववदेव तु /
श्रीबीजेन तु तुसंवेद्य वलयत्रयसंयुतम् //
text_mt: In the middle of the lion, one should write its own seed-syllable, just as before; / and encircled by the śrī-bīja, endowed with three concentric rings,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśaiśca saṃveṣṭya pūjayedyantramuttamam /
trailokyamohanaṃ nāma sarvakāmārthasādhanam //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशैश्च संवेष्ट्य पूजयेद्यन्त्रमुत्तमम् /
त्रैलोक्यमोहनं नाम सर्वकामार्थसाधनम् //
text_mt: and enclosed by nooses and goads, one should worship the supreme yantra, / named Trailokyamohana, which accomplishes all desires and ends.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrarājaṃ mahārājaṃ sarvacarkeśvareśvaram /
dhāraṇājjayamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
चक्रराजं महाराजं सर्वचर्केश्वरेश्वरम् /
धारणाज्जयमाप्नोति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः //
text_mt: It is the king of wheels, the great king, the sovereign of all lords of wheels. / From wearing it, one attains victory; it is true, it is true, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
atha yantrāntaraṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada siddhidam /
aṣṭāraṃ vilikhedyantraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karṇikayā yutam //
meaning:
अथ यन्त्रान्तरं वक्ष्ये शृणु नारद सिद्धिदम् /
अष्टारं विलिखेद्यन्त्रं श्लक्ष्णं कर्णिकया युतम् //
text_mt: Now I shall state another yantra, listen, O Nārada, which bestows accomplishment. / One should draw an eight-spoked, smooth yantra furnished with a pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantraṃ likhettatra praṇavena samanvitam /
ekākṣaraṃ nārasiṃhaṃ madhye caiva sasādhyakam //
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रं लिखेत्तत्र प्रणवेन समन्वितम् /
एकाक्षरं नारसिंहं मध्ये चैव ससाध्यकम् //
text_mt: There one should write the root mantra accompanied by the praṇava, / and in the middle the single-syllabled Nārasiṃha together with the name of the one to be affected.

sanskrit_iast:
japedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu sūtreṇāveṣṭya tadbahiḥ /
svarṇaraupyasutāmraiśca veṣṭayetkramataḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
जपेदष्टसहस्रं तु सूत्रेणावेष्ट्य तद्बहिः /
स्वर्णरौप्यसुताम्रैश्च वेष्टयेत्क्रमतः सुधीः //
text_mt: One should recite it eight thousand times, having wrapped it outside with thread; / and the wise one should encase it in sequence with gold, silver, and good copper.

sanskrit_iast:
lākṣayā veṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punarmantreṇa mantrayet /
kaṇṭhe bhuje śikhāyāṃ vā dhārayedyantramuttamam //
meaning:
लाक्षया वेष्टितं कृत्वा पुनर्मन्त्रेण मन्त्रयेत् /
कण्ठे भुजे शिखायां वा धारयेद्यन्त्रमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having wrapped it with lac, one should consecrate it again with the mantra. / One should wear the excellent yantra on the neck, on the arm, or in the topknot.

sanskrit_iast:
naranārīnaredrāśca sarve syurvaśagā bhuvi /
duṣṭāstaṃ naiva bādhante piśācoragarākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
नरनारीनरेद्राश्च सर्वे स्युर्वशगा भुवि /
दुष्टास्तं नैव बाधन्ते पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः //
text_mt: Men, women, and rulers of men on earth will all become subservient [to him]; / wicked piśācas, serpents, and rākṣasas will never harm him.

sanskrit_iast:
yantrarājaprasādena sarvatra jayamāpnuyāt /
athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi yantraṃ sarvavaśaṅkaram //
meaning:
यन्त्रराजप्रसादेन सर्वत्र जयमाप्नुयात् /
अथान्यत्संप्रवक्ष्यामि यन्त्रं सर्ववशङ्करम् //
text_mt: By the grace of the king of yantras, he attains victory everywhere. / Now I shall describe another yantra, which subjugates all.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāraṃ mahācakraṃ pūrvavadvilikhetsudhīḥ /
mātrādvādaśasaṃbhinnadalena vilikhedrudhaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशारं महाचक्रं पूर्ववद्विलिखेत्सुधीः /
मात्राद्वादशसंभिन्नदलेन विलिखेद्रुधः //
text_mt: The wise one should draw the great twelve-spoked wheel as before; / the intelligent one should draw it with petals separated into twelve measures.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye mantraṃ śaktiyuktaṃ śrībījena tu veṣṭayeta /
kālāntakaṃ nāma cakraṃ surāsukhaśaṅkaram //
meaning:
मध्ये मन्त्रं शक्तियुक्तं श्रीबीजेन तु वेष्टयेत /
कालान्तकं नाम चक्रं सुरासुखशङ्करम् //
text_mt: In the center, one should surround the mantra, endowed with śakti, with the śrī-bīja; / it is the wheel named Kālāntaka, which bestows happiness upon the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramullekhayedbhūrje sarvaśatrunivāraṇam /
yasya dhāraṇamātreṇa sarvatra vijayī bhavet //
meaning:
चक्रमुल्लेखयेद्भूर्जे सर्वशत्रुनिवारणम् /
यस्य धारणमात्रेण सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् //
text_mt: One should inscribe on birch-bark the wheel that wards off all enemies, / by the mere wearing of which one becomes victorious everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sarveṣṭadaṃ jvālāmālisaṃjñaṃ vadāmyaham /
bījaṃ hṛdbhagavānṅeṃto narasiṃhāya tatparam //
meaning:
अथ सर्वेष्टदं ज्वालामालिसंज्ञं वदाम्यहम् /
बीजं हृद्भगवान्ङेंतो नरसिंहाय तत्परम् //
text_mt: Now I shall declare the all-desire-granting [mantra] named Jvālāmālin: / The bīja, the heart [namaḥ], bhagavate, followed by narasiṃhāya,

sanskrit_iast:
jvāline māline dīptadaṃṣṭrāya agnine padam /
trāya sarvādirakṣoghnāya ca naḥ sarvabhūpadam //
meaning:
ज्वालिने मालिने दीप्तदंष्ट्राय अग्निने पदम् /
त्राय सर्वादिरक्षोघ्नाय च नः सर्वभूपदम् //
text_mt: jvāline, māline, dīptadaṃṣṭrāya, the word agninetrāya, / sarvarakṣoghnāya, and sarvabhūtapradahanāya,

sanskrit_iast:
harirvināśanāyānte sarvajvaravināśanaḥ /
nāmānte dahayugmaṃ ca pacadvayamudīrayet //
meaning:
हरिर्विनाशनायान्ते सर्वज्वरविनाशनः /
नामान्ते दहयुग्मं च पचद्वयमुदीरयेत् //
text_mt: and ended by [sarva]harivināśanāya, sarvajvaravināśanāya; / after the name, one should utter a pair of dahas and a pair of pacas,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣayugmaṃ ca varmāstraṭhadūyānto dhruvādikaḥ /
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ prokto jvālāmālī manūttamaḥ //
meaning:
रक्षयुग्मं च वर्मास्त्रठदूयान्तो ध्रुवादिकः /
अष्टषष्ट्यक्षरैः प्रोक्तो ज्वालामाली मनूत्तमः //
text_mt: a pair of rakṣas, the armor [huṃ], the weapon [phaṭ], and ending with the pair of ṭhas [svāhā], beginning with the syllable oṃ. / Formed of sixty-eight syllables, the supreme Jvālāmālī mantra is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyādikaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ trayodaśabhirakṣaraiḥ /
paṅktibhī rudrāsaṃkhyākairaṣṭādaśabhirakṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यादिकं तु पूर्वोक्तं त्रयोदशभिरक्षरैः /
पङ्क्तिभी रुद्रासंख्याकैरष्टादशभिरक्षरैः //
text_mt: With thirteen syllables, the previously mentioned [limbs] beginning with the heart; / with ten, with eleven, with eighteen,

sanskrit_iast:
bhānubhiḥ karaṇairmantrī varairaṅgāni kalpayet /
pūrvoktarūpiṇaṃ jvālāmālina nṛhariṃ smaret //
meaning:
भानुभिः करणैर्मन्त्री वरैरङ्गानि कल्पयेत् /
पूर्वोक्तरूपिणं ज्वालामालिन नृहरिं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: with twelve, and with the sense organs, the practitioner should form the limbs with the best [syllables]. / One should meditate on the previously described Jvālāmālin Nṛhari.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśaṃ ca juhuyātkapilāghṛtaiḥ /
raudrāpasmārabhūtādināśako 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ //
meaning:
लक्षं जपो दशांशं च जुहुयात्कपिलाघृतैः /
रौद्रापस्मारभूतादिनाशको ऽयं मनूत्तमः //
text_mt: The recitation is one hundred thousand, and one-tenth of that one should offer as oblation with ghee from a brown cow. / This supreme mantra destroys violent epilepsies, spirits, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo māyā nṛsiṃhaśca sṛṣṭirbrahmāstramīritaḥ /
ṣaḍakṣaro mahāmantraḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
प्राणो माया नृसिंहश्च सृष्टिर्ब्रह्मास्त्रमीरितः /
षडक्षरो महामन्त्रः सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकः //
text_mt: Prāṇa, māyā, Nṛsiṃha, creation, and the Brahmāstra are declared: / this six-syllabled great mantra is the bestower of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
munirbrahmā tathā chandaḥ paṅktirdevo nṛkesarī /
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
मुनिर्ब्रह्मा तथा छन्दः पङ्क्तिर्देवो नृकेसरी /
षड्दीर्घभाजा बीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Its sage is Brahmā, its meter is paṅkti, its deity is Nṛkesarin; / with the bīja endowed with the six long vowels, one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktenaiva vidhinā dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ samācaret /
siddhena manunānena sarvasiddhirbhavennṛṇām //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेनैव विधिना ध्यानं पूजां समाचरेत् /
सिद्धेन मनुनानेन सर्वसिद्धिर्भवेन्नृणाम् //
text_mt: One should perform meditation and worship according to the procedure stated before; / by means of this perfected mantra, all success is obtained by men.

sanskrit_iast:
ramābījādiko 'nuṣṭuptrayastriṃśārṇavānmanuḥ /
prajāpatirmuniścchando 'nuṣṭup lakṣmīnṛkesarī //
meaning:
रमाबीजादिको ऽनुष्टुप्त्रयस्त्रिंशार्णवान्मनुः /
प्रजापतिर्मुनिश्च्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप् लक्ष्मीनृकेसरी //
text_mt: Beginning with the bīja of Ramā, the anuṣṭubh mantra consists of thirty-three syllables. / Prajāpati is the sage, the meter is anuṣṭubh, Lakṣmī-Nṛkesarin is the deity,

sanskrit_iast:
devatā caja padaiḥ sarveṇāṅgakalpanamīritam /
vinyasyaivaṃ tu pañcāṅgaṃ svātmarakṣāṃ samācaret //
meaning:
देवता चज पदैः सर्वेणाङ्गकल्पनमीरितम् /
विन्यस्यैवं तु पञ्चाङ्गं स्वात्मरक्षां समाचरेत् //
text_mt: and the formation of the limbs is taught through all the words. / Having thus placed the five limbs, one should perform self-protection:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃspṛśan dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ śarabhasya manuṃ japet /
praṇavo hṛcchivāryanti mahate śarabhāya ca //
meaning:
संस्पृशन् दक्षिणं बाहुं शरभस्य मनुं जपेत् /
प्रणवो हृच्छिवार्यन्ति महते शरभाय च //
text_mt: Touching the right arm, one should recite the mantra of Śarabha: / The praṇava [oṃ], the heart [namaḥ], śivāya, then mahate śarabhāya ca,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnipriyānto mantrastu rakṣārthe samudāhṛtaḥ /
athavā rāmamantrānte paraṃ kṣadvitayaṃ paṭhet //
meaning:
वह्निप्रियान्तो मन्त्रस्तु रक्षार्थे समुदाहृतः /
अथवा राममन्त्रान्ते परं क्षद्वितयं पठेत् //
text_mt: and ending with the beloved of fire [svāhā]—this mantra is proclaimed for protection. / Or after the Rāma mantra, one should recite two kṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā keśavādyaistu rakṣāṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ /
keśavaḥ pātu pādau me jaṅghe nārāyaṇo 'vatu //
meaning:
अथवा केशवाद्यैस्तु रक्षां कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः /
केशवः पातु पादौ मे जङ्घे नारायणो ऽवतु //
text_mt: Or else one should diligently perform protection with [the names] beginning with Keśava: / May Keśava protect my feet; may Nārāyaṇa protect my shanks;

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavo me kaṭiṃ pātu govindo guhyameva ca /
nābhiṃ viṣṇuśca me pātu jaṭharaṃ madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
माधवो मे कटिं पातु गोविन्दो गुह्यमेव च /
नाभिं विष्णुश्च मे पातु जठरं मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: may Mādhava protect my waist; and Govinda, my private parts; / may Viṣṇu protect my navel; Madhusūdana, my belly;

sanskrit_iast:
ūrū trivikramaḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu me naraḥ /
śrīdharaḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśo mukhaṃ mama //
meaning:
ऊरू त्रिविक्रमः पातु हृदयं पातु मे नरः /
श्रीधरः पातु कण्ठं च हृषीकेशो मुखं मम //
text_mt: may Trivikrama protect my thighs; may Nara protect my heart; / may Śrīdhara protect my neck; and Hṛṣīkeśa, my face.

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābhaḥ stanau pātu śīrṣaṃ dāmodaro 'vatu /
evaṃ vinyasya cāṅgeṣu japakāle tu sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
पद्मनाभः स्तनौ पातु शीर्षं दामोदरो ऽवतु /
एवं विन्यस्य चाङ्गेषु जपकाले तु साधकः //
text_mt: May Padmanābha protect my breasts, and may Dāmodara guard my head. / Having thus performed the ritual placement upon the limbs at the time of recitation, the practitioner

sanskrit_iast:
nirbhayo jāyate bhūtavetālagraharākṣasāt /
punarnyasetprayatnena dhyānaṃ kurvansamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
निर्भयो जायते भूतवेतालग्रहराक्षसात् /
पुनर्न्यसेत्प्रयत्नेन ध्यानं कुर्वन्समाहितः //
text_mt: becomes free from fear of spirits, vetālas, planetary afflictions, and rākṣasas. / Concentrated, he should again perform the ritual placement with effort while meditating:

sanskrit_iast:
purastātkeśavaḥ pātuḥ cakrī jāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ /
paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhī nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ //
meaning:
पुरस्तात्केशवः पातुः चक्री जांबूनदप्रभः /
पश्चान्नारायणः शङ्खी नीलजीमूतसन्निभः //
text_mt: “May Keśava, bearing a discus and shining like molten gold, protect me in front; / may Nārāyaṇa, bearing a conch and resembling a dark raincloud, protect me behind;

sanskrit_iast:
urddhvamindīvaraśyāmo mādhavastu gadādharaḥ /
givindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahān //
meaning:
उर्द्ध्वमिन्दीवरश्यामो माधवस्तु गदाधरः /
गिविन्दो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे धन्वी चन्द्रप्रभो महान् //
text_mt: may Mādhava, dark as a blue lotus and holding a mace, protect me above; / may Govinda, holding a bow and radiant as the moon, great, protect me on the right side;

sanskrit_iast:
uttare haladhṛgviṣṇuḥ padmakiñjalkasannibhaḥ /
āgneyyāmaravindākṣo musalīmadhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तरे हलधृग्विष्णुः पद्मकिञ्जल्कसन्निभः /
आग्नेय्यामरविन्दाक्षो मुसलीमधुसूदनः //
text_mt: may Viṣṇu, holding a plow and resembling the filaments of a lotus, protect me on the north; / may lotus-eyed Madhusūdana, holding a pestle, protect me in the southeast;

sanskrit_iast:
trivikramaḥ khaḍgapāṇirnairṛtyāṃ jvalanaprabhaḥ /
vāyavyāṃ mādhavo vajrī taruṇādityasannibhaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिविक्रमः खड्गपाणिर्नैरृत्यां ज्वलनप्रभः /
वायव्यां माधवो वज्री तरुणादित्यसन्निभः //
text_mt: may Trivikrama, sword in hand and radiant as fire, protect me in the southwest; / may Mādhava, wielding a thunderbolt and resembling the morning sun, protect me in the northwest;

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīdharaḥ paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ /
vidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśa urddhū pātu samudgaraḥ //
meaning:
ऐशान्यां पुण्डरीकाक्षः श्रीधरः पट्टिशायुधः /
विद्युत्प्रभो हृषीकेश उर्द्धू पातु समुद्गरः //
text_mt: may lotus-eyed Śrīdhara, armed with a spear, protect me in the northeast; / may lightning-bright Hṛṣīkeśa, holding a mallet, protect me above;

sanskrit_iast:
adhaśca padmanābho me sahasrāṃśusamaprabheḥ /
sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvādyaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ //
meaning:
अधश्च पद्मनाभो मे सहस्रांशुसमप्रभेः /
सर्वायुधः सर्वशक्तिः सर्वाद्यः सर्वतोमुखः //
text_mt: and may Padmanābha, brilliant as a thousand suns, protect me below. / He who bears all weapons, possesses all powers, is the primal source of all, and faces all directions,

sanskrit_iast:
indragopaprabhaḥ pāyātpāśahasto 'parājitaḥ /
sa bāhyābhyantare dehamavyāddāmo daro hariḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रगोपप्रभः पायात्पाशहस्तो ऽपराजितः /
स बाह्याभ्यन्तरे देहमव्याद्दामो दरो हरिः //
text_mt: who shines like an indragopa insect, holds a noose, and is undefeated— / may Dāmodara Hari protect my body, both without and within.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvatra niśchidraṃ nāma dvādaśapañjaram /
praviṣṭo 'haṃ na me kiñcidbhayamasti kadācana //
meaning:
एवं सर्वत्र निश्छिद्रं नाम द्वादशपञ्जरम् /
प्रविष्टो ऽहं न मे किञ्चिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन //
text_mt: Having thus entered the impenetrable armor of twelve names everywhere, / I have no fear whatsoever at any time.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rakṣāṃ vidhāyātha durddharṣo jāyate naraḥ /
sarveṣu nṛharermantravargeṣvevaṃ vidhirmataḥ //
meaning:
एवं रक्षां विधायाथ दुर्द्धर्षो जायते नरः /
सर्वेषु नृहरेर्मन्त्रवर्गेष्वेवं विधिर्मतः //
text_mt: Having thus established protection, a man becomes invincible. / This procedure is held to apply to all groups of mantras of Nṛhari.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ dhyānapūjādikaṃ caret /
jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना सर्वं ध्यानपूजादिकं चरेत् /
जितं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन //
text_mt: One should perform all meditation, worship, and so forth according to the previously stated rule: / “Victory to you, lotus-eyed one! O creator of the universe, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa te namaḥ /
itthaṃ saṃprārthya japtvā ca paṭitvā visṛjedvibhum //
meaning:
नमस्ते ऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुष ते नमः /
इत्थं संप्रार्थ्य जप्त्वा च पटित्वा विसृजेद्विभुम् //
text_mt: Homage to you, Hṛṣīkeśa! Homage to you, Mahāpuruṣa!” / Having thus prayed, recited, and chanted, one should dismiss the all-pervading Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī jāyate sampadāṃ padam /
jayadvayaṃ śrīnṛsiṃhetyaṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री जायते सम्पदां पदम् /
जयद्वयं श्रीनृसिंहेत्यष्टार्णो ऽयं मनूत्तमः //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus mastered, the mantrin becomes an abode of prosperity. / “Jaya” twice, and then “Śrīnṛsiṃha”: this is the supreme eight-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
munirbrahmātha gāyatrī chandaḥ prokto 'sya devatā /
śrīmāñjayanṛsiṃhastu sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
मुनिर्ब्रह्माथ गायत्री छन्दः प्रोक्तो ऽस्य देवता /
श्रीमाञ्जयनृसिंहस्तु सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकः //
text_mt: The sage is Brahmā; then the meter is declared to be gāyatrī; its deity / is glorious Jayanṛsiṃha, who grants all desired boons.

sanskrit_iast:
seṃdugorvidapūrveṇa viyatā sendunā punaḥ /
ṣaḍvīrghāḍhye na kurvīta ṣaḍaṅgāni viśāladhīḥ //
meaning:
सेंदुगोर्विदपूर्वेण वियता सेन्दुना पुनः /
षड्वीर्घाढ्ये न कुर्वीत षडङ्गानि विशालधीः //
text_mt: With the moon and the cow-knower preceding, and with ether accompanied by the moon, / augmented with the six long vowels, the wise one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast: tato dhyāyeddhṛdi vibhuṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ candraśekharam //
meaning: ततो ध्यायेद्धृदि विभुं नृसिंहं चन्द्रशेखरम् //
text_mt: Then one should meditate in the heart on the all-pervading Nṛsiṃha, who wears the crescent moon:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmannṛkesaritano jagadekabaṃndho śrīnīlakaṇṭha karuṇārṇave sāmarāja /
vahnīndutīvrakaranetra pinākapāṇe śītāṃśuśekhara rameśvara pāhi viṣṇo //
meaning:
श्रीमन्नृकेसरितनो जगदेकबंन्धो श्रीनीलकण्ठ करुणार्णवे सामराज /
वह्नीन्दुतीव्रकरनेत्र पिनाकपाणे शीतांशुशेखर रमेश्वर पाहि विष्णो //
text_mt: “O Lord in the glorious form of the man-lion, sole friend of the universe, blue-throated one, ocean of compassion, king of the Sāmas, / having the fire, moon, and sun as your eyes, holding the Pināka bow, adorned with the cool-rayed moon, Lord of Ramā, O Viṣṇu, protect me!”

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ prapellakṣāṣṭakaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ /
sājyena pāyasānnena juhuyātprāgvadarcanam //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं प्रपेल्लक्षाष्टकं मन्त्री दशांशतः /
साज्येन पायसान्नेन जुहुयात्प्राग्वदर्चनम् //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, the mantrin should recite it eight hundred thousand times; / he should offer a tenth of that in fire oblations with milk-rice mixed with ghee, with worship as described before.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro māyā svabījānte karṇograṃ vīramīrayet /
mahāviṣṇu tato brūyājjvalantaṃ sarvatomukham //
meaning:
तारो माया स्वबीजान्ते कर्णोग्रं वीरमीरयेत् /
महाविष्णु ततो ब्रूयाज्ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् //
text_mt: The oṃkāra, the māyā syllable, after its own bīja one should utter karṇa, ugra, vīra; / then one should say mahāviṣṇu, jvalanta, sarvatomukha;

sanskrit_iast:
sphuraddvayaṃ prasphureti dvayaṃ ghorapadaṃ tataḥ /
vadeddhorataraṃ te tu tanurūpaṃ ca ṭhadvayam //
meaning:
स्फुरद्द्वयं प्रस्फुरेति द्वयं घोरपदं ततः /
वदेद्धोरतरं ते तु तनुरूपं च ठद्वयम् //
text_mt: “sphurat” twice, “prasphura” twice, then the word “ghora”; / then one should say “ghoratara”, and “te tanurūpa”, and two ṭhas;

sanskrit_iast:
pracaṭadvayamābhāṣya kahayugma ca madvayam /
bandhadvayaṃ ghātayeti dvayaṃ varmāstramīrayet //
meaning:
प्रचटद्वयमाभाष्य कहयुग्म च मद्वयम् /
बन्धद्वयं घातयेति द्वयं वर्मास्त्रमीरयेत् //
text_mt: having uttered “pracaṭa” twice, a pair of “kaha”, a pair of “ma”, / a pair of “bandha”, and a pair of “ghātaya”, one should pronounce the armor and weapon syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ namāmyaham /
pañcāśītyakṣaro mantro bhajatāmiṣṭadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
नृसिंहं भीषणं भद्रं मृत्युमृत्युं नमाम्यहम् /
पञ्चाशीत्यक्षरो मन्त्रो भजतामिष्टदायकः //
text_mt: “I bow to Nṛsiṃha, terrifying, auspicious, the death of death.” / This eighty-five-syllable mantra grants the desires of those who worship.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣī hyaghorabrahmaṇau tathā triṣṭubanuṣṭubhau /
chandasī ca tathā ghoranṛsiṃho devatā mataḥ //
meaning:
ऋषी ह्यघोरब्रह्मणौ तथा त्रिष्टुबनुष्टुभौ /
छन्दसी च तथा घोरनृसिंहो देवता मतः //
text_mt: The two sages are Aghora and Brahmā; the two meters are triṣṭubh and anuṣṭubh; / and Ghoranṛsiṃha is considered the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānārcanādikaṃ cāsya kuryādānuṣṭubhaṃ sudhīḥ /
viśeṣānmantravaryo 'yaṃ sarvarakṣākaro mataḥ //
meaning:
ध्यानार्चनादिकं चास्य कुर्यादानुष्टुभं सुधीः /
विशेषान्मन्त्रवर्यो ऽयं सर्वरक्षाकरो मतः //
text_mt: The wise one should perform the meditation, worship, and other rites belonging to the anuṣṭubh [mantra] for it. / This best of mantras is particularly regarded as conferring all protection.

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ jayayugaṃ paścānnṛsiṃhetyaṣṭavarṇavān /
ṛṣiḥ prajāpatiścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam //
meaning:
बीजं जययुगं पश्चान्नृसिंहेत्यष्टवर्णवान् /
ऋषिः प्रजापतिश्चास्यानुष्टुप्छन्द उदाहृतम् //
text_mt: The bīja, the pair of “jaya”, then “nṛsiṃha”: it has eight syllables. / Its sage is Prajāpati, and the meter is declared to be anuṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast:
vidāraṇanṛsiṃho 'sya devatā parikīrtitaḥ /
jaṃ bījaṃ haṃ tathā śaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye //
meaning:
विदारणनृसिंहो ऽस्य देवता परिकीर्तितः /
जं बीजं हं तथा शक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये //
text_mt: Its deity is celebrated as Vidāraṇanṛsiṃha; / “jaṃ” is the bīja, “haṃ” is the power, and the ritual application is for the attainment of all objectives.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāḍhyena nṛsiṃhena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret /
raudraṃ dhyāyennṛsiṃhaṃ tu śatruvakṣo vidāraṇam //
meaning:
दीर्घाढ्येन नृसिंहेन षडङ्गन्यासमाचरेत् /
रौद्रं ध्यायेन्नृसिंहं तु शत्रुवक्षो विदारणम् //
text_mt: With “Nṛsiṃha” augmented by the long vowels, one should perform the ritual placement of the six limbs. / One should meditate on fierce Nṛsiṃha ripping open the chest of the enemy,

sanskrit_iast:
nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhaṃ bhaktābhayada śrīniketanam /
taptahāṭakakeśāntajvalaptāvakalocanam //
meaning:
नखदंष्ट्रायुधं भक्ताभयद श्रीनिकेतनम् /
तप्तहाटककेशान्तज्वलप्तावकलोचनम् //
text_mt: having nails and fangs as weapons, granting fearlessness to devotees, the abode of fortune, / with the tips of his hair like heated gold, and eyes like blazing fire:

sanskrit_iast:
vajrādhikanakhasparśa divyasiṃha namo 'stu te /.
munirbrahmā samākhyāto 'nuṣṭupchandaḥ samīritaḥ //
meaning:
वज्राधिकनखस्पर्श दिव्यसिंह नमो ऽस्तु ते /.
मुनिर्ब्रह्मा समाख्यातो ऽनुष्टुप्छन्दः समीरितः //
text_mt: “O divine lion whose touch of claws is harder than a thunderbolt, homage to you!” / The sage is declared to be Brahmā, and the meter is said to be anuṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāsya ragadārṇasya divyapūrvo nṛkesarī /
pādaiścaturbhiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
देवतास्य रगदार्णस्य दिव्यपूर्वो नृकेसरी /
पादैश्चतुर्भिः सर्वेण पञ्चाङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: The deity of this mantra whose syllables are “ragada…” is the man-lion preceded by “divya”. / With the four quarters and with the whole, one should perform the five limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvatproktaṃ munīśvara /
pūrvoktāni ca sarvāṇi kāryāṇyāyānti siddhatām //
meaning:
ध्यानपूजादिकं सर्वं प्राग्वत्प्रोक्तं मुनीश्वर /
पूर्वोक्तानि च सर्वाणि कार्याण्यायान्ति सिद्धताम् //
text_mt: All meditation, worship, and other rites are as previously taught, O lord of sages; / and all previously stated undertakings attain success.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya hṛñca te /
jastejase āvirāvirbhava vajranakhāntataḥ //
meaning:
तारो नमो भगवते नरसिंहाय हृञ्च ते /
जस्तेजसे आविराविर्भव वज्रनखान्ततः //
text_mt: The oṃkāra, “namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya”, “hṛt” and “te / jastejase āvirāvirbhava vajranakha”, followed by

sanskrit_iast:
vrajadaṃṣṭreti karmānte tvāsayākrandayadvayam /
tamo grasadvayaṃ paścātsvāhānte cābhayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
व्रजदंष्ट्रेति कर्मान्ते त्वासयाक्रन्दयद्वयम् /
तमो ग्रसद्वयं पश्चात्स्वाहान्ते चाभयं ततः //
text_mt: “vajradaṃṣṭra”; after “karmāśaya”, two “randhaya”s, / two “tamo grasa”s, and at the end of “svāhā”, then “abhaya”;

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyante ca bhūyiṣṭā dhruvo bījāntimo manuḥ /
dviṣaṣṭyarmo 'sya munyādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadīritam //
meaning:
आत्मन्यन्ते च भूयिष्टा ध्रुवो बीजान्तिमो मनुः /
द्विषष्ट्यर्मो ऽस्य मुन्यादि सर्वं पूर्ववदीरितम् //
text_mt: after “ātmani”, “bhūyiṣṭhāḥ”, the praṇava, and the final bīja is the mantra. / It has sixty-two syllables; its sage and the rest are all stated as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro nṛsiṃhabījaṃ ca namo bhagavate tataḥ /
narasiṃhāya tāraśca bījamasya yadā tataḥ //
meaning:
तारो नृसिंहबीजं च नमो भगवते ततः /
नरसिंहाय तारश्च बीजमस्य यदा ततः //
text_mt: The oṃkāra, the Nṛsiṃha-bīja, then “namo bhagavate”; / then “narasiṃhāya”, and the oṃkāra, and its bīja, when, then:

sanskrit_iast:
rūpāya tāraḥ svarbījaṃ kūrmarūpāya tārakam /
bījaṃ varāharūpāya tāro bīja nṛsiṃhataḥ //
meaning:
रूपाय तारः स्वर्बीजं कूर्मरूपाय तारकम् /
बीजं वराहरूपाय तारो बीज नृसिंहतः //
text_mt: to “…rūpāya”, the oṃkāra, one's own bīja, to “kūrmarūpāya”, the oṃkāra, / the bīja to “varāharūpāya”, the oṃkāra, the bīja from “nṛsiṃha-

sanskrit_iast:
rūpāya tāra svaṃ bījaṃ vāmanānte ca rūpataḥ /
pāpadhruvatrayaṃ bījaṃ rāmāya nigamāditaḥ //
meaning:
रूपाय तार स्वं बीजं वामनान्ते च रूपतः /
पापध्रुवत्रयं बीजं रामाय निगमादितः //
text_mt: -rūpāya”, the oṃkāra, one's own bīja; and at the end of “vāmana”, from “rūpa”; / three praṇavas, the bīja to “rāmāya”, from the beginning of the Veda;

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ kṛṣṇāya tārānte bījaṃ ca kalkine tataḥ /
jayadvayaṃ tataḥ śālagrāmānte ca nivāsine //
meaning:
बीजं कृष्णाय तारान्ते बीजं च कल्किने ततः /
जयद्वयं ततः शालग्रामान्ते च निवासिने //
text_mt: the bīja to “kṛṣṇāya” followed by the oṃkāra, and then the bīja to “kalkine”; / then two “jaya”s, and after “śālagrāma”, to “-nivāsine”;

sanskrit_iast:
divyasiṃhāya ṅentaḥ syātsvayaṃbhūḥ puruṣāya hṛt /
tāraḥ svaṃ bījamityeṣa mahāsāmrājyadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यसिंहाय ङेन्तः स्यात्स्वयंभूः पुरुषाय हृत् /
तारः स्वं बीजमित्येष महासाम्राज्यदायकः //
text_mt: then in the dative case to “divyasiṃhāya”, “svayaṃbhūḥ puruṣāya hṛt”, / the oṃkāra, one's own bīja: this grants great sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhamantraḥ khāṅkārṇo muniratriḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
chando 'tijagatī proktaṃ devatā kathitā manoḥ //
meaning:
नृसिंहमन्त्रः खाङ्कार्णो मुनिरत्रिः प्रकीर्तितः /
छन्दो ऽतिजगती प्रोक्तं देवता कथिता मनोः //
text_mt: This Nṛsiṃha mantra has ninety syllables; the sage is proclaimed to be Atri; / the meter is declared to be atijagatī; the deity of the mantra is said to be

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvatāro nṛhariṃ bījaṃ khaṃ śaktiravyayaḥ /
ṣaḍūdīrghāḍhyena bījena kṛtvāṅgāni ca bhāvayet //
meaning:
दशावतारो नृहरिं बीजं खं शक्तिरव्ययः /
षडूदीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन कृत्वाङ्गानि च भावयेत् //
text_mt: Nṛhari in the ten incarnations; the bīja is “khaṃ”; the imperishable one is the power. / Having formed the limbs with the bīja augmented by the six long vowels, one should meditate:

sanskrit_iast:
anekacandrapratimo lakṣmīmukhakṛtekṣaṇaḥ /
daśāvatāraiḥ sahitastanotu nṛhariḥ sukham //
meaning:
अनेकचन्द्रप्रतिमो लक्ष्मीमुखकृतेक्षणः /
दशावतारैः सहितस्तनोतु नृहरिः सुखम् //
text_mt: “Resembling multiple moons, his gaze fixed upon the face of Lakṣmī, / accompanied by the ten incarnations—may Nṛhari bestow happiness!”

sanskrit_iast:
japo 'yutaṃ daśāṃśena homaḥ syātpāyasena tu /
prāgukte pūjayetpīṭhe mūrtisaṃkalpya mūlataḥ //
meaning:
जपो ऽयुतं दशांशेन होमः स्यात्पायसेन तु /
प्रागुक्ते पूजयेत्पीठे मूर्तिसंकल्प्य मूलतः //
text_mt: Recitation should be ten thousand times, and the fire oblation one-tenth of that with milk-rice. / One should worship upon the previously mentioned ritual seat, visualizing the form from the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgānyādau ca matsyādyāndigdaleṣu tator'cayet /
indrādyānapi vajrādyānsampūjyeṣṭamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अङ्गान्यादौ च मत्स्याद्यान्दिग्दलेषु ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्राद्यान्सम्पूज्येष्टमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: First the limbs, and then one should worship the Fish and others on the petals in the directions. / Having worshipped Indra and the others, as well as the thunderbolt and other weapons, one attains the desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrārṇaṃ mahāmantraṃ vakṣye tantreṣu gopitam /
tāro māyā ramā kāmo bījaṃ krodhapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रार्णं महामन्त्रं वक्ष्ये तन्त्रेषु गोपितम् /
तारो माया रमा कामो बीजं क्रोधपदं ततः //
text_mt: I shall declare the thousand-syllable great mantra concealed in the tantras: / the oṃkāra, māyā, ramā, kāma, the bīja, then the word “krodha”;

sanskrit_iast:
mūrte nṛsiṃha śabdānte mahāpuruṣa īrayet /
pradhānadharmādharmānte nigaḍetipadaṃ vadet //
meaning:
मूर्ते नृसिंह शब्दान्ते महापुरुष ईरयेत् /
प्रधानधर्माधर्मान्ते निगडेतिपदं वदेत् //
text_mt: after the word “mūrtaye nṛsiṃha”, one should utter “mahāpuruṣa”; / after “pradhānadharmādharma”, one should speak the word “nigaḍa”;

sanskrit_iast:
nirmocanānte kāleti tatataḥ puruṣa īrayet /
kālāntakasadṛktoyaṃ sveśvarānte sadṛgjalam //
meaning:
निर्मोचनान्ते कालेति तततः पुरुष ईरयेत् /
कालान्तकसदृक्तोयं स्वेश्वरान्ते सदृग्जलम् //
text_mt: after “nirmocana”, “kāla”, and then one should utter “puruṣa”; / “kālāntakasadṛktoyaṃ”, after “sveśvara”, “sadṛgjalam”.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāntānte tu niviṣṭeti caitanyacitsadā tataḥ /
bhāsakānte tu kālādyatītanityoditeti ca //
meaning:
श्रान्तान्ते तु निविष्टेति चैतन्यचित्सदा ततः /
भासकान्ते तु कालाद्यतीतनित्योदितेति च //
text_mt: After "śrānta", "niviṣṭa"; then "caitanyacit sadā"; / after "bhāsaka", "kālādyatītanityodita";

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamayākrāntamahākāruṇiketi ca /
hṛdayābjacatuścoktā dalānte tu niviṣṭitaḥ //
meaning:
उदयास्तमयाक्रान्तमहाकारुणिकेति च /
हृदयाब्जचतुश्चोक्ता दलान्ते तु निविष्टितः //
text_mt: and "udayāstamayākrāntamahākāruṇika"; / [the phrase] "hṛdayābjacatuḥ" is spoken, and after "dala", "niviṣṭitaḥ";

sanskrit_iast:
caitanyātmaṃścaturāmandvādaśātmaṃstataḥ param /
caturviṃśātmannante tu pañcaviṃśātmannityapi //
meaning:
चैतन्यात्मंश्चतुरामन्द्वादशात्मंस्ततः परम् /
चतुर्विंशात्मन्नन्ते तु पञ्चविंशात्मन्नित्यपि //
text_mt: "caitanyātman", "caturātman", and after that "dvādaśātman"; / "caturviṃśātman", and finally "pañcaviṃśātman";

sanskrit_iast:
bako hariḥ sahasrānte mūrte ehyehi śabdataḥ /
bhagavannṛsiṃhapuruṣa krodheśvara rasā saha //
meaning:
बको हरिः सहस्रान्ते मूर्ते एह्येहि शब्दतः /
भगवन्नृसिंहपुरुष क्रोधेश्वर रसा सह //
text_mt: "bakaḥ", "hariḥ"; after "sahasra", "mūrte"; from the words "ehyehi", / "bhagavan nṛsiṃhapuruṣa krodheśvara", together with "rasā";

sanskrit_iast:
sravanditānte pādeti kalpāntāgnisahasra ca /
koṭyābhānte mahādeva nikāyadaśaśabdataḥ //
meaning:
स्रवन्दितान्ते पादेति कल्पान्ताग्निसहस्र च /
कोट्याभान्ते महादेव निकायदशशब्दतः //
text_mt: after "sravandita", "pāda"; and "kalpāntāgnisahasra"; / after "koṭyābha", from the words "mahādeva nikāyadaśa";

sanskrit_iast:
śatayajñātalaṃ jñeyaṃ tataścāmalayugmakam /
piṅgalekṣaṇasaṭādaṣṭrā daṃṣṭrāyudha nakhāyudha //
meaning:
शतयज्ञातलं ज्ञेयं ततश्चामलयुग्मकम् /
पिङ्गलेक्षणसटादष्ट्रा दंष्ट्रायुध नखायुध //
text_mt: "śatayajñātala" should be known; then the two "amala"s; / "piṅgalekṣaṇa", "saṭādaṣṭrā", "daṃṣṭrāyudha", "nakhāyudha";

sanskrit_iast:
dānavendrāntakāvahniṇaśoṇitapadaṃ tataḥ /
saṃ saktivigrahānte tu bhūtāpasmārayātudhān //
meaning:
दानवेन्द्रान्तकावह्निणशोणितपदं ततः /
सं सक्तिविग्रहान्ते तु भूतापस्मारयातुधान् //
text_mt: Then the word dānavendrāntakāvahniṇaśoṇita; / and after saṃsaktivigraha, bhūtāpasmārayātudhān;

sanskrit_iast:
surāsuravandyamānapādapaṅkajaśabdataḥ /
bhagavanvyomacakreśvarānte tu prabhavāpyaya //
meaning:
सुरासुरवन्द्यमानपादपङ्कजशब्दतः /
भगवन्व्योमचक्रेश्वरान्ते तु प्रभवाप्यय //
text_mt: after the words surāsuravandyamānapādapaṅkaja, / bhagavan vyomacakreśvara, and then prabhavāpyaya;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpeṇottiṣṭa cottiṣṭa avidyānicayaṃ daha /
daha jñānaiśvaryamante prakāśayayugaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
रूपेणोत्तिष्ट चोत्तिष्ट अविद्यानिचयं दह /
दह ज्ञानैश्वर्यमन्ते प्रकाशययुगं ततः //
text_mt: rūpeṇottiṣṭha cottiṣṭha avidyānicayaṃ daha / daha jñānaiśvaryam, and then twice prakāśaya;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ sarvajña aroṣānte jaṃbhājṛṃbhyavatārakam /
satyapuruṣa śabdānte sadasanmadhya īrayet //
meaning:
ओं सर्वज्ञ अरोषान्ते जंभाजृंभ्यवतारकम् /
सत्यपुरुष शब्दान्ते सदसन्मध्य ईरयेत् //
text_mt: oṃ sarvajña aroṣa, then jaṃbhājṛmbhyavatāraka; / after the word satyapuruṣa, one should utter sadasanmadhya-

sanskrit_iast:
niviṣṭaṃ mama duḥsvapnabhayaṃ nigaḍaśabdataḥ /
bhayaṃ kāntāraśabdānte bhayaṃ viṣapadāttataḥ //
meaning:
निविष्टं मम दुःस्वप्नभयं निगडशब्दतः /
भयं कान्तारशब्दान्ते भयं विषपदात्ततः //
text_mt: niviṣṭa mama duḥsvapnabhaya; after the word nigaḍa, / bhaya; after the word kāntāra, bhaya; then after the word viṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
jvarānte ḍākinī kṛtyādhvarevatībhayaṃ tataḥ /
aśanyante bhayaṃ durbhikṣabhayaṃ mārīśabdataḥ //
meaning:
ज्वरान्ते डाकिनी कृत्याध्वरेवतीभयं ततः /
अशन्यन्ते भयं दुर्भिक्षभयं मारीशब्दतः //
text_mt: after jvara, ḍākinīkṛtyādhvarevatībhaya; then / after aśani, bhaya; durbhikṣabhaya; after the word mārī,

sanskrit_iast:
bhayaṃ mārīcaśabdānte bhayaṃ chāyāpadaṃ tataḥ /
skandāpasmāraśabdānte bhayaṃ caurabhayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
भयं मारीचशब्दान्ते भयं छायापदं ततः /
स्कन्दापस्मारशब्दान्ते भयं चौरभयं ततः //
text_mt: bhaya; after the word mārīca, bhaya; then the word chāyā; / after the word skandāpasmāra, bhaya; then caurabhaya;

sanskrit_iast:
jalasvapnāgnibhayaṃ gajasiṃhabhujaṅgagataḥ /
bhayaṃ janmajarānte maraṇādiśabdamīrayet //
meaning:
जलस्वप्नाग्निभयं गजसिंहभुजङ्गगतः /
भयं जन्मजरान्ते मरणादिशब्दमीरयेत् //
text_mt: jalasvapnāgnibhaya; from gajasiṃhabhujaṅga, / bhaya; after janmajarā, one should utter the words maraṇādi-

sanskrit_iast:
bhayaṃ nirmocayayugaṃ praśamayayugaṃ tataḥ /
jñeyarūpadhāraṇānte nṛsiṃhabṛhatsāmataḥ //
meaning:
भयं निर्मोचययुगं प्रशमययुगं ततः /
ज्ञेयरूपधारणान्ते नृसिंहबृहत्सामतः //
text_mt: bhaya, twice nirmocaya, then twice praśamaya; / after jñeyarūpadhāraṇa, nṛsiṃhabṛhatsāma,

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣānte sarvabhayanivāraṇapadaṃ tataḥ /
aṣṭāṣṭakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭi ceṭikābhayamīrayet //
meaning:
पुरुषान्ते सर्वभयनिवारणपदं ततः /
अष्टाष्टकं चतुःषष्टि चेटिकाभयमीरयेत् //
text_mt: after puruṣa, then the word sarvabhayanivāraṇa; / one should utter aṣṭāṣṭakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭi ceṭikābhaya;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāvṛtastrayastriṃśaddevatākoṭiśabdataḥ /
namitānte padapadātpaṅkajānvita īrayet //
meaning:
विद्यावृतस्त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवताकोटिशब्दतः /
नमितान्ते पदपदात्पङ्कजान्वित ईरयेत् //
text_mt: after the words vidyāvṛtas trayastriṃśaddevatākoṭi- / namita, from the word pada, combined with paṅkaja, one should utter;

sanskrit_iast:
saha sravadanānte tu sahasrodara saṃvadet /
sahasrekṣaṇaśabdānte sahasrapādamīrayet //
meaning:
सह स्रवदनान्ते तु सहस्रोदर संवदेत् /
सहस्रेक्षणशब्दान्ते सहस्रपादमीरयेत् //
text_mt: after sahasravadana, one should say sahasrodara; / after the words sahasrekṣaṇa, one should utter sahasrapāda;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabhuja saṃprocya sahasrajihva saṃvadet /
sahastānte lalāṭeti sahasrāyudhato dharāt //
meaning:
सहस्रभुज संप्रोच्य सहस्रजिह्व संवदेत् /
सहस्तान्ते ललाटेति सहस्रायुधतो धरात् //
text_mt: having said sahasrabhuja, one should say sahasrajihva; / after sahasta, lalāṭa; from sahasrāyudhadhara,

sanskrit_iast:
tamaḥprakāśaka puramathanānte tu sarva ca /
mantrerājeśvarapadādvihāyasagatiprada //
meaning:
तमःप्रकाशक पुरमथनान्ते तु सर्व च /
मन्त्रेराजेश्वरपदाद्विहायसगतिप्रद //
text_mt: tamaḥprakāśaka; after puramathana, sarva; / after the words mantreśvareśa, vihāyasagatiprada;

sanskrit_iast:
pātālagatipradānte yantramarddana īrayet /
ghorāṭṭahāsahasitaviśvāvāsapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
पातालगतिप्रदान्ते यन्त्रमर्द्दन ईरयेत् /
घोराट्टहासहसितविश्वावासपदं ततः //
text_mt: after pātālagatiprada, one should utter yantramardana; / then the word ghorāṭṭahāsahasitaviśvāvāsa;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeva tato 'krūra tato hayamukheti ca /
paramahaṃsa viśveśa viśvānte tu viḍaṃbana //
meaning:
वासुदेव ततो ऽक्रूर ततो हयमुखेति च /
परमहंस विश्वेश विश्वान्ते तु विडंबन //
text_mt: then Vāsudeva, then Akrūra, then Hayamukha, / Paramahaṃsa, Viśveśa, and after viśva, viḍambana-

sanskrit_iast:
niviṣṭānte tataḥpradurbhāvakāraka īrayet /
hṛṣīkeśa ca svacchanda niḥśeṣajīva vinyaset //
meaning:
निविष्टान्ते ततःप्रदुर्भावकारक ईरयेत् /
हृषीकेश च स्वच्छन्द निःशेषजीव विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: niviṣṭa; then one should utter prādurbhāvakāraka; / Hṛṣīkeśa, Svacchanda; one should place niḥśeṣajīva-

sanskrit_iast:
grāsakānte mahā paścātpiśitāsṛgitīrayet /
laṃpaṭānte khecarīti siddhyateṃ tu pradāyaka //
meaning:
ग्रासकान्ते महा पश्चात्पिशितासृगितीरयेत् /
लंपटान्ते खेचरीति सिद्ध्यतें तु प्रदायक //
text_mt: grāsaka; after mahā, one should say piśitāsṛk; / after lampaṭa, khecarīsiddhyante pradāyaka;

sanskrit_iast:
ajeyāvyaya avyakta brahmāṇḍodara ityapi /
tato brahmasahasrānte koṭisragruṇḍaśabdataḥ //
meaning:
अजेयाव्यय अव्यक्त ब्रह्माण्डोदर इत्यपि /
ततो ब्रह्मसहस्रान्ते कोटिस्रग्रुण्डशब्दतः //
text_mt: ajeyāvyaya avyakta brahmāṇḍodara, and also / then after brahmasahasra, from the words koṭisragruṇḍa-

sanskrit_iast:
māla paṇḍitamuṇḍeti matsya kūrmaṃ tataḥ param /
varāhānte nṛsiṃheti vāmanānte samīrayet //
meaning:
माल पण्डितमुण्डेति मत्स्य कूर्मं ततः परम् /
वराहान्ते नृसिंहेति वामनान्ते समीरयेत् //
text_mt: māla paṇḍitamuṇḍa; Matsya, Kūrma; thereafter, / after Varāha, Nṛsiṃha; after Vāmana, one should utter;

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyākramaṇānte tu pādaśālika īrayet /
rāmatraya tato viṣṇurūpānte dhara eva ca //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्याक्रमणान्ते तु पादशालिक ईरयेत् /
रामत्रय ततो विष्णुरूपान्ते धर एव च //
text_mt: after trailokyākramaṇa, one should utter pādaśālika; / the three Rāmas, then after viṣṇurūpa, dhara;

sanskrit_iast:
tattvatrayānte praṇavādhāratastacchikhāṃ padam /
niviṣṭavahnijāyānte svadhā caiva tato vaṣaṭ //
meaning:
तत्त्वत्रयान्ते प्रणवाधारतस्तच्छिखां पदम् /
निविष्टवह्निजायान्ते स्वधा चैव ततो वषट् //
text_mt: after tattvatraya, praṇavādhāra; then the word tacchikhā- / niviṣṭa; after the wife of Agni [svāhā], svadhā and then vaṣaṭ;

sanskrit_iast:
netra varmāstramuñcāryya prāṇādhāra itariyet /
ādidevapadātprāṇāpānapaścānniviṣṭitaḥ //
meaning:
नेत्र वर्मास्त्रमुञ्चार्य्य प्राणाधार इतरियेत् /
आदिदेवपदात्प्राणापानपश्चान्निविष्टितः //
text_mt: having pronounced netra, varman, and astra, one should utter prāṇādhāra; / after the word ādideva, prāṇāpānaniviṣṭita;

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcarātrika ditija vinidhanānte kareti ca /
mahāmāyā amoghānte daryaṃ daityandraśabdataḥ //
meaning:
पाञ्चरात्रिक दितिज विनिधनान्ते करेति च /
महामाया अमोघान्ते दर्यं दैत्यन्द्रशब्दतः //
text_mt: pāñcarātrika; after ditijavinidhana, kara; / mahāmāyā; after amogha, dārya; from the word daityendra-

sanskrit_iast:
daryānte dalanetyuktā tejorāśin dhruvaṃ smaraḥ /
tejasvarānte puruṣapaṃṅeṃte satyapūruṣa //
meaning:
दर्यान्ते दलनेत्युक्ता तेजोराशिन् ध्रुवं स्मरः /
तेजस्वरान्ते पुरुषपंङेंते सत्यपूरुष //
text_mt: dārya, dalana is stated; tejorāśin; dhruva [oṃ]; smara [klīṃ]; / after tejasvara, puruṣa; after pañca, satyapūruṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
astratāro 'cyutāstraṃ ca tāro vācā sudeva phaṭ /
tāramāyāmūrteḥ phaṭ vaḥ kāmaḥ svarādimaḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्रतारो ऽच्युतास्त्रं च तारो वाचा सुदेव फट् /
तारमायामूर्तेः फट् वः कामः स्वरादिमः //
text_mt: astra; tāra [oṃ]; acyutāstra; tāra; vācā sudeva phaṭ; / tāra; māyāmūrtaye phaṭ; vaḥ; kāma [klīṃ]; the initial vowel [a];

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtestramavyayobījaṃ viśvamūrtestrimavyayaḥ /
māyāviśvātmane ṣaṭ ca tāraḥ saucaṃ turātmane //
meaning:
मूर्तेस्त्रमव्ययोबीजं विश्वमूर्तेस्त्रिमव्ययः /
मायाविश्वात्मने षट् च तारः सौचं तुरात्मने //
text_mt: mūrtaye astra; the imperishable seed-syllable [oṃ]; viśvamūrtaye astramavyayaḥ; / māyā [hrīṃ]; viśvātmane ṣaṭ; tāra [oṃ]; sauḥ; caturātmane;

sanskrit_iast:
phaṭ tārohaṃ viśvarūpinnastraṃ ca tadanantaram /
tārauhnaiparamānte tu hraṃsaphaṭpraṇavastataḥ //
meaning:
फट् तारोहं विश्वरूपिन्नस्त्रं च तदनन्तरम् /
तारौह्नैपरमान्ते तु ह्रंसफट्प्रणवस्ततः //
text_mt: phaṭ; tāra [oṃ]; ahaṃ viśvarūpin; and the astra immediately after; / tāra [oṃ]; uhnai paramānte tu; then hrasaḥ phaṭ and praṇava [oṃ];

sanskrit_iast:
hraḥ hiraṇaayagarbharūpa dhāraṇānte ca phaṭ dhruvaḥ /
hraiṃ anaupamyarūpadhāriṇāstraṃ dhruvastataḥ //
meaning:
ह्रः हिरणअयगर्भरूप धारणान्ते च फट् ध्रुवः /
ह्रैं अनौपम्यरूपधारिणास्त्रं ध्रुवस्ततः //
text_mt: hraḥ hiraṇyagarbharūpadhāraṇa, and after it phaṭ; dhruva [oṃ]; / hraiṃ anaupamyarūpadhārin astra, then dhruva [oṃ];

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaiṃ nṛsiṃharūpadhārin oṃ klaṃ ślaśca svarādikaḥ /
ṣṭāṅgavinyāsavinya stamūrtidhāriṃstataśca phaṭ //
meaning:
क्षैं नृसिंहरूपधारिन् ओं क्लं श्लश्च स्वरादिकः /
ष्टाङ्गविन्यासविन्य स्तमूर्तिधारिंस्ततश्च फट् //
text_mt: kṣaiṃ nṛsiṃharūpadhārin; oṃ klaṃ ślaśca; the initial vowel [a]; / ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsavinyastamūrtidhārin, and then phaṭ;

sanskrit_iast:
hrau nisargasiddhyaikarūpadhāriṃstataśca phaṭ /
tāro varmatrayaṃ saṃkaraṃ vaṃ cāmukamastakam //
meaning:
ह्रौ निसर्गसिद्ध्यैकरूपधारिंस्ततश्च फट् /
तारो वर्मत्रयं संकरं वं चामुकमस्तकम् //
text_mt: hrauḥ nisargasiddhyaikarūpadhārin, and then phaṭ; / tāra [oṃ]; the three armours [huṃ huṃ huṃ]; saṃkara; vaṃ; and amukamastakaṃ

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍadvayaṃ khāda yetidvayaṃ klīṃ sādhyamānaya /
dvayaṃ tato mahātmansyānsamyagdarśayayugmakam //
meaning:
खण्डद्वयं खाद येतिद्वयं क्लीं साध्यमानय /
द्वयं ततो महात्मन्स्यान्सम्यग्दर्शययुग्मकम् //
text_mt: khaṇḍaya twice; khādaya twice; klīṃ sādhyamānaya / twice; then mahātman syāt; samyagdarśaya twice;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghāḍyāṃ svabījaṃ ca kṣapitānte tu kalmaṣa /
uttarāyaṃ dvayaṃ pañcabāṇabījāni voñcaret //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घाड्यां स्वबीजं च क्षपितान्ते तु कल्मष /
उत्तरायं द्वयं पञ्चबाणबीजानि वोञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: endowed with the six long [vowels] and its own seed-syllable; after kṣapita, kalmaṣa; / uttarāya twice; one should utter the five seed-syllables of the arrow of love;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhānte tato jvālātmane svāhā samīrayet /
nṛsiṃhānte tataḥ kālātmane svāhā dhruvastataḥ //
meaning:
नृसिंहान्ते ततो ज्वालात्मने स्वाहा समीरयेत् /
नृसिंहान्ते ततः कालात्मने स्वाहा ध्रुवस्ततः //
text_mt: then after nṛsiṃha, one should utter jvālātmane svāhā; / then after nṛsiṃha, kālātmane svāhā; then dhruva [oṃ];

sanskrit_iast:
khabījaṃ kāmabījaṃ ca lakṣmībījadvayaṃ tataḥ /
māyātārāntimo mantraḥ sahasrākṣarasaṃmitaḥ //
meaning:
खबीजं कामबीजं च लक्ष्मीबीजद्वयं ततः /
मायातारान्तिमो मन्त्रः सहस्राक्षरसंमितः //
text_mt: the kha seed-syllable [haṃ], the kāma seed-syllable [klīṃ], then two Lakṣmī seed-syllables [śrīṃ śrīṃ]; / concluding with māyā [hrīṃ] and tāra [oṃ], this mantra consists of a thousand syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilo 'sya muniśchando jagatī devatā punaḥ /
śrīlakṣmīrnṛharirbījaṃ kṣaiṃ śaktirvahnivallabhā //
meaning:
कपिलो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो जगती देवता पुनः /
श्रीलक्ष्मीर्नृहरिर्बीजं क्षैं शक्तिर्वह्निवल्लभा //
text_mt: Its seer is Kapila; the metre is jagatī; the deity, moreover, / is Śrī Lakṣmī-Nṛhari; the seed-syllable is kṣaiṃ; the power is the wife of Agni [svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
śveto varṇa udāttaśca svaraḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ /
kṣetraṃ ca paramātmā tu viniyogo 'khilātpaye //
meaning:
श्वेतो वर्ण उदात्तश्च स्वरः प्रोक्तो मनीषिभिः /
क्षेत्रं च परमात्मा तु विनियोगो ऽखिलात्पये //
text_mt: the colour is white; the pitch is stated by the wise to be udātta; / the field is the Supreme Self; the application is for the destruction of all [evils].

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaḥ sahasrabāhavente sahasrāyudhadharāya ca /
nṛsiṃhāntaṃ vahnijāyāstrāyaphaṭū mantra īritaḥ //
meaning:
क्षः सहस्रबाहवेन्ते सहस्रायुधधराय च /
नृसिंहान्तं वह्निजायास्त्रायफटू मन्त्र ईरितः //
text_mt: kṣaḥ; after sahasrabāhave, and sahasrāyudhadharāya; / ending in nṛsiṃhāya, vahnijāyā [svāhā], astrāya phaṭ: [thus] the mantra is stated.

sanskrit_iast:
anena karaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvāṅgāni samācaret /
tāraḥ kṣāṃ ca sahasrānte kṣaraśabdādvijṛṃbhitam //
meaning:
अनेन करशुद्धिं च कृत्वाङ्गानि समाचरेत् /
तारः क्षां च सहस्रान्ते क्षरशब्दाद्विजृंभितम् //
text_mt: Having performed the purification of the hands with this [mantra], one should perform the [nyāsa of the] limbs: / tāra [oṃ]; kṣāṃ; and from the word sahasrākṣara, vijṛmbhita;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhāyāgnijāyānto hṛdaye manurīritaḥ /
māraḥ kṣīṃ ca mahātenuṃ prabhānte vikareti ca //
meaning:
नृसिंहायाग्निजायान्तो हृदये मनुरीरितः /
मारः क्षीं च महातेनुं प्रभान्ते विकरेति च //
text_mt: ending in nṛsiṃhāyāvahnijāyā [svāhā], the mantra for the heart is stated. / māra [klīṃ]; kṣīṃ; and after mahātanuprabhā, vikara;

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhāyāgnijāyānte śiromantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
tāraḥ kṣūṃ taptayaṃhāyaścādṛkkeśānta īrayet //
meaning:
नृसिंहायाग्निजायान्ते शिरोमन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः /
तारः क्षूं तप्तयंहायश्चादृक्केशान्त ईरयेत् //
text_mt: ending in nṛsiṃhāyāvahnijāyā [svāhā], the head mantra is proclaimed. / tāra [oṃ]; kṣūṃ taptasūryāyasa, one should say up to dṛkkeśa;

sanskrit_iast:
jvalatyāvakalo mūrmo dīrghā vajrādhiketi ca /
nakha sparśāddivyasiṃha namo 'stu bhagavan hariḥ //
meaning:
ज्वलत्यावकलो मूर्मो दीर्घा वज्राधिकेति च /
नख स्पर्शाद्दिव्यसिंह नमो ऽस्तु भगवन् हरिः //
text_mt: jvalatyāvakalā; urvī; dīrghā vajrādhikā, and / nakhasparśāddivyasiṃha namo 'stu bhagavan hariḥ;

sanskrit_iast:
mahādhvasta jagadrūpa nṛsiṃhāya dvayandvayam /
anena ca śikhā proktā kavacaṃ tadanantaram //
meaning:
महाध्वस्त जगद्रूप नृसिंहाय द्वयन्द्वयम् /
अनेन च शिखा प्रोक्ता कवचं तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: mahādhvastajagadrūpa nṛsiṃhāya twice each: / with this the śikhā is declared; immediately after is the armour.

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ kṣaiṃ ca suvarṇaṃ te madamattapadaṃ tataḥ /
vihvalitanṛsiṃhāya svāhāntaṃ kavacaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
तारः क्षैं च सुवर्णं ते मदमत्तपदं ततः /
विह्वलितनृसिंहाय स्वाहान्तं कवचं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: tāra [oṃ]; kṣaiṃ; and suvarṇa; then the words madamatta; / ending in vihvalitanṛsiṃhāya svāhā, the armour is traditionally taught.

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ rkṣau ca sahasrākṣa viśvasrākṣa viśvarūpapadaṃ vadet /
dhāraṇegni priyānto 'yaṃ netramantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
तारः र्क्षौ च सहस्राक्ष विश्वस्राक्ष विश्वरूपपदं वदेत् /
धारणेग्नि प्रियान्तो ऽयं नेत्रमन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt: tāra [oṃ]; kṣauṃ; and one should say the words sahasrākṣa viśvasrākṣa viśvarūpa; / ending in dhāraṇāyāvahnipriyā [svāhā], this eye mantra is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro kṣaśca sahasrānte vārāvepadamīrayet /
sahasrānte yudhāyāthaṃ nṛsiṃhāyāgnisuṃdarī //
meaning:
तारो क्षश्च सहस्रान्ते वारावेपदमीरयेत् /
सहस्रान्ते युधायाथं नृसिंहायाग्निसुंदरी //
text_mt: tāra [oṃ]; and kṣaḥ; after sahasra, one should utter the word vārava; / after sahasra, āyudhāya; then nṛsiṃhāya; agnisundarī [svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
astramantraḥ samākhyātastato dhyāyennṛkesarī /
udyadarkasahasrābhaṃ trīkṣaṇaṃ bhīsabhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
अस्त्रमन्त्रः समाख्यातस्ततो ध्यायेन्नृकेसरी /
उद्यदर्कसहस्राभं त्रीक्षणं भीसभूषणम् //
text_mt: this weapon mantra is declared; then one should meditate on the Man-Lion, / who shines like a thousand rising suns, three-eyed, adorned with serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
sutīkṣṇāgrabhujo daṇḍairdaityadāraṇakaṃ smaret /
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī sahasraṃ pāyena caga //
meaning:
सुतीक्ष्णाग्रभुजो दण्डैर्दैत्यदारणकं स्मरेत् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेन्मन्त्री सहस्रं पायेन चग //
text_mt: one should meditate on him tearing asunder the Daitya with his very sharp-pointed arms and staff-like [hands]. / Having meditated thus, the practitioner should recite [the mantra] a thousand times […].

sanskrit_iast:
ājyaplutena juhuyātsamyaksiddho bhavenmanuḥ /
prāgukte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ //
meaning:
आज्यप्लुतेन जुहुयात्सम्यक्सिद्धो भवेन्मनुः /
प्रागुक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः //
text_mt: One should offer into the fire with [offerings] drenched in clarified butter; then the mantra becomes fully perfected. / Having formed the image with the root [mantra] upon the previously described Vaiṣṇava ritual seat,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya nṛhariṃ paścādādāvaṅgāni pūjayet /
cakra śaṅkhaṃ ca pāśaṃ vāṅkuśaṃ kuliśameva ca //
meaning:
संपूज्य नृहरिं पश्चादादावङ्गानि पूजयेत् /
चक्र शङ्खं च पाशं वाङ्कुशं कुलिशमेव च //
text_mt: and having worshiped Nṛhari, one should next worship the limbs first, / and [then] the discus, the conch, the noose, or the goad, and the thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
gadākṛpāṇikṣveḍāni daleṣu paripūjayet /
lokeśānapi vajrādyānpūjayettadanantaram //
meaning:
गदाकृपाणिक्ष्वेडानि दलेषु परिपूजयेत् /
लोकेशानपि वज्राद्यान्पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: the mace, the sword, and the arrows on the petals. / Immediately thereafter, one should worship the lords of the world, beginning with Indra with his thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhati /
bhasmābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā grahagrastaṃ vilepayet //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री प्रयोगान्कर्तुमर्हति /
भस्माभिमन्त्रितं कृत्वा ग्रहग्रस्तं विलेपयेत् //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus perfected, the mantra-practitioner is qualified to perform ritual applications. / Having consecrated ashes with the mantra, he should smear one seized by seizing spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmasaṃlepanādeva sarvagrahavināśanam /
anenaiva vidhānena yakṣarākṣasakinnaraḥ //
meaning:
भस्मसंलेपनादेव सर्वग्रहविनाशनम् /
अनेनैव विधानेन यक्षराक्षसकिन्नरः //
text_mt: merely by smearing with the ashes, all seizing spirits are destroyed. / By this very procedure, yakṣas, rākṣasas, kinnaras,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśācāśca naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
parābhicārakṛtyāni manunānena mantritam //
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाश्च नश्यन्त्येव न संशयः /
पराभिचारकृत्यानि मनुनानेन मन्त्रितम् //
text_mt: bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas are indeed destroyed; there is no doubt. / Consecrated with this mantra against the hostile sorceries of others,

sanskrit_iast:
bhasma saṃlepayetsadyo durādharṣo bhavennaraḥ /
sudine sthāpayetkumbhe sarvatobhadramaṇḍale //
meaning:
भस्म संलेपयेत्सद्यो दुराधर्षो भवेन्नरः /
सुदिने स्थापयेत्कुम्भे सर्वतोभद्रमण्डले //
text_mt: one should smear the ashes, and the man immediately becomes unassailable. / On an auspicious day, one should place [a water-jar] upon the sarvatobhadra sacred diagram,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthatoyena saṃpūrya japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
tenābhiṣikto manujaḥ sarvāpattiṃ tared dhruvam //
meaning:
तीर्थतोयेन संपूर्य जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
तेनाभिषिक्तो मनुजः सर्वापत्तिं तरेद् ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: and having filled the jar with water from sacred fords, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times. / A man consecrated by sprinkling with that [water] will surely overcome all distress.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bahūktena sarveṣṭadāyako 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ /
vajranakhāya vidmahe tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāya dhīmahi /
tanno nṛsiṃhaḥ śabdānte vadeṃścaiva pracodayāt //
meaning:
किं बहूक्तेन सर्वेष्टदायको ऽयं मनूत्तमः /
वज्रनखाय विद्महे तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राय धीमहि /
तन्नो नृसिंहः शब्दान्ते वदेंश्चैव प्रचोदयात् //
text_mt: What need of many words? This best of mantras grants all desired things: / 'vajranakhāya vidmahe tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāya dhīmahi / tanno nṛsiṃhaḥ'—and at the end of the phrase, one should utter 'pracodayāt.'

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā nṛsiṃhagāyatrī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī /
etasyāḥ smaraṇādeva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde nṛsiṃhopāsanāmantragāyatryādinirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एषा नृसिंहगायत्री सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनी /
एतस्याः स्मरणादेव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे नृसिंहोपासनामन्त्रगायत्र्यादिनिरूपणं नामैकसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This is the Nṛsiṃha-gāyatrī, bestowing all desired things; / merely by remembering it, destruction of all sins occurs.

Thus ends the seventy-first chapter in the third quarter of the Bṛhadupākhyāna in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, entitled 'The Explanation of the Worship, Mantra, Gāyatrī, and Other Details of Nṛsiṃha.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ viṣṇurnentaḥ surapatistathā /
mahābalāya svāhānto mantro vasudharākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
प्रणवो हृदयं विष्णुर्नेन्तः सुरपतिस्तथा /
महाबलाय स्वाहान्तो मन्त्रो वसुधराक्षरः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / The Praṇava [Oṃ], the heart [namaḥ], Viṣṇu in the dative [viṣṇave], then the lord of the gods [sura-pataye], / followed by 'to the one of great strength' [mahābalāya], ending with svāhā: this is the eighteen-syllabled mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
munirindurvirāṭ chando devatā dadhivāmanaḥ /
tāro bījaṃ tathā śaktirvahnijāyā prakīrtitā //
meaning:
मुनिरिन्दुर्विराट् छन्दो देवता दधिवामनः /
तारो बीजं तथा शक्तिर्वह्निजाया प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt: The sage is Indu, the metre is Virāj, the deity is Dadhivāmana; / the Tāra [Oṃ] is the seed-syllable, and the wife of Agni [Svāhā] is proclaimed the śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
candrākṣirāmabāṇeṃṣu netrasaṃkhyairmanūdbhavaiḥ /
varṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā ca mūrdhni bhāle ca netrayoḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्राक्षिरामबाणेंषु नेत्रसंख्यैर्मनूद्भवैः /
वर्णैः षडङ्गं कृत्वा च मूर्ध्नि भाले च नेत्रयोः //
text_mt: Having performed the six limbs with the letters produced from the mantra numbering one, two, three, five, five, and two; / and on the head, the forehead, the eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
karṇayorghrāṇayoroṣṭatālukaṇṭhabhujeṣu ca /
pṛṣṭe hṛdyudare nābhau guhye corusthale punaḥ //
meaning:
कर्णयोर्घ्राणयोरोष्टतालुकण्ठभुजेषु च /
पृष्टे हृद्युदरे नाभौ गुह्ये चोरुस्थले पुनः //
text_mt: the ears, the nostrils, the lips, palate, throat, and arms, / the back, heart, belly, navel, genitals, and thighs,

sanskrit_iast:
jānudvayaṃ jaṅghayośca pādayorvinyasetkramāt /
aṣṭādaśaiva mantrotthāstato devaṃ vicintayet //
meaning:
जानुद्वयं जङ्घयोश्च पादयोर्विन्यसेत्क्रमात् /
अष्टादशैव मन्त्रोत्थास्ततो देवं विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: the two knees, the two shanks, and the two feet, one should successively perform ritual placement / of the eighteen [syllables] arising from the mantra; then one should meditate upon the god:

sanskrit_iast:
muktāgauraṃ ratnabhūṣaṃ candrasthaṃ bhṛṅgasannibhaiḥ /
alakairvilasadvaktraṃ kumbhaṃ śuddhāṃbupūritam //
meaning:
मुक्तागौरं रत्नभूषं चन्द्रस्थं भृङ्गसन्निभैः /
अलकैर्विलसद्वक्त्रं कुम्भं शुद्धांबुपूरितम् //
text_mt: White as a pearl, adorned with jewels, seated on the moon, with a face radiant / with locks of hair resembling black bees; holding in his two arms a water-jar filled with pure water

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyannapūrṇacaṣakaṃ dorbhyāṃ saṃdadhanaṃ bhajet /
lakṣatrayaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ghṛtaplutaiḥ //
meaning:
दध्यन्नपूर्णचषकं दोर्भ्यां संदधनं भजेत् /
लक्षत्रयं जपेन्मन्त्रं तद्दशांशं घृतप्लुतैः //
text_mt: and a cup filled with curd-rice, one should worship him. / One should recite the mantra three hundred thousand times, and offer one-tenth of that into the fire / with milk-rice steeped in clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasānnaiḥ prajuhuyāddadhyannena yathāvidhi /
candrānte kalpite pīṭhe pūrvokteṃ pūjayeñca tam //
meaning:
पायसान्नैः प्रजुहुयाद्दध्यन्नेन यथाविधि /
चन्द्रान्ते कल्पिते पीठे पूर्वोक्तें पूजयेञ्च तम् //
text_mt: and with curd-rice, according to the rule. / And on the previously described ritual seat visualized within the lunar orb, one should worship him.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpamūrtimūlena saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ /
kesareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni saṃpūjya digdaleṣu ca //
meaning:
संकल्पमूर्तिमूलेन संपूज्य च विधानतः /
केसरेषु षडङ्गानि संपूज्य दिग्दलेषु च //
text_mt: Having conceived the form with the root [mantra] and worshiped him according to rule, / having worshiped the six limbs on the filaments, and on the directional petals:

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnamaniruddhakam /
koṇapatreṣu śāntiṃ ca śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ ratim //
meaning:
वासुदेवं संकर्षणं प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धकम् /
कोणपत्रेषु शान्तिं च श्रियं सरस्वतीं रतिम् //
text_mt: Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; / on the corner petals, Śānti, Śrī, Sarasvatī, and Rati;

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajaṃ ca vainateyaṃ ca kaustubhaṃ vanamālikam /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śārṅgaṃ daleṣvaṣṭasu pūjayet //
meaning:
ध्वजं च वैनतेयं च कौस्तुभं वनमालिकम् /
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां शार्ङ्गं दलेष्वष्टसु पूजयेत् //
text_mt: and the flag, Garuḍa, the Kaustubha gem, the forest garland, / the conch, the discus, the mace, and the Śārṅga bow on the eight petals, one should worship.

sanskrit_iast:
dalāgreṣu keśavādīndikpālāṃstadanantaram /
tadastrāṇi ca sampūjya gajānaṣṭau samarcayet //
meaning:
दलाग्रेषु केशवादीन्दिक्पालांस्तदनन्तरम् /
तदस्त्राणि च सम्पूज्य गजानष्टौ समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: At the tips of the petals, one should worship the deities beginning with Keśava, then the guardians of the directions / and their weapons, and then worship the eight elephants [of the quarters]:

sanskrit_iast:
airāvataḥ puṇḍarīko vāmanaḥ kumudāeṃ'janaḥ /
puṣpadantaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ supratīkaśca diggajāḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदाएंऽजनः /
पुष्पदन्तः सार्वभौमः सुप्रतीकश्च दिग्गजाः //
text_mt: Airāvata, Puṇḍarīka, Vāmana, Kumuda, Añjana, / Puṣpadanta, Sārvabhauma, and Supratīka are the quarter-elephants;

sanskrit_iast:
kariṇyo 'bhramukapilopiṅgalānupamāḥ kramāt /
tāmrakarṇī śubhradantī cāṅganā hyañjanā vatī //
meaning:
करिण्यो ऽभ्रमुकपिलोपिङ्गलानुपमाः क्रमात् /
ताम्रकर्णी शुभ्रदन्ती चाङ्गना ह्यञ्जना वती //
text_mt: their female elephants in order are Abhramu, Kapilā, Piṅgalā, Anupamā, / Tāmrakarṇī, Śubhradantī, Aṅganā, and Añjanāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
evamārādhito mantrī dadyādiṣṭāni mantriṇe /
śrīkāmaḥ pāyasājyena sahasraṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ //
meaning:
एवमाराधितो मन्त्री दद्यादिष्टानि मन्त्रिणे /
श्रीकामः पायसाज्येन सहस्रं जुहुयात्सुधीः //
text_mt: Thus propitiated, [the deity] grants desires to the mantra-practitioner. / Desiring prosperity, the wise practitioner should make a thousand fire oblations with milk-rice and clarified butter;

sanskrit_iast:
mahatīṃ śriyamāpnoti dhānyāptirdhānya homataḥ /
śatapuṣpāsamutthaiśca bījairhutvā sahasrataḥ //
meaning:
महतीं श्रियमाप्नोति धान्याप्तिर्धान्य होमतः /
शतपुष्पासमुत्थैश्च बीजैर्हुत्वा सहस्रतः //
text_mt: he attains great prosperity, and from offering grain into the fire comes the acquisition of grain. / And having offered a thousand times with seeds produced from fennel [śatapuṣpā],

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhayaṃ nāśayeddhi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
daddhyodanena śuddhena hutvā mucyate durgateḥ //
meaning:
महाभयं नाशयेद्धि नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
दद्ध्योदनेन शुद्धेन हुत्वा मुच्यते दुर्गतेः //
text_mt: he will surely destroy great danger; no doubt should be entertained here. / Having offered pure curd-rice into the fire, he is freed from misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā traivikramaṃ rūpaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ /
kārāgṛhādbhavanmukto baddho mantraprabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा त्रैविक्रमं रूपं जपेन्मन्त्रं समाहितः /
कारागृहाद्भवन्मुक्तो बद्धो मन्त्रप्रभावतः //
text_mt: Meditating upon the Trivikrama form, one should recite the mantra with focused mind; / a bound person becomes freed from prison through the power of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhittau saṃpādya deveśaṃ phalake vā prapūjayet /
nityaṃ sugandhakusumairmahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
भित्तौ संपाद्य देवेशं फलके वा प्रपूजयेत् /
नित्यं सुगन्धकुसुमैर्महतीं श्रियमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having depicted the Lord of gods upon a wall or on a wooden tablet, one should worship him / daily with fragrant flowers; he shall attain great prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā raktotpalairmantrī vaśayetsakalaṃ jagat /
annājyairjuhuyānnityamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
हुत्वा रक्तोत्पलैर्मन्त्री वशयेत्सकलं जगत् /
अन्नाज्यैर्जुहुयान्नित्यमष्टाविंशतिसंख्यया //
text_mt: Having offered red lotuses into the fire, the mantra-practitioner subjugates the entire world. / One should daily make twenty-eight fire oblations with food and clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
sitājyānnaṃ ca vidhivatprāpnuyādannamakṣayam /
apūpaiḥ ṣaḍrasopetairhunedvasusahasrakam //
meaning:
सिताज्यान्नं च विधिवत्प्राप्नुयादन्नमक्षयम् /
अपूपैः षड्रसोपेतैर्हुनेद्वसुसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: and white food with clarified butter according to rule; he shall obtain inexhaustible food. / One should offer eight thousand [oblations] of cakes endowed with the six tastes;

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣmīṃ ca parābhūya mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt /
juhuyādayutaṃ mantrī dadhyannaṃ ca sitānvitam //
meaning:
अलक्ष्मीं च पराभूय महतीं श्रियमाप्नुयात् /
जुहुयादयुतं मन्त्री दध्यन्नं च सितान्वितम् //
text_mt: having overcome misfortune [Alakṣmī], he shall attain great prosperity. / The mantra-practitioner should offer into the fire ten thousand [oblations] of curd-rice mixed with sugar;

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra vasetso 'pi tatrānnagirimāpnuyāt /
padmākṣarairyutaṃ bilvāntikastho juhuyānnaraḥ //
meaning:
यत्र यत्र वसेत्सो ऽपि तत्रान्नगिरिमाप्नुयात् /
पद्माक्षरैर्युतं बिल्वान्तिकस्थो जुहुयान्नरः //
text_mt: wherever he may dwell, there he shall obtain a mountain of food. / A man standing near a bilva tree, offering [oblations] with lotus seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmīṃ sa labhate tatra tatra na saṃśayaḥ /
juhuyātpāyasairlakṣaṃ vācaspatisamo bhavet //
meaning:
महालक्ष्मीं स लभते तत्र तत्र न संशयः /
जुहुयात्पायसैर्लक्षं वाचस्पतिसमो भवेत् //
text_mt: obtains Mahālakṣmī; there is no doubt in this anywhere. / One who offers a hundred thousand [oblations] of milk-rice becomes equal to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśaṃ putrajīvaphalairhunet /
tatkāṣṭairedhite vahnau śreṣṭhaṃ putramavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
लक्षं जप्त्वा तद्दशांशं पुत्रजीवफलैर्हुनेत् /
तत्काष्टैरेधिते वह्नौ श्रेष्ठं पुत्रमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having recited [the mantra] a hundred thousand times, one should offer one-tenth of that with putrajīva fruits / into a fire kindled with its wood; he shall obtain an excellent son.

sanskrit_iast:
sasādhyatāraṃ vilasatkarṇikaṃ ca suvarṇakaiḥ /
vilasatkesaraṃ mantrākṣaradvandvāṣṭapatrakam //
meaning:
ससाध्यतारं विलसत्कर्णिकं च सुवर्णकैः /
विलसत्केसरं मन्त्राक्षरद्वन्द्वाष्टपत्रकम् //
text_mt: The pericarp shining with the Tāra [Oṃ] and the name of the person to be influenced, glowing golden / filaments, an eight-petalled lotus bearing the syllables of the mantra in pairs,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣayugmārṇāntyapatraṃ dvādaśākṣaraveṣṭitam /
tadbahirmātṛkāvarṇairyantraṃ sampatpradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
शेषयुग्मार्णान्त्यपत्रं द्वादशाक्षरवेष्टितम् /
तद्बहिर्मातृकावर्णैर्यन्त्रं सम्पत्प्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: with the last petal bearing the remaining pair of syllables, surrounded by the twelve syllables, / and outside that surrounded by the letters of the alphabet: this yantra bestows wealth upon men.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ trivikramaṃ dhyātvā prasūnai raktavarṇakaiḥ /
juhuyādayutaṃ mantrī sarvatra vijayī bhavet //
meaning:
रक्तं त्रिविक्रमं ध्यात्वा प्रसूनै रक्तवर्णकैः /
जुहुयादयुतं मन्त्री सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् //
text_mt: Meditating upon red Trivikrama, the mantra-practitioner should offer into the fire / ten thousand red-coloured blossoms; he becomes victorious everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyeñcandrāsanagataṃ padmānāmayutaṃ hunet /
labhedakaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam //
meaning:
ध्यायेञ्चन्द्रासनगतं पद्मानामयुतं हुनेत् /
लभेदकण्टकं राज्यं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् //
text_mt: One should meditate on him seated on a lunar seat and offer ten thousand lotuses into the fire; / he shall obtain a kingdom free of thorns, endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā lavaṅgairmadhvāktairapāmārgadalaistu vā /
ayutaṃ sādhyanāmāḍhyaṃ sa vaśyo jāyate dhruvam //
meaning:
हुत्वा लवङ्गैर्मध्वाक्तैरपामार्गदलैस्तु वा /
अयुतं साध्यनामाढ्यं स वश्यो जायते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Having offered into the fire ten thousand cloves smeared with honey, or leaves of apāmārga, / joined with the name of the person to be influenced, that person surely becomes subjugated.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā hyapāmārgadalaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
tāvajjaptvā ca saptāhānmahārogātpramucyate //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं हुत्वा ह्यपामार्गदलैः शुभैः /
तावज्जप्त्वा च सप्ताहान्महारोगात्प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having offered one hundred and eight times with auspicious apāmārga leaves / and recited that many times for seven days, he is freed from serious illness.

sanskrit_iast:
uhiratpadamābhāṣya praṇavohīya śabdataḥ /
sarvavārgīśvaretyante pravadedīśvaretyatha //
meaning:
उहिरत्पदमाभाष्य प्रणवोहीय शब्दतः /
सर्ववार्गीश्वरेत्यन्ते प्रवदेदीश्वरेत्यथ //
text_mt: Having uttered the word 'uhir', followed by the Praṇava [Oṃ] and 'hīya', / followed by 'sarvavāgīśvara', then one should utter 'īśvara';

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedamayācintyapadānte sarvamīrayet /
bodhayadvitavānto 'yaṃ mantrastārādirīritaḥ //
meaning:
सर्ववेदमयाचिन्त्यपदान्ते सर्वमीरयेत् /
बोधयद्वितवान्तो ऽयं मन्त्रस्तारादिरीरितः //
text_mt: at the end of the words 'sarvavedamayācintya', one should utter 'sarvaṃ'; / ending with 'bodhaya bodhaya', this mantra is declared to begin with the Tāra [Oṃ].

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirbrahmāsya nirdiṣṭaśchando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam /
devatā syāddhayagrīvo vāgaiśvaryaprado vibhuḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिर्ब्रह्मास्य निर्दिष्टश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुबुदाहृतम् /
देवता स्याद्धयग्रीवो वागैश्वर्यप्रदो विभुः //
text_mt: Its sage is indicated as Brahmā, the metre is declared to be Anuṣṭubh, / the deity is Hayagrīva, the all-pervading lord who grants mastery of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
tāreṇa pādairmantrasya pañcāṅgāni prakalpayet /
tuṣārādrisamacchāyaṃ tulasīdāmabhūṣitam //
meaning:
तारेण पादैर्मन्त्रस्य पञ्चाङ्गानि प्रकल्पयेत् /
तुषाराद्रिसमच्छायं तुलसीदामभूषितम् //
text_mt: With the Tāra [Oṃ] and the quarters of the mantra, one should form the five limbs. / [Meditate upon him] having the hue of the snowy mountain, adorned with a garland of tulasī,

sanskrit_iast:
turaṅgavadanaṃ vande tuṅgasārasvataḥ padam /
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapenmantramayutaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
तुरङ्गवदनं वन्दे तुङ्गसारस्वतः पदम् /
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रमयुतं तद्दशांशतः //
text_mt: "I bow to the horse-faced one", and the word "tuṅgasārasvataḥ". / Having meditated thus, one should recite the mantra ten thousand times; a tenth part of that

sanskrit_iast:
madhvaktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā vimalādisamanvite /
pūjayedveṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ //
meaning:
मध्वक्तैः पायसैर्हुत्वा विमलादिसमन्विते /
पूजयेद्वेष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः //
text_mt: having offered in fire with sweet porridge mixed with honey, / one should worship upon a Vaiṣṇava pīṭha furnished with Vimalā and the rest, conceiving the form from the root [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikāyāṃ caturdikṣu yajetpūrvāditaḥ kramāt /
sanandanaṃ ca sanakaṃ śriyaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ tathā //
meaning:
कर्णिकायां चतुर्दिक्षु यजेत्पूर्वादितः क्रमात् /
सनन्दनं च सनकं श्रियं च पृथिवीं तथा //
text_mt: On the pericarp in the four directions, one should worship in order starting from the east: / Sanandana, Sanaka, Śrī, and likewise the Earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvahirdikṣu vedāśca ṣaṭkoṇeṣu tator'cayet /
niruktaṃ jyotiṣaṃ paścādyajedvyākaraṇaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तद्वहिर्दिक्षु वेदाश्च षट्कोणेषु ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
निरुक्तं ज्योतिषं पश्चाद्यजेद्व्याकरणं ततः //
text_mt: Outside that, in the directions, the Vedas; and then one should worship in the six corners: / Nirukta, Jyotiṣa, and next one should worship Vyākaraṇa; then

sanskrit_iast:
kalpaṃ śikṣāṃ ca chandāṃsi vedāṅgāni tvimāni vai /
tato 'ṣṭadalamūle tu mātaro 'ṣṭau samarcayet //
meaning:
कल्पं शिक्षां च छन्दांसि वेदाङ्गानि त्विमानि वै /
ततो ऽष्टदलमूले तु मातरो ऽष्टौ समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Kalpa, Śikṣā, and the meters—truly these auxiliary limbs of the Veda. / Then, at the root of the eight petals, one should worship the eight Mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
vakratuṇḍādikānaṣṭo dalamadhye prapūjayet /
dalāgreṣyarcayetpaścātsādhakaścāṣṭabhairavān //
meaning:
वक्रतुण्डादिकानष्टो दलमध्ये प्रपूजयेत् /
दलाग्रेष्यर्चयेत्पश्चात्साधकश्चाष्टभैरवान् //
text_mt: One should worship the eight beginning with Vakratuṇḍa in the middle of the petals; / and then at the tips of the petals the practitioner should worship the eight Bhairavas:

sanskrit_iast:
asitāṅgaṃ ruruṃ caiva bhīṣaṇaṃ raktakanetrakam /
baṭukaṃ kāladamanaṃ danturaṃ vikaṭaṃ tathā //
meaning:
असिताङ्गं रुरुं चैव भीषणं रक्तकनेत्रकम् /
बटुकं कालदमनं दन्तुरं विकटं तथा //
text_mt: Asitāṅga, Ruru, Bhīṣaṇa, Raktakanetra, / Baṭuka, Kāladamana, Dantura, and Vikaṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśadaleṣvavatārānharerdaśa /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ nandakaṃ śārṅgameva ca //
meaning:
तद्बहिः षोडशदलेष्ववतारान्हरेर्दश /
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां पद्मं नन्दकं शार्ङ्गमेव च //
text_mt: Outside that, on the sixteen petals, the ten incarnations of Hari, / the conch, discus, mace, lotus, Nandaka, and the Śārṅga bow.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbahirbhūgṛhe śakramukhāndaśa digīśvarān /
vajrādyāṃstadbahiśceṣṭvādvāreṣu ca tataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
तद्बहिर्भूगृहे शक्रमुखान्दश दिगीश्वरान् /
वज्राद्यांस्तद्बहिश्चेष्ट्वाद्वारेषु च ततः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Outside that, in the earth-enclosure, the ten lords of the directions headed by Indra; / and having worshipped outside that the [weapons] beginning with the thunderbolt, then in order at the doors:

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgaṇapatiṃ durgāṃ kṣetreśaṃ baṭukaṃ tathā /
samastaprakaṭādyāśca yoginyastadbahirbhavet //
meaning:
महागणपतिं दुर्गां क्षेत्रेशं बटुकं तथा /
समस्तप्रकटाद्याश्च योगिन्यस्तद्बहिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Mahāgaṇapati, Durgā, the lord of the field, and likewise Baṭuka; / and outside that should be all the Yoginīs, Prakaṭā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbahiḥ sapta nadyaśca tadbāhye tu grahānnava /
tadbāhye parvatānaṣṭau nakṣatrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ //
meaning:
तद्बहिः सप्त नद्यश्च तद्बाह्ये तु ग्रहान्नव /
तद्बाह्ये पर्वतानष्टौ नक्षत्राणि च तद्बहिः //
text_mt: Outside that, the seven rivers; outside that, the nine planets; / outside that, the eight mountains; and outside that, the lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañcadaśāvṛttyā saṃpūjya turagānanam /
vāgīśvarasamo vāci dhanairdhanapatirbhavet //
meaning:
एवं पञ्चदशावृत्त्या संपूज्य तुरगाननम् /
वागीश्वरसमो वाचि धनैर्धनपतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the horse-faced one through fifteen enclosures, / he becomes equal to the lord of speech in eloquence, and a Kubera in riches.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānkartumarhati /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu śuddhaṃ vāryabhimantritam //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री प्रयोगान्कर्तुमर्हति /
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु शुद्धं वार्यभिमन्त्रितम् //
text_mt: The mantra being thus accomplished, the mantra-practitioner may perform ritual applications. / Pure water consecrated one thousand and eight times

sanskrit_iast:
bījena māsamātraṃ yaḥ pibeddhīmān jitandriyaḥ /
janmamūko 'pi sa naro vāksiddhiṃ labhate dhruvam //
meaning:
बीजेन मासमात्रं यः पिबेद्धीमान् जितन्द्रियः /
जन्ममूको ऽपि स नरो वाक्सिद्धिं लभते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: with the seed-syllable, which a wise man of subdued senses drinks for just a month— / even if born mute, that man certainly attains mastery of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
viyadbhugusthamardhīrābindumadbījamīritam /
candrasūryoparāge tu pātre rukmamaye kṣipet //
meaning:
वियद्भुगुस्थमर्धीराबिन्दुमद्बीजमीरितम् /
चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे तु पात्रे रुक्ममये क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: The seed-syllable is declared to be [the letter] residing on Bhrgu and the sky, endowed with the half-moon and the dot. / During an eclipse of the moon or sun, one should place in a golden vessel

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhaṃ vacāṃ tato mantrī kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitaḥ /
sparśādvimokṣaparyantaṃ prajapenmantramādarāt //
meaning:
दुग्धं वचां ततो मन्त्री कण्ठमात्रोदके स्थितः /
स्पर्शाद्विमोक्षपर्यन्तं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रमादरात् //
text_mt: milk and sweet-flag; then, standing in neck-deep water, / the mantra-practitioner should devotedly recite the mantra from the beginning of the contact to the release [of the eclipse].

sanskrit_iast:
pibettatsarvamacirāttasya sārasvataṃ bhavet /
jyotiṣmatīlatābījaṃ dineṣvekaikavarddhitam //
meaning:
पिबेत्तत्सर्वमचिरात्तस्य सारस्वतं भवेत् /
ज्योतिष्मतीलताबीजं दिनेष्वेकैकवर्द्धितम् //
text_mt: He should drink all of that; quickly he will attain the state of Sarasvatī. / Seeds of the jyotiṣmatī creeper, increased by one each day,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvadbhakṣayedabhimantritam /
sarasvatyavatāro 'sau satyaṃ syādbhuvi mānavaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं यावद्भक्षयेदभिमन्त्रितम् /
सरस्वत्यवतारो ऽसौ सत्यं स्याद्भुवि मानवः //
text_mt: he should eat consecrated up to one hundred and eight; / that mortal on earth will truly become an incarnation of Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
kirṃ bahūktena viprendra manorasya prasādataḥ /
sarvavedāgamādīnāṃ vyākhyātā jñānavān bhavet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde hayagrīvopāsanānirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
किर्ं बहूक्तेन विप्रेन्द्र मनोरस्य प्रसादतः /
सर्ववेदागमादीनां व्याख्याता ज्ञानवान् भवेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने सनत्कुमारविभागे तृतीयपादे हयग्रीवोपासनानिरूपणं नाम द्विसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
What need is there of saying more, O foremost of Brahmins? By the grace of this mantra, / one becomes a knower, an expounder of all the Vedas, Āgamas, and the rest.

Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, entitled "The Description of the Worship of Hayagrīva," in the third quarter of the Sanatkumāra section, in the Great Narrative of the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha rāmasya manavo vakṣyante siddhidāyākāḥ /
yeṣāmārādhanānmartyāstaranti bhavasāgaram //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ रामस्य मनवो वक्ष्यन्ते सिद्धिदायाकाः /
येषामाराधनान्मर्त्यास्तरन्ति भवसागरम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Now the success-granting mantras of Rāma will be declared, / through the worship of which mortals cross over the ocean of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu mantravaryeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate /
gāṇapatyeṣu saureṣu śāktaśaiveṣvabhīṣṭadam //
meaning:
सर्वेषु मन्त्रवर्येषु श्रेष्ठं वैष्णवमुच्यते /
गाणपत्येषु सौरेषु शाक्तशैवेष्वभीष्टदम् //
text_mt: Among all the best mantras, the Vaiṣṇava [mantra] is declared the highest; / among the Gāṇapatya, Saura, Śākta, and Śaiva, it grants desired desires.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇaveṣvapi mantreṣu rāmamantrāḥ phalādhikāḥ /
gāṇapatyādimantrebhyaḥ koṭikoṭiguṇādhikāḥ //
meaning:
वैष्णवेष्वपि मन्त्रेषु राममन्त्राः फलाधिकाः /
गाणपत्यादिमन्त्रेभ्यः कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकाः //
text_mt: Even among Vaiṣṇava mantras, the Rāma mantras bear greater fruit; / they are millions upon millions of times superior to mantras of the Gāṇapatya and other deities.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuśayyāsthito vahnirindubhūṣitamastakaḥ /
rāmāya hṛdayānto 'yaṃ mahāghaudhavināśanaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुशय्यास्थितो वह्निरिन्दुभूषितमस्तकः /
रामाय हृदयान्तो ऽयं महाघौधविनाशनः //
text_mt: Fire situated on Viṣṇu's bed, its head adorned with the moon, / with "rāmāya" and ending in "hṛdaya" [namaḥ]—this destroys a multitude of great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu rāmamantraṣu hyatiśreṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ /
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi jñātājñātakṛtāni ca //
meaning:
सर्वेषु राममन्त्रषु ह्यतिश्रेष्ठः षडक्षरः /
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्राणि ज्ञाताज्ञातकृतानि च //
text_mt: Among all Rāma mantras, this six-syllabled one is supreme. / Thousands of slaughters of Brahmins committed knowingly or unknowingly,

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇasteya surāpānagurutalpāyutāni ca /
koṭikoṭisahasrāṇi hyupapāpāni yāni vai //
meaning:
स्वर्णस्तेय सुरापानगुरुतल्पायुतानि च /
कोटिकोटिसहस्राणि ह्युपपापानि यानि वै //
text_mt: tens of thousands of thefts of gold, drinkings of liquor, and violatings of the teacher's bed, / and whatever secondary sins exist by the thousands of tens of millions—

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasyoñcāraṇātsadyo layaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ /
brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando rāmaśca devatā //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्योञ्चारणात्सद्यो लयं यान्ति न संशयः /
ब्रह्मा मुनिः स्याद्गायत्री छन्दो रामश्च देवता //
