text_mt: by the pronunciation of the mantra they instantly dissolve, there is no doubt. / Brahmā is the sage, the meter is gāyatrī, and Rāma is the deity;

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ bījaṃ ca hṛcchaktirviniyogo 'khilāptaye /
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
आद्यं बीजं च हृच्छक्तिर्विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
षड्दीर्घभाजा बीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: the initial [syllable] is the seed-syllable, the heart-phrase is the power, and the ritual application is for the attainment of all [aims]. / With the seed-syllable taking the six long vowels, one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarandhre bhruvormadhye hṛnnābhyorguhyapādayoḥ /
mantravarṇānkramānnyasya keśavādīnpravinyaset //
meaning:
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे भ्रुवोर्मध्ये हृन्नाभ्योर्गुह्यपादयोः /
मन्त्रवर्णान्क्रमान्न्यस्य केशवादीन्प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt: At the aperture of Brahman, between the eyebrows, at the heart, the navel, the genitals, and the feet, / placing the syllables of the mantra in order, one should ritually place Keśava and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyeddhṛdi raghūttamam /
kālāṃbhodharakāntaṃ ca vīrā sanasamāsthitam //
meaning:
पीठन्यासादिकं कृत्वा ध्यायेद्धृदि रघूत्तमम् /
कालांभोधरकान्तं च वीरा सनसमास्थितम् //
text_mt: Having performed the ritual placement on the seat and so on, one should meditate in the heart upon the best of the Raghu lineage: / lovely as a dark raincloud, seated in the hero's posture,

sanskrit_iast:
jñānamudrāṃ dakṣahaste dadhataṃ jānunītaram /
saroruhakarāṃ sītāṃ vidyudābhāṃ ca pārśvagām //
meaning:
ज्ञानमुद्रां दक्षहस्ते दधतं जानुनीतरम् /
सरोरुहकरां सीतां विद्युदाभां च पार्श्वगाम् //
text_mt: holding the gesture of wisdom with his right hand and placing the other upon his knee; / with Sītā at his side, brilliant as lightning, holding a lotus in her hand,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyantīṃ rāmavakrābjaṃ vividhākalpabhūṣitām /
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
पश्यन्तीं रामवक्राब्जं विविधाकल्पभूषिताम् /
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेद्वर्णलक्षं मन्त्री दशांशतः //
text_mt: gazing upon Rāma's lotus-face, adorned with various ornaments. / Having meditated thus, the mantra-practitioner should recite one hundred thousand times per syllable; a tenth part of that

sanskrit_iast:
kamalairjuhuyādvahnau brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ /
pūjayedvaiṣṇave pīṭhe vimalādisamanvite //
meaning:
कमलैर्जुहुयाद्वह्नौ ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः /
पूजयेद्वैष्णवे पीठे विमलादिसमन्विते //
text_mt: he should offer into fire with lotuses, and then feed Brahmins. / One should worship upon a Vaiṣṇava pīṭha furnished with Vimalā and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiṃ mūlena saṃkalpya tasyāmāvāhya sādhakaḥ /
sītāṃ vāme samāsīnāṃ tanmantreṇa prapūjayet //
meaning:
मूर्तिं मूलेन संकल्प्य तस्यामावाह्य साधकः /
सीतां वामे समासीनां तन्मन्त्रेण प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: conceiving the form by means of the root [mantra]; having invoked [the deity] into it, the practitioner / should worship Sītā seated on the left with her own mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ramāsītāpadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ dviṭhānto jānakīmanuḥ /
agreḥ śārṅgaṃ ca sampūjya śarānpārśvadvayer'cayet //
meaning:
रमासीतापदं ङेंतं द्विठान्तो जानकीमनुः /
अग्रेः शार्ङ्गं च सम्पूज्य शरान्पार्श्वद्वयेर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: The word "ramāsītā" in the dative, ending in "dviṭhā" [svāhā], is the mantra of Jānakī. / Having worshipped the Śārṅga bow in front, he should worship the arrows on both flanks.

sanskrit_iast:
keśareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni patreṣvetānsamarcayet /
hanumantaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ bharataṃ sabibhīṣaṇam //
meaning:
केशरेषु षडङ्गानि पत्रेष्वेतान्समर्चयेत् /
हनुमन्तं च सुग्रीवं भरतं सबिभीषणम् //
text_mt: On the filaments [he should worship] the six limbs; on the petals he should worship these: / Hanumān, Sugrīva, Bharata along with Vibhīṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇāṅgadaśatrughnān jāṃbavantaṃ kramātpunaḥ /
vācayantaṃ hanūmantagrato dhṛtapustakam //
meaning:
लक्ष्मणाङ्गदशत्रुघ्नान् जांबवन्तं क्रमात्पुनः /
वाचयन्तं हनूमन्तग्रतो धृतपुस्तकम् //
text_mt: Lakṣmaṇa, Aṅgada, Śatrughna, and Jāmbavān in succession; / Hanumān reciting in front, holding a book;

sanskrit_iast:
yajedbharataśatrughnau pārśvayordhṛtacāmarau /
dhṛtātapatraṃ hastābhyāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ pṛṣṭator'cayet //
meaning:
यजेद्भरतशत्रुघ्नौ पार्श्वयोर्धृतचामरौ /
धृतातपत्रं हस्ताभ्यां लक्ष्मणं पृष्टतोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: one should worship Bharata and Śatrughna at the sides holding chowries; / one should worship Lakṣmaṇa at the back holding an umbrella with both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ṣṭapatre sṛṣṭiṃ ca japantaṃ vijayaṃ tathā /
surāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭrapālaṃ ca akopaṃ dharmapālakam //
meaning:
ततो ऽष्टपत्रे सृष्टिं च जपन्तं विजयं तथा /
सुराष्ट्रं राष्ट्रपालं च अकोपं धर्मपालकम् //
text_mt: Then, on the eight petals, Sṛṣṭi, Japanta, Vijaya, / Surāṣṭra, Rāṣṭrapāla, Akopa, Dharmapālaka,

sanskrit_iast:
sumantaṃ ceti sampūjya loke śānāyudhairyutān /
evaṃ rāmaṃ samārādhya jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate //
meaning:
सुमन्तं चेति सम्पूज्य लोके शानायुधैर्युतान् /
एवं रामं समाराध्य जीवन्मुक्तः प्रजायते //
text_mt: and Sumanta—having worshipped these together with the guardians of the world and their weapons, / worshipping Rāma in this manner, one becomes liberated while alive.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāktaiḥ prajuhuyājjātīpuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ /
rājavaśyāya kamalairdhanadhānyādisiddhaye //
meaning:
चन्दनाक्तैः प्रजुहुयाज्जातीपुष्पैः समाहितः /
राजवश्याय कमलैर्धनधान्यादिसिद्धये //
text_mt: Concentrated, one should offer [into fire] jasmine flowers smeared with sandalwood paste / to subjugate kings, and lotuses for the attainment of wealth, grain, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīkāmaḥ prajuhuyātprasūnairvilvasaṃbhavaiḥ /
ājyāktairnīlakamalairvaśayedakhilaṃ jagat //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीकामः प्रजुहुयात्प्रसूनैर्विल्वसंभवैः /
आज्याक्तैर्नीलकमलैर्वशयेदखिलं जगत् //
text_mt: Desiring fortune, he should offer oblations with flowers born of the bilva tree; / with blue lotuses smeared with ghee he can subjugate the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtāktaśatavarvībhirdīrghāyuśca nirāmayaḥ /
raktotpalānāṃ homena dhanaṃ prāpnoti vāñchitam //
meaning:
घृताक्तशतवर्वीभिर्दीर्घायुश्च निरामयः /
रक्तोत्पलानां होमेन धनं प्राप्नोति वाञ्छितम् //
text_mt: With śatāvarī roots smeared with ghee, he attains long life and freedom from disease; / by a fire oblation of red lotuses, he obtains the desired wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
pālāśakusumairhutvā medhāvī jāyate naraḥ /
tajjaptāṃbhaḥ pibetprātarvatsarātkavirāḍ bhavet //
meaning:
पालाशकुसुमैर्हुत्वा मेधावी जायते नरः /
तज्जप्तांभः पिबेत्प्रातर्वत्सरात्कविराड् भवेत् //
text_mt: Offering oblations with palāśa blossoms, a man becomes endowed with intellect; / he should drink water recited over with it in the morning; after a year he becomes a king among poets.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmantritānnaṃ bhuñjītamahārogapraśāntaye /
rogoktauṣadhahomena tadrogānmucyate kṣaṇām //
meaning:
तन्मन्त्रितान्नं भुञ्जीतमहारोगप्रशान्तये /
रोगोक्तौषधहोमेन तद्रोगान्मुच्यते क्षणाम् //
text_mt: He should eat food consecrated with that mantra to pacify severe disease; / by offering a fire oblation of the medicine prescribed for the disease, he is freed from that illness in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīre ca goṣṭhe vā japellakṣaṃ payobrataḥ /
pāyasenājyayuktena hutvā vidyānidhirbhavet //
meaning:
नदीतीरे च गोष्ठे वा जपेल्लक्षं पयोब्रतः /
पायसेनाज्ययुक्तेन हुत्वा विद्यानिधिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Living on a milk diet, on a riverbank or in a cowshed, he should recite it one hundred thousand times; / offering oblations of milk-rice mixed with ghee, he becomes a treasure-house of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
parikṣīṇādhipatyo yaḥ śākāhāro jalāntare /
japellakṣaṃ ca juhuyādvilvapuṣpairdaśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
परिक्षीणाधिपत्यो यः शाकाहारो जलान्तरे /
जपेल्लक्षं च जुहुयाद्विल्वपुष्पैर्दशांशतः //
text_mt: One whose sovereignty has wasted away, eating only vegetables, [standing] in the water, / should recite it one hundred thousand times and offer oblations with bilva flowers to the extent of a tenth part.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva punarāpnoti svādhipatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
upoṣya gaṅgātīrānte sthitvā lakṣaṃ japennaraḥ //
meaning:
तदैव पुनराप्नोति स्वाधिपत्यं न संशयः /
उपोष्य गङ्गातीरान्ते स्थित्वा लक्षं जपेन्नरः //
text_mt: Then indeed he regains his own sovereignty; of this there is no doubt. / Having fasted and stayed upon the bank of the Gaṅgā, a man should recite a hundred thousand [times].

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā vilvotthairvā prasūnakaiḥ /
madhuratrayasaṃyuktairādajyaśriyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
दशांशं कमलैर्हुत्वा विल्वोत्थैर्वा प्रसूनकैः /
मधुरत्रयसंयुक्तैरादज्यश्रियमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Offering one-tenth [of that count] in fire oblations with lotuses, or with flowers from the bilva tree, / joined with the three sweets, he would attain royal fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgamāse jale sthitvā kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
lakṣaṃ japtvā daśāṃśena pāyasairjuhuyādvasau //
meaning:
मार्गमासे जले स्थित्वा कन्दमूलफलाशनः /
लक्षं जप्त्वा दशांशेन पायसैर्जुहुयाद्वसौ //
text_mt: Standing in water in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, eating roots and fruits, / having recited a hundred thousand [times], he should offer in fire oblation a tenth part with milk-rice into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmacandrasadṛśaḥ putraḥ pautro 'pi jāyate /
anye 'pi bahavaḥ saṃti prayogāmantrarājake //
meaning:
श्रीरामचन्द्रसदृशः पुत्रः पौत्रो ऽपि जायते /
अन्ये ऽपि बहवः संति प्रयोगामन्त्रराजके //
text_mt: A son or even a grandson resembling Śrī Rāmacandra is born [to him]. / There are also many other applications of this king of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu prayogakartṛāṇāṃ paraloko na vidyate /
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ ca tadbāhyārkadalaṃ likhet //
meaning:
किन्तु प्रयोगकर्तृआणां परलोको न विद्यते /
षट्कोणं वसुपत्रं च तद्बाह्यार्कदलं लिखेत् //
text_mt: However, for those who perform magical applications, the other world does not exist. / One should draw a hexagon, an eight-petalled [lotus], and outside it a twelve-petalled [lotus].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍarṇāni mantrasya vilikhed budhaḥ /
aṣṭapatre tathāṣṭārṇāṃllikhetpraṇavagarbhitān //
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडर्णानि मन्त्रस्य विलिखेद् बुधः /
अष्टपत्रे तथाष्टार्णांल्लिखेत्प्रणवगर्भितान् //
text_mt: In the hexagon, the wise man should write the six syllables of the mantra; / likewise on the eight petals he should write the eight syllables enveloped by the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmabījaṃ ravidale madhye mantrāvṛtābhidhām /
sudarśanāvṛtaṃ bāhye dikṣu yugmāvṛtaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कामबीजं रविदले मध्ये मन्त्रावृताभिधाम् /
सुदर्शनावृतं बाह्ये दिक्षु युग्मावृतं तथा //
text_mt: The seed-syllable of desire on the twelve petals, in the center the name surrounded by the mantra, / on the outside surrounded by Sudarśana, and likewise in the cardinal directions surrounded in pairs;

sanskrit_iast:
vajrollasadbhūmigehaṃ kandarpāṅkuśapāśakaiḥ /
bhūmyā ca vilasatkoṇaṃ yantrarājamidaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
वज्रोल्लसद्भूमिगेहं कन्दर्पाङ्कुशपाशकैः /
भूम्या च विलसत्कोणं यन्त्रराजमिदं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: an earthen chamber shining with vajras, with [the seed-syllables of] Kāmadeva, the elephant-goad, and the noose, / and its corners shining with the earth [seed-syllables]—this is commemorated as the king of yantras.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrje 'ṣṭagandhaiḥ saṃlikhya pūjayeduktavartmanā /
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dalārkābjānyāveṣṭavṛttayugmataḥ //
meaning:
भूर्जे ऽष्टगन्धैः संलिख्य पूजयेदुक्तवर्त्मना /
षट्कोणेषु दलार्काब्जान्यावेष्टवृत्तयुग्मतः //
text_mt: Writing it on birch bark with the eight fragrances, he should worship it according to the prescribed way. / In the hexagon, [the letters] around the petals of the twelve-petalled lotus enclosed by a pair of circles;

sanskrit_iast:
keśareṣvaṣṭapatrasya svaradvandvaṃ likhed budhaḥ /
bahistu mātṛkāṃ caiva mantraṃ prāṇanidhayanama //
meaning:
केशरेष्वष्टपत्रस्य स्वरद्वन्द्वं लिखेद् बुधः /
बहिस्तु मातृकां चैव मन्त्रं प्राणनिधयनम //
text_mt: on the filaments of the eight-petalled lotus the wise man should write the vowels in pairs; / and outside [he should write] the mātṛkā letters and the mantra, the abode of life-breath.

sanskrit_iast:
yantrametacchubhe ghasre kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje /
mūrdhni vā dhārayenmantrī sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
यन्त्रमेतच्छुभे घस्रे कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे भुजे /
मूर्ध्नि वा धारयेन्मन्त्री सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: On an auspicious day, the mantra-practitioner who wears this yantra on his throat, or on his right arm, / or on his head, is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sudine śubhanakṣatre sudeśe śalyavarjite /
vaśyākarṣaṇavidveṣadrāvaṇoccāṭanādikam //
meaning:
सुदिने शुभनक्षत्रे सुदेशे शल्यवर्जिते /
वश्याकर्षणविद्वेषद्रावणोच्चाटनादिकम् //
text_mt: On an auspicious day, under an auspicious constellation, in a good place free from buried bones, / [for the rites of] subjugation, attraction, causing enmity, routing, expulsion, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyadvayaṃ tathādityārdrāmaghāsu yathākramam /
dūrvotthā lekhanī vaśye tathākṛṣṭau karañjajā //
meaning:
पुष्यद्वयं तथादित्यार्द्रामघासु यथाक्रमम् /
दूर्वोत्था लेखनी वश्ये तथाकृष्टौ करञ्जजा //
text_mt: during the two Puṣyas, likewise under Āditya, Ārdrā, and Maghā, in regular order: / a pen made of dūrvā grass in subjugation, and one made from the karañja tree in attraction;

sanskrit_iast:
narāsthijā māraṇe tu staṃbhane rājavṛkṣajā /
śāntipuṣṭaṣṭyāyuṣāṃ siddhayai sarvāpacchamanāya ca //
meaning:
नरास्थिजा मारणे तु स्तंभने राजवृक्षजा /
शान्तिपुष्टष्ट्यायुषां सिद्धयै सर्वापच्छमनाय च //
text_mt: one made of human bone in eradication, but one from the rājavṛkṣa tree in immobilization; / for the attainment of pacification, nourishment, and longevity, and for the alleviation of all misfortunes,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhramotpādane caiva śilāyāṃ vilikhed budhaḥ /
kharacarmaṇi vidveṣe dhvaje tūñcāṭanāya ca //
meaning:
विभ्रमोत्पादने चैव शिलायां विलिखेद् बुधः /
खरचर्मणि विद्वेषे ध्वजे तूञ्चाटनाय च //
text_mt: and to produce delusion, the wise man should write upon a stone slab; / upon donkey's hide to cause enmity, and upon a flag for expulsion;

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūṇāṃ jvarasantāpaśokamāraṇakarmaṇi /
pītavasraṃ likhitvā tu sādhayetsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
शत्रूणां ज्वरसन्तापशोकमारणकर्मणि /
पीतवस्रं लिखित्वा तु साधयेत्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: for fever, torment, sorrow, and eradication of enemies, / having written upon a yellow cloth, the excellent practitioner should accomplish it.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśyākṛṣṭau cāṣṭagandhaiḥ sampūjya ca yathāvidhi /
citāṅgārādinā caiva tāḍanoccāṭanādikam //
meaning:
वश्याकृष्टौ चाष्टगन्धैः सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि /
चिताङ्गारादिना चैव ताडनोच्चाटनादिकम् //
text_mt: In subjugation and attraction, having worshipped properly with the eight fragrances, / and with funeral-pyre charcoal and the like for beating, expulsion, and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣārkakṣīrayogena māraṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam /
likhitvaivaṃ yantrarājaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet //
meaning:
विषार्कक्षीरयोगेन मारणं भवति ध्रुवम् /
लिखित्वैवं यन्त्रराजं गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् //
text_mt: by using poison and milk from the arka plant, eradication certainly takes place. / Having drawn the king of yantras in this way, he should worship it with fragrant paste, flowers, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
trilohaveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā dhārayetsādhakottamaḥ /
bījaṃ rāmāya ṭhadvandvaṃ mantro 'yaṃ rasavarṇakaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिलोहवेष्टितं कृत्वा धारयेत्साधकोत्तमः /
बीजं रामाय ठद्वन्द्वं मन्त्रो ऽयं रसवर्णकः //
text_mt: Having enclosed it with the three metals, the excellent practitioner should wear it. / The seed-syllable, 'to Rāma', and the pair of ṭhas: this mantra has six syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsudarśanamanuḥ kathyate siddhidāyakaḥ /
sudarśanamahāśabdāccakrarājeśvareti ca //
meaning:
महासुदर्शनमनुः कथ्यते सिद्धिदायकः /
सुदर्शनमहाशब्दाच्चक्रराजेश्वरेति च //
text_mt: The great Sudarśana mantra, granting accomplishments, is proclaimed: / after the great words 'Sudarśana' and 'lord of the king of wheels',

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭāntakaduṣṭabhayānakaduṣṭabhayaṅkaram /
chindhidvayaṃ bhindhiyugmaṃ vidārayayugaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
दुष्टान्तकदुष्टभयानकदुष्टभयङ्करम् /
छिन्धिद्वयं भिन्धियुग्मं विदारययुगं ततः //
text_mt: 'destroyer of the wicked, terrifying to the wicked, terrifying the wicked', / a pair of 'cut', a pair of 'split', then a pair of 'tear open';

sanskrit_iast:
paramantrān grasadvandvaṃ bhakṣayadvitayaṃ tataḥ /
trāsayadvitayaṃ varmāstrāgnijāyāntimo manuḥ //
meaning:
परमन्त्रान् ग्रसद्वन्द्वं भक्षयद्वितयं ततः /
त्रासयद्वितयं वर्मास्त्राग्निजायान्तिमो मनुः //
text_mt: 'devour the mantras of others' twice, then a pair of 'eat', / a pair of 'frighten', the armor, the weapon, and ending with the wife of fire: such is the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyakṣaraḥ prokto yantrasaṃveṣṭane tvayam /
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃto ṅeṃto hi raghunandanaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टषष्ट्यक्षरः प्रोक्तो यन्त्रसंवेष्टने त्वयम् /
तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतो ङेंतो हि रघुनन्दनः //
text_mt: This [mantra] of sixty-eight syllables is prescribed for encircling the yantra. / The oṃkāra, 'hṛt', 'the Lord' in the dative case, and indeed 'the delight of Raghu' in the dative case;

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣoghnaviśadāyānte madhurādiprasanna ca /
varadānāyāmitānte nutejasepadamīrayet //
meaning:
रक्षोघ्नविशदायान्ते मधुरादिप्रसन्न च /
वरदानायामितान्ते नुतेजसेपदमीरयेत् //
text_mt: ending with 'bright slayer of demons', and 'pleasing' beginning with 'sweet', / ending with 'boundless for granting boons', one should utter the word 'to the lustrous one';

sanskrit_iast:
bālāyānte tu rāmāya viṣṇave hṛdayāntimaḥ /
saptacatvāriṃśadarṇo mālāmantro 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
बालायान्ते तु रामाय विष्णवे हृदयान्तिमः /
सप्तचत्वारिंशदर्णो मालामन्त्रो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: then ending with 'the boy', 'to Rāma', 'to Viṣṇu', and ending with 'hṛdaya'— / this garland mantra of forty-seven syllables has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro muniścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam /
śrīrāmo devatā bījaṃ dhruvaḥ śaktiśca ṭhadvayam //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रो मुनिश्चास्य गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् /
श्रीरामो देवता बीजं ध्रुवः शक्तिश्च ठद्वयम् //
text_mt: Viśvāmitra is its seer, and the gāyatrī is declared its meter; / Śrī Rāma is the deity, the seed-syllable is dhruva, and the power is the pair of ṭhas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghasvarayugmāyābījenāṅgāni kalpayet /
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasya pūrvavadācaret //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घस्वरयुग्मायाबीजेनाङ्गानि कल्पयेत् /
ध्यानपूजादिकं सर्वमस्य पूर्ववदाचरेत् //
text_mt: With the seed-syllable joined to the six long vowels, one should perform the [six] limbs. / One should perform all its meditation, worship, and so on as before.

sanskrit_iast:
ayamārādhito mantraḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchati /
svakāmasatyavāglakṣmītārāḍhyaḥ pañcavarṇakaḥ //
meaning:
अयमाराधितो मन्त्रः सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति /
स्वकामसत्यवाग्लक्ष्मीताराढ्यः पञ्चवर्णकः //
text_mt: This mantra, when worshipped, bestows all desired things. / Endowed with one's desired [seed-syllables] of truth, speech, Lakṣmī, and oṃkāra, the five-syllable [mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāñcaturvargaphalapradaḥ /
brahmā saṃmohanaḥ śaktirdakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
षडक्षरः षड्विधः स्याञ्चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदः /
ब्रह्मा संमोहनः शक्तिर्दक्षिणामूर्तिसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: becomes sixfold with six syllables, bestowing the fruit of the four goals of life. / Brahmā, Saṃmohana, Śakti, and the one named Dakṣiṇāmūrti,

sanskrit_iast:
agastyaḥ śrīśivaḥ proktāste teṣāṃ munayaḥ kramāt /
athavā kāmabījāderviśvāmitro muniḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्यः श्रीशिवः प्रोक्तास्ते तेषां मुनयः क्रमात् /
अथवा कामबीजादेर्विश्वामित्रो मुनिः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Agastya, and Śrī Śiva are declared to be their respective seers in order. / Alternatively, for the one beginning with the seed-syllable of desire, Viśvāmitra is remembered as the seer;

sanskrit_iast:
chandaḥ proktaṃ ca gāyatrī śrīrāmo devatā punaḥ /
bījaśaktirādhamāntyaṃ mantrārṇaiḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
छन्दः प्रोक्तं च गायत्री श्रीरामो देवता पुनः /
बीजशक्तिराधमान्त्यं मन्त्रार्णैः स्यात्षडङ्गकम् //
text_mt: the meter is declared to be gāyatrī, and the deity again is Śrī Rāma. / The seed-syllable and power are the first and the last; the six limbs are formed with the syllables of the mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
bījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktairvā mantrārṇānpūrvavannyaset /
dhyāyetkalpatarormūle suvarṇamayamaṇḍape //
meaning:
बीजैः षड्दीर्घयुक्तैर्वा मन्त्रार्णान्पूर्ववन्न्यसेत् /
ध्यायेत्कल्पतरोर्मूले सुवर्णमयमण्डपे //
text_mt: or with the seed-syllables joined with the six long vowels; one should assign the syllables of the mantra as before. / One should meditate [upon him] at the root of the wish-fulfilling tree in a pavilion made of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpakākhyavimānāntaḥ siṃhāsanaparicchade /
padme vasudaledevamindranīlasamaprabham //
meaning:
पुष्पकाख्यविमानान्तः सिंहासनपरिच्छदे /
पद्मे वसुदलेदेवमिन्द्रनीलसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: inside the aerial chariot named Puṣpaka, adorned with a throne, / on an eight-petalled lotus: the God, shining like sapphire,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāsanasamāsīnaṃ jñānamudropaśobhitam /
vāmorunyastataddhastasītālakṣmaṇasevitam //
meaning:
वीरासनसमासीनं ज्ञानमुद्रोपशोभितम् /
वामोरुन्यस्ततद्धस्तसीतालक्ष्मणसेवितम् //
text_mt: seated in the heroic posture, adorned with the gesture of knowledge, / with that [same] hand placed upon his left thigh, attended by Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
ratnākalpaṃ vibhundhyātvā varṇalakṣaṃ japenmanum /
yadvā smārādimantrāṇāṃ jayābhaṃ ca hariṃ smaret //
meaning:
रत्नाकल्पं विभुन्ध्यात्वा वर्णलक्षं जपेन्मनुम् /
यद्वा स्मारादिमन्त्राणां जयाभं च हरिं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: having meditated upon the omnipresent Lord adorned with jewels, one should recite the mantra a hundred thousand times per syllable. / Or, for mantras beginning with Kāma, one should recall Hari shining with victory.

sanskrit_iast:
yejanaṃ kāmyakarmāṇi sarvaṃ kuryātṣaḍarṇavat /
rāmaśca candrabha drānto ṅenamonto dhruvādikaḥ //
meaning:
येजनं काम्यकर्माणि सर्वं कुर्यात्षडर्णवत् /
रामश्च चन्द्रभ द्रान्तो ङेनमोन्तो ध्रुवादिकः //
text_mt: He should perform worship and desire-prompted rites entirely like [the mantra of] six syllables. / 'Rāma' ending with 'candra' and 'bhadra', in the dative case ending with 'namaḥ', beginning with dhruva:

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāvaṣṭākṣarau hyetau tārāntyau cennavākṣarau /
eteṣāṃ yajanaṃ sarvaṃ kuryānmantrī ṣaḍarṇavat //
meaning:
मन्त्रावष्टाक्षरौ ह्येतौ तारान्त्यौ चेन्नवाक्षरौ /
एतेषां यजनं सर्वं कुर्यान्मन्त्री षडर्णवत् //
text_mt: these two mantras have eight syllables; if they have the oṃkāra at the end, they have nine syllables. / The practitioner should perform all worship of these like [the mantra of] six syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
jānakīvallabho ṅeṃto dviṭhāntaḥ kavacādikaḥ /
daśārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro viśiṣṭo 'sya muniḥ svarāṭ //
meaning:
जानकीवल्लभो ङेंतो द्विठान्तः कवचादिकः /
दशार्णो ऽयं महामन्त्रो विशिष्टो ऽस्य मुनिः स्वराट् //
text_mt: 'Beloved of Jānakī' in the dative case, ending with two ṭhas, and beginning with the armor [seed-syllable]: / this great mantra has ten syllables; its eminent seer is Svarāṭ,

sanskrit_iast:
chandaśca devatā sītā patirbījaṃ tathādimam /
svāhā śaktiśca kāmena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt //
meaning:
छन्दश्च देवता सीता पतिर्बीजं तथादिमम् /
स्वाहा शक्तिश्च कामेन कुर्यादङ्गानि षट् क्रमात् //
text_mt: the meter is [virāṭ], and the deity is the husband of Sītā; the seed-syllable is likewise the first [syllable], / svāhā is the power, and with the seed-syllable of desire he should perform the six limbs in order.

sanskrit_iast:
śirolalāṭabhrūmadhyatālukaṇṭheṣu hṛdyapi /
nābhyaṅghrijānupādeṣu daśārṇānvinyasenmanoḥ //
meaning:
शिरोललाटभ्रूमध्यतालुकण्ठेषु हृद्यपि /
नाभ्यङ्घ्रिजानुपादेषु दशार्णान्विन्यसेन्मनोः //
text_mt: On the crown, forehead, eyebrow center, palate, throat, and also heart, / on the navel, feet, knees, and feet, one should assign the ten syllables of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyānagare ratnacitrasauvarṇamaṇḍape /
mandārapuṣpairābaddhavitāne toraṇānvite //
meaning:
अयोध्यानगरे रत्नचित्रसौवर्णमण्डपे /
मन्दारपुष्पैराबद्धविताने तोरणान्विते //
text_mt: In the city of Ayodhyā, in a golden pavilion variegated with jewels, / beneath a canopy strung with mandāra flowers, adorned with arched gateways,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsanasamāsīna puṣpakopari rāghavam /
rakṣobhirharibhirdevaiḥ suvimānagataiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
सिंहासनसमासीन पुष्पकोपरि राघवम् /
रक्षोभिर्हरिभिर्देवैः सुविमानगतैः शुभैः //
text_mt: Rāghava seated upon a throne inside the Puṣpaka [chariot], / by rākṣasas, monkeys, and gods mounted on splendid, auspicious aerial chariots

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūyamānaṃ munibhiḥ prahvaiśca parisevitam /
sītālaṅkṛtavāmāṅgaṃ lakṣmaṇenopaśobhitam //
meaning:
संस्तूयमानं मुनिभिः प्रह्वैश्च परिसेवितम् /
सीतालङ्कृतवामाङ्गं लक्ष्मणेनोपशोभितम् //
text_mt: being extolled, and attended by bowing sages; / his left side adorned by Sītā, beautified by Lakṣmaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmaṃ prasannavadanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam /
evaṃ dhyātvā japenmantrī varṇalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
श्यामं प्रसन्नवदनं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेन्मन्त्री वर्णलक्षं समाहितः //
text_mt: dark-complexioned, with a cheerful face, adorned with all ornaments— / having meditated thus, the practitioner should recite, concentrated in mind, a hundred thousand times per syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃśaḥ kamalairhemo yajanaṃ ca ṣaḍarṇavat /
rāmo ṅeṃnto dhanuṣpāṇirṅaitoṃ'te vahnisuṃdarī //
meaning:
दशांशः कमलैर्हेमो यजनं च षडर्णवत् /
रामो ङेंन्तो धनुष्पाणिर्ङैतोंऽते वह्निसुंदरी //
text_mt: The fire oblation is one-tenth [part] with lotuses, and the worship is like [the mantra of] six syllables. / 'Rāma' in the dative case, 'holding a bow in hand' in the dative case, and at the end 'the beautiful wife of fire':

sanskrit_iast:
daśākṣaro 'yaṃ mantro 'sya munirbrahmā virāṭ punaḥ /
chandastu devatā prokto rāmo rākṣasamardanaḥ //
meaning:
दशाक्षरो ऽयं मन्त्रो ऽस्य मुनिर्ब्रह्मा विराट् पुनः /
छन्दस्तु देवता प्रोक्तो रामो राक्षसमर्दनः //
text_mt: this mantra has ten syllables; its seer is Brahmā, and virāṭ / is the meter; the deity is declared to be Rāma, crusher of rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ bījaṃ dviṭhaḥ śaktibīñjenāṅgāni kalpayet /
varṇanyāsaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ puraścaryārcanādikaman //
meaning:
आद्यं बीजं द्विठः शक्तिबीञ्जेनाङ्गानि कल्पयेत् /
वर्णन्यासं तथा ध्यानं पुरश्चर्यार्चनादिकमन् //
text_mt: The first is the seed-syllable, the pair of ṭhas is the power; with the seed-syllable he should fashion the limbs. / The placement of syllables, likewise the meditation, preparatory rites, worship, and so on,

sanskrit_iast:
daśākṣaroktavatkuryāccāpabāṇadharaṃ smaret /
tāro namo bhagavate rāmānte candrabhadrakau //
meaning:
दशाक्षरोक्तवत्कुर्याच्चापबाणधरं स्मरेत् /
तारो नमो भगवते रामान्ते चन्द्रभद्रकौ //
text_mt: he should perform as described for the ten-syllable [mantra]; he should meditate [upon him] holding a bow and arrows. / The oṃkāra, 'obeisance to the Lord', after 'Rāma' [the words] 'candra' and 'bhadra'—

sanskrit_iast:
ṅeṃtāvarkākṣarau mantrau ṛṣidhyānādi pūrvavat /
śrīpūrvaṃ jayapūrvaṃ ca taddvidhā rāmanāma ca //
meaning:
ङेंतावर्काक्षरौ मन्त्रौ ऋषिध्यानादि पूर्ववत् /
श्रीपूर्वं जयपूर्वं च तद्द्विधा रामनाम च //
text_mt: The two twelve-syllable mantras end in the dative case; the sage, meditation, and so forth are as before; / the name of Rāma is preceded by 'śrī' and preceded by 'jaya', and is thus twofold.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśākṣaro mantro munirbrahmā virāṭ smṛtam /
chandastu devatā prokto rāmaḥ pāpaughanāśanaḥṛ //
meaning:
त्रयोदशाक्षरो मन्त्रो मुनिर्ब्रह्मा विराट् स्मृतम् /
छन्दस्तु देवता प्रोक्तो रामः पापौघनाशनःऋ //
text_mt: For the thirteen-syllable mantra, the sage is remembered as Brahmā, the meter as virāṭ, / and the deity is proclaimed to be Rāma, the destroyer of the flood of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgāni prakurvīta dvirāvṛttyā padatrayaiḥ /
dhyānārcanādikaṃ sava hyasya kuryāddaśārṇavat //
meaning:
षडङ्गानि प्रकुर्वीत द्विरावृत्त्या पदत्रयैः /
ध्यानार्चनादिकं सव ह्यस्य कुर्याद्दशार्णवत् //
text_mt: He should perform the six limbs by repeating the three words twice; / all the meditation, worship, and so forth of this [mantra] he should perform like that of the ten-syllable one.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro namo bhagavate rāmāyānte mahāpadam /
puruṣāya hṛdanto 'yaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
तारो नमो भगवते रामायान्ते महापदम् /
पुरुषाय हृदन्तो ऽयं मनुरष्टादशाक्षरः //
text_mt: The tāra, 'namo bhagavate rāmāya', followed by the great words / 'puruṣāya', and ending in the heart-mantra ('namaḥ'): this is the eighteen-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro muniśchado dhṛtī rāmo 'sya devatā /
tāro bījaṃ namaḥ śaktiścandrākṣyabdhyagniṣaḍbhujaiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रो मुनिश्छदो धृती रामो ऽस्य देवता /
तारो बीजं नमः शक्तिश्चन्द्राक्ष्यब्ध्यग्निषड्भुजैः //
text_mt: Viśvāmitra is the sage, dhṛti the meter, Rāma its deity, / the tāra the seed, 'namaḥ' the power; by [groups of] one, two, four, three, and six

sanskrit_iast:
varṇaimantrotthitaiḥ kuryātṣaḍaṅgāni samāhitaḥ /
niḥśāṇabherīpaṭahaśaṅkhaturyādiniḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
वर्णैमन्त्रोत्थितैः कुर्यात्षडङ्गानि समाहितः /
निःशाणभेरीपटहशङ्खतुर्यादिनिःस्वनैः //
text_mt: syllables arising from the mantra, composed in mind, he should perform the six limbs. / Amid the sounds of kettledrums, bherī drums, paṭaha drums, conches, and trumpets,

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttanṛtye parito jayamaṅgalabhāṣite /
candanāgarukastūrīkarpūrādisuvāsite //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तनृत्ये परितो जयमङ्गलभाषिते /
चन्दनागरुकस्तूरीकर्पूरादिसुवासिते //
text_mt: with dancing commenced all around, celebrated with chants of victory and auspiciousness, / fragranced with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, camphor, and other scents,

sanskrit_iast:
nānākusumasaurabhyavāhigandhavahānvite /
devagandharvanārībhirgāyantībhiralakṛte //
meaning:
नानाकुसुमसौरभ्यवाहिगन्धवहान्विते /
देवगन्धर्वनारीभिर्गायन्तीभिरलकृते //
text_mt: accompanied by breezes carrying the fragrance of various flowers, / adorned with celestial damsels and Gandharva women singing,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsane samāsīnaṃ puṣpakopari rāghavam /
saumitrisītāsahitaṃ jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitam //
meaning:
सिंहासने समासीनं पुष्पकोपरि राघवम् /
सौमित्रिसीतासहितं जटामुकुटशोभितम् //
text_mt: seated upon a lion-throne atop the Puṣpaka [chariot], Rāghava, / accompanied by the son of Sumitrā and Sītā, adorned with a diadem of matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
cāpabāṇadharaṃ śyāmaṃ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇam /
hatvā rāvaṇamāyāntaṃ kṛtatrailokyarakṣaṇam //
meaning:
चापबाणधरं श्यामं ससुग्रीवविभीषणम् /
हत्वा रावणमायान्तं कृतत्रैलोक्यरक्षणम् //
text_mt: holding bow and arrows, dark-complexioned, with Sugrīva and Vibhīṣaṇa, / having slain Rāvaṇa, returning, having protected the three worlds—

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇaṃ lakṣaṃ matrī daśāṃśataḥ /
ghṛtāktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā yajanaṃ pūrvavañcaret //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेद्वर्णं लक्षं मत्री दशांशतः /
घृताक्तैः पायसैर्हुत्वा यजनं पूर्ववञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: having meditated thus, the practitioner of the mantra should recite the syllables one hundred thousand times, and to the extent of a tenth part / offering oblations of milk-rice smeared with ghee, he should conduct the worship as before.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ sītāpataye tadanantaram /
rāmāya hanayugmānte varmāstrāgnipriyāntimaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवो हृदयं सीतापतये तदनन्तरम् /
रामाय हनयुग्मान्ते वर्मास्त्राग्निप्रियान्तिमः //
text_mt: The praṇava, the heart-mantra, then 'sītāpataye', / 'rāmāya', followed by a pair of 'hana', ending with armor, weapon, and the beloved of fire ('svāhā'):

sanskrit_iast:
ekonaviṃśadvarṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ /
viśvāmitro muniścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam //
meaning:
एकोनविंशद्वर्णो ऽयं मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः /
विश्वामित्रो मुनिश्चास्यानुष्टुप्छन्द उदाहृतम् //
text_mt: this nineteen-syllable mantra accomplishes all aims; / Viśvāmitra is its sage, and the anuṣṭubh is declared its meter;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā rāmabhadro jaṃ bījaṃ śaktirnama iti /
mantrotthitaiḥ kramādvarṇaistato dhyāyeñca pūrvavat //
meaning:
देवता रामभद्रो जं बीजं शक्तिर्नम इति /
मन्त्रोत्थितैः क्रमाद्वर्णैस्ततो ध्यायेञ्च पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: the deity is Rāmabhadra, 'jaṃ' the seed, 'namaḥ' the power. / With the syllables arising from the mantra in sequence, he should then meditate as before.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ kāmyakarmādi sarvamasya ṣaḍarṇavat /
tāraḥ svabījaṃ kamalā rāmabhadreti saṃpaṭhet //
meaning:
पूजनं काम्यकर्मादि सर्वमस्य षडर्णवत् /
तारः स्वबीजं कमला रामभद्रेति संपठेत् //
text_mt: The worship, the rites for desired ends, and everything else of this [mantra] are like the six-syllable one. / One should recite: the tāra, one's own seed, Kamalā, 'rāmabhadra',

sanskrit_iast:
maheṣvāsapadānte tu raghuvīra nṛpottama /
daśāsyāntakaśabdānte māṃ rakṣa dehi saṃpaṭhet //
meaning:
महेष्वासपदान्ते तु रघुवीर नृपोत्तम /
दशास्यान्तकशब्दान्ते मां रक्ष देहि संपठेत् //
text_mt: and after the word 'maheṣvāsa', 'raghuvīra nṛpottama'; / after the words 'daśāsyāntaka', one should recite 'māṃ rakṣa dehi',

sanskrit_iast:
paramānte me śriyaṃ syānmantro bāṇaguṇākṣaraḥ /
bījairviyukto dvātriṃśadarṇo 'yaṃ phaladāyakaḥ //
meaning:
परमान्ते मे श्रियं स्यान्मन्त्रो बाणगुणाक्षरः /
बीजैर्वियुक्तो द्वात्रिंशदर्णो ऽयं फलदायकः //
text_mt: and after 'parama', 'me śriyam': this would be a thirty-five-syllable mantra. / Divested of the seed-syllables, this thirty-two-syllable [mantra] bestows fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitro muniścāsyānuṣṭupchanda udāhṛtam /
devatā rāmabhadro 'tra bījaṃ svaṃ śaktirindirā //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रो मुनिश्चास्यानुष्टुप्छन्द उदाहृतम् /
देवता रामभद्रो ऽत्र बीजं स्वं शक्तिरिन्दिरा //
text_mt: Viśvāmitra is its sage, and the anuṣṭubh is declared its meter; / here the deity is Rāmabhadra, the seed is one's own, and Indirā is the power.

sanskrit_iast:
bījatrayādyaiḥ kurvīta padaiḥ sarveṇa mantravit /
pañcāṅgāni ca vinyasya mantravarṇānkramānnyaset //
meaning:
बीजत्रयाद्यैः कुर्वीत पदैः सर्वेण मन्त्रवित् /
पञ्चाङ्गानि च विन्यस्य मन्त्रवर्णान्क्रमान्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: The knower of mantra should perform the five limbs with the words beginning with the three seeds and with the whole [mantra], / and having rituals placed them, he should place the mantra's syllables in sequence:

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhni bhāle dṛśoḥ śrotre gaṇḍayugme sanāsike /
āsye doḥsaṃdhiyugale stanahṛnnābhiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
मूर्ध्नि भाले दृशोः श्रोत्रे गण्डयुग्मे सनासिके /
आस्ये दोःसंधियुगले स्तनहृन्नाभिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: on the crown of the head, the forehead, the eyes, the ears, both cheeks, the nose, / the mouth, the joints of both arms, the breasts, the heart, and the navel in sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭau meḍhre pāyupādasaṃdhiṣvarṇānnyasenmanoḥ /
dhyānārcanādikaṃ cāsya pūrvavatsamupācaret //
meaning:
कटौ मेढ्रे पायुपादसंधिष्वर्णान्न्यसेन्मनोः /
ध्यानार्चनादिकं चास्य पूर्ववत्समुपाचरेत् //
text_mt: on the hips, the penis, the anus, and the joints of the feet he should place the syllables of the mantra; / and he should perform its meditation, worship, and so forth as before.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣatrayaṃ puraścaryāṃ pāyasairhavanaṃ matam /
dhyātvā rāmaṃ pītavarṇaṃ japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
लक्षत्रयं पुरश्चर्यां पायसैर्हवनं मतम् /
ध्यात्वा रामं पीतवर्णं जपेल्लक्षं समाहितः //
text_mt: The preliminary rite is considered to be three hundred thousand recitations and an offering of milk-rice; / meditating on Rāma of golden hue, composed in mind, he should recite it one hundred thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṃśaṃ kamalairhutvā dhanairdhanapatirbhavet /
tāro māyā ramādvandvaṃ dāśarathāya hṛñca vai //
meaning:
दशांशं कमलैर्हुत्वा धनैर्धनपतिर्भवेत् /
तारो माया रमाद्वन्द्वं दाशरथाय हृञ्च वै //
text_mt: Offering oblations of lotuses to the extent of a tenth part, he becomes a lord of wealth in riches. / The tāra, Māyā, a pair of Ramā, 'dāśarathāya', and the heart-mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśākṣaro mantro munyādyarcāsya pūrvavat /
trailokyānte tu nāthāya hṛdanto vasuvarṇavān //
meaning:
एकादशाक्षरो मन्त्रो मुन्याद्यर्चास्य पूर्ववत् /
त्रैलोक्यान्ते तु नाथाय हृदन्तो वसुवर्णवान् //
text_mt: this is an eleven-syllable mantra; its sage, worship, and so forth are as before. / After 'trailokya', 'nāthāya' ending in the heart-mantra: it consists of eight syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
asyāpi pūrvavatsarvaṃ nyāsadhyānārcanādikam /
āñjaneyapadānte tu gurave hṛdayāntimaḥ //
meaning:
अस्यापि पूर्ववत्सर्वं न्यासध्यानार्चनादिकम् /
आञ्जनेयपदान्ते तु गुरवे हृदयान्तिमः //
text_mt: for this also, everything—ritual placement, meditation, worship, and so forth—is as before. / After the word 'āñjaneya', 'gurave' ending with the heart-mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
mantro navākṣaro 'syāpi yajanaṃ pūrvavanmatam /
ṅetaṃ rāmapada paścāddhṛdayaṃ pañcavaṇavat //
meaning:
मन्त्रो नवाक्षरो ऽस्यापि यजनं पूर्ववन्मतम् /
ङेतं रामपद पश्चाद्धृदयं पञ्चवणवत् //
text_mt: The mantra of this too has nine syllables; the worship is considered to be as before: / the word 'Rāma' ending in the dative case, followed by the heart [mantra] of five syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
munidhyānārcanaṃ cāsya proktaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat /
rāmānte candrabhadrau ca ṅeṃtau pāvakavallabhā //
meaning:
मुनिध्यानार्चनं चास्य प्रोक्तं सर्वं षडर्णवत् /
रामान्ते चन्द्रभद्रौ च ङेंतौ पावकवल्लभा //
text_mt: the sage, meditation, and worship of this are all declared to be like the six-syllable one. / After 'rāma', 'candra' and 'bhadra' in the dative, and the beloved of fire:

sanskrit_iast:
mantro dvau ca samākhyātau munyādyarcādi pūrvavat /
vahniḥ śeṣānvitaścaiva candrabhūṣitamastakaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रो द्वौ च समाख्यातौ मुन्याद्यर्चादि पूर्ववत् /
वह्निः शेषान्वितश्चैव चन्द्रभूषितमस्तकः //
text_mt: two mantras are thus proclaimed; the sage, worship, and so forth are as before. / Agni joined with Śeṣa, and having his head adorned with the moon:

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaro raghupatermantraḥ kalpadrumo 'paraḥ /
brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando rāmo 'sya devatā //
meaning:
एकाक्षरो रघुपतेर्मन्त्रः कल्पद्रुमो ऽपरः /
ब्रह्मा मुनिः स्याद्गायत्री छन्दो रामो ऽस्य देवता //
text_mt: this single-syllable mantra of the lord of the Raghus is another wish-granting tree; / Brahmā is the sage, the meter is gāyatrī, and Rāma is its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena mantreṇa ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret /
sarayūtīramandāravedikāpaṅkajāsane //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन मन्त्रेण षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् /
सरयूतीरमन्दारवेदिकापङ्कजासने //
text_mt: With the mantra enriched by the six long vowels, he should perform the six limbs. / On a lotus seat upon an altar beneath a mandāra tree on the bank of the Sarayū,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmaṃ vīrāsanāsīnaṃ jñānamudropaśobhitam /
vāmorunyastaṃ taddhastaṃ sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutam //
meaning:
श्यामं वीरासनासीनं ज्ञानमुद्रोपशोभितम् /
वामोरुन्यस्तं तद्धस्तं सीतालक्ष्मणसंयुतम् //
text_mt: dark, seated in the hero's posture, adorned with the gesture of wisdom, / with that hand resting upon his left thigh, accompanied by Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
avekṣaṇāṇamātmānaṃ manmathāmitatejasam /
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ kevalaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣayā //
meaning:
अवेक्षणाणमात्मानं मन्मथामिततेजसम् /
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं केवलं मोक्षकाङ्क्षया //
text_mt: gazing upon Himself, having the immeasurable splendour of Kama, / resembling pure crystal, solely through the desire for liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
cintayetparamātmānamṛtulakṣaṃ japenmanum /
sarvvaṃ ṣaḍarṇavañcāsya homanityārcanādikam //
meaning:
चिन्तयेत्परमात्मानमृतुलक्षं जपेन्मनुम् /
सर्व्वं षडर्णवञ्चास्य होमनित्यार्चनादिकम् //
text_mt: he should contemplate the Supreme Self and recite the mantra six hundred thousand times; / and all the fire oblations, daily worship, and so forth of this are like the six-syllable one.

sanskrit_iast:
vahniḥ śeṣāsano bhāntaḥ kevalo dvyakṣaro manuḥ /
ekākṣarokta vatsarvaṃ munidhyānārcanādikam //
meaning:
वह्निः शेषासनो भान्तः केवलो द्व्यक्षरो मनुः /
एकाक्षरोक्त वत्सर्वं मुनिध्यानार्चनादिकम् //
text_mt: Agni, seated on Śeṣa, ending with the dot of nasalisation, alone, is the two-syllable mantra; / all the sage, meditation, worship, and so forth are as stated for the single-syllable one.

sanskrit_iast:
tāramānāramānaṅgacāstrabījairdvivarṇakaḥ /
tryakṣaro mantrarājaḥ syātṣaḍvidhaḥ sakaleṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
तारमानारमानङ्गचास्त्रबीजैर्द्विवर्णकः /
त्र्यक्षरो मन्त्रराजः स्यात्षड्विधः सकलेष्टदः //
text_mt: With the seeds of the tāra, Māyā, Ramā, Ananga, and the weapon added to the two syllables, / the three-syllable king of mantras is sixfold, granting all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
vdyakṣaraścandrabhadrānto dvividhaścaturakṣaraḥ /
ekārṇoktavadeteṣāṃ munidhyānārcanādikam //
meaning:
व्द्यक्षरश्चन्द्रभद्रान्तो द्विविधश्चतुरक्षरः /
एकार्णोक्तवदेतेषां मुनिध्यानार्चनादिकम् //
text_mt: The two-syllable mantra ending with 'candra' and 'bhadra' is twofold and has four syllables; / for these, the sage, meditation, worship, and so forth are as stated for the one-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro rāmaścaturthyanto varmāstraṃ vahnivallabhā /
aṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro munyādyarcā ṣaḍarṇavat //
meaning:
तारो रामश्चतुर्थ्यन्तो वर्मास्त्रं वह्निवल्लभा /
अष्टार्णो ऽयं महामन्त्रो मुन्याद्यर्चा षडर्णवत् //
text_mt: The tāra, 'rāma' in the dative case, the armor, the weapon, and the beloved of fire: / this eight-syllable great mantra has its sage, worship, and so forth like the six-syllable one.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro mayā hṛdante syādrāmāya praṇavāntimaḥ /
śivomārāmamantro 'yamaṣṭārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
तारो मया हृदन्ते स्याद्रामाय प्रणवान्तिमः /
शिवोमाराममन्त्रो ऽयमष्टार्णः सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: The tāra, Māyā, the heart-mantra at the end, 'rāmāya', ending with the praṇava: / this is the eight-syllable mantra of Śiva, Umā, and Rāma, bestowing all supernatural attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ sadāśivaḥ prokto gāyatrī chanda īritam /
śivomārāmacandro 'tra devatā parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिः सदाशिवः प्रोक्तो गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् /
शिवोमारामचन्द्रो ऽत्र देवता परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: Sadāśiva is declared the sage, the meter is stated to be gāyatrī, / and the deity here is proclaimed as Śiva, Umā, and Rāmacandra.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍvīryayāmāya yātu dhruvapañcārṇayuktayā /
ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāyātha dhyāyeddhṛdi surārcitam //
meaning:
षड्वीर्ययामाय यातु ध्रुवपञ्चार्णयुक्तया /
षडङ्गानि विधायाथ ध्यायेद्धृदि सुरार्चितम् //
text_mt: Having performed the six limbs with the five syllables joined with the eternal one [and the long vowels], / he should then meditate in his heart upon Him who is worshipped by the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ trinetraṃ somārddhadhāriṇaṃ śūlinaṃ varam /
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ kaparddinamupāsmahe //
meaning:
रामं त्रिनेत्रं सोमार्द्धधारिणं शूलिनं वरम् /
भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गं कपर्द्दिनमुपास्महे //
text_mt: "We worship Rāma, the excellent three-eyed one, bearing the crescent moon, holding the trident, / with all limbs smeared with holy ash, wearing matted hair,"

sanskrit_iast:
rāmābhirāmaṃ saindaryasīmāṃ somāvataṃsinīm /
pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇadharāṃ dhyāyetrilocanām //
meaning:
रामाभिरामं सैन्दर्यसीमां सोमावतंसिनीम् /
पाशाङ्कुशधनुर्बाणधरां ध्यायेत्रिलोचनाम् //
text_mt: or he should meditate on the delight of Rāma, the pinnacle of beauty, wearing the moon as a crest-jewel, / holding the noose, the goad, the bow, and arrows, having three eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇalakṣaṃ trimadhurānvitaiḥ /
bilpapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistilairvā paṅkajairhunet //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेद्वर्णलक्षं त्रिमधुरान्वितैः /
बिल्पपत्रैः फलैः पुष्पैस्तिलैर्वा पङ्कजैर्हुनेत् //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times per syllable; / and make fire oblation with bilva leaves, fruits, flowers, sesame seeds, or lotuses, mixed with the three sweets.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamāyānti nidhayaḥ siddhayaśca surepsitāḥ /
tāro māyā ca bharatāgrajarāmamanobhavaḥ //
meaning:
स्वयमायान्ति निधयः सिद्धयश्च सुरेप्सिताः /
तारो माया च भरताग्रजराममनोभवः //
text_mt: Treasures and perfections desired by the gods come on their own. / The tāra, māyā, the elder brother of Bharata, Rāma, love,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnijāyādvādaśārṇo mantraḥ kalpadrumo 'paraḥ /
aṅgirāśca muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
वह्निजायाद्वादशार्णो मन्त्रः कल्पद्रुमो ऽपरः /
अङ्गिराश्च मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता पुनः //
text_mt: and the wife of fire—this twelve-syllable mantra is another wish-fulfilling tree. / Its sage is Aṅgiras, the meter is gāyatrī, and the deity is further

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmo bhuvanābījaṃ svāhāśaktiḥ samīritaḥ /
candraikamunibhūnetrairmantrārṇairaṅgakalpanam //
meaning:
श्रीरामो भुवनाबीजं स्वाहाशक्तिः समीरितः /
चन्द्रैकमुनिभूनेत्रैर्मन्त्रार्णैरङ्गकल्पनम् //
text_mt: Śrīrāma; bhuvanā is the seed-syllable, and svāhā is declared to be the power. / The assignment of the limbs is performed with the mantra syllables by one, one, seven, one, and two.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjādikaṃ cāśca sarvaṃ kuryātṣaḍarṇavat /
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ sītāpate rāmaśca ṅeṃtimaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यानपूजादिकं चाश्च सर्वं कुर्यात्षडर्णवत् /
प्रणवो हृदयं सीतापते रामश्च ङेंतिमः //
text_mt: One should perform all the meditation, worship, and other rites as for the six-syllable [mantra]. / The praṇava, the heart, 'to the husband of Sītā,' and Rāma ending with the dative [case-suffix],

sanskrit_iast:
hanadvayānte varmāstraṃ mantraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṇavān /
agastyo 'sya muniśchando bṛhatī devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
हनद्वयान्ते वर्मास्त्रं मन्त्रः षोडशवर्णवान् /
अगस्त्यो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो बृहती देवता पुनः //
text_mt: followed by two hanas, the armor, and the weapon—this is the sixteen-syllable mantra. / Its sage is Agastya, the meter is bṛhatī, and the deity is further

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmo 'haṃ tathā bījaṃ rāṃ śaktiḥ samudīritā /
rāmābdhivahnivedākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakalpanā //
meaning:
श्रीरामो ऽहं तथा बीजं रां शक्तिः समुदीरिता /
रामाब्धिवह्निवेदाक्षिवर्णैः पञ्चाङ्गकल्पना //
text_mt: Śrīrāma; ahaṃ is the seed-syllable, and rāṃ is declared to be the power. / The assignment of the five limbs is performed with three, four, three, four, and two syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasya kuryātṣaḍarṇavat /
tāro hṛñcaiva brahmaṇyasevyāya padamīrayet //
meaning:
ध्यानपूजादिकं सर्वमस्य कुर्यात्षडर्णवत् /
तारो हृञ्चैव ब्रह्मण्यसेव्याय पदमीरयेत् //
text_mt: One should perform all of its meditation, worship, and other rites as for the six-syllable [mantra]. / The tāra, the heart, and then one should utter the word, 'to him who is served by the pious,'

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāyākuṇṭhaśabdāntaṃ tejase ca samīrayet /
uttamaślokadhuryāya svaṃ bhṛguḥ kāmikānvitaḥ //
meaning:
रामायाकुण्ठशब्दान्तं तेजसे च समीरयेत् /
उत्तमश्लोकधुर्याय स्वं भृगुः कामिकान्वितः //
text_mt: and 'to Rāma,' and one should utter 'to the unhindered luster,' / 'to the foremost of those celebrated in sacred verse,' then sva, and Bhṛgu accompanied by kāmikā;

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍārpitāṃ priye mantro rāmarāmākṣaro mataḥ /
ṛṣiḥ śukrastathānuṣṭupchando rāmo 'sya devatā //
meaning:
दण्डार्पितां प्रिये मन्त्रो रामरामाक्षरो मतः /
ऋषिः शुक्रस्तथानुष्टुप्छन्दो रामो ऽस्य देवता //
text_mt: with a staff placed on it, then priye—this is considered the mantra of thirty-two syllables. / Its sage is Śukra, the meter is anuṣṭubh, and Rāma is its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ kuryāccheṣaṃ ṣaḍarṇavat /
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena juhuyātpāyasaiḥ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
पादैः सर्वेण पञ्चाङ्गं कुर्याच्छेषं षडर्णवत् /
लक्षं जपो दशांशेन जुहुयात्पायसैः सुधीः //
text_mt: One should perform the five limbs with the quarters and the whole [mantra], and the rest as for the six-syllable [mantra]. / A wise person should perform recitation one hundred thousand times, and make fire oblation with rice pudding to one-tenth [of that count].

sanskrit_iast:
siddhamantrasya bhuktiḥ syānmuktiḥ pātakanāśanam /
ādau dāśarathāyānte vidmahe padamuccaret //
meaning:
सिद्धमन्त्रस्य भुक्तिः स्यान्मुक्तिः पातकनाशनम् /
आदौ दाशरथायान्ते विद्महे पदमुच्चरेत् //
text_mt: For one who has perfected the mantra, there will be enjoyment, liberation, and the destruction of sins. / First, at the end of 'dāśarathāya,' one should utter the word 'vidmahe';

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sītāvallabhāya dhīmahīti samuccaret /
tanno rāmaḥ proco varṇo dayāditi ca saṃvadet //
meaning:
ततः सीतावल्लभाय धीमहीति समुच्चरेत् /
तन्नो रामः प्रोचो वर्णो दयादिति च संवदेत् //
text_mt: then one should utter 'sītāvallabhāya dhīmahi'; / and one should recite: 'tanno rāmaḥ pracodayāt.'

sanskrit_iast:
eṣoktārā magāyatrī sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradā /
padmāsītāpadaṃ ṅetaṃ ṭhadvayāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ //
meaning:
एषोक्तारा मगायत्री सर्वाभीष्टफलप्रदा /
पद्मासीतापदं ङेतं ठद्वयान्तः षडक्षरः //
text_mt: This is declared to be the Rāma-gāyatrī, which grants the fruits of all desires. / The word Padmā-Sītā ending with the dative, followed by two ṭhas, is the six-syllable [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
vālmīkiśca muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ /
sītā bhagavatī proktā śrīṃ bījaṃ vahnisundarī //
meaning:
वाल्मीकिश्च मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता पुनः /
सीता भगवती प्रोक्ता श्रीं बीजं वह्निसुन्दरी //
text_mt: Vālmīki is the sage, the meter is gāyatrī, and the deity is further / declared to be the goddess Sītā; śrīṃ is the seed-syllable, and the wife of fire [svāhā]

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktena bījenāṅgāni kalpayet /
tato dhyāyanmahādevīṃ sītāṃ trailokyapūjitām //
meaning:
शक्तिः षड्दीर्घयुक्तेन बीजेनाङ्गानि कल्पयेत् /
ततो ध्यायन्महादेवीं सीतां त्रैलोक्यपूजिताम् //
text_mt: is the power. One should assign the limbs with the seed-syllable joined with the six long [vowels]. / Then, meditating on the great goddess Sītā, who is worshipped by the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
taptahāṭakavarṇābhāṃ padmayugmaṃ karadvaye /
sadratnabhūṣaṇasphūrjaddivyadehāṃ śubhātmikām //
meaning:
तप्तहाटकवर्णाभां पद्मयुग्मं करद्वये /
सद्रत्नभूषणस्फूर्जद्दिव्यदेहां शुभात्मिकाम् //
text_mt: having the luster and color of molten gold, holding a pair of lotuses in both hands, / whose divine body radiates with ornaments of genuine jewels, auspicious in nature,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvastrāṃ śaśimukhīṃ padmākṣīṃ muditāntarām /
paśyantīṃ rāghavaṃ puṇyaṃ śayyārdhyāṃ ṣaḍguṇeśvarīm //
meaning:
नानावस्त्रां शशिमुखीं पद्माक्षीं मुदितान्तराम् /
पश्यन्तीं राघवं पुण्यं शय्यार्ध्यां षड्गुणेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: wearing various garments, moon-faced, lotus-eyed, delighted at heart, / gazing upon the holy descendant of Raghu, worthy of half the bed, sovereign of the six virtues;

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ /
juhuyātkamalaiḥ phullaiḥ pīṭhe pūrvodite yajet //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेद्वर्णलक्षं मन्त्री दशांशतः /
जुहुयात्कमलैः फुल्लैः पीठे पूर्वोदिते यजेत् //
text_mt: having meditated thus, the mantra-practitioner should recite [it] one hundred thousand times per syllable; / he should make fire oblation with blooming lotuses to one-tenth [of that count], and worship her on the seat previously described.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena tasyāmāvāhya jānakīm /
saṃpūjya dakṣiṇe rāmamabhyarcyāgre 'nilātmajam //
meaning:
मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलेन तस्यामावाह्य जानकीम् /
संपूज्य दक्षिणे राममभ्यर्च्याग्रे ऽनिलात्मजम् //
text_mt: Having fashioned the form with the root [mantra] and invoked Jānakī into it, / and having worshipped her, one should worship Rāma on the right, and the son of the wind [Hanumān] in front.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣaṭe lakṣmaṇamabhyarcya ṣaṭkoṇeṣvaṅgapūjanam /
patreṣu mantrimukhyaṃśca bāhye lokeśvarānpunaḥ //
meaning:
पृषटे लक्ष्मणमभ्यर्च्य षट्कोणेष्वङ्गपूजनम् /
पत्रेषु मन्त्रिमुख्यंश्च बाह्ये लोकेश्वरान्पुनः //
text_mt: Having worshipped Lakṣmaṇa in the rear, [there is] the worship of the limbs in the six angles, / the principal ministers on the petals, and further the guardians of the world outside.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrādyānapi saṃpūjya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet /
jātīpuṣpaiścandanāktai rājavaśyāya homayet //
meaning:
वज्राद्यानपि संपूज्य सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् /
जातीपुष्पैश्चन्दनाक्तै राजवश्याय होमयेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped even the thunderbolt and other [weapons], one becomes master of all perfections. / One should make fire oblation with jasmine flowers anointed with sandalwood to subdue kings;

sanskrit_iast:
kamalairdhanadhānyāptirnīlābjairvaśayan jagat /
bilvapatraiḥ śriyaḥ prāptyai dūrvābhīrorāśāntaye //
meaning:
कमलैर्धनधान्याप्तिर्नीलाब्जैर्वशयन् जगत् /
बिल्वपत्रैः श्रियः प्राप्त्यै दूर्वाभीरोराशान्तये //
text_mt: with lotuses [one achieves] the attainment of wealth and grain; with blue lotuses one subdues the world; / with bilva leaves for the attainment of prosperity; with dūrvā grass for the pacification of diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bahūktuna saubhāgyaṃ putrānpautrānparaṃ sukham /
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca sītārādhanato labhet //
meaning:
किं बहूक्तुन सौभाग्यं पुत्रान्पौत्रान्परं सुखम् /
धनं धान्यं च मोक्षं च सीताराधनतो लभेत् //
text_mt: What need of many words? One obtains good fortune, sons, grandsons, supreme happiness, / wealth, grain, and liberation from the worship of Sītā.

sanskrit_iast:
śakraṛ seṃdurlakṣmaṇāya hṛdayaṃ saptavarṇavān /
agastyo 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
शक्रऋ सेंदुर्लक्ष्मणाय हृदयं सप्तवर्णवान् /
अगस्त्यो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता पुनः //
text_mt: Śakra, ṛ, accompanied by the moon [anusvāra], 'lakṣmaṇāya', the heart—[this is] the seven-syllable [mantra]. / Agastya is its sage, the meter is gāyatrī, and the deity is further

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇākhyo mahāvīraścāḍhyaṃ hṛdvījaśaktike /
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
लक्ष्मणाख्यो महावीरश्चाढ्यं हृद्वीजशक्तिके /
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: the great hero named Lakṣmaṇa; rich in power, the heart is both seed-syllable and power. / One should perform the six limbs with the seed-syllable accompanied by the six long [vowels].

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujaṃ svarṇarucuratanuṃ padmanibhekṣaṇam /
dhanurbāṇakaraṃ rāmasevāsaṃsaktamānasam //
meaning:
द्विभुजं स्वर्णरुचुरतनुं पद्मनिभेक्षणम् /
धनुर्बाणकरं रामसेवासंसक्तमानसम् //
text_mt: Two-armed, with a body having the splendor of gold, with eyes resembling lotuses, / holding a bow and arrows in his hands, his mind intently devoted to the service of Rāma;

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedvarṇalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ //ṭha
madhvāktaiḥ pāyasairhutvā rāmapīṭhe prapūjayeta //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेद्वर्णलक्षं मन्त्री दशांशतः //ठ
मध्वाक्तैः पायसैर्हुत्वा रामपीठे प्रपूजयेत //
text_mt: having meditated thus, the mantra-practitioner should recite [it] one hundred thousand times per syllable; / having offered fire oblation to one-tenth [of that count] with rice pudding smeared with honey, he should worship him on the seat of Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmavadyajanaṃ cāsya sarvasiddhiprado hyayam /
sākalyaṃ rāmapūjāyā yadīcchenniyataṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
रामवद्यजनं चास्य सर्वसिद्धिप्रदो ह्ययम् /
साकल्यं रामपूजाया यदीच्छेन्नियतं नरः //
text_mt: And his worship is like that of Rāma; this indeed grants all perfections. / If a person constantly desires the completeness of the worship of Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
tena yatnena karttavyaṃ lakṣmaṇārcanamādarāt /
śrīrāmacandrabhedāstu bahavaḥ saṃti siddhidāḥ //
meaning:
तेन यत्नेन कर्त्तव्यं लक्ष्मणार्चनमादरात् /
श्रीरामचन्द्रभेदास्तु बहवः संति सिद्धिदाः //
text_mt: then the worship of Lakṣmaṇa must be performed by him with care and respect. / There are indeed many forms of Śrīrāmacandra that grant perfections;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsādhakaiḥ sadā kāryaṃ lakṣmaṇārādhanaṃ śubham /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā susamāhitaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्साधकैः सदा कार्यं लक्ष्मणाराधनं शुभम् /
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं वा शतं वा सुसमाहितैः //
text_mt: by their practitioners the auspicious worship of Lakṣmaṇa should always be performed / one thousand and eight times, or one hundred times, by those who are fully concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇasya manurjapyo mumukṣubhiratandritaiḥ /
ajaptvā lakṣmaṇamanuṃ rāmamantrān japanti ye //
meaning:
लक्ष्मणस्य मनुर्जप्यो मुमुक्षुभिरतन्द्रितैः /
अजप्त्वा लक्ष्मणमनुं राममन्त्रान् जपन्ति ये //
text_mt: The mantra of Lakṣmaṇa should be recited by seekers of liberation without slackness. / Those who recite the mantras of Rāma without having recited the mantra of Lakṣmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
na teṣāṃ jāyate siddhirhānireva pade pade /
yo japellakṣmaṇamanuṃ nityamekāntamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
न तेषां जायते सिद्धिर्हानिरेव पदे पदे /
यो जपेल्लक्ष्मणमनुं नित्यमेकान्तमास्थितः //
text_mt: for them perfection does not arise; rather, there is only loss at every step. / Whoever recites the mantra of Lakṣmaṇa daily, remaining in solitude,

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt /
jayapradhāno mantro 'yaṃ rājyaprāptyaikasādhanam //
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् /
जयप्रधानो मन्त्रो ऽयं राज्यप्राप्त्यैकसाधनम् //
text_mt: is freed from all sins and attains all desires. / This mantra has victory as its primary fruit; it is the sole means for the attainment of a kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭarājyāptaye mantraṃ japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ /
so 'cirānnaṣṭarājyaṃ svaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
नष्टराज्याप्तये मन्त्रं जपेल्लक्षं समाहितः /
सो ऽचिरान्नष्टराज्यं स्वं प्राप्नोत्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: For the recovery of a lost kingdom, one should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times with concentration; / he certainly regains his lost kingdom without delay; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyanrāmamayodhyāyāmabhiṣikta mananyadhīḥ /
pañcāyutaṃ manuṃ japtvā naṣṭarājyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ध्यायन्राममयोध्यायामभिषिक्त मनन्यधीः /
पञ्चायुतं मनुं जप्त्वा नष्टराज्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Meditating with single-pointed mind on Rāma anointed [as king] in Ayodhyā, / having recited the mantra fifty thousand times, one recovers a lost kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgapāśavinirmuktaṃ dhyātvā lakṣmaṇamādarāt /
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ nigaḍānmucyate dhruvam //
meaning:
नागपाशविनिर्मुक्तं ध्यात्वा लक्ष्मणमादरात् /
अयुतं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं निगडान्मुच्यते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Having meditated with reverence on Lakṣmaṇa freed from the serpent-noose, / one should recite the mantra ten thousand times; he is surely released from fetters.

sanskrit_iast:
vātātmajenānītābhiroṣadhībhirgatavyatham /
dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japanmantramalpamṛtyuṃ jayeddhuvam //
meaning:
वातात्मजेनानीताभिरोषधीभिर्गतव्यथम् /
ध्यात्वा लक्षं जपन्मन्त्रमल्पमृत्युं जयेद्धुवम् //
text_mt: Meditating on him relieved of pain by the medicinal herbs brought by the son of the wind, / reciting the mantra one hundred thousand times, one surely overcomes premature death.

sanskrit_iast:
ghātayantaṃ meghanādaṃ dhyātvā lakṣaṃ japenmanum /
durjayaṃ vāpi vegena jayedripukulaṃ mahat //
meaning:
घातयन्तं मेघनादं ध्यात्वा लक्षं जपेन्मनुम् /
दुर्जयं वापि वेगेन जयेद्रिपुकुलं महत् //
text_mt: Meditating on him slaying Meghanāda, one should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times; / he swiftly conquers a great host of enemies, even one difficult to conquer.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā śūrpaṇakhānāsāchedanodyuktamānasam /
sahasraṃ prajapenmantraṃ puruhūtādikān jayet //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा शूर्पणखानासाछेदनोद्युक्तमानसम् /
सहस्रं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं पुरुहूतादिकान् जयेत् //
text_mt: Meditating on his mind resolved on cutting off the nose of Śūrpaṇakhā, / one should recite the mantra a thousand times; he conquers Indra and the other [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
rāmapādābjasevārthaṃ kṛtodyogamatho smaran /
prajapallaṅkṣamekānte mahārogātpramucyate //
meaning:
रामपादाब्जसेवार्थं कृतोद्योगमथो स्मरन् /
प्रजपल्लङ्क्षमेकान्ते महारोगात्प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Then, remembering him resolved upon serving the lotus feet of Rāma, / reciting [it] one hundred thousand times in solitude, one is freed from grave disease.

sanskrit_iast:
trimāsaṃ vijitāhāro nityaṃ saptasahasrakam /
aṣṭottaraśataiḥ puṣpairniśchedraiḥ śātapatrakaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रिमासं विजिताहारो नित्यं सप्तसहस्रकम् /
अष्टोत्तरशतैः पुष्पैर्निश्छेद्रैः शातपत्रकैः //
text_mt: Conquering one's food for three months, daily [reciting it] seven thousand times, / having worshipped according to the rule with one hundred and eight unblemished hundred-petalled flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā vidhānena pāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram /
nivedya prajapenmantraṃ kuṣṭarogātpranucyate //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विधानेन पायसं च सशर्करम् /
निवेद्य प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं कुष्टरोगात्प्रनुच्यते //
text_mt: and having offered rice pudding with sugar, one should recite the mantra; / he is freed from the disease of leprosy.

sanskrit_iast:
vijane vijitāhāraḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ vidhināmunā /
kṣayarogātpramucyeta satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
विजने विजिताहारः षण्मासं विधिनामुना /
क्षयरोगात्प्रमुच्येत सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः //
text_mt: In a secluded place, with diet restrained for six months according to this rule, / one would be freed from consumption; this is true, true, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimantrya jalaṃ prātarmantreṇa triḥ samāhitaḥ /
trisaṃdhyaṃ vā pibennityaṃ mucyate sarvarogataḥ //
meaning:
अभिमन्त्र्य जलं प्रातर्मन्त्रेण त्रिः समाहितः /
त्रिसंध्यं वा पिबेन्नित्यं मुच्यते सर्वरोगतः //
text_mt: Having consecrated water with the mantra three times in the morning with concentration, / or drinking it daily at the three junctions of the day, one is freed from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
dāridrayaṃ ca parābhūtaṃ jāyate dhanadopamaḥ /
viṣādidoṣasaṃsparśo na bhavettu kadācana //
meaning:
दारिद्रयं च पराभूतं जायते धनदोपमः /
विषादिदोषसंस्पर्शो न भवेत्तु कदाचन //
text_mt: Poverty is overcome, and he becomes equal to the giver of wealth [Kubera]; / no contact with blemishes such as poison ever occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
manunā mantritaistoyaiḥ pratyehaṃ kṣālayenmukham /
mukhanetrādisaṃbhūtāñjayeddvrogāṃśca dāruṇān //
meaning:
मनुना मन्त्रितैस्तोयैः प्रत्येहं क्षालयेन्मुखम् /
मुखनेत्रादिसंभूताञ्जयेद्द्व्रोगांश्च दारुणान् //
text_mt: One should wash the face every day with water consecrated with the mantra; / he overcomes terrible diseases arising in the mouth, eyes, and other [organs].

sanskrit_iast:
pītvābhimantritaṃ tvaṃbhaḥ kukṣirogān jayeddhruvam /
lakṣmaṇapratimāṃ kṛtvā dadyādbhaktyā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
पीत्वाभिमन्त्रितं त्वंभः कुक्षिरोगान् जयेद्ध्रुवम् /
लक्ष्मणप्रतिमां कृत्वा दद्याद्भक्त्या विधानतः //
text_mt: Drinking water consecrated with the mantra, he will certainly conquer diseases of the belly. / Having fashioned an image of Lakṣmaṇa, one should give it with devotion according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvebhyo 'tha rogebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
kanyārthī vimalāpāṇigrahaṇāsaktamānasaḥ //
meaning:
स सर्वेभ्यो ऽथ रोगेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः /
कन्यार्थी विमलापाणिग्रहणासक्तमानसः //
text_mt: He is freed from all diseases, there is no doubt in this. / A man desiring a maiden, whose mind is set upon taking her pure hand in marriage,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyan lakṣaṃ japenmantrī abjairhutvā daśāṃśataḥ /
īpsitāṃ labhate kanyāṃ śīgrameva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायन् लक्षं जपेन्मन्त्री अब्जैर्हुत्वा दशांशतः /
ईप्सितां लभते कन्यां शीग्रमेव न संशयः //
text_mt: meditating, should recite a hundred thousand [times] as a practitioner, offering one-tenth into the fire with lotuses; / he obtains the desired maiden very quickly, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitaṃ juṃbhaṇāstrāṇāṃ mantreṣu niyatavratam /
dhyātvā ca vidhivannityaṃ japenmāsatrayaṃ manum //
meaning:
दीक्षितं जुंभणास्त्राणां मन्त्रेषु नियतव्रतम् /
ध्यात्वा च विधिवन्नित्यं जपेन्मासत्रयं मनुम् //
text_mt: Meditating on him as initiated into the mantras of the stupor-inducing weapons, observing fixed vows, / one should daily recite the mantra according to rule for three months,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāpuraḥsaraṃ saptasahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ /
sarvāsāmapi vidyānāṃ tattvajño jāyate naraḥ //
meaning:
पूजापुरःसरं सप्तसहस्रं विजितेन्द्रियः /
सर्वासामपि विद्यानां तत्त्वज्ञो जायते नरः //
text_mt: preceded by worship, seven thousand [times], with senses conquered; / that man becomes a knower of the truth of all sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrakratuvare kṛtādbhutaparākramam /
dhyāyaṃllakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ mucyate mahato bhayāt //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रक्रतुवरे कृताद्भुतपराक्रमम् /
ध्यायंल्लक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं मुच्यते महतो भयात् //
text_mt: Meditating on him whose valor was wonderful in the excellent sacrifice of Viśvāmitra, / reciting the mantra a hundred thousand times, one is freed from great danger.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuddhastrikālaṃ prajapenmanum /
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
कृतनित्यक्रियः शुद्धस्त्रिकालं प्रजपेन्मनुम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो याति विष्णोः परं पदम् //
text_mt: Having performed the daily rites, purified, reciting the mantra at the three junctures of the day, / released from all sins, he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣito vidhivanmantrī guṇairvigatakalmaṣaḥ /
svācāraniyato dānto gṛhastho vijitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
दीक्षितो विधिवन्मन्त्री गुणैर्विगतकल्मषः /
स्वाचारनियतो दान्तो गृहस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: An initiated practitioner according to rule, free from defilement by virtues, / devoted to his own proper conduct, subdued, a householder with senses conquered,

sanskrit_iast:
aihikānanapekṣyaiva niṣkāmo yor'cayedvibhum /
sa sarvānpuṇyapāpaudhāndagdhvā nirmalamānasaḥ //
meaning:
ऐहिकाननपेक्ष्यैव निष्कामो योर्ऽचयेद्विभुम् /
स सर्वान्पुण्यपापौधान्दग्ध्वा निर्मलमानसः //
text_mt: who worships the Lord without desire, disregarding worldly rewards, / having burned the entire mass of merits and sins, with a purified mind,

sanskrit_iast:
punarāvṛttirahitaḥ śāśvataṃ padamaśvataṃ padamaśnute /
sakāmo vāñchitān labdhvā bhuktvā bhogān manogatān //
meaning:
पुनरावृत्तिरहितः शाश्वतं पदमश्वतं पदमश्नुते /
सकामो वाञ्छितान् लब्ध्वा भुक्त्वा भोगान् मनोगतान् //
text_mt: free from rebirth, attains the eternal abode. / One with desires, having obtained the sought-after [ends] and enjoyed the pleasures desired in his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
jātiramaraściraṃ bhūtvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam /
nidrācandrānvitā paścādbharatāya hṛdantimaḥ //
meaning:
जातिरमरश्चिरं भूत्वा याति विष्णोः परं पदम् /
निद्राचन्द्रान्विता पश्चाद्भरताय हृदन्तिमः //
text_mt: becomes long-lived and free from old age, and goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / [The syllable] ‘nidrā’ combined with the moon, then ‘bharatāya’, and ending with ‘hṛt’—

sanskrit_iast:
saptākṣaro manuścāsya munyādyarcādi pūrvavat /
bakaḥ seṃduśca śatrudhnaparaṃ ṅetaṃ hṛdantimaḥ //
meaning:
सप्ताक्षरो मनुश्चास्य मुन्याद्यर्चादि पूर्ववत् /
बकः सेंदुश्च शत्रुध्नपरं ङेतं हृदन्तिमः //
text_mt: this is his seven-syllabled mantra; its sage and the rest, and worship, are as before. / ‘Baka’ with the moon, followed by ‘śatrughna’ in the dative, and ending with ‘hṛt’—

sanskrit_iast:
saptākṣaro 'yaṃ śatrudhnamantraḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge buhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde rāmādyupāsanāvarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सप्ताक्षरो ऽयं शत्रुध्नमन्त्रः सर्वेष्टसिद्धिदः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बुहदुपाख्याने सनत्कुमारविभागे तृतीयपादे रामाद्युपासनावर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
this is the seven-syllabled Śatrughna mantra, granting the fulfillment of all desires.

Thus in the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, in the first part, in the great narrative, in the section of Sanatkumāra, in the third quarter, the seventy-third chapter, entitled ‘Description of the Worship of Rāma and Others’.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
athocyante hanumato mantrāḥ sarveṣṭadāyakāḥ /
yānsamārādhya viprendra tattulyācaraṇā narāḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथोच्यन्ते हनुमतो मन्त्राः सर्वेष्टदायकाः /
यान्समाराध्य विप्रेन्द्र तत्तुल्याचरणा नराः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Now the mantras of Hanumān that bestow all desires are spoken of, / by worshipping which, O best of brahmins, men come to act like him.

sanskrit_iast:
manuḥ svaredusaṃyuktaṃ gaganaṃ ca bhagānvitāḥ /
hasaphaāgniniśādhīśāḥdvitīyaṃ bījamīritam //
meaning:
मनुः स्वरेदुसंयुक्तं गगनं च भगान्विताः /
हसफआग्निनिशाधीशाःद्वितीयं बीजमीरितम् //
text_mt: The mantra: ether joined with vowel and moon, and combined with ‘bhaga’; / ‘ha’, ‘sa’, ‘pha’, fire, and the lord of the night: this is declared as the second seed-syllable;

sanskrit_iast:
svaphaāgnayo bhagendvāḍhyāstṛtīyaṃ bījamīritam /
viyadbhṛgvagnimanvinduyuktaṃ syāñca caturthakam //
meaning:
स्वफआग्नयो भगेन्द्वाढ्यास्तृतीयं बीजमीरितम् /
वियद्भृग्वग्निमन्विन्दुयुक्तं स्याञ्च चतुर्थकम् //
text_mt: ‘sva’, ‘pha’, and fires, rich in ‘bhaga’ and the moon: this is declared as the third seed-syllable; / ether, Bhṛgu, fire, Manu, and the moon combined shall be the fourth;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamaṃ bhagacandrāḍhyāviyadbhṛgusvakāgnayaḥ /
manvindvāḍhyau hasau ṣaṣṭaṃ ṅeṃtaḥ syāddhanumāṃstataḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमं भगचन्द्राढ्यावियद्भृगुस्वकाग्नयः /
मन्विन्द्वाढ्यौ हसौ षष्टं ङेंतः स्याद्धनुमांस्ततः //
text_mt: the fifth is ‘bhaga’ and moon, joined with ether, Bhṛgu, its own [vowel], and fire; / ‘ha’ and ‘sa’ joined with Manu and moon is the sixth; then ‘hanumat’ in the dative;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayānto mahāmantrarājo 'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ /
rāmacandro muniścāsya jagatīchanda īritam //
meaning:
हृदयान्तो महामन्त्रराजो ऽयं द्वादशाक्षरः /
रामचन्द्रो मुनिश्चास्य जगतीछन्द ईरितम् //
text_mt: ending with ‘hṛdaya’—this twelve-syllabled [formula] is the king of great mantras. / Rāmacandra is its sage, and Jagatī is declared as the metre;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā hanumānbījaṃ ṣaṣṭaṃ śaktirdvatīyakam /
ṣaḍbījaiśca ṣaḍaṅgāni śirobhāle dṛśormukhe //
meaning:
देवता हनुमान्बीजं षष्टं शक्तिर्द्वतीयकम् /
षड्बीजैश्च षडङ्गानि शिरोभाले दृशोर्मुखे //
text_mt: Hanumān is the deity, the sixth is the seed-syllable, the second is the power. / And with the six seed-syllables, the six limbs [are placed]: on the head, on the forehead, on the two eyes, in the mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
galabāhudvaye caiva hṛdi kukṣau ca nābhitaḥ /
dhvaje jānudvaye pādadvaye varṇānkramānnyaset //
meaning:
गलबाहुद्वये चैव हृदि कुक्षौ च नाभितः /
ध्वजे जानुद्वये पादद्वये वर्णान्क्रमान्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: on the throat and two arms, on the heart and belly, at the navel, / on the penis, on the two knees, and on the two feet, one should place the syllables in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍbījāni padadvandvaṃ mūrdhni bhāle mukhe hṛdi /
nābhāvūrvorjaṅghayośca pādayorvinyasetkramāt //
meaning:
षड्बीजानि पदद्वन्द्वं मूर्ध्नि भाले मुखे हृदि /
नाभावूर्वोर्जङ्घयोश्च पादयोर्विन्यसेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: One should place the six seed-syllables and the two words in order: on the crown, on the forehead, in the mouth, on the heart, / at the navel, on the thighs, on the shanks, and on the feet.

sanskrit_iast:
añjanīgarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ tato dhyāyetkapīśvaram /
udyatkoṭyarkasaṃkāśaṃ jagatprakṣobhakārakam //
meaning:
अञ्जनीगर्भसंभूतं ततो ध्यायेत्कपीश्वरम् /
उद्यत्कोट्यर्कसंकाशं जगत्प्रक्षोभकारकम् //
text_mt: Then one should meditate upon the lord of monkeys, born from the womb of Añjanī, / resembling ten million rising suns, shaking the world,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmāṅghridhyānaniṣṭaṃ sugrīvapramukhārcitam /
vitrāsayantaṃ nādena rākṣasānmārutiṃ bhajet //
meaning:
श्रीरामाङ्घ्रिध्याननिष्टं सुग्रीवप्रमुखार्चितम् /
वित्रासयन्तं नादेन राक्षसान्मारुतिं भजेत् //
text_mt: devoted to meditating on the feet of glorious Rāma, worshipped by Sugrīva and others; / one should resort to Māruti, who terrifies the rākṣasas with his roar.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapedbhānusahasraṃ vijitaindriyaḥ /
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādbīhīnpayodadhyājyamiśritān //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेद्भानुसहस्रं विजितैन्द्रियः /
दशांशं जुहुयाद्बीहीन्पयोदध्याज्यमिश्रितान् //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should recite twelve thousand times, with senses conquered. / One should offer into the fire a tenth [part in] paddy mixed with milk, curd, and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrttiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ /
āvāhya tatra saṃpūjya pādyādibhirupāyanaiḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्त्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः /
आवाह्य तत्र संपूज्य पाद्यादिभिरुपायनैः //
text_mt: Having fashioned an image with the root [mantra] upon the previously mentioned Vaiṣṇava ritual seat, / invoking [him] there and worshipping with water for the feet and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
keśareṣvaṅgapūjā syātpatreṣu ca tator'cayet /
rāmabhakto mahātejāḥ kapirājo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
केशरेष्वङ्गपूजा स्यात्पत्रेषु च ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
रामभक्तो महातेजाः कपिराजो महाबलः //
text_mt: the worship of the limbs should be upon the filaments; and then on the petals one should worship: / the devotee of Rāma, the greatly radiant, the king of monkeys, the exceedingly powerful,

sanskrit_iast:
droṇādrihārako merupīṭhakārcanakārakaḥ /
dakṣiṇāśābhāskaraśca sarvavighnavināśakaḥ //
meaning:
द्रोणाद्रिहारको मेरुपीठकार्चनकारकः /
दक्षिणाशाभास्करश्च सर्वविघ्नविनाशकः //
text_mt: the bringer of Mount Droṇa, the worshipper of the ritual seat of Meru, / the sun of the southern quarter, and the destroyer of all obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ sampūjya nāmāni dalāgreṣu tator'cayet /
sugrīvamaṅgada nīlaṃ jāṃbavantaṃ nalaṃ tathā //
meaning:
इत्थं सम्पूज्य नामानि दलाग्रेषु ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
सुग्रीवमङ्गद नीलं जांबवन्तं नलं तथा //
text_mt: Having worshipped these names in this way, one should then worship on the tips of the petals: / Sugrīva, Aṅgada, Nīla, Jāmbavat, and Nala,

sanskrit_iast:
suṣeṇaṃ dvividaṃ maindaṃ lokapālastator'cayet /
vajrādyānapi saṃpūjya siddhaścaivaṃ manurbhavet //
meaning:
सुषेणं द्विविदं मैन्दं लोकपालस्ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
वज्राद्यानपि संपूज्य सिद्धश्चैवं मनुर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Suṣeṇa, Dvivida, and Mainda; then one should worship the guardians of the world. / Having also worshipped the thunderbolt and the other [weapons], the mantra becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ navaśataṃ rātrau japeddaśadināvadhi /
yo narastasya naśyanti rājaśatrūtthabhītayaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रं नवशतं रात्रौ जपेद्दशदिनावधि /
यो नरस्तस्य नश्यन्ति राजशत्रूत्थभीतयः //
text_mt: A man who recites the mantra nine hundred [times] at night for a period of ten days, / his fears arising from kings and enemies are destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
mātuliṅgāmrakadalīphalairhutvā sahasrakam /
dvāviṃśatibrahmacāri viprānsaṃbhojayecchucīn //
meaning:
मातुलिङ्गाम्रकदलीफलैर्हुत्वा सहस्रकम् /
द्वाविंशतिब्रह्मचारि विप्रान्संभोजयेच्छुचीन् //
text_mt: Offering a thousand oblations into the fire with citron, mango, and plantain fruits, / one should feed twenty-two pure celibate brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṅkṛte bhūtaviṣagraharogādyupadravāḥ /
naśyanti tatkṣaṇādeva vidveṣigrahadānavāḥ //
meaning:
एवङ्कृते भूतविषग्रहरोगाद्युपद्रवाः /
नश्यन्ति तत्क्षणादेव विद्वेषिग्रहदानवाः //
text_mt: When this is done, afflictions such as spirits, poisons, seizing planets, and diseases, / and hostile seizing planets and dānavas, are destroyed in that very instant.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśatenāṃbu mantritaṃ viṣanāśanam /
bhūtāpasmārakṛtyotthajvare tanmantramantritaiḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतेनांबु मन्त्रितं विषनाशनम् /
भूतापस्मारकृत्योत्थज्वरे तन्मन्त्रमन्त्रितैः //
text_mt: Water consecrated with one hundred and eight [recitations] destroys poison. / In a fever arising from spirits, epilepsy, or black magic, with ashes

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmabhiḥ salilairvāpi tāḍayejjvariṇaṃ krudhā /
tridinājjvaramukto 'sau sukhaṃ ca labhate naraḥ //
meaning:
भस्मभिः सलिलैर्वापि ताडयेज्ज्वरिणं क्रुधा /
त्रिदिनाज्ज्वरमुक्तो ऽसौ सुखं च लभते नरः //
text_mt: or water consecrated with that mantra, one should strike the feverish person in anger; / after three days, that man is freed from the fever and attains comfort.

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi bhuktvā tanmantramantritam /
sarvānrogānparābhūya sukhī bhavati tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
औषधं वा जलं वापि भुक्त्वा तन्मन्त्रमन्त्रितम् /
सर्वान्रोगान्पराभूय सुखी भवति तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: Having consumed medicine or water consecrated with that mantra, / having overcome all diseases, he becomes happy at that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjaptabhasmaliptāṅgo bhuktvā tanmantritaṃ payaḥ /
yoddhuṃ gacchecca yo mantrī śastrasaṃghairṃna bādhyate //
meaning:
तज्जप्तभस्मलिप्ताङ्गो भुक्त्वा तन्मन्त्रितं पयः /
योद्धुं गच्छेच्च यो मन्त्री शस्त्रसंघैर्ंन बाध्यते //
text_mt: A practitioner who goes to fight with his body smeared with ashes over which that was recited, and having drunk water consecrated with it, / is not harmed by hosts of weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
śaskṣataṃ vraṇasphoṭo lūtāsphoṭo 'pi bhasmanā /
trirjaptena ca saṃspṛṣṭāḥ śuṣyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
शस्क्षतं व्रणस्फोटो लूतास्फोटो ऽपि भस्मना /
त्रिर्जप्तेन च संस्पृष्टाः शुष्यन्त्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: A weapon wound, an ulcer boil, or a spider boil, touched with ash / recited over three times, will certainly dry up, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
japedarkāstamārabhya yāvadarkedayo bhavet /
mantraṃ saptadinaṃ yāvañcādāya bhasmakīlakau //
meaning:
जपेदर्कास्तमारभ्य यावदर्केदयो भवेत् /
मन्त्रं सप्तदिनं यावञ्चादाय भस्मकीलकौ //
text_mt: Starting from sunset until sunrise, / he should recite the mantra for seven days; and taking two wooden pegs with ash,

sanskrit_iast:
nikhanedabhimantryāśuśatrūṇāṃ dvāryalakṣitaḥ /
vidveṣaṃ mitha āpannāḥ palāyante 'rayo 'cirāt //
meaning:
निखनेदभिमन्त्र्याशुशत्रूणां द्वार्यलक्षितः /
विद्वेषं मिथ आपन्नाः पलायन्ते ऽरयो ऽचिरात् //
text_mt: having quickly consecrated them, he should bury them unseen at the door of the enemies; / having fallen into mutual enmity, the enemies flee before long.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāṃbu candanaṃ mantrī mantreṇānena mantritam /
bhakṣyādiyojitaṃ yasmai dadāti sa tu dāsavat //
meaning:
भस्मांबु चन्दनं मन्त्री मन्त्रेणानेन मन्त्रितम् /
भक्ष्यादियोजितं यस्मै ददाति स तु दासवत् //
text_mt: The practitioner gives ash, water, or sandalwood paste consecrated with this mantra, / mixed with food and the like, to whomever, that person becomes like a slave;

sanskrit_iast:
krūrāśca jantavo 'pyevaṃ bhavanti vaśavartinaḥ /
gṛhītveśanadiskaṃsthaṃ karañjatarumūlakam //
meaning:
क्रूराश्च जन्तवो ऽप्येवं भवन्ति वशवर्तिनः /
गृहीत्वेशनदिस्कंस्थं करञ्जतरुमूलकम् //
text_mt: even cruel beasts become obedient in this way. / Taking the root of a karañja tree situated in the north-eastern direction,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tenāṅguṣṭamātrāṃ pratimāṃ ca hanūmataḥ /
kṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭāṃ ca siṃdūrādyaiḥ prapūjya ca //
meaning:
कृत्वा तेनाङ्गुष्टमात्रां प्रतिमां च हनूमतः /
कृत्वा प्राणप्रतिष्टां च सिंदूराद्यैः प्रपूज्य च //
text_mt: and having fashioned from it an image of Hanumān the size of a thumb, / and having performed the installation of life-breath and worshipped it with vermilion and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasyābhimukhī dvāre nikhanenmantramuñcaran /
grahābhicārarogāgniviṣacauranṛpodbhavāḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्याभिमुखी द्वारे निखनेन्मन्त्रमुञ्चरन् /
ग्रहाभिचाररोगाग्निविषचौरनृपोद्भवाः //
text_mt: he should bury it facing the house at the door, uttering the mantra. / Afflictions arising from seizing planets, sorcery, disease, fire, poison, thieves, and kings

sanskrit_iast:
na jāyante gṛhe tasmin kadācidapyupadravāḥ /
tadgṛhaṃ dhanaputrādyairedhate pratyahaṃ ciram //
meaning:
न जायन्ते गृहे तस्मिन् कदाचिदप्युपद्रवाः /
तद्गृहं धनपुत्राद्यैरेधते प्रत्यहं चिरम् //
text_mt: never arise in that house at any time; / that house prospers daily for a long time with wealth, sons, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
niśi yatra vane bhasma mṛtsnayā vāpi yatnataḥ /
śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā hṛdi nāma samālikhet //
meaning:
निशि यत्र वने भस्म मृत्स्नया वापि यत्नतः /
शत्रोः प्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा हृदि नाम समालिखेत् //
text_mt: At night, wherever in the forest, having carefully made an effigy of the enemy / with ash or clay, he should write the name upon the chest.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭāntaṃ bhindyācchastrairmanuṃ japan /
mantrānte proñcarecchatrornāma chindhi ca bhindhi ca //
meaning:
कृत्वा प्राणप्रतिष्टान्तं भिन्द्याच्छस्त्रैर्मनुं जपन् /
मन्त्रान्ते प्रोञ्चरेच्छत्रोर्नाम छिन्धि च भिन्धि च //
text_mt: Having performed up to the installation of life-breath, reciting the mantra, he should pierce it with weapons; / at the end of the mantra, he should utter the enemy’s name and: ‘Cut and pierce!’

sanskrit_iast:
mārayeti ca tasyānte dantairoṣṭaṃ nipūḍya ca /
pāṇyostale prapīḍyātha tyaktvā taṃ svagṛhaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
मारयेति च तस्यान्ते दन्तैरोष्टं निपूड्य च /
पाण्योस्तले प्रपीड्याथ त्यक्त्वा तं स्वगृहं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: And at its end, [pronouncing] “Kill!”, biting the lip with the teeth / and pressing the palms of the hands together, he should leave it and go to his own house.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvansaptadinaṃ caivaṃ hanyācchatruṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
rājikālavaṇairmuktacikuraḥ pitṛkānane //
meaning:
कुर्वन्सप्तदिनं चैवं हन्याच्छत्रुं न संशयः /
राजिकालवणैर्मुक्तचिकुरः पितृकानने //
text_mt: Doing this for seven days, he slays his enemy without doubt. / With disheveled hair in the cemetery, with black mustard and salt,

sanskrit_iast:
dhattūraphalapuṣpaiśca nakharomaviṣairapi /
dvika(kāka)kauśikagṛdhrāṇāṃ pakṣaiḥ śleṣmāntakākṣajaiḥ //
meaning:
धत्तूरफलपुष्पैश्च नखरोमविषैरपि /
द्विक(काक)कौशिकगृध्राणां पक्षैः श्लेष्मान्तकाक्षजैः //
text_mt: with dhattūra fruits and flowers, and with nails, hair, and poisons, / with feathers of crows, owls, and vultures, and with the kindling-sticks

sanskrit_iast:
