samiddhistriśataṃ yāmayadiṅmukho juhuyānniśi /
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kurvanmārayeduddhataṃ ripun //
meaning:
समिद्धिस्त्रिशतं यामयदिङ्मुखो जुहुयान्निशि /
एवं सप्तदिनं कुर्वन्मारयेदुद्धतं रिपुन् //
text_mt: produced from the śleṣmāntaka [and] akṣa trees, facing the southern quarter, he should offer three hundred oblations at night. / Doing this for seven days, he causes his haughty enemy to be killed.

sanskrit_iast:
vitrāsastridinaṃ rātrau śmaśāne ṣaṭśataṃ japet /
tato vetāla utthāya vadedbhāvi śubhāśubham //
meaning:
वित्रासस्त्रिदिनं रात्रौ श्मशाने षट्शतं जपेत् /
ततो वेताल उत्थाय वदेद्भावि शुभाशुभम् //
text_mt: Free of fear, he should recite [the mantra] six hundred times at night in the cremation ground for three days. / Then a vetāla, rising up, will speak of the future good and evil.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkarībhūya vartteta kurute sādhakoditam /
bhāsmāṃbumantritaṃ rātrau sahasrāvṛttikaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
किङ्करीभूय वर्त्तेत कुरुते साधकोदितम् /
भास्मांबुमन्त्रितं रात्रौ सहस्रावृत्तिकं पुनः //
text_mt: Becoming his servant, he remains and does whatever the practitioner commands. / Again, water consecrated with ashes, recited over a thousand times at night,

sanskrit_iast:
dinatrayaṃ ca tatpaścātprakṣipetpratimāsu ca /
yāsu kāsu ca sthūlāsu laghuṣvapi viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
दिनत्रयं च तत्पश्चात्प्रक्षिपेत्प्रतिमासु च /
यासु कासु च स्थूलासु लघुष्वपि विशेषतः //
text_mt: and after three days cast upon images— / upon any images whatsoever, whether large or especially small—

sanskrit_iast:
mantraprabhāvāñcalanaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ kuje vā ravivāsare //
meaning:
मन्त्रप्रभावाञ्चलनं भवत्येव न संशयः /
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां कुजे वा रविवासरे //
text_mt: movement definitely occurs by the power of the mantra, without doubt. / On the eighth or fourteenth lunar day, or on a Tuesday or Sunday,

sanskrit_iast:
hanumatpratimāṃ paṭṭe māṣaiḥ snehapariplutaiḥ /
kuryādramyāṃ viśuddhātmā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām //
meaning:
हनुमत्प्रतिमां पट्टे माषैः स्नेहपरिप्लुतैः /
कुर्याद्रम्यां विशुद्धात्मा सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम् //
text_mt: the pure-minded practitioner should make a charming image of Hanumat on a board out of māṣa beans drenched in oil, / endowed with all auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
tailadīpaṃ vāmabhāge ghṛtadīpaṃ tu dakṣiṇe /
saṃsthāpyāvāhayetpaścānmūlamantreṇa mantravit //
meaning:
तैलदीपं वामभागे घृतदीपं तु दक्षिणे /
संस्थाप्यावाहयेत्पश्चान्मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Placing an oil lamp on the left side and a ghee lamp on the right side, / the knower of mantras should then invoke [him] using the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇapratiṣṭāṃ kṛtvā ca pādyādīni samarpayet /
raktacandanapuṣpaiśca siṃdūrādyaiḥ samarcayet //
meaning:
प्राणप्रतिष्टां कृत्वा च पाद्यादीनि समर्पयेत् /
रक्तचन्दनपुष्पैश्च सिंदूराद्यैः समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Having performed the establishment of the breath of life, he should offer water for the feet and other rites, / and worship him with red sandalwood, flowers, vermilion, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pradāyātha naivedyaṃ ca samarpayet /
apūpamodanaṃ śākamodakānvaṭakādikam //
meaning:
धूपं दीपं प्रदायाथ नैवेद्यं च समर्पयेत् /
अपूपमोदनं शाकमोदकान्वटकादिकम् //
text_mt: Offering incense and a lamp, he should then present the food offering: / sweet cakes, cooked rice, vegetables, sweet dumplings, savory fried cakes, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sājyaṃ ca tatsamarpyātha mūlamantreṇa mantravit /
akhaṇḍitānyahilatādalāni saptaviṃśatim //
meaning:
साज्यं च तत्समर्प्याथ मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् /
अखण्डितान्यहिलतादलानि सप्तविंशतिम् //
text_mt: Having offered that along with ghee using the root-mantra, the knower of mantras / should take twenty-seven unbroken betel leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā kṛtvā sapūgāni mūlenaiva samarpayet /
evaṃ saṃpūjya mantrajño japeddaśaśanta manum //
meaning:
त्रिधा कृत्वा सपूगानि मूलेनैव समर्पयेत् /
एवं संपूज्य मन्त्रज्ञो जपेद्दशशन्त मनुम् //
text_mt: divide them threefold, and offer them along with betel nuts using the root-mantra alone. / Having worshipped thus, the knower of mantras should recite the mantra one thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrārārtikaṃ kṛtvā stutvā ca bahudhā sudhīḥ /
nijepsitaṃ nivedyātha vidhivadvisṛjettataḥ //
meaning:
कर्पूरारार्तिकं कृत्वा स्तुत्वा च बहुधा सुधीः /
निजेप्सितं निवेद्याथ विधिवद्विसृजेत्ततः //
text_mt: Performing the wave-offering with camphor and praising him in many ways, the wise man, / having communicated his own desire, should then dismiss him according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyānnena saṃbhojya brāhmaṇānsaptasaṃkhyayā /
niveditāni parṇāni tebhyo dadyādvibhajya ca //
meaning:
नैवेद्यान्नेन संभोज्य ब्राह्मणान्सप्तसंख्यया /
निवेदितानि पर्णानि तेभ्यो दद्याद्विभज्य च //
text_mt: Feeding seven brāhmaṇas with the consecrated food offerings, / he should distribute and give them the leaves that were offered.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathā śakti dattvā tān visṛjetsudhīḥ /
tata iṣṭagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणां च यथा शक्ति दत्त्वा तान् विसृजेत्सुधीः /
तत इष्टगणैः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Giving a priestly fee according to his ability, the wise man should dismiss them. / Then, remaining silent, he should eat himself together with his loved ones.

sanskrit_iast:
taddine bhūmiśayyāṃ ca brahmacaryyaṃ samācaret /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ so 'cirādeva niścitam //
meaning:
तद्दिने भूमिशय्यां च ब्रह्मचर्य्यं समाचरेत् /
एवं यः कुरुते मर्त्यः सो ऽचिरादेव निश्चितम् //
text_mt: On that day he should sleep on the bare ground and observe celibacy. / The mortal who acts thus, surely and before long,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnuyātsakalānkāmānkapīśasya prasādataḥ /
hanumatpratimāṃ bhūmau vilikhettatpuro manum //
meaning:
प्राप्नुयात्सकलान्कामान्कपीशस्य प्रसादतः /
हनुमत्प्रतिमां भूमौ विलिखेत्तत्पुरो मनुम् //
text_mt: will obtain all desires through the grace of the lord of monkeys. / He should draw an image of Hanumat on the ground, and in front of it the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyanāma dvitīyāntaṃ vimocaya vimocaya /
tatpūrvaṃ mārjayedvāmapāṇinātha punarlikhet /
evamaṣṭottaraśataṃ likhitvā mārjayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
साध्यनाम द्वितीयान्तं विमोचय विमोचय /
तत्पूर्वं मार्जयेद्वामपाणिनाथ पुनर्लिखेत् /
एवमष्टोत्तरशतं लिखित्वा मार्जयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: The name of the target in the accusative case, followed by: “Release, release!” / He should wipe it clean with his left hand and then write it again; / having written it thus one hundred and eight times, he should wipe it again.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte mahākārāgṛhācchīghraṃ vimucyate /
evamanyāni karmāṇi kuryyāntpallavamullikhan //
meaning:
एवं कृते महाकारागृहाच्छीघ्रं विमुच्यते /
एवमन्यानि कर्माणि कुर्य्यान्त्पल्लवमुल्लिखन् //
text_mt: When this is done, one is swiftly freed from a great prison. / Thus one should perform other ritual acts, writing the appended phrases.

sanskrit_iast:
sarṣapairvaśyakṛddhomo vidveṣe hayamārajaiḥ /
kuṅkumairidhmakāṣṭhairvā marīcairjīrakairapi //
meaning:
सर्षपैर्वश्यकृद्धोमो विद्वेषे हयमारजैः /
कुङ्कुमैरिध्मकाष्ठैर्वा मरीचैर्जीरकैरपि //
text_mt: Oblation with mustard seeds brings subjugation; in causing enmity, with parts of the oleander, / with saffron, firewood, or black pepper and cumin.

sanskrit_iast:
jvare dūrvāguḍūcībhirdadhnā kṣīreṇa vā ghṛtaiḥ /
śūle karañjavātārisamidbhistailalolitaiḥ //
meaning:
ज्वरे दूर्वागुडूचीभिर्दध्ना क्षीरेण वा घृतैः /
शूले करञ्जवातारिसमिद्भिस्तैललोलितैः //
text_mt: In fever, with dūrvā grass, guḍūcī, curd, milk, or ghee; / in piercing pain, with kindling-sticks of the karañja and castor plant smeared with oil,

sanskrit_iast:
tailāktābhiśca nirguṇḍīsamidbhirvā prayatnataḥ /
saubhāgye candanaiścendralocanairvā lavaṅgakaiḥ //
meaning:
तैलाक्ताभिश्च निर्गुण्डीसमिद्भिर्वा प्रयत्नतः /
सौभाग्ये चन्दनैश्चेन्द्रलोचनैर्वा लवङ्गकैः //
text_mt: or with kindling-sticks of nirguṇḍī anointed with oil, carefully [offered]; / for good fortune, with sandalwood, indralocana, or cloves;

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhapuṣpairvastrāptyai tattaddhānyaistadāptaye /
ripupādarajobhiśca rājīlavaṇamiśritaiḥ //
meaning:
सुगन्धपुष्पैर्वस्त्राप्त्यै तत्तद्धान्यैस्तदाप्तये /
रिपुपादरजोभिश्च राजीलवणमिश्रितैः //
text_mt: for obtaining garments, with fragrant flowers; for gaining various grains, with those respective grains; / and with dust from an enemy’s feet mixed with black mustard and salt,

sanskrit_iast:
homayetsaptarātraṃ ca ripuryāti yamālayam /
dhānyaiḥ saṃprāpyate dhānyamannairannasamucchrayaḥ //
meaning:
होमयेत्सप्तरात्रं च रिपुर्याति यमालयम् /
धान्यैः संप्राप्यते धान्यमन्नैरन्नसमुच्छ्रयः //
text_mt: he should offer oblations for seven nights, and the enemy goes to the abode of Yama. / By grains, grain is obtained; by food, an abundance of food;

sanskrit_iast:
tilājyakṣīramadhubhirmahiṣīgosamṛddhaye /
kiṃ bahūktairviṣe vyādhau śāntau mohe ca māraṇe //
meaning:
तिलाज्यक्षीरमधुभिर्महिषीगोसमृद्धये /
किं बहूक्तैर्विषे व्याधौ शान्तौ मोहे च मारणे //
text_mt: with sesamum, ghee, milk, and honey, for the prosperity of buffaloes and cows. / What need of saying much? In cases of poison, disease, pacification, delusion, and killing;

sanskrit_iast:
vivāde staṃbhane dyūte bhūtabhītau ca saṃkaṭe /
vaśye yuddhe kṣate divye bandhamokṣe mahāvane //
meaning:
विवादे स्तंभने द्यूते भूतभीतौ च संकटे /
वश्ये युद्धे क्षते दिव्ये बन्धमोक्षे महावने //
text_mt: in dispute, immobilization, gambling, fear of spirits, and peril; / in subjugation, battle, wounds, ordeals, liberation from bonds, and in the great forest,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhito 'yaṃ nṛṇāṃ dadyānmantraḥ śreyaḥ suniścitam /
vakṣye 'tha hanumadyantraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam //
meaning:
साधितो ऽयं नृणां दद्यान्मन्त्रः श्रेयः सुनिश्चितम् /
वक्ष्ये ऽथ हनुमद्यन्त्रं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: this mantra, when mastered, will assuredly grant the highest good to men. / I shall now declare the yantra of Hanumat, which grants all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
lāṅgūlākārasaṃyuktaṃ valayatritayaṃ likhet /
sādhyanāma likhenmadhye pāśibīja praveṣṭitam //
meaning:
लाङ्गूलाकारसंयुक्तं वलयत्रितयं लिखेत् /
साध्यनाम लिखेन्मध्ये पाशिबीज प्रवेष्टितम् //
text_mt: One should draw three concentric circles provided with the form of a tail. / In the middle he should write the name of the target, encircled by the bīja of the noose-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
uparyaṣṭacchadaṃ kṛtvā patreṣu kavacaṃ likhet /
tadbahirdaṃhamālikhya tadbahiścaturasrakam //
meaning:
उपर्यष्टच्छदं कृत्वा पत्रेषु कवचं लिखेत् /
तद्बहिर्दंहमालिख्य तद्बहिश्चतुरस्रकम् //
text_mt: Above it, having made an eight-petalled lotus, he should write the armor-mantra on the petals. / Outside that, having drawn a [...] circle, outside that a square.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasasrasya rekhāgre triśūlāni samālikhet /
saiṃ bījaṃ bhūpurasyāṣṭavajreṣu vilikhettataḥ //
meaning:
चतुरसस्रस्य रेखाग्रे त्रिशूलानि समालिखेत् /
सैं बीजं भूपुरस्याष्टवज्रेषु विलिखेत्ततः //
text_mt: At the tips of the lines of the square he should draw tridents. / Then he should write the bīja 'saiṃ' on the eight thunderbolts of the earth-city.

sanskrit_iast:
koṇeṣvakuṃśamālikhya mālāmantreṇa veṣṭayet /
tatsarvaṃ veṣṭayedyantravalayatritayena ca //
meaning:
कोणेष्वकुंशमालिख्य मालामन्त्रेण वेष्टयेत् /
तत्सर्वं वेष्टयेद्यन्त्रवलयत्रितयेन च //
text_mt: Having written the goad in the corners, he should surround it with the mālā-mantra. / He should enclose all that with three circles of the yantra.

sanskrit_iast:
śilāyāṃ phalake vastre tāmrapatre 'tha kuḍyake /
tāḍapatre 'tha bhūrje vā rocanānābhikuṅkubhaiḥ //
meaning:
शिलायां फलके वस्त्रे ताम्रपत्रे ऽथ कुड्यके /
ताडपत्रे ऽथ भूर्जे वा रोचनानाभिकुङ्कुभैः //
text_mt: On a stone, a wooden board, cloth, a copper sheet, or a wall, / on a palm-leaf or birch bark, with yellow pigment, musk, and saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
yantrametatsamālikhya nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ /
kapeḥ prāṇānpratiṣṭāpya pūjayettadyathāvidhi //
meaning:
यन्त्रमेतत्समालिख्य निराहारो जितेन्द्रियः /
कपेः प्राणान्प्रतिष्टाप्य पूजयेत्तद्यथाविधि //
text_mt: having drawn this yantra, fasting and with senses subdued, / having established the vital breath of the monkey, he should worship it according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣaduḥkhaśāntyarthaḥ yantraṃ saṃdhārayed budhaḥ /
mārījvarābhicārādisarvopadravanāśanam //
meaning:
अशेषदुःखशान्त्यर्थः यन्त्रं संधारयेद् बुधः /
मारीज्वराभिचारादिसर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् //
text_mt: For the pacification of endless suffering, the wise man should wear the yantra, / which destroys all afflictions such as pestilence, fevers, and malevolent sorcery.

sanskrit_iast:
yoṣitāmapi bālānāṃ dhṛtaṃ janamanoharam /
bhūtakṛtyāpiśācānāṃ darśanādeva nāśanam //
meaning:
योषितामपि बालानां धृतं जनमनोहरम् /
भूतकृत्यापिशाचानां दर्शनादेव नाशनम् //
text_mt: Worn by women and children, it captivates the minds of people; / it destroys bhūtas, kṛtyās, and piśācas by its very sight.

sanskrit_iast:
mālāmantramatho vakṣye tāro vāgviṣṇugehinī /
dīrghatrayānvitā māyā prāguktaṃ kūṭapañcakam //
meaning:
मालामन्त्रमथो वक्ष्ये तारो वाग्विष्णुगेहिनी /
दीर्घत्रयान्विता माया प्रागुक्तं कूटपञ्चकम् //
text_mt: Now I shall declare the mālā-mantra: the praṇava, Sarasvatī, the consort of Viṣṇu, / the māyā-bīja endowed with three long vowels, the five-fold combination previously spoken,

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvo hṛddhanumānṅeṃto 'tha prakaṭaparākramaḥ /
ākrāntadigmaṇḍalānte yaśovitānasaṃvadet //
meaning:
ध्रुवो हृद्धनुमान्ङेंतो ऽथ प्रकटपराक्रमः /
आक्रान्तदिग्मण्डलान्ते यशोवितानसंवदेत् //
text_mt: the dhruva, the heart, 'Hanumat' in the dative case, and then: 'O you of manifest valor!', / at the end of 'who have pervaded the circle of the quarters', one should say: 'whose canopy of fame

sanskrit_iast:
dhavalīkṛtavarṇānte jagattritayavajra ca /
dehajvaladagnisūrya koṭyante ca samaprabha //
meaning:
धवलीकृतवर्णान्ते जगत्त्रितयवज्र च /
देहज्वलदग्निसूर्य कोट्यन्ते च समप्रभ //
text_mt: has whitened the three worlds', and 'O adamantine / body, whose splendor is equal to crores of blazing fires and suns!',

sanskrit_iast:
tanūruhapadānte tu rudrāvatāra saṃvadet /
laṅkāpurī tataḥ paścāddahanodadhilaṅghana //
meaning:
तनूरुहपदान्ते तु रुद्रावतार संवदेत् /
लङ्कापुरी ततः पश्चाद्दहनोदधिलङ्घन //
text_mt: and after the word 'whose body hair...', one should say: 'O incarnation of Rudra!', / then 'the city of Laṅkā', 'O burner of...', 'who leaped over the ocean!',

sanskrit_iast:
daśagrīvaśiraḥ paścātkṛtāntakapadaṃ vadet /
sītānte śvasanapadaṃ vāyvante sutamīrayet //
meaning:
दशग्रीवशिरः पश्चात्कृतान्तकपदं वदेत् /
सीतान्ते श्वसनपदं वाय्वन्ते सुतमीरयेत् //
text_mt: after 'the heads of the ten-necked one', one should say the word 'death-dealer', / after 'Sītā', the word 'breath-giving', and after 'wind', one should utter 'son!',

sanskrit_iast:
añjanāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ śrīrāmalakṣmaṇānvitaḥ /
nandanti kara varṇānte sainyaprākāra īrayet //
meaning:
अञ्जनागर्भसंभूतः श्रीरामलक्ष्मणान्वितः /
नन्दन्ति कर वर्णान्ते सैन्यप्राकार ईरयेत् //
text_mt: ‘born from the womb of Añjanā’, ‘accompanied by the blessed Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa’, / after the syllable that causes delight, one should utter ‘rampart of the army!’,

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvasakhyakādūrṇādraṇavālinivarhaṇa /
kāraṇadroṇaśabdānte parvatotpāṭaneti ca //
meaning:
सुग्रीवसख्यकादूर्णाद्रणवालिनिवर्हण /
कारणद्रोणशब्दान्ते पर्वतोत्पाटनेति च //
text_mt: ‘who eagerly forged friendship with Sugrīva’, ‘destroyer of Vālin in battle’, / after the words ‘the cause of... Droṇa’, one should say ‘uprooter of the mountain!’,

sanskrit_iast:
aśokavanavīthyante dāruṇākṣakumāraka /
chedanānte vanarakṣākarānte tu samūha ca //
meaning:
अशोकवनवीथ्यन्ते दारुणाक्षकुमारक /
छेदनान्ते वनरक्षाकरान्ते तु समूह च //
text_mt: after ‘avenue of the Aśoka grove’, ‘severer of the fierce prince Akṣa’, / after ‘severing’, and after ‘protecting the grove’, ‘the host

sanskrit_iast:
vibhañjanānte brahmāstrabrahmaśakti graseti ca /
lakṣmaṇānte śaktibhedanivāraṇapadaṃ vadet //
meaning:
विभञ्जनान्ते ब्रह्मास्त्रब्रह्मशक्ति ग्रसेति च /
लक्ष्मणान्ते शक्तिभेदनिवारणपदं वदेत् //
text_mt: destroying’, and after ‘destroying’, ‘devourer of the Brahmā-missile and the Brahma-potency!’, / after ‘Lakṣmaṇa’, one should speak the phrase ‘averter of the piercing by the spear!’,

sanskrit_iast:
viśalyoṣadhiśabdānte samānayana saṃpaṭhet /
bālodita tato bhānumaṇḍalagrasaneti ca //
meaning:
विशल्योषधिशब्दान्ते समानयन संपठेत् /
बालोदित ततो भानुमण्डलग्रसनेति च //
text_mt: after the word ‘herb that removes arrows’, one should recite ‘bringer of!’, / then ‘who swallowed the disc of the newly risen sun!’,

sanskrit_iast:
meghanādahomapadādvidhvaṃsanapadaṃ vadet /
indrajidūdhakārānte ṇasītāsakṣaketi ca //
meaning:
मेघनादहोमपदाद्विध्वंसनपदं वदेत् /
इन्द्रजिदूधकारान्ते णसीतासक्षकेति च //
text_mt: after the word ‘the sacrifice of Meghanāda’, one should say the word ‘destroyer of!’, / and after ‘slayer of Indrajit’, ‘cause of life to Sītā!’.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasīsaṃghaśabdānte vidāraṇapadaṃ vadet /
kuṃbhakarṇādisaṃkīrtyavadhānte ca parāyaṇa //
meaning:
राक्षसीसंघशब्दान्ते विदारणपदं वदेत् /
कुंभकर्णादिसंकीर्त्यवधान्ते च परायण //
text_mt: After the word 'rākṣasī-saṃgha' ('host of demonesses'), one should utter the word 'vidāraṇa' ('rending'); / having mentioned Kumbhakarṇa and others, then 'parāyaṇa' ('wholly devoted to') after 'vadha' ('slaying'),

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrāmabhaktivarṇānte tatpareti samudra ca /
vyomadrumalaṅghaneti mahāsāmarthya saṃvadet //
meaning:
श्रीरामभक्तिवर्णान्ते तत्परेति समुद्र च /
व्योमद्रुमलङ्घनेति महासामर्थ्य संवदेत् //
text_mt: and after the syllables 'śrī-rāma-bhakti' ('devotion to Śrī Rāma'), 'tatpara' ('intent upon that'); then 'samudra-' ('ocean-'), / 'vyoma-druma-laṅghana' ('leaping over the tree of the sky'), and one should utter 'mahā-sāmarthya' ('of great power');

sanskrit_iast:
mahātejaḥpuñjaśabdādvirājamānavoñcaret /
svāmivacanasaṃpāditārjunānte ca saṃyuga //
meaning:
महातेजःपुञ्जशब्दाद्विराजमानवोञ्चरेत् /
स्वामिवचनसंपादितार्जुनान्ते च संयुग //
text_mt: after the word 'mahā-tejaḥ-puñja' ('mass of great splendor'), one should utter 'virājamāna' ('shining'); / then 'saṃyuga-' ('battle-') after 'arjuna', and 'svāmi-vacana-saṃpādita' ('accomplished through the lord's command');

sanskrit_iast:
sahāyānte kumāreti brahmacārinpadaṃvadet /
gaṃbhīraśabdodayānte dakṣiṇāpatha saṃvadet /
mārttāṇḍameru śabdānte vadetparvatapīṭikā //
meaning:
सहायान्ते कुमारेति ब्रह्मचारिन्पदंवदेत् /
गंभीरशब्दोदयान्ते दक्षिणापथ संवदेत् /
मार्त्ताण्डमेरु शब्दान्ते वदेत्पर्वतपीटिका //
text_mt: after 'sahāya' ('companion'), one should utter 'kumāra' ('youth') and the word 'brahmacārin' ('celibate student'); / after the rising of the word 'gambhīra' ('deep'), one should utter 'dakṣiṇāpatha' ('the southern region'); / after the words 'mārtāṇḍa-meru' ('sun and Meru'), one should utter 'parvata-pīṭhikā' ('mountain-pedestal');

sanskrit_iast:
arcanānte tu sakalamantrānte mapadaṃ vadet /
ācāryamama śabdānte sarvagrahavināśana //
meaning:
अर्चनान्ते तु सकलमन्त्रान्ते मपदं वदेत् /
आचार्यमम शब्दान्ते सर्वग्रहविनाशन //
text_mt: after 'arcana' ('worship'), then 'sakala-mantra' ('all mantras'), at the end of which one should say the syllable 'ma'; / after the words 'ācārya mama' ('my preceptor'), then 'sarva-graha-vināśana' ('destroyer of all seize-spirits');

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajvaroñcāṭanānte sarvaviṣavināśana /
sarvāpattinivāraṇa sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇa //
meaning:
सर्वज्वरोञ्चाटनान्ते सर्वविषविनाशन /
सर्वापत्तिनिवारण सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हण //
text_mt: after 'sarva-jvaroccāṭana' ('expeller of all fevers'), 'sarva-viṣa-vināśana' ('destroyer of all poisons'), / 'sarvāpatti-nivāraṇa' ('averter of all misfortunes'), and 'sarva-duṣṭa-nibarhaṇa' ('subduer of all the wicked').

sanskrit_iast: sarvavyādhyādi samprocya bhayānte ca nivāraṇa //
meaning: सर्वव्याध्यादि सम्प्रोच्य भयान्ते च निवारण //
text_mt: Having spoken "all diseases and so forth," then after "fear" comes "dispeller";

sanskrit_iast: sarvaśatrucchedaneti tato mama parasya ca //
meaning: सर्वशत्रुच्छेदनेति ततो मम परस्य च //
text_mt: then "destroyer of all enemies"; next, "of me and of others";

sanskrit_iast:
tatastribhuvanānte tu puṃstrīnapuṃsakātmakam /
sarvajīvapadānte tu jātaṃ vaśayayugmakam //
meaning:
ततस्त्रिभुवनान्ते तु पुंस्त्रीनपुंसकात्मकम् /
सर्वजीवपदान्ते तु जातं वशययुग्मकम् //
text_mt: then, after "the three worlds," "consisting of male, female, and neuter"; / and after the word "all living beings," the phrase "bring under control, bring under control";

sanskrit_iast:
mamājñākārakaṃ paścātsaṃpādaya yugaṃ punaḥ /
tato nānānāmadheyānsarvān rājñaḥ sa saṃpaṭhet //
meaning:
ममाज्ञाकारकं पश्चात्संपादय युगं पुनः /
ततो नानानामधेयान्सर्वान् राज्ञः स संपठेत् //
text_mt: after that, "bring about, bring about obedience to my command"; / then he should recite all the kings along with their various names;

sanskrit_iast:
parivārānmametyante sevakān kuru yugmakam /
sarvaśastravītyante ṣāṇi vidhvaṃsaya dvayam //
meaning:
परिवारान्ममेत्यन्ते सेवकान् कुरु युग्मकम् /
सर्वशस्त्रवीत्यन्ते षाणि विध्वंसय द्वयम् //
text_mt: at the end of "my retinue," "make servants, make servants"; / after "all weapons and missiles," "destroy, destroy the poisons";

sanskrit_iast:
lajjādīrghatrayopetā hotrayaṃ caihi yugmakam /
vilomaṃ pañcakūṭāni sarvaśatrūnhanadvayam //
meaning:
लज्जादीर्घत्रयोपेता होत्रयं चैहि युग्मकम् /
विलोमं पञ्चकूटानि सर्वशत्रून्हनद्वयम् //
text_mt: [the syllable Hrīṃ] having the three long [vowels], three times "Ho", and twice "Ehi"; / in reverse order the five peak syllables; twice "slay all enemies";

sanskrit_iast: parabalāni parānte sainyāni kṣobhayadvayam //
meaning: परबलानि परान्ते सैन्यानि क्षोभयद्वयम् //
text_mt: after "the armies of enemies," twice "agitate the forces";

sanskrit_iast: mama sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ sādhayeti dvayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning: मम सर्वं कार्यजातं साधयेति द्वयं ततः //
text_mt: then twice "accomplish all my undertakings";

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduṣṭadurjanānte mukhāni kīlayadvayam /
dhetrayaṃ varmatritayaṃ phaṭtrayaṃ hāntrayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदुष्टदुर्जनान्ते मुखानि कीलयद्वयम् /
धेत्रयं वर्मत्रितयं फट्त्रयं हान्त्रयं ततः //
text_mt: after "all wicked and evil people," twice "pin their mouths"; / three times "Dhe", three armours [Hūṃ], three times "Phaṭ", and then three times "Hā";

sanskrit_iast: vahnipriyānto mantro 'yaṃ mālāsaṃjño 'khileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning: वह्निप्रियान्तो मन्त्रो ऽयं मालासंज्ञो ऽखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: ending with the beloved of fire [Svāhā], this mantra named Mālā grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast: vasvaṣṭabāṇavarṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sarveṣṭāsādhakaḥ //
meaning: वस्वष्टबाणवर्णो ऽयं मन्त्रः सर्वेष्टासाधकः //
text_mt: This mantra of five hundred and eighty-eight syllables accomplishes all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhaye mahotpāte smṛto 'yaṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ /
dvādaśārṇasya ṣaṭkūṭaṃ tyaktvā bījaṃ tathādimam //
meaning:
महाभये महोत्पाते स्मृतो ऽयं दुःखनाशनः /
द्वादशार्णस्य षट्कूटं त्यक्त्वा बीजं तथादिमम् //
text_mt: Remembered in great fear and great calamity, it destroys suffering. / Having omitted the first seed-syllable and the six-peak [formula] of the twelve-syllabled [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakūṭātmako mantraḥ sarvakāmapradāyakaḥ /
rāmacandro muniścāsya gāyatrī chanda īritam //
meaning:
पञ्चकूटात्मको मन्त्रः सर्वकामप्रदायकः /
रामचन्द्रो मुनिश्चास्य गायत्री छन्द ईरितम् //
text_mt: the five-peak mantra is the bestower of all desires. / Rāmacandra is its seer, and the metre is declared to be gāyatrī;

sanskrit_iast:
hanumāndevatā prokto viniyogo 'khilāptaye /
pañcabījaiḥ samastena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
हनुमान्देवता प्रोक्तो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
पञ्चबीजैः समस्तेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Hanumān is proclaimed the deity, and the application is for the attainment of everything. / With the five seed-syllables together with the whole [mantra], one should perform the six limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
rāmadūto lakṣmaṇānte prāṇadātāñjanīsutaḥ /
sītāśokavināśo 'yaṃ laṅkāprāsādabhañjanaḥ //
meaning:
रामदूतो लक्ष्मणान्ते प्राणदाताञ्जनीसुतः /
सीताशोकविनाशो ऽयं लङ्काप्रासादभञ्जनः //
text_mt: "Messenger of Rāma", "giver of life to Lakṣmaṇa", "son of Añjanī", / "destroyer of Sītā's sorrow", "shatterer of the palaces of Laṅkā" —

sanskrit_iast:
hanumadādyāḥ pañcaite bījādyā ṅeyutāḥ punaḥ /
ṣaḍaṅgamanavo hyete dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat //
meaning:
हनुमदाद्याः पञ्चैते बीजाद्या ङेयुताः पुनः /
षडङ्गमनवो ह्येते ध्यानपूजादि पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: these five, beginning with Hanumān, preceded by the seed-syllables and ending with the dative case [Ṅe], / are indeed the mantras for the six limbs; meditation, worship, and the rest are as before.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo vāgbhavaṃ padmā māyā dīrghatrayānvitā /
pañcakūṭāni mantro 'yaṃ rudrārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवो वाग्भवं पद्मा माया दीर्घत्रयान्विता /
पञ्चकूटानि मन्त्रो ऽयं रुद्रार्णः सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: The Praṇava [Om], the seed of speech [Aiṃ], the lotus seed [Śrīṃ], and the seed of illusion [Hrīṃ] endowed with the three long vowels, / and the five-peak syllables: this eleven-syllabled mantra grants all spiritual attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvamasyāpi pūrvavanmatam /
ayamārādhito mantraḥ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यानपूजादिकं सर्वमस्यापि पूर्ववन्मतम् /
अयमाराधितो मन्त्रः सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकः //
text_mt: Its meditation, worship, and the rest are also considered to be entirely as before. / This mantra, when worshipped, bestows all desired things.

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhagavate paścādanantaścandraśekharāṃ /
janeyāya mahānte tu balāyānte 'gnivallabhā //
meaning:
नमो भगवते पश्चादनन्तश्चन्द्रशेखरां /
जनेयाय महान्ते तु बलायान्ते ऽग्निवल्लभा //
text_mt: "Namo bhagavate", then Ananta [A], Candraśekhara with anusvāra [Aṃ], / "Janeyāya", then after "mahā" [comes] "balāya", and at the end the beloved of fire [Svāhā];

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśārṇo mantro 'yaṃ sunirīśvarasaṃjñakaḥ /
chando 'nuṣṭupdevatā tu hanumānpavanātmajaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टादशार्णो मन्त्रो ऽयं सुनिरीश्वरसंज्ञकः /
छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप्देवता तु हनुमान्पवनात्मजः //
text_mt: this eighteen-syllabled mantra is known as Sunirīśvara. / The metre is anuṣṭubh, and the deity is Hanumān, the son of the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
haṃ bījaṃ vahnivanitā śaktiḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ /
āñjaneyāya hṛdayaṃ śiraśca rudramūrtaye //
meaning:
हं बीजं वह्निवनिता शक्तिः प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः /
आञ्जनेयाय हृदयं शिरश्च रुद्रमूर्तये //
text_mt: The seed-syllable is Haṃ, and the wife of fire [Svāhā] is declared by the wise to be the power. / "To the son of Añjanā" is the heart, "and to the Rudra-form" is the head;

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyāṃ vāyuputrāyāgnigarbhāya varmaṇi /
rāmadūtāya netraṃ syādbahyāstrāyāstramīritam //
meaning:
शिखायां वायुपुत्रायाग्निगर्भाय वर्मणि /
रामदूताय नेत्रं स्याद्बह्यास्त्रायास्त्रमीरितम् //
text_mt: "to the son of the wind" on the tuft, "to the fire-wombed" for the armor, / "to the messenger of Rāma" is the eye, and "to the external weapon" is declared the weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpacāmīkaranibhaṃ bhīghnasaṃvihitāñjalim /
calatkuṇḍaladīptāsyaṃ padmakṣaṃ mārutiṃ smaret //
meaning:
तत्पचामीकरनिभं भीघ्नसंविहिताञ्जलिम् /
चलत्कुण्डलदीप्तास्यं पद्मक्षं मारुतिं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: One should meditate on Māruti, resembling refined gold, with hands folded in reverent salutation, / his face radiant with swinging earrings, lotus-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivamayutaṃ japtvā daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ /
vaiṣṇave pūjayetpīṭhe prāguddiṣṭena vartmanā //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवमयुतं जप्त्वा दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः /
वैष्णवे पूजयेत्पीठे प्रागुद्दिष्टेन वर्त्मना //
text_mt: Having meditated thus and recited [the mantra] ten thousand times, one should offer a tenth part in fire oblations with sesame seeds. / He should worship on a Vaiṣṇava seat in the manner previously described.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ naktabhojī jitendriyaḥ /
japitvā kṣudrarogebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं नित्यं नक्तभोजी जितेन्द्रियः /
जपित्वा क्षुद्ररोगेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Reciting [it] one hundred and eight times daily, eating only at night, with senses restrained, / he is freed from petty ailments; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāroganivṛttyai tu sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japet /
rākṣasaughaṃ vinighnantaṃ kapiṃ dhyātvādhanāśanam //
meaning:
महारोगनिवृत्त्यै तु सहस्रं प्रत्यहं जपेत् /
राक्षसौघं विनिघ्नन्तं कपिं ध्यात्वाधनाशनम् //
text_mt: For the removal of great diseases, one should recite [it] a thousand times daily, / meditating on the monkey who slays the host of demons and destroys sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ prajapennityamacirājja yati dviṣam /
sugrīveṇa samaṃ rāmaṃ saṃdadhānaṃ kapiṃ smaran //
meaning:
अयुतं प्रजपेन्नित्यमचिराज्ज यति द्विषम् /
सुग्रीवेण समं रामं संदधानं कपिं स्मरन् //
text_mt: He should constantly recite ten thousand times, and soon he conquers his enemy. / Meditating on the monkey uniting Rāma with Sugrīva,

sanskrit_iast:
prajapedayutaṃ yastu saṃdhiṃ kuryāddvipadvayoḥ /
dhyātvā laṅkāṃ dahṝntaṃ tamayutaṃ prajapenmanum //
meaning:
प्रजपेदयुतं यस्तु संधिं कुर्याद्द्विपद्वयोः /
ध्यात्वा लङ्कां दहॄन्तं तमयुतं प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: he who recites ten thousand times brings about an alliance between two kings. / Meditating on him burning Laṅkā, one should recite the mantra ten thousand times;

sanskrit_iast:
acirādeva śatrūṇāṃ grāmānsaṃpradahetsudhīḥ /
dhyātvā prayāṇasamaye hanumantaṃ japenmanum //
meaning:
अचिरादेव शत्रूणां ग्रामान्संप्रदहेत्सुधीः /
ध्यात्वा प्रयाणसमये हनुमन्तं जपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: the wise man will soon burn down the villages of his enemies. / Meditating on Hanumān at the time of departure, one should recite the mantra;

sanskrit_iast:
yo yāti so 'cirātsveṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā gṛhe vrajet /
hanumantaṃ sadā gehe yor'cayejjapatatparaḥ //
meaning:
यो याति सो ऽचिरात्स्वेष्टं साधयित्वा गृहे व्रजेत् /
हनुमन्तं सदा गेहे योर्ऽचयेज्जपतत्परः //
text_mt: he who departs will soon accomplish his desired goal and return home. / One who constantly worships Hanumān at home, intent on recitation,

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyaṃ ca śriyaṃ kāntiṃ labhate nirupadravam /
kānane vyāghracaurebhyo rakṣenmanurayaṃ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आरोग्यं च श्रियं कान्तिं लभते निरुपद्रवम् /
कानने व्याघ्रचौरेभ्यो रक्षेन्मनुरयं स्मृतः //
text_mt: attains health, prosperity, and beauty, free from distress. / Remembered in the forest, this mantra protects from tigers and thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
prasvāpakāle śayyāyāṃ smarenmantramananyadhīḥ /
tasya duḥsvapnacaurādibhayaṃ naiva bhavetkvacit //
meaning:
प्रस्वापकाले शय्यायां स्मरेन्मन्त्रमनन्यधीः /
तस्य दुःस्वप्नचौरादिभयं नैव भवेत्क्वचित् //
text_mt: At the time of falling asleep on the bed, one should remember the mantra with undivided mind; / he will never have any fear from bad dreams, thieves, or the like.

sanskrit_iast:
viyatseṃdurhanumate tato rudrātmakāya ca /
varmāstrānto mahāmantro dvādaśārṇo 'ṣṭasiddhikṛt //
meaning:
वियत्सेंदुर्हनुमते ततो रुद्रात्मकाय च /
वर्मास्त्रान्तो महामन्त्रो द्वादशार्णो ऽष्टसिद्धिकृत् //
text_mt: Space with the moon [Haṃ], then "to Hanumān", and "to the essence of Rudra", / ending with the armor and weapon [Hūṃ Phaṭ]: this great twelve-syllabled mantra produces the eight spiritual accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmacandro muniścāsya jagatī chanda īritam /
hanumāndevatāṃ bījamādyaṃ śaktirhumīritā //
meaning:
रामचन्द्रो मुनिश्चास्य जगती छन्द ईरितम् /
हनुमान्देवतां बीजमाद्यं शक्तिर्हुमीरिता //
text_mt: Rāmacandra is its seer, and the metre is declared to be jagatī; / Hanumān is the deity, the first [syllable] is the seed-syllable, and Hūṃ is declared to be the power.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret /
mahāśailaṃ samutpāṭya dhāvantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ prati //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घभाजा बीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् /
महाशैलं समुत्पाट्य धावन्तं रावणं प्रति //
text_mt: With the seed-syllable accompanied by the six long [vowels], one should perform the six limbs. / Uprooting a great mountain and charging towards Rāvaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
lākṣāraktāruṇaṃ raudraṃ kālāntakayamopamam /
jvaladagnisamaṃ jaitraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham //
meaning:
लाक्षारक्तारुणं रौद्रं कालान्तकयमोपमम् /
ज्वलदग्निसमं जैत्रं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: red as lac and ruddy, fierce, like the Death of the end of time, / like blazing fire, victorious, possessing the radiance of ten million suns,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgadādyairmahāvīrairveṣṭitaṃ rudrarūpiṇam /
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇe duṣṭa sṛjantaṃ ghoraniḥ svanam //
meaning:
अङ्गदाद्यैर्महावीरैर्वेष्टितं रुद्ररूपिणम् /
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ रणे दुष्ट सृजन्तं घोरनिः स्वनम् //
text_mt: surrounded by great heroes such as Aṅgada, having the form of Rudra, / uttering a terrible roar: "Halt, halt in battle, evil one!" —

sanskrit_iast:
śaivarūpiṇamabhyarcya dhyātvā lakṣa japenmanum /
daśāṃśaṃ juhuyādvīhīnpayodadhyājyamiśritān //
meaning:
शैवरूपिणमभ्यर्च्य ध्यात्वा लक्ष जपेन्मनुम् /
दशांशं जुहुयाद्वीहीन्पयोदध्याज्यमिश्रितान् //
text_mt: having meditated on and worshipped him in Śiva's form, one should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times. / One should offer a tenth part in fire oblations with rice mixed with milk, curd, and ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe vimalādisamanvite /
mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlena pūjā kāryā hanūmataḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे विमलादिसमन्विते /
मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलेन पूजा कार्या हनूमतः //
text_mt: On the previously described Vaiṣṇava seat endowed with Vimalā and others, / having formed the icon by means of the root mantra, the worship of Hanumān must be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaikamātro 'pi nṛṇāṃ siddhireva na saṃśayaḥ /
athāsya sādhanaṃ vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
ध्यानैकमात्रो ऽपि नृणां सिद्धिरेव न संशयः /
अथास्य साधनं वक्ष्ये लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Even by mere meditation, success is indeed attained by men; of this there is no doubt. / Now I shall declare his practice out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
hanumatsādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam /
etadguhyatamaṃ loke śīghrasiddhikaraṃ param //
meaning:
हनुमत्साधनं पुण्यं महापातकनाशनम् /
एतद्गुह्यतमं लोके शीघ्रसिद्धिकरं परम् //
text_mt: The holy practice of Hanumān destroys heinous sins; / it is the most secret in the world, bringing swift success, supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrī yasya prasādena trailokyavijayī bhavet /
prātaḥ snātvā nadītīre upaviśya kuśāsane //
meaning:
मन्त्री यस्य प्रसादेन त्रैलोक्यविजयी भवेत् /
प्रातः स्नात्वा नदीतीरे उपविश्य कुशासने //
text_mt: by whose grace the practitioner of mantras becomes a conqueror of the three worlds. / Having bathed in the morning on a riverbank and sat down on a kuśa-grass seat,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaṣaḍaṅge ca mūlena sakalaṃ caret /
puṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ datvā dhyātvā rāmaṃ sasītakam //
meaning:
प्राणायामषडङ्गे च मूलेन सकलं चरेत् /
पुष्पाञ्जल्यष्टकं दत्वा ध्यात्वा रामं ससीतकम् //
text_mt: one should perform breath control, the six limbs, and all [rites] with the root mantra. / Having offered eight handfuls of flowers, and meditating on Rāma with Sītā,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrapātre tataḥ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakeśaram /
kucandanena ghṛṣṭena saṃlikhettacchalākayā //
meaning:
ताम्रपात्रे ततः पद्ममष्टपत्रं सकेशरम् /
कुचन्दनेन घृष्टेन संलिखेत्तच्छलाकया //
text_mt: he should then draw an eight-petaled lotus with filaments upon a copper plate / using ground red sandalwood with its stylus.

sanskrit_iast:
karmikāyāṃ likhenmantraṃ tatrāvāhya kapīśvaram /
mūrtiṃ mūlena saṃkalpya dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ caret //
meaning:
कर्मिकायां लिखेन्मन्त्रं तत्रावाह्य कपीश्वरम् /
मूर्तिं मूलेन संकल्प्य ध्यात्वा पाद्यादिकं चरेत् //
text_mt: In the pericarp he should write the mantra, invoke the lord of monkeys there, / visualize the form with the root mantra, meditate, and offer water for the feet and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivedya mūlamantrataḥ /
kesareṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni daleṣu ca tator'cayet //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिकं सर्वं निवेद्य मूलमन्त्रतः /
केसरेषु षडङ्गानि दलेषु च ततोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: Having offered all items such as perfume and flowers with the root mantra, / he should then worship the six limbs on the filaments and [the attendants] on the petals:

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva hyaṅgadaṃ nalanīlakau /
jāṃbavantaṃ ca kumudaṃ kesarīśaṃ daler'cayet //
meaning:
सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणं चैव ह्यङ्गदं नलनीलकौ /
जांबवन्तं च कुमुदं केसरीशं दलेर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: he should worship Sugrīva, Lakṣmaṇa, Aṅgada, Nala and Nīla, / Jāmbavān, Kumuda, and the lord Kesarin on the petals.

sanskrit_iast:
dikpālāṃścāpi vajrādīnpūjayettadanantaram /
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayetsveṣṭamātmani //
meaning:
दिक्पालांश्चापि वज्रादीन्पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् /
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेत्स्वेष्टमात्मनि //
text_mt: Immediately after that, he should also worship the guardians of the directions and their weapons such as the thunderbolt. / When the mantra is thus perfected, the practitioner of mantras accomplishes his desire within himself.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīre kānane vā parvate vijane 'thavā /
sādhayetsādhaka śreṣṭho bhūmigrahaṇapūrvakam //
meaning:
नदीतीरे कानने वा पर्वते विजने ऽथवा /
साधयेत्साधक श्रेष्ठो भूमिग्रहणपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: On a riverbank, or in a forest, or on a mountain, or in a solitary place, / the best practitioner should practice after taking possession of the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
jitāhāro jitaśvāso jitavākca jitendriyaḥ /
digbandha nādikaṃ kṛtvā nyāsadhyānādipūrvakam //
meaning:
जिताहारो जितश्वासो जितवाक्च जितेन्द्रियः /
दिग्बन्ध नादिकं कृत्वा न्यासध्यानादिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: having conquered food, conquered breath, conquered speech, and conquered the senses, / having performed the sealing of the directions and the rest preceded by ritual placement and meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japenmantrarājaṃ pūjayitvā tu pūrvavat /
lakṣānti divasaṃ prāpya kuryyāñca pūjanaṃ mahat //
meaning:
लक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रराजं पूजयित्वा तु पूर्ववत् /
लक्षान्ति दिवसं प्राप्य कुर्य्याञ्च पूजनं महत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped as before, he should recite the king of mantras one hundred thousand times; / and reaching the final day of the hundred thousand, he should perform a great worship.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāgramanasā samyagdhyātvā pavananandanam /
divārātrau japaṃ kuryādyāvatsaṃdarśanaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
एकाग्रमनसा सम्यग्ध्यात्वा पवननन्दनम् /
दिवारात्रौ जपं कुर्याद्यावत्संदर्शनं भवेत् //
text_mt: Having meditated well upon the son of the wind with a one-pointed mind, / one should perform recitation day and night until an actual vision occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
sudṛḍhaṃ sādhakaṃ matvā niśīthe pavanātmajaḥ /
suprasannastato bhūtvā prayāti sādhakāgrataḥ //
meaning:
सुदृढं साधकं मत्वा निशीथे पवनात्मजः /
सुप्रसन्नस्ततो भूत्वा प्रयाति साधकाग्रतः //
text_mt: Recognizing the practitioner to be firmly resolute, the son of the wind at midnight / becomes exceedingly pleased and appears before the practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
yathepsitaṃ varaṃ datvā sādhakāya kapīśvaraḥ /
varaṃ labdhvā sādhakandro viharedātmanaḥ sukhaiḥ //
meaning:
यथेप्सितं वरं दत्वा साधकाय कपीश्वरः /
वरं लब्ध्वा साधकन्द्रो विहरेदात्मनः सुखैः //
text_mt: Having granted the desired boon to the practitioner, the lord of monkeys [departs]; / having obtained the boon, the best among practitioners may wander about enjoying personal happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhi sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā /
prakāśitaṃ rahasyaṃ vai devānāmapi durlabham //
meaning:
एतद्धि साधनं पुण्यं लोकानां हितकाम्यया /
प्रकाशितं रहस्यं वै देवानामपि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: For this meritorious practice, revealed out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds, / is indeed a secret difficult to attain even for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
anyānapiprayogāṃśca sādhayedātmano hitān /
viyadinduyutaṃ paścānṅeṃtaṃ pavananandanam //
meaning:
अन्यानपिप्रयोगांश्च साधयेदात्मनो हितान् /
वियदिन्दुयुतं पश्चान्ङेंतं पवननन्दनम् //
text_mt: He may also accomplish other applications beneficial to himself. / The ether [h] joined with the moon [ṃ], followed by 'pavananandana' ('son of the wind') in the dative case,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnipriyānto mantro 'yaṃ daśārṇaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ /
munyādikaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgānyapi pūrvavat //
meaning:
वह्निप्रियान्तो मन्त्रो ऽयं दशार्णः सर्वकामदः /
मुन्यादिकं च पूर्वोक्तं षडङ्गान्यपि पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: and ending with the beloved of fire [svāhā]—this ten-syllabled mantra grants all desires. / The seer and other [preliminaries] are as previously stated, and the six limbs are also as before.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyedraṇe hanūmantaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham /
dhāvantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ jetuṃ dṛṣṭvā satvaramutthitam //
meaning:
ध्यायेद्रणे हनूमन्तं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् /
धावन्तं रावणं जेतुं दृष्ट्वा सत्वरमुत्थितम् //
text_mt: One should meditate upon Hanūmān in battle, radiant as ten million suns, / who, having seen [the fallen], rose up swiftly to conquer the running Rāvaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahāvīraṃ patitaṃ raṇabhūtale /
guruṃ ca krodhamutpādya grahotuṃ guruparvatam //
meaning:
लक्ष्मणं च महावीरं पतितं रणभूतले /
गुरुं च क्रोधमुत्पाद्य ग्रहोतुं गुरुपर्वतम् //
text_mt: and, [seeing] the great hero Lakṣmaṇa fallen on the battlefield, / conceiving a mighty rage to seize the great mountain;

sanskrit_iast:
hāhākāraiḥ sadarpaiśca kaṃpayantaṃ jagattrayam /
ābrahmāṇḍaṃ samākhyāpya kṛtvā bhīmaṃ kalevaram //
meaning:
हाहाकारैः सदर्पैश्च कंपयन्तं जगत्त्रयम् /
आब्रह्माण्डं समाख्याप्य कृत्वा भीमं कलेवरम् //
text_mt: causing the three worlds to tremble with haughty roars, / filling the cosmos [with his form], having assumed a terrifying body.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japeddaśāṃśena juhuyātpūrvavatsudhīḥ /
pūrvavatpūjanaṃ proktaṃ mantra syāsya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
लक्षं जपेद्दशांशेन जुहुयात्पूर्ववत्सुधीः /
पूर्ववत्पूजनं प्रोक्तं मन्त्र स्यास्य विधानतः //
text_mt: The wise man should recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times, and offer fire oblations with a tenth part as before; / worship is prescribed as before, according to the rule for this mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī sādhayedātmano hitam /
asyāpi mantravaryasya rahasyaṃ sādhanaṃ tu vai //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री साधयेदात्मनो हितम् /
अस्यापि मन्त्रवर्यस्य रहस्यं साधनं तु वै //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus mastered, the practitioner should accomplish his own welfare. / The secret practice of this excellent mantra as well,

sanskrit_iast:
sugopyaṃ sarvatantreṣu na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit /
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya kṛtanityakriyaḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
सुगोप्यं सर्वतन्त्रेषु न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् /
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते चोत्थाय कृतनित्यक्रियः शुचिः //
text_mt: which is to be guarded carefully in all tantras and not given to just anyone: / Rising at the hour of Brahman and purified, having performed his daily rites,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā nadīṃ taḥ snātvā tīrthamāvāhya cāṣṭadhā /
mūlamantraṃ tato japtvā siṃcedādityasaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
गत्वा नदीं तः स्नात्वा तीर्थमावाह्य चाष्टधा /
मूलमन्त्रं ततो जप्त्वा सिंचेदादित्यसंख्यया //
text_mt: having gone to a river and bathed there, having invoked the sacred ford eightfold, / and having then recited the root mantra, one should sprinkle [water] twelve times.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā gaṅgātīre 'thavā punaḥ /
parvate vā vane vāpi bhūmigrahaṇapūrvakam //
meaning:
एवं स्नानादिकं कृत्वा गङ्गातीरे ऽथवा पुनः /
पर्वते वा वने वापि भूमिग्रहणपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having thus performed ablutions and the like, either on the bank of the Gaṅgā, / or on a mountain, or in a forest, having first taken possession of the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
ādyavarṇaiḥ pūrakaṃ syātpañcavargaiśca kumbhakam /
recakaṃ ca punaryādyairevaṃ prāṇānniyanya ca //
meaning:
आद्यवर्णैः पूरकं स्यात्पञ्चवर्गैश्च कुम्भकम् /
रेचकं च पुनर्याद्यैरेवं प्राणान्नियन्य च //
text_mt: inhalation is done with the initial letters, retention with the five groups of consonants, / and exhalation again with the letters beginning with ya; thus restraining the breaths,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya bhūtaśuddhyādi pīṭhanyāsāvadhi punaḥ /
dhyātvā pūrvoktavidhinā saṃpūjya ca kapīśvaram //
meaning:
विधाय भूतशुद्ध्यादि पीठन्यासावधि पुनः /
ध्यात्वा पूर्वोक्तविधिना संपूज्य च कपीश्वरम् //
text_mt: having performed the purification of elements and so forth up to the ritual placement on the seat, / and having meditated upon and worshipped the lord of monkeys according to the rule stated before,

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre prajapennityaṃ sādhako 'yutamādarāt /
saptame divase prāpte kuryāñca pūjanaṃ mahat //
meaning:
तदग्रे प्रजपेन्नित्यं साधको ऽयुतमादरात् /
सप्तमे दिवसे प्राप्ते कुर्याञ्च पूजनं महत् //
text_mt: the practitioner should daily recite [the mantra] ten thousand times before him with reverence. / When the seventh day arrives, he should perform a great worship.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāgramanasā mantrī divārātraṃ japenmanum /
mahābhayaṃ pradatvā tribhāgaśeṣāsu niścitam //
meaning:
एकाग्रमनसा मन्त्री दिवारात्रं जपेन्मनुम् /
महाभयं प्रदत्वा त्रिभागशेषासु निश्चितम् //
text_mt: With a one-pointed mind, the mantra-practitioner should recite the mantra day and night. / Having produced great dread, when a third of the night remains, certainly,

sanskrit_iast:
yāminīṣu samāyāti niyataṃ pavanātmajaḥ /
yathepsitaṃ varaṃ dadyātsādhakāya kapīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यामिनीषु समायाति नियतं पवनात्मजः /
यथेप्सितं वरं दद्यात्साधकाय कपीश्वरः //
text_mt: during the night watches, the son of the wind invariably arrives. / The lord of monkeys will grant the practitioner the boon he desires:

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāṃ vāpi dhanaṃ vāpi rājyaṃ vā śatrunigraham /
tatkṣaṇādeva cāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
विद्यां वापि धनं वापि राज्यं वा शत्रुनिग्रहम् /
तत्क्षणादेव चाप्नोति सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः //
text_mt: whether knowledge, or wealth, or kingship, or the subjugation of enemies; / he obtains it immediately indeed; this is true, true, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke 'khilānkāmānbhuktvānte muktimāpnuyāt /
sadyācitaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ hanūmanteti coddharet //
meaning:
इह लोके ऽखिलान्कामान्भुक्त्वान्ते मुक्तिमाप्नुयात् /
सद्याचितं वायुयुग्मं हनूमन्तेति चोद्धरेत् //
text_mt: Having enjoyed all desires in this world, he attains liberation in the end. / One should pronounce 'sadyācita', the pair of wind-syllables, and 'hanūmanta';

sanskrit_iast:
phalānte phakriyānetrayuktā ca kāmikā tataḥ /
dhaggante dhagitetyuktvā āyurāsva padaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
फलान्ते फक्रियानेत्रयुक्ता च कामिका ततः /
धग्गन्ते धगितेत्युक्त्वा आयुरास्व पदं ततः //
text_mt: after 'phala', [the letter] pha, kriyā, joined with the eyes, and then the wishing-cow; / after 'dhag', having said 'dhagita', then the word 'āyurāsva';

sanskrit_iast:
lohito garuḍo hetibāṇanetrākṣaro manuḥ /
munyādikaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ plīharogaharo hariḥ //
meaning:
लोहितो गरुडो हेतिबाणनेत्राक्षरो मनुः /
मुन्यादिकं तु पूर्वोक्तं प्लीहरोगहरो हरिः //
text_mt: red, Garuḍa, weapon, arrows, eyes—this is the mantra of [twenty-five] syllables. / The seer and others are as stated before; Hari, who removes spleen disease,

sanskrit_iast:
devatā ca samuddiṣṭā plīhayuktodare punaḥ /
nāgavallīdalaṃ sthāpyamuparyācchādayettataḥ //
meaning:
देवता च समुद्दिष्टा प्लीहयुक्तोदरे पुनः /
नागवल्लीदलं स्थाप्यमुपर्याच्छादयेत्ततः //
text_mt: is declared to be the deity. Furthermore, upon the belly affected with spleen disease, / a betel leaf is to be placed, and then he should cover it from above

sanskrit_iast:
vastraṃ caivāṣṭaguṇitaṃ tataḥ sādhakasattamaḥ /
śakalaṃ vaṃśajaṃ tasyopari muñcetkapiṃ smaret //
meaning:
वस्त्रं चैवाष्टगुणितं ततः साधकसत्तमः /
शकलं वंशजं तस्योपरि मुञ्चेत्कपिं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: with an eightfold folded cloth; then the excellent practitioner / should place a piece of bamboo on top of it, and remember the monkey.

sanskrit_iast:
āraṇyasāṇakotpanne vahnau yaṣṭiṃ pratāpayet /
badarībhūruhotthāṃ tāṃ mantreṇānena saptadhā //
meaning:
आरण्यसाणकोत्पन्ने वह्नौ यष्टिं प्रतापयेत् /
बदरीभूरुहोत्थां तां मन्त्रेणानेन सप्तधा //
text_mt: In a fire produced from wild cow-dung, he should heat a stick / made from a jujube tree seven times with this mantra;

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saṃtāḍayedvaṃśaśakalaṃ jaṭharasthitam /
saptakṛtvaḥ plīharogo nāśamāyāti niścitam //
meaning:
तया संताडयेद्वंशशकलं जठरस्थितम् /
सप्तकृत्वः प्लीहरोगो नाशमायाति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: with that [stick] he should strike the bamboo piece resting on the belly / seven times; the spleen disease is destroyed without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro namo bhagavate āñjaneyāya coñcaret /
amukasya śṛṅkhalāṃ troṭayadvitayamīrayet //
meaning:
तारो नमो भगवते आञ्जनेयाय चोञ्चरेत् /
अमुकस्य शृङ्खलां त्रोटयद्वितयमीरयेत् //
text_mt: One should utter the deliverer [oṃ], 'namo bhagavate āñjaneyāya' ('obeisance to the lord, son of Añjanā'), / 'amukasya śṛṅkhalāṃ' ('the chain of so-and-so'), and then pronounce the two words 'troṭaya troṭaya' ('break, break');

sanskrit_iast:
bandhamokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ svāhānto 'yaṃ manurmataḥ /
īśvaro 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭupca devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
बन्धमोक्षं कुरुयुगं स्वाहान्तो ऽयं मनुर्मतः /
ईश्वरो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप्च देवता पुनः //
text_mt: then 'bandha-mokṣaṃ kuru kuru' ('release from fetters, do, do'), ending with 'svāhā'—this is considered the mantra. / Īśvara is its seer, the metre is anuṣṭubh, and the deity again

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅkhalāmocaraḥ śrīmānhanūmānpavanātmajaḥ /
haṃ bījaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ śaktirbandhamokṣe niyogatā //
meaning:
शृङ्खलामोचरः श्रीमान्हनूमान्पवनात्मजः /
हं बीजं ठद्वयं शक्तिर्बन्धमोक्षे नियोगता //
text_mt: is the glorious Hanūmān, the son of the wind, the breaker of chains. / 'Haṃ' is the seed-syllable, 'ṭha ṭha' is the power, and its application is in release from bonds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghavahriyuktena bījenāṅgāni kalpayet /
vāme śailaṃ vairibhidaṃ viśuddhaṃ ṭaṅkamanyataḥ //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घवह्रियुक्तेन बीजेनाङ्गानि कल्पयेत् /
वामे शैलं वैरिभिदं विशुद्धं टङ्कमन्यतः //
text_mt: One should form the limbs with the seed-syllable joined with the six long vowels and the fire [r]. / In his left [hand] holding a rock, the destroyer of foes, and in the other a pure chisel,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ ca dhyāyetkuṇḍalinaṃ harim /
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣadaśāṃśaṃ cūtapallavaiḥ //
meaning:
दधानं स्वर्णवर्णं च ध्यायेत्कुण्डलिनं हरिम् /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षदशांशं चूतपल्लवैः //
text_mt: golden-hued, one should meditate upon Hari wearing earrings. / Having thus meditated, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times, and with a tenth of that, with mango leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyātpūrvavatproktaṃ yajanaṃ vāsya sūribhiḥ /
mahākārāgṛhe prāpto hyayutaṃ prajapennaraḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयात्पूर्ववत्प्रोक्तं यजनं वास्य सूरिभिः /
महाकारागृहे प्राप्तो ह्ययुतं प्रजपेन्नरः //
text_mt: one should offer fire oblations; the worship is declared by the wise to be as before. / If a man has fallen into a great prison, he should recite it ten thousand times;

sanskrit_iast:
śīghraṃ kārāgṛhānmuktaḥ sukhī bhavati niścitam /
yantraṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi bandhamokṣakaraṃ śubham //
meaning:
शीघ्रं कारागृहान्मुक्तः सुखी भवति निश्चितम् /
यन्त्रं चास्य प्रवक्ष्यामि बन्धमोक्षकरं शुभम् //
text_mt: he is quickly released from the prison and becomes happy, undoubtedly. / I shall also describe his auspicious diagram that effects release from fetters:

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭacchadāntaḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ sādhyanāmasamanvitam /
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu dhruvaṃ ṅeṃtamāñjaneyapadaṃ likhet //
meaning:
अष्टच्छदान्तः षट्कोणं साध्यनामसमन्वितम् /
षट्कोणेषु ध्रुवं ङेंतमाञ्जनेयपदं लिखेत् //
text_mt: A hexagon inside an eight-petalled [lotus], accompanied by the name of the person to be affected; / in the six angles one should write the fixed syllable [oṃ] and the word 'āñjaneya' in the dative case;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭacchadeṣu vilikhetpraṇavo vātuvātviti /
gorocanākuṅkumena likhitvā yantramuttamam //
meaning:
अष्टच्छदेषु विलिखेत्प्रणवो वातुवात्विति /
गोरोचनाकुङ्कुमेन लिखित्वा यन्त्रमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: on the eight petals one should write the praṇava, and 'vātu vātu'. / Having drawn this excellent diagram with yellow pigment and saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtvā mūrdhni japenmantramayutaṃ bandhamuktaye /
yantrametallikhitvā tu mṛttikopari mārjayet //
meaning:
धृत्वा मूर्ध्नि जपेन्मन्त्रमयुतं बन्धमुक्तये /
यन्त्रमेतल्लिखित्वा तु मृत्तिकोपरि मार्जयेत् //
text_mt: wearing it on the head, one should recite the mantra ten thousand times for release from bonds. / Or, having drawn this diagram, the knower of mantras should wipe it over the clay

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastena mantrajñaḥ pratyahaṃ maṇḍalā vadhi /
evaṃ kṛte mahākārāgṛhānmantrī vimucyate //
meaning:
दक्षहस्तेन मन्त्रज्ञः प्रत्यहं मण्डला वधि /
एवं कृते महाकारागृहान्मन्त्री विमुच्यते //
text_mt: with his right hand every day for the period of a sacred diagram [forty-eight days]. / When this is done, the mantra-practitioner is freed from the great prison.

sanskrit_iast:
gaganaṃ jvalanaḥ sākṣī markaṭeti dvayaṃ tataḥ /
toyaṃ śaśeṣe makare parimuñcati muñcati //
meaning:
गगनं ज्वलनः साक्षी मर्कटेति द्वयं ततः /
तोयं शशेषे मकरे परिमुञ्चति मुञ्चति //
text_mt: The sky [ha], fire [ra], the witness, then two times 'markaṭa' ('monkey'); / water [va], then in the crocodile, 'parimuñcati muñcati' ('releases, releases');

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śṛṅkhalikāṃ ceti vedanetrākṣaro manuḥ /
imaṃ mantraṃ dakṣakare likhitvā vāmahastataḥ //
meaning:
ततः शृङ्खलिकां चेति वेदनेत्राक्षरो मनुः /
इमं मन्त्रं दक्षकरे लिखित्वा वामहस्ततः //
text_mt: then 'śṛṅkhalikāṃ' ('the fetter')—this is the mantra of twenty-four syllables. / Having written this mantra on the right hand, with the left hand

sanskrit_iast:
dūrikṛtya japenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ budhaḥ /
trisaptāhātprabaddho 'sau mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
दूरिकृत्य जपेन्मन्त्रमष्टोत्तरशतं बुधः /
त्रिसप्ताहात्प्रबद्धो ऽसौ मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: wiping it away, the wise man should recite the mantra one hundred and eight times. / Within three weeks, he who was bound is freed; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
munyādyarcādikaṃ sarvamasya pūrvavadācaret /
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena śubhairdravyaiśca homayet //
meaning:
मुन्याद्यर्चादिकं सर्वमस्य पूर्ववदाचरेत् /
लक्षं जपो दशांशेन शुभैर्द्रव्यैश्च होमयेत् //
text_mt: One should perform the worship of the sage and others for this [mantra] as before. / Recitation is one hundred thousand, and one should offer fire oblations with tenth part [of that number] using auspicious substances.

sanskrit_iast:
pucchākāre suvastre ca lekhanyā kṣurakotthayā /
gandhāṣṭakairlikhedvūpaṃ kapirājasya sundaram //
meaning:
पुच्छाकारे सुवस्त्रे च लेखन्या क्षुरकोत्थया /
गन्धाष्टकैर्लिखेद्वूपं कपिराजस्य सुन्दरम् //
text_mt: On a fine cloth shaped like a tail, with a pen made of kṣuraka, / one should draw the handsome form of the monkey king using the eight scents.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye 'ṣṭadaśārṇaṃ tu śatrunāmānvitaṃ likhet /
tena mantrābhijaptena śirobaddhvena bhūmipaḥ //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये ऽष्टदशार्णं तु शत्रुनामान्वितं लिखेत् /
तेन मन्त्राभिजप्तेन शिरोबद्ध्वेन भूमिपः //
text_mt: In its middle, one should write the eighteen-syllable [mantra] accompanied by the enemy's name. / A king, having bound that [cloth] consecrated by recitation upon his head,

sanskrit_iast:
jayatyarigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ darśanādeva niścitam /
candrasūryo parāgādau pūrvoktaṃ lekhayeddhvaje //
meaning:
जयत्यरिगणं सर्वं दर्शनादेव निश्चितम् /
चन्द्रसूर्यो परागादौ पूर्वोक्तं लेखयेद्ध्वजे //
text_mt: certainly conquers the whole host of enemies merely by its sight. / At the time of a solar or lunar eclipse and the like, one should have what was spoken before written upon a banner.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajamādāya mantrajñaḥ saṃsparśānmokṣaṇāvadhi /
mātṛkāṃ jāpayetpaścāddaśāṃśena ca homayet //
meaning:
ध्वजमादाय मन्त्रज्ञः संस्पर्शान्मोक्षणावधि /
मातृकां जापयेत्पश्चाद्दशांशेन च होमयेत् //
text_mt: Taking the banner, the knower of mantras should recite the mātṛkā / from the moment of contact [of the eclipse] until the end of liberation [from it], and then make fire oblations with a tenth part [of the count].

sanskrit_iast:
tilaiḥ sarṣapasaṃmiśraiḥ saṃskṛte havyavāhane /
gaje dhvajaṃ samāropya gacchedyuddhvāya bhūpatiḥ //
meaning:
तिलैः सर्षपसंमिश्रैः संस्कृते हव्यवाहने /
गजे ध्वजं समारोप्य गच्छेद्युद्ध्वाय भूपतिः //
text_mt: With sesame seeds mixed with mustard seeds into the consecrated sacrificial fire. / Mounting the banner upon an elephant, the king should go to battle.

sanskrit_iast:
gajasthaṃ taṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante 'rayo dhruvam /
mahārakṣākaraṃ yantraṃ vakṣye samyagdhanūmataḥ //
meaning:
गजस्थं तं ध्वजं दृष्ट्वा पलायन्ते ऽरयो ध्रुवम् /
महारक्षाकरं यन्त्रं वक्ष्ये सम्यग्धनूमतः //
text_mt: Seeing that banner mounted upon an elephant, the enemies certainly flee. / I shall explain fully the yantra of Hanūmat that produces great protection:

sanskrit_iast:
likhedvasudalaṃ padmaṃ sādhyākhyāyutakarṇikam /
dale 'ṣṭakoṇamālikhya mālāmantreṇa veṣṭayet //
meaning:
लिखेद्वसुदलं पद्मं साध्याख्यायुतकर्णिकम् /
दले ऽष्टकोणमालिख्य मालामन्त्रेण वेष्टयेत् //
text_mt: One should draw an eight-petalled lotus whose pericarp contains the name of the one to be mastered. / Having drawn an eight-pointed figure on the petal[s], one should encircle it with the mālāmantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbahir māyayāveṣṭya prāṇasthāpanamācaret /
likhitaṃ svarṇalekhanyā bhūrjapatre suśobhane //
meaning:
तद्बहिर् माययावेष्ट्य प्राणस्थापनमाचरेत् /
लिखितं स्वर्णलेखन्या भूर्जपत्रे सुशोभने //
text_mt: Having encircled it outside with Māyā, one should perform the installation of the breath of life. / Drawn with a golden pen on very splendid birch-bark,

sanskrit_iast:
kāśmīrarocanābhyāṃ tu trilohena ca veṣṭitam /
sampātasādhitaṃ yantraṃ bhuje vā mūrdhni dhārayet //
meaning:
काश्मीररोचनाभ्यां तु त्रिलोहेन च वेष्टितम् /
सम्पातसाधितं यन्त्रं भुजे वा मूर्ध्नि धारयेत् //
text_mt: with saffron and yellow orpiment, and enclosed in three metals, / the yantra, consecrated through repeated offerings, should be worn on the arm or the head.

sanskrit_iast:
raṇe durodare vāde vyavahāre jayaṃ labhet /
grahairvighnairviṣaiḥ śastraiścaurairnaivābhibhūyate //
meaning:
रणे दुरोदरे वादे व्यवहारे जयं लभेत् /
ग्रहैर्विघ्नैर्विषैः शस्त्रैश्चौरैर्नैवाभिभूयते //
text_mt: In battle, in gambling, in debate, and in worldly transactions, he obtains victory; / he is never overcome by seizing spirits, obstacles, poisons, weapons, or thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānro gānapākṛtya ciraṃ jīvecchataṃ samāḥ /
ṣaḍdīrghayuktaṃ gagana vahnyākhyaṃ tārasaṃpuṭam //
meaning:
सर्वान्रो गानपाकृत्य चिरं जीवेच्छतं समाः /
षड्दीर्घयुक्तं गगन वह्न्याख्यं तारसंपुटम् //
text_mt: Warding off all diseases, he lives long for a hundred years. / The sky accompanied by the six long [vowels], designated as fire, enclosed by the praṇava—

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭārṇo 'yaṃ mahāmantro mālāmantro 'tha kathyate /
praṇavo vajrakāyeti vajratuṇḍeti saṃpaṭhet //
meaning:
अष्टार्णो ऽयं महामन्त्रो मालामन्त्रो ऽथ कथ्यते /
प्रणवो वज्रकायेति वज्रतुण्डेति संपठेत् //
text_mt: this is the eight-syllable great mantra. Now the garland-mantra is spoken: / The praṇava; one should recite 'vajrakāya', 'vajratuṇḍa';

sanskrit_iast:
kapilānte piṅgaleti urddhvakeśamahāpadam /
balaraktamukhānte tu taḍijjihva mahā tataḥ //
meaning:
कपिलान्ते पिङ्गलेति उर्द्ध्वकेशमहापदम् /
बलरक्तमुखान्ते तु तडिज्जिह्व महा ततः //
text_mt: after 'kapila', 'piṅgala', the great words 'ūrdhvakeśa', / then after 'balaraktamukha', 'taḍijjihva mahā';

sanskrit_iast:
raudradaṃṣṭrotkaṭaṃ paścātkahadvandvaṃ karāliti /
mahadṛḍhaprahāreṇa laṅkeśvaravadhāttataḥ //
meaning:
रौद्रदंष्ट्रोत्कटं पश्चात्कहद्वन्द्वं करालिति /
महदृढप्रहारेण लङ्केश्वरवधात्ततः //
text_mt: then 'raudradaṃṣṭrotkaṭa', the pair of 'kaha', 'karālin', / then 'mahadṛḍhaprahāreṇa laṅkeśvaravadhāt';

sanskrit_iast:
vāyurmahāsetupadaṃ bandhānte ca mahā punaḥ /
śailapravāha gaganecara ehyehi saṃvadet //
meaning:
वायुर्महासेतुपदं बन्धान्ते च महा पुनः /
शैलप्रवाह गगनेचर एह्येहि संवदेत् //
text_mt: the word 'vāyurmahāsetu' and after 'bandha', again 'mahā', / one should say 'śailapravāha gaganecara ehyehi';

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanmahābalānte parākramapadaṃ vadet /
bhairavājñāpayaihyehi mahāraudrapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
भगवन्महाबलान्ते पराक्रमपदं वदेत् /
भैरवाज्ञापयैह्येहि महारौद्रपदं ततः //
text_mt: after 'bhagavanmahābala', one should speak the word 'parākrama'; / 'bhairavājñāpaya ehyehi', then the word 'mahāraudra';

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghapucchena varṇānte vadedveṣṭaya vairiṇam /
jaṃbhayadvayamābhāṣya varmāstrānto manurmataḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घपुच्छेन वर्णान्ते वदेद्वेष्टय वैरिणम् /
जंभयद्वयमाभाष्य वर्मास्त्रान्तो मनुर्मतः //
text_mt: after the syllables 'dīrghapucchena', one should say 'veṣṭaya vairiṇam', / and having spoken the pair of 'jambhaya', the mantra ends in armor and weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
mālāhvayo dvijaśreṣṭha śaranetradharākṣaraḥ /
mālāmantrāṣṭārṇayośca munyādyarcā tu pūrvavat //
meaning:
मालाह्वयो द्विजश्रेष्ठ शरनेत्रधराक्षरः /
मालामन्त्राष्टार्णयोश्च मुन्याद्यर्चा तु पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: Called the garland-mantra, O best among the twice-born, it has one hundred and twenty-five syllables. / The worship of the sage and others for the garland-mantra and the eight-syllable [mantra] is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
japto yuddhe jayaṃ dadyādvyādhau vyādhivināśanaḥ /
evaṃ yo bhajate mantrī vāyuputraṃ kapīśvaram //
meaning:
जप्तो युद्धे जयं दद्याद्व्याधौ व्याधिविनाशनः /
एवं यो भजते मन्त्री वायुपुत्रं कपीश्वरम् //
text_mt: Recited, it grants victory in battle; in illness, it destroys disease. / Thus, the mantra-practitioner who worships the son of the wind, the lord of monkeys,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānsa labhate kāmānde vairapi sudurlabhān /
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutānpautrānsaubhāgyamatulaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वान्स लभते कामान्दे वैरपि सुदुर्लभान् /
धनं धान्यं सुतान्पौत्रान्सौभाग्यमतुलं यशः //
text_mt: obtains all desires that are very hard to attain even for the gods: / wealth, grain, sons, grandsons, unparalleled good fortune, renown,

sanskrit_iast:
medhāṃ vidyāṃ prabhāṃ rājyaṃ vivāde vijayaṃ tathā /
vaśyādyāni ca karmāṇi saṃgare vijayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मेधां विद्यां प्रभां राज्यं विवादे विजयं तथा /
वश्याद्यानि च कर्माणि संगरे विजयं तथा //
text_mt: intellect, learning, splendor, sovereignty, as well as victory in dispute, / rituals such as subjection, and likewise victory in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
upāsitoṃ'janāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ pradadātyalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne sanatkumāravibhāge tṛtīyapāde hanumanmantrakathanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
उपासितोंऽजनागर्भसंभूतः प्रददात्यलम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने सनत्कुमारविभागे तृतीयपादे हनुमन्मन्त्रकथनंनाम चतुःसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Worshipped, the one born from the womb of Añjanā abundantly bestows [these].

Thus, in the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, in the first part, in the great narrative, in the section of Sanatkumāra, in the third quarter, the seventy-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Explanation of the Hanūmat-mantra'.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye sarahasyaṃ hanūmataḥ /
yasya vijñānamātreṇa siddho bhavati sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ दीपविधिं वक्ष्ये सरहस्यं हनूमतः /
यस्य विज्ञानमात्रेण सिद्धो भवति साधकः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Now I shall explain the rite of the lamp of Hanūmat together with its secret, / by the mere understanding of which the practitioner becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpapātrapramāṇaṃ ca tailamānaṃ krameṇa tu /
dravyasya ca pramāṇaṃ vai tattu mānamanukramāt //
meaning:
दीपपात्रप्रमाणं च तैलमानं क्रमेण तु /
द्रव्यस्य च प्रमाणं वै तत्तु मानमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: The measurement of the lamp-vessel and the measure of oil in due order, / and the measurement of the substance—that measurement in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
sthānabhedaṃ ca mantraṃ ca dīpadānamanuṃ pṛthak /
puṣpavāsitatailena sarvakāmapradaṃ matam //
meaning:
स्थानभेदं च मन्त्रं च दीपदानमनुं पृथक् /
पुष्पवासिततैलेन सर्वकामप्रदं मतम् //
text_mt: the variation of places, the mantra, and separately the mantra for offering the lamp. / [A lamp] with flower-scented oil is considered to grant all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tilatailaṃ śriyaḥ prāptyai pathikāgamanaṃ prati /
atasītailamuddiṣṭaṃ vaśyakarmaṇi niścitam //
meaning:
तिलतैलं श्रियः प्राप्त्यै पथिकागमनं प्रति /
अतसीतैलमुद्दिष्टं वश्यकर्मणि निश्चितम् //
text_mt: Sesame oil is for obtaining prosperity; for the arrival of a traveler, / linseed oil is prescribed, [and] certainly in the act of subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
sārṣāpaṃ roganāśāya kathitaṃ karmakovidaiḥ /
māraṇe rājikotthaṃ vā vibhītakasamudbhavam //
meaning:
सार्षापं रोगनाशाय कथितं कर्मकोविदैः /
मारणे राजिकोत्थं वा विभीतकसमुद्भवम् //
text_mt: Mustard oil is declared for the destruction of diseases by those skilled in rituals; / in eradication, [oil] from black mustard seeds or derived from vibhītaka [is used];

sanskrit_iast:
uñcāṭane karajotthaṃ vidveṣe madhuvṛkṣajam /
alābhe sarvatailānāṃ tilajaṃ tailamuttamam //
meaning:
उञ्चाटने करजोत्थं विद्वेषे मधुवृक्षजम् /
अलाभे सर्वतैलानां तिलजं तैलमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: in expulsion, [oil] derived from karaja; in causing hatred, that produced from the madhūka tree. / If all oils are unavailable, sesame-derived oil is best.

sanskrit_iast:
godhūmāśca tilā māṣā mudgā vai taṇḍulāḥ kramāt /
pañcadhānyamidaṃ proktaṃ nityadīpaṃ tu māruteḥ //
meaning:
गोधूमाश्च तिला माषा मुद्गा वै तण्डुलाः क्रमात् /
पञ्चधान्यमिदं प्रोक्तं नित्यदीपं तु मारुतेः //
text_mt: Wheat, sesame, black gram, green gram, and rice in order— / this is declared to be the five grains for the daily lamp of the son of the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhānyasamudbhūtaṃ piṣṭamātraṃ suśobhanam /
sarvakāmapradaṃ proktaṃ sarvadā dīpadānake //
meaning:
पञ्चधान्यसमुद्भूतं पिष्टमात्रं सुशोभनम् /
सर्वकामप्रदं प्रोक्तं सर्वदा दीपदानके //
text_mt: Merely flour produced from the five grains, being very auspicious, / is declared to grant all desires in always offering lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśye taḍulapiṣṭotthaṃ māraṇe māṣapiṣṭajam /
uñcāṭane kṛṣṇatilapiṣṭajaṃ ca prakīrtitam //
meaning:
वश्ये तडुलपिष्टोत्थं मारणे माषपिष्टजम् /
उञ्चाटने कृष्णतिलपिष्टजं च प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: In subjugation, [a lamp-vessel] made of rice flour [is prescribed]; in eradication, made of black gram flour; / in expulsion, it is proclaimed to be made of black sesame flour;

sanskrit_iast:
pathikāgamane proktaṃ godhūmotthaṃ sataṇḍulam /
mohane tvāḍhakījāta vidveṣe ca kulatthajam //
meaning:
पथिकागमने प्रोक्तं गोधूमोत्थं सतण्डुलम् /
मोहने त्वाढकीजात विद्वेषे च कुलत्थजम् //
text_mt: in the arrival of a traveler, [a vessel] made of wheat with rice is declared; / in bewitchment, produced from pigeon pea; and in causing hatred, made of horse gram.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāme kevalā māṣāḥ proktā dīpasya pātrake /
saṃdhau tripiṣṭajaṃ lakṣmīhetoḥ kastūrikābhavam //
meaning:
संग्रामे केवला माषाः प्रोक्ता दीपस्य पात्रके /
संधौ त्रिपिष्टजं लक्ष्मीहेतोः कस्तूरिकाभवम् //
text_mt: In battle, black gram alone is declared for the vessel of the lamp; / in peacemaking, [a vessel] made of three flours; for the sake of prosperity, that which is made of musk,

sanskrit_iast:
elālavaṅgakarpūramṛganābhisamudbhavam /
kanyāprāptyai tathā rājavaṃśye sakhye tathaiva ca //
meaning:
एलालवङ्गकर्पूरमृगनाभिसमुद्भवम् /
कन्याप्राप्त्यै तथा राजवंश्ये सख्ये तथैव च //
text_mt: or produced with cardamom, clove, camphor, and musk, / likewise for obtaining a maiden, in matters of royal lineage, and likewise in friendship.

sanskrit_iast:
alābhe sarvavastūnāṃ pañcadhānyaṃ varaṃ smṛtam /
aṣṭamuṣṭirbhavetkiñcitkiñcidaṣṭau caḥ puṣkalam //
meaning:
अलाभे सर्ववस्तूनां पञ्चधान्यं वरं स्मृतम् /
अष्टमुष्टिर्भवेत्किञ्चित्किञ्चिदष्टौ चः पुष्कलम् //
text_mt: In the absence of all materials, the five grains are remembered as best. / Eight handfuls make a kiñcit, and eight kiñcits make a puṣkala.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkalānāṃ caturṇāṃ ca hyāḍhakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
caturāḍhako bhaveddroṇaḥ khārī droṇacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
पुष्कलानां चतुर्णां च ह्याढकः परिकीर्तितः /
चतुराढको भवेद्द्रोणः खारी द्रोणचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: Four puṣkalas are proclaimed as an āḍhaka; / four āḍhakas make a droṇa, and a khārī is four droṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
khārīcatuṣṭaya prasthasaṃjñā ca parikīrtitā /
athavānyaprakāreṇa mānamatra nigadyate //
meaning:
खारीचतुष्टय प्रस्थसंज्ञा च परिकीर्तिता /
अथवान्यप्रकारेण मानमत्र निगद्यते //
text_mt: Four khārīs are proclaimed by the designation prastha. / Or rather, by another method, the measure here is declared:

sanskrit_iast:
paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuḍavaṃ matam /
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthastaiścaturbhistathāḍhakaḥ //
meaning:
पलद्वयं तु प्रसृतं द्विगुणं कुडवं मतम् /
चतुर्भिः कुडवैः प्रस्थस्तैश्चतुर्भिस्तथाढकः //
text_mt: Two palas make a prasṛta, and twice that is considered a kuḍava; / four kuḍavas make a prastha, and by four of those likewise an āḍhaka;

sanskrit_iast:
caturāḍhako bhaveddroṇaḥṛ khārī droṇacatuṣṭayam /
krameṇaitena te jñeyāḥ pātre ṣaṭkarmasaṃbhave //
meaning:
चतुराढको भवेद्द्रोणःऋ खारी द्रोणचतुष्टयम् /
क्रमेणैतेन ते ज्ञेयाः पात्रे षट्कर्मसंभवे //
text_mt: four āḍhakas make a droṇa, and a khārī is four droṇas. / In this order they are to be known for a vessel used in the six magical rites.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca sapta nava tathā pramāṇāste yathākramam /
saugandhe naiva mānaṃ syāttadyathāruci saṃmatam //
meaning:
पञ्च सप्त नव तथा प्रमाणास्ते यथाक्रमम् /
सौगन्धे नैव मानं स्यात्तद्यथारुचि संमतम् //
text_mt: Five, seven, and nine are their measures respectively; / for fragrant substance there is no fixed measure, it is approved according to taste.

sanskrit_iast:
nityapātre tu tailānāṃ niyamo vārtikodbhavaḥ /
somavāre gṛhītvātaddhvānyaṃ toyaplutaṃ dharet //
meaning:
नित्यपात्रे तु तैलानां नियमो वार्तिकोद्भवः /
सोमवारे गृहीत्वातद्ध्वान्यं तोयप्लुतं धरेत् //
text_mt: In the daily vessel, however, the rule for oils is produced from the commentary. / Taking that grain on a Monday, one should keep it soaked in water.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātpramāṇato jñeyaṃ kumārīhastapeṣaṇam /
tatpiṣṭaṃ śuddhapātre tu nadītoyena piṇḍitam //
meaning:
पश्चात्प्रमाणतो ज्ञेयं कुमारीहस्तपेषणम् /
तत्पिष्टं शुद्धपात्रे तु नदीतोयेन पिण्डितम् //
text_mt: Afterwards, according to measure, it should be ground by the hand of an unmarried girl; / that flour, gathered into a ball with river water in a clean vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpapātraṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhaḥ prayatamānasaḥ /
dīpapātre jvālyamāne māruteḥ kavacaṃ paṭhet //
meaning:
दीपपात्रं ततः कुर्याच्छुद्धः प्रयतमानसः /
दीपपात्रे ज्वाल्यमाने मारुतेः कवचं पठेत् //
text_mt: he should then make into a lamp-vessel, pure and with controlled mind. / While the lamp-vessel is being kindled, he should recite the armor of the son of the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhabhūmau samāsthāpya bhaume dīpaṃ pradāpayet /
mālāmanūnāṃ ye varṇāḥ sādhyanāmasamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
शुद्धभूमौ समास्थाप्य भौमे दीपं प्रदापयेत् /
मालामनूनां ये वर्णाः साध्यनामसमन्विताः //
text_mt: Setting it down on clean ground, he should offer the lamp on a Tuesday. / Whatever syllables are in the garland-mantras together with the name of the one to be mastered,

sanskrit_iast:
vartikāyāṃ prakarttavyāstantavastatpramāṇakāḥ /
tattriṃśāṃśena vā grāhyā gurukārye 'khilāḍhyatā //
meaning:
वर्तिकायां प्रकर्त्तव्यास्तन्तवस्तत्प्रमाणकाः /
तत्त्रिंशांशेन वा ग्राह्या गुरुकार्ये ऽखिलाढ्यता //
text_mt: threads of that number are to be made into the wick; / or they may be taken as a thirtieth part of that; in an important undertaking, the fullness of all is required.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭatulyāḥ smṛtā nitye sāmānye 'tha viśeṣake /
rudrāḥ kūṭagaṇāḥ proktā na pātre niyamo mataḥ //
meaning:
कूटतुल्याः स्मृता नित्ये सामान्ये ऽथ विशेषके /
रुद्राः कूटगणाः प्रोक्ता न पात्रे नियमो मतः //
text_mt: [The threads] are traditionally equal to the syllables of the kūṭa in the daily rite; then, in the ordinary [rite], or in the special [rite], / the groups of kūṭas are said to be eleven. No restriction is maintained regarding the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāstantavo 'thādhvani smṛtāḥ /
raktasūtraṃ hanumato dīpadāne prakīrtitam //
meaning:
एकविंशतिसंख्याकास्तन्तवो ऽथाध्वनि स्मृताः /
रक्तसूत्रं हनुमतो दीपदाने प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: On a journey, twenty-one threads are prescribed. / A red thread is proclaimed in offering a lamp to Hanumat.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamuñcāṭane dveṣe 'ruṇaṃ māraṇakarmaṇi /
kūṭatulyapalaṃ tailaṃ gurukārye śivairguṇam //
meaning:
कृष्णमुञ्चाटने द्वेषे ऽरुणं मारणकर्मणि /
कूटतुल्यपलं तैलं गुरुकार्ये शिवैर्गुणम् //
text_mt: In eradication, a black [thread is used]; in causing enmity and in the rite of killing, a reddish one. / In a weighty rite, oil equal in palas to the kūṭa, multiplied by eleven [is used].

sanskrit_iast: nitye pañcapalaṃ proktamathavā mānasī ruciḥ //
meaning: नित्ये पञ्चपलं प्रोक्तमथवा मानसी रुचिः //
text_mt: In the daily rite, five palas are prescribed, or whatever pleases the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
hanumatpratimāyāstu sannidhau dīpadāpanam /
śivālaye 'thavā kuryānnityanaimittike sthale //
meaning:
हनुमत्प्रतिमायास्तु सन्निधौ दीपदापनम् /
शिवालये ऽथवा कुर्यान्नित्यनैमित्तिके स्थले //
text_mt: One should perform the offering of a lamp in the presence of an image of Hanumat, / or in a temple of Śiva, in a daily or occasional sacred place.

sanskrit_iast: viśeṣo 'styatra yaḥ kaścinmārute rucyate mayā //
meaning: विशेषो ऽस्त्यत्र यः कश्चिन्मारुते रुच्यते मया //
text_mt: Whatever particular detail exists regarding the Son of the Wind is now spoken by me.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāgre pramodena grahabhūtagraheṣu ca /
catuṣpathe tathā proktaṃ ṣaṭsu dīpapradāpanam //
meaning:
प्रतिमाग्रे प्रमोदेन ग्रहभूतग्रहेषु च /
चतुष्पथे तथा प्रोक्तं षट्सु दीपप्रदापनम् //
text_mt: Offering a lamp is prescribed before the image joyfully, and during afflictions by planets and spirits, / and likewise at a crossroads, in six [places].

sanskrit_iast:
sannidhau sphaāṭike liṅge śālagrāmasya sannidhau /
nānābhogaśriyai proktaṃ dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ //
meaning:
सन्निधौ स्फआटिके लिङ्गे शालग्रामस्य सन्निधौ /
नानाभोगश्रियै प्रोक्तं दीपदानं हनूमतः //
text_mt: In the presence of a crystal liṅga, or in the presence of a Śālagrāma stone, / offering a lamp to Hanumat is prescribed for various kinds of enjoyment and prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśasannidhau vighnamahāsaṃkaṭanāśane /
viṣavyādhibhaye ghore hanumatsannidhau smṛtam //
meaning:
गणेशसन्निधौ विघ्नमहासंकटनाशने /
विषव्याधिभये घोरे हनुमत्सन्निधौ स्मृतम् //
text_mt: In the presence of Gaṇeśa, [it is prescribed] for destroying obstacles and great crises; / in terrible fear of poison or disease, [it] is prescribed in the presence of Hanumat.

sanskrit_iast:
durgāyāḥ sannidhau proktaṃ saṃgrāme dīpadāpanam /
catuṣpathe vyādhinaṣṭau duṣṭadṛṣṭau tathaiva ca //
meaning:
दुर्गायाः सन्निधौ प्रोक्तं संग्रामे दीपदापनम् /
चतुष्पथे व्याधिनष्टौ दुष्टदृष्टौ तथैव च //
text_mt: Offering a lamp is prescribed in the presence of Durgā in battle, / and at a crossroads for the curing of disease and against the evil eye.

sanskrit_iast:
rājadvāre bandhamuktau kārāgāre 'thavā matam /
aśvatthavaṭamūle tu sarvakāryaprasiddhaye //
meaning:
राजद्वारे बन्धमुक्तौ कारागारे ऽथवा मतम् /
अश्वत्थवटमूले तु सर्वकार्यप्रसिद्धये //
text_mt: It is held [to be offered] at the royal gate or in a prison for release from bondage, / but at the foot of an aśvattha or banyan tree for the accomplishment of all aims;

sanskrit_iast:
vaśye bhaye vivāde ca veśmasaṃgrāmasaṃkaṭe /
dyūte dṛṣṭistaṃbhane ca vidveṣe māraṇe tathā //
meaning:
वश्ये भये विवादे च वेश्मसंग्रामसंकटे /
द्यूते दृष्टिस्तंभने च विद्वेषे मारणे तथा //
text_mt: in subjugation, in fear, in dispute, in distress concerning house or battle, / in gambling, in checking the sight, and in causing enmity and killing;

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtakotthāpane caiva pratimācālane tathā /
viṣe vyādhau jvare bhūtagrahe krṛtyāvimocane //
meaning:
मृतकोत्थापने चैव प्रतिमाचालने तथा /
विषे व्याधौ ज्वरे भूतग्रहे क्रृत्याविमोचने //
text_mt: in reviving the dead, in moving an image, / in poison, disease, fever, affliction by spirits, and release from black magic;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatagranthau mahāraṇye durgevyāghne ca dantini /
krūrasattveṣu sarveṣu śaśvadūndhavimokṣaṇe //
meaning:
क्षतग्रन्थौ महारण्ये दुर्गेव्याघ्ने च दन्तिनि /
क्रूरसत्त्वेषु सर्वेषु शश्वदून्धविमोक्षणे //
text_mt: in swellings of wounds, in a great forest, in an impassable place, regarding a tiger and an elephant, / among all cruel beasts, and in perpetual release from bondage;

sanskrit_iast:
pathikāgamane caiva duḥsthāne rājamohane /
āgame nirgame caiva rājadvāre prakīrtitam //
meaning:
पथिकागमने चैव दुःस्थाने राजमोहने /
आगमे निर्गमे चैव राजद्वारे प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: in the arrival of a traveler, in a perilous place, in charming a king, / in coming and going, and at the royal gate—[thus] it is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast: dīpadānaṃ hanumato nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning: दीपदानं हनुमतो नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Offering a lamp to Hanumat [is prescribed]; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraikaviṃśapiṇḍāṃśca tridhā maṇḍalamānakam /
laghumānaṃ smṛtaṃ pañca sapta vā nava vā tathā //
meaning:
रुद्रैकविंशपिण्डांश्च त्रिधा मण्डलमानकम् /
लघुमानं स्मृतं पञ्च सप्त वा नव वा तथा //
text_mt: The measure of the maṇḍala is threefold: eleven or twenty-one piṇḍas; / the small measure is taught to be five, seven, or nine.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīreṇa navanūtena dadhnā vā gomayena ca /
pratimākaraṇaṃ proktaṃ māruterdīpadāpane //
meaning:
क्षीरेण नवनूतेन दध्ना वा गोमयेन च /
प्रतिमाकरणं प्रोक्तं मारुतेर्दीपदापने //
text_mt: With milk, fresh butter, yogurt, or cow dung, / the fashioning of the image is prescribed in the offering of a lamp to the Son of the Wind.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ vīraṃ kṛtvā kesarivikramam //
meaning: दक्षिणाभिमुखं वीरं कृत्वा केसरिविक्रमम् //
text_mt: Making the hero face southward, with the valour of a lion,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛkṣavinyastapādaṃ ca kirīṭena virājitam /
likhedbhittau paṭe vāpi pīṭhe vā māruteḥ śubhe //
meaning:
ऋक्षविन्यस्तपादं च किरीटेन विराजितम् /
लिखेद्भित्तौ पटे वापि पीठे वा मारुतेः शुभे //
text_mt: with his foot placed upon a bear, and resplendent with a diadem, / one should draw the Son of the Wind on an auspicious wall, canvas, or ritual seat.

sanskrit_iast:
mālāmantreṇa dātavyaṃ dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ /
nityadīpaḥ prakarttavyo dvādaśākṣaravidyayā //
meaning:
मालामन्त्रेण दातव्यं दीपदानं हनूमतः /
नित्यदीपः प्रकर्त्तव्यो द्वादशाक्षरविद्यया //
text_mt: The offering of the lamp to Hanumat is to be given with the garland mantra. / The daily lamp should be made with the twelve-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣastatra yastaṃ vai dīpadāne 'vadhāraya /
ṣaṣṭyādau ca dvitīyādāvimaṃ dīpamitīrayet //
meaning:
विशेषस्तत्र यस्तं वै दीपदाने ऽवधारय /
षष्ट्यादौ च द्वितीयादाविमं दीपमितीरयेत् //
text_mt: Understand the particular rule that applies to the offering of the lamp: / at the beginning with the sixth case and with the second case, one should pronounce, 'This lamp...'

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇeti padaṃ paścāccheṣaṃ pūrvavaduñcaret /
kūṭādau nityadīpe ca mantraṃ sūryākṣaraṃ vadet //
meaning:
गृहाणेति पदं पश्चाच्छेषं पूर्ववदुञ्चरेत् /
कूटादौ नित्यदीपे च मन्त्रं सूर्याक्षरं वदेत् //
text_mt: then the word 'Accept!', and recite the rest as before. / In the daily lamp beginning with the kūṭa, one should utter the twelve-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mālākhyamanunā tattatkāryeṣu kārayet /
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau tadgatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र मालाख्यमनुना तत्तत्कार्येषु कारयेत् /
गोमयेनोपलिप्तायां भूमौ तद्गतमानसः //
text_mt: There, with the mantra called 'garland', one should perform it for the various specific aims. / On ground smeared with cow dung, fixing his mind on him,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ ca bhūmau rekhāsamanvitam /
kamalaṃ ca likhedbhadraṃ tatra dīpaṃ nidhāpayet //
meaning:
षट्कोणं वसुपत्रं च भूमौ रेखासमन्वितम् /
कमलं च लिखेद्भद्रं तत्र दीपं निधापयेत् //
text_mt: one should draw a six-pointed figure with eight petals accompanied by lines on the ground, / and an auspicious lotus; there one should place the lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
śaive vā vaiṣṇave pīṭhe pūjayedañjanāsutam /
kūṭaṣaṭkaṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇe antarāle paralikhet //
meaning:
शैवे वा वैष्णवे पीठे पूजयेदञ्जनासुतम् /
कूटषट्कं च षट्कोणे अन्तराले परलिखेत् //
text_mt: On a Śaiva or Vaiṣṇava ritual seat, one should worship the son of Añjanā. / And one should write the six kūṭas in the six corners, and another in the intervening space.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni bījayuktāni saṃlikhet /
saumyaṃ madhyagataṃ lekhyaṃ tatra saṃpūjya mārutim //
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि बीजयुक्तानि संलिखेत् /
सौम्यं मध्यगतं लेख्यं तत्र संपूज्य मारुतिम् //
text_mt: In the six corners one should write the six limbs endowed with seed-syllables; / a gentle [figure] is to be drawn in the centre, and worshipping the Son of the Wind there,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni nāmāni ca puroktavat /
vasupatre kramātpūjyā aṣṭāvete ca vānarāḥ //
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि नामानि च पुरोक्तवत् /
वसुपत्रे क्रमात्पूज्या अष्टावेते च वानराः //
