text_mt: [one should write] the six limbs in the six corners, and the names as mentioned before. / On the eight petals, these eight monkeys are to be worshipped in order:

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvāyāṅgadāyātha suṣeṇāya nalāya ca /
nīlāyātho jāṃbavate prahastāya tathaiva ca //
meaning:
सुग्रीवायाङ्गदायाथ सुषेणाय नलाय च /
नीलायाथो जांबवते प्रहस्ताय तथैव च //
text_mt: to Sugrīva, to Aṅgada, then to Suṣeṇa and to Nala, / to Nīla, then to Jāmbavat, and likewise to Prahasta,

sanskrit_iast:
suveṣāya tataḥ paścādyajetṣaḍaṅgadevatāḥ /
ādāvañjanāputrāya tataśca rudramūrtaye //
meaning:
सुवेषाय ततः पश्चाद्यजेत्षडङ्गदेवताः /
आदावञ्जनापुत्राय ततश्च रुद्रमूर्तये //
text_mt: [and] to Suveṣa; thereafter, one should worship the deities of the six limbs: / first to the Son of Añjanā, then to the Embodiment of Rudra,

sanskrit_iast:
tato vāyusutāyātha jānakījīvanāya ca /
rāmadūtāya brahmāstranivāraṇāya tatparam //
meaning:
ततो वायुसुतायाथ जानकीजीवनाय च /
रामदूताय ब्रह्मास्त्रनिवारणाय तत्परम् //
text_mt: then to the Son of the Wind, and to the Life of Jānakī, / to the Messenger of Rāma, and after that, to the Destroyer of the Brahmā-missile.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya deśakālau ca kīrtet /
kuśodakaṃ samādāya dīpamantraṃ samuñcaret //
meaning:
पञ्चोपचारैः संपूज्य देशकालौ च कीर्तेत् /
कुशोदकं समादाय दीपमन्त्रं समुञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped with the fivefold offerings, one should proclaim the place and time. / Taking water with kuśa grass, one should utter the lamp-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
uttagabhimukho japtvā sādhayetsādhakottamaḥ /
taṃ mantraṃ kūṭadhā japtvā jalaṃ bhūmau vinikṣipet //
meaning:
उत्तगभिमुखो जप्त्वा साधयेत्साधकोत्तमः /
तं मन्त्रं कूटधा जप्त्वा जलं भूमौ विनिक्षिपेत् //
text_mt: Facing northward, having recited [the mantra], the excellent practitioner should accomplish [his aim]. / Having recited that mantra kūṭa-wise, he should cast the water on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ karapuṭaṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti japenmanum /
anena dīpavaryeṇa udaṅmukhagatena vai //
meaning:
ततः करपुटं कृत्वा यथाशक्ति जपेन्मनुम् /
अनेन दीपवर्येण उदङ्मुखगतेन वै //
text_mt: Then, making cupped hands, he should recite the mantra according to his ability: / 'By this excellent lamp facing northward,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vidhehi hanumanyathā syurme manorathaāḥ /
trayodaśaivaṃ dravyāṇi gomayaṃ mṛttikā masī //
meaning:
तथा विधेहि हनुमन्यथा स्युर्मे मनोरथआः /
त्रयोदशैवं द्रव्याणि गोमयं मृत्तिका मसी //
text_mt: so act, O Hanumat, that my desires may be fulfilled!' / Thus the thirteen substances: cow dung, clay, ink,

sanskrit_iast:
alaktaṃ daradaṃ raktacandanaṃ candanaṃ madhu /
kastūrikā dadhi kṣīraṃ navanītaṃ ghaṛtaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अलक्तं दरदं रक्तचन्दनं चन्दनं मधु /
कस्तूरिका दधि क्षीरं नवनीतं घऋतं तथा //
text_mt: lac-dye, red cinnabar, red sandalwood, sandalwood, honey, / musk, yogurt, milk, fresh butter, and ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayaṃ dvividhaṃ tatra proktaṃ gomahiṣībhavam /
paścādvinaṣṭadravyāptau māhiṣaṃ gomayaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
गोमयं द्विविधं तत्र प्रोक्तं गोमहिषीभवम् /
पश्चाद्विनष्टद्रव्याप्तौ माहिषं गोमयं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Cow dung there is said to be of two kinds: produced from cows or from female buffaloes. / For recovering articles lost later, dung from a female buffalo is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
pathikāgamane dūrānmahādurgasya rakṣaṇe /
bālādirakṣaṇe caiva caurādibhayanāśane //
meaning:
पथिकागमने दूरान्महादुर्गस्य रक्षणे /
बालादिरक्षणे चैव चौरादिभयनाशने //
text_mt: In the arrival of a traveler from afar, in the protection of a great fortress, / in the protection of children and the like, and in destroying fear of thieves and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
strīvaśyādiṣu kāryeṣu śastaṃ gogomayaṃ mane /
bhūmispṛṣṭaṃ na tadgrāhyamantarikṣāñca bhājane //
meaning:
स्त्रीवश्यादिषु कार्येषु शस्तं गोगोमयं मने /
भूमिस्पृष्टं न तद्ग्राह्यमन्तरिक्षाञ्च भाजने //
text_mt: [and] in rites such as subjugating women, cow dung from a cow is approved in my opinion. / That which has touched the ground should not be taken, but [caught] in the air in a vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhā mṛttikā tu śvetā pītāruṇāsitā /
tatra gopīcandanaṃ tu haritālaṃ ca gaurikam //
meaning:
चतुर्विधा मृत्तिका तु श्वेता पीतारुणासिता /
तत्र गोपीचन्दनं तु हरितालं च गौरिकम् //
text_mt: Clay is of four kinds: white, yellow, red, and black; / among these, gopīcandana, yellow orpiment, and red chalk,

sanskrit_iast:
maṣī lākṣārasodbhūtā sarvaṃ vānyatsphuṭaṃ matam /
kṛtvā gopīcadaṃnena caturasraṃ gṛhaṃ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
मषी लाक्षारसोद्भूता सर्वं वान्यत्स्फुटं मतम् /
कृत्वा गोपीचदंनेन चतुरस्रं गृहं सुधीः //
text_mt: ink produced from lac-resin, or all the others are held to be obvious. / Having made a square chamber with gopīcandana, the wise practitioner,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye māhiṣeṇātha kuryānmūrtiṃ hanūmataḥ /
bījaṃ krodhāñca tatpucchaṃ likhenmantrī samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये माहिषेणाथ कुर्यान्मूर्तिं हनूमतः /
बीजं क्रोधाञ्च तत्पुच्छं लिखेन्मन्त्री समाहितः //
text_mt: should then fashion an image of Hanumat in its centre with dung of a female buffalo. / The concentrated practitioner of mantras should write the seed-syllable, wrath, and his tail.

sanskrit_iast:
tailena snāpayenmūrtiṃ guḍena tilakaṃ caret /
śatapatrasamo dhūpaḥ śālaniryāsasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
तैलेन स्नापयेन्मूर्तिं गुडेन तिलकं चरेत् /
शतपत्रसमो धूपः शालनिर्याससंभवः //
text_mt: He should bathe the image with oil and make a mark with molasses. / The incense produced from the resin of the śāla tree is equal to a hundred petals.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryyāñca tailadīpaṃ tu vartipañcakasaṃyutam /
dadhyodanena naivedyaṃ dadyātsādhakasattamaḥ //
meaning:
कुर्य्याञ्च तैलदीपं तु वर्तिपञ्चकसंयुतम् /
दध्योदनेन नैवेद्यं दद्यात्साधकसत्तमः //
text_mt: He should make an oil-lamp endowed with five wicks; / the best of practitioners should present an offering of yogurt-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
vāratrayaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe saśeṣaviṣamuñcaran /
evaṃ kṛte tu naṣṭānāṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ gavāmapi //
meaning:
वारत्रयं कण्ठदेशे सशेषविषमुञ्चरन् /
एवं कृते तु नष्टानां महिषीणां गवामपि //
text_mt: Pronouncing 'the remaining poison' on the throat region three times; / when this is done, the recovery of lost female buffaloes and cows,

sanskrit_iast:
dāsīdāsādikānāṃ ca naṣṭānāṃ prāptirīritā /
caurādiduṣṭasattvānāṃ sarpādīnāṃ bhaye punaḥ //
meaning:
दासीदासादिकानां च नष्टानां प्राप्तिरीरिता /
चौरादिदुष्टसत्त्वानां सर्पादीनां भये पुनः //
text_mt: and of lost female and male servants and the like, is declared. / Furthermore, in fear of thieves, wicked creatures, snakes, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tālena ca caturdvāraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam /
pūrvadvāre gajaḥ sthāpyo dakṣiṇe mahiṣastathā //
meaning:
तालेन च चतुर्द्वारं गृहं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् /
पूर्वद्वारे गजः स्थाप्यो दक्षिणे महिषस्तथा //
text_mt: having made a beautiful four-gated chamber with yellow orpiment, / an elephant should be placed at the eastern gate, and likewise a buffalo at the southern;

sanskrit_iast:
sarpastu paścime dvāre vyāghraścaivottare tathā /
evaṃ krameṇa khaḍgaṃ ca kṣurikādaṇḍamudgarān //
meaning:
सर्पस्तु पश्चिमे द्वारे व्याघ्रश्चैवोत्तरे तथा /
एवं क्रमेण खड्गं च क्षुरिकादण्डमुद्गरान् //
text_mt: a serpent at the western gate, and a tiger at the northern. / Having drawn in this order a sword, a dagger, a staff, and a club,

sanskrit_iast:
vilikhya madhye mūrtiṃ ca mahiṣīgomayena vai /
kṛtvā ḍamaruhastāṃ ca cakitākṣīṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
विलिख्य मध्ये मूर्तिं च महिषीगोमयेन वै /
कृत्वा डमरुहस्तां च चकिताक्षीं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: and having carefully fashioned an image in the middle with the dung of a female buffalo, / holding a hand-drum and with startled eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
payasā snāpanaṃ raktacandanenānulepanam /
jātīpuṣpaistu saṃpūjya śuddhadhūpa prakalpayet //
meaning:
पयसा स्नापनं रक्तचन्दनेनानुलेपनम् /
जातीपुष्पैस्तु संपूज्य शुद्धधूप प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: [one should perform] bathing with milk and anointing with red sandalwood; / having worshipped with jasmine flowers, one should arrange pure incense.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena dīpaṃ dattvātha pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet /
gaganaṃ dīpikendvāḍhyāṃ śāstraṃ ca purato japet //
meaning:
घृतेन दीपं दत्त्वाथ पायसान्नं निवेदयेत् /
गगनं दीपिकेन्द्वाढ्यां शास्त्रं च पुरतो जपेत् //
text_mt: Offering a lamp with clarified butter, one should then present milk-rice [as an oblation]; / and in front [of the image], one should recite the text adorned with the sky, lamp, and moon.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saptadinaṃ kṛtvā mucyate mahato bhayāt /
anayorbhauṃmavāre tu kuryādāraṃbhamādarāt //
meaning:
एवं सप्तदिनं कृत्वा मुच्यते महतो भयात् /
अनयोर्भौंमवारे तु कुर्यादारंभमादरात् //
text_mt: Having done this for seven days, one is freed from great danger. / Moreover, one should carefully begin these two on a Tuesday.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrusenābhaye prāpte gairikeṇa tu maṇḍalam /
kṛtvā tadantare tālamīṣṭannamraṃ samālikhet //
meaning:
शत्रुसेनाभये प्राप्ते गैरिकेण तु मण्डलम् /
कृत्वा तदन्तरे तालमीष्टन्नम्रं समालिखेत् //
text_mt: When danger from an enemy army arises, one should make a sacred diagram with red chalk, / and in its middle, draw a slightly bent palm tree.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvalaṃbamānāṃ ca pratimāṃ gomayena tu /
vāmahastena tālāgraṃ dakṣiṇe jñānamudrikā //
meaning:
तत्रावलंबमानां च प्रतिमां गोमयेन तु /
वामहस्तेन तालाग्रं दक्षिणे ज्ञानमुद्रिका //
text_mt: There, [one should draw] an image suspended [from it], using cow dung: / with the left hand on the top of the palm tree, and the gesture of knowledge in the right.

sanskrit_iast:
tālamūlātsvakāṣṭāyāṃ mārge hastamite gṛham /
caturasra vidhāyātha tanmadhye mūrtimālikhet //
meaning:
तालमूलात्स्वकाष्टायां मार्गे हस्तमिते गृहम् /
चतुरस्र विधायाथ तन्मध्ये मूर्तिमालिखेत् //
text_mt: On the path a cubit away from the root of the palm tree in one's own direction, having made / a square chamber, one should then draw an image in its center:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇābhamukhīṃ rimyāṃ hṛdaye vihitāñjalim /
toyena snānagandhādi yathāsaṃbhavamarpayet //
meaning:
दक्षिणाभमुखीं रिम्यां हृदये विहिताञ्जलिम् /
तोयेन स्नानगन्धादि यथासंभवमर्पयेत् //
text_mt: Facing south, charming, with folded hands placed at the heart. / One should offer bathing with water, perfumes, and other [offerings] as available.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśārānnaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sājyaṃ tasyai nivedayet /
kilidvayaṃ japaṃ proktamevaṃ kuryāddine dine //
meaning:
कृशारान्नं च नैवेद्यं साज्यं तस्यै निवेदयेत् /
किलिद्वयं जपं प्रोक्तमेवं कुर्याद्दिने दिने //
text_mt: And one should offer her an oblation of dish of rice and lentils mixed with clarified butter. / Recitation of two 'kili's is prescribed; one should perform this day after day.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte bhavecchīghraṃ pathikānāṃ samāgamaḥ /
śyāmapāṣāṇakhaṇḍena likhitvā bhūpatergṛham //
meaning:
एवं कृते भवेच्छीघ्रं पथिकानां समागमः /
श्यामपाषाणखण्डेन लिखित्वा भूपतेर्गृहम् //
text_mt: When this is done, the arrival of travelers takes place quickly. / Having drawn the king's palace with a piece of dark stone,

sanskrit_iast:
prākāraṃ tu caturdvārayuktaṃ dvāreṣu tatra vai /
anyonyapuccha ridhitrayayuktāṃ hanūmataḥ //
meaning:
प्राकारं तु चतुर्द्वारयुक्तं द्वारेषु तत्र वै /
अन्योन्यपुच्छ रिधित्रययुक्तां हनूमतः //
text_mt: and an enclosure wall equipped with four gates, there at the gates / [one should make figures] of Hanumat with intertwined tails and three lines.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryānmūrtiṃ gomayena dhattūrakusumaiyajet /
jaṭāmāṃsībhavaṃ dhūpaṃ tailāktaghṛtadīpakam //
meaning:
कुर्यान्मूर्तिं गोमयेन धत्तूरकुसुमैयजेत् /
जटामांसीभवं धूपं तैलाक्तघृतदीपकम् //
text_mt: One should make the image with cow dung and worship with dhattūra flowers, / with incense made from spikenard, and a lamp of oil and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ tilatailāktasakṣārā māṣaroṭikā /
dhyeyo dakṣiṇahastena roṭikāṃ bhakṣayanhariḥ //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं तिलतैलाक्तसक्षारा माषरोटिका /
ध्येयो दक्षिणहस्तेन रोटिकां भक्षयन्हरिः //
text_mt: The oblation is a salted bread of black gram smeared with sesame oil. / Hari is to be meditated upon as eating the bread with his right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmahastena pāṣāṇaistrāsayanparasainikān /
pnārayanbhrukuṭīṃ baddhvā bhīṣayanmathayansthitaḥ //
meaning:
वामहस्तेन पाषाणैस्त्रासयन्परसैनिकान् /
प्नारयन्भ्रुकुटीं बद्ध्वा भीषयन्मथयन्स्थितः //
text_mt: and with his left hand terrifying the enemy soldiers with stones, / standing with knitted eyebrows, frightening and crushing [them].

sanskrit_iast:
japeñca bhugbhugiti vai sahasraṃ dhyānatatparaḥ /
evaṃ kṛtavidhānena parasainyaṃ vināśayet //
meaning:
जपेञ्च भुग्भुगिति वै सहस्रं ध्यानतत्परः /
एवं कृतविधानेन परसैन्यं विनाशयेत् //
text_mt: Intent on meditation, one should recite 'bhug-bhug' a thousand times. / By the ritual performed in this manner, one destroys the enemy army.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣā bhavati durgāṇāṃ satyaṃ satya na saṃśayaḥ /
prāyogā bahavastatra saṃkṣepādgaditā mayā //
meaning:
रक्षा भवति दुर्गाणां सत्यं सत्य न संशयः /
प्रायोगा बहवस्तत्र संक्षेपाद्गदिता मया //
text_mt: Protection of fortresses is accomplished, truly, truly, there is no doubt. / Many rites exist there; they have been spoken by me in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ yo vidhānena dīpadānaṃ hanūmataḥ /
tasyāsādhyaṃ na vai kiñcidvidyate bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
प्रत्यहं यो विधानेन दीपदानं हनूमतः /
तस्यासाध्यं न वै किञ्चिद्विद्यते भुवनत्रये //
text_mt: For one who gives a lamp to Hanūmat daily according to the rules, / there is indeed nothing unattainable in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
na deyaṃ duṣṭahṛdaye duṣṭacintanabuddhaye /
avinītāya śiṣyāya piśunāya kadācana //
meaning:
न देयं दुष्टहृदये दुष्टचिन्तनबुद्धये /
अविनीताय शिष्याय पिशुनाय कदाचन //
text_mt: It should not be given to an evil-hearted person, nor to one whose mind thinks wicked thoughts, / nor to an undisciplined pupil, nor ever to a slanderous person.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaghnāya na dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ ca parīkṣite /
bahunā kimihoktena sarvaṃ dadyātkapīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
कृतघ्नाय न दातव्यं दातव्यं च परीक्षिते /
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन सर्वं दद्यात्कपीश्वरः //
text_mt: It must not be given to an ungrateful person, but should be given to one who has been tested. / What need is there of saying much here? The lord of monkeys grants everything.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mantrāntaraṃ vakṣye tattvajñānapradāyakam /
tāro namo hanumate jāṭharatrayamīrayet //
meaning:
अथ मन्त्रान्तरं वक्ष्ये तत्त्वज्ञानप्रदायकम् /
तारो नमो हनुमते जाठरत्रयमीरयेत् //
text_mt: Now I will state another mantra that bestows knowledge of reality: / One should utter the pranava (oṃ), 'namo hanumate', three 'ra's,

sanskrit_iast:
danakṣobhaṃ samābhāṣya saṃharadvayamīrayet /
ātmatattvaṃ tataḥ paścātprakāśayayugaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
दनक्षोभं समाभाष्य संहरद्वयमीरयेत् /
आत्मतत्त्वं ततः पश्चात्प्रकाशययुगं ततः //
text_mt: and having uttered 'danakṣobhaṃ', one should utter two 'saṃhara's; / then 'ātmatattvaṃ', and thereafter two 'prakāśaya's,

sanskrit_iast:
varmāstravahnijāyāntaḥ sārddhūṣaḍviṃśadarṇavān /
vasiṣṭho 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭup ca devatāḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
वर्मास्त्रवह्निजायान्तः सार्द्धूषड्विंशदर्णवान् /
वसिष्ठो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप् च देवताः पुनः //
text_mt: ending with the armor (huṃ), weapon (phaṭ), and the wife of Agni (svāhā); it has twenty-six and a half syllables. / Its sage is Vasiṣṭha, its meter is anuṣṭubh, and the deity is further

sanskrit_iast:
hanumānmunisaptartuvedāṣṭanigamaiḥ kramāt /
mantrārṇaiśca ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyāyetkapīśvaram //
meaning:
हनुमान्मुनिसप्तर्तुवेदाष्टनिगमैः क्रमात् /
मन्त्रार्णैश्च षडङ्गानि कृत्वा ध्यायेत्कपीश्वरम् //
text_mt: Hanumān. Having performed the six limbs with seven, six, four, eight, and four letters of the mantra / respectively, one should meditate on the lord of monkeys:

sanskrit_iast:
jānusthāvāmabāhuṃ ca jñānamudrāparaṃ hṛdi /
adhyātmacittamāsīnaṃ kadalīvanamadhyagam //
meaning:
जानुस्थावामबाहुं च ज्ञानमुद्रापरं हृदि /
अध्यात्मचित्तमासीनं कदलीवनमध्यगम् //
text_mt: His left arm resting on his knee, the other [hand] in the gesture of knowledge at his heart, / his mind focused on the Supreme Self, seated, situated in the middle of a plantain grove,

sanskrit_iast:
bālārkakoṭipratimaṃ dhyāyejjñānapradaṃ harim /
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ //
meaning:
बालार्ककोटिप्रतिमं ध्यायेज्ज्ञानप्रदं हरिम् /
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेल्लक्षं दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः //
text_mt: resembling ten million rising suns—one should meditate on Hari who bestows knowledge. / Having meditated thus, one should recite a hundred thousand times and offer a tenth of that in fire with sesame seeds

sanskrit_iast:
sājyaiḥ saṃpūjayetpīṭhe pūrvokte pūrvavatprabhum /
japto 'yaṃ madanakṣobhaṃ nāśayatyeva niścitam //
meaning:
साज्यैः संपूजयेत्पीठे पूर्वोक्ते पूर्ववत्प्रभुम् /
जप्तो ऽयं मदनक्षोभं नाशयत्येव निश्चितम् //
text_mt: mixed with clarified butter. One should worship the Lord on the aforementioned ritual seat as before. / When recited, this [mantra] certainly destroys the agitation of love.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñānamavāpnoti kapīndrasya prasādataḥ /
atha mantrātaraṃ vākṣye bhūtavidrāvaṇaṃ param //
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञानमवाप्नोति कपीन्द्रस्य प्रसादतः /
अथ मन्त्रातरं वाक्ष्ये भूतविद्रावणं परम् //
text_mt: One obtains knowledge of reality through the grace of the chief of monkeys. / Now I will explain another mantra, supreme in dispersing evil spirits:

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ kāśīṅkukṣiparavarāhaścāñjanāpadam /
pavano vanaputrānte āveśidvayamīrayet //
meaning:
तारः काशीङ्कुक्षिपरवराहश्चाञ्जनापदम् /
पवनो वनपुत्रान्ते आवेशिद्वयमीरयेत् //
text_mt: The praṇava (oṃ), 'kā', 'śīṅku', 'kṣipa', 'ra', the supreme boar ('varāhaḥ'), and the word 'añjanā', / 'pavano', and following 'vanaputra', one should utter two 'āveśi's,

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ śrīhanumatyaścādastraracabhujākṣaraḥ /
brahmā muniḥ syādgāyatrī chando 'tra devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
तारः श्रीहनुमत्यश्चादस्त्ररचभुजाक्षरः /
ब्रह्मा मुनिः स्याद्गायत्री छन्दो ऽत्र देवता पुनः //
text_mt: the praṇava (oṃ), 'śrīhanumate', and then the weapon-letter (phaṭ); it has twenty-four syllables. / Brahmā is the sage, the meter here is gāyatrī, and the deity is further

sanskrit_iast:
hanumānkamalā bījaṃ phaṭ śaktiḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaret //
meaning:
हनुमान्कमला बीजं फट् शक्तिः परिकीर्तितः /
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन षडङ्गानि समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Hanumān; Kamalā (śrīm) is the seed-syllable, and phaṭ is declared to be the power. / One should perform the six limbs with the seed-syllable endowed with the six long vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
āñjaneya pāṭalāsyaṃ svarṇādrisamavigraham /
pārijātadrumūlasthaṃ cintayetsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
आञ्जनेय पाटलास्यं स्वर्णाद्रिसमविग्रहम् /
पारिजातद्रुमूलस्थं चिन्तयेत्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: The son of Añjanā, with a pale red face and a body resembling a mountain of gold, / situated at the foot of a pārijāta tree—the excellent practitioner should meditate on him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ /
trimadhvaktairyañjatpīṭhe pūrvoktepūrvavatsudhīḥ //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षं दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः /
त्रिमध्वक्तैर्यञ्जत्पीठे पूर्वोक्तेपूर्ववत्सुधीः //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should recite a hundred thousand times and offer a tenth of that in fire with sesame seeds / smeared with the three sweets. The wise person should worship on the aforementioned ritual seat as before.

sanskrit_iast:
anena manunā mantrī grahagrastaṃ pramārjayet /
ākrandaṃstaṃ vimucyātha grahaḥ śīghraṃ palāyate //
meaning:
अनेन मनुना मन्त्री ग्रहग्रस्तं प्रमार्जयेत् /
आक्रन्दंस्तं विमुच्याथ ग्रहः शीघ्रं पलायते //
text_mt: With this mantra, the mantra-practitioner should wipe down one possessed by a planetary spirit. / Crying out, the planetary spirit releases him and quickly flees.

sanskrit_iast:
manavo 'mī sadāgopyā na prakāśyā yatastataḥ /
parīkṣitāya śiṣyāya deyā vā nijasūnave //
meaning:
मनवो ऽमी सदागोप्या न प्रकाश्या यतस्ततः /
परीक्षिताय शिष्याय देया वा निजसूनवे //
text_mt: These mantras are always to be concealed and not revealed everywhere. / They should be given to a tested disciple or to one's own son.

sanskrit_iast:
hanumadbhajanāsaktaḥ kārtavīryārjunaṃ sudhīḥ /
viśeṣataḥ samārādhya yathoktaṃ phalamāpnuyāt //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde dīpavidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
हनुमद्भजनासक्तः कार्तवीर्यार्जुनं सुधीः /
विशेषतः समाराध्य यथोक्तं फलमाप्नुयात् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे दीपविधिनिरूपणं नाम पञ्चसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Devoted to the worship of Hanumat, the wise person, / having especially propitiated Kārtavīryārjuna, obtains the stated fruit.

Thus ends the seventy-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Rule for Lamps', in the third quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
kārtavīryataprabhṛtayo nṛpā bahuvidhā bhuvi /
jāyante 'tha pralīyante svasvakarmānusārataḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
कार्तवीर्यतप्रभृतयो नृपा बहुविधा भुवि /
जायन्ते ऽथ प्रलीयन्ते स्वस्वकर्मानुसारतः //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Various kings such as Kārtavīrya / are born on earth and then dissolve in accordance with their respective deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathaṃ rājavaryo 'sau lokesevyatvamāgataḥ /
samullaṅghya nṛpānanyānetanme nuda saṃśayam //
meaning:
तत्कथं राजवर्यो ऽसौ लोकेसेव्यत्वमागतः /
समुल्लङ्घ्य नृपानन्यानेतन्मे नुद संशयम् //
text_mt: Why then has this best of kings attained the status of being worshipped in the world, / surpassing other kings? Dispel this doubt of mine!

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi saṃdehavinivṛttaye /
yathā sevyatvamāpannaḥ kārtavīryārjuno bhuvi //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि संदेहविनिवृत्तये /
यथा सेव्यत्वमापन्नः कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो भुवि //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Nārada! For the removal of your doubt, I shall tell / how Kārtavīryārjuna attained the status of being worshipped on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sudarśanacakrasyāvatāraḥ pṛthivītale /
dattātreyaṃ samārādhya labdhavāṃsteja uttamam //
meaning:
यः सुदर्शनचक्रस्यावतारः पृथिवीतले /
दत्तात्रेयं समाराध्य लब्धवांस्तेज उत्तमम् //
text_mt: He who was an incarnation of the Sudarśana discus on the surface of the earth, / having worshipped Dattātreya, obtained excellent splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kṣitīśvaredrasya smaraṇādeva nārada /
śatrūñjayati saṃgrāme naṣṭaṃ prāpnoti satvaram //
meaning:
तस्य क्षितीश्वरेद्रस्य स्मरणादेव नारद /
शत्रूञ्जयति संग्रामे नष्टं प्राप्नोति सत्वरम् //
text_mt: Merely by remembering that lord among kings, O Nārada, / one conquers enemies in battle and quickly recovers what was lost.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāsya mantrapūjādi sarvatantreṣu gopitam /
tubhyaṃ prakāśayiṣye 'haṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam //
meaning:
तेनास्य मन्त्रपूजादि सर्वतन्त्रेषु गोपितम् /
तुभ्यं प्रकाशयिष्ये ऽहं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: Therefore, his mantra, worship, and so forth have been concealed in all tantras. / I shall reveal to you [this rite] which bestows all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnitārayutā raudrī lakṣmīragnīnduśāntiyuk /
vedhādharenduśāntyāḍhyo nidrayāśāgni binduyuk //
meaning:
वह्नितारयुता रौद्री लक्ष्मीरग्नीन्दुशान्तियुक् /
वेधाधरेन्दुशान्त्याढ्यो निद्रयाशाग्नि बिन्दुयुक् //
text_mt: The raudrī syllable combined with fire and the tāra; lakṣmī joined with fire, the moon, and śānti; / endowed with the creator, the lower lip, the moon, and śānti; joined with sleep, hope, fire, and the bindu;

sanskrit_iast:
pāśo māyāṅkuśaṃ padmāvarmāstre kārtavīpadam /
rephovā dyāsano 'nanto vahnijau karṇasaṃsthitau //
meaning:
पाशो मायाङ्कुशं पद्मावर्मास्त्रे कार्तवीपदम् /
रेफोवा द्यासनो ऽनन्तो वह्निजौ कर्णसंस्थितौ //
text_mt: pāśa, māyā, aṅkuśa, padmā, varman, astra; the word 'kārtavī'; / the letter 'ra', the seat of the deity, Ananta, the two fire-born ones situated on the ear;

sanskrit_iast:
meṣaḥ sadīrghaḥ pavano manurukto hṛdantimaḥ /
ūnarviśativarṇo 'yaṃ tārādirnakhavarṇakaḥ //
meaning:
मेषः सदीर्घः पवनो मनुरुक्तो हृदन्तिमः /
ऊनर्विशतिवर्णो ऽयं तारादिर्नखवर्णकः //
text_mt: meṣa endowed with the long vowel, and pavana; the mantra is declared to end with 'hṛd' [namaḥ]. / This [mantra] of nineteen syllables begins with the tāra and contains twenty letters.

sanskrit_iast:
dattātreyo muniścāsyacchando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam /
kārtavīryārjuno devo bījaśaktirdhruvaśca hṛt //
meaning:
दत्तात्रेयो मुनिश्चास्यच्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुबुदाहृतम् /
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो देवो बीजशक्तिर्ध्रुवश्च हृत् //
text_mt: Dattātreya is its seer, the metre is declared to be anuṣṭubh, / Kārtavīryārjuna is the deity, dhruva is the seed-syllable, and the heart is the power.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāḍhyabījayugmena hṛdayaṃ vinyasedadhaḥ /
śāntiyuktacaturthena kāmādyena śirāḥeṃ'gakam //
meaning:
शेषाढ्यबीजयुग्मेन हृदयं विन्यसेदधः /
शान्तियुक्तचतुर्थेन कामाद्येन शिराःएंऽगकम् //
text_mt: With the pair of seed-syllables endowed with Śeṣa, one should place the heart below; / with the fourth endowed with śānti and beginning with kāma, the head limb;

sanskrit_iast:
indvāḍhyaṃ vāmakarṇādyamāyayorvīśayuktayā /
śikhāmaṅkuśapadmābhyāṃ savāgbhyāṃ varma vinyaset //
meaning:
इन्द्वाढ्यं वामकर्णाद्यमाययोर्वीशयुक्तया /
शिखामङ्कुशपद्माभ्यां सवाग्भ्यां वर्म विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: with the one endowed with the moon, beginning with the left ear, and māyā joined with the lord of earth, / the crest; with the aṅkuśa and lotus along with vāc, the armor;

sanskrit_iast:
varmāstrābhyāmastramuktaṃ śeṣārṇairvyāpakaṃ punaḥ /
hṛdaye jaṭhare nābhau jaṭhare guhyadeśataḥ //
meaning:
वर्मास्त्राभ्यामस्त्रमुक्तं शेषार्णैर्व्यापकं पुनः /
हृदये जठरे नाभौ जठरे गुह्यदेशतः //
text_mt: With the armor and weapon [mantras], the weapon is recited; and with the remaining syllables, the pervasive [placement is done]. / [They are placed] on the heart, belly, navel, stomach, and from the secret region.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣapāde vāmapāde sakthni jānuni jaṅghayoḥ /
vinyasedbījadaśakaṃ praṇavadvayamadhyagam //
meaning:
दक्षपादे वामपादे सक्थ्नि जानुनि जङ्घयोः /
विन्यसेद्बीजदशकं प्रणवद्वयमध्यगम् //
text_mt: on the right foot, on the left foot, on the thigh, on the knee, and on the two shanks, / one should place the ten seed-syllables situated between two praṇavas [Oṃ].

sanskrit_iast:
tārādyānatha śeṣārṇānmastake ca lalāṭake /
bhruvoḥ śrutyostathaivākṣṇornasi vaktre galeṃ'sake //
meaning:
ताराद्यानथ शेषार्णान्मस्तके च ललाटके /
भ्रुवोः श्रुत्योस्तथैवाक्ष्णोर्नसि वक्त्रे गलेंऽसके //
text_mt: Then, one should place the remaining syllables beginning with the tāra on the crown of the head, on the forehead, / on the eyebrows, on the two ears, and likewise on the eyes, on the nose, in the mouth, on the throat, on the shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamantreṇa sarvāṅge kṛtvā vyāpakamādṛtaḥ /
sarveṣṭasiddhaye dhyāyetkārtavīryaṃ janeśvaram //
meaning:
सर्वमन्त्रेण सर्वाङ्गे कृत्वा व्यापकमादृतः /
सर्वेष्टसिद्धये ध्यायेत्कार्तवीर्यं जनेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Having carefully performed the pervasive placement on all limbs with the entire mantra, / one should meditate on Kārtavīrya, the lord of men, for the attainment of all desires:

sanskrit_iast:
udyadrarkasahasrābhaṃ sarvabhūpativanditam /
dorbhiḥ pañcāśatā dakṣairbāṇānvāmairdhanūṃṣi ca //
meaning:
उद्यद्रर्कसहस्राभं सर्वभूपतिवन्दितम् /
दोर्भिः पञ्चाशता दक्षैर्बाणान्वामैर्धनूंषि च //
text_mt: Shining like a thousand rising suns, praised by all kings, / holding arrows in his fifty right hands and bows in his left hands;

sanskrit_iast:
dadhataṃ svarṇamālāḍhyaṃ raktavastrasamāvṛtam /
cakrāvatāraṃ śrīviṣṇordhyāyedarjunabhūpatim //
meaning:
दधतं स्वर्णमालाढ्यं रक्तवस्त्रसमावृतम् /
चक्रावतारं श्रीविष्णोर्ध्यायेदर्जुनभूपतिम् //
text_mt: adorned with a golden garland, draped in red garments, / an incarnation of the discus of Śrī Viṣṇu: one should meditate on King Arjuna.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ /
sataṇḍulaiḥ pāyasena viṣṇupīṭhe yajattutam //
meaning:
लक्षमेकं जपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः /
सतण्डुलैः पायसेन विष्णुपीठे यजत्तुतम् //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra a hundred thousand times, and offer a tenth part in homa with sesame seeds / mixed with unbroken rice, and with milk-rice. One should praise and worship him on the pīṭha of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni tato dikṣu vivikṣu ca /
cauramadavibhañjanaṃ mārīmadavibhañjanam //
meaning:
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि ततो दिक्षु विविक्षु च /
चौरमदविभञ्जनं मारीमदविभञ्जनम् //
text_mt: the six limbs in the six corners; then in the directions and intermediate directions: / 'Destroyer of the pride of thieves', 'Destroyer of the pride of pestilence',

sanskrit_iast:
arimadavibhañjanaṃ daityamadavibhañjanam /
duṣṭanāśaṃ duḥkhanāśaṃ duritāpadvināśakam //
meaning:
अरिमदविभञ्जनं दैत्यमदविभञ्जनम् /
दुष्टनाशं दुःखनाशं दुरितापद्विनाशकम् //
text_mt: 'Destroyer of the pride of enemies', 'Destroyer of the pride of demons', / 'Destroyer of the wicked', 'Destroyer of sorrow', and 'Remover of sins and misfortunes'.

sanskrit_iast:
dikṣvaṣṭaśaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ prācyādiṣvasitaprabhāḥ /
kṣemaṅkarī vaśyakarī śrīkarī ca yaśaskarī //
meaning:
दिक्ष्वष्टशक्तयः पूज्याः प्राच्यादिष्वसितप्रभाः /
क्षेमङ्करी वश्यकरी श्रीकरी च यशस्करी //
text_mt: In the directions, eight dark-colored powers are to be worshipped, beginning in the east: / Kṣemaṅkarī, Vaśyakarī, Śrīkarī, and Yaśaskarī,

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ karī tathā prajñākarī vidyākarī punaḥ /
dhanakaryaṣṭamī paścāllokeśā astrasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
आयुः करी तथा प्रज्ञाकरी विद्याकरी पुनः /
धनकर्यष्टमी पश्चाल्लोकेशा अस्त्रसंयुताः //
text_mt: Āyuḥkarī, likewise Prajñākarī, Vidyākarī, / and Dhanakarī as the eighth; thereafter the guardians of the directions equipped with weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ prayogārhaḥ prajāyate /
kārtavīryārjunasyātha pūjāyantramihocyate //
meaning:
एवं संसाधितो मन्त्रः प्रयोगार्हः प्रजायते /
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनस्याथ पूजायन्त्रमिहोच्यते //
text_mt: The mantra accomplished in this way becomes fit for ritual application. / Now the worship diagram of Kārtavīryārjuna is explained here:

sanskrit_iast:
svabījānaṅgadhruvavākkarṇikaṃ digdalaṃ likhet /
tārādivarmāntadalaṃ śeṣavarṇadalāntaram //
meaning:
स्वबीजानङ्गध्रुववाक्कर्णिकं दिग्दलं लिखेत् /
तारादिवर्मान्तदलं शेषवर्णदलान्तरम् //
text_mt: One should draw a ten-petalled lotus whose pericarp contains its own seed-syllable, the love-seed (klīm), the praṇava (oṃ), and the speech-seed (aiṃ); / petals beginning with the praṇava and ending with the armor (huṃ), with other petals containing the remaining syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣmāntyasvarakiñjalkaṃ śeṣārṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam /
koṇālaṅkṛtabhūtārṇabhūgṛhaṃ yantramīśituḥ //
meaning:
ऊष्मान्त्यस्वरकिञ्जल्कं शेषार्णैः परिवेष्टितम् /
कोणालङ्कृतभूतार्णभूगृहं यन्त्रमीशितुः //
text_mt: its filaments containing the sibilants and final vowels, encircled by the remaining syllables; / the lord's diagram is an earth-citadel whose corners are adorned with five-syllable [groups].

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhitvā yantramādarāt /
tatra kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatrāvāhyārcayennṛpam //
meaning:
शुद्धभूमावष्टगन्धैर्लिखित्वा यन्त्रमादरात् /
तत्र कुंभं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तत्रावाह्यार्चयेन्नृपम् //
text_mt: Having carefully inscribed the diagram with the eight perfumes on clean ground / and established a water pot there, one should invoke and worship the king in it.

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭvā kuṃbhaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ /
abhiṣiṃ cettadaṃbhobhiḥ priyaṃ sarveṣṭasiddhaye //
meaning:
स्पृष्ट्वा कुंभं जपेन्मन्त्रं सहस्रं विजितेन्द्रियः /
अभिषिं चेत्तदंभोभिः प्रियं सर्वेष्टसिद्धये //
text_mt: Touching the pot, one of conquered senses should recite the mantra a thousand times; / for the accomplishment of all desired aims, one should sprinkle a loved one with its waters.

sanskrit_iast:
putrānyaśo roganāśamāyuḥ svajanarañjanam /
vāksiddhiṃ sudṛśaḥ kumbhābhiṣikto labhate naraḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रान्यशो रोगनाशमायुः स्वजनरञ्जनम् /
वाक्सिद्धिं सुदृशः कुम्भाभिषिक्तो लभते नरः //
text_mt: Sprinkled from the pot, a man gains sons, fame, destruction of diseases, / longevity, delight of his kinsmen, perfection of speech, and fair-eyed women.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūpadrava āpanne grāme vā puṭabhedane /
saṃsthāpaṃyedidaṃ yantraṃ śatrubhītinivṛttaye //
meaning:
शत्रूपद्रव आपन्ने ग्रामे वा पुटभेदने /
संस्थापंयेदिदं यन्त्रं शत्रुभीतिनिवृत्तये //
text_mt: When affliction from enemies befalls a village or a commercial town, / one should install this diagram for the cessation of fear of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
sarṣapāriṣṭalaśunakārpāsairmāryate ripuḥ /
dhattūraiḥ stabhyate nimbairdveṣyate vaśyateṃ'bujaiḥ //
meaning:
सर्षपारिष्टलशुनकार्पासैर्मार्यते रिपुः /
धत्तूरैः स्तभ्यते निम्बैर्द्वेष्यते वश्यतेंऽबुजैः //
text_mt: An enemy is killed with mustard seeds, soapnuts, garlic, and cotton; / he is paralyzed with dhattūras, made hated with neem, and subjugated with lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
uñcāṭane vibhītasya samidbhiḥ khadirasya ca /
kaṭutailamahiṣyājyairhemadravyāñjanaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
उञ्चाटने विभीतस्य समिद्भिः खदिरस्य च /
कटुतैलमहिष्याज्यैर्हेमद्रव्याञ्जनं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: In eradication, [the oblation is] with kindling sticks of vibhītaka and khadira; / mustard oil, buffalo ghee, and golden ingredients are traditionally prescribed for the collyrium.

sanskrit_iast:
yavairhute śriyaḥ prāptistilairājyairaghakṣayaḥ /
tilataṇḍulasiddhārthajālairvaśyo nṛpo bhavet //
meaning:
यवैर्हुते श्रियः प्राप्तिस्तिलैराज्यैरघक्षयः /
तिलतण्डुलसिद्धार्थजालैर्वश्यो नृपो भवेत् //
text_mt: When barley is offered into the fire, fortune is obtained; with sesame seeds and ghee, destruction of sins [is attained]; / with mixtures of sesame seeds, rice grains, and white mustard seeds, a king becomes submissive.

sanskrit_iast:
apāmārgārkadūrvāṇāṃ homo lakṣmīprado 'ghanut /
strīvaśyakṛtpriyaṅgūṇāṃ murāṇāṃ bhūtaśāntidaḥ //
meaning:
अपामार्गार्कदूर्वाणां होमो लक्ष्मीप्रदो ऽघनुत् /
स्त्रीवश्यकृत्प्रियङ्गूणां मुराणां भूतशान्तिदः //
text_mt: A fire oblation of apāmārga, arka, and dūrvā grass bestows prosperity and removes sins; / [an oblation] of priyaṅgu brings women under control; of murā, it pacifies evil spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthoduṃbaraplakṣavaṭabilvasamudbhavāḥ /
samidho labhate hutvā putrānāyurddhanaṃ sukham //
meaning:
अश्वत्थोदुंबरप्लक्षवटबिल्वसमुद्भवाः /
समिधो लभते हुत्वा पुत्रानायुर्द्धनं सुखम् //
text_mt: By offering kindling sticks produced from aśvattha, uduṃbara, plakṣa, / vaṭa, and bilva, one obtains sons, long life, wealth, and happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmokahemasiddhārthalavaṇaiścauranāśanam /
rocanāgomayaistaṃbho bhūprāptiḥ śālibhirhutaiḥ //
meaning:
निर्मोकहेमसिद्धार्थलवणैश्चौरनाशनम् /
रोचनागोमयैस्तंभो भूप्राप्तिः शालिभिर्हुतैः //
text_mt: With snake-sloughs, gold, white mustard seeds, and salt, thieves are destroyed; / with rocanā and cow dung, paralysis [is caused]; with offered śāli rice, land is obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
homasaṃkhyā tu sarvatra sahasrādayutāvadhi /
prakalpanīyā mantrajñaiḥ kāryyagauravalāghavāt //
meaning:
होमसंख्या तु सर्वत्र सहस्रादयुतावधि /
प्रकल्पनीया मन्त्रज्ञैः कार्य्यगौरवलाघवात् //
text_mt: The count of fire oblations, however, is everywhere from a thousand up to ten thousand, / to be determined by knowers of mantras according to the weight or lightness of the objective.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtavīryyasya mantrāṇāmucyate lakṣaṇaṃ budhāḥ /
kārtavīryārjunaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ sarvamantreṣu yojayet //
meaning:
कार्तवीर्य्यस्य मन्त्राणामुच्यते लक्षणं बुधाः /
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनं ङेंतं सर्वमन्त्रेषु योजयेत् //
text_mt: O wise ones, the characteristics of the mantras of Kārtavīrya are declared: / one should join “kārtavīryārjuna” in the dative case to all the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
svabījādyo daśārṇo 'sau anye navaśivākṣarāḥ /
ādyabījadvayenāsau dvitīyo mantra īritaḥ //
meaning:
स्वबीजाद्यो दशार्णो ऽसौ अन्ये नवशिवाक्षराः /
आद्यबीजद्वयेनासौ द्वितीयो मन्त्र ईरितः //
text_mt: Beginning with its own seed-syllable, this is a ten-syllabled [mantra]; the others have nine or eleven syllables; / with two initial seed-syllables, the second mantra is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
svakāmābhyāṃ tṛtīyo 'sau svabhrūbhyāṃ tu caturthakaḥ /
svapāśābhyāṃ pañcamo 'sau ṣaṣṭaḥ svena ca māyayā //
meaning:
स्वकामाभ्यां तृतीयो ऽसौ स्वभ्रूभ्यां तु चतुर्थकः /
स्वपाशाभ्यां पञ्चमो ऽसौ षष्टः स्वेन च मायया //
text_mt: The third has its own [seed-syllable] and Kāma's; the fourth has its own and Bhrū's; / the fifth has its own and Pāśa's; the sixth has its own and Māyā's.

sanskrit_iast:
svāṅkuśābhyāṃ saptamaḥ syātsvaramābhyāmathāṣṭamaḥ /
svavāgbhavābhyāṃ navamo varmāstrābhyāmathāntimaḥ //
meaning:
स्वाङ्कुशाभ्यां सप्तमः स्यात्स्वरमाभ्यामथाष्टमः /
स्ववाग्भवाभ्यां नवमो वर्मास्त्राभ्यामथान्तिमः //
text_mt: The seventh has its own and Aṅkuśa's; then the eighth has its own and Ramā's; / the ninth has its own and Vāgbhava's; then the final one has armor and weapon [syllables].

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyādinavānteṣu bījayoḥ syādvyatikramaḥ /
mantre tu daśame varṇā navavarmāstramadhyagāḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयादिनवान्तेषु बीजयोः स्याद्व्यतिक्रमः /
मन्त्रे तु दशमे वर्णा नववर्मास्त्रमध्यगाः //
text_mt: In those from the second to the end of the ninth, there is an alternation of the two seed-syllables; / but in the tenth mantra, the nine syllables are placed between the armor and weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣu mantravaryeṣu svānukūlaṃ manuṃ bhajet /
eṣāmādye virāṭchado 'nyeṣu triṣṭubudāhṛtam //
meaning:
एतेषु मन्त्रवर्येषु स्वानुकूलं मनुं भजेत् /
एषामाद्ये विराट्छदो ऽन्येषु त्रिष्टुबुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Among these supreme mantras, one should resort to the mantra favorable to oneself; / for the first of these, the virāj metre is stated, and for the others the triṣṭubh is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa mantrā ime proktā yadā syuḥ praṇavādikāḥ /
tadādimaḥ śivārṇaḥ syādanye tu dvādaśākṣarāḥ //
meaning:
दश मन्त्रा इमे प्रोक्ता यदा स्युः प्रणवादिकाः /
तदादिमः शिवार्णः स्यादन्ये तु द्वादशाक्षराः //
text_mt: When these ten mantras declared are preceded by the praṇava, / then the first has eleven syllables, while the others have twelve syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣṭupūchandastathādye syādanyeṣu jagatī matā /
evaṃ viṃśatimantrāṇāṃ yajanaṃ pūrvavanmatama //
meaning:
त्रिष्टुपूछन्दस्तथाद्ये स्यादन्येषु जगती मता /
एवं विंशतिमन्त्राणां यजनं पूर्ववन्मतम //
text_mt: The triṣṭubh metre is thus for the first, and for the others the jagatī is accepted; / the worship of these twenty mantras is regarded as being like the previous one.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāḍhyamūlabījena kuryādeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam /
tāro hṛtkārtavīryārjunāya varmāstraṭhadvayam //
meaning:
दीर्घाढ्यमूलबीजेन कुर्यादेषां षडङ्गकम् /
तारो हृत्कार्तवीर्यार्जुनाय वर्मास्त्रठद्वयम् //
text_mt: With the root seed-syllable accompanied by long vowels, one should perform their six limbs: / the oṃkāra, the heart, “to Kārtavīryārjuna”, armor, weapon, and two phaṭs.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśārṇo mantro 'yamasyejyā pūrvavanmatā /
bhūnetrasamanetrākṣivarṇerasyāṅgapañcakam //
meaning:
चतुर्दशार्णो मन्त्रो ऽयमस्येज्या पूर्ववन्मता /
भूनेत्रसमनेत्राक्षिवर्णेरस्याङ्गपञ्चकम् //
text_mt: This is a fourteen-syllabled mantra; its worship is regarded as being like the previous one; / its five limbs are formed with one, two, two, two, and two syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃtaḥ kārtavīryārjunastathā /
varmāstrāgnipriyāmantraḥ prokto hyaṣṭādaśārṇakaḥ //
meaning:
तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतः कार्तवीर्यार्जुनस्तथा /
वर्मास्त्राग्निप्रियामन्त्रः प्रोक्तो ह्यष्टादशार्णकः //
text_mt: The oṃkāra, the heart, bhagavat in the dative case, likewise Kārtavīryārjuna, / armor, weapon, and Agni's beloved: this is declared as an eighteen-syllabled mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
trivedasaptayugmākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakaṃ manoḥ /
namo bhagavate śrīti kārtavīryārjunāya ca //
meaning:
त्रिवेदसप्तयुग्माक्षिवर्णैः पञ्चाङ्गकं मनोः /
नमो भगवते श्रीति कार्तवीर्यार्जुनाय च //
text_mt: The five limbs of the mantra are with three, four, seven, two, and two syllables; / “Salutation to the Lord, fortune”, and “to Kārtavīryārjuna”;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti tapobalaparākramaḥ /
paripālitasaptānte dvīpāya sarvarāpadam //
meaning:
सर्वदुष्टान्तकायेति तपोबलपराक्रमः /
परिपालितसप्तान्ते द्वीपाय सर्वरापदम् //
text_mt: “to the destroyer of all wicked ones”, “whose valor is the power of asceticism”, / “to the protector of the seven continents”, “to all… danger”;

sanskrit_iast:
janyacūḍā maṇānte ye mahāśaktimate tataḥ /
sahasradahanaprānte varmāstrānto mahāmanuḥ //
meaning:
जन्यचूडा मणान्ते ये महाशक्तिमते ततः /
सहस्रदहनप्रान्ते वर्मास्त्रान्तो महामनुः //
text_mt: … “to the possessor of great power”, / ending with “thousand fires”, and ending with the armor and weapon is the great mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣaṣṭivarṇavānproktaḥ smaramātsarvavighnahṛt /
rājanyakravartī ca vīraḥ śūrastṛtīyakaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिषष्टिवर्णवान्प्रोक्तः स्मरमात्सर्वविघ्नहृत् /
राजन्यक्रवर्ती च वीरः शूरस्तृतीयकः //
text_mt: It is declared to have sixty-three syllables; merely by being remembered, it removes all obstacles; / “emperor among kings”, “hero”, “valiant” as the third;

sanskrit_iast:
māhiṣmatīpatiḥ paścāñcaturthaḥ samudīritaḥ /
revāṃbuparitṛptaśca kāṇo hastaprabādhitaḥ //
meaning:
माहिष्मतीपतिः पश्चाञ्चतुर्थः समुदीरितः /
रेवांबुपरितृप्तश्च काणो हस्तप्रबाधितः //
text_mt: “lord of Māhiṣmatī” is proclaimed next as the fourth; / “delighted by the waters of the Revā”, “having impaired arms…”;

sanskrit_iast:
daśāsyeti ca ṣaḍbhiḥ syātpadairṅetaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam /
siṃcyamānaṃ yuvatibhiḥ krīḍantaṃ narmadājale //
meaning:
दशास्येति च षड्भिः स्यात्पदैर्ङेतैः षडङ्गकम् /
सिंच्यमानं युवतिभिः क्रीडन्तं नर्मदाजले //
text_mt: and “Ten-faced [Rāvaṇa]”: with these six words in the dative case, the six limbs are formed; / [meditating on him as] being sprinkled by young women while sporting in the waters of the Narmadā,

sanskrit_iast:
hastairjalaudhaṃ rundhantaṃ dhyāyenmattaṃ nṛpottamam /
evaṃ dhyātvāyutaṃ mantraṃ pajedanyattu pūrvavat //
meaning:
हस्तैर्जलौधं रुन्धन्तं ध्यायेन्मत्तं नृपोत्तमम् /
एवं ध्यात्वायुतं मन्त्रं पजेदन्यत्तु पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: blocking the surge of waters with his arms, one should meditate on that best of intoxicated kings; / having meditated thus, one should recite the mantra ten thousand times, and the rest is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ tu prajapellakṣaṃ pūjāyogaśca pūrvavat /
kārtavīryārjuno nāma rājā bāhusahasravān //
meaning:
पूर्वं तु प्रजपेल्लक्षं पूजायोगश्च पूर्ववत् /
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम राजा बाहुसहस्रवान् //
text_mt: First, however, one should recite it one hundred thousand times, and the procedure of worship is as before; / “There was a king named Kārtavīryārjuna, possessed of a thousand arms:

sanskrit_iast:
tasya saṃsmaraṇādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca saṃvadet /
labhyate mantravaryo 'yaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य संस्मरणादेव हृतं नष्टं च संवदेत् /
लभ्यते मन्त्रवर्यो ऽयं द्वात्रिंशद्वर्णसंयुतः //
text_mt: merely by remembering him, what is stolen and lost is recovered.” / This supreme mantra is obtained consisting of thirty-two syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat /
kārtavīryāya śabdānte vidmahe padamuñcaret //
meaning:
पादैः सर्वेण पञ्चाङ्गं ध्यानपूजादि पूर्ववत् /
कार्तवीर्याय शब्दान्ते विद्महे पदमुञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: The five limbs are with its quarters and the whole; meditation, worship, and the rest are as before; / after the words “to Kārtavīrya”, one should utter the word “vidmahe”;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvīryāya varṇānte dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet /
tannor'junaḥ pravarṇānte codayātpadamīrayet //
meaning:
महावीर्याय वर्णान्ते धीमहीति पदं वदेत् /
तन्नोर्ऽजुनः प्रवर्णान्ते चोदयात्पदमीरयेत् //
text_mt: after the syllables “to the one of great valor”, one should utter the word “dhīmahi”; / after the syllables “may that Arjuna”, one should utter the word “pracodayāt”.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryeṣārjuna syoktā prayogādau japettu tām /
anuṣṭubhaṃ manuṃ rātrau japatāṃ caurasaṃcayāḥ //
meaning:
गायत्र्येषार्जुन स्योक्ता प्रयोगादौ जपेत्तु ताम् /
अनुष्टुभं मनुं रात्रौ जपतां चौरसंचयाः //
text_mt: This is declared as the gāyatrī of Arjuna; one should recite it at the beginning of any ritual application; / for those who recite this anuṣṭubh mantra at night, hordes of thieves

sanskrit_iast:
palāyante gṛhāddūraṃ tarpaṇāddhravanādapi /
atho dīpavidhiṃ vakṣye kārtavīryapriyaṅkaram //
meaning:
पलायन्ते गृहाद्दूरं तर्पणाद्ध्रवनादपि /
अथो दीपविधिं वक्ष्ये कार्तवीर्यप्रियङ्करम् //
text_mt: flee far from the house, as also through offering libation and reciting; / now I shall declare the ritual of the lamp, which is pleasing to Kārtavīrya.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe mārge kārtikāśvinapauṣataḥ /
māghaphālgunayormāsordīpāraṃbhaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
वैशाखे श्रावणे मार्गे कार्तिकाश्विनपौषतः /
माघफाल्गुनयोर्मासोर्दीपारंभं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, Śrāvaṇa, Mārgaśīrṣa, Kārtika, Āśvina, Pauṣa, / Māgha, and Phālguna, one should undertake the commencement of the lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
tithau riktāvihīnāyāṃ vāre śanikujau vinā /
hastottarāśviraudreyapuṣyavaiṣṇavavāyubhe //
meaning:
तिथौ रिक्ताविहीनायां वारे शनिकुजौ विना /
हस्तोत्तराश्विरौद्रेयपुष्यवैष्णववायुभे //
text_mt: On a lunar day other than a riktā day, on a weekday except Saturday and Tuesday, / under the asterisms Hastā, Uttarā, Aśvinī, Ārdrā, Puṣya, Śravaṇā, and Svātī,

sanskrit_iast:
dvidaivate ca rohiṇyāṃ dīpāraṃbho hitāvahaḥ /
carame ca vyatīpāte dhṛtau vṛddhau sukarmaṇi //
meaning:
द्विदैवते च रोहिण्यां दीपारंभो हितावहः /
चरमे च व्यतीपाते धृतौ वृद्धौ सुकर्मणि //
text_mt: and under Viśākhā and Rohiṇī, the commencement of the lamp brings welfare; / in the final [caraṇa], on Vyatīpāta, Dhṛti, Vṛddhi, Sukarman,

sanskrit_iast:
prītau harṣaṃ ca saubhāgye śobhanāyuṣmatorapi /
karaṇe viṣṭirahite grahaṇe 'rddhodayādiṣu //
meaning:
प्रीतौ हर्षं च सौभाग्ये शोभनायुष्मतोरपि /
करणे विष्टिरहिते ग्रहणे ऽर्द्धोदयादिषु //
text_mt: Prīti, Harṣaṇa, Saubhāgya, Śobhana, and Āyuṣmat; / during an astrological division devoid of Viṣṭi, during an eclipse, at Ardhodaya, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
yogeṣu rātrau pūrvāhne dīpāraṃbhaghaḥ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ /
kārtike śuklasaptamyāṃ niśīthe 'tīva śobhanaḥ //
meaning:
योगेषु रात्रौ पूर्वाह्ने दीपारंभघः कृतः शुभः /
कार्तिके शुक्लसप्तम्यां निशीथे ऽतीव शोभनः //
text_mt: under these conjunctions, at night or in the forenoon, the undertaken commencement of the lamp is auspicious; / on the seventh day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, at midnight, it is exceedingly auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tatra ravervāraḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaṃ ca durlabham /
atyāvaśyakakāryeṣu māsādīnāṃ na śodhanam //
meaning:
यदि तत्र रवेर्वारः श्रवणं भं च दुर्लभम् /
अत्यावश्यककार्येषु मासादीनां न शोधनम् //
text_mt: If it is a Sunday then and the asterism is Śravaṇā, it is rare [and most auspicious]; / in matters of extreme urgency, there is no examination of months and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye hyupoṣya niyato brahmacārī sapītakaiḥ /
prātaḥ snātvā śuddhabhūmau liptāyāṃ gomayodakaiḥ //
meaning:
आद्ये ह्युपोष्य नियतो ब्रह्मचारी सपीतकैः /
प्रातः स्नात्वा शुद्धभूमौ लिप्तायां गोमयोदकैः //
text_mt: Having fasted on the first day, self-restrained, celibate, wearing yellow garments, / having bathed in the morning, on clean ground smeared with cow dung and water,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānāyamya saṃkalpya nyāsānpūrvoditāṃścaret /
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ racayedbhūmau raktacandanataṇḍulaiḥ //
meaning:
प्राणानायम्य संकल्प्य न्यासान्पूर्वोदितांश्चरेत् /
षट्कोणं रचयेद्भूमौ रक्तचन्दनतण्डुलैः //
text_mt: having controlled the breath and made the solemn resolve, one should perform the previously mentioned ritual placements; / one should fashion a hexagon on the ground with red sandalwood and rice grains.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ smaraṃ samālikhya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu samālikhet /
navārṇairveṣṭayettañca trikoṇaṃ tadbahiḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अतः स्मरं समालिख्य षट्कोणेषु समालिखेत् /
नवार्णैर्वेष्टयेत्तञ्च त्रिकोणं तद्बहिः पुनः //
text_mt: Then, having inscribed the Kāma seed-syllable, one should inscribe [syllables] in the six angles; / and one should enclose that with nine syllables, and outside that, again a triangle.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vilikhite yantre nidadhyāddīpabhājanam /
svarṇajaṃ rajatotthaṃ vā tāmrajaṃ tadabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
एवं विलिखिते यन्त्रे निदध्याद्दीपभाजनम् /
स्वर्णजं रजतोत्थं वा ताम्रजं तदभावतः //
text_mt: When the diagram is thus drawn, one should place the vessel for the lamp, / made of gold or made of silver, or in their absence, made of copper,

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyapātraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ lohajaṃ mṛtau /
śāntaye mudgacūrṇotthaṃ saṃdhau godhūmacūrṇajam //
meaning:
कांस्यपात्रं मृण्मयं च कनिष्ठं लोहजं मृतौ /
शान्तये मुद्गचूर्णोत्थं संधौ गोधूमचूर्णजम् //
text_mt: or a vessel of bronze; an earthen one is inferior; an iron one is for death; / for pacification, one made of mudga flour; for reconciliation, one made of wheat flour.

sanskrit_iast:
ājye palasahasre tu pātraṃ śatapalaṃ smṛtam /
ājye 'yutapale pātraṃ palapañcaśatā smṛtam //
meaning:
आज्ये पलसहस्रे तु पात्रं शतपलं स्मृतम् /
आज्ये ऽयुतपले पात्रं पलपञ्चशता स्मृतम् //
text_mt: For a thousand palas of ghee, the vessel is taught to be one hundred palas; / for ten thousand palas of ghee, the vessel is taught to be five hundred palas.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcasaptatisaṃkhye tu pātraṃ ṣaṣṭipalaṃ smṛtam /
trisāhasrī ghṛtapale śarkarāpalabhājanam //
meaning:
पञ्चसप्ततिसंख्ये तु पात्रं षष्टिपलं स्मृतम् /
त्रिसाहस्री घृतपले शर्करापलभाजनम् //
text_mt: For the quantity of seventy-five, the vessel is taught to be sixty palas; / for three thousand palas of ghee, a vessel of one hundred and twenty palas [is required].

sanskrit_iast:
dvisāhakhtryāṃ dviśatamitaṃ ca bhājanamiṣyate /
śate 'kṣicarasaṃśyātamevamanyatra kalpayet //
meaning:
द्विसाहख्त्र्यां द्विशतमितं च भाजनमिष्यते /
शते ऽक्षिचरसंश्यातमेवमन्यत्र कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: For two thousand [palas], a vessel measuring two hundred [palas] is desired; / for a hundred, sixty palas is reckoned; thus one should determine in other cases.

sanskrit_iast:
nityadīpe vahnipalaṃ pātramājyaṃ palaṃ smṛtam /
evaṃ pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vartīḥ sūtrotthitāḥ kṣipet //
meaning:
नित्यदीपे वह्निपलं पात्रमाज्यं पलं स्मृतम् /
एवं पात्रं प्रतिष्ठाप्य वर्तीः सूत्रोत्थिताः क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: For a daily lamp, the vessel is taught to be three palas and the ghee one pala; / having thus established the vessel, one should place wicks made of thread:

sanskrit_iast:
ekā tisro 'thavā pañcasaptādyā viṣamā api /
tithimānādāsahasraṃ tantusaṃkhyā vinirmitā //
meaning:
एका तिस्रो ऽथवा पञ्चसप्ताद्या विषमा अपि /
तिथिमानादासहस्रं तन्तुसंख्या विनिर्मिता //
text_mt: one, three, or five, seven, and so on, an odd number; / the number of threads fashioned is according to the measure of lunar days up to a thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
goghṛtaṃ prakṣipettatra śuddhavastraviśodhitam /
sahasrapalasaṃkhyādidaśāṃśaṃ kāryagauravāt //
meaning:
गोघृतं प्रक्षिपेत्तत्र शुद्धवस्त्रविशोधितम् /
सहस्रपलसंख्यादिदशांशं कार्यगौरवात् //
text_mt: One should pour cow ghee into it, strained through clean cloth, / beginning with the amount of a thousand palas or a tenth part thereof, according to the weight of the objective.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇādikṛtāṃ ramyāṃ śalākāṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulām /
tadarddhāṃ vā tadarddhāṃ vā sūkṣmāgrāṃ sthūlamūlikām //
meaning:
सुवर्णादिकृतां रम्यां शलाकां षोडशाङ्गुलाम् /
तदर्द्धां वा तदर्द्धां वा सूक्ष्माग्रां स्थूलमूलिकाम् //
text_mt: A beautiful needle made of gold or other [metals], sixteen finger-breadths [long], / or half of that, or half of that, with a fine tip and a thick base,

sanskrit_iast:
vimuñceddakṣiṇe pātramadhye cāgre kṛtāgrikām /
pātradakṣiṇadigdeśe muktvāṃ gulacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
विमुञ्चेद्दक्षिणे पात्रमध्ये चाग्रे कृताग्रिकाम् /
पात्रदक्षिणदिग्देशे मुक्त्वां गुलचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: he should release in the right part, into the middle of the vessel, with its tip prepared in front. / Leaving four finger-breadths in the southern region of the vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
adhogrāṃ dakṣiṇādhārāṃ nikhanecchurikāṃ śubhām /
dīpaṃ prajvālayettatra gaṇeśasmṛtipūrvakam //
meaning:
अधोग्रां दक्षिणाधारां निखनेच्छुरिकां शुभाम् /
दीपं प्रज्वालयेत्तत्र गणेशस्मृतिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: he should dig an auspicious knife with its tip pointing downward and its edge to the right. / There he should ignite the lamp, preceded by the remembrance of Gaṇeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpātpūrvatra digbhāge sarvatobhadramaṇḍale /
taṇḍulāṣṭadale vāpi vidhivatsthāpayeddhūṭam //
meaning:
दीपात्पूर्वत्र दिग्भागे सर्वतोभद्रमण्डले /
तण्डुलाष्टदले वापि विधिवत्स्थापयेद्धूटम् //
text_mt: To the east of the lamp, upon a sarvatobhadra diagram / or on an eight-petaled [diagram] of rice grains, he should duly install a water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāvāhya nṛpādhīśaṃ pūjayetpūrvavatsudhīḥ /
jalākṣatānsamādāya dīpaṃ saṃkalpayettataḥ //
meaning:
तत्रावाह्य नृपाधीशं पूजयेत्पूर्ववत्सुधीः /
जलाक्षतान्समादाय दीपं संकल्पयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Invoking the king of kings there, the wise man should worship him as before; / then, taking water and unbroken rice grains, he should dedicate the lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpasaṃkalpamantro 'yaṃ kathyate dvīṣubhūmitaḥ /
praṇavaḥ pāśamāye ca śikhā kārtākṣarāṇi ca //
meaning:
दीपसंकल्पमन्त्रो ऽयं कथ्यते द्वीषुभूमितः /
प्रणवः पाशमाये च शिखा कार्ताक्षराणि च //
text_mt: This lamp-dedication mantra is stated, [numbering] one hundred and fifty-two [syllables]: / The Praṇava, pāśa, and māyā, [the words] śikhā, kārtākṣara,

sanskrit_iast:
vīryārjunāya māhiṣmatīnāthāya sahasra ca /
bāhave iti varṇānte sahasrapadamuccaret //
meaning:
वीर्यार्जुनाय माहिष्मतीनाथाय सहस्र च /
बाहवे इति वर्णान्ते सहस्रपदमुच्चरेत् //
text_mt: vīryārjunāya, māhiṣmatīnāthāya, sahasra-, / and bāhave; after the word [bāhave], one should utter the word sahasra,

sanskrit_iast:
kratudīkṣitahastāya dattātreyapriyāya ca /
ātreyāyānusūyānte garbharatnāya tatparam //
meaning:
क्रतुदीक्षितहस्ताय दत्तात्रेयप्रियाय च /
आत्रेयायानुसूयान्ते गर्भरत्नाय तत्परम् //
text_mt: kratudīkṣitahastāya, dattātreyapriyāya ca, / ātreyāya, followed by anasūyā-, and then garbharatnāya;

sanskrit_iast:
namo grīvāmakarṇendusthitau pāśa imaṃ tataḥ /
dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa amukaṃ rakṣa rakṣa padaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ग्रीवामकर्णेन्दुस्थितौ पाश इमं ततः /
दीपं गृहाण अमुकं रक्ष रक्ष पदं पुनः //
text_mt: then namo, [the syllables of] grīvā, ma, karṇa, indu, and the pāśa; then the words: / imaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa, amukaṃ rakṣa rakṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭānnāśayayugmaṃ syāttathā pātaya ghātaya /
śatrūn jahidvayaṃ māyā tāraḥ svaṃ bījamātmabhūḥ //
meaning:
दुष्टान्नाशययुग्मं स्यात्तथा पातय घातय /
शत्रून् जहिद्वयं माया तारः स्वं बीजमात्मभूः //
text_mt: duṣṭānnāśaya twice, and likewise pātaya ghātaya, / śatrūñjahi twice, māyā, the tāra, one's own bīja, the ātmabhū,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnīpriyā anenātha dīpavaryeṇa paścimā /
bhimukhenāmukaṃ rakṣa amukānte varaprada //
meaning:
वह्नीप्रिया अनेनाथ दीपवर्येण पश्चिमा /
भिमुखेनामुकं रक्ष अमुकान्ते वरप्रद //
text_mt: and vahneḥ priyā [svāhā]. Then by this foremost of lamps / facing west: “amukaṃ rakṣa,” followed by “amuka,” “varaprada”;

sanskrit_iast:
māyākāśadvayaṃ vāmanetracandrayutaṃ śivā /
vedādikāmacāmuṇḍāḥ svāhā tu pūsabindukau //
meaning:
मायाकाशद्वयं वामनेत्रचन्द्रयुतं शिवा /
वेदादिकामचामुण्डाः स्वाहा तु पूसबिन्दुकौ //
text_mt: the māyā, two ākāśas with the left eye and moon, śivā, / the beginning of the Veda [oṃ], kāma, cāmuṇḍā, svāhā, then pū, sa, with bindu,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo 'gnipriyā mantro netrabāṇādharākṣaraḥ /
dattātreyo munirmālāmantrasya parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवो ऽग्निप्रिया मन्त्रो नेत्रबाणाधराक्षरः /
दत्तात्रेयो मुनिर्मालामन्त्रस्य परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: the Praṇava, and the fire's beloved [svāhā]. This mantra has one hundred and fifty-two syllables. / Dattātreya is proclaimed as the seer of this garland-mantra;

sanskrit_iast:
chando 'mitaṃ kārtavīryurjuno devo 'khilāptikṛt /
cāmuṇḍayā ṣaḍaṅgāni caretṣaḍdīrghayuktayā //
meaning:
छन्दो ऽमितं कार्तवीर्युर्जुनो देवो ऽखिलाप्तिकृत् /
चामुण्डया षडङ्गानि चरेत्षड्दीर्घयुक्तया //
text_mt: the metre is Amita; the deity is Kārtavīryārjuna, who grants all desires. / With Cāmuṇḍā joined with the six long [vowels], one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā devaṃ tato mantraṃ paṭhitvānte kṣipejjajalam /
govindāḍhyo halī seṃduścāmuṇḍābījamīritam //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा देवं ततो मन्त्रं पठित्वान्ते क्षिपेज्जजलम् /
गोविन्दाढ्यो हली सेंदुश्चामुण्डाबीजमीरितम् //
text_mt: Then, having meditated on the deity and recited the mantra, at the end he should pour water. / The plough-bearer [h] endowed with Govinda [i], together with the moon [m], is pronounced the bīja of Cāmuṇḍā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato navākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sahasraṃ tatpuro japet /
tāro 'nanto binduyukto māyāsvaṃ vāmanetrayuk //
meaning:
ततो नवाक्षरं मन्त्रं सहस्रं तत्पुरो जपेत् /
तारो ऽनन्तो बिन्दुयुक्तो मायास्वं वामनेत्रयुक् //
text_mt: Then he should recite the nine-syllable mantra one thousand times in front of it: / The tāra [oṃ], Ananta [ā], endowed with a bindu, māyā [hrīṃ], one's own [bīja] with the left eye [ī],

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmāgnī śāntibindvāḍhyau vahni jāyāṅkuśaṃ dhruvam /
ṛṣiḥ pūrvoditonuṣṭupchando 'nyatpūrvavatpunaḥ //
meaning:
कूर्माग्नी शान्तिबिन्द्वाढ्यौ वह्नि जायाङ्कुशं ध्रुवम् /
ऋषिः पूर्वोदितोनुष्टुप्छन्दो ऽन्यत्पूर्ववत्पुनः //
text_mt: Kūrma and fire endowed with peace and a bindu, the wife of fire [svāhā], the goad [kroṃ], and dhruva [oṃ]. / The seer is stated as before, the metre is Anuṣṭubh, and the rest is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ mantrarājaṃ ca japitvā kavacaṃ paṭhet /
evaṃ dīpapradānasya kartāpnotyakhile 'psitam //
meaning:
सहस्रं मन्त्रराजं च जपित्वा कवचं पठेत् /
एवं दीपप्रदानस्य कर्ताप्नोत्यखिले ऽप्सितम् //
text_mt: Having recited the king of mantras a thousand times, he should read the protective armour. / Thus the performer of the lamp offering attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaprabodhakāle tu varjayedaśubhāṃ giram /
viprasya darśanaṃ tatra śubhadaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
दीपप्रबोधकाले तु वर्जयेदशुभां गिरम् /
विप्रस्य दर्शनं तत्र शुभदं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: At the time of kindling the lamp, he should avoid inauspicious speech. / The sight of a brāhmaṇa at that time is proclaimed to be auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ pradhyamaṃ proktaṃ mlecchasya vadhabandhanam /
ākhvotvordarśanaṃ duṣṭaṃ gavāśvasya sukhāvaham //
meaning:
शूद्राणां प्रध्यमं प्रोक्तं म्लेच्छस्य वधबन्धनम् /
आख्वोत्वोर्दर्शनं दुष्टं गवाश्वस्य सुखावहम् //
text_mt: that of Śūdras is said to be middling; of a barbarian, killing and imprisonment; / the sight of a rat or cat is evil, while that of cows and horses brings happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpajvālā samā siddhyai vakrā niśavidhāyinī /
śabdā bhayadā karturujjvalā sukhadā matā //
meaning:
दीपज्वाला समा सिद्ध्यै वक्रा निशविधायिनी /
शब्दा भयदा कर्तुरुज्ज्वला सुखदा मता //
text_mt: A straight lamp flame brings accomplishment; a crooked one produces night [loss of light]; / a crackling flame brings fear to the performer; a radiant one is held to bring happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇā śatrubhayotpattye vamantī paśunāśinī /
kṛte dīpe yadā pātraṃ bhagnaṃ dṛśyate daivataḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णा शत्रुभयोत्पत्त्ये वमन्ती पशुनाशिनी /
कृते दीपे यदा पात्रं भग्नं दृश्यते दैवतः //
text_mt: A black flame causes fear of enemies; a spitting flame destroys cattle. / If, when the lamp is lit, the vessel is seen to break by fate,

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣādarvāktadā gacchedyajamāno yamālayam /
vartyataraṃ yadā kuryātkāryaṃ siddhyedvilaṃbataḥ //
meaning:
पक्षादर्वाक्तदा गच्छेद्यजमानो यमालयम् /
वर्त्यतरं यदा कुर्यात्कार्यं सिद्ध्येद्विलंबतः //
text_mt: then within a fortnight the patron goes to the abode of Yama. / If he changes the wick, the goal will be accomplished with delay.

sanskrit_iast:
netrahīno bhavetkartā tasmindīpāntare kṛte /
aśucisparśane vyādhirdīpanāśe tu caurabhīḥ //
meaning:
नेत्रहीनो भवेत्कर्ता तस्मिन्दीपान्तरे कृते /
अशुचिस्पर्शने व्याधिर्दीपनाशे तु चौरभीः //
text_mt: The performer becomes blind if another lamp is lit from that one; / on touching an impure object, disease occurs; but on the destruction of the lamp, fear of thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
śvamārjārākhusaṃsparśe bhavedbhūpatito bhayam /
pātrāraṃbhe vasupalaiḥ kṛto dīpo 'khileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
श्वमार्जाराखुसंस्पर्शे भवेद्भूपतितो भयम् /
पात्रारंभे वसुपलैः कृतो दीपो ऽखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: If touched by a dog, a cat, or a rat, fear arises from the king. / When starting the vessel, a lamp made with eight palas bestows all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddīpaḥ prayatnena rakṣaṇīyoṃ'tarāyataḥ /
āsamāpteḥ prakurvīta brahmacaryaṃ ca bhūśayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्दीपः प्रयत्नेन रक्षणीयोंऽतरायतः /
आसमाप्तेः प्रकुर्वीत ब्रह्मचर्यं च भूशयः //
text_mt: Therefore, the lamp should be protected with effort against obstacles. / Until completion, he should observe celibacy and sleep on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdrapatitādīnāṃ saṃbhāṣāmapi varjayet /
japetsahasraṃ pratyekaṃ mantrarājaṃ navākṣaram //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्रपतितादीनां संभाषामपि वर्जयेत् /
जपेत्सहस्रं प्रत्येकं मन्त्रराजं नवाक्षरम् //
text_mt: He should avoid even conversation with women, Śūdras, outcasts, and others. / He should recite each, the king of mantras and the nine-syllable one, a thousand times,

sanskrit_iast:
stotrapāṭhaṃ pratidinaṃ niśīthinyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
ekapādena dīpāgre sthitvā yo mantranāyakam //
meaning:
स्तोत्रपाठं प्रतिदिनं निशीथिन्यां विशेषतः /
एकपादेन दीपाग्रे स्थित्वा यो मन्त्रनायकम् //
text_mt: and recite the hymn every day, especially in the dead of night. / Standing on one foot in front of the lamp, whoever [recites] the sovereign mantra

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ prajapedvātrau so 'bhīṣṭaṃ kṣipramāpnuyāt /
samāpya śobhanadine saṃbhojya dvijasattamān //
meaning:
सहस्रं प्रजपेद्वात्रौ सो ऽभीष्टं क्षिप्रमाप्नुयात् /
समाप्य शोभनदिने संभोज्य द्विजसत्तमान् //
text_mt: a thousand times at night, quickly attains his desired object. / Having completed it on an auspicious day and fed the best of twice-borns,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhodakena kartāramabhiṣiñcanmanuṃ japet /
kartā tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātpuṣkalāṃ toṣahetave //
meaning:
कुंभोदकेन कर्तारमभिषिञ्चन्मनुं जपेत् /
कर्ता तु दक्षिणां दद्यात्पुष्कलां तोषहेतवे //
text_mt: consecrating the performer with water from the pitcher, [the preceptor] should recite the mantra. / The performer should give a plentiful sacrificial fee for the sake of [the guru's] satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
gurau tuṣṭe dadātīṣṭaṃ kṛtavīryasuto nṛpaḥ /
gurvājñayā svayaṃ kuryādyadi vā kāraye dguruḥ //
meaning:
गुरौ तुष्टे ददातीष्टं कृतवीर्यसुतो नृपः /
गुर्वाज्ञया स्वयं कुर्याद्यदि वा कारये द्गुरुः //
text_mt: When the guru is pleased, King Kārtavīrya, the son of Kṛtavīrya, grants the desired wish. / He should perform it himself by the guru's command, or the guru should have it done.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dhanādikaṃ tasmai dīpadānāya nārada /
gurvājñāmantarā kuryādyo dīpaṃ sveṣṭasiddhaye //
meaning:
दत्त्वा धनादिकं तस्मै दीपदानाय नारद /
गुर्वाज्ञामन्तरा कुर्याद्यो दीपं स्वेष्टसिद्धये //
text_mt: Giving wealth and the like to him for the offering of the lamp, O Nārada; / whoever offers the lamp without the guru's command to achieve his own desired end,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhirna jāyate tasya hānireva pade pade /
uttamaṃ goghṛtaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ mahaṣībhavam //
meaning:
सिद्धिर्न जायते तस्य हानिरेव पदे पदे /
उत्तमं गोघृतं प्रोक्तं मध्यमं महषीभवम् //
text_mt: no success arises for him, but only loss at every step. / Cow's ghee is declared best, that from a buffalo is middling,

sanskrit_iast:
tilatailaṃ tu tādṛk syātkanīyo 'jādijaṃ ghṛtam /
āsyaroge sugandhena dadyāttailena dīpakam //
meaning:
तिलतैलं तु तादृक् स्यात्कनीयो ऽजादिजं घृतम् /
आस्यरोगे सुगन्धेन दद्यात्तैलेन दीपकम् //
text_mt: sesame oil is considered similar, and ghee from goats and others is inferior. / For diseases of the mouth, he should offer a lamp with fragrant oil;

sanskrit_iast:
siddhvārthasaṃbhavenātha dviṣatāṃ nāśanāya ca /
sahasreṇa palairdīpe vihite ca na dṛśyate //
meaning:
सिद्ध्वार्थसंभवेनाथ द्विषतां नाशनाय च /
सहस्रेण पलैर्दीपे विहिते च न दृश्यते //
text_mt: with mustard oil, for the destruction of enemies. / And if, when the lamp is offered with a thousand palas, there is no seen

sanskrit_iast:
kāryasiddhastadā kuryātrrivāraṃ dīpajaṃ vidhim /
tadā sudurlabhamapi kāryyaṃ siddhvyenna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
कार्यसिद्धस्तदा कुर्यात्र्रिवारं दीपजं विधिम् /
तदा सुदुर्लभमपि कार्य्यं सिद्ध्व्येन्न संशयः //
text_mt: accomplishment of the purpose, then he should perform the lamp rite three times. / Then even an extremely rare goal will be accomplished; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpapriyaḥ kārtavīryo mārtaṇḍo nativallabhaḥ /
stutiproyo mahāviṣṇurgaṇeśa staparṇapriyaḥ //
meaning:
दीपप्रियः कार्तवीर्यो मार्तण्डो नतिवल्लभः /
स्तुतिप्रोयो महाविष्णुर्गणेश स्तपर्णप्रियः //
text_mt: Kārtavīrya is fond of lamps; the Sun is fond of prostrations; / Mahāviṣṇu is fond of praise; Gaṇeśa is fond of sweet-scented leaves;

sanskrit_iast:
durgārcanapriyā nūnamabhiṣekapriyaḥ śivaḥ /
tasmātteṣāṃ pratoṣāya vidadhyāttattadādarāt //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde kārtavīryamāhātmyamantradīpakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
दुर्गार्चनप्रिया नूनमभिषेकप्रियः शिवः /
तस्मात्तेषां प्रतोषाय विदध्यात्तत्तदादरात् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे कार्तवीर्यमाहात्म्यमन्त्रदीपकथनं नाम षट्सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Durgā is surely fond of worship; Śiva is fond of ritual bathing. / Therefore, for their satisfaction, one should perform each respective [service] with devotion.

Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter, named 'The Discourse on the Greatness, Mantras, and Lamp Rite of Kārtavīrya,' in the Third Quarter of the Great Narrative in the Pūrvabhāga of the auspicious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña sarva tantraviśārada /
tvayā mahyaṃ samākhyātaṃ vidhānaṃ tantragopitam //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ सर्व तन्त्रविशारद /
त्वया मह्यं समाख्यातं विधानं तन्त्रगोपितम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / Excellent, excellent, O greatly wise one, learned in all Tantras! / You have explained to me the ritual concealed in the Tantras.

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā tu mahābhāga kīrtavīryahanūmatoḥ /
kavace śrotumicchāmi tadvadasvakṛpānidhe //
meaning:
अधुना तु महाभाग कीर्तवीर्यहनूमतोः /
कवचे श्रोतुमिच्छामि तद्वदस्वकृपानिधे //
text_mt: Now, O illustrious one, I wish to hear the protective armour / of Kārtavīrya and Hanumān; tell that, O ocean of compassion!

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu viprendra vakṣyāmi kavacaṃ paramādbhutam /
kārtavīryasya yenāsau prasannaḥ kāryasiddhikṛt //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु विप्रेन्द्र वक्ष्यामि कवचं परमाद्भुतम् /
कार्तवीर्यस्य येनासौ प्रसन्नः कार्यसिद्धिकृत् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O foremost among brāhmaṇas, I shall tell the most wonderful armour / of Kārtavīrya, by which he, becoming pleased, accomplishes desired ends.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrādityasaṃkāśe nānāratnasamujjvaṃle /
bhāsvaddhvajapatākāḍhye turagāyutabhūṣite //
meaning:
सहस्रादित्यसंकाशे नानारत्नसमुज्ज्वंले /
भास्वद्ध्वजपताकाढ्ये तुरगायुतभूषिते //
text_mt: [He should meditate on him as] resembling a thousand suns, radiant with various gems, / rich with brilliant flags and banners, adorned with ten thousand horses,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsaṃvartakāṃbhodhibhīmarāvavirāviṇi /
samuddhṛtamahāchattravitānitaviyatpathe //
meaning:
महासंवर्तकांभोधिभीमरावविराविणि /
समुद्धृतमहाछत्त्रवितानितवियत्पथे //
text_mt: roaring with a dreadful roar like the great ocean of dissolution, / having the path of the sky canopied by an uplifted great parasol,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārathavare dīptanānāyudhavirājite /
susthitaṃ vipulodāraṃ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
महारथवरे दीप्तनानायुधविराजिते /
सुस्थितं विपुलोदारं सहस्रभुजमण्डितम् //
text_mt: firmly standing on an excellent great chariot, resplendent with various blazing weapons, / vast, magnanimous, adorned with a thousand arms,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmairuddaṇḍakodaṇḍāndadhānamaparaiḥ śarān /
kirīṭahāramukuṭakeyūravalayāṅgadaiḥ //
meaning:
वामैरुद्दण्डकोदण्डान्दधानमपरैः शरान् /
किरीटहारमुकुटकेयूरवलयाङ्गदैः //
text_mt: bearing raised bows with his left [hands], and arrows with his other [hands], / [adorned] with diadems, necklaces, crests, bracelets, and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
mudrikodarabandhādyairmāaiñjīnūpurakādibhiḥ /
bhūṣitaṃ vividhākalpairbhāsvaraiḥ sumahādhanaiḥ //
meaning:
मुद्रिकोदरबन्धाद्यैर्माऐञ्जीनूपुरकादिभिः /
भूषितं विविधाकल्पैर्भास्वरैः सुमहाधनैः //
text_mt: finger-rings, waist-bands, and jingling anklets, / decorated with various gleaming, immensely precious ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
ābaddhakavacaṃ vīraṃ suprasannānanāṃbujam /
dhanurjyā siṃhanādena kaṃpayantaṃ jagattrayam //
meaning:
आबद्धकवचं वीरं सुप्रसन्नाननांबुजम् /
धनुर्ज्या सिंहनादेन कंपयन्तं जगत्त्रयम् //
text_mt: Clad in armour, heroic, with a lotus-like face very serene, / making the three worlds tremble with the twang of his bowstring and his lion-roar,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśatrukṣayakaraṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam /
sarvasaṃpatpradātāraṃ vijayaśrīniṣevitam //
meaning:
सर्वशत्रुक्षयकरं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् /
सर्वसंपत्प्रदातारं विजयश्रीनिषेवितम् //
text_mt: destroying all enemies, wiping out all diseases, / bestowing all prosperity, attended by the goddess of victory,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ bhadraṃ bhaktābhayavidhāyinam /
divyamālyānulepāḍhyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam //
meaning:
सर्वसौभाग्यदं भद्रं भक्ताभयविधायिनम् /
दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपाढ्यं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् //
text_mt: giving all good fortune, auspicious, granting fearlessness to his devotees, / rich in divine garlands and unguents, endowed with all auspicious marks,

sanskrit_iast:
rathanāgāśvapādātavṛndamadhyagamīśvaram /
varadaṃ cakravartīnaṃ sarvalokaikapālakam //
meaning:
रथनागाश्वपादातवृन्दमध्यगमीश्वरम् /
वरदं चक्रवर्तीनं सर्वलोकैकपालकम् //
text_mt: the Lord standing amidst hosts of chariots, elephants, horses, and foot-soldiers, / granting boons, a universal emperor, the sole protector of all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
samānoditasāhasradivākarasamadyutim /
mahāyogabhavaiśvaryakīrtyākrāntajagattrayam //
meaning:
समानोदितसाहस्रदिवाकरसमद्युतिम् /
महायोगभवैश्वर्यकीर्त्याक्रान्तजगत्त्रयम् //
text_mt: having the splendour of a thousand suns risen together, / whose fame and glory, born of great yoga, pervade the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmañṭataṃ hareraṃśādavatīrṇaṃ mahītale /
samyagātmādibhedena dhyātvā rakṣāmudīrayet //
meaning:
श्रीमञ्टतं हरेरंशादवतीर्णं महीतले /
सम्यगात्मादिभेदेन ध्यात्वा रक्षामुदीरयेत् //
text_mt: the illustrious one descended to the earth from a portion of Hari— / having properly meditated [on him] according to the divisions of the self and the rest, one should recite the armour [hymn]:

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṅgamūrtayaḥ pañca pāntu māṃ sphaṭikojjvalāḥ /
agnīśāsuravāyavyakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikāḥ //
meaning:
अस्याङ्गमूर्तयः पञ्च पान्तु मां स्फटिकोज्ज्वलाः /
अग्नीशासुरवायव्यकोणेषु हृदयादिकाः //
text_mt: "May his five limb-manifestations, brilliant as crystal, protect me: / the Heart and the others situated in the south-east, north-east, south-west, and north-west corners.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatosrajvaladrūpā daracarmāsipāṇayaḥ /
avyāhatabalaiśvaryaśaktisāmarthyavigrahāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वतोस्रज्वलद्रूपा दरचर्मासिपाणयः /
अव्याहतबलैश्वर्यशक्तिसामर्थ्यविग्रहाः //
text_mt: Blazing with radiance on every side, holding a conch, shield, and sword in their hands, / their forms embody unimpeded strength, sovereignty, power, and capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemaṅkarīśaktiyutaścauravargavibhañjanaḥ /
prācīṃ diśaṃ rakṣatu me bāṇabāṇāsanāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेमङ्करीशक्तियुतश्चौरवर्गविभञ्जनः /
प्राचीं दिशं रक्षतु मे बाणबाणासनायुधः //
text_mt: Accompanied by the power Kṣemaṅkarī, crushing bands of thieves, / armed with arrows and a bow, may he protect the eastern direction for me.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkarīśaktisahito mārībhayavināśakaḥ /
śaracāpadharaḥ śrīmān diśaṃ me pātu dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
श्रीकरीशक्तिसहितो मारीभयविनाशकः /
शरचापधरः श्रीमान् दिशं मे पातु दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by the power Śrīkarī, destroying fear of plagues, / bearing arrows and a bow, may the glorious one protect my southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvaśyakarīyuktaḥ sarvaśatruvināśakṛt /
maheṣucāpadhṛkpātu mama prācetasīṃ diśam //
meaning:
महावश्यकरीयुक्तः सर्वशत्रुविनाशकृत् /
महेषुचापधृक्पातु मम प्राचेतसीं दिशम् //
text_mt: Joined with [the power] Mahāvaśyakarī, destroying all enemies, / holding great arrows and a bow, may he protect my western direction.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśaḥkaryā samāyukto daityasaṃghavināśanaḥ /
parirakṣatu me samyagvidiśaṃ caitrabhānavīm //
meaning:
यशःकर्या समायुक्तो दैत्यसंघविनाशनः /
परिरक्षतु मे सम्यग्विदिशं चैत्रभानवीम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Yaśaḥkarī, destroying hordes of Daityas, / may he thoroughly protect my south-eastern intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyākarīsamāyuktaḥ sumahahuḥkhanāśanaḥ /
pātu me nairṛtīṃ cāpapāṇirvidiśamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
विद्याकरीसमायुक्तः सुमहहुःखनाशनः /
पातु मे नैरृतीं चापपाणिर्विदिशमीश्वरः //
text_mt: Accompanied by Vidyākarī, destroying very great sorrow, / may the Lord, with a bow in hand, protect my south-western intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanakaryā samāyukto mahādurita nāśanaḥ /
iṣvāsaneṣudhṛkpātu vidiśaṃ mama vāyavīm //
meaning:
धनकर्या समायुक्तो महादुरित नाशनः /
इष्वासनेषुधृक्पातु विदिशं मम वायवीम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Dhanakarī, destroying great sins, / holding a bow and arrows, may he protect my north-western intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥkaryā yutaḥ śrīmānmahābhayavināśanaḥ /
cāpeṣudhārī śaivīṃ me vidiśaṃ parirakṣatu //
meaning:
आयुःकर्या युतः श्रीमान्महाभयविनाशनः /
चापेषुधारी शैवीं मे विदिशं परिरक्षतु //
text_mt: Accompanied by Āyuḥkarī, glorious, destroying great fears, / holding a bow and arrows, may he thoroughly protect my north-eastern intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast:
vijayaśrīyutaḥ sākṣātsahasrāradharo vibhuḥ /
diśamūrddhvāmavatu me sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
विजयश्रीयुतः साक्षात्सहस्रारधरो विभुः /
दिशमूर्द्ध्वामवतु मे सर्वदुष्टभयङ्करः //
text_mt: Endowed with the goddess of victory, holding the thousand-spoked [discus] visibly, the all-pervading lord, / inspiring terror in all the wicked, may he protect my upper direction.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhabhṛtsumahāśaktisaṃyuto 'pyadharāṃ diśam /
parirakṣatu me duḥkhadhvāntasambhedabhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खभृत्सुमहाशक्तिसंयुतो ऽप्यधरां दिशम् /
परिरक्षतु मे दुःखध्वान्तसम्भेदभास्करः //
text_mt: Bearing a conch, joined with very great power, / may the sun dispelling the darkness of sorrow protect my lower direction.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyogasamāyuktaḥ sarvadikcakramaṇḍalaḥ /
mahāyogīśvaraḥ pātu sarvato mama padmabhṛt //
meaning:
महायोगसमायुक्तः सर्वदिक्चक्रमण्डलः /
महायोगीश्वरः पातु सर्वतो मम पद्मभृत् //
text_mt: Endowed with great yoga, whose circle of wheels covers all directions, / may the lord of great yogins, holding a lotus, protect me on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu mūrtayo raktā raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtāḥ /
pradhānadevatārūpāḥ pṛthagrathavare sthitāḥ //
meaning:
एतास्तु मूर्तयो रक्ता रक्तमाल्यांशुकावृताः /
प्रधानदेवतारूपाः पृथग्रथवरे स्थिताः //
text_mt: These forms are red, covered in red garlands and garments, / embodying the principal deity, standing separately on excellent chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayaḥ padmahastāścata nīlendīvarasannnibhāḥ /
śuklamālyānuvasanāḥ suliptatilakojjvalāḥ //
meaning:
शक्तयः पद्महस्ताश्चत नीलेन्दीवरसन्न्निभाः /
शुक्लमाल्यानुवसनाः सुलिप्ततिलकोज्ज्वलाः //
text_mt: The powers hold lotuses in their hands, resembling blue water-lilies, / dressed in white garlands and garments, gleaming with well-anointed marks [on their foreheads].

sanskrit_iast:
tatpārśadeśvarāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ /
svasvadikṣu sthitāḥ pāntu māmindrādyā mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
तत्पार्शदेश्वराः स्वस्ववाहनायुधभूषणाः /
स्वस्वदिक्षु स्थिताः पान्तु मामिन्द्राद्या महाबलाः //
text_mt: May the rulers of the directions beside him, with their respective mounts, weapons, and ornaments, / stationed in their own quarters, Indra and the rest of great might, protect me.

sanskrit_iast:
etastasya samākhyātāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ /
sarvato māṃ sadā pātuṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
एतस्तस्य समाख्याताः सर्वावरणदेवताः /
सर्वतो मां सदा पातुं सर्वशक्तिसमन्विताः //
text_mt: These are proclaimed as all his encircling deities; / endowed with all powers, may they always protect me from every side.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye codare nābhau jaṭhare guhyamaṇḍale /
tejorūpāḥ sthitāḥ pātuṃ vāñchāsukhanadrumāḥ //
meaning:
हृदये चोदरे नाभौ जठरे गुह्यमण्डले /
तेजोरूपाः स्थिताः पातुं वाञ्छासुखनद्रुमाः //
text_mt: Stationed in the heart, belly, navel, stomach, and the secret region, / in the form of light, wish-fulfilling trees of desires and happiness, may they protect me.

sanskrit_iast:
diśaṃ cānye mahāvarṇā mantrarūpā mahojjvalāḥ /
vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam //
meaning:
दिशं चान्ये महावर्णा मन्त्ररूपा महोज्ज्वलाः /
व्यापकत्वेन पान्त्वस्मानापादतलमस्तकम् //
text_mt: And may the other great syllables of the directions, having the nature of mantras and very radiant, / protect us pervasively from the soles of our feet to our head.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtavīryaḥ śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ haihayeśvaraḥ /
sumukho me mukhaṃ pātu karṇauṃ vyāptajagattrayaḥ //
meaning:
कार्तवीर्यः शिरः पातु ललाटं हैहयेश्वरः /
सुमुखो मे मुखं पातु कर्णौं व्याप्तजगत्त्रयः //
text_mt: May Kārtavīrya protect my head; may the lord of the Haihayas protect my forehead; / may the pleasant-faced one protect my face; may he who pervades the three worlds protect my ears.

sanskrit_iast:
sukumāro hanuṃ pātu bhrūyugaṃ me dhanurdharaḥ /
nayanaṃ puṃmaḍarīkākṣago nāsikāṃ me guṇākaraḥ //
meaning:
सुकुमारो हनुं पातु भ्रूयुगं मे धनुर्धरः /
नयनं पुंमडरीकाक्षगो नासिकां मे गुणाकरः //
text_mt: May the delicate one protect my chin; may the bowman protect my two eyebrows; / may the lotus-eyed one protect my eyes; may the treasury of virtues protect my nose.

sanskrit_iast:
adharoṣṭhau sadā pātu brahjñeyo dvijānkaviḥ /
sarvaśāstrakalādhārī jihvāṃ cibukamavyayaḥ //
meaning:
अधरोष्ठौ सदा पातु ब्रह्ज्ञेयो द्विजान्कविः /
सर्वशास्त्रकलाधारी जिह्वां चिबुकमव्ययः //
text_mt: May the knower of Brahman always protect my lower lip; may the wise one protect my teeth; / may he who holds all scriptures and arts protect my tongue, and the imperishable one my chin.

sanskrit_iast:
dattātreyapriyaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ skandhau rājakuleśvaraḥ /
bhujau daśāsyadarpaghno hṛdayaṃ me mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
दत्तात्रेयप्रियः कण्ठं स्कन्धौ राजकुलेश्वरः /
भुजौ दशास्यदर्पघ्नो हृदयं मे महाबलः //
text_mt: May the beloved of Dattātreya protect my throat; may the lord of the royal race protect my shoulders; / may the crusher of the ten-headed [Rāvaṇa's] pride protect my arms; may the very powerful one protect my heart.

sanskrit_iast:
kukṣiṃ rakṣatu me vidvān vakṣaḥ parapurañjayaḥ /
karau sarvārthadaḥ pātukarāgrāṇi jagatpriyaḥ //
meaning:
कुक्षिं रक्षतु मे विद्वान् वक्षः परपुरञ्जयः /
करौ सर्वार्थदः पातुकराग्राणि जगत्प्रियः //
text_mt: May the learned one protect my belly; may the conqueror of enemy cities protect my chest; / may the bestower of all wealth protect my hands; may the beloved of the universe protect my fingertips.

sanskrit_iast:
revāṃbagulīlāsaṃhapto jaṭharaṃ parirakṣatu /
vīraśūrastu me nābhiṃ pārśvau me sarvaduṣṭahā //
meaning:
रेवांबगुलीलासंहप्तो जठरं परिरक्षतु /
वीरशूरस्तु मे नाभिं पार्श्वौ मे सर्वदुष्टहा //
text_mt: May he who took delight in playing in the waters of the Revā protect my stomach; / may the brave hero protect my navel; may the slayer of all wicked beings protect my flanks.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabhujanṛtpṛṣṭaṃ saptadvīpādhipaḥ kaṭim /
ūrū māhiṣmatīnātho jānunī vallabho bhuvaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रभुजनृत्पृष्टं सप्तद्वीपाधिपः कटिम् /
ऊरू माहिष्मतीनाथो जानुनी वल्लभो भुवः //
text_mt: May the thousand-armed one protect my back; may the sovereign of the seven continents protect my waist; / may the lord of Māhiṣmatī protect my thighs; may the beloved of the earth protect my knees.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅghe vīrādhipaḥ pātu pātu pādau manojavaḥ /
pātu sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvamarmasu //
meaning:
जङ्घे वीराधिपः पातु पातु पादौ मनोजवः /
पातु सर्वायुधधरः सर्वाङ्गं सर्वमर्मसु //
text_mt: May the sovereign of heroes protect my shanks; may he who is swift as thought protect my feet; / may he who bears all weapons protect my whole body at every vital point.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduṣṭāntakaḥ pātu dhātvaṣṭakakalevaram /
prāṇādidaśajīveśānsarvaśiṣṭeṣṭado 'vatu //
meaning:
सर्वदुष्टान्तकः पातु धात्वष्टककलेवरम् /
प्राणादिदशजीवेशान्सर्वशिष्टेष्टदो ऽवतु //
text_mt: May the ender of all the wicked protect my body of eight bodily elements; / may he who grants all that the righteous desire protect the ten vital airs and the rest, lords of life.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśīkṛtendriyagrāmaḥ pātu sarvendriyāṇi me /
anuktamapi yatsthāna śarīrāntarbahiśca yat //
meaning:
वशीकृतेन्द्रियग्रामः पातु सर्वेन्द्रियाणि मे /
