तालपत्रैर्विरचितमासनं पर्यकल्पयत् /
प्रक्षाल्य पादौ हस्तौ च समाचम्य समाहितः //
text_mt: He prepared a seat fashioned from palm leaves. / Having washed his feet and hands and properly sipped water, collected in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmasnānamatho cakre punarācamya vāgyataḥ /
devavedyāmatho cakre padmaṃ ca sumanoharam //
meaning:
भस्मस्नानमथो चक्रे पुनराचम्य वाग्यतः /
देववेद्यामथो चक्रे पद्मं च सुमनोहरम् //
text_mt: he then took an ash-bath, sipped water again with restrained speech, / and then drew a very charming lotus on the divine altar.

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ tālapatre padmāsanagataḥ kapiḥ /
prāṇānāyamya saṃnyasya śulkadhyānasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तरं तालपत्रे पद्मासनगतः कपिः /
प्राणानायम्य संन्यस्य शुल्कध्यानसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Thereupon the monkey, seated in the lotus posture on the palm leaf, / restrained his breath, performed ritual placement, and engaged in pure meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya gurumīśānaṃ japannāsīdataḥ param /
atha devāryanaṃ karttuṃ yatnamāsthitavānkapiḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य गुरुमीशानं जपन्नासीदतः परम् /
अथ देवार्यनं कर्त्तुं यत्नमास्थितवान्कपिः //
text_mt: Bowing to his guru and to the Lord, chanting, he sat after that. / Then the monkey made an effort to perform the worship of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśapatrapuṭakadvayānītajalaṃ śuci /
śiraḥ kamaṇḍalugataṃ nidhāyāgninimantritam //
meaning:
पलाशपत्रपुटकद्वयानीतजलं शुचि /
शिरः कमण्डलुगतं निधायाग्निनिमन्त्रितम् //
text_mt: Having placed pure water brought in two leaf-cups of palāśa / into his water-pot on his head, invoked by Agni,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanādi kṛtvātha snānaparyantameva ca /
atha snāpayituṃ devamādāya karasaṃpuṭe //
meaning:
आवाहनादि कृत्वाथ स्नानपर्यन्तमेव च /
अथ स्नापयितुं देवमादाय करसंपुटे //
text_mt: and having performed the invocations and other rites up to the bath, / then, in order to bathe the deity, taking it into the hollow of his hands,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nirīkṣaṇaṃ devapīṭhaṃ no dṛṣṭavānkapiḥ /
liṅgamātraṃ karagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वा निरीक्षणं देवपीठं नो दृष्टवान्कपिः /
लिङ्गमात्रं करगतं दृष्ट्वा भीतिसमन्वितः //
text_mt: and looking closely, the monkey did not see the ritual seat of the deity. / Seeing only the liṅga in his hand, he was filled with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
idamāha mahāyogī kiṃvā pāpaṃ mayā kṛtam /
yadetatpīṭharahitaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ karasthitam //
meaning:
इदमाह महायोगी किंवा पापं मया कृतम् /
यदेतत्पीठरहितं शिवलिङ्गं करस्थितम् //
text_mt: The great yogin said this: "What sin have I committed, / that this Śiva-liṅga resting in my hand is devoid of a ritual seat?

sanskrit_iast:
mamādya maraṇaṃ siddhaṃ na pīṭhaṃ cāgamiṣyati /
atha rudraṃ japiṣyāmi tadāyati maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ममाद्य मरणं सिद्धं न पीठं चागमिष्यति /
अथ रुद्रं जपिष्यामि तदायति महेश्वरः //
text_mt: My death today is certain, and the seat will not come. / Now I shall recite the Rudra; then Maheśvara will arrive."

sanskrit_iast:
iti niścitya manasā jajāpa śatarudriyam /
yadā tu na samāyāto maheśo 'tha kapīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
इति निश्चित्य मनसा जजाप शतरुद्रियम् /
यदा तु न समायातो महेशो ऽथ कपीश्वरः //
text_mt: Resolving thus in his mind, he recited the Śatarudrīya. / When, however, Maheśa did not arrive, then the lord of monkeys

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ nyapātayadbhūmau vīrabhadraḥ samāgataḥ /
kimarthaṃ rudyate bhadra rudite kāraṇaṃ vada //
meaning:
रुद्रं न्यपातयद्भूमौ वीरभद्रः समागतः /
किमर्थं रुद्यते भद्र रुदिते कारणं वद //
text_mt: fell down weeping upon the ground. Vīrabhadra arrived: / "Why do you weep, good sir? Tell me the cause of your weeping."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā prāha hanumānvīrabhadraṃ manogatam /
pīṭhahīnamidaṃ liṅgaṃ paśya me pāpasaṃcayam //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्राह हनुमान्वीरभद्रं मनोगतम् /
पीठहीनमिदं लिङ्गं पश्य मे पापसंचयम् //
text_mt: Hearing that, Hanumān spoke his inner thoughts to Vīrabhadra: / "This liṅga is without a seat; behold the accumulation of my sins!"

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhadrastataḥ prāha śrutvā kapisamīritam /
yadi nāyāti pīṭhaṃ te liṅge mā sāhasaṃ kuru //
meaning:
वीरभद्रस्ततः प्राह श्रुत्वा कपिसमीरितम् /
यदि नायाति पीठं ते लिङ्गे मा साहसं कुरु //
text_mt: Hearing what the monkey said, Vīrabhadra then replied: / "If the seat does not come to your liṅga, do not do anything rash.

sanskrit_iast:
dāhayiṣyāmyahaṃ lokānyadi nāyāti pīṭhakam /
paśya darśaya me liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ cātrāgataṃ na vā //
meaning:
दाहयिष्याम्यहं लोकान्यदि नायाति पीठकम् /
पश्य दर्शय मे लिङ्गं पीठं चात्रागतं न वा //
text_mt: I will burn up the worlds if the seat does not come. / Look, show me the liṅga, whether the seat has arrived here or not."

sanskrit_iast:
ata dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro liṅge pīṭhamanāgatam /
dagdhukāmo 'khilāṃllokānvīrabhadraḥ prātāpavān //
meaning:
अत दृष्ट्वा वीरभद्रो लिङ्गे पीठमनागतम् /
दग्धुकामो ऽखिलांल्लोकान्वीरभद्रः प्रातापवान् //
text_mt: Seeing then that the seat had not arrived at the liṅga, / Vīrabhadra, powerful, was eager to burn all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
analaṃ bhuvi cikṣepa kṣaṇāddagdhā mahī tadā /
atha saptatalāndagdhvā punarūrddhvamavartata //
meaning:
अनलं भुवि चिक्षेप क्षणाद्दग्धा मही तदा /
अथ सप्ततलान्दग्ध्वा पुनरूर्द्ध्वमवर्तत //
text_mt: He cast fire onto the earth; then in an instant the earth was burned. / Then, having burned the seven netherworlds, it turned upwards again.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcorddhvalokānadahajjanalokanivāsinaḥ /
lalāṭanetrasaṃbhūtaṃ nakhenādāya cānalam //
meaning:
पञ्चोर्द्ध्वलोकानदहज्जनलोकनिवासिनः /
ललाटनेत्रसंभूतं नखेनादाय चानलम् //
text_mt: It burned the five upper worlds and the dwellers of Janaloka. / Taking the fire produced from the forehead eye with his fingernail,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṃbīraphalasaṃkāśaṃ kṛtvā karatale vibhuḥ /
tapaḥ satyaṃ ca saṃdagdhumudyato 'bhūnmunīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
जंबीरफलसंकाशं कृत्वा करतले विभुः /
तपः सत्यं च संदग्धुमुद्यतो ऽभून्मुनीश्वरः //
text_mt: and shaping it like a citron fruit in the palm of his hand, the lord, / that best of sages, prepared to burn Tapas and Satya.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu munayo dṛṣṭvātapolokanivāsinaḥ /
dagdhukāmaṃ vīrabhadraṃ gautamāśramamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु मुनयो दृष्ट्वातपोलोकनिवासिनः /
दग्धुकामं वीरभद्रं गौतमाश्रममागताः //
text_mt: Then, seeing Vīrabhadra eager to burn [the worlds], / the sages residing in Tapoloka went to the hermitage of Gautama.

sanskrit_iast:
na dṛṣṭvā tatra deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ svātmani sthitam /
astuvanbhaktisaṃyuktāḥ stotrairvedasamudbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
न दृष्ट्वा तत्र देवेशं शङ्करं स्वात्मनि स्थितम् /
अस्तुवन्भक्तिसंयुक्ताः स्तोत्रैर्वेदसमुद्भवैः //
text_mt: Not seeing the Lord of gods, Śaṅkara, there, established in his own self, / filled with devotion, they praised him with hymns born of the Vedas:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ vedavedyāya devāya tasmai śuddhaprabhācintyarūpāya kasmai /
brahmādyadhīśāya sṛṣṭyādikartre,viṣṇupriyāyārtihṝntreṃ'takartre //
meaning:
ओं वेदवेद्याय देवाय तस्मै शुद्धप्रभाचिन्त्यरूपाय कस्मै /
ब्रह्माद्यधीशाय सृष्ट्यादिकर्त्रे,विष्णुप्रियायार्तिहॄन्त्रेंऽतकर्त्रे //
text_mt: "Oṃ. To that god known through the Vedas, whose form is of pure radiance and unthinkable, who is the singular one, / to the ruler of Brahmā and the others, maker of creation and the rest, dear to Viṣṇu, dispeller of distress, and maker of the end!

sanskrit_iast:
/
namaste 'khilādhīśvarāyāṃbarāya namaste carasthāvaravyāpakāya /
namo vedaguhyāya bhaktapriyāya namaḥ pākabhoktre makheśāya tubhyam //
meaning:
/
नमस्ते ऽखिलाधीश्वरायांबराय नमस्ते चरस्थावरव्यापकाय /
नमो वेदगुह्याय भक्तप्रियाय नमः पाकभोक्त्रे मखेशाय तुभ्यम् //
text_mt: Salutations to you, sovereign Lord of all, sky-formed; salutations to you, pervader of the moving and unmoving! / Salutations to the secret of the Vedas, beloved of devotees! Salutations to you, enjoyer of sacrificial portions, lord of sacrifice!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste śivāyādidevāya kurmo namo vyālayajñopavītapradhartne /
namaste surābinduvarṣāpanāya trayīmūrtaye kālakālāya nātha //
meaning:
नमस्ते शिवायादिदेवाय कुर्मो नमो व्यालयज्ञोपवीतप्रधर्त्ने /
नमस्ते सुराबिन्दुवर्षापनाय त्रयीमूर्तये कालकालाय नाथ //
text_mt: Salutations to you, Śiva, primordial god, we bow; salutations to the wearer of serpents as the sacred thread! / Salutations to you who cause the rain of wine-drops, embodiment of the three Vedas, death of Death, O Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
dharitrīmarudvyomatoyenduvahniprabhāmaṇḍalātmāṣṭadhāmūrti dhartre /
śivāyāśivaghnāya vīrāya bhūyātsadā naḥ prasanno jagannāthakejyaḥ //
meaning:
धरित्रीमरुद्व्योमतोयेन्दुवह्निप्रभामण्डलात्माष्टधामूर्ति धर्त्रे /
शिवायाशिवघ्नाय वीराय भूयात्सदा नः प्रसन्नो जगन्नाथकेज्यः //
text_mt: To the bearer of the eightfold form composed of earth, wind, sky, water, moon, fire, and the orb of radiance; / to Śiva, slayer of inauspiciousness, the heroic one—may the Lord of the world, worthy of worship, be ever pleased with us!

sanskrit_iast:
kalānāthabhālāya ātmā mahātmā mano hyagrayāno nirūpyo na vāgbhiḥ /
jagajjāḍyavidhvaṃsanobhuktimuktipradaḥ stātprasannaḥ sadā śuddha kīrtiḥ //
meaning:
कलानाथभालाय आत्मा महात्मा मनो ह्यग्रयानो निरूप्यो न वाग्भिः /
जगज्जाड्यविध्वंसनोभुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदः स्तात्प्रसन्नः सदा शुद्ध कीर्तिः //
text_mt: To him whose forehead bears the lord of digits, the Self, the Great Self, swift as the mind, indescribable by words, / destroyer of the stupor of the world, giver of enjoyment and liberation, of pure fame—may he be ever pleased!

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ saṃprasūtaṃ jagajjātamīśātsthitaṃ yena rakṣāvatā bhāvitaṃ ca /
layaṃ yāsyate yatra vācāṃ vidūre sa vai naḥ prasanno 'stu kālatrayātmā //
meaning:
यतः संप्रसूतं जगज्जातमीशात्स्थितं येन रक्षावता भावितं च /
लयं यास्यते यत्र वाचां विदूरे स वै नः प्रसन्नो ऽस्तु कालत्रयात्मा //
text_mt: From whom this born universe was produced, by which protecting Lord it is maintained and sustained, / and into whom it will dissolve, beyond words—may he, the soul of the three times, be pleased with us!

sanskrit_iast:
yadārdi ca madhyaṃ tathāntaṃ na ke 'pi vijānanti vijñā api svānumānāḥ /
sa vai sarvamūrtiḥ sadā no vibhūtyeprasanno 'stu kiṃ jñāpayāmo 'tra kṛtyam //
meaning:
यदार्दि च मध्यं तथान्तं न के ऽपि विजानन्ति विज्ञा अपि स्वानुमानाः /
स वै सर्वमूर्तिः सदा नो विभूत्येप्रसन्नो ऽस्तु किं ज्ञापयामो ऽत्र कृत्यम् //
text_mt: Whose beginning, middle, and end none know, even the wise relying on their own inferences— / may he, possessing all forms, be ever pleased for our prosperity! What duty here can we make known to you?"

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃ stutimathākarṇya bhaganetrapradaḥ śivaḥ /
viṣṇumāha munīnetānānayasva madantikam //
meaning:
एतां स्तुतिमथाकर्ण्य भगनेत्रप्रदः शिवः /
विष्णुमाह मुनीनेतानानयस्व मदन्तिकम् //
text_mt: Hearing this hymn of praise, Śiva, who restores Bhaga's eyes, / said to Viṣṇu: "Bring these sages into my presence."

sanskrit_iast:
atha viṣṇuḥ samāgatya tapolokanivāsinaḥ /
munīnsāṃtvayya viśveśaṃ darśayāmāsa śaṅkaram //
meaning:
अथ विष्णुः समागत्य तपोलोकनिवासिनः /
मुनीन्सांत्वय्य विश्वेशं दर्शयामास शङ्करम् //
text_mt: Then Viṣṇu went, consoled the sages dwelling in Tapoloka, / and presented them to Śaṅkara, the lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tānāha śaṅkaro vākyaṃ kimarthaṃ yūyamāgatāḥ /
tapolokādbhūmilokaṃ munayo muktakilbiṣāḥ //
meaning:
तानाह शङ्करो वाक्यं किमर्थं यूयमागताः /
तपोलोकाद्भूमिलोकं मुनयो मुक्तकिल्बिषाः //
text_mt: Śaṅkara spoke these words to them: "Why have you come / from Tapoloka to the earthly world, O sages freed from sin?"

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā śūlino vākyaṃ procuste munisattamāḥ /
deva dvādaśalokānāṃ dṛśyante bhasmarāśayaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शूलिनो वाक्यं प्रोचुस्ते मुनिसत्तमाः /
देव द्वादशलोकानां दृश्यन्ते भस्मराशयः //
text_mt: Hearing the trident-bearer's words, those best of sages said: / "O God, heaps of ash are seen across twelve worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitamekaṃ vanamidaṃ paśya tallokasaṃkṣayam /
tacchrutvā giriśaḥ prāha tānmunīnūrddharetasaḥ //
meaning:
स्थितमेकं वनमिदं पश्य तल्लोकसंक्षयम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा गिरिशः प्राह तान्मुनीनूर्द्धरेतसः //
text_mt: Only this one forest remains standing; behold the destruction of those worlds!" / Hearing that, Giriśa said to those chaste sages:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrlokasya tu saṃdāhe pātālānāṃ tathaiva ca /
sandeho nāsti munayaḥ sthitānāṃ no rahaḥsthale //
meaning:
भूर्लोकस्य तु संदाहे पातालानां तथैव च /
सन्देहो नास्ति मुनयः स्थितानां नो रहःस्थले //
text_mt: "Regarding the burning of the earth-world and likewise of the netherworlds, / there is no doubt, O sages, for us who stay in a secluded place.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhapañcakalokānāṃ dāhe saṃdeha eva naḥ /
kathamaṅgāravṛṣṭiśca kathaṃ no vā mahādhvaniḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्द्धपञ्चकलोकानां दाहे संदेह एव नः /
कथमङ्गारवृष्टिश्च कथं नो वा महाध्वनिः //
text_mt: Our doubt concerns only the burning of the five upper worlds. / How could there be a rain of embers, and how was there not a great sound?"

sanskrit_iast:
tadākarṇya vibhorvākyaṃ śaṅkarasya munīśvarāḥ /
procuḥ prāñjalayo devaṃ brahmādisurasaṃgatam //
meaning:
तदाकर्ण्य विभोर्वाक्यं शङ्करस्य मुनीश्वराः /
प्रोचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवं ब्रह्मादिसुरसंगतम् //
text_mt: Hearing those words of the all-pervading Śaṅkara, the great sages, / with joined palms, spoke to the God who was accompanied by Brahmā and other gods:

sanskrit_iast:
bhītirasmākamadhunā vartate vīrabhadrataḥ /
sa evāṅgāra vṛṣṭiṃ ca pipāsurapibadvibhoḥ //
meaning:
भीतिरस्माकमधुना वर्तते वीरभद्रतः /
स एवाङ्गार वृष्टिं च पिपासुरपिबद्विभोः //
text_mt: "Our fear now comes from Vīrabhadra; / he himself, thirsting, drank the shower of embers from the Lord."

sanskrit_iast:
devo 'tha vīramāhūya kiṃ vīretyabravīdvacaḥ /
vīro 'pyāha kaperliṅge pīṭhābhāvādidaṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
देवो ऽथ वीरमाहूय किं वीरेत्यब्रवीद्वचः /
वीरो ऽप्याह कपेर्लिङ्गे पीठाभावादिदं कृतम् //
text_mt: Then the God summoned the hero and spoke these words: "What is it, O hero?" / And the hero said: "This was done because of the absence of a seat for the monkey's liṅga."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvāha śivo devo munīṃstānbhayavihvalān /
kapeścittaṃ parijñātuṃ mayā kṛtamidaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वाह शिवो देवो मुनींस्तान्भयविह्वलान् /
कपेश्चित्तं परिज्ञातुं मया कृतमिदं द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Hearing that, the god Śiva said to those sages who were overcome with fear:
“O twice-born, this was done by me in order to test the monkey's mind.

sanskrit_iast:
mā bhaiṣṭa bhavatāṃ saukhyaṃ sadā saṃpādayāmyaham /
ityuktvā tu yathāpūrvaṃ devadevaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ //
meaning:
मा भैष्ट भवतां सौख्यं सदा संपादयाम्यहम् /
इत्युक्त्वा तु यथापूर्वं देवदेवः कृपानिधिः //
text_mt:
Do not fear; I shall always secure your happiness.”
Having spoken thus, the god of gods, an ocean of compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhānapyakhilāṃllokānpūrvataḥ śobhanānvibhuḥ /
kalpayāmāsa viśvātmā vīrabhadramathābravīt //
meaning:
दग्धानप्यखिलांल्लोकान्पूर्वतः शोभनान्विभुः /
कल्पयामास विश्वात्मा वीरभद्रमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
the all-pervading Soul of the universe restored all the worlds, even though burnt,
to be even more splendid than before, and then addressed Vīrabhadra:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu vatsa yato bhadraṃ bhaktānāmīhase sadā /
tataste vipulā kīrtirloke sthāsyati śāśvatī //
meaning:
साधु वत्स यतो भद्रं भक्तानामीहसे सदा /
ततस्ते विपुला कीर्तिर्लोके स्थास्यति शाश्वती //
text_mt:
“Well done, my child! Since you always desire what is auspicious for devotees,
therefore your vast and eternal renown will endure in the world.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāliṅgya śirasi samāghrāya maheśvaraḥ /
tāṃbūlaṃ vīrabhadrāya dattavānprītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वालिङ्ग्य शिरसि समाघ्राय महेश्वरः /
तांबूलं वीरभद्राय दत्तवान्प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, embracing him and smelling his head,
Maheśvara, glad at heart, gave betel to Vīrabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsau hanumānīpūjanaṃ kṛtavānyathā /
samāptāyāṃ tu pūjāyāṃ hanumānprītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
अथासौ हनुमानीपूजनं कृतवान्यथा /
समाप्तायां तु पूजायां हनुमान्प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt:
Then Hanumān performed the worship as [prescribed].
When the worship was concluded, Hanumān, glad at heart,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ vanacaraṃ tatra gandharvaṃ savipañcakam /
dadarśa tamathābhyāha vīṇā me dīyatāmiti //
meaning:
एकं वनचरं तत्र गन्धर्वं सविपञ्चकम् /
ददर्श तमथाभ्याह वीणा मे दीयतामिति //
text_mt:
saw a certain forest-dwelling Gandharva there with a lute.
He said to him: “Let the lute be given to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvo 'pyāha na mayā tyājyā vīṇā priyā mama /
mamāpīṣṭehaṃ gandharva vīṇetyāha kapīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वो ऽप्याह न मया त्याज्या वीणा प्रिया मम /
ममापीष्टेहं गन्धर्व वीणेत्याह कपीश्वरः //
text_mt:
The Gandharva also replied: “I will not give up the lute; it is dear to me.”
“The lute is dear to me as well, O Gandharva,” said the lord of monkeys.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na datte gandharvo vallakīṃ kapaye priyām /
tadā muṣṭiprahāreṇa gandharvaḥ pātitaḥ kṣitau //
meaning:
यदा न दत्ते गन्धर्वो वल्लकीं कपये प्रियाम् /
तदा मुष्टिप्रहारेण गन्धर्वः पातितः क्षितौ //
text_mt:
When the Gandharva did not give the cherished lute to the monkey,
then with a blow of his fist the Gandharva was knocked to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāmādāya mahatīṃ svaratantusamanvitām /
hanumānvānaraśreṣṭho gāyanprāgācchivāntikam //
meaning:
वीणामादाय महतीं स्वरतन्तुसमन्विताम् /
हनुमान्वानरश्रेष्ठो गायन्प्रागाच्छिवान्तिकम् //
text_mt:
Taking the great lute furnished with melodious strings,
Hanumān, best of monkeys, singing, approached Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gānena mahatā prasādya jagadīśvaram /
bṛhatīkusumaiḥ śuddhair devapādāvapūjayat //
meaning:
ततो गानेन महता प्रसाद्य जगदीश्वरम् /
बृहतीकुसुमैः शुद्धैर् देवपादावपूजयत् //
text_mt:
Then, having propitiated the Lord of the universe with great singing,
he worshipped the god's feet with pure bṛhatī flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno viśvātmā munīnāṃ sannidhau tadā /
daityānāṃ devatānāṃ ca nṛpāṇāṃ śaṅkaro 'pi ca //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो विश्वात्मा मुनीनां सन्निधौ तदा /
दैत्यानां देवतानां च नृपाणां शङ्करो ऽपि च //
text_mt:
Then, being pleased, the Soul of the universe—Śaṅkara—in the presence of the sages,
as well as of the Daityas, deities, and kings,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai varamatha prādātkalpāntaṃ jīvitaṃ punaḥ /
samullaṅghane śaktiṃ śāstrajñatvaṃ balonnatim //
meaning:
तस्मै वरमथ प्रादात्कल्पान्तं जीवितं पुनः /
समुल्लङ्घने शक्तिं शास्त्रज्ञत्वं बलोन्नतिम् //
text_mt:
granted him a boon: life until the end of the kalpa,
power in leaping across [the ocean], knowledge of scriptures, and height of strength.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattaṃ varaṃ prāpya maheśena mahātmanā /
pratyakṣaṃ mama viprendra hanumānharṣamāgagataḥ //
meaning:
एवं दत्तं वरं प्राप्य महेशेन महात्मना /
प्रत्यक्षं मम विप्रेन्द्र हनुमान्हर्षमागगतः //
text_mt:
Having obtained the boon thus granted by the high-souled Maheśa
before my very eyes, O best of Brahmins, Hanumān was filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
samastabhūṣāsu ṣitāṅgaḥ svadīptirmadīkṛtadevadīptiḥ /
prasannamūrtistaruṇaḥ śivāṃśaḥ saṃbhāvayāmāsa samastadevān //
meaning:
समस्तभूषासु षिताङ्गः स्वदीप्तिर्मदीकृतदेवदीप्तिः /
प्रसन्नमूर्तिस्तरुणः शिवांशः संभावयामास समस्तदेवान् //
text_mt:
With his limbs adorned with all ornaments, dimming the radiance of the gods with his own radiance,
with a gracious form, youthful, a portion of Śiva, he honoured all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñapto hanumāṃstatra matsevāyai munīśvaraḥ /
maheśenāhamapyenaṃ śaśimaulimavaimi ca //
meaning:
आज्ञप्तो हनुमांस्तत्र मत्सेवायै मुनीश्वरः /
महेशेनाहमप्येनं शशिमौलिमवैमि च //
text_mt:
Commanded by Maheśa to serve me there, that lord of sages, Hanumān,
[served me], and I also regard him as the moon-crested [Śiva] himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bahūktena viprarṣe yādṛśo vānareśvaraḥ /
buddhau nyāye ca vai dhairye tādṛganyo 'sti na kvacit //
meaning:
किं बहूक्तेन विप्रर्षे यादृशो वानरेश्वरः /
बुद्धौ न्याये च वै धैर्ये तादृगन्यो ऽस्ति न क्वचित् //
text_mt:
What need is there of saying much, O Brahmin-seer? As the lord of monkeys is
in intellect, in justice, and in courage, there is nowhere another like him.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam /
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva gaccha vipra yathāsukham //
meaning:
इति ते सर्वमाख्यातं चरितं पापनाशनम् /
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव गच्छ विप्र यथासुखम् //
text_mt:
Thus the entire narrative, which destroys sins
for those who recite and hear it, has been related to you; depart at your pleasure, O Brahmin.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā rāmabhadrasya raghunāthasya dhīmataḥ /
vacanaṃ dakṣiṇīkṛtya natvā cāgāṃ yathāgataḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा रामभद्रस्य रघुनाथस्य धीमतः /
वचनं दक्षिणीकृत्य नत्वा चागां यथागतः //
text_mt:
Hearing that speech of the wise Rāmabhadra, the lord of the Raghus,
circumambulating him and bowing down, I departed as I had come.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte 'bhihitaṃ vipra caritaṃ ca hanūmataḥ /
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde hanumaccaritraṃ nāma ekonāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत्ते ऽभिहितं विप्र चरितं च हनूमतः /
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे हनुमच्चरित्रं नाम एकोनाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrutvā tu nārado viprāḥ kumāravacanaṃ muniḥ /
yatpapraccha punastacca yuṣmabhyaṃ pravadāmyaham //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रुत्वा तु नारदो विप्राः कुमारवचनं मुनिः /
यत्पप्रच्छ पुनस्तच्च युष्मभ्यं प्रवदाम्यहम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having heard the words of Kumāra, O Brahmins, the sage Nārada
questioned him again; and that I shall relate to you.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ tathā hanumato 'pi ca /
caritaṃ ca mahatpuṇyaṃ śrutvā bhūyo 'bravīdvacaḥ //
meaning:
कार्तवीर्यस्य कवचं तथा हनुमतो ऽपि च /
चरितं च महत्पुण्यं श्रुत्वा भूयो ऽब्रवीद्वचः //
text_mt:
Having heard the armor of Kārtavīrya and the highly meritorious
deeds of Hanumān, he spoke these words once more:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha tvayātikaruṇātmanā /
śrāvitaṃ caritaṃ puṇyaṃ śivasya ca hanūmataḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
साधु साधु मुनिश्रेष्ठ त्वयातिकरुणात्मना /
श्रावितं चरितं पुण्यं शिवस्य च हनूमतः //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
“Well done, well done, O best of sages! By you, whose nature is exceedingly compassionate,
the holy narrative of Śiva and of Hanumān has been recited.

sanskrit_iast:
tantrasyāṃsya kramaprāptaṃ kathanīyaṃ ca yattvayā /
tatprabrūhi mahābhāga kiṃ pṛṣṭvānyadvidāṃvara //
meaning:
तन्त्रस्यांस्य क्रमप्राप्तं कथनीयं च यत्त्वया /
तत्प्रब्रूहि महाभाग किं पृष्ट्वान्यद्विदांवर //
text_mt:
What next follows in due order to be told in this tantra,
speak that, O fortunate one! What else is there to ask, O best of knowers?”

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
atha vakṣye kṛṣṇamantrānbhuktimuktiphalapradān /
brahmādyā yānsamārādhya sṛṣṭyādikaraṇe kṣamāḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथ वक्ष्ये कृष्णमन्त्रान्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदान् /
ब्रह्माद्या यान्समाराध्य सृष्ट्यादिकरणे क्षमाः //
text_mt:
Sanatkumāra said:
“Now I shall explain the mantras of Kṛṣṇa that grant the fruits of enjoyment and liberation,
by worshipping which Brahmā and the others are able to carry out creation and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaḥ kṛṣṇapadaṃ ṅataṃ govindaṃ ca tathāvidham /
gopījanapadaṃ paścādvallabhāyāgnisuṃdarī //
meaning:
कामः कृष्णपदं ङतं गोविन्दं च तथाविधम् /
गोपीजनपदं पश्चाद्वल्लभायाग्निसुंदरी //
text_mt:
[The seed of] Kāma, the word ‘kṛṣṇa’ ending in the dative, ‘govinda’ likewise,
then the word ‘gopījana’, followed by ‘vallabhāya’ and the beautiful wife of Agni [‘svāhā’].

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśārṇo mantro 'yaṃ durgādhiṣṭhātṛdaivataḥ /
nārado 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī devatā punaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टादशार्णो मन्त्रो ऽयं दुर्गाधिष्ठातृदैवतः /
नारदो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता पुनः //
text_mt:
This eighteen-syllable mantra has Durgā as its presiding deity.
Its sage is Nārada; the meter is gāyatrī; its deity, furthermore,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā ca kāmo bījaṃ prakīrtitam /
svāhā śaktirniyogastu caturvargaprasiddhaye //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णः परमात्मा च कामो बीजं प्रकीर्तितम् /
स्वाहा शक्तिर्नियोगस्तु चतुर्वर्गप्रसिद्धये //
text_mt:
is Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Self; Kāma is declared to be its seed-syllable;
svāhā is its power; and its application is for the attainment of the four goals of life.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiṃ śirasi vaktre tu chandaśca hṛdi devatām /
guhye bījaṃ padoḥ śaktiṃ nyasetsādhakasattamaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिं शिरसि वक्त्रे तु छन्दश्च हृदि देवताम् /
गुह्ये बीजं पदोः शक्तिं न्यसेत्साधकसत्तमः //
text_mt:
The best of practitioners should perform ritual placement of the seer on the head, the meter on the mouth,
the deity in the heart, the seed-syllable on the secret parts, and the power on both feet.

sanskrit_iast:
yugevadābdhi nigamairdvābhyāṃ varṇairmanūdbhavaiḥ /
pañcāṅgāni pravinyasya tattvanyāsaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
युगेवदाब्धि निगमैर्द्वाभ्यां वर्णैर्मनूद्भवैः /
पञ्चाङ्गानि प्रविन्यस्य तत्त्वन्यासं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Having placed the five limbs with the syllables of the mantra by twos, fours, fours, fours,
and two syllables, he should perform the ritual placement of elements.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdantimādikāntārṇamaparādyāni cātmane /
matyantāni ca tatvāni jīvādyāni nyasetkramāt //
meaning:
हृदन्तिमादिकान्तार्णमपराद्यानि चात्मने /
मत्यन्तानि च तत्वानि जीवाद्यानि न्यसेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Ending in ‘hṛdaya’ and beginning with the first syllable, with the syllables beginning with ‘a’ ending with ‘ātman’,
and with the principles ending with ‘mati’, he should successively place those beginning with the individual soul:

sanskrit_iast:
jīvaṃ prāṇaṃ matimahṝṅkāraṃ manastathaiva ca /
śabdaṃ sparśaṃ rūparasau gandhaṃ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ tathā //
meaning:
जीवं प्राणं मतिमहॄङ्कारं मनस्तथैव च /
शब्दं स्पर्शं रूपरसौ गन्धं श्रोत्रं त्वचं तथा //
text_mt:
the individual soul, vital breath, intellect, ego, mind,
sound, touch, form, taste, smell, ear, skin,

sanskrit_iast:
netraṃ ca rasanāṅghrāṇaṃ vācaṃ pāṇiṃ padendriyam /
pāyuṃ śiśnamathākāśaṃ vāyuṃ vahniṃ jalaṃ mahīm //
meaning:
नेत्रं च रसनाङ्घ्राणं वाचं पाणिं पदेन्द्रियम् /
पायुं शिश्नमथाकाशं वायुं वह्निं जलं महीम् //
text_mt:
eye, tongue, nose, speech, hand, the organ of locomotion [feet],
the anus, the genitals, then space, wind, fire, water, and earth.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sarvāge matyāditritayaṃ hṛdi /
mūrddhāsyahṛdguhya pādeṣvatha śabdādikānnyaset //
meaning:
जीवं प्राणं च सर्वागे मत्यादित्रितयं हृदि /
मूर्द्धास्यहृद्गुह्य पादेष्वथ शब्दादिकान्न्यसेत् //
text_mt:
He should place the individual soul and the vital breath in all limbs, the triad beginning with intellect in the heart,
and sound and the rest on the head, mouth, heart, secret parts, and feet;

sanskrit_iast:
karṇādisvasvasthāneṣu śrotrādīnīndriyāṇi ca /
tathā vāgādīndriyāṇi svasvasthānaṣu vinyaset //
meaning:
कर्णादिस्वस्वस्थानेषु श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाणि च /
तथा वागादीन्द्रियाणि स्वस्वस्थानषु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt:
the sense organs beginning with the ear in their respective locations such as the ears,
and similarly the organs of action beginning with speech in their respective locations;

sanskrit_iast:
mūddhasyahṛdguhyapādeṣvākāśādīnnyasettataḥ /
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamarkenduhnibiṃbānyanukramāt //
meaning:
मूद्धस्यहृद्गुह्यपादेष्वाकाशादीन्न्यसेत्ततः /
हृत्पुण्डरीकमर्केन्दुह्निबिंबान्यनुक्रमात् //
text_mt:
then he should place space and the other [elements] on the head, mouth, heart, secret parts, and feet.
Then successively the lotus of the heart and the discs of the sun, moon, and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
dviṣaṭhyaṣṭadaśakalāvyāptāni ca tathā mataḥ /
bhūtāṣṭāṃ gākṣipadagairvarṇaiḥ pragvinnyaseddhṛdi //
meaning:
द्विषठ्यष्टदशकलाव्याप्तानि च तथा मतः /
भूताष्टां गाक्षिपदगैर्वर्णैः प्रग्विन्न्यसेद्धृदि //
text_mt:
pervaded respectively by twelve, sixteen, and ten digits, are recognized.
He should first place them in the heart with syllables of five, eight, six, and two components.

sanskrit_iast:
athākāśādisthaleṣu vāsudevādikāṃstataḥ /
vāsudevaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ //
meaning:
अथाकाशादिस्थलेषु वासुदेवादिकांस्ततः /
वासुदेवः संकर्षणः प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धकः //
text_mt:
Then, on the sites of space and the rest, those beginning with Vāsudeva:
Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, Aniruddha,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaśca kramaśaḥ parameṣṭhyādibhiryutāḥ /
parameṣṭhipumāñcchau caviśvanivṛttisarvakāḥ //
meaning:
नारायणश्च क्रमशः परमेष्ठ्यादिभिर्युताः /
परमेष्ठिपुमाञ्च्छौ चविश्वनिवृत्तिसर्वकाः //
text_mt:
and Nārāyaṇa in succession, united with Parameṣṭhin and the rest:
Parameṣṭhin, Puruṣa, Śauca, Viśva, and Nivṛtti-sarva;

sanskrit_iast:
śvetānilāgnyaṃbubhūmivarṇaiḥ prāgvatpravinyaset /
svabījādyaṃ kopatatvaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ vyāpakena ca //
meaning:
श्वेतानिलाग्न्यंबुभूमिवर्णैः प्राग्वत्प्रविन्यसेत् /
स्वबीजाद्यं कोपतत्वं नृसिंहं व्यापकेन च //
text_mt:
with syllables white, wind-, fire-, water-, and earth-colored, he should perform the ritual placement as before.
With the principle of wrath beginning with its own seed-syllable, and Nṛsiṃha as a pervasive placement,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvadvinyasya sarvāge tattvanyāso 'yamīritaḥ /
makārādyā ādyavarṇāḥ sarve syuścandrabhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
प्राग्वद्विन्यस्य सर्वागे तत्त्वन्यासो ऽयमीरितः /
मकाराद्या आद्यवर्णाः सर्वे स्युश्चन्द्रभूषिताः //
text_mt:
having placed it as before on all limbs, this ritual placement of elements has been described.
The initial syllables, beginning with ‘ma’, should all be adorned with the crescent moon;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevādikā jñeyā ṅeṃtāḥ sādhakasattamaiḥ /
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ //
meaning:
वासुदेवादिका ज्ञेया ङेंताः साधकसत्तमैः /
प्राणायामं ततः कृत्वा पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः //
text_mt:
those beginning with Vāsudeva are to be known by the best of practitioners as ending in the dative case.
Then, performing breath-control with inhalation, retention, and exhalation,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ ṣaḍbhardvābhyāṃ ca mūlamantreṇa mantravit /
kecidāhurihācāryāḥ prāṇāyāmottaraṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भिः षड्भर्द्वाभ्यां च मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् /
केचिदाहुरिहाचार्याः प्राणायामोत्तरं पुनः //
text_mt:
with four, six, and two repetitions of the root mantra, the knower of mantras [should proceed].
Some teachers here state that after breath-control,

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhanyāsaṃ vidhāyātha nyāsānanyānsamācaret /
daśatattvādi vinyasya vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
पीठन्यासं विधायाथ न्यासानन्यान्समाचरेत् /
दशतत्त्वादि विन्यस्य वक्ष्यमाणविधानतः //
text_mt:
having performed the ritual placement of the seat, he should perform the other ritual placements.
Having placed the ten elements and so forth according to the rule to be explained,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtipañjaranāmānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ /
sarvāṅge vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā kirīṭamanunā sudhīḥ //
meaning:
मूर्तिपञ्जरनामानं पूर्वोक्तं विन्यसेद्बुधः /
सर्वाङ्गे व्यापकं कृत्वा किरीटमनुना सुधीः //
text_mt:
the wise practitioner should perform the previously mentioned placement called Mūrtipañjara.
Having made a pervasive placement on all limbs with the crown mantra, the wise one [should proceed].

sanskrit_iast:
tatastārapuṭaṃ mantraṃ vyāpayya karayostriśaḥ /
pañcāṅgulīṣu karayoḥ pañcāṅgaṃ vinyasettataḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तारपुटं मन्त्रं व्यापय्य करयोस्त्रिशः /
पञ्चाङ्गुलीषु करयोः पञ्चाङ्गं विन्यसेत्ततः //
text_mt: Then, having pervaded the hands three times with the mantra enclosed by the praṇava, / he should next place the five limbs on the five fingers of the hands.

sanskrit_iast:
triśo mūlena mūrddhādipādāntaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyaset /
sakṛdvyāpayya tāreṇa mantranyāsaṃ tataścaret //
meaning:
त्रिशो मूलेन मूर्द्धादिपादान्तं व्यापकं न्यसेत् /
सकृद्व्यापय्य तारेण मन्त्रन्यासं ततश्चरेत् //
text_mt: With the root mantra, he should place a pervasion three times from head to foot. / Having pervaded once with the praṇava, he should then perform the nyāsa of the mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
śirolalāṭe bhrūmadhye karṇayoścakṣuṣostathā /
ghrāṇayorvadane kaṇṭhe hṛdi nābhau tathā punaḥ //
meaning:
शिरोललाटे भ्रूमध्ये कर्णयोश्चक्षुषोस्तथा /
घ्राणयोर्वदने कण्ठे हृदि नाभौ तथा पुनः //
text_mt: On the head, the forehead, between the eyebrows, on the ears and on the eyes, / on the nostrils, on the mouth, on the throat, on the heart, and again on the navel,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭyāṃ liṅge jānunośca pādayorvinyasetkramāt /
hṛdantānmantravarṇāṃśca tato mūrdhni dhruvaṃ nyaset //
meaning:
कट्यां लिङ्गे जानुनोश्च पादयोर्विन्यसेत्क्रमात् /
हृदन्तान्मन्त्रवर्णांश्च ततो मूर्ध्नि ध्रुवं न्यसेत् //
text_mt: on the hips, the penis, the knees, and the feet, he should place sequentially / the syllables of the mantra ending with the heart [syllables]; then he should place the praṇava on the crown of the head.

sanskrit_iast:
punarnayanayorāsye hṛdi guhye ca pādayoḥ /
vinyaseddhṛdayāntāni manoḥ pañcapadāni ca //
meaning:
पुनर्नयनयोरास्ये हृदि गुह्ये च पादयोः /
विन्यसेद्धृदयान्तानि मनोः पञ्चपदानि च //
text_mt: Again, on the eyes, mouth, heart, private parts, and feet, / he should place the five words of the mantra ending with the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo munyādikaṃ nyasya pañcāṅgaṃ pūrvavannyaset /
atha vakṣye mahāguhyaṃ sarvanyāsottamottamam //
meaning:
भूयो मुन्यादिकं न्यस्य पञ्चाङ्गं पूर्ववन्न्यसेत् /
अथ वक्ष्ये महागुह्यं सर्वन्यासोत्तमोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having placed the seer and the rest again, he should place the five limbs as before. / Now I shall declare the great secret, the best of the best of all nyāsas,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vijñānamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ /
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmīśvaraḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य विज्ञानमात्रेण जीवन्मुक्तो भवेन्नरः /
अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धीनामीश्वरः स्यान्न संशयः //
text_mt: by the mere knowledge of which a man becomes liberated while living, / and becomes the master of the eight supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, without doubt;

sanskrit_iast:
yasyārādhanato mantrī kṛṣṇasaṃnidhyatāṃ vrajet /
tārādyābhirvyāhṛtibhiḥ saṃpuṭaṃ vinyasenmanum //
meaning:
यस्याराधनतो मन्त्री कृष्णसंनिध्यतां व्रजेत् /
ताराद्याभिर्व्याहृतिभिः संपुटं विन्यसेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: by whose worship the practitioner of mantra attains proximity to Kṛṣṇa. / He should place the mantra enclosed by the sacred utterances preceded by the praṇava;

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa puṭitāṃścāpi praṇavādyāṃstato nyaset /
gāyatryā puṭutaṃ mantraṃ vinyasenmātṛkāsthale //
meaning:
मन्त्रेण पुटितांश्चापि प्रणवाद्यांस्ततो न्यसेत् /
गायत्र्या पुटुतं मन्त्रं विन्यसेन्मातृकास्थले //
text_mt: and then he should place them, enclosed by the mantra, preceded by the praṇava. / He should place the mantra enclosed by the gāyatrī in the positions of the mātṛkā letters;

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa puṭitāṃ tāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ vinyasetkramāt /
mātṛkāpuṭitaṃ mūlaṃ vinyasetsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेण पुटितां तां च गायत्रीं विन्यसेत्क्रमात् /
मातृकापुटितं मूलं विन्यसेत्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: and sequentially he should place that gāyatrī enclosed by the mantra. / The best of practitioners should place the root mantra enclosed by the mātṛkā;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlena puṭitāṃ caiva mātṛkāṃ vinyasetkramāt /
tṛcaṃ na mātṛkāvarṇānpūrvaṃ tattatsthale sudhīḥ //
meaning:
मूलेन पुटितां चैव मातृकां विन्यसेत्क्रमात् /
तृचं न मातृकावर्णान्पूर्वं तत्तत्स्थले सुधीः //
text_mt: and sequentially he should place the mātṛkā enclosed by the root mantra. / The wise one should first place the three verses, not the mātṛkā letters, in their respective locations;

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasennyāsaṣaṭkaṃ ca ṣoḍhā nyāso 'yamīritaḥ /
anena nyāsavaryeṇa sākṣātkṛṣṇasamo bhavet //
meaning:
विन्यसेन्न्यासषट्कं च षोढा न्यासो ऽयमीरितः /
अनेन न्यासवर्येण साक्षात्कृष्णसमो भवेत् //
text_mt: and he should place the set of six nyāsas; this is declared as the sixfold nyāsa. / By this excellent nyāsa, he becomes equal to Kṛṣṇa himself.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsena puṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ /
devā api namantyenaṃ kiṃpunarmānavā bhuvi //
meaning:
न्यासेन पुटितं दृष्ट्वा सिद्धगन्धर्वकिन्नराः /
देवा अपि नमन्त्येनं किंपुनर्मानवा भुवि //
text_mt: Seeing him enclosed by this nyāsa, the Siddhas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras, / even the gods bow down to him, what to speak of mortals on earth?

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanasya mantreṇa kuryāddigbandhanaṃ tataḥ /
devaṃ dhyāyansvahṛdaye sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam //
meaning:
सुदर्शनस्य मन्त्रेण कुर्याद्दिग्बन्धनं ततः /
देवं ध्यायन्स्वहृदये सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: Then, with the mantra of Sudarśana, he should perform the sealing of the quarters, / meditating in his heart upon the Lord, the granter of all desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
utphullakusumavrātanamraśākhairvaradrumaiḥ /
sasmeyamañjarīvṛndavallarīveṣṭitaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
उत्फुल्लकुसुमव्रातनम्रशाखैर्वरद्रुमैः /
सस्मेयमञ्जरीवृन्दवल्लरीवेष्टितैः शुभैः //
text_mt: With excellent trees whose branches bow under masses of blooming flowers, / embraced by auspicious creepers with clusters of blossoming buds,

sanskrit_iast:
galatparāgadhūlibhiḥ surabhīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ /
smarecchiśiritaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ mantrīsamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
गलत्परागधूलिभिः सुरभीकृतदिङ्मुखः /
स्मरेच्छिशिरितं वृन्दावनं मन्त्रीसमाहितः //
text_mt: whose quarters are perfumed by falling pollen dust, / cool and tranquil—the collected practitioner of mantra should meditate on Vṛndāvana;

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlannavakañjālivigalanmadhusaṃcayaiḥ /
lubdhāntaḥ karaṇairguñjaddvirephapaṭalaiḥ śubham //
meaning:
उन्मीलन्नवकञ्जालिविगलन्मधुसंचयैः /
लुब्धान्तः करणैर्गुञ्जद्द्विरेफपटलैः शुभम् //
text_mt: auspicious with swarms of humming bees whose inner faculties are greedy / for the flowing streams of honey from the opening rows of fresh lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
marālaparabhṛtkīrakapotanikarairmuhuḥ /
mukharīkṛtamānṛtyanmāyūrakulamañjulam //
meaning:
मरालपरभृत्कीरकपोतनिकरैर्मुहुः /
मुखरीकृतमानृत्यन्मायूरकुलमञ्जुलम् //
text_mt: constantly made resonant by flocks of swans, cuckoos, parrots, and pigeons, / delightful with crowds of peacocks dancing around;

sanskrit_iast:
kālindyā lolakallolavipruṣairmandavāhibhiḥ /
unnidrāṃburuhavrātarajobhirdhūsaraiḥ śivaiḥ //
meaning:
कालिन्द्या लोलकल्लोलविप्रुषैर्मन्दवाहिभिः /
उन्निद्रांबुरुहव्रातरजोभिर्धूसरैः शिवैः //
text_mt: continually attended by gentle, auspicious breezes carrying drops from the rolling waves of the Kālindī, / grey with the pollen of masses of blooming lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
pradīpita smarairgoṣṭhasuṃdarīmṛduvāsasām /
vilolanaparaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ vā tairnirantaram //
meaning:
प्रदीपित स्मरैर्गोष्ठसुंदरीमृदुवाससाम् /
विलोलनपरैः संसेवितं वा तैर्निरन्तरम् //
text_mt: which inflame passion and flutter the soft garments / of the beautiful women of the cowherd settlement.

sanskrit_iast:
smarettadante gīrvāṇabhūruhaṃ sumanoharam /
tadadhaḥ svarṇavedyāṃ ca ratnapīṭhamanuttamam //
meaning:
स्मरेत्तदन्ते गीर्वाणभूरुहं सुमनोहरम् /
तदधः स्वर्णवेद्यां च रत्नपीठमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: At its edge, he should meditate on the exceedingly charming celestial tree, / and beneath it, on a golden altar, on an unsurpassed jewel-seat.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakuṭṭimapīṭhe 'sminnaruṇaṃ kamalaṃ smaret /
aṣṭapatraṃ ca tanmadhye mukundaṃ saṃsmaretsthitam //
meaning:
रत्नकुट्टिमपीठे ऽस्मिन्नरुणं कमलं स्मरेत् /
अष्टपत्रं च तन्मध्ये मुकुन्दं संस्मरेत्स्थितम् //
text_mt: Upon this jeweled platform-seat he should meditate on a reddish lotus / with eight petals, and in its center he should meditate on Mukunda, standing:

sanskrit_iast:
phullendīvarakāntaṃ ca kekibarhāvataṃsakam /
pītāṃśukaṃ candramukhaṃ sarasīruhanetrakam //
meaning:
फुल्लेन्दीवरकान्तं च केकिबर्हावतंसकम् /
पीतांशुकं चन्द्रमुखं सरसीरुहनेत्रकम् //
text_mt: lovely as a blossomed blue lotus, adorned with a peacock feather crest, / wearing yellow garments, moon-faced, with lotus eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgaṃ ca śrīvatsāṃkaṃ subhūṣitam /
vrajastrīnetrakamalābhyarcitaṃ gogaṇāvṛtam //
meaning:
कौस्तुभोद्भासिताङ्गं च श्रीवत्सांकं सुभूषितम् /
व्रजस्त्रीनेत्रकमलाभ्यर्चितं गोगणावृतम् //
text_mt: his body illumined by the Kaustubha gem, marked with the Śrīvatsa, well adorned, / adored by the lotus-eyes of the women of Vraja, surrounded by herds of cows,

sanskrit_iast:
gopavṛndayutaṃ vaṃśīṃ vādayantaṃ smaretsudhīḥ /
evaṃ dhyātvā japedādāvayutadvitayaṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
गोपवृन्दयुतं वंशीं वादयन्तं स्मरेत्सुधीः /
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेदादावयुतद्वितयं बुधः //
text_mt: accompanied by crowds of cowherds, playing the flute—thus the wise one should meditate. / Having meditated thus, the wise practitioner should first recite [the mantra] twenty thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādaruṇāṃbhojaistaddaśāṃśaṃ samāhitaḥ /
japetpaścānmantrasiddhyai bhūtalakṣaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयादरुणांभोजैस्तद्दशांशं समाहितः /
जपेत्पश्चान्मन्त्रसिद्ध्यै भूतलक्षं समाहितः //
text_mt: Collected in mind, he should make fire oblations of a tenth of that with red lotuses; / thereafter, concentrated, he should recite a hundred thousand times for the accomplishment of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇaiḥ kamalaihutvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet /
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ //
meaning:
अरुणैः कमलैहुत्वा सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् /
पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः //
text_mt: Having offered oblations with red lotuses, he becomes the master of all supernatural powers. / Having projected the image with the root mantra on the previously mentioned Vaiṣṇava seat,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmāvāhya cābhyarcedgopījanamanoharam /
mukhe veṇuṃ samabhyarcya vanamālāṃ ca kaustubham //
meaning:
तस्यामावाह्य चाभ्यर्चेद्गोपीजनमनोहरम् /
मुखे वेणुं समभ्यर्च्य वनमालां च कौस्तुभम् //
text_mt: and having invoked therein, he should worship the enchanter of the cowherd women. / Having worshiped the flute at his mouth, and the forest garland and the Kaustubha gem,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsaṃ ca hṛdi prārcya tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet /
tataḥ śvetāṃ ca tulasīṃ śuklacandanapaṅkilām //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सं च हृदि प्रार्च्य ततः पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिपेत् /
ततः श्वेतां च तुलसीं शुक्लचन्दनपङ्किलाम् //
text_mt: and having worshiped the Śrīvatsa on his chest, he should then scatter a handful of flowers. / Then, with white tulasī smeared with white sandalwood paste,

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃ ca tulasīṃ raktañcadanāktāṃ krasātsudhīḥ /
arpayeddakṣiṇe jadvayamaśvāriyugmakam //
meaning:
रक्तां च तुलसीं रक्तञ्चदनाक्तां क्रसात्सुधीः /
अर्पयेद्दक्षिणे जद्वयमश्वारियुग्मकम् //
text_mt: and red tulasī smeared with red sandalwood paste, the wise one should sequentially / offer two lotuses and two oleanders on the right side;

sanskrit_iast:
hayamāradvayenaiva hṛdi mūrdhni tathā punaḥ /
padmadvayaṃ ca vidhivattataḥ śīrṣe samarpayet //
meaning:
हयमारद्वयेनैव हृदि मूर्ध्नि तथा पुनः /
पद्मद्वयं च विधिवत्ततः शीर्षे समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: with two oleanders on the heart and on the head; and again, / he should duly offer two lotuses on the head;

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīdvayamaṃbhojadvayamaśvāriyugmakam /
tataḥ sarvāṇi puṣpāṇi sarvāṅgeṣu samarpayet //
meaning:
तुलसीद्वयमंभोजद्वयमश्वारियुग्मकम् /
ततः सर्वाणि पुष्पाणि सर्वाङ्गेषु समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: two tulasīs, two lotuses, and two oleanders. / Then he should offer all varieties of flowers upon all the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe vāsudevākhyaṃ svacchaṃ caitanyamavyayam /
vāme ca rukmiṇīṃ tadūnnityāṃ raktāṃ rajoguṇām //
meaning:
दक्षिणे वासुदेवाख्यं स्वच्छं चैतन्यमव्ययम् /
वामे च रुक्मिणीं तदून्नित्यां रक्तां रजोगुणाम् //
text_mt: On the right side [he should worship] the one called Vāsudeva, pure, imperishable consciousness; / and on the left side, Rukmiṇī, eternal, red, endowed with the quality of passion.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya gopālaṃ kuryādāvaraṇārcanam /
yajeddāmasudāmau ca vasudāmaṃ ca kiṅkiṇīm //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य गोपालं कुर्यादावरणार्चनम् /
यजेद्दामसुदामौ च वसुदामं च किङ्किणीम् //
text_mt: Having thus worshiped Gopāla, he should perform the worship of the surrounding deities: / he should worship Dāma and Sudāman, Vasudāma and Kiṅkiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādyāśāsu dāmādyā ṅeṃnamontadhruvādikāḥ /
agninairṛtivāyvīśakoṇeṣu hṛdayādikān //
meaning:
पूर्वाद्याशासु दामाद्या ङेंनमोन्तध्रुवादिकाः /
अग्निनैरृतिवाय्वीशकोणेषु हृदयादिकान् //
text_mt: In the directions beginning with the east are Dāma and the rest, ending in the dative case and 'namaḥ' and preceded by the praṇava. / In the fire, south-west, north-west, and north-east corners, [he should worship] the heart and other limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
dikṣvastrāṇi samabhyarcya patreṣu mahiṣīryajet /
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca nāgnajityabhidhā punaḥ //
meaning:
दिक्ष्वस्त्राणि समभ्यर्च्य पत्रेषु महिषीर्यजेत् /
रुक्मिणी सत्यभामा च नाग्नजित्यभिधा पुनः //
text_mt: Having worshipped the weapons in the directions, one should worship the queens on the petals: / Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, and next the one named Nāgnajitī,

sanskrit_iast:
suvindā mitravindā ca lakṣmaṇā carkṣajā tataḥ /
suśīlā ca lasadramyacitritāṃbarabhūṣaṇā //
meaning:
सुविन्दा मित्रविन्दा च लक्ष्मणा चर्क्षजा ततः /
सुशीला च लसद्रम्यचित्रितांबरभूषणा //
text_mt: Suvindā, Mitravindā, Lakṣmaṇā, and then the daughter of the bear [Jāmbavatī], / and Suśīlā, adorned with shining, charming, variegated garments and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yajeddalāgreṣu vasudevañca devakīm /
nandagopaṃ yaśodāṃ ca balabhadraṃ subhadrikām //
meaning:
ततो यजेद्दलाग्रेषु वसुदेवञ्च देवकीम् /
नन्दगोपं यशोदां च बलभद्रं सुभद्रिकाम् //
text_mt: Then, upon the tips of the petals, one should worship Vasudeva and Devakī, / Nandagopa and Yaśodā, Balabhadra and Subhadrā,

sanskrit_iast:
gopānūgopīśca govindavilīnamatilocanān /
jñānamudrābhayakarau pitarau pītapāṇḍurau //
meaning:
गोपानूगोपीश्च गोविन्दविलीनमतिलोचनान् /
ज्ञानमुद्राभयकरौ पितरौ पीतपाण्डुरौ //
text_mt: and the cowherd men and cowherd women whose minds and eyes are merged in Govinda; / the two fathers, yellow and pale-white, their hands showing the gesture of wisdom and the gesture of fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
divyamālyāṃbarālepabhūṣaṇe mātarau punaḥ /
dhārayantyau caruṃ caiva pāyasīṃ pūrṇapātrikām //
meaning:
दिव्यमाल्यांबरालेपभूषणे मातरौ पुनः /
धारयन्त्यौ चरुं चैव पायसीं पूर्णपात्रिकाम् //
text_mt: and the two mothers, adorned with divine garlands, garments, unguents, and ornaments, / holding an offering of boiled rice and a full vessel containing milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇaśyāmale hāramaṇikuṃ ḍalamaṇḍite /
balaḥ śaṅkhendudhavalo muśalaṃ lāṅgalaṃ dadhat //
meaning:
अरुणश्यामले हारमणिकुं डलमण्डिते /
बलः शङ्खेन्दुधवलो मुशलं लाङ्गलं दधत् //
text_mt: [The two forms,] reddish and dark, adorned with necklaces and jeweled earrings. / Bala, white as a conch and the moon, holding a pestle and a plow,

sanskrit_iast:
hālālolo nīlavāsā halavānekakuṇḍalaḥ /
kalā yā śyāmalā bhadrā subhadrā bhadrabhūṣaṇā //
meaning:
हालालोलो नीलवासा हलवानेककुण्डलः /
कला या श्यामला भद्रा सुभद्रा भद्रभूषणा //
text_mt: impassioned with wine, wearing blue garments, holding a plow, wearing a single earring; / and Kalā, who is dark, auspicious Subhadrā adorned with auspicious ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
varābhayayutā pītavasanā rūḍhayauvanā /
veṇuvīṇāhemayaṣṭiśaṅkhaśṛṅgādipāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
वराभययुता पीतवसना रूढयौवना /
वेणुवीणाहेमयष्टिशङ्खशृङ्गादिपाणयः //
text_mt: holding the gestures of boon and fearlessness, clad in yellow garments, of full youth; / and cowherds and cowherdesses holding flutes, vīṇās, golden staffs, conches, horns, and the like in their hands,

sanskrit_iast:
gopā gopyaśca vividhaprābhṛtānnakarāṃbujāḥ /
mandāradīṃśca tadbāhye pūjayetkalpapādapān //
meaning:
गोपा गोप्यश्च विविधप्राभृतान्नकरांबुजाः /
मन्दारदींश्च तद्बाह्ये पूजयेत्कल्पपादपान् //
text_mt: with lotus hands filled with various gifts and foods. / Outside of that, he should worship the wish-fulfilling trees beginning with Mandāra:

sanskrit_iast:
mandāraśca tathā saṃtānako vai pārijātakaḥ /
kalpadrumastataḥ paścāddhvaricandanasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
मन्दारश्च तथा संतानको वै पारिजातकः /
कल्पद्रुमस्ततः पश्चाद्ध्वरिचन्दनसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: Mandāra, Santānaka, Pārijāta, / then the Kalpadruma, and after that the one named Haricandana.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye dikṣu samabhyarcya bahiḥ śakrādikānyajet /
tadastrāṇi ca saṃpūjya yajetkṛṣṇāṣṭakena ca //
meaning:
मध्ये दिक्षु समभ्यर्च्य बहिः शक्रादिकान्यजेत् /
तदस्त्राणि च संपूज्य यजेत्कृष्णाष्टकेन च //
text_mt: Having worshiped in the center and in the directions, outside he should worship Indra and the other [guardians], / and having worshiped their weapons, he should also worship with the eight names of Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ ca vāsudevaṃ ca devakīnandanaṃ tathā /
nārāyaṇaṃ yaduśreṣṭhaṃ vārṣṇeyaṃ dharmapālakam //
meaning:
कृष्णं च वासुदेवं च देवकीनन्दनं तथा /
नारायणं यदुश्रेष्ठं वार्ष्णेयं धर्मपालकम् //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa, Vāsudeva, the son of Devakī, / Nārāyaṇa, the best of the Yadus, the descendant of Vṛṣṇi, the protector of dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
asurākrāntabhūbhārahāriṇaṃ pūjayettataḥ /
ebhirāvaraṇaiḥ pūjā kartavyāsukhairiṇaḥ //
meaning:
असुराक्रान्तभूभारहारिणं पूजयेत्ततः /
एभिरावरणैः पूजा कर्तव्यासुखैरिणः //
text_mt: and the remover of the burden of the earth overwhelmed by demons—he should then worship. / Worship with these surrounding deities should be performed by the seeker of happiness,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārasāgarotthīrtyai sarvakāmāptaye budhaḥ /
evaṃ pūjādibhiḥ siddhā bhavadvaiśravaṇo yamaḥ //
meaning:
संसारसागरोत्थीर्त्यै सर्वकामाप्तये बुधः /
एवं पूजादिभिः सिद्धा भवद्वैश्रवणो यमः //
text_mt: for crossing the ocean of worldly existence and for the attainment of all desires, by the wise one. / Through such worship and rites, Kubera and Yama attained their status.

sanskrit_iast:
trikālapūjanaṃ cāsya vakṣye sarvārthasiddhidam /
śrīmadudyānasaṃvītihemabhūratnamaṇḍape //
meaning:
त्रिकालपूजनं चास्य वक्ष्ये सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् /
श्रीमदुद्यानसंवीतिहेमभूरत्नमण्डपे //
text_mt: I shall declare the worship of him at the three junctures of the day, which grants the accomplishment of all aims: / In a jewel-pavilion on golden ground surrounded by a glorious garden,

sanskrit_iast:
lasatkalpadrumādhastharatnābjapīṭhasaṃsthitam /
sutrāmaratnasaṃkāśaṃ guḍasnigdhālakaṃ śiśum //
meaning:
लसत्कल्पद्रुमाधस्थरत्नाब्जपीठसंस्थितम् /
सुत्रामरत्नसंकाशं गुडस्निग्धालकं शिशुम् //
text_mt: seated on a jewel-lotus seat beneath a radiant wish-fulfilling tree, / resembling sapphire, a child with locks glossy as molasses,

sanskrit_iast:
calatkanakakuṇḍalollasitacārugaṇḍasthalaṃ sughoṇadharamadbhutasmitamukhāṃvutaṃ sundaram /
sphuradvimalaratnayukkanakasūtranaddha dadhatsuvarṇaparimaṇḍitaṃ subhagapaiṇḍarīkaṃ nakham //
meaning:
चलत्कनककुण्डलोल्लसितचारुगण्डस्थलं सुघोणधरमद्भुतस्मितमुखांवुतं सुन्दरम् /
स्फुरद्विमलरत्नयुक्कनकसूत्रनद्ध दधत्सुवर्णपरिमण्डितं सुभगपैण्डरीकं नखम् //
text_mt: his lovely cheeks glowing with trembling golden earrings, with a well-formed nose and lips, with a wondrously smiling lotus-face, handsome, / wearing an auspicious tiger-claw pendant ornamented with gold, tied with a golden cord joined with sparkling, pure jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
samuddhūsarorasthale dhenudhūlyā supuṣṭāṅgamaṣṭāpadākalpadīptam /
kaṭīlasthale cārujaṅghāntayugmaṃ pinaddhaṃ kvaṇatkiṅkiṇījāladāmnā //
meaning:
समुद्धूसरोरस्थले धेनुधूल्या सुपुष्टाङ्गमष्टापदाकल्पदीप्तम् /
कटीलस्थले चारुजङ्घान्तयुग्मं पिनद्धं क्वणत्किङ्किणीजालदाम्ना //
text_mt:
whose chest is covered with the dust of cows, whose limbs are well nourished, who shines with gold ornaments,
and around the area of whose waist and lovely pair of shanks is fastened a cord bearing a network of tinkling small bells;

sanskrit_iast:
hasantaṃ hasadvandhujīvaprasūnaprabhāpāṇipādāṃbujodārakāntyā /
dadhānaṃ karo dakṣiṇe pāyasānna suhaiyaṅgavīnaṃ tathā vāmahaste //
meaning:
हसन्तं हसद्वन्धुजीवप्रसूनप्रभापाणिपादांबुजोदारकान्त्या /
दधानं करो दक्षिणे पायसान्न सुहैयङ्गवीनं तथा वामहस्ते //
text_mt:
who is smiling, whose hands and lotus feet have the noble splendor of blooming bandhujīva blossoms,
holding sweet milk-rice in his right hand, and fresh butter in his left hand;

sanskrit_iast:
lasadgopagopīgavāṃ vṛndamadhye sthitaṃ vāsavādyaiḥ surairarcitāndhrim /
mahābhārabhūtāmarārātiyūthāṃstataḥ pūtanādīnnihṝntuṃ pravṛttam //
meaning:
लसद्गोपगोपीगवां वृन्दमध्ये स्थितं वासवाद्यैः सुरैरर्चितान्ध्रिम् /
महाभारभूतामरारातियूथांस्ततः पूतनादीन्निहॄन्तुं प्रवृत्तम् //
text_mt:
standing in the midst of a shining throng of cowherds, cowherdesses, and cows, his feet worshipped by the gods headed by Indra,
and engaged in slaying Pūtanā and others, the hosts of enemies of the gods who had become a great burden [to the earth]—

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvārccayeddevaṃ pūrvavatsthiramānasaḥ /
dadhnā guḍena naivedyaṃ datvā daśaśataṃ japet //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार्च्चयेद्देवं पूर्ववत्स्थिरमानसः /
दध्ना गुडेन नैवेद्यं दत्वा दशशतं जपेत् //
text_mt:
having meditated thus, one should worship the deity as before with a steady mind.
Having offered food-oblations with curds and molasses, one should recite [the mantra] a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyandine yajedevaṃ viśiṣyarūpadhāriṇam /
nāradādyairmunigaṇaiḥ suravṛndaiśca pūjitam //
meaning:
मध्यन्दिने यजेदेवं विशिष्यरूपधारिणम् /
नारदाद्यैर्मुनिगणैः सुरवृन्दैश्च पूजितम् //
text_mt:
At midday, one should thus worship the deity assuming a special form,
worshipped by hosts of sages headed by Nārada and by the throngs of gods:

sanskrit_iast:
lasadgopagopīgavāṃ vṛndamadhyastitaṃ sāṃdrameghaprabhaṃsuṃndarāṅgam /
śikhaṇḍicchadāpīḍamabjāyatākṣaṃ lasañcillikaṃ pūrṇacadrānanaṃ ca //
meaning:
लसद्गोपगोपीगवां वृन्दमध्यस्तितं सांद्रमेघप्रभंसुंन्दराङ्गम् /
शिखण्डिच्छदापीडमब्जायताक्षं लसञ्चिल्लिकं पूर्णचद्राननं च //
text_mt:
standing in the midst of a shining throng of cowherds, cowherdesses, and cows, having the complexion of a dense cloud, having handsome limbs,
with a crest of peacock feathers, long eyes like lotus petals, shining eyebrows, and a face like the full moon;

sanskrit_iast:
calatkuṇḍalollāsigaṇḍasthalaśrībharaṃ sundaraṃ mandahāsaṃ sunāsam /
sukārtasvarābhāṃbaraṃ divyabhūṣaṃ kvaṇatkiṅkiṇījālamattānulepam //
meaning:
चलत्कुण्डलोल्लासिगण्डस्थलश्रीभरं सुन्दरं मन्दहासं सुनासम् /
सुकार्तस्वराभांबरं दिव्यभूषं क्वणत्किङ्किणीजालमत्तानुलेपम् //
text_mt:
bearing an abundance of beauty on his cheek-surfaces illuminated by moving earrings, handsome, with a gentle smile, a fine nose,
garbed in garments with the brilliance of fine gold, wearing divine ornaments, with a network of tinkling small bells, anointed with intoxicating fragrance;

sanskrit_iast:
veṇuṃ dhamantaṃ svakare dadhānaṃ savye daraṃ yaṣṭimudāraveṣam /
dakṣe tathaivepsitadānadakṣaṃ dhyātvārcayennandajamindirāptyai //
meaning:
वेणुं धमन्तं स्वकरे दधानं सव्ये दरं यष्टिमुदारवेषम् /
दक्षे तथैवेप्सितदानदक्षं ध्यात्वार्चयेन्नन्दजमिन्दिराप्त्यै //
text_mt:
blowing his flute, holding the conch and staff in his left hands, dressed in noble attire,
and similarly in his right hands capable of bestowing desired gifts—having meditated upon Nanda's son, one should worship him to attain Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvārcayetkṛṣṇaṃ pūrvavadvaiṣṇavottamaḥ /
apūpapāyasānnādyairnaivaidyaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार्चयेत्कृष्णं पूर्ववद्वैष्णवोत्तमः /
अपूपपायसान्नाद्यैर्नैवैद्यं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
Having meditated thus, the best of Vaiṣṇavas should worship Kṛṣṇa as before;
he should arrange an offering of food consisting of sweet cakes, milk-rice, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā cāṣṭattaraśataṃ payo 'naiḥ sarpiṣāplutaiḥ /
svasvadikṣu baliṃ dadyāddiśedācamanaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
हुत्वा चाष्टत्तरशतं पयो ऽनैः सर्पिषाप्लुतैः /
स्वस्वदिक्षु बलिं दद्याद्दिशेदाचमनं ततः //
text_mt:
And having offered a hundred and eight oblations into the fire with cooked milk-rice inundated with ghee,
he should offer food-tributes in each direction, and then present water for sipping.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭttarasahasraṃ ca prajapenmantramuttamam /
ahno madhye yajedevaṃ yaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ //
meaning:
अष्ट्त्तरसहस्रं च प्रजपेन्मन्त्रमुत्तमम् /
अह्नो मध्ये यजेदेवं यः कृष्णं वैष्णवोत्तमः //
text_mt:
And he should mutter the excellent mantra one thousand and eight times.
The best of Vaiṣṇavas who thus worships Kṛṣṇa at midday—

sanskrit_iast:
devāḥ sarve namasyanti lokānāṃ vallabho naraḥ /
medhāyuḥśrīkāntiyuktaḥ putraiḥ pautraiśca varddhate //
meaning:
देवाः सर्वे नमस्यन्ति लोकानां वल्लभो नरः /
मेधायुःश्रीकान्तियुक्तः पुत्रैः पौत्रैश्च वर्द्धते //
text_mt:
all the gods bow down to him; that man becomes dear to the worlds;
endowed with intelligence, long life, fortune, and beauty, he prospers with sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyakālapūjāyāmasti kālavikalpanā /
sāyāhne niśi vetyatra vadantyeke vipaścitaḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयकालपूजायामस्ति कालविकल्पना /
सायाह्ने निशि वेत्यत्र वदन्त्येके विपश्चितः //
text_mt:
Concerning the worship at the third period [of the day], there is an option regarding time:
'in the evening or at night,' so say some learned men.

sanskrit_iast:
daśākṣareṇa cedrātrau sāyāhne 'ṣṭādaśārṇataḥ /
ubhayīmubhayenaiva kuryādityapare jaguḥ //
meaning:
दशाक्षरेण चेद्रात्रौ सायाह्ने ऽष्टादशार्णतः /
उभयीमुभयेनैव कुर्यादित्यपरे जगुः //
text_mt:
If at night, [it should be done] with the ten-syllabled mantra; in the evening, with the eighteen-syllabled mantra;
others have declared: 'One may perform both with both.'

sanskrit_iast:
sāyāhne dvāravatyāṃ tu citrodyānopaśobhite /
aṣṭasāhasrasaṃkhyātairbhavanairupamaṇḍite //
meaning:
सायाह्ने द्वारवत्यां तु चित्रोद्यानोपशोभिते /
अष्टसाहस्रसंख्यातैर्भवनैरुपमण्डिते //
text_mt:
In the evening, however, [one should meditate on him] in Dvārakā, adorned with marvelous gardens,
embellished with sixteen thousand mansions,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasārasasaṃkīrṇakamalotpalaśālibhiḥ /
sarobhirnīlāṃbhobhiḥ parīte bhavanottame //
meaning:
हंससारससंकीर्णकमलोत्पलशालिभिः /
सरोभिर्नीलांभोभिः परीते भवनोत्तमे //
text_mt:
surrounded by lakes of blue water crowded with swans and cranes
and rich in lotuses and water-lilies, within an excellent palace,

sanskrit_iast:
udyatpradyotanodyotadyutau śrīmaṇimaṇḍale /
hemāṃbhojāsanāsīnaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ trailokyamohanam //
meaning:
उद्यत्प्रद्योतनोद्योतद्युतौ श्रीमणिमण्डले /
हेमांभोजासनासीनं कृष्णं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् //
text_mt:
in an auspicious circle of jewels radiant with the splendor of the rising sun,
seated on a golden lotus seat, Kṛṣṇa, the enchanter of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
munivṛndaiḥ parivṛtamātmatattvavinirṇaye /
tebhyo munibhyaḥ svaṃ dhāma diśantaṃ paramakṣaram //
meaning:
मुनिवृन्दैः परिवृतमात्मतत्त्वविनिर्णये /
तेभ्यो मुनिभ्यः स्वं धाम दिशन्तं परमक्षरम् //
text_mt:
surrounded by hosts of sages to ascertain the truth of the Self,
pointing out his own supreme and imperishable abode to those sages;

sanskrit_iast:
unnidredīvaraśyāmaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam /
snigdhaṃ kuntalasaṃbhinnakirīṭavanamālinam //
meaning:
उन्निद्रेदीवरश्यामं पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणम् /
स्निग्धं कुन्तलसंभिन्नकिरीटवनमालिनम् //
text_mt:
dark like a blooming blue lotus, with long eyes like lotus petals,
sleek, wearing a crown intermingled with locks of hair, and wearing a woodland garland;

sanskrit_iast:
cāruprasannavadanaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam /
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhaṃ sumanoharam //
meaning:
चारुप्रसन्नवदनं स्फुरन्मकरकुण्डलम् /
श्रीवत्सवक्षसं भ्राजत्कौस्तुभं सुमनोहरम् //
text_mt:
with a lovely, serene face, with glittering alligator-shaped earrings,
with the Śrīvatsa on his chest, with the shining Kaustubha gem, enchanting the mind;

sanskrit_iast:
kāśmīrakapiśoraskaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam /
hārakeyūrakaṭakakaṭisūtrairalaṅkṛtam //
meaning:
काश्मीरकपिशोरस्कं पीतकौशेयवाससम् /
हारकेयूरकटककटिसूत्रैरलङ्कृतम् //
text_mt:
whose chest is tawny with saffron, who wears yellow silk garments,
adorned with necklaces, armlets, bracelets, and a waist-cord;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtaviśvaṃbharābhūribhāraṃ muditamānasam /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmarājadbhujacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
हृतविश्वंभराभूरिभारं मुदितमानसम् /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मराजद्भुजचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
who has removed the heavy burden of the earth, joyful at heart,
whose four arms shine with the conch, discus, club, and lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvārcayenmantrī syādaṅgaiḥ prathamāvṛttiḥ /
dvitīyā mahiṣībhistu tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार्चयेन्मन्त्री स्यादङ्गैः प्रथमावृत्तिः /
द्वितीया महिषीभिस्तु तृतीयायां समर्चयेत् //
text_mt:
Having meditated thus, the practitioner of mantras should worship. The first circuit should consist of the [six] limbs;
the second, however, of his chief queens; in the third, he should worship

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaṃ parvataṃ jiṣṇuṃ niśaṭhoddhavadārukān /
viṣvaksenaṃ ca śaineyaṃ dikṣvagre vinatāsutam //
meaning:
नारदं पर्वतं जिष्णुं निशठोद्धवदारुकान् /
विष्वक्सेनं च शैनेयं दिक्ष्वग्रे विनतासुतम् //
text_mt:
Nārada, Parvata, Arjuna, Niśaṭha, Uddhava, and Dāruka,
as well as Viṣvaksena and Sātyaki in the directions, and the son of Vinatā in front.

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālaiśca vajrādyaiḥ pūjayedvaiṣṇavottamaḥ /
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatpāyasaṃ vinivedayet //
meaning:
लोकपालैश्च वज्राद्यैः पूजयेद्वैष्णवोत्तमः /
एवं संपूज्य विधिवत्पायसं विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt:
The best of Vaiṣṇavas should worship [the fourth circuit] with the world-protectors and their weapons such as the thunderbolt.
Having thus worshipped according to rule, he should offer milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayitvā khaṇḍamiśradugdhabuddhyā jalairiha /
japedaṣṭaśataṃ mantrī bhāvayanpuruṣottamam //
meaning:
तर्पयित्वा खण्डमिश्रदुग्धबुद्ध्या जलैरिह /
जपेदष्टशतं मन्त्री भावयन्पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Having offered water-gratification here with water considered to be milk mixed with candied sugar,
the practitioner of mantras should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times, meditating on the Supreme Person.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāsu homaṃ sarvāsu kuryānmadhyandine 'thavā /
āsanādarghyaparyantaṃ kṛtvā stutvā nametsudhīḥ //
meaning:
पूजासु होमं सर्वासु कुर्यान्मध्यन्दिने ऽथवा /
आसनादर्घ्यपर्यन्तं कृत्वा स्तुत्वा नमेत्सुधीः //
text_mt:
In all these acts of worship, or at midday, one should perform a fire oblation.
Having performed [the rites] from the seat up to the water offering, the wise person should praise and bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
samarthātmānamudvāsya svīyahṛtsarasīruhe /
vinyasya tanmayo bhūtvā punarātmānamarcayet //
meaning:
समर्थात्मानमुद्वास्य स्वीयहृत्सरसीरुहे /
विन्यस्य तन्मयो भूत्वा पुनरात्मानमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Bidding farewell to the deity, and establishing him, fully capable, / within the lotus of his own heart, becoming one with him, he should again worship himself.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyāhne vāsudevaṃ yo nityamevaṃ samarcayet /
sarvānkāmānavāpyānte sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
सायाह्ने वासुदेवं यो नित्यमेवं समर्चयेत् /
सर्वान्कामानवाप्यान्ते स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt:
He who always worships Vāsudeva thus in the evening,
having attained all desires, goes in the end to the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau cenmadanākrāntacetasaṃ nandanandanam /
yajedrāsapariśrāntaṃ gopīmaṇḍalamadhyagam //
meaning:
रात्रौ चेन्मदनाक्रान्तचेतसं नन्दनन्दनम् /
यजेद्रासपरिश्रान्तं गोपीमण्डलमध्यगम् //
text_mt:
If at night, one should worship the son of Nanda whose heart is overcome with passion,
fatigued by the rāsa dance, standing in the midst of the circle of cowherdesses,

sanskrit_iast:
vikasatkundakahlāramallikākusumodgataiḥ /
rajobhirdhūsarairmandamārutaiḥ śiśirīkṛte //
meaning:
विकसत्कुन्दकह्लारमल्लिकाकुसुमोद्गतैः /
रजोभिर्धूसरैर्मन्दमारुतैः शिशिरीकृते //
text_mt:
made cool by gentle breezes gray with the pollen
arising from the blossoms of blooming kunda, kahlāra, and mallikā jasmines,

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlannavakairavālivigalanmādhvīkalabdhāntaraṃ bhrāmyanmattamilindagītalalite sanmallikojjṛmbhite /
pīyūṣāṃśukarairviśālitaharitprānte smaroddīpane kālindīpulināṅgaṇe smitamukhaṃ veṇuṃ raṇantaṃ muhuḥ //
meaning:
उन्मीलन्नवकैरवालिविगलन्माध्वीकलब्धान्तरं भ्राम्यन्मत्तमिलिन्दगीतललिते सन्मल्लिकोज्जृम्भिते /
पीयूषांशुकरैर्विशालितहरित्प्रान्ते स्मरोद्दीपने कालिन्दीपुलिनाङ्गणे स्मितमुखं वेणुं रणन्तं मुहुः //
text_mt:
in an open courtyard on the bank of the Yamunā that inflames desire, where the directions are expanded by the nectar-rays [of the moon],
blossoming with fine mallikā jasmines, charming with the songs of intoxicated bees wandering into the openings of the dripping nectar of rows of blooming fresh night-lotuses, smiling-faced, repeatedly sounding the flute,

sanskrit_iast:
antastoyalasannavāṃbudaghaṭāsaṃghaṭṭakāratviṣaṃ cañcañcillikamaṃbujāyatadṛśaṃ bimbādharaṃ sundaram /
māyūracchadabaddhamaulivilasaddhaṃmillamālaṃ calaṃ dīpyatkuṇḍalaratnaraśmivilasadgaṇḍadvayodbāsitam //
meaning:
अन्तस्तोयलसन्नवांबुदघटासंघट्टकारत्विषं चञ्चञ्चिल्लिकमंबुजायतदृशं बिम्बाधरं सुन्दरम् /
मायूरच्छदबद्धमौलिविलसद्धंमिल्लमालं चलं दीप्यत्कुण्डलरत्नरश्मिविलसद्गण्डद्वयोद्बासितम् //
text_mt:
having the luster of an array of fresh water-bearing rainclouds, with dancing eyebrows, long lotus eyes, and bimba-fruit lips, handsome,
with a garland entwined in his braided hair on his head crowned with peacock feathers, moving, illuminated by his two cheeks radiant with the gems of his glittering earrings,

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcīnūpurahārakaṅkaṇalasatkeyūrabhūṣānvitaṃ gopīnāṃ dvitayāṃ tare sulalitaṃ vanyaprasūnasrajam /
anyonyaṃ vinibaddhagopadayitādorvallivītaṃ lasadrāsakrīḍanalolupaṃ manasijākrāntaṃ mukundaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
काञ्चीनूपुरहारकङ्कणलसत्केयूरभूषान्वितं गोपीनां द्वितयां तरे सुललितं वन्यप्रसूनस्रजम् /
अन्योन्यं विनिबद्धगोपदयितादोर्वल्लिवीतं लसद्रासक्रीडनलोलुपं मनसिजाक्रान्तं मुकुन्दं भवेत् //
text_mt:
endowed with ornaments of girdles, anklets, necklaces, bracelets, and gleaming armlets, graceful between pairs of cowherdesses, wearing a garland of forest flowers,
embraced by the creeper-like arms of the beloved cowherdesses linked together, Mukunda, eager for the splendid rāsa dance, overcome by love, should be [meditated upon]:

sanskrit_iast:
vividhaśrutibhinnamanojñatarasvarasaptakamūrchanatānagaṇaiḥ /
bhramamāṇamamūbhirudāramaṇisphuṭamaṇḍanasiṃjitacārutanum //
meaning:
विविधश्रुतिभिन्नमनोज्ञतरस्वरसप्तकमूर्छनतानगणैः /
भ्रममाणममूभिरुदारमणिस्फुटमण्डनसिंजितचारुतनुम् //
text_mt:
moving about with them through hosts of musical pauses and melodic expansions of the seven charming notes differentiated by various microtones,
his lovely body tinkling with clear ornaments of noble jewels;

sanskrit_iast:
itaretarabaddhakarapramadāgaṇakalpitarāsavihāravidhau /
maṇiśaṅkugamapyamunā vapuṣā bahudhā vihitasvakadivyatanum //
meaning:
इतरेतरबद्धकरप्रमदागणकल्पितरासविहारविधौ /
मणिशङ्कुगमप्यमुना वपुषा बहुधा विहितस्वकदिव्यतनुम् //
text_mt:
in the performance of the rāsa play devised by the throngs of women who held each other's hands,
though he stood at the jeweled post, he multiplied his divine body into many through that very form.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvārcayenmantrī syādaṅgaiḥ prathamāvṛtiḥ /
śrīkāmaḥ sasvarādyāni kalābjairvaiṣṇavottamaḥ //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार्चयेन्मन्त्री स्यादङ्गैः प्रथमावृतिः /
श्रीकामः सस्वराद्यानि कलाब्जैर्वैष्णवोत्तमः //
text_mt:
Having meditated thus, the practitioner of mantras should worship. The first circuit should consist of the [six] limbs.
Desiring prosperity, the best of Vaiṣṇavas, with the lotuses of parts starting with the vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
yajetkeśavakīrtyādimithunāni ca ṣoḍaśa /
indrādyānapi vajrādīnpūjayettadanantaram //
meaning:
यजेत्केशवकीर्त्यादिमिथुनानि च षोडश /
इन्द्राद्यानपि वज्रादीन्पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt:
should worship the sixteen pairs beginning with Keśava and Kīrti;
and immediately after that, he should worship Indra and the others, as well as the thunderbolt and the other [weapons].

sanskrit_iast:
pṛnthu suvṛttaṃ masṛṇaṃ vitastimātronnataṃ kau vinikhanya śaṅkum /
ākramya padbhyāmitaretaraistu hastairbhramo 'yaṃ khalu rāsagoṣṭhī //
meaning:
पृन्थु सुवृत्तं मसृणं वितस्तिमात्रोन्नतं कौ विनिखन्य शङ्कुम् /
आक्रम्य पद्भ्यामितरेतरैस्तु हस्तैर्भ्रमो ऽयं खलु रासगोष्ठी //
text_mt:
Having driven into the ground a thick, well-rounded, smooth peg only a span in height,
pressing it with their feet while holding hands with one another, this circling is indeed the gathering of the rāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
sapūjyaivaṃ ca payasā sasito palasarpiṣā /
naivedyamarcayitvā tu caṣakairnṛpasaṃkhyakaiḥ //
meaning:
सपूज्यैवं च पयसा ससितो पलसर्पिषा /
नैवेद्यमर्चयित्वा तु चषकैर्नृपसंख्यकैः //
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped, and having offered an oblation of food with milk, sugar-candy, and ghee
using sixteen cups,

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ pāpapte (?) mantrī mithuneṣvarpayetkramāt /
vidhāya pūrvavaccheṣaṃ sahasraṃ prajapenmanum //
meaning:
सततं पापप्ते (?) मन्त्री मिथुनेष्वर्पयेत्क्रमात् /
विधाय पूर्ववच्छेषं सहस्रं प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt:
the practitioner of mantras should continuously offer […] to the pairs in order;
having performed the remainder as before, he should recite the mantra a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
stutvā natvā ca saṃprārthya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet /
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ sa sasmṛddheḥ padaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
स्तुत्वा नत्वा च संप्रार्थ्य पूजाशेषं समापयेत् /
एवं यः पूजयेत्कृष्णं स सस्मृद्धेः पदं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Having praised, bowed, and prayed, he should complete the conclusion of the worship.
He who thus worships Kṛṣṇa becomes an abode of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmīśvaraḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ /
bhuktveha vividhānbhogānante viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धीनामीश्वरः स्यान्न संशयः /
भुक्त्वेह विविधान्भोगानन्ते विष्णुपदं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He will become a master of the eight supernatural powers such as atomicity, there is no doubt; / having enjoyed various delights in this world, he will go at the end to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pūjādibhiḥ siddhe manaukāmyāni sādhayet /
aṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ vā trikālaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
एवं पूजादिभिः सिद्धे मनौकाम्यानि साधयेत् /
अष्टाविंशतिवारं वा त्रिकालं पूजयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: Once the mantra has been thus mastered by worship and the like, he may accomplish his desired ends; / or the wise practitioner should worship three times a day, twenty-eight times [each].

sanskrit_iast:
svakālavihitān bhūyaḥ parivārāṃśca tarpayet /
prātarddadhnā guḍāktena madhyāhne payasā punaḥ //
meaning:
स्वकालविहितान् भूयः परिवारांश्च तर्पयेत् /
प्रातर्द्दध्ना गुडाक्तेन मध्याह्ने पयसा पुनः //
text_mt: He should again offer water-oblations to the retinue prescribed for their proper times: / in the morning with curd mixed with jaggery, and at midday with milk;

sanskrit_iast:
navanītayutenātha sāyāhne tarpayetpunaḥ /
sasitopalamiśreṇa payasā vaiṣṇavottamaḥ //
meaning:
नवनीतयुतेनाथ सायाह्ने तर्पयेत्पुनः /
ससितोपलमिश्रेण पयसा वैष्णवोत्तमः //
text_mt: then in the evening, the best of Vaiṣṇavas / should again offer water-oblations with milk mixed with fresh butter and rock sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayāmipadaṃ yojyaṃ mantrānte sveṣu nāmasu /
dvitīyānteṣu tu punaḥ pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet //
meaning:
तर्पयामिपदं योज्यं मन्त्रान्ते स्वेषु नामसु /
द्वितीयान्तेषु तु पुनः पूजाशेषं समापयेत् //
text_mt: The word ‘tarpayāmi’ should be joined at the end of the mantra to his own names / in the accusative case; and then he should conclude the remainder of the worship.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyukṣyatatprasādādbhirātmānaṃ prapabedapaḥ /
tattṛtpastamathodvāsya tanmayaḥ prajapenmanum //
meaning:
अभ्युक्ष्यतत्प्रसादाद्भिरात्मानं प्रपबेदपः /
तत्तृत्पस्तमथोद्वास्य तन्मयः प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: Sprinkling himself with the water of His prasāda, he should drink that water; / satisfied by it, having then dismissed Him, absorbed in Him, he should recite the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dravyāṇi kāmyeṣu procyante tarpaṇeṣu ca /
tāni proktavidhānānāmāśrityānyatamaṃ bhajet //
meaning:
अथ द्रव्याणि काम्येषु प्रोच्यन्ते तर्पणेषु च /
तानि प्रोक्तविधानानामाश्रित्यान्यतमं भजेत् //
text_mt: Now the substances used in desire-prompted rites and water-oblations are declared; / having resorted to any one of these prescribed offerings, he should worship:

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ dādhikaṃ cājyaṃ gauḍānnaṃ kṛsaraṃ payaḥ /
dadhīni kadalī mocā ciñcā rajasvalā tathā //
meaning:
पायसं दाधिकं चाज्यं गौडान्नं कृसरं पयः /
दधीनि कदली मोचा चिञ्चा रजस्वला तथा //
text_mt: Rice-pudding, curd-rice, clarified butter, molasses-rice, spiced rice-and-lentil mash, milk, / curds, plantain, banana, tamarind, and the citrus fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
apūpā modakā lājāḥ pṛthukā navanītakam /
dravyaṣoḍaśakaṃ hyetatkathitaṃ padmajādibhiḥ //
meaning:
अपूपा मोदका लाजाः पृथुका नवनीतकम् /
द्रव्यषोडशकं ह्येतत्कथितं पद्मजादिभिः //
text_mt: sweet cakes, round sweets, parched grains, flattened rice, and fresh butter: / these sixteen substances have indeed been declared by the lotus-born Brahmā and others.

sanskrit_iast:
lājānte pṛthukaṃ prākca samarpya ca sitopalam /
catuḥsaptativāraṃ yaḥ prātarevaṃ pratarpayet //
meaning:
लाजान्ते पृथुकं प्राक्च समर्प्य च सितोपलम् /
चतुःसप्ततिवारं यः प्रातरेवं प्रतर्पयेत् //
text_mt: Having offered flattened rice after parched grains, and rock sugar before, / he who thus offers water-oblations seventy-four times in the morning,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadaṃ matrī maṇḍalādiṣṭamāpnuyāt /
dhāroṣṇapakkapayasā navanītaṃ dadhīni ca //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा कृष्णपदं मत्री मण्डलादिष्टमाप्नुयात् /
धारोष्णपक्कपयसा नवनीतं दधीनि च //
text_mt: meditating on the feet of Kṛṣṇa, the mantrin will attain his desire within forty days. / With milk warm from the udder and boiled milk, fresh butter, curds,

sanskrit_iast:
daugdhāmrāmājyaṃ matsyaṇḍī kṣaudraṃ kīlālameva ca /
pūjayennavabhirdravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ ravisaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
दौग्धाम्रामाज्यं मत्स्यण्डी क्षौद्रं कीलालमेव च /
पूजयेन्नवभिर्द्रव्यैः प्रत्येकं रविसंख्यया //
text_mt: milky mango, clarified butter, candied sugar, honey, and water: / he should worship with these nine substances, each twelve times in number.

sanskrit_iast:
evamaṣṭotaraśataṃsaṃkhyākaṃ tarpaṇaṃ punaḥ /
yaḥ kuryādvaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhaḥ pūrvoktaṃ phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवमष्टोतरशतंसंख्याकं तर्पणं पुनः /
यः कुर्याद्वैष्णवश्रेष्ठः पूर्वोक्तं फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Whoever, the best of Vaiṣṇavas, thus performs a water-oblation / numbering one hundred and eight times, attains the fruit stated previously.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ bahūktena sarveṣṭadāyakaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tvidam /
sasitopaladhāroṣṇadugdhabuddhyā jalena vai //
meaning:
किं बहूक्तेन सर्वेष्टदायकं तर्पणं त्विदम् /
ससितोपलधारोष्णदुग्धबुद्ध्या जलेन वै //
text_mt: What need of saying much? This water-oblation bestows all desires: / by using water with the mental conception of milk warm from the udder mixed with rock sugar,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaṃ prataparyan grāmaṃ vrajanprāpnoti sādhakaḥ /
dhanavastrāṇi bhojyaṃ ca parivāragaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
कृष्णं प्रतपर्यन् ग्रामं व्रजन्प्राप्नोति साधकः /
धनवस्त्राणि भोज्यं च परिवारगणैः सह //
text_mt: a practitioner offering water-oblations to Kṛṣṇa while going to a village obtains / wealth, garments, food, and a retinue of attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsaṃtarpayenmantrī tāvatsaṃkhyaṃ japenmanum /
tarpaṇenaiva kāryāṇi sādhayedakhilānyapi //
meaning:
यावत्संतर्पयेन्मन्त्री तावत्संख्यं जपेन्मनुम् /
तर्पणेनैव कार्याणि साधयेदखिलान्यपि //
text_mt: As many times as the mantrin offers water-oblations, so many times he should recite the mantra; / by the water-oblation alone he can accomplish all undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyahomamatho vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca /
śrīpuṣpairjuhuyānmantrī śriyamicchannininditām //
meaning:
काम्यहोममथो वक्ष्ये साधकानां हिताय च /
श्रीपुष्पैर्जुहुयान्मन्त्री श्रियमिच्छन्निनिन्दिताम् //
text_mt: Now I shall declare the desire-prompted fire oblation for the welfare of practitioners: / the mantrin desiring unblemished fortune should offer oblations of lotus flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
sājyenānnena juhuyātghṛtānnasya samṛddhaye /
vanyapuṣpairdvijān jātīpuṣpaiśca pṛthivīpatīn //
meaning:
साज्येनान्नेन जुहुयात्घृतान्नस्य समृद्धये /
वन्यपुष्पैर्द्विजान् जातीपुष्पैश्च पृथिवीपतीन् //
text_mt: He should offer food mixed with clarified butter to obtain an abundance of food cooked in ghee; / he subjugates twice-born people with wild flowers, and kings with jasmine flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
asitaiḥ kusumairvaiśyān śūdrānnīlotpalaistathā /
vaśayellavaṇaiḥ sarvānaṃbujairyuvatījanam //
meaning:
असितैः कुसुमैर्वैश्यान् शूद्रान्नीलोत्पलैस्तथा /
वशयेल्लवणैः सर्वानंबुजैर्युवतीजनम् //
text_mt: vaiśyas with dark flowers, and śūdras with blue water-lilies; / he can subjugate all people with salts, and young women with lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
gośālāsu kṛto homaḥ pāyasena sasarpiṣā /
gavāṃ śāntiṃ karotyāśu gopālo gokuleśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गोशालासु कृतो होमः पायसेन ससर्पिषा /
गवां शान्तिं करोत्याशु गोपालो गोकुलेश्वरः //
text_mt: A fire oblation performed in cowsheds with rice-pudding mixed with clarified butter / quickly brings peace to the cows, through Gopāla, the Lord of Gokula.

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣāveṣadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam /
dhyātvā pratarpayenmantrī dugdhabuddhyā śubhairjalaiḥ //
meaning:
शिक्षावेषधरं कृष्णं किङ्किणीजालशोभितम् /
ध्यात्वा प्रतर्पयेन्मन्त्री दुग्धबुद्ध्या शुभैर्जलैः //
text_mt: Meditating on Kṛṣṇa dressed as a pupil and adorned with a network of jingling bells, / the mantrin should offer water-oblations with pure waters, with the mental conception of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutānkīrtiṃ prītastasmai dadāti saḥ /
brahmavṛkṣasamidbhirvā kuśairvā tilatandulaiḥ //
meaning:
धनं धान्यं सुतान्कीर्तिं प्रीतस्तस्मै ददाति सः /
ब्रह्मवृक्षसमिद्भिर्वा कुशैर्वा तिलतन्दुलैः //
text_mt: Pleased, He bestows upon him wealth, grain, sons, and renown. / Or with fuel-sticks of the palāśa tree, with kuśa grass, or with sesame and rice grains,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādayutaṃ mantrī trimadhvāktairhutāśane /
vaśaye dbrāhmaṇāṃścātha rājavṛkṣasamudbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
जुहुयादयुतं मन्त्री त्रिमध्वाक्तैर्हुताशने /
वशये द्ब्राह्मणांश्चाथ राजवृक्षसमुद्भवैः //
text_mt: the mantrin should offer ten thousand oblations into the fire, smeared with the three sweets. / Then he can subjugate brāhmaṇas; and with blossoms originating from the aragvadha tree

sanskrit_iast:
prasūnaiḥ kṣatriyānvaiśyānkuraṇḍakusumaistathā /
pāṭalotthaiśca kusumairvaśayedantimānsudhīḥ //
meaning:
प्रसूनैः क्षत्रियान्वैश्यान्कुरण्डकुसुमैस्तथा /
पाटलोत्थैश्च कुसुमैर्वशयेदन्तिमान्सुधीः //
text_mt: he subjugates kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas with yellow amaranth flowers; / and the wise one can subjugate the lowest class with flowers born of the trumpet-flower tree.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetapadmai raktapapdaiścaṃpakaiḥ pāṭalaiḥ kramāt /
hutvāyutaṃ trimadhvāktairvaśayettadvarāṅganāḥ //
meaning:
श्वेतपद्मै रक्तपप्दैश्चंपकैः पाटलैः क्रमात् /
हुत्वायुतं त्रिमध्वाक्तैर्वशयेत्तद्वराङ्गनाः //
text_mt: Having offered ten thousand oblations smeared with the three sweets with white lotuses, / red lotuses, campaka blossoms, and trumpet-flowers in turn, he can subjugate their noble women.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ hayārikusumaurniśīthe trimadhuplutaiḥ /
varastrīrvaśayetprājñaḥ samyagdhṛtvā dināṣṭakam //
meaning:
नित्यं हयारिकुसुमौर्निशीथे त्रिमधुप्लुतैः /
वरस्त्रीर्वशयेत्प्राज्ञः सम्यग्धृत्वा दिनाष्टकम् //
text_mt: Constantly offering at midnight oleander flowers submerged in the three sweets, / the wise man can subjugate noble women after maintaining it fully for eight days.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutatritayaṃ rātrau siddhārthaistrimadhuplutaiḥ /
pratyahaṃ juhvato māsātsureśo 'pi vaśībhavet //
meaning:
अयुतत्रितयं रात्रौ सिद्धार्थैस्त्रिमधुप्लुतैः /
प्रत्यहं जुह्वतो मासात्सुरेशो ऽपि वशीभवेत् //
text_mt: If one offers thirty thousand oblations at night with white mustard seeds soaked in the three sweets / every day for a month, even the lord of the gods is brought under subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtya ballavīvastrāṇyārūḍhaṃ nīpabhūruhe /
smaretkṛṣṇaṃ japedrātrau sahasraṃ khendūhātsudhīḥ //
meaning:
आहृत्य बल्लवीवस्त्राण्यारूढं नीपभूरुहे /
स्मरेत्कृष्णं जपेद्रात्रौ सहस्रं खेन्दूहात्सुधीः //
text_mt: Having taken the clothes of the cowherd women, mounted upon a kadamba tree— / the wise one should remember Kṛṣṇa thus and recite at night a thousand times for one month;

sanskrit_iast:
haṭhādākarṣayecchīghramurvaśīmapi sādhakaḥ /
bahunā kimihoktena mantro 'yaṃ sarvavaśyakṛt //
meaning:
हठादाकर्षयेच्छीघ्रमुर्वशीमपि साधकः /
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन मन्त्रो ऽयं सर्ववश्यकृत् //
text_mt: the practitioner can forcibly and quickly attract even Urvaśī. / What need is there of saying much here? This mantra brings all under subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ cātha vakṣye mokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām /
dhyāyetsvahṛtsarasije devakīnandanaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
रहस्यं परमं चाथ वक्ष्ये मोक्षप्रदं नृणाम् /
ध्यायेत्स्वहृत्सरसिजे देवकीनन्दनं विभुम् //
text_mt: And now I shall declare the supreme secret that grants liberation to men: / one should meditate on the all-pervading Son of Devakī in the lotus of one's heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatkundendugauraṃ sarasijanayanaṃ śaṅkhacakre gadābje bibhrāṇaṃ hastapadmairnavanalinalasanmālayādīpyamānam /
vande vedyaṃ munīndraiḥ kaṇikamunilasaddivyabhūṣābhirāmaṃ divyāṅgālepabhāsaṃ sakalabhayaharaṃ pītavastraṃ nurārim //
meaning:
श्रीमत्कुन्देन्दुगौरं सरसिजनयनं शङ्खचक्रे गदाब्जे बिभ्राणं हस्तपद्मैर्नवनलिनलसन्मालयादीप्यमानम् /
वन्दे वेद्यं मुनीन्द्रैः कणिकमुनिलसद्दिव्यभूषाभिरामं दिव्याङ्गालेपभासं सकलभयहरं पीतवस्त्रं नुरारिम् //
