text_mt: smeared with the three sweets, and worship Hari on the previously described ritual seat, / with the limbs, Nārada and the other [sages], the world-rulers, and their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddho manurdadyātsarvānkāmāṃśca mantriṇe /
līlādaṇḍapadābjo 'pi janasaṃsaktadoḥ padam //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धो मनुर्दद्यात्सर्वान्कामांश्च मन्त्रिणे /
लीलादण्डपदाब्जो ऽपि जनसंसक्तदोः पदम् //
text_mt: The mantra thus perfected bestows all desires upon the practitioner. / 'līlādaṇḍapadābjo 'pi janasaṃsaktadoḥpadaṃ',

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍānte vā dharāvahniradhīśāḍhyo 'tha lohitaḥ /
meghaśyāmapadaṃ paścādbhagavān salilaṃsadṛk //
meaning:
दण्डान्ते वा धरावह्निरधीशाढ्यो ऽथ लोहितः /
मेघश्यामपदं पश्चाद्भगवान् सलिलंसदृक् //
text_mt: or with 'daṇḍa' at the end, earth, fire with its ruler, then the red one, / next the word 'meghaśyāma', 'bhagavān', water with the eye-letter,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇo ityuktvā ṭhadvayaṃ syādekonatriṃśadarṇavān /
nārado 'sya muniśchando 'nuṣṭup ca devatā manoḥ //
meaning:
विष्णो इत्युक्त्वा ठद्वयं स्यादेकोनत्रिंशदर्णवान् /
नारदो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप् च देवता मनोः //
text_mt: and uttering 'viṣṇo', there should be two 'ṭha's: this forms a twenty-nine-syllable mantra. / Nārada is its seer, the metre is anuṣṭubh, and the deity of the mantra

sanskrit_iast:
līlādaṇḍahariḥ prokto manvabdhadhiyugavahnibhiḥ /
vedaiḥ pañcāṃ gakaṃ bhāgairmantravarṇotthitaiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
लीलादण्डहरिः प्रोक्तो मन्वब्धधियुगवह्निभिः /
वेदैः पञ्चां गकं भागैर्मन्त्रवर्णोत्थितैः क्रमात् //
text_mt: is declared to be Līlādaṇḍahari. With fourteen, four, two, three, / and four syllables drawn from the syllables of the mantra in sequence, the five limbs [are performed].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmohayaṃśca nijavāmakarasthalīlādaṇḍena gopayuvatīḥ parasuṃdarīśca /
diśyannijapriyasakhāṃsagandakṣahasto devaśriyaṃ nihatakaṃsa urukramo naḥ //
meaning:
संमोहयंश्च निजवामकरस्थलीलादण्डेन गोपयुवतीः परसुंदरीश्च /
दिश्यन्निजप्रियसखांसगन्दक्षहस्तो देवश्रियं निहतकंस उरुक्रमो नः //
text_mt: 'Fascinating the young cowherd women and other beautiful maidens with the playful cane in his left hand, / his right hand resting upon the shoulder of his dear companion, having slain Kaṃsa, the wide-striding Lord—may he bestow fortune upon us.'

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena juhuyāttilataṇḍulaiḥ /
trimadhvaktaistato 'bhyarcedaṅgaṃ dikpālahetibhiḥ //
meaning:
लक्षं जपो दशांशेन जुहुयात्तिलतण्डुलैः /
त्रिमध्वक्तैस्ततो ऽभ्यर्चेदङ्गं दिक्पालहेतिभिः //
text_mt: Recitation is one hundred thousand times; one should offer a tenth of that in fire oblations with sesame and rice grains / smeared with the three sweets; then one should worship the limbs, the guardians of the directions, and their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
līlādaṇḍa hariṃ yo vai bhajate nityamādarāt /
sa sarvaiḥ pūjyate lokaistasya gehe sthirā ramā //
meaning:
लीलादण्ड हरिं यो वै भजते नित्यमादरात् /
स सर्वैः पूज्यते लोकैस्तस्य गेहे स्थिरा रमा //
text_mt: Whoever constantly and respectfully worships Līlādaṇḍahari / is honoured by all people, and Lakṣmī remains steady in his home.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyārūḍhā smṛtistoyaṃ keśavāḍhyadharāyugam /
bhayāgnivallabhāmantraḥ saptārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
सद्यारूढा स्मृतिस्तोयं केशवाढ्यधरायुगम् /
भयाग्निवल्लभामन्त्रः सप्तार्णः सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: The instant-mounted memory, water, a pair of earth syllables with Keśava, / and the wife of the fear-fire: this is a seven-syllable mantra bestowing all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchando uṣṇiggovallamasya tu /
devatāpūrvavaccakraiḥ pañcāṅgāni tu kalpayet //
meaning:
ऋषिः स्यान्नारदश्छन्दो उष्णिग्गोवल्लमस्य तु /
देवतापूर्ववच्चक्रैः पञ्चाङ्गानि तु कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Its seer is Nārada, its metre is uṣṇih, and its deity is Govallabha. / As before, one should arrange the five limbs with the disc-syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyeyo hariḥ sakapilāgaṇamadhyasaṃsthastā āhvayandadhaddakṣiṇadosthaveṇum /
pāśaṃ sayaṣṭimaparatra payodanīlaḥ pītāmbarāhiripupicchakṛtāvataṃsaḥ //
meaning:
ध्येयो हरिः सकपिलागणमध्यसंस्थस्ता आह्वयन्दधद्दक्षिणदोस्थवेणुम् /
पाशं सयष्टिमपरत्र पयोदनीलः पीताम्बराहिरिपुपिच्छकृतावतंसः //
text_mt: 'Hari is to be meditated upon standing amid a herd of tawny cows, calling them, holding a flute in his right hand, / a noose with a staff in the other, dark as a raincloud, clad in yellow garments, with a crest-ornament made of peacock feathers.'

sanskrit_iast:
saptalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttataḥ /
godugdhaiḥ pūjayetpīṭhe syādaṅgaiḥ prathamāvṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सप्तलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं जुहुयात्ततः /
गोदुग्धैः पूजयेत्पीठे स्यादङ्गैः प्रथमावृतिः //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra seven hundred thousand times, and then offer a tenth of that in fire oblations / with cow's milk; one should worship him on the ritual seat, the first circuit being the limbs;

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇapiṅgalāṃ gaurapiṅgalāṃ raktapiṅgalām /
guḍapiṅgāṃ babhruvarṇāṃ cottamāṃ kapilāṃ tathā //
meaning:
सुवर्णपिङ्गलां गौरपिङ्गलां रक्तपिङ्गलाम् /
गुडपिङ्गां बभ्रुवर्णां चोत्तमां कपिलां तथा //
text_mt: worshipping the golden-tawny, the white-tawny, the red-tawny, / the molasses-tawny, the brownish-red, the excellent tawny,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkapiṅgalāṃ pītapiṅgalāṃ cottamāṃ śubhām /
gogaṇāṣṭakamabhyarcya lokeśānuyudhairyutān //
meaning:
चतुष्कपिङ्गलां पीतपिङ्गलां चोत्तमां शुभाम् /
गोगणाष्टकमभ्यर्च्य लोकेशानुयुधैर्युतान् //
text_mt: the four-legged tawny, and the auspicious excellent yellow-tawny— / having worshipped this group of eight cows and the world-rulers endowed with their weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjyaivaṃ manau siddhe kuryātkāmyāni mantravit /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ yaḥ payobhirdinaśo hunet //
meaning:
संपूज्यैवं मनौ सिद्धे कुर्यात्काम्यानि मन्त्रवित् /
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं यः पयोभिर्दिनशो हुनेत् //
text_mt: and having thus worshipped, when the mantra is perfected, the knower of mantras should perform desired rites. / He who offers oblations of milk one thousand and eight times daily

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣātsagogaṇo mukto daśārṇe cāpyayaṃ vidhiḥ /
tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃtaḥ śrīgovindastathā bhavet //
meaning:
पक्षात्सगोगणो मुक्तो दशार्णे चाप्ययं विधिः /
तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतः श्रीगोविन्दस्तथा भवेत् //
text_mt: for a fortnight is freed along with his herds of cattle. This procedure applies also to the ten-syllable [mantra]. / The praṇava, the heart-mantra, 'bhagavate' ending in the dative, and then 'śrīgovindāya'—

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśārṇo manuḥ prokto nārado 'sya munirmataḥ /
chandaḥ proktaṃ ca gāyatrī śrīgovindo 'sya devatā /
candrākṣiyugabhūtārṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ pañcāṅgakalpanam //
meaning:
द्वादशार्णो मनुः प्रोक्तो नारदो ऽस्य मुनिर्मतः /
छन्दः प्रोक्तं च गायत्री श्रीगोविन्दो ऽस्य देवता /
चन्द्राक्षियुगभूतार्णैः सर्वैः पञ्चाङ्गकल्पनम् //
text_mt: this is declared to be a twelve-syllable mantra; Nārada is considered its seer, / the metre is declared to be gāyatrī, and Śrīgovinda is its deity; / the arrangement of the five limbs is made with one, two, four, five, and all the syllables.

sanskrit_iast: dhyāyetkalpadrumūlāśritamaṇivilasaddivyasiṃhāsanasthaṃ meghaśyāmaṃ piśaṅgāṃśukamatisubhagaṃ śaṅkharetre karābhyām //
meaning: ध्यायेत्कल्पद्रुमूलाश्रितमणिविलसद्दिव्यसिंहासनस्थं मेघश्यामं पिशङ्गांशुकमतिसुभगं शङ्खरेत्रे कराभ्याम् //
text_mt: 'One should meditate on him seated upon a divine throne shining with gems at the base of the wish-fulfilling tree, / dark as a raincloud, wearing yellowish garments, exceedingly charming, holding a conch and a cane with his hands,

sanskrit_iast: bibhrāṇaṃ gosahasrairvṛtamamarapatiṃ prauḍhahastaikakuṃbhapraścotatsaudhadhārāsnapitamabhinavāṃbhojapatrābhanetram //
meaning: बिभ्राणं गोसहस्रैर्वृतममरपतिं प्रौढहस्तैककुंभप्रश्चोतत्सौधधारास्नपितमभिनवांभोजपत्राभनेत्रम् //
text_mt: surrounded by thousands of cows, the Lord of the immortals, bathed by streams of nectar dripping from a single jar held in his mature hand, his eyes resembling the petals of a fresh lotus.'

sanskrit_iast:
ravilakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ dugdhairhutvā daśāṃśataḥ /
yajecca pūrvavadgoṣṭhasthitaṃ vā pratimādiṣu //
meaning:
रविलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं दुग्धैर्हुत्वा दशांशतः /
यजेच्च पूर्ववद्गोष्ठस्थितं वा प्रतिमादिषु //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra one million two hundred thousand times, offer a tenth of that in fire oblations with milk, / and worship as before in a cowshed or in images and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvokte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ /
tatrāvāhya yajetkṛṣṇaṃ gurupūjanapūrvakam //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः /
तत्रावाह्य यजेत्कृष्णं गुरुपूजनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having conceived the icon from the root-mantra on the previously described Vaiṣṇava ritual seat, / having invoked Kṛṣṇa there, one should worship him, preceded by worship of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca pārśvayorindramagrataḥ /
pṛṣṭhataḥ surabhiṃ ceṣṭvā kesareṣvaṅgapūjanam //
meaning:
रुक्मिणीं सत्यभामां च पार्श्वयोरिन्द्रमग्रतः /
पृष्ठतः सुरभिं चेष्ट्वा केसरेष्वङ्गपूजनम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Rukmiṇī and Satyabhāmā on the two flanks, Indra in front, / and Surabhi behind, [there is] the worship of the limbs upon the filaments.

sanskrit_iast:
kāliṃ dyādyā mahiṣyo 'ṣṭau vasupatreṣu saṃsthitāḥ /
pīṭhakoṇeṣu baddhvādikiṅkaṇīṃ ca tathā punaḥ //
meaning:
कालिं द्याद्या महिष्यो ऽष्टौ वसुपत्रेषु संस्थिताः /
पीठकोणेषु बद्ध्वादिकिङ्कणीं च तथा पुनः //
text_mt: Kālindī and the other eight chief queens reside on the eight petals; / having bound [the cords] in the corners of the seat, and likewise bells,

sanskrit_iast:
dāmāni pṛṣṭhayorveṇuṃ puraḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau /
agrato vanamāsādirdikṣvaṣṭasu tathā sthitāḥ //
meaning:
दामानि पृष्ठयोर्वेणुं पुरः श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभौ /
अग्रतो वनमासादिर्दिक्ष्वष्टसु तथा स्थिताः //
text_mt: ropes behind, the flute in front, and Śrīvatsa and Kaustubha in front; / the garland of wild flowers and others are positioned ahead in the eight directions,

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcajanyaṃ gadā cakraṃ vasudevaśca devakī /
nandagopo yaśodā ca sagogopālagopikāḥ //
meaning:
पाञ्चजन्यं गदा चक्रं वसुदेवश्च देवकी /
नन्दगोपो यशोदा च सगोगोपालगोपिकाः //
text_mt: as well as Pāñcajanya, the mace, the discus, Vasudeva, and Devakī, / Nandagopa, Yaśodā, together with the cattle, cowherds, and cowherd women.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādyāśca sthitā bāhye vajrādyāśca tataḥ param /
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca puṇḍarīko 'tha vāmanaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्राद्याश्च स्थिता बाह्ये वज्राद्याश्च ततः परम् /
कुमुदः कुमुदाक्षश्च पुण्डरीको ऽथ वामनः //
text_mt: Indra and the others are situated outside, and after them the thunderbolt and the other [weapons]. / Kumuda, Kumudākṣa, Puṇḍarīka, then Vāmana,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭitaḥ /
viṣvaksenaśca saṃpūjyaḥ svātmā cārcyastataḥ param //
meaning:
शङ्कुकर्णः सर्वनेत्रः सुमुखः सुप्रतिष्टितः /
विष्वक्सेनश्च संपूज्यः स्वात्मा चार्च्यस्ततः परम् //
text_mt: Śaṅkukarṇa, Sarvanetra, Sumukha, Supratiṣṭhita, / and Viṣvaksena are to be worshipped; and after that, one's own self is to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ trikālaṃ vā yo govindaṃ yajennaraḥ /
sa cirāyurnirātaṅko dhanadhānyapatirbhavet //
meaning:
एककालं त्रिकालं वा यो गोविन्दं यजेन्नरः /
स चिरायुर्निरातङ्को धनधान्यपतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: The person who worships Govinda once a day or at the three junctions of the day / will have a long life, be free from illness, and become a master of wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtiḥ sadyānvitā cakrī dakṣakarṇayutodharā /
nāthāya hṛdayānto 'yaṃ vasuvarṇo mahāmanuḥ //
meaning:
स्मृतिः सद्यान्विता चक्री दक्षकर्णयुतोधरा /
नाथाय हृदयान्तो ऽयं वसुवर्णो महामनुः //
text_mt: The Smṛti [letter] joined with Sadya, the discus-bearer, the earth letter joined with the right ear, / followed by 'to the Lord' and ending with Hṛdaya—this is the eight-syllable great mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
munirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chandaḥ kṛṣṇo 'sya devatā /
varṇadvandvaiśca sarveṇa pañcāṅgānyasya kalpayet //
meaning:
मुनिर्ब्रह्मास्य गायत्री छन्दः कृष्णो ऽस्य देवता /
वर्णद्वन्द्वैश्च सर्वेण पञ्चाङ्गान्यस्य कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Its sage is Brahmā, its meter is gāyatrī, and its deity is Kṛṣṇa. / With pairs of syllables and with the whole, one should fashion its five limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavarṣamatilolamaṅgaṇe dhāvamānamaticañcalekṣaṇam /
kiṅkiṇīvalayahāranūpurai rañjitaṃ namata gopabālakam //
meaning:
पञ्चवर्षमतिलोलमङ्गणे धावमानमतिचञ्चलेक्षणम् /
किङ्किणीवलयहारनूपुरै रञ्जितं नमत गोपबालकम् //
text_mt: Bow to the cowherd child, five years of age, very playful, running in the courtyard, / with very restless eyes, adorned with bells, bracelets, necklaces, and anklets.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japedaṣṭalakṣaṃ mantrī daśāṃśataḥ /
brahmavṛkṣasamidbhiśca juhuyātpāyasena vā //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेदष्टलक्षं मन्त्री दशांशतः /
ब्रह्मवृक्षसमिद्भिश्च जुहुयात्पायसेन वा //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, the practitioner should recite it eight hundred thousand times, / and should make fire oblations for a tenth of that with kindling sticks of the Brahma tree or with milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgukte vaiṣṇave pīṭhe mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya mūlataḥ /
tatrāvāhyārcayetkṛṣṇaṃ mantrī vai sthiramānasaḥ //
meaning:
प्रागुक्ते वैष्णवे पीठे मूर्तिं संकल्प्य मूलतः /
तत्रावाह्यार्चयेत्कृष्णं मन्त्री वै स्थिरमानसः //
text_mt: Having fashioned the form upon the previously mentioned Vaiṣṇava seat with the basic mantra, / the practitioner, with a steady mind, should invoke and worship Kṛṣṇa there.

sanskrit_iast:
kesareṣu caturdikṣu vidikṣvaṅgāni pūjayet /
vāsudevaṃ balaṃ dikṣu pradyumnamaniruddhakam //
meaning:
केसरेषु चतुर्दिक्षु विदिक्ष्वङ्गानि पूजयेत् /
वासुदेवं बलं दिक्षु प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धकम् //
text_mt: Upon the filaments, he should worship the limbs in the four cardinal and intermediate directions; / in the cardinal directions, Vāsudeva, Bala, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha;

sanskrit_iast:
vidikṣu rukmiṇīsatyabhāme vai lakṣyaṇarkṣaje /
lokeśānsāyudhānbāhye evaṃ siddho bhavenmanuḥ //
meaning:
विदिक्षु रुक्मिणीसत्यभामे वै लक्ष्यणर्क्षजे /
लोकेशान्सायुधान्बाह्ये एवं सिद्धो भवेन्मनुः //
text_mt: in the intermediate directions, Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, Lakṣmaṇā, and the daughter of the bear; / and outside, the guardians of the world with their weapons. Thus the mantra becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ śrībhuvanākāmo ṅeṃtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīrayet /
śrīgovindaṃ tataḥ procya gopījanapadaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तारः श्रीभुवनाकामो ङेंतं श्रीकृष्णमीरयेत् /
श्रीगोविन्दं ततः प्रोच्य गोपीजनपदं ततः //
text_mt: One should utter the Pranava, Śrī, Bhuvana, and Kāma; Śrīkṛṣṇa in the dative; / then having spoken Śrīgovinda; then the word Gopījana;

sanskrit_iast:
vallabhāya tataḥ padmātrayaṃ tatvākṣaro manuḥ /
munyādikaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ siddhagopālakaṃ smaret //
meaning:
वल्लभाय ततः पद्मात्रयं तत्वाक्षरो मनुः /
मुन्यादिकं च पूर्वोक्तं सिद्धगोपालकं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: then 'to the beloved' [Vallabhāya]; and three times Padmā—this is the twenty-five-syllable mantra. / The sage and the rest are as stated before; one should remember the perfected Gopāla:

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavīmaṇḍapāsīnau garuḍenābhipālitau /
divyakrīḍāsu niratau rāmakṛṣṇau smaran japet //
meaning:
माधवीमण्डपासीनौ गरुडेनाभिपालितौ /
दिव्यक्रीडासु निरतौ रामकृष्णौ स्मरन् जपेत् //
text_mt: Seated in a bower of spring creepers, protected by Garuḍa, / engrossed in divine sports—remembering Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, one should recite.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanaṃ pūrvavaccāsya kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaiḥ /
cakrī munisvaropetaḥ sargī caikākṣaro manuḥ //
meaning:
पूजनं पूर्ववच्चास्य कर्तव्यं वैष्णवोत्तमैः /
चक्री मुनिस्वरोपेतः सर्गी चैकाक्षरो मनुः //
text_mt: Its worship should be performed as before by the best of Vaiṣṇavas. / The discus-bearer endowed with the seventh vowel and with the visarga is the single-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇeti dvyakṣaraḥ proktaḥ kāmādiḥ syāttrivarṇakaḥ /
saiva ṅeṃto yugārṇaḥ syātkṛṣṇāya nama ityapi //
meaning:
कृष्णेति द्व्यक्षरः प्रोक्तः कामादिः स्यात्त्रिवर्णकः /
सैव ङेंतो युगार्णः स्यात्कृष्णाय नम इत्यपि //
text_mt: The two-syllabled [mantra] is taught as 'Kṛṣṇa'; with the Kāma-bīja first, it becomes three syllables. / That very [mantra] ending in the dative is four syllables, namely 'Kṛṣṇāya namaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcākṣaraśca kṛṣṇāya kāmaruddhastathā paraḥ /
gopālāyāgnijāyānto rasavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाक्षरश्च कृष्णाय कामरुद्धस्तथा परः /
गोपालायाग्निजायान्तो रसवर्णः प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt: And the five-syllabled one is 'Kṛṣṇāya' enclosed by Kāma; likewise another / ending in the wife of Agni [svāhā] is 'Gopālāya', proclaimed to have six syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaḥ kṛṣṇapadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ vahnijāyāntakaḥ paraḥ /
kṛṣṇagovindakau ṅeṃtau saptārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
कामः कृष्णपदं ङेंतं वह्निजायान्तकः परः /
कृष्णगोविन्दकौ ङेंतौ सप्तार्णः सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: Kāma, the word 'Kṛṣṇa' in the dative, and ending in the wife of Agni [svāhā] is another; / 'Kṛṣṇa' and 'Govinda' in the dative is the seven-syllabled one that grants all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśaktikāmāḥ kṛṣṇāya kāmaḥ saptākṣaraḥ paraḥ /
kṛṣṇagovindakau ṅeṃtau hṛdanto 'nyo navākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
श्रीशक्तिकामाः कृष्णाय कामः सप्ताक्षरः परः /
कृष्णगोविन्दकौ ङेंतौ हृदन्तो ऽन्यो नवाक्षरः //
text_mt: Śrī, Śakti, and Kāma [bījas], then 'Kṛṣṇāya' and Kāma, is another seven-syllabled one; / 'Kṛṣṇa' and 'Govinda' in the dative, ending in 'hṛd' [namaḥ], is another, nine-syllabled one.

sanskrit_iast:
ṅeṃtau ca kṛṣṇagovindau tathā kāmaḥ puṭaḥ paraḥ /
kāmaḥ śārṅgī dharāsaṃstho manvindvāḍhyaśca manmathaḥ //
meaning:
ङेंतौ च कृष्णगोविन्दौ तथा कामः पुटः परः /
कामः शार्ङ्गी धरासंस्थो मन्विन्द्वाढ्यश्च मन्मथः //
text_mt: And 'Kṛṣṇa' and 'Govinda' in the dative, enclosed likewise by Kāma, is another; / Kāma, the bearer of Śārṅga with the vowel 'u', endowed with bindu, and Kāma [i.e., klīṃ klūṃ klīṃ],

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmalāṅgāya hṛdayaṃ daśārṇaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ /
bālānte vapuṣe kṛṣṇāyāgnijāyāntimo 'paraḥ //
meaning:
श्यामलाङ्गाय हृदयं दशार्णः सर्वसिद्धिदः /
बालान्ते वपुषे कृष्णायाग्निजायान्तिमो ऽपरः //
text_mt: followed by 'Śyāmalāṅgāya hṛdayam' [namaḥ], is the ten-syllabled one that grants all perfections; / another ends in the wife of Agni [svāhā]: 'Bāla' followed by 'vapuṣe kṛṣṇāya'.

sanskrit_iast:
dviṭhānte bālavapuṣe kāmaḥ kṛṣṇāya saṃvadet /
tato dhyāyansvahṛdaye gopījanamanoharam //
meaning:
द्विठान्ते बालवपुषे कामः कृष्णाय संवदेत् /
ततो ध्यायन्स्वहृदये गोपीजनमनोहरम् //
text_mt: Ending in dviṭhā [svāhā], one should utter Kāma, 'Kṛṣṇāya bālavapuṣe'; / then, meditating in one's heart on the captivator of the gopīs' hearts:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvṛndāvipinapratoliṣu namatsaṃphullavallītatiṣvantarjālavighaṭṭainaḥ surabhiṇā vātena saṃsevite /
kālindīpuline vihāriṇamatho rādhaikajīvātukaṃ vande nandakiśoraminduvadanaṃ snigdhāṃbudāḍaṃbaram //
meaning:
श्रीवृन्दाविपिनप्रतोलिषु नमत्संफुल्लवल्लीततिष्वन्तर्जालविघट्टैनः सुरभिणा वातेन संसेविते /
कालिन्दीपुलिने विहारिणमथो राधैकजीवातुकं वन्दे नन्दकिशोरमिन्दुवदनं स्निग्धांबुदाडंबरम् //
text_mt: "I praise the youthful son of Nanda, whose face is like the moon, who displays the grace of a glossy cloud, / who sports on the sandbanks of the Kālindī, the sole life of Rādhā, / served by the fragrant breeze charged with drops of water / in the lanes of the forest of glorious Vṛndā, where clusters of blossoms bend low."

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāktavartmanā pūjā jñeyā hyeṣāṃ munīśvara /
devakīsutavarṇānte govindapadamuccaret //
meaning:
पूर्वाक्तवर्त्मना पूजा ज्ञेया ह्येषां मुनीश्वर /
देवकीसुतवर्णान्ते गोविन्दपदमुच्चरेत् //
text_mt: Their worship is to be understood as performed by the previously mentioned method, O lord of sages. / Following the syllables 'Devakīsuta', one should utter the word 'Govinda',

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevapadaṃ procya saṃbṛddhyantaṃ jagatpatiṃm /
dehi me tanayaṃ paścātkṛṣṇa tvāmahamīrayet //
meaning:
वासुदेवपदं प्रोच्य संबृद्ध्यन्तं जगत्पतिंम् /
देहि मे तनयं पश्चात्कृष्ण त्वामहमीरयेत् //
text_mt: and having spoken the word 'Vāsudeva' in the vocative, one should say 'Jagatpatim, / dehi me tanayaṃ', and thereafter 'Kṛṣṇa tvām aham

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ gata ityanto mantro dvātriṃśadakṣaraḥ /
nārado 'sya muniśchando gāyatrī cāpyanuṣṭubham /
devaḥ sutapradaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pādaiḥ sarveṇa cāṅgakam //
meaning:
शरणं गत इत्यन्तो मन्त्रो द्वात्रिंशदक्षरः /
नारदो ऽस्य मुनिश्छन्दो गायत्री चाप्यनुष्टुभम् /
देवः सुतप्रदः कृष्णः पादैः सर्वेण चाङ्गकम् //
text_mt: śaraṇaṃ gataḥ'; this is the thirty-two-syllabled mantra. / Its sage is Nārada, the metre is gāyatrī and anuṣṭubh, / the deity is Kṛṣṇa who grants sons, and the limb-placement is performed with each quarter and with the whole [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
vijayena yuto rathasthitaḥ prasamānīya samudramadhyataḥ /
pradadattanayān dvijanmane smaraṇīyo vasudevanandanaḥ //
meaning:
विजयेन युतो रथस्थितः प्रसमानीय समुद्रमध्यतः /
प्रददत्तनयान् द्विजन्मने स्मरणीयो वसुदेवनन्दनः //
text_mt: Accompanied by Arjuna, mounted upon a chariot, having brought back by force from the midst of the ocean / and returned the sons to the twice-born sage—thus is the son of Vasudeva to be remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japo 'yutaṃ homastalairmadhurasaṃplutaiḥ /
arcā pūrvodite pīṭhe aṅgalokeśvarāyudhaiḥ //
meaning:
लक्षं जपो ऽयुतं होमस्तलैर्मधुरसंप्लुतैः /
अर्चा पूर्वोदिते पीठे अङ्गलोकेश्वरायुधैः //
text_mt: One hundred thousand recitations, ten thousand fire oblations with sesamum seeds bathed in sweet liquids, / and worship upon the previously described ritual seat, with the limbs, the lords of the quarters, and their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī vandhyāyāmapi putravān /
tāro māyā tataḥ sāṃtaseṃduṣvāntaśca sarvavān //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री वन्ध्यायामपि पुत्रवान् /
तारो माया ततः सांतसेंदुष्वान्तश्च सर्ववान् //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus perfected, the mantra-practitioner obtains a son even from a barren woman. / Tāra [oṃ], māyā [hrīṃ], then 'sa' with bindu, and the end of darkness [ū] endowed with bindu [i.e., sūṃ],

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ vahnipriyānto 'yaṃ mantro vasvakṣaraḥ paraḥ /
pañcabrahmātmakasyāsya mantrasya muni sattamaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽहं वह्निप्रियान्तो ऽयं मन्त्रो वस्वक्षरः परः /
पञ्चब्रह्मात्मकस्यास्य मन्त्रस्य मुनि सत्तमः //
text_mt: 'so 'ham', ending with the beloved of Agni [svāhā]: this is another, eight-syllabled mantra. / Of this mantra, which consists of the five Brahmans, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirbrahmā ca paramā gāyatrīchanda īritam /
parañjyotiḥ paraṃ brahma devatā parikīrtitam //
meaning:
ऋषिर्ब्रह्मा च परमा गायत्रीछन्द ईरितम् /
परञ्ज्योतिः परं ब्रह्म देवता परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: the ṛṣi is Brahmā, the supreme gāyatrī is declared as the metre, / and the deity is proclaimed to be the supreme light, the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo bījamākhyātaṃ svāhā śaktirudāhṛtā /
svāheti hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ so 'haṃ veti śiro matam //
meaning:
प्रणवो बीजमाख्यातं स्वाहा शक्तिरुदाहृता /
स्वाहेति हृदयं प्रोक्तं सो ऽहं वेति शिरो मतम् //
text_mt: The praṇava is declared as the bīja, svāhā is proclaimed as the śakti; / 'svāhā' is taught as the heart, and 'so 'ham' is regarded as the head;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaśceti śikhā proktā hṛllekhā kavacaṃ smṛtam /
praṇavo netramākhyātamastraṃ harihareti ca //
meaning:
हंसश्चेति शिखा प्रोक्ता हृल्लेखा कवचं स्मृतम् /
प्रणवो नेत्रमाख्यातमस्त्रं हरिहरेति च //
text_mt: 'haṃsaḥ' is taught as the crest, and the hṛllekhā [hrīṃ] is considered the armor; / the praṇava is declared as the eye, and the weapon is 'Hari-Hara'.

sanskrit_iast:
sa brahmā sa śivo vipra sa hariḥ saiva devarāṭ /
sa sarvarūpaḥ sarvākhyaḥ so 'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ //
meaning:
स ब्रह्मा स शिवो विप्र स हरिः सैव देवराट् /
स सर्वरूपः सर्वाख्यः सो ऽक्षरः परमः स्वराट् //
text_mt: He is Brahmā, he is Śiva, O twice-born, he is Hari, and he alone is Indra; / he is all-formed, all-named, imperishable, supreme, and self-sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japedaṣṭalakṣahomo daśāṃśataḥ /
pūjāpraṇavapīṭhe 'sya sāṃgāvaraṇakairmatā //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेदष्टलक्षहोमो दशांशतः /
पूजाप्रणवपीठे ऽस्य सांगावरणकैर्मता //
text_mt: Having thus meditated, one should recite it eight hundred thousand times, with fire oblation of one-tenth; / his worship is regarded as being performed on the praṇava-seat, with the ancillary and surrounding deities.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau jñānaṃ sādhakendrasya nārada /
jāyate tattvamasyādivākyoktaṃ nirvikalpakam //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ ज्ञानं साधकेन्द्रस्य नारद /
जायते तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्योक्तं निर्विकल्पकम् //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus perfected, O Nārada, there arises in the best of practitioners / the non-conceptual knowledge taught in such statements as 'That thou art'.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmo ṅeṃto hṛṣīkeśo hṛdayānto gajākṣaraḥ /
ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chando gāyatramīritam //
meaning:
कामो ङेंतो हृषीकेशो हृदयान्तो गजाक्षरः /
ऋषिर्ब्रह्मास्य गायत्री छन्दो गायत्रमीरितम् //
text_mt: Kāma [klīṃ], 'Hṛṣīkeśa' in the dative, ending in 'hṛdaya' [namaḥ] is the eight-syllabled one; / its ṛṣi is Brahmā, and the metre is declared to be gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
devatā tu hṛṣīkeśo viniyogo 'khilāptaye /
kāmo bījaṃ tathāyeti śaktirasya hyudāhṛtā //
meaning:
देवता तु हृषीकेशो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये /
कामो बीजं तथायेति शक्तिरस्य ह्युदाहृता //
text_mt: The deity is Hṛṣīkeśa, the application is for the attainment of all desires; / Kāma is the bīja, and 'āyā' is declared to be its śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyānaṃ samācaret /
puruṣottamamantroktaṃ sarvaṃ vāsya prakīrtitam //
meaning:
बीजेनैव षडङ्गानि कृत्वा ध्यानं समाचरेत् /
पुरुषोत्तममन्त्रोक्तं सर्वं वास्य प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Having performed the six limbs with the bīja alone, one should perform meditation; / or everything taught for the Puruṣottama-mantra is proclaimed for it.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japo 'yutaṃ homo ghṛtenaiva prakīrtitaḥ /
tarpaṇaṃ sarvakāmāptyai proktaṃ saṃmohinīsumaiḥ //
meaning:
लक्षं जपो ऽयुतं होमो घृतेनैव प्रकीर्तितः /
तर्पणं सर्वकामाप्त्यै प्रोक्तं संमोहिनीसुमैः //
text_mt: One hundred thousand recitations, and ten thousand fire oblations with ghee alone are proclaimed; / water oblation with saṃmohinī flowers is prescribed for the attainment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībījaṃ śaktirāpeti bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅkastathā /
trailokyamohanaḥ śabdo namoṃ'to manurīritaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीबीजं शक्तिरापेति बीजेनैव षडङ्कस्तथा /
त्रैलोक्यमोहनः शब्दो नमोंऽतो मनुरीरितः //
text_mt: The śrī-bīja [śrīṃ], the śakti [hrīṃ], 'āpaḥ', and likewise the six limbs with the bīja itself; / the words 'trailokyamohana' ending in 'namaḥ' is the mantra declared.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirbrahmā ca gāyatrī chandaḥ śrīdharadevatā /
śrībījaṃ śaktirāpeti bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
ऋषिर्ब्रह्मा च गायत्री छन्दः श्रीधरदेवता /
श्रीबीजं शक्तिरापेति बीजेनैव षडङ्गकम् //
text_mt: The ṛṣi is Brahmā, the metre is gāyatrī, and the deity is Śrīdhara; / the śrī-bīja [śrīṃ] is the bīja, the śakti [hrīṃ], and the six limbs are done with the bīja itself.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣottamavaddhyānapūjādikamihoditaḥ /
lakṣaṃ japastathā homa ājyenaiva daśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
पुरुषोत्तमवद्ध्यानपूजादिकमिहोदितः /
लक्षं जपस्तथा होम आज्येनैव दशांशतः //
text_mt: Meditation, worship, and so forth are taught here as for Puruṣottama; / one hundred thousand recitations, and fire oblation of one-tenth of that with ghee alone.

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhaśvetapuṣpaistu pūjāṃ homādikaṃ caret /
evaṃ kṛte tu viprendra sākṣātsyācchrīdharaḥ svayam //
meaning:
सुगन्धश्वेतपुष्पैस्तु पूजां होमादिकं चरेत् /
एवं कृते तु विप्रेन्द्र साक्षात्स्याच्छ्रीधरः स्वयम् //
text_mt: One should perform worship, fire oblation, and so forth with fragrant white flowers; / when this is done, O best of the twice-born, Śrīdhara himself appears visibly.

sanskrit_iast:
acyutānantagovindapadaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ namontimam /
mantro 'sya śaunakaṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
अच्युतानन्तगोविन्दपदं ङेंतं नमोन्तिमम् /
मन्त्रो ऽस्य शौनकऋषिर्विराट् छन्दः प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The words 'Acyuta', 'Ananta', and 'Govinda' in the dative, ending in 'namaḥ'— / of this mantra, the sage is Śaunaka, and the metre is proclaimed to be virāṭ.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ parāśaravyāsanāradā ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
virāṭ chandaḥ samākhyātaṃ parabrahmātmako hariḥ //
meaning:
एषां पराशरव्यासनारदा ऋषयः स्मृताः /
विराट् छन्दः समाख्यातं परब्रह्मात्मको हरिः //
text_mt: For these [mantras], Parāśara, Vyāsa, and Nārada are remembered as the sages; / the metre is proclaimed to be virāṭ, and the deity is Hari, whose essence is the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
devatābījaśaktī tu pūrvokte sādhakairmate /
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam //
meaning:
देवताबीजशक्ती तु पूर्वोक्ते साधकैर्मते /
शङ्खचक्रधरं देवं चतुर्बाहुं किरीटिनम् //
text_mt: The bīja and śakti are considered by practitioners to be as previously stated. / [One should meditate on] the four-armed God wearing a diadem, holding the conch and disc,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairapyāyudhairyuktaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitam /
sanakādimunīndraistu sarvadevairupāsitam //
meaning:
सर्वैरप्यायुधैर्युक्तं गरुडोपरि संस्थितम् /
सनकादिमुनीन्द्रैस्तु सर्वदेवैरुपासितम् //
text_mt: equipped with all weapons, seated upon Garuḍa, / worshipped by the lords of sages beginning with Sanaka and by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhūmisahitaṃ devamudayādityasannibham /
prātarudyatsahasrāṃśumaṇḍalopamakuṇḍalam //
meaning:
श्रीभूमिसहितं देवमुदयादित्यसन्निभम् /
प्रातरुद्यत्सहस्रांशुमण्डलोपमकुण्डलम् //
text_mt: the God accompanied by Śrī and Bhūmi, resembling the rising sun, / whose ear-rings resemble the orb of the thousand-rayed sun rising in the morning,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokasya rakṣārthamanantaṃ nityameva hi /
abhayaṃ varadaṃ devaṃ prayacchantaṃ mudānvitam //
meaning:
सर्वलोकस्य रक्षार्थमनन्तं नित्यमेव हि /
अभयं वरदं देवं प्रयच्छन्तं मुदान्वितम् //
text_mt: the eternal Ananta himself, for the protection of all the worlds, / the cheerful God bestowing freedom from fear and boons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvār cayetpīṭhe vaiṣṇave susamāhitaḥ /
ādyāvaraṇasaṃgaiḥ syāccakraśaṅkhagadāsibhiḥ //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वार् चयेत्पीठे वैष्णवे सुसमाहितः /
आद्यावरणसंगैः स्याच्चक्रशङ्खगदासिभिः //
text_mt: Having thus meditated, well-concentrated, one should worship him upon the Vaiṣṇava ritual seat; / the first surrounding group consists of the disc, conch, mace, and sword;

sanskrit_iast:
muśalāḍhyadhanuḥ pāśāṅkuśaiḥ proktaṃ dvitīyakam /
sanakādikaśākteyavyāsanāradaśaunakaiḥ //
meaning:
मुशलाढ्यधनुः पाशाङ्कुशैः प्रोक्तं द्वितीयकम् /
सनकादिकशाक्तेयव्यासनारदशौनकैः //
text_mt: the second is taught with the pestle, bow, noose, and goad; / the third is proclaimed with the sages beginning with Sanaka, the son of Śakti [Parāśara], Vyāsa, Nārada, and Śaunaka,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ lokapālaistu caturthaṃ parikīrtitam /
lakṣaṃ japo daśāṃśena ghṛtena havanaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
तृतीयं लोकपालैस्तु चतुर्थं परिकीर्तितम् /
लक्षं जपो दशांशेन घृतेन हवनं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: and the fourth is proclaimed with the guardians of the world; / one hundred thousand recitations, and fire oblation of one-tenth of that with ghee is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ siddhe manau mantrī prayogānapyupācaret /
śrīvṛkṣamūle deveśaṃ dhyāyanvairogiṇaṃ smaran //
meaning:
एवं सिद्धे मनौ मन्त्री प्रयोगानप्युपाचरेत् /
श्रीवृक्षमूले देवेशं ध्यायन्वैरोगिणं स्मरन् //
text_mt: When the mantra is thus perfected, the mantra-practitioner may perform ritual applications: / meditating on the Lord of Gods at the foot of a bilva tree, or keeping a sick person in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭvā japtvāyutaṃ sādhyaṃ smṛtvā vā manasā dvija /
rogiṇāṃ roganirmuktiṃ kuryānmantrī tu maṇḍalāt //
meaning:
स्पृष्ट्वा जप्त्वायुतं साध्यं स्मृत्वा वा मनसा द्विज /
रोगिणां रोगनिर्मुक्तिं कुर्यान्मन्त्री तु मण्डलात् //
text_mt: touching the subject to be cured and reciting ten thousand times, or recalling him in mind, O twice-born, / the mantra-practitioner can free the sick from illness within a period of forty days.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyārthī juhuyāllājairbilvaiścāpi dhanāptaye /
vastrārthī gandhakusumairārogyāya tilairhunet //
meaning:
कन्यार्थी जुहुयाल्लाजैर्बिल्वैश्चापि धनाप्तये /
वस्त्रार्थी गन्धकुसुमैरारोग्याय तिलैर्हुनेत् //
text_mt: One seeking a maiden should offer puffed grain; and [bilva fruits] for the acquisition of wealth; / one seeking clothing should offer fragrant flowers, and sesamum seeds for health.

sanskrit_iast:
ravivāre jale sthitvā nābhimātre japettu yaḥ /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vai sa jvaraṃ nāśayed dhruvam //
meaning:
रविवारे जले स्थित्वा नाभिमात्रे जपेत्तु यः /
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं वै स ज्वरं नाशयेद् ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: One who stands in water up to the navel on a Sunday and recites / one thousand and eight times certainly destroys fever.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhārthaṃ japenmāsaṃ śaśimaṇḍalamadhyagam /
dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ labhetkanyāṃ vāñchitāṃ cāpi nārada //
meaning:
विवाहार्थं जपेन्मासं शशिमण्डलमध्यगम् /
ध्यात्वा कृष्णं लभेत्कन्यां वाञ्छितां चापि नारद //
text_mt: To obtain a marriage, one should recite for a month, meditating on Kṛṣṇa / situated in the center of the orb of the moon; then, O Nārada, he will obtain the desired maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevapadaṃ procya nigaḍacchedaśabdataḥ /
vāsudevāya varmāstre svāhānto manurīritaḥ //
meaning:
वसुदेवपदं प्रोच्य निगडच्छेदशब्दतः /
वासुदेवाय वर्मास्त्रे स्वाहान्तो मनुरीरितः //
text_mt: Uttering the word 'Vasudeva', then the words 'nigaḍaccheda', / then 'Vāsudevāya', armor [huṃ], weapon [phaṭ], ending in svāhā, is the mantra declared.

sanskrit_iast:
nārado 'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī kṛṣṇadevatā /
varma bījaṃ śiraḥ śaktiranyatsarvaṃ daśārṇavat //
meaning:
नारदो ऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्री कृष्णदेवता /
वर्म बीजं शिरः शक्तिरन्यत्सर्वं दशार्णवत् //
text_mt: Its sage is Nārada, the metre is gāyatrī, the deity is Kṛṣṇa, / the armor [huṃ] is the bīja, the head [svāhā] is the śakti, and everything else is like the ten-syllabled mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bālaḥ pavanadīrghaiduyukto jhiṇṭīśayurjalam /
atrirvyāsāya hṛdayaṃ manuraṣṭākṣaro 'vatu //
meaning:
बालः पवनदीर्घैदुयुक्तो झिण्टीशयुर्जलम् /
अत्रिर्व्यासाय हृदयं मनुरष्टाक्षरो ऽवतु //
text_mt: […] 'Vyāsāya hṛdayam' [namaḥ]: may this eight-syllabled mantra protect!

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmānuṣṭup muniśchando devaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ /
ādyaṃ bījaṃ namaḥ śaktidīrghāḍhyo nādināṅgakam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मानुष्टुप् मुनिश्छन्दो देवः सत्यवतीसुतः /
आद्यं बीजं नमः शक्तिदीर्घाढ्यो नादिनाङ्गकम् //
text_mt: Brahmā is the sage, the metre is anuṣṭubh, and the deity is the son of Satyavatī [Vyāsa]. / The first [syllable] is the seed, ‘namaḥ’ is the energy, and with the long vowels and the nasal sound, the limbs [are formed].

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyāmudrikayā lasatkaratalaṃ sadyogapīṭhasthitaṃ vāme jānutale dadhānamaparaṃ hastaṃ suvidyānidhim /
vipravrātavṛtaṃ prasannamanasaṃ pāthoruhāṅgadyutiṃ pārāśaryyamatīva puṇyacaritaṃ vyāsaṃ smaretsiddhaye //
meaning:
व्याख्यामुद्रिकया लसत्करतलं सद्योगपीठस्थितं वामे जानुतले दधानमपरं हस्तं सुविद्यानिधिम् /
विप्रव्रातवृतं प्रसन्नमनसं पाथोरुहाङ्गद्युतिं पाराशर्य्यमतीव पुण्यचरितं व्यासं स्मरेत्सिद्धये //
text_mt: Whose palm shines with the exposition gesture, seated on an excellent yoga-pīṭha, holding his other hand upon his left knee, a treasure-house of noble knowledge, / surrounded by a multitude of brahmins, serene in mind, with the bodily lustre of a lotus, Pārāśarya whose conduct is exceedingly virtuous—one should meditate upon Vyāsa for attainment.

sanskrit_iast:
japedaṣṭasahasrāṇi pāyasairhemamācaret /
pūrvoktapīṭhe vyāsasya pūrvamaṅgāni pūjayet //
meaning:
जपेदष्टसहस्राणि पायसैर्हेममाचरेत् /
पूर्वोक्तपीठे व्यासस्य पूर्वमङ्गानि पूजयेत् //
text_mt: He should recite [the mantra] eight thousand times and perform fire oblations with milk-rice. / On the previously mentioned pīṭha, he should first worship the limbs of Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyādiṣu yajetpailaṃ vaiśaṃpāyanajaiminī /
sumaṃptuṃ koṇabhāgeṣu śrīśukaṃ romaharṣaṇam //
meaning:
प्राच्यादिषु यजेत्पैलं वैशंपायनजैमिनी /
सुमंप्तुं कोणभागेषु श्रीशुकं रोमहर्षणम् //
text_mt: In the east and the other directions, he should worship Paila, Vaiśaṃpāyana, Jaimini, / and Sumantu; in the corner directions, the glorious Śuka, Romaharṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
ugraśravasamanyāṃśca munīnseṃdrādikāyayudhān /
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kavitvaṃ śobhanāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
उग्रश्रवसमन्यांश्च मुनीन्सेंद्रादिकाययुधान् /
एवं सिद्धमनुर्मन्त्री कवित्वं शोभनाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: and Ugraśravas, as well as the other sages, together with Indra and the other [guardians] and their weapons. / Thus having mastered the mantra, the practitioner of the mantra attains poetic skill, excellent progeny,

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyānaśaktiṃ kīrtiṃ ca labhate saṃpadāṃ cayam /
nṛsiṃho mādhavo dṛṣṭo lohito nigamādimaḥ //
meaning:
व्याख्यानशक्तिं कीर्तिं च लभते संपदां चयम् /
नृसिंहो माधवो दृष्टो लोहितो निगमादिमः //
text_mt: the power of exposition, renown, and an accumulation of riches. / ‘Nṛsiṃha’, ‘Mādhava’, ‘dṛṣṭa’, ‘lohita’, the first of the Vedas [oṃ],

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśānujāyā pañcārṇo manurviṣaharaḥ paraḥ /
anantapaṅktipakṣīndrā muniśchandaḥ surā matāḥ //
meaning:
कृशानुजाया पञ्चार्णो मनुर्विषहरः परः /
अनन्तपङ्क्तिपक्षीन्द्रा मुनिश्छन्दः सुरा मताः //
text_mt: and the wife of fire [svāhā] is the supreme five-syllabled mantra that destroys poison. / Ananta, paṅkti, and the king of birds [Garuḍa] are considered the sage, metre, and deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tāravahnipriye bījaśaktī mantrasya kīrtite /
jvalajvala mahāmantrī svāhā hṛdayamīritam //
meaning:
तारवह्निप्रिये बीजशक्ती मन्त्रस्य कीर्तिते /
ज्वलज्वल महामन्त्री स्वाहा हृदयमीरितम् //
text_mt: Tāra [oṃ] and the beloved of fire [svāhā] are stated to be the seed and the energy of the mantra. / ‘Jvala jvala mahāmantrī svāhā’ is declared to be the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍeti padasyānte cūḍānanaśucipriyā /
śiromantro garuḍataḥ śikhe svāhā śikhā manuḥ //
meaning:
गरुडेति पदस्यान्ते चूडाननशुचिप्रिया /
शिरोमन्त्रो गरुडतः शिखे स्वाहा शिखा मनुः //
text_mt: After the word ‘garuḍa’, ‘cūḍānana’ and the beloved of the pure [svāhā] / is the head mantra; from ‘garuḍa’, ‘śikhe svāhā’ is the śikhā mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍeti padaṃ procya prabhañjayayugaṃ vadet /
prabhedayayugaṃ paścādvitrāsaya vimardaya //
meaning:
गरुडेति पदं प्रोच्य प्रभञ्जययुगं वदेत् /
प्रभेदययुगं पश्चाद्वित्रासय विमर्दय //
text_mt: Uttering the word ‘garuḍa’, one should say the pair of ‘prabhañjaya’, / then the pair of ‘prabhedaya’, ‘vitrāsaya’, ‘vimardaya’,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ dvistataḥ svāhā kavacasya manurmataḥ /
ugrarūpadharānte tu sarvaviṣahareti ca //
meaning:
प्रत्येकं द्विस्ततः स्वाहा कवचस्य मनुर्मतः /
उग्ररूपधरान्ते तु सर्वविषहरेति च //
text_mt: each twice, and then ‘svāhā’ is considered the mantra of the armour. / After ‘ugrarūpadhara’, then ‘sarvaviṣahara’,

sanskrit_iast:
bhīṣayadvitayaṃ procya sarvaṃ dahadaheti ca /
bhasmīkuru tataḥ svāhā netramantro 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
भीषयद्वितयं प्रोच्य सर्वं दहदहेति च /
भस्मीकुरु ततः स्वाहा नेत्रमन्त्रो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: and uttering the pair of ‘bhīṣaya’, then ‘sarvaṃ daha daha’ / and ‘bhasmīkuru’, followed by ‘svāhā’—this is declared to be the eye mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
apratihatavarṇānte balāya prahateti ca /
śāsanānte tathā huṃ phaṭ svāhāstramanurīritaḥ //
meaning:
अप्रतिहतवर्णान्ते बलाय प्रहतेति च /
शासनान्ते तथा हुं फट् स्वाहास्त्रमनुरीरितः //
text_mt: After the syllables ‘apratihata’, ‘balāya prahata’, / and after ‘śāsana’, likewise ‘huṃ phaṭ svāhā’ is declared to be the weapon mantra.

sanskrit_iast: pāde kaṭau hṛdi mukhe mūrdhniṃ varṇānpravinyaset //
meaning: पादे कटौ हृदि मुखे मूर्ध्निं वर्णान्प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should place the syllables on the feet, waist, heart, mouth, and head.

sanskrit_iast:
taptasvarṇanibhaṃ phaṇīndranikaraiḥkḷptāṅga bhūṣaṃprabhuṃ startṛāṇāṃ śamayantamugramakhilaṃ nṝṇāṃ viṣaṃ tatkṣaṇāt /
cañcvagrapracaladbhujaṅgamabhayaṃ pāṇyorvaraṃ bibhrataṃ pakṣoccāritasāmagītamamalaṃ śrīpakṣirājaṃ bhaje //
meaning:
तप्तस्वर्णनिभं फणीन्द्रनिकरैःकॢप्ताङ्ग भूषंप्रभुं स्तर्तृआणां शमयन्तमुग्रमखिलं नॄणां विषं तत्क्षणात् /
चञ्च्वग्रप्रचलद्भुजङ्गमभयं पाण्योर्वरं बिभ्रतं पक्षोच्चारितसामगीतममलं श्रीपक्षिराजं भजे //
text_mt: Resembling molten gold, his bodily ornaments formed of heaps of serpent-kings, the lord who instantly dispels all fierce poison from men who praise him, / terrifying snakes that flutter at the tip of his beak, bearing a boon in his hands, whose pure wings chant the Sāmaveda songs—I revere the glorious king of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ /
pūjayenmātṛkāpīṭhe garuḍaṃ vedavigraham //
meaning:
पञ्चलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः /
पूजयेन्मातृकापीठे गरुडं वेदविग्रहम् //
text_mt: He should recite the mantra five hundred thousand times, and offer a tenth part in fire oblations with sesamum seeds. / On the mātṛkā-pīṭha he should worship Garuḍa, the embodiment of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyantaḥ pakṣirājaḥ svāhā pīṭhamanuḥ smṛtaḥ /
dṛṣṭvāṅgaṃ karṇikāmadhye nāgānyantreṣu pūjayet //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यन्तः पक्षिराजः स्वाहा पीठमनुः स्मृतः /
दृष्ट्वाङ्गं कर्णिकामध्ये नागान्यन्त्रेषु पूजयेत् //
text_mt: ‘Pakṣirāja’ in the dative with ‘svāhā’ is remembered as the pīṭha mantra. / Having visualized the limbs in the middle of the pericarp, he should worship the serpents in the diagrams.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbihirlokapālāṃśca vajrādyairvilasatkarān /
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī nāśayedgaraladvayam /
dehānte labhate cāpiśrīviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde kṛṣṇādimantrabhedanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तद्बिहिर्लोकपालांश्च वज्राद्यैर्विलसत्करान् /
एवं सिद्धमनुर्मन्त्री नाशयेद्गरलद्वयम् /
देहान्ते लभते चापिश्रीविष्णोः परमं पदम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे कृष्णादिमन्त्रभेदनिरूपणं नामैकाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Outside that, [he should worship] the world-guardians whose hands shine with the thunderbolt and other [weapons]. / Thus having mastered the mantra, the practitioner destroys both kinds of poison, / and at the end of the body he attains the supreme abode of the glorious Viṣṇu.

Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, named the Description of the Varieties of Mantras of Kṛṣṇa and Others, in the third quarter of the Bṛhadupākhyāna in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
kiṃ tvaṃ nārada jānāsi pūrvajanmani yattvayā /
prāptaṃ bhagavataḥ sākṣācchūlino yugalātmakam //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
किं त्वं नारद जानासि पूर्वजन्मनि यत्त्वया /
प्राप्तं भगवतः साक्षाच्छूलिनो युगलात्मकम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Do you know, O Nārada, what was obtained by you in a previous birth / directly from the lord who wields the trident [Śiva], consisting of the divine pair,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇamantrarahasyaṃ ca smara vismṛtimāgatam /
sūta uvāca
ityukto nārado viprāḥ kumāreṇa tu dhīmatā //
meaning:
कृष्णमन्त्ररहस्यं च स्मर विस्मृतिमागतम् /
सूत उवाच
इत्युक्तो नारदो विप्राः कुमारेण तु धीमता //
text_mt: and the secret mantra of Kṛṣṇa? Recall what has been forgotten! / Sūta said: / Thus addressed, O brahmins, by the wise Kumāra,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāne vivedāśu ciraṃ caritaṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ /
tataściraṃ dhyānaparo nārado bhagavatpriyaḥ //
meaning:
ध्याने विवेदाशु चिरं चरितं पूर्वजन्मनः /
ततश्चिरं ध्यानपरो नारदो भगवत्प्रियः //
text_mt: Nārada, in meditation, quickly came to know the long past story of his former birth. / Then, intent on meditation for a long time, Nārada, beloved of the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā sarvaṃ suvṛttāntaṃ suprasannānano 'bravīt /
bhagavansarvavṛttāntaḥ pūrvakalpasamudbavaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा सर्वं सुवृत्तान्तं सुप्रसन्नाननो ऽब्रवीत् /
भगवन्सर्ववृत्तान्तः पूर्वकल्पसमुद्बवः //
text_mt: knowing the entire account well, said with a delighted face: / ‘O Lord, the whole account arising from the previous aeon

sanskrit_iast:
mama smṛtimanuprāpto vinā yugalalaṃbhanam /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
मम स्मृतिमनुप्राप्तो विना युगललंभनम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: has returned to my memory, except for the attainment of the divine pair.’ / Hearing those words of the great-souled Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāro bhagavān vyājahāra yathātatham /
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi yasmiñjanmani śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान् व्याजहार यथातथम् /
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्मिञ्जन्मनि शूलिनः //
text_mt: the blessed Sanatkumāra spoke as it truly was. / Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O brahmin, I shall tell you in which birth from the trident-wielder

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaṃ kṛṣṇarahasyaṃ vai sāvadhāno bhavādhunā /
asmātsārasvatātkalpātpūrvasminpañcaviṃśake //
meaning:
प्राप्तं कृष्णरहस्यं वै सावधानो भवाधुना /
अस्मात्सारस्वतात्कल्पात्पूर्वस्मिन्पञ्चविंशके //
text_mt: the secret of Kṛṣṇa was indeed obtained. Be attentive now! / Prior to this present Sārasvata aeon, in the twenty-fifth

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe tvaṃ kāśyapo jāto nārado nāma nāmataḥ /
tatraikadā tvaṃ kailāsaṃ prāptaḥ kṛṣṇasya yoginaḥ //
meaning:
कल्पे त्वं काश्यपो जातो नारदो नाम नामतः /
तत्रैकदा त्वं कैलासं प्राप्तः कृष्णस्य योगिनः //
text_mt: aeon, you were born as a Kāśyapa named Nārada by name. / There, once, you reached Kailāsa to ask of the yogin Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpraṣṭuṃ paramaṃ tatvaṃ śivaṃ kailāsavāsinam /
tvayā pṛṣṭo mahādevo rahasyaṃ svaprakāśitam //
meaning:
संप्रष्टुं परमं तत्वं शिवं कैलासवासिनम् /
त्वया पृष्टो महादेवो रहस्यं स्वप्रकाशितम् //
text_mt: to ask Śiva, the dweller of Kailāsa, about the supreme truth. / Questioned by you, Mahādeva, in accordance with the truth,

sanskrit_iast:
kathayāmāsa tatvena nityalīlānugaṃ hareḥ /
tatastadante tu punastvayā vijñāpito haraḥ //
meaning:
कथयामास तत्वेन नित्यलीलानुगं हरेः /
ततस्तदन्ते तु पुनस्त्वया विज्ञापितो हरः //
text_mt: related the secret revealed by himself, which follows the eternal pastimes of Hari. / Then, at the end of that, Hara was again petitioned by you

sanskrit_iast:
nityāṃ līlāṃ harerdraṣṭuṃ tataḥ prāha sadāśivaḥ /
gopījanapadasyānte vallabheti padaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
नित्यां लीलां हरेर्द्रष्टुं ततः प्राह सदाशिवः /
गोपीजनपदस्यान्ते वल्लभेति पदं ततः //
text_mt: in order to see the eternal pastimes of Hari; then Sadāśiva said: / ‘After the word “gopījana”, then the word “vallabha”,

sanskrit_iast:
caraṇāccharaṇaṃ paścātprapadye iti vai manuḥ /
mantrasyāsya ṛṣiḥ prokto surabhiśchanda eva ca //
meaning:
चरणाच्छरणं पश्चात्प्रपद्ये इति वै मनुः /
मन्त्रस्यास्य ऋषिः प्रोक्तो सुरभिश्छन्द एव च //
text_mt: then from “caraṇāt” to “śaraṇaṃ prapadye”—this is indeed the mantra. / The sage of this mantra is declared to be Surabhi, the metre is

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrī devatā cāsya ballavīvallabho vibhuḥ /
prapanno 'smīti tadbhaktau viniyoga udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
गायत्री देवता चास्य बल्लवीवल्लभो विभुः /
प्रपन्नो ऽस्मीति तद्भक्तौ विनियोग उदाहृतः //
text_mt: gāyatrī, and its deity is the all-pervading Beloved of the cowherd maidens. / The application is declared with “I have taken refuge” in devotion to him.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsya siddhādikaṃ vipra śodhanaṃ nyāsakalpanam /
kevalaṃ cintanaṃ sadyo nityalīlāprakāśakam //
meaning:
नास्य सिद्धादिकं विप्र शोधनं न्यासकल्पनम् /
केवलं चिन्तनं सद्यो नित्यलीलाप्रकाशकम् //
text_mt: It has no [requirement of] purification such as “siddha” and the like, O brahmin, nor any prescription of ritual placement; / mere contemplation immediately reveals the eternal pastimes.

sanskrit_iast: ābhyantarasya dharmasya sādhanaṃ vacmi sāṃpratam //
meaning: आभ्यन्तरस्य धर्मस्य साधनं वच्मि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: I shall now speak of the practice of the internal duty.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgṛhya mantraṃ gurubhaktiyukto vicintya sarvaṃ manasā tadīhitam /
kṛpāṃ tadīyāṃ nijadharmasaṃstho vibhāvayannātmani toṣayedgurum //
meaning:
संगृह्य मन्त्रं गुरुभक्तियुक्तो विचिन्त्य सर्वं मनसा तदीहितम् /
कृपां तदीयां निजधर्मसंस्थो विभावयन्नात्मनि तोषयेद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: Having received the mantra, endowed with devotion to the guru, pondering all his wishes with the mind, / meditating upon his grace in oneself while steadfast in one’s own duty, one should please the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
satāḥ śikṣeta vai dharmāṃnprapannānāṃ bhayāpahān /
aihikāmuṣmikīcintāvidhurān siddhidāyakān //
meaning:
सताः शिक्षेत वै धर्मांन्प्रपन्नानां भयापहान् /
ऐहिकामुष्मिकीचिन्ताविधुरान् सिद्धिदायकान् //
text_mt: One should learn the practices of the virtuous that remove the fears of the surrendered, / free from worldly and other-worldly worries, conferring spiritual attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
sveṣṭadevadhiyā nityaṃ toṣayedvaiṣṇavāṃstathā /
bhartsanādikameteṣāṃ na kadācidvicintayet //
meaning:
स्वेष्टदेवधिया नित्यं तोषयेद्वैष्णवांस्तथा /
भर्त्सनादिकमेतेषां न कदाचिद्विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: With the mindset that they are one's chosen deity, one should always please the Vaiṣṇavas; / one should never think of censuring them and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvakarmavaśādbhavyamaihikaṃ bhogyameva ca /
āyuṣyakaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva kariṣyati //
meaning:
पूर्वकर्मवशाद्भव्यमैहिकं भोग्यमेव च /
आयुष्यकं तथा कृष्णः स्वयमेव करिष्यति //
text_mt: Whatever is to be experienced in this world will occur by the power of past deeds; / likewise, Kṛṣṇa himself will take care of one’s lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nityalīlāsthaṃ cintayetsvadhiyāniśam /
śrīmadarcāvatāreṇa kṛṣṇaṃ paricaretsadā //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णं नित्यलीलास्थं चिन्तयेत्स्वधियानिशम् /
श्रीमदर्चावतारेण कृष्णं परिचरेत्सदा //
text_mt: Day and night one should meditate with one’s intellect on the glorious Kṛṣṇa abiding in eternal pastimes; / one should always serve Kṛṣṇa in the glorious form of the icon-incarnation.

sanskrit_iast:
ananyacintanīyo 'sau prapannaiḥ śaraṇārthibhiḥ /
stheyaṃ ca dehagehādāvudāsīnatayā budhaiḥ //
meaning:
अनन्यचिन्तनीयो ऽसौ प्रपन्नैः शरणार्थिभिः /
स्थेयं च देहगेहादावुदासीनतया बुधैः //
text_mt: He alone should be contemplated with undivided focus by those who have taken refuge, seeking shelter; / and the wise should remain detached from the body, home, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
guroravajñāṃ sādhūnāṃ nindāṃ bhedaṃ hare harau /
vedanindāṃ harernāmabalātpāpasamīhanam //
meaning:
गुरोरवज्ञां साधूनां निन्दां भेदं हरे हरौ /
वेदनिन्दां हरेर्नामबलात्पापसमीहनम् //
text_mt: Disrespect toward the guru, slander of the virtuous, seeing difference between Hari and Hara, / slander of the Vedas, undertaking sin on the strength of the name of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
arthavādaṃ harer nāmni pāṣaṇḍaṃ nāmasaṃgrahe /
alase nāstike caiva harināmopadeśanam //
meaning:
अर्थवादं हरेर् नाम्नि पाषण्डं नामसंग्रहे /
अलसे नास्तिके चैव हरिनामोपदेशनम् //
text_mt: treating Hari’s name as mere praise, heresy in the recitation of the name, / teaching Hari’s name to the lazy and the atheist,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmavismaraṇaṃ cāpi nāmnyanādarameva ca /
saṃtyajed dūrato vatsa doṣānetānsudāruṇān //
meaning:
नामविस्मरणं चापि नाम्न्यनादरमेव च /
संत्यजेद् दूरतो वत्स दोषानेतान्सुदारुणान् //
text_mt: forgetting the name, and disrespect toward the name— / one should avoid these terrible faults from afar, O child!

sanskrit_iast:
prapanno 'smīti satataṃ cintayeddhṛdgataṃ harim /
sa eva pālanaṃ nityaṃ kariṣyati mameti ca //
meaning:
प्रपन्नो ऽस्मीति सततं चिन्तयेद्धृद्गतं हरिम् /
स एव पालनं नित्यं करिष्यति ममेति च //
text_mt: Constantly thinking “I have surrendered”, one should contemplate Hari dwelling in the heart, / and [reflect]: “He alone will always protect me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tavāsmi rādhikānātha karmaṇā manasā girā /
kṛṣṇakānteti caivāsmi yuvāmeva gatirmama //
meaning:
तवास्मि राधिकानाथ कर्मणा मनसा गिरा /
कृष्णकान्तेति चैवास्मि युवामेव गतिर्मम //
text_mt: “I am yours, O Lord of Rādhikā, in deed, thought, and word; / and I am yours, O beloved of Kṛṣṇa! You two alone are my refuge.”

sanskrit_iast:
dāsāḥ sakhāyaḥ pitaraḥ preyasyaśca hareriha /
sarve nityā muniśreṣṭha cintanīyā mahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
दासाः सखायः पितरः प्रेयस्यश्च हरेरिह /
सर्वे नित्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ चिन्तनीया महात्मभिः //
text_mt: The servants, friends, parents, and beloved women of Hari here [on earth]— / all are eternal, O best of sages, and should be contemplated by great souls.

sanskrit_iast:
gamanāgamane nityakaroti vanagoṣṭayoḥ /
gocāraṇaṃ vayasyaiśca vināsuravighātanam //
meaning:
गमनागमने नित्यकरोति वनगोष्टयोः /
गोचारणं वयस्यैश्च विनासुरविघातनम् //
text_mt: He constantly goes and comes between the forest and the cow-pens; / he herds the cows with his companions, except when slaying demons.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhāyo dvādaśākhyātā hareḥ śrīdāmapūrvakāḥ /
rādhikāyāḥ suśīlādyāḥ sakhyo dvātriṃśadīritāḥ //
meaning:
सखायो द्वादशाख्याता हरेः श्रीदामपूर्वकाः /
राधिकायाः सुशीलाद्याः सख्यो द्वात्रिंशदीरिताः //
text_mt: Twelve friends of Hari are recounted, headed by Śrīdāman; / thirty-two female companions of Rādhikā are proclaimed, headed by Suśīlā.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ cintayedvatsa tāsāṃ madhye manoramām /
rūpayauvanasaṃpannāṃ kiśorīṃ ca svalaṅkṛtām //
meaning:
आत्मानं चिन्तयेद्वत्स तासां मध्ये मनोरमाम् /
रूपयौवनसंपन्नां किशोरीं च स्वलङ्कृताम् //
text_mt: Among them, my child, one should imagine oneself as a delightful / young maiden endowed with beauty and youth, well adorned,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāśilpakalābhijñāṃ kṛṣṇabhogānurūpiṇīm /
tatsevanasukhāhlādabhāvenātisunirvṛtām //
meaning:
नानाशिल्पकलाभिज्ञां कृष्णभोगानुरूपिणीम् /
तत्सेवनसुखाह्लादभावेनातिसुनिर्वृताम् //
text_mt: skilled in various crafts and arts, suited for Kṛṣṇa's pleasure, / completely blissful in the disposition of delight in serving him.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ muhūrtamārabhya yāvadardhaniśā bhavet /
tāvatparicarettau tu yathākālānusevayā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मं मुहूर्तमारभ्य यावदर्धनिशा भवेत् /
तावत्परिचरेत्तौ तु यथाकालानुसेवया //
text_mt: Beginning from the hour of Brahmā until midnight comes, / one should attend upon the two of them with service suited to each time.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ ca tayornnāmnāṃ paṭhennityaṃ samāhitaḥ /
etasādhanamuddiṣṭaṃ prapannānāṃ munīśvara //
meaning:
सहस्रं च तयोर्न्नाम्नां पठेन्नित्यं समाहितः /
एतसाधनमुद्दिष्टं प्रपन्नानां मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: With a concentrated mind, one should daily recite the thousand names of both; / this spiritual practice is taught for those who have taken refuge, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
nākhyeyaṃ kasyacittubhyaṃ mayā tattvaṃ prakāśitam /
sanatkumāra uvāca
tatastvaṃ nārada punaḥ pṛṣṭavānvai sadāśivam //
meaning:
नाख्येयं कस्यचित्तुभ्यं मया तत्त्वं प्रकाशितम् /
सनत्कुमार उवाच
ततस्त्वं नारद पुनः पृष्टवान्वै सदाशिवम् //
text_mt:
This must not be told to anyone; the ultimate truth has been revealed to you by me.
Sanatkumāra said:
Then, Nārada, you indeed questioned Sadāśiva again

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ taccāpi proktavāṃ stacchṛṇuṣva me /
dhyātvā vṛndāvane ramye yamunātīrasaṃgatam //
meaning:
नाम्नां सहस्रं तच्चापि प्रोक्तवां स्तच्छृणुष्व मे /
ध्यात्वा वृन्दावने रम्ये यमुनातीरसंगतम् //
text_mt: about that thousand of names, and he too spoke it; hear that from me. / Having meditated on [him] assembled on the bank of the Yamunā in beautiful Vṛndāvana,

sanskrit_iast:
kalpavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya tiṣṭhantaṃ rādhikāyutam /
paṭhennāmasahasraṃ tu yugalākhyaṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
कल्पवृक्षं समाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं राधिकायुतम् /
पठेन्नामसहस्रं तु युगलाख्यं महामुने //
text_mt: standing by a wish-granting tree accompanied by Rādhikā, / one should recite the thousand names named 'The Pair', O great sage:

sanskrit_iast:
devakīnandanaḥ śaurirvāsudevo balānujaḥ /
gadāgrajaḥ kaṃsamohaḥ kaṃsasevakamohanaḥ //
meaning:
देवकीनन्दनः शौरिर्वासुदेवो बलानुजः /
गदाग्रजः कंसमोहः कंससेवकमोहनः //
text_mt: Delight of Devakī, Śauri, Vāsudeva, Younger Brother of Bala, / Elder Brother of Gada, Delusion of Kaṃsa, Deluder of Kaṃsa's Servants,

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnargalaḥ bhinnalohaḥ pitṛbāhyaḥ pitṛstutaḥ /
mātṛstutaḥ śivadhyeyo yamunājalabhedanaḥ //
meaning:
भिन्नर्गलः भिन्नलोहः पितृबाह्यः पितृस्तुतः /
मातृस्तुतः शिवध्येयो यमुनाजलभेदनः //
text_mt: He whose bolts were shattered, He whose irons were broken, Carried by his Father, Praised by his Father, / Praised by his Mother, Meditated upon by Śiva, Cleaver of the Waters of the Yamunā,

sanskrit_iast:
vrajavāsī vrajānandī nandabālo dayānidhiḥ /
līlābālaḥ padmanetro gokulotsava īśvaraḥ //
meaning:
व्रजवासी व्रजानन्दी नन्दबालो दयानिधिः /
लीलाबालः पद्मनेत्रो गोकुलोत्सव ईश्वरः //
text_mt: Dweller in Vraja, Joy of Vraja, Boy of Nanda, Treasure of Compassion, / Playful Boy, Lotus-Eyed, Festival of Gokula, Sovereign Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
gopikānandanaḥ kṛṣṇo gopānandaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ /
bakaprāṇaharo viṣṇurbakamuktiprado hariḥ //
meaning:
गोपिकानन्दनः कृष्णो गोपानन्दः सतां गतिः /
बकप्राणहरो विष्णुर्बकमुक्तिप्रदो हरिः //
text_mt: Delight of the Cowherd Women, Kṛṣṇa, Joy of Cowherds, Refuge of the Virtuous, / Taker of Baka's Life, Viṣṇu, Giver of Liberation to Baka, Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
baladolāśayaśayaḥ śyāmalaḥ sarvasuṃdaraḥ /
padmanābho hṛṣīkeśaḥ krīḍāmanujabālakaḥ //
meaning:
बलदोलाशयशयः श्यामलः सर्वसुंदरः /
पद्मनाभो हृषीकेशः क्रीडामनुजबालकः //
text_mt: Resting in the Cradle of Bala, Dark-Hued, All-Beautiful, / Lotus-Navelled, Hṛṣīkeśa, Human Child in Play,

sanskrit_iast:
līlāvidhvastaśakaṭo vedamantrābhiṣecitaḥ /
yaśodānandanaḥ kānto munikoṭiniṣevitaḥ //
meaning:
लीलाविध्वस्तशकटो वेदमन्त्राभिषेचितः /
यशोदानन्दनः कान्तो मुनिकोटिनिषेवितः //
text_mt: Shatterer of the Cart in Play, Consecrated with Vedic Mantras, / Delight of Yaśodā, Beloved, Served by Millions of Sages,

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ madhuvanāvāsī vaikuṇṭhaḥ saṃbhavaḥ kratuḥ /
ramāpatiryadupatirmurārirmadhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
नित्यं मधुवनावासी वैकुण्ठः संभवः क्रतुः /
रमापतिर्यदुपतिर्मुरारिर्मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Perpetual Dweller in Madhuvana, Vaikuṇṭha, Source of Existence, Sacrifice, / Lord of Ramā, Lord of the Yadus, Enemy of Mura, Slayer of Madhu,

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavo mānahārī ca śrīpatirbhūdharaḥ prabhuḥ /
bṛhadvanamahālīlo nandasūnurmahāsanaḥ //
meaning:
माधवो मानहारी च श्रीपतिर्भूधरः प्रभुः /
बृहद्वनमहालीलो नन्दसूनुर्महासनः //
text_mt: Mādhava, Remover of Pride, Lord of Śrī, Supporter of the Earth, Master, / Great in Play in Bṛhadvana, Son of Nanda, Possessor of a Great Seat,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇāvartaprāṇahārī yaśodāvismayapradaḥ /
trailokyavaktraḥ padmākṣaḥ padmahastaḥ priyaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
तृणावर्तप्राणहारी यशोदाविस्मयप्रदः /
त्रैलोक्यवक्त्रः पद्माक्षः पद्महस्तः प्रियङ्करः //
text_mt: Taker of Tṛṇāvarta's Life, Giver of Wonder to Yaśodā, / Having the Three Worlds in his Mouth, Lotus-Eyed, Lotus-Handed, Beneficent,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyo dharmagoptā ca bhūpatiḥ śrīdharaḥ svarāṭ /
ajādhyakṣaḥ śivādhyakṣo dharmādhyakṣo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्यो धर्मगोप्ता च भूपतिः श्रीधरः स्वराट् /
अजाध्यक्षः शिवाध्यक्षो धर्माध्यक्षो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Friendly to Brāhmaṇas, Protector of Dharma, King of the Earth, Bearer of Śrī, Self-Ruling, / Overseer of Aja, Overseer of Śiva, Overseer of Dharma, Great Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntavedyo brahmasthaḥ prajāpatiramoghadṛk /
gopīkarāvalaṃbī ca gopabālakasupriyaḥ //
meaning:
वेदान्तवेद्यो ब्रह्मस्थः प्रजापतिरमोघदृक् /
गोपीकरावलंबी च गोपबालकसुप्रियः //
text_mt: Known through the Upaniṣads, Abiding in Brahman, Lord of Creatures, Infallible of Sight, / Holding the Hands of Cowherd Women, Dear Friend of Cowherd Boys,

sanskrit_iast:
bālānuyīyī balavān śrīdāmapriya ātmavān /
gopīgṛhāṅgaṇaratirbhadraḥ suślokamaṅgalaḥ //
meaning:
बालानुयीयी बलवान् श्रीदामप्रिय आत्मवान् /
गोपीगृहाङ्गणरतिर्भद्रः सुश्लोकमङ्गलः //
text_mt: Following the Boys, Mighty, Dear to Śrīdāman, Self-Possessed, / Delighting in the Courtyards of Cowherd Women's Houses, Auspicious, Praised in Beautiful Verses,

sanskrit_iast:
navanītaharo bālo navanītapriyāśanaḥ /
bālavṛndī markavṛndī cakitākṣaḥ palāyitaḥ //
meaning:
नवनीतहरो बालो नवनीतप्रियाशनः /
बालवृन्दी मर्कवृन्दी चकिताक्षः पलायितः //
text_mt: Stealer of Fresh Butter, Child, Fond of Eating Fresh Butter, / Surrounded by Children, Surrounded by Monkeys, Startled-Eyed, Fleeing,

sanskrit_iast:
yaśodātarjitaḥ kaṃpī māyāruditaśobhanaḥ /
dāmodaro 'prameyātmā dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
यशोदातर्जितः कंपी मायारुदितशोभनः /
दामोदरो ऽप्रमेयात्मा दयालुर्भक्तवत्सलः //
text_mt: Threatened by Yaśodā, Trembling, Charming in Feigned Crying, / Dāmodara, Immeasurable-Souled, Compassionate, Loving to Devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
subaddholūkhale namraśirā gopīkadarthitaḥ /
vṛkṣabhaṅgī śokabhaṅgī dhanadātmajamokṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सुबद्धोलूखले नम्रशिरा गोपीकदर्थितः /
वृक्षभङ्गी शोकभङ्गी धनदात्मजमोक्षणः //
text_mt: Firmly Bound to the Mortar, Bowed-Headed, Scolded by the Cowherd Woman, / Breaker of the Trees, Dispeller of Grief, Liberator of the Sons of Kuvera,

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣivacanaślāghī bhaktavātsalyasāgaraḥ /
vrajakolāhalakaro vrajānadavivarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
देवर्षिवचनश्लाघी भक्तवात्सल्यसागरः /
व्रजकोलाहलकरो व्रजानदविवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: Praiser of the Words of the Divine Sage, Ocean of Affection for Devotees, / Maker of Clamour in Vraja, Increaser of Vraja's Joy,

sanskrit_iast:
gopātmā prerakaḥ sākṣī vṛndāvananivāsakṛt /
vatsapālo vatsapatirgopadārakamaṇḍanaḥ //
meaning:
गोपात्मा प्रेरकः साक्षी वृन्दावननिवासकृत् /
वत्सपालो वत्सपतिर्गोपदारकमण्डनः //
text_mt: Soul of Cowherds, Instigator, Witness, Dweller in Vṛndāvana, / Protector of Calves, Lord of Calves, Ornament of Cowherd Children,

sanskrit_iast:
bālakrīḍo bālaratirbālakaḥ kanakāṅgadī /
pītāmbaro hemamālī maṇimuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
बालक्रीडो बालरतिर्बालकः कनकाङ्गदी /
पीताम्बरो हेममाली मणिमुक्ताविभूषणः //
text_mt: Boyish in Play, Delighting with Boys, Child, Wearing Golden Armlets, / Clothed in Yellow Garments, Wearing a Golden Garland, Adorned with Gems and Pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇīkaṭakī sūtrī nūpurī mudri kānvitaḥ /
vatsāsurapatidhvaṃsī bakāsuravināśanaḥ //
meaning:
किङ्किणीकटकी सूत्री नूपुरी मुद्रि कान्वितः /
वत्सासुरपतिध्वंसी बकासुरविनाशनः //
text_mt: Wearing Small Bells and Bracelets, Wearing a Girdle-Cord, Wearing Anklets, Wearing Rings, / Destroyer of the Lord of Vatsāsura, Destroyer of Bakāsura,

sanskrit_iast:
aghāsuravināśī ca vinidrīkṛtabālakaḥ /
ādya ātmapradaḥ saṃgī yamunātīrabhojanaḥ //
meaning:
अघासुरविनाशी च विनिद्रीकृतबालकः /
आद्य आत्मप्रदः संगी यमुनातीरभोजनः //
text_mt: Destroyer of Aghāsura, He who Awakened the Boys, / Primordial, Giver of Himself, Companion, Feasting on the Bank of the Yamunā,

sanskrit_iast:
gopālamaṇḍalīmadhyaḥ sarvagopālabhūṣaṇaḥ /
kṛtahastatalagrāso vyañjanāśritaśākhikaḥ //
meaning:
गोपालमण्डलीमध्यः सर्वगोपालभूषणः /
कृतहस्ततलग्रासो व्यञ्जनाश्रितशाखिकः //
text_mt: He stands in the midst of the circle of cowherds, the ornament of all cowherds; / he has morsels of food on his palms, and rests by the branch under the shade of a tree.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtabāhuśṛṅgayaṣṭiguñjālaṅkṛtakaṇṭhakaḥ /
mayūrapicchamukuṭo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
कृतबाहुशृङ्गयष्टिगुञ्जालङ्कृतकण्ठकः /
मयूरपिच्छमुकुटो वनमालाविभूषितः //
text_mt: He carries a horn and a staff on his arm, his neck is adorned with guñjā berries; / his crown is made of peacock feathers, and he is beautified with a forest garland.

sanskrit_iast:
gairikācitritavapurnavameghavapuḥ smaraḥ /
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyo lasanmakarakuṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
गैरिकाचित्रितवपुर्नवमेघवपुः स्मरः /
कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्यो लसन्मकरकुण्डलः //
text_mt: His body is painted with red minerals, his form is like a fresh raincloud, he is the god of love; / he possesses the loveliness of ten million Kandarpa gods, and wears gleaming shark-shaped earrings.

sanskrit_iast:
ājānubāhurbhagavānnidrārahitalocanaḥ /
koṭisāgaragābhīryaḥ kālakālaḥ sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
आजानुबाहुर्भगवान्निद्रारहितलोचनः /
कोटिसागरगाभीर्यः कालकालः सदाशिवः //
text_mt: His arms reach to his knees, he is the Lord whose eyes are free from sleep; / deep as ten million oceans, the death of Death, ever auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
virañcimohanavapurgopavatsavapurddharaḥ /
brahmāṇḍakoṭijanako brahmamohavināśakaḥ //
meaning:
विरञ्चिमोहनवपुर्गोपवत्सवपुर्द्धरः /
ब्रह्माण्डकोटिजनको ब्रह्ममोहविनाशकः //
text_mt: His form bewildered Brahmā, he assumed the forms of the cowherd boys and calves; / the progenitor of billions of universes, he dispelled the delusion of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā brahmeḍitaḥ svāmī śakradarpādināśanaḥ /
giripūjopadeṣṭā ca dhṛtagovarddhanācalaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मेडितः स्वामी शक्रदर्पादिनाशनः /
गिरिपूजोपदेष्टा च धृतगोवर्द्धनाचलः //
text_mt: He is Brahmā, praised by Brahmā, the master, the destroyer of the pride of Indra and others; / the teacher of the worship of the mountain, who held up Mount Govardhana.

sanskrit_iast:
purandareḍitaḥ pūjyaḥ kāmadhenuprapūjitaḥ /
sarvatīrthābhiṣiktaśca govindo goparakṣakaḥ //
meaning:
पुरन्दरेडितः पूज्यः कामधेनुप्रपूजितः /
सर्वतीर्थाभिषिक्तश्च गोविन्दो गोपरक्षकः //
text_mt: Praised by Indra, worthy of worship, worshipped by Kāmadhenu; / anointed with [the waters of] all sacred fords, he is Govinda, the protector of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
kāliyārtikaraḥ krūro nāgapatnīḍito virāṭ /
dhenukāriḥ pralaṃbārirvṛṣāsuravimardanaḥ //
meaning:
कालियार्तिकरः क्रूरो नागपत्नीडितो विराट् /
धेनुकारिः प्रलंबारिर्वृषासुरविमर्दनः //
text_mt: He brought distress to Kāliya, fierce, praised by the wives of the serpent, the cosmic form; / the enemy of Dhenuka, the enemy of Pralamba, the crusher of the bull-demon.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāsurātmajadhvaṃsī keśikaṇṭhavidārakaḥ /
gopagoptā dhenugoptā dāvāgnipariśoṣakaḥ //
meaning:
मायासुरात्मजध्वंसी केशिकण्ठविदारकः /
गोपगोप्ता धेनुगोप्ता दावाग्निपरिशोषकः //
text_mt: The slayer of the son of the demon Maya, the tearer of Keśin's neck; / the protector of cowherds, the protector of cows, the dried of the forest fire.

sanskrit_iast:
gopakanyāvastrahārī gopakanyāvarapradaḥ /
yajñapatnyannabhojī ca munimānāpahārakaḥ //
meaning:
गोपकन्यावस्त्रहारी गोपकन्यावरप्रदः /
यज्ञपत्न्यन्नभोजी च मुनिमानापहारकः //
text_mt: The stealer of the garments of the cowherd girls, the bestower of boons on the cowherd girls; / the eater of the food offered by the wives of the sacrificers, the remover of the sages' pride.

sanskrit_iast:
jaleśamānamathano nandagopālajīvanaḥ /
gandharvaśāpamoktā ca śaṅkhacūḍaśiroharaḥ //
meaning:
जलेशमानमथनो नन्दगोपालजीवनः /
गन्धर्वशापमोक्ता च शङ्खचूडशिरोहरः //
text_mt: The crusher of the pride of the lord of waters, the very life of the cowherd Nanda; / the releaser from the Gandharva's curse, who cut off the head of Śaṅkhacūḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśī vaṭī veṇuvādī gopīcintāpahārakaḥ /
sarvagoptā samāhvānaḥ sarvagopīmanorathaḥ //
meaning:
वंशी वटी वेणुवादी गोपीचिन्तापहारकः /
सर्वगोप्ता समाह्वानः सर्वगोपीमनोरथः //
text_mt: He holds the flute and reed-pipe, plays the flute, and removes the anxiety of the milkmaids; / the protector of all, he summons them, the fulfillment of all desires of the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaṅgadharmapravaktā ca gopīmaṇḍalamohanaḥ /
rāsakrīḍārasāsvādī rasiko rādhikādhavaḥ //
meaning:
व्यङ्गधर्मप्रवक्ता च गोपीमण्डलमोहनः /
रासक्रीडारसास्वादी रसिको राधिकाधवः //
text_mt: The proclaimer of subtle, esoteric duty, the bewitcher of the circle of milkmaids; / the relisher of the rasa of the rāsa dance, the connoisseur of rasa, the consort of Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
kiśorīprāṇanāthaśca vṛṣabhānasutāpriyaḥ /
sarvagopījanānandī gopījanavimohanaḥ //
meaning:
किशोरीप्राणनाथश्च वृषभानसुताप्रियः /
सर्वगोपीजनानन्दी गोपीजनविमोहनः //
text_mt: The lord of the young girl's life-breath, dear to the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu; / the delighter of all the milkmaids, the bewitcher of the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
gopikāgītacarito gopīnartanalālasaḥ /
gopīskandhāśritakaro gopikācuṃbanapriyaḥ //
meaning:
गोपिकागीतचरितो गोपीनर्तनलालसः /
गोपीस्कन्धाश्रितकरो गोपिकाचुंबनप्रियः //
text_mt: His deeds are sung by the milkmaids, he longs to dance with the milkmaids; / his hands rest on the shoulders of the milkmaids, he delights in kissing the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
gopikāmārjitamukho gopīvyañjanavījitaḥ /
gopikākeśasaṃskārī gopikāpuṣpasaṃstaraḥ //
meaning:
गोपिकामार्जितमुखो गोपीव्यञ्जनवीजितः /
गोपिकाकेशसंस्कारी गोपिकापुष्पसंस्तरः //
text_mt: His face is wiped by the milkmaids, he is fanned by the fans of the milkmaids; / he dresses the hair of the milkmaids, he provides a couch of flowers for the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
gopikāhṛdayālaṃbī gopīvahanatatparaḥ /
gopikāmadahārī ca gopikāparamārjitaḥ //
meaning:
गोपिकाहृदयालंबी गोपीवहनतत्परः /
गोपिकामदहारी च गोपिकापरमार्जितः //
text_mt: He rests upon the hearts of the milkmaids, he is intent upon carrying the milkmaids; / he takes away the pride of the milkmaids, he is thoroughly cleansed by the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
gopikākṛtasaṃnīlo gopikāsaṃsmṛtapriyaḥ /
gopikāvanditapado gopikāvaśavartanaḥ //
meaning:
गोपिकाकृतसंनीलो गोपिकासंस्मृतप्रियः /
गोपिकावन्दितपदो गोपिकावशवर्तनः //
text_mt: He conceals himself among the milkmaids, his affection is remembered by the milkmaids; / his feet are worshipped by the milkmaids, he is obedient to the will of the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā parājitaḥ śrīmānnikuñjesuvihāravān /
kuñjapriyaḥ kuñjavāsī vṛndāvanavikāsanaḥ //
meaning:
राधा पराजितः श्रीमान्निकुञ्जेसुविहारवान् /
कुञ्जप्रियः कुञ्जवासी वृन्दावनविकासनः //
text_mt: Defeated by Rādhā, glorious, he sports in the bowers; / fond of bowers, dwelling in bowers, he causes Vṛndāvana to blossom.

sanskrit_iast:
yamunājalasiktāṅgo yamunāsaukhyadāyakaḥ /
śaśisaṃstaṃbhanaḥ śūraḥ kāmī kāmavimohanaḥ //
meaning:
यमुनाजलसिक्ताङ्गो यमुनासौख्यदायकः /
शशिसंस्तंभनः शूरः कामी कामविमोहनः //
text_mt: His limbs are sprinkled with the water of the Yamunā, the giver of joy to the Yamunā; / he stays the moon, heroic, impassioned, confounding the god of love.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmādyāḥ kāmanāthaśca kāmamānasabhedanaḥ /
kāmadaḥ kāmarūpaśca kāminīkāmasaṃcayaḥ //
meaning:
कामाद्याः कामनाथश्च काममानसभेदनः /
कामदः कामरूपश्च कामिनीकामसंचयः //
text_mt: The source of desire, the lord of desires, the piercer of the heart of love; / the granter of desires, assuming any form at will, the repository of desires for passionate women.

sanskrit_iast:
nityakrīḍo mahālīlaḥ sarvaḥ sarvagatastathā /
paramātmā parādhīśaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ (m) //
meaning:
नित्यक्रीडो महालीलः सर्वः सर्वगतस्तथा /
परमात्मा पराधीशः सर्वकारणकारणः (म्) //
text_mt: His play is eternal, his pastimes are immense, the All, and likewise omnipresent; / the Supreme Self, the supreme sovereign, the cause of all causes.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītanāradavacā hyakrūraparicintitaḥ /
akrūravanditapado gopikātoṣakārakaḥ //
meaning:
गृहीतनारदवचा ह्यक्रूरपरिचिन्तितः /
अक्रूरवन्दितपदो गोपिकातोषकारकः //
text_mt: He heeded the words of Nārada, contemplated by Akrūra; / his feet were praised by Akrūra, he brings contentment to the milkmaids.

sanskrit_iast:
akrūravākyasaṃgrāhī mathurāvāsakāraṇaḥ (m) /
akrūratāpaśamano rajakāyuḥpraṇāśanaḥ //
meaning:
अक्रूरवाक्यसंग्राही मथुरावासकारणः (म्) /
अक्रूरतापशमनो रजकायुःप्रणाशनः //
text_mt: He accepted the speech of Akrūra, the cause of the residence in Mathurā; / the pacifier of Akrūra's anguish, the destroyer of the washerman's lifespan.

sanskrit_iast:
mathurānandadāyī ca kaṃsavastraviluṇṭhanaḥ /
kaṃsavastraparīdhāno gopavastrapradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
मथुरानन्ददायी च कंसवस्त्रविलुण्ठनः /
कंसवस्त्रपरीधानो गोपवस्त्रप्रदायकः //
text_mt: The bestower of joy upon Mathurā, the plunderer of Kaṃsa's garments; / he dressed in the garments of Kaṃsa, and gave garments to the cowherds.

sanskrit_iast:
sudāmagṛhagāmī ca sudāmaparipūjitaḥ /
tantuvāya kasaṃprītaḥ kubjācandanalepanaḥ //
meaning:
सुदामगृहगामी च सुदामपरिपूजितः /
तन्तुवाय कसंप्रीतः कुब्जाचन्दनलेपनः //
text_mt: He went to the house of Sudāman, and was worshipped by Sudāman; / delighted by the weaver, smeared with the sandalwood paste of Kubjā.

sanskrit_iast:
kubjārūpaprado vijño mukundo viṣṭaraśravāḥ /
sarvajño mathurālokī sarvalokābhinandanaḥ //
meaning:
कुब्जारूपप्रदो विज्ञो मुकुन्दो विष्टरश्रवाः /
सर्वज्ञो मथुरालोकी सर्वलोकाभिनन्दनः //
text_mt: He granted beauty of form to Kubjā, wise, Mukunda, of far-reaching fame; / omniscient, gazing upon Mathurā, the delight of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpākaṭākṣadarśī ca daityārirdevapālakaḥ /
sarvaduḥkhapraśamano dhanubharṅgī mahotsavaḥ //
meaning:
कृपाकटाक्षदर्शी च दैत्यारिर्देवपालकः /
सर्वदुःखप्रशमनो धनुभर्ङ्गी महोत्सवः //
text_mt: Looking with a glance of compassion, the enemy of the Daityas, the protector of the gods; / the pacifier of all distress, the breaker of the bow, a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
kuvalayāpīḍahṝntā dantaskandhabalāgraṇīḥ /
kalparūpadharodhīro divyavastrānulepanaḥ //
meaning:
कुवलयापीडहॄन्ता दन्तस्कन्धबलाग्रणीः /
कल्परूपधरोधीरो दिव्यवस्त्रानुलेपनः //
text_mt: The slayer of Kuvalayāpīḍa, foremost in strength bearing tusks upon his shoulder; / assuming the form of the wishing-tree, resolute, endowed with divine garments and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
mallarūpo mahākālaḥ kāmarūpī balānvitaḥ /
kaṃsatrāsakaro bhīmo muṣṭikāntaśca kaṃsahā //
meaning:
मल्लरूपो महाकालः कामरूपी बलान्वितः /
कंसत्रासकरो भीमो मुष्टिकान्तश्च कंसहा //
text_mt: Appearing as a wrestler, great Death, taking any form at will, endowed with strength; / causing terror to Kaṃsa, terrible, the ender of Muṣṭika, the slayer of Kaṃsa.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇūraghno bhayaharaḥ śalāristośalāntakaḥ /
vaikuṇṭhavāsī kaṃsāriḥ sarvaduṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ //
meaning:
चाणूरघ्नो भयहरः शलारिस्तोशलान्तकः /
वैकुण्ठवासी कंसारिः सर्वदुष्टनिषूदनः //
text_mt: The slayer of Cāṇūra, the remover of fear, the enemy of Śala, the destroyer of Tośala; / dwelling in Vaikuṇṭha, the enemy of Kaṃsa, the slayer of all evil ones.

sanskrit_iast:
devadundubhinirghoṣī pitṛśokanivāraṇaḥ /
yādavendraḥ satāṃnātho yādavāripramarddanaḥ //
meaning:
देवदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषी पितृशोकनिवारणः /
यादवेन्द्रः सतांनाथो यादवारिप्रमर्द्दनः //
text_mt: Announced by the roar of the divine drums, the dispeller of his parents' sorrow; / the chief of the Yādavas, the lord of the virtuous, the crusher of the enemies of the Yādavas.

sanskrit_iast:
śauriśokavināśī ca devakītāpanāśanaḥ /
ugrasenaparitrātā ugrasenābhipūjitaḥ //
meaning:
शौरिशोकविनाशी च देवकीतापनाशनः /
उग्रसेनपरित्राता उग्रसेनाभिपूजितः //
text_mt: The destroyer of the sorrow of Śūrasena's son [Vasudeva], the dispeller of Devakī's grief; / the savior of Ugrasena, deeply worshipped by Ugrasena.

sanskrit_iast:
ugrasenābhiṣekī ca ugrasenadayā paraḥ /
sarvasātvatasākṣī ca yadūnāmabhinandanaḥ //
meaning:
उग्रसेनाभिषेकी च उग्रसेनदया परः /
सर्वसात्वतसाक्षी च यदूनामभिनन्दनः //
text_mt: He consecrated Ugrasena, devoted with mercy to Ugrasena; / the witness of all the Sātvatas, the delight of the Yadus.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāthurasaṃsevyaḥ karuṇo bhaktabāndhavaḥ /
sarvagopāladhanado gopīgopālalālasaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वमाथुरसंसेव्यः करुणो भक्तबान्धवः /
सर्वगोपालधनदो गोपीगोपाललालसः //
text_mt: Served by all the residents of Mathurā, compassionate, the kinsman of his devotees; / the giver of wealth to all cowherds, full of yearning for the milkmaids and cowherds.

sanskrit_iast:
śauridattopavītī ca ugrasenadayākaraḥ /
gurubhakto brahmacārī nigamādhyayane rataḥ //
meaning:
शौरिदत्तोपवीती च उग्रसेनदयाकरः /
गुरुभक्तो ब्रह्मचारी निगमाध्ययने रतः //
text_mt: Invested with the sacred thread by the son of Śūrasena, showing mercy to Ugrasena; / devoted to his guru, a celibate student, engaged in the study of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkarṣaṇasahādhyāyī sudāmasuhṛdeva ca /
vidyānidhiḥ kalākośo mṛtaputradastathā //
meaning:
संकर्षणसहाध्यायी सुदामसुहृदेव च /
विद्यानिधिः कलाकोशो मृतपुत्रदस्तथा //
text_mt: The fellow-student of Saṃkarṣaṇa, indeed the friend of Sudāman; / a treasury of learning, a repository of arts, the restorer of his [teacher's] dead son.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrī pāñcajanī caiva sarvanārakimocanaḥ /
yamārcitaḥ paro devo nāmoccāravaso (śo)'cyutaḥ //
meaning:
चक्री पाञ्चजनी चैव सर्वनारकिमोचनः /
यमार्चितः परो देवो नामोच्चारवसो (शो)ऽच्युतः //
text_mt: Bearer of the discus, possessing the conch Pāñcajanya, the deliverer of all residents of hell; / worshipped by Yama, the supreme God, Acyuta who is won by the utterance of his name.

sanskrit_iast:
kubjā vilāsī subhago dīnabandhuranūpamaḥ /
akrūragṛhagoptā ca pratijñāpālakaḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
कुब्जा विलासी सुभगो दीनबन्धुरनूपमः /
अक्रूरगृहगोप्ता च प्रतिज्ञापालकः शुभः //
text_mt: Sporting with Kubjā, fortunate, friend of the destitute, incomparable; / the protector of Akrūra's house, keeper of his promise, auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
jarāsaṃdhajayī vidvān yavanānto dvijāśrayaḥ /
mucukundapriyakarojarāsaṃdhapalāyitaḥ //
meaning:
जरासंधजयी विद्वान् यवनान्तो द्विजाश्रयः /
मुचुकुन्दप्रियकरोजरासंधपलायितः //
text_mt: Conqueror of Jarāsaṃdha, learned, the end of the Yavana, refuge of the twice-born; / doing what was pleasing to Mucukunda, fleeing from Jarāsaṃdha.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakājanako gūḍho brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ /
līlādharaḥ priyakaro viśvakarmā yaśaḥpradaḥ //
meaning:
द्वारकाजनको गूढो ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यसंगरः /
लीलाधरः प्रियकरो विश्वकर्मा यशःप्रदः //
text_mt: The founder of Dvārakā, hidden, friendly to Brahmins, true to his word; / maintainer of divine play, doing what is pleasing, Viśvakarman himself, bestower of fame.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇīpriyasaṃdeśo rukmaśokavivarddhanaḥ /
caidyaśokālayaḥ śreṣṭho duṣṭarājanyanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मिणीप्रियसंदेशो रुक्मशोकविवर्द्धनः /
चैद्यशोकालयः श्रेष्ठो दुष्टराजन्यनाशनः //
text_mt: Bearer of Rukmiṇī's dear message, increaser of the grief of Rukmin; / the abode of grief for the king of Cedi, the foremost, the destroyer of wicked kings.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmivairūpyakaraṇo rukmiṇīvacane rataḥ /
balabhadravacogrāhī muktarukmī janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मिवैरूप्यकरणो रुक्मिणीवचने रतः /
बलभद्रवचोग्राही मुक्तरुक्मी जनार्दनः //
text_mt: The cause of Rukmin's disfigurement, intent on the words of Rukmiṇī; / heeding the words of Balabhadra, releasing Rukmin, Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇīprāṇanāthaśca satyabhāmāpatiḥ svayam /
bhaktapakṣī bhaktivaśyo hyakrūramaṇidāyakaḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मिणीप्राणनाथश्च सत्यभामापतिः स्वयम् /
भक्तपक्षी भक्तिवश्यो ह्यक्रूरमणिदायकः //
text_mt: The lord of Rukmiṇī's life-breath, himself the husband of Satyabhāmā; / taking the side of his devotees, submissive to devotion, the giver of the jewel to Akrūra.

sanskrit_iast:
śatadhanvāprāṇahārī ṛkṣarājasutāpriyaḥ /
satrājittanayākānto mitravindāpahārakaḥ //
meaning:
शतधन्वाप्राणहारी ऋक्षराजसुताप्रियः /
सत्राजित्तनयाकान्तो मित्रविन्दापहारकः //
text_mt: The taker of Śatadhanvan's life, dear to the daughter of the king of bears; / beloved of Satrājit's daughter, the carrier-off of Mitravindā.

sanskrit_iast:
satyāpatirlakṣmaṇājitpūjyo bhadrāpriyaṅkaraḥ /
narakā suraghātīṃ ca līlākanyāharo jayī //
meaning:
सत्यापतिर्लक्ष्मणाजित्पूज्यो भद्राप्रियङ्करः /
नरका सुरघातीं च लीलाकन्याहरो जयी //
text_mt: The husband of Satyā, conqueror of Lakṣmaṇā, worthy of worship, pleasing to Bhadrā; / the slayer of the demon Naraka, carrying off the maidens in sport, victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
murārirmadaneśo 'pi dharitrīduḥkhanāśanaḥ /
vainateyī svargagāmī aditya kuṇḍalapradaḥ //
meaning:
मुरारिर्मदनेशो ऽपि धरित्रीदुःखनाशनः /
वैनतेयी स्वर्गगामी अदित्य कुण्डलप्रदः //
text_mt: Murāri, lord of Love, dispeller of the earth's distress; / riding on Garuḍa, ascending to heaven, restorer of Aditi's earrings.

sanskrit_iast:
indrārcito ramākānto vajribhāryāprapūjitaḥ /
pārijātāpahārī ca śakramānāpahārakaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रार्चितो रमाकान्तो वज्रिभार्याप्रपूजितः /
पारिजातापहारी च शक्रमानापहारकः //
text_mt: Worshipped by Indra, consort of Ramā, honored by the wife of the wielder of the thunderbolt; / taker of the Pārijāta tree, dispeller of the pride of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnajanakaḥ sāṃbatāto bahusuto vidhuḥ /
gargācāryaḥ satyagatirdharmādhāro dhāradharaḥ //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नजनकः सांबतातो बहुसुतो विधुः /
गर्गाचार्यः सत्यगतिर्धर्माधारो धारधरः //
text_mt: The father of Pradyumna, the father of Sāmba, having many sons, the moon; / having Garga as teacher, the true path, the foundation of righteousness, bearer of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāmaṇḍanaḥ ślokyaḥ suśloko nigamālayaḥ /
paiṇḍrakaprāṇahārī ca kāśīrājaśiroharaḥ //
meaning:
द्वारकामण्डनः श्लोक्यः सुश्लोको निगमालयः /
पैण्ड्रकप्राणहारी च काशीराजशिरोहरः //
text_mt: The ornament of Dvārakā, worthy of praise, of glorious renown, the dwelling of the Vedas; / the taker of Pauṇḍraka's life-breath, the severer of the head of the king of Kāśī.

sanskrit_iast:
avaiṣṇavavipradāhī sudakṣiṇabhayābahaḥ /
jarāsaṃdhavidārīṃ ca dharmanandanayajñakṛt //
meaning:
अवैष्णवविप्रदाही सुदक्षिणभयाबहः /
जरासंधविदारीं च धर्मनन्दनयज्ञकृत् //
text_mt: The burner of the non-Vaiṣṇava Brahmin, inspiring terror in Sudakṣiṇa; / the tearer of Jarāsaṃdha, performer of the sacrifice of the son of Dharma [Yudhiṣṭhira].

sanskrit_iast:
śiśupālaśiraraścedī dantavakravināśanaḥ /
vidūrathāṃsakaḥ śrīśaḥ śrīdo dvividanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
शिशुपालशिररश्चेदी दन्तवक्रविनाशनः /
विदूरथांसकः श्रीशः श्रीदो द्विविदनाशनः //
text_mt: The severer of Śiśupāla's head, the destroyer of Dantavakra; / the slayer of Vidūratha, lord of Śrī, bestower of fortune, the destroyer of Dvivida.

sanskrit_iast:
