rukmiṇīmānahārī ca rukmiṇīmānavarddhanaḥ /
devarṣiśāpahartā ca draupadīvākyapālakaḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मिणीमानहारी च रुक्मिणीमानवर्द्धनः /
देवर्षिशापहर्ता च द्रौपदीवाक्यपालकः //
text_mt: Subduer of Rukmiṇī's Pride, Increaser of Rukmiṇī's Honour, / Remover of the Divine Sage's Curse, Keeper of Draupadī's Word,

sanskrit_iast:
durvāso bhayahāti va pāñcālīsmaraṇāgataḥ /
pārthadūtaḥ pārthamantrī pārthaduḥkhaudhanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्वासो भयहाति व पाञ्चालीस्मरणागतः /
पार्थदूतः पार्थमन्त्री पार्थदुःखौधनाशनः //
text_mt: Dispeller of Fear from Durvāsas, Coming at the Remembrance of the Princess of Pañcāla, / Messenger of Arjuna, Counsellor of Arjuna, Destroyer of the Multitude of Arjuna's Sorrows,

sanskrit_iast:
pārthamānāpahārī ca pārthajīvanadāyakaḥ /
pāñcālī vastradātā ca viśvapālakapālakaḥ //
meaning:
पार्थमानापहारी च पार्थजीवनदायकः /
पाञ्चाली वस्त्रदाता च विश्वपालकपालकः //
text_mt: Remover of Arjuna's Pride, Giver of Life to Arjuna, / Giver of Garments to the Princess of Pañcāla, Protector of the Protectors of the World,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāśvasārathiḥ satyaḥ satyasādhyo bhayāpahaḥ /
satyasaṃdhaḥ satyaratiḥ satyapriya udāradhīḥ //
meaning:
श्वेताश्वसारथिः सत्यः सत्यसाध्यो भयापहः /
सत्यसंधः सत्यरतिः सत्यप्रिय उदारधीः //
text_mt: Charioteer of the White Horses, Truth, Attainable through Truth, Remover of Fear, / True to his Promise, Delighting in Truth, Fond of Truth, Generous-Minded,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsenajayī caiva śivasainyavināśananaḥ /
bāṇāsurabhujacchettā bāṇabāhuvarapradaḥ //
meaning:
महासेनजयी चैव शिवसैन्यविनाशननः /
बाणासुरभुजच्छेत्ता बाणबाहुवरप्रदः //
text_mt: Conqueror of Kārttikeya, Destroyer of Śiva's Army, / Lopper of Bāṇāsura's Arms, Granter of Boons to Bāṇa's Arms,

sanskrit_iast:
tārkṣyamānāpahārī ca tārkṣyatejovivarddhanaḥ /
rāmasvarūpadhārī ca satyabhāmāmudāvahaḥ //
meaning:
तार्क्ष्यमानापहारी च तार्क्ष्यतेजोविवर्द्धनः /
रामस्वरूपधारी च सत्यभामामुदावहः //
text_mt: Subduer of Garuḍa's Pride, Increaser of Garuḍa's Splendour, / Taking the Form of Rāma, Bringer of Joy to Satyabhāmā,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnākarajalakrīḍo vrajalīlāpradarśakaḥ /
svapratijñāparidhvaṃsī bhīṣmājñāparipālakaḥ //
meaning:
रत्नाकरजलक्रीडो व्रजलीलाप्रदर्शकः /
स्वप्रतिज्ञापरिध्वंसी भीष्माज्ञापरिपालकः //
text_mt: Sporting in the Waters of the Ocean, Revealer of the Plays of Vraja, / Destroyer of his Own Vow, Keeper of Bhīṣma's Command,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrāyudhaharaḥ kālaḥ kālikeśo mahābalaḥ /
varvarīṣaśirohārī varvarīṣaśiraḥpradaḥ //
meaning:
वीरायुधहरः कालः कालिकेशो महाबलः /
वर्वरीषशिरोहारी वर्वरीषशिरःप्रदः //
text_mt: Stripper of the Weapons of Warriors, Death, Lord of the Dark One, Of Great Strength, / Taker of Varvarīṣa's Head, Restorer of Varvarīṣa's Head,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaputrajayī śūraduryodhanamadāntakaḥ /
gopikāprītinirbandhanityakrīḍo vrajeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
धर्मपुत्रजयी शूरदुर्योधनमदान्तकः /
गोपिकाप्रीतिनिर्बन्धनित्यक्रीडो व्रजेश्वरः //
text_mt: Causing the Victory of the Son of Dharma, Queller of the Pride of Heroic Duryodhana, / Perpetually Sporting through the Bond of the Cowherd Women's Love, Lord of Vraja,

sanskrit_iast:
rādhākuṇḍaratirdhanyaḥ sadāndolasamāśritaḥ /
sadāmadhuvanānandī sadāvṛndāvanapriyaḥ //
meaning:
राधाकुण्डरतिर्धन्यः सदान्दोलसमाश्रितः /
सदामधुवनानन्दी सदावृन्दावनप्रियः //
text_mt: Delighting in Rādhākuṇḍa, Blessed, Ever Residing on a Swing, / Ever Rejoicing in Madhuvana, Ever Fond of Vṛndāvana,

sanskrit_iast:
aśokavanasannaddhaḥ sadātilakasaṃgataḥ /
sadāgovarddhanaratiḥ sadā gokulavallabhaḥ //
meaning:
अशोकवनसन्नद्धः सदातिलकसंगतः /
सदागोवर्द्धनरतिः सदा गोकुलवल्लभः //
text_mt: Arrayed in the Aśoka Grove, Ever Marked with Tilaka, / Ever Delighting in Govardhana, Ever Dear to Gokula,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṇḍīravaṭasaṃvāsī nityaṃ vaṃśīvaṭasthitaḥ /
nandagrāmakṛtāvāso vṛṣabhānugrahapriyaḥ //
meaning:
भाण्डीरवटसंवासी नित्यं वंशीवटस्थितः /
नन्दग्रामकृतावासो वृषभानुग्रहप्रियः //
text_mt: Dwelling at the Bhāṇḍīra Banyan, Perpetually Abiding at the Vaṃśīvaṭa, / Making his Abode in Nandagrāma, Fond of the House of Vṛṣabhānu,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītakāminīrūpo nityaṃ rāsivilāsakṛt /
vallavījanasaṃgoptā vallavījanavallabhaḥ //
meaning:
गृहीतकामिनीरूपो नित्यं रासिविलासकृत् /
वल्लवीजनसंगोप्ता वल्लवीजनवल्लभः //
text_mt: Assuming the Form of a Desirable Woman, Perpetually Sporting in the Rāsa Dance, / Protector of the Cowherd Women, Beloved of the Cowherd Women,

sanskrit_iast:
devaśarmakṛpākartā kalpapādapasaṃsthitaḥ /
śilānugandhanilayaḥ pādacārī ghanacchaviḥ //
meaning:
देवशर्मकृपाकर्ता कल्पपादपसंस्थितः /
शिलानुगन्धनिलयः पादचारी घनच्छविः //
text_mt: Bestower of Grace on Devaśarman, Dwelling at the Wish-Granting Tree, / Residing in the Fragrance of Stone, Moving on Foot, Of Cloud-Like Hue,

sanskrit_iast:
atasīkusumaprakhyaḥ sadā lakṣmīkṛpākaraḥ /
tripurāripriyakaro hyugradhanvāparājitaḥ //
meaning:
अतसीकुसुमप्रख्यः सदा लक्ष्मीकृपाकरः /
त्रिपुरारिप्रियकरो ह्युग्रधन्वापराजितः //
text_mt: Resembling the Atasī Flower, Constantly Showing Grace to Lakṣmī, / Bringing Pleasure to the Foe of Tripura, Armed with a Fierce Bow, Unconquered,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdhuradhvaṃsakartā ca nikuṃbhaprāṇahārakaḥ /
vajranābhapuradhvaṃsī paiṇḍrakaprāṇahārakaḥ //
meaning:
षड्धुरध्वंसकर्ता च निकुंभप्राणहारकः /
वज्रनाभपुरध्वंसी पैण्ड्रकप्राणहारकः //
text_mt: Destroyer of the Six Duras, Taker of Nikuṃbha's Life, / Destroyer of Vajranābha's City, Taker of Pauṇḍraka's Life,

sanskrit_iast:
bahulāśvaprītikartā dvijavaryapriyaṅkaraḥ /
śivasaṃkaṭahārī ca vṛkāsuravināśanaḥ //
meaning:
बहुलाश्वप्रीतिकर्ता द्विजवर्यप्रियङ्करः /
शिवसंकटहारी च वृकासुरविनाशनः //
text_mt: Affectionate to Bahulāśva, Dear to the Best of the Twice-Born, / Remover of Distress from Śiva, Destroyer of Vṛkāsura,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgusatkārakārī ca śivasāttvikatāpradaḥ /
gokarṇapūjakaḥ sāṃbakuṣṭhavidhvaṃsakāraṇaḥ //
meaning:
भृगुसत्कारकारी च शिवसात्त्विकताप्रदः /
गोकर्णपूजकः सांबकुष्ठविध्वंसकारणः //
text_mt: Show-er of Respect to Bhṛgu, Bestower of Goodness upon Śiva, / Worshipper at Gokarṇa, Cause of the Destruction of Sāmba's Leprosy,

sanskrit_iast:
vedastuto vedavettā yaduvaṃśavivarddhanaḥ /
yaduvaṃśavināśī ca uddhavoddhārakārakaḥ //
meaning:
वेदस्तुतो वेदवेत्ता यदुवंशविवर्द्धनः /
यदुवंशविनाशी च उद्धवोद्धारकारकः //
text_mt: Praised by the Vedas, Knower of the Vedas, Increaser of the Yadu Dynasty, / Destroyer of the Yadu Dynasty, Cause of the Deliverance of Uddhava;

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā ca rādhikā caiva ānandā vṛṣabhānujā /
vṛndāvaneśvarī puṇyā kṛṣṇamānasahāriṇī //
meaning:
राधा च राधिका चैव आनन्दा वृषभानुजा /
वृन्दावनेश्वरी पुण्या कृष्णमानसहारिणी //
text_mt: [And now the Names of Rādhā:] Rādhā, Rādhikā, Blissful, Daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, / Mistress of Vṛndāvana, Holy, Captivator of Kṛṣṇa's Heart,

sanskrit_iast:
pragalbhā caturā kāmā kāminī harimohinī /
lalitā madhurā mādhvī kiśorī kanakaprabhā //
meaning:
प्रगल्भा चतुरा कामा कामिनी हरिमोहिनी /
ललिता मधुरा माध्वी किशोरी कनकप्रभा //
text_mt: Bold, clever, full of desire, enchanting woman, bewitcher of Hari, / charming, sweet, intoxicating like wine, youthful maiden, radiant as gold;

sanskrit_iast:
jitacandrā jitamṛgā jitasiṃhā jitadvipā /
jitaraṃbhā jitapikā govindahṛdayodbhavā //
meaning:
जितचन्द्रा जितमृगा जितसिंहा जितद्विपा /
जितरंभा जितपिका गोविन्दहृदयोद्भवा //
text_mt: Surpassing the moon, surpassing the deer, surpassing the lion, surpassing the elephant, / surpassing the plantain, surpassing the cuckoo, born from Govinda's heart;

sanskrit_iast:
jitabiṃbā jitaśukā jitapadmā kumārikā /
śrīkṛṣṇākarṣaṇā devī nityaṃ yugmasvarūpiṇī //
meaning:
जितबिंबा जितशुका जितपद्मा कुमारिका /
श्रीकृष्णाकर्षणा देवी नित्यं युग्मस्वरूपिणी //
text_mt: Surpassing the bimba fruit, surpassing the parrot, surpassing the lotus, maiden, / attractor of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, goddess, eternally in a paired form;

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ vihāriṇī kāntā rasikā kṛṣṇavallabhā /
āmodinī modavatī nandanandanabhūṣitā //
meaning:
नित्यं विहारिणी कान्ता रसिका कृष्णवल्लभा /
आमोदिनी मोदवती नन्दनन्दनभूषिता //
text_mt: Eternally sporting, lovely, appreciative of rasa, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / fragrant, joyful, adorned by the son of Nanda;

sanskrit_iast:
divyāṃbarā divyahārā muktāmaṇivibhūṣitā /
kuñjapriyā kuñjavāsā kuñjanāyakanāyikā //
meaning:
दिव्यांबरा दिव्यहारा मुक्तामणिविभूषिता /
कुञ्जप्रिया कुञ्जवासा कुञ्जनायकनायिका //
text_mt: Clad in celestial garments, wearing celestial necklaces, adorned with pearls and gems, / fond of the groves, residing in the groves, heroine of the lord of the groves;

sanskrit_iast:
cārurūpā cāruvaktrā cāruhemāṅgadā śubhā /
śrīkṛṣṇaveṇusaṃgītā muralīhāriṇī śivā //
meaning:
चारुरूपा चारुवक्त्रा चारुहेमाङ्गदा शुभा /
श्रीकृष्णवेणुसंगीता मुरलीहारिणी शिवा //
text_mt: Of lovely form, lovely-faced, wearing lovely golden armlets, auspicious, / sung to by Śrī Kṛṣṇa's flute, stealer of the muralī flute, benevolent;

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrā bhagavatī śāntā kumudā sundarī priyā /
kṛṣṇaratiḥ śrīkṛṣṇasahacāriṇī //
meaning:
भद्रा भगवती शान्ता कुमुदा सुन्दरी प्रिया /
कृष्णरतिः श्रीकृष्णसहचारिणी //
text_mt: Gracious, divine lady, tranquil, lotus-like, beautiful, beloved, / delight of Kṛṣṇa, companion of Śrī Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśīvaṭapriyasthānā yugmāyugmasvarūpiṇī /
bhāṇḍīravāsinī śubhrā gopīnāthapriyā sakhī //
meaning:
वंशीवटप्रियस्थाना युग्मायुग्मस्वरूपिणी /
भाण्डीरवासिनी शुभ्रा गोपीनाथप्रिया सखी //
text_mt: Whose favorite place is Vaṃśīvaṭa, whose nature is both paired and single, / dwelling in Bhāṇḍīra, bright, beloved friend of Gopīnātha;

sanskrit_iast:
śrutiniḥśvasitā divyā govindarasadāyinī /
śrīkṛṣṇaprārthanīśānā mahānandapradāyinī //
meaning:
श्रुतिनिःश्वसिता दिव्या गोविन्दरसदायिनी /
श्रीकृष्णप्रार्थनीशाना महानन्दप्रदायिनी //
text_mt: Breathed out by the Vedas, divine, giver of Govinda's nectar, / ruler longed for by Śrī Kṛṣṇa, giver of supreme bliss;

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhajanasaṃsevyā koṭilakṣmī sukhāvahā /
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyā ratikoṭiratipradā //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठजनसंसेव्या कोटिलक्ष्मी सुखावहा /
कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्या रतिकोटिरतिप्रदा //
text_mt: Served by the residents of Vaikuṇṭha, bringing joy to ten million Lakṣmīs, / possessing the charm of ten million Kamas, bestowing the delight of ten million Ratis;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktigrāhyā bhaktirūpā lāvaṇyasarasī umā /
brahmarudrādisaṃrādhyā nityaṃ kautūhalānvitā //
meaning:
भक्तिग्राह्या भक्तिरूपा लावण्यसरसी उमा /
ब्रह्मरुद्रादिसंराध्या नित्यं कौतूहलान्विता //
text_mt: Attained through devotion, the embodiment of devotion, a lake of charm, Umā, / worshipped by Brahmā, Rudra, and others, ever full of curiosity;

sanskrit_iast:
nityalīlā nityakāmā nityaśṛṅgārabhūṣitā /
nityavṛndāvanarasā nandanandanasaṃyutā //
meaning:
नित्यलीला नित्यकामा नित्यशृङ्गारभूषिता /
नित्यवृन्दावनरसा नन्दनन्दनसंयुता //
text_mt: Engaged in eternal play, of eternal desire, adorned with eternal erotic love, / having the eternal relish of Vṛndāvana, accompanied by the son of Nanda;

sanskrit_iast:
gopagikāmaṇḍalīyuktā nityaṃ gopālasaṃgatā /
gorasakṣepaṇī śūrā sānandānandadāyinī //
meaning:
गोपगिकामण्डलीयुक्ता नित्यं गोपालसंगता /
गोरसक्षेपणी शूरा सानन्दानन्ददायिनी //
text_mt: Surrounded by a host of cowherdesses, ever united with Gopāla, / who casts aside cow-milk, heroic, joyful, giver of delight;

sanskrit_iast:
mahālīlā prakṛṣṭā ca nāgarī nagacāriṇī /
nityamāghūrṇitā pūrṇā kastūrītilakānvitā //
meaning:
महालीला प्रकृष्टा च नागरी नगचारिणी /
नित्यमाघूर्णिता पूर्णा कस्तूरीतिलकान्विता //
text_mt: Engaged in the great sport, pre-eminent, sophisticated townswoman, moving on the mountain, / ever whirling [in dance], complete, marked with a tilaka of musk;

sanskrit_iast:
padmā śyāmā mṛgākṣī ca siddhirūpā rasāvahā /
koṭicandrānanā gaurī koṭikokilasusvarā //
meaning:
पद्मा श्यामा मृगाक्षी च सिद्धिरूपा रसावहा /
कोटिचन्द्रानना गौरी कोटिकोकिलसुस्वरा //
text_mt: Padmā, dark-complexioned, deer-eyed, embodiment of perfection, bringing rasa, / moon-faced like ten million moons, fair-complexioned, sweet-voiced like ten million cuckoos;

sanskrit_iast:
śīlasaindaryanilayā nandanandanalālitā /
aśokavanasaṃvāsā bhāṇḍīravanasaṅgatā //
meaning:
शीलसैन्दर्यनिलया नन्दनन्दनलालिता /
अशोकवनसंवासा भाण्डीरवनसङ्गता //
text_mt: Abode of virtue and beauty, cherished by the son of Nanda, / dwelling in the Aśoka grove, joined with the Bhāṇḍīra forest;

sanskrit_iast:
kalpadrumatalāviṣṭā kṛṣṇā viśvā haripriyā /
ajāgamyā bhavāgamyā govarddhanakṛtālayā //
meaning:
कल्पद्रुमतलाविष्टा कृष्णा विश्वा हरिप्रिया /
अजागम्या भवागम्या गोवर्द्धनकृतालया //
text_mt: Residing at the foot of wish-fulfilling trees, Kṛṣṇā, universal, beloved of Hari, / inaccessible to the unborn [Brahmā], inaccessible to Bhava [Śiva], making her home on Govardhana;

sanskrit_iast:
yamunātīranilayā śaśvadgovindajalpinī /
śaśvanmānavatī snigdhā śrīkṛṣṇaparivanditā //
meaning:
यमुनातीरनिलया शश्वद्गोविन्दजल्पिनी /
शश्वन्मानवती स्निग्धा श्रीकृष्णपरिवन्दिता //
text_mt: Dwelling on the bank of the Yamunā, constantly speaking of Govinda, / constantly high-spirited with pique, affectionate, worshipped on all sides by Śrī Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇastutā kṛṣṇavṛtā śrīkṛṣṇahṛdayālayā /
devadrumaphalā sevyā vṛndāvanarasālayā //
meaning:
कृष्णस्तुता कृष्णवृता श्रीकृष्णहृदयालया /
देवद्रुमफला सेव्या वृन्दावनरसालया //
text_mt: Praised by Kṛṣṇa, chosen by Kṛṣṇa, having her abode in Śrī Kṛṣṇa's heart, / fruit of the celestial tree, worthy of service, abode of the rasa of Vṛndāvana;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭitīrthamayī satyā koṭitīrthaphalapradā /
koṭiyogasuduṣprāpyā koṭiyajñadurāśrayā //
meaning:
कोटितीर्थमयी सत्या कोटितीर्थफलप्रदा /
कोटियोगसुदुष्प्राप्या कोटियज्ञदुराश्रया //
text_mt: Embodying ten million sacred fords, true, granting the fruit of ten million sacred fords, / extremely hard to attain through ten million yogas, difficult to reach by ten million sacrifices;

sanskrit_iast:
manasā śaśilekhā ca śrīkoṭisubhagānaghā /
koṭimuktasukhā saumyā lakṣmīkoṭivilāsinī //
meaning:
मनसा शशिलेखा च श्रीकोटिसुभगानघा /
कोटिमुक्तसुखा सौम्या लक्ष्मीकोटिविलासिनी //
text_mt: Manasā, a crescent of the moon, possessing the fortune of ten million Śrīs, sinless, / having the bliss of ten million liberated souls, gentle, sporting with ten million Lakṣmīs;

sanskrit_iast:
tilottamā trikālasthā trikālajñāpyadhīśvarī /
trivedajñā trilokajñā turīyāntanivāsinī //
meaning:
तिलोत्तमा त्रिकालस्था त्रिकालज्ञाप्यधीश्वरी /
त्रिवेदज्ञा त्रिलोकज्ञा तुरीयान्तनिवासिनी //
text_mt: Tilottamā, present in the three times, knowing the three times, sovereign goddess, / knowing the three Vedas, knowing the three worlds, dwelling beyond the fourth [state];

sanskrit_iast:
durgārādhyā ramārādhyā viśvārādhyā cidātmikā /
devārādhyā parārādhyā brahmārādhyā parātmikā //
meaning:
दुर्गाराध्या रमाराध्या विश्वाराध्या चिदात्मिका /
देवाराध्या पराराध्या ब्रह्माराध्या परात्मिका //
text_mt: Worshipped by Durgā, worshipped by Ramā, worshipped by all, whose self is consciousness, / worshipped by the gods, worshipped by the supreme, worshipped by Brahmā, supreme self;

sanskrit_iast:
śivārādhyā premasādhyā bhaktārādhyā rasātmikā /
kṛṣṇaprāṇārpiṇī bhāmā śuddhapremavilāsinī //
meaning:
शिवाराध्या प्रेमसाध्या भक्ताराध्या रसात्मिका /
कृष्णप्राणार्पिणी भामा शुद्धप्रेमविलासिनी //
text_mt: Worshipped by Śiva, attained through love, worshipped by devotees, whose self is rasa, / who surrenders her life to Kṛṣṇa, passionate lady, sporting in pure love;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇārādhyā bhaktisādhyā bhaktavṛndaniṣevitā /
viśvādhārā kṛpādhārā jīvadhārātināyikā //
meaning:
कृष्णाराध्या भक्तिसाध्या भक्तवृन्दनिषेविता /
विश्वाधारा कृपाधारा जीवधारातिनायिका //
text_mt: Worshipped by Kṛṣṇa, attained through devotion, attended by hosts of devotees, / support of the universe, support of grace, support of living beings, supreme leader;

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhapremamayī lajjā nityasiddhā śiromaṇiḥ /
divyarūpā divyabhogā divyaveṣā mudānvitā //
meaning:
शुद्धप्रेममयी लज्जा नित्यसिद्धा शिरोमणिः /
दिव्यरूपा दिव्यभोगा दिव्यवेषा मुदान्विता //
text_mt: Composed of pure love, modest, eternally perfected, crest-jewel, / of celestial form, having celestial enjoyment, in celestial dress, full of joy;

sanskrit_iast:
divyāṅganāvṛndasārā nityanūtanayauvanā /
parabrahmāvṛtā dhyeyā mahārūpā mahojjvalā //
meaning:
दिव्याङ्गनावृन्दसारा नित्यनूतनयौवना /
परब्रह्मावृता ध्येया महारूपा महोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: Essence of heavenly maidens, of ever-youthful age, / enveloped in the supreme Brahman, worthy of meditation, of immense form, immensely radiant;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭisūryaprabhā koṭicandrabiṃbādhikacchaviḥ /
komalāmṛtavāgādyā vedādyā vedadurlabhā //
meaning:
कोटिसूर्यप्रभा कोटिचन्द्रबिंबाधिकच्छविः /
कोमलामृतवागाद्या वेदाद्या वेददुर्लभा //
text_mt: Having the brilliance of ten million suns, exceeding the beauty of ten million orbs of the moon, / tender, of nectarous speech, primordial, beginning of the Vedas, hard to attain even through the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāsaktā kṛṣṇabhaktā candrāvaliniṣevitā /
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃpūrṇā kṛṣṇadehārddhadhāriṇī //
meaning:
कृष्णासक्ता कृष्णभक्ता चन्द्रावलिनिषेविता /
कलाषोडशसंपूर्णा कृष्णदेहार्द्धधारिणी //
text_mt: Attached to Kṛṣṇa, devoted to Kṛṣṇa, served by Candrāvalī, / complete in sixteen digits, bearing half of Kṛṣṇa's body;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇabuddhiḥ kṛṣṇasārākṛṣṇarūpavihāriṇī /
kṛṣṇakāntā kṛṣṇadhanā kṛṣṇamohanakāriṇī //
meaning:
कृष्णबुद्धिः कृष्णसाराकृष्णरूपविहारिणी /
कृष्णकान्ता कृष्णधना कृष्णमोहनकारिणी //
text_mt: Having her mind fixed on Kṛṣṇa, having Kṛṣṇa as her essence, sporting in Kṛṣṇa's form, / beloved of Kṛṣṇa, whose wealth is Kṛṣṇa, enchanting Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṇagotrī kṛṣṇadevī kulodvahā /
sarvabhūtasthitāvātmā sarvalokanamaskṛtā //
meaning:
कृष्णदृष्टिः कृष्णगोत्री कृष्णदेवी कुलोद्वहा /
सर्वभूतस्थितावात्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृता //
text_mt: Whose gaze is on Kṛṣṇa, of Kṛṣṇa's lineage, goddess of Kṛṣṇa, uplifter of the family, / seated in all beings, their self, bowed to by all the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadātrī premadhātrī svarṇagātrī manoramā /
nagadhātrī yaśoṭhātrī mahādevī śubhaṅkarī //
meaning:
कृष्णदात्री प्रेमधात्री स्वर्णगात्री मनोरमा /
नगधात्री यशोठात्री महादेवी शुभङ्करी //
text_mt: Giver of Kṛṣṇa, foster-mother of love, golden-limbed, delightful, / upholder of mountains, bringer of renown, great goddess, conferring auspiciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśeṣadevajananī avatāragaṇaprasūḥ /
utpalāṅkāravindāṅkā prasādāṅkā dvitīyakā //
meaning:
श्रीशेषदेवजननी अवतारगणप्रसूः /
उत्पलाङ्कारविन्दाङ्का प्रसादाङ्का द्वितीयका //
text_mt: Mother of the divine Śeṣa, mother of the hosts of avatars, / marked with a water-lily, marked with a lotus, marked with royal favor, second to none;

sanskrit_iast:
rathāṅkā kuñjarāṅkā ca kuṇḍalāṅkapadasthitā /
chatrāṅkā vidyudaṅkā ca puṣpamālāṅkitāpi ca //
meaning:
रथाङ्का कुञ्जराङ्का च कुण्डलाङ्कपदस्थिता /
छत्राङ्का विद्युदङ्का च पुष्पमालाङ्कितापि च //
text_mt: Marked with a chariot, marked with an elephant, on whose feet is the mark of earrings, / marked with an umbrella, marked with lightning, and marked with a garland of flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍāṅkā mukuṭāṅkā ca pūrṇacandrā śukāṅkitā /
kṛṣṇātrahārapākā ca vṛndākuñjavihāriṇī //
meaning:
दण्डाङ्का मुकुटाङ्का च पूर्णचन्द्रा शुकाङ्किता /
कृष्णात्रहारपाका च वृन्दाकुञ्जविहारिणी //
text_mt: Marked with a staff, marked with a crown, a full moon, marked with a parrot, / cooking the food for Kṛṣṇa, sporting in the groves of Vṛndā;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaprabodhanakarī kṛṣṇaśeṣānnabhojinī /
padmakesaramadhyasthā saṃgītāgamavedinī //
meaning:
कृष्णप्रबोधनकरी कृष्णशेषान्नभोजिनी /
पद्मकेसरमध्यस्था संगीतागमवेदिनी //
text_mt: Awakener of Kṛṣṇa, eater of the remnants of Kṛṣṇa's food, / abiding in the center of the lotus filament, knower of musical treatises;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikalpāntabhrūbhaṅgā aprāptapralayācyutā /
sarvasattvanidhiḥ padmaśaṅkhādinidhisevitā //
meaning:
कोटिकल्पान्तभ्रूभङ्गा अप्राप्तप्रलयाच्युता /
सर्वसत्त्वनिधिः पद्मशङ्खादिनिधिसेविता //
text_mt: Whose knitting of eyebrows spans ten million kalpas, imperishable since no dissolution reaches her, / treasury of all existence, served by the treasures of the lotus, conch, and others;

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryā devavṛndavimohinī /
sasvānandapradā sarvā suvarṇalatikākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
अणिमादिगुणैश्वर्या देववृन्दविमोहिनी /
सस्वानन्दप्रदा सर्वा सुवर्णलतिकाकृतिः //
text_mt: Possessing sovereignty with attributes such as atom-smallness, bewitcher of the host of gods, / giver of self-bliss, the all, having the form of a golden creeper;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇābhisārasaṃketā mālinī nṛtyapaṇḍitā /
gopīsiṃdhusakāśāhvāṃ gopamaṇḍapaśobhinī //
meaning:
कृष्णाभिसारसंकेता मालिनी नृत्यपण्डिता /
गोपीसिंधुसकाशाह्वां गोपमण्डपशोभिनी //
text_mt: Having an agreed meeting-place for secret tryst with Kṛṣṇa, garland-maker, skilled in dancing, / having the name Gopīsindhusakāśā, adorning the pavilion of the cowherds;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇaprītidā bhītā pratyaṅgapulakāñcitā /
śrīkṛṣṇāliṅganaratā govindavirahākṣamā //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णप्रीतिदा भीता प्रत्यङ्गपुलकाञ्चिता /
श्रीकृष्णालिङ्गनरता गोविन्दविरहाक्षमा //
text_mt: Giver of affection to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, fearful, thrilled with horripilation on every limb, / devoted to embracing Śrī Kṛṣṇa, unable to bear separation from Govinda;

sanskrit_iast:
anantaguṇasaṃpannā kṛṣṇakīrtanalālasā /
bījatrayamayī mūrtiḥ kṛṣṇānugrahavāñchitā //
meaning:
अनन्तगुणसंपन्ना कृष्णकीर्तनलालसा /
बीजत्रयमयी मूर्तिः कृष्णानुग्रहवाञ्छिता //
text_mt: Endowed with endless virtues, longing to chant the praise of Kṛṣṇa, / whose form is composed of three seed-syllables, desiring the grace of Kṛṣṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
vimalādiniṣevyā ca lalitādyārcitā satī /
padmavṛndasthitā hṛṣṭā tripurāparisevitā //
meaning:
विमलादिनिषेव्या च ललिताद्यार्चिता सती /
पद्मवृन्दस्थिता हृष्टा त्रिपुरापरिसेविता //
text_mt: Served by Vimalā and others, worshipped by Lalitā and others, chaste, / standing among a cluster of lotuses, joyful, attended by Tripurā;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛntāvatyarcitā śraddhā durjñeyā bhaktavallabhā /
durlabhā sāṃdrasaukhyātmā śreyohetuḥ subhogadā //
meaning:
वृन्तावत्यर्चिता श्रद्धा दुर्ज्ञेया भक्तवल्लभा /
दुर्लभा सांद्रसौख्यात्मा श्रेयोहेतुः सुभोगदा //
text_mt: Worshipped by Vṛndāvatī, faith, inscrutable, dear to devotees, / rare, whose nature is dense bliss, cause of welfare, bestower of excellent pleasures;

sanskrit_iast:
sāraṅgā śāradā bodhā sadvṛndāvanacāriṇī /
brahmānandā cidānandā dhyānāndārddhamātrikā //
meaning:
सारङ्गा शारदा बोधा सद्वृन्दावनचारिणी /
ब्रह्मानन्दा चिदानन्दा ध्यानान्दार्द्धमात्रिका //
text_mt: Sāraṅgā, Śāradā, awareness, moving in the true Vṛndāvana, / bliss of Brahman, bliss of consciousness, half a syllabic measure of meditation's bliss;

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā suratajñā ca govindaprāṇasaṃgamā /
kṛṣṇāṅgabhūṣaṇā ratnabhūṣaṇā svarṇabhūṣitā //
meaning:
गन्धर्वा सुरतज्ञा च गोविन्दप्राणसंगमा /
कृष्णाङ्गभूषणा रत्नभूषणा स्वर्णभूषिता //
text_mt: Gandharva lady, knower of love-making, joined with Govinda's breath of life, / ornament on Kṛṣṇa's body, adorned with jewels, decorated with gold;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇahṛdayāvāsamuktākanakanāli (si) kā /
sadratnakaṅkaṇayutā śrīmannīlagiristhitā //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णहृदयावासमुक्ताकनकनालि (सि) का /
सद्रत्नकङ्कणयुता श्रीमन्नीलगिरिस्थिता //
text_mt: A golden nose-pearl whose dwelling is the heart of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, / adorned with bracelets of excellent gems, dwelling on the glorious blue mountain;

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇanūpurasaṃpannā svarṇakiṅkiṇimaṇḍitā /
aśeṣarāsakutukā raṃbhorūstanumadhyamā //
meaning:
स्वर्णनूपुरसंपन्ना स्वर्णकिङ्किणिमण्डिता /
अशेषरासकुतुका रंभोरूस्तनुमध्यमा //
text_mt: Endowed with golden anklets, adorned with golden girdles, / eager for the endless rāsa dance, having thighs like plantain trunks, slender-waisted;

sanskrit_iast:
parākṛtiḥ pararānandā parasvargavihāriṇī /
prasūnakabarī citrā mahāsiṃdūrasundarī //
meaning:
पराकृतिः पररानन्दा परस्वर्गविहारिणी /
प्रसूनकबरी चित्रा महासिंदूरसुन्दरी //
text_mt: Of supreme form, having supreme bliss, sporting in the highest heaven, / having a braid adorned with flowers, wondrous, beautiful with great vermilion;

sanskrit_iast:
kaiśoravayasā bālā pramadākulaśekharā /
kṛṣṇādharasudhā svādā śyāmapremavinodinī //
meaning:
कैशोरवयसा बाला प्रमदाकुलशेखरा /
कृष्णाधरसुधा स्वादा श्यामप्रेमविनोदिनी //
text_mt: A girl of youthful age, crest among passionate women, / relishing the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's lower lip, delighting in love for the dark lord;

sanskrit_iast:
śikhipicchalasaccūḍā svarṇacaṃpakabhūṣitā /
kuṅkumālaktakastūrīmaṇḍitā cāparājitā //
meaning:
शिखिपिच्छलसच्चूडा स्वर्णचंपकभूषिता /
कुङ्कुमालक्तकस्तूरीमण्डिता चापराजिता //
text_mt: Having a topknot shining with peacock feathers, adorned with golden campaka flowers, / decorated with saffron, red dye, and musk, and unconquered;

sanskrit_iast:
hemaharānvitāpuṣpā hārāḍhyā rasavatyapi /
mādhuryyamadhurā padmā padmahastā suviśrutā //
meaning:
हेमहरान्वितापुष्पा हाराढ्या रसवत्यपि /
माधुर्य्यमधुरा पद्मा पद्महस्ता सुविश्रुता //
text_mt: Equipped with golden necklaces, flowery, rich in garlands, full of charm and flavor, / sweetness of all sweetness, Padmā, lotus in hand, very renowned;

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūbhaṅgābhaṅgakodaṇḍakaṭākṣaśarasaṃdhinī /
śeṣadevāśirasthā ca nityasthalavihāriṇī //
meaning:
भ्रूभङ्गाभङ्गकोदण्डकटाक्षशरसंधिनी /
शेषदेवाशिरस्था च नित्यस्थलविहारिणी //
text_mt: Fitting the arrows of sidelong glances to the unbreakable bow of her knitted eyebrows, / resting upon the head of Śeṣa, sporting in the eternal realm.

sanskrit_iast:
kāruṇyajalamadhyasthā nityamattādhirohiṇī /
aṣṭabhāṣavatī cāṣṭanāyikā lakṣaṇānvitā //
meaning:
कारुण्यजलमध्यस्था नित्यमत्ताधिरोहिणी /
अष्टभाषवती चाष्टनायिका लक्षणान्विता //
text_mt: She stands in the waters of compassion, ever ascending in intoxication; / possessing eight languages, she is the eight heroines endowed with auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
sunūtijñā śrutijñā ca sarvajñā duḥkhahāriṇī /
rajoguṇeśvarī caiva jaraccandranibhānanā //
meaning:
सुनूतिज्ञा श्रुतिज्ञा च सर्वज्ञा दुःखहारिणी /
रजोगुणेश्वरी चैव जरच्चन्द्रनिभानना //
text_mt: She knows good conduct, knows the Śruti, knows all, and removes distress; / she is the sovereign over the quality of rajas, her face resembling the full moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ketakīkusumābhāsā sadā siṃdhuvanasthitā /
hemapuṣpādhikakarā pañcaśaktimayī hitā //
meaning:
केतकीकुसुमाभासा सदा सिंधुवनस्थिता /
हेमपुष्पाधिककरा पञ्चशक्तिमयी हिता //
text_mt: Radiant as the ketakī flower, she ever dwells in the ocean forest; / her hands surpass golden flowers, she embodies fivefold power, she is beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
stanakubhī narāḍhyā ca kṣīṇāpuṇyā yaśasvanī /
vairājasūyajananī śrīśā bhuvanamohinī //
meaning:
स्तनकुभी नराढ्या च क्षीणापुण्या यशस्वनी /
वैराजसूयजननी श्रीशा भुवनमोहिनी //
text_mt: With pitcher-like breasts, accompanied by men, slender, devoid of demerit, renowned; / mother of the cosmic soul, sovereign of fortune, enchantress of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāśobhā mahāmāyā mahākāntirmahāsmṛtiḥ /
mahāmohā mahāvidyā mahākīrrtiṃmahāratiḥ //
meaning:
महाशोभा महामाया महाकान्तिर्महास्मृतिः /
महामोहा महाविद्या महाकीर्र्तिंमहारतिः //
text_mt: She is great splendour, great illusion, great beauty, great memory; / great infatuation, great knowledge, great fame, great pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādhairyā mahāvīryā mahāśaktirmahādyutiḥ /
mahāgaurī mahāsaṃpanmahābhogavilāsinī //
meaning:
महाधैर्या महावीर्या महाशक्तिर्महाद्युतिः /
महागौरी महासंपन्महाभोगविलासिनी //
text_mt: She is great fortitude, great valour, great energy, great radiance; / she is Mahāgaurī, great prosperity, delighting in immense enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
samayā bhaktidāśokā vātsalyarasadāyinī /
suhṛdbhaktipradā svacchā mādhuryarasavarṣiṇī //
meaning:
समया भक्तिदाशोका वात्सल्यरसदायिनी /
सुहृद्भक्तिप्रदा स्वच्छा माधुर्यरसवर्षिणी //
text_mt: She is the season, bestower of devotion, free from sorrow, bestowing the aesthetic flavour of parental affection; / grantor of devotion to friends, pure, showering the aesthetic flavour of sweet love.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvabhaktipradā śuddhapremabhaktividhāyinī /
goparāmābhaghirāmā ca krīḍārāmā pareśvarī //
meaning:
भावभक्तिप्रदा शुद्धप्रेमभक्तिविधायिनी /
गोपरामाभघिरामा च क्रीडारामा परेश्वरी //
text_mt: Bestower of emotional devotion, ordainer of pure loving devotion; / pleasing the cowherds, delightful to sight, delighting in play, supreme sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
nityarāmā cātmarāmā kṛṣṇarāmā rameśvarī /
ekānaikajagadvyāptā viśvalīlāprakāśinī //
meaning:
नित्यरामा चात्मरामा कृष्णरामा रमेश्वरी /
एकानैकजगद्व्याप्ता विश्वलीलाप्रकाशिनी //
text_mt: Ever delighting, delighting in the Self, delighting Kṛṣṇa, sovereign of Ramā; / pervading the singular and multiple worlds, revealing the universal play.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvakatī śā durgeśā jagadīśā jagadvidhiḥ /
viṣṇuvaṃśanivāsā ca viṣṇuvaṃśasamudbhavā //
meaning:
सरस्वकती शा दुर्गेशा जगदीशा जगद्विधिः /
विष्णुवंशनिवासा च विष्णुवंशसमुद्भवा //
text_mt: She is Sarasvatī, ruler of Durgā, sovereign of the world, cosmic ordainer; / dwelling in the lineage of Viṣṇu, born from the lineage of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuvaṃśastutā kartrī viṣṇuvaṃśāvanī sadā /
ārāmasthā vanasthā ca sūryyaputryavagāhinī //
meaning:
विष्णुवंशस्तुता कर्त्री विष्णुवंशावनी सदा /
आरामस्था वनस्था च सूर्य्यपुत्र्यवगाहिनी //
text_mt: Praised by the lineage of Viṣṇu, the creator, ever protecting the lineage of Viṣṇu; / residing in groves, residing in forests, bathing in the daughter of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
prītisthā nityayantrasthā golokasthā vibhūtidā /
svānubhūtisthitā vyaktā sarvalokanivāsinī //
meaning:
प्रीतिस्था नित्ययन्त्रस्था गोलोकस्था विभूतिदा /
स्वानुभूतिस्थिता व्यक्ता सर्वलोकनिवासिनी //
text_mt: Abiding in love, abiding in the eternal mystical diagram, dwelling in Goloka, bestower of majesty; / established in self-experience, manifest, dweller in all worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtā hyadbhutā śrīmannārāyaṇasamīḍitā /
akṣarāpi ca kūṭasthā mahāpuruṣasaṃbhavā //
meaning:
अमृता ह्यद्भुता श्रीमन्नारायणसमीडिता /
अक्षरापि च कूटस्था महापुरुषसंभवा //
text_mt: Nectarous, wondrous, extolled by the glorious Nārāyaṇa; / imperishable, unchanging, born of the Supreme Being.

sanskrit_iast:
audāryabhāvasādhyā ca sthūlasūkṣmātirūpiṇī /
śirīṣapuṣpamṛdulā gāṅgeyamukuraprabhā //
meaning:
औदार्यभावसाध्या च स्थूलसूक्ष्मातिरूपिणी /
शिरीषपुष्पमृदुला गाङ्गेयमुकुरप्रभा //
text_mt: Attainable through the mood of generosity, having an immense subtle and gross form; / soft as the śirīṣa flower, possessing the brilliance of a golden mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalajitākṣī ca sadratnakavarānvitā /
premaparyakanilayā tejomaṇḍalamadhyagā //
meaning:
नीलोत्पलजिताक्षी च सद्रत्नकवरान्विता /
प्रेमपर्यकनिलया तेजोमण्डलमध्यगा //
text_mt: Her eyes surpassing blue water-lilies, adorned with the finest gems; / resting on the couch of love, situated in the midst of a circle of light.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṅgagopanābhedā līlāvaraṇanāyikā /
sudhāsiṃdhusamullāsāmṛtāsyandavidhāyinī //
meaning:
कृष्णाङ्गगोपनाभेदा लीलावरणनायिका /
सुधासिंधुसमुल्लासामृतास्यन्दविधायिनी //
text_mt: Non-different from the concealment of Kṛṣṇa’s body, heroine enveloped in playful sport; / joyfully exultant like an ocean of nectar, producing an outpouring of ambrosia.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇacittā rāsacittā premacittā haripriyā /
acintanaguṇagrāmā kṛṣṇalīlā malāpahā //
meaning:
कृष्णचित्ता रासचित्ता प्रेमचित्ता हरिप्रिया /
अचिन्तनगुणग्रामा कृष्णलीला मलापहा //
text_mt: Her mind fixed on Kṛṣṇa, her mind fixed on the rāsa-dance, her mind fixed on love, dear to Hari; / possessor of inconceivable virtues, playful sport of Kṛṣṇa, remover of impurities.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsasiṃdhuśaśāṅkā ca rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍīnī /
natavratā siṃharīcchā sumīrtiḥ sukhanditā //
meaning:
राससिंधुशशाङ्का च रासमण्डलमण्डीनी /
नतव्रता सिंहरीच्छा सुमीर्तिः सुखन्दिता //
text_mt: Moon of the rāsa ocean, ornament of the circle of the rāsa dance; / performing vows, having the desire of a lioness, of auspicious form, fully divided.

sanskrit_iast:
gopīcūḍāmaṇirgopīgaṇeḍyā virajādhikā /
gopapreṣṭhā gopakanyā gopanārī sugopikā //
meaning:
गोपीचूडामणिर्गोपीगणेड्या विरजाधिका /
गोपप्रेष्ठा गोपकन्या गोपनारी सुगोपिका //
text_mt: Crest-jewel among the cowherd maidens, praised by hosts of cowherd maidens, superior to the Virajā; / dearest to cowherds, cowherd daughter, cowherd woman, the excellent cowherd maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
gopadhāmā sudāmāṃbā gopālī gopamohinī /
gopabhūṣā kṛṣṇabhūṣā śrīvṛndāvanacandrikā //
meaning:
गोपधामा सुदामांबा गोपाली गोपमोहिनी /
गोपभूषा कृष्णभूषा श्रीवृन्दावनचन्द्रिका //
text_mt: Abode of cowherds, mother of Sudāman, cowherd girl, enchantress of cowherds; / ornament of cowherds, ornament of Kṛṣṇa, moonlight of glorious Vṛndāvana.

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇādighoṣaniratā rāsotsavavikāsinī /
kṛṣṇaceṣṭā parijñātā koṭikandarpamohinī //
meaning:
वीणादिघोषनिरता रासोत्सवविकासिनी /
कृष्णचेष्टा परिज्ञाता कोटिकन्दर्पमोहिनी //
text_mt: Devoted to the sound of lutes and other instruments, blossoming in the festival of the rāsa-dance; / knowing Kṛṣṇa's movements, enchanting millions of love-gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa guṇanāgāḍhyā devasuṃdarimohinī /
kṛṣṇacandramanojñā ca kṛṣṇadevasahodarī //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण गुणनागाढ्या देवसुंदरिमोहिनी /
कृष्णचन्द्रमनोज्ञा च कृष्णदेवसहोदरी //
text_mt: Endowed with mountains of glorious Kṛṣṇa's virtues, enchanting divine beauties; / delightful to the moon-like Kṛṣṇa, sister of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇābhilāṣiṇī kṛṣṇapremānugrahavāñchitā /
kṣemā ca madhurālāpā bhruvomāyā subhadrikā //
meaning:
कृष्णाभिलाषिणी कृष्णप्रेमानुग्रहवाञ्छिता /
क्षेमा च मधुरालापा भ्रुवोमाया सुभद्रिका //
text_mt: Longing for Kṛṣṇa, desiring the grace of Kṛṣṇa’s love; / peaceful, of sweet conversation, illusion of eyebrows, very auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiḥ paramānandā nīpadrumatalasthitā /
kṛpākaṭākṣā biṃboṣṭī raṃbhā cārunitaṃbinī //
meaning:
प्रकृतिः परमानन्दा नीपद्रुमतलस्थिता /
कृपाकटाक्षा बिंबोष्टी रंभा चारुनितंबिनी //
text_mt: Primal matter, supreme bliss, dwelling beneath the kadamba tree; / her side-glance full of mercy, having bimba-fruit lips, Rambhā, possessing beautiful hips.

sanskrit_iast:
smarakelinidhānā ca gaṇḍatāṭaṅkamaṇḍitā /
hemādrikāntirucirā premādyā madamantharā //
meaning:
स्मरकेलिनिधाना च गण्डताटङ्कमण्डिता /
हेमाद्रिकान्तिरुचिरा प्रेमाद्या मदमन्थरा //
text_mt: Treasury of the amorous play of the love-god, adorned with earrings upon her cheeks; / delightful with the brilliance of the golden mountain, beginning with love, slow with passion.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇacintā premacintā raticintā ca kṛṣṇadā /
rāsacintā bhāvacintā śuddhacantā mahārasā //
meaning:
कृष्णचिन्ता प्रेमचिन्ता रतिचिन्ता च कृष्णदा /
रासचिन्ता भावचिन्ता शुद्धचन्ता महारसा //
text_mt: Meditation on Kṛṣṇa, meditation on love, meditation on pleasure, giver of Kṛṣṇa; / meditation on the rāsa, meditation on emotion, pure contemplation, of great aesthetic flavour.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇādṛṣṭitruṭiyugā dṛṣṭipakṣmivinindinī /
kandarpajananī mukhyā vaikuṇṭhagatidāyinī //
meaning:
कृष्णादृष्टित्रुटियुगा दृष्टिपक्ष्मिविनिन्दिनी /
कन्दर्पजननी मुख्या वैकुण्ठगतिदायिनी //
text_mt: Considering a moment without seeing Kṛṣṇa to be an age, reproaching the eyelids of her eyes; / mother of the love-god, foremost, giver of the path to Vaikuṇṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsabhāvā priyāśliṣṭā preṣṭhā prathamanāyikā /
śuddhādehinī ca śrīrāmā rasamañjarī //
meaning:
रासभावा प्रियाश्लिष्टा प्रेष्ठा प्रथमनायिका /
शुद्धादेहिनी च श्रीरामा रसमञ्जरी //
text_mt: The mood of the rāsa, embraced by her beloved, dearest, foremost heroine; / possessing a pure body, glorious Ramā, blossom of aesthetic flavour.

sanskrit_iast:
suprabhāvā śubhācārā svarṇadī narmadāṃbikā /
gomatī candrabhāgeḍyā sarayūstāmraparṇisūḥ //
meaning:
सुप्रभावा शुभाचारा स्वर्णदी नर्मदांबिका /
गोमती चन्द्रभागेड्या सरयूस्ताम्रपर्णिसूः //
text_mt: Of great splendour, of auspicious conduct, the heavenly Gaṅgā, Narmadā, mother Ambikā; / praised as Gomatī and Candrabhāgā, the Sarayū, mother of the Tāmraparṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalaṅkacaritrā ca nirguṇā ca nirañjanā /
etannāmasahasraṃ tu yugmarūpasya nārada //
meaning:
निष्कलङ्कचरित्रा च निर्गुणा च निरञ्जना /
एतन्नामसहस्रं तु युग्मरूपस्य नारद //
text_mt: Having a spotless life, without attributes, and stainless. / This thousand names of the dual form, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena vṛndāvanarasāvahe /
mahāpāpapraśamanaṃ vandhyātvavinivartakam //
meaning:
पठनीयं प्रयत्नेन वृन्दावनरसावहे /
महापापप्रशमनं वन्ध्यात्वविनिवर्तकम् //
text_mt: should be recited with diligence, bringing the nectar of Vṛndāvana; / it quells great sins and removes barrenness,

sanskrit_iast:
dāridraya śamanaṃ roganāśanaṃ kāmadaṃ mahat /
pāpāpahaṃ vairiharaṃ rādhāmādhavabhaktidam //
meaning:
दारिद्रय शमनं रोगनाशनं कामदं महत् /
पापापहं वैरिहरं राधामाधवभक्तिदम् //
text_mt: allays poverty, destroys disease, grants great desires; / dispels evil, removes enmity, and bestows devotion to Rādhā and Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
namastasmai bhagavate kṛṣṇāyākuṇṭhamedhase /
rādhāsaṃgasudhāsiṃdhau namo nityavihāriṇe //
meaning:
नमस्तस्मै भगवते कृष्णायाकुण्ठमेधसे /
राधासंगसुधासिंधौ नमो नित्यविहारिणे //
text_mt: Salutations to that Blessed One, Kṛṣṇa, whose intellect is unobstructed, / salutations to the one who ever sports in the ocean of nectar of communion with Rādhā!

sanskrit_iast:
rādhādevī jagatkartrī jagatpālanatagatparā /
jagallayavidhātrī ca sarveśī sarvasūtikā //
meaning:
राधादेवी जगत्कर्त्री जगत्पालनतगत्परा /
जगल्लयविधात्री च सर्वेशी सर्वसूतिका //
text_mt: The goddess Rādhā is the maker of the universe, devoted to the preservation of the universe, / the cause of the dissolution of the universe, ruler of all, mother of all.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā nāmasahasraṃ vai mayā proktaṃ munīśvara /
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde rādhākṛṣṇa sahasranāmakathanaṃ nāma vdyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तस्या नामसहस्रं वै मया प्रोक्तं मुनीश्वर /
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे राधाकृष्ण सहस्रनामकथनं नाम व्द्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Her thousand names have indeed been recited by me, O best of sages; / it bestows enjoyment and liberation and is divine. What more do you wish to hear?

Thus ends the eighty-second chapter in the third quarter of the great narrative of the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, entitled 'The Recitation of the Thousand Names of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa'.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśaunaka uvāca
sādhu sūta mahābhāgaḥ jagaduddhārakārakam /
mahātantravidhānaṃ naḥ kumāroktaṃ tvayoditam //
meaning:
श्रीशौनक उवाच
साधु सूत महाभागः जगदुद्धारकारकम् /
महातन्त्रविधानं नः कुमारोक्तं त्वयोदितम् //
text_mt: Glorious Śaunaka said: / Excellent, O Sūta, highly fortunate one! Bringing about the salvation of the world, / the ordinance of the great Tantra, spoken by the Kumāra, has been recounted to us by you.

sanskrit_iast:
alabhyametattantreṣu purāṇeṣvapi mānada /
yadihoditamasmabhyaṃ tvayātikaruṇātmanā //
meaning:
अलभ्यमेतत्तन्त्रेषु पुराणेष्वपि मानद /
यदिहोदितमस्मभ्यं त्वयातिकरुणात्मना //
text_mt: This is unobtainable in the Tantras and even in the Purāṇas, O bestower of honour, / which has been told here to us by you, whose soul is exceedingly compassionate.

sanskrit_iast:
nārado bhagavānsūta lokoddharaṇatatparaḥ /
bhūyaḥ papraccha kiṃ sādho kumāraṃ viduṣāṃ varam //
meaning:
नारदो भगवान्सूत लोकोद्धरणतत्परः /
भूयः पप्रच्छ किं साधो कुमारं विदुषां वरम् //
text_mt: What did the venerable Nārada, intent on uplifting the world, / further ask the Kumāra, the best of the wise, O virtuous one?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrutvā sa nārado viprāḥ yugmanāmasahasrakam /
sanatkumāramapyāha praṇamya jñānināṃ varam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रुत्वा स नारदो विप्राः युग्मनामसहस्रकम् /
सनत्कुमारमप्याह प्रणम्य ज्ञानिनां वरम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard the thousand names of the dual form, O brāhmaṇas, that Nārada, / bowing down to Sanatkumāra, the foremost among the knowers, spoke again.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
brahmaṃstvayā samākhyātā vidhayastantracoditāḥ /
tatrāpi kṛṣṇamantrāṇāṃ vaibhavaṃ hyuditaṃ mahat //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
ब्रह्मंस्त्वया समाख्याता विधयस्तन्त्रचोदिताः /
तत्रापि कृष्णमन्त्राणां वैभवं ह्युदितं महत् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / O Brahman, the ordinances enjoined by the Tantra have been explained by you; / and therein, indeed, the great power of the mantras of Kṛṣṇa was declared.

sanskrit_iast:
yā tatra rādhikādevī sarvādyā samudāhṛtā /
tasyā aṃśāvatārāṇāṃ caritaṃ mantrapūrvakam //
meaning:
या तत्र राधिकादेवी सर्वाद्या समुदाहृता /
तस्या अंशावताराणां चरितं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: The goddess Rādhikā, who is declared there to be primordial to all— / the deeds of her partial incarnations, accompanied by their mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
tantroktaṃ vada sarvajña tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ /
śaktestantrāṇyanekāni śivoktāni munīśvara //
meaning:
तन्त्रोक्तं वद सर्वज्ञ त्वामहं शरणं गतः /
शक्तेस्तन्त्राण्यनेकानि शिवोक्तानि मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: as declared in the Tantra, speak, O omniscient one! I have taken refuge in you. / Many are the Tantras of the Goddess declared by Śiva, O best of sages;

sanskrit_iast:
yāni tatsāramuddhṛtya sākalyenābhidhehi naḥ /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
यानि तत्सारमुद्धृत्य साकल्येनाभिधेहि नः /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: extracting their essence, relate them to us completely. / Having heard that speech of the high-souled Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāraḥ provāca smṛtvā rādhāpadāṃbujam /
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rādhāṃśānāṃ samudbhavam //
meaning:
सनत्कुमारः प्रोवाच स्मृत्वा राधापदांबुजम् /
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि राधांशानां समुद्भवम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra, remembering the lotus feet of Rādhā, replied: / Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Nārada, I shall tell of the origin of the portions of Rādhā,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīnāṃ paramāścaryaṃ mantrasādhanapūrvakam /
yā tu rādhā mayā proktā kṛṣṇārddhāṅgasamudbhavā //
meaning:
शक्तीनां परमाश्चर्यं मन्त्रसाधनपूर्वकम् /
या तु राधा मया प्रोक्ता कृष्णार्द्धाङ्गसमुद्भवा //
text_mt: most wonderful of the powers, along with their mantras and practices. / She who was declared by me as Rādhā, born from half of Kṛṣṇa’s body,

sanskrit_iast:
golokavāsinī sā tu nityā kṛṣṇasahāyinī /
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthā dṛśyadṛśyasvarūpiṇī //
meaning:
गोलोकवासिनी सा तु नित्या कृष्णसहायिनी /
तेजोमण्डलमध्यस्था दृश्यदृश्यस्वरूपिणी //
text_mt: dwells in Goloka; she is eternal, the companion of Kṛṣṇa, / seated in the centre of the orb of radiance, whose essential nature is both visible and invisible.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācittu tayā sārddhaṃ sthitasya munisattama /
kṛṣṇasya vāmabhāgāttu jāto nārāyaṇaḥ svayam //
meaning:
कदाचित्तु तया सार्द्धं स्थितस्य मुनिसत्तम /
कृष्णस्य वामभागात्तु जातो नारायणः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Once, as he was staying together with her, O best of sages, / from the left side of Kṛṣṇa, Nārāyaṇa was born spontaneously,

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikāyāśca vāmāṅgānmahālakṣmīrbabhūva ha /
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahālakṣmīṃ dattvā nārāyaṇāya ca //
meaning:
राधिकायाश्च वामाङ्गान्महालक्ष्मीर्बभूव ह /
ततः कृष्णो महालक्ष्मीं दत्त्वा नारायणाय च //
text_mt: and from the left side of Rādhikā, Mahālakṣmī indeed came into being. / Then Kṛṣṇa, giving Mahālakṣmī to Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhe sthāpayāmāsa śaśvatpālanakarmaṇi /
atha golokanāthasya gomnāṃ vivarato mune //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठे स्थापयामास शश्वत्पालनकर्मणि /
अथ गोलोकनाथस्य गोम्नां विवरतो मुने //
text_mt: established them in Vaikuṇṭha for the perpetual work of protection. / Then, O sage, from the pores of the lord of Goloka...

sanskrit_iast:
jātuścāsaṃkhyagopālāstejasā vayasā samāḥ /
prāṇatulyapriyāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pārṣadā vibhoḥ //
meaning:
जातुश्चासंख्यगोपालास्तेजसा वयसा समाः /
प्राणतुल्यप्रियाः सर्वे बभूवुः पार्षदा विभोः //
text_mt: And from the hair-pores of the lord of Goloka, O sage, / countles cowherd youths were born, equal in splendour and in age, / all as dear to him as his own breath of life, and became the lord’s attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhāṅgalomakūpebhye babhūvurgopakanyakāḥ /
rādhātulyāḥ sarvataśca rādhādāsyaḥ priyaṃvadāḥ //
meaning:
राधाङ्गलोमकूपेभ्ये बभूवुर्गोपकन्यकाः /
राधातुल्याः सर्वतश्च राधादास्यः प्रियंवदाः //
text_mt: From the hair-pores of Rādhā’s body cowherd maidens were born, / equal to Rādhā in every way, handmaidens of Rādhā, sweet of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare vipra sahasā kṛṣṇadehataḥ /
āvirbabhūva sā durgā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्र सहसा कृष्णदेहतः /
आविर्बभूव सा दुर्गा विष्णुमाया सनातनी //
text_mt: In the meantime, O twice-born one, suddenly from Kṛṣṇa’s body / there emerged Durgā, the eternal Māyā of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
devīnāṃ bījarūpāṃ ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī /
paripūrṇatamā tejaḥ svarūpā triguṇātmikā //
meaning:
देवीनां बीजरूपां च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी /
परिपूर्णतमा तेजः स्वरूपा त्रिगुणात्मिका //
text_mt: the seed-form of goddesses, the primordial Nature (Mūlaprakṛti), the sovereign Goddess, / most complete, consisting of splendor, possessing the nature of the three qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrabhujasaṃyuktā nānāśastrā trilocanā /
yā tu saṃsāravṛkṣasya bījarūpā sanātanī //
meaning:
सहस्रभुजसंयुक्ता नानाशस्त्रा त्रिलोचना /
या तु संसारवृक्षस्य बीजरूपा सनातनी //
text_mt: endowed with a thousand arms, holding various weapons, three-eyed, / who is the eternal seed-form of the tree of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyai pradadau rādhikeśvaraḥ /
etasminnantare tatra sastrīkastu caturmukhaḥ //
meaning:
रत्नसिंहासनं तस्यै प्रददौ राधिकेश्वरः /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र सस्त्रीकस्तु चतुर्मुखः //
text_mt: Rādhikā’s lord gave her a jewel throne. / In the meantime, the four-faced one [Brahmā] appeared there together with his wife,

sanskrit_iast:
jñānināṃ pravaraḥ śrīmān pumānoṅkāramuccaran /
kamaṇḍaludharo jātastapasvī nābhito hareḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानिनां प्रवरः श्रीमान् पुमानोङ्कारमुच्चरन् /
कमण्डलुधरो जातस्तपस्वी नाभितो हरेः //
text_mt: the foremost among the wise, the glorious ascetic, / holding a water-pot, chanting 'Om', born from the navel of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu saṃstūya sarveśaṃ sāvitryā bhāryayā saha /
niṣasādāsane ramye vibhostasyājñayā mune //
meaning:
स तु संस्तूय सर्वेशं सावित्र्या भार्यया सह /
निषसादासने रम्ये विभोस्तस्याज्ञया मुने //
text_mt: Having praised the Lord of all together with his wife Sāvitrī, / he sat down on a lovely seat by the command of that all-pervading Lord, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kṛṣṇo mahābhāga dvidhārūpo babhūva ha /
vāmārddhāṅgo mahādevo dakṣārddho gopikāpatiḥ //
meaning:
अथ कृष्णो महाभाग द्विधारूपो बभूव ह /
वामार्द्धाङ्गो महादेवो दक्षार्द्धो गोपिकापतिः //
text_mt: Then, O fortunate one, Kṛṣṇa assumed a two-fold form: / his left half was Mahādeva, and his right half was the lord of the cowherd women.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavaktrastrinetro 'sau vāmārddhāgo munīśvaḥ /
stutvā kṛṣṇaṃ samājñapto niṣasāda hareḥ puraḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चवक्त्रस्त्रिनेत्रो ऽसौ वामार्द्धागो मुनीश्वः /
स्तुत्वा कृष्णं समाज्ञप्तो निषसाद हरेः पुरः //
text_mt: That left half, having five faces and three eyes, O chief of sages, / praised Kṛṣṇa, and being instructed, sat down in front of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kṛṣṇaścaturvaktraṃ prāha sṛṣṭiṃ kuru prabho /
satyaloke sthito nityaṅgaccha māṃsmara sarvadā //
meaning:
अथ कृष्णश्चतुर्वक्त्रं प्राह सृष्टिं कुरु प्रभो /
सत्यलोके स्थितो नित्यङ्गच्छ मांस्मर सर्वदा //
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa said to the four-faced one: 'Perform creation, O Lord. / Residing constantly in Satyaloka, go and remember me at all times.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastu hariṇā praṇamya jagadīśvaram /
jagāma bhāryayā sākaṃ sa tu sṛṣṭiṃ karoti vai //
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तु हरिणा प्रणम्य जगदीश्वरम् /
जगाम भार्यया साकं स तु सृष्टिं करोति वै //
text_mt: Thus spoken to by Hari, having bowed to the Lord of the universe, / he went with his wife, and he indeed performs creation,

sanskrit_iast:
pitāsmākaṃ muniśreṣṭha mānasīṃ kalpadaihikīm /
tataḥ paścātpañcavaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāha mahāmate //
meaning:
पितास्माकं मुनिश्रेष्ठ मानसीं कल्पदैहिकीम् /
ततः पश्चात्पञ्चवक्त्रं कृष्णं प्राह महामते //
text_mt: our father, O best of sages—the mental creation and that of the cosmic period. / Thereafter, O noble-minded one, Kṛṣṇa said to the five-faced one:

sanskrit_iast:
durgāṃ gṛhāṇa viśveśa śivaloke tapaśvara /
yāvatsṛṣṭistadante tu lokānsaṃhara sarvataḥ //
meaning:
दुर्गां गृहाण विश्वेश शिवलोके तपश्वर /
यावत्सृष्टिस्तदन्ते तु लोकान्संहर सर्वतः //
text_mt: 'Take Durgā, O Lord of the universe, and perform austerity in Śivaloka; / as long as creation lasts, and at its end, destroy the worlds completely.'

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi kṛṣṇaṃ namastṛtya śivalokaṃ jagāma ha /
tataḥ kālāntare brahmankṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि कृष्णं नमस्तृत्य शिवलोकं जगाम ह /
ततः कालान्तरे ब्रह्मन्कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः //
text_mt: He too, having bowed to Kṛṣṇa, went to Śivaloka. / Then, in the course of time, O Brahmin, from the mouth of the supreme Self, Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vaktrātsarasvatī jātā bīṇāpustakadhāriṇī /
tāmādideśa bhaghagavān vaikuṇṭhaṃ gaccha mānade //
meaning:
वक्त्रात्सरस्वती जाता बीणापुस्तकधारिणी /
तामादिदेश भघगवान् वैकुण्ठं गच्छ मानदे //
text_mt: Sarasvatī was born, holding a lute and a book. / The Blessed Lord instructed her: 'Go to Vaikuṇṭha, O giver of honor!

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīsamīpe tiṣṭha tvaṃ caturbhujasamāśrayā /
sāpi kṛṣṇaṃ namaskṛtya gatā nārāyaṇāntikam //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीसमीपे तिष्ठ त्वं चतुर्भुजसमाश्रया /
सापि कृष्णं नमस्कृत्य गता नारायणान्तिकम् //
text_mt: Remain near Lakṣmī, taking refuge in the four-armed one [Nārāyaṇa].' / She too, having bowed to Kṛṣṇa, went to the presence of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañcavidhā jātā sā rādhā sṛṣṭikāraṇam /
āsāṃ pūrṇasvarūpāṇāṃ mantradhyānārcanādikam //
meaning:
एवं पञ्चविधा जाता सा राधा सृष्टिकारणम् /
आसां पूर्णस्वरूपाणां मन्त्रध्यानार्चनादिकम् //
text_mt: In this way, that Rādhā, the cause of creation, became fivefold. / Of these [goddesses] possessing complete natures, the mantra, meditation, and worship,

sanskrit_iast:
vadāmi śṛṇu vipredraṃ lokānāṃ siddhidāyakam /
tāraḥ kriyāyuk pratiśṭhā prītyāḍhyā ca tataḥ param //
meaning:
वदामि शृणु विप्रेद्रं लोकानां सिद्धिदायकम् /
तारः क्रियायुक् प्रतिश्ठा प्रीत्याढ्या च ततः परम् //
text_mt: I shall tell you, O prince among the twice-born, which grant accomplishment to people: / The syllable Tāra [Om], followed by Kriyā [the letter 'r'], Pratiṣṭhā [the vowel 'ā'], and enriched by Prīti [the letter 'dh'], and then

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāmṛtā kṣudhāyuktā vahnijāyāntakato manuḥ /
sutapāstu ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā manoḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानामृता क्षुधायुक्ता वह्निजायान्तकतो मनुः /
सुतपास्तु ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता मनोः //
text_mt: Jñānāmṛtā [the letter 'i'], joined with Kṣudhā [the letter 'k'], and ending with the wife of Agni [Svāhā]—this is the mantra [oṃ rādhikāyai svāhā]. / Sutapas is the seer, Gāyatrī is the metre, and the deity of the mantra

sanskrit_iast:
rādhikā praṇavo bījaṃ svāhā śaktirudāhṛtā /
ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādvinduvibhūṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
राधिका प्रणवो बीजं स्वाहा शक्तिरुदाहृता /
षडक्षरैः षडङ्गानि कुर्याद्विन्दुविभूषितैः //
text_mt: is Rādhikā; the Praṇava is the seed-syllable, and Svāhā is declared as the power. / With its six syllables adorned with the bindu, one should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhyāyansvahṛdaye rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇabhāminīm /
śvetacaṃpakavarṇābhāṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhām //
meaning:
ततो ध्यायन्स्वहृदये राधिकां कृष्णभामिनीम् /
श्वेतचंपकवर्णाभां कोटिचन्द्रसमप्रभाम् //
text_mt: Then, meditating in one's heart on Rādhikā, the beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / who has the radiance of the white campaka flower, resembling the splendor of ten million moons,

sanskrit_iast:
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ nīlendīvaralocanām /
suśroṇīṃ sunitaṃbāṃ ca pakvabiṃbādharāṃbarām //
meaning:
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यां नीलेन्दीवरलोचनाम् /
सुश्रोणीं सुनितंबां च पक्वबिंबाधरांबराम् //
text_mt: whose face is like the autumn full moon, whose eyes are like blue water-lilies, / with beautiful hips and handsome buttocks, wearing garments [red like] ripe bimba fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
muktākundābhadaśanāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām /
ratnakeyūravalayahārakuṇḍalaśobhitām //
meaning:
मुक्ताकुन्दाभदशनां वह्निशुद्धांशुकान्विताम् /
रत्नकेयूरवलयहारकुण्डलशोभिताम् //
text_mt: whose teeth resemble pearls and kunda blossoms, adorned with garments purified by fire, / adorned with jewel armlets, bangles, necklaces, and earrings,

sanskrit_iast:
gopībhiḥ supriyābhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ /
rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitām //
meaning:
गोपीभिः सुप्रियाभिश्च सेवितां श्वेतचामरैः /
रासमण्डलमध्यस्थां रत्नसिंहासनस्थिताम् //
text_mt: served by her dear cowherd women with white chowries, / standing in the midst of the rāsa circle, seated upon a jewel throne—

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣiptvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ /
lakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettilaiḥ //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिप्त्वा पूजयेदुपचारकैः /
लक्षषट्कं जपेन्मन्त्रं तद्दशांशं हुनेत्तिलैः //
text_mt: having meditated thus, throwing a handful of flowers, one should worship her with the articles of worship. / One should recite the mantra six hundred thousand times and offer a tenth of that in fire oblation with sesame seeds

sanskrit_iast:
ājyāktairmātṛkāpīṭhe pūjā cāvaraṇaiḥ saha /
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni tadbāhye 'ṣṭadale yajet //
meaning:
आज्याक्तैर्मातृकापीठे पूजा चावरणैः सह /
षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि तद्बाह्ये ऽष्टदले यजेत् //
text_mt: smeared with clarified butter, performing worship on the Mātṛkā seat together with the surrounding deities. / In the six corners one should worship the six limbs, and outside that, on the eight-petalled lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
mālāvatīṃ mādhavīṃ ca ratnamālāṃ suśīlikām /
tataḥ śaśikalāṃ pārijātāṃ padmāvatīṃ tathā //
meaning:
मालावतीं माधवीं च रत्नमालां सुशीलिकाम् /
ततः शशिकलां पारिजातां पद्मावतीं तथा //
text_mt: Mālāvatī, Mādhavī, Ratnamālā, and Suśīlikā; / then Śaśikalā, Pārijātā, and likewise Padmāvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
suṃdarīṃ ca kramātprācyāṃ digvidikṣu tato bahiḥ /
indrādyānsāyudhāniṣṭvā viniyogāṃstu sādhayet //
meaning:
सुंदरीं च क्रमात्प्राच्यां दिग्विदिक्षु ततो बहिः /
इन्द्राद्यान्सायुधानिष्ट्वा विनियोगांस्तु साधयेत् //
text_mt: and Sundarī, in order, in the east and the other cardinal and intermediate directions. Beyond that, / having worshipped Indra and the others along with their weapons, one should accomplish the applications.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhā kṛṣṇapriyā rāseśvarī gopīgaṇādhipā /
nirguṇā kṛṣṇapūjyā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī //
meaning:
राधा कृष्णप्रिया रासेश्वरी गोपीगणाधिपा /
निर्गुणा कृष्णपूज्या च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी //
text_mt: Radha, the beloved of Kṛṣṇa, Queen of the rāsa-dance, sovereign of the cowherd maidens, / devoid of attributes, worshipped by Kṛṣṇa, primordial Nature, the supreme Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvarī sarvapūjyā vairājajananī tathā /
pūrvādyāśāsu rakṣantu pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरी सर्वपूज्या वैराजजननी तथा /
पूर्वाद्याशासु रक्षन्तु पान्तु मां सर्वतः सदा //
text_mt: sovereign of all, worshipped by all, and mother of the cosmic person: / may they protect me in the directions beginning with the east; may they protect me on all sides always.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ devi jagatāṃ mātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī /
kṛṣṇamāyādidevī ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhike śubhe //
meaning:
त्वं देवि जगतां माता विष्णुमाया सनातनी /
कृष्णमायादिदेवी च कृष्णप्राणाधिके शुभे //
text_mt: You, O goddess, are the mother of the worlds, the eternal illusory potency of Viṣṇu, / the primeval goddess and illusory potency of Kṛṣṇa, dearer to Kṛṣṇa than his own life-breaths, O auspicious one!

sanskrit_iast:
kaṣṇabhaktiprade rādhe namaste maṅgalaprade /
iti samprārthya sarveśīṃ stutvā hṛdi visarjayet //
meaning:
कष्णभक्तिप्रदे राधे नमस्ते मङ्गलप्रदे /
इति सम्प्रार्थ्य सर्वेशीं स्तुत्वा हृदि विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: O Radha, granter of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, homage to you, O bestower of auspiciousness! / Having prayed thus to the sovereign of all and praised her, one should dismiss her into one's heart.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yo bhajate rādhāṃ sarvādyāṃ sarvamaṅgalām /
bhuktveha bhogānakhilānso 'nte golokamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं यो भजते राधां सर्वाद्यां सर्वमङ्गलाम् /
भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलान्सो ऽन्ते गोलोकमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: One who worships Radha in this manner, the primal source of all, the all-auspicious, / after enjoying all pleasures here, reaches Goloka in the end.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tubhyaṃ mahālakṣmyā vidhānaṃ vacmi nārada /
yadārādhanato bhūyātsādhako bhuktimuktimān //
meaning:
अथ तुभ्यं महालक्ष्म्या विधानं वच्मि नारद /
यदाराधनतो भूयात्साधको भुक्तिमुक्तिमान् //
text_mt: Now I declare to you the ritual procedure of Mahālakṣmī, O Nārada, / by whose worship the practitioner becomes possessed of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇīpūrvā kamalavāsinī /
ṅeṃtā vahnipriyānto 'yaṃ mantrakalpadrumaḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीमायाकामवाणीपूर्वा कमलवासिनी /
ङेंता वह्निप्रियान्तो ऽयं मन्त्रकल्पद्रुमः परः //
text_mt: Preceded by the [bījas of] Lakṣmī, Māyā, Kāma, and Vāṇī, followed by ‘kamalavāsinī’ / in the dative case and ending with the beloved of fire (Svāhā)—this is the supreme wishing-tree of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaścāsya chando hi jagatī tathā /
devatā tu mahālakṣmīrdvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
ऋषिर्नारायणश्चास्य छन्दो हि जगती तथा /
देवता तु महालक्ष्मीर्द्विद्विवर्णैः षडङ्गकम् //
text_mt: Its seer is Nārāyaṇa, the metre is Jagatī, / the deity is Mahālakṣmī, and the six limbs are formed with pairs of syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetacaṃpakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām /
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām //
meaning:
श्वेतचंपकवर्णाभां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् /
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम् //
text_mt: Having meditated on her whose complexion shines like a white campaka flower, adorned with jewel ornaments, / her face serene with a gentle smile, yearning to bestow grace upon her devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratīṃ ratnamālāṃ ca koṭicandrasamaprabhām /
dhyātvā japedarkalakṣaṃ pāyasena daśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
बिभ्रतीं रत्नमालां च कोटिचन्द्रसमप्रभाम् /
ध्यात्वा जपेदर्कलक्षं पायसेन दशांशतः //
text_mt: wearing a necklace of jewels, possessing the brilliance of ten million moons— / one should recite [the mantra] one million two hundred thousand times, [and perform] fire oblation with rice pudding to the extent of a tenth part.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādedhite vahnau śrīdṛkāṣṭaiḥ samarcayet /
navaśaktiyute pīṭhe hyaṅgai rāvaraṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
जुहुयादेधिते वह्नौ श्रीदृकाष्टैः समर्चयेत् /
नवशक्तियुते पीठे ह्यङ्गै रावरणैः सह //
text_mt: One should offer fire oblations into a kindled fire, and worship with bilva wood, / on a ritual seat endowed with nine energies, along with the limbs and enclosures.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtirunnatiḥ kāntiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kīrtiśca sannatiḥ /
vyāṣṭirutkṛṣṭirṛddhiśca saṃproktā nava śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
विभूतिरुन्नतिः कान्तिः सृष्टिः कीर्तिश्च सन्नतिः /
व्याष्टिरुत्कृष्टिरृद्धिश्च संप्रोक्ता नव शक्तयः //
text_mt: Vibhūti, Unnati, Kānti, Sṛṣṭi, Kīrti, Sannati, / Vyāṣṭi, Utkṛṣṭi, and Ṛddhi are declared to be the nine energies.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāvāhya ca mūlena mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya sādhakaḥ /
ṣaṭ koṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni dakṣiṇe tu gajānanam //
meaning:
अत्रावाह्य च मूलेन मूर्तिं संकल्प्य साधकः /
षट् कोणेषु षडङ्गानि दक्षिणे तु गजाननम् //
text_mt: Having invoked her here with the root-mantra and visualized the form, the practitioner / [should worship] the six limbs in the six corners, and Gajānana on the right;

sanskrit_iast:
vāme kusumadhanvānaṃ vasupatre tato yajet /
umāṃ śrīṃ bhāratīṃ durgāṃ dharaṇīṃ vedamātaram //
meaning:
वामे कुसुमधन्वानं वसुपत्रे ततो यजेत् /
उमां श्रीं भारतीं दुर्गां धरणीं वेदमातरम् //
text_mt: on the left, the flower-bowed [Kāma]; then upon the eight petals one should worship / Umā, Śrī, Bhāratī, Durgā, Dharaṇī, the Mother of the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
devīmuṣāṃ ca pūrvādau digvidikṣu krameṇa hi /
jahnusūryasute pūjye pādaprakṣālanodyate //
meaning:
देवीमुषां च पूर्वादौ दिग्विदिक्षु क्रमेण हि /
जह्नुसूर्यसुते पूज्ये पादप्रक्षालनोद्यते //
text_mt: and the goddess Uṣā, in order in the cardinal and intermediate directions starting with the east; / the daughters of Jahnu and Sūrya are to be worshipped as engaged in washing her feet;

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjyau pārśvayorghṛtacāmarau /
dhṛtātapatraṃ varuṇaṃ pūjayetpaścime tataḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खपद्मनिधी पूज्यौ पार्श्वयोर्घृतचामरौ /
धृतातपत्रं वरुणं पूजयेत्पश्चिमे ततः //
text_mt: the two treasures, Śaṅkha and Padma, holding flywhisks on both sides, are to be worshipped; / then one should worship Varuṇa holding a parasol in the west.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya rāśīnparito yathāsthānaṃ navagrahān /
caturdantairāvatādīn digvidikṣu tator'cayet //
meaning:
संपूज्य राशीन्परितो यथास्थानं नवग्रहान् /
चतुर्दन्तैरावतादीन् दिग्विदिक्षु ततोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the zodiacal signs all around and the nine planets in their proper places, / one should then worship the four-tusked Airāvata and others in the cardinal and intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbahirlokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ /
dūrvābhirājyasiktābhirjuhuyādāyuṣe naraḥ //
meaning:
तद्बहिर्लोकपालांश्च तदस्त्राणि च तद्बहिः /
दूर्वाभिराज्यसिक्ताभिर्जुहुयादायुषे नरः //
text_mt: Outside that, the guardians of the world, and outside them, their weapons. / A man should make fire oblations with dūrvā grass soaked in clarified butter for longevity.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍūcīmājyasaṃsiktāṃ juhuyātsaptavāsaram /
aṣaaṭottarasahasraṃ yaḥ sa jīveccharadāṃ śatam //
meaning:
गुडूचीमाज्यसंसिक्तां जुहुयात्सप्तवासरम् /
अषअटोत्तरसहस्रं यः स जीवेच्छरदां शतम् //
text_mt: He who offers guḍūcī soaked in clarified butter for seven days, / a thousand and eight times [each day], shall live for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā tilānghṛtābhyaktāndīrghamāyuṣyamāpnuyāt /
ārabhyārkadinaṃ mantrī daśāhaṃ ghṛtasaṃplutaḥ //
meaning:
हुत्वा तिलान्घृताभ्यक्तान्दीर्घमायुष्यमाप्नुयात् /
आरभ्यार्कदिनं मन्त्री दशाहं घृतसंप्लुतः //
text_mt: By offering fire oblations of sesame seeds smeared with clarified butter, one obtains a long life. / Beginning on a Sunday, the mantra-practitioner, drenched in clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādarkasamidhaḥ śarīrārogyasiddhaye /
śālibhirjuhvato nityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam //
meaning:
जुहुयादर्कसमिधः शरीरारोग्यसिद्धये /
शालिभिर्जुह्वतो नित्यमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: should offer fire oblations of arka-twigs for ten days to achieve bodily health. / For one who continually offers fire oblations with rice a thousand and eight times,

sanskrit_iast:
acirādeva mahatī lakṣmī saṃjāyate dhruvam /
uṣājā jīnālikerarajobhirgṛtamiśritaiḥ //
meaning:
अचिरादेव महती लक्ष्मी संजायते ध्रुवम् /
उषाजा जीनालिकेररजोभिर्गृतमिश्रितैः //
text_mt: great fortune (Lakṣmī) arises before long without doubt. / With black cumin, cumin, and coconut powder mixed with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
hunedaṣṭottaraśataṃ pāyasāśī tu nityaśaḥ /
maṇḍalājjāyate so 'pi kubera iva mānavaḥ //
meaning:
हुनेदष्टोत्तरशतं पायसाशी तु नित्यशः /
मण्डलाज्जायते सो ऽपि कुबेर इव मानवः //
text_mt: one should offer fire oblations one hundred and eight times, eating only rice pudding, every day; / within a period of forty days, that man becomes like Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣā guḍamiśreṇa homato hyannavānbhavet /
japāpuṣpāṇi juhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam //
meaning:
हविषा गुडमिश्रेण होमतो ह्यन्नवान्भवेत् /
जपापुष्पाणि जुहुयादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: By offering fire oblation with sacrificial food mixed with molasses, one becomes possessed of food. / One should offer fire oblations of hibiscus flowers a thousand and eight times;

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃbūlarasasaṃmiśraṃ tadbhasmatilakaṃ caret /
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ mohanāya dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
तांबूलरससंमिश्रं तद्भस्मतिलकं चरेत् /
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां मोहनाय द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: mixed with betel juice, the best of the twice-born should apply its ash as a tilaka / in order to captivate all four social classes.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yo bhajate lakṣmīṃ sādhakendro munīśvara /
sampadastasya jāyante mahālakṣmīḥ prasīdati //
meaning:
एवं यो भजते लक्ष्मीं साधकेन्द्रो मुनीश्वर /
सम्पदस्तस्य जायन्ते महालक्ष्मीः प्रसीदति //
text_mt: The foremost practitioner who worships Lakṣmī in this manner, O sovereign of sages, / acquires treasures, and Mahālakṣmī is pleased with him.

sanskrit_iast:
dehānte vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
yā tu durgā dvijaśreṣṭha śivalokaṃ gatā satī //
meaning:
देहान्ते वैष्णवं धाम लभते नात्र संशयः /
या तु दुर्गा द्विजश्रेष्ठ शिवलोकं गता सती //
text_mt: At the end of his body, he reaches the realm of Viṣṇu; there is no doubt in this. / As for Durgā, O best of the twice-born, who as Satī went to the realm of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
sā śivājñāmanuprāpya divyalokaṃ vinirmame /
devīloketi vikhyātaṃ sarvalokavilakṣaṇam //
meaning:
सा शिवाज्ञामनुप्राप्य दिव्यलोकं विनिर्ममे /
देवीलोकेति विख्यातं सर्वलोकविलक्षणम् //
text_mt: having received Śiva's command, she created a divine world, / renowned as Devīloka, distinct from all other worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitā jaganmātā taponiyamamāsthitā /
vividhān svāvatārānhi trikāle kurute 'niśam //
meaning:
तत्र स्थिता जगन्माता तपोनियममास्थिता /
विविधान् स्वावतारान्हि त्रिकाले कुरुते ऽनिशम् //
text_mt: Dwelling there, the Mother of the Worlds, intent on ascetic practice and vows, / continuously produces her various incarnations across the three times.

sanskrit_iast:
māyādhikā hlādinīyuk candrāḍhyā sargiṇī punaḥ /
pratiṣṭhā smṛtisaṃyuktā kṣudhayā sahitā punaḥ //
meaning:
मायाधिका ह्लादिनीयुक् चन्द्राढ्या सर्गिणी पुनः /
प्रतिष्ठा स्मृतिसंयुक्ता क्षुधया सहिता पुनः //
text_mt: Māyā, followed by the joy-giving vowel, adorned with the moon, and then the aspirate; / [then] Pratiṣṭhā joined with Smṛti, accompanied by Kṣudhā; then

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāmṛtā vahnijāyāntastārādyo manurmataḥ /
ṛṣiḥ syādvāmadevo 'sya chando gāyatramīritam //
meaning:
ज्ञानामृता वह्निजायान्तस्ताराद्यो मनुर्मतः /
ऋषिः स्याद्वामदेवो ऽस्य छन्दो गायत्रमीरितम् //
text_mt: Jñānāmṛtā, ending with the wife of fire (Svāhā), beginning with the star (Oṃ)—this is considered the mantra. / Its seer is Vāmadeva, and its metre is said to be Gāyatrī;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā jagatāmādirdurgā durgatināśinī /
tārādyekaikavarṇena hṛdayāditrayaṃ matam //
meaning:
देवता जगतामादिर्दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनी /
ताराद्येकैकवर्णेन हृदयादित्रयं मतम् //
text_mt: the deity is Durgā, the primal source of the worlds, destroyer of distress. / With each single syllable beginning with the star (Oṃ), the triad beginning with the heart is recognized;

sanskrit_iast:
tribhirvarmekṣaṇa dvābhyāṃ sarvairastramudīritam /
mahāmarakataprakhyāṃ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitām //
meaning:
त्रिभिर्वर्मेक्षण द्वाभ्यां सर्वैरस्त्रमुदीरितम् /
महामरकतप्रख्यां सहस्रभुजमण्डिताम् //
text_mt: with three, the armour; with two, the eyes; and with all, the weapon is pronounced. / Resembling a great emerald, adorned with a thousand arms,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāśastrāṇi dadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām /
kaṅkaṇāṅgadahārāḍhyāṃ kvaṇannūpurakānvitām //
meaning:
नानाशस्त्राणि दधतीं त्रिनेत्रां शशिशेखराम् /
कङ्कणाङ्गदहाराढ्यां क्वणन्नूपुरकान्विताम् //
text_mt: bearing diverse weapons, three-eyed, with the crescent moon on her crest, / rich in bracelets, armlets, and necklaces, accompanied by tinkling anklets,

sanskrit_iast: kirīṭakuṇḍaladharāṃ durgāṃ devīṃ vicintayet //
meaning: किरीटकुण्डलधरां दुर्गां देवीं विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: wearing a diadem and ear-ornaments—thus should one meditate upon the goddess Durgā.

sanskrit_iast:
vasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tilaiḥ samadhurairhuneta /
payoṃ'dhasā vā sahasraṃ navapadmātmake yajet //
meaning:
वसुलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तिलैः समधुरैर्हुनेत /
पयोंऽधसा वा सहस्रं नवपद्मात्मके यजेत् //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra eight hundred thousand times, and offer fire oblations with sweet-mixed sesame seeds, / or a thousand times with milk-rice; one should worship her on an eight-petalled lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhā māyā jayā sūkṣmā viśuddhānaṃ dinī punaḥ /
suprabhā vijayā sarvasiddhidā pīṭhaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रभा माया जया सूक्ष्मा विशुद्धानं दिनी पुनः /
सुप्रभा विजया सर्वसिद्धिदा पीठशक्तयः //
text_mt: Prabhā, Māyā, Jayā, Sūkṣmā, Viśuddhā, Nandinī, / Suprabhā, Vijayā, and Sarvasiddhidā are the seat-energies.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhirhrasvatrayaklībarahitaiḥ pūjaye dimāḥ /
praṇavo vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya mahāpadāt //
meaning:
अद्भिर्ह्रस्वत्रयक्लीबरहितैः पूजये दिमाः /
प्रणवो वज्रनखदंष्ट्रायुधाय महापदात् //
text_mt: One should worship these with [the seeds of] water devoid of the three shorts and the neuter vowels. / The Praṇava, followed by ‘vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya’, and from the great word

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāya varmāstraṃ hṛñca proktaḥ siṃhamanurmune /
dadyādāsanametena mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet //
meaning:
सिंहाय वर्मास्त्रं हृञ्च प्रोक्तः सिंहमनुर्मुने /
दद्यादासनमेतेन मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: ‘siṃhāya’, followed by the armour, the weapon, and the heart—this is declared to be the lion-mantra, O sage. / One should assign the seat with this, and visualize the form with the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāvṛrttiṃ purābhyārcya śaktīḥ patreṣu pūjayet /
jayā ca vijayā kīrtiḥ prītiḥ paścātprabhā punaḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गावृर्त्तिं पुराभ्यार्च्य शक्तीः पत्रेषु पूजयेत् /
जया च विजया कीर्तिः प्रीतिः पश्चात्प्रभा पुनः //
text_mt: Having first worshipped the enclosure of the limbs, one should worship the energies on the petals: / Jayā, Vijayā, Kīrti, Prīti, then Prabhā,

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā medhā śrutiścaivasvanāmādyakṣarādikāḥ /
patrāgreṣvarcayedaṣṭāvāyudhāni yathākramāt //
meaning:
श्रद्धा मेधा श्रुतिश्चैवस्वनामाद्यक्षरादिकाः /
पत्राग्रेष्वर्चयेदष्टावायुधानि यथाक्रमात् //
text_mt: Śraddhā, Medhā, and Śruti, preceded by the initial letters of their own names. / On the tips of the petals one should worship the eight weapons in proper order:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgapāśāṅkuśaśarāndhanuḥ /
lokeśvarāṃstato bāhye teṣāmastrāṇyanantaram //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदाखड्गपाशाङ्कुशशरान्धनुः /
लोकेश्वरांस्ततो बाह्ये तेषामस्त्राण्यनन्तरम् //
text_mt: conch, discus, mace, sword, noose, goad, arrows, and bow. / Outside of that, the lords of the world, and immediately after them, their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ japādibhirmantrī mantre siddhe vidhānavit /
kuryātprayogānamunā yathā svasvamanīṣitān //
meaning:
इत्थं जपादिभिर्मन्त्री मन्त्रे सिद्धे विधानवित् /
कुर्यात्प्रयोगानमुना यथा स्वस्वमनीषितान् //
text_mt: In this way, when the mantra has been mastered through recitation and the like, the mantra-practitioner, knowing the ritual procedure, / should perform applications with it according to his own desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena kalaśānnavaśobhanān /
ratnahemādisaṃyuktānghaṭeṣu navasu sthitān //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधानेन कलशान्नवशोभनान् /
रत्नहेमादिसंयुक्तान्घटेषु नवसु स्थितान् //
text_mt: Having duly installed nine auspicious water-pots, / containing jewels, gold, and other materials, placed in nine jars,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyasthe pūjayeddevīmitareṣu jayādikāḥ /
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairabhiṣiñcennarādhipam //
meaning:
मध्यस्थे पूजयेद्देवीमितरेषु जयादिकाः /
संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरभिषिञ्चेन्नराधिपम् //
text_mt: he should worship the goddess in the central one, and Jayā and the others in the remaining ones; / having worshipped them with fragrant pastes, flowers, and other offerings, he should consecrate the king.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā vijayate śatrūnyo 'dhiko vijayaśriyam /
prāpnotrogo dīrghāyuḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
राजा विजयते शत्रून्यो ऽधिको विजयश्रियम् /
प्राप्नोत्रोगो दीर्घायुः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः //
text_mt: The king conquers his enemies, attains superior royal fortune of victory, / becomes free from illness, long-lived, and rid of all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
vandhyābhiṣiktā vidhinālabhate tanayaṃ varam /
mantreṇānena saṃjaptamājyaṃ kṣudragrahāpaham //
meaning:
वन्ध्याभिषिक्ता विधिनालभते तनयं वरम् /
मन्त्रेणानेन संजप्तमाज्यं क्षुद्रग्रहापहम् //
text_mt: A barren woman, consecrated according to the rule, obtains an excellent son. / Clarified butter consecrated with this mantra removes malicious spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhiṇīnāṃ viśeṣeṇa japtaṃ bhasmādikaṃ tathā /
jṛṃbhaśvāse tu kṛṣṇasya praviṣṭerādhikāmukham //
meaning:
गर्भिणीनां विशेषेण जप्तं भस्मादिकं तथा /
जृंभश्वासे तु कृष्णस्य प्रविष्टेराधिकामुखम् //
text_mt: Likewise, ashes and other substances consecrated [with it are efficacious], especially for pregnant women. / But when Kṛṣṇa's yawn-breath entered the mouth of Radhika,

sanskrit_iast:
yā tu devī samudbhūtā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī /
tasyā vidhānaṃ viprendra śṛṇu lokopakārakam //
meaning:
या तु देवी समुद्भूता वीणापुस्तकधारिणी /
तस्या विधानं विप्रेन्द्र शृणु लोकोपकारकम् //
text_mt: the goddess who arose bearing a lute and a book— / hear her ritual procedure, O foremost of Brahmins, which brings welfare to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo vāgbhavaṃ māyā śrīḥ kāmaḥ śaktirīritā /
sarasvatī caturthyantā svāhānto dvādaśākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवो वाग्भवं माया श्रीः कामः शक्तिरीरिता /
सरस्वती चतुर्थ्यन्ता स्वाहान्तो द्वादशाक्षरः //
text_mt: The Praṇava, the Vāgbhava syllable, Māyā, Śrī, Kāma, and the Śakti syllable are uttered; / Sarasvatī ending in the dative, and terminating with Svāhā—this is the twelve-syllabled [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
manurnārāyaṇa ṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ samīritam /
mahāsarasvatī cāsya devatā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
मनुर्नारायण ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दः समीरितम् /
महासरस्वती चास्य देवता परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: The seer of this mantra is Nārāyaṇa; the metre is said to be Virāṭ; / and Mahāsarasvatī is proclaimed as its deity.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavena ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā varṇānnyased budhaḥ /
brahmarandhre nyasettāraṃ lajjāṃ bhrūmadhyagāṃ nyaset //
meaning:
वाग्भवेन षडङ्गानि कृत्वा वर्णान्न्यसेद् बुधः /
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे न्यसेत्तारं लज्जां भ्रूमध्यगां न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Having performed the six limbs with the Vāgbhava syllable, the wise person should place the phonemes: / in the cranial aperture one should place Tāra [Om], and place Lajjā [Hrīṃ] between the eyebrows;

sanskrit_iast:
mukhanāsādikarṇeṣu gudeṣu śrīmukhārṇakān /
tato vāgdevatāṃ dhyāyedvīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm //
meaning:
मुखनासादिकर्णेषु गुदेषु श्रीमुखार्णकान् /
ततो वाग्देवतां ध्यायेद्वीणापुस्तकधारिणीम् //
text_mt: on the mouth, nose, ears, and anus, the phonemes of the face of Śrī. / Then one should meditate on the Goddess of Speech, holding a lute and a book,

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrakundadhavalāṃ pūrṇacandrojjvalānanām /
haṃsādhirūḍhāṃ bhālendudivyālaṅkāraśobhitām //
meaning:
कर्पूरकुन्दधवलां पूर्णचन्द्रोज्ज्वलाननाम् /
हंसाधिरूढां भालेन्दुदिव्यालङ्कारशोभिताम् //
text_mt: white as camphor and the kunda flower, whose face is brilliant like the full moon, / mounted on a swan, adorned with the crescent moon on her forehead and celestial ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
japeddvādaśalakṣāṇi tatsahasraṃ sitāṃbujaiḥ /
nāgacaṃpakapuṣpairvā juhuyātsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
जपेद्द्वादशलक्षाणि तत्सहस्रं सितांबुजैः /
नागचंपकपुष्पैर्वा जुहुयात्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: The excellent practitioner should recite [the mantra] one million two hundred thousand times, and offer a thousand oblations / with white lotuses or with nāgacampaka flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkokte yajetpīṭhe vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tām /
varṇābjenāsanaṃ dadyānmūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet //
meaning:
मातृकोक्ते यजेत्पीठे वक्ष्यमाणक्रमेण ताम् /
वर्णाब्जेनासनं दद्यान्मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: One should worship her on the ritual seat prescribed for the Mātṛkās, according to the manner to be described; / one should offer the seat with the phoneme lotus, and envision her form with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
devyā dakṣiṇataḥ pūjyā saṃskṛtā vāṅmayī śubhā /
prākṛtā vāmataḥ pūjyā vāṅmayīsarvasiddhidā //
meaning:
देव्या दक्षिणतः पूज्या संस्कृता वाङ्मयी शुभा /
प्राकृता वामतः पूज्या वाङ्मयीसर्वसिद्धिदा //
text_mt: To the right of the Goddess, the auspicious Sanskrit speech should be worshipped; / to her left, the Prakrit speech, which grants all accomplishments, should be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamaṅgāni ṣaṭkoṇe prajñādyāḥ prayajedbahiḥ /
prajñā medhā śrutiḥ śaktiḥ smṛtirvāgīśvarī matiḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वमङ्गानि षट्कोणे प्रज्ञाद्याः प्रयजेद्बहिः /
प्रज्ञा मेधा श्रुतिः शक्तिः स्मृतिर्वागीश्वरी मतिः //
text_mt: First the limbs in the six-pointed diagram; outside, one should worship Prajñā and the others: / Prajñā, Medhā, Śruti, Śakti, Smṛti, Vāgīśvarī, Mati,

sanskrit_iast:
svastiśceti samākhyātā brahmādyāstadanantaram /
lokeśānarcayedbhūyastadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ //
meaning:
स्वस्तिश्चेति समाख्याता ब्रह्माद्यास्तदनन्तरम् /
लोकेशानर्चयेद्भूयस्तदस्त्राणि च तद्बहिः //
text_mt: and Svasti are declared; immediately after them, Brahmā and the others; / one should further worship the guardians of the worlds, and outside them, their weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vāgdevīṃ sākṣādvāgvallabho bhavet /
brahmacaryarataḥ śuddhaḥ śuddhadantanakhā dikaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य वाग्देवीं साक्षाद्वाग्वल्लभो भवेत् /
ब्रह्मचर्यरतः शुद्धः शुद्धदन्तनखा दिकः //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the Goddess of Speech, one becomes the beloved master of speech in visible form, / remaining devoted to celibacy, pure, with clean teeth, nails, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmaran sarvavanitāḥ satataṃ devatādhiyā /
kavitvaṃ labhate dhīmān māsairdvādaśabhirdhruvam //
meaning:
संस्मरन् सर्ववनिताः सततं देवताधिया /
कवित्वं लभते धीमान् मासैर्द्वादशभिर्ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: constantly contemplating all women with the thought of their divinity; / within twelve months, the wise practitioner surely attains the gift of poetic composition.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā tanmantritaṃ toyaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ mune /
mahākavirbhavenmantrī vatsareṇa na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पीत्वा तन्मन्त्रितं तोयं सहस्रं प्रत्यहं मुने /
महाकविर्भवेन्मन्त्री वत्सरेण न संशयः //
text_mt: Having drunk water consecrated a thousand times with that mantra every day, O sage, / the practitioner becomes a great poet within a year, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
uromātrodake sthitvā dhyāyanmārtaṇḍamaṇḍale /
sthitāṃ devīṃ pratidinaṃ trisahasraṃ japenmanum //
meaning:
उरोमात्रोदके स्थित्वा ध्यायन्मार्तण्डमण्डले /
स्थितां देवीं प्रतिदिनं त्रिसहस्रं जपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: Standing in water up to the chest, meditating on the Goddess seated / in the solar disc, one should recite the mantra three thousand times every day.

sanskrit_iast:
labhate maṇḍalātsiddhiṃ vācāmapratimāṃ bhuvi /
pālāśabilvakusumairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
लभते मण्डलात्सिद्धिं वाचामप्रतिमां भुवि /
पालाशबिल्वकुसुमैर्जुहुयान्मधुरोक्षितैः //
text_mt: Within a forty-day period one attains peerless eloquence on earth. / One should offer fire oblations with palāśa and bilva blossoms sprinkled with sweet substances,

sanskrit_iast:
samidbhirvā tadutthābhiryaśaḥ prāpnoti vākpateḥ /
rājavṛkṣasamudbhūtaiḥ prasūnairmadhurāplutaiḥ //
meaning:
समिद्भिर्वा तदुत्थाभिर्यशः प्राप्नोति वाक्पतेः /
राजवृक्षसमुद्भूतैः प्रसूनैर्मधुराप्लुतैः //
text_mt: or with sacrificial sticks derived from them; [thereby] one attains the renown of Bṛhaspati. / With blossoms produced from the rājavṛkṣa tree soaked in sweet substances,

sanskrit_iast:
satsamidbhiśca juhuyātkavitvamatulaṃ labhet /
atha pravakṣye viprendra sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇaḥ priyām //
meaning:
सत्समिद्भिश्च जुहुयात्कवित्वमतुलं लभेत् /
अथ प्रवक्ष्ये विप्रेन्द्र सावित्रीं ब्रह्मणः प्रियाम् //
text_mt: and with good sacrificial firewood one should make fire oblations; one shall obtain unequalled poetic talent. / Now I shall declare, O prince of the twice-born, Sāvitrī, the beloved of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ samārādhya sasṛje brahmā lokāṃścarācarān /
lakṣmī māyā kāmapūrvā sāvitrī ṅesamanvitā //
meaning:
यां समाराध्य ससृजे ब्रह्मा लोकांश्चराचरान् /
लक्ष्मी माया कामपूर्वा सावित्री ङेसमन्विता //
text_mt: having worshipped whom Brahmā created the moving and unmoving worlds: / Lakṣmī, Māyā, preceded by Kāma, followed by Sāvitrī ending in the dative case,

sanskrit_iast:
svāhānto manurākhyātaḥ sāvitryā vasuvarṇavān /
ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chandaḥ proktaṃ ca devatā //
meaning:
स्वाहान्तो मनुराख्यातः सावित्र्या वसुवर्णवान् /
ऋषिर्ब्रह्मास्य गायत्री छन्दः प्रोक्तं च देवता //
text_mt: and ending with Svāhā—this is declared to be the eight-syllabled mantra of Sāvitrī. / Its seer is Brahmā, Gāyatrī is declared as the metre, and the deity

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī sarvadevānāṃ sāvitrī parikīrtitā /
hṛdantikairbrahma viṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivaiḥ //
meaning:
सावित्री सर्वदेवानां सावित्री परिकीर्तिता /
हृदन्तिकैर्ब्रह्म विष्णुरुद्रेश्वरसदाशिवैः //
text_mt: Sāvitrī is proclaimed to be the Sāvitrī of all deities. / Through the names Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Īśvara, and Sadāśiva ending with 'hṛd' ['namaḥ'],

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanā ca ṅeyuktairaṅgānāṃ kalpanaṃ matam /
taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā //
meaning:
