सर्वात्मना च ङेयुक्तैरङ्गानां कल्पनं मतम् /
तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभां ज्वलन्तीं ब्रह्मतेजसा //
text_mt: and with 'sarvātman' in the dative case [ending in 'ṅe'], the assignment of limbs (ṣaḍaṅga) is prescribed. / [One should meditate upon her,] shining with the brilliance of molten gold, blazing with Brahman-splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍasahasrasamavigrahām /
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām //
meaning:
ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्तण्डसहस्रसमविग्रहाम् /
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् //
text_mt: whose form equals a thousand midday summer suns, / her face gracious with a gentle smile, adorned with gem-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
bahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām /
sukhadāṃ muktidāṃ caiva sarvasaṃpatpradāṃ śivām //
meaning:
बह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम् /
सुखदां मुक्तिदां चैव सर्वसंपत्प्रदां शिवाम् //
text_mt: clad in garments purified by fire, eager to bestow grace on her devotees, / granting happiness and liberation, bestower of all prosperity, auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
vedabījasvarūpāṃ ca dhyāyedvedaprasūṃ satīm /
dhyātvaivaṃ maṇḍale vidvān trikoṇojjvalakarṇike //
meaning:
वेदबीजस्वरूपां च ध्यायेद्वेदप्रसूं सतीम् /
ध्यात्वैवं मण्डले विद्वान् त्रिकोणोज्ज्वलकर्णिके //
text_mt: whose nature is the seed of the Vedas, the virtuous mother who brings forth the Vedas—one should meditate on her thus. / Having meditated thus, the wise practitioner, on a sacred diagram with a pericarp brilliant with a triangle,

sanskrit_iast:
saure pīṭhe yajeddevīṃ dīptādinavaśaktibhiḥ /
mūlamantreṇa kḷptāyāṃ mūrtauṃ devīṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
सौरे पीठे यजेद्देवीं दीप्तादिनवशक्तिभिः /
मूलमन्त्रेण कॢप्तायां मूर्तौं देवीं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: on the solar seat should worship the goddess along with the nine powers beginning with Dīptā. / In the form conceived through the root-mantra, he should worship the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
koṇeṣu triṣu saṃpūjyā brāhṛyādyāḥ śaktayo bahiḥ /
ādityādyāstataḥ pūjyā uṣādisahitāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
कोणेषु त्रिषु संपूज्या ब्राहृयाद्याः शक्तयो बहिः /
आदित्याद्यास्ततः पूज्या उषादिसहिताः क्रमात् //
text_mt: In the three corners, the powers beginning with Brāhmī are to be worshipped on the outside. / Then the deities beginning with Āditya, along with Uṣā and others, are to be worshipped in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
tatataḥ ṣaḍaṅgānyabhyarcya kesareṣu yathāvidhi /
prahlādinīṃ prabhāṃ paścānnityāṃ viśvaṃbharāṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
तततः षडङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य केसरेषु यथाविधि /
प्रह्लादिनीं प्रभां पश्चान्नित्यां विश्वंभरां पुनः //
text_mt: Then, having worshipped the six limbs according to rule on the filaments, / [one should worship] Prahlādinī, Prabhā, then Nityā, and then Viśvaṃbharā,

sanskrit_iast:
vilāsinīprabhāvatyau jayāṃ śāntāṃ yajetpunaḥ /
kāntiṃ durgāsarasvatyau vidyārūpāṃ tataḥ param //
meaning:
विलासिनीप्रभावत्यौ जयां शान्तां यजेत्पुनः /
कान्तिं दुर्गासरस्वत्यौ विद्यारूपां ततः परम् //
text_mt: Vilāsinī and Prabhāvatī, Jayā, and then Śāntā; / Kānti, Durgā, Sarasvatī, and after that, the one whose form is wisdom (Vidyārūpā);

sanskrit_iast:
viśālasaṃjñitāmīśāṃ vyāpinīṃ vimalāṃ yajet /
tamopahāriṇīṃ sūkṣmāṃ viśvayoniṃ jayāvahām //
meaning:
विशालसंज्ञितामीशां व्यापिनीं विमलां यजेत् /
तमोपहारिणीं सूक्ष्मां विश्वयोनिं जयावहाम् //
text_mt: one should worship the goddess named Viśālā, Īśā, Vyāpinī, and Vimalā; / Tamopahāriṇī, Sūkṣmā, Viśvayoni, the victory-bringing Jayāvahā,

sanskrit_iast:
padnālayāṃ parāṃ śobhāṃ brahmarūpāṃ tator'cayet /
brāhmyādyāḥ śāraṇā bāhye pūjayetproktalakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
पद्नालयां परां शोभां ब्रह्मरूपां ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
ब्राह्म्याद्याः शारणा बाह्ये पूजयेत्प्रोक्तलक्षणाः //
text_mt: Padmālayā, Parā, Śobhā, and then one should worship her who embodies Brahman. / Outside, one should worship the protective deities beginning with Brāhmī, who have the characteristics described.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bhyarcyed grahānbāhye śakrādyānayudhaiḥ saha /
itthamāvaraṇairdevīḥ daśabhiḥ paripūjayet //
meaning:
ततो ऽभ्यर्च्येद् ग्रहान्बाह्ये शक्राद्यानयुधैः सह /
इत्थमावरणैर्देवीः दशभिः परिपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Then, on the outside, one should worship the planets along with the deities beginning with Śakra and their weapons. / In this way, one should worship the goddesses in ten enclosures.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ hunettilaiḥ /
sarvapāpuvinirmukto dīrghamāyuḥ sa vindati //
meaning:
अष्टलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तत्सहस्रं हुनेत्तिलैः /
सर्वपापुविनिर्मुक्तो दीर्घमायुः स विन्दति //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra eight hundred thousand times, and offer a thousand oblations with sesame seeds. / Freed from all sins, he attains a long life.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇābjaistrimadhvaktairjuhuyādayutaṃ tataḥ /
mahālakṣmīrbhavettasya ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अरुणाब्जैस्त्रिमध्वक्तैर्जुहुयादयुतं ततः /
महालक्ष्मीर्भवेत्तस्य षण्मासान्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Then one should offer ten thousand oblations with red lotuses smeared with the three sweets. / Within six months, great fortune shall be his; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavṛkṣaprasūnaistu juhuyādbāhyatejase /
bahunā kimihoktena yathāvatsādhitā satī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मवृक्षप्रसूनैस्तु जुहुयाद्बाह्यतेजसे /
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन यथावत्साधिता सती //
text_mt: With blossoms of the palāśa tree, one should offer oblations for outer radiance. / What is the use of saying much here? When properly mastered, the virtuous one,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakānāmiyaṃ vidyā bhavetkāmadudhā mune /
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
साधकानामियं विद्या भवेत्कामदुधा मुने /
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt: this lore becomes a wish-yielding cow for practitioners, O sage. / Now I shall declare to you the supreme, wondrous secret,

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrīpañjaraṃ nāma sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇām /
vyomakeśārlakāsaktāṃ sukirīṭavirājitām //
meaning:
सावित्रीपञ्जरं नाम सर्वरक्षाकरं नृणाम् /
व्योमकेशार्लकासक्तां सुकिरीटविराजिताम् //
text_mt: named the Sāvitrī-pañjara, which grants all protection to men: / Attached to the sky-hair [of the cosmos], adorned with a splendid diadem,

sanskrit_iast:
meghabhrukuṭilākrāntāṃ vidhiviṣṇuśivānanām /
gurubhārgavakarṇāntāṃ somasūryāgnilocanām //
meaning:
मेघभ्रुकुटिलाक्रान्तां विधिविष्णुशिवाननाम् /
गुरुभार्गवकर्णान्तां सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनाम् //
text_mt: pervaded by the knitted brows of the clouds, having the faces of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / having Bṛhaspati and Śukra as her ears, and the moon, sun, and fire as her eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
iḍāpiṅgalikāsūkṣmāvāyunāsāpuṭānvitām /
saṃdhyādvijoṣṭhapuṭitāṃ lasadvāgupajihvikām //
meaning:
इडापिङ्गलिकासूक्ष्मावायुनासापुटान्विताम् /
संध्याद्विजोष्ठपुटितां लसद्वागुपजिह्विकाम् //
text_mt: endowed with the subtle currents of the nostrils in Iḍā and Piṅgalā, / with the twilights as her two lips, her uvula being shining speech;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāsūryamaṇigrīvāṃ marudbāhusamanvitān /
parjanyadṛdayāsaktāṃ vasvākhyapratimaṇḍalām //
meaning:
संध्यासूर्यमणिग्रीवां मरुद्बाहुसमन्वितान् /
पर्जन्यदृदयासक्तां वस्वाख्यप्रतिमण्डलाम् //
text_mt: her neck adorned with the jewel of the twilight sun, endowed with the winds as her arms, / fixed in the heart of Parjanya, surrounded by the orb of the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśodaravibhrāntāṃ nābhyavāntaravīthikām /
prajāpatyākhyajaghanāṃ kaṭīndrāṇīsamāśritām //
meaning:
आकाशोदरविभ्रान्तां नाभ्यवान्तरवीथिकाम् /
प्रजापत्याख्यजघनां कटीन्द्राणीसमाश्रिताम् //
text_mt: roaming through the belly of space, her navel the intermediate paths of the atmosphere, / her hips known as Prajāpati, her waist attended by Indrāṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
ūrvormalayamerubhyāṃ śobhamānāṃ saridvarām /
sujānujahukuśikāṃ vaiśvadevākhyasaṃjñikām //
meaning:
ऊर्वोर्मलयमेरुभ्यां शोभमानां सरिद्वराम् /
सुजानुजहुकुशिकां वैश्वदेवाख्यसंज्ञिकाम् //
text_mt: shining as the best of rivers through her thighs, which are Malaya and Meru, / her fair knees being Jahnu and Kuśika, designated as the All-gods;

sanskrit_iast:
pādāṅghrinakhalomākhyabhūnāgadrumalakṣitām /
graharāśyarkṣayogādimūrtāvayavasaṃjñikām //
meaning:
पादाङ्घ्रिनखलोमाख्यभूनागद्रुमलक्षिताम् /
ग्रहराश्यर्क्षयोगादिमूर्तावयवसंज्ञिकाम् //
text_mt: marked by the earth, serpents, and trees as her feet, legs, nails, and bodily hair, / the limbs of her form designated as the planets, zodiac signs, lunar mansions, and astrological yogas;

sanskrit_iast:
tithimāsartupakṣākhyaiḥ saṃketanimiṣātmikām /
māyākalpitavaicitryasaṃdhyākhyacchadanāvṛtām //
meaning:
तिथिमासर्तुपक्षाख्यैः संकेतनिमिषात्मिकाम् /
मायाकल्पितवैचित्र्यसंध्याख्यच्छदनावृताम् //
text_mt: her blinks of the eye being the units of time called lunar days, months, seasons, and fortnights, / covered by the mantle named twilight, a manifold variety fashioned by Māyā;

sanskrit_iast:
jvalatkālānalaprakhyoṃ taḍitkīṭisamaprabhām /
koṭisūryapratīkāśāṃ śaśikoṭisuśītalām //
meaning:
ज्वलत्कालानलप्रख्यों तडित्कीटिसमप्रभाम् /
कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशां शशिकोटिसुशीतलाम् //
text_mt: resembling the blazing fire of destruction, having brilliance like fireflies of lightning, / comparable to ten million suns, yet cooling as ten million moons;

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāmaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ sāṃdrānandāmṛtātmikām /
vāgatītāṃ mano 'garmyā varadāṃ vedamātaram //
meaning:
सुधामण्डलमध्यस्थां सांद्रानन्दामृतात्मिकाम् /
वागतीतां मनो ऽगर्म्या वरदां वेदमातरम् //
text_mt: seated in the midst of the orb of nectar, her nature dense bliss and nectar, / beyond speech, inaccessible to thought, the boon-granting mother of the Vedas;

sanskrit_iast:
carācaramayīṃ nityāṃ brahmākṣarasamanvitām /
dhyātvā svātmāvibhedena sāvitrīpañjaraṃ nyaset //
meaning:
चराचरमयीं नित्यां ब्रह्माक्षरसमन्विताम् /
ध्यात्वा स्वात्माविभेदेन सावित्रीपञ्जरं न्यसेत् //
text_mt: consisting of all moving and unmoving things, eternal, endowed with the imperishable Brahman: / having meditated on her as non-different from one's own self, one should perform the Sāvitrī-pañjara placement.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarasya ṛṣiḥ so 'haṃ chaṃndo vikṛtirucyate /
devatā ca paro haṃsaḥ parabrahmādidevatā //
meaning:
पञ्चरस्य ऋषिः सो ऽहं छंन्दो विकृतिरुच्यते /
देवता च परो हंसः परब्रह्मादिदेवता //
text_mt: The sage of the pañjara is 'So 'ham' ('I am He'); the metre is said to be Vikṛti; / and the presiding deity is the supreme Haṃsa, the Supreme Brahman as the original divinity.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāptyai viniyoga udāhṛtaḥ /
ṣaḍaṅgadevatāmantrairaṅganyāsaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाप्त्यै विनियोग उदाहृतः /
षडङ्गदेवतामन्त्रैरङ्गन्यासं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: The ritual application is declared to be for attaining duty, wealth, desire, and liberation. / With the mantras of the six limb-deities, one should perform the placement on the limbs (aṅganyāsa).

sanskrit_iast:
tridhāmūlena medhāvī vyāpakaṃ hi samācaret /
pūrvoktāṃ devātāṃ dhyāyetsākārāṃ guṇasaṃyutām //
meaning:
त्रिधामूलेन मेधावी व्यापकं हि समाचरेत् /
पूर्वोक्तां देवातां ध्यायेत्साकारां गुणसंयुताम् //
text_mt: With the root-mantra, the intelligent practitioner should perform the three-fold pervasive placement (vyāpaka). / He should meditate upon the previously described deity endowed with form and qualities:

sanskrit_iast:
tripadā harijā pūrvamukhī brahmāstrasaṃjñikā /
caturviśatitattvāḍhyā pātu prācīṃ diśaṃ mama //
meaning:
त्रिपदा हरिजा पूर्वमुखी ब्रह्मास्त्रसंज्ञिका /
चतुर्विशतितत्त्वाढ्या पातु प्राचीं दिशं मम //
text_mt: May the three-footed one, born of Hari, facing east, designated as the Brahmāstra, / endowed with the twenty-four principles, protect my eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadā brahmadaṇḍā brahmāṇī dakṣiṇānanā /
ṣaḍviṃśatattvasaṃyuktā pātu me dakṣiṇāṃ diśam //
meaning:
चतुष्पदा ब्रह्मदण्डा ब्रह्माणी दक्षिणानना /
षड्विंशतत्त्वसंयुक्ता पातु मे दक्षिणां दिशम् //
text_mt: May the four-footed Brahmadaṇḍā, Brahmāṇī, facing south, / united with the twenty-six principles, protect my southern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaṅmukhī pañcapadī pañcāśattattvarūpiṇī /
pātu pratīcīmaniśaṃ mama brahmaśirāeṅkitā //
meaning:
प्रत्यङ्मुखी पञ्चपदी पञ्चाशत्तत्त्वरूपिणी /
पातु प्रतीचीमनिशं मम ब्रह्मशिराएङ्किता //
text_mt: May the five-footed one, facing west, who embodies the fifty principles, / marked as Brahmaśiras, constantly protect my western quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāsyā brahmaturyāḍhyā sātharvāṅgirasātmikā /
udīcīṃ ṣaṭpadā pātu ṣaṣṭitattvakalātmikā //
meaning:
सौम्यास्या ब्रह्मतुर्याढ्या साथर्वाङ्गिरसात्मिका /
उदीचीं षट्पदा पातु षष्टितत्त्वकलात्मिका //
text_mt: Gentle-faced, possessing the fourth state of Brahman, embodying Atharvan and Aṅgiras, / six-footed, embodying the sixty principles and digits, may she protect the north.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadvarṇaracitā navapādā śatākṣarī /
vyomā saṃpātu me vorddhvaśiro vedāntasaṃsthitā //
meaning:
पञ्चाशद्वर्णरचिता नवपादा शताक्षरी /
व्योमा संपातु मे वोर्द्ध्वशिरो वेदान्तसंस्थिता //
text_mt: Formed of fifty letters, nine-footed, of a hundred syllables, / sky-dwelling, established in the Upaniṣads—may she protect upward, above my head.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyunnibhā brahmasandhyā mṛgārūḍhā caturbhujā /
cāpeṣucarmāsidharā pātu me pāvakīṃ diśam //
meaning:
विद्युन्निभा ब्रह्मसन्ध्या मृगारूढा चतुर्भुजा /
चापेषुचर्मासिधरा पातु मे पावकीं दिशम् //
text_mt: Resembling lightning, the Brahma-twilight, mounted on a deer, four-armed, / holding a bow, arrow, shield, and sword—may she protect my fiery quarter [the south-east].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmī kumārī gāyatrī raktāṅgī haṃsavāhinī /
bibhratkamaṇḍaluṃ cākṣaṃ sruvasruvau pātu nairṛtim //
meaning:
ब्रह्मी कुमारी गायत्री रक्ताङ्गी हंसवाहिनी /
बिभ्रत्कमण्डलुं चाक्षं स्रुवस्रुवौ पातु नैरृतिम् //
text_mt: Brāhmī, the maiden, Gāyatrī, red-limbed, riding a swan, / holding a water pot and rosary, and the two ladles, sruva and sruc—may she protect the south-west.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavarṇā ca sāvitrī yuvatī vṛṣavāhanā /
kapālaśūlakākṣasragdhāriṇī pātu vāyavīm //
meaning:
शुक्लवर्णा च सावित्री युवती वृषवाहना /
कपालशूलकाक्षस्रग्धारिणी पातु वायवीम् //
text_mt: White in color, Sāvitrī, a youthful maiden riding a bull, / holding a skull-bowl, a trident, and a rosary—may she protect the north-west.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmā sarasvatī vṛddhā vaiṣṇavī garuḍāsanā /
śaṅkhacakrābhayakarā pātu śaivīṃ diśaṃ mama //
meaning:
श्यामा सरस्वती वृद्धा वैष्णवी गरुडासना /
शङ्खचक्राभयकरा पातु शैवीं दिशं मम //
text_mt: Dark-complexioned Sarasvatī, mature, Vaiṣṇavī, seated on Garuḍa, / holding a conch, discus, and the gesture of fearlessness—may she protect my north-eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā devamātā gaurāṅgī siṃhavāhanā /
varābhayakhaḍgacarmabhujā pātvadharāṃ diśam //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा देवमाता गौराङ्गी सिंहवाहना /
वराभयखड्गचर्मभुजा पात्वधरां दिशम् //
text_mt: Four-armed, mother of the gods, fair-limbed, riding a lion, / with arms bearing the boon, fearlessness, sword, and shield—may she protect the lower direction.

sanskrit_iast:
tattatpārśve sthitāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ /
svasvadikṣusthitāḥ pātuṃ grahaśaktyaṅgasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
तत्तत्पार्श्वे स्थिताः स्वस्ववाहनायुधभूषणाः /
स्वस्वदिक्षुस्थिताः पातुं ग्रहशक्त्यङ्गसंयुताः //
text_mt: Stationed at their respective sides, with their respective vehicles, weapons, and ornaments, / positioned in their respective quarters, accompanied by the planetary powers and limbs, may they protect;

sanskrit_iast:
mantrādhidevatārūpā mudrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ /
vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam //
meaning:
मन्त्राधिदेवतारूपा मुद्राधिष्ठातृदेवताः /
व्यापकत्वेन पान्त्वस्मानापादतलमस्तकम् //
text_mt: embodying the presiding deities of the mantras, the presiding deities of the hand-gestures (mudrās)— / pervasively, may they protect us from the soles of our feet to the head.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ te kathitaṃ satyaṃ sāvitrīpañjaraṃ mayā /
saṃdhyayoḥ pratyahaṃ bhaktyā japakāle viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
इदं ते कथितं सत्यं सावित्रीपञ्जरं मया /
संध्ययोः प्रत्यहं भक्त्या जपकाले विशेषतः //
text_mt: This Sāvitrī-pañjara has truly been declared to you by me. / Daily at the two twilights with devotion, especially at the time of recitation,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samicchatā /
bhūtidā bhuvanā vāṇī mahāvasumatī mahī //
meaning:
पठनीयं प्रयत्नेन भुक्तिं मुक्तिं समिच्छता /
भूतिदा भुवना वाणी महावसुमती मही //
text_mt: it should be read with diligence by one desiring enjoyment and liberation: / 'Boon-giver, Bhuvanā, Vāṇī, Mahāvasumatī, Mahī,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyajananī nandā savisargā tapasvinī /
yaśasvinī satī satyā vedaviccinmayī śubhā //
meaning:
हिरण्यजननी नन्दा सविसर्गा तपस्विनी /
यशस्विनी सती सत्या वेदविच्चिन्मयी शुभा //
text_mt: Mother of Gold, Nandā, Savisargā, Tapasvinī, / Glorious, Satī, Truth, Knower of the Vedas, Embodiment of Consciousness, Auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvā turyā vareṇyā ca nisṛṇī yamunā bhuvā /
modā devī variṣṭhā ca dhīśca śāntirmatī mahī //
meaning:
विश्वा तुर्या वरेण्या च निसृणी यमुना भुवा /
मोदा देवी वरिष्ठा च धीश्च शान्तिर्मती मही //
text_mt: All-pervading, the Fourth, Vareṇyā, Nisṛṇī, Yamunā, Earth, / Joy, the Goddess, Most Excellent, Intellect, Peace, Wisdom, Earth,

sanskrit_iast:
dhiṣaṇā yoginī yuktā nadī prajñāpracodanī /
dayā ca yāminī padmā rohiṇī ramaṇī jayā //
meaning:
धिषणा योगिनी युक्ता नदी प्रज्ञाप्रचोदनी /
दया च यामिनी पद्मा रोहिणी रमणी जया //
text_mt: Dhiṣaṇā, Yoginī, United, River, Inspirer of Wisdom, / Compassion, Night, Lotus, Rohiṇī, Delightful, Victorious,

sanskrit_iast:
senāmukhī sāmamayī bagalā doṣavārjitā /
māyā prajñā parā dogdhrī māninī poṣiṇī kriyā //
meaning:
सेनामुखी साममयी बगला दोषवार्जिता /
माया प्रज्ञा परा दोग्ध्री मानिनी पोषिणी क्रिया //
text_mt: Vanguard of the Army, Sāma-embodied, Bagalā, Faultless, / Māyā, Wisdom, Supreme, Milker [of desires], Proud, Nourisher, Action,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotsnā tīrthamayī ramyā saumyāmṛtamayā tathā /
brāhmī haimī bhujaṅgī ca vaśinī suṃdarī vanī //
meaning:
ज्योत्स्ना तीर्थमयी रम्या सौम्यामृतमया तथा /
ब्राह्मी हैमी भुजङ्गी च वशिनी सुंदरी वनी //
text_mt: Moonlight, Embodiment of Sacred Fords, Charming, Gentle, Embodiment of Nectar, / Brāhmī, Golden, Serpent, Subduer, Beautiful, Forest.'

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārahasinī sarvā sudhā sā ṣaḍguṇāvatī /
māyā svadhā ramā tanvī ripughnī rakṣaṇaṇī satī //
meaning:
ओङ्कारहसिनी सर्वा सुधा सा षड्गुणावती /
माया स्वधा रमा तन्वी रिपुघ्नी रक्षणणी सती //
text_mt: Oṅkārahasinī, Sarvā, Sudhā, Sā, Ṣaḍguṇāvatī, / Māyā, Svadhā, Ramā, Tanvī, Ripughnī, Rakṣaṇī, Satī,

sanskrit_iast:
haimī tārā vidhugatirviṣaghnī ca varānanā /
amarā tīrthadā dīkṣā durdharṣā rogahāriṇī //
meaning:
हैमी तारा विधुगतिर्विषघ्नी च वरानना /
अमरा तीर्थदा दीक्षा दुर्धर्षा रोगहारिणी //
text_mt: Haimī, Tārā, Vidhugati, Viṣaghnī, and Varānanā, / Amarā, Tīrthadā, Dīkṣā, Durdharṣā, Rogahāriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāpāpanṛśaṃsaghnī ṣaṭpadī vajriṇī raṇī /
yoginī vamalā satyā abalā baladā jayā //
meaning:
नानापापनृशंसघ्नी षट्पदी वज्रिणी रणी /
योगिनी वमला सत्या अबला बलदा जया //
text_mt: Nānāpāpanṛśaṃsaghnī, Ṣaṭpadī, Vajriṇī, Raṇī, / Yoginī, Vimalā, Satyā, Abalā, Baladā, Jayā,

sanskrit_iast:
gomatī jāhnavī rajāvī tapanī jātavedasā /
acirā vṛṣṭidā jñeyā ṛtatantrā ṛtātmikā //
meaning:
गोमती जाह्नवी रजावी तपनी जातवेदसा /
अचिरा वृष्टिदा ज्ञेया ऋततन्त्रा ऋतात्मिका //
text_mt: Gomatī, Jāhnavī, Rajāvī, Tapanī, Jātavedasā, / Acirā, Vṛṣṭidā, to be known as Ṛtatantrā, Ṛtātmikā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmadudhā saumyā bhavāhṝṅkāravarjitā /
dvipadā yā catuṣpadā tripadā yā ca ṣaṭpadā //
meaning:
सर्वकामदुधा सौम्या भवाहॄङ्कारवर्जिता /
द्विपदा या चतुष्पदा त्रिपदा या च षट्पदा //
text_mt: Sarvakāmadudhā, Saumyā, Bhavā, devoid of the hṝṅkāra sound; / she who is two-footed, four-footed, three-footed, and six-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāpadī navapadī sahasrākṣākṣarātmikā /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ sāvitryā yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ //
meaning:
अष्टापदी नवपदी सहस्राक्षाक्षरात्मिका /
अष्टोत्तरशतं नाम्नां सावित्र्या यः पठेन्नरः //
text_mt: eight-footed, nine-footed, whose nature is a thousand eyes and syllables— / whatever man recites this one hundred and eight names of Sāvitrī,

sanskrit_iast:
sa cirāyuḥ sukhī putrī vijayī vinayī bhavet /
etatte kathitaṃ vipra pañcaprakṛtilakṣaṇam //
meaning:
स चिरायुः सुखी पुत्री विजयी विनयी भवेत् /
एतत्ते कथितं विप्र पञ्चप्रकृतिलक्षणम् //
text_mt: he becomes long-lived, happy, blessed with sons, victorious, and humble. / This has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, the definition of the five Prakṛtis,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārādhanapūrvaṃ ca viśvakāmaprapūraṇam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīya purāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde pañcaprakṛtimantrādinirūpaṇaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
मन्त्राराधनपूर्वं च विश्वकामप्रपूरणम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीय पुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे पञ्चप्रकृतिमन्त्रादिनिरूपणं नाम त्र्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
preceded by the worship of their mantras, fulfilling all desires.

Thus ends the eighty-third chapter in the third quarter of the major narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, entitled 'Exposition of the Mantras of the Five Prakṛtis and Related Rites'.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
kalikalpāntare brahman brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ /
lokapadme tapasthasya sṛṣṭyarthaṃ saṃbabhūvatuḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
कलिकल्पान्तरे ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः /
लोकपद्मे तपस्थस्य सृष्ट्यर्थं संबभूवतुः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / In another Kalpa, O brāhmaṇa, when Brahmā, whose birth is from the Unmanifest, / was stationed in asceticism on the cosmic lotus for the sake of creation, there arose

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇukarṇamalodbhūtāvasurau madhukaiṭabhau /
tau jātamātrau payasi lokapralayalakṣaṇe //
meaning:
विष्णुकर्णमलोद्भूतावसुरौ मधुकैटभौ /
तौ जातमात्रौ पयसि लोकप्रलयलक्षणे //
text_mt: two asuras, Madhu and Kaiṭabha, born from the earwax of Viṣṇu. / As soon as they were born, standing knee-deep in the water

sanskrit_iast:
jānumātre sthitau dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇaṃ kamalasthitam /
pravṛttāvattumālakṣya tuṣṭāva jagadaṃbikām //
meaning:
जानुमात्रे स्थितौ दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणं कमलस्थितम् /
प्रवृत्तावत्तुमालक्ष्य तुष्टाव जगदंबिकाम् //
text_mt: that marks the cosmic dissolution, and seeing Brahmā seated on the lotus, / perceiving that they were about to devour him, [Brahmā] praised the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devī jagatkartrī śaivī śaktiranuttamā /
nārāyaṇākṣisaṃsthānā nidrā prītā babhūva ha //
meaning:
ततो देवी जगत्कर्त्री शैवी शक्तिरनुत्तमा /
नारायणाक्षिसंस्थाना निद्रा प्रीता बभूव ह //
text_mt: Then the goddess, the maker of the universe, the unexcelled power of Śiva, / stationed in Nārāyaṇa's eyes as sleep, was pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā mantrādikaṃ sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu /
sāruṇā krodhanī śāntiścandrālaṅkṛtaśekharā //
meaning:
तस्या मन्त्रादिकं सर्वं कथयिष्यामि तच्छृणु /
सारुणा क्रोधनी शान्तिश्चन्द्रालङ्कृतशेखरा //
text_mt: I will relate all concerning her mantra and rites; hear that: / she is crimson, wrathful, tranquil, with her crest adorned by the moon;

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣarībīja mantraṛṣiḥ śaktirudāhṛtā /
gāyatrī ca bhavecchando devatā bhuvaneśvarī //
meaning:
एकाक्षरीबीज मन्त्रऋषिः शक्तिरुदाहृता /
गायत्री च भवेच्छन्दो देवता भुवनेश्वरी //
text_mt: the single syllable is said to be the bīja, mantra, ṛṣi, and śakti; / the metre is Gāyatrī, and the deity is Bhuvaneśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdirghayuktabījena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt /
saṃhārasṛṣṭimārgeṇa mātṛkānyastavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
षड्दिर्घयुक्तबीजेन कुर्यादङ्गानि षट् क्रमात् /
संहारसृष्टिमार्गेण मातृकान्यस्तविग्रहः //
text_mt: With the bīja joined with the six long [vowels], one should perform the six limbs in sequence. / Having one's body ritually placed with the mātṛkā letters by the path of dissolution and creation,

sanskrit_iast:
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddevatābhāvasiddhaye /
hṛllekhāṃ mūrdhni vadane gaganāṃ hṛdayāṃbuje //
meaning:
मन्त्रन्यासं ततः कुर्याद्देवताभावसिद्धये /
हृल्लेखां मूर्ध्नि वदने गगनां हृदयांबुजे //
text_mt: one should then perform the nyāsa of the mantra for the attainment of the deity's nature: / Hṛllekhā on the crown, Gaganā on the face, on the heart-lotus

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃ karālikāṃ guhye mahocchuṣmāṃ padadvaye /
ūrddhvaprāgdakṣiṇodīcyapaścimeṣūttare 'pi ca //
meaning:
रक्तां करालिकां गुह्ये महोच्छुष्मां पदद्वये /
ऊर्द्ध्वप्राग्दक्षिणोदीच्यपश्चिमेषूत्तरे ऽपि च //
text_mt: Raktā, Karālikā on the private parts, Mahocchuṣmā on the two feet; / above, east, south, north, west, and also northeast,

sanskrit_iast:
sadyādihrasvabījādyānvastavyā bhūtasaprabhāḥ /
aṅgāni vinyasetpaścājjātiyuktāni ṣaṭ kramāt //
meaning:
सद्यादिह्रस्वबीजाद्यान्वस्तव्या भूतसप्रभाः /
अङ्गानि विन्यसेत्पश्चाज्जातियुक्तानि षट् क्रमात् //
text_mt: beginning with the short bīja starting with Sadyojāta, shining like elements, they are to be placed; / afterwards, one should ritually place the six limbs in order, joined with their respective jātis.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ vinyasedbhāle gāyatryā saha saṃyutam /
sāvitryā sahitaṃ viṣṇuṃ kapole dakṣiṇe nyaset //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं विन्यसेद्भाले गायत्र्या सह संयुतम् /
सावित्र्या सहितं विष्णुं कपोले दक्षिणे न्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should place Brahmā joined with Gāyatrī on the forehead; / one should place Viṣṇu along with Sāvitrī on the right cheek;

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśvaryā samāyuktaṃ vāmagaṇḍe maheśvaram /
śriyā dhanapatiṃ nyasya vāmakarṇāgrake punaḥ //
meaning:
वागीश्वर्या समायुक्तं वामगण्डे महेश्वरम् /
श्रिया धनपतिं न्यस्य वामकर्णाग्रके पुनः //
text_mt: Maheśvara accompanied by Vāgīśvarī on the left cheek; / having placed the Lord of Wealth with Śrī on the tip of the left ear, then

sanskrit_iast:
ratyā smaraṃ mukhe nyasya puṇyāgaṇapatiṃ nyaset /
savyakarṇopari nidhākarṇagaṇḍāntarālayoḥ //
meaning:
रत्या स्मरं मुखे न्यस्य पुण्यागणपतिं न्यसेत् /
सव्यकर्णोपरि निधाकर्णगण्डान्तरालयोः //
text_mt: having placed Smara with Rati on the mouth, one should place Puṇyā and Gaṇapati / above the right ear; between the ear and the cheek-temple,

sanskrit_iast:
nyastavyaṃ vadane mūlaṃ bhūpaścaitrāṃstato nyaset /
kaṇṭhamūle stanadvandve vāmāṃse hṛdayāṃbuje //
meaning:
न्यस्तव्यं वदने मूलं भूपश्चैत्रांस्ततो न्यसेत् /
कण्ठमूले स्तनद्वन्द्वे वामांसे हृदयांबुजे //
text_mt: the mūlamantra is to be placed on the face; then he should place the earthly Caitras: / at the base of the throat, on the two breasts, on the left shoulder, on the heart-lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
savyāṃse pārśvayugale nābhideśe ca deśikaḥ /
bhālāṃśca pārśvajaṭhare pārśvāṃsāparake hṛdi //
meaning:
सव्यांसे पार्श्वयुगले नाभिदेशे च देशिकः /
भालांश्च पार्श्वजठरे पार्श्वांसापरके हृदि //
text_mt: on the right shoulder, on the two sides, and on the navel region, the preceptor / [places them]; on the forehead, the side of the belly, the other side of the shoulder, and on the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇyādyāstanau nyasya vidhinā proktalakṣaṇāḥ /
mūlena vyāpakaṃ dehe nyasya devīṃ vicintayet //
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्याद्यास्तनौ न्यस्य विधिना प्रोक्तलक्षणाः /
मूलेन व्यापकं देहे न्यस्य देवीं विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: having placed Brahmāṇī and the others on the body according to rule, as described in their characteristics, / and having performed an all-pervasive nyāsa on the body with the root-mantra, one should meditate on the goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
udyaddivākaranibhāṃ tuṅgorojāṃ trilocanām / /
smarāsyāmindumukuṭāṃ varapāśāṅkuśābhayām //
meaning:
उद्यद्दिवाकरनिभां तुङ्गोरोजां त्रिलोचनाम् / /
स्मरास्यामिन्दुमुकुटां वरपाशाङ्कुशाभयाम् //
text_mt: resembling the rising sun, with prominent breasts, three-eyed, / with a smiling face, an moon-crest, holding the boon-giving gesture, noose, goad, and the fear-dispelling gesture.

sanskrit_iast:
radalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ trimadhvaktairhunettataḥ /
aṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśena brahmavṛkṣasamidvaraiḥ //
meaning:
रदलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं त्रिमध्वक्तैर्हुनेत्ततः /
अष्टद्रव्यैर्दशांशेन ब्रह्मवृक्षसमिद्वरैः //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra thirty-two hundred thousand times; then one should offer in fire / with the eight substances smeared with the three sweets, or with excellent firewood of the Brahmā-tree by one-tenth of that amount.

sanskrit_iast:
drākṣākharjūravātādaśarkarānālikerakam /
tandulājyatilaṃ vipra dravyāṣṭakamudāhṛtam //
meaning:
द्राक्षाखर्जूरवातादशर्करानालिकेरकम् /
तन्दुलाज्यतिलं विप्र द्रव्याष्टकमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Grapes, dates, almonds, sugar, coconut, / rice grains, ghee, and sesame, O brāhmaṇa, are declared to be the eight substances.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādardhyaṃ dineśāya tatra saṃcintya pārvatīm /
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye vṛttaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirddalaiḥ //
meaning:
दद्यादर्ध्यं दिनेशाय तत्र संचिन्त्य पार्वतीम् /
पद्ममष्टदलं बाह्ये वृत्तं षोडशभिर्द्दलैः //
text_mt: One should offer arghya to the sun, having meditated there on Pārvatī; / an eight-petalled lotus outside, enclosed by sixteen petals,

sanskrit_iast:
vilikhetkaṇiṅkrāmadhyeṣaḍkoṇamatisundaram /
tataḥ saṃpūjayetpīṭhaṃ navaśaktisamanvitam //
meaning:
विलिखेत्कणिङ्क्रामध्येषड्कोणमतिसुन्दरम् /
ततः संपूजयेत्पीठं नवशक्तिसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: In the middle of the pericarp one should draw an exceedingly beautiful hexagon. / Then one should worship the ritual seat endowed with the nine Śaktis:

sanskrit_iast:
jayākhyā vijayā paścādajitāhvāparājitā /
nityā vilāsinī gogdhītyaghorā maṅgalā nava //
meaning:
जयाख्या विजया पश्चादजिताह्वापराजिता /
नित्या विलासिनी गोग्धीत्यघोरा मङ्गला नव //
text_mt: Jayā, Vijayā, next the one named Ajitā, Aparājitā, / Nityā, Vilāsinī, Dogdhrī, Aghorā, and Maṅgalā—these are the nine.

sanskrit_iast:
bījāḍhyamāsanaṃ dattvā mūrtiṃ tenaiva kalpayet /
tasyāṃ saṃpūjayeddevīmāvāhyāvaraṇaiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
बीजाढ्यमासनं दत्त्वा मूर्तिं तेनैव कल्पयेत् /
तस्यां संपूजयेद्देवीमावाह्यावरणैः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Having offered a seat rich in the seed-syllable, one should fashion the form [of the deity] with that very [seed-syllable]. / Having invoked the goddess into it, one should worship her along with her coverings in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
madheyapāgyāmyasaumyeṣu pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥ /
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu yajenmantrī paścānmithunadevatāḥ //
meaning:
मधेयपाग्याम्यसौम्येषु पूजयेदङ्गदेवताः /
षट्कोणेषु यजेन्मन्त्री पश्चान्मिथुनदेवताः //
text_mt: In the centre, east, south, and north, one should worship the limb-deities. / In the [angles of the] hexagon, the practitioner of mantra should then worship the paired deities.

sanskrit_iast:
indrakoṇaṃ lasaddaṇḍakuṇḍikākṣaguṇābhayām /
gāyatrīṃ pūjayenmatrī brahmāṇamapi tādṛśam //
meaning:
इन्द्रकोणं लसद्दण्डकुण्डिकाक्षगुणाभयाम् /
गायत्रीं पूजयेन्मत्री ब्रह्माणमपि तादृशम् //
text_mt: In Indra’s corner, the practitioner of mantra should worship Gāyatrī, who displays a staff, water-pot, rosary, and boon, / and Brahmā who is likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣaḥ koṇe śaṅkhacakragadāpaṅkajadhāriṇīm /
sāvitrīṃ pītavasanāṃ yajedviṇuṃ ca tādṛśam //
meaning:
रक्षः कोणे शङ्खचक्रगदापङ्कजधारिणीम् /
सावित्रीं पीतवसनां यजेद्विणुं च तादृशम् //
text_mt: In the demon’s corner, one should worship Sāvitrī, wearing yellow garments and holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / and Viṣṇu who is likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyukoṇe paraśvakṣamālā bhayavarānvitām /
yajetsarasvatīmacchāṃ rudraṃ tādṛśalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
वायुकोणे परश्वक्षमाला भयवरान्विताम् /
यजेत्सरस्वतीमच्छां रुद्रं तादृशलक्षणम् //
text_mt: In Vāyu’s corner, one should worship the pure Sarasvatī, endowed with an axe, rosary, fear-dispelling gesture, and boon, / and Rudra possessing the same characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnikoṇe yajedratnakuṃbhaṃ maṇikaraṇḍakam /
karābhyāṃ bibhratīṃ pītāṃ tundilaṃ dhanadāyakam //
meaning:
वह्निकोणे यजेद्रत्नकुंभं मणिकरण्डकम् /
कराभ्यां बिभ्रतीं पीतां तुन्दिलं धनदायकम् //
text_mt: In Agni’s corner, one should worship [Mahālakṣmī], holding a jewel-pitcher and a gem-casket with her hands, / golden-complexioned, and the pot-bellied Dhanada [Kubera],

sanskrit_iast:
āliṅgya savyahastena vāme tāṃbūladhāriṇīm /
dhanadāṅkasamārūḍhāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
आलिङ्ग्य सव्यहस्तेन वामे तांबूलधारिणीम् /
धनदाङ्कसमारूढां महालक्ष्मीं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: embracing her with his right hand, holding betel in her left, / seated on the lap of Dhanada—[thus] one should worship Mahālakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
paścime madanaṃ bāṇapāśāṅkuśaśarāsanām /
dhārayantaṃ japāraktaṃ pūjayedraktabhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
पश्चिमे मदनं बाणपाशाङ्कुशशरासनाम् /
धारयन्तं जपारक्तं पूजयेद्रक्तभूषणम् //
text_mt: In the west, one should worship Madana, red like a hibiscus, adorned with red ornaments, / bearing arrows, noose, goad, and bow.

sanskrit_iast:
savyena patimāśliṣya vāmenotpaladhāriṇīm /
pāṇinā ramaṇāṅkasthāṃ ratiṃ samyaksamarcayet //
meaning:
सव्येन पतिमाश्लिष्य वामेनोत्पलधारिणीम् /
पाणिना रमणाङ्कस्थां रतिं सम्यक्समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: One should properly worship Rati, seated on the lap of her lover, / embracing her husband with her right arm and holding a blue lotus in her left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānye pūjayetsamyak vighnarājaṃ priyānvitam /
sṛṇipāśadharaṃ kāntaṃ varāṅgāsṛkkalāṅgulim //
meaning:
ऐशान्ये पूजयेत्सम्यक् विघ्नराजं प्रियान्वितम् /
सृणिपाशधरं कान्तं वराङ्गासृक्कलाङ्गुलिम् //
text_mt: In the northeast, one should properly worship the King of Obstacles [Gaṇeśa] accompanied by his beloved, / handsome, holding a goad and noose, his finger touched with blood from the female organ,

sanskrit_iast:
mādhvīpūrṇakapālāḍhyaṃ vighnarājaṃ digaṃbaram /
puṣkare vigaladratnasphuraccaṣakadhāriṇam //
meaning:
माध्वीपूर्णकपालाढ्यं विघ्नराजं दिगंबरम् /
पुष्करे विगलद्रत्नस्फुरच्चषकधारिणम् //
text_mt: the sky-clad King of Obstacles, equipped with a skull-bowl full of liquor, / holding in his trunk a radiant drinking-cup with trickling gems,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūrasadṛśākārāmuddāmamadavibhramām /
dhṛtaraktotpalāmanyapāṇinā tu dhvajaspṛśām //
meaning:
सिंदूरसदृशाकारामुद्दाममदविभ्रमाम् /
धृतरक्तोत्पलामन्यपाणिना तु ध्वजस्पृशाम् //
text_mt: resembling vermilion in form, intoxicated with unrestrained rut and charm, / holding a red lotus, and with her other hand touching his banner [or phallus],

sanskrit_iast:
āśliṣṭakāntāmaruṇāṃ puṣṭimarceddigaṃbarām /
karṇikāyāṃ nidhī pūjyau ṣaṭkoṇasyātha pārśvayoḥ //
meaning:
आश्लिष्टकान्तामरुणां पुष्टिमर्चेद्दिगंबराम् /
कर्णिकायां निधी पूज्यौ षट्कोणस्याथ पार्श्वयोः //
text_mt: one should worship the sky-clad, crimson Puṣṭi embracing her lover. / In the pericarp and then on the flanks of the hexagon, the two treasures are to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāni kesareṣvetāḥ paścātpatreṣu pūjayet /
anaṅgakusumā paścāddvitīyānaṅgamekhalā //
meaning:
अङ्गानि केसरेष्वेताः पश्चात्पत्रेषु पूजयेत् /
अनङ्गकुसुमा पश्चाद्द्वितीयानङ्गमेखला //
text_mt: In the filaments [one should worship] the limbs, and then worship these on the petals: / Anaṅgakusumā, next the second, Anaṅgamekhalā,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgagamanā tadvadanaṅgamadanāturā /
bhuvanapālā gaganavegā ṣaṣṭhī caiva tataḥ param //
meaning:
अनङ्गगमना तद्वदनङ्गमदनातुरा /
भुवनपाला गगनवेगा षष्ठी चैव ततः परम् //
text_mt: likewise Anaṅgagamanā, Anaṅgamadanāturā, / Bhuvanapālā, and then sixth Gaganavegā,

sanskrit_iast:
śaśilekhā gaganalekhā cetyaṣṭau yatra śaktayaḥ /
khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇyaḥ śyāmāḥ pūjyāśca mātaraḥ //
meaning:
शशिलेखा गगनलेखा चेत्यष्टौ यत्र शक्तयः /
खड्गखेटकधारिण्यः श्यामाः पूज्याश्च मातरः //
text_mt: Śaśilekhā, and Gaganalekhā—these eight Śaktis. / The dark mothers holding a sword and shield are to be worshipped there.

sanskrit_iast:
padmādbahiḥ samabhyarcyāḥ śaktayaḥ paricārikāḥ /
prathamānaṅgadvayāsyādanaṅgamadanā tataḥ //
meaning:
पद्माद्बहिः समभ्यर्च्याः शक्तयः परिचारिकाः /
प्रथमानङ्गद्वयास्यादनङ्गमदना ततः //
text_mt: Outside the lotus, the attendant Śaktis are to be worshipped: / the first being the pair of Anaṅgas, then Anaṅgamadanā,

sanskrit_iast:
madanāturā bhavanavegā tato bhuvanapālikā /
syātsarvaśiśirānaṅgavedanānaṅgamekhalā //
meaning:
मदनातुरा भवनवेगा ततो भुवनपालिका /
स्यात्सर्वशिशिरानङ्गवेदनानङ्गमेखला //
text_mt: Madanāturā, Bhavanavegā, then Bhuvanapālikā, / Sarvaśiśirā, Anaṅgavedanā, and Anaṅgamekhalā.

sanskrit_iast:
caṣakaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ chatramujjvalam /
cāmare cāṃśukaṃ puṣpaṃ bibhrāṇāḥ karapaṅkajaiḥ //
meaning:
चषकं तालवृन्तं च तांबूलं छत्रमुज्ज्वलम् /
चामरे चांशुकं पुष्पं बिभ्राणाः करपङ्कजैः //
text_mt: Holding in their lotus-hands a drinking-cup, a palmyra fan, / betel, a bright umbrella, two chowries, a garment, and a flower,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃdīptān lokapālānbahiryajet /
vajrādīnyapi tadbāhye devīmitthaṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंदीप्तान् लोकपालान्बहिर्यजेत् /
वज्रादीन्यपि तद्बाह्ये देवीमित्थं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: one should worship the guardians of the world outside, resplendent with all ornaments; / outside them, [their weapons] beginning with the thunderbolt. Thus one should worship the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrī trimadhuropetairhutvāśvatthasamidvaraiḥ /
brāhmaṇānvaśayecchīghraṃ pārthivānpadmahomataḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्री त्रिमधुरोपेतैर्हुत्वाश्वत्थसमिद्वरैः /
ब्राह्मणान्वशयेच्छीघ्रं पार्थिवान्पद्महोमतः //
text_mt: Having offered oblation with excellent Aśvattha firewood mixed with the three sweets, / the practitioner of mantra quickly subdues brāhmaṇas; and kings by an oblation of lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
palāśapuṣpaistatpatnīṃ mantriṇaḥ kusudairapi /
pañcaviṃśatidhā japtairjalaiḥ snānaṃ dine dine //
meaning:
पलाशपुष्पैस्तत्पत्नीं मन्त्रिणः कुसुदैरपि /
पञ्चविंशतिधा जप्तैर्जलैः स्नानं दिने दिने //
text_mt: their wives by Palāśa flowers, and ministers with water-lilies. / A bath day after day with water over which [the mantra] has been recited twenty-five times—

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānamabhiṣiñcedyaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavānbhavet /
pañcaviṃśatidhā japtaṃ jalaṃ prātaḥ pibennaraḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानमभिषिञ्चेद्यः सर्वसौभाग्यवान्भवेत् /
पञ्चविंशतिधा जप्तं जलं प्रातः पिबेन्नरः //
text_mt: he who sprinkles himself [with this] will be endowed with all good fortune. / If a man drinks in the morning water over which [the mantra] has been recited twenty-five times,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya mahatīṃ prajñāṃ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet /
karpūrāgarusaṃyuktakuṅkumaṃ sādhu sādhitam //
meaning:
अवाप्य महतीं प्रज्ञां कवीनामग्रणीर्भवेत् /
कर्पूरागरुसंयुक्तकुङ्कुमं साधु साधितम् //
text_mt: having attained great wisdom, he will become foremost among poets. / Having taken saffron thoroughly consecrated with camphor and agallochum,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā tilakaṃ kuryādrājavaśyamanuttamam /
śālipiṣṭamayīṃ kṛtvā puttalīṃ madhurānvitām //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा तिलकं कुर्याद्राजवश्यमनुत्तमम् /
शालिपिष्टमयीं कृत्वा पुत्तलीं मधुरान्विताम् //
text_mt: he should make a forehead-mark; it grants supreme subjugation of kings. / Having made a doll of rice flour mixed with sweet substances,

sanskrit_iast:
japtāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ bhakṣayedravivāsare /
vaśaṃ nayati rājānaṃ nārīṃ vā narameva ca //
meaning:
जप्तां प्रतिष्ठितप्राणां भक्षयेद्रविवासरे /
वशं नयति राजानं नारीं वा नरमेव च //
text_mt: empowered by recitation and having its life-breath established, he should eat it on a Sunday; / it brings a king, a woman, or a man under his sway.

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitvā vīkṣya toyodgataṃ ravim /
trisahasraṃ japenmantraṃ kanyāmiṣṭāṃ labhettataḥ //
meaning:
कण्ठमात्रोदके स्थित्वा वीक्ष्य तोयोद्गतं रविम् /
त्रिसहस्रं जपेन्मन्त्रं कन्यामिष्टां लभेत्ततः //
text_mt: Standing in water up to the neck and gazing upon the sun rising from the water, / he should recite the mantra three thousand times; then he will obtain the maiden he desires.

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ tanmantritaṃ mantrī bhuñjīta śrīprasiddhaye /
likhitāṃ bhasmanā māyāṃ sasādhyāṃ phalakādiṣu //
meaning:
अन्नं तन्मन्त्रितं मन्त्री भुञ्जीत श्रीप्रसिद्धये /
लिखितां भस्मना मायां ससाध्यां फलकादिषु //
text_mt: The practitioner of mantra should consume food consecrated with that mantra for the attainment of prosperity. / If one immediately shows a pregnant woman the diagram of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālaṃ darśayedyantraṃ sukhaṃ sūyeta garbhiṇī /
bhuvaneśīyamākhyātā sahasrabhujasaṃbhavā //
meaning:
तत्कालं दर्शयेद्यन्त्रं सुखं सूयेत गर्भिणी /
भुवनेशीयमाख्याता सहस्रभुजसंभवा //
text_mt: written with ash on a board or the like along with the object of accomplishment, she will give birth with ease. / This Bhuwaneśī has been declared, arisen from the thousand-armed one,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktipradā nṝṇāṃ smartṛāṇāṃ dvijasattama /
tataḥ kalpāntare vipra kadācinmahiṣāsuraḥ //
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा नॄणां स्मर्तृआणां द्विजसत्तम /
ततः कल्पान्तरे विप्र कदाचिन्महिषासुरः //
text_mt: granting enjoyment and liberation to men who remember her, O best of the twice-born! / Then in another kalpa, O vipra, Mahiṣāsura once

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva lokapālāṃstu jitvā bhuṅkte jagattrayam /
tatastpīḍitā devā vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
बभूव लोकपालांस्तु जित्वा भुङ्क्ते जगत्त्रयम् /
ततस्त्पीडिता देवा वैकुण्ठं शरणं ययुः //
text_mt: arose, and having conquered the guardians of the world, he enjoyed the three worlds. / Then the afflicted gods went to Vaikuṇṭha for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devī mahālakṣmīścakrādyāṅgotthatejasā /
śrīrbabhūvamuniśreṣṭha mūrtā vyāptajagattrayā //
meaning:
ततो देवी महालक्ष्मीश्चक्राद्याङ्गोत्थतेजसा /
श्रीर्बभूवमुनिश्रेष्ठ मूर्ता व्याप्तजगत्त्रया //
text_mt: Then, O best of sages, the goddess Mahālakṣmī, Śrī, embodied from the splendour / originating from the limbs [of the gods] beginning with the discus, arose, pervading the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ sā mahiṣādīṃstu nihatya jagadīśvarī /
aravindavanaṃ prāptā bhajatāmiṣṭadāyinī //
meaning:
स्वयं सा महिषादींस्तु निहत्य जगदीश्वरी /
अरविन्दवनं प्राप्ता भजतामिष्टदायिनी //
text_mt: Having slain Mahiṣa and others herself, that sovereign mistress of the universe / reached the lotus grove, granting desires to those who adore her.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ samarcanaṃ vakṣye saṃkṣepeṇa śṛṇu dvija /
mṛtyukrodhena guruṇā bindubhūṣitamastakā //
meaning:
तस्याः समर्चनं वक्ष्ये संक्षेपेण शृणु द्विज /
मृत्युक्रोधेन गुरुणा बिन्दुभूषितमस्तका //
text_mt: I shall declare her worship in brief; listen, O twice-born! / [The syllable] topped with a bindu, having ‘death’ [k], ‘anger’ [r], and the heavy vowel [ī],

sanskrit_iast:
bījamantraḥ śriyaḥ prokto bhajatāmiṣṭadāyakaḥ /
ṛṣirbhṛgurnivṛcchando devatā śrīḥ samīritā //
meaning:
बीजमन्त्रः श्रियः प्रोक्तो भजतामिष्टदायकः /
ऋषिर्भृगुर्निवृच्छन्दो देवता श्रीः समीरिता //
text_mt: is proclaimed as the seed-syllable of Śrī, granting desires to those who adore her. / The ṛṣi is stated to be Bhṛgu, the metre Nivṛt, and the deity Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt /
tato dhyāyejjagadvedyāṃ śriyaṃ saṃpattidāyinīm //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घयुक्तबीजेन कुर्यादङ्गानि षट् क्रमात् /
ततो ध्यायेज्जगद्वेद्यां श्रियं संपत्तिदायिनीम् //
text_mt: With the seed-syllable joined with the six long vowels, one should perform the six limbs in sequence. / Then one should meditate upon Śrī, known by the world, the bestower of fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanābhāṃ gajaiḥ śvetaiścaturbhiḥ svakaroddhṛtaiḥ /
hiraṇmayāmṛtaghaṭaiḥ sicyamānāṃ sarojagām //
meaning:
काञ्चनाभां गजैः श्वेतैश्चतुर्भिः स्वकरोद्धृतैः /
हिरण्मयामृतघटैः सिच्यमानां सरोजगाम् //
text_mt: golden in hue, seated upon a lotus, being sprinkled by four white elephants / with golden pitchers of nectar lifted up by their trunks,

sanskrit_iast:
varābhayābjasragdhastāṃ kṣaumavastrāṃ kirīṭinīm /
siddhalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ hunettathā //
meaning:
वराभयाब्जस्रग्धस्तां क्षौमवस्त्रां किरीटिनीम् /
सिद्धलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तत्सहस्रं हुनेत्तथा //
text_mt: her hands displaying the boon, fear-dispelling gesture, and lotus garland, wearing silk garments and a diadem. / One should recite the mantra a perfected hundred thousand times and offer oblation one thousand times as well,

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhakusumairiṣṭvā kamalairmadhuraplutaiḥ /
mahālakṣmyudite pīṭhe mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet //
meaning:
सुगन्धकुसुमैरिष्ट्वा कमलैर्मधुरप्लुतैः /
महालक्ष्म्युदिते पीठे मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: having worshipped with fragrant flowers and with lotuses drenched in sweets. / On the ritual seat prescribed for Mahālakṣmī, one should fashion the form with the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
yajetpūrvavadaṅgāni digdaleṣvarcayettataḥ /
vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnamaniruddhakam //
meaning:
यजेत्पूर्ववदङ्गानि दिग्दलेष्वर्चयेत्ततः /
वासुदेवं संकर्षणं प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धकम् //
text_mt: One should worship the limbs as before, and then worship on the cardinal petals: / Vāsudeva, Saṃkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha,

sanskrit_iast:
himapītatamālendranīlābhānpītavāsasaḥ /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇastāṃścaturbhujān //
meaning:
हिमपीततमालेन्द्रनीलाभान्पीतवाससः /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मधारिणस्तांश्चतुर्भुजान् //
text_mt: resembling snow, yellow, the Tamāla tree, and the sapphire, wearing yellow garments, / holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, and four-armed.

sanskrit_iast:
vidiganteṣu patreṣu damakādīnyajedgajān /
damakaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca guggulaṃ ca kuraṇṭakam //
meaning:
विदिगन्तेषु पत्रेषु दमकादीन्यजेद्गजान् /
दमकं पुण्डरीकं च गुग्गुलं च कुरण्टकम् //
text_mt: On the petals in the intermediate directions, one should worship the elephants beginning with Damaka: / Damaka, Puṇḍarīka, Guggula, and Kuraṇṭaka.

sanskrit_iast:
yajecchaṅkhanidhiṃ devyā dakṣiṇe pramadānvitam /
muktāmāṇikyasaṃkāśau kiñcitsmitamukhāṃbujau //
meaning:
यजेच्छङ्खनिधिं देव्या दक्षिणे प्रमदान्वितम् /
मुक्तामाणिक्यसंकाशौ किञ्चित्स्मितमुखांबुजौ //
text_mt: To the right of the goddess, one should worship the treasure Śaṅkha accompanied by his woman, / resembling pearl and ruby, their lotus faces slightly smiling,

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyāliṅganaparau śaṅkhapaṅkajadhāriṇau /
vigaladratnavarṣābhyāṃ śaṅkhabhyā mūrdhni lāñchitau //
meaning:
अन्योन्यालिङ्गनपरौ शङ्खपङ्कजधारिणौ /
विगलद्रत्नवर्षाभ्यां शङ्खभ्या मूर्ध्नि लाञ्छितौ //
text_mt: intent on embracing each other, holding a conch and a lotus, / marked on the head with two conches pouring forth a shower of gems—

sanskrit_iast:
tundilaṃ kaṃbukanidhiṃ vasudhārāṃ ghanastanīm /
vāmataḥ paṅkajanidhiṃ priyayā sahitaṃ yajet //
meaning:
तुन्दिलं कंबुकनिधिं वसुधारां घनस्तनीम् /
वामतः पङ्कजनिधिं प्रियया सहितं यजेत् //
text_mt: the pot-bellied treasure Śaṅkha and the full-breasted Vasudhārā. / On the left one should worship the treasure Padma together with his beloved,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūrābhau bhujaśliṣṭau raktapadmotpalānvitau /
niḥsaradratnavarṣābhyāṃ padmābhyāṃ mūrdhni lāñchitau //
meaning:
सिंदूराभौ भुजश्लिष्टौ रक्तपद्मोत्पलान्वितौ /
निःसरद्रत्नवर्षाभ्यां पद्माभ्यां मूर्ध्नि लाञ्छितौ //
text_mt: vermilion in hue, embracing with their arms, holding a red lotus and a blue lotus, / marked on the head with two lotuses pouring forth a shower of emerging gems.

sanskrit_iast:
tundilaṃ paṅkajanidhiṃ tattvāṃ vasumatīmapi /
dalāgreṣu yajedetābalākyādyāḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
तुन्दिलं पङ्कजनिधिं तत्त्वां वसुमतीमपि /
दलाग्रेषु यजेदेताबलाक्याद्याः समन्ततः //
text_mt: with the pot-bellied Lotus-treasure and the earth as well; / on the petal tips one should worship these, beginning with Balākī all around:

sanskrit_iast:
balākī vimalā caiva kamalā vanamālikā /
vibhīṣikā mālikā ca śāṅkarī vasumālikā //
meaning:
बलाकी विमला चैव कमला वनमालिका /
विभीषिका मालिका च शाङ्करी वसुमालिका //
text_mt: Balākī and Vimalā, Kamalā, Vanamālikā, / Vibhīṣikā and Mālikā, Śāṅkarī, Vasumālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
paṅkajadvayadhāriṇyo muktāhārasamaprabhāḥ /
lokeśānpūjayedante vajrādyāstrāṇi tadbahiḥ //
meaning:
पङ्कजद्वयधारिण्यो मुक्ताहारसमप्रभाः /
लोकेशान्पूजयेदन्ते वज्राद्यास्त्राणि तद्बहिः //
text_mt: holding two lotuses, having a brilliance like a pearl necklace. / At the end one should worship the world-protectors, and outside of that, the weapons beginning with the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ yo bhajate devīṃ vidhinā sādhakottamaḥ /
dhanadhānyasamṛddhaḥ syācchriyamāpnotyaninditām //
meaning:
इत्थं यो भजते देवीं विधिना साधकोत्तमः /
धनधान्यसमृद्धः स्याच्छ्रियमाप्नोत्यनिन्दिताम् //
text_mt: The best practitioner who thus worships the goddess according to rule / becomes rich in wealth and grain, and attains irreproachable prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣaḥpramāṇasalile sthitvā mantramimaṃ japet /
trilakṣamarkagaṃ dhyāyansa bhavetkamalālayaḥ //
meaning:
वक्षःप्रमाणसलिले स्थित्वा मन्त्रमिमं जपेत् /
त्रिलक्षमर्कगं ध्यायन्स भवेत्कमलालयः //
text_mt: Standing in chest-deep water, one should recite this mantra / three hundred thousand times while meditating on her stationed in the sun; he becomes an abode of Kamalā.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇugehasthabilvasya mūle lakṣatrayaṃ japet /
sādhako yaḥ sa labhate vāñchitaṃ dhanasaṃcayam //
meaning:
विष्णुगेहस्थबिल्वस्य मूले लक्षत्रयं जपेत् /
साधको यः स लभते वाञ्छितं धनसंचयम् //
text_mt: At the root of a bilva tree located at a temple of Viṣṇu, whatever practitioner / recites it three hundred thousand times obtains his desired accumulation of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
aśokavahnāvājyāktaistaṇḍulairvaśayejjagat /
homenakhādire vahnau taṇḍulermadhurokṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
अशोकवह्नावाज्याक्तैस्तण्डुलैर्वशयेज्जगत् /
होमेनखादिरे वह्नौ तण्डुलेर्मधुरोक्षितैः //
text_mt: In a fire of aśoka wood, with rice grains smeared with ghee, he can subjugate the world; / by an oblation in a khadira-wood fire with rice grains sprinkled with honey,

sanskrit_iast:
rājā vaśyo bhavecchīghraṃ mahālakṣmīśca varddhate /
bilvacchāyāmadhivasanbilvamiśrahaviṣyabhuk //
meaning:
राजा वश्यो भवेच्छीघ्रं महालक्ष्मीश्च वर्द्धते /
बिल्वच्छायामधिवसन्बिल्वमिश्रहविष्यभुक् //
text_mt: a king quickly becomes subjugated, and Mahālakṣmī increases. / Residing under the shade of a bilva tree and eating haviṣya mixed with bilva,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaratrayaṃ hutvā tatphalairathavāṃbujaiḥ /
sādhakendro mahālakṣmīṃ cakṣuṣā paśyati dhruvam //
meaning:
संवत्सरत्रयं हुत्वा तत्फलैरथवांबुजैः /
साधकेन्द्रो महालक्ष्मीं चक्षुषा पश्यति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: having offered oblations for three years with its fruits or with lotuses, / the best of practitioners certainly sees Mahālakṣmī with his own eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kalpāntare brahmandevarājyaviluṃpakau /
jātau śubhaniśuṃbhau dvāvasurau lokakaṇṭakau //
meaning:
अथ कल्पान्तरे ब्रह्मन्देवराज्यविलुंपकौ /
जातौ शुभनिशुंभौ द्वावसुरौ लोककण्टकौ //
text_mt: Then in another Kalpa, O brāhmaṇa, the two asuras Śumbha and Niśumbha, / destroyers of the kingdom of the gods and thorns to the worlds, were born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhraṣṭādhikāraistu śakrādyaiḥ saṃstutā mune /
mahāsarasvatī devī tadā cāvatatāra ha //
meaning:
ततो भ्रष्टाधिकारैस्तु शक्राद्यैः संस्तुता मुने /
महासरस्वती देवी तदा चावततार ह //
text_mt: Then, being praised by Śakra and the others who had fallen from their authority, O sage, / the goddess Mahāsarasvatī descended at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
himālaye mahāpuṇye śailoddeśe 'tiśobhane /
tataḥ śumbhādikānhatvā daivataiḥ paripūjitā //
meaning:
हिमालये महापुण्ये शैलोद्देशे ऽतिशोभने /
ततः शुम्भादिकान्हत्वा दैवतैः परिपूजिता //
text_mt: in the highly auspicious Himālayas, in a most beautiful mountain region. / Then, having slain Śumbha and the others, and being worshipped by the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ dattvāviśaddevī mānasaṃ nāma vai saraḥ /
tasyā mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahito munane //
meaning:
वरं दत्त्वाविशद्देवी मानसं नाम वै सरः /
तस्या मन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वावहितो मुनने //
text_mt: having granted a boon, the goddess entered the lake named Mānasa. / I will proclaim her mantra; listen attentively, O sage:

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāmṛtā śaśadharā krāntabhālopaśobhitā /
vāgbījaṃ tena cāṅgāni kalpayetsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानामृता शशधरा क्रान्तभालोपशोभिता /
वाग्बीजं तेन चाङ्गानि कल्पयेत्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: Nectar of knowledge, moon-bearing, adorned with a radiant forehead; / the speech-bīja [aim]: with it, the best practitioner should fashion the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ sadāśivaścāsya chando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam /
devatā vāksamākhyātā bhajatāmiṣṭadāyinī //
meaning:
ऋषिः सदाशिवश्चास्य छन्दो ऽनुष्टुबुदाहृतम् /
देवता वाक्समाख्याता भजतामिष्टदायिनी //
text_mt: Its ṛṣi is Sadāśiva, the metre is declared to be Anuṣṭubh, / the deity is spoken of as Vāc, bestowing the desired objects of those who worship her.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetāṃbarāṃ visaśvetāṃ vīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm /
divyairābharaṇairyuktāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nirantarām //
meaning:
श्वेतांबरां विसश्वेतां वीणापुस्तकधारिणीम् /
दिव्यैराभरणैर्युक्तां ध्यायेद्देवीं निरन्तराम् //
text_mt: Wearing white garments, white like a lotus-stalk, holding a vīṇā and a book, / endowed with divine ornaments, one should constantly meditate on the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsarasvatīpīṭhe mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet /
devīṃ saṃpūjayettasyāmaṅgādyāvaraṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
महासरस्वतीपीठे मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत् /
देवीं संपूजयेत्तस्यामङ्गाद्यावरणैः सह //
text_mt: On the seat of Mahāsarasvatī, one should form the image with the root-mantra; / one should worship the goddess upon it along with the enclosures beginning with the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ādāvaṅgāvṛtiḥ paścādaṃbikādyāḥsamīritāḥ /
dvitīyā mātṛbhiḥ proktā tṛtīyādyaṣṭaśaktibhiḥ //
meaning:
आदावङ्गावृतिः पश्चादंबिकाद्याःसमीरिताः /
द्वितीया मातृभिः प्रोक्ता तृतीयाद्यष्टशक्तिभिः //
text_mt: First is the enclosure of the limbs; next are declared to be Ambikā and the others; / the second is taught as being with the Mothers; the third with the eight powers and so on;

sanskrit_iast:
caturthī pañcamī proktā dvātriṃśacchaktibhaghiḥ punaḥ /
catuḥṣaṣṭyā smṛtā ṣaṣṭhī śaktibhirlokanāyakaiḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थी पञ्चमी प्रोक्ता द्वात्रिंशच्छक्तिभघिः पुनः /
चतुःषष्ट्या स्मृता षष्ठी शक्तिभिर्लोकनायकैः //
text_mt: the fourth and fifth are declared to be with thirty-two powers again; / the sixth is remembered as being with sixty-four powers, and with the leaders of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamī punareteṣāmastraiḥ syādaṣṭamāvṛtiḥ /
evaṃ pūjyā jagaddhātrī śrīmatī vāgbhavābhidhā //
meaning:
सप्तमी पुनरेतेषामस्त्रैः स्यादष्टमावृतिः /
एवं पूज्या जगद्धात्री श्रीमती वाग्भवाभिधा //
text_mt: The seventh [circuit] consists of them, and the eighth circuit is made of their weapons. / In this way, the bearer of the universe, named Śrīmatī Vāgbhavā, is to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāneṣu pūrvamukteṣu yajedaṅgāni sādhakaḥ /
ambikā vāgbhavā durgā śrīśaktiścoktalakṣaṇā //
meaning:
स्थानेषु पूर्वमुक्तेषु यजेदङ्गानि साधकः /
अम्बिका वाग्भवा दुर्गा श्रीशक्तिश्चोक्तलक्षणा //
text_mt: In the places previously spoken of, the practitioner should worship the limbs: / Ambikā, Vāgbhavā, Durgā, and Śrīśakti, having the described characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyāśca tataḥ pūjyāḥ karālī vikarālyumā /
sarasvatī śrīrdurgā ca lakṣmīścaiva dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्याश्च ततः पूज्याः कराली विकराल्युमा /
सरस्वती श्रीर्दुर्गा च लक्ष्मीश्चैव धृतिः स्मृतिः //
text_mt: Then Brahmā and the others are to be worshipped: Karālī, Vikarālī, Umā, / Sarasvatī, Śrī, Durgā, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Smṛti,

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā medhā ratiḥ kāntirāryā ṣoḍaśa śaktayaḥ /
khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇyaḥ śyāmāḥ pūjyāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
श्रद्धा मेधा रतिः कान्तिरार्या षोडश शक्तयः /
खड्गखेटकधारिण्यः श्यामाः पूज्याः स्वलङ्कृताः //
text_mt: Śraddhā, Medhā, Rati, Kānti, and Āryā—these are the sixteen energies. / Bearing swords and shields, dark-complexioned, and well-adorned, they are to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaghnī puṣṭayaḥ prajñā sinīvālī kuhūḥ punaḥ /
rudravīryā prabhā nandā poṣaṇā vṛddhidā śubhā //
meaning:
विषघ्नी पुष्टयः प्रज्ञा सिनीवाली कुहूः पुनः /
रुद्रवीर्या प्रभा नन्दा पोषणा वृद्धिदा शुभा //
text_mt: Viṣaghnī, Puṣṭi, Prajñā, Sinīvālī, then Kuhū, / Rudravīryā, Prabhā, Nandā, Poṣaṇā, Vṛddhidā, Śubhā,

sanskrit_iast:
kālarātrirmahārātrirbhadrakālī kapārdinī /
vikṛtirdaṇḍimuṇḍinyau seṃdukhaṇḍā śikhaṇḍinī //
meaning:
कालरात्रिर्महारात्रिर्भद्रकाली कपार्दिनी /
विकृतिर्दण्डिमुण्डिन्यौ सेंदुखण्डा शिखण्डिनी //
text_mt: Kālarātri, Mahārātri, Bhadrakālī, Kapardinī, / Vikṛti, Daṇḍinī, Muṇḍinī, Sendukhaṇḍā, Śikhaṇḍinī,

sanskrit_iast:
niśumbhamathanī caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī /
indrāṇī caiva rudrāṇī śaṅkarārddhaśarīriṇī //
meaning:
निशुम्भमथनी चण्डमुण्डविनाशिनी /
इन्द्राणी चैव रुद्राणी शङ्करार्द्धशरीरिणी //
text_mt: Niśumbhamathanī, Caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī, / Indrāṇī, Rudrāṇī, Śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
nārī nārāyaṇī caiva triśūlinyapi pālinī /
ambikā hradinī caiva dvātriṃśacchaktayaḥ sitāḥ //
meaning:
नारी नारायणी चैव त्रिशूलिन्यपि पालिनी /
अम्बिका ह्रदिनी चैव द्वात्रिंशच्छक्तयः सिताः //
text_mt: Nārī, Nārāyaṇī, Triśūlinī, Pālinī, / Ambikā, and Hradinī—these are the thirty-two white energies.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrahastāḥ piśācāsyāḥ saṃpūjyāścārubhūṣaṇāḥ /
piṅgalākṣī viśālākṣī samṛddhirbuddhireva ca //
meaning:
चक्रहस्ताः पिशाचास्याः संपूज्याश्चारुभूषणाः /
पिङ्गलाक्षी विशालाक्षी समृद्धिर्बुद्धिरेव च //
text_mt: Discus in hand, with faces of piśācas, and having beautiful ornaments, they should be worshipped; [then:] Piṅgalākṣī, Viśālākṣī, Samṛddhi, Buddhi,

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā svāhā svadhā bhikṣā māyā saṃjñā vasuṃdharā /
trilokadhātrī gāyatrī sāvitrī tridaśeśvarī //
meaning:
श्रद्धा स्वाहा स्वधा भिक्षा माया संज्ञा वसुंधरा /
त्रिलोकधात्री गायत्री सावित्री त्रिदशेश्वरी //
text_mt: Śraddhā, Svāhā, Svadhā, Bhikṣā, Māyā, Saṃjñā, Vasundharā, / Trilokadhātrī, Gāyatrī, Sāvitrī, Tridaśeśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarūpā bahurūpā ca skandamātā śrutapriyā /
vimalā kamalā paścādaruṇī punarāruṇī //
meaning:
सरूपा बहुरूपा च स्कन्दमाता श्रुतप्रिया /
विमला कमला पश्चादरुणी पुनरारुणी //
text_mt: Sarūpā, Bahurūpā, Skandamātā, Śrutapriyā, / Vimalā, Kamalā, then Aruṇī, and again Āruṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtirvikṛtiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ saṃhṛtireva ca /
sandhyā mātā satī haṃsī mardikā vajrikā parā //
meaning:
प्रकृतिर्विकृतिः सृष्टिः स्थितिः संहृतिरेव च /
सन्ध्या माता सती हंसी मर्दिका वज्रिका परा //
text_mt: Prakṛti, Vikṛti, Sṛṣṭi, Sthiti, Saṃhṛti, / Sandhyā, Mātā, Satī, Haṃsī, Mardikā, Vajrikā, Parā,

sanskrit_iast:
devamātā bhagavatī devakī kamalāsanā /
trimukhī saptavadanā surāsuravimarddinī //
meaning:
देवमाता भगवती देवकी कमलासना /
त्रिमुखी सप्तवदना सुरासुरविमर्द्दिनी //
text_mt: Devamātā, Bhagavatī, Devakī, Kamalāsanā, / Trimukhī, Saptavadanā, Surāsuravimardinī,

sanskrit_iast:
laṃboṣṭhī corddvakeśī ca bahuśiśnā vṛkodarī /
ratharekhāhvayā paścācchaśirekhā tathāparā //
meaning:
लंबोष्ठी चोर्द्द्वकेशी च बहुशिश्ना वृकोदरी /
रथरेखाह्वया पश्चाच्छशिरेखा तथापरा //
text_mt: Lamboṣṭhī, Ūrdhvakeśī, Bahuśiśnā, Vṛkodarī, / she named Ratharekhā, then Śaśirekhā, and another:

sanskrit_iast:
gaganavegā pavanavegā vegā ca tadanantaram /
tato bhuvanapālākhyā tataḥ syānmadanāturā //
meaning:
गगनवेगा पवनवेगा वेगा च तदनन्तरम् /
ततो भुवनपालाख्या ततः स्यान्मदनातुरा //
text_mt: Gaganavegā, Pavanavegā, immediately after Vegā, / then she named Bhuvanapālā, then there is Madanāturā,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgānaṅgavadanā tathaivānaṅgamekhalā /
anaṅgakusumā viśvarūpā surabhayaṅkarī //
meaning:
अनङ्गानङ्गवदना तथैवानङ्गमेखला /
अनङ्गकुसुमा विश्वरूपा सुरभयङ्करी //
text_mt: Anaṅgā, Anaṅgavadanā, likewise Anaṅgamekhalā, / Anaṅgakusumā, Viśvarūpā, Surabhayaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣobhyā saptavāhinyā vajrārūpā śucivratāḥ /
varadākhyātha vāgīśī catuḥṣaṣṭiḥsamīritāḥ //
meaning:
अक्षोभ्या सप्तवाहिन्या वज्रारूपा शुचिव्रताः /
वरदाख्याथ वागीशी चतुःषष्टिःसमीरिताः //
text_mt: Akṣobhyā, Saptavāhinyā, Vajrārūpā, Śucivratāḥ, / she named Varadā, then Vāgīśī—these sixty-four are declared.

sanskrit_iast:
cāpabāṇadharāḥ sarvā jvālājihvā mahāprabhāḥ /
daṃṣṭriṇyaścorddhvakeśyastā yuddhopakrāntamānasāḥ //
meaning:
चापबाणधराः सर्वा ज्वालाजिह्वा महाप्रभाः /
दंष्ट्रिण्यश्चोर्द्ध्वकेश्यस्ता युद्धोपक्रान्तमानसाः //
text_mt: All bearing bows and arrows, with tongues of flame, exceedingly radiant, / with fangs, their hair standing upright, their minds resolved on battle,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃdīptā pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ /
lokeśāḥ pūrvavatpūjyāstadvadvajrādikānyapi //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंदीप्ता पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नतः /
लोकेशाः पूर्ववत्पूज्यास्तद्वद्वज्रादिकान्यपि //
text_mt: blazing with all ornaments, they are to be worshipped with effort. / The guardians of the worlds are to be worshipped as before, and likewise their weapons such as the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
japetṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ ca taddaśāṃśaṃ hunetsudhīḥ /
ājyena khādire vahnau tataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥ //
meaning:
जपेत्षोडशलक्षं च तद्दशांशं हुनेत्सुधीः /
आज्येन खादिरे वह्नौ ततः सिद्धो भवेन्मनुः //
text_mt: The wise man should recite [the mantra] one million six hundred thousand times and offer in oblation a tenth part of that / with clarified butter into a fire of khadira wood; then the mantra becomes perfected.

sanskrit_iast:
kamalairayutaṃ hutvā rājānaṃ vaśamānayet /
utpalairjuhvato nūnaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ prajāyate //
meaning:
कमलैरयुतं हुत्वा राजानं वशमानयेत् /
उत्पलैर्जुह्वतो नूनं महालक्ष्मीः प्रजायते //
text_mt: Offering ten thousand oblations with lotuses, he brings a king under his subjugation; / for one offering oblations with blue water-lilies, Mahālakṣmī surely arises.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśakusumairhutvā vatsareṇa kaṃvirbhavet /
rājīlavaṇahomena vanitāṃ vaśamānayet //
meaning:
पलाशकुसुमैर्हुत्वा वत्सरेण कंविर्भवेत् /
राजीलवणहोमेन वनितां वशमानयेत् //
text_mt: Offering oblations with palāśa flowers, he becomes a poet within a year; / with an oblation of rājī and salt, he brings a woman under subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau bhogāṃstu bhuktvānte viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt /
vāṇībījajapāśakto nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
iti śrībṛhannāradīcayapuraṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde devīmantranirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
भूमौ भोगांस्तु भुक्त्वान्ते विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् /
वाणीबीजजपाशक्तो नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीचयपुरणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे देवीमन्त्रनिरूपणं नाम चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having enjoyed pleasures on earth, in the end he attains the realm of Viṣṇu. / For one capable of reciting the seed-syllable of the goddess of speech, no doubt should be entertained here.

Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Mantra of the Goddess', in the Third Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
vāgdevatā vatāro 'nyaḥ kāliketi prakīrtitā /
tasyā mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
वाग्देवता वतारो ऽन्यः कालिकेति प्रकीर्तिता /
तस्या मन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Another incarnation of the goddess of speech is celebrated as Kālikā; / I shall proclaim her mantra, which bestows enjoyment and liberation upon mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭikriyānvitā śāntirbidvāḍhyā ca tridhā punaḥ /
aruṇākṣyādīpikā ca binduyuktā dvidhā tataḥ //
meaning:
सृष्टिक्रियान्विता शान्तिर्बिद्वाढ्या च त्रिधा पुनः /
अरुणाक्ष्यादीपिका च बिन्दुयुक्ता द्विधा ततः //
text_mt: Śānti combined with the activity of creation, endowed with a dot, three times; / then Aruṇākṣī and Dīpikā, endowed with a dot, twice;

sanskrit_iast:
māyādvayaṃ tataḥ paścāddakṣiṇe kālike padam /
punaśca saptabījāni svāhānto 'yaṃ manūttamaḥ //
meaning:
मायाद्वयं ततः पश्चाद्दक्षिणे कालिके पदम् /
पुनश्च सप्तबीजानि स्वाहान्तो ऽयं मनूत्तमः //
text_mt: after that, two māyā-seeds, then the phrase 'dakṣiṇe kālike', / and again seven seed-syllables, ending with 'svāhā'—this is the supreme mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavo 'sya ṛṣiśchanda uṣṇikkālī tu devatā /
bījaṃ māyādīrghavartma śaktiruktā munīśvara //
meaning:
भैरवो ऽस्य ऋषिश्छन्द उष्णिक्काली तु देवता /
बीजं मायादीर्घवर्त्म शक्तिरुक्ता मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: Bhairava is its seer; the metre is Uṣṇih; Kālī is the deity; / the seed-syllable is Māyā; Dīrghavartmā is declared as the energy, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrdhāḍhye bījena vidyāyā aṅgamīritam /
mātṛkārṇāndaśa daśa hṛdaye bhujayoḥ padoḥ //
meaning:
षड्दीर्धाढ्ये बीजेन विद्याया अङ्गमीरितम् /
मातृकार्णान्दश दश हृदये भुजयोः पदोः //
text_mt: With the seed-syllable endowed with the six long vowels, the limb-structure of the vidyā is proclaimed. / Ten syllables of the alphabet each [are to be placed] on the heart, on the two arms, on the two feet;

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasya vyāpakaṃ kuryānmūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ /
śiraḥ kṛpāṇamabhayaṃ varaṃ hastaiśca bibhratīm //
meaning:
विन्यस्य व्यापकं कुर्यान्मूलमन्त्रेण साधकः /
शिरः कृपाणमभयं वरं हस्तैश्च बिभ्रतीम् //
text_mt: Having placed [them], the practitioner should perform the pervasive ritual placement with the root mantra, / [meditating on her] bearing in her hands a head, a sword, the gesture of fearlessness, and the boon-granting gesture,

sanskrit_iast:
muṇḍasraṅmastakāṃ muktakeśāṃ pitṛvanastitām /
sarvālaṅkṛtavarṇāṃ ca śyāmāṅgīṃ kālikāṃ smaret //
meaning:
मुण्डस्रङ्मस्तकां मुक्तकेशां पितृवनस्तिताम् /
सर्वालङ्कृतवर्णां च श्यामाङ्गीं कालिकां स्मरेत् //
text_mt: Her head garlanded with severed skulls, her hair dishevelled, situated in the cremation ground, / endowed with every ornamental attribute, dark-limbed Kālikā he should recall.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ juhuyādayutaṃ tataḥ /
prasūnaiḥ karavīrotthaiḥ pūjāyantramathocyate //
meaning:
एवं ध्यात्वा जपेल्लक्षं जुहुयादयुतं ततः /
प्रसूनैः करवीरोत्थैः पूजायन्त्रमथोच्यते //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, he should recite a hundred thousand times, and then offer ten thousand fire oblations / with blossoms of the karavīra flower. Next, the diagram of worship is described.

sanskrit_iast:
vilikhya pūrvaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ trikoṇatritayaṃ tataḥ /
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye bhūpuraṃ tatra pūjayet //
meaning:
विलिख्य पूर्वं षट्कोणं त्रिकोणत्रितयं ततः /
पद्ममष्टदलं बाह्ये भूपुरं तत्र पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having drawn first a six-pointed figure, and then a group of three triangles, / an eight-petalled lotus outside, and a bhūpura there, he should worship [the deities].

sanskrit_iast:
jayā ca vijayā cāpi ajitā cāparājitā /
nityā vilāsinī vāpi dogdhyaghorā ca maṅgalā //
meaning:
जया च विजया चापि अजिता चापराजिता /
नित्या विलासिनी वापि दोग्ध्यघोरा च मङ्गला //
text_mt: Jayā, Vijayā, Ajitā, and Aparājitā, / Nityā, Vilāsinī, Dogdhryaghorā, and Maṅgalā:

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhasya śaktayo māyātmane hṛtpīṭhamantrakaḥ /
śivarūpaśavaśthāṃ ca śivābhirdikṣu veṣṭitām //
meaning:
पीठस्य शक्तयो मायात्मने हृत्पीठमन्त्रकः /
शिवरूपशवश्थां च शिवाभिर्दिक्षु वेष्टिताम् //
text_mt: These are the powers of the ritual seat; the heart-mantra of the ritual seat belongs to the nature of Māyā. / [Meditating on her] seated on a corpse in the form of Śiva, surrounded in all directions by jackals,

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālaratāsaktāṃ dhyātvāṅgānyarcayetpurā /
kālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīm //
meaning:
महाकालरतासक्तां ध्यात्वाङ्गान्यर्चयेत्पुरा /
कालीं कपालिनीं कुल्लां कुरुकुल्लां विरोधिनीम् //
text_mt: Engaged in amorous union with Mahākāla, he should first worship the limbs; / then Kāli, Kapālinī, Kullā, Kurukullā, Virodhinī,

sanskrit_iast:
vipracittāṃ ca ṣaṭkoṇe navakoṇe tator'cayet /
ugrāmuṣṇaprabhāṃ dīptāṃ nīlādhānāṃ balākikām //
meaning:
विप्रचित्तां च षट्कोणे नवकोणे ततोर्ऽचयेत् /
उग्रामुष्णप्रभां दीप्तां नीलाधानां बलाकिकाम् //
text_mt: And Vipracittā in the six-pointed figure; then in the nine-pointed figure he should worship / Ugrā, Uṣṇaprabhā, Dīptā, Nīlādhānā, Balākikā,

sanskrit_iast:
mātrāṃ mudrāṃ tathā mitrāṃ pūjyāḥ patreṣu mātaraḥ /
padmasyāsya suyatnena brāhmī nārāyaṇītyapi //
meaning:
मात्रां मुद्रां तथा मित्रां पूज्याः पत्रेषु मातरः /
पद्मस्यास्य सुयत्नेन ब्राह्मी नारायणीत्यपि //
text_mt: Mātrā, Mudrā, and likewise Mitrā. The mothers are to be worshipped on the petals / of this lotus with great effort: Brāhmī, Nārāyaṇī as well,

sanskrit_iast:
māheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā kaumārī cāparājitā /
vārāhī nārasiṃhā ca punaretāstu bhūpure //
meaning:
माहेश्वरी च चामुण्डा कौमारी चापराजिता /
वाराही नारसिंहा च पुनरेतास्तु भूपुरे //
text_mt: Māheśvarī, Cāmuṇḍā, Kaumārī, Aparājitā, / Vārāhī, and Nārasiṃhī; and then these in the bhūpura:

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavīṃ mahadādyāṃ tāṃ siṃhādyāṃ dhūmrapūrvikām /
bhīmonmattādikāṃ cāpi vaśīkaraṇabhairavīm //
meaning:
भैरवीं महदाद्यां तां सिंहाद्यां धूम्रपूर्विकाम् /
भीमोन्मत्तादिकां चापि वशीकरणभैरवीम् //
text_mt: Bhairavī beginning with Mahat, Siṃhādyā, Dhūmrapūrvikā, / Bhīmonmattādikā as well, and Vaśīkaraṇabhairavī,

sanskrit_iast:
mohanādyāṃ samārādhya śakrādīnyāyudhānyapi /
evamārādhitā kālī siddhā bhavati mantriṇām //
meaning:
मोहनाद्यां समाराध्य शक्रादीन्यायुधान्यपि /
एवमाराधिता काली सिद्धा भवति मन्त्रिणाम् //
text_mt: And worshiping the one beginning with Mohana, along with Indra and the others and the weapons. / Worshipped in this manner, Kālī becomes accomplished for practitioners of mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prayogānkurvīta mahābhairavabhāṣitān /
ātmano vā parasyārthaṃ kṣiprasiddhipradāyakān //
meaning:
ततः प्रयोगान्कुर्वीत महाभैरवभाषितान् /
आत्मनो वा परस्यार्थं क्षिप्रसिद्धिप्रदायकान् //
text_mt: Then he may perform the ritual applications proclaimed by Mahābhairava, / which grant swift accomplishment for oneself or for another's sake.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāṃ prahāraṃ nindāṃ ca kauṭilyaṃ vāpriyaṃ vacaḥ /
ātmano hitamanvicchan kālībhakto vivarjayet //
meaning:
स्त्रीणां प्रहारं निन्दां च कौटिल्यं वाप्रियं वचः /
आत्मनो हितमन्विच्छन् कालीभक्तो विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Beating women, speaking ill of them, deceit, or unpleasant speech— / seeking his own welfare, a devotee of Kālī must avoid these.

sanskrit_iast:
sudṛśo madanāvāsaṃ paśyanyaḥ prajapenmanum /
ayutaṃ so 'cirādeva vākpateḥ samatāmiyāt //
meaning:
सुदृशो मदनावासं पश्यन्यः प्रजपेन्मनुम् /
अयुतं सो ऽचिरादेव वाक्पतेः समतामियात् //
text_mt: Looking upon the abode of love of a fair-eyed woman, whoever recites the mantra / ten thousand times would quickly attain equality with the lord of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
digambaro muktakeśaḥ śmaśānastho 'dhiyāmini /
japedyo 'yutametasya bhaveyuḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
दिगम्बरो मुक्तकेशः श्मशानस्थो ऽधियामिनि /
जपेद्यो ऽयुतमेतस्य भवेयुः सर्वसिद्धयः //
text_mt: Sky-clad, with dishevelled hair, standing in a cremation ground in the dead of night, / whoever recites ten thousand times—to him all accomplishments shall belong.

sanskrit_iast:
śavasya hṛdaye sthitvā nirvāsāḥ pretabhūmigaḥ /
arkapuṣpasahasreṇābhyaktena svīyaretasā //
meaning:
शवस्य हृदये स्थित्वा निर्वासाः प्रेतभूमिगः /
अर्कपुष्पसहस्रेणाभ्यक्तेन स्वीयरेतसा //
text_mt: Standing upon the heart of a corpse, naked, gone to the cemetery, / with a thousand arka flowers anointed with his own semen,

sanskrit_iast:
devīṃ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā japannekaikaśo manum /
so 'careṇaiva kālena dharaṇīprabhutāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
देवीं यः पूजयेद्भक्त्या जपन्नेकैकशो मनुम् /
सो ऽचरेणैव कालेन धरणीप्रभुतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Whoever worships the goddess with devotion, reciting the mantra one by one, / would attain sovereignty over the earth in no time at all.

sanskrit_iast:
rajaḥ kīrṇaṃ bhagaṃ nāryā dhyāyanyo hyayutaṃ japet /
sakavitvena ramyeṇa janānmohayati dhruvam //
meaning:
रजः कीर्णं भगं नार्या ध्यायन्यो ह्ययुतं जपेत् /
सकवित्वेन रम्येण जनान्मोहयति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Meditating on a woman’s vulva filled with menstrual fluid, whoever recites ten thousand times / surely bewilders people with delightful poetic skill.

sanskrit_iast:
tripañcāre mahāpīṭhe śivasya hṛdi saṃsthitām /
mahākālena devena mārayuddhaṃ prakurvatīm //
meaning:
त्रिपञ्चारे महापीठे शिवस्य हृदि संस्थिताम् /
महाकालेन देवेन मारयुद्धं प्रकुर्वतीम् //
text_mt: Situated on the great seat of fifteen spokes upon the heart of Śiva, / engaged in erotic combat with the god Mahākāla,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dhyāyansmeravadanāṃ vidadhatsurataṃ svayam /
japetsahasramapi yaḥ sa śaṅkarasamo bhavet //
meaning:
तां ध्यायन्स्मेरवदनां विदधत्सुरतं स्वयम् /
जपेत्सहस्रमपि यः स शङ्करसमो भवेत् //
text_mt: Meditating on her with a smiling face while personally engaging in intercourse, / whoever recites even a thousand times becomes equal to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
asthilomatvacāyuktaṃ māṃsaṃ mārjārameṣayoḥ /
uṣṭrasya mahiṣasyāpi baliṃ yastu samarpayet //
meaning:
अस्थिलोमत्वचायुक्तं मांसं मार्जारमेषयोः /
उष्ट्रस्य महिषस्यापि बलिं यस्तु समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: Offering as an oblation flesh accompanied by bones, hair, and skin / of a cat, a ram, a camel, or a buffalo,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāṣṭamyormadhyarātre vaśyāḥ syustasya jantavaḥ /
vidyālakṣmīyaśaḥputraiḥ sa ciraṃ sukhamedhate //
meaning:
भूताष्टम्योर्मध्यरात्रे वश्याः स्युस्तस्य जन्तवः /
विद्यालक्ष्मीयशःपुत्रैः स चिरं सुखमेधते //
text_mt: At midnight on the fourteenth or eighth lunar day, living beings will be subdued by him; / he thrives happily for a long time with knowledge, fortune, fame, and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
yo haviṣyāśanarato divā devīṃ smaran japet /
naktaṃ nidhuvanāsakto lakṣaṃ sa syāddharāpatiḥ //
meaning:
यो हविष्याशनरतो दिवा देवीं स्मरन् जपेत् /
नक्तं निधुवनासक्तो लक्षं स स्याद्धरापतिः //
text_mt: Whoever, devoted to eating sacrificial offerings, recites recalling the goddess by day, / and is devoted to lovemaking by night, [for] a hundred thousand times, becomes an earthly ruler.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṃbhojairhunenmantrī dhanairjayati vittapam /
bilvapatrairbhavedrājyaṃ raktapuṣpairvaśīkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
रक्तांभोजैर्हुनेन्मन्त्री धनैर्जयति वित्तपम् /
बिल्वपत्रैर्भवेद्राज्यं रक्तपुष्पैर्वशीकृतिः //
text_mt: Offering oblations with red lotuses, the practitioner of mantras surpasses Kubera in wealth; / with bilva leaves comes kingship, and with red flowers comes subjugation.

sanskrit_iast:
asṛjī mahiṣādīnāṃ kālikāṃ yastu tarpayet /
tasya syuracirādeva karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
असृजी महिषादीनां कालिकां यस्तु तर्पयेत् /
तस्य स्युरचिरादेव करस्थाः सर्वसिद्धयः //
text_mt: Whoever satisfies Kālikā with the blood of buffaloes and the like, / in his hands all accomplishments shall swiftly rest.

sanskrit_iast:
yo lakṣaṃ prajapenmantraṃ śavamāruhya mantravit /
tasya siddho manuḥ sadyaḥ sarvepsitaphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
यो लक्षं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं शवमारुह्य मन्त्रवित् /
तस्य सिद्धो मनुः सद्यः सर्वेप्सितफलप्रदः //
text_mt: Whoever, knowing the mantras, recites the mantra a hundred thousand times having mounted a corpse, / for him the mantra is instantly accomplished, yielding all desired fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāśvamedhapramukhairyāgauriṣṭaṃ sujanmanā /
dattaṃ dānaṃ tapastaptaṃ upāste yastu kālikām //
meaning:
तेनाश्वमेधप्रमुखैर्यागौरिष्टं सुजन्मना /
दत्तं दानं तपस्तप्तं उपास्ते यस्तु कालिकाम् //
text_mt: By him sacrifices headed by the horse sacrifice have been offered, he of noble birth; / gifts have been given, austerities practiced by him who worships Kālikā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivo gaurī lakṣmīrgaṇapatī raviḥ /
pūjitāḥ sakalā devā yaḥ kālīṃ pūjayetsadā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुः शिवो गौरी लक्ष्मीर्गणपती रविः /
पूजिताः सकला देवा यः कालीं पूजयेत्सदा //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Gaurī, Lakṣmī, Gaṇapati, and the Sun— / all gods are worshipped by him who constantly worships Kālī.

sanskrit_iast:
athāparaḥ sarasvatyā hyavatāro nigadyate /
yāṃ niṣevya narā loke kṛtārthāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अथापरः सरस्वत्या ह्यवतारो निगद्यते /
यां निषेव्य नरा लोके कृतार्थाः स्युर्न संशयः //
text_mt: Now another incarnation of Sarasvatī is proclaimed, / by serving whom men in the world become fulfilled, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyinī candrayuktā māyā ca vadanāntare /
sakāmikā krudhā śāntiścandrālaṅkṛtamastakā //
meaning:
आप्यायिनी चन्द्रयुक्ता माया च वदनान्तरे /
सकामिका क्रुधा शान्तिश्चन्द्रालङ्कृतमस्तका //
text_mt: Āpyāyinī joined with the moon, and Māyā in the middle of the mouth, / Sakāmikā, with anger, Śānti adorned with the moon on her head,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpikā sāsanā candrayugastraṃ manurīritaḥ /
munirakṣobhya uddiṣṭaśchandastu bṛhatī matam //
meaning:
दीपिका सासना चन्द्रयुगस्त्रं मनुरीरितः /
मुनिरक्षोभ्य उद्दिष्टश्छन्दस्तु बृहती मतम् //
text_mt: Dīpikā seated, the two moons, and the weapon: the mantra is stated. / The sage is declared to be Akṣobhya, and the meter is regarded as Bṛhatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tārākhyā devatā bījaṃ dvitīyañca caturthakam /
śaktiḥ ṣaḍdīrghayuktena dvitīyenāṅgakalpanam //
meaning:
ताराख्या देवता बीजं द्वितीयञ्च चतुर्थकम् /
शक्तिः षड्दीर्घयुक्तेन द्वितीयेनाङ्गकल्पनम् //
text_mt: The deity is called Tārā; the second is the seed-syllable, and the fourth / is the power; the arrangement of the limbs is performed with the second [syllable] joined with the six long [vowels].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍhā nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttārāyāḥ sarvasiddhim /
śrīkaṇṭhādīnnyasedrudrānmātṛkāvarṇapūrvakān //
meaning:
षोढा न्यासं ततः कुर्यात्तारायाः सर्वसिद्धिम् /
श्रीकण्ठादीन्न्यसेद्रुद्रान्मातृकावर्णपूर्वकान् //
text_mt: Then he should perform the sixfold ritual placement of Tārā, which yields all accomplishments. / He should place the Rudras beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha preceded by the letters of the alphabet,

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkoktasthale māyā tṛtīyakrodhapūrvakān /
caturthīnamasāyuktānprathamo nyāsa īritaḥ //
meaning:
मातृकोक्तस्थले माया तृतीयक्रोधपूर्वकान् /
चतुर्थीनमसायुक्तान्प्रथमो न्यास ईरितः //
text_mt: At the places stated for the alphabet, preceded by Māyā, the third [syllable], and Krodha, / and accompanied by the dative case and namas; this is declared as the first ritual placement.

sanskrit_iast:
śavapīṭhasamāsīnāṃ nīlakāntiṃ trilocanām /
arddhenduśekharāṃ nānābhūṣaṇāḍhyāṃ smarannyaset //
meaning:
शवपीठसमासीनां नीलकान्तिं त्रिलोचनाम् /
अर्द्धेन्दुशेखरां नानाभूषणाढ्यां स्मरन्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Seated upon a corpse-seat, blue-complexioned, three-eyed, / crested with the crescent moon, adorned with various ornaments—recalling her, he should place [them].

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye tu grahanyāsaṃ kuryāttāṃ samanusmaran /
tribījasvarapūrvaṃ tu raktasūya hṛdi nyaset //
meaning:
द्वितीये तु ग्रहन्यासं कुर्यात्तां समनुस्मरन् /
त्रिबीजस्वरपूर्वं तु रक्तसूय हृदि न्यसेत् //
text_mt: In the second, he should perform the ritual placement of planets, remembering her well: / preceded by the three seed-syllables and vowels, he should place the red Sun in the heart;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pavargapūrvaṃ tu śuklaṃ lomaṃ bhruvodveye /
kavargapūrvaṃ raktābhaṃ maṅgalaṃ locanatrayam //
meaning:
तथा पवर्गपूर्वं तु शुक्लं लोमं भ्रुवोद्वेये /
कवर्गपूर्वं रक्ताभं मङ्गलं लोचनत्रयम् //
text_mt: Likewise, preceded by the pa-class [of consonants], the white Moon on both eyebrows; / preceded by the ka-class, the red-hued Mars on the triad of eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
cavargādyaṃ budhaṃ śyāmaṃ nyasedvakṣaghasthale budhaḥ /
ḍhavargādyaṃ pītavarṇaṃ kaṭhṇakūpe bṛhaspatim //
meaning:
चवर्गाद्यं बुधं श्यामं न्यसेद्वक्षघस्थले बुधः /
ढवर्गाद्यं पीतवर्णं कठ्णकूपे बृहस्पतिम् //
text_mt: Preceded by the ca-class, the wise man should place dark Mercury on the chest; / preceded by the ḍha-class, yellow Jupiter in the throat-well;

sanskrit_iast:
tavargādyaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ghaṭikāyāṃ tu bhārgavam /
nīlavarṇaṃ pavargādyaṃ nābhideśe śanaiścaram //
meaning:
तवर्गाद्यं श्वेतवर्णं घटिकायां तु भार्गवम् /
नीलवर्णं पवर्गाद्यं नाभिदेशे शनैश्चरम् //
text_mt: Preceded by the ta-class, white Venus in the nape of the neck; / preceded by the pa-class, blue-colored Saturn in the region of the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
śavargādyaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyātvā rāhuṃ mukhe nyaset /
tribījapūrvakaścaivaṃ grahanyāsaḥ samīritaḥ //
meaning:
शवर्गाद्यं धूम्रवर्णं ध्यात्वा राहुं मुखे न्यसेत् /
त्रिबीजपूर्वकश्चैवं ग्रहन्यासः समीरितः //
text_mt: Preceded by the śa-class, meditating on smoke-colored Rāhu, he should place him in the mouth. / Thus the ritual placement of planets preceded by the three seed-syllables is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ lokapālānāṃ nyāsaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ /
māyādibījatritayapūrvakaṃ sarvasiddhaye //
meaning:
तृतीयं लोकपालानां न्यासं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः /
मायादिबीजत्रितयपूर्वकं सर्वसिद्धये //
text_mt: Thirdly, he should carefully perform the ritual placement of the world guardians, / preceded by the triad of seed-syllables beginning with Māyā, for all accomplishments,

sanskrit_iast:
svamastake lalāṭādi dikṣvaṣṭasvadhaurddhvataḥ /
hrasvadīrghakādikāṣṭavargapūrvāndiśādhipān //
meaning:
स्वमस्तके ललाटादि दिक्ष्वष्टस्वधौर्द्ध्वतः /
ह्रस्वदीर्घकादिकाष्टवर्गपूर्वान्दिशाधिपान् //
text_mt: On his own head, forehead, and so forth, in the eight directions, below, and above— / the regents of the directions preceded by the short, long, and the eight classes beginning with ka.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktyabhidhe nyāsaṃ caturthe tu samācaret /
tribījapūrvakānnyasyetṣaṭśivāñchaktisaṃyutān //
meaning:
शिवशक्त्यभिधे न्यासं चतुर्थे तु समाचरेत् /
त्रिबीजपूर्वकान्न्यस्येत्षट्शिवाञ्छक्तिसंयुतान् //
text_mt: In the fourth, he should perform the ritual placement named after Śiva and Śakti: / preceded by the three seed-syllables, he should place the six Śivas accompanied by their powers,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārādiṣu cakreṣu svacakravarṇapūrvakān /
brahmāṇaṃ ḍākinīyuktaṃ vādisāṃtārṇapūrvakam //
meaning:
आधारादिषु चक्रेषु स्वचक्रवर्णपूर्वकान् /
ब्रह्माणं डाकिनीयुक्तं वादिसांतार्णपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: In the cakras beginning with the mūlādhāra, preceded by the syllables of their respective cakras: / Brahmā joined with Ḍākinī, preceded by the letters from va to sa,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlādhāre vinyasecca caturddalasamanvitam /
śrīviṣṇuṃ rākiṇīyuktabādilāntārṇapūrvakam //
meaning:
मूलाधारे विन्यसेच्च चतुर्द्दलसमन्वितम् /
श्रीविष्णुं राकिणीयुक्तबादिलान्तार्णपूर्वकम् //
