text_mt: Chinnamastā; Ramā is said to be the seed; svāhā the power. / āṃ khaḍgāya is declared to be the heart; īṃ khaḍgāya is remembered as the head;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ vajrāya śikhā proktā aiṃ pāśāya tanucchadam /
aumaṅkuśāya netraṃ syādvisargo vasurakṣayuk //
meaning:
ओं वज्राय शिखा प्रोक्ता ऐं पाशाय तनुच्छदम् /
औमङ्कुशाय नेत्रं स्याद्विसर्गो वसुरक्षयुक् //
text_mt: oṃ vajrāya is said to be the crown; aiṃ pāśāya the armor; / auṃ aṅkuśāya is the eye; the visarga conjoined with eight protections,

sanskrit_iast:
māyāyugmaṃ cāstramaṅgaṃ manavaḥ praṇavādikāḥ /
svāhāntāścaivamaṅgāni kṛtvā dhyāyedthāṃbikām //
meaning:
मायायुग्मं चास्त्रमङ्गं मनवः प्रणवादिकाः /
स्वाहान्ताश्चैवमङ्गानि कृत्वा ध्यायेद्थांबिकाम् //
text_mt: And the pair of Māyās is the weapon-limb; the mantras begin with the praṇava / and end with svāhā. Having thus performed the limbs, one should meditate upon the Mother:

sanskrit_iast:
bhānumaṇḍalasaṃsthānāṃ pravikīrṇālakaṃ śiraḥ /
chinnaṃ svakaṃ sphaāramukhaṃ svaraktaṃ prapibadgalat //
meaning:
भानुमण्डलसंस्थानां प्रविकीर्णालकं शिरः /
छिन्नं स्वकं स्फआरमुखं स्वरक्तं प्रपिबद्गलत् //
text_mt: Standing in the orb of the sun, her severed head having disheveled locks of hair, / with a wide open mouth, drinking her own blood dripping down [from her neck],

sanskrit_iast:
uparisthāṃ ratāsaktaratimanmathayornije /
ḍākinīvarṇinīsakhyau dṛṣṭvā modabharākulām //
meaning:
उपरिस्थां रतासक्तरतिमन्मथयोर्निजे /
डाकिनीवर्णिनीसख्यौ दृष्ट्वा मोदभराकुलाम् //
text_mt: Standing upon Rati and Manmatha, who are engaged in lovemaking; / seeing her two companions, Ḍākinī and Varṇinī, overcome with intense delight.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ prajapellakṣacatuṣkaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ /
pālāśairvilvajairvāpi juhuyātkusumaiḥ phalaiḥ //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं प्रजपेल्लक्षचतुष्कं तद्दशांशतः /
पालाशैर्विल्वजैर्वापि जुहुयात्कुसुमैः फलैः //
text_mt: Having thus meditated, one should recite four hundred thousand times, and as a tenth part of that, / one should offer fire oblations with blossoms and fruits of the palāśa or the bilva.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktimārabhya paratattvāntapūjite /
pīṭhe jayākhyā vijayā jitā cāpi parājitā //
meaning:
आधारशक्तिमारभ्य परतत्त्वान्तपूजिते /
पीठे जयाख्या विजया जिता चापि पराजिता //
text_mt: On the ritual seat, worshiped starting from the base-energy up to the supreme principle, / Jayā, Vijayā, Jitā, and Aparājitā,

sanskrit_iast:
nityā vilāsinī ṣaṣṭhī dogdhya ghorā ca maṅgalā /
dikṣu madhye ca saṃpūjyā nava pīṭhasya śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
नित्या विलासिनी षष्ठी दोग्ध्य घोरा च मङ्गला /
दिक्षु मध्ये च संपूज्या नव पीठस्य शक्तयः //
text_mt: Nityā, Vilāsinī, the sixth Dogdhrī, Aghorā, and Maṅgalā: / these nine energies of the ritual seat are to be worshiped in the directions and in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabuddhiprade varṇanīye sarvabhṛguḥ sadṛk /
siddhiprade ḍākinīye tāro vajraḥ sabhautikaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वबुद्धिप्रदे वर्णनीये सर्वभृगुः सदृक् /
सिद्धिप्रदे डाकिनीये तारो वज्रः सभौतिकः //
text_mt: "sarvabuddhiprade varṇanīye", "sarva", Bhṛgu accompanied by the eye, / "siddhiprade ḍākinīye", the tārā, the thunderbolt together with the elemental,

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgīśo rocanīyente bhagaṃ dhehi namontakaḥ /
tārādipīṭhamantro 'yaṃ vedarāmākṣaro mataḥ //
meaning:
खड्गीशो रोचनीयेन्ते भगं धेहि नमोन्तकः /
तारादिपीठमन्त्रो ऽयं वेदरामाक्षरो मतः //
text_mt: "khaḍgīśo rocanīye", at the end, "bhagaṃ dhehi", terminating in "namaḥ". / This ritual-seat mantra beginning with the tārā is considered to have thirty-four syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
samarpyāsanametena tatra saṃpūjayecchivām /
trikoṇamadhyaṣaṭkoṇapadmabhūpuramadhyataḥ //
meaning:
समर्प्यासनमेतेन तत्र संपूजयेच्छिवाम् /
त्रिकोणमध्यषट्कोणपद्मभूपुरमध्यतः //
text_mt: Having offered the seat with this, one should worship Śivā there, / within the earth-citadel, the lotus, the hexagram, and the triangle at its center.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyāvaraṇamārabhya pūjayetpratilomataḥ /
bhūpure bāhyabhāgeṣu vajrādīni prapūjayet //
meaning:
बाह्यावरणमारभ्य पूजयेत्प्रतिलोमतः /
भूपुरे बाह्यभागेषु वज्रादीनि प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Beginning from the outer enclosure, one should worship in reverse order. / In the outer parts of the earth-citadel, one should worship the thunderbolt and other [weapons];

sanskrit_iast:
tadantaḥ surarājādīnpūjayeddharitāṃ patīn /
bhūpurasya caturdvārṣu dvārapālānyajedatha //
meaning:
तदन्तः सुरराजादीन्पूजयेद्धरितां पतीन् /
भूपुरस्य चतुर्द्वार्षु द्वारपालान्यजेदथ //
text_mt: Inside that, one should worship the king of the gods and the other guardians of the quarters; / then, at the four gates of the earth-citadel, one should worship the doorkeepers:

sanskrit_iast:
karālavikarālākhyāvatikālastṛtīyakaḥ /
mahākālaścaturthaḥ syādatha padmeṣṭaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
करालविकरालाख्यावतिकालस्तृतीयकः /
महाकालश्चतुर्थः स्यादथ पद्मेष्टशक्तयः //
text_mt: Those named Karāla and Vikarāla, the third being Atikāla, / and Mahākāla is the fourth. Then, on the lotus, the eight energies:

sanskrit_iast:
ekaliṅgā yoginī ca ḍākinī bhairavī tathā /
mahābhairavakendrākṣī tvasitāṅgī tu saptamī //
meaning:
एकलिङ्गा योगिनी च डाकिनी भैरवी तथा /
महाभैरवकेन्द्राक्षी त्वसिताङ्गी तु सप्तमी //
text_mt: Ekaliṅgā, Yoginī, Ḍākinī, Bhairavī, / Mahābhairavī, Kendrākṣī, Asitāṅgī as the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhāriṇyaṣṭamī ceti ṣaṭkoṇeṣvaṅgamūrtayaḥ /
trikoṇagā chinnamastā pārśvayostu sakhīdvayam //
meaning:
संहारिण्यष्टमी चेति षट्कोणेष्वङ्गमूर्तयः /
त्रिकोणगा छिन्नमस्ता पार्श्वयोस्तु सखीद्वयम् //
text_mt: And Saṃhāriṇī as the eighth; and on the hexagram, the forms of the limbs. / Chinnamastā resides in the triangle, and at her sides are the two companions,

sanskrit_iast:
ḍākinīvarṇanīsaṃjñaṃ tārāvāgbhyāṃ prapūjayet /
evaṃ pūjādibhiḥ siddhe mantre mantrī manorathān //
meaning:
डाकिनीवर्णनीसंज्ञं तारावाग्भ्यां प्रपूजयेत् /
एवं पूजादिभिः सिद्धे मन्त्रे मन्त्री मनोरथान् //
text_mt: Known as Ḍākinī and Varṇinī; one should worship [them] with the tārā and speech [seeds]. / In this way, when the mantra is mastered through worship and the rest, the practitioner [attains] his desires;

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnuyānnikhilānsadyo durlabhāṃstatprasādataḥ /
śrīpuṣpairlabhate lakṣmīṃ tatphailaśca samīhitam //
meaning:
प्राप्नुयान्निखिलान्सद्यो दुर्लभांस्तत्प्रसादतः /
श्रीपुष्पैर्लभते लक्ष्मीं तत्फैलश्च समीहितम् //
text_mt: Through her grace, he quickly obtains all things that are otherwise hard to attain. / With śrī-flowers he obtains wealth, and with their fruits whatever he desires;

sanskrit_iast:
vāksiddhiṃ mālatīpuṣpaiścaṃpakairhavanātsukham /
ghṛtāktaṃ chāgamāṃsaṃ yo juhuyātpratyahaṃ śatam //
meaning:
वाक्सिद्धिं मालतीपुष्पैश्चंपकैर्हवनात्सुखम् /
घृताक्तं छागमांसं यो जुहुयात्प्रत्यहं शतम् //
text_mt: Success in speech with mālatī flowers, and happiness from oblations of campaka flowers. / He who offers daily one hundred fire oblations of goat's meat smeared with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
māsamekaṃ tu vaśagāstasya syuḥ sarvapārthivāḥ /
karavīrasumaiḥ śvatairlakṣasaṃkhyairjuhoti yaḥ //
meaning:
मासमेकं तु वशगास्तस्य स्युः सर्वपार्थिवाः /
करवीरसुमैः श्वतैर्लक्षसंख्यैर्जुहोति यः //
text_mt: For one month, will have all kings subjected to his will. / He who offers fire oblations with a hundred thousand white oleander flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
rogajālaṃ parābhūya sukhī jīvecchataṃ samāḥ /
raktau statsaṃkhyayā hutvā vaśayenmantriṇo nṛpān //
meaning:
रोगजालं पराभूय सुखी जीवेच्छतं समाः /
रक्तौ स्तत्संख्यया हुत्वा वशयेन्मन्त्रिणो नृपान् //
text_mt: Overcoming the host of diseases, lives happily for a hundred years. / By offering red ones in that same number, he brings kings and ministers under control.

sanskrit_iast:
phalairhutvāmuyāllakṣmīmuduṃbarapalāśajaiḥ /
gomāyumāṃsaistāmeva kavitāṃ pāyasāṃdhasā //
meaning:
फलैर्हुत्वामुयाल्लक्ष्मीमुदुंबरपलाशजैः /
गोमायुमांसैस्तामेव कवितां पायसांधसा //
text_mt: By offering fire oblations with fruits born of udumbara and palāśa, he obtains fortune; / by meat of jackals, the same; poetic gift with milk-rice food;

sanskrit_iast:
bandhūkakusumairbhāgyaṃ karmikāraiḥ samīhitam /
tilataṇḍulahomena vaśayennikhilāñjanān //
meaning:
बन्धूककुसुमैर्भाग्यं कर्मिकारैः समीहितम् /
तिलतण्डुलहोमेन वशयेन्निखिलाञ्जनान् //
text_mt: Good fortune with bandhūka blossoms; desired objects with karṇikāra flowers; / by fire oblations of sesame and raw rice, he subdues all people.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīrajobhirākṛṣṭairmṛgamāṃsaiḥ samīhitam /
staṃbhanaṃ māhiṣairmāṃsaiḥ paṅkajaiḥ saghṛtairapi //
meaning:
नारीरजोभिराकृष्टैर्मृगमांसैः समीहितम् /
स्तंभनं माहिषैर्मांसैः पङ्कजैः सघृतैरपि //
text_mt: With the menstrual fluids of women, desired objects are attracted; with venison, the desired [is gained]; / immobilization [is achieved] with buffalo meat, as well as with lotuses smeared with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
citāgnau parabhṛtpakṣairjurhuyādarimṛtyave /
unmattakāṣṭhadīpte 'gnau tatphalaṃ vāyasacchadaiḥ //
meaning:
चिताग्नौ परभृत्पक्षैर्जुर्हुयादरिमृत्यवे /
उन्मत्तकाष्ठदीप्ते ऽग्नौ तत्फलं वायसच्छदैः //
text_mt: One should offer fire oblations into a funeral pyre with feathers of a cuckoo for the death of an enemy; / that same result [is attained] in a fire kindled with datura wood using crow feathers.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūte vane nṛpadvāre samare vairisaṃkaṭe /
vijayaṃ labhate mantrī dhyāyandevīṃ japanmanum //
meaning:
द्यूते वने नृपद्वारे समरे वैरिसंकटे /
विजयं लभते मन्त्री ध्यायन्देवीं जपन्मनुम् //
text_mt: In gambling, in the forest, at a king's gate, in battle, in danger from enemies, / the practitioner attains victory by meditating on the goddess and reciting the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktyai muktyai sitāṃ dhyāyeduccāṭe nīlarociṣam /
raktāṃ vaśye mṛtau dhūmrāṃ staṃbhane kanakaprabhām //
meaning:
भुक्त्यै मुक्त्यै सितां ध्यायेदुच्चाटे नीलरोचिषम् /
रक्तां वश्ये मृतौ धूम्रां स्तंभने कनकप्रभाम् //
text_mt: For enjoyment and liberation, one should meditate on her as white; for driving away [enemies], of blue radiance; / red for subjection; smoke-colored for death; and possessing the luster of gold for immobilization.

sanskrit_iast:
niśi dadyādbaliṃ tasyai siddhaye madirādinā /
gopanīyaḥ prayogo 'ya procyate sarvasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
निशि दद्याद्बलिं तस्यै सिद्धये मदिरादिना /
गोपनीयः प्रयोगो ऽय प्रोच्यते सर्वसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: At night, one should offer her an animal sacrifice or food offering with liquor and the like for attainment. / This secret practice, which grants all attainments, is declared:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāhe kṛṣṇapakṣasya madhyarātre tamoghane /
snāttvā raktāmbaradharo raktamālyānulepanaḥ //
meaning:
भूताहे कृष्णपक्षस्य मध्यरात्रे तमोघने /
स्नात्त्वा रक्ताम्बरधरो रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनः //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, at midnight when darkness is thick, / having bathed, wearing red garments, adorned with red garlands and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya pūjayennārīṃ chinnamastāsvarūpiṇīm /
sundarīṃ yauvanākrāntāṃ narapañcakagāminīm //
meaning:
आनीय पूजयेन्नारीं छिन्नमस्तास्वरूपिणीम् /
सुन्दरीं यौवनाक्रान्तां नरपञ्चकगामिनीम् //
text_mt: Having brought a woman who is the embodiment of Chinnamastā, / beautiful, in the prime of youth, who has known five men,

sanskrit_iast:
susmitāṃ muktakabīrīṃ bhūṣādānapratoṣitām /
vivastrāṃ pūjayitvaināmayutaṃ prajapenmanum //
meaning:
सुस्मितां मुक्तकबीरीं भूषादानप्रतोषिताम् /
विवस्त्रां पूजयित्वैनामयुतं प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: Gently smiling, with disheveled hair, gladdened by gifts of ornaments, / having worshiped her unclothed, one should recite the mantra ten thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ dattvā niśāṃ nītvā saṃpreṣya dhanatoṣitām /
bhojayedvividhairannairbrāhmaṇānbhojanādinā //
meaning:
बलिं दत्त्वा निशां नीत्वा संप्रेष्य धनतोषिताम् /
भोजयेद्विविधैरन्नैर्ब्राह्मणान्भोजनादिना //
text_mt: Having offered a bali, passed the night, and sent her away satisfied with wealth, / he should feed brāhmaṇas with various kinds of foods and feasts.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā lakṣmīṃ putrānpautrāndhanaṃ yaśaḥ /
nārīmāyuḥ sukhaṃ dharmamiṣṭaṃ ca samavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना लक्ष्मीं पुत्रान्पौत्रान्धनं यशः /
नारीमायुः सुखं धर्ममिष्टं च समवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: By this procedure, he obtains wealth, sons, grandsons, riches, fame, / a woman, long life, happiness, righteousness, and whatever is desired.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ rātrau vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidyākāmena mantriṇā /
manoratheṣu cānyeṣu gacchettāṃ prajapanmanum //
meaning:
तस्यां रात्रौ व्रतं कार्यं विद्याकामेन मन्त्रिणा /
मनोरथेषु चान्येषु गच्छेत्तां प्रजपन्मनुम् //
text_mt: On that night, an observance should be undertaken by the practitioner who desires learning; / and for other desires, he should approach her while reciting the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣasyutthāya śayyāyāmupaviṣṭo japecchatam /
ṣaṇmāsābhyantaremantrī kavitvena jayetkavim //
meaning:
उषस्युत्थाय शय्यायामुपविष्टो जपेच्छतम् /
षण्मासाभ्यन्तरेमन्त्री कवित्वेन जयेत्कविम् //
text_mt: Having risen at dawn and seated upon his bed, he should recite [it] one hundred times; / within six months, the practitioner will surpass even the poet [Bṛhaspati] in poetic skill.

sanskrit_iast:
śivena kīlitā ceyaṃ tadutkīlanamucyate /
māyāṃ tārapuṭāṃ mantrī japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
शिवेन कीलिता चेयं तदुत्कीलनमुच्यते /
मायां तारपुटां मन्त्री जपेदष्टोत्तरं शतम् //
text_mt: This [mantra] was locked by Śiva; its unlocking is now declared: / the practitioner should recite the Māyā-syllable, enclosed by the tārā, one hundred and eight times

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasyādau tathaivānte bhavetsiddhipradā tu sā /
uditā chinnamasteyaṃ kalau śīghramabhīṣṭadā //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्यादौ तथैवान्ते भवेत्सिद्धिप्रदा तु सा /
उदिता छिन्नमस्तेयं कलौ शीघ्रमभीष्टदा //
text_mt: At the beginning of the mantra and likewise at its end; then it becomes the bestower of success. / This Chinnamastā has been described; in the Kali age, she quickly grants desired wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
avatārāntaraṃ devyā vacmi te munisattama /
jñānāmṛtāruṇā śvetākrodhinīndusamanvitā //
meaning:
अवतारान्तरं देव्या वच्मि ते मुनिसत्तम /
ज्ञानामृतारुणा श्वेताक्रोधिनीन्दुसमन्विता //
text_mt: I shall tell you another incarnation of the goddess, O best of sages: / Jñānāmṛtā, Aruṇā, Śvetā, Krodhinī conjoined with the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
śāntistathāvidhā cāpi nīcasargānvitāstathā /
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājākhyaṃ śaktibījāhvayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
शान्तिस्तथाविधा चापि नीचसर्गान्वितास्तथा /
वाग्भवं कामराजाख्यं शक्तिबीजाह्वयं तथा //
text_mt: Likewise Śānti of that nature, and conjoined with the visarga; / the vāgbhava, the seed named kāmarāja, and the seed called śakti—

sanskrit_iast:
tribhirbījaiḥ pañcakūṭātmikā tripurabhairavī /
ṛṣiḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtiśchandaḥ paṅktirudīritā //
meaning:
त्रिभिर्बीजैः पञ्चकूटात्मिका त्रिपुरभैरवी /
ऋषिः स्याद्दक्षिणामूर्तिश्छन्दः पङ्क्तिरुदीरिता //
text_mt: Composed of five peaks by means of these three seeds is Tripurabhairavī. / The seer is Dakṣiṇāmūrti; the meter is declared to be Paṅkti;

sanskrit_iast:
devatā deśikairuktā devī tripurabhairavī /
nābherācaraṇaṃ nyasya vāgbhavaṃ mantravitpunaḥ //
meaning:
देवता देशिकैरुक्ता देवी त्रिपुरभैरवी /
नाभेराचरणं न्यस्य वाग्भवं मन्त्रवित्पुनः //
text_mt: The goddess is said by teachers to be the goddess Tripurabhairavī. / Having rituals placed the vāgbhava from the navel down to the feet, the knower of mantras again

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayānnābhiparyantaṃ kāmabījaṃ pravinyaset /
śiraso hṛtpradeśāntaṃ tārtīyaṃ vinyasettataḥ //
meaning:
हृदयान्नाभिपर्यन्तं कामबीजं प्रविन्यसेत् /
शिरसो हृत्प्रदेशान्तं तार्तीयं विन्यसेत्ततः //
text_mt: Should place the kāma-seed from the heart to the navel; / then he should place the third seed from the head to the heart region.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ karayostārtīyamubhayaṃ nyaset /
mūlādhāre hṛdi nyasya bhūyo bījatrayaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
आद्यं द्वितीयं करयोस्तार्तीयमुभयं न्यसेत् /
मूलाधारे हृदि न्यस्य भूयो बीजत्रयं क्रमात् //
text_mt: He should place the first and second on the two hands, and the third on both; / having placed the triad of seeds in the mūlādhāra and in the heart again in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
navayonyātmakaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryādbījaistribhiḥ punaḥ /
bāloditaprakāreṇa mūrtinyāsamathācaret //
meaning:
नवयोन्यात्मकं न्यासं कुर्याद्बीजैस्त्रिभिः पुनः /
बालोदितप्रकारेण मूर्तिन्यासमथाचरेत् //
text_mt: He should perform the ritual placement of the nine yonis once more with the three seeds; / then he should perform the ritual placement of the divine forms in the manner stated for Bālā.

sanskrit_iast:
svasvabījādikaṃ pūrvaṃ mūrdhnīśānamanobhavam /
nyasedvaktre tatpuruṣaṃ makaradhvajamātmavit //
meaning:
स्वस्वबीजादिकं पूर्वं मूर्ध्नीशानमनोभवम् /
न्यसेद्वक्त्रे तत्पुरुषं मकरध्वजमात्मवित् //
text_mt: The knower of the self, having first [uttered] the respective seeds, / should place Īśāna-Manobhava on the head, and Tatpuruṣa-Makaradhvaja on the mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyaghorakumārādikandarppaṃ tadanantaram /
guhyadeśe pravinyasyedvāmadevādimanmatham //
meaning:
हृद्यघोरकुमारादिकन्दर्प्पं तदनन्तरम् /
गुह्यदेशे प्रविन्यस्येद्वामदेवादिमन्मथम् //
text_mt: Then Aghora-Kumāra-Kandarpa on the heart, / and should ritually place Vāmadeva-Manmatha on the secret region.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātaṃ kāmadevaṃ pādayorvinyasettataḥ /
ūrddhvaṃprāgdakṣiṇodīcyapaścimeṣu mukheṣu tān //
meaning:
सद्योजातं कामदेवं पादयोर्विन्यसेत्ततः /
ऊर्द्ध्वंप्राग्दक्षिणोदीच्यपश्चिमेषु मुखेषु तान् //
text_mt: Then one should place Sadyojāta-Kāmadeva upon the feet; / and one should place them [respectively] on the upper, eastern, southern, northern, and western faces.

sanskrit_iast:
pravinyasedya dhāpūrva bhṛgurvyomāgnisaṃsthitaḥ /
sadyādipañcahrasvādyā bījameṣāṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
प्रविन्यसेद्य धापूर्व भृगुर्व्योमाग्निसंस्थितः /
सद्यादिपञ्चह्रस्वाद्या बीजमेषां प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: As before, one should place Bhṛgu seated with ether and fire. / The five short vowels beginning with 'a' are taught as their seed-syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghayuktenādyena bījenāṅgakriyā matā /
pañcabāṇāṃstato nyasyenmantrī trailokyamohanān //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घयुक्तेनाद्येन बीजेनाङ्गक्रिया मता /
पञ्चबाणांस्ततो न्यस्येन्मन्त्री त्रैलोक्यमोहनान् //
text_mt: The performance of the limbs is considered to be done with the first seed-syllable joined with the six long [vowels]. / Then the practitioner of mantra should place the five arrows that enchant the three worlds:

sanskrit_iast:
drāmādyāṃ drāviṇīṃ mūrdhniṃ drāmādyāṃ kṣobhaṇī pade /
klīṃvaśīkaraṇīṃ vaktre guhye bḷṃ bījapūrvikām //
meaning:
द्रामाद्यां द्राविणीं मूर्ध्निं द्रामाद्यां क्षोभणी पदे /
क्लींवशीकरणीं वक्त्रे गुह्ये बॢं बीजपूर्विकाम् //
text_mt: Drāviṇī, beginning with 'drām', on the head; Kṣobhaṇī, beginning with 'drīm', on the feet; / Vaśīkaraṇī, with 'klīm', on the mouth; and Ākarṣaṇī, preceded by the seed-syllable 'blūm', on the private parts;

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣaṇīṃ hṛdi punaḥ sarvāntabhṛgusaṃsthitām /
saṃmohanīṃ kramādevaṃ bāṇanyāso 'yamīritaḥ //
meaning:
आकर्षणीं हृदि पुनः सर्वान्तभृगुसंस्थिताम् /
संमोहनीं क्रमादेवं बाणन्यासो ऽयमीरितः //
text_mt: then Saṃmohanī, situated with the last of all, Bhṛgu, on the heart. / In this sequence the ritual placement of the arrows has been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
bhālabhrūmadhyavadane ghaṇṭikākaṇṭhahṛtsu ca /
nābhyadhiṣṭhānayoḥ pañca tārādyāḥ subhagādikāḥ //
meaning:
भालभ्रूमध्यवदने घण्टिकाकण्ठहृत्सु च /
नाभ्यधिष्ठानयोः पञ्च ताराद्याः सुभगादिकाः //
text_mt: On the forehead, between the eyebrows, on the face, the uvula, the throat, the heart, / the navel, and the generative organ, the five [syllables] beginning with the praṇava, and [the deities] beginning with Subhagā [should be placed].

sanskrit_iast:
mastakāvidhi nābheśca mantriṇā subhagā bhagā /
bhagasarpiṇyatha parā bhagamālinyanantaram //
meaning:
मस्तकाविधि नाभेश्च मन्त्रिणा सुभगा भगा /
भगसर्पिण्यथ परा भगमालिन्यनन्तरम् //
text_mt: By the practitioner of mantra, from the head down to the navel: Subhagā, Bhagā, / then Bhagasarpiṇī, next the supreme Bhagamālinī;

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgānaṅgakusumā bhūyaścānaṅgamekhalā /
anaṅgamadanā sarvā madavibhramamantharā //
meaning:
अनङ्गानङ्गकुसुमा भूयश्चानङ्गमेखला /
अनङ्गमदना सर्वा मदविभ्रममन्थरा //
text_mt: Anaṅgā, Anaṅgakusumā, and further Anaṅgamekhalā, / and Anaṅgamadanā—all languid with the intoxication of passion,

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānadevatā varṇabhūṣaṇādyairalaṅkṛtāḥ /
akṣasrakpustakābhītivaradāḍhyakarāṃbujāḥ //
meaning:
प्रधानदेवता वर्णभूषणाद्यैरलङ्कृताः /
अक्षस्रक्पुस्तकाभीतिवरदाढ्यकरांबुजाः //
text_mt: adorned with the complexions, ornaments, and attributes of the principal deity, / their lotus hands furnished with a rosary, a book, the gesture of fearlessness, and the gesture of granting boons.

sanskrit_iast:
vākkāmablūṃ strīṃ sarānte tārāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ /
tataḥ kuryādbhūṣaṇākhyaṃ nyāsamuktadiśā mune //
meaning:
वाक्कामब्लूं स्त्रीं सरान्ते ताराः पञ्च प्रकीर्तिताः /
ततः कुर्याद्भूषणाख्यं न्यासमुक्तदिशा मुने //
text_mt: The five praṇavas are taught as Vāc, Kāma, 'blūṃ', 'strīṃ', and ending with 'saḥ' and 'ra'. / Then, O sage, one should perform the ritual placement called Bhūṣaṇa in the manner described.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nyastaśarīro 'sau dhyāyettripurabhairavīm /
sahasrabhānusaṃkāśāmaruṇakṣaumavāsasīm //
meaning:
एवं न्यस्तशरीरो ऽसौ ध्यायेत्त्रिपुरभैरवीम् /
सहस्रभानुसंकाशामरुणक्षौमवाससीम् //
text_mt: Having thus placed [the deities upon] his body, he should meditate upon Tripurabhairavī, / resembling a thousand suns, wearing garments of red silk,

sanskrit_iast:
śiromālāmasṛgliptastanīṃ japavaṭīṃ karaiḥ /
vidyāmabhītiṃ ca varaṃ dadhatīṃ trīkṣaṇānanām //
meaning:
शिरोमालामसृग्लिप्तस्तनीं जपवटीं करैः /
विद्यामभीतिं च वरं दधतीं त्रीक्षणाननाम् //
text_mt: with a garland of severed heads, her breasts smeared with blood, holding in her hands a rosary, / sacred knowledge, and the gestures of fearlessness and boon-granting, her face possessing three eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāṃ prāpya japenmantraṃ tattvalakṣaṃ jitendriyaḥ /
puṣpairbhānusahasrāṇi juhuyādbahmavṛkṣajaiḥ //
meaning:
दीक्षां प्राप्य जपेन्मन्त्रं तत्त्वलक्षं जितेन्द्रियः /
पुष्पैर्भानुसहस्राणि जुहुयाद्बह्मवृक्षजैः //
text_mt: Having obtained initiation, with senses subdued, he should recite the mantra twenty-four hundred thousand times; / he should offer twelve thousand fire oblations with flowers produced from the Palāśa tree,

sanskrit_iast:
trimadhvaktaiḥ prasūnairvā karavīrasamudbhavaiḥ /
padmaṃ vasudalopetaṃ navayonyaṣṭakarṇikam //
meaning:
त्रिमध्वक्तैः प्रसूनैर्वा करवीरसमुद्भवैः /
पद्मं वसुदलोपेतं नवयोन्यष्टकर्णिकम् //
text_mt: or with oleander blossoms smeared with the three sweet substances. / A lotus endowed with eight petals, having nine yonis and an eight-[seeded] pericarp,

sanskrit_iast:
icchādiśaktibhiryuktaṃ bhairavyāḥ pīṭhamarcayet /
icchā jñānā kriyā paścātkāminī kāmadāyinī //
meaning:
इच्छादिशक्तिभिर्युक्तं भैरव्याः पीठमर्चयेत् /
इच्छा ज्ञाना क्रिया पश्चात्कामिनी कामदायिनी //
text_mt: endowed with the powers such as Icchā—one should worship this ritual seat of Bhairavī: / Icchā, Jñānā, Kriyā, then Kāminī, Kāmadāyinī,

sanskrit_iast:
ratipriyā madānandā navamī syānmanonmanī /
varadābhayadhāriṇyaḥ saṃproktā nava śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
रतिप्रिया मदानन्दा नवमी स्यान्मनोन्मनी /
वरदाभयधारिण्यः संप्रोक्ता नव शक्तयः //
text_mt: Ratipriyā, Madānandā, and the ninth is Manonmanī; / the nine powers are proclaimed as bearing the gestures of granting boons and fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavaṃ lohito rāyai śrīkaṇṭho lohito 'nalaḥ /
dīrghavānyai parā paścādaparāyau hasau yutaḥ //
meaning:
वाग्भवं लोहितो रायै श्रीकण्ठो लोहितो ऽनलः /
दीर्घवान्यै परा पश्चादपरायौ हसौ युतः //
text_mt: Vāgbhava, Lohita, with 'rāyai', Śrīkaṇṭha, Lohita, Anala / having a long vowel with 'yai', next Parā, and Aparā, joined with 'hasau',

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivamahāpretaṅeṃtaṃ padmāsanaṃ namaḥ /
anena manunā dadyādāsanaṃ śrīgurukramam //
meaning:
सदाशिवमहाप्रेतङेंतं पद्मासनं नमः /
अनेन मनुना दद्यादासनं श्रीगुरुक्रमम् //
text_mt: ending with the dative of Sadāśivamahāpreta, and 'padmāsanāya namaḥ'— / by means of this mantra according to the tradition of the auspicious guru, one should assign the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmadhyayonyantarāle pūjayetkalpayettataḥ /
pañcabhiḥ praṇavairmūrtiṃ tasyāmāvāhya devatām //
meaning:
प्राङ्मध्ययोन्यन्तराले पूजयेत्कल्पयेत्ततः /
पञ्चभिः प्रणवैर्मूर्तिं तस्यामावाह्य देवताम् //
text_mt: Then in the space between the eastern and central yonis he should worship and envision / the form [of the deity] with five praṇavas, invoking the deity into it.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedagamoktena vidhānena samāhitaḥ /
tārāvākchaktikamalā hasakhūphreṃ hasauḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेदगमोक्तेन विधानेन समाहितः /
तारावाक्छक्तिकमला हसखूफ्रें हसौः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Collected in mind, he should worship according to the rule taught in the scriptures. / The praṇava, Vāc, Śakti, Kamalā, 'hasakhphreṃ', and 'hasauḥ' are traditionally remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmakoṇe yajeddevyā ratimindusamaprabhām /
sṛṇipāśadharāṃ saumyāṃ madavibhramavihvalām //
meaning:
वामकोणे यजेद्देव्या रतिमिन्दुसमप्रभाम् /
सृणिपाशधरां सौम्यां मदविभ्रमविह्वलाम् //
text_mt: In the left corner one should worship the goddess Rati, radiant like the moon, / bearing a goad and a noose, gentle, agitated by the intoxication of passion.

sanskrit_iast:
prītiṃ takṣiṇakoṇasthāṃ taptakāñcanasannibhām /
aṅkuśaṃ praṇataṃ dobhyāṃ dhārayantīṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
प्रीतिं तक्षिणकोणस्थां तप्तकाञ्चनसन्निभाम् /
अङ्कुशं प्रणतं दोभ्यां धारयन्तीं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: One should worship Prīti seated in the right corner, resembling molten gold, / holding a goad and [a hand] bowed in respect with both arms.

sanskrit_iast:
agre manobhavāṃ raktāṃ raktapuṣpādyalaṅkṛtām /
ikṣukārmukapuṣpeṣudhāriṇīṃ sasmitānanām //
meaning:
अग्रे मनोभवां रक्तां रक्तपुष्पाद्यलङ्कृताम् /
इक्षुकार्मुकपुष्पेषुधारिणीं सस्मिताननाम् //
text_mt: In front, Manobhavā: red, adorned with red flowers and ornaments, / bearing a sugarcane bow and flower arrows, with a smiling face.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgānyabhyarcayetpaścādyathāpūrvaṃ vidhānavit /
dikṣvagre ca nijairmantraiḥ pūjayedbāṇadevatāḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गान्यभ्यर्चयेत्पश्चाद्यथापूर्वं विधानवित् /
दिक्ष्वग्रे च निजैर्मन्त्रैः पूजयेद्बाणदेवताः //
text_mt: Then, knowing the ritual procedure, he should worship the limbs as before. / In the directions and in front, he should worship the deities of the arrows with their own mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
hastābjairdhṛtapuṣpeṣupraṇāmāmṛtasaprabhāḥ /
aṣṭayoniṣvaṣṭaśaktīḥ pūjayetsubhagādikāḥ //
meaning:
हस्ताब्जैर्धृतपुष्पेषुप्रणामामृतसप्रभाः /
अष्टयोनिष्वष्टशक्तीः पूजयेत्सुभगादिकाः //
text_mt: having the radiance of nectar, bowing and holding flower arrows with their lotus hands. / In the eight yonis one should worship the eight powers beginning with Subhagā.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaro bhairavāṅkasthā madavibhramavihvalāḥ /
aṣṭapatreṣu saṃpūjyā yathāvatkusumādibhiḥ //
meaning:
मातरो भैरवाङ्कस्था मदविभ्रमविह्वलाः /
अष्टपत्रेषु संपूज्या यथावत्कुसुमादिभिः //
text_mt: The Mothers seated on the lap of Bhairava, agitated by the intoxication of passion, / are to be properly worshipped on the eight petals with flowers and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālāṃstato dikṣu teṣāmastrāṇi tadbahiḥ /
pūrvajanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairjñātvaināṃ paradevatām //
meaning:
लोकपालांस्ततो दिक्षु तेषामस्त्राणि तद्बहिः /
पूर्वजन्मकृतैः पुण्यैर्ज्ञात्वैनां परदेवताम् //
text_mt: Then [he should worship] the guardians of the world in the directions, and their weapons outside of them. / Having known this supreme deity through the merits accrued in previous lives,

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhajeduktamārgeṇa sa bhavetsaṃpadāṃ padam /
evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
यो भजेदुक्तमार्गेण स भवेत्संपदां पदम् /
एवं सिद्धमनुर्मन्त्री साधयेदिष्टमात्मनः //
text_mt: whoever worships according to the prescribed path becomes an abode of riches. / Thus, having accomplished the mantra, the practitioner will attain his desired goal.

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādaruṇāṃbhoñjairadoṣairmadhurāplutaiḥ /
lakṣasaṃkhyaṃ tadarddhaṃ vā pratyahaṃ bhojayeddvijān //
meaning:
जुहुयादरुणांभोञ्जैरदोषैर्मधुराप्लुतैः /
लक्षसंख्यं तदर्द्धं वा प्रत्यहं भोजयेद्द्विजान् //
text_mt: He should offer fire oblations with red lotuses that are flawless and soaked in sweet substances, / to the count of one hundred thousand or half of that, and he should feed twice-born men daily.

sanskrit_iast:
vanitā yuvatī ramyāḥ prīṇayeddevatādhiyā /
homānte dhanadhānyādyaistoṣayedgurumātmanaḥ //
meaning:
वनिता युवती रम्याः प्रीणयेद्देवताधिया /
होमान्ते धनधान्याद्यैस्तोषयेद्गुरुमात्मनः //
text_mt: One should gratify charming young women with the thought that they are deities. / At the end of the fire oblation, one should satisfy one's guru with wealth, grain, and other gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte jagadvaśyo ramāyā bhavanaṃ bhavet /
raktotpalaistrimadhvaktairaruṇairvā hayārijaiḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृते जगद्वश्यो रमाया भवनं भवेत् /
रक्तोत्पलैस्त्रिमध्वक्तैररुणैर्वा हयारिजैः //
text_mt: When this is done, the world becomes subject to him, and he becomes an abode of Ramā. / With red lotuses anointed with the three sweets, or with red oleander flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ payonnaiḥ saghṛtairhemādviśvaṃ vaśaṃ nayet /
vāksiddhaṃ labhate mantrī palāśakusumairhutaiḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पैः पयोन्नैः सघृतैर्हेमाद्विश्वं वशं नयेत् /
वाक्सिद्धं लभते मन्त्री पलाशकुसुमैर्हुतैः //
text_mt: or with milk-rice mixed with ghee, he brings the world under his sway from [the height of] Meru. / The practitioner of mantra attains perfection of speech through oblations of palāśa blossoms.

sanskrit_iast:
karpūrāgurusaṃyuktaṃ guggulaṃ juhuyātsudhīḥ /
jñānaṃ divyamavāpnoti tenaiva sa bhavetkaviḥ //
meaning:
कर्पूरागुरुसंयुक्तं गुग्गुलं जुहुयात्सुधीः /
ज्ञानं दिव्यमवाप्नोति तेनैव स भवेत्कविः //
text_mt: The wise man should offer into the fire guggulu mixed with camphor and aguru; / he attains divine knowledge and by that very act becomes a poet.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrāktairamṛtākhaṇḍairhemaḥ sarvāpamṛtyujit /
dūrvābhaghirāyuṣe homaḥ kṣīrāktābhirdinatrayam //
meaning:
क्षीराक्तैरमृताखण्डैर्हेमः सर्वापमृत्युजित् /
दूर्वाभघिरायुषे होमः क्षीराक्ताभिर्दिनत्रयम् //
text_mt: A fire oblation with amṛtā pieces anointed with milk conquers every untimely death. / For longevity, a fire oblation of dūrvā grass anointed with milk should be made for three days.

sanskrit_iast:
girikarṇībhavaiḥ puṣpairbrāhmaṇānvaśayeddhutaiḥ /
kahlāraiḥ pārthivānpuṣpaistadvadhūḥ karṇikārajaiḥ //
meaning:
गिरिकर्णीभवैः पुष्पैर्ब्राह्मणान्वशयेद्धुतैः /
कह्लारैः पार्थिवान्पुष्पैस्तद्वधूः कर्णिकारजैः //
text_mt: Through oblations of girikarṇī flowers, he brings brāhmaṇas under his sway; / with white water-lilies, kings; with karṇikāra flowers, their wives;

sanskrit_iast:
mallikākusumairhutvā rājaputrānvaśaṃ nayet /
koraṇṭakusumairvaiṃśyānvṛṣalānpāṭalodbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
मल्लिकाकुसुमैर्हुत्वा राजपुत्रान्वशं नयेत् /
कोरण्टकुसुमैर्वैंश्यान्वृषलान्पाटलोद्भवैः //
text_mt: having offered oblations with mallikā blossoms, he brings princes under his sway; / with yellow amaranth blossoms, the vaiśyas; and the śūdras with trumpet-flower blossoms.

sanskrit_iast:
anulomāṃ vilomāntasthitasādhyāhvayānvitam /
mantramuccārya juhuyānmantrī madhuralolitaiḥ //
meaning:
अनुलोमां विलोमान्तस्थितसाध्याह्वयान्वितम् /
मन्त्रमुच्चार्य जुहुयान्मन्त्री मधुरलोलितैः //
text_mt: Reciting the mantra accompanied by the name of the person to be subjugated placed between the direct and reverse forms, / the practitioner of mantra should offer oblations steeped in the three sweets.

sanskrit_iast:
sarṣapairmadhusaṃmiśrairvaśayetpārthivān kṣaṇāt /
anenaiva vidhānena tatpatnīstatsutānapi //
meaning:
सर्षपैर्मधुसंमिश्रैर्वशयेत्पार्थिवान् क्षणात् /
अनेनैव विधानेन तत्पत्नीस्तत्सुतानपि //
text_mt: With mustard seeds mixed with honey, he instantly brings kings under his sway; / and by this very procedure, their wives and sons as well.

sanskrit_iast:
jātibilvabhavaiḥ puṣpairmadhuratrayasaṃyutaiḥ /
naranārīnarapatīnhomena vaśayetkramāt //
meaning:
जातिबिल्वभवैः पुष्पैर्मधुरत्रयसंयुतैः /
नरनारीनरपतीन्होमेन वशयेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt: With blossoms of jasmine and bilva combined with the three sweets, / one should gradually bring men, women, and kings under sway by fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
mālatībakulodbhūtaiḥ puṣpaiścandanalolitaiḥ /
juhuyātkavitāṃ mantrī labhate vatsarāntare //
meaning:
मालतीबकुलोद्भूतैः पुष्पैश्चन्दनलोलितैः /
जुहुयात्कवितां मन्त्री लभते वत्सरान्तरे //
text_mt: With flowers of mālatī and bakula smeared with sandalwood paste, / the practitioner of mantra should make fire oblations; he attains poetic mastery within a year.

sanskrit_iast:
madhuratraghayasaṃyuktaiḥ phalairbilvasamudbhavaiḥ /
juhuyādvāśayellokaṃ śriyaṃ prāpnoti vāñchitām //
meaning:
मधुरत्रघयसंयुक्तैः फलैर्बिल्वसमुद्भवैः /
जुहुयाद्वाशयेल्लोकं श्रियं प्राप्नोति वाञ्छिताम् //
text_mt: With bilva fruits mixed with the three sweets, / he should offer oblations; he subjugates people and obtains the fortune he desires.

sanskrit_iast:
sājyamannaṃ prajuhuyādbhavedannasamṛddhimān /
kastūrīkuṅkumopetaṃ karpūraṃ juhuyādvaśī //
meaning:
साज्यमन्नं प्रजुहुयाद्भवेदन्नसमृद्धिमान् /
कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमोपेतं कर्पूरं जुहुयाद्वशी //
text_mt: He should offer cooked food with ghee into the fire; he becomes rich in food. / A master of self should offer camphor mixed with musk and saffron;

sanskrit_iast:
kandarpādadhikaṃ sadyaḥ saindaryamadhigacchati /
lājānprajuhuyānmantrī dadhikṣīramadhuplutān //
meaning:
कन्दर्पादधिकं सद्यः सैन्दर्यमधिगच्छति /
लाजान्प्रजुहुयान्मन्त्री दधिक्षीरमधुप्लुतान् //
text_mt: he instantly acquires beauty surpassing that of Kandarpa. / The practitioner of mantra should offer oblations of puffed rice drenched in curd, milk, and honey;

sanskrit_iast:
vijitya rogānakhilānsa jīveccharadāṃ śatam /
pādadvayaṃ malayajaṃ pādaṃ kuṅkumakesaram //
meaning:
विजित्य रोगानखिलान्स जीवेच्छरदां शतम् /
पादद्वयं मलयजं पादं कुङ्कुमकेसरम् //
text_mt: having conquered all diseases, he will live for a hundred autumns. / Two parts sandalwood, one part saffron filaments,

sanskrit_iast:
pādaṃ gorocanāntāni trīṇi piṣṭvāhimāṃbhasā /
vidadhyāttilakaṃ bhāle yānpaśyedyairvilokyate //
meaning:
पादं गोरोचनान्तानि त्रीणि पिष्ट्वाहिमांभसा /
विदध्यात्तिलकं भाले यान्पश्येद्यैर्विलोक्यते //
text_mt: and one part gorocanā: having ground these three with cold water, / one should apply a mark on the forehead; whomever one sees, or by whomever one is looked upon,

sanskrit_iast:
yānspṛśetspṛśyate yairvā vaśyāḥ syustasya te 'cirāt /
karpūrakapicorāṇi samabhāgāni kalpayet //
meaning:
यान्स्पृशेत्स्पृश्यते यैर्वा वश्याः स्युस्तस्य ते ऽचिरात् /
कर्पूरकपिचोराणि समभागानि कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: whomever one touches, or by whomever one is touched, will quickly fall under his sway. / One should measure equal parts of camphor and kapicora;

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā jaṭāmāṃsī tāvatī rocanā matā /
kuṅkumaṃ samabhāgaṃ syāddigbhātaṃ candanaṃ matam //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा जटामांसी तावती रोचना मता /
कुङ्कुमं समभागं स्याद्दिग्भातं चन्दनं मतम् //
text_mt: four parts of jaṭāmāṃsī, and an equal amount of gorocanā is prescribed; / saffron should be an equal part, and sandalwood is deemed ten parts;

sanskrit_iast:
agururnavabhāgaṃ syāditibhāgakrameṇa ca /
himādbhiḥ kanyayā piṣṭametatsarvaṃ susādhitam //
meaning:
अगुरुर्नवभागं स्यादितिभागक्रमेण च /
हिमाद्भिः कन्यया पिष्टमेतत्सर्वं सुसाधितम् //
text_mt: aguru should be nine parts—in accordance with this sequence of proportions; / ground by a maiden with cold water, all this is properly prepared.

sanskrit_iast:
ādāya tilakaṃ bhāle kuryyādbhūmipatīnnarān /
vanitāmadagarvāḍhyā madonmattānmatandajān //
meaning:
आदाय तिलकं भाले कुर्य्याद्भूमिपतीन्नरान् /
वनितामदगर्वाढ्या मदोन्मत्तान्मतन्दजान् //
text_mt: Taking it, he should make a mark on his forehead: kings, men, / women rich in passion and pride, rut-maddened elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghrānmahāsarpānbhūtavetālarākṣasān /
darśanādeva vaśayettilakaṃ dhārayannaraḥ //
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रान्महासर्पान्भूतवेतालराक्षसान् /
दर्शनादेव वशयेत्तिलकं धारयन्नरः //
text_mt: lions, tigers, great serpents, spirits, vetālas, and rākṣasas, / he brings under sway merely by sight, wearing that mark on his forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā bhairavī proktā hyavatārāntaraṃ śṛṇu /
vāṅmāyā kamalā tāro namonte bhagavatyatha //
meaning:
इत्येषा भैरवी प्रोक्ता ह्यवतारान्तरं शृणु /
वाङ्माया कमला तारो नमोन्ते भगवत्यथ //
text_mt: Thus has this Bhairavī been declared; now listen to another manifestation: / the speech-syllable, the māyā-syllable, the kamalā-syllable, and the tāra-syllable, then 'namaḥ' at the end, then 'bhagavati',

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmātaṅgeśvari vadetsarvajanamanohari /
sarvādisukharājyante sarvādisukharañjanī //
meaning:
श्रीमातङ्गेश्वरि वदेत्सर्वजनमनोहरि /
सर्वादिसुखराज्यन्ते सर्वादिसुखरञ्जनी //
text_mt: one should say 'śrīmātaṅgeśvari', then 'sarvajanamanohari', / after 'sarvādisukharājya', 'sarvādisukharañjanī',

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarājavaśaṃ paścātkarisarvapadaṃ vadet /
strīpuruṣavaśaṃ sṛṣṭividyākrodhinikānvitā //
meaning:
सर्वराजवशं पश्चात्करिसर्वपदं वदेत् /
स्त्रीपुरुषवशं सृष्टिविद्याक्रोधिनिकान्विता //
text_mt: then 'sarvarājavaśaṅkari', then one should utter the word 'sarva', / 'strīpuruṣavaśaṅkari', followed by 'vidyākrodhinī',

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ duṣṭamṛgavaśaṃ karisarvapadaṃ tataḥ /
sarvasattvavaśaṅkarisarvalokaṃ tataḥ param //
meaning:
सर्वं दुष्टमृगवशं करिसर्वपदं ततः /
सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्करिसर्वलोकं ततः परम् //
text_mt: 'sarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṅkari', then the word 'sarva', / 'sarvasattvavaśaṅkari', and after that 'sarvaloka-',

sanskrit_iast:
amukaṃ me vaśaṃ paścādānayānalasundarī /
aṣṭāśītyakṣaro mantro munyādyā bhairavīgatāḥ //
meaning:
अमुकं मे वशं पश्चादानयानलसुन्दरी /
अष्टाशीत्यक्षरो मन्त्रो मुन्याद्या भैरवीगताः //
text_mt: '[bring] so-and-so into my control', then 'ānaya analasundarī svāhā'. / This is the eighty-eight-syllable mantra; its sage and other [presiding entities] are those belonging to Bhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsānmantrī tanau kuryādvakṣyamāṇānyathākramam /
śirolalāṭabhrūmadhye tālukaṇṭhagalorasi //
meaning:
न्यासान्मन्त्री तनौ कुर्याद्वक्ष्यमाणान्यथाक्रमम् /
शिरोललाटभ्रूमध्ये तालुकण्ठगलोरसि //
text_mt: The practitioner of mantra should perform the ritual placements on the body to be described, in due order: / on the head, forehead, between the eyebrows, palate, throat, neck, chest,

sanskrit_iast:
anāhate bhujadvandve jaṭhare nābhimaṇḍale /
svādhiṣṭhāne guptadeśe pādayordakṣavāmayoḥ //
meaning:
अनाहते भुजद्वन्द्वे जठरे नाभिमण्डले /
स्वाधिष्ठाने गुप्तदेशे पादयोर्दक्षवामयोः //
text_mt: the heart-lotus, the pair of arms, the belly, the navel circle, / the svādhiṣṭhāna, the private part, and the right and left feet,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlādhāre gude nyasyetpadānyaṣṭādaśa kramāt /
guṇaikadvicatuḥ ṣaḍbhirvasuparvanavāṣṭabhiḥ //
meaning:
मूलाधारे गुदे न्यस्येत्पदान्यष्टादश क्रमात् /
गुणैकद्विचतुः षड्भिर्वसुपर्वनवाष्टभिः //
text_mt: on the mūlādhāra and the anus, one should place the eighteen parts in order, / with [units of] three, one, two, four, six, eight, joint [six], nine, eight,

sanskrit_iast:
nandapaṅktyaṣṭavedāgnicandrayugmaguṇā kṣibhiḥ /
yadukḷptiriyaṃ proktā mantravarṇairyathākramam //
meaning:
नन्दपङ्क्त्यष्टवेदाग्निचन्द्रयुग्मगुणा क्षिभिः /
यदुकॢप्तिरियं प्रोक्ता मन्त्रवर्णैर्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: nine, ten, eight, four, three, one, two, three, and two [syllables]. / This division is proclaimed according to the letters of the mantra in due sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
ratyādyā mṛlahṛdayabhrumadhyeṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ /
vākśaktilakṣmībījādyā mātaṅgyantāḥ pravinyaset //
meaning:
रत्याद्या मृलहृदयभ्रुमध्येषु विचक्षणः /
वाक्शक्तिलक्ष्मीबीजाद्या मातङ्ग्यन्ताः प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt: The wise man should place Rati and the other [śaktis] at the mūla, heart, and between the eyebrows, / preceded by the seed-syllables of speech, śakti, and Lakṣmī, ending with 'Mātaṅgī'.

sanskrit_iast:
śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu vidhinā nyaset /
hṛllekhāṃ gaganāṃ raktāṃ bhūyo mantrī karālikām //
meaning:
शिरोवदनहृद्गुह्यपादेषु विधिना न्यसेत् /
हृल्लेखां गगनां रक्तां भूयो मन्त्री करालिकाम् //
text_mt: He should place them according to rule on the head, face, heart, private region, and feet. / The practitioner of mantra should again place Hṛllekhā, Gaganā, Raktā, Karālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
mahocchuṣmāṃ svanāmādivarṇabījapuraḥ sarāḥ /
mātaṅgyantāḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tataḥ kurvīta sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
महोच्छुष्मां स्वनामादिवर्णबीजपुरः सराः /
मातङ्ग्यन्ताः षडङ्गानि ततः कुर्वीत साधकः //
text_mt: and Mahocchuṣmā, preceded by the seed-letters of their own names, / and ending with 'Mātaṅgī'. Then the adept should perform the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇaiścaturviṃśatibhirhṛttrayodaśabhiḥ śiraḥ /
śikhāṣṭādaśabhiḥ proktā varma tāvadbhirakṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
वर्णैश्चतुर्विंशतिभिर्हृत्त्रयोदशभिः शिरः /
शिखाष्टादशभिः प्रोक्ता वर्म तावद्भिरक्षरैः //
text_mt: The heart is taught with twenty-four syllables, the head with thirteen, / the topknot with eighteen, and the armor with as many syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
syāttrayodaśabhirnetraṃ dvābhyāmastraṃ prakīrtitam /
bāṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādbhairavīproktavartmanā //
meaning:
स्यात्त्रयोदशभिर्नेत्रं द्वाभ्यामस्त्रं प्रकीर्तितम् /
बाणन्यासं ततः कुर्याद्भैरवीप्रोक्तवर्त्मना //
text_mt: the eyes with thirteen, and the weapon is declared to be with two. / Then he should perform the arrow placement according to the path taught for Bhairavī.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgīpadayoścānyaṃ manmathānvadanāṃśayoḥ /
pārsvakaṭyornābhideśe kaṭipārśvāṃśake punaḥ //
meaning:
मातङ्गीपदयोश्चान्यं मन्मथान्वदनांशयोः /
पार्स्वकट्योर्नाभिदेशे कटिपार्श्वांशके पुनः //
text_mt: Ending with the word 'Mātaṅgī', and the other with Manmatha, on the face and shoulders, / on the flanks and hips, in the navel region, and again on the hips, flanks, and shoulders,

sanskrit_iast:
bījatrayādikānmantrī manmathaṃ makaradhvajam /
madanaṃ puṣpadhanvānaṃ pañcamaṃ kusumāyudham //
meaning:
बीजत्रयादिकान्मन्त्री मन्मथं मकरध्वजम् /
मदनं पुष्पधन्वानं पञ्चमं कुसुमायुधम् //
text_mt: preceded by the three seed-syllables, the practitioner of mantra [places] Manmatha, Makaradhvaja, / Madana, Puṣpadhanvan, and fifth, Kusumāyudha,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhaṃ kandarpanāmānaṃ manobhavaratipriyau /
mātaṅgyantāstato nyasyetsthāneṣveteṣu mantravit //
meaning:
षष्ठं कन्दर्पनामानं मनोभवरतिप्रियौ /
मातङ्ग्यन्तास्ततो न्यस्येत्स्थानेष्वेतेषु मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: sixth, the one named Kandarpa, Manobhava, and Ratipriya; / ending with 'Mātaṅgī', the knower of mantra should then place them in these positions:

sanskrit_iast:
kusumā mekhalā caiva madanā madanā turā /
madanavegā sambhavā ca bhuvanapālendurekhikā //
meaning:
कुसुमा मेखला चैव मदना मदना तुरा /
मदनवेगा सम्भवा च भुवनपालेन्दुरेखिका //
text_mt: Kusumā, Mekhalā, Madanā, Madanāturā, / Madanavegā, Sambhavā, Bhuvanapālā, and Indurekhikā,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgapadapūrvāśca mātaṅgyantāḥ samīritāḥ /
vinyastavyāstato mūle 'dhiṣṭhāne maṇipūrake //
meaning:
अनङ्गपदपूर्वाश्च मातङ्ग्यन्ताः समीरिताः /
विन्यस्तव्यास्ततो मूले ऽधिष्ठाने मणिपूरके //
text_mt: preceded by the word 'Anaṅga' and ending with 'Mātaṅgī', are proclaimed. / They are then to be placed in the mūla, the adhiṣṭhāna, the maṇipūraka,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtkaṇṭhāsye bhruvormadhye mastake cāpi matriṇā /
ādye lakṣmīsarasvatyau ratiḥ prītiśca kṛttikā //
meaning:
हृत्कण्ठास्ये भ्रुवोर्मध्ये मस्तके चापि मत्रिणा /
आद्ये लक्ष्मीसरस्वत्यौ रतिः प्रीतिश्च कृत्तिका //
text_mt: the heart, the throat, the face, between the eyebrows, and on the head by the practitioner of mantra. / First, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī, Rati, Prīti, and Kṛttikā,

sanskrit_iast:
śāntiḥ puṣṭiḥ punastuṣṭimārtagaṃpadaśekharā /
mūlamantraṃ pṛthaṅnyasyennijamūrddhani mantravit //
meaning:
शान्तिः पुष्टिः पुनस्तुष्टिमार्तगंपदशेखरा /
मूलमन्त्रं पृथङ्न्यस्येन्निजमूर्द्धनि मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Śānti, Puṣṭi, and again Tuṣṭi, crowned with the word 'Mātaṅgī'. / The knower of mantra should place the root mantra separately on his own head,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāradeśe 'dhiṣṭhāne nābhau paścādanāhate /
kaṇṭhadeśe bhravormadhye bindau bhūyaḥ kalā padoḥ //
meaning:
आधारदेशे ऽधिष्ठाने नाभौ पश्चादनाहते /
कण्ठदेशे भ्रवोर्मध्ये बिन्दौ भूयः कला पदोः //
text_mt: in the region of the ādhāra, in the adhiṣṭhāna, in the navel, next in the anāhata, / in the throat region, between the eyebrows, at the bindu, then at the kalā and the padas,

sanskrit_iast:
nirodhikāyāmarddhendunāde nādāntayoḥ punaḥ /
unnatāṃseṣu vaktre ca dhruvamaṇḍalake śive //
meaning:
निरोधिकायामर्द्धेन्दुनादे नादान्तयोः पुनः /
उन्नतांसेषु वक्त्रे च ध्रुवमण्डलके शिवे //
text_mt: in the nirodhikā, the crescent moon, the sound, and at the ends of the sound, / on the elevated shoulders, in the mouth, and in the dhruvamaṇḍala, the auspicious center.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgyantāḥ pravinyasye dvāmāṃ jyeṣṭhamataḥ param /
raudrīṃ praśāntāṃ śraddhākhyāṃ punarmāheśvarīmatha //
meaning:
मातङ्ग्यन्ताः प्रविन्यस्ये द्वामां ज्येष्ठमतः परम् /
रौद्रीं प्रशान्तां श्रद्धाख्यां पुनर्माहेश्वरीमथ //
text_mt: Ending with 'Mātaṅgī', he should place Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, after that / Raudrī, Praśāntā, the one called Śraddhā, and further Māheśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāśaktiṃ sulakṣmīṃ ca sṛṣṭiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca mohinīm /
pramathāśvāsinīṃ vidyullatāṃ cicchaktimapyatha //
meaning:
क्रियाशक्तिं सुलक्ष्मीं च सृष्टिं संज्ञां च मोहिनीम् /
प्रमथाश्वासिनीं विद्युल्लतां चिच्छक्तिमप्यथ //
text_mt: Kriyāśakti, Sulakṣmī, Sṛṣṭi, Saṃjñā, and Mohinī, / Pramathā, Āśvāsinī, Vidyullatā, and Cicchakti,

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca sundarīṃ nindāṃ nandabuddhimimāḥ kramāt /
śirobhālahṛdādhāreṣvetā bījatrayādhikāḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च सुन्दरीं निन्दां नन्दबुद्धिमिमाः क्रमात् /
शिरोभालहृदाधारेष्वेता बीजत्रयाधिकाः //
text_mt: and then Sundarī, Nindā, and Nandabuddhi, in order. / Augmented with the three seed-syllables, on the head, forehead, heart, and ādhāra,

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgyādyāḥ pravinyasyedyathāvaddeśikottamaḥ /
mātaṅgīṃ mahadādyāṃ tāṃ mahālakṣmīpadādikām //
meaning:
मातङ्ग्याद्याः प्रविन्यस्येद्यथावद्देशिकोत्तमः /
मातङ्गीं महदाद्यां तां महालक्ष्मीपदादिकाम् //
text_mt: the excellent teacher should duly place these, beginning with 'Mātaṅgī': / Mātaṅgī beginning with Mahat, and that one beginning with the word 'Mahālakṣmī'.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhalakṣmīpadādyāṃ ca mūlamādhāramaṇḍalam /
nyasettenaiva kurvīta vyāpakaṃ deśikottamaḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धलक्ष्मीपदाद्यां च मूलमाधारमण्डलम् /
न्यसेत्तेनैव कुर्वीत व्यापकं देशिकोत्तमः //
text_mt: The best of teachers should perform the ritual placement of the root and the supportive maṇḍala / beginning with the word 'siddhalakṣmī', and with that very [mantra] perform the comprehensive permeation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nyastaśarīro 'sau cintayenmantradevatām /
śyāmāṃ śukoktiṃ śṛṇvantīṃ nyastaikāṅghriśiroruhām //
meaning:
एवं न्यस्तशरीरो ऽसौ चिन्तयेन्मन्त्रदेवताम् /
श्यामां शुकोक्तिं शृण्वन्तीं न्यस्तैकाङ्घ्रिशिरोरुहाम् //
text_mt: Having thus placed [the mantra upon] his body, he should contemplate the deity of the mantra: / dark-complexioned, listening to the words of a parrot, one foot placed upon the hair of [Śiva's] head,

sanskrit_iast:
śaśikhaṇḍadharāṃ vīṇāṃ vādayantīṃ madhūnmadām /
raktāṃśukāṃ ca kahlāramālāśobhitacūlikām //
meaning:
शशिखण्डधरां वीणां वादयन्तीं मधून्मदाम् /
रक्तांशुकां च कह्लारमालाशोभितचूलिकाम् //
text_mt: bearing the crescent moon, playing the vīṇā, intoxicated with honey-wine, / clad in red garments, her crest of hair adorned with a garland of white water-lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhapatrāṃ tu mātaṅgīṃ citrakodbhāsimastakām /
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ madhūkajaiḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खपत्रां तु मातङ्गीं चित्रकोद्भासिमस्तकाम् /
अयुतं प्रजपेन्मन्त्रं तद्दशांशं मधूकजैः //
text_mt: wearing ear ornaments of conch shell, Mātaṅgī, her forehead gleaming with decorative sectarian marks. / He should recite the mantra ten thousand times, and [offer] a tenth of that with blossoms

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaistrimadhuropetairjuhuyānmantrasiddhaye /
trikoṇakarṇikaṃ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ prakalpayet //
meaning:
पुष्पैस्त्रिमधुरोपेतैर्जुहुयान्मन्त्रसिद्धये /
त्रिकोणकर्णिकं पद्ममष्टपत्रं प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: produced from the Madhūka tree mixed with the three sweet substances, to achieve the mantra's perfection. / One should fashion an eight-petalled lotus whose pericarp is a triangle,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭapatrāvṛtaṃ bāhye vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ /
caturasrīkṛtaṃ bāhye kāntyā dṛṣṭimanoharam //
meaning:
अष्टपत्रावृतं बाह्ये वृतं षोडशभिर्दलैः /
चतुरस्रीकृतं बाह्ये कान्त्या दृष्टिमनोहरम् //
text_mt: surrounded on the outside by eight petals, surrounded by sixteen petals, / squared on the exterior, delighting the sight with its beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminpūjayetpīṭhe navaśaktīḥ kramādimāḥ /
vibhūtipūrvāḥ pūrvoktā mātaṅgīpadapaścimāḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्पूजयेत्पीठे नवशक्तीः क्रमादिमाः /
विभूतिपूर्वाः पूर्वोक्ता मातङ्गीपदपश्चिमाः //
text_mt: On this ritual seat one should worship these nine powers in proper order: / those mentioned earlier beginning with Vibhūti, and ending with the word 'mātaṅgī';

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānte śaktikamalāsanāya nama ityatha /
vāksatyalakṣmī bījādya uktaḥ pīṭhārcane manuḥ //
meaning:
सर्वान्ते शक्तिकमलासनाय नम इत्यथ /
वाक्सत्यलक्ष्मी बीजाद्य उक्तः पीठार्चने मनुः //
text_mt: then ending with 'śaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ' for all of them. / The mantra beginning with the seed-syllables Vāc, Satya, and Lakṣmī has been declared for worshipping the ritual seat.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlena mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya tasyāmāvāhya devatām /
arcayedvidhinānena vakṣyamāṇena mantravit //
meaning:
मूलेन मूर्तिं संकल्प्य तस्यामावाह्य देवताम् /
अर्चयेद्विधिनानेन वक्ष्यमाणेन मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Having visualized the form with the root mantra and invoked the deity into it, / the knower of mantra should worship according to this procedure that will be explained.

sanskrit_iast:
ratyādyāstriṣu koṇeṣu pūjayetpūrvavatsudhīḥ /
hṛhṛllekhāḥ pañcapūjyā madhye dikṣu ca mantriṇā //
meaning:
रत्याद्यास्त्रिषु कोणेषु पूजयेत्पूर्ववत्सुधीः /
हृहृल्लेखाः पञ्चपूज्या मध्ये दिक्षु च मन्त्रिणा //
text_mt: The wise practitioner should worship Rati and the others in the three corners as before. / In the centre and in the directions, five Hṛllekhā mantras should be worshipped by the practitioner,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśābhayābhīṣṭadhāriṇyo bhūtasaprabhāḥ /
aṅgāni pūjayetpaścādyathāpūrvaṃ vidhānavit //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशाभयाभीष्टधारिण्यो भूतसप्रभाः /
अङ्गानि पूजयेत्पश्चाद्यथापूर्वं विधानवित् //
text_mt: holding a noose, a goad, the gesture of fearlessness, and the gesture granting desires, radiant like spirits. / Knowing the ritual procedure, he should then worship the limbs as before.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇānabhyarcayeddikṣu pañcamaṃ purato yajet /
dalamadhye 'tha saṃpūjyā anaṅgakusumādikāḥ //
meaning:
बाणानभ्यर्चयेद्दिक्षु पञ्चमं पुरतो यजेत् /
दलमध्ये ऽथ संपूज्या अनङ्गकुसुमादिकाः //
text_mt: He should worship the arrows in the cardinal directions, and the fifth in front. / Then in the middle of the petals, [the deities] beginning with Anaṅgakusumā are to be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśābhayābhīṣṭadhāriṇyo 'ruṇavigrahāḥ /
patrāgreṣu punaḥ pūjyā lakṣmyādyā vallakīkarāḥ //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशाभयाभीष्टधारिण्यो ऽरुणविग्रहाः /
पत्राग्रेषु पुनः पूज्या लक्ष्म्याद्या वल्लकीकराः //
text_mt: holding a noose, a goad, the gesture of fearlessness, and the gesture granting desires, with red bodies. / Again, on the tips of the petals, those beginning with Lakṣmī, holding vīṇās in their hands, are to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
bahiraṣṭadaleṣvarcyā manmathādyā madoddhatāḥ /
aparāṅgā niṣaṅgādyāḥ puṣpāstreṣudhanurddharāḥ //
meaning:
बहिरष्टदलेष्वर्च्या मन्मथाद्या मदोद्धताः /
अपराङ्गा निषङ्गाद्याः पुष्पास्त्रेषुधनुर्द्धराः //
text_mt: On the outer eight petals, those beginning with Manmatha, insolent with intoxication, / with other limbs [adorned], equipped with quivers, holding flower arrows and bows, should be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
patrasthā mātaraḥ pūjyā brāhmādyāḥ proktalakṣaṇāḥ /
tadagreṣvarcayedvidvānasitāṅgādibhairavān //
meaning:
पत्रस्था मातरः पूज्या ब्राह्माद्याः प्रोक्तलक्षणाः /
तदग्रेष्वर्चयेद्विद्वानसिताङ्गादिभैरवान् //
text_mt: The Mothers positioned on the petals, beginning with Brāhmī and possessing the characteristics described, are to be worshipped. / In front of them the wise practitioner should worship the Bhairavas beginning with Asitāṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ ṣoḍaśa patreṣu pūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśa śaktayaḥ /
vāmādyāḥ kalavīṇābhirgāyantyaḥ śyāmavigrahāḥ //
meaning:
पुनः षोडश पत्रेषु पूज्याः षोडश शक्तयः /
वामाद्याः कलवीणाभिर्गायन्त्यः श्यामविग्रहाः //
text_mt: Again, on the sixteen petals the sixteen powers are to be worshipped: / Vāmā and the others, singing with sweet-sounding vīṇās, having dark forms.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasre caturdikṣu catasraḥ pūjayetpunaḥ /
mātaṅgyādyāmadonmattā vīṇollasitapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
चतुरस्रे चतुर्दिक्षु चतस्रः पूजयेत्पुनः /
मातङ्ग्याद्यामदोन्मत्ता वीणोल्लसितपाणयः //
text_mt: On the square [enclosure], in the four directions, one should again worship the four / beginning with Mātaṅgī, mad with intoxication, their hands resplendent with vīṇās.

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyakoṇe vighneśaṃ durgāṃ naiśācareḥ yajet /
vāyavye baṭukān paścādīśāne kṣetrapaṃ yajet //
meaning:
आग्नेयकोणे विघ्नेशं दुर्गां नैशाचरेः यजेत् /
वायव्ये बटुकान् पश्चादीशाने क्षेत्रपं यजेत् //
text_mt: In the south-eastern corner one should worship Vighneśa, and in the south-western Durga. / In the north-western he should worship the Baṭukas, and subsequently Kṣetrapa in the north-eastern.

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālā bahiḥ pūjyā vajrādyairāyudhaiḥ saha /
mantre 'sminsaṃdhite mantrī sādhayediṣṭamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
लोकपाला बहिः पूज्या वज्राद्यैरायुधैः सह /
मन्त्रे ऽस्मिन्संधिते मन्त्री साधयेदिष्टमात्मनः //
text_mt: The guardians of the world are to be worshipped outside together with their weapons, such as the thunderbolt. / When this mantra is mastered, the practitioner achieves his desired goal.

sanskrit_iast:
mallikājātipunnāgairhemādbhāgyālayo bhavet /
phalaurbilyasamudbhūtaistatpatrairvā hutādbhavet //
meaning:
मल्लिकाजातिपुन्नागैर्हेमाद्भाग्यालयो भवेत् /
फलौर्बिल्यसमुद्भूतैस्तत्पत्रैर्वा हुताद्भवेत् //
text_mt: From a fire oblation with mallikā, jātī, and punnāga flowers, one becomes an abode of good fortune. / From an oblation of bilva fruits or with its leaves,

sanskrit_iast:
rājaputrasya rājyāptiḥ paṅkajaiḥ śriyamāpnuyāt /
utpalairvaśayedviśvaṃ kṣārairmadhvāśritaiḥ striyam //
meaning:
राजपुत्रस्य राज्याप्तिः पङ्कजैः श्रियमाप्नुयात् /
उत्पलैर्वशयेद्विश्वं क्षारैर्मध्वाश्रितैः स्त्रियम् //
text_mt: a prince attains a kingdom. With lotuses one obtains fortune. / With blue water lilies one can subjugate the universe; with ashes mixed with honey, a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
vañjulasya samidbhomo vṛṣṭiṃ vitanute 'cirāt /
kṣīrāktairamṛtākhaṇḍairhemānnāśayati jvaram //
meaning:
वञ्जुलस्य समिद्भोमो वृष्टिं वितनुते ऽचिरात् /
क्षीराक्तैरमृताखण्डैर्हेमान्नाशयति ज्वरम् //
text_mt: A fire oblation with kindling sticks of vañjula quickly causes rain. / By oblations of pieces of amṛtā smeared with milk, he destroys fever.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvābhirāyurāpnoti tandulairdhanavānbhavet /
kadaṃbairvaśyamāpnoti sarvaṃ trimadhuraplutam //
meaning:
दूर्वाभिरायुराप्नोति तन्दुलैर्धनवान्भवेत् /
कदंबैर्वश्यमाप्नोति सर्वं त्रिमधुरप्लुतम् //
text_mt: Through dūrvā grass he gains long life; through grains of rice he becomes wealthy. / With kadamba flowers he obtains subjugation; everything should be bathed in the three sweets.

sanskrit_iast:
nandyāvartabhavaiḥ puṣpairhemo vāksiddhidāyakaḥ /
niṃbaprasūnairjuhuyādīpsitaśrīsamṛddhaye //
meaning:
नन्द्यावर्तभवैः पुष्पैर्हेमो वाक्सिद्धिदायकः /
निंबप्रसूनैर्जुहुयादीप्सितश्रीसमृद्धये //
text_mt: A fire oblation with flowers born of the nandyāvarta grants perfection of speech. / One should offer with nimba blossoms for prosperity and desired fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśakusumairhemāttejasvī jāyate naraḥ /
candanāgurukastūrī candrakuṅkumarocanāḥ //
meaning:
पलाशकुसुमैर्हेमात्तेजस्वी जायते नरः /
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरी चन्द्रकुङ्कुमरोचनाः //
text_mt: From a fire oblation with palāśa blossoms, a man becomes radiant. / Sandalwood, agallochum, musk, camphor, saffron, and rocanā,

sanskrit_iast:
vaśyāya ca priyatvāya hutāśca tilakīkṛtāḥ /
nirguṇḍīmūlahomena nigaḍānmucyate naraḥ //
meaning:
वश्याय च प्रियत्वाय हुताश्च तिलकीकृताः /
निर्गुण्डीमूलहोमेन निगडान्मुच्यते नरः //
text_mt: offered in the fire and applied as a forehead mark, lead to subjugation and fondness. / By a fire oblation of nirguṇḍī roots, a man is freed from fetters.

sanskrit_iast:
niṃbatailānvitairloṇairhemaḥ śatruvināśanaḥ /
haridrācūrṇasaṃmiśrairlavaṇaiḥ staṃbhayejjagat //
meaning:
निंबतैलान्वितैर्लोणैर्हेमः शत्रुविनाशनः /
हरिद्राचूर्णसंमिश्रैर्लवणैः स्तंभयेज्जगत् //
text_mt: A fire oblation with salt mixed with nimba oil destroys enemies. / With salt mixed with turmeric powder, one can paralyze the world.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgīsiddhavidyaiṣā proktā te dvijasattama /
avatārāntaraṃ bhūyo varṇayāmi niśāmaya //
meaning:
मातङ्गीसिद्धविद्यैषा प्रोक्ता ते द्विजसत्तम /
अवतारान्तरं भूयो वर्णयामि निशामय //
text_mt: This proven lore of Mātaṅgī has been told to you, O best of the twice-born. / Now hear another incarnation, which I shall describe further.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpakāprīticandrāḍhyā dvidhā cedrañjitāpunaḥ /
vativahnipriyāmantro dhūmāvatyā gajākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
दीपकाप्रीतिचन्द्राढ्या द्विधा चेद्रञ्जितापुनः /
वतिवह्निप्रियामन्त्रो धूमावत्या गजाक्षरः //
text_mt: Provided with dīpaka, aprīti, and the moon, twice colored again, / ending with the wife of fire: such is Dhūmāvatī's eight-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
pippalādo muniśchando nivṛddhūmāvatīśvarī /
bījena ṣaḍdīrghajātiyuktena parikalpayet //
meaning:
पिप्पलादो मुनिश्छन्दो निवृद्धूमावतीश्वरी /
बीजेन षड्दीर्घजातियुक्तेन परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: The sage is Pippalāda; the metre is nivṛt; the deity is Dhūmāvatī. / One should construct [the limbs] with the bīja joined to the six long vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhūmāvatīṃ dhyāyecchatrunigrahakāriṇīm /
vivarṇāṃ cañcalāṃ duṣṭāṃ dīrghāṃ ca malināṃbarām //
meaning:
ततो धूमावतीं ध्यायेच्छत्रुनिग्रहकारिणीम् /
विवर्णां चञ्चलां दुष्टां दीर्घां च मलिनांबराम् //
text_mt: Then one should meditate upon Dhūmāvatī, who effects the suppression of enemies: / discolored, restless, fierce, tall, wearing soiled garments,

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktakuntalāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vidhavāṃ viraladvijām /
kaṅkadhvajarathārūḍhāṃ pralaṃbitapayodharam //
meaning:
विमुक्तकुन्तलां सूक्ष्मां विधवां विरलद्विजाम् /
कङ्कध्वजरथारूढां प्रलंबितपयोधरम् //
text_mt: with disheveled hair, emaciated, a widow with sparse teeth, / mounted on a chariot with a crow-banner, with hanging breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryahastāṃ nirukṣāṅkadhṛtahastāṃbarānvitām /
pravṛddhalomāṃ tu bhṛśaṃ kuṭilākuṭilekṣaṇām //
meaning:
सूर्यहस्तां निरुक्षाङ्कधृतहस्तांबरान्विताम् /
प्रवृद्धलोमां तु भृशं कुटिलाकुटिलेक्षणाम् //
text_mt: holding a winnowing basket, wearing dry clothes held in hand, / with an excessive growth of hair, and with exceedingly crooked eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣutpipāsārditāṃ nityaṃ bhayadāṃ kalahapriyām /
evaṃvidhāṃ tu saṃcintya namaḥ svāhā phaḍantakam //
meaning:
क्षुत्पिपासार्दितां नित्यं भयदां कलहप्रियाम् /
एवंविधां तु संचिन्त्य नमः स्वाहा फडन्तकम् //
text_mt: constantly tormented by hunger and thirst, terrifying, fond of quarrels. / Having thus meditated upon her, [with the mantra] ending in namaḥ, svāhā, and phaṭ,

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ sādhyopari nyasya tasminsthāpya śavaṃ japet /
avaṣṭabhya śavaṃ śatrunāmnātha prajapenmanum //
meaning:
बीजं साध्योपरि न्यस्य तस्मिन्स्थाप्य शवं जपेत् /
अवष्टभ्य शवं शत्रुनाम्नाथ प्रजपेन्मनुम् //
text_mt: placing the bīja upon the target, setting a corpse thereon, one should recite. / Gripping the corpse, one should then recite the mantra with the enemy's name.

sanskrit_iast:
soṣṇīṣakañcuko vidvānkṛṣṇe bhūte divāniśam /
upavāsī śmaśāne vā vipine śūnyamandire //
meaning:
सोष्णीषकञ्चुको विद्वान्कृष्णे भूते दिवानिशम् /
उपवासी श्मशाने वा विपिने शून्यमन्दिरे //
text_mt: Wearing a turban and armor, the learned man, in the dark half, on the fourteenth lunar day, day and night, / fasting in a cremation ground, or in a forest, or an empty house,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasya siddhyai yatavāgdhyāyandevīṃ nirantaram /
sahasrādūrddhūtaḥ śatrurjvareṇa parigṛhyate //
meaning:
मन्त्रस्य सिद्ध्यै यतवाग्ध्यायन्देवीं निरन्तरम् /
सहस्रादूर्द्धूतः शत्रुर्ज्वरेण परिगृह्यते //
text_mt: restraining his speech for the success of the mantra, meditating constantly on the goddess: / the enemy, agitated from a thousand [recitations], is seized by fever.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyena śāntiḥ syājjvarasya payasāpi vā /
mantrādyā kṣaramālikhya śatrūnāma tataḥ param //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्येन शान्तिः स्याज्ज्वरस्य पयसापि वा /
मन्त्राद्या क्षरमालिख्य शत्रूनाम ततः परम् //
text_mt: Relief of the fever comes from pañcagavya or from milk. / Having inscribed the first syllable of the mantra, then the enemy's name,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ manuvarṇaṃ ca śatrunāmaivamālikhet /
sarvaṃ manudiksahasrajapācchavamṛtirbhavet //
meaning:
द्वितीयं मनुवर्णं च शत्रुनामैवमालिखेत् /
सर्वं मनुदिक्सहस्रजपाच्छवमृतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: and the second syllable of the mantra, one should thus write the enemy's name. / From ten thousand recitations of the whole mantra, death of the corpse-like person occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā kaṅkaṃ śyaśānāgnau tadbhasmādāya mantravit /
virodhināmnāṣṭaśataṃ japtamuccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा कङ्कं श्यशानाग्नौ तद्भस्मादाय मन्त्रवित् /
विरोधिनाम्नाष्टशतं जप्तमुच्चाटनं रिपोः //
text_mt: Having burned a crow in the fire of the cremation ground and taken its ash, the mantra-knower, / reciting a hundred and eight times with the adversary's name, causes the enemy's expulsion.

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānabhasmanā kṛtvā śavaṃ tasyopari nyaset /
virodhināmasaṃruddhaṃ kṛṣṇe pakṣe samuccaret //
meaning:
श्मशानभस्मना कृत्वा शवं तस्योपरि न्यसेत् /
विरोधिनामसंरुद्धं कृष्णे पक्षे समुच्चरेत् //
text_mt: Having fashioned a corpse with ash from a cremation ground, one should place [the mantra] upon it; / one should utter it enclosed by the adversary's name during the dark fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣīkṣīradhūpaṃ ca dadyācchatruvipatkaram /
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ avatāracatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
महिषीक्षीरधूपं च दद्याच्छत्रुविपत्करम् /
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं अवतारचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: One should offer incense of buffalo milk, which causes calamity to the enemy. / Thus the four incarnations have been spoken of in brief

sanskrit_iast:
durgāyā jagadaṃbāyāḥ kiṃ punaḥ praṣṭumicchasi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde durgāmantracatuṣṭayavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
दुर्गाया जगदंबायाः किं पुनः प्रष्टुमिच्छसि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे दुर्गामन्त्रचतुष्टयवर्णनं नाम सप्ताशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
of Durgā, the Mother of the Universe. What more do you wish to ask?

Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Four Mantras of Durgā,' in the third quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrutvetthaṃ yajanaṃ viprā mantradhyānapuraḥsaram /
sarvāsāmavatārāṇāṃ nārado devadarśanaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रुत्वेत्थं यजनं विप्रा मन्त्रध्यानपुरःसरम् /
सर्वासामवताराणां नारदो देवदर्शनः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having thus heard the worship along with the mantras and meditation, O Brahmins, / of all the incarnations, Nārada, who sees the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādyāyā jaganmātuḥ śrīrādhāyāḥ samarcanam /
avatārakalānāṃ hi papraccha vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाद्याया जगन्मातुः श्रीराधायाः समर्चनम् /
अवतारकलानां हि पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: asked, full of humility, about the worship of the primeval Mother of the Universe, / the glorious Rādhā, and about the parts of her incarnations.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
dhanyo 'smikṛtakṛtyo 'smi jāto 'haṃ tvatprasādataḥ /
pajjaganmātṛmantrāṇāṃ vaibhavaṃ śrutavānmune //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
धन्यो ऽस्मिकृतकृत्यो ऽस्मि जातो ऽहं त्वत्प्रसादतः /
पज्जगन्मातृमन्त्राणां वैभवं श्रुतवान्मुने //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I am blessed! I have accomplished my purpose through your grace, / since I have heard the glory of the mantras of the Mother of the Universe, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā lakṣmīmukhānāṃ tu avatārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
tathā rādhāvatārāṇāṃ śrotumicchāmi vaibhavam //
meaning:
यथा लक्ष्मीमुखानां तु अवताराः प्रकीर्तिताः /
तथा राधावताराणां श्रोतुमिच्छामि वैभवम् //
text_mt: Just as the incarnations of Lakṣmī and others have been proclaimed, / so I wish to hear the glory of the incarnations of Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
yatsaṃkhyākāśca yadrūpā yatprabhāvā vidāṃvara /
rādhāvatārāstānsatyaṃ kīrtayāśeṣasiddhidān //
meaning:
यत्संख्याकाश्च यद्रूपा यत्प्रभावा विदांवर /
राधावतारास्तान्सत्यं कीर्तयाशेषसिद्धिदान् //
text_mt: Whatever their number, form, and power, O best among the knowers: / tell truly of those incarnations of Rādhā which grant complete success!

sanskrit_iast:
etacchutvā vacastasya nāradasya vidheḥ sutaḥ /
sanatkumāraḥ provāca dhyātvā rādhāpadāṃbujam //
meaning:
एतच्छुत्वा वचस्तस्य नारदस्य विधेः सुतः /
सनत्कुमारः प्रोवाच ध्यात्वा राधापदांबुजम् //
text_mt: Having heard those words of Nārada, Brahmā's son, / Sanatkumāra, spoke, after meditating on Rādhā's lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi rahasyātirahasyakam /
rādhāvatāracaritaṃ bhajatāmiṣṭisiddhidam //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यातिरहस्यकम् /
राधावतारचरितं भजतामिष्टिसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Listen, O Brahmin, I will declare the secret of secrets, / the deeds of Rādhā's incarnations, granting the fulfillment of wishes to those who worship.

sanskrit_iast:
candrāvalī ca lalitā dve sakhyau supriye sadā /
mālāvatīmukhāṣṭānāṃ candrāvalyadhipāsmṛtā //
meaning:
चन्द्रावली च ललिता द्वे सख्यौ सुप्रिये सदा /
मालावतीमुखाष्टानां चन्द्रावल्यधिपास्मृता //
text_mt: Candrāvalī and Lalitā are always two very dear companions. / Candrāvalī is considered the ruler of the eight headed by Mālāvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāvatīmukhāṣṭānāmīśvarī lalitā matā /
rādhācaraṇapūjāyāmuktā mālāvatīmukhāḥ //
meaning:
कलावतीमुखाष्टानामीश्वरी ललिता मता /
राधाचरणपूजायामुक्ता मालावतीमुखाः //
text_mt: Lalitā is considered the sovereign mistress of the eight headed by Kalāvatī. / Those headed by Mālāvatī are mentioned in the worship of Rādhā's feet.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitādhīśvarīṇāṃ tu nāmāni śṛṇu sāṃpratam /
kalāvatī madhumatī viśākhā śyāmalābhidhā //
meaning:
ललिताधीश्वरीणां तु नामानि शृणु सांप्रतम् /
कलावती मधुमती विशाखा श्यामलाभिधा //
text_mt: Now hear the names of the female deities ruled by Lalitā: / Kalāvatī, Madhumatī, Viśākhā, she whose name is Śyāmalā,

sanskrit_iast:
śaibyā vṛndā śrīdharākhyā sarvāstuttulyavigrahāḥ /
suśīlāpramukhā ścānyāḥ sakhyo dvātriṃśadīritāḥ //
meaning:
शैब्या वृन्दा श्रीधराख्या सर्वास्तुत्तुल्यविग्रहाः /
सुशीलाप्रमुखा श्चान्याः सख्यो द्वात्रिंशदीरिताः //
text_mt: Śaibyā, Vṛndā, and the one named Śrīdharā—all of them possessing forms equal to hers. / Thirty-two other companions, headed by Suśīlā, are also declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḥ śṛṇuṣva mahābhāga nāmataḥ pravadāmi te /
suśīlāṃ śaśilekhā ca yamunā mādhavī ratiḥ //
meaning:
ताः शृणुष्व महाभाग नामतः प्रवदामि ते /
सुशीलां शशिलेखा च यमुना माधवी रतिः //
text_mt: Hear them, O fortunate one, I will declare them to you by name: / Suśīlā, Śaśilekhā, Yamunā, Mādhavī, Rati,

sanskrit_iast:
kadambamālā kuntī ca jāhnavī ca svayaṃprabhā /
candrānanā padmamukhī sāvitrī ca sudhāmukhī //
meaning:
कदम्बमाला कुन्ती च जाह्नवी च स्वयंप्रभा /
चन्द्रानना पद्ममुखी सावित्री च सुधामुखी //
text_mt: Kadambamālā, Kuntī, Jāhnavī, Svayaṃprabhā, / Candrānanā, Padmamukhī, Sāvitrī, Sudhāmukhī,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhā padmā pārijātā gauriṇī sarvamaṅgalā /
kālikā kamalā durgā virajā bhāratī surā //
meaning:
शुभा पद्मा पारिजाता गौरिणी सर्वमङ्गला /
कालिका कमला दुर्गा विरजा भारती सुरा //
text_mt: Śubhā, Padmā, Pārijātā, Gauriṇī, Sarvamaṅgalā, / Kālikā, Kamalā, Durgā, Virajā, Bhāratī, Surā,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgā madhumatī caiva sundarī candanā satī /
aparṇā manasānandā dvātriṃśadrādhikāpriyāḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गा मधुमती चैव सुन्दरी चन्दना सती /
अपर्णा मनसानन्दा द्वात्रिंशद्राधिकाप्रियाः //
text_mt: Gaṅgā, Madhumatī, Sundarī, Candanā, Satī, / Aparṇā, and Manasānandā: [these] thirty-two are dear to Rādhikā.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidchalilā devī puṃrūpā kṛṣṇavigrahā /
sasarja ṣoḍaśakalāstāḥ sarvāstatsamaprabhāḥ //
meaning:
कदाचिद्छलिला देवी पुंरूपा कृष्णविग्रहा /
ससर्ज षोडशकलास्ताः सर्वास्तत्समप्रभाः //
text_mt: Once, playing sportively, the goddess, assuming male form with the body of Kṛṣṇa, / created sixteen parts, all possessing splendor equal to his.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsā mantraṃ tathā dhyānaṃ yantrārcādikramaṃ tathā /
varṇaye sarvatantreṣu rahasyaṃ munisattama //
meaning:
तासा मन्त्रं तथा ध्यानं यन्त्रार्चादिक्रमं तथा /
वर्णये सर्वतन्त्रेषु रहस्यं मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: Their mantra, meditation, and ritual procedure of sacred diagrams and worship / I will describe, O best of sages, as the secret in all Tantras.

sanskrit_iast:
vāto maruccāgrivahnī dharākṣme jalacāriṇī /
vimukhaṃ caraśucivibhū vanasvaśaktayaḥ svarāḥ //
meaning:
वातो मरुच्चाग्रिवह्नी धराक्ष्मे जलचारिणी /
विमुखं चरशुचिविभू वनस्वशक्तयः स्वराः //
text_mt: Vāta, Marut, Agni, Vahni, Dharā, Kṣmā, Jalacāriṇī, / Vimukha, Cara, Śuci, Vibhu, the śaktis in the forest, the vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇastejaḥ sthirā vāyurvāyuścāpi prabhā tathā /
jyakumabhraṃ tathā nādo dāvakaḥ pātha ityatha //
meaning:
प्राणस्तेजः स्थिरा वायुर्वायुश्चापि प्रभा तथा /
ज्यकुमभ्रं तथा नादो दावकः पाथ इत्यथ //
text_mt: Prāṇa, Tejas, Sthirā, Vāyu, Vāyu again, Prabhā, / Jyakuma, Abhra, Nāda, Dāvaka, and then Pāthas;

sanskrit_iast:
vyomarayaḥ śikhī gotrā toyaṃ śūnyajavīdyutiḥ /
bhūmī raso namo vyāptaṃ dāhaścāpi rasāṃbu ca //
meaning:
व्योमरयः शिखी गोत्रा तोयं शून्यजवीद्युतिः /
भूमी रसो नमो व्याप्तं दाहश्चापि रसांबु च //
text_mt: Vyomaraya, Śikhin, Gotrā, Toya, Śūnya, Javī, Dyuti, / Bhūmi, Rasa, Namaḥ, Vyāpta, Dāha, and Rasāmbu;

sanskrit_iast:
viyatsparśaśca hṛddhaṃsahalāgrāso halātmikāḥ /
candrāvalī ca lalitā haṃselā nāyake mate //
meaning:
वियत्स्पर्शश्च हृद्धंसहलाग्रासो हलात्मिकाः /
चन्द्रावली च ललिता हंसेला नायके मते //
text_mt: Viyat, Sparśa, and Hṛd, Haṃsa, Halāgrāsa, Halātmikā: / Candrāvalī and Lalitā are regarded as the two leaders, Haṃsa and Ilā.

sanskrit_iast:
grāsasthitā svayaṃ rādhā svayaṃ śaktisvarūpiṇī /
śeṣāstu ṣoḍaśakalā dvātriṃśattatkalāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रासस्थिता स्वयं राधा स्वयं शक्तिस्वरूपिणी /
शेषास्तु षोडशकला द्वात्रिंशत्तत्कलाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Rādhā herself, being of the nature of Śakti itself, stands encompassing them. / The remaining are remembered as the sixteen parts, and thirty-two as their portions.

sanskrit_iast:
vāṅmayaṃ nikhilaṃ vyāptamābhireva munīśvara /
lalitāpramukhāṇāṃ tu ṣoḍaśītvamupāgatā //
meaning:
वाङ्मयं निखिलं व्याप्तमाभिरेव मुनीश्वर /
ललिताप्रमुखाणां तु षोडशीत्वमुपागता //
text_mt: All that consists of speech is pervaded by these alone, O lord of sages. / Lalitā and the other foremost ones attained sixteenfold nature.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrādhā sundarī devī tāntrikaiḥ parikīrtyate /
kurukullā ca vārāhī candrālilalite ubhe //
meaning:
श्रीराधा सुन्दरी देवी तान्त्रिकैः परिकीर्त्यते /
कुरुकुल्ला च वाराही चन्द्रालिललिते उभे //
text_mt: The goddess Sundarī is praised as Śrī Rādhā by tantric practitioners; / Kurukullā and Vārāhī, Candrāli and Lalitā—both of them,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhūte mantravargaṃ te 'bhidhāsye 'haṃ yathātatham /
hṛtprāṇelāhaṃsadāvahnisvairlaliteritā //
meaning:
संभूते मन्त्रवर्गं ते ऽभिधास्ये ऽहं यथातथम् /
हृत्प्राणेलाहंसदावह्निस्वैर्ललितेरिता //
text_mt: Having arisen, I shall describe to you their group of mantras accurately. / Lalitā is pronounced as heart, breath, earth, haṃsa, fire, and independent.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhā haṃsabhedeva śṛṇu tāṃ ca yathākramam /
haṃsādyayādyā madhyā syādādimadhyasthahaṃsayā //
meaning:
त्रिविधा हंसभेदेव शृणु तां च यथाक्रमम् /
हंसाद्ययाद्या मध्या स्यादादिमध्यस्थहंसया //
text_mt: Hear that threefold division according to the classification of haṃsa in due order: / The first has haṃsa at the beginning; the middle one has haṃsa stationed between the beginning and the middle;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyā prakṛtiḥ saiva turyā tairantyamāyayā /
āsu turyābhavanmuktyai tisro 'nyāḥ syuścasaṃpade //
meaning:
तृतीया प्रकृतिः सैव तुर्या तैरन्त्यमायया /
आसु तुर्याभवन्मुक्त्यै तिस्रो ऽन्याः स्युश्चसंपदे //
text_mt: The third is Prakṛti herself; the fourth is regarded by them as having Māyā at the end. / Among these, the fourth is for liberation, and the other three bring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
iti tripurasuṃdaryā vidyā sarumatasamīritā /
dāhabhūmīrasākṣmāsvairvaśinībījamīritam //
meaning:
इति त्रिपुरसुंदर्या विद्या सरुमतसमीरिता /
दाहभूमीरसाक्ष्मास्वैर्वशिनीबीजमीरितम् //
text_mt: Thus the knowledge of Tripurasundarī has been declared according to all opinions. / The bīja of Vaśinī is taught as burning, earth, water, ground, and independent.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo rasāśaktiyutaḥ kāmeśvaryakṣaraṃ mahat /
śūnyamaṃburasāvahnisvayogānmohanīmanuḥ //
meaning:
प्राणो रसाशक्तियुतः कामेश्वर्यक्षरं महत् /
शून्यमंबुरसावह्निस्वयोगान्मोहनीमनुः //
text_mt: Breath united with water and energy is the great syllable of Kāmeśvarī. / The mantra of Mohanī is formed from the union of void, water, taste, fire, and independence.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptaṃ rasākṣmāsvayutaṃ vimalābījamīritam /
jyānabhodāhavahnisvayogaiḥ syādaruṇāmanuḥ //
meaning:
व्याप्तं रसाक्ष्मास्वयुतं विमलाबीजमीरितम् /
ज्यानभोदाहवह्निस्वयोगैः स्यादरुणामनुः //
text_mt: Pervading, joined with water, ground, and independence, is declared the bīja of Vimalā. / The mantra of Aruṇā consists of the unions of earth, sky, burning, fire, and independence.

sanskrit_iast:
jayinyāstu samuddiṣṭaḥ sarvatra jayadāyakaḥ /
kaṃ nabhodāhasahitaṃ vyāptakṣmāsvayutaṃ manuḥ //
meaning:
जयिन्यास्तु समुद्दिष्टः सर्वत्र जयदायकः /
कं नभोदाहसहितं व्याप्तक्ष्मास्वयुतं मनुः //
text_mt: The mantra of Jayinī is proclaimed as granting victory everywhere. / Ka, joined with sky and burning, united with pervading, ground, and independence, is the mantra

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvaryāḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ paraḥ /
grāso nabhodāhavahnisvairyuktaḥ kaulinīmanuḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वर्याः समाख्यातः सर्वसिद्धिकरः परः /
ग्रासो नभोदाहवह्निस्वैर्युक्तः कौलिनीमनुः //
text_mt: Declared of Sarveśvarī, supreme, bestowing all accomplishments. / Swallowing, united with sky, burning, fire, and independence, is the mantra of Kaulinī.

sanskrit_iast:
etairmanubhiraṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhirvargasaṃyuktaiḥ /
vāgdevatāntairnyāsaḥ syādyena devyātmako bhavet //
meaning:
एतैर्मनुभिरष्टाभिः शक्तिभिर्वर्गसंयुक्तैः /
वाग्देवतान्तैर्न्यासः स्याद्येन देव्यात्मको भवेत् //
text_mt: With these mantras, with the eight energies accompanied by the groups [of letters], / ending with the deities of speech, there should be ritual placement by which one becomes identical with the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
randhre bhāle tathājñāyāṃ gale hṛdi tathā nyaset /
nābhāvādhārake pādadvaye mūlāgrakāvadhi //
meaning:
रन्ध्रे भाले तथाज्ञायां गले हृदि तथा न्यसेत् /
नाभावाधारके पादद्वये मूलाग्रकावधि //
text_mt: One should place them in the aperture of the head, on the forehead, likewise in the ājñā-centre, in the throat, and in the heart, / in the navel, in the basic support, and in both feet, up to the tips of the roots.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyena bījena kuryāścaiva ṣaḍaṅgakam /
lohitāṃ lalitāṃ bāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥ //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घाढ्येन बीजेन कुर्याश्चैव षडङ्गकम् /
लोहितां ललितां बाणचापपाशसृणीः करैः //
text_mt: One should also perform the six limbs with the bīja lengthened by the six [vowels]. / One should meditate on the red Lalitā, holding arrows, bow, noose, and goad in her hands,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ kāmarājāṅke yantrītāṃ mudutāṃ smaret /
madhyasthadevī tvekaiva ṣoḍaśākārataḥ sthātā //
meaning:
दधानां कामराजाङ्के यन्त्रीतां मुदुतां स्मरेत् /
मध्यस्थदेवी त्वेकैव षोडशाकारतः स्थाता //
text_mt: Seated on the lap of the King of Desire, restrained, [and] joyful. / But the goddess situated in the center is solitary, yet abiding in sixteen forms.

sanskrit_iast:
yatastasmāttanau tasyāstvanyāḥ pañcadaśārcayet /
ṛṣiḥ śivaśchanda uktā devatā lalitādikāḥ //
meaning:
यतस्तस्मात्तनौ तस्यास्त्वन्याः पञ्चदशार्चयेत् /
ऋषिः शिवश्छन्द उक्ता देवता ललितादिकाः //
text_mt: Because of that, one should worship the other fifteen upon her body. / The seer is Śiva, the meter is stated [as appropriate], and the deities are Lalitā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāmapi nityānāmāvṛtīrnāmasaṃcaye /
paṭale tu prayogāṃśca vakṣyāmyagre savistaram //
meaning:
सर्वासामपि नित्यानामावृतीर्नामसंचये /
पटले तु प्रयोगांश्च वक्ष्याम्यग्रे सविस्तरम् //
text_mt: I shall explain in detail further on, in the chapter on the collection of names, / the circuits and ritual applications of all the Nityā deities.

sanskrit_iast:
atha ṣoḍaśanityāsu dvitīyā yā samīritā /
kāmeśvarīti tāṃ sarvakāmadāṃ śṛṇu nārada //
meaning:
अथ षोडशनित्यासु द्वितीया या समीरिता /
कामेश्वरीति तां सर्वकामदां शृणु नारद //
text_mt: Now, hear, O Nārada, of the one who is taught as the second among the sixteen Nityās, / named Kāmeśvarī, who bestows all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śuciḥ svena yutastvādyo lalitā syāddvitīyakaḥ /
śūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayovyāptena saṃyutam //
meaning:
शुचिः स्वेन युतस्त्वाद्यो ललिता स्याद्द्वितीयकः /
शून्यमग्नियुतं पश्चाद्रयोव्याप्तेन संयुतम् //
text_mt: Purity joined with independence is the first, Lalitā is the second; / void united with fire, followed by speed joined with pervading;

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo rasāgnisahitaḥ śūnyayugmaṃ carānvitam /
nabhogotrā punaścaiṣāṃ dāhena samayojitā //
meaning:
प्राणो रसाग्निसहितः शून्ययुग्मं चरान्वितम् /
नभोगोत्रा पुनश्चैषां दाहेन समयोजिता //
text_mt: Breath accompanied by water and fire, a pair of voids accompanied by a mover, / sky and earth joined together again with burning;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbu syāccarasaṃyuktaṃ navaśaktiyutaṃ ca hṛt /
eṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikādaśākṣarī //
meaning:
अंबु स्याच्चरसंयुक्तं नवशक्तियुतं च हृत् /
एषा कामेश्वरी नित्या कामदैकादशाक्षरी //
text_mt: Water accompanied by a mover, and heart joined with nine energies— / this is the Nityā Kāmeśvarī, having eleven syllables, granting desires.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlavidyākṣaraireva kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt /
ekena hṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ tāvatātho dvayaṃ dvayāt //
meaning:
मूलविद्याक्षरैरेव कुर्यादङ्गानि षट् क्रमात् /
एकेन हृदयं शीर्षं तावताथो द्वयं द्वयात् //
text_mt: With the syllables of the root-vidyā itself, one should perform the six limbs in order: / The heart with one, the head with as much, then two with two,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirnayanaṃ tadvadastramekena kīrtitam /
dṛkśrotranāsādvitaye jihvāhṛnnābhiguhyake //
meaning:
चतुर्भिर्नयनं तद्वदस्त्रमेकेन कीर्तितम् /
दृक्श्रोत्रनासाद्वितये जिह्वाहृन्नाभिगुह्यके //
text_mt: Likewise the eye with four, and the weapon is declared to be with one. / In the pair of eyes, ears, and nostrils, on the tongue, heart, navel, and privates,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakatvena sarvāṅge mūrddhādiprapadāvadhi /
nyasedvidyākṣarāṇyeṣu sthāneṣu tadanantaram //
meaning:
व्यापकत्वेन सर्वाङ्गे मूर्द्धादिप्रपदावधि /
न्यसेद्विद्याक्षराण्येषु स्थानेषु तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: And pervasively throughout the whole body from the head down to the tip of the feet, / one should then place the syllables of the vidyā in these locations.

sanskrit_iast:
samastena vyāpakaṃ tu kuryāduktakrameṇa tu /
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi nityapūjāsu coditam //
meaning:
समस्तेन व्यापकं तु कुर्यादुक्तक्रमेण तु /
अथ ध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि नित्यपूजासु चोदितम् //
text_mt: One should make the pervasive placement with the whole [mantra] according to the prescribed order. / Now I shall explain the meditation taught in the daily worship,

sanskrit_iast:
yena devī suprasannā dadātīṣṭamayatnataḥ /
bālārkakoṭisaṃkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām //
meaning:
येन देवी सुप्रसन्ना ददातीष्टमयत्नतः /
बालार्ककोटिसंकाशां माणिक्यमुकुटोज्ज्वलाम् //
text_mt: Through which the goddess, very pleased, grants what is desired without effort: / Resembling ten million rising suns, radiant with a ruby crown,

sanskrit_iast:
hāragraiveyakāñcībhirūrmikānūpurādibhiḥ /
maṇḍitāṃ raktavasanāṃ ratnābharaṇaśobhitām //
meaning:
हारग्रैवेयकाञ्चीभिरूर्मिकानूपुरादिभिः /
मण्डितां रक्तवसनां रत्नाभरणशोभिताम् //
text_mt: Adorned with necklaces, torcs, girdles, rings, anklets, and other [ornaments], / dressed in red garments, resplendent with jewel ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍbhujāṃ trīkṣaṇāmindukalākalitamaulikām /
pañcāṣṭaṣoḍaśadvandvaṣaṭkoṇacaturasragām //
meaning:
षड्भुजां त्रीक्षणामिन्दुकलाकलितमौलिकाम् /
पञ्चाष्टषोडशद्वन्द्वषट्कोणचतुरस्रगाम् //
