text_mt: Having six arms, three eyes, with a crescent moon adorning her crest, / situated within [the diagram of] five, eight, sixteen, two, six angles, and a square,

sanskrit_iast:
mandasmitalasadvaktrāṃ dayāmantharavīkṣaṇām /
pāśāṅkuśau ca puṇḍrekṣucāpaṃ puṣpaśilīmukham //
meaning:
मन्दस्मितलसद्वक्त्रां दयामन्थरवीक्षणाम् /
पाशाङ्कुशौ च पुण्ड्रेक्षुचापं पुष्पशिलीमुखम् //
text_mt: With a face shining with a gentle smile, with glances languid with compassion, / holding in her hands a noose, a goad, a bow of sugarcane, flower arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnapātraṃ sīdhupūrṇaṃ varadaṃ bibhratīṃ karaiḥ /
tataḥ prayogānkurvīta siddhe matre tu sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
रत्नपात्रं सीधुपूर्णं वरदं बिभ्रतीं करैः /
ततः प्रयोगान्कुर्वीत सिद्धे मत्रे तु साधकः //
text_mt: A jewel cup filled with wine, and bestowing boons. / Then, when the mantra has been perfected, the practitioner should undertake the ritual applications.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāmatha vakṣyāmi nāmnā tu bhagamālinī /
kāmeśvaryādirādiḥ syādrasaścāpasthirārasaḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयामथ वक्ष्यामि नाम्ना तु भगमालिनी /
कामेश्वर्यादिरादिः स्याद्रसश्चापस्थिरारसः //
text_mt: Now I shall describe the third, named Bhagamālinī: / The beginning is the beginning of Kāmeśvarī, taste, bow, fixed, taste,

sanskrit_iast:
dharāyuksacarā paścātsthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sthirāśūnye 'gnisaṃyukte rasaḥ syāttadanantaram //
meaning:
धरायुक्सचरा पश्चात्स्थिरा पश्चाद्रसः स्मृतः /
स्थिराशून्ये ऽग्निसंयुक्ते रसः स्यात्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Joined with earth, moving, then fixed; after that, taste is remembered; / fixed and void joined with fire; immediately after that is taste;

sanskrit_iast:
sthirā bhūsahitā gotrā sadāho 'gnirasaḥ sthirā /
nabhaśca marutā yuktaṃ rasavarṇasamanvitam //
meaning:
स्थिरा भूसहिता गोत्रा सदाहो ऽग्निरसः स्थिरा /
नभश्च मरुता युक्तं रसवर्णसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Fixed with earth, earth with burning, fire, taste, fixed, / and sky joined with wind, accompanied by the syllable of taste.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitā /
aṃbahaṃsacaro 'thikto raso 'tha syātsthirā punaḥ //
meaning:
ततो रसः स्थिरा पश्चान्मरुता सह योजिता /
अंबहंसचरो ऽथिक्तो रसो ऽथ स्यात्स्थिरा पुनः //
text_mt: Then taste, fixed, then joined with wind, / water, haṃsa, moving, united; then taste, then fixed again;

sanskrit_iast:
sthirādharānvitā haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa ca /
rasaḥ sthirā tato vyāptaṃ bhūyutaṃ śūnyamagniyuk //
meaning:
स्थिराधरान्विता हंसो व्याप्तेन च चरेण च /
रसः स्थिरा ततो व्याप्तं भूयुतं शून्यमग्नियुक् //
text_mt: Fixed joined with earth, haṃsa with pervading and a mover, / taste, fixed, then pervading joined with earth, void joined with fire,

sanskrit_iast:
rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniśūnyaṃ taviyuto marut /
rayaḥ śūnyaṃ cāgniyutaṃ hṛdāhaṃsācca tatparam //
meaning:
रसः स्थिरा ततः साग्निशून्यं तवियुतो मरुत् /
रयः शून्यं चाग्नियुतं हृदाहंसाच्च तत्परम् //
text_mt: Taste, fixed, then void with fire, wind joined with ether, / speed, and void joined with fire; and next after that, from heart and haṃsa,

sanskrit_iast:
rasaḥ sthirāṃbu ca viyatsvayutaṃ prāṇa eva ca /
dāho 'griyugrasastasmāsthirākṣmā dāhasaṃyutā /
sacaraḥ syājjavīpūrvavidyā tartīyataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
रसः स्थिरांबु च वियत्स्वयुतं प्राण एव च /
दाहो ऽग्रियुग्रसस्तस्मास्थिराक्ष्मा दाहसंयुता /
सचरः स्याज्जवीपूर्वविद्या तर्तीयतः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Taste, fixed, water, and ether with independence, breath itself, / burning, fire, taste, then fixed, earth joined with burning, / and a mover; this is the vidyā preceded by Javī in order from the third.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣṭayamathārṇānāṃ rasastadanu ca sthirā /
hṛdaṃbuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syājjavī ca hṛt //
meaning:
चतुष्टयमथार्णानां रसस्तदनु च स्थिरा /
हृदंबुयुक् क्ष्मया दाहः सचरः स्याज्जवी च हृत् //
text_mt: Then a tetrad of syllables: taste, and after that fixed, / heart joined with water; with earth, burning; accompanied by a mover is Javī and heart,

sanskrit_iast:
dāho 'ṃbumarutā yukto vyomni sāgnirasastutaḥ /
sthirā tu marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgninabhaścarau //
meaning:
दाहो ऽंबुमरुता युक्तो व्योम्नि साग्निरसस्तुतः /
स्थिरा तु मरुता युक्ता शून्यं साग्निनभश्चरौ //
text_mt: Burning joined with water and wind, taste with fire in the ether, / but fixed joined with wind, void, with fire, sky, and mover,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃso vyāptamarudyuktaḥ śūnyaṃ vyāptamatoṃ'bu ca /
dāho gotrācarayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥ //
meaning:
हंसो व्याप्तमरुद्युक्तः शून्यं व्याप्तमतोंऽबु च /
दाहो गोत्राचरयुता तथा दाहस्तथा रयः //
text_mt: Haṃsa joined with pervading and wind, void, pervading, then water, / burning, joined with earth and mover, likewise burning, likewise speed,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛddharāsahitaṃ dāharayau carasamanvitau /
rasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavet //
meaning:
हृद्धरासहितं दाहरयौ चरसमन्वितौ /
रसः स्थिरा ततः प्राणो रसाग्निसहितो भवेत् //
text_mt: Heart accompanied by earth, burning and speed accompanied by a mover, / taste, fixed, then breath accompanied by water and fire;

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ tataḥ pūrvamataḥ param /
śūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syādvāhayuktāṃbunā caraḥ //
meaning:
शून्ययुग्मं चरयुतं ततः पूर्वमतः परम् /
शून्ययुग्मं च गोत्रा स्याद्वाहयुक्तांबुना चरः //
text_mt: A pair of voids accompanied by a mover, then the previous one; after this, / a pair of voids, and there should be earth, moving with water joined with fire,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo rasā carayuto gotravyasimataḥ param /
gotrādāhamarudyuktā tvaṃbunyāsamato bhavet //
meaning:
प्राणो रसा चरयुतो गोत्रव्यसिमतः परम् /
गोत्रादाहमरुद्युक्ता त्वंबुन्यासमतो भवेत् //
text_mt: Breath, water, accompanied by a mover, then earth and sword; / earth joined with burning and wind, then there should be placement with water;

sanskrit_iast:
yuktonāṃbhaśca bhūyuktaṃ vāścareṇa samanvitam /
grāso dharāyutaḥ paścādrasaḥ śaktyā samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
युक्तोनांभश्च भूयुक्तं वाश्चरेण समन्वितम् /
ग्रासो धरायुतः पश्चाद्रसः शक्त्या समन्वितः //
text_mt: Joined without water, joined with earth, wind accompanied by a mover, / swallowing joined with earth, after that taste accompanied by energy,

sanskrit_iast:
grāso bhūsahito vipra raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛt /
dāhonāṃbu ca hṛtpaścādrayeṃ'bumarudanvitaḥ //
meaning:
ग्रासो भूसहितो विप्र रसो व्याप्तं ततश्च हृत् /
दाहोनांबु च हृत्पश्चाद्रयेंऽबुमरुदन्वितः //
text_mt: Swallowing accompanied by earth, O brahmin, taste, pervading, and then heart, / burning without water, and heart, then speed joined with water and wind,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ caiva rasaśca sacarasthirā /
viyadaṃbuyutaṃ dāhastvagniyuksayutaḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
शून्यं च केवलं चैव रसश्च सचरस्थिरा /
वियदंबुयुतं दाहस्त्वग्नियुक्सयुतः शुचिः //
text_mt: Void, and pure [space] alone, and taste, and fixed with a mover, / ether joined with water, burning, joined with fire, joined with [the vowel], pure,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthirāḥ /
tadantarita bījāni svasaṃyuktāni pañca vai //
meaning:
भूमी रसाक्ष्मास्वयुता पञ्चैकान्तरिताः स्थिराः /
तदन्तरित बीजानि स्वसंयुक्तानि पञ्च वै //
text_mt: Earth, water, ground, joined with independence; five fixed ones separated by one; / and the five bījas between them joined with independence,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni kramājjyāsacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutā /
haṃsaścarayuto dviḥ syāttataḥ prāṇo rasāgniyuk //
meaning:
तानि क्रमाज्ज्यासचरो रसो भूश्च नभोयुता /
हंसश्चरयुतो द्विः स्यात्ततः प्राणो रसाग्नियुक् //
text_mt: They are in order: earth with a mover, taste, and earth joined with sky, / haṃsa with a mover twice, then breath joined with water and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho 'mbumarudyutaḥ /
vyomāgnisahitaṃ paścādrasaśca marutā sthirā //
meaning:
शून्ययुग्मं चरयुतं हृद्दाहो ऽम्बुमरुद्युतः /
व्योमाग्निसहितं पश्चाद्रसश्च मरुता स्थिरा //
text_mt: A pair of voids with a mover, heart, burning joined with water and wind, / sky accompanied by fire, after that taste, and fixed with wind,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ sāgninabhaścaiva careṇa sahitaṃ tathā /
aṃbu paścādviyattasmānnabhaśca marudanvitam //
meaning:
शून्यं साग्निनभश्चैव चरेण सहितं तथा /
अंबु पश्चाद्वियत्तस्मान्नभश्च मरुदन्वितम् //
text_mt: Void, and sky with fire, likewise accompanied by a mover, / water, after that ether, and sky joined with wind from that.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ vyāptaṃ ca dadyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥ /
haṃsaḥ sadāho 'mbagurasā carasvaiḥ saṃyuto bhavet //
meaning:
शून्यं व्याप्तं च दद्युक्तं रयदाहस्ववह्निभिः /
हंसः सदाहो ऽम्बगुरसा चरस्वैः संयुतो भवेत् //
text_mt: [The letter] śūnya, pervaded and joined with [the vowel] da, with ra, ya, fire, and its own fire; / haṃsa with fire, and water, gu, and rasa, joined with its own vowels;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaḥ sadāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritam /
saptatriṃśacchatārṇaiḥ syānnityā saubhāgamālinī //
meaning:
हंसः सदाहवह्निस्वैर्युक्तमन्त्यमुदीरितम् /
सप्तत्रिंशच्छतार्णैः स्यान्नित्या सौभागमालिनी //
text_mt: haṃsa with fire, fire's vowel, is declared to be the last. / Composed of one hundred and thirty-seven syllables, she is the Nityā Saubhāgyamālinī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgāni mantravarṇaiḥ syurādyena hṛdudīritam /
tataścatṛrbhiḥ śīrṣaṃ syācchikhā tribhirudīritā //
meaning:
अङ्गानि मन्त्रवर्णैः स्युराद्येन हृदुदीरितम् /
ततश्चतृर्भिः शीर्षं स्याच्छिखा त्रिभिरुदीरिता //
text_mt: The limbs are formed by the syllables of the mantra: the heart is declared with the first; / then the head with four; the crest is declared with three;

sanskrit_iast:
guṇavedākṣaraiḥ śeṣāṇyaṅgāni ṣaḍiti kramāt /
aruṇāmaruṇākalpāṃ suṃdarīṃ susmitānanām //
meaning:
गुणवेदाक्षरैः शेषाण्यङ्गानि षडिति क्रमात् /
अरुणामरुणाकल्पां सुंदरीं सुस्मिताननाम् //
text_mt: the remaining limbs with the syllables [measured by] qualities (three) and the Vedas (four) in order, making six. / One should meditate on the red goddess, adorned with red ornaments, beautiful, with a smiling face,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrāṃ bāhubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirupetāṃ kamalāsanām /
kahlārapāśapuṇḍrekṣukodaṇḍānvāmabāhubhiḥ //
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रां बाहुभिः षड्भिरुपेतां कमलासनाम् /
कह्लारपाशपुण्ड्रेक्षुकोदण्डान्वामबाहुभिः //
text_mt: three-eyed, endowed with six arms, seated upon a lotus, / holding in her left arms a red lotus, a noose, and a sugarcane bow,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ padmamaṅkuśaṃ puṣpasāyakam /
tathāvidhābhiḥ parito yutāṃ śaktigaṇaiḥ stutaiḥ //
meaning:
दधानां दक्षिणैः पद्ममङ्कुशं पुष्पसायकम् /
तथाविधाभिः परितो युतां शक्तिगणैः स्तुतैः //
text_mt: and holding in her right arms a lotus, a goad, and a flower-arrow; / surrounded on all sides by praised hosts of Śaktis of similar form,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaroktābhiranyābhiḥ smaronmādamadātmabhiḥ /
eṣā tṛtīyā kathitā vanitā janamohinī //
meaning:
अक्षरोक्ताभिरन्याभिः स्मरोन्मादमदात्मभिः /
एषा तृतीया कथिता वनिता जनमोहिनी //
text_mt: and by other [Śaktis] spoken of by the syllables, whose nature is the intoxication and passion of Love. / This third lady, enchanting all beings, has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthīṃ śṛṇu viprendra nityaklinnāsamāhvayām /
haṃsastu dāhavahnisvairyuktaḥ prathamamucyate //
meaning:
चतुर्थीं शृणु विप्रेन्द्र नित्यक्लिन्नासमाह्वयाम् /
हंसस्तु दाहवह्निस्वैर्युक्तः प्रथममुच्यते //
text_mt: Listen, O foremost among Brahmins, to the fourth, named Nityaklinnā. / Haṃsa joined with fire, fire's vowel, is said to be the first;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavet /
hṛdaṃbumarutā yuktaḥ sa evaikādaśākṣaraḥ //
meaning:
कामेश्वर्यास्तृतीयादिवर्णानामष्टकं भवेत् /
हृदंबुमरुता युक्तः स एवैकादशाक्षरः //
text_mt: then comes an octad of syllables beginning with the third of Kāmeśvarī; / joined with the heart, water, and wind—that indeed is the eleven-syllabled [vidyā].

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśākṣarī ceyaṃ vidyārṇairaṅgakalpanam /
ādyena mantravarṇena hṛdayaṃ samudīritam //
meaning:
एकादशाक्षरी चेयं विद्यार्णैरङ्गकल्पनम् /
आद्येन मन्त्रवर्णेन हृदयं समुदीरितम् //
text_mt: This is the eleven-syllabled [vidyā]. The formation of the limbs is performed by the syllables of the vidyā: / with the first syllable of the mantra, the heart is proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tu śeṣāṇi aṅgāni parikalpayet /
nyasedaṅguṣṭhamūlādikaniṣṭhāgrāntamūrddhvagam //
meaning:
द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां तु शेषाणि अङ्गानि परिकल्पयेत् /
न्यसेदङ्गुष्ठमूलादिकनिष्ठाग्रान्तमूर्द्ध्वगम् //
text_mt: one should then assign the remaining limbs with two [syllables] each. / One should perform the placement from the root of the thumbs to the tip of the little fingers, moving upward;

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ tadvalaye nyasya hṛddṛkchrotre nasordvayoḥ /
tvaci dhvaje ca pāyau ca pādayo rarṇakānnyaset //
meaning:
शेषं तद्वलये न्यस्य हृद्दृक्छ्रोत्रे नसोर्द्वयोः /
त्वचि ध्वजे च पायौ च पादयो रर्णकान्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: placing the rest in the wrist, one should place the syllables in the heart, eyes, ears, both nostrils, / skin, penis, anus, and both feet.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇāmaruṇākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm /
aruṇasragvilepāṃ tāṃ cārusmeramukhāṃbujām //
meaning:
अरुणामरुणाकल्पामरुणांशुकधारिणीम् /
अरुणस्रग्विलेपां तां चारुस्मेरमुखांबुजाम् //
text_mt: Red, adorned with red ornaments, wearing red garments, / smeared with red unguents and wearing red garlands, her lotus face smiling sweetly,

sanskrit_iast:
netratrayollasadvaktrāṃ bhālegharmāṃbumauktike /
virājamānāṃ mukuṭalasadarddhenduśekharām //
meaning:
नेत्रत्रयोल्लसद्वक्त्रां भालेघर्मांबुमौक्तिके /
विराजमानां मुकुटलसदर्द्धेन्दुशेखराम् //
text_mt: her face radiant with three eyes, glistening with pearls of perspiration on her forehead, / her crest adorned with the crescent moon gleaming on her diadem,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirbāhubhiḥ pāśamaṅkuśaṃ pānapātrakam /
abhayaṃ bibhratīṃ padmamadhyāsīnāṃ madālasām //
meaning:
चतुर्भिर्बाहुभिः पाशमङ्कुशं पानपात्रकम् /
अभयं बिभ्रतीं पद्ममध्यासीनां मदालसाम् //
text_mt: bearing in her four arms the noose, the goad, a drinking bowl, / and the gesture of fearlessness, seated in the center of a lotus, languid with intoxication—

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayennityakkinnāṃ nityāṃ svaśaktibhiḥ /
puṇyā caturthī gaditā nityākkinnāhvayā mune //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं पूजयेन्नित्यक्किन्नां नित्यां स्वशक्तिभिः /
पुण्या चतुर्थी गदिता नित्याक्किन्नाह्वया मुने //
text_mt: having meditated thus, one should worship the Nityā Nityaklinnā along with her own Śaktis. / The auspicious fourth Nityā, named Nityaklinnā, has been declared, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
vanitā navanītasya dāvikāgnirjayādinā /
bhūḥ svena yuktā prathamaṃ prāṇo dāhena tadyutaḥ //
meaning:
वनिता नवनीतस्य दाविकाग्निर्जयादिना /
भूः स्वेन युक्ता प्रथमं प्राणो दाहेन तद्युतः //
text_mt: Vanitā of butter, the spoon, fire, beginning with victory; / earth joined with its own [vowel] first; breath joined with that fire;

sanskrit_iast:
raso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prabhādāhena tadyutā /
jyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityāklinnāntagadvayam //
meaning:
रसो दाहेन तद्युक्तं प्रभादाहेन तद्युता /
ज्या च दाहेन तद्युक्ता नित्याक्लिन्नान्तगद्वयम् //
text_mt: rasa with fire, joined with that; splendor with fire, joined with that; / and jyā with fire, joined with that; followed by the two ending [syllables] of Nityaklinnā.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā navākṣarī nityā bheruṇḍā sarvasiddhidā /
praṇavaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ tyaktvā madhyasthaiḥ ṣaḍbhirakṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
एषा नवाक्षरी नित्या भेरुण्डा सर्वसिद्धिदा /
प्रणवं ठद्वयं त्यक्त्वा मध्यस्थैः षड्भिरक्षरैः //
text_mt: This is the nine-syllabled Nityā Bheruṇḍā, who grants all perfections. / Omitting the Praṇava and the two ṭhas, with the six syllables situated in the middle,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgāni prakurvīta varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ param /
randhrādyāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hannābhyāṃ dhārayadvayam //
meaning:
षडङ्गानि प्रकुर्वीत वर्णन्यासं ततः परम् /
रन्ध्राद्यामुखकण्ठेषु हन्नाभ्यां धारयद्वयम् //
text_mt: one should perform the six limbs; thereafter the placement of the syllables: / in the apertures, mouth, throat, heart, and navel, one should place two streams;

sanskrit_iast:
nyasenmantrārṇanavakaṃ mātṛkānyāsapūrvakam /
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi devyāḥ sarvārthasiddhidam //
meaning:
न्यसेन्मन्त्रार्णनवकं मातृकान्यासपूर्वकम् /
अथ ध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि देव्याः सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: one should place the nine syllables of the mantra preceded by the placement of the Mātṛkās. / Now I shall declare the meditation of the goddess that grants the attainment of all desires:

sanskrit_iast:
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśadehāṃ netratrayānvitām /
cārusmitāṃ citamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitām //
meaning:
तप्तकाञ्चनसंकाशदेहां नेत्रत्रयान्विताम् /
चारुस्मितां चितमुखीं दिव्यालङ्कारभूषिताम् //
text_mt: Her body resembles molten gold, endowed with three eyes, / of charming smile, of radiant face, adorned with divine ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṭaṅkahārakeyūraratnastabakamaṇḍitām /
rasanānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīm //
meaning:
ताटङ्कहारकेयूररत्नस्तबकमण्डिताम् /
रसनानूपुरोर्म्यादिभूषणैरतिसुन्दरीम् //
text_mt: embellished with earrings, necklaces, armlets, and clusters of gems, / very beautiful with ornaments such as girdles, anklets, and rings,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśau carmakhaṅgau gadāvahnidhanuḥśarān /
karairdadhānāmāsīnā pūjāyāṃ matpasasthitām //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशौ चर्मखङ्गौ गदावह्निधनुःशरान् /
करैर्दधानामासीना पूजायां मत्पसस्थिताम् //
text_mt: holding the noose and goad, shield and sword, mace, fire, bow, and arrows / with her hands, seated in worship, stationed on a corpse,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīśca tatsamākāratejohetibhiranvitāḥ /
pūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitāsyā vijayādikāḥ //
meaning:
शक्तीश्च तत्समाकारतेजोहेतिभिरन्विताः /
पूजयेत्तद्वदभितः स्मितास्या विजयादिकाः //
text_mt: and her Śaktis, Vijayā and the others, having a smiling countenance, endowed with forms, / radiance, and weapons like hers—one should worship them similarly all around.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamīya samākhyātā bheruṇḍākhyā munīśvara /
yasyāḥ smaraṇato naśyedgaralaṃ trividhaṃ kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
पञ्चमीय समाख्याता भेरुण्डाख्या मुनीश्वर /
यस्याः स्मरणतो नश्येद्गरलं त्रिविधं क्षणात् //
text_mt: This fifth one has been declared, named Bheruṇḍā, O lord of sages, / by remembering whom the threefold poison is instantly destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yā tu ṣaṣṭhī dvijaśreṣṭha sā nityā vahnivāsinī /
tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣvādya sādhakānāṃ susiddhidam //
meaning:
या तु षष्ठी द्विजश्रेष्ठ सा नित्या वह्निवासिनी /
तद्विधानं शृणुष्वाद्य साधकानां सुसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: The sixth, O best of the twice-born, is the Nityā Vahnivāsinī. / Hear now her ritual procedure, which grants excellent perfection to practitioners.

sanskrit_iast:
bheruṇḍādyamihādyaṃ syānnityaklinnādyanantaram /
tatoṃ'buśūnye haṃsāgnihyuttamaṃbumarudyutam //
meaning:
भेरुण्डाद्यमिहाद्यं स्यान्नित्यक्लिन्नाद्यनन्तरम् /
ततोंऽबुशून्ये हंसाग्निह्युत्तमंबुमरुद्युतम् //
text_mt: The first of Bheruṇḍā should be first here, followed by the first of Nityaklinnā; / then, in water and void, haṃsa, fire, accompanied by the highest water and wind;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdagninā yutaṃ śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā ca yuk /
śūnyaṃ nabhaḥ śaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudāhṛtā //
meaning:
हृदग्निना युतं शून्यं व्याप्तेन शुचिना च युक् /
शून्यं नभः शक्तियुतं नवार्णेयमुदाहृता //
text_mt: the heart joined with fire, void, and joined with pervaded fire; / void, sky, joined with Śakti—she is declared as nine-syllabled.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā dvitīyabījena svarāndīrghānniyojayet /
māyāntānṣaḍbhirevāṃ gānyācaretsakarāṅgayoḥ //
meaning:
विद्या द्वितीयबीजेन स्वरान्दीर्घान्नियोजयेत् /
मायान्तान्षड्भिरेवां गान्याचरेत्सकराङ्गयोः //
text_mt: With the second bīja of the vidyā, one should apply the long vowels / ending in māyā, and with six [of them] perform the limbs on the hands and body.

sanskrit_iast:
navākṣarāṇi vidyāyā navarandhreṣu vinyaset /
vyāpakaṃ ca samastena kuryādevātmasiddhaye //
meaning:
नवाक्षराणि विद्याया नवरन्ध्रेषु विन्यसेत् /
व्यापकं च समस्तेन कुर्यादेवात्मसिद्धये //
text_mt: One should place the nine syllables of the vidyā in the nine bodily openings, / and perform the pervasive placement with the whole [mantra] for the attainment of oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsvapi ca vidyāsu vyāpakanyāsamācaret /
taptakāñcanasaṃkāśāṃ navayauvanasundarīm //
meaning:
सर्वास्वपि च विद्यासु व्यापकन्यासमाचरेत् /
तप्तकाञ्चनसंकाशां नवयौवनसुन्दरीम् //
text_mt: One should perform the pervasive placement in all the vidyās as well. / [Meditate on her,] resembling molten gold, beautiful in fresh youth,

sanskrit_iast:
cārusmeramukhāṃbhojāṃ vilasannayanatrayām /
aṣṭābhirbāhubhiryuktāṃ māṇikyābharaṇojjvalām //
meaning:
चारुस्मेरमुखांभोजां विलसन्नयनत्रयाम् /
अष्टाभिर्बाहुभिर्युक्तां माणिक्याभरणोज्ज्वलाम् //
text_mt: her lotus face smiling sweetly, shining with three eyes, / endowed with eight arms, radiant with ruby ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
padmarāgakirīṭāṃśusaṃbhedāruṇitāṃbarām /
pītakauśeyavasanāṃ ratnamañjīramekhalām //
meaning:
पद्मरागकिरीटांशुसंभेदारुणितांबराम् /
पीतकौशेयवसनां रत्नमञ्जीरमेखलाम् //
text_mt: her garment reddened by the mingling rays of her ruby crown, / dressed in yellow silk, wearing gem-encrusted anklets and a girdle,

sanskrit_iast:
raktamauktikasakaṃbhinnastabakābharaṇojjvalām /
ratnābjakaṃbupuṇḍrekṣucāpapūrṇendumaṇḍalam //
meaning:
रक्तमौक्तिकसकंभिन्नस्तबकाभरणोज्ज्वलाम् /
रत्नाब्जकंबुपुण्ड्रेक्षुचापपूर्णेन्दुमण्डलम् //
text_mt: radiant with clusters of red pearls mingled as ornaments, / holding a jeweled lotus, a conch, a sugarcane bow, the orb of the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ bāhubhirvāmaiḥ kahlāraṃ hemaśṛṅgakam /
puṣpeṣuṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ //
meaning:
दधानां बाहुभिर्वामैः कह्लारं हेमशृङ्गकम् /
पुष्पेषुं मातुलिङ्गं च दधानां दक्षिणैः करैः //
text_mt: in her left arms, and holding a red lotus, a golden horn, / a flower-arrow, and a citron in her right hands;

sanskrit_iast:
svasvanāmābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām /
evaṃ dhyātvārcayedvahnivāsinīṃ vahnivigraham //
meaning:
स्वस्वनामाभिरभितः शक्तिभिः परिवारिताम् /
एवं ध्यात्वार्चयेद्वह्निवासिनीं वह्निविग्रहम् //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by Śaktis having their respective names. / Meditating thus, one should worship Vahnivāsinī, the embodiment of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ smarapato vaśyaṃ jāyate bhuvanatrayam /
atha yā saptamī nityā mahāvajreśvarī mune //
meaning:
यस्याः स्मरपतो वश्यं जायते भुवनत्रयम् /
अथ या सप्तमी नित्या महावज्रेश्वरी मुने //
text_mt: by remembering whom the three worlds become subdued. / Now, the seventh Nityā, O sage, is Mahāvajreśvarī;

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā vidyāṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ susiddhidām /
dvitīyaṃ vahvivāsinyā nityaklinnā caturthakam //
meaning:
तस्या विद्यां प्रवक्ष्यामि साधकानां सुसिद्धिदाम् /
द्वितीयं वह्विवासिन्या नित्यक्लिन्ना चतुर्थकम् //
text_mt: I shall declare her vidyā, which grants excellent perfection to practitioners: / The second of Vahnivāsinī, the fourth of Nityaklinnā,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakam /
nityaklinnādvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ṣaṣṭhasaptamau //
meaning:
पञ्चमं भगमालाद्यं भेरुण्डाया द्वितीयकम् /
नित्यक्लिन्नाद्वितीयं च तृतीयं षष्ठसप्तमौ //
text_mt: the fifth, the first of Bhagamālā, the second of Bheruṇḍā, / the second and third of Nityaklinnā, the sixth, the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ cāpi pūrvaṃ syādantimaṃ punaḥ /
dvayamekaikamatha ca dvayadvayamatha dvayam //
meaning:
अष्टमं नवमं चापि पूर्वं स्यादन्तिमं पुनः /
द्वयमेकैकमथ च द्वयद्वयमथ द्वयम् //
text_mt: the eighth, and the ninth; also the previous, and the last again: / two, then one each, then two and two, and then two.

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramāt /
pratyekaṃ śaktipuṭutairmantrārṇairdaśabhirnyaset //
meaning:
मायया पुटितं कृत्वा कुर्यादङ्गानि षट् क्रमात् /
प्रत्येकं शक्तिपुटुतैर्मन्त्रार्णैर्दशभिर्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Having enclosed them with Māyā, one should perform the six limbs in order; / one should place the ten syllables of the mantra, each enclosed by Śakti,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛkchrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramāt /
raktāṃ raktāṃbarāṃ raktagaṅghamālāvibhūṣaṇām //
meaning:
दृक्छ्रोत्रनासावाग्वक्षोनाभिगुह्येषु च क्रमात् /
रक्तां रक्तांबरां रक्तगङ्घमालाविभूषणाम् //
text_mt: in the eyes, ears, nostrils, speech, chest, navel, and privities in sequence. / [Meditate on her as] red, wearing red garments, adorned with red fragrant garlands,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām /
pāśāṅkuśāmikṣucāpaṃ dāḍimīśāyakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजां त्रिनयनां माणिक्यमुकुटोज्ज्वलाम् /
पाशाङ्कुशामिक्षुचापं दाडिमीशायकं तथा //
text_mt: four-armed, three-eyed, radiant with a diadem of rubies, / holding the noose, goad, sugarcane bow, and pomegranate arrow

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ bāhubhirnetrairdayāsuprītiśītalaiḥ /
paśyantī sādhake astraṣaṭkoṇābjamahīpure //
meaning:
दधानां बाहुभिर्नेत्रैर्दयासुप्रीतिशीतलैः /
पश्यन्ती साधके अस्त्रषट्कोणाब्जमहीपुरे //
text_mt: with her arms, looking upon the practitioner with eyes cool with compassion and great affection; / seated comfortably in the center of the cakra, in the weapon, hexagon, lotus, and earth-city,

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhām /
śaktibhiḥ svasvarūpābhirāvṛtāṃ pītamadhyagām //
meaning:
चक्रमध्ये सुखासीनां स्मेरवक्त्रसरोरुहाम् /
शक्तिभिः स्वस्वरूपाभिरावृतां पीतमध्यगाम् //
text_mt: her lotus face smiling, surrounded by Śaktis having forms like her own, seated upon an altar,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsane 'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥ /
vṛtāṃ tābhirvinodāni yātāyātādibhiḥ sadā //
meaning:
सिंहासने ऽभितः प्रेङ्खत्पोतस्थाभिश्च शक्तिभिः /
वृतां ताभिर्विनोदानि यातायातादिभिः सदा //
text_mt: on a lion-throne, surrounded by Śaktis situated on rocking boats all around, / constantly engaging with them in sports of coming and going,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāṇāmaruṇāṃbhodhau cintayenmantranāyakam /
eṣā tu saptamīproktā dūtiṃ cāpyaṣṭamīṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
कुर्वाणामरुणांभोधौ चिन्तयेन्मन्त्रनायकम् /
एषा तु सप्तमीप्रोक्ता दूतिं चाप्यष्टमीं शृणु //
text_mt: performing [them] in the red ocean—one should meditate on this sovereign of mantras. / This seventh one has been proclaimed; hear also of the eighth, the messenger.

sanskrit_iast:
vajreśvaryādyamādyaṃ syādviyadagniyutaṃ tataḥ /
aṃbu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥ //
meaning:
वज्रेश्वर्याद्यमाद्यं स्याद्वियदग्नियुतं ततः /
अंबु स्यान्मरुता युक्तं गोत्रा क्ष्मासंयुता ततः //
text_mt: The first [syllable] of Vajreśvarī should be first; then space combined with fire; / then water combined with wind; then the earth combined with ground; then,

sanskrit_iast:
rayovyāsena śucinā yutaḥ syāttadanantaram /
atyārṇāṃ vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritāḥ //
meaning:
रयोव्यासेन शुचिना युतः स्यात्तदनन्तरम् /
अत्यार्णां वह्निवासिन्या दूती नित्या समीरिताः //
text_mt: ray together with the span, combined with the pure fire. / Immediately after that are the syllables of Vahnivāsinī: thus Dūtī Nityā is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍdīrghasvarayuktena vidyāyāḥ syātṣaḍaṅgakam /
tenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasu //
meaning:
षड्दीर्घस्वरयुक्तेन विद्यायाः स्यात्षडङ्गकम् /
तेनैव पुटितैरर्णैर्न्यसेच्छ्रोत्रादिपञ्चसु //
text_mt: With [that seed] endowed with the six long vowels, the six limbs of the mantra-knowledge are formed. / Encased by that very [seed], one should perform ritual placement of the syllables upon the five [sense organs], the ears and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhakaṃ nasi vinyasya vyāpakaṃ vidyayā nyaset /
nidāghakālamadhyāhnadivākarasamaprabhām //
meaning:
षष्ठकं नसि विन्यस्य व्यापकं विद्यया न्यसेत् /
निदाघकालमध्याह्नदिवाकरसमप्रभाम् //
text_mt: Placing the sixth on the nose, one should perform the pervasive ritual placement with the mantra-knowledge. / [One should meditate on her] shining like the midday sun in the summer season,

sanskrit_iast:
navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāṃbarām /
nānābharaṇasaṃbhinnadehakāntivirājitām //
meaning:
नवरत्नकिरीटां च त्रीक्षणामरुणांबराम् /
नानाभरणसंभिन्नदेहकान्तिविराजिताम् //
text_mt: wearing a diadem of nine jewels, three-eyed, clad in crimson garments, / radiant with a bodily luster mingled with various ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
śucismitāmaṣṭabhujā stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ /
pāśaṃ kheṭaṃ gadāṃ ratnacaṣakaṃ vāmabāhubhiḥ //
meaning:
शुचिस्मितामष्टभुजा स्तूयमानां महर्षिभिः /
पाशं खेटं गदां रत्नचषकं वामबाहुभिः //
text_mt: with a pure smile, eight-armed, praised by the great sages, / [holding] a noose, a shield, a mace, and a jeweled chalice in her left arms,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇairaṅkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ kaṭṭāraṃ kamalaṃ tathā /
dadhānāṃ sādhakābhīṣṭadānodyamasamanvitām //
meaning:
दक्षिणैरङ्कुशं खड्गं कट्टारं कमलं तथा /
दधानां साधकाभीष्टदानोद्यमसमन्विताम् //
text_mt: holding a goad, a sword, a dagger, and likewise a lotus with her right ones, / intent upon the effort of granting the desired boons to the practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ pṛnayeddevīṃ dūtīṃ durnnītināśinīm /
ityeṣā kathitā tubhyaṃ samastāpannivāriṇī //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं पृनयेद्देवीं दूतीं दुर्न्नीतिनाशिनीम् /
इत्येषा कथिता तुभ्यं समस्तापन्निवारिणी //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should worship the goddess Dūtī, the destroyer of wickedness. / Thus has been told to you [the deity] who averts all adversities,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkarī śivatāvāsakāriṇī sarvasiddhidā /
atha te navamīṃ nityāṃ tvaritāṃ nāma nārada //
meaning:
श्रीकरी शिवतावासकारिणी सर्वसिद्धिदा /
अथ ते नवमीं नित्यां त्वरितां नाम नारद //
text_mt: bringing prosperity, establishing the state of Śiva, granting all accomplishments. / Now to you I shall declare the ninth Nityā, named Tvaritā, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
pravakṣyāmi yaśovidyādhanārogyasukhapradām /
ādyaṃ tu vahnivāsinyā dūtyādistadanantaram //
meaning:
प्रवक्ष्यामि यशोविद्याधनारोग्यसुखप्रदाम् /
आद्यं तु वह्निवासिन्या दूत्यादिस्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: who bestows fame, knowledge, wealth, health, and happiness. / First is the initial [seed] of Vahnivāsinī, then the initial of Dūtī;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃso dharā svayaṃ yuktastejaścarasamanvitam /
vāyuḥ prabhācarayutā grāsaśaktisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
हंसो धरा स्वयं युक्तस्तेजश्चरसमन्वितम् /
वायुः प्रभाचरयुता ग्रासशक्तिसमन्वितः //
text_mt: haṃsa, the earth himself, combined with light and movement; / wind, combined with radiant movement, endowed with the power of consumption;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdāra yeṇa dāhena vahnisvāṣṭamaṃ tathā /
haṃsaḥ kṣmākhaṃyuto grāsaścarayukto dvitīyakaḥ //
meaning:
हृदार येण दाहेन वह्निस्वाष्टमं तथा /
हंसः क्ष्माखंयुतो ग्रासश्चरयुक्तो द्वितीयकः //
text_mt: the heart with ar, then by burning fire with its eighth; / haṃsa joined with earth and ether, endowed with consumption and movement, the second;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarī /
vidyā caturthavarṇādisaptabhistvakṣaraistathā //
meaning:
द्वितिर्नादयुता नित्या त्वरिता द्वादशाक्षरी /
विद्या चतुर्थवर्णादिसप्तभिस्त्वक्षरैस्तथा //
text_mt: twice, endowed with sound: the twelve-syllabled Nityā Tvaritā. / With the seven syllables beginning with the fourth syllable of the mantra-knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭkrameṇa karāṅgayoḥ /
śirolalāṭakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyādhārake tathā //
meaning:
कुर्यादङ्गानि युग्मार्णैः षट्क्रमेण कराङ्गयोः /
शिरोललाटकण्ठेषु हृन्नाभ्याधारके तथा //
text_mt: one should form the six limbs in sequence on the hands and limbs with pairs of syllables. / On the head, forehead, throat, heart, navel, and pelvic base,

sanskrit_iast:
ūruyugme tathā jānudvaye jaṅghādvaye tathā /
pādayugme tathā varṇānmantrajāndaśa vinyaset //
meaning:
ऊरुयुग्मे तथा जानुद्वये जङ्घाद्वये तथा /
पादयुग्मे तथा वर्णान्मन्त्रजान्दश विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: on the pair of thighs, likewise on both knees, both calves, / and likewise on the pair of feet, one should place the ten syllables born of the mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyopāntyamadhyasthairmantrārṇairitarairapi /
tārādyaiḥ śṛṇu taddhyānaṃ sarvasiddhividhāyakam //
meaning:
द्वितीयोपान्त्यमध्यस्थैर्मन्त्रार्णैरितरैरपि /
ताराद्यैः शृणु तद्ध्यानं सर्वसिद्धिविधायकम् //
text_mt: with the second, the penultimate, and the middle syllables of the mantra, as well as the others, / preceded by the praṇava. Hear her meditation, which brings about all accomplishments:

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmavarṇaśubhākārāṃ navayauvanaśobhitām /
dvidvikramādaṣṭanāgaiḥ kalpitābharaṇojjvalaiḥ //
meaning:
श्यामवर्णशुभाकारां नवयौवनशोभिताम् /
द्विद्विक्रमादष्टनागैः कल्पिताभरणोज्ज्वलैः //
text_mt: Dark-complexioned, auspicious in form, adorned with fresh youth, / radiant with ornaments fashioned from the eight serpents, two by two in order,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṭaṅkamaṅgadaṃ tadvadrasanā nūpuraṃ ca taiḥ /
viprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrajātibhirbhīmavigrahaiḥ //
meaning:
ताटङ्कमङ्गदं तद्वद्रसना नूपुरं च तैः /
विप्रक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रजातिभिर्भीमविग्रहैः //
text_mt: as earrings, armlets, similarly as girdle, and as anklets, / of the brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra castes, of terrible forms,

sanskrit_iast:
pallavāṃśukasaṃvītāṃ śikhipicchakṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
valayairbhūṣitabhujāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām //
meaning:
पल्लवांशुकसंवीतां शिखिपिच्छकृतैः शुभैः /
वलयैर्भूषितभुजां माणिक्यमुकुटोज्ज्वलाम् //
text_mt: clad in garments of sprouts, her arms adorned with auspicious bangles / made of peacock feathers, brilliant with a crown of rubies,

sanskrit_iast:
barhibarhikṛtāpīḍāṃ tacchatrāṃ tatpatākinīm /
guñjāguṇalasadvakṣaḥ kucakuṅkumamaṇḍalām //
meaning:
बर्हिबर्हिकृतापीडां तच्छत्रां तत्पताकिनीम् /
गुञ्जागुणलसद्वक्षः कुचकुङ्कुममण्डलाम् //
text_mt: crowned with a crest of peacock feathers, having a parasol and banners of the same, / the saffron circle of her breasts on her chest gleaming with strings of guñjā berries,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ mandasmitamukhāṃbujām /
pāśāṅkuśavarābhītilasadbhujacatuṣṭayām //
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रां चारुवदनां मन्दस्मितमुखांबुजाम् /
पाशाङ्कुशवराभीतिलसद्भुजचतुष्टयाम् //
text_mt: three-eyed, with a beautiful face, a lotus-like mouth with a gentle smile, / with four arms gleaming with a noose, a goad, and the gestures of granting boons and fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivaṃ totalāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchaktibhirvṛtām /
tadagrasthā lu phaṭkārī śaracāpakarojjvalā //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवं तोतलां देवीं पूजयेच्छक्तिभिर्वृताम् /
तदग्रस्था लु फट्कारी शरचापकरोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should worship the goddess Totalā surrounded by her śaktis. / Standing before her, Phaṭkārī, brilliant with bow and arrow in hand,

sanskrit_iast:
prasīdetphaladāne ca sādhakānāṃ tvarānvitāṃ /
eṣā tu navamī nityā tvaritoktā munīśvara //
meaning:
प्रसीदेत्फलदाने च साधकानां त्वरान्वितां /
एषा तु नवमी नित्या त्वरितोक्ता मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: is propitiated, swift in granting the fruit to practitioners. / This ninth Nityā, named Tvaritā, has been declared, O lord of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhnaduḥsvapraśamanī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī /
śuciḥ svena yutastvādyo rasāvahnisamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
विध्नदुःस्वप्रशमनी सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनी /
शुचिः स्वेन युतस्त्वाद्यो रसावह्निसमन्वितः //
text_mt: quelling obstacles and bad dreams, the bestower of all desires. / The pure fire combined with its own is the first, together with the earth and fire;

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanaducchaktibhiḥ paraḥ /
itīritā tryakṣarākhyā nityeyaṃ kulasuṃdarī //
meaning:
प्राणो द्वितीयः स्वयुतो वनदुच्छक्तिभिः परः /
इतीरिता त्र्यक्षराख्या नित्येयं कुलसुंदरी //
text_mt: prāṇa combined with its own is the second; the next is with the powers of the cloud-forest: / thus is proclaimed this three-syllabled Nityā named Kulasundarī,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ smaraṇa mātreṇa sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate /
tribhistairuditairmūlavarṇaiḥ kuryyātṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
यस्याः स्मरण मात्रेण सर्वज्ञत्वं प्रजायते /
त्रिभिस्तैरुदितैर्मूलवर्णैः कुर्य्यात्षडङ्गकम् //
text_mt: by the mere recollection of whom omniscience is born. / With those three spoken root-syllables, one should perform the six limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhikramāt /
pratyeka taistribhirbījairdīrghasvarasamanvitaiḥ //
meaning:
आदिमध्यावसानेषु पूजाजपविधिक्रमात् /
प्रत्येक तैस्त्रिभिर्बीजैर्दीर्घस्वरसमन्वितैः //
text_mt: at the beginning, middle, and end, according to the rule of worship and recitation, / individually with those three seed-syllables endowed with long vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātkarāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhi /
ūrddhvaprāgdakṣiṇodakca paścimādhasnāgnabhiḥ //
meaning:
कुर्यात्कराङ्गवक्त्राणां न्यासं प्रोक्तं यथाविधि /
ऊर्द्ध्वप्राग्दक्षिणोदक्च पश्चिमाधस्नाग्नभिः //
text_mt: One should perform the ritual placement of the hands, limbs, and faces as prescribed: / in the upper, eastern, southern, northern, western, and downward directions with the fire [syllables],

sanskrit_iast:
suvinadyantarasthaistannadātmasu yathākramam /
ādhārarandhrahṛtsvekaṃ dvitīyaṃ locanatraye //
meaning:
सुविनद्यन्तरस्थैस्तन्नदात्मसु यथाक्रमम् /
आधाररन्ध्रहृत्स्वेकं द्वितीयं लोचनत्रये //
text_mt: situated within the sound, on those very deities of sound in order: / one on the pelvic base, fontanelle, and heart; the second on the three eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣu /
pañcamaṃ cāṃsanābhīṣu tataḥ pāṇipadadvaye //
meaning:
तृतीयं श्रोत्रचिबुके चतुर्थं घ्राणतालुषु /
पञ्चमं चांसनाभीषु ततः पाणिपदद्वये //
text_mt: the third on the ears and chin; the fourth on the nostrils and palate; / the fifth on the shoulders and navel; then on both hands and both feet,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamadhyāgrato nyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥ /
lohitāṃ lohitākāraśaktiṃbṛdaniṣevitām //
meaning:
मूलमध्याग्रतो न्यस्येन्नवधा मूलवर्णकैः /
लोहितां लोहिताकारशक्तिंबृदनिषेविताम् //
text_mt: from the base, middle, and tip, one should place in nine ways using the root-syllables. / [One should meditate on her] red, attended by a host of red-formed śaktis,

sanskrit_iast:
lohitāṃśukabhūṣāsraglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāṃbujām /
anardhyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikyamukuṭojvalām //
meaning:
लोहितांशुकभूषास्रग्लेपनां षण्मुखांबुजाम् /
अनर्ध्यरत्नघटितमाणिक्यमुकुटोज्वलाम् //
text_mt: with red garments, ornaments, garlands, and ointments, with six lotus-faces, / radiant with a ruby diadem fashioned of priceless jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnastabakasaṃbhinnalasadvakṣaḥsthalāṃ śubhām /
kāruṇyānandaparamā maruṇāṃbujaviṣṭarām //
meaning:
रत्नस्तबकसंभिन्नलसद्वक्षःस्थलां शुभाम् /
कारुण्यानन्दपरमा मरुणांबुजविष्टराम् //
text_mt: auspicious, her radiant bosom mingled with clusters of gems, / supreme in compassion and bliss, seated upon a red lotus seat,

sanskrit_iast:
bhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvavāḍhmayīm /
pravālākṣasrajaṃ padmaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ratnanirmitām //
meaning:
भुजैर्द्वादशभिर्युक्तां सर्वेषां सर्ववाढ्मयीम् /
प्रवालाक्षस्रजं पद्मं कुण्डिकां रत्ननिर्मिताम् //
text_mt: endowed with twelve arms, embodying all speech for all beings, / holding a rosary of coral, a lotus, a water pot made of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnapūrṇaṃ tu caṣakaṃ luṅgīṃ vyākhyānamudrikām /
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairvāmaiḥ pustakaṃ cāruṇotpalam //
meaning:
रत्नपूर्णं तु चषकं लुङ्गीं व्याख्यानमुद्रिकाम् /
दधानां दक्षिणैर्वामैः पुस्तकं चारुणोत्पलम् //
text_mt: a chalice filled with jewels, a citron fruit, and the gesture of exposition / in her right hands; and in her left hands a book, a red water lily,

sanskrit_iast:
haimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kaṃbuvaraṃ bhujaiḥ /
abhitaḥ stūyamānāṃ ca devagandharvakinnaraiḥ //
meaning:
हैमीं च लेखनीं रत्नमालां कंबुवरं भुजैः /
अभितः स्तूयमानां च देवगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः //
text_mt: a golden pen, a necklace of gems, and an excellent conch; / praised on all sides by gods, gandharvas, and kinnaras,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣarākṣasadaityarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ /
dhyātvaivamarcannityāṃ vāglakṣmīkāntisiddhaye //
meaning:
यक्षराक्षसदैत्यर्षिसिद्धविद्याधरादिभिः /
ध्यात्वैवमर्चन्नित्यां वाग्लक्ष्मीकान्तिसिद्धये //
text_mt: yakṣas, rākṣasas, daityas, sages, siddhas, vidyādharas, and others. / Having meditated thus, one should worship the Nityā for the attainment of eloquence, fortune, and beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
sitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapi /
dhūmābhāṃ vairividviṣṭyai mṛtaye nigrahāya ca //
meaning:
सितां केवलवाक्सिद्ध्यै लक्ष्म्यै हेमप्रभामपि /
धूमाभां वैरिविद्विष्ट्यै मृतये निग्रहाय च //
text_mt: One should contemplate her as white for the sole attainment of speech; of golden luster for fortune; / smoke-hued for hatred of enemies, death, and subjugation;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāṃ ca mūkīkaraṇe smarettattadapekṣayā /
ityeṣā daśamī nityāproktā te kulasundarī //
meaning:
नीलां च मूकीकरणे स्मरेत्तत्तदपेक्षया /
इत्येषा दशमी नित्याप्रोक्ता ते कुलसुन्दरी //
text_mt: and dark blue for rendering dumb, according to the desired purpose. / Thus has this tenth Nityā, Kulasundarī, been declared to you.

sanskrit_iast:
nityānityāṃ tu daśamīṃ trikuṭāṃ vacmi sāṃpratam /
haṃsaśca hṛtprāṇarasādāhakarṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
नित्यानित्यां तु दशमीं त्रिकुटां वच्मि सांप्रतम् /
हंसश्च हृत्प्राणरसादाहकर्णैः समन्वितः //
text_mt: Now I speak of the eternal and non-eternal tenth, Trikuṭā: / haṃsa, combined with the heart, breath, earth, fire, and the ears,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyayā kulasuṃdaryā yojitaḥ saṃpradāyataḥ /
nityānityatrivarṇeyaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ kūṭākṣarairyutā //
meaning:
विद्यया कुलसुंदर्या योजितः संप्रदायतः /
नित्यानित्यत्रिवर्णेयं षड्भिः कूटाक्षरैर्युता //
text_mt: joined with the mantra-knowledge of Kulasundarī according to tradition. / This eternal and non-eternal three-syllabled [vidyā] is endowed with six composite syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
pratilomādibhī rūpairdvisaptatibhidā matā /
yasyā bhajanataḥ siddho naraḥ syātkhecaraḥ sukhī //
meaning:
प्रतिलोमादिभी रूपैर्द्विसप्ततिभिदा मता /
यस्या भजनतः सिद्धो नरः स्यात्खेचरः सुखी //
text_mt: in reverse and direct forms, it is understood to have seventy-two divisions. / By worshiping her, a person becomes an accomplished sky-farer, happy,

sanskrit_iast:
nigrahānugrahau kartuṃ kṣamaḥ syādbhuvanatraye /
dīrghasvarasametābhyāṃ haṃsahṛbhdyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam //
meaning:
निग्रहानुग्रहौ कर्तुं क्षमः स्याद्भुवनत्रये /
दीर्घस्वरसमेताभ्यां हंसहृभ्द्यां षडङ्गकम् //
text_mt: and able to execute curse and grace throughout the three worlds. / With haṃsa and the heart syllable, joined with long vowels, the six limbs [are formed].

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyādhāreṣu ca kramāt /
vidyākṣarāṇi kramaśo nyasedvinduyutāni ca //
meaning:
भ्रूमध्ये कण्ठहृन्नाभिगुह्याधारेषु च क्रमात् /
विद्याक्षराणि क्रमशो न्यसेद्विन्दुयुतानि च //
text_mt: Between the eyebrows, on the throat, heart, navel, genitals, and the pelvic base in order, / one should place the syllables of the mantra-knowledge one by one, endowed with the nasal point.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ ca samastena vidhāya vidhinā punaḥ /
dhyāyetsamastasaṃpattihetoḥ sarvātmikāṃ śivām //
meaning:
व्यापकं च समस्तेन विधाय विधिना पुनः /
ध्यायेत्समस्तसंपत्तिहेतोः सर्वात्मिकां शिवाम् //
text_mt: And having performed the pervasive ritual placement with the whole [mantra] according to rule, / one should meditate on the auspicious goddess, the self of all, the cause of all prosperity:

sanskrit_iast:
udyadbhāskarabiṃbābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām /
padmarāgakṛtākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm //
meaning:
उद्यद्भास्करबिंबाभां माणिक्यमुकुटोज्ज्वलाम् /
पद्मरागकृताकल्पामरुणांशुकधारिणीम् //
text_mt: resembling the disk of the rising sun, brilliant with a diadem of rubies, / adorned with ruby ornaments, wearing crimson garments,

sanskrit_iast:
cārusmitalasadvaktraṣaṭsarojavirājitām /
prativaktraṃ trinayanāṃ bhujairdvādaśabhiryutām //
meaning:
चारुस्मितलसद्वक्त्रषट्सरोजविराजिताम् /
प्रतिवक्त्रं त्रिनयनां भुजैर्द्वादशभिर्युताम् //
text_mt: radiant with six lotus faces shining with charming smiles, / three-eyed in each face, endowed with twelve arms,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśākṣaguṇapuṇḍrekṣucāpakheṭatriśūlakān /
karairvāmairdadhānāṃ ca aṅkuśaṃ pustakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
पाशाक्षगुणपुण्ड्रेक्षुचापखेटत्रिशूलकान् /
करैर्वामैर्दधानां च अङ्कुशं पुस्तकं तथा //
text_mt: holding a noose, a rosary, a sugar-cane bow, a shield, and a trident / with her left hands; and a goad, a book, and likewise

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpeṣumaṃbujaṃ caiva nṛkapālābhaye tathā /
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairdhyāyeddevīmananyadhīḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पेषुमंबुजं चैव नृकपालाभये तथा /
दधानां दक्षिणैर्हस्तैर्ध्यायेद्देवीमनन्यधीः //
text_mt: Holding flower-arrows and a lotus, / as well as a human skull and [the gesture of] fearlessness with her right hands, / one should meditate upon the goddess with undivided mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣaikā daśī proktā dvādaśīṃ śṛṇu nārada /
tvaritoyāntyamādyaṃ syādyutidohacarasvayuk //
meaning:
इत्येषैका दशी प्रोक्ता द्वादशीं शृणु नारद /
त्वरितोयान्त्यमाद्यं स्याद्युतिदोहचरस्वयुक् //
text_mt: Thus has this eleventh [Nityā] been declared; listen to the twelfth, O Nārada: / The last [letter] of Tvaritā is the first; [then] Dyuti joined with Dāha, Cara, and Sva;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛñca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ vajreśīpañcamaṃ tathā /
marutsvayukto madhyāḍhyo daśamyāḥ parataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
हृञ्च दाहक्ष्मास्वयुतं वज्रेशीपञ्चमं तथा /
मरुत्स्वयुक्तो मध्याढ्यो दशम्याः परतः पुनः //
text_mt: and Hṛt joined with Dāha, Kṣmā, and Sva; and the fifth of Vajreśī; / [then] Marut joined with Sva and adorned with Madhya; next, after the tenth,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā vajreśītyaṣṭamaḥ kramāt /
ṣaḍakṣarāṇi tvaritā tṛtīyaṃ tadanantaram //
meaning:
भूमी रसाक्ष्मास्वयुता वज्रेशीत्यष्टमः क्रमात् /
षडक्षराणि त्वरिता तृतीयं तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Bhūmī joined with Rasā, Kṣmā, and Sva; in order, the eighth of Vajreśī; / six syllables of Tvaritā; after that, the third;

sanskrit_iast:
dyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaram /
uktā nīlapatākākhyā nityā saptadaśākṣarī //
meaning:
द्युतिर्दाहचरस्वेन अस्या आद्यमनन्तरम् /
उक्ता नीलपताकाख्या नित्या सप्तदशाक्षरी //
text_mt: Dyuti with Dāha, Cara, and Sva; immediately after, the first of this [same deity]. / [Thus] is declared the seventeen-syllabled Nityā named Nīlapatākā.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidvipakṣākṣiṣaḍvarṇairmantrotthairaṅgakalpanam /
śrotrādināsāyugale vāci kaṇṭhe hṛdi kramāt //
meaning:
द्विद्विपक्षाक्षिषड्वर्णैर्मन्त्रोत्थैरङ्गकल्पनम् /
श्रोत्रादिनासायुगले वाचि कण्ठे हृदि क्रमात् //
text_mt: One should perform the assignment of limbs with two, two, two, two, and six syllables / arisen from the mantra. In the pair of ears and [eyes], in the nose, in speech, in the throat, in the heart, in order,

sanskrit_iast:
nābhāvādhārake 'thāpi pādasaṃdhiṣu ca kramāt /
mantrākṣarāṇi kramaśo nyasetsaptadaśāpi ca //
meaning:
नाभावाधारके ऽथापि पादसंधिषु च क्रमात् /
मन्त्राक्षराणि क्रमशो न्यसेत्सप्तदशापि च //
text_mt: in the navel, in the base [cakra], and also in the joints of the feet in order, / one should place all seventeen syllables of the mantra one by one.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ ca samastena vidadhyāñca yathāvidhi /
indranīlanibhāṃ bhāsvanmaṇimaulivirājitām //
meaning:
व्यापकं च समस्तेन विदध्याञ्च यथाविधि /
इन्द्रनीलनिभां भास्वन्मणिमौलिविराजिताम् //
text_mt: And with the whole [mantra] one should perform the pervasive ritual placement according to the rule: / Resembling a sapphire, adorned with a radiant jeweled crown,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīm /
daśahastāṃ lasanmuktāmaṇyābharaṇamaṇḍitām //
meaning:
पञ्चवक्त्रां त्रिनयनामरुणांशुकधारिणीम् /
दशहस्तां लसन्मुक्तामण्याभरणमण्डिताम् //
text_mt: having five faces, three-eyed, wearing crimson garments, / having ten hands, adorned with brilliant pearl and gem ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnastabakasaṃpannadehāṃ cārusmitānanām /
pāśaṃ patākāṃ carmāpi śārṅgacāpaṃ varaṃ karaiḥ //
meaning:
रत्नस्तबकसंपन्नदेहां चारुस्मिताननाम् /
पाशं पताकां चर्मापि शार्ङ्गचापं वरं करैः //
text_mt: her body endowed with clusters of gems, her face wearing a charming smile, / [holding] a noose, a banner, a shield, a Śārṅga bow, and [granting] a boon with the hands

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ /
aṅkuśe ca tathā śarkti khaṅgaṃ bāṇaṃ tathābhayam //
meaning:
दधानां वामपार्श्वस्थैः सर्वाभरणभूषितैः /
अङ्कुशे च तथा शर्क्ति खङ्गं बाणं तथाभयम् //
text_mt: situated on the left side, adorned with all ornaments; / and likewise holding an elephant-hook, a spear, a sword, an arrow, and fearlessness

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭare /
svākāravarṇaveṣāsyapāṇyāyudhavibhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
दधानां दक्षिणैर्हस्तैरासीनां पद्मविष्टरे /
स्वाकारवर्णवेषास्यपाण्यायुधविभूषणैः //
text_mt: with her right hands; seated on a lotus seat; / surrounded by hosts of Śaktis having her own form, / color, dress, faces, hands, weapons, and ornaments—

sanskrit_iast:
śaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakrame /
triṣaṭkoṇayutaṃ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ tato bahiḥ //
meaning:
शक्तिवृन्दैर्वृतां ध्यायेद्देवीं नित्यार्चनक्रमे /
त्रिषट्कोणयुतं पद्ममष्टपत्रं ततो बहिः //
text_mt: one should meditate upon the goddess in the sequence of the daily worship. / [Drawing] a lotus endowed with three and six angles [a nine-angled figure], then outside an eight-petaled [lotus],

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāsraṃ bhūpuradvandvāvṛtaṃ tatpurayugmakam /
caturdvārayutaṃ dikṣu śākhābhiśca samanvitam //
meaning:
अष्टास्रं भूपुरद्वन्द्वावृतं तत्पुरयुग्मकम् /
चतुर्द्वारयुतं दिक्षु शाखाभिश्च समन्वितम् //
text_mt: an eight-sided figure enclosed by two earth-citadels; that pair of citadels / endowed with four gates in the cardinal directions and provided with branch-alleys—

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nāmāvṛtāṃ śaktiṃ gaṇaistatrārcayecchivām /
eṣā te dvādaśī nityā proktā nīlapatākinī //
meaning:
कृत्वा नामावृतां शक्तिं गणैस्तत्रार्चयेच्छिवाम् /
एषा ते द्वादशी नित्या प्रोक्ता नीलपताकिनी //
text_mt: having made this, one should worship there the auspicious goddess, the Śakti surrounded by her attendants by their names. / This twelfth Nityā, Nīlapatākinī, has been declared to you.

sanskrit_iast:
samare vijayaṃ khaṅgapādukāñjanasiddhidā /
vetālayakṣiṇīceṭapiśācādiprasādhinī //
meaning:
समरे विजयं खङ्गपादुकाञ्जनसिद्धिदा /
वेतालयक्षिणीचेटपिशाचादिप्रसाधिनी //
text_mt: She gives victory in battle, and the magical attainments of the sword, the enchanted sandals, and the salve; / she subdues vetālas, yakṣiṇīs, ceṭas, piśācas, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
nidhānabilasiddhānnasādhinī kāmacoditā /
atha trayodeśīṃ nityāṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada //
meaning:
निधानबिलसिद्धान्नसाधिनी कामचोदिता /
अथ त्रयोदेशीं नित्यां वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद //
text_mt: prompted by desire, she accomplishes [access to] treasures, subterranean realms, and perfected food. / Now I shall declare the thirteenth Nityā; listen, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
raso nabhastathā dāho vyāptakṣmāvanapūrvikā /
khena yuktā bhavennityā vijayaikākṣarā mune //
meaning:
रसो नभस्तथा दाहो व्याप्तक्ष्मावनपूर्विका /
खेन युक्ता भवेन्नित्या विजयैकाक्षरा मुने //
text_mt: Rasa, Nabhas, and Dāha, preceded by the pervaded Kṣmā and Vana, / joined with Kha—this is the one-syllabled Nityā Vijayā, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāyā vyañjanairdīrghasvarayuktaiścatuṣṭayam /
śeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryātṣaḍaṅgāni karāṅgayoḥ //
meaning:
विद्याया व्यञ्जनैर्दीर्घस्वरयुक्तैश्चतुष्टयम् /
शेषाभ्यां च द्वयं कुर्यात्षडङ्गानि कराङ्गयोः //
text_mt: With the consonants of the mantra joined with long vowels, [one makes] four [limbs], / and with the remaining two one should make two, [thus] the six limbs in the hands and the body.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānendriyeṣu śrotrādiṣvatha citte ca vinyaset /
akṣarāṇi kramādbinduyutānyanyattu pūrvavat //
meaning:
ज्ञानेन्द्रियेषु श्रोत्रादिष्वथ चित्ते च विन्यसेत् /
अक्षराणि क्रमाद्बिन्दुयुतान्यन्यत्तु पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: In the sense-organs—ears and so forth—and in the mind one should place / the syllables in order, joined with the bindu; the rest is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca vaktrāṃ daśabhujāṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanām /
bhāsvanmukuṭavinyāsacandralekhāvirājitām //
meaning:
पञ्च वक्त्रां दशभुजां प्रतिवक्त्रं त्रिलोचनाम् /
भास्वन्मुकुटविन्यासचन्द्रलेखाविराजिताम् //
text_mt: Having five faces, ten arms, three eyes on each face, / adorned with a crescent moon arranged on her radiant crown,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ pītāṃbarasamujjvalām /
udyadbhāsvadbiṃbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitām //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तां पीतांबरसमुज्ज्वलाम् /
उद्यद्भास्वद्बिंबतुल्यदेहकान्तिं शुचिस्मिताम् //
text_mt: endowed with all ornaments, resplendent in yellow garments, / her bodily radiance equal to the disk of the rising sun, possessing a pure smile,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhaṃ pāśaṃ kheṭacāpau kahlāraṃ vāmabāhubhiḥ /
cakraṃ tathāṅkuśaṃ khaṅgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṃ gakam //
meaning:
शङ्खं पाशं खेटचापौ कह्लारं वामबाहुभिः /
चक्रं तथाङ्कुशं खङ्गं सायकं मातुलुं गकम् //
text_mt: holding a conch, a noose, a shield, a bow, and a white lily with her left arms, / and a discus, an elephant-hook, a sword, an arrow, and a citron

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastaiḥ prayoge bhīmadarśanām /
upāsaneti saumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanām //
meaning:
दधानां दक्षिणैर्हस्तैः प्रयोगे भीमदर्शनाम् /
उपासनेति सौम्यां च सिंहोपरि कृतासनाम् //
text_mt: with her right hands; terrifying in appearance during ritual applications, / but gentle during daily worship; seated upon a lion,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghrārūḍhābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām /
samare pūjane 'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanām //
meaning:
व्याघ्रारूढाभिरभितः शक्तिभिः परिवारिताम् /
समरे पूजने ऽन्येषु प्रयोगेषु सुखासनाम् //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by Śaktis mounted on tigers; / seated in a comfortable posture during battle, worship, and other ritual applications.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayaścāpi pūjāyāṃ sukhāsanasamanvitāḥ /
sarvā devyāḥ samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhā api //
meaning:
शक्तयश्चापि पूजायां सुखासनसमन्विताः /
सर्वा देव्याः समाकारमुखपाण्यायुधा अपि //
text_mt: The Śaktis also, in the worship, are endowed with comfortable postures, / all having forms, faces, hands, and weapons identical to the goddess's.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvāropaśobhitam /
śākhaṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvatsamarcayet //
meaning:
चतुरस्रद्वयं कृत्वा चतुर्द्वारोपशोभितम् /
शाखष्टकसमोपेतं तत्र प्राग्वत्समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Having constructed two squares adorned with four gates, / provided with eight branches, one should worship there as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantarvṛtayugmāntaraṣṭakoṇaṃ vidhāya tu /
tadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutam //
meaning:
तदन्तर्वृतयुग्मान्तरष्टकोणं विधाय तु /
तदन्तश्च तथा पद्मं षोडशच्छदसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Within that, having constructed an eight-angled figure inside a pair of circles, / and inside that a lotus endowed with sixteen petals,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivāṣṭacchada padmaṃ vidhāyāvāhya tatra tām /
tattacchaktyā vṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathārcayet //
meaning:
तथैवाष्टच्छद पद्मं विधायावाह्य तत्र ताम् /
तत्तच्छक्त्या वृतां सम्यगुपचारैस्तथार्चयेत् //
text_mt: and likewise having made an eight-petaled lotus, having invoked her there / surrounded by the respective Śaktis, one should properly worship her with services.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā traghayodaśī proktā vādeyuddhe jayapradā /
caturdaśīṃ pravakṣye 'tha nityāṃ vai sarvamaṅgalām //
meaning:
एषा त्रघयोदशी प्रोक्ता वादेयुद्धे जयप्रदा /
चतुर्दशीं प्रवक्ष्ये ऽथ नित्यां वै सर्वमङ्गलाम् //
text_mt: This thirteenth [Nityā] is declared to bestow victory in debate and in battle. / Now I shall declare the fourteenth Nityā, Sarvamaṅgalā.

sanskrit_iast: hṛdaṃbuvanayuktaṃ khaṃ nityā syātsarvamaṅgalā //
meaning: हृदंबुवनयुक्तं खं नित्या स्यात्सर्वमङ्गला //
text_mt: Kha joined with Hṛt, Ambu, and Vana is the Nityā Sarvamaṅgalā.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaryanayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt /
ṣaḍdīrghāḍhyāṃ mūlavidyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu pravinyaset //
meaning:
एकाक्षर्यनया सिद्धो जायते खेचरः क्षणात् /
षड्दीर्घाढ्यां मूलविद्यां षडङ्गेषु प्रविन्यसेत् //
text_mt: One who attains perfection by this single syllable becomes a sky-goer in an instant. / One should place the root-mantra joined with the six long vowels upon the six limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ nityāṃ jātarūpābhāṃ muktāmāṇikyabhūṣaṇām /
māṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaddayāparām //
meaning:
तां नित्यां जातरूपाभां मुक्तामाणिक्यभूषणाम् /
माणिक्यमुकुटां नेत्रद्वयप्रेङ्खद्दयापराम् //
text_mt: That Nityā has the radiance of refined gold, is adorned with pearls and rubies, / wears a ruby crown, and is wholly devoted to compassion fluttering in her two eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujāṃ śāsanāṃ padme tvaṣṭaṣoḍaśataddvayaiḥ /
patrairupete sacatudvāraṃbhūsadmayugmake //
meaning:
द्विभुजां शासनां पद्मे त्वष्टषोडशतद्द्वयैः /
पत्रैरुपेते सचतुद्वारंभूसद्मयुग्मके //
text_mt: Having two arms, giving commands, [seated] on a lotus endowed with eight, / sixteen, and thirty-two petals, in a pair of earth-enclosures with four gates,

sanskrit_iast:
mātuluṅgaphalaṃ dakṣe dadhānāṃ karapaṅkaje /
vāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikam //
meaning:
मातुलुङ्गफलं दक्षे दधानां करपङ्कजे /
वामेन निजभक्तानां प्रयच्छन्तीं धनादिकम् //
text_mt: holding a citron fruit in her right lotus-hand, / and bestowing wealth and the like upon her devotees with her left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
svasamānābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām /
ṣaṭsaptātībhiranyābhirapsarotthābhiranvitām //
meaning:
स्वसमानाभिरभितः शक्तिभिः परिवारिताम् /
षट्सप्तातीभिरन्याभिरप्सरोत्थाभिरन्विताम् //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by Śaktis equal to herself, / accompanied by seventy-six other [Śaktis] born of the celestial nymphs—

sanskrit_iast:
prayogeṣvanyadā nityaṃ saparyāsūktaśaktikām /
eṣā caturdaśī proktā tathā pañcadaśīṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
प्रयोगेष्वन्यदा नित्यं सपर्यासूक्तशक्तिकाम् /
एषा चतुर्दशी प्रोक्ता तथा पञ्चदशीं शृणु //
text_mt: in ritual applications and at other times, the Śaktis mentioned in the worship are always [present]. / This fourteenth [Nityā] has been declared; listen now to the fifteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūḥ śūnyaṃ nabhasā bhūśca rasaścātha sthirāṃbu ca /
rayogninā yutījyāṃbumarudyuktārasā marut //
meaning:
भूः शून्यं नभसा भूश्च रसश्चाथ स्थिरांबु च /
रयोग्निना युतीज्यांबुमरुद्युक्तारसा मरुत् //
text_mt: Bhū, Śūnya, joined with Nabhas, and Bhū, Rasa, and then Sthirā and Ambu; / Raya joined with Agni; Jyā, Ambu, and Marut joined; Rasā, Marut,

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaśca marutā yuktaṃ rasā śūnye 'pi saṃyute /
gotrā careṇa sahitā aṃbupūrvākṣarastathā //
meaning:
नभश्च मरुता युक्तं रसा शून्ये ऽपि संयुते /
गोत्रा चरेण सहिता अंबुपूर्वाक्षरस्तथा //
text_mt: and Nabhas joined with Marut; Rasā, even joined with Śūnya; / Gotrā accompanied by Cara; and the syllable preceded by Ambu;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbvagnī hṛñca dāhāṃburasakṣmārayahṛtsvayuk /
haṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥ //
meaning:
अंब्वग्नी हृञ्च दाहांबुरसक्ष्मारयहृत्स्वयुक् /
हंसश्च मरुता दाहः प्राणश्च मरुता युतः //
text_mt: Ambu and Agni; Hṛt; Dāha, Ambu, Rasa, Kṣmā, Raya, and Hṛt joined with Sva; / Haṃsa with Marut; Dāha; and Prāṇa joined with Marut;

sanskrit_iast:
dāhaḥ sāgniprāṇacarau jyāmarutsahitārayaḥ /
careṇāṃbu ca gotrāhṛtsāgnirjyāṃburasā svayuk //
meaning:
दाहः साग्निप्राणचरौ ज्यामरुत्सहितारयः /
चरेणांबु च गोत्राहृत्साग्निर्ज्यांबुरसा स्वयुक् //
text_mt: Dāha; Agni with Prāṇa and Cara; Raya accompanied by Jyā and Marut; / Ambu with Cara; Gotrā, Hṛt with Agni; Jyā, Ambu, and Rasā joined with Sva;

sanskrit_iast:
rayaḥ sāgnirjyāṃburasā punarete javī tataḥ /
dāhenānena te dviḥ syādbhasvo dāhamarutsvayuk //
meaning:
रयः साग्निर्ज्यांबुरसा पुनरेते जवी ततः /
दाहेनानेन ते द्विः स्याद्भस्वो दाहमरुत्स्वयुक् //
text_mt: Raya with Agni; Jyā, Ambu, and Rasā; again these; then Javī; / with Dāha, these [syllables] should be doubled; Bhasva joined with Dāha, Marut, and Sva;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaḥ sadāhavahnisvo dāhakṣmāsvayutaśca saḥ /
saptadāhāstato 'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca te //
meaning:
हंसः सदाहवह्निस्वो दाहक्ष्मास्वयुतश्च सः /
सप्तदाहास्ततो ऽस्याः स्युरष्टमाद्यास्तु पञ्च ते //
text_mt: Haṃsa with Dāha, Vahni, and Sva; and it joined with Dāha, Kṣmā, and Sva; / then seven Dāhas; the five from this [mantra's] eighth onwards;

sanskrit_iast:
upāntyādhaḥ sthitaṃ nīlapatākāyā anantaram /
tvaritā tvaṃ ca bheruṇḍāṣṭamaṃ ca navanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
उपान्त्याधः स्थितं नीलपताकाया अनन्तरम् /
त्वरिता त्वं च भेरुण्डाष्टमं च नवनं तथा //
text_mt: that which is placed below the penultimate; immediately after, [the syllable] of Nīlapatākā; / then [of] Tvaritā; and the eighth and ninth of Bheruṇḍā.

sanskrit_iast:
sā jvālāmālinīnityā triṣaṣṭyarṇā samīritā /
ekadvayacatuḥpañcacatuṣṭayadaśākṣaraiḥ //
meaning:
सा ज्वालामालिनीनित्या त्रिषष्ट्यर्णा समीरिता /
एकद्वयचतुःपञ्चचतुष्टयदशाक्षरैः //
text_mt: She, the Nityā Jvālāmālinī, is declared to possess sixty-three syllables. / With one, two, four, five, four, and ten syllables

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭkarāṅgayoḥ /
śeṣaistu vyāpakaṃ kuryāttato dhyāyetsanātanīm //
meaning:
कुर्यादङ्गानि मूलार्णैरादितः षट्कराङ्गयोः /
शेषैस्तु व्यापकं कुर्यात्ततो ध्यायेत्सनातनीम् //
text_mt: from the beginning of the root-syllables, one should make the six limbs in the hands and the body; / with the remaining [syllables] one should perform the pervasive placement, and then meditate upon the eternal goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
jvalajjvalanasaṃkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām /
ṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām //
meaning:
ज्वलज्ज्वलनसंकाशां माणिक्यमुकुटोज्ज्वलाम् /
षड्वक्त्रां द्वादशभुजां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् //
text_mt: Resembling blazing fire, resplendent with a ruby crown, / having six faces, twelve arms, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśau khaṅgakheṭau cāpabāṇau gadādarau /
śūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ kapapaṅkajaiḥ //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशौ खङ्गखेटौ चापबाणौ गदादरौ /
शूलवह्नी वराभीती दधानां कपपङ्कजैः //
text_mt: holding a noose and elephant-hook, sword and shield, bow and arrow, mace and conch, / trident and fire, and [granting] boons and fearlessness with her lotus-hands,

sanskrit_iast:
svapramāṇābhirabhitaḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritām /
cārusmitalasadvaktra sarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvatām //
meaning:
स्वप्रमाणाभिरभितः शक्तिभिः परिवारिताम् /
चारुस्मितलसद्वक्त्र सरोजां त्रीक्षणान्वताम् //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by Śaktis equal to herself, / her lotus-faces resplendent with charming smiles, endowed with three eyes [on each face].

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvaivamupacāraistairarcayettāṃ tu nityaśaḥ /
caturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitam //
meaning:
ध्यात्वैवमुपचारैस्तैरर्चयेत्तां तु नित्यशः /
चतुरस्रद्वयं कृत्वा चतुर्द्वारसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Having meditated thus, one should worship her continually with those offerings, / having drawn two squares furnished with four gates,

sanskrit_iast:
saśākhamaṣṭapatrābjamantarā tryasrakaṃ tataḥ /
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ jayet //
meaning:
सशाखमष्टपत्राब्जमन्तरा त्र्यस्रकं ततः /
षट्कोणं मध्यतस्त्र्यस्रं विधायात्र शिवां जयेत् //
text_mt: an eight-petalled lotus along with filaments, inside that a triangle, / a hexagon, and a triangle in the center; here one should worship Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā pañcadaśī proktā ṣoḍaśīṃ śṛṇu nārada /
vāyupraṇavatattvaistu citrāsyādakṣaradvayā //
meaning:
एषा पञ्चदशी प्रोक्ता षोडशीं शृणु नारद /
वायुप्रणवतत्त्वैस्तु चित्रास्यादक्षरद्वया //
text_mt: This has been declared as the fifteenth [Nityā]; hear of the sixteenth, O Nārada: / [composed] of wind, Praṇava, and tattvas, having two syllables from the mouth of Citrā,

sanskrit_iast:
yā siddhā dhanadhānyātmanidhilābhāya kalpyate /
vidyādyavāyunā kuryāddīrghasvarayujā kramāt //
meaning:
या सिद्धा धनधान्यात्मनिधिलाभाय कल्प्यते /
विद्याद्यवायुना कुर्याद्दीर्घस्वरयुजा क्रमात् //
text_mt: which, perfected, is designed for the acquisition of the treasure of wealth and grain. / With the first wind of the vidyā, combined in turn with the long vowels,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyaset /
udyadādityabiṃbābhāṃ navaratnavibhūṣaṇām //
meaning:
षडङ्गानि यथापूर्वं मातृकां विद्यया न्यसेत् /
उद्यदादित्यबिंबाभां नवरत्नविभूषणाम् //
text_mt: one should perform the six limbs as before, and impose the mātṛkā with the vidyā: / shining like the orb of the rising sun, adorned with nine gems,

sanskrit_iast:
navaratnakirīṭāṃ ca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalām /
caturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ śucismitalasanmukhīm //
meaning:
नवरत्नकिरीटां च चित्रपट्टांशुकोज्ज्वलाम् /
चतुर्भुजां त्रिनयनां शुचिस्मितलसन्मुखीम् //
text_mt: crowned with a diadem of nine gems, resplendent in garments of variegated silk, / four-armed, three-eyed, her face radiant with a pure smile,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīm /
caturbhujeṣu vai pāśamaṅkuśaṃ varadābhaye //
meaning:
सर्वानन्दमयीं नित्यां समस्तेप्सितदायिनीम् /
चतुर्भुजेषु वै पाशमङ्कुशं वरदाभये //
text_mt: consisting of all bliss, eternal, granting every desire, / indeed [holding] in her four hands a noose, a goad, and the gestures of bestowing boons and freedom from fear,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ maṅgalāṃ padmakarṇikāyonimadhyagām /
tacchaktibhiśca taccakre tathaivārcanamīritam //
meaning:
दधानां मङ्गलां पद्मकर्णिकायोनिमध्यगाम् /
तच्छक्तिभिश्च तच्चक्रे तथैवार्चनमीरितम् //
text_mt: auspicious, seated in the center of the yoni on the pericarp of the lotus. / The worship is likewise declared to be in her cakra along with her Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇadāhau dharāyukto punarādyaṃ rase marut /
vyāsaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayam //
meaning:
प्राणदाहौ धरायुक्तो पुनराद्यं रसे मरुत् /
व्यासं मरुच्छक्तियुतं भूः स्वयुक्ता ततस्त्रयम् //
text_mt: Prāṇa and Dāha joined with Dharā; then the first; Marut in Rasa; / Vyāsa joined with Marut and Śakti; Bhū joined with Sva; then the triad.

sanskrit_iast:
asyā ādyāṃ rasāyugmaṃ caraṇena prayojitam /
dāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ param //
meaning:
अस्या आद्यां रसायुग्मं चरणेन प्रयोजितम् /
दाहेन वह्निशक्तिभ्यां युतो हंसस्ततः परम् //
text_mt: Her first, a pair of Rasā, applied with Caraṇa; / accompanied by Dāha, Vahni, and Śaktis; thereafter Haṃsa;

sanskrit_iast:
nabhodirhṛtsadāhāṃbujyā śūnyaṃ svena saṃyutam /
aṃbu paścādviṣayuktaṃ marutā tu nabhoyutam //
meaning:
नभोदिर्हृत्सदाहांबुज्या शून्यं स्वेन संयुतम् /
अंबु पश्चाद्विषयुक्तं मरुता तु नभोयुतम् //
text_mt: Nabhas, Adi, Hṛt, Sa, Dāha, Aṃbu, Jyā; Śūnya combined with Sva; / Aṃbu thereafter joined with Viṣa; combined with Nabhas by Marut;

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ vyāptaṃ bhuvā haṃsaḥ pūrvāntyau syānmanutrayam /
asyāḥ ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇā daityāsyādādya īritaḥ //
meaning:
शून्यं व्याप्तं भुवा हंसः पूर्वान्त्यौ स्यान्मनुत्रयम् /
अस्याः षष्ठादिपञ्चार्णा दैत्यास्यादाद्य ईरितः //
text_mt: Śūnya pervaded by Bhuvā; Haṃsa; the first and final: this should be the triad of mantras. / Her five syllables beginning with the sixth, from the demon's mouth, are stated as the first;

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśākṣarādantyā dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍa īritaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramāt //
meaning:
एकादशाक्षरादन्त्या द्वितीयः खण्ड ईरितः /
तृतीयः पञ्चविंशार्णः प्रोक्ता मन्त्रा इति क्रमात् //
text_mt: from the eleventh syllable to the last is declared the second section; / the third consists of twenty-five syllables; thus the mantras are proclaimed in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
bālā bījatrayādyairdvistribhirmantraiḥ ṣaḍagaṅkam /
vikīrṇakuntalāṃ nagrāṃ raktāmānandavigrahām //
meaning:
बाला बीजत्रयाद्यैर्द्विस्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रैः षडगङ्कम् /
विकीर्णकुन्तलां नग्रां रक्तामानन्दविग्रहाम् //
text_mt: One should perform the six limbs twice and thrice with the mantras beginning with the three Bālā syllables. / With disheveled locks, naked, red, an embodiment of bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīkaraiḥ /
tatsamānāyudhākāravarṇā devyāstu vā //
meaning:
दधानां चिन्तयेद्बाणचापपाशसृणीकरैः /
तत्समानायुधाकारवर्णा देव्यास्तु वा //
text_mt: holding arrows, a bow, a noose, and a goad in her hands, one should meditate [upon her]; / and the Goddess's [attendants], having weapons, forms, and colors like hers,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtusrātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥ /
ityeṣā kurukullānte proktā candrāvalīsvayam //
meaning:
ऋतुस्राताः स्फुरद्योन्यः सदानन्दारुणेक्षणाः /
इत्येषा कुरुकुल्लान्ते प्रोक्ता चन्द्रावलीस्वयम् //
text_mt: having bathed after their season, with pulsating yonis, ever blissful, with reddish eyes. / Thus at the end of Kurukullā, Candrāvalī herself has been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhīmabhidhāsyāmi lalitāyāḥ parā tanuḥ /
śuciḥ svenātha śūnyaṃ syānnabhasābhrarasisthirā //
meaning:
वाराहीमभिधास्यामि ललितायाः परा तनुः /
शुचिः स्वेनाथ शून्यं स्यान्नभसाभ्ररसिस्थिरा //
text_mt: I shall declare Vārāhī, the supreme form of Lalitā: / Śuci with Sva; then there is Śūnya; Nabhas, Abhra, Rasi, Sthirā;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutāṃburayau tathā /
ilasāyuto 'gniretāni punaraṃbumarudyutam //
meaning:
अंबु पश्चाद्रयः साग्निर्मरुतांबुरयौ तथा /
इलसायुतो ऽग्निरेतानि पुनरंबुमरुद्युतम् //
text_mt: Aṃbu thereafter; Raya along with Agni; Marut, Aṃbu, and Raya likewise; / Ila joined with Sā; Agni; these, again combined with Aṃbu and Marut;

sanskrit_iast:
dāhāṃbumarutāhaṃsastvagninaitattrayaṃ punaḥ /
ambudāhau marudyuktau haṃso 'tha dharayā nabhaḥ //
meaning:
दाहांबुमरुताहंसस्त्वग्निनैतत्त्रयं पुनः /
अम्बुदाहौ मरुद्युक्तौ हंसो ऽथ धरया नभः //
text_mt: Dāha, Aṃbu, Marut, Haṃsa with Agni; this triad again; / Aṃbu and Dāha joined with Marut; then Haṃsa; Nabhas with Dharā;

sanskrit_iast:
tejogninā punaḥ pañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥ /
toyaṃ careṇa tatpūrvaṃ toyamagniyutaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तेजोग्निना पुनः पञ्च वातः स्वेन समायुतः /
तोयं चरेण तत्पूर्वं तोयमग्नियुतं ततः //
text_mt: Tejas with Agni; then five; Vāta combined with Sva; / Toya with Cara; before that Toya joined with Agni; then

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śūnyaṃ śaktyā nabho yutam /
dāho dharā svasaharitastoyaṃ carasamanvitam //
meaning:
शून्यं व्याप्तेन शुचिना शून्यं शक्त्या नभो युतम् /
दाहो धरा स्वसहरितस्तोयं चरसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Śūnya with pervading Śuci; Śūnya joined with Śakti and Nabhas; / Dāha, Dharā, accompanied by Sva and Harit; Toya combined with Cara;

sanskrit_iast:
etatpūrvamadhuḥ proktaṃ catuṣṭayamataḥ param /
jyākhyena yuktā sacaro rabhaścaitasya pūrvakam //
meaning:
एतत्पूर्वमधुः प्रोक्तं चतुष्टयमतः परम् /
ज्याख्येन युक्ता सचरो रभश्चैतस्य पूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Madhu preceded by this is proclaimed; hereafter a tetrad: / accompanied by what is called Jyā, Cara, Rabha, and that which precedes it;

sanskrit_iast:
raso 'gninā punaḥ proktaṃ catuṣkā apayaṃ tataḥ /
śubhobhratā careṇāpi haṃsaḥ svena sapūrvakam //
meaning:
रसो ऽग्निना पुनः प्रोक्तं चतुष्का अपयं ततः /
शुभोभ्रता चरेणापि हंसः स्वेन सपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Rasa with Agni; again a tetrad is proclaimed; then Apayam; / Śubha, Abhra, Cara as well, Haṃsa with Sva along with its predecessor;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃso 'gninā prāk tritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutam /
rasaścareṇa tatpūrvamagninā ca raso yutaḥ //
meaning:
हंसो ऽग्निना प्राक् त्रितयं हृदयं स्वसमायुतम् /
रसश्चरेण तत्पूर्वमग्निना च रसो युतः //
text_mt: Haṃsa with Agni, the preceding triad; Hṛdaya combined with Sva; / Rasa with Cara, its predecessor, and Rasa joined with Agni;

sanskrit_iast:
paścāduktastrayaṃ vāto dharayā ca nabhonvitam /
prāṇaḥ svena yutaḥ paścāddhṛdayasvayutaṃ rasaḥ //
meaning:
पश्चादुक्तस्त्रयं वातो धरया च नभोन्वितम् /
प्राणः स्वेन युतः पश्चाद्धृदयस्वयुतं रसः //
text_mt: then the triad mentioned: Vāta and Nabhas combined with Dharā; / Prāṇa joined with Sva; then Rasa joined with Hṛdaya and Sva;

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptametattrayaṃ paścāddāhenāṃbu samanvitam /
gotrābharāyutā sparśo nādayukto javīyutaḥ //
meaning:
व्याप्तमेतत्त्रयं पश्चाद्दाहेनांबु समन्वितम् /
गोत्राभरायुता स्पर्शो नादयुक्तो जवीयुतः //
text_mt: this triad pervaded; then Aṃbu accompanied by Dāha; / Sparśa joined with Gotrā and Bharā, endowed with Nāda and speed;

sanskrit_iast:
dāhena pūrvapūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutam /
śūnyaṃ marutsvasahitaṃ hṛddāhenāṃbunā caraḥ //
meaning:
दाहेन पूर्वपूर्वं च पूर्वं च मरुता युतम् /
शून्यं मरुत्स्वसहितं हृद्दाहेनांबुना चरः //
text_mt: with Dāha each preceding one, and the predecessor joined with Marut; / Śūnya with Marut and Sva; Cara with Hṛt, Dāha, and Aṃbu;

sanskrit_iast:
sparśo marutsvasahito hṛddāhenāṃbusaṃyutam /
jyāgniḥ svasaṃyuto haṃsastathāṃbu marutā saha //
meaning:
स्पर्शो मरुत्स्वसहितो हृद्दाहेनांबुसंयुतम् /
ज्याग्निः स्वसंयुतो हंसस्तथांबु मरुता सह //
text_mt: Sparśa accompanied by Marut and Sva; joined with Hṛt, Dāha, and Aṃbu; / Jyā, Agni joined with Sva, Haṃsa, and likewise Aṃbu with Marut;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdrūpreṇa svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥ /
prāṇadāhau dharāyuktau punastau vahninā viyat //
meaning:
हृद्रूप्रेण स्वेन युतं रसश्च स्वेन संयुतः /
प्राणदाहौ धरायुक्तौ पुनस्तौ वह्निना वियत् //
text_mt: Hṛt joined with Rūpra and Sva, and Rasa combined with Sva; / Prāṇa and Dāha joined with Dharā; again those two with Vahni; Viyat;

sanskrit_iast:
vārddāhayuktamaṃbu syādiṣaṣṭyāsasvasaṃyutam /
pūrvadviruktavarṇau ca śuddhiḥ svena yutastathā //
meaning:
वार्द्दाहयुक्तमंबु स्यादिषष्ट्यासस्वसंयुतम् /
पूर्वद्विरुक्तवर्णौ च शुद्धिः स्वेन युतस्तथा //
text_mt: Aṃbu joined with Vāri and Dāha, joined with I, Ṣaṣṭhī, Asa, and Sva; / and the two syllables previously uttered; Śuddhi joined with Sva likewise;

sanskrit_iast:
sthirā rasā vatasvena dāvau haṃsau dharā svayuk /
yutirnādavatī paścāddhṛdaṃbumarutā yutam //
meaning:
स्थिरा रसा वतस्वेन दावौ हंसौ धरा स्वयुक् /
युतिर्नादवती पश्चाद्धृदंबुमरुता युतम् //
text_mt: Sthirā, Rasā, Vāta with Sva; Dāva, Haṃsa, Dharā joined with Sva; / then a junction endowed with Nāda; Hṛt joined with Aṃbu and Marut;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsaśca marutā vidyaḥ daśottaraśatākṣarī /
vārāhī pañcamī viśvavijayā bhadrakaumudī //
meaning:
हंसश्च मरुता विद्यः दशोत्तरशताक्षरी /
वाराही पञ्चमी विश्वविजया भद्रकौमुदी //
text_mt: and Haṃsa with Marut—the vidyā of one hundred and ten syllables: / Vārāhī, Pañcamī, Viśvavijayā, Bhadrakaumudī,

sanskrit_iast:
vārtālīti ca vikhyātā staṃbhanādyakhileṣṭadā /
aṅgāni kuryānmantrārṇaiḥ saptabhiṣaḍbhireva ca //
meaning:
वार्तालीति च विख्याता स्तंभनाद्यखिलेष्टदा /
अङ्गानि कुर्यान्मन्त्रार्णैः सप्तभिषड्भिरेव च //
text_mt: and celebrated as Vārtālī, granting all desires such as immobilization. / One should perform the limbs with seven and six syllables of the mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
daśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhirditāḥ /
trikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇavṛttadvayasamanvitam //
meaning:
दशभिः सप्तभिः सप्तसंख्यैर्जातिभिर्दिताः /
त्रिकोणवृत्तषट्कोणवृत्तद्वयसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: with ten, seven, and seven, recited with the [respective] jātis. / Having prepared a cakra endowed with a triangle, a circle,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmālikhyapūjayet /
dhyāyecca devīṃ kīlāsyāṃ tataḥ kāñcanasannibhām //
meaning:
विधाय चक्रं तत्रैव स्वनामालिख्यपूजयेत् /
ध्यायेच्च देवीं कीलास्यां ततः काञ्चनसन्निभाम् //
text_mt: a hexagon, and two circles, having inscribed one's own name right there, one should worship it. / Then one should meditate on the Goddess having a boar's face, resembling gold,

sanskrit_iast:
ākaṇṭhaṃ vanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgasaroruhām /
trinetrāmaṣṭahastāṃ ca cakraṃ śaṅkhamathāṅkuśam //
meaning:
आकण्ठं वनितारूपां ज्वलत्पिङ्गसरोरुहाम् /
त्रिनेत्रामष्टहस्तां च चक्रं शङ्खमथाङ्कुशम् //
text_mt: having the form of a woman up to her neck, with blazing golden lotuses, / three-eyed, eight-armed, [holding] a discus, a conch, then a goad,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśaṃ ca muśalaṃ śīrṣamabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathā /
dadhānāṃ garuḍaskandhe sukhāsīnāṃ vicintayet //
meaning:
पाशं च मुशलं शीर्षमभयं वरदं तथा /
दधानां गरुडस्कन्धे सुखासीनां विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: a noose, a pestle, a severed head, and gestures of freedom from fear and bestowing boons: / one should contemplate her seated comfortably upon the shoulders of Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
nityapūjāsu tacchaktīstatsamānāḥ smarenmune /
prayogeṣu smareddevīṃ siṃhasthāṃ vyāghragāmapi //
meaning:
नित्यपूजासु तच्छक्तीस्तत्समानाः स्मरेन्मुने /
प्रयोगेषु स्मरेद्देवीं सिंहस्थां व्याघ्रगामपि //
text_mt: In daily worships, O sage, one should remember her Śaktis who are similar to her. / In magical rituals, one should remember the Goddess mounted on a lion, or even riding a tiger,

sanskrit_iast:
gajārūḍhāṃ hayārūḍhāṃ tarśyārūḍhāṃ ca śaktibhiḥ /
śyāmāmapyaruṇāṃ pītāmasitāṃbhojavigrahām //
meaning:
गजारूढां हयारूढां तर्श्यारूढां च शक्तिभिः /
श्यामामप्यरुणां पीतामसितांभोजविग्रहाम् //
text_mt: mounted on an elephant, mounted on a horse, or mounted on Garuḍa with her Śaktis, / dark, or reddish, yellow, or with a body like a blue lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
tattattprayogeṣu tathā dhyāyettattadavāptaye /
aruṇāṃ pañcamīṃ vaśye pītāṃ staṃbhanake smaret //
meaning:
तत्तत्त्प्रयोगेषु तथा ध्यायेत्तत्तदवाप्तये /
अरुणां पञ्चमीं वश्ये पीतां स्तंभनके स्मरेत् //
text_mt: In the respective magical rituals, one should meditate in that manner to attain each result: / in subjection, one should remember Pañcamī as red; in immobilization, as yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāṃ ca durgame mārge sitāṃ yuddhe 'rinaṣṭaye /
dhūmrāmuccāṭane dhyāyetsādhako dvijasattamaḥ //
meaning:
श्यामां च दुर्गमे मार्गे सितां युद्धे ऽरिनष्टये /
धूम्रामुच्चाटने ध्यायेत्साधको द्विजसत्तमः //
text_mt: on an impassable path as dark; in battle, for the destruction of enemies, as white; / in eradication, the practitioner, best among the twice-born, should meditate upon her as smoky.

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ ṣoḍaśa nityāste saṃkṣapātsamudīritāḥ /
bhajatāmiṣṭadāḥ sadyaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṅkarāḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde rādhādimantranirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एताः षोडश नित्यास्ते संक्षपात्समुदीरिताः /
भजतामिष्टदाः सद्यः सर्वपापक्षयङ्कराः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे राधादिमन्त्रनिरूपणं नामाष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
These sixteen Nityās have been proclaimed to you in brief; / they grant desires immediately to those who worship them, and destroy all sins.

Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, entitled "Ascertainment of the Mantras of Rādhā and Others," in the third quarter of the major narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāra uvāca
athāsāmāvṛtisthānāṃ śaktīnāṃ samayena ca /
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ vakṣyāmi gurudhyānapuraḥ saram //
meaning:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
अथासामावृतिस्थानां शक्तीनां समयेन च /
नाम्नां सहस्रं वक्ष्यामि गुरुध्यानपुरः सरम् //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra said: / Now I shall declare the thousand names of the Śaktis who abide in the enclosures of these [Nityās], / in accordance with tradition, preceded by meditation on the Guru.

sanskrit_iast:
nāthā nava prakāśādyāḥ subhagāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
bhūmyādīniśivāntāni viddhi tattvāni nārada //
meaning:
नाथा नव प्रकाशाद्याः सुभगान्ताः प्रकीर्तिताः /
भूम्यादीनिशिवान्तानि विद्धि तत्त्वानि नारद //
text_mt: The nine Nāthas are proclaimed beginning with Prakāśa and ending with Subhaga; / know the tattvas, O Nārada, to begin with Earth and end with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
gurujanmādiparvāṇi darśāntāni ca sapta vai /
etāni prāhamanovṛttyā cintayetsādhakottamaḥ //
meaning:
गुरुजन्मादिपर्वाणि दर्शान्तानि च सप्त वै /
एतानि प्राहमनोवृत्त्या चिन्तयेत्साधकोत्तमः //
text_mt: The seven festivals, beginning with the Guru's birth and ending with the new moon: / these the excellent practitioner should contemplate with the mind's intent upon the Guru.

sanskrit_iast:
gurustotraṃ japeccāpi tadgatenāntarātmanā /
namaste nātha bhagavañśivāya gururūpiṇe //
meaning:
गुरुस्तोत्रं जपेच्चापि तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना /
नमस्ते नाथ भगवञ्शिवाय गुरुरूपिणे //
text_mt: And with an inner self devoted to him, he should recite the Guru's hymn of praise: / "Homage to you, O Lord, O venerable one, O Śiva in the form of the Guru!"

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai svaukṛtānekavigraha /
navāya navarūpāya paramārthaikarūpiṇe //
meaning:
विद्यावतारसंसिद्ध्यै स्वौकृतानेकविग्रह /
नवाय नवरूपाय परमार्थैकरूपिणे //
text_mt: O you who have assumed multiple bodies for the full realization of the descent of knowledge, / who are ever new, who have nine forms, and whose sole form is the ultimate reality;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave ciddhanāya te /
svatantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya śivātmane //
meaning:
सर्वाज्ञानतमोभेदभानवे चिद्धनाय ते /
स्वतन्त्राय दयाकॢप्तविग्रहाय शिवात्मने //
text_mt: to you, the sun dispersing the darkness of all ignorance, a mass of consciousness, / independent, whose body is fashioned of compassion, whose nature is Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe /
vivekināṃ vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśinām //
meaning:
परतन्त्राय भक्तानां भव्यानां भव्यरूपिणे /
विवेकिनां विवेकाय विमर्शाय विमर्शिनाम् //
text_mt: subservient to your devotees, the form of auspiciousness to the auspicious, / discernment to the discerning, reflective awareness to the reflective,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśānāṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇe /
purastātpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaḥ kuryāmuparyadhaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकाशानां प्रकाशाय ज्ञानिनां ज्ञानरूपिणे /
पुरस्तात्पार्श्वयोः पृष्ठे नमः कुर्यामुपर्यधः //
text_mt: light to luminous beings, having the form of knowledge to the knowers— / to you I make salutation in front, on both sides, behind, above, and below.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā mañcittasadane vidhehi bhavadāsanam /
iti stutvā guruṃ bhaktyā parāṃ devīṃ vicintayet //
meaning:
सदा मञ्चित्तसदने विधेहि भवदासनम् /
इति स्तुत्वा गुरुं भक्त्या परां देवीं विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: "Always establish your seat in the house of my mind." / Having thus praised the guru with devotion, he should meditate on the supreme Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśagrahanakṣatrayoginīrāśirūpiṇīm /
devīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāpīṭharūpiṇīm //
