वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं यस्तु ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति /
स यादि ब्रह्मणो लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
whoever gives it covered with a cloth to a brāhmaṇa,
he goes to the world of Brahmā; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
marīce 'ṣṭādaśaitāni mayā proktāni yāni te /
purāṇāni tu saṃkṣepācchrotavyāni ca vistarāt //
meaning:
मरीचे ऽष्टादशैतानि मया प्रोक्तानि यानि ते /
पुराणानि तु संक्षेपाच्छ्रोतव्यानि च विस्तरात् //
text_mt:
O Marīci, these eighteen Purāṇas spoken by me to you
in brief are also to be heard in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ /
kathayedvā vidhānena neha bhūyaḥ sa jāyate //
meaning:
अष्टादश पुराणानि यः शृणोति नरोत्तमः /
कथयेद्वा विधानेन नेह भूयः स जायते //
text_mt:
That best of men who listens to the eighteen Purāṇas
or recites them according to the rules is not born here again.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrametatpurāṇānāṃ yanmayoktaṃ tavādhunā /
tannityaṃ śīlanīyaṃ hi purāṇaphalamicchatā //
meaning:
सूत्रमेतत्पुराणानां यन्मयोक्तं तवाधुना /
तन्नित्यं शीलनीयं हि पुराणफलमिच्छता //
text_mt:
This aphorism of the Purāṇas, which was spoken by me to you now,
is indeed constantly to be studied by one desiring the fruit of the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
na dāṃbhikāya pāpāya devagurvanusūyave /
deyaṃ kadāpi sādhūnāṃ dveṣiṇe na śaṭhāya ca //
meaning:
न दांभिकाय पापाय देवगुर्वनुसूयवे /
देयं कदापि साधूनां द्वेषिणे न शठाय च //
text_mt:
It should never be given to a hypocrite, a sinner, one who envies gods and gurus,
to a hater of the virtuous, nor to a rogue.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntāya śamacittāya śuśrūṣābhiratāya ca /
nirmatsarāya śucaye deyaṃ sadvaiṣṇavāya ca //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde brahmāṇḍapurāṇānukramaṇīnirūpaṇaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
शान्ताय शमचित्ताय शुश्रूषाभिरताय च /
निर्मत्सराय शुचये देयं सद्वैष्णवाय च //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे ब्रह्माण्डपुराणानुक्रमणीनिरूपणं नाम नवोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
It should be given to one who is calm, tranquil in mind, devoted to service,
free from malice, pure, and a true Vaiṣṇava.

Thus ends the one hundred and ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Table of Contents of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa', in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
purāṇasūtramakhilaṃ śrutaṃ tava mukhādvibho /
marūcaye yathā proktaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
पुराणसूत्रमखिलं श्रुतं तव मुखाद्विभो /
मरूचये यथा प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना //
text_mt:
Nārada said:
The entire summary of the Purāṇas has been heard from your mouth, O Lord,
as it was told to Marīci by Brahmā, the supreme deity.

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā tu mahābhāga tithīnāṃ vai kathānakam /
kramato mahyamākhyāhi yathā syādvataniścayaḥ //
meaning:
अधुना तु महाभाग तिथीनां वै कथानकम् /
क्रमतो मह्यमाख्याहि यथा स्याद्वतनिश्चयः //
text_mt:
Now, O greatly fortunate one, tell me in order
the account of the lunar days, so that there may be certainty regarding the observances.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminmāse tu yā puṇyā tithiryena uvāsitā /
yadvidhānaṃ ca pūjādestatsarvaṃ vada sāṃpratam //
meaning:
यस्मिन्मासे तु या पुण्या तिथिर्येन उवासिता /
यद्विधानं च पूजादेस्तत्सर्वं वद सांप्रतम् //
text_mt:
In which month, which lunar day is sacred, by whom it was observed,
and what the procedure for worship and the like is—tell all that now.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi tithīnāṃ te vrataṃ pṛthak /
tithīśānukramādeva sarvasiddhividhāyakam //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि तिथीनां ते व्रतं पृथक् /
तिथीशानुक्रमादेव सर्वसिद्धिविधायकम् //
text_mt:
Sanātana said:
Listen, Nārada; I shall tell you the individual observance for the lunar days,
in order of the lords of the lunar days, bestowing all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi jagadbrahmā sasaja prathame 'hani /
śuklapakṣe samagraṃ vai tadā sūryodaye sati //
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि जगद्ब्रह्मा ससज प्रथमे ऽहनि /
शुक्लपक्षे समग्रं वै तदा सूर्योदये सति //
text_mt:
In the month of Caitra, on the first day of the bright fortnight,
Brahmā created the entire universe at sunrise.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarādau vasaṃtādau balirājye tathaiva ca /
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā pratipatsarvadā budhaiḥ //
meaning:
वत्सरादौ वसंतादौ बलिराज्ये तथैव च /
पूर्वविद्धैव कर्तव्या प्रतिपत्सर्वदा बुधैः //
text_mt:
At the start of the year, at the beginning of spring, and likewise during the reign of Bali,
the first lunar day conjoined with the previous day should always be observed by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kāryā mahāśāntiḥ sarvakalmaṣanāśinī /
sarvotpātapraśamanī kaliduṣkṛtahāriṇī //
meaning:
तत्र कार्या महाशान्तिः सर्वकल्मषनाशिनी /
सर्वोत्पातप्रशमनी कलिदुष्कृतहारिणी //
text_mt:
There, a great rite of pacification is to be performed, destroying all sins,
allaying all portents, removing the evil deeds of the Kali age,

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ pradāpuṣṭikarī dhanasaubhāgyavarddhinī /
maṅgalyā ca pavitrā ca lokadvayamukhāvahā //
meaning:
आयुः प्रदापुष्टिकरी धनसौभाग्यवर्द्धिनी /
मङ्गल्या च पवित्रा च लोकद्वयमुखावहा //
text_mt:
granting life, bringing nourishment, increasing wealth and good fortune,
auspicious, pure, and bringing happiness in both worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmādau tu saṃpūjyo brahmā vahnivapurdharaḥ /
pādyārdhyapuṣpadhūpaiśca vastrālaṅkārabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्यामादौ तु संपूज्यो ब्रह्मा वह्निवपुर्धरः /
पाद्यार्ध्यपुष्पधूपैश्च वस्त्रालङ्कारभोजनैः //
text_mt:
On it, Brahmā bearing the body of Agni is first to be worshipped
with water for the feet, guest-water, flowers, incense, garments, ornaments, and food,

sanskrit_iast:
homairbalyupahāraiśca tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ /
tataḥ krameṇa devebhyaḥ pūjā kāryā pṛthakpṛthak //
meaning:
होमैर्बल्युपहारैश्च तथा ब्राह्मणतर्पणैः /
ततः क्रमेण देवेभ्यः पूजा कार्या पृथक्पृथक् //
text_mt:
with fire oblations, offerings of bali, and propitiations of brāhmaṇas.
Then worship should be performed in succession for the gods individually.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvoṅkāra namaskāraṃ kuśodakatilākṣataiḥ /
savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca tato dadyāddijātaye //
meaning:
कृत्वोङ्कार नमस्कारं कुशोदकतिलाक्षतैः /
सवस्त्रं सहिरण्यं च ततो दद्याद्दिजातये //
text_mt:
Having made the utterance of Oṃ and salutation with kuśa grass, water, sesame, and unbroken rice grains,
one should then give to a twice-born, along with cloth and gold,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ vedaviduṣe vratasaṃpūrtihetave /
evaṃ pūjāviśeṣeṇa vrataṃ syātsaurisaṃjñakam //
meaning:
दक्षिणां वेदविदुषे व्रतसंपूर्तिहेतवे /
एवं पूजाविशेषेण व्रतं स्यात्सौरिसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt:
a sacrificial gift to a knower of the Vedas for the purpose of completing the observance.
In this way, through this specific worship, the observance becomes known as Sauri,

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyadaṃ nṛṇāṃ vipra tasminneva dine mune /
vidyāvratamapi proktamasyāmeva tithau mune //
meaning:
आरोग्यदं नृणां विप्र तस्मिन्नेव दिने मुने /
विद्याव्रतमपि प्रोक्तमस्यामेव तिथौ मुने //
text_mt:
granting health to mortals, O brāhmaṇa sage, on that very day.
The Vidya-vrata is also proclaimed on this very lunar day, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tilakaṃ nāma ca proktaṃ kṛṣṇenājātaśatrave /
atha jyeṣṭhe site pakṣe pakṣatyāṃ divasodaye //
meaning:
तिलकं नाम च प्रोक्तं कृष्णेनाजातशत्रवे /
अथ ज्येष्ठे सिते पक्षे पक्षत्यां दिवसोदये //
text_mt:
And the observance named Tilaka was declared by Kṛṣṇa to Ajātaśatru.
Then, in Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, on the first lunar day at the rising of day,

sanskrit_iast:
devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayet /
raktatanturīdhānaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ //
meaning:
देवोद्यानभवं हृद्यं करवीरं समर्चयेत् /
रक्ततन्तुरीधानं गन्धधूपविलेपनैः //
text_mt:
one should worship the charming oleander born in a divine garden,
wrapped with red thread, with perfumes, incense, and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
prarūḍhasaptadhānyaiśca nāragairbījapūrakaiḥ /
abhyukṣyākṣatatoyena mantreṇetthaṃ kṣamāpayet //
meaning:
प्ररूढसप्तधान्यैश्च नारगैर्बीजपूरकैः /
अभ्युक्ष्याक्षततोयेन मन्त्रेणेत्थं क्षमापयेत् //
text_mt:
with sprouted seven grains, and with oranges and citrons.
Having sprinkled it with water and unbroken rice, one should ask forgiveness with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
karavīra vṛṣāvāsa namaste bhānuvallabha /
daṃbholimṛḍadurgādidevānāṃ satataṃ priya //
meaning:
करवीर वृषावास नमस्ते भानुवल्लभ /
दंभोलिमृडदुर्गादिदेवानां सततं प्रिय //
text_mt:
'O oleander, abode of righteousness, salutation to you, beloved of the sun,
ever dear to the gods headed by the wielder of the thunderbolt, Śiva, and Durgā!'

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṇeneti vedoktamantreṇetthaṃ kṣamāpayet /
evaṃ bhaktyā samabhyacya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
आकृष्णेनेति वेदोक्तमन्त्रेणेत्थं क्षमापयेत् /
एवं भक्त्या समभ्यच्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt:
With this Vedic mantra beginning with 'ākṛṣṇena', one should thus ask forgiveness.
Having worshipped thus with devotion and given a sacrificial gift to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryātpaścātsvabhavanaṃ vrajet /
nabhaḥ śukle pratipadi lakṣmībuddhipradāyakam //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कुर्यात्पश्चात्स्वभवनं व्रजेत् /
नभः शुक्ले प्रतिपदि लक्ष्मीबुद्धिप्रदायकम् //
text_mt:
one should then perform circumambulation and afterwards return to one's own home.
On the bright first lunar day of Śrāvaṇa, granting fortune and wisdom,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ nidānaṃ paramaṃ vratam /
somavāraṃ samārabhya sārdhamāsatrayaṃ dvija //
meaning:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां निदानं परमं व्रतम् /
सोमवारं समारभ्य सार्धमासत्रयं द्विज //
text_mt:
the supreme observance, the foundation of righteousness, wealth, desire, and liberation,
is undertaken on a Monday for three and a half months, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikāsitabhūtāyāmupoṣyaṃ vratatatparaḥ /
pūrṇāyāṃ śivamabhyarcya suvaṇa vaṃśasaṃyutam //
meaning:
कार्तिकासितभूतायामुपोष्यं व्रततत्परः /
पूर्णायां शिवमभ्यर्च्य सुवण वंशसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
Devoted to the observance, having fasted on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight of Kārtika,
one should worship Śiva on the full moon day with a bamboo vessel containing gold.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyanaṃ sumahatpuṇyaṃ devatāprītivardhakam /
dadyādviprāya saṃkalpya dhanavṛddhyai munīśvara //
meaning:
वायनं सुमहत्पुण्यं देवताप्रीतिवर्धकम् /
दद्याद्विप्राय संकल्प्य धनवृद्ध्यै मुनीश्वर //
text_mt:
A most meritorious ritual gift increasing the delight of the deities
should be given to a brāhmaṇa with a solemn resolve for the increase of wealth, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādraśuklapratipadi vrataṃ nāmnā mahattamam /
vrataṃ maunāhvayaṃ kecitprāhuratra śivor'cyate //
meaning:
भाद्रशुक्लप्रतिपदि व्रतं नाम्ना महत्तमम् /
व्रतं मौनाह्वयं केचित्प्राहुरत्र शिवोर्ऽच्यते //
text_mt:
On the bright first lunar day of Bhādrapada is the supreme observance by name;
some call it the observance called Mauna, wherein Śiva is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ tu pacenmaunī ṣoḍaśatriguṇāni ca /
phalāni piṣṭapakvāni dadyādviprāya ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं तु पचेन्मौनी षोडशत्रिगुणानि च /
फलानि पिष्टपक्वानि दद्याद्विप्राय षोडश //
text_mt:
The silent observer should cook offerings, and sixteen times three
fruits and cooked pastries; he should give sixteen to a brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
devāya ṣoḍaśānyāni bhujyante ṣoḍaśātmanā /
sauvarṇaṃ śivamabhyarcya kumbhopari vidhānavit //
meaning:
देवाय षोडशान्यानि भुज्यन्ते षोडशात्मना /
सौवर्णं शिवमभ्यर्च्य कुम्भोपरि विधानवित् //
text_mt:
sixteen others to the god, and sixteen are eaten by himself.
Having worshipped golden Śiva atop a water jar, a knower of the rules

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ dhenusahitamācāryyāya pradāpayet /
idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra deva devasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं धेनुसहितमाचार्य्याय प्रदापयेत् /
इदं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र देव देवस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt:
should give all that together with a cow to the preceptor.
Having performed this observance, O brāhmaṇa, of the god of gods, the trident-bearer,

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśābdaṃ dehāntaṃ bhuktabhogaḥ śivaṃ vrajet /
āśvine sitapakṣatyāṃ katvāśokavrataṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशाब्दं देहान्तं भुक्तभोगः शिवं व्रजेत् /
आश्विने सितपक्षत्यां कत्वाशोकव्रतं नरः //
text_mt:
for fourteen years, having enjoyed pleasures until the end of the body, he goes to Śiva.
Having performed the Aśoka-vrata on the bright first lunar day of Āśvina, a man

sanskrit_iast:
aśoko jāyate vipradhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ /
aśokapūjanaṃ tatra kāryaṃ niyamatatparaiḥ //
meaning:
अशोको जायते विप्रधनधान्यसमन्वितः /
अशोकपूजनं तत्र कार्यं नियमतत्परैः //
text_mt:
becomes free from sorrow, endowed with wealth and grain, O brāhmaṇa.
The worship of the aśoka tree is to be performed there by those intent on the vow.

sanskrit_iast:
vratānte dvādaśe varṣe mūrtiṃ cāśokaśākhinaḥ /
samarpya gurave bhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
व्रतान्ते द्वादशे वर्षे मूर्तिं चाशोकशाखिनः /
समर्प्य गुरवे भक्त्या शिवलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
At the end of the observance, in the twelfth year, having offered an image of the aśoka tree
to the guru with devotion, he is glorified in the world of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāmeva pratipadi navarātraṃ samārabhet /
pūrvāhne pūjayeddevīṃ ghaṭasthāpanapūrvakam //
meaning:
अस्यामेव प्रतिपदि नवरात्रं समारभेत् /
पूर्वाह्ने पूजयेद्देवीं घटस्थापनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt:
On this very first lunar day, one should begin the Navarātra.
In the morning, one should worship the Goddess after establishing the water jar,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkurāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā yavairgodhūmamiśritaiḥ /
tataḥ pratidinaṃ kuryādekabhuktamayācitam //
meaning:
अङ्कुरारोपणं कृत्वा यवैर्गोधूममिश्रितैः /
ततः प्रतिदिनं कुर्यादेकभुक्तमयाचितम् //
text_mt:
having sown sprouts with barley mixed with wheat.
Then every day one should eat once, unasked,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaṃ yathāśakti pūjāpāṭhajapādikam /
mārkaṃṇḍeya purāṇoktaṃ caritatritayaṃ dvija //
meaning:
उपवासं यथाशक्ति पूजापाठजपादिकम् /
मार्कंण्डेय पुराणोक्तं चरितत्रितयं द्विज //
text_mt:
fast according to one's ability, and perform worship, recitation, japa, and the like.
The three episodes proclaimed in the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhanīyaṃ navadinaṃ bhuktimuktī abhīpsatā /
kumārīpūjanaṃ tatra praśastaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
पठनीयं नवदिनं भुक्तिमुक्ती अभीप्सता /
कुमारीपूजनं तत्र प्रशस्तं भोजनादिभिः //
text_mt:
should be read for nine days by one desiring enjoyment and liberation.
The worship of young virgins there with food and the like is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra sarvasiddhyālayo naraḥ /
jāyate bhuvi durgāyāḥ prasādānnātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र सर्वसिद्ध्यालयो नरः /
जायते भुवि दुर्गायाः प्रसादान्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
Having performed the observance in this manner, O brāhmaṇa, a man becomes an abode
of all accomplishments on earth through the grace of Durgā; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
athorjasitapakṣatyāṃ navarātroditaṃ caret /
viśeṣādannakūṭākhyaṃ viṣṇuprītivivardhanam //
meaning:
अथोर्जसितपक्षत्यां नवरात्रोदितं चरेत् /
विशेषादन्नकूटाख्यं विष्णुप्रीतिविवर्धनम् //
text_mt:
Then, on the bright first lunar day of Kārtika, one should observe what is prescribed for Navarātra,
especially the rite called Annakūṭa, which increases the pleasure of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapākaiḥ sardadohaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye /
kartavyamannakūṭaṃ tu govarddhanasamarcane //
meaning:
सर्वपाकैः सर्ददोहैः सर्वैः सर्वार्थसिद्धये /
कर्तव्यमन्नकूटं तु गोवर्द्धनसमर्चने //
text_mt: With all cooked foods and all milk-yields, for the achievement of all ends, / a mountain of food should be made during the worship of Govardhana.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ gobhiḥ saha śrīmadgovarddhanadharādharam /
samarcya dakṣiṇīkṛtya bhuktimuktī samāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सायं गोभिः सह श्रीमद्गोवर्द्धनधराधरम् /
समर्च्य दक्षिणीकृत्य भुक्तिमुक्ती समाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: In the evening, having worshipped the glorious Govardhana mountain along with the cows / and circumambulated it, one obtains enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mārgasitādyāyāṃ dhanavratamanuttamam /
naktaṃ viṣṇvarcanaṃ homaiḥ sauvarṇīṃ hutabhuktanum //
meaning:
अथ मार्गसिताद्यायां धनव्रतमनुत्तमम् /
नक्तं विष्ण्वर्चनं होमैः सौवर्णीं हुतभुक्तनुम् //
text_mt: Now, on the first day of the bright half of Mārgaśīrṣa, is the unsurpassed vow for wealth: / the worship of Viṣṇu at night with fire oblations; one should give a golden image of Agni,

sanskrit_iast:
raktavastrayugācchannāṃ dvijāya pratipādayet /
evaṃ kṛtvā dhanairdhānyaiḥ samṛddho jāyate bhuvi //
meaning:
रक्तवस्त्रयुगाच्छन्नां द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् /
एवं कृत्वा धनैर्धान्यैः समृद्धो जायते भुवि //
text_mt: covered with a pair of red garments, to a twice-born. / Doing thus, one becomes rich with wealth and grains on earth;

sanskrit_iast:
vahninā dagdhapāpastu viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
pauṣaśuklapratipadi bhānumabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
वह्निना दग्धपापस्तु विष्णुलोके महीयते /
पौषशुक्लप्रतिपदि भानुमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: with his sins burnt by fire, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / On the first day of the bright half of Pauṣa, having worshipped the Sun with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktavrato martyo bhānulokamavāpnuyāt /
māghaśuklādyadivase vahniṃ sākṣānmaheśvaram //
meaning:
एकभक्तव्रतो मर्त्यो भानुलोकमवाप्नुयात् /
माघशुक्लाद्यदिवसे वह्निं साक्षान्महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: a mortal observing the vow of eating a single meal reaches the world of the Sun. / On the first day of the bright half of Māgha, having duly worshipped

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyacya vidhānena samṛddho jāyate bhuvi /
atha phaālgunaśuklādau devadevaṃ digaṃbaram //
meaning:
समभ्यच्य विधानेन समृद्धो जायते भुवि /
अथ फआल्गुनशुक्लादौ देवदेवं दिगंबरम् //
text_mt: Agni as Maheśvara in person, one becomes prosperous on earth. / Now, on the first day of the bright half of Phālguna, one should sprinkle all around with water

sanskrit_iast:
dhūlidhūsarasarvāṅgaṃ jalairukṣetsamantataḥ /
karmaṇā laukikenāpi saṃtuṣṭo hi maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
धूलिधूसरसर्वाङ्गं जलैरुक्षेत्समन्ततः /
कर्मणा लौकिकेनापि संतुष्टो हि महेश्वरः //
text_mt: the God of gods, who is clothed in space, whose entire body is grey with dust. / Satisfied even by an ordinary worldly act,

sanskrit_iast:
svasāyujyaṃ pradiśati bhaktyā samyaksamarcitaḥ /
vaiśākhe tu sitādyāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvavihāriṇam //
meaning:
स्वसायुज्यं प्रदिशति भक्त्या सम्यक्समर्चितः /
वैशाखे तु सिताद्यायां विष्णुं विश्वविहारिणम् //
text_mt: Maheśvara, when worshipped properly with devotion, grants union with himself. / On the first day of the bright half of Vaiśākha, having duly worshipped

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya vidhānena viprānsaṃbhojayedvatī /
evaṃ śucisitādyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum //
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य विधानेन विप्रान्संभोजयेद्वती /
एवं शुचिसिताद्यायां ब्रह्माणं जगतां गुरुम् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, who sports through the universe, the vow-keeper should feed Brahmins. / Likewise, on the first day of the bright half of Śuci, [having worshipped] Brahmā, the guru of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā sahito brahmā sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ /
svasāyujyaṃ pradiśati sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
विष्णुना सहितो ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरः /
स्वसायुज्यं प्रदिशति सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Brahmā together with Viṣṇu, the Lord of the lords of all worlds, / grants union with himself, and one obtains all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
āsu dvādaśamāsānāṃ pratipatsu dvijottama /
vratāni tubhyaṃ proktāni bhuktimuktipradāni ca //
meaning:
आसु द्वादशमासानां प्रतिपत्सु द्विजोत्तम /
व्रतानि तुभ्यं प्रोक्तानि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि च //
text_mt: The vows on these first days of the twelve months, O best of the twice-born, / have been declared to you, bestowing enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
vrateṣveteṣu sarveṣu brahmacaryaṃ vidhīyate /
bhojane tu haviṣyānnaṃ sāmānyata udāhṛtam //
iti śrībṛhannanāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsapratipadvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
व्रतेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु ब्रह्मचर्यं विधीयते /
भोजने तु हविष्यान्नं सामान्यत उदाहृतम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्ननारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासप्रतिपद्व्रतनिरूपणं नाम दशोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
In all these vows, celibacy is prescribed; / for food, sacrificial food is generally prescribed.

Thus ends the one hundred and tenth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Vows on the First Days of the Twelve Months,' in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi dvitīyāyā vratāni te /
yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वितीयाया व्रतानि ते /
यानि कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Listen, O Brahmin, I will declare to you the vows of the second lunar day, / performing which with devotion a man is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ brahmaṇaṃ ca saśaktikam /
haviṣyānnena gandhādyaiḥ stoṣya sarvakratūdbhavam //
meaning:
चैत्रशुक्लद्वितीयायां ब्रह्मणं च सशक्तिकम् /
हविष्यान्नेन गन्धाद्यैः स्तोष्य सर्वक्रतूद्भवम् //
text_mt: On the second day of the bright half of Caitra, praising Brahmā together with his Śakti / with sacrificial food, perfumes, and the like, [one attains] the fruit arising from all sacrifices;

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ labdhvākhilānkāmānante brahmapadaṃ labhet /
asminneva dine vipra bālendumuditaṃ pare //
meaning:
फलं लब्ध्वाखिलान्कामानन्ते ब्रह्मपदं लभेत् /
अस्मिन्नेव दिने विप्र बालेन्दुमुदितं परे //
text_mt: having attained all desires, at the end he reaches the station of Brahmā. / On this very day, O Brahmin, having worshipped the newly risen crescent moon

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya niśāraṃbhe bhuktimuktiphalaṃ bhavet /
atha vāsmindine bhaktyā dasrāvabhyarcya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य निशारंभे भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं भवेत् /
अथ वास्मिन्दिने भक्त्या दस्रावभ्यर्च्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: at the beginning of the night on the following [day], the fruit is enjoyment and liberation. / Alternatively, on this day, having worshipped the two Dasras with devotion and care,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇarajate netre pradadyācca dvijātaye /
pūrṇayātrāvrate hyasmindadhnā vāpi ghṛtena ca //
meaning:
सुवर्णरजते नेत्रे प्रदद्याच्च द्विजातये /
पूर्णयात्राव्रते ह्यस्मिन्दध्ना वापि घृतेन च //
text_mt: one should give eyes of gold and silver to a twice-born. / In this vow of complete journey, indeed with curd or with ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
netravrataṃ dvādaśa vatsarānvai kṛtyā bhavedbhūmipatirdvijendra /
surūparūpo 'rigaṇapratāpī dharmābhirāmo nṛpavargamukhyaḥ //
meaning:
नेत्रव्रतं द्वादश वत्सरान्वै कृत्या भवेद्भूमिपतिर्द्विजेन्द्र /
सुरूपरूपो ऽरिगणप्रतापी धर्माभिरामो नृपवर्गमुख्यः //
text_mt: By performing the netravrata for twelve years, O best of twice-born, / one becomes an earthly ruler, endowed with handsome form, burning up hordes of foes, delighting in righteousness, foremost among kings.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ brahmaṇaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam /
samarcya saptadhānyānyāḍhyakuṃbhopari vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
राधशुक्लद्वितीयायां ब्रह्मणं विष्णुरूपिणम् /
समर्च्य सप्तधान्यान्याढ्यकुंभोपरि विधानतः //
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, having duly worshipped Brahmā in the form of Viṣṇu / upon a water-jar filled with the seven grains,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān /
jyeṣṭhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaraṃ bhuvanādhipam //
meaning:
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति भुक्त्वा भोगान्मनोरमान् /
ज्येष्ठशुक्लद्वितीयायां भास्करं भुवनाधिपम् //
text_mt: one attains the world of Viṣṇu after enjoying delightful pleasures. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, having duly worshipped the sun, the lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
catuvaktrasvarūpaṃ ca samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ /
bhojayitvā dvijān bhaktyā bhāskaraṃ lokamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
चतुवक्त्रस्वरूपं च समभ्यर्च्य विधानतः /
भोजयित्वा द्विजान् भक्त्या भास्करं लोकमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: in the form of the four-faced one [Brahmā], / and having fed the twice-born with devotion, one attains the world of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe dvitīyā puṇyasaṃyutā /
tasyāṃ rathaṃ samāropya rāmaṃ saha subhadrayā //
meaning:
आषाढस्य सिते पक्षे द्वितीया पुण्यसंयुता /
तस्यां रथं समारोप्य रामं सह सुभद्रया //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha is the meritorious second lunar day. / On that day, having mounted Rāma along with Subhadrā onto a chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijādibhirvratī sārdhaṃ parikramya purādikam /
jalāśayāntikaṃ gatvā kārayecca mahotsavam //
meaning:
द्विजादिभिर्व्रती सार्धं परिक्रम्य पुरादिकम् /
जलाशयान्तिकं गत्वा कारयेच्च महोत्सवम् //
text_mt: the observer of the vow, accompanied by the twice-born and others, having circumambulated the city and other places / and having gone to the vicinity of a reservoir of water, should perform a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
tadante devabhavane niveśya ca yathāvidhi /
brāhmaṇānbhojayeccaiva vratasyāsya prapūrtaye //
meaning:
तदन्ते देवभवने निवेश्य च यथाविधि /
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्चैव व्रतस्यास्य प्रपूर्तये //
text_mt: Then, having placed [the deities] in a temple according to rule, / he should feed the brāhmaṇas for the complete fulfillment of this vow.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaḥ śukladvitīyāyāṃ viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ /
svapitīti tithiḥ puṇyā hyaśokaśayanāhvayā //
meaning:
नभः शुक्लद्वितीयायां विश्वकर्मा प्रजापतिः /
स्वपितीति तिथिः पुण्या ह्यशोकशयनाह्वया //
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, Viśvakarman Prajāpati / goes to sleep; hence this meritorious lunar day is called Aśokaśayanā.

sanskrit_iast:
saśaktika tu śayyāsthaṃ pūjayitvā caturmukham /
imamuccārayenmantraṃ praṇamya jagatāṃ patim //
meaning:
सशक्तिक तु शय्यास्थं पूजयित्वा चतुर्मुखम् /
इममुच्चारयेन्मन्त्रं प्रणम्य जगतां पतिम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the four-faced one lying on a couch together with his consort, / and having bowed down to the lord of the worlds, one should utter this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkānta śrīvāsa śrīpate prabho /
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmada //
meaning:
श्रीवत्सधारिञ्छ्रीकान्त श्रीवास श्रीपते प्रभो /
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामद //
text_mt: “O bearer of the Śrīvatsa, beloved of Śrī, abode of Śrī, lord of Śrī, O master, / bestower of righteousness, wealth, and desire, may my householder life not go to ruin!”

sanskrit_iast:
candrārddhadānamatroktaṃ sarvasiddhividhāyakam /
bhādraśukladvitīyāyāṃ śakrarūpaṃ jagadvidhim //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्द्धदानमत्रोक्तं सर्वसिद्धिविधायकम् /
भाद्रशुक्लद्वितीयायां शक्ररूपं जगद्विधिम् //
text_mt: Here, giving a crescent moon is declared to bring about all success. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, having worshipped the creator of the world in the form of Indra

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā vidhānenana sarvakratuphalaṃ labhet /
āśvine māsi vai puṇyā dvitīyā śuklapakṣagā //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा विधानेनन सर्वक्रतुफलं लभेत् /
आश्विने मासि वै पुण्या द्वितीया शुक्लपक्षगा //
text_mt: according to rule, one obtains the fruit of all sacrifices. / In the month of Āśvina, the second lunar day occurring in the bright fortnight is meritorious;

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ pradattametasyāmanantaphalamucyate /
ūrjjaśukladvitīyāyāṃ yamo yamunayā purā //
meaning:
दानं प्रदत्तमेतस्यामनन्तफलमुच्यते /
ऊर्ज्जशुक्लद्वितीयायां यमो यमुनया पुरा //
text_mt: a gift given on this day is said to yield endless fruit. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, Yama was formerly

sanskrit_iast:
bhojitaḥ svagṛhe tena dvitīyaiṣā yamāhvayā /
puṣṭipravarddhanaṃ cātra bhaginyā bhojanaṃ gṛhe //
meaning:
भोजितः स्वगृहे तेन द्वितीयैषा यमाह्वया /
पुष्टिप्रवर्द्धनं चात्र भगिन्या भोजनं गृहे //
text_mt: fed by Yamunā in her own house; therefore, this second lunar day is named after Yama. / Eating in the house of a sister here promotes nourishment.

sanskrit_iast: vastrālaṅkārapūrvaṃ tu tasmai deyamataḥ param //
meaning: वस्त्रालङ्कारपूर्वं तु तस्मै देयमतः परम् //
text_mt: Then, preceded by garments and ornaments, [gifts] should be given to him after that.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājadevaḥ saṃbhojito nijakarātsvasṛsauhṛdena /
tasyāṃ svasuḥ karatalādiha yo bhunakti prāpnoti ratnadhanadhānyamanuttamaṃ saḥ //
meaning:
यस्यां तिथौ यमुनया यमराजदेवः संभोजितो निजकरात्स्वसृसौहृदेन /
तस्यां स्वसुः करतलादिह यो भुनक्ति प्राप्नोति रत्नधनधान्यमनुत्तमं सः //
text_mt: On the lunar day when Lord Yamarāja was fed by Yamunā from her own hand out of sisterly affection, / he who eats from the hand of a sister on that day obtains incomparable jewels, wealth, and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśukladvitīyāyāṃ śrāddhena pitṛpūjanam /
ārogyaṃ labhate cāpi putrapautrasamanvayaḥ //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्लद्वितीयायां श्राद्धेन पितृपूजनम् /
आरोग्यं लभते चापि पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वयः //
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, worship of the ancestors through a śrāddha / brings health, and one is endowed with sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāṃ gośṛṅgodakamārjanam /
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāmāste bālendudarśanam //
meaning:
पौषशुक्लद्वितीयायां गोशृङ्गोदकमार्जनम् /
सर्वकामप्रदं नॄणामास्ते बालेन्दुदर्शनम् //
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa, sprinkling with water from a cow’s horn / grants all desires to mortals; viewing the crescent moon is also [performed].

sanskrit_iast:
yor'ghyadānena bālenduṃ haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ /
pūjayetsājyasumanedharmakāmārthasiddhaye //
meaning:
योर्ऽघ्यदानेन बालेन्दुं हविष्याशी जितेन्द्रियः /
पूजयेत्साज्यसुमनेधर्मकामार्थसिद्धये //
text_mt: He who, subsisting on sacrificial food with senses conquered, / worships the crescent moon by offering arghya along with clarified butter and flowers, achieves righteousness, desire, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhānurūpaṃ prajāpatim /
samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ pūjayedraktapuṣpakaiḥ //
meaning:
माघशुक्लद्वितीयायां भानुरूपं प्रजापतिम् /
समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं पूजयेद्रक्तपुष्पकैः //
text_mt: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, having duly honoured Prajāpati in the form of the sun, / one should worship him with red flowers

sanskrit_iast:
raktairgaṃvaistathā svarṇamūrtiṃ nirmāya śaktitaḥ /
tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ gāghṛmairvāpitaṇḍulaiḥ //
meaning:
रक्तैर्गंवैस्तथा स्वर्णमूर्तिं निर्माय शक्तितः /
ततः पूर्णं ताम्रपात्रं गाघृमैर्वापितण्डुलैः //
text_mt: and red perfumes, having fashioned a golden image according to one's means. / Then, having offered a copper vessel filled with saffron or rice grains

sanskrit_iast:
samarpya deve bhaktyaiva sa mūrtiṃ pradadeddvije /
evaṃ kṛte vrate vipra sākṣātsūrya ivoditaḥ //
meaning:
समर्प्य देवे भक्त्यैव स मूर्तिं प्रददेद्द्विजे /
एवं कृते व्रते विप्र साक्षात्सूर्य इवोदितः //
text_mt: to the deity with devotion, he should give that image to a twice-born. / When the vow is thus performed, O twice-born, like the sun visibly risen,

sanskrit_iast:
durāsado durādharṣo jāyate bhuvimānavaḥ /
iha kāmānvarāmbhuktvā yātyante brahmaṇaḥ padam //
meaning:
दुरासदो दुराधर्षो जायते भुविमानवः /
इह कामान्वराम्भुक्त्वा यात्यन्ते ब्रह्मणः पदम् //
text_mt: a mortal becomes difficult of approach and invincible in the world. / Having enjoyed excellent desires here, he goes at the end to the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevastuto 'bhīkṣṇaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ /
atha phaālgunaśuklāyā dvitīyāyāṃ dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदेवस्तुतो ऽभीक्ष्णं विमानवरमास्थितः /
अथ फआल्गुनशुक्लाया द्वितीयायां द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: Constantly praised by all the gods, seated in an excellent aerial chariot. / Then, on the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, the best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ śivaṃ samabhyarcya suśvetaiśca sugandhibhaḥ /
puṣpairvitānakaṃ kṛtvā puṣpālaṅkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पैः शिवं समभ्यर्च्य सुश्वेतैश्च सुगन्धिभः /
पुष्पैर्वितानकं कृत्वा पुष्पालङ्करणैः शुभैः //
text_mt: having worshipped Śiva with pure white, fragrant flowers, / having made a canopy of flowers, along with auspicious floral ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyairvividhairdhūpairdīparnīrājanādibhiḥ /
prasādya praṇameccaiva sāṣṭāṅgaṃ patito bhuvi //
meaning:
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैर्धूपैर्दीपर्नीराजनादिभिः /
प्रसाद्य प्रणमेच्चैव साष्टाङ्गं पतितो भुवि //
text_mt: with various food-offerings, incenses, lamps, waving of lights, and other rites, / having propitiated him, should bow down prostrate on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ martyo vyādhivivarjitaḥ /
dhanadhānyasamāyukto jīvedvirṣaśataṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्च्य देवेशं मर्त्यो व्याधिविवर्जितः /
धनधान्यसमायुक्तो जीवेद्विर्षशतं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Having thus worshipped the lord of gods, a mortal, free from disease / and endowed with wealth and grain, certainly lives for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvidhānaṃ dvitīyāsu śuklapakṣagatāsu vā /
proktaṃ tadeva kṛṣṇāsu karttavyaṃ vidhikovidaiḥ //
meaning:
यद्विधानं द्वितीयासु शुक्लपक्षगतासु वा /
प्रोक्तं तदेव कृष्णासु कर्त्तव्यं विधिकोविदैः //
text_mt: Whatever procedure was prescribed for the second lunar days of the bright fortnight, / that very same [procedure] should be performed on those of the dark fortnight by those skilled in ritual rules.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnireva pṛthaṅmāḥsu nānārūpavapurddharaḥ /
pūjyate hi dvitīyāsu brahmacaryyādi pūrvavat //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsadvitīyāvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
वह्निरेव पृथङ्माःसु नानारूपवपुर्द्धरः /
पूज्यते हि द्वितीयासु ब्रह्मचर्य्यादि पूर्ववत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासद्वितीयाव्रतनिरूपणं नामैकादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Indeed, Fire alone, assuming various forms and bodies, is worshipped in the different months / on the second lunar days; celibacy and the rest are as before.

Thus ends the one hundred and eleventh chapter, named 'Description of the Vow of the Second Lunar Day for the Twelve Months', in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi tṛtīyāyā vratāni te /
yāni samyagvidhāyāśu nārī saubhāgyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि तृतीयाया व्रतानि ते /
यानि सम्यग्विधायाशु नारी सौभाग्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Listen, O Nārada! I shall declare to you the vows of the third lunar day, / by properly observing which a woman quickly attains marital felicity.

sanskrit_iast:
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā sabhartṛkām /
sauvarṇā rājatīṃ vāpi tāmnīṃ vā mṛṇyayīṃ dvija //
meaning:
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां गौरीं कृत्वा सभर्तृकाम् /
सौवर्णा राजतीं वापि ताम्नीं वा मृण्ययीं द्विज //
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, having made [an image of] Gaurī with her husband, / [whether] of gold, silver, copper, or clay, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairvastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
dūrvākāṇḍaiśca vidhivatsopavāsā tu kanyakā //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्वस्त्रैराभरणैः शुभैः /
दूर्वाकाण्डैश्च विधिवत्सोपवासा तु कन्यका //
text_mt: having worshipped her according to rule with perfumes, flowers, and the like, with auspicious garments and ornaments, / and with stalks of dūrvā grass, an unmarried girl who fasts,

sanskrit_iast:
varārthinī ca saubhāgyaputrabhartrarthinī tathā /
dvijabhāryā bhartṛmatīḥ kanyakāṃ vā sulakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
वरार्थिनी च सौभाग्यपुत्रभर्त्रर्थिनी तथा /
द्विजभार्या भर्तृमतीः कन्यकां वा सुलक्षणाः //
text_mt: or one seeking a husband, or likewise one desiring marital felicity, sons, and a husband, / having pleased the wives of brāhmaṇas who have living husbands, or well-omened unmarried girls,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūrāñjanavastrādyaiḥ pratoṣya prītamānasā /
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvratasaṃpūrtikāmyayā //
meaning:
सिंदूराञ्जनवस्त्राद्यैः प्रतोष्य प्रीतमानसा /
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्व्रतसंपूर्तिकाम्यया //
text_mt: with vermilion, collyrium, garments, and other [gifts], with a delighted mind, / should keep vigil at night, desiring the completion of the vow.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāṃ pratimāṃ vipra gurave pratipādayet /
dhātujāṃ mṛnmayīṃ vā tu nikṣipecca jalāśaye //
meaning:
ततस्तां प्रतिमां विप्र गुरवे प्रतिपादयेत् /
धातुजां मृन्मयीं वा तु निक्षिपेच्च जलाशये //
text_mt: Then, O vipra, she should give that image to her guru, / or if it is made of metal or clay, cast it into a reservoir of water.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi kṛtvā gaurīvrataṃ śubham /
dhenudvādaśasaṃkalpaṃ dadyādutsargasiddhaye //
meaning:
एवं द्वादशवर्षाणि कृत्वा गौरीव्रतं शुभम् /
धेनुद्वादशसंकल्पं दद्यादुत्सर्गसिद्धये //
text_mt: Having thus observed the auspicious vow of Gaurī for twelve years, / she should make a resolve to donate twelve cows for the accomplishment of its completion.

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra bahunoktena gaurī saubhāgyadāyinī /
strīṇāṃ yathā tathā nānyā vidyate bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन गौरी सौभाग्यदायिनी /
स्त्रीणां यथा तथा नान्या विद्यते भुवनत्रये //
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much on this? Gaurī bestows marital felicity; / for women, there is none other like her in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanaṃ putrānpatiṃ vidyāmājñāsiddhiṃ yaśaḥ sukham /
labhate sarvameveṣṭaṃ gaurīmabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
धनं पुत्रान्पतिं विद्यामाज्ञासिद्धिं यशः सुखम् /
लभते सर्वमेवेष्टं गौरीमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: Wealth, sons, a husband, learning, success of command, renown, happiness— / by worshipping Gaurī with devotion, she obtains every desired thing.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhaśuklatṛtīyā yā sākṣayā parikīrtitā /
tithistrotāyugādyā sā kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇī //
meaning:
राधशुक्लतृतीया या साक्षया परिकीर्तिता /
तिथिस्त्रोतायुगाद्या सा कृतस्याक्षयकारिणी //
text_mt: The third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Rādha (Vaiśākha) is proclaimed as Akṣayā (Imperishable); / that lunar day, the beginning of the Tretā age, renders imperishable whatever is performed.

sanskrit_iast:
dve śukle dve tathā kṛṣṇe yugādī kavayo viduḥ /
śukle pūrvāhnike grāhye kṛṣṇe caiva tapastatha //
meaning:
द्वे शुक्ले द्वे तथा कृष्णे युगादी कवयो विदुः /
शुक्ले पूर्वाह्निके ग्राह्ये कृष्णे चैव तपस्तथ //
text_mt: Two in the bright fortnight and likewise two in the dark fortnight are known by the wise as age-beginnings (yugādis); / in the bright fortnight they are to be taken in the forenoon, and in the dark fortnight likewise [...].

sanskrit_iast:
dvāparaṃ hi kalirbhādre pravṛttāni yugāni vai /
tatra rādhatṛtīyāyāṃ śrīsametaṃ jagadgurum //
meaning:
द्वापरं हि कलिर्भाद्रे प्रवृत्तानि युगानि वै /
तत्र राधतृतीयायां श्रीसमेतं जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: The Dvāpara and the Kali ages indeed commenced in the month of Bhādra; / there, on the third lunar day of Rādha, having worshipped the teacher of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyarcetpuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ /
yadvā gaṅgāṃbhasi snāto mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ //
meaning:
नारायणं समभ्यर्चेत्पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः /
यद्वा गङ्गांभसि स्नातो मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa accompanied by Śrī, with flowers, incense, and ointments, / or having bathed in the waters of the Gaṅgā, a person is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣatnaiḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ snāyādapyakṣatairnaraḥ /
saktūnsaṃbhojayedviprānsvayamabhyavaharecca tān //
meaning:
अक्षत्नैः पूजयेद्विष्णुं स्नायादप्यक्षतैर्नरः /
सक्तून्संभोजयेद्विप्रान्स्वयमभ्यवहरेच्च तान् //
text_mt: A man should worship Viṣṇu with unbroken grains of rice and bathe with unbroken grains of rice; / he should feed the vipras with roasted barley flour and consume it himself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavidhirvipra naro viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ /
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतविधिर्विप्र नरो विष्णुपरायणः /
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः //
text_mt: The man who has thus performed the ritual, O vipra, devoted to Viṣṇu, / goes to the world of Viṣṇu, bowed to by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
atha jyeṣṭhatṛtīyā tu śuklā raṃbheti nāmataḥ /
tasyāṃ sabhāryaṃ vidhivatpūjayedvāhmaṇottamam //
meaning:
अथ ज्येष्ठतृतीया तु शुक्ला रंभेति नामतः /
तस्यां सभार्यं विधिवत्पूजयेद्वाह्मणोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Now, the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha is named Rambhā; / on it, one should worship an excellent brāhmaṇa along with his wife according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpāṃśukādyaistu nārī saubhāgyakāmyayā /
raṃbhāvratamidaṃ vipra vidhivatsamupāśritam //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पांशुकाद्यैस्तु नारी सौभाग्यकाम्यया /
रंभाव्रतमिदं विप्र विधिवत्समुपाश्रितम् //
text_mt: with perfumes, flowers, cloths, and the like, a woman desiring marital felicity; / this Rambhā vow, O vipra, when observed according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti vittaṃ putrāṃśca matiṃ dharme śubhāvahām /
athāṣāḍhatṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śuklavāsasā //
meaning:
ददाति वित्तं पुत्रांश्च मतिं धर्मे शुभावहाम् /
अथाषाढतृतीयायां शुक्लायां शुक्लवाससा //
text_mt: bestows wealth, sons, and an auspicious disposition towards righteousness. / Then, on the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, [dressed] in white garments,

sanskrit_iast:
keśavaṃ tu salakṣmīkaṃ sastrīke tu dvijer'cayet /
bhojanaiḥ surabhīdānairvastraiścāpi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
केशवं तु सलक्ष्मीकं सस्त्रीके तु द्विजेर्ऽचयेत् /
भोजनैः सुरभीदानैर्वस्त्रैश्चापि विभूषणैः //
text_mt: she should worship Keśava along with Lakṣmī, and a brāhmaṇa couple, / with meals, gifts of cows, garments, and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
priyervākyairbhṛśaṃ prītā nārī saubhāgyavāñchayā /
samupāsya vrataṃ caitaddhanadhānyasamanvitā //
meaning:
प्रियेर्वाक्यैर्भृशं प्रीता नारी सौभाग्यवाञ्छया /
समुपास्य व्रतं चैतद्धनधान्यसमन्विता //
text_mt: greatly pleased, with affectionate words. A woman desiring marital felicity, / having observed this vow, endowed with wealth and grain,

sanskrit_iast:
devadevaprasādena viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt /
nabhaḥ śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ svarṇagaurīvrataṃ caret //
meaning:
देवदेवप्रसादेन विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् /
नभः शुक्लतृतीयायां स्वर्णगौरीव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt: by the grace of the God of gods, will reach the world of Viṣṇu. / On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa), she should observe the Svarṇagaurī vow.

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhavānīmabhipūjayet /
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi suvrate //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिर्भवानीमभिपूजयेत् /
पुत्रान्देहि धनं देहि सौभाग्यं देहि सुव्रते //
text_mt: She should worship Bhavānī with sixteen articles of worship: / 'Grant me sons, grant me wealth, grant me marital felicity, O observant goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṃśca sarvakāmānme dehi dehi namo 'stu te /
evaṃ saṃprārthya deveśīṃ bhavānīṃ bhavasaṃyutām //
meaning:
अन्यांश्च सर्वकामान्मे देहि देहि नमो ऽस्तु ते /
एवं संप्रार्थ्य देवेशीं भवानीं भवसंयुताम् //
text_mt: And grant me all my other desires, grant them! Salutations to you!' / Having thus prayed to the ruler of the gods, Bhavānī, who is united with Bhava,

sanskrit_iast:
vratasaṃpūrtikāmā tu vāyanaṃ dāpayettathā /
evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi kṛtvā nārī vrataṃ śubham //
meaning:
व्रतसंपूर्तिकामा तु वायनं दापयेत्तथा /
एवं षोडशवर्षाणि कृत्वा नारी व्रतं शुभम् //
text_mt: and desiring the completion of the vow, she should offer the sacred gift (vāyana). / Having thus performed this auspicious vow for sixteen years, a woman,

sanskrit_iast:
udyāpanaṃ caredbhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitā /
maṇḍape maṇḍale śuddhe gaṇeśādisurārcanam //
meaning:
उद्यापनं चरेद्भक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जिता /
मण्डपे मण्डले शुद्धे गणेशादिसुरार्चनम् //
text_mt: free from deceit regarding wealth, should perform the concluding rite with devotion. / Having worshipped Gaṇeśa and the other deities in an altar-pavilion upon a purified diagram,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tāmramayaṃ pātraṃ kalaśoparivinyaset /
sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ tatra bhavānyāḥ pratipūjayet //
meaning:
कृत्वा ताम्रमयं पात्रं कलशोपरिविन्यसेत् /
सौवर्णीं प्रतिमां तत्र भवान्याः प्रतिपूजयेत् //
text_mt: she should place a copper vessel upon a sacred water-pot; / there she should worship a golden image of Bhavānī,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyak tato homaṃ samācaret /
veṇupātraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pakvānnaparipūritaiḥ //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः सम्यक् ततो होमं समाचरेत् /
वेणुपात्रैः षोडशभिः पक्वान्नपरिपूरितैः //
text_mt: duly with perfumes, flowers, and other [offerings], and then perform the fire oblation. / With sixteen bamboo baskets filled with cooked food,

sanskrit_iast:
samarpya devyai naivedyaṃ dvijeṣvetannivedayet /
vāyanaṃ ca tataḥ paścāddadyātsaṃbandhibandhuṣu //
meaning:
समर्प्य देव्यै नैवेद्यं द्विजेष्वेतन्निवेदयेत् /
वायनं च ततः पश्चाद्दद्यात्संबन्धिबन्धुषु //
text_mt: having offered them as food offering to the Goddess, she should present them to the twice-born; / and then afterwards she should give the sacred gift to relatives and kin.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāṃ gurave dattvā dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā /
pūrṇaṃ labhetphalaṃ nārī vratācaraṇatatparā //
meaning:
प्रतिमां गुरवे दत्त्वा द्विजेभ्यो दक्षिणां तथा /
पूर्णं लभेत्फलं नारी व्रताचरणतत्परा //
text_mt: Having given the image to her guru and likewise priestly fees to the twice-born, / the woman devoted to the observance of the vow attains the full fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ vai hāritālakam /
kuryādbhaktyā vidhānena pādyārdhyārcana pūrvakam //
meaning:
भाद्रशुक्लतृतीयायां व्रतं वै हारितालकम् /
कुर्याद्भक्त्या विधानेन पाद्यार्ध्यार्चन पूर्वकम् //
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra, she should perform the vow of Hāritālikā / with devotion according to the prescribed rule, beginning with the worship of water for the feet and guest-water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu kāñcane pātre rājate cāpi tāmrake /
vaiṇave mṛnmaye vāpi vinyasyānnaṃ sadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
ततस्तु काञ्चने पात्रे राजते चापि ताम्रके /
वैणवे मृन्मये वापि विन्यस्यान्नं सदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Then, having placed food along with a priestly gift in a golden, / silver, copper, bamboo, or earthen vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
saphalaṃ ca savastraṃ ca dvijāya pratipādayet /
tadante pāraṇaṃ kuryādiṣṭabandhujanaiḥ saha //
meaning:
सफलं च सवस्त्रं च द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् /
तदन्ते पारणं कुर्यादिष्टबन्धुजनैः सह //
text_mt: together with fruit and together with cloth, she should offer it to a twice-born one; / at the end of it, she should break her fast together with her cherished relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavratā nārī bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān /
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa gaurīsahacarībhavet //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रता नारी भुक्त्वा भोगान्मनोरमान् /
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण गौरीसहचरीभवेत् //
text_mt: A woman who has observed this vow, having enjoyed delightful pleasures, / becomes a companion of Gaurī by the power of this vow.

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyadravyavastrāṇi vaṃśapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa /
dātavyāni prayatnena brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi //
meaning:
सौभाग्यद्रव्यवस्त्राणि वंशपात्राणि षोडश /
दातव्यानि प्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथाविधि //
text_mt: Articles of marital felicity, garments, and sixteen bamboo vessels / should be diligently given to brāhmaṇas according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
anyebhyo vipravaryebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca prayatnataḥ /
bhūyasīṃ ca tato dadyādviprebhyo devituṣṭaye //
meaning:
अन्येभ्यो विप्रवर्येभ्यो दक्षिणां च प्रयत्नतः /
भूयसीं च ततो दद्याद्विप्रेभ्यो देवितुष्टये //
text_mt: And then, for the satisfaction of the Goddess, she should diligently give a generous priestly fee / to the other eminent vipras.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yā kurute nārī vrataṃ saubhāgyavarddhanam /
sā tu devīprasādena saubhāgyaṃ labhate dhruvam //
meaning:
एवं या कुरुते नारी व्रतं सौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् /
सा तु देवीप्रसादेन सौभाग्यं लभते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: A woman who thus performs the vow that increases marital felicity, / surely attains marital felicity by the grace of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tṛtīyā bhādre tu hastarkṣasahitā bhavet /
hastagaurīvrataṃ nāma taduddiṣṭaṃ hi śauriṇā //
meaning:
यदा तृतीया भाद्रे तु हस्तर्क्षसहिता भवेत् /
हस्तगौरीव्रतं नाम तदुद्दिष्टं हि शौरिणा //
text_mt: When the third lunar day in the month of Bhādra is joined with the asterism Hasta, / that vow, named Hastagaurī, has indeed been taught by Śauri.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā koṭīśvarī nāma vrataṃ proktaṃ pinākinā /
lakṣeśvarī caiva tathā tadvidhānamudīryate //
meaning:
तथा कोटीश्वरी नाम व्रतं प्रोक्तं पिनाकिना /
लक्षेश्वरी चैव तथा तद्विधानमुदीर्यते //
text_mt: Likewise, the vow named Koṭīśvarī was declared by the wielder of Pināka (Śiva), / as well as Lakṣeśvarī; its ritual procedure is now proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ vrataṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ yāvadvarṣacatuṣṭayam /
upavāsena kartavyaṃ varṣe varṣe tu nārada //
meaning:
अस्यां व्रतं तु संग्राह्यं यावद्वर्षचतुष्टयम् /
उपवासेन कर्तव्यं वर्षे वर्षे तु नारद //
text_mt: This vow should be undertaken for a period of four years; / it must be observed by fasting year after year, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
akhaṇḍānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ tilānāṃ vā munīsvara /
lakṣamekaṃ viśodhyātha kṣipetpayasi saṃsṛte //
meaning:
अखण्डानां तण्डुलानां तिलानां वा मुनीस्वर /
लक्षमेकं विशोध्याथ क्षिपेत्पयसि संसृते //
text_mt: Having purified one hundred thousand unbroken grains of rice, or sesame seeds, O lord of sages, / one should drop them into poured milk.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpakkena tu nirmāya devyā mūrtiṃ suśomanām /
prakare gandhapuṣpāṇāṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitām //
meaning:
तत्पक्केन तु निर्माय देव्या मूर्तिं सुशोमनाम् /
प्रकरे गन्धपुष्पाणां पुष्पमालाविभूषिताम् //
text_mt: Fashioning a very beautiful image of the Goddess from that cooked [substance], / decorated with garlands of flowers upon an expanse of perfumes and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya pārvatīṃ tatra pūjayedbhaktibhāvitaḥ /
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairnaivedyavistaraiḥ //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य पार्वतीं तत्र पूजयेद्भक्तिभावितः /
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपैर्नैवेद्यविस्तरैः //
text_mt: and having installed Pārvatī there, filled with devotion, one should worship her / with perfumes, flowers, and incense, with lamps and abundant food offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
vividhaiśca phalairvipra namaskṛtya kṣamāpayet /
tato visarjayaddevīṃ jalamadhye 'tha dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
विविधैश्च फलैर्विप्र नमस्कृत्य क्षमापयेत् /
ततो विसर्जयद्देवीं जलमध्ये ऽथ दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: and with various fruits, O vipra; having bowed, one should ask for forgiveness. / Then one should discharge the Goddess into the middle of the water; then,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā vidhijñaviprebhyo bhuñjīyācca pare dine /
iti te kathitaṃ vipra koṭilakṣeśvarīvratam //
meaning:
दत्त्वा विधिज्ञविप्रेभ्यो भुञ्जीयाच्च परे दिने /
इति ते कथितं विप्र कोटिलक्षेश्वरीव्रतम् //
text_mt: having given priestly fees to vipras knowledgeable in the rules, one should eat on the next day. / Thus has been declared to you, O vipra, the Koṭilakṣeśvarī vow.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīlokaṃ prayātyante vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ /
iṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ bṛbadgaurīvrataṃ caret //
meaning:
गौरीलोकं प्रयात्यन्ते व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावतः /
इषशुक्लतृतीयायां बृबद्गौरीव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt: At the end, by the power of this vow, he goes to the world of Gaurī. / On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, one should perform the Bṛhadgaurīvrata.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavarṣaṃ vidhānena pūrvoktenaiva nārada /
ācāryaṃ pūjayedante viprānanyāndhanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चवर्षं विधानेन पूर्वोक्तेनैव नारद /
आचार्यं पूजयेदन्ते विप्रानन्यान्धनादिभिः //
text_mt: For five years, O Nārada, according to the procedure stated before, / he should worship the preceptor at the end, and the other twice-born with wealth and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinīḥ pañca pūjyā vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ /
kañcukaiścaiva tāṭaṅkaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtrairharipriyāḥ //
meaning:
सुवासिनीः पञ्च पूज्या वस्त्रालङ्कारचन्दनैः /
कञ्चुकैश्चैव ताटङ्कैः कण्ठसूत्रैर्हरिप्रियाः //
text_mt: Five married women, beloved of Hari, are to be worshipped with garments, ornaments, and sandalwood paste, / with bodices, ear-rings, and necklaces.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśapātrāṇi pañcaiva sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭitāni ca /
siṃdūraṃ jīrakaṃ caiva saubhāgyadravyasaṃyutam //
meaning:
वंशपात्राणि पञ्चैव सूत्रैः संवेष्टितानि च /
सिंदूरं जीरकं चैव सौभाग्यद्रव्यसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Five bamboo vessels wound round with threads, / vermilion, cumin seeds, along with the articles of marital auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
godhīmapiṣṭajātaṃ ca navāpūpaṃ phalā dikam /
vāyanāni ca pañcaiva tābhyo dadyācca bhojayet //
meaning:
गोधीमपिष्टजातं च नवापूपं फला दिकम् /
वायनानि च पञ्चैव ताभ्यो दद्याच्च भोजयेत् //
text_mt: fresh cakes made of wheat flour, fruits, and the rest; / and he should present five ritual presents to them and feed them.

sanskrit_iast:
arghaṃ dattvā vāyanāni paścādbhuñjīta vāgyatā /
tatphalaṃ dhārayetkaṇṭhe sarvakāmasamṛddhaye //
meaning:
अर्घं दत्त्वा वायनानि पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत वाग्यता /
तत्फलं धारयेत्कण्ठे सर्वकामसमृद्धये //
text_mt: Having offered arghya and given the ritual presents, she should afterwards eat, keeping silent. / She should wear that fruit upon her neck for the prosperity of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya sālaṅkārā sakhījanaiḥ /
gītavādyayutā nadyāṃ gaurīṃ tāṃ tu visarjayet //
meaning:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय सालङ्कारा सखीजनैः /
गीतवाद्ययुता नद्यां गौरीं तां तु विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Then, rising in the morning, adorned, accompanied by her female companions / and accompanied by singing and instrumental music, she should dismiss that Gaurī in a river:

sanskrit_iast:
āhūtāsi mayābhadre pūjitā ca yathā vidhi /
mama saubhāgyadānāya yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tvayā //
meaning:
आहूतासि मयाभद्रे पूजिता च यथा विधि /
मम सौभाग्यदानाय यथेष्टं गम्यतां त्वया //
text_mt: “You were invoked by me, O auspicious one, and worshipped according to rule; / to grant me marital auspiciousness, go as you please!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhaktyā dvija devīprasādataḥ /
bhuktvā bhogāṃstu dehānte gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं भक्त्या द्विज देवीप्रसादतः /
भुक्त्वा भोगांस्तु देहान्ते गौरीलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having performed the vow thus with devotion, O twice-born, by the grace of the Goddess, / having enjoyed pleasures, he attains the world of Gaurī at the end of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ viṣṇugaurīvrataṃ caret /
pūjayitvā jagadvandyāmupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्जशुक्लतृतीयायां विष्णुगौरीव्रतं चरेत् /
पूजयित्वा जगद्वन्द्यामुपचारैः पृथग्विधैः //
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, one should observe the Viṣṇugaurīvrata. / Having worshipped her who is adored by the universe with various kinds of offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinīṃ bhojayitvā maṅgaladravyapūjitām /
visarjayetpraṇamyaināṃ viṣṇugaurīpratuṣṭaye //
meaning:
सुवासिनीं भोजयित्वा मङ्गलद्रव्यपूजिताम् /
विसर्जयेत्प्रणम्यैनां विष्णुगौरीप्रतुष्टये //
text_mt: and having fed a married woman honoured with auspicious items, / one should bow to her and dismiss her for the complete satisfaction of Viṣṇugaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ haragaurīvrataṃ śubham /
kṛtvā pūrvavidhānena pūjayejjagadaṃbikām //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्लतृतीयायां हरगौरीव्रतं शुभम् /
कृत्वा पूर्वविधानेन पूजयेज्जगदंबिकाम् //
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, having performed the auspicious Haragaurīvrata / according to the previous procedure, one should worship the mother of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvrataprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān /
devīlokaṃ samāsādya modate ca tayā saha //
meaning:
एतद्व्रतप्रभावेण भुक्त्वा भोगान्मनोरमान् /
देवीलोकं समासाद्य मोदते च तया सह //
text_mt: By the power of this vow, having enjoyed delightful pleasures / and reached the world of the Goddess, he rejoices together with her.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ brahmagaurīvrataṃ caret /
pūrvoktena vidhānena pūjitāpi dvijottama //
meaning:
पौषशुक्लतृतीयायां ब्रह्मगौरीव्रतं चरेत् /
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन पूजितापि द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa, one should perform the Brahmagaurīvrata. / Worshipped according to the procedure stated earlier, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmagaurīprasādena modate tatra saṃgatā /
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ pūjyā saubhāgyasuṃdarī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मगौरीप्रसादेन मोदते तत्र संगता /
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां पूज्या सौभाग्यसुंदरी //
text_mt: by the grace of Brahmagaurī, one rejoices united with her there. / On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, Saubhāgyasundarī is to be worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktena vidhānena nālikerārghyadānataḥ /
prasannā diśati svīyaṃ lokaṃ tu vratatoṣitā //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन नालिकेरार्घ्यदानतः /
प्रसन्ना दिशति स्वीयं लोकं तु व्रततोषिता //
text_mt: According to the procedure stated earlier, through the offering of an arghya of coconut, / she, pleased and gratified by the vow, bestows her own world.

sanskrit_iast:
phaālgunasya site pakṣe tṛtīyā kulasaukhyadā /
pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ sarvamaṅgaladā bhavet //
meaning:
फआल्गुनस्य सिते पक्षे तृतीया कुलसौख्यदा /
पूजिता गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः सर्वमङ्गलदा भवेत् //
text_mt: The third lunar day in the bright fortnight of Phālguna bestows happiness to the family; / worshipped with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and other offerings, she becomes the giver of all blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsu ca tṛtīyāsu vidhiḥ sādhāraṇo mune /
devīpūjā viprapūjā dānaṃ homo visarjanam //
meaning:
सर्वासु च तृतीयासु विधिः साधारणो मुने /
देवीपूजा विप्रपूजा दानं होमो विसर्जनम् //
text_mt: On all the third lunar days, O sage, the procedure is common: / worship of the Goddess, worship of the twice-born, gifts, fire oblations, and ritual dismissal.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kathitānīha tṛtīyāyā vratāni te /
bhaktyā kṛtāni ceṣṭāṃstu kāmāndardyumanogatān //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsatṛtīyāvratakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येवं कथितानीह तृतीयाया व्रतानि ते /
भक्त्या कृतानि चेष्टांस्तु कामान्दर्द्युमनोगतान् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासतृतीयाव्रतकथनं नाम द्वादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus the vows of the third lunar day have been declared to you here; / performed with devotion, they grant the desired objects in the mind.

Thus ends the one hundred and twelfth chapter in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa, entitled 'Account of the Vows of the Third Lunar Day in the Twelve Months'.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu vipraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturthyāste vratānyaham /
yāni kṛtvā narā nāryo 'bhīṣṭānkāmānavāpnuyuḥ //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु विप्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्थ्यास्ते व्रतान्यहम् /
यानि कृत्वा नरा नार्यो ऽभीष्टान्कामानवाप्नुयुः //
text_mt:
Sanātana said:
Listen, O brāhmaṇa, I shall declare to you the observances of the fourth [tithi],
by performing which men and women attain their cherished desires.

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāsacaturthyāṃ tu vāsudevasvarūpiṇam /
gaṇapaṃ samyagabhyarcya dattvā kāñcanadakṣiṇām //
meaning:
चैत्रमासचतुर्थ्यां तु वासुदेवस्वरूपिणम् /
गणपं सम्यगभ्यर्च्य दत्त्वा काञ्चनदक्षिणाम् //
text_mt:
On the fourth tithi of the month of Caitra, having duly worshipped Gaṇapa,
who has the form of Vāsudeva, and having given a gift of gold

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya viṣṇulokaṃ tu gaccheddevanamaskṛtaḥ /
vaiśākhasya caturthyāṃ tu prārthyaṃ saṃkarṣaṇāhvayam //
meaning:
विप्राय विष्णुलोकं तु गच्छेद्देवनमस्कृतः /
वैशाखस्य चतुर्थ्यां तु प्रार्थ्यं संकर्षणाह्वयम् //
text_mt:
to a brāhmaṇa, one goes, revered by the gods, to the world of Viṣṇu.
On the fourth tithi of Vaiśākha, the one called Saṃkarṣaṇa should be prayed to;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthadvijamukhyebhyaḥ śaṅkhaṃ dattvā vidhānavit /
prāpya saṃkarṣaṇaṃ lokaṃ modate bahukalpakam //
meaning:
गृहस्थद्विजमुख्येभ्यः शङ्खं दत्त्वा विधानवित् /
प्राप्य संकर्षणं लोकं मोदते बहुकल्पकम् //
text_mt:
having given a conch shell to foremost householder twice-borns, one knowing the rite,
attaining the world of Saṃkarṣaṇa, rejoices for many kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhamāsacaturthyāṃ tu prārcya pradyumnarūpiṇam /
phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yuthebhyo dattvā svargaṃ labhennaraḥ //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठमासचतुर्थ्यां तु प्रार्च्य प्रद्युम्नरूपिणम् /
फलं मूलं च युथेभ्यो दत्त्वा स्वर्गं लभेन्नरः //
text_mt:
On the fourth tithi of the month of Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped [him] in the form of Pradyumna,
and having given fruits and roots to mendicant groups, a person attains heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhasya caturthyāṃ tu saṃprapūjyāniruddhakam /
yatibhyo 'lābupātrāṇi dattvābhīṣṭaṃ labhennaraḥ //
meaning:
आषाढस्य चतुर्थ्यां तु संप्रपूज्यानिरुद्धकम् /
यतिभ्यो ऽलाबुपात्राणि दत्त्वाभीष्टं लभेन्नरः //
text_mt:
On the fourth tithi of Āṣāḍha, having fully worshipped Aniruddha,
and having given gourd-vessels to ascetics, a person attains their desire.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmūrtivratānyevaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśavatsaram /
udyāpanaṃ vidhānena kartavyaṃ phalamicchatā //
meaning:
चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतान्येवं कृत्वा द्वादशवत्सरम् /
उद्यापनं विधानेन कर्तव्यं फलमिच्छता //
text_mt:
Having thus performed the observances of the four forms for twelve years,
the concluding rite should be performed according to the rules by one desiring the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
anyajjyeṣṭhacaturthyāṃ tu satīvratamanuttamam /
kṛtvā gaṇapatermāturloke modeta tatsamam //
meaning:
अन्यज्ज्येष्ठचतुर्थ्यां तु सतीव्रतमनुत्तमम् /
कृत्वा गणपतेर्मातुर्लोके मोदेत तत्समम् //
text_mt:
On another fourth tithi in Jyeṣṭha is the unsurpassed Satīvrata;
having performed it, one rejoices equally in the world of the mother of Gaṇapati.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā'ṣāḍhacaturthyāṃ tu vratamanyacchubhāvaham /
rathantarāhvakalpasya hyādibhūtaṃ dinaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
तथाऽषाढचतुर्थ्यां तु व्रतमन्यच्छुभावहम् /
रथन्तराह्वकल्पस्य ह्यादिभूतं दिनं यतः //
text_mt:
Likewise, on the fourth tithi of Āṣāḍha there is another auspicious observance,
since it is the very first day of the kalpa named Rathantara.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāpūtena manasā gaṇeśaṃ vidhinā naraḥ /
pūjayitvā labheccāpi phalaṃ devādidurgamam //
meaning:
श्रद्धापूतेन मनसा गणेशं विधिना नरः /
पूजयित्वा लभेच्चापि फलं देवादिदुर्गमम् //
text_mt:
With a mind purified by faith, a person, having worshipped Gaṇeśa
according to the rules, attains even a fruit difficult to obtain for the gods and others.

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇasya caturthyāṃ tu jāti candrodaye mune //
meaning: श्रावणस्य चतुर्थ्यां तु जाति चन्द्रोदये मुने //
text_mt: On the fourth tithi of Śrāvaṇa, O sage, upon moonrise,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśāya pradadyācca hyarghyaṃ vidhividāṃvaraḥ /
lambodaraṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ raktavarṇakam //
meaning:
गणेशाय प्रदद्याच्च ह्यर्घ्यं विधिविदांवरः /
लम्बोदरं चतुर्बाहुं त्रिनेत्रं रक्तवर्णकम् //
text_mt:
the best of those knowing the rites should offer water-offering to Gaṇeśa:
one should meditate on him as pot-bellied, four-armed, three-eyed, red-hued,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnavibhūṣāḍhyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ vicintayet /
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiḥ samarcayet //
meaning:
नानारत्नविभूषाढ्यं प्रसन्नास्यं विचिन्तयेत् /
आवाहनादिभिः सर्वैरुपचारैः समर्चयेत् //
text_mt:
richly adorned with various jewels, with a gracious face;
one should worship him with all the offerings, beginning with invocation.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ modakaṃ dadyādgaṇeśaprītidāyakam /
evaṃ vrataṃ vidhāyātha bhuktvā modakameva ca //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं मोदकं दद्याद्गणेशप्रीतिदायकम् /
एवं व्रतं विधायाथ भुक्त्वा मोदकमेव च //
text_mt:
One should offer sweet dumplings as food-offering, giving pleasure to Gaṇeśa.
Thus having performed the observance and then eaten sweet dumplings alone,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaṃ svapyānniśāyāṃ tu bhūmāveva kṛtārcanaḥ /
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa kāmānmanasi cintitān //
meaning:
सुखं स्वप्यान्निशायां तु भूमावेव कृतार्चनः /
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण कामान्मनसि चिन्तितान् //
text_mt:
one who has performed the worship should sleep comfortably at night upon the ground alone.
By the power of this observance, having obtained the desires thought of in one's mind,

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā leke paraṃ cāpi gaṇeśapadamāpnuyāt /
nānena sadṛśaṃ cānyadvratamasti jagattraye //
meaning:
लब्ध्वा लेके परं चापि गणेशपदमाप्नुयात् /
नानेन सदृशं चान्यद्व्रतमस्ति जगत्त्रये //
text_mt:
one also attains the supreme world, the abode of Gaṇeśa.
There is no other observance equal to this in the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkāryaṃ prayatnena sarvānkāmānabhīpsatā /
athāsminneva divase dūrvāgaṇapati vratam //
meaning:
तस्मात्कार्यं प्रयत्नेन सर्वान्कामानभीप्सता /
अथास्मिन्नेव दिवसे दूर्वागणपति व्रतम् //
text_mt:
therefore, it must be performed with effort by one desiring all wishes.
Now, on this very day, the Dūrvāgaṇapati observance

sanskrit_iast:
kecidicchanti devarṣe tadvidhānaṃ vadāmi te /
haimaṃ nirmāya gaṇapaṃ tāmrapātropari sthitam //
meaning:
केचिदिच्छन्ति देवर्षे तद्विधानं वदामि ते /
हैमं निर्माय गणपं ताम्रपात्रोपरि स्थितम् //
text_mt:
is desired by some, O divine sage; I shall tell you its procedure:
having made a golden Gaṇapa placed upon a copper vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭitaṃ raktavastreṇa sarvatobhadramaṇḍale /
pūjayedraktakusumaiḥ patrikābhiśca pañcabhiḥ //
meaning:
वेष्टितं रक्तवस्त्रेण सर्वतोभद्रमण्डले /
पूजयेद्रक्तकुसुमैः पत्रिकाभिश्च पञ्चभिः //
text_mt:
wrapped in red cloth, upon a sarvatobhadra diagram,
one should worship him with red flowers and five leaves:

sanskrit_iast:
bilvapatramapāmārgaṃ śamī dūrvā haripriyā /
ābhiranyaśca kusumairabhyarcya phalamodakaiḥ //
meaning:
बिल्वपत्रमपामार्गं शमी दूर्वा हरिप्रिया /
आभिरन्यश्च कुसुमैरभ्यर्च्य फलमोदकैः //
text_mt:
bilva leaf, apāmārga, śamī, dūrvā, [and] Tulasī.
Having worshipped with these and other flowers, fruits, and sweet dumplings,

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryāya vidhijñāya satkṛtya vinivedayet /
upahāraṃ prakalpyātha dadyādarghaṃ samudyate /
tataḥ saṃprārathya vighneśamūrtiṃ sopaskarāṃ mune //
meaning:
आचार्याय विधिज्ञाय सत्कृत्य विनिवेदयेत् /
उपहारं प्रकल्प्याथ दद्यादर्घं समुद्यते /
ततः संप्रारथ्य विघ्नेशमूर्तिं सोपस्करां मुने //
text_mt:
having arranged the offerings, one should present the water-offering when [the moon] has risen.
Then, having prayed to the image of the Lord of Obstacles along with its paraphernalia, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryāya vidhijñāya satkṛtya vinivedayet /
kṛtvaivaṃ pañca varṣāṇi samupāsya yathāvidhi //
meaning:
आचार्याय विधिज्ञाय सत्कृत्य विनिवेदयेत् /
कृत्वैवं पञ्च वर्षाणि समुपास्य यथाविधि //
text_mt:
one should respectfully dedicate it to a preceptor who knows the rites.
Having thus worshipped according to the rules for five years,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktveha bhogānakhilān lokaṃ gaṇapatervrajet /
atha bhādracaturthyāṃ tu bahulādhenusaṃjñakam //
meaning:
भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलान् लोकं गणपतेर्व्रजेत् /
अथ भाद्रचतुर्थ्यां तु बहुलाधेनुसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt:
after enjoying all worldly pleasures here, one goes to the world of Gaṇapati.
Now, on the fourth tithi of Bhādra, [the cow] named the Bahulā cow

sanskrit_iast:
pūjanī yo 'tra yatnena sraggandhayavasādibhiḥ /
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śaktaśceddānamācaret //
meaning:
पूजनी यो ऽत्र यत्नेन स्रग्गन्धयवसादिभिः /
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शक्तश्चेद्दानमाचरेत् //
text_mt:
should be worshipped here with effort, with garlands, perfumes, barley, and the like.
Then, having circumambulated it, one should make a gift if capable.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktaḥ puretāṃ tu namaskṛtya visarjayet /
pañcābdaṃ vādaśābdaṃ vā ṣoḍaśābdamathāpi vā //
meaning:
अशक्तः पुरेतां तु नमस्कृत्य विसर्जयेत् /
पञ्चाब्दं वादशाब्दं वा षोडशाब्दमथापि वा //
text_mt:
If incapable, having bowed to her, one should dismiss her.
Having performed the observance for five years, or twelve years, or even sixteen years,

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ kṛtvā samudyāpya dhenuṃ dadyātpayasvinīm /
prabhāveṇa vratasyāsya bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān //
meaning:
व्रतं कृत्वा समुद्याप्य धेनुं दद्यात्पयस्विनीम् /
प्रभावेण व्रतस्यास्य भुक्त्वा भोगान्मनोरमान् //
text_mt:
and having concluded it properly, one should donate a milch cow.
By the power of this observance, having enjoyed delightful pleasures,

sanskrit_iast:
satkṛto devatāvṛndairgolokaṃ samavāpnuyāt /
atha śukla caturthyāṃ tu siddhavaināyakavratam //
meaning:
सत्कृतो देवतावृन्दैर्गोलोकं समवाप्नुयात् /
अथ शुक्ल चतुर्थ्यां तु सिद्धवैनायकव्रतम् //
text_mt:
honoured by the hosts of gods, one attains Goloka.
Now, on the bright fourth tithi is the Siddhavināyaka observance.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiḥ samarcanam /
ekāgramānaso bhūtvā dhyāyetsiddhivināyakam //
meaning:
आवाहनादिभिः सर्वैरुपचारैः समर्चनम् /
एकाग्रमानसो भूत्वा ध्यायेत्सिद्धिविनायकम् //
text_mt: With one-pointed mind, having performed worship through all services beginning with invocation, / one should meditate on Siddhivināyaka:

sanskrit_iast:
ekadantaṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturbhujam /
pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ taptakāñcanasannibham //
meaning:
एकदन्तं शूर्पकर्णं गजवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् /
पाशाङ्कुशधरं देवं तप्तकाञ्चनसन्निभम् //
text_mt: single-tusked, winnowing-basket-eared, elephant-faced, four-armed, / holding a noose and a goad, divine, resembling molten gold.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśati patrāṇi caikaviṃśatināmabhiḥ /
samarpayedbhaktiyuktastāni nāmāni vai śṛṇu //
meaning:
एकविंशति पत्राणि चैकविंशतिनामभिः /
समर्पयेद्भक्तियुक्तस्तानि नामानि वै शृणु //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion, one should offer twenty-one leaves / with twenty-one names; hear indeed those names:

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhāya śamīpatraṃ gaṇādhīśāya bhṛṅgajam /
umāputrāya bailvaṃ tu dūrvāṃ gajamukhāya ca //
meaning:
सुमुखाय शमीपत्रं गणाधीशाय भृङ्गजम् /
उमापुत्राय बैल्वं तु दूर्वां गजमुखाय च //
text_mt: a śamī-leaf to Sumukha; one born of bhṛṅga to Gaṇādhīśa; / a bilva-leaf to the son of Umā; and dūrvā-grass to Gajamukha;

sanskrit_iast:
laṃbodarāya badarīṃ dhattūraṃ harasūnave /
śūrpakarṇāya tulasīṃ vakratuṇḍāya śiṃbijam //
meaning:
लंबोदराय बदरीं धत्तूरं हरसूनवे /
शूर्पकर्णाय तुलसीं वक्रतुण्डाय शिंबिजम् //
text_mt: a jujube-leaf to Lambodara; dhattūra to the son of Hara; / tulasī to Śūrpakarṇa; pod-born [leaf] to Vakratuṇḍa;

sanskrit_iast:
guhāgrajāyāpāmārgamekadantāya bārhatam /
herambāya tu siṃdūraṃ catirhetre ca patrajam //
meaning:
गुहाग्रजायापामार्गमेकदन्ताय बार्हतम् /
हेरम्बाय तु सिंदूरं चतिर्हेत्रे च पत्रजम् //
text_mt: apāmārga to Guha's elder brother; bṛhatī to Ekadanta; / red lead to Heramba, and a tree-leaf to Caturnetra;

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvarāyāgastyasya patraṃ prītivivarddhanam /
dūrvāyugmaṃ tato gṛhya gandhapuṣpākṣatairyutam //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरायागस्त्यस्य पत्रं प्रीतिविवर्द्धनम् /
दूर्वायुग्मं ततो गृह्य गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैर्युतम् //
text_mt: the leaf of agastya, which increases love, to Sarveśvara. / Then, taking a pair of dūrvā-grass blades accompanied by perfume, flowers, and unbroken rice,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ nivedayedbhaktiyukto modakapañcakam /
ācamayya namaskṛtya saṃprārthya ca visarjjayet //
meaning:
पूजां निवेदयेद्भक्तियुक्तो मोदकपञ्चकम् /
आचमय्य नमस्कृत्य संप्रार्थ्य च विसर्ज्जयेत् //
text_mt: endowed with devotion, one should offer worship, [offering] five sweetmeats. / Having sipped water, bowed down, and prayed, one should dismiss [him].

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya pratimāṃ haimīṃ sopaskarāṃ mune /
nivedayecca gurave dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
meaning:
विनायकस्य प्रतिमां हैमीं सोपस्करां मुने /
निवेदयेच्च गुरवे द्विजेभ्यो दक्षिणां ददेत् //
text_mt: O sage, one should offer a golden image of Vināyaka, / equipped with all accessories, to the guru, and give a priestly fee to the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtārcano bhaktyā pañca varṣāṇi nārada /
upāsya labhate kāmānaihikāmuṣmikān śubhān //
meaning:
एवं कृतार्चनो भक्त्या पञ्च वर्षाणि नारद /
उपास्य लभते कामानैहिकामुष्मिकान् शुभान् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the worship with devotion for five years, O Nārada, / by worshipping he attains auspicious desires pertaining to this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ caturthyāṃ śaśinaṃ na paśyecca kadācana /
paśyan mithyābhiśāpa tu labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
atha taddoṣanāśāya mantraṃ paurāṇikaṃ paṭhet //
meaning:
अस्यां चतुर्थ्यां शशिनं न पश्येच्च कदाचन /
पश्यन् मिथ्याभिशाप तु लभते नात्र संशयः /
अथ तद्दोषनाशाय मन्त्रं पौराणिकं पठेत् //
text_mt: On this fourth [tithi], one should never look at the moon; / looking at it, one incurs false accusations, there is no doubt here. / Now, for the destruction of that fault, one should recite the Purāṇic mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhaḥ prasenamamadhītsiṃho jāṃbavatā hataḥ /
sakumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ //
meaning:
सिंहः प्रसेनममधीत्सिंहो जांबवता हतः /
सकुमारक मा रोदीस्तव ह्येष स्यमन्तकः //
text_mt: 'The lion killed Prasena; the lion was slain by Jāmbavat. / Do not weep, O sweet child! For this Syamantaka jewel is yours.'

sanskrit_iast: iṣaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu kaparddīśaṃ vināyakam //
meaning: इषशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु कपर्द्दीशं विनायकम् //
text_mt: On the fourth [tithi] of the bright [fortnight] of Iṣa, however, [one should worship] Vināyaka, the lord of cowries:

sanskrit_iast:
pauruṣiṇa tu sūktena pūjayedupacārakaiḥ /
akāraṇānmuṣṭigatāṃstaṇḍulānsakaparddikān //
meaning:
पौरुषिण तु सूक्तेन पूजयेदुपचारकैः /
अकारणान्मुष्टिगतांस्तण्डुलान्सकपर्द्दिकान् //
text_mt: one should worship with the Puruṣasūkta with the [various] services. / For no reason, rice-grains held in the fist together with cowries

sanskrit_iast:
viprāya baṭave dadyādgandhapuṣpārcitāya ca /
taṇḍulā vaiśvadaivatyā haradaivatyamiśritāḥ //
meaning:
विप्राय बटवे दद्याद्गन्धपुष्पार्चिताय च /
तण्डुला वैश्वदैवत्या हरदैवत्यमिश्रिताः //
text_mt: one should give to a twice-born youth who has been worshipped with perfume and flowers. / The rice-grains are dedicated to the Viśvedevas, mixed with those dedicated to Hara:

sanskrit_iast:
kapardigaṇanātho 'sau prīyatāṃ taiḥ samarpitaiḥ /
caturthyāṃ kārtike kṛṣṇe karakākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
कपर्दिगणनाथो ऽसौ प्रीयतां तैः समर्पितैः /
चतुर्थ्यां कार्तिके कृष्णे करकाख्यं व्रतं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: 'May that Kapardigaṇanātha be pleased by these offered [items]!' / On the fourth [tithi] in the dark [fortnight] of Kārttika, the observance named Karaka is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāmevādhikāro 'tra tadvidhānamudīryate /
pūjayecca gaṇādhīśaṃ snātā strīsamalaṅkṛtā //
meaning:
स्त्रीणामेवाधिकारो ऽत्र तद्विधानमुदीर्यते /
पूजयेच्च गणाधीशं स्नाता स्त्रीसमलङ्कृता //
text_mt: Women alone are entitled to this; its rule is being declared: / having bathed and being adorned, a woman should worship Gaṇādhīśa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre pūrṇapakvānnaṃ vinyasetkarakāndaśa /
samarpya devadevāya bhaktyā prayatamānasā //
meaning:
तदग्रे पूर्णपक्वान्नं विन्यसेत्करकान्दश /
समर्प्य देवदेवाय भक्त्या प्रयतमानसा //
text_mt: Before him, having placed ten vessels filled with cooked food, / having offered them to the god of gods with devotion and a restrained mind,

sanskrit_iast:
devo me prīyatāmevamuccāryyātha samarpayet /
suvāsinībhyo viprebhyo yathākāmaṃ ca sādaram //
meaning:
देवो मे प्रीयतामेवमुच्चार्य्याथ समर्पयेत् /
सुवासिनीभ्यो विप्रेभ्यो यथाकामं च सादरम् //
text_mt: saying 'May the god be pleased with me,' one should then offer them / to married women and to the twice-born as desired, with respect.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścandrodaye rātrau dattvārghaṃ vidhipūrvakam /
bhuñjīta miṣṭamannaṃ ca vratasya paripūrtaye //
meaning:
ततश्चन्द्रोदये रात्रौ दत्त्वार्घं विधिपूर्वकम् /
भुञ्जीत मिष्टमन्नं च व्रतस्य परिपूर्तये //
text_mt: Then, at moonrise at night, having offered an oblation according to rule, / she should eat sweet food for the complete fulfillment of the observance.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā kṣīreṇa karakaṃ pūrṇaṃ toyena vā mune /
sapūgākṣataratnāḍhyaṃ dvijāya pratipādayet //
meaning:
यद्वा क्षीरेण करकं पूर्णं तोयेन वा मुने /
सपूगाक्षतरत्नाढ्यं द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् //
text_mt: Or, O sage, a vessel filled with milk or with water, / rich in betel nuts, unbroken rice, and gems, one should bestow upon a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkṛtvā vrataṃ nārī ṣoḍaśadvādaśābdakam /
upāyanaṃ vidhāyātha vratametadvisarjjayet //
meaning:
एतत्कृत्वा व्रतं नारी षोडशद्वादशाब्दकम् /
उपायनं विधायाथ व्रतमेतद्विसर्ज्जयेत् //
text_mt: Having performed this observance for sixteen or twelve years, / a woman should then make an offering and complete this observance.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvajjīvaṃ tu vā nāryā kāryyaṃ saubhāgyavāñchayā /
vratenānena sadṛśaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakam //
meaning:
यावज्जीवं तु वा नार्या कार्य्यं सौभाग्यवाञ्छया /
व्रतेनानेन सदृशं स्त्रीणां सौभाग्यदायकम् //
text_mt: Or it should be observed by a woman for as long as she lives, through desire for good fortune. / An observance equal to this, bestowing good fortune upon women,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyate bhuvaneṣvanyattasmānnityamiti sthitiḥ /
ūrjjaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu nāgavratamudāhṛtam //
meaning:
विद्यते भुवनेष्वन्यत्तस्मान्नित्यमिति स्थितिः /
ऊर्ज्जशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु नागव्रतमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: is not found anywhere else in the worlds; therefore, it is established as perpetual. / On the fourth [tithi] of the bright [fortnight] of Ūrja, the Serpent Observance is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarvrataṃ tu saṃkalpya dhenuśṛñjagalaṃ śuci /
pītvā snātvātha madhyāhne śaṅkhapālādipannagān //
meaning:
प्रातर्व्रतं तु संकल्प्य धेनुशृञ्जगलं शुचि /
पीत्वा स्नात्वाथ मध्याह्ने शङ्खपालादिपन्नगान् //
text_mt: Having taken the resolve for the observance in the morning, having drunk pure cow's horn-water / and then bathed, at midday [one should worship] Śaṅkhapāla and other serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ cāhvāmapūrvaistu pūjayedupacārakaiḥ /
kṣīreṇāpyāyanaṃ kuryādetannāgavrataṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
शेषं चाह्वामपूर्वैस्तु पूजयेदुपचारकैः /
क्षीरेणाप्यायनं कुर्यादेतन्नागव्रतं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: and Śeṣa preceded by his names, with the [various] services. / One should perform satiation with milk; this is remembered as the Serpent Observance.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṅkṛte tu viprendra nṛbhirnāgavrate śubhe /
viṣāṇi naśyantyacirānna daśanti ca pannagāḥ //
meaning:
एवङ्कृते तु विप्रेन्द्र नृभिर्नागव्रते शुभे /
विषाणि नश्यन्त्यचिरान्न दशन्ति च पन्नगाः //
text_mt: When this auspicious Serpent Observance is performed by men, O best of the twice-born, / poisons are swiftly destroyed, and serpents do not bite.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu varṣaṃ yāvanmunīśvarā /
kṣapayedekabhaktena naktenātha dvitīyakam //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु वर्षं यावन्मुनीश्वरा /
क्षपयेदेकभक्तेन नक्तेनाथ द्वितीयकम् //
text_mt: On the fourth [tithi] of the bright [fortnight] of Mārgaśīrṣa, O lord of sages, for a year / one should pass the time eating once a day; then during the second, with nocturnal eating;

sanskrit_iast:
ayācitopavāsābhyāṃ tṛtīyakacaturthake /
evaṃ krameṇa vidhivaccatvāryabdāni mānavaḥ //
meaning:
अयाचितोपवासाभ्यां तृतीयकचतुर्थके /
एवं क्रमेण विधिवच्चत्वार्यब्दानि मानवः //
text_mt: during the third and fourth [years], with food received unasked and with fasting. / Thus, in succession according to rule, for four years a man

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya ca tato 'syānte vratasnāto mahāvratī /
kārayeddhemaghaṭitaṃ bhūgaṇermūṣakaṃ ratham //
meaning:
समाप्य च ततो ऽस्यान्ते व्रतस्नातो महाव्रती /
कारयेद्धेमघटितं भूगणेर्मूषकं रथम् //
text_mt: completes it, and then at its conclusion, having taken the bath of the observance, the great observer of vows / should have a golden mouse-chariot made by a group of goldsmiths;

sanskrit_iast:
aśakto varṇakaireva śubhraṃ cābjaṃ supatrakam /
tasyopari ghaṭaṃ sthāpya tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam //
meaning:
अशक्तो वर्णकैरेव शुभ्रं चाब्जं सुपत्रकम् /
तस्योपरि घटं स्थाप्य ताम्रपात्रेण संयुतम् //
text_mt: if unable, [made] only with colors, and a white lotus with fine petals. / Placing a jar upon it along with a copper vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayettaṇḍalaiḥ śubhraistasyopari gaṇeśvaram /
nyasedvastrayugācchannaṃ gandhādyaiḥ pūjayecca tam //
meaning:
पूरयेत्तण्डलैः शुभ्रैस्तस्योपरि गणेश्वरम् /
न्यसेद्वस्त्रयुगाच्छन्नं गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेच्च तम् //
text_mt: one should fill it with white rice-grains; upon it one should place Gaṇeśvara / covered with a pair of garments, and should worship him with perfumes and other [offerings].

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ modakaṃ kalpyaṃ gaṇeśaḥ prīyatāmiti /
jāgarairśītavādyādyaiḥ purāṇākhyānakaiścaret //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं मोदकं कल्प्यं गणेशः प्रीयतामिति /
जागरैर्शीतवाद्याद्यैः पुराणाख्यानकैश्चरेत् //
text_mt: A sweetmeat should be prepared as food offering, saying, 'May Gaṇeśa be pleased.' / One should keep vigil with songs, musical instruments, and recitations of Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte vimale snātvā homaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ /'
tilavrīhiyavaśvetasurṣapājyaiḥ sakhaṇḍakaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा होमं कृत्वा विधानतः /'
तिलव्रीहियवश्वेतसुर्षपाज्यैः सखण्डकैः //
text_mt: Having bathed at a clear dawn and performed fire oblations according to rule / with sesame, unhusked rice, barley, white mustard, clarified butter, and sugar pieces,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇo gaṇādhipaścaiva kūṣmāṇḍastripurāntakaḥ /
laṃbodaraikadantau ca rukmadaṃṣṭraśca vighnapaḥ //
meaning:
गणो गणाधिपश्चैव कूष्माण्डस्त्रिपुरान्तकः /
लंबोदरैकदन्तौ च रुक्मदंष्ट्रश्च विघ्नपः //
text_mt: with these sixteen names: Gaṇa, Gaṇādhipa, Kūṣmāṇḍa, Tripurāntaka, / Lambodara, Ekadanta, Rukmadaṃṣṭra, Vighnapa,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā yamo 'tha varuṇaḥ somasūryahutāśanāḥ /
