gandhamādī parameṣṭhītyevaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmabhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा यमो ऽथ वरुणः सोमसूर्यहुताशनाः /
गन्धमादी परमेष्ठीत्येवं षोडशनामभिः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Yama, Varuṇa, Soma, Sūrya, Hutāśana, / Gandhamādin, and Parameṣṭhin,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādyairṅeṃnamoṃ'taiḥ pratyekaṃ dahane hunet /
vakratuṇḍeti ṅeṃtena barmāntenāṣṭayukchatam //
meaning:
प्रणवाद्यैर्ङेंनमोंऽतैः प्रत्येकं दहने हुनेत् /
वक्रतुण्डेति ङेंतेन बर्मान्तेनाष्टयुक्छतम् //
text_mt: each preceded by Praṇava and ending in dative 'namaḥ', one should offer into the fire. / With 'Vakratuṇḍa' in the dative ending in 'varman', one should offer one hundred and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vyāhṛtibhiḥ śaktyā hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret /
dikpālānpūjayitvā ca brāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ //
meaning:
ततो व्याहृतिभिः शक्त्या हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं चरेत् /
दिक्पालान्पूजयित्वा च ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Then, having offered with the vyāhṛtis according to ability, one should perform the final oblation. / And having worshipped the guardians of the directions, one should feed brāhmaṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
catutviṃśatisaṃkhyākān modakaiḥ pāyasaistathā /
savatsāṃ gāṃ tato dadyādācāryāya sadakṣiṇām //
meaning:
चतुत्विंशतिसंख्याकान् मोदकैः पायसैस्तथा /
सवत्सां गां ततो दद्यादाचार्याय सदक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: twenty-four in number, with sweetmeats and milk pudding. / Then one should give a cow with calf, accompanied by a fee, to the ācārya.

sanskrit_iast:
anyobhyo 'pi yathāśakti bhūyasīṃ ca tato dadet /
praṇamya dakṣiṇīkṛtya pravisṛjya dvijottamām //
meaning:
अन्योभ्यो ऽपि यथाशक्ति भूयसीं च ततो ददेत् /
प्रणम्य दक्षिणीकृत्य प्रविसृज्य द्विजोत्तमाम् //
text_mt: To the others as well, according to one's ability, one should give an abundant [fee]. / Having bowed down, circumambulated, and dismissed those best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhubhiḥ saha bhuñjīta svayaṃ ca prītamānasaḥ /
etadvrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogānihottamān //
meaning:
बन्धुभिः सह भुञ्जीत स्वयं च प्रीतमानसः /
एतद्व्रतं नरः कृत्वा भुक्त्वा भोगानिहोत्तमान् //
text_mt: one should oneself eat together with relatives, with a pleased mind. / Having performed this observance and enjoyed excellent pleasures here [on earth], a man

sanskrit_iast:
sāyujyaṃ labhate viṣṇorgaṇeśasya prasādataḥ /
kecidvaravrataṃ nāma prāhuretasya nārada //
meaning:
सायुज्यं लभते विष्णोर्गणेशस्य प्रसादतः /
केचिद्वरव्रतं नाम प्राहुरेतस्य नारद //
text_mt: attains union with Viṣṇu through the grace of Gaṇeśa. / Some, O Nārada, call this the Varavrata.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānametadevāpi phalaṃ cāpīha tatsamam /
pauṣamāsacaturthyāṃ tu vighneśaṃ prārthya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
विधानमेतदेवापि फलं चापीह तत्समम् /
पौषमासचतुर्थ्यां तु विघ्नेशं प्रार्थ्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: Its procedure is this very same, and its fruit here is also equal to that. / On the fourth [tithi] of the month of Pauṣa, having prayed to Vighneśa with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
vipraikaṃ bhojayeccaivaṃ modakairdakṣiṇāṃ dadet /
evaṃ kṛte mune bhūyādvratī saṃpattibhājanam //
meaning:
विप्रैकं भोजयेच्चैवं मोदकैर्दक्षिणां ददेत् /
एवं कृते मुने भूयाद्व्रती संपत्तिभाजनम् //
text_mt: one should feed one twice-born thus with sweetmeats, and give a fee. / When this is done, O sage, the observer of vows becomes a vessel of prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
māghakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ tu saṃkaṣṭavratamucyate /
tatropavāsaṃ saṃkalpya vratī niyamapūrvakam //
meaning:
माघकृष्णचतुर्थ्यां तु संकष्टव्रतमुच्यते /
तत्रोपवासं संकल्प्य व्रती नियमपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: On the fourth [tithi] of the dark [fortnight] of Māgha, the Saṃkaṣṭa Observance is declared. / Having resolved upon fasting there according to rule, the observer of vows,

sanskrit_iast:
candrodayamabhivyāpya tiṣṭhetprayatamānasaḥ /
tataścandrodaye prāpte mṛnmayaṃ gaṇanāyakam //
meaning:
चन्द्रोदयमभिव्याप्य तिष्ठेत्प्रयतमानसः /
ततश्चन्द्रोदये प्राप्ते मृन्मयं गणनायकम् //
text_mt: restrained in mind, should remain [fasting] until moonrise. / Then, when moonrise has arrived, having fashioned an earthen Gaṇanāyaka

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya vinyasetpīṭhe sāyudhaṃ ca savāhanam /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
विधाय विन्यसेत्पीठे सायुधं च सवाहनम् /
उपचारैः षोडशभिः समभ्यर्च्य विधानतः //
text_mt: equipped with weapons and with a mount, one should place him on a ritual seat. / Having worshipped him properly with the sixteen services,

sanskrit_iast:
modakaṃ cāpi naivedyaṃ saguḍaṃ tilakuṭṭakam /
tator'ghyaṃ tāmraje pātre raktacandanamiśritam //
meaning:
मोदकं चापि नैवेद्यं सगुडं तिलकुट्टकम् /
ततोर्ऽघ्यं ताम्रजे पात्रे रक्तचन्दनमिश्रितम् //
text_mt: sweetmeats and pounded sesame with jaggery as food offering, / then an water-offering in a copper vessel mixed with red sandalwood

sanskrit_iast:
sakuśaṃ ca sadūrvaṃ ca puṣpākṣatasamanvitam /
saśamīpatradadhi ca kṛtvā candrāya dāpayet //
meaning:
सकुशं च सदूर्वं च पुष्पाक्षतसमन्वितम् /
सशमीपत्रदधि च कृत्वा चन्द्राय दापयेत् //
text_mt:
Having prepared [water] with kuśa, dūrvā, flowers, and unbroken grains,
along with śamī leaves and curd, one should offer it to the moon:

sanskrit_iast:
gaganārṇavamāṇikya candra dākṣāyaṇīpate /
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ gaṇeśapratirūpaka //
meaning:
गगनार्णवमाणिक्य चन्द्र दाक्षायणीपते /
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं गणेशप्रतिरूपक //
text_mt:
"O ruby of the sky-ocean! O moon! O lord of Dakṣa's daughter!
Accept the water-offering given by me, O image of Gaṇeśa!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā gaṇeśāya divyārghyaṃ pāpanāśanam /
śaktyā saṃbhojya viprāgryānsvayaṃ bhuñjīta cājñayā //
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा गणेशाय दिव्यार्घ्यं पापनाशनम् /
शक्त्या संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्स्वयं भुञ्जीत चाज्ञया //
text_mt:
Having thus offered the divine, sin-destroying water-offering to Gaṇeśa,
and having fed the foremost brāhmaṇas according to one's capacity, one should eat oneself with their permission.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra saṃkaṣṭākhyaṃ śūbhāvaham /
samṛddho dhanadhānyaiḥ syānna ca saṃkaṣṭamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र संकष्टाख्यं शूभावहम् /
समृद्धो धनधान्यैः स्यान्न च संकष्टमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Having thus performed this observance called Saṃkaṣṭā, which brings good fortune, O brāhmaṇa,
one will flourish with wealth and grain, and will not encounter distress.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu gaurīvratamanuttamam /
tasyāṃ tu gaurī saṃpūjyā saṃyuktā yoginīgaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
माघशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु गौरीव्रतमनुत्तमम् /
तस्यां तु गौरी संपूज्या संयुक्ता योगिनीगणैः //
text_mt:
On the bright fourth tithi of Māgha is the unsurpassed Gaurīvrata;
on that [tithi], Gaurī accompanied by the host of yoginīs is to be worshipped

sanskrit_iast:
naraiḥ strībhirviśeṣeṇa kundapuṣpaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ /
raktasūtre raktapuṣpaistathaivālaktakena ca //
meaning:
नरैः स्त्रीभिर्विशेषेण कुन्दपुष्पैः सकुङ्कुमैः /
रक्तसूत्रे रक्तपुष्पैस्तथैवालक्तकेन च //
text_mt:
by men, and especially by women, with kunda flowers and saffron,
with red threads, red flowers, and likewise with red lac;

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpairdīpaṃśca balibhiḥ saguḍainārdrakeṇa ca /
payasā pāyasenāpi lavaṇena ca pālakaiḥ //
meaning:
धूपैर्दीपंश्च बलिभिः सगुडैनार्द्रकेण च /
पयसा पायसेनापि लवणेन च पालकैः //
text_mt:
with incenses, lamps, oblations, with jaggery and ginger,
with milk, with rice-milk, with salt, and with spinach.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryastathā viprāḥ suśobhanāḥ /
saubhāgyavṛddhaye deyo bhoktavyaṃ bandhubhiḥ saha //
meaning:
पूज्याश्चाविधवा नार्यस्तथा विप्राः सुशोभनाः /
सौभाग्यवृद्धये देयो भोक्तव्यं बन्धुभिः सह //
text_mt:
Non-widowed women and auspicious brāhmaṇas are to be worshipped;
[gifts] should be given for the increase of good fortune, and one should eat together with relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ gaurīvrataṃ vipra saubhāgyārogyavarddhanam /
prativarṣaṃ prakarttavyaṃ nārībhiśca naraistathā //
meaning:
इदं गौरीव्रतं विप्र सौभाग्यारोग्यवर्द्धनम् /
प्रतिवर्षं प्रकर्त्तव्यं नारीभिश्च नरैस्तथा //
text_mt:
This Gaurīvrata, O brāhmaṇa, increases good fortune and health;
it should be performed every year by women and also by men.

sanskrit_iast:
ḍhuṇḍhivrataṃ paraiḥ proktaṃ kaiścitkuṇḍavrataṃ smṛtam /
lalitāvratamityanyaiḥ śāntivratamathāparaiḥ //
meaning:
ढुण्ढिव्रतं परैः प्रोक्तं कैश्चित्कुण्डव्रतं स्मृतम् /
ललिताव्रतमित्यन्यैः शान्तिव्रतमथापरैः //
text_mt:
It is proclaimed by others as Ḍhuṇḍhivrata, remembered by some as Kuṇḍavrata,
by others as Lalitāvrata, and by still others as Śāntivrata.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvamasyāṃ kṛtaṃ mune /
bhavetsaha sraguṇitaṃ prasādāddantinaḥ sadā //
meaning:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः सर्वमस्यां कृतं मुने /
भवेत्सह स्रगुणितं प्रसादाद्दन्तिनः सदा //
text_mt:
Bathing, giving, recitation, fire oblation—all done on this [day], O sage,
becomes multiplied a thousandfold, always through the grace of the Tusker.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ phaālgune māsi ḍhuṇḍhirājavrataṃ śubham /
tilaṣiṣṭairdvijān bhojya svayaṃ cāśnīta mānavaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां फआल्गुने मासि ढुण्ढिराजव्रतं शुभम् /
तिलषिष्टैर्द्विजान् भोज्य स्वयं चाश्नीत मानवः //
text_mt:
On the fourth tithi in the month of Phālguna is the auspicious Ḍhuṇḍhirājavrata.
Having fed the twice-born with sesame flour, a person should also eat [it] themselves,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśārādhanaparo dānahomaprapūjanaiḥ /
tilaireva kṛtaiḥ siddhiṃ prāpnuyāttatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
गणेशाराधनपरो दानहोमप्रपूजनैः /
तिलैरेव कृतैः सिद्धिं प्राप्नुयात्तत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt:
devoted to the worship of Gaṇeśa with gifts, fire oblations, and acts of worship
performed with sesame alone; one attains perfection through his grace.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ ca kṛtvā saṃpūjya yatnataḥ /
dvijāgryāya pradātavyaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye //
meaning:
सौवर्णं गजवक्त्रं च कृत्वा संपूज्य यत्नतः /
द्विजाग्र्याय प्रदातव्यं सर्वसंपत्समृद्धये //
text_mt:
Having made a golden elephant-faced [image] and worshipped it with effort,
it should be given to a foremost twice-born for the abundance of all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminkasminbhavenmāsi caturthī ravivārayuk /
sāṃgārakā vā viprendra sā viśeṣaphalapradā //
meaning:
यस्मिन्कस्मिन्भवेन्मासि चतुर्थी रविवारयुक् /
सांगारका वा विप्रेन्द्र सा विशेषफलप्रदा //
text_mt:
In whatever month a fourth tithi falls on a Sunday
or on a Tuesday, O chief of brāhmaṇas, it grants special fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsu ca caturthīṣu śuklāsvapyasitāsu ca /
vighneśa eva deveśaḥ saṃpūjyo bhaktitatparaiḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādśanāsa caturthīvratānirūpaṇaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikasatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वासु च चतुर्थीषु शुक्लास्वप्यसितासु च /
विघ्नेश एव देवेशः संपूज्यो भक्तितत्परैः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वाद्शनास चतुर्थीव्रतानिरूपणं नाम त्रयोदशाधिकसततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
And on all fourth tithis, whether bright or dark,
the Lord of Obstacles, the Lord of Gods, alone is to be worshipped by those devoted in devotion.

Thus ends the one hundred and thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Fourth-Tithi Observances of the Twelve Months', in the fourth quarter of the great narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi pañcamyāste vratānyaham /
yāni bhaktyā samāsthāya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चम्यास्ते व्रतान्यहम् /
यानि भक्त्या समास्थाय सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Sanātana said:
Listen, O brāhmaṇa, I shall declare to you the observances of the fifth [tithi],
by undertaking which with devotion one attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
proktā matsyajayantī tu pañcamī madhuśuklagā /
asyāṃ matsyāvatārārcā bhaktaiḥ kāryā mahotsavā //
meaning:
प्रोक्ता मत्स्यजयन्ती तु पञ्चमी मधुशुक्लगा /
अस्यां मत्स्यावतारार्चा भक्तैः कार्या महोत्सवा //
text_mt:
The fifth tithi in the bright [fortnight] of Madhu is proclaimed as Matsyajayantī;
on this [day], worship of the Fish incarnation should be performed by devotees as a great festival.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpañcamīti caiṣoktā tatra kāryaṃ śriyor'canam /
gandhādyairupacāraistu naivedyaiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ //
meaning:
श्रीपञ्चमीति चैषोक्ता तत्र कार्यं श्रियोर्ऽचनम् /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैस्तु नैवेद्यैः पायसादिभिः //
text_mt: And this is called Śrīpañcamī. There, worship of Śrī should be performed / with offerings such as fragrant pastes, and food offerings such as milk-rice and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yo lakṣmīṃ pūjayeccātra taṃ vai lakṣmīrna muñcati /
pṛthvīvrataṃ tathā cāndraṃ hayagarīvavrataṃ tathā //
meaning:
यो लक्ष्मीं पूजयेच्चात्र तं वै लक्ष्मीर्न मुञ्चति /
पृथ्वीव्रतं तथा चान्द्रं हयगरीवव्रतं तथा //
text_mt: Whoever worships Lakṣmī here, him Lakṣmī certainly never abandons. / Likewise the Pṛthvīvrata, the Cāndravrata, and the Hayagrīvavrata,

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ tattadvidhānena tattatsiddhimabhīpsubhiḥ /
atha vaiśākhapañcamyāṃ śeṣaṃ cābhyarcya mānavaḥ //
meaning:
कार्यं तत्तद्विधानेन तत्तत्सिद्धिमभीप्सुभिः /
अथ वैशाखपञ्चम्यां शेषं चाभ्यर्च्य मानवः //
text_mt: should be performed according to their respective rules by those desiring their respective accomplishments. / Then, on the fifth day of Vaiśākha, a man having worshipped Śeṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvairnāgagaṇairyuktamabhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam /
tathā jyeṣṭhasya pañcamyāṃ pitṝnabhyarcayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
सर्वैर्नागगणैर्युक्तमभीष्टं लभते फलम् /
तथा ज्येष्ठस्य पञ्चम्यां पितॄनभ्यर्चयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: together with all the host of serpents, attains his desired fruit. / Likewise, on the fifth day of Jyeṣṭha, a wise man should worship the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmaphalāvāptirbhavedvai viprabhojanaiḥ /
athāṣāḍhasya pañcamyāṃ vāyuṃ sarvagataṃ mune //
meaning:
सर्वकामफलावाप्तिर्भवेद्वै विप्रभोजनैः /
अथाषाढस्य पञ्चम्यां वायुं सर्वगतं मुने //
text_mt: Attainment of the fruit of all desires shall indeed come about through feeding brāhmaṇas. / Then, on the fifth day of Āṣāḍha, [to worship] the all-pervading wind, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
grāmādbahirvinirgatya dharopasthe samāstitaḥ /
dhvajaṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃ tu vaṃśadaṇḍāgrasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
ग्रामाद्बहिर्विनिर्गत्य धरोपस्थे समास्तितः /
ध्वजं च पञ्चवर्णं तु वंशदण्डाग्रसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: having gone outside the village, established on the surface of the earth, / a five-coloured flag situated at the top of a bamboo pole,

sanskrit_iast:
samucchritaṃ nidadhyāttu kalpitābje tu madhyataḥ /
tatastanmūladeśe tu dikṣu sarvāsu nārada //
meaning:
समुच्छ्रितं निदध्यात्तु कल्पिताब्जे तु मध्यतः /
ततस्तन्मूलदेशे तु दिक्षु सर्वासु नारद //
text_mt: raised high, one should place in the middle of a prepared lotus. / Then, at its base, in all the directions, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālānsamabhyarcya kuryādvāyuparīkṣaṇam /
prathamādiṣu yāmeṣu yo yo vāyuḥ pravartate //
meaning:
लोकपालान्समभ्यर्च्य कुर्याद्वायुपरीक्षणम् /
प्रथमादिषु यामेषु यो यो वायुः प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: having worshipped the world-guardians, one should make examination of the wind: / whichever wind blows in the first and subsequent watches,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai tasmai digīśāya pūjāṃ samyak prakalpayet /
evaṃ sthitvā nirāhārastatra yāmacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
तस्मै तस्मै दिगीशाय पूजां सम्यक् प्रकल्पयेत् /
एवं स्थित्वा निराहारस्तत्र यामचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: to that respective lord of the direction one should properly offer worship. / Having thus remained without food there for four watches,

sanskrit_iast:
sāyamāgatya gehaṃ svaṃ bhuktvā svalpaṃ samāhitaḥ /
lokapālānnamaskṛtya svapyādbhūmitale śucau //
meaning:
सायमागत्य गेहं स्वं भुक्त्वा स्वल्पं समाहितः /
लोकपालान्नमस्कृत्य स्वप्याद्भूमितले शुचौ //
text_mt: having returned home in the evening and eaten a little, composed in mind, / having bowed to the world-guardians, one should sleep on the pure ground.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svapno jāyate tasyāṃ rātrau yāme caturthake /
sa eva bhavitā nūnaṃ svapna ityāha vai śivaḥ //
meaning:
यः स्वप्नो जायते तस्यां रात्रौ यामे चतुर्थके /
स एव भविता नूनं स्वप्न इत्याह वै शिवः //
text_mt: Whatever dream arises on that night during the fourth watch, / that very dream will surely come to pass—so said Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhe tu samutpanne śivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ /
sopavāso nayedaṣṭayāmaṃ taddinameva vā //
meaning:
अशुभे तु समुत्पन्ने शिवपूजापरायणः /
सोपवासो नयेदष्टयामं तद्दिनमेव वा //
text_mt: If an inauspicious [dream] should arise, dedicated to the worship of Śiva, / fasting, he should spend eight watches or that whole day.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayitvā dvijānaṣṭau tataḥ śubhaphalaṃ labhet /
vratametatsamuditaṃ śubhāśubhanidarśanam //
meaning:
भोजयित्वा द्विजानष्टौ ततः शुभफलं लभेत् /
व्रतमेतत्समुदितं शुभाशुभनिदर्शनम् //
text_mt: Having fed eight brāhmaṇas, he shall then attain an auspicious fruit. / This observance has been declared as an indicator of good and bad fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṇāṃ saubhāgyajanakamiha loke paratra ca /
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ vrataṃ hyannasamṛddhidam //
meaning:
नृणां सौभाग्यजनकमिह लोके परत्र च /
श्रावणे कृष्णपञ्चम्यां व्रतं ह्यन्नसमृद्धिदम् //
text_mt: generating good fortune for men in this world and in the next. / On the dark fifth of Śrāvaṇa, there is an observance that bestows an abundance of grain.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ dinaśeṣe tu sarvāṇyannāni nārada /
pṛthak pātreṣu saṃsthāpya jalairāplāvayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां दिनशेषे तु सर्वाण्यन्नानि नारद /
पृथक् पात्रेषु संस्थाप्य जलैराप्लावयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: On the fourth day at the end of the day, O Nārada, / placing all kinds of grains in separate vessels, the wise man should flood them with water.

sanskrit_iast:
tato pātrāntare tattu niṣkāsyāṃbu nidhāpayet /
prātarbhānau samudite pitṝṃścaiva tathā ṛṣīn //
meaning:
ततो पात्रान्तरे तत्तु निष्कास्यांबु निधापयेत् /
प्रातर्भानौ समुदिते पितॄंश्चैव तथा ऋषीन् //
text_mt: Then, having drained that water into another vessel, he should set [the grain] down. / In the morning, when the sun has risen, having worshipped the ancestors and the ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
devāṃścābhyarcya susnātaṃ kṛtvā naivedyamagrataḥ /
tadannaṃ yācakebhyastu prayacchetprītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
देवांश्चाभ्यर्च्य सुस्नातं कृत्वा नैवेद्यमग्रतः /
तदन्नं याचकेभ्यस्तु प्रयच्छेत्प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: and the deities, having bathed well, offering food oblations in front, / with a pleased mind he should give that food to beggars.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ dinaṃ kṣipedevaṃ pradoṣe tu śivālaye /
gatvā saṃpūjayeddevaṃ liṅgarūpiṇamīśvaram //
meaning:
सर्वं दिनं क्षिपेदेवं प्रदोषे तु शिवालये /
गत्वा संपूजयेद्देवं लिङ्गरूपिणमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: He should pass the whole day thus; and at twilight, going to a temple of Śiva, / he should worship the lord, God in the form of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyakpūjayitvā maheśvaram /
japetpañcākṣarī vidyāṃ śataṃ cāpi sahasrakam //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् /
जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरी विद्यां शतं चापि सहस्रकम् //
text_mt: Having properly worshipped Maheśvara with fragrant pastes, flowers, and other offerings, / he should recite the five-syllable vidyā a hundred or a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
japaṃ nivedya devāya bhavāya bhavarūpiṇe /
stutvā sarvairvaundikaiśca paurāṇaiścāpyanākulaḥ //
meaning:
जपं निवेद्य देवाय भवाय भवरूपिणे /
स्तुत्वा सर्वैर्वौन्दिकैश्च पौराणैश्चाप्यनाकुलः //
text_mt: Offering the recitation to the God, to Bhava who has the form of worldly existence, / having praised him with all Vedic and purāṇic hymns, untroubled,

sanskrit_iast:
prārthayeddevamīśānaṃ śaśvatsarvānnasiddhaye /
śāradīyāni cānnāni tathā vāsaṃtikānyapi //
meaning:
प्रार्थयेद्देवमीशानं शश्वत्सर्वान्नसिद्धये /
शारदीयानि चान्नानि तथा वासंतिकान्यपि //
text_mt: he should pray to the Lord, God, for constant success in [obtaining] all grains: / 'Whatever autumn grains and whatever spring grains

sanskrit_iast:
yāni syustaiḥ samṛddho 'haṃ bhūyāṃ janmani janmani /
evaṃ saṃprārthya deveśaṃ gṛhamāgatya vai svakam //
meaning:
यानि स्युस्तैः समृद्धो ऽहं भूयां जन्मनि जन्मनि /
एवं संप्रार्थ्य देवेशं गृहमागत्य वै स्वकम् //
text_mt: there may be, may I be enriched by them in birth after birth!' / Having thus prayed to the Lord of gods, having returned to his own home,

sanskrit_iast:
datvānnaṃ brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ pakvaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ /
etadannavrataṃ vipra vidhinā'caritaṃ nṛbhiḥ //
meaning:
दत्वान्नं ब्राह्मणादिभ्यः पक्वं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः /
एतदन्नव्रतं विप्र विधिनाऽचरितं नृभिः //
text_mt: having given cooked food to brāhmaṇas and others, he should eat, restraining his speech. / This observance of grain, O brāhmaṇa, performed according to rule by men,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānnasaṃpajjanakaṃ paraloke gatipradam /
śrāvaṇe śuklapañcajamyāṃ nṛbhirāstikyatatparaiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वान्नसंपज्जनकं परलोके गतिप्रदम् /
श्रावणे शुक्लपञ्चजम्यां नृभिरास्तिक्यतत्परैः //
text_mt: generates prosperity of all grains and bestows a [good] destiny in the other world. / On the bright fifth of Śrāvaṇa, by men intent on faith,

sanskrit_iast:
dvārasyobhayato lekhyā gomayena viṣolbaṇāḥ /
gandhādyaiḥ pūjayettāṃśca tathendrāṇīmanantaram //
meaning:
द्वारस्योभयतो लेख्या गोमयेन विषोल्बणाः /
गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेत्तांश्च तथेन्द्राणीमनन्तरम् //
text_mt: on both sides of the door should be drawn [serpents] fierce with poison, using cow dung; / and one should worship them with fragrant pastes and other [articles], and then Indrāṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya svarṇarūpyādidadhyakṣatakuśāṃbubhiḥ /
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairnaivedyasaṃcayaiḥ //
meaning:
संपूज्य स्वर्णरूप्यादिदध्यक्षतकुशांबुभिः /
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपैर्नैवेद्यसंचयैः //
text_mt: Having worshipped with gold, silver, and other gifts, curd, unhusked rice, kuśa grass, and water, / with fragrant pastes, flowers, and incense, lamps, and heaps of food offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya taddravyaṃ saṃpraṇamya ca /
saṃprārthya bhaktibhāvena viprāgryeṣu samarpayet //
meaning:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तद्द्रव्यं संप्रणम्य च /
संप्रार्थ्य भक्तिभावेन विप्राग्र्येषु समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: then, having circumambulated that wealth and bowed down, / having prayed with devotion, he should give it to the foremost of brāhmaṇas:

sanskrit_iast:
yadidaṃ svarṇaraupyādi dravyaṃ vai viprasātkṛtam /
tadanantaphalaṃ bhūyānmama janmani janmani //
meaning:
यदिदं स्वर्णरौप्यादि द्रव्यं वै विप्रसात्कृतम् /
तदनन्तफलं भूयान्मम जन्मनि जन्मनि //
text_mt: 'This wealth, consisting of gold, silver, and the like, which has been given to a brāhmaṇa, / may it yield endless fruit for me in birth after birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ dadato dravyaṃ bhaktibhāvena nārada /
prasannaḥ syāddhanādhyakṣaḥ svarṇādikasamṛddhidaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं ददतो द्रव्यं भक्तिभावेन नारद /
प्रसन्नः स्याद्धनाध्यक्षः स्वर्णादिकसमृद्धिदः //
text_mt: To him who gives wealth in this manner with devotion, O Nārada, / the lord of wealth will be pleased, granting abundance of gold and other riches.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā viprānsaṃbhojya bhaktitaḥ /
paścātsvayaṃ ca bhuñjīta dārāpatyasuhṛddṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एतद्व्रतं नरः कृत्वा विप्रान्संभोज्य भक्तितः /
पश्चात्स्वयं च भुञ्जीत दारापत्यसुहृद्दृतः //
text_mt: A man having performed this observance and fed brāhmaṇas with devotion, / should afterwards himself eat, surrounded by wife, children, and friends.

sanskrit_iast: bhādre tu kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ nāgān kṣīreṇa tarpayet //
meaning: भाद्रे तु कृष्णपञ्चम्यां नागान् क्षीरेण तर्पयेत् //
text_mt: On the dark fifth of Bhādrapada, he should satisfy the serpents with milk;

sanskrit_iast:
yastasyā'saptamaṃ yāvatkulaṃ sarpātsunirbhayam /
bhādrasya śuklapañcamyāṃ pūjayedṛṣisattamān //
meaning:
यस्तस्याऽसप्तमं यावत्कुलं सर्पात्सुनिर्भयम् /
भाद्रस्य शुक्लपञ्चम्यां पूजयेदृषिसत्तमान् //
text_mt: for him, his family up to the seventh generation is completely free from fear of snakes. / On the bright fifth of Bhādrapada, one should worship the best of ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarnadyādike snātvā kṛtvā nityamatandritaḥ /
gṛhamāgatya yatnena vedikāṃ kārayenmṛdā //
meaning:
प्रातर्नद्यादिके स्नात्वा कृत्वा नित्यमतन्द्रितः /
गृहमागत्य यत्नेन वेदिकां कारयेन्मृदा //
text_mt: Having bathed in the morning in a river or other water, unwearied, having performed the daily rites, / having come home, he should carefully make an altar of earth.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayenopalipyātha kṛtvā puṣpopaśobhitām /
tatrāstīrya kuśānvipraṛṣīnsapta samarcayet //
meaning:
गोमयेनोपलिप्याथ कृत्वा पुष्पोपशोभिताम् /
तत्रास्तीर्य कुशान्विप्रऋषीन्सप्त समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Having smeared it with cow dung and adorned it with flowers, / having spread kuśa grass there, O brāhmaṇa, he should worship the seven ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairdīpaiḥ suśobhaneḥ /
kaśyapo 'trirbharadvājau viśvāmitro 'tha gautamaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धैश्च विविधैः पुष्पैर्धूपैर्दीपैः सुशोभनेः /
कश्यपो ऽत्रिर्भरद्वाजौ विश्वामित्रो ऽथ गौतमः //
text_mt: with diverse fragrant pastes, flowers, incense, and exceedingly splendid lamps: / Kaśyapa, Atri, Bharadvāja, Viśvāmitra, then Gautama,

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagnirvasiṣṭhaśca saptaite ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
etaibhyo 'ghya ca vidhivatkalpayitvā pradāya ca //
meaning:
जमदग्निर्वसिष्ठश्च सप्तैते ऋषयः स्मृताः /
एतैभ्यो ऽघ्य च विधिवत्कल्पयित्वा प्रदाय च //
text_mt: Jamadagni, and Vasiṣṭha—these are remembered as the seven ṛṣis. / Having prepared and offered water of guest-reception to these according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ vipacedvīmānśyāmākādyairakṛṣṭakaiḥ /
tannivedya visṛjyemānsvayaṃ cādyāttadeva hi //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं विपचेद्वीमान्श्यामाकाद्यैरकृष्टकैः /
तन्निवेद्य विसृज्येमान्स्वयं चाद्यात्तदेव हि //
text_mt: the wise man should cook an oblation of food from uncultivated wild grains such as śyāmāka; / having offered that, having dismissed them, he himself should eat that very food.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā sapta varṣāṇi prativatsaram /
kṛtvā vratānte varayedācāryān sapta vaidikān //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना सप्त वर्षाणि प्रतिवत्सरम् /
कृत्वा व्रतान्ते वरयेदाचार्यान् सप्त वैदिकान् //
text_mt: Every year according to this rule for seven years / having performed it, at the end of the observance he should select seven Vedic teachers.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāḥ saptakurvīnta suvarṇena svaśaktitaḥ /
jaṭilāḥ sākṣasūtrāśca kamaṇḍalusamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिमाः सप्तकुर्वीन्त सुवर्णेन स्वशक्तितः /
जटिलाः साक्षसूत्राश्च कमण्डलुसमन्विताः //
text_mt: He should make seven images of gold according to his capacity, / having matted hair, accompanied by rosaries and water pots.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya kalaśeṣvetāṃstāmreṣu mṛnmayeṣu vā /
snāpayedvidhi vadbhaktyā pṛthakpañcāmṛtairapi //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य कलशेष्वेतांस्ताम्रेषु मृन्मयेषु वा /
स्नापयेद्विधि वद्भक्त्या पृथक्पञ्चामृतैरपि //
text_mt: Having installed them upon water vessels made of copper or of clay, / he should bathe them according to rule with devotion, also separately with the five nectars.

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ /
arghyaṃ datvā tato homaṃ tilavrīhiyavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः संपूज्य भक्तितः /
अर्घ्यं दत्वा ततो होमं तिलव्रीहियवादिभिः //
text_mt: Then, having worshipped them with devotion with sixteen ritual services, / having given water of guest-reception, then making fire oblations with sesame, unhusked rice, barley, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
ṭhasahastomā'iti ṛkhā nāmanantraistu vā pṛthak /
puṇyairmantraistathaivānyairhutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret //
meaning:
ठसहस्तोमाऽइति ऋखा नामनन्त्रैस्तु वा पृथक् /
पुण्यैर्मन्त्रैस्तथैवान्यैर्हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं चरेत् //
text_mt: with the verse beginning with 'sahasrastoma' or with their name-mantras separately, / and having offered oblations with other holy mantras, he should perform the final oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu sapta gā dadyādvastrālaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ /
ācāryaṃ pūjayejjaiva vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु सप्त गा दद्याद्वस्त्रालङ्कारसंयुताः /
आचार्यं पूजयेज्जैव वस्त्रालङ्कारभूषणैः //
text_mt: Then he should give seven cows endowed with garments and ornaments; / and he should worship the teacher with garments and ornamental jewellery.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñayā guroḥ paścānmūrtīrvipreṣu cārpayet /
bhojayitvā tu tānbhaktyā praṇipatya visarjayet //
meaning:
अनुज्ञया गुरोः पश्चान्मूर्तीर्विप्रेषु चार्पयेत् /
भोजयित्वा तु तान्भक्त्या प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Afterwards, with the permission of the guru, he should give the images to the brāhmaṇas; / having fed them with devotion and bowed down, he should dismiss them.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśceṣṭaiḥ sahāsīnaḥ svayaṃ brāhmaṇaśeṣitam /
bhuṅktvā vai ṣaḍrasopetaṃ pramudyātsaha bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
ततश्चेष्टैः सहासीनः स्वयं ब्राह्मणशेषितम् /
भुङ्क्त्वा वै षड्रसोपेतं प्रमुद्यात्सह बन्धुभिः //
text_mt: Then, seated together with dear ones, having himself eaten / what was left by the brāhmaṇas, endowed with the six tastes, he should rejoice together with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkṛtvā vrataṃ gāṅgaṃ bhogānbhuktvātha vāñchitān /
saptarṣīṇāṃ prasādena vimānavarago bhavet //
meaning:
एतत्कृत्वा व्रतं गाङ्गं भोगान्भुक्त्वाथ वाञ्छितान् /
सप्तर्षीणां प्रसादेन विमानवरगो भवेत् //
text_mt: Having performed this observance, O son of Gaṅgā, having enjoyed desired pleasures, / through the grace of the seven ṛṣis he shall go upon an excellent celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast: āśvine śuklapañcamyāmupāṅgalalitāvratam //
meaning: आश्विने शुक्लपञ्चम्यामुपाङ्गललिताव्रतम् //
text_mt: On the bright fifth of Āśvina is the Upāṅgalalitā observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ śaktyā nirmāya nārada /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayettāṃ vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः स्वर्णमयीं मूर्तिं शक्त्या निर्माय नारद /
उपचारैः षोडशभिः पूजयेत्तां विधानतः //
text_mt: Having fashioned a golden image of her according to one's capacity, O Nārada, / one should worship her according to rule with the sixteen ritual services.

sanskrit_iast:
pakvānnaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ dakṣiṇānvitam /
dvijavaryāya dātavyaṃ vratasaṃpūrtihetave //
meaning:
पक्वान्नं फलसंयुक्तं सघृतं दक्षिणान्वितम् /
द्विजवर्याय दातव्यं व्रतसंपूर्तिहेतवे //
text_mt: Cooked food accompanied by fruits, with ghee and a priestly gift, / should be given to an eminent twice-born to complete the observance.

sanskrit_iast:
"savāhanā śaktiyutā varadā pūjitā mayā /
mātarmāmanugṛhyātha gamyatāṃ nijamandiram //
meaning:
"सवाहना शक्तियुता वरदा पूजिता मया /
मातर्मामनुगृह्याथ गम्यतां निजमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: "Accompanied by your mount, endowed with power, the granter of boons, you have been worshipped by me; / O Mother, having favored me, go now to your own abode."

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklapañcamyāṃ jayāvratamanuttamam /
kartavyaṃ pāpanāśāya śraddhayā dvijasattama //
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लपञ्चम्यां जयाव्रतमनुत्तमम् /
कर्तव्यं पापनाशाय श्रद्धया द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: On the bright fifth day of Kārtika, the incomparable Jayā observance / should be performed with faith for the destruction of sins, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā jayāṃ vipra yathāvidhi samāhitaḥ /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ śuciralaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा जयां विप्र यथाविधि समाहितः /
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः शुचिरलङ्कृतः //
text_mt: Having worshipped Jayā according to rule, collected in mind, O brahmin, / with sixteen offerings, then pure and adorned,

sanskrit_iast:
vipraikaṃ bhojayeccāpi tasmai dattvā ca dakṣiṇām /
visarjayettataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
विप्रैकं भोजयेच्चापि तस्मै दत्त्वा च दक्षिणाम् /
विसर्जयेत्ततः पश्चात्स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: he should feed one brahmin, and having given him a priestly gift, / should dismiss him; thereafter he himself should eat, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu vai bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ snānaṃ kuryāj jayādine /
naśyanti tasya pāpāni siṃhākrāntā mṛgā yathā //
meaning:
यस्तु वै भक्तिसंयुक्तः स्नानं कुर्याज् जयादिने /
नश्यन्ति तस्य पापानि सिंहाक्रान्ता मृगा यथा //
text_mt: Whoever, endowed with devotion, bathes on the day of Jayā, / his sins perish just as deer attacked by a lion.

sanskrit_iast:
yadaśvamedhāvabhṛthe phalaṃ snānena kīrtitam /
tatphalaṃ prāpyate viprasnānenāpi jayādine //
meaning:
यदश्वमेधावभृथे फलं स्नानेन कीर्तितम् /
तत्फलं प्राप्यते विप्रस्नानेनापि जयादिने //
text_mt: Whatever fruit is declared from bathing at the concluding bath of an horse-sacrifice, / that same fruit is attained, O brahmin, even by a bath on the day of Jayā.

sanskrit_iast:
aputro labhate putraṃ vandhyā gabha ca vindati /
rogī rogātpramucyeta baddho mucyeta bandhanāt //
meaning:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं वन्ध्या गभ च विन्दति /
रोगी रोगात्प्रमुच्येत बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् //
text_mt: The sonless one obtains a son, and a barren woman conceives a child; / the diseased is freed from disease, and the bound is released from bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśukle ca pañcamyāṃ nāgāniṣṭvā vidhānataḥ /
nāgebhyo hyabhayaṃ labdhvā modate saha bāndhavaiḥ //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्ले च पञ्चम्यां नागानिष्ट्वा विधानतः /
नागेभ्यो ह्यभयं लब्ध्वा मोदते सह बान्धवैः //
text_mt: And having worshipped the serpents according to rule on the bright fifth day of Mārgaśīrṣa, / having indeed obtained fearlessness from serpents, he rejoices with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣe 'pi śuklapañcamyāṃ sampūjya madhusūdanam /
labhate bāñchitānkāmānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
पौषे ऽपि शुक्लपञ्चम्यां सम्पूज्य मधुसूदनम् /
लभते बाञ्छितान्कामान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Having worshipped the slayer of Madhu on the bright fifth day of Pauṣa as well, / he attains desired wishes; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyāṃ pratimāse tu śukle kṛṣṇe ca nārada /
pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ śastaṃ nāgānāṃ cāpi sarvathā //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthapañcamīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पञ्चम्यां प्रतिमासे तु शुक्ले कृष्णे च नारद /
पितॄणां पूजनं शस्तं नागानां चापि सर्वथा //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थपञ्चमीव्रतनिरूपणं नाम चतुर्दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Every month on the fifth day, in both the bright and dark fortnights, O Nārada, / the worship of the ancestors and of the serpents is always praised.

Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Fifth-Day Observances in the Twelve Months', in the fourth quarter in the Great Narrative of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi ṣaṣṭhyāścaiva vratāni te /
yāni samyagvidhāyātra labhaghetsarvānmanorathān //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि षष्ठ्याश्चैव व्रतानि ते /
यानि सम्यग्विधायात्र लभघेत्सर्वान्मनोरथान् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Listen, O brahmin, I shall declare to you the observances of the sixth day, / by properly performing which here one attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ kumāravratamuttamam /
tatreṣṭvā ṣaṇmukhaṃ devaṃ nānāpūjā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
चैत्रमासे शुक्लषष्ठ्यां कुमारव्रतमुत्तमम् /
तत्रेष्ट्वा षण्मुखं देवं नानापूजा विधानतः //
text_mt: On the bright sixth day in the month of Caitra is the excellent Kumāra observance; / having worshipped the six-faced god there with various rituals according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ prāpnuyāccirajīvinam /
vaiśākhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca pūjayitvā ca kārtikam //
meaning:
पुत्रं सर्वगुणोपेतं प्राप्नुयाच्चिरजीविनम् /
वैशाखशुक्लषष्ठ्यां च पूजयित्वा च कार्तिकम् //
text_mt: one obtains a long-lived son endowed with all good qualities. / And on the bright sixth day of Vaiśākha, having worshipped Kārttikeya,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate mātṛjaṃ saukhyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
jyeṣṭhamāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ vidhineṣṭvā divākaram //
meaning:
लभते मातृजं सौख्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
ज्येष्ठमासे शुक्लषष्ठ्यां विधिनेष्ट्वा दिवाकरम् //
text_mt: he obtains happiness derived from the mother; no doubt should be entertained here. / Having worshipped the sun according to rule on the bright sixth day of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate vāñchitānkāmāṃstatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ /
āṣāḍhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai skandavratamanuttamam //
meaning:
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामांस्तत्प्रसादान्न संशयः /
आषाढशुक्लषष्ठ्यां वै स्कन्दव्रतमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: he obtains his desired wishes through his grace, there is no doubt. / On the bright sixth day of Āṣāḍha is the incomparable Skanda observance.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya pūjayitvainaṃ śivomāpriyamātmajam /
labhate 'bhīpsitānkāmānputrapautrādisaṃtatīḥ //
meaning:
उपोष्य पूजयित्वैनं शिवोमाप्रियमात्मजम् /
लभते ऽभीप्सितान्कामान्पुत्रपौत्रादिसंततीः //
text_mt: Having fasted and worshipped this son dear to Śiva and Umā, / he obtains his longed-for wishes and an unbroken line of sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śarajanmānamarcayet /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhaktyā paramayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
श्रावणे शुक्लषष्ठ्यां तु शरजन्मानमर्चयेत् /
उपचारैः षोडशभिर्भक्त्या परमयान्वितः //
text_mt: On the bright sixth day of Śrāvaṇa, he should worship the reed-born one / with sixteen offerings, filled with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
labhate 'bhīpsitānarthānṣaṇmukhasya prasādataḥ /
bhādramāse kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭyāṃ lalitāvratamucyate //
meaning:
लभते ऽभीप्सितानर्थान्षण्मुखस्य प्रसादतः /
भाद्रमासे कृष्णषष्ट्यां ललिताव्रतमुच्यते //
text_mt: He attains desired aims by the grace of the six-faced one. / On the dark sixth day in the month of Bhādrapada, the Lalitā observance is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena nārī śuklāmbarāvṛtā /
śuktamālyayadharā vāpi nadyāḥ saṃgamavālukām //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नात्वा विधानेन नारी शुक्लाम्बरावृता /
शुक्तमाल्ययधरा वापि नद्याः संगमवालुकाम् //
text_mt: Having bathed in the morning according to rule, a woman, clad in white garments / or wearing white garlands, [taking] sand from a river confluence,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā vaṃśapātre tu dhṛtvā piṇḍākṛtiṃ ca tām /
pañcadhā lalitāṃ tatra dhyāyedvanavilāsinīm //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा वंशपात्रे तु धृत्वा पिण्डाकृतिं च ताम् /
पञ्चधा ललितां तत्र ध्यायेद्वनविलासिनीम् //
text_mt: taking it and placing it in a bamboo vessel in the shape of a lump, / should meditate there fivefold on Lalitā who sports in the woods.

sanskrit_iast:
paṅkajaṃ karavīraṃ ca nepālīṃ mālatīṃ tathā /
nīlotpalaṃ ketakīṃ ca saṃgṛhya tagaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
पङ्कजं करवीरं च नेपालीं मालतीं तथा /
नीलोत्पलं केतकीं च संगृह्य तगरं तथा //
text_mt: Having gathered lotus, karavīra, nepālī, and mālatī, / blue lotus, ketakī, and tagara,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikāṣṭaśataṃ grāhyamaṣṭāviṃśatireva ca /
akṣatāḥ kalikā gṛhya tābhirdevīṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
एकैकाष्टशतं ग्राह्यमष्टाविंशतिरेव च /
अक्षताः कलिका गृह्य ताभिर्देवीं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: taking one hundred and eight or twenty-eight of each, / and taking unhusked rice grains and buds, she should worship the goddess with them.

sanskrit_iast:
prārthayedagrataḥ sthitvā devīṃ tāṃ giriśapriyām /
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvartte vilvake nīlaparvate //
meaning:
प्रार्थयेदग्रतः स्थित्वा देवीं तां गिरिशप्रियाम् /
गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्त्ते विल्वके नीलपर्वते //
text_mt: Standing before her, she should pray to that goddess dear to the mountain-dweller: / "At Gaṅgādvāra, Kuśāvarta, Bilvaka, and Nīlaparvata,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā kanakhale devi harariṃ labdhavatī patim /
lalite subhagaṃ devi sukhasaubhāgyadāyini //
meaning:
स्नात्वा कनखले देवि हररिं लब्धवती पतिम् /
ललिते सुभगं देवि सुखसौभाग्यदायिनि //
text_mt: having bathed at Kanakhala, O goddess, you obtained Hari [i.e., Hara] as your husband. / O Lalitā, beautiful goddess, giver of happiness and good fortune!"

sanskrit_iast:
anataṃ dahi saubhāgyemahyaṃ tubhyaṃ namo 'namanaḥ /
mantreṇānena kusumaiśvaṃpakasya suśobhanaiḥ //
meaning:
अनतं दहि सौभाग्येमह्यं तुभ्यं नमो ऽनमनः /
मन्त्रेणानेन कुसुमैश्वंपकस्य सुशोभनैः //
text_mt:
‘Grant me boundless good fortune; homage, homage unto you!’
With this mantra, having duly worshipped [her] with very beautiful campaka flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya vidhivattasyā navaidyaṃ purato nyaset /
trapuṣairapi kūṣmāṇḍairnālikeraiḥ sudāḍimaiḥ //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्तस्या नवैद्यं पुरतो न्यसेत् /
त्रपुषैरपि कूष्माण्डैर्नालिकेरैः सुदाडिमैः //
text_mt:
one should place before her an offering of food,
along with cucumbers, ash gourds, coconuts, fine pomegranates,

sanskrit_iast:
bījapūraiḥ sutuḍīraiḥ kāravallaiḥ sacirbhaṭaiḥ /
phalaistatkālasaṃbhūtaiḥ kṛtvā śobhāṃ tadagrataḥ //
meaning:
बीजपूरैः सुतुडीरैः कारवल्लैः सचिर्भटैः /
फलैस्तत्कालसंभूतैः कृत्वा शोभां तदग्रतः //
text_mt:
citrons, fine tuḍīras, bitter gourds, and cirbhaṭas,
having made an attractive display before her with fruits produced at that season,

sanskrit_iast:
virūḍhadhānyāṅkurakaiḥ sudīpāvalibhistathā /
sāddhai sargaṇakaidhūpaḥ sauhālakakarañjakaiḥ //
meaning:
विरूढधान्याङ्कुरकैः सुदीपावलिभिस्तथा /
साद्धै सर्गणकैधूपः सौहालककरञ्जकैः //
text_mt:
with sprouted grains, and likewise with rows of bright lamps,
with incense along with its accessories, and with sauhālakas and karañjakas,

sanskrit_iast:
guḍapuṣpaiḥ karṇaveṣṭaḍairmodakairupamodakaiḥ /
bahuprakārairnaivedyairyathā vibhavasārataḥ //
meaning:
गुडपुष्पैः कर्णवेष्टडैर्मोदकैरुपमोदकैः /
बहुप्रकारैर्नैवेद्यैर्यथा विभवसारतः //
text_mt:
with guḍapuṣpas, karṇaveṣṭas, modakas, and minor sweets,
with many kinds of offerings of food according to the extent of one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarcya vidhivadrātrau jāgaraṇotsavam /
gītavādyanaṭairnṛtyaiḥ prokṣaṇīyairanekadhā //
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्रात्रौ जागरणोत्सवम् /
गीतवाद्यनटैर्नृत्यैः प्रोक्षणीयैरनेकधा //
text_mt:
Having thus worshipped according to rule, a festival of night vigil
accompanied by songs, instrumental music, actors, dances, and various rites to be displayed—

sanskrit_iast:
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tāṃ rātriṃ prasabhaṃ nayet /
na ca saṃmīlayennetre nārīyāmacatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
सखीभिः सहिता साध्वी तां रात्रिं प्रसभं नयेत् /
न च संमीलयेन्नेत्रे नारीयामचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
together with her female companions, the virtuous woman should spend that night with effort,
and the woman should not close her eyes for the four watches of the night.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhagā duṣkṛtā vandhyā netrasaṃmīlanādbhavet /
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ saritaṃ nayet //
meaning:
दुर्भगा दुष्कृता वन्ध्या नेत्रसंमीलनाद्भवेत् /
एवं जागरणं कृत्वा सप्तम्यां सरितं नयेत् //
text_mt:
From closing her eyes, she would become ill-fated, wicked, and barren.
Having thus kept vigil, on the seventh day she should take [the image] to the river.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpaistathābhyarcya gītavādyapuraḥsaraiḥ /
tacca dadyāddvijendrāya naivedyādi dvijottama //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पैस्तथाभ्यर्च्य गीतवाद्यपुरःसरैः /
तच्च दद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राय नैवेद्यादि द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
Having worshipped with fragrant pastes and flowers preceded by song and instrumental music,
she should give that offering of food and the rest to a noble twice-born, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā gṛhaṃ samāgatya hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ tataḥ /
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा गृहं समागत्य हुत्वा वैश्वानरं ततः /
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च पूजयित्वा सुवासिनीः //
text_mt:
Having bathed, returned home, and then made an offering into the fire,
having worshipped the gods, ancestors, men, and married women,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyakāścaiva saṃbhojya brāhmaṇāndaśa pañca ca /
bhakṣyabhojyairbahuvidhairdatvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ //
meaning:
कन्यकाश्चैव संभोज्य ब्राह्मणान्दश पञ्च च /
भक्ष्यभोज्यैर्बहुविधैर्दत्वा दानानि भूरिशः //
text_mt:
and having fed maidens and fifteen brāhmaṇas
with various kinds of edible foods, and given abundant gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitā me 'stu suprītā ityuktvā tānvisarjayet /
yaḥ kaścidācaredetadvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ param //
meaning:
ललिता मे ऽस्तु सुप्रीता इत्युक्त्वा तान्विसर्जयेत् /
यः कश्चिदाचरेदेतद्व्रतं सौभाग्यदं परम् //
text_mt:
saying, ‘May Lalitā be well pleased with me,’ she should dismiss them.
Whoever performs this foremost vow that grants good fortune—

sanskrit_iast:
naro vā yadi vā nārī tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu /
yadvrataiśca tapobhiśca dānairvā niyamairapi //
meaning:
नरो वा यदि वा नारी तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु /
यद्व्रतैश्च तपोभिश्च दानैर्वा नियमैरपि //
text_mt:
whether a man or a woman—listen to the meritorious fruit thereof.
Whatever is obtained by vows, austerities, gifts, or observances,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeteneha labhyeta kiṃ bahūktena nārada /
mṛteranantaraṃ prāpya śivalokaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
तदेतेनेह लभ्येत किं बहूक्तेन नारद /
मृतेरनन्तरं प्राप्य शिवलोकं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
all that is obtained in this world by this [vow]; why say more, O Nārada?
After death, having attained the eternal world of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
modate lalitādevyā śaive vai sakhivacciram /
nabhasye māsi yā śuklā ṣaṣṭhī sā candanāhvayā //
meaning:
मोदते ललितादेव्या शैवे वै सखिवच्चिरम् /
नभस्ये मासि या शुक्ला षष्ठी सा चन्दनाह्वया //
text_mt:
she rejoices for a long time like a companion of the goddess Lalitā in the realm of Śiva.
The bright sixth day in the month of Bhādrapada is known as Candanā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya labhate tatsalokatām /
rohiṇī pātabhaumaistu saṃyutā kapilā bhavet //
meaning:
तस्यां देवीं समभ्यर्च्य लभते तत्सलोकताम् /
रोहिणी पातभौमैस्तु संयुता कपिला भवेत् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the goddess on it, one attains her world.
Joined with Rohiṇī, Pāta, and Tuesday, [a lunar day] becomes Kapilā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ raviṃ samabhyarcya vratī niyamatatparaḥ /
labhate vāñchitānkāmānbhāskarasya prasādataḥ //
meaning:
तस्यां रविं समभ्यर्च्य व्रती नियमतत्परः /
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामान्भास्करस्य प्रसादतः //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the Sun on that day, the observer of the vow, intent upon the rules,
attains his desired wishes through the grace of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
annadānaṃ japo homaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam /
sarvamevākṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ kṛtaṃ devarṣisattama //
meaning:
अन्नदानं जपो होमं पितृदेवर्षितर्पणम् /
सर्वमेवाक्षयं ज्ञेयं कृतं देवर्षिसत्तम //
text_mt:
Gift of food, recitation, fire oblation, and libations to ancestors and divine seers—
all performed [then] is to be known as imperishable, O best of divine seers.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāṃ dhenumabhyarcya vastramālyānule panaiḥ /
pradadyādvedaviduṣe dvādaśātmapratuṣṭaye //
meaning:
कपिलां धेनुमभ्यर्च्य वस्त्रमाल्यानुले पनैः /
प्रदद्याद्वेदविदुषे द्वादशात्मप्रतुष्टये //
text_mt:
Having worshipped a brown cow with garments, garlands, and ointments,
one should give it to a knower of the Vedas for the pleasure of the Twelve-formed [Sun].

sanskrit_iast:
atheṣuśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu pūjyā kātyāyanī dvija /
gandhādyairmaṅgaladravyairnaivedyairvividhaistathā //
meaning:
अथेषुशुक्लषष्ठ्यां तु पूज्या कात्यायनी द्विज /
गन्धाद्यैर्मङ्गलद्रव्यैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैस्तथा //
text_mt:
Now, on the bright sixth day of Āśvina, Kātyāyanī is to be worshipped, O twice-born,
with auspicious items such as fragrant pastes, and likewise with various offerings of food.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣamāpya deveśīṃ praṇipatya visarjayet /
pūjyātra saikatī mūrtiryadvā dvijasatī mudā //
meaning:
ततः क्षमाप्य देवेशीं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् /
पूज्यात्र सैकती मूर्तिर्यद्वा द्विजसती मुदा //
text_mt:
Then, asking forgiveness of the queen of gods and bowing down, one should bid farewell to her.
An image made of sand is to be worshipped here, or a twice-born virtuous woman with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrālaṅkaraṇairbhavyaiḥ kātyāyinyāḥ pratuṣṭaye /
kanyā varaṃ prāpnuyācca vāñcitaṃ putramaṅganā //
meaning:
वस्त्रालङ्करणैर्भव्यैः कात्यायिन्याः प्रतुष्टये /
कन्या वरं प्राप्नुयाच्च वाञ्चितं पुत्रमङ्गना //
text_mt:
with splendid garments and ornaments, for the pleasure of Kātyāyanī.
A maiden will obtain a desired husband, and a woman a son,

sanskrit_iast:
kātyāyinīprasādādvai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
kārtike śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu ṣaṇmukhena mahātmanā //
meaning:
कात्यायिनीप्रसादाद्वै नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
कार्तिके शुक्लषष्ठ्यां तु षण्मुखेन महात्मना //
text_mt:
through the grace of Kātyāyinī; no doubt should be entertained here.
On the bright sixth day of Kārttika, by the great-souled six-faced one (Skanda),

sanskrit_iast:
devasenā mahābhāgā labdhā sarvusurārpitā /
atastasyāṃ suraśreṣṭhāṃ devasenāṃ ca ṣaṇmukham //
meaning:
देवसेना महाभागा लब्धा सर्वुसुरार्पिता /
अतस्तस्यां सुरश्रेष्ठां देवसेनां च षण्मुखम् //
text_mt:
the highly fortunate Devasenā was obtained, given by all the gods.
Therefore, having worshipped the foremost of goddesses, Devasenā, and the six-faced one on that day,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya nikhilaireva upacārairmanoharaiḥ /
prāpnuyādatulāṃ siddhiṃ manobhīṣṭāṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
संपूज्य निखिलैरेव उपचारैर्मनोहरैः /
प्राप्नुयादतुलां सिद्धिं मनोभीष्टां द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
with all delightful services,
one will attain matchless success desired by the mind, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva vahnipūjoktāṃ tāṃ ca sampaksamācaret /
vividhadravyahomaiśca vahnipūjāpuraḥ saram //
meaning:
अत्रैव वह्निपूजोक्तां तां च सम्पक्समाचरेत् /
विविधद्रव्यहोमैश्च वह्निपूजापुरः सरम् //
text_mt:
Right here, worship of the fire is proclaimed, and one should perform it properly,
preceded by worship of fire with oblations of various substances.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe śaklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ nihatastārakāsuraḥ /
skandena satkṛtiḥ prāptā brahamādyaiḥ parikalpitā //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे शक्लषष्ठ्यां निहतस्तारकासुरः /
स्कन्देन सत्कृतिः प्राप्ता ब्रहमाद्यैः परिकल्पिता //
text_mt:
On the bright sixth day of Mārgaśīrṣa, the demon Tāraka was slain;
honour arranged by Brahmā and the others was received by Skanda.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'syāṃ pūjayetskandaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ phalaiḥ /
vastrairābhūṣaṇaścāpi naivedyairvividhaistathā //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्यां पूजयेत्स्कन्दं गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैः फलैः /
वस्त्रैराभूषणश्चापि नैवेद्यैर्विविधैस्तथा //
text_mt:
Therefore, on this [day] one should worship Skanda with fragrant pastes, flowers, unbroken grains, and fruits,
with garments and ornaments, and likewise with various offerings of food.

sanskrit_iast:
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tathā śatabhiṣānvitā /
yadi cetsā samuddiṣṭā caṃpāhvā munisattama //
meaning:
रविवारेण संयुक्ता तथा शतभिषान्विता /
यदि चेत्सा समुद्दिष्टा चंपाह्वा मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt:
If it is combined with a Sunday and likewise associated with the Śatabhiṣaj [nakṣatra],
that [day] is designated as Caṃpā, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ viśveśvaro devo draṣṭavyaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ /
pūjanīyo vedanīyaḥ smartavyaḥ saukhyamicchatā //
meaning:
तस्यां विश्वेश्वरो देवो द्रष्टव्यः पापनाशनः /
पूजनीयो वेदनीयः स्मर्तव्यः सौख्यमिच्छता //
text_mt:
On that day, Lord Viśveśvara, the destroyer of sins, should be seen;
he should be worshipped, known, and remembered by one who desires happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
snānadānādikaṃ cātra sarvamakṣayyamucyate /
pauṣamāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ devo dinapatirdvija //
meaning:
स्नानदानादिकं चात्र सर्वमक्षय्यमुच्यते /
पौषमासे शुक्लषष्ठ्यां देवो दिनपतिर्द्विज //
text_mt:
Bathing, giving of gifts, and the like done here is all declared to be imperishable.
On the bright sixth day in the month of Pauṣa, O twice-born, the god who is the lord of day,

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇurūpī jagattrātā pradurbhūtāḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning: विष्णुरूपी जगत्त्राता प्रदुर्भूताः सनातनः //
text_mt: having the form of Viṣṇu, the protector of the universe, the eternal one, became manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasmātpūjanīyo 'syāṃ dravyairgandhapuraskṛtaiḥ /
naivedyairvasttrabhūṣādyaiḥ sarvasaukhyamabhīpsubhiḥ //
meaning:
स तस्मात्पूजनीयो ऽस्यां द्रव्यैर्गन्धपुरस्कृतैः /
नैवेद्यैर्वस्त्त्रभूषाद्यैः सर्वसौख्यमभीप्सुभिः //
text_mt:
Therefore, he should be worshipped on this [day] with substances preceded by fragrant pastes,
with food offerings, garments, ornaments, and the like, by those desiring all happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse sitā ṣaṣṭhī varuṇāhvā smṛtā tu sā /
tasyāṃ varuṇamabhyarcyedviṣṇurūpaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
माघमासे सिता षष्ठी वरुणाह्वा स्मृता तु सा /
तस्यां वरुणमभ्यर्च्येद्विष्णुरूपं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
The bright sixth day in the month of Māgha is remembered as Varuṇā;
on it, one should worship Varuṇa, who has the form of Viṣṇu, the eternal one,

sanskrit_iast:
raktairgandhāṃśukaiḥ puṣpairnaivedyairdhūpadīpakaiḥ /
evamabhyarcya vidhivadyadyaccābhilaṣennaraḥ //
meaning:
रक्तैर्गन्धांशुकैः पुष्पैर्नैवेद्यैर्धूपदीपकैः /
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्यद्यच्चाभिलषेन्नरः //
text_mt:
with red fragrant pastes, garments, flowers, offerings of food, incense, and lamps.
Having thus worshipped according to rule, whatever a person desires,

sanskrit_iast:
tattacca phalato labdhvā modate tatprasādataḥ /
phaālgune śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu devaṃ paśupatiṃ dvija //
meaning:
तत्तच्च फलतो लब्ध्वा मोदते तत्प्रसादतः /
फआल्गुने शुक्लषष्ठ्यां तु देवं पशुपतिं द्विज //
text_mt:
all that he obtains as the fruit, and rejoices through his grace.
On the bright sixth day in Phālguna, O twice-born, Lord Paśupati—

sanskrit_iast:
mṛnmayaṃ vidhinā kṛttvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ /
saṃsnāpya śatarudreṇa pṛthakpañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ //
meaning:
मृन्मयं विधिना कृत्त्वा पूजयेदुपचारकैः /
संस्नाप्य शतरुद्रेण पृथक्पञ्चामृतैर्जलैः //
text_mt:
having fashioned [an image] out of clay according to rule, one should worship [him] with the services,
having bathed [him] with the Śatarudrīya, and separately with the five nectars and water;

sanskrit_iast:
gandhairālipya suśvetairakṣataiḥ śvetapuṣpakaiḥ /
bilvapatraiśca dhattūrakusumaiśca phalaistathā //
meaning:
गन्धैरालिप्य सुश्वेतैरक्षतैः श्वेतपुष्पकैः /
बिल्वपत्रैश्च धत्तूरकुसुमैश्च फलैस्तथा //
text_mt:
having anointed [him] with fragrant pastes, with pure white unbroken grains and white flowers,
with leaves of bilva, flowers of dhattūra, and fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya nānānaivedyairnīrājya vidhivattataḥ /
kṣamāpya praṇipatyainaṃ kailāsāya visarjayet //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य नानानैवेद्यैर्नीराज्य विधिवत्ततः /
क्षमाप्य प्रणिपत्यैनं कैलासाय विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
having worshipped with various offerings of food, and then waved lamps according to rule,
having asked forgiveness and bowed down to him, one should bid him farewell to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛta śivārcastu naro nāryathavā mune /
iha bhuktvā varānbhogānante śivagatiṃ labhet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitaṣaṣṭhīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं कृत शिवार्चस्तु नरो नार्यथवा मुने /
इह भुक्त्वा वरान्भोगानन्ते शिवगतिं लभेत् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितषष्ठीव्रतनिरूपणं नाम पञ्चदशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
A man or a woman who has thus performed the worship of Śiva, O sage,
having enjoyed excellent pleasures in this world, attains the state of Śiva at the end.

Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Vows of the Sixth Lunar Day in the Twelve Months', in the fourth quarter of the major narrative in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi saptamyāste vratānyaham /
yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā sūryasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि सप्तम्यास्ते व्रतान्यहम् /
यानि कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या सूर्यसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Sanātana said:
Listen, O Nārada, I will tell you the vows of the seventh lunar day,
by performing which with devotion a man attains union with the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre tu śuklasaptamyāṃ bahiḥ snānaṃ samācaret /
sthaṇḍile gomayālipte gauramṛttikayāstṛte //
meaning:
चैत्रे तु शुक्लसप्तम्यां बहिः स्नानं समाचरेत् /
स्थण्डिले गोमयालिप्ते गौरमृत्तिकयास्तृते //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh day of Caitra, one should take a bath outdoors.
On a raised mound smeared with cow dung and covered with white clay,

sanskrit_iast:
likhitvāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ vibhāvam /
vinyasetpūrvapatre tu devau dvau kṛtadhātukau //
meaning:
लिखित्वाष्टदलं पद्मं कर्णिकायां विभावम् /
विन्यसेत्पूर्वपत्रे तु देवौ द्वौ कृतधातुकौ //
text_mt:
having drawn an eight-petalled lotus, one should place the radiant [Sun] in the pericarp,
and on the eastern petal two gods who are the Dhātṛs;

sanskrit_iast:
āgneyaṃ ca nyasenpatre gandharvauṃ kṛtakārakau /
dakṣiṇe ca nyasetpatre tathaiva rākṣasadvayam //
meaning:
आग्नेयं च न्यसेन्पत्रे गन्धर्वौं कृतकारकौ /
दक्षिणे च न्यसेत्पत्रे तथैव राक्षसद्वयम् //
text_mt:
on the south-eastern petal one should place two gandharvas as attendants;
and on the southern petal likewise two rākṣasas;

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛtau dvau nyasetpatre nairṛte munisattama /
kādraveyau mahānāgau paścime kṛtacārakau //
meaning:
आकृतौ द्वौ न्यसेत्पत्रे नैरृते मुनिसत्तम /
काद्रवेयौ महानागौ पश्चिमे कृतचारकौ //
text_mt:
one should place two forms on the south-western petal, O best of sages;
two great serpents, offspring of Kadrū, as attendants on the western;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavya yātudhānau dvau uttare ca ṛṣidvayam /
aiśānye vinyasetpatpe grahameko dvijottama //
meaning:
वायव्य यातुधानौ द्वौ उत्तरे च ऋषिद्वयम् /
ऐशान्ये विन्यसेत्पत्पे ग्रहमेको द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
on the north-western two yātudhānas, and on the northern two seers;
on the north-eastern petal one should place a single planet, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ /
dīpairdhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaistāṃbūlakramukādibhiḥ //
meaning:
तेषां संपूजनं कार्यं गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः /
दीपैर्धूपैः सनैवेद्यैस्तांबूलक्रमुकादिभिः //
text_mt:
Their worship should be performed with scents, garlands, and unguents,
with lamps, incenses, food offerings, betel, areca nuts, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjya homaṃ tu ghṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ caret /
sūryasyāṣṭāṣṭa cānyeṣāṃ pradadyādāhutīḥ kramāt //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्य होमं तु घृतेनाष्टशतं चरेत् /
सूर्यस्याष्टाष्ट चान्येषां प्रदद्यादाहुतीः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Having thus worshiped, one should perform a fire oblation of one hundred and eight [offerings] with clarified butter;
one should offer eight oblations in sequence to the sun, and eight to each of the others,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmamantreṇa vedyāṃ vā tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadet /
dakṣiṇā ca tato deyā dvijebhyaḥ śaktito dvija //
meaning:
नाममन्त्रेण वेद्यां वा ततः पूर्णाहुतिं ददेत् /
दक्षिणा च ततो देया द्विजेभ्यः शक्तितो द्विज //
text_mt:
with their name-mantras on the altar, and then offer the final oblation.
Then a sacrificial fee should be given to the twice-born according to one's means, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkṛtvā vidhaānaṃ tu sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt /
dehānte maṇḍalaṃ bhānorbhattvā gacchetparaṃ padam //
meaning:
एतत्कृत्वा विधआनं तु सर्वसौख्यमवाप्नुयात् /
देहान्ते मण्डलं भानोर्भत्त्वा गच्छेत्परं पदम् //
text_mt:
Having performed this rite, one attains every happiness;
at the end of the body, piercing the orb of the sun, one goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhaśuklasaptamyāṃ jahnunā jāhnavī svayam /
krodhātpītā punastyaktā karṇarandhrāttu dakṣiṇāt //
meaning:
वैशाखशुक्लसप्तम्यां जह्नुना जाह्नवी स्वयम् /
क्रोधात्पीता पुनस्त्यक्ता कर्णरन्ध्रात्तु दक्षिणात् //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh of Vaiśākha, the river Jāhnavī [Gaṅgā] herself
was drunk in anger by Jahnu, and released again from his right ear cavity.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tatra pūjayetsnātvā pratyūṣe vimale jale /
gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaiśca sarvairevopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
तां तत्र पूजयेत्स्नात्वा प्रत्यूषे विमले जले /
गन्धपुष्पाक्षताद्यैश्च सर्वैरेवोपचारकैः //
text_mt:
Having bathed at dawn in pure water, one should worship her there
with scents, flowers, unhusked barley, and all the customary services.

sanskrit_iast:
tato ghaṭasahasraṃ tu deyaṃ gaṅgāvrate tvidam /
bhaktyā kṛtaṃ saptakulaṃ nayetsvargamasaṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ततो घटसहस्रं तु देयं गङ्गाव्रते त्विदम् /
भक्त्या कृतं सप्तकुलं नयेत्स्वर्गमसंशयः //
text_mt:
Then, in this observance of Gaṅgā, a thousand jars should be given;
performed with devotion, it leads seven generations to heaven, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kamalavratamapyatra proktaṃ tadvidhirucyate /
tilamātraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ vidhāya kamalaṃ śubham //
meaning:
कमलव्रतमप्यत्र प्रोक्तं तद्विधिरुच्यते /
तिलमात्रं तु सौवर्णं विधाय कमलं शुभम् //
text_mt:
The Lotus Observance is also taught here; its procedure is now told:
making an auspicious lotus of gold, just [the weight of] a sesamum seed,

sanskrit_iast:
vastrayugmāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpādinārcayet /
namaste padmahastāya namaste viśvadhāriṇe //
meaning:
वस्त्रयुग्मावृतं कृत्वा गन्धधूपादिनार्चयेत् /
नमस्ते पद्महस्ताय नमस्ते विश्वधारिणे //
text_mt:
and covering it with a pair of cloths, one should worship it with scents, incense, and the like:
‘Homage to you who hold a lotus in your hand! Homage to you who uphold the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
divākara namastubhyaṃ prabhākara namo 'stu te /
iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ sūrye cāstamupāgate //
meaning:
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमो ऽस्तु ते /
इति संप्रार्थ्य देवेशं सूर्ये चास्तमुपागते //
text_mt:
Homage to you, maker of the day! Homage be to you, maker of light!’
Having thus prayed to the lord of gods, when the sun has set,

sanskrit_iast:
sodakuṃbhaṃ tu tatpadmaṃ kapilāṃ ca dvijer'payet /
taddine tūpavastavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ ca pare 'hani //
meaning:
सोदकुंभं तु तत्पद्मं कपिलां च द्विजेर्ऽपयेत् /
तद्दिने तूपवस्तव्यं भोक्तव्यं च परे ऽहनि //
text_mt:
one should present that lotus along with a water-jar and a brown cow to a twice-born.
One must fast on that day and eat on the next day.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā vratasākalyamāpnuyāt /
nibavrataṃ ca tatreva tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me //
meaning:
संभोज्य ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या व्रतसाकल्यमाप्नुयात् /
निबव्रतं च तत्रेव तद्विधानं शृणुष्व मे //
text_mt:
Having fed the brāhmaṇas with devotion, one attains the complete fruit of the observance.
And right there is the Nimba Observance; hear from me its procedure.

sanskrit_iast:
niṃbapatraiḥ smṛtā pūjā bhāskarasya dvijottama /
khakholkāyeti mantreṇa praṇavādyena nārada //
meaning:
निंबपत्रैः स्मृता पूजा भास्करस्य द्विजोत्तम /
खखोल्कायेति मन्त्रेण प्रणवाद्येन नारद //
text_mt:
Worship of the sun with neem leaves is taught, O best of the twice-born,
with the mantra ‘To Khakholka’, preceded by the praṇava, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
niṃbapatraṃ tato 'śnīyācchayedbhūmau ca vāgyataḥ /
dvijānpare 'hni saṃbhojya svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
निंबपत्रं ततो ऽश्नीयाच्छयेद्भूमौ च वाग्यतः /
द्विजान्परे ऽह्नि संभोज्य स्वयं भुञ्जीत बन्धुभिः //
text_mt:
Then one should eat a neem leaf, and sleep on the ground, restrained in speech.
Having fed the twice-born on the next day, one should eat oneself along with relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
niṃbapatravrataṃ caitatkartṛāṇāṃ sarvasaukhyadam /
saptamī śarkarākhyaiṣā proktā taccāpi me śṛṇu //
meaning:
निंबपत्रव्रतं चैतत्कर्तृआणां सर्वसौख्यदम् /
सप्तमी शर्कराख्यैषा प्रोक्ता तच्चापि मे शृणु //
text_mt:
And this Neem-leaf Observance grants all happiness to its performers.
This seventh day named Śarkarā is taught; hear that also from me.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaṃ pibato hastātsūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ /
niṣpeturbhuvi cotpannāḥ śālimudgayavekṣavaḥ //
meaning:
अमृतं पिबतो हस्तात्सूर्यस्यामृतबिन्दवः /
निष्पेतुर्भुवि चोत्पन्नाः शालिमुद्गयवेक्षवः //
text_mt:
As the sun drank the nectar, drops of nectar fell from his hand
upon the earth, and from them arose winter-rice, mung beans, barley, and sugarcane.

sanskrit_iast:
śarkarā ca tatastasmādikṣusārāmṛtopamā /
iṣṭā raverataḥ puṇyā śarkarā havyakavyayoḥ //
meaning:
शर्करा च ततस्तस्मादिक्षुसारामृतोपमा /
इष्टा रवेरतः पुण्या शर्करा हव्यकव्ययोः //
text_mt:
And from that [came] sugar, comparable to the nectar-essence of sugarcane;
therefore, sugar is dear to the sun and auspicious in offerings to gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
śarkarāsaptamī caiva vājimedhapalapradā /
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanī putrasaṃtativardhinī //
meaning:
शर्करासप्तमी चैव वाजिमेधपलप्रदा /
सर्वदुःखोपशमनी पुत्रसंततिवर्धिनी //
text_mt:
And this Śarkarāsaptamī bestows the fruit of a horse-sacrifice;
it pacifies all sorrows and increases sons and progeny.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāntu śarkarādānaṃ śarkarābhojanaṃ tathā /
kartavyaṃ hi prayatnena vratame tadravipriyam //
meaning:
अस्यान्तु शर्करादानं शर्कराभोजनं तथा /
कर्तव्यं हि प्रयत्नेन व्रतमे तद्रविप्रियम् //
text_mt:
On this [tithi], the gift of sugar as well as the eating of sugar
must be performed with effort; this observance is dear to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kuryātparāyā bhaktyā sa vai sadgatimāpnuyāt /
jyeṣṭhe tu śuklasaptamyāṃ jāta indro raviḥ svayam //
meaning:
यः कुर्यात्पराया भक्त्या स वै सद्गतिमाप्नुयात् /
ज्येष्ठे तु शुक्लसप्तम्यां जात इन्द्रो रविः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Whoever performs it with supreme devotion attains the good realm.
On the bright seventh of Jyeṣṭha, Indra was born as the sun himself.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena sopavāso jitendriyaḥ /
svargatiṃ labhate vipra devendrasya prasādataḥ //
meaning:
तं संपूज्य विधानेन सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः /
स्वर्गतिं लभते विप्र देवेन्द्रस्य प्रसादतः //
text_mt:
Having worshiped him according to rule, fasting and with senses controlled,
one attains a heavenly realm by the grace of the lord of the gods, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ vivasvānnāma bhāskaraḥ /
jātastaṃ tatra saṃprārcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pṛthak //
meaning:
आषाढशुक्लसप्तम्यां विवस्वान्नाम भास्करः /
जातस्तं तत्र संप्रार्च्य गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पृथक् //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh of Āṣāḍha, the sun named Vivasvat
was born; having worshiped him there with scents, flowers, and the like separately,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate sūryasāyujyaṃ viprendrātra na saṃśayaḥ /
śrāvaṇe śuklasaptamyāmavyaṅgākhyaṃ vrataṃ śubham //
kārpāsaṃ tu caturhastaṃ sārddha vastraṃ hi gopateḥ ///
meaning:
लभते सूर्यसायुज्यं विप्रेन्द्रात्र न संशयः /
श्रावणे शुक्लसप्तम्यामव्यङ्गाख्यं व्रतं शुभम् //
कार्पासं तु चतुर्हस्तं सार्द्ध वस्त्रं हि गोपतेः ///
text_mt:
one attains union with the sun, O best of the twice-born, of this there is no doubt.
On the bright seventh of Śrāvaṇa is the auspicious observance named Avyaṅga.

A cotton cloth four cubits long, together with a half-cloth, for the lord of rays [the Sun],

sanskrit_iast: pūjānte prītaye deyaṃ vratametacchubhāvaham //
meaning: पूजान्ते प्रीतये देयं व्रतमेतच्छुभावहम् //
text_mt: should be given at the end of the worship for his pleasure; this observance brings auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi ceddhastayukteyaṃ tadā syātpāpanāśinī /
asyāṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvaṃ cākṣayyatāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
यदि चेद्धस्तयुक्तेयं तदा स्यात्पापनाशिनी /
अस्यां दानं जपो होमः सर्वं चाक्षय्यतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
If this [tithi] is conjoined with the Hasta nakṣatra, then it destroys sins;
giving, recitation, and fire oblation on this day all become imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādre tu śuklasaptamyāmamuktābharaṇavratam /
somasya tu maheśasya pūjanaṃ cātra kīrtitam //
meaning:
भाद्रे तु शुक्लसप्तम्याममुक्ताभरणव्रतम् /
सोमस्य तु महेशस्य पूजनं चात्र कीर्तितम् //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh of Bhādrapada is the Amuktābharaṇa Observance;
and the worship of Soma and Maheśa is proclaimed on this [tithi].

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgādibhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ samarcanam /
prārthya praṇamya visṛjetsarvakāmasamṛddhaye //
meaning:
गङ्गादिभिः षोडशभिरुपचारैः समर्चनम् /
प्रार्थ्य प्रणम्य विसृजेत्सर्वकामसमृद्धये //
text_mt:
Worshiping with the sixteen services, beginning with Gaṅgā [water],
praying, and bowing down, one should dismiss [the deity] for the attainment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
phalasaptamikā ceyaṃ tadvidhānamudīryate /
nālikeraṃ ca vṛntākaṃ nāraṅgaṃ bījapūrakam //
meaning:
फलसप्तमिका चेयं तद्विधानमुदीर्यते /
नालिकेरं च वृन्ताकं नारङ्गं बीजपूरकम् //
text_mt:
And this is the Phalasaptamikā; its procedure is declared:
a coconut, an eggplant, an orange, a citron,

sanskrit_iast:
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bṛhatīpūgamiti sapta phalāni vai /
mahādevasya purato vinyasyāparadorakam //
meaning:
कूष्माण्डं बृहतीपूगमिति सप्त फलानि वै /
महादेवस्य पुरतो विन्यस्यापरदोरकम् //
text_mt:
a white pumpkin, a nightshade, and an areca nut—these seven fruits indeed
having placed before Mahādeva, and also another cord,

sanskrit_iast:
saptatantukṛtaṃ saptagranthiyuktaṃ dvijottama /
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā dhārayedvāmake kare //
meaning:
सप्ततन्तुकृतं सप्तग्रन्थियुक्तं द्विजोत्तम /
संपूज्य परया भक्त्या धारयेद्वामके करे //
text_mt:
made of seven threads and tied with seven knots, O best of the twice-born,
having worshiped it with supreme devotion, a woman should wear it on her left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
strī naro dakṣiṇe caiva yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate /
saṃbhojya viprānsaptaiva pāyasena visṛjyasa tān //
meaning:
स्त्री नरो दक्षिणे चैव यावद्वर्षं समाप्यते /
संभोज्य विप्रान्सप्तैव पायसेन विसृज्यस तान् //
text_mt:
and a man on the right, until the year is completed.
Having fed exactly seven brāhmaṇas with milk-rice and dismissed them,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ bhuñjīta matimān vratasaṃpūrtihetave /
phalāni tāni deyāni saptasvapi dvijeṣu ca //
meaning:
स्वयं भुञ्जीत मतिमान् व्रतसंपूर्तिहेतवे /
फलानि तानि देयानि सप्तस्वपि द्विजेषु च //
text_mt:
the wise one should eat oneself for the purpose of completing the observance.
Those fruits should also be given to seven twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu sapta varṣāṇi kṛtvopāsya yathāvidhi /
sāyujyaṃ labhate vipra mahādevasya tadvratī //
meaning:
एवं तु सप्त वर्षाणि कृत्वोपास्य यथाविधि /
सायुज्यं लभते विप्र महादेवस्य तद्व्रती //
text_mt:
Thus, having performed and worshiped according to rule for seven years,
the keeper of that observance attains union with Mahādeva, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine śuklapakṣe tu vijñeyā śubhasaptamī /
tasyāṃ kṛtasnānapūjo vācayitvā dvijottamān //
meaning:
आश्विने शुक्लपक्षे तु विज्ञेया शुभसप्तमी /
तस्यां कृतस्नानपूजो वाचयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् //
text_mt:
The auspicious seventh is to be known in the bright fortnight of Āśvina.
Having performed bathing and worship on it, and having caused the best of the twice-born to recite blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhya kapilāṅgāṃ ca saṃpūjya prārthayettataḥ /
tvāmahaṃ dadmi kalyāṇi prīyatāmaryamā svayam //
meaning:
आरभ्य कपिलाङ्गां च संपूज्य प्रार्थयेत्ततः /
त्वामहं दद्मि कल्याणि प्रीयतामर्यमा स्वयम् //
text_mt:
and having commenced [the rite] and worshiped the brown cow, one should then pray:
‘I give you, O auspicious one; may Aryaman himself be pleased!

sanskrit_iast:
pālaya tvaṃ jagatkatsnaṃ yato 'si dharmasambhavā /
ityuktvā vedaviduṣe dattvā kṛtvā ca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
पालय त्वं जगत्कत्स्नं यतो ऽसि धर्मसम्भवा /
इत्युक्त्वा वेदविदुषे दत्त्वा कृत्वा च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt:
Protect the entire world, since you are born from dharma.’
Having spoken thus, having given it to one learned in the Veda and offered a sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya svayaṃ vipra visṛjetprāśayetvaravayam /
pacagavyaṃ vrataṃ cetthaṃ vidhāya śvo dvijottamān //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य स्वयं विप्र विसृजेत्प्राशयेत्वरवयम् /
पचगव्यं व्रतं चेत्थं विधाय श्वो द्विजोत्तमान् //
text_mt:
and having personally bowed down, O brāhmaṇa, one should let [her] go, and should drink the five products of the cow.
Having thus performed the observance, on the next day, having fed the best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayitvā svayaṃ cādyāttadannaṃ dvijaśeṣitam /
kṛtaṃ hyetadgataṃ vipra subhāṣyaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
भोजयित्वा स्वयं चाद्यात्तदन्नं द्विजशेषितम् /
कृतं ह्येतद्गतं विप्र सुभाष्यं श्रद्धयान्वितः //
text_mt:
one should oneself eat that food left by the twice-born.
This observance thus performed, O brāhmaṇa, spoken well by one endowed with faith,

sanskrit_iast:
devadevaprasādena bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
atha kārtikaśuklāyāṃ śākākhyaṃ saptamīvratam //
meaning:
देवदेवप्रसादेन भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
अथ कार्तिकशुक्लायां शाकाख्यं सप्तमीव्रतम् //
text_mt:
one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation by the grace of the god of gods.
Now, on the bright [seventh] of Kārtika is the seventh-day observance called Śāka.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu saptaśākānisasvarṇakamalāni ca /
pradadyātsaptaviprebhyaḥ śākāhārastataḥ svayam //
meaning:
तस्यां तु सप्तशाकानिसस्वर्णकमलानि च /
प्रदद्यात्सप्तविप्रेभ्यः शाकाहारस्ततः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
On it one should give seven vegetables along with golden lotuses
to seven twice-born men; then one should oneself eat only vegetables.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye 'hni dvijānbhojya datvā tebhyo 'nnadakṣiṇām /
visṛjya bandhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीये ऽह्नि द्विजान्भोज्य दत्वा तेभ्यो ऽन्नदक्षिणाम् /
विसृज्य बन्धुभिः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt:
On the second day, having fed the twice-born and given them food and a sacrificial fee,
and dismissed them, one should eat oneself along with relatives, restrained in speech.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgasya sitasaptamyāṃ mitravratamudāhṛtam /
yadviṣṇordakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ tadeva kṛtavāniha //
meaning:
मार्गस्य सितसप्तम्यां मित्रव्रतमुदाहृतम् /
यद्विष्णोर्दक्षिणं नेत्रं तदेव कृतवानिह //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh of Mārgaśīrṣa, the Mitra Observance is declared,
which is the right eye of Viṣṇu; precisely that he performed here.

sanskrit_iast:
adityāṃ kaśyapājjajñe mitro nāmā divākaraḥ /
ato 'syāṃ pūjanaṃ tasya yathoktavidhinā dvija //
meaning:
अदित्यां कश्यपाज्जज्ञे मित्रो नामा दिवाकरः /
अतो ऽस्यां पूजनं तस्य यथोक्तविधिना द्विज //
text_mt:
From Kaśyapa upon Aditi was born the sun named Mitra;
therefore, on this [tithi], worship of him [is prescribed] according to the stated rule, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dvijānbhojayitvā saptaiva madhurādinā /
suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam //
meaning:
कृत्वा द्विजान्भोजयित्वा सप्तैव मधुरादिना /
सुवर्णदक्षिणां दत्वा विसृज्याश्नीत च स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Having performed it, having fed seven twice-born with sweets and the like,
having given a gold fee and dismissed them, one should eat oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaitadvidhinā lokaṃ sṛryyasya vrajati dhruvam /
dvijobrāhmaṃ tathā śūdraḥ satkulejanma cāpnuyāt //
meaning:
कृत्वैतद्विधिना लोकं सृर्य्यस्य व्रजति ध्रुवम् /
द्विजोब्राह्मं तथा शूद्रः सत्कुलेजन्म चाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Having performed this according to rule, a twice-born certainly goes to the realm of the sun,
and attains a birth in the world of Brahmā, while a śūdra attains birth in a noble family.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣasya śuklasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ cābhayasaṃjñitam /
upoṣya bhānuṃ triḥsandhyaṃ samabhyarcya dharāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
पौषस्य शुक्लसप्तम्यां व्रतं चाभयसंज्ञितम् /
उपोष्य भानुं त्रिःसन्ध्यं समभ्यर्च्य धरास्थितः //
text_mt:
On the bright seventh of Pauṣa is the observance named Abhaya.
Having fasted, remaining on the ground, having worshiped the sun at the three junctures of the day,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrasiktānnasaṃbaddhaṃ modakaṃ prasthasaṃmitam /
dvijāya datvā bhojyānyānsaptāṣṭabhyaśca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
क्षीरसिक्तान्नसंबद्धं मोदकं प्रस्थसंमितम् /
द्विजाय दत्वा भोज्यान्यान्सप्ताष्टभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt:
having given to a twice-born a sweetmeat measuring a prastha, prepared with food soaked in milk,
and having fed other [brāhmaṇas], [one should give] a fee to seven or eight [of them].

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthavī vā suvarṇaṃ vā visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam /
abhayākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvetatsarvasyābhayadaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
पृथवी वा सुवर्णं वा विसृज्याश्नीत च स्वयम् /
अभयाख्यं व्रतं त्वेतत्सर्वस्याभयदं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Or having given away land or gold, one should eat oneself. / This observance called Abhaya is traditionally regarded as granting freedom from fear to everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍākhyaṃ vrataṃ nāma kathayanti dvijāḥ pare /
ekameveti ca proktamekadaivatayā budhaiḥ //
meaning:
मार्तण्डाख्यं व्रतं नाम कथयन्ति द्विजाः परे /
एकमेवेति च प्रोक्तमेकदैवतया बुधैः //
text_mt: Other twice-born call it the observance named Mārtaṇḍa; / it is declared by the wise to be one and the same because of having the same deity.

sanskrit_iast:
māghe tu kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ sarvāptisaṃjñakam /
samupoṣya dine tasminsampūjyādityabimbakam //
meaning:
माघे तु कृष्णसप्तम्यां व्रतं सर्वाप्तिसंज्ञकम् /
समुपोष्य दिने तस्मिन्सम्पूज्यादित्यबिम्बकम् //
text_mt: On the dark seventh of Māgha, however, there is the observance named Sarvāpti. / Having fasted on that day and fully worshipped the solar disc,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ kṛtvā rātrau ca jāgaram /
pare 'hni viprānsambhojya pāyasena tu sapta vai //
meaning:
सौवर्णं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैः कृत्वा रात्रौ च जागरम् /
परे ऽह्नि विप्रान्सम्भोज्य पायसेन तु सप्त वै //
text_mt: made of gold, with fragrant perfumes, flowers, and the like, and having kept vigil at night, / on the next day having fed seven Brahmins with sweet milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ nālikerāṇi tebhyo datvā guruṃ tataḥ /
sauvarṇaṃ tu raverbimbaṃ yuktaṃ dakṣiṇayā nyayā //
meaning:
दक्षिणां नालिकेराणि तेभ्यो दत्वा गुरुं ततः /
सौवर्णं तु रवेर्बिम्बं युक्तं दक्षिणया न्यया //
text_mt: and having given them a sacrificial gift and coconuts, then to the preceptor / [giving] the golden disc of the sun along with a suitable sacrificial gift,

sanskrit_iast:
samarpya ca bhṛśaṃ prārthya visṛjyādyātsvayaṃ tataḥ /
etatsarvāptidaṃ nāma saṃproktaṃ sārvakāmikam //
meaning:
समर्प्य च भृशं प्रार्थ्य विसृज्याद्यात्स्वयं ततः /
एतत्सर्वाप्तिदं नाम संप्रोक्तं सार्वकामिकम् //
text_mt: and having offered it, pray intensely, bid farewell, and then eat oneself. / This is declared to be the wish-fulfilling one called Sarvāptida [Granting All Attainments].

sanskrit_iast:
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa dvaitaṃ sidhyeddhi sarvathā /
māghasya śuklasaptamyāmacalākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण द्वैतं सिध्येद्धि सर्वथा /
माघस्य शुक्लसप्तम्यामचलाख्यं व्रतं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: By the power of this observance, duality is surely overcome in every way. / On the bright seventh of Māgha, the observance named Acalā is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
trilocanajayantīyaṃ sarvapāpaharā smṛtā /
rathākhyā saptamī ceyaṃ cakravartitvadāyinī //
meaning:
त्रिलोचनजयन्तीयं सर्वपापहरा स्मृता /
रथाख्या सप्तमी चेयं चक्रवर्तित्वदायिनी //
text_mt: This birth-anniversary of the Three-Eyed One is remembered as removing all sins; / and this seventh named Rathā grants sovereign emperorhood.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ samarcya savituḥ pratimāṃ tu haimīṃ haimāśvayuktarathagāṃ tu dadetsahebhām /
yo bhāvabhaktisahitaḥ sa gato hi lokaṃ śambhoḥ sa modata ihāpi ca bhuktabhogaḥ //
meaning:
अस्यां समर्च्य सवितुः प्रतिमां तु हैमीं हैमाश्वयुक्तरथगां तु ददेत्सहेभाम् /
यो भावभक्तिसहितः स गतो हि लोकं शम्भोः स मोदत इहापि च भुक्तभोगः //
text_mt: On this [day], whoever, endowed with devotion of feeling, worships the golden image of the Sun / mounted on a chariot with golden horses, and gives it away along with an elephant, / goes indeed to the world of Śambhu and rejoices here as well, having enjoyed pleasures.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāskarī saptamī ceyaṃ koṭibhāsvadgrahopamā /
aruṇodayavelāyāmasyāṃ snānaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
भास्करी सप्तमी चेयं कोटिभास्वद्ग्रहोपमा /
अरुणोदयवेलायामस्यां स्नानं विधीयते //
text_mt: And this Bhāskarī Saptamī is equal to ten million solar eclipses; / a bath is prescribed on this [day] at the time of dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
arkasya ca badaryāśca sapta sapta dalāni vai /
nidhāya śirasi snāyātsaptajanmāghaśāntaye //
meaning:
अर्कस्य च बदर्याश्च सप्त सप्त दलानि वै /
निधाय शिरसि स्नायात्सप्तजन्माघशान्तये //
text_mt: Having placed seven leaves of the arka plant and seven of the badarī on one's head, / one should bathe for the pacification of sins from seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
putrapradaṃ vrataṃ cātra prāhādityaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ /
yo māghasitaptamyāṃ pūjayenmāṃ vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रप्रदं व्रतं चात्र प्राहादित्यः स्वयं प्रभुः /
यो माघसितप्तम्यां पूजयेन्मां विधानतः //
text_mt: And here the lord Sun himself proclaimed the son-granting observance: / 'Whoever worships me properly on the bright seventh of Māgha,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāhaṃ putratāṃ yāsye svāṃśena bhṛśatoṣitaḥ /
tasmājjitendriyo bhūtvā samupoṣya divāniśam //
meaning:
तस्याहं पुत्रतां यास्ये स्वांशेन भृशतोषितः /
तस्माज्जितेन्द्रियो भूत्वा समुपोष्य दिवानिशम् //
text_mt: to him I shall go into sonhood by a portion of myself, being greatly pleased.' / Therefore, having controlled one's senses, having fasted day and night,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedapare cāhni homaṃ kṛtvā dvijāṃ stataḥ /
dadhyodanena payasā pāyasena ca bhojayet //
meaning:
पूजयेदपरे चाह्नि होमं कृत्वा द्विजां स्ततः /
दध्योदनेन पयसा पायसेन च भोजयेत् //
text_mt: one should worship on the next day, and having performed a fire oblation, then / one should feed twice-born [Brahmins] with curd-rice, milk, and sweet milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yamtu kurute putrasaptamīḥ /
labhate sa tu satputraṃ cirāyuṣamanāmayam //
tapasyaśuklasaptamyāṃ vratamarkapuṭaṃ caret //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यम्तु कुरुते पुत्रसप्तमीः /
लभते स तु सत्पुत्रं चिरायुषमनामयम् //
तपस्यशुक्लसप्तम्यां व्रतमर्कपुटं चरेत् //
text_mt:
Whoever performs the Putrasaptamī according to this rule / obtains an excellent son who is long-lived and free from illness.

On the bright seventh of Tapasya [Phālguna], one should observe the Arkapuṭa rite.

sanskrit_iast: arkapatrairyajedarkamarkapatrāṇi cāśnuyāt //
meaning: अर्कपत्रैर्यजेदर्कमर्कपत्राणि चाश्नुयात् //
text_mt: One should worship the sun with arka leaves, and one should eat [from] arka leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
arkanāma japecchaśvaditthaṃ cārkapuṭavratam /
dhanadaṃ putradaṃ caitatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
अर्कनाम जपेच्छश्वदित्थं चार्कपुटव्रतम् /
धनदं पुत्रदं चैतत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
