text_mt: One should constantly recite the name of the Sun: such is the Arkapuṭa observance. / This grants wealth, grants sons, and destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
trivargadāmiti prāhuḥ kecidetadvataṃ dvija /
yajñavrataṃ tathāpyanye vidhivaddhomakarmaṇā //
meaning:
त्रिवर्गदामिति प्राहुः केचिदेतद्वतं द्विज /
यज्ञव्रतं तथाप्यन्ये विधिवद्धोमकर्मणा //
text_mt: Some say this observance, O twice-born, grants the three aims of life [trivarga]; / others [say it is] a sacrificial observance according to rule through the act of fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsu sarvamāseṣu saptamīṣu dvijottamaḥ /
bhāskarārādhanaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāmikamityalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitasappamīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वासु सर्वमासेषु सप्तमीषु द्विजोत्तमः /
भास्कराराधनं प्रोक्तं सर्वकामिकमित्यलम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितसप्पमीव्रतनिरूपणं नाम षोडशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
On all the sevenths in all the months, O best of the twice-born, / the worship of the Sun is declared to grant all desires. Enough [said].

Thus ends the one hundred and sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Seventh-Day Observances in the Twelve Months', in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the Pūrvabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse bhavānyāḥ procyate janiḥ /
pradakṣiṇaśataṃ kṛtvā kāryo yātrāmahotsavaḥ //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शुक्लाष्टम्यां चैत्रमासे भवान्याः प्रोच्यते जनिः /
प्रदक्षिणशतं कृत्वा कार्यो यात्रामहोत्सवः //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / On the bright eighth in the month of Caitra, the birth of Bhavānī is proclaimed; / having performed a hundred circumambulations, a great pilgrimage festival should be celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ jagadambāyāḥ sarvānandapradaṃ nṛṇām /
atraivāśo kakalikāprāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam //
meaning:
दर्शनं जगदम्बायाः सर्वानन्दप्रदं नृणाम् /
अत्रैवाशो ककलिकाप्राशनं समुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Beholding the Mother of the Universe grants all joy to men. / Right here, the consumption of aśoka buds is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
aśokakalikāścāṣṭau ye pibanti punarvasau /
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ //
meaning:
अशोककलिकाश्चाष्टौ ये पिबन्ति पुनर्वसौ /
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां न ते शोकमवाप्नुयुः //
text_mt: Those who drink eight aśoka buds under [the asterism] Punarvasu / on the bright eighth in the month of Caitra shall not encounter grief.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāṣṭamīti ca proktā devyāḥ pūjāvidhānataḥ /
vaiśākhasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ samupoṣyātra vāriṇā //
meaning:
महाष्टमीति च प्रोक्ता देव्याः पूजाविधानतः /
वैशाखस्य सिताष्टम्यां समुपोष्यात्र वारिणा //
text_mt: It is declared to be the Mahāṣṭamī through the prescribed worship of the goddess. / On the bright eighth of Vaiśākha, having fasted on this [day], with water

sanskrit_iast:
snātvāparājitāṃ devīṃ māṃsībālakavāribhiḥ /
snāpayitvārcya gandhādyairnaivedyaṃ śarkarāmayam //
meaning:
स्नात्वापराजितां देवीं मांसीबालकवारिभिः /
स्नापयित्वार्च्य गन्धाद्यैर्नैवेद्यं शर्करामयम् //
text_mt: having bathed, and having bathed the goddess Aparājitā with water containing spikenard and bālaka, / having worshipped her with perfumes and the like, [and offered] food-offering made of sugar,

sanskrit_iast:
kumārīrbhojayeccāpi navamyāṃ pāraṇāgrataḥ /
jyotirmayavimānena bhrājamāno yathā raviḥ //
meaning:
कुमारीर्भोजयेच्चापि नवम्यां पारणाग्रतः /
ज्योतिर्मयविमानेन भ्राजमानो यथा रविः //
text_mt: one should also feed young maidens on the ninth before the breaking of the fast. / Shining like the sun in a luminous aerial chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
lokeṣu vicaredvipra devyāścaiva prasādataḥ /
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāse pūjayitvā trilocanam //
meaning:
लोकेषु विचरेद्विप्र देव्याश्चैव प्रसादतः /
कृष्णाष्टम्यां ज्येष्ठमासे पूजयित्वा त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: one would wander through the worlds, O twice-born, by the grace of the goddess. / Having worshipped the Three-Eyed One on the dark eighth in the month of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ /
jyeṣṭhaśukle tathāṣṭamyāṃ yo devīṃ pūjayennaraḥ //
meaning:
शिवलोके वसेत्कल्पं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः /
ज्येष्ठशुक्ले तथाष्टम्यां यो देवीं पूजयेन्नरः //
text_mt: one dwells in the world of Śiva for an eon, bowed to by all the gods. / Likewise, whatever man worships the goddess on the bright eighth of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vimānena carati gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ /
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tathā'ṣāḍhe snātvā caiva niśāṃbunā //
meaning:
स विमानेन चरति गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणैः /
शुक्लाष्टम्यां तथाऽषाढे स्नात्वा चैव निशांबुना //
text_mt: he travels in an aerial chariot with hosts of gandharvas and apsarases. / Likewise, having bathed on the bright eighth in Āṣāḍha with water [kept overnight],

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva snāpayeddevīṃ pūjayecca vidhānataḥ /
tataḥ śuddhajalaiḥ snāpya viliṃpetseṃducandanaiḥ //
meaning:
तेनैव स्नापयेद्देवीं पूजयेच्च विधानतः /
ततः शुद्धजलैः स्नाप्य विलिंपेत्सेंदुचन्दनैः //
text_mt: with that very [water] one should bathe the goddess and worship her according to rule. / Then, having bathed her with pure waters, one should smear her with sandalwood combined with camphor.

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaṃ śarkaropetaṃ datvā'camanamarpayet /
bhojayitvā tato viprāndatvā svarṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
नैवेद्यं शर्करोपेतं दत्वाऽचमनमर्पयेत् /
भोजयित्वा ततो विप्रान्दत्वा स्वर्णं च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: Having presented a food-offering accompanied by sugar, one should offer water for sipping. / Then, having fed the Brahmins and given gold as a sacrificial gift,

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya ca tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ /
etadvrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā devīlokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
विसृज्य च ततः पश्चात्स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः /
एतद्व्रतं नरः कृत्वा देवीलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: and having bidden them farewell, one should afterwards eat oneself, restrained in speech. / Having performed this observance, a man attains the world of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhaḥśukletathāṣṭamyāṃ devīmiṣṭvā vidhānataḥ /
kṣīreṇa snāpayitvā ca miṣṭānnaṃ vinivedayet //
meaning:
नभःशुक्लेतथाष्टम्यां देवीमिष्ट्वा विधानतः /
क्षीरेण स्नापयित्वा च मिष्टान्नं विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Likewise, on the bright eighth of Nabhas [Śrāvaṇa], having worshipped the goddess according to rule, / and having bathed her with milk, one should offer sweet food.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvijān bhojayitvā pare 'hni svayamapyuta /
bhuktvā samāpayedadvrataṃ saṃtativardhanam //
meaning:
ततो द्विजान् भोजयित्वा परे ऽह्नि स्वयमप्युत /
भुक्त्वा समापयेदद्व्रतं संततिवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Then, having fed the twice-born on the next day, and having eaten oneself too, / one should conclude this observance that increases offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhomāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ daśāphalamiti vratam /
upavāsaṃ tu saṃkalpya snātvā kṛtvā ca naityikam //
meaning:
नभोमासे सिताष्टम्यां दशाफलमिति व्रतम् /
उपवासं तु संकल्प्य स्नात्वा कृत्वा च नैत्यिकम् //
text_mt: On the bright eighth in the month of Nabhas, there is the observance called Daśāphala. / Having undertaken a fast, having bathed and performed daily rites,

sanskrit_iast:
tulasyāḥ kṛṣṇāvarṇāyā dalairdaśabhirarcayet /
kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathānantaṃ govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam //
meaning:
तुलस्याः कृष्णावर्णाया दलैर्दशभिरर्चयेत् /
कृष्णं विष्णुं तथानन्तं गोविन्दं गरुडध्वजम् //
text_mt: with ten leaves of dark tulasī one should worship / Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, and Ananta, Govinda, Garuḍadhvaja,

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ hariṃ prabhum /
etaiśca nāmabhirnityaṃ kṛṣṇadevaṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
दामोदरं हृषीकेशं पद्मनाभं हरिं प्रभुम् /
एतैश्च नामभिर्नित्यं कृष्णदेवं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Dāmodara, Hṛṣīkeśa, Padmanābha, and Lord Hari; / with these names one should daily worship Lord Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇasamanvitam /
evaṃ daśadinaṃ kuryādvratānāmuttamaṃ vratam //
meaning:
नमस्कारं ततः कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणसमन्वितम् /
एवं दशदिनं कुर्याद्व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् //
text_mt: Then one should perform obeisance accompanied by circumambulation. / In this way one should perform this best of observances for ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau madhye tathā cānte homaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ /
kṛṣṇamantreṇa juhuyāccaruṇāṣṭottaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
आदौ मध्ये तथा चान्ते होमं कुर्याद्विधानतः /
कृष्णमन्त्रेण जुहुयाच्चरुणाष्टोत्तरं शतम् //
text_mt: At the beginning, in the middle, and at the end, one should perform a fire oblation according to rule; / one should offer an oblation of sacrificial boiled rice a hundred and eight times with the Kṛṣṇa-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
homānte vidhinā samyagācāryyaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ /
sauvarṇe tāmrapātre vā mṛnmaye veṇupātrake //
meaning:
होमान्ते विधिना सम्यगाचार्य्यं पूजयेत्सुधीः /
सौवर्णे ताम्रपात्रे वा मृन्मये वेणुपात्रके //
text_mt: At the end of the fire oblation, the wise person should properly worship the preceptor according to rule. / In a vessel of gold, or of copper, or of clay, or of bamboo,

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīdalaṃ suvarṇena kārayitvā sulakṣaṇam /
haimīṃ ca pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तुलसीदलं सुवर्णेन कारयित्वा सुलक्षणम् /
हैमीं च प्रतिमां कृत्वा पूजयित्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: having had a tulasī leaf fashioned out of gold with auspicious marks, / and having made a golden image and worshipped it according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya pratimāṃ pātre hyācāryāya nivedayet /
dātavyā gauḥ savatsā ca vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitā //
meaning:
निधाय प्रतिमां पात्रे ह्याचार्याय निवेदयेत् /
दातव्या गौः सवत्सा च वस्त्रालङ्कारभूषिता //
text_mt: having placed the image in the vessel, he should present it to the preceptor. / A cow with her calf should also be given, adorned with garments and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhaṃ kṛṣṇadevāya pūrikā daśa cārpayet /
tāśca dadyādvidhijñāya svayaṃ vā bhakṣayedvratī //
meaning:
दशाहं कृष्णदेवाय पूरिका दश चार्पयेत् /
ताश्च दद्याद्विधिज्ञाय स्वयं वा भक्षयेद्व्रती //
text_mt: For ten days, one should offer ten pūrikā cakes to Lord Kṛṣṇa; / and the observer of the vow should give them to one who knows the ritual, or eat them himself.

sanskrit_iast:
śayanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ yathāśakti dvijottama /
daśame 'hni tato mūrtiṃ sadravyāṃ guraver'payet //
meaning:
शयनं च प्रदातव्यं यथाशक्ति द्विजोत्तम /
दशमे ऽह्नि ततो मूर्तिं सद्रव्यां गुरवेर्ऽपयेत् //
text_mt: And a bed should be given according to one's ability, O best of the twice-born. / Then on the tenth day, he should present the image with wealth to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
vratānte daśaviprebhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa pūrikāḥ /
dadyādeva daśābdaṃ tu kṛtvā vratamanuttamam //
meaning:
व्रतान्ते दशविप्रेभ्यः प्रत्येकं दश पूरिकाः /
दद्यादेव दशाब्दं तु कृत्वा व्रतमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: At the end of the observance, he should give ten pūrikās to each of ten Brahmins; / having performed this peerless observance for ten years,

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya vidhinā bhūyātsarvakā masamanvitaḥ /
ante kṛṣṇasya sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
उपोष्य विधिना भूयात्सर्वका मसमन्वितः /
अन्ते कृष्णस्य सायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: having fasted according to rule, he becomes endowed with all desires; / at the end, he attains union with Kṛṣṇa; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī ceyaṃ smṛtā pāpaharā nṛṇām /
kevalenopavāsena tasmiñjanmadine hareḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णजन्माष्टमी चेयं स्मृता पापहरा नृणाम् /
केवलेनोपवासेन तस्मिञ्जन्मदिने हरेः //
text_mt: And this Kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī is remembered as destroying the sins of men; / by merely fasting on that birthday of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ /
upavāsī tilaiḥ snāto nadyādau vimale jale //
meaning:
सप्तजन्मकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः /
उपवासी तिलैः स्नातो नद्यादौ विमले जले //
text_mt: one is freed from sins committed in seven births, there is no doubt here. / Fasting, having bathed with sesame seeds in clear water of a river or similar place,

sanskrit_iast:
sudeśe maṇḍape kḷpte maṇḍalaṃ racayetsudhīḥ /
tanmadhye kalaśaṃ sthāpya tāmrajaṃ vāpi mṛnmayam //
meaning:
सुदेशे मण्डपे कॢप्ते मण्डलं रचयेत्सुधीः /
तन्मध्ये कलशं स्थाप्य ताम्रजं वापि मृन्मयम् //
text_mt: the wise one should draw a sacred diagram in a pavilion constructed in an auspicious spot; / placing a pot made of copper or earthenware in its center,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari nyasetpātraṃ tāmraṃ tasyopari sthitām /
haimīṃ vastrayugācchannāṃ kṛṣṇasya pratimāṃ śubham //
meaning:
तस्योपरि न्यसेत्पात्रं ताम्रं तस्योपरि स्थिताम् /
हैमीं वस्त्रयुगाच्छन्नां कृष्णस्य प्रतिमां शुभम् //
text_mt: above it he should place a copper vessel; resting upon that, / an auspicious golden image of Kṛṣṇa covered with a pair of garments.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyādyairupacāraistu pūjayetsnigdhamānasaḥ /
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandameva ca //
meaning:
पाद्याद्यैरुपचारैस्तु पूजयेत्स्निग्धमानसः /
देवकीं वसुदेवं च यशोदां नन्दमेव च //
text_mt: He should worship with offerings such as water for the feet, his mind affectionate, / and [he should worship] Devakī, Vasudeva, Yaśodā, and Nanda,

sanskrit_iast:
vrajaṃ gopāṃstathā gopīrgāśca dikṣu samarcayet /
tata ārārtikaṃ kṛtvā kṣamāpyānamya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
व्रजं गोपांस्तथा गोपीर्गाश्च दिक्षु समर्चयेत् /
तत आरार्तिकं कृत्वा क्षमाप्यानम्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: and he should worship Vraja, the cowherds, the cowherd women, and the cattle in the directions; / then, having performed the lustration of lights, asking forgiveness and bowing with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhettathaivārddharātre punaḥ saṃsnāpayeddharim /
pañcāmṛtaiḥ śuddhajalairgandhādyaiḥ pūjayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
तिष्ठेत्तथैवार्द्धरात्रे पुनः संस्नापयेद्धरिम् /
पञ्चामृतैः शुद्धजलैर्गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: he should remain thus; at midnight he should bathe Hari again / with the five nectars and pure waters, and worship him again with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyākaṃ ca yavānīṃ ca śuṇṭhīṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca nārada /
sājyaṃ raupye dhṛtaṃ pātre naivedyaṃ vinivedayet //
meaning:
धान्याकं च यवानीं च शुण्ठीं खण्डं च नारद /
साज्यं रौप्ये धृतं पात्रे नैवेद्यं विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Coriander, ajwain, dried ginger, and raw sugar, O Nārada, / placed with ghee in a silver vessel, he should present as food offering.

sanskrit_iast:
punarārārtikaṃ kṛtvā daśadhā rūpadhāriṇam /
vicintayanmṛgāṅkāya dadyādarghyaṃ samudyate //
meaning:
पुनरारार्तिकं कृत्वा दशधा रूपधारिणम् /
विचिन्तयन्मृगाङ्काय दद्यादर्घ्यं समुद्यते //
text_mt: Having performed the lustration of lights again, contemplating him / who assumes ten forms, he should offer water of hospitality to the moon as it rises.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṣamāpya deveśaṃ rātrikhaṇḍaṃ nayedvratī /
paurāṇikaiḥ stotrapāṭhairgītavādyairanekadhā //
meaning:
ततः क्षमाप्य देवेशं रात्रिखण्डं नयेद्व्रती /
पौराणिकैः स्तोत्रपाठैर्गीतवाद्यैरनेकधा //
text_mt: Then, having asked forgiveness of the lord of gods, the observer of the vow should pass the rest of the night / with recitations of Puranic hymns and with diverse songs and musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte vipragryānbhojayenmadhurānnakaiḥ /
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo visṛjettuṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते विप्रग्र्यान्भोजयेन्मधुरान्नकैः /
दत्वा च दक्षिणां तेभ्यो विसृजेत्तुष्टमानसः //
text_mt: Then, in the morning, he should feed the foremost of brahmins with sweet foods, / and having given them a priestly gift, he should dismiss them, joyful in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ svarṇadhenudharānvitām /
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyāśrīta ca svayam //
meaning:
ततस्तां प्रतिमां विष्णोः स्वर्णधेनुधरान्विताम् /
गुरवे दक्षिणां दत्वा विसृज्याश्रीत च स्वयम् //
text_mt: Then, having given that image of Viṣṇu, accompanied by a golden cow and land, / and a priestly gift to the teacher, and having dismissed him, he himself should eat.

sanskrit_iast:
dārāpatyasuhṛdbhṛtyarevaṃ kṛtvā vrata naraḥ /
sākṣādgokamāpnoti vimānavaramāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
दारापत्यसुहृद्भृत्यरेवं कृत्वा व्रत नरः /
साक्षाद्गोकमाप्नोति विमानवरमास्थितः //
text_mt: Having performed this observance along with his wife, children, friends, and servants, a man / attains Goloka directly, seated upon an excellent celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
naitena sadṛśaṃ cānyadvratamasti jagattraye /
kṛtena yena labhyeta koṭyaikādaśakaṃ phalam //
meaning:
नैतेन सदृशं चान्यद्व्रतमस्ति जगत्त्रये /
कृतेन येन लभ्येत कोट्यैकादशकं फलम् //
text_mt: There is no other observance equal to this in the three worlds, / through the performance of which one would obtain the fruit of a crore of Ekādaśīs.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ nabhasyasya kuryādrādhāvrataṃ naraḥ /
pūrvavadrādhikāṃ haimīṃ kalaśasthāṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां नभस्यस्य कुर्याद्राधाव्रतं नरः /
पूर्ववद्राधिकां हैमीं कलशस्थां प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: On the bright eighth day of the month of Bhādrapada, a man should observe the Rādhā vow; / as before, he should worship golden Rādhikā placed on a water-pot.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne pūjayitvenāmekabhaktaṃ samāpayet /
śakto bhaktaścopavāsaṃ pare 'hni vidhinā tataḥ //
meaning:
मध्याह्ने पूजयित्वेनामेकभक्तं समापयेत् /
शक्तो भक्तश्चोपवासं परे ऽह्नि विधिना ततः //
text_mt: Having worshipped her at midday, he should complete a single meal, / or, if capable and devoted, a fast, and on the next day according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
suvāsinīrbhojayitvā gurave pratimārpaṇam /
kṛtvā svayaṃ ca bhuñjītaṃ vratamevaṃ samāpayet //
meaning:
सुवासिनीर्भोजयित्वा गुरवे प्रतिमार्पणम् /
कृत्वा स्वयं च भुञ्जीतं व्रतमेवं समापयेत् //
text_mt: having fed married women whose husbands are living, / having offered the image to the teacher, he himself should eat, and thus complete the observance.

sanskrit_iast:
vratenānena viprarṣe kṛtena vidhinā vratī /
rahasyaṃ goṣṭhajaṃ labdhvā rādhāparikare vaset //
meaning:
व्रतेनानेन विप्रर्षे कृतेन विधिना व्रती /
रहस्यं गोष्ठजं लब्ध्वा राधापरिकरे वसेत् //
text_mt: Through this observance performed according to rule, O brahmin-sage, the observer of the vow, / having attained the secret of the cowherd station, dwells among the retinue of Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ cātra kathitaṃ tacca me śṛṇu /
śucau deśe prajātāyāṃ dvarvāyāṃ dvijasattama //
meaning:
दूर्वाष्टमीव्रतं चात्र कथितं तच्च मे शृणु /
शुचौ देशे प्रजातायां द्वर्वायां द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: The Dūrvāṣṭamī observance is also declared here; hear that from me: / on dūrvā grass that has grown in a pure spot, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpya liṅgaṃ tato gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpakaiḥ /
naivedyairarcayedbhaktyā dadhyakṣataphalādibhiḥ //
meaning:
स्थाप्य लिङ्गं ततो गन्धैः पुष्पैर्धूपैश्च दीपकैः /
नैवेद्यैरर्चयेद्भक्त्या दध्यक्षतफलादिभिः //
text_mt: having installed a liṅga, he should then worship it with devotion using perfumes, flowers, incenses, and lamps, / food offerings, curd, unhusked rice grains, fruits, and other items.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyaṃ pradadyātpūjānte mantrābhyāṃ susamāhitaḥ /
tvaṃ dūrve 'mṛtajanmāsi surāsuranamaskṛte //
meaning:
अर्घ्यं प्रदद्यात्पूजान्ते मन्त्राभ्यां सुसमाहितः /
त्वं दूर्वे ऽमृतजन्मासि सुरासुरनमस्कृते //
text_mt: At the conclusion of the worship, he should offer water of honour with very concentrated mind using two mantras: / 'O Dūrvā, you were born from nectar, honoured by gods and asuras;

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ dehi sarvakāryakarī bhava /
yathā śākhā praśākhābhirvistṛtāsi mahītale //
meaning:
सौभाग्यं संततिं देहि सर्वकार्यकरी भव /
यथा शाखा प्रशाखाभिर्विस्तृतासि महीतले //
text_mt: Grant good fortune and offspring; accomplish all undertakings! / Just as you have spread over the surface of the earth with branches and minor branches,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vistṛtasaṃtānaṃ dehi me 'pyajarāmaram /
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya viprānsaṃbhojya tatra vai //
meaning:
तथा विस्तृतसंतानं देहि मे ऽप्यजरामरम् /
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य विप्रान्संभोज्य तत्र वै //
text_mt: So grant me an extensive lineage that is ageless and immortal.' / Then, having circumambulated [it] and fed the brāhmaṇas there,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā svayaṃ gṛhaṃ gacchedatvā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām /
phalāni ca praśastāni miṣṭāni surabhīṇi ca //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा स्वयं गृहं गच्छेदत्वा विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् /
फलानि च प्रशस्तानि मिष्टानि सुरभीणि च //
text_mt: He should eat himself and go home after giving priestly fees to the brāhmaṇas, / As well as auspicious, sweet, and fragrant fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ puṇyā pāpaharā nṛṇā dūrvāṣṭamī dvija /
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ strījanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
एवं पुण्या पापहरा नृणा दूर्वाष्टमी द्विज /
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां स्त्रीजनानां विशेषतः //
text_mt: Thus the Dūrvāṣṭamī brings merit and removes sins for men, O twice-born one, / And for all four castes, especially for women.

sanskrit_iast:
yā na pūjayate dūrvā nārī mohādyathāvidhi /
janmāni trīṇi vaidhavyaṃ labhate sā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
या न पूजयते दूर्वा नारी मोहाद्यथाविधि /
जन्मानि त्रीणि वैधव्यं लभते सा न संशयः //
text_mt: The woman who, through delusion, does not worship Dūrvā according to the rules, / Suffers widowhood for three births; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā jyeṣṭharkṣasaṃyuktā bhavecjaivāṣṭabhī dvija /
jyeṣṭhā nāmnī tu sā jñeyā pūjitā pāpanāśinī //
meaning:
यदा ज्येष्ठर्क्षसंयुक्ता भवेच्जैवाष्टभी द्विज /
ज्येष्ठा नाम्नी तु सा ज्ञेया पूजिता पापनाशिनी //
text_mt: When the eighth lunar day is conjoined with the constellation Jyeṣṭhā, O twice-born one, / It is known by the name Jyeṣṭhā; when worshipped, it destroys sins.

sanskrit_iast:
athaināṃ tu samārabhya vrataṃ ṣoḍaśavāsaram /
mahālakṣmyāḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvasaṃpadvivardhanam //
meaning:
अथैनां तु समारभ्य व्रतं षोडशवासरम् /
महालक्ष्म्याः समुद्दिष्टं सर्वसंपद्विवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Beginning on this day, a sixteen-day vow / Of Mahālakṣmī is prescribed, which increases all prosperity:

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣye 'haṃ mahālakṣmīvrataṃ te tvatparāyaṇaḥ /
tadavighnena me yātu samāptiṃ tvatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
करिष्ये ऽहं महालक्ष्मीव्रतं ते त्वत्परायणः /
तदविघ्नेन मे यातु समाप्तिं त्वत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt: 'Devoted to you, I will perform your Mahālakṣmī-vow; / May it reach completion without obstacles through your grace.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya tato baddhā ḍoraka dakṣiṇe kare /
ṣoḍaśagranthisahitaṃ guṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam //
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य ततो बद्धा डोरक दक्षिणे करे /
षोडशग्रन्थिसहितं गुणैः षोडशभिर्युतम् //
text_mt: Having recited this, he should tie on his right hand a cord / Having sixteen knots and made of sixteen threads.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'nvahaṃ mahālakṣmīṃ gandhādyairarccayedvratī /
yāvatkṛṣṇāṣṭamī tatra caredudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽन्वहं महालक्ष्मीं गन्धाद्यैरर्च्चयेद्व्रती /
यावत्कृष्णाष्टमी तत्र चरेदुद्यापनं सुधीः //
text_mt: Then, day after day, the observer of the vow should worship Mahālakṣmī with perfumes and the like / Until the dark eighth lunar day; on that day the wise one should perform the concluding rite.

sanskrit_iast:
vastramaṇḍapikāṃ kṛtvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale /
kalaśaṃ supratiṣṭhāpya dīpamuddyotayettataḥ //
meaning:
वस्त्रमण्डपिकां कृत्वा सर्वतोभद्रमण्डले /
कलशं सुप्रतिष्ठाप्य दीपमुद्द्योतयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Having made a cloth pavilion on a sarvatobhadra diagram / And properly installed a pot, he should then light a lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
uttārya ḍorakaṃ bāhoḥ kuṃbhasyādho nivedayet /
catasraḥ pratimāḥ kṛtvā sauvarṇīstatsvarūpiṇīḥ //
meaning:
उत्तार्य डोरकं बाहोः कुंभस्याधो निवेदयेत् /
चतस्रः प्रतिमाः कृत्वा सौवर्णीस्तत्स्वरूपिणीः //
text_mt: Taking the cord off his arm, he should place it under the pot. / Having made four golden images representing her form,

sanskrit_iast:
snapanaṃ kārayettāsāḥ jalaiḥ pañcāmṛtaistathā /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
स्नपनं कारयेत्तासाः जलैः पञ्चामृतैस्तथा /
उपचारैः षोडशभिः पूजयित्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: He should bathe them with waters and with the five nectars, / And having worshipped [them] according to the rules with the sixteen services,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgarastatra kartavyo gītavāditraniḥ svanaiḥ /
tato niśīthe saṃprāpte 'bhyudite 'mṛtadīdhitau //
meaning:
जागरस्तत्र कर्तव्यो गीतवादित्रनिः स्वनैः /
ततो निशीथे संप्राप्ते ऽभ्युदिते ऽमृतदीधितौ //
text_mt: A night-vigil should be kept there with the sounds of songs and musical instruments. / Then, when midnight has arrived and the moon has risen,

sanskrit_iast:
datvārghyaṃ bandhanaṃ dravyaiḥ śrīkhaṇḍādyairvidhānataḥ /
candramaṇḍalasaṃsthāyai mahālakṣyai pradāpayet //
meaning:
दत्वार्घ्यं बन्धनं द्रव्यैः श्रीखण्डाद्यैर्विधानतः /
चन्द्रमण्डलसंस्थायै महालक्ष्यै प्रदापयेत् //
text_mt: Having properly offered water of honour and a fastening with substances such as sandalwood, / He should have it offered to Mahālakṣmī seated in the lunar disc:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta mahālakṣmīsahodara /
pīyūṣadhāma rohiṇyāḥ sahitār'ghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me //
meaning:
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूत महालक्ष्मीसहोदर /
पीयूषधाम रोहिण्याः सहितार्ऽघ्यं गृहाण मे //
text_mt: 'O one born from the ocean of milk, uterine brother of Mahālakṣmī, / O abode of nectar, united with Rohiṇī, accept my water of honour!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodārṇavasambhūte kamale kamalālaye /
viṣṇuvakṣasthalasthe me sarvakāmapradā bhava //
meaning:
क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भूते कमले कमलालये /
विष्णुवक्षस्थलस्थे मे सर्वकामप्रदा भव //
text_mt: O one born from the ocean of milk, O Kamala, O Kamalālayā! / O you who dwell on the chest of Viṣṇu, grant all my desires!

sanskrit_iast:
ekanāthe jagannāthe jamadagnipriye 'vyaye /
reṇuke trāhi māṃ devi rāmamātaḥ śivaṃ kuru //
meaning:
एकनाथे जगन्नाथे जमदग्निप्रिये ऽव्यये /
रेणुके त्राहि मां देवि राममातः शिवं कुरु //
text_mt: O sole mistress, O mistress of the universe, O beloved of Jamadagni, O imperishable one! / O goddess Reṇukā, protect me! O mother of Rāma, bring about auspiciousness!'

sanskrit_iast:
mantrairetairmahālakṣmīṃ prārthya śrotriyayoṣitaḥ /
samyaksaṃpūjya tāḥ samyaggandhayāvakakajjalaiḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रैरेतैर्महालक्ष्मीं प्रार्थ्य श्रोत्रिययोषितः /
सम्यक्संपूज्य ताः सम्यग्गन्धयावककज्जलैः //
text_mt: Having prayed to Mahālakṣmī with these mantras, having properly honoured the wives of Vedic scholars / Correctly with perfume, red lac-dye, and collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya juhuyādagnau bilvapadmakapāyasaiḥ /
tadalābhe ghṛtairvipra gṛhebhyaḥ samidhastilān //
meaning:
संभोज्य जुहुयादग्नौ बिल्वपद्मकपायसैः /
तदलाभे घृतैर्विप्र गृहेभ्यः समिधस्तिलान् //
text_mt: And having fed them, he should make fire oblations with wood-apple, lotus, and milk-rice, / Or in their absence, O twice-born one, with clarified butter, fuel sticks, and sesame seeds taken from households.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuñjayāya ca paraṃ sarvarogapraśāntaye /
candanaṃ tālapatraṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ tathākṣatān //
meaning:
मृत्युञ्जयाय च परं सर्वरोगप्रशान्तये /
चन्दनं तालपत्रं च पुष्पमालां तथाक्षतान् //
text_mt: And for Mṛtyuñjaya, for the total pacification of all diseases, [he should offer] / Sandalwood, palm leaf, a garland of flowers, and unbroken grains,

sanskrit_iast:
durvāṃ kausumbhasūtraṃ ca yugaṃ śrīphalameva vā /
bhakṣyāṇi ca nave śūrpe pratidravyaṃ tu ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
दुर्वां कौसुम्भसूत्रं च युगं श्रीफलमेव वा /
भक्ष्याणि च नवे शूर्पे प्रतिद्रव्यं तु षोडश //
text_mt: Dūrvā grass, a safflower-coloured thread, a pair [of garments], or wood-apples, / And sixteen edibles of each substance in a new winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast:
samācchādyānyaśūrpeṇa vratī dadyātsamantrakam /
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūtā lakṣmīścandrasahodarā //
meaning:
समाच्छाद्यान्यशूर्पेण व्रती दद्यात्समन्त्रकम् /
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूता लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रसहोदरा //
text_mt: Covering it with another winnowing basket, the observer of the vow should give it accompanied by the mantra: / 'May Lakṣmī, born from the ocean of milk, sister of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
vratenānena saṃtuṣṭā bhavatādviṣṇuvallabhā /
cetasraḥ pratimāstāstu śrotriyebhyaḥ samarpayet //
meaning:
व्रतेनानेन संतुष्टा भवताद्विष्णुवल्लभा /
चेतस्रः प्रतिमास्तास्तु श्रोत्रियेभ्यः समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: And beloved of Viṣṇu, be pleased by this vow!' / He should present those four images to Vedic scholars.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu caturo viprān ṣoḍaśāpi suvāsinīḥ /
miṣṭānnenāśayitvā tu visṛjettāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु चतुरो विप्रान् षोडशापि सुवासिनीः /
मिष्टान्नेनाशयित्वा तु विसृजेत्ताः सदक्षिणाः //
text_mt: Then, having fed four brāhmaṇas and also sixteen married women whose husbands are living / With sweet food, he should dismiss them with priestly fees.

sanskrit_iast:
samāptiniyamaḥ paścādbhañjīteṣṭaiḥ samanvitaḥ /
etadvrataṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ kṛtvā vipra vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
समाप्तिनियमः पश्चाद्भञ्जीतेष्टैः समन्वितः /
एतद्व्रतं महालक्ष्म्याः कृत्वा विप्र विधानतः //
text_mt: Having concluded the observances, he should later eat together with his cherished ones. / Having performed this vow of Mahālakṣmī according to rule, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktveṣṭānaihikān kāmāṃllakṣmīloke vasecciram /
eṣāṣokāṣṭamī coktā yasyāṃ pūrṇaṃ ramāvratam //
meaning:
भुक्त्वेष्टानैहिकान् कामांल्लक्ष्मीलोके वसेच्चिरम् /
एषाषोकाष्टमी चोक्ता यस्यां पूर्णं रमाव्रतम् //
text_mt: He enjoys his desired worldly wishes and dwells for a long time in the world of Lakṣmī. / This is also called Aśokāṣṭamī, on which Ramā's vow is completed.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāśokasya pūjā syādekabhaktaṃ tathā smṛtam /
kṛtvāśokavrataṃ nārī hyaśokā śokajanmani //
meaning:
अत्राशोकस्य पूजा स्यादेकभक्तं तथा स्मृतम् /
कृत्वाशोकव्रतं नारी ह्यशोका शोकजन्मनि //
text_mt: Worship of the Aśoka tree should take place here, and taking only a single meal is prescribed. / Having performed the Aśoka vow, a woman becomes free from grief in an existence of grief,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra kutrāpi saṃjātā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
āśvine śuklapakṣe tu proktā vipra mahāṣṭamī //
meaning:
यत्र कुत्रापि संजाता नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
आश्विने शुक्लपक्षे तु प्रोक्ता विप्र महाष्टमी //
text_mt: Wherever she may be born; there should be no doubt about this. / The bright eighth lunar day of Āśvina is declared to be Mahāṣṭamī, O twice-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra durgācanaṃ proktaṃ savrairapyupacārakaiḥ /
upavāsaṃ caikabhaktaṃ mahāṣṭamyāṃ vidhāya tu //
meaning:
तत्र दुर्गाचनं प्रोक्तं सव्रैरप्युपचारकैः /
उपवासं चैकभक्तं महाष्टम्यां विधाय तु //
text_mt: Worship of Durgā with all services is prescribed on that day. / Having observed a fast and a single meal on Mahāṣṭamī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato vibhavaṃ prāpya modate devavacciram /
ūrjje kṛṣṇādike 'ṣṭamyāṃ karakākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
सर्वतो विभवं प्राप्य मोदते देववच्चिरम् /
ऊर्ज्जे कृष्णादिके ऽष्टम्यां करकाख्यं व्रतं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: He attains glory in every respect and rejoices for a long time like a god. / In the month of Kārttika, on the dark eighth lunar day, the vow named Karaka is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
tatromāsahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ /
candrodayer'ghadānaṃ ca vidheyaṃ vratibhiḥ sadā //
meaning:
तत्रोमासहितः शंभुः पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः /
चन्द्रोदयेर्ऽघदानं च विधेयं व्रतिभिः सदा //
text_mt: There Śambhu accompanied by Umā should be worshipped with effort, / And offering water of honour at moonrise must always be performed by those observing the vow

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ sarvaguṇopetamicchadbhirvividhaṃ sukham /
gopāṣṭamīti saṃproktā kārtike dhavale dale //
meaning:
पुत्रं सर्वगुणोपेतमिच्छद्भिर्विविधं सुखम् /
गोपाष्टमीति संप्रोक्ता कार्तिके धवले दले //
text_mt: Who desire a son endowed with all good qualities and diverse happiness. / It is called Gopāṣṭamī in the bright half of Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrakuryādgavāṃ pūjāṃ gogrāsaṃ gopradakṣiṇām /
gavānugamanaṃ dānaṃ vāñchansarvāśca saṃpadaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रकुर्याद्गवां पूजां गोग्रासं गोप्रदक्षिणाम् /
गवानुगमनं दानं वाञ्छन्सर्वाश्च संपदः //
text_mt: There one desiring all prosperity should perform the worship of cows, the feeding of a mouthful of grass to a cow, circumambulation of cows, / Following cows, and the gift [of cows].

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe mithunaṃ darbhanirmitam /
anaghāṃ cānaghāṃ tatra bahuputrasamanvitam //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां मार्गशीर्षे मिथुनं दर्भनिर्मितम् /
अनघां चानघां तत्र बहुपुत्रसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: On the dark eighth lunar day in Mārgaśīrṣa, having set up a couple made of darbha grass, / Anagha and Anaghā accompanied by many sons,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā śubhe deśe gomayenopalepite /
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ //
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा शुभे देशे गोमयेनोपलेपिते /
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरुपचारैः पृथग्विधैः //
text_mt: In an auspicious place smeared with cow dung, / He should worship them with perfumes, flowers, and the like, with various kinds of services.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya dvijadāṃpatyaṃ visṛjellabdhadakṣiṇam /
vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā nārī vā vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
संभोज्य द्विजदांपत्यं विसृजेल्लब्धदक्षिणम् /
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा नारी वा विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having fed a brāhmaṇa couple, he should dismiss them after they have received priestly fees. / Having performed this vow according to the rules, a man or a woman

sanskrit_iast: putraṃ sallakṣaṇopetaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning: पुत्रं सल्लक्षणोपेतं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Obtains a son endowed with auspicious marks; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgāśīrṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ kālabhairavasannidau /
upoṣya jāgaraṃ kṛtvā mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
मार्गाशीर्षसिताष्टम्यां कालभैरवसन्निदौ /
उपोष्य जागरं कृत्वा महापापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having fasted and kept a night-vigil in the presence of Kālabhairava on the bright eighth lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa, / One is freed from great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiñcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣajanmani /
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kālabhairavadarśanāt //
meaning:
यत्किञ्चिदशुभं कर्म कृतं मानुषजन्मनि /
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति कालभैरवदर्शनात् //
text_mt: Whatever inauspicious deed was done in human birth / All dissolves away from the sight of Kālabhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
atha pauṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhamaṣṭakasaṃjñitam /
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ varṣaṃ kulasantativarddhanam //
meaning:
अथ पौषसिताष्टम्यां श्राद्धमष्टकसंज्ञितम् /
पितॄणां तृप्तिदं वर्षं कुलसन्ततिवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: Now, on the bright eighth lunar day of Pauṣa, the ancestral rite named Aṣṭakā [is performed], / Which brings satisfaction to the ancestors for a year and increases family lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu pauṣasya śivaṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ /
bhuktimuktimavāpnoti bhaktimekāṃ samācaran //
meaning:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां तु पौषस्य शिवं सम्पूज्य भक्तितः /
भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नोति भक्तिमेकां समाचरन् //
text_mt: Having worshipped Śiva with devotion on the bright eighth lunar day of Pauṣa, / Practising single-minded devotion, he attains enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu māghasya bhadrakālīṃ samarcayet /
bhaktito vairivṛndaghnīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु माघस्य भद्रकालीं समर्चयेत् /
भक्तितो वैरिवृन्दघ्नीं सर्वकामप्रदायिनीम् //
text_mt: On the dark eighth lunar day of Māgha, he should worship Bhadrakālī with devotion, / The slayer of host of enemies, who bestows all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīṣmaṃ saṃtarpayaddvija /
saṃtatiṃ tvavyavacchinnāmicchaṃścāpyaparājayam //
meaning:
माघमासे सिताष्टम्यां भीष्मं संतर्पयद्द्विज /
संततिं त्वव्यवच्छिन्नामिच्छंश्चाप्यपराजयम् //
text_mt: On the bright eighth lunar day in the month of Māgha, O twice-born one, one desiring unbroken lineage / And invincibility should make a water offering to Bhīṣma.

sanskrit_iast:
phaālgune tvasitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīprāṃ devīṃ samarcayet /
tatra vrataparo vipra sarvakāmasamṛddhaye //
meaning:
फआल्गुने त्वसिताष्टम्यां भीप्रां देवीं समर्चयेत् /
तत्र व्रतपरो विप्र सर्वकामसमृद्धये //
text_mt: On the dark eighth lunar day in Phālguna, intent on the vow on that day, O twice-born one, / He should worship the goddess Bhīmā for the fulfilment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ phaālgunasya śivaṃ cāpi śivāṃ dvija /
gandhādyaiḥ samyagabhyarcya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet //
meaning:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां फआल्गुनस्य शिवं चापि शिवां द्विज /
गन्धाद्यैः सम्यगभ्यर्च्य सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् //
text_mt: On the bright eighth lunar day of Phālguna, having properly worshipped Śiva and Śivā / With perfumes and other articles, O twice-born one, he becomes the master of all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
phaālgunāparapakṣe tu śītalāmaṣṭamīdine /
pūjayetsarvavapakkānaiḥ saptamyāṃ vidhivatkṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
फआल्गुनापरपक्षे तु शीतलामष्टमीदिने /
पूजयेत्सर्ववपक्कानैः सप्तम्यां विधिवत्कृतैः //
text_mt: In the dark fortnight of Phālguna, on the day of the eighth lunar day, / He should worship Śītalā with all cooked foods prepared properly on the seventh lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
śītale tvaṃ jaganmātā śītale tvaṃ jagatpitā /
śītale tvaṃ jagadvātrī śītalāyai namonamaḥ //
meaning:
शीतले त्वं जगन्माता शीतले त्वं जगत्पिता /
शीतले त्वं जगद्वात्री शीतलायै नमोनमः //
text_mt: "O Śītalā, you are the mother of the universe; O Śītalā, you are the father of the universe. / O Śītalā, you are the sustainer of the universe; salutations, salutations to Śītalā!"

sanskrit_iast:
vande 'haṃ śītalāṃ devīṃ rāsabhasthāṃ digaṃbarām /
mārjanī kalaśopetāṃ visphoṭakavināśinīm //
meaning:
वन्दे ऽहं शीतलां देवीं रासभस्थां दिगंबराम् /
मार्जनी कलशोपेतां विस्फोटकविनाशिनीम् //
text_mt: "I praise the goddess Śītalā, mounted upon a donkey, sky-clad, / equipped with a broom and a water-pot, the destroyer of smallpox."

sanskrit_iast:
śītale śītale cetthaṃ ye japanti jale lthitāḥ //ṭha
teṣāṃ tu śītalā devī syādvisphoṭakaśāntidā //
meaning:
शीतले शीतले चेत्थं ये जपन्ति जले ल्थिताः //ठ
तेषां तु शीतला देवी स्याद्विस्फोटकशान्तिदा //
text_mt: Those who, standing in water, thus recite: "O Śītalā, O Śītalā," / to them the goddess Śītalā will grant relief from smallpox.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ śītalāmantrairyaḥ samarcayate dvija /
tasya varṣaṃ bhavecchāntiḥ śītalāyāḥ prasādataḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं शीतलामन्त्रैर्यः समर्चयते द्विज /
तस्य वर्षं भवेच्छान्तिः शीतलायाः प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Whoever thus properly worships with Śītalā's mantras, O twice-born one, / to him peace will come for a year by the grace of Śītalā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāsobhaye pakṣe vidhivaccāṣṭamīdine /
śivāṃ vāpiśivaṃ prārcyalabhate vāñchitaṃ phalam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitāṣṭamīvratakathanaṃ nāma saptadaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वमासोभये पक्षे विधिवच्चाष्टमीदिने /
शिवां वापिशिवं प्रार्च्यलभते वाञ्छितं फलम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थिताष्टमीव्रतकथनं नाम सप्तदशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
In every month, in both fortnights, on the eighth day according to rule, / having properly worshipped Śivā or Śiva, one attains the desired fruit.

Thus ends the one hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Vrata of the Eighth Day Standing in the Twelve Months," in the Fourth Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
atha vakṣyāmi viprendra navamyāste vratāni vai /
yāni kṛtvā narā loke labhante vāñchitaṃ phalam //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
अथ वक्ष्यामि विप्रेन्द्र नवम्यास्ते व्रतानि वै /
यानि कृत्वा नरा लोके लभन्ते वाञ्छितं फलम् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Now I shall declare to you, O best of sages, the observances of the ninth [tithi], / by performing which men in this world obtain their desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrasya śuklapakṣe tu śrīrāmanavamīvratam /
tatropavāsaṃ vidhivacchakto bhaktaḥ samācaret //
meaning:
चैत्रस्य शुक्लपक्षे तु श्रीरामनवमीव्रतम् /
तत्रोपवासं विधिवच्छक्तो भक्तः समाचरेत् //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of Caitra occurs the Śrīrāmanavamī observance; / there, a capable devotee should properly observe a fast.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktaścaikabhaktaṃ vai madhyāhnotsavataḥ param /
viprānsaṃbhojya miṣṭānnai rāmaprīti sumācaret //
meaning:
अशक्तश्चैकभक्तं वै मध्याह्नोत्सवतः परम् /
विप्रान्संभोज्य मिष्टान्नै रामप्रीति सुमाचरेत् //
text_mt: One who is incapable should eat only one single meal after the midday festival; / having fed brāhmaṇas with sweet foods, he should generate Rāma's delight.

sanskrit_iast:
gobhūtilahariraṇyādyervastrālaṅkaraṇestathā /
eva yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śrīrāmanavamīvratam //
meaning:
गोभूतिलहरिरण्याद्येर्वस्त्रालङ्करणेस्तथा /
एव यः कुरुते भक्त्या श्रीरामनवमीव्रतम् //
text_mt: With cows, land, sesame, gold, and the like, as well as with garments and ornaments, / he who thus performs the Śrīrāmanavamī observance with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhūya cehapāpāni vraje dviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam /
uktaṃ mātṛvrataṃ cātra bhairaveṇa samanvitāḥ //
meaning:
विधूय चेहपापानि व्रजे द्विष्णोः परं पदम् /
उक्तं मातृव्रतं चात्र भैरवेण समन्विताः //
text_mt: having shaken off sins here, goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / And here the Mātṛvrata accompanied by Bhairava is spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
sraggandhavasranamanaivedyaiścatuḥṣṭistu yoginīḥ /
atraiva bhadrakālo tu yoginīnāṃ mahābalā //
meaning:
स्रग्गन्धवस्रनमनैवेद्यैश्चतुःष्टिस्तु योगिनीः /
अत्रैव भद्रकालो तु योगिनीनां महाबला //
text_mt: With garlands, scents, garments, obeisances, and food offerings [one worships] the sixty-four Yoginīs; / right here, Bhadrakālī, of great strength among the Yoginīs,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāsāmādhipatye 'bhiṣecitā /
tasmāttāṃ pūjayeccātra sopavāso jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठः सर्वासामाधिपत्ये ऽभिषेचिता /
तस्मात्तां पूजयेच्चात्र सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: is consecrated into sovereignty over all of them, O best of brāhmaṇas; / therefore, one should worship her here, fasting and with senses controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhe navamyāṃ dalayoścaṇḍikāṃ yastu pūjayet /
vidhinā sa vimānena devataiḥ saha modate //
meaning:
राधे नवम्यां दलयोश्चण्डिकां यस्तु पूजयेत् /
विधिना स विमानेन देवतैः सह मोदते //
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, on the ninth of both fortnights, whoever worships Caṇḍikā / according to rule, rejoices together with the deities in a celestial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaśuklanavamyāṃ tu sopavāso narottamaḥ /
umāṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatkumārīrbhojayeddvijān //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठशुक्लनवम्यां तु सोपवासो नरोत्तमः /
उमां संपूज्य विधिवत्कुमारीर्भोजयेद्द्विजान् //
text_mt: On the ninth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, an excellent man, fasting, / having worshipped Umā according to rule, should feed maidens and brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
svabhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā śālyannaṃ payasāśnuyāt /
umāvratamidaṃ vipra yaḥ kuryādvidhivannaraḥ //
meaning:
स्वभक्त्या दक्षिणां दत्वा शाल्यन्नं पयसाश्नुयात् /
उमाव्रतमिदं विप्र यः कुर्याद्विधिवन्नरः //
text_mt: Having given a priestly fee according to his devotion, he should eat rice with milk. / The man who performs this observance of Umā according to rule, O brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhuktveha varānbhogānante svargagatiṃ labhet /
āṣāḍhe māsi viprendra yaḥ kuryātpakṣayordvija //
meaning:
स भुक्त्वेह वरान्भोगानन्ते स्वर्गगतिं लभेत् /
आषाढे मासि विप्रेन्द्र यः कुर्यात्पक्षयोर्द्विज //
text_mt: having enjoyed excellent pleasures here, attains heavenly status at the end. / In the month of Āṣāḍha, O best of brāhmaṇas, whoever in both fortnights, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ caindrīṃ samabhyarcyedairāvatagatāṃ sitām /
sa bhavedvai valoke tu bhogabhāragdevayānagaḥ //
meaning:
नक्तं चैन्द्रीं समभ्यर्च्येदैरावतगतां सिताम् /
स भवेद्वै वलोके तु भोगभारग्देवयानगः //
text_mt: observing a night-fast, worships white Aindrī riding upon Airāvata, / will indeed partake of enjoyments in her world, travelling in a divine vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe māsi viprendra yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam /
pakṣayorupavāsaṃ vā kaumārīṃ caṇḍikāṃ yajet //
meaning:
श्रावणे मासि विप्रेन्द्र यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् /
पक्षयोरुपवासं वा कौमारीं चण्डिकां यजेत् //
text_mt: In the month of Śrāvaṇa, O best of brāhmaṇas, whoever eats only at night / or fasts in both fortnights, should worship Caṇḍikā as Kaumārī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pāpaharāṃ gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpakaiḥ /
naivedyairvividhaiścaiva kumārībhojanaistathā //
meaning:
एवं पापहरां गन्धैः पुष्पैर्धूपैश्च दीपकैः /
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैश्चैव कुमारीभोजनैस्तथा //
text_mt: Thus, [he worships] the destroyer of sins with scents, flowers, incense, lamps, / various offerings of food, and likewise by feeding maidens.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā kaumārīvratamuttamam /
sa vimānena gacchedvai devīlokaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या कौमारीव्रतमुत्तमम् /
स विमानेन गच्छेद्वै देवीलोकं सनातनम् //
text_mt: He who thus performs with devotion the excellent Kaumārī observance / goes indeed by celestial chariot to the eternal world of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādre tu navamī śuklā nandāhvā parikīrtitā /
tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayeddurgāṃ vidhivaccopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
भाद्रे तु नवमी शुक्ला नन्दाह्वा परिकीर्तिता /
तस्यां यः पूजयेद्दुर्गां विधिवच्चोपचारकैः //
text_mt: In Bhādrapada, the bright ninth is known by the name Nandā; / on it, whoever worships Durgā according to rule with ritual offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labdhvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate /
āśvine śuklanavamī mahāpūrvā prakīrtitā //
meaning:
सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लब्ध्वा विष्णुलोके महीयते /
आश्विने शुक्लनवमी महापूर्वा प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt: obtaining the fruit of a horse sacrifice, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / In Āśvina, the bright ninth is proclaimed as the Mahānavamī.

sanskrit_iast:
aparāhne śamīpūjā kāryāsyāṃ prāgdiśi dvija /
tato niśāyāṃ prāgyāme khaḍgaṃ dhanuriṣūngadām //
meaning:
अपराह्ने शमीपूजा कार्यास्यां प्राग्दिशि द्विज /
ततो निशायां प्राग्यामे खड्गं धनुरिषून्गदाम् //
text_mt: In the afternoon of this day, the worship of the śamī tree is to be performed in the eastern direction, O twice-born one; / then at night, in the first watch, [worshipping] the sword, bow, arrows, mace,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ chirikāṃ carma kheṭakam /
chatraṃ dhvajaṃ gajaṃ cāśva govṛṣaṃ pustakaṃ tulām //
meaning:
शूलं शक्तिं च परशुं छिरिकां चर्म खेटकम् /
छत्रं ध्वजं गजं चाश्व गोवृषं पुस्तकं तुलाम् //
text_mt: spear, lance, axe, dagger, hide, shield, / parasol, banner, elephant, horse, cow, bull, book, scales,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ cakraśaṅkhau gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ /
saṃpūjya mahiṣaṃ tatra bhadrakālyai samālabhet //
meaning:
दण्डं पाशं चक्रशङ्खौ गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः /
संपूज्य महिषं तत्र भद्रकाल्यै समालभेत् //
text_mt: staff, noose, discus, and conch with ritual offerings such as perfumes, / having worshipped them, one should then sacrifice a buffalo to Bhadrakālī:

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ baliṃ vidhāyātha bhuktvā pakkānna meva ca /
dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vrataṃ tatra samāpayet //
meaning:
एवं बलिं विधायाथ भुक्त्वा पक्कान्न मेव च /
द्विजेभ्यो दक्षिणां दत्वा व्रतं तत्र समापयेत् //
text_mt:
Having thus offered the oblation, eaten cooked food,
and given sacrificial gifts to the twice-born, one should conclude the observance there.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayeddurgāṃ nṝṇāṃ durgatināśinīm /
iha bhuktvā varānbhogānante svargatimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एवं यः पूजयेद्दुर्गां नॄणां दुर्गतिनाशिनीम् /
इह भुक्त्वा वरान्भोगानन्ते स्वर्गतिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
He who thus worships Durgā, who destroys the misfortunes of mortals,
enjoys excellent pleasures in this world and attains heaven in the end.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklanavamī yākṣayā sā prakīrtatā /
tasyāmaśvatthamūle vai tarppaṇaṃ samyagācaret //
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लनवमी याक्षया सा प्रकीर्तता /
तस्यामश्वत्थमूले वै तर्प्पणं सम्यगाचरेत् //
text_mt:
The bright ninth in Kārttika is renowned as Akṣayā;
on it, one should properly perform the water offering at the base of a sacred fig tree.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ cāpi nārada /
svaśākhoktaistathā mantraiḥ sūryāyārghyaṃ tator'payet //
meaning:
देवानां च ऋषीणां च पितॄणां चापि नारद /
स्वशाखोक्तैस्तथा मन्त्रैः सूर्यायार्घ्यं ततोर्ऽपयेत् //
text_mt:
To the gods, the sages, and the ancestors, O Nārada,
and then one should offer an arghya to the sun with the mantras declared in one's own Vedic branch.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvijānbhojayitvā miṣṭānnena munūśvara /
svayaṃ bhuktvā ca vihareddvijebhyo dattadakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततो द्विजान्भोजयित्वा मिष्टान्नेन मुनूश्वर /
स्वयं भुक्त्वा च विहरेद्द्विजेभ्यो दत्तदक्षिणः //
text_mt:
Then, having fed the twice-born with sweet food, O best of sages,
and given sacrificial gifts to the twice-born, one should eat oneself and take one's recreation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā japadānaṃ dvijārcanam /
homaṃ ca sarvamakṣayyaṃ bhavediti vidhervayaḥ //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या जपदानं द्विजार्चनम् /
होमं च सर्वमक्षय्यं भवेदिति विधेर्वयः //
text_mt:
He who thus performs recitation, gift-giving, worship of the twice-born,
and fire oblation with devotion—all this becomes imperishable; such is the word of the creator.

sanskrit_iast:
mārge tu śuklanavamī nandinī parikīrtitā /
tasyāmupoṣito yastu jagadaṃbāṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
मार्गे तु शुक्लनवमी नन्दिनी परिकीर्तिता /
तस्यामुपोषितो यस्तु जगदंबां प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt:
In Mārgaśīrṣa, the bright ninth is celebrated as Nandinī;
he who, having fasted on it, worships the Mother of the Universe

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyaiḥ so 'śvamedhasya phalabhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥ /
pauṣe śuklanavamyāṃ tu mahāmāyāṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैः सो ऽश्वमेधस्य फलभाङ्नात्र संशयः /
पौषे शुक्लनवम्यां तु महामायां प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt:
with fragrances and the rest, shares the fruit of a horse sacrifice—there is no doubt about this.
On the bright ninth in Pauṣa, one should worship Mahāmāyā

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktaparo vipra vājapeyaphalāptaye /
māghamāse tu vā śuklā navamī lokapūjitā //
meaning:
एकभक्तपरो विप्र वाजपेयफलाप्तये /
माघमासे तु वा शुक्ला नवमी लोकपूजिता //
text_mt:
devoted to a single meal, O twice-born, to obtain the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice.
In the month of Māgha, the bright ninth, revered by the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
mahānandeti sā proktā sadānandakarī nṛṇām /
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ japo homa upoṣaṇam //
meaning:
महानन्देति सा प्रोक्ता सदानन्दकरी नृणाम् /
तस्यां स्नानं तथा दानं जपो होम उपोषणम् //
text_mt:
is called Mahānandā; it constantly brings joy to mortals.
On it, bathing, gift-giving, recitation, fire oblation, and fasting—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
phaālgunāmalapakṣasya navamī yā dvijottama //
meaning:
सर्वमक्षयतां याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
फआल्गुनामलपक्षस्य नवमी या द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
all attains imperishability; no doubt should be entertained here.
The ninth of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
ānandā sā mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā smṛtā /
sopavāsor'cayettatra yastvānandāṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
आनन्दा सा महापुण्या सर्वपापहरा स्मृता /
सोपवासोर्ऽचयेत्तत्र यस्त्वानन्दां द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
is remembered as Ānandā, highly meritorious, removing all sins.
He who, fasting, worships Ānandā on that day, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
sa labhedvāñchitānkāmānsatyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitanavamīvratakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स लभेद्वाञ्छितान्कामान्सत्यं सत्यं मयोदितम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितनवमीव्रतकथनं नामाष्टादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
attains his desired wishes; this is spoken by me in truth, in absolute truth.

Thus ends the one hundred and eighteenth chapter in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, entitled "The Account of the Observances of the Ninth Days Occurring in the Twelve Months."

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
atha te 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi daśamyā vai vratāni ca /
yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā dharmarājapriyo bhavet //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
अथ ते ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि दशम्या वै व्रतानि च /
यानि कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या धर्मराजप्रियो भवेत् //
text_mt:
Sanātana said:
Now I shall declare to you the observances of the tenth day,
by performing which with devotion a man becomes dear to the King of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
caitraśuklada śamyāṃ tu dharmarājaṃ prapūjayet /
tatkālasaṃbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairgandhādibhistathā //
meaning:
चैत्रशुक्लद शम्यां तु धर्मराजं प्रपूजयेत् /
तत्कालसंभवैः पुष्पैः फलैर्गन्धादिभिस्तथा //
text_mt:
On the bright tenth of Caitra, one should worship the King of Dharma
with flowers produced in that season, with fruits, and with fragrances and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sopavāso vaikabhakto bhojayitvā dvijottamān /
caturddaśatatastebhyaḥ śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
सोपवासो वैकभक्तो भोजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् /
चतुर्द्दशततस्तेभ्यः शक्त्या दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt:
Fasting or taking a single meal, having fed fourteen
foremost twice-born men, one should then bestow sacrificial gifts upon them according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra dharmarājaprapūjanam /
sa dharmasyājñayāgaccheddevaiḥ sādharmyamacyutaḥ //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र धर्मराजप्रपूजनम् /
स धर्मस्याज्ञयागच्छेद्देवैः साधर्म्यमच्युतः //
text_mt:
He who thus performs the worship of the King of Dharma, O twice-born,
goes, infallible, to shared divinity with the gods by the command of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāṃ mādhave śukle viṣṇumabhyarcya mānavaḥ /
gandhādyairupacāraiśca śvetapuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ //
meaning:
दशम्यां माधवे शुक्ले विष्णुमभ्यर्च्य मानवः /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैश्च श्वेतपुष्पैः सुगन्धिभिः //
text_mt:
On the tenth day of the bright fortnight in Mādhava, having worshipped Viṣṇu
with offerings of fragrances and the like, and with fragrant white flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā vipransaṃbhojya yatnataḥ /
labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
शतं प्रदक्षिणाः कृत्वा विप्रन्संभोज्य यत्नतः /
लभते वैष्णवं लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
having performed a hundred circumambulations and diligently fed the twice-born,
a mortal attains the world of Viṣṇu; no doubt should be entertained here.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhe śukladaśamyāṃ tu jāhnavī saritāṃ varā /
samāyātā dharāṃ svargāttasmātsā puṇyadā smṛtā //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठे शुक्लदशम्यां तु जाह्नवी सरितां वरा /
समायाता धरां स्वर्गात्तस्मात्सा पुण्यदा स्मृता //
text_mt:
On the bright tenth of Jyeṣṭha, the Jāhnavī, best of rivers,
came to earth from heaven; therefore it is remembered as bestowing merit.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaḥ śukladalaṃ hasto budhaśca daśamīḥ tithiḥ /
garānandavyatīpātāḥ kanyenduvṛṣabhāskarāḥ //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठः शुक्लदलं हस्तो बुधश्च दशमीः तिथिः /
गरानन्दव्यतीपाताः कन्येन्दुवृषभास्कराः //
text_mt:
The month of Jyeṣṭha, the bright half, the Hasta asterism, Wednesday, the tenth lunar day,
the Garā division, Ānanda yoga, Vyatīpāta, the moon in Virgo, and the sun in Taurus:

sanskrit_iast:
daśayogaḥ samākhyāto mahāpuṇyatamo dvija /
harate daśa pāpāni tasmāddaśaharaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दशयोगः समाख्यातो महापुण्यतमो द्विज /
हरते दश पापानि तस्माद्दशहरः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
this tenfold conjunction is declared to be most exceedingly meritorious, O twice-born;
it removes ten sins, and therefore it is known as Daśaharā.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ yo jāhnavīṃ prāpya snāti saṃprītamānasaḥ /
vidhinā jāhnavītoye sa yāti harimandiram //
meaning:
अस्यां यो जाह्नवीं प्राप्य स्नाति संप्रीतमानसः /
विधिना जाह्नवीतोये स याति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
He who reaches the Jāhnavī and bathes with a delighted mind
according to the rules in the waters of the Jāhnavī on this day goes to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhaśukladaśamī puṇyā manvā dikaiḥ smṛtā /
tasyāṃ snānaṃ japo dānaṃ homo vā svargatipradāḥ //
meaning:
आषाढशुक्लदशमी पुण्या मन्वा दिकैः स्मृता /
तस्यां स्नानं जपो दानं होमो वा स्वर्गतिप्रदाः //
text_mt:
The bright tenth of Āṣāḍha is remembered by Manu and others as meritorious;
bathing, recitation, gift-giving, or fire oblation on it bestows the heavenly path.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe śukladaśamī sarvāśāparipūrtidā /
asyāṃ śivārcanaṃ śastaṃ gandhādyai rupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
श्रावणे शुक्लदशमी सर्वाशापरिपूर्तिदा /
अस्यां शिवार्चनं शस्तं गन्धाद्यै रुपचारकैः //
text_mt:
The bright tenth in Śrāvaṇa fulfills all desires;
on it, the worship of Śiva with offerings of fragrances and the like is praised.

sanskrit_iast:
tatropavāso naktaṃ vā dvijānāṃ bhojanaṃ japaḥ /
hemno dāna ca dhenvādeḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
तत्रोपवासो नक्तं वा द्विजानां भोजनं जपः /
हेम्नो दान च धेन्वादेः सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt:
A fast on that day, or an evening meal, feeding twice-born men, recitation,
and the donation of gold, cows, and the like destroy all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
atho nabhasyaśuklāyāṃ daśamyāṃ dvijasattama /
vrataṃ daśāvatārākhyaṃ tatra snānaṃ jalāśaye //
meaning:
अथो नभस्यशुक्लायां दशम्यां द्विजसत्तम /
व्रतं दशावताराख्यं तत्र स्नानं जलाशये //
text_mt:
Now, on the bright tenth of Nabhasya, O best of the twice-born,
there is the observance named Daśāvatāra; having bathed there in a body of water,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā saṃdhyādiniyamaṃ devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam /
tato daśāvatārāṇi samabhyarcetsa māhitaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वा संध्यादिनियमं देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् /
ततो दशावताराणि समभ्यर्चेत्स माहितः //
text_mt:
and having performed the twilight observances and water offerings to the gods, sages, and ancestors,
one should then worship the ten incarnations with concentrated mind:

sanskrit_iast:
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam /
rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca bauddhaṃ kalkinameva ca //
meaning:
मत्स्यं कूर्मं वराहं च नरसिंहं त्रिविक्रमम् /
रामं रामं च कृष्णं च बौद्धं कल्किनमेव च //
text_mt:
Matsya, Kūrma, Varāha, Narasiṃha, Trivikrama,
Rāma, Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Buddha, and Kalkin.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamūrtistu sauvarṇīḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ /
daśabhyo vipravaryebhyo dadyātsatkṛtya nārada //
meaning:
दशमूर्तिस्तु सौवर्णीः पूजयित्वा विधानतः /
दशभ्यो विप्रवर्येभ्यो दद्यात्सत्कृत्य नारद //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the ten golden images according to the prescribed rules,
one should honour and give them to ten excellent twice-born men, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaṃ caikabhaktaṃ kṛtvā saṃbhojya vāḍavān /
visṛjya paścādbhuñjīta svayaṃ sveṣṭaiḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
उपवासं चैकभक्तं कृत्वा संभोज्य वाडवान् /
विसृज्य पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत स्वयं स्वेष्टैः समाहितः //
text_mt:
Having observed a fast or taken a single meal, and having fed the Brahmins
and dismissed them, one should eat afterwards oneself with one's dear ones, composed in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā kṛtvā vrataṃ tvetadbhuktvā bhogānihottamān /
vimānena vrajedante viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
भक्त्या कृत्वा व्रतं त्वेतद्भुक्त्वा भोगानिहोत्तमान् /
विमानेन व्रजेदन्ते विष्णुलोकं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
Having performed this observance with devotion and enjoyed excellent pleasures here,
one goes in the end by aerial chariot to the eternal world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine śukladaśamī vijayā sā prakīrtitā /
caturgomayapiṇḍāni prātarnyasya gṛhāṅgaṇe //
meaning:
आश्विने शुक्लदशमी विजया सा प्रकीर्तिता /
चतुर्गोमयपिण्डानि प्रातर्न्यस्य गृहाङ्गणे //
text_mt:
The bright tenth in Āśvina is celebrated as Vijayā.
Having placed four balls of cow-dung in the morning in the courtyard of the house

sanskrit_iast:
cakravālasvarūpeṇa tanmadhye rāmalakṣmaṇau /
tathā bharataśatrughnau pūjayeccaturo 'pi hi //
meaning:
चक्रवालस्वरूपेण तन्मध्ये रामलक्ष्मणौ /
तथा भरतशत्रुघ्नौ पूजयेच्चतुरो ऽपि हि //
text_mt:
in the form of a circle, one should worship in their midst Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa,
as well as Bharata and Śatrughna—all four of them indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
sapidhānāsu pātrīṣu gomayīṣu catasṛṣṭa /
kinnaṃ dhānyaṃ saraupyaṃ tu dhṛtvā dhautāṃśukāvṛtam //
meaning:
सपिधानासु पात्रीषु गोमयीषु चतसृष्ट /
किन्नं धान्यं सरौप्यं तु धृत्वा धौतांशुकावृतम् //
text_mt:
In four cow-dung vessels with lids,
having placed moistened grain along with silver, covered with clean cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛbhrātṛputrajāyā bhṛtyasamanvitam /
saṃpūjyaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyaiśca vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
पितृमातृभ्रातृपुत्रजाया भृत्यसमन्वितम् /
संपूज्यं गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्नैवेद्यैश्च विधानतः //
text_mt:
together with father, mother, brothers, sons, wife, and servants,
one should worship them according to rule with fragrances, flowers, and the like, and food offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtyātha bhuñjīta dvijānsaṃbhojya pūjitān /
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu naro varṣaṃ suravānvitaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्याथ भुञ्जीत द्विजान्संभोज्य पूजितान् /
एवं कृत्वा विधानं तु नरो वर्षं सुरवान्वितः //
text_mt:
Having bowed and fed the worshipped twice-born, one should eat.
Having performed this procedure, a man, accompanied by good heroes

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadhānyasamṛddhaśca niścitaṃ jāyate dvija /
athāpārāhnasamaye navamyāṃ saṃnimantritām //
meaning:
धनधान्यसमृद्धश्च निश्चितं जायते द्विज /
अथापाराह्नसमये नवम्यां संनिमन्त्रिताम् //
text_mt:
and enriched with wealth and grain, is certainly born, O twice-born.
Then, in the afternoon, having approached the śamī tree that was invited on the ninth

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadikṣu śamīṃ vipra gatvā tanmūlajāṃ mṛdam /
gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ prāpya gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वदिक्षु शमीं विप्र गत्वा तन्मूलजां मृदम् /
गृहीत्वा स्वगृहं प्राप्य गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः //
text_mt:
in the eastern direction, O twice-born, and taken earth born from its root,
one should reach one's own house to the sounds of songs and musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya tāṃ vidhānena sajjīkṛtya svakaṃ balam /
nirgatya pūrvadvāreṇa grāmādbrahiranākulaḥ //
meaning:
संपूज्य तां विधानेन सज्जीकृत्य स्वकं बलम् /
निर्गत्य पूर्वद्वारेण ग्रामाद्ब्रहिरनाकुलः //
text_mt:
worship it according to the rule, and equip one's own army;
one should leave the village through the eastern gate unperturbed.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śatrupratikṛtiṃ nirmitāṃ patrakādibhiḥ /
manasā kalpitāṃ vāpi svarṇaṃ puṃravaṃśareṇa vai //
meaning:
ततः शत्रुप्रतिकृतिं निर्मितां पत्रकादिभिः /
मनसा कल्पितां वापि स्वर्णं पुंरवंशरेण वै //
text_mt:
Then, an effigy of the enemy fashioned from leaves and the like,
or conceived mentally, with an arrow made of reed tipped with gold,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhyediti bhṛśaṃ prītaḥ prāpnuyātsvagṛhaṃ niśi /
evaṃ kṛtavidhirvāpi gacchedvā śatrunigrahe //
meaning:
विध्येदिति भृशं प्रीतः प्राप्नुयात्स्वगृहं निशि /
एवं कृतविधिर्वापि गच्छेद्वा शत्रुनिग्रहे //
text_mt:
one should pierce; greatly pleased, one should return to one's house at night.
Or having thus performed the rite, one may march forth to subdue enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣaivaṃ daśamī vipra vidhinā'caritā sadā /
dhanaṃ jayaṃ sutān gāśca gajāśvaṃ vāpyajāvikam //
meaning:
एषैवं दशमी विप्र विधिनाऽचरिता सदा /
धनं जयं सुतान् गाश्च गजाश्वं वाप्यजाविकम् //
text_mt:
This tenth day, O twice-born, thus observed constantly according to the rule,
gives wealth, victory, sons, cattle, elephants, horses, or goats and sheep

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādiha śarīrānte svargatiṃ cāpi nārada /
daśamyāṃ kārtike śukle sārvabhaumavrataṃ caret //
meaning:
दद्यादिह शरीरान्ते स्वर्गतिं चापि नारद /
दशम्यां कार्तिके शुक्ले सार्वभौमव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt:
in this world, and at the end of the body, heavenly realm as well, O Nārada.
On the bright tenth in Kārttika, one should observe the Sārvabhauma rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtopavāso vaikāśī niśīthe 'pūpakādibhiḥ /
daśadikṣu baliṃ dadyād gṛhadvāpi purādbrahiḥ //
meaning:
कृतोपवासो वैकाशी निशीथे ऽपूपकादिभिः /
दशदिक्षु बलिं दद्याद् गृहद्वापि पुराद्ब्रहिः //
text_mt:
Having fasted or eaten once, at midnight one should offer an oblation of cakes and the like
in the ten directions, either at the house door or outside the town,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale 'ṣṭadale kḷpte goviḍliptadharātale /
mantrairebhirdvijaśreṣṭha gaṇeśādikṛtārcanaḥ //
meaning:
मण्डले ऽष्टदले कॢप्ते गोविड्लिप्तधरातले /
मन्त्रैरेभिर्द्विजश्रेष्ठ गणेशादिकृतार्चनः //
text_mt:
upon an eight-petalled maṇḍala fashioned on the ground smeared with cow-dung,
with these mantras, O best of the twice-born, having performed the worship of Gaṇeśa and the others:

sanskrit_iast:
yo me pūrvagataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
tamindro devarā jo 'dya nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे पूर्वगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
तमिन्द्रो देवरा जो ऽद्य नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: "Whatever evil has approached me from the east by sinful action here, / let Indra, the king of the gods, who grants all desires, destroy that today.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me vahnigataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
tejorājo 'tha vahnistaṃ nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे वह्निगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
तेजोराजो ऽथ वह्निस्तं नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the south-east by sinful action here, / let Agni, the king of splendor, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me dakṣagataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
taṃ yamaḥ pretarājo vai nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे दक्षगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
तं यमः प्रेतराजो वै नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the south by sinful action here, / let Yama, the king of spirits, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me nairṛtigaḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
rakṣorājo nairṛtistaṃ nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे नैरृतिगः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
रक्षोराजो नैरृतिस्तं नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the south-west by sinful action here, / let Nairṛta, the king of rākṣasas, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me paścimagaḥ pāpmā pāpakenehakarmaṇā /
yādaḥ patistaṃ varuṇo nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे पश्चिमगः पाप्मा पापकेनेहकर्मणा /
यादः पतिस्तं वरुणो नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the west by sinful action here, / let Varuṇa, the lord of aquatic creatures, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me vāyugataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
vāyustaṃ marutāṃ rājo nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे वायुगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
वायुस्तं मरुतां राजो नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the north-west by sinful action here, / let Vāyu, the king of the Maruts, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me saumyagataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
somastamṛkṣayakṣeśo nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे सौम्यगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
सोमस्तमृक्षयक्षेशो नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the north by sinful action here, / let Soma, the lord of asterisms and yakṣas, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo ma īśagataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
īśāno bhūtanāthastaṃ nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो म ईशगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
ईशानो भूतनाथस्तं नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from the north-east by sinful action here, / let Īśāna, the lord of spirits, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo maṃ ūrddhvagataḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
brahmā prajāpatīśastaṃ nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मं ऊर्द्ध्वगतः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
ब्रह्मा प्रजापतीशस्तं नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has approached me from above by sinful action here, / let Brahmā, the lord of the Prajāpatis, who grants all desires, destroy that.

sanskrit_iast:
yo me 'dhaḥsaṃsthitaḥ pāpmā pāpakeneha karmaṇā /
ananto nāgarājastaṃ nāśayatvakhileṣṭadaḥ //
meaning:
यो मे ऽधःसंस्थितः पाप्मा पापकेनेह कर्मणा /
अनन्तो नागराजस्तं नाशयत्वखिलेष्टदः //
text_mt: Whatever evil has resided below me by sinful action here, / let Ananta, the king of snakes, who grants all desires, destroy that."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ dikṣu daśasu baliṃ datvā samāhitaḥ /
kṣetrapālāya tadbāhye kṣipedbalimatandritaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं दिक्षु दशसु बलिं दत्वा समाहितः /
क्षेत्रपालाय तद्बाह्ये क्षिपेद्बलिमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: Having thus offered a sacrifice in the ten directions with focused mind, / one should, unwearied, toss an offering outside of that to the guardian of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavidhiḥ śeṣaṃ niśāyāṃ ninayetsudhīḥ /
gītaiḥ sumaṅgalaprāyaiḥ stavapāṭhairjapādibhiḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतविधिः शेषं निशायां निनयेत्सुधीः /
गीतैः सुमङ्गलप्रायैः स्तवपाठैर्जपादिभिः //
text_mt: Having thus performed the rite, the wise one should pass the remainder of the night / with songs predominantly auspicious, with recitations of hymns of praise, recitations of mantras, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya lokapālān dvijottamān /
dvādaśābhyarcya saṃbhojya śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य लोकपालान् द्विजोत्तमान् /
द्वादशाभ्यर्च्य संभोज्य शक्तितो दक्षिणां ददेत् //
text_mt: Having bathed in the morning and worshipped the guardians of the worlds, having worshipped twelve / excellent brāhmaṇas and fed them, he should give a priestly fee according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra bhogānbhuktaihikāñchubhān /
yugaṃ svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā sārvabhaumo nṛpo bhavet //
meaning:
इत्थं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र भोगान्भुक्तैहिकाञ्छुभान् /
युगं स्वर्गसुखं भुक्त्वा सार्वभौमो नृपो भवेत् //
text_mt: Having performed this observance thus, O brāhmaṇa, enjoying auspicious earthly pleasures, / and having enjoyed the happiness of heaven for a yuga, he will become an emperor.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśukladaśamyāṃ tu caredā rogyakaṃ vratam /
gandhādyairarcayedviprān daśa taccaraṇodakam //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्लदशम्यां तु चरेदा रोग्यकं व्रतम् /
गन्धाद्यैरर्चयेद्विप्रान् दश तच्चरणोदकम् //
text_mt: On the bright tenth of Mārgaśīrṣa, one should perform the observance for health; / he should worship ten brāhmaṇas with perfumes and the like; having drunk the water of their feet,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvātha dakṣiṇāṃ datvā visūjedekabhojanaṃ /
etatkṛtvā vrataṃ vipra hyārogyaṃ prāpya bhūtale //
meaning:
पीत्वाथ दक्षिणां दत्वा विसूजेदेकभोजनं /
एतत्कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र ह्यारोग्यं प्राप्य भूतले //
text_mt: and then having given a priestly fee, eating a single meal, he should dismiss them. / Having performed this observance, O brāhmaṇa, having attained health on the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarājaprasādena modate divi devavat /
pauṣe daśamyāṃ śuklāyāṃ viśvedevān samarcayet //
meaning:
धर्मराजप्रसादेन मोदते दिवि देववत् /
पौषे दशम्यां शुक्लायां विश्वेदेवान् समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: he rejoices in heaven like a god by the grace of the King of Justice. / On the bright tenth in Pauṣa, one should worship the Viśvedevas:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtuṃ dakṣaṃ vasū6nsatyaṃ kālaṃ kāmaṃ muniṃ gurum /
vipraṃ rāmaṃ ca daśadhā keśavastānsamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋतुं दक्षं वसू6न्सत्यं कालं कामं मुनिं गुरुम् /
विप्रं रामं च दशधा केशवस्तान्समास्थितः //
text_mt: Ṛtu, Dakṣa, Vasu, Satya, Kāla, Kāma, Muni, Guru, / Vipra, and Rāma—Keśava resides in them ten-fold.

sanskrit_iast:
svāpayitvā darbhamayānāsaneṣu ca saṃsthitān /
gandhairdhūpaistathā dīpairnaivedyaiścāpi nārada //
meaning:
स्वापयित्वा दर्भमयानासनेषु च संस्थितान् /
गन्धैर्धूपैस्तथा दीपैर्नैवेद्यैश्चापि नारद //
text_mt: Having installed them made of darbha grass, seated upon seats, / [worshipping them] with perfumes, incenses, and lamps, as well as food offerings, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā praṇiyatya visarjayet /
dakṣiṇāṃ tāṃ dvijāgryebhyo gurave vā samarpayet //
meaning:
प्रत्येकं दक्षिणां दत्वा प्रणियत्य विसर्जयेत् /
दक्षिणां तां द्विजाग्र्येभ्यो गुरवे वा समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: giving a priestly fee to each and bowing down, he should bid farewell to them; / he should offer that priestly fee to the best of brāhmaṇas or to the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavidhi ścaikabhakto bhogī vratī bhavet /
lokadvayasya viprarṣe nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
māghaśukladaśamyāṃ tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ///
meaning:
एवं कृतविधि श्चैकभक्तो भोगी व्रती भवेत् /
लोकद्वयस्य विप्रर्षे नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
माघशुक्लदशम्यां तु सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ///
text_mt:
One who has thus performed the rite and eats a single meal becomes a practitioner of the observance who enjoys pleasures / in both worlds, O brāhmaṇa-sage; no doubt should be entertained on this matter.

On the bright tenth day of Māgha, however, fasting and having subdued his senses,

sanskrit_iast: devāṃnagiraso nāma daśa samyaksamarcayet //
meaning: देवांनगिरसो नाम दश सम्यक्समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: one should properly worship the ten gods known as the Āṅgirasas,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā svarṇamayānvipra gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ /
ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca //
meaning:
कृत्वा स्वर्णमयान्विप्र गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः /
आत्मा ह्यायुर्मनो दक्षो मदः प्राणस्तथैव च //
text_mt: having fashioned them out of gold, O brahmin, with services such as perfumes and other offerings: / Ātman, Āyus, Manas, Dakṣa, Mada, and likewise Prāṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
barhiṣmāṃśca gaviṣṭhaśca dattaḥ satyaśca te daśa /
daśa viprānbhojayitvā madhurānnena nārada //
meaning:
बर्हिष्मांश्च गविष्ठश्च दत्तः सत्यश्च ते दश /
दश विप्रान्भोजयित्वा मधुरान्नेन नारद //
text_mt: Barhiṣmat, Gaviṣṭha, Datta, and Satya—these are the ten. / Having fed ten brahmins with sweet food, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtīstebhyaḥ pradadyāttāḥ svargalokāptaye kramāt /
antyaśukladaśamyāṃ tu caturdaśaṃ yamānyajet //
meaning:
मूर्तीस्तेभ्यः प्रदद्यात्ताः स्वर्गलोकाप्तये क्रमात् /
अन्त्यशुक्लदशम्यां तु चतुर्दशं यमान्यजेत् //
text_mt: one should present those images to them in order to attain the heavenly world. / On the final bright tenth day, however, one should worship the fourteen Yamas:

sanskrit_iast:
yamaśca dharmarājaśca mṛtyuścaivāntakastathā /
vaivasvataśca kālaśca sarvabhūtakṣayastathā //
meaning:
यमश्च धर्मराजश्च मृत्युश्चैवान्तकस्तथा /
वैवस्वतश्च कालश्च सर्वभूतक्षयस्तथा //
text_mt: Yama, Dharmarāja, Mṛtyu, and Antaka, / Vaivasvata, Kāla, and Sarvabhūtakṣaya,

sanskrit_iast:
audumbaraśca daghnaśca dvau nīlaparameṣṭhinau /
vṛkodaraścacitraśca citraguptaścaturdaśa //
meaning:
औदुम्बरश्च दघ्नश्च द्वौ नीलपरमेष्ठिनौ /
वृकोदरश्चचित्रश्च चित्रगुप्तश्चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Audumbara, Daghna, the two Nīla and Parameṣṭhin, / Vṛkodara, Citra, and Citragupta—the fourteen.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyairupacāraiśca samabhyarcyāthatarpayet /
tilāṃbumiśrāñjalibhirdarbhaiḥ pratyekaśastribhiḥ //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैश्च समभ्यर्च्याथतर्पयेत् /
तिलांबुमिश्राञ्जलिभिर्दर्भैः प्रत्येकशस्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: Having worshipped them with offerings such as perfumes and other services, one should then make water libations / with three handfuls of water mixed with sesame seeds and with kuśa grass for each one.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca dadyātsūryārghaṃ tāmrapātreṇa nārada /
raktacandanasaṃmiśratilākṣatayavāṃbubhiḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च दद्यात्सूर्यार्घं ताम्रपात्रेण नारद /
रक्तचन्दनसंमिश्रतिलाक्षतयवांबुभिः //
text_mt: Then, O Nārada, one should offer water oblation to Sūrya using a copper vessel, / with water mixed with red sandalwood, sesame seeds, unbroken rice, and barley:

sanskrit_iast:
ehi sūryasahasrāṃśo tejorāśe jagatpate /
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ bhaktyā māmanukaṃpaya //
meaning:
एहि सूर्यसहस्रांशो तेजोराशे जगत्पते /
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं भक्त्या मामनुकंपय //
text_mt: “Come, O Sūrya of a thousand rays, mass of radiance, Lord of the Universe! / Accept this water oblation offered by me with devotion; have compassion on me.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti mantreṇa datvārghyaṃ viprānbhojya caturddaśa /
raupyāṃ sudakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam //
meaning:
इति मन्त्रेण दत्वार्घ्यं विप्रान्भोज्य चतुर्द्दश /
रौप्यां सुदक्षिणां दत्वा विसृज्याश्नीत च स्वयम् //
text_mt: Having offered the water oblation with this mantra, fed fourteen brahmins, / given generous sacrificial fees of silver, and dismissed them, one should eat oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavidhirvipra dharmarājaprasādataḥ /
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca putrārthānaihikāndevadurlabhān //
meaning:
एवं कृतविधिर्विप्र धर्मराजप्रसादतः /
भुक्त्वा भोगांश्च पुत्रार्थानैहिकान्देवदुर्लभान् //
text_mt: One who has thus performed the rite, O brahmin, through the grace of Dharmarāja, / having enjoyed pleasures, sons, and wealth in this world, rare even for gods,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāsthāya dehānte viṣṇulokabhāk //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitadaśamīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
विमानवरमास्थाय देहान्ते विष्णुलोकभाक् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितदशमीव्रतनिरूपणं नामैकोनविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
mounts an excellent aerial chariot and at the end of the body attains the world of Viṣṇu.

Thus ends the one hundred nineteenth chapter in the fourth quarter of the Great Narrative in the first part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, entitled “Description of the Tenth-Day Observances in the Twelve Months.”

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
ekādaśyāṃ tu dalayornirāhāraḥ samāhitaḥ /
nānāpuṣpairmune kṛtvā vicitraṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
एकादश्यां तु दलयोर्निराहारः समाहितः /
नानापुष्पैर्मुने कृत्वा विचित्रं मण्डपं शुभम् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / On the eleventh day in both fortnights, abstaining from food and concentrated in mind, / having constructed a splendid and beautiful pavilion with various flowers, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
srātvā samyagvidhānena sopavāso jitendriyaḥ /
saṃpūjya vidhivadviṣṇuṃ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
स्रात्वा सम्यग्विधानेन सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः /
संपूज्य विधिवद्विष्णुं श्रद्धया सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: having bathed according to proper rule, fasting, with restrained senses, / having worshipped Viṣṇu according to injunction with faith and deep concentration,

sanskrit_iast:
upacārairbahuvidhairjapairhemaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ /
stotrapāṭhairbahuvidhairgītavādyairmanoharaiḥ //
meaning:
उपचारैर्बहुविधैर्जपैर्हेमैः प्रदक्षिणैः /
स्तोत्रपाठैर्बहुविधैर्गीतवाद्यैर्मनोहरैः //
text_mt: with numerous services, recitations, fire oblations, circumambulations, / readings of various hymns of praise, and charming songs and instrumental music,

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiśca jayaśabdairmanoharaiḥ /
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश्च जयशब्दैर्मनोहरैः /
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा याति विष्णोः परं पदम् //
text_mt: with prostrations like a staff and charming cries of “Victory!”, / having kept a night vigil, he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ sopavāso narottamaḥ /
kṛtvā ca niyamānsarvānvakṣyamāṇāndinatraye //
meaning:
चैत्रस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां सोपवासो नरोत्तमः /
कृत्वा च नियमान्सर्वान्वक्ष्यमाणान्दिनत्रये //
text_mt: Fasting on the bright eleventh day of Caitra, the best of men, / having observed all the restrictions to be described over three days,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāmarcayedbhaktayā vāsudevaṃ sanātanam /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ saṃbhojya bāndhavān //
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo visṛjyāśnīta ca svayam ///
meaning:
द्वादश्यामर्चयेद्भक्तया वासुदेवं सनातनम् /
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः संभोज्य बान्धवान् //
दत्वा च दक्षिणां तेभ्यो विसृज्याश्नीत च स्वयम् ///
text_mt:
should worship the eternal Vāsudeva on the twelfth day with devotion / through sixteen forms of service. Then, having fed his relatives,

and given them a sacrificial fee, he should dismiss them and eat himself.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ tu kāmadā nāma sarvapātakanāśinī //
meaning: इयं तु कामदा नाम सर्वपातकनाशिनी //
text_mt: This [eleventh day] is called Kāmadā, the destroyer of all sins;

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktipradā vipra bhaktyā samyagupoṣitā /
vaiśākhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा विप्र भक्त्या सम्यगुपोषिता /
वैशाखकृष्णैकादश्यां समुपोष्य विधानतः //
text_mt: it grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, O brahmin, when fasted on properly with devotion. / Having fasted according to rule on the dark eleventh day of Vaiśākha,

sanskrit_iast:
varūthinīṃ paradine pūjayenmṛdhusūdanam /
svarṇānnakanyādhenūnāṃ dānamatra praśasyate //
meaning:
वरूथिनीं परदिने पूजयेन्मृधुसूदनम् /
स्वर्णान्नकन्याधेनूनां दानमत्र प्रशस्यते //
text_mt: [known as] Varūthinī, one should worship Madhusūdana on the next day. / The gift of gold, food, a maiden, and cows is praised here.

sanskrit_iast:
varūthinīvrataṃ kṛtvā naro niyamatatparaḥ /
sarvapāpa vinirmukto vaiṣṇavaṃ labhate padvam //
meaning:
वरूथिनीव्रतं कृत्वा नरो नियमतत्परः /
सर्वपाप विनिर्मुक्तो वैष्णवं लभते पद्वम् //
text_mt: Having performed the Varūthinī observance, a man intent upon religious vows, / freed from all sins, attains the Vaiṣṇava state.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣya ca mohinīm /
snātvā pare 'hni saṃpūjya gandhādyaiḥ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
वैशाखशुक्लैकादश्यां समुपोष्य च मोहिनीम् /
स्नात्वा परे ऽह्नि संपूज्य गन्धाद्यैः पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having fasted on the bright eleventh day of Vaiśākha, [known as] Mohinī, / bathing and worshipping Puruṣottama on the following day with perfumes and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya viprānmucyeta pātakebhyo na saṃśayaḥ /
jeṣṭhasya kṛṣṇakādaśyāṃ samupoṣya parāṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
संभोज्य विप्रान्मुच्येत पातकेभ्यो न संशयः /
जेष्ठस्य कृष्णकादश्यां समुपोष्य परां नृप //
text_mt: and feeding brahmins, he is freed from sins; there is no doubt. / Having fasted on the dark eleventh day of Jyeṣṭha, [known as] Parā, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ naityikaṃ kṛtvā samabhyarcya trivikramam /
tato dvijāgryānsaṃbhojya datvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां नैत्यिकं कृत्वा समभ्यर्च्य त्रिविक्रमम् /
ततो द्विजाग्र्यान्संभोज्य दत्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् //
