text_mt: having performed the daily rites on the twelfth day and worshipped Trivikrama, / then feeding excellent brahmins and giving them a sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ /
jyeṣṭhasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ nirjalāṃ samupoṣya tu //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन्नरः /
ज्येष्ठस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां निर्जलां समुपोष्य तु //
text_mt: A man, completely freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu. / Fasting without water on the bright eleventh lunar day of Jyeṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
udayādudayaṃ yāvadbhāskarasya dvijottama /
prabhāte kṛtanityastu dvādaśyāmupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
उदयादुदयं यावद्भास्करस्य द्विजोत्तम /
प्रभाते कृतनित्यस्तु द्वादश्यामुपचारकैः //
text_mt: from sunrise to sunrise [the next day], O best of Brahmins, / and having performed the daily rites in the morning of the twelfth lunar day, with offerings

sanskrit_iast:
hyaṣīkeśaṃ samabhyarcya viprān saṃbhojya bhaktitaḥ /
caturviṃśaikādaśīnāṃ phalaṃ yattatsamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ह्यषीकेशं समभ्यर्च्य विप्रान् संभोज्य भक्तितः /
चतुर्विंशैकादशीनां फलं यत्तत्समाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: having worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa and fed the Brahmins with devotion, / one obtains whatever fruit belongs to the twenty-four eleventh lunar days.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ yoginīṃ samupoṣya vai /
nārāyaṇaṃ samabhyarcya dvādaśyāṃ kṛtanityakaḥ //
meaning:
आषाढकृष्णैकादश्यां योगिनीं समुपोष्य वै /
नारायणं समभ्यर्च्य द्वादश्यां कृतनित्यकः //
text_mt: Having indeed fasted on the Yoginī [fast] on the dark eleventh lunar day of Āṣāḍha, / having worshipped Nārāyaṇa on the twelfth lunar day, after performing his daily rites,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃbhojya viprāgryāndatvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām /
sarvadānaphalaṃ prāpya modate viṣṇumandire //
meaning:
ततः संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्दत्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् /
सर्वदानफलं प्राप्य मोदते विष्णुमन्दिरे //
text_mt: and then having fed the best of Brahmins and given them a priestly fee, / having attained the fruit of all gifts, he rejoices in the abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ yadbidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat /
upoṣya tasmin divase vidhivanmaṇḍape śubhe //
meaning:
आषाढशुक्लैकादश्यां यद्बिधानं शृणुष्व तत् /
उपोष्य तस्मिन् दिवसे विधिवन्मण्डपे शुभे //
text_mt: Hear that procedure which is [prescribed] for the bright eleventh lunar day of Āṣāḍha: / having fasted on that day, according to rule, in an auspicious pavilion,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayetpratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ śaṅkhacakragadāṃbujaiḥ /
lasaccaturbhujāmagryāṃ kāñcanīṃ vātha rājatīm //
meaning:
स्थापयेत्प्रतिमां विष्णोः शङ्खचक्रगदांबुजैः /
लसच्चतुर्भुजामग्र्यां काञ्चनीं वाथ राजतीम् //
text_mt: one should install an image of Viṣṇu, shining with four arms, / with conch, discus, mace, and lotus, made of gold or silver, the best,

sanskrit_iast:
pītāṃbaradharāṃ śubhre paryyaṅke svāstṛte dvija /
tataḥ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpya mantraiḥ śuddhajalena ca //
meaning:
पीतांबरधरां शुभ्रे पर्य्यङ्के स्वास्तृते द्विज /
ततः पञ्चामृतैः स्नाप्य मन्त्रैः शुद्धजलेन च //
text_mt: wearing yellow garments, upon a white, well-spread couch, O Brahmin. / Then, having bathed [it] with the five nectars, with mantras, and with pure water,

sanskrit_iast:
pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena hyupacārān prakalpayet /
nīrājanāntānpādyādīṃstataḥ saṃprārthayeddharim //
meaning:
पौरुषेणैव सूक्तेन ह्युपचारान् प्रकल्पयेत् /
नीराजनान्तान्पाद्यादींस्ततः संप्रार्थयेद्धरिम् //
text_mt: one should offer the services with the Puruṣasūkta alone, / ending with the waving of lights, beginning with water for washing the feet; then one should pray to Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
supte tvayi jagannātha jagatsuptaṃ bhavedidam /
vibuddhe tvayi buddhaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ carācaram //
meaning:
सुप्ते त्वयि जगन्नाथ जगत्सुप्तं भवेदिदम् /
विबुद्धे त्वयि बुद्धं च जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् //
text_mt: ‘When you are asleep, O Lord of the world, this world is asleep; / when you awaken, the entire world of moving and unmoving things is awake.’

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃprārthya devāgre cāturmāsyapracoditān /
niyamāṃstu yathāśakti gṛhṇīyādbhaktimānnaraḥ //
meaning:
इति संप्रार्थ्य देवाग्रे चातुर्मास्यप्रचोदितान् /
नियमांस्तु यथाशक्ति गृह्णीयाद्भक्तिमान्नरः //
text_mt: Having prayed thus before the god, a devoted man / should undertake, according to his ability, the observances enjoined for the four-month rainy retreat.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte dvādaśyāṃ samarceccheṣaśāyinam /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ saṃbhojya vāḍavān //
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते द्वादश्यां समर्चेच्छेषशायिनम् /
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः संभोज्य वाडवान् //
text_mt: Then, in the morning of the twelfth lunar day, he should worship the one who reclines on Śeṣa / with sixteen offerings, and then, having fed the Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
pratoṣya dabhiṇābhiśca svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ /
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra gandhādyaiḥ pratyahaṃ yajet //
meaning:
प्रतोष्य दभिणाभिश्च स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः /
ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र गन्धाद्यैः प्रत्यहं यजेत् //
text_mt: and having satisfied them with priestly fees, he himself should eat, restrained in speech. / From then on, O chief of Brahmins, he should worship [him] daily with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaivaṃ vidhinā vipra devasya śayanīvratam /
bhuktimuktiyuto martyo bhavedviṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वैवं विधिना विप्र देवस्य शयनीव्रतम् /
भुक्तिमुक्तियुतो मर्त्यो भवेद्विष्णोः प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Having performed the god’s sleep-vow according to rule in this manner, O Brahmin, / a mortal, endowed with enjoyment and liberation, becomes [blessed] through the grace of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe tu ekādaśyāṃ dvijottama /
kāmikāṃ samupoṣyaiva niyamena narottama //
meaning:
श्रावणे कृष्णपक्षे तु एकादश्यां द्विजोत्तम /
कामिकां समुपोष्यैव नियमेन नरोत्तम //
text_mt: On the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, on the eleventh lunar day, O best of Brahmins, / having fasted on the Kāmikā [fast] strictly, O best of men,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ kṛtanityastu śrīdharaṃ pūjayeddharim /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśa bhistataḥ saṃbhojya vai dvijān //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां कृतनित्यस्तु श्रीधरं पूजयेद्धरिम् /
उपचारैः षोडश भिस्ततः संभोज्य वै द्विजान् //
text_mt: having performed his daily rites on the twelfth lunar day, he should worship Hari, the bearer of Śrī, / with sixteen offerings, and then, having fed the Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo visṛjyāśnīta bāndhavaiḥ /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute viprakāmikāvratamuttamam //
meaning:
दत्वा च दक्षिणां तेभ्यो विसृज्याश्नीत बान्धवैः /
एवं यः कुरुते विप्रकामिकाव्रतमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: and having given them a priestly fee, and dismissed them, he should eat with his relatives. / The person who thus performs the excellent Kāmikā vow, O Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvakāmāṃllabdhveha yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam /
ekādaśyāṃ nabhaḥśukle pavitrāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
स सर्वकामांल्लब्ध्वेह याति विष्णोः परं पदम् /
एकादश्यां नभःशुक्ले पवित्रां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having obtained all desires in this world, goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / Having fasted on the Pavitrā [fast] on the bright eleventh lunar day of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa),

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ niyato bhūtvā pūjayecca janārdanam /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ saṃbhojya vāḍavān //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां नियतो भूत्वा पूजयेच्च जनार्दनम् /
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः संभोज्य वाडवान् //
text_mt: and having become restrained, he should worship Janārdana on the twelfth lunar day / with sixteen offerings, and then, having fed the Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
/.
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ putraṃ prāpyeha sadguṇam /
yāti viṣṇoḥ padaṃ sākṣātsarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
/.
दत्वा च दक्षिणां तेभ्यः पुत्रं प्राप्येह सद्गुणम् /
याति विष्णोः पदं साक्षात्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः //
text_mt: and having given them a priestly fee, having obtained a virtuous son in this world, / he goes directly to the abode of Viṣṇu, bowed to by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasyakṛṣṇaikā daśyāmajākhyāṃ samupoṣya vai /
arcedurpendraṃ dvādaśyāmupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ //
meaning:
नभस्यकृष्णैका दश्यामजाख्यां समुपोष्य वै /
अर्चेदुर्पेन्द्रं द्वादश्यामुपचारैः पृथग्विधैः //
text_mt: Having fasted on the one called Ajā on the dark eleventh lunar day of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), / he should worship Upendra on the twelfth lunar day with various kinds of offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
viprānsaṃbhojya miṣṭānnairvisṛjetprāptadakṣiṇān /
evaṃ kṛtavrato viprabhaktyājāyāḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
विप्रान्संभोज्य मिष्टान्नैर्विसृजेत्प्राप्तदक्षिणान् /
एवं कृतव्रतो विप्रभक्त्याजायाः समाहितः //
text_mt: Having fed the Brahmins with sweet foods, he should dismiss them after they have received their priestly fees. / Having thus performed the vow of Ajā with devotion and concentration, O Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktveha bhogānakhilānyātyante vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣayam /
nabhasyaśuklaikādaśyāṃ padmākhyāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलान्यात्यन्ते वैष्णवं क्षयम् /
नभस्यशुक्लैकादश्यां पद्माख्यां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having enjoyed all pleasures in this world, he goes at the end to the realm of Viṣṇu. / Having fasted on the one called Padmā on the bright eleventh lunar day of Nabhasya,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā nityārcanaṃ tatra kaṭidānamathācaret /
pūrvaṃ saṃsthāpitāyāstu pratimāyā dvijottama //
meaning:
कृत्वा नित्यार्चनं तत्र कटिदानमथाचरेत् /
पूर्वं संस्थापितायास्तु प्रतिमाया द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: and having performed the daily worship there, he should then perform the turning of the side. / Of the image previously installed, O best of Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
samutsavavidhānena nītvā tāṃ salilāśaye /
kṛtāṃbusparśanāṃ tatra saṃprapūjya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
समुत्सवविधानेन नीत्वा तां सलिलाशये /
कृतांबुस्पर्शनां तत्र संप्रपूज्य विधानतः //
text_mt: having taken it to a reservoir of water with festive celebration, / having had it touch the water there and worshipped it properly,

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya maṇḍape tasmin vāmapārśvena śāyayet /
tataḥ prabhāpte dvādaśyāṃ gandhādyairarcya vāmanam //
meaning:
आनीय मण्डपे तस्मिन् वामपार्श्वेन शाययेत् /
ततः प्रभाप्ते द्वादश्यां गन्धाद्यैरर्च्य वामनम् //
text_mt: and having brought it back to that pavilion, he should lay it down on its left side. / Then, in the morning of the twelfth lunar day, having worshipped Vāmana with perfumes and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya vāḍavāndatvā dakṣiṇāṃ ca visarjayet /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra padmāvratamanuttamam //
meaning:
संभोज्य वाडवान्दत्वा दक्षिणां च विसर्जयेत् /
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र पद्माव्रतमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: having fed the Brahmins and given a priestly fee, he should dismiss them. / The person who thus performs the unsurpassed Padmā vow, O Brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktiṃ prāpyeha muktiṃ tu labhateṃ'te prapañcataḥ /
iṣasya kṛṣṇaikā daśyāmindirāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
भुक्तिं प्राप्येह मुक्तिं तु लभतेंऽते प्रपञ्चतः /
इषस्य कृष्णैका दश्यामिन्दिरां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having attained enjoyment in this world, obtains liberation from the manifest world at the end. / Having fasted on the Indirā [fast] on the dark eleventh lunar day of Iṣa (Āśvina),

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaśilāgre tu madhyāhne śrāddhamācaret /
viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ vipra tataḥ prātarharerdine //
meaning:
शालग्रामशिलाग्रे तु मध्याह्ने श्राद्धमाचरेत् /
विष्णोः प्रीतिकरं विप्र ततः प्रातर्हरेर्दिने //
text_mt: one should perform an ancestral rite at midday in front of a śālagrāma stone, / pleasing to Viṣṇu, O Brahmin; then, in the morning on the day of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
padnanābhaṃ samabhyarcya bhūdevānbhojayetsudhīḥ /
visṛjya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā tāṃstato 'śnīta ca svayam //
meaning:
पद्ननाभं समभ्यर्च्य भूदेवान्भोजयेत्सुधीः /
विसृज्य दक्षिणां दत्वा तांस्ततो ऽश्नीत च स्वयम् //
text_mt: the wise man, having worshipped Padmanābha, should feed the gods of the earth (Brahmins); / having dismissed them after giving a priestly fee, he himself should then eat.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavrato martyo bhuktvā bhogānihepsitān /
pitṝṇāṃ koṭimuddhṛtya yātyante vaiṣṇavaṃ gṛham //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतो मर्त्यो भुक्त्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् /
पितॄणां कोटिमुद्धृत्य यात्यन्ते वैष्णवं गृहम् //
text_mt: A mortal who has performed this vow, having enjoyed desired pleasures in this world / and lifted up ten million ancestors, goes at the end to the home of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāmiṣe śukle vipra pāśāṅkuśāhvayām /
upoṣya vidhivadviṣṇordine viṣṇuṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
एकादश्यामिषे शुक्ले विप्र पाशाङ्कुशाह्वयाम् /
उपोष्य विधिवद्विष्णोर्दिने विष्णुं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: On the bright eleventh lunar day of Iṣa, O Brahmin, having fasted according to rule / on the one named Pāśāṅkuśā, he should worship Viṣṇu on the day of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃbhojya viprāgryāndatvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām /
bhaktyā praṇamya visṛjedaśnīyācca svayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
ततः संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्दत्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् /
भक्त्या प्रणम्य विसृजेदश्नीयाच्च स्वयं ततः //
text_mt: Then, having fed the best of Brahmins and given them a priestly fee, / having bowed with devotion, he should dismiss them, and then eat himself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā naraḥ pāśāṅkuśāvratam /
sa bhuktveha varānbhogānyāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या नरः पाशाङ्कुशाव्रतम् /
स भुक्त्वेह वरान्भोगान्याति विष्णोः सलोकताम् //
text_mt: The man who thus performs the Pāśāṅkuśā vow with devotion, / having enjoyed excellent pleasures in this world, goes to dwell in the same realm as Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu ekādaśyāṃ dvijottama /
ramāmupoṣya vidhivaddvādaśyāṃ prātararcayet //
meaning:
कार्तिके कृष्णपक्षे तु एकादश्यां द्विजोत्तम /
रमामुपोष्य विधिवद्द्वादश्यां प्रातरर्चयेत् //
text_mt: In the dark fortnight of Kārtika, on the eleventh lunar day, O best of Brahmins, / having fasted on Ramā according to rule, he should worship in the morning on the twelfth lunar day

sanskrit_iast:
keśavaṃ keśihṝntāraṃ devadevaṃ sanātanam /
bhojayecca tato viprānvisṛjellabdhadakṣiṇān //
meaning:
केशवं केशिहॄन्तारं देवदेवं सनातनम् /
भोजयेच्च ततो विप्रान्विसृजेल्लब्धदक्षिणान् //
text_mt: Keśava, the destroyer of Keśin, the eternal God of gods; / and then he should feed the Brahmins and dismiss them once they have received their priestly fees.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavrato vipra bhogānbhuktveha vāñchitān /
vyomayānena sāṃnidhyaṃ labhate ca ramāpateḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतो विप्र भोगान्भुक्त्वेह वाञ्छितान् /
व्योमयानेन सांनिध्यं लभते च रमापतेः //
text_mt: Having thus performed the vow, O Brahmin, having enjoyed desired pleasures in this world, / he attains closeness to the husband of Ramā (Viṣṇu) by means of an aerial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣya prabodhinīm /
keśavaṃ bodhayedrātrau suptaṃ gītādimaṅgalaiḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्जस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां समुपोष्य प्रबोधिनीम् /
केशवं बोधयेद्रात्रौ सुप्तं गीतादिमङ्गलैः //
text_mt: Having fasted on the Prabodhinī on the bright eleventh lunar day of Ūrja (Kārtika), / he should awaken Keśava who is asleep at night with auspicious songs and other performances,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca vādyairnānāvidhairapi /
drākṣekṣudāḍimaiścānyai raṃbhāśṛṅgāṭakādibhiḥ //
meaning:
ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रैश्च वाद्यैर्नानाविधैरपि /
द्राक्षेक्षुदाडिमैश्चान्यै रंभाशृङ्गाटकादिभिः //
text_mt: and with Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman mantras, and also with various musical instruments, / with offerings of grapes, sugarcane, pomegranates, and other [fruits], such as plantains and water chestnuts.

sanskrit_iast:
samarpaṇaistato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pare 'hani /
snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā gadādāmodaraṃ yajet //
meaning:
समर्पणैस्ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां परे ऽहनि /
स्नात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा गदादामोदरं यजेत् //
text_mt: Then, the night having passed, on the next day, / having bathed and performed the daily rites, he should worship Damodara with the mace,

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pauruṣeṇāpi sūktataḥ /
saṃbhojya viprānvisṛjeddakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣitān //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिः पौरुषेणापि सूक्ततः /
संभोज्य विप्रान्विसृजेद्दक्षिणाभिः प्रतोषितान् //
text_mt: with sixteen offerings and also with the Puruṣasūkta; / having fed the Brahmins, he should dismiss them when they are pleased with priestly fees.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāṃ pratimāṃ haimīṃ sadhenuṃ guraver'payet /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bodhinīvratamādṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तां प्रतिमां हैमीं सधेनुं गुरवेर्ऽपयेत् /
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या बोधिनीव्रतमादृतः //
text_mt: Then he should give that golden image, along with a cow, to the teacher. / The person who, full of reverence, thus performs the Bodhinī vow with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhuktveha varānbhogānvaiṣṇavaṃ labhate padam /
mārgasya kṛṣṇaikādaśyāmutpannāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
स भुक्त्वेह वरान्भोगान्वैष्णवं लभते पदम् /
मार्गस्य कृष्णैकादश्यामुत्पन्नां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having enjoyed excellent pleasures in this world, obtains the abode of Viṣṇu. / Having fasted on the Utpannā on the dark eleventh lunar day of Mārga (Mārgaśīrṣa),

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇamabhyarcedgandhādyairupacārakaiḥ /
tataḥ saṃbhojya viprāgryāndatvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां कृष्णमभ्यर्चेद्गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः /
ततः संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्दत्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: he should worship Kṛṣṇa on the twelfth lunar day with perfumes and other offerings; / then, having fed the best of Brahmins and given them a priestly fee,

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya paścādbhuñjīta svayamiṣṭaiḥ samāhitaḥ /
evaṃ yo bhaktibhāvena utpannāvratamācaret //
meaning:
विसृज्य पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत स्वयमिष्टैः समाहितः /
एवं यो भक्तिभावेन उत्पन्नाव्रतमाचरेत् //
text_mt: and having dismissed them, he himself, composed in mind, should afterwards eat with his loved ones. / He who thus observes the Utpannā vow with an attitude of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
sa vimānaṃ samāruhya yātyante vaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
mārgasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ mokṣākhyāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
स विमानं समारुह्य यात्यन्ते वैष्णवं पदम् /
मार्गस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां मोक्षाख्यां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having mounted an aerial chariot, goes at the end to the abode of Viṣṇu. / Having fasted on the one called Mokṣā on the bright eleventh lunar day of Mārga,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ prātarabhyarcya hyanantaṃ viśvarūpakam /
sarvairevopacāraistu viprānsaṃbhojayeddvijaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां प्रातरभ्यर्च्य ह्यनन्तं विश्वरूपकम् /
सर्वैरेवोपचारैस्तु विप्रान्संभोजयेद्द्विजः //
text_mt: having worshipped Ananta, whose form is the universe, in the morning of the twelfth day / with all services, the twice-born should feed brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya dakṣiṇāṃ datvā svayaṃ bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra bhuktvā bhogānihepsitān //
meaning:
विसृज्य दक्षिणां दत्वा स्वयं भुञ्जीत बान्धवैः /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र भुक्त्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् //
text_mt: Having dismissed them after giving a sacrificial fee, he should eat himself with his relatives. / Having thus performed the observance, O brahmin, and enjoyed desired pleasures in this world,

sanskrit_iast:
daśa pūrvāndaśa parānsamuddhṛtya vrajeddharim /
paupasya kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ saphalāṃ samupoṣya vai /
dvādaśyāmacyutaṃ prārcya sarvairevopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
दश पूर्वान्दश परान्समुद्धृत्य व्रजेद्धरिम् /
पौपस्य कृष्णैकादश्यां सफलां समुपोष्य वै /
द्वादश्यामच्युतं प्रार्च्य सर्वैरेवोपचारकैः //
text_mt: having rescued ten ancestors and ten descendants, he goes to Hari. / Having fasted on the dark eleventh day of Pauṣa, [known as] Saphalā, / and worshipped Acyuta on the twelfth day with all services,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya viprānmadhurairvisṛjellabdhadakṣiṇān /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra saphalāyā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
संभोज्य विप्रान्मधुरैर्विसृजेल्लब्धदक्षिणान् /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र सफलाया विधानतः //
text_mt: having fed the brahmins with sweets, one should dismiss them once they have received their sacrificial fees. / Having thus performed the observance of Saphalā according to rule, O brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktveha bhogānakhilānyātyante vaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
pauṣasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ putradāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलान्यात्यन्ते वैष्णवं पदम् /
पौषस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां पुत्रदां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: having enjoyed all pleasures in this world, he goes to the Vaiṣṇava abode at the end. / Having fasted on the bright eleventh day of Pauṣa, [known as] Putradā,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ cakriṇaṃ prāryedarghādyairupacārakaiḥ /
tataḥ saṃbhojya viprāgryāndatvā tebhyastu dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां चक्रिणं प्रार्येदर्घाद्यैरुपचारकैः /
ततः संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्दत्वा तेभ्यस्तु दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: on the twelfth day one should worship the Bearer of the Discus with services such as water offering. / Then, having fed excellent brahmins and given them a sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya svayamaśnīyāccheṣānnaṃ sveṣṭabāndhavaiḥ /
evaṃ kṛtavrato vipra bhukvā bhogānihepsitān //
meaning:
विसृज्य स्वयमश्नीयाच्छेषान्नं स्वेष्टबान्धवैः /
एवं कृतव्रतो विप्र भुक्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् //
text_mt: and dismissed them, he should eat the remaining food himself with his dear relatives. / Having observed this vow, O brahmin, and enjoyed desired pleasures in this world,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāruhya yātyante harimandiram /
māghamya kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ ṣaṭtilāṃ samupoṣya vai //
meaning:
विमानवरमारुह्य यात्यन्ते हरिमन्दिरम् /
माघम्य कृष्णैकादश्यां षट्तिलां समुपोष्य वै //
text_mt: he ascends an excellent aerial chariot and goes at the end to the abode of Hari. / Having fasted on the dark eleventh day of Māgha, [known as] Ṣaṭtilā,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā datvā tarpayitvā hutvā bhuktvā samarcya ca /
tilaireva dvijaśreṣṭha dvādaśyāṃ prātareva hi //
meaning:
स्नात्वा दत्वा तर्पयित्वा हुत्वा भुक्त्वा समर्च्य च /
तिलैरेव द्विजश्रेष्ठ द्वादश्यां प्रातरेव हि //
text_mt: bathing, giving, offering libations, performing fire sacrifice, eating, and worshipping / with sesame seeds alone, O best of brahmins, early in the morning of the twelfth day,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhaṃ samyagabhyarvya sarvairevopacārakaiḥ /
dvijānsaṃbhojya visṛjeddatvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठं सम्यगभ्यर्व्य सर्वैरेवोपचारकैः /
द्विजान्संभोज्य विसृजेद्दत्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: having fully worshipped Vaikuṇṭha with all services, / one should feed brahmins and dismiss them after giving them a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra vidhinā susamāhitaḥ /
bhuktveha vāñchitānbhogānante viṣṇupadaṃ labhet //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र विधिना सुसमाहितः /
भुक्त्वेह वाञ्छितान्भोगानन्ते विष्णुपदं लभेत् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the observance according to rule, concentrated in mind, O brahmin, / and enjoyed desired pleasures in this world, he attains the abode of Viṣṇu at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
māghasya śuklaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣya jayāhvayām /
prātarhari dine 'bhyarccecchrīpatiṃ puruṣaṃ dvija //
meaning:
माघस्य शुक्लैकादश्यां समुपोष्य जयाह्वयाम् /
प्रातर्हरि दिने ऽभ्यर्च्चेच्छ्रीपतिं पुरुषं द्विज //
text_mt: Having fasted on the bright eleventh day of Māgha, named Jayā, / one should worship the Puruṣa, the Lord of Śrī, on the morning of Hari’s day, O brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayitvā dakṣiṇāṃ ca datvā viprānvisṛjya ca /
svayaṃ bhuñjīta taccheṣaṃ prayato nijabāndhavaiḥ //
meaning:
भोजयित्वा दक्षिणां च दत्वा विप्रान्विसृज्य च /
स्वयं भुञ्जीत तच्छेषं प्रयतो निजबान्धवैः //
text_mt: Having fed and given a sacrificial fee to the brahmins and dismissed them, / he should eat the remainder himself, restrained, together with his own relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ kurute vipra vrataṃ keśavatoṣaṇam /
sa bhuktveha varānbhogānante viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
य एवं कुरुते विप्र व्रतं केशवतोषणम् /
स भुक्त्वेह वरान्भोगानन्ते विष्णोः पदं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Whoever performs this observance that pleases Keśava, O brahmin, / he, having enjoyed excellent pleasures here, goes to the abode of Viṣṇu at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasyakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ vijayāṃ samupoṣya vai /
dvādaśyāṃ prātarabhyarcya yogīśaṃ gandhapūrvakaiḥ //
meaning:
तपस्यकृष्णैकादश्यां विजयां समुपोष्य वै /
द्वादश्यां प्रातरभ्यर्च्य योगीशं गन्धपूर्वकैः //
text_mt: Having fasted on the dark eleventh day of Tapasya, [known as] Vijayā, / and worshipped the Lord of Yogins in the morning of the twelfth day with perfumes and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃbhojya bhūdevāndakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣya tān /
visṛjya bāndhavaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayamaśnīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
ततः संभोज्य भूदेवान्दक्षिणाभिः प्रतोष्य तान् /
विसृज्य बान्धवैः सार्द्धं स्वयमश्नीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: then feeding the earthly gods and pleasing them with sacrificial fees, / and dismissing them, he should eat himself in silence together with his relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavrato martyo bhuktvā bhogānihepsitān /
dehānte vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ yāti devaiḥ susatkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतो मर्त्यो भुक्त्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् /
देहान्ते वैष्णवं लोकं याति देवैः सुसत्कृतः //
text_mt: A mortal who has thus performed the observance, having enjoyed desired pleasures in this world, / goes to the Vaiṣṇava world at the end of the body, highly honored by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
phaālgunasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dvijottama /
upoṣyāmalakīṃ bhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ prātararcayet //
meaning:
फआल्गुनस्य सिते पक्षे एकादश्यां द्विजोत्तम /
उपोष्यामलकीं भक्त्या द्वादश्यां प्रातरर्चयेत् //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight of Phālguna, on the eleventh day, O best of brahmins, / having fasted on Āmalakī with devotion, one should worship in the morning of the twelfth day

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍarīkākṣamakhilairupacāraistato dvijān /
bhojayitvā varānnena dadyāttebhyastu dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
पुण्डरीकाक्षमखिलैरुपचारैस्ततो द्विजान् /
भोजयित्वा वरान्नेन दद्यात्तेभ्यस्तु दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: the Lotus-eyed One with all services; then, having fed the brahmins / with excellent food, one should give them a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānenāmalakyāṃ pūjanādikam /
sitaikādaśyāṃ tapasye vrajedviṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा विधानेनामलक्यां पूजनादिकम् /
सितैकादश्यां तपस्ये व्रजेद्विष्णोः परं पदम् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the worship and other rites according to rule on the Āmalakī / bright eleventh day in Tapasya, one goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrasya kṛṣṇaikādaśīṃ pāpamocanikāṃ dvija /
upāṣya dvādaśyāṃprātargovindaṃ pūjayettathā //
meaning:
चैत्रस्य कृष्णैकादशीं पापमोचनिकां द्विज /
उपाष्य द्वादश्यांप्रातर्गोविन्दं पूजयेत्तथा //
text_mt: Fasting on the dark eleventh [day] of Caitra, [called] Pāpamocanikā, O twice-born one, / one should then worship Govinda in the morning on the twelfth [day],

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdvijānsaṃbhojya dakṣiṇām /
datvā tebhyo visṛjyātha svayaṃ bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिर्द्विजान्संभोज्य दक्षिणाम् /
दत्वा तेभ्यो विसृज्याथ स्वयं भुञ्जीत बान्धवैः //
text_mt: with sixteen offerings. Having fed twice-born ones, giving a priestly gift / to them, and dismissing [them], one should then eat oneself with relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
eva yaḥ kurute vipra pāpamocanikāvratām /
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ vimānena tu bhāsvatā //
meaning:
एव यः कुरुते विप्र पापमोचनिकाव्रताम् /
स याति वैष्णवं लोकं विमानेन तु भास्वता //
text_mt: He who observes the vow of Pāpamocanikā in this way, O Brahmin, / goes to the realm of Viṣṇu in a shining aerial chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ kṛṣṇo tathā śukle vrataṃ caikādaśībhavam /
mokṣadaṃ kīrtitaṃ vipra nāstyasminsaṃśayaḥ kvacit //
meaning:
इत्थं कृष्णो तथा शुक्ले व्रतं चैकादशीभवम् /
मोक्षदं कीर्तितं विप्र नास्त्यस्मिन्संशयः क्वचित् //
text_mt: Thus the vow observed on the eleventh [day], both in the dark and bright [fortnights], / has been proclaimed to grant liberation, O Brahmin; there is no doubt about this anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
yatastridinasaṃsādhyaṃ kīrtinaṃ pāpanāśanam /
sarvavratottamaṃ vipra tato jñeyaṃ mahāphalam //
meaning:
यतस्त्रिदिनसंसाध्यं कीर्तिनं पापनाशनम् /
सर्वव्रतोत्तमं विप्र ततो ज्ञेयं महाफलम् //
text_mt: Because it is accomplished over three days and is proclaimed to destroy sin, / O Brahmin, it is known to be the best of all vows, possessing great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tyajeccatvāri bhuktāni nāradai taddinatraye /
ādyantayorekamekaṃ madhyame dvayameva hi //
meaning:
त्यजेच्चत्वारि भुक्तानि नारदै तद्दिनत्रये /
आद्यन्तयोरेकमेकं मध्यमे द्वयमेव हि //
text_mt: On these three days, O Nārada, one must abandon four meals: / one each on the first and last [days], and indeed two on the middle [day].

sanskrit_iast:
atha te niyamānvacmi vrate hyasmindinatraye /
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrānnaṃ caṇakānkodravāṃstathā //
meaning:
अथ ते नियमान्वच्मि व्रते ह्यस्मिन्दिनत्रये /
कांस्यं मांसं मसूरान्नं चणकान्कोद्रवांस्तथा //
text_mt: Now I shall tell you the restrictions during these three days in the vow: / bell-metal, meat, lentils, chickpeas, and kodrava grains,

sanskrit_iast:
śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune /
daśamyāṃ daśa vastūni varjayedvaiṣṇavaṛ sadā //
meaning:
शाकं मधु परान्नं च पुनर्भोजनमैथुने /
दशम्यां दश वस्तूनि वर्जयेद्वैष्णवऋ सदा //
text_mt: vegetables, honey, another's food, eating a second time, and sexual intercourse; / on the tenth [day], a Vaiṣṇava must always avoid [these] ten things.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam /
parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim //
meaning:
द्यूतक्रीडां च निद्रां च तांबूलं दन्तधावनम् /
परापवादं पैशुन्यं स्तेयं हिंसां तथा रतिम् //
text_mt: Gambling, sleep, betel, brushing the teeth, / speaking ill of others, slander, theft, injury, and sexual enjoyment,

sanskrit_iast:
kopaṃ hyanṛtavākyaṃ ca ekādaśyāṃ vivarjjayet /
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ viṇmlecchabhāṣaṇam //
meaning:
कोपं ह्यनृतवाक्यं च एकादश्यां विवर्ज्जयेत् /
कांस्यं मांसं सुरां क्षौद्रं तैलं विण्म्लेच्छभाषणम् //
text_mt: anger, and speaking falsehood—these one must avoid on the eleventh [day]. / Bell-metal, meat, wine, honey, oil, speaking while defecating, speaking with barbarians,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune /
aspṛśyasparśamāśūre dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśa tyajet //
meaning:
व्यायामं च प्रवासं च पुनर्भोजनमैथुने /
अस्पृश्यस्पर्शमाशूरे द्वादश्यां द्वादश त्यजेत् //
text_mt: exercise, travel, eating a second time, sexual intercourse, / and touching what is untouchable—on the twelfth [day], a brave man must abandon [these] twelve.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ niyamakṛdvipra upavāsaṃ samācaret /
śakto 'śaktustu matimānekabhuktaṃ na naktakam //
meaning:
एवं नियमकृद्विप्र उपवासं समाचरेत् /
शक्तो ऽशक्तुस्तु मतिमानेकभुक्तं न नक्तकम् //
text_mt: Observing these rules in this way, O Brahmin, one who is capable should fast; / but one who is incapable, if wise, [should eat] a single meal, not an evening meal;

sanskrit_iast:
ayācitaṃ vāpi carenna tyajedvratamīdṛśam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīya purāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthabhāge dvādaśamāsastitaikādaśīvratakathanaṃ nāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अयाचितं वापि चरेन्न त्यजेद्व्रतमीदृशम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीय पुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थभागे द्वादशमासस्तितैकादशीव्रतकथनं नाम विंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
or he may observe [the vow by eating] unasked food; he must not abandon such a vow.

Thus ends the one hundred and twentieth chapter, named "Account of the Vows of the Eleventh Day in the Twelve Months," in the Fourth Part of the Major Narrative in the First Section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
atha vratāni dvādaśyāḥ kathayāmi tavānagha /
yāni kṛtvā naro loke viṣṇoḥ priyataro bhavet //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
अथ व्रतानि द्वादश्याः कथयामि तवानघ /
यानि कृत्वा नरो लोके विष्णोः प्रियतरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Now I shall tell you, O sinless one, the vows of the twelfth [day], / by performing which a man becomes very dear to Viṣṇu in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrasya śukladvādaśyāṃ madanavratamācaret /
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ sitatandulapūritam //
meaning:
चैत्रस्य शुक्लद्वादश्यां मदनव्रतमाचरेत् /
स्थापयेदव्रणं कुंभं सिततन्दुलपूरितम् //
text_mt: On the bright twelfth [day] of Caitra, one should observe the vow of Madana. / One should set up an unblemished jar filled with white rice,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāphalayutaṃ tadvadikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam /
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sitacandanacarccitam //
meaning:
नानाफलयुतं तद्वदिक्षुदण्डसमन्वितम् /
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं सितचन्दनचर्च्चितम् //
text_mt: provided with various fruits, likewise accompanied by sugarcane stalks, / covered with a pair of white cloths, and smeared with white sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_iast:
nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ /
tāmrapātraṃ guḍopetaṃ tasyopari niveśayet //
meaning:
नानाभक्ष्यसमोपेतं सहिरण्यं स्वशक्तितः /
ताम्रपात्रं गुडोपेतं तस्योपरि निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Furnished with various edibles, accompanied by gold according to one's means, / one should place upon it a copper vessel provided with jaggery.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra saṃpūjayeddevaṃ kāmarūpiṇamacyutam /
gandhādyairupacāraistu sopavāso pare 'hani //
meaning:
तत्र संपूजयेद्देवं कामरूपिणमच्युतम् /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैस्तु सोपवासो परे ऽहनि //
text_mt: There one should worship the god Acyuta, who assumes any desired form, / with offerings such as fragrant pastes; fasting, on the following day,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prātaḥ samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet /
brahmaṇānbhojayeccaiva tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
पुनः प्रातः समभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् /
ब्रह्मणान्भोजयेच्चैव तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: having worshipped again in the morning, one should present it to a Brahmin. / One should also feed Brahmins and give them a priestly gift.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣamevaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtadhenusamanvitām /
śayyāṃ tu dadyādgurave sarvopaskarasaṃyutām //
meaning:
वर्षमेवं व्रतं कृत्वा घृतधेनुसमन्विताम् /
शय्यां तु दद्याद्गुरवे सर्वोपस्करसंयुताम् //
text_mt: Having observed the vow in this way for a year, one should give a bed / provided with a clarified-butter cow and equipped with all utensils to the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanaṃ kāmadevaṃ ca śuktāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm /
vāsobhirdvijadāṃpatyaṃ pūjayitvā samarpayet //
meaning:
काञ्चनं कामदेवं च शुक्तां गां च पयस्विनीम् /
वासोभिर्द्विजदांपत्यं पूजयित्वा समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: and a golden Kāmadeva, and a white milch cow; / having honoured a Brahmin couple with garments, one should present [these],

sanskrit_iast:
prīyatāṃ kāmarūpī me harirityevamuccaran /
yaḥ kuryādvidhinānena madanadvādaśīvratam //
meaning:
प्रीयतां कामरूपी मे हरिरित्येवमुच्चरन् /
यः कुर्याद्विधिनानेन मदनद्वादशीव्रतम् //
text_mt: saying: "May Hari, who assumes any desired form, be pleased with me." / He who observes the vow of Madanadvādaśī according to this rule

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvapāpanirbhuktaḥ prāpnoti harisāmyatām /
asyāmeva samuddiṣṭaṃ bhartṛdvādaśikāvratam //
meaning:
स सर्वपापनिर्भुक्तः प्राप्नोति हरिसाम्यताम् /
अस्यामेव समुद्दिष्टं भर्तृद्वादशिकाव्रतम् //
text_mt: is freed from all sins and attains equality with Hari. / On this very [day], the vow of Bhartṛdvādaśī is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
svāstṛtāṃ tatra śayyāṃ tu kṛtvātra śrīyutaṃ harim /
saṃsthāpya maṇḍapaṃ puṣpaistaduparpyupakalpayet //
meaning:
स्वास्तृतां तत्र शय्यां तु कृत्वात्र श्रीयुतं हरिम् /
संस्थाप्य मण्डपं पुष्पैस्तदुपर्प्युपकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Having made a well-spread bed there, placing Hari together with Śrī upon it, / one should construct a pavilion above it with flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃpūjya gandhādyairvratī jāgaraṇaṃ niśi /
nṛtyavāditragītādyaistataḥ prātaḥ pare 'hani //
meaning:
ततः संपूज्य गन्धाद्यैर्व्रती जागरणं निशि /
नृत्यवादित्रगीताद्यैस्ततः प्रातः परे ऽहनि //
text_mt: Then, having worshipped with fragrant pastes and other [offerings], the vow-keeper [spends] the night keeping vigil / with dances, musical instruments, songs, and the like; then in the morning on the following day,

sanskrit_iast:
saśayyaṃ śrīhariṃ haimaṃ dvijagryāya nivedayet /
dvijānsaṃbhojya visṛjaddakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣitān //
meaning:
सशय्यं श्रीहरिं हैमं द्विजग्र्याय निवेदयेत् /
द्विजान्संभोज्य विसृजद्दक्षिणाभिः प्रतोषितान् //
text_mt: he should present the golden Śrīhari together with the bed to an eminent twice-born one. / Having fed the twice-born ones, he should dismiss [them], gratified with priestly gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavratasyāpi dāṃpatyaṃ jāyate sthiram /
saptajanmasu bhuṅkte ca bhogān lokadvayepsitān //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतस्यापि दांपत्यं जायते स्थिरम् /
सप्तजन्मसु भुङ्क्ते च भोगान् लोकद्वयेप्सितान् //
text_mt: Even so, the marital union of one who has observed this vow becomes enduring, / and for seven births he enjoys the desired pleasures of both worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ /
saṃpūjya mādhavaṃ bhaktyā gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
वैशाखशुक्लद्वादश्यां सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः /
संपूज्य माधवं भक्त्या गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः //
text_mt: On the bright twelfth [day] of Vaiśākha, fasting, with senses subdued, / having worshipped Mādhava with devotion through offerings such as fragrant pastes,

sanskrit_iast:
pakkānnaṃ tṛptijanakaṃ madhuraṃ sodakuṃbhakam /
viprāya dadyādvidhivanmādhavaḥ prīyatāmiti //
meaning:
पक्कान्नं तृप्तिजनकं मधुरं सोदकुंभकम् /
विप्राय दद्याद्विधिवन्माधवः प्रीयतामिति //
text_mt: one should duly give cooked food that produces satisfaction, sweet, accompanied by a water-jar, / to a Brahmin, saying: "May Mādhava be pleased."

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhaśuklāyāṃ pūjayitvā trivikramam /
gandhādyairmadhurānnāḍhyaṃ karaka vinivedayet //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां ज्येष्ठशुक्लायां पूजयित्वा त्रिविक्रमम् /
गन्धाद्यैर्मधुरान्नाढ्यं करक विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: On the bright twelfth [day] of Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped Trivikrama / with fragrant pastes and other [offerings], one should present a water pot filled with sweet food.

sanskrit_iast:
vratī dvijāya tatpaścādekabhaktaṃ samācaret /
vratenānena saṃtuṣṭo devadevastrivikramaḥ //
meaning:
व्रती द्विजाय तत्पश्चादेकभक्तं समाचरेत् /
व्रतेनानेन संतुष्टो देवदेवस्त्रिविक्रमः //
text_mt: After that, the vow-keeper should take a single meal. / Pleased by this vow, the god of gods Trivikrama

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti vipulānbhogānante mokṣaṃ ca nārada /
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ dvijāndvādaśa bhojayet //
meaning:
ददाति विपुलान्भोगानन्ते मोक्षं च नारद /
आषाढशुक्लद्वादश्यां द्विजान्द्वादश भोजयेत् //
text_mt: bestows abundant pleasures and liberation at the end, O Nārada. / On the bright twelfth [day] of Āṣāḍha, one should feed twelve twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
madhurānnena tānpūjya pṛthaggandhādikaiḥ kramāt /
tabhyo vāsāṃsi daṇḍāṃśca brahmasūtrāṇi mudrikāḥ //
meaning:
मधुरान्नेन तान्पूज्य पृथग्गन्धादिकैः क्रमात् /
तभ्यो वासांसि दण्डांश्च ब्रह्मसूत्राणि मुद्रिकाः //
text_mt: Having honoured them with sweet food and individually with fragrant pastes and other [offerings] in order, / [one should give] them garments, staffs, sacred threads, signet rings,

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇi ca dadedbhaktyā viṣṇumeṃ prīyatāmiti /
dvādaśyāṃ tu nabhaḥśukle śrīdharaṃ pūjayedvratī //
meaning:
पात्राणि च ददेद्भक्त्या विष्णुमें प्रीयतामिति /
द्वादश्यां तु नभःशुक्ले श्रीधरं पूजयेद्व्रती //
text_mt: and vessels with devotion, saying: "May Viṣṇu be pleased with me." / On the bright twelfth [day] of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa), the vow-keeper should worship Śrīdhara

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyaistatparo bhaktyā dadhibhaktairdvijottamān /
saṃbhojya dakṣiṇā raupyāṃ datvā natvā visarjjayet //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैस्तत्परो भक्त्या दधिभक्तैर्द्विजोत्तमान् /
संभोज्य दक्षिणा रौप्यां दत्वा नत्वा विसर्ज्जयेत् //
text_mt: with fragrant pastes and other [offerings], devoted to him; with curd-rice, having fed / the best of the twice-born and given a silver priestly gift, he should bow and dismiss them,

sanskrit_iast:
vratenānena deveśaḥ śrīdharaḥ prīyatāmiti /
dvādaśyāṃ nabhasyaśukle vratī saṃpūjya vāmanam //
meaning:
व्रतेनानेन देवेशः श्रीधरः प्रीयतामिति /
द्वादश्यां नभस्यशुक्ले व्रती संपूज्य वामनम् //
text_mt: [saying:] "May Śrīdhara, the lord of gods, be pleased by this vow." / On the bright twelfth [day] of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), the vow-keeper, having worshipped Vāmana,

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre bhojayedviprānpāyasairdvādaśaiva ca /
sauvarṇī dakṣiṇāṃ datvā viṣṇuprītikaro bhavet //
meaning:
तदग्रे भोजयेद्विप्रान्पायसैर्द्वादशैव च /
सौवर्णी दक्षिणां दत्वा विष्णुप्रीतिकरो भवेत् //
text_mt: should feed precisely twelve Brahmins in front of him with milk-rice; / giving a golden priestly gift, he becomes one who pleases Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāmiṣaśuklāyāṃ padmanābhaṃ samarcayet /
gandhādyairupacāraistu tadagre bhojayeddvijān //
meaning:
द्वादश्यामिषशुक्लायां पद्मनाभं समर्चयेत् /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैस्तु तदग्रे भोजयेद्द्विजान् //
text_mt: On the bright twelfth [day] of Iṣa (Āśvina), one should worship Padmanābha / with offerings such as fragrant pastes; in front of him one should feed twice-born ones

sanskrit_iast:
madhurānnena vastrāḍhyāṃ sauvarṇīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadet /
vratenaitena saṃtuṣṭaḥ padmanābho dvijottama //
meaning:
मधुरान्नेन वस्त्राढ्यां सौवर्णीं दक्षिणां ददेत् /
व्रतेनैतेन संतुष्टः पद्मनाभो द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: with sweet food, and should give a golden priestly gift along with garments. / Pleased by this vow, Padmanābha, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetadvīpagatiṃ dadyāddehabhogāṃśca vāñchitān /
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu govatsadvādaśīvratam //
meaning:
श्वेतद्वीपगतिं दद्याद्देहभोगांश्च वाञ्छितान् /
कार्तिके कृष्णपक्षे तु गोवत्सद्वादशीव्रतम् //
text_mt: bestows going to Śvetadvīpa and desired bodily pleasures. / In Kārttika, in the dark fortnight, however, [there is] the Govatsadvādaśī vow.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vatsayutāṃ gāṃ tu samālikhya sugandhibhiḥ /
candanādyaistathā puṣpamālābhiḥ prārcya tāmrake //
meaning:
तत्र वत्सयुतां गां तु समालिख्य सुगन्धिभिः /
चन्दनाद्यैस्तथा पुष्पमालाभिः प्रार्च्य ताम्रके //
text_mt: There, having depicted a cow together with a calf, worshipping it with fragrant / sandalwood pastes and other [unguents] and flower garlands, in a copper

sanskrit_iast:
pātre puṣpākṣatatilairarghyaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ /
pradadyātpādamūle 'syā mantreṇānena nārada //
meaning:
पात्रे पुष्पाक्षततिलैरर्घ्यं कृत्वा विधानतः /
प्रदद्यात्पादमूले ऽस्या मन्त्रेणानेन नारद //
text_mt: vessel having duly prepared an arghya offering with flowers, unbroken grains, and sesame seeds, / one should present it at her feet with this mantra, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūte surāsuranamaskṛte /
sarvadevamaye devi sarvadevairalaṅkṛte //
meaning:
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूते सुरासुरनमस्कृते /
सर्वदेवमये देवि सर्वदेवैरलङ्कृते //
text_mt: "O goddess born from the ocean of milk, bowed to by gods and asuras, / comprising all gods, adorned with all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
mātarmātargavāṃ mātargṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo 'stu te /
tato māṣādisaṃsiddhānvaṭakāṃśca nivedayet //
meaning:
मातर्मातर्गवां मातर्गृहाणार्घ्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते /
ततो माषादिसंसिद्धान्वटकांश्च निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: O mother, O mother, mother of cows, accept the arghya offering; homage to you!" / Then one should offer fried cakes prepared with black gram and other ingredients,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañca daśaikaṃ vā yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ /
surabhi tvaṃ jaganmātā nityaṃ viṣṇupade sthitā //
meaning:
एवं पञ्च दशैकं वा यथाविभवमात्मनः /
सुरभि त्वं जगन्माता नित्यं विष्णुपदे स्थिता //
text_mt: five, ten, or one, according to one's own means, [saying:] / "O Surabhi, you are the mother of the universe, eternally abiding in the abode of Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamaye grāsaṃ mayā dattamimaṃ grasa /
sarvadevamaye devi sarvadevairalaṅkṛte //
meaning:
सर्वदेवमये ग्रासं मया दत्तमिमं ग्रस /
सर्वदेवमये देवि सर्वदेवैरलङ्कृते //
text_mt: O you who comprise all gods, swallow this morsel given by me! / O goddess comprising all gods, adorned with all gods!"

sanskrit_iast:
mātarmamābhilaṣitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru nandinī /
taddine tailapakvaṃ ca sthālīpakvaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
मातर्ममाभिलषितं सफलं कुरु नन्दिनी /
तद्दिने तैलपक्वं च स्थालीपक्वं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
"O Mother, bringer of joy, fulfill my desire!"
On that day, O best of the twice-born, [food] fried in oil and cooked in a pot,

sanskrit_iast:
gokṣīraṃ goghṛtaṃ caiva dadhi takraṃ ca varjayet /
dvādaśyāmūrjaśuklāyāṃ devaṃ dāmodaraṃ dvija //
meaning:
गोक्षीरं गोघृतं चैव दधि तक्रं च वर्जयेत् /
द्वादश्यामूर्जशुक्लायां देवं दामोदरं द्विज //
text_mt:
Cow's milk, cow's ghee, curds, and buttermilk are to be avoided.
On the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Ūrja, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcyopacāraistu gandhādyaiḥ susamāhitaḥ /
tadagre bhojayedviprānpakvānnenārkasaṃkhyakān //
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्योपचारैस्तु गन्धाद्यैः सुसमाहितः /
तदग्रे भोजयेद्विप्रान्पक्वान्नेनार्कसंख्यकान् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the god Dāmodara with services, beginning with perfumes, highly concentrated,
One should feed twelve brāhmaṇas in front of him with cooked food.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kuṃbhānapāṃpūrṇānvastrācchannānsamarcitān /
sapūgamodakasvarṇāṃstebhyaḥ prītyā samarpayet //
meaning:
ततः कुंभानपांपूर्णान्वस्त्राच्छन्नान्समर्चितान् /
सपूगमोदकस्वर्णांस्तेभ्यः प्रीत्या समर्पयेत् //
text_mt:
Then, jars filled with water, covered with garments, and worshipped,
Together with betel-nuts, sweetmeats, and gold, he should lovingly offer to them.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte priyo viṣṇorjāyate 'khilabhogabhuk /
dehānte viṣṇusāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृते प्रियो विष्णोर्जायते ऽखिलभोगभुक् /
देहान्ते विष्णुसायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
When this is done, he becomes dear to Viṣṇu, enjoys all pleasures,
And at the end of his body attains union with Viṣṇu; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
nīrājanavrataṃ cātra gaditaṃ tannibodha me /
suptotthitaṃ jagannāthamalaṅkṛtya niśāgame //
meaning:
नीराजनव्रतं चात्र गदितं तन्निबोध मे /
सुप्तोत्थितं जगन्नाथमलङ्कृत्य निशागमे //
text_mt:
The rite of waving lights (nīrājana) is also declared here; learn it from me.
At the arrival of night, having adorned the Lord of the World who has awakened from sleep,

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkṛto navaṃ vahnimutpādyābhyarcya mantrataḥ /
hutvā tatra samuddīpte raupya dīpikayā mune //
meaning:
अलङ्कृतो नवं वह्निमुत्पाद्याभ्यर्च्य मन्त्रतः /
हुत्वा तत्र समुद्दीप्ते रौप्य दीपिकया मुने //
text_mt:
He himself adorned, producing fresh fire, worshipping it with mantras,
And having made fire oblations there when it is brightly kindled, O sage, with a silver lamp,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādyarcitayā janairnīrājayeddharim /
tatraivānugatāṃ lakṣmīṃ brahmāṇīṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पाद्यर्चितया जनैर्नीराजयेद्धरिम् /
तत्रैवानुगतां लक्ष्मीं ब्रह्माणीं चण्डिकां तथा //
text_mt:
Worshipped with perfume, flowers, and the like, people should wave lights before Hari,
And in the very same place, to Lakṣmī who attends him, as well as to Brahmāṇī and Caṇḍikā,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaṃ śaṅkaraṃ gaurīṃ yakṣaṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān /
mātṝḥ pitṝnnagānnāgānsarvānnīrājayetkramāt //
meaning:
आदित्यं शङ्करं गौरीं यक्षं गणपतिं ग्रहान् /
मातॄः पितॄन्नगान्नागान्सर्वान्नीराजयेत्क्रमात् //
text_mt:
To the Sun, Śaṅkara, Gaurī, the yakṣa, Gaṇapati, the planets,
The mothers, the ancestors, the mountains, and the serpents—he should wave lights before them all in order.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryānmahiṣyādeśca maṇḍalam /
namo jayeti śabdaiśca ghaṇṭāśaṅkhā diniḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
गवां नीराजनं कुर्यान्महिष्यादेश्च मण्डलम् /
नमो जयेति शब्दैश्च घण्टाशङ्खा दिनिःस्वनैः //
text_mt:
He should perform the waving of lights for cows, and for the herd of buffaloes and the like,
With the shouts of 'Salutations!' and 'Victory!', and with the sounds of bells, conches, and other instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūrāliptaśṛṅgāṇāṃ citrāṅgāṇāṃ ca varṇakaiḥ /
gavāṃ kolāhale vṛtte nīrājanamahotsave //
meaning:
सिंदूरालिप्तशृङ्गाणां चित्राङ्गाणां च वर्णकैः /
गवां कोलाहले वृत्ते नीराजनमहोत्सवे //
text_mt:
Their horns smeared with vermilion and their bodies painted with diverse colors,
While the tumult of the cows goes on during the great festival of waving lights,

sanskrit_iast:
turagāṃllakṣaṇopetām gajāṃśca madaviplutān /
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi cchatrādīni ca nārada //
meaning:
तुरगांल्लक्षणोपेताम् गजांश्च मदविप्लुतान् /
राजचिह्नानि सर्वाणि च्छत्रादीनि च नारद //
text_mt:
To horses endowed with auspicious marks and to elephants dripping with rut,
To all the royal emblems, umbrellas, and the rest, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
rājā purodhasā sārdhaṃ mantribhṛtyaparaḥ saraḥ /
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ nīrajya svayamādarāt //
meaning:
राजा पुरोधसा सार्धं मन्त्रिभृत्यपरः सरः /
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं नीरज्य स्वयमादरात् //
text_mt:
The king, together with his royal priest, preceded by his ministers and attendants,
Having duly worshipped and himself waved lights with reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhatūryādighoṣaiśca nānāratnavinirmite /
siṃhāsane nave kḷpte tiṣṭhetsamyagalaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खतूर्यादिघोषैश्च नानारत्नविनिर्मिते /
सिंहासने नवे कॢप्ते तिष्ठेत्सम्यगलङ्कृतः //
text_mt:
Amidst the sounds of conches, horns, and other instruments, should sit well adorned
Upon a newly fashioned throne made of various jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sulakṣaṇairyuktā veśyā vātha kulāṅganā /
śīrṣopari naredrasya tayā nīrājayecchanaiḥ //
meaning:
ततः सुलक्षणैर्युक्ता वेश्या वाथ कुलाङ्गना /
शीर्षोपरि नरेद्रस्य तया नीराजयेच्छनैः //
text_mt:
Then, endowed with auspicious marks, either a courtesan or a woman of noble family,
Through her, one should slowly wave lights over the head of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
evameṣā mahāsāṃtiḥ kartavyā prativatsaram /
rājñā vittavatānyena varṣamārogyamicchatā //
meaning:
एवमेषा महासांतिः कर्तव्या प्रतिवत्सरम् /
राज्ञा वित्तवतान्येन वर्षमारोग्यमिच्छता //
text_mt:
In this way, this great pacification rite should be performed every year
By a king or by another wealthy person desiring good health for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate śāntiruttamā /
nīrājanābhidhā vipra tadrogā yānti saṃkṣayam //
meaning:
येषां राष्ट्रे पुरे ग्रामे क्रियते शान्तिरुत्तमा /
नीराजनाभिधा विप्र तद्रोगा यान्ति संक्षयम् //
text_mt:
In whose realm, city, or village this excellent pacification rite
Named nīrājana is performed, O twice-born, their diseases come to an end.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśuklāyāṃ sādhyavratamanuttamam /
manobhavastathā prāṇo naro yātaśca vīryavān //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां मार्गशुक्लायां साध्यव्रतमनुत्तमम् /
मनोभवस्तथा प्राणो नरो यातश्च वीर्यवान् //
text_mt:
On the twelfth day of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, there is the unsurpassed rite of the Sādhyas.
Manobhava, Prāṇa, Nara, Yāta, the powerful [Vīryavān],

sanskrit_iast:
citirhayo nṛpaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā /
vibhuścāpi prabhuścaiva sādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
चितिर्हयो नृपश्चैव हंसो नारायणस्तथा /
विभुश्चापि प्रभुश्चैव साध्या द्वादश कीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
Citi, Haya, Nṛpa, Haṃsa, Nārāyaṇa,
Vibhu, and Prabhu—these are celebrated as the twelve Sādhyas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyairetāṃstandulakalpitān /
tato dvijāgryānsaṃbhojya dvādaśātra sudakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरेतांस्तन्दुलकल्पितान् /
ततो द्विजाग्र्यान्संभोज्य द्वादशात्र सुदक्षिणाः //
text_mt:
He should worship them, fashioned out of raw rice, with perfumes, flowers, and the rest;
Then, having fed the foremost twice-born, twelve in number here, and generous priestly gifts

sanskrit_iast:
datvā tebhyastu visṛjetprīyānnārayaṇastviti /
etasyāmeva viditaṃ dvādaśādityasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
दत्वा तेभ्यस्तु विसृजेत्प्रीयान्नारयणस्त्विति /
एतस्यामेव विदितं द्वादशादित्यसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt:
Having given to them, he should dismiss them with the thought: 'May Nārāyaṇa be pleased.'
On this very [day], the vow known as the Twelve Ādityas is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ tatrārcayeddhīmānādityāndvādaśāpi ca /
dhātāmitror'yamā pūṣā śakroṃ'śo varuṇo bhagaḥ //
meaning:
व्रतं तत्रार्चयेद्धीमानादित्यान्द्वादशापि च /
धातामित्रोर्ऽयमा पूषा शक्रोंऽशो वरुणो भगः //
text_mt:
In that rite, the wise man should worship all the twelve Ādityas:
Dhātṛ, Mitra, Aryaman, Pūṣan, Śakra, Aṃśa, Varuṇa, Bhaga,

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭā vivasvānsavitā viṣṇurdvādaśa īritāḥ /
pratimāsaṃ tu śuklāyāṃ dvādaśyāmarcya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
त्वष्टा विवस्वान्सविता विष्णुर्द्वादश ईरिताः /
प्रतिमासं तु शुक्लायां द्वादश्यामर्च्य यत्नतः //
text_mt:
Tvaṣṭṛ, Vivasvat, Savitṛ, and Viṣṇu are declared as the twelve.
Worshipping them diligently on the bright twelfth day each month,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣaṃ nayedvratānte tu pratimā dvādaśāpi ca /
haimīḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā bhojayitvā dvijottamān //
meaning:
वर्षं नयेद्व्रतान्ते तु प्रतिमा द्वादशापि च /
हैमीः संपूज्य विधिना भोजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् //
text_mt:
He should spend a year. At the conclusion of the vow, having worshipped according to rule
Twelve golden images, and having fed the best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
madhurānnaiḥ susatkṛtya pratyekaṃ cārpayedvratī /
eva vrataṃ naraḥ kṛtvā dvādaśādityasaṃjñakam //
meaning:
मधुरान्नैः सुसत्कृत्य प्रत्येकं चार्पयेद्व्रती /
एव व्रतं नरः कृत्वा द्वादशादित्यसंज्ञकम् //
text_mt:
Having honored them well with sweet dishes, the observer of the vow should offer [an image] to each one.
Having performed this vow named the Twelve Ādityas, a man

sanskrit_iast:
sūryalokaṃ samāsādya bhuktvā bhogāṃścaraṃ tataḥ /
jāyate bhuvi dharmātmā mānuṣye rogavarjitaḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यलोकं समासाद्य भुक्त्वा भोगांश्चरं ततः /
जायते भुवि धर्मात्मा मानुष्ये रोगवर्जितः //
text_mt:
Reaches the world of the Sun and enjoys pleasures for a long time; then
He is born on earth as a righteous person in a human form, free from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vratasya puṇyena punareva labhedvratam /
tatpuṇyena ravenbhitvā maṇḍalaṃ dvijasattama //
meaning:
ततो व्रतस्य पुण्येन पुनरेव लभेद्व्रतम् /
तत्पुण्येन रवेन्भित्वा मण्डलं द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt:
Then, through the merit of the vow, he attains the vow once again;
By its merit, having pierced the orb of the sun, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
nirañjanaṃ nirā kāraṃ nirdvandvaṃ brahma cāpnuyāt /
atraivākhaṇḍasaṃjñaṃ ca vratamukta dvijottama //
meaning:
निरञ्जनं निरा कारं निर्द्वन्द्वं ब्रह्म चाप्नुयात् /
अत्रैवाखण्डसंज्ञं च व्रतमुक्त द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
He attains Brahman, stainless, formless, and free from dualities.
Right here, the vow named Akhaṇḍa is declared, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiṃ nirmāya sauvarṇīṃ janārdanasamāhvayām /
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaistadagre bhojayeddvijān //
meaning:
मूर्तिं निर्माय सौवर्णीं जनार्दनसमाह्वयाम् /
अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैस्तदग्रे भोजयेद्द्विजान् //
text_mt:
Having fashioned a golden image named Janārdana,
And having worshipped it with perfume, flowers, and the rest, he should feed brāhmaṇas before it.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśa pratimāsaṃ tu naktāśīḥ syājjitendriyaḥ /
tataḥ samānte tāṃ mūrtiṃ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
द्वादश प्रतिमासं तु नक्ताशीः स्याज्जितेन्द्रियः /
ततः समान्ते तां मूर्तिं समभ्यर्च्य विधानतः //
text_mt:
Twelve [in number] each month, he should eat only at night, with controlled senses.
Then, at the end of the year, having worshipped that image according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
gurave dhenusahitāṃ dadyātsaṃprārthayettathā /
śatajanmasu yatkiñcinmayākhaṇḍavrataṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
गुरवे धेनुसहितां दद्यात्संप्रार्थयेत्तथा /
शतजन्मसु यत्किञ्चिन्मयाखण्डव्रतं कृतम् //
text_mt:
He should give it to the guru together with a cow, and he should pray thus:
'Whatever unbroken vow (akhaṇḍavrata) has been performed by me across a hundred births,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṇḍamihāstu me /
tataḥ saṃbhojya viprāgryānsakhaṇḍāḍhyaistu pāyasaiḥ //
meaning:
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन तदखण्डमिहास्तु मे /
ततः संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यान्सखण्डाढ्यैस्तु पायसैः //
text_mt:
O Lord, by your grace, let it be whole (akhaṇḍa) for me in this world.'
Then, having fed the foremost brāhmaṇas with milk-rice enriched with sugar candy,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśaiva hi sauvarṇīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pradadennamet /
iti kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra prīṇayitvā janārdanam //
meaning:
द्वादशैव हि सौवर्णीं दक्षिणां प्रददेन्नमेत् /
इति कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र प्रीणयित्वा जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
He should give a gift of gold to the twelve, and bow.
Having performed this vow in this manner, O twice-born, having pleased Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇena vimānena yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam /
pauṣasya kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ rūpavratamudīritam //
meaning:
सौवर्णेन विमानेन याति विष्णोः परं पदम् /
पौषस्य कृष्णद्वादश्यां रूपव्रतमुदीरितम् //
text_mt:
He goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu by means of a golden celestial chariot.
On the dark twelfth day of Pauṣa, the Rūpavrata is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
daśamyāṃ vidhivatsnātvā gṛhṇīyādgomayaṃ vratī /
śvetāyā vaikavarṇāyā antarikṣagataṃ dvija //
meaning:
दशम्यां विधिवत्स्नात्वा गृह्णीयाद्गोमयं व्रती /
श्वेताया वैकवर्णाया अन्तरिक्षगतं द्विज //
text_mt:
Having bathed according to rule on the tenth day, the observer of the vow should take cow dung
From a white or monochrome cow that has been caught in mid-air, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tena piṇḍikāḥ kalpya nārada /
śoṣayedātape dhṛtvā pātre tāmre 'tha mṛnmaye //
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशतं तेन पिण्डिकाः कल्प्य नारद /
शोषयेदातपे धृत्वा पात्रे ताम्रे ऽथ मृन्मये //
text_mt:
Having fashioned one hundred and eight balls from it, O Nārada,
Placing them in a copper or earthen vessel, he should dry them in the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāsaḥ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ /
sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇorniśāyāṃ jāgaraṃ caret //
meaning:
एकादश्यां सोपवासः समभ्यर्च्य विधानतः /
सौवर्णीं प्रतिमां विष्णोर्निशायां जागरं चरेत् //
text_mt:
Fasting on the eleventh day, having worshipped according to rule
A golden image of Viṣṇu, he should observe a vigil at night,

sanskrit_iast:
sumaṅgalairgītavādyaiḥ stotrapāṭhairjapādibhiḥ /
tataḥ prabhāte dvādaśyāṃ tilapātropari sthitām //
meaning:
सुमङ्गलैर्गीतवाद्यैः स्तोत्रपाठैर्जपादिभिः /
ततः प्रभाते द्वादश्यां तिलपात्रोपरि स्थिताम् //
text_mt:
With auspicious songs and instruments, recitation of hymns, japa, and the like.
Then, at dawn on the twelfth day, [placing] it on a vessel of sesame,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbupūrṇe ghaṭe nyasya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ /
tato 'gniṃ navamutpādya kāṣṭhasaṃgharṣaṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
अंबुपूर्णे घटे न्यस्य पूजयेदुपचारकैः /
ततो ऽग्निं नवमुत्पाद्य काष्ठसंघर्षणादिभिः //
text_mt:
Setting it upon a water-filled pot, he should worship it with offerings of service.
Then, producing fresh fire by rubbing pieces of wood and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ samabhyarcya vidhivadekaikāṃ piṇḍikāṃ sudhīḥ /
homayetsatilājyāṃ ca dvādaśākṣaravidyayā //
meaning:
तं समभ्यर्च्य विधिवदेकैकां पिण्डिकां सुधीः /
होमयेत्सतिलाज्यां च द्वादशाक्षरविद्यया //
text_mt:
Having worshipped it according to rule, the wise man should offer each ball into the fire,
Together with sesame and ghee, with the twelve-syllable mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavyātha ca pūraṇāṃ ca śatamaṣṭottara tataḥ /
bhojayetpāyasairviprānprītyā susnigdhamānasaḥ //
meaning:
वैष्णव्याथ च पूरणां च शतमष्टोत्तर ततः /
भोजयेत्पायसैर्विप्रान्प्रीत्या सुस्निग्धमानसः //
text_mt:
Or with the Vaiṣṇava [mantra], performing the full offering one hundred and eight times. Then,
With a tender and loving mind, he should lovingly feed brāhmaṇas with milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
sahitāṃ ca ghaṭenaiva pratimāṃ gurava'peyet /
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā datvā natvā visarjayet /
naro vā yadi vā nārī vrataṃ kṛtvaivamādarāt //
meaning:
सहितां च घटेनैव प्रतिमां गुरवऽपेयेत् /
विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणां शक्त्या दत्वा नत्वा विसर्जयेत् /
नरो वा यदि वा नारी व्रतं कृत्वैवमादरात् //
text_mt:
He should offer the image together with the pot to the guru.
Having given priestly gifts according to his means to the brāhmaṇas and bowed, he should dismiss them.
Whether a man or a woman, having performed the vow in this manner with reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate rūpasaubhāgyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
sahasye śuklapakṣe tu sujanmadvādaśīvratam //
meaning:
लभते रूपसौभाग्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
सहस्ये शुक्लपक्षे तु सुजन्मद्वादशीव्रतम् //
text_mt:
Attains beauty and good fortune; no doubt should be entertained on this point.
In the bright fortnight of Sahasya (Pauṣa), however, is the Sujanmadvādaśī vow.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā vidhānena gṛhṇoyādvārṣikavratam /
pītvā gaśṛṅgavāryādau tāṃ ca kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
स्नात्वा विधानेन गृह्णोयाद्वार्षिकव्रतम् /
पीत्वा गशृङ्गवार्यादौ तां च कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
Having bathed according to rule, one should undertake the year-long vow.
Having first drunk water from the cow's horns and having circumambulated her,

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ tataḥ śukledvādaśyāṃ dānamācaret /
ghṛtaprasthaṃ taccatuṣkaṃ kramādvīheryavasya ca //
meaning:
प्रतिमासं ततः शुक्लेद्वादश्यां दानमाचरेत् /
घृतप्रस्थं तच्चतुष्कं क्रमाद्वीहेर्यवस्य च //
text_mt:
He should then make gifts on the bright twelfth day each month:
A prastha of ghee, four of that in succession of rice and of barley,

sanskrit_iast:
dviraktikaṃ hema tilāḍhakārddhaṃ payasāṃ ghaṭam /
raupyasya māṣamekaṃ ca tṛptikṛnmiṣṭapakvakam //
meaning:
द्विरक्तिकं हेम तिलाढकार्द्धं पयसां घटम् /
रौप्यस्य माषमेकं च तृप्तिकृन्मिष्टपक्वकम् //
text_mt:
Two raktikās of gold, half an āḍhaka of sesame, a pot of milk,
A māṣa of silver, satisfying sweet cooked food,

sanskrit_iast:
chatraṃ māṣārdhahemnaśca prasthaṃ phaāṇitamuttamam /
candanaṃ palikaṃ vastraṃ pañcahastonmitaṃ tanum //
meaning:
छत्रं माषार्धहेम्नश्च प्रस्थं फआणितमुत्तमम् /
चन्दनं पलिकं वस्त्रं पञ्चहस्तोन्मितं तनुम् //
text_mt:
An umbrella, half a māṣa of gold, an excellent prastha of boiled sugarcane juice,
A pala of sandalwood, and fine cloth measuring five cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu māsikaṃ dānaṃ kṛtvā prāśya yathākramam /
gomūtraṃ jalamājyaṃ vā paktvā śākaṃ caturvidham //
meaning:
एवं तु मासिकं दानं कृत्वा प्राश्य यथाक्रमम् /
गोमूत्रं जलमाज्यं वा पक्त्वा शाकं चतुर्विधम् //
text_mt: Having made this monthly gift in this manner, and having consumed in order / cow urine, water, or ghee, and having cooked the fourfold greens,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhiyuktaṃ ca yāvānnaṃ tilājyaṃ śarkarānvitām /
darbhāṃbukṣīramuditaṃ prāśanaṃ pratimāsikam //
meaning:
दधियुक्तं च यावान्नं तिलाज्यं शर्करान्विताम् /
दर्भांबुक्षीरमुदितं प्राशनं प्रतिमासिकम् //
text_mt: and barley gruel mixed with curd, sesame seeds with ghee, and sugar, / the consumption of kuśa grass water and milk is prescribed month by month.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavrato varṣaṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ raveḥ /
kṛtvā vai tāmrapātrasthāṃ nyasyābhyarcya vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतो वर्षं सौवर्णीं प्रतिमां रवेः /
कृत्वा वै ताम्रपात्रस्थां न्यस्याभ्यर्च्य विधानतः //
text_mt: One who has observed the vow for a year in this manner, having fashioned a golden image of the Sun, / placed it in a copper vessel, and worshipped it according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
gurave dhenusahitāṃ pratyarpya praṇametpuraḥ /
viprāndrādaśa saṃbhojya tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
गुरवे धेनुसहितां प्रत्यर्प्य प्रणमेत्पुरः /
विप्रान्द्रादश संभोज्य तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: having offered it to the guru together with a cow, should bow before him. / Having fed twelve brāhmaṇas, he should give them a dakṣiṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavrato vipra janmāpnotyuttame kule /
nirogo dhanadhānyāḍhyo bhaveccāvikaledriyaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रतो विप्र जन्माप्नोत्युत्तमे कुले /
निरोगो धनधान्याढ्यो भवेच्चाविकलेद्रियः //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, one who has observed the vow in this manner takes birth in an excellent family; / he becomes free from disease, rich in wealth and grain, and with his senses unimpaired.

sanskrit_iast:
māghasya śukladvādaśyāṃ śālagrāmaśilāṃ dvija /
abhyacya vidhivadbhaktyā suvarṇaṃ tanmukhe nyaset //
meaning:
माघस्य शुक्लद्वादश्यां शालग्रामशिलां द्विज /
अभ्यच्य विधिवद्भक्त्या सुवर्णं तन्मुखे न्यसेत् //
text_mt: On the bright twelfth day of Māgha, O twice-born, / having worshipped the Śālagrāma stone properly with devotion, one should place gold on its mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ sthāpya raupyapātre tu sitavastrayugāvṛtām /
pradadyādvedaviduṣe taṃ hi saṃbhojayettataḥ //
meaning:
तां स्थाप्य रौप्यपात्रे तु सितवस्त्रयुगावृताम् /
प्रदद्याद्वेदविदुषे तं हि संभोजयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Having placed it in a silver vessel and covered it with a pair of white garments, / one should give it to a knower of the Vedas; one should then feed him

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasānnena khaṇḍājyasahitena hitena ca /
evaṃ kṛtvaikabhaktaḥ sanviṣṇu cintanatatparaḥ //
meaning:
पायसान्नेन खण्डाज्यसहितेन हितेन च /
एवं कृत्वैकभक्तः सन्विष्णु चिन्तनतत्परः //
text_mt: with rice-milk pudding accompanied by sugar and ghee, wholesome [and delicious]. / Having acted thus, taking a single meal, intent on meditation upon Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavaṃ labhate dhāma bhuktvā bhogānihepsitān /
antye sitāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
वैष्णवं लभते धाम भुक्त्वा भोगानिहेप्सितान् /
अन्त्ये सितायां द्वादश्यां सौवर्णीं प्रतिमां हरेः //
text_mt: after enjoying the desired pleasures here, he attains the abode of Viṣṇu. / On the final bright twelfth day, [making] a golden image of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairdadyādvedavide dvija /
dviṣaṭkasaṃkhyānviprāṃśca bhojayitvā ca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्दद्याद्वेदविदे द्विज /
द्विषट्कसंख्यान्विप्रांश्च भोजयित्वा च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: having worshipped it with fragrant scents, flowers, and the like, O twice-born, one should give it to a knower of the Vedas. / And having fed brāhmaṇas numbering twelve, and given dakṣiṇā,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā visarjayetpaścātsvayaṃ bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ /
trispṛśonmīlinī pakṣavarddhinī vañjulī tathā //
meaning:
दत्वा विसर्जयेत्पश्चात्स्वयं भुञ्जीत बान्धवैः /
त्रिस्पृशोन्मीलिनी पक्षवर्द्धिनी वञ्जुली तथा //
text_mt: and dismissed them thereafter, one should eat oneself with relatives. / Trispṛśā, Unmīlinī, Pakṣavarddhinī, and Vañjulī,

sanskrit_iast:
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī cāparājitā /
etā aṣṭau sadopoṣyā dvādaśyaḥ pāpahārikāḥ //
meaning:
जया च विजया चैव जयन्ती चापराजिता /
एता अष्टौ सदोपोष्या द्वादश्यः पापहारिकाः //
text_mt: and Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, and Aparājitā— / on these eight twelfth lunar days, which remove sins, one should always fast.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnārada uvāca
kīdṛśaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brahmannetāsāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tathā /
tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva yāścanyāḥ puṇyadāyukāḥ //
meaning:
श्रीनारद उवाच
कीदृशं लक्षणं ब्रह्मन्नेतासां किं फलं तथा /
तत्सर्वं मे समाचक्ष्व याश्चन्याः पुण्यदायुकाः //
text_mt: Śrī Nārada said: / What is the characteristic of these, O holy one? What is their fruit? / Tell me all that, and whatever others bestow merit.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
itthaṃ sanātanaḥ pṛṣṭo nāradena dvijottamaḥ /
praśasya bhrātaraṃ prāha mahābhāgavataṃ muniḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्थं सनातनः पृष्टो नारदेन द्विजोत्तमः /
प्रशस्य भ्रातरं प्राह महाभागवतं मुनिः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Questioned thus by Nārada, the sage Sanātana, best of the twice-born, / praised his brother, the great devotee of the Lord, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhrātaḥ sādhūnāṃ saṃśayacchidā /
vakṣye mahādvādaśīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca phalaṃ pṛthak //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
साधु पृष्टं त्वया भ्रातः साधूनां संशयच्छिदा /
वक्ष्ये महाद्वादशीनां लक्षणं च फलं पृथक् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Well asked by you, brother, who cuts away the doubts of the virtuous! / I shall declare the characteristic and separate fruit of the great twelfth lunar days.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī nivṛttā cetsūryasyodayataḥ purā /
tadā tu trispṛśā nāma dvādaśī sā mahāphalā //
meaning:
एकादशी निवृत्ता चेत्सूर्यस्योदयतः पुरा /
तदा तु त्रिस्पृशा नाम द्वादशी सा महाफला //
text_mt: If the eleventh lunar day terminates before sunrise, / then that twelfth lunar day is named Trispṛśā, and bears great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāmupoṣya govindaṃ yaḥ pūjayati nārada /
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ labhate dhruvam //
meaning:
अस्यामुपोष्य गोविन्दं यः पूजयति नारद /
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं लभते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Fasting on this and worshipping Govinda, O Nārada, / one surely attains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāruṇodaye viddhā daśamyaikādaśī tithiḥ /
tadā tāṃ saṃparityajya dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet //
meaning:
यदारुणोदये विद्धा दशम्यैकादशी तिथिः /
तदा तां संपरित्यज्य द्वादशीं समुपोषयेत् //
text_mt: When the eleventh lunar day is penetrated by the tenth at dawn, / then, abandoning it, one should fast on the twelfth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatreṣṭvā vāsudevākhyaṃ samyakpūjāvidhānataḥ /
rājasūyasahasrasya phalamunmīlite labhet //
meaning:
तत्रेष्ट्वा वासुदेवाख्यं सम्यक्पूजाविधानतः /
राजसूयसहस्रस्य फलमुन्मीलिते लभेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the one named Vāsudeva there according to the proper ritual of worship, / one attains the fruit of a thousand Rājasūya sacrifices on the Unmīlitā.

sanskrit_iast:
yadodaye tu savituryāmyā tvekādaśīṃ spṛśet /
tadā vañjulikākhyāṃ tu tāṃ tyaktvopoṣayetsadā //
meaning:
यदोदये तु सवितुर्याम्या त्वेकादशीं स्पृशेत् /
तदा वञ्जुलिकाख्यां तु तां त्यक्त्वोपोषयेत्सदा //
text_mt: When at sunrise the Yamī [Dvādaśī] touches the eleventh lunar day, / then, leaving it aside, one should always fast on the one named Vañjulikā.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ /
pūjayetsatataṃ bhaktyā sarvasyābhayadaṃ param //
meaning:
अस्यां संकर्षणं देवं गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः /
पूजयेत्सततं भक्त्या सर्वस्याभयदं परम् //
text_mt: On this day one should constantly worship with devotion the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, the supreme granter of fearlessness to all, / with offerings such as fragrant pastes.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā mahādvādaśī tu sarvakratuphalapradā /
sarvapāpaharā proktā sarvasaṃpatpradāyinī //
meaning:
एषा महाद्वादशी तु सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदा /
सर्वपापहरा प्रोक्ता सर्वसंपत्प्रदायिनी //
text_mt: This great twelfth day grants the fruit of all sacrifices; / it is declared to remove all sins and bestow all prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
kuhūrāke yadā vṛddhe syātāṃ vipra yadā tadā /
pakṣavarddhanikā nāma dvādaśī sā mahāphalā //
meaning:
कुहूराके यदा वृद्धे स्यातां विप्र यदा तदा /
पक्षवर्द्धनिका नाम द्वादशी सा महाफला //
text_mt: When, O brāhmaṇa, the new-moon day or the full-moon day expands, / that twelfth day of great fruit is named Pakṣavarddhanikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ pradyumnaṃ jagatāṃ patim /
sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ sākṣātputra pautravivardhanam //
meaning:
तस्यां संपूजयेद्देवं प्रद्युम्नं जगतां पतिम् /
सर्वैश्वर्य्यप्रदं साक्षात्पुत्र पौत्रविवर्धनम् //
text_mt: On that day one should thoroughly worship the god Pradyumna, the lord of the worlds, / who directly bestows all sovereignty and increases sons and grandsons.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu dhavale pakṣe dvādaśī syānmadhānvitā //ṭha
tadā proktā jayā nāma sarvaśatruvināśinī //
meaning:
यदा तु धवले पक्षे द्वादशी स्यान्मधान्विता //ठ
तदा प्रोक्ता जया नाम सर्वशत्रुविनाशिनी //
text_mt: When in the bright fortnight the twelfth day is conjoined with Maghā, / then it is declared to be Jayā, which destroys all enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ saṃpūjayeddeva maniruddhaṃ ramāpatim /
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyakam //
meaning:
अस्यां संपूजयेद्देव मनिरुद्धं रमापतिम् /
सर्वकामप्रदं नॄणां सर्वसौभाग्यदायकम् //
text_mt: On this day one should worship the god Aniruddha, the husband of Ramā, / who grants all desires to mortals and bestows all good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇarkṣayutā cetsyāddvādaśī dhavale dale /
tadā sā vijayā nāma tasyāmacedgadādharam //
meaning:
श्रवणर्क्षयुता चेत्स्याद्द्वादशी धवले दले /
तदा सा विजया नाम तस्यामचेद्गदाधरम् //
text_mt: If the twelfth day in the bright half is joined with the asterism Śravaṇa, / then it is Vijayā by name; on it one should worship the Mace-Bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaukhyapradaṃ śaśvatsarvabhogaparāyaṇam /
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ vipra tāṃ copoṣyāpnuyānnaraḥ //
meaning:
सर्वसौख्यप्रदं शश्वत्सर्वभोगपरायणम् /
सर्वतीर्थफलं विप्र तां चोपोष्याप्नुयान्नरः //
text_mt: He continually grants all happiness and is the goal of all enjoyment. / Fasting on it, O brāhmaṇa, a man obtains the fruit of all sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā syācca site pakṣe prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā /
dvādaśī sā mahāpuṇyā jayantī nāmataḥ smṛtā //
meaning:
यदा स्याच्च सिते पक्षे प्राजापत्यर्क्षसंयुता /
द्वादशी सा महापुण्या जयन्ती नामतः स्मृता //
text_mt: When in the bright fortnight the twelfth day is conjoined with the asterism Rohiṇī, / that highly meritorious twelfth day is known by the name Jayantī.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ samarccayeddevaṃ vāmanaṃ siddhidaṃ nṛṇām /
upoṣitaiṣā viprendra sarvavrataphalapradā //
meaning:
यस्यां समर्च्चयेद्देवं वामनं सिद्धिदं नृणाम् /
उपोषितैषा विप्रेन्द्र सर्वव्रतफलप्रदा //
text_mt: On it one should worship the god Vāmana, who grants success to mortals. / Fasted upon, O prince of brāhmaṇas, this bestows the fruit of all vows,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadānaphalā cāpi bhuktimuktipradāyinī /
yadā tu syātsite pakṣe dvādaśī jīvabhānvitā //
meaning:
सर्वदानफला चापि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायिनी /
यदा तु स्यात्सिते पक्षे द्वादशी जीवभान्विता //
text_mt: gives the fruit of all gifts, and grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / But when in the bright fortnight the twelfth day is joined with the asterism Puṣya,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāparājitā proktā sarvajñā napradāyinī /
asyāṃ samarcayeddevaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam //
meaning:
तदापराजिता प्रोक्ता सर्वज्ञा नप्रदायिनी /
अस्यां समर्चयेद्देवं नारायणमनामयम् //
text_mt: then it is declared to be Aparājitā, which bestows omniscience. / On this day one should worship the free-from-affliction god Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārapāśavicchittikārakaṃ jñānasāgaram /
asyāstūpoṣaṇādeva muktaḥ syādvipra bhojanaḥ //
meaning:
संसारपाशविच्छित्तिकारकं ज्ञानसागरम् /
अस्यास्तूपोषणादेव मुक्तः स्याद्विप्र भोजनः //
text_mt: the causer of the cutting of worldly bonds, the ocean of knowledge. / Merely by fasting on this, O brāhmaṇa, a mortal becomes liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tvāṣāḍhaśuklāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ maitrabhaṃ bhavet /
tadā vratadvayaṃ kāryyaṃ na doṣo 'traikadaivatam //
meaning:
यदा त्वाषाढशुक्लायां द्वादश्यां मैत्रभं भवेत् /
तदा व्रतद्वयं कार्य्यं न दोषो ऽत्रैकदैवतम् //
text_mt: When on the bright twelfth of Āṣāḍha there is the asterism Anurādhā, / then a double vow is to be performed; there is no fault in this, since the deity is one.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇarkṣayutāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ bhādraśuklake /
ūrjje sitāyāṃ dvādaśyāmantyabhe ca vratadvayam //
meaning:
श्रवणर्क्षयुतायां च द्वादश्यां भाद्रशुक्लके /
ऊर्ज्जे सितायां द्वादश्यामन्त्यभे च व्रतद्वयम् //
text_mt: And on the twelfth in the bright Bhādrapada conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇa, / and on the bright twelfth of Kārttika with the final asterism, there is a double vow.

sanskrit_iast:
etābhyo 'ntra viprendra dvādaśyāmekabhuktakam /
nisargataḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ vrataṃ pātakanāśanam //
meaning:
एताभ्यो ऽन्त्र विप्रेन्द्र द्वादश्यामेकभुक्तकम् /
निसर्गतः समुद्दिष्टं व्रतं पातकनाशनम् //
text_mt: Apart from these, O prince of brāhmaṇas, eating once on the twelfth day / is naturally prescribed as a vow that destroys fallenness.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyā vrataṃ nityaṃ dvādaśyāḥ sahitaṃ yataḥ /
nodyāpanamihoddiṣṭaṃ karttavyaṃ jīvitāvidhi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe bṛhadupākhyāne pūrvabhāge caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasya dvādaśīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एकादश्या व्रतं नित्यं द्वादश्याः सहितं यतः /
नोद्यापनमिहोद्दिष्टं कर्त्तव्यं जीविताविधि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे बृहदुपाख्याने पूर्वभागे चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्य द्वादशीव्रतनिरूपणं नामैकविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Since the vow of the eleventh day is regular together with the twelfth, / no concluding rite is prescribed here; it should be performed throughout life.

Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-first chapter in the fourth quarter of the first part in the Great Purāṇa of Nārada, in the Great Narrative, entitled 'Determination of the Vow of the Twelfth Day of the Twelve Months.'

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
athātaṛ saṃpravakṣyāmi trayodaśyā vratāni te /
yāni kṛtvā naro bhaktyā subhago jāyate bhuvi //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
अथातऋ संप्रवक्ष्यामि त्रयोदश्या व्रतानि ते /
यानि कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या सुभगो जायते भुवि //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Now I shall declare to you the vows of the thirteenth day, / performing which with devotion a man becomes fortunate on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
madhau śuklatrayodaśyāṃ madanaṃ candanātmakam /
kṛtvā saṃpūjya yatnena vījeyavdyajanena ca //
meaning:
मधौ शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां मदनं चन्दनात्मकम् /
कृत्वा संपूज्य यत्नेन वीजेयव्द्यजनेन च //
text_mt: In Madhu, on the bright thirteenth day, having made Madana out of sandalwood, / having worshipped him with diligence, and fanned him with a fan,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃkṣudhitaḥ kāmaḥ putrapautravivarddhanaḥ /
anaṅgapūjāpyatroktā tāṃ nibodha munīśvara //
meaning:
ततः संक्षुधितः कामः पुत्रपौत्रविवर्द्धनः /
अनङ्गपूजाप्यत्रोक्ता तां निबोध मुनीश्वर //
text_mt: then Kāma, aroused, causes the increase of sons and grandsons. / The worship of the Bodiless One is also declared here; learn that, O lord of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sindūrarajanīrāgaiḥ phalake 'naṅgamālikhet /
ratiprītiyutaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ puṣpacāpeṣudhāriṇam //
meaning:
सिन्दूररजनीरागैः फलके ऽनङ्गमालिखेत् /
रतिप्रीतियुतं श्लक्ष्णं पुष्पचापेषुधारिणम् //
text_mt: With red-lead and turmeric colors, one should paint the Bodiless One on a board, / smooth, accompanied by Rati and Prīti, holding a bow and arrows of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmadevaṃ vasantaṃ ca vājivaktraṃ vṛṣadhvajam /
madhyāhne pūjayedbhaktyā gandhasragbhūṣaṇāṃśukaiḥ //
meaning:
कामदेवं वसन्तं च वाजिवक्त्रं वृषध्वजम् /
मध्याह्ने पूजयेद्भक्त्या गन्धस्रग्भूषणांशुकैः //
text_mt: At midday, one should worship Kāmadeva, Spring, the Horse-Faced one, and the Bull-Bannered one with devotion, / with fragrant scents, garlands, ornaments, and garments,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣabhyairnānāvidhaiścāpi mantreṇānena nārada /
namo mārāya kāmāya kāmadevasya mūrttaye //
meaning:
क्षभ्यैर्नानाविधैश्चापि मन्त्रेणानेन नारद /
नमो माराय कामाय कामदेवस्य मूर्त्तये //
text_mt: and with various kinds of foods to be chewed, O Nārada, with this mantra: / 'Homage to Māra, to Kāma, to the embodiment of Kāmadeva,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivendrāṇāṃ manaḥbhobhakarāya vai /
tattasyāgrato bhaktyā pūjayedaṅganāpatim //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवेन्द्राणां मनःभोभकराय वै /
तत्तस्याग्रतो भक्त्या पूजयेदङ्गनापतिम् //
text_mt: who truly agitates the minds of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Indra.' / Then in front of him, one should worship with devotion the husband of the woman.

sanskrit_iast:
vastramālyāvibhūṣādyaiḥ kāmo 'yamiti cintayet /
saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyaṃ gandhavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
वस्त्रमाल्याविभूषाद्यैः कामो ऽयमिति चिन्तयेत् /
संपूज्य द्विजदांपत्यं गन्धवस्त्रविभूषणैः //
text_mt: With garments, garlands, ornaments, and the like, one should think: 'This is Kāma.' / Having worshipped a brāhmaṇa married couple with fragrant scents, garments, and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra varṣe varṣe mahotsavam /
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ sadaiva saḥ //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र वर्षे वर्षे महोत्सवम् /
वसंतसमये प्राप्ते हृष्टः पुष्टः सदैव सः //
text_mt: The twice-born who performs such a great festival year after year / when springtime arrives is ever delighted and well-nourished.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ pūjayedvā yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate /
madanaṃ hṛdbhavaṃ kāmaṃ manmathaṃ ca ratipriyam //
meaning:
प्रतिमासं पूजयेद्वा यावद्वर्षं समाप्यते /
मदनं हृद्भवं कामं मन्मथं च रतिप्रियम् //
text_mt: Or he may worship each month until the year is completed: / Madana, Hṛdbhava, Kāma, Manmatha, and Ratipriya,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgaṃ caiva kandarpaṃ pūjayenmakaradhvajam /
kusumāyudhasaṃjñaṃ ca tataḥ paścānmanobhavam //
meaning:
अनङ्गं चैव कन्दर्पं पूजयेन्मकरध्वजम् /
कुसुमायुधसंज्ञं च ततः पश्चान्मनोभवम् //
text_mt: Anaṅga, Kandarpa, Makaradhvaja, / the one named Kusumāyudha, and thereafter Manobhava,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣameṣu tathā vipra mālartāpriyamityapi /
ajāyā dānamapyuktaṃ snātvā nadyā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
विषमेषु तथा विप्र मालर्ताप्रियमित्यपि /
अजाया दानमप्युक्तं स्नात्वा नद्या विधानतः //
text_mt: likewise, O twice-born, Viṣameṣu and Mālartāpriya. / Having bathed in a river according to the prescribed rule, the gift of a she-goat is also enjoined.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāḥ payasvinīrdadyāddaridrāya kuṭuṃbine /
bhūyastvanena dānena sa loke naiva jāyate //
meaning:
अजाः पयस्विनीर्दद्याद्दरिद्राय कुटुंबिने /
भूयस्त्वनेन दानेन स लोके नैव जायते //
text_mt: He should give milch she-goats to an impoverished householder; / by this gift, indeed, he is never born again in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
yadīyaṃ śaninā yuktā sā mahāvāruṇī smṛtā /
gaṅgāyāṃ yadi labhyeta koṭisūryagrahādhikā //
meaning:
यदीयं शनिना युक्ता सा महावारुणी स्मृता /
गङ्गायां यदि लभ्येत कोटिसूर्यग्रहाधिका //
text_mt: If this [thirteenth tithi] is conjoined with Saturn, it is known as the Mahāvāruṇī; / if it is attained at the Gaṅgā, it is greater than ten million solar eclipses.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhayogaḥ śatarkṣaṃ ca śanau kāme madhau site /
mahāmaheti vikhyātā kulakoṭivimuktidā //
meaning:
शुभयोगः शतर्क्षं च शनौ कामे मधौ सिते /
महामहेति विख्याता कुलकोटिविमुक्तिदा //
text_mt: With an auspicious conjunction, the Śatabhiṣaj lunar mansion, on Saturn's day, on the thirteenth, in the bright fortnight of Madhu, / it is renowned as the Mahāmahā, bestowing liberation on ten million ancestors of one's lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ kāmadevavrataṃ smṛtam /
tatra gandhādibhiḥ kāmaṃ pūjayedupavāsavān //
meaning:
