राधशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां कामदेवव्रतं स्मृतम् /
तत्र गन्धादिभिः कामं पूजयेदुपवासवान् //
text_mt: The vow of Kāmadeva is remembered to take place on the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha; / fasting on that day, one should worship Kāma with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ tataḥ paścāttrayodaśyāṃ site dale /
evameva vrataṃ kāryaṃ varṣānte gāmalaṅkṛtām //
meaning:
प्रतिमासं ततः पश्चात्त्रयोदश्यां सिते दले /
एवमेव व्रतं कार्यं वर्षान्ते गामलङ्कृताम् //
text_mt: Thereafter, every month on the thirteenth of the bright fortnight, / this vow must be performed in the very same way. At the end of the year, an adorned cow

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādviprāya satkṛtya vratasāṃgatvasiddhaye /
jyeṣṭhaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ daurbhāgyaśamanaṃ vratam //
meaning:
दद्याद्विप्राय सत्कृत्य व्रतसांगत्वसिद्धये /
ज्येष्ठशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां दौर्भाग्यशमनं व्रतम् //
text_mt: should be given to a twice-born after honoring him, for the successful completion of the vow. / On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, there is a vow that quells misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā nadītoye pūjayecchucideśajam /
śvetamandāramarkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा नदीतोये पूजयेच्छुचिदेशजम् /
श्वेतमन्दारमर्कं वा करवीरं च रक्तकम् //
text_mt: Having bathed there in the river water, one should worship, grown in a pure place, / a white mandāra, or an arka, and a red karavīra.

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ prārthayenmantratastadā /
mandārakaravīrārkā bhavanto bhāskarāṃśajāḥ //
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य गगने सूर्यं प्रार्थयेन्मन्त्रतस्तदा /
मन्दारकरवीरार्का भवन्तो भास्करांशजाः //
text_mt: Looking at the sun in the sky, one should then pray with this mantra: / 'O mandāra, karavīra, and arka, you are born from portions of the Sun!

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitā mama daurbhāgyaṃ nāśayantu namo 'stu vaḥ /
itthaṃ yor'cayate bhaktyā varṣe varṣe drumatrayam //
meaning:
पूजिता मम दौर्भाग्यं नाशयन्तु नमो ऽस्तु वः /
इत्थं योर्ऽचयते भक्त्या वर्षे वर्षे द्रुमत्रयम् //
text_mt: Having been worshipped, may you destroy my misfortune! Salutations unto you!' / He who worships these three trees with devotion in this manner year after year,

sanskrit_iast:
naśyate tasya daurbhāgyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
śuciśuklatrayodaśyāmekabhaktaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
नश्यते तस्य दौर्भाग्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
शुचिशुक्लत्रयोदश्यामेकभक्तं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: his misfortune is destroyed; no doubt should be entertained here. / On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, one should observe a single meal.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā jagannāthāvumāmāheśvarī tanūḥ /
haimyau raupyau ca mṛnmapyau yathāśaktyā vidhāya ca //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथावुमामाहेश्वरी तनूः /
हैम्यौ रौप्यौ च मृन्मप्यौ यथाशक्त्या विधाय च //
text_mt: Having worshipped the Lords of the Universe, the bodies of Umā and Maheśvara, / fashioned of gold, silver, or clay according to one's means,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhokṣasthe devagṛhe goṣṭhe brāhmaṇaveśmani /
sthāpayitvā pratiṣṭhāpya daivamantreṇa nārada //
meaning:
सिंहोक्षस्थे देवगृहे गोष्ठे ब्राह्मणवेश्मनि /
स्थापयित्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य दैवमन्त्रेण नारद //
text_mt: seated on a lion and a bull, in a temple, in a cowshed, or in a brāhmaṇa's house, / having installed and consecrated them with divine mantras, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pañcadinaṃ pūjā caikabhaktaṃ vrataṃ tathā /
tṛtīyadivase prātaḥ snātvā saṃpūjya tau punaḥ //
meaning:
ततः पञ्चदिनं पूजा चैकभक्तं व्रतं तथा /
तृतीयदिवसे प्रातः स्नात्वा संपूज्य तौ पुनः //
text_mt: there is worship for five days, and likewise the vow of a single meal. / On the third day, having bathed in the morning and worshipped the two again,

sanskrit_iast:
samarpaṇīyau viprāya vedavedāṅgaśāline /
varṣe varṣe tataḥ paścādvidheyaṃ varṣapañcakam //
meaning:
समर्पणीयौ विप्राय वेदवेदाङ्गशालिने /
वर्षे वर्षे ततः पश्चाद्विधेयं वर्षपञ्चकम् //
text_mt: they must be presented to a twice-born possessing the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. / Thereafter, year after year, it should be performed for five years.

sanskrit_iast:
tadante dhenuyugmena sahitau tau pradāpayet /
itthaṃ naro vā nārī vā kṛtvā vratamidaṃ śubham //
meaning:
तदन्ते धेनुयुग्मेन सहितौ तौ प्रदापयेत् /
इत्थं नरो वा नारी वा कृत्वा व्रतमिदं शुभम् //
text_mt: At the conclusion of that period, one should give the two along with a pair of cows. / A man or a woman who has performed this auspicious vow in this manner

sanskrit_iast:
naiva dāṃpatyavicchedaṃ labhate saptajanmasu /
nabhaḥ śuklatrayodaśyāṃ ratikāmavrataṃ śubham //
meaning:
नैव दांपत्यविच्छेदं लभते सप्तजन्मसु /
नभः शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां रतिकामव्रतं शुभम् //
text_mt: never suffers separation between husband and wife for seven births. / On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, there is the auspicious vow of Rati and Kāma,

sanskrit_iast:
vaidhavyavāraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ tathā saṃtānavardhanam /
kṛtopavāsā kanyaiva nārī vā dvijasattama //
meaning:
वैधव्यवारणं स्त्रीणां तथा संतानवर्धनम् /
कृतोपवासा कन्यैव नारी वा द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: which averts widowhood for women and increases offspring. / Fasting, whether an unmarried maiden or a married woman, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmre vā mṛnmaye vāpi sauvarṇe rājate tathā /
ratikāmau pravinyasya gandhādyaiḥ samyagarcayet //
meaning:
ताम्रे वा मृन्मये वापि सौवर्णे राजते तथा /
रतिकामौ प्रविन्यस्य गन्धाद्यैः सम्यगर्चयेत् //
text_mt: having placed Rati and Kāma upon a copper, clay, golden, / or silver vessel, one should worship them properly with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dvijadāṃpatyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ nimantrya ca /
satakṛtya bhojya pratime dadyāttābhyāṃ sadakṣiṇe //
meaning:
ततस्तु द्विजदांपत्यं चतुर्दश्यां निमन्त्र्य च /
सतकृत्य भोज्य प्रतिमे दद्यात्ताभ्यां सदक्षिणे //
text_mt: Then, having invited a twice-born couple on the fourteenth, / honoring them and feeding them, one should give the two images to them along with a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ caturdaśābdaṃ ca kṛtvā vratamanuttamam /
dhenuyugmānvite deye vratasaṃpūrtihetave //
meaning:
एवं चतुर्दशाब्दं च कृत्वा व्रतमनुत्तमम् /
धेनुयुग्मान्विते देये व्रतसंपूर्तिहेतवे //
text_mt: Having performed this unsurpassed vow in this manner for fourteen years, / [two images] accompanied by a pair of cows must be given for the sake of the vow's complete fulfillment.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ gotrirātravrataṃ smṛtam /
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇaṃ vāpi rājatam //
meaning:
भाद्रशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां गोत्रिरात्रव्रतं स्मृतम् /
लक्ष्मीनारायणं कृत्वा सौवर्णं वापि राजतम् //
text_mt: On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, the Go-trirātra vow is remembered. / Having made images of Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa from gold or silver,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya maṇḍale 'ṣṭadale śubhe /
pīṭhe vinyasya vastrāḍhyaṃ gandhādyaiḥ paripūjayet //
meaning:
पञ्चामृतेन संस्नाप्य मण्डले ऽष्टदले शुभे /
पीठे विन्यस्य वस्त्राढ्यं गन्धाद्यैः परिपूजयेत् //
text_mt: bathing them with the five nectars, placing them on an auspicious eight-petalled sacred diagram / and a ritual seat, lavishly adorned with garments, one should worship them completely with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
ārārtikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyātsānnodakaṃ ghaṭam /
evaṃ dinatrayaṃ kṛtvā vratānte māsamarcya ca //
meaning:
आरार्तिकं ततः कृत्वा दद्यात्सान्नोदकं घटम् /
एवं दिनत्रयं कृत्वा व्रतान्ते मासमर्च्य च //
text_mt: Then, having performed the wave-offering of lamps, one should give a pot with food and water. / Having done this for three days and worshipped for a month at the end of the vow,

sanskrit_iast:
samyagarthaṃ ca saṃpādya dadyānmantreṇa nārada /
pañcagāvaḥ samutpannā mathyamāne mahodadhau //
meaning:
सम्यगर्थं च संपाद्य दद्यान्मन्त्रेण नारद /
पञ्चगावः समुत्पन्ना मथ्यमाने महोदधौ //
text_mt: and having properly prepared the offering, one should give it with the mantra, O Nārada: / 'Five cows arose when the great ocean was churned;

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ madhye tu yā nandā tasyai dhenvai namo namaḥ /
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tato dadyādviprāya mantrataḥ //
meaning:
तासां मध्ये तु या नन्दा तस्यै धेन्वै नमो नमः /
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ततो दद्याद्विप्राय मन्त्रतः //
text_mt: among them, salutations, salutations to that milch cow Nandā!' / Then, having circumambulated it, one should give it to a twice-born with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ /
gāvo me pārśvataḥ saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham //
meaning:
गावो ममाग्रतः सन्तु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः /
गावो मे पार्श्वतः संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् //
text_mt: 'May cows be in front of me; may cows be behind me; / may cows be at my sides; may I dwell in the midst of cows!'

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca dvijadāṃpatyaṃ samyagabhyarcya bhojayet /
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tasmai satkṛtya pratipādayet //
meaning:
ततश्च द्विजदांपत्यं सम्यगभ्यर्च्य भोजयेत् /
लक्ष्मीनारायणं तस्मै सत्कृत्य प्रतिपादयेत् //
text_mt: Then, having duly worshipped a twice-born couple, one should feed them; / honoring him, one should present the image of Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa to that twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca /
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti gotrirātravratācca tat //
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्राणि राजसूयशतानि च /
कृत्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति गोत्रिरात्रव्रताच्च तत् //
text_mt: Whatever fruit one attains by performing thousands of horse-sacrifices / and hundreds of royal-consecration sacrifices, that is attained through the Go-trirātra vow.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣe śuklatrayodaśyāṃ trirātraśokakavratam /
haimaṃ hyaśokaṃ nirmāya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
इषे शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां त्रिरात्रशोककव्रतम् /
हैमं ह्यशोकं निर्माय पूजयित्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, there is the three-night Aśoka vow. / Having fashioned a golden aśoka tree and worshipped it according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaparā nārī nityaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇāḥ /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vipra mantreṇānena sādaram //
meaning:
उपवासपरा नारी नित्यं कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाः /
अष्टोत्तरशतं विप्र मन्त्रेणानेन सादरम् //
text_mt: the woman devoted to fasting should continuously perform circumambulations / one hundred and eight times, O twice-born, with respect and with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
hareṇa nirmitaḥ pūrvaṃ tvamaśoka kṛpālunā /
lokopakārakaraṇastatprasīda śivapriya //
meaning:
हरेण निर्मितः पूर्वं त्वमशोक कृपालुना /
लोकोपकारकरणस्तत्प्रसीद शिवप्रिय //
text_mt: 'Formerly created by the compassionate Hara, / you bring welfare to the world, O Aśoka! Therefore be pleased, O darling of Śiva!'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastṛtīye divase vṛkṣe tasminvṛṣadhvajam /
samabhyarcya vidhānena dvijaṃ saṃbhojya dāpayet //
meaning:
ततस्तृतीये दिवसे वृक्षे तस्मिन्वृषध्वजम् /
समभ्यर्च्य विधानेन द्विजं संभोज्य दापयेत् //
text_mt: Then, on the third day, having duly worshipped the Bull-bannered Lord / upon that tree, and having fed a twice-born, one should give it away.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtavratā nārī vaidhavyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit /
putrapautrādi sahitā bhartuśca syātsuvallabhā //
meaning:
एवं कृतव्रता नारी वैधव्यं नाप्नुयात्क्वचित् /
पुत्रपौत्रादि सहिता भर्तुश्च स्यात्सुवल्लभा //
text_mt: A woman who has performed this vow in this manner never suffers widowhood; / endowed with sons, grandsons, and other descendants, she becomes exceedingly dear to her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjjakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāmekabhaktaḥ samāhitaḥ /
pradoṣe tailadīpaṃ tu prajvālyābhyarcya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ज्जकृष्णत्रयोदश्यामेकभक्तः समाहितः /
प्रदोषे तैलदीपं तु प्रज्वाल्याभ्यर्च्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: On the thirteenth of the dark fortnight of Kārttika, eating a single meal, concentrated in mind, / having carefully kindled and worshipped an oil lamp at dusk,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhadvāre bahirdadyādyamo me prīyatāmiti /
evaṃ kṛte tu viprendra yamapīḍā na jāyate //
meaning:
गृहद्वारे बहिर्दद्याद्यमो मे प्रीयतामिति /
एवं कृते तु विप्रेन्द्र यमपीडा न जायते //
text_mt: one should offer it outside the house door, reciting: 'May Yama be pleased with me.' / When this is done, O leader of the twice-born, torment by Yama does not occur.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjśuklatrayodaśyāmekabhojī dvijottama /
punaḥ snātvā pradoṣe tu vāgyataḥ susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ज्शुक्लत्रयोदश्यामेकभोजी द्विजोत्तम /
पुनः स्नात्वा प्रदोषे तु वाग्यतः सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: On the thirteenth of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, eating a single meal, O best of the twice-born, / having bathed again at dusk, with speech restrained and well-concentrated,

sanskrit_iast:
pradīpānāṃ sahasreṇa śatenāpyathavā dvija /
pradīpayecchivaṃ vāpi dvātriṃśaddīpamālayā //
meaning:
प्रदीपानां सहस्रेण शतेनाप्यथवा द्विज /
प्रदीपयेच्छिवं वापि द्वात्रिंशद्दीपमालया //
text_mt: with a thousand lamps, or even a hundred, O twice-born, / or with a garland of thirty-two lamps, one should illuminate Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena dīpayeddvīpāngandhādyaiḥ pūjayecchivam /
phalairnānāvidhaiścaiva naivedyairapi nārada //
meaning:
घृतेन दीपयेद्द्वीपान्गन्धाद्यैः पूजयेच्छिवम् /
फलैर्नानाविधैश्चैव नैवेद्यैरपि नारद //
text_mt: One should kindle the lamps with ghee and worship Śiva with perfumes and other offerings, / with various kinds of fruits, and also with food offerings, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ stuvīta deveśaṃ śivaṃ nāmnāṃ śatena ca /
tāni nāmāni kīrtyante sarvābhīṣṭapradāni vai //
meaning:
ततः स्तुवीत देवेशं शिवं नाम्नां शतेन च /
तानि नामानि कीर्त्यन्ते सर्वाभीष्टप्रदानि वै //
text_mt: Then one should praise Śiva, the Lord of Gods, with a hundred names; / those names are now recited, which truly grant all desired objects:

sanskrit_iast:
namo rudrāya bhīmāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vedhase /
kaparddine sureśāya vyomakeśāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो रुद्राय भीमाय नीलकण्ठाय वेधसे /
कपर्द्दिने सुरेशाय व्योमकेशाय वै नमः //
text_mt: 'Salutation to Rudra, to the Terrible, to the Blue-throated, to the Creator, / to the One with Braided Hair, to the Lord of the Gods, to the Sky-haired One, indeed salutation!

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣadhvajāya somāya somanāthāya vai namaḥ /
digaṃbarāya bhṛṅgāya umākāntāya varddhine //
meaning:
वृषध्वजाय सोमाय सोमनाथाय वै नमः /
दिगंबराय भृङ्गाय उमाकान्ताय वर्द्धिने //
text_mt: Salutation indeed to the Bull-bannered One, to Soma, to the Lord of Soma, / to the Space-clad One, to Bhṛṅgin, to Umā's Beloved, to the Increaser,

sanskrit_iast:
tapomayāya vyāptāya śipiviṣyāya vai namaḥ /
vyālapriyāya vyālāya vyālānāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
तपोमयाय व्याप्ताय शिपिविष्याय वै नमः /
व्यालप्रियाय व्यालाय व्यालानां पतये नमः //
text_mt: to the Embodiment of Austerity, to the All-pervading, to Śipiviṣṭa, indeed salutation! / To the Serpent-lover, to the Serpent, to the Lord of Serpents, salutation!

sanskrit_iast:
mahīdharāya vyomāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ /
tripuraghnāya siṃhāya śārdūlāyārṣabhāya ca //
meaning:
महीधराय व्योमाय पशूनां पतये नमः /
त्रिपुरघ्नाय सिंहाय शार्दूलायार्षभाय च //
text_mt: To the Earth-supporter, to the Sky, to the Lord of Beasts, salutation! / To the Slayer of Tripura, to the Lion, to the Tiger, and to the Bull,

sanskrit_iast:
mitāya mitanāthāya siddhāya parameṣṭhine /
vedagītāya guptāya vedaguhyāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
मिताय मितनाथाय सिद्धाय परमेष्ठिने /
वेदगीताय गुप्ताय वेदगुह्याय वै नमः //
text_mt: to the Measured, to the Lord of the Measured, to the Perfected, to the Supreme Lord, / to the One Sung by the Vedas, to the Hidden, to the Mystery of the Vedas, salutation!'

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāya dīrgharūpāya dīrghārthāya mahīyase /
namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya vyomarūpāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घाय दीर्घरूपाय दीर्घार्थाय महीयसे /
नमो जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय व्योमरूपाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the vast, to the one whose form is vast, to the vast-purposed, to the most exalted! / Homage to the support of the world, to the one whose form is space; homage indeed!

sanskrit_iast:
kalyāṇāya viśiṣyāya śiṣṭāya paramātmane /
gajakṛtti dharāyātha andhakāsurabhedine //
meaning:
कल्याणाय विशिष्याय शिष्टाय परमात्मने /
गजकृत्ति धरायाथ अन्धकासुरभेदिने //
text_mt: To the auspicious, to the most distinguished, to the disciplined, to the Supreme Self, / to the wearer of the elephant skin, and then to the slayer of the demon Andhaka;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlalohitaśuklāya caḍamuṇḍapriyāya ca /
bhaktipriyāya devāya yajñāntāyāvyayāya ca //
meaning:
नीललोहितशुक्लाय चडमुण्डप्रियाय च /
भक्तिप्रियाय देवाय यज्ञान्तायाव्ययाय च //
text_mt: to the blue, red, and white, to the one beloved of Caṇḍī and Muṇḍā, / to the god who loves devotion, to the end of sacrifices, and to the imperishable;

sanskrit_iast:
maheśāya namastubhyaṃ mahādevaharāya ca /
trinetrāya trivedāya vedāṅgāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
महेशाय नमस्तुभ्यं महादेवहराय च /
त्रिनेत्राय त्रिवेदाय वेदाङ्गाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: to Maheśa, homage to you, to Mahādeva, and to Hara, / to the three-eyed, to the three Vedas, to the limb of the Veda, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
arthāyārthasvarūpāya paramārthāya vai namaḥ /
viśvarūpāya viśvāya viśvanāthāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
अर्थायार्थस्वरूपाय परमार्थाय वै नमः /
विश्वरूपाय विश्वाय विश्वनाथाय वै नमः //
text_mt: To wealth, to the essential nature of wealth, to the supreme goal; homage indeed! / To the universal form, to the universe, to the lord of the universe; homage indeed!

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarāya ca kālāya kālāvayavarūpiṇe /
arūpāya virūpāya sūkṣmasūkṣmāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्कराय च कालाय कालावयवरूपिणे /
अरूपाय विरूपाय सूक्ष्मसूक्ष्माय वै नमः //
text_mt: To Śaṅkara, and to Time, to the one having the form of the divisions of time, / to the formless, to the multiform, to the subtlest of the subtle; homage indeed!

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānavāsine tubhyaṃ namaste kṛttivāsase /
śaśāṅkaśekharāyātha rudrabhūmiśritāya ca //
meaning:
श्मशानवासिने तुभ्यं नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे /
शशाङ्कशेखरायाथ रुद्रभूमिश्रिताय च //
text_mt: Homage to you who dwell in the cremation ground; homage to you who are clad in animal skins, / and then to the one adorned with the crescent moon, and to the one resorting to Rudra's ground;

sanskrit_iast:
durgāya durgapārāya durgāvayavasākṣiṇe /
liṅgarūpāya liṅgāya liṅgānapataye namaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्गाय दुर्गपाराय दुर्गावयवसाक्षिणे /
लिङ्गरूपाय लिङ्गाय लिङ्गानपतये नमः //
text_mt: to the impassable, to the one beyond difficulty, to the witness of the limbs of Durgā, / to the one whose form is the liṅga, to the liṅga, to the lord of liṅgas; homage!

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ prabhāvarūpāya prabhāvārthāya vai namaḥ //
meaning: नमः प्रभावरूपाय प्रभावार्थाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the one whose form is majesty, to the goal of majesty; homage indeed!

sanskrit_iast:
namo namaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya te mṛtyuñjayāyātmabhavasvarūpiṇe /
triyaṃbakāya śitikaṇṭhabhārgiṇe gaurīyuje maṅgalahetave namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो नमः कारणकारणाय ते मृत्युञ्जयायात्मभवस्वरूपिणे /
त्रियंबकाय शितिकण्ठभार्गिणे गौरीयुजे मङ्गलहेतवे नमः //
text_mt: Homage, homage to you, the cause of causes, the conqueror of death, the one whose essential nature is self-born, / the three-eyed one, the blue-throated Bhārgava, united with Gaurī, the source of auspiciousness; homage!

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃ śatamidaṃ vipra pinākiguṇakīrtanam /
paṭhitvā dakṣiṇīkṛtya prāyānnijaniketanam //
meaning:
नाम्नां शतमिदं विप्र पिनाकिगुणकीर्तनम् /
पठित्वा दक्षिणीकृत्य प्रायान्निजनिकेतनम् //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, having recited this hundred names, which praises the virtues of the wielder of the Pināka, / and having circumambulated [the deity], one should go to one's own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra mahādevaprasādataḥ /
bhuktveha bhogānakhilānante śivapadaṃ labhet //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र महादेवप्रसादतः /
भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलानन्ते शिवपदं लभेत् //
text_mt: Having observed the observance in this way, O brāhmaṇa, by the grace of Mahādeva, / after enjoying all pleasures in this world, one will attain the state of Śiva at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ yo 'naṅgaṃ vidhinā yajet /
trikālamekakālaṃ vā śivasaṃgamasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
मार्गशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां यो ऽनङ्गं विधिना यजेत् /
त्रिकालमेककालं वा शिवसंगमसंभवम् //
text_mt: Whoever worships Anaṅga according to rule on the thirteenth day of the bright half of Mārgaśīrṣa, / either three times [a day] or once, arisen from the union of Śiva [and Śakti],

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyairupacāraistu pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ /
ghaṭe maṅgalapaṭṭe vā bhojayeddvijadaṃpatī //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैस्तु पूजयित्वा विधानतः /
घटे मङ्गलपट्टे वा भोजयेद्द्विजदंपती //
text_mt: and having worshipped [him] properly with articles of worship such as perfumes, / on a water-pot or on an auspicious board, he should feed a brāhmaṇa couple.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca dakṣiṇāṃ datvā svayamekāśanaṃ caret /
evaṃ kṛte tu vidhivadvratī saubhāgyabhājanaḥ //
jāyate bhuvi viprendra mahādevaprasādataḥ //
meaning:
ततश्च दक्षिणां दत्वा स्वयमेकाशनं चरेत् /
एवं कृते तु विधिवद्व्रती सौभाग्यभाजनः //
जायते भुवि विप्रेन्द्र महादेवप्रसादतः //
text_mt: Then, having given a priestly gift, he should himself eat only one meal. / When this is done according to rule, the observer of the observance becomes an owner of good fortune / in this world, O prince among brāhmaṇas, by the grace of Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samabhyarcyācyutaṃ harim /
ghṛtapātraṃ dvijendrāya pradadyātsarvasiddhaye //
meaning:
पौषशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां समभ्यर्च्याच्युतं हरिम् /
घृतपात्रं द्विजेन्द्राय प्रदद्यात्सर्वसिद्धये //
text_mt: On the thirteenth day of the bright half of Pauṣa, having worshipped Acyuta Hari, / he should give a vessel of clarified butter to a chief of brāhmaṇas for the attainment of all success.

sanskrit_iast:
māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samārabhya dinatrayam /
māghasnānavrataṃ vipra nānākāmaphalāvaham //
meaning:
माघशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां समारभ्य दिनत्रयम् /
माघस्नानव्रतं विप्र नानाकामफलावहम् //
text_mt: Beginning on the thirteenth day of the bright half of Māgha for three days, / the observance of bathing in Māgha, O brāhmaṇa, brings the fruit of diverse desires.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snātasya yatphalam /
nāśvameghasahasreṇa tatphalaṃ labhate bhuvi //
meaning:
प्रयागे माघमासे तु त्र्यहं स्नातस्य यत्फलम् /
नाश्वमेघसहस्रेण तत्फलं लभते भुवि //
text_mt: The fruit that is obtained by one who bathes for three days at Prayāga in the month of Māgha / is not obtained on earth by a thousand horse-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snānaṃ japo homo dānaṃ cānantyamaśnute /
phaālgune tu site pakṣe trayodaśyāmupoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र स्नानं जपो होमो दानं चानन्त्यमश्नुते /
फआल्गुने तु सिते पक्षे त्रयोदश्यामुपोषितः //
text_mt: Ablution, recitation, fire oblation, and giving gifts performed there attain endlesness. / But having fasted on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight in Phālguna,

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya jagannāthaṃ prāraṃbhe dhanadavratam /
mahārājaṃ yakṣapatiṃ gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य जगन्नाथं प्रारंभे धनदव्रतम् /
महाराजं यक्षपतिं गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः //
text_mt: having bowed to the Lord of the Universe, one begins the observance of the Giver of Wealth: / [worshipping] the great king, the lord of the yakṣas, with services such as perfumes,

sanskrit_iast:
likhitaṃ varṇakaiḥ paṭṭe pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ /
evaṃ śuklatrayodaśyāṃ pratimāsaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
लिखितं वर्णकैः पट्टे पूजयेद्भक्तिभावतः /
एवं शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां प्रतिमासं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: depicted with colors on a wooden board, he should worship with a devout heart. / In this way, on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight of every month, O best of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjayetsopavāsaścaikabhukto bhavennaraḥ /
tato vratānte tu punaḥ sauvarṇaṃ dhananāyakam //
meaning:
संपूजयेत्सोपवासश्चैकभुक्तो भवेन्नरः /
ततो व्रतान्ते तु पुनः सौवर्णं धननायकम् //
text_mt: a man should worship while fasting, or he may take a single meal. / Then, at the end of the observance, having further made a golden lord of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya nidhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sauvarṇābhirdvijottama /
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ snānaiḥ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ //
meaning:
विधाय निधिभिः सार्द्धं सौवर्णाभिर्द्विजोत्तम /
उपचारैः षोडशभिः स्नानैः पञ्चामृतादिभिः //
text_mt: along with golden treasures, O best of brāhmaṇas, / with the sixteen services, and with baths consisting of the five nectars and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyairvividhairbhaktyā pūjayettu samāhitaḥ /
tato dhenumalaṅkṛtya vastrasraggandhabhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैर्भक्त्या पूजयेत्तु समाहितः /
ततो धेनुमलङ्कृत्य वस्त्रस्रग्गन्धभूषणैः //
text_mt: and with diverse food-offerings, concentrated in mind, he should worship with devotion. / Then, having decorated an auspicious cow together with her calf / with garments, garlands, perfumes, and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
savatsāṃ dāpayedvipra samyagvedavide śubhām /
saṃbhojya viprānmiṣṭānnairdvādaśātha trayodaśa //
meaning:
सवत्सां दापयेद्विप्र सम्यग्वेदविदे शुभाम् /
संभोज्य विप्रान्मिष्टान्नैर्द्वादशाथ त्रयोदश //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, he should present it to a proper knower of the Veda. / Having fed twelve or thirteen brāhmaṇas with sweet foods,

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ samarcya vastrādyaiḥ pratimāṃ tāṃ nivedayet /
dvijebhyo dakṣaṇāṃ śaktyā datvā natvā visṛjya ca //
meaning:
गुरुं समर्च्य वस्त्राद्यैः प्रतिमां तां निवेदयेत् /
द्विजेभ्यो दक्षणां शक्त्या दत्वा नत्वा विसृज्य च //
text_mt: and having worshipped the guru with garments and other gifts, he should present that image. / Having given a priestly gift to the brāhmaṇas according to his ability, having bowed down, and having dismissed them,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ bhuñjīta matimāniṣṭaiḥ saha samāhitaḥ /
evaṃ kṛte vrate vipra nirdhanaḥ prāpya vaibhavam //
meaning:
स्वयं भुञ्जीत मतिमानिष्टैः सह समाहितः /
एवं कृते व्रते विप्र निर्धनः प्राप्य वैभवम् //
text_mt: the wise man, focused in mind, should himself eat together with his cherished ones. / When the observance has been performed in this way, O brāhmaṇa, a poor man attains abundance,

sanskrit_iast:
modate bhuvi vikhyāto rājarāja ivāparaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvādaśamāsasthitatrayodaśīvratakathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
मोदते भुवि विख्यातो राजराज इवापरः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वादशमासस्थितत्रयोदशीव्रतकथनं नाम द्वाविंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
and rejoices on the earth, renowned like a second king of kings.

Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-second chapter, titled 'The Exposition of the Observances of the Thirteenth Day in the Twelve Months' in the Great Narrative of the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi caturdaśyā vratāni te /
yāni kṛtvā naro loke sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि चतुर्दश्या व्रतानि ते /
यानि कृत्वा नरो लोके सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Listen, O Nārada! I will tell you the observances of the fourteenth day, / by performing which a man attains all desires in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
caitraśukla caturdaśyāṃ kuṅkumāgarucandanaiḥ /
gandhādyairvastramaṇibhiḥ kāryāryā mahatī śive //
meaning:
चैत्रशुक्ल चतुर्दश्यां कुङ्कुमागरुचन्दनैः /
गन्धाद्यैर्वस्त्रमणिभिः कार्यार्या महती शिवे //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra, with saffron, agallochum, and sandalwood, / with perfumes and other offerings, garments and gems, a great worship should be offered to Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
vitānadhvajachatrāṇi datvā pūjyāśca mātaraḥ /
evaṃ kṛtvārcanaṃ vipra sopavāso 'thavaikabhuk //
meaning:
वितानध्वजछत्राणि दत्वा पूज्याश्च मातरः /
एवं कृत्वार्चनं विप्र सोपवासो ऽथवैकभुक् //
text_mt: Having offered canopies, banners, and umbrellas, the Mothers should also be worshipped. / Having performed worship in this manner, O brāhmaṇa, while fasting or eating one meal,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate mānavo bhuvi /
atraiva damanārcāṃ ca kārayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ //
meaning:
अश्वमेधाधिकं पुण्यं लभते मानवो भुवि /
अत्रैव दमनार्चां च कारयेद्गन्धपुष्पकैः //
text_mt: a mortal obtains on earth merit greater than that of a horse-sacrifice. / Right here, one should also have the worship with damana flowers performed with perfumes and blossoms;

sanskrit_iast:
samarpayetsupūrṇāyāṃ śivāya śivarūpiṇe /
rādhakṛṣṇaca turddaśyāṃ sopavāso niśāgame //
meaning:
समर्पयेत्सुपूर्णायां शिवाय शिवरूपिणे /
राधकृष्णच तुर्द्दश्यां सोपवासो निशागमे //
text_mt: he should offer them to Śiva, who embodies auspiciousness, on the completely full [tithi]. / On the fourteenth day of the dark half of Vaiśākha, fasting at the arrival of night,

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgamabhyarcayeccaivaṃ snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ sudhīḥ /
gandhādyairupacāraiśca bilvapatraiśca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
लिङ्गमभ्यर्चयेच्चैवं स्नात्वा धौतांबरः सुधीः /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैश्च बिल्वपत्रैश्च सर्वतः //
text_mt: having bathed and dressed in clean clothes, the wise man should worship the liṅga / with services such as perfumes, and with bilva leaves on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā mantraṃ dvijāgryāya bhuñjīta ca pare 'hani /
evameva tu kṛṣṇāsu sarvāsu dvijasattama //
meaning:
दत्वा मन्त्रं द्विजाग्र्याय भुञ्जीत च परे ऽहनि /
एवमेव तु कृष्णासु सर्वासु द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: Having given a mantra to a superior brāhmaṇa, he should eat on the next day. / In this very manner, on all dark [fourteenth days], O best of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
śivavrataṃ prakartavyaṃ dhanasaṃtānamicchatā /
rādhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ śrīnṛsiṃhavrataṃ caret //
meaning:
शिवव्रतं प्रकर्तव्यं धनसंतानमिच्छता /
राधशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां श्रीनृसिंहव्रतं चरेत् //
text_mt: the observance of Śiva should be performed by one who desires wealth and offspring. / On the fourteenth day of the bright half of Vaiśākha, one should observe the holy observance of Nṛsiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsavidhānena śakto 'śaktastathaikabhuk /
niśāgame tu saṃpūjya nṛsiṃhaṃ daityasūdanam //
meaning:
उपवासविधानेन शक्तो ऽशक्तस्तथैकभुक् /
निशागमे तु संपूज्य नृसिंहं दैत्यसूदनम् //
text_mt: By the rule of fasting, if capable, or if incapable, eating a single meal; / and having worshipped Nṛsiṃha, the slayer of the Daityas, at the arrival of night,

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ snānaiḥ pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ /
tataḥ kṣamāpayeddevaṃ mantreṇānena nārada //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिः स्नानैः पञ्चामृतादिभिः /
ततः क्षमापयेद्देवं मन्त्रेणानेन नारद //
text_mt: with the sixteen services and with baths consisting of the five nectars and the like, / he should then ask the god's pardon with this mantra, O Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
tatpahāṭakakeśānta jvalatpāvakalocana /
vajrādhikanakhasparśadivyasiṃha namo 'stu ta //
meaning:
तत्पहाटककेशान्त ज्वलत्पावकलोचन /
वज्राधिकनखस्पर्शदिव्यसिंह नमो ऽस्तु त //
text_mt: 'O you whose hair-tips are like molten gold, whose eyes are blazing fire, / whose touch of claws is harder than a thunderbolt, divine lion, homage be to you!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ vratī syātsthaṇḍileśayaḥ /
jitendriyo jitakrodhaḥ sarvabhogavivarjjitaḥ //
meaning:
इति संप्रार्थ्य देवेशं व्रती स्यात्स्थण्डिलेशयः /
जितेन्द्रियो जितक्रोधः सर्वभोगविवर्ज्जितः //
text_mt: Having thus prayed to the Lord of gods, the observer of the observance should sleep on the bare ground, / with senses conquered, anger conquered, and free from all sensual enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra vidhivadvratamuttamam /
varṣe varṣe sa labhate bhuktabhogo hareḥ padam //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र विधिवद्व्रतमुत्तमम् /
वर्षे वर्षे स लभते भुक्तभोगो हरेः पदम् //
text_mt: Whoever properly performs this excellent observance year after year in this manner, O brāhmaṇa, / after enjoying pleasures, attains the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāreśvarayātrā ca kāryātraiva munīśvara /
durlabhaṃ vārcanaṃ tatra darśanaṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
ओङ्कारेश्वरयात्रा च कार्यात्रैव मुनीश्वर /
दुर्लभं वार्चनं तत्र दर्शनं पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: The pilgrimage to Oṅkāreśvara should also be undertaken at this time, O lord among sages. / Rare is the worship there; the sight of it destroys sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kimatra bahunoktena pūjādhyānajapekṣaṇam /
yadbhavettatsamuddiṣṭaṃ jñānamokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन पूजाध्यानजपेक्षणम् /
यद्भवेत्तत्समुद्दिष्टं ज्ञानमोक्षप्रदं नृणाम् //
text_mt: What is the use of saying much here? Whatever worship, meditation, recitation, and beholding / there may be, it has been stated to grant knowledge and liberation to men.

sanskrit_iast:
atra liṅgavrataṃ cāpi karttavyaṃ pāpanāśanam /
pañcāmṛtaistu saṃsnāpya liṅgamālipya kuṅkumaiḥ //
meaning:
अत्र लिङ्गव्रतं चापि कर्त्तव्यं पापनाशनम् /
पञ्चामृतैस्तु संस्नाप्य लिङ्गमालिप्य कुङ्कुमैः //
text_mt: Here, the observance of the liṅga, which destroys sins, should also be performed. / Having bathed the liṅga with the five nectars and smeared it with saffron,

sanskrit_iast:
naivedyaiśca phalairdhūpairdīpairvastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ /
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayetpaiṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam //
meaning:
नैवेद्यैश्च फलैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्वस्त्रविभूषणैः /
एवं यः पूजयेत्पैष्टं लिङ्गं सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: with food offerings, fruits, incense, lamps, garments, and ornaments, / whoever thus worships a liṅga made of flour, which grants the attainment of all aims,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa labhate mahādevaprasādataḥ /
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ divā pañcatapā niśaḥ //
meaning:
भुक्तिं मुक्तिं स लभते महादेवप्रसादतः /
ज्येष्ठशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां दिवा पञ्चतपा निशः //
text_mt: attains enjoyment and liberation by the grace of Mahādeva. / On the fourteenth day of the bright half of Jyeṣṭha, practicing the five fires during the day and at the beginning of the night,

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe dadeddhemadhenuṃ rudravratamidaṃ smṛtam /
śuciśuklacaturdaśyāṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ //
meaning:
मुखे ददेद्धेमधेनुं रुद्रव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् /
शुचिशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां शिवं संपूज्य मानवः //
text_mt: one should give a golden cow; this is known as the observance of Rudra. / On the fourteenth day of the bright half of Āṣāḍha, having worshipped Śiva, a man

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sarvasaṃpadamāpnuyāt /
nabhaḥ śuklacaturdaśyāṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ matam //
meaning:
देशकालोद्भवैः पुष्पैः सर्वसंपदमाप्नुयात् /
नभः शुक्लचतुर्दश्यां पवित्रारोपणं मतम् //
text_mt: With flowers born of the region and season, he obtains all prosperity. / On the bright fourteenth of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa), the investiture of the sacred thread (pavitrāropaṇa) is recognized.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsvaśākhoktavidhinā kartavyaṃ dvijasattama /
śatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā tato devyai nivedayet //
meaning:
तत्स्वशाखोक्तविधिना कर्तव्यं द्विजसत्तम /
शताभिमन्त्रितं कृत्वा ततो देव्यै निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: It should be performed according to the rule declared in one's own Vedic branch, O best of the twice-born. / Having consecrated it a hundred times with mantra, one should then present it to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā naro nāryathavā yadi /
mahādevyāḥ prasādena bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
पवित्रारोपणं कृत्वा नरो नार्यथवा यदि /
महादेव्याः प्रसादेन भुक्तिं मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: If a man or a woman performs the investiture of the sacred thread, / by the grace of the Great Goddess they attain worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāmanantavratamuttamam /
karttavyamekabhuktaṃ hi godhūmaprasthapiṣṭakam //
meaning:
भाद्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यामनन्तव्रतमुत्तमम् /
कर्त्तव्यमेकभुक्तं हि गोधूमप्रस्थपिष्टकम् //
text_mt: On the bright fourteenth of Bhādrapada is the excellent Anantavrata. / One should eat only once: a prastha measure of wheat flour,

sanskrit_iast:
vipācya śarkarājyāktamanantāya nivedayet /
gandhādyaiḥ prāk samabhyarcyaḥ kārpāsaṃ paṭṭajaṃ tu vā //
meaning:
विपाच्य शर्कराज्याक्तमनन्ताय निवेदयेत् /
गन्धाद्यैः प्राक् समभ्यर्च्यः कार्पासं पट्टजं तु वा //
text_mt: cooked and mixed with sugar and ghee, should be offered to Ananta. / Having previously worshipped with fragrances and other offerings, a thread of cotton or silk,

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśagranthiyutaṃ sūtraṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam /
tataḥ purāṇamuttārya sūtraṃ kṣiptvā jalāśayeṃ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशग्रन्थियुतं सूत्रं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् /
ततः पुराणमुत्तार्य सूत्रं क्षिप्त्वा जलाशयें //
text_mt: made very splendid with fourteen knots, [should be prepared]. / Then, having taken off the old thread and cast it into a reservoir of water,

sanskrit_iast:
nibaghnīyānnavaṃ nārī vāme dakṣe pumānbhuje /
vipācya piṣṭapakvaṃ tatpradadyāddakṣiṇānvitam //
meaning:
निबघ्नीयान्नवं नारी वामे दक्षे पुमान्भुजे /
विपाच्य पिष्टपक्वं तत्प्रदद्याद्दक्षिणान्वितम् //
text_mt: a woman should bind the new one on her left arm, and a man on his right. / Having cooked that prepared pastry, he should present it accompanied by a sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ ca tanmitaṃ cādyādevaṃ kuryādvratottamam /
dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ tata udyāpayetsudhīḥ //
meaning:
स्वयं च तन्मितं चाद्यादेवं कुर्याद्व्रतोत्तमम् /
द्विसप्तवर्षपर्यन्तं तत उद्यापयेत्सुधीः //
text_mt: And he himself should eat an equal measure of it; thus one should perform the excellent vow / for a period of fourteen years; then the wise person should perform the concluding rite (udyāpana).

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ dhānyavarṇaiḥ prakalpya ca /
suśobhane nyasettatra kalaśaṃ tāmrajaṃ mune //
meaning:
मण्डलं सर्वतोभद्रं धान्यवर्णैः प्रकल्प्य च /
सुशोभने न्यसेत्तत्र कलशं ताम्रजं मुने //
text_mt: Having prepared a sarvatobhadra maṇḍala with grains of various colors, / in that very beautiful [spot] he should place a copper vessel, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari nyaseddhaimīmanantapratimāṃ śubhām /
pītapaṭṭāṃśukācchannāṃ tatra tāṃ vidhinā yajet //
meaning:
तस्योपरि न्यसेद्धैमीमनन्तप्रतिमां शुभाम् /
पीतपट्टांशुकाच्छन्नां तत्र तां विधिना यजेत् //
text_mt: Upon it he should place an auspicious golden image of Ananta / covered with a yellow silk cloth; there he should worship it according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ mātṛkāḥ kheṭāṃllokapāṃśca yajetpṛthak /
tato homaṃ haviṣyeṇa kṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret //
meaning:
गणेशं मातृकाः खेटांल्लोकपांश्च यजेत्पृथक् /
ततो होमं हविष्येण कृत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं चरेत् //
text_mt: One should worship Gaṇeśa, the Mothers, the planets, and the guardians of the directions separately; / then, having performed a fire oblation with sacrificial food (haviṣya), one should perform the final offering (pūrṇāhuti).

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ dhenuṃ pratimāṃ ca dvijottama /
pradadyādgurave bhaktyā dvijānanyāṃścaturdaśa //
meaning:
शय्यां सोपस्करां धेनुं प्रतिमां च द्विजोत्तम /
प्रदद्याद्गुरवे भक्त्या द्विजानन्यांश्चतुर्दश //
text_mt: A bed with all its furnishings, a cow, and the image, O best of the twice-born, / he should give to the guru with devotion, and having fed fourteen other twice-born men

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya miṣṭapakvānnairdakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣayet /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute 'nantavrataṃ pratyakṣamādarāt //
meaning:
संभोज्य मिष्टपक्वान्नैर्दक्षिणाभिः प्रतोषयेत् /
एवं यः कुरुते ऽनन्तव्रतं प्रत्यक्षमादरात् //
text_mt: with sweet, cooked foods, he should satisfy them with sacrificial fees. / Whoever thus performs the Anantavrata openly with reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pyanantaprasādena jāyate bhuktimuktibhāk /
kadalīvratamapyatra tadvidhānaṃ ca me śṛṇu //
meaning:
सो ऽप्यनन्तप्रसादेन जायते भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् /
कदलीव्रतमप्यत्र तद्विधानं च मे शृणु //
text_mt: he too, by the grace of Ananta, comes to partake of enjoyment and liberation. / The kadalī vow also occurs here; hear from me its rite.

sanskrit_iast:
naro vā yadi vā nārī raṃbhāmupavanasthitām /
snātvā saṃpūjayedgandhapuṣpadhānyāṅkurādibhiḥ //
meaning:
नरो वा यदि वा नारी रंभामुपवनस्थिताम् /
स्नात्वा संपूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पधान्याङ्कुरादिभिः //
text_mt: A man or a woman, having bathed, should worship / a plantain tree standing in a garden with fragrant pastes, flowers, grain-sprouts, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhidūrvākṣatairddvīpairvastrapakkānnasaṃ cathaiḥ /
evaṃ saṃpūjya mantreṇa tataḥ saṃprārthayerdvatī //
meaning:
दधिदूर्वाक्षतैर्द्द्वीपैर्वस्त्रपक्कान्नसं चथैः /
एवं संपूज्य मन्त्रेण ततः संप्रार्थयेर्द्वती //
text_mt: with curd, dūrvā grass, unbroken grain, lamps, cloth, and an abundance of cooked food. / Having thus worshipped with mantra, the observer of the vow should then pray:

sanskrit_iast:
apsaro marakanyābhirnāgakanyābhirārcite /
śarīrārogyalāvaṇyaṃ dehi devi namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अप्सरो मरकन्याभिर्नागकन्याभिरार्चिते /
शरीरारोग्यलावण्यं देहि देवि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: "O you who are worshipped by the maidens of the apsarases, gods, and nāgas! / Grant health of body and beauty, O goddess; homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃprārthyaṃ kanyāstu catasro vā suvāsinīḥ /
saṃbhojyāṃ śukasidvarakajjalālaktacarcitāḥ //
meaning:
इति संप्रार्थ्यं कन्यास्तु चतस्रो वा सुवासिनीः /
संभोज्यां शुकसिद्वरकज्जलालक्तचर्चिताः //
text_mt: Having prayed thus, having fed four maidens or married women / adorned with garments, vermilion, collyrium, and red lac,

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya nijaṃ gehaṃ samāpya niyamaṃ vrajet /
evaṃ kṛte vrate vipra labdhvā saubhāgyamuttamam //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य निजं गेहं समाप्य नियमं व्रजेत् /
एवं कृते व्रते विप्र लब्ध्वा सौभाग्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: and bowed to them, he should go to his own house and conclude his observance. / The vow having been performed thus, O brahmin, having attained excellent good fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
iha loke vimānena svargaloke vrajetparam /
iṣakṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ viṣaśastrāṃbuvahnibhiḥ //
meaning:
इह लोके विमानेन स्वर्गलोके व्रजेत्परम् /
इषकृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां विषशस्त्रांबुवह्निभिः //
text_mt: in this world, he departs beyond to heaven in a celestial vehicle. / On the dark fourteenth of Iṣa (Āśvina), for those killed by poison, weapons, water, and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
sarpaśvāpadavajrādyairhatānāṃ brahmaghātinām /
caturddaśyāṃ kriyāśrāddhamekoddiṣṭavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
सर्पश्वापदवज्राद्यैर्हतानां ब्रह्मघातिनाम् /
चतुर्द्दश्यां क्रियाश्राद्धमेकोद्दिष्टविधानतः //
text_mt: by serpents, wild beasts, thunderbolts, and the like, and for slayers of brahmins, / the funeral rite (śrāddha) should be performed on the fourteenth according to the rule of an ekoddiṣṭa rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ vipravargaṃ ca bhojayenmiṣṭapakvakaiḥ /
tarpaṇaṃ ca gavāṃ grāsaṃ baliṃ caiva śvakākayoḥ //
meaning:
कर्तव्यं विप्रवर्गं च भोजयेन्मिष्टपक्वकैः /
तर्पणं च गवां ग्रासं बलिं चैव श्वकाकयोः //
text_mt: It should be performed, and he should feed a gathering of brahmins with sweet cooked foods. / Having made libations, an offering of food to cows, and offerings to dogs and crows,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā camya svayaṃ paścādbhuñjīyādbandhubhiḥ saha /
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipra śrāddhaṃ saṃpannadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
कृत्वा चम्य स्वयं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीयाद्बन्धुभिः सह /
एवं यः कुरुते विप्र श्राद्धं संपन्नदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: and having sipped water, he himself should eat afterward along with his kinsmen. / Whoever thus performs the funeral rite with abundant sacrificial fees, O brahmin,

sanskrit_iast:
sa uddhṛtya pitṝngaccheddevalokaṃ sanātanam /
iṣaśukla caturddaśyāṃ dharmarājaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
स उद्धृत्य पितॄन्गच्छेद्देवलोकं सनातनम् /
इषशुक्ल चतुर्द्दश्यां धर्मराजं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: he rescues his ancestors and goes to the eternal world of the gods. / On the bright fourteenth of Iṣa, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyaiḥ samyagabhyarcya sauvarṇaṃ bhojya vāṅavam /
dadyāttasmai dharmarājastrāyate bhuvi nārada //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैः सम्यगभ्यर्च्य सौवर्णं भोज्य वाङवम् /
दद्यात्तस्मै धर्मराजस्त्रायते भुवि नारद //
text_mt: having fully worshipped Dharmarāja with fragrances and other offerings, / he should give him a golden [image], food, and a vessel; Dharmarāja protects him on earth, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute dharmapratimādānamuttamam /
sa bhuktveha varānbhogāndivaṃ dharmājñayā vrajet //
meaning:
एवं यः कुरुते धर्मप्रतिमादानमुत्तमम् /
स भुक्त्वेह वरान्भोगान्दिवं धर्माज्ञया व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Whoever makes this excellent gift of an image of Dharma / enjoys excellent pleasures here and goes to heaven by the command of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrjjakṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ tailābhyaṅgaṃ vidhūdaye /
kṛtvā snātvārcayeddharmaṃ narakādabhayaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ऊर्ज्जकृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां तैलाभ्यङ्गं विधूदये /
कृत्वा स्नात्वार्चयेद्धर्मं नरकादभयं लभेत् //
text_mt: On the dark fourteenth of Ūrja (Kārttika), having applied an oil-massage at moonrise / and bathed, he should worship Dharma; he obtains freedom from fear of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
pradoṣe tailadīpāṃstu dīpayedyamatuṣṭaye /
catuṣpathe gṛhādbrāhmapradeśe vā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रदोषे तैलदीपांस्तु दीपयेद्यमतुष्टये /
चतुष्पथे गृहाद्ब्राह्मप्रदेशे वा समाहितः //
text_mt: At twilight (pradoṣa), one should light oil lamps for the gratification of Yama / at a crossroads, outside the house, or in an open area, with composed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsare hemalaṃbyākhye māsi śrīmati kārtike /
śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāmaruṇābhyudayaṃ prati //
meaning:
वत्सरे हेमलंब्याख्ये मासि श्रीमति कार्तिके /
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यामरुणाभ्युदयं प्रति //
text_mt: In the year named Hemalamba, in the auspicious month of Kārttika, / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, toward daybreak,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā viśveśvaro devo devaiḥ saha munīśvara /
maṇikarṇika tīrthe ca tripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā dadhat //
meaning:
स्नात्वा विश्वेश्वरो देवो देवैः सह मुनीश्वर /
मणिकर्णिक तीर्थे च त्रिपुण्ड्रं भस्मना दधत् //
text_mt: Lord Viśveśvara bathed along with the gods, O lord of sages, / at the sacred ford Maṇikarṇikā, bearing the tripuṇḍra mark with ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānaṃ svayamabhyarcya cakre pāśupatavratam /
tatastatra mahāpūjāṃ liṅge gandhādibhiścaret //
meaning:
स्वात्मानं स्वयमभ्यर्च्य चक्रे पाशुपतव्रतम् /
ततस्तत्र महापूजां लिङ्गे गन्धादिभिश्चरेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped himself by himself, he undertook the Pāśupata vow. / Then he should perform a great worship to the liṅga there with fragrances and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
droṇapuṣpairbilvadalairarkapuṣpaiśca ketakaiḥ /
puṣpaiḥ phalairmiṣṭapakvairnaivedyairvividhairapi //
meaning:
द्रोणपुष्पैर्बिल्वदलैरर्कपुष्पैश्च केतकैः /
पुष्पैः फलैर्मिष्टपक्वैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि //
text_mt: with droṇa flowers, bilva leaves, arka flowers, and ketaka blossoms, / with flowers, fruits, sweet cooked foods, and diverse offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvaikabhuktaṃ tu vrataṃ viśveśatoṣaṇam /
labhate vāñchitānkāmānihāmutra ca nārada //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वैकभुक्तं तु व्रतं विश्वेशतोषणम् /
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामानिहामुत्र च नारद //
text_mt: Having thus performed the vow pleasing to Viśveśa with a single meal, / one attains one's desired wishes both in this world and the next, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakūrcavrataṃ cātra kartavyamṛddhimicchatā /
sopavāsaḥ pañcagavyaṃ pibedrātrau jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मकूर्चव्रतं चात्र कर्तव्यमृद्धिमिच्छता /
सोपवासः पञ्चगव्यं पिबेद्रात्रौ जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: And the Brahmakūrca vow should be performed here by one desiring prosperity. / Fasting, with senses conquered, he should drink the five products of the cow (pañcagavya) at night:

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāyāstu gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā /
śvetāyāḥ kṣīramuditaṃ raktāyāśca tathā dadhi //
meaning:
कपिलायास्तु गोमूत्रं कृष्णाया गोमयं तथा /
श्वेतायाः क्षीरमुदितं रक्तायाश्च तथा दधि //
text_mt: urine from a tawny cow, dung from a black cow, / milk prescribed from a white cow, and curd from a red cow;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā karburāyāśca ghṛtamekatra melayet /
kuśāṃ bunā tataḥ prātaḥ snātvā santarpyaṃ devatāḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा कर्बुरायाश्च घृतमेकत्र मेलयेत् /
कुशां बुना ततः प्रातः स्नात्वा सन्तर्प्यं देवताः //
text_mt: having taken ghee from a speckled cow, he should mix them together / with kuśa-grass water. Then in the morning, having bathed and satisfied the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇāṃstoṣayitvā ca bhuñjīyādvāgyataḥ svayam /
brahmakūrcavrataṃ hyetatsarvapātakanāśanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणांस्तोषयित्वा च भुञ्जीयाद्वाग्यतः स्वयम् /
ब्रह्मकूर्चव्रतं ह्येतत्सर्वपातकनाशनम् //
text_mt: and having gratified the brahmins, he himself should eat with restrained speech. / For this Brahmakūrca vow destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yacca bālye kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kaumāre vārddhake 'pi yat /
brahmakūrcopavāsena tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati //
meaning:
यच्च बाल्ये कृतं पापं कौमारे वार्द्धके ऽपि यत् /
ब्रह्मकूर्चोपवासेन तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति //
text_mt: Whatever sin was committed in childhood, in youth, or in old age, / it is destroyed that very moment by the Brahmakūrca fast.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṣāṇavratamapyatra proktaṃ tacchṛṇu nārada /
sopavāso divā naktaṃ pāṣāṇākārapiṣṭacakam //
meaning:
पाषाणव्रतमप्यत्र प्रोक्तं तच्छृणु नारद /
सोपवासो दिवा नक्तं पाषाणाकारपिष्टचकम् //
text_mt: The Pāṣāṇa vow is also declared here; hear that, O Nārada: / Fasting by day, at night, having worshipped a flour cake shaped like a stone,

sanskrit_iast:
prārcya gandhādibhirgauṃrīṃ ghṛtapaṅkvamupāharet /
vratametaccaritvā tu yathoktaṃ dvijasattama //
meaning:
प्रार्च्य गन्धादिभिर्गौंरीं घृतपङ्क्वमुपाहरेत् /
व्रतमेतच्चरित्वा तु यथोक्तं द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: and having worshipped Gaurī with fragrances and the like, he should offer it cooked in ghee. / Having performed this vow as declared, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryasaukhyasaubhāgyarūpāṇi prāpnuyānnaraḥ /
mārgaśuklacaturdaśyāmekabhuktaḥ puroditam //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यसौख्यसौभाग्यरूपाणि प्राप्नुयान्नरः /
मार्गशुक्लचतुर्दश्यामेकभुक्तः पुरोदितम् //
text_mt: a man attains sovereignty, happiness, good fortune, and beauty. / Having eaten once as previously stated on the bright fourteenth of Mārgaśīrṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
nirāhāro vṛṣaṃ svarṇaṃ prārcya dadyāddvijātaye /
pare 'hni prātarutthāya snātvā somaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
निराहारो वृषं स्वर्णं प्रार्च्य दद्याद्द्विजातये /
परे ऽह्नि प्रातरुत्थाय स्नात्वा सोमं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: and remaining without food [thereafter], having worshipped a golden bull, he should give it to a twice-born man. / Having risen in the morning on the next day and bathed, he should worship

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayetkamalaiḥ puṣpairgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ /
dvijānsambhojya miṣṭānnaustoṣayeddakṣiṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेत्कमलैः पुष्पैर्गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः /
द्विजान्सम्भोज्य मिष्टान्नौस्तोषयेद्दक्षिणादिभिः //
text_mt: Soma and Maheśvara with lotus flowers, fragrances, garlands, and unguents. / Having fed the twice-born with sweet foods, he should satisfy them with sacrificial fees and other gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchivavrataṃ vipra bhuktimuktipradāyakam /
kartṛāṇāmupadeṣṭṛāṇāṃ sāhyānāmanumodinām //
meaning:
एतच्छिवव्रतं विप्र भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् /
कर्तृआणामुपदेष्टृआणां साह्यानामनुमोदिनाम् //
text_mt: This Śiva vow, O brahmin, bestows enjoyment and liberation / on those who perform it, those who teach it, those who assist it, and those who approve of it.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ virūpākṣavrataṃ smṛtam /
kapardīśvarasāṃnidhyaṃ prāpsyāmyatra vicintya ca //
meaning:
पौषशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां विरूपाक्षव्रतं स्मृतम् /
कपर्दीश्वरसांनिध्यं प्राप्स्याम्यत्र विचिन्त्य च //
text_mt: On the bright fourteenth of Pauṣa, the Virūpākṣa vow is remembered. / Thinking, "Here I shall attain the presence of Kapardīśvara,"

sanskrit_iast:
snātvāgādhajale vipra virūpākṣaṃ śivaṃ yajet /
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā //
meaning:
स्नात्वागाधजले विप्र विरूपाक्षं शिवं यजेत् /
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा //
text_mt: and having bathed in deep water, O brahmin, he should worship Virūpākṣa Śiva / with an abundance of fragrances, garlands, prostrations, incense, lamps, and food.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsthaṃ dvijātaye dattvā modate divi devavat /
māghakṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ yamatarpaṇamīritam //
meaning:
तत्स्थं द्विजातये दत्त्वा मोदते दिवि देववत् /
माघकृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां यमतर्पणमीरितम् //
text_mt: Having given that [image] to a twice-born man, he rejoices in heaven like a god. / On the dark fourteenth of Māgha, the water offering (tarpaṇa) to Yama is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
anarkābhyudite kāle snātvā saṃtarpayedyamam /
dvisaptanāmabhiḥ proktaiḥ sarvapāpavimuktaye //
meaning:
अनर्काभ्युदिते काले स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद्यमम् /
द्विसप्तनामभिः प्रोक्तैः सर्वपापविमुक्तये //
text_mt: At a time before the sun has risen, having bathed, one should offer libation to Yama / with the fourteen proclaimed names, for release from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tiladarbhāṃbubhiḥ kāryaṃ tarppaṇaṃ dvijabhojanam /
kṛśarānnaṃ svayaṃ cāpi tadevāśnīta vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
तिलदर्भांबुभिः कार्यं तर्प्पणं द्विजभोजनम् /
कृशरान्नं स्वयं चापि तदेवाश्नीत वाग्यतः //
text_mt: The libation should be performed with sesame, darbha grass, and water, and feeding of twice-borns [should be done]; / he himself should also eat that very food of kṛśara, restraining his speech.

sanskrit_iast:
antyakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ śivarātrivrataṃ dvija /
nirjalaṃ samupoṣyātra divānaktaṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
अन्त्यकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां शिवरात्रिव्रतं द्विज /
निर्जलं समुपोष्यात्र दिवानक्तं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of the final [month, Māgha or Phālguna], O twice-born, is the vow of Śivarātri; / fasting here without water, one should worship day and night,

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhuvādikaṃ liṅgaṃ pārthivaṃ vā samāhitaḥ /
gandhādyairupacāraiśca sāṃbubilvadalādibhiḥ //
meaning:
स्वयंभुवादिकं लिङ्गं पार्थिवं वा समाहितः /
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैश्च सांबुबिल्वदलादिभिः //
text_mt: with focused mind, a self-manifest or other linga, or an earthen one, / with perfumes and other offerings, with water, bilva leaves, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ stotrapāṭhairjapādibhiḥ /
tataḥ pare 'hni saṃpūjya punarevopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
धूपैर्दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैः स्तोत्रपाठैर्जपादिभिः /
ततः परे ऽह्नि संपूज्य पुनरेवोपचारकैः //
text_mt: with incenses, lamps, food offerings, recitations of hymns, mantras, and so forth. / Then, on the following day, having worshipped again with the offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhojya viprānmiṣṭānnairvisṛjellabdhadakṣiṇān /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ martyo mahādevaprasādataḥ //
meaning:
संभोज्य विप्रान्मिष्टान्नैर्विसृजेल्लब्धदक्षिणान् /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं मर्त्यो महादेवप्रसादतः //
text_mt: having fed the brahmins with sweet foods, one should dismiss them after they have received their priestly fees. / Having performed this vow in this manner, a mortal, by the grace of Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
amartyabhogān labhate daivataiḥ susabhājitaḥ /
antyaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ durgāṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
अमर्त्यभोगान् लभते दैवतैः सुसभाजितः /
अन्त्यशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां दुर्गां संपूज्य भक्तितः //
text_mt: attains immortal pleasures, warmly honoured by the gods. / Having worshipped Durgā with devotion on the fourteenth day of the final bright fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhādyairupacāraistu viprānsaṃbhojayettataḥ /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra durgāyāścaikabhojanaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धाद्यैरुपचारैस्तु विप्रान्संभोजयेत्ततः /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र दुर्गायाश्चैकभोजनः //
text_mt: with perfumes and other offerings, one should then feed brahmins. / Having performed this vow of Durgā in this manner, O twice-born, eating only once a day,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate vāñchitānkāmānihāmutra ca nārada /
caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmupavāsaṃ vidhāya ca //
meaning:
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामानिहामुत्र च नारद /
चैत्रकृष्णचतुर्दश्यामुपवासं विधाय च //
text_mt: one obtains desired pleasures in this world and the next, O Nārada. / And having observed a fast on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Caitra,

sanskrit_iast:
kedārodakapānena vācimedhaphalaṃ bhavet /
udyāpane tu sarvāṃsāṃ sāmānyo vidhirucyate //
meaning:
केदारोदकपानेन वाचिमेधफलं भवेत् /
उद्यापने तु सर्वांसां सामान्यो विधिरुच्यते //
text_mt: by drinking the water of Kedāra, the fruit of a horse-sacrifice is gained. / Now the common rule for the concluding rite of all [the fourteenth-day vows] is stated:

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhāścaturdaśaivātra sapūgākṣatamodakāḥ /
sadakṣiṇāṃśukāstāmrāmṛnmayāścāvraṇā navāḥ //
meaning:
कुंभाश्चतुर्दशैवात्र सपूगाक्षतमोदकाः /
सदक्षिणांशुकास्ताम्रामृन्मयाश्चाव्रणा नवाः //
text_mt: Fourteen pots indeed here, with areca nuts, unbroken grain, and sweetmeats, / with priestly gifts and garments, made of copper and earthenware, unblemished and new,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanto vaśadaṇḍāśca pavitrāṇyāsanāni ca /
pātrāṇi yajñasūtrāṇi tāvatyeva hi kalpayet //
meaning:
तावन्तो वशदण्डाश्च पवित्राण्यासनानि च /
पात्राणि यज्ञसूत्राणि तावत्येव हि कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: as many bamboo staffs, purification rings, seats, / vessels, and sacred threads indeed should one prepare.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣaṃ prāguktavatkuryādvittaśāṭhyavivarjjitaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthabhāge dvādaśamāsasthitacaturdaśīvratavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
शेषं प्रागुक्तवत्कुर्याद्वित्तशाठ्यविवर्ज्जितः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थभागे द्वादशमासस्थितचतुर्दशीव्रतवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The remainder he should perform as previously stated, devoid of dishonesty regarding wealth.

Thus ends the hundred and twenty-third chapter, named the Description of the Vow of the Fourteenth Day throughout the Twelve Months, in the fourth part of the Bṛhadupākhyāna in the Pūrvabhāga of the illustrious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sanātana uvāca
atha nārada vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pūrṇāvratāni te /
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī prāpnuyātsukhasaṃtatim //
meaning:
सनातन उवाच
अथ नारद वक्ष्यामि शृणु पूर्णाव्रतानि ते /
यानि कृत्वा नरो नारी प्राप्नुयात्सुखसंततिम् //
text_mt: Sanātana said: / Now, O Nārada, I will speak to you of the full-moon vows; listen, / by performing which a man or a woman will obtain unbroken happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
caitrapūrṇā tu viprendra manvādiḥ samudāhṛtā /
asyāṃ sānnodakaṃ kuṃbhaṃ pradadyātsomatuṣṭaye //
meaning:
चैत्रपूर्णा तु विप्रेन्द्र मन्वादिः समुदाहृता /
अस्यां सान्नोदकं कुंभं प्रदद्यात्सोमतुष्टये //
text_mt: The full moon of Caitra, O chief of twice-borns, is declared to be the beginning of a Manvantara; / on this day, one should give a jar containing food and water for the pleasure of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhyāmapi pūrṇāyāṃ dānaṃ sarvasya sarvadam /
yadyaddravyaṃ dadedvipre tattadāpnoti niścitam //
meaning:
वैशाख्यामपि पूर्णायां दानं सर्वस्य सर्वदम् /
यद्यद्द्रव्यं ददेद्विप्रे तत्तदाप्नोति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: Also on the full moon of Vaiśākha, giving one's all bestows everything; / whatever item one gives to a brahmin, that very thing he surely obtains.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarājavrataṃ cātra kathitaṃ tanniśāmaya /
śṛtānnamudakuṃbhaṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ vai dvijottame //
meaning:
धर्मराजव्रतं चात्र कथितं तन्निशामय /
शृतान्नमुदकुंभं च वैशाख्यां वै द्विजोत्तमे //
text_mt: And the vow of Dharmarāja here is related; listen to it: / Cooked food and a water-pot, on the full moon of Vaiśākha, indeed, to an excellent twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādgodānaphaladaṃ dharmarājasya tuṣṭaye /
atra kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyātsakhuraṃ ca saśṛṅgakam //
meaning:
दद्याद्गोदानफलदं धर्मराजस्य तुष्टये /
अत्र कृष्णाजिनं दद्यात्सखुरं च सशृङ्गकम् //
text_mt: one should give, yielding the fruit of the gift of a cow, for the pleasure of Dharmarāja. / Here, one should give a black buckskin with hooves and horns,

sanskrit_iast:
tilaiḥ sahasamācchādya vastrairhemnā dvijātaye /
yastu kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyātsatkṛtya vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
तिलैः सहसमाच्छाद्य वस्त्रैर्हेम्ना द्विजातये /
यस्तु कृष्णाजिनं दद्यात्सत्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: covered with sesame seeds, along with garments and gold, to a twice-born. / The one who gives a black buckskin, having honoured [him] according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstravide saptadvīpabhūmipradaḥ sa vai /
modate viṣṇu loke hi yāvaccandrārkatārakam //
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रविदे सप्तद्वीपभूमिप्रदः स वै /
मोदते विष्णु लोके हि यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् //
text_mt: to a knower of all the scriptures, is indeed a giver of the earth with its seven continents; / he rejoices in the world of Viṣṇu as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhānsvacchajalaiḥ pūrṇānhiraṇyena samanvitān /
yaḥ pradadyāddvijāgryebhyaḥ sa na śocati karhicit //
meaning:
कुंभान्स्वच्छजलैः पूर्णान्हिरण्येन समन्वितान् /
यः प्रदद्याद्द्विजाग्र्येभ्यः स न शोचति कर्हिचित् //
text_mt: He who gives jars filled with clear water, accompanied by gold, / to the best of twice-borns, never grieves.

sanskrit_iast:
atha jyeṣṭasya pūrṇāyāṃ vaṭasāvitrikaṃ vratam /
sopavāsā vaṭaṃ siṃcetsalilairamṛtopamaiḥ //
meaning:
अथ ज्येष्टस्य पूर्णायां वटसावित्रिकं व्रतम् /
सोपवासा वटं सिंचेत्सलिलैरमृतोपमैः //
text_mt: Now, on the full moon of Jyeṣṭha is the vow of Vaṭasāvitrī. / Fasting, she should sprinkle the banyan tree with waters resembling nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
sṛtreṇa veṣṭayeccaiva saśatāṣṭapradakṣiṇam /
tataḥ saṃprārthaddaivīṃ sāvitrīṃ supativratām //
meaning:
सृत्रेण वेष्टयेच्चैव सशताष्टप्रदक्षिणम् /
ततः संप्रार्थद्दैवीं सावित्रीं सुपतिव्रताम् //
text_mt: and wrap it with thread while making one hundred and eight circumambulations. / Then she should pray to the divine Sāvitrī, devoted to her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
jagatpūjye jaganmātaḥ sāvitri patidaivate /
patyā sahāviyogaṃ me vaṭasthe kuru te namaḥ //
meaning:
जगत्पूज्ये जगन्मातः सावित्रि पतिदैवते /
पत्या सहावियोगं मे वटस्थे कुरु ते नमः //
text_mt: “O you worshipped by the world, O mother of the world, O Sāvitrī whose deity is her husband! / Residing in the banyan tree, make me never separated from my husband; reverence to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti saprārthya yā nārī bhojayitvā pare 'hani /
suvāsinīḥ svayaṃ bhuñjyātsā syātsaubhāgyabhāginī //
meaning:
इति सप्रार्थ्य या नारी भोजयित्वा परे ऽहनि /
सुवासिनीः स्वयं भुञ्ज्यात्सा स्यात्सौभाग्यभागिनी //
text_mt: Having prayed thus, the woman who, having fed auspicious married women on the next day, / eats herself, will share in good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ gopadmavratamucyate /
caturbhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ jāṃbūnadasamaprabham //
meaning:
आषाढस्य तु पूर्णायां गोपद्मव्रतमुच्यते /
चतुर्भुजं महाकायं जांबूनदसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: On the full moon of Āṣāḍha, the vow of Gopadma is taught. / [Meditating on Hari as] having four arms, a vast body, radiant like Jambūnada gold,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaramāgaruḍaśobhitam /
sevitaṃ munibhirdevairyakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मरमागरुडशोभितम् /
सेवितं मुनिभिर्देवैर्यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः //
text_mt: adorned with conch, discus, mace, and lotus, Ramā and Garuḍa, / served by sages, gods, yakṣas, gandharvas, and kinnaras,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ hariṃ tatra snātvā pūjāṃ samācaret /
pauruṣeṇaiva sūktena gandhādyairupacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
एवंविधं हरिं तत्र स्नात्वा पूजां समाचरेत् /
पौरुषेणैव सूक्तेन गन्धाद्यैरुपचारकैः //
text_mt: having bathed, one should perform the worship of Hari of such a form there / using the Puruṣasūkta, with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryaṃ vastrabhūṣādyaistoṣayetsnigdhamānasaḥ /
bhojayenmiṣṭapakvānnairdvijānanyāṃśca śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
आचार्यं वस्त्रभूषाद्यैस्तोषयेत्स्निग्धमानसः /
भोजयेन्मिष्टपक्वान्नैर्द्विजानन्यांश्च शक्तितः //
text_mt: With an affectionate mind, one should please the ācārya with garments, ornaments, and the like, / and feed brahmins and others according to one's capacity with sweet cooked foods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ vipra prasādātkamalāpateḥ /
aihikāmuṣmikānkāmāṃllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र प्रसादात्कमलापतेः /
ऐहिकामुष्मिकान्कामांल्लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Having performed the vow thus, O twice-born, by the grace of the Lord of Kamalā, / one obtains desires of this world and the next; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kokilāvratamapyatra proktaṃ tadvidhirucyate /
pūrṇimāyāṃ samārabhya vrataṃ snāyādbrahirjale //
meaning:
कोकिलाव्रतमप्यत्र प्रोक्तं तद्विधिरुच्यते /
पूर्णिमायां समारभ्य व्रतं स्नायाद्ब्रहिर्जले //
text_mt: The Kokilā vow also is declared here; its procedure is stated: / Beginning on the full-moon day, one should bathe in water outside [the village]

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāntaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi gaurīrūpāṃ ca kokilām /
svarṇapakṣāṃ ratnanetrāṃ pravālamukhapaṅkajām //
meaning:
पूर्णान्तं श्रावणे मासि गौरीरूपां च कोकिलाम् /
स्वर्णपक्षां रत्ननेत्रां प्रवालमुखपङ्कजाम् //
text_mt: until the full moon in the month of Śrāvaṇa; and [worship] the cuckoo in the form of Gaurī, / with golden wings, gem-like eyes, and a lotus-like coral beak,

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrīvarṇasaṃyuktāmutpannāṃ nandane vane /
cūtacaṃpakavṛkṣasthāṃ kalagītaninādinīm //
meaning:
कस्तूरीवर्णसंयुक्तामुत्पन्नां नन्दने वने /
चूतचंपकवृक्षस्थां कलगीतनिनादिनीम् //
text_mt: endowed with the colour of musk, born in the Nandana forest, / perched upon mango and campaka trees, sounding with sweet songs.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayetpārvatīṃ devīṃ kokilārūpadhāriṇīm /
gandhādyaiḥ pratyahaṃ prārccellikhitāṃ varṇakaiḥ paṭe //
meaning:
चिन्तयेत्पार्वतीं देवीं कोकिलारूपधारिणीम् /
गन्धाद्यैः प्रत्यहं प्रार्च्चेल्लिखितां वर्णकैः पटे //
text_mt: One should meditate upon the goddess Pārvatī who has taken the form of a cuckoo; / painted with colours on a cloth, one should worship her daily with perfumes and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vratānte haimīṃ vā tilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvija /
dadyādviprāya mantreṇa bhaktyā sasvarṇadakṣiṇām //
meaning:
ततो व्रतान्ते हैमीं वा तिलपिष्टमयीं द्विज /
दद्याद्विप्राय मन्त्रेण भक्त्या सस्वर्णदक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: Then, at the end of the vow, O twice-born, [an image] made of gold or of sesame flour, / one should give with devotion to a brahmin with a mantra, together with a priestly fee in gold:

sanskrit_iast:
devīṃ caitrarathotpanne kokile haravallabhe /
saṃpūjya dattā viprāya sarvasaukhyakarī bhava //
meaning:
देवीं चैत्ररथोत्पन्ने कोकिले हरवल्लभे /
संपूज्य दत्ता विप्राय सर्वसौख्यकरी भव //
text_mt: “O goddess, born in the Caitraratha forest, O cuckoo, beloved of Hara! / Being worshipped and given to the brahmin, bring about all happiness!”

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaṃ suvāsinīstriṃśadekāṃ vā bhojayettataḥ /
vastrādidakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā datvā natvā visarjayet //
meaning:
द्विजं सुवासिनीस्त्रिंशदेकां वा भोजयेत्ततः /
वस्त्रादिदक्षिणां शक्त्या दत्वा नत्वा विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Then one should feed thirty auspicious married women, or even one, along with a twice-born; / having given priestly gifts of garments and so forth according to ability, and having bowed, one should dismiss them.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yā kurute nārī kokilāvratamuttam /
sā labhetsukhasaubhāgyaṃ saptajanmasunārada //
meaning:
एवं या कुरुते नारी कोकिलाव्रतमुत्तम् /
सा लभेत्सुखसौभाग्यं सप्तजन्मसुनारद //
text_mt: The woman who performs this supreme Kokilā vow in this manner / shall obtain happiness and good fortune for seven births, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrāvaṇapūrṇāyāṃ vedopākaraṇaṃ smṛtam /
yajurbhistatra karttavyaṃ devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam //
meaning:
अथ श्रावणपूर्णायां वेदोपाकरणं स्मृतम् /
यजुर्भिस्तत्र कर्त्तव्यं देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् //
text_mt: Now, on the Śrāvaṇa full moon, the commencement of Vedic study is prescribed; / libations to gods, ṛṣis, and ancestors are to be performed there by followers of the Yajurveda,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi svaśākhoktavidhānataḥ /
bahavṛcaistu caturdvaśyāṃ sāmagairbhādrage kare //
meaning:
ऋषीणां पूजनं चापि स्वशाखोक्तविधानतः /
बहवृचैस्तु चतुर्द्वश्यां सामगैर्भाद्रगे करे //
text_mt: and worship of the ṛṣis as well, according to the rule prescribed in one’s own Vedic branch. / By Rigvedins, however, [it is performed] on the fourteenth; by Samavedins, when the moon is in Hasta in Bhādrapada.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣāvidhānaṃ ca tathā kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam //
meaning: रक्षाविधानं च तथा कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: And likewise, the protective ritual should be performed according to rule:

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthākṣatarājikāśca vidhṛtā raktāṃśukāṃśe sitāḥ kausuṃbhena ca tantunātha salilaiḥ prakṣālya kāṃsye dhṛtāḥ /
gandhādyairabhipūjya devanikarānsaṃprārthya viṣṇvādikānbadhnīyāddvijahastataḥ pramudito natvā prakoṣṭhe svake //
meaning:
सिद्धार्थाक्षतराजिकाश्च विधृता रक्तांशुकांशे सिताः कौसुंभेन च तन्तुनाथ सलिलैः प्रक्षाल्य कांस्ये धृताः /
गन्धाद्यैरभिपूज्य देवनिकरान्संप्रार्थ्य विष्ण्वादिकान्बध्नीयाद्द्विजहस्ततः प्रमुदितो नत्वा प्रकोष्ठे स्वके //
text_mt: White mustard seeds, unbroken grains, and black mustard seeds, placed in a piece of red cloth with a safflower thread, washed with water and held in a brass vessel, / worshipped with perfumes and the like, having prayed to the assembly of gods, Viṣṇu and others, one should joyfully, having bowed, bind it on his wrist from the hand of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā dvijebhyo 'dhyāyamācaret /
visṛjya ca ṛṣīnsapta dhārayedbrahmasūtrakam //
meaning:
ततस्तु दक्षिणां दत्वा द्विजेभ्यो ऽध्यायमाचरेत् /
विसृज्य च ऋषीन्सप्त धारयेद्ब्रह्मसूत्रकम् //
text_mt: Then, having given a fee to the twice-borns, he should commence Vedic study; / and having dismissed the seven sages, he should put on the sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
rañjitaṃ kuṅkumādyaiśca navīnaṃ nirmitaṃ svayam /
śaktyā saṃbhojya viprāgryānekabhuktaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
रञ्जितं कुङ्कुमाद्यैश्च नवीनं निर्मितं स्वयम् /
शक्त्या संभोज्य विप्राग्र्यानेकभुक्तं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: which is coloured with saffron and the like, newly made by oneself. / Having fed the best of twice-borns according to one's capacity, one should eat only one meal [that day].

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte hyasminvrate vipra vārṣikaṃ karmaṃ vaidikam /
vismṛtaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca na kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
कृते ह्यस्मिन्व्रते विप्र वार्षिकं कर्मं वैदिकम् /
विस्मृतं विधिहीनं च न कृतं सुकृतं भवेत् //
text_mt: When this vow is performed, O twice-born, the annual Vedic rite / that was forgotten, deficient in rule, or unperformed, becomes well-performed.

sanskrit_iast:
prauṣṭhapadyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmumāmāheśvaravratam /
ekabhuktaśca yastāṃ tu śivaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
प्रौष्ठपद्यां पौर्णमास्यामुमामाहेश्वरव्रतम् /
एकभुक्तश्च यस्तां तु शिवं संपूज्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: On the full moon day of Prauṣṭhapadā is the Umā-Māheśvara observance. / Having eaten once [the previous day], one who worships Śiva with care,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjaliḥ prārthayecchvaḥ kariṣye ca vrataṃ prabho /
evaṃ vijñāpya devaṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvratamuttamam //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिः प्रार्थयेच्छ्वः करिष्ये च व्रतं प्रभो /
एवं विज्ञाप्य देवं तु गृह्णीयाद्व्रतमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Should pray with folded hands: ‘Tomorrow I will perform the observance, O Lord.’ / Having thus petitioned the god, he should undertake the supreme observance.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau devāntike suptvā utthāyāparayāmake /
kṛtamaitrādinityastu bhasmarudrākṣadhṛk tataḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ देवान्तिके सुप्त्वा उत्थायापरयामके /
कृतमैत्रादिनित्यस्तु भस्मरुद्राक्षधृक् ततः //
text_mt: Having slept near the god at night and arisen in the final watch, / having performed the morning duties and the like, wearing ashes and rudrākṣa beads,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ samyagupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ /
bilvapatraiḥ sugandhāḍhyerṃnaivedyairdhūpadīpakaiḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेच्छङ्करं सम्यगुपचारैः पृथग्विधैः /
बिल्वपत्रैः सुगन्धाढ्येर्ंनैवेद्यैर्धूपदीपकैः //
text_mt: He should properly worship Śaṅkara with various types of services, / with bilva leaves, fragrant offerings, food offerings, incense, and lamps.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścopavasedvidvānāpradoṣaṃ vindhūdaye /
punaḥ saṃpūjya tatraiva rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret //
meaning:
ततश्चोपवसेद्विद्वानाप्रदोषं विन्धूदये /
पुनः संपूज्य तत्रैव रात्रौ जागरणं चरेत् //
text_mt: Then the wise man should fast until twilight; when the moon rises, / having worshipped again right there, he should keep vigil through the night.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañcadaśābdāntaṃ kṛtvā vratamatandritaḥ /
varṣe varṣe tadutsarge vidadhyādvidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
एवं पञ्चदशाब्दान्तं कृत्वा व्रतमतन्द्रितः /
वर्षे वर्षे तदुत्सर्गे विदध्याद्विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having performed the observance thus unwearied until fifteen years [have elapsed], / year after year, he should carry out its formal conclusion according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
umāyāśca maheśasya sauvarṇī pratimādvayam /
haimā raupyā mṛnmayāśca ghaṭāḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ //
meaning:
उमायाश्च महेशस्य सौवर्णी प्रतिमाद्वयम् /
हैमा रौप्या मृन्मयाश्च घटाः पञ्चदशोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Two golden images of Umā and Maheśa [are made], / and fifteen excellent jars of gold, silver, or clay.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraikasminghaṭe sthāpyaṃ savastraṃ pratimādvayam /
pañcāmṛtena saṃsrāpya jalaiḥ śuddhaistator'cayet //
meaning:
तत्रैकस्मिन्घटे स्थाप्यं सवस्त्रं प्रतिमाद्वयम् /
पञ्चामृतेन संस्राप्य जलैः शुद्धैस्ततोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: The two clothed images are to be placed upon one jar there; / having bathed them with the five nectars and with pure waters, he should then worship them

sanskrit_iast:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ pañcadaśa dvijān /
bhojayeccaiva miṣṭānnairdadyāttebhyaśca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
उपचारैः षोडशभिस्ततः पञ्चदश द्विजान् /
भोजयेच्चैव मिष्टान्नैर्दद्यात्तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: With the sixteen services; then he should feed / fifteen Brāhmaṇas with sweet foods and give them priestly gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhamekaikamīśasya mūrtyāḍhyaṃ guraver'payet /
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caiva umāmāheśvarābhidham //
meaning:
कुंभमेकैकमीशस्य मूर्त्याढ्यं गुरवेर्ऽपयेत् /
एवं कृत्वा व्रतं चैव उमामाहेश्वराभिधम् //
text_mt: He should offer each jar, endowed with an image of the Lord, to the guru. / Having performed this observance named Umā-Māheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate bhuvi vikhyāto nidhānaṃ sarvasaṃpadām /
athāsminneva divase śakravratamapi smṛtam //
meaning:
जायते भुवि विख्यातो निधानं सर्वसंपदाम् /
अथास्मिन्नेव दिवसे शक्रव्रतमपि स्मृतम् //
text_mt: He becomes renowned on earth, a storehouse of all prosperity. / Now, on this very day, the Śakra observance is also remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena saṃpūjya suranāyakam /
gandhādyaiṃrupacāraistu naivedyānāṃ ca rāśibhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नात्वा विधानेन संपूज्य सुरनायकम् /
गन्धाद्यैंरुपचारैस्तु नैवेद्यानां च राशिभिः //
text_mt: Having bathed in the morning according to rule, and having worshipped the leader of the gods / with services such as fragrances and heaps of food offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
tato nimantritānviprānsaṃbhojya vidhivaddvija /
samāgatāṃstathaivānyāndīnānāthāṃśca bhojayet //
meaning:
ततो निमन्त्रितान्विप्रान्संभोज्य विधिवद्द्विज /
समागतांस्तथैवान्यान्दीनानाथांश्च भोजयेत् //
text_mt: Then having fed the invited Brāhmaṇas according to rule, O twice-born one, / he should likewise feed others who have arrived, the poor, and the helpless.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchakravrataṃ vipra kartavyaṃ prativārṣikam /
rājñā vā dhaninānyena dhānyaniṣpattimicchatā //
meaning:
एतच्छक्रव्रतं विप्र कर्तव्यं प्रतिवार्षिकम् /
राज्ञा वा धनिनान्येन धान्यनिष्पत्तिमिच्छता //
text_mt: This Śakra observance, O Brāhmaṇa, should be performed annually / by a king or another wealthy person desiring the production of grain.

sanskrit_iast:
āśvine māsi pūrṇāyāṃ vrataṃ kojāgarābhidham /
tena snātvā vidhānena sopavāso jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
आश्विने मासि पूर्णायां व्रतं कोजागराभिधम् /
तेन स्नात्वा विधानेन सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: On the full moon day in the month of Āśvina is the observance named Kojāgara. / Having bathed according to rule, fasting and with senses subdued,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīmabhyarcya sauvarṇīṃ ghaṭe saṃsthāpya tāmraje /
mṛnmaye vā savastrāntāmupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidham //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीमभ्यर्च्य सौवर्णीं घटे संस्थाप्य ताम्रजे /
मृन्मये वा सवस्त्रान्तामुपचारैः पृथग्विधम् //
text_mt: Having placed a golden image of Lakṣmī, adorned with garments, / upon a copper or earthen jar, having worshipped her with various services,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sāyantane kāle 'bhyudite tārakādhipe /
haimānraupyānmṛnmayānvā ghṛtapūrṇānpradīpayet //
meaning:
ततः सायन्तने काले ऽभ्युदिते तारकाधिपे /
हैमान्रौप्यान्मृन्मयान्वा घृतपूर्णान्प्रदीपयेत् //
text_mt: Then, in the evening when the lord of the stars has arisen, / he should light [lamps] of gold, silver, or clay, filled with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ tadardhamayutaṃ sahasraṃ śatameva vā /
ghṛtaśarkarasaṃmiśraṃ vipācya bahu pāyasam //
meaning:
लक्षं तदर्धमयुतं सहस्रं शतमेव वा /
घृतशर्करसंमिश्रं विपाच्य बहु पायसम् //
text_mt: A hundred thousand, half of that, ten thousand, a thousand, or even a hundred. / Having cooked abundant milk-rice mixed with clarified butter and sugar,

sanskrit_iast:
bahupātreṣu saṃsthāpya kaumudyāṃ śītadīdhiteḥ /
yāmamātre gate rātryā lakṣmyai tadvinivedayet //
meaning:
बहुपात्रेषु संस्थाप्य कौमुद्यां शीतदीधितेः /
याममात्रे गते रात्र्या लक्ष्म्यै तद्विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Placing it in many vessels under the moonbeams of the cold-rayed one, / when one watch of the night has passed, he should offer it to Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃbhojayettena viprānbhaktyā tataśca taiḥ /
sahaiva jāgaraṃ kuryyānnṛtyagītasumaṅgalaiḥ //
meaning:
ततः संभोजयेत्तेन विप्रान्भक्त्या ततश्च तैः /
सहैव जागरं कुर्य्यान्नृत्यगीतसुमङ्गलैः //
text_mt: Then he should feed Brāhmaṇas with it with devotion; then / he should keep vigil along with them, accompanied by dancing, singing, and auspicious activities.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ruṇodaye snātvā tāṃ mūrtiṃ guraver'payet /
asyāṃ rātrau mahālakṣmīrvarābhayakarāṃbujā //
meaning:
ततो ऽरुणोदये स्नात्वा तां मूर्तिं गुरवेर्ऽपयेत् /
अस्यां रात्रौ महालक्ष्मीर्वराभयकरांबुजा //
text_mt: Then, having bathed at dawn, he should give that image to the guru. / On this night, Mahālakṣmī, whose lotus-like hands grant boons and fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
niśīthe carate loke ko jāgartiṃ dharātale /
tasmai vittaṃ prayacchāmi jāgrate pūjakāya me //
meaning:
निशीथे चरते लोके को जागर्तिं धरातले /
तस्मै वित्तं प्रयच्छामि जाग्रते पूजकाय मे //
text_mt: Roams through the world at midnight, [asking,] ‘Who is awake on the surface of the earth? / To him, the waking worshipper of mine, I grant wealth.’

sanskrit_iast:
varṣe varṣe kṛtaṃ caitadvrataṃ lakṣmīpratoṣaṇam /
samṛddhimaihikīṃ dadyāddvehānte pāralaukikīm //
meaning:
वर्षे वर्षे कृतं चैतद्व्रतं लक्ष्मीप्रतोषणम् /
समृद्धिमैहिकीं दद्याद्द्वेहान्ते पारलौकिकीम् //
text_mt: This observance pleasing to Lakṣmī, performed year after year, / bestows worldly prosperity and other-worldly [bliss] at the end of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kuryātkārtikadarśanam /
vipratvalabdhaye bhūyaḥ sarvaśatrujayāya ca //
meaning:
कार्तिक्यां पूर्णिमायां तु कुर्यात्कार्तिकदर्शनम् /
विप्रत्वलब्धये भूयः सर्वशत्रुजयाय च //
text_mt: On the full moon day of Kārttika, one should perform the viewing of Kārttika, / in order to attain brāhmaṇa-hood once again and to conquer all enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva dīpadānena vidheyastripurotsavaḥ /
niśāmukhe dvijaśreṣṭha sarvajīvasukhāvahaḥ //
meaning:
अत्रैव दीपदानेन विधेयस्त्रिपुरोत्सवः /
निशामुखे द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वजीवसुखावहः //
text_mt: On this very [day], through the donation of lamps, the Tripura festival is to be celebrated / at nightfall, O best of the twice-born, bringing happiness to all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kīṭāḥ pataṅgā maśakāśca vṛkṣā jale sthale ye vicaranti jīvāḥ /
dṛṣṭvā pradīpānnahi te 'pi janminaḥ punaśca muktiṃ hi labhanta eva ca //
meaning:
कीटाः पतङ्गा मशकाश्च वृक्षा जले स्थले ये विचरन्ति जीवाः /
दृष्ट्वा प्रदीपान्नहि ते ऽपि जन्मिनः पुनश्च मुक्तिं हि लभन्त एव च //
text_mt: Insects, moths, mosquitoes, trees, and whichever living beings roam on water or land, / having seen the lamps, those born beings never [return to rebirth] and indeed attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast: atra candrodaye vipra saṃpūjyāḥ kṛttikāśca ṣaṭ //
meaning: अत्र चन्द्रोदये विप्र संपूज्याः कृत्तिकाश्च षट् //
text_mt: Here, at moonrise, O Brāhmaṇa, the six Kṛttikās are to be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikeyastathā khaḍgī varuṇaśca hutāśanaḥ /
gandhapuṣpaistathā dhūpadīpairnaivedyevistaraiḥ //
meaning:
कार्तिकेयस्तथा खड्गी वरुणश्च हुताशनः /
गन्धपुष्पैस्तथा धूपदीपैर्नैवेद्येविस्तरैः //
text_mt: As well as Kārttikeya, the sword-bearer [Khaḍgin], Varuṇa, and the fire [Hutāśana], / with fragrant flowers, incense, lamps, and abundant food offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
paramānnaiḥ phalaiḥ śākairvahnibrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ /
evaṃ devānsamabhyarcya dīpo deyo gṛhādbahiḥ //
meaning:
परमान्नैः फलैः शाकैर्वह्निब्राह्मणतर्पणैः /
एवं देवान्समभ्यर्च्य दीपो देयो गृहाद्बहिः //
text_mt: With fine food, fruits, herbs, and offerings to fire and Brāhmaṇas. / Having thus worshipped the gods, a lamp should be placed outside the house.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpopānte tathā gartaścaturasro manoharaḥ /
caturddaṃśāṅgulaḥ kāryaḥ secyaścadanavāriṇā //
meaning:
दीपोपान्ते तथा गर्तश्चतुरस्रो मनोहरः /
चतुर्द्दंशाङ्गुलः कार्यः सेच्यश्चदनवारिणा //
text_mt: And near the lamp, a beautiful four-sided pit / of fourteen aṅgulas should be made and sprinkled with sandalwood water.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ kṣīreṇa saṃpūrya haimaṃ tatra vinikṣipet /
muktānetrasamāyuktaṃ matsyaṃ sarvāṅgaśobhanam //
meaning:
गवां क्षीरेण संपूर्य हैमं तत्र विनिक्षिपेत् /
मुक्तानेत्रसमायुक्तं मत्स्यं सर्वाङ्गशोभनम् //
text_mt: Having filled it with cows' milk, one should place therein a golden / fish with eyes of pearl, beautiful in all its limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmatsyāya ca nama iti mantraṃ samuccaran /
gandhādyaistatra saṃpūjya dvijāya pratipādayet //
meaning:
महामत्स्याय च नम इति मन्त्रं समुच्चरन् /
