गन्धाद्यैस्तत्र संपूज्य द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् //
text_mt: Uttering the mantra: ‘Obeisance to the Great Fish,’ / having worshipped it there with fragrances and the like, he should present it to a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrasāgaradānaṃ te mayoktaṃ dvijasattama /
dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa modate harisannidhau //
meaning:
क्षीरसागरदानं ते मयोक्तं द्विजसत्तम /
दानस्यास्य प्रभावेण मोदते हरिसन्निधौ //
text_mt: The gift of the Milk Ocean has been described to you, O best of the twice-born; / by the power of this gift, one rejoices in the presence of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
atra kṛttvā vṛṣotsargaṃ vrataṃ naktaṃ ca nārada /
rudralokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
अत्र कृत्त्वा वृषोत्सर्गं व्रतं नक्तं च नारद /
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Having performed here the release of a bull and the night-fast observance, O Nārada, / he attains the world of Rudra; no doubt should be entertained on this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣyā pūrṇimāyāṃ svarṇāḍhyaṃ lavaṇāḍhakam /
devaṃ viprāya śāntāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye //
meaning:
मार्गशीर्ष्या पूर्णिमायां स्वर्णाढ्यं लवणाढकम् /
देवं विप्राय शान्ताय सर्वकामसमृद्धये //
text_mt: On the full moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa, an āḍhaka measure of salt endowed with gold / [is to be given] to a peaceful Brāhmaṇa for the fulfilment of all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ jagatpurā lakṣmyā tyaktamāsīttato hariḥ /
purandaraśca somaśca tathā tiṣyo bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
इदं जगत्पुरा लक्ष्म्या त्यक्तमासीत्ततो हरिः /
पुरन्दरश्च सोमश्च तथा तिष्यो बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: Long ago, this world was abandoned by Lakṣmī; then Hari, / Purandara, Soma, and also Tiṣya and Bṛhaspati—

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaite puṣyayuktāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ jagadbalāt /
alaṅkṛtaṃ punaścakuḥ saubhāgyotsavakelibhiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चैते पुष्ययुक्तायां पौर्णमास्यां जगद्बलात् /
अलङ्कृतं पुनश्चकुः सौभाग्योत्सवकेलिभिः //
text_mt: These five, on the full moon day joined with the Puṣya constellation, / adorned the world once again by force with festive sports of good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnaraḥ puṣyayoge sarvasaubhāgyavṛddhaye /
gaurasarṣapakalkena samālabhya svakāṃ tanum //
meaning:
तस्मान्नरः पुष्ययोगे सर्वसौभाग्यवृद्धये /
गौरसर्षपकल्केन समालभ्य स्वकां तनुम् //
text_mt: Therefore, when the Puṣya conjunction occurs, a man, for the increase of all good fortune, / having smeared his body with a paste of white mustard,

sanskrit_iast:
snāyātsarvauṃṣadhijalairdhārayecca navāṃśuke /
dṛṣṭvā ca maṅgalaṃ dravyaṃ spṛṣṭvā natvā tator'cayet //
meaning:
स्नायात्सर्वौंषधिजलैर्धारयेच्च नवांशुके /
दृष्ट्वा च मङ्गलं द्रव्यं स्पृष्ट्वा नत्वा ततोर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: Should bathe with waters containing all medicinal herbs and put on two new garments. / Having seen an auspicious object, touched it, and bowed, he should then worship

sanskrit_iast:
hariśakrendupuṣyejyāngandhādyarupacārakaiḥ /
vidhāya homaṃ viprāṃśca tarpayetpāyasāśanaiḥ //
meaning:
हरिशक्रेन्दुपुष्येज्यान्गन्धाद्यरुपचारकैः /
विधाय होमं विप्रांश्च तर्पयेत्पायसाशनैः //
text_mt: Hari, Śakra, Indu, Puṣya, and Bṛhaspati with services such as fragrances; / having performed fire oblation, he should satisfy Brāhmaṇas with meals of milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkṛtvā vrataṃ vipra ramāprītivivarddhanam /
alakṣmīnāśanaṃ caiva modateha paratra ca //
meaning:
एतत्कृत्वा व्रतं विप्र रमाप्रीतिविवर्द्धनम् /
अलक्ष्मीनाशनं चैव मोदतेह परत्र च //
text_mt: Having performed this observance, which enhances the favour of Ramā, O Brāhmaṇa, / and destroys misfortune, he rejoices here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ tato mādhyāṃ tilakārpāsakaṃbalam /
ratnāni kañcukoṣṇīṣapādatrāṇāni vā dhanam //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां ततो माध्यां तिलकार्पासकंबलम् /
रत्नानि कञ्चुकोष्णीषपादत्राणानि वा धनम् //
text_mt: Then, on the full moon day of Māgha, sesame, cotton, a blanket, / gems, a tunic, a turban, footwear, or wealth—

sanskrit_iast:
datvā pramodate svarge dānaṃ vittānusārataḥ /
yastvatra śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ pūjayedvidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
दत्वा प्रमोदते स्वर्गे दानं वित्तानुसारतः /
यस्त्वत्र शङ्करं देवं पूजयेद्विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Having given a gift according to one's wealth, he rejoices in heaven. / But whoever worships the god Śaṅkara here according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpyaviṣṇuloke mahīyate /
phaālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ tu holikāpūjanaṃ matam //
meaning:
सो ऽश्वमेधफलं प्राप्यविष्णुलोके महीयते /
फआल्गुने पूर्णिमायां तु होलिकापूजनं मतम् //
text_mt: He, having obtained the fruit of a horse sacrifice, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu. / On the full moon day of Phālguna, the worship of Holikā is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcayaṃ sarvakāṣṭhānāmupalānāṃ ca kārayet /
tatrāgniṃ vidhivaddhrutvā rakṣoghnairmantravistaraiḥ //
meaning:
संचयं सर्वकाष्ठानामुपलानां च कारयेत् /
तत्राग्निं विधिवद्ध्रुत्वा रक्षोघ्नैर्मन्त्रविस्तरैः //
text_mt: One should make a heap of all kinds of wood and cow-dung cakes; / having kindled a fire there according to rule with extensive demon-slaying mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
"asṛkpābhayasaṃtrastaiḥ kṛtā tvaṃ holi bāliśaiḥ /
atastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi bhūte bhūtipradā bhava" //
meaning:
"असृक्पाभयसंत्रस्तैः कृता त्वं होलि बालिशैः /
अतस्त्वां पूजयिष्यामि भूते भूतिप्रदा भव" //
text_mt: ‘You, O Holi, were made by children terrified by the fear of blood-drinkers; / therefore I will worship you, O spirit, be the bestower of prosperity!’

sanskrit_iast:
iti mantreṇa sandīpya kāṣṭhādikṣepaṇaistataḥ /
parikramyotsavaḥ kāryyo gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
इति मन्त्रेण सन्दीप्य काष्ठादिक्षेपणैस्ततः /
परिक्रम्योत्सवः कार्य्यो गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः //
text_mt: Having kindled [the fire] with this mantra, then by throwing wood and the like, / having circumambulated, a festival should be celebrated with the sounds of songs and musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
holikā rākṣasī ceyaṃ prahlādabhayadāyinī /
tatastāṃ pradahṝntyevaṃ kāṣṭhādyairgītamaṅgalaiḥ //
meaning:
होलिका राक्षसी चेयं प्रह्लादभयदायिनी /
ततस्तां प्रदहॄन्त्येवं काष्ठाद्यैर्गीतमङ्गलैः //
text_mt: And this Holikā was an ogre who brought terror to Prahlāda; / therefore they burn her thus with wood and other fuels, amidst auspicious songs.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarasya dāho 'yaṃ kāmadāho matāntare /
iti jānīhi viprendra loke sthitiranekadhā //
meaning:
संवत्सरस्य दाहो ऽयं कामदाहो मतान्तरे /
इति जानीहि विप्रेन्द्र लोके स्थितिरनेकधा //
text_mt: In another tradition, this is the burning of the year, or the burning of Kāma. / Know this, O best of Brahmins; the customs in the world are diverse.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣānte dve pṛthagvaive tato 'māvratamucyate /
pṛthakchṛṇuṣva me vipra pitṝṇāmativallabham //
meaning:
पक्षान्ते द्वे पृथग्वैवे ततो ऽमाव्रतमुच्यते /
पृथक्छृणुष्व मे विप्र पितॄणामतिवल्लभम् //
text_mt: There are indeed two separate [observances] at the ends of the fortnights. Now the vow of the new-moon day is spoken of; / listen to me separately, O Brahmin, concerning what is exceedingly dear to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
caitravaiśākhayostatra darśe pitṛsamarcanam /
pārvaṇena vidhānena śrāddhaṃ vittānusārataḥ //
meaning:
चैत्रवैशाखयोस्तत्र दर्शे पितृसमर्चनम् /
पार्वणेन विधानेन श्राद्धं वित्तानुसारतः //
text_mt: On the new moon of Caitra and Vaiśākha, the worship of the ancestors is to be performed, / [namely,] the ancestral rite according to the pārvaṇa procedure, in keeping with one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijānāṃ bhojanaṃ dānaṃ gavādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
sarvamāseṣvamāyāṃ vai bahupuṇyapradaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
द्विजानां भोजनं दानं गवादीनां विशेषतः /
सर्वमासेष्वमायां वै बहुपुण्यप्रदं यतः //
text_mt: Feeding Brahmins and giving gifts, especially of cows and other offerings, / on the new-moon day in all months, indeed bestows great merit.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhāmāyāṃ vrataṃ proktaṃ sāvitryāḥ kasya nārada /
vidhānaṃ jyeṣṭhapūrṇāvadihāpi parikīrtitam //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठामायां व्रतं प्रोक्तं सावित्र्याः कस्य नारद /
विधानं ज्येष्ठपूर्णावदिहापि परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: On the new moon of Jyeṣṭha, the vow of Sāvitrī is prescribed, O Nārada; / its procedure has been proclaimed to be just like that of the full moon of Jyeṣṭha here as well.

sanskrit_iast:
śucau nabhasi bhādre ca māse pūrṇāntike dvija /
pitṛśrāddhaṃ dānahomasurārcānantyaśnute //
meaning:
शुचौ नभसि भाद्रे च मासे पूर्णान्तिके द्विज /
पितृश्राद्धं दानहोमसुरार्चानन्त्यश्नुते //
text_mt: In the months of Śuci, Nabhas, and Bhādra, near the full-moon day, O twice-born, / an ancestral rite, giving of gifts, fire oblation, and worship of the gods obtain infinity.

sanskrit_iast:
bhādradarśe 'parāhne tu tilakṣetrasamudbhavān /
viriñcimanunāmantrya huṃphaṭ chinnānkuśān dvija //
meaning:
भाद्रदर्शे ऽपराह्ने तु तिलक्षेत्रसमुद्भवान् /
विरिञ्चिमनुनामन्त्र्य हुंफट् छिन्नान्कुशान् द्विज //
text_mt: On the new moon of Bhādra, in the afternoon, having consecrated [kuśa grasses] grown in sesame fields / with the Viriñci mantra, with 'huṃ phaṭ', cut the kuśa grasses, O Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu yojayedekadāparān /
iṣāmāyāṃ viśeṣaṇa pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam //
meaning:
सर्वदा सर्वकार्येषु योजयेदेकदापरान् /
इषामायां विशेषण पितॄणां श्राद्धतर्पणम् //
text_mt: One should always employ them in all rites, and on another occasion [gather] others. / On the new moon of Iṣa, the ancestral rite and water oblation for the ancestors are especially [prescribed],

sanskrit_iast:
vidheyaṃ jāhnavītoye muktidaṃ ca gayāsthale /
ūrjjāmāyāṃ dīpadānaṃ devā gāragṛheṣu ca //
meaning:
विधेयं जाह्नवीतोये मुक्तिदं च गयास्थले /
ऊर्ज्जामायां दीपदानं देवा गारगृहेषु च //
text_mt: to be performed in the water of the Jāhnavī; and in the place of Gayā it grants liberation. / On the new moon of Ūrja, the offering of lamps in temples and homes,

sanskrit_iast:
nadyārāmataḍāgeṣu caityagoṣṭhāpaṇeṣu ca /
samarcanaṃ tathā lakṣmyāḥ svarṇaraupye kṛtākṛte //
meaning:
नद्यारामतडागेषु चैत्यगोष्ठापणेषु च /
समर्चनं तथा लक्ष्म्याः स्वर्णरौप्ये कृताकृते //
text_mt: at rivers, gardens, and ponds, and at monuments, cowpens, and market-stalls, / as well as the worship of Lakṣmī in gold and silver, whether fashioned or unformed,

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtaṃ ca varṣaphaladaṃ jaye cāpiparājaye /
gavāṃ pūjātra vihitā śṛṅgādyaṅgānurañjanaiḥ //
meaning:
द्यूतं च वर्षफलदं जये चापिपराजये /
गवां पूजात्र विहिता शृङ्गाद्यङ्गानुरञ्जनैः //
text_mt: and gambling, which yields the fruit of the whole year in victory and even in defeat, [should be performed]. / Here the worship of cows is enjoined, by ornamenting their horns and other limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
yavasānnādidānaiśca namaskārapradakṣiṇaiḥ /
mārge 'pi pitṛpūjā syācchraddhairbrāhmaṇabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
यवसान्नादिदानैश्च नमस्कारप्रदक्षिणैः /
मार्गे ऽपि पितृपूजा स्याच्छ्रद्धैर्ब्राह्मणभोजनैः //
text_mt: by gifts of grass, food, and the like, and by reverent salutations and circumambulations. / In Mārgaśīrṣa also, there should be ancestral worship through faithful offerings and feeding of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryādi niyamairjapahomārcanādibhiḥ /
pauṣe māghe ca viprendra pitṛśrāddhaṃ phalādhikam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यादि नियमैर्जपहोमार्चनादिभिः /
पौषे माघे च विप्रेन्द्र पितृश्राद्धं फलाधिकम् //
text_mt: With the vows of celibacy and the like, with recitation, fire oblation, and worship, / the ancestral rite in Pauṣa and Māgha, O best of Brahmins, bears greater fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
amāyāṃ karṇapātārkayuktāyāṃ tu gayādhikam /
phaālgune kevalaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvijānāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अमायां कर्णपातार्कयुक्तायां तु गयाधिकम् /
फआल्गुने केवलं श्राद्धं द्विजानां भोजनं तथा //
text_mt: When the new moon is conjoined with Karṇapāta and the Sun, [the fruit is] greater than at Gayā. / In Phālguna, an ancestral rite alone, as well as the feeding of Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
dānādi sarvaphaladaṃ darśe some 'dhikaṃ phalam /
itthaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ tithikṛtyaṃ mune tava //
meaning:
दानादि सर्वफलदं दर्शे सोमे ऽधिकं फलम् /
इत्थं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं तिथिकृत्यं मुने तव //
text_mt: and giving gifts yield all fruits; on a Monday new moon, the fruit is even greater. / Thus, O sage, the duty of lunar days has been briefly spoken to you;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatrāpi viśeṣo 'sti sa purāṇāntare sthitaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitapaurṇamāsya māvāsyāvratakathanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikaśatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वत्रापि विशेषो ऽस्ति स पुराणान्तरे स्थितः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितपौर्णमास्य मावास्याव्रतकथनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्यधिकशतमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
there are particular details everywhere, which are recorded in other Purāṇas.

Thus ends the one hundred twenty-fourth chapter in the Fourth Quarter of the Great Narrative in the First Part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, entitled 'The Description of the Vows of the Full-Moon and New-Moon Days in the Twelve Months'.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ityevamuktvā muninā hi pṛṣṭāste vai kumārāḥ kila nāradena /
saṃpūjitāḥ śāstravidāṃ variṣṭhāḥ kṛtāhnikā jagmurumeśalokam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्येवमुक्त्वा मुनिना हि पृष्टास्ते वै कुमाराः किल नारदेन /
संपूजिताः शास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठाः कृताह्निका जग्मुरुमेशलोकम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus when questioned by the sage, those Kumāras, / worshipped by Nārada, the foremost among knowers of the scriptures, having completed their daily rites, went to the world of the Lord of Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatreśamagryarkanibhairmunīndraiḥ śrīvāmadevādibhirarcitāṅghrim /
surāsurendrairabhivandyamugraṃ natvājñayā tasya niṣedururvyām //
meaning:
तत्रेशमग्र्यर्कनिभैर्मुनीन्द्रैः श्रीवामदेवादिभिरर्चिताङ्घ्रिम् /
सुरासुरेन्द्रैरभिवन्द्यमुग्रं नत्वाज्ञया तस्य निषेदुरुर्व्याम् //
text_mt: There, having bowed to the Lord, fierce and worthy of praise by the chiefs of gods and demons, whose feet were worshipped by eminent sages resembling the foremost sun, such as the venerable Vāmadeva, / they sat upon the ground at his command.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvātha tatrākhilaśāstrasāraṃ śivāgamaṃ te paśupāśamokṣaṇam /
jagmustato jñānaghanasvarūpā natvā purāriṃ svapiturnikāśam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वाथ तत्राखिलशास्त्रसारं शिवागमं ते पशुपाशमोक्षणम् /
जग्मुस्ततो ज्ञानघनस्वरूपा नत्वा पुरारिं स्वपितुर्निकाशम् //
text_mt: Having heard there the Śiva-āgama, the essence of all scriptures, which brings release from the bonds of the individual soul, / they, whose essence was concentrated knowledge, having bowed to the Enemy of Pura, went into the presence of their father.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpādapadme praṇatiṃ vidhāya pitrāpi satkṛtya sabhājitāste /
labdhvāśiṣo 'dyāpi caranti śaśvallokeṣu tīrthāni ca tīrthabhūtāḥ //
meaning:
तत्पादपद्मे प्रणतिं विधाय पित्रापि सत्कृत्य सभाजितास्ते /
लब्ध्वाशिषो ऽद्यापि चरन्ति शश्वल्लोकेषु तीर्थानि च तीर्थभूताः //
text_mt: Having made prostration at his lotus feet, honored and welcomed by their father, / having received his blessings, they, having become sacred fords themselves, constantly roam the sacred fords in the worlds even today.

sanskrit_iast:
jagmustato vai badarīvanānte surendravargairupasevyamānam /
dadhyuściraṃ viṣṇupadābjamavyayaṃ dhyāyanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ //
meaning:
जग्मुस्ततो वै बदरीवनान्ते सुरेन्द्रवर्गैरुपसेव्यमानम् /
दध्युश्चिरं विष्णुपदाब्जमव्ययं ध्यायन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः //
text_mt: Then they went to the edge of the Badarī forest, attended by groups of the lords of gods, / and meditated for a long time upon the imperishable lotus feet of Viṣṇu, on which ascetics free from passion meditate.

sanskrit_iast:
nārado 'pi tato viprā kumārebhyaḥ samīhitam /
labdhvā jñānaṃ savijñānaṃ bhṛśaṃ prītamanā hyabhūt //
meaning:
नारदो ऽपि ततो विप्रा कुमारेभ्यः समीहितम् /
लब्ध्वा ज्ञानं सविज्ञानं भृशं प्रीतमना ह्यभूत् //
text_mt: Nārada too, O Brahmins, having obtained from the Kumāras the desired / knowledge together with direct realization, became exceedingly pleased in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasmātsvarṇadītīrādāgatya piturantike /
praṇamya satkṛtaḥ pitrā brahmaṇā niṣasāda ca //
meaning:
स तस्मात्स्वर्णदीतीरादागत्य पितुरन्तिके /
प्रणम्य सत्कृतः पित्रा ब्रह्मणा निषसाद च //
text_mt: He, having come from the bank of that golden river into the presence of his father / and bowed, was honored by his father Brahmā and sat down.

sanskrit_iast:
kumārebhyaḥ śrutaṃ yacca jñānaṃ vijñānasaṃyutam /
varṇayāmāsa tattvena so 'pi śrutvā mumoda ca //
meaning:
कुमारेभ्यः श्रुतं यच्च ज्ञानं विज्ञानसंयुतम् /
वर्णयामास तत्त्वेन सो ऽपि श्रुत्वा मुमोद च //
text_mt: And the knowledge accompanied by direct realization which he had heard from the Kumāras / he described in truth; and he, having heard it, also rejoiced.

sanskrit_iast:
atha praṇamya śirasā labdhāśīrmunisattamaḥ /
ājagāma ca kailāsaṃ munisiddhaniṣevitam //
meaning:
अथ प्रणम्य शिरसा लब्धाशीर्मुनिसत्तमः /
आजगाम च कैलासं मुनिसिद्धनिषेवितम् //
text_mt: Then, having bowed with his head and received his blessing, that best of sages / went to Kailāsa, frequented by sages and Siddhas,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāścaryamayaṃ śaśvatsarvarttukusumadrumaiḥ /
mandāraiḥ pārijātaiśca caṃpakāśokavañjulaiḥ //
meaning:
नानाश्चर्यमयं शश्वत्सर्वर्त्तुकुसुमद्रुमैः /
मन्दारैः पारिजातैश्च चंपकाशोकवञ्जुलैः //
text_mt: filled with various wonders, constantly [adorned] with trees blooming in all seasons, / with mandāra, pārijāta, campaka, aśoka, and vañjula trees,

sanskrit_iast:
anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣairnānāpakṣigaṇāvṛtaiḥ /
vātoddhūtaśikhaiḥ pānthānāhvayadbhirivāvṛtam //
meaning:
अन्यैश्च विविधैर्वृक्षैर्नानापक्षिगणावृतैः /
वातोद्धूतशिखैः पान्थानाह्वयद्भिरिवावृतम् //
text_mt: and with other various trees surrounded by flocks of diverse birds, / as if calling travelers with their crowns shaken by the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ siddhakinnarasaṃkulam /
sarobhiḥ svacchasalilairlasatkāñcanapaṅkajaiḥ //
meaning:
नानामृगगणाकीर्णं सिद्धकिन्नरसंकुलम् /
सरोभिः स्वच्छसलिलैर्लसत्काञ्चनपङ्कजैः //
text_mt: crowded with various herds of deer, filled with Siddhas and Kinnaras, / with lakes of clear water and shining golden lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
śobhitaṃ sārasairhaṃsaiścakrāhvādyairnināditam /
svarddhanīpātanir ghṛṣṭaṃ krīḍadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
शोभितं सारसैर्हंसैश्चक्राह्वाद्यैर्निनादितम् /
स्वर्द्धनीपातनिर् घृष्टं क्रीडद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः //
text_mt: graced and made resonant by cranes, swans, and cakravāka birds, / washed by the descent of the heavenly river, with troops of Apsarases sporting

sanskrit_iast:
salile 'lakanandāyāḥ kucakuṅkumapiṅgale /
āmodamuditairnāgaiḥ salilaiḥ puṣkaroddhṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
सलिले ऽलकनन्दायाः कुचकुङ्कुमपिङ्गले /
आमोदमुदितैर्नागैः सलिलैः पुष्करोद्धृतैः //
text_mt: in the water of the Alakanandā, reddish-yellow with the saffron from their breasts, / crowded with elephants delighted by the fragrance, bathing female elephants

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayadbhiḥ kareṇūśca kalabhāṃśca samākule /
atha śvetābhrasadṛśe śṛṅge tasya ca bhūbhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
स्नापयद्भिः करेणूश्च कलभांश्च समाकुले /
अथ श्वेताभ्रसदृशे शृङ्गे तस्य च भूभृतः //
text_mt: and young calves with water drawn up in their trunks. / Then, upon a peak of that mountain that resembled a white cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭaṃ kālābhrasadṛśaṃ dadarśa śatayojanam /
tasyādhastātsamāsīnaṃ yogimaṇḍalamadhyagam //
meaning:
वटं कालाभ्रसदृशं ददर्श शतयोजनम् /
तस्याधस्तात्समासीनं योगिमण्डलमध्यगम् //
text_mt: he saw a banyan tree resembling a dark raincloud, a hundred yojanas [in extent]; / and seated beneath it in the midst of a circle of yogins,

sanskrit_iast:
kapardinaṃ virūpākṣa vyāghracarmāṃbarāvṛtam /
bhūtibhūṣitasarvāṅgaṃ nāgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam //
meaning:
कपर्दिनं विरूपाक्ष व्याघ्रचर्मांबरावृतम् /
भूतिभूषितसर्वाङ्गं नागभूषणभूषितम् //
text_mt: the one with matted hair, odd-eyed, clothed in a tiger-skin garment, / all his limbs adorned with sacred ash, ornamented with serpents as ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrākṣamālayā śaśvacchobhitaṃ candraśekharam /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārado viprā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्राक्षमालया शश्वच्छोभितं चन्द्रशेखरम् /
तं दृष्ट्वा नारदो विप्रा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः //
text_mt: constantly adorned with a garland of rudrākṣa beads, bearing the crescent moon upon his crest. / Seeing him, O Brahmins, Nārada, his neck bowed low with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
nanām śirasā tasya pādayorjagadīśituḥ /
tataḥ prasannamanasā stutvā vāgbhirvṛṣadhvajam //
meaning:
ननाम् शिरसा तस्य पादयोर्जगदीशितुः /
ततः प्रसन्नमनसा स्तुत्वा वाग्भिर्वृषध्वजम् //
text_mt: bowed with his head at the two feet of that Lord of the universe. / Then, with a delighted mind, having praised the Bull-bannered Lord with words,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣasādājñayā sthāṇoḥ satkṛto yogibhistadā /
athāpṛcchacca kuśalaṃ nāradaṃ jagatāṃ guruḥ //
meaning:
निषसादाज्ञया स्थाणोः सत्कृतो योगिभिस्तदा /
अथापृच्छच्च कुशलं नारदं जगतां गुरुः //
text_mt: he sat down by the command of Sthāṇu, honored by the yogins at that time. / Then the Teacher of the worlds inquired after the welfare of Nārada;

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca prāha prasādena bhavataḥ sarvamasti me /
sarveṣāṃ yogivaryāṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tatra vāḍavāḥ //
meaning:
स च प्राह प्रसादेन भवतः सर्वमस्ति मे /
सर्वेषां योगिवर्याणां शृण्वतां तत्र वाडवाः //
text_mt: and he replied, 'By your grace, all is well with me.' / While all the foremost yogins were listening there, O Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
papraccha śāṃbhivaṃ jñānaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam /
sa śivaḥ sādaraṃ tasya bhaktyā saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
पप्रच्छ शांभिवं ज्ञानं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् /
स शिवः सादरं तस्य भक्त्या संतुष्टमानसः //
text_mt: he inquired about the Śāmbhava knowledge, which brings release from the bonds of the individual soul. / That Śiva, his mind satisfied by his devotion, with affectionate regard,

sanskrit_iast:
yogamaṣṭāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ prāha praṇatavatsalaḥ /
sa labdhvā śāṃbhavaṃ jñānaṃ śaṅkarāllokaśaṅkarāt //
meaning:
योगमष्टाङ्गसंयुक्तं प्राह प्रणतवत्सलः /
स लब्ध्वा शांभवं ज्ञानं शङ्कराल्लोकशङ्करात् //
text_mt: affectionate to those who bow, taught him yoga endowed with the eight limbs. / Having obtained the Śāmbhava knowledge from Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
suprasannamanā natvā yayau nārāyaṇāntikam /
tatrāpi nārado 'bhīkṣṇaṃ gatāgataparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सुप्रसन्नमना नत्वा ययौ नारायणान्तिकम् /
तत्रापि नारदो ऽभीक्ष्णं गतागतपरायणः //
text_mt: with an exceedingly delighted mind, having bowed, he went into the presence of Nārāyaṇa. / There also Nārada, constantly intent on going and coming,

sanskrit_iast:
sevitaṃ yogibhiḥ siddhairnārāyaṇamatoṣayat /
etadvaḥ kīrtitaṃ viprā nāradīyaṃ mahanmayā //
meaning:
सेवितं योगिभिः सिद्धैर्नारायणमतोषयत् /
एतद्वः कीर्तितं विप्रा नारदीयं महन्मया //
text_mt: pleased Nārāyaṇa, who was served by yogins and Siddhas. / This great Nāradīya has been proclaimed by me to you, O Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
upākhyānaṃ vedasamaṃ sarvaśāstranidarśanam /
catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ jñānavarddhanam //
meaning:
उपाख्यानं वेदसमं सर्वशास्त्रनिदर्शनम् /
चतुष्पादसमायुक्तं शृण्वतां ज्ञानवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: a narrative equal to the Veda, an exposition of all scriptures, / consisting of four quarters, increasing the knowledge of those who listen.

sanskrit_iast:
ya etatkīrtayedviprā nāradīyaṃ śivālaye /
samāje dvijamukhyānāṃ tathā keśavamandire //
meaning:
य एतत्कीर्तयेद्विप्रा नारदीयं शिवालये /
समाजे द्विजमुख्यानां तथा केशवमन्दिरे //
text_mt: Whoever proclaims this Nāradīya, O Brahmins, in an abode of Śiva, / in an assembly of the foremost of Brahmins, or in a temple of Keśava,

sanskrit_iast:
mathurāyāṃ prayāge ca puruṣottamasannidhau /
setau kāñcyāṃ kuśasthalyāṃ gaṅgādvāre kuśasthale //
meaning:
मथुरायां प्रयागे च पुरुषोत्तमसन्निधौ /
सेतौ काञ्च्यां कुशस्थल्यां गङ्गाद्वारे कुशस्थले //
text_mt: in Mathurā, in Prayāga, or in the presence of Puruṣottama, / at the Causeway, in Kāñcī, in Kuśasthalī, at Gaṅgādvāra, or in Kuśasthala,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkareṣu nadītīre yatra kutrāpi bhaktimān /
sa labhetsarvaya jñānāṃ tīrthānāṃ ca phalaṃ mahat //
meaning:
पुष्करेषु नदीतीरे यत्र कुत्रापि भक्तिमान् /
स लभेत्सर्वय ज्ञानां तीर्थानां च फलं महत् //
text_mt: at Puṣkara, on a riverbank, or wherever a devoted person may be, / he attains the great fruit of all sacrifices and sacred fords,

sanskrit_iast:
dānānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ vāpyaśeṣataḥ /
upavāsaparo vāpi haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
दानानां चापि सर्वेषां तपसां वाप्यशेषतः /
उपवासपरो वापि हविष्याशी जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: and of all gifts, and of all austerities entirely, / whether intent on fasting, eating sacrificial food, with senses subdued;

sanskrit_iast:
śrotā caiva tathā vaktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ /
śivabhaktirato vāpi śṛṇvan siddhimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
श्रोता चैव तथा वक्ता नारायणपरायणः /
शिवभक्तिरतो वापि शृण्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: both the listener and the speaker devoted to Nārāyaṇa, / or engaged in devotion to Śiva, will attain accomplishment by listening [to it].

sanskrit_iast:
asninnaśeṣapuṇyānāṃ siddhīnāṃ ca samudbhavaḥ /
kathitaḥ sarvapāpaghnaḥ paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sadā //
meaning:
अस्निन्नशेषपुण्यानां सिद्धीनां च समुद्भवः /
कथितः सर्वपापघ्नः पठतां शृण्वतां सदा //
text_mt: In this [Purāṇa] the source of all merits and accomplishments is proclaimed, / destroying all sins for those who recite and listen always.

sanskrit_iast:
kalidoṣaharaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvasaṃpattivarddhanam /
sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ cedaṃ sarvajñānaprakāśakam //
meaning:
कलिदोषहरं पुंसां सर्वसंपत्तिवर्द्धनम् /
सर्वेषामीप्सितं चेदं सर्वज्ञानप्रकाशकम् //
text_mt: It removes the faults of the Kali age for men, increases all prosperity, / fulfills the desires of all, and illuminates all knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
śaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śāktānāṃ sūyasevinām /
tathaiva gāṇapatyānāṃ varṇāśramavatāṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
शैवानां वैष्णवानां च शाक्तानां सूयसेविनाम् /
तथैव गाणपत्यानां वर्णाश्रमवतां द्विजाः //
text_mt: for Śaivas, Vaiṣṇavas, Śāktas, and worshippers of the Sun, / as well as for Gāṇapatyas, and for those observing caste and stage of life, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca phalānāṃ saṃprakāśakam /
mantrāṇāṃ caiva yantrāṇāṃ vedāṅgānāṃ vibhāgaśaḥ //
meaning:
तपसां च व्रतानां च फलानां संप्रकाशकम् /
मन्त्राणां चैव यन्त्राणां वेदाङ्गानां विभागशः //
text_mt: revealing the fruits of austerities and vows, / and of mantras, yantras, and the limbs of the Veda in detail,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāgamānāṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ vedānāṃ caiva saṃgraham /
ya etatpaṭhate bhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
तथागमानां सांख्यानां वेदानां चैव संग्रहम् /
य एतत्पठते भक्त्या शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः //
text_mt: as well as a compendium of Āgamas, Sāṃkhya, and the Vedas. / Whoever recites this with devotion, or listens with a concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast:
sa labhedvāñchitānkāmāndevādiṣvapi durlabhān /
śrutvedaṃ nāradīyaṃ tu purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam //
meaning:
स लभेद्वाञ्छितान्कामान्देवादिष्वपि दुर्लभान् /
श्रुत्वेदं नारदीयं तु पुराणं वेदसंमितम् //
text_mt: attains desired wishes difficult to obtain even among the gods and others. / Having heard this Nāradīya Purāṇa, equal to the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
vācakaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā dhanaratnāṃśukādibhiḥ /
bhūmidānairgavāṃ dānai ratnadānaiśca saṃtatam //
meaning:
वाचकं पूजयेद्भक्त्या धनरत्नांशुकादिभिः /
भूमिदानैर्गवां दानै रत्नदानैश्च संततम् //
text_mt: one should worship the reciter with devotion, offering wealth, jewels, garments, and the like, / with gifts of land, gifts of cows, and gifts of gems continuously,

sanskrit_iast:
hastyaśvarathadānaiśca prīṇayetsatataṃ gurum /
yastu vyākurute viprāḥ purāṇaṃ dharmasaṃgraham //
meaning:
हस्त्यश्वरथदानैश्च प्रीणयेत्सततं गुरुम् /
यस्तु व्याकुरुते विप्राः पुराणं धर्मसंग्रहम् //
text_mt: and should constantly please the guru with gifts of elephants, horses, and chariots. / For the one who expounds this Purāṇa, a compendium of dharma, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvargapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ ko 'nyastatsadṛśo guruḥ /
kāyena manasā vācā dhanādyairapi saṃtatam //
meaning:
चतुर्वर्गप्रदं नॄणां को ऽन्यस्तत्सदृशो गुरुः /
कायेन मनसा वाचा धनाद्यैरपि संततम् //
text_mt: bestowing the four goals of life upon men—what other guru is equal to him? / In body, mind, speech, and constantly through wealth and other means,

sanskrit_iast:
priyaṃ samācarettasya gurorddharmopadeśinaḥ /
śrutvā purāṇaṃ vidhivaddhomaṃ kṛtvā surārcanam //
meaning:
प्रियं समाचरेत्तस्य गुरोर्द्धर्मोपदेशिनः /
श्रुत्वा पुराणं विधिवद्धोमं कृत्वा सुरार्चनम् //
text_mt: one should do what is pleasing to that guru who teaches dharma. / Having listened to the Purāṇa according to rule, performed fire oblations, and worshipped the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścācchataṃ miṣṭānnapāyasaiḥ /
dakṣiṇāṃ pradadecchaktyā bhaktyā prīyeta mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाच्छतं मिष्टान्नपायसैः /
दक्षिणां प्रददेच्छक्त्या भक्त्या प्रीयेत माधवः //
text_mt: one should then feed a hundred Brahmins with sweet foods and milk-rice pudding; / one should give a sacrificial fee according to one's ability; Mādhava is pleased by devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śreṣṭhā nadī gaṅgā puṣkaraṃ ca saro yathā /
kāśī purī nago merurdevo nārāyaṇo hariḥ //
meaning:
यथा श्रेष्ठा नदी गङ्गा पुष्करं च सरो यथा /
काशी पुरी नगो मेरुर्देवो नारायणो हरिः //
text_mt: Just as the Gaṅgā is the foremost river, and Puṣkara is [the foremost] lake, / Kāśī the [foremost] city, Meru the mountain, and God Nārāyaṇa Hari [the foremost deity],

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ yugaṃ sāmavedo dhenurvipro 'nnamaṃbu ca /
mārgo mṛgendraḥ puruṣo 'śvatthaḥ prahlāda ānanam //
meaning:
कृतं युगं सामवेदो धेनुर्विप्रो ऽन्नमंबु च /
मार्गो मृगेन्द्रः पुरुषो ऽश्वत्थः प्रह्लाद आननम् //
text_mt: the Kṛta age, the Sāmaveda, the cow, the Brahmin, food, and water, / the path, the lion, the Puruṣa, the aśvattha tree, Prahlāda, the mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥ śravā vasaṃtaśca japaḥ śeṣor'yamā dhanuḥ /
pāvako viṣṇurindraśca kapilo vākpatiḥ kaviḥ //
meaning:
उच्चैः श्रवा वसंतश्च जपः शेषोर्ऽयमा धनुः /
पावको विष्णुरिन्द्रश्च कपिलो वाक्पतिः कविः //
text_mt: Uccaiḥśravas, spring, recitation, Śeṣa, Aryaman, the bow, / fire, Viṣṇu, Indra, Kapila, the Lord of Speech [Bṛhaspati], the poet [Śukra],

sanskrit_iast:
arjuno hanumāndarbhaścittaṃ citrarathoṃ'bujam /
urvaśī kāñcanaṃ yadvacchreṣṭāścaite svajātiṣu //
meaning:
अर्जुनो हनुमान्दर्भश्चित्तं चित्ररथोंऽबुजम् /
उर्वशी काञ्चनं यद्वच्छ्रेष्टाश्चैते स्वजातिषु //
text_mt: Arjuna, Hanumān, darbha grass, the mind, Citraratha, the lotus, / Urvaśī, and gold—just as these are foremost among their own kind,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva nāradīyaṃ tu purāṇeṣu prakīrtitam /
śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu sarveṣāṃ vo dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
तथैव नारदीयं तु पुराणेषु प्रकीर्तितम् /
शान्तिरस्तु शिवं चास्तु सर्वेषां वो द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: so indeed is the Nāradīya proclaimed among the Purāṇas. / May there be peace, and may there be auspiciousness for all of you, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
gamiṣyāmi guroḥ pārṃśvaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ /
ityuktvābhyarcitaḥ sūtaḥ śaunakādyairmahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
गमिष्यामि गुरोः पार्ंश्वं व्यासस्यामिततेजसः /
इत्युक्त्वाभ्यर्चितः सूतः शौनकाद्यैर्महात्मभिः //
text_mt: I shall go to the presence of my guru, Vyāsa of immeasurable splendor.” / Having spoken thus, Sūta was worshipped by the great-souled Śaunaka and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñaptaśca punaḥ sarvairdarśanārthaṃ guroryayau /
te 'pi sarve dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śaunakādyāḥ samāhitāḥ /
śrutaṃ samyaganuṣṭhāya tatra tasthuśca satriṇaḥ //
meaning:
आज्ञप्तश्च पुनः सर्वैर्दर्शनार्थं गुरोर्ययौ /
ते ऽपि सर्वे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शौनकाद्याः समाहिताः /
श्रुतं सम्यगनुष्ठाय तत्र तस्थुश्च सत्रिणः //
text_mt: and, permitted by all, he departed to see his guru. / And all those best twice-born, Śaunaka and the others, composed in mind, / having practiced well what was heard, remained there performing their sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kalikalmaṣaviṣanāśanaṃ hariṃ yo japapūjanavidhibheṣajopasevī /
sa tu nirviṣamanasā sametya yāgaṃ labhate satamabhīpsitaṃ hi lokam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde purāṇamahimāvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
samāptoyaṃ bṛhannāradīyapurāṇasya pūrvabhāgaḥ
śrīrādhāmadanamohano jayati tarām
uttarabhāgaḥ
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ
meaning:
कलिकल्मषविषनाशनं हरिं यो जपपूजनविधिभेषजोपसेवी /
स तु निर्विषमनसा समेत्य यागं लभते सतमभीप्सितं हि लोकम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे पुराणमहिमावर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः
समाप्तोयं बृहन्नारदीयपुराणस्य पूर्वभागः
श्रीराधामदनमोहनो जयति तराम्
उत्तरभागः
श्रीगणेशाय नमः
श्रीकृष्णाय नमः
text_mt:
He who, using the remedy of the rules of recitation and worship, attends upon Hari, the destroyer of the poison that is the impurity of the Kali age, / having reached that sacrifice with a mind free of poison, indeed attains the world desired by the virtuous.

Thus ends the hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Greatness of the Purāṇa,' in the fourth quarter in the great narrative of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

Here ends the first part of the Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

Glorious Rādhā-Madanamohana is supremely victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
pāntu vo jaladaśyāmāḥ śārṅgajyāghātakarkaśāḥ /
trailokyamaṇḍapastaṃbhāścatvāro haribāhavaḥ //
meaning:
पान्तु वो जलदश्यामाः शार्ङ्गज्याघातकर्कशाः /
त्रैलोक्यमण्डपस्तंभाश्चत्वारो हरिबाहवः //
text_mt: Dark as rain clouds, calloused by the striking of the bowstring of Śārṅga, / the four pillars of the pavilion of the three worlds—may the arms of Hari protect you!

sanskrit_iast:
surada suraśiroratnanighṛṣṭamaṇirañjitam /
haripādāṃbujadvandvamabhīṣṭaptadamastu naḥ //
meaning:
सुरद सुरशिरोरत्ननिघृष्टमणिरञ्जितम् /
हरिपादांबुजद्वन्द्वमभीष्टप्तदमस्तु नः //
text_mt: Colored by gems rubbed against the crest-jewels of gods and demons, / may the pair of lotus-feet of Hari grant our desires!

sanskrit_iast:
māndhātovāca
pāpendhanasya ghorasya śuṣkārdrasya dvijottama /
kovahnirdahate tasya tadbhavānvaktumarhati //
meaning:
मान्धातोवाच
पापेन्धनस्य घोरस्य शुष्कार्द्रस्य द्विजोत्तम /
कोवह्निर्दहते तस्य तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति //
text_mt: Māndhātṛ said: / For the dreadful firewood of sin, dry and wet, O best of the twice-born, / what fire burns it? You ought to tell that.

sanskrit_iast:
nājñātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu caturmukhasamudbhava /
vidyate tava viprendra trividhasya suniścitam //
meaning:
नाज्ञातं त्रिषु लोकेषु चतुर्मुखसमुद्भव /
विद्यते तव विप्रेन्द्र त्रिविधस्य सुनिश्चितम् //
text_mt: Nothing in the three worlds is unknown to you, O son of the four-faced [Brahmā], / of threefold nature, O best of the twice-born, that is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātaṃ pātakaṃ śuṣkaṃ jñātaṃ cārdramudāhṛtam /
bhāvyaṃ vāpyathavātītaṃ vartamāna vadasva naḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञातं पातकं शुष्कं ज्ञातं चार्द्रमुदाहृतम् /
भाव्यं वाप्यथवातीतं वर्तमान वदस्व नः //
text_mt: Sin committed unknowingly is called dry, and that committed knowingly is called wet, / whether future, past, or present—tell us,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnino kena tadbhasma bhavedetanmataṃ mama /
vasiṣṭaṃ uvāca
śrūyatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla vahninā yena tadbhavet //
meaning:
वह्निनो केन तद्भस्म भवेदेतन्मतं मम /
वसिष्टं उवाच
श्रूयतां नृपशार्दूल वह्निना येन तद्भवेत् //
text_mt: by what fire would that be turned to ash? This is my question. / Vasiṣṭha said: / Hear, O tiger among kings, by what fire that happens:

sanskrit_iast: bhasma śuṣkaṃ tathārdraṃ ca pāpamasya hyeśeṣataḥ //
meaning: भस्म शुष्कं तथार्द्रं च पापमस्य ह्येशेषतः //
text_mt: the sin, both dry and wet, of this [man] completely becomes ash.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇoryo naraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ /
upavāsaparo bhūtvā pūjayenmadhusūdanam //
meaning:
अवाप्य वासरं विष्णोर्यो नरः संयतेन्द्रियः /
उपवासपरो भूत्वा पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: Having reached the day of Viṣṇu, whatever man, with restrained senses, / intent on fasting, should worship Madhusūdana,

sanskrit_iast:
sa dhātrīsnānasahito rātrau jāgaraṇānvitaḥ /
viśodhayati pāpāni kitavo hi yathā dhanam //
meaning:
स धात्रीस्नानसहितो रात्रौ जागरणान्वितः /
विशोधयति पापानि कितवो हि यथा धनम् //
text_mt: he, taking a bath with myrobalan and keeping vigil at night, / cleanses sins away, just as a gambler clears his wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadāśīsamākhyena vahninā pātakendhanam /
bhasmatāṃ yāti rājendra api janmaśatodbhavam //
meaning:
एकदाशीसमाख्येन वह्निना पातकेन्धनम् /
भस्मतां याति राजेन्द्र अपि जन्मशतोद्भवम् //
text_mt: By the fire known as Ekādaśī, the firewood of sins / goes to ashes, O king of kings, even if arisen across a hundred births.

sanskrit_iast:
nedṛśa pāvanaṃ kiñcinnārāṇāṃ bhūpa vidyate /
yādṛśaṃ padmanābhasya dinaṃ pātakahānidam //
meaning:
नेदृश पावनं किञ्चिन्नाराणां भूप विद्यते /
यादृशं पद्मनाभस्य दिनं पातकहानिदम् //
text_mt: There exists no such purifier for men, O king, / as the day of Padmanābha, which destroys sin.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatpāpāni dehe 'smiṃstiṣṭhanti manujādhipa /
yāvannopavasejjantuḥ padmanābhadimaṃ śubham //
meaning:
तावत्पापानि देहे ऽस्मिंस्तिष्ठन्ति मनुजाधिप /
यावन्नोपवसेज्जन्तुः पद्मनाभदिमं शुभम् //
text_mt: Sins remain in this body only so long, O ruler of men, / as a creature does not fast on the auspicious day of Padmanābha.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca /
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्राणि राजसूयशतानि च /
एकादश्युपवासस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् //
text_mt: Thousands of horse sacrifices and hundreds of Rājasūya sacrifices / do not equal a sixteenth part of a fast on Ekādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavati prabho /
ekādaśyupavāsena tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
एकादशेन्द्रियैः पापं यत्कृतं भवति प्रभो /
एकादश्युपवासेन तत्सर्वं विलयं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed by the eleven senses, O lord, / all of that dissolves by fasting on Ekādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīsamaṃ kiñcitpāpanāśaṃ na vidyate /
vyājenāpi kṛtā rājanna darśayati bhāskarim //
meaning:
एकादशीसमं किञ्चित्पापनाशं न विद्यते /
व्याजेनापि कृता राजन्न दर्शयति भास्करिम् //
text_mt: There is no destroyer of sin equal to Ekādaśī; / even if observed under a pretext, O king, it does not reveal the son of the Sun [Yama].

sanskrit_iast:
svargamokṣapradā hyeṣā rājyaputrapradāyinī /
sukalatrapradā hyeṣā śarīrārogyadāyinī //
meaning:
स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदा ह्येषा राज्यपुत्रप्रदायिनी /
सुकलत्रप्रदा ह्येषा शरीरारोग्यदायिनी //
text_mt: For this grants heaven and liberation, bestows kingdom and sons; / indeed, this grants a good wife, and bestows health of body.

sanskrit_iast:
na gaṅgā na gayā bhūpa na kāśī na ca puṣkaram /
na cāpi kairavaṃ kṣetraṃ na revā na ca devikā //
meaning:
न गङ्गा न गया भूप न काशी न च पुष्करम् /
न चापि कैरवं क्षेत्रं न रेवा न च देविका //
text_mt: Neither Gaṅgā nor Gayā, O king, nor Kāśī nor Puṣkara, / nor the sacred field of Kairava, nor the Revā nor the Devikā,

sanskrit_iast:
yamunā candrabhāgā ca puṇyā bhūpa harerdināt /
anāyāsena rājendra prāpyate harimandiram //
meaning:
यमुना चन्द्रभागा च पुण्या भूप हरेर्दिनात् /
अनायासेन राजेन्द्र प्राप्यते हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: nor the Yamunā nor the Candrabhāgā is as sacred, O king, as the day of Hari. / Without effort, O king of kings, the abode of Hari is reached;

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau jāmaraṇa kṛtvā samupoṣya harerdinam /
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke vrajennaraḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ जामरण कृत्वा समुपोष्य हरेर्दिनम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके व्रजेन्नरः //
text_mt: having kept vigil at night and fasted on the day of Hari, / freed from all sins, a man goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaiva mātṛke pakṣe daśa rājendra paitṛke /
bhāryāyā daśa pakṣe ca puruṣānuddharettathā //
meaning:
दशैव मातृके पक्षे दश राजेन्द्र पैतृके /
भार्याया दश पक्षे च पुरुषानुद्धरेत्तथा //
text_mt: He delivers ten generations on the mother's side, ten on the father's side, O king of kings, / and likewise ten generations on the wife's side;

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānamapi rājendra sa nayedvaiṣṇavaṃ puram /
cintāmaṇisamā hyeṣā athavāpi nidheḥ samā //
meaning:
आत्मानमपि राजेन्द्र स नयेद्वैष्णवं पुरम् /
चिन्तामणिसमा ह्येषा अथवापि निधेः समा //
text_mt: he leads himself also, O king of kings, to the city of Viṣṇu. / For this is like the wishing-jewel, or like a treasure,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpapādapaprakhyā vedavākyopamāthavā /
dvādaśīṃ ye prapannā hi narā naravarottama //
meaning:
संकल्पपादपप्रख्या वेदवाक्योपमाथवा /
द्वादशीं ये प्रपन्ना हि नरा नरवरोत्तम //
text_mt: resembling the wishing-tree, or comparable to the words of the Veda. / The men who resort to Dvādaśī, O best of the foremost of men,

sanskrit_iast:
te dvandvabāhavo jātā nāgārikṛtavāhanāḥ /
sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāśca prayānti harimandiram //
meaning:
ते द्वन्द्वबाहवो जाता नागारिकृतवाहनाः /
स्रग्विणः पीतवस्त्राश्च प्रयान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: become four-armed, have the enemy of serpents [Garuḍa] as their mount, / wearing garlands and yellow garments, they go to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa prabhāvo hi mayā dvādaśyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
pāpendhanasya ghorasya pāvakākhyo mahīpate //
meaning:
एष प्रभावो हि मया द्वादश्याः परिकीर्तितः /
पापेन्धनस्य घोरस्य पावकाख्यो महीपते //
text_mt: This power of the dvādaśī has thus been proclaimed by me, / which is called a fire for the dreadful fuel of sin, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
harerddinaṃ sadopoṣyaṃ narairdharmaparāyaṇaiḥ /
icchadbhirvipulānyogānputrapautrādikāṃstathā //
meaning:
हरेर्द्दिनं सदोपोष्यं नरैर्धर्मपरायणैः /
इच्छद्भिर्विपुलान्योगान्पुत्रपौत्रादिकांस्तथा //
text_mt: Hari's day must always be fasted by men devoted to righteousness, / who desire extensive acquisitions, as well as sons, grandsons, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
haridinamiha martyo yaḥ karotyādareṇa naravara sa tu kukṣiṃ māturāpnoti naiva /
bahuvṛjinasameto 'kāmataḥ kāmato vā vrajati padamanantaṃ lokanāthasya viṣṇoḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge dvādaśīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
हरिदिनमिह मर्त्यो यः करोत्यादरेण नरवर स तु कुक्षिं मातुराप्नोति नैव /
बहुवृजिनसमेतो ऽकामतः कामतो वा व्रजति पदमनन्तं लोकनाथस्य विष्णोः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे द्वादशीमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम प्रथमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
A mortal here who observes Hari's day with devotion, O best of men, never enters a mother's womb again; / even burdened with many sins, whether unintentionally or intentionally, he goes to the endless abode of Viṣṇu, lord of the world.

Thus ends the first chapter, named 'Description of the Eulogy of Greatness of Dvādaśī', in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭa uvāca
imamevārthamuddiśya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ /
papracchurmunayaḥ sūtaṃ vyāsaśiṣyaṃ mahāmatim //
meaning:
वसिष्ट उवाच
इममेवार्थमुद्दिश्य नैमिषारण्यवासिनः /
पप्रच्छुर्मुनयः सूतं व्यासशिष्यं महामतिम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / With reference to this very matter, the sages residing in the Naimiṣa forest / questioned Sūta, the high-minded disciple of Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu pṛṣṭo mahābhāga ekādaśyāḥ suvistaram /
māhātmyaṃ kathayāmāsa upavāsavidhiṃ tathā //
meaning:
स तु पृष्टो महाभाग एकादश्याः सुविस्तरम् /
माहात्म्यं कथयामास उपवासविधिं तथा //
text_mt: Being asked, O illustrious one, he related at full length / the eulogy of greatness of the ekādaśī, and also the rule of fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyaṃ sūtaputrasya śrutvā dvijavarottamāḥ /
māhātmyaṃ cakriṇaścāpi sarvapāpaugha śāntidam //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यं सूतपुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा द्विजवरोत्तमाः /
माहात्म्यं चक्रिणश्चापि सर्वपापौघ शान्तिदम् //
text_mt: Having heard that speech of the son of Sūta, and also the eulogy of greatness of the Wielder of the Discus / which brings pacification to the multitude of all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ papracchuramalaṃ sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ nṛpa /
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni bhavān jānāti mānada //
meaning:
पुनः पप्रच्छुरमलं सूतं पौराणिकं नृप /
अष्टादश पुराणानि भवान् जानाति मानद //
text_mt: the best of twice-born men questioned once more the stainless Sūta, skilled in the Purāṇas, O king: / "O honor-bestowing one, you know the eighteen Purāṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
kānīnasya prasādenaḥ mahābhāratamapyuta /
tannāsti yanna vetsi tvaṃ purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi //
meaning:
कानीनस्य प्रसादेनः महाभारतमप्युत /
तन्नास्ति यन्न वेत्सि त्वं पुराणेषु स्मृतिष्वपि //
text_mt: and also the Mahābhārata, by the grace of the maiden-born [Vyāsa]; / there is nothing that you do not know among the Purāṇas and the Smṛtis,

sanskrit_iast:
carite raghunāthasya śatakoṭipravistare /
asmākaṃ saṃśayaḥ kaściddhṛdaye saṃpravartate //
meaning:
चरिते रघुनाथस्य शतकोटिप्रविस्तरे /
अस्माकं संशयः कश्चिद्धृदये संप्रवर्तते //
text_mt: or in the deeds of Raghunātha extended to a hundred crores [of verses]. / A doubt has arisen in our hearts;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ bhavānarhati cchettuṃ yāthārthyena suvistarāt /
titheḥ prāntamupoṣyaṃ syādāhosvinmūlameva ca //
meaning:
तं भवानर्हति च्छेत्तुं याथार्थ्येन सुविस्तरात् /
तिथेः प्रान्तमुपोष्यं स्यादाहोस्विन्मूलमेव च //
text_mt: it is right that you should dispel it thoroughly according to truth: / Should the end of a lunar day be fasted, or rather its beginning?

sanskrit_iast:
daive paitrye samākhyāhi nāvedyaṃ vidyate tavala /
sautiruvāca
titheḥ prāntaṃ surāṇāṃ hi upoṣyaṃ prītivarddhanam //
meaning:
दैवे पैत्र्ये समाख्याहि नावेद्यं विद्यते तवल /
सौतिरुवाच
तिथेः प्रान्तं सुराणां हि उपोष्यं प्रीतिवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: Explain it with respect to rites for the gods and for the ancestors; there is nothing unknown to you." / Sauti said: / "The end of a lunar day, when fasted, increases the pleasure of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ titheḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu kālajñaiḥ priyamīritam /
ataḥ prāntamupoṣyaṃ hi titherdaśaphalepsubhiḥ //
meaning:
मूलं तिथेः पितॄणां तु कालज्ञैः प्रियमीरितम् /
अतः प्रान्तमुपोष्यं हि तिथेर्दशफलेप्सुभिः //
text_mt: while the beginning of a lunar day is declared dear to the ancestors by knowers of time. / Therefore, the end of a lunar day must be fasted by those desiring divine fruits;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ hi pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ vijñeyaṃ dharmakāṅkṣibhiḥ /
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā dvitīyā cāṣṭamī tathā //
meaning:
मूलं हि पितृतृप्त्यर्थं विज्ञेयं धर्मकाङ्क्षिभिः /
पूर्वविद्धा न कर्तव्या द्वितीया चाष्टमी तथा //
text_mt: the beginning is to be recognized for the gratification of ancestors by those desiring righteousness. / An overlapped-from-the-previous dvitīyā must not be observed, nor an aṣṭamī,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhī caikādaśī bhūpa dharmakāmārthalipsubhiḥ /
pūrvaviddhā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kartavyā saptamī sadā //
meaning:
षष्ठी चैकादशी भूप धर्मकामार्थलिप्सुभिः /
पूर्वविद्धा द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कर्तव्या सप्तमी सदा //
text_mt: nor a ṣaṣṭhī, nor an ekādaśī, O king, by those desiring righteousness, pleasure, and wealth. / O best of twice-born men, an overlapped-from-the-previous saptamī must always be observed,

sanskrit_iast:
darśaśca paurṇamāsaśca pituḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam /
pūrvaviddhānimāṃstyaktvā narakaṃ pratipadyate //
meaning:
दर्शश्च पौर्णमासश्च पितुः सांवत्सरं दिनम् /
पूर्वविद्धानिमांस्त्यक्त्वा नरकं प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: as well as the new moon, the full moon, and the day of a father's annual rite. / Discarding these when overlapped from the previous, one goes to hell,

sanskrit_iast:
hāniṃ ca saṃtaterbhūpadaurbhāgyaṃ samavāpnuyāt /
etacchrutaṃ mayā viprāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanātpurā //
meaning:
हानिं च संततेर्भूपदौर्भाग्यं समवाप्नुयात् /
एतच्छ्रुतं मया विप्राः कृष्णद्वैपायनात्पुरा //
text_mt: and meets with the loss of offspring, O king, and with misfortune. / This was heard by me formerly from Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana, O brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityodayavelāyāṃ yāstokāpi tithirbhavet /
pūrvaviddhā tu mantavyā prabhūtā nodayaṃ vinā //
meaning:
आदित्योदयवेलायां यास्तोकापि तिथिर्भवेत् /
पूर्वविद्धा तु मन्तव्या प्रभूता नोदयं विना //
text_mt: Whatever lunar day exists at the time of sunrise, even if slight, / is to be considered as overlapping the previous; an extensive one [is not valid] without sunrise.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithistātkālikī smṛtā /
pitrye 'stamanavelāyāṃ sparśe pūrṇā nigadyate //
meaning:
पारणे मरणे नॄणां तिथिस्तात्कालिकी स्मृता /
पित्र्ये ऽस्तमनवेलायां स्पर्शे पूर्णा निगद्यते //
text_mt: At the breaking of a fast and at the death of men, the lunar day of the relevant time is declared [valid]; / in rites for ancestors, if there is contact at the time of sunset, it is said to be complete.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatrodayinī grāhyā daivasyodayikī tithiḥ /
pratyahaṃ śodhayetprājñastithiṃ daivajñacintakāt //
meaning:
न तत्रोदयिनी ग्राह्या दैवस्योदयिकी तिथिः /
प्रत्यहं शोधयेत्प्राज्ञस्तिथिं दैवज्ञचिन्तकात् //
text_mt: A sunrise-based [tithi] is not to be accepted there; the sunrise-based tithi belongs to the gods. / Everyday a wise man should ascertain the lunar day from an astrologer.

sanskrit_iast:
tithipramāṇaṃ viprendrāḥ kṣapākaradivākarau /
candrārkacāravijñānātkālaṃ kālavido viduḥ //
meaning:
तिथिप्रमाणं विप्रेन्द्राः क्षपाकरदिवाकरौ /
चन्द्रार्कचारविज्ञानात्कालं कालविदो विदुः //
text_mt: The measure of a lunar day, O chief brahmins, is the moon and the sun; / from knowledge of the course of the moon and sun, knowers of time understand time.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāyāḥ saṃgadoṣeṇa na yogyāstāḥ prapūjane /
varjayanti narāstajjñā yāmāṃśca caturo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वायाः संगदोषेण न योग्यास्ताः प्रपूजने /
वर्जयन्ति नरास्तज्ज्ञा यामांश्च चतुरो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Due to the flaw of contact with the preceding, they are unfit for worship; / men who know that, O twice-born, avoid the four watches.

sanskrit_iast:
ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi snānapūjāvidhikramam /
na divā śuddhimāpnoti tadā rātrau vidhīyate //
meaning:
अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि स्नानपूजाविधिक्रमम् /
न दिवा शुद्धिमाप्नोति तदा रात्रौ विधीयते //
text_mt: Hereafter I shall explain the order of rules for bathing and worship: / If one does not attain purity by day, then it is prescribed at night.

sanskrit_iast:
dinakāryamaśeṣaṃ hi kartavyaṃ śarvarīmukhe /
vidhireṣa mayā khyāto narāṇāmupavāsinām //
meaning:
दिनकार्यमशेषं हि कर्तव्यं शर्वरीमुखे /
विधिरेष मया ख्यातो नराणामुपवासिनाम् //
text_mt: All daytime rites must be performed at the beginning of the night; / this rule has been proclaimed by me for fasting men.

sanskrit_iast:
alpāyāmatha viprendrā dvādaśyāmaruṇodaye /
snānārcanakriyā kāryyā dānahomādisaṃyutā //
meaning:
अल्पायामथ विप्रेन्द्रा द्वादश्यामरुणोदये /
स्नानार्चनक्रिया कार्य्या दानहोमादिसंयुता //
text_mt: When the twelfth lunar day is short, O foremost brāhmaṇas, at dawn / the rites of bathing and worship, along with gifts, fire oblations, and other [acts], are to be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ pāraṇe pṛthivīphalam /
śatayajñādhikaṃ vāpi naraḥ prāpnotyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां पारणे पृथिवीफलम् /
शतयज्ञाधिकं वापि नरः प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: Breaking the fast on the thirteenth lunar day, a man obtains the fruit of the earth, / or more than a hundred sacrifices; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ pratyūṣe snānamācaret /
pitṛtarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ na dṛṣṭvā dvādaśīdinam //
meaning:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्राः प्रत्यूषे स्नानमाचरेत् /
पितृतर्पणसंयुक्तं न दृष्ट्वा द्वादशीदिनम् //
text_mt: For this reason, O brāhmaṇas, one should perform bathing at daybreak / accompanied by ancestral libations, without waiting to see the day of the twelfth.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāhānikarā hyeṣā dvādaśī laṅghitā nṛbhiḥ /
karoti dharmaharaṇamasnāteva sarasvatī //
meaning:
महाहानिकरा ह्येषा द्वादशी लङ्घिता नृभिः /
करोति धर्महरणमस्नातेव सरस्वती //
text_mt: For when neglected by men, this twelfth [lunar day] causes great loss; / like the Sarasvatī without bathing, it takes away all religious merit.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaye vāpyathavā vṛddhau saṃprāpte vā dinodaye /
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pūrvaviddhāṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
क्षये वाप्यथवा वृद्धौ संप्राप्ते वा दिनोदये /
उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या पूर्वविद्धां विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Whether in decrease, increase, or upon reaching the rise of the day, / the holy twelfth is to be observed as a fast; one must avoid [an eleventh] pierced by the preceding.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇa uvāca
yadā ca prāpyate sūta dvādaśyāṃ pūrvasaṃbhavā /
tadopavāso hi kathaṃ kartavyo mānavairvada //
meaning:
ब्राह्मण उवाच
यदा च प्राप्यते सूत द्वादश्यां पूर्वसंभवा /
तदोपवासो हि कथं कर्तव्यो मानवैर्वद //
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa said: / When, O Sūta, [the fast] falls upon the twelfth because the preceding [tithi] is present, / tell [us], how should the fast then be observed by men?

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsadinaṃ viddhaṃ yadā bhavati pūrvayā /
dvitīye 'hni yadā na syātsvalpāpyekādaśī tithiḥ //
meaning:
उपवासदिनं विद्धं यदा भवति पूर्वया /
द्वितीये ऽह्नि यदा न स्यात्स्वल्पाप्येकादशी तिथिः //
text_mt: When the day of fasting is pierced by the preceding [tithi], / and on the second day there is not even a very short eleventh lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
tatropavāso vihitaḥ kathaṃ tadvada sūtaja /
sautiruvāca
yadā na prāpyate viprā dvādaśyāṃ pūrvasambhavam //
meaning:
तत्रोपवासो विहितः कथं तद्वद सूतज /
सौतिरुवाच
यदा न प्राप्यते विप्रा द्वादश्यां पूर्वसम्भवम् //
text_mt: How is the fast prescribed there? Tell that, O son of Sūta. / Sauti said: / When, O brāhmaṇas, [an eleventh] without overlap from the preceding is not found on the twelfth,

sanskrit_iast:
ravicandrārkajāhaṃ tu tadopoṣyaṃ paraṃ dinam /
bahvā gamavirodheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu vivādiṣu //
meaning:
रविचन्द्रार्कजाहं तु तदोपोष्यं परं दिनम् /
बह्वा गमविरोधेषु ब्राह्मणेषु विवादिषु //
text_mt: On the day of the Sun, the Moon, or the son of the Sun (Saturn), the following day is then to be observed as a fast. / When many scriptures conflict, and the brāhmaṇas are in dispute,

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam /
ekādaśyāṃ tu viddhāyāṃ saṃprāpte śravaṇe tathā //
meaning:
उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणम् /
एकादश्यां तु विद्धायां संप्राप्ते श्रवणे तथा //
text_mt: The holy twelfth is to be observed as a fast, and the breaking of the fast on the thirteenth. / So too, when the eleventh is pierced and Śravaṇa has arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pakṣayorubhayorapi /
eṣa vo nirṇayaḥ prokto mayā śāstravinirṇayāt //
meaning:
उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या पक्षयोरुभयोरपि /
एष वो निर्णयः प्रोक्तो मया शास्त्रविनिर्णयात् //
text_mt: The holy twelfth is to be observed as a fast in both fortnights. / This decision has been declared to you by me in accordance with the decision of the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
kimanyacchrotukāmā hi tadbhavanto bruvantu me /
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
yugādīnāṃ vadavidhiṃ saute samyagyathātatham //
meaning:
किमन्यच्छ्रोतुकामा हि तद्भवन्तो ब्रुवन्तु मे /
ऋषय ऊचुः
युगादीनां वदविधिं सौते सम्यग्यथातथम् //
text_mt: What else do you desire to hear? Let you tell me that. / The sages said: / Declare the rules concerning the beginnings of yugas accurately as they are, O Sauti,

sanskrit_iast:
ravisaṃkrātikādīnāṃ nāvedyaṃ vidyate tava /
sautiruvāca
dve śukle dve tathā kṛṣṇe yugādyāḥ kavayo viduḥ //
meaning:
रविसंक्रातिकादीनां नावेद्यं विद्यते तव /
सौतिरुवाच
द्वे शुक्ले द्वे तथा कृष्णे युगाद्याः कवयो विदुः //
text_mt: As well as the solstices, transits of the sun, and the like; there is nothing unknown to you. / Sauti said: / Two in the bright [fortnight] and two in the dark: the wise know these as the beginnings of yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
śukle pūrvāhṇike grāhye kṛṣṇe grāhye 'parāhṇike /
ayanaṃ dinabhāgāḍhyaṃ saṃkramaḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ palaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्ले पूर्वाह्णिके ग्राह्ये कृष्णे ग्राह्ये ऽपराह्णिके /
अयनं दिनभागाढ्यं संक्रमः षोडशः पलः //
text_mt: In the bright, [the yugādi] is to be taken in the forenoon; in the dark, it is to be taken in the afternoon. / A solstice consists of parts of a day; a solar transit is sixteen palas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve tu dakṣiṇe bhāge vyatīte cottaro mataḥ /
madhyakāle tu viṣuve tvakṣayā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
पूर्वे तु दक्षिणे भागे व्यतीते चोत्तरो मतः /
मध्यकाले तु विषुवे त्वक्षया परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: In the southern [solstice], the prior portion is considered, and in the northern, the subsequent; / but at the middle time of the equinox, it is proclaimed to be imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā viprāstithiṃ samyaksāṃvatsarasamīritām /
kartavyo hyupavāsastu anyathā narakaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा विप्रास्तिथिं सम्यक्सांवत्सरसमीरिताम् /
कर्तव्यो ह्युपवासस्तु अन्यथा नरकं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Having accurately ascertained the lunar day declared by the astrologer, O brāhmaṇas, / the fast is indeed to be performed; otherwise one goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaviddhāṃ prakurvāṇo naro dharmaṃ nikṛntati /
saṃtatestu vināśāya saṃpadāṃ haraṇāya ca //
meaning:
पूर्वविद्धां प्रकुर्वाणो नरो धर्मं निकृन्तति /
संततेस्तु विनाशाय संपदां हरणाय च //
text_mt: A man who performs [the fast on a tithi] pierced by the preceding cuts away his dharma, / leading to the destruction of his lineage and the loss of his wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
palavedhe 'pi viprendrā daśamyā varjayecchivām /
surāyā bindunā spṛṣṭa yathā gaṅgājalantyajet //
meaning:
पलवेधे ऽपि विप्रेन्द्रा दशम्या वर्जयेच्छिवाम् /
सुराया बिन्दुना स्पृष्ट यथा गङ्गाजलन्त्यजेत् //
text_mt: Even with a piercing of a single pala by the tenth, O foremost brāhmaṇas, one should avoid the auspicious [eleventh], / just as one would abandon Gaṅgā water touched by a drop of liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
śvahataṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca daśamyā dūṣitāṃ tyajet /
ekādaśīṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
श्वहतं पञ्चगव्यं च दशम्या दूषितां त्यजेत् /
एकादशीं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पक्षयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: Just as one would abandon the five products of the cow defiled by a dog, so should one abandon the eleventh defiled by the tenth, / O best of twice-born, in both fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaviddhā purā dattā sā tithiryadumaulinā /
dānavebhyo dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prīṇanārthaṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
पूर्वविद्धा पुरा दत्ता सा तिथिर्यदुमौलिना /
दानवेभ्यो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रीणनार्थं महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Long ago, that lunar day pierced by the preceding was given by the crown of the Yadus (Kṛṣṇa) / to the Dānavas, O best of twice-born, to propitiate those great beings.

sanskrit_iast:
akāle yaddhanaṃ dattamapātrebhyo dvijottamāḥ /
saṃkrudvairapi yaddattaṃ yaddattaṃ cāpyasatkṛtam //
meaning:
अकाले यद्धनं दत्तमपात्रेभ्यो द्विजोत्तमाः /
संक्रुद्वैरपि यद्दत्तं यद्दत्तं चाप्यसत्कृतम् //
text_mt: Wealth given at an improper time, given to unworthy recipients, O best of twice-born, / or given in anger, or given without respect,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaviddhatithau dattaṃ taddattamasureṣvatha /
yaducchiṣṭena dattaṃ tu yaddattaṃ patiteṣvapi //
meaning:
पूर्वविद्धतिथौ दत्तं तद्दत्तमसुरेष्वथ /
यदुच्छिष्टेन दत्तं तु यद्दत्तं पतितेष्वपि //
text_mt: Or given on a lunar day pierced by the preceding, that is indeed given to the Asuras. / What is given in an impure state, or what is given to the fallen,

sanskrit_iast:
strījeteṣu ca yaddattaṃ yaddattaṃ jalavarjitam /
punaḥ kīrtanasaṃyuktaṃ taddattamasureṣu vai //
meaning:
स्त्रीजेतेषु च यद्दत्तं यद्दत्तं जलवर्जितम् /
पुनः कीर्तनसंयुक्तं तद्दत्तमसुरेषु वै //
text_mt: And what is given to those conquered by women, or what is given without water, / or accompanied by boasting afterwards, that is indeed given to the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviprā na kartvyā viddhāpyekādaśī tithiḥ /
yathā hantipurā puṇyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca vṛṣalīpatiḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्विप्रा न कर्त्व्या विद्धाप्येकादशी तिथिः /
यथा हन्तिपुरा पुण्यं श्राद्धं च वृषलीपतिः //
text_mt: Therefore, O brāhmaṇas, an eleventh lunar day that is pierced must not be observed, / just as a husband of a Śūdra woman formerly destroys the merit of a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ tathā pūjā kṛtā hareḥ /
tithau viddhe kṣayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā //
meaning:
दत्तं जप्तं हुतं स्नातं तथा पूजा कृता हरेः /
तिथौ विद्धे क्षयं याति तमः सूर्योदये यथा //
text_mt: What is given, recited, offered into fire, or bathed, and likewise worship paid to Hari, / on a pierced lunar day goes to ruin, just as darkness at sunrise.

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇaṃ patiṃ yauvanagarvitā yathā tyajanti nāryo jhaṣaketunārditāḥ /
tathā hi vedhaṃ vibudhāstyajanti tithyantaraṃ dharmavivṛddhaye sadā //
śrībṛhannāradīyapuraṇottarabhāge tithivicāro nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
जीर्णं पतिं यौवनगर्विता यथा त्यजन्ति नार्यो झषकेतुनार्दिताः /
तथा हि वेधं विबुधास्त्यजन्ति तिथ्यन्तरं धर्मविवृद्धये सदा //
श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुरणोत्तरभागे तिथिविचारो नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Just as women proud of their youth, afflicted by the fish-bannered [god of love], abandon an aged husband, / so the wise always abandon an overlap for another lunar day to increase their dharma.

In the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, the second chapter, entitled "Deliberation on Lunar Days".

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vistareṇa samākhyā hi viṣṇorārādhanakriyām /
yayā toṣaṃ samāyāti pradadāti samīhitam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
विस्तरेण समाख्या हि विष्णोराराधनक्रियाम् /
यया तोषं समायाति प्रददाति समीहितम् //
title: athatṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / Declare in full the rite of worshipping Viṣṇu, / by which he attains satisfaction and grants what is desired.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmībhartājagannāthohyaśeṣāghaughanāśanaḥ /
karmaṇā kena sa prīto bhavedyaḥ sacarācaraḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीभर्ताजगन्नाथोह्यशेषाघौघनाशनः /
कर्मणा केन स प्रीतो भवेद्यः सचराचरः //
text_mt: The Lord of Lakṣmī, the Lord of the world, who destroys the entire mass of sins— / by what deed is he pleased, he who contains the moving and the unmoving?

sanskrit_iast:
sautiruvāca
bhaktigrāhyo hṛṣīkeśo na dhanairddharaṇīdhara /
bhaktyā saṃpūjito viṣṇuḥ pradadāti manoratham //
meaning:
सौतिरुवाच
भक्तिग्राह्यो हृषीकेशो न धनैर्द्धरणीधर /
भक्त्या संपूजितो विष्णुः प्रददाति मनोरथम् //
text_mt: Sauti said: / Hṛṣīkeśa is won through devotion, not by wealth, O support of the earth; / Viṣṇu, worshipped with devotion, grants one's desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviprāḥ sadā bhaktiḥ karttavyā cakrapāṇinaḥ /
janenāpi jagannāthaḥ pūjitaḥ kleśahā bhavet //
meaning:
तस्माद्विप्राः सदा भक्तिः कर्त्तव्या चक्रपाणिनः /
जनेनापि जगन्नाथः पूजितः क्लेशहा भवेत् //
text_mt: Therefore, O brāhmaṇas, devotion to the wielder of the discus should always be cultivated; / even worshipped by an ordinary man, the Lord of the world removes distress.

sanskrit_iast:
paritoṣaṃ vrajatyāśutṛṣitastu jalairyathā /
atrāpi śrūyate viprā ākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
परितोषं व्रजत्याशुतृषितस्तु जलैर्यथा /
अत्रापि श्रूयते विप्रा आख्यानं पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: He goes quickly to contentment, just as a thirsty man with water. / On this point too, O brāhmaṇas, a sin-destroying ancient tale is heard,

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgadasya saṃvādamṛṣiṇā gautamena hi /
āsīdgrukmāṅgado rājā sārvabhaumaḥ kṣamānvitaḥ //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गदस्य संवादमृषिणा गौतमेन हि /
आसीद्ग्रुक्माङ्गदो राजा सार्वभौमः क्षमान्वितः //
text_mt: Namely, the dialogue of Rukmāṅgada with the sage Gautama. / There was a king named Rukmāṅgada, a sovereign emperor endowed with forgiveness,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraśāyipriyo bhakto harivāsaratatparaḥ /
nānyaṃ paśyati deveśātpadmanābhānmahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरशायिप्रियो भक्तो हरिवासरतत्परः /
नान्यं पश्यति देवेशात्पद्मनाभान्महीपतिः //
text_mt: Dear to the one who sleeps on the milk-ocean, devoted, intent upon the day of Hari; / the ruler of the earth saw none other than the lotus-navelled Lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭahaṃ vāraṇe dhṛtvā vādayeddhari vāsare /
aṣṭavarṣādhiko yastu pañcāśītyūnavarṣakaḥ //
meaning:
पटहं वारणे धृत्वा वादयेद्धरि वासरे /
अष्टवर्षाधिको यस्तु पञ्चाशीत्यूनवर्षकः //
text_mt: Placing a drum upon an elephant, he had it sounded on the day of Hari: / 'Whoever is older than eight years and younger than eighty-five,

sanskrit_iast:
bhunakti mānavo hyadya viṣṇorahani mandadhīḥ /
sa me daṇḍyaścaga vadhyaśca nirvāsyo nagarādbahiḥ //
meaning:
भुनक्ति मानवो ह्यद्य विष्णोरहनि मन्दधीः /
स मे दण्ड्यश्चग वध्यश्च निर्वास्यो नगराद्बहिः //
text_mt: If that human, foolish of mind, eats food today on the day of Viṣṇu, / he shall be punished by me, killed, and banished outside the city.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā ca yadi vā bhrātā putro bhāryā suhṛnmama /
padmanābhadine bhoktā nigrāhyo dasyuvadbhavet //
meaning:
पिता च यदि वा भ्राता पुत्रो भार्या सुहृन्मम /
पद्मनाभदिने भोक्ता निग्राह्यो दस्युवद्भवेत् //
text_mt: Be he my father, or brother, son, wife, or friend, / one who eats on the day of the lotus-navelled [Lord] shall be seized like a bandit.

sanskrit_iast:
dadaghvaṃma vipramukhyabhyo majjadhvaṃ jāhnavījale /
mameda vacanaṃ śṛtvā rājyaṃ bhuñjīta māmakam //
meaning:
ददघ्वंम विप्रमुख्यभ्यो मज्जध्वं जाह्नवीजले /
ममेद वचनं शृत्वा राज्यं भुञ्जीत मामकम् //
text_mt: Give to the foremost brāhmaṇas, bathe in the waters of the Jāhnavī; / having heard this word of mine, let one enjoy my kingdom.'

sanskrit_iast:
vāsare vāsare viṣṇoḥ śuklapakṣe mahīpatiḥ /
aśukle tu viśeṣeṇa paṭahe hemasaṃpuṭe //
meaning:
वासरे वासरे विष्णोः शुक्लपक्षे महीपतिः /
अशुक्ले तु विशेषेण पटहे हेमसंपुटे //
text_mt: On each day of Viṣṇu in the bright fortnight, the ruler of the earth, / and especially in the non-bright (dark), with a drum in a golden case [proclaimed this].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ praghuṣṭe bhūpena sarvabhūmau dvijottamāḥ /
gacchidbhiḥ saṃkulo mārgaḥ kṛto kṛto lokairharerdvijāḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रघुष्टे भूपेन सर्वभूमौ द्विजोत्तमाः /
गच्छिद्भिः संकुलो मार्गः कृतो कृतो लोकैर्हरेर्द्विजाः //
text_mt: When it was thus proclaimed by the king throughout the entire earth, O best of twice-born, / the path of Hari was crowded with people going there, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ye kecinnidhanaṃ yānti bhūpālaviṣaye narāḥ /
jñānātpramādato vāpi te yānti harimandiram //
meaning:
ये केचिन्निधनं यान्ति भूपालविषये नराः /
ज्ञानात्प्रमादतो वापि ते यान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Whatever men met death in the territory of that king, / whether through knowledge or through negligence, they went to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ vaiṣṇavo lokaḥ prāpyate mānavairdvijāḥ /
vyājenāpi prakurvāṇairdvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm //
meaning:
अवश्यं वैष्णवो लोकः प्राप्यते मानवैर्द्विजाः /
व्याजेनापि प्रकुर्वाणैर्द्वादशीं पापनाशिनीम् //
text_mt: The world of Viṣṇu is inevitably attained by men, O twice-born, / who observe the sin-destroying twelfth, even under a pretext.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'śnāti pārthivaṃ pāpaṃ yo 'śnāti harivāsare /
sa prāpnoti dharādharmaṃ yo nāśnāti harerdine //
meaning:
सो ऽश्नाति पार्थिवं पापं यो ऽश्नाति हरिवासरे /
स प्राप्नोति धराधर्मं यो नाश्नाति हरेर्दिने //
text_mt: He eats earthly sin who eats on the day of Hari; / he attains the righteousness of the earth who does not eat on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo naiva hantavya ityeṣā vaidikī smṛtiḥ /
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो नैव हन्तव्य इत्येषा वैदिकी स्मृतिः /
एकादश्यां न भोक्तव्यं पक्षयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: 'A brāhmaṇa must never be killed'—this is the Vedic tradition; / [likewise] one must not eat on the eleventh in both fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
vailakṣyamagamadrājā ravisūnurdvijottamāḥ /
lekhyakarmaṇi viśrāntaścitragupto 'bhavattadā //
meaning:
वैलक्ष्यमगमद्राजा रविसूनुर्द्विजोत्तमाः /
लेख्यकर्मणि विश्रान्तश्चित्रगुप्तो ऽभवत्तदा //
text_mt: The king who is the son of the Sun (Yama) fell into despondency, O best of twice-born, / and Citragupta then rested from the work of writing.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmārjitāni lekhyāni pūrvakarmodbhavāni ca /
gacchanti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ svadharmairmānavāḥ kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
संमार्जितानि लेख्यानि पूर्वकर्मोद्भवानि च /
गच्छन्ति वैष्णवं लोकं स्वधर्मैर्मानवाः क्षणात् //
text_mt: The records arising from previous actions were wiped clean; / by their own duties, human beings went in an instant to the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyā stu nirayāḥ sarve pāpaprāṇivivarjitāḥ /
bhagno yāmyo 'bhavanmārgo dvādaśādityatāpitaḥ //
meaning:
शून्या स्तु निरयाः सर्वे पापप्राणिविवर्जिताः /
भग्नो याम्यो ऽभवन्मार्गो द्वादशादित्यतापितः //
text_mt: All the hells became empty, deserted by sinful creatures; / the path to the realm of Yama became broken, scorched by the twelve suns.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve hi garuḍārūḍhā janā yānti hareḥ padam /
devā nāmapi ye lokāste śūnyā hyabhavaṃstathā //
meaning:
सर्वे हि गरुडारूढा जना यान्ति हरेः पदम् /
देवा नामपि ये लोकास्ते शून्या ह्यभवंस्तथा //
text_mt: Mounted upon Garuḍa, all people go to Hari's abode; / and the worlds of the gods became empty in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
utsannāḥ pitṛdevejyāstīrthadānādisatkriyāḥ /
muktvaikāṃ dvādaśīṃ martyā nānyaṃ jānanti te vratam //
meaning:
उत्सन्नाः पितृदेवेज्यास्तीर्थदानादिसत्क्रियाः /
मुक्त्वैकां द्वादशीं मर्त्या नान्यं जानन्ति ते व्रतम् //
text_mt: Sacrifices to ancestors and gods, and good works such as gifts at sacred fords, were abandoned; / mortals know no other vow except the single dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnye triviṣṭape jāte śūnye ca narake tathā /
nārado dharmarājānaṃ gatvā cedamuvāca ha //
meaning:
शून्ये त्रिविष्टपे जाते शून्ये च नरके तथा /
नारदो धर्मराजानं गत्वा चेदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: When heaven had become empty, and hell had likewise become empty, / Nārada went to the king of righteousness and said this:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
nākrandaḥ śrūyate rājan prāṅgaṇe narakeṣvatha /
na cāpi kriyate lekhyaṃ kiñcidduṣkṛtakarmaṇām //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
नाक्रन्दः श्रूयते राजन् प्राङ्गणे नरकेष्वथ /
न चापि क्रियते लेख्यं किञ्चिद्दुष्कृतकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: Nārada said: / "No lamentation is heard, O king, in your courtyard or in the hells; / nor is any writing done of the deeds of evil-doers.

sanskrit_iast:
citragupto muniriva sthito 'yaṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ /
kāraṇaṃ kiṃ na cāyānti pāpino yena te gṛham //
meaning:
चित्रगुप्तो मुनिरिव स्थितो ऽयं मौनसंयुतः /
कारणं किं न चायान्ति पापिनो येन ते गृहम् //
text_mt: This Citragupta stands silent like a sage. / What is the reason that sinners do not come to your house,

sanskrit_iast:
māyādaṃbhasamākrāntā duṣṭakarmaratāstathā /
evamukte tu vacane nāradena mahātmanā //
meaning:
मायादंभसमाक्रान्ता दुष्टकर्मरतास्तथा /
एवमुक्ते तु वचने नारदेन महात्मना //
text_mt: those overcome by deceit and hypocrisy, and devoted to wicked deeds?" / When these words had been spoken by the high-souled Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
prāha vaivasvato rājā kiñciddainyasamanvitaḥ /
yama uvāca
yo 'yaṃ nārada bhūpālaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sāṃprataṃ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
प्राह वैवस्वतो राजा किञ्चिद्दैन्यसमन्वितः /
यम उवाच
यो ऽयं नारद भूपालः पृथिव्यां सांप्रतं स्थितः //
text_mt: King Vaivasvata spoke, filled with a certain dejection. / Yama said: / "That king who presently lives on earth, O Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi bhakto hṛṣīkeśe purāṇapuruṣottame /
prabodhayati rājendraḥ sa janaṃ paṭahena hi //
meaning:
स हि भक्तो हृषीकेशे पुराणपुरुषोत्तमे /
प्रबोधयति राजेन्द्रः स जनं पटहेन हि //
text_mt: he is a devotee of Hṛṣīkeśa, the ancient supreme person; / that lord of kings awakens people with the drum:

sanskrit_iast:
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare /
ye kecidbhuñjate martyāste me daṇḍeṣu yānti hi //
meaning:
न भोक्तव्यं न भोक्तव्यं संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे /
ये केचिद्भुञ्जते मर्त्यास्ते मे दण्डेषु यान्ति हि //
text_mt: 'One must not eat, one must not eat when Hari's day has arrived! / Whatever mortals eat, they will go under my punishments.'

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhayāddhi janāḥ sarve dvādaśīṃ samupāsate /
vyājenāpi munuśreṣṭha dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitāḥ //
meaning:
तद्भयाद्धि जनाः सर्वे द्वादशीं समुपासते /
व्याजेनापि मुनुश्रेष्ठ द्वादश्यां समुपोषिताः //
text_mt: Out of fear of that, all people observe the dvādaśī; / having fasted on the dvādaśī even under a pretext, O best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam /
dvādaśīsevanāllokāḥ prāyānti harimandiram //
meaning:
प्रयान्ति वैष्णवं लोकं दाहप्रलयवर्जितम् /
द्वादशीसेवनाल्लोकाः प्रायान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: they go to the Vaiṣṇava realm, free from burning and dissolution. / Through devotion to the dvādaśī, people go to Hari's temple.

sanskrit_iast:
tena rājñā dvijaśreṣṭha mārgā luptā mamādhunā /
kṛta hi narakāḥ śūnyā lokāścāpi divaukasām //
meaning:
तेन राज्ञा द्विजश्रेष्ठ मार्गा लुप्ता ममाधुना /
कृत हि नरकाः शून्या लोकाश्चापि दिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: By that king, O best of twice-born, my paths have now been destroyed; / the hells have been made empty, and so too the realms of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntaṃ lekhakerlekhyaṃ likhitaṃ mārjitaṃ janaiḥ /
ekādaśyupavāsasya māhātmyena dvijottama //
meaning:
विश्रान्तं लेखकेर्लेख्यं लिखितं मार्जितं जनैः /
एकादश्युपवासस्य माहात्म्येन द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: The writing has been rested by the scribes; what was written has been erased by the people, / through the greatness of fasting on the ekādaśī, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyādipāpāni abhuktvaiva janā dvija /
samupoṣya dinaṃ viṣṇoḥ prayānti harimandiram //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि अभुक्त्वैव जना द्विज /
समुपोष्य दिनं विष्णोः प्रयान्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Without even experiencing [the fruits of] sins such as killing a brahmin, O twice-born, / having fasted on the day of Viṣṇu, people go to Hari's temple.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ kāṣāṭamṛgeṇaiva tulyo jāto mahāmune /
netrahīnaḥ karṇahīnaḥ saṃdhyāhīno dvijo yathā //
meaning:
सो ऽहं काषाटमृगेणैव तुल्यो जातो महामुने /
नेत्रहीनः कर्णहीनः संध्याहीनो द्विजो यथा //
text_mt: Such as I am, I have become equal to a wooden deer, O great sage; / like a twice-born lacking eyes, lacking ears, and lacking twilight devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
strījito vā pumānyadvatṣaṇḍho vā pramadāpatiḥ /
tyaktakāmastvahaṃ brahmaṃllokapālatvamīdṛśam //
meaning:
स्त्रीजितो वा पुमान्यद्वत्षण्ढो वा प्रमदापतिः /
त्यक्तकामस्त्वहं ब्रह्मंल्लोकपालत्वमीदृशम् //
text_mt: or like a man conquered by a woman, or an impotent husband of a wife. / I have abandoned desire, O brahmin, for such guardianship of the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyāmi brahmaloke vai duḥkhaṃ jñāpayituṃ svakam /
nirvyāpāro niyogī tu niyoge yastu tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
यास्यामि ब्रह्मलोके वै दुःखं ज्ञापयितुं स्वकम् /
निर्व्यापारो नियोगी तु नियोगे यस्तु तिष्ठति //
text_mt: I shall go to the world of Brahmā to make known my sorrow. / An appointed official who stays in his post without duty,

sanskrit_iast:
svāmivittaṃ samaśnāti sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam /
sautiruvāca
evamuktvā yamo viprā nāradena samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
स्वामिवित्तं समश्नाति स याति नरकं ध्रुवम् /
सौतिरुवाच
एवमुक्त्वा यमो विप्रा नारदेन समन्वितः //
text_mt: yet consumes his master's wealth, surely goes to hell." / Sauti said: / Having spoken thus, O brahmins, Yama, accompanied by Nārada

sanskrit_iast:
yayau virañcisadanaṃ citracisadanaṃ citraguptena cānvitaḥ /
sa dadarśa samāsīnaṃ mūrtāmūratajanāvṛtam //
meaning:
ययौ विरञ्चिसदनं चित्रचिसदनं चित्रगुप्तेन चान्वितः /
स ददर्श समासीनं मूर्तामूरतजनावृतम् //
text_mt: and accompanied by Citragupta, went to the abode of Brahmā. / He saw [Brahmā] seated, surrounded by manifest and unmanifest beings,

sanskrit_iast:
vedāśrayaṃ jagadbījaṃ sarveṣāṃ prapitāmaham /
svabhavaṃ bhūtanilayamoṅkārākhyamakalmaṣam //
meaning:
वेदाश्रयं जगद्बीजं सर्वेषां प्रपितामहम् /
स्वभवं भूतनिलयमोङ्काराख्यमकल्मषम् //
text_mt: the refuge of the Vedas, the seed of the universe, the great-grandfather of all, / self-existent, the dwelling of all beings, named the syllable Om, stainless,

sanskrit_iast:
śuciṃ śucipadaṃ haṃsaṃ brahmāṇaṃ darbhalāñchanam /
upāsyamānaṃ vividhairlokapālairdigīśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
शुचिं शुचिपदं हंसं ब्रह्माणं दर्भलाञ्छनम् /
उपास्यमानं विविधैर्लोकपालैर्दिगीश्वरैः //
text_mt: pure, of pure abode, the swan, Brahmā marked with darbha grass, / being worshiped by various world-guardians and lords of the quarters,

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇaiśca vedaurvegrahasaṃsthitaiḥ /
mūrtimadbhiḥ samudraiśya nadībhiśca sarovaraiḥ //
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणैश्च वेदौर्वेग्रहसंस्थितैः /
मूर्तिमद्भिः समुद्रैश्य नदीभिश्च सरोवरैः //
text_mt: and by the Itihāsas, Purāṇas, and Vedas standing embodied in the firmament, / and by embodied oceans, rivers, and lakes.

sanskrit_iast:
dehadhṛgbhistathā vṛkṣairaśvatthādyairviśeṣataḥ /
vāpīkūpataḍāgādyairmūrtimadbhiśca parvataiḥ //
meaning:
देहधृग्भिस्तथा वृक्षैरश्वत्थाद्यैर्विशेषतः /
वापीकूपतडागाद्यैर्मूर्तिमद्भिश्च पर्वतैः //
text_mt: with trees bearing bodies, especially the aśvattha and others, / with step-wells, wells, ponds, and personified mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātraistathā pakṣairmāsaiḥ saṃvatsarairdvijāḥ /
kalākāṣṭhānimeṣaiśca ṛtubhiścāyanairyugaiḥ //
meaning:
अहोरात्रैस्तथा पक्षैर्मासैः संवत्सरैर्द्विजाः /
कलाकाष्ठानिमेषैश्च ऋतुभिश्चायनैर्युगैः //
text_mt: with day-and-nights, fortnights, months, and years, O twice-born ones, / with kalās, kāṣṭhās, winks of the eye, seasons, solstices, and yugas,

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaraistathā kalpairnimeṣairunmiṣairapi /
ṛkṣairyogaiśca karaṇaiḥ paurṇamāseṃdusaṃkṣayaiḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरैस्तथा कल्पैर्निमेषैरुन्मिषैरपि /
ऋक्षैर्योगैश्च करणैः पौर्णमासेंदुसंक्षयैः //
text_mt: with manvantaras, kalpas, winkings, and open-eyed moments, / with constellations, yogas, karaṇas, full moons, and new moons,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhairduḥkhaistathā dvandvairlābhālābhairjayājayaiḥ /
satyānṛtaiśca deveśo veṣṭito dharmapāvakaḥ //
meaning:
सुखैर्दुःखैस्तथा द्वन्द्वैर्लाभालाभैर्जयाजयैः /
सत्यानृतैश्च देवेशो वेष्टितो धर्मपावकः //
text_mt: with pleasures and pains, dualities, gains and losses, victories and defeats, / and with truths and untruths was the lord of gods, the fire of righteousness, surrounded.

sanskrit_iast:
karmavidbhiśca puruṣairanupairupāsyate /
sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā ca pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
कर्मविद्भिश्च पुरुषैरनुपैरुपास्यते /
सत्त्वेन रजसा चैव तमसा च पितामहः //
text_mt: The Grandfather was served by men knowledgeable in action, without peers, / and by goodness, passion, and darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
śāntamūḍhātighoraiśca vikāraiḥ prākṛtairvibhuḥ /
vāyunā śleṣmapittābhyāṃ mūrtairātaṅkanāmabhiḥ //
meaning:
शान्तमूढातिघोरैश्च विकारैः प्राकृतैर्विभुः /
वायुना श्लेष्मपित्ताभ्यां मूर्तैरातङ्कनामभिः //
text_mt: and by peaceful, bewildered, and exceedingly dreadful modifications of nature, the omnipresent lord; / by wind, phlegm, and bile in embodied forms, named as afflictions,

sanskrit_iast:
ānandena ca viśvātmā paradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ /
anuktairapi bhūtaiśca saṃvṛto lokakṛtsvayam //
meaning:
आनन्देन च विश्वात्मा परधर्मं समाश्रितः /
अनुक्तैरपि भूतैश्च संवृतो लोककृत्स्वयम् //
text_mt: and with bliss, the Soul of All, resting in the supreme state; / surrounded by elements, even those not mentioned, the Creator of the Worlds himself.

sanskrit_iast:
duruktaiḥ kaṭuvākyādyairmūrtimadbhirupāsyate /
teṣāṃ madhye 'viśatsauriḥ savrīḍeva vadhūryathā //
meaning:
दुरुक्तैः कटुवाक्याद्यैर्मूर्तिमद्भिरुपास्यते /
तेषां मध्ये ऽविशत्सौरिः सव्रीडेव वधूर्यथा //
text_mt: He was served by harsh words, bitter speech, and the like in embodied forms. / In their midst entered the son of the Sun, like a bashful bride,

sanskrit_iast:
vilokayannadhobhāgaṃ namravaktro vyadarśayat /
te praviṣṭaṃ yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakāyasthaṃ sanāradam //
meaning:
विलोकयन्नधोभागं नम्रवक्त्रो व्यदर्शयत् /
ते प्रविष्टं यमं दृष्ट्वा सकायस्थं सनारदम् //
text_mt: looking downwards, showing a bowed face. / Seeing Yama who had entered, accompanied by his scribe and with Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
vismitākṣā mithaḥ procuḥ kimayaṃ bhāskaristviha /
saṃprāpto hi lokakaraṃ draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
विस्मिताक्षा मिथः प्रोचुः किमयं भास्करिस्त्विह /
संप्राप्तो हि लोककरं द्रष्टुं देवं पितामहम् //
text_mt: with eyes full of astonishment, they spoke to one another: “Why has this son of the Sun / arrived here to see the god, the Grandfather, maker of the worlds?

sanskrit_iast:
nirvyāpāraḥ kṣaṇaṃ nāsti yo 'yaṃ vyagro raveḥ sutaḥ /
so 'yamabhyāgataḥ kasmātkañcitkṣemaṃ divaukasām //
meaning:
निर्व्यापारः क्षणं नास्ति यो ऽयं व्यग्रो रवेः सुतः /
सो ऽयमभ्यागतः कस्मात्कञ्चित्क्षेमं दिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: He who is the son of the Sun is never idle for a moment, ever busy. / Why has he come? Is all well with the heaven-dwellers?

sanskrit_iast:
āścaryātiśayaṃ manye yanmārjitapaṭastvayam /
lekhakaḥ samanuprāpto dainyena mahatānvitaḥ //
meaning:
आश्चर्यातिशयं मन्ये यन्मार्जितपटस्त्वयम् /
लेखकः समनुप्राप्तो दैन्येन महतान्वितः //
text_mt: I deem it a great wonder that this scribe, / his scroll erased, has arrived, overwhelmed with great despondency.

sanskrit_iast:
na kenacitpaṭo hyasya mārjito 'bhūcca dharmiṇā /
yanna dṛṣṭaṃ śrunta vāpi tadihaiva pradṛśyate //
meaning:
न केनचित्पटो ह्यस्य मार्जितो ऽभूच्च धर्मिणा /
यन्न दृष्टं श्रुन्त वापि तदिहैव प्रदृश्यते //
text_mt: Indeed, his scroll was never erased by any righteous man! / What was never seen or even heard of is seen right here.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuccaratāṃ teṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ kṛtaśāsanaḥ /
nipapātāgrato viprā brahmaṇo ravinandanaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुच्चरतां तेषां भूतानां कृतशासनः /
निपपाताग्रतो विप्रा ब्रह्मणो रविनन्दनः //
text_mt: As those beings were saying this, the ruler who had fulfilled his command, / the son of the Sun, O brahmins, fell down before Brahmā

sanskrit_iast:
mūlacchinno yathā śākhī trāhi trāhīti saṃrudan /
paribhūto 'smi deveśa yanmārjitapaṭaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मूलच्छिन्नो यथा शाखी त्राहि त्राहीति संरुदन् /
परिभूतो ऽस्मि देवेश यन्मार्जितपटः कृतः //
text_mt: like a tree severed at its root, crying out, “Save me! Save me! / I have been humiliated, O Lord of gods, since my scroll has been wiped clean!

sanskrit_iast:
