tvayā nāthena vidhuraṃ paśyāmi kamalāsana /
evaṃ bruvansa niśceṣṭo babhūva dvijasaṃttamāḥ //
meaning:
त्वया नाथेन विधुरं पश्यामि कमलासन /
एवं ब्रुवन्स निश्चेष्टो बभूव द्विजसंत्तमाः //
text_mt: With you as my protector, O Lotus-seated one, I find myself helpless!” / Saying this, he became motionless, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato halahalāśabdaḥ sabhāyāṃ samavartata /
yor'thaṃ rodayate lokānsarvānsthāvaraja gamān //
meaning:
ततो हलहलाशब्दः सभायां समवर्तत /
योर्ऽथं रोदयते लोकान्सर्वान्स्थावरज गमान् //
text_mt: Then an uproar arose in the assembly: / “He who makes all the worlds of moving and unmoving beings weep,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'yaṃ roditi duḥkhārtaḥ kasmādvaivasvato yamaḥ /
athavā satyagātheyaṃ laukikī pratibhāti naḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽयं रोदिति दुःखार्तः कस्माद्वैवस्वतो यमः /
अथवा सत्यगाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति नः //
text_mt: why does this Yama, son of Vivasvat, weep, stricken with grief? / Or rather, this worldly saying seems true to us:

sanskrit_iast:
janasantāpakartā yaḥ so 'cireṇopatapyate /
nahi duṣkṛtakarmā hi naraḥ prāpnoti śobhanam //
meaning:
जनसन्तापकर्ता यः सो ऽचिरेणोपतप्यते /
नहि दुष्कृतकर्मा हि नरः प्राप्नोति शोभनम् //
text_mt: ‘He who causes torment to people is himself tormented before long; / for a man of wicked deeds never attains good fortune.’”

sanskrit_iast:
tato nivārayāmāsa vāyusteṣāṃ vacastadā /
lokānāṃ samacittānāṃ mataṃ jñātvā hi vedhasaḥ //
meaning:
ततो निवारयामास वायुस्तेषां वचस्तदा /
लोकानां समचित्तानां मतं ज्ञात्वा हि वेधसः //
text_mt: Then Vāyu silenced their words at that time, / knowing indeed the will of the Creator for the beings of even minds.

sanskrit_iast:
nivārya śaṅkāṃ mārtaṇḍiṃ śanairutthāpayan vibhuḥ /
bhujābhyāṃ sādhupīnābhyāṃ lokamūrtirudāradhīḥ //
meaning:
निवार्य शङ्कां मार्तण्डिं शनैरुत्थापयन् विभुः /
भुजाभ्यां साधुपीनाभ्यां लोकमूर्तिरुदारधीः //
text_mt: Dispelling the doubt, slowly raising the son of Mārtaṇḍa / with his well-rounded arms, the all-pervading lord of noble mind, whose form is the world,

sanskrit_iast:
vihvalaṃ taṃ palāyantamāsane saṃnyaveśayat /
sakāyasthamuvācedaṃ vyomamūrtiṃ raveḥ sutam //
meaning:
विह्वलं तं पलायन्तमासने संन्यवेशयत् /
सकायस्थमुवाचेदं व्योममूर्तिं रवेः सुतम् //
text_mt: seated that distraught, fleeing one upon a seat. / The one whose form is space said this to the son of the Sun, accompanied by his scribe:

sanskrit_iast:
kena tvamabhibhūto 'si kena sthānādvivāsitaḥ /
kenāpamārjito devapaṭo lokapaṭastava //
meaning:
केन त्वमभिभूतो ऽसि केन स्थानाद्विवासितः /
केनापमार्जितो देवपटो लोकपटस्तव //
text_mt: “By whom have you been overcome? By whom expelled from your post? / By whom has your divine register, the scroll of the world, been wiped clean?

sanskrit_iast:
brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa kuśaketurvadatvayam /
yaḥ prabhustāta sarveṣāṃ sa te kartā samunnatim /
apaneṣyati mārtaṇḍe duḥkhaṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
ब्रूहि सर्वमशेषेण कुशकेतुर्वदत्वयम् /
यः प्रभुस्तात सर्वेषां स ते कर्ता समुन्नतिम् /
अपनेष्यति मार्तण्डे दुःखं हृदयसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: Tell everything in full; let this Kuśaketu speak. / He who is the master of all, dear one, he will grant your elevation / and will remove the sorrow residing in your heart, O son of Mārtaṇḍa.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa evamuktastu prabhañjanena dineśasūnustamatho babhāṣe /
vilokya vaktraṃ kuśaketusūnoḥ sagadgadaṃ mandamudīrayanvacaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottare bhāge yamasya brahmalokagamanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स एवमुक्तस्तु प्रभञ्जनेन दिनेशसूनुस्तमथो बभाषे /
विलोक्य वक्त्रं कुशकेतुसूनोः सगद्गदं मन्दमुदीरयन्वचः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरे भागे यमस्य ब्रह्मलोकगमनं नाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus addressed by the Wind, the son of the Day-lord then spoke to him, / looking at the face of the son of Brahmā, uttering words slowly with faltering voice:

Thus ends the third chapter, named 'Yama’s Journey to the World of Brahmā', in the latter part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
śṛṇu me vacanaṃ nātha pitāmaha pitāmaha /
maraṇādadhikaṃ deva yatpratāpasya khaṇḍanam //
meaning:
यम उवाच
शृणु मे वचनं नाथ पितामह पितामह /
मरणादधिकं देव यत्प्रतापस्य खण्डनम् //
text_mt: Yama said: / “Hear my words, O lord, O Grandfather, O Grandfather! / Worse than death, O god, is the destruction of one's authority.

sanskrit_iast:
nispṛho nācaredyastu niyogaṃ padmasaṃbhava /
andhakūpe nipatati sa cāśu narake dhruvam //
meaning:
निस्पृहो नाचरेद्यस्तु नियोगं पद्मसंभव /
अन्धकूपे निपतति स चाशु नरके ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: He who, being indifferent, does not carry out his appointed duty, O Lotus-born one, / falls into a blind well and surely into hell swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
niyogī na niyogaṃ yaḥ karoti kamalāsana /
prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavetkāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ //
meaning:
नियोगी न नियोगं यः करोति कमलासन /
प्रभोर्वित्तं समश्नाति स भवेत्काष्ठकीटकः //
text_mt: An appointed servant who does not perform his duty, O Lotus-seated one, / and consumes his master's wealth, becomes a woodworm.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'śnāti lobhādvittāni prajābhyo vā mahīpateḥ /
niyogī narakaṃ yāti yāvatkalpaśatatrayam //
meaning:
यो ऽश्नाति लोभाद्वित्तानि प्रजाभ्यो वा महीपतेः /
नियोगी नरकं याति यावत्कल्पशतत्रयम् //
text_mt: An appointed official who greedily consumes the wealth of the king or of the subjects / goes to hell for three hundred kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmakāryaparo yastu svāminaṃ ca viluṃpati /
bhavedveśmani mandātmā ākhuḥ kalpaśatatrayam //
meaning:
आत्मकार्यपरो यस्तु स्वामिनं च विलुंपति /
भवेद्वेश्मनि मन्दात्मा आखुः कल्पशतत्रयम् //
text_mt: He who is devoted to his own ends and defrauds his master, / that dull-witted soul becomes a rat in the house for three hundred kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
niyogī yastu vai bhūtvā ātmaveśmani bhokṣyati /
bhṛtyānvai karmakaraṇe rājño mārjāratāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
नियोगी यस्तु वै भूत्वा आत्मवेश्मनि भोक्ष्यति /
भृत्यान्वै कर्मकरणे राज्ञो मार्जारतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: And he who, having become an official, eats the servants of the king / in his own house during the execution of work, becomes a cat.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ deva tavādeśāt prajā dharmeṇa śāsayan /
puṇyena puṇyakartāraṃ pāpaṃ pāpena karmaṇā //
meaning:
सो ऽहं देव तवादेशात् प्रजा धर्मेण शासयन् /
पुण्येन पुण्यकर्तारं पापं पापेन कर्मणा //
text_mt: Such as I was, O god, by your command ruling the subjects according to righteousness, / [treating] the doer of merit with merit, and the sinner according to sinful deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
samyagvicārya munibhirgharmaśāstrādibhirvibho /
kalpādau vartamānasya yāvadyāvaddinaṃ tava //
meaning:
सम्यग्विचार्य मुनिभिर्घर्मशास्त्रादिभिर्विभो /
कल्पादौ वर्तमानस्य यावद्यावद्दिनं तव //
text_mt: having deliberated well with the sages and the treatises on dharma, O all-pervading lord, / abiding [thus] from the beginning of the kalpa as long as your day lasts—

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ tvadīyena vibho niyogenaiva śaknuyām /
kartuṃ rukmāṅgadenādya parābhūto hi bhūbhujā //
meaning:
सो ऽहं त्वदीयेन विभो नियोगेनैव शक्नुयाम् /
कर्तुं रुक्माङ्गदेनाद्य पराभूतो हि भूभुजा //
text_mt: such as I am, O all-pervading lord, able only by your appointment / to act, I have been defeated today by King Rukmāṅgada!

sanskrit_iast:
bhayādyasya jagannātha pṛthivī sāgarāṃbarā /
na bhuṅkte vāsare viṣṇoḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśane //
meaning:
भयाद्यस्य जगन्नाथ पृथिवी सागरांबरा /
न भुङ्क्ते वासरे विष्णोः सर्वपापप्रणाशने //
text_mt: Out of fear of him, O Lord of the universe, the earth clothed in oceans / does not eat on the day of Viṣṇu that destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya sarvadharmāṃstu vihāya pitṛpūjanam /
vihāya devapūjāṃ ca tīrthasnānādikastriyām //
meaning:
विहाय सर्वधर्मांस्तु विहाय पितृपूजनम् /
विहाय देवपूजां च तीर्थस्नानादिकस्त्रियाम् //
text_mt: Abandoning all religious duties, abandoning the worship of the ancestors, / abandoning the worship of gods, and the acts such as bathing at sacred fords,

sanskrit_iast:
yogasāṃkhyāvubhau tyaktvā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ ca mānada /
tyaktvā svādhyāyahomāṃśca kṛtvā pāpāni bhūriśaḥ //
meaning:
योगसांख्यावुभौ त्यक्त्वा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च मानद /
त्यक्त्वा स्वाध्यायहोमांश्च कृत्वा पापानि भूरिशः //
text_mt: leaving behind both Yoga and Sāṃkhya, knowledge and what is to be known, O giver of honor, / leaving behind self-study and fire oblations, and having committed sins abundantly,

sanskrit_iast:
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamupoṣya harivāsaram /
manujāḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tathaiva ca pitāmahaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रयान्ति वैष्णवं लोकमुपोष्य हरिवासरम् /
मनुजाः पितृभिः सार्द्धं तथैव च पितामहैः //
text_mt: humans, by fasting on the day of Hari, go to the world of Viṣṇu / along with their fathers, and likewise with their grandfathers;

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmapīha pitaraḥ pitṝṇāṃ pitarastathā /
tathā mātāmahā yānti māturye janakādayaḥ //
meaning:
तेषामपीह पितरः पितॄणां पितरस्तथा /
तथा मातामहा यान्ति मातुर्ये जनकादयः //
text_mt: and even their fathers, and the fathers of their fathers, / and maternal grandfathers, the maternal relatives beginning with the mother's father,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmapi janetāro janitṝṇāṃ hi pūrvajāḥ /
etadduḥkhaṃ punardeva mama marmavibhedanam //
meaning:
तेषामपि जनेतारो जनितॄणां हि पूर्वजाः /
एतद्दुःखं पुनर्देव मम मर्मविभेदनम् //
text_mt: and also their progenitors, the forebears of those progenitors go. / Furthermore, O god, this sorrow pierces my vital parts:

sanskrit_iast:
priyāyāḥ pitaro yānti mārjayitvā lipiṃ mama /
pitṝṇāṃ bījato yasmāddhātryā kukṣau dhṛto yataḥ //
meaning:
प्रियायाः पितरो यान्ति मार्जयित्वा लिपिं मम /
पितॄणां बीजतो यस्माद्धात्र्या कुक्षौ धृतो यतः //
text_mt: the ancestors of one's beloved wife go, having wiped clean my writing! / Because of the seed of the fathers, and because one is borne in the womb of the mother,

sanskrit_iast:
yadekaḥ kurute karma tadekenaiva bhujyate /
tato 'nyasya kṛtaṃ brahmanbījaṃ dhātrīsamudbhavam //
meaning:
यदेकः कुरुते कर्म तदेकेनैव भुज्यते /
ततो ऽन्यस्य कृतं ब्रह्मन्बीजं धात्रीसमुद्भवम् //
text_mt: the karma that one person performs is experienced by that one alone; / hence, O Brahmā, how can the seed produced from the mother save another?

sanskrit_iast:
tārayetsa ubhau pakṣau yatpiṇḍo yasya vigrahaḥ /
na bhāryāyā bhavedvījaṃ na bhāryā kukṣidhāriṇī //
meaning:
तारयेत्स उभौ पक्षौ यत्पिण्डो यस्य विग्रहः /
न भार्याया भवेद्वीजं न भार्या कुक्षिधारिणी //
text_mt: He saves both families, whose ancestral rice-ball and whose body it is; / but the seed does not belong to the wife, nor does the wife bear [the husband's ancestral line] in her womb.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tasyā jagannātha pakṣo yāti paraṃ padam /
jāmātuḥ puṇyamāhātmyattina me śiraso rujā //
meaning:
कथं तस्या जगन्नाथ पक्षो याति परं पदम् /
जामातुः पुण्यमाहात्म्यत्तिन मे शिरसो रुजा //
text_mt: How does her family go to the supreme abode, O Lord of the universe? / Because of the greatness of the son-in-law's merit—this causes me a headache!

sanskrit_iast:
na me prayojanaṃ deva niyogenedṛśena vai /
ekādaśyupavāsī yaḥ sa māṃ tyaktvā vrajeddharim //
meaning:
न मे प्रयोजनं देव नियोगेनेदृशेन वै /
एकादश्युपवासी यः स मां त्यक्त्वा व्रजेद्धरिम् //
text_mt: I have no use, O god, for an appointment of this kind, / for whoever fasts on the eleventh day bypasses me and goes to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kulatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya ātmanā saha padmaja /
tyaktvā tu māmakaṃ mārgaṃ prayāti harimandiram //
meaning:
कुलत्रयं समुद्धृत्य आत्मना सह पद्मज /
त्यक्त्वा तु मामकं मार्गं प्रयाति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Delivering three lineages along with himself, O Lotus-born one, / he bypasses my path and goes to the abode of Hari.”

sanskrit_iast:
na yajñaistādṛśairdeva gatiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ /
na tīrthairnāpi dānairvā na vratairviṣṇuvarjitaiḥ //
meaning:
न यज्ञैस्तादृशैर्देव गतिं प्राप्नोति मानवः /
न तीर्थैर्नापि दानैर्वा न व्रतैर्विष्णुवर्जितैः //
text_mt: A human does not attain that state through sacrifices of that kind, O lord, / nor through sacred fords, nor through gifts, nor through observances devoid of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
na jale pāvake vāpi mṛtaḥ prāpnoti tāṃ gatim /
yogena saṃpraṇaṣṭo vā bhṛgupātena vā vidhe //
meaning:
न जले पावके वापि मृतः प्राप्नोति तां गतिम् /
योगेन संप्रणष्टो वा भृगुपातेन वा विधे //
text_mt: One dying in water or in fire does not attain that state, / nor one perished through yoga, nor by falling from a cliff, O ordainer.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśīṃ na gatiṃ yāti yādṛśīṃ vaiṣṇavavratī /
gatiṃ matimatāṃ śreṣṭha satyametadudīritam //
meaning:
तादृशीं न गतिं याति यादृशीं वैष्णवव्रती /
गतिं मतिमतां श्रेष्ठ सत्यमेतदुदीरितम् //
text_mt: One does not go to that state to which one observing the Vaiṣṇava vow goes; / this truth has been spoken, O best of the intelligent.

sanskrit_iast:
harerdine dhātṛphalāṅgalipto vimuktavāñchārasabhojano naraḥ /
prayāti loke dharaṇīdharasya viduṣṭakarmāpi manuṣyajanmā //
meaning:
हरेर्दिने धातृफलाङ्गलिप्तो विमुक्तवाञ्छारसभोजनो नरः /
प्रयाति लोके धरणीधरस्य विदुष्टकर्मापि मनुष्यजन्मा //
text_mt: A man smeared with myrobalan fruit on the day of Hari, who has renounced eating pleasant delicacies, / goes to the realm of the Bearer of the Earth, even if born a mortal of wicked deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ nirāśo bhuvi hīnakarmā tavāgataḥ pādasarojayugmam /
vijñapti mātrābhayadāptikālaṃ kuruṣva sargasthitināsahetoḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽहं निराशो भुवि हीनकर्मा तवागतः पादसरोजयुग्मम् /
विज्ञप्ति मात्राभयदाप्तिकालं कुरुष्व सर्गस्थितिनासहेतोः //
text_mt: Such as I am, hopeless on earth, with my function ruined, I have come to your pair of lotus feet; / make it a time of attaining fearlessness merely through my plea, for the sake of creation, maintenance, and destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
māsyustadā pāpakṛto vihīnā yanmāmakairbhūtagaṇairmanuṣyāḥ /
niyantritāḥ śṛṅkhalarajjubandhanaiḥ samīpagā me vaśagā bhaveyuḥ //
meaning:
मास्युस्तदा पापकृतो विहीना यन्मामकैर्भूतगणैर्मनुष्याः /
नियन्त्रिताः शृङ्खलरज्जुबन्धनैः समीपगा मे वशगा भवेयुः //
text_mt: May those sinners not be absent when men, bound by my legions of spirits / with ropes and chains, should approach me and be under my control.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnastu mārgo ravitāpayukto yadviṣṇusaṃghairatitīvrahastaiḥ /
vimucya kuṃbhīṃ sakalo janaughaḥ prayāti taddhāma parātparasya //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge yamavākyaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
भग्नस्तु मार्गो रवितापयुक्तो यद्विष्णुसंघैरतितीव्रहस्तैः /
विमुच्य कुंभीं सकलो जनौघः प्रयाति तद्धाम परात्परस्य //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे यमवाक्यं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The path scorched by the sun's heat has been broken by the hosts of Viṣṇu with their very swift hands; / having abandoned the Kumbhī cauldron, the whole multitude of people proceeds to that abode of the higher than the highest.

Thus ends the fourth chapter, named "The Speech of Yama," in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
ghṛṣṭatāṃ samanuprāptaḥ panthā devasya cakriṇaḥ /
acchidrairgamyanānaiśca naraistribhuvanārcita //
meaning:
यम उवाच
घृष्टतां समनुप्राप्तः पन्था देवस्य चक्रिणः /
अच्छिद्रैर्गम्यनानैश्च नरैस्त्रिभुवनार्चित //
text_mt: Yama said: / The path of the Discus-bearing god has become worn smooth / by flawless men who are traveling along it, O you who are worshipped in the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
apramāṇamahaṃ manye lokaṃ viṣṇorjagatpate /
yo na pūryati lokaighaiḥ sarvasatvasaroruhaiḥ //
meaning:
अप्रमाणमहं मन्ये लोकं विष्णोर्जगत्पते /
यो न पूर्यति लोकैघैः सर्वसत्वसरोरुहैः //
text_mt: I consider the world of Viṣṇu to be measureless, O lord of the world, / which does not become full with the floods of worlds, the lotuses of all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavāvasathainaiva samastena pitāmaha /
svakarmasthā vikarmasthāḥ śucayo 'śucayo 'pi vā //
meaning:
माधवावसथैनैव समस्तेन पितामह /
स्वकर्मस्था विकर्मस्थाः शुचयो ऽशुचयो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: By the entire abode of Mādhava alone, O grandfather, / whether abiding in their own duties or in unlawful acts, whether pure or impure,

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇorlokaṃ yānti nṛpājñayā /
so 'smākaṃ hi mahān śatrurbhavatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
उपोष्य वासरं विष्णोर्लोकं यान्ति नृपाज्ञया /
सो ऽस्माकं हि महान् शत्रुर्भवतां च विशेषतः //
text_mt: having fasted on the day of Viṣṇu by the king's order, they go to his world. / Indeed, he is a great enemy of ours, and especially of yours.

sanskrit_iast:
nigrāhyo jagatāṃnātha bhavennāstyatra saṃśayaḥ /
tena varṣasahasreṇa śāsitaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
निग्राह्यो जगतांनाथ भवेन्नास्त्यत्र संशयः /
तेन वर्षसहस्रेण शासितं क्षितिमण्डलम् //
text_mt: He should be restrained, O lord of the worlds; there is no doubt about this. / By him the circle of the earth has been ruled for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyo jano nīto vaiṣṇavaṃ harivallabham /
āropayitvā garuḍe kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam //
meaning:
अप्रमेयो जनो नीतो वैष्णवं हरिवल्लभम् /
आरोपयित्वा गरुडे कृत्वा रूपं चतुर्भुजम् //
text_mt: Immeasurable numbers of people have been led to the Vaiṣṇava realm dear to Hari, / mounted upon Garuḍa, having assumed a four-armed form,

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastrasusaṃvītaṃ sragviṇaṃ cārulopanam /
yadi sthāsyati deveśa mādhavyāṃ mādhavapriyaḥ //
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रसुसंवीतं स्रग्विणं चारुलोपनम् /
यदि स्थास्यति देवेश माधव्यां माधवप्रियः //
text_mt: dressed in fine yellow garments, wearing garlands and pleasing ointments. / If he remains thus, O lord of gods, devoted to Mādhava on the day of Mādhava,

sanskrit_iast:
samastaṃ neṣyate lokaṃ viṣṇoḥ padamanāmayam /
eṣa daṇḍaḥ paṭo hyeṣa tava padbhyāṃ visarjitaḥ //
meaning:
समस्तं नेष्यते लोकं विष्णोः पदमनामयम् /
एष दण्डः पटो ह्येष तव पद्भ्यां विसर्जितः //
text_mt: he will lead the entire world to the disease-free abode of Viṣṇu. / This staff and this cloth have been cast down before your feet!

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālatvamatulaṃ mārjita tena bhūbhujā /
rukmāṅgadena deveśa dhanyā sā sa dhṛto yayā //
meaning:
लोकपालत्वमतुलं मार्जित तेन भूभुजा /
रुक्माङ्गदेन देवेश धन्या सा स धृतो यया //
text_mt: Incomparable guardianship of the worlds was wiped away by that king, / Rukmāṅgada, O lord of the gods; blessed is she by whom he was carried [in the womb]!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaduḥkhavināśāya mātrṛjāto guṇādhikaḥ /
kimapatyena jātena mātuḥ kleśakareṇa hi //
meaning:
सर्वदुःखविनाशाय मात्रृजातो गुणाधिकः /
किमपत्येन जातेन मातुः क्लेशकरेण हि //
text_mt: A son born from a mother superior in virtue brings about the destruction of all suffering. / What is the use of an offspring born who only causes affliction to his mother?

sanskrit_iast:
yo na tāpayate śatrūn jyeṣṭhe māsi yathā raviḥ /
vṛthāśūlā hi jananī jātā deva kuputriṇī //
meaning:
यो न तापयते शत्रून् ज्येष्ठे मासि यथा रविः /
वृथाशूला हि जननी जाता देव कुपुत्रिणी //
text_mt: He who does not scorch his enemies like the sun in the month of Jyeṣṭha— / vain were his mother's labor-pains; she has become a mother of a wicked son, O god.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya na sphurate kīrtirghanastheva śatahradā /
yaḥ piturnoddharetpakṣaṃ vidyayā vā balena vā //
meaning:
यस्य न स्फुरते कीर्तिर्घनस्थेव शतह्रदा /
यः पितुर्नोद्धरेत्पक्षं विद्यया वा बलेन वा //
text_mt: He whose fame does not flash like lightning in a cloud, / who does not raise up his father's side by learning or by strength—

sanskrit_iast:
māturjaṭharajo rogaḥ sa prasūto dharātale /
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca pratīpo yo bhavetsutaḥ //
meaning:
मातुर्जठरजो रोगः स प्रसूतो धरातले /
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च प्रतीपो यो भवेत्सुतः //
text_mt: he is merely a disease of the womb born to his mother on the surface of the earth. / A son who is opposed to virtue, wealth, and pleasure

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛhā procyate sadbhirvṛthā tasyaiva jīvitam /
ekā hi vīrasūreva virañce nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मातृहा प्रोच्यते सद्भिर्वृथा तस्यैव जीवितम् /
एका हि वीरसूरेव विरञ्चे नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: is declared by the virtuous to be a killer of his mother; in vain is his life. / She alone is the mother of a hero, O Virañci, there is no doubt here,

sanskrit_iast:
yayā rukmāṅgado jāto mallipemarjjanāya vai /
nedaṃ vyavasthitaṃ deva kṣitau kenāpi bhūbhujā //
meaning:
यया रुक्माङ्गदो जातो मल्लिपेमर्ज्जनाय वै /
नेदं व्यवस्थितं देव क्षितौ केनापि भूभुजा //
text_mt: by whom Rukmāṅgada was born to wipe away the host of wrestling champions. / Such an arrangement was never instituted by any king on earth, O god.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇe 'pi jagannātha na śrutaṃ paṭamārjanam /
so 'haṃ na jāṃ mi kadācidāśa dṛṣṭvā kṣirīśaṃ harisevane sthitam /
pravādamānaṃ paṭahaṃ sughoraṃ pralopamānaṃ mamaviśmamārgam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge yamavilāpanaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पुराणे ऽपि जगन्नाथ न श्रुतं पटमार्जनम् /
सो ऽहं न जां मि कदाचिदाश दृष्ट्वा क्षिरीशं हरिसेवने स्थितम् /
प्रवादमानं पटहं सुघोरं प्रलोपमानं ममविश्ममार्गम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे यमविलापनं नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Even in the Purāṇas, O lord of the world, no wiping out of the cloth has been heard of. / Such as I am, I do not know... having seen the king intent upon the worship of Hari, / beating the terrible war-drum and destroying my universal path.

Thus ends the fifth chapter, named "The Lamentation of Yama," in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
kimāścaryaṃ tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ vā khidyate bhavān /
sadguṇeṣu ca saṃtāpaḥ sa tāpo maraṇāntikaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
किमाश्चर्यं त्वया दृष्टं कथं वा खिद्यते भवान् /
सद्गुणेषु च संतापः स तापो मरणान्तिकः //
title: athaṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Brahmā said: / What wonder have you seen, or why are you grieving? / Torment felt over good virtues is a torment that ends in death.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa prāpyate paramaṃ padam /
tamupoṣya kathaṃ saure na gacchati narastviti //
meaning:
यस्योच्चारणमात्रेण प्राप्यते परमं पदम् /
तमुपोष्य कथं सौरे न गच्छति नरस्त्विति //
text_mt: Through the mere utterance of whose name the supreme abode is reached— / having fasted for him, O son of the Sun, how should a mortal not go [there]?

sanskrit_iast:
eko hi kṛṣṇasya kṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ /
daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kaṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya //
meaning:
एको हि कृष्णस्य कृतः प्रणामो दशाश्वमेधावभृथेन तुल्यः /
दशाश्वमेधी पुनरेति जन्म कष्णप्रणामी न पुनर्भवाय //
text_mt: A single bow made to Kṛṣṇa is equal to the concluding bath of ten horse-sacrifices; / one who performs ten horse-sacrifices is born again, but one who bows to Kṛṣṇa is not [born] for rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
kurukṣetreṇa kiṃ tasya kiṃ kāśyā virajena vā /
jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam //
meaning:
कुरुक्षेत्रेण किं तस्य किं काश्या विरजेन वा /
जिह्वाग्रे वर्तते यस्य हरिरित्यक्षरद्वयम् //
text_mt: What need has he of Kurukṣetra, what of Kāśī, or of Viraja, / upon the tip of whose tongue rests the two syllables "Ha-ri"?

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ śvapacīṃ gacchan viśeṣeṇa rajasvalām /
annamaśnansurāpakvaṃ maraṇe yo hariṃ smaret //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः श्वपचीं गच्छन् विशेषेण रजस्वलाम् /
अन्नमश्नन्सुरापक्वं मरणे यो हरिं स्मरेत् //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa who goes with an outcaste woman, especially one in her courses, / or who eats food cooked in liquor—if at death he remembers Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyāgamyayorjātaṃ vihāya pāpasaṃcayam /
sa yāti viṣṇusāyujyaṃ vimukto bhavabandhanaiḥ //
meaning:
अभक्ष्यागम्ययोर्जातं विहाय पापसंचयम् /
स याति विष्णुसायुज्यं विमुक्तो भवबन्धनैः //
text_mt: abandoning the heap of sins born of inedible food and forbidden women, / he goes to communion with Viṣṇu, released from worldly bonds.

sanskrit_iast:
yannāmoccāraṇānmokṣaḥ kathaṃ na tadupoṣaṇe /
yasminsaṃgīyate so 'pi cintyate puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
यन्नामोच्चारणान्मोक्षः कथं न तदुपोषणे /
यस्मिन्संगीयते सो ऽपि चिन्त्यते पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: When liberation comes from uttering his name, how could it not from fasting for him, / in which that Puruṣottama is sung and also meditated upon?

sanskrit_iast:
līlayā coccareddevaṃ śṛṇuyācca janārdanam /
gaṅgāṃbhaḥ pūtapuṇyatve sa naraḥ samatāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
लीलया चोच्चरेद्देवं शृणुयाच्च जनार्दनम् /
गङ्गांभः पूतपुण्यत्वे स नरः समतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: If one should playfully utter the god or listen to [the praises of] Janārdana, / that man attains equality [with one having] merit purified by the water of the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ jagatāṃnātho janmadaḥ puruṣottamaḥ /
kathaṃ śāsati durmedhāstasya vāsarasevinam //
meaning:
अस्माकं जगतांनाथो जन्मदः पुरुषोत्तमः /
कथं शासति दुर्मेधास्तस्य वासरसेविनम् //
text_mt: Puruṣottama, the lord of the worlds, is our progenitor; / how could foolish people punish someone who observes his holy day?

sanskrit_iast:
yastvaṃ na cūrṇitastaistu yastvaṃ baddho na tairdṛḍham /
tadasmākaṃ kṛtaṃ mānaṃ me tattvaṃ nāvabudhyase //
meaning:
यस्त्वं न चूर्णितस्तैस्तु यस्त्वं बद्धो न तैर्दृढम् /
तदस्माकं कृतं मानं मे तत्त्वं नावबुध्यसे //
text_mt: That you were not crushed by them, that you were not firmly bound by them— / that was respect shown to me; you do not understand my true nature.

sanskrit_iast:
yo niyogī na jānāti nṛpabhaktānvarān kṣitau /
kṛtsnāyāsena saṃyuktaḥ sa tairnigrāhyate punaḥ //
meaning:
यो नियोगी न जानाति नृपभक्तान्वरान् क्षितौ /
कृत्स्नायासेन संयुक्तः स तैर्निग्राह्यते पुनः //
text_mt: An officer who does not recognize the king's foremost devotees on earth / and acts with total violence is, in turn, restrained by them.

sanskrit_iast:
rājeṣṭā na niyoktavyāḥ sāparādhā niyoginā /
svāmiprasādātsiddhāste vininyurvvai niyoginam //
meaning:
राजेष्टा न नियोक्तव्याः सापराधा नियोगिना /
स्वामिप्रसादात्सिद्धास्ते विनिन्युर्व्वै नियोगिनम् //
text_mt: Those who are dear to the king, even if guilty of an offense, must not be disciplined by an officer; / perfected through the master's grace, they would discipline that officer himself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi pāpakartāraḥ praṇatā ye janārdane /
kathaṃ saṃyamitā teṣāṃ bālyādbhāskaranandana //
meaning:
एवं हि पापकर्तारः प्रणता ये जनार्दने /
कथं संयमिता तेषां बाल्याद्भास्करनन्दन //
text_mt: Thus, indeed, regarding evildoers who bow down to Janārdana: / how could there be a punisher of them, O son of Bhāskara, through childishness?

sanskrit_iast:
śaivairbhāskarabhaktairvā madbhaktairvā divākare /
karomi tava sāhāyyaṃ haribhaktairna bhāskare //
meaning:
शैवैर्भास्करभक्तैर्वा मद्भक्तैर्वा दिवाकरे /
करोमि तव साहाय्यं हरिभक्तैर्न भास्करे //
text_mt: Against devotees of Śiva, devotees of the Sun, or devotees of mine, O son of the Sun, / I can render you assistance, but not against devotees of Hari, O son of Bhāskara.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāmeva devānāmādistupuruṣottamaḥ //
meaning: सर्वेषामेव देवानामादिस्तुपुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: For Puruṣottama is the very origin of all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
madhusūdanabhaktānāṃ nigraho nopapadyate /
vyājenāpi kṛtā yaistu dvādaśī pakṣayordvayoḥ //
meaning:
मधुसूदनभक्तानां निग्रहो नोपपद्यते /
व्याजेनापि कृता यैस्तु द्वादशी पक्षयोर्द्वयोः //
text_mt: Restraint of the devotees of Madhusūdana is not admissible; / and by those who have observed the Dvādaśī of both fortnights, even under a pretext,

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ kṛte avamāne tu tava nāhaṃ sahāyavān /
kṛte sahāye tava sūryasūno bhavedanītirmama dehaghātinī /
viparyayo brahmapadātsupuṇyātkṛteva mārge saha viṣṇubhaktaiḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge brahmavākyaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तैः कृते अवमाने तु तव नाहं सहायवान् /
कृते सहाये तव सूर्यसूनो भवेदनीतिर्मम देहघातिनी /
विपर्ययो ब्रह्मपदात्सुपुण्यात्कृतेव मार्गे सह विष्णुभक्तैः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे ब्रह्मवाक्यं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
if disrespect has been shown to you by them, I cannot be an ally. / If assistance were given to you, O son of the Sun, there would be unrighteousness destroying my own body, / and a fall from the highly meritorious abode of Brahmā, as it were, on a path [trodden] against the devotees of Viṣṇu.

Thus ends the sixth chapter, named "The Speech of Brahmā," in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaṃ tāta mayā sārddhaṃ vedāṅghrinamane hitam /
nāhaṃ gacchāmi yogāntaṃ punareva jagatpate //
meaning:
प्राप्तं तात मया सार्द्धं वेदाङ्घ्रिनमने हितम् /
नाहं गच्छामि योगान्तं पुनरेव जगत्पते //
text_mt: Father, the good has been attained together with me by bowing at the feet of the Veda; / I will never go to the end of yoga again, O lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
praśāsati mahīṃ bhūpehāṭakāṅgadasaṃjñake /
tamekaṃ devatāśreṣṭhaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare //
meaning:
प्रशासति महीं भूपेहाटकाङ्गदसंज्ञके /
तमेकं देवताश्रेष्ठं संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे //
text_mt: while the king named Hāṭakāṅgada rules the earth. / If you shake that one foremost among deities from his steadfastness

sanskrit_iast:
yadi cālayase dhairyāttato 'haṃ tava kiṅkaraḥ /
sa me śatrurmahāndeva tena luptaḥ paṭo mama //
meaning:
यदि चालयसे धैर्यात्ततो ऽहं तव किङ्करः /
स मे शत्रुर्महान्देव तेन लुप्तः पटो मम //
text_mt: when the day of Hari has arrived, then I am your servant. / He is my great enemy, O god; by him my proclamation-cloth has been destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tamekaṃ bhojayitvā tu kārṣṇe 'hani mahīpatim /
kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi gayāpiṇḍaprado yathā //
meaning:
तमेकं भोजयित्वा तु कार्ष्णे ऽहनि महीपतिम् /
कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि गयापिण्डप्रदो यथा //
text_mt: If I can feed that one king on the day of Kṛṣṇa, / then I shall have fulfilled my task, like one offering a piṇḍa at Gayā.

sanskrit_iast:
adya prabhṛti deveśoyairnaraiḥ saṃsmṛto hariḥ /
upoṣitaḥ stutovāpi na niyamyā mayā hi te //
meaning:
अद्य प्रभृति देवेशोयैर्नरैः संस्मृतो हरिः /
उपोषितः स्तुतोवापि न नियम्या मया हि ते //
text_mt: From today onward, O Lord of the gods, those men by whom Hari is remembered, / fasted for, or praised, are truly not to be restrained by me.

sanskrit_iast:
haririti sahasā ye saṃgṛṇanticchalena jananijaṭharamārgātte vimukte vimuktā hi martyāḥ /
mama paṭavilipiṃ te no viśanti pravīṇā divicaravarasaṃghaiste namasyā bhavanti /
sautiruvāca //
meaning:
हरिरिति सहसा ये संगृणन्तिच्छलेन जननिजठरमार्गात्ते विमुक्ते विमुक्ता हि मर्त्याः /
मम पटविलिपिं ते नो विशन्ति प्रवीणा दिविचरवरसंघैस्ते नमस्या भवन्ति /
सौतिरुवाच //
text_mt:
Those mortals who even once or deceitfully proclaim, 'Hari!', are liberated from the path of the mother's womb; / those skilled ones do not enter the register of my record-cloth, and they are worthy of homage by the host of supreme celestials.
Sauti said:

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatasya kāryeṇa tatsammānacikīrṣayayā /
rcitayāmāsa deveśo viriñciḥ kuśalāñchanaḥ //
meaning:
वैवस्वतस्य कार्येण तत्सम्मानचिकीर्षयया /
र्चितयामास देवेशो विरिञ्चिः कुशलाञ्छनः //
text_mt: For the purpose of Vaivasvata, wishing to show him honor, / the Lord of gods, Viriñci, who marks welfare, reflected.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayitvā kṣaṇaṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtaiśca bhūṣitaḥ /
bhūtatrāsanamātraṃ tu rūpaṃ sa jagṛhe vibhuḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तयित्वा क्षणं देवः सर्वभूतैश्च भूषितः /
भूतत्रासनमात्रं तु रूपं स जगृहे विभुः //
text_mt: Having reflected for a moment, the Lord, adorned by all beings, / the almighty one assumed a form that merely brought terror to beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnutpādayāmāsa pramadāṃ lokamohinīm /
sarvayoṣidvarā devīmanasā nirbhitā babhau //
meaning:
तस्मिन्नुत्पादयामास प्रमदां लोकमोहिनीम् /
सर्वयोषिद्वरा देवीमनसा निर्भिता बभौ //
text_mt: In that [form], he produced a woman who enchants the worlds; / best among all women, fashioned by his mind, the goddess shone forth.

sanskrit_iast:
sā babhūvāgratastasya sarvālaṅkārabhīṣitā /
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahastāṃ tu rūpadraviṇasaṃyutām //
meaning:
सा बभूवाग्रतस्तस्य सर्वालङ्कारभीषिता /
दृष्ट्वा पितामहस्तां तु रूपद्रविणसंयुताम् //
text_mt: She stood before him, adorned with every ornament; / seeing her endowed with the treasure of beauty, the Grandfather

sanskrit_iast:
prāhemān paśyato hyetāṃ svakānvai kāmamohitān /
pratyavāyabhayādbrahyā cakṣuṣī saṃnyamīlayat //
meaning:
प्राहेमान् पश्यतो ह्येतां स्वकान्वै काममोहितान् /
प्रत्यवायभयाद्ब्रह्या चक्षुषी संन्यमीलयत् //
text_mt: spoke, beholding those sons of his bewildered by passion; / out of fear of sin, Brahmā closed his eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
sarāgeṇeha manasā sarāgeṇeha cakṣuṣā /
cintayedvīkṣayedvāpi jananīṃ vā sutāmapi //
meaning:
सरागेणेह मनसा सरागेणेह चक्षुषा /
चिन्तयेद्वीक्षयेद्वापि जननीं वा सुतामपि //
text_mt: Whoever, with an impassioned mind or an impassioned eye, / should contemplate or look upon a mother or a daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
vadhūṃ vā bhrātṛjāyāṃ vā gurobhāryāṃ nṛpastriyam /
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃcintya śvapacīmapi //
meaning:
वधूं वा भ्रातृजायां वा गुरोभार्यां नृपस्त्रियम् /
स याति नरकं घोरं संचिन्त्य श्वपचीमपि //
text_mt: or a daughter-in-law, a brother's wife, a guru's wife, or a king's woman, / goes to a dreadful hell, [even] by lusting after an outcast woman.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā hi pramadā hyetā yaḥ kṣobhaṃ vrajate naraḥ /
tasya janmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛthā bhavati nānyathā //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा हि प्रमदा ह्येता यः क्षोभं व्रजते नरः /
तस्य जन्मकृतं पुण्यं वृथा भवति नान्यथा //
text_mt: The man who, seeing these women, falls into agitation, / the merit accumulated in his lifetime becomes futile, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃge daśasāhasraṃ puṇyamāyāti saṃkṣayam /
puṇyasya saṃkṣayātpāpī pāṣāṇākhurbhaveddhruvam //
meaning:
प्रसंगे दशसाहस्रं पुण्यमायाति संक्षयम् /
पुण्यस्य संक्षयात्पापी पाषाणाखुर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: In illicit attachment, ten thousand [units of] merit go to destruction; / through the destruction of merit, the sinner certainly becomes a rat in a stone.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna cintaye tprājño hyetā rāgeṇa cakṣuṣā /
jananyā api pādau tu nādeyau dvādaśābdikaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्न चिन्तये त्प्राज्ञो ह्येता रागेण चक्षुषा /
जनन्या अपि पादौ तु नादेयौ द्वादशाब्दिकैः //
text_mt: Therefore, a wise man should not gaze upon them with eyes of passion; / even the feet of a mother should not be massaged by [sons] twelve years old,

sanskrit_iast:
sutaistvabhyaṅgakaraṇe punaryauvanasaṃsthitaiḥ /
ṣaṣṭyatītāṃ suto 'bhyaṅge niyuñjīta vicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सुतैस्त्वभ्यङ्गकरणे पुनर्यौवनसंस्थितैः /
षष्ट्यतीतां सुतो ऽभ्यङ्गे नियुञ्जीत विचक्षणः //
text_mt: nor in applying unction by sons established in their youth; / a discerning son should engage [his mother] in applying unction [only when she is] past sixty.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddho vāpi yuvā vāpi na pādau dhāvayedvadhūm /
ubhayoḥ patanaṃ proktaṃ raurave 'ṅgārasaṃcaye //
meaning:
वृद्धो वापि युवा वापि न पादौ धावयेद्वधूम् /
उभयोः पतनं प्रोक्तं रौरवे ऽङ्गारसंचये //
text_mt: Whether old or young, one should not let a daughter-in-law wash his feet; / the fall of both into the Raurava hell upon a heap of burning coals is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
yā vadhūrdarśayedaṅgaṃ vivṛtaṃ śvaśurasya hi /
pāṇipādāhatā rājan krimibhakṣyā bhavettu sā /
vadhūhastena yaḥ pāpaḥ pādaśaucaṃ karoti hi //
meaning:
या वधूर्दर्शयेदङ्गं विवृतं श्वशुरस्य हि /
पाणिपादाहता राजन् क्रिमिभक्ष्या भवेत्तु सा /
वधूहस्तेन यः पापः पादशौचं करोति हि //
text_mt: A daughter-in-law who displays an uncovered limb to her father-in-law / shall be beaten hand and foot, O king, and eaten by worms; / the wicked man who has his feet washed by the hand of a daughter-in-law,

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ vāpyathavābhyaṅgaṃ tasyāpyevaṃvidhā gatiḥ /
sūcīmukhaiḥ kṛṣṇavaktrorbhujyate kalpasaṃsthitim //
meaning:
स्नानं वाप्यथवाभ्यङ्गं तस्याप्येवंविधा गतिः /
सूचीमुखैः कृष्णवक्त्रोर्भुज्यते कल्पसंस्थितिम् //
text_mt: or a bath or unction [performed by her], meets a similar fate; / he is devoured by needle-mouthed, black-faced beings for the duration of a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna vīkṣayennārīṃ sutāṃ vāpi vadhūṃ naraḥ /
sābhilāṣeṇa manasā tatkṣaṇātpatate naraḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्न वीक्षयेन्नारीं सुतां वापि वधूं नरः /
साभिलाषेण मनसा तत्क्षणात्पतते नरः //
text_mt: Therefore, a man should not look at a woman, a daughter, or a daughter-in-law / with a desiring mind; from that moment the man falls.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃcintayitvā ca sūkṣmāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha /
yadidaṃ vartulaṃ vaktraṃ sonnataṃ dṛśyate śubham //
meaning:
एवं संचिन्तयित्वा च सूक्ष्मां दृष्टिं चकार ह /
यदिदं वर्तुलं वक्त्रं सोन्नतं दृश्यते शुभम् //
text_mt: Reflecting thus, he cast subtle insight: / 'That which is seen as this round, prominent, lovely face,

sanskrit_iast:
asthipañjarametaddhi carmamāṃsāvṛtaṃ tviti /
vasā medo 'tha nayane sojvale strīṣu saṃsthite //
meaning:
अस्थिपञ्जरमेतद्धि चर्ममांसावृतं त्विति /
वसा मेदो ऽथ नयने सोज्वले स्त्रीषु संस्थिते //
text_mt: is merely a skeleton of bones covered with skin and flesh; / serum, fat, and eyes shining brightly are situated in women;

sanskrit_iast:
atyucchritamidaṃ māṃsaṃ stanayoḥ samavasthitam /
nimnāṃśatāṃ darśayati trivalī jaṭharasthitā //
meaning:
अत्युच्छ्रितमिदं मांसं स्तनयोः समवस्थितम् /
निम्नांशतां दर्शयति त्रिवली जठरस्थिता //
text_mt: this highly elevated flesh is positioned upon the breasts; / the three folds on the belly show a hollow depression;

sanskrit_iast:
punarevādhikaṃ kṣiptaṃ māṃsaṃ jaghanavatmani /
mūtradvāramidaṃ guhyaṃ yatra mugdhaṃ jagattrayam //
meaning:
पुनरेवाधिकं क्षिप्तं मांसं जघनवत्मनि /
मूत्रद्वारमिदं गुह्यं यत्र मुग्धं जगत्त्रयम् //
text_mt: again, more flesh is cast onto the tract of the hips; / this secret urinary orifice is where the three worlds are deluded.'

sanskrit_iast:
apānavāyunā juṣṭaṃ sadaiva pratikutsitam /
bhastrāvargādhikaṃ kṣiptaṃ māṃsaṃ jaghanavartmani //
meaning:
अपानवायुना जुष्टं सदैव प्रतिकुत्सितम् /
भस्त्रावर्गाधिकं क्षिप्तं मांसं जघनवर्त्मनि //
text_mt: It is afflicted with downward-moving breath and ever thoroughly repulsive; / an excess of flesh is thrown upon the course of the thighs like a pair of bellows.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ yadviddvidhā kāṣṭhaṃ tadvajjaṅghā dvidhā dhruvam /
śukrāsthipūritaṃ māṃsaiḥ kathaṃ sundaratāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
कृतं यद्विद्द्विधा काष्ठं तद्वज्जङ्घा द्विधा ध्रुवम् /
शुक्रास्थिपूरितं मांसैः कथं सुन्दरतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Just as a piece of wood is split in two, so surely are the shanks divided; / filled with semen, bones, and flesh, how could this attain beauty?

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsamedovasāsāre kiṃ sāraṃ dehināṃ vada /
viṣṭhāmūtramalaiḥ puṣṭe ko dehe rajyate naraḥ //
meaning:
मांसमेदोवसासारे किं सारं देहिनां वद /
विष्ठामूत्रमलैः पुष्टे को देहे रज्यते नरः //
text_mt: In this essence of flesh, fat, and marrow, tell [me], what is the essence of embodied beings? / What man takes delight in a body nourished on the impurities of feces and urine?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vicārya bahudhā viriñcirjñānacakṣuṣā /
dhairyaṃ kṛtvā va nārīṃ tāmuvāca gajagāminīm //
meaning:
एवं विचार्य बहुधा विरिञ्चिर्ज्ञानचक्षुषा /
धैर्यं कृत्वा व नारीं तामुवाच गजगामिनीम् //
text_mt: Having thus reflected in many ways with the eye of knowledge, / Brahmā, regaining his composure, spoke to that woman whose gait was like an elephant's:

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhi manasā sṛṣṭā mayā tvaṃ varavarṇinī /
tathā bhūtāsi cārvaṅgi mānasonmādakāriṇī //
meaning:
यथाहि मनसा सृष्टा मया त्वं वरवर्णिनी /
तथा भूतासि चार्वङ्गि मानसोन्मादकारिणी //
text_mt: "Indeed, just as you were created by my mind, O woman of fair complexion, / so have you become, O lovely-limbed one, a cause of madness to the mind."

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca tadā sā tu praṇamya caturānanam /
paśya mūcchānvatanātha jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
तमुवाच तदा सा तु प्रणम्य चतुराननम् /
पश्य मूच्छान्वतनाथ जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: Then she, having bowed to the four-faced one, said to him: / "Behold, O lord, the world of the moving and unmoving fallen into a swoon!

sanskrit_iast:
mohitaṃ mama rūpeṇa sayogi yadakalmaṣam /
sa nāsti triṣu lokeṣu yaḥ pumānmama darśanāt //
meaning:
मोहितं मम रूपेण सयोगि यदकल्मषम् /
स नास्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु यः पुमान्मम दर्शनात् //
text_mt: It is bewitched by my form, along with the yogins who are faultless; / there is no man in the three worlds who, having seen me,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanta māditaḥ kṛtvā na kṣobhaṃ yāti padmaja /
ātmastutirna kartavyā kenacicchubhamicchatā //
meaning:
भवन्त मादितः कृत्वा न क्षोभं याति पद्मज /
आत्मस्तुतिर्न कर्तव्या केनचिच्छुभमिच्छता //
text_mt: beginning with you, O lotus-born one, does not fall into agitation. / Self-praise should not be spoken by anyone desiring their own good;

sanskrit_iast:
stavanānnarakaṃ yāti viśuddho 'pi ca mānavaḥ /
tathāpi stavanaṃ brahman kartavyaṃ kāryahetunā //
meaning:
स्तवनान्नरकं याति विशुद्धो ऽपि च मानवः /
तथापि स्तवनं ब्रह्मन् कर्तव्यं कार्यहेतुना //
text_mt: through self-praise even a purified person goes to hell. / Yet praise must be uttered, O Brahmā, on account of a purpose to be accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaṃ sṛṣṭā tvayā brahman kasyacitkṣobhaṇāya vai /
tamādiśa jagannātha kṣobhayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
साहं सृष्टा त्वया ब्रह्मन् कस्यचित्क्षोभणाय वै /
तमादिश जगन्नाथ क्षोभयिष्ये न संशयः //
text_mt: I have indeed been created by you, O Brahmā, to agitate someone; / designate him, O lord of the world, and I shall agitate him, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ dṛṣṭvāpi kṣitau deva bhūdharaścāpi muhyati /
kiṃ punaścetanopetaḥ śvāsocchāsī narastviti //
meaning:
मां दृष्ट्वापि क्षितौ देव भूधरश्चापि मुह्यति /
किं पुनश्चेतनोपेतः श्वासोच्छासी नरस्त्विति //
text_mt: Even a mountain on earth, O god, becomes bewildered upon seeing me; / how much more so a human endowed with consciousness and drawing breath?

sanskrit_iast:
tathā coktaṃ purāṇeṣu nārīvīkṣaṇavarṇanam /
unmādakaraṇaṃ nṝṇāṃ duścaravratanāśanam //
meaning:
तथा चोक्तं पुराणेषु नारीवीक्षणवर्णनम् /
उन्मादकरणं नॄणां दुश्चरव्रतनाशनम् //
text_mt: And likewise it has been declared in the Purāṇas, describing the sight of a woman: / it causes madness in men and destroys vows that are difficult to perform.

sanskrit_iast:
sanmārge tāvadāste prabhavati puruṣastāvadevendriyāṇāṃ lajjāṃ tāvadvidhatte vinayamapi samālaṃbate tāvadeva /
bhrūcāpākṣepayuktāḥ śravaṇapathagatā nīlapakṣmāṇa ete yāvallīlāvatīnāṃ na hṛdi dhṛtimuṣo dṛṣṭibāṇāḥ patanti //
meaning:
सन्मार्गे तावदास्ते प्रभवति पुरुषस्तावदेवेन्द्रियाणां लज्जां तावद्विधत्ते विनयमपि समालंबते तावदेव /
भ्रूचापाक्षेपयुक्ताः श्रवणपथगता नीलपक्ष्माण एते यावल्लीलावतीनां न हृदि धृतिमुषो दृष्टिबाणाः पतन्ति //
text_mt:
A man remains on the good path only so long, he masters his senses only so long, / he observes modesty only so long, and maintains humility only so long,
so long as these arrows of glances, launched from the bow of the eyebrows, reaching to the ears, / having dark eyelashes and stealing steadfastness from the heart, do not strike the playful women.

sanskrit_iast:
dhiktasya mūḍhamanasaḥ kukaveḥ kavitvaṃ yaḥ strīmukhaṃ ca śaśinaṃ ca samīkaroti /
bhrūkṣepavismitakaṭākṣanirīkṣanirīkṣitāni kopaprasādahasitāni kutaḥ śaśāṅke //
meaning:
धिक्तस्य मूढमनसः कुकवेः कवित्वं यः स्त्रीमुखं च शशिनं च समीकरोति /
भ्रूक्षेपविस्मितकटाक्षनिरीक्षनिरीक्षितानि कोपप्रसादहसितानि कुतः शशाङ्के //
text_mt: Fie upon the poetry of that dull-witted, bad poet who equates a woman's face with the moon! / For whence are there in the moon the arching of eyebrows, the gazing glances of astonishment, the smiling of anger and favor?

sanskrit_iast:
pītaṃ hi madyaṃ manujena nātha karoti mohaṃ suvicakṣaṇasya /
smṛtā ca dṛṣṭā yuvatī nareṇa vimohayedeva surādhikā hi //
meaning:
पीतं हि मद्यं मनुजेन नाथ करोति मोहं सुविचक्षणस्य /
स्मृता च दृष्टा युवती नरेण विमोहयेदेव सुराधिका हि //
text_mt: Liquor when drunk by a man, O lord, causes bewilderment even to the very wise; / but a young woman, remembered and looked upon by a man, completely bewitches him, for she is greater than wine.

sanskrit_iast:
mohanārthaṃ tvayā sṛṣṭā narāṇāṃ prapitāmaha /
tamādiśajagannātha trailokyaṃ mohayāmyaham //
meaning:
मोहनार्थं त्वया सृष्टा नराणां प्रपितामह /
तमादिशजगन्नाथ त्रैलोक्यं मोहयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: I have been created by you, O great-grandfather, for the bewilderment of men; / designate him, O lord of the world, and I shall bewilder the three worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
satyamuktaṃ tvayā devi nāsādhyaṃ bhuvanatraye /
nāganāsoru subhage mattamātaṅgagāmini //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सत्यमुक्तं त्वया देवि नासाध्यं भुवनत्रये /
नागनासोरु सुभगे मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / "You have spoken the truth, O goddess; nothing is impossible in the three worlds [for you], / O you whose thighs are like an elephant's trunk, O fortunate one whose gait is like that of an intoxicated elephant!

sanskrit_iast:
yā tvaṃ dūṣayase ceto mamāpi varavarṇini /
tanmayā sugṛhītaṃ tu kṛtaṃ jñānāṅkuśena hi //
meaning:
या त्वं दूषयसे चेतो ममापि वरवर्णिनि /
तन्मया सुगृहीतं तु कृतं ज्ञानाङ्कुशेन हि //
text_mt: Since you disturb even my mind, O fair-complexioned one, / yet it was firmly seized and checked by me with the elephant-goad of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvaṃ kathaṃ na lokānāṃ cetāṃsyapahariṣyasi /
satyametadviśālākṣi tava rūpaṃ vimohanam //
meaning:
सा त्वं कथं न लोकानां चेतांस्यपहरिष्यसि /
सत्यमेतद्विशालाक्षि तव रूपं विमोहनम् //
text_mt: How then will you not steal away the minds of the people of the worlds? / It is true, O large-eyed one, that your beauty is utterly bewildering.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmaraṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ niśceṣṭamapi lakṣaye /
yannimittaṃ mayā sṛṣṭā tatsādhaya varānane //
meaning:
सामरं हि जगत्सर्वं निश्चेष्टमपि लक्षये /
यन्निमित्तं मया सृष्टा तत्साधय वरानने //
text_mt: Indeed, I perceive the entire world along with the gods rendered motionless; / therefore accomplish that for the sake of which you were created by me, O fair-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
vaidiśe nagare rājā nāmnā rukmāṅgadaḥ kṣitau /
yasya sandhyāvalī bhāryā tava rūpopamā śubhe //
meaning:
वैदिशे नगरे राजा नाम्ना रुक्माङ्गदः क्षितौ /
यस्य सन्ध्यावली भार्या तव रूपोपमा शुभे //
text_mt: In the city of Vidiśā, upon earth, there is a king named Rukmāṅgada, / whose wife is Sandhyāvalī, equal to you in beauty, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ dharmāṅgado jāto pituratyadhikaḥ sutaḥ /
daśanāgāyu tabalaḥ pratāpena raviryathā //
meaning:
यस्यां धर्माङ्गदो जातो पितुरत्यधिकः सुतः /
दशनागायु तबलः प्रतापेन रविर्यथा //
text_mt: From her was born Dharmāṅgada, a son surpassing his father, / possessing the strength of ten myriad elephants, like the sun in majesty;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kṣāntyā dharayā tulyo gāṃbhīrye sāṃgaropamaḥ /
tejasā vahnivaddvīptaḥ krodhe vaivasvatopamaḥ //
meaning:
यः क्षान्त्या धरया तुल्यो गांभीर्ये सांगरोपमः /
तेजसा वह्निवद्द्वीप्तः क्रोधे वैवस्वतोपमः //
text_mt: who equals the earth in forbearance, the ocean in depth, / blazes like fire in splendor, and resembles Yama in wrath;

sanskrit_iast:
tyāge vairaucaniryadvadgatau hi pavanopamaḥ /
saumyatve śaśitulyastu rūpavān manmatho yathā //
meaning:
त्यागे वैरौचनिर्यद्वद्गतौ हि पवनोपमः /
सौम्यत्वे शशितुल्यस्तु रूपवान् मन्मथो यथा //
text_mt: who is like Bali in generosity, like the wind in speed, / like the moon in gentleness, and handsome like Kāma;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvabhārgavayostulyo yo nītau rājanandanaḥ /
pitrā bhuktaṃ samastaikaṃ jaṃbūdvīpaṃ varānane //
meaning:
जीवभार्गवयोस्तुल्यो यो नीतौ राजनन्दनः /
पित्रा भुक्तं समस्तैकं जंबूद्वीपं वरानने //
text_mt: who, as the king's son, equals Bṛhaspati and Śukra in statecraft. / Jambūdvīpa was enjoyed in its entirety alone by his father, O fair-faced one;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadena dvīpāni saṃjitānyaparāṇyapi /
pitrostu vrīḍayā yena na jñātaṃ pramadāsukham //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदेन द्वीपानि संजितान्यपराण्यपि /
पित्रोस्तु व्रीडया येन न ज्ञातं प्रमदासुखम् //
text_mt: and the other continents too were completely conquered by Dharmāṅgada. / Yet, out of bashfulness before his parents, he has not known the pleasure of women.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ prāptāḥ parityaktā yena bhāryāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
yo na vākyādvicalate sahaiva hi piturgṛhe //
meaning:
स्वयं प्राप्ताः परित्यक्ता येन भार्याः सहस्रशः /
यो न वाक्याद्विचलते सहैव हि पितुर्गृहे //
text_mt: Thousands of wives who came of their own accord were abandoned by him; / he never deviates from his father's command while staying in his house.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vai trīṇi subhage mātṝṇāṃ cāruhāsini /
śatāni kanakābhāse tvaviśeṣeṇa paśyati //
meaning:
यस्य वै त्रीणि सुभगे मातॄणां चारुहासिनि /
शतानि कनकाभासे त्वविशेषेण पश्यति //
text_mt: He looks upon the three hundred mothers that he has, / O fortunate one of lovely smile and golden luster, without any distinction.

sanskrit_iast:
casya dharmapradhānasya putraratnāñcitasya ca /
samīpaṃ gaccha cārvaṅgi mandare parvatottame //
meaning:
चस्य धर्मप्रधानस्य पुत्ररत्नाञ्चितस्य च /
समीपं गच्छ चार्वङ्गि मन्दरे पर्वतोत्तमे //
text_mt: Go to the vicinity of that king who is devoted to dharma / and adorned with a jewel of a son, O lovely-limbed one, on the excellent mountain Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vatsyati rājā vai turageṇātivāhitaḥ /
tava gītena cārvaṅgi mohito 'śvaṃ vihāya cakata //
meaning:
तत्र वत्स्यति राजा वै तुरगेणातिवाहितः /
तव गीतेन चार्वङ्गि मोहितो ऽश्वं विहाय चकत //
text_mt: The king will dwell there, carried far away by his horse; / bewildered by your singing, O lovely-limbed one, and leaving his horse,

sanskrit_iast:
adhiruhya gireḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ sa saṃgaṃ yāsyati tvayā /
tatra devi tvayāvācyaṃ militvā bhūbhujā tviha //
meaning:
अधिरुह्य गिरेः पृष्ठं स संगं यास्यति त्वया /
तत्र देवि त्वयावाच्यं मिलित्वा भूभुजा त्विह //
text_mt: having ascended the ridge of the mountain, he will seek union with you. / There, O goddess, having met with the king, you must say to him here:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi tava rājanna saṃśayaḥ /
yadbravīmi hyahaṃ nātha tatkāryaṃ hi tvayā dhruvam //
meaning:
अहं भार्या भविष्यामि तव राजन्न संशयः /
यद्ब्रवीमि ह्यहं नाथ तत्कार्यं हि त्वया ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: 'I will become your wife, O king, there is no doubt; / but whatever I say, O lord, must certainly be done by you.'

sanskrit_iast:
mohitastava rūpeṇa tathaiva pratipadyate /
yatastaṃ śapathairdhṛtvā dakṣiṇena kareṇa vai //
meaning:
मोहितस्तव रूपेण तथैव प्रतिपद्यते /
यतस्तं शपथैर्धृत्वा दक्षिणेन करेण वै //
text_mt: Bewitched by your beauty, he will agree to it just so; / wherefore, taking hold of him with oaths by his right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vācyaḥ katipayaiḥ subhru dinairapagataistviti /
surate tava cārvaṅgi yadā mugdho hi lakṣyate //
meaning:
वाच्यः कतिपयैः सुभ्रु दिनैरपगतैस्त्विति /
सुरते तव चार्वङ्गि यदा मुग्धो हि लक्ष्यते //
text_mt: he is to be addressed, O fair-browed one, after a few days have passed: / when he is seen to be completely infatuated with your sexual pleasure, O lovely-limbed one,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prahasya rājño vai smāraṇīyaṃ purā vacaḥ /
yastvayā śapatho rājankṛto madvākyapālane //
meaning:
तदा प्रहस्य राज्ञो वै स्मारणीयं पुरा वचः /
यस्त्वया शपथो राजन्कृतो मद्वाक्यपालने //
text_mt: then, smiling, you must remind the king of his former words: / 'The oath that was made by you, O king, to carry out my command,

sanskrit_iast:
tatpālayamahīpāla manye 'haṃ samayastviti /
evamukte tvayā mugdho rājā vai satyagauravāt //
meaning:
तत्पालयमहीपाल मन्ये ऽहं समयस्त्विति /
एवमुक्ते त्वया मुग्धो राजा वै सत्यगौरवात् //
text_mt: fulfill that, O ruler of the earth, for I consider this to be the proper time.' / When you have spoken thus, the king, infatuated, will say out of regard for the truth:

sanskrit_iast:
pālayāmi na saṃdeho brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham /
evamukte tu vacane tvayā vācyo varānane //
meaning:
पालयामि न संदेहो ब्रूहि किं ते ददाम्यहम् /
एवमुक्ते तु वचने त्वया वाच्यो वरानने //
text_mt: 'I shall fulfill it, of this there is no doubt; tell me, what shall I give you?' / And when these words have been spoken, you must say to him, O fair-faced one:

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgado mahīpālo dharmāṅgadapitā śubhe /
nopavāsastvayā kāryo jātu vai harivāsare //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गदो महीपालो धर्माङ्गदपिता शुभे /
नोपवासस्त्वया कार्यो जातु वै हरिवासरे //
text_mt: To King Rukmāṅgada, the father of Dharmāṅgada, O auspicious one: / 'No fast must ever be observed by you on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
suratasraṃ sakārī me hyupavāso bhavetpriya /
sumugdhāṃ yauvanopetāṃ svabhāryāṃ yo na sevate //
meaning:
सुरतस्रं सकारी मे ह्युपवासो भवेत्प्रिय /
सुमुग्धां यौवनोपेतां स्वभार्यां यो न सेवते //
text_mt: Fasting would cause an interruption to my sexual pleasure, my dear! / Whoever does not attend upon his own wedded wife, deeply infatuated and endowed with youth,

sanskrit_iast:
parvāpekṣī durācāraḥ sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam /
trirātramapaviddhāhaṃ tvayā bhūpa upoṣaṇāt //
meaning:
पर्वापेक्षी दुराचारः स याति नरकं ध्रुवम् /
त्रिरात्रमपविद्धाहं त्वया भूप उपोषणात् //
text_mt: looking merely to sacred days, that wicked-mannered man surely goes to hell. / I have been cast aside for three nights by you, O king, on account of fasting;

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ nimeṣamapyekaṃ sthātuṃ śaktā tvayā vinā /
śrāddhakāle tu saṃprāpte upāviṣṭairdvijaiḥ kila //
meaning:
नाहं निमेषमप्येकं स्थातुं शक्ता त्वया विना /
श्राद्धकाले तु संप्राप्ते उपाविष्टैर्द्विजैः किल //
text_mt: I am unable to remain even for a single moment without you! / Even when the time for a śrāddha has arrived and the twice-born are seated, it is said,

sanskrit_iast:
yācate saṃgamaṃ bhāryā yadi bhogyā tadaiva sā /
evaṃ saṃbodhyamāno 'pi yadā rājā vacastava //
meaning:
याचते संगमं भार्या यदि भोग्या तदैव सा /
एवं संबोध्यमानो ऽपि यदा राजा वचस्तव //
text_mt: if a wife begs for sexual union, she must be enjoyed right then!' / When the king, even though being addressed in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
na kariṣyati cārvaṅgi tadā vācyaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ /
yadi na tyajase rājannupavāsaṃ harerdine //
meaning:
न करिष्यति चार्वङ्गि तदा वाच्यं परं वचः /
यदि न त्यजसे राजन्नुपवासं हरेर्दिने //
text_mt: does not obey your words, O lovely-limbed one, then another statement must be made: / 'If you do not abandon fasting on the day of Hari, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
svahastena śiraścchitvā svaputrasya varāsinā /
dharmāṅgadasya rājendra mamotsaṃgekṣipa svayam //
meaning:
स्वहस्तेन शिरश्च्छित्वा स्वपुत्रस्य वरासिना /
धर्माङ्गदस्य राजेन्द्र ममोत्संगेक्षिप स्वयम् //
text_mt: then cutting off the head of your own son Dharmāṅgada with an excellent sword / with your own hand, O best of kings, throw it into my lap yourself!

sanskrit_iast:
yadyetanmatpriyaṃ tvaṃ hi na karoṣi mahīpate /
dharmakṣīṇo bhavān gantā narake nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यद्येतन्मत्प्रियं त्वं हि न करोषि महीपते /
धर्मक्षीणो भवान् गन्ता नरके नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: If you do not do this pleasing act for me, O lord of the earth, / then, bereft of dharma, you will go to hell; of this there is no doubt!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ varāṅgane na hiṃsyate prāṇasamaṃ ca putram /
saṃgṛhya vākyaṃ vasudhāmarāṇāṃ sambhokṣyate mādhavavāsaṃre 'sau //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा त्वदीयं वचनं वराङ्गने न हिंस्यते प्राणसमं च पुत्रम् /
संगृह्य वाक्यं वसुधामराणां सम्भोक्ष्यते माधववासंरे ऽसौ //
text_mt: Hearing your words, O beautiful woman, he will not slay his son who is dear as life; / accepting the counsel of the brāhmaṇas, he will dine on the day of Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jano yāsyati pūrvavacca yamāntikaṃ kiṅkarapāśabaddhaḥ /
lipipramāṇaṃ narakādhivāsī bhaviṣyate sādhu kṛtaṃ tvayā hi //
meaning:
ततो जनो यास्यति पूर्ववच्च यमान्तिकं किङ्करपाशबद्धः /
लिपिप्रमाणं नरकाधिवासी भविष्यते साधु कृतं त्वया हि //
text_mt: Then the people will go as before to Yama’s presence, bound by the cords of his servants; / according to what is written, he shall dwell in hell; well done indeed by you!

sanskrit_iast:
atha yadi nihanti tanayaṃ rājā satyena saṃyutaḥ śrīmān /
niḥśeṣāmarapūjyaṃ vrajati padaṃ padmanābhasya //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīṃ prati brahmavākyaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अथ यदि निहन्ति तनयं राजा सत्येन संयुतः श्रीमान् /
निःशेषामरपूज्यं व्रजति पदं पद्मनाभस्य //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीं प्रति ब्रह्मवाक्यं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Or, if the glorious king, adhering to the truth, slays his son, / he will proceed to the abode of Padmanābha, worshipped by all the immortals.

Thus ends the seventh chapter, named ‘Brahmā’s Speech to Mohinī’, in the Uttarabhāga of the illustrious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sautiruvāca
sāsa śrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ nārī kamalalocanā /
uvāca nāma medehi yena gacchāmi mandiram //
meaning:
सौतिरुवाच
सास श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं नारी कमललोचना /
उवाच नाम मेदेहि येन गच्छामि मन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Sauti said: / Hearing the words of Brahmā, that lotus-eyed woman / said: ‘Give me a name, so that I may go to my abode.’

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā nāma prakartavyamapatyānāṃ jagatpate /
nāma pāpaharaṃ proktaṃ tatkuruṣva kuśadhvaja //
meaning:
पित्रा नाम प्रकर्तव्यमपत्यानां जगत्पते /
नाम पापहरं प्रोक्तं तत्कुरुष्व कुशध्वज //
text_mt: ‘A father must bestow a name upon his offspring, O Lord of the Universe; / a name is declared to destroy sins; do that, O Kuśadhvaja!’

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
yasmādidaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tvayā suṃdari mohitam /
mohinī nāma te devi saguṇaṃ hi bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
यस्मादिदं जगत्सर्वं त्वया सुंदरि मोहितम् /
मोहिनी नाम ते देवि सगुणं हि भविष्यति //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / ‘Since all this world has been enchanted by you, O beautiful woman, / your name shall be Mohinī, endowed with virtues, O goddess.’

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvasthāgataḥ samyag darśanātte bhaviṣyati /
yadi prāpnoti vai subhru tvatsaṃparkaṃ sukhāvaham //
meaning:
दशावस्थागतः सम्यग् दर्शनात्ते भविष्यति /
यदि प्राप्नोति वै सुभ्रु त्वत्संपर्कं सुखावहम् //
text_mt: ‘He will fall into the ten states of love from merely gazing upon you, / if, O fair-browed one, he attains your joy-bringing union.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktā varārohā praṇamya kamalāsanam /
vīkṣyamāṇāmarairmārge pratasthe mandarācalam //
meaning:
एवमुक्ता वरारोहा प्रणम्य कमलासनम् /
वीक्ष्यमाणामरैर्मार्गे प्रतस्थे मन्दराचलम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the shapely woman bowed to the lotus-seated [Brahmā], / and, watched by the immortals along the path, set out for Mount Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyena muhūrtena saṃprāptā girimastakam /
yasya saṃveṣṭane nāgo vāsukirnahi pūryate //
meaning:
तृतीयेन मुहूर्तेन संप्राप्ता गिरिमस्तकम् /
यस्य संवेष्टने नागो वासुकिर्नहि पूर्यते //
text_mt: Within three muhūrtas she reached the crest of the mountain, / to encircle which the serpent Vāsuki did not suffice,

sanskrit_iast:
yo dhṛto hariṇā pūrvaṃ mathito devadānavaiḥ /
ṣaḍlakṣayojanaḥ siṃdhuryasyāsau gahvaro bhavet //
meaning:
यो धृतो हरिणा पूर्वं मथितो देवदानवैः /
षड्लक्षयोजनः सिंधुर्यस्यासौ गह्वरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Which was upheld by Hari of old and churned by the gods and Dānavas, / and of which the ocean, six hundred thousand yojanas [wide], was a hollow cavern,

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmadehena saṃpṛkto yo na bhinno girirmahān /
patatā yena rājendra siṃdhorguhyaṃ pradarśitam //
meaning:
कूर्मदेहेन संपृक्तो यो न भिन्नो गिरिर्महान् /
पतता येन राजेन्द्र सिंधोर्गुह्यं प्रदर्शितम् //
text_mt: That great mountain which, touching the body of Kūrma, was not shattered, / and which, as it plunged, O best of kings, laid bare the depths of the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
gataṃ brahmāṇḍamārgeṇa payo yasmādgirerdvijāḥ /
kūrmāsthigharṣatā yena pāvako janito mahān //
meaning:
गतं ब्रह्माण्डमार्गेण पयो यस्माद्गिरेर्द्विजाः /
कूर्मास्थिघर्षता येन पावको जनितो महान् //
text_mt: From which mountain, O twice-born ones, the milk went by the path of the cosmic egg, / and which, by rubbing against Kūrma’s shell, generated a great fire,

sanskrit_iast:
yasminsa vasate devaḥ saha bhūtairdigaṃbaraḥ /
na devairdānavairvāpi dṛṣṭo yo hi dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिन्स वसते देवः सह भूतैर्दिगंबरः /
न देवैर्दानवैर्वापि दृष्टो यो हि द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Upon which that naked god dwells together with the bhūtas, / and which is indeed not seen by the gods or Dānavas, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrākhye kāle mahati gacchati /
keyūragharṣaṇe yena kṛtaṃ devasya cakriṇaḥ //
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राख्ये काले महति गच्छति /
केयूरघर्षणे येन कृतं देवस्य चक्रिणः //
text_mt: In the course of a vast span of time named ten thousand years, / by which rubbing was made against the armlet of the discus-bearing god,

sanskrit_iast: ratnānāṃ mandiraṃ hyeṣa bahudhātusamanvitaḥ //
meaning: रत्नानां मन्दिरं ह्येष बहुधातुसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Which is indeed an abode of jewels, endowed with many minerals,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāvihāro 'pi divaukasāṃ yastapasvinā yastapaso 'pi hetuḥ /
surāṅganānāṃ rativarddhano yo ratnauṣadhīnāṃ prabhavo girirmahān //
meaning:
क्रीडाविहारो ऽपि दिवौकसां यस्तपस्विना यस्तपसो ऽपि हेतुः /
सुराङ्गनानां रतिवर्द्धनो यो रत्नौषधीनां प्रभवो गिरिर्महान् //
text_mt: Which is the pleasure-park of the gods, the cause of penance for ascetics, / which increases the passion of divine damsels, that great mountain, the source of gems and medicinal herbs,

sanskrit_iast:
daśaikasāhasramitaśca mūle tatsaṃkhyayā vistaratāṃ gato 'sau /
dairghyeṇa tāvanti hi yojanāni trailokyayaṣṭīva samucchrito 'sau //
meaning:
दशैकसाहस्रमितश्च मूले तत्संख्यया विस्तरतां गतो ऽसौ /
दैर्घ्येण तावन्ति हि योजनानि त्रैलोक्ययष्टीव समुच्छ्रितो ऽसौ //
text_mt: Measuring eleven thousand [yojanas] at its base, and expanding to that same measure, / being just as many yojanas in height, raised aloft like the staff of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
sakāñcanai ratnamayaiśca śṛṅgaiḥ prakāśayanbhūmitalaṃ viyacca /
yasmingataḥ kaśya panandano vai viraśmitāmeti vinaṣṭatejāḥ //
meaning:
सकाञ्चनै रत्नमयैश्च शृङ्गैः प्रकाशयन्भूमितलं वियच्च /
यस्मिन्गतः कश्य पनन्दनो वै विरश्मितामेति विनष्टतेजाः //
text_mt: Illuminating the surface of the earth and the sky with its golden, jewel-filled peaks, / reaching which the son of Kaśyapa, indeed, is deprived of his rays, his brilliance destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanākārabhūtāṅgaṃ saprāptā kāñcanaprabhā /
sūryatejonihantāraṃ mandaraṃ tejasā svayam //
meaning:
काञ्चनाकारभूताङ्गं सप्राप्ता काञ्चनप्रभा /
सूर्यतेजोनिहन्तारं मन्दरं तेजसा स्वयम् //
text_mt: Possessing a golden luster, she reached Mount Mandara whose limbs were formed of gold, / which itself suppressed the sun's splendor with its own radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvatī nṛpakāmārthamupaviṣṭā śilātale /
nīlakāntimaye divye saptayojanaviratṛte //
meaning:
कुर्वती नृपकामार्थमुपविष्टा शिलातले /
नीलकान्तिमये दिव्ये सप्तयोजनविरतृते //
text_mt: Acting for the sake of the king’s desire, she sat upon a stone slab, / divine, full of sapphire radiance, and extending for seven yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ śilāyāṃ rājendra ligaṃ tiṣṭhati kauliśam /
daśahasta pramāṇaṃ hi vistarādūrddhvasaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
तस्यां शिलायां राजेन्द्र लिगं तिष्ठति कौलिशम् /
दशहस्त प्रमाणं हि विस्तरादूर्द्ध्वसंख्यया //
text_mt: On that stone slab, O best of kings, stands a liṅga of thunderbolt stone, / ten cubits in extent and in height.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣaliṅgeti vikhyātaṃ prāsādābhrasamaṃ param /
tasminbālā dvijaśreṣṭhāścakre saṃgītamuttamam //
meaning:
वृषलिङ्गेति विख्यातं प्रासादाभ्रसमं परम् /
तस्मिन्बाला द्विजश्रेष्ठाश्चक्रे संगीतमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Known as Vṛṣaliṅga, supreme, resembling a cloud like a mansion; / beside it, O best of the twice-born, the maiden performed excellent music,

sanskrit_iast:
tantrītā lasamāyuktaṃ klamahānikaraṃ param /
samīpavartinī tasya bhūtvā liṅgasya bhāminī //
meaning:
तन्त्रीता लसमायुक्तं क्लमहानिकरं परम् /
समीपवर्तिनी तस्य भूत्वा लिङ्गस्य भामिनी //
text_mt: Accompanied by the rhythm of stringed instruments, supremely dispel-ling fatigue, / having approached close to that liṅga, the lovely woman [sang],

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchanātālasahitaṃ gāndhāradhvanisaṃyutam /
tasminpravṛtte rājendragīte manmathavarddhane //
meaning:
मूर्च्छनातालसहितं गान्धारध्वनिसंयुतम् /
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते राजेन्द्रगीते मन्मथवर्द्धने //
text_mt: Endowed with melodic modulation and rhythm, combined with the gāndhāra note; / while that song increasing love proceeded, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva sthāvarāṇāṃ hi spṛhā tasminmunīśvarāḥ /
na ca daivaṃ na cādaivaṃ gītaṃ tādṛgbabhūva ha //
meaning:
बभूव स्थावराणां हि स्पृहा तस्मिन्मुनीश्वराः /
न च दैवं न चादैवं गीतं तादृग्बभूव ह //
text_mt: Even immovable beings felt desire for it, O chiefs of sages; / there was never such a song, whether divine or non-divine,

sanskrit_iast: mohinīmukhanirgītaṃ gītaṃ satvavimohanam //
meaning: मोहिनीमुखनिर्गीतं गीतं सत्वविमोहनम् //
text_mt: As the song sung from the mouth of Mohinī, enchanting all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaiva gītaṃ hi digambarastu tenaiva rūpeṇa varāṅganāyāḥ /
kāmāturo bhoktumanāścacāla tāṃ mohinīṃ pārvatidṛṣṭilajjaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite mandakharṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
श्रुत्वैव गीतं हि दिगम्बरस्तु तेनैव रूपेण वराङ्गनायाः /
कामातुरो भोक्तुमनाश्चचाल तां मोहिनीं पार्वतिदृष्टिलज्जः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते मन्दखर्णनं नामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Hearing that song of the lovely woman, the sky-clad [Śiva], / struck with desire and wishing to enjoy that Mohinī in that very form, approached, feeling bashful under the gaze of Pārvatī.

Thus ends the eighth chapter, named ‘Description of Mandara’ in the Story of Mohinī, in the Uttarabhāga of the illustrious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sautiruvāca
rukmāṅgadastu rājendro bhuktvā bhogāṃstumānuṣān /
saṃpūjya bahuśo devaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ haram //
meaning:
सौतिरुवाच
रुक्माङ्गदस्तु राजेन्द्रो भुक्त्वा भोगांस्तुमानुषान् /
संपूज्य बहुशो देवं पीतांबरधरं हरम् //
text_mt: Sauti said: / But King Rukmāṅgada, having enjoyed human pleasures / and having repeatedly worshipped the god Hara, the wearer of yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā mūrdhni padaṃ viprāḥ śatrīṇāṃ raṇaśālinām /
kṛtvā śūnyaṃ yamapathaṃ jitvā vaivasvataṃ yamam //
meaning:
दत्वा मूर्ध्नि पदं विप्राः शत्रीणां रणशालिनाम् /
कृत्वा शून्यं यमपथं जित्वा वैवस्वतं यमम् //
text_mt: Having placed his foot on the heads of his enemies proud of battle, O brāhmaṇas, / having emptied the path of Yama, having conquered Yama the son of Vivasvat,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭhasya tu panthānaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ mānavaiḥ kṛtam /
āhūya tanayaṃ kāle dharmāṅgadamabhāṣata //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठस्य तु पन्थानं संपूर्णं मानवैः कृतम् /
आहूय तनयं काले धर्माङ्गदमभाषत //
text_mt: The path to Vaikuṇṭha was filled by him with human beings; / summoning his son Dharmāṅgada in due time, he said:

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃ vasumatīṃ putra vasupūrṇāṃ samantataḥ /
paripālaya vīryeṇa svadharme kṛtaniścayaḥ //
meaning:
एतां वसुमतीं पुत्र वसुपूर्णां समन्ततः /
परिपालय वीर्येण स्वधर्मे कृतनिश्चयः //
text_mt: ‘Protect this earth, my son, filled with wealth on every side, / by your prowess, determined in your own duty.’

sanskrit_iast:
putra samarthe jāte yo rājyaṃ na pratipādayet /
tasya dharmastathā kīrtirvinasyati na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्र समर्थे जाते यो राज्यं न प्रतिपादयेत् /
तस्य धर्मस्तथा कीर्तिर्विनस्यति न संशयः //
text_mt: ‘When a capable son is born, he who does not hand over the kingdom / has his virtue and his fame destroyed, without a doubt.’

sanskrit_iast:
samarthena ca putreṇa yo na yāti pitā sukham /
avaśya pātakī so 'pi vijñeyo bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
समर्थेन च पुत्रेण यो न याति पिता सुखम् /
अवश्य पातकी सो ऽपि विज्ञेयो भुवनत्रये //
text_mt: ‘And the father who does not attain happiness through a capable son / is surely to be known as a sinner in the three worlds.’

sanskrit_iast:
piturbhārakṣamaḥ putro bhāraṃ nodvahate tu yaḥ /
māturuccāravajjāto dvijihvo viṣavarjitaḥ //
meaning:
पितुर्भारक्षमः पुत्रो भारं नोद्वहते तु यः /
मातुरुच्चारवज्जातो द्विजिह्वो विषवर्जितः //
text_mt: ‘A son who is capable of bearing the father's burden, but does not carry that burden, / is born like the excrement of his mother, a double-tongued snake devoid of poison.’

sanskrit_iast:
sa putro yo 'dhikakhyātaḥ piturbhavati bhūtale /
prakāśayati sarvatra svakarairiva bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
स पुत्रो यो ऽधिकख्यातः पितुर्भवति भूतले /
प्रकाशयति सर्वत्र स्वकरैरिव भास्करः //
text_mt: ‘He is a true son who becomes more renowned on earth than his father; / he illuminates everywhere, as does the sun with its rays.’

sanskrit_iast:
putrāpanayajairduḥkhai rātrau jāgartiṃ yatpitā /
sa putro narakaṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
पुत्रापनयजैर्दुःखै रात्रौ जागर्तिं यत्पिता /
स पुत्रो नरकं याति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: ‘A father who stays awake at night through sorrows born of his son’s misdeeds— / that son goes to hell until the dissolution of all beings.’

sanskrit_iast:
piturvacanamādṛtya sarvaṃ yaḥ kurute gṛhe /
sa yāti deva sāyujyaṃ stūyamāno divi sthitaiḥ //
meaning:
पितुर्वचनमादृत्य सर्वं यः कुरुते गृहे /
स याति देव सायुज्यं स्तूयमानो दिवि स्थितैः //
text_mt: ‘He who, respecting his father’s word, carries out everything in the house, / attains union with the gods, praised by those dwelling in heaven.’

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ prajākṛte putra āsaktaḥ karmabhiḥ kṣitau /
na bhuktaṃ naiva suptaṃ tu svecchayā pālane sthitaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽहं प्रजाकृते पुत्र आसक्तः कर्मभिः क्षितौ /
न भुक्तं नैव सुप्तं तु स्वेच्छया पालने स्थितः //
text_mt: ‘Such as I am, O son, intent on works on earth for the sake of my subjects, / I have neither eaten nor slept at my own will, devoted to their protection.’

sanskrit_iast:
asamarthe tvayi suta na prāptaṃ hi mayā sukham /
viṣṇuvāsarabhoktṝṇāṃ nigrahe kṛtabuddhinā //
meaning:
असमर्थे त्वयि सुत न प्राप्तं हि मया सुखम् /
विष्णुवासरभोक्तॄणां निग्रहे कृतबुद्धिना //
text_mt: ‘While you were not capable, my son, no happiness was obtained by me, / whose mind was resolved upon punishing those who eat on the day of Viṣṇu.’

sanskrit_iast:
kecicchaive sthitā mārge saure kecidvyavasthitāḥ /
viriñcimārgagāścānye pārvatyāśca sthitāḥ pare //
meaning:
केचिच्छैवे स्थिता मार्गे सौरे केचिद्व्यवस्थिताः /
विरिञ्चिमार्गगाश्चान्ये पार्वत्याश्च स्थिताः परे //
text_mt: ‘Some follow the path of Śiva, some are established in that of Sūrya, / others follow the path of Viriñci, and yet others adhere to Pārvatī.’

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ ca prātarāsīnā agnihotre vyavasthitāḥ /
bālo yuvā vā vṛddho vā gurviṇī vā kumārikā //
meaning:
सायं च प्रातरासीना अग्निहोत्रे व्यवस्थिताः /
बालो युवा वा वृद्धो वा गुर्विणी वा कुमारिका //
text_mt: ‘Seated in the evening and morning, engaged in the fire-sacrifice, / whether a child, a youth, an old man, a pregnant woman, or an unmarried girl,’

sanskrit_iast:
sarogo vikalo vāpi na śaknoti hyupoṣitum /
ityevaṃ jalpitaṃ yaistu tānnirasya samantataḥ //
meaning:
सरोगो विकलो वापि न शक्नोति ह्युपोषितुम् /
इत्येवं जल्पितं यैस्तु तान्निरस्य समन्ततः //
text_mt: ‘Whether diseased or crippled, [saying,] “One is indeed unable to fast”— / entirely repelling those by whom such things were uttered,’

sanskrit_iast:
vacobhistu purāṇoktairvāsarairbahubhistvaham /
saṃbodhayitvā bahuśaḥ prajānāṃ sukhahetave //
meaning:
वचोभिस्तु पुराणोक्तैर्वासरैर्बहुभिस्त्वहम् /
संबोधयित्वा बहुशः प्रजानां सुखहेतवे //
text_mt: ‘With words stated in the Purāṇas, over many days indeed, / having instructed them repeatedly for the sake of the happiness of the subjects,’

sanskrit_iast:
nigṛhya tānharidine nirāhārānkaromi ca /
śāstradṛṣṭyā tu viduṣo mūrkhāndaṇḍanapūrvakam //
meaning:
निगृह्य तान्हरिदिने निराहारान्करोमि च /
शास्त्रदृष्ट्या तु विदुषो मूर्खान्दण्डनपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: ‘Restraining them, I make them go without food on the day of Hari— / the learned through the perspective of scripture, and the fools by means of punishment.’

sanskrit_iast:
śāsayitvā kṛtāḥ sarve nirāhārā harerdine /
tena me na sukhaṃ kiñcidavalīḍhaṃ dharātale //
meaning:
शासयित्वा कृताः सर्वे निराहारा हरेर्दिने /
तेन मे न सुखं किञ्चिदवलीढं धरातले //
text_mt: "All were made to fast on Hari's day through chastisement; / because of that, no pleasure on the earth's surface has been enjoyed by me.

sanskrit_iast:
kaccinna duḥkhena janānyojayetkila putraka /
svebhyo vāpi parebhyo vā yā rakṣecca prajā nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
कच्चिन्न दुःखेन जनान्योजयेत्किल पुत्रक /
स्वेभ्यो वापि परेभ्यो वा या रक्षेच्च प्रजा नृपः //
text_mt: O dear son, could it be that a king should afflict the people with suffering? / The king who protects the subjects from his own people or from enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmī hyakṣayā lokāḥ purāṇeṣu prakīrtitāḥ /
so 'haṃ prajākṛte saumya saṃsthito nātmanaḥ kvacit //
meaning:
तस्यामी ह्यक्षया लोकाः पुराणेषु प्रकीर्तिताः /
सो ऽहं प्रजाकृते सौम्य संस्थितो नात्मनः क्वचित् //
text_mt: imperishable worlds for him are celebrated in the Purāṇas; / such as I am, O gentle one, I have stood for the sake of the people, never for myself.

sanskrit_iast:
saukhyamicchāmyahaṃ bhoktuṃ mṛgayādisamudbhavam /
na pānadyūtajaṃ putra kāmaye 'haṃ kadācana //
meaning:
सौख्यमिच्छाम्यहं भोक्तुं मृगयादिसमुद्भवम् /
न पानद्यूतजं पुत्र कामये ऽहं कदाचन //
text_mt: I wish to enjoy the pleasure arising from hunting and the like; / I never desire, O son, that which arises from drinking and gambling.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣu sakto 'cirātputra vināśaṃ yāti pārthivaḥ /
tvatprasādādahaṃ putra mṛgayāvyājato 'dhunā //
meaning:
एषु सक्तो ऽचिरात्पुत्र विनाशं याति पार्थिवः /
त्वत्प्रसादादहं पुत्र मृगयाव्याजतो ऽधुना //
text_mt: Attached to these, O son, a monarch soon goes to destruction; / by your grace, O son, under the pretext of hunting,

sanskrit_iast:
girīnvanāni saritaḥ sarāṃsi vividhāni ca /
bhoktukāmaḥ priyānkāmāṃstvayi bhāraṃ niveśya ca //
meaning:
गिरीन्वनानि सरितः सरांसि विविधानि च /
भोक्तुकामः प्रियान्कामांस्त्वयि भारं निवेश्य च //
text_mt: I wish to enjoy delightful pleasures among mountains, forests, rivers, and various lakes, / having placed the burden upon you.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatsthitaṃ hṛdaye mama /
kṛte tava mahākīrtirakṛte narakasthitiḥ //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्स्थितं हृदये मम /
कृते तव महाकीर्तिरकृते नरकस्थितिः //
text_mt: All this which rested in my heart has been told; / if it is done, great fame is yours; if undone, residence in hell."

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgada uvāca
sarvametatkariṣyāmi bhuṅkṣva bhogānmano 'nugān /
gurvīṃ rājyadhuraṃ tāta tvadīyāmuddharāmyaham //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गद उवाच
सर्वमेतत्करिष्यामि भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्मनो ऽनुगान् /
गुर्वीं राज्यधुरं तात त्वदीयामुद्धराम्यहम् //
text_mt: Dharmāṅgada said: / "I shall do all this; enjoy pleasures that follow your heart's desire! / O father, I shall lift up your heavy burden of sovereignty.

sanskrit_iast:
nahi me 'nyaḥ smṛto dharmastvadvākyakaraṇaṃ vinā /
piturvākyamakurvāṇaḥ kurvandharmānadho vrajet //
meaning:
नहि मे ऽन्यः स्मृतो धर्मस्त्वद्वाक्यकरणं विना /
पितुर्वाक्यमकुर्वाणः कुर्वन्धर्मानधो व्रजेत् //
text_mt: For no other duty is remembered for me except carrying out your word; / not doing a father's word, though performing other duties, one goes downward.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātkariṣye vacanaṃ tvadīyaṃ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ /
evamukte tu vacane rājā hṛṣṭo babhūva ha //
meaning:
तस्मात्करिष्ये वचनं त्वदीयं प्राञ्जलिः स्थितः /
एवमुक्ते तु वचने राजा हृष्टो बभूव ह //
text_mt: Therefore, standing with folded palms, I shall execute your command." / When these words were spoken, the king became glad.

sanskrit_iast:
gantukāmo mṛgānbhūyolabdhvā jñātvā vanaṃ tataḥ /
dharmāṅgado 'pi dṛṣṭātmā prajā āhūya cābravīt //
meaning:
गन्तुकामो मृगान्भूयोलब्ध्वा ज्ञात्वा वनं ततः /
धर्माङ्गदो ऽपि दृष्टात्मा प्रजा आहूय चाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Wishing to go, having learned of the forest and found deer there, / Dharmāṅgada also, with a resolved soul, summoned the subjects and said:

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā niyukto bhavatāṃ pālanāya hitāya ca /
piturvākyaṃ mayā kāryaṃ sarvathā dharmamicchatā //
meaning:
पित्रा नियुक्तो भवतां पालनाय हिताय च /
पितुर्वाक्यं मया कार्यं सर्वथा धर्ममिच्छता //
text_mt: "I have been appointed by my father for your protection and welfare; / the word of my father must be done by me by all means, desiring righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyo hi dharmaḥ putrasya piturvākyaṃ vinā prajāḥ /
mayi daṇḍadhare śāstā na yamo bhavati kvacit //
meaning:
नान्यो हि धर्मः पुत्रस्य पितुर्वाक्यं विना प्रजाः /
मयि दण्डधरे शास्ता न यमो भवति क्वचित् //
text_mt: For there is no other duty for a son except a father's word, O subjects; / while I bear the rod of punishment, Yama is nowhere the punisher.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā tu yuṣmābhiḥ smartavyo garuḍadhvajaḥ /
brahmārpaṇaprayogeṇa yajanīyo janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु युष्माभिः स्मर्तव्यो गरुडध्वजः /
ब्रह्मार्पणप्रयोगेण यजनीयो जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Knowing this, the one with Garuḍa on his banner should be remembered by you; / Janārdana is to be worshipped through the practice of offering to Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
mamatvaṃ hi parityajya svajātivihitena ca /
yena vo hyakṣayā lokā bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ममत्वं हि परित्यज्य स्वजातिविहितेन च /
येन वो ह्यक्षया लोका भवेयुर्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: abandoning possessiveness, according to what is ordained for one's own caste, / by which there shall be imperishable worlds for you, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmārgādhiko hyeṣa bhavatāṃ darśitaḥ prajāḥ /
brahmārpaṇakriyāyuktā bhavantu jñānakovidāḥ //
meaning:
पितृमार्गाधिको ह्येष भवतां दर्शितः प्रजाः /
ब्रह्मार्पणक्रियायुक्ता भवन्तु ज्ञानकोविदाः //
text_mt: This path, superior to that of the ancestors, has been shown to you, O subjects; / endowed with the act of offering to Brahman, become skilled in knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
na bhoktavyaṃ haridine paitro mārgastu śāśvataḥ /
viśeṣo hi mayākhyāto bhavatāṃ brahmasaṃsthitiḥ //
meaning:
न भोक्तव्यं हरिदिने पैत्रो मार्गस्तु शाश्वतः /
विशेषो हि मयाख्यातो भवतां ब्रह्मसंस्थितिः //
text_mt: One must not eat on the day of Hari; this is the eternal ancestral path; / the distinction has been told by me for your establishment in Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
prayoktavyā ca tattvajñaiḥ punarāvṛtti durlabhā /
yadupoṣyaṃ haridinaṃ tadavaśyamiti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
प्रयोक्तव्या च तत्त्वज्ञैः पुनरावृत्ति दुर्लभा /
यदुपोष्यं हरिदिनं तदवश्यमिति स्थितिः //
text_mt: And it is to be practiced by knowers of reality, so that rebirth is rare; / that Hari's day must be fasted on—that is the fixed rule."

sanskrit_iast:
anunīya prajāḥ sarvāḥ samāśvātyata punaḥ punaḥ /
na divā na ca śarvaryāṃ śete dharmāṃ gadaḥ sadā //
meaning:
अनुनीय प्रजाः सर्वाः समाश्वात्यत पुनः पुनः /
न दिवा न च शर्वर्यां शेते धर्मां गदः सदा //
text_mt: Conciliating all the subjects and consoling them again and again, / Dharmāṅgada never slept, neither by day nor by night.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra bhramate śauryātkurvanniṣkaṇṭakāṃ kṣitim /
paṭaho raṭate nityaṃ mṛgāriripumastake //
meaning:
सर्वत्र भ्रमते शौर्यात्कुर्वन्निष्कण्टकां क्षितिम् /
पटहो रटते नित्यं मृगारिरिपुमस्तके //
text_mt: He roamed everywhere with valor, making the earth free of thorns; / the drum continually sounded upon the heads of lion-like enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
abhuktvā dvādaśīṃ lokā mamatvena vivarjitāḥ /
trividheṣu ca kāryeṣu deveśaścintyatāṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
अभुक्त्वा द्वादशीं लोका ममत्वेन विवर्जिताः /
त्रिविधेषु च कार्येषु देवेशश्चिन्त्यतां हरिः //
text_mt: Not eating on Dvādaśī, freed from possessiveness, / in the three kinds of deeds, let Hari, the Lord of gods, be contemplated by the people.

sanskrit_iast:
havyakavyavaho devaḥ sa eva puruṣottamaḥ /
sūrye yo hi kṛśākāśe visarge jagatāṃ patiḥ //
meaning:
हव्यकव्यवहो देवः स एव पुरुषोत्तमः /
सूर्ये यो हि कृशाकाशे विसर्गे जगतां पतिः //
text_mt: The god who bears the oblations to gods and ancestors is indeed Puruṣottama; / he who is the Lord of the worlds in the sun, in the subtle ether, and in creation,

sanskrit_iast:
smarttavyo manujaiḥ sarvairdharmakāmārthakāmukaiḥ /
svajātivihito 'pyevaṃ sanmārge caiva mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
स्मर्त्तव्यो मनुजैः सर्वैर्धर्मकामार्थकामुकैः /
स्वजातिविहितो ऽप्येवं सन्मार्गे चैव माधवः //
text_mt: is to be remembered by all men who desire dharma, pleasure, and wealth; / Mādhava, ordained according to one's own caste and on the virtuous path,

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva bhoktā bhoktavyaḥ sa eva puruṣottamaḥ /
viniyogastu tasyaiva sarvakarmasu yujyate //
meaning:
स एव भोक्ता भोक्तव्यः स एव पुरुषोत्तमः /
विनियोगस्तु तस्यैव सर्वकर्मसु युज्यते //
text_mt: is the enjoyer, the object to be enjoyed, he is Puruṣottama; / his application alone is suitable in all rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ raṭanti viprendrāḥ paṭahe meghaniḥsvane /
evaṃ dharmamavāpyātha pitāṃ dharmāṅgadasya hi //
meaning:
एवं रटन्ति विप्रेन्द्राः पटहे मेघनिःस्वने /
एवं धर्ममवाप्याथ पितां धर्माङ्गदस्य हि //
text_mt: Thus the foremost brahmins proclaim with drum resounding like a cloud; / having thus attained virtue, Dharmāṅgada's father indeed,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā putraṃ kriyopetamātmano hyadhikaṃ dvijāḥ /
uvāca bhāryāṃ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sthitāṃ lakṣmīmivāparām //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा पुत्रं क्रियोपेतमात्मनो ह्यधिकं द्विजाः /
उवाच भार्यां संहृष्टः स्थितां लक्ष्मीमिवापराम् //
text_mt: knowing his son to be endowed with right action, even superior to himself, O twice-born, / rejoiced and spoke to his wife, who stood like another Lakṣmī:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvali hyahaṃ dhanyastvaṃ cāpi varavarṇinī /
ubhayorjanitaḥ putraḥ śaśāṅkadhavalaḥ kṣitau //
meaning:
संध्यावलि ह्यहं धन्यस्त्वं चापि वरवर्णिनी /
उभयोर्जनितः पुत्रः शशाङ्कधवलः क्षितौ //
text_mt: "O Saṃdhyāvalī, blessed am I, and you too, O fair-complexioned lady; / by both of us has a son been engendered on earth, radiant as the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇābhyāṃ śrūyate mokṣo na dṛṣṭaḥ kenacitkvacit /
so 'smābhiradhikaṃ prāpto mokṣaḥ satputrasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
कर्णाभ्यां श्रूयते मोक्षो न दृष्टः केनचित्क्वचित् /
