सो ऽस्माभिरधिकं प्राप्तो मोक्षः सत्पुत्रसंभवः //
text_mt: Liberation is heard of by the ears, but seen by no one anywhere; / that liberation has been attained by us in greater measure through the birth of a noble son.

sanskrit_iast:
putre vinayasaṃpanne vṛttāśauryasamanvite /
pratāpini varārohe piturmokṣo gṛhe dhruvam //
meaning:
पुत्रे विनयसंपन्ने वृत्ताशौर्यसमन्विते /
प्रतापिनि वरारोहे पितुर्मोक्षो गृहे ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: When a son is endowed with modesty, possessed of noble conduct and valor, / and full of majesty, O lady of fair hips, a father's liberation in the home is certain.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ śatānandaḥ sutena yaḥ /
pitā bhavati cārvaṅgi satkarmakaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो रूपं शतानन्दः सुतेन यः /
पिता भवति चार्वङ्गि सत्कर्मकरणैः शुभैः //
text_mt: Joy is the very nature of Brahman; he who has a hundred joys through his son / becomes a father, O fair-limbed lady, through auspicious, good deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
naitatsāmyaṃ bhaveddevi loke sthāvarajaṅgame /
satputraḥ piturādāya bhāramudvahate tu yaḥ //
meaning:
नैतत्साम्यं भवेद्देवि लोके स्थावरजङ्गमे /
सत्पुत्रः पितुरादाय भारमुद्वहते तु यः //
text_mt: Nothing equals this, O queen, in the world of the stationary and the moving: / a noble son who takes up and carries the burden of his father.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ gamiṣyāmi vanāya hṛṣṭo vihāraśīlo mṛgahiṃsanāya /
svecchācaraścātha viśālanetre vimuktapāpo janarakṣaṇāya //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarebhāge rukmāṅgadadharmāṅgadasaṃvādo nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सो ऽहं गमिष्यामि वनाय हृष्टो विहारशीलो मृगहिंसनाय /
स्वेच्छाचरश्चाथ विशालनेत्रे विमुक्तपापो जनरक्षणाय //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरेभागे रुक्माङ्गदधर्माङ्गदसंवादो नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Therefore, delighted and fond of recreation, I shall go to the forest to hunt deer; / roaming at my own pleasure, O wide-eyed lady, free from sin, for the protection of the people."

Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Dialogue between Rukmāṅgada and Dharmāṅgada', in the latter section of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tataḥ prāha viśālākṣī bharturvākyaṃ niśamya sā /
satyamuktaṃ tvayā rājanputrasaukhyātparaṃ sukham //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
ततः प्राह विशालाक्षी भर्तुर्वाक्यं निशम्य सा /
सत्यमुक्तं त्वया राजन्पुत्रसौख्यात्परं सुखम् //
title: athadaśamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then, hearing her husband's words, the large-eyed lady said: / "You have spoken the truth, O king; happiness superior to the happiness of a son

sanskrit_iast:
na bhavediha rājendra munīnāṃ bhāṣitaṃ yathā /
tulyaṃ bhavati loke 'smin viṣṇvākhyasya parasya hi //
meaning:
न भवेदिह राजेन्द्र मुनीनां भाषितं यथा /
तुल्यं भवति लोके ऽस्मिन् विष्ण्वाख्यस्य परस्य हि //
text_mt: does not exist here, O ruler of kings, as spoken by the sages; / in this world it is truly equal to the supreme [state] named Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
putre bhārastvayā nyastaḥ saptadvīpasamudbhavaḥ /
mārgī hiṃsāṃ parityajya yajñairiṣṭvā janārdanam //
meaning:
पुत्रे भारस्त्वया न्यस्तः सप्तद्वीपसमुद्भवः /
मार्गी हिंसां परित्यज्य यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: The burden born of the seven continents has been placed by you upon your son; / abandoning the hunting and killing of deer, having worshiped Janārdana with sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
bhogaspṛhāṃ parityajya sevasya suranimnagām /
etannyāyyaṃ bhavati bho na nyāyyo mṛganigrahaḥ //
meaning:
भोगस्पृहां परित्यज्य सेवस्य सुरनिम्नगाम् /
एतन्न्याय्यं भवति भो न न्याय्यो मृगनिग्रहः //
text_mt: and renouncing longing for worldly pleasures, serve the river of the gods [the Gaṅgā]; / this is proper, O lord; the slaying of deer is not proper.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye nakhapāto hi vṛddhāyā bhūpate yathā /
tathā viṣayasevā hi pitṝṇāṃ putriṇāṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
हृदये नखपातो हि वृद्धाया भूपते यथा /
तथा विषयसेवा हि पितॄणां पुत्रिणां विदुः //
text_mt: Indeed, as a scratch from a fingernail on the heart of an old woman, O lord of the earth, / so, the wise know, is indulgence in sensual pleasures for fathers who have sons.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe vāpi hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayasva mahīpate /
nirdeṣamṛgayūthānāṃ na yuktaṃ sūdanaṃ tava //
meaning:
गृहे वापि हृषीकेशं पूजयस्व महीपते /
निर्देषमृगयूथानां न युक्तं सूदनं तव //
text_mt: Worship Hṛṣīkeśa in the house, O king; / the destruction of harmless herds of deer is not fitting for you.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ purāṇe parikīrtitaḥ /
hiṃsayā vartamānasya vyartho dharmmobhavediti /
kurvannapi vṛthā dharmānyo hiṃsāmanuvartate //
meaning:
अहिंसा परमो धर्मः पुराणे परिकीर्तितः /
हिंसया वर्तमानस्य व्यर्थो धर्म्मोभवेदिति /
कुर्वन्नपि वृथा धर्मान्यो हिंसामनुवर्तते //
text_mt: Non-violence is proclaimed in the Purāṇa as the supreme virtue; / for one who lives by violence, virtue becomes useless; / even while performing virtues, they are in vain for one who persists in violence.

sanskrit_iast:
parairupahatāṃ bhūpa nopabhuñjanti sādhavaḥ /
ṣaḍvidhaṃ nṛpa te proktaṃ vidvadbhirjīvaghātanam //
meaning:
परैरुपहतां भूप नोपभुञ्जन्ति साधवः /
षड्विधं नृप ते प्रोक्तं विद्वद्भिर्जीवघातनम् //
text_mt: Good people do not consume what has been slaughtered by others, O king; / six kinds of slaughter of living beings have been spoken to you by the learned, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
anumodayitā pūrvaṃ dvitīyo ghātakaḥ smṛtaḥ /
viśvāsakastṛtīyo 'pi caturtho bhakṣakastathā /
pañcamaḥ pācakaḥ proktaḥ ṣaṣṭho bhūpātra vigrahī /
hiṃ sayā saṃyutaṃ dharmamadharmaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
अनुमोदयिता पूर्वं द्वितीयो घातकः स्मृतः /
विश्वासकस्तृतीयो ऽपि चतुर्थो भक्षकस्तथा /
पञ्चमः पाचकः प्रोक्तः षष्ठो भूपात्र विग्रही /
हिं सया संयुतं धर्ममधर्मं च विदुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: First is the consenter, the second is remembered as the killer, / the third is the one who inspires trust, and the fourth is the eater; / the fifth is declared the cook, and the sixth, O king, is the purchaser. / The wise know that virtue connected with violence is indeed unrighteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
na pāpaṃ kurute bhūpa putre bhāraṃ niveśya vai /
dharmaṃ samāśrayamansamyaksaṃjātapalitaḥ pitā //
meaning:
न पापं कुरुते भूप पुत्रे भारं निवेश्य वै /
धर्मं समाश्रयमन्सम्यक्संजातपलितः पिता //
text_mt: Having placed the burden upon his son, a father commits no sin, O king, / if, turning gray-haired, he properly resorts to virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
parityajya imaṃ bhāvaṃ mṛgahiṃsāsamudbhavam /
mṛgaśīlā hi rājāno vinaṣṭāḥ śataśo na-pa //
meaning:
परित्यज्य इमं भावं मृगहिंसासमुद्भवम् /
मृगशीला हि राजानो विनष्टाः शतशो न-प //
text_mt: Abandon this disposition arising from the killing of deer; / for kings devoted to hunting have perished by the hundreds, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādduṣṭaṃ hi tanmanye yatra mṛgapātanam /
dayā varā mṛge rījñāṃ dharmiṇāmapi dṛśyate //
meaning:
तस्माद्दुष्टं हि तन्मन्ये यत्र मृगपातनम् /
दया वरा मृगे रीज्ञां धर्मिणामपि दृश्यते //
text_mt: Therefore I consider that vile wherein lies the slaughter of deer; / excellent compassion toward deer is seen even among righteous kings.

sanskrit_iast:
nivārito mayā hi tvaṃ hitabuddhyā punaḥ punaḥ /
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ bhāryāṃ nṛpo vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
निवारितो मया हि त्वं हितबुद्ध्या पुनः पुनः /
एवं ब्रुवाणां तां भार्यां नृपो वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: You have indeed been restrained by me again and again with a mind wishing your welfare." / To his wife speaking thus, the king uttered these words:

sanskrit_iast:
nahirhise mṛgāndevi mṛgavyājena kānane /
paryyaṭiṣye dhanuṣpāṇiḥ kurvankaṇṭakaśodhanam //
meaning:
नहिर्हिसे मृगान्देवि मृगव्याजेन कानने /
पर्य्यटिष्ये धनुष्पाणिः कुर्वन्कण्टकशोधनम् //
text_mt: "I will not kill deer, O queen, under the pretext of hunting deer in the forest; / I will wander, bow in hand, removing thorns [of danger].

sanskrit_iast:
janamadhye suto me 'stu kānane 'haṃ varānane /
śvāpadebhyaśca dasyubhyaḥ prajā rakṣyā mahībhṛtā //
meaning:
जनमध्ये सुतो मे ऽस्तु कानने ऽहं वरानने /
श्वापदेभ्यश्च दस्युभ्यः प्रजा रक्ष्या महीभृता //
text_mt: Let my son stay among the people; I shall be in the forest, O fair-faced lady; / subjects must be protected by the king from beasts of prey and robbers.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanāvātha putreṇa gopanīyāḥ prajā śubhe /
prajā arakṣannṛpatiḥ sadharmmo 'pi vrajatyadhaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनावाथ पुत्रेण गोपनीयाः प्रजा शुभे /
प्रजा अरक्षन्नृपतिः सधर्म्मो ऽपि व्रजत्यधः //
text_mt: Whether by oneself or by one's son, subjects must be guarded, O auspicious lady; / a king who does not protect his subjects, even if endowed with virtue, goes down [to hell].

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ rakṣaṇamuddiśyagamiṣyāmi vanaṃ priye /
vimuktabhāvo 'hamiti meruśṛṅge raviryathā //
meaning:
सो ऽहं रक्षणमुद्दिश्यगमिष्यामि वनं प्रिये /
विमुक्तभावो ऽहमिति मेरुशृङ्गे रविर्यथा //
text_mt: Therefore, aiming at protection, I will go to the forest, my dear, / with a detached mind, like the sun on the peak of Mount Meru."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuddiśya tāṃ rājā āruroha hayottamam /
doṣāpatisamaprakhyaṃ nirdeṣaṃ kṣitibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
एवमुद्दिश्य तां राजा आरुरोह हयोत्तमम् /
दोषापतिसमप्रख्यं निर्देषं क्षितिभूषणम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to her, the king mounted an excellent horse, / resembling the lord of the night [the moon], faultless, an ornament of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
devavāhasamaṃ rūpe prabhañjanasamaṃ jave /
dharāmādṛtya bhūpālo datvā taṃ dakṣiṇaṃ karam //
meaning:
देववाहसमं रूपे प्रभञ्जनसमं जवे /
धरामादृत्य भूपालो दत्वा तं दक्षिणं करम् //
text_mt: equal to the mount of a god in beauty, equal to the wind in speed; / touching the earth, the king raised his right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakoṭidātāraṃ kāminīkucapīḍanam /
aśokapallavākāraṃ vajrāṅkuśavirohaṇam //
meaning:
सहस्रकोटिदातारं कामिनीकुचपीडनम् /
अशोकपल्लवाकारं वज्राङ्कुशविरोहणम् //
text_mt: which bestowed thousands of crores, embraced the breasts of lovely women, / resembled a sprout of an Aśoka tree, and bore the marks of the thunderbolt and elephant-hook.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpratasthe mahīpālaścālayāno mahītalam /
sādhayāno yayau deśānkānanaṃ sa nṛpottamaḥ //
meaning:
संप्रतस्थे महीपालश्चालयानो महीतलम् /
साधयानो ययौ देशान्काननं स नृपोत्तमः //
text_mt: The ruler of the earth set out, causing the surface of the earth to tremble; / bringing lands under control, that best of kings went to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
vājivegena nirddhūtā vāraṇāḥ syandanā hayāḥ /
padātayo nipetuste mūrcchitāḥ kṣitimaṇḍale //
meaning:
वाजिवेगेन निर्द्धूता वारणाः स्यन्दना हयाः /
पदातयो निपेतुस्ते मूर्च्छिताः क्षितिमण्डले //
text_mt: Shaken off by the speed of the horse, elephants, chariots, and horses, / as well as foot-soldiers, fell fainting on the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rājā sahasā prāpto munīnāmāśramaṃ param /
yojanānāṃ samuttīrya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
स राजा सहसा प्राप्तो मुनीनामाश्रमं परम् /
योजनानां समुत्तीर्य शतमष्टोत्तरं नृप //
text_mt: The king suddenly arrived at the supreme hermitage of sages, / having traversed a hundred and eight yojanas, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
praviveśāśramaṃ ramyaṃ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam /
aśokabakulopetaṃ punnāgasaralāvṛtam //
meaning:
प्रविवेशाश्रमं रम्यं कदलीखण्डमण्डितम् /
अशोकबकुलोपेतं पुन्नागसरलावृतम् //
text_mt: He entered the charming hermitage, adorned with groves of plantain trees, / furnished with Aśoka and Bakula trees, filled with Punnāga and Sarala trees,

sanskrit_iast:
mātuliṅgaiḥ kapitthaiśca kharjūraiḥ panasādibhiḥ /
nārikelaistathā tālaiḥ ketakaiḥ siṃduvārakaiḥ //
meaning:
मातुलिङ्गैः कपित्थैश्च खर्जूरैः पनसादिभिः /
नारिकेलैस्तथा तालैः केतकैः सिंदुवारकैः //
text_mt: with citron trees, wood-apple trees, date palms, jackfruit trees, and others, / with coconut trees, palmyra palms, Ketaka plants, and Sinduvāraka shrubs,

sanskrit_iast:
candanaiḥ satamālaiśca sālaiḥ pippalacaṃpakaiḥ /
kramukairdāḍimaiścaiva dhātrīvṛkṣaiḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
चन्दनैः सतमालैश्च सालैः पिप्पलचंपकैः /
क्रमुकैर्दाडिमैश्चैव धात्रीवृक्षैः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: with sandalwood trees, Tamālas, Sāl trees, Pippalas, and Campakas, / with betel-nut trees, pomegranates, and thousands of Dhātrī trees,

sanskrit_iast:
nimbavṛkṣaiśca bahuśastathāmrairlodhrapādapaiḥ /
paripakvaphalairnamraiḥ khagārūḍhaiḥ samāvṛtam //
meaning:
निम्बवृक्षैश्च बहुशस्तथाम्रैर्लोध्रपादपैः /
परिपक्वफलैर्नम्रैः खगारूढैः समावृतम् //
text_mt: with numerous Nimba trees, mangoes, and Lodhra trees, / bending under fully ripened fruit and filled with birds perched upon them,

sanskrit_iast:
hyadyena vāyunā yuktaṃ puṣpagandhāvṛtena hi /
paśyamāno muniṃ rājā dadarśa hutabhukprabham //
meaning:
ह्यद्येन वायुना युक्तं पुष्पगन्धावृतेन हि /
पश्यमानो मुनिं राजा ददर्श हुतभुक्प्रभम् //
text_mt: blessed with a delightful breeze pervaded by the fragrance of flowers. / Looking around, the king beheld a sage radiant like the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevaṃ dvijavaraṃ bahuśiṣyasamāvṛtam /
avaruhya hayāddṛṣṭvā praṇanāma ca sādaram //
meaning:
वामदेवं द्विजवरं बहुशिष्यसमावृतम् /
अवरुह्य हयाद्दृष्ट्वा प्रणनाम च सादरम् //
text_mt: Vāmadeva, the best of the twice-born, surrounded by many disciples; / seeing him, he dismounted from his horse and bowed respectfully.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāpi muninā rājā hyarghādyairabhipūjitaḥ /
upaviśyāsane kauśe prāha saṃhṛṣṭayā girā //
meaning:
तेनापि मुनिना राजा ह्यर्घाद्यैरभिपूजितः /
उपविश्यासने कौशे प्राह संहृष्टया गिरा //
text_mt: Worshiped by that sage as well with guest-offerings and other honors, / having sat down on a seat of kuśa grass, he spoke with a delighted voice:

sanskrit_iast:
adya me pātakaṃ kṣīṇaṃ saṃprāptaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam /
dṛṣṭvā tava padāṃbhojaṃ samyagdhyānaparasya ca //
meaning:
अद्य मे पातकं क्षीणं संप्राप्तं कर्मणः फलम् /
दृष्ट्वा तव पदांभोजं सम्यग्ध्यानपरस्य च //
text_mt: "Today my sin is destroyed, and the fruit of my action is obtained, / having beheld your lotus feet, you who are fully intent upon meditation."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya rukmāṅgadamahīpateḥ /
saṃpṛṣṭvā kuśalaṃ prāha vāmadevo mudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य रुक्माङ्गदमहीपतेः /
संपृष्ट्वा कुशलं प्राह वामदेवो मुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of King Rukmāṅgada, / and having inquired after his welfare, Vāmadeva, filled with joy, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
rājaṃstvayātipuṇyena viṣṇubhaktena vīkṣitaḥ /
mamāśramo mahābhāga puṇyo jāto dharātale //
meaning:
राजंस्त्वयातिपुण्येन विष्णुभक्तेन वीक्षितः /
ममाश्रमो महाभाग पुण्यो जातो धरातले //
text_mt: "O king, beheld by you who are exceedingly virtuous and devoted to Viṣṇu, / my hermitage on the surface of the earth has become sacred, O fortunate one.

sanskrit_iast:
kaste 'nyastulyatāmeti pārthivo dharaṇītale /
yena vaivasvato māgro bhagno nirjitya vai yamam //
meaning:
कस्ते ऽन्यस्तुल्यतामेति पार्थिवो धरणीतले /
येन वैवस्वतो माग्रो भग्नो निर्जित्य वै यमम् //
text_mt: What other ruler of the earth equals you on the face of the earth, / by whom the path of Yama was broken after conquering Yama himself,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpitaḥ sakalo loko vaikuṇṭhaṃ padamavyayam /
upoṣayitvā nṛpatedvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm //
meaning:
प्रापितः सकलो लोको वैकुण्ठं पदमव्ययम् /
उपोषयित्वा नृपतेद्वादशीं पापनाशिनीम् //
text_mt: and all the world was brought to the imperishable abode of Vaikuṇṭha, / having made them fast on the sin-destroying dvādaśī, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ śobhanopāyaiḥ prajāḥ sayamya bhūtale /
svakarmasthā vikarmasthā nītā madhubhidaḥ padam //
meaning:
चतुर्भिः शोभनोपायैः प्रजाः सयम्य भूतले /
स्वकर्मस्था विकर्मस्था नीता मधुभिदः पदम् //
text_mt: Having restrained the subjects on earth by the four splendid means, / those established in their own duty and those in wrong conduct were led to the abode of the slayer of Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'smākaṃ draṣṭukāmānāṃ saṃprāpto darśanaṃ nṛpa /
śvapaco 'pi mahīpāla viṣṇubhakto dvijādhikaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽस्माकं द्रष्टुकामानां संप्राप्तो दर्शनं नृप /
श्वपचो ऽपि महीपाल विष्णुभक्तो द्विजाधिकः //
text_mt: Such a one has arrived before the sight of us who wished to see you, O king; / even an outcaste who is devoted to Viṣṇu is superior to a twice-born, O ruler of the earth."

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktivihīnastu dvijo 'pi śvapacādhikaḥ /
durlabhā bhūpa rājāno viṣṇubhaktā mahītale //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तिविहीनस्तु द्विजो ऽपि श्वपचाधिकः /
दुर्लभा भूप राजानो विष्णुभक्ता महीतले //
text_mt: Yet even a twice-born lacking devotion to Viṣṇu is lower than an outcaste dog-eater. / Rare on earth, O king, are kings devoted to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvaiṣṇavo bhavedrājā kṣitilakṣmīprasādhakaḥ /
yo na rājā raherbhakto deveṣvanyeṣu bhaktimān //
meaning:
नावैष्णवो भवेद्राजा क्षितिलक्ष्मीप्रसाधकः /
यो न राजा रहेर्भक्तो देवेष्वन्येषु भक्तिमान् //
text_mt: A king who is not a Vaiṣṇava cannot attain the goddess of royal fortune on earth; / a king who has no devotion to Hari, but shows devotion toward other gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā jāre patiṃ tyaktvā ratā strī sa tathā nṛpaḥ /
evaṃ vyatikramastasya nṛpaterbhavati dhruvam //
meaning:
यथा जारे पतिं त्यक्त्वा रता स्त्री स तथा नृपः /
एवं व्यतिक्रमस्तस्य नृपतेर्भवति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: that king is just like a woman who abandons her husband and delights in a paramour. / Such a king undoubtedly goes astray.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasyārthasya kāmasya prajñāyāśca gaterapi /
tattvayā nyāyavihitaṃ kṛtaṃ viṣṇoḥ prapūjanam //
meaning:
धर्मस्यार्थस्य कामस्य प्रज्ञायाश्च गतेरपि /
तत्त्वया न्यायविहितं कृतं विष्णोः प्रपूजनम् //
text_mt: For the sake of virtue, wealth, pleasure, wisdom, and the ultimate path as well, / worship of Viṣṇu has been properly performed by you according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tena dhanyo 'si nṛpate vayaṃ dhanyāstavekṣaṇāt /
ityevaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ tu vāmadevaṃ nṛpottamaḥ //
meaning:
तेन धन्यो ऽसि नृपते वयं धन्यास्तवेक्षणात् /
इत्येवं भाषमाणं तु वामदेवं नृपोत्तमः //
text_mt: Therefore, O king, you are blessed, and we are blessed by the sight of you.” / To Vāmadeva who was speaking thus, the best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
uvācāvanato bhūtvā prakṛtyā vinayānvitaḥ /
kṣāmaye tvā dvijaśreṣṭha nāhametādṛśo vibho //
meaning:
उवाचावनतो भूत्वा प्रकृत्या विनयान्वितः /
क्षामये त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ नाहमेतादृशो विभो //
text_mt: bending low and naturally filled with humility, said: / “I beg your pardon, O best of the twice-born! I am not such a person, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādapāṃsunā tulyo nāhaṃ vipra bhavāmi hi /
na viprebhyo 'dhikā devā bhavantīha kadācana //
meaning:
त्वत्पादपांसुना तुल्यो नाहं विप्र भवामि हि /
न विप्रेभ्यो ऽधिका देवा भवन्तीह कदाचन //
text_mt: Indeed, O brāhmaṇa, I am not equal even to the dust of your feet; / for gods are never superior to brāhmaṇas in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
parituṣṭairdvijairbhaktirjantorbhavati mādhave /
dveṣyo bhavati tai ruṣṭaiḥ satyametanmayeritam //
meaning:
परितुष्टैर्द्विजैर्भक्तिर्जन्तोर्भवति माधवे /
द्वेष्यो भवति तै रुष्टैः सत्यमेतन्मयेरितम् //
text_mt: When the twice-born are pleased, a creature attains devotion to Mādhava; / when they are angered, he becomes an object of hatred—this truth is spoken by me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tamāha vāmadevastu brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham /
nādeyaṃ vidyate rājangṛhāyātasya te 'dhunā //
meaning:
तमाह वामदेवस्तु ब्रूहि किं ते ददाम्यहम् /
नादेयं विद्यते राजन्गृहायातस्य ते ऽधुना //
text_mt: Vāmadeva said to him: “Speak, what shall I give you? / Nothing is not to be given to you who have now arrived at my home, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
abhīṣṭaṃ hi mahīpāla yo dadāti mahītale /
paṭahaṃ vāsare viṣṇoḥ prajābhojanavāraṇam //
meaning:
अभीष्टं हि महीपाल यो ददाति महीतले /
पटहं वासरे विष्णोः प्रजाभोजनवारणम् //
text_mt: who grant the desires of all on the earth, O ruler of the earth, / and [beat] the drum to forbid people from eating on Viṣṇu's day.”

sanskrit_iast:
tamāha nṛpatirvipraṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā /
prāptameva mayā sarvaṃ tvadaṅghriyugalekṣaṇāt //
meaning:
तमाह नृपतिर्विप्रं कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तदा /
प्राप्तमेव मया सर्वं त्वदङ्घ्रियुगलेक्षणात् //
text_mt: Then the king said to the brāhmaṇa, with folded hands: / “Everything has indeed been attained by me merely by beholding your pair of feet.

sanskrit_iast:
mamaikaḥ saṃśayo brahman vartate bahukālataḥ /
taṃ pṛcchāmi dvijāgryaṃ tvāṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam //
meaning:
ममैकः संशयो ब्रह्मन् वर्तते बहुकालतः /
तं पृच्छामि द्विजाग्र्यं त्वां सर्वसंदेहभञ्जनम् //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, a single doubt has persisted in me for a long time; / I ask you, the foremost of the twice-born, the dispeller of all doubts:

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasundarī bhāryā mama kena sukarmaṇā /
yā vilokayate dṛṣṭyā māṃ sadā manmathādhikam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी भार्या मम केन सुकर्मणा /
या विलोकयते दृष्ट्या मां सदा मन्मथाधिकम् //
text_mt: By what good deed do I have a wife of three-world beauty, / who always looks upon me with eyes full of love, seeing me as more [handsome] than Kāma?

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra padaṃ devī dadāti varavarṇinī /
tatra tatra nidhānāni prakāśayati medinī //
meaning:
यत्र यत्र पदं देवी ददाति वरवर्णिनी /
तत्र तत्र निधानानि प्रकाशयति मेदिनी //
text_mt: Wherever that fair-complexioned queen sets her foot, / there the earth reveals treasures.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāścāṅgaṃ jarāhīnaṃ valīpalitavarjitam /
sadā bhāti muniśreṣṭha śāradenduprabhā yathā //
meaning:
यस्याश्चाङ्गं जराहीनं वलीपलितवर्जितम् /
सदा भाति मुनिश्रेष्ठ शारदेन्दुप्रभा यथा //
text_mt: Her body is free from old age, devoid of wrinkles and grey hair; / it always shines, O best of sages, like the radiance of the autumn moon.

sanskrit_iast:
vināgnināpi sā vipra sādhayatyeva ṣaḍrasam /
annaṃ pacati yatsvalpaṃ tasminbhuñjanti koṭayaḥ //
meaning:
विनाग्निनापि सा विप्र साधयत्येव षड्रसम् /
अन्नं पचति यत्स्वल्पं तस्मिन्भुञ्जन्ति कोटयः //
text_mt: Even without fire, O brāhmaṇa, she prepares food of six tastes; / whatever small amount of food she cooks, millions dine upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
pitavratā dānaśīlā sarvabhūtasukhāvahā /
nāvajñā kriyate brahman vākyenāpi prasūptayā //
meaning:
पितव्रता दानशीला सर्वभूतसुखावहा /
नावज्ञा क्रियते ब्रह्मन् वाक्येनापि प्रसूप्तया //
text_mt: Devoted to her husband, generous, bringing happiness to all living beings, / even while asleep she shows no disrespect in speech, O brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ jātastu tanayo mamājñāyāṃ sthitaḥ sadā /
ahameva dharāpṛṣṭhe putrī dvijavarottama //
meaning:
यस्यां जातस्तु तनयो ममाज्ञायां स्थितः सदा /
अहमेव धरापृष्ठे पुत्री द्विजवरोत्तम //
text_mt: A son was born to her who is ever obedient to my command; / I alone on the surface of the earth have such a son, O best among the foremost twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya putraḥ piturbhakto hyadhiko guṇasaṃcayaiḥ /
ekadvīpapatiścāhaṃ vidito dharaṇītale //
meaning:
यस्य पुत्रः पितुर्भक्तो ह्यधिको गुणसंचयैः /
एकद्वीपपतिश्चाहं विदितो धरणीतले //
text_mt: whose son is devoted to his father and surpassed by an abundance of virtues. / I was known on earth as the lord of a single continent,

sanskrit_iast:
putro mamādhiko jātaḥ saptadvīpaprapālakaḥ /
madarthe yena viprendra samānītā nṛpātmajā //
meaning:
पुत्रो ममाधिको जातः सप्तद्वीपप्रपालकः /
मदर्थे येन विप्रेन्द्र समानीता नृपात्मजा //
text_mt: yet a superior son was born to me, the protector of seven continents, / by whom, O chief of the twice-born, a king's daughter was brought for my sake,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyullekheti vikhyātā raṇe jitvā mahībhujaḥ /
atha tenādhipatinā rūpadraviṇaśālinā //
meaning:
विद्युल्लेखेति विख्याता रणे जित्वा महीभुजः /
अथ तेनाधिपतिना रूपद्रविणशालिना //
text_mt: renowned as Vidyullekhā, having conquered the kings in battle. / Then, by that lord endowed with beauty and wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsena raṇe jitvā kṛtvā sarvānnirāyudhān /
yo gatvā pramadārājyaṃ jitvā tāḥ pramadā raṇe //
meaning:
षण्मासेन रणे जित्वा कृत्वा सर्वान्निरायुधान् /
यो गत्वा प्रमदाराज्यं जित्वा ताः प्रमदा रणे //
text_mt: having conquered in battle and disarmed all within six months, / who went to the kingdom of women and conquered those women in combat,

sanskrit_iast:
ājahāra śubhāstāsāṃ madhyādaṣṭau varāṅganāḥ /
pradadau mayi tāḥ sarvāḥ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
आजहार शुभास्तासां मध्यादष्टौ वराङ्गनाः /
प्रददौ मयि ताः सर्वाः प्रणम्य च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: he took from among them eight auspicious, excellent women, / and bowing again and again, presented them all to me.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni vāsāṃsi divyāni yāni ratnāni bhūtale /
tāni me pradadau putro jananyā tūpavarṇitaḥ //
meaning:
यानि वासांसि दिव्यानि यानि रत्नानि भूतले /
तानि मे प्रददौ पुत्रो जनन्या तूपवर्णितः //
text_mt: Whatever divine garments and whatever jewels exist on earth, / my son presented them to me, being praised by his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhnā pṛthivīṃ sarvāmatītya bahuyojanām /
punarāyāti śarvaryāṃ matpādābhyaṅgakāraṇāt //
meaning:
एकाह्ना पृथिवीं सर्वामतीत्य बहुयोजनाम् /
पुनरायाति शर्वर्यां मत्पादाभ्यङ्गकारणात् //
text_mt: Traversing the entire earth of many leagues in a single day, / he returns at night solely to massage my feet.

sanskrit_iast:
niśītheṃ'gāni saṃvāhya dvāri tiṣṭhati daṃśitaḥ /
prabodhayanpreṣyajanānnidrayā saṃkulendriyān //
meaning:
निशीथेंऽगानि संवाह्य द्वारि तिष्ठति दंशितः /
प्रबोधयन्प्रेष्यजनान्निद्रया संकुलेन्द्रियान् //
text_mt: Having massaged my limbs at midnight, he stands armed at the door, / awakening the attendants whose senses are overwhelmed by sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāyaṃ me muniśreṣṭha deho rogavivarjitaḥ /
aprameyaṃ mama sukhaṃ vaśagā hi priyā gṛhe //
meaning:
तथायं मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ देहो रोगविवर्जितः /
अप्रमेयं मम सुखं वशगा हि प्रिया गृहे //
text_mt: Likewise, O best of sages, this body of mine is free from disease; / immeasurable is my happiness, and obedient is the beloved in my home.

sanskrit_iast:
vājino vāraṇāścaiva dhanadhānyamanantakam /
vartate hi janaḥ sarvo mamājñāpālakaḥ kṣitau //
meaning:
वाजिनो वारणाश्चैव धनधान्यमनन्तकम् /
वर्तते हि जनः सर्वो ममाज्ञापालकः क्षितौ //
text_mt: There are horses, elephants, and endless wealth and grain, / and indeed every person on earth obeys my command.

sanskrit_iast:
kena karmaprabhāveṇa mamedaṃ sāṃprataṃ sukham /
iha janmakṛtaṃ vāpi parajanmakṛtaṃ tathā //
meaning:
केन कर्मप्रभावेण ममेदं सांप्रतं सुखम् /
इह जन्मकृतं वापि परजन्मकृतं तथा //
text_mt: By the power of what deed do I enjoy this present happiness, / whether performed in this life or done in a past life?

sanskrit_iast: mama puṇyaṃ vada brahman vicārya svamanīṣayā //
meaning: मम पुण्यं वद ब्रह्मन् विचार्य स्वमनीषया //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, reflect with your intellect and tell me of my religious merit.”

sanskrit_iast:
dehe na rogo vaśagāpriyā ca gṛhe vibhūtirnṛharau ca bhaktiḥ /
vidvatsu pūjā dvijadānaśaktirmanye 'hametatsukṛtaprasūtam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge rukmāṅgada vāmadevasaṃvādo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
देहे न रोगो वशगाप्रिया च गृहे विभूतिर्नृहरौ च भक्तिः /
विद्वत्सु पूजा द्विजदानशक्तिर्मन्ये ऽहमेतत्सुकृतप्रसूतम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे रुक्माङ्गद वामदेवसंवादो नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
“No disease in the body, an obedient wife, prosperity in the home, devotion to Nṛhari, / honor among the learned, and the capacity to give to brāhmaṇas—I deem this born of good deeds.”

Thus ends the tenth chapter, named 'The Dialogue between Rukmāṅgada and Vāmadeva,' in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tacchrutvā nṛpatervākyaṃ mahājñānī munīśvaraḥ /
cintayitvā kṣaṇaṃ jñātvā kāraṇaṃ tamucāva ha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतेर्वाक्यं महाज्ञानी मुनीश्वरः /
चिन्तयित्वा क्षणं ज्ञात्वा कारणं तमुचाव ह //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing those words of the king, the chief of sages, endowed with great knowledge, / contemplated for a moment, recognized the cause, and spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadeva uvāca
purā tvamavanīpāla śūdrajātisamudbhavaḥ /
dārirdyeṇa parābhūto duṣṭayā bhāryayā tathā //
meaning:
वामदेव उवाच
पुरा त्वमवनीपाल शूद्रजातिसमुद्भवः /
दारिर्द्येण पराभूतो दुष्टया भार्यया तथा //
text_mt: Vāmadeva said: / “Formerly, O protector of the earth, you were born into the Śūdra caste, / overcome by poverty as well as by a wicked wife.

sanskrit_iast:
parasevanayā caiva vetanena bhujikriyā /
nivasanduḥkhasaṃtapto bahuvarṣāṇi pārthiva //
meaning:
परसेवनया चैव वेतनेन भुजिक्रिया /
निवसन्दुःखसंतप्तो बहुवर्षाणि पार्थिव //
text_mt: Earning a livelihood through wages and the service of others, / you lived tormented by sorrow for many years, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kadāciddvijasaṃsargāttīrthayātrāṃ gato bhavān /
tataḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni parakramya mahīpate //
meaning:
कदाचिद्द्विजसंसर्गात्तीर्थयात्रां गतो भवान् /
ततः सर्वाणि तीर्थानि परक्रम्य महीपते //
text_mt: Once, through association with a brāhmaṇa, you went on a pilgrimage to sacred fords; / then, having circumambulated all the sacred fords, O ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijasevāparo jāto mathurāṃ puṇyarūpiṇīm /
tatra snātaṃ tvayā viprasaṃgena yamunājale //
meaning:
द्विजसेवापरो जातो मथुरां पुण्यरूपिणीम् /
तत्र स्नातं त्वया विप्रसंगेन यमुनाजले //
text_mt: and devoted to serving brāhmaṇas, you went to Mathurā, the embodiment of merit. / There, in the company of a brāhmaṇa, you bathed in the waters of the Yamunā,

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntisaṃjñake tīrthe sarvatīrthottamottame /
mandire ca varāhasya kathyamānāṃ kathāṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
विश्रान्तिसंज्ञके तीर्थे सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमे /
मन्दिरे च वराहस्य कथ्यमानां कथां नृप //
text_mt: at the sacred ford named Viśrānti, the most supreme of all sacred fords; / and in the temple of Varāha, O king, you heard the narrative

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇoktāṃ ca śuśrāva aśūnyaśayanavratam /
caturbhiḥ pāraṇairyasya niṣpattistu vidhīyate //
meaning:
पुराणोक्तां च शुश्राव अशून्यशयनव्रतम् /
चतुर्भिः पारणैर्यस्य निष्पत्तिस्तु विधीयते //
text_mt: told from the Purāṇa about the Aśūnyaśayana vow, / the completion of which is prescribed with four ritual breaks of fast,

sanskrit_iast:
yena cīrṇena deveśo jīmūtābhaḥ prasīdati /
lakṣmībhartā jagannātho niḥśeṣāghaughanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
येन चीर्णेन देवेशो जीमूताभः प्रसीदति /
लक्ष्मीभर्ता जगन्नाथो निःशेषाघौघनाशनः //
text_mt: by the observance of which the lord of gods, dark like a rain-cloud, is pleased— / the husband of Lakṣmī, lord of the universe, destroyer of the entire mass of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṛtaṃ bhavatā rājanpunarabhyetya mandiram /
aśūnyaśayanaṃ puṇyaṃ gṛhe vṛddhikaraṃ param //
meaning:
तत्कृतं भवता राजन्पुनरभ्येत्य मन्दिरम् /
अशून्यशयनं पुण्यं गृहे वृद्धिकरं परम् //
text_mt: Having returned home, O king, that was performed by you— / the meritorious Aśūnyaśayana [vow], which brings supreme prosperity to the household.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvedaṃ mahārāja vrataṃ pātakanāśanam /
gārhasthyamanutiṣṭheta vandhyāvanniṣphalo bhavet /
sukhamīdṛgvidhaṃ loke durlabhaṃ pratibhāti me //
meaning:
अकृत्वेदं महाराज व्रतं पातकनाशनम् /
गार्हस्थ्यमनुतिष्ठेत वन्ध्यावन्निष्फलो भवेत् /
सुखमीदृग्विधं लोके दुर्लभं प्रतिभाति मे //
text_mt: Without performing this vow that destroys sins, / if one engages in household life, one becomes fruitless like a barren woman. / Such happiness appears to me rare in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya dvitīyayāṃ mahīpate /
grāhyametadvrataṃ puṇyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham //
meaning:
श्रावणस्य तु मासस्य द्वितीययां महीपते /
ग्राह्यमेतद्व्रतं पुण्यं जन्ममृत्युजरापहम् //
text_mt: On the second day of the month of Śrāvaṇa, O ruler of the earth, / this meritorious vow must be undertaken, which removes birth, death, and old age.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīyukto jagannāthaḥ pūjanīyo 'tra pārthiva /
phalaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiścāruraktānulepanaiḥ /
śayyādānairvastradānaistathā brāhmaṇabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीयुक्तो जगन्नाथः पूजनीयो ऽत्र पार्थिव /
फलैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैश्चारुरक्तानुलेपनैः /
शय्यादानैर्वस्त्रदानैस्तथा ब्राह्मणभोजनैः //
text_mt: Here, O king, the lord of the universe along with Lakṣmī is to be worshipped / with fruits, flowers, incenses, pleasant red unguents, / gifts of beds, gifts of garments, and the feeding of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvayā sarvametaddhikṛtaṃ rājansudustaram /
tasyaiva karmaṇaḥ puṣṭiraśūnyasya mahīpate /
imānevāgrataḥ puṇyāstvayoktānvistarācchṛṇu //
meaning:
तत्त्वया सर्वमेतद्धिकृतं राजन्सुदुस्तरम् /
तस्यैव कर्मणः पुष्टिरशून्यस्य महीपते /
इमानेवाग्रतः पुण्यास्त्वयोक्तान्विस्तराच्छृणु //
text_mt: All this, though very difficult to perform, was indeed done by you, O king. / The fruit of that very Aśūnya[śayana] deed, O ruler of the earth, / are these very merits mentioned by you; now hear them in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
nāprasanneṃ jagannāthe bhaveyuriti niścitam /
pūrvajanmani deveśastvayāśūnyena pūjitaḥ //
meaning:
नाप्रसन्नें जगन्नाथे भवेयुरिति निश्चितम् /
पूर्वजन्मनि देवेशस्त्वयाशून्येन पूजितः //
text_mt: Unless the lord of the universe is pleased, these would certainly not exist. / In your previous birth, the lord of gods was worshipped by you with the Aśūnya [vow].

sanskrit_iast:
iha janmani rājendra dvādaśyārcayase harim /
avaśyaṃ prāpyase rājan viṣṇoḥ sāyujyatāṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
इह जन्मनि राजेन्द्र द्वादश्यार्चयसे हरिम् /
अवश्यं प्राप्यसे राजन् विष्णोः सायुज्यतां ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: In this birth, O best of kings, you worship Hari on the twelfth lunar day; / you will surely attain oneness with Viṣṇu without fail, O king.”

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa praśno mayā rājanvyākhyātaste sumaṅgalaḥ /
saṃpadāṃ prabhavopeto jñāterutkarṣaṇārthakaḥ //
meaning:
एष प्रश्नो मया राजन्व्याख्यातस्ते सुमङ्गलः /
संपदां प्रभवोपेतो ज्ञातेरुत्कर्षणार्थकः //
text_mt: This very auspicious question has been explained to you by me, O king, / endowed with the source of prosperity, aiming at the elevation of your kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
kimanyatte mahīpāla dadāmīha karomi ca /
avaśyaṃ sarvayogyo 'si bhakto 'si tvaṃ janārdane //
meaning:
किमन्यत्ते महीपाल ददामीह करोमि च /
अवश्यं सर्वयोग्यो ऽसि भक्तो ऽसि त्वं जनार्दने //
text_mt: What else may I give or do for you here, O ruler of the earth? / You are surely worthy of everything, for you are a devotee of Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
utsuko 'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mandaraṃ parvataṃ prati /
tatrāścaryāṇyanekāni draṣṭukāmastavājñayā //
meaning:
राजोवाच
उत्सुको ऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्दरं पर्वतं प्रति /
तत्राश्चर्याण्यनेकानि द्रष्टुकामस्तवाज्ञया //
text_mt:
The king said:
O best of the twice-born, I am eager to go towards Mount Mandara, / desiring, with your permission, to see many wonders there,

sanskrit_iast:
laghurbhūtvā guruṃ tyaktvā putropari dvijottama /
rājyaśāsanajaṃ bhāraṃ durvahaṃ yacca bhūmipaiḥ //
meaning:
लघुर्भूत्वा गुरुं त्यक्त्वा पुत्रोपरि द्विजोत्तम /
राज्यशासनजं भारं दुर्वहं यच्च भूमिपैः //
text_mt: having become light, O best of the twice-born, by leaving upon my son the heavy burden / born of ruling the kingdom, which is difficult for kings to bear.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ svecchācaro yāto matkṛtyaṃ tanayaścaret /
tacchatvā vacanaṃ rājño vāmadevo 'bravīdidam //
meaning:
सो ऽहं स्वेच्छाचरो यातो मत्कृत्यं तनयश्चरेत् /
तच्छत्वा वचनं राज्ञो वामदेवो ऽब्रवीदिदम् //
text_mt:
Free to act as I please, I have departed; let my son perform my duty.
Having heard that speech of the king, Vāmadeva said this:

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhi paramaṃ kṛtyaṃ putrasya nṛpapuṅgavaṃ /
yatkleśātpitaraṃ premṇā vimocayati sarvadā //
meaning:
एतद्धि परमं कृत्यं पुत्रस्य नृपपुङ्गवं /
यत्क्लेशात्पितरं प्रेम्णा विमोचयति सर्वदा //
text_mt: "Indeed, this is the supreme duty of a son, O best of kings: / that out of love he always relieves his father from distress.

sanskrit_iast:
piturvacanakārī ca manovākkāyaśaktitaḥ /
tasya bhāgīrathīsnānamahanyahani jāyate //
meaning:
पितुर्वचनकारी च मनोवाक्कायशक्तितः /
तस्य भागीरथीस्नानमहन्यहनि जायते //
text_mt: And for him who carries out his father's command according to the capacity of mind, speech, and body, / a bath in the Bhāgīrathī takes place day after day.

sanskrit_iast:
nirasya pitṛvākyaṃ tu vrajetsnātuṃ surāpagām /
no śuddhistasya putrasya itītthaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
निरस्य पितृवाक्यं तु व्रजेत्स्नातुं सुरापगाम् /
नो शुद्धिस्तस्य पुत्रस्य इतीत्थं वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: If, however, having rejected a father's word, a son should go to bathe in the river of the gods, / there is no purification for that son: such is the Vedic tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ gaccha yathākāmaṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'si bhūpate /
hariprasādātte jāto vaṃśe putraḥ sa puṇyakṛt //
meaning:
स त्वं गच्छ यथाकामं कृतकृत्यो ऽसि भूपते /
हरिप्रसादात्ते जातो वंशे पुत्रः स पुण्यकृत् //
text_mt: Go, therefore, as you desire, O king; you have accomplished your duty. / By the grace of Hari, that son who does virtuous deeds was born in your lineage."

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte tu muninā samāruhya turaṅgamam /
yayau śīghragatiḥ śrīmānsadāgatiriva svayam //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते तु मुनिना समारुह्य तुरङ्गमम् /
ययौ शीघ्रगतिः श्रीमान्सदागतिरिव स्वयम् //
text_mt: When the sage had spoken thus, having mounted a horse, / the glorious one set out at rapid speed, like the wind itself.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣyamāṇo girīnsarvānvanāni saritastathā /
sarvāścaryāṇi rājendraḥ sarāṃsyupavanāni ca //
meaning:
वीक्ष्यमाणो गिरीन्सर्वान्वनानि सरितस्तथा /
सर्वाश्चर्याणि राजेन्द्रः सरांस्युपवनानि च //
text_mt: Observing all the mountains, and likewise forests and rivers, / all kinds of wonders, lakes, and groves, the king of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'cireṇaiva kālena saṃprāpto mandarācalam /
bhrāmayitvā giriṃ śvetaṃ gandhamādanameva ca //
meaning:
सो ऽचिरेणैव कालेन संप्राप्तो मन्दराचलम् /
भ्रामयित्वा गिरिं श्वेतं गन्धमादनमेव च //
text_mt: in no long time reached Mount Mandara, / having circled round Mount Śveta and Gandhamādana,

sanskrit_iast:
atītya ca mahāmeruṃ dṛṣṭvā caivottarānkurūn /
śatasūryapratīkāśaṃ sarvataḥ kāñcanāvṛtam //
meaning:
अतीत्य च महामेरुं दृष्ट्वा चैवोत्तरान्कुरून् /
शतसूर्यप्रतीकाशं सर्वतः काञ्चनावृतम् //
text_mt: and having passed Mahāmeru, and seen the Northern Kurus—/ [Mandara] resembling a hundred suns, completely covered in gold,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃghṛṣṭaṃ haribāhubhyāṃ sravantaṃ kāñcanaṃ rasam /
tadbhūbhāgaṃ nagākīrṇaṃ bahudhātuvibhūṣitam //
meaning:
संघृष्टं हरिबाहुभ्यां स्रवन्तं काञ्चनं रसम् /
तद्भूभागं नगाकीर्णं बहुधातुविभूषितम् //
text_mt: rubbed by the arms of Hari, flowing with golden sap, / its region of earth crowded with mountains, adorned with many ores,

sanskrit_iast:
bahunirjharasaṃyuktaṃ bahukandarabhūṣitam /
nimnāgāyutasaṃpūrṇaṃ dhautaṃ gaṅgājalaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
बहुनिर्झरसंयुक्तं बहुकन्दरभूषितम् /
निम्नागायुतसंपूर्णं धौतं गङ्गाजलैः शुभैः //
text_mt: accompanied by many waterfalls, adorned with many caves, / filled with myriads of rivers, washed by the auspicious waters of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvastairyuvatīvṛndaiḥ kāntāśarmopasevibhiḥ /
ghaṭapramāṇairnṛpate paripakvaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वस्तैर्युवतीवृन्दैः कान्ताशर्मोपसेविभिः /
घटप्रमाणैर्नृपते परिपक्वैः सुगन्धिभिः //
text_mt: frequented by confident troops of young women enjoying the comfort of their lovers, / [adorned] with ripe, fragrant fruits the size of water-jars, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
phalairyuvatisaṃbhūtaiḥ kucairiva vibhūṣitam /
dvirephadhvanisaṃyuktaṃ kokilasvaranāditam //
meaning:
फलैर्युवतिसंभूतैः कुचैरिव विभूषितम् /
द्विरेफध्वनिसंयुक्तं कोकिलस्वरनादितम् //
text_mt: which were like breasts growing upon young women, / accompanied by the buzzing of bees, resounded with the songs of cuckoos,

sanskrit_iast:
anekasattvavirutaiḥ samantānnāditaṃ girim /
saṃpaśyamāno nṛpatirviveśa sa mahāgirim //
meaning:
अनेकसत्त्वविरुतैः समन्तान्नादितं गिरिम् /
संपश्यमानो नृपतिर्विवेश स महागिरिम् //
text_mt: the mountain resounded on all sides with the cries of various creatures—/ looking upon that great mountain, the king entered it.

sanskrit_iast:
āroḍhukāmastu kutūhalāttamanveṣayankena pathā praroham /
sa vīkṣate yāvadasau samantāttāvatsamastaṃ drumapakṣisaṃgham //
meaning:
आरोढुकामस्तु कुतूहलात्तमन्वेषयन्केन पथा प्ररोहम् /
स वीक्षते यावदसौ समन्तात्तावत्समस्तं द्रुमपक्षिसंघम् //
text_mt: Desiring to climb it out of curiosity, he sought out by which path to ascend; / as he looked all around, [he saw] the whole flock of birds in the trees

sanskrit_iast:
visarpamāṇaṃ dhvaninā gṛhītaṃ vimohinīvaktrasamudbhavena /
upaplavantaṃ tarasā mahīpastenaiva sārddhaṃ sa jagāma tūrṇam //
meaning:
विसर्पमाणं ध्वनिना गृहीतं विमोहिनीवक्त्रसमुद्भवेन /
उपप्लवन्तं तरसा महीपस्तेनैव सार्द्धं स जगाम तूर्णम् //
text_mt: gliding forth, captivated by a sound originating from the mouth of Vimohinī, / fluttering quickly away; and with them the ruler of the earth went swiftly along.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi karṇe dhvanirāviveśa vimohinīvaktrasamudbhavo yaḥ /
vimohito yena vimucya vāhaṃ trivikrameṇeva vilaṅghyamānam //
meaning:
तस्यापि कर्णे ध्वनिराविवेश विमोहिनीवक्त्रसमुद्भवो यः /
विमोहितो येन विमुच्य वाहं त्रिविक्रमेणेव विलङ्घ्यमानम् //
text_mt: The sound originating from Vimohinī's mouth entered his ears as well, / bewitched by which, leaving his mount that was traversing [the path] like Trivikrama,

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaṃ girermohinigītamugdhaṃ kṣaṇena rājā sahasā dadarśa /
girau sthitāṃ taptasuvarṇabhāsaṃ kāmasya yaṣṭīmiva nirmitāṃ ca //
meaning:
मार्गं गिरेर्मोहिनिगीतमुग्धं क्षणेन राजा सहसा ददर्श /
गिरौ स्थितां तप्तसुवर्णभासं कामस्य यष्टीमिव निर्मितां च //
text_mt: the king, enchanted by Mohinī’s song, suddenly beheld in a moment the path of the mountain, / and [her] standing on the mountain, shining like heated gold, looking like a staff fashioned by the god of love,

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasya liṅgaṃ gagane prasaktaṃ saṃpūjayantīmiva lokasūtyai /
kṣamāsvarūpāmiva vai rasāyā gireḥ sutāyā iva rūparāśim //
meaning:
शक्रस्य लिङ्गं गगने प्रसक्तं संपूजयन्तीमिव लोकसूत्यै /
क्षमास्वरूपामिव वै रसाया गिरेः सुताया इव रूपराशिम् //
text_mt: as if worshiping the liṅga of Indra attached to the sky for the generation of the worlds, / as if the very embodiment of the earth's patience, an abundance of beauty like that of the mountain's daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhostu velāmiva rūpayuktāṃ tasyāstanuṃ vai ratimandirākhyām /
vikarṣamāṇāṃ sahasā trinetraṃ liṅgāśrayaṃ devavinodanārtham //
meaning:
सिंधोस्तु वेलामिव रूपयुक्तां तस्यास्तनुं वै रतिमन्दिराख्याम् /
विकर्षमाणां सहसा त्रिनेत्रं लिङ्गाश्रयं देवविनोदनार्थम् //
text_mt: like the ocean shore endowed with form, her body indeed called the abode of love, / suddenly drawing the three-eyed one residing in the liṅga for the gods' diversion.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuṇyakartturmanasābhilāṣāṃ vyavasthito mohinirūpadarśī /
vimohito 'sau nipapāta rājā vimohinīkāmaśareṇa viddhaḥ //
meaning:
तत्पुण्यकर्त्तुर्मनसाभिलाषां व्यवस्थितो मोहिनिरूपदर्शी /
विमोहितो ऽसौ निपपात राजा विमोहिनीकामशरेण विद्धः //
text_mt: Standing there and beholding Mohinī's beauty, yearning in his heart for the performer of that merit, / the king, enchanted and pierced by Vimohinī’s arrow of desire, fell down.

sanskrit_iast:
jvareṇa tīvreṇa gṛhītadehaḥ samīpamasyāḥ sa sasarpa śīghram /
visarpiṇaṃ bhūmipatiṃ sunetrā vilokayāmāsa kaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā //
meaning:
ज्वरेण तीव्रेण गृहीतदेहः समीपमस्याः स ससर्प शीघ्रम् /
विसर्पिणं भूमिपतिं सुनेत्रा विलोकयामास कटाक्षदृष्ट्या //
text_mt: His body seized by a burning fever, he crept quickly to her presence; / the fair-eyed one observed the approaching ruler of the earth with a sidelong glance.

sanskrit_iast:
vimucya vīṇāṃ virarāma gītātpāptaṃ ca kāryaṃ sahasaiva mene /
vidhūnayantī mṛgapakṣisaghānsuvāsasā gaṇḍabhujau nivārya //
meaning:
विमुच्य वीणां विरराम गीतात्पाप्तं च कार्यं सहसैव मेने /
विधूनयन्ती मृगपक्षिसघान्सुवाससा गण्डभुजौ निवार्य //
text_mt: Laying aside her lute, she ceased from singing and at once deemed her purpose accomplished; / waving away the flocks of deer and birds, covering her cheeks and arms with fine garments,

sanskrit_iast:
śilīmukhān śvāsasugandhamugdhān jagāma devī nṛpateḥ samīpam /
tyaktvā haraṃ pūjyatamaṃ suliṅgaṃ gagatvā tu pārśve tamudāraceṣṭā //
meaning:
शिलीमुखान् श्वाससुगन्धमुग्धान् जगाम देवी नृपतेः समीपम् /
त्यक्त्वा हरं पूज्यतमं सुलिङ्गं गगत्वा तु पार्श्वे तमुदारचेष्टा //
text_mt: and [brushing away] bees intoxicated by the sweet fragrance of her breath, the goddess approached the king; / leaving the most worshipful Hara, the noble liṅga, and going beside him, she of noble actions,

sanskrit_iast:
vimohinī nīrarajapatranetrā uvāca vākyaṃ madhuraṃ manojñam /
rukmāṅgadaṃ kāmaśarābhitaptamuttiṣṭha rājanvaśagā tavāham //
meaning:
विमोहिनी नीररजपत्रनेत्रा उवाच वाक्यं मधुरं मनोज्ञम् /
रुक्माङ्गदं कामशराभितप्तमुत्तिष्ठ राजन्वशगा तवाहम् //
text_mt: Vimohinī, whose eyes were like lotus petals, spoke these sweet and pleasing words / to Rukmāṅgada, who was scorched by the arrows of desire: "Rise, O king, I am under your command.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ mūrcchayā dehamimaṃ kṣiṇoṣi yastvaṃ dharābhāramimaṃ mahāntam /
tṛṇīkṛtaṃ bhūpa samudvahethā yanmāmakaṃ rūpamavekṣya hāri //
meaning:
किं मूर्च्छया देहमिमं क्षिणोषि यस्त्वं धराभारमिमं महान्तम् /
तृणीकृतं भूप समुद्वहेथा यन्मामकं रूपमवेक्ष्य हारि //
text_mt: Why do you waste away this body with fainting, you who / bear this great burden of the earth as if it were a blade of grass, O king, having seen my captivating form?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ muhyase durbalagauriveha paṅke nimagnā bhava tvam /
dhīro 'si viḍaṃbayethāḥ kimarthamātmānamudāraceṣṭam //
meaning:
किं मुह्यसे दुर्बलगौरिवेह पङ्के निमग्ना भव त्वम् /
धीरो ऽसि विडंबयेथाः किमर्थमात्मानमुदारचेष्टम् //
text_mt: Why are you bewildered, like a feeble cow sunk in mud here? / You are steadfast; why should you demean yourself, whose deeds are noble?

sanskrit_iast:
yadyasti vāñchā tava bhūpatīśa mamānukūle surate 'tihṛdye /
pradāya dānaṃ ca sudharmamuktaṃ bhuṅkṣva svadāsīmiva māṃ ratijñām //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarebhāge mohinīdarśanaṃ nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यद्यस्ति वाञ्छा तव भूपतीश ममानुकूले सुरते ऽतिहृद्ये /
प्रदाय दानं च सुधर्ममुक्तं भुङ्क्ष्व स्वदासीमिव मां रतिज्ञाम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरेभागे मोहिनीदर्शनं नाम एकादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
If you desire, O lord of kings, very delightful lovemaking agreeable to me, / then having given the gift prescribed by righteous law, enjoy me, skilled in passion, like your own slave!"

Thus ends the eleventh chapter, named 'The Sight of Mohinī', in the second part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭa uvāca
vyāhṛte śobhane vākye mohinyā nṛpatistadā /
unmīlya netre rājendra śatapatranibhe tathā //
meaning:
वसिष्ट उवाच
व्याहृते शोभने वाक्ये मोहिन्या नृपतिस्तदा /
उन्मील्य नेत्रे राजेन्द्र शतपत्रनिभे तथा //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
When those charming words were spoken by Mohinī, the king then / opened his eyes resembling lotuses, O king of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
sagadgadamuvācedaṃ mugdho mohinidarśanāt /
mayā bāle subahuśaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ //
meaning:
सगद्गदमुवाचेदं मुग्धो मोहिनिदर्शनात् /
मया बाले सुबहुशः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः //
text_mt: and, enchanted by the sight of Mohinī, spoke these words with a choked voice: / "O maiden, many women with faces like the full moon

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭāstathānubhūtāśca nedṛgdṛṣṭaṃ vapuḥ kvacit /
yādṛśaṃ tvaṃ dhārayase rūpaṃ lokavimohanam //
meaning:
दृष्टास्तथानुभूताश्च नेदृग्दृष्टं वपुः क्वचित् /
यादृशं त्वं धारयसे रूपं लोकविमोहनम् //
text_mt: have been seen and experienced by me, but nowhere have I seen such a form / as this world-enchanting beauty which you bear.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ darśanamātreṇa tvadīyena varānane /
manobhavaśarairviddhaḥ patitaḥ sahasā kṣitau /
ajalpitavaco devi mohitastava tejasā //
meaning:
सो ऽहं दर्शनमात्रेण त्वदीयेन वरानने /
मनोभवशरैर्विद्धः पतितः सहसा क्षितौ /
अजल्पितवचो देवि मोहितस्तव तेजसा //
text_mt: Merely by the sight of you, O fair-faced one, / pierced by the arrows of the mind-born god, I fell suddenly to the earth, / unable to speak a word, O goddess, bewildered by your splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
kuru prasādaṃ karabhoru mahyaṃ dāsyāmi sarvaṃ tava cittasaṃstham /
nādeyamastīha jagattraye 'pi tavānurāgeṇa nibaddhacetasaḥ //
meaning:
कुरु प्रसादं करभोरु मह्यं दास्यामि सर्वं तव चित्तसंस्थम् /
नादेयमस्तीह जगत्त्रये ऽपि तवानुरागेण निबद्धचेतसः //
text_mt: Show favour to me, O woman with thighs like an elephant's trunk! I shall grant everything in your heart; / for there is nothing in all the three worlds that cannot be given by me whose mind is bound by love for you.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ dharāṃ bhūdharabhūṣitāṅgīṃ samudravastrāṃ śaśisūryanetrām /
ghanastanīṃ vyomasubaddhadehāṃ niṣkānanāṃ suṃdari vāmaśīlām //
meaning:
इमां धरां भूधरभूषिताङ्गीं समुद्रवस्त्रां शशिसूर्यनेत्राम् /
घनस्तनीं व्योमसुबद्धदेहां निष्काननां सुंदरि वामशीलाम् //
text_mt: This earth, her limbs adorned by mountains, robed in the ocean, her eyes the moon and sun, / heavy-breasted, her body bound to the sky, devoid of wilderness, O beautiful one of adverse nature,

sanskrit_iast:
pātālaguhyāṃ bahuvṛkṣaromṇīṃ saptādharāṃ subhru tavāsmi dātā /
sakośabaddhāṃ gajavājipūrṇāṃ samantrihṛdyāṃ nagaraiḥ sametām //
meaning:
पातालगुह्यां बहुवृक्षरोम्णीं सप्ताधरां सुभ्रु तवास्मि दाता /
सकोशबद्धां गजवाजिपूर्णां समन्त्रिहृद्यां नगरैः समेताम् //
text_mt: her secret parts the underworld, her hairs the many trees, resting on seven supports, O fair-browed one, I shall give to you, / along with the treasury, filled with elephants and horses, delightful to ministers, and united with cities.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānamapi dāsyāmi tavā cārvaṅgi saṃgame /
kiṃ punarddhanaratnādi prasīda mama mohini //
meaning:
आत्मानमपि दास्यामि तवा चार्वङ्गि संगमे /
किं पुनर्द्धनरत्नादि प्रसीद मम मोहिनि //
text_mt: I shall give even myself for union with you, O lovely-limbed one; / what need be said of wealth, gems, and the like? Be gracious to me, O Mohinī!"

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā mohinī madhurākṣaram /
samuvāca smitaṃ kṛtvā tamutthāpya nṛpaṃ tadā //
meaning:
नृपस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा मोहिनी मधुराक्षरम् /
समुवाच स्मितं कृत्वा तमुत्थाप्य नृपं तदा //
text_mt: Hearing the king's sweet-spoken words, / Mohinī smiled, raised the king up, and then spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
na dharāṃ bhūdharopetāṃ varaye vasudhādhipa /
yadvidiṣyāmyahaṃ kāla tatkāryamaviśaṅkayā //
meaning:
न धरां भूधरोपेतां वरये वसुधाधिप /
यद्विदिष्याम्यहं काल तत्कार्यमविशङ्कया //
text_mt: "I do not choose the earth with its mountains, O lord of the earth! / Whatever I shall instruct in due time, that must be done without hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajiṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ kuruṣva samayaṃ mama /
rājovāca
yena saṃtuṣyase devi samayaṃ taṃ karomyaham //
meaning:
भजिष्यामि न संदेहः कुरुष्व समयं मम /
राजोवाच
येन संतुष्यसे देवि समयं तं करोम्यहम् //
text_mt:
I will attend upon you, there is no doubt; make an agreement with me."
The king said: / "O goddess, by whatever you are satisfied, I make that agreement.

sanskrit_iast: daśāvasthāṃ gato deho mama tvatsaṃgamaṃ vinā //
meaning: दशावस्थां गतो देहो मम त्वत्संगमं विना //
text_mt: My body has fallen into the ten states [of lovesickness] without union with you."

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
dīyatāṃ dakṣiṇo hasto bahudharmakarastava /
yena me pratyayo rājan vacane tāvake bhavet //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
दीयतां दक्षिणो हस्तो बहुधर्मकरस्तव /
येन मे प्रत्ययो राजन् वचने तावके भवेत् //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / "Let your right hand, which has performed much righteousness, be given, / so that, O king, I may have trust in your word.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā tvaṃ dharmaśīlo 'si satyakīrtirjagattraye /
na vaktāsyanṛtaṃ kāle mārgāyaṃ laukikaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
राजा त्वं धर्मशीलो ऽसि सत्यकीर्तिर्जगत्त्रये /
न वक्तास्यनृतं काले मार्गायं लौकिकः कृतः //
text_mt: You are a king devoted to righteousness, whose fame for truth is renowned in the three worlds. / You will not speak an untruth when the time comes; this worldly path has been established."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bravāṇāṃ rājendro mohinīṃ hṛcchayāturaḥ /
abravīnnṛpatistāṃ tu suprasannamanā nṛpa //
meaning:
एवं ब्रवाणां राजेन्द्रो मोहिनीं हृच्छयातुरः /
अब्रवीन्नृपतिस्तां तु सुप्रसन्नमना नृप //
text_mt: To Mohinī speaking thus, the king, afflicted with love— / the king, with a very delighted mind, spoke to her, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
janmaprabhṛti vāmoru nānṛtaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā /
svaireṣvapi vihāreṣu kadāpi varavāṇiṃni //
meaning:
जन्मप्रभृति वामोरु नानृतं भाषितं मया /
स्वैरेष्वपि विहारेषु कदापि वरवाणिंनि //
text_mt: "From my birth onward, O fair-thighed one, an untruth has never been spoken by me, / even in playful amusements at any time, O lady of excellent speech!

sanskrit_iast:
athavā vyāhṛtairvākyaiḥ kimebhiḥ pratyayākṣaraiḥ /
dato hyeṣa mayā hasto dakṣiṇaḥ puṇyalāñchanaḥ //
meaning:
अथवा व्याहृतैर्वाक्यैः किमेभिः प्रत्ययाक्षरैः /
दतो ह्येष मया हस्तो दक्षिणः पुण्यलाञ्छनः //
text_mt: Or rather, what need is there of these words spoken as tokens of trust? / Indeed, this right hand marked with merit is given by me.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcitkṛtamājanma sundari /
tatsarvaṃ tava vāmoru yadi kuryānna te vacaḥ //
meaning:
यन्मया सुकृतं किञ्चित्कृतमाजन्म सुन्दरि /
तत्सर्वं तव वामोरु यदि कुर्यान्न ते वचः //
text_mt: Whatever good deed has been done by me since birth, O beautiful woman, / let all that belong to you, O fair-thighed one, if I do not carry out your word.

sanskrit_iast:
antare hyeṣa datto me dharmo bhāryā bhavāṅgane /
tava rūpeṇa me kṣobhaḥ sahasā pratyupasthitaḥ //
meaning:
अन्तरे ह्येष दत्तो मे धर्मो भार्या भवाङ्गने /
तव रूपेण मे क्षोभः सहसा प्रत्युपस्थितः //
text_mt: Indeed, this righteousness within me is given [as a pledge]: become my wife, O woman! / By your beauty, agitation has suddenly arisen within me.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtadhvajasutaścāhaṃ nāmnā rukmāṃ gado nṛpaḥ /
ikṣvākuvaśasaṃbhūtaḥ suto dharmāṅgado mama //
meaning:
ऋतध्वजसुतश्चाहं नाम्ना रुक्मां गदो नृपः /
इक्ष्वाकुवशसंभूतः सुतो धर्माङ्गदो मम //
text_mt: I am the son of Ṛtadhvaja, a king named Rukmāṅgada, / born in the lineage of Ikṣvāku; my son is Dharmāṅgada.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgavyājena gahanaṃ praviṣṭaścārulocane /
tato dṛṣṭo vane hṛdyo vāmadevāśramo mayā //
meaning:
मृगव्याजेन गहनं प्रविष्टश्चारुलोचने /
ततो दृष्टो वने हृद्यो वामदेवाश्रमो मया //
text_mt: Under the pretext of hunting deer, I entered the dense forest, O fair-eyed one; / then, in the forest, the charming hermitage of Vāmadeva was seen by me.

sanskrit_iast:
muninā jalpitaṃ tatra kiñcittena visarjitaḥ /
āruhya vāhanaśreṣṭhaṃmandaraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ //
meaning:
मुनिना जल्पितं तत्र किञ्चित्तेन विसर्जितः /
आरुह्य वाहनश्रेष्ठंमन्दरं द्रष्टुमागतः //
text_mt: A little was spoken there by the sage, and dismissed by him, / having mounted my excellent mount, I came to see Mount Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramamāṇo girivaraṃ kutūhalamanāstadā /
prāptaṃ macchravaṇe gītaṃ tava vaktravinirgatam //
meaning:
भ्रममाणो गिरिवरं कुतूहलमनास्तदा /
प्राप्तं मच्छ्रवणे गीतं तव वक्त्रविनिर्गतम् //
text_mt: Wandering about the excellent mountain then with a curious mind, / a song that issued from your mouth reached my ears.

sanskrit_iast:
tena gītena cākṛṣṭastvatsamīpamupāgataḥ /
dṛṣṭeḥ pathamanuprāptā mama tvaṃ cārulocane //
meaning:
तेन गीतेन चाकृष्टस्त्वत्समीपमुपागतः /
दृष्टेः पथमनुप्राप्ता मम त्वं चारुलोचने //
text_mt: Drawn by that song, I came near you, / and you came within the range of my sight, O fair-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ mūrcchito devi visaṃjñaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau /
sāṃprataṃ cetanāyuktastava vākyāmṛtena hi //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं मूर्च्छितो देवि विसंज्ञः पतितः क्षितौ /
सांप्रतं चेतनायुक्तस्तव वाक्यामृतेन हि //
text_mt: Then, O goddess, I fainted, fell unconscious to the ground; / now, indeed, I am endowed with consciousness by the nectar of your words.

sanskrit_iast:
punarjātamivātmānaṃ manye 'haṃ lokamohini /
pratyuttarapradānena prasādaṃ karttumarhasi //
meaning:
पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्ये ऽहं लोकमोहिनि /
प्रत्युत्तरप्रदानेन प्रसादं कर्त्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: I consider myself, as it were, born anew, O enchantress of the worlds! / You ought to show favor by giving an answer."

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpeṇaiva samuddiṣṭā mohinyāhottaraṃ vacaḥ /
ahaṃ brahmabhavā rājaṃstvadarthaṃ samupāgatā //
meaning:
नृपेणैव समुद्दिष्टा मोहिन्याहोत्तरं वचः /
अहं ब्रह्मभवा राजंस्त्वदर्थं समुपागता //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the king, Mohinī spoke a word in reply: / "O king, born of Brahmā, I have come here for your sake.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā kīrti smaropetā mandaraṃ kanakācalam /
parityajya surānsarvānviśvaṃbharapurogamān //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा कीर्ति स्मरोपेता मन्दरं कनकाचलम् /
परित्यज्य सुरान्सर्वान्विश्वंभरपुरोगमान् //
text_mt: Having heard of your fame, filled with love, [I came to] Mandara, the golden mountain, / having abandoned all the gods headed by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
samāhitamanāstvatra tapasyāniratā sthitā /
saṃpūjayantī deveśaṃ gītadānena śaṅkaram //
meaning:
समाहितमनास्त्वत्र तपस्यानिरता स्थिता /
संपूजयन्ती देवेशं गीतदानेन शङ्करम् //
text_mt: With a concentrated mind, devoted to austerity, I stood here, / worshiping Śaṅkara, the lord of gods, with the offering of song.

sanskrit_iast:
gītadānamahaṃ manye surāṇāmativallabham /
sarvadānādhikaṃ bhūpa hyanantagatidāyakam //
meaning:
गीतदानमहं मन्ये सुराणामतिवल्लभम् /
सर्वदानाधिकं भूप ह्यनन्तगतिदायकम् //
text_mt: I consider the offering of song to be exceedingly dear to the gods, / superior to all gifts, O king, and granting the endless goal.

sanskrit_iast:
yena tuṣṭaḥ paśupatiḥ sadyaḥ pratyupakārakaḥ /
īpsito 'yaṃ mayā prāpto bhavānavanipālakaḥ //
meaning:
येन तुष्टः पशुपतिः सद्यः प्रत्युपकारकः /
ईप्सितो ऽयं मया प्राप्तो भवानवनिपालकः //
text_mt: Pleased by this, Paśupati immediately conferred a reciprocal favor: / you, this desired protector of the earth, have been attained by me.

sanskrit_iast: abhiprīto 'si me rājannabhiprītā hyahaṃ tava //
meaning: अभिप्रीतो ऽसि मे राजन्नभिप्रीता ह्यहं तव //
text_mt: You are loved by me, O king, and indeed I am loved by you."

sanskrit_iast:
tamevaṃ muktvā dvijarājavaktrā karaṃ gṛhītvā nṛpatestu vegāt /
utthāpayāmāsa dharāśayānamindrasya yaṣṭīmiva mohinī sā //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge samayakaraṇaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तमेवं मुक्त्वा द्विजराजवक्त्रा करं गृहीत्वा नृपतेस्तु वेगात् /
उत्थापयामास धराशयानमिन्द्रस्य यष्टीमिव मोहिनी सा //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे समयकरणं नाम द्वादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to him, that Mohinī, whose face was like the full moon, / quickly took the king's hand and raised him up as he lay on the earth, like Indra's flagstaff.

Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named 'The Making of the Agreement,' in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
utthāpayitvā rājānaṃ mohinī vākyamabravīt /
mā śaṅkāṃ kuru rājendra kumārīṃ viddhyakalmaṣām //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
उत्थापयित्वा राजानं मोहिनी वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
मा शङ्कां कुरु राजेन्द्र कुमारीं विद्ध्यकल्मषाम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having raised up the king, Mohinī spoke these words: / "Do not doubt, O king of kings; know me to be an unblemished maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
udvahasva mahīpāla gṛhyoktavidhinā hi mām /
anūḍhā kanyakā rājan yadi garbhaṃ bibharti hi //
meaning:
उद्वहस्व महीपाल गृह्योक्तविधिना हि माम् /
अनूढा कन्यका राजन् यदि गर्भं बिभर्ति हि //
text_mt: Marry me, O protector of the earth, according to the rule prescribed in the Gṛhyasūtras. / For if an unmarried maiden bears an embryo, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
prasūyati divākīrtiṃ sarvavarṇavigarhitam /
cāṇḍālayonayastisraḥ purāṇe kavayo viduḥ //
meaning:
प्रसूयति दिवाकीर्तिं सर्ववर्णविगर्हितम् /
चाण्डालयोनयस्तिस्रः पुराणे कवयो विदुः //
text_mt: she gives birth to a Caṇḍāla, despised by all varnas. / Wise poets know three wombs of Caṇḍālas in the Purāṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
kumārīsaṃbhavātvekā sagotrāpi dvitīyakā /
brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrajanitā tṛtīyā nṛpapuṅgava //
meaning:
कुमारीसंभवात्वेका सगोत्रापि द्वितीयका /
ब्राह्मण्यां शूद्रजनिता तृतीया नृपपुङ्गव //
text_mt: one born of an unmarried maiden, the second also from one of the same gotra, / and the third begotten by a Śūdra on a Brahmin woman, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmātkāraṇādrājan kumārīṃ māṃ samudvaha /
tatastāṃ capalāpāṅgīṃ nṛpo rukmāṅgado girau //
meaning:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजन् कुमारीं मां समुद्वह /
ततस्तां चपलापाङ्गीं नृपो रुक्माङ्गदो गिरौ //
text_mt: For this reason, O king, marry me, a maiden." / Thereupon, on the mountain, King Rukmāṅgada, having married that woman

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhya vidhinā yuktastasthau rājā hasanniva /
rājovāca
na tathā tridivaprāptiḥ prīṇayenmāṃ varānane //
meaning:
उद्वाह्य विधिना युक्तस्तस्थौ राजा हसन्निव /
राजोवाच
न तथा त्रिदिवप्राप्तिः प्रीणयेन्मां वरानने //
text_mt: with restless eye-corners in accordance with the proper rite, stood as though smiling. / The king said: / "Attainment of heaven would not delight me so much, O fair-faced woman,

sanskrit_iast:
tavaprāptiryathā devi mandare 'sminsukhāya vai /
manye purandarāddevi hyātmānamadhikaṃ kṣitau //
meaning:
तवप्राप्तिर्यथा देवि मन्दरे ऽस्मिन्सुखाय वै /
मन्ये पुरन्दराद्देवि ह्यात्मानमधिकं क्षितौ //
text_mt: as attainment of you on this Mount Mandara brings happiness, O goddess! / Indeed, O goddess, I consider myself greater on earth than Purandara.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasundarīṃ prāpya bhāryāṃ tvāṃ cārulocane /
tasmādyadanukūlaṃ te tatkaromi praśādhi mām //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरीं प्राप्य भार्यां त्वां चारुलोचने /
तस्माद्यदनुकूलं ते तत्करोमि प्रशाधि माम् //
text_mt: having obtained you, the beauty of the three worlds, as my wife, O fair-eyed one! / Therefore, whatever is agreeable to you, that I shall do; command me!

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva ramase bāle athavā mandire mama /
malaye meruśikhare vane vā nandane vada //
meaning:
इहैव रमसे बाले अथवा मन्दिरे मम /
मलये मेरुशिखरे वने वा नन्दने वद //
text_mt: Do you wish to sport right here, O young woman, or in my palace, / on the Malaya mountain, on the peak of Meru, or in the Nandana forest? Tell me."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā nṛpatervākyaṃ mohinī madhuraṃ nṛpa /
uvācānuśayaṃ rājanvacanaṃ prītivarddhanam //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतेर्वाक्यं मोहिनी मधुरं नृप /
उवाचानुशयं राजन्वचनं प्रीतिवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: Hearing that sweet speech of the king, O king, / Mohinī spoke words of concern, O king, that increased his affection:

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnīnāṃ kaṭākṣāṇāṃ kṣatāni nagare mama /
bhaviṣyanti mahīpāla kathaṃ gacchāmi te puram //
meaning:
सपत्नीनां कटाक्षाणां क्षतानि नगरे मम /
भविष्यन्ति महीपाल कथं गच्छामि ते पुरम् //
text_mt: "In your city, O protector of the earth, there will be wounds / from the side-glances of co-wives for me; how can I go to your city?

sanskrit_iast:
māsma sīmantinī kācidbhaveddhi kṣitimaṇḍale /
yasyāḥ sapatnīprabhavaṃ duḥkhamāmaraṇaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
मास्म सीमन्तिनी काचिद्भवेद्धि क्षितिमण्डले /
यस्याः सपत्नीप्रभवं दुःखमामरणं भवेत् //
text_mt: Let no married woman ever exist on the face of the earth / for whom there is sorrow arising from a co-wife until death!

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaṃ labdhā mahīpāla manasā vaśagā tava /
jñātvā sapatnīprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhartā kṛto mayā //
meaning:
साहं लब्धा महीपाल मनसा वशगा तव /
ज्ञात्वा सपत्नीप्रभवं दुःखं भर्ता कृतो मया //
text_mt: I, obtained by you, O protector of the earth, submissive to you in mind, / have accepted you as my husband, knowing well the sorrow arising from a co-wife.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsyāmi parvataśreṣṭhe bahvāścaryasamanvite /
na tvaṃ vasasi rājendra saṃdhyāvalyā vinā kvacit //
meaning:
वत्स्यामि पर्वतश्रेष्ठे बह्वाश्चर्यसमन्विते /
न त्वं वससि राजेन्द्र संध्यावल्या विना क्वचित् //
text_mt: I would dwell on this excellent mountain endowed with many wonders, / but you do not dwell anywhere, O king of kings, without Saṃdhyāvalī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstvaṃ virahe duḥkhī saputrāyā bhaviṣyasi /
duḥkhena bhavato rājanbhūri duḥkhaṃ bhavenmama //
meaning:
तस्यास्त्वं विरहे दुःखी सपुत्राया भविष्यसि /
दुःखेन भवतो राजन्भूरि दुःखं भवेन्मम //
text_mt: In separation from her, who has your son, you will become sorrowful; / through your sorrow, O king, great sorrow would be mine.

sanskrit_iast:
yatraiva bhavataḥ saukhyaṃ tatrāhamapi saṃsthitā /
yatra tvaṃ raṃsyase rājaṃstatra me mandaro giriḥ //
meaning:
यत्रैव भवतः सौख्यं तत्राहमपि संस्थिता /
यत्र त्वं रंस्यसे राजंस्तत्र मे मन्दरो गिरिः //
text_mt: Wherever your happiness is, right there I also abide; / wherever you will take pleasure, O king, there is Mount Mandara for me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartṛsthāne hi vastavyamṛddhihīne 'pi bhāryayā /
sa meruḥ kāñcanamayaḥ sannidhāne pracakṣate //
meaning:
भर्तृस्थाने हि वस्तव्यमृद्धिहीने ऽपि भार्यया /
स मेरुः काञ्चनमयः सन्निधाने प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: For a wife must dwell at her husband's place, even if destitute of wealth; / it is declared to be golden Mount Meru in his presence.

sanskrit_iast:
manoratho nāma meruryatra tvaṃ ramase vibho /
bhartṛsthānaṃ parityajya svapiturvāpi varjitam //
meaning:
मनोरथो नाम मेरुर्यत्र त्वं रमसे विभो /
भर्तृस्थानं परित्यज्य स्वपितुर्वापि वर्जितम् //
text_mt: The realm of one's wish is called Meru, where you sport, O lord; / having abandoned the husband's abode, or leaving one's father's,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛsthānāśrayaratā nārī tamasi majjati /
sarvadharmavihīnāpi nārī bhavati sūkarī //
meaning:
पितृस्थानाश्रयरता नारी तमसि मज्जति /
सर्वधर्मविहीनापि नारी भवति सूकरी //
text_mt: a woman devoted to relying on her father's home sinks into darkness; / even if devoid of all duties, a woman [staying elsewhere] becomes a sow.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jānāmyahaṃ doṣaṃ kathaṃ vatsyāmi mandare /
mamiṣyāmitvayā sārddhamīśastvaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ //
meaning:
एवं जानाम्यहं दोषं कथं वत्स्यामि मन्दरे /
ममिष्यामित्वया सार्द्धमीशस्त्वं सुखदुःखयोः //
text_mt: Knowing such fault, how can I dwell on Mount Mandara? / I will go with you; you are the master of my happiness and sorrow."

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā rājā saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ /
pariṣvajya varārohāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
मोहिन्यास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा राजा संहृष्टमानसः /
परिष्वज्य वरारोहामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing those words of Mohinī, the king, with a delighted mind, / embraced that woman of shapely hips and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāṇāṃ mama sarvāsāmupariṣṭādbhaviṣyasi /
mā śaṅkāṃ kuru vāmoru yato duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
भार्याणां मम सर्वासामुपरिष्टाद्भविष्यसि /
मा शङ्कां कुरु वामोरु यतो दुःखं भविष्यति //
text_mt: "You will be supreme over all my wives; / do not worry, O fair-thighed one, that any sorrow will arise from that.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitādadhikā subhru bhaviṣyasi gṛhe mama /
ehi gacchāva tanvaṅgi sukhāya nagaraṃ prati //
meaning:
जीवितादधिका सुभ्रु भविष्यसि गृहे मम /
एहि गच्छाव तन्वङ्गि सुखाय नगरं प्रति //
text_mt: You will be dearer to me than life, O lovely-browed woman, in my house; / come, let us two go, O slender-limbed one, to the city for happiness.

sanskrit_iast: bhuṅkṣva bhogānmayā sārddhaṃ tatrasthā svecchayā priye //
meaning: भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्मया सार्द्धं तत्रस्था स्वेच्छया प्रिये //
text_mt: Dwelling there, enjoy pleasures together with me according to your desire, O beloved!"

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvevamuktā śaśigauravaktrā rukmāṅgadenātmavināśanāya /
saṃprasthitā nūpuragoṣayuktā vikarṣayantī girijātaśobhām //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīsaṃmohanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सा त्वेवमुक्ता शशिगौरवक्त्रा रुक्माङ्गदेनात्मविनाशनाय /
संप्रस्थिता नूपुरगोषयुक्ता विकर्षयन्ती गिरिजातशोभाम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीसंमोहनं नाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Addressed thus by Rukmāṅgada for his own destruction, that [woman] with a face fair as the moon, / accompanied by the sound of anklets, set forth, drawing away the beauty born of the mountain.

Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, entitled “The Enchantment of Mohinī,” in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃprasthitāvubhau rājangiriśīrṣāddharātalam /
paśyamānau bahūnbhāvāngirijātānmanoharamanoharān //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
संप्रस्थितावुभौ राजन्गिरिशीर्षाद्धरातलम् /
पश्यमानौ बहून्भावान्गिरिजातान्मनोहरमनोहरान् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Both of them set forth, O king, from the mountain peak to the surface of the earth, / gazing upon many captivating forms born of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidvidrumasaṃkāśāḥ kecidrajatasannibhāḥ /
kecinnīlasamaprakhyāḥ kecitkāñcanasatviṣaḥ //
meaning:
केचिद्विद्रुमसंकाशाः केचिद्रजतसन्निभाः /
केचिन्नीलसमप्रख्याः केचित्काञ्चनसत्विषः //
text_mt: Some resembled coral, some were like silver, / some appeared like sapphire, some possessed the luster of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
kecitsphāṭikavarṇābhā haritālanibhāḥ pare /
anyonyaśleṣatāṃ prāptau sakalaiḥ sthāvarairiva //
meaning:
केचित्स्फाटिकवर्णाभा हरितालनिभाः परे /
अन्योन्यश्लेषतां प्राप्तौ सकलैः स्थावरैरिव //
text_mt: some had the color of crystal, and others were like orpiment; / as if attaining mutual embrace with all stationary things.

sanskrit_iast:
saprāpya vasudhāṃ bhūpo hyapaśyadvājināṃ varam /
khanyamānaṃ khureṇorvī kuliśābhena veginā //
meaning:
सप्राप्य वसुधां भूपो ह्यपश्यद्वाजिनां वरम् /
खन्यमानं खुरेणोर्वी कुलिशाभेन वेगिना //
text_mt: Reaching the earth, the king beheld the best of horses, / digging the earth swiftly with its thunderbolt-like hoof.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya dārayataḥ pṛthvīṃ sutīkṣṇena khureṇa hi /
gṛhagodhābhavattasmin bhūbhāgāntargatā kila //
meaning:
तस्य दारयतः पृथ्वीं सुतीक्ष्णेन खुरेण हि /
गृहगोधाभवत्तस्मिन् भूभागान्तर्गता किल //
text_mt: As it tore the earth with its extremely sharp hoof, / there was a house-lizard within that piece of ground.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgacchamānā nṛpate khureṇa vidalīkṛtā /
vidīryamāṇāṃ nṛpatirapaśyatsa dayāparaḥ //
meaning:
निर्गच्छमाना नृपते खुरेण विदलीकृता /
विदीर्यमाणां नृपतिरपश्यत्स दयापरः //
text_mt: As it was coming out, O king, it was crushed and torn apart by the hoof; / seeing it being torn apart, that king, full of compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyadhāvata vegena hā hateti priyāṃ vadan /
tataḥ sa vṛkṣapatreṇa komalena mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
अभ्यधावत वेगेन हा हतेति प्रियां वदन् /
ततः स वृक्षपत्रेण कोमलेन महीपतिः //
text_mt: ran up with haste, crying out to his beloved, “Alas, it is struck!” / Then the lord of the earth, with a tender tree leaf,

sanskrit_iast:
utsārya tāṃ khurādāśu prākṣipattṛṇaśādvale /
tatastu mohinīṃ prāha prekṣya mūrcchāgatāṃ hi tām //
meaning:
उत्सार्य तां खुरादाशु प्राक्षिपत्तृणशाद्वले /
ततस्तु मोहिनीं प्राह प्रेक्ष्य मूर्च्छागतां हि ताम् //
text_mt: quickly removed it from the hoof and placed it on a grassy lawn; / then, seeing it fallen into unconsciousness, he said to Mohinī:

sanskrit_iast:
śīghramāhara cārvaṅgijalaṃ jalajalocane /
yena mūrcchāgatāṃ siṃce gṛhagodhāṃ vimardditām //
meaning:
शीघ्रमाहर चार्वङ्गिजलं जलजलोचने /
येन मूर्च्छागतां सिंचे गृहगोधां विमर्द्दिताम् //
text_mt: “Bring water quickly, O fair-limbed one, O lotus-eyed woman, / so that I may sprinkle the crushed house-lizard who has fainted.”

sanskrit_iast:
sā bharturvacanācchīghramānayacchītalaṃ jalam /
tenābhyaṣiṃ cannṛpatirgṛhagodhāṃ vimūrcchitām //
meaning:
सा भर्तुर्वचनाच्छीघ्रमानयच्छीतलं जलम् /
तेनाभ्यषिं चन्नृपतिर्गृहगोधां विमूर्च्छिताम् //
text_mt: At her husband’s command she quickly brought cool water; / with it the king sprinkled the swooning house-lizard.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa cetanāṃ rājan śītalājjalasecanāt /
abhighāteṣu sarveṣu śastaṃ vāriprasecanam //
meaning:
अवाप चेतनां राजन् शीतलाज्जलसेचनात् /
अभिघातेषु सर्वेषु शस्तं वारिप्रसेचनम् //
text_mt: It regained consciousness, O king, from the sprinkling of cool water; / in all cases of injury, the pouring of water is commended,

sanskrit_iast:
athavā klinnavastreṇa sahasā bandhanaṃ hitam /
saṃprāptacetanā bhūpa godhā vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
अथवा क्लिन्नवस्त्रेण सहसा बन्धनं हितम् /
संप्राप्तचेतना भूप गोधा वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: or else swift bandaging with a wet cloth is beneficial. / Having regained consciousness, O king, the lizard spoke these words,

sanskrit_iast:
rājānamagrato vīkṣya vedanārtā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ /
rukmāṅgada mahābāho nibodha mama ceṣṭitam //
meaning:
राजानमग्रतो वीक्ष्य वेदनार्ता शनैः शनैः /
रुक्माङ्गद महाबाहो निबोध मम चेष्टितम् //
text_mt: seeing the king before her, afflicted with pain, slowly and softly: / “O mighty-armed Rukmāṅgada, learn of my past deeds!

sanskrit_iast:
śākale nagare ramye bhāryāhaṃ hyagrajanmanaḥ /
rūpayauvanasaṃpannā tasya nātipriyā vibho //
meaning:
शाकले नगरे रम्ये भार्याहं ह्यग्रजन्मनः /
रूपयौवनसंपन्ना तस्य नातिप्रिया विभो //
text_mt: In the delightful city of Śākala, I was the wife of a brāhmaṇa; / endowed with beauty and youth, I was not dear to him, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā vidveṣasaṃyukto mayi niṣṭhurajalpakaḥ /
nānyasya kasyaciddveṣṭā sa tu me nṛpate patiḥ //
meaning:
सदा विद्वेषसंयुक्तो मयि निष्ठुरजल्पकः /
नान्यस्य कस्यचिद्द्वेष्टा स तु मे नृपते पतिः //
text_mt: He was always full of aversion toward me and spoke harshly; / he hated no one else, but he hated me, my husband, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ha krodhasaṃyuktā vaśīkaraṇalaṃbhanāt /
apṛcchaṃ pramadā rājanyāstyaktāḥ patibhiḥ kila //
meaning:
ततो ऽह क्रोधसंयुक्ता वशीकरणलंभनात् /
अपृच्छं प्रमदा राजन्यास्त्यक्ताः पतिभिः किल //
text_mt: Then, filled with wrath, in order to obtain a means of subjugation, / I questioned women, O king, who had been abandoned by their husbands.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiruktā hyahaṃ bhūpa vaśyo bhartā bhaviṣyati /
asmākaṃ pratyayo jāto bhartṛtyāgāvamānanāt //
meaning:
ताभिरुक्ता ह्यहं भूप वश्यो भर्ता भविष्यति /
अस्माकं प्रत्ययो जातो भर्तृत्यागावमाननात् //
text_mt: I was told by them, O king: ‘Your husband will become submissive. / We gained conviction after the humiliation of desertion by our husbands.

sanskrit_iast:
pravrajyābheṣajairvaśyā jātā hi patayastu naḥ /
tvaṃ pṛccha tāṃ varārohe dāsyate bheṣajaṃ śubham //
meaning:
प्रव्रज्याभेषजैर्वश्या जाता हि पतयस्तु नः /
त्वं पृच्छ तां वरारोहे दास्यते भेषजं शुभम् //
text_mt: Our husbands have indeed become submissive through the medicines of an ascetic nun; / ask her, O lady of fair hips, and she will give you an effective medicine.

sanskrit_iast:
na vikalpastvayā kāryo bhavitā dāsavatpatiḥ /
tato 'haṃ tvaritaṃ gatvā tāsāṃ vākyena bhūpate //
meaning:
न विकल्पस्त्वया कार्यो भविता दासवत्पतिः /
ततो ऽहं त्वरितं गत्वा तासां वाक्येन भूपते //
text_mt: You must have no hesitation; your husband will become like a servant.’ / Then, going swiftly according to their word, O ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādaḥ kathitastasyāḥ pṛcchantyā mama mānavaiḥ /
śatastaṃbhasamāyuktaḥ kāntimatsudhayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
प्रासादः कथितस्तस्याः पृच्छन्त्या मम मानवैः /
शतस्तंभसमायुक्तः कान्तिमत्सुधया युतः //
text_mt: her mansion was described to me as I inquired of the people; / it had a hundred pillars and was endowed with radiant whitewash.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya taṃ sutejaskāmapaśyaṃ brahyacāriṇīm /
prāvṛtāṃ dīrghavastreṇa sandhyārāgasavarṇinīm //
meaning:
प्रविश्य तं सुतेजस्कामपश्यं ब्रह्यचारिणीम् /
प्रावृतां दीर्घवस्त्रेण सन्ध्यारागसवर्णिनीम् //
text_mt: Entering it, I saw an ascetic woman of great splendor, / wrapped in a long garment of the color of twilight glow.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghābhiḥ sā jaṭābhistu saṃvṛtā dīptisayutā /
paricārakaistu saṃyuktā vījyamānā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घाभिः सा जटाभिस्तु संवृता दीप्तिसयुता /
परिचारकैस्तु संयुक्ता वीज्यमाना शनैः शनैः //
text_mt: She was endowed with radiant energy, covered by long matted locks; / attended by servants, she was being fanned slowly and gently.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣasūtrakarā sā tu japantī bhagamālinī /
sarvavaśyakaraṃ mantraṃ kṣobhakaṃ pratyayāvaham //
meaning:
अक्षसूत्रकरा सा तु जपन्ती भगमालिनी /
सर्ववश्यकरं मन्त्रं क्षोभकं प्रत्ययावहम् //
text_mt: Holding a rosary in her hand, she was reciting the Bhagamālinī [mantra], / a mantra that subjugates all, stirs [the mind], and brings conviction.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ praṇatā bhūtvā padbhyāṃ nyasyāṅgalīyakam /
mṛdukāñcanasaṃbhūtaṃ atiriktaprabhānvitam //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं प्रणता भूत्वा पद्भ्यां न्यस्याङ्गलीयकम् /
मृदुकाञ्चनसंभूतं अतिरिक्तप्रभान्वितम् //
text_mt: Then, bowing down, I placed at her feet a ring / made of soft gold and endowed with extraordinary luster.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hṛṣṭābhavaddṛṣṭvā padasthaṃ cāṅgulīyakam /
apṛṣṭayā tayā jñātaṃ mama bhartturvimānanam //
meaning:
ततो हृष्टाभवद्दृष्ट्वा पदस्थं चाङ्गुलीयकम् /
अपृष्टया तया ज्ञातं मम भर्त्तुर्विमाननम् //
text_mt: Then she became pleased upon seeing the ring at her feet; / without being asked, she understood my husband’s disrespect.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoktāhaṃ tato bhūpa tāpasyā praṇatā sthitā /
cūrṇo rakṣānvito hyeṣa sarvabhūtavaśānugaḥ //
meaning:
तयोक्ताहं ततो भूप तापस्या प्रणता स्थिता /
चूर्णो रक्षान्वितो ह्येष सर्वभूतवशानुगः //
text_mt: Then, O king, I was told by that female ascetic as I remained bowed: / ‘This powder, accompanied by an amulet, brings all living beings under control.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā bhartari saṃyojyo rakṣyaṃ grīvāśayāṅkuram /
bhaviṣyati patirvaśyo nānyāṃ yāsyati sundarīm //
meaning:
त्वया भर्तरि संयोज्यो रक्ष्यं ग्रीवाशयाङ्कुरम् /
भविष्यति पतिर्वश्यो नान्यां यास्यति सुन्दरीम् //
text_mt: You must administer it to your husband, and protect the sprout resting on the neck; / your husband will become submissive and will not go to any other beautiful woman.’

sanskrit_iast:
cūrṇarakṣāṃ gṛhītvāhaṃ prāptābhartṛgṛhaṃ punaḥ /
pradoṣe payasā yuktaścūrṇo bhartari yojitaḥ //
meaning:
चूर्णरक्षां गृहीत्वाहं प्राप्ताभर्तृगृहं पुनः /
प्रदोषे पयसा युक्तश्चूर्णो भर्तरि योजितः //
text_mt: Taking the powder and the amulet, I returned to my husband’s house; / at dusk, the powder mixed with milk was administered to my husband,

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāyāṃ hi kṛtā rakṣā na vicāro mayā kṛtaḥ /
yadā sa pītacūrṇastu bhartā nṛpavarottamā //
meaning:
ग्रीवायां हि कृता रक्षा न विचारो मया कृतः /
यदा स पीतचूर्णस्तु भर्ता नृपवरोत्तमा //
text_mt: and the amulet was placed on his neck; I did not reflect on the consequences. / When he, my husband, had drunk the powder, O best among kings,

sanskrit_iast:
tadahaḥ kṣayarogo 'bhūtpatiḥ kṣīṇo dine dine /
guhye tu krimayo jātāḥ kṣataduṣṭavraṇodbhavāḥ //
meaning:
तदहः क्षयरोगो ऽभूत्पतिः क्षीणो दिने दिने /
गुह्ये तु क्रिमयो जाताः क्षतदुष्टव्रणोद्भवाः //
text_mt: on that very day consumption arose, and my husband wasted away day by day; / and in his private parts worms appeared, arising from corrupt, suppurating sores.

sanskrit_iast:
dinaiḥ katipayairjātairdīpavadravidarśanāt /
hatatejāstathā bharttā māmuvācākulendriyaḥ //
meaning:
दिनैः कतिपयैर्जातैर्दीपवद्रविदर्शनात् /
हततेजास्तथा भर्त्ता मामुवाचाकुलेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: After a few days had passed, like a lamp at the sight of the sun, / my husband, his vigor destroyed, spoke to me, his senses bewildered,

sanskrit_iast:
krandamāno divā rātrau dāso 'smi tava śobhane /
trāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ na gaccheyaṃ paristriyam //
meaning:
क्रन्दमानो दिवा रात्रौ दासो ऽस्मि तव शोभने /
त्राहि मां शरणं प्राप्तं न गच्छेयं परिस्त्रियम् //
text_mt: weeping day and night: ‘I am your servant, O fair lady! / Save me, who have sought your refuge; I will not go to another woman!’

sanskrit_iast:
tattasya ruditaṃ śrutvā bhayabhītā mahīpate /
tasyāṃ niveditaṃ sarvaṃ kathaṃ bhartā bhavetsukhī //
meaning:
तत्तस्य रुदितं श्रुत्वा भयभीता महीपते /
तस्यां निवेदितं सर्वं कथं भर्ता भवेत्सुखी //
text_mt: Hearing that weeping of his, terrified with fear, O lord of the earth, / I reported everything to her: ‘How may my husband become well?’

sanskrit_iast:
tayāpi bheṣajaṃ dattaṃ dvitīyaṃ dāhaśāntaye /
datte tu bheṣaje tasminsustho 'bhūttatkṣaṇātpatiḥ //
meaning:
तयापि भेषजं दत्तं द्वितीयं दाहशान्तये /
दत्ते तु भेषजे तस्मिन्सुस्थो ऽभूत्तत्क्षणात्पतिः //
text_mt: She gave a second medicine to alleviate the burning sensation; / and when that medicine was administered, my husband became well at that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvacūrṇodbhavo dāhaḥ śāntastenauṣadhena ha /
tataḥ prabhṛti me bhartā vaśyo 'bhūdvacane sthitaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वचूर्णोद्भवो दाहः शान्तस्तेनौषधेन ह /
ततः प्रभृति मे भर्ता वश्यो ऽभूद्वचने स्थितः //
text_mt: The burning sensation produced by the previous powder was quelled by that medicine; / from that time onward, my husband became obedient and stood by my word.

sanskrit_iast:
kālena pañcatāṃ prāptā gatā narakayātanām /
tāmrabhrāṣṭre hyahaṃ dagdhā yugāni daśa pañca ca //
meaning:
कालेन पञ्चतां प्राप्ता गता नरकयातनाम् /
ताम्रभ्राष्ट्रे ह्यहं दग्धा युगानि दश पञ्च च //
text_mt: In the course of time I met my death and went to the torments of hell; / I was burned in a copper frying pan for fifteen yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmāṇi tilamātrāṇi kṛtvā khaṇḍānyanekaśaḥ /
kiñcitpātakaśeṣeṇa dharāyāmavatāritā //
meaning:
सूक्ष्माणि तिलमात्राणि कृत्वा खण्डान्यनेकशः /
किञ्चित्पातकशेषेण धरायामवतारिता //
text_mt: Cut into many minute pieces the size of sesame seeds, / with a small residue of sin remaining, I was brought down to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhagodhāmayaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtaṃ bhāskarajena me /
sāhamatra sthitā bhūpa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ purā //
meaning:
गृहगोधामयं रूपं कृतं भास्करजेन मे /
साहमत्र स्थिता भूप वर्षाणामयुतं पुरा //
text_mt: The form of a house-lizard was given to me by the son of the Sun (Yama); / and I have remained here, O king, for ten thousand years in the past.

sanskrit_iast:
yānyāpi yuvatirbhūpa bharturvaśyaṃ samācaret /
vṛthādharmā durācārā dahyate tāmrabhrāṣṭrake //
meaning:
यान्यापि युवतिर्भूप भर्तुर्वश्यं समाचरेत् /
वृथाधर्मा दुराचारा दह्यते ताम्रभ्राष्ट्रके //
