text_mt: An impure man does not attain righteousness, nor does a brāhmaṇa of harsh speech attain wealth; / one who does not ask never knows, and one who does not move goes nowhere.

sanskrit_iast:
aśiśyo na kriyāṃ vetti na bhayaṃ vetti jāgarī /
kasmādbhūpāla māṃ tyaktvā dharmāṅgadagṛhe śubhe //
meaning:
अशिश्यो न क्रियां वेत्ति न भयं वेत्ति जागरी /
कस्माद्भूपाल मां त्यक्त्वा धर्माङ्गदगृहे शुभे //
text_mt: One who is not a pupil knows not rites, nor does a watchful man know fear. / Why, O protector of the earth, having abandoned me in the auspicious house of Dharmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast: vīkṣyase rājyapadavīṃ samarthe tanaye vibho //
meaning: वीक्ष्यसे राज्यपदवीं समर्थे तनये विभो //
text_mt: do you watch over the royal office, O lord, when your son is capable?"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ brubāṇāṃ tanayāṃ vidhestu ratipriyāṃ cāruviśālanetrām /
vrīḍānvitaḥ putrasamīpavartī provāca vākyaṃ nṛpatiḥ priyāntām //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite mohinīvacanaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं ब्रुबाणां तनयां विधेस्तु रतिप्रियां चारुविशालनेत्राम् /
व्रीडान्वितः पुत्रसमीपवर्ती प्रोवाच वाक्यं नृपतिः प्रियान्ताम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते मोहिनीवचनं नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
To the daughter of Brahmā, fond of love, with beautiful wide eyes, speaking thus, / the king, standing near his son and filled with embarrassment, addressed words that were dear:

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'The Speech of Mohinī,' in the story of Mohinī in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
nādhikāro mayā mīru kṛto nṛpaparigrahe /
śramāturasya nidrā me pravṛttā mukhadāyinī //
meaning:
राजोवाच
नाधिकारो मया मीरु कृतो नृपपरिग्रहे /
श्रमातुरस्य निद्रा मे प्रवृत्ता मुखदायिनी //
title: athāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The king said:
"No claim, O timid one, was made by me to the royal retinue; / sleep, bringing ease to me overcome with exhaustion, came upon [me].

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadaṃ samābhāṣya mohinīṃ naya mandiram /
pūjayasva yathānyā mameṣā patnī priyā mama //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदं समाभाष्य मोहिनीं नय मन्दिरम् /
पूजयस्व यथान्या ममेषा पत्नी प्रिया मम //
text_mt: Having spoken to Dharmāṅgada: 'Take Mohinī to the mansion; / honor [her] properly, for she is my wife, dear to me,

sanskrit_iast:
nijaṃ kamalapatrākṣa sarvaratnavibhūṣitam /
nirvātavātasaṃyuktaṃ sarvartusukhadāyakam //
meaning:
निजं कमलपत्राक्ष सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् /
निर्वातवातसंयुक्तं सर्वर्तुसुखदायकम् //
text_mt: to your own [chamber], O lotus-petal-eyed one, adorned with every jewel, / screened from drafts, bestowing delight in all seasons'—

sanskrit_iast:
evamādiśya tanayamahaṃ nidrāmupāgataḥ /
śayanaṃ prāpya kaṣṭātte abhāgyo hi dhanaṃ yathā //
meaning:
एवमादिश्य तनयमहं निद्रामुपागतः /
शयनं प्राप्य कष्टात्ते अभाग्यो हि धनं यथा //
text_mt: having instructed my son thus, I fell asleep, / having reached a bed with difficulty from you, like an unfortunate man [reaching] wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
vibuddhamātraḥ sahasā tvatsamīpamupāgataḥ /
yadvravīṣi vaco devi tatkaromi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
विबुद्धमात्रः सहसा त्वत्समीपमुपागतः /
यद्व्रवीषि वचो देवि तत्करोमि न संशयः //
text_mt: As soon as I awoke, I came quickly into your presence. / Whatever word you speak, O queen, that I shall do without doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
parisāṃtvaya rājendra imāndārānsuduḥkhitān /
mamodvāhena nirviṇṇānnirāśānkāmabhogayoḥ //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
परिसांत्वय राजेन्द्र इमान्दारान्सुदुःखितान् /
ममोद्वाहेन निर्विण्णान्निराशान्कामभोगयोः //
text_mt:
Mohinī said:
"Comfort, O king of kings, these deeply grieving wives / who are despondent and hopeless of desire and pleasure on account of my marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhānāṃ rūpayuktānāṃ kalatrāṇāṃ viśāṃpate /
mūrghni kīlaṃ kaniṣṭhākhyaṃ yo hi rājannikhānayet //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठानां रूपयुक्तानां कलत्राणां विशांपते /
मूर्घ्नि कीलं कनिष्ठाख्यं यो हि राजन्निखानयेत् //
text_mt: The man who, O king, would drive the peg called 'younger wife' / into the head of elder wives endowed with beauty, O lord of the people—

sanskrit_iast:
na sadgatirbhavettasya na ta sā vindate param /
pativratāśrudagdhāyāḥ kā śāntirme bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
न सद्गतिर्भवेत्तस्य न त सा विन्दते परम् /
पतिव्रताश्रुदग्धायाः का शान्तिर्मे भविष्यति //
text_mt: he will not have a good destiny, nor does she attain the highest [state]. / For me, consumed by the tears of a devoted wife, what peace will there be?

sanskrit_iast:
janitāraṃ hi me bhasma kuryyurdevyaḥ pativratāḥ /
kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtaṃ bhūpa tvādṛśīṃ tathā //
meaning:
जनितारं हि मे भस्म कुर्य्युर्देव्यः पतिव्रताः /
किं पुनः प्राकृतं भूप त्वादृशीं तथा //
text_mt: For devoted wives could turn even my creator to ashes, O divine ladies; / how much more so an ordinary king, and one such as me?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvalīsamā nārī trailokye nāsti bhūmipa /
tava snehanibaddhāṅgī saṃbhojayati ṣaḍrasaiḥ //
meaning:
संध्यावलीसमा नारी त्रैलोक्ये नास्ति भूमिप /
तव स्नेहनिबद्धाङ्गी संभोजयति षड्रसैः //
text_mt: There is no woman equal to Saṃdhyāvalī in the three worlds, O ruler of the earth; / her limbs bound by love for you, she feeds [you] with the six flavors,

sanskrit_iast:
priyāṇi cāṭuvākyāni vadatī tava gauvavāt /
evaṃvidhā hi śataśo nāryaḥ saṃti gṛhe tava //
meaning:
प्रियाणि चाटुवाक्यानि वदती तव गौववात् /
एवंविधा हि शतशो नार्यः संति गृहे तव //
text_mt: speaking pleasant, flattering words out of respect for you; / indeed, there are hundreds of such women in your house.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsāṃ na pādarajasā tulyāhaṃ bhūpate kvacit /
mohinī vacanaṃ śrutvā vrīḍito hyabhavannṛpaḥ //
meaning:
यासां न पादरजसा तुल्याहं भूपते क्वचित् /
मोहिनी वचनं श्रुत्वा व्रीडितो ह्यभवन्नृपः //
text_mt: “I am nowhere equal even to the dust of their feet, O king!” / Hearing Mohinī's words, the king indeed became ashamed.

sanskrit_iast:
saputrāyāḥ samīpe tu jyeṣṭhāyā nṛpatistadā /
iṅgitajñaḥ suto jñātvā daśāvasthāgatāṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
सपुत्रायाः समीपे तु ज्येष्ठाया नृपतिस्तदा /
इङ्गितज्ञः सुतो ज्ञात्वा दशावस्थागतां नृपम् //
text_mt: The king was then near his eldest wife, who had a son. / The son, who knew all gestures and signs, understood that the king had reached the ten stages [of love-sickness],

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ kāmasaṃtaptaṃ mohinyarthe vimohitam /
mātṛḥ sarvāḥ samāhūya saṃdhyāvalipurogamāḥ //
meaning:
पितरं कामसंतप्तं मोहिन्यर्थे विमोहितम् /
मातृः सर्वाः समाहूय संध्यावलिपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: His father tormented by passion and deluded on account of Mohinī. / Summoning all the mothers, with Saṃdhyāvalī at their head,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā evamāha priya vacaḥ /
vimohinī me jananī navoḍhā brāhmaṇaḥ sutā //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा एवमाह प्रिय वचः /
विमोहिनी मे जननी नवोढा ब्राह्मणः सुता //
text_mt: And folding his hands in reverence, he spoke these affectionate words: / “The bewitching [woman], my mother, is a newly-wed daughter of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca prārthayate devyo rājānaṃ rahasisthitam /
ātmanā saha khelārthaṃ tanmodadhvaṃ suharṣitāḥ //
meaning:
सा च प्रार्थयते देव्यो राजानं रहसिस्थितम् /
आत्मना सह खेलार्थं तन्मोदध्वं सुहर्षिताः //
text_mt: And she, O queens, entreats the king when seated in private / to dally with her. Therefore, rejoice with great joy!”

sanskrit_iast:
mātara ūcuḥ
ko 'numodayate putra sarpabhakṣaṇamātmanaḥ /
ko hi dīpayate vahniṃ svadehe dehināṃ vara //
meaning:
मातर ऊचुः
को ऽनुमोदयते पुत्र सर्पभक्षणमात्मनः /
को हि दीपयते वह्निं स्वदेहे देहिनां वर //
text_mt: The mothers said: / “Who approves, O son, of eating a serpent himself? / Who indeed ignites a fire upon his own body, O best of embodied beings?

sanskrit_iast:
ko bhakṣayedviṣaṃ ghoraṃ kaśchindyādātmanaḥ śiraḥ /
kastaretsāgaraṃ baddhvā grīvāyāṃ dāruṇāṃ śilām //
meaning:
को भक्षयेद्विषं घोरं कश्छिन्द्यादात्मनः शिरः /
कस्तरेत्सागरं बद्ध्वा ग्रीवायां दारुणां शिलाम् //
text_mt: Who would eat terrible poison? Who would cut off his own head? / Who would cross the ocean after tying a heavy stone around his neck?

sanskrit_iast:
ko gaccheddvīpivadanaṃ kaḥ keśānsuharerharet /
ko niṣīdati dhārāyāṃ khaṅgasyā kāśabhāsinaḥ //
meaning:
को गच्छेद्द्वीपिवदनं कः केशान्सुहरेर्हरेत् /
को निषीदति धारायां खङ्गस्या काशभासिनः //
text_mt: Who would enter a tiger's mouth? Who would pull the hairs of a lion? / Who sits on the edge of a sword shining like the sky?

sanskrit_iast:
kānumodayate bhartrā sapatnyāḥ krīḍanaṃ kila /
sarvasyāpi pradānena naitanmanasi vartate //
meaning:
कानुमोदयते भर्त्रा सपत्न्याः क्रीडनं किल /
सर्वस्यापि प्रदानेन नैतन्मनसि वर्तते //
text_mt: What woman would ever approve of her co-wife's dalliance with her husband? / Even with the gift of everything, this does not enter one's mind.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ hi chedanaṃ mūrdhnastatkṣaṇāttu varāsinā /
kā dṛṣṭyā dayitaṃ kāntaṃ nirīkṣedanyayāhṛtam //
meaning:
वरं हि छेदनं मूर्ध्नस्तत्क्षणात्तु वरासिना /
का दृष्ट्या दयितं कान्तं निरीक्षेदन्ययाहृतम् //
text_mt: Better indeed to have one's head cut off that very moment by an excellent sword! / What woman could look on with her own eyes and watch her beloved lover stolen by another?

sanskrit_iast:
kā sā sīmantinī loke bhavedetādṛśī kvacit /
ātmaprāṇasamaṃ kāntamanyastrīkucapīḍanam //
meaning:
का सा सीमन्तिनी लोके भवेदेतादृशी क्वचित् /
आत्मप्राणसमं कान्तमन्यस्त्रीकुचपीडनम् //
text_mt: What woman anywhere in the world could be such / that, having heard of her lover—dear to her as her own life—pressing the breasts of another woman,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśrutya sahate yā tu kiṃ punaḥ svena cakṣuṣā /
sarveṣāmeva duḥkhānāṃ duḥkhametadanantakam //
meaning:
संश्रुत्य सहते या तु किं पुनः स्वेन चक्षुषा /
सर्वेषामेव दुःखानां दुःखमेतदनन्तकम् //
text_mt: she endures it, to say nothing of [seeing it] with her own eyes? / Of all sorrows, this is the endless sorrow:

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhartānyāṅganāsaṃkto dṛśyaṭate svena cakṣuṣā /
varaṃ sarvā mṛtāḥ putra yugapanmātarastava //
meaning:
यद्भर्तान्याङ्गनासंक्तो दृश्यटते स्वेन चक्षुषा /
वरं सर्वा मृताः पुत्र युगपन्मातरस्तव //
text_mt: that a husband is seen attached to another woman with one's own eyes. / Better, O son, that all of your mothers should die at once,

sanskrit_iast:
na tu mohinisaṃyukto dṛśyo 'yaṃ nṛpatiḥ patiḥ /
dharmāṅgada uvāca
yadi me na pituḥ saukhyaṃ kariṣyatha śubhānanāḥ //
meaning:
न तु मोहिनिसंयुक्तो दृश्यो ऽयं नृपतिः पतिः /
धर्माङ्गद उवाच
यदि मे न पितुः सौख्यं करिष्यथ शुभाननाः //
text_mt: than that this king, our husband, should be seen united with Mohinī!” / Dharmāṅgada said: / “If you will not bring about my father's happiness, O fair-faced ladies,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣamāloḍya pāsyāmi yuṣmatsaukhyaṃ mṛte mayi /
karmaṇā manasā vācā yā piturduḥkhamācaret //
meaning:
विषमालोड्य पास्यामि युष्मत्सौख्यं मृते मयि /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा या पितुर्दुःखमाचरेत् //
text_mt: I will stir up poison and drink it; your happiness will be upon my death! / She who acts to cause sorrow to my father by action, mind, or speech,

sanskrit_iast:
sā me śatrurvadhārhāsti yadi saṃdhyāvalī bhavet /
sarvāsāṃ sādhikā devī mohinī janakapriyā //
meaning:
सा मे शत्रुर्वधार्हास्ति यदि संध्यावली भवेत् /
सर्वासां साधिका देवी मोहिनी जनकप्रिया //
text_mt: is my enemy and deserves to be killed, even if she were Saṃdhyāvalī! / The queen Mohinī, dear to my father, is superior to all of you.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍārthamāgatā bālā mandarācalamandirāt /
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā vepamānā hi mātaraḥ //
meaning:
क्रीडार्थमागता बाला मन्दराचलमन्दिरात् /
तत्पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा वेपमाना हि मातरः //
text_mt: The maiden has come from her dwelling on Mount Mandara for sport.” / Hearing those words of the son, the mothers trembled,

sanskrit_iast:
ūcuḥ sagadgadāṃ vācaṃ hitārthaṃ tanayasya hi /
avaśyaṃ tava vākyaṃ hi kartavyaṃ nyāyasaṃyutam //
meaning:
ऊचुः सगद्गदां वाचं हितार्थं तनयस्य हि /
अवश्यं तव वाक्यं हि कर्तव्यं न्यायसंयुतम् //
text_mt: and spoke words in a faltering voice for the welfare of their son: / “Your word must certainly be carried out, since it is endowed with justice.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu dānaprado bhūtvā mohinīṃ yātu te pitā /
yo bhāryāmudvahedbhartā dvitīyāmaparāmapi //
meaning:
किं तु दानप्रदो भूत्वा मोहिनीं यातु ते पिता /
यो भार्यामुद्वहेद्भर्ता द्वितीयामपरामपि //
text_mt: However, let your father go to Mohinī only after bestowing gifts. / Whatever husband marries a second, additional wife,

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhāyai dviguṇaṃ tasyā dadyaccaivānyathā ṛṇī /
anujñāpya yadā bhārtā jyeṣṭhāmanyāṃ samudvahetak //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठायै द्विगुणं तस्या दद्यच्चैवान्यथा ऋणी /
अनुज्ञाप्य यदा भार्ता ज्येष्ठामन्यां समुद्वहेतक् //
text_mt: must give double to the eldest wife; otherwise, he incurs a debt. / When a husband, having taken permission from the eldest, marries another,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā jyeṣṭhābhilaṣitaṃ deyamāhuḥ purāvidaḥ /
jyeṣṭhayā sahitaḥ kuryādiṣṭāpūrtaṃ narottamaḥ //
meaning:
तदा ज्येष्ठाभिलषितं देयमाहुः पुराविदः /
ज्येष्ठया सहितः कुर्यादिष्टापूर्तं नरोत्तमः //
text_mt: then what is desired by the eldest must be given, so say knowers of the past. / Together with the eldest, the best of men should perform sacrificial rites and charitable works (iṣṭāpūrta).

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dharmo 'nyathānyāyo jāyate dharmasaṃkṣayaḥ /
śrutvā tu mātṛvacanaṃ prahaṣṭenāntarātmano //
meaning:
एष धर्मो ऽन्यथान्यायो जायते धर्मसंक्षयः /
श्रुत्वा तु मातृवचनं प्रहष्टेनान्तरात्मनो //
text_mt: This is righteousness; otherwise, there is injustice, and loss of righteousness arises.” / Having heard his mothers' words, with a delighted inner soul,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyai dadau sāgrāṃ koṭiṃ koṭiṃ sutastadā /
sahasraṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ pradadau tathā //
meaning:
एकैकस्यै ददौ साग्रां कोटिं कोटिं सुतस्तदा /
सहस्रं नगराणां च ग्रामाणां प्रददौ तथा //
text_mt: the son then gave to each one of them more than ten million [pieces of gold], / and likewise bestowed a thousand cities and villages.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaśvatarībhiścapṛthagyuktā nṛpātmajaḥ /
ekaikasya dadāvaṣṭau rathānkāñcanamālinaḥ //
meaning:
चतुरश्वतरीभिश्चपृथग्युक्ता नृपात्मजः /
एकैकस्य ददावष्टौ रथान्काञ्चनमालिनः //
text_mt: The king's son gave to each one eight chariots / adorned with golden garlands, each yoked with four mules.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsasāmayutaṃ prādādyeṣāṃ mūlyaṃ śatādhikam /
śuddhasya merujātasya akṣayasya nupātmajaḥ //
meaning:
वाससामयुतं प्रादाद्येषां मूल्यं शताधिकम् /
शुद्धस्य मेरुजातस्य अक्षयस्य नुपात्मजः //
text_mt: He gave ten thousand garments, the value of which exceeded a hundred [pieces of gold], / and pure, imperishable [gold] produced from Meru the king's son

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanasya dadau lakṣamekaikaṃ pratimātaram /
dāsānāṃ ca śataṃ sāgraṃ dāsīnāṃ ca nṛpātmajaḥ //
meaning:
काञ्चनस्य ददौ लक्षमेकैकं प्रतिमातरम् /
दासानां च शतं साग्रं दासीनां च नृपात्मजः //
text_mt: gave—a hundred thousand [measures] of gold—to each mother; / and the king's son gave more than a hundred male slaves and female slaves,

sanskrit_iast:
dhenūnāṃ ghaṭadogdhrīṇāmekaikasyai tathāyutam /
yugandharāṇāṃ bhadrāṇāṃ śatāni daśa vai pṛthak //
meaning:
धेनूनां घटदोग्ध्रीणामेकैकस्यै तथायुतम् /
युगन्धराणां भद्राणां शतानि दश वै पृथक् //
text_mt: and ten thousand cows yielding a jar-full of milk to each one; / and ten hundred fine draught oxen individually.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaprakāraṃ nṛpate dhānyaṃ ca pradadau sutaḥ /
vāṭīnāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ prādāddhasanniva //
meaning:
दशप्रकारं नृपते धान्यं च प्रददौ सुतः /
वाटीनां तु सहस्राणां शतं प्रादाद्धसन्निव //
text_mt: The son bestowed ten kinds of grain, O king, / and, as if smiling, gave a hundred thousand gardens.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṃbhāyutaṃ sarpiṣastu tailasya ca pṛthagdadau /
ajāvikamasaṃkhyātamekaikasyai nyavedayat //
meaning:
कुंभायुतं सर्पिषस्तु तैलस्य च पृथग्ददौ /
अजाविकमसंख्यातमेकैकस्यै न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: He gave separately ten thousand jars of clarified butter and of oil, / and presented countless goats and sheep to each one.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasreṇa sahasreṇa suvarṇasya vyabhūṣayat /
ākhaṇḍalāstrayuktaratha bhūṣaṇasya subhaktimān //
meaning:
सहस्रेण सहस्रेण सुवर्णस्य व्यभूषयत् /
आखण्डलास्त्रयुक्तरथ भूषणस्य सुभक्तिमान् //
text_mt: He decorated [each] with a thousand and a thousand [pieces] of gold; / the son, full of devotion, [gave] ornaments fitted with Indra's thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīpramāṇairhariśca mauktikairdīptisaṃyutaiḥ /
pradadau saṃhatānkṛtvā valayānpañca sapta ca //
meaning:
धात्रीप्रमाणैर्हरिश्च मौक्तिकैर्दीप्तिसंयुतैः /
प्रददौ संहतान्कृत्वा वलयान्पञ्च सप्त च //
text_mt: And [he gave] bright pearls the size of āmalakī fruits; / having had them assembled, he gave five and seven bracelets.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśacca śate dve tu bhauktikāni mahīpate /
saṃdhyāvalyāṃ sthitānīha śītāṃśupratimāni ca //
meaning:
पञ्चाशच्च शते द्वे तु भौक्तिकानि महीपते /
संध्यावल्यां स्थितानीह शीतांशुप्रतिमानि च //
text_mt: And two hundred and fifty pearl-ornaments, O ruler of the earth, / resembling the cool-rayed moon, which were kept with Saṃdhyāvalī,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyai dadau putrosa hārayugmaṃ manoharam /
kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ bhūri karpūraṃ prasthasaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
एकैकस्यै ददौ पुत्रोस हारयुग्मं मनोहरम् /
कुङ्कुमं चन्दनं भूरि कर्पूरं प्रस्थसंख्यया //
text_mt: and a delightful pair of necklaces the son gave to each one. / Copious saffron and sandalwood, and camphor measured by prasthas,

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrikāṃ tathā tābhyo bhūyasīṃ pradadau sutaḥ /
mātṝṇāmaviśeṣeṇa pituḥ sukhamabhīpsayan //
meaning:
कस्तूरिकां तथा ताभ्यो भूयसीं प्रददौ सुतः /
मातॄणामविशेषेण पितुः सुखमभीप्सयन् //
text_mt: and an abundance of musk the son gave to them, / wishing for his father's happiness, without making any distinction among the mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
bhājanāni vicitrāṇi jalapātrāṇyanekaśaḥ /
ghṛtakṣīrasya pātrāṇi peyasya vividhasya ca //
meaning:
भाजनानि विचित्राणि जलपात्राण्यनेकशः /
घृतक्षीरस्य पात्राणि पेयस्य विविधस्य च //
text_mt: Variegated vessels, numerous water pots, / vessels for clarified butter and milk, and for various kinds of beverages—

sanskrit_iast:
caturddaśaśataṃ prādātsahasreṇa samanvitam /
sthālīnāṃ kāñcanīnāṃ hi sakuṃbhānāṃ nṛpātmajaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्द्दशशतं प्रादात्सहस्रेण समन्वितम् /
स्थालीनां काञ्चनीनां हि सकुंभानां नृपात्मजः //
text_mt: the king's son gave fourteen hundred together with a thousand / golden dishes along with pitchers.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyai dadau bhūpa śatāni trīṇi pañca ca /
kareṇūnāṃ savegānāṃ māṃsavikrāntakandharām //
meaning:
एकैकस्यै ददौ भूप शतानि त्रीणि पञ्च च /
करेणूनां सवेगानां मांसविक्रान्तकन्धराम् //
text_mt: He gave three hundred and five swift female elephants / with fleshy, powerful necks to each one, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatiṃ viṃśatiṃ prādāduṣṭrīṇāṃ ca śataṃ śatam /
śibikānāṃ saveṣāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ pīvaragāminām //
meaning:
विंशतिं विंशतिं प्रादादुष्ट्रीणां च शतं शतम् /
शिबिकानां सवेषाणां पुंसां पीवरगामिनाम् //
text_mt: He gave twenty [palanquins] to each, and a hundred female camels to each, / and palanquins along with liveried men who walk with a stout step.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau daśa saptāśvānmātṝṇāṃ sukhayāyinaḥ /
evaṃ datvā bahudhanaṃ bahvībhyo nṛpanandanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रददौ दश सप्ताश्वान्मातॄणां सुखयायिनः /
एवं दत्वा बहुधनं बह्वीभ्यो नृपनन्दनः //
text_mt: He gave seventeen easy-paced horses to the mothers. / Having thus given much wealth to the many [mothers], the king's son,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo dhanapatiprakhyaścakre tāsāṃ pradakṣiṇāḥ /
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
धन्यो धनपतिप्रख्यश्चक्रे तासां प्रदक्षिणाः /
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: fortunate and resembling Kubera, circumambulated them. / Folding his hands in reverence, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
mamoparodhātpraṇatasya mūrdhnāpatiṃ samuddiśya yathā bhavatyaḥ /
bruvantu sarvāḥ pitaraṃ mamādya svaireṇa saṃbhuṅkṣva nareśaṃ mohinīm //
meaning:
ममोपरोधात्प्रणतस्य मूर्ध्नापतिं समुद्दिश्य यथा भवत्यः /
ब्रुवन्तु सर्वाः पितरं ममाद्य स्वैरेण संभुङ्क्ष्व नरेशं मोहिनीम् //
text_mt: “At my urging, with head bowed down toward our lord, / may you all now say to my father: ‘O ruler of men, enjoy Mohinī freely!

sanskrit_iast:
na cāsmadīyā bhavatā kilerṣyā svalpāpi kāryā manasi pratītā /
vimohinīṃ brahmasutāṃ suśīlāṃ ramasva saukhyena rahaḥ śatāni //
meaning:
न चास्मदीया भवता किलेर्ष्या स्वल्पापि कार्या मनसि प्रतीता /
विमोहिनीं ब्रह्मसुतां सुशीलां रमस्व सौख्येन रहः शतानि //
text_mt: Let not even the slightest jealousy from us be held in your mind; / sport in private hundreds of times with pleasure with the enchanting, virtuous daughter of a brāhmaṇa!’”

sanskrit_iast:
tatputravākyaṃ hi niśamya sarvāḥ saṃhṛṣṭalomnyo nṛpanāthamūcuḥ /
svabhūduhitrā suciraṃ ramasva videhaputryeva raghupravīraḥ //
meaning:
तत्पुत्रवाक्यं हि निशम्य सर्वाः संहृष्टलोम्न्यो नृपनाथमूचुः /
स्वभूदुहित्रा सुचिरं रमस्व विदेहपुत्र्येव रघुप्रवीरः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of the son, with their hair standing on end with joy, they all said to the king: / “Sport for a very long time with the daughter of Brahmā, just as the hero of the Raghu race did with the princess of Videha!

sanskrit_iast:
na śalyabhūtā kuśaketuputrī tvatsaṃgamādvidvi na saṃśayo 'tra /
putraujasā duḥkhavimuktabhāvātsamīritaṃ vākyamidaṃ pratīhi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mātṛsanmānaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
न शल्यभूता कुशकेतुपुत्री त्वत्संगमाद्विद्वि न संशयो ऽत्र /
पुत्रौजसा दुःखविमुक्तभावात्समीरितं वाक्यमिदं प्रतीहि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मातृसन्मानं नाम अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The daughter of Kuśaketu is no dart of grief on account of your union, O king; of this there is no doubt. / Believe this word uttered because all sorrow has been dispelled by our son's magnificence.”

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, titled ‘Honouring the Mothers’, in the Uttara-bhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
so 'nujñāto mahīpālaḥ priyābhiḥ priyakāmukaḥ /
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe dharmāṅgadamuvāca ha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
सो ऽनुज्ञातो महीपालः प्रियाभिः प्रियकामुकः /
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे धर्माङ्गदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Being permitted by his beloveds, the king, eager for his beloved, / attained unequalled delight and spoke to Dharmāṅgada:

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃ dvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ paripālaya putraka /
kṛtvā duṣṭavadhaṃ tvādāvapramattaḥ sadodyataḥ //
meaning:
एतां द्वीपवतीं पृथ्वीं परिपालय पुत्रक /
कृत्वा दुष्टवधं त्वादावप्रमत्तः सदोद्यतः //
text_mt: "Protect this earth endowed with islands, my dear son, / having first slain the wicked, remaining heedful and ever energetic;

sanskrit_iast:
sadāvasarasaṃyuktaḥ sadācāranirīkṣakaḥ /
sadā cetanasaṃyuktaḥ sadā vāṇijyavallabhaḥ //
meaning:
सदावसरसंयुक्तः सदाचारनिरीक्षकः /
सदा चेतनसंयुक्तः सदा वाणिज्यवल्लभः //
text_mt: always seizing the proper time, observing good conduct, / ever alert of mind, and ever fond of commerce;

sanskrit_iast:
sadā bhramaṇaśīlaśca sadā dānaratirbhava /
sadā kauṭilyahīnaśca sadācārarataḥ sadā //
meaning:
सदा भ्रमणशीलश्च सदा दानरतिर्भव /
सदा कौटिल्यहीनश्च सदाचाररतः सदा //
text_mt: always disposed to touring [the realm], and ever delighting in giving; / always free from deceit, and ever devoted to righteous practice.

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ śṛṇu me putra yatkarttavyaṃ tvayādhunā /
aviśvāsastu sarvatra bhūmipānāṃ praśasyate //
meaning:
अपरं शृणु मे पुत्र यत्कर्त्तव्यं त्वयाधुना /
अविश्वासस्तु सर्वत्र भूमिपानां प्रशस्यते //
text_mt: Hear another thing from me, my son, which you must now do: / for rulers of the earth, lack of trust everywhere is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
koṣasya ca parijñānaṃ janānāṃ janavallabha /
rasavaddravyamākarṣeḥ puṣpebhya iva ṣaṭpadaḥ //
meaning:
कोषस्य च परिज्ञानं जनानां जनवल्लभ /
रसवद्द्रव्यमाकर्षेः पुष्पेभ्य इव षट्पदः //
text_mt: And keep an exact knowledge of the treasury and of the people, O beloved of the people! / You should draw wealth like sweet sap, just as a bee [draws nectar] from flowers.

sanskrit_iast: tvayā putreṇa saṃprāptaṃ punareveha yauvanam //
meaning: त्वया पुत्रेण संप्राप्तं पुनरेवेह यौवनम् //
text_mt: Through you, my son, my youth has returned here once again.

sanskrit_iast:
imāmapūrvāṃ vararūpamohinīṃ saṃprāpya bhāryāṃ dvijarājavaktrām /
sukhena saṃyojya ca te 'dya bhāraṃ saptodadhidvīpabhavaṃ praraṃsye //
meaning:
इमामपूर्वां वररूपमोहिनीं संप्राप्य भार्यां द्विजराजवक्त्राम् /
सुखेन संयोज्य च ते ऽद्य भारं सप्तोदधिद्वीपभवं प्ररंस्ये //
text_mt: Having obtained this unprecedented wife, Mohinī of supreme beauty whose face is like the moon, / and having happily laid upon you today the burden born of the continents and seven seas, I shall take my pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
vrīḍākarastāta manuṣyaloke samarthaputre suratābhikāmī /
bhavetpitā cedbralibhiśca yukto jīrṇadvijaḥ śvetaśiroruhaśca //
meaning:
व्रीडाकरस्तात मनुष्यलोके समर्थपुत्रे सुरताभिकामी /
भवेत्पिता चेद्ब्रलिभिश्च युक्तो जीर्णद्विजः श्वेतशिरोरुहश्च //
text_mt: It causes shame in the world of men, dear father, when, though having an able son, / a father longs for sexual pleasure if he is afflicted with wrinkles, has decayed teeth, and has white hair."

sanskrit_iast:
jīrṇo 'pyajīrṇastava saukhyavṛddho vāñche imāṃ lokavarāṃ varārhām /
saṃtyajya devānmama hetumāgatāmanaṅgabāṇābhihatāṃ sunetrām //
meaning:
जीर्णो ऽप्यजीर्णस्तव सौख्यवृद्धो वाञ्छे इमां लोकवरां वरार्हाम् /
संत्यज्य देवान्मम हेतुमागतामनङ्गबाणाभिहतां सुनेत्राम् //
text_mt: "Though aged, I am unaged, increased in joy through you, and I desire this woman, the best in the world and worthy of the best, / who, abandoning the gods, has come for my sake, struck by the arrows of the bodiless Love, fair-eyed as she is.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmaṃ ramiṣye drutakāṃ canābhāṃ hyekāntaśīlaḥ paripūrṇacetāḥ /
bhūtvā tu gupto vananirjhareṣu ramyeṣu divyeṣu nadītaṭeṣu //
meaning:
कामं रमिष्ये द्रुतकां चनाभां ह्येकान्तशीलः परिपूर्णचेताः /
भूत्वा तु गुप्तो वननिर्झरेषु रम्येषु दिव्येषु नदीतटेषु //
text_mt: I shall freely enjoy this woman who shines like molten gold, living in seclusion with a fulfilled mind, / remaining hidden in forest cascades and on charming, celestial riverbanks.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ purandhrī mama jīvitādhikā sukhena dhāryā tridivaikanārī /
asyāstu hetorvibudhā vimūḍhā yathā ramāyai dharaṇīśasaṃghāḥ //
meaning:
इयं पुरन्ध्री मम जीविताधिका सुखेन धार्या त्रिदिवैकनारी /
अस्यास्तु हेतोर्विबुधा विमूढा यथा रमायै धरणीशसंघाः //
text_mt: This matron is dearer to me than life, the sole woman of heaven who must be maintained in comfort; / for her sake the gods were deluded, just as hosts of kings are for Ramā."

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyamākarṇya pituḥ subuddhiḥ praṇamya bhaktyā jananīsametam /
nṛpottamaṃ taṃ nṛpanandano 'sau dideśa bhogārthamanekavittam //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य पितुः सुबुद्धिः प्रणम्य भक्त्या जननीसमेतम् /
नृपोत्तमं तं नृपनन्दनो ऽसौ दिदेश भोगार्थमनेकवित्तम् //
text_mt: Hearing those words of his father, the wise prince bowed with devotion / before that best of kings and his mother, and assigned immense wealth for his pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāvidheyāṃstu piturniyojya dāsāṃśca dāsīśca hiraṇyakaṇṭhīḥ /
matsyadhvajārttasya sukhāya putrastato mahīrakṣaṇamācacāra //
meaning:
आज्ञाविधेयांस्तु पितुर्नियोज्य दासांश्च दासीश्च हिरण्यकण्ठीः /
मत्स्यध्वजार्त्तस्य सुखाय पुत्रस्ततो महीरक्षणमाचचार //
text_mt: Assigning male servants obedient to his father's command and female servants with golden necklaces / for the pleasure of him who was stricken by the fish-bannered Love, the son then undertook the protection of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaistuto dharmavibhūṣaṇo 'sau samāvṛto dvīpavatīṃ samagrām /
tasyetthamurvīṃ carataśca bhūpa na pāpabuddhiṃ kurute janaighaḥ //
meaning:
नृपैस्तुतो धर्मविभूषणो ऽसौ समावृतो द्वीपवतीं समग्राम् /
तस्येत्थमुर्वीं चरतश्च भूप न पापबुद्धिं कुरुते जनैघः //
text_mt: Praised by kings, that ornament of righteousness held sway over the entire earth with its islands; / and as he thus traversed the land, O king, the multitude of people did not turn their minds to sin.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi vṛkṣaḥ phalapuṣpahīno na kṣetramāsīdyavaśālihīnam /
sravanti gāvo ghaṭapūradugdhaṃ ghṛtādhikaṃ śarkaravatsumiṣṭam //
meaning:
न चापि वृक्षः फलपुष्पहीनो न क्षेत्रमासीद्यवशालिहीनम् /
स्रवन्ति गावो घटपूरदुग्धं घृताधिकं शर्करवत्सुमिष्टम् //
text_mt: Nor was any tree bereft of fruit and flowers; no field was without barley and rice; / the cows yielded jars full of milk, rich in ghee and exceedingly sweet like sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīraṃ supeyaṃ sakalārtināśanaṃ pāpāpahaṃ puṣṭivivardhanaṃ ca /
jano na kaścidvibhavasya goptā bhartuhiṃ bhāryā na kaṭūktivādinī //
meaning:
क्षीरं सुपेयं सकलार्तिनाशनं पापापहं पुष्टिविवर्धनं च /
जनो न कश्चिद्विभवस्य गोप्ता भर्तुहिं भार्या न कटूक्तिवादिनी //
text_mt: The milk was delicious to drink, dispelling all suffering, removing sin, and increasing strength; / no person hoarded wealth, and no wife spoke harsh words to her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
putro vinītaḥ pitṛśāsane rato vadhūḥ sthitā hastapuṭe ca śvaśroḥ /
dvijopadeśe hi jano vyavasthito vedoktadharmācaraṇāddvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रो विनीतः पितृशासने रतो वधूः स्थिता हस्तपुटे च श्वश्रोः /
द्विजोपदेशे हि जनो व्यवस्थितो वेदोक्तधर्माचरणाद्द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The son was modest and devoted to the father's governance; the daughter-in-law stood at the beck and call of the mother-in-law; / the people remained fixed in the instruction of the twice-born, and the best of the twice-born were devoted to practicing the dharma proclaimed in the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhuñjate mādhavavāsare janā na yānti śoṣaṃ bhuviḥ nimnagāstu /
saṃbhujya mānā nahi yānti saṃpadaḥ saṃbhogayuktairapi mānavaiḥ kṣayam //
meaning:
न भुञ्जते माधववासरे जना न यान्ति शोषं भुविः निम्नगास्तु /
संभुज्य माना नहि यान्ति संपदः संभोगयुक्तैरपि मानवैः क्षयम् //
text_mt: People did not eat on the day of Mādhava; the rivers on earth did not dry up; / and though enjoyed by men endowed with pleasures, their fortunes did not diminish.

sanskrit_iast:
vivṛddhimāyānti jalairivorddhvaṃ dūrvātṛṇaṃ śādvalatāmupaiti /
kṛtī ca loko hyabhavatsamasto dharmāṅgade pālanasaṃpravṛtte //
meaning:
विवृद्धिमायान्ति जलैरिवोर्द्ध्वं दूर्वातृणं शाद्वलतामुपैति /
कृती च लोको ह्यभवत्समस्तो धर्माङ्गदे पालनसंप्रवृत्ते //
text_mt: Just as [plants] grow upward through waters, the dūrvā grass became lush green pastures; / and all the people became prosperous when Dharmāṅgada took up the protection [of the realm].

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tu saukhyāni ca yānti mānavā hareḥ padaṃ taddinasevanena /
dvārāṇi sadhvāntaniśāsu bhūpa guptāni kurvanti na dasyu bhītāḥ //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तु सौख्यानि च यान्ति मानवा हरेः पदं तद्दिनसेवनेन /
द्वाराणि सध्वान्तनिशासु भूप गुप्तानि कुर्वन्ति न दस्यु भीताः //
text_mt: Having enjoyed pleasures, mortals go to the abode of Hari by observing that day; / O king, through nights plunged in darkness, people did not lock their doors out of fear of thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi gopeṣu dadanti vṛttiṃ svecchācarā mandiramāvrajanti /
kṣīraṃ kṣarantyo ghaṭavatsubhūriśo vatsapriyāḥ śāntikarāśca gāvaḥ //
meaning:
न चापि गोपेषु ददन्ति वृत्तिं स्वेच्छाचरा मन्दिरमाव्रजन्ति /
क्षीरं क्षरन्त्यो घटवत्सुभूरिशो वत्सप्रियाः शान्तिकराश्च गावः //
text_mt: Nor did they give wages to cowherds; roaming at their own will, the cows returned to the homestead, / flowing abundantly with milk like jars, loving their calves, and bringing peace.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛṣṭapacyā dharaṇī samastā prarūḍhasasyā kila lāṅgalaṃ vinā /
mātuḥ payobhiḥ śiśavaḥ supuṣṭā bhartuḥ prayogaiḥ pramadāḥ supuṣṭāḥ //
meaning:
अकृष्टपच्या धरणी समस्ता प्ररूढसस्या किल लाङ्गलं विना /
मातुः पयोभिः शिशवः सुपुष्टा भर्तुः प्रयोगैः प्रमदाः सुपुष्टाः //
text_mt: The entire earth yielded crops without being ploughed, with sprouting grain indeed without a plough; / children were well-nourished with their mothers' milk, and women were well-nourished by the embraces of their husbands.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpaiḥ suguptāstu janāḥ supuṣṭāḥ satyābhiyukto hi vṛṣaḥ supuṣṭaḥ /
evaṃ vidhe dharmaratipradhāne jane pravṛtte haribhaktiyukte /
saṃrakṣyamāṇe hi nṛpātmajena jagāma kālaḥ sukhahe tubhūtaḥ //
meaning:
नृपैः सुगुप्तास्तु जनाः सुपुष्टाः सत्याभियुक्तो हि वृषः सुपुष्टः /
एवं विधे धर्मरतिप्रधाने जने प्रवृत्ते हरिभक्तियुक्ते /
संरक्ष्यमाणे हि नृपात्मजेन जगाम कालः सुखहे तुभूतः //
text_mt: Well-protected by kings, the people were well-nourished, and the bull of dharma, engaged with truth, was well-nourished. / When the people, devoted chiefly to righteous conduct and endowed with devotion to Hari, acted in this way, / and were protected by the king's son, time passed, becoming a cause of happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāmayo bhūtisamanvitaśca sabhūrivarṣotsavakārakaśca /
pṛthvīpatiścātivimohitaśca vimohinīceṣṭitasaukhyayuktaḥ //
meaning:
निरामयो भूतिसमन्वितश्च सभूरिवर्षोत्सवकारकश्च /
पृथ्वीपतिश्चातिविमोहितश्च विमोहिनीचेष्टितसौख्ययुक्तः //
text_mt: Free from illness, endowed with prosperity, and holding festivals for many years, / the lord of the earth was deeply infatuated, enjoying the pleasure of Mohinī's amorous gestures.

sanskrit_iast:
dinaṃ na jānāti na cāpi rātriṃ māsaṃ ca pakṣaṃ ca sa vatsaraṃ ca /
atīva mugdhaḥ suratena tasyā virañciputryāḥ śubhaceṣṭitāyāḥ //
vimohinīsaṃgamane nṛpasya babhūva śaktistvadhikā manoje /
yathā yathā sevata eva bhūpastathā tathā vṛddhimiyarti vīryam /
pakṣeṣu śukleṣviva śītabhānurna kṣīyate saṃtatasevanena //
meaning:
दिनं न जानाति न चापि रात्रिं मासं च पक्षं च स वत्सरं च /
अतीव मुग्धः सुरतेन तस्या विरञ्चिपुत्र्याः शुभचेष्टितायाः //
विमोहिनीसंगमने नृपस्य बभूव शक्तिस्त्वधिका मनोजे /
यथा यथा सेवत एव भूपस्तथा तथा वृद्धिमियर्ति वीर्यम् /
पक्षेषु शुक्लेष्विव शीतभानुर्न क्षीयते संततसेवनेन //
text_mt: He knew neither day nor night, nor month, nor fortnight, nor year, / deeply enchanted by sexual union with that auspicious-acting daughter of Brahmā. / In union with Mohinī, the king’s passion in love grew even greater; / as the king indulged in love again and again, his virility increased correspondingly, / like the cool-rayed moon in the bright fortnights, it was not diminished by continuous indulgence.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndārakaḥ pītasudhāraso yathā saṃspṛśya saṃspṛśya punarnavo 'sau /
pibaṃstu pānaṃ sumanoharaṃ hi śṛṇvaṃstu gītaṃ supadaprayuktam //
meaning:
वृन्दारकः पीतसुधारसो यथा संस्पृश्य संस्पृश्य पुनर्नवो ऽसौ /
पिबंस्तु पानं सुमनोहरं हि शृण्वंस्तु गीतं सुपदप्रयुक्तम् //
text_mt: Like a god who has drunk the nectar of immortality, he became ever renewed by touching her again and again, / drinking delightful drink and listening to songs composed in exquisite meter,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyaṃśca rūpaṃ sa nitaṃbinīnāṃ spṛśanspṛśanmohinivaktracandram /
vimarddamānastu kareṇa tuṅgau sukhena pīnau piśitoparūḍhau //
meaning:
पश्यंश्च रूपं स नितंबिनीनां स्पृशन्स्पृशन्मोहिनिवक्त्रचन्द्रम् /
विमर्द्दमानस्तु करेण तुङ्गौ सुखेन पीनौ पिशितोपरूढौ //
text_mt: gazing upon the beauty of broad-hipped women, touching again and again the moon-face of Mohinī, / and caressing with his hand the high, plump breasts well-covered in flesh,

sanskrit_iast:
ghanastanau kāñcanakuṃbhatulyau pracchāditau hāravibhūṣaṇena /
valitrayaṃ nātivivarddhamānaṃ manoharaṃ lomaśarājiśobham //
meaning:
घनस्तनौ काञ्चनकुंभतुल्यौ प्रच्छादितौ हारविभूषणेन /
वलित्रयं नातिविवर्द्धमानं मनोहरं लोमशराजिशोभम् //
text_mt: firm breasts like golden jars, covered with an ornament of necklaces, / and her threefold fold [of the abdomen], not overly large, charming with the beauty of a line of hair.

sanskrit_iast:
stanasya rūpaṃ parito vilokya dadhre varāṅgyāḥ śubhalocanāyāḥ /
nahīdṛśaṃ cārutaraṃ nitāntaṃ nitaṃbinīnāṃ manaso 'bhirāmam //
meaning:
स्तनस्य रूपं परितो विलोक्य दध्रे वराङ्ग्याः शुभलोचनायाः /
नहीदृशं चारुतरं नितान्तं नितंबिनीनां मनसो ऽभिरामम् //
text_mt: Observing all around the beauty of the breasts of that lovely-limbed woman with auspicious eyes, he held [her]; / never was there such exceedingly delightful, mind-captivating [beauty] among broad-hipped women.

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛgvidhaṃ mohinamohanārthaṃ vinirmitaṃ yadvidhinā svarūpam /
mṛgendraśatroḥkarasannikāśe jaṅghe vilome drutakāñcanābhe //
meaning:
यादृग्विधं मोहिनमोहनार्थं विनिर्मितं यद्विधिना स्वरूपम् /
मृगेन्द्रशत्रोःकरसन्निकाशे जङ्घे विलोमे द्रुतकाञ्चनाभे //
text_mt: Such was the form fashioned by Brahmā to enchant the enchanter: / her shanks, smooth-haired and radiant like molten gold, resembled the trunk of an elephant;

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṅkakāntirddaśanasya paṅktirnigūḍhagulphe janamohanārtham /
āpādaśīrṣaṃ kila tatsvarūpaṃ saṃpaśyataccāruviśālanetryāḥ //
meaning:
शशाङ्ककान्तिर्द्दशनस्य पङ्क्तिर्निगूढगुल्फे जनमोहनार्थम् /
आपादशीर्षं किल तत्स्वरूपं संपश्यतच्चारुविशालनेत्र्याः //
text_mt: the row of her teeth had the brilliance of the moon, her ankles were hidden, for the enchantment of mankind; / gazing upon that very form from foot to head of that lady with beautiful, large eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
mene surāṇāmadhikaṃ hi rājā kṛtārthamātmānamatīva harṣāt /
aho sutanvī vipulekṣaṇeyaṃ yāciṣyate yacca tadeva deyam //
meaning:
मेने सुराणामधिकं हि राजा कृतार्थमात्मानमतीव हर्षात् /
अहो सुतन्वी विपुलेक्षणेयं याचिष्यते यच्च तदेव देयम् //
text_mt: the king, out of immense joy, considered himself more fulfilled than the gods: / 'Ah, whatever this slender-bodied, wide-eyed woman shall ask for, that alone must be given!

sanskrit_iast:
asyāstu ramye surate śubhāyā dāsyāmi cānte nijavittajātam /
sudurlabhaṃ deyamadeyamanyairdāsyāmi cāsyā yadi vāpyadeyam //
meaning:
अस्यास्तु रम्ये सुरते शुभाया दास्यामि चान्ते निजवित्तजातम् /
सुदुर्लभं देयमदेयमन्यैर्दास्यामि चास्या यदि वाप्यदेयम् //
text_mt: In this auspicious lady's delightful sexual union, and at its close, I shall give the mass of my own wealth; / even what is hard to obtain, whether to be given or not to be given by others, I will give her, even if it ought not to be given.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyapyadeyaṃ mama jīvitaṃ hi yāciṣyate cedyadi hemavarṇā /
dāsyāmi cedaṃ na vicārayiṣye putraṃ vinā nāsti nadeyamasyāḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīpraṇayavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यद्यप्यदेयं मम जीवितं हि याचिष्यते चेद्यदि हेमवर्णा /
दास्यामि चेदं न विचारयिष्ये पुत्रं विना नास्ति नदेयमस्याः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीप्रणयवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Even if my very life ought not to be given, if this golden-complexioned lady asks for it, / I shall give it, I will not hesitate; except for my son, there is nothing not to be given to her.'

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of Mohinī's Love', in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ suratamūḍhasya rājño rukmāṅgadasya ca /
trīṇi pañca ca varṣāṇi vyatītāni sukhena vai //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं सुरतमूढस्य राज्ञो रुक्माङ्गदस्य च /
त्रीणि पञ्च च वर्षाणि व्यतीतानि सुखेन वै //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / In this way, three and five [eight] years passed happily indeed / for King Rukmāṅgada, who was infatuated with sexual union.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpte navame varṣe putro dharmāṅgado balī /
jitvā vidyādharānpañca malaye parvatottame //
meaning:
संप्राप्ते नवमे वर्षे पुत्रो धर्माङ्गदो बली /
जित्वा विद्याधरान्पञ्च मलये पर्वतोत्तमे //
text_mt: When the ninth year arrived, his mighty son Dharmāṅgada, / having conquered five vidyādharas on the best of mountains, Malaya,

sanskrit_iast:
ājahāra maṇīnpañca sarvakāmapradān śubhān /
ekaṃ kāñcanadātāraṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ śubham //
meaning:
आजहार मणीन्पञ्च सर्वकामप्रदान् शुभान् /
एकं काञ्चनदातारं कोटिकोटिगुणं शुभम् //
text_mt: brought back five auspicious gems that bestow all desires: / one auspicious gem that bestows gold multiplied crores and crores of times;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ vastrabhūṣādilakṣakoṭipradaṃ tathā /
tṛtīyamamṛtasrāvi punaryauvanakārakam //
meaning:
द्वितीयं वस्त्रभूषादिलक्षकोटिप्रदं तथा /
तृतीयममृतस्रावि पुनर्यौवनकारकम् //
text_mt: a second that grants lakhs and crores of garments, ornaments, and the like; / a third that exudes nectar and restores youth;

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāgṛhaprakartāraṃ caturthaṃ cānnasādhakam /
pañcamaṃ vyobhagatidaṃ trailokyaparisarpaṇam //
meaning:
सभागृहप्रकर्तारं चतुर्थं चान्नसाधकम् /
पञ्चमं व्योभगतिदं त्रैलोक्यपरिसर्पणम् //
text_mt: a fourth that creates assembly halls and mansions and provides food; / and a fifth that gives the power of roaming in the sky, traversing the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tānmaṇīngṛhya manasā vidyādharasamanvitaḥ /
strībhirvidyādharāṇāṃ ca sāśrunetrābhirāvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तान्मणीन्गृह्य मनसा विद्याधरसमन्वितः /
स्त्रीभिर्विद्याधराणां च साश्रुनेत्राभिरावृतः //
text_mt: Taking those jewels with his mind, accompanied by the vidyādharas / and surrounded by the wives of the vidyādharas whose eyes were filled with tears,

sanskrit_iast:
vavande caraṇau mātuḥ pitū rukmāṅgadasya ca /
maṇīnpañca samarpyātha pādayoḥ prāha saṃnataḥ //
meaning:
ववन्दे चरणौ मातुः पितू रुक्माङ्गदस्य च /
मणीन्पञ्च समर्प्याथ पादयोः प्राह संनतः //
text_mt: he bowed down to the feet of his mother and of his father Rukmāṅgada, / and having offered the five gems at their feet, bowed low, he said:

sanskrit_iast:
ime jitā mayā tāta pañca vidyādharā raṇe /
malaye bhūdharaśreṣṭhe vaiṣṇavāstreṇa bhūpate //
meaning:
इमे जिता मया तात पञ्च विद्याधरा रणे /
मलये भूधरश्रेष्ठे वैष्णवास्त्रेण भूपते //
text_mt: 'Father, these five vidyādharas were conquered by me in battle / on Malaya, the best of mountains, by means of the Vaiṣṇava missile, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
ime te bhṛtyatāṃ prāptāḥ sastrīkā nṛpasattama /
maṇīnprayaccha mohinyai bhujabhūṣaṇahetave //
meaning:
इमे ते भृत्यतां प्राप्ताः सस्त्रीका नृपसत्तम /
मणीन्प्रयच्छ मोहिन्यै भुजभूषणहेतवे //
text_mt: These, along with their wives, have become your servants, O best of kings; / give the jewels to Mohinī to serve as ornaments for her arms.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradā hyete punaryauvanakāriṇaḥ /
jīrṇadantāḥ punarbālā bhavanti maṇidhāraṇāt //
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदा ह्येते पुनर्यौवनकारिणः /
जीर्णदन्ताः पुनर्बाला भवन्ति मणिधारणात् //
text_mt: For these bestow all desires and bring about youth again; / those whose teeth are worn with age become young again by wearing these jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
vastraharmyasuvarṇānāṃ svargateramṛtasya ca /
dātāro māsayuddhena sādhitāstava tejasā //
meaning:
वस्त्रहर्म्यसुवर्णानां स्वर्गतेरमृतस्य च /
दातारो मासयुद्धेन साधितास्तव तेजसा //
text_mt: Givers of garments, mansions, gold, attainment of heaven, and nectar, / they were won through a month-long battle by your splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhitāni mayā kṛcchrātsaptadvīpāni bhūpate /
karadānisamastāni kṛtāni tava tejasā //
meaning:
साधितानि मया कृच्छ्रात्सप्तद्वीपानि भूपते /
करदानिसमस्तानि कृतानि तव तेजसा //
text_mt: The seven continents were conquered with difficulty by me, O king; / all were made tribute-paying by your splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
samudre ca praviṣṭasya gataḥ saṃvatsaro mama /
jitā bhogavatī tāta mayā nāgasamāvṛtā //
meaning:
समुद्रे च प्रविष्टस्य गतः संवत्सरो मम /
जिता भोगवती तात मया नागसमावृता //
text_mt: A year of mine passed as I entered into the ocean; / Bhogavatī, crowded with serpent-demons, was conquered by me, O father.

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtā nāgakanyāśca mayā cāyutasaṃkhyakāḥ /
tatrāpi hāraratnāni subahūnyāhṛtāni ca //
meaning:
आहृता नागकन्याश्च मया चायुतसंख्यकाः /
तत्रापि हाररत्नानि सुबहून्याहृतानि च //
text_mt: And ten thousand Nāga maidens were brought back by me, / and very many necklaces and jewels were also brought from there.

sanskrit_iast:
punaścāhaṃ gatastāta dānavānāṃ puraṃ mahat /
tānnirjityaṃ ca kanyānāṃ surūpāṇāṃ suvarcasām //
meaning:
पुनश्चाहं गतस्तात दानवानां पुरं महत् /
तान्निर्जित्यं च कन्यानां सुरूपाणां सुवर्चसाम् //
text_mt: And again I went, O father, to the great city of the Dānavas; / having conquered them, of maidens who are beautiful and of great splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtāni mayā trīṇi sahasrāṇi ca pañca ca /
daśakoṭyastu ratnānāṃ dīpakarma niśāgame //
meaning:
आहृतानि मया त्रीणि सहस्राणि च पञ्च च /
दशकोट्यस्तु रत्नानां दीपकर्म निशागमे //
text_mt: three thousand and five [hundred] were brought back by me, / and ten crores of jewels that perform the function of lamps when night arrives,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvatāṃ te mahīpāla ānītāstava mandire /
tato 'haṃ vāruṇaṃ lokaṃ rasātalatalasthitam //
meaning:
कुर्वतां ते महीपाल आनीतास्तव मन्दिरे /
ततो ऽहं वारुणं लोकं रसातलतलस्थितम् //
text_mt: O protector of the earth, have been brought to your palace. / Then I, arrogant with the power of valor and a servant of your pair of feet,

sanskrit_iast:
gato vīryabalotsiktastvadaṅghriyugasevakaḥ /
tatrokto varuṇo devaḥ sthīyatāṃ matpinturvaśe //
meaning:
गतो वीर्यबलोत्सिक्तस्त्वदङ्घ्रियुगसेवकः /
तत्रोक्तो वरुणो देवः स्थीयतां मत्पिन्तुर्वशे //
text_mt: went to the realm of Varuṇa, situated at the base of Rasātala. / There the god Varuṇa was told: "Remain under the control of my father,

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgadasya nṛpateryadi jīvitumicchasi /
kupito mama vākyena varuṇo yoddhumāgataḥ //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गदस्य नृपतेर्यदि जीवितुमिच्छसि /
कुपितो मम वाक्येन वरुणो योद्धुमागतः //
text_mt: King Rukmāṅgada, if you wish to live!" / Angered by my word, Varuṇa came forth to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
tena saṃvatsaraṃ yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ jātaṃ rasātale /
jito nārāyaṇāstreṇa mayā sa jalanāyakaḥ //
meaning:
तेन संवत्सरं युद्धं घोरं जातं रसातले /
जितो नारायणास्त्रेण मया स जलनायकः //
text_mt: A dreadful battle took place with him in Rasātala for a year; / that lord of waters was defeated by me with the Nārāyaṇa missile.

sanskrit_iast:
na hataḥ pramadāvākyaistasya jīvitarakṣaṇe /
nirjitenāyutaṃ dattaṃ vājināṃ vātaraṃhasām //
meaning:
न हतः प्रमदावाक्यैस्तस्य जीवितरक्षणे /
निर्जितेनायुतं दत्तं वाजिनां वातरंहसाम् //
text_mt: He was not slain, because of the pleas of women for the protection of his life; / having been defeated, he gave ten thousand horses fleet as the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ śubhrāṇāṃ candravarcasām /
tṛṇatoyavihīnā ye jīvanti bahuśaḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
एकतः श्यामकर्णानां शुभ्राणां चन्द्रवर्चसाम् /
तृणतोयविहीना ये जीवन्ति बहुशः समाः //
text_mt: white with black ears on one side and radiant as the moon, / which live for many years without grass or water.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃ kanyāṃ surūpāṃ me puraskṛtya svalaṅkṛtām /
bhāryārthe varuṇaḥ prādātsāpyānītā mayā śubhā //
meaning:
एकां कन्यां सुरूपां मे पुरस्कृत्य स्वलङ्कृताम् /
भार्यार्थे वरुणः प्रादात्साप्यानीता मया शुभा //
text_mt: Bringing forward one beautiful maiden well-adorned, / Varuṇa gave her for the purpose of marriage, and that auspicious lady too was brought by me.

sanskrit_iast:
kumārī tu samānītāḥ bahuvittasamanvitā /
tannisti triṣu lokeṣu sthānaṃ tāta sudurgamam //
meaning:
कुमारी तु समानीताः बहुवित्तसमन्विता /
तन्निस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु स्थानं तात सुदुर्गमम् //
text_mt: Thus maidens endowed with abundant wealth were brought; / father, there is no place in the three worlds that is difficult of access [for your power].'

sanskrit_iast:
yanmayā na jitaṃ hyasti tavāṅghriparisevanāt /
taduttiṣṭha parīkṣasva tvatprasādārjitāṃ śriyam //
meaning:
यन्मया न जितं ह्यस्ति तवाङ्घ्रिपरिसेवनात् /
तदुत्तिष्ठ परीक्षस्व त्वत्प्रसादार्जितां श्रियम् //
text_mt: "Whatever has not been conquered by me by serving your feet— / rise up, therefore, and inspect the wealth acquired by your favor!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca saṃpadaḥ sarvāstvadadhīnā viśāṃpate /
yaḥ putrastāta vadati mayā lakṣmīḥ samarjitā //
meaning:
अहं च संपदः सर्वास्त्वदधीना विशांपते /
यः पुत्रस्तात वदति मया लक्ष्मीः समर्जिता //
text_mt: I and all my fortunes are subject to you, O ruler of the people! / That son, dear father, who says, 'Wealth has been acquired by me,

sanskrit_iast:
na deyā bhūmidevebhyaḥ so 'pi vai narakaṃ vrajet /
ātmasaṃbhāvanaṃ tāta na kartavyaṃ sutena hi //
meaning:
न देया भूमिदेवेभ्यः सो ऽपि वै नरकं व्रजेत् /
आत्मसंभावनं तात न कर्तव्यं सुतेन हि //
text_mt: and it must not be given to the gods on earth'—he indeed goes to hell; / for self-glorification, dear father, must never be made by a son.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭhāradātrasadṛśaḥ putraḥ saṃpatsamuccaye /
pituḥ śauryeṇa putrasya varddhate dhanasaṃcayaḥ //
meaning:
कुठारदात्रसदृशः पुत्रः संपत्समुच्चये /
पितुः शौर्येण पुत्रस्य वर्द्धते धनसंचयः //
text_mt: A son is like an axe and a sickle in the gathering of riches; / through the father's prowess, the accumulation of wealth of the son increases.

sanskrit_iast:
taijasaṃ dātramādāya lunāti tṛṇasaṃcayān /
vāyunā pūritaṃ vastraṃ tārayennaugataṃ jale //
meaning:
तैजसं दात्रमादाय लुनाति तृणसंचयान् /
वायुना पूरितं वस्त्रं तारयेन्नौगतं जले //
text_mt: Taking a sickle made of metal, one cuts bundles of grass; / a sail filled with wind carries across a boat traveler upon the water.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dārumayī yoṣā ceṣṭate kuhakecchayā /
tathāhi pitṛvīryeṇa putrāstejobalānvitāḥ //
meaning:
यथा दारुमयी योषा चेष्टते कुहकेच्छया /
तथाहि पितृवीर्येण पुत्रास्तेजोबलान्विताः //
text_mt: Just as a wooden doll moves according to the juggler's wish, / even so sons are endowed with brilliance and strength by their father's virility.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādiyaṃ mādhavadevavallabhā vilokayasvādya mayopanītā /
ātmecchayā yacchatu rakṣatādvā svasaṃpado mātṛsamūhavaryāḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge dharmāṅgadadigvijayo nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तस्मादियं माधवदेववल्लभा विलोकयस्वाद्य मयोपनीता /
आत्मेच्छया यच्छतु रक्षताद्वा स्वसंपदो मातृसमूहवर्याः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे धर्माङ्गददिग्विजयो नाम विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Therefore, behold this [wealth] dear to Lord Mādhava, brought here today by me; / let the foremost of mothers distribute it according to her own wish, or let her protect her own fortunes."

Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "The World-Conquest of Dharmāṅgada", in the latter section of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
māndhātovāca
putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kiṃ cakāra mahīpatiḥ /
sā cāpi mohinī brahmanpriyā rājño vidheḥ sutā //
meaning:
मान्धातोवाच
पुत्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा किं चकार महीपतिः /
सा चापि मोहिनी ब्रह्मन्प्रिया राज्ञो विधेः सुता //
title: athaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Māndhātṛ said: / Having heard his son's speech, what did the king do? / And what of Mohinī, O brāhmaṇa, the beloved of the king, the daughter of the Creator?

sanskrit_iast:
āścaryarūpaṃ kathitamākhyānaṃ tu sudhopamam /
viśeṣatastvayā puṇyaṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam //
meaning:
आश्चर्यरूपं कथितमाख्यानं तु सुधोपमम् /
विशेषतस्त्वया पुण्यं सर्वसंदेहभञ्जनम् //
text_mt: A wondrous narrative, nectar-like, has been told, / especially auspicious and dispelling all doubt, by you.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭo nṛpapuṅgavaḥ /
udatiṣṭhatpriyāyuktastāḥ śriyaścāvalokayat //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तत्पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहृष्टो नृपपुङ्गवः /
उदतिष्ठत्प्रियायुक्तस्ताः श्रियश्चावलोकयत् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing that speech of his son, the bull among kings rejoiced; / accompanied by his beloved, he stood up and surveyed those riches.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ harṣānvito bhūpa rājā viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ /
nāgakanyāstu tāḥ sarvā vāruṇīsahitā mudā //
meaning:
क्षणं हर्षान्वितो भूप राजा विष्णुपरायणः /
नागकन्यास्तु ताः सर्वा वारुणीसहिता मुदा //
text_mt: Filled with delight for a moment, O king, that monarch devoted to Viṣṇu / joyfully gave all those daughters of the nāgas together with the daughter of Varuṇa

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau tanaye premṇā bhāryārthaṃ dharmabhūṣaṇe /
śeṣaṃ dānavanārībhirbahuratnasamanvitam //
meaning:
प्रददौ तनये प्रेम्णा भार्यार्थं धर्मभूषणे /
शेषं दानवनारीभिर्बहुरत्नसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: with affection to his son, that ornament of righteousness, to be his wives; / the rest, accompanied by the women of the Dānavas and many jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyai pradadau rājā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ /
saṃvibhajya pitā vittaṃ dharmāṅgadasamāhṛtam //
meaning:
मोहिन्यै प्रददौ राजा कामबाणप्रपीडितः /
संविभज्य पिता वित्तं धर्माङ्गदसमाहृतम् //
text_mt: the king, tormented by the arrows of Love, gave to Mohinī, / the father having divided the wealth gathered by Dharmāṅgada.

sanskrit_iast:
purohitamuvācedaṃ kāle cāhūya bhūpatiḥ /
sarvāsāṃ matsuto brahmanpāṇīngṛhṇātu dharmataḥ //
meaning:
पुरोहितमुवाचेदं काले चाहूय भूपतिः /
सर्वासां मत्सुतो ब्रह्मन्पाणीन्गृह्णातु धर्मतः //
text_mt: Summoning the family priest at that time, the ruler of the earth said this: / "O brāhmaṇa, let my son take the hands of all of them according to the law;

sanskrit_iast:
kumārīṇāṃ kumāro 'yaṃ madvākye saṃsthitaḥ sadā /
vaivāhyalagne nakṣatre muhūrte sarvakāmade //
meaning:
कुमारीणां कुमारो ऽयं मद्वाक्ये संस्थितः सदा /
वैवाह्यलग्ने नक्षत्रे मुहूर्ते सर्वकामदे //
text_mt: this young prince ever stands obedient to my command. / At a wedding ascendant, an auspicious lunar mansion, and a muhūrta that grants all desires,

sanskrit_iast:
vācayitvā dvijānsvasti gosvarṇāṃbaratoṣitān /
vivāhaṃ kuru putrasya mama dharmāṅgadasya vai //
meaning:
वाचयित्वा द्विजान्स्वस्ति गोस्वर्णांबरतोषितान् /
विवाहं कुरु पुत्रस्य मम धर्माङ्गदस्य वै //
text_mt: having the twice-born recite blessings, satisfied with cows, gold, and garments, / perform indeed the marriage of my son Dharmāṅgada!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ putrasya pitodvāhaṃ na karotīha mandadhīḥ /
sasa majjennarake ghore hyapratiṣṭhe yugāyutam //
meaning:
यः पुत्रस्य पितोद्वाहं न करोतीह मन्दधीः /
सस मज्जेन्नरके घोरे ह्यप्रतिष्ठे युगायुतम् //
text_mt: Whatever foolish father does not perform his son's marriage here, / he sinks into a dreadful hell without support for ten thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāccodvāhayetputraṃ pitā dharmasamanvitaḥ /
ātmā saṃsthāpitastena yena saṃsthāpitaḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्चोद्वाहयेत्पुत्रं पिता धर्मसमन्वितः /
आत्मा संस्थापितस्तेन येन संस्थापितः सुतः //
text_mt: Therefore, a father endowed with righteousness should have his son married; / oneself has been established by him by whom the son has been established.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakratuphalaṃ tasya putrodvāhe kṛte bhavet /
putrasya guṇayuktasya nirguṇasyāpi bhūsura //
meaning:
सर्वक्रतुफलं तस्य पुत्रोद्वाहे कृते भवेत् /
पुत्रस्य गुणयुक्तस्य निर्गुणस्यापि भूसुर //
text_mt: The fruit of all sacrifices is his when the son's marriage has been performed, / whether the son is endowed with virtues or lacking virtues, O earthly god!

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā kārayitavyo hi vivāho dharmamicchatā /
yo na dāraiśca vittaiśca putrānsaṃyojayetpitā //
meaning:
पित्रा कारयितव्यो हि विवाहो धर्ममिच्छता /
यो न दारैश्च वित्तैश्च पुत्रान्संयोजयेत्पिता //
text_mt: A marriage must certainly be caused to be performed by a father desiring righteousness; / that father who does not unite his sons with wives and with wealth

sanskrit_iast:
na pumānsa tu vijñeya ihāmutra vigarhitaḥ /
tasmādvṛttiyutāḥ kāryāḥ putrā dāraiḥ samanvitāḥ //
meaning:
न पुमान्स तु विज्ञेय इहामुत्र विगर्हितः /
तस्माद्वृत्तियुताः कार्याः पुत्रा दारैः समन्विताः //
text_mt: is not to be known as a real man, but is condemned in this world and the next. / Therefore, sons should be provided with a livelihood and endowed with wives,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ramante te tuṣṭāḥ sukhaṃ putrāḥ sumānitāḥ /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājño dvijastasya purohitaḥ //
meaning:
यथा रमन्ते ते तुष्टाः सुखं पुत्राः सुमानिताः /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राज्ञो द्विजस्तस्य पुरोहितः //
text_mt: so that, satisfied and highly honored, the sons may delight in happiness." / Hearing that speech of the king, the twice-born priest of his

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadavivāhārthamudyato harṣasaṃyutaḥ /
sa yuvānicchamāno 'pi strīsaukhyaṃ lajjāyā sutaḥ //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदविवाहार्थमुद्यतो हर्षसंयुतः /
स युवानिच्छमानो ऽपि स्त्रीसौख्यं लज्जाया सुतः //
text_mt: undertook with joy the marriage of Dharmāṅgada. / That young son, though not desiring the pleasure of women out of modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
svīcakāra piturvākyāddārasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tadā /
varuṇātmajayā sārddhaṃ nāgakanyā manoharāḥ //
meaning:
स्वीचकार पितुर्वाक्याद्दारसंग्रहणं तदा /
वरुणात्मजया सार्द्धं नागकन्या मनोहराः //
text_mt: then accepted the taking of wives at his father's command. / Along with the daughter of Varuṇa, the charming daughters of the nāgas,

sanskrit_iast:
upayeme mahābāhū rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi /
udvāhayitvā sarvāstā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā //
meaning:
उपयेमे महाबाहू रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि /
उद्वाहयित्वा सर्वास्ता विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा //
text_mt: incomparable on earth in beauty, the mighty-armed one wedded, / having married them all through the rite prescribed by the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
vasugoratnadānāni viprebhyaḥ pradadau mudā /
kṛtadāro vavande 'tha pādānmātuḥ piturmudā //
meaning:
वसुगोरत्नदानानि विप्रेभ्यः प्रददौ मुदा /
कृतदारो ववन्दे ऽथ पादान्मातुः पितुर्मुदा //
text_mt: With joy he gave gifts of wealth, cows, and jewels to the brāhmaṇas. / Having taken wives, he then gladly bowed to the feet of his mother and father.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃdhyāvalīdevīmāha dharmāṅgadaḥ sutaḥ /
piturvākyena me devi saṃjāto dārasaṃgrahaḥ //
meaning:
ततः संध्यावलीदेवीमाह धर्माङ्गदः सुतः /
पितुर्वाक्येन मे देवि संजातो दारसंग्रहः //
text_mt: Then the son, Dharmāṅgada, said to Queen Saṃdhyāvalī: / “O queen, my taking of wives came to pass by my father's command.

sanskrit_iast:
etanme nāsti manasi yatpitrodvāhito hyaham /
avyayaṃ pitaraṃ vijñaṃ devi śuśrūṣaye hyaham //
meaning:
एतन्मे नास्ति मनसि यत्पित्रोद्वाहितो ह्यहम् /
अव्ययं पितरं विज्ञं देवि शुश्रूषये ह्यहम् //
text_mt: It was not in my mind that my father should have me married. / O queen, I would rather serve my wise, imperishable father.

sanskrit_iast:
divyairbhogairna me kiñcitsvargeṇāpi prayojanam /
kāryā me pitṛśuśrūṣā tava caiva divāniśam //
meaning:
दिव्यैर्भोगैर्न मे किञ्चित्स्वर्गेणापि प्रयोजनम् /
कार्या मे पितृशुश्रूषा तव चैव दिवानिशम् //
text_mt: I have no need of divine pleasures, nor even of heaven. / My duty is the service of my father and of you, day and night.”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvalyuvāca
ciraṃ jīva sukhaṃ putra bhuṅkṣva bhogānmano 'nugān /
pituḥ prasādāddīrghoyurmano nandaya me suta //
meaning:
संध्यावल्युवाच
चिरं जीव सुखं पुत्र भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्मनो ऽनुगान् /
पितुः प्रसादाद्दीर्घोयुर्मनो नन्दय मे सुत //
text_mt: Saṃdhyāvalī said: / “Live long and happily, my son; enjoy pleasures that accord with your heart. / By your father's grace be long-lived, and gladden my heart, my son.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā suputriṇī putra jātā guṇavatā kṣitau /
sapatnīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ hṛdaye saṃsthitā hyaham //
meaning:
त्वया सुपुत्रिणी पुत्र जाता गुणवता क्षितौ /
सपत्नीनां च सर्वासां हृदये संस्थिता ह्यहम् //
text_mt: Through you, a virtuous son, I have become a mother of a noble son on earth, / and I have indeed established myself in the hearts of all my co-wives.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā pariṣvajya mūrddhanyāghrāya cāsakṛt /
vyasarjayattataḥ putraṃ rājyatantrāvalokane //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा परिष्वज्य मूर्द्धन्याघ्राय चासकृत् /
व्यसर्जयत्ततः पुत्रं राज्यतन्त्रावलोकने //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, embracing him and smelling his head repeatedly, / she then dismissed her son to look after the affairs of state.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjitastadā mātrā mātṝranyāḥ praṇamya ca /
rājyatantraṃ tadakhilaṃ cakre pitṛvacaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
विसर्जितस्तदा मात्रा मातॄरन्याः प्रणम्य च /
राज्यतन्त्रं तदखिलं चक्रे पितृवचः स्थितः //
text_mt: Then, dismissed by his mother and having bowed to the other mothers, / he managed all those affairs of state, abiding by his father's word.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣṭanigrahaṇaṃ cakre śiṣṭānāṃ paripālanam /
aṭanaṃ sarvadeśeṣu vīkṣaṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇām //
meaning:
दुष्टनिग्रहणं चक्रे शिष्टानां परिपालनम् /
अटनं सर्वदेशेषु वीक्षणं सर्वकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: He carried out the punishment of the wicked and the protection of the good; / he traveled through all regions and inspected all activities.

sanskrit_iast:
cakre sarvatra kāryāṇāṃ māsi māsi nirīkṣaṇam /
hastyaśvapoṣaṇaṃ cakre cāracakrekṣaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
चक्रे सर्वत्र कार्याणां मासि मासि निरीक्षणम् /
हस्त्यश्वपोषणं चक्रे चारचक्रेक्षणं तथा //
text_mt: Every month he conducted inspections of public affairs everywhere; / he maintained elephants and horses, and likewise oversaw the network of spies.

sanskrit_iast:
vādasaṃvīkṣaṇaṃ cakre tulāmānaṃ dine dene /
gṛhe gṛhe narāṇāṃ ca cakre saṃrakṣaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
वादसंवीक्षणं चक्रे तुलामानं दिने देने /
गृहे गृहे नराणां च चक्रे संरक्षणं नृपः //
text_mt: He examined legal disputes and checked weights and measures day after day; / and in every house the king provided protection for the people.

sanskrit_iast:
stanandhayī kvacidbālaḥ stanahīno na roditi /
śvaśrūrvadhvā na kutrāpi prarodityavamānitā //
meaning:
स्तनन्धयी क्वचिद्बालः स्तनहीनो न रोदिति /
श्वश्रूर्वध्वा न कुत्रापि प्ररोदित्यवमानिता //
text_mt: Nowhere did a suckling infant cry for lack of the breast; / nowhere did a mother-in-law or daughter-in-law weep because of disrespect.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitsamarthastanayaḥ pitaraṃ nahi yācate /
na varṇasaṃkaro rājye keṣāñcidabhavatpunaḥ //
meaning:
क्वचित्समर्थस्तनयः पितरं नहि याचते /
न वर्णसंकरो राज्ये केषाञ्चिदभवत्पुनः //
text_mt: Nowhere did an able-bodied son beg from his father; / nor was there any confusion of classes in his kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
na gūḍhavibhavo loko dharme vadati dūṣaṇam /
na kañcukavihīnā tu bhavennārī sabhartṛkā //
meaning:
न गूढविभवो लोको धर्मे वदति दूषणम् /
न कञ्चुकविहीना तु भवेन्नारी सभर्तृका //
text_mt: People did not conceal their wealth, nor speak ill of righteousness; / nor was any married woman seen without a bodice.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhānniṣkramaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ māstu rājye madīyake /
mā sakeśā hi vidhavā māstvakeśā mabhartṛkā //
meaning:
गृहान्निष्क्रमणं स्त्रीणां मास्तु राज्ये मदीयके /
मा सकेशा हि विधवा मास्त्वकेशा मभर्तृका //
text_mt: [He decreed:] “Let women not wander outside their homes in my kingdom; / let there be no widow with uncut hair, and no married woman with shaved hair.

sanskrit_iast:
mā vratīha sadākrośī māraṇyā nagarāśrayāḥ /
sāmānyavṛttyadātā me rājye 'vasatu nirghṛṇaḥ //
meaning:
मा व्रतीह सदाक्रोशी मारण्या नगराश्रयाः /
सामान्यवृत्त्यदाता मे राज्ये ऽवसतु निर्घृणः //
text_mt: Let no person observing a vow be constantly abusive; let not forest dwellers settle in towns; / let no cruel person who denies common livelihood dwell in my kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
gopālo nagarākāṅkṣī nirguṇastūpadeśakaḥ /
ṛtvigvā śāstrahīnaśca mā me rājye vasediha //
meaning:
गोपालो नगराकाङ्क्षी निर्गुणस्तूपदेशकः /
ऋत्विग्वा शास्त्रहीनश्च मा मे राज्ये वसेदिह //
text_mt: Let no cowherd coveting the city, no teacher lacking virtue, / nor any priest ignorant of the scriptures dwell here in my kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hi niṣpādayennīlīṃ nīlīraṅgātisecakaḥ /
nirvāsyau tāvubhau pāpau yo vai madyaṃ karoti ca //
meaning:
यो हि निष्पादयेन्नीलीं नीलीरङ्गातिसेचकः /
निर्वास्यौ तावुभौ पापौ यो वै मद्यं करोति च //
text_mt: He who produces indigo, he who profusely douses with indigo dye, / and he who makes intoxicating drink—both those sinners must be banished.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā māṃsaṃ hi yo 'śnāti pṛṣṭhamāṃsapriyo hi yaḥ /
tasya vāso na me rājye svakalatraṃ tyajecca yaḥ //
meaning:
वृथा मांसं हि यो ऽश्नाति पृष्ठमांसप्रियो हि यः /
तस्य वासो न मे राज्ये स्वकलत्रं त्यजेच्च यः //
text_mt: He who eats meat uselessly, he who is fond of back-meat, / and he who abandons his own wife shall have no dwelling in my kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ parityajya varaṃ surāṇāṃ saṃpūjayedyo 'nyatamaṃ hi devam /
gacchetsagarbhāṃ yuvatīṃ prasūtāṃ daṇḍyaśca vadhyaśca sa cāsmadīyaiḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge śikṣānirūpaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
विष्णुं परित्यज्य वरं सुराणां संपूजयेद्यो ऽन्यतमं हि देवम् /
गच्छेत्सगर्भां युवतीं प्रसूतां दण्ड्यश्च वध्यश्च स चास्मदीयैः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे शिक्षानिरूपणं नामैकविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He who, forsaking Viṣṇu, the foremost among the gods, worships any other deity, / or approaches a pregnant young woman who has just given birth, is to be punished and put to death by our men.”

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, entitled “Instruction on Moral Conduct,” in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭa uvāca
evaṃ dharmāṅgado rājyaṃ cakāra vasudhātale /
piturnaniyogādrājendra pālayan harivāsaram //
meaning:
वसिष्ट उवाच
एवं धर्माङ्गदो राज्यं चकार वसुधातले /
पितुर्ननियोगाद्राजेन्द्र पालयन् हरिवासरम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus Dharmāṅgada ruled the realm upon the surface of the earth / at his father's direction, O king of kings, observing the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
na babhūva janaḥ kaścidyo na dharme vyavasthitaḥ /
nāsukhī nāprajaḥ kaścinna vā phuṣṭhī mahīpate //
meaning:
न बभूव जनः कश्चिद्यो न धर्मे व्यवस्थितः /
नासुखी नाप्रजः कश्चिन्न वा फुष्ठी महीपते //
text_mt: There was no person who was not established in righteousness; / no one was unhappy, childless, or afflicted with leprosy, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭapuṣṭa jane tasmin kṣmā caiva nidhidāyinī /
ghaṭadogdhrīṣu nṛpate tṛptavatsāsu dhenuṣu //
meaning:
हृष्टपुष्ट जने तस्मिन् क्ष्मा चैव निधिदायिनी /
घटदोग्ध्रीषु नृपते तृप्तवत्सासु धेनुषु //
text_mt: While the people were joyful and thriving, the earth yielded treasures, / and cows, whose calves were satisfied, yielded potfuls of milk, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
puṭake kuṭake kṣaudraṃ droṇamātraṃ drume drume /
prahṛṣṭāyāṃ tu medinyāṃ sarvadhānyasamudbhavaḥ //
meaning:
पुटके कुटके क्षौद्रं द्रोणमात्रं द्रुमे द्रुमे /
प्रहृष्टायां तु मेदिन्यां सर्वधान्यसमुद्भवः //
text_mt: On every tree there were small hollows yielding a droṇa of honey; / and while the earth was delighted, all varieties of grain sprang forth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasya sparddhini yuge tretānte dvāpare yuge /
vyatīte jaladāpāye nirmale cāṃbare gṛhe //
meaning:
कृतस्य स्पर्द्धिनि युगे त्रेतान्ते द्वापरे युगे /
व्यतीते जलदापाये निर्मले चांबरे गृहे //
text_mt: In the Dvāpara age, at the close of the Tretā age, rivaling the Kṛta age, / when the cessation of the rains had passed, and the sky was clear and clouds were gone,

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhiśālipakvāḍhye kuṃbhodbhavavilokite /
madhyapravāhayuktāsu nimnagāsu samantataḥ //
meaning:
सुगन्धिशालिपक्वाढ्ये कुंभोद्भवविलोकिते /
मध्यप्रवाहयुक्तासु निम्नगासु समन्ततः //
text_mt: when the earth was rich with ripe, fragrant rice, watched over by Agastya, / and rivers flowed with a moderate current everywhere,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrotthaiḥ kāśapuṣpaiśca śuklakeśairivāṅganā /
candrāṃśudhavale loke nātitīvre divākare //
meaning:
तीरोत्थैः काशपुष्पैश्च शुक्लकेशैरिवाङ्गना /
चन्द्रांशुधवले लोके नातितीव्रे दिवाकरे //
text_mt: when the banks bloomed with kāśa flowers like women with white hair, / when the world was white with moonbeams and the sun was not overly hot,

sanskrit_iast:
tasminmanuṣyabahulairjalasnānavicitritaiḥ /
yatrotsukaiḥ prayātaistu bhūmipālaiḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्मनुष्यबहुलैर्जलस्नानविचित्रितैः /
यत्रोत्सुकैः प्रयातैस्तु भूमिपालैः समन्ततः //
text_mt: at that time, crowded with men variegated by water-baths, / and kings had set out everywhere, eager for festivities,

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhasamaye viṣṇorāśvinānte jagadguroḥ /
mohinī ramayāmāsa tatkāle hṛcchayārditā //
meaning:
प्रबोधसमये विष्णोराश्विनान्ते जगद्गुरोः /
मोहिनी रमयामास तत्काले हृच्छयार्दिता //
text_mt: at the time of the awakening of Viṣṇu, the teacher of the world, at the end of the month of Āśvina, / Mohinī, afflicted by love at that time, delighted

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaṃ vividhaiḥ saukhyaiḥ sarvabhāvena suṃdarī /
vaneṣu giriśṛṅgeṣu nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca //
meaning:
राजानं विविधैः सौख्यैः सर्वभावेन सुंदरी /
वनेषु गिरिशृङ्गेषु नदीनां संगमेषु च //
text_mt: the king with diverse pleasures wholeheartedly, being a beautiful woman, / in the forests, on mountain peaks, and at the confluences of rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
padminī kusumāḍhyeṣu saraḥsu vividheṣu ca /
malaye mandare vindhye mahendre vibudhālaye //
meaning:
पद्मिनी कुसुमाढ्येषु सरःसु विविधेषु च /
मलये मन्दरे विन्ध्ये महेन्द्रे विबुधालये //
text_mt: at various lakes abundant with lotus blossoms, / on Malaya, Mandara, Vindhya, Mahendra, in the abode of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
sahye prāleyasaṃjñe ca digaṃbaragirau śubhe /
anyeṣu caiva rājānaṃ svargasthānādikeṣu ca //
meaning:
सह्ये प्रालेयसंज्ञे च दिगंबरगिरौ शुभे /
अन्येषु चैव राजानं स्वर्गस्थानादिकेषु च //
text_mt: on the auspicious Sahya, the mountain called snowy [Himālaya], and Digambara, / and in other heavenly realms and the like, she delighted

sanskrit_iast:
rameyāyāsa rājendra divyarūpā dine dine /
rājāpi mohinīṃ prāpya sarvaṃ kṛtyaṃ parityajan //
meaning:
रमेयायास राजेन्द्र दिव्यरूपा दिने दिने /
राजापि मोहिनीं प्राप्य सर्वं कृत्यं परित्यजन् //
text_mt: the king, O king of kings, appearing in divine form day after day. / The king too, having gained Mohinī, abandoned all other duties;

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktaṃ na vāsaraṃ viṣṇorjanmamṛtyunikṛntanam /
vrataṃ nopekṣate tattu atimugdho 'pi pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
त्यक्तं न वासरं विष्णोर्जन्ममृत्युनिकृन्तनम् /
व्रतं नोपेक्षते तत्तु अतिमुग्धो ऽपि पार्थिवः //
text_mt: yet he did not abandon the day of Viṣṇu, which cuts off birth and death. / Even though utterly infatuated, that king did not neglect the vow.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāṃ tyajati bhūpālo daśamyādidinatraye /
evaṃ prakīḍatastasya pūrṇe saṃvatsare gate //
meaning:
क्रीडां त्यजति भूपालो दशम्यादिदिनत्रये /
एवं प्रकीडतस्तस्य पूर्णे संवत्सरे गते //
text_mt: The ruler of the earth abandoned dalliance during the three days beginning with the tenth. / As he was sporting thus, when a full year had elapsed,

sanskrit_iast:
kāle kālavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ saṃprāptaḥ kārtikaḥ śubhaḥ /
nidrāchedakaro viṣṇoḥ sa māsaḥ puṇyadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
काले कालविदां श्रेष्ठः संप्राप्तः कार्तिकः शुभः /
निद्राछेदकरो विष्णोः स मासः पुण्यदायकः //
text_mt: the auspicious month of Kārtika arrived in due time, O best of those who know time— / that month which ends the sleep of Viṣṇu and bestows merit,

sanskrit_iast:
yasminkṛtaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ vaiṣṇavairmanujairnṛpa /
akṣayaṃ hi bhavetsarvaṃ viṣṇulokapradāyakam //
meaning:
यस्मिन्कृतं हि सुकृतं वैष्णवैर्मनुजैर्नृप /
अक्षयं हि भवेत्सर्वं विष्णुलोकप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: in which good deeds performed by Vaiṣṇava men, O king, / all become imperishable, granting the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
na kārtikasamo māso na kūtena samaṃ yugam /
na dharmastu dayā tulyo na jyotiścakṣuṣā samam //
meaning:
न कार्तिकसमो मासो न कूतेन समं युगम् /
न धर्मस्तु दया तुल्यो न ज्योतिश्चक्षुषा समम् //
text_mt: There is no month equal to Kārtika; there is no yuga equal to the Kṛta; / there is no duty equal to compassion; there is no light equal to the eye.

sanskrit_iast:
na vedena samaṃ śāstraṃ na tīrthaṃ gaṅgayā samam /
na bhūmyā sadṛśaṃ dānaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāryayā samam //
meaning:
न वेदेन समं शास्त्रं न तीर्थं गङ्गया समम् /
न भूम्या सदृशं दानं न सुखं भार्यया समम् //
text_mt: There is no scripture equal to the Veda; there is no sacred ford equal to the Gaṅgā; / there is no gift equal to land; there is no happiness equal to a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
na kṛṣyā tu samaṃ vittaṃ na lābhaḥ surabhīsamaḥ /
na tapo 'naśanādanyanna damena samaṃ śivam //
meaning:
न कृष्या तु समं वित्तं न लाभः सुरभीसमः /
न तपो ऽनशनादन्यन्न दमेन समं शिवम् //
text_mt: There is no wealth equal to agriculture; there is no gain equal to a wish-granting cow; / there is no austerity other than fasting; there is no auspicious good equal to self-control.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛptirna rasanātulyā na samo 'nyo dvijena ca /
na dharmeṇa samaṃ mitraṃ na satyena samaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
तृप्तिर्न रसनातुल्या न समो ऽन्यो द्विजेन च /
न धर्मेण समं मित्रं न सत्येन समं यशः //
text_mt: There is no satisfaction equal to taste; there is none equal to a twice-born; / there is no friend equal to righteousness; there is no fame equal to truth.

sanskrit_iast:
nārogyasamamaiśvaryaṃ na devaḥ keśavātparaḥ /
na kārtikasamaṃ loke pāvanaṃ kavayo viduḥ //
meaning:
नारोग्यसममैश्वर्यं न देवः केशवात्परः /
न कार्तिकसमं लोके पावनं कवयो विदुः //
text_mt: There is no sovereignty equal to health; there is no deity higher than Keśava; / poets know no purifier in the world equal to Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikaḥ pravaro māso viṣṇoścāpi priyaḥ sadā /
avrato hi kṣipedyastu māsaṃ dāmodarapriyam //
meaning:
कार्तिकः प्रवरो मासो विष्णोश्चापि प्रियः सदा /
अव्रतो हि क्षिपेद्यस्तु मासं दामोदरप्रियम् //
text_mt: Kārtika is the foremost month and ever dear to Viṣṇu. / Whosoever passes the month dear to Dāmodara without vows

sanskrit_iast: tiryagyonimavāpnoti sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ //
meaning: तिर्यग्योनिमवाप्नोति सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः //
text_mt: attains an animal birth, excluded from all duties.

sanskrit_iast:
māndhātovāca
saṃprāpya kārtike māse rājā rukmāṅgado mune /
mohinīṃ mohasaṃyuktāṃ kathaṃ sa bubhuje vada //
meaning:
मान्धातोवाच
संप्राप्य कार्तिके मासे राजा रुक्माङ्गदो मुने /
मोहिनीं मोहसंयुक्तां कथं स बुभुजे वद //
text_mt: Māndhātṛ said: / “When the month of Kārtika arrived, O sage, how did King Rukmāṅgada / enjoy Mohinī, who was filled with infatuation? Tell me.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubhaktaḥ śrutiparaḥ pravaraḥ sa mahīkṣitām /
tasminpuṇyatame māse kiṃ cakāra nṛpottamaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुभक्तः श्रुतिपरः प्रवरः स महीक्षिताम् /
तस्मिन्पुण्यतमे मासे किं चकार नृपोत्तमः //
text_mt: He was devoted to Viṣṇu, intent upon the scriptures, the foremost of monarchs. / What did that best of kings do in that most holy month?”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃprāptaṃ kārtikaṃ dṛṣṭvā prabodhakaraṇaṃ hareḥ /
atipramugdho rājendro mohinīṃ vākyamabravīt //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
संप्राप्तं कार्तिकं दृष्ट्वा प्रबोधकरणं हरेः /
अतिप्रमुग्धो राजेन्द्रो मोहिनीं वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Seeing the arrival of Kārtika, which brings about the awakening of Hari, the king of kings, deeply infatuated, spoke words to Mohinī:

sanskrit_iast:
rataṃ devi tvayā sārddhaṃ mayā saṃvatsarānbahūn /
tavāpamānabhītena noktaṃ kiñcidapi kvacit //
meaning:
रतं देवि त्वया सार्द्धं मया संवत्सरान्बहून् /
तवापमानभीतेन नोक्तं किञ्चिदपि क्वचित् //
text_mt: "O lady, I have sported with you for many years; / fearing your displeasure, I have never said anything anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃprataṃ vaktukāmo 'haṃ tannibodha śubhānane /
tvayyāsaktasya me devi bahavaḥ kārtikā gatāḥ //
meaning:
सांप्रतं वक्तुकामो ऽहं तन्निबोध शुभानने /
त्वय्यासक्तस्य मे देवि बहवः कार्तिका गताः //
text_mt: Now I desire to speak; understand that, O fair-faced woman! / For me who am attached to you, O lady, many Kārtikas have passed.

sanskrit_iast:
na vratī kārtike jāto muktvaikaṃ harivāsaram /
so 'haṃ kārtikamicchāmi vrate na paryyupāsitum //
meaning:
न व्रती कार्तिके जातो मुक्त्वैकं हरिवासरम् /
सो ऽहं कार्तिकमिच्छामि व्रते न पर्य्युपासितुम् //
text_mt: I did not undertake a vow in Kārtika, except for the one day of Hari. / Therefore, I desire to attend to Kārtika with a vow.

sanskrit_iast:
avratena gato yeṣāṃ kārtiko martyadharmiṇām /
iṣṭāpūrtau vṛthā teṣāṃ dharmo druhiṇasaṃbhave //
meaning:
अव्रतेन गतो येषां कार्तिको मर्त्यधर्मिणाम् /
इष्टापूर्तौ वृथा तेषां धर्मो द्रुहिणसंभवे //
text_mt: For those mortal beings for whom Kārtika has passed without a vow, / their religious duty in sacrificial and charitable works is useless, O daughter of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsāśino 'pi bhūpālā atyarthaṃ mṛgayāratāḥ /
te bhāṃsaṃ kārtike tyaktvā gatā viṣṇvālayaṃ śubhe //
meaning:
मांसाशिनो ऽपि भूपाला अत्यर्थं मृगयारताः /
ते भांसं कार्तिके त्यक्त्वा गता विष्ण्वालयं शुभे //
text_mt: Even kings who ate meat and were excessively devoted to hunting, / having given up meat in Kārtika, went to Viṣṇu's abode, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttānāṃ hi bhakṣyāṇāṃ kārtike niyame kṛte /
avaśyaṃ viṣṇurūpatvaṃ prāpyate sādhakena hi //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तानां हि भक्ष्याणां कार्तिके नियमे कृते /
अवश्यं विष्णुरूपत्वं प्राप्यते साधकेन हि //
text_mt: Indeed, when an observance is made regarding everyday foods in Kārtika, / similarity of form with Viṣṇu is certainly attained by the practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhantu bahuvittāni dānāni varavarṇini /
hṛdayāyāsakartṝṇi dīpadānāddivaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
तिष्ठन्तु बहुवित्तानि दानानि वरवर्णिनि /
हृदयायासकर्तॄणि दीपदानाद्दिवं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Leave aside gifts of great wealth that cause exertion to the heart, O woman of excellent complexion; / through the offering of a lamp one goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyabhāvātsubhage paradīpaprabodhanam /
kartavyaṃ bhaktibhāvena sarvadānādhikaṃ ca tat //
meaning:
तस्याप्यभावात्सुभगे परदीपप्रबोधनम् /
कर्तव्यं भक्तिभावेन सर्वदानाधिकं च तत् //
text_mt: Even in the absence of that, O auspicious one, trimming another's lamp / should be performed with a spirit of devotion; and that is greater than all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
ekataḥ sarvadānāni dīpadānaṃ hi caikataḥ /
kārtikena samaṃ proktaṃ dīpadānātprabodhanam //
meaning:
एकतः सर्वदानानि दीपदानं हि चैकतः /
कार्तिकेन समं प्रोक्तं दीपदानात्प्रबोधनम् //
text_mt: All gifts are on one side, and the gift of a lamp is on the other; / keeping a lamp burning is proclaimed equal to Kārtika [observances] through the gift of a lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ bhaktibhāvena sarvadānādhikaṃ smṛtam /
kārtikīṃ ca tithiṃ kṛtvā viṣṇornābhisaroruhe //
meaning:
कर्तव्यं भक्तिभावेन सर्वदानाधिकं स्मृतम् /
कार्तिकीं च तिथिं कृत्वा विष्णोर्नाभिसरोरुहे //
text_mt: It should be performed with a spirit of devotion; it is remembered as superior to all gifts. / And having observed the full-moon lunar day of Kārtika at the navel-lotus of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
ājanmakṛtapāpāttu mucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ /
vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ kārtiko yasya gacchati //
meaning:
आजन्मकृतपापात्तु मुच्यते नात्रसंशयः /
व्रतोपवासनियमैः कार्तिको यस्य गच्छति //
text_mt: one is freed from sins committed since birth; there is no doubt in this. / For whomever Kārtika passes with vows, fasts, and observances,

sanskrit_iast:
devo vaimāniko bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim /
tasmānmohini mohaṃ tvaṃ parityajya mamopari //
meaning:
देवो वैमानिको भूत्वा स याति परमां गतिम् /
तस्मान्मोहिनि मोहं त्वं परित्यज्य ममोपरि //
text_mt: becoming a god travelling in an aerial car, he goes to the supreme state. / Therefore, O Mohinī, giving up your infatuation toward me,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāṃ vidhehi tatkālaṃ kariṣye kārttikavratam /
tava vakṣojapūjāyā virato nīrajekṣame //
meaning:
आज्ञां विधेहि तत्कालं करिष्ये कार्त्तिकव्रतम् /
तव वक्षोजपूजाया विरतो नीरजेक्षमे //
text_mt: grant your permission; at that time I will perform the vow of Kārtika. / Desisting from the worship of your breasts, O lotus-eyed woman,

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ vratadharaścaiva bhaviṣye haripūjane /
mohinyuvāca
vistareṇa samākhyāhi māhātmyaṃ kārtikasya ca //
meaning:
अहं व्रतधरश्चैव भविष्ये हरिपूजने /
मोहिन्युवाच
विस्तरेण समाख्याहि माहात्म्यं कार्तिकस्य च //
text_mt: I shall indeed maintain the vow in the worship of Hari." / Mohinī said: / "Explain in detail the eulogy of greatness of Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapuṇyākaraḥ prokto māso 'yaṃ rājasattamā /
viśeṣātkutra kathitastadādiśa mahāmate //
meaning:
सर्वपुण्याकरः प्रोक्तो मासो ऽयं राजसत्तमा /
विशेषात्कुत्र कथितस्तदादिश महामते //
text_mt: This month is said to be a mine of all merits, O best of kings; / tell where it is especially proclaimed, O highly intelligent one!

sanskrit_iast: śrutvā kārttikamāhātmyaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ yathepsitam //
meaning: श्रुत्वा कार्त्तिकमाहात्म्यं करिष्ये ऽहं यथेप्सितम् //
text_mt: Having heard the eulogy of the greatness of Kārtika, I shall act as you desire."

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgada uvāca
māhātmyamabhidhāsyāmi māsasyāsya varānane /
yena bhaktirbhavitrī te prakartuṃ haripūjanam //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गद उवाच
माहात्म्यमभिधास्यामि मासस्यास्य वरानने /
येन भक्तिर्भवित्री ते प्रकर्तुं हरिपूजनम् //
text_mt: Rukmāṅgada said: / "I shall describe the eulogy of the greatness of this month, O fair-faced one, / by which devotion will arise in you to perform the worship of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike kṛcchrasevī yaḥ prājāpatyacaro 'pi vā /
ekāntaropavāsī vā trirātropoṣito 'pi vā //
meaning:
कार्त्तिके कृच्छ्रसेवी यः प्राजापत्यचरो ऽपि वा /
एकान्तरोपवासी वा त्रिरात्रोपोषितो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Whoever performs the kṛcchra in Kārtika, or practices the prājāpatya, / or fasts on alternate days, or even fasts for three nights,

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā daśāhaṃ pakṣaṃ vā māsaṃ vā varavarṇini /
kṣapayitvā naro yāti sa viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
यद्वा दशाहं पक्षं वा मासं वा वरवर्णिनि /
क्षपयित्वा नरो याति स विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: or, O woman of excellent complexion, having spent ten days, a fortnight, or a month [fasting], / that man goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca /
asmin narairdharā caiva prāpyate dvīpamālinī //
meaning:
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च /
अस्मिन् नरैर्धरा चैव प्राप्यते द्वीपमालिनी //
text_mt: By eating once a day, by eating at night, and likewise by eating only unsolicited food / in this [month], the earth garlanded with continents is attained by men.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣātpuṣkare tīrthe dvārāvatyāṃ ca śaukare /
māso 'yaṃ bhaktidaḥ prokto vratadānārcanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
विशेषात्पुष्करे तीर्थे द्वारावत्यां च शौकरे /
मासो ऽयं भक्तिदः प्रोक्तो व्रतदानार्चनादिभिः //
