text_mt: Especially at the sacred ford of Puṣkara, at Dvārāvatī, and at Śaukara, / this month is declared to bestow devotion through vows, gifts, worship, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tasninhari dinaṃ puṇyaṃ tathā vai bhīṣmapañcakam /
prabodhinīṃ naraḥ kṛtvā jāgareṇa samanvitām //
meaning:
तस्निन्हरि दिनं पुण्यं तथा वै भीष्मपञ्चकम् /
प्रबोधिनीं नरः कृत्वा जागरेण समन्विताम् //
text_mt: In that [month] the sacred day of Hari and the Bhīṣmapañcaka [occur]; / a man who observes the Prabodhinī accompanied by a vigil

sanskrit_iast:
na māturjaṭhare tiṣṭhedapi pāpānvito naraḥ /
tasmindine varārohe maṇḍalaṃ yastu paśyati //
meaning:
न मातुर्जठरे तिष्ठेदपि पापान्वितो नरः /
तस्मिन्दिने वरारोहे मण्डलं यस्तु पश्यति //
text_mt: does not stay in a mother's womb, even if the man is endowed with sin. / On that day, O woman of lovely hips, whoever beholds a sacred diagram,

sanskrit_iast:
vinā sāṃkhyena yogena sa yāti paramaṃ padam /
kārtike maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaukareḥ sūkaraṃ śubhe //
meaning:
विना सांख्येन योगेन स याति परमं पदम् /
कार्तिके मण्डलं दृष्ट्वा शौकरेः सूकरं शुभे //
text_mt: even without Sāṃkhya or Yoga, goes to the supreme abode. / Having seen a sacred diagram in Kārtika, [or] the Boar of Śaukara, O fair one,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā kokavarāhaṃ vā na bhūyastanayo bhavet /
trividhasyāpi pāpasya dṛṣṭvā muktirbhavennṛṇām //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा कोकवराहं वा न भूयस्तनयो भवेत् /
त्रिविधस्यापि पापस्य दृष्ट्वा मुक्तिर्भवेन्नृणाम् //
text_mt: or having seen Kokāvarāha, one does not become a child [in a womb] again. / For men, liberation from even the threefold sin occurs upon seeing

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ capalāpāṅgi śrīdharaṃ kubjake tathā /
kārtike varjayettailaṃ kārttike varjayenmadhu //
meaning:
मण्डलं चपलापाङ्गि श्रीधरं कुब्जके तथा /
कार्तिके वर्जयेत्तैलं कार्त्तिके वर्जयेन्मधु //
text_mt: the sacred diagram, O woman with tremulous eyes, [or] Śrīdhara at Kubjaka. / In Kārtika one should avoid oil; in Kārtika one should avoid honey;

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike varjayenmāṃsaṃ kārtike varjayetstriyaḥ /
niṣpāvānkārtike devi tyañjedviṣṇutatparaḥ //
meaning:
कार्तिके वर्जयेन्मांसं कार्तिके वर्जयेत्स्त्रियः /
निष्पावान्कार्तिके देवि त्यञ्जेद्विष्णुतत्परः //
text_mt: in Kārtika one should avoid meat; in Kārtika one should avoid women. / In Kārtika, O lady, one devoted to Viṣṇu should abandon flat beans.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarakṛtātpāpādbrahirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt /
prāpnoti rājakīṃ yoniṃ sakṛdbhakṣaṇasaṃbhavāt //
meaning:
संवत्सरकृतात्पापाद्ब्रहिर्भवति तत्क्षणात् /
प्राप्नोति राजकीं योनिं सकृद्भक्षणसंभवात् //
text_mt: From the sin committed throughout a year, he is freed at that very moment. / From eating [them] even once, one incurs rebirth as a washerman.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śaukaramāṃsaṃ yastu bhuñjīta durmatiḥ /
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi raurave paripacyate //
meaning:
कार्तिके शौकरमांसं यस्तु भुञ्जीत दुर्मतिः /
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि रौरवे परिपच्यते //
text_mt: The evil-minded one who eats pig's meat in Kārtika / is cooked in Raurava for sixty thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmukto jāyate pāpī viṣṭhāśī grāmyasūkaraḥ /
mātsyaṃ māṃsaṃ na bhuñjīta na kaurmaṃ nāpi hāriṇam //
meaning:
तन्मुक्तो जायते पापी विष्ठाशी ग्राम्यसूकरः /
मात्स्यं मांसं न भुञ्जीत न कौर्मं नापि हारिणम् //
text_mt: Released from that, the sinner is born as an excrement-eating village boar. / One should not eat the meat of fish, nor that of turtle, nor that of deer.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālo jāyate devi kārtike māṃsabhakṣaṇāt /
kārtikaḥ sarvapāpaghnaḥ kiñcidvratadharasya hi //
meaning:
चाण्डालो जायते देवि कार्तिके मांसभक्षणात् /
कार्तिकः सर्वपापघ्नः किञ्चिद्व्रतधरस्य हि //
text_mt: A person is born as an outcaste, O lady, from eating meat in Kārtika. / Kārtika destroys all sins for one who keeps even a slight vow.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike tu kṛtādīkṣā nṛṇāṃ janmanikṛntanī /
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dīkṣāṃ kurvīta kārtike //
meaning:
कार्तिके तु कृतादीक्षा नृणां जन्मनिकृन्तनी /
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन दीक्षां कुर्वीत कार्तिके //
text_mt: Initiation undertaken in Kārtika cuts away the rebirths of men; / therefore, with all effort, one should take initiation in Kārtika.

sanskrit_iast:
adīkṣitasya vāmoru kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam /
paśuyonimavāpnoti dīkṣayā rahito naraḥ //
meaning:
अदीक्षितस्य वामोरु कृतं सर्वं निरर्थकम् /
पशुयोनिमवाप्नोति दीक्षया रहितो नरः //
text_mt: For an uninitiated person, O fair-thighed one, whatever is done is useless; / devoid of initiation, a man enters the womb of an animal.

sanskrit_iast:
na gṛhe kārtikaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa tu kārtikīm /
tīrthe hi kārtikīṃ kurvannaro yāti hareḥ padam //
meaning:
न गृहे कार्तिकं कुर्याद्विशेषेण तु कार्तिकीम् /
तीर्थे हि कार्तिकीं कुर्वन्नरो याति हरेः पदम् //
text_mt: One should not observe Kārtika at home, and especially not the full moon of Kārtika; / for observing the full moon of Kārtika at a sacred ford, a man goes to Hari's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike śuklapakṣasya kagṛtvā hyekādaśīṃ naraḥ /
prātardatvā śubhānkuṃbhānprayāti harimandiram //
meaning:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य कगृत्वा ह्येकादशीं नरः /
प्रातर्दत्वा शुभान्कुंभान्प्रयाति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Having observed the eleventh day of the bright fortnight in Kārtika, / and giving auspicious water-pots in the morning, a man goes to the temple of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaravratānāṃ hi samāptiḥ kārtikaṃ smṛtā /
vivāhā yatra dṛśyante viṣṇornābhisaroruhe //
meaning:
संवत्सरव्रतानां हि समाप्तिः कार्तिकं स्मृता /
विवाहा यत्र दृश्यन्ते विष्णोर्नाभिसरोरुहे //
text_mt: The completion of vows lasting a year is remembered to be in Kārtika, / where marriages are seen [performed] at the navel-lotus of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dināni tatra catvāri yathaikaṃ varāvarṇini /
vinottarāyaṇe kālaṃ lagnaśuddhiṃ vināpi ca //
meaning:
दिनानि तत्र चत्वारि यथैकं वरावर्णिनि /
विनोत्तरायणे कालं लग्नशुद्धिं विनापि च //
text_mt: The four days there are like one [day], O woman of excellent complexion; / without the period of the northern course of the sun, and even without an auspicious astrological moment,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante yatra sambandhāḥ putrapautravivarddhanāḥ /
tasmānmohini kartāsmi kārtike vratasevanam //
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते यत्र सम्बन्धाः पुत्रपौत्रविवर्द्धनाः /
तस्मान्मोहिनि कर्तास्मि कार्तिके व्रतसेवनम् //
text_mt: alliances are seen there that increase sons and grandsons. / Therefore, O Mohinī, I will undertake the practice of the vow in Kārtika

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣapāpanāśāya tava prītivivṛddhaye /
mohinyuvāca
aho māhātmyamatulaṃ kārtikasya tvayoritam //
meaning:
अशेषपापनाशाय तव प्रीतिविवृद्धये /
मोहिन्युवाच
अहो माहात्म्यमतुलं कार्तिकस्य त्वयोरितम् //
text_mt: for the destruction of endless sins and for the enhancement of your pleasure." / Mohinī said: / "Ah, the peerless greatness of Kārtika has been spoken by you!

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsyavratānāṃ hi vidhimudyāpanaṃ vada /
pūrṇatā yena bhavatagi vratānāṃ pṛthivīpate //
meaning:
चातुर्मास्यव्रतानां हि विधिमुद्यापनं वद /
पूर्णता येन भवतगि व्रतानां पृथिवीपते //
text_mt: Tell the concluding rite and rule of the vows of the four months of the rainy season, / by which, O lord of the earth, the completion of the vows takes place,

sanskrit_iast:
avaikalyaṃ bhaveccaiva vrataṃ puṇyaphalasya tu /
rājovāca
naktavratī ṣaḍrasena brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayetpriye //
meaning:
अवैकल्यं भवेच्चैव व्रतं पुण्यफलस्य तु /
राजोवाच
नक्तव्रती षड्रसेन ब्राह्मणं भोजयेत्प्रिये //
text_mt: and the vow of meritorious fruit will be without deficiency." / The king said: / "One observing the vow of eating at night should feed a brāhmaṇa with food of six flavors, O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
ayācite tvanaṅkāhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ pradāpayet /
amāṃsāśībhavedyasttu gāṃ pradadyātsadakṣiṇām //
meaning:
अयाचिते त्वनङ्काहं सहिरण्यं प्रदापयेत् /
अमांसाशीभवेद्यस्त्तु गां प्रदद्यात्सदक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: In the vow of eating unsolicited food, he should give an ox along with gold; / and he who refrains from eating meat should give a cow along with a priestly gift.

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīsnāne naro dadyāddadhipāyasameva ca /
phalānāṃ niyame subhru phaladānaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
धात्रीस्नाने नरो दद्याद्दधिपायसमेव च /
फलानां नियमे सुभ्रु फलदानं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: For the bath with myrobalan, a man should give curds and milk-rice pudding; / in the restriction of fruits, O fair-browed one, he should perform the donation of fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tailatyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyā ddhṛtatyāge payastathā /
dhānyānāṃ niyame śālīṃstattaddhānyamathāpi vā //
meaning:
तैलत्यागे घृतं दद्या द्धृतत्यागे पयस्तथा /
धान्यानां नियमे शालींस्तत्तद्धान्यमथापि वा //
text_mt: In renouncing oil he should give ghee, and in renouncing ghee, milk; / in the restriction of grains, rice, or those very grains.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādbhūśayane śayyāṃ tūlikāgaṇḍakānvitām /
patrabhojī narodadyādbhājanaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam //
meaning:
दद्याद्भूशयने शय्यां तूलिकागण्डकान्विताम् /
पत्रभोजी नरोदद्याद्भाजनं घृतसंयुतम् //
text_mt: When observing sleeping on the ground, he should give a bed furnished with a mattress and pillows; / a man who eats from leaves should give a vessel filled with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
maune ghaṇṭāṃ tilānvāpi sahiraṇyānpradāpayet /
daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ kāryamubhayoḥ śayanānvitam //
meaning:
मौने घण्टां तिलान्वापि सहिरण्यान्प्रदापयेत् /
दंपत्योर्भोजनं कार्यमुभयोः शयनान्वितम् //
text_mt: In the vow of silence he should give a bell or sesame seeds with gold; / a meal should be offered to a married couple together with a bed,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhogaṃ dakṣiṇopetaṃ vratasya paripūrtaye /
prātaḥ snāne hayaṃ dadyānniḥsnehe ghṛtasaktukān //
meaning:
संभोगं दक्षिणोपेतं व्रतस्य परिपूर्तये /
प्रातः स्नाने हयं दद्यान्निःस्नेहे घृतसक्तुकान् //
text_mt: and provisions accompanied by a priestly gift, for the complete fulfillment of the vow; / for the morning bath he should give a horse; in the avoidance of unctuous food, ghee and barley meal.

sanskrit_iast:
nakharāṇāṃ ca keśānāṃ dhāraṇe darpaṇaṃ dadet /
upānahau pradadyāttu pādatrāṇavivarjane //
meaning:
नखराणां च केशानां धारणे दर्पणं ददेत् /
उपानहौ प्रदद्यात्तु पादत्राणविवर्जने //
text_mt: In keeping nails and hair [uncut], one should give a mirror; / but when foregoing footwear, one should give a pair of sandals.

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇasya tu saṃtyāge dātavyā surabhistathā /
āmiṣasya parityāge savatsāṃ kapilāṃ dadet //
meaning:
लवणस्य तु संत्यागे दातव्या सुरभिस्तथा /
आमिषस्य परित्यागे सवत्सां कपिलां ददेत् //
text_mt: When completely giving up salt, a cow should be given; / and upon renouncing meat, one should give a brown cow with its calf.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ dīpaprado yastu vrate 'bhīṣṭe surālaye /
sa kāñcanaṃ tathā tāmraṃ saghṛtaṃ dīpakaṃ priye //
meaning:
नित्यं दीपप्रदो यस्तु व्रते ऽभीष्टे सुरालये /
स काञ्चनं तथा ताम्रं सघृतं दीपकं प्रिये //
text_mt: One who daily offers a lamp in the temple of a deity during a cherished vow, / he, O lovely one, should give a lamp made of gold or copper along with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyādvāsasā chatraṃ vaiṣṇave vratapūrtaye /
ekāntaropavāsī tu kṣaumavastraṃ pradāpayet //
meaning:
प्रदद्याद्वाससा छत्रं वैष्णवे व्रतपूर्तये /
एकान्तरोपवासी तु क्षौमवस्त्रं प्रदापयेत् //
text_mt: And an umbrella with cloth, to a Vaiṣṇava, to complete the vow. / One who fasts on alternate days should give a linen garment.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātre kāñcanopetāṃ dadyācchayyāṃ svalaṅkṛtām /
ṣaḍrarātrādyupavāseṣu śibikāṃ chatrasaṃyutām //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रे काञ्चनोपेतां दद्याच्छय्यां स्वलङ्कृताम् /
षड्ररात्राद्युपवासेषु शिबिकां छत्रसंयुताम् //
text_mt: For a fast of three nights, one should give a well-adorned bed furnished with gold; / for fasts of six nights and the like, a palanquin with an umbrella,

sanskrit_iast:
savāhapuruṣaṃ pīnamanaṅvāhamathārpayet /
ajāvikaṃ tvekabhakte phalāhāre suvarṇakam //
meaning:
सवाहपुरुषं पीनमनङ्वाहमथार्पयेत् /
अजाविकं त्वेकभक्ते फलाहारे सुवर्णकम् //
text_mt: And then offer a stout draft-ox along with a driver. / When eating once a day, [one should give] a goat or sheep; when living on fruit, [a piece of] gold;

sanskrit_iast:
śākāhāre phalaṃ dadyātsauvarṇaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam /
rasānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ tyāge 'nuktasya vāpi ca //
meaning:
शाकाहारे फलं दद्यात्सौवर्णं घृतसंयुतम् /
रसानां चैव सर्वेषां त्यागे ऽनुक्तस्य वापि च //
text_mt: When living on vegetables, one should give a golden fruit accompanied by clarified butter. / When giving up all juices, or [when giving up] whatever has not been specified,

sanskrit_iast:
dātavyaṃ rājataṃ pātraṃ sauvarṇa vāpi śaktitaḥ /
yathoktasyāpradāne tu yathoktākaraṇe 'pi vā //
meaning:
दातव्यं राजतं पात्रं सौवर्ण वापि शक्तितः /
यथोक्तस्याप्रदाने तु यथोक्ताकरणे ऽपि वा //
text_mt: A silver vessel, or a golden one according to one's capacity, should be given. / If one fails to give what has been prescribed, or fails to do what has been enjoined,

sanskrit_iast:
vipravākyaṃ caretsubhru viṣṇusmaraṇapūrvakam /
vṛthā vipravaco yastu manyate manujaḥ śubhe //
meaning:
विप्रवाक्यं चरेत्सुभ्रु विष्णुस्मरणपूर्वकम् /
वृथा विप्रवचो यस्तु मन्यते मनुजः शुभे //
text_mt: One should act according to the word of a brāhmaṇa, O fair-browed one, preceded by the remembrance of Viṣṇu. / The mortal who considers a brāhmaṇa's word to be in vain, O fair lady,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṃ naiva dadyādvā sa yāti narakedhruvam /
vratavaikalyamāsādya kuṣṭhī cāndhaḥ prajāyate //
meaning:
दक्षिणां नैव दद्याद्वा स याति नरकेध्रुवम् /
व्रतवैकल्यमासाद्य कुष्ठी चान्धः प्रजायते //
text_mt: Or does not give the priestly gift, certainly goes to hell; / incurring impairment of his vow, he is born a leper and blind.

sanskrit_iast:
dharāmarāṇāṃ vacane vyavasthitā divaukasastīrthagaṇā makhāśca /
ko laṅghayetsubhru vaco hi teṣāṃ śreyobhikāmo manujastu vidvān //
meaning:
धरामराणां वचने व्यवस्थिता दिवौकसस्तीर्थगणा मखाश्च /
को लङ्घयेत्सुभ्रु वचो हि तेषां श्रेयोभिकामो मनुजस्तु विद्वान् //
text_mt: The gods of heaven, hosts of sacred fords, and sacrifices are established upon the word of the gods of the earth; / what wise man desirous of welfare would transgress their word, O fair-browed one?

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ mayā dharmarahasyayuktaṃ virañcaye śrīpatinā yathoktam /
prakāśitaṃ tubhyamananyavācyaṃ phalapradaṃ mādhavatuṣṭihetum //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge kārtikamāhātmyaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इदं मया धर्मरहस्ययुक्तं विरञ्चये श्रीपतिना यथोक्तम् /
प्रकाशितं तुभ्यमनन्यवाच्यं फलप्रदं माधवतुष्टिहेतुम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे कार्तिकमाहात्म्यं नाम द्वाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This secret doctrine of dharma, as told by the Lord of Śrī to Brahmā, / has been revealed by me to you; it is not to be spoken to anyone else; it bestows fruit and brings delight to Mādhava."

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled the Eulogy of the Greatness of Kārtika, in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
vākyamuktaṃ tvayā sādhu kārtike yadupoṣaṇam /
vratādikaraṇaṃ rājñāṃ noktaṃ kvāpi nidarśane //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
वाक्यमुक्तं त्वया साधु कार्तिके यदुपोषणम् /
व्रतादिकरणं राज्ञां नोक्तं क्वापि निदर्शने //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / "A proper statement was spoken by you regarding fasting in Kārtika; / but nowhere in any example has the performance of vows and the like been prescribed for kings.

sanskrit_iast:
muktvaikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ loke noktaṃ śūdraviśorapi /
dānaṃ hi pālanaṃ yuddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhūbhujāṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
मुक्त्वैकं ब्राह्मणं लोके नोक्तं शूद्रविशोरपि /
दानं हि पालनं युद्धं तृतीयं भूभुजां स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Except for the brāhmaṇa alone, in this world it is not enjoined even for the śūdra and the vaiśya. / Giving gifts, protection, and warfare are remembered as the three duties for kings.

sanskrit_iast:
na vrataṃ hi tvayā kāryaṃ yadi māmicchasi priyām /
muhūrtamapi rājendra na śaknomi tvayā vinā //
meaning:
न व्रतं हि त्वया कार्यं यदि मामिच्छसि प्रियाम् /
मुहूर्तमपि राजेन्द्र न शक्नोमि त्वया विना //
text_mt: Indeed, no vow should be performed by you if you hold me dear. / O king of kings, I cannot endure even a moment without you,

sanskrit_iast:
sthātuṃ kamalagarbhābha kiṃ punarmāsasaṃkhyayā /
yatropavāsakaraṇaṃ manyase vasādhādhipa //
meaning:
स्थातुं कमलगर्भाभ किं पुनर्माससंख्यया /
यत्रोपवासकरणं मन्यसे वसाधाधिप //
text_mt: O lotus-hued one, so what need be said of an entire month? / If you consider fasting to be necessary, O lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vai bhojanaṃ deyaṃ viprāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām /
athavā jyeṣṭhapatnī yā sā karotu vratādikam /
evamukte tu vacane mohinyā rukmabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र वै भोजनं देयं विप्राणां च महात्मनाम् /
अथवा ज्येष्ठपत्नी या सा करोतु व्रतादिकम् /
एवमुक्ते तु वचने मोहिन्या रुक्मभूषणः //
text_mt: Then food should be given to great-souled brāhmaṇas; / or else let your senior wife perform the vows and the like." / When such words were spoken by Mohinī, the king adorned with gold ornaments

sanskrit_iast:
ājuhāva priyāṃ bhāryāṃ nāmnā saṃdhyāvaliṃśubhām /
āhūtā tatkṣaṇātprāptā rājānaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam //
meaning:
आजुहाव प्रियां भार्यां नाम्ना संध्यावलिंशुभाम् /
आहूता तत्क्षणात्प्राप्ता राजानं भूरिदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Summoned his beloved and auspicious wife named Saṃdhyāvalī. / Summoned, she arrived at that very moment before the king who bestowed abundant priestly gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
āśīnaṃ śayane divye mohinībāhusaṃvṛtam /
saṃghṛṣṭaṃ hi kucāgreṇa svarṇakuṃbhanibhena hi //
meaning:
आशीनं शयने दिव्ये मोहिनीबाहुसंवृतम् /
संघृष्टं हि कुचाग्रेण स्वर्णकुंभनिभेन हि //
text_mt: Who was seated on a splendid couch, embraced by the arms of Mohinī, / and rubbed against the tips of her breasts that resembled golden jars.

sanskrit_iast:
śayane vāmanetrāyāḥ sakāmāyā mahīpate /
kṛtāṃ jalipuṭā bhūtvā bharturnamitakandharā //
meaning:
शयने वामनेत्रायाः सकामाया महीपते /
कृतां जलिपुटा भूत्वा भर्तुर्नमितकन्धरा //
text_mt: On the couch of that fair-eyed woman full of desire, O king, / folding her hands in reverence and bowing her head to her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvalī prāha nṛpaṃ kimāhūtā karomyaham /
tava vākye sthitā kānta duḥsāpatnyavivarjitā //
meaning:
संध्यावली प्राह नृपं किमाहूता करोम्यहम् /
तव वाक्ये स्थिता कान्त दुःसापत्न्यविवर्जिता //
text_mt: Saṃdhyāvalī said to the king: "Having been summoned, what shall I do? / I abide by your command, my beloved, free from hostility toward my co-wife.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā hi ramase mohinyā sahaha bhūpate /
tathā tathā mama prītirvarddhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यथा यथा हि रमसे मोहिन्या सहह भूपते /
तथा तथा मम प्रीतिर्वर्द्धते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: The more you take pleasure with Mohinī, O king, / the more my joy increases; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartuḥ saukhyena yā nārī duḥkhayuktā prajāyate /
sā tu śyenī bhavedrājaṃstrīṇi varṣāṇi pañca ca //
meaning:
भर्तुः सौख्येन या नारी दुःखयुक्ता प्रजायते /
सा तु श्येनी भवेद्राजंस्त्रीणि वर्षाणि पञ्च च //
text_mt: A woman who becomes unhappy because of her husband's happiness / becomes a hawk, O king, for eight years.

sanskrit_iast: ājñāṃ me dehi rājendra mā vrīhāṃ kāmikāṃ kuru //
meaning: आज्ञां मे देहि राजेन्द्र मा व्रीहां कामिकां कुरु //
text_mt: Give me an order, O king of kings; do not feel ashamed toward your desirous [wife]."

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgada uvāca
jānāmi tava śīlaṃ tu kulaṃ jānāmi bhāmini /
tava vākyena hi ciraṃ mohinī ramitā mayā //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गद उवाच
जानामि तव शीलं तु कुलं जानामि भामिनि /
तव वाक्येन हि चिरं मोहिनी रमिता मया //
text_mt: Rukmāṅgada said: / "I know your character, O fair lady, and I know your noble lineage. / Indeed, it was by your word that I have long enjoyed pleasure with Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
ramamāṇasya suciraṃ bahavaḥ kārtikā gatāḥ /
priyā saukhyena mugdhasya na gato harivāsaraḥ //
meaning:
रममाणस्य सुचिरं बहवः कार्तिका गताः /
प्रिया सौख्येन मुग्धस्य न गतो हरिवासरः //
text_mt: While I was thus sporting for a long time, many Kārtika months have passed; / bewitched by the happiness of my beloved, no day of Hari was observed.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ tṛptimanuprāptaḥ kāmabhogātpunaḥ punaḥ /
jñāto 'yaṃ kārtiko māsaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽहं तृप्तिमनुप्राप्तः कामभोगात्पुनः पुनः /
ज्ञातो ऽयं कार्तिको मासः सर्वपापक्षयङ्करः //
text_mt: I, having obtained satiety through sexual pleasures again and again, / have come to know this month of Kārtika that destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kartukāmo vrataṃ devi kārtikākhyaṃ supuṇyadam /
iyaṃ vārayate māṃ ca vratādbrahmasutā śubhe //
meaning:
कर्तुकामो व्रतं देवि कार्तिकाख्यं सुपुण्यदम् /
इयं वारयते मां च व्रताद्ब्रह्मसुता शुभे //
text_mt: O queen, desiring to perform the vow named Kārtika that bestows great merit, / I am restrained from the vow by this daughter of Brahmā, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
asyā na vipriyaṃ kāryaṃ sarvathā varavarṇini /
māmakaṃ vratamādhatsva kṛcchrākhyaṃ kāyaśoṣakam //
meaning:
अस्या न विप्रियं कार्यं सर्वथा वरवर्णिनि /
मामकं व्रतमाधत्स्व कृच्छ्राख्यं कायशोषकम् //
text_mt: What is displeasing to her must not be done by any means, O woman of excellent complexion; / undertake my vow called the kṛcchra penance, which emaciates the body."

sanskrit_iast:
sā caivamuktā navahemavarṇā bhartrā tadā pīnapayodharaṅgī /
uvāca vākyaṃ dvijarājakaktrāvrataṃ cariṣye tava tuṣṭihetoḥ //
meaning:
सा चैवमुक्ता नवहेमवर्णा भर्त्रा तदा पीनपयोधरङ्गी /
उवाच वाक्यं द्विजराजकक्त्राव्रतं चरिष्ये तव तुष्टिहेतोः //
text_mt: She, having the complexion of fresh gold, endowed with full breasts, and possessing a face like the king of the twice-born, / addressed thus by her husband, then spoke these words: "I will perform the vow for the sake of your pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
yenaiva kīrtistu yaśo bhavecca tathaiva saukhyaṃ tava kīrtiyuktam /
karomi saumyaṃ naradevanātha kṣipāmi dehaṃ jvalanetvadartham //
meaning:
येनैव कीर्तिस्तु यशो भवेच्च तथैव सौख्यं तव कीर्तियुक्तम् /
करोमि सौम्यं नरदेवनाथ क्षिपामि देहं ज्वलनेत्वदर्थम् //
text_mt: Whatever will bring you renown, glory, and happiness accompanied by fame, / that agreeable deed I shall do, O ruler of men; I would even cast my body into the fire for your sake!

sanskrit_iast:
akāryametannahi bhūmipāla vākyena te hanmi sutaṃ svakīyam /
kintvevametadvratakarma bhūyaḥ karomi saumyaṃ naradevanātha //
meaning:
अकार्यमेतन्नहि भूमिपाल वाक्येन ते हन्मि सुतं स्वकीयम् /
किन्त्वेवमेतद्व्रतकर्म भूयः करोमि सौम्यं नरदेवनाथ //
text_mt: This [vow] is not something that should not be done, O protector of the earth; at your word I would even slay my own son! / How much more, then, this sacred act of a vow: I shall perform it, O gentle lord of men!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā raviputraśatruṃ praṇamya taṃ cāruviśālanetrā /
vrataṃ cakārātha tadā hi devī hyaśeṣapāpaughavināśanāya //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा रविपुत्रशत्रुं प्रणम्य तं चारुविशालनेत्रा /
व्रतं चकाराथ तदा हि देवी ह्यशेषपापौघविनाशनाय //
text_mt: Having spoken thus and bowed to the enemy of the son of the Sun, that goddess of lovely wide eyes / then undertook the vow for the destruction of the entire multitude of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vrate pravṛtte varakṛcchrasaṃjñe priyākṛte harṣamavāpa rājā /
uvāca vākyaṃ kuśaketuputrīṃ kṛtaṃ vacaḥ subhru samīhitaṃ te //
meaning:
व्रते प्रवृत्ते वरकृच्छ्रसंज्ञे प्रियाकृते हर्षमवाप राजा /
उवाच वाक्यं कुशकेतुपुत्रीं कृतं वचः सुभ्रु समीहितं ते //
text_mt: When the vow known as the excellent kṛcchra was undertaken by his beloved, the king felt joy; / he spoke these words to the daughter of Kuśaketu: "Your desired word has been fulfilled, O fair-browed one!

sanskrit_iast:
ramasva kāmaṃ maya sanniviṣṭasaṃpūrṇavāñchā karabhoru hṛṣṭā /
vimuktakāryastava subhru hetornānyāsti nārī mama saukhyahetuḥ //
meaning:
रमस्व कामं मय सन्निविष्टसंपूर्णवाञ्छा करभोरु हृष्टा /
विमुक्तकार्यस्तव सुभ्रु हेतोर्नान्यास्ति नारी मम सौख्यहेतुः //
text_mt: Delight to your heart's content, your desires completely fulfilled through me, O woman with thighs like an elephant's trunk, rejoice! / Free from obligations for your sake, O fair-browed one, no other woman is the cause of my happiness."

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvevamuktā nijanāyakena praharṣamabhyetya jagāda bhūpam /
jñātvā bhavantaṃ bahukāmayuktaṃ triviṣṭapānnātha samāgatāham //
meaning:
सा त्वेवमुक्ता निजनायकेन प्रहर्षमभ्येत्य जगाद भूपम् /
ज्ञात्वा भवन्तं बहुकामयुक्तं त्रिविष्टपान्नाथ समागताहम् //
text_mt: She, thus addressed by her lover, felt immense joy and spoke to the king: / "Knowing you to be filled with deep desire, O lord, I have come from heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvāmarāndaityagaṇāṃśca sarvāngandharvayakṣoragarākṣasāṃśca /
saṃdṛśyamānānmama nātha hetoḥ snehānvitāhaṃ tava mandarādrau //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वामरान्दैत्यगणांश्च सर्वान्गन्धर्वयक्षोरगराक्षसांश्च /
संदृश्यमानान्मम नाथ हेतोः स्नेहान्विताहं तव मन्दराद्रौ //
text_mt: Having forsaken all the immortals, the hosts of daityas, gandharvas, yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas, / who were gazing upon me, O lord; out of affection I have come to you on Mount Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
etatkāmaphalaṃ loke yaddvayorekacittatā /
anyacetaḥ kṛtaḥ kāmaḥ śavayoriva saṃgamaḥ //
meaning:
एतत्कामफलं लोके यद्द्वयोरेकचित्तता /
अन्यचेतः कृतः कामः शवयोरिव संगमः //
text_mt: This is the fruit of love in this world: that two persons share a single heart; / love made with divided hearts is like the union of two corpses.

sanskrit_iast:
saphalaṃ hi vapurme 'dya saphalaṃ rūpameva hi /
tvayā kāmavatā kānta durllabhaṃ yajjagattraye //
meaning:
सफलं हि वपुर्मे ऽद्य सफलं रूपमेव हि /
त्वया कामवता कान्त दुर्ल्लभं यज्जगत्त्रये //
text_mt: Fruitful indeed is my body today! Fruitful indeed is my beauty! / United with you who are filled with passion, O beloved, a fortune hard to attain in the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
pronnatābhyāṃ kucābhyāṃ hi kāmino hṛdayaṃ yadi /
saṃśliṣṭaṃ nahi śīryeta manye vajrasamaṃ dṛḍham /
tadeva cāmṛtaṃ loke yatpurandhryadharāsavam //
meaning:
प्रोन्नताभ्यां कुचाभ्यां हि कामिनो हृदयं यदि /
संश्लिष्टं नहि शीर्येत मन्ये वज्रसमं दृढम् /
तदेव चामृतं लोके यत्पुरन्ध्र्यधरासवम् //
text_mt: If a lover's heart embraced by high, swelling breasts does not shatter, / I consider it firm as a diamond! / That alone is the true nectar in the world: the nectar of a fair woman's lower lip,

sanskrit_iast:
kucābhyāṃ hṛdi līnābhyāṃ mukhena paripīyate /
evamuktvā pariṣvajya rājānaṃ rahasi sthitam //
meaning:
कुचाभ्यां हृदि लीनाभ्यां मुखेन परिपीयते /
एवमुक्त्वा परिष्वज्य राजानं रहसि स्थितम् //
text_mt: Which is drunk eagerly by the mouth while her breasts cling to his chest." / Having spoken thus and embraced the king who was in private,

sanskrit_iast:
ramayāmāsa tanvaṅgī vātsyāyanavidhānataḥ /
tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya mohinyā sahitasya hi //
meaning:
रमयामास तन्वङ्गी वात्स्यायनविधानतः /
तस्यैवं रममाणस्य मोहिन्या सहितस्य हि //
text_mt: The slender-limbed woman made love to him according to the precepts of Vātsyāyana. / While he was thus sporting together with Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgadasya karṇābhyāṃ paṭahadhvanirāgataḥ /
mattebhakuṃbhasaṃsthastu dharmāṅgadanideśataḥ //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गदस्य कर्णाभ्यां पटहध्वनिरागतः /
मत्तेभकुंभसंस्थस्तु धर्माङ्गदनिदेशतः //
text_mt: The sound of a war-drum reached Rukmāṅgada's ears, / beaten upon the forehead of a rutting elephant by the command of Dharmāṅgada.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarharidinaṃ lokāstiṣṭhadhvaṃ tvekabhojanāḥ /
akṣāralavaṇāḥ sarve haviṣyānnaniṣeviṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रातर्हरिदिनं लोकास्तिष्ठध्वं त्वेकभोजनाः /
अक्षारलवणाः सर्वे हविष्यान्ननिषेविणः //
text_mt: "Tomorrow is the day of Hari! O people, remain taking only one meal, / all of you eating haviṣya food, free from pungents and salt,

sanskrit_iast:
avanītalpaśayanāḥ priyāsaṃgavivarjitāḥ /
smaradhvaṃ devadeveśaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam //
meaning:
अवनीतल्पशयनाः प्रियासंगविवर्जिताः /
स्मरध्वं देवदेवेशं पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: sleeping on a bed on the bare ground, abstaining from intimacy with a beloved! / Remember the ancient Supreme Person, the Lord of the god of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdbhojanasaṃyuktā upavāsaṃ kariṣyatha /
akṛtaśrāddhanicayā aprāptāḥ piṇḍameva ca //
meaning:
सकृद्भोजनसंयुक्ता उपवासं करिष्यथ /
अकृतश्राद्धनिचया अप्राप्ताः पिण्डमेव च //
text_mt: Having taken but one meal, you shall observe a fast. / Those who have not performed a heap of ancestral rites and have not obtained an ancestral rice-ball,

sanskrit_iast:
gayāmagataputrāśca gacchadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam /
eṣā kārtikaśuklā vai harernidrāvyapohinī //
meaning:
गयामगतपुत्राश्च गच्छध्वं श्रीहरेः पदम् /
एषा कार्तिकशुक्ला वै हरेर्निद्राव्यपोहिनी //
text_mt: and those whose sons have not gone to Gayā, go to the abode of glorious Hari! / This bright fortnight of Kārttika is indeed that which dispels the sleep of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarekādaśī prāptā mā kṛthā bhojanaṃ kvacit /
brahmahatyādipāpāni kāmakārakṛtāni ca //
meaning:
प्रातरेकादशी प्राप्ता मा कृथा भोजनं क्वचित् /
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि कामकारकृतानि च //
text_mt: Tomorrow ekādaśī has arrived; do not take food anywhere! / Sins such as the murder of a brahmin and those committed intentionally—

sanskrit_iast:
tāni yāsyanti sarvāṇi upoṣyemāṃ prabodhinīm /
prabodhayeddharmmaparānnyāyācāra samanvitān //
meaning:
तानि यास्यन्ति सर्वाणि उपोष्येमां प्रबोधिनीम् /
प्रबोधयेद्धर्म्मपरान्न्यायाचार समन्वितान् //
text_mt: all those will depart by fasting on this Prabodhinī. / It awakens those dedicated to dharma who possess righteous conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
hareḥ prabodhamādhatte tenaiṣā bodhinī smṛtā /
sakṛccopoṣitāṃ cemāṃ nidrācchedakarīṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
हरेः प्रबोधमाधत्ते तेनैषा बोधिनी स्मृता /
सकृच्चोपोषितां चेमां निद्राच्छेदकरीं हरेः //
text_mt: It brings about the awakening of Hari; therefore it is called Bodhinī. / If one has fasted even once on this day which ends the sleep of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
tanayo na bhavenmartyo na garbhe jāyate punaḥ /
rurudhvaṃ cakriṇaḥ pūjāmātmavittena mānavāḥ //
meaning:
तनयो न भवेन्मर्त्यो न गर्भे जायते पुनः /
रुरुध्वं चक्रिणः पूजामात्मवित्तेन मानवाः //
text_mt: one's son will not remain a mortal, nor is one born again in a womb. / O men, perform the worship of the wielder of the discus with your own wealth!

sanskrit_iast:
vastraiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpairvaracandanakuṅkumaiḥ /
suhṛdyaiśca phalairgandhairyajadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam //
meaning:
वस्त्रैः पुष्पैर्धूपदीपैर्वरचन्दनकुङ्कुमैः /
सुहृद्यैश्च फलैर्गन्धैर्यजध्वं श्रीहरेः पदम् //
text_mt: Worship the abode of glorious Hari with garments, flowers, incenses, lamps, / excellent sandalpaste, saffron, delightful fruits, and fragrant perfumes!

sanskrit_iast:
yo na kuryādvaco me 'dya dharmyaṃ viṣṇugatipradam /
sa me daṇḍyaśca vādhyaśca nirvāsyo viṣayāddhruvam //
meaning:
यो न कुर्याद्वचो मे ऽद्य धर्म्यं विष्णुगतिप्रदम् /
स मे दण्ड्यश्च वाध्यश्च निर्वास्यो विषयाद्ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Whoever does not carry out my righteous word today, which grants the state of Viṣṇu, / must certainly be punished by me, executed, and banished from my domain!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhe vādyamāne paṭahe meghaniḥsvane /
hastā damuñca tāṃbūlaṃ sakarpūraṃ nṛpottamaḥ //
meaning:
एवंविधे वाद्यमाने पटहे मेघनिःस्वने /
हस्ता दमुञ्च तांबूलं सकर्पूरं नृपोत्तमः //
text_mt: While such a proclamation-drum sounding like a cloud was being beaten, / the best of kings dropped the betel with camphor from his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīkucayorlagnaṃ hṛdayaṃ sa vikṛṣya vai /
udattiṣṭhanmahīpālaḥ śayyāyāṃ rativarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
मोहिनीकुचयोर्लग्नं हृदयं स विकृष्य वै /
उदत्तिष्ठन्महीपालः शय्यायां रतिवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: Withdrawing his heart that was attached to Mohinī's breasts, / the protector of the earth, who was augmenting pleasure, rose from the bed.

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīṃ mohakāmārttāṃ satviyan ślakṣṇayā girā /
devi prātarharidinaṃ bhaviṣyatyadhanāśanam //
meaning:
मोहिनीं मोहकामार्त्तां सत्वियन् श्लक्ष्णया गिरा /
देवि प्रातर्हरिदिनं भविष्यत्यधनाशनम् //
text_mt: Comforting Mohinī, who was afflicted by bewildering desire, with gentle words, [he said]: / "O queen, tomorrow is the day of Hari, when food should be eaten at midday.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyato 'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāmiti /
tavājñayā mayā kṛcchraṃ sandhyāvalyā tu kāritam //
meaning:
संयतो ऽहं भविष्यामि क्षम्यतां क्षम्यतामिति /
तवाज्ञया मया कृच्छ्रं सन्ध्यावल्या तु कारितम् //
text_mt: I shall be self-restrained; forgive me, forgive me! / By your command, the hard penance was indeed caused to be performed by Sandhyāvalī.

sanskrit_iast:
iyamekādaśī kāryā prabodhakaraṇī mayā /
aśeṣapāpabandhasya chedanī gatidāyinī //
meaning:
इयमेकादशी कार्या प्रबोधकरणी मया /
अशेषपापबन्धस्य छेदनी गतिदायिनी //
text_mt: This ekādaśī, which brings about awakening, must be observed by me; / it cuts off the entire bond of sins and grants the [highest] path,

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ mahotsavavidhāyinī /
tasmāddhaviṣyaṃ bhokṣye 'haṃ niyato mattagāminī //
meaning:
त्रयाणामपि लोकानां महोत्सवविधायिनी /
तस्माद्धविष्यं भोक्ष्ये ऽहं नियतो मत्तगामिनी //
text_mt: bringing about a great festival even for the three worlds. / Therefore, O woman of graceful gait, I shall eat haviṣya food, being self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā saha viśālākṣi tvaṃ cāpi tamadhokṣajam /
ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśamupavāsaparāyaṇā /
yena yāsyasi nirvāṇaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam //
meaning:
मया सह विशालाक्षि त्वं चापि तमधोक्षजम् /
आराधय हृषीकेशमुपवासपरायणा /
येन यास्यसि निर्वाणं दाहप्रलयवर्जितम् //
text_mt: Together with me, O large-eyed one, you too worship Adhokṣaja, / Hṛṣīkeśa, being devoted to the fast, / by which you will go to nirvāṇa, free from burning and dissolution."

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
sādhūktaṃ hi tvayā rājanpūjanaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ /
janmamṛtyujarāchedi kariṣye 'haṃ tavājñayā //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
साधूक्तं हि त्वया राजन्पूजनं चक्रपाणिनः /
जन्ममृत्युजराछेदि करिष्ये ऽहं तवाज्ञया //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / "Well spoken indeed by you, O king! Worship of the wielder of the discus / cuts off birth, death, and old age; I shall perform it by your command.

sanskrit_iast:
pratijñā yā tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtā mandaramastake /
karapradānasahitā bhavatā sukṛtāṅkitā //
meaning:
प्रतिज्ञा या त्वया पूर्वं कृता मन्दरमस्तके /
करप्रदानसहिता भवता सुकृताङ्किता //
text_mt: The vow that was made by you earlier upon the summit of Mandara, / accompanied by the giving of your hand and sealed by your merit—

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu samayaḥ prāpto dīyatāṃ sa hi me tvayā /
janmaprabhṛti yatpuṇyaṃ tvayā yatnena saṃcitam //
meaning:
तस्यास्तु समयः प्राप्तो दीयतां स हि मे त्वया /
जन्मप्रभृति यत्पुण्यं त्वया यत्नेन संचितम् //
text_mt: the time for that has indeed arrived; let it be granted to me by you! / Whatever merit has been accumulated with effort by you since birth,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ na dadāsi varaṃ yadi /
rukmāṅgada uvāca
ehi cārvaṅgi karttāsmi yatte manasi vartate //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं नश्यति क्षिप्रं न ददासि वरं यदि /
रुक्माङ्गद उवाच
एहि चार्वङ्गि कर्त्तास्मि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते //
text_mt: all that will perish quickly if you do not grant the boon." / Rukmāṅgada said: / "Come, O beautiful-limbed one, I will do whatever is in your mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nādeyaṃ vidyate kiñcittubhyaṃ me jīvitāvadhi /
kiṃ punargrāmavittādi dharāyuktaṃ ca bhāmini //
meaning:
नादेयं विद्यते किञ्चित्तुभ्यं मे जीवितावधि /
किं पुनर्ग्रामवित्तादि धरायुक्तं च भामिनि //
text_mt: Nothing exists that cannot be given by me to you up to the limit of my life, / what to speak of villages, wealth, and the like, together with the earth, O splendid woman!"

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
nātha kānta vibho rājan jīviteśa ratipriya /
nopoṣyaṃ vāmaraṃ viṣṇorbhoktavyā yadyahaṃ priyā //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
नाथ कान्त विभो राजन् जीवितेश रतिप्रिय /
नोपोष्यं वामरं विष्णोर्भोक्तव्या यद्यहं प्रिया //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / "O lord, O beloved, O master, O king, O lord of my life, O lover of pleasure! / The day of Viṣṇu is not to be fasted, and I am to be enjoyed if I am dear [to you].

sanskrit_iast:
na ca te 'haṃ priyā rājan suhūrtamapi kāmaye /
tvatsaṃyogaṃ vinā bhūtā bhaviṣyāmi varaṃ vinā //
meaning:
न च ते ऽहं प्रिया राजन् सुहूर्तमपि कामये /
त्वत्संयोगं विना भूता भविष्यामि वरं विना //
text_mt: If I am not dear to you, O king, I do not desire even a moment [with you]; / remaining without union with you, I shall be without the boon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmāṃ yadi vāñchethā bhoktuṃ satyaparāyaṇa /
tadā tyajopavāsaṃ hi bhujyatāṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
तस्मान्मां यदि वाञ्छेथा भोक्तुं सत्यपरायण /
तदा त्यजोपवासं हि भुज्यतां हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Therefore, if you wish to enjoy me, O devotee of truth, / then give up the fast and let food be eaten on the day of Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva varo deyo yo mayā prārthitaḥ purā /
na ceddāsyasi rājendra bhūtvānṛtavacābhavān //
meaning:
एष एव वरो देयो यो मया प्रार्थितः पुरा /
न चेद्दास्यसि राजेन्द्र भूत्वानृतवचाभवान् //
text_mt: This very boon must be given, which was requested by me formerly. / If you do not grant it, O king of kings, you, having become a speaker of falsehood,

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyate narake ghore yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam /
rājovāca
maivaṃ tvaṃ vada kalyāṇi nedaṃ tvayyupapadyate //
meaning:
यास्यते नरके घोरे यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् /
राजोवाच
मैवं त्वं वद कल्याणि नेदं त्वय्युपपद्यते //
text_mt: shall go to a dreadful hell until the dissolution of all beings." / The king said: / "Do not speak thus, O auspicious one! This is not proper for you.

sanskrit_iast:
vidheśca tanayā bhūtvā dharmavighnaṃ koroṣi kim /
janmaprabhṛtyahaṃ naiva bhuktavānharivāsare //
meaning:
विधेश्च तनया भूत्वा धर्मविघ्नं कोरोषि किम् /
जन्मप्रभृत्यहं नैव भुक्तवान्हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Having been born as the daughter of Brahmā, why do you cause an obstacle to dharma? / Since birth I have never eaten on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cādyāhaṃ kathaṃ bhoktā saṃjātapalitaḥ śubhe /
yauvanātītamartyasya kṣīṇendriyabalasya ca //
meaning:
स चाद्याहं कथं भोक्ता संजातपलितः शुभे /
यौवनातीतमर्त्यस्य क्षीणेन्द्रियबलस्य च //
text_mt: How can that same I eat today, having grown grey hairs, O auspicious woman? / For a mortal past his youth, whose sensory strength is diminished,

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇadīsevanaṃ yuktamathavā haripūjanam /
na kṛtaṃ yanmayā bālye yauvane na kṛtaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
स्वर्णदीसेवनं युक्तमथवा हरिपूजनम् /
न कृतं यन्मया बाल्ये यौवने न कृतं च यत् //
text_mt: resorting to the golden river [Gaṅgā] or worshiping Hari is appropriate. / What was not done by me in childhood, and what was not done in youth,

sanskrit_iast:
tadahaṃ kṣīṇavīryo 'dya kathaṃ kuryāṃ jugupsitam /
prasīda capalāpāṅgi prasīda varavarṇini //
meaning:
तदहं क्षीणवीर्यो ऽद्य कथं कुर्यां जुगुप्सितम् /
प्रसीद चपलापाङ्गि प्रसीद वरवर्णिनि //
text_mt: how can I, now lacking vigor, do that detestable thing today? / Be gracious, O woman of darting glances! Be gracious, O woman of excellent complexion!

sanskrit_iast:
mā kuruṣva vrate bhaṅgaṃ dātāhaṃ rājyasaṃpadām /
athavā necchasi tvaṃ tatkaromyanyatsulocane //
meaning:
मा कुरुष्व व्रते भङ्गं दाताहं राज्यसंपदाम् /
अथवा नेच्छसि त्वं तत्करोम्यन्यत्सुलोचने //
text_mt: Do not break my observance! I will give the riches of the kingdom, / or, if you do not desire that, I shall do something else, O fair-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
āropayitvā śibikāṃ vimānapratimāṃ śubhām /
yatrecchasi nayiṣyāmi pādacārī kalatrayuk //
meaning:
आरोपयित्वा शिबिकां विमानप्रतिमां शुभाम् /
यत्रेच्छसि नयिष्यामि पादचारी कलत्रयुक् //
text_mt: Having placed [you] in a palanquin resembling an auspicious celestial chariot, / I, accompanied by my wife, will carry you on foot wherever you desire.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi taccāpi necchestvaṃ vimānaṃ hi kṛtaṃ mayā /
tarhi svarṇamayau staṃbhau kṛtvā vidrumabhūṣitau //
meaning:
यदि तच्चापि नेच्छेस्त्वं विमानं हि कृतं मया /
तर्हि स्वर्णमयौ स्तंभौ कृत्वा विद्रुमभूषितौ //
text_mt: If you do not desire even that celestial chariot made by me, / then, having erected two golden pillars adorned with coral,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāphalamayīṃ dolāṃ kariṣye tvatkṛte priye /
tatra tvāṃ dolayiṣyāmi bahūnmāsānaharniśam //
meaning:
मुक्ताफलमयीं दोलां करिष्ये त्वत्कृते प्रिये /
तत्र त्वां दोलयिष्यामि बहून्मासानहर्निशम् //
text_mt: I will make a swing made of pearls for your sake, my beloved. / There I will swing you for many months, day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
vratabhaṅgaṃ varārohe mā kuruṣva mama priye /
varaṃ śvapacamāṃsaṃ hi śvamāṃsaṃ vā varānane //
meaning:
व्रतभङ्गं वरारोहे मा कुरुष्व मम प्रिये /
वरं श्वपचमांसं हि श्वमांसं वा वरानने //
text_mt: O woman of lovely hips, do not cause the breaking of my observance, O my beloved! / It would be better indeed for men to eat dog-cooker's flesh, or dog's meat, O fair-faced one,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano vā narairbhuktaṃ yairbhuktaṃ harivāsare /
trailokyaghātinaḥ pāpaṃ maithune śaśinaḥ kṣaye //
meaning:
आत्मनो वा नरैर्भुक्तं यैर्भुक्तं हरिवासरे /
त्रैलोक्यघातिनः पापं मैथुने शशिनः क्षये //
text_mt: or their own flesh, than what is eaten by those who have eaten on the day of Hari! / The sin of a slayer of the three worlds enters into a man

sanskrit_iast:
narasya saṃcaretpāpaṃ bhūtāyāṃ kṣaurakarmaṇi /
bhojane vāsare viṣṇostaile ṣaṣṭyāṃ vyavasthite //
meaning:
नरस्य संचरेत्पापं भूतायां क्षौरकर्मणि /
भोजने वासरे विष्णोस्तैले षष्ट्यां व्यवस्थिते //
text_mt: in sexual intercourse during the waning of the moon, in the act of shaving on the fourteenth lunar day, / in eating on the day of Viṣṇu, when oil is used on the sixth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
lavaṇe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ saptamyāṃ piśite śubhe /
ājyeṣu paurṇamāsyāṃ vai surāyāṃ ravisaṃkrame //
meaning:
लवणे तु तृतीयायां सप्तम्यां पिशिते शुभे /
आज्येषु पौर्णमास्यां वै सुरायां रविसंक्रमे //
text_mt: in salt on the third, in meat on the seventh, O auspicious one, / in clarified butter on the full moon day, in liquor at the sun's ingress into a zodiac sign,

sanskrit_iast:
gocārasya pralope ca kūṭasākṣyapradāyake /
nikṣepahārake vāpi kumārīvighnakārake //
meaning:
गोचारस्य प्रलोपे च कूटसाक्ष्यप्रदायके /
निक्षेपहारके वापि कुमारीविघ्नकारके //
text_mt: in destroying pasture land, in giving false testimony, / in stealing a deposit, or in hindering an unmarried maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvastaghātake cāpi mṛtavatsāpradogdhari /
dadāmīti dvijāgryāya pratiśrutya na dātari //
meaning:
विश्वस्तघातके चापि मृतवत्साप्रदोग्धरि /
ददामीति द्विजाग्र्याय प्रतिश्रुत्य न दातरि //
text_mt: in betraying one who trusts, in milking a cow whose calf is dead, / in promising 'I will give' to the best of brahmins and not giving,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇikūṭe tulākūṭe kanyānṛtagavānṛte /
yatpātakaṃ tadanne hi saṃsthitaṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
मणिकूटे तुलाकूटे कन्यानृतगवानृते /
यत्पातकं तदन्ने हि संस्थितं हरिवासरे //
text_mt: in falsifying jewels, in falsifying balances, in lying about a maiden, in lying about a cow— / whatever sin there is, it resides in food on the day of Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
tadvidvāṃścārunayane kathaṃ bhokṣyāmi tāpakam /
mohinyuvāca
ekabhuktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca //
meaning:
तद्विद्वांश्चारुनयने कथं भोक्ष्यामि तापकम् /
मोहिन्युवाच
एकभुक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च //
text_mt: Knowing that, O fair-eyed one, how shall I eat that which causes torment?" / Mohinī said: / "By eating once, by eating at night, or likewise by eating unasked food,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsena rājendra dvādaśīṃ na hi laṅghayet /
gurviṇīnāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ rogiṇāṃ tathā //
meaning:
उपवासेन राजेन्द्र द्वादशीं न हि लङ्घयेत् /
गुर्विणीनां गृहस्थानां क्षीणानां रोगिणां तथा //
text_mt: or by fasting, O king of kings, one should never transgress dvādaśī. / For pregnant women, householders, the emaciated, and the sick,

sanskrit_iast:
śiśūnāṃ valigātrāṇāṃ na yuktaṃ samupoṣaṇam /
yajñabhogodyatānāṃ ca saṃgrāmakṣitisevinām //
meaning:
शिशूनां वलिगात्राणां न युक्तं समुपोषणम् /
यज्ञभोगोद्यतानां च संग्रामक्षितिसेविनाम् //
text_mt: for children, and for those with wrinkled limbs, complete fasting is not suitable; / and for those engaged in the enjoyment of sacrifices, and those who serve on the battlefield,

sanskrit_iast:
pativratānāṃ rājendra na yuktaṃ samupoṣaṇam /
etanme gautamaḥ prāha sthitāyā mandarācale //
meaning:
पतिव्रतानां राजेन्द्र न युक्तं समुपोषणम् /
एतन्मे गौतमः प्राह स्थिताया मन्दराचले //
text_mt: and for women devoted to their husbands, O king of kings, complete fasting is not suitable. / This was told to me by Gautama while I was staying on Mount Mandara.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvratena dinaṃ viṣṇorneyaṃ manujasattama /
te gṛhasthā dvijā jñeyā yeṣāmagniparigrahaḥ //
meaning:
नाव्रतेन दिनं विष्णोर्नेयं मनुजसत्तम /
ते गृहस्था द्विजा ज्ञेया येषामग्निपरिग्रहः //
text_mt: The day of Viṣṇu should not be spent without an observance, O best of men. / Those twice-born who maintain the sacred fires are to be known as householders.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaste tu vijñeyā ye prajāpālane sthitāḥ /
gurviṇī hyaṣṭamamāsīyā śiśavaścāṣṭavatsarāḥ //
meaning:
राजानस्ते तु विज्ञेया ये प्रजापालने स्थिताः /
गुर्विणी ह्यष्टममासीया शिशवश्चाष्टवत्सराः //
text_mt: And they are to be known as kings who stand firm in protecting their subjects. / Pregnant women in their eighth month, children up to eight years old,

sanskrit_iast:
atilaṅghaninaḥ kṣīṇā valigātrāstu vārddhakāḥ /
ye vivāhādimāṅgalyakarmavyagrā mahotsavāḥ //
meaning:
अतिलङ्घनिनः क्षीणा वलिगात्रास्तु वार्द्धकाः /
ये विवाहादिमाङ्गल्यकर्मव्यग्रा महोत्सवाः //
text_mt: those exhausted by excessive fasting, the emaciated, and the elderly whose limbs are wrinkled, / those engaged in auspicious rites such as weddings, and those holding great festivals,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttāśca pravṛttebhyo yajñānāṃ codyatā hi te /
trividhena purāṇena bhartturyā strī hite ratā //
meaning:
निवृत्ताश्च प्रवृत्तेभ्यो यज्ञानां चोद्यता हि ते /
त्रिविधेन पुराणेन भर्त्तुर्या स्त्री हिते रता //
text_mt: and those who have turned away from worldly engagements and are intent on sacrifices— / according to the threefold Purāṇa, the woman who is devoted to the welfare of her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā tu sā jñeyā yonisaṃrakṣaṇā tathā /
kimanyairbahubhirbhūpa vākyālāpakṛtairmayā //
meaning:
पतिव्रता तु सा ज्ञेया योनिसंरक्षणा तथा /
किमन्यैर्बहुभिर्भूप वाक्यालापकृतैर्मया //
text_mt: she is to be known as a devoted wife, as is she who guards her chastity. / What need is there, O king, for many other words uttered by me?

sanskrit_iast:
bhojane tu kṛte prītirekādaśyāṃ tvayā mama /
na prītiryadi me chitvā śiraḥ svaṃ hi prayacchasi //
meaning:
भोजने तु कृते प्रीतिरेकादश्यां त्वया मम /
न प्रीतिर्यदि मे छित्वा शिरः स्वं हि प्रयच्छसि //
text_mt: My pleasure is only achieved if you eat on Ekādaśī; / if not my pleasure, then cut off your own head and give it to me!

sanskrit_iast:
na kariṣyasi cedrājan bhojanaṃ harivāsare /
tadā hyasatyavacaso dehaṃ na sparśayāmi te //
meaning:
न करिष्यसि चेद्राजन् भोजनं हरिवासरे /
तदा ह्यसत्यवचसो देहं न स्पर्शयामि ते //
text_mt: If you do not eat on Hari’s day, O king, / then, as a speaker of untruth, I shall not let you touch my body.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ hi satyaṃ rājendra pūjyate /
viśeṣādbhūmipālānāṃ tvadvidhānāṃ mahīpate //
meaning:
वर्णानामाश्रमाणां हि सत्यं राजेन्द्र पूज्यते /
विशेषाद्भूमिपालानां त्वद्विधानां महीपते //
text_mt: Truth indeed is revered among all classes and stages of life, O best of kings, / especially among rulers of the earth such as you, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
satyena sūryastapati śaśī satyenarājate /
satye sthitā kṣitirbhūpa satyaṃ dhārayate jagat //
meaning:
सत्येन सूर्यस्तपति शशी सत्येनराजते /
सत्ये स्थिता क्षितिर्भूप सत्यं धारयते जगत् //
text_mt: By truth the sun gives heat; by truth the moon shines bright; / the earth rests upon truth, O king; truth upholds the world.

sanskrit_iast:
satyena vāyurvahati satyena jvalate śikhī /
satyā dhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
सत्येन वायुर्वहति सत्येन ज्वलते शिखी /
सत्या धारमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: By truth the wind blows; by truth the fire blazes; / this entire universe, both motionless and moving, has truth as its foundation.

sanskrit_iast:
na satyāccālate siṃdhurna vindhyo varddhate nṛpa /
na garbhaṃ yuvatī dhatte velātītaṃ kadācana //
meaning:
न सत्याच्चालते सिंधुर्न विन्ध्यो वर्द्धते नृप /
न गर्भं युवती धत्ते वेलातीतं कदाचन //
text_mt: The ocean does not transgress [its bounds] because of truth, nor does Mount Vindhya grow, O king; / a young woman never bears a child past its due time [because of truth].

sanskrit_iast:
satye sthitā hi taravaḥ phalapuṣpapradarśinaḥ /
divyādisādhanaṃ nṝṇāṃ satyādhāraṃ mahīpate //
meaning:
सत्ये स्थिता हि तरवः फलपुष्पप्रदर्शिनः /
दिव्यादिसाधनं नॄणां सत्याधारं महीपते //
text_mt: Firm in truth, the trees show forth flowers and fruit; / the means to heaven and the like for men is founded upon truth, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhasahasrebhyaḥ satyameva viśiṣyate /
madirāpānatulyena karmaṇā lipyase 'nṛtāt //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge rukmāṅgadasaṃlāpo nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अश्वमेधसहस्रेभ्यः सत्यमेव विशिष्यते /
मदिरापानतुल्येन कर्मणा लिप्यसे ऽनृतात् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे रुक्माङ्गदसंलापो नाम त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Truth is superior even to thousands of horse-sacrifices; / from untruth you will be tainted with an act equal to drinking wine.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'The Dialogue of Rukmāṅgada', in the latter section of the venerable Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ mamedaṃ gautameritam /
mandare parvataśreṣṭhe harivāsarabhojanam //
meaning:
राजोवाच
यत्त्वया व्याहृतं वाक्यं ममेदं गौतमेरितम् /
मन्दरे पर्वतश्रेष्ठे हरिवासरभोजनम् //
title: athacaturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The king said: / As to the word spoken by you to me, which was uttered by Gautama / on Mount Mandara, the foremost of mountains, regarding eating on Hari’s day—

sanskrit_iast:
amatena purāṇānāṃ vyāhṛtaṃ yaddvijanmanā /
kṣudraśāstropadeśena lolupena varānane //
meaning:
अमतेन पुराणानां व्याहृतं यद्द्विजन्मना /
क्षुद्रशास्त्रोपदेशेन लोलुपेन वरानने //
text_mt: that which was uttered by that twice-born man, contrary to the mind of the Purāṇas, / taught from inferior treatises because he was greedy, O fair-faced woman:

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇe nirṇayo hyeṣa vidvadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ /
na śaṅkhena pibettoyaṃ na hanyātkūrmasūkarau //
meaning:
पुराणे निर्णयो ह्येष विद्वद्भिः समुदाहृतः /
न शङ्खेन पिबेत्तोयं न हन्यात्कूर्मसूकरौ //
text_mt: this decision in the Purāṇas has indeed been declared by the wise: / one should not drink water from a conch shell; one should not kill a tortoise or a boar;

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi /
agamyāgamane devi abhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇe //
meaning:
एकादश्यां न भोक्तव्यं पक्षयोरुभयोरपि /
अगम्यागमने देवि अभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणे //
text_mt: one must not eat on Ekādaśī in both lunar fortnights. / In approaching an unapproachable woman, O goddess, and in eating forbidden food,

sanskrit_iast:
akāryakaraṇe jantorgosahasravadhaḥ smṛtaḥ /
jānannapi kathaṃ devi bhokṣye 'haṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
अकार्यकरणे जन्तोर्गोसहस्रवधः स्मृतः /
जानन्नपि कथं देवि भोक्ष्ये ऽहं हरिवासरे //
text_mt: and in committing forbidden deeds, the sin of a living being is recorded as equal to the slaughter of a thousand cows. / Even knowing this, O goddess, how could I eat on Hari’s day?

sanskrit_iast:
puroḍāśo 'pi vāmoru saṃprāpte harivāsare /
abhakṣyeṇa samaḥ proktaḥ kiṃ punaścāttanakriyā //
meaning:
पुरोडाशो ऽपि वामोरु संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे /
अभक्ष्येण समः प्रोक्तः किं पुनश्चात्तनक्रिया //
text_mt: Even the sacrificial cake, O woman of lovely thighs, when Hari’s day has arrived, / is declared to be equal to uneatable food; how much more so ordinary food?

sanskrit_iast:
anukūlaṃ nṛṇāṃ proktaṃ kṣīṇānāṃ varavarṇini /
mūlaṃ phalaṃ payastoyamupabhojyaṃ munīśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
अनुकूलं नृणां प्रोक्तं क्षीणानां वरवर्णिनि /
मूलं फलं पयस्तोयमुपभोज्यं मुनीश्वरैः //
text_mt: Substitutes have been declared by the best of sages for people who are weak, O fair-complexioned woman: / roots, fruits, milk, and water may be consumed.

sanskrit_iast:
natvatra bhojanaṃ kaiścidekādaśyāṃ pradarśitam /
jvariṇāṃ laṅghanaṃ śastaṃ dhārmikāṇāmupoṣaṇam //
meaning:
नत्वत्र भोजनं कैश्चिदेकादश्यां प्रदर्शितम् /
ज्वरिणां लङ्घनं शस्तं धार्मिकाणामुपोषणम् //
text_mt: However, eating has not been prescribed by any on Ekādaśī. / Fasting is commended for the feverish, and fasting for the righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaṃ gatipradaṃ proktaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare /
jvaramadhye kṛtaṃ pathyaṃ nidhanāya prakalpate //
meaning:
शुभं गतिप्रदं प्रोक्तं संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे /
ज्वरमध्ये कृतं पथ्यं निधनाय प्रकल्पते //
text_mt: It is declared auspicious and granting the [highest] state when the day of Hari has arrived; / taking wholesome food in the midst of a fever brings about death.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇave tu dine bhuktaṃ narakāyaiva kevalam /
māgrahaṃ kuru vāmoru vratabhaṅgo bhavenmama //
meaning:
वैष्णवे तु दिने भुक्तं नरकायैव केवलम् /
माग्रहं कुरु वामोरु व्रतभङ्गो भवेन्मम //
text_mt: Eating on the day of Viṣṇu leads solely to hell. / Do not insist, O fair-thighed one! My vow would be broken.

sanskrit_iast:
yadanyadvocate tubhyaṃ tatkartāsmi na saṃśayaḥ /
mohinyuvāca
na cānyadrocate rājanvinā vai bhojanaṃ tava //
meaning:
यदन्यद्वोचते तुभ्यं तत्कर्तास्मि न संशयः /
मोहिन्युवाच
न चान्यद्रोचते राजन्विना वै भोजनं तव //
text_mt: Whatever else is pleasing to you, that I will do without doubt. / Mohinī said: / Nothing else pleases me, O king, except your eating.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitasyāpi dānena na me kiñcitprayodajanam /
na ca vedeṣu dṛṣṭo 'yamupavāso harerdine //
meaning:
जीवितस्यापि दानेन न मे किञ्चित्प्रयोदजनम् /
न च वेदेषु दृष्टो ऽयमुपवासो हरेर्दिने //
text_mt: Even by the giving of your life, I have no purpose at all. / Nor is this fasting seen in the Vedas on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
agnimanto na viprā hi manyante samupoṣaṇam /
vedabāhya kathaṃ dharmaṃ bhavāṃścaritumicchati //
meaning:
अग्निमन्तो न विप्रा हि मन्यन्ते समुपोषणम् /
वेदबाह्य कथं धर्मं भवांश्चरितुमिच्छति //
text_mt: Indeed, the brahmins who keep the sacred fire do not approve of complete fasting. / Why do you wish to practice a duty that is outside the Veda?

sanskrit_iast:
vaco niśamya mohinyā rājā vedavidāṃ varaḥ /
uvāca mānase kruddhaḥ prahasanniva bhūpate //
meaning:
वचो निशम्य मोहिन्या राजा वेदविदां वरः /
उवाच मानसे क्रुद्धः प्रहसन्निव भूपते //
text_mt: Hearing the words of Mohinī, the king, foremost among knowers of the Veda, / was angry in his mind, and, as if laughing, said, O lord of the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu mohini madvākyaṃ vedo 'yaṃ bahudhā sthitaḥ /
yajñakarmakriyā vedaḥ smṛtirvedo gṛhāśrame //
meaning:
शृणु मोहिनि मद्वाक्यं वेदो ऽयं बहुधा स्थितः /
यज्ञकर्मक्रिया वेदः स्मृतिर्वेदो गृहाश्रमे //
text_mt: Listen to my words, O Mohinī: this Veda is established manifoldly. / The Veda is the performance of sacrificial rites; the Veda is the Smṛti in the householder's stage of life;

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtirvedaḥ kriyāvedaḥ purāṇeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
purāṇapuṃruṣājjātaṃ yathedaṃ jagadadbhutam //
meaning:
स्मृतिर्वेदः क्रियावेदः पुराणेषु प्रतिष्ठितः /
पुराणपुंरुषाज्जातं यथेदं जगदद्भुतम् //
text_mt: The Smṛti-Veda and the Kriyā-Veda are established in the Purāṇas. / Just as this wondrous universe was born from the ancient Puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
tathedaṃ vāṅmayaṃ jātaṃ purāṇebhyo na saṃśayaḥ /
vedārthādadhikaṃ manye purāṇārthaṃ varānane //
meaning:
तथेदं वाङ्मयं जातं पुराणेभ्यो न संशयः /
वेदार्थादधिकं मन्ये पुराणार्थं वरानने //
text_mt: so too this entire body of speech was born from the Purāṇas, without doubt. / I consider the meaning of the Purāṇas greater than the meaning of the Vedas, O fair-faced woman!

sanskrit_iast:
vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ sarve purāṇeṣveva sarvadā /
bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ prahariṣyati //
meaning:
वेदाः प्रतिष्ठिताः सर्वे पुराणेष्वेव सर्वदा /
बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद्वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति //
text_mt: All the Vedas are ever established only in the Purāṇas. / The Veda fears one of little learning, thinking: 'He will strike me down!'

sanskrit_iast:
na vede grahasaṃcāro na śuddhiḥ kālabodhinī /
tithivṛddhikṣayo vāpi parvagrahavinirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
न वेदे ग्रहसंचारो न शुद्धिः कालबोधिनी /
तिथिवृद्धिक्षयो वापि पर्वग्रहविनिर्णयः //
text_mt: In the Veda there is no movement of the planets, no purification that instructs concerning time, / nor the increase and decrease of lunar days, nor the determination of eclipse-conjunctions.

sanskrit_iast:
iti hāsapurāṇaistu niścayo 'yaṃ kṛtaḥ purā /
yanna dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu tatsarvaṃ lakṣyate smṛtau //
meaning:
इति हासपुराणैस्तु निश्चयो ऽयं कृतः पुरा /
यन्न दृष्टं हि वेदेषु तत्सर्वं लक्ष्यते स्मृतौ //
text_mt: This determination was made long ago by the Itihāsas and Purāṇas. / For whatever is not seen in the Vedas is all observed in the Smṛti;

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayoryanna dṛṣṭaṃ hi tatpurāṇaiḥ pragīyate /
prāyaścittaṃ tu hatyāyāmāturasyauṣadhaṃ priye //
meaning:
उभयोर्यन्न दृष्टं हि तत्पुराणैः प्रगीयते /
प्रायश्चित्तं तु हत्यायामातुरस्यौषधं प्रिये //
text_mt: what is not seen in both is proclaimed by the Purāṇas. / Expiation is prescribed for murder, and medicine for the sick, O dear one;

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi pāpaśuddhiḥ syādātmanaśca parasya vā /
yadvedairgīyate subhru upāṅgairyatpragīyate //
meaning:
न चापि पापशुद्धिः स्यादात्मनश्च परस्य वा /
यद्वेदैर्गीयते सुभ्रु उपाङ्गैर्यत्प्रगीयते //
text_mt: nor could there be purification from sin for oneself or another [without them]. / What is sung by the Vedas, O fair-browed one, what is proclaimed by the secondary limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaiḥ smṛtibhiścaiva veda eva nigadyate /
raṭantīha purāṇāni bhūyo bhūyo varānane //
meaning:
पुराणैः स्मृतिभिश्चैव वेद एव निगद्यते /
रटन्तीह पुराणानि भूयो भूयो वरानने //
text_mt: and by the Purāṇas and Smṛtis, is declared to be the Veda itself. / Here the Purāṇas shout repeatedly, O fair-faced woman:

sanskrit_iast:
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare /
purāṇamanyathā matvā tiryagyonimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
न भोक्तव्यं न भोक्तव्यं संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे /
पुराणमन्यथा मत्वा तिर्यग्योनिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: 'One must not eat, one must not eat, when the day of Hari has arrived!' / Considering the Purāṇa otherwise, one would obtain rebirth as an animal.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsrāto 'pi sudānto 'pi na gatiṃ prāpnuyāditi /
pitaraṃ ko na vandeta mātaraṃ ko na pūjayet //
meaning:
संस्रातो ऽपि सुदान्तो ऽपि न गतिं प्राप्नुयादिति /
पितरं को न वन्देत मातरं को न पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Even if well-bathed and well-restrained, he would not attain the [good] state. / Who would not bow to a father? Who would not honor a mother?

sanskrit_iast:
ko na gacchetsaricchreṣṭhāṃ ko bhuṅkte harivāsare /
ko hi dūṣayate vedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ko nipātayet //
meaning:
को न गच्छेत्सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां को भुङ्क्ते हरिवासरे /
को हि दूषयते वेदं ब्राह्मणं को निपातयेत् //
text_mt: Who would not go to the best of rivers? Who eats on the day of Hari? / Who indeed vilifies the Veda? Who would bring down a brahmin?

sanskrit_iast: ko gacchetparadārān hi ko bhuṅkte harivāsare //
meaning: को गच्छेत्परदारान् हि को भुङ्क्ते हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Who indeed would go to another's wife? Who eats on the day of Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
nahīdṛśaṃ pāpamihāsti jantorvimūḍhacittasya dine hareḥ priye /
yadbhojanenātmanipātakāriṇā yamasya ravāteṣu ciraṃ sulocane //
meaning:
नहीदृशं पापमिहास्ति जन्तोर्विमूढचित्तस्य दिने हरेः प्रिये /
यद्भोजनेनात्मनिपातकारिणा यमस्य रवातेषु चिरं सुलोचने //
text_mt: For there is no such sin in this world, O dear one, for a deluded person on the day of Hari, / as that committed by eating, bringing sin upon oneself [and dwelling] long in the hellish torments of Yama, O woman of beautiful eyes!

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
śīghramānaya viprāṃstvaṃ ghūrṇike vedapāragān /
yeṣāṃ vākyena yukto 'yaṃ rājā kuryāddhi bhojanam //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
शीघ्रमानय विप्रांस्त्वं घूर्णिके वेदपारगान् /
येषां वाक्येन युक्तो ऽयं राजा कुर्याद्धि भोजनम् //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / Quickly bring, O Ghūrṇikā, brahmins who have mastered the Vedas, / persuaded by whose words this king may indeed take food.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tadvākyamupākarṇya brāhmaṇānvedaśālinaḥ /
gautamādīnsamāhūya mohinīpārśvamānayata //
meaning:
सा तद्वाक्यमुपाकर्ण्य ब्राह्मणान्वेदशालिनः /
गौतमादीन्समाहूय मोहिनीपार्श्वमानयत //
text_mt: Hearing her words, she summoned the brahmins endowed with Vedic learning, / Gautama and others, and brought them to Mohinī's side.

sanskrit_iast:
tānviprānāgatāndṛṣṭvā vedavedāṅgapāragān /
mohinī sahitā rājñā vavande kāryatatparā //
meaning:
तान्विप्रानागतान्दृष्ट्वा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान् /
मोहिनी सहिता राज्ञा ववन्दे कार्यतत्परा //
text_mt: Seeing those brahmins arrived, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / Mohinī, intent on her purpose, bowed down along with the king.

sanskrit_iast:
upaviṣṭāstu te sarve śātakaiṃbhamayeṣu ca /
āsaneṣu mahīpāla jvaladagnisamaprabhāḥ //
meaning:
उपविष्टास्तु ते सर्वे शातकैंभमयेषु च /
आसनेषु महीपाल ज्वलदग्निसमप्रभाः //
text_mt: They all sat down on golden seats, / O protector of the earth, possessing a brilliance equal to blazing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ madhye vayovṛddho gautamo vākyamabravīt /
vayaṃ samāgatā devi nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ //
meaning:
तेषां मध्ये वयोवृद्धो गौतमो वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
वयं समागता देवि नानाशास्त्रविशारदाः //
text_mt: Among them, Gautama, advanced in age, spoke these words: / 'We have arrived, O queen, skilled in various treatises,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃdehahartāro yadarthaṃ te samāhutāḥ /
tacchatvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ mohinī brahmaṇaḥ sutā //
meaning:
सर्वसंदेहहर्तारो यदर्थं ते समाहुताः /
तच्छत्वा वचनं तेषां मोहिनी ब्रह्मणः सुता //
text_mt: dispelling all doubts, for which purpose we were summoned.' / Hearing those words of theirs, Mohinī, the daughter of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsādhyakṛtaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttāṃstānuvāca ha /
mohinyuvāca
saṃdehastu jaḍau hyeṣa svalpo vā svamatiryathā //
meaning:
सर्वासाध्यकृतं कर्तुं प्रवृत्तांस्तानुवाच ह /
मोहिन्युवाच
संदेहस्तु जडौ ह्येष स्वल्पो वा स्वमतिर्यथा //
text_mt: spoke to those who were ready to accomplish what was impossible to accomplish: / Mohinī said: / 'This doubt is dull indeed, whether small or according to one's own opinion.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'yaṃ vadati rājā vai nāhaṃ bhokṣye harerdine /
annādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
सो ऽयं वदति राजा वै नाहं भोक्ष्ये हरेर्दिने /
अन्नाधारमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: Thus this king says: 'I will certainly not eat on Hari’s day. / All this universe, motionless and moving, has food as its support.'

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtā hyapi tathānnena prīyante pitaro divi /
karkandhumātraṃ prahutaṃ puroḍāśaṃ hi devatāḥ //
meaning:
मृता ह्यपि तथान्नेन प्रीयन्ते पितरो दिवि /
कर्कन्धुमात्रं प्रहुतं पुरोडाशं हि देवताः //
text_mt: Even the dead ancestors in heaven are pleased by food. / The deities desire even a sacrificial cake the size of a jujube offered in the fire, O best of the twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmayanti dvijaśreṣṭhāstato 'nnaṃ hyamṛtaṃ param /
pipīlikāpi kṣudhitā mukhenādāya taṇḍulam //
meaning:
कामयन्ति द्विजश्रेष्ठास्ततो ऽन्नं ह्यमृतं परम् /
पिपीलिकापि क्षुधिता मुखेनादाय तण्डुलम् //
text_mt: therefore food is the supreme nectar. / Even an ant, when hungry, takes a grain of rice in its mouth

sanskrit_iast:
bilaṃ vrajati duḥkhena kasyānnaṃ nahi rocate /
ayaṃ khādati nānnādyaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare //
meaning:
बिलं व्रजति दुःखेन कस्यान्नं नहि रोचते /
अयं खादति नान्नाद्यं संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे //
text_mt: and enters its hole with difficulty; to whom is food not pleasing? / This [king] does not eat food today when the day of Hari has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
nijadharmaṃ parityajya paradharme vyavasthitaḥ /
vidhāvānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca yujyate vratasevanam //
meaning:
निजधर्मं परित्यज्य परधर्मे व्यवस्थितः /
विधावानां यतीनां च युज्यते व्रतसेवनम् //
text_mt: Abandoning his own duty, he is established in the duty of another. / The observance of vows is suitable for widows and ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
paradharmarato yaḥ syātsvadharmavimukho naraḥ /
soṃ'dhe tamasi majjeta yāvadindrāścaturddaśa //
meaning:
परधर्मरतो यः स्यात्स्वधर्मविमुखो नरः /
सोंऽधे तमसि मज्जेत यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्द्दश //
text_mt: A man who is devoted to the duty of another and averse to his own duty / would sink into blind darkness for as long as fourteen Indras [rule].

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsādikaraṇaṃ bhūbhujāṃ noditaṃ kvacit /
prajāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ tyaktvā caturvargaphalapradam //
meaning:
उपवासादिकरणं भूभुजां नोदितं क्वचित् /
प्रजासंरक्षणं त्यक्त्वा चतुर्वर्गफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: The performance of fasts and the like has nowhere been prescribed for kings, / setting aside the protection of the subjects, which yields the fruit of the four aims of life.

sanskrit_iast:
nārīṇāṃ bhartṛśūśrūṣā putrāṇāṃ pitṛsevanam /
śūdrāṇāṃ dvijasevā ca lokarakṣā mahībhṛtām //
meaning:
नारीणां भर्तृशूश्रूषा पुत्राणां पितृसेवनम् /
शूद्राणां द्विजसेवा च लोकरक्षा महीभृताम् //
text_mt: The duty of women is service to the husband; of sons, service to the father; / of Śūdras, service to the twice-born; and of kings, protection of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
svakaṃ karma parityajya yo 'nyatra kurute śramam /
ajñānādvā pramādācca patitaḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
स्वकं कर्म परित्यज्य यो ऽन्यत्र कुरुते श्रमम् /
अज्ञानाद्वा प्रमादाच्च पतितः स न संशयः //
text_mt: He who abandons his own duty and exerts himself in another's, / whether out of ignorance or negligence, is fallen; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'yamadya mahīpālo yatidharmme vyavasthitaḥ /
subuddhyācāraśīlaśca vedoktaṃ tyajati dvijāḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽयमद्य महीपालो यतिधर्म्मे व्यवस्थितः /
सुबुद्ध्याचारशीलश्च वेदोक्तं त्यजति द्विजाः //
text_mt: This ruler of the earth is today established in the duty of an ascetic; / though having a disposition toward good intellect and conduct, he abandons what is spoken in the Veda, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
svecchācārā tu yā nārī yo 'vinītaḥ suto dvijāḥ /
ekāntaśīlo nṛpatirbhṛtyaḥ karmavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
स्वेच्छाचारा तु या नारी यो ऽविनीतः सुतो द्विजाः /
एकान्तशीलो नृपतिर्भृत्यः कर्मविवर्जितः //
text_mt: A woman who acts according to her own will, an undisciplined son, O twice-born, / a king who loves solitude, and a servant devoid of work—

sanskrit_iast:
sarve te narakaṃ yānti hyapratiṣṭhaśca yo dvijāḥ /
ayaṃ hi niyamopeto haripūjanatatparaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे ते नरकं यान्ति ह्यप्रतिष्ठश्च यो द्विजाः /
अयं हि नियमोपेतो हरिपूजनतत्परः //
text_mt: all of them go to hell, and also the twice-born who lacks a steady position. / For this [king], bound by restrictions, is intent on the worship of Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
ākrande varttamāne tu na yadyeṣa pradhāvati /
vyapohya haripūjāṃ vai brahmahatyāṃ tu vindati //
meaning:
आक्रन्दे वर्त्तमाने तु न यद्येष प्रधावति /
व्यपोह्य हरिपूजां वै ब्रह्महत्यां तु विन्दति //
text_mt: if an outcry occurs and he does not run forward, / casting aside the worship of Hari, he surely incurs the guilt of slaying a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīṇadehe haridine kathaṃ saṃyamayiṣyati /
annātprabhavati prāṇaḥ prāṇāddehaviceṣṭanam //
meaning:
क्षीणदेहे हरिदिने कथं संयमयिष्यति /
अन्नात्प्रभवति प्राणः प्राणाद्देहविचेष्टनम् //
text_mt: With an emaciated body, how will he maintain control on the day of Hari? / Vital breath arises from food, and bodily exertion arises from vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
ceṣṭayā ripunāśaśca taddhīnaḥ paribhūyate /
evaṃ jñātvā mayā rājā bodhyamāno na buddhyati //
meaning:
चेष्टया रिपुनाशश्च तद्धीनः परिभूयते /
एवं ज्ञात्वा मया राजा बोध्यमानो न बुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: By exertion the enemy is destroyed; deprived of it, he is overcome. / Knowing this, the king, though instructed by me, does not understand.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva vrataṃ rājño yatprajāpālanaṃ caret /
na vrataṃ kiñcidastyanyannṛpasya dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
एतदेव व्रतं राज्ञो यत्प्रजापालनं चरेत् /
न व्रतं किञ्चिदस्त्यन्यन्नृपस्य द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: This alone is the king's vow: that he should carry out the protection of subjects. / There is no other vow for a king, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ deva kāryeṇa narādhipasya kṛtvā hi manyuṃ viṣayasthitānām /
taddevakāryaṃ sa ca yajñahomo yadraktapāto na bhavet svarāṣṭre //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīpraśno nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
किं देव कार्येण नराधिपस्य कृत्वा हि मन्युं विषयस्थितानाम् /
तद्देवकार्यं स च यज्ञहोमो यद्रक्तपातो न भवेत् स्वराष्ट्रे //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीप्रश्नो नाम चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
What is the ruler of men to do with divine service, having caused grief to those dwelling in his realm? / That is divine service, and that is sacrifice and fire oblation, by which no bloodshed occurs in one's kingdom.'

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, named 'The Inquiry of Mohinī', in the second part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tadvākyaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā mohinyā samudīritam /
tathyamityevamuktvā tu rājānaṃ vākyamabruvan //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणाः श्रुत्वा मोहिन्या समुदीरितम् /
तथ्यमित्येवमुक्त्वा तु राजानं वाक्यमब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing those words spoken by Mohinī, the brahmins / said 'It is true,' and then spoke these words to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ
yastvayā nṛpate puṇyaḥ kṛto 'yaṃ śapathaḥ kila /
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः
यस्त्वया नृपते पुण्यः कृतो ऽयं शपथः किल /
एकादश्यां न भोक्तव्यं पक्षयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: The Brāhmaṇas said: / The holy vow that was made by you, O king, [viz.]: / 'One must not eat on Ekādaśī in both lunar fortnights'—

sanskrit_iast:
na kṛtaḥ śāstradṛṣṭyā tu svabuddhyaiva prakalpitaḥ /
sāgrīnāṃ prāśanaṃ proktamubhayoḥ saṃdhyayoḥ kila //
meaning:
न कृतः शास्त्रदृष्ट्या तु स्वबुद्ध्यैव प्रकल्पितः /
साग्रीनां प्राशनं प्रोक्तमुभयोः संध्ययोः किल //
text_mt: "It was not made according to the view of the scriptures, but merely conceived by your own intellect. / Indeed, eating is prescribed at both twilights for those who maintain sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast:
homocchiṣṭaprabhoktārastrayo varṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
viśeṣādbhūmipālānāṃ kathaṃ yuktamupoṣaṇam //
meaning:
होमोच्छिष्टप्रभोक्तारस्त्रयो वर्णाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
विशेषाद्भूमिपालानां कथं युक्तमुपोषणम् //
text_mt: The three classes are declared to eat the remains of fire oblations. / How is fasting proper, especially for kings,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadodyataśastrāṇāṃ duṣṭasaṃyamināṃ vibho /
śāstrato 'śāstrato vāpi yastvayā śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदोद्यतशस्त्राणां दुष्टसंयमिनां विभो /
शास्त्रतो ऽशास्त्रतो वापि यस्त्वया शपथः कृतः //
text_mt: who always have their weapons raised, who restrain the wicked, O lord? / Whether from scripture or not from scripture, this oath which you have made

sanskrit_iast:
paripūrṇo bhavatyadya vākyena hi dvijanmanām /
vratabhaṅgo na te 'stīha bhukṣvaṃ viprasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
परिपूर्णो भवत्यद्य वाक्येन हि द्विजन्मनाम् /
व्रतभङ्गो न ते ऽस्तीह भुक्ष्वं विप्रसमन्वितः //
text_mt: is fulfilled today by the word of the twice-born. / There is no breach of vow for you in this; eat, accompanied by the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
paritāpo na te kāryo vipravākyaṃ mahattaram /
yo 'nyathā manyate vākyaṃ viprāṇāṃ nṛpasattama //
meaning:
परितापो न ते कार्यो विप्रवाक्यं महत्तरम् /
यो ऽन्यथा मन्यते वाक्यं विप्राणां नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: You should not feel remorse; the word of a brāhmaṇa is superior. / He who regards the word of brāhmaṇas otherwise, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāti rākṣasīṃ yoniṃ janmāni daśa pañca ca /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rodraṃ rājā kopasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
स याति राक्षसीं योनिं जन्मानि दश पञ्च च /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं रोद्रं राजा कोपसमन्वितः //
text_mt: enters a rākṣasa womb for fifteen births." / Hearing that harsh speech, the king, filled with anger,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca sphuramāṇauṣṭastānviprānślakṣṇayā girā /
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ bhavanto mārgadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
उवाच स्फुरमाणौष्टस्तान्विप्रान्श्लक्ष्णया गिरा /
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां भवन्तो मार्गदर्शिनः //
text_mt: with trembling lips, spoke to those brāhmaṇas in gentle words: / "You are the guides on the path for all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ vidhavānāṃ ca śloko 'yaṃ paṭhyate dvijāḥ /
vimārgagāmināṃ caitanmataṃ na sātvatāṃ kvacit //
meaning:
यतीनां विधवानां च श्लोको ऽयं पठ्यते द्विजाः /
विमार्गगामिनां चैतन्मतं न सात्वतां क्वचित् //
text_mt: This verse is recited for ascetics and widows, O twice-born! / And this is the opinion of those who go astray; it is never that of the Bhāgavatas.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhavadbhiḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ rājñāṃ nopoṣaṇaṃ smṛtam /
tatra vākyāni śṛṇuta vaiṣṇavā cāralakṣaṇe //
meaning:
यद्भवद्भिः समुद्दिष्टं राज्ञां नोपोषणं स्मृतम् /
तत्र वाक्यानि शृणुत वैष्णवा चारलक्षणे //
text_mt: As to what you have pointed out, that fasting is not prescribed for kings, / listen in that regard to the words on the characteristics of Vaiṣṇava conduct:

sanskrit_iast:
na śaṅkhena pibettoyaṃ na hanyātkūrmasūkarau /
ekā daśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
न शङ्खेन पिबेत्तोयं न हन्यात्कूर्मसूकरौ /
एका दश्यां न भोक्तव्यं पक्षयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: 'One must not drink water from a conch; one must not kill a turtle or a boar; / one must not eat on the eleventh day in either fortnight;

sanskrit_iast:
na pātavyaṃ hi madya tu na hantavyo dvijaḥ kvacit /
krīḍennākṣaistu dharmajño nāśnīyāddharivāsare //
meaning:
न पातव्यं हि मद्य तु न हन्तव्यो द्विजः क्वचित् /
क्रीडेन्नाक्षैस्तु धर्मज्ञो नाश्नीयाद्धरिवासरे //
text_mt: one must never drink intoxicating liquor; one must never kill a twice-born; / one who knows dharma should not play with dice; one should not eat on the day of Hari.'

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣya bhakṣaṇaṃ pāpaṃ paradārābhimarśanam /
ekādaśyāṃ bhojanaṃ ca patanasyaiva kāraṇam //
meaning:
अभक्ष्य भक्षणं पापं परदाराभिमर्शनम् /
एकादश्यां भोजनं च पतनस्यैव कारणम् //
text_mt: Eating what is not fit to be eaten is a sin, [as is] touching another's wife; / and eating on the eleventh day is indeed a cause of falling.

sanskrit_iast:
akāryakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatam /
ko hi saṃceṣṭamānastu bhunakti harivāsare //
meaning:
अकार्यकरणं कृत्वा किं जीवेच्छरदां शतम् /
को हि संचेष्टमानस्तु भुनक्ति हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Why should one live a hundred autumns by doing what ought not to be done? / For who, while having breath, eats on the day of Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadebhyo 'pi janairnānnaṃ deyaṃ harerdine /
uttarāśāsthitairviprairviṣṇudharmaparāyaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
चतुष्पदेभ्यो ऽपि जनैर्नान्नं देयं हरेर्दिने /
उत्तराशास्थितैर्विप्रैर्विष्णुधर्मपरायणैः //
text_mt: Even to four-footed beasts food should not be given by people on the day of Hari / according to the brāhmaṇas residing in the northern quarter who are devoted to the dharma of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ kathaṃ karomyadya abhakṣyasya tu bhakṣaṇam /
nopakṣīṇaśarīro 'haṃ nāmayāvī dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽहं कथं करोम्यद्य अभक्ष्यस्य तु भक्षणम् /
नोपक्षीणशरीरो ऽहं नामयावी द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: How then shall I today eat what should not be eaten? / My body is not emaciated; I am not afflicted with disease, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ hi vrataṃ tyakṣe vimārgasthadvijoktitaḥ /
dharmabhūṣaṇasaṃjñena rakṣyamāṇe dharātale //
meaning:
स कथं हि व्रतं त्यक्षे विमार्गस्थद्विजोक्तितः /
धर्मभूषणसंज्ञेन रक्ष्यमाणे धरातले //
text_mt: How indeed shall I abandon the vow on the word of twice-born who tread the wrong path, / while the surface of the earth is being protected by the one named Dharmabhūṣaṇa?

sanskrit_iast:
na ca rakṣāvihīno 'haṃ śatruḥ ko 'pina me 'sti ca /
evaṃ jñātvā dvijaśreṣṭhā vaiṣṇavavrataśālinaḥ //
meaning:
न च रक्षाविहीनो ऽहं शत्रुः को ऽपिन मे ऽस्ति च /
एवं ज्ञात्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठा वैष्णवव्रतशालिनः //
text_mt: I am not devoid of protection, nor is there any enemy of mine. / Knowing thus, O best of the twice-born, endowed with the Vaiṣṇava vow,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhirnocitaṃ vaktuṃ pratikūlaṃ vratāpaham /
asaṃparīkṣya ye dadyuḥ prāyaścittaṃ dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
भवद्भिर्नोचितं वक्तुं प्रतिकूलं व्रतापहम् /
असंपरीक्ष्य ये दद्युः प्रायश्चित्तं द्विजातयः //
text_mt: it is not proper for you to speak what is contrary and destructive to the vow. / Those twice-born who prescribe an expiation without thorough examination,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmeva hi tatpāpaṃ smṛtivaikalyasambhavam /
devo vā dānavo vāpi gandharvo rākṣaso 'pi vā //
meaning:
तेषामेव हि तत्पापं स्मृतिवैकल्यसम्भवम् /
देवो वा दानवो वापि गन्धर्वो राक्षसो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: that sin arising from the impairment of the Smṛti belongs to them alone. / Whether a deva, or a dānava, a gandharva, or a rākṣasa,

sanskrit_iast:
siddho vā brāhmaṇo vāpi pitāsmākaṃ svayaṃ vadet /
harirvāpi haro vāpi mohinījanako 'pi vā //
meaning:
सिद्धो वा ब्राह्मणो वापि पितास्माकं स्वयं वदेत् /
हरिर्वापि हरो वापि मोहिनीजनको ऽपि वा //
text_mt: or a siddha, or a brāhmaṇa, or our own father himself should say so, / or Hari, or Hara, or the father of Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast:
dinakṛllokapālo vā no bhokṣye harivāsare /
yo hi rukmāṅgado rājā vikhyāto bhūtale dvijāḥ //
meaning:
दिनकृल्लोकपालो वा नो भोक्ष्ये हरिवासरे /
यो हि रुक्माङ्गदो राजा विख्यातो भूतले द्विजाः //
text_mt: the sun, or a world-guardian—I will not eat on the day of Hari! / Indeed, the king Rukmāṅgada, renowned on the surface of the earth, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
satyapratijñāṃ viphalāṃ na kadācitkaroti hi /
dyupateḥ kṣīyate tejo himavānparivarttate //
meaning:
सत्यप्रतिज्ञां विफलां न कदाचित्करोति हि /
द्युपतेः क्षीयते तेजो हिमवान्परिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: never renders his true promise unfulfilled! / The splendor of the lord of heaven may fade, the Himālaya may turn upside down,

sanskrit_iast:
jaladhiḥ śoṣamāyāti pāvakaścoṣṇatāṃ tyajet /
tathāpi na tyaje viprā vratamekādaśīdine //
meaning:
जलधिः शोषमायाति पावकश्चोष्णतां त्यजेत् /
तथापि न त्यजे विप्रा व्रतमेकादशीदिने //
text_mt: the ocean may dry up, and fire may abandon its heat, / yet I will not abandon the vow on the day of the eleventh, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhireṣā bhuvanatraye 'pi āraṭyate me paṭahena viprāḥ /
grāmeṣu deśeṣu pareṣu vāpi ye bhuñjate rukmavibhūṣaṇasya //
meaning:
प्रसिद्धिरेषा भुवनत्रये ऽपि आरट्यते मे पटहेन विप्राः /
ग्रामेषु देशेषु परेषु वापि ये भुञ्जते रुक्मविभूषणस्य //
text_mt: This proclamation is celebrated even in the three worlds, heralded by drum, O twice-born, / in the villages and in other countries: whoever eats under Rukmavibhūṣaṇa

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍyāśca vadhyāśca saputrakāste na cāpi vāso viṣaye hi teṣām /
harerdine sarvamakhapradhāne pāpāpahe dharmavivarddhane ca //
meaning:
दण्ड्याश्च वध्याश्च सपुत्रकास्ते न चापि वासो विषये हि तेषाम् /
हरेर्दिने सर्वमखप्रधाने पापापहे धर्मविवर्द्धने च //
text_mt: is to be punished and put to death, together with his sons, and there shall be no dwelling for them in his realm / on the day of Hari, which is the chief of all sacrifices, dispeller of sin, and enhancer of dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaprade janmanikṛntanākhye tejo nidhau sarvajanaprarūḍhe /
eṃvavidhe prodgata eva śabde yadyasmi bhoktā vṛjinasya karttā //
meaning:
मोक्षप्रदे जन्मनिकृन्तनाख्ये तेजो निधौ सर्वजनप्ररूढे /
एंवविधे प्रोद्गत एव शब्दे यद्यस्मि भोक्ता वृजिनस्य कर्त्ता //
text_mt: bestower of liberation, named the destroyer of rebirths, a treasure of splendor, established among all people! / When such a proclamation has indeed gone forth, if I were to eat and become a committer of sin,

sanskrit_iast:
amedhyaliptaḥ paṭaho bhavettadā saṃchādito nīlamayena vāsasā /
utpādya kīrtiṃ svayameva jaturnikṛntati prāṇabhayācca pāpāt //
meaning:
अमेध्यलिप्तः पटहो भवेत्तदा संछादितो नीलमयेन वाससा /
उत्पाद्य कीर्तिं स्वयमेव जतुर्निकृन्तति प्राणभयाच्च पापात् //
text_mt: the drum would then become smeared with foul matter and covered with a blue cloth! / Having himself brought forth fame, who would sever his throat out of fear of sin for the sake of life?

sanskrit_iast:
yastasya vāso niraye yugānāṃ ṣaṣṭirbhavedvā krimidaṃśasaṃjñe /
vṛthā hi sūtā mama sā janitrī bhavennirāśā dvijapitṛdevāḥ //
meaning:
यस्तस्य वासो निरये युगानां षष्टिर्भवेद्वा क्रिमिदंशसंज्ञे /
वृथा हि सूता मम सा जनित्री भवेन्निराशा द्विजपितृदेवाः //
text_mt: For him, there would be a residence in hell for sixty yugas in the one named Worm-Sting; / in vain indeed would that mother of mine have given birth, and the twice-born, ancestors, and gods would be bereft of hope!

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvato harṣamupāśrayecca salekhako me vratabhaṅga eva /
kiṃ tena jātena durātmanā hi dadāti harṣaṃ ripusuṃdarīṇām //
meaning:
वैवस्वतो हर्षमुपाश्रयेच्च सलेखको मे व्रतभङ्ग एव /
किं तेन जातेन दुरात्मना हि ददाति हर्षं रिपुसुंदरीणाम् //
text_mt: Vaivasvata along with his scribe would rejoice at the very breach of my vow! / What is the use of that wicked-souled one being born who gives joy to the beautiful women of his enemies?

sanskrit_iast:
kukarmaṇā pāparatiḥ kujātiḥ sarvasya nāśī tvaśucissa mūḍhaḥ /
na manyate vedapurāṇaśāstrānante purīṃ yāti dineśasūnoḥ //
meaning:
कुकर्मणा पापरतिः कुजातिः सर्वस्य नाशी त्वशुचिस्स मूढः /
न मन्यते वेदपुराणशास्त्रानन्ते पुरीं याति दिनेशसूनोः //
