text_mt: Through evil deeds, delighted in sin, of base birth, destroying everything, impure is that fool; / he does not honor the Vedas, Purāṇas, and scriptures, and in the end goes to the city of the son of the sun!

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaiva vāntiṃ punaratti tāṃ yastadvatpratijñāvratabhaṅgakārī /
vedā na śāstraṃ na ca tatpurāṇaṃ na cāpi santaḥ smṛtayo na ca syuḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वैव वान्तिं पुनरत्ति तां यस्तद्वत्प्रतिज्ञाव्रतभङ्गकारी /
वेदा न शास्त्रं न च तत्पुराणं न चापि सन्तः स्मृतयो न च स्युः //
text_mt: Like one who, having vomited, eats it again, so is he who breaks his oath and vow. / There are no Vedas, no scripture, no Purāṇa, and no virtuous people, nor would there be Smṛtis

sanskrit_iast:
ye mādhavasya priyakṛtyayogye vadanti śuddhe 'hni bhujikriyāṃ tu /
śrāddhena tenāpi na cāsti tṛptiḥ pituśca cīrṇena harerdine tu //
meaning:
ये माधवस्य प्रियकृत्ययोग्ये वदन्ति शुद्धे ऽह्नि भुजिक्रियां तु /
श्राद्धेन तेनापि न चास्ति तृप्तिः पितुश्च चीर्णेन हरेर्दिने तु //
text_mt: which declare the act of eating on the pure day suited for the deed dear to Mādhava. / Nor is there satisfaction for the ancestor through that ancestral rite performed on the day of Hari;

sanskrit_iast: vratena yadviṣṇupadapradena sākaṃ kṣayāhena vadantu mūḍhāḥ //
meaning: व्रतेन यद्विष्णुपदप्रदेन साकं क्षयाहेन वदन्तु मूढाः //
text_mt: let fools speak of [performing an ancestral rite] along with the anniversary of death on that day which bestows Viṣṇu's abode!"

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu tadvākyaṃ mohinī jvalitāntarā /
kopasaṃraktanayanā bhartāraṃ paryabhāṣat //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु तद्वाक्यं मोहिनी ज्वलितान्तरा /
कोपसंरक्तनयना भर्तारं पर्यभाषत् //
text_mt: Having heard those words of his, Mohinī, burning within, / with eyes reddened by anger, addressed her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
karoṣi cenna me vākyaṃ dharmabāhyo bhaviṣyasi /
dharmabāhyo hi puruṣaḥ pāṃśunā tulyatāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
करोषि चेन्न मे वाक्यं धर्मबाह्यो भविष्यसि /
धर्मबाह्यो हि पुरुषः पांशुना तुल्यतां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: "If you do not obey my word, you will be outside of dharma; / and a man outside of dharma is reduced to equality with dust.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṃśunā pūryate gartaḥ sa gartakhanako bhavet /
tvayā mamārpitaḥ pāṇirvarāya pṛthivīpate //
meaning:
पांशुना पूर्यते गर्तः स गर्तखनको भवेत् /
त्वया ममार्पितः पाणिर्वराय पृथिवीपते //
text_mt: A pit is filled with dust; he would become the digger of his own pit! / You offered your hand to me for a boon, O lord of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
tāmullaṅghya pratijñāṃ svāṃ pālayiṣyāsi no yadi /
kṛtakṛtyā tadā yāsye prāpto dharmo mayā tava //
meaning:
तामुल्लङ्घ्य प्रतिज्ञां स्वां पालयिष्यासि नो यदि /
कृतकृत्या तदा यास्ये प्राप्तो धर्मो मया तव //
text_mt: Transgressing that, if you do not fulfill your promise, / then having accomplished my purpose I shall depart; your dharma has been attained by me!

sanskrit_iast:
na cāhaṃ te priyā bhāryā na ca tvaṃ me patirnṛpa /
upadhānaṃ kariṣyāmi svakaṃ bāhuṃ na te yudhi //
meaning:
न चाहं ते प्रिया भार्या न च त्वं मे पतिर्नृप /
उपधानं करिष्यामि स्वकं बाहुं न ते युधि //
text_mt: I am no beloved wife of yours, and you are no husband to me, O king! / I will not make my arm your pillow in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dhik tvāṃ dharmakṣayakaraṃ svavacolopakārakam /
mleccheṣvapi na dṛśyeta tvādṛśo dharmalopakaḥ //
meaning:
धिक् त्वां धर्मक्षयकरं स्ववचोलोपकारकम् /
म्लेच्छेष्वपि न दृश्येत त्वादृशो धर्मलोपकः //
text_mt: Fie on you, who cause the destruction of dharma and violate your own word! / Even among the mlecchas, such a violator of dharma would not be seen.

sanskrit_iast:
satyāccalitamadyatvāṃ parityakṣye supāpinam /
evamuktvā varārohā hyudatiṣṭhattvarānvitā //
meaning:
सत्याच्चलितमद्यत्वां परित्यक्ष्ये सुपापिनम् /
एवमुक्त्वा वरारोहा ह्युदतिष्ठत्त्वरान्विता //
text_mt: Today I will abandon you, a great sinner fallen from truth!" / Having spoken thus, the slender-waisted woman stood up in haste.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā satī haraṃ tyaktvā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā /
prasthitā sā tadā tanvī bhūsuraiśca samanvitā //
meaning:
यथा सती हरं त्यक्त्वा दिव्याभरणभूषिता /
प्रस्थिता सा तदा तन्वी भूसुरैश्च समन्विता //
text_mt: Just as Satī, having abandoned Hara, adorned with divine ornaments, / set forth, so did that slender woman, accompanied by the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ madyasya saṃsparśo nāsya saṃgo nṛpasya vai /
varaṃ nīlāṃbarasparśo nāsya dharmacyutasya hi //
meaning:
वरं मद्यस्य संस्पर्शो नास्य संगो नृपस्य वै /
वरं नीलांबरस्पर्शो नास्य धर्मच्युतस्य हि //
text_mt: "Better the touch of intoxicating liquor than association with this king! / Better the touch of a blue garment than of this one fallen from dharma!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi mohinī ruṣṭā pralapantī tadā bhṛśam /
gautamādisamāyuktā nirjagāma gṛhādbrahiḥ //
meaning:
एवं हि मोहिनी रुष्टा प्रलपन्ती तदा भृशम् /
गौतमादिसमायुक्ता निर्जगाम गृहाद्ब्रहिः //
text_mt: Thus Mohinī, enraged, lamenting profusely at that time, / accompanied by Gautama and others, departed outside the palace.

sanskrit_iast:
hā tāta hā jagannātha sṛṣṭisthittyantakāraka /
ityeva śabdaṃ krośantī brahmaṇomānasodbhavā //
meaning:
हा तात हा जगन्नाथ सृष्टिस्थित्त्यन्तकारक /
इत्येव शब्दं क्रोशन्ती ब्रह्मणोमानसोद्भवा //
text_mt: "Alas, Father! Alas, Lord of the World, creator of creation, maintenance, and dissolution!" / Calling out these very words, the mind-born daughter of Brahmā [went forth].

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu vājirājaṃ samāsthitaḥ /
aṭitvā sakalāmurvīṃ saṃprāpto dharmabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वाजिराजं समास्थितः /
अटित्वा सकलामुर्वीं संप्राप्तो धर्मभूषणः //
text_mt: At that very moment, mounted upon an excellent horse, / having roamed the entire earth, Dharmabhūṣaṇa arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmukho 'bhūjjananyāstu tvarāyukto vimatsaraḥ /
karṇābhyāṃ tasya śabdo 'sau viśrutaḥ pitṛvatsalaḥ //
meaning:
संमुखो ऽभूज्जनन्यास्तु त्वरायुक्तो विमत्सरः /
कर्णाभ्यां तस्य शब्दो ऽसौ विश्रुतः पितृवत्सलः //
text_mt: He came face-to-face with his mother, moving with haste, free from malice; / that sound was heard by his ears—he who was devoted to his father,

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīvaktrasaṃbhūto vipravākyopabṛṃhitaḥ /
dharmāṅgado dharmamūrtiḥ rukmāgadasutastadā //
meaning:
मोहिनीवक्त्रसंभूतो विप्रवाक्योपबृंहितः /
धर्माङ्गदो धर्ममूर्तिः रुक्मागदसुतस्तदा //
text_mt: originating from Mohinī’s mouth and amplified by the words of the Brāhmaṇas; / then Dharmāṅgada, the embodiment of righteousness, the son of Rukmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast:
avaruhya hayāttūrṇaṃ yayau tātapadāntike /
punarutthāya viprendrānnanāma vihitāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
अवरुह्य हयात्तूर्णं ययौ तातपदान्तिके /
पुनरुत्थाय विप्रेन्द्रान्ननाम विहिताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: quickly dismounting from his horse, went near to his father’s feet; / rising up again, he bowed to the foremost Brāhmaṇas with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śīghragatiṃ dṛṣṭvā mohinīṃ ruṣṭamānasām /
ālakṣya tarasā mātaḥ prāha rājan kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
ततः शीघ्रगतिं दृष्ट्वा मोहिनीं रुष्टमानसाम् /
आलक्ष्य तरसा मातः प्राह राजन् कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Then, seeing Mohinī walking swiftly with an enraged mind, / observing [her], he said quickly with folded hands: 'O mother! O queen!

sanskrit_iast:
kenāvamānitā devi kathaṃ ruṣṭā pituḥ priye /
etairdvijendraiḥ sahitā kva tvaṃ saṃprasthitādhunā //
meaning:
केनावमानिता देवि कथं रुष्टा पितुः प्रिये /
एतैर्द्विजेन्द्रैः सहिता क्व त्वं संप्रस्थिताधुना //
text_mt: By whom have you been insulted, O goddess? Why are you angry, O beloved of my father? / Accompanied by these foremost of the twice-born, where are you setting off to now?'

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadavacaḥ śrutvā mohinī vākyamabravīt /
pitā tavānṛtī putra karo yena vṛthā kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदवचः श्रुत्वा मोहिनी वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
पिता तवानृती पुत्र करो येन वृथा कृतः //
text_mt: Hearing Dharmāṅgada’s words, Mohinī spoke: / 'Your father is a liar, my son, by whom his right hand—

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ karttā sukṛtaṃ bhūri raktāśokākṛtiḥ sthitaḥ /
dhvajāṅkuśāṅkitaḥ śrīmāndakṣiṇaḥ kanakāṅgadaḥ //
meaning:
यः कर्त्ता सुकृतं भूरि रक्ताशोकाकृतिः स्थितः /
ध्वजाङ्कुशाङ्कितः श्रीमान्दक्षिणः कनकाङ्गदः //
text_mt: the doer of abundant merit, having the appearance of a red aśoka, / marked with a banner and an elephant-hook, splendid, adorned with a golden armlet—has been rendered in vain.

sanskrit_iast: rukmāṅgadena te pitrā na cāhaṃ vastumutsahe //
meaning: रुक्माङ्गदेन ते पित्रा न चाहं वस्तुमुत्सहे //
text_mt: And I have no wish to live with your father, Rukmāṅgada.'

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgada uvāca
yadvavīṣi vaco devi tatkarttāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
mā kopaṃ kuru mātastvaṃ nivarttatasva pituḥ priye //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गद उवाच
यद्ववीषि वचो देवि तत्कर्त्ताहं न संशयः /
मा कोपं कुरु मातस्त्वं निवर्त्ततस्व पितुः प्रिये //
text_mt: Dharmāṅgada said: / 'Whatever word you speak, O goddess, that I will perform without a doubt; / do not be angry, O mother! Turn back, O beloved of my father!'

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
anena samayenāhaṃ tvatpitrā mandarācale /
kṛtā bhāryā śivaḥ sākṣye sthito yatra surādhipaḥ //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
अनेन समयेनाहं त्वत्पित्रा मन्दराचले /
कृता भार्या शिवः साक्ष्ये स्थितो यत्र सुराधिपः //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / 'On this condition I was made a wife by your father on Mount Mandara, / where Śiva, the lord of gods, stood as witness:

sanskrit_iast:
samayātsa cyutaḥ samyakpitā te rukmabhūpaṇaḥ /
na prayacchati me deyaṃ tasya vṛddhiṃ vicintaye //
meaning:
समयात्स च्युतः सम्यक्पिता ते रुक्मभूपणः /
न प्रयच्छति मे देयं तस्य वृद्धिं विचिन्तये //
text_mt: he has fallen completely from that agreement, your father, adorned with gold; / he does not grant me what is to be given, while I consider his prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
na yāce kāñcanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvaṃ grāmavāsasī /
yena tasya bhaveddhānirna yāce tannṛpātmaja //
meaning:
न याचे काञ्चनं धान्यं हस्त्यश्वं ग्रामवाससी /
येन तस्य भवेद्धानिर्न याचे तन्नृपात्मज //
text_mt: I do not ask for gold, grain, elephants, horses, a village, or clothing; / that by which loss would come to him, I do not ask for that, O prince.

sanskrit_iast:
yenāsau prīṇayeddehaṃ svakīyaṃ dehināṃ vara /
tanmayā prārthitaṃ putra sa mohānna prayacchati //
meaning:
येनासौ प्रीणयेद्देहं स्वकीयं देहिनां वर /
तन्मया प्रार्थितं पुत्र स मोहान्न प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: That by which he may gratify his own body, O best of embodied beings— / that has been requested by me, O son; out of delusion he does not grant it.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva copakārāya śarīrasya nṛpātmaja /
yācitaḥ sukhahetostu mayā nṛpatisattamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव चोपकाराय शरीरस्य नृपात्मज /
याचितः सुखहेतोस्तु मया नृपतिसत्तमः //
text_mt: Indeed, for the benefit of that very body, O prince, / for the sake of happiness, the best of kings was asked by me.

sanskrit_iast: sthitaḥ so 'dyānṛte ghore surāpānasame vibhuḥ //
meaning: स्थितः सो ऽद्यानृते घोरे सुरापानसमे विभुः //
text_mt: Today the powerful king stands in terrible falsehood, which is equal to drinking liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
satyacyutaṃ niṣṭhuravākyabhāṣiṇaṃ vimuktadharmaṃ tvanṛtaṃ śaṭhaṃ ca /
parityajeyaṃ janakaṃ tavādhamaṃ naiva sthitirme bhavitā hi tena //
meaning:
सत्यच्युतं निष्ठुरवाक्यभाषिणं विमुक्तधर्मं त्वनृतं शठं च /
परित्यजेयं जनकं तवाधमं नैव स्थितिर्मे भविता हि तेन //
text_mt: Fallen from truth, speaking harsh words, abandoning righteousness, false, and deceitful— / I shall abandon your vile father; my stay with him shall never be!'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā mohinīvākyaṃ putro dharmāṅgado 'bravīt /
mayi jīvati tāto me na bhavedanṛtī kvacit //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा मोहिनीवाक्यं पुत्रो धर्माङ्गदो ऽब्रवीत् /
मयि जीवति तातो मे न भवेदनृती क्वचित् //
text_mt: Hearing those words of Mohinī, the son Dharmāṅgada said: / 'While I am alive, my father shall never be a liar.

sanskrit_iast:
nivartasva varārohe kariṣye 'haṃ tavepsitam /
pitrā me nānṛtaṃ devi pūrvamuktaṃ kadācana //
meaning:
निवर्तस्व वरारोहे करिष्ये ऽहं तवेप्सितम् /
पित्रा मे नानृतं देवि पूर्वमुक्तं कदाचन //
text_mt: Turn back, O woman of shapely hips! I will fulfill your desire. / An untruth has never before been spoken by my father, O goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ mayi jāte tu vadiṣyati mahīpatiḥ /
yasya satye sthitā lokāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ //
meaning:
स कथं मयि जाते तु वदिष्यति महीपतिः /
यस्य सत्ये स्थिता लोकाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः //
text_mt: How could that lord of the earth speak [an untruth] when I am born [as his son], / he in whose truth the worlds abide, together with gods, asuras, and humans?

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatagṛhaṃ yena kṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ hi pāpibhiḥ /
vijṛṃbhate yasya kīrtirvyāptaṃ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
वैवस्वतगृहं येन कृतं शून्यं हि पापिभिः /
विजृंभते यस्य कीर्तिर्व्याप्तं ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् //
text_mt: By whom the abode of Yama has been rendered completely empty of sinners, / whose fame blazes forth, pervading the circle of the cosmic egg—

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ jāyate bhūpo mithyāvacanasaṃsthitaḥ /
aśrutaṃ bhūpatervākyaṃ parokṣe śraddadhe katham //
meaning:
स कथं जायते भूपो मिथ्यावचनसंस्थितः /
अश्रुतं भूपतेर्वाक्यं परोक्षे श्रद्दधे कथम् //
text_mt: how could that king become one established in false words? / How can I believe words of the king that are unheard [by me] in his absence?

sanskrit_iast:
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā nivartasva śubhānane /
etaddharmāṅgadenoktaṃ vākyamākarṇya mohinī //
meaning:
ममोपरि दयां कृत्वा निवर्तस्व शुभानने /
एतद्धर्माङ्गदेनोक्तं वाक्यमाकर्ण्य मोहिनी //
text_mt: Showing compassion toward me, turn back, O fair-faced woman!' / Having heard this speech uttered by Dharmāṅgada, Mohinī

sanskrit_iast:
nyavartata mahīpālaputraskandhāvalaṃbinī /
yatra rukmāṅgadaḥ śete mṛtakalpo raviprabhaḥ //
meaning:
न्यवर्तत महीपालपुत्रस्कन्धावलंबिनी /
यत्र रुक्माङ्गदः शेते मृतकल्पो रविप्रभः //
text_mt: turned back, leaning on the shoulder of the prince, / to where Rukmāṅgada lay like a dead man, though radiant as the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminniveśayāmāsa śayane kāñcanānvite /
dīparatnaiḥ suprakāśe vidrumaiścitrite vare //
meaning:
तस्मिन्निवेशयामास शयने काञ्चनान्विते /
दीपरत्नैः सुप्रकाशे विद्रुमैश्चित्रिते वरे //
text_mt: She had him placed upon that bed adorned with gold, / brightly illuminated with jewel-lamps, wonderfully decorated with coral, excellent,

sanskrit_iast:
ākhaṇḍalāstramaṇibhiḥ kṛtapāde sukomale /
dīrghavistārasaṃyukte hyanaupamye manohare //
meaning:
आखण्डलास्त्रमणिभिः कृतपादे सुकोमले /
दीर्घविस्तारसंयुक्ते ह्यनौपम्ये मनोहरे //
text_mt: with legs fashioned of diamonds, very soft, / endowed with great length and breadth, peerless and charming.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ prāhapitaraṃ ślakṣṇayā girā /
tātaiṣā jananī me 'dya tvāṃ vadatyanṛtī tviti //
meaning:
ततः कृताञ्जलिः प्राहपितरं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा /
तातैषा जननी मे ऽद्य त्वां वदत्यनृती त्विति //
text_mt: Then, with folded palms, he spoke to his father in gentle words: / "Father, this mother of mine says today that you are a liar.

sanskrit_iast:
kasmāttvamanṛtī bhūpa bhaviṣyasi mahītale /
sakoṣaratnanicaye gajāśvarathasaṃyute //
meaning:
कस्मात्त्वमनृती भूप भविष्यसि महीतले /
सकोषरत्ननिचये गजाश्वरथसंयुते //
text_mt: Why should you become a liar on earth, O king, / while the kingdom is being ruled [by you],

sanskrit_iast:
rājye praśāsyamāne tu saptodadhisamanvite /
pradehi sakalaṃ hyasyai yattyā śrāvitaṃ vibho //
meaning:
राज्ये प्रशास्यमाने तु सप्तोदधिसमन्विते /
प्रदेहि सकलं ह्यस्यै यत्त्या श्रावितं विभो //
text_mt: replete with treasury and heaps of gems, accompanied by elephants, horses, and chariots, / and endowed with the seven oceans? Grant her entirely, O lord, whatever was promised by you!

sanskrit_iast:
mayi cāpadhare tāta ko vyalīkaṃ carettava /
dehi śakrapadaṃ devyai jitaṃ viddhi purandaram //
meaning:
मयि चापधरे तात को व्यलीकं चरेत्तव /
देहि शक्रपदं देव्यै जितं विद्धि पुरन्दरम् //
text_mt: While I bear the bow, father, who would act falsely toward you? / Give the queen the station of Indra; know Purandara to be conquered!

sanskrit_iast:
vairiñcyaṃ durllabhaṃ yacca yogigamyaṃ nirañjanam /
taccāpyahaṃ pradāsyāmi tapasā toṣya padmajam //
meaning:
वैरिञ्च्यं दुर्ल्लभं यच्च योगिगम्यं निरञ्जनम् /
तच्चाप्यहं प्रदास्यामि तपसा तोष्य पद्मजम् //
text_mt: Even the status of Brahmā, which is hard to attain, accessible only to yogins, and untainted— / even that I will grant after pleasing the lotus-born [Brahmā] through asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
samīhate yajjananī madīyā rasātale vāpi dharātale vā /
triviṣṭape vāpi pare pade vā dāsyāmi jitvā naradevadānavān //
meaning:
समीहते यज्जननी मदीया रसातले वापि धरातले वा /
त्रिविष्टपे वापि परे पदे वा दास्यामि जित्वा नरदेवदानवान् //
text_mt: Whatever my mother desires—whether in the netherworld, on earth, / in heaven, or in the supreme abode—I shall grant it after conquering men, gods, and Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ hi dāsastava bhūpa yasmādvikrīyatāṃ māmathavā tṛṇāya /
haste hi pāpasya divāprakīrtervatsyāmi tatkarmakaraḥ subhuktaḥ //
meaning:
अहं हि दासस्तव भूप यस्माद्विक्रीयतां मामथवा तृणाय /
हस्ते हि पापस्य दिवाप्रकीर्तेर्वत्स्यामि तत्कर्मकरः सुभुक्तः //
text_mt: Indeed, I am your servant, O king; therefore, sell me, even for a blade of grass! / Into the hands of a sinner, a Caṇḍāla, I will dwell as his laborer, fed on his remnants.

sanskrit_iast:
yadduṣkaraṃ bhūmipate trilokyāṃ nādeyamastīha tadiṣṭaṃbhāvāt /
taccāpi rājendra dadasva devyai majjīvitaṃ majjananībhavaṃ vā //
meaning:
यद्दुष्करं भूमिपते त्रिलोक्यां नादेयमस्तीह तदिष्टंभावात् /
तच्चापि राजेन्द्र ददस्व देव्यै मज्जीवितं मज्जननीभवं वा //
text_mt: Whatever is difficult to do in the three worlds, O lord of earth, nothing is impossible to give here out of affection; / O best of kings, give that too to the queen—whether my life, or what belongs to my mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva sadyo nṛpanātha loke satkīrtiyukto bhava sarvadaiva /
virājayitvā svaguṇairnṛpaughānkarairivātmaprabhavaiḥ khaśobhaiḥ //
meaning:
तेनैव सद्यो नृपनाथ लोके सत्कीर्तियुक्तो भव सर्वदैव /
विराजयित्वा स्वगुणैर्नृपौघान्करैरिवात्मप्रभवैः खशोभैः //
text_mt: By that alone, O lord of kings, be possessed of good renown at all times in the world, / outshining the hosts of kings through your virtues, as [the sun outshines the stars] through rays born of itself and adorning the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtiprabhaṅge vṛjinaṃ bhaviṣyati prajāvadhe yanmanurāha satyam /
saṃmārjayitvā vimalaṃ yaśaḥ svaṃ kathaṃ sukhī syāṃ nṛpate tataḥ kṣamaḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
कीर्तिप्रभङ्गे वृजिनं भविष्यति प्रजावधे यन्मनुराह सत्यम् /
संमार्जयित्वा विमलं यशः स्वं कथं सुखी स्यां नृपते ततः क्षमः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
When renown is destroyed, sin will arise, like that which Manu truthfully declared occurs at the slaughter of subjects; / having wiped away my own spotless fame, how could I be happy, O king, or be capable after that?"

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the Mohinīcarita of the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
kīrtirnaśyatu me putra hyanṛtī vā bhavāmyaham /
gato vā narakaṃ ghoraṃ kathaṃ bhokṣye harerdine //
meaning:
राजोवाच
कीर्तिर्नश्यतु मे पुत्र ह्यनृती वा भवाम्यहम् /
गतो वा नरकं घोरं कथं भोक्ष्ये हरेर्दिने //
title: athaṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The king said: / "Let my renown perish, O son, or let me become a liar, / or let me go to a dreadful hell—how can I eat on the day of Hari?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo nilayaṃ yātu devīyaṃ mohinī suta /
bhūyo bhūyo vadati māṃ durmedhāśca subāliśā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो निलयं यातु देवीयं मोहिनी सुत /
भूयो भूयो वदति मां दुर्मेधाश्च सुबालिशा //
text_mt: Let this queen Mohinī go to the abode of Brahmā, O son! / Again and again she speaks to me, evil-minded and utterly foolish.

sanskrit_iast:
nāparaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ vasudhāṃ vasu kiñcana /
muktvaivaṃ vāsare viṣṇorbhojanaṃ pāpanāśane //
meaning:
नापरं कामये राज्यं वसुधां वसु किञ्चन /
मुक्त्वैवं वासरे विष्णोर्भोजनं पापनाशने //
text_mt: I desire no other kingdom, no land, and no wealth whatever; / having renounced that, [she demands] eating on the sin-destroying day of Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast:
yadyahaṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ vrajeyaṃ krimisaṃjñitām /
tathāpi naiva kartāhaṃ bhojanaṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
यद्यहं कुत्सितां योनिं व्रजेयं क्रिमिसंज्ञिताम् /
तथापि नैव कर्ताहं भोजनं हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Even if I should go to a vile womb, known as that of a worm, / even so I will never eat on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā gurutarā bhūtvā lokānāṃ śikṣayānvitā /
dundubhī kurvatī nādaṃ sā kathaṃ vitathā bhavet //
meaning:
एषा गुरुतरा भूत्वा लोकानां शिक्षयान्विता /
दुन्दुभी कुर्वती नादं सा कथं वितथा भवेत् //
text_mt: Having become most authoritative, endowed with instruction for the worlds, / how could that kettledrum, sending forth its sound, be made false?

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā agamyāgamanaṃ tathā /
apeyaṃ caiva pītvā tu kiṃ jīveccharadaḥ śatam //
meaning:
अभक्ष्यभक्षणं कृत्वा अगम्यागमनं तथा /
अपेयं चैव पीत्वा तु किं जीवेच्छरदः शतम् //
text_mt: Having eaten what should not be eaten, having approached [a woman] who should not be approached, / and having drunk what should not be drunk—would one live for a hundred autumns?

sanskrit_iast:
asatyaṃ vāpi kṛtvāhaṃ tyaktarājyanayaḥ kṣitau /
dhikkṛto 'pi janaiḥ sarvairna bhokṣye harivāsare //
meaning:
असत्यं वापि कृत्वाहं त्यक्तराज्यनयः क्षितौ /
धिक्कृतो ऽपि जनैः सर्वैर्न भोक्ष्ये हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Even if I commit falsehood and abandon the conduct of kingship on earth, / even if reviled by all people, I will not eat on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
viyoge capalāpāṅgyā yadi cenmaraṇaṃ mama /
taccāpi varamevātra na bhokṣye harivāsare //
meaning:
वियोगे चपलापाङ्ग्या यदि चेन्मरणं मम /
तच्चापि वरमेवात्र न भोक्ष्ये हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Even if my death should occur from separation from this woman of tremulous sidelong glances, / even that is preferable here; I will not eat on the day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ harṣamahaṃ kartā mārtaṇḍatanayasya vai /
vrajadbhirmanujairmārge nirayasyātiduḥkhitaiḥ //
meaning:
कथं हर्षमहं कर्ता मार्तण्डतनयस्य वै /
व्रजद्भिर्मनुजैर्मार्गे निरयस्यातिदुःखितैः //
text_mt: How could I cause joy to the son of the Sun / by having men, exceedingly miserable, march along the path to hell?

sanskrit_iast:
yāstu śūnyāḥ kṛtāstāta mayā narakapaṅktayaḥ /
janaiḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyanti mayi bhukte tu tāḥ suta //
meaning:
यास्तु शून्याः कृतास्तात मया नरकपङ्क्तयः /
जनैः पूर्णा भविष्यन्ति मयि भुक्ते तु ताः सुत //
text_mt: The rows of hells that were made empty by me, O dear child, / will be filled with people, O son, if I should eat.

sanskrit_iast:
māsma sīmantinī putra kukṣau saṃdhārayetsutam /
samartho yastu śatrūṇāṃ harṣaṃ saṃjanayedbhuvi //
meaning:
मास्म सीमन्तिनी पुत्र कुक्षौ संधारयेत्सुतम् /
समर्थो यस्तु शत्रूणां हर्षं संजनयेद्भुवि //
text_mt: Let no woman, O son, bear a son in her womb / who, though capable, causes joy to his enemies on earth!

sanskrit_iast:
bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇoretadeva hiyācate /
tanna dāsyāmi mohinyā yācito 'pi surāsuraiḥ //
meaning:
भोजनं वासरे विष्णोरेतदेव हियाचते /
तन्न दास्यामि मोहिन्या याचितो ऽपि सुरासुरैः //
text_mt: Eating on the day of Viṣṇu—this alone she asks for; / that I will not give to Mohinī, even if entreated by gods and Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
pibedviṣaṃ viśedvahniṃ nipatetparvatāgrataḥ /
ākāśabhāsā svaśiraśchindyādeva varāsinā //
meaning:
पिबेद्विषं विशेद्वह्निं निपतेत्पर्वताग्रतः /
आकाशभासा स्वशिरश्छिन्द्यादेव वरासिना //
text_mt: One might drink poison, enter fire, fall from the top of a mountain, / or cut off one's own head with an excellent sword gleaming like the sky;

sanskrit_iast:
na bhokṣyate haridine rājā rukmāṅgadaḥ kṣitau /
rukmāṅgadeti mannāma prasiddhaṃ bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
न भोक्ष्यते हरिदिने राजा रुक्माङ्गदः क्षितौ /
रुक्माङ्गदेति मन्नाम प्रसिद्धं भुवनत्रये //
text_mt: king Rukmāṅgada will not eat on the day of Hari on earth! / My name Rukmāṅgada is renowned throughout the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyupavāsena tanmayā saṃcitaṃ yaśaḥ /
sa kathaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtvā nāśaye svakṛtaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
एकादश्युपवासेन तन्मया संचितं यशः /
स कथं भोजनं कृत्वा नाशये स्वकृतं यशः //
text_mt: by fasting on the Ekādaśī, that fame was accumulated by me. / How, by eating, could I destroy my own accumulated renown?

sanskrit_iast:
mriyate yadi vā gacchati nipatati naśyecca khaṇḍaśo vāpi /
viramati tadapi na ceto māmakamiti mohinīhetoḥ //
meaning:
म्रियते यदि वा गच्छति निपतति नश्येच्च खण्डशो वापि /
विरमति तदपि न चेतो मामकमिति मोहिनीहेतोः //
text_mt: Whether she dies, or departs, or falls down, or perishes in pieces, / even then my mind does not turn back on account of Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
parityajāmyeṣa nijaṃ hi jīvitaṃ lokaiḥ sametaḥ sahadārabhṛtyaiḥ /
na tveva kuryāṃ madhusūdanasya dine supuṇye 'nnaniṣevaṇaṃ hi //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite ṣaḍvaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
परित्यजाम्येष निजं हि जीवितं लोकैः समेतः सहदारभृत्यैः /
न त्वेव कुर्यां मधुसूदनस्य दिने सुपुण्ये ऽन्ननिषेवणं हि //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते षड्वविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
I shall abandon my own life together with the people, with my wife, and with my servants; / but never will I partake of food on the holy day of Madhusūdana!"

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the Mohinīcarita of the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
adastadā /
āhūya jananīṃ śīghraṃ nāmnā saṃdhyāvalīṃ śubhām //
meaning:
अदस्तदा /
आहूय जननीं शीघ्रं नाम्ना संध्यावलीं शुभाम् //
text_mt: [Dharmāṅgada spoke] this then, / having quickly summoned his mother, the auspicious one named Saṃdhyāvalī,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāyuta samaprakhyāṃ tejasā rucirastanām /
pālayantīṃ dharāṃ sarvāṃ pādavinyāsavikramaiḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यायुत समप्रख्यां तेजसा रुचिरस्तनाम् /
पालयन्तीं धरां सर्वां पादविन्यासविक्रमैः //
text_mt: resembling ten thousand suns, charming of breasts through splendor, / protecting the entire earth by the strides of her footsteps.

sanskrit_iast:
putrasya vacanātprāptā tatkṣaṇaṃ nṛpasannidhau /
śrāvitā mohinī vākyaṃ piturvākyaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
पुत्रस्य वचनात्प्राप्ता तत्क्षणं नृपसन्निधौ /
श्राविता मोहिनी वाक्यं पितुर्वाक्यं तथैव च //
text_mt: Arriving that very moment near the king at the word of her son, / she was informed of the speech of Mohinī and likewise of the speech of his father.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayoḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā parisāṃtvayya mohinīm /
bhojanāya sthitāmenāṃ nṛpasya harivāsare //
meaning:
उभयोः संविदं कृत्वा परिसांत्वय्य मोहिनीम् /
भोजनाय स्थितामेनां नृपस्य हरिवासरे //
text_mt: Having arranged an agreement between the two, having consoled Mohinī / who was insisting on the king's eating on the day of Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā no cyavate satyādyathā bhuṅkte na me pitā /
tathā vidhīyatāmevaṃ kuśalaṃ cobhayorbhavet //
meaning:
यथा नो च्यवते सत्याद्यथा भुङ्क्ते न मे पिता /
तथा विधीयतामेवं कुशलं चोभयोर्भवेत् //
text_mt: "In such a way that he does not fall from truth, and in such a way that my father does not eat, / let it be arranged thus, so that there may be well-being for both."

sanskrit_iast:
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā devī saṃdhyāvalī nṛpa /
mohinīṃ ślakṣṇayā vācā prāha brahmasutā tadā //
meaning:
तत्पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा देवी संध्यावली नृप /
मोहिनीं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा प्राह ब्रह्मसुता तदा //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of her son, Queen Saṃdhyāvalī, O king, / the daughter of Brahmā, then spoke to Mohinī in gentle words:

sanskrit_iast:
māgrahaṃ kuru vāmoru kathañcidapi bhūpatiḥ /
nāsvādayati pāpānna saṃprāpte harivāsare //
meaning:
माग्रहं कुरु वामोरु कथञ्चिदपि भूपतिः /
नास्वादयति पापान्न संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे //
text_mt: "Do not be obstinate, O fair-thighed one! Under no circumstances does the lord of earth / partake of food made of sin when the day of Hari arrives.

sanskrit_iast:
anuvartaya rājāna gurureṣa sanātanaḥ /
sadā bhavati yā nārī bharturvacanakāriṇī //
meaning:
अनुवर्तय राजान गुरुरेष सनातनः /
सदा भवति या नारी भर्तुर्वचनकारिणी //
text_mt: Comply with the king! He is the eternal elder. / Whatever woman is always obedient to the command of her husband,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ syurakṣayayā lokāḥ sāvitryāstu yathāmalāḥ /
yadyanena purā devi tava dattaḥ karo girau //
meaning:
तस्याः स्युरक्षयया लोकाः सावित्र्यास्तु यथामलाः /
यद्यनेन पुरा देवि तव दत्तः करो गिरौ //
text_mt: imperishable worlds belong to her, spotless like those of Sāvitrī. / If formerly by him, O queen, his hand was given to you on the mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmārtena vimūḍhena tanna yo 'gyaṃ vicintitam /
yaddeyaṃ taddadātyeṣa hyadeyaṃ prārthayasva mā //
meaning:
कामार्तेन विमूढेन तन्न यो ऽग्यं विचिन्तितम् /
यद्देयं तद्ददात्येष ह्यदेयं प्रार्थयस्व मा //
text_mt: distressed by desire and bewildered, he did not consider what was proper. / What can be given, he gives; do not ask for what cannot be given!

sanskrit_iast:
vipattirapi bhadraiva sanmārge saṃsthitasya tu /
na bhuktaṃ yena subhage śaiśave 'pi harerdine //
meaning:
विपत्तिरपि भद्रैव सन्मार्गे संस्थितस्य तु /
न भुक्तं येन सुभगे शैशवे ऽपि हरेर्दिने //
text_mt: Even misfortune is auspicious for one who abides on the path of the good. / By whom food was not eaten on the day of Hari even in childhood, O blessed lady,

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ bhokṣyate puṇye mādhavasya dine 'dhunā /
kāmaṃ varaya vāmoruvaramanyaṃ sudurlabham //
meaning:
स कथं भोक्ष्यते पुण्ये माधवस्य दिने ऽधुना /
कामं वरय वामोरुवरमन्यं सुदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: how will he eat now on the holy day of Mādhava? / Choose at will, O fair-thighed one, another boon that is exceedingly hard to obtain!

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dadātyeva bhūpālo nivṛttā bhava bhojane /
manyase yadi māṃ devi dharmāṅgadavirohiṇīm //
meaning:
तं ददात्येव भूपालो निवृत्ता भव भोजने /
मन्यसे यदि मां देवि धर्माङ्गदविरोहिणीम् //
text_mt: The lord of earth will indeed give it; turn away from [demanding] eating! / If, O queen, you consider me hostile to Dharmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast:
asmajjīvitasaṃyuktaṃ rājyaṃ varaya suvrate /
saptadvīpasametaṃ hi sasaridvanaparvatam //
meaning:
अस्मज्जीवितसंयुक्तं राज्यं वरय सुव्रते /
सप्तद्वीपसमेतं हि ससरिद्वनपर्वतम् //
text_mt: choose the kingdom along with our lives, O woman of good vows, / endowed with the seven continents, together with rivers, forests, and mountains!

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhāyā variṣṭhāhaṃ kariṣye pādavandanam /
bharturarthe viśālākṣi prasīda tanumadhyame //
meaning:
कनिष्ठाया वरिष्ठाहं करिष्ये पादवन्दनम् /
भर्तुरर्थे विशालाक्षि प्रसीद तनुमध्यमे //
text_mt: I, the senior, will perform the salutation to the feet of the junior! / For the sake of our husband, O large-eyed one, be gracious, O slender-waisted lady!

sanskrit_iast:
vācā śapathadoṣaistu saṃnirudhya patiṃ hi yā /
akāryaṃ kārayetpāpā sā nārī niraye vaset //
meaning:
वाचा शपथदोषैस्तु संनिरुध्य पतिं हि या /
अकार्यं कारयेत्पापा सा नारी निरये वसेत् //
text_mt: Whatever sinful woman, binding her husband by speech with the faults of oaths, / causes him to do what ought not to be done—she shall dwell in hell.

sanskrit_iast:
sā cyutā narakāddhorātsaptajanmāni pañca ca /
sūkarīṃ yonimāpnoti cāṇḍālīṃ ca tataḥ param //
meaning:
सा च्युता नरकाद्धोरात्सप्तजन्मानि पञ्च च /
सूकरीं योनिमाप्नोति चाण्डालीं च ततः परम् //
text_mt: Falling from dreadful hell, for twelve births / she attains the womb of a sow, and after that, the womb of a Caṇḍāla woman."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā mayā devi vikriyāṃ pāpasaṃbhavām /
nivāritāsi vāmoru sakhībhāvena suṃdari //
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा मया देवि विक्रियां पापसंभवाम् /
निवारितासि वामोरु सखीभावेन सुंदरि //
text_mt: Knowing this, O queen, this sinful change / was averted by me, O fair-thighed one, out of friendship, O beautiful lady.

sanskrit_iast:
vipakṣasyāpi sadbuddhirdātavyā dharmamicchatā /
kiṃ punaḥ sakhisaṃsthāyāstava padmanibhānane //
meaning:
विपक्षस्यापि सद्बुद्धिर्दातव्या धर्ममिच्छता /
किं पुनः सखिसंस्थायास्तव पद्मनिभानने //
text_mt: Good counsel should be given even to an adversary by one who desires righteousness; / how much more to you who stand as a friend, O lotus-faced one?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyā valīvacaḥ śrutvā mohinī mohakāriṇī /
uvāca kanakābhāṃ tāṃ bharturjyeṣṭhāṃ priyāṃ tadā //
meaning:
संध्या वलीवचः श्रुत्वा मोहिनी मोहकारिणी /
उवाच कनकाभां तां भर्तुर्ज्येष्ठां प्रियां तदा //
text_mt: Hearing the words of Saṃdhyāvalī, the bewitching Mohinī / then spoke to that golden-complexioned woman, the king's senior and beloved wife:

sanskrit_iast:
mānanīyāsi me subhru karomi vacanaṃ tava /
vidvadbhirmunibhiryyattu gīyate nāradādibhiḥ //
meaning:
माननीयासि मे सुभ्रु करोमि वचनं तव /
विद्वद्भिर्मुनिभिर्य्यत्तु गीयते नारदादिभिः //
text_mt: "You are venerable to me, O woman of lovely brows; I shall heed your word. / But as for that which is proclaimed by the wise sages, by Nārada and the rest:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tannācaredrājā bhojanaṃ harivāsare /
kriyatāmaparaṃ devi maraṇādadhikaṃ tava //
meaning:
यदि तन्नाचरेद्राजा भोजनं हरिवासरे /
क्रियतामपरं देवि मरणादधिकं तव //
text_mt: If the king does not eat on the day of Hari, / then let another [choice], worse than death, be made by you, O queen!

sanskrit_iast:
mamāpi duḥkhadaṃhyetaddaivājjalpāmyahaṃ śubhe /
kasyeṣṭamātmahananaṃ kasyeṣṭaṃ viṣabhakṣaṇam //
meaning:
ममापि दुःखदंह्येतद्दैवाज्जल्पाम्यहं शुभे /
कस्येष्टमात्महननं कस्येष्टं विषभक्षणम् //
text_mt: This is distressing even to me; by fate alone do I speak, O auspicious one. / For who desires suicide? Who desires to drink poison?

sanskrit_iast:
patanaṃ vā girermūrdhraḥ krīḍā vāpi bileśayaiḥ /
vyāghrasiṃhābhigamanaṃ samudrataraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
पतनं वा गिरेर्मूर्ध्रः क्रीडा वापि बिलेशयैः /
व्याघ्रसिंहाभिगमनं समुद्रतरणं तथा //
text_mt: Or jumping from the top of a mountain, or playing with creatures that dwell in holes, / or approaching tigers and lions, or crossing the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
daruktānṛtavākyaṃ vā paradārābhimarśanam /
apathyabhakṣaṇaṃ loke tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇam //
meaning:
दरुक्तानृतवाक्यं वा परदाराभिमर्शनम् /
अपथ्यभक्षणं लोके तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षणम् //
text_mt: or harsh speech, untruthful words, or touching another's wife, / or eating unwholesome food in this world, or eating what is forbidden to eat,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgāṭanamathākṣairvā krīḍanaṃ sāhasaṃ tathā /
chedanaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhānāṃ loṣṭānāmavamarddanam //
meaning:
मृगाटनमथाक्षैर्वा क्रीडनं साहसं तथा /
छेदनं तृणकाष्ठानां लोष्टानामवमर्द्दनम् //
text_mt: or hunting, or gambling with dice, or acts of rashness, / or chopping grass and wood, or crushing clods of earth,

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsanaṃ sūkṣmadevānāṃ jalapāvakakhelanam /
daivāviṣṭo varārohe naraḥ sarvaṃ karoti vai //
meaning:
हिंसनं सूक्ष्मदेवानां जलपावकखेलनम् /
दैवाविष्टो वरारोहे नरः सर्वं करोति वै //
text_mt: or injuring minute deities, or playing with fire and water? / Driven by fate, O shapely lady, a man indeed commits all these [sins]

sanskrit_iast:
trivargavicyutaṃ ghoraṃ yaśodehaharaṃ kṣitau /
narakārhe naro devi karotyaśubhakarma tat //
meaning:
त्रिवर्गविच्युतं घोरं यशोदेहहरं क्षितौ /
नरकार्हे नरो देवि करोत्यशुभकर्म तत् //
text_mt: which lead away from the three aims of life, are terrifying, and destroy one's fame and body on earth. / A man performs that inauspicious deed which makes him fit for hell, O queen.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaṃ pāpā durācārā vaktukāmā sunirghṛṇam /
yādṛśena hi bhāvena yonau śukraṃ samutsṛjet //
meaning:
साहं पापा दुराचारा वक्तुकामा सुनिर्घृणम् /
यादृशेन हि भावेन योनौ शुक्रं समुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt: Such a sinful, ill-behaved woman am I, wishing to speak with utmost cruelty. / For with whatever disposition one emits seed into the womb,

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśena hi bhāvena saṃtānaṃ saṃbhavediti /
sāhaṃ vivādabhāvena rājño rukmāṅgadasya hi //
meaning:
तादृशेन हि भावेन संतानं संभवेदिति /
साहं विवादभावेन राज्ञो रुक्माङ्गदस्य हि //
text_mt: with just such a disposition is the offspring born. / Thus, out of a disposition of discord towards King Rukmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast:
jātā jalajajātena strīrūpā varavarṇinī /
duṣṭabhāvā tathā jātā kartrī duṣṭaṃ nṛpasya tu //
meaning:
जाता जलजजातेन स्त्रीरूपा वरवर्णिनी /
दुष्टभावा तथा जाता कर्त्री दुष्टं नृपस्य तु //
text_mt: I was born from the Lotus-born [Brahmā] as a woman of exquisite beauty, / and thus born with a wicked nature, destined to bring ruin upon the king.

sanskrit_iast:
na lagnaṃ na grahā devi na horā puṇyadarśinī /
tatkālabhāvanā grāhyā tadbhāvo jāyate sutaḥ //
meaning:
न लग्नं न ग्रहा देवि न होरा पुण्यदर्शिनी /
तत्कालभावना ग्राह्या तद्भावो जायते सुतः //
text_mt: Neither the ascendant, nor the planets, O queen, nor the auspicious astrological hour determines this; / the mindset of that moment must be understood, for the child is born having that disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
tena bhāvena jātasya dākṣiṇyaṃ nopapadyate /
na ca vrīḍā na ca sneho na dharmo devi vidyate //
meaning:
तेन भावेन जातस्य दाक्षिण्यं नोपपद्यते /
न च व्रीडा न च स्नेहो न धर्मो देवि विद्यते //
text_mt: For one born of such a disposition, courtesy does not arise; / neither shame nor affection nor righteousness is found, O queen.

sanskrit_iast: jānannapi yathāyuktastaṃ bhāvamanuvartate //
meaning: जानन्नपि यथायुक्तस्तं भावमनुवर्तते //
text_mt: Even while knowing, one conforms to that disposition according to how one is constituted.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣye vacaḥ prāṇaharaṃ tavādhunā bhartuḥ salokasya vadhūjanasya /
dharmāpahaṃ vācyakaraṃ mamāpi kartuṃ na śakyaṃ manasāpi bhīru //
meaning:
वक्ष्ये वचः प्राणहरं तवाधुना भर्तुः सलोकस्य वधूजनस्य /
धर्मापहं वाच्यकरं ममापि कर्तुं न शक्यं मनसापि भीरु //
text_mt: I shall now speak words that will snatch away the life of your husband, together with his people and womenfolk, / destroying righteousness and bringing infamy upon me too—words impossible even to conceive in thought, O timid one.

sanskrit_iast:
karoṣi vākyaṃ yadi māmakaṃ hi bhavecca kīrtirmahatīha loke /
bharturyaśaḥ syāttridive gatiste putre praśaṃsā mama dhigvivādaḥ //
meaning:
करोषि वाक्यं यदि मामकं हि भवेच्च कीर्तिर्महतीह लोके /
भर्तुर्यशः स्यात्त्रिदिवे गतिस्ते पुत्रे प्रशंसा मम धिग्विवादः //
text_mt: Yet if you fulfill my word, great renown will be yours in this world; / fame will belong to your husband, your destination will be heaven, your son will receive praise, and shame will fall on my quarrel!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
mohinīvacanaṃ śrutvā devī saṃdhyāvalī vibho /
dhairyamālaṃbya tāṃ tanvīṃ brūhi brūhītyacodayat //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
मोहिनीवचनं श्रुत्वा देवी संध्यावली विभो /
धैर्यमालंब्य तां तन्वीं ब्रूहि ब्रूहीत्यचोदयत् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing Mohinī's words, O lord, Queen Saṃdhyāvalī / summoned her courage and urged that slender woman, saying, "Speak! Speak!"

sanskrit_iast:
kīdṛśaṃ vadase vākyaṃ yena duḥkhaṃ bhavenmama /
bharturme satyakaraṇe na duḥkhaṃ jāyate kvacit /
ātmano nidhane vāpi putrasya nidhane 'pi vā /
bharturarthe prakurvantyā rājyanāśe na me vyathā //
meaning:
कीदृशं वदसे वाक्यं येन दुःखं भवेन्मम /
भर्तुर्मे सत्यकरणे न दुःखं जायते क्वचित् /
आत्मनो निधने वापि पुत्रस्य निधने ऽपि वा /
भर्तुरर्थे प्रकुर्वन्त्या राज्यनाशे न मे व्यथा //
text_mt: "What kind of word do you speak that could cause me grief? / When upholding the truth of my husband, grief never arises anywhere for me. / In my own death or in the death of my son, / or in the loss of the kingdom for my husband's sake, I feel no anguish.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyā duḥkhī bhavedbhartā bhāryāyā varavārṇinī /
samṛddhāyāḥ sapāpāyāstasyāḥ proktā hyadhogatiḥ //
meaning:
यस्या दुःखी भवेद्भर्ता भार्याया वरवार्णिनी /
समृद्धायाः सपापायास्तस्याः प्रोक्ता ह्यधोगतिः //
text_mt: That wife whose husband is distressed, O lady of fair complexion, / while she herself is prosperous, is sinful and said to go to a lowly state.

sanskrit_iast:
sā yāti narakaṃ pāpā pūyākhyaṃ yugasaptatim /
tataśchuchundarī syācca sapta janmāni bhārate //
meaning:
सा याति नरकं पापा पूयाख्यं युगसप्ततिम् /
ततश्छुछुन्दरी स्याच्च सप्त जन्मानि भारते //
text_mt: That sinful woman goes to the hell named Pūya for seventy yugas; / after that, she becomes a musk-rat for seven lifetimes in Bhārata.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kākī tataḥ śyālī godhā gotvena śuddhyati /
bharturarthe tu yā vitteṃ vidyamānaṃ na yacchati //
meaning:
ततः काकी ततः श्याली गोधा गोत्वेन शुद्ध्यति /
भर्तुरर्थे तु या वित्तें विद्यमानं न यच्छति //
text_mt: Then she becomes a crow, then a jackal, then an iguana, and is purified by becoming a cow. / But she who does not give her existing wealth for her husband's sake,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitaṃ vā varārohe viṣṭhāyāṃ sā bhavetkrimiḥ /
krimiyonivinirmuktā kāṣṭhīlā jāyate śubhe //
meaning:
जीवितं वा वरारोहे विष्ठायां सा भवेत्क्रिमिः /
क्रिमियोनिविनिर्मुक्ता काष्ठीला जायते शुभे //
text_mt: or even her life, O shapely lady, becomes a worm in feces. / Freed from the womb of a worm, she is born as a wood-borer, O auspicious one.

sanskrit_iast:
mama kaumārabhāve tu matpituḥ kāṣṭhapāṭakaḥ /
agniprajvālanātha hi kāṣṭhaṃ pāṭayate ciram //
meaning:
मम कौमारभावे तु मत्पितुः काष्ठपाटकः /
अग्निप्रज्वालनाथ हि काष्ठं पाटयते चिरम् //
text_mt: In my childhood, a woodcutter of my father's / was splitting wood for a long time to kindle the sacrificial fires.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhībhiḥ sahitā cāhaṃ krīḍāsaṃsaktamānasā /
kāṣṭhaṃ pāṭayatastasya samīpamagamaṃ tadā //
meaning:
सखीभिः सहिता चाहं क्रीडासंसक्तमानसा /
काष्ठं पाटयतस्तस्य समीपमगमं तदा //
text_mt: Accompanied by my friends, my mind engrossed in play, / I then approached him as he was splitting the wood.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dṛṣṭā mayā subhru kāṣṭhīlā dārunirgatā /
navanītanibhaṃ dehaṃ bibhrāṇā cāñjanatviṣam //
meaning:
तत्र दृष्टा मया सुभ्रु काष्ठीला दारुनिर्गता /
नवनीतनिभं देहं बिभ्राणा चाञ्जनत्विषम् //
text_mt: There I saw, O fair-browed one, a wood-borer that had emerged from the timber, / possessing a body soft as fresh butter and dark as collyrium,

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhikāṅgulisamā sthaulye hyaṅgulimānikā /
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā patitāṃ bhūmau hantuṃ dhvāṅkṣaḥ samāgataḥ //
meaning:
कनिष्ठिकाङ्गुलिसमा स्थौल्ये ह्यङ्गुलिमानिका /
तां दृष्ट्वा पतितां भूमौ हन्तुं ध्वाङ्क्षः समागतः //
text_mt: equal to a little finger in thickness and measuring one finger-width. / Seeing it fallen to the ground, a crow came up to kill it.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadgṛhṇāti vaktreṇa kāṣṭhīlāṃ kṣudhitaḥ sa tu /
tāvannivāritaḥ sadyo mayā loṣṭena tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
यावद्गृह्णाति वक्त्रेण काष्ठीलां क्षुधितः स तु /
तावन्निवारितः सद्यो मया लोष्टेन तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: Just as the hungry crow was seizing the wood-borer with its beak, / it was instantly driven away by me with a clod of earth at that moment.

sanskrit_iast:
sā muktā tāḍitenetthaṃ vāyasena varānane /
sakṣatā tuṇḍasaṃspṛṣṭā na ca śaktā palāyitum //
meaning:
सा मुक्ता ताडितेनेत्थं वायसेन वरानने /
सक्षता तुण्डसंस्पृष्टा न च शक्ता पलायितुम् //
text_mt: Released in this way after being struck by the crow, O lady of fair face, / it was wounded, touched by the beak, and unable to flee.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā vepamānā tu prāṇatyāgamupāgamat /
siktā kiñcijjalainaiva tataḥ svāsthyamupāgatā //
meaning:
ततः सा वेपमाना तु प्राणत्यागमुपागमत् /
सिक्ता किञ्चिज्जलैनैव ततः स्वास्थ्यमुपागता //
text_mt: Then, trembling, it approached the point of death; / but sprinkled with a little water, it regained its composure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatataḥ sā mānuṣīvācā māmāha varavarṇinī /
saṃdhyāvalīti saṃbodhya sakhīmadhyasamāsthitām //
meaning:
तततः सा मानुषीवाचा मामाह वरवर्णिनी /
संध्यावलीति संबोध्य सखीमध्यसमास्थिताम् //
text_mt: Then that creature of fair hue addressed me in human speech, / calling me by name as 'Saṃdhyāvalī', as I stood in the midst of my friends:

sanskrit_iast:
sumantunāmno hi muneḥ sarvajñasya sutābhavam /
pūrvajanmani patnī ca kaiṇḍinyasya śubhānane //
meaning:
सुमन्तुनाम्नो हि मुनेः सर्वज्ञस्य सुताभवम् /
पूर्वजन्मनि पत्नी च कैण्डिन्यस्य शुभानने //
text_mt: 'I was the daughter of an omniscient sage named Sumantu, / and in my previous life the wife of Kaiṇḍinya, O auspicious-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
nyavasaṃ kānyakubje tu susamṛddhā sudarpitā /
jananyā bandhuvargasya pituriṣṭatamā hyaham //
meaning:
न्यवसं कान्यकुब्जे तु सुसमृद्धा सुदर्पिता /
जनन्या बन्धुवर्गस्य पितुरिष्टतमा ह्यहम् //
text_mt: I lived in Kānyakubja, exceedingly prosperous and very proud, / most beloved of my mother, my kin, and my father.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrā dattā tataścāhaṃ kaiṇḍinyāya mahātmane /
kulīnāya sarūpāya strīsaṃgarahitāya ca //
meaning:
पित्रा दत्ता ततश्चाहं कैण्डिन्याय महात्मने /
कुलीनाय सरूपाय स्त्रीसंगरहिताय च //
text_mt: Then I was given by my father to the noble Kaiṇḍinya, / who was well-born, handsome, and free from attachment to other women.

sanskrit_iast:
śayanīyādikaṃ dattaṃ yautukaṃ janakena me /
śvaśureṇāpi me dattaṃ suvarṇasyāyutaṃ purā //
meaning:
शयनीयादिकं दत्तं यौतुकं जनकेन मे /
श्वशुरेणापि मे दत्तं सुवर्णस्यायुतं पुरा //
text_mt: Beds and other furnishings were given as a dowry by my father; / and ten thousand pieces of gold were also given to me formerly by my father-in-law.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛśvaśūravittābhyāṃ paripūrṇābhavaṃ tadā /
gomahiṣyādisaṃyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitā //
meaning:
पितृश्वशूरवित्ताभ्यां परिपूर्णाभवं तदा /
गोमहिष्यादिसंयुक्ता धनधान्यसमन्विता //
text_mt: Endowed with the wealth of both father and father-in-law, I was rich then, / provided with cows, buffaloes, and the like, and possessed of wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭā śvaśurayośvāhaṃ sauśīnyena janasya ca /
kālena pañcatāṃ prāptaḥ śvaśuro vedatattvavit //
meaning:
इष्टा श्वशुरयोश्वाहं सौशीन्येन जनस्य च /
कालेन पञ्चतां प्राप्तः श्वशुरो वेदतत्त्ववित् //
text_mt: I was dear to my parents-in-law and to people on account of my good character. / In the course of time, my father-in-law, who knew the truth of the Vedas, passed away.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ mṛtaṃ patimādāya śvaśrūragniṃ viveśa sā /
tato bhartāñjaliṃ datvā pitroḥ śrāddhamathākarot //
meaning:
तं मृतं पतिमादाय श्वश्रूरग्निं विवेश सा /
ततो भर्ताञ्जलिं दत्वा पित्रोः श्राद्धमथाकरोत् //
text_mt: Taking her deceased husband, my mother-in-law entered the fire. / Then my husband offered water-oblations and performed the ancestral rites for his parents.

sanskrit_iast:
gate māsadvaye devi bhartā me rājamandiram /
gataḥ kautukabhāvenahṛcchayena prapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
गते मासद्वये देवि भर्ता मे राजमन्दिरम् /
गतः कौतुकभावेनहृच्छयेन प्रपीडितः //
text_mt: When two months had passed, O queen, my husband went to the royal palace / out of curiosity, tormented by lust.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra veśyāḥ surūpāḍhyā yauvanena samanvitāḥ /
praviśatyāṃ nṛpagṛhe dṛṣṭāstena dvijanmanā //
meaning:
तत्र वेश्याः सुरूपाढ्या यौवनेन समन्विताः /
प्रविशत्यां नृपगृहे दृष्टास्तेन द्विजन्मना //
text_mt: There, courtesans richly endowed with beauty and youth / were seen by that twice-born man as they entered the king's dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ madhyāttu dve gṛhyavittadānena bhūriṇā /
svagṛhe dhārayāmāsa krīḍārthaṃ durmatiḥ patiḥ //
meaning:
तासां मध्यात्तु द्वे गृह्यवित्तदानेन भूरिणा /
स्वगृहे धारयामास क्रीडार्थं दुर्मतिः पतिः //
text_mt: Taking two from among them by giving abundant wealth, / my foolish-minded husband kept them in his own home for sport.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ vittamaśeṣaṃ tu kṣayaṃ nītaṃ niṣevaṇāt /
varṣatraye gate devi nisvo jātaḥ patirmama //
meaning:
ताभ्यां वित्तमशेषं तु क्षयं नीतं निषेवणात् /
वर्षत्रये गते देवि निस्वो जातः पतिर्मम //
text_mt: By attending to the two of them, all his wealth was brought to ruin. / When three years had passed, O queen, my husband became penniless.

sanskrit_iast:
tatā māṃ prārthayāmāsa dehi me 'ṅgavibhūṣaṇam /
tanmayā nahi dattaṃ tu bhartre vyasanine tadā //
meaning:
तता मां प्रार्थयामास देहि मे ऽङ्गविभूषणम् /
तन्मया नहि दत्तं तु भर्त्रे व्यसनिने तदा //
text_mt: Then he begged me, saying, "Give me your body-ornaments"; / but I did not give them then to my addicted husband.

sanskrit_iast:
subhage sarvamādāya gatāhaṃ mandiraṃ pituḥ /
tataḥ pitṛgṛhe vittaṃ bhṛtyādikamaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सुभगे सर्वमादाय गताहं मन्दिरं पितुः /
ततः पितृगृहे वित्तं भृत्यादिकमशेषतः //
text_mt: Taking everything, O fortunate one, I went to my father's house. / Then all the wealth, servants, and belongings in my father's house

sanskrit_iast:
vikrīya dattaṃ vaiśyābhyāṃ taccāpi kṣayamāgatam /
kṣetradhānyādikaṃ yacca sabhāṇḍaṃ saparicchadam //
meaning:
विक्रीय दत्तं वैश्याभ्यां तच्चापि क्षयमागतम् /
क्षेत्रधान्यादिकं यच्च सभाण्डं सपरिच्छदम् //
text_mt: were sold and given to the two courtesans, and that too came to ruin; / whatever fields, grain, and the like existed, along with vessels and furnishings—'

sanskrit_iast:
svalpamūlyena vikrīyagato nadanadīpatim /
nāvamāruhya me bhartā viveśāntarmahodadheḥ //
meaning:
स्वल्पमूल्येन विक्रीयगतो नदनदीपतिम् /
नावमारुह्य मे भर्ता विवेशान्तर्महोदधेः //
text_mt: Having sold [it] at a low price, he went to the lord of rivers; / boarding a boat, my husband entered into the great ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gato dūramadhvānaṃ paśyamāno 'dbhutāni ca /
śubhe samudrajātāni jīvaceṣṭhāṅkitāni ca //
meaning:
स गतो दूरमध्वानं पश्यमानो ऽद्भुतानि च /
शुभे समुद्रजातानि जीवचेष्ठाङ्कितानि च //
text_mt: He traveled far along the path, seeing wondrous things, / O auspicious lady, born of the ocean and marked by the activities of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhañjanavaśaṃ prāptā sā naukā śatayojanam /
gatā viśīrṇatāṃ tatra mṛtāste nāvamāśritāḥ //
meaning:
प्रभञ्जनवशं प्राप्ता सा नौका शतयोजनम् /
गता विशीर्णतां तत्र मृतास्ते नावमाश्रिताः //
text_mt: Having fallen under the power of a tempest, that boat went a hundred yojanas / and broke apart there; those who relied on the boat died.

sanskrit_iast:
matpatirdaivayogena dīrgha kāṣṭhaṃ samāśritaḥ /
vāyunā nīyamāno 'sau prācīnena svakarmaṇā //
meaning:
मत्पतिर्दैवयोगेन दीर्घ काष्ठं समाश्रितः /
वायुना नीयमानो ऽसौ प्राचीनेन स्वकर्मणा //
text_mt: By the workings of fate, my husband held onto a long piece of wood; / being carried by the wind due to his past karma,

sanskrit_iast:
āsasādācalaṃ devi ratnaśṛṅgavibhūṣitam /
bahunir jharaṇopetaṃ bahupakṣisamanvitam //
meaning:
आससादाचलं देवि रत्नशृङ्गविभूषितम् /
बहुनिर् झरणोपेतं बहुपक्षिसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: he reached a mountain, O lady, adorned with jeweled peaks, / endowed with many waterfalls and frequented by many birds,

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvṛkṣaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpaphalopagaiḥ /
ullikhantaṃ hi śikharaiḥ khamadhyaṃ svātmanastribhiḥ //
meaning:
बहुवृक्षैः समाकीर्णं नानापुष्पफलोपगैः /
उल्लिखन्तं हि शिखरैः खमध्यं स्वात्मनस्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: overspread with many trees bearing various flowers and fruits, / indeed scraping the midst of the sky with its three peaks.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataṃ divyaṃ tyaktvā naukāṣṭhamadbhutam /
āruroha mudāyukto vittākāṅkṣī sulocane //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा पर्वतं दिव्यं त्यक्त्वा नौकाष्ठमद्भुतम् /
आरुरोह मुदायुक्तो वित्ताकाङ्क्षी सुलोचने //
text_mt: Seeing that divine mountain, having abandoned the marvelous boat-timber, / he climbed up, filled with joy and desirous of wealth, O fair-eyed lady.

sanskrit_iast:
viśaśrāma muhūrtaṃ tu kṣutpipāsāsamanvitaḥ /
tata utthāya bhakṣyārthaṃ vṛkṣāṃstatra vyalokayat //
meaning:
विशश्राम मुहूर्तं तु क्षुत्पिपासासमन्वितः /
तत उत्थाय भक्ष्यार्थं वृक्षांस्तत्र व्यलोकयत् //
text_mt: He rested for a moment, overcome by hunger and thirst; / then, rising to find food, he looked at the trees there.

sanskrit_iast:
supakvāstatra mṛdvīkā dṛṣṭvā bhuktvā mudānvitaḥ /
śāntiṃ prāptastato 'paśyatsālamekaṃ sunirmalam //
meaning:
सुपक्वास्तत्र मृद्वीका दृष्ट्वा भुक्त्वा मुदान्वितः /
शान्तिं प्राप्तस्ततो ऽपश्यत्सालमेकं सुनिर्मलम् //
text_mt: Seeing fully ripe grapes there and eating them, filled with joy, / he found relief; then he saw a spotless śāla tree,

sanskrit_iast:
ghanacchāyaṃ meghanibhaṃ pañcāśatpuruṣocchrayam /
tasyādhastātsa suṣvāpa svottarīyaṃ prasārya ca //
meaning:
घनच्छायं मेघनिभं पञ्चाशत्पुरुषोच्छ्रयम् /
तस्याधस्तात्स सुष्वाप स्वोत्तरीयं प्रसार्य च //
text_mt: yielding dense shade, resembling a cloud, fifty men's heights tall; / beneath it he fell asleep, having spread out his upper garment.

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyā nidrayā caiva saṃpraghūrṇitalocanaḥ /
tāvatsupto 'tikhinno 'sau yāvatsūryo 'statāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
मोहिन्या निद्रया चैव संप्रघूर्णितलोचनः /
तावत्सुप्तो ऽतिखिन्नो ऽसौ यावत्सूर्यो ऽस्ततां गतः //
text_mt: His eyes rolled back in bewildering sleep; / he, utterly exhausted, slept until the sun set.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrye 'staṃ samanuprāpte samāyāte niśāmukhe /
abhyagādrākṣaso ghoro garjamāno yathā ghanaḥ //
meaning:
सूर्ये ऽस्तं समनुप्राप्ते समायाते निशामुखे /
अभ्यगाद्राक्षसो घोरो गर्जमानो यथा घनः //
text_mt: When the sun had set and the onset of night had arrived, / a terrible rākṣasa approached, roaring like a cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkenādāya tanvaṅgīṃ sītāmiva daśānanaḥ /
śubhāṃ kāśīpateḥ putrīṃ nāmnā ratnāvalīṃ śubhām //
meaning:
अङ्केनादाय तन्वङ्गीं सीतामिव दशाननः /
शुभां काशीपतेः पुत्रीं नाम्ना रत्नावलीं शुभाम् //
text_mt: carrying in his arms a slender-limbed girl, like Daśānana carrying Sītā: / the auspicious daughter of the king of Kāśī, named Ratnāvalī,

sanskrit_iast:
adhautapādāṃ suśroṇīṃ saumyadikchīrṣaśāyinīm /
patikāmā kumārī sā nāvindatsadṛśaṃ patim //
meaning:
अधौतपादां सुश्रोणीं सौम्यदिक्छीर्षशायिनीम् /
पतिकामा कुमारी सा नाविन्दत्सदृशं पतिम् //
text_mt: with unwashed feet, broad hips, sleeping with her head toward the north; / that maiden, desiring a husband, had not found a suitable match.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayoṣidvarā bālā rudatī nidrayākulā /
pitā tasyāḥ pradāne tu cintāviṣṭo hyaharnniśam //
meaning:
सर्वयोषिद्वरा बाला रुदती निद्रयाकुला /
पिता तस्याः प्रदाने तु चिन्ताविष्टो ह्यहर्न्निशम् //
text_mt: She, the best of all young women, was weeping, bewildered by sleep; / her father was day and night filled with worry over giving her in marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpacchāyāśrite tanvi śayane sā vyavasthitā /
aṭamānena pāpena dṛṣṭā sā rūpaśālinī //
meaning:
दीपच्छायाश्रिते तन्वि शयने सा व्यवस्थिता /
अटमानेन पापेन दृष्टा सा रूपशालिनी //
text_mt: Resting on a bed in the shadow of a lamp, O slender one, / that beautiful woman was seen by the wandering evil one.

sanskrit_iast:
dīparatnaiḥ sukhacite dhārayantī ca kaṅkaṇe /
ubhayordaśa ratnāni niṣke ca daśapañca ca //
meaning:
दीपरत्नैः सुखचिते धारयन्ती च कङ्कणे /
उभयोर्दश रत्नानि निष्के च दशपञ्च च //
text_mt: She was wearing two bracelets thickly set with shining jewels, / ten jewels on both, and fifteen on her necklace;

sanskrit_iast:
sīmante sapta ratnāni keyūre 'ṣṭau ca pañca ca /
evaṃ ratnācitāṃ bālāṃ śātakumbhasamaprabhām //
meaning:
सीमन्ते सप्त रत्नानि केयूरे ऽष्टौ च पञ्च च /
एवं रत्नाचितां बालां शातकुम्भसमप्रभाम् //
text_mt: seven jewels on the part of her hair, and thirteen on her armlet; / thus adorned with jewels, the girl had the luster of refined gold.

sanskrit_iast:
jahāra rājabhavanāttāṃ tadā cāruhāsinīm /
vāyumārgaṃ samāśritya kṣaṇātprāptaḥ svamālayam //
meaning:
जहार राजभवनात्तां तदा चारुहासिनीम् /
वायुमार्गं समाश्रित्य क्षणात्प्राप्तः स्वमालयम् //
text_mt: Then he abducted that sweet-smiling girl from the royal palace; / resorting to the path of the wind, he reached his own abode in an instant,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ parvataṃ sa yatrāste patirmeśālamāśritaḥ /
tatra tasya guhāṃ dṛṣṭvā suvarṇasadṛśaprabhām //
meaning:
तं पर्वतं स यत्रास्ते पतिर्मेशालमाश्रितः /
तत्र तस्य गुहां दृष्ट्वा सुवर्णसदृशप्रभाम् //
text_mt: that mountain where my husband was staying, resting beneath the śāla tree. / Seeing his cave there, glowing like gold,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhayasyāsahā tatra praviveśāsya paśyataḥ /
anekairmaṇivinyāsaiḥ saṃyuktāṃ citramandirām //
meaning:
तद्भयस्यासहा तत्र प्रविवेशास्य पश्यतः /
अनेकैर्मणिविन्यासैः संयुक्तां चित्रमन्दिराम् //
text_mt: he entered while [my husband] watched, [she] helpless from fear of him; / it was a wondrous dwelling adorned with arrangements of many jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādravyasamākīrṇāṃ śayanāsanasaṃyutām /
bhojanaiḥ pānapātraiśca bhakṣyabhojyairanekadhā //
meaning:
नानाद्रव्यसमाकीर्णां शयनासनसंयुताम् /
भोजनैः पानपात्रैश्च भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकधा //
text_mt: filled with diverse goods, provided with beds and seats, / with meals and drinking cups, and with eatables and foods of many kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya tatra śayyāyāṃ mumocotpalalocanām /
rudatīmatisaṃtrastāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām //
meaning:
प्रविश्य तत्र शय्यायां मुमोचोत्पललोचनाम् /
रुदतीमतिसंत्रस्तां पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम् //
text_mt: Having entered, he released on the bed the lotus-eyed girl, / who was weeping, terrified, possessing plump hips and breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstu ruditaṃ śrutvā tasya bhāryā hi rākṣasī /
ājagāma tvarāyuktā yatrāsau rākṣasaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यास्तु रुदितं श्रुत्वा तस्य भार्या हि राक्षसी /
आजगाम त्वरायुक्ता यत्रासौ राक्षसः स्थितः //
text_mt: Hearing her weeping, his wife, a rākṣasī, / came in haste to where that rākṣasa stood.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ taptakāñcanasaprabhām /
papraccha nijabhartāraṃ kruddhā nirbhartsatī satī //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीं तप्तकाञ्चनसप्रभाम् /
पप्रच्छ निजभर्तारं क्रुद्धा निर्भर्त्सती सती //
text_mt: Seeing her of beautiful limbs, radiant as molten gold, / she, enraged and scolding, questioned her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamāhṛtā ceyaṃ jīvantyāṃ mayi nirghṛṇaṃ /
anyāṃ samīhase bhāryāṃ nāhaṃ bhāryāṃ bhavāmi te //
meaning:
किमर्थमाहृता चेयं जीवन्त्यां मयि निर्घृणं /
अन्यां समीहसे भार्यां नाहं भार्यां भवामि ते //
text_mt: "Why has this girl been brought while I am alive, you heartless one? / If you desire another wife, I shall not be your wife!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ bhartā rākṣasīmasitekṣaṇām /
uvāca rākṣaso harṣātsvāṃ priyāṃ cārulocanām //
meaning:
एवं ब्रुवाणां तां भर्ता राक्षसीमसितेक्षणाम् /
उवाच राक्षसो हर्षात्स्वां प्रियां चारुलोचनाम् //
text_mt: To the dark-eyed rākṣasī speaking thus, her husband, / the rākṣasa, joyfully spoke to his beloved, fair-eyed one:

sanskrit_iast:
tvadarthamāhṛtaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mayā kośyāḥ śubhānane /
daivopapāditaṃ dvāri dvitīyaṃ mama tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
त्वदर्थमाहृतं भक्ष्यं मया कोश्याः शुभानने /
दैवोपपादितं द्वारि द्वितीयं मम तिष्ठति //
text_mt: "Food has been brought by me for you from Kāśī, O fair-faced one! / A second one, provided by fate, is staying at my door:

sanskrit_iast:
śālavṛkṣāśritaḥ śete vipraścaiko varānane /
tamānaya tvarāyuktā yenāhaṃ bhakṣyamācare //
meaning:
शालवृक्षाश्रितः शेते विप्रश्चैको वरानने /
तमानय त्वरायुक्ता येनाहं भक्ष्यमाचरे //
text_mt: a brāhmaṇa is sleeping sheltered beneath the śāla tree, O fair-faced woman; / bring him quickly, so that I may make a meal!"

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā kumārī sābravīdidam /
mithyā rākṣasi bhartā te bhāṣate tvadbhayādayam //
meaning:
राक्षसस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कुमारी साब्रवीदिदम् /
मिथ्या राक्षसि भर्ता ते भाषते त्वद्भयादयम् //
text_mt: Hearing the rākṣasa's words, the maiden said this: / "Falsely does your husband speak, O rākṣasī, out of fear of you!

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā tvāṃ jarayopetāṃ virūpāmatijihyagām /
suptāṃ pitṛgṛhe rātrau māṃ samāsādya kāmataḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा त्वां जरयोपेतां विरूपामतिजिह्यगाम् /
सुप्तां पितृगृहे रात्रौ मां समासाद्य कामतः //
text_mt: Knowing you to be overtaken by old age, deformed, and extremely crooked, / he approached me out of lust while I slept at night in my father's house.

sanskrit_iast:
anūḍhāṃ rudatīṃ bhadre bhāryārthaṃ samupānayat /
itīritamupākarṇya vacanaṃ rājakanyayā //
meaning:
अनूढां रुदतीं भद्रे भार्यार्थं समुपानयत् /
इतीरितमुपाकर्ण्य वचनं राजकन्यया //
text_mt: He brought me, an unmarried girl, weeping, to be his wife, O good lady!" / Hearing the words thus spoken by the king's daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhayuktātimātraṃ vai babhūva kṣipatī vacaḥ /
tasyāśca rūpamālokya satyamevāvadhārayat //
meaning:
क्रोधयुक्तातिमात्रं वै बभूव क्षिपती वचः /
तस्याश्च रूपमालोक्य सत्यमेवावधारयत् //
text_mt: she became exceedingly enraged, hurling harsh words; / and beholding her beauty, she concluded it to be indeed the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayāmāsa cāpyevaṃ bhāryārthe hyāhṛteti ca /
avaśyaṃ mūrghniṃ kīlaṃ me roṣayiṣyati rākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तयामास चाप्येवं भार्यार्थे ह्याहृतेति च /
अवश्यं मूर्घ्निं कीलं मे रोषयिष्यति राक्षसः //
text_mt: And she thought: "Indeed, she has been brought as a wife; / surely the rākṣasa will drive a stake into my head!

sanskrit_iast:
māsma sīmantinī kācidbhevatsā bhuvanatraye /
yā sāpatnyena duḥkhena pīḍyamānā hi jīvati //
meaning:
मास्म सीमन्तिनी काचिद्भेवत्सा भुवनत्रये /
या सापत्न्येन दुःखेन पीड्यमाना हि जीवति //
text_mt: May no woman exist in the three worlds, O dear one, / who lives afflicted by the misery of having a co-wife!

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva duḥkhānāṃ mahaccedaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
sāmānyadravyabhogādi niṣṭhā caivāparā bhavet //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव दुःखानां महच्चेदं न संशयः /
सामान्यद्रव्यभोगादि निष्ठा चैवापरा भवेत् //
text_mt: Of all sufferings, this is the greatest, there is no doubt; / enjoyment of ordinary possessions and the like is one thing, but this is an entirely different state."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sā bahu saṃcintya bhartāraṃ vākyamabravīt /
madīyā mama bhakṣyārthaṃ tvayānītā sulocanā //
meaning:
एवं सा बहु संचिन्त्य भर्तारं वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
मदीया मम भक्ष्यार्थं त्वयानीता सुलोचना //
text_mt: Having reflected thus at length, she spoke these words to her husband: / "The fair-eyed girl brought by you is mine, for my food.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ vipramānayiṣyāmi bhakṣyārthaṃ tava suvrata /
tataḥ sa rākṣasaḥ prāha gacchagaccheti satvaram //
meaning:
तं विप्रमानयिष्यामि भक्ष्यार्थं तव सुव्रत /
ततः स राक्षसः प्राह गच्छगच्छेति सत्वरम् //
text_mt: I will bring that brāhmaṇa for your food, O faithful one." / Then the rākṣasa said: "Go, go quickly!

sanskrit_iast:
sṛkkiṇī sravate 'tyarthaṃ tasya bhakṣaṇakāmyayā /
tataḥ sā rākṣasī ghorā śrutvā patisamīritam //
meaning:
सृक्किणी स्रवते ऽत्यर्थं तस्य भक्षणकाम्यया /
ततः सा राक्षसी घोरा श्रुत्वा पतिसमीरितम् //
text_mt: The corners of my mouth are watering profusely with the desire to devour him." / Then that terrible rākṣasī, hearing what her husband said,

sanskrit_iast:
nirjagāma durantāśā dadarśa dvijasattamam /
rūpayauvanasaṃyuktaṃ vidyāratnavibhūṣitam //
meaning:
निर्जगाम दुरन्ताशा ददर्श द्विजसत्तमम् /
रूपयौवनसंयुक्तं विद्यारत्नविभूषितम् //
text_mt: went out with malicious intent, and saw the excellent twice-born, / endowed with beauty and youth, adorned with the jewel of learning.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā māyayā bhūtvā suṃdarī ṣoḍaśābdikā /
hṛcchayena samāviṣṭā tadantikamupāgamat //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा मायया भूत्वा सुंदरी षोडशाब्दिका /
हृच्छयेन समाविष्टा तदन्तिकमुपागमत् //
text_mt: Seeing him, she turned by magic into a beautiful sixteen-year-old girl; / seized with passion, she approached his presence.

sanskrit_iast:
abravītsā pṛthuśroṇī taṃ vipraṃ prītisaṃyutā /
kastvaṃ kasmādihāyataḥ kimarthamiha tiṣṭhasi //
meaning:
अब्रवीत्सा पृथुश्रोणी तं विप्रं प्रीतिसंयुता /
कस्त्वं कस्मादिहायतः किमर्थमिह तिष्ठसि //
text_mt: Filled with affection, that broad-hipped woman said to the brāhmaṇa: / "Who are you? From where have you come here? For what purpose do you stay here?

sanskrit_iast:
pṛcchāmi patikāmāhaṃ rākṣasī hṛcchayāturā /
svabhartrāhaṃ parityaktā tvāṃ patiṃ kartumāgatā //
meaning:
पृच्छामि पतिकामाहं राक्षसी हृच्छयातुरा /
स्वभर्त्राहं परित्यक्ता त्वां पतिं कर्तुमागता //
text_mt: I ask desiring a husband, a rākṣasī distressed by desire; / abandoned by my own husband, I have come to make you my husband."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā bhartā me bhayasaṃyutaḥ /
uvāca vacanaṃ prājño dhairyamālaṃbya tāṃ śubhe //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्या भर्ता मे भयसंयुतः /
उवाच वचनं प्राज्ञो धैर्यमालंब्य तां शुभे //
text_mt: Hearing her words, my husband, filled with fear, / wise, summoned courage and spoke these words to her, O auspicious lady:

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣomānuṣasaṃyogaḥ kathaṃ rākṣasi saṃbhavet /
mānuṣāstu smṛtā bhakṣyā rākṣasānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
रक्षोमानुषसंयोगः कथं राक्षसि संभवेत् /
मानुषास्तु स्मृता भक्ष्या राक्षसानां न संशयः //
text_mt: "How can there be a union between a rākṣasa and a human, O rākṣasī? / Humans are considered food for rākṣasas, there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ sā tu punastaṃ prāha sādaram /
asaṃbhāvyaṃ ca jagati saṃbhaveddaivayogataḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं सा तु पुनस्तं प्राह सादरम् /
असंभाव्यं च जगति संभवेद्दैवयोगतः //
text_mt: Hearing his words, she spoke to him again respectfully: / "Even what is impossible can happen in this world through the workings of fate.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇe śrūyate hyetadbhaviṣyaṃ bhārate sthitam /
hiḍaṃbā rākṣasī vipra bhīmabhāryā bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
पुराणे श्रूयते ह्येतद्भविष्यं भारते स्थितम् /
हिडंबा राक्षसी विप्र भीमभार्या भविष्यति //
text_mt: For it is heard in the Purāṇa as a future event set forth in the Bhārata: / the rākṣasī Hiḍimbā will become the wife of Bhīma, O vipra.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣotpāditaḥ putro bhaviṣyati ghaṭotkacaḥ /
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ śaktyā mṛtyumavāpsyati //
meaning:
मानुषोत्पादितः पुत्रो भविष्यति घटोत्कचः /
अवध्यः सर्वशस्त्राणां शक्त्या मृत्युमवाप्स्यति //
text_mt: The son begotten by a human will be Ghaṭotkaca; / invulnerable to all weapons, he will meet his death by a spear."

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviṣādaṃ mā viprakuru tvaṃ daivayogataḥ /
bhāryā tavāhaṃ saṃjātā dava hi balavattaram //
meaning:
तस्माद्विषादं मा विप्रकुरु त्वं दैवयोगतः /
भार्या तवाहं संजाता दव हि बलवत्तरम् //
text_mt: Therefore, O vipra, do not despair because of fate; / I have become your wife, for destiny is indeed stronger.

sanskrit_iast:
martyalokaṃ gate śaktre vairocaninirīkṣaṇe /
tadantaraṃ samāsādya bhartā me ghorarākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
मर्त्यलोकं गते शक्त्रे वैरोचनिनिरीक्षणे /
तदन्तरं समासाद्य भर्ता मे घोरराक्षसः //
text_mt: When Śakra had gone to the mortal world to see the son of Virocana, / my husband, a dreadful rākṣasa, taking advantage of that opportunity,

sanskrit_iast:
tadgṛhācchaktimaharaddīptāmagriśikhāmiva /
seyaṃ samāśritā cātra śālavṛkṣe tu vāsavī //
meaning:
तद्गृहाच्छक्तिमहरद्दीप्तामग्रिशिखामिव /
सेयं समाश्रिता चात्र शालवृक्षे तु वासवी //
text_mt: stole the dart from his house like a blazing flame of fire. / And this dart of Vāsava has been placed here in a śāla tree.

sanskrit_iast:
ahatvaikaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha nagacchati purandaram /
yadvadhāya prakṣipettāṃ so 'maro 'pi vinaśyati //
meaning:
अहत्वैकं द्विजश्रेष्ठ नगच्छति पुरन्दरम् /
यद्वधाय प्रक्षिपेत्तां सो ऽमरो ऽपि विनश्यति //
text_mt: Without killing one [victim], O best of the twice-born, it does not return to Purandara; / at whosever destruction he hurls it, even an immortal perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhamāruhya śālāgraṃ śaktimānīya bhāsvarām /
tvatkare saṃpradāsyāmi bharturnidhanakāmyayā //
meaning:
साहमारुह्य शालाग्रं शक्तिमानीय भास्वराम् /
त्वत्करे संप्रदास्यामि भर्तुर्निधनकाम्यया //
text_mt: Climbing to the top of the śāla tree and bringing down the radiant dart, / I shall place it in your hand, wishing for the destruction of my husband.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvamanayā śaktyā na hiṃsasi niśācaram /
khādayiṣyati durmedhāstvāṃ ca māṃ ca na saśayaḥ //
meaning:
यदि त्वमनया शक्त्या न हिंससि निशाचरम् /
खादयिष्यति दुर्मेधास्त्वां च मां च न सशयः //
text_mt: If you do not slay the night-stalker with this dart, / that evil-minded one will devour both you and me, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tava śatrurmahāneṣa mamāpi ca parantapa /
yenāhṛtā kumārīha bhāryārthaṃ mandabuddhinā //
meaning:
तव शत्रुर्महानेष ममापि च परन्तप /
येनाहृता कुमारीह भार्यार्थं मन्दबुद्धिना //
text_mt: He is a great enemy of yours and also of mine, O scorcher of foes, / by whom, dull-witted as he is, a maiden has been abducted here for the sake of a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnabhāvo janito mama bhartrā durātmanā /
vyāpādite 'sminnubhayoḥ krīḍanaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati //
meaning:
सपत्नभावो जनितो मम भर्त्रा दुरात्मना /
व्यापादिते ऽस्मिन्नुभयोः क्रीडनं संभविष्यति //
text_mt: The state of a co-wife has been produced by my wicked-souled husband; / when he is slain, there will be amorous play for the two of us.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyanyathā vadervākyaṃ tvāmahaṃ rativarddhana /
tadātmakagṛtapuṇyasya na bhaveyaṃ hi bhāginī //
meaning:
यद्यन्यथा वदेर्वाक्यं त्वामहं रतिवर्द्धन /
तदात्मकगृतपुण्यस्य न भवेयं हि भागिनी //
text_mt: If I am speaking a false word to you, O increaser of my delight, / then may I have no share in the merit earned by myself!

sanskrit_iast:
yā gatirbrahmahatyāyāṃ kutsitā prāpyate naraiḥ /
tāṃ gatiṃ hi prapadye 'haṃ yadyetadanṛtaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
या गतिर्ब्रह्महत्यायां कुत्सिता प्राप्यते नरैः /
तां गतिं हि प्रपद्ये ऽहं यद्येतदनृतं भवेत् //
text_mt: Whatever vile fate is reached by men guilty of the murder of a brāhmaṇa, / that fate indeed may I attain if this should be untrue!

sanskrit_iast:
madyaṃ hi pibato brahman brāhmaṇasya durātmanaḥ /
yā gatirvihitā ghorā tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyāmyaham //
meaning:
मद्यं हि पिबतो ब्रह्मन् ब्राह्मणस्य दुरात्मनः /
या गतिर्विहिता घोरा तां गतिं प्राप्नुयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: O brāhmaṇa, whatever dreadful fate is ordained for an evil-souled brāhmaṇa who drinks wine, / that fate may I attain!

sanskrit_iast:
gurudāraprasaktasya jatoḥ pāpaniṣeviṇaḥ /
yā gatistāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mithyā procya samāpnuyām //
meaning:
गुरुदारप्रसक्तस्य जतोः पापनिषेविणः /
या गतिस्तां द्विजश्रेष्ठ मिथ्या प्रोच्य समाप्नुयाम् //
text_mt: Whatever fate is ordained for a sin-practicing creature who clings to the guru's wife, / that fate, O best of the twice-born, may I meet by speaking falsely!

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇanyāsāpaharaṇe medinīharaṇe ca yā /
ātmano hanane yā hi vihitā munibhirdvija //
meaning:
स्वर्णन्यासापहरणे मेदिनीहरणे च या /
आत्मनो हनने या हि विहिता मुनिभिर्द्विज //
text_mt: Whatever [fate] is ordained by the sages, O twice-born, for stealing a deposit of gold, / for seizing land, and for killing oneself—

sanskrit_iast:
gatistāmanugacchāmi yadyetadanṛtaṃ vade /
pañcamyāṃ ca tathāṣṭamyāṃ yatpāpaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇe //
meaning:
गतिस्तामनुगच्छामि यद्येतदनृतं वदे /
पञ्चम्यां च तथाष्टम्यां यत्पापं मांसभक्षणे //
text_mt: to that fate may I go if I speak what is untrue in this! / And whatever sin there is in eating meat on the fifth and likewise the eighth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
strīsaṃgame tarucchede yatpāpaṃ śaśinaḥ kṣaye /
yaducchiṣṭe ghṛtaṃ bhokturmaithunena divā ca yat //
meaning:
स्त्रीसंगमे तरुच्छेदे यत्पापं शशिनः क्षये /
यदुच्छिष्टे घृतं भोक्तुर्मैथुनेन दिवा च यत् //
text_mt: whatever sin in intercourse with a woman or cutting a tree at the waning of the moon, / whatever in eating ghee when impure, and whatever through daytime copulation,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvadevamakartuśca gṛhiṇo hi dvijasya yat /
bhikṣāmadāturbhikṣubhyo vidhavāyā dvibhojanāt //
meaning:
वैश्वदेवमकर्तुश्च गृहिणो हि द्विजस्य यत् /
भिक्षामदातुर्भिक्षुभ्यो विधवाया द्विभोजनात् //
text_mt: and whatever [sin] of a twice-born householder who does not perform the vaiśvadeva sacrifice, / who does not give alms to mendicants, and from a widow eating twice [a day],

sanskrit_iast:
tailaṃ bhoktuśca saṃkrāntau gobhistīrthaṃ ca gacchataḥ /
tathā mṛdamanuddhṛtya snātuḥ parajalāśaye //
meaning:
तैलं भोक्तुश्च संक्रान्तौ गोभिस्तीर्थं च गच्छतः /
तथा मृदमनुद्धृत्य स्नातुः परजलाशये //
text_mt: and of one who consumes oil on a saṃkrānti, and who approaches a sacred ford with cattle, / likewise of one who bathes in another's body of water without lifting clay,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhavṛkṣajanitaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca khādataḥ /
gāmasevayato baddhvā pākhaṇḍapathagāminaḥ //
meaning:
निषिद्धवृक्षजनितं दन्तकाष्ठं च खादतः /
गामसेवयतो बद्ध्वा पाखण्डपथगामिनः //
text_mt: and of one who chews a tooth-stick produced from a forbidden tree, / of one who ties up a cow and does not attend to her, and of one who walks the path of heretics,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevārcanaṃ kartuḥ kāṣṭhagrāvasthitasya yat /
gohīnāṃ mahiṣīṃ dharturbhinnakāṃsye ca bhuñjataḥ //
meaning:
पितृदेवार्चनं कर्तुः काष्ठग्रावस्थितस्य यत् /
गोहीनां महिषीं धर्तुर्भिन्नकांस्ये च भुञ्जतः //
text_mt: whatever [sin] of one who performs worship of the ancestors and gods standing on wood or stone, / of one who keeps a buffalo-cow destitute of cattle, and of one who eats from broken bell-metal,

sanskrit_iast:
adhautabhinnapārakyavastrasaṃvītakarmiṇaḥ /
nagrastrīprekṣaṇaṃ karturabhakṣyasya ca bhojinaḥ //
meaning:
अधौतभिन्नपारक्यवस्त्रसंवीतकर्मिणः /
नग्रस्त्रीप्रेक्षणं कर्तुरभक्ष्यस्य च भोजिनः //
text_mt: of one who performs rites clothed in unwashed, torn, or another's garment, / of one who looks at a naked woman, and of one who eats inedible food,

sanskrit_iast:
kathāyāṃ śrīharervighnaṃ karturyatpātakaṃ dvija /
tena pāpena lipye 'haṃ yadi vacmi tavānṛtam //
meaning:
कथायां श्रीहरेर्विघ्नं कर्तुर्यत्पातकं द्विज /
तेन पापेन लिप्ये ऽहं यदि वच्मि तवानृतम् //
text_mt: and whatever sin belongs to one who creates an obstacle in the recitation of the tale of Śrī Hari, O twice-born— / with that sin may I be tainted if I speak an untruth to you!

sanskrit_iast:
uktānyetāni pāpāni yānyanuktānyapi dvija /
sarveṣāṃ bhāginī cāhaṃ yadyetadanṛtaṃ vade //
meaning:
उक्तान्येतानि पापानि यान्यनुक्तान्यपि द्विज /
सर्वेषां भागिनी चाहं यद्येतदनृतं वदे //
text_mt: These sins that have been stated and even those that have not been stated, O twice-born— / may I become a partaker of all of them if I speak an untruth in this!

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃbodhito devi bhartā me pāpayā tayā /
tatheti niścayaṃ cakre bhavitavyena mohitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संबोधितो देवि भर्ता मे पापया तया /
तथेति निश्चयं चक्रे भवितव्येन मोहितः //
text_mt: Thus addressed, O goddess, by that wicked woman, / my husband, deluded by destiny, resolved, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
nirdravyo vyayasanāsakto madvākyakaluṣīkṛtaḥ /
uvāca rākṣasīṃ vākyaṃ sarvaṃsiddhipradāyakam //
meaning:
निर्द्रव्यो व्ययसनासक्तो मद्वाक्यकलुषीकृतः /
उवाच राक्षसीं वाक्यं सर्वंसिद्धिप्रदायकम् //
text_mt: Destitute, addicted to vice, and sullied by my words, / he spoke words to the rākṣasī that would grant all success:

sanskrit_iast:
śīghramānaya tāṃ śaktiṃ karomi vacanaṃ tava /
sarvametatpradeyaṃ hi tvayā me rākṣase hate //
meaning:
शीघ्रमानय तां शक्तिं करोमि वचनं तव /
सर्वमेतत्प्रदेयं हि त्वया मे राक्षसे हते //
text_mt: 'Quickly bring that spear! I shall carry out your word. / Indeed, all this must be given to me by you once the rākṣasa is slain.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyāśayā praviṣṭo 'haṃ sāgaraṃ timisaṃkulam /
tacchrutvā rākṣasī śaktiṃ samānīya nagasthitām //
meaning:
द्रव्याशया प्रविष्टो ऽहं सागरं तिमिसंकुलम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसी शक्तिं समानीय नगस्थिताम् //
text_mt: Longing for wealth, I would enter the ocean teeming with whales!' / Hearing that, the rākṣasī brought the spear resting on the mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau madbhartṛsiddhyarthaṃ vimuñcantīṃ mahārciṣam /
etasminneva kāle tu rākṣasaḥ kāmamohitaḥ //
meaning:
ददौ मद्भर्तृसिद्ध्यर्थं विमुञ्चन्तीं महार्चिषम् /
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राक्षसः काममोहितः //
text_mt: which was blazing with mighty flames, and gave it for my husband's success. / Just at that very time, the rākṣasa, infatuated by lust,

sanskrit_iast:
gamanāyodyataḥ kanyāṃ sā bhītā vākyamabravīt /
kumārīsevane rakṣo mahāpāpaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
गमनायोद्यतः कन्यां सा भीता वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
कुमारीसेवने रक्षो महापापं विधीयते //
text_mt: was about to approach the maiden. Terrified, she said: / 'Enjoying a virgin, O rākṣasa, is deemed a great sin.

sanskrit_iast:
chalenāhaṃ hṛtā kāśyāḥ suptā pitṛgṛhātvayā /
tava doṣo na cehāsti bhavitavyaṃ mamedṛśam //
meaning:
छलेनाहं हृता काश्याः सुप्ता पितृगृहात्वया /
तव दोषो न चेहास्ति भवितव्यं ममेदृशम् //
text_mt: I was deceitfully abducted by you from my father's house in Kāśī while asleep. / There is no fault of yours here; such was my destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
guhāmadhyagatāyāstuko me trātā bhaviṣyati /
vidhiyogādbhavedbhartā vidhiyogādbhavetpriyā //
meaning:
गुहामध्यगतायास्तुको मे त्राता भविष्यति /
विधियोगाद्भवेद्भर्ता विधियोगाद्भवेत्प्रिया //
text_mt: Having entered the interior of this cave, who will be my protector? / By fate's decree one obtains a husband; by fate's decree one obtains a beloved wife.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavedvidhivaśādvidyā gṛhaṃ saukhyaṃ dhanaṃ kulam /
vidhinā preryamāṇastu janaḥ sarvatra gacchati //
meaning:
भवेद्विधिवशाद्विद्या गृहं सौख्यं धनं कुलम् /
विधिना प्रेर्यमाणस्तु जनः सर्वत्र गच्छति //
text_mt: By the power of fate come learning, a home, happiness, wealth, and family. / Urged on by fate, a person goes everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ bhavitā bhartā tvameva rajanīcara /
vidhainā vihite mārge kiṃ kariṣyati paṇḍitaḥ //
meaning:
अवश्यं भविता भर्ता त्वमेव रजनीचर /
विधैना विहिते मार्गे किं करिष्यति पण्डितः //
text_mt: You alone will inevitably be my husband, O night-roamer. / On the path ordained by fate, what will a wise man do?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādānayata vipraṃ śālavṛkṣāśrita tviha /
ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ kuśānagniṃ vivāhaṃ vidhinā kuru //
meaning:
तस्मादानयत विप्रं शालवृक्षाश्रित त्विह /
घृतं जलं कुशानग्निं विवाहं विधिना कुरु //
text_mt: Therefore, bring the brāhmaṇa who has taken shelter in the śāla tree here. / [Procure] ghee, water, kuśa grass, and fire, and perform the marriage according to the ritual rules.

sanskrit_iast:
vināpi darbhatoyāgnīnnyathoktavidhimatarā /
brāhmaṇasyaiva vākyena vivāhaḥ saphalo bhavet //
meaning:
विनापि दर्भतोयाग्नीन्न्यथोक्तविधिमतरा /
ब्राह्मणस्यैव वाक्येन विवाहः सफलो भवेत् //
text_mt: Even without darbha grass, water, and fire, and without the prescribed rites, / a marriage can become fruitful solely through the word of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
na hato yadi viprastu bhāryayā tava rākṣasa /
vṛtte homasya kārye tu taṃ bhavān bhakṣayiṣyati //
meaning:
न हतो यदि विप्रस्तु भार्यया तव राक्षस /
वृत्ते होमस्य कार्ये तु तं भवान् भक्षयिष्यति //
text_mt: If the brāhmaṇa has not been slain by your wife, O rākṣasa, / then once the duty of the fire oblation is accomplished, you may eat him.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte tu vacane tayā vai rājakanyayā /
viśvastamānaso darpānnirjagāma sa rākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते तु वचने तया वै राजकन्यया /
विश्वस्तमानसो दर्पान्निर्जगाम स राक्षसः //
text_mt: When these words had been spoken by that royal maiden, / the rākṣasa, with a trusting mind, went out in pride.

sanskrit_iast: satvaraṃ hṛcchayāviṣṭastamānetuṃ bahiḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning: सत्वरं हृच्छयाविष्टस्तमानेतुं बहिः स्थितः //
text_mt: Overcome with desire, he quickly went out to fetch him, remaining outside.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya nirgacchato devi kṣutamāsītsvayaṃ kila /
savyaṃ cāpyasphurannetraṃ svavastraṃ skhalitaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तस्य निर्गच्छतो देवि क्षुतमासीत्स्वयं किल /
सव्यं चाप्यस्फुरन्नेत्रं स्ववस्त्रं स्खलितं तथा //
text_mt: As he was going out, O goddess, he sneezed by himself; / his left eye twitched, and his garment slipped.

sanskrit_iast:
anāhṛtya tu tatsarvaṃ nirgato 'sau darīmukhāt /
bibhrāṇāṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ svāmapaśyannitaṃbinīm //
meaning:
अनाहृत्य तु तत्सर्वं निर्गतो ऽसौ दरीमुखात् /
बिभ्राणां मानुषं रूपं स्वामपश्यन्नितंबिनीम् //
text_mt: Disregarding all of that, he went out from the cave's mouth, / and saw his broad-hipped wife assuming human form,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭayantīṃ tu saṃbandhaṃ bhāryābhartṛsamudbhavam /
parityajāmi tvāṃ pāpaṃ rākṣasaṃ krūrakarmiṇam //
meaning:
घटयन्तीं तु संबन्धं भार्याभर्तृसमुद्भवम् /
परित्यजामि त्वां पापं राक्षसं क्रूरकर्मिणम् //
text_mt: forging a bond arising from the relation of wife and husband [with him]: / 'I abandon you, an evil, cruel-acting rākṣasa,

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣīpramadāsaktaṃ maccharīrasya dūṣakam /
tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ bhāryayā samudīritam /
īrṣyākopasamāyuktastvabhyadhāvanniśācaraḥ //
meaning:
मानुषीप्रमदासक्तं मच्छरीरस्य दूषकम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा दारुणं वाक्यं भार्यया समुदीरितम् /
ईर्ष्याकोपसमायुक्तस्त्वभ्यधावन्निशाचरः //
text_mt: attached to a human woman, a defiler of my body!' / Hearing these harsh words uttered by his wife, / the night-roamer, seized with jealousy and wrath, rushed forward.

sanskrit_iast:
utkṣipya bāhū pravidārya vaktraṃ saṃprasthito bhakṣayituṃ sa cobhau /
kālena vegātpavano yathaiva samuccaranvākyamanarthayuktam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite kāṣṭhīlopākhyānaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
उत्क्षिप्य बाहू प्रविदार्य वक्त्रं संप्रस्थितो भक्षयितुं स चोभौ /
कालेन वेगात्पवनो यथैव समुच्चरन्वाक्यमनर्थयुक्तम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते काष्ठीलोपाख्यानं नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Raising his arms and tearing open his mouth, he set out to devour both of them, / rushing swiftly like a wind in the hour of death, uttering incoherent words.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named 'The Story of Kāṣṭhīla', in the Mohinīcarita of the second half of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhīlovāca
rākṣasaṃ dhāvamānaṃ tu kālāntakayamopamam /
dṛṣṭvā sā rākṣasī prāha bhartāraṃ mama śaṅkitā //
meaning:
काष्ठीलोवाच
राक्षसं धावमानं तु कालान्तकयमोपमम् /
दृष्ट्वा सा राक्षसी प्राह भर्तारं मम शङ्किता //
title: athāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Kāṣṭhīla said: / Seeing the rākṣasa rushing forward, resembling Death, the End-Maker, / that rākṣasī, terrified, spoke to my husband:

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣipasvānalaprakhyāṃ śaktiṃ hemavibhūṣitām /
