mamāyaṃ pañcatāṃ yātu digaṃbararipupriya //
meaning:
प्रक्षिपस्वानलप्रख्यां शक्तिं हेमविभूषिताम् /
ममायं पञ्चतां यातु दिगंबररिपुप्रिय //
text_mt: 'Hurl the spear adorned with gold, resembling fire! / May he meet his demise, O lover of the enemy of the Digambara!'

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā vākyānmama patiḥ pauruṣe tu vyavasthitaḥ /
mumoca vipulāṃ śaktiṃ rakṣovakṣasthala prati //
meaning:
तस्या वाक्यान्मम पतिः पौरुषे तु व्यवस्थितः /
मुमोच विपुलां शक्तिं रक्षोवक्षस्थल प्रति //
text_mt: At her word, my husband, relying on his prowess, / hurled the vast spear toward the rākṣasa's chest.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalantī jvalanaprakhyā dyotayantī diśo daśa /
divyāṃśutīkṣṇa vaktrātā kiṅkiṇīśatanāditā //
meaning:
ज्वलन्ती ज्वलनप्रख्या द्योतयन्ती दिशो दश /
दिव्यांशुतीक्ष्ण वक्त्राता किङ्किणीशतनादिता //
text_mt: Blazing like fire, illuminating the ten directions, / with a tip sharp with divine radiance, resounding with hundreds of bells,

sanskrit_iast:
raktacandanaliptāṅgī raktavastropaśobhitā /
hṛdi tasya nipatyāsau śaktirviprakaracyutā //
meaning:
रक्तचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी रक्तवस्त्रोपशोभिता /
हृदि तस्य निपत्यासौ शक्तिर्विप्रकरच्युता //
text_mt: its surface smeared with red sandalwood, adorned with red cloth, / that spear, released from the brāhmaṇa's hand, fell upon his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ tu rākṣasaṃ gaganaṃ yayau /
pātayitvā svabhartāraṃ viprahastena rākṣasī //
meaning:
कृत्वा भस्मावशेषं तु राक्षसं गगनं ययौ /
पातयित्वा स्वभर्तारं विप्रहस्तेन राक्षसी //
text_mt: Reducing the rākṣasa to a heap of ashes, it soared into the sky. / Having caused her own husband to be struck down by the brāhmaṇa's hand,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene hṛṣṭatanūruhā /
athovāca dvijaṃ hṛṣṭā rākṣasī śubhalocanam //
meaning:
कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मेने हृष्टतनूरुहा /
अथोवाच द्विजं हृष्टा राक्षसी शुभलोचनम् //
text_mt: the rākṣasī considered herself to have accomplished her goal, her body-hairs bristling with joy. / Then the delighted rākṣasī spoke to the fair-eyed twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
ehi kānta guhāṃ ramyāṃ praviśa tvaṃ yadṛcchayā /
bhuṅkṣva bhogānmayā sārddhaṃ ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ //
meaning:
एहि कान्त गुहां रम्यां प्रविश त्वं यदृच्छया /
भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्मया सार्द्धं ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः //
text_mt: 'Come, O beloved, enter the delightful cave at your pleasure! / Enjoy pleasures with me, both celestial and human.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti prāṇanātho me prāhahṛṣṭavapustadā /
tataḥ sādāya me kāntaṃ svāṃ praviṣṭā guhāṃ mudā //
meaning:
तथेति प्राणनाथो मे प्राहहृष्टवपुस्तदा /
ततः सादाय मे कान्तं स्वां प्रविष्टा गुहां मुदा //
text_mt: 'So be it,' my life-lord replied, his body rejoicing at that time. / Then, taking my beloved, she joyfully entered her cave.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃvīkṣyaiva tadbhasma bhartṛdehasamudbhavam /
kucābhyāmunnatābhyāṃ sā madbhartāramapīḍayat //
meaning:
असंवीक्ष्यैव तद्भस्म भर्तृदेहसमुद्भवम् /
कुचाभ्यामुन्नताभ्यां सा मद्भर्तारमपीडयत् //
text_mt: Without even looking at the ashes born from her husband's body, / she pressed my husband with her swelling breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
darśayāmāsa tāṃ tanvīṃ kumārīṃ śayane sthitām /
iyaṃ tenāsitāpāṅgī bimboṣṭhī kāñcanaprabhā //
meaning:
दर्शयामास तां तन्वीं कुमारीं शयने स्थिताम् /
इयं तेनासितापाङ्गी बिम्बोष्ठी काञ्चनप्रभा //
text_mt: She showed him that slender maiden lying on the bed: / 'This girl of black outer corners of the eyes, bimbā-like lips, and golden radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryārthe samupānītā vārāṇasyā dvijottama /
yasyāḥ sīmāṃ na laṅghanti pātakāni hyaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
भार्यार्थे समुपानीता वाराणस्या द्विजोत्तम /
यस्याः सीमां न लङ्घन्ति पातकानि ह्यशेषतः //
text_mt: was brought from Vārāṇasī for the sake of becoming a wife, O best of the twice-born, / beyond whose boundary sins in their entirety do not cross.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktikṣetraṃ ca tāṃ prāhuḥ puṇyaṃ pāpakṣayaṅkaram /
yā gṛhaṃ tripurāreśca pañcagavyūtisaṃsthitā //
meaning:
शक्तिक्षेत्रं च तां प्राहुः पुण्यं पापक्षयङ्करम् /
या गृहं त्रिपुरारेश्च पञ्चगव्यूतिसंस्थिता //
text_mt: They call it the field of power, sacred, destroying sins, / the home of the Enemy of Tripura, extending for five krosas,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ mṛtāḥ punarmartyā garbhavāsaṃ viśanti na /
sa tvamasyā gṛhaṃ pitryaṃ punarnaya sulocanām //
meaning:
यस्यां मृताः पुनर्मर्त्या गर्भवासं विशन्ति न /
स त्वमस्या गृहं पित्र्यं पुनर्नय सुलोचनाम् //
text_mt: dying in which mortals never again enter the dwelling of a womb. / Take this fair-eyed girl back to her paternal home.

sanskrit_iast:
imāni tava ratnāni śayanānyāsanāni ca /
mayā saha samastāni vikrīṇīhi nijecchayā //
meaning:
इमानि तव रत्नानि शयनान्यासनानि च /
मया सह समस्तानि विक्रीणीहि निजेच्छया //
text_mt: These jewels, beds, and seats of yours, / sell them all together with me according to your desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadarthe rākṣaso ghoro mayā brahmanniṣūditaḥ /
mugdhayā tava rūpeṇa preṣito yamasādanam //
meaning:
त्वदर्थे राक्षसो घोरो मया ब्रह्मन्निषूदितः /
मुग्धया तव रूपेण प्रेषितो यमसादनम् //
text_mt: For your sake, O brāhmaṇa, the terrible rākṣasa was slain by me; / captivated by your beauty, I sent him to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmamopiri vibho kṛtvā viśvāsamātmanā /
bhajasva māṃ viśālākṣa bhaktāṃ vai kāmarūpiṇīm //
meaning:
तस्मान्ममोपिरि विभो कृत्वा विश्वासमात्मना /
भजस्व मां विशालाक्ष भक्तां वै कामरूपिणीम् //
text_mt: Therefore, having placed your trust in me, O lord, / enjoy me, O wide-eyed one, your devoted woman who can assume any form at will.'

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhartā me cārulocane /
rākṣasyāḥ kāmataptāyāḥ kumāryāḥ sannidhau śubhe //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं भर्ता मे चारुलोचने /
राक्षस्याः कामतप्तायाः कुमार्याः सन्निधौ शुभे //
text_mt: Hearing these words of the rākṣasī burning with lust / in the presence of that maiden, O auspicious and fair-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca rākṣasīṃ tāṃ tu saśaṅko madhuraṃ vacaḥ /
subhage nītiśāstreṣu viśvastavyā na yoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
उवाच राक्षसीं तां तु सशङ्को मधुरं वचः /
सुभगे नीतिशास्त्रेषु विश्वस्तव्या न योषितः //
text_mt: my husband spoke sweet words to that rākṣasī, though filled with suspicion: / 'O fortunate one, according to the treatises on statecraft, women are not to be trusted.

sanskrit_iast:
kaumāraṃ yā patiṃ hanti sā kathaṃ māṃ na hiṃsati /
matto rūpādhikaṃ matvā paraṃ puruṣalaṃpaṭā //
meaning:
कौमारं या पतिं हन्ति सा कथं मां न हिंसति /
मत्तो रूपाधिकं मत्वा परं पुरुषलंपटा //
text_mt: How will she who slays her youthful husband not harm me, / lusting after other men, deeming another to surpass me in beauty?

sanskrit_iast: so 'haṃ viśvāsabhāvena viśvastaste varānane //
meaning: सो ऽहं विश्वासभावेन विश्वस्तस्ते वरानने //
text_mt: Yet, out of trust, I have trusted you, O fair-faced woman.

sanskrit_iast:
adya vātha paredyurvā pakṣe māse 'tha vatsare /
vyāpādaya yathecchaṃ vā tvāṃ prapanno 'smi bhāmini //
meaning:
अद्य वाथ परेद्युर्वा पक्षे मासे ऽथ वत्सरे /
व्यापादय यथेच्छं वा त्वां प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि भामिनि //
text_mt: Today, or tomorrow, or in a fortnight, a month, or a year, / slay me as you wish; I have surrendered to you, O passionate woman!

sanskrit_iast:
evameva tvayā kāryaṃ nādya copakṛtaṃ tava /
ātmā te sarvathā deyaḥ pratīkārasya hetave //
meaning:
एवमेव त्वया कार्यं नाद्य चोपकृतं तव /
आत्मा ते सर्वथा देयः प्रतीकारस्य हेतवे //
text_mt: Indeed, this is what you should do; no favor has been done for you today. / One's own self must be surrendered by all means for the sake of retaliation.

sanskrit_iast:
madarthe nihato bhartā tvayā niḥśaṅkayā yataḥ /
tato 'haṃ nottaraṃ vacmi paraṃ kiñcitsulocane //
meaning:
मदर्थे निहतो भर्ता त्वया निःशङ्कया यतः /
ततो ऽहं नोत्तरं वच्मि परं किञ्चित्सुलोचने //
text_mt: Since your husband was slain without hesitation by you for my sake, / therefore I speak no further answer, O fair-eyed one.'

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya madbhartuḥ sābravīdidam /
viśvastahiṃsanaṃ brahman brahmahatyā samaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य मद्भर्तुः साब्रवीदिदम् /
विश्वस्तहिंसनं ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्महत्या समं भवेत् //
text_mt: Hearing those words of my husband, she said this: / 'Slaying one who trusts, O brāhmaṇa, is equal to the slaying of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyevaṃ rākṣasīṃ krūrāṃ manyase patighātinīm /
patiṃ tathāpi garheyaṃ viśvastaṃ ghātaye katham //
meaning:
यद्येवं राक्षसीं क्रूरां मन्यसे पतिघातिनीम् /
पतिं तथापि गर्हेयं विश्वस्तं घातये कथम् //
text_mt: Even if you consider me a cruel rākṣasī who slays her husband, / I may blame my husband, yet how could I slay one who trusts?'

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmā hi dharmasya gatirna jñāyeta kathañcana /
kenāpi kutraciddevadaityarākṣasakādinā /
kecinmanuṣyāḥ paṭavo dharmasūkṣmatvacintane //
meaning:
सूक्ष्मा हि धर्मस्य गतिर्न ज्ञायेत कथञ्चन /
केनापि कुत्रचिद्देवदैत्यराक्षसकादिना /
केचिन्मनुष्याः पटवो धर्मसूक्ष्मत्वचिन्तने //
text_mt: Subtle indeed is the course of dharma; it cannot be known in any way / by anyone anywhere, whether gods, daityas, rākṣasas, or others; / yet some men are clever in contemplating the subtlety of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'nityena śarīreṇa naiṣkarmyaṃ sādhayantyuta /
śrūyate ca purāṇeṣu kiñcidatra nigadyate //
meaning:
ये ऽनित्येन शरीरेण नैष्कर्म्यं साधयन्त्युत /
श्रूयते च पुराणेषु किञ्चिदत्र निगद्यते //
text_mt: Those who accomplish actionlessness by means of this impermanent body, / and what is heard in the Purāṇas—a little of that is told here.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasyaivānukūlyena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā /
daśāvatāragrahaṇe duḥkhaṃ prāptamanekadhā //
meaning:
धर्मस्यैवानुकूल्येन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना /
दशावतारग्रहणे दुःखं प्राप्तमनेकधा //
text_mt: Solely in accordance with dharma, suffering in many ways / was experienced by the almighty Viṣṇu in assuming his ten descents.

sanskrit_iast:
kva sītārthaṃ śrīnivāso rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ /
vilāpaṃ kurute nāgapāśabandhādikarmasu //
meaning:
क्व सीतार्थं श्रीनिवासो रामो लक्ष्मणसंयुतः /
विलापं कुरुते नागपाशबन्धादिकर्मसु //
text_mt: Where Rāma, the abode of Śrī, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, / makes a lament for Sītā's sake in events such as the binding by the serpent-noose!

sanskrit_iast:
kva devadevo vasudevasūnurvijñānarūpo nikhalaprapañcī /
hā kaṣṭamityasradṛgādiceṣṭaḥ pārthograsanādikabhṛtyakṛtyaḥ //
meaning:
क्व देवदेवो वसुदेवसूनुर्विज्ञानरूपो निखलप्रपञ्ची /
हा कष्टमित्यस्रदृगादिचेष्टः पार्थोग्रसनादिकभृत्यकृत्यः //
text_mt: Where the god of gods, the son of Vasudeva, whose form is pure consciousness, who unfolds the entire phenomenal world, / whose actions include tearful eyes crying 'Alas, what misery!', and who performs the tasks of a servant for Pārtha, Ugrasena, and others!

sanskrit_iast:
īśasya kṛtyaṃ dvija durvibhāvyaṃ dharmānukūlyena samāsthitasya /
vyāsaḥ svayaṃ vedavibhāgakarttā pārāśaristattvadṛgijyamūrtiḥ /
kanyātvavidhvasakavīryajanmā kānīnasaṃjño 'nujadāragāmī //
meaning:
ईशस्य कृत्यं द्विज दुर्विभाव्यं धर्मानुकूल्येन समास्थितस्य /
व्यासः स्वयं वेदविभागकर्त्ता पाराशरिस्तत्त्वदृगिज्यमूर्तिः /
कन्यात्वविध्वसकवीर्यजन्मा कानीनसंज्ञो ऽनुजदारगामी //
text_mt: The action of the Lord who abides by the conformity to dharma is difficult to comprehend, O twice-born: / Vyāsa himself, the divider of the Vedas, son of Parāśara, seer of reality, an embodiment worthy of worship, / born of seed that destroyed maidenhood, called kānīna, approached his younger brother's wife.

sanskrit_iast:
parivettā ca didhiṣūḥ śantanuḥ svaḥsaritpattiḥ /
didhiṣū tanayaḥ sākṣādvasuḥ strīvādamṛtyubhāk //
meaning:
परिवेत्ता च दिधिषूः शन्तनुः स्वःसरित्पत्तिः /
दिधिषू तनयः साक्षाद्वसुः स्त्रीवादमृत्युभाक् //
text_mt: And Śantanu, the husband of the heavenly river, was an older brother married before the elder, a husband of an elder brother's widow; / his son, the husband of an elder brother's widow, an actual Vasu, suffered death due to an argument over a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
ye golakasutāḥ kuṇḍāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samayonigāḥ /
teṣāṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
ये गोलकसुताः कुण्डाः पाण्डवाः समयोनिगाः /
तेषां संकीर्तनं पुण्यं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: Those sons of adulterous unions, born of illegitimate intercourse, the Pāṇḍavas who went to the same womb— / the glorification of them is meritorious, purifying, and destroys sin.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dhyāyanti smarantyaddhā yogamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning: यं ध्यायन्ति स्मरन्त्यद्धा योगमूर्तिः सनातनः //
text_mt: He whom they truly meditate upon and remember is the eternal embodiment of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurveśyāsamāsaktaḥ prahlādādyupadeśakṛt /
śrīnṛsiṃho 'suradhvaṃsī devadevādhidaivatam //
meaning:
विष्णुर्वेश्यासमासक्तः प्रह्लादाद्युपदेशकृत् /
श्रीनृसिंहो ऽसुरध्वंसी देवदेवाधिदैवतम् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu attached to a courtesan, the instructor of Prahlāda and others; / Śrī Nṛsiṃha, the destroyer of asuras, the supreme deity of the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāravāsanādhvaṃsī devadevādhidaivatam /
saṃsāravāsanādhvaṃsī svarṇākṣabhavanasthitiḥ //
meaning:
संसारवासनाध्वंसी देवदेवाधिदैवतम् /
संसारवासनाध्वंसी स्वर्णाक्षभवनस्थितिः //
text_mt: destroyer of worldly latent impressions, the supreme deity of the god of gods, / destroyer of worldly latent impressions, resided in the mansion of Golden-Eye.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmadagnyaḥ svayaṃ siddhastapasā dagdhakilbiṣaḥ /
īśvaraḥ kṣatrasaṃhārabhrūṇahatyādikarmakṛt //
meaning:
जामदग्न्यः स्वयं सिद्धस्तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषः /
ईश्वरः क्षत्रसंहारभ्रूणहत्यादिकर्मकृत् //
text_mt: Jāmadagnya, himself an adept whose sins were burned by austerities, / the Lord, committed the massacre of the kṣatriyas, the killing of embryos, and other deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamevarṣabho yogī lokaśikṣāparo dvijaḥ /
lokaglānikaro jātaḥ kurvandharmānurodhataḥ //
meaning:
स्वयमेवर्षभो योगी लोकशिक्षापरो द्विजः /
लोकग्लानिकरो जातः कुर्वन्धर्मानुरोधतः //
text_mt: The yogī Ṛṣabha himself, a twice-born intent on instructing the world, / became one who caused distress to the world, acting in accordance with dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
nārado nārado bhūyo bhūyo bhūyo 'pi nāradaḥ /
nārāyaṇaparo nāro naro narahito 'maraḥ //
meaning:
नारदो नारदो भूयो भूयो भूयो ऽपि नारदः /
नारायणपरो नारो नरो नरहितो ऽमरः //
text_mt: Nārada is Nārada, and again and again Nārada— / the immortal man devoted to Nārāyaṇa, beneficial to men.

sanskrit_iast:
gautamo gautamo vipra gopaceṣṭāparāyaṇaḥ /
vedabāhyārthasaṃyuktaśāstrī vedopakāra kṛt //
meaning:
गौतमो गौतमो विप्र गोपचेष्टापरायणः /
वेदबाह्यार्थसंयुक्तशास्त्री वेदोपकार कृत् //
text_mt: Gautama, O vipra, Gautama intent upon cowherd behaviour, / teacher of a treatise conjoined with meanings outside the Veda, yet a benefactor of the Veda!

sanskrit_iast:
vasuṣṭhaścorvaśījāto 'gastyo 'pi svayamīśvarau /
yena lokopakārārthaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ śāstramuttamam //
meaning:
वसुष्ठश्चोर्वशीजातो ऽगस्त्यो ऽपि स्वयमीश्वरौ /
येन लोकोपकारार्थं वासिष्ठं शास्त्रमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: And Vasiṣṭha and Agastya, born of Urvaśī, were themselves lords; / by whom, for the benefit of the world, the supreme treatise of Vasiṣṭha was made,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ yasminpurāṇāni vedāḥ sāmyatvamāgatāḥ /
yaḥ svayaṃ rāmacandrasya guruḥ sarveśvarasya ca //
meaning:
कृतं यस्मिन्पुराणानि वेदाः साम्यत्वमागताः /
यः स्वयं रामचन्द्रस्य गुरुः सर्वेश्वरस्य च //
text_mt: in which the Purāṇas and the Vedas have attained equality; / he who was himself the guru of Rāmacandra and the Lord of all—

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ gādhijāśaptastiryagyonimupāgamat /
yo damitvā vibhurvindhyaṃ vātāpiṃ sāgaraṃ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
स कथं गाधिजाशप्तस्तिर्यग्योनिमुपागमत् /
यो दमित्वा विभुर्विन्ध्यं वातापिं सागरं स्थितः //
text_mt: how did he, cursed by the son of Gādhi, enter into animal birth? / He who, a mighty one, subduing the Vindhya, Vātāpi, and the ocean, remained—

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ mṛtakādātā duṣkaraṃ samupāsate /
yo vidhiḥ karmasākṣyādivandyo mānyaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
स कथं मृतकादाता दुष्करं समुपासते /
यो विधिः कर्मसाक्ष्यादिवन्द्यो मान्यः पितामहः //
text_mt: how did he, a receiver of corpses, perform what is hard to do? / Vidhi, who is the witness of actions and so forth, adorable, the venerable grandfather—

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīmohito dehamutsasarja kathaṃ sa ca /
yaḥ śivaḥ śivadaḥ sākṣātprakṛtīśaḥ parātparaḥ //
meaning:
मोहिनीमोहितो देहमुत्ससर्ज कथं स च /
यः शिवः शिवदः साक्षात्प्रकृतीशः परात्परः //
text_mt: how did he, infatuated by Mohinī, cast off his body? / He who is Śiva, the bestower of auspiciousness, directly the Lord of nature, higher than the highest—

sanskrit_iast:
sa kathaṃ devapatnīgaḥ śmaśānāśubhaceṣṭitaḥ /
tasmāddvija sadācāro niṣevyo vidhinā vidhiḥ //
meaning:
स कथं देवपत्नीगः श्मशानाशुभचेष्टितः /
तस्माद्द्विज सदाचारो निषेव्यो विधिना विधिः //
text_mt: how did he consort with gods' wives and engage in inauspicious practices in the cremation ground? / Therefore, O twice-born, proper conduct, the sacred injunction, must be observed according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tamahaṃbhāvanāyukto no heyādyo vidāṃ varaḥ /
sa śāntimāpnuyādagryāṃ dhamyāmubhayasaṃsthitām //
meaning:
तमहंभावनायुक्तो नो हेयाद्यो विदां वरः /
स शान्तिमाप्नुयादग्र्यां धम्यामुभयसंस्थिताम् //
text_mt: Joined with the notion of ego, that foremost of the knowers should not be abandoned; / he would attain the foremost, righteous peace that abides in both.

sanskrit_iast:
āpavargyaḥ smṛto dharmo dhanaṃ dharmaikasādhanam /
tanmayā sādhito dharmaḥ sarvottamadhanātmanā //
meaning:
आपवर्ग्यः स्मृतो धर्मो धनं धर्मैकसाधनम् /
तन्मया साधितो धर्मः सर्वोत्तमधनात्मना //
text_mt: Dharma is traditional lore leading to liberation, and wealth is the sole means for dharma; / that dharma has been accomplished by me whose nature is the supreme wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu viprātra dharmasya gatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ vadāmyaham /
yadā samāgato bhartā mama kanyāṃ samāharan //
meaning:
शृणु विप्रात्र धर्मस्य गतिं सूक्ष्मां वदाम्यहम् /
यदा समागतो भर्ता मम कन्यां समाहरन् //
text_mt: Listen, O vipra: here I will speak the subtle course of dharma, / when my husband came, abducting the maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ paśyan nijakarmasthaṃ ko 'pi doṣo na tasya vai /
mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ nāma kanyeyaṃ samupāhṛtā //
meaning:
त्वां पश्यन् निजकर्मस्थं को ऽपि दोषो न तस्य वै /
मया पृष्टः कथं नाम कन्येयं समुपाहृता //
text_mt: Seeing you steadfast in your own duty, no fault at all attached to him. / I asked him: 'How was this maiden abducted?'

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tena mṛṣā vākyamuktaṃ madbhakṣaṇārthakam /
tanniśamyāha māṃ baddhā svayaṃ cāsthāni darśanāt //
meaning:
तदा तेन मृषा वाक्यमुक्तं मद्भक्षणार्थकम् /
तन्निशम्याह मां बद्धा स्वयं चास्थानि दर्शनात् //
text_mt: Then he spoke a false word for the sake of devouring me. / Hearing that, he tied me up, and I myself [fell] into the bones out of fear.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vadanti ca dāṃpatye bhāryā mokṣavirodhinī /
na te tattvadṛśo jñeyā na sā bhāryā virodhinī //
meaning:
ये वदन्ति च दांपत्ये भार्या मोक्षविरोधिनी /
न ते तत्त्वदृशो ज्ञेया न सा भार्या विरोधिनी //
text_mt: Those who say that in married life a wife is an obstacle to liberation— / they are not to be regarded as seers of truth; such a wife is not an obstacle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryā samuddharetpāpātpatantaṃ niraye patim /
sā bhāryānyā karmavallīrūpā saṃsāradāyīnī //
meaning:
भार्या समुद्धरेत्पापात्पतन्तं निरये पतिम् /
सा भार्यान्या कर्मवल्लीरूपा संसारदायीनी //
text_mt: A wife delivers her husband from sin as he falls into hell. / She is a [true] wife; any other is of the nature of a vine of karma that brings about worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaṃ kimatra tanmattaḥ samyakchṛṇu svayaṃ vara /
alīkaṃ naiva vaktavyaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi //
meaning:
पापं किमत्र तन्मत्तः सम्यक्छृणु स्वयं वर /
अलीकं नैव वक्तव्यं प्राणैः कण्ठगतैरपि //
text_mt: What is sin here? Hear it properly from me, O chosen one: / an untruth should never be spoken, even when life has reached the throat.

sanskrit_iast:
satyamevācaretsatye sākṣāddharme vyavasthitaḥ /
satye samāsthito brahmā satye santaḥ samāsthitāḥ //
meaning:
सत्यमेवाचरेत्सत्ये साक्षाद्धर्मे व्यवस्थितः /
सत्ये समास्थितो ब्रह्मा सत्ये सन्तः समास्थिताः //
text_mt: One established in truth alone, which is visible dharma, should practice truth; / Brahmā is founded on truth; the virtuous are founded on truth.

sanskrit_iast:
satye samāsthitaṃ viśvaṃ sarvadā sacarācaram /
satyaṃ brūyāditi vaco vedānteṣu pragīyate //
meaning:
सत्ये समास्थितं विश्वं सर्वदा सचराचरम् /
सत्यं ब्रूयादिति वचो वेदान्तेषु प्रगीयते //
text_mt: The entire universe, moving and unmoving, is always founded on truth. / 'Speak the truth' is the precept proclaimed in the Upaniṣads.

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ hi tatsatyamabhidhīmahi /
satyaṃ tu sarvadā vipra maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam //
meaning:
सत्यं ब्रह्मस्वरूपं हि तत्सत्यमभिधीमहि /
सत्यं तु सर्वदा विप्र मङ्गलं मङ्गलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Truth is indeed the nature of Brahman; we declare that truth. / For truth, O twice-born one, is always auspicious and bestows auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
asatyamātmakṣayadaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam /
strīṣu satyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ tatrāpi śṛṇu kāraṇam //
meaning:
असत्यमात्मक्षयदं सद्यः प्रत्ययकारकम् /
स्त्रीषु सत्यं न वक्तव्यं तत्रापि शृणु कारणम् //
text_mt: Untruth brings destruction to oneself and immediately produces mistrust. / Truth should not be spoken to women; hear the reason even for that:

sanskrit_iast:
nidhiṃ striyai na kathayedityādau doṣavāraṇam /
uktaṃ taddharmajanakaṃ dharmasūkṣmatvadarśakam //
meaning:
निधिं स्त्रियै न कथयेदित्यादौ दोषवारणम् /
उक्तं तद्धर्मजनकं धर्मसूक्ष्मत्वदर्शकम् //
text_mt: 'One should not reveal a hidden treasure to a woman'—such an avoidance of fault / is declared to be conducive to dharma and reveals the subtlety of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśā dvijā jalaṃ vahnirvedā bhūkāladiksurāḥ /
sākṣye yatra vivāheṣu dāṃpatyaṃ tadudīritam //
meaning:
कुशा द्विजा जलं वह्निर्वेदा भूकालदिक्सुराः /
साक्ष्ये यत्र विवाहेषु दांपत्यं तदुदीरितम् //
text_mt: Kuśa grass, twice-born men, water, fire, the Vedas, the earth, time, the directions, and the gods— / where these are witnesses in marriages, that is called matrimony.

sanskrit_iast:
samaṅgīkaraṇaṃ karma vivāhe tu vidhīyate /
strīpuṃsordvijasaṃskāre nirdiṣṭaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ //
meaning:
समङ्गीकरणं कर्म विवाहे तु विधीयते /
स्त्रीपुंसोर्द्विजसंस्कारे निर्दिष्टं गुरुशिष्ययोः //
text_mt: A rite of mutual union is prescribed in marriage, / declared between man and woman, as between guru and disciple in the initiation of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātparasparaṃ jñeyo guruśiṣyau vadhūvarau /
nānayoraṇumātro 'pi bhedo bodhyo vijānatā //
meaning:
तस्मात्परस्परं ज्ञेयो गुरुशिष्यौ वधूवरौ /
नानयोरणुमात्रो ऽपि भेदो बोध्यो विजानता //
text_mt: Therefore, bride and groom should be known as guru and disciple to each other; / not the slightest difference between the two should be perceived by one who understands.

sanskrit_iast:
tattatkarmānurūpatvātprādhānyastrīniyojyayoḥ /
kvacidvyatyayadoṣaśceddaivamevātra kāraṇam //
meaning:
तत्तत्कर्मानुरूपत्वात्प्राधान्यस्त्रीनियोज्ययोः /
क्वचिद्व्यत्ययदोषश्चेद्दैवमेवात्र कारणम् //
text_mt: In accordance with each particular duty, primacy belongs either to the woman or the one to be directed; / if somewhere there is the fault of an inversion, destiny alone is the cause there.

sanskrit_iast:
daivādhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
daivaṃ tatpūrvajanmāni saṃcitāḥ karmavāsanāḥ //
meaning:
दैवाधीनं जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
दैवं तत्पूर्वजन्मानि संचिताः कर्मवासनाः //
text_mt: The entire world, together with gods, asuras, and humans, is subservient to destiny. / That destiny consists of the impressions of karma accumulated in previous births.

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaṃ niṣevannanyonyaṃ vartate kāmakārakam /
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vipra taṃ tu śāntaṃ vidurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
प्राप्तं निषेवन्नन्योन्यं वर्तते कामकारकम् /
शुभं वाप्यशुभं विप्र तं तु शान्तं विदुर्बुधाः //
text_mt: Indulging in what has befallen, acting mutually out of desire, / whether good or bad, O twice-born one—the wise know him who is tranquil.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaḥ satyasamācāro janturlokapratārakaḥ /
evamādi viditvā tu nāyaṃ bhartā nipātitaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तः सत्यसमाचारो जन्तुर्लोकप्रतारकः /
एवमादि विदित्वा तु नायं भर्ता निपातितः //
text_mt: A creature who is peaceful and behaves truthfully is a deceiver of the world [if acting otherwise]; / having understood such things, this husband was not cast down [by me].

sanskrit_iast:
kanyātvadhvaṃsakātpāpātpūto madupakārataḥ /
gatiṃ prayātaḥ kṛtināṃ tvaddhastavinipātitaḥ //
meaning:
कन्यात्वध्वंसकात्पापात्पूतो मदुपकारतः /
गतिं प्रयातः कृतिनां त्वद्धस्तविनिपातितः //
text_mt: Purified through my benefaction from the sin of destroying maidenhood, / and brought down by your hand, he has gone to the destiny of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā tūpakṛtaṃ patye jānantyā dharmasūkṣyatām /
tvatprāṇarakṣaṇe dharmo mamābhūddvijasattama //
meaning:
मया तूपकृतं पत्ये जानन्त्या धर्मसूक्ष्यताम् /
त्वत्प्राणरक्षणे धर्मो ममाभूद्द्विजसत्तम //
text_mt: Benefit was rendered by me to my husband, knowing the subtlety of dharma; / in protecting your life, merit accrued to me, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tena dharmeṇa kiṃ prāptamiti samyaṅnibodha me /
rākṣasīṃ yonimāpannā rākṣasasya priyā hyaham //
meaning:
तेन धर्मेण किं प्राप्तमिति सम्यङ्निबोध मे /
राक्षसीं योनिमापन्ना राक्षसस्य प्रिया ह्यहम् //
text_mt: Hear properly from me what was obtained through that merit: / though born into a rākṣasa womb and the beloved of a rākṣasa,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarūpā brāhmaṇī tu saṃjātā dharmakāraṇāt /
dharmakāmadughā dhenuḥ saṃtoṣo nandanaṃ vanam //
meaning:
कामरूपा ब्राह्मणी तु संजाता धर्मकारणात् /
धर्मकामदुघा धेनुः संतोषो नन्दनं वनम् //
text_mt: I became a brāhmaṇa woman able to take any form at will, because of dharma. / Dharma is the wish-fulfilling cow; contentment is the Nandana grove;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā mokṣakarī proktā tṛṣṇā vaitaraṇī nadī /
vaitaraṇyāṃ patanbhartā mayoddhṛta ihābhavat //
meaning:
विद्या मोक्षकरी प्रोक्ता तृष्णा वैतरणी नदी /
वैतरण्यां पतन्भर्ता मयोद्धृत इहाभवत् //
text_mt: knowledge is declared to bring liberation; craving is the Vaitaraṇī river. / My husband, falling into the Vaitaraṇī, was rescued here by me.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāścopakṛtaṃ vipra varṇottamaniveśanāt /
iyaṃ tvasaṃginī bhāryā bhaviṣyati piturgṛhe //
meaning:
अस्याश्चोपकृतं विप्र वर्णोत्तमनिवेशनात् /
इयं त्वसंगिनी भार्या भविष्यति पितुर्गृहे //
text_mt: And a benefit was done to her, O brahmin, by settling her with the best of castes; / but this one, without clinging, shall remain as a wife in her father's house.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tavāsyāśca sadā rakṣikā dharmabodhinī /
matsaṃgamātpūrvameva yā bhāryā vipra te 'bhavat //
meaning:
अहं तवास्याश्च सदा रक्षिका धर्मबोधिनी /
मत्संगमात्पूर्वमेव या भार्या विप्र ते ऽभवत् //
text_mt: I am ever the protector of you and her, teaching the dharma. / The one who was your wife, O brahmin, before you met me—

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ tvatsaṃginī bhāryā bhaviṣyati varānanā /
sāpi tiryaggatiṃ prāpya mucyate madanugrahāt //
meaning:
इयं त्वत्संगिनी भार्या भविष्यति वरानना /
सापि तिर्यग्गतिं प्राप्य मुच्यते मदनुग्रहात् //
text_mt: this fair-faced one shall become your companion wife. / Having attained the condition of an animal, she too is liberated by my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ purā bhave 'bhūvaṃ ramaṇī lokasundarī /
kandalīti ca vikhyātā tanayaurvamunerdvija //
meaning:
अहं पुरा भवे ऽभूवं रमणी लोकसुन्दरी /
कन्दलीति च विख्याता तनयौर्वमुनेर्द्विज //
text_mt: Formerly, in another birth, I was a delightful woman, lovely in all the worlds, / renowned as Kandalī, O twice-born, the daughter of the sage Aurva.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥ prabhāvātsaṃjātā yamalā mithunandharā /
puruṣo me sahabhavo damito dharmakāraṇāt //
meaning:
तपः प्रभावात्संजाता यमला मिथुनन्धरा /
पुरुषो मे सहभवो दमितो धर्मकारणात् //
text_mt: Born through the power of asceticism as twins, bearing a pair; / my brother born with me was disciplined for the sake of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaivaurveṇa śiṣṭāhaṃ dattā durvāsase bhavam /
taṃ patiṃ prāpya viprendra prākkarmavaśāgā hyaham //
meaning:
तेनैवौर्वेण शिष्टाहं दत्ता दुर्वाससे भवम् /
तं पतिं प्राप्य विप्रेन्द्र प्राक्कर्मवशागा ह्यहम् //
text_mt: Instructed by that same Aurva, I was given to Durvāsas for worldly life. / Having obtained him as a husband, O best of brahmins, I fell under the sway of past karma;

sanskrit_iast:
kalahābhiratā patyā śaptā bhasmatvamāgatā /
kiñcitpāpāvaśeṣeṇa rākṣasīṃ yonimāgatā //
meaning:
कलहाभिरता पत्या शप्ता भस्मत्वमागता /
किञ्चित्पापावशेषेण राक्षसीं योनिमागता //
text_mt: delighting in quarrel, I was cursed by my husband and reduced to ashes; / with a remnant of some sin, I came into the womb of a rākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yonau mayā labdho bhartāyaṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ /
gobhilo nāma tejasvī sa tvayā vinipātitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र योनौ मया लब्धो भर्तायं राक्षसाधिपः /
गोभिलो नाम तेजस्वी स त्वया विनिपातितः //
text_mt: In that womb I obtained this husband, the lord of rākṣasas, / named Gobhila, full of vigor; he was struck down by you.

sanskrit_iast:
śopo 'sya pūrvavayasibabhūva dvijasattama /
kasyāścidrājakanyāyāḥ striyā'rabdhā mṛtistava //
meaning:
शोपो ऽस्य पूर्ववयसिबभूव द्विजसत्तम /
कस्याश्चिद्राजकन्यायाः स्त्रियाऽरब्धा मृतिस्तव //
text_mt: In his early life there was a curse upon him, O best of the twice-born: / "Your death will be caused by a woman, the daughter of some king."

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu rākṣasībhāvarahitā pūrvakarmaṇaḥ /
śubhasya balamāpannā jātā tava sahāyinī //
meaning:
अहं तु राक्षसीभावरहिता पूर्वकर्मणः /
शुभस्य बलमापन्ना जाता तव सहायिनी //
text_mt: I, however, freed from the nature of a rākṣasa, having attained the power / of previous auspicious karma, have become your helper.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhitāhaṃ kṛtā bhartrā kumāryāharaṇātpurā /
bhāryātha pāpinā brahmaṃstena vyāpādito mayā //
meaning:
दुःखिताहं कृता भर्त्रा कुमार्याहरणात्पुरा /
भार्याथ पापिना ब्रह्मंस्तेन व्यापादितो मया //
text_mt: I was made sorrowful by my husband in the past through the abduction of maidens; / therefore that sinful wife-abductor, O brahmin, was slain by me.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvasto hi yatastvaṃ vai mama sarveṇa cetasā /
tatastvāṃ gopayiṣyāmi sarvabhāvena kāmuka //
meaning:
विश्वस्तो हि यतस्त्वं वै मम सर्वेण चेतसा /
ततस्त्वां गोपयिष्यामि सर्वभावेन कामुक //
text_mt: Since you have truly trusted me with your whole heart, / therefore I shall protect you with all my being, O passionate one.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa te śapathaḥ satyaḥ pañcabhūtopasākṣikaḥ /
kṛtsnasya puruṣasyeha sannidhau vyāhṛto mayā //
meaning:
एष ते शपथः सत्यः पञ्चभूतोपसाक्षिकः /
कृत्स्नस्य पुरुषस्येह सन्निधौ व्याहृतो मया //
text_mt: This true oath is made to you, with the five elements as witnesses, / uttered by me here in the presence of the whole cosmic person.

sanskrit_iast:
na karoṣi dvijaśreṣṭha saṃvidaṃ hyanyathā kvacit /
madvākye bhavatā stheyaṃ sarvakṛtyeṣu mānada //
meaning:
न करोषि द्विजश्रेष्ठ संविदं ह्यन्यथा क्वचित् /
मद्वाक्ये भवता स्थेयं सर्वकृत्येषु मानद //
text_mt: You do not, O foremost of the twice-born, violate your agreement anywhere; / you should abide by my word in all undertakings, O honor-giver.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ rākṣasyā paribhāṣitam /
pratipede vacaḥ sarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ hi tayā tadā //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं राक्षस्या परिभाषितम् /
प्रतिपेदे वचः सर्वं यत्कृतं हि तया तदा //
text_mt: Having heard this speech spoken by the rākṣasa woman, / he consented to all the conditions that were made by her then.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā rākṣasī sarvaṃ saṃpragṛhya guhādhanam /
kareṇurūpiṇī bhūtvā pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā patiṃ mama //
meaning:
ततः सा राक्षसी सर्वं संप्रगृह्य गुहाधनम् /
करेणुरूपिणी भूत्वा पृष्ठे कृत्वा पतिं मम //
text_mt: Then that rākṣasa woman, taking all the wealth from the cave, / assumed the form of a female elephant and placed my husband on her back;

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saha viśālākṣyā ratnāvalyā mudānvitā /
yayāvākāśamārgeṇa kāśīmabhi mulocane //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite kāṣṭhīlopākhyānaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तया सह विशालाक्ष्या रत्नावल्या मुदान्विता /
ययावाकाशमार्गेण काशीमभि मुलोचने //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते काष्ठीलोपाख्यानं नामाष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
together with that large-eyed Ratnāvalī, filled with joy, / she went through the path of the sky towards Kāśī, O fair-eyed one.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named the Story of Kāṣṭhīla, in the Mohinīcarita of the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhīlovāca
evaṃ sā rākṣasī subhru hastinīrūpadhāriṇī /
tribhirmuhūrtaiḥ saṃprāptā kāśīṃ viśveśamandiram //
meaning:
काष्ठीलोवाच
एवं सा राक्षसी सुभ्रु हस्तिनीरूपधारिणी /
त्रिभिर्मुहूर्तैः संप्राप्ता काशीं विश्वेशमन्दिरम् //
title: athaikonatriśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Kāṣṭhīla said: / In this way, O fair-browed one, that rākṣasa woman, bearing the form of a female elephant, / reached Kāśī, the temple of the Lord of the Universe, within three muhūrtas.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca tāṃ purīṃ prāpya bhartāramasitekṣaṇā /
iyaṃ pāpataroḥ kānta kuṭhārā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
उवाच तां पुरीं प्राप्य भर्तारमसितेक्षणा /
इयं पापतरोः कान्त कुठारा परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: Having reached that city, the dark-eyed one said to her husband: / "Beloved, this [city] is proclaimed an axe to the tree of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍūrmikāñcanasyaiṣā kānta proktā durodarī /
karmabījopaśamanī sarveṣāṃ gatidāyikā //
meaning:
षडूर्मिकाञ्चनस्यैषा कान्त प्रोक्ता दुरोदरी /
कर्मबीजोपशमनी सर्वेषां गतिदायिका //
text_mt: Beloved, she is declared the gambler's board against the gold of the six waves, / the pacifier of the seeds of karma, bestowing the [highest] path on all.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ hi vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ purāṇāḥ saṃpracakṣate /
nāvaiṣṇave sthale muktiḥ sarvasya tu kadācana //
meaning:
आद्यं हि वैष्णवं स्थानं पुराणाः संप्रचक्षते /
नावैष्णवे स्थले मुक्तिः सर्वस्य तु कदाचन //
text_mt: The ancients declare it to be the primal Vaiṣṇava sacred site; / nowhere in a non-Vaiṣṇava place does liberation ever arise for anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhavasya purī ceyaṃ pūrvamāsīddvijottama /
muktidā sarvajantūnāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinī //
meaning:
माधवस्य पुरी चेयं पूर्वमासीद्द्विजोत्तम /
मुक्तिदा सर्वजन्तूनां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी //
text_mt: Formerly, O best of the twice-born, this was Mādhava's city, / bestowing liberation upon all creatures, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā śaṅkaro devo draṣṭuṃ prāgātpitāmaham /
sarvalokaikakartāraṃ bhrājamānaṃ svatejasā //
meaning:
एकदा शङ्करो देवो द्रष्टुं प्रागात्पितामहम् /
सर्वलोकैककर्तारं भ्राजमानं स्वतेजसा //
text_mt: Once, the god Śaṅkara went to see the Grandfather, / the sole creator of all the worlds, shining with his own splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā tatra mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum /
namaskṛtya sthito hyagre vedapāṭhaṃ niśāmayan //
meaning:
गत्वा तत्र महादेवो ब्रह्माणं जगतां गुरुम् /
नमस्कृत्य स्थितो ह्यग्रे वेदपाठं निशामयन् //
text_mt: Having gone there, Mahādeva bowed to Brahmā, the guru of the worlds, / and stood before him, listening to the recitation of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiradbhutaivaktraiścaturo nigamānmudā /
udgirantaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā prīto 'bhavattadā //
meaning:
चतुर्भिरद्भुतैवक्त्रैश्चतुरो निगमान्मुदा /
उद्गिरन्तं जगन्नाथं दृष्ट्वा प्रीतो ऽभवत्तदा //
text_mt: Seeing the Lord of the World joyfully chanting the four Vedas / with his four wondrous faces, he was pleased at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tatpañcamaṃ vaktraṃ brahmaṇo bhūtanāyakaḥ /
pragalbhaṃ tamupālakṣya kṣaṇājjātaḥ samatsaraḥ //
meaning:
अथ तत्पञ्चमं वक्त्रं ब्रह्मणो भूतनायकः /
प्रगल्भं तमुपालक्ष्य क्षणाज्जातः समत्सरः //
text_mt: Then, observing the fifth face of Brahmā to be insolent, / the lord of spirits instantly became envious.

sanskrit_iast:
sa krodhajanmā viprendra tasya prāgalbhyamakṣaman /
cakarta tannakhāgreṇa khasthaṃ vaktraṃ trilocanaḥ //
meaning:
स क्रोधजन्मा विप्रेन्द्र तस्य प्रागल्भ्यमक्षमन् /
चकर्त तन्नखाग्रेण खस्थं वक्त्रं त्रिलोचनः //
text_mt: Overcome with anger, O best of brahmins, unable to tolerate his insolence, / the three-eyed one cut off that skyward face with the tip of his fingernail.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchinnaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śīrṣaṃ saṃlagnaṃ karapallave /
vāme nirdhūtamāniśaṃ na nivṛttaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
तच्छिन्नं ब्रह्मणः शीर्षं संलग्नं करपल्लवे /
वामे निर्धूतमानिशं न निवृत्तं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: That severed head of Brahmā clung to the sprout-like fingers / of his left hand; though shaken day and night, it did not fall away, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā tu duḥkhito bhūtvā tasthau sthāṇuṃ vyalokayan /
rudro 'pi lajjito bhūtvā nirjjagāma tvarānvitaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा तु दुःखितो भूत्वा तस्थौ स्थाणुं व्यलोकयन् /
रुद्रो ऽपि लज्जितो भूत्वा निर्ज्जगाम त्वरान्वितः //
text_mt: Brahmā, becoming sorrowful, stood looking at Sthāṇu; / Rudra too became ashamed and quickly went away.

sanskrit_iast:
bahudhā yatamāno 'pi tacchiraḥ kṣeptumāturaḥ /
na śaśāka parityaktuṃ tadadbhutamabhūnmahat //
meaning:
बहुधा यतमानो ऽपि तच्छिरः क्षेप्तुमातुरः /
न शशाक परित्यक्तुं तदद्भुतमभून्महत् //
text_mt: Though striving in many ways, eager to cast off that head, / he was unable to abandon it; that was a great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayā vyākulo bhūtvā sasmāra garuḍadhvajam /
tena saṃsmṛtamātrastu śīghramāvirabhūcca saḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तया व्याकुलो भूत्वा सस्मार गरुडध्वजम् /
तेन संस्मृतमात्रस्तु शीघ्रमाविरभूच्च सः //
text_mt: Agitated with anxiety, he remembered the one whose banner bears Garuḍa; / and no sooner was he remembered by him than he swiftly appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvagataṃ dvija /
nanāma śirasā namro niṣprabho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं विष्णुं सर्वगतं द्विज /
ननाम शिरसा नम्रो निष्प्रभो वृषभध्वजः //
text_mt: Seeing that lord of the gods of gods, Viṣṇu the all-pervading, O twice-born, / the bull-bannered one, drained of luster, bowed humbly with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tathāturamālakṣya bhītaṃ brahmadruhaṃ hariḥ /
samāśvāsyā bravīdvākyaṃ tattoṣaparikārakam //
meaning:
तं तथातुरमालक्ष्य भीतं ब्रह्मद्रुहं हरिः /
समाश्वास्या ब्रवीद्वाक्यं तत्तोषपरिकारकम् //
text_mt: Noticing him thus afflicted and afraid, the slayer of Brahmā, Hari / consoled him and spoke words bringing him satisfaction:

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbho tvayā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yaccinnaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śiraḥ /
tatphalaṃ bhuṅkṣva sarṃvajña kiyatkālaṃ kṛtaṃ svayam //
meaning:
शंभो त्वया कृतं पापं यच्चिन्नं ब्रह्मणः शिरः /
तत्फलं भुङ्क्ष्व सर्ंवज्ञ कियत्कालं कृतं स्वयम् //
text_mt: "O Śambhu, a sin was committed by you in that Brahmā's head was severed; / enjoy the fruit of what was done by yourself for some time, O omniscient one.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham /
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma hyapi janmaśataiḥ priya //
meaning:
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् /
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म ह्यपि जन्मशतैः प्रिय //
text_mt: Karma that has been performed, auspicious or inauspicious, must inevitably be experienced; / unexperienced karma is not destroyed even in hundreds of births, dear one.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitaṃ haram /
prāṇā vikalatāṃ yānti mama tvadduḥkhadarśanāt //
meaning:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि त्वां दृष्ट्वा दुःखितं हरम् /
प्राणा विकलतां यान्ति मम त्वद्दुःखदर्शनात् //
text_mt: What can I do, where can I go, seeing Hara distressed? / My vital breaths become agitated at the sight of your suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni kāni ca pāpāni mahānti mahatāṃ gate /
na tāni brahmahatyāyāḥ samānīti matirmama //
meaning:
यानि कानि च पापानि महान्ति महतां गते /
न तानि ब्रह्महत्यायाः समानीति मतिर्मम //
text_mt: Whatever great sins there are, O refuge of the great, / my view is that they are not equal to the murder of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvaṃ sarvasya lokasya gururdharmopadeśakaḥ /
brahmahatyābhibhūtastu kṣaṇaṃ sthātuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ //
meaning:
यस्त्वं सर्वस्य लोकस्य गुरुर्धर्मोपदेशकः /
ब्रह्महत्याभिभूतस्तु क्षणं स्थातुं न च क्षमः //
text_mt: You who are the guru of all the world, the teacher of dharma, / overcome by the murder of a brahmin, are not able to remain still even for a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā ghoratarā hatyā mīnagandhyā jarāturā /
lelihānā sureśāna grahītuṃ tvānudhāvati //
meaning:
एषा घोरतरा हत्या मीनगन्ध्या जरातुरा /
लेलिहाना सुरेशान ग्रहीतुं त्वानुधावति //
text_mt: This most terrible murder, smelling of fish, stricken with old age, / licking with her tongue, O lord of gods, runs after you to seize you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnaikatra bhavatā stheyaṃ dvādaśabatsaram /
aṭanīyaṃ hitārthāya pāpanāśābhikāmyayā //
meaning:
तस्मान्नैकत्र भवता स्थेयं द्वादशबत्सरम् /
अटनीयं हितार्थाय पापनाशाभिकाम्यया //
text_mt: Therefore, you must not stay in one place for twelve years; / you must wander for your own welfare, desiring the destruction of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
aṭitvā dvādaśābdāni tīrtheṣu sakaleṣu ca /
prakṣālayankaraṃ vāmaṃ bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇankapālake //
meaning:
अटित्वा द्वादशाब्दानि तीर्थेषु सकलेषु च /
प्रक्षालयन्करं वामं भिक्षां गृह्णन्कपालके //
text_mt: Having wandered for twelve years through all the sacred fords, / washing your left hand and receiving alms in the skull-bowl,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhiṃ yāsyasi deveśa pāpādasmātsudāruṇāt /
ityukto viṣṇunā vipra sthāṇuḥ sarvagato 'bhavat //
meaning:
शुद्धिं यास्यसि देवेश पापादस्मात्सुदारुणात् /
इत्युक्तो विष्णुना विप्र स्थाणुः सर्वगतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: you will attain purification from this most dreadful sin, O lord of gods." / Thus spoken to by Viṣṇu, O brahmin, Sthāṇu went everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanārthaṃ hi pāṇiṃ prakṣālayan jale /
varṣatrayaṃ bhramitvā tu prāpto badarikāśramam //
meaning:
कपालमोचनार्थं हि पाणिं प्रक्षालयन् जले /
वर्षत्रयं भ्रमित्वा तु प्राप्तो बदरिकाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Washing his hand in water in order to release the skull-bowl, / having roamed for three years, he reached Badarikāśrama.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣārthaṃ devadevasya dharmaputrasya mānada /
dvārastho dehi bhikṣāṃ me viṣṇo ityavadanmuhuḥ //
meaning:
भिक्षार्थं देवदेवस्य धर्मपुत्रस्य मानद /
द्वारस्थो देहि भिक्षां मे विष्णो इत्यवदन्मुहुः //
text_mt: For the sake of alms from the god of gods, the son of Dharma, O respectful one, / standing at the door, he repeatedly said, "Give me alms, O Viṣṇu!"

sanskrit_iast:
tato nārāyaṇo devo dṛṣṭvā dvāri sthitaṃ haram /
gṛhāṇa bhikṣāmityuktvā pradadau dakṣiṇaṃ karam //
meaning:
ततो नारायणो देवो दृष्ट्वा द्वारि स्थितं हरम् /
गृहाण भिक्षामित्युक्त्वा प्रददौ दक्षिणं करम् //
text_mt: Then the divine Nārāyaṇa, seeing Hara standing at the door, / said, "Receive the alms," and stretched out his right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tato haro hariṃ dṛṣṭvā bhikṣāṃ dātuṃ samudyatam /
prāharaddakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ triśūlena dvijottama //
meaning:
ततो हरो हरिं दृष्ट्वा भिक्षां दातुं समुद्यतम् /
प्राहरद्दक्षिणं पाणिं त्रिशूलेन द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: Then Hara, seeing Hari prepared to give alms, / struck the right hand with his trident, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tattriśūlakṣatāddhārāstisro lokabhayaṅkarāḥ /
prasthadvādaśahastāśca nirgatāścitravarṇikāḥ //
meaning:
तत्त्रिशूलक्षताद्धारास्तिस्रो लोकभयङ्कराः /
प्रस्थद्वादशहस्ताश्च निर्गताश्चित्रवर्णिकाः //
text_mt:
From that wound made by the trident, three streams, terrifying to the worlds,
and twelve cubits wide, flowed out in diverse colours.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā kṣatajadhārā tu kapāle nyapatattadā /
dvitīyā tanmukhe prāptā payasyātha tṛtīyakā //
meaning:
एका क्षतजधारा तु कपाले न्यपतत्तदा /
द्वितीया तन्मुखे प्राप्ता पयस्याथ तृतीयका //
text_mt:
One stream of blood fell then into the skull-bowl;
the second reached his mouth, and the third into water.

sanskrit_iast:
jaladhārā śivaṃ prāptā harasya heturagrataḥ /
tā dhārāstrīṇi varṣāṇi saṃsevya vidhivaddharaḥ //
meaning:
जलधारा शिवं प्राप्ता हरस्य हेतुरग्रतः /
ता धारास्त्रीणि वर्षाणि संसेव्य विधिवद्धरः //
text_mt:
The stream of water reached Śiva, in front as the cause for Hara.
Hara, duly waiting upon those streams for three years,

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcitprīto yayau kṣetraṃ kuroḥ puṇyakaraṃ dvija /
tatra gatvā haraḥ sthāṇurbhūtastatra papāta ca //
meaning:
किञ्चित्प्रीतो ययौ क्षेत्रं कुरोः पुण्यकरं द्विज /
तत्र गत्वा हरः स्थाणुर्भूतस्तत्र पपात च //
text_mt:
somewhat pleased, went to the merit-yielding sacred field of Kuru, O twice-born.
Having gone there, Hara became motionless like a post, and fell there.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahrade trivarṣāṇi magro brahmahradāṃbuni /
varṣatraye gate tatra kṣatārddhāṅgo viniḥsṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मह्रदे त्रिवर्षाणि मग्रो ब्रह्मह्रदांबुनि /
वर्षत्रये गते तत्र क्षतार्द्धाङ्गो विनिःसृतः //
text_mt:
Immersed in the Brahmahrada lake, in the waters of the Brahmahrada for three years,
when three years had elapsed there, he emerged with half his body injured.

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvaguhāśayam /
tatastuṣṭo jagannātho varaṃ tasmai dadau tu saḥ //
meaning:
चिरं तुष्टाव देवेशं विष्णुं सर्वगुहाशयम् /
ततस्तुष्टो जगन्नाथो वरं तस्मै ददौ तु सः //
text_mt:
For a long time he praised Viṣṇu, the lord of gods, who dwells in the cave of every heart.
Then, pleased, Jagannātha granted him a boon:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha kāśīmito bhrāntvā tīrthāni bahuśo hara /
tato hariṃ namaskṛtya parītya bahudhā tathā //
meaning:
गच्छ काशीमितो भ्रान्त्वा तीर्थानि बहुशो हर /
ततो हरिं नमस्कृत्य परीत्य बहुधा तथा //
text_mt:
“Go from here to Kāśī, O Hara, having wandered through many sacred fords.”
Then, bowing down to Hari and circumambulating him many times in that manner,

sanskrit_iast:
kramāttīrthāṭanaṃ kurvannavimuktapurīṃ gataḥ /
avimuktasya sīmāyāṃ prāviśadvīkṣtaya dhūrjaṭiḥ //
meaning:
क्रमात्तीर्थाटनं कुर्वन्नविमुक्तपुरीं गतः /
अविमुक्तस्य सीमायां प्राविशद्वीक्ष्तय धूर्जटिः //
text_mt:
gradually making a pilgrimage to sacred fords, he went to the city of Avimukta.
Seeing it at the boundary of Avimukta, Dhūrjaṭi entered.

sanskrit_iast:
nāpaśyattāmanuprāptāṃ brahmahatyāṃ bahiḥ sthitām /
tato 'sau vaiṣṇavaṃ jñātvā kṣetraṃ duritanāśanam /
tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā mādhavaṃ vandyamīśvaram //
meaning:
नापश्यत्तामनुप्राप्तां ब्रह्महत्यां बहिः स्थिताम् /
ततो ऽसौ वैष्णवं ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं दुरितनाशनम् /
तुष्टाव प्रयतो भूत्वा माधवं वन्द्यमीश्वरम् //
text_mt:
He did not see that [sin of] slaying a brahmin which had reached there, staying outside.
Then, knowing it to be a Vaiṣṇava sacred field that destroys misfortune,
becoming purified, he praised Mādhava, the venerable lord:

sanskrit_iast:
jaya jaya jagadīśa nātha viṣṇo jagadānandanidhāna vedavedya /
madhumathana nṛsiṃha pītavāso garuḍādhiṣṭhita mādhavādideva //
meaning:
जय जय जगदीश नाथ विष्णो जगदानन्दनिधान वेदवेद्य /
मधुमथन नृसिंह पीतवासो गरुडाधिष्ठित माधवादिदेव //
text_mt:
“Victory, victory, O Lord of the world, Master, Viṣṇu, treasure of the joy of the world, knowable through the Vedas,
slayer of Madhu, Nṛsiṃha, yellow-robed one, seated upon Garuḍa, Mādhava, primeval god!

sanskrit_iast:
vrajaramaṇa rameśa rādhikeśa tridaśeśākhilakāmapūra kṛṣṇa /
suravarakaruṇārṇavārtināśinnalinākṣādhipate vibho pareśa //
meaning:
व्रजरमण रमेश राधिकेश त्रिदशेशाखिलकामपूर कृष्ण /
सुरवरकरुणार्णवार्तिनाशिन्नलिनाक्षाधिपते विभो परेश //
text_mt:
Delighter of Vraja, husband of Ramā, lord of Rādhikā, ruler of the thirty [gods], fulfiller of all desires, Kṛṣṇa,
ocean of compassion for the best of gods, dispeller of distress, lotus-eyed sovereign, all-pervading supreme lord!

sanskrit_iast:
yaduku latilakābdhivāsa śaure kudharoddhāravidhānadakṣa dhanvin /
kalikaluṣaharāṅghripadmayugma gṛṇadātmaprada kūrma kaśyapottha //
meaning:
यदुकु लतिलकाब्धिवास शौरे कुधरोद्धारविधानदक्ष धन्विन् /
कलिकलुषहराङ्घ्रिपद्मयुग्म गृणदात्मप्रद कूर्म कश्यपोत्थ //
text_mt:
Ornament of the Yadu race, dweller in the ocean, Śauri, skilled in lifting the earth, bowman,
whose pair of lotus feet removes the impurities of the Kali age, who give your own self to the praiser, Kūrma, born of Kaśyapa!

sanskrit_iast:
kukupativanapāvakākhilejyāsrapakālāsitavastra buddha kalkin /
bhavabhayahara bhaktavaśya gopa praṇattoddhāraka puṇyakīrtinām //
meaning:
कुकुपतिवनपावकाखिलेज्यास्रपकालासितवस्त्र बुद्ध कल्किन् /
भवभयहर भक्तवश्य गोप प्रणत्तोद्धारक पुण्यकीर्तिनाम् //
text_mt:
Fire to the forest of wicked kings, object of all sacrifice, death to the demon Asrapa, dark-clothed one, Buddha, Kalkin,
remover of the fear of worldly existence, subdued by devotion, cowherd, rescuer of the bowed, whose name brings holy renown!

sanskrit_iast:
dharaṇibharaharāsurāripūjya prakṛtīśeśa jagannivāsa rāma /
guṇagaṇavilasaccarācareśa triguṇātīta sanātanāgrapūjya /
nijajanaparirakṣitāntakāre kamalāṅghre kamanīya padmanābha /
kamalakara kuśeśayā dhivāsa priyakāmonmathana tryadhīśavandya //
meaning:
धरणिभरहरासुरारिपूज्य प्रकृतीशेश जगन्निवास राम /
गुणगणविलसच्चराचरेश त्रिगुणातीत सनातनाग्रपूज्य /
निजजनपरिरक्षितान्तकारे कमलाङ्घ्रे कमनीय पद्मनाभ /
कमलकर कुशेशया धिवास प्रियकामोन्मथन त्र्यधीशवन्द्य //
text_mt:
Remover of the earth's burden, worshipful to the enemies of the asuras, lord of Prakṛti, abode of the universe, Rāma,
lord of mobile and immobile creation shining with hordes of virtues, beyond the three guṇas, primeval worshipful one,
protector of your own people, death to Death, lotus-footed, handsome, lotus-navelled one,
lotus-handed one, dweller in the lotus, crusher of cherished desires, worshipped by the three lords!

sanskrit_iast:
aghahara raghunātha yādaveśa priyabhūdeva parātparāmarejya /
haladhara duritāpaha praṇamya triguṇavyāpta jagattrikāladakṣa //
meaning:
अघहर रघुनाथ यादवेश प्रियभूदेव परात्परामरेज्य /
हलधर दुरितापह प्रणम्य त्रिगुणव्याप्त जगत्त्रिकालदक्ष //
text_mt:
Remover of sins, lord of the Raghus, lord of the Yādavas, dear to the gods of the earth, higher than the highest, worshipped by the gods,
bearer of the plough, dispeller of sins, praiseworthy one, pervader of the universe with the three guṇas, omniscient through the three times!

sanskrit_iast:
danujakulavināśanaikakarmannanaghārūḍhaphaṇīśa kaṃsakāla /
raviśaśinayana pragalbhaceṣṭa pradhutadhvānta navāṃbudābha meśa //
meaning:
दनुजकुलविनाशनैककर्मन्ननघारूढफणीश कंसकाल /
रविशशिनयन प्रगल्भचेष्ट प्रधुतध्वान्त नवांबुदाभ मेश //
text_mt:
Sole actor in destroying the race of Danu's sons, sinless one mounted on the serpent king, death to Kaṃsa,
sun-and-moon-eyed one, bold in actions, dispeller of darkness, dark as a fresh cloud, lord of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
makha makhadhara mātṛbaddhadāmannavanītapriya ballavīgaṇeśa /
aghabakavṛṣakeśipūtanānta triśirovālidaśāsyabhedakārin //
meaning:
मख मखधर मातृबद्धदामन्नवनीतप्रिय बल्लवीगणेश /
अघबकवृषकेशिपूतनान्त त्रिशिरोवालिदशास्यभेदकारिन् //
text_mt:
Sacrifice, upholder of sacrifice, tied with a rope by your mother, lover of butter, lord of the cowherd women,
bringer of end to Agha, Baka, Vṛṣa, Keśin, and Pūtanā, cleaver of Triśiras, Vālin, and the ten-headed one!

sanskrit_iast:
narakamuravināśa bāṇadoḥ kṛttripurārījya sudāmamitra sevya /
bhavataraṇivahitrapādapadma prakaṭaiśvarya purāṇa pūrṇabāho //
meaning:
नरकमुरविनाश बाणदोः कृत्त्रिपुरारीज्य सुदाममित्र सेव्य /
भवतरणिवहित्रपादपद्म प्रकटैश्वर्य पुराण पूर्णबाहो //
text_mt:
Destroyer of Naraka and Mura, cutter of Bāṇa's arms, worshipped by the foe of Tripura, friend of Sudāman, worthy to be served,
whose lotus feet are a ship to cross worldly existence, whose sovereignty is manifest, ancient one of full arms!

sanskrit_iast:
bahujanisukṛtāpya maṅgalārha śrutivedya śrutidhāma śāntaśuddha /
tava varada vareṇyamaṅghriyugmaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptamaghārditaṃ prapāhi //
meaning:
बहुजनिसुकृताप्य मङ्गलार्ह श्रुतिवेद्य श्रुतिधाम शान्तशुद्ध /
तव वरद वरेण्यमङ्घ्रियुग्मं शरणं प्राप्तमघार्दितं प्रपाहि //
text_mt:
Attainable by the merit of many births, worthy of blessings, known through the Vedas, abode of the Vedas, peaceful and pure,
O granter of boons, I have taken refuge in your excellent pair of feet; protect me who am tormented by sin!

sanskrit_iast: nahi mama gatidaṃ purāṇapuṃso 'nyaditi prārthanayā prasīda'medya //
meaning: नहि मम गतिदं पुराणपुंसो ऽन्यदिति प्रार्थनया प्रसीदऽमेद्य //
text_mt: For me there is no other giver of refuge than the ancient Person; thus, by my prayer, be pleased, O unblemished one!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti stuto jagannātho bhaktyā devena śaṃbhunā /
āvirbabhūva sahasā mādhavo bhaktavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
इति स्तुतो जगन्नाथो भक्त्या देवेन शंभुना /
आविर्बभूव सहसा माधवो भक्तवत्सलः //
text_mt:
Thus praised with devotion by god Śambhu,
Mādhava, affectionate to his devotees, suddenly appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍavadbhūmau nipapāta haro harim /
punarutthāya viprendra nanāma vidhṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा दण्डवद्भूमौ निपपात हरो हरिम् /
पुनरुत्थाय विप्रेन्द्र ननाम विधृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt:
Seeing Hari, Hara fell to the ground like a rod.
Rising again, O best of brahmins, he bowed with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ praṇataṃ bhūtanāyakam /
varaṃ vṛṇu pradāsye 'haṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ stotratastava //
meaning:
तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रणतं भूतनायकम् /
वरं वृणु प्रदास्ये ऽहं संतुष्टः स्तोत्रतस्तव //
text_mt:
Hṛṣīkeśa said to him, the bowed lord of beings:
“Choose a boon; I will give it, being pleased with your hymn of praise.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā bhagavadvākyaṃ bhūteśo brahyahatyayā /
pīḍitātmā jagādedaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवद्वाक्यं भूतेशो ब्रह्यहत्यया /
पीडितात्मा जगादेदं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं हरिम् //
text_mt:
Hearing that word of the Lord, the lord of spirits, his soul afflicted
by the slaying of a brahmin, spoke this to Hari, the giver of enjoyment and liberation:

sanskrit_iast:
icchāmi vasituṃ kṣetre tava cakragadādhara /
tvatkṣetrasīmābāhyasthā brahmahatyā yadīkṣyate //
meaning:
इच्छामि वसितुं क्षेत्रे तव चक्रगदाधर /
त्वत्क्षेत्रसीमाबाह्यस्था ब्रह्महत्या यदीक्ष्यते //
text_mt:
“I wish to dwell in your sacred field, O wielder of the discus and mace,
since the slaying of a brahmin is seen remaining outside the boundary of your sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetradānena kāruṇyaṃ kuru me garuḍadhvaja /
mama nirgamane brahmahatyā māṃ punareṣyati //
meaning:
क्षेत्रदानेन कारुण्यं कुरु मे गरुडध्वज /
मम निर्गमने ब्रह्महत्या मां पुनरेष्यति //
text_mt:
Show compassion to me by granting the sacred field, O Garuḍa-bannered one;
upon my departure, the slaying of a brahmin will come to me again.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatkṣetre saṃsthito 'haṃ tu pūjāṃ prāpsye jagattraye /
ityuktvā hyabhavattūṣṇīṃ devadevaṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
त्वत्क्षेत्रे संस्थितो ऽहं तु पूजां प्राप्स्ये जगत्त्रये /
इत्युक्त्वा ह्यभवत्तूष्णीं देवदेवं वृषध्वजः //
text_mt:
Established in your sacred field, I shall receive worship in the three worlds.”
Having spoken thus to the god of gods, the bull-bannered one fell silent.

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti pratipede ca kṣīrasāgarajāpriyaḥ /
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra śaivaṃ kṣetraṃ nigadyate //
meaning:
तथेति प्रतिपेदे च क्षीरसागरजाप्रियः /
ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र शैवं क्षेत्रं निगद्यते //
text_mt:
“So be it,” agreed the beloved of the daughter of the milk-ocean.
From that time forth, O best of brahmins, it is called a Śaiva sacred field.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ tu keśavasyedaṃ purāṇaṃ kavayo viduḥ /
kṛpayā saṃparītasya mādhavasya dvijottama //
meaning:
क्षेत्रं तु केशवस्येदं पुराणं कवयो विदुः /
कृपया संपरीतस्य माधवस्य द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt:
Yet wise sages know this ancient sacred field to be Keśava's.
From the eyes of Mādhava, who was filled with compassion, O best of twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
netrābhyāṃ nirgataṃ vāri tena bindusaro 'bhavat /
mādhavasyājñayā tatra sasnau devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
नेत्राभ्यां निर्गतं वारि तेन बिन्दुसरो ऽभवत् /
माधवस्याज्ञया तत्र सस्नौ देवो वृषध्वजः //
text_mt:
water came forth, and from that arose the lake Bindusaras.
By the command of Mādhava, the bull-bannered god bathed there.

sanskrit_iast:
snātamātre hare tattu kapālaṃ pāṇito 'patat /
kapālamocanaṃ nāma tattīrthaṃ khyātimāgatam //
meaning:
स्नातमात्रे हरे तत्तु कपालं पाणितो ऽपतत् /
कपालमोचनं नाम तत्तीर्थं ख्यातिमागतम् //
text_mt:
As soon as Hara bathed, that skull fell from his hand.
That sacred ford became renowned by the name Kapālamocana.

sanskrit_iast:
bindumādhavanāmāsau datvā svaṃ dhāma śūline /
bhaktibhāvena śaṃbhustu nibaddhastatra saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
बिन्दुमाधवनामासौ दत्वा स्वं धाम शूलिने /
भक्तिभावेन शंभुस्तु निबद्धस्तत्र संस्थितः //
text_mt:
Having granted his own abode to the trident-bearer, he who is named Bindumādhava,
Śambhu remained established there, bound by the spirit of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ tu brahmādayo devāḥ svaḥsthāḥ paśyati sarvadā /
sūryāyutasamaprakhya digaṃbaraniṣevitam //
meaning:
यं तु ब्रह्मादयो देवाः स्वःस्थाः पश्यति सर्वदा /
सूर्यायुतसमप्रख्य दिगंबरनिषेवितम् //
text_mt:
whom Brahmā and the other gods residing in heaven always behold,
resembling ten thousand suns, served by the sky-clad [ascetic].

sanskrit_iast:
vighnāni śūlinā kānta kṛtānyasya niṣevaṇe /
yairvighnairabhibhūtāstu stutvā viṣṇuṃ śivārcakāḥ //
meaning:
विघ्नानि शूलिना कान्त कृतान्यस्य निषेवणे /
यैर्विघ्नैरभिभूतास्तु स्तुत्वा विष्णुं शिवार्चकाः //
text_mt:
Obstacles were created by the trident-bearer in attending upon him, O beloved;
overwhelmed by which obstacles, worshippers of Śiva praised Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve lokāḥ sthitā hyatra śivaḥ kāśīti cintakāḥ /
śivasya cintanādvipra śaivāḥ sarve nirākulāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे लोकाः स्थिता ह्यत्र शिवः काशीति चिन्तकाः /
शिवस्य चिन्तनाद्विप्र शैवाः सर्वे निराकुलाः //
text_mt:
All the people stay here, contemplating: “Śiva is Kāśī.”
From the contemplation of Śiva, O brahmin, all Śaivas, free from agitation,

sanskrit_iast:
prayānti śivalokaṃ vaijarāmṛtyuvivarjitam /
bahupuṇyayutāḥ saṃto nivasaṃttayatra nīrujaḥ //
meaning:
प्रयान्ति शिवलोकं वैजरामृत्युविवर्जितम् /
बहुपुण्ययुताः संतो निवसंत्तयत्र नीरुजः //
text_mt:
attain the realm of Śiva, entirely free from old age and death.
Endowed with great merit, they dwell here free from sickness.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaśiṣṭāśinaḥ kāśīkānta ṛddhisamanvitāḥ /
nātra snānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti na japaṃ na surārcanam //
meaning:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः काशीकान्त ऋद्धिसमन्विताः /
नात्र स्नानं प्रशंसंति न जपं न सुरार्चनम् //
text_mt:
Eating the remains of sacrifices, endowed with prosperity, O beloved of Kāśī;
here they do not praise bathing, nor recitation, nor the worship of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
nāpi dānaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha muktvaikaṃ dehapātanam /
mṛtyuṃ prātyuṃ naraḥ kāmaṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaveddhruvan //
meaning:
नापि दानं द्विजश्रेष्ठ मुक्त्वैकं देहपातनम् /
मृत्युं प्रात्युं नरः कामं कृतकृत्यो भवेद्ध्रुवन् //
text_mt:
nor giving of gifts, O best of twice-born, except for the single shedding of the body.
Reaching death at will, a person surely becomes one who has achieved his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
seyamāsāditā viprara purī prāsādasaṃkulā /
bhoginīmapi mokṣāya kiṃ punarvratadhāriṇām //
meaning:
सेयमासादिता विप्रर पुरी प्रासादसंकुला /
भोगिनीमपि मोक्षाय किं पुनर्व्रतधारिणाम् //
text_mt:
This city, crowded with palaces, has been attained, O brahmin,
which brings liberation even to a worldly woman, how much more to observers of vows!

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣipyatāmiyaṃ bālā kāśīśasyeha mandire /
viyojitā tu yā pūrvaṃ tena duṣṭena rakṣasā //
meaning:
निक्षिप्यतामियं बाला काशीशस्येह मन्दिरे /
वियोजिता तु या पूर्वं तेन दुष्टेन रक्षसा //

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaḥ suratārthāya kumārī niyamānvitā /
eṣa prabhāvo 'pi hitaḥ kṣetrasyāsya dvijotma //
meaning:
आत्मनः सुरतार्थाय कुमारी नियमान्विता /
एष प्रभावो ऽपि हितः क्षेत्रस्यास्य द्विजोत्म //
text_mt: Even such is the beneficial power of this sacred field, O best of twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
vinaśyantīha karmāṇi śubhānyapyaśubhāni ca /
bhūtavyabhaviṣyāṇi jñānājñānakṛtāni ca //
meaning:
विनश्यन्तीह कर्माणि शुभान्यप्यशुभानि च /
भूतव्यभविष्याणि ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतानि च //
text_mt:
here actions are destroyed, both auspicious and inauspicious,
past and future, and those performed knowingly or unknowingly.”

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā purī karmavināśanāya kṛṣṇena pūrvaṃ hi vinirmitābhūt /
yasyāṃ mṛtā duḥkhamanantamugraṃ bhuñjanti martyā yamayātanāṃ no //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite kāṣṭhīlopākhyāne rākṣasīcarite kāśīvarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एषा पुरी कर्मविनाशनाय कृष्णेन पूर्वं हि विनिर्मिताभूत् /
यस्यां मृता दुःखमनन्तमुग्रं भुञ्जन्ति मर्त्या यमयातनां नो //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते काष्ठीलोपाख्याने राक्षसीचरिते काशीवर्णनं नाम एकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This city was previously created by Kṛṣṇa for the destruction of karma; / mortals dying in it do not experience the endless, terrible suffering that is the torment of Yama.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, named 'The Description of Kāśī in the Tale of the Rākṣasī,' in the story of Kāṣṭhīla, in the narrative of Mohinī, in the Latter Section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhīlovāca
bhāryāyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasyā dharmasaṃmitam /
pṛṣṭhātkaroṇurūpiṇyāḥ sakanyo 'vātaraddvijaḥ //
meaning:
काष्ठीलोवाच
भार्यायास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षस्या धर्मसंमितम् /
पृष्ठात्करोणुरूपिण्याः सकन्यो ऽवातरद्द्विजः //
title: athatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Kāṣṭhīla said: / Hearing that speech of his wife, the rākṣasī, which was in accordance with dharma, / the twice-born descended with the maiden from the back of her who had taken the form of a female elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
avatīrṇe dvije sābhūtsurūpā pramadā punaḥ /
kṣapācarī kṣapānāthavaktrā pīnonnatastanī //
meaning:
अवतीर्णे द्विजे साभूत्सुरूपा प्रमदा पुनः /
क्षपाचरी क्षपानाथवक्त्रा पीनोन्नतस्तनी //
text_mt: When the twice-born had descended, that night-wanderer became again a beautiful young woman / with a face like the moon and full, prominent breasts.

sanskrit_iast:
sā kumārī tataḥ prāpya nagaraṃ svapituḥ śubham /
bāhyarakṣāsthita prāptaṃ purapālamuvāca ha //
meaning:
सा कुमारी ततः प्राप्य नगरं स्वपितुः शुभम् /
बाह्यरक्षास्थित प्राप्तं पुरपालमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Then, having reached the auspicious city of her father, / that princess spoke to the city-guardian who stood stationed as the outer watch:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha tvaṃ nṛpateḥ pārśvaṃ piturmama purādhipa /
brūhi māṃ samanuprāptāṃ ratnaśālāṃ purā hṛtām //
meaning:
गच्छ त्वं नृपतेः पार्श्वं पितुर्मम पुराधिप /
ब्रूहि मां समनुप्राप्तां रत्नशालां पुरा हृताम् //
text_mt: 'Go, O city-lord, to the presence of the king, my father; / tell him that I have returned—I who was formerly abducted from the gem-chamber;

sanskrit_iast:
ratnāvaliṃ ratnabhūtāṃ sudyumnasya mahīkṣituḥ /
talpasthā rakṣasā rātrau svapurasthā hṛtā dvija //
meaning:
रत्नावलिं रत्नभूतां सुद्युम्नस्य महीक्षितुः /
तल्पस्था रक्षसा रात्रौ स्वपुरस्था हृता द्विज //
text_mt: Ratnāvalī, the jewel-like [daughter] of King Sudyumna, / who, lying on her couch in her own city, was abducted at night by a rākṣasa, O twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ sā samanuprāptā jīvamānākṣatā pitaḥ /
samāśvasihi śokaṃ tvaṃ mā kṛthā matkṛte kvacit //
meaning:
पुनः सा समनुप्राप्ता जीवमानाक्षता पितः /
समाश्वसिहि शोकं त्वं मा कृथा मत्कृते क्वचित् //
text_mt: that she has returned alive and unhurt, O father! / Take comfort; do not grieve on my account anywhere!

sanskrit_iast:
aviplutāsmi rājendra gāṅgā āpa ivāmalāḥ /
tava kīrtikarī tadvanmātuḥ sauśīlyasūcikā //
meaning:
अविप्लुतास्मि राजेन्द्र गाङ्गा आप इवामलाः /
तव कीर्तिकरी तद्वन्मातुः सौशील्यसूचिका //
text_mt: I am unviolated, O king of kings, pure like the waters of the Gaṅgā, / bringing you renown and testifying to my mother's good character.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatkumārīvacaḥ śrutvā purāpālastvarānvitaḥ /
abāhuriti vikhyātaḥ prāptaḥ sudyumrasannidhau //
meaning:
तत्कुमारीवचः श्रुत्वा पुरापालस्त्वरान्वितः /
अबाहुरिति विख्यातः प्राप्तः सुद्युम्रसन्निधौ //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of the maiden, the city-guardian, in great haste, / known as Abāhu, arrived into the presence of Sudyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapraṇāmaḥ saṃpṛṣṭaḥ prāha rājānamādarāt /
rājannupāgatā naṣṭā dihitā tava mānada //
meaning:
कृतप्रणामः संपृष्टः प्राह राजानमादरात् /
राजन्नुपागता नष्टा दिहिता तव मानद //
text_mt: Having bowed and being questioned, he spoke respectfully to the king: / 'O King, O honor-giver, your lost daughter has returned!

sanskrit_iast:
ratnāvalīti vikhyātā sastrīkadvidajasaṃyutā /
purabāhye sthitā dṛṣṭā mayā jñātā na cābhavat //
meaning:
रत्नावलीति विख्याता सस्त्रीकद्विदजसंयुता /
पुरबाह्ये स्थिता दृष्टा मया ज्ञाता न चाभवत् //
text_mt: Known as Ratnāvalī, accompanied by a twice-born man and his wife, / she stands outside the city; I saw her, but did not recognize her.

sanskrit_iast:
tayāhaṃ preritaḥ prāgāṃ tvāṃ vijñāpayituṃ prabho /
aviplutāhaṃ vadati māṃ jānātu samāgatām //
meaning:
तयाहं प्रेरितः प्रागां त्वां विज्ञापयितुं प्रभो /
अविप्लुताहं वदति मां जानातु समागताम् //
text_mt: Sent by her, I came to inform you, O Lord; / she says: "I am unviolated; let him know that I have arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ mama satkṛtyai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
tadadbhutaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā purapālasya tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
पितरं मम सत्कृत्यै नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
तदद्भुतं वचः श्रुत्वा पुरपालस्य तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: There should be no hesitation here in honoring my father."' / Hearing that wondrous speech of the city-guardian, immediately,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmātyaḥ sakalatrastu sadvijo niryayau nṛpaḥ /
sa tu gatvā purādbrāhye gaṅgātīre vyavasthitām //
meaning:
सामात्यः सकलत्रस्तु सद्विजो निर्ययौ नृपः /
स तु गत्वा पुराद्ब्राह्ये गङ्गातीरे व्यवस्थिताम् //
text_mt: the king set forth with his ministers, with his wives, and with twice-born men. / Having gone outside the city, to her stationed on the bank of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyadbhāskarākārāṃ sastrīkadvijasaṃyutām /
sahaje naiva veṣeṇa bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇapriyām //
meaning:
अपश्यद्भास्कराकारां सस्त्रीकद्विजसंयुताम् /
सहजे नैव वेषेण भूषितां भूषणप्रियाम् //
text_mt: he saw her, radiant like the sun, accompanied by the twice-born and his wife, / adorned in natural attire, fond of ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
amlānakusumaprakhyāṃ tatpakāñcanasuprabhām /
dūrāddṛṣṭvāntikaṃ gatvā paryaṣvajata bhūpatiḥ //
meaning:
अम्लानकुसुमप्रख्यां तत्पकाञ्चनसुप्रभाम् /
दूराद्दृष्ट्वान्तिकं गत्वा पर्यष्वजत भूपतिः //
text_mt: resembling an unfading flower, possessing the fine lustre of molten gold. / Seeing her from afar and approaching, the king embraced her.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ sāpi saṃhṛṣṭā samāśliṣya nanāma ha /
tataśca mātrā saṃgamya hṛṣṭayā harṣitāntarā //
meaning:
पितरं सापि संहृष्टा समाश्लिष्य ननाम ह /
ततश्च मात्रा संगम्य हृष्टया हर्षितान्तरा //
text_mt: She too, overjoyed, embraced her father and bowed down. / Then, having met her mother and being filled with inner joy by that delighted one,

sanskrit_iast:
prāha vākyaṃ viśālākṣī saṃbodhya pitaraṃ nṛpam /
suptāhaṃ ratnaśālāyāṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritā //
meaning:
प्राह वाक्यं विशालाक्षी संबोध्य पितरं नृपम् /
सुप्ताहं रत्नशालायां सखीभिः परिवारिता //
text_mt: the large-eyed maiden spoke these words, addressing her father, the king: / 'Asleep in the gem-chamber, surrounded by my female companions,

sanskrit_iast:
udakūkṛtvā śirastātādhautāṅghrirmañcakopari /
cintayatnī bhartṛyogaṃ niśīthe rakṣasā hṛtā //
meaning:
उदकूकृत्वा शिरस्ताताधौताङ्घ्रिर्मञ्चकोपरि /
चिन्तयत्नी भर्तृयोगं निशीथे रक्षसा हृता //
text_mt: with my head toward the north, O father, my feet unwashed, upon the couch, / contemplating marriage with a husband, I was carried off at midnight by a rākṣasa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa māṃ gṛhītvā svapuraṃ prāgādarṇavage girau /
nānāratnamaye tatra guhāyāṃ sthāpitā hyaham //
meaning:
स मां गृहीत्वा स्वपुरं प्रागादर्णवगे गिरौ /
नानारत्नमये तत्र गुहायां स्थापिता ह्यहम् //
text_mt: Taking me, he went to his own city on a mountain situated in the ocean; / there I was placed in a cave filled with various gems.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatrodvahanopāyacintayāntarvyavasthitaḥ /
tasya bhāryā tviyaṃ subhrūryā tiṣṭhati sumadhyamā //
meaning:
स तत्रोद्वहनोपायचिन्तयान्तर्व्यवस्थितः /
तस्य भार्या त्वियं सुभ्रूर्या तिष्ठति सुमध्यमा //
text_mt: He stayed inside contemplating the means of marrying [me]. / But this fair-browed, slender-waisted woman standing here is his wife,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratī mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ rākṣasī rākṣasapriyā /
anayā buddhiyogena śaktyā śakrasya bhūpate //
meaning:
बिभ्रती मानुषं रूपं राक्षसी राक्षसप्रिया /
अनया बुद्धियोगेन शक्त्या शक्रस्य भूपते //
text_mt: bearing a human form, a rākṣasī and the beloved of the rākṣasa. / By her intellect and by the power of Śakra, O King,

sanskrit_iast:
ghātito viprahastena krūrakarmā patiḥ svakaḥ /
puraiva mama taṃ śailaṃ prāpto devena bhūsuraḥ //
meaning:
घातितो विप्रहस्तेन क्रूरकर्मा पतिः स्वकः /
पुरैव मम तं शैलं प्राप्तो देवेन भूसुरः //
text_mt: her own husband of cruel deeds was slain by the hand of a twice-born man. / Even before me, that earthly god had arrived at that mountain by divine will.'

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ tu rākṣasī dṛṣṭvā patiṃ svaṃ dharmadūṣakam /
vipreṇa saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatye nijakarmaṇā //
meaning:
इयं तु राक्षसी दृष्ट्वा पतिं स्वं धर्मदूषकम् /
विप्रेण संविदं कृत्वा दांपत्ये निजकर्मणा //
text_mt:
Seeing that her own husband was a corrupter of dharma, this rākṣasī,
having made an agreement with the vipra regarding matrimony by her own act,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpeṇāpyasya saṃmugdhā ghātayāmāsa rākṣasam /
evaṃ kṛtvā patiṃ vipraṃ hastinīrūpadhāriṇī //
meaning:
रूपेणाप्यस्य संमुग्धा घातयामास राक्षसम् /
एवं कृत्वा पतिं विप्रं हस्तिनीरूपधारिणी //
text_mt:
and also infatuated by his beauty, caused the rākṣasa to be slain.
Having thus made the vipra her husband, assuming the form of a female elephant,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā vāstukaṃ vittaṃ pṛṣṭhamāropya māmapi /
samāyātātra bhūpāla māmattuṃ tava mandiram //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा वास्तुकं वित्तं पृष्ठमारोप्य मामपि /
समायातात्र भूपाल मामत्तुं तव मन्दिरम् //
text_mt:
taking the household wealth and mounting me upon her back as well,
she has come here, O king, to your palace to devour me.

sanskrit_iast:
anayā rakṣitā rājan rākṣasyārākṣasāttataḥ /
tasmādimāṃ pūjayasva satkṛtyāgrajasaṃyutām //
meaning:
अनया रक्षिता राजन् राक्षस्याराक्षसात्ततः /
तस्मादिमां पूजयस्व सत्कृत्याग्रजसंयुताम् //
text_mt:
I was protected by this rākṣasī, O king, from the non-rākṣasa [beast];
therefore, honor her, respectfully receiving her along with the twice-born elder.

sanskrit_iast:
asyā evāmumatyā māṃ dehyasmai brāhmaṇāya hi /
anenaikāsanagatā jātā bhartā sa me bhavat //
meaning:
अस्या एवामुमत्या मां देह्यस्मै ब्राह्मणाय हि /
अनेनैकासनगता जाता भर्ता स मे भवत् //
text_mt:
With her consent, give me indeed to this brāhmaṇa.
Having sat upon the same seat with him, he has become my husband.

sanskrit_iast:
yenaikāsanagā nārī bhavedbhartā sa eva hi /
nānya itthaṃ purāṇeṣu śrūyate hyāgameṣvapi //
meaning:
येनैकासनगा नारी भवेद्भर्ता स एव हि /
नान्य इत्थं पुराणेषु श्रूयते ह्यागमेष्वपि //
text_mt:
The man with whom a woman sits upon the same seat becomes her husband indeed;
no one else. Thus it is heard in the Purāṇas and in the scriptures as well.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ pṛṣṭhe niviṣṭāhaṃ prītyā saha dvijanmanā /
dharmata stena madbhartā bhavedeṣā matirmama //
meaning:
अस्याः पृष्ठे निविष्टाहं प्रीत्या सह द्विजन्मना /
धर्मत स्तेन मद्भर्ता भवेदेषा मतिर्मम //
text_mt:
I sat upon her back with affection alongside the twice-born;
by dharma, therefore, he should be my husband. This is my thought.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādimāṃ sāṃtvayitvā śāstrāgamavidhānataḥ /
dehi viprāya māṃ tāta pitamanyaṃ vṛṇe na ca //
meaning:
तस्मादिमां सांत्वयित्वा शास्त्रागमविधानतः /
देहि विप्राय मां तात पितमन्यं वृणे न च //
text_mt:
Therefore, having appeased her according to the injunctions of the scriptures and traditions,
give me to the vipra, father; I shall choose no other father [i.e., husband].

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā duhiturvākyaṃ sudyumno bhūpatistadā /
sāṃtvayāmāsa tanvaṅgīṃ rākṣasīṃ praśrayānataḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा दुहितुर्वाक्यं सुद्युम्नो भूपतिस्तदा /
सांत्वयामास तन्वङ्गीं राक्षसीं प्रश्रयानतः //
text_mt:
Hearing that speech of his daughter, King Sudyumna then
appeased the slender-limbed rākṣasī, bowing with humility:

sanskrit_iast:
sutaiṣā dharmabhītā me tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatā /
yadarthaṃ nihataḥ kāntastvayā pūrvataraḥ sati //
meaning:
सुतैषा धर्मभीता मे त्वामेव शरणं गता /
यदर्थं निहतः कान्तस्त्वया पूर्वतरः सति //
text_mt:
‘This daughter of mine, fearful of adharma, has taken refuge with you alone,
for whose sake her former lover was slain by you, O virtuous one.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadadhīnā tato bhadre jāteyaṃ matsutā kila /
imamicchati bhartāraṃ yo 'yaṃ bhartā kṛtastvayā //
meaning:
त्वदधीना ततो भद्रे जातेयं मत्सुता किल /
इममिच्छति भर्तारं यो ऽयं भर्ता कृतस्त्वया //
text_mt:
Therefore, O auspicious one, this daughter of mine has truly become subject to you.
She desires him as husband, who has been made a husband by you.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā praṇāmadānābhyāṃ yācitā tvaṃ niśācari /
anumodaya sāhāyye sutāṃ mama sulocane //
meaning:
मया प्रणामदानाभ्यां याचिता त्वं निशाचरि /
अनुमोदय साहाय्ये सुतां मम सुलोचने //
text_mt:
You are entreated by me with salutations and gifts, O night-roamer;
consent to assist my daughter, O lovely-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvākyādbhavatu preṣyā matsutā brāhmaṇasya tu /
sāpatnabhāvaṃ tyaktvā tu sutāṃ me paripālaya //
meaning:
त्वद्वाक्याद्भवतु प्रेष्या मत्सुता ब्राह्मणस्य तु /
सापत्नभावं त्यक्त्वा तु सुतां मे परिपालय //
text_mt:
By your word, let my daughter become a servant to the brāhmaṇa;
casting aside the feeling of a co-wife, protect my daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
sutāyā mama bhāryāyā madbalasya janasya ca /
purasya viṣayasyāpi svāminī tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सुताया मम भार्याया मद्बलस्य जनस्य च /
पुरस्य विषयस्यापि स्वामिनी त्वं न संशयः //
text_mt:
Of my daughter, of my wife, of my army, and of my people,
of the city, and of the kingdom as well, you are the mistress without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tava vākye sthitā hyeṣā sadaivāpi bhaviṣyati /
etacchruttvā tu vacanaṃ sudyumnasya niśācarī //
meaning:
तव वाक्ये स्थिता ह्येषा सदैवापि भविष्यति /
एतच्छ्रुत्त्वा तु वचनं सुद्युम्नस्य निशाचरी //
text_mt:
She will always abide indeed by your command.’
Hearing these words of Sudyumna, the night-roamer,

sanskrit_iast:
anvamodata śuddhena cetasā sahacāriṇī /
uvāca ca dharāpālaṃ pradānāya kṛtodyamam //
meaning:
अन्वमोदत शुद्धेन चेतसा सहचारिणी /
उवाच च धरापालं प्रदानाय कृतोद्यमम् //
text_mt:
his companion, consented with a pure heart,
and spoke to the protector of the earth, who was prepared to give [her]:

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthaṃ praṇatastvaṃ māṃ sadbhāvena nṛpottama /
tasmāddvitīyā bhāryeyaṃ bhavatvasya dvijanmanaḥ //
meaning:
यदर्थं प्रणतस्त्वं मां सद्भावेन नृपोत्तम /
तस्माद्द्वितीया भार्येयं भवत्वस्य द्विजन्मनः //
text_mt:
‘Since you have bowed to me with sincere devotion, O best of kings,
therefore let this [girl] become the second wife of this twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca bhavatā pūjyā kṛtvārcāṃ devamandire /
sarvaiśca nāgaraiḥ sārddhaṃ phālgune dhavale dale //
meaning:
अहं च भवता पूज्या कृत्वार्चां देवमन्दिरे /
सर्वैश्च नागरैः सार्द्धं फाल्गुने धवले दले //
text_mt:
And I must be worshipped by you, having made an icon in a temple of the gods,
along with all the citizens, during the bright fortnight in [the month of] Phālguna.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāhamutsavaḥ kāryo hyaṣṭamyā ācaturdaśīm /
naṭanartakayuktena gītavādyena bhūriṇā //
meaning:
सप्ताहमुत्सवः कार्यो ह्यष्टम्या आचतुर्दशीम् /
नटनर्तकयुक्तेन गीतवाद्येन भूरिणा //
text_mt:
A seven-day festival is to be held, from the eighth up to the fourteenth day,
with actors and dancers, accompanied by abundant song and instrumental music,

sanskrit_iast:
maireyamāṃsaraktādibalibhiścāpi pūjayā /
evaṃ prakurvate tubhyaṃ sadā kṣemakarī hyaham //
meaning:
मैरेयमांसरक्तादिबलिभिश्चापि पूजया /
एवं प्रकुर्वते तुभ्यं सदा क्षेमकरी ह्यहम् //
text_mt:
and with worship through offerings of liquor, flesh, blood, and the like.
To you who do this, I shall always be one who bestows well-being,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaveyaṃ nṛpaśārdūla svaṃ vacaḥ pratipālaya /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ sudyumno nṛpatistadā //
aṅgīcakāra tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ prītayā tayā /
pratipanne tu vacasi rājñā tuṣṭā tu rākṣasī //
meaning:
भवेयं नृपशार्दूल स्वं वचः प्रतिपालय /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः सुद्युम्नो नृपतिस्तदा //
अङ्गीचकार तत्सर्वं यदुक्तं प्रीतया तया /
प्रतिपन्ने तु वचसि राज्ञा तुष्टा तु राक्षसी //
text_mt:
O tiger among kings. Protect your own word.’
Hearing that speech of hers, King Sudyumna then

accepted all that was spoken by her with delight.
When the word was accepted by the king, the rākṣasī was pleased,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ premṇā kuru bhāryāmimāmapi /
rājakanyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha gṛhyoktavidhinā śubhām //
meaning:
उवाच ब्राह्मणं प्रेम्णा कुरु भार्यामिमामपि /
राजकन्यां द्विजश्रेष्ठ गृह्योक्तविधिना शुभाम् //
text_mt:
and affectionately said to the brāhmaṇa: ‘Make this auspicious one your wife as well,
this royal maiden, O best of the twice-born, according to the domestic rites;

sanskrit_iast:
īrṣyāṃ tyaktvā viśālākṣyā bhavāmyeṣā sahodarī /
rākṣasyā vacaneneha pariṇīya nṛpātmajām //
meaning:
ईर्ष्यां त्यक्त्वा विशालाक्ष्या भवाम्येषा सहोदरी /
राक्षस्या वचनेनेह परिणीय नृपात्मजाम् //
text_mt:
abandoning jealousy, I shall become a sister to this large-eyed girl.’
Having married the king’s daughter here at the word of the rākṣasī,

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvittayutāṃ vipro mahodayapuraṃ yayau /
āruhya kariṇīrūpāṃ rākṣasīṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ //
meaning:
बहुवित्तयुतां विप्रो महोदयपुरं ययौ /
आरुह्य करिणीरूपां राक्षसीं क्षणमात्रतः //
text_mt:
the vipra, accompanied by great wealth, went to the city of Mahodaya,
mounting the rākṣasī in the form of a female elephant, in just an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mayā śrutaṃ devi bhartā te samupāgataḥ /
dhanaratnasamāyukto bhāryādvayasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो मया श्रुतं देवि भर्ता ते समुपागतः /
धनरत्नसमायुक्तो भार्याद्वयसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
Then it was heard by me, O lady: ‘Your husband has arrived,
endowed with wealth and gems, accompanied by two wives.’

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ bandhuvargeṇa pitṛbhyāṃ ca sakhīgaṇaiḥ /
bahuśo bhartsitā rūkṣairvacanairmarmabhedibhiḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं बन्धुवर्गेण पितृभ्यां च सखीगणैः /
बहुशो भर्त्सिता रूक्षैर्वचनैर्मर्मभेदिभिः //
text_mt:
Then I was repeatedly rebuked by the group of kinsmen, by my parents, and by friends,
with harsh words that pierced the vital spots:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ yāsyasi bhartāraṃ dhanalubdhe śriyā vṛtam /
yastvayā nirddhanaḥ pūrvaṃ parityaktaḥ sudīnavat //
meaning:
कथं यास्यसि भर्तारं धनलुब्धे श्रिया वृतम् /
यस्त्वया निर्द्धनः पूर्वं परित्यक्तः सुदीनवत् //
text_mt:
‘How will you go to your husband, O you who lust for wealth, now that he is attended by fortune,
he who, penniless, was formerly abandoned by you like a wretch?

sanskrit_iast:
cañcalānīha vittāni pitryāṇi kila yoṣitām /
kāntārjitāni subhage sthirāṇīti nigadyate //
meaning:
चञ्चलानीह वित्तानि पित्र्याणि किल योषिताम् /
कान्तार्जितानि सुभगे स्थिराणीति निगद्यते //
text_mt:
Fickle here indeed is ancestral wealth for women;
that earned by the beloved, O fortunate one, is declared to be stable.

sanskrit_iast:
paruṣairvacanairyastu kṣiptastadbhāṣaṇaṃ katham /
bhaviṣyati praveśo 'pi duṣkarastasya veśmani //
meaning:
परुषैर्वचनैर्यस्तु क्षिप्तस्तद्भाषणं कथम् /
भविष्यति प्रवेशो ऽपि दुष्करस्तस्य वेश्मनि //
text_mt:
How can there be speech with him who was cast off with harsh words?
Even entrance into his house will be difficult.

sanskrit_iast:
gatāyā api te tatra śayanaṃ patinā saha /
bhaviṣyati durācāre sukhadaṃ na kadācana //
meaning:
गताया अपि ते तत्र शयनं पतिना सह /
भविष्यति दुराचारे सुखदं न कदाचन //
text_mt:
Even if you have gone there, sleeping with your husband,
O ill-behaved woman, will never bring happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
lokāpavādādyadi cedgrahīṣyati patistava /
tvāṃ snehahīnacittastu na kadācinmiliṣyati //
meaning:
लोकापवादाद्यदि चेद्ग्रहीष्यति पतिस्तव /
त्वां स्नेहहीनचित्तस्तु न कदाचिन्मिलिष्यति //
text_mt:
Even if your husband takes you back due to public censure,
his heart devoid of affection, he will never unite [with you].

sanskrit_iast:
nedṛśaṃ duḥkhadaṃ kiñcidyādṛśaṃ dūracittayoḥ /
daṃpakatyormilanaṃ loke vaikalyakaraṇaṃ mahat //
meaning:
नेदृशं दुःखदं किञ्चिद्यादृशं दूरचित्तयोः /
दंपकत्योर्मिलनं लोके वैकल्यकरणं महत् //
text_mt:
There is nothing that brings sorrow such as the union in this world
of a husband and wife whose hearts are far apart; it produces great distress.’

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuvidhā vācaḥ śṛṇvānā bandhubhāṣitāḥ /
adhomukhyasrupūrṇākṣī babhūvāhaṃ suduḥkhitā //
meaning:
एवं बहुविधा वाचः शृण्वाना बन्धुभाषिताः /
अधोमुख्यस्रुपूर्णाक्षी बभूवाहं सुदुःखिता //
text_mt:
Hearing these manifold words spoken by my kinsmen,
with my face turned downwards and eyes filled with tears, I became exceedingly sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
cetasārcitayaṃ cāhaṃ pūrvalobhena muhyatī /
na dattaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇerna dattaṃ kaṭisūtrakam //
meaning:
चेतसार्चितयं चाहं पूर्वलोभेन मुह्यती /
न दत्तं कङ्कणं पाणेर्न दत्तं कटिसूत्रकम् //
text_mt:
And I thought in my mind, bewildered by my former greed:
‘The bracelet of my hand was not given, the waist-cord was not given,

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi nūpure datte yena tuṣṭiṃ vrajetpatiḥ /
dhanajīvitayoḥ svāmī bhartā lokeṣu gīyate //
meaning:
न चापि नूपुरे दत्ते येन तुष्टिं व्रजेत्पतिः /
