धनजीवितयोः स्वामी भर्ता लोकेषु गीयते //
text_mt:
nor were the two anklets given, by which my husband might have attained satisfaction.
A husband is sung in the worlds to be the master of wealth and life.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmayāpahṛtaṃ vittaṃ bhavitrī kā gatirmama /
kathaṃ yāsyāmi tadveśma kathaṃ saṃbhāṣaye punaḥ //
meaning:
तन्मयापहृतं वित्तं भवित्री का गतिर्मम /
कथं यास्यामि तद्वेश्म कथं संभाषये पुनः //
text_mt:
Yet that wealth was stolen by me! What will my fate be?
How shall I go to his house? How can I speak to him again?

sanskrit_iast:
yo mayā duṣṭayā tyaktaḥ sa pratyeti kathaṃ hi mām /
evaṃ viciṃye yādaddhṛdayena vidūyatā //
meaning:
यो मया दुष्टया त्यक्तः स प्रत्येति कथं हि माम् /
एवं विचिंये यादद्धृदयेन विदूयता //
text_mt:
How can he trust me, who was abandoned by wicked me?’
While I was reflecting thus with an aching heart,

sanskrit_iast:
veṣṭitā bandhuvargeṇa tāvaddolā samāgatā /
chatreṇa śaśivarṇena śobhamānā sukomalā //
meaning:
वेष्टिता बन्धुवर्गेण तावद्दोला समागता /
छत्रेण शशिवर्णेन शोभमाना सुकोमला //
text_mt:
surrounded by my circle of kinsmen, a palanquin arrived,
shining with a parasol the color of the moon, very soft,

sanskrit_iast:
āstṛtā rāṅkavaiḥ pīnaiḥ puruṣorvidhṛtāṃsakaiḥ /
te samāgatya puruṣāḥ procurmāmasakṛcchabhe //
meaning:
आस्तृता राङ्कवैः पीनैः पुरुषोर्विधृतांसकैः /
ते समागत्य पुरुषाः प्रोचुर्मामसकृच्छभे //
text_mt:
spread with thick woolen blankets, carried on the broad shoulders of men.
Those men, having arrived, said to me repeatedly, O auspicious lady:

sanskrit_iast:
ākāritāsi patyā te vraja śīghraṃ mudānvitā /
dhanaratnayuto bhartā saddhibhāryaḥ samāgataḥ //
meaning:
आकारितासि पत्या ते व्रज शीघ्रं मुदान्विता /
धनरत्नयुतो भर्ता सद्धिभार्यः समागतः //
text_mt:
‘You are summoned by your husband; go quickly, filled with joy!
Endowed with wealth and gems, your husband has arrived with two virtuous wives.

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭamātreṇa gṛhe tvāmānetuṃ varānane /
preṣitāḥ satvaraṃ patyā saṃsthitāṃ pitṛveśmani //
meaning:
प्रविष्टमात्रेण गृहे त्वामानेतुं वरानने /
प्रेषिताः सत्वरं पत्या संस्थितां पितृवेश्मनि //
text_mt:
As soon as he entered the house, O fair-faced lady, we were dispatched
swiftly by your husband to bring you, who are staying in your father’s house.’

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ vrīḍitā devi bhartustadvīkṣya ceṣṭitam /
naivottaramadāṃ tebhyaḥ kiñcinmaunaṃ samāsthitā //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं व्रीडिता देवि भर्तुस्तद्वीक्ष्य चेष्टितम् /
नैवोत्तरमदां तेभ्यः किञ्चिन्मौनं समास्थिता //
text_mt:
Then, O lady, seeing that gesture of my husband, I was ashamed;
I gave no answer to them at all, having maintained silence.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ bandhuvargeṇa bhūyobhūyaḥ prabodhitā /
āhūtā svāminā gaccha sammānena tadantikam //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं बन्धुवर्गेण भूयोभूयः प्रबोधिता /
आहूता स्वामिना गच्छ सम्मानेन तदन्तिकम् //
text_mt:
Then I was repeatedly instructed by my circle of kinsmen:
‘You are called by your master; go into his presence with honor.

sanskrit_iast:
svāminākāritā patnī yā na yāti tadantikam /
sā tu dhvāṅkṣī bhavetputri janmāni daśa pañca ca //
meaning:
स्वामिनाकारिता पत्नी या न याति तदन्तिकम् /
सा तु ध्वाङ्क्षी भवेत्पुत्रि जन्मानि दश पञ्च च //
text_mt:
A wife summoned by her master who does not go into his presence,
O daughter, becomes a female crow for fifteen births.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā samāśvāsya māṃ gṛhītvā tvarānvitāḥ /
dolāmāropya gaccheti procuḥ snigdhā muhurmurhuḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा समाश्वास्य मां गृहीत्वा त्वरान्विताः /
दोलामारोप्य गच्छेति प्रोचुः स्निग्धा मुहुर्मुर्हुः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus and comforted me, taking me with haste,
placing me on the palanquin, affectionate, they repeatedly said: ‘Go!’

sanskrit_iast:
tataste puruṣā dolāṃ nidhāyāṃseṣu satvaram /
jagmurmahodayapuraṃ yatra tiṣṭhati me patiḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते पुरुषा दोलां निधायांसेषु सत्वरम् /
जग्मुर्महोदयपुरं यत्र तिष्ठति मे पतिः //
text_mt:
Then those men, having swiftly placed the palanquin on their shoulders,
went to the city of Mahodaya, where my husband was staying.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā gṛhaṃ tasya sarvataḥ kāñcanāvṛtam /
āsanīyaiśca bhojyaiśca dhanairvastrairyutaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
दृष्टं मया गृहं तस्य सर्वतः काञ्चनावृतम् /
आसनीयैश्च भोज्यैश्च धनैर्वस्त्रैर्युतं ततः //
text_mt:
His house was seen by me, covered on all sides with gold,
and endowed with seats, foods, riches, and garments.”

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā rākṣasī devī sā cāpi nṛpanandinī /
prītyā ca bhaktyā kurutāṃ praṇatiṃ mama sundari //
meaning:
अथ सा राक्षसी देवी सा चापि नृपनन्दिनी /
प्रीत्या च भक्त्या कुरुतां प्रणतिं मम सुन्दरि //
text_mt: Then that demoness lady and that king's daughter / offered obeisance to me with affection and devotion, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastābhyāmamahaṃ premṇā yathārhamabhipūjitā /
bhartṛvākyena saṃprītā snātvābhujaṃ tathāhṛtā //
meaning:
ततस्ताभ्याममहं प्रेम्णा यथार्हमभिपूजिता /
भर्तृवाक्येन संप्रीता स्नात्वाभुजं तथाहृता //
text_mt: Then I was honoured by the two with love according to my due; / pleased by my husband's word, I bathed and ate the food brought [for me].

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'stasamayātpaścādbhartā cāhūya satvaram /
pariṣvajya ciraṃ dorbhyāṃ paryaṅke saṃnyaveśayat //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्तसमयात्पश्चाद्भर्ता चाहूय सत्वरम् /
परिष्वज्य चिरं दोर्भ्यां पर्यङ्के संन्यवेशयत् //
text_mt: Then, after sunset, my husband called [me] quickly, / embraced [me] with both arms for a long time, and seated me upon the couch.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niśācarīṃ rājaputrīṃ cāhūya so 'bravīt /
bhaktyā yuvābhyāṃ kartavyamasyāścaraṇasevanam //
meaning:
ततो निशाचरीं राजपुत्रीं चाहूय सो ऽब्रवीत् /
भक्त्या युवाभ्यां कर्तव्यमस्याश्चरणसेवनम् //
text_mt: Then, having summoned the demoness and the king's daughter, he said: / 'Devotedly, you two must attend upon her feet.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ prākkālikī bhāryā jyeṣṭhā ca yuvayordbhuvam /
patyurvākyāttatastābhyāṃ gṛhītau caraṇau mama //
meaning:
इयं प्राक्कालिकी भार्या ज्येष्ठा च युवयोर्द्भुवम् /
पत्युर्वाक्यात्ततस्ताभ्यां गृहीतौ चरणौ मम //
text_mt: She was my wife from former times, and surely the senior of you two.' / Then, by the husband's word, they clasped my feet,

sanskrit_iast:
sāpatnabhāvajāmīrṣyāṃ parityajya sulocane /
tataḥ preṣyānsamāhūya bhartā me vākyamabravīt //
meaning:
सापत्नभावजामीर्ष्यां परित्यज्य सुलोचने /
ततः प्रेष्यान्समाहूय भर्ता मे वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: having abandoned the jealousy arising from co-wife status, O lovely-eyed one. / Then, having summoned the servants, my husband addressed these words:

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiñcidrakṣasaḥ pārśvānmayā prāptaṃ purā vasu /
sutāmudvahato rājño yacca labdhaṃ mayākhilam //
meaning:
यत्किञ्चिद्रक्षसः पार्श्वान्मया प्राप्तं पुरा वसु /
सुतामुद्वहतो राज्ञो यच्च लब्धं मयाखिलम् //
text_mt: 'Whatever wealth was obtained by me formerly from the demon's side, / and whatever whole [dowry] was received by me while marrying the king's daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ bhaktibhāvena samānayata mā ciram /
iyaṃ hi svāminī prāptā tasya vittasya kiṅkarāḥ //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं भक्तिभावेन समानयत मा चिरम् /
इयं हि स्वामिनी प्राप्ता तस्य वित्तस्य किङ्कराः //
text_mt: bring all that with devoted mind without delay! / For the mistress of that wealth has arrived, O servants!'

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyātsahasā preṣyaiḥ samānītaṃ dhanaṃ śubhe /
bhartā samarpayāmāsa prītyā yukto 'khilaṃ tadā //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यात्सहसा प्रेष्यैः समानीतं धनं शुभे /
भर्ता समर्पयामास प्रीत्या युक्तो ऽखिलं तदा //
text_mt: By his command, the wealth was swiftly brought by the servants, O auspicious one; / and the husband, filled with joy, then handed over everything.

sanskrit_iast:
satkṛtya bhūṣaṇairvastraikhyalīkena cetasā /
ubhayostatra paśyantyo rākṣasīrājakanyayoḥ //
meaning:
सत्कृत्य भूषणैर्वस्त्रैख्यलीकेन चेतसा /
उभयोस्तत्र पश्यन्त्यो राक्षसीराजकन्ययोः //
text_mt: Honouring [me] with ornaments and garments with an unblemished heart, / while both the demoness and the princess were looking on there,

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṅkasthāṃ pariṣvajya māṃ cuñcubādhare śubhe /
taddṛṣṭvā cādbhutaṃ bharturdehavittasamarpaṇam //
meaning:
पर्यङ्कस्थां परिष्वज्य मां चुञ्चुबाधरे शुभे /
तद्दृष्ट्वा चाद्भुतं भर्तुर्देहवित्तसमर्पणम् //
text_mt: embracing me as I sat on the couch, kissing my lower lip, O auspicious one, / and seeing that wondrous offering of body and wealth by my husband,

sanskrit_iast:
ullāsakaraṇa vākyaṃ kareṇa kucapīḍanam /
chinnā gauriva khaṅgena gatāḥ prāṇā mamābhavan //
meaning:
उल्लासकरण वाक्यं करेण कुचपीडनम् /
छिन्ना गौरिव खङ्गेन गताः प्राणा ममाभवन् //
text_mt: [his] speech causing joy, the pressing of [my] breast with his hand— / like a cow struck down with a sword, my vital breaths departed.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ yamanirddiṣṭāṃ prāptā narakayātanām /
tāmatītya suduḥkhārtā kāṣṭhīlā cābhavaṃ śubhe //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं यमनिर्द्दिष्टां प्राप्ता नरकयातनाम् /
तामतीत्य सुदुःखार्ता काष्ठीला चाभवं शुभे //
text_mt: Then I attained the torment of hell ordained by Yama; / having lived through that, intensely afflicted with suffering, I became a kāṣṭhīlā, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyāmi punarevāhaṃ tiryagyoniṃ sahasraśaḥ /
yā bharturnāpayedvittaṃ jīvitaṃ ca śubhānane //
meaning:
यास्यामि पुनरेवाहं तिर्यग्योनिं सहस्रशः /
या भर्तुर्नापयेद्वित्तं जीवितं च शुभानने //
text_mt: I will go again into animal wombs thousands of times. / She who does not surrender her wealth and life to her husband, O fair-faced one,

sanskrit_iast:
sāpīdṛśīmavasthā vai yāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
evaṃ jñātvāniśaṃ rakṣetpatyurvittaṃ ca jīvitam //
meaning:
सापीदृशीमवस्था वै यास्यत्येव न संशयः /
एवं ज्ञात्वानिशं रक्षेत्पत्युर्वित्तं च जीवितम् //
text_mt: she too will surely reach such a condition, without doubt. / Knowing this, one should unceasingly protect the husband's wealth and life.

sanskrit_iast: patirmātā pitā vittaṃ jīvitaṃ ca gururgatiḥ //
meaning: पतिर्माता पिता वित्तं जीवितं च गुरुर्गतिः //
text_mt: The husband is mother, father, wealth, life, teacher, and refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāti nārī bahubhiḥ supuṇyaiḥ sahaiva bhartrā svaśarīradāhāt /
viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vittaśarīralubdhā prayāti yāmīṃ ca kuyonipīḍām //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite kāṣṭhīlācaritaṃ nāma triṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
प्रयाति नारी बहुभिः सुपुण्यैः सहैव भर्त्रा स्वशरीरदाहात् /
विष्णोः पदं वित्तशरीरलुब्धा प्रयाति यामीं च कुयोनिपीडाम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते काष्ठीलाचरितं नाम त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
A woman goes along with her husband by burning her own body through many great merits / to the abode of Viṣṇu; greedy for wealth and body, she goes to the torment of Yama and wretched wombs.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Story of Kāṣṭhīlā,' in the narrative of Mohinī in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ kāṣṭhīlāyāḥ śucismite /
sandhyāvalī nāma bhṛśaṃ tāmuvāca ha sādaram //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः काष्ठीलायाः शुचिस्मिते /
सन्ध्यावली नाम भृशं तामुवाच ह सादरम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing that speech of that kāṣṭhīlā, O you of pure smile, / [a woman] named Sandhyāvalī spoke to her with great respect:

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvākyādvismayo jātaḥ kāṣṭhīle sāṃprataṃ mama /
kathaṃ dṛṣṭā mayā tvaṃ ca yāsyantī kutsitāṃ gatim //
meaning:
त्वद्वाक्याद्विस्मयो जातः काष्ठीले सांप्रतं मम /
कथं दृष्टा मया त्वं च यास्यन्ती कुत्सितां गतिम् //
text_mt: 'From your words, wonder has arisen in me now, O Kāṣṭhīlā. / How is it that I have seen you destined to go to a vile state?

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā kena te muktirbhavetkutsitayonitaḥ /
tanme vada viśālāṅge tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitā hyaham //
meaning:
कर्मणा केन ते मुक्तिर्भवेत्कुत्सितयोनितः /
तन्मे वद विशालाङ्गे त्वां दृष्ट्वा दुःखिता ह्यहम् //
text_mt: By what deed could your liberation from a vile womb occur? / Tell me that, O large-limbed one; for seeing you, I am sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsapiṇḍopamaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ navanītopamaṃ śubhe /
śarīraṃ tava saṃvīkṣya tayā me jāyate hṛdi //
meaning:
मांसपिण्डोपमं श्लक्ष्णं नवनीतोपमं शुभे /
शरीरं तव संवीक्ष्य तया मे जायते हृदि //
text_mt: Resembling a lump of flesh, smooth, resembling butter, O fair one— / seeing your body, [compassion] arises in my heart for it.'

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhīlovāca
pṛthivīṃ dāsyase subhru sakalāmapi matkṛte /
tathāpi naiva mucyeyaṃ sadyaḥ kutsitayonitaḥ //
meaning:
काष्ठीलोवाच
पृथिवीं दास्यसे सुभ्रु सकलामपि मत्कृते /
तथापि नैव मुच्येयं सद्यः कुत्सितयोनितः //
text_mt:
Kāṣṭhīlā said:
Even if you were to give the entire earth on my behalf, fair-browed one,
still I would not be freed immediately from this contemptible womb.

sanskrit_iast:
yena puṇyena subhage mucyeyaṃ karmabandhanāt /
tannirdiśāmi sumahadgatidaṃ tvaṃ niśāmaya //
meaning:
येन पुण्येन सुभगे मुच्येयं कर्मबन्धनात् /
तन्निर्दिशामि सुमहद्गतिदं त्वं निशामय //
text_mt:
By what religious merit, fortunate one, I may be released from the bond of karma,
that I shall declare to you—an immense path-giver; listen!

sanskrit_iast:
yaścāyaṃ māghamāsastu sarvamāsottamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
yasmin krośanti pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca //
meaning:
यश्चायं माघमासस्तु सर्वमासोत्तमः स्मृतः /
यस्मिन् क्रोशन्ति पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च //
text_mt:
This month of Māgha, remembered as the best of all months,
in which sins such as the killing of a brāhmaṇa cry out [in distress]—

sanskrit_iast:
durlabho māghamāso vai durllabhaṃ janma mānuṣam /
durllabhaṃ coṣasi snānaṃ durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam //
meaning:
दुर्लभो माघमासो वै दुर्ल्लभं जन्म मानुषम् /
दुर्ल्लभं चोषसि स्नानं दुर्लभं कृष्णसेवनम् //
text_mt:
Rare indeed is the month of Māgha, rare is human birth,
rare is bathing at dawn, and rare is service to Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabho vāsaro viṣṇorvidhinā samupoṣitaḥ /
devaistejaḥ parikṣiptaṃ māghamāse svakaṃ jale //
meaning:
दुर्लभो वासरो विष्णोर्विधिना समुपोषितः /
देवैस्तेजः परिक्षिप्तं माघमासे स्वकं जले //
text_mt:
Rare is the day of Viṣṇu fasted according to the rule;
the gods have cast their own splendor into the water in the month of Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmājjalaṃ māghamāse pāvanaṃ hi viśeṣataḥ /
nedṛśī saṃgare śūrairgatiḥ prāpyeta saukhyadā //
meaning:
तस्माज्जलं माघमासे पावनं हि विशेषतः /
नेदृशी संगरे शूरैर्गतिः प्राप्येत सौख्यदा //
text_mt:
Therefore, water is exceptionally purifying in the month of Māgha.
Such a bliss-giving state could not be attained even by heroes in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśī plavane prātaḥ prāpyate niyamasthitaiḥ /
sarittaḍāgavāpīṣu snāne sattamamīritam //
meaning:
यादृशी प्लवने प्रातः प्राप्यते नियमस्थितैः /
सरित्तडागवापीषु स्नाने सत्तममीरितम् //
text_mt:
as that which is attained in bathing at dawn by those firm in vows.
Bathing in rivers, ponds, and stepwells is declared the best;

sanskrit_iast:
kūpabhāṇḍajalairmadhyaṃ jaghanyaṃ vahnitāpitaiḥ /
na saukhyairlabhyate puṇyaṃ duḥkhairevāpyate tu tat //
meaning:
कूपभाण्डजलैर्मध्यं जघन्यं वह्नितापितैः /
न सौख्यैर्लभ्यते पुण्यं दुःखैरेवाप्यते तु तत् //
text_mt:
with water from wells and pots it is middling; with water heated by fire it is base.
Merit is not attained through comforts, but it is gained through hardships alone.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmmasevārthakaṃ snānaṃ nāṅganairmalyahetukam /
homārthaṃ sevanaṃ vahnerna ca śītādihānaye //
meaning:
धर्म्मसेवार्थकं स्नानं नाङ्गनैर्मल्यहेतुकम् /
होमार्थं सेवनं वह्नेर्न च शीतादिहानये //
text_mt:
Bathing is for the sake of serving righteousness, not for the cause of cleansing the limbs;
resorting to fire is for the sake of oblation, not for the removal of cold and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannodayate sūryastāvatsnānaṃ vidhīyate /
ācchādite ghanairvyomni hyudgamiṣyantamarthayet //
meaning:
यावन्नोदयते सूर्यस्तावत्स्नानं विधीयते /
आच्छादिते घनैर्व्योम्नि ह्युद्गमिष्यन्तमर्थयेत् //
text_mt:
As long as the sun has not risen, so long is bathing prescribed.
If the sky is covered with clouds, one should pray to [the sun] that is about to rise.

sanskrit_iast:
abhāve saridādīnāṃ navakuṃbhasthitaṃ jalam /
vāyunā tāḍitaṃ rātrau snāne gaṅgāsamaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
अभावे सरिदादीनां नवकुंभस्थितं जलम् /
वायुना ताडितं रात्रौ स्नाने गङ्गासमं विदुः //
text_mt:
In the absence of rivers and the like, water kept in a new jar
and struck by the wind at night is known to be equal to the Gaṅgā for bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
māghasnāyī varārohe durgatiṃ naiva paśyati /
tannāsti pātakaṃ yattu māghasnānaṃ na śodhayet //
meaning:
माघस्नायी वरारोहे दुर्गतिं नैव पश्यति /
तन्नास्ति पातकं यत्तु माघस्नानं न शोधयेत् //
text_mt:
One who bathes in Māgha, fair-hipped one, never sees a bad rebirth;
there is no sin that bathing in Māgha does not purify.

sanskrit_iast:
agnipraveśādadhikaṃ māghoṣasyeva majjanam /
jīvatā bhujyate duḥkhaṃ mṛtena bahulaṃ sukham //
meaning:
अग्निप्रवेशादधिकं माघोषस्येव मज्जनम् /
जीवता भुज्यते दुःखं मृतेन बहुलं सुखम् //
text_mt:
Dipping at the dawn of Māgha is greater than entering fire:
while living, one endures a little hardship, and having died, one experiences abundant happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
etasmātkāraṇādbhadre māghasnānaṃ viśiṣyate /
ahanyahani dātavyāstilāḥ śarkarayānvitāḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्भद्रे माघस्नानं विशिष्यते /
अहन्यहनि दातव्यास्तिलाः शर्करयान्विताः //
text_mt:
For this reason, auspicious one, the Māgha bath is superior.
Day after day, sesame seeds mixed with sugar should be given,

sanskrit_iast:
meghapuṃṣpopapannena sahānnena sumadhyame /
yāvakaiścaiva hotavyā gavyasarpiḥ samanvitaiḥ //
meaning:
मेघपुंष्पोपपन्नेन सहान्नेन सुमध्यमे /
यावकैश्चैव होतव्या गव्यसर्पिः समन्वितैः //
text_mt:
along with food prepared with water, slender-waisted one;
and one should make offerings with barley grains accompanied by cow's ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhyāṃ snānasamāptai tu dadyādviprāya ṣaḍrasam /
sūryo me prīyatāṃ devo viṣṇumūrtirnirañjanaḥ //
meaning:
माध्यां स्नानसमाप्तै तु दद्याद्विप्राय षड्रसम् /
सूर्यो मे प्रीयतां देवो विष्णुमूर्तिर्निरञ्जनः //
text_mt:
At the full moon, upon the completion of the bath, one should give [food of] six tastes to a brāhmaṇa:
‘May the divine Sun, whose form is Viṣṇu, unstained, be pleased with me!’

sanskrit_iast:
vāsāṃsi dvijayugmāya sa saptānnāni cārpayet /
triṃśacca modakā deyāstilānnāḥ śarkarāmayāḥ //
meaning:
वासांसि द्विजयुग्माय स सप्तान्नानि चार्पयेत् /
त्रिंशच्च मोदका देयास्तिलान्नाः शर्करामयाः //
text_mt:
He should present garments to a pair of brāhmaṇas and seven types of grain,
and thirty sweetmeats made of sesame seeds and sugar should be given.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgāstrayastilānāṃ tu caturthaḥ śarkarāṃśakaḥ /
tāṃbūlādīni bhogyāni bhaktyādakadyādvidhānavit //
meaning:
भागास्त्रयस्तिलानां तु चतुर्थः शर्करांशकः /
तांबूलादीनि भोग्यानि भक्त्यादकद्याद्विधानवित् //
text_mt:
Three parts of sesame seeds and a fourth part of sugar:
the knower of the rule should offer betel and other enjoyable things with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
srotomukhaḥ sariti cānyatra bhāskarasaṃmukhaḥ /
snāyādāvāhya tīrthāni gaṅgādīnya karmaṇḍalāt //
meaning:
स्रोतोमुखः सरिति चान्यत्र भास्करसंमुखः /
स्नायादावाह्य तीर्थानि गङ्गादीन्य कर्मण्डलात् //
text_mt:
Facing the current in a river, and elsewhere facing the sun,
he should bathe, having summoned the sacred fords such as the Gaṅgā from the [sun's] disk.

sanskrit_iast:
yadanekajanurjanyaṃ yajjñānājñānataḥ kṛtam /
tvattejasā hataṃ cāstu tattu pāpaṃ sahasradhā //
meaning:
यदनेकजनुर्जन्यं यज्ज्ञानाज्ञानतः कृतम् /
त्वत्तेजसा हतं चास्तु तत्तु पापं सहस्रधा //
text_mt:
‘Whatever sin has arisen from many births, whatever has been done consciously or unconsciously,
may that sin be destroyed a thousandfold by your splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
divākara jagannātha prabhākara namo 'stu te /
paripūrṇaṃ kuruṣvedaṃ māghasnānaṃ mamācyuta //
meaning:
दिवाकर जगन्नाथ प्रभाकर नमो ऽस्तु ते /
परिपूर्णं कुरुष्वेदं माघस्नानं ममाच्युत //
text_mt:
O Maker of Day, Lord of the World, Maker of Light, homage to you!
Make this Māgha bath of mine complete, O Acyuta!’

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthasnāyī varārohe māghasnāyī phalālpakaḥ /
tīrthasnānādiyātsvargaṃ māghasnānātparaṃ padam //
meaning:
तीर्थस्नायी वरारोहे माघस्नायी फलाल्पकः /
तीर्थस्नानादियात्स्वर्गं माघस्नानात्परं पदम् //
text_mt:
One who bathes in sacred fords, fair-hipped one, has little fruit compared to one who bathes in Māgha:
from bathing in a sacred ford one may go to heaven; from the Māgha bath, to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
māghasya dhavale pakṣe bhavedekādaśī tu yā /
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā mahāpātakanāśinī //
meaning:
माघस्य धवले पक्षे भवेदेकादशी तु या /
रविवारेण संयुक्ता महापातकनाशिनी //
text_mt:
The Ekādaśī that falls in the bright fortnight of Māgha,
combined with Sunday, destroys great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
vināpi ṛkṣasaṃyogaṃ sā śuklaikādaśī nṛṇām /
vinirdahati pāpāni kunṛpo viṣayaṃ yathā //
meaning:
विनापि ऋक्षसंयोगं सा शुक्लैकादशी नृणाम् /
विनिर्दहति पापानि कुनृपो विषयं यथा //
text_mt:
Even without conjunction with an asterism, that bright Ekādaśī
consumes the sins of men, as a bad king consumes a realm,

sanskrit_iast:
kuputrastu kulaṃ yadvatkubhāryā ca patiṃ yathā /
adharmastu yathā dharmaṃ kumantrī nṛpatiṃ yathā //
meaning:
कुपुत्रस्तु कुलं यद्वत्कुभार्या च पतिं यथा /
अधर्मस्तु यथा धर्मं कुमन्त्री नृपतिं यथा //
text_mt:
just as a bad son ruins a family, a bad wife her husband,
unrighteousness ruins righteousness, and an evil minister a king,

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānaṃ ca yathā jñānaṃ kuśaucaṃ śucitāṃ yathā /
yathā hantyanṛtaṃ satyaṃ vādassaṃvādameva ca //
meaning:
अज्ञानं च यथा ज्ञानं कुशौचं शुचितां यथा /
यथा हन्त्यनृतं सत्यं वादस्संवादमेव च //
text_mt:
just as ignorance destroys knowledge, and bad purification destroys purity,
just as falsehood destroys truth, and disputation destroys pleasant conversation,

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṇaṃ himamanarthor'thaṃ pāpaṃ kīrtiṃ smayastapaḥ /
yathā rasā mahārogāñchrāddhaṃ saṃketa eva ca //
meaning:
उष्णं हिममनर्थोर्ऽथं पापं कीर्तिं स्मयस्तपः /
यथा रसा महारोगाञ्छ्राद्धं संकेत एव च //
text_mt:
just as heat destroys frost, worthlessness wealth, sin renown, pride asceticism,
just as mercury destroys great diseases, and an appointed meeting destroys a śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā duritasaṃghaṃ tu dvādaśī hanti sādhitā /
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ //
meaning:
तथा दुरितसंघं तु द्वादशी हन्ति साधिता /
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः //
text_mt:
so the Dvādaśī, when performed, destroys a multitude of sins:
brahminicide, liquor-drinking, theft, and violation of the Guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānti pātakānyetānyāśu hanti harerdinam /
samavetāni caitāni na śāmayati puṣkaram //
meaning:
महान्ति पातकान्येतान्याशु हन्ति हरेर्दिनम् /
समवेतानि चैतानि न शामयति पुष्करम् //
text_mt:
These great sins the day of Hari destroys swiftly;
when united, Puṣkara cannot pacify them,

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi naimiṣāraṇyaṃ na kṣetraṃ kurusaṃjñitam /
prabhāso na gayā devi na revā na sarasvatī //
meaning:
न चापि नैमिषारण्यं न क्षेत्रं कुरुसंज्ञितम् /
प्रभासो न गया देवि न रेवा न सरस्वती //
text_mt:
nor can the Naimiṣa forest, nor the field called Kuru,
nor Prabhāsa, nor Gayā, O goddess, nor the Revā, nor the Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
na gagā yamunā caiva prayāgo na ca devakā /
na sarāṃsi nadāścānye homadānatapāṃsi ca //
meaning:
न गगा यमुना चैव प्रयागो न च देवका /
न सरांसि नदाश्चान्ये होमदानतपांसि च //
text_mt:
nor the Gaṅgā, and Yamunā, nor Prayāga, nor the Devakā,
nor lakes, nor other rivers, nor oblations, gifts, and austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
na cānyatsukṛtaṃ subhru purāṇe paṭhyate sphuṭam /
pāpasaṃghavināśāya muktvaikaṃ harivāsaram //
meaning:
न चान्यत्सुकृतं सुभ्रु पुराणे पठ्यते स्फुटम् /
पापसंघविनाशाय मुक्त्वैकं हरिवासरम् //
text_mt:
nor any other good deed, fair-browed one, is clearly taught in the Purāṇa
for the destruction of the multitude of sins, except for the single day of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣaṇātsakṛddevi vinaśyantyagharāśayaḥ /
ekataḥ pṛthivīdānamekato harivāsaram //
meaning:
उपोषणात्सकृद्देवि विनश्यन्त्यघराशयः /
एकतः पृथिवीदानमेकतो हरिवासरम् //
text_mt:
From fasting once, O goddess, heaps of sins are destroyed.
On one side the gift of the earth, on the other side the day of Hari—

sanskrit_iast:
na samaṃ brahmaṇā proktamadhikaṃ harivāsaram /
tasminvarāhavapuṣaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ tu hāṭakam //
meaning:
न समं ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तमधिकं हरिवासरम् /
तस्मिन्वराहवपुषं कृत्वा देवं तु हाटकम् //
text_mt:
they are not equal, Brahmā has declared; the day of Hari is greater.
On that day, having made a golden deity with the form of Varāha,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭopari nave pātre dhṛtvā tāmramaye śubhe /
sarvabījānvite caiva sitavastrāvaguṇṭhite //
meaning:
घटोपरि नवे पात्रे धृत्वा ताम्रमये शुभे /
सर्वबीजान्विते चैव सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठिते //
text_mt:
placing it upon a pot, in a new, auspicious copper vessel
supplied with all kinds of seeds and covered with a white cloth,

sanskrit_iast:
sahiraṇye sudīpāḍhye kṛtapuṣpāvataṃsake /
vidhinā pūjayitvā cakuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī //
meaning:
सहिरण्ये सुदीपाढ्ये कृतपुष्पावतंसके /
विधिना पूजयित्वा चकुर्याज्जागरणं व्रती //
text_mt:
with gold, endowed with a bright lamp, provided with a flower crest,
having worshipped it according to rule, the vow-keeper should keep an all-night vigil.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarviprāya dadyācca vaiṣṇavāya kuṭuṃbine /
tatkuṃbhakroḍasaṃyuktaṃ sanaivedyaparicchadam //
meaning:
प्रातर्विप्राय दद्याच्च वैष्णवाय कुटुंबिने /
तत्कुंभक्रोडसंयुक्तं सनैवेद्यपरिच्छदम् //
text_mt:
In the morning, he should give it to a Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇa householder,
endowed with that pot and boar [image], along with food offerings and furnishings.

sanskrit_iast:
paścācca pāraṇaṃ kuryāddvijānbhojya suhṛdvṛtaḥ /
evaṃ kṛte varārohe na bhūyo jāyate kvacit //
meaning:
पश्चाच्च पारणं कुर्याद्द्विजान्भोज्य सुहृद्वृतः /
एवं कृते वरारोहे न भूयो जायते क्वचित् //
text_mt:
Afterwards he should break the fast, having fed the brāhmaṇas, surrounded by friends.
When this is done, fair-hipped one, he is never born again anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
bahujanmārjjitaṃ pāpaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ ca yat /
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā //
meaning:
बहुजन्मार्ज्जितं पापं ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं च यत् /
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति तमः सूर्योदये यथा //
text_mt:
Sin acquired in many births, done knowingly or unknowingly,
all that goes to destruction, just as darkness at the rising of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśāstraṃ mayā tubhyaṃ varṇitā dvādaśī śubhe /
yā sā kṛtā tvayā pūrvamāsīddevyanyajanmani //
meaning:
यथाशास्त्रं मया तुभ्यं वर्णिता द्वादशी शुभे /
या सा कृता त्वया पूर्वमासीद्देव्यन्यजन्मनि //
text_mt:
Thus has Dvādaśī been described to you by me according to the scripture, auspicious one,
which was performed by you formerly in another birth, O goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāstavātulā puṣṭirvartate vartayiṣyati /
bharttustava ca putrasya sarvadā sukhadāyinī //
meaning:
यस्यास्तवातुला पुष्टिर्वर्तते वर्तयिष्यति /
भर्त्तुस्तव च पुत्रस्य सर्वदा सुखदायिनी //
text_mt:
By which you have incomparable nourishment now and will have it in the future,
always giving happiness to your husband and to your son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstvayā turīyāṃśo deyaścenmahyamādarāt /
tadā prītā gamiṣyāmi tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
तस्यास्त्वया तुरीयांशो देयश्चेन्मह्यमादरात् /
तदा प्रीता गमिष्यामि तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
If the fourth part of that [merit] is given to me by you with respect,
then, pleased, I shall go to that supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
vittāhrutijaṃ pāpaṃ yadbhūtaṃ mama suṃdari /
tasya pāvanahetuṃ ca turīyāṃśaṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
वित्ताह्रुतिजं पापं यद्भूतं मम सुंदरि /
तस्य पावनहेतुं च तुरीयांशं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt:
Whatever sin arose from the misappropriation of wealth, beautiful one,
grant me a fourth part [of your merit] as the cause of purification for that!

sanskrit_iast:
jīvitenāpi vittena bhartāraṃ vañcayettu yā /
kṛmiyoniśataṃ gatvā pulkasī jāyate tu sā //
meaning:
जीवितेनापि वित्तेन भर्तारं वञ्चयेत्तु या /
कृमियोनिशतं गत्वा पुल्कसी जायते तु सा //
text_mt:
A woman who cheats her husband of life or of wealth,
having gone through a hundred wombs of worms, is born as an outcaste woman.

sanskrit_iast:
surataṃ yācamānāya patye vittaṃ ca mānini /
yā na yacchati durbuddhiḥ kāṣṭhīlā jāyate dhruvam //
meaning:
सुरतं याचमानाय पत्ये वित्तं च मानिनि /
या न यच्छति दुर्बुद्धिः काष्ठीला जायते ध्रुवम् //
text_mt:
She who, proud and evil-minded, does not grant sexual pleasure
or wealth to her husband when he asks, is surely born as a kāṣṭhīlā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpātakaviśuddhyarthaṃ dehi me dvādaśībhavam /
turīyāṃśamitaṃ puṇyaṃ yadyasti mayi te ghṛṇā //
meaning:
तत्पातकविशुद्ध्यर्थं देहि मे द्वादशीभवम् /
तुरीयांशमितं पुण्यं यद्यस्ति मयि ते घृणा //
text_mt:
For the complete purification of that sin, give me one-fourth part of the merit
arising from that Dvādaśī, if you have compassion for me.’

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā vacastasyāḥ kāṣṭhīlāyāḥ sulocane /
puṇyaṃ dattavatī tasyai pāṇau vāri pragṛhya ca //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्याः काष्ठीलायाः सुलोचने /
पुण्यं दत्तवती तस्यै पाणौ वारि प्रगृह्य च //
text_mt:
Having heard this speech of that kāṣṭhīlā, fair-eyed one,
she gave her the merit, taking water in her hand:

sanskrit_iast:
yatkṛtaṃ hi mayā pūrvamekādaśyā mupoṣaṇam /
tatturīyāṃśapuṇyena kāṣṭhīleyaṃ vimucyatām //
meaning:
यत्कृतं हि मया पूर्वमेकादश्या मुपोषणम् /
तत्तुरीयांशपुण्येन काष्ठीलेयं विमुच्यताम् //
text_mt:
‘Whatever fast of Ekādaśī was performed by me formerly,
by a fourth part of that merit may this kāṣṭhīlā be liberated!’

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmakṛtātpāpātsatyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam /
evamukte tu vacane mayā vidyutsamaprabhā //
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मकृतात्पापात्सत्यं सत्यं मयोदितम् /
एवमुक्ते तु वचने मया विद्युत्समप्रभा //
text_mt:
en: "…from the sin committed in a previous birth; I speak the absolute truth."
When these words were spoken by me, shining like lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭā divyavimānasthā gacchantī vaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
patirhi daivataṃ loke vañcanīyo na bhāryayā //
meaning:
दृष्टा दिव्यविमानस्था गच्छन्ती वैष्णवं पदम् /
पतिर्हि दैवतं लोके वञ्चनीयो न भार्यया //
text_mt:
en: she was seen seated upon a celestial aerial chariot, ascending to the realm of Viṣṇu.
Indeed, a husband is the deity in this world; he must never be deceived by a wife,

sanskrit_iast:
dehena cāpi vittena yadīcchecchobhanāṃ gatim /
sā tvaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi bharturarthe tavepsitam //
meaning:
देहेन चापि वित्तेन यदीच्छेच्छोभनां गतिम् /
सा त्वं ब्रूहि प्रदास्यामि भर्तुरर्थे तवेप्सितम् //
text_mt:
en: with body or with wealth, if she desires an auspicious path.
So you, speak! For the sake of my husband I will give whatever you desire:

sanskrit_iast:
vittaṃ dehaṃ tathā putraṃ yaccānyadvā varānane /
kimanyaddaivataṃ loke strīṇāmekaṃ patiṃ vinā //
meaning:
वित्तं देहं तथा पुत्रं यच्चान्यद्वा वरानने /
किमन्यद्दैवतं लोके स्त्रीणामेकं पतिं विना //
text_mt:
en: wealth, body, likewise my son, or whatever else, O fair-faced woman.
What other deity is there in this world for women, except their one husband?

sanskrit_iast:
tasyārthe vā tyajedvittaṃ jīvitaṃ vā sulocane /
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तस्यार्थे वा त्यजेद्वित्तं जीवितं वा सुलोचने /
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं विष्णुलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
en: For his sake, one may abandon wealth or even life, O fair-eyed woman;
she is honoured in the realm of Viṣṇu for a hundred crore full kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
agnyādisākṣye vṛtamīkṣya niṣṭhurā yuktaṃ sudhorairvyasanairdvijātmajā /
patiṃ dadau naiva ca yācitā dhanaṃ tenaiva pāpena babhūva kīṭā //
meaning:
अग्न्यादिसाक्ष्ये वृतमीक्ष्य निष्ठुरा युक्तं सुधोरैर्व्यसनैर्द्विजात्मजा /
पतिं ददौ नैव च याचिता धनं तेनैव पापेन बभूव कीटा //
text_mt: en: Seeing [her husband] chosen in the presence of the fire and other witnesses, yet afflicted with dreadful distresses, the cruel daughter of the twice-born did not give him wealth when requested; and because of that very sin she became a worm.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmayā duṣṭamanaṅgayaṣṭi kaumārabhāve pitṛveśmavāse /
jñātvā hitaṃ tathyamidaṃ svabharturdadāmi sarvaṃ ca gṛhāṇa subhru //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite kāṣṭhīlopākhyāne māghamāhātmyaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतन्मया दुष्टमनङ्गयष्टि कौमारभावे पितृवेश्मवासे /
ज्ञात्वा हितं तथ्यमिदं स्वभर्तुर्ददामि सर्वं च गृहाण सुभ्रु //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते काष्ठीलोपाख्याने माघमाहात्म्यं नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
en: Having understood this true benefit for my husband in my maidenhood while dwelling in my father's house, O slender-limbed woman with wicked mind, I give everything. Take it, O lovely-browed one!

en: Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named 'Eulogy of the Greatness of Māgha', in the story of Kāṣṭhīlā within the narrative of Mohinī, in the Uttara portion of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃdhyāvalīvacaḥ śrutvā mohinī duhitā vidheḥ /
uvāca tatparā svīye kārye mohakaraṇḍikā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
संध्यावलीवचः श्रुत्वा मोहिनी दुहिता विधेः /
उवाच तत्परा स्वीये कार्ये मोहकरण्डिका //
text_mt:
en: Vasiṣṭha said:
Hearing the words of Saṃdhyāvalī, Mohinī, the daughter of the Creator,
a casket of delusion, intent on her own purpose, said:

sanskrit_iast:
yadyevaṃ tvaṃ vijānāsi dharmādharmagatiṃ śubhe /
bharturarthe pradātrī ca dhanajīvitayorapi //
meaning:
यद्येवं त्वं विजानासि धर्माधर्मगतिं शुभे /
भर्तुरर्थे प्रदात्री च धनजीवितयोरपि //
text_mt:
en: "If you understand so well the course of dharma and adharma, O auspicious woman,
and are willing to give even wealth and life for your husband's sake,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāhaṃ yācaye vittaṃ jīvitādadhikaṃ śubhe /
dehi putraśiroḥ mahyaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ hṛdayādhikam //
meaning:
तदाहं याचये वित्तं जीवितादधिकं शुभे /
देहि पुत्रशिरोः मह्यं यदिष्टं हृदयाधिकम् //
text_mt:
en: then I ask for wealth greater than life, O auspicious woman:
give me the head of your son, who is cherished more dearly than your own heart.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi no bhojanaṃ kuryātsaṃprāpte harivāsare /
tadā svahaste saṃgṛhya khaḍgaṃ rājā patistava //
meaning:
यदि नो भोजनं कुर्यात्संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे /
तदा स्वहस्ते संगृह्य खड्गं राजा पतिस्तव //
text_mt:
en: If he does not eat when the day of Hari has arrived,
then your husband the king, taking a sword in his own hand,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadaśiraścāru candrabiṃbopamaṃ śubham /
ajātaśmaśrukaṃ caiva kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vibhūṣitam //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदशिरश्चारु चन्द्रबिंबोपमं शुभम् /
अजातश्मश्रुकं चैव कुण्डलाभ्यां विभूषितम् //
text_mt:
en: must cut off the lovely, auspicious head of Dharmāṅgada,
resembling the disc of the moon, having no beard, and adorned with earrings,

sanskrit_iast:
chitvā śīghraṃ pātayatu mamotsaṃge sulocane /
etadvā kurutadbhadre yadānnaṃ na bhunakti ca //
meaning:
छित्वा शीघ्रं पातयतु ममोत्संगे सुलोचने /
एतद्वा कुरुतद्भद्रे यदान्नं न भुनक्ति च //
text_mt:
en: and cast it quickly into my lap, O fair-eyed woman!
Either do this, O good woman, when he does not eat food

sanskrit_iast:
dine mādhavadevasya pāpasaṃghavināśane /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā mohinyāḥ kaṭukākṣaram //
meaning:
दिने माधवदेवस्य पापसंघविनाशने /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्या मोहिन्याः कटुकाक्षरम् //
text_mt:
en: on the day of the god Mādhava, which destroys multitudes of sins."
Hearing that speech of Mohinī with its harsh syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
pracakaṃpe kṣaṇaṃ devī śītārtā kadalī yathā /
saṃdhyāvalī tato dhairyamāsthāya varavārṇinī //
meaning:
प्रचकंपे क्षणं देवी शीतार्ता कदली यथा /
संध्यावली ततो धैर्यमास्थाय वरवार्णिनी //
text_mt:
en: the queen trembled for a moment, like a plantain tree stricken by the cold.
Then Saṃdhyāvalī of excellent complexion, summoning her courage,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca mohinīṃ vākyaṃ sumukhī prahasaṃtyapi /
śrūyante hi purāṇeṣu gāthāḥ subhru samīritāḥ //
meaning:
उवाच मोहिनीं वाक्यं सुमुखी प्रहसंत्यपि /
श्रूयन्ते हि पुराणेषु गाथाः सुभ्रु समीरिताः //
text_mt:
en: spoke words to Mohinī, with a fair countenance and even smiling:
"Indeed, verses are heard spoken in the Purāṇas, O lovely-browed one,

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśī prati saṃbaddhāḥ svargamokṣapradāyikāḥ /
dhanaṃ tyajettyajeddārāñjīvitaṃ ca gṛhaṃ tyajet //
meaning:
द्वादशी प्रति संबद्धाः स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायिकाः /
धनं त्यजेत्त्यजेद्दाराञ्जीवितं च गृहं त्यजेत् //
text_mt:
en: connected with the dvādaśī, bestowing heaven and liberation:
One may abandon wealth, one may abandon a wife, life, and abandon one's home;

sanskrit_iast:
tyajeddeśaṃ tathā bhūpaṃ svargaṃ mitraṃ guruṃ tyajet /
tyajettīrthaṃ tyajeddharmaṃ tyajedatyantasupriyam //
meaning:
त्यजेद्देशं तथा भूपं स्वर्गं मित्रं गुरुं त्यजेत् /
त्यजेत्तीर्थं त्यजेद्धर्मं त्यजेदत्यन्तसुप्रियम् //
text_mt:
en: one may abandon one's land, likewise the king, heaven, a friend, and abandon the guru;
one may abandon a sacred ford, abandon duty, abandon what is exceedingly dear;

sanskrit_iast:
tyajedyogaṃ tyajeddānaṃ jñānaṃ puṇyakriyā tyajet /
tapastyajettyajedvidyāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ tyajecchubhe //
meaning:
त्यजेद्योगं त्यजेद्दानं ज्ञानं पुण्यक्रिया त्यजेत् /
तपस्त्यजेत्त्यजेद्विद्यां सिद्धिं मोक्षं त्यजेच्छुभे //
text_mt:
en: one may abandon yoga, abandon giving, knowledge, and abandon meritorious deeds;
one may abandon austerity, abandon learning, perfection, and abandon liberation, O auspicious woman;

sanskrit_iast:
na tyajeddvādagaśīṃ puṇyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi /
iha saṃbandhinaḥ sarve putrabhrātṛsuhṛtpriyāḥ //
meaning:
न त्यजेद्द्वादगशीं पुण्यां पक्षयोरुभयोरपि /
इह संबन्धिनः सर्वे पुत्रभ्रातृसुहृत्प्रियाः //
text_mt:
en: but one must not abandon the meritorious dvādaśī in either fortnight.
In this world, all relatives—sons, brothers, friends, and loved ones—

sanskrit_iast:
aihikāmuṣmike devi sādhanī dvādaśī smṛtā /
dvādaśyāstu prabhāveṇa sarvaṃ kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
ऐहिकामुष्मिके देवि साधनी द्वादशी स्मृता /
द्वादश्यास्तु प्रभावेण सर्वं क्षेमं भविष्यति //
text_mt:
en: are for this world; but the dvādaśī is remembered as the means for both this world and the next, O lady.
Through the power of the dvādaśī, all will turn out well.

sanskrit_iast:
dāpaye tava tuṣṭyarthaṃ dharmāṅgadaśiraḥ śubhe /
viśvāsaṃ kuru me vākye sukhinī bhava śobhane //
meaning:
दापये तव तुष्ट्यर्थं धर्माङ्गदशिरः शुभे /
विश्वासं कुरु मे वाक्ये सुखिनी भव शोभने //
text_mt:
en: For your satisfaction, I will cause the head of Dharmāṅgada to be given, O auspicious woman.
Trust my words; be happy, O beautiful lady!

sanskrit_iast:
ihārthaṃ śrūyate bhadre itihāsaḥ purātanaḥ /
kathayiṣyāmi te bhadre sāvadhānā śruṇuṣva me //
meaning:
इहार्थं श्रूयते भद्रे इतिहासः पुरातनः /
कथयिष्यामि ते भद्रे सावधाना श्रुणुष्व मे //
text_mt:
en: On this subject an ancient narrative is heard, O good woman.
I shall tell it to you, O good woman; listen to me attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīdvirocanaḥ pūrvaṃ daityo dharmaparāyaṇaḥ /
tasya bhāryā viśālākṣī dvijapūjanatatparā //
meaning:
आसीद्विरोचनः पूर्वं दैत्यो धर्मपरायणः /
तस्य भार्या विशालाक्षी द्विजपूजनतत्परा //
text_mt:
en: Formerly, there was a daitya named Virocana, devoted to dharma.
His wife, large-eyed, was devoted to worshipping the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
nityamekamṛṣiṃ prātaḥ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi /
pādodakaṃ tasya subhru bhaktyā pibati hṛṣṭadhīḥ //
meaning:
नित्यमेकमृषिं प्रातः पूजयित्वा यथाविधि /
पादोदकं तस्य सुभ्रु भक्त्या पिबति हृष्टधीः //
text_mt:
en: Every morning, having worshipped one sage in accordance with the rules,
she would drink his foot-washing water with devotion and a joyful mind, O lovely-browed one.

sanskrit_iast:
prāhlādiśaṅkitā devā āsanpūrvaṃ mṛte sati /
hiraṇyakaśipau rājyaṃ śāsati hyugratejasi //
meaning:
प्राह्लादिशङ्किता देवा आसन्पूर्वं मृते सति /
हिरण्यकशिपौ राज्यं शासति ह्युग्रतेजसि //
text_mt:
en: Formerly, when Hiraṇyakaśipu was dead, the gods were apprehensive of the son of Prahlāda,
as he, possessing fierce splendour, ruled the kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
prāhlādau hlādasaṃyukte cerurvyagrā mahītale /
ekadā śakramukhyāste devāḥ samantrya vākpatim //
meaning:
प्राह्लादौ ह्लादसंयुक्ते चेरुर्व्यग्रा महीतले /
एकदा शक्रमुख्यास्ते देवाः समन्त्र्य वाक्पतिम् //
text_mt:
en: While the son of Prahlāda was filled with joy, [the gods] wandered agitated over the earth.
Once, those gods, led by Śakra, took counsel with the Lord of Speech

sanskrit_iast:
procuḥ kiṃ kāryamadhunāsmābhiḥ śatru pratāpitaiḥ /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ devānāṃ gururabravīt //
meaning:
प्रोचुः किं कार्यमधुनास्माभिः शत्रु प्रतापितैः /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां देवानां गुरुरब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
en: and said: 'What should we do now, tormented by the enemy?'
Hearing their words, the guru of the gods said:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurvijñāpanīyo 'dya duḥkhaṃ prāptaiḥ suravrajaiḥ /
tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṃ tasya guroramitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुर्विज्ञापनीयो ऽद्य दुःखं प्राप्तैः सुरव्रजैः /
तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य गुरोरमिततेजसः //
text_mt:
en: 'Viṣṇu must be petitioned today by the hosts of gods who have met with distress.'
Hearing that utterance of their guru of boundless splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
virocanaprāṇahatyai jagmurvaikuṇṭhamantike /
tatra gatvā suraśreṣṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ stavaiḥ //
meaning:
विरोचनप्राणहत्यै जग्मुर्वैकुण्ठमन्तिके /
तत्र गत्वा सुरश्रेष्ठं वैकुण्ठं तुष्टुवुः स्तवैः //
text_mt:
en: they went near Vaikuṇṭha for the slaying of Virocana.
Having gone there, they praised Vaikuṇṭha, the foremost of the gods, with hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
namo devādhidevāya viṣṇave 'mitatejase /
bhaktavighnavināśāya vaikuṇṭhāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
नमो देवाधिदेवाय विष्णवे ऽमिततेजसे /
भक्तविघ्नविनाशाय वैकुण्ठाय नमो नमः //
text_mt:
en: The gods said:
'Homage to the god above all gods, to Viṣṇu of boundless splendour,
to the destroyer of obstacles for his devotees, to Vaikuṇṭha, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
haraye 'dbhutasiṃhāya vāmanāya mahātmane /
kroḍarūpāya matsyāya pralayābdhinivāsine //
meaning:
हरये ऽद्भुतसिंहाय वामनाय महात्मने /
क्रोडरूपाय मत्स्याय प्रलयाब्धिनिवासिने //
text_mt:
en: To Hari, the wondrous lion, to Vāmana the great-souled,
to him in the form of a boar, to the fish, who dwells in the ocean of cosmic dissolution;

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmāya mandaradhṛte bhārgavāyābdhiśāyine /
rāmāyākhilanāthāya viśveśāya ca sākṣiṇe //
meaning:
कूर्माय मन्दरधृते भार्गवायाब्धिशायिने /
रामायाखिलनाथाय विश्वेशाय च साक्षिणे //
text_mt:
en: to the tortoise, supporter of Mount Mandara; to Bhārgava; to him who reclines on the ocean;
to Rāma, the lord of all, the lord of the universe, and the witness;

sanskrit_iast:
dattātreyāya śuddhāya kapilāyārtihāriṇe /
yajñāya dhṛtadharmāya sanakādisvarūpiṇe //
meaning:
दत्तात्रेयाय शुद्धाय कपिलायार्तिहारिणे /
यज्ञाय धृतधर्माय सनकादिस्वरूपिणे //
text_mt:
en: to Dattātreya the pure; to Kapila who takes away distress;
to the sacrifice; to the upholder of dharma; to him whose form is Sanaka and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvasya varadātre ca pṛthave bhūrikarmaṇe /
ṛṣabhāya viśuddhāya hayaśīrṣabhṛtātmane //
meaning:
ध्रुवस्य वरदात्रे च पृथवे भूरिकर्मणे /
ऋषभाय विशुद्धाय हयशीर्षभृतात्मने //
text_mt:
en: to the granter of boons to Dhruva; to Pṛthu of abundant deeds;
to Ṛṣabha the utterly pure; to him whose self bears the horse-head;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsāyāgamarūpāyāmṛtakumbhavidhāriṇe /
kṛṣṇāṃya vāsudevāya saṃkarṣaṇavapurdhṛte //
meaning:
हंसायागमरूपायामृतकुम्भविधारिणे /
कृष्णांय वासुदेवाय संकर्षणवपुर्धृते //
text_mt:
en: to the swan; to him whose form is the scriptures; to the bearer of the nectar-jar;
to Kṛṣṇa, to Vāsudeva, to the bearer of Saṃkarṣaṇa's form;

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnāyāniruddhāya brahmaṇe śaṅkarāya ca /
kumārāya gaṇeśāya nandine bhṛṅgiṇe namaḥ //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नायानिरुद्धाय ब्रह्मणे शङ्कराय च /
कुमाराय गणेशाय नन्दिने भृङ्गिणे नमः //
text_mt:
en: to Pradyumna, to Aniruddha; to Brahman and to Śaṅkara;
to Kumāra, to Gaṇeśa, to Nandin, to Bhṛṅgin, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
gandhamādanavāsāya naranārāyaṇāya ca /
jagannāthāya nāthāya namo rāmeśvarāya ca //
meaning:
गन्धमादनवासाय नरनारायणाय च /
जगन्नाथाय नाथाय नमो रामेश्वराय च //
text_mt:
en: To him who dwells on Gandhamādana; to Nara and Nārāyaṇa;
to Jagannātha, to the protector; homage to Rāmeśvara!

sanskrit_iast:
dvārakāvāsine caiva tulasī vanavāsine /
namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste paṅkajāṅghraye //
meaning:
द्वारकावासिने चैव तुलसी वनवासिने /
नमः कमलनाभाय नमस्ते पङ्कजाङ्घ्रये //
text_mt:
en: To the dweller in Dvārakā; to the dweller in the tulasī forest;
homage to the lotus-naveled one; homage to your lotus-feet!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kamalahastāya kamalākṣāya te namaḥ /
kamalāpratipālāya keśavāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः कमलहस्ताय कमलाक्षाय ते नमः /
कमलाप्रतिपालाय केशवाय नमो नमः //
text_mt:
en: Homage to the lotus-handed one; homage to you, the lotus-eyed one;
to the protector of Kamalā; to Keśava, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhāskararūpāya śaśirūpadharāya ca /
lokapālasvarūpāya prajāpativapurdhṛte //
meaning:
नमो भास्कररूपाय शशिरूपधराय च /
लोकपालस्वरूपाय प्रजापतिवपुर्धृते //
text_mt:
en: Homage to him whose form is the sun, and who bears the form of the moon;
to him whose nature is the world-guardians; to the bearer of the form of Prajāpati;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtagrāmasvarūpāya jīvarūpāya tejase /
jayāya jayine netre niyamāya kriyātmane //
meaning:
भूतग्रामस्वरूपाय जीवरूपाय तेजसे /
जयाय जयिने नेत्रे नियमाय क्रियात्मने //
text_mt:
en: to him whose nature is the multitude of beings; to him in the form of the living soul; to the splendour;
to victory, to the victorious one, to the leader, to restraint, to him whose self is action;

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇāya nirīhāya nītijñāyākriyātmane /
buddhāya kalkirūpāya kṣetrajñāyākṣarāya ca //
meaning:
निर्गुणाय निरीहाय नीतिज्ञायाक्रियात्मने /
बुद्धाय कल्किरूपाय क्षेत्रज्ञायाक्षराय च //
text_mt:
en: to the quality-less, to the desire-less, to the knower of conduct, to him whose self is inaction;
to the Buddha, to him whose form is Kalki, to the knower of the field, and to the imperishable;

sanskrit_iast:
govindāya jagadbhartre 'nantāyādyāya śārṅgiṇe /
śaṅkhine gadine caiva namaścakradharāya ca //
meaning:
गोविन्दाय जगद्भर्त्रे ऽनन्तायाद्याय शार्ङ्गिणे /
शङ्खिने गदिने चैव नमश्चक्रधराय च //
text_mt:
en: to Govinda, the sustainer of the world, to Ananta, the primeval, bearer of the Śārṅga bow;
to the bearer of the conch and the mace, and homage to the bearer of the discus;

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgine śūline caiva sarvaśastrāstraghātine /
śaraṇyāya vareṇyāya parāya paramātmane //
meaning:
खड्गिने शूलिने चैव सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रघातिने /
शरण्याय वरेण्याय पराय परमात्मने //
text_mt:
en: to the bearer of the sword and bearer of the trident; slayer with all weapons and missiles;
to the refuge, to the choice one, to the supreme, to the supreme self;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣīkeśāya viśvāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ /
kālanābhāya kālāya śaśisūryyadṛśe namaḥ /
pūrṇāya parisevyāya parātparatarāya ca //
meaning:
हृषीकेशाय विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय ते नमः /
कालनाभाय कालाय शशिसूर्य्यदृशे नमः /
पूर्णाय परिसेव्याय परात्परतराय च //

sanskrit_iast:
jagatkartre jagadbhartre jagaddhātreṃ'takāya ca /
mohine kṣobhine kāmarūpiṇe 'jāya sūriṇe //
meaning:
जगत्कर्त्रे जगद्भर्त्रे जगद्धात्रेंऽतकाय च /
मोहिने क्षोभिने कामरूपिणे ऽजाय सूरिणे //
text_mt: [The gods prayed:] 'To the maker of the world, sustainer of the world, creator of the world, and ender; / to the deluder, agitator, taker of forms at will, unborn, wise one!

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavaṃstava saṃprāptāḥ śaraṇaṃ daityatāpitāḥ /
tadvidhatsvākhilādhāra yathā hi sukhino vayam //
meaning:
भगवंस्तव संप्राप्ताः शरणं दैत्यतापिताः /
तद्विधत्स्वाखिलाधार यथा हि सुखिनो वयम् //
text_mt: O Blessed One, tormented by the Daitya, we have taken refuge in You. / Therefore, O foundation of all, arrange it so that we, being happy,

sanskrit_iast:
putramitrakalatrādisaṃyutā viharāmahe /
tacchrutvā stavanaṃ teṣāṃ vaikuṇṭhaḥ prītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रादिसंयुता विहरामहे /
तच्छ्रुत्वा स्तवनं तेषां वैकुण्ठः प्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: may sport together with sons, friends, wives, and others.' / Hearing that hymn of praise of theirs, Vaikuṇṭha was pleased in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau darśanaṃ teṣāṃ daityasaṃ saṃtāpitātmanām /
te dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ snigdhamānasam //
meaning:
प्रददौ दर्शनं तेषां दैत्यसं संतापितात्मनाम् /
ते दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं वैकुण्ठं स्निग्धमानसम् //
text_mt: He granted a vision of himself to those whose souls were tormented by the Daitya. / Seeing the Lord of the god of gods, Vaikuṇṭha, tender-minded,

sanskrit_iast:
virocanavadhāyāśu prārthayāmāsurādarāt /
tacchrutvā śakramukhyānāṃ kāryaṃ kāryavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
विरोचनवधायाशु प्रार्थयामासुरादरात् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा शक्रमुख्यानां कार्यं कार्यविदां वरः //
text_mt: they respectfully prayed for the swift slaying of Virocana. / Hearing that purpose of Indra and the others, [Viṣṇu], the best of those who know what to do,

sanskrit_iast:
samāśvāsya surānprītyā visasarja mudānvitān /
gateṣu devavargeṣu sarvopāyavidāṃvaraḥ //
meaning:
समाश्वास्य सुरान्प्रीत्या विससर्ज मुदान्वितान् /
गतेषु देववर्गेषु सर्वोपायविदांवरः //
text_mt: reassured the gods with affection and dismissed them filled with joy. / When the hosts of gods had departed, the best of those who know every expedient,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa virocanagṛhaṃ yayau /
dvijapūjanakāle tu saṃprāptaḥ kāryasādhakaḥ //
meaning:
वृद्धब्राह्मणरूपेण विरोचनगृहं ययौ /
द्विजपूजनकाले तु संप्राप्तः कार्यसाधकः //
text_mt: went in the form of an old brāhmaṇa to the house of Virocana. / At the time for worshipping brāhmaṇas, the accomplisher of the purpose arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā viśālākṣī brāhmaṇaṃ hṛṣṭamānasā /
apūrvaṃ bhaktibhāvena dadau satkṛtya cāsanam //
meaning:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा विशालाक्षी ब्राह्मणं हृष्टमानसा /
अपूर्वं भक्तिभावेन ददौ सत्कृत्य चासनम् //
text_mt: Seeing that brāhmaṇa, the large-eyed [queen], rejoiced in mind, / offered an extraordinary seat with devotion and honoured him.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'naṅgīkṛtya taddattamāsanaṃ prāha tāṃ śubhe /
nāhaṃ samādade devi tvaddattaṃ paramāsanam //
meaning:
सो ऽनङ्गीकृत्य तद्दत्तमासनं प्राह तां शुभे /
नाहं समाददे देवि त्वद्दत्तं परमासनम् //
text_mt: Not accepting that seat offered by her, he said to her, O fair one: / 'O lady, I do not take the supreme seat offered by you.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇu me kāryamatulaṃ yadarthamahamāgataḥ /
yanme manogataṃ kāryaṃ tadvijñāya ca mānini //
meaning:
शृणु मे कार्यमतुलं यदर्थमहमागतः /
यन्मे मनोगतं कार्यं तद्विज्ञाय च मानिनि //
text_mt: Hear my incomparable purpose for the sake of which I have come: / knowing the purpose that is in my mind, O proud lady,

sanskrit_iast:
yoṃ'gīkaroti tatpūjāṃ grahīṣyāmi varānane /
tacchrutvā vṛddhaviprasya vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradā //
meaning:
योंऽगीकरोति तत्पूजां ग्रहीष्यामि वरानने /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वृद्धविप्रस्य वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा //
text_mt: whoever agrees to it, his worship I shall accept, O fair-faced one.' / Hearing those words of the old brāhmaṇa, she, skilled in speech,

sanskrit_iast:
māyayā mohitā viṣṇoḥ strītvāccāhātiharṣitā /
viśālākṣyuvāca
yatte manogataṃ vipra taddāsyāmi gṛhāṇame //
meaning:
मायया मोहिता विष्णोः स्त्रीत्वाच्चाहातिहर्षिता /
विशालाक्ष्युवाच
यत्ते मनोगतं विप्र तद्दास्यामि गृहाणमे //
text_mt: deluded by the illusory power of Viṣṇu and because of her female nature, spoke, exceedingly delighted: / Viśālākṣī said: / 'Whatever is in your mind, O brāhmaṇa, that I shall give; accept from me

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ pādasalilaṃ dehi me vāñchitārthadam /
ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha na pratyemi striyā vacaḥ //
meaning:
आसनं पादसलिलं देहि मे वाञ्छितार्थदम् /
इत्युक्तः स द्विजः प्राह न प्रत्येमि स्त्रिया वचः //
text_mt: the seat and water for the feet, and grant me my desired object.' / Addressed thus, that brāhmaṇa said: 'I do not trust a woman's word.

sanskrit_iast:
tava bhartā yadi vadettadā me pratyayo bhavet /
tadākarṇya dvijenoktaṃ virocanagṛheśvarī //
meaning:
तव भर्ता यदि वदेत्तदा मे प्रत्ययो भवेत् /
तदाकर्ण्य द्विजेनोक्तं विरोचनगृहेश्वरी //
text_mt: If your husband speaks, then I shall have confidence.' / Hearing what was spoken by the brāhmaṇa, the mistress of Virocana's house

sanskrit_iast:
patimākārayāmāsa tatraiva dvijasannidhau /
sa prāpto dūtavākyena prāhlādirhṛṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
पतिमाकारयामास तत्रैव द्विजसन्निधौ /
स प्राप्तो दूतवाक्येन प्राह्लादिर्हृष्टमानसः //
text_mt: summoned her husband right there into the presence of the brāhmaṇa. / Having arrived upon the messenger's word, the son of Prahlāda, cheerful in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥpuraṃ yatra bhāryā viśālākṣī samāsthitā /
tamāgataṃ samālokya patiṃ dharmaparāyaṇā //
meaning:
अन्तःपुरं यत्र भार्या विशालाक्षी समास्थिता /
तमागतं समालोक्य पतिं धर्मपरायणा //
text_mt: [entered] the inner apartments where his wife Viśālākṣī was situated. / Seeing her husband arrived, she, devoted to righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
utthāya natvā viprāgryamāsanaṃ punararpayat /
yadā tu jagṛhe naiva dattamāsanamādarāt //
meaning:
उत्थाय नत्वा विप्राग्र्यमासनं पुनरर्पयत् /
यदा तु जगृहे नैव दत्तमासनमादरात् //
text_mt: stood up, bowed to the eminent brāhmaṇa, and offered the seat again. / But when he did not accept at all the seat offered with respect,

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaṃ kathayāmāsa daityānāṃ patimātmanaḥ /
taddṛttāntamupājñāya daityarāṭ sa virocanaḥ //
meaning:
राजानं कथयामास दैत्यानां पतिमात्मनः /
तद्दृत्तान्तमुपाज्ञाय दैत्यराट् स विरोचनः //
text_mt: she reported to the king, her husband, the lord of the Daityas. / Having understood the circumstance, the king of Daityas, that Virocana,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāsnehena mugdhātmā tattadāṅgīcakāra ha /
aṅgīkṛte tu daityena tadvijñāya ca mānasam //
meaning:
भार्यास्नेहेन मुग्धात्मा तत्तदाङ्गीचकार ह /
अङ्गीकृते तु दैत्येन तद्विज्ञाय च मानसम् //
text_mt: with his soul infatuated by love for his wife, agreed to that. / When it was agreed to by the Daitya, understanding his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca brāhmaṇo hṛṣṭaḥ svamāyurmama kalpaya /
tatastu daṃpatī tatra mugdhau svakṛtayā śucā //
meaning:
उवाच ब्राह्मणो हृष्टः स्वमायुर्मम कल्पय /
ततस्तु दंपती तत्र मुग्धौ स्वकृतया शुचा //
text_mt: the brāhmaṇa, pleased, said: 'Bestow your own life upon me!' / Thereupon the husband and wife were bewildered there by their own grief.

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtaṃ dhyānamāsthāya karau baddhocaturdvijam /
gṛhāṇa jīvitaṃ vipra dehi pādodakaṃ mama //
meaning:
मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थाय करौ बद्धोचतुर्द्विजम् /
गृहाण जीवितं विप्र देहि पादोदकं मम //
text_mt: Remaining in contemplation for a moment, they folded their hands and said to the brāhmaṇa: / 'Take [my] life, O brāhmaṇa, and give me the water that has washed your feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayoktaṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ kurvaḥ prītimavāpnuhi /
tatastu vipraḥ protātmā tadaṅgīkṛtya cāsanam //
meaning:
त्वयोक्तं वचनं सत्यं कुर्वः प्रीतिमवाप्नुहि /
ततस्तु विप्रः प्रोतात्मा तदङ्गीकृत्य चासनम् //
text_mt: We make true the word spoken by you; may you attain delight.' / Thereupon the brāhmaṇa, delighted in soul, accepting that seat,

sanskrit_iast:
pādodakaṃ dadau tasyai bhaktyā prīto janārdanaḥ /
prakṣālya pādau viprasya viśālākṣī mudānvitā //
meaning:
पादोदकं ददौ तस्यै भक्त्या प्रीतो जनार्दनः /
प्रक्षाल्य पादौ विप्रस्य विशालाक्षी मुदान्विता //
text_mt: gave her the foot-water, Janārdana pleased with her devotion. / Having washed the feet of the brāhmaṇa, Viśālākṣī, full of joy,

sanskrit_iast:
patyā saha dadhau mūrdhni apaḥ pādāvanejanīḥ /
tatastu sahasā subhru daṃpatī divyarūpiṇau //
meaning:
पत्या सह दधौ मूर्ध्नि अपः पादावनेजनीः /
ततस्तु सहसा सुभ्रु दंपती दिव्यरूपिणौ //
text_mt: placed the foot-washing water on her head along with her husband. / Thereupon immediately, O fair-browed one, the husband and wife, having celestial forms,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānavaramāruhya jagmaturvaiṣṇavaṃ padam /
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān devaśalyaṃ vimocya saḥ //
meaning:
विमानवरमारुह्य जग्मतुर्वैष्णवं पदम् /
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् देवशल्यं विमोच्य सः //
text_mt: mounted an excellent aerial chariot and went to the realm of Viṣṇu. / Then the gracious Lord, having removed the thorn of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ stutaḥ /
evaṃ mayāpi dātavyaṃ tava devi pratiśrutam //
meaning:
ययौ वैकुण्ठभवनं सर्वैर्देवगणैः स्तुतः /
एवं मयापि दातव्यं तव देवि प्रतिश्रुतम् //
text_mt: He went to the abode of Vaikuṇṭha, praised by all the hosts of gods. / So too must what was promised to you be given by me, O queen.

sanskrit_iast:
na satyāccālaye devi patiṃ rukmāṅgadābhidham /
sattayameva manuṣyāṇāṃ gatidaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
न सत्याच्चालये देवि पतिं रुक्माङ्गदाभिधम् /
सत्तयमेव मनुष्याणां गतिदं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: I shall not sway my husband named Rukmāṅgada from the truth, O queen; / truth alone is proclaimed to bestow the highest destiny upon mortals.

sanskrit_iast: satyācccutaṃ manuṣyaṃ hi śvapākādadhamaṃ viduḥ //
meaning: सत्याच्च्चुतं मनुष्यं हि श्वपाकादधमं विदुः //
text_mt: For a man fallen from truth is considered lower than an outcaste dog-eater.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā kanakāvadātā sā mohinīṃ paṅkajajanmajātām /
jagrāha bhartuścaraṇau sutāmnau raktāṅgulī pāṇiyugena subhrūḥ //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite saṃdhyāvalīkathanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा कनकावदाता सा मोहिनीं पङ्कजजन्मजाताम् /
जग्राह भर्तुश्चरणौ सुताम्नौ रक्ताङ्गुली पाणियुगेन सुभ्रूः //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते संध्यावलीकथनं नाम द्वात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to Mohinī, who was born of the lotus-born [Brahmā], the fair-browed woman, radiant as gold, / seized with both hands her husband's feet, which had coppery, red-toed soles.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, entitled 'The Speech of Saṃdhyāvalī in the Story of Mohinī', in the latter part of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃdhyāvalī tataḥ pādau bhartuḥ saṃgṛhya bhūpate /
uvāca vacanaṃ devī dharmāṃ gadavināśanam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
संध्यावली ततः पादौ भर्तुः संगृह्य भूपते /
उवाच वचनं देवी धर्मां गदविनाशनम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then, holding the feet of her husband, the king, / Queen Saṃdhyāvalī spoke words that would destroy Dharmāṅgada:

sanskrit_iast:
bahudhāpyanuśiṣṭeyaṃ mayā bhūpa yathā tvayā /
mohinyā moharūpāyā nānyatsaṃrocate 'dhunā //
meaning:
बहुधाप्यनुशिष्टेयं मया भूप यथा त्वया /
मोहिन्या मोहरूपाया नान्यत्संरोचते ऽधुना //
text_mt: “O king, though she was instructed in many ways by me, just as by you, / nothing else now appeals to Mohinī, who is delusion incarnate.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇorvadhaṃ vā tanayasya vai /
dharmatyāgādvaraṃ nātha putrasya vinipātanam //
meaning:
भोजनं वासरे विष्णोर्वधं वा तनयस्य वै /
धर्मत्यागाद्वरं नाथ पुत्रस्य विनिपातनम् //
text_mt: Either eating on the day of Viṣṇu, or the killing of your son— / O lord, the destruction of a son is better than the abandonment of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśī hi jananyāstu pīḍā bhavati bhūpate /
putrasyotpādane tīvrātādṛśī na bhavetpituḥ //
meaning:
यादृशी हि जनन्यास्तु पीडा भवति भूपते /
पुत्रस्योत्पादने तीव्रातादृशी न भवेत्पितुः //
text_mt: For such intense pain as a mother suffers, O king, / in bringing forth a son does not belong to a father.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhasaṃdhāraṇe rājan khedaḥ sneho 'dhiko yathā /
māturbhavati bhūpāla tathā nahi bhavetpituḥ //
meaning:
गर्भसंधारणे राजन् खेदः स्नेहो ऽधिको यथा /
मातुर्भवति भूपाल तथा नहि भवेत्पितुः //
text_mt: The suffering and the greater affection in bearing the embryo, O king, / which belongs to a mother, O protector of the earth, does not belong to a father.

sanskrit_iast:
bījanirvāṣakaḥ proktaḥ pitā rājendra bhūtale /
jananī dhāriṇī kliṣṭā varddhane pālane 'dhikā //
meaning:
बीजनिर्वाषकः प्रोक्तः पिता राजेन्द्र भूतले /
जननी धारिणी क्लिष्टा वर्द्धने पालने ऽधिका //
text_mt: The father is said on earth to be the sower of the seed, O best of kings; / the mother is the bearer, who suffers, and is foremost in rearing and nurturing.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ śataguṇaḥ sneho mātuḥ putre pravartate /
snehādhikyaṃ tu saṃprekṣya mātaraṃ mahatīṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
पितुः शतगुणः स्नेहो मातुः पुत्रे प्रवर्तते /
स्नेहाधिक्यं तु संप्रेक्ष्य मातरं महतीं विदुः //
text_mt: A mother’s affection toward a son is a hundred times that of a father; / considering this excess of affection, they know the mother to be superior.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaṃ jātā gatasnehā paralokajigīṣayā /
putrasya nṛpaśārdūla satyavākyasya pālanāt //
meaning:
साहं जाता गतस्नेहा परलोकजिगीषया /
पुत्रस्य नृपशार्दूल सत्यवाक्यस्य पालनात् //
text_mt: That very I have become devoid of affection for my son, O tiger among kings, / through the desire to conquer the other world and by upholding your truthful word.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpādaya sutaṃ bhūpa snehaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ /
mā satyalaṅghanaṃ kārṣīḥ śāpito 'si mayātmanā //
meaning:
व्यापादय सुतं भूप स्नेहं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः /
मा सत्यलङ्घनं कार्षीः शापितो ऽसि मयात्मना //
text_mt: Slay the son, O king, casting affection far away! / Do not transgress the truth; you are adjured by me and by your own self!

sanskrit_iast:
nikaṣeṣu hyaṣīkeśo bhaviṣyati phalapradaḥ /
yasmiṃścīrṇe rujā dehe nālpāpi nṛpa jāyate //
meaning:
निकषेषु ह्यषीकेशो भविष्यति फलप्रदः /
यस्मिंश्चीर्णे रुजा देहे नाल्पापि नृप जायते //
text_mt: For Hṛṣīkeśa will grant the fruit upon the touchstone, / which when observed, not even the slightest affliction arises in the body, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmānmānavo 'vaśyaṃ svargabhraṣṭo na saṃśayaḥ /
prāṇānādāya putraṃ vā sarvasvaṃ vā mahīpate //
meaning:
अधर्मान्मानवो ऽवश्यं स्वर्गभ्रष्टो न संशयः /
प्राणानादाय पुत्रं वा सर्वस्वं वा महीपते //
text_mt: Through unrighteousness a mortal falls from heaven without doubt, / whether one gives up life, a son, or all one's possessions, O protector of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścānuvartate daivaṃ sa pumān gīyate mahān /
tā āpado 'pi bhūpāla dhanyā yāḥ satyakārikāḥ //
meaning:
यश्चानुवर्तते दैवं स पुमान् गीयते महान् /
ता आपदो ऽपि भूपाल धन्या याः सत्यकारिकाः //
text_mt: He who conforms to the divine will is sung of as a great man; / even those misfortunes are blessed, O king, which produce truth.

sanskrit_iast:
sattayasaṃrakṣaṇārthatvānnṛṇāṃ syurmokṣadāyikāḥ /
kīrtisaṃstaraṇārthāya karttavyaṃ manujaiḥ sadā //
meaning:
सत्तयसंरक्षणार्थत्वान्नृणां स्युर्मोक्षदायिकाः /
कीर्तिसंस्तरणार्थाय कर्त्तव्यं मनुजैः सदा //
text_mt: Because they preserve the truth, they bestow liberation upon mortals; / men should always perform deeds enjoined by the treatises,

sanskrit_iast:
karma bhūpāla śāstroktaṃ snehadveṣavivarjitam /
tadalaṃ paritāpena satyaṃ pālaya bhūpate //
meaning:
कर्म भूपाल शास्त्रोक्तं स्नेहद्वेषविवर्जितम् /
तदलं परितापेन सत्यं पालय भूपते //
text_mt: free from affection and hatred, O king, in order to spread their fame. / Therefore, enough with lamentation; protect the truth, O lord of the earth!

sanskrit_iast:
satyasya pālanādrājanviṣṇudehena yujyate /
devairutpāditā hyeṣā nikaṣā te vimohinī //
meaning:
सत्यस्य पालनाद्राजन्विष्णुदेहेन युज्यते /
देवैरुत्पादिता ह्येषा निकषा ते विमोहिनी //
text_mt: By protecting truth, O king, one becomes united with the body of Viṣṇu; / this deluding woman has indeed been created by the gods as a touchstone for you.

sanskrit_iast:
manye bhūpāla sā patnyā kṛtā tāṃ tvaṃ na budhyase /
putravya pādanāddevā bhaviṣyanti hyavāṅmukhāḥ //
meaning:
मन्ये भूपाल सा पत्न्या कृता तां त्वं न बुध्यसे /
पुत्रव्य पादनाद्देवा भविष्यन्ति ह्यवाङ्मुखाः //
text_mt: I think, O king, she was sent by [a rival] queen, but you do not realize it; / yet by slaying the son, the gods will have their faces cast downward.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ datvā padaṃ mūrdhni yāsyase paramaṃ padam /
viṣṇorudvahatāṃ bhaktiṃ devatāḥ paripanthinaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां दत्वा पदं मूर्ध्नि यास्यसे परमं पदम् /
विष्णोरुद्वहतां भक्तिं देवताः परिपन्थिनः //
text_mt: Placing your foot upon their heads, you will go to the supreme abode; / the gods are adversaries to those who bear devotion to Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyatyandhatā loke tadeva prakaṭīkṛtam /
viruddhā vibudhā bhūpa seśvarāstava ceṣṭitaiḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यत्यन्धता लोके तदेव प्रकटीकृतम् /
विरुद्धा विबुधा भूप सेश्वरास्तव चेष्टितैः //
text_mt: Blindness will occur in the world; that very thing has been manifested. / The gods together with their lords, O king, are opposed to your deeds.'

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣamārgaprabhettārastava niścayā lopakāḥ /
sa tvaṃ bhūpa dṛḍho bhūtvā ghātayasva sutaṃ priyam //
meaning:
मोक्षमार्गप्रभेत्तारस्तव निश्चया लोपकाः /
स त्वं भूप दृढो भूत्वा घातयस्व सुतं प्रियम् //
text_mt: breakers of the path of liberation, and destroyers of your resolve; / being firm, O king, have your dear son slain!

sanskrit_iast: mohinyāḥ kuru vākyaṃ tu ātmanaḥ satyapālanāt //
meaning: मोहिन्याः कुरु वाक्यं तु आत्मनः सत्यपालनात् //
text_mt: Carry out Mohinī's demand in order to keep your own truth!

sanskrit_iast:
lupte 'pi vākye bhavitā nṛpeśa pāpaṃ samaṃ brahmavadhena ghoram /
tantāsi loke śamanasya bhūpa yaśaḥpraṇo bhavitā dharāyām //
meaning:
लुप्ते ऽपि वाक्ये भविता नृपेश पापं समं ब्रह्मवधेन घोरम् /
तन्तासि लोके शमनस्य भूप यशःप्रणो भविता धरायाम् //
text_mt: If your promise is broken, O lord of kings, a sin terrible as the murder of a brahmin will accrue; / you will suffer in the realm of Yama, O king, and your fame on earth will be destroyed.”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā rukmāṅgadastadā /
saṃdhyāvalīmuvācedaṃ mohinyāḥ sannidhau nṛpa //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा रुक्माङ्गदस्तदा /
संध्यावलीमुवाचेदं मोहिन्याः सन्निधौ नृप //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing the words of his wife, King Rukmāṅgada then / spoke this to Saṃdhyāvalī in the presence of Mohinī, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
putrahatyā mahāhatyā brahmahatyādhikā priye /
ghātayitvā sutaṃ loke kā gatirmme bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
पुत्रहत्या महाहत्या ब्रह्महत्याधिका प्रिये /
घातयित्वा सुतं लोके का गतिर्म्मे भविष्यति //
text_mt: “The killing of a son is a great killing, greater even than killing a brahmin, O dear one; / having caused my son to be slain, what destiny will be mine in the world?

sanskrit_iast:
kva gato mandaraṃ śailaṃ kva prāptā mohinī mayā /
dharmāṅgadavināśāya devi kālapriyā tviyam //
meaning:
क्व गतो मन्दरं शैलं क्व प्राप्ता मोहिनी मया /
धर्माङ्गदविनाशाय देवि कालप्रिया त्वियम् //
text_mt: Where was Mount Mandara to which I went, and where was Mohinī whom I found? / O queen, she is indeed the beloved of Death, meant for the destruction of Dharmāṅgada!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmajñaṃ vinayopetaṃ prajārañjanakārakam /
aprajaṃ ca sutaṃ hatvā kā gatirme bhaviṣyāti //
meaning:
धर्मज्ञं विनयोपेतं प्रजारञ्जनकारकम् /
अप्रजं च सुतं हत्वा का गतिर्मे भविष्याति //
text_mt: Having slain my childless son, who knows dharma, is endowed with modesty, / and brings delight to the subjects, what will become of me?

sanskrit_iast: kuputrasyāpi hananāddevi duḥkhaṃ bhavetpituḥ //
meaning: कुपुत्रस्यापि हननाद्देवि दुःखं भवेत्पितुः //
text_mt: Even from the killing of a bad son, O queen, sorrow would befall a father;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punarddharmaśīlasya gurusevāvidhāyinaḥ /
jambūdvīpamidaṃ bhuktaṃ mayā tu varavarṇini //
meaning:
किं पुनर्द्धर्मशीलस्य गुरुसेवाविधायिनः /
जम्बूद्वीपमिदं भुक्तं मया तु वरवर्णिनि //
text_mt: how much more for one of righteous conduct who renders service to elders? / This Jambūdvīpa was enjoyed by me, O fair-complexioned one,

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpāni sapta bhuktāni tanayena tavādhunā /
viṣṇoraṃśo varārohe piturapyadhiko bhavet //
meaning:
द्वीपानि सप्त भुक्तानि तनयेन तवाधुना /
विष्णोरंशो वरारोहे पितुरप्यधिको भवेत् //
text_mt: while the seven continents have now been enjoyed by your son; / an incarnation of Viṣṇu, O beautiful woman, is superior even to his father.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇeṣu varārohe kavibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
yo 'yamatyadhikaḥ putro dharmāṅgada iti kṣitau //
meaning:
पुराणेषु वरारोहे कविभिः परिकीर्तितः /
यो ऽयमत्यधिकः पुत्रो धर्माङ्गद इति क्षितौ //
text_mt: It is proclaimed by poets in the Purāṇas, O lovely-limbed woman: / this son who is superior, Dharmāṅgada on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
mama vaṃśasya cārvaṅgi kiṃ punarmama mānadaḥ /
aho duḥkhamanuprāptaṃ putrādapyadhikaṃ mayā //
meaning:
मम वंशस्य चार्वङ्गि किं पुनर्मम मानदः /
अहो दुःखमनुप्राप्तं पुत्रादप्यधिकं मया //
text_mt: and who confers honor upon my lineage, O lovely-limbed one—how much more on me? / Alas, I have encountered a grief far exceeding that for a son!

sanskrit_iast:
punareva varārohe brūhi tvaṃ vacanaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
mohinīṃ mohasaṃprāptāṃ mama duḥkhapradāyinīm //
meaning:
पुनरेव वरारोहे ब्रूहि त्वं वचनैः शुभैः /
मोहिनीं मोहसंप्राप्तां मम दुःखप्रदायिनीम् //
text_mt: Once more, O beautiful woman, speak with auspicious words / to Mohinī, who is possessed by delusion and is causing me sorrow.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā tu nṛpatiḥ priyāṃ sandhyāvalīṃ tadā /
samīpamāgatya nṛpo mohinīkṣidamabravīt //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा तु नृपतिः प्रियां सन्ध्यावलीं तदा /
समीपमागत्य नृपो मोहिनीक्षिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having thus spoken to his beloved Saṃdhyāvalī then, / the king approached Mohinī and spoke this to her:

sanskrit_iast:
na bhokṣye vāsare viṣṇorna hiṃsye tanayaṃ śubhe /
ātmānaṃ dārayiṣyāmi devīṃ sandhyāvalīṃ tathā //
meaning:
न भोक्ष्ये वासरे विष्णोर्न हिंस्ये तनयं शुभे /
आत्मानं दारयिष्यामि देवीं सन्ध्यावलीं तथा //
text_mt: “I shall not eat on the day of Viṣṇu, nor shall I harm my son, O auspicious one; / I shall cut myself to pieces, and likewise Queen Saṃdhyāvalī,

sanskrit_iast:
anyadvā dāruṇaṃ karma karomi tava śāsanāt /
duṣṭāgrahamimaṃ subhru parityaja sutaṃ prati //
meaning:
अन्यद्वा दारुणं कर्म करोमि तव शासनात् /
दुष्टाग्रहमिमं सुभ्रु परित्यज सुतं प्रति //
text_mt: or I will perform some other dreadful deed at your command; / abandon this wicked stubbornness against my son, O fair-browed one!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ phalaṃ bhavitā tubhyaṃ hatvā dharmāṅgadaṃ sutam /
bhojayitvā dine viṣṇoḥ ko lābho bhavitā vada //
meaning:
किं फलं भविता तुभ्यं हत्वा धर्माङ्गदं सुतम् /
भोजयित्वा दिने विष्णोः को लाभो भविता वद //
text_mt: What fruit will there be for you in slaying my son Dharmāṅgada? / Tell me, what gain will there be in making me eat on the day of Viṣṇu?

sanskrit_iast:
dāso 'smi tava bhṛtyo 'smi vaśago 'smi varānane /
anyaṃ yācasva subhage varaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
दासो ऽस्मि तव भृत्यो ऽस्मि वशगो ऽस्मि वरानने /
अन्यं याचस्व सुभगे वरं त्वां शरणं गतः //
text_mt: I am your slave, I am your servant, I am under your power, O fair-faced woman; / ask another boon, O fortunate one, I have taken refuge in you!

sanskrit_iast:
raktāśokasamānābhyāṃ tava cārvaṅgisarvaśaḥ /
anyatprayojanaṃ kiñcitkarttāsmi vaśagastava //
meaning:
रक्ताशोकसमानाभ्यां तव चार्वङ्गिसर्वशः /
अन्यत्प्रयोजनं किञ्चित्कर्त्तास्मि वशगस्तव //
text_mt: By [your feet] resembling red aśoka flowers, O lovely-limbed one, in every way / I shall fulfill any other purpose for you, being subservient to you.

sanskrit_iast:
prasādaṃ kuru me devi putrabhikṣāṃ prayaccha me /
durlabho guṇavānputro durlabho harivāsaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रसादं कुरु मे देवि पुत्रभिक्षां प्रयच्छ मे /
दुर्लभो गुणवान्पुत्रो दुर्लभो हरिवासरः //
text_mt: Grant me favor, O queen! Grant me the alms of my son! / Rare is a virtuous son; rare is the day of Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaḥ jāhnavītoyaṃ durlabhā jananī kṣitau /
durlabhaṃ hi kule janma durlabhā vaṃśajā priyā //
meaning:
दुर्लभः जाह्नवीतोयं दुर्लभा जननी क्षितौ /
दुर्लभं हि कुले जन्म दुर्लभा वंशजा प्रिया //
text_mt: rare is the water of the Gaṅgā; rare is a mother on earth; / rare is birth in a noble family; rare is a wife born of good lineage;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ kāñcanaṃ dānaṃ durlabhaṃ haripūjanam /
durlabhā vaiṣṇavī dīkṣā durlabhaḥ smṛtisaṃgrahaḥ //
meaning:
दुर्लभं काञ्चनं दानं दुर्लभं हरिपूजनम् /
दुर्लभा वैष्णवी दीक्षा दुर्लभः स्मृतिसंग्रहः //
text_mt: rare is the gift of gold; rare is the worship of Hari; / rare is Vaiṣṇava initiation; rare is the comprehension of sacred tradition;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaḥ śaukare vāso durlabhaṃ haricintanam /
durlabho jāgaro viṣṇordurlabhā hyātmasatkriyā //
meaning:
दुर्लभः शौकरे वासो दुर्लभं हरिचिन्तनम् /
दुर्लभो जागरो विष्णोर्दुर्लभा ह्यात्मसत्क्रिया //
text_mt: rare is dwelling in Śūkara; rare is meditation on Hari; / rare is keeping vigil for Viṣṇu; rare indeed is honoring oneself;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhā putrasaṃprāptirdurlabhaṃ pauṣkaraṃ jalam /
durlabhaḥ śiṣṭasaṃsargo durlabhā bhaktirucyate //
meaning:
दुर्लभा पुत्रसंप्राप्तिर्दुर्लभं पौष्करं जलम् /
दुर्लभः शिष्टसंसर्गो दुर्लभा भक्तिरुच्यते //
text_mt: rare is the attainment of a son; rare is the water of Puṣkara; / rare is association with the virtuous; rare, it is said, is devotion;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ kapilādānaṃ durlabhaṃ nīlamokṣaṇam /
kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ durlabhaṃ varavarṇini //
meaning:
दुर्लभं कपिलादानं दुर्लभं नीलमोक्षणम् /
कृतं श्राद्धं त्रयोदश्यां दुर्लभं वरवर्णिनि //
text_mt: rare is the gift of a brown cow; rare is the release of a blue bull; / rare, O fair-complexioned one, is a śrāddha performed on the thirteenth lunar day;

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhā vasudhā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ pātakanāśanam /
dhenustilamayī subhru durlabhā vipragāminī //
meaning:
दुर्लभा वसुधा चीर्णं व्रतं पातकनाशनम् /
धेनुस्तिलमयी सुभ्रु दुर्लभा विप्रगामिनी //
text_mt: rare is the gift of land, an observed vow that destroys sins, / and a cow made of sesame seeds gifted to a brahmin, O fair-browed woman!”

sanskrit_iast:
dhātrīsnānaṃ varārohe durlabho harivāsaraḥ /
durlabhaṃ parvakāle tu snānaṃ śītalavāriṇā //
meaning:
धात्रीस्नानं वरारोहे दुर्लभो हरिवासरः /
दुर्लभं पर्वकाले तु स्नानं शीतलवारिणा //
text_mt: Bathing [with the fruit of] the dhātrī, O fair-hipped woman, and the day of Hari are hard to obtain; / and hard to obtain is bathing with cool water at the time of a festival.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse viśeṣeṇa pratyūṣasamaye śubhe /
yathāśāstroditaṃ karma taddevi bhuvi durlabham //
meaning:
माघमासे विशेषेण प्रत्यूषसमये शुभे /
यथाशास्त्रोदितं कर्म तद्देवि भुवि दुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Especially in the month of Māgha, at the auspicious hour of dawn, / an action performed according to the scriptures, O goddess, is hard to find in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ kuśalaṃ pathyaṃ durlabhaṃ cauṣadhaṃ tathā /
vyādhervighātakaraṇaṃ durlabhaṃ śāstramārgataḥ //
meaning:
दुर्लभं कुशलं पथ्यं दुर्लभं चौषधं तथा /
व्याधेर्विघातकरणं दुर्लभं शास्त्रमार्गतः //
text_mt: Wholesome well-being is hard to find, and likewise medicine is hard to find; / and warding off an illness according to scriptural injunctions is hard to find.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhaṃ smaraṇaṃ viṣṇormaraṇe varavarṇini /
evaṃ vaco varārohe kuru me dharmarakṣakam //
meaning:
दुर्लभं स्मरणं विष्णोर्मरणे वरवर्णिनि /
एवं वचो वरारोहे कुरु मे धर्मरक्षकम् //
text_mt: Remembering Viṣṇu at death, O woman of excellent complexion, is hard to obtain. / Therefore, O fair-hipped woman, speak words that protect my dharma!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vadhenevai cārvaṅgi prasādaṃ kartumarhasi /
sevitā viṣayāḥ samyakkṛtaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam //
meaning:
किं वधेनेवै चार्वङ्गि प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि /
सेविता विषयाः सम्यक्कृतं राज्यमकण्टकम् //
text_mt: Why [insist on] slaying? O fair-limbed woman, you ought to show mercy! / Pleasures have been properly enjoyed by me; the kingdom was made free of thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā mūrghni padaṃ dattaṃ devagoviprarakṣiṇām /
adṛṣṭaviṣayaṃ putraṃ nāhaṃ hiṃsye kadācana //
meaning:
मया मूर्घ्नि पदं दत्तं देवगोविप्ररक्षिणाम् /
अदृष्टविषयं पुत्रं नाहं हिंस्ये कदाचन //
text_mt: I placed my foot upon the heads of those who harm gods, cows, and brāhmaṇas; / I shall never kill my son, who has not even seen worldly pleasures.

sanskrit_iast:
svahasteneha cārvaṅgi kiṃ nu pāpamataḥ param /
mohinyuvāca
dharmāṅgado na me śatrurnāhaṃ hanmi sutaṃ tava //
meaning:
स्वहस्तेनेह चार्वङ्गि किं नु पापमतः परम् /
मोहिन्युवाच
धर्माङ्गदो न मे शत्रुर्नाहं हन्मि सुतं तव //
text_mt: What sin in this world could be greater than doing this with my own hand, O fair-limbed woman?” / Mohinī said: / “Dharmāṅgada is not my enemy, nor do I slay your son.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ bhuṅkṣvatvaṃ harivāsare /
vasudhāṃ svecchayā rājaṃstvaṃ śādhi bahuvatsaram //
meaning:
पूर्वमेव मया प्रोक्तं भुङ्क्ष्वत्वं हरिवासरे /
वसुधां स्वेच्छया राजंस्त्वं शाधि बहुवत्सरम् //
text_mt: I said to you even before: eat on the day of Hari, / and rule the earth according to your desire, O king, for many years!

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ vyāpādaye putramarthasiddhistu bhojane /
mama bhūmipate kāryaṃ na putranidhane tava //
meaning:
नाहं व्यापादये पुत्रमर्थसिद्धिस्तु भोजने /
मम भूमिपते कार्यं न पुत्रनिधने तव //
text_mt: I do not wish to kill the son, but my purpose is accomplished through [your] eating. / O lord of the earth, I have no business with the death of your son.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi putraḥ priyo rājanbhujyatāṃ harivāsare /
kiṃ vilāpairmahīpāla etairddharmabahiṣkṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
यदि पुत्रः प्रियो राजन्भुज्यतां हरिवासरे /
किं विलापैर्महीपाल एतैर्द्धर्मबहिष्कृतैः //
text_mt: If the son is dear to you, O king, then eat on the day of Hari! / What is the use of these lamentations, O protector of the earth, which are excluded from dharma?

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ saṃrakṣa yatnena kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama /
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ rājanmohinīṃ tanumadhyamām //
meaning:
सत्यं संरक्ष यत्नेन कुरुष्व वचनं मम /
एवं ब्रुवाणां तां राजन्मोहिनीं तनुमध्यमाम् //
text_mt: Protect the truth with effort and do my bidding!” / To that slender-waisted Mohinī who was speaking thus, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāṅgadaḥ pratyuvāca dṛṣṭvā natvāgrataḥ sthitaḥ /
etadeva gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mā śaṅkāṃ kuru bhāmini //
meaning:
धर्माङ्गदः प्रत्युवाच दृष्ट्वा नत्वाग्रतः स्थितः /
एतदेव गृहाण त्वं मा शङ्कां कुरु भामिनि //
text_mt: Dharmāṅgada replied, having seen [her] and bowed as he stood before [her]: / “Take this very thing; do not hesitate, O spirited lady!”

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā nirmalaṃ khaṅgaṃ vinyasya nṛpateḥ puraḥ /
ātmānaṃ ca pratyuvāca satyadharmavyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा निर्मलं खङ्गं विन्यस्य नृपतेः पुरः /
आत्मानं च प्रत्युवाच सत्यधर्मव्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: Taking the stainless sword and placing it before the king, / firmly established in the truth and in dharma, he addressed him on his own behalf:

sanskrit_iast:
na vilaṃbaḥ pitaḥ kāryastvayā mama nipātane /
manmāturvacanaṃ satyaṃ kuru bhūpa pratiśrutam //
meaning:
न विलंबः पितः कार्यस्त्वया मम निपातने /
मन्मातुर्वचनं सत्यं कुरु भूप प्रतिश्रुतम् //
text_mt: “O father, you must make no delay in striking me down! / Fulfill the promise made to my mother, O king, and make it true!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā rakṣyo dhanairdārairathavāpi nijātmajaiḥ /
apatyaṃ dharmakāmārthaṃ śreyaskāmasya bhūpateḥ //
meaning:
आत्मा रक्ष्यो धनैर्दारैरथवापि निजात्मजैः /
अपत्यं धर्मकामार्थं श्रेयस्कामस्य भूपतेः //
text_mt: The self is to be protected by means of wealth, wives, or even one's own sons; / an offspring is for dharma and desire, for a king who desires his own highest good.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadarthe maraṇaṃ mahyamakṣayya gatidāyakam /
tavāpi nirmanā lokāḥ svavākyaparipālanāt //
meaning:
त्वदर्थे मरणं मह्यमक्षय्य गतिदायकम् /
तवापि निर्मना लोकाः स्ववाक्यपरिपालनात् //
text_mt: Dying for your sake will bestow imperishable realms upon me, / and your worlds [hereafter] will be free of sorrow, due to keeping your word.

sanskrit_iast:
parityajya paraṃ duḥkhaṃ putravyāpādanodbhavam /
dehatyāge mamāraṃbho naradehe bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
परित्यज्य परं दुःखं पुत्रव्यापादनोद्भवम् /
देहत्यागे ममारंभो नरदेहे भविष्यति //
text_mt: Cast aside the supreme sorrow arising from the slaughter of a son! / My undertaking of casting off the body will take place in a human body,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāmayavinirmukte śatakratusame vibho /
piturarthe hatā ye tu māturarthe hatāstathā //
meaning:
सर्वामयविनिर्मुक्ते शतक्रतुसमे विभो /
पितुरर्थे हता ये तु मातुरर्थे हतास्तथा //
text_mt: freed from all afflictions, equal to [that of] Śatakratu, O lord! / Those who are slain for the sake of their father, and likewise those slain for the sake of their mother,

sanskrit_iast:
gavārthe brāhyaṇārthe vā pramadārthe mahīpate /
bhūmyarthe pārthivārthe vā devatārthe tathaiva ca //
meaning:
गवार्थे ब्राह्यणार्थे वा प्रमदार्थे महीपते /
भूम्यर्थे पार्थिवार्थे वा देवतार्थे तथैव च //
text_mt: or for the sake of a cow, or for the sake of a brāhmaṇa, or for the sake of a woman, O lord of the earth, / or for the sake of the land, or for the sake of a king, or likewise for the sake of a deity,

sanskrit_iast:
bālārthe vikalārthe ca yānti lokānsubhāsvarān /
tadalaṃ paritāpena jahi māṃ tvaṃ varāsinā //
meaning:
बालार्थे विकलार्थे च यान्ति लोकान्सुभास्वरान् /
तदलं परितापेन जहि मां त्वं वरासिना //
text_mt: or for the sake of a child, or for the sake of a cripple, go to splendid, radiant worlds. / Therefore enough of grieving! Slay me with your excellent sword!

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ pālaya rājendra mā bhuṅkṣva harivāsare /
dharmārthe tanayaṃ hanyādbhāryāṃ vāpi mahīpate //
meaning:
सत्यं पालय राजेन्द्र मा भुङ्क्ष्व हरिवासरे /
धर्मार्थे तनयं हन्याद्भार्यां वापि महीपते //
text_mt: Protect the truth, O king of kings! Do not eat on the day of Hari! / For the sake of dharma, one may kill a son or even a wife, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate vedavākyeṣu putraṃ hanyānmakhasthitaḥ /
aśvameghe makhavare na doṣo jāyate nṛpa //
meaning:
