श्रूयते वेदवाक्येषु पुत्रं हन्यान्मखस्थितः /
अश्वमेघे मखवरे न दोषो जायते नृप //
text_mt: It is heard in the words of the Veda that one engaged in a sacrifice may kill a son; / in the Aśvamedha, the best of sacrifices, no guilt is incurred, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbravīti mahīpāla mohinī jananī mama /
tattvayā hyavicāreṇa karttavyaṃ vacanaṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
यद्ब्रवीति महीपाल मोहिनी जननी मम /
तत्त्वया ह्यविचारेण कर्त्तव्यं वचनं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Whatever my mother Mohinī says, O protector of the earth, / you must certainly carry out her word without hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda rājendra kuruṣva vākyaṃ mayeritaṃ cātmavadhāya satyam /
vimocayethā nṛpate sughorādvākyānṛtānmohinihastayogāt //
meaning:
प्रसीद राजेन्द्र कुरुष्व वाक्यं मयेरितं चात्मवधाय सत्यम् /
विमोचयेथा नृपते सुघोराद्वाक्यानृतान्मोहिनिहस्तयोगात् //
text_mt: Be pleased, O king of kings! Carry out my word spoken in truth for my own slaying; / O king, free yourself from terrible untruth through the stroke of Mohinī's hand!

sanskrit_iast:
vadhena te bhūmipate sutasya yaśaḥ prakāśaṃ gamayiṣyate ca /
yaśaḥ pkāśādbhavitā hi kīrtistathākṣayā tāta na saṃśayo 'tra //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite dharmāṅgadoktirnāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
वधेन ते भूमिपते सुतस्य यशः प्रकाशं गमयिष्यते च /
यशः प्काशाद्भविता हि कीर्तिस्तथाक्षया तात न संशयो ऽत्र //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते धर्माङ्गदोक्तिर्नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
O protector of the earth, by the slaying of your son, your fame will be brought to light; / and through the shining of your fame, O father, your renown will become imperishable; there is no doubt of this."

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, named 'The Speech of Dharmāṅgada' in the story of Mohinī, in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā rājā rukmāṅgadastadā /
saṃdhyāvalīmukhaṃ prekṣya prahṛṣṭakamalopamam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तत्पुत्रवचनं श्रुत्वा राजा रुक्माङ्गदस्तदा /
संध्यावलीमुखं प्रेक्ष्य प्रहृष्टकमलोपमम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing that speech of his son, King Rukmāṅgada then / looked upon the face of Saṃdhyāvalī, which was like a blooming lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīvacanaṃ śṛṇvanbhuṅkṣva mā hana dehajam /
mā bhuṅkṣva tanayaṃ hiṃsa cetyāgrahasamanvitam //
meaning:
मोहिनीवचनं शृण्वन्भुङ्क्ष्व मा हन देहजम् /
मा भुङ्क्ष्व तनयं हिंस चेत्याग्रहसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: while hearing the word of Mohinī filled with insistence: / "Eat, do not kill your offspring! / Do not eat, [then] slay your son!"

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ /
antarddhānagatastasthau vyomni dhairyāvalokakaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवान्कमलेक्षणः /
अन्तर्द्धानगतस्तस्थौ व्योम्नि धैर्यावलोककः //
text_mt: At that very moment, the lotus-eyed Lord, / hidden from sight, stood in the sky observing his fortitude,

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāṃ nṛpaśārdūla meghaśyāmo nirañjanaḥ /
dharmāṅgadasya vīrasya tasya rukmāṅgadasya tu //
meaning:
त्रयाणां नृपशार्दूल मेघश्यामो निरञ्जनः /
धर्माङ्गदस्य वीरस्य तस्य रुक्माङ्गदस्य तु //
text_mt: and the fortitude of the three, O tiger among kings—the cloud-dark, taintless [Lord]— / of heroic Dharmāṅgada, of that Rukmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvalyā sametasya vīśasaṃstho janārdanaḥ /
vacane bhuṅkṣva bhuṅkṣveti mohinyā vyāhṛte tadā //
meaning:
संध्यावल्या समेतस्य वीशसंस्थो जनार्दनः /
वचने भुङ्क्ष्व भुङ्क्ष्वेति मोहिन्या व्याहृते तदा //
text_mt: and of Saṃdhyāvalī. Janārdana, abiding in space, [watched them] / when the word "Eat! Eat!" was then uttered by Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha vimalaṃ khaṅgaṃ hantuṃ dharmāṅgadaṃ sutam /
supraharṣeṇa manasā praṇamya garuḍadhvajam /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā khaṅgahastaṃ tu pitaraṃ dharmmaṃbhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
जग्राह विमलं खङ्गं हन्तुं धर्माङ्गदं सुतम् /
सुप्रहर्षेण मनसा प्रणम्य गरुडध्वजम् /
तं दृष्ट्वा खङ्गहस्तं तु पितरं धर्म्मंभूषणः //
text_mt: He took up a spotless sword to kill his son Dharmāṅgada / with a very joyful mind, having bowed to the one whose banner is Garuḍa. / Seeing his father holding a sword in hand, he who was adorned with righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya mātāpitarau devaṃ cakradharaṃ tathā /
vadanaṃ prekṣya cādīnaṃ jananyā nṛpapuṅgavaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य मातापितरौ देवं चक्रधरं तथा /
वदनं प्रेक्ष्य चादीनं जनन्या नृपपुङ्गवः //
text_mt: bowing to his parents and likewise to the discus-bearing God, / and looking upon the undaunted face of his mother, the best of kings' sons,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣāṅgadena tu tadā svagrīvorvītale kṛtā /
kaṃbugrīvāṃ samānāṃ tu suvarṇā sukomalām //
meaning:
वृषाङ्गदेन तु तदा स्वग्रीवोर्वीतले कृता /
कंबुग्रीवां समानां तु सुवर्णा सुकोमलाम् //
text_mt: placed his own neck on the ground. / He brought forward his neck, resembling a conch, golden, extremely tender,

sanskrit_iast:
bahurekhamatha sthūlāṃ khaṅgamārge jyadarśayat /
pitṛbhaktyā yutenaiva mātṛbhaktyādhikena vai //
meaning:
बहुरेखमथ स्थूलां खङ्गमार्गे ज्यदर्शयत् /
पितृभक्त्या युतेनैव मातृभक्त्याधिकेन वै //
text_mt: having many lines, and thick, into the path of the sword, / endowed with devotion to his father and with even greater devotion to his mother.

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāpradāne tanayasya bhūpa harṣākule cārusudhāṃśuvaktre /
gṛhītakhaṅge jagadīśanāthe cacāla pṛthvīṃ sanagā samagrā //
meaning:
ग्रीवाप्रदाने तनयस्य भूप हर्षाकुले चारुसुधांशुवक्त्रे /
गृहीतखङ्गे जगदीशनाथे चचाल पृथ्वीं सनगा समग्रा //
text_mt: When the son offered his neck, O king, with joyful mind and a face lovely as the moon, / and the Lord of the world had taken up the sword, the entire earth along with its mountains trembled.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhuḥ pravṛddhaśca babhūva sadyo nimajja nārthaṃ bhuvanatrayasya /
nipeturulkāḥ śataśo dharāyāṃ nirghātayuktāḥ sataḍitkhamadhyāt //
meaning:
सिंधुः प्रवृद्धश्च बभूव सद्यो निमज्ज नार्थं भुवनत्रयस्य /
निपेतुरुल्काः शतशो धरायां निर्घातयुक्ताः सतडित्खमध्यात् //
text_mt: The ocean swelled instantly, as if to submerge the three worlds; / hundreds of meteors fell upon the earth, accompanied by claps of thunder and lightning from the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
vivarṇarūpā ca babhūva mohinī na devakāryaṃ hi kṛtaṃ mayeti /
nirarthakaṃ janma mamādhunābhūtkṛtaṃ tu daivena dajagadvidhāyinā //
meaning:
विवर्णरूपा च बभूव मोहिनी न देवकार्यं हि कृतं मयेति /
निरर्थकं जन्म ममाधुनाभूत्कृतं तु दैवेन दजगद्विधायिना //
text_mt: Mohinī turned pale, [thinking:] "I have indeed not accomplished the purpose of the gods! / My birth has now become useless, though created by destiny, the maker of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vimohanaṃ rūpamidaṃ viḍaṃbanaṃ yadbhūmipālena na bhuktamannam /
harerdine pāpabhayāpahe tu tṛṇaiḥ samāhaṃ bhavitā triviṣṭape //
meaning:
विमोहनं रूपमिदं विडंबनं यद्भूमिपालेन न भुक्तमन्नम् /
हरेर्दिने पापभयापहे तु तृणैः समाहं भविता त्रिविष्टपे //
text_mt: This bewitching beauty of mine is a mockery, since food was not eaten by the king! / On Hari's day, which destroys fear of sin, I will be regarded as straw in heaven.

sanskrit_iast: satvādhiko yāsyati mokṣamārgaṃ gantāsmi pāpa narakaṃ sudāruṇam //
meaning: सत्वाधिको यास्यति मोक्षमार्गं गन्तास्मि पाप नरकं सुदारुणम् //
text_mt: He, rich in virtue, will go to the path of liberation, while I, a sinner, shall go to a terrible hell."

sanskrit_iast:
samudyate tadā khaṅge nṛpeṇa nṛpapuṅgava /
mohinī mohasaṃyuktā papāta dharaṇītale //
meaning:
समुद्यते तदा खङ्गे नृपेण नृपपुङ्गव /
मोहिनी मोहसंयुक्ता पपात धरणीतले //
text_mt: As the sword was then raised by the king, O best of kings, / Mohinī fell to the earth, seized with faintness.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāpi tena khaṅgena bhrājamānaḥ samudyataḥ /
grīvāyāśchedanārthāya vṛṣāṅgadasutasya tu //
meaning:
राजापि तेन खङ्गेन भ्राजमानः समुद्यतः /
ग्रीवायाश्छेदनार्थाय वृषाङ्गदसुतस्य तु //
text_mt: The king too, shining with that sword, stood ready / to cut off the neck of the son born of Vṛṣāṅgada.

sanskrit_iast:
sakuṇḍalaṃ cāru śaśiprakāśaṃ bhrājiṣṇu vaktraṃ tanayasya bhūpaḥ /
pracicchide yāvadatīva harṣāddhairyānvito rukmavibhūṣaṇo 'sau //
meaning:
सकुण्डलं चारु शशिप्रकाशं भ्राजिष्णु वक्त्रं तनयस्य भूपः /
प्रचिच्छिदे यावदतीव हर्षाद्धैर्यान्वितो रुक्मविभूषणो ऽसौ //
text_mt: As that king, adorned with gold and endowed with fortitude, / was just about to sever with great joy his son's radiant face that was adorned with earrings and bright like the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadgṛhītaḥ svakareṇa bhūpaḥ kṣīrābdhikanyāpatinā mahīpaḥ /
tuṣṭo 'smi tuṣṭo 'smi na saṃśayo 'tra gacchasva lokaṃ mama lokanātha //
meaning:
तावद्गृहीतः स्वकरेण भूपः क्षीराब्धिकन्यापतिना महीपः /
तुष्टो ऽस्मि तुष्टो ऽस्मि न संशयो ऽत्र गच्छस्व लोकं मम लोकनाथ //
text_mt: just then the king was seized by the hand by the Lord of the daughter of the milk-ocean: / "I am pleased, I am pleased, of this there is no doubt! Go to my realm, O lord of the realm!

sanskrit_iast:
priyānvitaścātmajasaṃyutaśca kīrtiṃ samādhāya mahītale tu /
trailokyapūjyāṃ vimalāṃ ca śuklāṃ kṛtvā padaṃ mūrdhni yamasya bhūpa //
meaning:
प्रियान्वितश्चात्मजसंयुतश्च कीर्तिं समाधाय महीतले तु /
त्रैलोक्यपूज्यां विमलां च शुक्लां कृत्वा पदं मूर्ध्नि यमस्य भूप //
text_mt: Together with your beloved and united with your son, having established upon the earth / pure and bright fame revered across the three worlds, having placed your foot upon the head of Yama, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
prayāhi vāsaṃ mama dehasaṃjñaṃ sa cakriṇo bhūmipatiḥ kareṇa /
saṃspṛṣṭamātro virajā babhūva priyāsametastanayena yuktaḥ //
meaning:
प्रयाहि वासं मम देहसंज्ञं स चक्रिणो भूमिपतिः करेण /
संस्पृष्टमात्रो विरजा बभूव प्रियासमेतस्तनयेन युक्तः //
text_mt: proceed to my realm called My Body!" The king, the moment he was touched / by the hand of the discus-bearer, became free of all passion, along with his beloved and united with his son.

sanskrit_iast:
upetya vegena jagāma dehaṃ devasya divyaṃ sa nṛpo mahātmā /
vihāya lakṣmīmavanīprasūtāṃ vihāya dāsīḥsudhanaṃ sa kośam //
meaning:
उपेत्य वेगेन जगाम देहं देवस्य दिव्यं स नृपो महात्मा /
विहाय लक्ष्मीमवनीप्रसूतां विहाय दासीःसुधनं स कोशम् //
text_mt: Approaching swiftly, that great-souled king went into the divine body of the God, / abandoning his earthly wealth, abandoning female servants, abundant treasure, and his treasury,

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya nāgāṃsturagānrathāṃśca svadāravargaṃ svajanādikāṃśca /
jagāma dehaṃ madhusūdanasya tatoṃ'barātpuṣpacayaḥ papāta //
meaning:
विहाय नागांस्तुरगान्रथांश्च स्वदारवर्गं स्वजनादिकांश्च /
जगाम देहं मधुसूदनस्य ततोंऽबरात्पुष्पचयः पपात //
text_mt: abandoning elephants, horses, chariots, his wives, and his kin; / he entered the body of Madhusūdana. Then a shower of flowers fell from the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhṛṣṭasiddhaiḥ suralokapālaiḥ saṃtāḍitā dundubhayo vineduḥ /
rājan jagurgītamatīva ramyaṃ devāṅganāḥ saṃnanṛturmudānvitāḥ //
meaning:
संहृष्टसिद्धैः सुरलोकपालैः संताडिता दुन्दुभयो विनेदुः /
राजन् जगुर्गीतमतीव रम्यं देवाङ्गनाः संननृतुर्मुदान्विताः //
text_mt: Drums sounded, struck by the rejoicing Siddhas and the guardians of the world of the gods; / O king, they sang exceedingly charming songs, and the celestial nymphs danced, filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvakanyā nṛpakarmatuṣṭāstadadbhutaṃ prekṣya dineśasūnuḥ /
harestanau bhūmipatiṃ praviṣṭaṃ sadāraputraṃ svalipiṃ pramārjya //
meaning:
गन्धर्वकन्या नृपकर्मतुष्टास्तदद्भुतं प्रेक्ष्य दिनेशसूनुः /
हरेस्तनौ भूमिपतिं प्रविष्टं सदारपुत्रं स्वलिपिं प्रमार्ज्य //
text_mt: The Gandharva daughters were pleased by the king's deed. Beholding that marvel— / the ruler of the earth, with his wife and son, entering the body of Hari—the son of the Sun god wiped away his own writing,

sanskrit_iast:
lokāṃśca sarvānnṛpadiṣṭamārge kṛtvā kṛtajñānharilokamārgān /
bhītaḥ punaḥ prāpya pitāmahāntikaṃ provāca devaṃ caturānanaṃ rudan //
meaning:
लोकांश्च सर्वान्नृपदिष्टमार्गे कृत्वा कृतज्ञान्हरिलोकमार्गान् /
भीतः पुनः प्राप्य पितामहान्तिकं प्रोवाच देवं चतुराननं रुदन् //
text_mt: and, having set all the people on the path directed by the king, knowing their duties, on the path to Hari's world, / terrified, went again before the Grandfather and, weeping, said to the four-faced God:

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ niyogī bhavitā hi deva ājñāvihīnaḥ suralokanātha /
vidhehi cānyatprakaromi tāta nideśanaṃ māstu madīya daṇḍam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite sutavadhodyatasya rukmāṅgadasya bhagavaddarśanaṃ nāma catustriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
नाहं नियोगी भविता हि देव आज्ञाविहीनः सुरलोकनाथ /
विधेहि चान्यत्प्रकरोमि तात निदेशनं मास्तु मदीय दण्डम् //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते सुतवधोद्यतस्य रुक्माङ्गदस्य भगवद्दर्शनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
"I can no longer be your agent, O God, bereft of authority, O lord of the gods' realm! / Ordain something else; I will do it, O father! Let not my staff [of justice] be an empty instruction!"

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, named 'The King's Vision of the Lord as Rukmāṅgada Prepares to Slay His Son' in the story of Mohinī, in the latter section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yama uvāca
vibudheśa jagannātha carācaraguro prabho /
mohinī niṣphalā jātā vandhyā strī janane yathā //
meaning:
यम उवाच
विबुधेश जगन्नाथ चराचरगुरो प्रभो /
मोहिनी निष्फला जाता वन्ध्या स्त्री जनने यथा //
text_mt: Yama said: / "O lord of the wise, O Lord of the universe, O teacher of the moving and unmoving, O Master! / Mohinī has become fruitless, like a barren woman in childbearing.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmāṅgadapraṇītena mārgeṇa kuśalāñchana /
lokaḥ prayāti vaikuṃṇṭhaṃ na māṃ kaścitprapadyate //
meaning:
रुक्माङ्गदप्रणीतेन मार्गेण कुशलाञ्छन /
लोकः प्रयाति वैकुंण्ठं न मां कश्चित्प्रपद्यते //
text_mt: By the path laid down by Rukmāṅgada, O you marked with auspiciousness, / the populace goes to Vaikuṇṭha; no one falls to me.

sanskrit_iast:
gate 'pi bhūminātheśe dehaṃ devasya cakriṇaḥ /
tathāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ na buddhiḥ parivartate //
meaning:
गते ऽपि भूमिनाथेशे देहं देवस्य चक्रिणः /
तथापि सर्वभूतानां न बुद्धिः परिवर्तते //
text_mt: Even though the ruler of the earth has gone to the body of the discus-bearing God, / still the understanding of all beings does not turn away.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇorākumārāttu mānavāḥ /
prayānti paramaṃ lokaṃ luptapāpāḥ pitāmaha //
meaning:
उपोष्य वासरं विष्णोराकुमारात्तु मानवाः /
प्रयान्ति परमं लोकं लुप्तपापाः पितामह //
text_mt: Having fasted on Viṣṇu's day, mortals, even down to children, / go to the supreme realm with their sins destroyed, O Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
putrī te vrīḍitā devī mohinī mohamāgatā /
nāyāti tava sāmīpyaṃ na bhuṅkte lokagarhitā //
meaning:
पुत्री ते व्रीडिता देवी मोहिनी मोहमागता /
नायाति तव सामीप्यं न भुङ्क्ते लोकगर्हिता //
text_mt: Your daughter, the goddess Mohinī, overcome with shame, has fallen into despair; / reviled by the world, she does not come near you and does not eat.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvyāpārastvahaṃ jātaḥ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām /
raviputravacaḥ śrutvā provāca kamalāsanaḥ //
meaning:
निर्व्यापारस्त्वहं जातः किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम् /
रविपुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा प्रोवाच कमलासनः //
text_mt: I have become devoid of occupation; what shall I do? Instruct me!" / Hearing the words of the Sun god's son, the lotus-seated [Brahmā] said:

sanskrit_iast:
gacchāmaḥ sahitāḥ sarve mohinīṃ pratibodhitum /
mohinyāṃ pratibuddhāyāṃ kariṣyāmo divākare //
meaning:
गच्छामः सहिताः सर्वे मोहिनीं प्रतिबोधितुम् /
मोहिन्यां प्रतिबुद्धायां करिष्यामो दिवाकरे //
text_mt: "Let us all go together to comfort Mohinī; / when Mohinī is restored, O Sun's son,

sanskrit_iast:
tava kāryaṃ na saṃdehaḥ saṃbhramastyajyatāmayam /
tato deva gaṇāḥ sarve śatakratupurogamāḥ //
meaning:
तव कार्यं न संदेहः संभ्रमस्त्यज्यतामयम् /
ततो देव गणाः सर्वे शतक्रतुपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: we will accomplish your purpose, of this there is no doubt; cast aside this agitation!" / Then all the hosts of gods, led by Śatakratu,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā sahitāḥ pṛthvīṃ vimānaiḥ sūryasaprabhaiḥ /
samāyātā mahīpāla nārīṃ tāṃ pratibodhitum //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा सहिताः पृथ्वीं विमानैः सूर्यसप्रभैः /
समायाता महीपाल नारीं तां प्रतिबोधितुम् //
text_mt: went down to the earth together with Brahmā in aerial cars radiant as the sun, / O king, to comfort that woman.

sanskrit_iast:
te vimānaiḥ samantāttu parivārya śubhānanām /
tejohīnāṃ nirānandāṃ śuṣkatoyāṃ nadīmiva //
meaning:
ते विमानैः समन्तात्तु परिवार्य शुभाननाम् /
तेजोहीनां निरानन्दां शुष्कतोयां नदीमिव //
text_mt: Surrounding that fair-faced woman on all sides with their aerial cars, / [they saw her] bereft of splendour, devoid of joy, like a river whose waters are dried up.

sanskrit_iast:
śaśihīnāṃ niśāṃ bhūpa ṛtvigghīnāṃ kriyāmiva /
parājito yathā martyaḥ pralmānakusumaṃ yathā //
meaning:
शशिहीनां निशां भूप ऋत्विग्घीनां क्रियामिव /
पराजितो यथा मर्त्यः प्रल्मानकुसुमं यथा //
text_mt: Like a night without the moon, O king; like a ritual without an officiating priest; / like a defeated mortal; like a withered flower;

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttotsavavedīva vidrumaṃ dhavalaṃ yathā /
gataśālistu kedāro niṣpra yathā //
meaning:
निवृत्तोत्सववेदीव विद्रुमं धवलं यथा /
गतशालिस्तु केदारो निष्प्र यथा //
text_mt: like an altar after the festival has ended; like pale coral; / like a rice-field whose grain is gone; like [a lamp] without light;

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍa vā gatodvā yathā saraḥ /
manthānaṃ navanīte vā uddhṛte dharaṇīpate //
meaning:
मण्ड वा गतोद्वा यथा सरः /
मन्थानं नवनीते वा उद्धृते धरणीपते //
text_mt: like [...] whose water is gone, like a lake; / or like a churning-stick after the butter has been taken out, O lord of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃskṛtā yathā vāṇī marditā ca yathā camūm /
hata nāthāṃ tu yuvatīṃ dhānyahīnāṃ prajāṃ yathā //
meaning:
असंस्कृता यथा वाणी मर्दिता च यथा चमूम् /
हत नाथां तु युवतीं धान्यहीनां प्रजां यथा //
text_mt: like speech that is uncultivated; and like an army that is crushed; / like a young woman whose protector is slain; like subjects without grain;

sanskrit_iast:
mantrahīnavidhiṃ yuddhaṃ dharmaṃ ca dayayā vinā /
pṛthvīṃ bhūpālahīnā vā mantrahī yathā nṛpa //
meaning:
मन्त्रहीनविधिं युद्धं धर्मं च दयया विना /
पृथ्वीं भूपालहीना वा मन्त्रही यथा नृप //
text_mt: like a ritual without mantras, a battle or dharma without compassion; / like the earth without a ruler; or like [...] without ministers, O king;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadhānyavihīnaṃ vā gṛhaṃ nṛpavarottama /
jalahīnaṃ yathā kuṃbhaṃ paṅkasthaṃ gopatiṃ yathā //
meaning:
धनधान्यविहीनं वा गृहं नृपवरोत्तम /
जलहीनं यथा कुंभं पङ्कस्थं गोपतिं यथा //
text_mt: or like a house devoid of wealth and grain, O best of excellent kings; / like a jar without water; like a bull stuck in the mud;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthaṃ bhāryayā hīnaṃ rāṣṭrabhraṣṭaṃ ca bhūpatim /
bhagnakriyaṃ yathā vaidyaṃ bhagnaśākhaṃ yathā drumam //
meaning:
गृहस्थं भार्यया हीनं राष्ट्रभ्रष्टं च भूपतिम् /
भग्नक्रियं यथा वैद्यं भग्नशाखं यथा द्रुमम् //
text_mt: like a householder without a wife; and like a king fallen from his realm; / like a physician whose treatments have failed; like a tree whose branches are broken;

sanskrit_iast:
tejohīnaṃ yathāgāraṃ nirjalaṃ vā ghanaṃ yathā /
vidhūma iva saptārcirviraśmiriva bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
तेजोहीनं यथागारं निर्जलं वा घनं यथा /
विधूम इव सप्तार्चिर्विरश्मिरिव भास्करः //
text_mt: like a house devoid of splendor; or like a cloud without water; / like the seven-flamed fire without smoke; like the sun without rays;

sanskrit_iast:
matibhraṣṭo yathā martyaḥ parvasaṃgī yathā naraḥ /
atṛptaḥ kāntayā kāntaḥ pannagaśca viṣojjhitaḥ //
meaning:
मतिभ्रष्टो यथा मर्त्यः पर्वसंगी यथा नरः /
अतृप्तः कान्तया कान्तः पन्नगश्च विषोज्झितः //
text_mt: like a mortal whose intellect is ruined; like a man who engages in intercourse on sacred days; / like a lover unsatisfied by his beloved; and like a snake bereft of poison;

sanskrit_iast:
lūnapakṣo yathā pakṣī vṛttihīno yathā dvijaḥ /
śirobhraṣṭā yathā mālā parvato dhātuvarjitaḥ //
meaning:
लूनपक्षो यथा पक्षी वृत्तिहीनो यथा द्विजः /
शिरोभ्रष्टा यथा माला पर्वतो धातुवर्जितः //
text_mt: like a bird whose wings are clipped; like a twice-born without a livelihood; / like a garland fallen from the head; like a mountain devoid of minerals;

sanskrit_iast:
prabhraṣṭalipi śāstraṃ vā ṛgyajurvisvaraṃ yathā /
svarahīnaṃ yathā sāma padmahīnaṃ yathā saraḥ //
meaning:
प्रभ्रष्टलिपि शास्त्रं वा ऋग्यजुर्विस्वरं यथा /
स्वरहीनं यथा साम पद्महीनं यथा सरः //
text_mt: or like a scripture with corrupted writing; like the Ṛgveda or Yajurveda chanted with wrong accents; / like the Sāmaveda devoid of musical tune; like a lake devoid of lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mārgaṃ tṛṇai ruddhaṃ padmaṃ patravivarjitam /
jñānaṃ mamatvasaṃyuktaṃ pumāṃsaṃ prakṛtiṃ vinā //
meaning:
यथा मार्गं तृणै रुद्धं पद्मं पत्रविवर्जितम् /
ज्ञानं ममत्वसंयुक्तं पुमांसं प्रकृतिं विना //
text_mt: like a path blocked by weeds; like a lotus bereft of leaves; / like knowledge conjoined with attachment; like Puruṣa without Prakṛti;

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhyāni tattvahīnāni dharmaṃ daṃbhānvitaṃ yathā /
tejohīnāṃ tathāpaśyan mohinīṃ te divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
सांख्यानि तत्त्वहीनानि धर्मं दंभान्वितं यथा /
तेजोहीनां तथापश्यन् मोहिनीं ते दिवौकसः //
text_mt: like Sāṅkhya teachings devoid of true principles; like dharma accompanied by deceit— / even so the denizens of heaven beheld Mohinī devoid of luster,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyamānāṃ nirutsāhāṃ dṛśyamānāṃ janaiḥ prabho /
ākrośavacanaiḥ krūraiḥ putrahatyāsamanvitām //
meaning:
ध्यायमानां निरुत्साहां दृश्यमानां जनैः प्रभो /
आक्रोशवचनैः क्रूरैः पुत्रहत्यासमन्विताम् //
text_mt: brooding, dispirited, watched by the people, O lord, / with cruel words of revilement, associated with the murder of a son,

sanskrit_iast:
duḥśīlāṃ dharmasaṃtyaktāṃ tadvākyaparimoṣitām /
svavākyapālanāṃ caṇḍāmucurdevāḥ samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
दुःशीलां धर्मसंत्यक्तां तद्वाक्यपरिमोषिताम् /
स्ववाक्यपालनां चण्डामुचुर्देवाः समागताः //
text_mt: ill-behaved, abandoned by dharma, robbed of her word, / yet fiercely adhering to her own statement. The assembled gods said to her:

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ śokaṃ kuru vāmoru pauruṣaṃ hi tvayā kṛtam /
nahi mādhavabhaktānāṃ vidyate mānakhaṇḍanam //
meaning:
मां शोकं कुरु वामोरु पौरुषं हि त्वया कृतम् /
नहि माधवभक्तानां विद्यते मानखण्डनम् //
text_mt: “Do not grieve, O woman of lovely thighs! For manly effort was indeed made by you. / Surely, for devotees of Mādhava, there is no breaking of honor!

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvaṃ hariṇaśāvākṣi devakāryārthamāgatā /
tanna siddhaṃ varārohe sa prayāto 'dhunābhavam //
meaning:
सा त्वं हरिणशावाक्षि देवकार्यार्थमागता /
तन्न सिद्धं वरारोहे स प्रयातो ऽधुनाभवम् //
text_mt: You who have eyes like a fawn's came for the work of the gods; / that was not accomplished, O fair-hipped woman, and he has now gone to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
vighnavidhvaṃsinīṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtā rukmāṅgadena hi /
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā mohinī mādhave site //
meaning:
विघ्नविध्वंसिनीं पूर्वं कृता रुक्माङ्गदेन हि /
एकादशी महापुण्या मोहिनी माधवे सिते //
text_mt: For previously the destroyer of obstacles, the highly meritorious Mohinī Ekādaśī, / was observed by Rukmāṅgada during the bright fortnight of the month of Mādhava,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ viśālākṣi kṛcchrapādaprapūjitā /
tasyaivādhyuṣṭiratulā yatsatyācaccalito na hi //
meaning:
संवत्सरं विशालाक्षि कृच्छ्रपादप्रपूजिता /
तस्यैवाध्युष्टिरतुला यत्सत्याचच्चलितो न हि //
text_mt: honored for a year with quarters of severe austerities, O wide-eyed lady. / His unmatched persistence is such that he did not swerve from truth.

sanskrit_iast:
vighnarājñī tu vai nārī lokeṣu parigīyate /
karmaṇā manasā vācā putravyāpādane matim //
meaning:
विघ्नराज्ञी तु वै नारी लोकेषु परिगीयते /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा पुत्रव्यापादने मतिम् //
text_mt: A woman who is an obstacle is indeed celebrated in the worlds; / yet having formed the resolve in deed, mind, and speech to slay his son,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā coddhṛtya khaṅgaṃ ca tyaktvā snehaṃ sudūrurataḥ /
tādṛśaṃ nikaṣaṃ prokṣya bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वा चोद्धृत्य खङ्गं च त्यक्त्वा स्नेहं सुदूरुरतः /
तादृशं निकषं प्रोक्ष्य भगवान्मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: and having raised the sword, casting affection far away— / having examined such a touchstone, the blessed Lord Madhusūdana [intervened].

sanskrit_iast:
haniṣyati priyaṃ putraṃ na bhuṅkte harivāsare /
putrasya ca priyāyāśca bhāvaṃ prekṣya nṛpasya ca //
meaning:
हनिष्यति प्रियं पुत्रं न भुङ्क्ते हरिवासरे /
पुत्रस्य च प्रियायाश्च भावं प्रेक्ष्य नृपस्य च //
text_mt: He was about to slay his dear son, but would not eat on the day of Hari! / Seeing the disposition of the son, of the beloved wife, and of the king,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunā paretuṣṭena nītāḥ svabhavane trayaḥ /
sadehāḥ kṣīṇakarmāṇo hy aṅgāro 'gnirivāhitaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुना परेतुष्टेन नीताः स्वभवने त्रयः /
सदेहाः क्षीणकर्माणो ह्य् अङ्गारो ऽग्निरिवाहितः //
text_mt: the three of them were taken to his own abode by Viṣṇu, who was exceedingly pleased, / along with their bodies, their karmas exhausted, like embers placed into fire.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ karmaṇi cārabdhe yadi devī na siddhyati /
sarvayatnena subhage doṣaḥ ko 'tra tavādhunā //
meaning:
फलं कर्मणि चारब्धे यदि देवी न सिद्ध्यति /
सर्वयत्नेन सुभगे दोषः को ऽत्र तवाधुना //
text_mt: If the fruit does not succeed when an action has been undertaken / with every effort, O fortunate goddess, what fault is there on your part now?

sanskrit_iast:
etasmād varadāḥ sarve saṃprāptā vibudhāḥ śubhe /
siddhau vāpyatha vāsiddhau karmakṛtsyāddṛthā na hi //
meaning:
एतस्माद् वरदाः सर्वे संप्राप्ता विबुधाः शुभे /
सिद्धौ वाप्यथ वासिद्धौ कर्मकृत्स्याद्दृथा न हि //
text_mt: Therefore all the gods have arrived, ready to grant boons, O auspicious lady! / Whether in success or in failure, the performer of an act does not act in vain.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhartavyo bhṛtyavargaśca bhūbhujā dharmamicchatā /
sadbhāve ghaṭamānasya yadi karma na siddhyati //
meaning:
भर्तव्यो भृत्यवर्गश्च भूभुजा धर्ममिच्छता /
सद्भावे घटमानस्य यदि कर्म न सिद्ध्यति //
text_mt: And the group of servants must be supported by a king who desires righteousness. / If, though striving in good faith, his work does not succeed,

sanskrit_iast:
deyaṃ vetanamātraṃ tu na ca tuṣṭiphalaṃ bhavet /
yo na tasmai prayaccheta jīvanaṃ jīvanāya vai //
meaning:
देयं वेतनमात्रं तु न च तुष्टिफलं भवेत् /
यो न तस्मै प्रयच्छेत जीवनं जीवनाय वै //
text_mt: his wages alone must indeed be given, though there may be no reward of satisfaction. / Whoever does not grant him a livelihood for his living,

sanskrit_iast:
govadhaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ /
tasmād deyaṃ varārohe abhīṣṭaṃ varasundari //
meaning:
गोवधं समवाप्नोति स नरो नात्र संशयः /
तस्माद् देयं वरारोहे अभीष्टं वरसुन्दरि //
text_mt: that man incurs [the sin of] cow-slaughter; of this there is no doubt. / Therefore, O fair-hipped one, O exquisite beauty, what is desired must be given.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhāvena kṛte samyagvighnaṃ kāryaṃ divaukasām /
kiṃ na kurvanti vibudhās tvayā saha varānane //
meaning:
सद्भावेन कृते सम्यग्विघ्नं कार्यं दिवौकसाम् /
किं न कुर्वन्ति विबुधास् त्वया सह वरानने //
text_mt: When an obstacle to the business of the celestials has been properly created in good faith, / what will the gods not do in concert with you, O lovely-faced woman?

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyās tejasā bhagnā yām āhur vighranāśinīm /
vibudhair evam uktā tu mohinī lokamohinī //
meaning:
द्वादश्यास् तेजसा भग्ना याम् आहुर् विघ्रनाशिनीम् /
विबुधैर् एवम् उक्ता तु मोहिनी लोकमोहिनी //
text_mt: Broken by the splendour of the Dvādaśī, which they call the destroyer of obstacles, / Mohinī, the deluder of the world, thus addressed by the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca sā nirānandā patihīnātiduḥkhitā /
dhigidaṃ jīvitaṃ mahyaṃ yena kāryaṃ na sādhitam //
meaning:
उवाच सा निरानन्दा पतिहीनातिदुःखिता /
धिगिदं जीवितं मह्यं येन कार्यं न साधितम् //
text_mt: spoke, cheerless, bereft of her husband, utterly afflicted: / 'Fie on this life of mine, by which the task has not been accomplished!

sanskrit_iast:
na kṛto janasaṃbādho yamamārgo 'marādhipāḥ /
na tu luptaṃ haridinaṃ na bhuktaṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
न कृतो जनसंबाधो यममार्गो ऽमराधिपाः /
न तु लुप्तं हरिदिनं न भुक्तं हरिवासरे //
text_mt: The path of Yama was not crowded with people, O lords of the immortals! / Nor was the day of Hari violated; nor was food eaten on the day of Hari!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūbhujā tena vīreṇa kṛtaḥ putravadho mudā /
gato mūrdhni padaṃ datvā mama rukmāṅgado harim //
meaning:
भूभुजा तेन वीरेण कृतः पुत्रवधो मुदा /
गतो मूर्ध्नि पदं दत्वा मम रुक्माङ्गदो हरिम् //
text_mt: By that heroic king, the slaying of his son was performed with joy. / Having set his foot upon my head, Rukmāṅgada has gone to Hari—

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyaguṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ nirmalaṃ nirmalāśrayam /
haṃsaṃ śucipadaṃ vyoma praṇavaṃ bījamavyayam //
meaning:
अप्रमेयगुणं विष्णुं निर्मलं निर्मलाश्रयम् /
हंसं शुचिपदं व्योम प्रणवं बीजमव्ययम् //
text_mt: to Viṣṇu of immeasurable qualities, the spotless one, the refuge of the stainless, / the Swan, whose station is pure, the ether, the syllable Oṃ, the imperishable seed,

sanskrit_iast:
nirākāraṃ nirābhāsaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ nirañjanam /
śūnyaṃ viyatsvarūpaṃ ca dhyeyadhyānavivarjitam //
meaning:
निराकारं निराभासं निष्प्रपञ्चं निरञ्जनम् /
शून्यं वियत्स्वरूपं च ध्येयध्यानविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: formless, without appearance, devoid of phenomenal expansion, unstained, / the void, whose nature is the sky, free from object of meditation and meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
asti nāstīti yaṃ prāhurna dūre nāpi cāntike /
paraṃ dhāma manogrāhyaṃ puruṣākhyaṃ jaganmayam //
meaning:
अस्ति नास्तीति यं प्राहुर्न दूरे नापि चान्तिके /
परं धाम मनोग्राह्यं पुरुषाख्यं जगन्मयम् //
text_mt: whom they describe as "He is" and "He is not", neither far nor near, / the supreme abode, to be grasped by the mind, called the Puruṣa, identical with the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpaṅkajasamāsīnaṃ tejorūpaṃ sanātanam /
tasmiṃl layam anuprāpte kiṃ nu me jīvite phalam //
meaning:
हृत्पङ्कजसमासीनं तेजोरूपं सनातनम् /
तस्मिंल् लयम् अनुप्राप्ते किं नु मे जीविते फलम् //
text_mt: seated upon the lotus of the heart, whose form is light, the eternal. / Since he has attained dissolution in Him, what fruit is there indeed in my life?

sanskrit_iast:
asādhite tu yaḥ kārye naro gṛhṇāti vetanam /
svāminaṃ tu parityajya prayāti narakaṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
असाधिते तु यः कार्ये नरो गृह्णाति वेतनम् /
स्वामिनं तु परित्यज्य प्रयाति नरकं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: A man who takes wages when his task has not been accomplished, / having abandoned his master, surely goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
na sādhayanti ye kāryaṃ svāmināṃ tu divaukasaḥ /
bhṛtyā vetanabhoktāro jāyante bhūtale hayāḥ //
meaning:
न साधयन्ति ये कार्यं स्वामिनां तु दिवौकसः /
भृत्या वेतनभोक्तारो जायन्ते भूतले हयाः //
text_mt: O gods, servants who enjoy their wages but do not / accomplish the task of their masters are reborn as horses on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
asādhinīyaṃ kāryasya bhartṛputravināśinī /
kathaṃ varaṃ tu gṛhṇāmi bhavatāṃ nākavāsinām //
meaning:
असाधिनीयं कार्यस्य भर्तृपुत्रविनाशिनी /
कथं वरं तु गृह्णामि भवतां नाकवासिनाम् //
text_mt: As one who failed to accomplish the task, the destroyer of my husband and son, / how can I accept a boon from you who dwell in heaven?'

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
brūhi mohini dāsyāmi yatte hṛdi samīhitam /
anṛṇāstu bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā copakṛtiṃ tava //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
ब्रूहि मोहिनि दास्यामि यत्ते हृदि समीहितम् /
अनृणास्तु भविष्यामः कृत्वा चोपकृतिं तव //
text_mt: The gods said: / 'Speak, Mohinī! I will grant whatever is desired in your heart. / Having rendered you assistance, we shall be free from debt.

sanskrit_iast:
pariśramaḥ kṛto devi tvayā rājaprayojane /
tasya tvaṃ phalabhāgdevi tādṛśārthe kṛtasya tu //
meaning:
परिश्रमः कृतो देवि त्वया राजप्रयोजने /
तस्य त्वं फलभाग्देवि तादृशार्थे कृतस्य तु //
text_mt: Exertion was made by you, O goddess, in the matter concerning the king. / You are entitled to the fruit of that, O goddess, which was performed for such an end.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamuccaramāṇānāṃ devatānāṃ mahīpate /
nṛpaterājagāmātha purodhāḥ pāvakaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुच्चरमाणानां देवतानां महीपते /
नृपतेराजगामाथ पुरोधाः पावकप्रभः //
text_mt: While the deities were speaking thus, O king, / the king's royal priest, possessing the brilliance of fire, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣito jalamadhye tu prāṇāyāmarato muniḥ /
dvādaśābde tataḥ pūrṇe nirgato jalamadhyataḥ //
meaning:
उषितो जलमध्ये तु प्राणायामरतो मुनिः /
द्वादशाब्दे ततः पूर्णे निर्गतो जलमध्यतः //
text_mt: The sage, having stayed in the midst of the water devoted to prāṇāyāma, / came out from the water when twelve years were completed.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgatena śrutaṃ tena mohinīceṣṭitaṃ nṛpa /
sakrodho muniśārdūlo devavṛndamupāgataḥ //
meaning:
निर्गतेन श्रुतं तेन मोहिनीचेष्टितं नृप /
सक्रोधो मुनिशार्दूलो देववृन्दमुपागतः //
text_mt: Having come out, O king, he heard of Mohinī's conduct. / Enraged, that tiger among sages approached the assembly of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vibudhānsarvānmohinīvaradāyinaḥ /
dhigimāṃ dhigdevasaṃghaṃ karma dhikpāpasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
उवाच विबुधान्सर्वान्मोहिनीवरदायिनः /
धिगिमां धिग्देवसंघं कर्म धिक्पापसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: He said to all the gods who were bestowing boons on Mohinī: / 'Fie on this woman! Fie on the host of gods! Fie on the deed designated as sinful,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatāṃ bhāvanāśāya puruṣārthe prarohakam /
bhavanto yacca dātāro mohinyā vāñchitaṃ varam //
meaning:
भवतां भावनाशाय पुरुषार्थे प्ररोहकम् /
भवन्तो यच्च दातारो मोहिन्या वाञ्छितं वरम् //
text_mt: which brings about the destruction of your standing and sprouts against the aims of man! / In that you are granters of the desired boon to Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast:
hatyāyutā bhartṛsutopaghātinī vihinavṛttiśca marāśirūpā /
nāsmā hi loke bhavatīha śuddhiḥ samiddhavahnau patane 'pi devāḥ //
meaning:
हत्यायुता भर्तृसुतोपघातिनी विहिनवृत्तिश्च मराशिरूपा /
नास्मा हि लोके भवतीह शुद्धिः समिद्धवह्नौ पतने ऽपि देवाः //
text_mt: she who has tens of thousands of slaughters, the destroyer of her husband and son, vile in conduct, a heap of death— / for her, O gods, there can be no purification in this world, even by falling into kindled fire!

sanskrit_iast:
"hatyāyutaṃ bhartṛvadho nirarthakametatsamaṃ vipravaraiḥ purākṛtam /
na cāpi cāsyā bhavatīha śuddhiḥ samidbhavahnau patane 'pi devāḥ" //
vimoyitvā vacanaiḥ sudhāmayairukmāṅgadaṃ dharmaṃvibhūṣaṇaṃ ca /
priyāyutaṃ mokṣapadaṃ nihatya cakāra bhūmiṃ nṛpavarjitāṃ ca //
meaning:
"हत्यायुतं भर्तृवधो निरर्थकमेतत्समं विप्रवरैः पुराकृतम् /
न चापि चास्या भवतीह शुद्धिः समिद्भवह्नौ पतने ऽपि देवाः" //
विमोयित्वा वचनैः सुधामयैरुक्माङ्गदं धर्मंविभूषणं च /
प्रियायुतं मोक्षपदं निहत्य चकार भूमिं नृपवर्जितां च //
text_mt: "Tens of thousands of slaughters and the slaying of a husband are useless: this was declared of old by the best of the twice-born. / Nor can there be purification for her in this world, O gods, even by falling into kindled fire!" / Having deluded Rukmāṅgada, the ornament of righteousness, with nectarous words, / she destroyed the path of liberation along with his beloved and rendered the earth bereft of a king!

sanskrit_iast:
na cāpi vāso narakeṣu devā asyāḥ sthitiḥ kka tridive 'lpabuddheḥ /
na cāpi rājño nikaṭe ca devā nāpyetu viṣṇoḥ padamavyayaṃ yat //
meaning:
न चापि वासो नरकेषु देवा अस्याः स्थितिः क्क त्रिदिवे ऽल्पबुद्धेः /
न चापि राज्ञो निकटे च देवा नाप्येतु विष्णोः पदमव्ययं यत् //
text_mt: There is no dwelling for her even in the hells, O gods! Where can there be a place in heaven for this woman of dull wit? / Nor may she be near the king, O gods; nor may she attain the imperishable abode of Viṣṇu!

sanskrit_iast:
na lokavādena vidūṣitāyā lokeṣu kutrāpi bhavecca vāsaḥ /
dhirajīvanaṃ kargmavigarhitāyā devāḥ sadā pāpasamāratāyāḥ //
meaning:
न लोकवादेन विदूषिताया लोकेषु कुत्रापि भवेच्च वासः /
धिरजीवनं कर्ग्मविगर्हिताया देवाः सदा पापसमारतायाः //
text_mt: For one defiled by public censure, there can be no dwelling anywhere in the worlds. / Fie on the life of this woman condemned by her deeds, O gods, who is ever devoted to sin!

sanskrit_iast:
patiṃ hatvā sutaṃ hatvā sapatnīṃ jananīsamām /
hatvā dharāṃ samastāṃ vā kāṃ gatiṃ yāsyate surāḥ //
meaning:
पतिं हत्वा सुतं हत्वा सपत्नीं जननीसमाम् /
हत्वा धरां समस्तां वा कां गतिं यास्यते सुराः //
text_mt: Having slain her husband, having slain her son, having slain her co-wife who was like a mother, / or having destroyed the entire earth—what destination will she attain, O gods?

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ pāpatarā devā dharmavidhvaṃsinī hareḥ /
sarvadāpyanayā proktaṃ bhujyatāṃ harivāsare //
meaning:
इयं पापतरा देवा धर्मविध्वंसिनी हरेः /
सर्वदाप्यनया प्रोक्तं भुज्यतां हरिवासरे //
text_mt: She is most sinful, O gods, the destroyer of Hari's righteousness! / By her it was constantly said: "Let food be eaten on the day of Hari!"

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇasaṃvarddhanārthāya teṣāmevāpyadhogatiḥ /
bhujyatāṃ vāsare viṣṇorhanyatāṃ gaurdvijānvitā //
meaning:
प्राणसंवर्द्धनार्थाय तेषामेवाप्यधोगतिः /
भुज्यतां वासरे विष्णोर्हन्यतां गौर्द्विजान्विता //
text_mt: For the sake of sustaining the life-breaths, even those people go downwards. / Saying, "Eat on the day of Viṣṇu! Kill the cow along with the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
apeyaṃ pīyatā muktvā kathaṃ vāsaṃ labheddivi /
etadajñānināṃ proktaṃ jñānanāṃ tu na nirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
अपेयं पीयता मुक्त्वा कथं वासं लभेद्दिवि /
एतदज्ञानिनां प्रोक्तं ज्ञाननां तु न निर्णयः //
text_mt: Drink what should not be drunk!"—how could she obtain a dwelling in heaven? / This is declared for the ignorant; for the wise there is no question.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānāvdyāhṛte vākye bhujyatāṃ harivāsare /
tasyāpi śuddhirgaditā prāṇāyāmaśatena hi //
meaning:
अज्ञानाव्द्याहृते वाक्ये भुज्यतां हरिवासरे /
तस्यापि शुद्धिर्गदिता प्राणायामशतेन हि //
text_mt: Even if the words "Let food be eaten on the day of Hari" are uttered out of ignorance, / purification for that is declared by a hundred prāṇāyāmas,

sanskrit_iast:
athavāpyupavāsena ekādaśyā divaukasaḥ /
ṛkṣeṇa saṃyutāyāstu jyeṣṭhakuṇḍāplavena vā //
meaning:
अथवाप्युपवासेन एकादश्या दिवौकसः /
ऋक्षेण संयुतायास्तु ज्येष्ठकुण्डाप्लवेन वा //
text_mt: or by fasting on the Ekādaśī, O gods, / joined with the [appropriate] asterism, or by bathing in the Jyeṣṭhakuṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
śaukarasparśanā dvāpi naro devārcanena vā /
vyāhṛte kathitaṃ vipraiḥ seyamadya suniṣṭhurā //
meaning:
शौकरस्पर्शना द्वापि नरो देवार्चनेन वा /
व्याहृते कथितं विप्रैः सेयमद्य सुनिष्ठुरा //
text_mt: or by touching a boar, or by worship of the gods a man [is purified]. / When [such words] are uttered, it has been declared by the twice-born; but this woman today is exceedingly cruel,

sanskrit_iast:
bhojane pāpaniratā dine viṣṇordurāsade /
bharturvākyaṃ vyapohyaiva ghātayitvā sutaṃ priyam //
meaning:
भोजने पापनिरता दिने विष्णोर्दुरासदे /
भर्तुर्वाक्यं व्यपोह्यैव घातयित्वा सुतं प्रियम् //
text_mt: devoted to the sin of eating on the day of Viṣṇu, which is difficult to observe, / casting aside the command of her husband, causing her dear son to be slain—

sanskrit_iast:
vākyajñaṃ vākyanirataṃ mātṝṇāṃ tu hite ratam /
viṣṇudharmapraloptrīyaṃ bahupāpasamanvitā //
meaning:
वाक्यज्ञं वाक्यनिरतं मातॄणां तु हिते रतम् /
विष्णुधर्मप्रलोप्त्रीयं बहुपापसमन्विता //
text_mt: a son who knew his words, was devoted to his words, and was devoted to the welfare of his mothers! / She is the destroyer of the religion of Viṣṇu, full of many sins!

sanskrit_iast:
naiṣā spṛśyāsti deveśāḥ kathamasyā varapradāḥ /
bhavanto nyāyayukteṣu dharmayukteṣu tatparāḥ //
meaning:
नैषा स्पृश्यास्ति देवेशाः कथमस्या वरप्रदाः /
भवन्तो न्याययुक्तेषु धर्मयुक्तेषु तत्पराः //
text_mt: She must not be touched, O lords of the gods! How can you be bestowers of boons upon her, / when you are intent upon those who possess justice and possess righteousness?

sanskrit_iast:
pālanaṃ pāpayuktasya na kurvanti divaukasaḥ /
dharmādhārāḥ smṛtā devā dharmo vedesamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
पालनं पापयुक्तस्य न कुर्वन्ति दिवौकसः /
धर्माधाराः स्मृता देवा धर्मो वेदेसमास्थितः //
text_mt: The celestials do not protect one who is joined with sin. / The gods are remembered as the foundations of righteousness, and righteousness is rooted in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaiḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhartuḥ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
yadbravīti patiḥ kiñcittatkāryamāviśaṅkayā //
meaning:
वेदैः शुश्रूषणं भर्तुः स्त्रीणां धर्मः प्रकीर्तितः /
यद्ब्रवीति पतिः किञ्चित्तत्कार्यमाविशङ्कया //
text_mt: By the Vedas, obedience to the husband is proclaimed as the duty of women. / Whatever the husband says, even a little, that must be done without hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ śuklamiti brūyātkṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇeti cāmarāḥ /
śuśrūṣā sā hi vijñeyā na śuśrūṣā hi sevanam //
meaning:
शुक्लं शुक्लमिति ब्रूयात्कृष्णं कृष्णेति चामराः /
शुश्रूषा सा हि विज्ञेया न शुश्रूषा हि सेवनम् //
text_mt: One should call white "white", and black "black", O immortals! / That indeed is to be known as obedience; mere attendance is not obedience.

sanskrit_iast:
bharturājñā hatā devā ātmājñāsthāpanecchayā /
tasmātpāpā na saṃdeho mohinī sarvayoṣitām /
satyasya sādhanārthāya śapathairyantrito nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
भर्तुराज्ञा हता देवा आत्माज्ञास्थापनेच्छया /
तस्मात्पापा न संदेहो मोहिनी सर्वयोषिताम् /
सत्यस्य साधनार्थाय शपथैर्यन्त्रितो नृपः //
text_mt: The husband's command was violated, O gods, out of a desire to establish her own command! / Therefore, without doubt, Mohinī is the most sinful of all women. / For the purpose of fulfilling truth, the king was bound by oaths.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vividhaṃ vākyaṃ sā naicchatputraghātinī /
tena mokṣaṃ gato rājā pāpamasyāṃ visṛjya ca //
meaning:
उवाच विविधं वाक्यं सा नैच्छत्पुत्रघातिनी /
तेन मोक्षं गतो राजा पापमस्यां विसृज्य च //
text_mt: He spoke various words, but that slayer of a son did not relent. / Thereby the king attained liberation, casting his sin upon her.

sanskrit_iast: seyaṃ pāpaśarīrā hi hatyāyutasamanvitā //
meaning: सेयं पापशरीरा हि हत्यायुतसमन्विता //
text_mt: This very woman, indeed, has a body of sin, accompanied by tens of thousands of slaughters—

sanskrit_iast:
dātāraṃ sarvadānānāṃ brahmaṇyaṃ haridaivatam /
prajārañjanaśīlaṃ ca harivāsarasevinam //
meaning:
दातारं सर्वदानानां ब्रह्मण्यं हरिदैवतम् /
प्रजारञ्जनशीलं च हरिवासरसेविनम् //
text_mt: [against] him who gave all gifts, was devoted to brāhmaṇas, had Hari as his deity, / whose nature was to delight his subjects, who observed the day of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
paradāreṣu niḥsnehaṃ viṣaye vigataspṛham /
parārthatyaktakāmaṃ ca sadā makhaniṣeviṇam //
meaning:
परदारेषु निःस्नेहं विषये विगतस्पृहम् /
परार्थत्यक्तकामं च सदा मखनिषेविणम् //
text_mt: who had no attachment to others' wives, who was free from longing for sense-objects, / who gave up desire for the sake of others, and who constantly attended sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
sadaiva duṣṭadamane vartamānaṃ dharātale /
vyasanaiḥ saptabhirghorairanākrāntaṃ mahīpatim //
meaning:
सदैव दुष्टदमने वर्तमानं धरातले /
व्यसनैः सप्तभिर्घोरैरनाक्रान्तं महीपतिम् //
text_mt: who was always engaged in subduing the wicked upon the surface of the earth, / the king who was unassailed by the seven terrible vices!'

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnirasya durācārā varayogyā kathaṃ bhavet /
yo 'syāḥ pakṣetu varteta devo vā dānavo 'pi vā //
meaning:
संनिरस्य दुराचारा वरयोग्या कथं भवेत् /
यो ऽस्याः पक्षेतु वर्तेत देवो वा दानवो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: "Having rejected [such a king], how could this wicked woman be fit for a boon? / Whoever takes her side, whether a god or a dānavā,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ cāpi bhasmasātkuryāṃ kṣaṇena surasattamāḥ /
mohinyā rakṣaṇe yastu prayatnaṃ kurute surāḥ //
meaning:
तं चापि भस्मसात्कुर्यां क्षणेन सुरसत्तमाः /
मोहिन्या रक्षणे यस्तु प्रयत्नं कुरुते सुराः //
text_mt: I shall reduce him too to ashes in an instant, O best of the gods! / O gods, whoever makes an effort to protect Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast: tasya tajjāyate pāpaṃ yanmohinyāṃ vyavasthitam //
meaning: तस्य तज्जायते पापं यन्मोहिन्यां व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt: upon him falls that sin which resides in Mohinī."

sanskrit_iast:
sa evamuktvā nṛpate dvijendraḥ saṃgṛhya pāṇau salilaṃ ca tīvram /
krodhena saṃvīkṣya vidhiprasūtāṃ cikṣepa tanmūrghnyanalaprakāśam //
meaning:
स एवमुक्त्वा नृपते द्विजेन्द्रः संगृह्य पाणौ सलिलं च तीव्रम् /
क्रोधेन संवीक्ष्य विधिप्रसूतां चिक्षेप तन्मूर्घ्न्यनलप्रकाशम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O king, that best of the twice-born took fierce water in his hand, / glared in anger at her who was born of Brahmā, and hurled it onto her head like blazing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣiptamātre salile mahīpa sadyaḥ prajajvāla ca taccharīram /
saṃpaśyatāṃ nākanivāsināṃ tu tṛṇyā yathā vahniśikhāvalīḍhā //
meaning:
निक्षिप्तमात्रे सलिले महीप सद्यः प्रजज्वाल च तच्छरीरम् /
संपश्यतां नाकनिवासिनां तु तृण्या यथा वह्निशिखावलीढा //
text_mt: As soon as the water was thrown, O king, her body immediately burst into flames / before the eyes of the heaven-dwellers, like dry grass licked by a flame of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
kopaṃ vibho saṃhara saṃhareti yāvadgiraḥ khe marutāṃ babhūvuḥ /
tāvatsa vahnirdvijavākyamṛṣṭo bhasmāvaśeṣāṃ pramadāṃ cakāra //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinī carite śāpaprāptirnāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
कोपं विभो संहर संहरेति यावद्गिरः खे मरुतां बभूवुः /
तावत्स वह्निर्द्विजवाक्यमृष्टो भस्मावशेषां प्रमदां चकार //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनी चरिते शापप्राप्तिर्नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Even as the words of the gods resounded in the sky, 'Restrain, restrain your anger, O lord!', / in that very moment the fire, stirred by the brāhmaṇa's words, reduced the woman to ashes.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Incurring of the Curse', in the story of Mohinī in the Uttarabhadra of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
mohinī mohamutsṛjya gatā vibudhamandiram /
bhartsitā devadūtena sthitiste 'tra na pāpinī //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
मोहिनी मोहमुत्सृज्य गता विबुधमन्दिरम् /
भर्त्सिता देवदूतेन स्थितिस्ते ऽत्र न पापिनी //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having cast off delusion, Mohinī went to the dwelling of the gods. / Rebuked by a messenger of the gods, [she was told:] 'There is no place for you here, sinful woman!

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaśīle sudurmedhe bhartṛnindāparāyaṇe /
harivāsaralopinyāṃ vāsaste na triviṣṭape //
meaning:
पापशीले सुदुर्मेधे भर्तृनिन्दापरायणे /
हरिवासरलोपिन्यां वासस्ते न त्रिविष्टपे //
text_mt: O wicked-natured one, utterly foolish, devoted to reviling your husband, / transgressor of the day of Hari, your dwelling is not in heaven!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmato vimukhānāṃ ca narake vāsa iṣyate /
evamuktvā tu tāṃ vāyuḥ krūraṃ vacanapadbhutam //
meaning:
धर्मतो विमुखानां च नरके वास इष्यते /
एवमुक्त्वा तु तां वायुः क्रूरं वचनपद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Dwelling in hell is ordained for those who turn away from dharma.' / Having spoken these cruel and harsh words to her, Vāyu,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayitvā ca daṇḍena prerayāmāsa yātanām /
evaṃ saṃtāḍitā rājan devadūtena mohinī //
meaning:
ताडयित्वा च दण्डेन प्रेरयामास यातनाम् /
एवं संताडिता राजन् देवदूतेन मोहिनी //
text_mt: striking [her] with a staff, dispatched her to torment. / Thus beaten, O king, by the messenger of the gods, Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadaṇḍaparābhūtā saṃprāptā narakaṃ nṛpa /
tatra dharmājñayā sā tu dūtaiḥ saṃtāḍitā ciram //
meaning:
ब्रह्मदण्डपराभूता संप्राप्ता नरकं नृप /
तत्र धर्माज्ञया सा तु दूतैः संताडिता चिरम् //
text_mt: overwhelmed by the staff of Brahman, arrived in hell, O king. / There, by the command of Dharma, she was beaten for a long time by the messengers.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu kramaśo gatvā narakeṣu nipātitā /
pāpe dharmāṅgadaḥ putro ghātitaḥ patipāṇinā //
meaning:
सर्वेषु क्रमशो गत्वा नरकेषु निपातिता /
पापे धर्माङ्गदः पुत्रो घातितः पतिपाणिना //
text_mt: She went through all the hells in turn and was cast down [in them]: / 'O sinful woman, your son Dharmāṅgada was slain by the hand of his father,

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā yatastato bhuṅkṣva kṛtakarmaphalaṃ tviha /
prajāhitaṃ sthiraprajñaṃ mahendravaruṇopamam //
meaning:
त्वया यतस्ततो भुङ्क्ष्व कृतकर्मफलं त्विह /
प्रजाहितं स्थिरप्रज्ञं महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम् //
text_mt: because of you! Therefore, reap here the fruit of your deeds! / Having slain a son devoted to the welfare of his subjects, firm in wisdom, equal to Mahendra and Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpādhipaṃ putraṃ hatvedṛkphalabhoginī /
prākṛtasyāpi putrasya hiṃsāyāṃ brahmahā bhavet //
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपाधिपं पुत्रं हत्वेदृक्फलभोगिनी /
प्राकृतस्यापि पुत्रस्य हिंसायां ब्रह्महा भवेत् //
text_mt: the ruler of seven continents, you reap such fruit! / By killing even an ordinary son one becomes a slayer of a brāhmaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punarddharmayuktasya pāpe dharmāṅgadasya ca /
evaṃ nirbhatsitā dūtairyamasya nṛpasattama //
meaning:
किं पुनर्द्धर्मयुक्तस्य पापे धर्माङ्गदस्य च /
एवं निर्भत्सिता दूतैर्यमस्य नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: how much more [for killing] the righteous Dharmāṅgada, O sinful woman!' / Thus rebuked by Yama's messengers, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
bubhuje yātanāḥ sarvāḥ kramaśaḥ śamanoditāḥ /
brahmadaṇḍahatāyāstu dehasparśena yātanāḥ //
meaning:
बुभुजे यातनाः सर्वाः क्रमशः शमनोदिताः /
ब्रह्मदण्डहतायास्तु देहस्पर्शेन यातनाः //
text_mt: she experienced all the torments ordained by Yama in succession. / But through contact with the body of her who was struck by the staff of Brahman, the torments

sanskrit_iast:
jvalitāṅgā babhūvustā dhāraṇāya na tu kṣamāḥ /
tataste narakā rājan dharmarājamupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ज्वलिताङ्गा बभूवुस्ता धारणाय न तु क्षमाः /
ततस्ते नरका राजन् धर्मराजमुपागताः //
text_mt: themselves caught fire and were unable to endure her. / Then, O king, those hells approached Dharmarāja;

sanskrit_iast:
procuḥ prāñjalayo bhītāstadaṅgasparśapīḍitāḥ /
devadeva jagannātha dharmarāja dayāṃ kuru //
meaning:
प्रोचुः प्राञ्जलयो भीतास्तदङ्गस्पर्शपीडिताः /
देवदेव जगन्नाथ धर्मराज दयां कुरु //
text_mt: with folded hands, terrified and tormented by contact with her limbs, they said: / 'O god of gods, O lord of the universe, O Dharmarāja, have mercy!

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ niḥsārayāśu tvaṃ yātanābhyaḥ sukhāya naḥ /
yasyāḥ sparśanato nātha bhasmabhūtāḥ kṣaṇādaho //
meaning:
इमां निःसारयाशु त्वं यातनाभ्यः सुखाय नः /
यस्याः स्पर्शनतो नाथ भस्मभूताः क्षणादहो //
text_mt: Quickly cast her out from the torments for our comfort! / O lord, from her touch, alas, in an instant

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyāmastatastvenāṃ narakebhyo vivāsaya /
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ dharmarājo 'tivismitaḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यामस्ततस्त्वेनां नरकेभ्यो विवासय /
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां धर्मराजो ऽतिविस्मितः //
text_mt: we shall be reduced to ashes; therefore banish her from the hells!' / Hearing those words of theirs, Dharmarāja was utterly astonished.

sanskrit_iast:
dūtānsvānpratyuvāceyaṃ niḥsāryā mama mandirāt /
yo brahmadaṇḍanirdagdhaḥ pumān strī vā ca taskaraḥ //
meaning:
दूतान्स्वान्प्रत्युवाचेयं निःसार्या मम मन्दिरात् /
यो ब्रह्मदण्डनिर्दग्धः पुमान् स्त्री वा च तस्करः //
text_mt: He spoke to his messengers: 'She must be cast out from my dwelling! / Any man, woman, or thief who is burned by the staff of Brahman—

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pāpasya saṃsparśaṃ necchati yātanā mama /
tasmādimāṃ mahāpāpāṃ bharturvacanalopinīm //
meaning:
तस्य पापस्य संस्पर्शं नेच्छति यातना मम /
तस्मादिमां महापापां भर्तुर्वचनलोपिनीम् //
text_mt: my torment does not desire contact with that sinner. / Therefore, this great sinner who violated her husband's word,

sanskrit_iast:
putraghnīṃ dharmahantrīṃ ca brahmadaṇḍahatāmapi /
niḥsārayata me bāpi deho jvalati darśaṃnāt //
meaning:
पुत्रघ्नीं धर्महन्त्रीं च ब्रह्मदण्डहतामपि /
निःसारयत मे बापि देहो ज्वलति दर्शंनात् //
text_mt: the slayer of her son, the destroyer of dharma, struck as she is by the staff of Brahman— / expel her, for my body burns even at the sight [of her]!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāste tadā dūtā dharmarājena bhūpate /
praharanto 'straśastraiśca bahiścakruryamakṣayāt //
meaning:
इत्युक्तास्ते तदा दूता धर्मराजेन भूपते /
प्रहरन्तो ऽस्त्रशस्त्रैश्च बहिश्चक्रुर्यमक्षयात् //
text_mt: Thus addressed at that time by Dharmarāja, O king, the messengers, / striking her with missiles and weapons, cast her out of Yama's realm.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā duḥkhitā rājan mohinī mohasaṃyutā /
pātālaṃ prayayau tatra pātālasthairnivāritā //
meaning:
ततः सा दुःखिता राजन् मोहिनी मोहसंयुता /
पातालं प्रययौ तत्र पातालस्थैर्निवारिता //
text_mt: Then, O king, that grieving Mohinī, filled with confusion, / went to Pātāla, and there she was turned away by the dwellers of Pātāla.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu vrīḍitātyarthaḥ mohinī brahmaṇaḥ sutā /
janakasyāntikaṃ gatvā duḥkhaṃ svaṃ saṃnyavedayat //
meaning:
ततस्तु व्रीडितात्यर्थः मोहिनी ब्रह्मणः सुता /
जनकस्यान्तिकं गत्वा दुःखं स्वं संन्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: Thereupon exceedingly ashamed, Mohinī, the daughter of Brahmā, / went to her father and reported her sorrow:

sanskrit_iast:
tāta tannāsti me sthānaṃ trailokye sacarā care /
yatra yatra tu gacchāmi tatra tatra kṣipanti mām //
meaning:
तात तन्नास्ति मे स्थानं त्रैलोक्ये सचरा चरे /
यत्र यत्र तु गच्छामि तत्र तत्र क्षिपन्ति माम् //
text_mt: "Father, there is no place for me in the three worlds of mobile and immobile beings; / wherever I go, they cast me out from there.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ nirvāsitā lokairghātayitvāyudhairdṛḍham /
bhavadājñāṃ samādāya gatā rukmavibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
अहं निर्वासिता लोकैर्घातयित्वायुधैर्दृढम् /
भवदाज्ञां समादाय गता रुक्मविभूषणम् //
text_mt: I have been banished by the worlds, violently beaten with weapons. / Carrying out your command, I went to Rukmāṅgada;

sanskrit_iast:
mayā vyavasitaṃ cedaṃ sarvalokavigarhitam /
kleśayitvā tu bhartāraṃ putraṃ hatvā varāsinā //
meaning:
मया व्यवसितं चेदं सर्वलोकविगर्हितम् /
क्लेशयित्वा तु भर्तारं पुत्रं हत्वा वरासिना //
text_mt: and this act condemned by all the world was undertaken by me: / having afflicted my husband and slain my son with an excellent sword,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāvalīṃ kṣobhayitvā pitaḥ prāptā daśā mimām /
na gatirvidyate deva pāpāyā mama sāṃpratam //
meaning:
संध्यावलीं क्षोभयित्वा पितः प्राप्ता दशा मिमाम् /
न गतिर्विद्यते देव पापाया मम सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: and having agitated Saṃdhyāvalī, O father, I have fallen into this state. / There is now no refuge for me, a sinner, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣāddvijaśāpena jātāhaṃ duḥkhabhāginī /
vipravākyahatānā ca dagdhānāṃ citrabhānunā //
meaning:
विशेषाद्द्विजशापेन जाताहं दुःखभागिनी /
विप्रवाक्यहताना च दग्धानां चित्रभानुना //
text_mt: Especially through the curse of the brāhmaṇa, I have become an heir to sorrow. / For those struck down by a brāhmaṇa's word, burned by fire,

sanskrit_iast:
divākīrtihatānāṃ ca bhakṣitānāṃ mṛgādibhiḥ /
śatahradāvipannānāṃ muktidā svarṇadī pitaḥ //
meaning:
दिवाकीर्तिहतानां च भक्षितानां मृगादिभिः /
शतह्रदाविपन्नानां मुक्तिदा स्वर्णदी पितः //
text_mt: slain by outcasts, eaten by beasts and the like, / or killed by lightning, the golden river [Gaṅgā] gives liberation, O father.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ vipraṃ taṃ śāpadāyinam /
prasādayasi matprītyā tarhi me vihitā gatiḥ //
meaning:
यदि त्वं त्रिदशैः सार्द्धं विप्रं तं शापदायिनम् /
प्रसादयसि मत्प्रीत्या तर्हि मे विहिता गतिः //
text_mt: If you, together with the thirty [gods], propitiate that brāhmaṇa who gave the curse, / out of love for me, then a refuge will be provided for me."

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ rājan brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
śivendradharmasūryāgnideveśairmunibhiryutaḥ //
meaning:
तां तथावादिनीं राजन् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
शिवेन्द्रधर्मसूर्याग्निदेवेशैर्मुनिभिर्युतः //
text_mt: When she spoke thus, O king, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / accompanied by the sages and the lords of the gods—Śiva, Indra, Dharma, Sūrya, and Agni—

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīmagrataḥ kṛtvā jagāma dvijasannidhau /
tatra gatvā mahīpāla brahmā devādibhirvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मोहिनीमग्रतः कृत्वा जगाम द्विजसन्निधौ /
तत्र गत्वा महीपाल ब्रह्मा देवादिभिर्वृतः //
text_mt: putting Mohinī in front, went into the presence of the brāhmaṇa. / Having gone there, O king, Brahmā, surrounded by the gods and others,

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā gauraveṇāpi namaścakre svayaṃ vidhiḥ /
bhūpa rudrādidevaistu pūjyo mānyaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
महता गौरवेणापि नमश्चक्रे स्वयं विधिः /
भूप रुद्रादिदेवैस्तु पूज्यो मान्यः पितामहः //
text_mt: personally bowed with great respect. / O king, the grandfather who is worshiped and honored even by Rudra and the other gods,

sanskrit_iast:
mohinīprītaye mugdhaḥ svayaṃ cakre namaskriyām /
kārye mahati saṃprāpte hyasādhye bhuvanatraye //
meaning:
मोहिनीप्रीतये मुग्धः स्वयं चक्रे नमस्क्रियाम् /
कार्ये महति संप्राप्ते ह्यसाध्ये भुवनत्रये //
text_mt: infatuated with love for Mohinī, performed obeisance himself. / When a great matter has arisen that is impossible to achieve in the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
na dūṣitaṃ bhavedbhūpa yaviṣṭhasyābhivādanam /
sa dvijo vedavedāṅgaparagastapasi sthitaḥ //
meaning:
न दूषितं भवेद्भूप यविष्ठस्याभिवादनम् /
स द्विजो वेदवेदाङ्गपरगस्तपसि स्थितः //
text_mt: it is not a fault, O king, to salute a younger one. / That brāhmaṇa, who was a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and devoted to austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprekṣya lokakartāraṃ devaiḥ saha samāgatam /
samutthāya namaścakre brahmāṇaṃ tānmunīnsurān //
meaning:
संप्रेक्ष्य लोककर्तारं देवैः सह समागतम् /
समुत्थाय नमश्चक्रे ब्रह्माणं तान्मुनीन्सुरान् //
text_mt: seeing the creator of the worlds arrived together with the gods, / arose and bowed to Brahmā, those sages, and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsayāmāsa bhaktyā ca stutiṃ cakre 'bjajanmanaḥ /
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān lokakarttā jagadguruḥ //
meaning:
वासयामास भक्त्या च स्तुतिं चक्रे ऽब्जजन्मनः /
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् लोककर्त्ता जगद्गुरुः //
text_mt: He seated them with devotion and offered praise to the lotus-born [Brahmā]. / Then the blessed creator of the worlds, the teacher of the universe, pleased,

sanskrit_iast:
te dvijaṃ prārthayāmāsurmohinyarthe nṛpārcitam /
tāta vipra sadācāra paralokopakāraka //
meaning:
ते द्विजं प्रार्थयामासुर्मोहिन्यर्थे नृपार्चितम् /
तात विप्र सदाचार परलोकोपकारक //
text_mt: and those [gods] made a request of the brāhmaṇa worshiped by the king, for the sake of Mohinī: / 'Child, O brāhmaṇa of virtuous conduct, who confers benefits in the other world,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsiṃdho mohinīgatido bhava /
mayā saṃpreṣitā brahman rukmāṅgadavimohane //
meaning:
कृपां कुरु कृपासिंधो मोहिनीगतिदो भव /
मया संप्रेषिता ब्रह्मन् रुक्माङ्गदविमोहने //
text_mt: show mercy, O ocean of mercy, and provide a destination for Mohinī! / She was sent by me, O brāhmaṇa, to bewitch Rukmāṅgada—

sanskrit_iast:
sutā me yamalokaṃ tu śūnyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mānada /
vaikuṇṭhaṃ saṃkulaṃ prekṣya lokaiḥ sarvairni rākulaiḥ //
meaning:
सुता मे यमलोकं तु शून्यं दृष्ट्वा च मानद /
वैकुण्ठं संकुलं प्रेक्ष्य लोकैः सर्वैर्नि राकुलैः //
text_mt: my daughter, O honor-giver, seeing the realm of Yama empty / and seeing Vaikuṇṭha crowded with all kinds of tranquil beings,

sanskrit_iast:
manasotpāditā devī devānāṃ hitakāriṇī /
niśāmaya dharādeva yadbravīmi tavāgrataḥ //
meaning:
मनसोत्पादिता देवी देवानां हितकारिणी /
निशामय धरादेव यद्ब्रवीमि तवाग्रतः //
text_mt: was produced by the mind as a goddess acting for the welfare of the gods. / Listen, O earthly god, to what I speak before you:

sanskrit_iast:
gatiṃ dharmasyātisūkṣmāṃ lokakalyāṇakāriṇīm /
anayā nikaṣāśyāṅgyā parīkṣya svarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
गतिं धर्मस्यातिसूक्ष्मां लोककल्याणकारिणीम् /
अनया निकषाश्याङ्ग्या परीक्ष्य स्वर्णभूषणः //
text_mt: having tested the very subtle course of dharma that brings welfare to the world / by means of this woman whose limbs are dark like a touchstone, Rukmāṅgada,

sanskrit_iast:
sadāraḥ sasuto brahmanprāpito harimandiram /
rājñāprahatayā bhaktyā harivāsarapālanāt //
meaning:
सदारः ससुतो ब्रह्मन्प्रापितो हरिमन्दिरम् /
राज्ञाप्रहतया भक्त्या हरिवासरपालनात् //
text_mt: along with his wife and son, O brāhmaṇa, has been brought to the abode of Hari / on account of the king's observance of the day of Hari with unswerving devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ yamasthānaṃ lipimārjanakarmaṇā /
devāpakāro viprarṣe na kṣamo bāhujanmanā //
meaning:
कृतं शून्यं यमस्थानं लिपिमार्जनकर्मणा /
देवापकारो विप्रर्षे न क्षमो बाहुजन्मना //
text_mt: The abode of Yama has been emptied by the act of wiping away the written record. / Harm to the gods, O brāhmaṇa-seer, cannot be tolerated by a Kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast: bhūsurāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇaṃ yātāste tatsahāyakāḥ //
meaning: भूसुराणां विशेषेणं यातास्ते तत्सहायकाः //
text_mt: Especially [by harm] to brāhmaṇas, they have become their helpers.

sanskrit_iast:
na prāpyate sāṅghyavidā tu yacca nāṣṭāṅgayogena tu bhaktigamyam /
tatprāpitaṃ bhūsura bhūpabharturnijasya putrasya tathā sapatnyāḥ //
meaning:
न प्राप्यते साङ्घ्यविदा तु यच्च नाष्टाङ्गयोगेन तु भक्तिगम्यम् /
तत्प्रापितं भूसुर भूपभर्तुर्निजस्य पुत्रस्य तथा सपत्न्याः //
text_mt: What cannot be attained by a knower of Sāṅkhya nor by the eightfold yoga, but is reachable by devotion— / that, O brāhmaṇa, was brought to the sovereign king, to her own son, and to her co-wife.

sanskrit_iast:
yatpuṇyaśīlasya nṛpasya bhūpaśiromaṇerācaritaṃ pratīpam /
tatpāpavegena babhūva vidrutā bhasmāvaśeṣā tava śāpadagdhā //
meaning:
यत्पुण्यशीलस्य नृपस्य भूपशिरोमणेराचरितं प्रतीपम् /
तत्पापवेगेन बभूव विद्रुता भस्मावशेषा तव शापदग्धा //
text_mt: Because she acted contrary to the king of virtuous conduct, the crest-gem of monarchs, / she was consumed by the force of that sin, reduced to ashes, burnt by your curse.

sanskrit_iast:
devārthameṣā bhavavarddhanārthaṃ nṛpopakārāya ca saṃpravṛttā /
na svārthakāmā labhate 'vamānaṃ kathaṃ dvijāto 'pakṛtiṃ kṣamasva //
meaning:
देवार्थमेषा भववर्द्धनार्थं नृपोपकाराय च संप्रवृत्ता /
न स्वार्थकामा लभते ऽवमानं कथं द्विजातो ऽपकृतिं क्षमस्व //
text_mt: She acted for the sake of the gods, for the flourishing of worldly existence, and for the benefit of the king; / she did not desire her own selfish end. Why should she suffer humiliation? Forgive the offense, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
dayāṃ kuruṣva praśamaṃ bhajasva piṣṭasya peṣo nahi nītiyuktaḥ /
śāpapradānenanipātiteyaṃ kuru prasādaṃ gatido bhavatvam /
yasminkṛte brāhmaṇa mohinīyaṃ buddhiṃ tyajetkrūratarāṃ tvayījye //
meaning:
दयां कुरुष्व प्रशमं भजस्व पिष्टस्य पेषो नहि नीतियुक्तः /
शापप्रदानेननिपातितेयं कुरु प्रसादं गतिदो भवत्वम् /
यस्मिन्कृते ब्राह्मण मोहिनीयं बुद्धिं त्यजेत्क्रूरतरां त्वयीज्ये //
text_mt: Show compassion, resort to tranquility; grinding what is already ground is not fitting conduct. / She has been struck down by the hurling of a curse; bestow favor, become the granter of her destiny, / so that, when this is done, O brāhmaṇa, this Mohinī may cast aside her crueler intent toward you, O venerable one!

sanskrit_iast:
sa evamuktaḥ kamalāsanena vimṛśya buddhyā visasarja kopam /
uvāca devaṃ tridaśādhināthaṃ vimohinīdehakṛtaṃ dvijendraḥ //
meaning:
स एवमुक्तः कमलासनेन विमृश्य बुद्ध्या विससर्ज कोपम् /
उवाच देवं त्रिदशाधिनाथं विमोहिनीदेहकृतं द्विजेन्द्रः //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the lotus-seated Brahmā, reflecting with his intellect, he abandoned his anger. / The best of the twice-born spoke to the lord of the thirty [gods] regarding the body of Mohinī:

sanskrit_iast:
bahupāpayutā deva mohinī tanayā tava /
na lokeṣu sthitistasmātprāṇibhiḥ saṃkuleṣu ca //
meaning:
बहुपापयुता देव मोहिनी तनया तव /
न लोकेषु स्थितिस्तस्मात्प्राणिभिः संकुलेषु च //
text_mt: "O god, your daughter Mohinī is full of much sin; / therefore, there is no place for her in the worlds crowded with living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā vimṛśya suciraṃ moddinyarthaṃ vicintitam /
taddāsyami tava prītyā tvaṃ hi pūjyataro mama //
meaning:
मया विमृश्य सुचिरं मोद्दिन्यर्थं विचिन्तितम् /
तद्दास्यमि तव प्रीत्या त्वं हि पूज्यतरो मम //
text_mt: Reflecting for a long time, I have thought about [a place for] Mohinī; / I shall give it out of love for you, for you are most venerable to me,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā tava vacaḥ satyaṃ mama cāpi sureśvara /
devakāryaṃ ca bhavitā mohinīkṛtatyameva ca //
meaning:
यथा तव वचः सत्यं मम चापि सुरेश्वर /
देवकार्यं च भविता मोहिनीकृतत्यमेव च //
text_mt: so that your word may be true and mine as well, O lord of gods; / the purpose of the gods will be accomplished, and Mohinī's duty also [fulfilled].

sanskrit_iast:
yannākrāntaṃ hi bhūtaughaistatsthāne mohinīsthitiḥ /
jaṅgamājaṅgamairbhūmirvyāptā dvīpavatī sadā //
meaning:
यन्नाक्रान्तं हि भूतौघैस्तत्स्थाने मोहिनीस्थितिः /
जङ्गमाजङ्गमैर्भूमिर्व्याप्ता द्वीपवती सदा //
text_mt: Where it is not overrun by the hosts of beings, in that place Mohinī shall dwell. / The earth, filled with islands, is ever pervaded by moving and unmoving beings,

sanskrit_iast:
talāni cāpi daityādyairākāśaḥ pakṣipūrvakaiḥ /
nākaḥ sukṛtibhirjīvairnarakāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
तलानि चापि दैत्याद्यैराकाशः पक्षिपूर्वकैः /
नाकः सुकृतिभिर्जीवैर्नरकाः पापकर्मभिः //
text_mt: the subterranean realms by Daityas and others, the sky by birds and the like, / heaven by meritorious souls, the hells by evil-doers,

sanskrit_iast:
jhaṣādyaiḥ sāgarā vyāptā naiṣvaspṛṣyāsthitistataḥ /
tato brahmā suraiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃmantrya nṛpasattama //
meaning:
झषाद्यैः सागरा व्याप्ता नैष्वस्पृष्यास्थितिस्ततः /
ततो ब्रह्मा सुरैः सर्वैः संमन्त्र्य नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: and the oceans are pervaded by large fish and others; therefore, there is no untouchable place in these." / Then Brahmā, having deliberated with all the gods, O best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca mohinīṃ devīṃ nāsti sthānaṃ tava kvacit /
tacchrutvā mohinī vākyaṃ piturājñāvidhāyinī //
meaning:
उवाच मोहिनीं देवीं नास्ति स्थानं तव क्वचित् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा मोहिनी वाक्यं पितुराज्ञाविधायिनी //
text_mt: spoke to goddess Mohinī: "There is no place for you anywhere." / Hearing that speech, Mohinī, obedient to her father's command,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca praṇatā sarvān harivāsaranāśinī /
purodhasā sametāno devānāṃ lokasākṣiṇām //
meaning:
उवाच प्रणता सर्वान् हरिवासरनाशिनी /
पुरोधसा समेतानो देवानां लोकसाक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: bowed down and spoke to all the gods, the witnesses of the worlds, accompanied by their priest, / she who had destroyed the day of Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatāṃ tridaśaśreṣṭhā eṣa baddho mayāñjaliḥ /
praṇipātaśatenāpi prasannena hṛdā surāḥ //
meaning:
भवतां त्रिदशश्रेष्ठा एष बद्धो मयाञ्जलिः /
प्रणिपातशतेनापि प्रसन्नेन हृदा सुराः //
text_mt: "O best of the thirty [gods], my hands are joined in reverence to you. / Even with a hundred prostrations, O gods, with a gracious heart,

sanskrit_iast:
dātavyaṃ yācitaṃ maṃhyaṃ sarveṣāṃ prītikārakam /
ekādaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa sarveṣāṃ pāpināṃ gatiḥ //
meaning:
दातव्यं याचितं मंह्यं सर्वेषां प्रीतिकारकम् /
एकादश्याः प्रभावेण सर्वेषां पापिनां गतिः //
text_mt: what is begged by me, which brings pleasure to all, should be granted: / by the power of the ekādaśī, the salvation of all sinners

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyate tāṃ suraśreṣṭhā vardhituṃ me prayojanam /
patiḥ sapatnī putraśca mayā vaikuṇṭhagāḥ kṛtāḥ //
meaning:
साध्यते तां सुरश्रेष्ठा वर्धितुं मे प्रयोजनम् /
पतिः सपत्नी पुत्रश्च मया वैकुण्ठगाः कृताः //
text_mt: is accomplished; my purpose, O best of gods, is to increase that [sin]. / My husband, co-wife, and son were sent to Vaikuṇṭha by me,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrloke vidhavādyāhaṃ vartāmi bhavatāṃ kṛte /
yathā haridinaṃ duṣṭaṃ jāyate mama mānadāḥ //
meaning:
भूर्लोके विधवाद्याहं वर्तामि भवतां कृते /
यथा हरिदिनं दुष्टं जायते मम मानदाः //
text_mt: and on the mortal earth I remain today a widow for your sake. / O givers of honor, so that the day of Hari may become corrupted for me,

sanskrit_iast:
etatprayāce dadata svārthārthaṃ taddhi nānyathā //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge mohinīcarite ṣaṭtriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत्प्रयाचे ददत स्वार्थार्थं तद्धि नान्यथा //
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे मोहिनीचरिते षट्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
I beg this: grant it for your own purpose, for that is not otherwise."

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter in the Uttarabhāga of the glorious Bṛhannāradīyapurāṇa, in the story of Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
mohinyuvāca
ekādaśīsamaṃ devāḥ pāvanaṃ nāparaṃ bhavet /
yayā pūtā mahāpāpā gacchanti harimandiram //
meaning:
मोहिन्युवाच
एकादशीसमं देवाः पावनं नापरं भवेत् /
यया पूता महापापा गच्छन्ति हरिमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Mohinī said: / "O gods, there can be no purifier equal to the Ekādaśī, / purified by which even great sinners go to the abode of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamīpe mama sthānaṃ yuktaṃ bhāti vicāryatām /
devā ūcuḥ
vedho niśīthe devānāmupakārāya mohinī //
meaning:
तत्समीपे मम स्थानं युक्तं भाति विचार्यताम् /
देवा ऊचुः
वेधो निशीथे देवानामुपकाराय मोहिनी //
text_mt: "A place near that seems fitting for me; let it be considered." / The gods said: / "O Brahmā, for the benefit of the gods at midnight, Mohinī [was created].

sanskrit_iast:
sūryodaye surāṇāṃ ca hariṇā parikalpitaḥ /
pāraṇaṃ ca trayodaśyāmupavāsavināśanam //
meaning:
सूर्योदये सुराणां च हरिणा परिकल्पितः /
पारणं च त्रयोदश्यामुपवासविनाशनम् //
text_mt: And at sunrise for the gods, it was ordained by Hari; / and breaking the fast on the thirteenth day destroys the fast.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādvādaśikā hyaṣṭau yāḥ smṛtā vaiṣṇavāgame /
tāstu hyekādaśībhinnā upoṣyante ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ //
meaning:
महाद्वादशिका ह्यष्टौ याः स्मृता वैष्णवागमे /
तास्तु ह्येकादशीभिन्ना उपोष्यन्ते च वैष्णवैः //
text_mt: Indeed, the eight Mahādvādaśīs that are taught in the Vaiṣṇava scripture, / these are separate from the ekādaśī and are fasted upon by Vaiṣṇavas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśīvrataṃ bhinnaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām /
nityaṃ pakṣadvaye proktaṃ vidhinā tridinātmake //
meaning:
एकादशीव्रतं भिन्नं वैष्णवानां महात्मनाम् /
नित्यं पक्षद्वये प्रोक्तं विधिना त्रिदिनात्मके //
text_mt: The fast of ekādaśī is separate for the great-souled Vaiṣṇavas; / it is declared as a regular duty in both fortnights, according to the rule of a three-day period.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ prātastyajedbhuktiṃ kramātpūrvāparāhṇayoḥ /
ekādaśī yadā bhinnā upoṣyā hi pare 'hani /
dvādaśyāṃ hi vrataṃ kāryaṃ niraṃbu samupoṣaṇam //
meaning:
सायं प्रातस्त्यजेद्भुक्तिं क्रमात्पूर्वापराह्णयोः /
एकादशी यदा भिन्ना उपोष्या हि परे ऽहनि /
द्वादश्यां हि व्रतं कार्यं निरंबु समुपोषणम् //
text_mt: One should give up food in the evening and morning, successively, in the forenoon and afternoon; / when the ekādaśī is broken, the fast must be observed on the next day; / indeed, on the twelfth day, the fast should be undertaken without water.

sanskrit_iast:
laṅghane tvasamarthānāṃ jalaṃ śākaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ /
naivedyaṃ vā hareḥ proktaṃ svāhārātpādasaṃmitam //
meaning:
लङ्घने त्वसमर्थानां जलं शाकं फलं पयः /
नैवेद्यं वा हरेः प्रोक्तं स्वाहारात्पादसंमितम् //
text_mt: For those unable to fast completely: water, herbs, fruit, milk, / or Hari's food-offering is prescribed, measured as a fourth part of one's usual meal.

sanskrit_iast:
svātī sūryodaye viddho tyajantyakādaśīṃ sati /
niṣkāmā madhyarātre ca viddhāṃ muñcanti yāmyayā //
meaning:
स्वाती सूर्योदये विद्धो त्यजन्त्यकादशीं सति /
निष्कामा मध्यरात्रे च विद्धां मुञ्चन्ति याम्यया //
text_mt: When it is pierced at sunrise by the constellation Svātī, O virtuous lady, they abandon the ekādaśī; / and those free from desire abandon it when it is pierced at midnight by the constellation of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣvapi tu lokeṣu viditā daśamī tithiḥ /
yamasya tasyāḥ prānti tu sthitiḥ kāryā tvayānaghe //
meaning:
सर्वेष्वपि तु लोकेषु विदिता दशमी तिथिः /
यमस्य तस्याः प्रान्ति तु स्थितिः कार्या त्वयानघे //
text_mt: The tenth lunar day is known in all worlds / as belonging to Yama; at its end, O sinless one, your stay is to be made.

sanskrit_iast:
etena devakāryaṃ ca siddhaṃ bhavati śobhane /
sūryenducārā tithyāstu daśamyāḥ prāntagāminī //
meaning:
एतेन देवकार्यं च सिद्धं भवति शोभने /
सूर्येन्दुचारा तिथ्यास्तु दशम्याः प्रान्तगामिनी //
text_mt: By this, the work of the gods will also be accomplished, O lovely one. / Following the course of the sun and moon, it goes to the end of the tenth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvi tīrthāni caiva tvaṃ svāghanāśāya saṃcara /
aruṇodayamārabhya yāvatsūryodayo bhavet //
meaning:
भुवि तीर्थानि चैव त्वं स्वाघनाशाय संचर /
अरुणोदयमारभ्य यावत्सूर्योदयो भवेत् //
text_mt: Roam about the sacred fords on earth for the destruction of your own sin, / starting from dawn until sunrise takes place.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantastvaṃ vrate prāptā labhasvaikādaśīphalam /
yaḥ kaścitkurute viddhaṃ tvayā hyekādaśīvratam //
meaning:
तदन्तस्त्वं व्रते प्राप्ता लभस्वैकादशीफलम् /
यः कश्चित्कुरुते विद्धं त्वया ह्येकादशीव्रतम् //
text_mt: Entering into the observance within that [interval], obtain the fruit of ekādaśī. / Whosoever undertakes the fast of ekādaśī pierced by you,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tīpakārakastubhyaṃ bhaviṣyati surapriye /
muhūrtadvayamātraṃ tu jñeyaṃ cātrāruṇodayam //
meaning:
स तीपकारकस्तुभ्यं भविष्यति सुरप्रिये /
मुहूर्तद्वयमात्रं तु ज्ञेयं चात्रारुणोदयम् //
text_mt: he will be a benefactor to you, O beloved of the gods! / The dawn here is to be understood as measuring just two muhūrtas.

sanskrit_iast:
mūhūrtāḥ pañcadaśa ca smṛtā rātrerdinasya ca /
jñeyāste hrasvadīrghatve trairāśika vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
मूहूर्ताः पञ्चदश च स्मृता रात्रेर्दिनस्य च /
ज्ञेयास्ते ह्रस्वदीर्घत्वे त्रैराशिक विधानतः //
text_mt: Fifteen muhūrtas are remembered for the night and for the day; / they should be known in their shortness or length by the method of the rule of three.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśānmuhūrtānttu rātrairūrddhvā samāgatā /
sabdhvopavāsināṃ puṇyaṃ svasthā bhava śucismite //
meaning:
त्रयोदशान्मुहूर्तान्त्तु रात्रैरूर्द्ध्वा समागता /
सब्ध्वोपवासिनां पुण्यं स्वस्था भव शुचिस्मिते //
text_mt: Having arrived beyond the thirteenth muhūrta of the night, / obtain the merit of those who fast, and be at ease, O sweet-smiling one!

sanskrit_iast:
yamasaṃsthāpanārthāya vaikuṇṭhadhvaṃsanāya ca /
pākhaṇḍānāṃ vivṛddhyarthaṃ pāpasaṃcanāya ca //
meaning:
यमसंस्थापनार्थाय वैकुण्ठध्वंसनाय च /
पाखण्डानां विवृद्ध्यर्थं पापसंचनाय च //
text_mt: For the purpose of establishing Yama, for the destruction of Vaikuṇṭha, / for the increase of heretics, and for the accumulation of sins,

sanskrit_iast: dattaṃ te mohini sthānaṃ pratyūṣasamayāṅkitam //
meaning: दत्तं ते मोहिनि स्थानं प्रत्यूषसमयाङ्कितम् //
text_mt: a place marked by the time of dawn has been given to you, O Mohinī!

sanskrit_iast:
viddhaṃ tvayaikādaśikāvrataṃ ye kurvanti kartāra iha prayatnāt /
teṣāṃ bhavedyatsukṛtaṃ śubhe phalaṃ bhuṅkṣva prasannā bhava bhūsure tvam //
meaning:
विद्धं त्वयैकादशिकाव्रतं ये कुर्वन्ति कर्तार इह प्रयत्नात् /
तेषां भवेद्यत्सुकृतं शुभे फलं भुङ्क्ष्व प्रसन्ना भव भूसुरे त्वम् //
text_mt: Whatever merit and auspicious fruit belongs to those who observe here with effort / the vow of ekādaśī pierced by you, enjoy that, O auspicious one, and be gracious to the brāhmaṇa!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pradiṣṭā kamalāsanādyaiḥ sā mohinī hṛṣṭatarā babhūva /
mene kṛtārthaṃ nijajīvitaṃ ca svapāpatīrthābhiniṣevaṇena //
meaning:
एवं प्रदिष्टा कमलासनाद्यैः सा मोहिनी हृष्टतरा बभूव /
मेने कृतार्थं निजजीवितं च स्वपापतीर्थाभिनिषेवणेन //
text_mt: Directed thus by the lotus-seated Brahmā and others, that Mohinī became overjoyed, / and she considered her life fulfilled by attending to her sacred ford of sin.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsādhitaṃ kāryamidaṃ surāṇāṃ bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ hi gate 'pi dehe /
caitanyamātre pavanātmake 'smin saṃmārjito bhūpakṛtastu panthāḥ //
meaning:
संसाधितं कार्यमिदं सुराणां भस्मावशेषं हि गते ऽपि देहे /
चैतन्यमात्रे पवनात्मके ऽस्मिन् संमार्जितो भूपकृतस्तु पन्थाः //
text_mt: "This task of the gods has been accomplished, even though my body has been reduced to ashes; / in this mere consciousness of the nature of wind, the path made by the king has been wiped away.

sanskrit_iast:
nītaṃ mayā cātmakṛtaṃ hi vākyaṃ prahṛṣṭayā vai yadudāhṛtaṃ hi /
evaṃ vimṛśya kṣiptipālade vānpraṇamya hṛṣṭā ca purodhasaṃ svam //
meaning:
नीतं मया चात्मकृतं हि वाक्यं प्रहृष्टया वै यदुदाहृतं हि /
एवं विमृश्य क्षिप्तिपालदे वान्प्रणम्य हृष्टा च पुरोधसं स्वम् //
text_mt: And I have brought about my own promise that was uttered when overjoyed." / Reflecting thus, having bowed to the kings, the gods, and her own priest, overjoyed,

sanskrit_iast:
prānte sthitā sūryavihīnasaṃjñe kāle daśamyā janamohanāya /
kṛcchrāntarūpā ca dinaṃ ca bhuṅkte prakṛṣṭarūpā narakāya nṝṇām //
meaning:
प्रान्ते स्थिता सूर्यविहीनसंज्ञे काले दशम्या जनमोहनाय /
कृच्छ्रान्तरूपा च दिनं च भुङ्क्ते प्रकृष्टरूपा नरकाय नॄणाम् //
text_mt: she stood at the end [of the tenth day], at the time known as devoid of sun, to delude people; / assuming the form of an ordeal, she consumes the day, appearing in an extraordinary form, for the hell of men.

sanskrit_iast:
prāntasthitāṃ tāṃ ravijo nirīkṣya prahṛṣṭavaktro vacanaṃ jagāda /
tvayā pratiṣṭhā mama cārunetre kṛtātra loke punareva samyak /
vibhodito rukmavibhūṣaṇasya mattebhasaṃsthaḥ paṭahaḥ sughaiṣaḥ //
meaning:
प्रान्तस्थितां तां रविजो निरीक्ष्य प्रहृष्टवक्त्रो वचनं जगाद /
त्वया प्रतिष्ठा मम चारुनेत्रे कृतात्र लोके पुनरेव सम्यक् /
विभोदितो रुक्मविभूषणस्य मत्तेभसंस्थः पटहः सुघैषः //
text_mt: Seeing her standing at the end, the son of the Sun [Yama], with a joyful face, spoke these words: / "By you, O fair-eyed one, my standing has been properly re-established in this world; / the loud-sounding drum of Rukmāṅgada, seated on a rutted elephant, has been silenced.

sanskrit_iast: dṛṣṭe kārye janaḥ sarvaḥ pratyayaṃ kurute tviti //
meaning: दृष्टे कार्ये जनः सर्वः प्रत्ययं कुरुते त्विति //
text_mt: For when a deed is seen, all people place their trust in it."

sanskrit_iast:
sūryodaya spṛṣā hyeṣā daśamī garhitā sadā /
aspṛṣṭamudayaṃ nṝṇāṃ mohanāya bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
सूर्योदय स्पृषा ह्येषा दशमी गर्हिता सदा /
अस्पृष्टमुदयं नॄणां मोहनाय भविष्यति //
text_mt: For this tenth day, when touching sunrise, is ever reviled; / untouched by sunrise, it shall serve to delude mankind.

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya tāṃ yatpriyayogabhuktiṃ pādasthitā sāpi hyadṛṣyarūpā /
satyaṃ hi te nāma viśālanetre yanmohinītyeva jano bravīti //
meaning:
विहाय तां यत्प्रिययोगभुक्तिं पादस्थिता सापि ह्यदृष्यरूपा /
सत्यं हि ते नाम विशालनेत्रे यन्मोहिनीत्येव जनो ब्रवीति //
text_mt: Leaving aside the enjoyment of union with her beloved, she stood at his feet, invisible in form. / Truly, O large-eyed woman, your name is fitting, since people call you Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
vimohayitvā hi janaṃ samastaṃ paṭe madīye likhitaṃ karoṣi /
ityeva muktvā tanayo vivasvataḥ praṇamya tāṃ brahmasutāṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ //
meaning:
विमोहयित्वा हि जनं समस्तं पटे मदीये लिखितं करोषि /
इत्येव मुक्त्वा तनयो विवस्वतः प्रणम्य तां ब्रह्मसुतां प्रहृष्टः //
text_mt: Having thoroughly deluded all people, you cause them to be recorded on my scroll.” / Having spoken thus, the son of Vivasvat bowed to that daughter of Brahmā, delighted,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma devaiḥ saha nākalokaṃ kare gṛhītvā lipilekhitāram /
gateṣu deveṣu vimohinī sā brahmāṇamāsādya surāsureśam //
meaning:
जगाम देवैः सह नाकलोकं करे गृहीत्वा लिपिलेखितारम् /
गतेषु देवेषु विमोहिनी सा ब्रह्माणमासाद्य सुरासुरेशम् //
text_mt: and went with the gods to the celestial world, taking by the hand his scribe of records. / When the gods had gone, that enchanting Mohinī approached Brahmā, the lord of gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāpayāmāsa pitaḥ purodhā mamāyamatyugrataraśca kopāt /
dagdhaṃ śarīraṃ mama lokanātha punaḥ prapatsye 'tha tathā kuruṣva //
meaning:
विज्ञापयामास पितः पुरोधा ममायमत्युग्रतरश्च कोपात् /
दग्धं शरीरं मम लोकनाथ पुनः प्रपत्स्ये ऽथ तथा कुरुष्व //
text_mt: and made a petition: “O Father, this family priest of mine, through extreme anger, / has burnt my body, O lord of the world! Make it so that I may attain it once again.

sanskrit_iast:
vimohitaṃ caiva jaganmayedaṃ prānte samāsthāya yamasya tithyāḥ /
jito hi rājñā śamanaḥ purādya kṛto jayī tāta tava prabhāvāt //
meaning:
विमोहितं चैव जगन्मयेदं प्रान्ते समास्थाय यमस्य तिथ्याः /
जितो हि राज्ञा शमनः पुराद्य कृतो जयी तात तव प्रभावात् //
text_mt: Indeed, this world was deluded by me, abiding at the end of the tithi of Yama. / Formerly Śamana was defeated by the king, but today, O father, he has been made victorious through your power.

sanskrit_iast:
tava kṛtyamidaṃ tāta yatpunardehadhāriṇī /
bhūyāmahaṃ jagannātha brahmaṇaṃ sāṃtyayasva bhoḥ //
meaning:
तव कृत्यमिदं तात यत्पुनर्देहधारिणी /
भूयामहं जगन्नाथ ब्रह्मणं सांत्ययस्व भोः //
text_mt: This is your task, O father, that I should once more become endowed with a body. / O lord of the world, please conciliate the brāhmaṇa!”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā mohinīvākyaṃ brahmā lokavidhānakṛt /
brāhmaṇaṃ sāṃtvayāmāsa punareva sutākṛte //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा मोहिनीवाक्यं ब्रह्मा लोकविधानकृत् /
ब्राह्मणं सांत्वयामास पुनरेव सुताकृते //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Mohinī, Brahmā, the ordainer of the worlds, / conciliated the brāhmaṇa once more for the sake of his daughter:

sanskrit_iast:
vaso tāta nibodhedaṃ yadbravīmi hitāvaham /
tava cāsyā mahābhāga sarvalokahitāya ca //
meaning:
वसो तात निबोधेदं यद्ब्रवीमि हितावहम् /
तव चास्या महाभाग सर्वलोकहिताय च //
